title_en: Systems and methods for generating homogenous mixtures of brewed beverages and active ingredients
abstract_en: Various techniques for generating substantially homogenous mixtures of nonpolar materials and aqueous solutions are disclosed herein. An example method includes generating a substantially homogenous mixture of an aqueous solution and a nonpolar material by flowing the aqueous solution through a porous substrate infused with the nonpolar material.

title_en: Caster wheel alignment system for conveyor system
abstract_en: A caster wheel alignment system for selectively re-orienting improperly oriented caster wheels for transport vehicles of a conveyor system, such as a circular sorter. The alignment system includes a main support frame couplable with the conveyor at a drive track of the conveyor. The system includes a horizontal cam for adjusting an orientation of the caster wheel from a leading orientation to a trailing orientation. In some forms, the alignment system may include a bypass system, such as a float frame, supporting the horizontal cam, and a vertical cam. The vertical cam provided to temporarily move the float frame and horizontal cam away from the transport vehicle and/or drive track to permit the vehicle to move through the alignment system. The vertical and horizontal cams coordinate to intercept and correct improperly oriented wheels without significantly impeding the movement of the transport vehicle along the drive track.

title_en: Beverage pouring device, beverage pouring method, and beverage pouring system
abstract_en: Provided is a beer pouring device in which cleaning is not required due to a beer flow path being configured by a disposable flexible tube; also provided is a device which can perform pouring of beer and pouring of foam by using one flexible tube. A beverage pouring device 1, which uses a combination of tubes 12 having elastically deformable flexible parts as a flow path for a beverage 20, comprises a mechanism 32 for selectively setting inner cavities of the flexible parts to a first state having a first cross-sectional area or a second state having a second cross-sectional area smaller than the first cross-sectional area, wherein foam is generated from the beverage flowing through the tubes when the inner cavities of the flexible parts are set to the second state.

title_en: Safe transportation system operations
abstract_en: Multiply redundant safety system(s) that protects humans and assets while fueling vehicles, and/or transferring /fueling/tank exchanging of on road/off road, marine, aircraft, spacecraft, rockets, and all other vehicles/vessels utilizing Compressed and/or Liquefied Gas Fuels/compound(s), utilizing Hydrogen and/or Natural Gas Chemical Family of Natural Gas/Propane/Butane/ethane/ammonia/and/or any/all compound(s)/mixtures along with and/or without, oxidizer(s), such as Liquefied Oxygen, Oxygen Triplet (O3)/ozone/hydrogen peroxide/peroxide/solid oxidizer(s). One or more processors in combination with one or more system(s)/one or more sensor(s); in combination with one or more micro switches/one or more outputs/ actuator(s) which combine to detect any leaks/fire(s)/explosion/voltage(s)/hazards/vehicle position/ motion/vessel motion(s)/reusable tank/exchange tank/position(s)/arc's, spark(s)/and/or other hazards for rapid mitigation by locking out/stopping fueling/gas transfers/vehicle releasing/transfer line releasing. For different levels of safety, multiple combination(s) of various sensor(s)/ detector(s)/ input(s)/output(s)/ device(s)/system(s)/ action(s)/actuators, all may be standing alone and/or in any combination can be utilized.

title_en: Fastener
abstract_en: The disclosure provides in a bolt receiver that can engage with a radially elongate head of a single-sided fastener. The bolt receiver comprises a body having a passage extending through the body, a floor extending from the passage, and a counter face associated with the floor. The radially elongate head of the single-sided fastener can pass through the passage in a first orientation but then engage with the counter face when rotated to a second orientation.

title_en: Respiratory equipment packaging and a packaging insert for respiratory equipment
abstract_en:
Packaging and insert for a respiratory interface assembly comprising a respiratory interface and headgear.  
The packaging includes a first pocket having a first opening comprising the respiratory interface and the 
headgear of the respiratory assembly, and a second pocket, adjacent the first pocket and having a second 
opening. The second pocket is configured to receive an auxiliary device for the respiratory interface 
assembly, eg. mask size measuring device. The insert supports the respiratory interface in an upright 
orientation and includes at least one slot configured to receive a strap of the headgear of the respiratory 
interface assembly.

title_en: Bottled water dispenser with a system for treating water in a bottle with uv radiation
abstract_en: A bottled water dispenser (1) with a system for treating water in a bottle (4) with UV radiation, containing a water intake finger (5) equipped with a source of UV radiation (25) and configured to open the bottle (4) sealed by a cap (6) by pushing a valve (7) installed in the centre of the cap (6) inside to the bottle (4) or by rupturing this valve, wherein a semiconductor LED is used as the source of UV radiation (25), the semiconductor LED is installed in a recess (24) made at the end face of the water intake finger (5), so that when the bottle (4) is opened with the water intake finger (5), the source (25) is inside the bottle (4), and the radiation of the source (25) is directed towards the water surface and towards the walls of the bottle, and wherein the semiconductor LED is protected by a quartz glass (29) covering the recess (24).

title_en: Lng export terminal
abstract_en: A near shore liquefied natural gas (LNG) export terminal includes an LNG storage unit, a jetty and a converted hydrocarbon carrier-vessel moored against the jetty. The carrier-vessel includes a hull, at least one hydrocarbon storage tank and is provided with a natural gas processing system for liquefying natural gas. Onshore produced natural gas is supplied through a first pipeline to the natural gas processing plant on the carrier-vessel and the LNG produced by the natural gas processing system is transferred from the carrier-vessel to the LNG storage unit via a second pipeline suitable for the transfer of cryogenic fluids.

title_en: Method for controlling a folding box machine for quality assurance purposes
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for controlling a folding box machine (100) comprising a plurality of machining stations (4, 6, 7, 15, 18, 30) and a plurality of control devices (17, 19, 20) for controlling the quality of folding boxes. Each control device (17, 19, 20) controls different quality features of each folding box, and each control device (17, 19, 20) transmits the result of the control to a control unit (32). Target values are stored in the control unit (32) in order to classify the control results into results which meet the quality standard and results which do not meet the quality standard, and a folding box is discharged depending on an evaluation. The method advantageously reduces waste.

title_en: Soft-sided insulated container with hard-sided liner
abstract_en: Abstract A soft-sided insulated container that has a rigid closure. The rigid closure has a first closure interface that is a passive friction fit in which one part wipes another. The rigid closure has a second closure interface that is an active closure in which a mechanical device, such as a latch or clamp, is used positively to energize a closure between different parts of the closure.  The soft-sided insulated container has a soft-sided external casing, and a rigid internal liner that includes a mating rigid lid.  There is a releasable securement that holds the liner in engagement with the casing, but that can be released to permit the casing to be extracted from the liner. The releasable securement is a one-way passively engageable securement.

title_en: Detachable centrifugal brake for lift equipment
abstract_en: A detachable centrifugal brake (1) provided for lift equipment, comprising a central core (2) linked to a rotation shaft attached to motor means, an inner drum (4) having a contact surface provided to come into contact with brake elements which act due to the effects of centrifugal force. Furthermore, releasable coupling means are provided for locking/unlocking the inner drum (4) with respect to a stationary portion externally enveloping the inner drum (4), such that in a first operating position the inner drum (4) is integrally coupled to the outer drum while in a second operating position the inner drum (4) is free to rotate on its own shaft by means of the arrangement of rotation means. The coupling means include actuation means which act on the coupling means.

title_en: Clip-on adaptor for inventory divider
abstract_en: An adaptor for facilitating mounting of a shelf divider for pivoting around an axis perpendicular to uniformly spaced apart wires of a shelf include a frame having side members that are fixedly spaced apart, an axle extending between the side members on which a shelf divider can be pivotably mounted, and snap-fit connectors configured to releasably secure the adaptor onto spaced apart parallel wires of a wire shelf.

title_en: Method and system for attaching articles to a carrier
abstract_en: A method of at least partially forming packages. The method comprises moving a blank and a plurality of articles in a downstream direction through a clipping station. The blank can comprise at least a first attachment panel, a second attachment panel, and a keel portion extending from the first attachment panel to the second attachment panel. The method further can comprise forming a clipped assembly by clipping the first attachment panel and the second attachment panel of the blank to respective articles of the plurality of articles during the moving the blank and the plurality of articles through the clipping station and forming a keel by moving articles of the plurality of articles toward one another and folding the keel portion of the blank between the articles as the clipped assembly is moved in the downstream direction.

title_en: Connecting device for mounting a holder for components of a conveying device and conveying device for transporting unit loads
abstract_en: The invention relates to a connecting device for fastening holders, in particular lateral guide holders (6), on a frame profile (3a, 3b) of a conveyor device (1) for transporting unit loads (2). The connecting device comprises an attachment arrangement and also an assembly limb (7), wherein the attachment arrangement is arranged on the holder, and the assembly limb (7) is arranged on the frame profile (3a, 3b). In order to fasten the attachment arrangement to the frame profile (3a, 3b), the attachment arrangement has a connecting element and a locking element, wherein the connecting element is introducible into a first cutout (8) in the assembly limb (7), wherein an axis of rotation is defined about which the attachment arrangement can be rotated until the locking element catches in a second cutout (8) in the assembly limb (7) and locks the connecting device.

title_en: Overhead crane and boom
abstract_en: A crane assembly containing a boom for an overhead crane and trolley contains an arm having a first vertical portion and an outer surface, the arm fixed to the crane for upper and lower movement of the arm, and the arm containing a second portion angularly extending from the vertical portion. An outer sleeve surrounds and is fixed to the vertical portion, wherein the outer sleeve is fixed to the trolley and extends about the arm thereby defining a plenum between the outer sleeve and the inner vertical arm. During operation, the arm is adapted to be vertically moved within said outer sleeve. A support beam is fixed to the trolley, and is hingedly connected to the outer sleeve. A drive assembly is connected to the outer sleeve for rotating the boom about the support beam.

title_en: Method and apparatus for erecting cartons and for order fulfilment and packing
abstract_en: A system and method of packing an order. A first sequence of bins corresponding to orders is transported on a first conveyor to a packing station. A case for each order is constructed by a case forming system, the case forming system able to construct cases from blanks of various sizes. The cases are transported from the case construction apparatus to the packing station in a second sequence, wherein the sequential order of the cases corresponds to the bins in the first sequence. The bin in the first sequence are brought to the packing station with the cases in the second sequence.

title_en: Rubbing transmission mechanism of intelligent hair washing robot
abstract_en: A rubbing transmission mechanism of an intelligent hair washing robot comprises a swinging mechanism, a swinging part, a rubbing part, a swinging rod and a transmission part, wherein the swinging part comprises a shell, the swinging rod is connected with the shell, the shell comprises an inner shell and an outer shell which are buckled together, an upper clamping plate is arranged in the shell, the upper clamping plate divides the inner part of the shell into a motor mounting area and a transmission mechanism mounting area, a motor is mounted in the motor mounting area, a lower clamping plate is arranged on the other side of the motor mounting area, the motor is clamped by the upper clamping plate and the lower clamping plate from two opposite sides of the motor, a power output shaft on the motor penetrates through the upper clamping plate to extend into the transmission mechanism mounting area and is in transmission connection with the transmission mechanism, and the transmission mechanism is in transmission connection with the transmission part; the upper clamping plate and the lower clamping plate are fixed together with the inner shell and the outer shell. The transmission mechanism can provide working power for the rubbing part well, so that the rubbing part can meet the hair washing requirement well.

title_en: Full-automatic boxing device of injection molding machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full-automatic boxing device of an injection molding machine, which comprises an injection molding machine body, and further comprises a boxing mechanism and a transplanting mechanism, wherein the boxing mechanism is positioned on the side edge of the injection molding machine body, and the transplanting mechanism is fixed on the injection molding machine body and is close to a discharge hole of the injection molding machine body.

title_en: Ball pin part lifting type stock bin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ball pin part lifting type storage bin which comprises a rack, wherein the storage bin is arranged on the rack, the storage bin comprises a material frame, a support is arranged below the material frame, the material frame is fixedly arranged on the rack through the support, the material frame comprises an end plate and a bottom plate, two sides of the bottom plate are provided with side plates connected with the end plate, the end parts of the side plates are provided with lugs, a rear baffle is arranged between the lugs of 2 side plates, a first matching hole and a second matching hole are formed in the position of the 2 side plates of the material frame, which is positioned at the rear baffle, and the second matching hole extends to the bottom plate of the material frame and is communicated with the outside. The ball pin part lifting device is reasonable in structure, can lift up ball pin parts while storing a large number of ball pin parts in various types, eliminates ball pin parts in incorrect directions, and is matched with an external manipulator to automatically load and unload the sorted ball pin parts.

title_en: Anti-falling safety protection device for uncontrolled elevator
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-falling safety protection device for an uncontrolled elevator, which comprises a ladder well, wherein an elevator car body is adaptively arranged in an inner cavity of the ladder well, an equipment installation well is integrally arranged at the bottom end of a well body of the ladder well, a plurality of liquid discharge guide holes are respectively arranged on left and right sides of a column body of a pressing buffering column and on a top plate of a box body corresponding to an oil storage tank, a supporting pressing edge horizontally and integrally extends outwards on the circumference of the outer side of the top end of a buffering concave basin body, a first elastic spring is sleeved on the outer side of a rod body of a guiding straight rod, three groups of second elastic springs are sequentially arranged in a cavity below the buffering concave basin body from left to right, and guiding telescopic rods are also adaptively arranged at the positions of the left and right sides of the second elastic springs and the lower positions corresponding to the buffering concave basin body. The invention realizes the function of dispersing the falling force of the upper elevator car body when an accident occurs, and ensures the safety of personnel in the car.

title_en: Bookbinding apparatus
abstract_en: The invention discloses a binding processing device and a paper processing system, wherein the binding processing device comprises: a stitch binding unit that forms a stitch binding portion that uses a stitch for binding a sheet bundle; a needle-less binding unit that forms a needle-less binding portion that does not use binding for a bundle of sheets; and a plurality of discharge rollers that discharge the bound sheet bundle. The distance between the needle-less binding portion and the center position of the plurality of discharge rollers is equal to or longer than the distance between the needle-less binding portion and the center position.

title_en: Three-jaw manipulator driven by rotary cylinder
abstract_en: The invention relates to a three-jaw manipulator driven by a rotary cylinder, which comprises a support shell, a sliding seat and three sliding blocks, wherein the sliding seat is covered and installed with the support shell, the three sliding blocks are arranged on the sliding seat, and each sliding block is provided with a clamping jaw; when the sliding seat and the supporting shell are covered and installed, a cavity is formed, a driving wheel is arranged in the cavity, a rotating cylinder is installed at the lower end of the supporting shell, and the rotating cylinder drives the driving wheel to rotate in the cavity through a positioning shaft sleeve; the driving wheel is provided with three arc-shaped guide grooves, the three arc-shaped guide grooves are distributed on the driving wheel in a central symmetry manner, the sliding seat is provided with three centripetal linear guide grooves, the centripetal linear guide grooves are connected with the arc-shaped guide grooves through driving pulleys, and the driving pulleys drive the sliding blocks to slide along the centripetal linear guide grooves to drive the clamping jaws to open or close so as to clamp or loosen workpieces. The invention converts the rotary motion of the rotary cylinder into the linear motion of the clamping jaw, and realizes the opening and closing of the clamping jaw.

title_en: Side suction type box taking device and unstacking device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a side suction type box taking device and a unstacking device, and relates to the technical field of cargo transportation. A side-suction box taking device comprises a mounting main body, a suction assembly, a supporting table and a pressing mechanism. The saddle is connected to the bottom of the mounting body and protrudes from the side of the mounting body, and the saddle is used for supporting the goods. The pressing mechanism is movably connected to the mounting main body, and can move relative to the mounting main body to be far away from or close to the supporting platform. The suction component is used for sucking cargoes, is movably connected to the mounting main body and is located above the supporting table, and can stretch and retract relative to the mounting main body. An unstacking device adopts the side suction type box taking device. The side suction type box taking device and the unstacking device can ensure the stability and effectiveness of the sucked goods and can improve the stability and the high efficiency of transportation.

title_en: Fixed-length pay-off mechanism for coil
abstract_en: The invention provides a fixed-length pay-off mechanism for a coil, which comprises a coil shell, a coil outlet nozzle, an upper end plate, a coil, a lower end plate, a wire binding rod and a cable clamp. The coil shell, the upper end plate and the lower end plate form a coil containing container which has supporting and protecting functions on the coil. The outlet nozzle is arranged on the upper end plate, the cable is distributed from the central hole of the cable, and the outlet nozzle plays roles in guiding, buffering and reducing abrasion for the cable. The binding rod is a key structure for realizing stepping paying-off, when the cable is wound to a specified length, the cable is pulled out from the corresponding hole of the lower end plate, the binding rod is wound for multiple circles, then a coil is wound continuously until all gears are wound and hung according to the method, the paying-off length is marked at the position corresponding to the binding position, and finally the cable is uniformly wound and fixed on the cable clamp. When the length of the coil needs to be set during use, the coil tying rod with the length position and the length smaller than the length is pulled out, so that the coil length-fixing and paying-off function is realized.

title_en: Robot screen unlocking method and device, intelligent device and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a robot screen unlocking method, a device, intelligent equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method is applied to a robot, the robot comprises a detection module and a screen, the detection module is provided with a sensor and a camera, and the method comprises the following steps: when the screen is detected to be in the locked state, the sensor is called to sense whether an object exists in a preset range corresponding to a rotation path of the detection module, when the object exists in the preset range, the camera is called to collect an image including the object, the collected image is analyzed to determine whether the object is a target object, when the object is determined to be the target object, the screen is rotated until the screen faces the target object, and when the screen is detected to face the target object, the screen is adjusted from the locked state to the unlocked state. By adopting the invention, the screen is in the unlocking state under the condition of facing to the target object, so that on one hand, the power consumption can be reduced, and the service life of the screen can be prolonged; and on the other hand, the unlocking efficiency can be improved.

title_en: Slide rail architecture for assembly machines, systems and methods
abstract_en: A slide rail includes a continuous circuitous track. The continuous circuitous track comprises a layered printed circuit board. The layered printed circuit board includes a top track layer configured to supply power to a device having a contact element that slides across the top track layer, the layered printed circuit board further having a lower layer connected to the top track layer, the lower layer configured to supply power to the top track layer. The layered printed circuit board is flexible and curves around a bend in the continuously circuitous track. Further disclosed is a method of assembly using the slide rail.

title_en: Sand-blasting zinc-spraying robot moving mechanism and sand-blasting zinc-spraying equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sand-blasting zinc-spraying robot moving mechanism and sand-blasting zinc-spraying equipment, which solve the technical problems of low efficiency and low quality of manual sand-blasting and zinc-spraying operation in the prior art. The sand-blasting zinc-spraying robot moving mechanism comprises a plurality of upright columns, a bearing beam is arranged through the upright columns, a transverse walking mechanism is arranged on the bearing beam, the sand-blasting zinc-spraying robot is installed on the transverse walking mechanism, the transverse walking mechanism comprises a driving mechanism, and the sand-blasting zinc-spraying robot moves back and forth along the bearing beam under the driving of the driving mechanism; still be provided with the shell through the stand, the shell sets up in order to cover actuating mechanism along the spandrel girder, and the inside isolation ward that forms of shell, actuating mechanism move in the isolation ward, and the shell blocks that outside debris gets into the isolation ward. The sand blasting and zinc spraying equipment comprises a sand blasting and zinc spraying robot and a moving mechanism of the sand blasting and zinc spraying robot. The invention obviously improves the operation efficiency and quality of sand blasting and zinc blasting, and reduces the labor intensity of workers.

title_en: Die carrier for lifting elevator and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a die carrier for lifting an elevator and a construction method thereof, wherein the die carrier comprises a first hanging ring, a winch, a fixed beam and a lifting beam which are arranged at the bottom of self-climbing construction equipment, and in a normal construction state, the elevator is fixed on a hoistway structure by the fixed beam and works normally; before lifting, the elevator stops using, the elevator still bears the weight of the self structure through the fixed beam, at the moment, the connection between the lifting beam and the well structure is disconnected, and the lifting beam is lifted to an upper floor by using self-climbing construction equipment and a winch; after the lifting beam is in place, fixing the lifting beam on a hoistway structure; disconnecting the fixed beam from the hoistway structure, and lifting the elevator machine room and the elevator bridge in place by reversely taking the lifting beam as a fulcrum by utilizing the fixed lifting beam and the winch; after reaching the preset position, the fixed beam is fixed on the well structure, so that the climbing of the elevator is realized on the premise of not occupying the tower crane, the lifting energy of the tower is saved, and the safety of the elevator in lifting and running is improved.

title_en: A slewer for transporting tray
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rotary device for a transport tray, which realizes three-dimensional layered transport. The rotary device for transporting the tray comprises a rotary unit, the rotary unit comprises rotary discs, the rotary discs are obliquely arranged, and the rotary discs are inclined outwards from top to bottom; when in use, the rotating device is arranged on a track comprising an upper channel groove and a lower channel groove.

title_en: Binocular adjusting mechanism for connecting robot and screw machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a binocular adjusting mechanism for connecting a robot and a screw machine, which comprises a base, a screw machine mounting and fixing hole site, an industrial robot tail end general hole site, a lifting mechanism, a weight reduction groove, a lifting part rack, a telescopic rod, an industrial camera, a camera fixing area, a telescopic part rack, a lifting function knob, a lifting lock-up knob, a telescopic adjusting knob, a telescopic lock-up knob, a lifting meshing gear and a telescopic meshing gear. The bottom of the base is provided with a screw machine mounting and fixing hole site, and the screw machine is connected with the main body component through the screw machine mounting and fixing hole site; the lifting function knob, the lifting lock dead knob, the telescopic adjusting knob and the telescopic lock dead knob are fixed at the back of the lifting mechanism through a back plate of the lifting mechanism, so that the adjustment of corresponding functions is realized. The invention has the advantages of high integration of the whole mechanism, integration of a plurality of functions, compact structure, high precision, strong stability and the like.

title_en: Chain type flexible mechanical arm suitable for automatic underwater video inspection of in-pile components
abstract_en: The invention relates to a chain type flexible mechanical arm suitable for underwater automatic video inspection of a pile inner member, which comprises a lifting mechanism, a telescopic mechanism and a chain type mechanical arm; the lifting mechanism comprises a lifting motor, the lower end of the lifting motor is connected with a lifting screw rod, a lifting nut B is sleeved on the lifting screw rod, and the lifting nut B is connected with the telescopic mechanism through a connecting piece; the lifting motor drives the lifting screw rod to rotate, drives the nut B to slide up and down along the lifting screw rod, and further drives the telescopic mechanism to move up and down; the telescopic mechanism moves in the vertical direction along the lifting guide rail under the guidance of the lifting guide device and the lifting guide rail; the lifting guide device is fixed on the telescopic mechanism shell; the lifting guide rail is fixed on the frame of the lifting mechanism. All chain link units of the chain type mechanical arm can be bent and folded in one direction after being connected through a pin shaft, and the chain type mechanical arm cannot be bent and folded in the reverse direction and the two side directions, and can only keep a straight line state, so that the horizontal extension section of the chain type mechanical arm is ensured to keep a horizontal state all the time.

title_en: Bamboo strip feeder
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bamboo strip feeder, which belongs to the technical field of bamboo winding, wherein a feeding hopper, a conveying assembly and a vacuum adsorption assembly are correspondingly arranged, and the structure of the feeding hopper and a conveying belt and the relative position between the feeding hopper and the conveying belt are preferably arranged, so that a rectangular slot on the feeding hopper can be opposite to the conveying belt below the feeding hopper, and accurate feeding and adsorption of single bamboo strips on the conveying belt each time are realized, so that the accurate feeding of the bamboo strips along the length direction of the bamboo strips is realized through the corresponding conveying of the conveying belt. The bamboo strip feeder disclosed by the invention is simple in structure, simple and convenient to control, convenient to overhaul and convenient to maintain, capable of accurately realizing continuous feeding of the bamboo strips, reducing splitting, breaking, dropping and damaging of the bamboo strips in the feeding process, saving the raw material cost of bamboo strip curtain production, reducing the mechanical faults of the feeder, ensuring the continuity and stability of feeding of the bamboo strips, and good in application prospect and popularization value.

title_en: Automatic book bookshelf of access
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automatic book storing and taking bookshelf, which comprises a storage bookshelf and a taking and placing mechanism, wherein the taking and placing mechanism moves in the storage bookshelf to pick up or place books, the taking and placing mechanism is lifted outside the storage bookshelf, and the taking and placing mechanism is transferred to the taking and placing mechanism after picking up the books or is transferred to the storage bookshelf after picking up the books from the taking and placing mechanism. In the book taking process, the access mechanism moves to the lower part of the book position, rises upwards, picks up the book, translates to the middle position of the book storage rack, turns 180 degrees, rises to the book position, the taking and placing support plate sends the book to the access mechanism, and the book is taken by a reader from the other side. The invention simplifies the book inlet and outlet into one window, which is convenient for taking. The space of the bookshelf is fully utilized, and the storage capacity of the bookshelf is increased. The books are placed and stored in a planned way.

title_en: Cotton automatic feeding equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses automatic cotton feeding equipment which structurally comprises a bottom plate, wherein a plurality of rollers are fixedly arranged on the lower end surface of the bottom plate, a plurality of vertical blocks which are symmetrical front and back are fixedly arranged on the upper end surface of the bottom plate, the upper end surface of each vertical block is fixedly provided with a plurality of vertical holes, the upper end surface of the supporting frame is fixedly provided with a supporting frame, the upper end surface of the supporting frame is fixedly provided with a frame type top support, the vertical block is internally and fixedly provided with a transportation device for transporting the finished boxes of cotton, the upper side of the transportation device is provided with a storage device which is positioned in the support frame and used for storing the finished boxes of cotton, the equipment adopts the transportation device, the storage device and the turnover device to realize the high-efficiency storage of the finished boxes of cotton and when the finished boxes of cotton need to be used through the transportation of the conveyor, can be accurate efficient will become a case cotton upset and drop into the equipment that will use into a case cotton, very big improvement the material loading efficiency and the storage efficiency of equipment.

title_en: Double-mechanical-arm inspection robot and accurate door opening method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-mechanical-arm inspection robot and an accurate door opening method thereof, wherein the double-mechanical-arm inspection robot comprises a walking chassis; the walking chassis is provided with a lifting device; the top end of the lifting device is provided with a visual positioning device for identifying a positioning two-dimensional code on the cabinet door; the lifting device is provided with an operation mechanical arm; the lifting device drives the operation mechanical arm to move to different heights; the front end of the walking chassis is provided with a laser radar; detecting whether the front face of the inspection robot is parallel to the cabinet by using a laser radar; the invention combines visual positioning, laser radar ranging, walking chassis movement, height adjustment of the camera and the left and right mechanical arms by the lifting rod, movement of the left and right mechanical arms and a key triggering device at the tail end of the mechanical arm, realizes a method for controlling the accurate door opening of the two mechanical arms, can realize accurate door opening of a cabinet door, can monitor the running state of equipment blocked by the cabinet door, improves the working efficiency, reduces the labor cost and has wider application range.

title_en: Packaging for skin treatment compositions and method of applying treatment compositions
abstract_en: A packaged skin treatment composition comprising: a container having a neck, having stored therein a treatment composition comprising microscopic three-dimensional spherical structures having membranous outer walls and isolated interior spaces, (b) a wiper secured within the neck and having an inner barrel portion, (c) a closure for the container, (d) an applicator consisting of an applicator rod having a proximal end secured to the closure and a distal end terminating in an enlarged portion, wherein when the applicator rod is withdrawn from the container, the treatment composition is loaded onto the applicator in an amount sufficient to allow the treatment composition containing the microscopic spherical structures to be applied to a treatment surface.

title_en: Baking equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of automatic production equipment, in particular to baking equipment, which comprises a conveying mechanism for conveying products, an oven with a material frame arranged inside, and a pushing mechanism for pushing/pushing the products away from the material frame; the oven is arranged at one end of the conveying mechanism, and the pushing mechanism is arranged on the conveying mechanism; the material frame comprises at least two storage areas which are arranged in rows along the horizontal direction and used for storing products, and the oven further comprises a translation mechanism used for driving the material frame to move left and right. The conveying mechanism can be used for feeding, the pushing mechanism can push the products on the conveying mechanism into the oven for baking, and the pushing mechanism pushes the products on the material frame out for discharging after baking is completed. The baking equipment can automatically complete the working procedures of feeding, baking and discharging, has high degree of automation, effectively improves the production efficiency and reduces the labor intensity of workers.

title_en: Condition display device and yarn winding machine
abstract_en: A condition display device (40) is provided with: a winding condition acquisition unit (43) that acquires winding conditions for forming a package (26 a); a determination condition acquisition unit (44) for acquiring a yarn defect determination condition when the presence or absence of a yarn defect is determined; a touch panel (41); and a display control unit (46) that causes the touch panel (41) to display the winding condition and the yarn defect determination condition. A display control unit (46) causes the touch panel (41) to display the winding conditions acquired by the winding condition acquisition unit (43) and yarn defect determination conditions for determining the presence or absence of a yarn defect for a yarn wound under the acquired winding conditions.

title_en: High-speed network visual remote rescue elevator control system and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a control system and a control method of a high-speed network visual remote rescue elevator, wherein the control method of the high-speed network visual remote rescue elevator comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring the environmental condition in a car through a camera and a control board; s2, transmitting the environmental conditions in the car to a rescue control center through a control board, first communication equipment and second communication equipment; s3, the rescue control center sends the environmental conditions in the car to the intelligent wireless terminal; s4, the safety monitoring technician judges whether the conditions of remote safety rescue are met or not according to the environmental conditions on the intelligent wireless equipment car, and if the conditions of remote safety rescue are not met, the step S1 is carried out; if yes, go to step S5; s5, judging that the passengers are instructed to press the rescue button through the loudspeaker and the display, and the rescue button instructs the control panel to realize self rescue. The control system and the control method for the visual remote rescue elevator of the high-speed network solve the problem that safety rescue workers are required to go from a far place to an accident elevator in the prior art.

title_en: Anti-blocking device for concrete discharging bin
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a concrete discharge bin anti blocking device, comprising a storage bin, a support frame, and a conveyor belt. The storage bin is installed on the support frame, and the conveyor belt is installed on the support frame and located below the storage bin. A gravity monitoring mechanism is installed on the conveyor belt, and an auxiliary dredging mechanism is installed at the lower end of the storage bin. A material pushing mechanism is installed on one side of the auxiliary dredging mechanism. The present invention sets a gravity monitoring mechanism on the conveyor belt, and monitors and judges whether there is material on the conveyor belt through sensors in the gravity monitoring mechanism. If there is no material, it indicates that the bin opening is blocked. The controller will control the cylinder in the auxiliary dredging mechanism to start, and the cylinder drives the movable rod. Movement causes the material at the warehouse opening to disperse, and through the material pushing mechanism, Push the raw materials onto the conveyor belt, and the conveyor belt can continue to transport the materials normally.

title_en: Double-girder gantry crane for flower stands
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-girder gantry crane with a flower stand, which comprises a base, wherein moving wheels are arranged inside the bottom of the base, a support column is fixed at the top end of an installation part, a connecting block is fixedly welded at the top end of the support column, a stabilizing block is connected above a flange plate, a limiting rod is connected at the top end of the stabilizing block, a connecting piece is fixed on the inner side of the stabilizing block, double main beams are installed at the top end of the fixing block, a sliding groove is fixed inside the double main beams, a pulley is connected inside the sliding groove, a dust guard is connected to the outer side of the middle part of a winding box, buffering structures are arranged on the left side and the right side of the winding box, and a winding structure is arranged above the winding box. This two girder pergola gantry crane, easy to assemble, and can be effectual regular to the line to can effectually reduce the striking dynamics of rolling box to two girder bodies, the rolling box removes in addition and moves smoothly.

title_en: New forms of energy magnetism counter weight's fork truck for commodity circulation
abstract_en: The utility model provides a fork truck is used in commodity circulation of new forms of energy magnetism counter weight, relates to and gets the relevant technical field of thing flow, including ground, the top fixedly connected with steel sheet on ground, the top roll connection of steel sheet has the wheel. This fork truck is used in commodity circulation of new forms of energy magnetism counter weight, cooperation through rheostat and electromagnetism device is used, when fork truck transport goods, earlier according to the weight of goods, adjust the position of conducting block through the control room, the goods is heavier, the conducting block then rotates to the upper end of rheostat, reduce resistance, make the electric current increase through the electromagnetism device, thereby produce bigger magnetism, it is bigger with the magnetic adsorption power of steel sheet, otherwise, then rotate downwards, reduce the magnetic adsorption power, the magnetic force of electromagnetism device and steel sheet is regarded as the counter weight's distribution of gravity, thereby the effect of magnetism counter weight has been reached, get rid of the counter weight, the quality of fork truck has been reduced greatly, the handling cost has been reduced, fork truck's life has been prolonged, simultaneously can also effectively utilize storage battery's electric quantity.

title_en: Automatic collection device for solid wood boards
abstract_en: The technology discloses an automatic solid wood plate collecting device which comprises an air cylinder push rod mechanism, a transverse conveying belt mechanism, a longitudinal conveying belt mechanism, a crank block pushing mechanism and a collecting mechanism; one side of the transverse conveying belt mechanism is provided with an air cylinder push rod mechanism, the other side of the transverse conveying belt mechanism is provided with two supporting frames, an upper inclined conveying plate, a longitudinal conveying belt mechanism, a crank block pushing mechanism and a lower inclined conveying plate are arranged between the two supporting frames, the top of the upper inclined conveying plate faces the transverse conveying belt mechanism and the bottom of the upper inclined conveying plate faces one side of the longitudinal conveying belt mechanism, the top of the lower inclined conveying plate faces the other side of the longitudinal conveying belt mechanism and the bottom of the lower inclined conveying plate faces the collecting mechanism, the crank block pushing mechanism is located above the lower inclined conveying plate, and the collecting mechanism is located below the lower inclined conveying plate; the technology can realize automatic collection and stacking of the solid wood boards, can obviously improve the efficiency of board collection, and greatly reduces the labor cost.

title_en: Screw type material blanking device controller based on variable speed learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a variable speed learning-based screw material blanking device controller which comprises an input module, a storage module, an output module and a processing module, wherein the processing module further comprises a prediction module, a weight monitoring module, an error calculation module and a logic control module. Based on the single and accumulated blanking errors, the processing module controls the spiral conveyor through iterative learning, and learning factors of the single and accumulated blanking errors are dynamically adjusted based on the change of the blanking errors in the iterative process. According to the invention, based on the detection of the distance sensor and the weighing module, the material accumulation in the discharging bin is adjusted through the stirrer so as to ensure the stability of the material compactness; compared with the prior art, the invention ensures that the blanking control does not need to repeatedly trial and error parameters, can quickly obtain an iterative formula with better convergence performance, and effectively utilizes the blanking in the iterative learning process.

title_en: Large-scale equipment hoisting accurate positioning device, positioning system and positioning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a precise positioning device, a positioning system and a positioning method for hoisting large equipment, wherein the positioning device comprises the following components: the bracket comprises a bracket body and a mounting plate, and the mounting plate is fixed on the bracket body; the positioning adjusting device comprises an installation seat and a roller, wherein the installation seat is of a reducing structure, and the roller is arranged at the small-diameter end of the installation seat; the large diameter end of the mounting seat is mounted on the mounting plate. The roller is used in the in-place adjusting device, so that the equipment can be kept stressed all the time, and the normal lifting of the equipment in the lifting process is not influenced.

title_en: Free falling rammer deceleration control system of dynamic compactor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a free-falling rammer deceleration control system of a dynamic compactor, which is used for controlling a winch to perform primary braking before the rammer is not landed in the free-falling process of a non-unhooked mode rammer; when the rammer lands, the winch is controlled to perform secondary braking. The invention can work in a non-unhooking mode, reduces impact force on a winch, prevents the winch from being damaged, reduces the rope outlet amount of a hoisting steel wire rope of the winch, and prevents the next ramming from being influenced.

title_en: Traction machine for elevator
abstract_en: The invention provides a traction machine for an elevator, which can manually release the brake of a brake part to a rope pulley according to a simple flow without using a complex release mechanism. The elevator hoist of the present invention comprises: a fitting portion formed on one of an end surface of the sheave and a surface of the brake disc opposite to the end surface; and a fitted portion formed on the other surface, wherein the fitted portion and the fitted portion are configured to be fitted by an axial movement of the brake disc toward the sheave, and to be released from fitting by an axial movement of the brake disc away from the sheave, and wherein in a state in which the fitted portion and the fitted portion are fitted, rotation of the brake disc about the rotation axis is prevented, and in a state in which the brake disc is braked, the brake portion is supported by the stationary member so as to be movable in the axial direction in conjunction with the axial movement of the brake disc.

title_en: Fluid container for a motor vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fluid container for a motor vehicle, having a container wall (8, 64, 90) delimiting a storage volume (10, 66), a heating element (12, 34, 68) and an outer shell (14, 46, 70, 88), the storage volume (10, 66) being used for storing liquid with respect to the environment (U), the heating element (12, 34, 68) being arranged in the storage volume (10, 66) (8, 64), wherein the outer shell (14, 46, 70, 88) surrounds the heating element (12, 34, 68) in a liquid-tight manner with respect to the supply volume (10, 66).

title_en: Tool coordinate system calibration method and calibration device of three-axis mechanical arm
abstract_en: The invention provides a calibration method and a calibration device for a tool coordinate system of a triaxial mechanical arm, wherein the calibration method comprises the following steps: based on the same circular marker, the mechanical arm performs n times of shooting according to a plurality of different posturesShooting in a first posture, shooting in a second posture when the end part of the calibration jig reaches the circle center position in the ith shooting action, shooting in a jth shooting action, and recording a coordinate O corresponding to the tail end of the mechanical arm in the shooting action respectively when the end part of the calibration jig reaches the circle center position in the jth shooting action E   i And O E   j And establishing an equation to solve, and finally obtaining the horizontal distance W from the tail end of the mechanical arm to the end part of the calibration jig and the included angle theta between the connecting line of the tail end of the mechanical arm and the central point of the tool and the X-axis direction of the coordinate system at the tail end of the mechanical arm.

title_en: Control method of tail tensioning electromagnetic valve of scraper conveyor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control method of a scraper tail tensioning electromagnetic valve, which comprises the following steps: s1: if at least the displacement sensor fails, the tensioning electromagnetic valve is locked, and the operation returns to S1, and if only the tension sensor fails, the loading and unloading valve is controlled, and the operation returns to S1; if no fault exists, S2 is carried out; s2: if the tension needs to be adjusted, enabling a tension adjustment mark, and going to S3, otherwise, going to S3; s3, whether the real-time tension is within the range of the target tension threshold value or not, if yes, clearing the tension adjustment flag, and carrying out S4, otherwise, carrying out S4; s4: and if the tension adjusting mark is enabled, the tensioning electromagnetic valve is locked and the step returns to S1, and if the tension adjusting mark is enabled, the loading and unloading valve is controlled according to the real-time tension and the tension target value and the step returns to S1. The invention is used for solving the problems of slow response speed and poor control reliability of the stepping type time delay control tensioning electromagnetic valve.

title_en: SMD piezoelectric driving two-degree-of-freedom underwater mechanical arm and driving method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a patch type piezoelectric driving two-degree-of-freedom underwater mechanical arm and a driving method thereof, wherein the mechanical arm comprises a plurality of unit arm sections and connecting assemblies between the arm sections which are connected in sequence; when the device works, a driving signal with pi/2 phase difference is applied to the piezoelectric vibrators on the unit arm sections, so that each point of the piezoelectric vibrators, which is in contact with the adjacent piezoelectric vibrator, generates a slight elliptical motion, and generates a driving force through friction action, so that the rotation of the unit arm sections around the piezoelectric vibrators of the adjacent unit arm sections and the rotation of the unit arm sections around the axes of the piezoelectric vibrators of the unit arm sections can be realized respectively, and the unit arm sections and the adjacent unit arm sections are orthogonal in space, so that the two-degree-of-freedom rotation of the two arm sections in two orthogonal planes can be realized. The invention is easy to seal and realize microminiaturization, is not affected by electromagnetic interference, can be powered off and self-locked, does not need to carry out mode coupling frequency consistency adjustment of different phase modes, reduces the limitation on the design size, shape and the like of the mechanical arm, and has important application prospect for the underwater operation mechanical arm, especially for deep sea microminiature robots.

title_en: Lifting device for roller conveying
abstract_en: A lifting device for conveying a roller belongs to the field of engineering equipment, wherein a limiting baffle is fixed on a second support, a lifting device is fixed with a workbench, a height limiting support is fixed below the lifting device, an ultrasonic sensor is fixed on the workbench, and a fixing bolt is fixed with a wheel base; the lifting platform is controlled to be lifted by the controller, the outer wall of the roller is contacted with the limit baffle, so that the roller is fixed, when the roller is lifted to a higher position, the rolling lifting process is completed, and the conveying efficiency is ensured; when the roller needs to be moved, the device and the roller can be moved by controlling the upper handrail and the lower handrail, so that the operation is simple and convenient; when the lower roller needs to be unloaded, the height of the lifting device is reduced, the roller is separated from the fixing device, and then the rotating support is rotated manually, so that the unloading of the roller can be completed, the labor cost of workers is reduced, and the roller is protected from being damaged.

title_en: Conveyance system and conveyance control method
abstract_en: The invention provides a conveyance system and a conveyance control method, which can perform the calibration of the position of a hand supporting a substrate with high precision by a simple structure. The transport system (2) comprises: a hand (30) for supporting a workpiece (W) to be conveyed; an arm (40) for moving the hand (30); a scanning control unit (113) which moves the hand (30) in a scanning direction intersecting the side (33 a) and the side (33 b) by means of the arm (40) so that the side (33 a) and the side (33 b) fixed to the hand (30) which are not parallel to each other pass through a known Reference Position (RP) in the conveyance path of the workpiece (W); and a position detection unit (114) that detects a positional shift of the hand (30) in a direction intersecting the scanning direction, based on the timing at which the side (33 a) reaches the Reference Position (RP) and the timing at which the side (33 b) reaches the Reference Position (RP) when the scanning control unit (113) moves the hand (30).

title_en: Automatic sealing equipment for inner bag of carton
abstract_en: The invention discloses automatic sealing equipment for inner bags of cartons, which comprises a conveying mechanism, a bag lifting mechanism, a bag opening mechanism and a sealing mechanism, wherein the bag lifting mechanism, the bag opening mechanism and the sealing mechanism are all arranged above the conveying mechanism; the bag lifting mechanism comprises four groups of suction components which are respectively arranged at four corners of the rectangle, and the four groups of suction components can be simultaneously separated outwards or folded inwards; the bag opening mechanism comprises two groups of oppositely arranged support rods, the two groups of support rods can be simultaneously separated outwards or folded inwards, and a plurality of smooth grooves are formed in the outer sides of the support rods. The automatic sealing device is used for automatically sealing the inner bag of the carton.

title_en: Automatic hank reeling machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automatic hank reeling machine, which comprises a rack, wherein a feeding mechanism, a stranding mechanism, a discharging mechanism and an automatic threading mechanism are sequentially arranged on the rack; the feeding mechanism comprises an input belt rotationally connected to the rack and a belt driving mechanism for driving the input belt to rotate, a positioning box is fixed on the rack on the side edge of the input belt, and a lead mechanism is arranged on the positioning box; a side pushing mechanism is arranged on one side of the input belt, which is far away from the positioning box; the wire twisting mechanism comprises a wire twisting frame which is rotationally connected to the rack and a wire twisting driving mechanism which drives the wire twisting frame to rotate; the discharging mechanism comprises a material receiving belt positioned right below the twisted wire frame, and a discharging driving mechanism for driving the material receiving belt to slide is arranged on the ground; the automatic threading mechanism comprises a pair of four-axis mechanical arms positioned on two side edges of the rack and a clamping jig fixed at the working ends of the mechanical arms. The invention has the effect of improving the production efficiency.

title_en: Crane with anti-collision device and method for operating multiple cranes
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a crane for operating a plurality of cranes (1, 2), the movement of which is monitored by means of a collision-prevention device of the crane in order to prevent an imminent collision, the crane comprising at least one displacement device for displacing a crane element, a control unit (13) for controlling the displacement device and a collision-prevention device (17, 18) for monitoring the crane movement of the crane element in order to prevent a possible collision with another crane. According to the invention, in the event of an imminent collision between a running first crane (1) and a stopped second crane (2), the first crane is stopped, a remote control connection (21) from the first crane to the second crane is established, the second crane is moved out of a collision zone (130) which disturbs the desired movement of the first crane by means of control commands which are provided on the stopped first crane and transmitted to the second crane by means of the remote control connection, and the second crane is stopped after being moved out of the collision zone in a remote-controlled manner and the first crane is restarted, so that the first crane can carry out its task.

title_en: Machining blanking machine material stop gear that stability is strong
abstract_en: The invention discloses a material limiting mechanism with strong stability for a machining blanking machine, which comprises an adjusting mechanism, a tightening mechanism, a connecting plate, a clamping mechanism and a guide rod, wherein the tightening mechanism for limiting is symmetrically and fixedly connected with the side end face of the connecting plate, and comprises a positioning motor, a positioning plate, a threaded clamping plate, a connecting base, a connecting belt, a first overturning shaft and a threaded shaft. The invention can effectively improve the degree of freedom of the device for grabbing various materials by arranging the adjusting mechanism, the tightening mechanism and the clamping mechanism, so that the adaptability of the device is stronger, the efficiency and the stability for grabbing materials with different shapes are improved, and meanwhile, the adjusting mechanism can quickly adjust the working width between the clamping mechanisms, so that the device has wider distribution of the grabbing width of the material, can adapt to longer and heavier materials, and improves the uniformity and the stability for grabbing the material.

title_en: Method for operating a laboratory sample distribution system, laboratory sample distribution system and laboratory automation system
abstract_en: The present application relates to a method of operating a laboratory sample distribution system (100), wherein the laboratory sample distribution system (100) comprises: -a plurality of sample container carriers (140), wherein the sample container carriers (140) are adapted to carry laboratory sample containers, -a transport plane (110), wherein the transport plane (110) is adapted to support the sample container carriers (140), and-a plurality of drive elements (120), wherein the drive elements (120) are adapted to move the sample container carriers (140) on the transport plane (110), wherein the method comprises the steps of: -a) planning a Movement Path (MP) from a start point (ST) to an end point (GA) on a transport plane (110) for one of the sample container carriers (140), wherein the transport plane (110) is logically modelled by a plurality of nodes (110), wherein the nodes (111) are idle within at least one time window (fTW) or are reserved within at least one time window (rTW), wherein the planning comprises analyzing the accessibility of an idle time window (fTW) from one of the nodes (ni) to at least one next node (nj) and to an idle time window (fTW) of at least one next node (nk) such that the planned movement of the one sample container carrier (140) is non-stopped from the one node (ni) through the next node (nj) to the at least one next node (nk), and the Movement Path (MP) being reserved comprises analyzing the accessibility of an idle time window (fTW) from the one of the nodes (ni) to at least one next node (nj) and at least one next node (nk) such that the planned movement of the one sample container carrier (140) is driven along the transport plane (120) by the sequence of elements (nk).

title_en: Remote mutual inductance robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a remote mutual inductance robot, which comprises a control end and a remote robot, wherein the control end comprises a sensing control cabin, the sensing control cabin comprises a shell, a walking chassis, a sensing control cabin processor and a human body action recognition device, the shell is of a cylindrical structure, the walking chassis is arranged at the bottom in the shell, the human body action recognition device is arranged in the shell, the sensing control cabin processor is respectively and electrically connected with the walking chassis and the human body action recognition device, the remote robot is of a quasi-robot type, a camera is arranged at the head of the remote robot, a robot processor is arranged at the chest of the remote robot, and the remote robot is in wireless communication with the sensing control cabin processor through the robot processor. Compared with the prior art, the remote mutual inductance of the robot is realized through the matching of the control end and the remote robot.

title_en: Lifting driving assembly of transfer robot for warehouse logistics and transfer robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lifting driving assembly of a transfer robot for logistics in storage and a transfer robot, wherein the lifting driving assembly comprises two groups of jacking assemblies which are arranged in bilateral symmetry, and each group of jacking assemblies comprises two groups of link mechanisms arranged in a mirror image manner and a group of driving devices; the carrying robot for the warehouse logistics executes jacking operation through the lifting driving assembly, the lifting driving assembly consists of a plurality of groups of connecting rod mechanisms, the connecting rod mechanisms are low in structural cost and high in reliability, and the lifting driving assembly supports four corners of the lifting platform through the four groups of connecting rod mechanisms and is high in lifting stability.

title_en: Escalator brake system and control method
abstract_en: The application relates to an escalator brake system and a control method. The escalator braking system includes: a band-type brake; the temperature detection device is arranged between a friction plate and a brake drum of the band-type brake, is fixed on the brake shoe and is used for detecting the temperature of the friction plate; the running state detection device is used for detecting the running state of the escalator and outputting escalator state information; the control unit is connected with the temperature detection device and the running state detection device, is used for acquiring the temperature of the friction plate fed back by the temperature detection device and the escalator state information output by the running state detection device, and outputs a escalator stopping instruction to the escalator driving device when the temperature reaches a preset threshold value and the escalator is judged to be in a normal running state according to the escalator state information; the stop command is used for controlling the escalator driving device to stop working. The invention can avoid safety accidents or damage to the escalator driving device caused by the abnormity of the band-type brake.

title_en: Folding shell structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a folding shell structure which comprises a lifting device, wherein a turnover surface is arranged on the lifting device, and rises along with the rising of the lifting device and falls along with the falling of the lifting device. The lifting device drives the turnover surface to ascend or descend, after the turnover surface ascends, the turnover surface upwards pushes the book case, so that the book case is bent and folded, further the book case folding movement is realized, after the lifting device descends, the turnover surface is driven to descend, and after the next book case moves onto the turnover surface, the book case folding function of the next book case is realized after the turnover surface ascends.

title_en: Fixed tray for elevator
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of elevators, in particular to a fixed tray for an elevator, which comprises a bottom plate, a tray main body, a limiting mechanism, a fastening mechanism, an opening and closing mechanism, a cleaning mechanism and an adjusting mechanism, wherein the bottom plate is provided with a plurality of through holes; when the tray is used, the fastening mechanism is arranged inside the limiting mechanism, and the tray main body is conveniently mounted and limited through the corresponding lead screw transmission structure under the matching of the limiting mechanism, so that the tray main body is conveniently maintained and replaced; the limiting mechanisms are arranged on two sides of the top of the bottom plate, so that a safety effect on the operation of the fastening mechanism is facilitated, and the installation and the limiting of the tray main body are further facilitated; the inside of tray main part one side is located to the mechanism that will clean, and block in the inner wall of tray main part, through the lead screw transmission structure, drives corresponding cleaning block and removes, cleans the inner wall of tray main part to be convenient for get rid of the greasy dirt and the impurity that are infected with in the tray main part, make and avoid causing the pollution to the goods, made things convenient for the transportation to the goods.

title_en: Paper feeder for large-format printer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a paper feeder for a large-format printer, which consists of a frame, a paper lifting platform, a paper sucking and separating mechanism, a paper feeding mechanism and a controller, wherein the paper sucking and separating mechanism consists of a paper supporting height sensing wheel, a sucker fixing frame, a paper separator and a sucker motor, the sucker is provided with a row and is fixed on the sucker fixing frame, the sucker can move up and down, the sucker fixing frame is driven by the sucker fixing frame motor to move back and forth along the paper feeding direction, the paper feeding mechanism consists of a paper rubbing shaft and a paper pressing wheel, and the paper pressing wheel is driven by the motor to move up and down through a spring and a cam. The paper feeding length is accurate and controllable, paper can be freely controlled to advance and retreat, the paper can be timely pressed or released, the applicability of the paper width and the paper thickness is very wide, the mechanical property is stable, the structure is simple, the accurate paper feeding of positive and negative double-sided printing can be realized, unmanned continuous operation can be realized, and the utilization rate of printing equipment and the labor saving are greatly improved.

title_en: Electronic component braiding machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electronic component taping machine, which comprises a frame with a mounting platform, a taping pressing device and an electronic component conveying device, wherein the taping pressing device and the electronic component conveying device are positioned on the mounting platform, the electronic component taping machine further comprises a surface tape take-up disc fixing structure which is arranged on the frame and located at one side of the inlet of the taping pressing device, and the surface tape take-up disc fixing structure comprises a rotating roller capable of being provided with a surface tape take-up disc and a driving piece for driving the rotating roller to rotate. The invention is beneficial to increasing the functional diversity of the electronic element braider.

title_en: Robot teaching device and robot system
abstract_en: The invention provides a robot teaching device and a robot system. The robot teaching device includes an image acquisition device that acquires, as a moving image, a distance image representing distance information of an imaging object or a two-dimensional image of the imaging object, a trajectory detection unit that detects, using the moving image, a movement trajectory of a hand of an operator imaged as the imaging object in the moving image, a recognition unit that recognizes whether the detected movement trajectory represents a linear movement or a rotational movement, and a command generation unit that outputs a command for translating a predetermined movable part of the robot according to the movement trajectory when the movement trajectory is recognized as representing the linear movement, and outputs a command for rotationally moving the predetermined movable part of the robot according to the movement trajectory when the movement trajectory is recognized as representing the rotational movement.

title_en: Carton packaging machine
abstract_en: The invention provides a carton packaging machine. Carton packing machine includes the board, the conveying board, moving mechanism, fixture and stop gear, the top fixed mounting of board has the race, fixed mounting has the baffle on the lateral wall of board, the top fixed mounting of baffle has the driver, fixed mounting has the hem frame on the lateral wall of driver, conveying board fixed mounting is on the lateral wall of baffle, fixed plate fixed mounting is in the bottom of baffle, motor fixed mounting is on the lateral wall of fixed plate, remove a sliding connection in the bottom of conveying board, and remove the frame still with lead screw threaded connection, cylinder fixed mounting is on the lateral wall that removes the frame, the output fixed connection of clamping bar and cylinder, stop gear installs the top at the conveying board. The carton packaging machine provided by the invention has the advantage that the formed cartons can be stably conveyed to next process equipment.

title_en: Multi-platform foldable tunnel maintenance operation device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-platform foldable tunnel maintenance operation device which comprises a balancing weight, a telescopic boom, a first operation platform and an amplitude-variable operation mechanism, wherein the telescopic boom comprises a basic boom and an unfolding boom, one end of the basic boom is connected with the balancing weight, the other end of the basic boom is connected with the unfolding boom in a sliding manner, the bottom of the basic boom is provided with a first rotation mechanism, the free end of the unfolding boom is fixedly connected with the amplitude-variable operation mechanism, the inner side of the free end is rotatably connected with one end of the first operation platform through a second rotation mechanism, so that the first operation platform can be unfolded in the horizontal direction, the amplitude-variable operation mechanism can be unfolded in the vertical direction, and the length directions of the first operation platform and the amplitude-variable operation mechanism are arranged in the same direction; the amplitude-variable operating mechanism comprises a plurality of operating platforms which are distributed in a step shape when being unfolded. The device has the advantages of large operation coverage area, large bearing capacity, high operation efficiency, high safety, small car folding area, simple structure and low cost, and can realize simultaneous operation of half sections.

title_en: Container collecting and distributing lifting appliance with dustproof function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a container collecting, modifying and scattering hanger with a dustproof function, which comprises a lifting frame; the container tilting device comprises a rotating frame, a first power assembly and a dust collecting unit, wherein one end part of the rotating frame is connected to a lifting frame in a rotatable mode, the first power assembly is arranged on the lifting frame and used for providing power for the rotating angle of the rotating frame, the dust collecting unit is arranged on the rotating frame, and a lifting part used for fixing a container is arranged on the rotating frame; the dust collecting unit comprises a dust collecting cover, a second power assembly, a dust collecting container, a negative pressure source and a dust collecting pipeline, wherein one end part of the dust collecting cover is connected to the rotating frame in a rotatable mode, the second power assembly is arranged on the rotating frame and is used for providing power for the overturning angle of the dust collecting cover, the dust collecting container and the negative pressure source are arranged on the rotating frame, and the dust collecting pipeline is connected between the dust collecting container and the dust; the dust hood, the dust collecting pipeline, the dust collecting container and the negative pressure source are sequentially communicated with each other in an air flow mode, a filter assembly is arranged on the path of the dust collecting pipeline communicated to the dust collecting container, and the dust hood is configured to be enclosed outside the container outlet when the container is hoisted by the lifting appliance.

title_en: Stacking device for automatically stacking hollow bricks
abstract_en: The invention relates to a stacking device for automatically stacking and stacking hollow bricks, which comprises a vehicle body, wherein a two-dimensional translation assembly is arranged on the vehicle body; the two-dimensional translation assembly is connected with a sliding base, and a middle placing plate, a left placing plate and a conveying belt are fixedly arranged on the sliding base; the middle-positioned plate is provided with a second motor, the second motor is connected with a main rocker, and the main rocker is matched with an upper grooved wheel and a lower grooved wheel; the upper grooved wheel is connected with a pushing assembly; a power transmission component connected with the lower grooved wheel and the conveying belt is arranged between the lower grooved wheel and the conveying belt. The automatic feeding device has high automation degree, and can control the transmission of the conveying belt and the reciprocating sliding of the main push rod to be alternately carried out on the basis of adjusting the height and the horizontal position of the sliding base and the inclined slide way, thereby realizing the one-by-one feeding of hollow bricks in a neat and stacked mode.

title_en: Production line of bottle cap solute beverage
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of food processing, in particular to a production line of solute beverage of bottle caps, which comprises the following steps: the first vibration feeding machine comprises a vibrator body and a material tray; the fixed support platform is positioned on one side of the first vibration feeder; the positioning and feeding device is arranged on the fixed support table, and one side of the positioning and feeding device is communicated with the material tray through the material feeding groove; the rotary table is rotatably arranged on the fixed support table, a plurality of placing discs are arranged on the rotary table, grooves are formed in the placing discs, and bottle caps are placed in the placing discs by the positioning feeding device; and the material injection device, the bottle mouth film sealing device, the discharging device, the second vibration feeder, the conveyor and the packaging machine. The automatic feeding, powder injecting, sealing, discharging and packaging processes of the pressed bottle cap can be realized, the distribution among the processes is reasonable, the automatic production efficiency is high, and the personnel participation is reduced.

title_en: Production line of bottle cap solute beverage
