abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of food processing, in particular to a production line of bottle cap solute beverages, which comprises a first vibration feeder, a fixed supporting table, a positioning feeding device, a rotating table, a bottle cap feeding device, a bottle cap sealing device, a discharging device, a second vibration feeder, a conveyor and a packaging machine, wherein the first vibration feeder comprises a vibrator body and a material tray, the fixed supporting table is positioned on one side of the first vibration feeder, the positioning feeding device is arranged on the fixed supporting table, one side of the positioning feeding device is communicated with the material tray through a feeding groove, the rotating table is rotatably arranged on the fixed supporting table, a plurality of placing trays are arranged on the rotating table, grooves are formed in the placing trays, and the positioning feeding device is used for placing bottle caps in the placing trays. The automatic feeding, powder injection, sealing, discharging and packaging processes for pressing the bottle cap can be realized, the distribution among the processes is reasonable, the automatic production efficiency is high, and the personnel participation is reduced.

title_en: Ground anchor dismounting device for power engineering and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric power engineering, in particular to a ground anchor dismounting device for electric power engineering and a using method thereof, wherein the ground anchor dismounting device comprises a top plate and a supporting plate, wherein the left side and the right side of the bottom end of the top plate are fixedly connected with supporting plates, the top end of the supporting plate is uniformly and fixedly connected with four telescopic rods, the top ends of the four telescopic rods are fixedly connected with a fixing plate, a second round hole is formed in the middle position of the fixing plate, a second rotary groove is formed in the outer side wall of the second round hole, a second circular plate is rotatably connected inside the second rotary groove, a screwed pipe is fixedly connected to the bottom end of the second circular plate, fixing lugs are fixedly connected to the left end and the right end of the screwed pipe, a clamping plate is rotatably connected between the two fixing lugs, a first screw rod is connected to the inside of the screwed pipe, and a lifting hook is fixedly connected to the bottom end of the first screw rod; the ground anchor is convenient to detach the ground anchors with different lengths and types, the working strength of people is reduced, the working efficiency is improved, the practicability of the ground anchor is improved, and the use limitation of the ground anchor is reduced.

title_en: Ceramic product packaging box
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ceramic product packaging box, and belongs to the technical field of packaging. This ceramic product packing carton fold formation, it includes: the box body is provided with two buffering box bodies in parallel, every buffering box body all includes integrated into one piece's first roof and first curb plate, all set up first circular arc on every first roof, all set up the second circular arc on every first curb plate, and the first circular arc in every buffering box body intersects with the second circular arc at the edge of the junction of first roof and first curb plate, the arc center of first circular arc and second circular arc all is close to the edge direction, the first circular arc in every buffering box body encloses into part with the edge, the second circular arc encloses into part with the edge and is located the crossing part of first circular arc and second circular arc on the edge and all is removed, so that form the appearance assorted place space with ceramic product between the inner chamber of two first circular arcs, two second circular arcs and two buffering box bodies. The advantages are that: the buffer effect is good and the buffer is environment-friendly.

title_en: Shovel plate convenient to disassemble and assemble
abstract_en: The invention discloses a shovel plate convenient to disassemble and assemble, which comprises a bottom plate and side vertical plates, wherein the side vertical plates are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the top of the bottom plate, a middle vertical plate is arranged at the middle shaft of the top of the bottom plate, the side vertical plates and the top of the middle vertical plate are provided with transverse plates at equal intervals, the connecting ends of the tops of the side vertical plates and the bottom of the transverse plates are provided with upper fixing mechanisms capable of reinforcing the connecting relationship of the side vertical plates and the transverse plates, the connecting ends of the tops of the side vertical plates and the top of the bottom plate are provided with lower fixing mechanisms capable of reinforcing the connecting relationship of the side vertical plates and the bottom plate, the connecting ends of the two ends of the middle vertical plate, the transverse plates and the bottom plate are provided with middle fixing mechanisms capable of reinforcing the connecting relationship of the bottom plate, the transverse plates and the middle vertical plates, the shovel plate convenient to disassemble is realized under the matching action of the upper fixing mechanisms, avoiding the space to be occupied.

title_en: Task scheduling method for track inspection robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a task scheduling method for a track inspection robot, which utilizes the inspection robot to generate an execution task queue and endow various task priorities, and carries out limited dynamic adjustment on charging tasks, so that various tasks of the inspection robot can be efficiently switched according to the task priorities, wherein different types of tasks have different task priorities, and 3-digit numbers are used for representing the priorities, so that the comparison of multi-level priorities can be realized, and the expansion of service application is facilitated; the charging task can automatically adjust the priority according to the residual electric quantity of the inspection robot, and whether the charging task can be interrupted or not and whether the charging task needs to be automatically recovered after being interrupted or not are added into the task description, so that the task interruption and recovery functions can be flexibly configured; and periodically checking the execution task queue to ensure the priority of task execution.

title_en: Lossless flexible feeder
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lossless flexible feeder which comprises an installation bottom plate, an appearance metal plate and a vibrating disc, wherein the appearance metal plate is fixed on the installation bottom plate, the vibrating disc is positioned above the installation bottom plate and on the inner side of the appearance metal plate, the top of the appearance metal plate is higher than the vibrating disc, a rotating device is arranged on the installation bottom plate, the vibrating disc is connected to the rotating device, a vertical vibrator is arranged on the installation bottom plate and connected with the vibrating disc, and patterns are arranged on the surface of the vibrating disc.

title_en: Method, system and device for fusing sensing and space positioning of multiple sensors of robot
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of robot environment perception, and particularly relates to a method, a system and a device for robot multi-sensor fusion perception and spatial positioning, aiming at solving the problem of low accuracy and precision of robot perception and spatial positioning caused by adverse interference conditions of multi-factor synthesis in the environment. The invention comprises the following steps: acquiring raw data of a depth camera, a MARG sensor and a joint encoder; correcting the acquired data by combining the calibration and calibration results of the sensor; enhancing and repairing the visual data acquired by the depth camera; performing pre-fusion processing on visual data, motion state data and angular displacement data respectively based on visual feature points, quaternion postures and a kinematics principle of a robot mechanism; and with the help of an extended Kalman filter and a fuzzy theory, the spatial fusion positioning of the robot in the environment is completed by utilizing the pre-fused multi-sensor data. The invention realizes high-precision robot perception and space positioning under adverse interference of multi-factor synthesis.

title_en: Mechanical arm with positioning function for robot and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an mechanical arm with a positioning function for a robot and a using method thereof, and the mechanical arm comprises a base, wherein a support column is arranged in the middle of the upper surface of the base, a lifting mechanism is arranged on the support column, a rotating mechanism is arranged in the base, a lifting block is arranged above the support column, a connecting plate is fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the lifting block, a connecting block is arranged between the connecting plate and the lifting block, a first bolt penetrates through the connecting block, two ends of the first bolt respectively penetrate through the connecting plate and the lifting block, a bearing block is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the connecting block, shaft sleeves are fixedly arranged on two sides of the bearing block, and fastening bolts penetrate through the shaft sleeves. The invention simultaneously realizes the functions of convenient rotation, lifting and inclination angle adjustment, is convenient for the actual operation of workers, can realize the distributed installation of the whole mechanical arm, is convenient for the workers to carry, and is also convenient for the workers to disassemble and overhaul the mechanical arm.

title_en: Automatic water meter packaging production line and method
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic water meter packaging production line and a method, wherein the automatic water meter packaging production line comprises an automatic case unpacking machine, a first conveying line, a second conveying line, a third conveying line, a fourth conveying line, an automatic case sealing machine, a networking automatic marking and labeling machine and a stacker crane; the automatic case unpacking machine is arranged at a first station and is configured to place the case body into a first conveying line after being opened, and the second conveying line is arranged at a second station and is configured to be matched with the bottom foam encasement manipulator to carry out bottom foam encasement; the third conveying line is arranged at a third station and is configured to be matched with the water meter boxing manipulator to perform water meter boxing, and the fourth conveying line is arranged at a fourth station and is configured to be matched with the top layer foam boxing manipulator to perform top layer foam boxing; the automatic box sealing machine, the networking automatic marking and labeling machine and the stacker crane are sequentially arranged in a fifth station, a sixth station and a seventh station for carrying out continuous box sealing, marking, labeling and stacking; this openly realizes the water gauge examination. The full-process automatic operation of water gauge lead sealing and water gauge packing has very big promotion work efficiency, has saved the human cost expenditure.

title_en: Sludge soil remediation sludge solidification method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sludge soil remediation sludge solidification method, relates to the technical field of environment-friendly treatment equipment, and particularly relates to curing agent conveying equipment for sludge soil remediation. The curing agent conveying equipment for sludge soil remediation and the conveying method thereof send signals to a controller through remote control equipment, the controller controls a first-stage electric telescopic rod to drive a first-stage fixing frame and a conveying pipe to move downwards, so that the bottom of the conveying pipe is inserted into sludge, a second-stage electric telescopic rod drives a second-stage fixing frame and a protective casing to move upwards, the limitation on a blanking hole outside the conveying pipe is removed, a first servo motor drives a transmission gear and a transmission toothed belt, and auger blades rotate, so that the curing agent in the conveying pipe falls into the sludge along the blanking hole.

title_en: Polyester film reel storage support and using method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polyester film reel storage support which comprises a base positioned at the bottom, a support frame positioned on the side surface and a support rod used for placing a polyester film reel, wherein the base is horizontally placed on the ground, the support frame is vertically arranged on the base, the support rod is connected to the support frame, and the polyester film reel is placed on the support rod. Be equipped with a plurality of support frames on the base, set up two above support frames at least, the both sides of support frame all are equipped with the bracing piece, and the distance between two different support frames is also different, consequently can be applicable to the polyester film spool of different length, and the practicality is higher. The polyester film reel is supported on the supporting rods of the two paired supporting frames through the supporting shaft, so that the extrusion deformation of the polyester film reel is avoided, and the quality of the polyester film is ensured. The invention also discloses a use method of the polyester film reel storage bracket.

title_en: Energy-saving and environment-friendly pigment grouting machine device capable of avoiding pigment agglomeration to cause waste
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pigment grouters and discloses an energy-saving and environment-friendly pigment grouter device capable of avoiding pigment agglomeration waste. When the position that the ellipsoid of the lateral wall department of net needle is more most advanced stabs to filter screen lateral wall department when being stuck by the pigment piece, at the in-process of filter screen lateral wall department shake, can scrape the lateral wall of the ellipsoid of bottom for the lateral wall department of intermediate layer pole is compressed to move to the lateral wall department of the ellipsoid at its top of lateral wall by the extrusion, make the lateral wall of the ellipsoid of other positions swell and upwards prop greatly, can drag the lateral wall of the ellipsoid of bottom upwards, thereby can avoid the filter screen to cause the jam by the adhesion of pigment piece.

title_en: Exoskeleton design method for carrying load in situ
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of human body joint power-assisted equipment, and discloses an exoskeleton design method for carrying a load in situ, which comprises the steps of constructing a human body movement and mechanics acquisition system according to working condition parameters, and acquiring human body joint movement change data and human body joint torque change data; obtaining the movement speeds and the movement ranges of different joints through the movement change data of the human body joints, and determining the power-assisted joints of the exoskeleton device according to the maximum bearing moments of the different joints; the exoskeleton device is used for carrying the load in situ according to the assistance form and the energy and driving form of the exoskeleton; the exoskeleton device is tested according to a number of different test criteria. The invention solves the problem that the existing exoskeleton design is missing according to a theoretical method, and the exoskeleton device for carrying the load in situ is arranged, so that the assistance to each joint of the human body is realized.

title_en: Automatic winding machine for glazing film
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of coating machines, and particularly relates to an automatic winding machine for a glazing film, which comprises a base, a supporting seat and a supporting rod, wherein the top of the base is provided with a supporting column, one side of the supporting column is provided with a fixing seat and a functional seat, and the inside of the fixing seat is movably connected with a second conveying roller; according to the invention, the automatic winding machine is supported through the arrangement of the base, the supporting seat and the supporting rod, the label is pulled to the surface of the adsorption roller by the rodless cylinder through the arrangement of the fixing seat, the rodless cylinder and the adsorption roller, the label is sheared by the cylinder scissors through the arrangement of the cylinder scissors, the cylinder and the label paper, then the label on the adsorption roller is attached to the operation film by the cylinder, the operation film is driven through the arrangement of the first driving motor, the second driving motor, the first driving roller and the second driving roller, and the operation film is driven through the arrangement of the first conveying roller, the second conveying roller, the fourth conveying roller, the fifth conveying roller and the like.

title_en: Packaging bag capable of being heated and exhausted by microwaves and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a packaging bag capable of heating and exhausting by microwave, which comprises a bag body for containing food; the bag wall of the bag body is a composite film, and the composite film comprises a printing layer, a glue layer and a heat sealing layer which are laminated from outside to inside; the bag body is provided with an exhaust area without the glue layer, the exhaust area is in a strip shape, and the area of the heat sealing layer, which is positioned in the exhaust area, is provided with a plurality of exhaust through holes; one end of the exhaust area is communicated with the sealed end of the bag body through an exhaust port; the invention also discloses a preparation process of the packaging bag, the packaging bag structure can realize direct heating in a microwave oven, automatic directional exhaust can be realized, and the exhaust effect is uniform and stable; realizing hundred percent exhaust; the use is safe and convenient, the preparation process is simple to operate, the method is suitable for the flow process of an automatic production line, and the production efficiency is high.

title_en: Garbage bag breaking machine with external entanglement removing cutter set
abstract_en: The invention discloses a garbage bag breaking machine with an external entanglement removing knife set, which comprises: the bag breaking machine comprises a bag breaking machine shell with a bag breaking cavity, a bag breaking roller which is rotatably arranged around a fixed shaft is arranged in the bag breaking cavity, and a bag breaking knife belt is arranged on the outer wall surface of the bag breaking roller and is used for puncturing bagged garbage falling into the bag breaking cavity from a feeding funnel so as to drive the bagged garbage to rotate in the rotating process of the bag breaking roller. And a yielding knife belt is also arranged in the bag breaking cavity and is used for breaking the bags of the bagged garbage under the matching action with the bag breaking knife belt. And the entanglement clearing knife set is arranged in the bag breaking cavity and is driven by the bag breaking roller to slide towards the direction close to or far away from the outer wall surface of the bag breaking roller so as to cut off the entanglement wound on the bag breaking roller. Still be equipped with the sword area of unloading in the broken bag chamber, the sword area of unloading is laid in the rotatory material side of unloading of broken bag cylinder relatively broken bag cylinder parallel interval to be used for cooperating broken bag sword area to unload the rubbish and the disposal bag after the broken bag.

title_en: Special anti-reverse-bending conveying chain
abstract_en: The invention relates to a conveying chain, in particular to an anti-reverse-bending conveying chain. The technical scheme is as follows: a special anti-reverse-bending conveying chain comprises a conveying chain body, a plurality of inner chain links and outer chain links, wherein each inner chain link comprises an inner chain plate, an inner attached plate, a sleeve and a roller; the outer chain links comprise outer chain plates, outer supporting plates and pin shafts, the pin shafts penetrate through the sleeve of one chain link and are fixed between the outer chain plates and the outer supporting plates of the next chain link, the chain links are sequentially connected to form the anti-reverse-bending conveying chain, the outer supporting plates are arranged between the adjacent outer chain plates, and the height H of each outer supporting plate is smaller than the height H of the corresponding inner attached plate. The invention has the advantages that: the conveying chain can only be bent in one direction, the purpose of preventing reverse bending is achieved, and the stability of the chain in operation is effectively improved.

title_en: Elastic vibration damper for cylindrical object transportation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of aerospace, and discloses an elastic vibration damper for cylindrical object transportation, which comprises a flexible cushion block, an upper guide post unit, an air bag, a lower guide cylinder unit, an air pressure adjusting system and an air chamber, wherein the flexible cushion block is arranged on the upper guide post unit; the upper guide post unit comprises a support plate and a guide rod arranged on the support plate; the lower guide cylinder unit comprises a sleeve and a bottom plate, the bottom plate is arranged opposite to the support plate, and the sleeve is matched with the guide rod; the supporting plate is provided with a flexible cushion block, and an air bag is connected between the bottom plate and the supporting plate; the air bag is connected with an air pressure adjusting system, and the air pressure adjusting system is connected with an air chamber. The invention can adjust the supporting rigidity of the elastic vibration damper according to the deformation adaptability, the vibration characteristic and the bearable impact load of the cylinder, so that the deformation, the vibration and the vertical impact load of the cylinder are all in the adaptive range, thereby ensuring the safety of the cylinder in the transportation process, and the invention has simple structure, reliable function and easy realization.

title_en: Safety detection device for medical articles and detection method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safety detection device for medical articles, which comprises an installation box, an installation rod, a rotary table, a first fixed rod, a first transmission wheel, a driving transmission wheel, a second transmission wheel and a second fixed rod, wherein the top of the installation box is provided with a rotary groove, the rotary table is arranged in the rotary groove, and the rotary table is rotationally connected in the rotary groove; a rotating block is fixed at the bottom of the rotating disc, the rotating block is connected in the rotating groove in a sliding mode, and fixed blocks are fixed on the outer side of the rotating block at equal angles; according to the invention, the detection object is adjusted through the arrangement of the placing plate, and the object is automatically lifted upwards after detection, so that the height of the object in the mounting groove is changed, an operator can conveniently and quickly take out the object after object detection, the time consumed by taking the object is saved, the working efficiency is improved, and meanwhile, the object can be prevented from being too close to the detection head to damage the detection head, and the safety is improved.

title_en: Coal conveying trestle ground water jet automatic cleaning device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal conveying trestle ground water jet automatic cleaning device, which comprises a cleaning robot body, a guy cable power device and cleaning robot control system software, it is characterized in that the cleaning robot body consists of a scraper device and a cleaning unit, the cleaning robot control system is arranged on a stay cable to realize up-and-down movement through the stay cable, the stay cable power device adopts a double-cable circulation mode, the cleaning robot control system software is based on a network B/S framework, the cleaning robot control system realizes system integration interaction with a patrol robot control system, a flushing system and the like and realizes linkage control, when the inspection robot inspects the foreign matters in the inspection process, the cleaning robot can be controlled to carry out the cleaning task, the cleaning robot can also automatically start the cleaning task by setting the timing cleaning task, and the cleaning robot automatically starts to spray and wash the coal conveying belt ground to realize all-dimensional intelligent cleaning.

title_en: Method, device and system for automatically guiding transport vehicle to carry goods shelf
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a device and a system for automatically guiding a transport vehicle to carry a goods shelf. The method comprises the following steps: detecting the position of a marker on a goods shelf carried by the AGV in the visual field of a camera of the AGV; if the marker is detected to disappear from the visual field of the camera of the AGV, an abnormal shelf protection space is constructed, the abnormal shelf protection space takes the AGV as the center of the space, and the nearest distance from any point on the space to the reference projection profile is not less than the set distance, so that: the server schedules all the AGVs according to the abnormal goods shelf protection space; the reference projection profile is: when the center of the bottom plane of the rack coincides with the center of the AGV, the AGV and the rack as a whole have a projected contour on the travel plane of the AGV. According to the invention, when the goods shelf and the AGV have relative displacement, the goods shelf can be prevented from being scraped with the surrounding goods shelf.

title_en: Emptying mechanical arm of mechanical arm device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a discharging mechanical arm of a mechanical arm device, which comprises a rack, a mechanical arm, a clamping mechanism and a total power driving mechanism, wherein the total power driving mechanism comprises a first rotary driving component, a second rotary driving component, a third rotary driving component, a fourth rotary driving component, a first transmission component, a second transmission component and a third transmission component, the clamping mechanism comprises a clamping finger, a first clamping connecting rod, a second clamping connecting rod, a lifting support, a first rotary cylinder, a second rotary cylinder and a nut sleeve, the first rotary driving component, the second rotary driving component, the third rotary driving component and the fourth rotary driving component are all arranged above the rack, one end of the mechanical arm is rotatably connected with the upper part of the rack, and one end of the mechanical arm is connected with the first rotary driving component. The automatic transfer device is stable and reliable in structure, realizes automatic transfer or transportation of objects, does not need manual participation, saves labor cost and improves production efficiency.

title_en: Liftable cross beam for bridge crane and operation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a liftable crossbeam for a bridge crane and an operation method of the liftable crossbeam, and the liftable crossbeam comprises two bottom plates, wherein supporting mechanisms are arranged on the outer walls of the tops of the two bottom plates respectively, each supporting mechanism comprises two supporting plates, the two supporting plates are welded on the outer walls of the two ends of the top of the bottom plate respectively, a transverse plate is arranged above the bottom plate, the two ends of the transverse plate are welded on the outer walls of the tops of the two supporting plates respectively, lifting mechanisms are arranged on the outer walls of the tops of the two transverse plates respectively, each lifting mechanism comprises a supporting frame, the bottom of each supporting frame is welded on the outer wall of the top of the corresponding transverse plate, a sliding plate is slidably arranged in each supporting frame. The invention improves the stability, improves the integral supporting strength of the device, can adjust the height of the guide rail, is suitable for hoisting occasions with different heights, improves the flexibility, can support the fixed block and the guide rail, prevents the guide rail from inclining and improves the safety.

title_en: Construction engineering machinery maintenance is with operation platform that has butt joint mounting structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of maintenance operation platforms, in particular to an operation platform with a butt joint installation structure for maintenance of constructional engineering machinery. According to the invention, the butt joint installation mechanism is arranged, so that the limiting clamping block and the wedge block are quickly butted and clamped, the fixed connecting rod is accurately and quickly installed, the stability of the chassis at two sides of the maintenance operation platform main body is increased, the problem that the chassis is unstable when the top end of the maintenance operation platform main body rises is solved, the stability is increased, meanwhile, the weight at two sides can be flexibly adjusted, the gravity center is changed, the safety of the device is greatly improved, the device is prevented from shaking, and the normal operation of maintenance personnel is ensured.

title_en: Energy storage battery is with cable bundling machine that can go up unloading automatically
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of cable processing, and particularly relates to a cable bundling machine capable of automatically feeding and discharging materials for an energy storage battery, which comprises: the cabinet body, binding machine main part, linear electric motor and locker room, display screen and control panel are installed on the outside top of the cabinet body, logical groove has been seted up in the middle of the top of the cabinet body, controller and power module are installed to the inside bottom of the cabinet body, binding machine main part is installed to outside top one side of the cabinet body, linear electric motor is all installed to the inside both sides wall of the cabinet body, rotating electrical machines is installed to linear electric motor's output. This energy storage battery is with cable bundling machine of unloading in automation can be through automatic for carrying the completion material loading next time when carrying cable, and the material loading is accomplished with carrying simultaneously, does not waste operating time, and work efficiency is higher, and transport effect is better.

title_en: Printing machine encapsulation equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a printing machine packaging device, which belongs to the technical field of printing machine packaging and comprises a packaging table, a packaging device, a lifting device, an air exhaust device and a sealing device, wherein the packaging table is arranged on a horizontal plane, six grooves which are distributed in the circumferential direction are arranged on the packaging table, circular grooves communicated with the six grooves are formed in the packaging table, the packaging device is arranged in the grooves of the packaging table, the lifting device is arranged on the packaging table, the air exhaust device is arranged on the lifting device, the air exhaust end is positioned right above the packaging table, the sealing device comprises a pushing part and a sealing part, the pushing part is arranged on the lifting device, and the sealing part is arranged in the pushing part and is in sliding fit with the pushing part. According to the invention, through the mutual operation among the devices, the packaging tightness is good, dust is prevented from entering, the gas in the packaging process can be pumped out, and the packaging effect on the parts of the printing machine is improved.

title_en: Material pneumatic conveying device is thrown to bottle piece
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bottle flake feeding pneumatic conveying device which comprises a workbench, wherein a feeding mechanism, a Roots blower and a conveying pipe are sequentially arranged on the workbench, the feeding mechanism is used for conveying raw materials to an air inlet of the Roots blower, one end of the conveying pipe is connected with an air outlet of the Roots blower, and the other end of the conveying pipe is used for being connected with a feeding hole of an esterification kettle. During sending into roots's fan with the raw materials through utilizing feed mechanism, then the air current that produces through roots's fan promotes the raw materials motion to make the raw materials enter into the cauldron of esterifying through the conveying pipe, thereby realize the quick material loading operation of raw materials, and then make the producer need not to carry operations such as the raw materials, can reduce producers ' work burden, can improve production efficiency again.

title_en: Environment-friendly waste treatment equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses environment-friendly waste treatment equipment which comprises a separation box, a transmission box and a treatment box, wherein the separation box is fixedly connected to one side of the transmission box; the separating box is provided with a feeding hole, a separating motor, a separating cylinder, a base plate, a cushion layer, a guide plate I, a guide plate II, an interlayer and a conveying shaft, the base plate is provided with a pair of parts, the base plate is respectively positioned at the bottom of two ends of the separating cylinder, the two ends of the base plate are respectively connected with the two sides of the inner wall of the separating box, the middle part of the top of the base plate is an arc concave surface, and a plurality of rolling shafts are arranged in the arc concave surface at the top of the base plate. According to the invention, the waste is separated through the separating cylinder in the separating box, then the separated waste is transmitted to the processing box through the transmission box, in the process, the metal in the waste is recovered through the magnetic suction mechanism and the recovery mechanism, and meanwhile, the clamping mechanism is arranged, so that the metal leaked by the magnetic suction mechanism can be supplemented and recovered.

title_en: Method for operating an elevator installation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for operating an elevator installation (50), comprising: -a car (51), -at least one first guide rail (56) and a second guide rail (57) along which the car (51) can travel; furthermore, at least one movable, in particular rotatable, switching unit (53) is provided, by means of which the car (51) can be switched from a travel along the first guide rail (56) to a travel along the second guide rail (57), wherein the switching unit (53) can be transferred from a first position to a second position; furthermore, a drive device (60) is provided for driving the movement of the switching unit (58); the method comprises the following method steps: -determining a transition duration (U1, U2) for a movement of the transition unit (58) from the first position to the second position; -operating the drive means (60) according to the determined transition duration (U1, U2).

title_en: Reusable packaging bag, using method, transport tool and strength testing method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a reusable packaging bag, a using method, a transport tool and a strength testing method, wherein the bag is made of a watertight material on the outer side surface of the packaging bag, and the tearing strength of the material of the packaging bag in the direction vertical to the surface of the packaging bag is more than or equal to 10N/cm; the thickness of the packaging bag material is more than or equal to 0.11 mm; the bag material is made of a non-metal film or a paperboard with the outer surface or the inner and outer surfaces covered with the non-metal film, and the non-metal film can be adhered to the paperboard by glue. The reusable packaging bag, the packaging bag using method and the transportation tool have the characteristics of water impermeability, reusability and high strength, have the functions of RFID and temperature control, can reduce the waste of resources, reduce the pollution to the environment, reduce the transportation cost and improve the transportation efficiency; the whole-process tracing supervision of the bag can be carried out in the transportation process, and the whole-process tracing can be still carried out even if the transportation mode is switched; the logistics supervision efficiency is improved, and the personnel cost is greatly reduced.

title_en: Yarn group protection device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a yarn ball protection device, which is used for protecting a yarn ball and comprises a sealing cover and a yarn guide tube, wherein the sealing cover is a sealed shell provided with an upper end surface and a lower end surface, the shell is provided with an opening for placing the yarn ball in the shell, the upper end surface is provided with a spinning nozzle, the yarn guide tube is arranged at the spinning nozzle, and the yarn guide tube is provided with a movable joint for realizing universal fixation. This yarn group protection device is with the whole protection of yarn group, can prevent that yarn group from exposing the moisture absorption, reduces and receives the influence of environmental factor in FRP insulation product forming process, also can reduce the requirement of depositing the environment to yarn group simultaneously, reduces the material waste, reduction in production cost to guarantee that the yarn is at the in-process of drawing forth, the yarn trend of arbitrary direction is unobstructed smoothly not block the yarn smoothly, does not have the fluff.

title_en: Self-protection intelligent goods shelf for storage
abstract_en: The application provides storage is with from protection formula intelligence goods shelves, including goods shelves body, pushing mechanism, clamping mechanism, second canceling release mechanical system, first canceling release mechanical system, slide mechanism, coupling mechanism, disconnection mechanism, safety mechanism, indicating mechanism, lift, gravity induction mechanism, protection mechanism and telescopic machanism, the goods shelves body is including depositing the board, the first glide plane that the storing plate set up including the slope, the lower lateral wall that deposits the board is provided with the gravity induction mechanism who is used for monitoring to place goods weight on depositing the board, and is provided with the indicating mechanism who is convenient for observe the goods condition of placing on depositing the board, the lift includes the elevating platform that the U-shaped set up, the lateral part of lift is provided with the controller, the lateral wall of elevating platform is provided with places the board. This kind of storage is with from protection formula intelligence goods shelves, the placing of the goods of being convenient for to can avoid leading to the fact the potential safety hazard because of the goods on the goods shelves is overweight, use safelyr.

title_en: Safety protection early warning method for construction passenger-cargo dual-purpose elevator floor access door
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safety protection early warning method for a construction passenger-cargo dual-purpose elevator floor access door, and relates to the technical field of building construction. The safety protection early warning method for the construction passenger-cargo dual-purpose elevator floor access door comprises the following steps: s1, erecting a vertical transportation independent scaffold; and S2, building a floor entrance and exit access platform at the level of each floor. This construction people goods dual-purpose lift floor passway door safety protection early warning method, through setting up a floor import and export passageway platform between floor and construction people goods dual-purpose lift to import and export passageway platform outside installation at the floor and add elongated iron door bolt and wireless contact switch, whether utilize the bolt to touch wireless contact switch and let the navigating mate confirm whether the outward opening iron door closes tightly, can continuously monitor, labour saving and time saving, safe and reliable, master the floor import and export passageway platform outward opening iron door's developments at any time.

title_en: Large-scale double-station fried bean curd filling machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large-scale double-station fried bean curd filling machine which comprises a rack, wherein a driving combination is arranged in the rack, and a turntable mechanism, a lower suction bag combination, a bag taking combination, a first opening and clamping assembly, a bag opening combination, a bag opening linkage combination, a second opening and clamping assembly, a feeding and pressing bag combination, a bag guiding sheet combination, a bag detection combination, a non-vacuumizing heat sealing mechanism, a non-vacuumizing discharge conveying belt, a bag receiving arm combination, a vacuum rotation combination and a vacuumizing discharge conveying belt are arranged on the rack. The automatic grabbing and opening device can realize automatic grabbing of the packaging bag, automatic bag opening, automatic filling of the fried bean curd, automatic vacuumizing and automatic packaging of the packaging bag, automatic discharging of non-vacuum packaging and automatic discharging of vacuum packaging, and the fried bean curd is quick and efficient to fill, sanitary, safe, stable and reliable.

title_en: Loading and unloading device of heat dissipation cover bearing piece
abstract_en: The application discloses a loading and unloading device of a heat-dissipating cover bearing piece, which comprises a loading part, a material taking positioning part, a unloading part and a traversing assembly, wherein the traversing assembly spans the loading part, the material taking positioning part and the unloading part, after the loading part lifts the heat-dissipating cover bearing piece in place, the traversing assembly moves the heat-dissipating cover bearing piece from the loading part to the material taking positioning part, the material taking positioning part positions and fixes the heat-dissipating cover bearing piece, the material taking mechanism takes out a heat-dissipating cover on the heat-dissipating cover bearing piece, and the traversing assembly moves the heat-dissipating cover bearing piece after taking out from the material taking positioning part to the unloading part. According to the application, the heat-dissipating cover bearing piece fed on the feeding part is moved to the material taking positioning part to take materials through the transverse moving assembly, and the empty heat-dissipating cover bearing piece is conveyed to the discharging part to be discharged through the transverse moving assembly after the material taking is completed, so that the automatic feeding and discharging of the heat-dissipating cover bearing piece are realized, the shutdown feeding or shutdown discharging mode is avoided, and the guarantee is provided for the continuous operation of the production line.

title_en: Auxiliary medical instrument on-site supply system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an auxiliary medical apparatus on-site supply system, comprising: the negative pressure urine receiving structure is arranged below the sickbed and consists of a male negative pressure urine receiving device and a female negative pressure urine receiving device; the double-arm driving mechanism is connected with the negative pressure urine receiving structure and comprises a first mechanical arm, a second mechanical arm and an alternating current driving motor, wherein the alternating current driving motor is used for driving the first mechanical arm to stretch the male negative pressure urine receiving equipment to the side face of the hospital bed when receiving a first driving signal, and is also used for driving the second mechanical arm to stretch the female negative pressure urine receiving equipment to the side face of the hospital bed when receiving a second driving signal. The auxiliary medical appliance on-site supply system is compact in design and has certain compatibility. The auxiliary medical apparatus of the same sickbed can meet different requirements of patients of different sexes, so that the auxiliary function of the sickbed is effectively expanded.

title_en: Multiple opposite-direction type buffering and damping device for elevator car
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of elevator safety protection, in particular to a multi-opposite-type buffering and damping device for an elevator car, which comprises a buffering shell, an inner wall plate, a shifting buffering component, a supporting buffering component, a triangular buffering component and the like; the inner wall plate is fixedly installed in the buffering shell, the stirring buffering components are symmetrically arranged on the upper portion of the buffering shell in a sliding mode, the supporting buffering components are arranged between the symmetrical buffering shell and the inner wall plate, and the triangular buffering components are arranged on the supporting buffering components. Through stirring buffer assembly and supporting buffer assembly, damping spring carries out the shock attenuation to elevator car, and elevator car promotes buffer rod and device above that and moves towards keeping away from elevator car direction simultaneously, stirs the spring and is compressed, through stirring spring and elevator car recess cooperation for buffer rod is descended rapidly to the elevator railway carriage or compartment body and is cushioned the speed reduction, makes the elevator can not fall rapidly.

title_en: Swing angle detection device for lifting appliance of bridge crane
abstract_en: The invention discloses a swing angle detection device for a bridge crane sling, which comprises: the transmission device is used for converting the swing angle rotation information of the lifting appliance into displacement information of the transmission device, and a first capacitor plate is arranged on the transmission device; a protection device on which a second capacitive plate is disposed; the displacement detection device is used for detecting the displacement information of the transmission device; capacitance detection means for detecting a change in capacitance between said first capacitor plate and said second capacitor plate caused by movement of the actuator; and the calculation module is used for calculating the swing angle and the direction of the lifting appliance according to the displacement information and the capacitance change information of the transmission device. The container loading and unloading device is simple in structure, easy to manufacture, low in cost, not easy to be influenced by external environment changes, strong in anti-interference capacity and capable of guaranteeing the safety of container loading and unloading work.

title_en: Full-automatic appearance inspection pendulum box packaging equipment of electrolytic capacitor
abstract_en: The invention discloses full-automatic appearance inspection box-arranging packaging equipment for an electrolytic capacitor, which comprises a feeding mechanism, a first transfer disc, a second transfer disc, an appearance inspection mechanism, a material mixing inspection mechanism, a translation mechanism, an automatic box-arranging mechanism and a frame, wherein the feeding mechanism is used for conveying the electrolytic capacitor to the first transfer disc, the appearance inspection mechanism is used for inspecting the electrolytic capacitor on the first transfer disc, the translation mechanism is used for conveying the electrolytic capacitor on the first transfer disc to the second transfer disc, the material mixing inspection mechanism is used for inspecting the electrolytic capacitor on the second transfer disc, and the second transfer disc is connected with the automatic box-arranging mechanism. The automatic box arranging mechanism can effectively carry out appearance inspection and material mixing inspection on the electrolytic capacitor, has high automation degree and working efficiency, effectively reduces the problems of missed view or misjudgment caused by visual fatigue of workers working for a long time, and can effectively realize automatic box arranging of the electrolytic capacitor.

title_en: Pop-top can packaging bottle with telescopic straw
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of food packaging, in particular to a pop can packaging bottle with a telescopic straw, which comprises a can body, a pull ring, a connecting rope and a straw, wherein the pull ring is connected with the can body through the connecting rope; the middle part of the suction pipe is provided with a first corrugated pipe and a second corrugated pipe, the first corrugated pipe is positioned at a position close to the lower end of the suction pipe, and the second corrugated pipe is positioned at a position close to the upper end of the suction pipe; the lower end of the suction pipe is fixedly connected with the inner bottom wall of the tank body, and a gap is formed between the lower end of the suction pipe and the inner bottom wall of the tank body; the first end of connecting the rope and the lower terminal surface fixed connection of pull ring, the second end fixed connection of connecting the rope is at the middle part of straw, and the fixed connection point of connecting rope second end and straw is located between first bellows and the second bellows. The invention can reduce the risk that foreign matters or bacteria are brought into the oral cavity of people along with the beverage in the can, simultaneously reduces the risk that the foreign matters are brought into the beverage due to the unclean external suction pipe during storage, and improves the safety of people when drinking canned beverage.

title_en: Anti-drying medicine bottle
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical supplies, and particularly relates to an anti-drying medicine bottle which comprises a bottle body; the upper end of the bottle body is in threaded connection with a bottle cap; the bottom end of the bottle body is provided with a battery jar and a water tank; a battery is arranged in the battery groove; a motor is fixedly connected in the bottle body above the water tank, and a rotating shaft is fixedly connected on an output shaft of the motor; an impeller is fixedly connected to the rotating shaft; a first air passage and a second air passage are formed in the bottle body above the water tank; a first spray hole is formed in the side wall of the bottle body; according to the invention, the motor is powered by the battery, the motor drives the impeller to rotate, the impeller stirs water in the water tank, air with moisture is sent into the first air passage, and then the air enters the bottle body through the second air passage and the first spray hole, so that a humid environment is effectively created, medicines in the bottle body are stored in the humid air, the medicines are prevented from going bad, and the quality guarantee period of the medicines is prolonged to a great extent.

title_en: Multistage slide rail cantilever extending structure of carriage
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-stage slide rail cantilever telescopic structure of a conveying frame, which comprises a basic assembly, a slide rail assembly and a grabbing assembly, wherein the basic assembly comprises a base plate, a slide rail assembly and a cantilever; the basic assembly comprises side rails, a front bracket, a rear bracket, a conveying cylinder and a telescopic rod; the sliding rail assembly comprises a first-stage sliding rail, a second-stage sliding rail, a fixing plate, a third-stage sliding rail and a limiting piece, wherein one side of the side rail is connected with the first-stage sliding rail in a sliding manner; according to the telescopic mechanism, the third-stage slide rail is pulled to slide into the inner side of the second-stage slide rail through the conveying cylinder under the combined action of the first-stage slide rail, the second-stage slide rail is driven to slide into the inner side of the first-stage slide rail through the limiting piece, so that the mounting size is short, the occupied area is small, the external space of equipment is not occupied, meanwhile, the second-stage slide rail and the third-stage slide rail can be driven to extend out through the conveying cylinder, and the third-stage slide rail is used as required and is all designed in a U-shaped plate sleeving and embedding mode, so that the strength of the cantilever telescopic structure is.

title_en: Electronic pallet and method for selectively blocking fork openings of an electronic pallet
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to technology in a vehicle environment, and to an electronic pallet including a blocking mechanism arranged to selectively block and unblock its fork openings. According to a first aspect, the present disclosure relates to an electronic carrier (90) arranged to be loadable onto a vehicle (1). The electronic pallet (90) comprises a fork opening (94) arranged to receive the lifting fork (31). The electronic carrier (90) further comprises a blocking mechanism (91) arranged to selectively block and unblock the fork openings (94) and a control device (96) configured to control the blocking mechanism (91) to selectively block and unblock the fork openings (94) based on one or more predetermined criteria. Thereby, the fork opening (94) can be blocked during transportation and storage, thereby preventing theft. The disclosure also relates to a corresponding method, a computer program and a computer program product for performing the proposed method.

title_en: Improved yarn feeding mechanism of circular knitting machine
abstract_en: The invention provides an improved yarn feeding mechanism of a circular knitting machine, which comprises a plurality of yarn barrel transmission assemblies for clamping yarn barrels to transmit, a plurality of yarn splicing assemblies for correspondingly butting the yarns of the yarn barrels on the yarn barrel transmission assemblies with the yarns on a knitting machine body, and a rack for fixing the plurality of yarn barrel transmission assemblies and the plurality of yarn splicing assemblies; the wire connecting assembly comprises an ultrasonic butt connector and a wire storing device, wherein the ultrasonic butt connector is used for connecting two wires in a wire mode, and the wire storing device is located at the output end of the ultrasonic butt connector. According to the improved yarn feeding mechanism of the circular knitting machine, after the yarn barrel is used up, the yarn is continuously fed to the knitting machine body through the yarn pair cached by the yarn storing device, so that the machine does not need to be stopped, a new yarn barrel is transmitted through the yarn barrel transmission assembly, and then the yarn end of the new yarn barrel is connected with the knitting yarn through the ultrasonic butt joint device.

title_en: Stability control method of rail type liquid conveying system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a stable control method of a rail-mounted liquid conveying system, wherein the rail-mounted liquid conveying system comprises a rail and a plurality of conveying devices, and each conveying device comprises a container for containing liquid and a driver; the method comprises the following steps: step A: the main controller circuit obtains the load change information of the driver; and B: the main controller circuit acquires liquid level state information; step E: the main controller circuit generates liquid shaking state information according to the liquid level state information and the driver load change information, and uses the liquid shaking state information as liquid feedback information; step F: according to the liquid feedback information, the main controller circuit generates driving regulation and control information through a shake suppression control algorithm program and sends the driving regulation and control information to a driver in the corresponding conveying device, and the driving regulation and control information is used for regulating and controlling the motion state of the conveying device. Through the arrangement, the problems of poor transportation stability and poor reliability caused by the fact that liquid is easy to shake and splash in the conventional rail type liquid conveying system can be solved.

title_en: Series reconfigurable variable-stiffness robot joint structure based on permanent magnet springs
abstract_en: A series reconfigurable variable-stiffness robot joint structure based on permanent magnet springs comprises a base, a rope and a variable-stiffness motor; one end of a vertical base body of the base is processed into a waist-shaped blind hole, the other end of the vertical base body is processed with an upper through hole and a lower through hole which are communicated with the waist-shaped blind hole, a rotating shaft I is installed in the lower through hole through a bearing, one end of the rotating shaft I is sequentially connected with a speed reducer and a position servo motor, and a small belt wheel is installed at the part, located in the waist-shaped blind hole, of the; the upper through hole is internally rotatably installed with the shaft body of the output disc through a crossed roller bearing I, the end face of the crossed roller bearing I is fixedly connected with one end of the disc of the output disc, a large belt wheel is installed inside the shaft body of the output disc, which is located in the waist-shaped blind hole, a synchronous belt is installed between the large belt wheel and the small belt wheel, and the disc of the output disc is sequentially connected with the connecting rod disc and the variable rigidity device through a crossed roller bearing II. The rigidity adjusting device changes the rigidity adjusting range by quickly adjusting the arrangement mode of the permanent magnet springs and the ropes, and the application range is wider.

title_en: Packaging box
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of packaging, and particularly discloses a packaging box. Wherein, the packing carton is formed by paper material is folding to be used for packing lamp decoration and lamp decoration's accessory, the packing carton includes box and interior card subassembly. The top of the box body is folded to form a first buffer layer. The inside at the box of inside card subassembly holding, the holding tank has been seted up to the one end of inside card subassembly, and the inside folding of holding tank is formed with the inner wall buffer layer to be used for the holding lamp decoration, the other end of inside card subassembly is folded and is formed with the second buffer layer, and the both ends of second buffer layer butt respectively in the bottom of box and the bottom of holding tank, and the second buffer layer is used for the holding accessory. First buffer layer, inner wall buffer layer and second buffer layer cladding lamp decoration to fixed and buffering lamp decoration, and then avoid the direct contact of lamp decoration and box, further guarantee the buffering effect of lamp decoration, avoid increasing other buffer material and lead to packing carton manufacturing cost to increase.

title_en: Remove manipulator precision positioning system in coordination
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mobile manipulator cooperative precision positioning system, which belongs to the technical field of industrial robots and comprises an embedded control system, wherein the embedded control system and an upper computer exchange data in real time through a serial port interactive communication module, and the upper computer is used for processing acquired data; the embedded control system and the robot motion control module perform real-time data exchange; the robot transplanting module is used for transporting the clamping robot and the terminal operation robot clamped by the clamping robot to an operation area; the clamping part of the clamping robot module and the clamping part of the terminal operation robot are both provided with a pressure detection module; the terminal operation robot and the robot transplanting module are respectively provided with a monitoring module, and the monitoring modules are used for detecting whether barriers exist in the terminal operation robot along the advancing direction of the terminal operation robot. And cooperatively controlling the robot transplanting module, the clamping robot module and the terminal operation robot through the robot motion control module.

title_en: Self-interacting coating packaging hardware
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coating packaging, and discloses a self-adjusting coating packaging device which comprises a sleeve, wherein a base is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the middle of the sleeve, a compression rod is movably connected to the inner wall of the middle of the sleeve, an electromagnet is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the middle of the sleeve, an expansion block is movably connected to the inner wall of the middle of the sleeve, and an extension spring is fixedly connected to the outer side of the expansion block. This self-interacting coating packaging hardware, it leads the electrical pillar motion to drive through the compression pole, it drives the resistance card operation to lead electrical pillar, rethread compression spring uses with telescopic cooperation, thereby reach the storage bucket of scribbling to different diameters and carry out measuring effect, if the storage bucket of scribbling of small bore diameter the length of compression pole compressed this moment is less this moment lead electrical pillar and resistance card contact and the resistance of resistance card is minimum this moment, the flexible length of telescopic link is longer, if the storage bucket of scribbling of heavy-calibre the length of compression pole compressed this moment is longer this moment lead electrical pillar and resistance card contact and the resistance of resistance card is the biggest this moment, the flexible length of telescopic link is shorter.

title_en: Automatic welding system, method for manufacturing elevator car chamber member, and automatic welding method
abstract_en: The automatic welding system is provided with: a data storage unit for storing the order number, the drawing number, and the size data of the welding target workpiece in association with each other; a calculation unit that calculates a welding position of the workpiece to be welded based on the figure number and the size data corresponding to the input result of the order number; an image processing device for calculating an error amount between an actual setting position of the welding target workpiece obtained from the image pickup result of the camera and a standard setting position of the welding target workpiece obtained from the welding position calculated by the calculating part; and a welding machine, wherein the calculation part recalculates the welding position based on the error amount, thereby calculating the welding position after the correction, and enabling the welding machine to weld the workpieces to be welded based on the welding position after the correction.

title_en: Elevator car braking fixing device and fixing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an elevator car braking fixing device and a fixing method thereof, and belongs to the field of car braking. The utility model provides an elevator car braking fixing device, includes the car body, still includes: the box body is fixedly connected to the outer wall of the top of the car body; the speed sensor is arranged on the outer wall of the top of the box body; the safety block is connected to the car body in a sliding manner; the round groove and the long groove are communicated with each other and are arranged on the car body; the round rod is fixedly connected in the round groove; the sliding block is fixedly connected to the bottom of the safety block and is connected to the round rod in a sliding mode; the first sliding plate and the second sliding plate are connected to the round rod in a sliding mode and are fixedly connected through a connecting rod; the fixed block is fixedly connected to the side wall of the car body; an auxiliary clamping assembly matched with the sliding block is arranged in the long groove; the invention can carry out braking operation for many times, has better braking and fixing effects, and is convenient for automatic resetting of each fixing part, thereby being convenient for use.

title_en: Pick-up execution terminal and delivery pick-up system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a pick-up execution terminal and a conveying pick-up system, which are used for picking up materials conveyed on a conveying mechanism, wherein the pick-up execution terminal comprises: the main body is arranged on one side of the conveying mechanism along the conveying direction; a picking mechanism mounted on and movable relative to the body, the picking mechanism having an actuator for picking up the material; and the in-place sensing assembly is connected to the actuating mechanism in a follow-up manner, defines a sensing position and is used for sensing whether the material is in place or not, and the sensing position is positioned at the downstream of the material conveying path. The position that the fragment of brick stopped on conveying mechanism at every turn can always follow the position change that picks up the mechanism and change to guarantee that the position that the fragment of brick stopped at every turn all is in the near of picking up the mechanism, guarantee to pick up the mechanism and need not all remove to fixed position at every turn and grab the brick, the removal stroke is short, and it is short to grab the brick consuming time, reduces the energy consumption.

title_en: Automatic handling system based on AGV and multi-AGV cooperation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic handling system based on an AGV (automatic guided vehicle), which belongs to the technical field of the AGV and comprises an AGV trolley, an extrusion assembly, a moving track, a track seat, a triggering assembly, a cleaning assembly, a vibration component, a driving assembly and a transmission assembly, wherein the moving track is fixedly arranged at the top of the track seat, and the AGV trolley is arranged on the moving track in a sliding manner; according to the invention, the infrared sensor is installed on the outer part of the front-end AGV, the transmission component is installed in the inner part of the front-end AGV, when the front-end AGV runs in a usual mode, the infrared sensor can effectively detect the distance between the front-end AGV and the front-end AGV, when the distance reaches a set value, the front-end AGV can automatically control to start the driving motor, the driving motor can drive the transmission component to be sent out, and as the connecting spring pad is arranged on the outer part of the transmission component, when the first transmission plate of the transmission component is completely sent out of the AGV body, the front-end AGV can be automatically bent, and at the moment, a worker or a manipulator can quickly transfer cargos on the AGV body to the front-end AGV, so that the cooperative work effect of multiple AGVs is effectively realized.

title_en: Hank yarn carding and tightness adjusting device for spinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of spinning, in particular to a hank yarn carding and tightness adjusting device for spinning and a method thereof, which comprises a base, a vertical plate and a conveying mechanism, and also comprises a controller, a carding mechanism, a cleaning mechanism and a jacking mechanism, wherein the carding mechanism comprises an adjusting plate, a driving assembly and a plurality of carding plates, the cleaning mechanism is arranged at the top of the base and comprises a collecting box, a rotating assembly and a traction assembly, the jacking mechanism comprises a top roller and a height adjusting assembly, the top of the base is fixedly provided with a vertical rod, the height adjusting assembly is arranged on the inner wall of the vertical rod, the top roller is rotatably arranged on the height adjusting assembly, the driving assembly and the height adjusting assembly are electrically connected with the controller, the hank yarn carding and tightness adjusting device for spinning and the method thereof have higher carding efficiency, can synchronously clean impurities while carding, the power consumption is lower, is favorable to reducing the cost of this device, reduces hank yarn cost.

title_en: Test tube issuing and labeling mechanism, device and method
abstract_en: The application provides a labeling mechanism is provided to test tube at least a test tube storehouse, mounting panel, conveying piece, a sliding connection mounting panel at least roof, set up an at least first actuating mechanism on the mounting panel and with the second actuating mechanism that conveying piece is connected. Each test tube bin is used for placing a plurality of test tubes and is defined with a test tube inlet and a test tube outlet; one end of the mounting plate is provided with a V-shaped groove structure, and each test tube bin and the V-shaped groove structure are vertically mounted on the mounting plate. The conveying piece is arranged on the V-shaped groove structure. Each roof sliding connection test tube storehouse, its one end runs through this test tube storehouse and this end is used for placing and the test tube in this test tube storehouse of top. The second driving mechanism drives the conveying member to move so as to convey the test tubes on the conveying member to the clamping and labeling mechanism for labeling. The application also provides a test tube issuing and labeling device applying the test tube issuing and labeling mechanism and a test tube issuing and labeling method based on the test tube issuing and labeling mechanism.

title_en: Coal mine transportation device with transportation route planning function
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal mine transportation, in particular to a coal mine transportation device with a transportation route planning function, which comprises a feeding mechanism, a steering mechanism, a crushing mechanism, a discharging mechanism, a base and a driving mechanism, wherein the bottom of one end of the feeding mechanism is connected with the crushing mechanism, the bottom of the crushing mechanism is rotatably connected with the discharging mechanism, the base is arranged below the discharging mechanism, the driving mechanism is arranged on one side of the discharging mechanism, the bottom of the driving mechanism is fixed on the upper surface of the base, and the steering mechanism is connected between the top of the driving mechanism and the bottom of the feeding mechanism. The coal mine transportation device designed by the invention adopts the design of the blanking mechanism, is flexible in steering and smaller in weight, can complete the planning and adjustment of the transportation route under the condition of limited operation space in a mine tunnel, adopts the suspended design, can quickly complete the route planning of coal mine transportation through the steering mechanism even if the road surface is rugged, and effectively improves the coal transportation efficiency.

title_en: Solar protection devices that ETFE membrane structure sports building used
abstract_en: The invention relates to a sun shading device, in particular to a sun shading device with an ETFE (ethylene-vinyl acetate) membrane structure for sports buildings, which comprises a membrane supporting mechanism, a water flow collecting mechanism and a waste water utilization mechanism, wherein the sun shading membrane can be automatically replaced, a thin film roller can be easily disassembled, the device can collect water flow and convert the water flow energy, the device can switch the water direction, the membrane supporting mechanism is positioned above the water flow collecting mechanism, and the waste water utilization mechanism is positioned below the water flow collecting mechanism.

title_en: Green's food commodity circulation transport package case
abstract_en: The invention discloses a green and environment-friendly food logistics transportation packaging box, and relates to the technical field of logistics transportation equipment; the upper end of the second connecting rod is respectively hinged with the lower end of the first connecting rod at the corresponding position through a rotating shaft and a bearing; the two threaded rods respectively penetrate through the middle parts of the rotating shafts on the same sides of the front side and the rear side through threaded rotation; the side plates on the same sides of the left side and the right side are rotatably connected through hinges, and the side plates are rotatably connected with the lifting frame and the bottom plate through hinges; the two panels are movably inserted into the through grooves formed in the front side and the rear side of the upper side of the lifting frame respectively; slots are symmetrically formed in the front side and the rear side of the upper side of the bottom plate, and the bottom surface of the panel is movably inserted into the slots; the occupation of the storage space is reduced, and the transportation is convenient; the device wholly adopts collapsible, the structure of assembling, conveniently carries out the reutilization, has reduced the waste of resource, simultaneously, easy operation, convenient to use.

title_en: Medium discharge device, medium processing device, and recording system
abstract_en: The application discloses a medium discharge device, a medium processing device and a recording system. A medium discharge device is provided with: a first tray for receiving and placing a medium; a second tray that receives the medium discharged from the first tray; a discharge mechanism that discharges a medium from the first tray toward the second tray; and a first curl suppression member that is positioned above the rear end region in the discharge direction of the medium, maintains a posture, and moves following the movement of the rear end region until the medium placed on the first tray is discharged from the first tray to the second tray by the discharge mechanism and placed on the second tray.

title_en: Disposable suction head bundling device, packaging box and analyzer
abstract_en: The technical scheme provided by the invention is as follows: the disposable suction head bundling device, the packaging box and the analyzer comprise a handle belt, a first fixing belt, a second fixing belt and a locking belt; the first fixing band is a horizontal fixing band, and one end of the first fixing band is provided with a U-shaped tongue; the second fixing band comprises a vertical fixing band, a first thin band and a second thin band, and a void structure is arranged between the first thin band and the second thin band; the two sides of the lock belt are provided with a first opening, a second opening, a third opening and a T-shaped opening; the handle belt, the first fixing belt, the second fixing belt and the locking belt are made of an integral material through die cutting and forming; when binding, the U-shaped tongue of the first fixing band penetrates through the third opening from the inner side of the lock band and is clamped in the T-shaped opening, and by means of the technical scheme, the technical problem that a binding material drops in the process of installing the suction head is solved, and the technical problem that the existing binding technology is eccentric is solved.

title_en: Automatic bale breaker
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of unpacking, and provides an automatic unpacking machine, which comprises: the device comprises a tripping device, a conveying device, a turnover dumping device and a packaging and recycling device; the unbuckling device is located above the conveying device, the overturning and dumping device is located on one side of the conveying device, and the packaging and recovering device is located on one side of the overturning and dumping device. Therefore, the bag opening and pouring device is simple in structure, the packaging bags can be automatically unpacked, poured and recycled, the packaging bags are not damaged, and secondary recycling is achieved.

title_en: Manufacturing process and manufacturing formula of high-strength fireproof and moistureproof tray
abstract_en: The invention discloses a manufacturing process and a manufacturing formula of a high-strength fireproof and moistureproof tray, and relates to the technical field of trays. The invention comprises the following components in parts by weight: 25-15 parts of magnesium oxide, 20-10 parts of magnesium chloride, 20-10 parts of magnesium sulfate, 10-1 part of glass fiber cloth, 20-10 parts of sawdust, 20-10 parts of rice hull, 15-5 parts of straw, 2-1 part of perlite, 2-1 part of ferric oxide color paste and 2-1 part of ferric oxide toner.
