According to the invention, the magnesium chloride and the magnesium oxide are added into the formula of the tray, so that the heat resistance of the tray can be improved, and the fireproof effect of the tray can be achieved.

title_en: Flexible lifting feeding system based on AGV and feeding control method
abstract_en: The invention provides a flexible lifting feeding system based on an AGV and a feeding control method, wherein the system comprises: the system comprises an AGV logistics vehicle, an apparatus, a fine positioning lifting mechanism, an RFID system, a vision system, a lifting sliding door and a robot; utensil and AGV commodity circulation car location installation, load white automobile body part product on the utensil, smart location lifting mechanism arranges in feed opening department and matches the realization with the utensil and fix a position and lift, the RFID system is used for reading the information of utensil and then discerns the motorcycle type information that white automobile body part product corresponds, visual system is used for discerning the concrete characteristic of white automobile body part product, the door setting that slides goes up and down is between utensil and robot, the robot switches the gripping apparatus according to motorcycle type information to concrete characteristic adjustment gripping apparatus according to white automobile body part product snatchs the form. The invention can meet the requirements of welding automation, can also meet the flexible integration of multiple vehicle types, and has higher level.

title_en: Chess packaging system and chess packaging method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a chess packaging system and a chess packaging method. The chess container system comprises a chess piece conveying device, a feeding device, a sorting device and a transfer device; the feeding device comprises a feeding mechanism and a detection mechanism which are arranged at the input end of the chess piece conveying device, and the detection mechanism comprises an image identification component facing the chess piece conveying device; the sorting device comprises a guide mechanism arranged on the chess piece conveying device and a sorting mechanism movably arranged on the guide mechanism, the guide mechanism is provided with a plurality of cache channels, and the cache channels are communicated with one end of the guide mechanism close to the feeding device and one end of the guide mechanism close to the transferring device; the sorting mechanism can drive the chessmen to enter each cache channel; move and carry the device including set up in move the mechanism and follow-up install in moving the pick-up mechanism who carries the mechanism of carrying of piece conveyor output, move and carry the mechanism and can drive and pick up the mechanism reciprocating motion between sorting device and chess box to shift the chess piece to the chess box through picking up the mechanism.

title_en: Automatic material pumping machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic material pumping machine which comprises a rack and a bowl body, wherein a butterfly valve is fixed on the outer wall of the top of the rack, a pipe joint is connected to one section of the butterfly valve, the pipe joint is connected with a downstream vacuum conveyor, a hose is connected to one end of the butterfly valve, a guide rail is arranged on the inner wall of one side of the rack, a sliding block is connected to the guide rail in a sliding mode, a moving plate is fixed on the outer wall of one side of the sliding block through a bolt, an air cylinder is fixed on the outer wall of one side of the moving plate through a bolt, a suction nozzle is connected to one end of the air cylinder, the suction nozzle is connected with the hose, a conveying line is arranged on the inner wall of one side of the rack, the bowl body is located on the conveying line, the suction nozzle is located above the bowl body, and an ash hopper is arranged at the bottom of the rack. According to the invention, the pipe joint is arranged, the hose is connected with the butterfly valve and the pipe joint and the downstream vacuum conveyor, so that materials can be conveyed into the downstream vacuum conveyor through the suction nozzle and the pipeline system, the butterfly valve is closed when the materials are not conveyed, and the materials in the pipeline are prevented from returning to the suction nozzle, thereby causing equipment pollution.

title_en: Variable-angle movable steel structure oblique beam hoisting adjusting and supporting system and construction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a variable-angle movable steel structure oblique beam hoisting adjusting and supporting system and a construction method. The construction process comprises the following steps: a. the movable support frame body is installed; b. installing a jacking adjusting device; c. the movable positioning clamping plate is installed and butted with the jacking adjusting device; d. debugging the integral supporting system; e. lifting the steel oblique beam in place, and temporarily fixing the steel oblique beam; f. jacking the steel oblique beam to a mounting position, and adjusting the angle of the steel oblique beam to be connected; g. the steel oblique beam axially shifts and is in butt joint with the connecting part; h. the steel oblique beam is rechecked in place and welded in opposite positions; i. repeating the step e to the step h to finish the hoisting of the steel inclined beam in the same construction section; j. the integral supporting system transversely shifts, and the steps d to the steps i are repeated until the integral steel inclined beam hoisting work is completed; k. and (6) checking and accepting the whole. The invention takes the principles of transverse integral support displacement and flexible alignment of the inclined component to be installed as the principle, has accurate hoisting, high utilization rate of hoisting machinery and saves the construction period.

title_en: Rail mounted electric power angle steel tower overhauls robot
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electric power operation climbing robots, and particularly relates to a track type electric power angle steel tower maintenance robot. The mechanical arm comprises a host and mechanical arms, wherein the host comprises two sets of walking parts which are respectively matched with two adjacent angle steel main materials; horizontal sliding tables are arranged on the two sets of walking parts, the mechanical arm is arranged on the front surface of the base between the two sets of walking parts, horizontal guide rods extend from the base to the horizontal sliding tables on the two sides, and sliding guide fit with the horizontal direction as the guiding direction is formed between the horizontal guide rods and the horizontal sliding tables; the service robot also includes a centering assembly for centering the base position. The climbing device has a light and reliable structure, and can synchronously ensure the action stability and the action reliability of climbing operation, thereby greatly saving the labor inspection cost, improving the maintenance efficiency and ensuring the safe and reliable operation of a power transmission system.

title_en: Board collecting and releasing machine and method for improving test efficiency of PCB (printed circuit board) test machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a trigger retraction machine and a method for improving the test efficiency of a PCB (printed circuit board) test machine, wherein the trigger retraction machine comprises a rack, at least one material rack movably arranged on the rack, a first driving device for driving the material rack to move up and down, a suction plate arm arranged above the material rack and a second driving device for driving the suction plate arm to move left and right, the suction plate arm can move out of one side of the rack, and the material rack comprises a fixed seat in transmission connection with the first driving device and a plurality of long arms arranged at the front end of the fixed seat at intervals. According to the invention, the board collecting and releasing machine is used for carrying out the upper board and the lower board of the PCB, so that the processes of repeatedly carrying, framing and taking the frame in the testing procedure can be reduced, the time and the labor are greatly saved, the probability of scratching and collision of the finished board is reduced, the hidden danger of the product quality is reduced, and the production efficiency is improved.

title_en: Ball-milled storage barrel circulating system and using method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a storage vat circulating system after ball milling and a using method thereof, and relates to the technical field of material storage. According to the invention, when the ground product is stored in the storage barrel body, the sensing device is used for monitoring the internal temperature and humidity of the storage barrel body, when the internal temperature of the storage barrel body is higher, the transmission pump is started, the transmission pump drives the air with higher temperature in the storage barrel body to move into the transmission pump, the water source in the storage tank is matched for cooling the gas temperature in the annular hollow pipe, and the air is transmitted into the storage barrel body through the connecting pipeline, so that the temperature is cooled.

title_en: Dust suppression structure and coal conveying and crushing system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal conveying systems, in particular to a dust suppression structure and a coal conveying and crushing system, wherein the dust suppression structure is suitable for being installed in a coal dropping pipe, the coal dropping pipe comprises two opposite first side walls, the first side walls are provided with installation through holes, and the dust suppression structure comprises: the first fixing structure is suitable for being fixed on one of the first side walls, and is provided with a first hinge hole which is suitable for being communicated with the inside of the coal dropping pipe; the second fixing structure is suitable for being fixed on the other first side wall, and a second hinge hole suitable for being communicated with the inside of the coal dropping pipe is formed in the second fixing structure; the baffle is connected in the first hinge hole and the second hinge hole through a hinge shaft, and the baffle and the hinge shaft are suitable for being installed in the coal dropping pipe through the installation through hole; the driving assembly is suitable for being fixed outside the coal dropping pipe, is connected with the hinge shaft and is used for driving the baffle to rotate so that the baffle has a blocking position perpendicular to the axial direction of the coal dropping pipe and an opening position parallel to the axial direction of the coal dropping pipe.

title_en: Peripheral warning device special for power maintenance
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power maintenance, and particularly relates to a peripheral warning device special for power maintenance, which aims at solving the problems that the existing peripheral warning device for power maintenance is not easy to see by people when used at night and has poor warning effect. The warning belt can uniformly spray the fluorescent powder on the warning belt through the fluorescent powder storage box, so that people can clearly see the position of the warning belt at night.

title_en: Intelligent high-voltage cable counting winding drum for harbor machinery steamship deck
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent counting winding drum for a high-voltage cable for a port machinery ship deck, which comprises a positioning auxiliary structure, a first motor, an active winding drum and an intelligent counting structure, wherein one side of the positioning auxiliary structure is fixedly connected with the first motor through a screw, the output end of the first motor is fixedly connected with the active winding drum, and the intelligent counting structure is arranged on the side, away from the first motor, of the active winding drum. According to the invention, through the design of the positioning auxiliary structure, the device is convenient for carrying out automatic adaptive adjustment and clamping on the cable wound by the active winding drum, the assembly limiting performance of the cable is greatly improved, the labor payment is reduced, and through the design of the intelligent counting structure, the device is convenient for automatically metering the integral winding turns, so that the length of the wound cable is conveniently obtained, the convenience of data acquisition is greatly improved, and the device is more convenient to apply to a ship body.

title_en: Hydraulic jack
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydraulic jack which comprises a supporting seat, wherein one side of the outer wall of the top of the supporting seat is connected with a large hydraulic cylinder through a bolt, the outer wall of one side of the large hydraulic cylinder is provided with an oil tank, one side of the outer wall of the top of the oil tank is fixedly connected with a small hydraulic cylinder, the outer wall of the top of the small hydraulic cylinder is fixedly connected with a handle, the outer wall of the top of the large hydraulic cylinder is fixedly connected with a jacking mechanism, two sides of the outer wall of the top of the supporting seat are respectively provided with a second sliding groove, a counterweight mechanism is slidably connected inside the second sliding grooves, and the counterweight mechanism comprises a counterweight table and a counterweight block. The invention can prevent the jack from falling due to unstable gravity center to cause the heavy object to fall from the high position to cause damage to the heavy object, prevent the heavy object from falling from the jacking mechanism due to smaller contact area between the heavy object and the jacking mechanism, improve the stability of the jack and carry out lifting treatment on the heavy objects with different weights.

title_en: Method and device for planning splicing path of mechanical arm
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and computer equipment for planning a path of a mechanical arm, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining a starting point parameter and a target point parameter of the mechanical arm, and searching a plurality of first paths of the mechanical arm from the starting point to the target point from a preset path library based on an A-x algorithm according to the starting point parameter and the target point parameter, wherein the first paths refer to paths between any two adjacent nodes in the process of moving from the starting point to the target point; sequentially splicing the first paths according to a preset splicing algorithm to obtain an initial path corresponding to the movement of the mechanical arm from a starting point to a target point, and verifying whether the initial path meets collision detection; and if not, adjusting the initial path to obtain an adjusted path, and taking the adjusted path as the path of the mechanical arm, wherein the adjusted path meets the collision detection. The technical problem that the path planned by the prior art enables the motion efficiency of the mechanical arm to be lower is solved.

title_en: Powder tank car evacuating device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a powder tank truck vacuumizing device, which comprises a tank body; the air exhaust hole is arranged at the top of the vehicle box body, and the outer part of the air exhaust hole is butted with the air exhaust pump; the pushing rod is fixed on the inner wall of the car box body; the moving block is fixed at the end part of the push rod; the sealing block is arranged on the upper part of the moving block in a sliding manner; the telescopic link, the telescopic link is vertical to be set up inside the car box, and after the movable block extended, the telescopic link promoted sealed piece and will the aspirating hole shutoff. The problems that the air suction pump is directly connected with the car box body, the connection is unstable and the sealing of an air suction hole is unstable in the process of vacuumizing the carriage are solved.

title_en: New energy automobile fills electric pile
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new energy automobile charging pile which comprises a charging pile shell and a charging module, wherein the charging module is installed at the lower end of the charging pile shell, a wire alignment mechanism is installed at the upper end of the charging pile shell, an automatic winding mechanism is arranged at the upper end of the charging pile shell, and a wire butting mechanism is arranged on one side of the automatic winding mechanism. The invention has the advantages that the length of the electrified cable can be determined according to the actual working condition through the action of the wire butting mechanism, so that the charging requirement is met, the electric power is prevented from passing through redundant cables, and the purpose of energy conservation is realized; the output end of the length of the cable can be perpendicular to the winding roller all the time under the action of the automatic winding mechanism and the wire aligning mechanism, the output end of the length of the cable moves along with the movement of a cable releasing point, and the phenomenon that the cable is not stable enough when being wound is avoided.

title_en: Non-real-time and real-time mixed interpolation calculation method for industrial robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a non-real-time and real-time mixed interpolation calculation method for an industrial robot, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of: the interpolation calculation of the motion control system of the industrial robot is divided into a non-real-time discrete calculation part and a real-time interpolation calculation part, the non-real-time discrete calculation part and the real-time interpolation calculation part are mutually independent, an independent central processing unit is adopted to occupy independent memory resources, and a track instruction is converted into a real-time servo instruction through the mixed calculation of the non-real-time discrete calculation part and the real-time interpolation calculation part, so that the motion control of the robot is realized. The invention removes the limitation of the computer operation speed and the interpolation period beat, puts the complex track planning algorithm in the traditional real-time interpolation calculation into the non-real-time discrete calculation of the invention, leads the track planning to be separated from the time limitation of the real-time interpolation period, and improves the integral performance of the interpolation algorithm. The method reduces the calculated amount of the real-time interpolation calculation, improves the efficiency of the real-time interpolation calculation, and also improves the efficiency of the integral interpolation calculation.

title_en: Intelligent direct-current double-gun ordered charging pile
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent direct-current double-gun ordered charging pile which comprises a charging pile body, wherein the charging pile body comprises a shell, a charging gun, a bottom plate and a winding shaft, an interactive panel is arranged at the front end of the shell, a blocking cover and the charging gun are arranged on two sides of the shell, the rear end of the charging gun is connected with an output wire through a clamping block, exhaust pipes are arranged on two sides of the charging gun, a sucking disc is arranged at one end of each exhaust pipe, a second magnet is arranged at the rear end of each sucking disc, a handle is arranged at the bottom end of the charging gun, a hook is arranged at the bottom end of each handle, a wire hole is formed in the bottom end of the blocking cover, a first magnet is arranged on two sides of each wire hole, a roller is arranged at the bottom end of each wire hole, and a motor is arranged on one side inside the shell, so that the intelligent direct-current double-gun ordered charging pile is simple and convenient to use and can automatically recover the charging gun, the rate of utilization is higher, and firm in connection is more intelligent, has the function of removal use.

title_en: Safe and convenient welding rod heat preservation drying barrel
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of welding auxiliary equipment, and discloses a safe and convenient welding rod heat-insulating drying barrel which comprises a barrel body, wherein a barrel cover is movably connected to the top end of the barrel body, a secondary cavity bottom plate is fixedly connected to one side of the bottom end of the barrel body, the secondary cavity bottom plate is a circular chassis, a guide rail is arranged at the top end of the secondary cavity bottom plate and is divided into an inner rail and an outer rail, an inner partition plate is movably connected to the secondary cavity bottom plate through the inner rail, an outer partition plate is movably connected to the secondary cavity bottom plate through the outer rail, a partition plate air chamber is formed in the middle of the outer partition plate, and an outer handle is fixedly connected to the outer side of the outer partition plate. According to the invention, the inner cavity is divided into the main cavity and the secondary cavity by the inner partition plate, and the high-temperature and high-pressure gas in the inner cavity is sealed and isolated from the inner main cavity, so that the heat loss of the welding rod in the heat-insulating barrel in the process of taking the welding rod outwards is avoided, and the harm of burning and the like caused by hot steam in the barrel in the process of taking the welding rod is avoided.

title_en: Filling system with integrative coordinated type of spiral cover and gland
abstract_en: The invention discloses an integrated linkage type filling system with a rotary cover and a gland, and relates to the technical field of beverage production equipment. The invention comprises a bottle feeding and punching machine, a filling star wheel, a cap screwing machine, a transition star wheel, a capping machine and a bottle discharging star wheel; the cap screwing machine comprises a cap screwing mechanism, a star wheel turntable of the cap screwing machine and a transmission mechanism; the capping machine comprises a capping mechanism, a star wheel turntable of the capping machine and another transmission mechanism; the transmission mechanism comprises a shaft seat which is rotatably connected with a hollow shaft; the hollow shaft is connected with a transmission main shaft in a rotating way, and a clutch is connected between the hollow shaft and the transmission main shaft. The invention forms a production line between the cap screwing machine and the capping machine and between the bottle washing machine and the filling machine through the filling star wheel and the transition star wheel, and realizes power interruption when the cap screwing machine or the capping machine is not used through the transmission mechanism, thereby only realizing the conveying function, and solving the problems that the existing cap screwing machine and the capping machine cannot share one production line and the integral production cost is increased.

title_en: Portable storage tank for environment-friendly water-based polishing oil scratch-resistant wear-resistant coating
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable storage tank for environment-friendly water-based polishing oil scraping-resistant wear-resistant paint, which comprises a tank body and a tank cover, wherein the tank cover is detachably arranged on the surface of the tank body, a bottom cover is detachably arranged at the bottom of the tank body, a fixing ring is fixedly arranged on the side surface of the tank body, a lifting assembly is rotatably connected inside the fixing ring, a rotating wheel assembly is movably arranged at the bottom of the lifting assembly, the bottom cover comprises a cover body, and a threaded column pipe is fixedly arranged on the top surface of the cover body. In the scheme, the lifting assembly is matched with the rotating wheel assembly, so that the tank body can be moved through the roller, the tank body conveying process is simpler, the tank body is convenient to convey, and the effect of improving the conveying efficiency is achieved; the bottom cover matched with the drain hole is arranged at the bottom of the tank body, so that water can be directly discharged from the bottom of the tank body when the tank body is cleaned, the tank body does not need to be dumped or pumped for a long time to discharge, the drainage speed is accelerated, the operation is simple, and the effect of improving the cleaning speed is achieved.

title_en: Truss included angle measuring and calculating method and alignment method for movable multi-section truss belt conveyor
abstract_en: The invention provides a truss included angle measuring and calculating method of a movable multi-section truss belt conveyor, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of: a first sensor and a second sensor are respectively arranged at two sides of the end parts of two adjacent trusses and are respectively used for detecting the upper end distance m1 and the lower end distance n1 of the two adjacent trusses; calculating an included angle alpha between two adjacent trusses according to the upper end distance m1 and the lower end distance n1; according to the invention, the distance change values of the two trusses are measured by the sensor, then the included angle is obtained by conversion calculation according to a designed formula, and then the moving distance of the trusses is adjusted according to the included angle value.

title_en: Safe conveying device and method for food processing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safe conveying device and a safe conveying method for food processing, and the safe conveying device comprises a supporting plate, wherein an anti-virus frame is arranged in the middle of two ends of the top of the supporting plate, a plurality of groups of ultraviolet germicidal lamps are uniformly arranged on the top inside the anti-virus frame, limiting hinge rods are hinged to one side of two ends inside the anti-virus frame, grooves are formed in one side of the tops of the two groups of limiting hinge rods, and two-way threaded rods penetrate through one side of two ends of the anti-virus frame, which is close to the limiting hinge rods; according to the invention, through the mutual matching among the rollers, the containing frames, the adjusting components, the expansion plates, the containing grooves, the ropes and the third through grooves, the expansion plates can be pulled out from the insides of the two groups of containing grooves, the length of the conveying device can be flexibly adjusted, and the conveying device can be perfectly fused into a production line under different factories and situations, so that the conveying device can be suitable for conveying food with different lengths.

title_en: Wire protection guide device for wire winding machine
abstract_en: The invention provides a wire protection guide device for a take-up machine, which comprises a fixed support, a swinging support and a wire protection frame, wherein the fixed support is fixedly connected with the swinging support; the swinging support is fixed at the rear end of the fixed support, the wire protection frame is arranged above the front part of the fixed support, and the wire guide wheel set is arranged at the front end position and the rear end position of the wire protection frame and is arranged on the fixed support. The invention can wrap the steel wire, thereby greatly improving the safety of the production line; novel structure, simple, if the fixed bolster medium plate is opened the breach and has improved the installation convenience greatly, the design of swing support dead eye has improved the flexibility of device operation greatly.

title_en: Elevator car frame
abstract_en: The invention discloses an elevator car frame, which belongs to an elevator structure and comprises an upper beam and a lower beam, wherein a car is arranged between the upper beam and the lower beam, the upper beam comprises a plurality of upper beam units and upper beam connecting pieces used for connecting adjacent upper beam units, the upper beam connecting pieces are used for adjusting the length of the upper beam, the length of the upper beam can be adjusted by changing the installation positions of the upper beam units and the upper beam connecting pieces, and the lower Liang Tongli solves the problems that in the prior art, the elevator can only be used in a hoistway with fixed width, and the cost is greatly increased once the hoistway for construction is replaced.

title_en: Online labeling device and method for hot-rolled section
abstract_en: The invention provides a hot-rolled section bar on-line labeling device applied to the technical field of hot-rolled section bar production, and also relates to a hot-rolled section bar on-line labeling method, wherein an on-line cleaning part (1) of the hot-rolled section bar on-line labeling device comprises a suspension arm I (3), a cleaning sliding part (4), a sliding rod I (5) and a nozzle (6), and an on-line labeling part (2) comprises a suspension arm II (15), a sliding rod II (7), a labeling sliding part (8), a rubber belt wheel support (9) and a rubber belt wheel (10). The operation requirement is met.

title_en: Temporary paving apparatus
abstract_en: The invention discloses temporary paving equipment, which comprises a fixed support, a roller and a paving plate group, wherein the roller is rotatably arranged on the fixed support, the roller is used for winding the paving plate group, the paving plate group comprises a plurality of supporting pieces which are arranged in parallel and at intervals, two adjacent supporting pieces are connected through a connecting piece, two opposite ends of the connecting piece are respectively provided with a first connecting hole and a second connecting hole, two ends of the connecting piece are respectively pivoted with the supporting pieces through the first connecting holes, the supporting pieces are provided with locking mechanisms, each locking mechanism comprises a limiting column which is arranged corresponding to the second connecting hole, the limiting columns are separated from the second connecting holes when in a storage state so as to enable the connecting pieces to be rotatably connected with the supporting pieces, and the limiting columns are inserted into the second connecting holes when in an expansion state so as to enable the connecting pieces to be fixedly connected with the supporting pieces. The structure is favorable for transmitting the pressure on the supporting piece to the adjacent supporting piece through the connecting piece, the supporting capacity of the whole paving plate assembly for the vehicle is improved, and the smooth running of the vehicle is ensured.

title_en: Robot chassis structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a robot chassis structure which comprises a shell, a first side plate, a second side plate, a first wheel shaft and a second wheel shaft, wherein a communication interface is arranged on the shell, the first side plate is connected with a first side wall of the shell, a first gear box and a second gear box are arranged on the first side plate at intervals, the first gear box comprises two meshed gears and a first driving device connected with a main gear, the second gear box comprises two meshed gears and a second driving device connected with the main gear, the second side plate is connected with a second side wall of the shell, a third gear box and a fourth gear box are arranged on the second side plate at intervals, the third gear box comprises two meshed gears and a third driving device connected with the main gear, the fourth gear box comprises two meshed gears and a fourth driving device connected with the main gear, two driven gears arranged side by side are connected to the first wheel shaft at positions close to two ends, and other two driven gears arranged side by side are connected to the second wheel shaft at positions close to two ends.

title_en: Scissor type hydraulic lifting platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a scissor type hydraulic lifting platform which comprises a box body, wherein a first square through groove is formed in the joint of one side of the box body and a tape measure shell, the box body is communicated with the tape measure shell, one side of the tape measure shell is rotatably connected with a driving shaft, the driving shaft penetrates through the tape measure shell, an elastic steel bar is wound on the excircle of the driving shaft, a soft hairbrush is arranged at one end of the elastic steel bar, the elastic steel bar is positioned in the tape measure shell, the inner walls of the two sides of the box body are rotatably connected with rotating shafts, one sides of the two rotating shafts are fixedly connected with the same rotating block, a second square through groove is formed in the rotating block, and the elastic steel bar penetrates through the second square through groove. According to the pig transport vehicle, the pig is poked by the elastic steel bar and the rotating block, the rotating block enables the elastic steel bar to rotate, the avoided pig is poked, the pig is urged to advance, the pig cannot escape poking of the elastic steel bar, the speed of the pig entering the transport vehicle is greatly increased, the pig is prevented from being detained in the box body, and the whole transport efficiency is improved.

title_en: Energy-saving conveying and drying equipment for processing anhydrous sodium sulphate
abstract_en: The invention discloses energy-saving conveying and drying equipment for processing anhydrous sodium sulphate, and belongs to the technical field of drying machinery. This carry drying equipment includes: the quantitative grinding and drying device comprises a grinding assembly, a filtering assembly, a quantitative conveying assembly and a drying and packaging assembly, wherein a feeding port is formed in a conveying box body, a filter plate is arranged on the feeding port, a shaking motor is arranged in the conveying box body, a gear is arranged at the output end of the shaking motor, the shaking motor is fixedly connected with the inner wall of the conveying box body through a support, a plurality of supporting slide rods are arranged below the shaking motor, a shaking rack is arranged between the shaking motor and the supporting slide rods, teeth on the shaking rack are meshed with the gear on the shaking motor, grinding plates are arranged at two ends of the shaking rack respectively, rough teeth are arranged on two opposite sides of the two grinding plates respectively, the grinding plates are in sliding contact with the filtering assembly, the quantitative conveying assembly is located below the filtering assembly, and the quantitative conveying assembly is connected with the drying and packaging assembly.

title_en: Glass transfer robot and transfer method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a glass transfer robot and a transfer method thereof. Relates to the technical field of transfer robots. Through installing location sliding construction, regulation structure, support fixed knot structure and adsorption structure, can realize adsorbing glass, carry out the upset after adsorbing and carry, through the stability and the flexibility of location sliding construction guarantee displacement transport, can be applicable to the glass of isostructure material, can guarantee the accurate stability of location better, deformation can not appear easily. Including the location sliding construction who is used for providing required track of transport position control and power, guarantee slip stability, with location sliding construction passes through sliding component cooperation sliding connection, is used for driving the transport subassembly and carries out the regulation structure of position control, with adjust the structure through runner assembly rotate connect, be used for providing the support force's of glass transport support fixed knot construct, and with support fixed knot construct the spiro union, be used for adsorbing the adsorption structure group of location to glass.

title_en: Motor magnet steel automatic detection equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses automatic motor magnetic steel detection equipment which comprises a base, wherein a rotary table is arranged on the base, magnetic steel grooves and cushion block grooves are uniformly distributed at intervals on the rotary table, a feeding mechanism and at least three blanking mechanisms are sequentially arranged on the base along the rotating direction of the rotary table, each blanking mechanism comprises a second support, a second magnetic steel stacking groove, a blanking air cylinder and a blanking push plate assembly, a blanking push plate assembly is arranged at the end part of each blanking air cylinder and comprises a fixing head, a guide rod is vertically arranged on each fixing head, a lifting plate is slidably sleeved on each guide rod, a magnet and a blanking push plate are arranged on each lifting plate, a first return spring is arranged between each lifting plate and the bottom of each guide rod, and a stopping assembly is further arranged on each lifting plate. The detection equipment can automatically classify and stack the magnetic steels with the magnetic fluxes meeting the requirements and the magnetic fluxes being too large or too small, and the magnetic steels are still separated by the cushion blocks after detection is finished, so that the detection efficiency and the detection safety are improved.

title_en: Express delivery commodity circulation packing box
abstract_en: The invention provides an express logistics circulation packaging box which comprises a box body, an air bag, a plurality of air column units and a plurality of connecting assemblies, wherein the box body is provided with a containing cavity, the box body comprises a bottom plate, a top plate and a side plate for connecting the bottom plate and the top plate, and the side plate, the top plate and the bottom plate jointly enclose the containing cavity; the air bag is connected with the side plate of the box body and is provided with an inflation and deflation hole; the air column units are connected with the air bag and communicated with the air bag, and each air column unit at least comprises one air column; coupling assembling sets up in the one end that the gasbag was kept away from to the gas column, coupling assembling and gas column one-to-one, and relative gas column can be connected through coupling assembling to make a plurality of gas columns can be parallel or alternately, and then separate the chamber that holds of box for a plurality of accommodation space. The express logistics circulation packaging box can be repeatedly used, and transportation cost is reduced.

title_en: Automatic packaging equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to automatic packaging equipment which comprises a rack, a rack plate, side beams, a stay bar, a motor, a speed reducer, a main shaft, a first chain wheel, a first conveying assembly, a second conveying assembly, a feeding assembly and a heat-sealing cooling assembly, wherein the two side beams which are symmetrical in front and back and distributed in parallel are arranged above the rack; the heat-sealing cooling assembly is arranged above the second conveying assembly; the invention can automatically wind the film paper on the surface of the plate product without manual operation, thereby greatly improving the working efficiency and reducing the labor cost; after winding, the thermal shrinkage packaging of the film paper can be automatically completed; in addition, the film after thermal shrinkage can obtain even automatically cooling with the help of the arc orifice plate, labour saving and time saving.

title_en: Handling device is used in processing of PET composite sheet
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of processing of PET composite boards, in particular to a conveying device for processing the PET composite boards, which comprises a conveying frame, a lifting device, a lighting device and a cleaning device, wherein the inner side of the conveying frame is provided with the lifting device, the lifting device comprises a worm, the top of the front end of the conveying frame is rotatably connected with the worm, the outer side of the worm is meshed with a worm wheel, the inner side of the worm wheel is fixedly connected with a first threaded shaft, and the inner side of the worm wheel is fixedly connected with a first threaded shaft. The normal carrying of the PET composite board under the condition of the barrier is ensured.

title_en: Wedge-shaped lifting shaft structure
abstract_en: The invention provides a wedge-shaped lifting shaft structure, which relates to the technical field of automatic manufacturing, wherein a screw rod and a slide carriage are vertically arranged, so that the installation space in the vertical direction can be greatly saved, and the reliability and the positioning precision can be improved by an optimized structure; the lifting shaft structure comprises: a driving assembly for generating a driving force for achieving horizontal displacement; the steering assembly is connected with the horizontal driving assembly and is used for converting horizontal displacement into vertical displacement; the slide carriage is connected with the steering assembly and used for transmitting the converted vertical displacement to equipment to be lifted; the steering assembly comprises an upper triangle and a lower triangle; both the triangular plates are isosceles right-angle triangular plates or geometric plates obtained by reshaping the isosceles right-angle triangular plates; one right-angle side of the upper triangle is horizontally arranged and the upper triangle moves horizontally under the driving force of the driving component; the hypotenuses of the two triangular plates are connected in a sliding manner, so that the lower triangular plate can move vertically. The technical scheme provided by the invention is suitable for the automatic manufacturing lifting process.

title_en: Quantitative feeding device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quantitative feeding device, which comprises two groups of chain wheel assemblies, chain assemblies and power mechanisms, wherein the two groups of chain wheel assemblies are arranged at intervals in parallel, the chain assemblies surround the two groups of chain wheel assemblies and are in meshed fit with the chain wheel assemblies, and the power mechanisms drive the two groups of chain wheel assemblies to rotate; the chain component is arranged on the bottom plate, the plurality of pushing plates are fixedly connected with the chain component and can move forwards and backwards along the bottom plate along with the synchronous movement of the chain component to pass through the bottom plate in a reciprocating and transverse mode and push the material on the bottom plate to move forwards along the bottom plate. It has the following advantages: realize the ration and carry the feeding, simple structure.

title_en: Navel orange processing is with automatic vanning equipment for packing
abstract_en: The invention discloses automatic boxing and packaging equipment for navel orange processing, which belongs to the technical field of automatic boxing and packaging and comprises a first conveying table and a second conveying table, wherein the end part of the first conveying table is positioned above the second conveying table, a positioning frame erected above the second conveying table is arranged below the end part of the first conveying table, a weighing groove body is arranged in the positioning frame, a material hole is formed in the bottom surface of the weighing groove body, a fixing plate is fixed on the top surface of the weighing groove body, a vertically arranged electric push rod is installed on the top surface of the fixing plate, and a sealing head used for sealing the material hole in the bottom of the weighing groove body is connected to the bottom end of the electric push rod.

title_en: Bag opening and opening device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicine particle packaging, in particular to a bag opening and opening device, wherein a flat packaging bag with one side adsorbed is adsorbed and opened by an opposite vacuum adsorption mechanism, and then extends into the packaging bag by a plectrum opening mechanism above the packaging bag to open two sides of the opening at the top of the packaging bag in the width direction so as to complete the bag opening and shaping actions of the packaging bag, and the flat packaging bag for packaging traditional Chinese medicine particles is opened and then shaped through the mutual matching of the vacuum adsorption mechanism and the plectrum opening mechanism, so that the bag opening and shaping actions of the flat packaging bag at the same station can be completed, and the technical problem that the flat packaging bag cannot be opened and shaped synchronously is solved.

title_en: Gripper of transfer robot, gripping system and gripping method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of mechanical paws, in particular to a paw, a grabbing system and a grabbing method of a transfer robot, wherein the paw comprises an installation part, a grabbing part and a mode conversion part; the mounting part comprises a bottom plate, a first rotating shaft and a second rotating shaft; the first rotating shaft is rotatably connected with the bottom plate, and the rotating center line is collinear with the axis of the first rotating shaft; the second rotating shaft is rotatably connected with the bottom plate, and the rotating center line is collinear with the axis of the second rotating shaft; the grabbing part comprises a first finger module, a second finger module and a third finger module which are arranged in a triangular shape; the first finger module is connected with the first rotating shaft and rotates along with the first rotating shaft; the second finger module is connected with the second rotating shaft and rotates along with the second rotating shaft; the mode conversion part is respectively connected with the first rotating shaft and the second rotating shaft and drives the first rotating shaft and the second rotating shaft to rotate. The invention can be changed into different grabbing modes according to workpieces with different shapes, thereby ensuring the stability and the control precision in the grabbing process.

title_en: Material feeding unit and unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides a feeding device and an unmanned aerial vehicle, and relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles. The feeding device comprises a shell, a driving shaft and a conveying assembly. A feeding channel is arranged in the shell, and the driving shaft is rotatably connected with the shell. The conveying assembly is arranged in the feeding channel. The conveying assembly comprises an output part, a transmission part and a sealing part, wherein the transmission part is connected with the driving shaft, the sealing part is arranged on the radial periphery of the transmission part, at least part of the sealing part is biased towards the driving shaft, and the output part is connected with the transmission part so as to enable the output part to rotate along with the transmission part. The inner side wall of the shell is also provided with a sealing groove, the sealing part is accommodated in the sealing groove, and a gap is formed between the sealing part and the sealing groove. The unmanned aerial vehicle provided by the invention adopts the feeding device. The feeding device and the unmanned aerial vehicle can solve the technical problem that in the prior art, materials enter a bearing or gaps around the bearing to easily cause damage to the bearing.

title_en: Modular robot
abstract_en: A module robot (100) is configured by connecting a plurality of modules (101), wherein the modules (101) have: a first link (1); a second link (2) connected to the first link (1) so as to be movable relative thereto; and a hydraulic cylinder (3) that moves the first link (1) and the second link (2) relative to each other.

title_en: Hand-held type pay-off
abstract_en: The invention relates to a handheld pay-off device, which comprises an upper end cover and a lower end cover which are connected with two ends of a middle sleeve, wherein the lower end cover is synchronously and rotatably connected with a wire spool; two input wires are arranged in the rotating shaft, one end of each input wire penetrates through the side wall of the rotating shaft, extends into the middle sleeve and is electrically connected with the two fixed contact rings, and the other end of each input wire extends out of the rotating shaft; two output lines are arranged in the middle sleeve, one end of each output line is electrically connected with the two rotating coils, and the other end of each output line penetrates through the side wall of the middle sleeve and extends out of the middle sleeve. The wire spool is lower in ground clearance and vertically rotates, the gravity center is low, the backward traction force is small, and the paying-off difficulty is low; the interphone is connected with the wire brush on the wire spool, the interphone does not need to be stopped and disassembled during line detection, and the line detection is convenient.

title_en: Cross joint sealing all-in-one
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cross-shaped carton sealing integrated machine which is provided with a front carton sealing mechanism and a rear carton sealing mechanism which are parallel, wherein a conveyor belt group is arranged between the front carton sealing mechanism and the rear carton sealing mechanism to transport cartons, a steering mechanism is arranged at the conveyor belt group to complete carton packing, and a baffle plate for blocking the cartons and a pushing mechanism for pushing the cartons are arranged at the output end of the conveyor belt group; and an extended side conveying belt and a labeling mechanism for labeling when the carton passes are arranged between the rear box sealing mechanism and the output end of the conveying belt group. The two carton sealing mechanisms are arranged in parallel, so that the arrangement space occupied by the whole mechanism is reduced, the carton is put into and taken out of one side of the two carton sealing mechanisms, and manual operation and management are facilitated; the carton has been accomplished in the transportation turn to and label subsides establish, reduce equipment cost, liberation hand labor power and improvement machining efficiency.

title_en: Disinfection security device and household robot
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of robots, and provides a sterilizing security device and a household robot.A UV sterilizing module is used for carrying out UV sterilization and disinfection treatment on an indoor environment, and a sound monitoring module is used for detecting sound in the indoor environment and generating a sound detection signal; the monitoring control module is connected with the sound monitoring module and used for receiving the sound detection signal and generating a killing pause signal when the sound detection signal is greater than a preset pause sound threshold value; the sterilizing and killing driving module is connected with the ultraviolet sterilizing and killing module and the monitoring control module and used for controlling the ultraviolet sterilizing and killing module to start according to the received sterilizing and killing starting signal so as to adopt ultraviolet sterilization and disinfection treatment to the indoor environment and control the ultraviolet sterilizing and killing module to shut down according to the sterilizing and killing pause signal, thereby avoiding the indoor someone condition starting and sterilizing, causing harm to the health of a user and simultaneously solving the problem of poor sterilizing effect existing in the traditional indoor sterilizing mode.

title_en: System and method for processing objects including automatically moving matrix boxes
abstract_en: Systems and methods for processing objects including automatically moving matrix boxes are provided. A processing system for processing an object using a programmable motion device is disclosed. The processing system comprises: a sensing unit for sensing identification indicia representing an identification of a plurality of objects received from an input conveyor system; an acquisition system for acquiring objects from a plurality of objects at an input area using an end effector of a programmable motion device, wherein the programmable motion device is adapted to assist in the delivery of the objects to an identified processing bin, and the identified processing bin is associated with an identification tag, and the identified processing location is provided as one of the plurality of processing bins; and a delivery system for bringing the identified processing bin to the object, wherein the delivery system comprises a carrier for bringing the identified processing bin to the object.

title_en: Warehouse logistics unloading platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a warehouse logistics unloading platform which comprises a platform body, wherein an inner concave cavity is formed in the front of the platform body, and an unloading assembly is formed in the inner concave cavity; the discharging assembly takes a steel structure bracket as a supporting body, and a sliding seat with a panel is formed on the steel structure bracket; the inner side of the sliding seat is hinged and fixed, while the outer side frame is arranged on the steel structure bracket and can keep a stable inclined angle with the ground through the lifting seat; the sliding seat is provided with an extension plate body, the extension plate body can slide along the sliding seat and is fixed at a specific position, the outer edge of the extension plate body is provided with an outer protection frame, and the outer protection frame can overturn and can extend the plate body and the surface of the panel to reciprocate. The warehouse logistics unloading platform has the advantages of stable structure, good integrity and convenient operation, and can be suitable for most trucks in the market to carry out cargo loading and unloading operations.

title_en: Winch speed reducer synchronous braking system and rotary drilling rig
abstract_en: The invention provides a synchronous braking system of a winch speed reducer, which comprises a winch, a first speed reducer, a second speed reducer, a first hydraulic motor, a second hydraulic motor, a first brake, a second brake, a first main oil way, a second main oil way, a pilot oil way and a balance valve group, wherein the first brake is connected with the first hydraulic motor; the balance valve group comprises a first balance valve group and a second balance valve group, and each balance valve group is provided with a shuttle valve, a pressure reducing valve, a hydraulic valve, an unlocking valve, a first internal oil way and a second internal oil way. The synchronous braking system of the winch speed reducers can realize synchronous control of the speed reducers at two sides during lifting, descending and floating operation of the winch, so that operation errors and influences on the service life of equipment are reduced. The invention further provides a rotary drilling rig.

title_en: Glass plate package body and method for manufacturing glass plate package body
abstract_en: A glass plate package body (1) is provided with: a laminate (3) formed by alternately laminating rectangular glass plates (G) and interleaving paper (P) as a protective sheet in a front-back direction in an inclined posture; and a tray (2) on which the laminated body (3) is mounted in a state in which the laminated body (3) is supported from the rear side, wherein the interleaving paper (P) has a protruding portion (upper protruding portion (Pa)) protruding from the upper side (Ga) of the glass plate (G), folds (Pf) are formed in portions of the protruding portion corresponding to both ends in the width direction of the interleaving paper (P), and the folds (Pf) extend in a direction intersecting with the width direction (direction in which the upper side (Ga) of the glass plate (G) extends).

title_en: Full-automatic film sealing and cutting packaging machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of packaging machines, in particular to a full-automatic film sealing and cutting packaging machine which comprises an operation table, a pneumatic device, a first fixing mechanism, a longitudinal sealing mechanism, a second fixing mechanism, a conveying belt and a heat shrinking machine, wherein the pneumatic device is arranged on the left side of the operation table and comprises a first pneumatic plate and a second pneumatic plate, the pneumatic device is sequentially provided with the first fixing mechanism, the longitudinal sealing mechanism, the second fixing mechanism, the conveying belt and the heat shrinking machine rightwards, a product is placed in the first fixing mechanism, the pneumatic device is started, the second pneumatic plate pushes the product to the longitudinal sealing mechanism forwards and then returns, the second fixing mechanism is triggered in the returning process, the product can be pushed to the conveying belt by the backward returning of the second pneumatic plate while the product is fixed by the second fixing mechanism, the packaging firmness is prevented from being reduced due to shaking when the product is conveyed to the conveying belt, the return of the second hydraulic plate can be utilized to push the product to enter the heat shrinking machine, and the working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Wharf gasoline storage tank
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dock gasoline storage tank, which comprises: a tank body; two floating plate bodies, two floating plate body parallels are located this internal, be equipped with the first sealed bag of annular between two floating plate bodies, first sealed bag intercommunication has the sealed bag of annular second, be equipped with two sets of adjusting part in the sealed bag of second, two sets of adjusting part respectively with two floating plate body one-to-one settings, adjusting part include a plurality of with this body coupling's of floating plate telescopic link, the tip of telescopic link is equipped with the arc bracing piece, the cover is equipped with first spring on the telescopic link, first spring one end with the bracing piece is connected, the other end with the sealed bag of second is connected. According to the invention, the contact area between the second sealing bag and the side wall of the storage tank body is increased by arranging the upper floating disc body, the lower floating disc body, the first sealing bag and the second sealing bag, and meanwhile, the second sealing bag can be abutted against the side wall of the storage tank body by arranging the adjusting assembly, so that the reduction of gasoline leakage is realized.

title_en: Transformer substation hoisting equipment for railway construction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of railway construction, in particular to transformer substation hoisting equipment for railway construction, which comprises a support frame and a hoisting frame arranged on the support frame, wherein the support frame comprises a support base, a support rack erected on the support base and a hoisting frame plate arranged on the support rack; the hoisting frame plate is provided with a hoisting machine element, the top end of the hoisting frame is connected with the hoisting machine element through a hoisting stay cord, the side edge of the hoisting frame is provided with the hoisting stay cord, and the other end of the hoisting stay cord slides along the support rack; the lifting frame comprises a lifting frame plate connected with the lifting pull rope, support brackets respectively arranged on two sides of the lifting frame plate, and a bearing frame plate arranged at the bottom ends of the support brackets; a transmission inner frame is arranged between the support bracket and the bearing frame plate. This application maintains the balance of handling frame, avoids the condition of handling frame slope, guarantees to reduce the dead weight to handling frame itself again when the loading of goods.

title_en: Coordinated operation control system, coordinated operation control device, and coordinated operation control method
abstract_en: The invention provides a coordinated operation control system, a coordinated operation control device and a coordinated operation control method, which improve the work efficiency of movement coordinated operations of a 1 st device and a 2 nd device. When controlling the coordinated operation in the 1 st device and the 2 nd device which perform the coordinated operation in coordination with each other, the operation status of the 1 st operation of the 1 st device is collected, and the 2 nd operation of the 2 nd device is controlled based on the operation status.

title_en: Automatic integrated processing equipment and processing method for western medicines
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of western medicine processing equipment, and particularly relates to western medicine automatic integrated processing equipment and a processing method, wherein the western medicine automatic integrated processing equipment comprises a linkage device, a transmission device and a processing device, the linkage device comprises a side plate and a back plate, the inner walls of the side plate and the back plate are provided with the transmission device, the transmission device is matched with the linkage device for use, one side of the back plate is provided with the processing device, and the processing device also comprises: the invention discloses a shaping assembly and a stamping assembly arranged at the top of a processing device, which have the beneficial effects that: drive the transmission device rotation with fixed angle through motor one, cylinder one promotes fly leaf and top board and removes, makes cast aluminium hot plate, punching press piece and punching press groove heat and the punching press PVC film, and the PVC film is carried to conveyer belt two through roller five and roller one on, and the ampoule on the conveyer belt one meets with the PVC tray on the conveyer belt two, reaches synchronous production packing carton and ampoule packing, has the effect that reduce cost reduced the waste material.

title_en: Flexible processing line of air chamber
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flexible processing line of an air chamber, which relates to the technical field of high-voltage electrical equipment manufacturing and comprises a laser cutting workstation, a material trolley, an air chamber assembling workstation, an air chamber loading platform, a transfer robot guide rail, a carbon dioxide air chamber laser welding workstation, an optical fiber air chamber laser welding workstation, a robot stud welding workstation, a robot polishing workstation, an automatic cleaning workstation, a discharging trolley, a truss system and a safety guardrail device. The invention realizes the consistent production and processing of the air chamber, thereby effectively reducing manual control, improving the processing flexibility of the air chamber and improving the production and manufacturing efficiency and the quality of the air chamber.

title_en: Chassis of rail transit inspection robot and robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a chassis of a rail transit inspection robot, which comprises a chassis shell, a chassis upper cover, a driving mechanism, a power supply mechanism and an obstacle clearing mechanism. The obstacle clearing mechanism comprises a clearing main body, a clamping arm and a detecting head. A containing groove is formed in one side wall of the chassis shell, the fixed end of the clamping arm is hinged to one end in the containing groove, and the movable end of the clamping arm is provided with a clamping jaw assembly. Set up the detecting head through the place ahead at chassis shell, centre gripping arm and clamping jaw subassembly, the detecting head is used for detecting whether the robot has the debris that hinders its operation in motion process place ahead, if detect the existence of debris then send signal to the control unit, the control unit receives behind the signal will control the centre gripping arm and rotate to chassis shell the place ahead, and carry out centre gripping debris through clamping jaw subassembly, then withdraw through the control unit control centre gripping arm, withdraw in-process clamping jaw subassembly and loosen, so that debris fall on the track outside, and then make the chassis can not appear colliding rather than the debris of direction of advance, improve and patrol and examine efficiency.

title_en: Simulation robot for testing intelligent cabin of automobile
abstract_en: The invention relates to a simulation robot for testing an intelligent cabin of an automobile, which comprises: a head structure, a torso structure, and an upper limb structure; the head structure and the upper limb structure are respectively arranged on the body structure; the head structure is provided with an eye structure, a mouth structure and an ear structure; a control device and a voice interaction module are arranged in a robot body consisting of the head structure, the trunk structure and the upper limb structure; the control device is used for communicating with the upper computer, receiving a control instruction sent by the upper computer and controlling the working states of the head structure, the trunk structure, the eye structure, the mouth structure, the voice interaction module and the upper limb structure according to the control instruction. The simulation robot provided by the invention has accurate action, and the action consistency is high in multiple testing processes, so that the testing result of the simulation robot has objectivity and is accurate, and secondly, the simulation robot provided by the invention has the same appearance as a real person and can perform various testing actions, so that the testing function of the simulation robot is rich.

title_en: Move and carry mechanism and have its robotic arm
abstract_en: The invention provides a transfer mechanism and a robot arm with the same, wherein the transfer mechanism comprises: a load-bearing body; a plurality of bearing structure, the interval sets up in bearing the weight of the body, and bearing structure includes two at least support piece, and support piece includes supporting part and elastic component, and the first end of elastic component with bear the weight of body coupling, the second end and the supporting part of elastic component are connected, and the one end that the elastic component was kept away from to the supporting part is for supporting the end. The transfer mechanism solves the problem that the wafer is easy to slip in the transfer process in the prior art.

title_en: Multi-channel discharging device of coffee packaging machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-channel discharging device of a coffee packaging machine, which comprises a discharging bin, a discharging rack, a discharging stirring mechanism, a plurality of groups of discharging units with adjustable material quantities and a discharging driving mechanism, wherein the discharging rack is arranged on the discharging rack; the lower material bin is fixed at the upper end of the blanking rack, a plurality of groups of blanking units with adjustable material quantity are uniformly distributed at the lower end of the blanking rack along the left-right direction, the blanking stirring mechanism is inserted into the blanking bin through a cross shaft and a plurality of stirring blocks fixed on the cross shaft, a plurality of discharging through holes arranged along the left-right direction on a discharging bottom plate at the bottom of the lower material bin are aligned with a plurality of blanking through holes arranged along the left-right direction of the blanking rack one by one and are aligned with the plurality of groups of blanking units with adjustable material quantity one by one, and a blanking hopper is respectively arranged below each group of blanking units with adjustable material quantity; the blanking driving mechanism is used for synchronously driving a plurality of groups of blanking units with adjustable material quantity. The multi-channel blanking device realizes multi-channel parallel blanking, meets the production requirement of a multi-channel packaging machine, and improves the generation efficiency of the packaging machine by multiple times.

title_en: Self-cleaning medicament bag-dividing independent packaging equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medicament packaging, in particular to self-cleaning medicament bag-dividing independent packaging equipment which comprises an equipment base, wherein a medicament material cylinder and a medicament material inlet are distributed on the equipment base, the medicament material inlet is communicated with the medicament material cylinder, a packaging component is distributed on one side of the medicament material cylinder, the packaging component divides and packages medicaments in the medicament material cylinder, a cleaning mechanism is distributed in the medicament material cylinder, the cleaning mechanism cleans residues in the medicament material cylinder, the cleaning operation of the medicament material cylinder can be timely and automatically completed, manual cleaning is not needed, different medicament residues input during previous packaging are prevented from being retained in the medicament material cylinder, the medicament is polluted when the medicament is packaged, the medication risk is brought to a patient, the working efficiency of a pharmacy is improved, and the medicament packaging error occurrence rate is reduced, the medicine taking experience of patients is improved.

title_en: Automatic material supplementing robot suitable for factory
abstract_en: The invention provides a material automatic replenishing robot suitable for a factory, which comprises a movable base, wherein a movable turntable is fixedly arranged on the upper side of the movable base, a main arm is arranged on the upper side of the movable turntable, a first movable arm is movably arranged at the upper end of the main arm, a second movable arm is movably arranged at one end, far away from the main arm, of the first movable arm, and a third movable arm is movably arranged at one end, far away from the first movable arm, of the second movable arm. This automatic supplementary robot of material suitable for mill, utilize the defogging pump to produce kinetic energy and begin the work operation, absorb the gas in storing the gasbag simultaneously, utilize the defogging connecting pipe with its transmission to the defogging head in, the rethread removes the high-speed blowout of air current after the defogging head will heat, the air current can be blown automatically and wipe away the water smoke on the protective glass inboard this moment, thereby reached and clear away the purpose to the water smoke on the protective glass inboard, the effectual sight and the definition of having guaranteed the monitoring head, the device's monitoring effect has further been promoted.

title_en: Sample culture constant temperature transfer box
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a biological instrument technical field specifically discloses a sample culture constant temperature transfer box, including box, save case and damping device and buffer, box upper portion is connected with the case lid, has placed the save case in the box, and save incasement portion is separated by the baffle, and the inside bottom of saving the case is provided with buffer, and buffer is including the buffer, and buffer layer board is placed inside the save case, and the below of saving the case is provided with damping device, and damping device sets up the below at the save case. The purpose of this patent is to solve and use the incubator to produce strong vibration and can not weaken the problem.

title_en: Rope guide wheel of grab bucket
abstract_en: The invention discloses a grab bucket rope guide wheel, which belongs to the technical field of grab bucket rope guide wheels and comprises three groups of rope guide wheel sets arranged on a base, wherein each rope guide wheel set comprises two groups of rope guide wheels which are rotationally connected with the base through a rotating shaft, the upper and lower rope guide wheel sets are arranged in a groined shape, groined-shaped holes formed by arrangement are rope guide holes through which steel wire ropes pass, reinforcing parts are arranged at two ends of the rotating shaft corresponding to the rope guide wheel sets, plate frames are symmetrically arranged at two sides of the base, a support plate is arranged between the two groups of plate frames, two sides of the support plate are fixedly connected with the reinforcing parts through connecting parts, and an over-bending prevention structure is arranged at the top side of the support plate.

title_en: Medical injection medicine bottle opening auxiliary device
abstract_en: The application relates to a bottle opening auxiliary device, in particular to a medical injection medicine bottle opening auxiliary device. The application aims to provide a medical injection medicine bottle opening auxiliary device which can cut ampoule bottles in a time-saving and labor-saving manner without manual bottle opening. The utility model provides a medical treatment injection medicine bottle opening assistor, including connecting frame, motor, cutting knife, drive opening mechanism and stop gear, top right rear side is equipped with the motor in the connecting frame, and the motor left side is equipped with the button, and the button passes through electric connection with the motor, is equipped with the cutting knife that cuts ampoule bottle head on the motor output shaft, and the connecting frame is inside to be equipped with and is used for starting the drive opening mechanism of motor, is equipped with stop gear between the inside left side of connecting frame and the drive opening mechanism part. According to the ampoule bottle cutting device, the cutting knife is driven to rotate through rotation of the output shaft of the motor, medical staff approaches the ampoule bottle to the cutting knife, so that the ampoule bottle head is cut by the cutting knife, the ampoule bottle is not required to be cut by a hand-held cutter, and time and labor are saved.

title_en: State adjusting device, arranging system and arranging method for packaging containers
abstract_en: The invention discloses a state adjusting device, a sorting system and a sorting method of packaging containers, which relate to the technical field of packaging equipment and comprise a base, a rotating disc and a driving mechanism, wherein the rotating disc is rotatably arranged on the base and forms a fixed inclination angle with a horizontal plane, and at least one sucker mechanism is arranged on the rotating disc; when the rotating disc is driven by the driving mechanism to rotate from the feeding station to the discharging station of the rotating disc, the suction plane of the sucking disc mechanism is gradually transited from a horizontal state to a vertical state; and at the feeding station, the sucking disc mechanism sucks the packing container in a horizontal state under negative pressure, and at the discharging station, the sucking disc mechanism loosens the sucked packing container. The state adjusting device, the arranging system and the arranging method of the packaging container provided by the invention can be suitable for state adjustment of the packaging container, and are high in structure and adjusting process efficiency, reliable in operation, small in damage to the packaging container, capable of reducing labor intensity in the arranging process of the packaging container and improving production efficiency.

title_en: Robot system provided with coating robot
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a robot system including a painting robot. The robot system according to the present invention includes: a paint supply source (10); a feeder (20); a robot (30) for painting; a flow path (40) configured to be connected to the coating robot (30) from the coating material supply source (10) via the feeder (20), and a part of which is located in the non-explosion-proof area (103); and a non-contact type flowmeter (50) configured to be disposed in the flow path (40) and to detect a flow rate of the paint flowing through the flow path (40), wherein the painting robot (30) and the feeder (20) are disposed in the explosion-proof area (102), and wherein the paint supply source (10) and the non-contact type flowmeter (50) are disposed in the non-explosion-proof area (103).

title_en: Monitoring device and method for scenic spot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a monitoring device and a monitoring method for scenic spots, which comprise a box chamber, wherein an open inlet is arranged on the box chamber, a trapping device for inducing external mosquitoes to enter the box chamber from the inlet, a data acquisition device for acquiring the conditions of the mosquitoes trapped by the trapping device, and a power supply device for providing power for the operation of each mechanism are arranged in the box chamber. The device provided by the invention can effectively monitor the mosquito condition in the field of the scenic spot.

title_en: Full-automatic naked pearl screening machine
