abstract_en: The invention discloses a full-automatic naked bead screening machine, which comprises a fixed frame, a first support column and a second support column, wherein a support seat is fixedly arranged on the right side of the bottom surface inside the fixed frame; in the invention, the first motor is started to enable the rotary rod to vertically shake in the clamping groove, so that the sieve plate plays a screening role, meanwhile, the transmission structure is more stable, the service life is longer, the first spring is driven by the telescopic rod to contract when the sieve plate is clamped, the second spring is compressed when the sieve plate is sucked, and the damage to the material plate can be reduced when the sieve plate is clamped and sucked.

title_en: Substrate glass packaging system and packaging method
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a substrate glass packaging system and a packaging method, wherein the substrate glass packaging system comprises a sliding assembly, a first robot and an unloading push stop, a first clamping jaw is slidably arranged on the sliding rail assembly, the first clamping jaw is used for clamping substrate glass and can move along the sliding rail assembly, the first robot is arranged on one side of the sliding rail assembly, a first suction cup assembly is arranged on a moving part of the first robot, the first suction cup assembly is used for moving towards the substrate glass under the driving of the first robot so as to adsorb the substrate glass, the unloading push stop is arranged on the other side of the sliding rail assembly, the unloading push stop is used for driving the first suction cup assembly to adsorb the substrate glass moving between the first suction cup assembly and the unloading push stop when the first robot drives the first suction cup assembly, providing support for the substrate glass. The present disclosure can prevent the substrate glass from being damaged in the process of transferring to the spacer paper.

title_en: Material winding and unwinding device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of material roll reeling and unreeling, and discloses a material roll reeling and unreeling device which comprises a first plate and a second plate, wherein the first plate is provided with a first driving piece, a second driving piece and a rotating shaft, the rotating shaft can rotate around the axis of the rotating shaft, the second plate is fixedly connected with the rotating shaft and is arranged at intervals with the first plate, the second plate is provided with a material collecting reel and a material unreeling reel which are symmetrically arranged at two sides of the axis of the rotating shaft, the periphery of the rotating shaft is sleeved with a first synchronizing wheel and a second synchronizing wheel which can rotate relative to the rotating shaft, the first driving piece and the material collecting reel are respectively in transmission connection with the first synchronizing wheel through a first transmission belt and a second transmission belt, the second driving piece and the material unreeling reel are respectively in transmission connection with the second synchronizing wheel through a third transmission belt and a fourth transmission belt, any two of the first transmission belt, the second transmission belt, the third transmission belt and the fourth transmission belt have intervals along the extending direction of the rotating shaft, thereby avoiding the need for the shaft to be replaced periodically to reduce manufacturing costs.

title_en: Heavy load balance driving device for vertical shaft
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heavy load balance driving device for a vertical shaft, which comprises a fixed upright post and a movable upright post, wherein the middle parts of the fixed upright post and the movable upright post are respectively provided with an inner cavity; a driving device capable of driving the movable upright post to move along the inner cavity of the fixed upright post is fixedly arranged between the inner cavity of the fixed upright post and the inner cavity of the movable upright post; a buffer mechanism which can provide motion resistance for offsetting the gravity of the movable upright post is fixedly arranged between the inner cavity of the fixed upright post and the inner cavity of the movable upright post. The heavy load balance driving device for the vertical shaft disclosed by the invention solves the problems that the main driving of the existing heavy load vertical shaft driving device is difficult to select types and bears heavy load, and the service life of the main driving is shortened.

title_en: Gold stamping device for gold-saving paper and using method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gold stamping device capable of saving gold paper and a using method thereof, belonging to the field of printing machinery, the scheme can realize that the (longitudinal) phase of the next hot stamping and the previous hot stamping can be adjusted when the same gold stamping paper tape is repeatedly hot stamped by adjusting a movable vertical roller adjusting part consisting of one or more movable adjusting parts with locking devices, the movable vertical roller adjusting part is provided with a locking positioning device to ensure that the (longitudinal) phase is stable and unchanged after the hot stamping position is adjusted so as to meet the requirement of position staggering of hot stamping patterns during two hot stamping, and the transverse displacement of the same gold stamping paper tape can be adjusted to change the transverse relative position of the next gold stamping and the previous gold stamping at a paper guide roller part by adjusting a movable oblique roller adjusting part consisting of one or more movable adjusting parts with locking devices so as to ensure that the gold stamping paper is recycled at the set hot stamping position, the requirement of multi-channel continuous gold stamping is met, and the purpose of saving gold stamping paper materials is achieved.

title_en: Carrier tool
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of conveying equipment, and discloses a carrier. The carrier includes the support table that is used for bearing the work piece, can the centre gripping to put the fixture of work piece on the support table, unblock portion, flip mechanism, gas circuit passageway and communicate in the adsorption mechanism of gas circuit passageway, unblock portion can cooperate with outside unlocking device to make fixture can be in the second operating condition that releases the work piece, gas circuit passageway and adsorption mechanism all set up on the support table, outside gas circuit can dock with the gas circuit passageway, so that adsorption mechanism can hold the work piece of putting on the support table, flip mechanism can remove respectively to cover the first position of the top of the work piece that is located on the support table and expose the second position of the work piece that is located on the support table. According to the invention, the articles loaded in the workpiece can be prevented from falling in the moving process of the carrier, and the workpiece can be still fixed on the carrier after the clamping mechanism releases the workpiece, so that the workpiece is prevented from moving in the processing operation, and the production efficiency, the processing precision and the yield are ensured.

title_en: Industrial robot-oriented residual vibration suppression system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a residual vibration suppression system and a residual vibration suppression method for an industrial robot, wherein the residual vibration suppression system and the residual vibration suppression method for the industrial robot comprise an embedded industrial personal computer with a real-time control function, an acceleration sensor, an acceleration signal transmission device, the industrial robot and a servo controller thereof, wherein the acceleration sensor is arranged at the tail end of the industrial robot through an acceleration sensor fixing element, an acquired acceleration signal is connected into a servo driver of the industrial robot through the acceleration signal transmission device, and the servo driver is connected with the embedded industrial personal computer through a gigabit industrial Ethernet interface. The residual vibration suppression system provided by the invention is simpler, the cost is lower, the industrial robot control platform has a real-time function, and the provided residual vibration suppression method can further improve the smoothness of track operation, reduce the impact on a motor in the operation process and ensure the contour accuracy of interpolation tracks while realizing the maximum suppression of residual vibration.

title_en: Pork sausage sealing and packaging device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pork sausage sealing and packaging device, and relates to the technical field of food packaging equipment. The first support frame is rotationally connected with a first swivel, the third support frame is rotationally connected with a fourth swivel, the first swivel and the fourth swivel are fixedly connected with each other through a second connecting rod and a second swivel, the third support frame is fixedly connected with a fixed disc through a third connecting rod, the first swivel and the fourth swivel are fixedly connected with the third swivel and the connecting disc through the first connecting rod and the third swivel respectively, the charging mechanism is uniformly arranged in the circumferential direction of the second swivel, the heating rod is arranged on the inner circumferential side wall of the semicircular shell, the feeding mechanism is arranged on the second support frame on the base, and the sealing packaging mechanism is arranged on the base. According to the invention, the pork sausage is conveyed to the charging mechanism through the feeding mechanism and dried, the vacuumizing machine evacuates the air of the packaging bag, and the packaging bag filled with the pork sausage is sealed by the heating plates at the two sides, so that the pork sausage packaging machine has the advantages of good sealing effect and high packaging efficiency.

title_en: Automatic feeding method for plastic sleeves of seat trays
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic feeding method of a seat tray plastic sleeve, which comprises a second vibration disc and a second vibration feeding track, wherein the second vibration disc is provided with a second feeding track and a third feeding track which are communicated with each other, and the third feeding track is communicated with the second vibration feeding track; the second feeding track spirally rises along the side wall of the first vibration disc; wherein, in the process that the plastic sleeve moves along the second feeding track: the plastic sleeve is gradually clung to the outer side wall of the second feeding track; the plastic sleeve of the first bottom wall inwards or outwards falls off from the second feeding track; during the movement of the plastic sleeve along the third feeding track: when the vertically placed plastic sleeve with the first bottom wall facing upwards passes through the first falling position, the plastic sleeve falls from the first falling position; when the flat plastic sleeve passes through the second falling position, the flat plastic sleeve falls from the second falling position; according to the technical scheme, the plastic sleeve in a single specific state can be automatically sent out each time.

title_en: Mechanical positioning structure and manipulator assembly
abstract_en: The mechanical positioning structure comprises a first positioning mechanism, a fixed column penetrating through a central shaft of the first positioning mechanism, a first driving mechanism arranged between the fixed column and the first positioning mechanism, at least one second positioning mechanism arranged on a second positioning mechanism, a second driving mechanism and a platform arranged on the second driving mechanism; each second positioning mechanism is rotatably arranged on the fixed column and connected with the first driving mechanism, and the second positioning mechanism is of an arc-shaped structure; the first driving mechanism is used for driving the second positioning mechanism to move on the surface of the first positioning mechanism. The second driving mechanism is used for driving the platform to move on the second positioning mechanism. The application adopts the spherical positioning structure to meet the work of workpieces in all directions in space, reduce the space limitation degree and improve the space utilization rate.

title_en: Bottle cap for separating and storing contents and retortable sterilization bottle
abstract_en: The invention provides a bottle cap for separating and storing contents and a retortable sterilization bottle, which comprises a cylindrical inner wall, a cap body of a sealing part, an upper cap and a storage part, wherein the storage part comprises an inner insert and a piercing member; the upper cover is connected to the cover body through a first thread, one end of the puncture piece is connected to the upper cover through a second thread, and the other end of the puncture piece is connected with the cover body in a unidirectional rotation mode. According to the invention, the content to be mixed is stored in the storage part in a sealing way, the sealing of the mixed content is independent of the cover body matched with the opening part of the container, and independent storage and transportation can be realized; so that it can be applied to the case where the contents in the container need to be steamed at high temperature, but the contents to be mixed cannot be steamed at high temperature; the upper cover body is rotated to mix the content into the content in the container; the operation is simple, and the completely sealed storage of two contents can be realized.

title_en: Be used for plateau yak milk to preserve fresh and use storage device
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of storage devices, and provides a storage device for fresh-keeping of plateau yak milk, which comprises a storage tank and also comprises: the device comprises an end cover, a rotating shaft, a stirring rod, a feeding pipe, a check valve, a discharge port, a discharge check valve, a turbulence assembly and a driving assembly; the end cover is fixedly arranged on the storage tank, and the rotating shaft is rotatably connected in the storage tank. The puddler stirs milk through rotating, and then prevent that the phenomenon of caking from appearing in the milk, a plurality of puddlers are from last to lengthening in proper order down, and then produce ascending thrust, push away the milk of bottom upper portion, improve the mobility of milk in the holding vessel, prevent that the phenomenon of milk sedimentation from appearing stewing from taking place, further prevent the milk caking, and then keep fresh to milk, improve the dwell time of milk, the vortex subassembly carries out the antiport through drive assembly, the vortex subassembly carries out the streaming to milk, and the vortex subassembly is used for scraping the inner wall of holding vessel and end cover.

title_en: Robot rack with driving structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a robot rack with a driving structure, which comprises a rack body and driving mechanisms, wherein the driving mechanisms are arranged on two sides of the rack body; the frame body includes the crossbeam frame, locate the curb plate of crossbeam frame both sides, and install in the power of crossbeam frame, the power is connected with actuating mechanism electricity, actuating mechanism is including connecting respectively in the first drive arrangement and the second drive arrangement of curb plate both sides, the curb plate includes the connecting plate, connect respectively in the first link and the second link of connecting plate both sides, first drive arrangement is equipped with first base, first base fixed connection is in first link, second drive arrangement is equipped with the second base, second base fixed connection is in the second link. The side plate is provided with the connecting plate and the two connecting frames to be matched with the driving device for connection, the whole structure is stable and reliable, the assembly is convenient, and the side plate is particularly used for connecting the driving device with the robot walking frame and has good stability.

title_en: High-toughness film capable of being degraded in water environment and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of degradable films, and particularly relates to a high-toughness film capable of being degraded in a water environment, and a preparation method and application thereof. Firstly, the invention discloses a high-toughness film which can be degraded in a water environment, and the high-toughness film comprises the following components in percentage by mass: PLA is between 40 and 55 percent; PVA is between 20% and 40%; PEG is more than or equal to 5 percent and less than or equal to 15 percent; the content of the artificial granite waste residue is more than 0 percent and less than or equal to 30 percent. Secondly, the invention discloses a preparation method of the high-toughness film which can be degraded in water environment, which comprises the following steps: (1) taking PLA, PVA, PEG and artificial granite waste residue according to a proportion, adding dimethyl sulfoxide as a solvent, heating and uniformly stirring; (2) standing the solution for defoaming; (3) and pouring the solution on a glass plate, scraping the solution by using a film scraper, and drying to obtain a film material. The invention uses the artificial granite waste residue as the inorganic filler, improves the tensile strength of the film, improves the water degradation performance of the film, and effectively recycles the solid waste.

title_en: Belt conveyor rewinding and belt breakage detection device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for detecting the rewinding and the breakage of a belt conveyor. The method comprises the following steps: the magneto-electric detection system detects a conveying belt, the image acquisition unit acquires driving wheel image information and tail wheel image information, the monitoring host receives an electromagnetic detection signal, calculates the rotating speed of the driving wheel and the rotating speed of the tail wheel through the driving wheel image information and the tail wheel image information and compares the rotating speed of the driving wheel and the rotating speed of the tail wheel with a set threshold value, the monitoring host judges whether rewinding and belt breaking occur or not, and sends a rewinding and belt breaking signal outwards. The detection equipment and the detection method adopt a nondestructive detection method, have no abrasion and long service life and are suitable for long-term work; the detection equipment has simple structure, the response speed of the detection equipment and the detection method is high, the detection result is accurate and reliable, and the detection precision can not be reduced after long-term use.

title_en: Main beam of crane and crane
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of cranes, in particular relates to a girder and provides a girder of a crane and the crane. The main beam of the crane comprises an upper chord beam, a lower chord beam and inclined strut units, wherein each inclined strut unit is in a herringbone shape and consists of a long inclined strut member and a short inclined strut member, the bottom ends of the long inclined strut member and the short inclined strut member are connected with the lower chord beam, the top ends of the long inclined strut member and the short inclined strut member are connected with the middle part of the long inclined strut member in the length direction, or the top ends of the long inclined strut member and the short inclined strut member are connected with the upper chord beam, the bottom ends of the short inclined strut member are connected with the middle part of the long inclined strut member in the length direction, each two adjacent inclined strut units form an inclined strut unit group, each inclined strut unit group is distributed along the extending direction of the main beam of the crane, and the long inclined strut members in the same inclined strut unit group are adjacently distributed along the extending direction of the main beam of the crane, or the short inclined strut members in the same inclined strut unit group are adjacently distributed along the extending direction of the main beam of the crane, so that the technical problem that the X-shaped inclined strut units or V-shaped inclined strut units of the main beam in the prior art are inconvenient to process.

title_en: Full-automatic sampling pipe spiral cover pipetting workstation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a full-automatic sampling tube cap screwing pipetting workstation which comprises a machine body, an objective table arranged in the machine body, a cross beam mechanism arranged on the objective table and an operation main body arranged on the cross beam mechanism, wherein a control module used for controlling the objective table and the operation main body to work is arranged outside the machine body, a pipetting device in the operation main body can clamp a plurality of pipetting tips, the cap of the tube orifices of the sampling tubes can be automatically opened by the cap screwing device, the pipetting device drives the pipetting tips to be correspondingly placed in the sampling tubes to aspirate a liquid with a certain volume and then to be moved out of the sampling tubes, and the pipetting device correspondingly places the pipetting tips for aspirating the liquid above a nucleic acid extraction reagent plate and places the liquid to be measured into the nucleic acid extraction reagent plate. According to the full-automatic sampling tube cap screwing and pipetting device, the cap screwing device and the pipetting device in the operating main body of the full-automatic sampling tube cap screwing and pipetting device work in a mutually matched mode and sample liquid in a plurality of sampling tubes is sampled at the same time, so that automatic operation is achieved, the working efficiency is improved, and the manual operation intensity is reduced.

title_en: Four-crawler assembly type concrete road panel hoisting equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses four-crawler assembly type concrete pavement panel hoisting equipment which comprises a hoisting main beam, wherein four corners of the bottom end of the hoisting main beam are fixedly connected with vertical adjusting mechanisms, the bottom ends of two vertical adjusting mechanisms positioned on the same side are fixedly connected with supporting beams, the two supporting beams are arranged in parallel, moving mechanisms are arranged on two sides of the bottom end of each supporting beam, the four moving mechanisms are positioned on the same plane, the bottom end of the hoisting main beam is provided with a sliding groove, a transverse moving hanging beam is connected in the sliding groove in a sliding mode, one side inside the sliding groove is fixedly connected with a first hydraulic cylinder, the output end of the first hydraulic cylinder is fixedly connected with the transverse moving hanging beam, the bottom end of the transverse moving hanging beam is provided with a rotating mechanism, the bottom end of the rotating mechanism is provided with a hoisting machine, the hoisting machine is provided with a balance hoisting mechanism, and the balance hoisting mechanism is arranged corresponding to a concrete pavement panel. The invention is convenient and fast to adjust, transfer and construct, realizes the stable hoisting and the aerial angle adjustment of the concrete pavement slab, reduces the labor amount of constructors and improves the construction efficiency.

title_en: Variable-rigidity flexible clamping jaw based on magnetorheological fluid
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of clamping jaws, in particular to a variable-rigidity flexible clamping jaw based on magnetorheological fluid. Comprises a gripping mechanism, a tank body, a rotating mechanism and an adsorption mechanism which are sequentially arranged from top to bottom; a first baffle plate and a second baffle plate are horizontally arranged in the tank body, a sealing cavity is formed between the first baffle plate and the second baffle plate, a spacer is arranged in the sealing cavity to divide the sealing cavity into an upper gas cavity and a lower liquid cavity, and the rotating mechanism comprises more than three internal gears, a linear screw motor and a servo motor; more than three internal gears are coaxially arranged below the tank body through a partition bracket, and driven bearing gears axially move under the drive of a linear screw motor and are respectively meshed with a driving gear for transmission; the adsorption mechanism comprises a ring magnet, and the gripping mechanism comprises more than three soft clamping jaws; therefore, the invention can rapidly adjust the surface gripping force of the soft clamping jaw due to the rapid response capability of the magnetorheological fluid, and has strong safety, high working efficiency and good universality.

title_en: HPV detection kit and detection method facilitating storage of HPV sample
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of HPV sample storage and detection, and discloses an HPV detection kit and a detection method convenient for HPV sample storage; the HPV detection kit comprises an external protection box body which is convenient to carry, a storage device which is arranged inside the external protection box body, and an integrated sampling assembly which is arranged inside the storage device and used for collecting and storing samples; the external protection box body comprises an end cover A, an end cover B, a first circular tube side wall and a second circular tube side wall which are circular; the side wall of the first circular pipe and the side wall of the second circular pipe are buckled to form a closed cylindrical cavity; the storage device comprises a plurality of independent disc storage devices; s1, taking out the integrated sampling assembly; s2, taking out the sampler; s3, sampling and packaging; the invention can optimize the sampling operation method of HPV detection, improve the detection operability and effectively avoid cross infection of the detected sample.

title_en: Multi-degree-of-freedom single-damping resilience quick-release joint and exoskeleton
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-degree-of-freedom single-damping quick-release joint which comprises a cross shaft universal joint and a quick-release part, wherein the cross shaft universal joint is in quick-release connection with the quick-release part through at least one movable locking part, and a first damping rebounding mechanism which is coaxially and rotatably arranged with the quick-release part is arranged in the cross shaft universal joint. According to the invention, the quick-release part is arranged in the universal joint cross, and the quick-release part and the universal joint cross are quickly detached and connected in a quick-release manner, so that quick disassembly can be carried out on the basis of realizing multiple degrees of freedom, and thus modularization of each part of the exoskeleton can be realized, maintenance or iterative replacement of some parts in the exoskeleton is further facilitated, and the universal joint cross is also convenient for a user to put on and take off, so that user experience is improved, and the damping rebounding mechanism is arranged, so that certain buffering is provided, and the phenomenon that the joint is locked or damaged due to over-large impact or over-violent movement of the user or other situations that the joint cannot work normally is avoided.

title_en: Film covering device for lead-acid storage battery box
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of storage batteries, in particular to a film coating device for a lead-acid storage battery box, which comprises a supporting machine table and a supporting frame erected on the supporting machine table; the battery box loading device comprises a support frame, a support platform, a battery box and a battery box, wherein the support frame is provided with a support base; be provided with the rectangle driving medium on the support frame, the rectangle driving medium is provided with the rectangle track to and along the tectorial membrane frame of rectangle orbital motion, adsorb the base and set up in the regional bottom of axis of rectangle track, it presss from both sides to install the tectorial membrane that is used for pulling the membrane material on the tectorial membrane frame, and be used for dialling of pressfitting membrane material. The invention can effectively avoid the problem that the surface of the film material and the battery box has gaps or wrinkles, and is convenient for subsequent plastic packaging treatment.

title_en: Integrated airtight oiling machine applied to airtight detection of automobile front frame
abstract_en: The invention discloses an integrated airtight oiling machine applied to air tightness detection of an automobile front frame, which comprises a frame component, a first lifting component, a side positioning component, a pressing component, an airtight detection component, a transmission component and a side supporting component, wherein the first lifting component and the transmission component are respectively arranged in the middle area of the frame component, two groups of side positioning components are respectively arranged at two sides of the first lifting component, two groups of pressing components are arranged at the outer sides of the side positioning component, one side of the side positioning component is also provided with the airtight detection component, and two groups of side supporting components are correspondingly arranged at two sides of the transmission component. The invention integrates the original procedures of a plurality of scattered stations into one device, precisely realizes the procedures of workpiece positioning and clamping, oiling detection, workpiece carrying and the like through the matching of a plurality of components in the device, achieves the standardized procedure through automatic control, saves labor cost and improves the consistency of product processing.

title_en: Robot-powered grinding and polishing device for complex curved surface and control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a robot-controlled grinding and polishing device for complex curved surfaces and a control method thereof, wherein the robot-controlled grinding and polishing device comprises a six-axis robot arm body, a controller module, a vision module, a voice coil motor active floating mechanism, a six-dimensional force sensor and a tail end grinding and polishing tool module; the vision module is fixed to the tail end of the mechanical arm through a connecting plate and used for acquiring preliminary track information and positioning; the active floating mechanism is fixed under the vision module connecting plate through a base; the force sensor is fixed under the floating mechanism rotor connecting piece; the polishing operation module is fixed below the force sensor connecting flange. The device adopts a modularized split design, and is easy to maintain by configuring parts of different types according to different processing requirements without changing the whole structure; the control system controls the position, the gesture and the active floating mechanism of the mechanical arm by using corresponding local planners respectively, and corrects the global planning track accordingly, so that the dynamic response performance of the control system is effectively improved, and the operation quality is improved.

title_en: Method for hoisting in four-beam bridge crane factory building
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for hoisting a four-beam bridge crane in a factory building, which relates to a building hoisting technology and comprises the following steps: 1. hoisting a main beam A; 2. hoisting the auxiliary beam and the end beam; 3. hoisting an auxiliary trolley; 4. the main trolley supporting device is installed; 5. hoisting a main trolley; 6. hoisting the main beam B; the temporary travelling wheel at one end of the auxiliary beam is slightly lower than the normal mounting elevation, so that the jack is matched with the main beam B to be connected with the combined body of the end beam and the auxiliary beam; the elevation of the main trolley supporting device is slightly lower than the normal installation elevation, so that the main trolley supporting device can be conveniently removed after the main beam B is installed. The invention fully utilizes the characteristics of the four-beam bridge crane, solves the lifting problem of the main trolley and the end beam and auxiliary beam combination which are easy to clamp, has no aerial connection point, is safe and reliable in construction, can realize the lifting work of the crane in a small space, has relatively smaller lifting capacity requirement on the crane, and saves cost.

title_en: Garbage can packing method and garbage can
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent household equipment, and particularly relates to a garbage can packing method and a garbage can. The garbage can packing method provided by the invention comprises the following steps: detecting the height of the garbage in a garbage bag in the garbage can from a first opening at the top of the garbage can through a height detection device; comparing the detected height of the garbage with a first preset value, a second preset value and a third preset value; reminding a user to seal and pack the garbage bag according to the fact that the detected height of the garbage reaches a first preset value and does not reach a second preset value; automatically sealing and packaging the garbage bag according to the fact that the detected height of the garbage reaches a second preset value and does not reach a third preset value; automatically sealing and packaging the garbage bag according to the detected height of the garbage reaching a third preset value; according to the fact that the height of the garbage reaches a third preset value, the garbage bag cannot be sealed and packaged, and a user is reminded of adjusting the height of the garbage in the garbage bag; until the sealing and packaging of the garbage bag are completed.

title_en: Automatic wire cutting and coiling equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses automatic wire cutting and coiling equipment, which comprises a rack, a controller, a conveying device, a feeding disc, a feeding device, a wire coiling device and a wire cutting device, wherein the controller is connected with the feeding disc through a connecting device; the feeding tray can be movably arranged on the conveying device back and forth along the conveying device; the feeding device is arranged beside the rack and connected with the controller; the wire coiling device is arranged on the rack and positioned beside the conveying device; the wire cutting device can be movably arranged on the rack back and forth and is positioned beside the wire coiling device. Through being provided with conveyor, feed table, loading attachment, line coiling device and wire cutting device, make can realize automatic feeding through automatic mode, and through wire cutting device and the cooperation of line coiling device earlier with the wire rod dish on the line coiling device, move the wire rod of coiling good to the feed table in again, thereby make things convenient for the processing of follow-up technology to use, degree of automation is higher, greatly promoted the machining efficiency of current line coiling mode, make it can satisfy mass production's demand.

title_en: Lane-off monitoring system and method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of conveyors, and provides a lane-falling monitoring system which comprises a track rack assembly for supporting, a lane-falling sensing module and a signal processing module for collecting and processing signals of the lane-falling sensing module. The capability of monitoring the derailment of the wheel-rail belt conveyor is improved.

title_en: Device for packaging and dispensing cosmetic products
abstract_en: The present application relates to a packaging and dispensing assembly comprising a substantially tubular body obtained from a multilayer composite material, at least one inner layer of which is made of a hydrophilic material, the tubular body having at least one longitudinal end closed by a flat joint between two opposite portions of the tubular body and the multilayer material having a free edge at the longitudinal end directly exposing the layer of hydrophilic material, the assembly being characterized in that the free edge of the flat joint is covered with a strip of impermeable material extending on both sides of the flat joint, the strip of impermeable material being fixed to the tubular body in an at least watertight manner along the flat joint.

title_en: Multi-station rapid gilding press
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-station rapid gilding press, which belongs to the technical field of gilding presses and comprises a bottom assembly positioned at the lower side, wherein the bottom assembly is connected with a conveying assembly, a top assembly is arranged above the bottom assembly, a foil paper conveying and arranging assembly is arranged on the side surface of the top assembly, a scalding head is arranged below the top assembly, the bottom assembly comprises two vertical supporting plates, a rotary sleeve shaft, a friction wheel and a wheel disc, the rotary sleeve shaft is connected with a sleeve shaft pushing cylinder and a sleeve shaft motor through a plurality of connecting pieces, the friction wheel is connected with a wheel driving motor and a wheel pushing cylinder, the wheel disc is connected with a disc driving member, five bearing shafts which are distributed in an annular array and are rotationally connected with the wheel disc are arranged inside the wheel disc, a feeding station, a preset station, a gilding station, a tooth breaking station and a blanking station are formed in the wheel disc, five positioning blocks distributed in an annular array are arranged on the back surface of the wheel disc, and the multi-station rapid gilding press can realize continuous rapid processing.

title_en: Novel fresh-keeping cutlery box
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel fresh-keeping lunch box which comprises a box body and a box cover, wherein the box body and the box cover are buckled, an inner container is arranged in the box body, the box cover comprises a box cover main body, a box cover, an injection molding piece and ice crystals, the box cover main body and the box cover are connected through the injection molding piece in an injection molding mode, the box cover main body is provided with a first protruding portion protruding upwards, the box cover is provided with a second protruding portion protruding downwards, a cavity is defined between the first protruding portion and the second protruding portion, and the ice crystals are arranged in the cavity. The novel fresh-keeping lunch box provided by the invention has the advantages that the box cover can be put into the refrigerator in advance, ice crystals in the box can rapidly accumulate cold, and dishes are put into the inner container and then covered on the inner container, so that the refrigerating capacity can be gradually released, the dishes are prevented from being stuffy in the lunch box, and the novel fresh-keeping lunch box has good fresh-keeping performance.

title_en: Loading attachment for construction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a feeding device for building construction, which belongs to the technical field of building auxiliary devices and comprises a support frame, a pushing frame and support legs, wherein the outer surface of the lower end of the support frame is fixedly connected with the support legs, the outer surface of one side of the support frame is fixedly connected with the pushing frame, two groups of air pumps are arranged on the outer surface of the upper end of the support frame, and the output ends of the air pumps are fixedly connected with pushing plates; according to the invention, through arranging the adsorption component, after glass is placed on the surface of the supporting plate, the first two groups of electric telescopic rods are respectively driven to push the connecting plate to approach the supporting plate, when the vacuum chuck is positioned above the glass, the first group of connecting plates are stopped to move, then the other group of electric telescopic rods are driven to push the corresponding connecting plates to move to approach the supporting plate, and then air in the vacuum chuck is sucked by using vacuum equipment, so that the glass is adsorbed, and the automatic fixing of the glass is realized.

title_en: Explosion-proof control box and explosion-proof fork truck
abstract_en: The invention provides an explosion-proof control box and an explosion-proof forklift, which belong to the technical field of explosion-proof forklifts and comprise an explosion-proof shell, wherein the explosion-proof shell comprises a first installation surface and a second installation surface which are adjacently arranged, and a third installation surface which is arranged opposite to the first installation surface, a direction switch component is arranged on the first installation surface, the load switch assembly is installed on the second installation surface, and a plurality of cable lead-in assemblies are connected to the third installation surface, wherein the third installation surface is assembled with the forklift and is connected with the forklift control system through the cable lead-in assemblies, and the direction switch assembly and the load switch assembly are both arranged towards the direction of the cab. According to the invention, the switch assemblies are integrated and arranged in the explosion-proof shell, so that the whole operation switch action is positioned in the explosion-proof control box, the stability of the action of each switch assembly is ensured, and the integral explosion-proof performance of the explosion-proof control box is greatly improved.

title_en: Conveniently-packed pearl wool processing and winding mechanism and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pearl wool processing winding mechanism and method convenient to pack, and relates to the technical field of pearl wool processing, wherein the pearl wool processing winding mechanism comprises a base, wherein the rear end of the base is connected with a rotating assembly, and the output end of the rotating assembly is provided with adjustable winding assemblies at equal intervals along the circumferential direction; the adjustable winding assembly comprises a driving assembly and a position adjusting assembly, the driving assembly is arranged on the rotating assembly at equal intervals along the circumferential direction, the driving assembly is connected with the position adjusting assembly, the adjustable winding assembly is in an open state when winding and waiting for winding, the adjustable winding assembly is in a tightening state when discharging, and the pearl cotton coiled material can be conveniently taken down from the adjustable winding assembly by the adjustable winding assembly in the tightening state; the base is provided with a cutting and rolling component at a position to be rolled of the rotating component; through the mode, the winding roller and the contraction plate can be conveniently separated, and the packing difficulty is reduced.

title_en: Tray, glass plate package body, and package body for conveyance
abstract_en: A pallet (4) provided with a base part (4a) and a loading part (4b) which is arranged above the base part (4a) and used for loading a laminated body (3) comprising glass plates (2) is configured in such a way that a groove-shaped concave part (R) used for receiving a conveying device used for conveying the pallet (4) is arranged on the bottom surface (4z) of the base part (4 a).

title_en: Printing and dyeing drying winding device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a textile printing and dyeing field especially relates to a printing and dyeing stoving coiling mechanism, the power distribution box comprises a box body, one side of box is equipped with the wind-up roll, the opposite side of box is equipped with the transfer roller, be equipped with drying mechanism in the box, drying mechanism includes the drying roller, the drying roller is installed in the box, and drying roller's axis is perpendicular with material direction of delivery's axis, be equipped with dehumidification mechanism on the box, still be equipped with the actuating mechanism who is used for driving dehumidification mechanism to go up and down on the box, actuating mechanism still is connected with the wind-up roll, still be equipped with the control mechanism who is used for controlling actuating mechanism work in the box, this application has improved when new fabric gets into the box and dries in the traditional mode, lead to humidity unstable, thereby appear drying quality not good problem, can reach the effect that reduces the fabric and appear quality problem.

title_en: Conveying device and method for food detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a conveying device and a conveying method for food detection, and belongs to the field of food detection. A conveying device for food detection comprises a first conveying belt, a fruit body detection structure for detecting fruit color is erected on the first conveying belt, a screening assembly is arranged at the right end of the first conveying belt, a delivery inspection assembly is arranged below the screening assembly, the screening assembly comprises a screening track and a discharging pipe, and a discharging groove is formed in the screening track; the invention can detect whether the fruits are mature or rotten with the help of gravity, simultaneously, different fruits are screened according to the size, the largest and intact fruits can directly enter the high-quality product collecting vehicle, the fruits can be directly sold without being made into cans so as to obtain higher economic benefit, and the fruits of other small individuals are screened again so as to be made into cans of different types after being distinguished, thereby ensuring the maximization of the economic benefit of the products.

title_en: Method for planning low-profile creeping whole-body motion of humanoid robot based on key modal decomposition and CPG
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for planning low-attitude creeping whole-body motion of a humanoid robot based on key modal decomposition and CPG, which is characterized in that straight-line low-attitude creeping motion is decomposed into four key motion modes, a CPG coupling network based on a Hopf oscillator is subjected to parameter determination and initialization according to the key motion modes, and a mathematical model of the CPG coupling network is solved to obtain sagittal plane key motion tracks of a right shoulder pitching joint, a left shoulder pitching joint, a right leg hip pitching joint and a left leg hip pitching joint of the robot; according to the phase and amplitude converted by the key motion mode, mapping the sagittal key motion track into a whole body motion track, and sending the whole body motion track to each joint of the robot by the industrial personal computer for execution, so that the linear low-position creeping motion of the humanoid robot is realized. The invention realizes the track planning of the low-attitude creeping whole-body cooperative motion of the humanoid robot based on the creeping motion key modal decomposition and the CPG coupling network.

title_en: Desktop robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a desktop robot, which not only has the function of informing a selected program by using a display part, but also can simplify the display part and the circuit structure thereof and restrain the cost. A tabletop robot (1A) is provided with: a plurality of operation switches (15-17) having a light emitting part; a display unit (18) for displaying the identification information; a storage unit (14) that stores a plurality of programs; a registration unit (13a) that associates each of the plurality of programs with a plurality of operation switches (15-17); and a display light emission control unit (13b) that sequentially displays, on a display unit (18), identification information of programs associated with the program by the registration unit (13a) in a standby state before signals from the operation switches (15-17) are output, and that lights up the operation switches (15-17) associated with the program by the registration unit (13a) at a timing corresponding to the display of the identification information.

title_en: Production equipment for inorganic antirust resin
abstract_en: The invention discloses inorganic antirust resin production equipment, which belongs to the technical field of resin production equipment and comprises a tank body and a stirring device arranged in the tank body, wherein a feeding pipe is arranged at the top of the tank body, the top of the feeding pipe is movably arranged, a condensing box is arranged on one side of the tank body, the condensing box is connected with the tank body through an air inlet pipe, a fan is arranged in the air inlet pipe, a water storage tank is arranged on the condensing box, a water tank is arranged on one side of the condensing box, a water pump is arranged at the top of the water tank, the output end of the water pump is connected with the water storage tank through a first water pipe, and one end of the water storage tank is connected with the water tank through a second water pipe. The hot gas discharged from the filtering tank body can be effectively condensed, the influence on the surrounding environment when the hot gas is discharged can be effectively prevented, the resin in the second discharge pipe can be scraped out of the second discharge pipe, the second discharge pipe can be prevented from being blocked due to the accumulation of the resin in the second discharge pipe, and the influence on the quality of new resin caused by the solidified resin can be prevented.

title_en: Upper limb exoskeleton connecting device and exoskeleton
abstract_en: The invention discloses an upper limb exoskeleton connecting device and an exoskeleton, wherein the connecting device comprises a connecting assembly and a sliding guide structure, the connecting assembly is connected with the upper limb exoskeleton connection, the sliding guide structure is fixedly arranged on the inner side of an exoskeleton back plate, the connecting assembly penetrates through a sliding groove on the exoskeleton back plate, and the upper limb exoskeleton can move along the sliding groove of the exoskeleton back plate under the sliding fit of a sliding block of the connecting assembly and a guide groove of the sliding guide structure and is in sliding connection with the sliding groove of the exoskeleton back plate. According to the upper limb exoskeleton and the upper limb exoskeleton combined device, the upper limb exoskeleton and the exoskeleton back plate are connected through the connecting assembly and the sliding guide mechanism, so that the upper limb exoskeleton can be conveniently disassembled and assembled on the back plate, and can move along the sliding groove on the back plate under the sliding fit of the connecting assembly and the sliding guide mechanism, and the freedom degree of the upper limb inward-extending and outward-extending movement is realized.

title_en: Robot heat preservation and heat dissipation control device and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a robot heat preservation and heat dissipation control device and a method, wherein the device comprises a robot body box body, a low-temperature battery and a plurality of electronic devices are arranged in the robot body box body, a side plate of the robot body box body is provided with heat dissipation ribs, and the heat dissipation ribs and a heat dissipation module are coupled to form a heat dissipation unit; the heat dissipation module comprises an air channel fixing support, a refrigeration radiating fin, a centrifugal fan, a TEC refrigeration piece and a heat conduction copper pipe, wherein the centrifugal fan and the TEC refrigeration piece are installed in the air channel fixing support, the refrigeration radiating fin is attached to the cold surface of the TEC refrigeration piece, the heat conduction copper pipe is attached to the hot surface of the TEC refrigeration piece, and heat conduction silicone grease is filled between the heat conduction copper pipe and a heat dissipation rib. The invention controls the heating quantity of the PTC heater to heat up by reading the temperature Tq in the cavity and the ambient temperature Ta and further adjusting the voltage and the current of the PTC heater, and cools down by the heat dissipation module.

title_en: Step-by-step suspension conveying vehicle release device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a stepping suspension conveying vehicle release device which comprises a track, a conveying vehicle and a release mechanism, wherein the release mechanism comprises a cylinder, a first connecting rod, a first blocking rocker arm, a release rocker arm and a second blocking rocker arm, one end of the cylinder is hinged with a mounting plate fixed on the track, the other end of the cylinder is connected with a connecting shaft on the first connecting rod, one end of the first connecting rod is rotatably connected with the release rocker arm, the other end of the first connecting rod is rotatably connected with the first blocking rocker arm, one end of the release rocker arm far away from the first connecting rod is rotatably connected with the second connecting rod, the other end of the second connecting rod is rotatably connected with the second blocking rocker arm, and the first blocking rocker arm, the second release rocker arm and the second blocking rocker arm are matched with a bearing shaft on the conveying vehicle. The stepping suspension conveying vehicle releasing device is stable in operation, can give a certain initial speed to the conveying vehicles in the releasing process, ensures that the conveying vehicles can be started from a static state against static friction force, and ensures that all the conveying vehicles can be released orderly one by one.

title_en: Printing machine
abstract_en: The application relates to a printing machine, and belongs to the technical field of printing. It includes just getting the subassembly, getting the subassembly again, form advance roller and mounting bracket, follow on the mounting bracket form advance roller direction of delivery and slide and install the confession just get the mount table of unit mount, just get the subassembly including just getting sword and drive just get the regulation driving piece and the drive of the vertical motion of sword just get the sword level and insert the driving piece of just getting of paper heap, just get the sword and have a plurality ofly and divide the both sides of establishing paper direction of delivery, it includes propelling movement pole and the vertical motion butt of drive propelling movement pole again to get the subassembly highly regulated driving piece and the drive catch bar of paper on just getting the subassembly and push into the paper driving piece of form advancing the roller to the paper. The application has better effect of conveying the thin paper.

title_en: Conveyance control device, conveyance control method, and program
abstract_en: The invention provides a transport control device capable of realizing the efficiency of storage and access of articles. The conveyance control device of the embodiment is provided with a storage unit, a control unit, and a communication unit. The storage unit stores positional information about each of a plurality of racks included in a predetermined interval, a peripheral lane of the plurality of racks, a rack lower lane of each of the racks, a rack area in which a rack taken out from the rack by a carrier is placed, and management information for managing each of the racks. The control unit outputs a control signal for controlling the truck based on the position information and the management information. The communication unit transmits the control signal to the truck. The plurality of shelf groups each include first and second shelf columns. The perimeter channel includes an outgoing and first return path proximate the first shelf column of a given shelf group of the plurality of shelf groups and a second return path proximate the second shelf column of each shelf group. The control unit outputs a first control signal that controls travel of the truck to a first recovery position corresponding to a first rack included in the rack group, controls recovery of the first rack by the truck, and controls travel of the truck from the first recovery position to the rack area via the first or second return route.

title_en: Side-tipping stability test bed for mountain full-track tractor
abstract_en: The invention relates to a full-track tractor rolling stability test bed for a mountain land, which comprises a rolling test base and a rolling platform, wherein an axle weight instrument and an angle instrument are arranged on the rolling platform, a side support plate is arranged on one side of the rolling test base in a protruding mode, a support upright post is arranged on the other side of the rolling test base in a protruding mode, one side of the rolling platform is hinged to the upper end of the side support plate through a hinge mechanism, the other side of the rolling platform is borne on the support upright post, a lifting mechanism is arranged between the rolling test base and the rolling platform and is positioned at the middle position of the other side of the rolling test base, the lifting mechanism adopts a scissor type hydraulic lifting platform, an anti-overturning frame is connected to the outer side face of the side support plate, and the lower surface of the anti-overturning frame is level with the lower surface of the rolling test base. The test bed is more stable and reliable in use, different from a foundation pit type test bed, the side-tipping test base and the side-tipping platform can be assembled and disassembled and moved, the manufacturing cost is low, the test bed is more convenient, the detection function is comprehensive, and the turning driving of the side-tipping platform is more reasonable.

title_en: Paper collecting equipment for processing corrugated board
abstract_en: The invention discloses a paper collecting device for processing a corrugated board, which relates to the technical field of processing of the corrugated board and comprises a base, wherein a bearing plate which is obliquely arranged is rotatably arranged on the base; a first bearing space and a second bearing space are arranged on the bearing plate; the base is provided with a first driving structure for driving the bearing plate to rotate, and the first driving structure is used for replacing the first bearing space and the second bearing space; the adjusting structure comprises a fixing ring fixedly mounted on the base, two groups of limiting structures are arranged on the bearing plate, the first driving structure drives the bearing plate to rotate, and in the process, the bearing plate drives the limiting structures to clamp and limit the bearing plate. The invention can facilitate the workers to pack and limit the stacked corrugated boards, and meanwhile, the second bearing space moves to be matched with the conveying belt so as to receive a new corrugated board.

title_en: Sheet stack support assembly and method for operating a sheet stack support assembly
abstract_en: A stack support assembly (24) for a sheet processing machine is presented. It comprises a plurality of stack support bars (28) and a movable guide for selectively moving one or more of the stack support bars (28) from a retracted position to an extended position. Furthermore, an automatic selection unit (30) is provided for automatically selecting a sheet stack support bar (28) to be moved to an extended position and for connecting the selected sheet stack support bar (28) to a movable guide. Furthermore, a method for operating a sheet stack support assembly (24) for a sheet processing machine is set forth.

title_en: Multifunctional hydraulic tail plate for fire truck and fire truck
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional hydraulic tail plate for a fire engine and the fire engine, which comprise a base frame, a lifting platform and a forklift bearing mechanism, wherein the lifting platform and the forklift bearing mechanism are arranged on the base frame; the lifting platform comprises a power station, a control device, an action device and a platform plate; the action equipment is arranged on the base frame and connected with the platform board; the power station is connected with the action equipment; the control equipment is connected with the power station; the forklift bearing mechanism comprises a guide slot and a forklift supporting component; the guide slots are arranged on the base body frame, and two groups of guide slots are arranged; the forklift supporting components are arranged in two groups and symmetrically arranged about the center line of the platform plate, and are used for loading and supporting the forklift. The lifting platform and the forklift carrying mechanism are integrated into a whole, and the lifting platform and the forklift carrying mechanism are assembled for the rescue equipment fire truck at the same time; the lifting platform can be used for loading and unloading rescue equipment from the tail of the vehicle, and the forklift can be loaded along with the vehicle, so that the use under different scene conditions is met, and the lifting platform is convenient and fast.

title_en: Hydraulic electromagnetic chuck
abstract_en: The invention provides a hydraulic electromagnetic chuck, relates to the technical field of electromagnetic chucks and aims to solve the technical problem that a magnetic conductive object adsorbed by the existing hydraulic electromagnetic chuck is easy to fall off; the energy conversion device comprises a base and an electromagnetic chuck, wherein the base is provided with an energy conversion mechanism, the base is provided with an installation part, and the electromagnetic chuck comprises a disk body, a connecting part and a holding part; connecting portion and installation department are connected through the first elastic component of a plurality of, and the portion of hugging closely has two at least flexible ends, and when two flexible ends were flexible, can hug closely the installation department. When the hydraulic electromagnetic chuck transfers the magnetic conduction object, the magnetic conduction object is not easy to fall off.

title_en: System and method for automated assembly of components
abstract_en: A system (12) for automatically manipulating components (38) to be assembled onto products (14) on an assembly line (16) includes a carriage (34) movable to and between a first retracted position spaced from the assembly line (16) and a second position displaced from the retracted position in a direction toward the assembly line (16). An operator (32) on the carriage (34) supports a component mounting tool (36) configured to receive and support at least one component (38) for assembly to the product (14). When the carriage (34) is in the first position, the operator (32) may be arranged in a first orientation, and when the carriage (34) is in the second position, the operator may be pivoted to a second orientation, such that when the carriage (34) is in the first position, the member (38) on the member mounting tool (36) is supported in a pose for handling, and when the carriage (34) is in the second position, the member is supported in a pose for coupling to the product (14).

title_en: Touch screen protection film pad pasting ware with extranal packing function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a touch screen protective film laminator with an outer packaging function, and relates to the technical field of screen protective films. According to the invention, the common sealing structure is connected below the positioning structure of the film sticking device, the inner cavity of the positioning structure is used as an accommodating space, the protective film and the auxiliary tool are placed in the positioning structure, and the film sticking device is sealed and packaged on the basis of the accommodating space and used as an outer package of a protective film product, so that the packaging material is saved, the packaging volume is smaller, and the transportation cost is reduced.

title_en: Lifting system for vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a lifting system for a vehicle, in particular to the technical field of vehicle lifting, which comprises a lifter, an intelligent control unit and a user interface, wherein the lifter comprises a lifting handle, a lifting handle and a lifting handle; the elevator comprises a main body, a supporting structure, a driving structure and a locking structure; the main body comprises an upright post and a base, the supporting structure comprises a bottom support and a guide post, and a rack is arranged on the outer wall of the guide post; the driving structure drives the guide post to lift along the upright post; the locking structure is opposite to the rack, comprises a first locking piece and a second locking piece, and drives the first locking piece and the second locking piece to synchronously approach or depart from the executing piece of the rack; the first locking piece and the second locking piece are adopted to realize the safe locking of the supporting structure, so that the safety problem caused by the rapid descending of the supporting structure under the unexpected condition is avoided; the first locking piece is locked when the supporting structure is in a stop state, and is unlocked when the supporting structure is in a rising state and a falling state; and the second locking piece plays a role in safety protection when the supporting structure is in a rising state.

title_en: A haulage equipment for tubbiness material
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of building construction equipment, in particular to a carrying device for barrel-shaped materials; the handling apparatus for barrel material comprises: the mounting platform is mounted between the upper ends of the two supports, a sliding rail is arranged at the lower end of the mounting platform, a sliding block is slidably mounted on the sliding rail, and the sliding block penetrates through the sliding rod; the upper end of the sliding rod is connected with the adjusting assembly, the adjusting assembly is installed on the installation table, the end part of the lower end of the sliding rod, which penetrates through the sliding block, is provided with an installation end, and the lower end of the installation end is provided with a clamping assembly; the conveying equipment for the barrel-shaped materials can switch the direction of the barrel-shaped materials conveyed on the conveying belt through the matching action of the installed adjusting assembly and the clamping assembly, manual participation is not needed in the process, and therefore the conveying efficiency of the barrel-shaped materials is high.

title_en: Three-dimensional reconstruction robot for small objects
abstract_en: The invention provides a three-dimensional reconstruction robot for a small object, which belongs to the technical field of automatic driving and the field of three-dimensional reconstruction. The scanning module consists of a laser radar and a depth camera, the laser radar can scan the outline of an object from top to bottom more comprehensively, and the depth camera is used for matching laser radar data and collecting color information of the object; the path planning module can provide a path which is convenient for the robot to scan and acquire complete data of the object, and the robot can finish 360-degree scanning of the object to be scanned by walking the path; the driving module can control the robot to move according to the planned track. The robot can autonomously perform 360-degree annular scanning around a small object (which can be manually carried), extract the geometric characteristics and the color characteristics of the small object, and then perform three-dimensional model restoration on the small object.

title_en: Three-position five-way commutator for pneumatic logistics transmission of sample pipe
abstract_en: The invention provides a three-position five-way commutator for pneumatic logistics transmission of a specimen tube, and relates to the technical field of medical logistics equipment. The three-position five-way commutator comprises a first base body, a first upper joint, a second base body, a first lower joint, a second lower joint, a third lower joint, a first reversing disc, a second reversing disc, a first pipeline, a second pipeline, a third pipeline, a fourth pipeline and a driving mechanism. When the commutator is in a first state position, the sample tube can be transmitted between the first upper joint and the first lower joint, and the sample tube can be transmitted between the second upper joint and the third lower joint; the commutator is in a second state position, the sample tube can be transmitted between the first upper joint and the second lower joint, and the sample tube can be transmitted between the second upper joint and the third lower joint; the commutator is in the third state position, and the sample pipe can be transmitted between first top connection and first lower joint, and the sample pipe can be transmitted between second top connection and second lower joint.

title_en: Bottle (Ref. TM. Bottle)
abstract_en: The disclosed bottle (1) is a columnar bottle (1) that stores a liquid that generates gas inside, and is provided with: a main body (3) which stores liquid therein; a bottle opening (5) which is provided on the upper surface of the main body (3) and is open to the outside; a cap (9) that covers the bottle opening (5) in an openable and closable manner; and a liner (2) that is attached between the opening of the spout (5) and the cap (9) and that allows gas to pass therethrough without allowing liquid to pass therethrough. The main body part (3) is composed of a 1 st column part (15) of a semi-cylindrical shape having a spout (5) on the upper surface thereof and a 2 nd column part (11) of a cylindrical shape having a cross-sectional area that becomes smaller as the section area is relatively distant from the spout (5).

title_en: Train wheel transportation positioning device and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a train wheel transportation positioning device which comprises a conveying mechanism, a lifting mechanism, a rotating mechanism and a core fixing mechanism, wherein the lifting mechanism is connected to the conveying mechanism and moves along the conveying mechanism, the rotating mechanism is connected to the lifting mechanism, the core fixing mechanism is connected to the rotating mechanism, wheels are placed on the core fixing mechanism and fixed, the wheels rotate along with the rotation of the rotating mechanism and move up and down along with the lifting of the lifting mechanism, and horizontal linear movement is performed under the action of the conveying mechanism. The train wheel transportation positioning device can realize fixed-point transportation of the train wheels, can realize lifting movement of the wheels, can drive the wheels to rotate, and completely meets the fixed-point detection requirement of the hardness detection equipment on the train wheels. The invention also discloses a using method of the train wheel transportation positioning device.

title_en: Robot and control method
abstract_en: The application discloses a robot and a control method. The robot includes annular spring structure and expander, and annular spring structure is along the setting of axis direction can overturn, and annular spring structure includes a plurality of unit cells of following the axis and encircling the connection, and the unit cell includes n strip-shaped structures, and annular spring structure has 2n class cavity, and the robot has 2n group expander, and the e group expander sets up in the e class cavity, and the expander has expansion state and shrink state in order to be used for opening or closing the cavity to make annular spring structure upset and switch between 2n steady state, wherein, n is greater than or equal to 2 positive integer, and e is greater than or equal to 1 and less than or equal to 2n positive integer. The robot provided by the application has a better implementation mode of cross-medium movement.

title_en: Paper bag half-packaging device and half-packaging method for chopsticks
abstract_en: The invention relates to a paper bag half-packaging device of chopsticks, which comprises a rack and a control device, wherein the rack is provided with a chopstick sorting device, a chopstick receiving device, a paper bag storing device, a paper bag pushing device, a paper bag opening device and a chopstick pushing device, the chopstick sorting device is used for sorting the heads and the tails of the chopsticks to the chopstick receiving device, the chopstick receiving device can accommodate multiple layers of chopsticks, each layer can accommodate one pair of chopsticks, the paper bag storing device is arranged on one side of the chopstick receiving device, the paper bag pushing device is used for pushing paper bags in the paper bag storing device, the paper bag opening device is used for opening paper bags pushed by the paper bag pushing device, and the chopstick pushing device is used for pushing one pair of chopsticks in the paper bags with the opened bags. The multi-chopstick sorting and arranging device can sort and arrange multiple pairs of chopsticks and automatically semi-package paper bags, so that a great deal of labor cost and time cost are saved, and the service efficiency of restaurants is improved. The invention also relates to a paper bag half-packaging method of the chopsticks.

title_en: Converter station air-cooled fan operation and maintenance platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a converter station air-cooled fan operation and maintenance platform, which comprises a vehicle body and an operation and maintenance platform, wherein the operation and maintenance platform is positioned right above the vehicle body, a lifting mechanism is arranged between the vehicle body and the operation and maintenance platform, the lifting mechanism comprises a support column and a lifting box, a protection channel is connected in a penetrating manner at the center of the top of the operation and maintenance platform, and guardrail frames are fixedly connected at the two ends of the top of the operation and maintenance platform.

title_en: Double-hot-stamping module mechanism
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of stamping, in particular to a double-stamping module mechanism, which aims at the existing requirement for supporting gold and silver stamping, and is characterized in that a plurality of stamping modules are added or only one stamping module is adopted for reducing cost, only one stamping of one color is supported, and when another color is required to be stamped, color bands of different colors are required to be replaced for solving the problem; only one color-scalding module needs to be installed on one device, so that the number of modules is reduced, and the cost can be reduced.

title_en: Warehousing system
abstract_en: The application discloses a warehousing system, which comprises a warehousing control system, a storage area, a warehouse-out area, a packing area and a sorting robot, wherein packing tables are arranged in the packing area, and a plurality of packing grid openings are formed in each packing table in an encircling manner; picking shelves are arranged in the delivery area, and the number and the height of the picking basket storage layers of each picking shelf respectively correspond to the number and the height of the picking basket storage areas; the storage control system acquires order information to be delivered, splits the order information into a plurality of order lines according to article attribute information contained in the order information, and controls the picking robot to pick articles from the storage area into corresponding picking baskets according to the order lines; controlling a picking robot to convey a picking basket to a picking shelf in a warehouse-out area; and controlling the target picking robot to extract the target picking basket from a picking shelf in the delivery area according to the delivery attribute information in the order information, and transferring the target picking basket to a specified packing grid opening in the packing area to finish packing.

title_en: Mechanical arm
abstract_en: The application discloses a manipulator, which relates to the technical field of instruments and equipment, wherein the manipulator comprises a driving assembly and a gear reduction mechanism, the driving assembly comprises a first driving motor, the driving end of the first driving motor is provided with gear teeth, the first driving motor is a large torque density output motor, the gear reduction mechanism comprises a first reduction gear, the gear teeth of the first reduction gear are meshed with the gear teeth of the first driving motor, one end of the first reduction gear, which is far away from the first driving motor, is provided with a first connecting rod mechanism, the first driving motor is used for driving the first connecting rod mechanism to move, and the first reduction gear is used for reducing the rotation speed of the first driving motor and transmitting the rotation speed to the first connecting rod mechanism.
