The application can improve the back driving capability and the transmission efficiency of the driving system, and realize the speed reduction and the torque increase while maintaining the good back driving capability, so that the manipulator can perform rapid and elegant operation in a complex collision contact environment.

title_en: Automatic soil discharging control method and system based on laser scanner
abstract_en: The application discloses automatic dumping control method and system based on laser scanner, it is at first from the three-dimensional model of the dumping zone of gathering by laser scanner obtain multinomial statistical parameter and pass through sequence encoder with it in order to obtain statistical eigenvector, then, will the three-dimensional model of dumping zone passes through the image encoder in order to obtain model eigenvector, then, based on statistical eigenvector, it is right to optimize in order to obtain optimization model state matrix, finally, will optimization model state matrix passes through the classifier in order to obtain the classification result that is used for showing that the gyration angle of the material receiving arm of dumping machine should increase or should reduce. In this way, large equipment such as a dumping plough can be operated remotely and intelligently.

title_en: Full-automatic liquid injection and vacuum-pumping device of ultrathin soaking plate
abstract_en: The invention provides a full-automatic liquid injection and vacuum-pumping device for an ultrathin soaking plate, wherein a large vacuum pipeline and a vacuum cavity are both arranged on a vacuum equipment rack of the whole device; the large vacuum pipeline is connected with the vacuum cavity through the small vacuum pipeline; the mechanical arm is arranged on a bottom plate of a rack platform of the whole device; the clamping device comprises a vacuum chuck mounting plate and a vacuum chuck, and is mounted at the tail end of the mechanical arm; the image acquisition device, the feeding device, the propelling device, the feeding device, the discharging device, the weighing device, the liquid injection device and the material receiving box are all arranged on the bottom plate of the rack platform; the vacuum cavity, the mechanical arm controller, the material clamping device, the image acquisition device, the feeding device, the propelling device, the feeding device, the discharging device, the weighing device, the liquid injection device and the industrial personal computer are respectively connected with the motion controller. The full-automatic liquid injection and vacuum pumping device for the ultrathin soaking plate has the advantages of automatic material identification, automatic grabbing, automatic liquid injection and vacuum pumping and automatic feeding and discharging.

title_en: Electric element storage device with protection function and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric element storage device with a protection function and a using method thereof. The drying lamp can be driven to move back and forth, so that the electric elements placed in different positions of the inner cavity of the placing box are dried uniformly and thoroughly, the drying effect is good, the situation that moisture is distributed around the storage environment of the electric elements is avoided, moist air in the inner cavity of the electric element storing box can be discharged quickly, the electric elements are stored in the inner cavity environment of the electric element storing box safely, and the electric elements are protected.

title_en: Disc type wire collecting device with guide mechanism for processing enamelled copper flat wire
abstract_en: The invention provides a disc type wire collecting device with a guide mechanism for enamelled copper flat wire processing, which belongs to the field of copper flat wire collecting and comprises a side plate, wherein a servo motor is fixedly connected to the side wall of the side plate, a transmission shaft is fixedly connected to the bottom of the servo motor, a wire collecting disc is driven to rotate by the servo motor to provide wire collecting power, then the first rotating column and the second rotating column are driven to rotate by friction force generated by a wire rod, a fan blade on the side wall of the wire rod is driven to rotate at first to form wind power, gas exchange outside a working chamber is accelerated, the cooling effect is improved, then the formed wind power quickly dries the surface of the wire rod, and then the first rotating column and the second rotating column rotate to drive cooling liquid in inner cavities of the first rotating column, the second rotating column, the first connecting column, the first rotating ball and the second rotating ball to flow mutually, so that overheating of friction parts of the wire rod is avoided, and plating paint on the surface of the wire rod is dropped.

title_en: Feeding assembly and nucleic acid sampling system
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a feeding assembly and a nucleic acid sampling system having the feeding assembly. The feeding assembly comprises a first material conveying channel and a second material conveying channel which are arranged on the feeding frame and used for materials to pass through, and a single material outlet is formed in the feeding frame, and the first material conveying channel and the second material conveying channel are communicated with the material outlet. The feed assembly further comprises a switch movable relative to the feed frame between a first position and a second position, wherein when the switch is in the first position, the switch does not block material of the first material transport channel from traveling to the material outlet and blocks material of the second material transport channel from traveling to the material outlet, and when the switch is in the second position, the switch blocks material of the first material transport channel from traveling to the material outlet and does not block material of the second material transport channel from traveling to the material outlet.

title_en: Material taking device and ship unloader
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ship unloading mechanical devices, in particular to a material taking device and a ship unloader. The extracting device includes: a chain bucket arm; a hopper chain; the two tensioning chain wheels are arranged at the opposite lower ends of the length direction of the hopper arm and are suitable for stretching the hopper chain along the stress direction, and a material taking section suitable for being in contact with materials is formed in at least part of the area of the hopper chain; and the translational component is suitable for driving the material taking section to perform translational motion along the stress direction relative to the chain bucket arm. According to the material taking device provided by the invention, the translational component is arranged, and the translational component drives the material taking section to perform translational motion along the stress direction relative to the chain bucket arm. Therefore, when the unloading operation of the material taking device is carried out to the edge of the cabin wall, the position of the material taking section is adjusted through the translation assembly, so that the material taking hopper can touch materials in a wider range, the materials are closer to the edge of the inner wall of the cabin on the sea side or the land side, the bin cleaning amount is reduced, and the working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Dedicated automatic interlock mechanism of prefabricated component hoisting machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a special automatic meshing mechanism for a prefabricated part hoisting machine, which comprises a bottom plate provided with an installation shell and a driving motor, wherein a limiting groove is formed in the installation shell, the limiting groove extends along the axial direction of a driving shaft of the driving motor, an upper pressing block and a lower pressing block are connected in the limiting groove in a sliding manner, the opposite side surfaces of the upper pressing block and the lower pressing block are respectively provided with an upper chain tooth socket and a lower chain tooth socket, the side surface of the installation shell is provided with a channel, the bottom plate is rotatably connected with a transmission rod, the two sides of the outer peripheral surface of the transmission rod along the length direction are respectively provided with a first thread part and a second thread part with opposite thread turning directions, the transmission rod respectively penetrates through the upper pressing block and the lower pressing block in a threaded manner through the first thread part and the second thread part, and a transmission part is arranged between the transmission rod and the driving shaft of the driving motor. Through adopting above-mentioned setting, realize with hoist and mount robot's drive mechanism's drag chain interlock or the function of loosening. Meanwhile, the invention is applied to the hoisting robot, so that the production cost can be saved and the working efficiency can be improved.

title_en: Defect repairing method for large composite material packaging box
abstract_en: The invention discloses a defect repairing method of a large-scale composite material packing box, which relates to the technical field of composite materials, and is characterized in that historical maintenance data of the large-scale composite material packing box to be maintained are obtained in advance, scanning areas are divided according to air leakage probability, the area with the air leakage probability exceeding 10% is set as a necessary scanning area, and the rest scanning area is divided into a pumping scanning area; then scanning the packaging box by adopting a laser ultrasonic detection technology, imaging a scanning result in real time by utilizing an imaging technology, observing the imaging result, and positioning the defect position of the packaging box; then, a repairing agent is prepared to repair the defect position. The invention can quickly position the defect position of the inner skin of the packing box, further adopt subsequent repair measures, create a complete inner skin for the interior of the packing box, solve the problem of air leakage of the packing box and reduce the repair cost.

title_en: Lifting rope anti-drop device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lifting rope anti-drop device which comprises a baffle ring and a baffle rod, wherein the baffle rod comprises a first baffle rod and a second baffle rod which are coaxial, a gap is formed between the first baffle rod and the second baffle rod, the length of the gap is larger than the diameter of a lifting ring, two ends of the baffle ring are respectively connected with the end parts of the first baffle rod and the second baffle rod, which are close to each other, an accommodating space is formed in the baffle ring, the lifting ring enters the accommodating space through the gap, a blind hole is formed in the first baffle rod along the axis of the first baffle rod, a through hole is formed in the second baffle rod along the axis of the second baffle rod, a sliding baffle rod is connected in the through hole in a sliding manner, the sliding baffle rod can slide into the blind hole, and a locking piece for fixing the sliding baffle rod is arranged on the second baffle rod. The anticreep device of this scheme installs on rings, through the spacing of first shelves pole and second shelves pole to prevent that the lifting rope from coming off from rings, and then prevented the condition that the mould falls.

title_en: Apparatus and method for heating a movable web
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heating unit for heating a continuous web (18, 20), comprising: a heated roller (44) rotating about a rotational axis (46) and having an outer surface (86) comprising a pattern of thermally conductive regions (88) and thermally insulating regions (90); and at least one induction heater (98) electromagnetically coupled to the thermally conductive area (88) of the outer surface (86) of the heated roller (44).

title_en: Integrated equipment for cutting and winding foam adhesive tape
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of foam adhesive tape production equipment, in particular to integrated equipment for cutting and winding foam adhesive tapes, which comprises the following steps: the feeding device is fixedly arranged on one side of the rack through an installation rod, and a conveying roller wheel for conveying a foam adhesive tape is arranged on the supporting frame; the cutting device is arranged at the top of the rack through a support frame and comprises a cutting tool for cutting the foam adhesive tape; the winding device comprises a winding frame arranged on the other side of the rack and a winding shaft arranged on the winding frame and used for winding the foam adhesive tape, and the winding shaft is arranged in the supporting frame. On the transfer roller conveys the cotton sticky tape of bubble to the coiling mechanism, the rolling axle will bubble cotton sticky tape and roll, and when collecting epaxial bubble cotton sticky tape rolling to suitable size, the cutter will be tailor and the cotton sticky tape of bubble is cut, and this device will cut and combine together as an organic whole with the rolling, improves production efficiency, is convenient for carry out the rolling with the cotton sticky tape of bubble, and the practicality is strong.

title_en: Packing equipment and packing method
abstract_en: The application discloses a packaging device and a packaging method. The packaging equipment comprises a movable supporting piece, two driving pieces and a roller set. The roller group comprises a frame and a plurality of rollers rotatably connected with the frame, and the two driving pieces are connected with the movable supporting piece and respectively connected with a first end and a second end of the frame, which are oppositely arranged. When the parcel is born the weight of on a plurality of cylinders, remove support piece along first direction motion to drive a plurality of cylinders and move to the top of transporting the container, driving piece drive frame's first end or second end move along the second direction and predetermine the distance, so that the loading end and the horizontal plane slope of a plurality of cylinders set up, thereby make parcel on a plurality of cylinders can slide into in the transport container under the action of gravity, need not to carry out a large amount of location, thereby can improve dress package efficiency.

title_en: System and method for integrating load locks into factory interface footprints
abstract_en: The present disclosure describes devices, systems, and methods for integrating load locks into a factory interface footprint. A factory interface for an electronic device manufacturing system may include an interior space defined by a bottom, a top, and a plurality of sides, a first load lock disposed within the interior space of the factory interface, and a first factory interface robot disposed within the interior space of the factory interface, wherein the first factory interface robot is configured to transfer substrates between a first set of substrate carriers and the first load lock.

title_en: Method and device for cleaning interior of conveying belt of food enterprise
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for cleaning the interior of a conveying belt of a food enterprise, which comprises a spraying device arranged above the conveying belt, a water supply device connected with the spraying device, an air supply device connected with the water supply device and a roller brush arranged on the conveying belt, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring state parameters of a conveying belt and water pressure parameters of a water supply device, and acquiring air pressure parameters of an air supply device according to the state parameters and the water pressure parameters; operating the water supply device and the air supply device through air pressure parameters; the air pressure parameter of the air supply device is adjusted through the state parameter of the conveying belt and the water pressure parameter of the water supply device, so that the air supply device ensures that the cleaning water flow sprayed by the spraying device provides proper cleaning pressure for the conveying belt, the conveying belt is subjected to efficient cleaning operation, the residual milk in the conveying belt can be thoroughly removed, and the problems that the conveying belt is large in residual amount due to milk scale and long mould is difficult to clean are solved.

title_en: Device applied to voltage sag treatment of subway escalator and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a device applied to voltage sag management of a subway escalator and a control method thereof, wherein the device comprises a first isolation transformer, wherein the device is isolated from a commercial power grid to ensure the safety of the power grid, namely, electrical isolation is performed, then current is rectified into direct current through a rectifier, then the direct current is inverted into alternating current through an inverter, the alternating current is boosted and filtered by a second isolation transformer, the current passing through the second isolation transformer is output to a frequency converter control unit to realize the stable output of the current of the commercial power grid, when the voltage sag of the commercial power grid, an energy storage unit is converted into alternating current through the inverter and is output to the frequency converter control unit through the second isolation transformer to ensure the voltage of the frequency converter control unit to be unchanged; meanwhile, the energy storage unit is boosted through the second voltage sag protection module and outputs the boosted voltage to the frequency converter, so that sudden shutdown of the escalator due to voltage sag is avoided, and casualties are prevented from occurring.

title_en: Wine taking device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wine dispenser which comprises a first valve, a second valve, an actuating piece and a control piece, wherein a transition chamber is arranged between the first valve and the second valve, the transition chamber is communicated with the second valve, the actuating piece is connected with the second valve, and the actuating piece is used for providing an acting force for the second valve to approach the first valve. When the second valve is opened, the actuating piece drives the second valve to approach the first valve, and the first valve is opened, so that the force of a user is saved.

title_en: Clamping mechanism and light wave drying forming line feeding frame
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of light wave drying, in particular to a clamping mechanism and a material loading frame of a light wave drying forming line, wherein the clamping mechanism comprises a high-temperature-resistant gas claw and an adjusting assembly, the adjusting assembly comprises a fixed seat and a ball screw pair, a sliding block and a guide rail clamp are arranged on the fixed seat, the ball screw pair comprises a connecting seat, a screw rod and a nut, a linear guide rail is arranged on the connecting seat, the connecting seat is fixedly connected with the high-temperature-resistant gas claw through a gas claw mounting seat, the sliding block is arranged on the linear guide rail in a sliding mode and is locked by the guide rail clamp, the screw rod is rotatably arranged on the connecting seat and is matched with the nut, and the nut is connected with the fixed seat. The clamping mechanism and the feeding frame of the light wave drying and forming line adopting the clamping mechanism realize the feeding of raw materials and the clamping and positioning during drying, provide a new scheme for realizing the automatic operation of light wave drying and forming production, further reduce the operation intensity of workers and realize lean production while improving the production efficiency and quality of products.

title_en: Bearing packaging device and bearing packaging method
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of bearing packaging, discloses a bearing packaging device, a packaging barrel and a bearing packaging method, provides a bearing packaging device, the packaging barrel comprises a barrel body and a cover body in threaded connection with the barrel body, and a jack is formed in the middle of the cover body. The bearing packaging device comprises a cover placing frame and a pushing mechanism, wherein an inner cavity with an opening is formed in the cover placing frame, a stand column is arranged in the middle of the bottom wall of the inner cavity, a plurality of cover bodies are vertically arranged and pass through the stand column in a sliding mode through insertion holes, the stand column comprises a guide section for sleeving the cover bodies and an insertion section for sleeving the bearings, the length of the insertion section is consistent with that of the inside of the barrel, the pushing mechanism comprises an elastic piece arranged in the inner cavity and used for driving the cover bodies to move towards the opening direction, and the barrel can enter the inner cavity through the opening and be separated from the inner cavity after being connected with the cover bodies. The interlude section inserts and takes out a certain amount of bearings during the packing, need not artifical column number and later refill in the barrel, has improved bearing packing work efficiency.

title_en: Plastic bottle cap transportation and storage container
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of transport and storage containers, and particularly relates to a plastic bottle cap transport and storage container which comprises a storage box, wherein a cover plate is hinged to the upper side wall of the storage box, and a plurality of semiconductor refrigeration plates are fixedly connected to the side wall of the cover plate. The plastic bottle cap storage box can automatically release cold air into the storage box according to the temperature of the transported or stored plastic bottle cap when the expensive plastic bottle cap is transported or stored at a higher temperature, so that the problems that the plastic bottle cap is easy to deform at a high temperature, and a plastic strip between the plastic bottle cap and the anti-theft ring deforms and is damaged at a high temperature, so that the plastic bottle cap is wasted and cannot be used continuously are solved, the damage ratio of the plastic bottle cap can be automatically estimated in the process of pouring the plastic bottle cap after the plastic bottle cap is transported to a specified position, a manufacturer can conveniently pay for the plastic bottle cap, manual calculation is not needed, and the working strength of operators is reduced.

title_en: USB data line transmission detection device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a USB data line transmission detection device, which has the technical scheme that: the device comprises a chassis, wherein a U-shaped plate is fixedly arranged on one side of the chassis, side support plates are fixedly connected to two sides of the top of the chassis, a sliding groove is formed in the top of the chassis, a second connecting plate is fixedly connected to one side of the chassis, a first connecting plate is fixedly connected to the other side of the chassis, a first motor is fixedly connected to one side of the first connecting plate, a threaded rod is fixedly connected to the output end of the first motor, the threaded rod penetrates through the first connecting plate and is connected with the first connecting plate through a bearing, the other end of the threaded rod is connected with the second connecting plate through a bearing, and a detection mechanism is arranged on one side of the threaded rod; the detection mechanism comprises a thread block, and has the beneficial effects that: the equipment cost is low, convenient operation is favorable to the detection of a large amount of data lines, does not need manual repeated plug detection, improves detection efficiency to promote the production efficiency of data lines, make things convenient for the material loading and the unloading of data lines, make data line detection speed increase.

title_en: Interior building decoration construction material lifting conveying device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of indoor building decoration, in particular to an indoor building decoration construction material lifting conveying device, which comprises: a base; the transport mechanism is connected with the base; the adsorption fixing mechanisms are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the base and connected with the conveying mechanism; wherein, the transport mechanism includes: the adjusting component is arranged on the inner side of the base and is connected with the adsorption fixing mechanism; the storage component is arranged on the outer side of the base and is used for storing construction materials; the connecting component is arranged between the storage component and the adjusting component, and can ensure the stability and accuracy of the lifting conveying device when lifting and conveying materials through arranging the connecting component and the storage component, so that the safety and the practicability of the lifting conveying device are improved, and the working efficiency of construction operation is improved.

title_en: Electrical threading apparatus for building electrical construction
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric threading device for building electric construction, which relates to the technical field of electric construction appliances and comprises a triangular frame, wherein a winding wheel is fixedly connected to the outer surface of a rotating roller, a guide assembly is provided with a lead wire wound on the outer surface of the winding wheel, a wire clamping groove is formed in the top of the outer surface of the winding wheel, one end of the lead wire, which is far away from the winding wheel, is fixedly connected with an anti-falling connecting sleeve, a through hole is formed in the outer surface of the anti-falling connecting sleeve, a guide head is arranged on one side, which is far away from the lead wire, of the outer surface of a U-shaped piece, a spreader is arranged on one side, which is close to the winding wheel, of the U-shaped piece, a concave pinch roller is rotatably connected to the bottom of the U-shaped piece, and a semicircular hanging ring is fixedly connected to the position, which is close to the concave pinch roller, of the U-shaped piece. This building electrical construction is with electric threader has reached the effect of quick threading, can protect electric wire, cable, is difficult for receiving the adverse circumstances's in the spool influence, and the difficult condition that drops that appears, helps effective threading fast.

title_en: Tension control and wire storage functional device for optical fiber paying-off of vertical cabling machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tension control and wire storage function device for optical fiber paying-off of a vertical cable former, which relates to the technical field of cable formers and comprises the following components: a mounting frame; the slewing bearing is arranged on one side of the bottom of the mounting frame; the driving mechanism is connected with the slewing bearing and used for driving the slewing bearing to rotate; the positioning frame is arranged on the slewing bearing; the guide wheel mechanism is arranged on the positioning frame; wherein, still include: the limiting wheel is rotationally arranged at the top of the mounting frame; receive and release wire adjustment mechanism, it lays between spacing wheel and the guide pulley mechanism, receive and release wire adjustment mechanism is used for adjusting and receives the unwrapping wire and keep invariable state, adjusts receive line and unwrapping wire speed through receive and release wire adjustment mechanism, and then keeps receiving line and unwrapping wire in-process, and the conveying speed of cable is unanimous, avoids when receiving line speed is greater than unwrapping wire speed, and cable receive and release wire stability is higher.

title_en: Hoisting device for concrete prefabricated sandwich composite wallboard and use method of hoisting device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hoisting, in particular to a hoisting device of a concrete prefabricated sandwich composite wallboard and a use method thereof, comprising the following steps: the lifting device comprises a U-shaped supporting frame and a plurality of supporting columns arranged on the supporting frame, wherein lifting rings capable of being hung on lifting equipment are arranged on the supporting columns; the two ends of the supporting frame are respectively provided with a supporting plate, and a channel for the passage of the concrete wallboard is reserved between the two supporting plates; the lifting mechanism is arranged on the supporting frame and used for driving the lifting mechanism to move up and down; to sum up, the utility model provides a hoist device of precast concrete double-layered core composite wallboard and application method has the completion and snatchs transportation wallboard and arrive the function of installing the wallboard again, reduces the contact of staff and wallboard, utilizes positioning mechanism to confirm the relative position of wallboard hole and embedded bar, provides convenience for the staff, is convenient for install the wallboard, reduces the potential safety hazard.

title_en: Shoulder exoskeleton for upper limb auxiliary rehabilitation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a shoulder exoskeleton for upper limb auxiliary rehabilitation. The mechanism comprises a shoulder joint module and a follow-up system module, wherein the shoulder joint module comprises a first shoulder joint mechanism, a second shoulder joint mechanism, a third shoulder joint mechanism, a force sensor mechanism and an arm sleeve mechanism, the follow-up system module comprises an XY direction system module and a Z direction system module, the fact that the shoulder joint movement of a human body is not single sphere movement is considered, the motion characteristics are flexible, the follow-up system module connected with the shoulder joint can be better matched with the shoulder joint movement, the movement of the shoulder joint part of the human body is further realized in the maximum range through driving and controlling an integrated motor, therefore, the effective rehabilitation training of the shoulder joint is realized, and the safety and the stability in the training process are improved.

title_en: A high strength resistance to compression carton for transportation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cartons, and discloses a high-strength compression-resistant carton for transportation, which comprises a carton body, wherein two sides of the top of the carton body are connected with a box cover in a foldable manner, and a protection mechanism is arranged in an inner cavity of the carton body; the protection mechanism comprises two vertically arranged first rubber side plates and two vertically arranged second rubber side plates, the two first rubber side plates are fixedly connected to opposite faces of one group of inner walls of the box body through the honeycomb air cushion buffer layers, and the two second rubber side plates are fixedly connected to opposite faces of the other group of inner walls of the box body through the honeycomb air cushion buffer layers; the invention is beneficial to the four upright and one tiled honeycomb air cushion buffer layers to respectively push the two first rubber side plates, the two second rubber side plates and the one rubber bottom plate which are connected with the four upright and one tiled honeycomb air cushion buffer layers to extrude towards the direction close to the goods when the goods are put in by the protection mechanism, the initial air bag and the transitional air storage bag, so that the gap between the goods and the inner wall of the box body is automatically reduced.

title_en: Independently detachable modularized belt assembly
abstract_en: The invention provides a modular belt assembly capable of being detached independently, and belongs to the field of glove automation equipment. The technical scheme carries out modularized improvement on the belt component and designs a fast-assembling structure and an online tensioning adjusting mechanism for the belt component. In particular, the invention installs a plurality of unit bodies on a modularized mounting plate side by side; in the construction of the unit body: a belt is wound between a driving roller and a driven roller, an auxiliary support is arranged on a support, belt tensioning bolts are connected to the side ends of the auxiliary support in a threaded mode, belt seats are fixedly connected to the support, pressing blocks are respectively arranged at the bottom ends of the front belt seat and the rear belt seat, wedge heads are arranged at the side ends of the pressing blocks, a pull nut is fixedly connected to the bottom end of at least one belt seat, and a five-star handle is connected to the pull nut in a threaded mode. By the aid of the belt assembly disassembling device, modularization independent disassembly of the belt assembly is achieved, tensioning degree of the belt is convenient to adjust at any time, accordingly, workload of equipment maintenance is greatly reduced, and the belt assembly disassembling device has outstanding technical advantages.

title_en: Crane capable of preventing horizontal shaking
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of cranes, in particular to a crane capable of preventing horizontal shaking. The invention provides a crane capable of automatically fixing a weight and preventing horizontal shaking. The utility model provides a hoist that can prevent horizontal rocking, includes bottom plate, rotary disk, support frame and lifting mechanism etc. two parts all are connected with the telescopic leg around the downside of bottom plate, and the left portion upside rotation of bottom plate is connected with the rotary disk, and the upside of rotary disk is connected with the support frame, and the upper portion of support frame is equipped with the lifting mechanism that is used for steadily lifting the heavy object. When the lifting hook pulls the heavy object to move upwards, the lifting hook can move downwards due to the gravity of the heavy object, the common spring is stretched, and the clamping plate is driven to move inwards by the connecting rod, so that the heavy object is automatically clamped and fixed, the heavy object can be effectively prevented from being separated from the lifting hook, and meanwhile, the heavy object cannot shake horizontally when lifted under the limiting action of the telescopic rod, and the lifting hook is simple and convenient to operate and high in stability.

title_en: Roll-up treatment facility is tailor to foaming rubber cloth
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rubber product processing, in particular to foam rubber cloth cutting and rolling treatment equipment, which comprises a base; the base is fixedly provided with two mounting side plates, a winding drum is arranged between the two mounting side plates, a rotating shaft is rotatably arranged on one side of the mounting side plate, a key is fixed on the rotating shaft, and a key slot matched with the key is formed in the inner wall of the winding drum; a lifting frame is arranged between the top ends of the two mounting side plates, and a linear driving mechanism B for driving the lifting frame to vertically move is fixed on the mounting side plates; a rotating frame A and a rotating frame B are arranged on the inner side of the lifting frame; the rotating frame A is rotatably provided with a compression roller, and the rotating frame B is provided with an adhesive tape cutter. The invention can compress the cloth in the process of winding the cloth, avoids the phenomenon that the cloth is loose, can realize the automatic gluing function of the cloth after the winding work is finished, has good fixing effect, and is convenient for dismounting the winding cylinder.

title_en: Batch plate carrying device of tunnel type oven
abstract_en: The invention provides a batch plate carrying device of a tunnel oven, which comprises a baking transmission line, wherein the baking transmission line defines a plate feeding direction and a resetting direction, a plurality of frames are supported on the baking transmission line, a pull rod is arranged in the oven, a plurality of one-way braking parts are formed on the pull rod at intervals, the baking transmission line comprises a pair of in-oven guide rails which penetrate through the oven, each frame is supported on the pair of in-oven guide rails, when the pull rod moves along the plate feeding direction, each frame is driven to move through each one-way braking part, and when the pull rod moves along the resetting direction, each one-way braking part excludes driving each frame to move, so that the problem that a plate frame for a traditional plate can only be transported in batches by relying on a smelting bar or a walking beam is solved.

title_en: Robot end effector working space boundary generation method based on linear programming
abstract_en: The invention relates to a robot end effector working space boundary generation method based on linear programming, which comprises the following steps: s1, constructing a kinematic model of the robot motion by parameterizing the joint motion according to the joint characteristics of the robot; s2, respectively constructing linear equations of all constraints required by the working space boundary of the end effector of the robot; s3, determining a linear constraint equation set which needs to be met for generating a working space boundary of the end effector of the robot; s4, obtaining all robot joint motion parameters meeting linear equations in the constraint equation set; s5, finding out boundary joint motion parameters which simultaneously meet part of constraint from all the robot joint motion parameters which meet the linear equation of the linear constraint equation set; s6, identifying and determining working space boundary points of the end effector of the robot. When laying out robots and industrial production lines, the work of overlapping the industrial production lines and the robot working space is simplified, and the layout work of the robots is greatly simplified.

title_en: Full-automatic equipment and method for film printing, positioning, cutting, detecting and packaging
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the diaphragm production technology and specifically relates to a diaphragm printing location cuts and detects packing automation equipment and method, the equipment that this application provided includes printing device location cutting device and detects packing plant, printing device includes first conveyer belt, location cutting device includes cuts platform and second conveyer belt, the second conveyer belt is located and is cut on the platform, it includes the detection platform to detect packing plant and third conveyer belt to detect packing plant, the detection bench is located to the third conveyer belt, the detection bench is located between packing platform and the cutting platform, the one end and the third conveyer belt butt joint of first conveyer belt are kept away from to the second conveyer belt, the one end and the packing bench butt joint of second conveyer belt are kept away from to the third conveyer belt. The method comprises the steps of feeding, starting a machine, printing, drying, cutting, detecting and packaging, and automatically connecting all working procedures of diaphragm production together without manual positioning and installation for many times, so that the manual consumption is reduced, and the production efficiency is improved.

title_en: Freight logistics vehicle side wall lifting appliance and operation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a side wall lifting appliance of a freight logistics vehicle, which comprises an electric monorail trolley, an electric hoist and a frame welding assembly, wherein the electric hoist is hoisted below the electric monorail trolley, the side wall lifting frame comprises a plurality of groups of cross beams, support rectangular pipes are fixedly connected between the cross beams, sliding rectangular pipes are arranged in the support rectangular pipes, polyurethane supporting blocks are fixedly arranged on the upper surfaces of the sliding rectangular pipes, a plurality of groups of pneumatic clamping assemblies are arranged in the side wall lifting frame, each pneumatic clamping assembly comprises an air cylinder, an upper clamping head and a lower clamping head, the upper clamping heads are fixedly arranged on the side wall of the air cylinder, and the lower clamping heads are rotatably arranged on telescopic rod ends of the air cylinders; the invention discloses an operation method of a side wall lifting appliance of a freight logistics vehicle, which is provided with an integrally formed side wall lifting appliance frame structure, and has the advantages of reasonable process design, novel design, stable and reliable layout and convenience in operation, maintenance, detection and overhaul.

title_en: Collaborative robot control system and method
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a collaborative robot control system and method based on which the system is implemented. A cooperative robot control method, the method comprising the steps of: acquiring an image, wherein the image has depth information and comprises a co-operation scene of a cooperative person and a cooperative robot; estimating joint pose and speed of the cooperator based on the depth information and the acquisition frequency of the image; predicting an impedance control model of the current collaboration personnel based on the joint pose and the joint speed; and acquiring an impedance control model of the cooperative robot by combining the impedance control model of the current cooperative personnel and a working scene in the image, generating and sending a control instruction to the cooperative robot, wherein the control instruction is used for driving the cooperative robot to work. The method disclosed by the invention considers the difference between the cooperative task and the cooperative task person, and has wide application range; the robot body can be dynamically adjusted in real time, and the control is flexible and convenient; and the cooperators do not need to wear external sensors, so that the operation is simple and efficient.

title_en: Automatic granular propellant powder distribution system and method
abstract_en: The invention mainly relates to the technical field of automatic material mixing, and aims to solve the problems that in the conventional grid type mixer material distribution, granular propellant powder depends on manual material distribution, the material distribution quantity is uneven, unsafe production is easy to cause, and the quality level of a product is uneven.

title_en: Swing method and device for parts, swing tower welding workstation and controller
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a swing method and device for parts, a swing tower welding workstation and a controller. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining model information of a target part to be welded; generating corresponding work tasks according to the model information, and issuing the work tasks to the carrying robot and the welding robot; controlling the carrying robot and the welding robot to move to a first position and a second position respectively; controlling the transfer robot to acquire part images of the target parts so as to determine first position deviation data of the target parts according to the part images; controlling the carrying robot to adjust the grabbing position according to the first position deviation data so as to grab the target part to a third position; controlling the welding robot to determine second position deviation data of the target part according to the position information of the target part; transmitting the second position deviation data to the transfer robot; and controlling the conveying robot to convey the target part to the target position according to the second position deviation data.

title_en: Intelligent flexible clamping jaw mechanism for angle steel section bar
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent flexible clamping jaw mechanism of an angle steel section bar, which comprises a mounting frame, a telescopic component, a floating component and a magnetic attraction device, wherein a plurality of hanging rods are fixedly arranged at the bottom of the mounting frame, the telescopic component comprises a locking air cylinder, a supporting plate, locking blocks and locking ends, the supporting plate is fixedly connected with the bottoms of the hanging rods, the locking air cylinders are symmetrically arranged at two sides of the upper surface of the supporting plate, the locking air cylinder is connected with one end of the locking blocks through telescopic rods, the other end of the locking blocks is connected with the locking ends in a clamping manner, the floating component comprises a floating plate, a sliding rod, a limiting plate and a floating spring, two side surfaces of the floating plate are fixedly connected with the bottoms of the locking ends, the sliding rod is arranged on two sides of the floating plate in a sliding penetrating manner, the limiting plate is fixedly connected with one end of the sliding rod, the structure is flexible and stable, the grabbing precision is high, and the labor intensity is reduced.

title_en: Electric pressurizing and cooling device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric pressurizing and cooling device which comprises a beer barrel body, wherein a top wine discharge valve is fixedly arranged at the top of the beer barrel body, a dip tube is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the top wine discharge valve, a pressing seat is sleeved at the top end of the top wine discharge valve, a wine outlet pipe is fixedly arranged on the side face of the pressing seat, a gas cylinder is fixedly arranged at the bottom end inside the beer barrel body, a pressure release device is fixedly arranged at the top end of the gas cylinder, the pressure release device consists of a second valve, a transmission rod, an electromagnetic valve, a pressure sensor and a power supply, and the second valve is fixedly arranged at the top of the gas cylinder. According to the invention, the pressure release device is arranged at the top end of the gas cylinder, the pressure release device controls the opening and closing of the electromagnetic valve through the pressure sensor, and the gas in the gas cylinder can be discharged or closed through the opening and closing of the electromagnetic valve, so that the pressure in the beer barrel can be rapidly increased, the pressure in the beer barrel can be ensured to meet the condition of beer drawing, and the influence on the beer storage and drawing in the beer barrel due to the change of the pressure is avoided.

title_en: Rope driving power device and rehabilitation assistance robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a rope driving power device which comprises a driving wheel unit, a driving mechanism, a unidirectional wheel unit, a follower wheel unit, a base and a traction rope, wherein the driving wheel unit is connected with the unidirectional wheel unit; the driving wheel unit comprises a driving wheel used for winding the traction rope and a first friction wheel which is coaxially arranged with the driving wheel and only rotates unidirectionally along the rope releasing direction; the driving mechanism is connected to the driving wheel unit and used for driving the driving wheel unit to rotate; the unidirectional wheel unit comprises a unidirectional wheel which can rotate unidirectionally along the rope collecting direction along with the driving wheel so as to enable the traction rope to be collected; the follower wheel unit comprises a second friction wheel which is used for simultaneously and unidirectionally rotating along with the first friction wheel so as to squeeze the traction rope and enable the traction rope to be pulled out; one end of the traction rope is fixed on the driving wheel, and the other end of the traction rope is wound out from the other side of the unidirectional wheel and can penetrate out along the space between the first friction wheel and the second friction wheel. The rope driving power device and the rehabilitation assisting robot provided by the invention can realize the winding and unwinding of the traction rope, and are simple and compact in integral structure and low in cost.

title_en: Intelligent grabbing material handling robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent grabbing material handling robot, and belongs to the technical field of automatic production. An intelligent grabbing material handling robot comprises a mechanical structure and a control system, and further comprises  ：  The four groups of omnidirectional wheels are rotatably connected below the robot chassis by a mounting shaft and fixedly connected with an output shaft of the direct-current gear motor; the utility model has ingenious arrangement of the omni-directional wheels, almost can replace the Mecanum wheel in practical application, adopts symmetrical design, is formed by combining a parallelogram and a triangle, can realize flat taking and flat placing, does not cause inverted shaking to materials to the maximum extent, can intelligently identify and grasp, can identify colors, two-dimensional codes and bar codes by a robot camera, and can be used for following tasksThe grabbing materials are sequentially placed in the corresponding material frames fixed on the chassis, and in addition, the camera of the robot is installed behind the mechanical claw, so that the grabbing can be realized, and the situation that sundries at the low position shelter the camera is avoided.

title_en: Double-station loading station based on flexible manufacturing system and operation method
abstract_en: A double-station loading station based on a flexible manufacturing system and an operation method thereof are provided, wherein the double-station loading station mainly comprises a protection component, a material changing door, a drawer type loading station and a man-machine interaction system. The protection component plays a role in appearance and protection; the material changing door is provided with a safety door lock, so that misoperation of personnel is prevented; the drawer type loading station can realize the process of manually pulling out and feeding and pushing in the material grabbing process of the manipulator, and a positioning and detecting mechanism is designed at the corresponding limit position. The man-machine interaction system controls the opening and closing of the door and the clamping or loosening of the air chuck; the two drawer loading stations are mutually independent and are not influenced, can be used alternately, can accelerate the material changing speed, can reduce the waiting time of the mechanical arm, and can improve the working efficiency of equipment. The invention can also realize the continuous production of workpieces without stopping the material replacement, and fully exert the performance of the flexible manufacturing system.

title_en: Swab stripping device and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a swab stripping device, which comprises a feeding mechanism, a pressing mechanism and a stripping mechanism, wherein the feeding mechanism comprises a conveying belt, a positioning protrusion for positioning a swab packaging bag is arranged on the conveying belt, the pressing mechanism is arranged at the outlet end of the feeding mechanism and is arranged to be capable of pressing and positioning the swab packaging bag, and the stripping mechanism is arranged to be capable of impacting towards the end of a swab in the pressed swab packaging bag and ejecting the swab from the swab packaging bag. The swab stripping device solves the problems that continuous jamming is easy to occur and packaging is easy to damage when the swab is impacted, and the feeding continuity and the integrity are good, and the stability of the swab is good in the stripping process.

title_en: Multidirectional swing conveying equipment
abstract_en: The multidirectional swinging conveying equipment comprises a chassis, an encapsulation roller module, a power module and a transmission module, wherein a fixed bottom plate is arranged on the chassis, the encapsulation roller module comprises a roller mounting bracket, the lower surface of the roller mounting bracket is connected with a rotating shaft, a constant-height screw is connected below the rotating shaft through a first crank connecting rod, a fixed panel is arranged on the roller mounting bracket, an electric roller and the encapsulation roller are arranged in an inner cavity of the roller mounting bracket, the power module comprises a motor fixing seat, a servo motor and a speed reducer are arranged below the motor fixing seat, an output shaft of the speed reducer is connected with a rotating pin shaft through a second crank connecting rod, the transmission module comprises a connecting long plate and a connecting short plate, the surface of the connecting short plate is connected with the rotating pin shaft through a first connecting sleeve, a plurality of connecting blocks are arranged on the connecting long plate, and each connecting block is connected with the constant-height screw through a second connecting sleeve. The invention overcomes the defects of the prior art, not only can realize the purpose of conveying in different directions, but also greatly saves the occupied area and the cost.

title_en: Y-axis double-stroke mechanism and wafer carrying device
abstract_en: The application provides a Y axle double stroke mechanism and wafer handling device relates to semiconductor field technical field. The mechanism comprises: the device comprises a substrate, a Y-axis electric cylinder, a telescopic assembly, a conveying assembly and a Y-axis sucker; the Y-axis electric cylinder is fixed on the base plate, the telescopic component is connected to the Y-axis electric cylinder in a sliding way, and the Y-axis electric cylinder is used for pushing the telescopic component to advance or retreat; one end of the conveying component is fixedly connected with the substrate, the other end of the conveying component is fixedly connected with the Y-axis sucker, and the conveying component is movably arranged on the telescopic component through a fixed piece on the telescopic component; the Y-axis sucker is slidably arranged on the telescopic component; wherein, the transmission assembly, the telescopic assembly and the Y-axis sucker form a movable pulley motion model. The mechanism expands the pushing distance of the Y-axis electric cylinder by 2 times based on a movable pulley motion model formed by the conveying assembly, the telescopic assembly and the Y-axis sucker, realizes double-stroke telescopic operation, and solves the problem that the conventional device cannot smoothly convey wafers in a narrow space range.

title_en: Multi-agent deep reinforcement learning-based five-finger smart robot control method
abstract_en: The invention provides a five-finger smart robot control method based on multi-agent deep reinforcement learning. Considering a five-finger smart robot with the same size and structure as a human hand, an object placed on a desktop is arranged in a scene, and five fingers, a wrist and an arm are regarded as independent intelligent bodies to respectively train and work separately and cooperate with each other, so that the task of grabbing the object is finally completed. According to the invention, the cooperative relation of all joints of the robot is considered, the whole grabbing process is further refined and refined on the premise of ensuring that the robot finishes the task of grabbing objects by the multi-agent method, so that the grabbing action of the robot is more close to an ideal posture, all fingers are more flexible and free, and the detail grabbing action which cannot be finished by more single agents is finished. Meanwhile, the invention can effectively learn the task of grabbing objects without a data set, lightens the burden of collecting a large amount of data, and improves the adaptability of the five fingers of the machine to strange objects and environments.

title_en: Constant tension control unit for cable
abstract_en: The cable constant tension control unit comprises a winding drum assembly, a sliding table, a main support module, an auxiliary support module, a spring adjusting module, a driving roller group and a vertical roller group, wherein the main support module comprises an upper plate, two side plates and a bottom plate; the auxiliary bracket module comprises a frame body, an upper extension plate and a lower extension plate; the spring adjusting module comprises a spring rod, a spring, a top plate, a left vertical plate, a right vertical plate, a square ring, a supporting plate, a supporting part and a balancing weight; the winding drum assembly is fixed on the underframe, one end of a connecting frame is fixed on the underframe, the connecting frame is obliquely arranged, the other end of the connecting frame is connected with the sliding table, the main support module is arranged above the sliding table, and the main support module can move along the sliding table.

title_en: Battery conveying structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a battery conveying structure which comprises a feeding and discharging tray mechanism for conveying trays, a caching mechanism for caching the trays, a lifting mechanism for lifting the trays, a battery clamping position for clamping the full trays and a transfer mechanism for recycling the empty trays, wherein the battery clamping position is sequentially arranged. The charging tray can be in the battery transport structure internal circulation transmission, and the charging tray that bears the battery is pressed from both sides and is got the position by fixture and press from both sides and get the operation at the battery clamp, accomplishes and presss from both sides and get the operation back, and the charging tray gets into transfer mechanism, and transfer mechanism is with the reverse business turn over charging tray mechanism of passing into, and the in-process of empty charging tray transmission, and the charging tray that bears the battery follow-up still is constantly carried to the battery clamp and is got the position, can two-way transportation charging tray simultaneously.

title_en: Tubular product garbage collection mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a tubular product garbage collection mechanism belongs to the technical field of construction waste, it includes the collection box, place the board has been set firmly in the inside of collection box, place the board and run through and offered a plurality of and place the hole, the collection box is being provided with movable chamber in the below of placing the board, the activity intracavity is provided with the movable plate, the last table of movable plate has set firmly a plurality of and places the ejector pad of hole grafting adaptation, the ejector pad inserts the bottom of placing the hole with the top of placing hole one-to-one and ejector pad, be provided with the mobile device who is used for driving the movable plate and remove between the interior bottom wall of movable plate and collection box, be provided with a plurality of push pedal that assemble in the inside of collection box, be provided with the aggregate unit that is used for driving to assemble the push pedal and is close to or keep away from towards the collection box middle part between the push pedal. The application has the effect of reducing the potential safety hazard of tubular product waste material when storing.

title_en: Ternary power lithium battery electrolyte packaging equipment and method
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of lithium battery electrolyte, and discloses ternary power lithium battery electrolyte packaging equipment and a ternary power lithium battery electrolyte packaging method, wherein the ternary power lithium battery electrolyte packaging equipment comprises: a push rod; a rotating rod; a brake assembly; when electrolyte is conveyed to the barrel body through the feeding pipe, the electrolyte flow in the feeding pipe impacts the push rod to enable the push rod to overturn downwards, the push rod brakes the rotating assembly through the braking assembly, and then the rotating assembly cannot drive the rotating rods to rotate in a reciprocating mode; the feeding pipe has no circulating electrolyte, and the push rod is reset through the brake component, namely the push rod is turned upwards, so that the brake component releases the brake to the rotating component, the rotating component continuously drives the rotating rod at the highest point and drives the reciprocating rotation of the rest rotating rods, the electrolyte in the barrel is continuously stirred, the activity of the electrolyte is kept, and therefore the stirring of the electrolyte in the barrel can be stopped when feeding is realized, the electrolyte is prevented from splashing, and meanwhile, the driving cost is reduced.

title_en: Constant-temperature conveying equipment for wire production and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of conveying equipment, in particular to constant-temperature conveying equipment for wire production and a using method thereof, wherein the constant-temperature conveying equipment comprises an installation table and adjustable wire compacting and conveying components which are arranged on two sides of the periphery of the installation table; the storage bin is fixedly arranged on one side in the mounting groove, and a viscous heat-insulating material is arranged in the storage bin; the heat supply and material conveying component is arranged on the other side of the inside of the mounting groove; the overturning adjusting assembly is arranged at the bottom end of the periphery of the mounting table; through the heat supply material conveying subassembly that is equipped with in the mounting groove for inside viscidity insulating material of storage silo can transmit to the ejection of compact cover in with the help of the conveyer pipe, can make viscidity insulating material coating to electric wire periphery with the help of the effect of exerting pressure of elasticity restoring piece, the upset adjusting part that the cooperation was equipped with in the mount table simultaneously can switch the position angle of mount table, and then makes viscidity insulating material can evenly distributed to electric wire periphery, thereby plays and carries out thermal-insulated effect to electric wire transportation in-process.

title_en: Unmanned intelligent recognition device
abstract_en: The invention provides an unmanned intelligent recognition device, which belongs to the technical field of intelligent recognition and comprises a plurality of front side transverse rails and a plurality of front side longitudinal rails, wherein the front side transverse rails are respectively arranged on the front end surfaces of a plurality of shelf laminates, the front side longitudinal rails are respectively arranged on the front end surfaces of a shelf front side longitudinal beam, and are sequentially connected with two adjacent front side transverse rails end to form a front S-shaped rail, a front moving trolley is arranged on the front S-shaped rail in a sliding manner, a rotating part is arranged on the front moving trolley, a camera is arranged at the end part of the rotating part, and the rotating part is used for driving the camera to rotate above the front side transverse rails where the front moving trolley is arranged. According to the unmanned intelligent recognition device provided by the invention, the mobile trolley can automatically check the articles on the whole goods shelf sequentially through the front S-shaped track, so that the manual work is replaced, the inventory efficiency of the articles on the goods shelf is improved, and the accuracy of the inventory of the articles is ensured.

title_en: Waste storage device and method for single crystal silicon rod production
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of single crystal silicon rod waste storage, and provides a waste storage device for single crystal silicon rod production, which is used for storing conical leftover materials cut from the head and the tail of a single crystal silicon rod, and comprises a frame, a material sorting and conveying mechanism, a mechanical arm and a storage frame, wherein the material sorting and conveying mechanism is arranged on the frame and is connected with single crystal silicon rod cutting equipment, the material sorting and conveying mechanism is used for conveying the conical leftover materials and adjusting the posture of the conical leftover materials, the storage frame is positioned at the output end of the material sorting and conveying mechanism, the mechanical arm is arranged on the frame, and the execution end of the mechanical arm grabs the storage frame; the storage rack is provided with an upper layer plate and a lower layer plate, the upper layer plate is provided with a plurality of through holes, the lower layer plate is provided with a plurality of clamping grooves, and the through holes and the clamping grooves are distributed in a staggered mode. Through above-mentioned technical scheme, the waste material shape is special among the prior art, discharges messy, occupation space's problem during the storage has been solved.

title_en: Automatic splicing device for adhesive tape of case sealer
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic adhesive tape splicing device of a box sealing machine, wherein adhesive tape seat support plates are respectively fixed at the left end and the right end of the back of a fixed bottom plate, adhesive tape seats are respectively installed at the top ends of the two adhesive tape seat support plates, a plurality of auxiliary rollers are symmetrically installed on the right side and the left side of the front of the fixed bottom plate, a tape cutting cylinder and an adhesive tape splicing cylinder are respectively installed at the positions, corresponding to the two adhesive tape seat positions, of the front of the fixed bottom plate, the two tape cutting cylinders are respectively positioned above and at the rear positions of the two adhesive tape splicing cylinders, adhesive tape cutters are respectively fixed at the front ends of the two adhesive tape splicing cylinders, adhesive tape splicing splints are respectively fixed at the front of the two adhesive tape cutters on the fixed bottom plate. According to the automatic adhesive tape splicing device, the adhesive tape cutting and splicing are realized through the adhesive tape cutting cylinder and the adhesive tape splicing cylinder, so that the automatic adhesive tape splicing function is realized, the adhesive tape replacement is more convenient, the working efficiency is improved, and the labor capacity is reduced.

title_en: Big data-based die casting production data transmission system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of die casting production, in particular to a die casting production data transmission system and method based on big data, comprising a die casting data acquisition module, an abnormality index threshold analysis module, a data instruction transmission module, a correction characteristic threshold analysis module and an early warning response module; the die casting data acquisition module is used for acquiring first die casting data in a first cycle process and second die casting data in a second cycle process of the historical die casting production data record; the abnormality index threshold analysis module is used for analyzing an abnormality index threshold of the intelligent robot clamp in the second cycle process; the data instruction transmission module is used for transmitting data instructions of the intelligent robot clamp in the running process according to the abnormality index threshold value; the correction characteristic threshold analysis module is used for analyzing a correction characteristic threshold of the intelligent robot when the intelligent robot returns to the original point; the early warning response module is used for monitoring second die-casting data corresponding to the intelligent robot in the second circulation process in real time and carrying out transmission early warning.

title_en: Offshore rock debris logging observation sample porcelain plate placement device and rock debris observation operation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device for placing a porcelain disc for a marine rock debris logging observation sample and a rock debris observation operation system. The placing device comprises a frame body and a tray, wherein the frame body comprises four supporting legs and a connecting rod connected with the four supporting legs; three tray sliding groove groups are arranged in the frame body, each tray sliding groove group comprises two tray sliding grooves which are oppositely arranged, and the tray is in sliding connection with the two tray sliding grooves in the same group; two sewage plate sliding grooves are also oppositely arranged at the bottom of the frame body, and the sewage plate sliding grooves are connected with the sewage plate in a sliding manner; the support legs comprise three groups of support structures which are connected with each other, and each group of support structures comprises an inner support column and an outer sleeve; the lower part of the inner support column is provided with a raised short column, the side wall of the outer sleeve is vertically provided with a zigzag groove, and the short column is inserted into the zigzag groove; a baffle structure is arranged above each saw tooth of the saw tooth-shaped groove. The method and the device can realize the full-flow operation of on-site cuttings observation, improve the working efficiency and ensure that on-site cuttings logging work is completed smoothly and efficiently.

title_en: Cantilever transportation work vehicle and cantilever transportation method
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to the technical field of wrist arms, in particular to a wrist arm transportation operation vehicle and a wrist arm transportation method. The device comprises an operation platform, a cantilever placing area and a cantilever placing area, wherein the cantilever placing area is used for placing cantilever assemblies in a stacking mode, and the cantilever assemblies comprise a transfer template and a cantilever which is installed and fixed on the transfer template; one side of the operation platform is provided with a track, the grabbing device is movably arranged in the track, and the grabbing device is used for grabbing the wrist arm assembly and placing the wrist arm assembly on the preassembly rack; the preassembling rack is rotationally connected with the operation platform, a grabbing template is arranged on the preassembling rack and used for being in butt joint with the transferring template of the wrist-arm assembly piece so as to enable the operation arm of the wrist-arm installation device to integrally grab and carry out wrist-arm installation operation. Automatic carrying of the cantilever assembly can be achieved through the grabbing device and the rotatable preassembling rack, and the cantilever assembly is placed on the preassembling rack to facilitate positioning of the mechanical arm of the cantilever installation equipment, so that the purposes of automatic cantilever installation, manual participation reduction and cantilever installation efficiency improvement are finally achieved.

title_en: Continuous detection system for gas alarm
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a continuous detection system for a gas alarm, which comprises a workbench, a feeding device, a sound detection device, a sensitivity detection device, a discharging device and a conveying device. According to the utility model, the gas alarm is fixed by arranging the positioning plate and the quick locking device, so that the gas alarm is prevented from being deviated in the conveying process; meanwhile, the grabbing device can smoothly open the rapid locking device, and meanwhile, the rapid locking device can be closed, so that the gas alarm can be grabbed smoothly.

title_en: Elevator equipment management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an elevator equipment management system, which relates to the technical field of elevator management equipment, and comprises an elevator bridge box, wherein a black box for monitoring and managing the running state of an elevator in real time is arranged at the top of the elevator bridge box, radiating fins for radiating are uniformly distributed on two sides of the black box, a dust removing device for removing dust accumulated on the radiating fins is movably arranged on one side of the radiating fins, and a moving device for driving the dust removing device to move back and forth is also arranged on the black box; according to the intelligent black box monitoring system for the elevator, the structure of the existing intelligent black box monitoring system for the elevator is optimized, and the designed mounting frame, the miniature air pump, the first air pipe, the second air pipe, the pneumatic piece and the dust removing piece are matched with each other, so that dust on the radiating fins on the black box can be removed, dust accumulation is prevented, the radiating performance of the radiating fins is improved, and meanwhile, the problems that the dust absorbs moisture and becomes wet, the surface of the black box is not easy to dry and is easy to corrode are also avoided.

title_en: Polytetrafluoroethylene film surface treatment device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of polytetrafluoroethylene films, and discloses a polytetrafluoroethylene film surface treatment device which comprises a base, an assembly plate fixedly arranged on the base, and two discs arranged on the base, wherein one disc is rotatably arranged on the base, the other disc is connected with a transverse movement driving mechanism arranged on the base, and the two discs are provided with clamping mechanisms for fixing a film winding roller; the round roller is movably arranged on the assembly plate and is connected with two groups of elastic telescopic mechanisms arranged on the assembly plate, the rotating shaft of the round roller is connected with a Malta cross movement mechanism arranged on the assembly plate through a transmission mechanism, two guide rollers are rotatably arranged on a base and used for enabling films to be dried to bypass, two drying devices are movably arranged between the two guide rollers, and finally, the function of effectively and automatically drying the films in double sides is realized, the drying device is suitable for drying treatment of films with different specifications, and the comprehensiveness of the drying treatment is ensured.

title_en: Boxing device and boxing method for processing reagent bottles
abstract_en: The invention discloses a boxing device for processing reagent bottles and a boxing method thereof, relates to the technical field of reagent bottle processing, and aims to solve the problems that an existing reagent bottle boxing mechanism can only place one reagent bottle in a material box at a time, and a mechanical gripper needs to reciprocate, so that the efficiency is low. The reagent bottle material boxes are arranged above the belt conveyor, and a plurality of reagent bottle material boxes are arranged; the first bracket is arranged on one side of the belt conveyor, a connecting plate is arranged on the inner wall of the first bracket, one end of the connecting plate is fixedly connected with the belt conveyor, the upper part of the rear end of the connecting plate is fixedly connected with the first bracket through a reinforcing plate, and a avoidance notch is formed between the connecting plate and the first bracket; the feeding mechanism is arranged above the first bracket; the vibration feeding tray discharging guide rail is arranged above the feeding mechanism, two vibration feeding tray discharging guide rails are arranged, and a protective net is arranged at the front end of the vibration feeding tray discharging guide rail.

title_en: Beverage packing bag
abstract_en: The invention provides a beverage packaging bag, and belongs to the technical field of beverage packaging bags. The packaging bag solves the problem of improving the filling speed of the packaging bag while improving the freshness of packaged beverages. The beverage packaging bag comprises a bag body, a connector fixedly connected to the bag body and a bag cover detachably connected with the connector, wherein independent liquid inlet channels and liquid outlet channels are respectively arranged in the connector, a one-way valve for liquid to flow in from outside to inside in a one-way mode is arranged in the liquid inlet channels, a filling opening communicated with an inlet of the one-way valve is arranged on the bag cover, and the bag cover is arranged outside the liquid outlet channels to enable the liquid outlet channels to be closed. The packaging bag is used for filling liquid beverage without disassembling a packaging bag cover, and the filling liquid is not contacted with the outside air all the time in the whole filling process, so that the freshness of packaged beverage is well ensured, and the drinking requirement of a user can be well met; meanwhile, the filling operation speed is high, the waiting time of a user is saved, and the user experience is well improved.

title_en: Electric power tightener
