abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric power maintenance tools, in particular to an electric power tightener, which comprises a mounting plate, a rotating shaft, a rope winding drum, a ratchet wheel, a pawl and a rotating sleeve, wherein the upper side of the mounting plate is fixedly provided with a vertical rotating shaft, and the outer side of the rotating shaft is sleeved with the rope winding drum. The invention has reasonable and compact structure, when in use, one end of the steel wire rope is fixed at the outer side of the rope winding drum, the other end of the steel wire rope is fixedly connected with the wire clamp fixed on the wire, and then the rotating sleeve is rotated to drive the rope winding drum to rotate, so that the steel wire rope is wound at the outer side of the rope winding drum, and then the wire clamp and the wire are pulled to finish the wire tightening operation.

title_en: Automatic weighing and chemical grabbing machine and automatic weighing and chemical grabbing method
abstract_en: The automatic weighing and medicine grabbing machine comprises a rotary medicine cabinet and a medicine grabbing mechanical arm, wherein the rotary medicine cabinet comprises a rotary seat and a rotary cabinet body rotatably arranged on the rotary seat, the rotary cabinet body comprises a plurality of medicine boxes for accommodating different medicines, and the medicine grabbing mechanical arm is used for grabbing medicines in the corresponding medicine boxes according to requirements and comprises a machine base, a grabbing device arranged on the machine base and used for grabbing the medicines, a first driving device connected with the machine base and driving the machine base to move left and right, and a second driving device arranged on the machine base and connected with the grabbing device and used for driving the grabbing device to move up and down.

title_en: Electrode strorage device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electrodes, in particular to an electrode storage device, which comprises a square box body, wherein a cleaning box body is fixedly connected with the center of the inside of the square box body, and a cleaning rotating device is arranged in the cleaning box body and comprises: the cleaning barrel is slidably arranged in the cleaning box body; the cleaning rotary column is arranged in the square box body in a rolling way, and the bottom end of the cleaning rotary column is fixedly connected with cleaning helical teeth; the inner wall of the cleaning barrel is fixedly connected with a plurality of cleaning brushes; the first cleaning cover plate is fixedly arranged at the top end of the cleaning barrel, and cleaning electrode openings are formed in the first cleaning cover plate. The invention completes the cleaning and clamping of the electrode through the cleaning rotating device, completes the storage of the electrode through the conveying device, and can clean and store the electrode after use, thereby maintaining the sensitivity and the service life of the electrode.

title_en: Logistics transfer equipment and logistics system
abstract_en: The application discloses logistics transfer equipment and a logistics system, which relate to the field of logistics transfer and comprise a plurality of conveying tables arranged on a conveying belt, wherein a clamping mechanism is arranged on the conveying tables, a driving piece drives two clamping pieces to be close to or far away from each other, the clamping pieces are used for clamping two sides of a rectangular object, an adjusting mechanism is arranged on the conveying tables, and when the two clamping pieces translate and clamp and separate two sides of the rectangular object in the length direction, the driving piece is matched with a rotating assembly to drive a turntable to rotate for 90 degrees; this commodity circulation transfer equipment and logistics system, when being close to each other through driving piece drive two holders, the gear drives the guide arm and rotates in order to drive the drive belt and rotate, avoids the diagonal of rectangle object on the carousel and two holders centre gripping plane nearly vertically state, then two holders continue to push the rectangle object that is located on the carousel, makes the rectangle object gesture on every transport bench finally keep unanimous to follow-up pile up each rectangle object.

title_en: High-speed single-chip microcomputer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-speed singlechip, in particular to the technical field of singlechips, which adopts a singlechip with a single tool rest to easily burn and burn packaging films and seal the packaging films due to over-high speed and over-high temperature during use, so that the packaging efficiency and the appearance of finished products are reduced.

title_en: Multi-station winding and unwinding device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a multi-station winding and unwinding device, and relates to the field of multi-station winding and unwinding. Aims to solve the problem of complex arrangement of an expansion shaft in a winding and unwinding device. The device comprises a turnover shaft, a plate body, a first expansion shaft, a second expansion shaft, a first sleeve, a second sleeve, a first driving piece and a second driving piece, wherein the plate body is fixed on the turnover shaft, the first expansion shaft and the second expansion shaft are arranged on the plate body, the first sleeve and the second sleeve are respectively and rotatably sleeved on the turnover shaft, the first driving piece, the first sleeve and the first expansion shaft are sequentially in transmission connection, and the second driving piece, the second sleeve and the second expansion shaft are sequentially in transmission connection. The rotary table and the plate body are not required to be arranged at the same time, the rotation and the position exchange of the first expansion shaft and the second expansion shaft can be realized, the structure is simplified, and the problem that the existing winding and unwinding device is required to be independently provided with the rotary table and the plate body is solved.

title_en: Ampoule bottle opening device for nursing department
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of medical treatment, in particular to an ampoule bottle opening device for nursing department. Technical problems: the ampoule bottle opening device for nursing department can simply open the bottle and avoid accidental injury of liquid medicine or glass slag splashed by operators. Including the bottom plate, collect the frame, fixed seat and the body mar mechanism of placing etc. fixed mounting has the frame of collecting on the bottom plate, and fixed mounting has the fixed seat of placing on the bottom plate, is equipped with the body mar mechanism on the fixed seat of placing. The operating personnel pulls the U-shaped pull rod to move, and the U-shaped pull rod moves and drives the sliding groove block and the scribing wheel to move for the breach is drawn to the ampoule bottleneck department of scribing wheel pair ampoule, and the sliding groove block can drive the slip rack and move, and the slip rack moves the swing plate swing and breaks the bottleneck that has the breach with the ampoule from the mar, need not the direct ampoule bottleneck of breaking of operating personnel, reaches the function of opening the ampoule.

title_en: Bagged material packaging and separating system and method
abstract_en: The application discloses a system and a method for packaging and separating bagged materials, and belongs to the technical field of packaging and separating. The application relates to a bagged material packaging and separating system, which comprises a first conveying mechanism and a second conveying mechanism, wherein a cutting assembly is arranged above the first conveying mechanism, a separating assembly is arranged between the first conveying mechanism and the second conveying mechanism, two groups of first screening and discarding assemblies and second screening and discarding assemblies are sequentially arranged above the first conveying mechanism, one side of the outermost second screening and discarding assembly is provided with a rolling assembly.

title_en: Drawer type feeding and discharging device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of automatic equipment, and particularly relates to a drawer type feeding and discharging device and a working method thereof, aiming at solving the problems that the capacity of a storage bin of the existing feeding and discharging device is small, the capacity of a storage bin is enlarged by driving a multi-layer stacking material disc by a motor, and the cost is too high. By arranging the bidirectional slide rail in the drawer component, the feeding and discharging actions of the material disc are realized by means of anthropomorphic push-pull of the mechanical arm, compared with a motor driving mode, the automatic feeding and discharging device is convenient for workers to replace blanks and finished products under the condition of no stop, and the overall cost of the feeding and discharging device is effectively reduced, so that the automatic feeding and discharging device is beneficial to technical popularization and application; the tray in the drawer assembly is accurately positioned through the signals of the real-time monitoring sensor, the intelligent degree and the automation degree are high, and the problem that the operation path of the mechanical arm is interfered by the fact that the mechanical arm is empty and the barrier is arranged above the tray to be pulled out due to the fact that the tray is not positioned in the cabinet body is avoided.

title_en: Horizontal screw conveyor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a horizontal screw conveyor, which comprises a conveying pipe, wherein a screw rod is arranged in the conveying pipe, one end of the screw rod is connected with the driving end of a first motor, a feed chute is arranged on the upper side of one end of the conveying pipe, a screening mechanism is arranged above the feed chute, the feed chute is used for receiving materials which are qualified in screening, a crushing mechanism is arranged beside the screening mechanism and used for crushing the materials which are unqualified in screening, and a discharge hole of the crushing mechanism is communicated with a discharge hole of the screening mechanism through the conveying mechanism. The horizontal screw conveyor is used for separating impurities, eliminating uneven and large-particle materials and detecting whether the horizontal screw conveyor is blocked or not.

title_en: Stability control method for metamorphic robot reconstruction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a stability control method for metamorphic robot reconstruction, which comprises the following steps: 1. generating expected tracks of all joints in the reconstruction process of the metamorphic robot; 2. the deviation between the expected track and the actual track of the joints and the quenching and tempering core sliding blocks is input into a sliding mode controller, and the actual required moment of the motion of each joint and the quenching and tempering core sliding blocks in the reconstruction process is calculated and output; 3. inputting actual required moment of the motion of each joint and the quenching and tempering core sliding block in the reconstruction process into a dynamic model to obtain actual tracks of each joint and the quenching and tempering core sliding block; 4. and calculating the actual value of the metamorphic robot ZMP by utilizing the actual track of the motion of each joint and the quenching and tempering core sliding block, and feeding back the actual value to the fuzzy PID control module to form upper closed-loop control of stability. The invention can realize that the actual ZMP position of the whole vehicle approaches to the theoretical reference position, thereby improving the stability of the system during reconstruction.

title_en: Medical gauze stacking and binding integrated machine
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of medical supplies production equipment, in particular to a medical gauze stacking and binding integrated machine, which comprises a self-adaptive folding and binding machine for folding gauze, wherein the self-adaptive folding and binding machine comprises a fixed mounting table, a fixed adjusting seat is arranged on the fixed mounting table, a guide mounting frame is arranged on the fixed adjusting seat, a movable adjusting seat is arranged on the guide mounting frame, a first linear driver is also arranged on the guide mounting frame, the output end of the first linear driver is fixedly connected with the movable adjusting seat, binding guide devices are arranged on the fixed adjusting seat and the movable adjusting seat, a welding device, a cutting knife and a binding sensor are arranged at the bottom of the binding guide device, a stacking and pushing device is arranged at the side part of the feeding end of the binding guide device, a movable stripping device is arranged at the discharging end of the binding guide device, and a binding conveying device is arranged below the binding guide device.

title_en: Standing arrangement mechanism for steel plate conveying and stacking
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lifting arrangement mechanism for steel plate conveying and stacking, which comprises a first conveying belt, a second conveying belt, a turnover mechanism and a positioning mechanism, wherein the first conveying belt is used for conveying flat steel plates, the first conveying belt is used for conveying the flat steel plates, the second conveying belt is arranged on the right side of the first conveying belt and is used for conveying the lifted steel plates, the turnover mechanism is arranged between the first conveying belt and the second conveying belt and is used for turning the steel plates by 90 degrees, the positioning mechanism is arranged at the right end of the first conveying belt and is used for positioning the steel plates, the first conveying belt continuously conveys the steel plates to the right, the turnover mechanism turns the flat steel plates by 90 degrees to be lifted, the flat steel plates are placed on the second conveying belt, and the second conveying belt conveys the steel plates to the right at intervals, so that the steel plates can be automatically lifted.

title_en: Hydraulic lifting type freight cableway portal frame erecting device and application method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a hydraulic lifting type freight cableway portal frame erecting device and a using method thereof, wherein the device comprises a hydraulic lifting device and a position adjusting device, and the hydraulic lifting device is arranged on the position adjusting device; the hydraulic lifting device comprises a frame and a lifting assembly, wherein the lifting assembly comprises: the clamping device comprises a first clamp, a second clamp, a third clamp and a first hydraulic cylinder; according to the application, the hydraulic lifting device is driven to move through the position adjusting device, and the lifting of the landing leg of the door frame is realized through the hydraulic lifting device, so that a door frame erecting method from top to bottom is adopted in actual use, the door frame cross beam is firstly connected with the upper end of the landing leg of the door frame, then the erected cableway door frame is lifted through the erecting device, the subsequent door frame landing leg connection is carried out, the door frame erecting time of the freight cableway can be shortened, and the standardized and standardized technology of the freight cableway erecting operation is developed to a certain extent.

title_en: Belt conveyor, belt damping method and device thereof, electronic equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a belt conveyor, a belt damping method and device thereof, electronic equipment and a readable storage medium, and is applied to the technical field of material transportation. The belt conveyor is provided with a plurality of damping devices with the same structure, and each damping device is arranged between two lower bracket cross beams of the belt conveyor and penetrates through the lower conveying belt. Each set of damping device comprises a fixing part, an upper cross rod and a lower cross rod, the upper cross rod and the lower cross rod fix a lower conveying belt between the upper cross rod and the lower cross rod through the fixing parts, and a plurality of belt vibration pressing parts are arranged on the upper cross rod and the lower cross rod. The elastic connecting piece of fixed part sets up in the below of bottom rail, and the height of elastic connecting piece is confirmed according to the lateral load of the lower conveyor belt of each damping device mounted position department, makes the belt vibrations suppression spare of bottom rail promote the belt vibrations suppression spare contact of lower conveyor belt and last horizontal pole through the pretightning force. The application can effectively lighten the vibration of the belt without causing serious belt abrasion.

title_en: Overload monitoring equipment and method based on power load monitoring
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power load monitoring, in particular to overload monitoring equipment and a method thereof based on power load monitoring, wherein the monitoring equipment comprises a main support, universal wheels are arranged at the bottom of the main support, an operation table is arranged at the top of the main support, a first interface is arranged at one side of the top of the operation table, and a second interface is arranged at the other side of the top of the operation table; the top of the operating table is provided with a glasses-shaped groove, and the front side and the rear side of the glasses-shaped groove are provided with semicircular grooves; according to the invention, the monitoring line device is quickly moved out of the operation table, the wound cable is quickly separated, then the monitoring line device is rotated for 90 degrees to align the two semicircular grooves, so that the monitoring of the power load is realized, then the monitoring line device can quickly wind up the cable, the quick storage of the monitoring line device is realized, and finally the monitoring line device is sealed in the operation table through the cover plate, so that the corrosion is reduced, and the follow-up monitoring accuracy is improved.

title_en: Modular cutting machine for curtain production
abstract_en: The invention discloses a curtain production modularized cutting machine, which comprises a module limiting treatment structure and a curtain, wherein the curtain is arranged at the transverse position of the module limiting treatment structure, the curtain is arranged on the module limiting treatment structure in a sliding mode, the module limiting treatment structure is used for limiting the curtain and facilitating subsequent cutting, the module limiting treatment structure comprises an adjusting smooth part and an adjusting tensioning part, the adjusting smooth part and the adjusting smooth part are arranged in a rotating adjusting mode, the adjusting tensioning part can be adjusted through the bottom rotation of the adjusting smooth part, the adjusting smooth part comprises a smooth treatment part, a tray, a first motor and a driving fluted disc, the side end of the tray is fixedly connected with the first motor, and the driving fluted disc is fixedly connected with the first motor. The invention discloses a modularized cutting machine for curtain production, which realizes the purpose of limiting a curtain by arranging a module limiting processing structure and is convenient for subsequent cutting.

title_en: Dirt cleaning device for oil storage tank of oil field
abstract_en: The invention relates to a device for cleaning oil storage tanks of an oil field, which comprises an engineering vehicle, wherein a crane arm is arranged on the engineering vehicle and is hinged with the engineering vehicle, and the crane arm can swing in the vertical direction relative to the engineering vehicle; the lifting arm is hinged with the adjusting arm, and the adjusting arm can swing in the vertical direction and the horizontal direction relative to the lifting arm; the adjusting arm is connected with the working arm, the working arm is provided with a high-pressure spray head and a recovery pump, the high-pressure spray head can spray high-pressure water to clean the oil sludge in the oil storage tank, the recovery pump is connected with a drain pipe, and the drain outlet of the drain pipe is arranged on the outer side of the oil storage tank. According to the oil field oil storage tank dirt cleaning device, the lifting arm and the adjusting arm are arranged, so that the working arm can flexibly move in the vertical and horizontal directions, dirt cleaning without dead angles is realized, and the cleaned oil sludge is discharged in real time by matching with the hydraulic slurry pump, so that the dirt cleaning efficiency is high; the whole equipment adopts hydraulic control, realizes electroless work in the oil storage tank, and greatly improves the safety of the dirt cleaning work.

title_en: Test tube feeding device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a test tube feeding device which comprises a baffle plate and a feeding cup which moves back and forth on the baffle plate, wherein a discharging opening is arranged on the baffle plate on the moving path of the feeding cup, the feeding cup is provided with a cavity structure for correcting the azimuth of a test tube, and the feeding cup moves to enable the cavity structure to be opposite to the discharging opening so that the test tube can pass through the discharging opening to guide materials along the vertical direction. According to the invention, the test tube feeding device can be used for feeding a plurality of guide grooves, so that the test tubes of the guide grooves at different positions can be fed from the feeding port in the vertical direction, and can be matched with the feeding end of the labeling mechanism, and the feeding device provided by the invention can be used for feeding any number of guide grooves and feeding the labeling mechanism.

title_en: Storage warehouse
abstract_en: The present invention provides a storage, comprising: a storage chamber for storing articles; a partition plate provided so as to be movable in a direction along an inner wall of the storage chamber, the partition plate partitioning the storage chamber into a plurality of rooms; and a temperature adjusting device provided so as to be movable in the direction along the inner wall, the plurality of rooms being adjusted to different temperatures. The temperature adjusting device moves in the direction in conjunction with the movement of the partition plate, for example. For example, the partition plate may be provided so as to be movable between a 1 st position at which the partition plate is received along the inner wall and a 2 nd position at which the partition plate partitions the storage chamber into the plurality of rooms, and the temperature adjustment device may move in the direction in conjunction with the movement of the partition plate between the 1 st position and the 2 nd position.

title_en: Grabbing device for special-shaped workpieces
abstract_en: The invention discloses a grabbing device for a special-shaped workpiece, which comprises a fixing frame, wherein a plurality of grabbing structures are arranged on the fixing frame, each grabbing structure comprises a grabbing component and a locking component, each grabbing component comprises locking bars and grabbing blocks, the locking bars are fixedly connected with each other, each grabbing block is used for contacting with the surface of the workpiece and grabbing the workpiece, each locking bar can slide relative to the fixing frame so as to drive the grabbing blocks to slide to contact with the surface of the workpiece and grab the workpiece, each locking component comprises a plurality of locking blocks, the locking blocks are arranged along the circumferential direction of each locking bar, and the locking bars are mutually close to or far away from each other so as to lock or release the sliding of the locking bars relative to the fixing frame. According to the invention, the locking blocks in each grabbing structure can independently slide relative to the fixing frame, so that each grabbing block can slide to a position contacting with the surface of a workpiece, and further, all grabbing blocks can provide grabbing force, and the grabbing force and stability of the workpiece on an uneven surface are enhanced.

title_en: Beef processing detects sample storage facilities
abstract_en: The invention provides beef processing detection sample storage equipment, which belongs to the technical field of beef detection and comprises a sample storage box, and is characterized in that a sample storage pipe is arranged in the sample storage box, a baffle seat is integrally arranged on the middle lower side of the inside of the sample storage pipe, a connecting column is slidably arranged in the middle of the baffle seat, bulges are arranged on two sides of the connecting column, grooves matched with the bulges are respectively formed in the left side and the right side of the inside of the baffle seat, and an upper piston seat and a lower piston seat are respectively integrally arranged at the upper end and the lower end of the connecting column. The arrangement of the upper partition plate, the lower cavity, the cold air cavity, the sample storage tube, the baffle seat, the connecting column, the upper piston seat, the lower piston seat and the air valve is beneficial to reducing the loss of cold air when the beef sample test tube is taken, and improves the fresh-keeping effect.

title_en: Mining wind speed sensor cable hanging device
abstract_en: The application relates to a mining wind speed sensor hanging device, which relates to the technical field of coal mine safety monitoring and comprises a hanging vehicle, a wind speed sensor, a moving assembly, a mounting assembly and a driving assembly, wherein the hanging vehicle comprises a frame and universal wheels, and the universal wheels are fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the frame; the wind speed sensor is positioned on the frame and is used for detecting the wind speed change in the mine tunnel; the moving assembly is positioned on the frame and is used for driving the wind speed sensor to move; the mounting assembly is positioned on the frame and is used for mounting the wind speed sensor to the side wall of the mine tunnel; the driving assembly is positioned on the frame and used for driving the mounting assembly to work. The mining wind speed sensor has the effect of being easy to hang.

title_en: Control loop electrification alarm device
abstract_en: The application discloses a control loop electrification alarm device, which relates to the technical field of electric power detection and comprises a shell, wherein a detector is arranged at the top of the shell, an indicator lamp and a loudspeaker are respectively arranged at the top of one side of the shell in parallel, an outlet is arranged at the bottom of one side of a short side of the shell, a winding reel is arranged in the shell, a detection line is wound on the outer wall of the winding reel, an arc cavity is formed in one side of the winding reel, a fixed groove is formed in the top of the arc cavity, a central bulge of the other side of the winding reel is connected with the inner wall of the shell, a running plate is connected with the circular center of the arc cavity, a fixed cavity is arranged in one part of the circular outer wall of the running plate, a running cavity, a hollow tube and a fixed rod are arranged in the fixed cavity, one end of the fixed rod extends out of the circular outer wall of the running plate, the other side of the running plate is connected with a rotating motor, and one end of the rotating motor penetrates through the outer wall of one side of the shell. After detecting whether safety to the control circuit, through dead lever fixed operation board and reel, the motor is automatic retrieves the detection line, reduces artifical arrangement time, improves work efficiency.

title_en: Metering pushing device for packaging disposable plastic cups and packaging method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to a metering and pushing device, in particular to a metering and pushing device for packaging disposable plastic cups and a packaging method thereof. The utility model provides a disposable plastics cup is metering pusher for packing, includes material conveying platform, disposable plastics cup, conveyer belt and passage, still includes lead screw, carriage, metering slide bar, connecting plate and arc plectrum etc.. According to the application, the position of the trigger plate is moved by sliding the connecting plate back and forth along the metering slide rod, the number of disposable plastic cups to be packaged can be regulated, the sliding frame can be driven to slide back and forth along the upper end face of the material guiding pipe by controlling the forward and backward rotation of the screw rod, the sliding frame and the arc-shaped shifting sheet on the mounting frame can be driven to move back and forth to push the disposable plastic cups, the forefront disposable plastic cups can be blocked at the discharge hole through the extrusion pad, so that the arc-shaped shifting sheet can push and extrude the preset number of disposable plastic cups to be packaged together forward, and then the disposable plastic cups are sent into the packaging machine for packaging, and the production efficiency of the plastic cups is improved.

title_en: Packaging bag operation module of packaging machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of packaging equipment, and discloses a packaging bag operation module of a packaging machine, which comprises a module base body moving along a preset path of the packaging machine, at least two clamping mechanisms and a blanking and bag opening mechanism; the clamping mechanism is arranged on the module base body and comprises a first retaining piece and a second retaining piece which can move relatively, and the first retaining piece and the second retaining piece are respectively used for clamping two side sides of the packaging bag; the blanking and bag opening mechanism is arranged on the module substrate and is used for driving all the clamping mechanisms to synchronously switch between a bag expanding state and a bag contracting state; in the bag-expanding state, a first distance is arranged between the first retaining piece and the second retaining piece; in the contracted state, a second distance is provided between the first and second holders, the second distance being smaller than the first distance. The invention can provide higher synchronism when a plurality of packaging bags are operated simultaneously, and effectively avoid hidden danger of material leakage.

title_en: Joint axis self-alignment hand exoskeleton assisting multi-finger unfolding, folding and stretching
abstract_en: An assisting multi-finger unfolding and folding and extending joint axis self-alignment hand exoskeleton relates to the technical field of rehabilitation medical appliances. The invention aims to solve the problems that the hand exoskeleton with the joint axis self-alignment design can not realize four-finger simultaneous large-range abduction/adduction movement in the prior art, and the hand exoskeleton with the bowden cable remote drive design has the problem that the wire sleeve of the bowden cable independently driving the PIP joint interferes with finger movement. The invention comprises a thumb, an index finger, a middle finger, a ring finger, a little finger, a thumb transmission assembly, an index finger transmission assembly, a middle finger transmission assembly, a ring finger transmission assembly, a little finger transmission assembly, a base assembly and a far-end motor driving assembly, wherein the far-end motor driving assembly drives the thumb transmission assembly, the index finger transmission assembly, the middle finger transmission assembly, the ring finger transmission assembly and the little finger transmission assembly through bowden wires respectively to realize the extension, retraction and extension of the thumb, the index finger, the middle finger, the ring finger and the little finger. The invention is used for hand rehabilitation training.

title_en: Taking-out device for quantitative batch of NdFeB waste
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of recovery devices, and discloses a device for quantitatively taking out neodymium iron boron wastes in batches, which comprises a conveying belt wheel, wherein the outer side of the conveying belt wheel is connected with the conveying belt in a sliding manner, the conveying belt wheel is symmetrically arranged in the conveying belt, attraction components for sorting the neodymium iron boron wastes according to magnetism are arranged in the conveying belt, the magnetic neodymium iron boron wastes are piled in a quantitative hopper through the cooperation of a quantitative device structure and a feeding device structure, the quantitative hopper moves downwards to pour quantitative magnetic neodymium iron boron wastes, the non-magnetic neodymium iron boron wastes in the quantitative hopper move upwards to reduce the quality and return, and the magnetic neodymium iron boron wastes are continuously collected, so that the effect of quantitatively collecting the magnetic neodymium iron boron wastes is achieved, the weighing function is replaced, the effect of pouring the magnetic neodymium iron boron wastes in batches is realized, the whole machine replaces weighing, the huge manpower consumption for manual sorting is reduced, the time for manual sorting is shortened, and the working efficiency is accelerated.

title_en: Full-automatic fpc feeding system
abstract_en: The invention provides a full-automatic fpc feeding system, which relates to the technical field of fpc later-stage preparation processes and comprises the following components: the conveying device comprises a conveying channel, wherein two sides of the top of the conveying channel are of convex edge structures, a main conveying belt is rotatably arranged in the middle of the top of the conveying channel, and the main conveying belt is driven by a motor; a pushing sliding frame with a pulley structure in the middle is fixedly arranged outside the main conveying belt; two rows of through holes are also formed at the top edge of the conveying channel; the feeding frame is arranged to provide an automatic positioning feeding function, the fixed material plates are adsorbed and fixed by the electromagnet, then the uppermost fixed material plate is lifted, then the first electric cylinder is contracted to move the feeding frame backwards, the fixed material plates are moved to the position above the front end of the conveying channel, and then the steps are repeated to place the fixed material plate at the top of the main conveying belt, the feeding is continuously carried out by repeating the steps, the tedious repeated placement of workers is not needed, the automatic feeding can be realized, and the problem that the existing feeding system lacks an automatic feeding structure is solved.

title_en: High-speed rail-mounted type inspection robot vision system anti-shake device
abstract_en: The invention relates to an anti-shake device of a visual system of a high-speed rail-mounted inspection robot, which comprises a top plate, a linear module and a sliding rail, wherein an adjusting structure and a mounting mechanism are respectively arranged at the bottom of the top plate, the adjusting structure comprises a connecting plate which is connected to the outer wall of the bottom of the sliding rail in a sliding way, two mounting seats are fixedly arranged on the outer wall of the bottom of the connecting plate, a rotating shaft is rotatably connected to the inside of each mounting seat, two limiting rings are fixedly arranged on the outer peripheral wall of each rotating shaft, and a servo motor is fixedly arranged on the outer wall of the right side of each connecting plate. This high-speed rail-mounted inspection robot vision system anti-shake device through servo motor, action wheel, drive belt, from driving wheel and the effect of adjusting the pole, can drive the rotation axis and rotate in the inside of mount pad, simultaneously through the effect of connecting block, has increased the distance between curb plate and the rotation axis, is convenient for adjust the angle of inspecting the camera, has improved the shooting scope of inspecting the camera.

title_en: Automatic snatch and detection device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic grabbing and detecting device which comprises a mechanical arm, wherein a connecting seat is arranged at the grabbing end of the mechanical arm, an inductor is arranged at one side of the connecting seat, an iron core frame, a detecting frame and a gripper frame are arranged around the mechanical arm, the iron core frame comprises a first supporting frame, an iron core placing plate is placed at the upper end of the first supporting frame, a plurality of iron core placing holes are formed in the iron core placing plate in an array mode, the detecting frame comprises a second supporting frame, a detecting table is arranged at the upper end of the second supporting frame, a detecting device is arranged on the detecting table, the gripper frame comprises a third supporting frame, a placing frame is arranged at the upper end of the third supporting frame, a pneumatic triangular claw and a vacuum adsorption plate are placed on the placing frame, connecting structures which can be detachably connected with the connecting seat are arranged at the upper ends of the pneumatic triangular claw and the vacuum adsorption plate, the purpose of grabbing a motor iron core and the first iron core placing plate is achieved in a gripper replacing mode only through the arrangement of one mechanical arm, and the investment of the mechanical arm is reduced.

title_en: Anti-loose ring buckle for automatic dredging vibration device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-loosening ring buckle for an automatic dredging vibration device, which comprises a ring buckle, a bolt piece and a hinge, wherein the ring buckle is fixedly arranged at two ends of the hinge respectively, the bolt piece is fixedly arranged at the top end of the ring buckle and the locking assembly, the anti-loosening ring buckle comprises a base, a moving piece, a swinging piece, a first spring, a first telescopic piece, a rotating piece, a second telescopic piece, a clamping piece and a righting piece, the ring buckle is movably matched with the upper end of the base, the moving piece is arranged at the upper end of the base in a sliding manner, the swinging piece is arranged at the upper end of the moving piece in a rotating manner, the first spring is fixedly arranged at the side surface of the moving piece, the first telescopic piece is arranged at the upper end of the swinging piece in a sliding manner, the rotating piece is rotatably arranged at the front end of the first telescopic piece, the second telescopic piece is fixedly arranged at the side surface of the ring buckle, and the righting piece is fixedly arranged at the side surface of the second telescopic piece, so that the ring buckle can not be mutually loosened and separated, and the automatic dredging vibration device and a coal bin are not tightly attached any more, and the dredging coal bin is affected.

title_en: Kitchen manipulator for cooking
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent kitchen electricity, in particular to a kitchen manipulator for cooking. The invention provides a kitchen manipulator for cooking, which can integrate feeding and stir-frying and improve the stir-frying efficiency. The kitchen manipulator for cooking comprises a base and a mechanical arm arranged on the base, wherein the tail end of the mechanical arm is rotationally connected with a fixed shaft. According to the invention, the mechanical arm is controlled to drive the fixed shaft to move, so that the clamping jaw moves into a container for holding food materials, the food materials are grabbed through the swinging of the clamping jaw, then the clamping jaw drives the food materials to move into the pot, the telescopic rod of the electric push rod is started to shorten, so that the clamping jaw loosens the food materials, the food materials fall into the pot, then the electric driving shaft is started to rotate, the clamping jaw rotates along the circumferential direction of the fixed shaft, and the clamping jaw rotates to stir-fry the food materials through the cooperation of the rotating gear and the gear ring, so that the feeding and stir-frying are integrated, and the stir-frying efficiency is improved.

title_en: Chip product processing system and chip product processing method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a patch product processing system and a patch product processing method, comprising a first processing line, a second processing line, a third processing line and a fourth processing line; the first to third processing lines run in parallel; the fourth processing line is operated in series with respect to the first through third processing lines; cutting the original target object sheet by a first processing line to form a target object patch with a preset structure; cutting the primary release paper by a second processing line to form a hollow secondary release paper; cutting the first-stage adhesive tape by a third processing line to form a second-stage adhesive tape with a preset structure; the second-stage adhesive tape is combined with the second-stage release paper by a second processing line to obtain a first-stage back sizing tape; and (3) jointing the target object patch with the primary back sizing material belt by a fourth processing line, and cutting the secondary release paper once to obtain a target product. The invention can realize continuous and large-batch automatic production of the patch products and improve the processing stability and processing efficiency of the patch products.

title_en: Coal conveying belt arrangement method for thermal power plant
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal conveying belt arrangement method for a thermal power plant, which belongs to the technical field of thermal power generation and comprises a combustion boiler, a coal feeding belt and a main coal conveying belt, wherein a boiler steel frame is arranged on the combustion boiler, the main coal conveying belt is arranged above the combustion boiler through the boiler steel frame, coal is conveyed to the main coal conveying belt through a coal conveying transfer station, then is shunted to two sides of the boiler from the main coal conveying belt through the side coal conveying belts, and is dropped into coal bins on two sides of the boiler through the side coal conveying belts on two sides of the boiler, so that coal conveying is completed.

title_en: Cable wire feeding equipment for automobile wire harness processing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of automobile wire harness processing, in particular to cable wire feeding equipment for automobile wire harness processing. The technical proposal comprises: the wire feeding device comprises a supporting seat, a connecting plate and a wire feeding mechanism, wherein one side of the top of the supporting seat is fixedly provided with a wire tightening mechanism through a supporting rod, the wire tightening mechanism comprises a mounting seat and a mounting frame, a wire tightening rod extending out of the top is rotatably mounted inside the mounting seat, the mounting frame is sleeved on the outer side of the top of the wire tightening rod, one side of the mounting frame is fixedly provided with an eccentric disc, and the outer side of the top of the wire tightening rod is fixedly provided with a locking sleeve. According to the invention, the knob torsion piece drives the wire tightening rod to wind the automobile wire harness cable around the outer side, and the handle is pulled to drive the eccentric disc to abut against one side of the locking sleeve, so that the eccentric disc is convenient to abut against the locking sleeve, the wire tightening rod is locked, the wire tightening rod is convenient to tighten the automobile wire harness cable to be conveyed, and the wire tightening function of tightening the automobile wire harness cable to be fed is realized.

title_en: Quick access device of mobile power generation car
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quick access device of a mobile power generation vehicle, which belongs to the technical field of H02J according to IPC classification numbers and comprises a mobile vehicle frame, an adapter box and a joint shell, wherein the adapter box is fixed on the upper side of the mobile vehicle frame. This quick access device of mobile power generation car blocks cable joint with the clamp mouth of joint shell, and rotate hob and transmission tooth piece meshing, make the drive slot of C shape driving disk inner wall promote the connecting rod to be close to the center of joint shell gradually, a plurality of steel sheet splint subassemblies in the messenger joint shell can carry out the angle deflection round the connecting rod when centre gripping cable copper nose, make the scraper puncture the insulating pyrocondensation pipe on power supply cable copper nose surface, when continuing to press from both sides tightly, the scraper tear insulating pyrocondensation pipe and imbed the top layer of cable copper nose, make the inward flange of No. two steel sheet splint of steel sheet splint and cable copper nose produce abundant contact, and then when guaranteeing that this quick access device is connected with the cable of user's power cabinet, can not receive insulating pyrocondensation pipe's separation influence, guarantee can connect the electricity fast.

title_en: Control method and device of material conveying equipment and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a control method and device of material conveying equipment and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: responding to the opening triggering operation of the material conveying equipment, opening an electromagnetic valve of a discharging hopper, starting a first conveyor belt, and simultaneously starting N-1 first timers; the j-th first timer corresponds to the j-th conveyor belt, the j+1-th first timer corresponds to the j+1-th conveyor belt, the set duration of the j-th timer is smaller than the set duration of the j+1-th first timer, and j is a positive integer smaller than or equal to N-1; and when the overtime target first timers exist in the N-1 first timers, starting the conveyor belt corresponding to the target first timers. The problem of material extrusion and material accumulation not only can be avoided to this scheme, also can avoid because opening the too big problem of electric current that a plurality of conveyer belts appear simultaneously, guarantees the safe and stable of material and carries.

title_en: Preservative film winding device for broccoli storage
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of vegetable packaging, in particular to a preservative film winding device for broccoli storage. The existing preservative film winding device for broccoli cannot completely attach to irregular surfaces of broccoli to wind the preservative film, so that excessive air exists between the preservative film and the broccoli, and the surface of the broccoli is rotten in the storage process, so that the preservative film is not beneficial to storage after the broccoli is wound. A preservative film winding device for broccoli storage comprises a chassis and the like; the top of chassis fixedly connected with support frame, fixedly connected with carrier frame on the chassis. The broccoli wound with the preservative film is pressed by the sponge plate on the push plate, so that the wound preservative film can be more attached to the form of the broccoli, the air existing between the preservative film and the broccoli is reduced, and the storage of the broccoli is facilitated.

title_en: Robot cluster cooperative control method and system
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to the field of automatic control intelligent application technologies, and in particular, to a robot cluster cooperative control method, system, computer device, storage medium, and computer program product. The method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of respectively obtaining degree of freedom information of an individual robot and determining an individual motion structure model; determining an order relation according to the flow order of the target job tasks, and determining the parameters of the connection points between adjacent individual robots; connecting the individual motion structure models in a unified space coordinate system to obtain a cluster motion control model; determining a stage check point corresponding to a target operation task in the space coordinate system, and reversely calculating the stage check point based on a cluster motion control model to obtain a cooperative control instruction; and mapping the cooperative control instructions to different sub-motion units by taking the connection point as a demarcation point, and distributing the divided cooperative control instructions to associated individual robots. The method can improve the accuracy of motion control.

title_en: Finishing device and finishing method for polished sheet strips
abstract_en: A finishing device and a finishing method for polishing sheet strips. A finishing device for polishing sheet strips comprises a frame, a front baffle, a rear baffle, a roller, a discharging device, an adsorption device and a blowing device. A method of finishing a sanding sheet strip comprising the steps of: the feeding conveyor belt sends a plurality of polishing sheet strips into the roller, a negative pressure box is used for sucking air into the sucking and blowing holes on the outer wall of the roller, the nozzle blows air into the sucking and blowing holes on the outer wall of the roller, and the polishing sheet strips are blown off to the discharging device; the discharging device conveys the polishing sheet strips backwards and conveys the polishing sheet strips out of the roller. According to the invention, the polishing sheet strips are arranged in the same direction and are conveyed outwards one by matching with the air suction and blowing structures through the rotation of the roller with the protruding toothed plate, so that the equipment cost is low, and the whole finishing process is high in efficiency.

title_en: Polytetrafluoroethylene finished product packagine machine platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of finished product packaging, and discloses a polytetrafluoroethylene finished product packaging machine table, which comprises a supporting table, wherein a yielding groove is formed in the middle of the supporting table, and the polytetrafluoroethylene finished product packaging machine table also comprises a bearing mechanism, a folding mechanism and a pressing mechanism; the bearing mechanism comprises a guide rod which is in sliding connection with the supporting table, one end of the guide rod, which is close to the ground, is fixedly connected with a bracket, the middle part of the bracket is provided with a stand column, and one end of the stand column, which is far away from the ground, is provided with a negative pressure plate which is matched with the abdicating groove; the folding mechanism comprises first fixing plates arranged at two ends of one side, far away from the ground, of the supporting table, two first fixing plates are connected with first sliding rods in a sliding mode, one end, close to the center of the supporting table, of each first sliding rod is provided with a first installation frame, and the first installation frames are connected with first compression rollers perpendicular to the first sliding rods in a rotating mode. The invention is suitable for a polytetrafluoroethylene finished product packaging machine table, and the packaging paper can be used for carrying out folding and wrapping treatment on a finished product plate through the alternate movement of the first pressing roller and the second pressing roller.

title_en: Lifting device and lifting method for underground coal mine supporting canopy
abstract_en: The invention relates to a lifting device for a coal mine underground supporting canopy and a lifting device thereof. The lifting device comprises two lifting mechanisms positioned at two sides of the roadway; a first roller and a horizontal telescopic device which are wound with a steel wire rope are arranged at the vertically oriented jacking end of the lifting mechanism; the jacking end of the lifting mechanism drives the first roller and the horizontal telescopic device to move upwards to the high position of the roadway; the first ends of the steel wire ropes on the two lifting mechanisms are connected with two ends of the long steel beam, and after the steel wire ropes hoist the long steel beam to the high position of a roadway, the driving ends of the horizontal retractors on the two lifting mechanisms are propped against the end surfaces of the two ends of the long steel beam; and two single columns can be connected to the first end of wire rope on two elevating system, and wire rope can lift by crane the single column of horizontality to vertical state, and the jacking end of single column will be located the long girder steel top of tunnel eminence and prop on the tunnel roof. The device has the beneficial effects of replacing manpower to carry the long steel beam with larger weight and standing the single column with larger weight.

title_en: Cutting-off interlocking device and control method for dangerous goods liquid tank truck
abstract_en: The invention provides a cutting-off interlocking device of a dangerous goods liquid tank truck, when a loading and unloading arm opening is broken, the pressure measured by a pressure detector 4 is lower than a pressure threshold value, and a cut-off switch 3 is immediately closed by a controller 7, so that dangerous goods liquid leakage is avoided; when the temperature measured by the temperature detector 4 is greater than the temperature threshold, the controller 7 immediately turns off the cut-off switch 3, so that accidents caused by abnormal temperature of dangerous goods liquid are avoided; when loading and unloading are completed, the disconnecting switch 3 is closed, the buoyancy detector 2 monitors that if buoyancy exists in the pipe cavity at the joint of the tank wagon joint 1 and the loading and unloading port of the tank wagon, information of residual dangerous material liquid exists between the tank wagon joint 1 and the loading and unloading port of the tank wagon is fed back to the controller 7, and the controller 7 triggers the warning device 8 to prompt operators to operate in a illegal mode, and the valve of the loading and unloading port of the tank wagon is not closed, so that the problem that oil filling riser leakage and other accidents are avoided in the actual loading and unloading process is solved.

title_en: Picking manipulator and picking equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a picking manipulator and picking equipment, and relates to the technical field of manipulators. Wherein, picking manipulator includes: the annular frame body is provided with a first notch; the annular ring gear is sleeved on the outer periphery of the annular frame body and can rotate relative to the annular frame body, cutting saw teeth are circumferentially arranged on the annular ring gear, and the tip parts of the cutting saw teeth are higher than the bottom of the first notch and lower than or equal to the opening position of the first notch; the annular ring gear is provided with a first driving connecting part which is connected with a first driving device, so that cutting saw teeth cut objects entering the first notch.

title_en: Slag bucket with cooling weighing and automatic cleaning functions
abstract_en: The invention relates to a slag bucket with cooling weighing and automatic cleaning functions, which comprises a slag bucket main body, a weighing mechanism and a crushing mechanism, wherein the slag bucket main body is formed by connecting a crushing guide seat body with a cooling guide seat body up and down, two discharging guide seat bodies are arranged at the lower end of the cooling guide seat body, are arranged in an inverted V shape and are connected with a lower cooling guide seat body into a whole, a feed inlet is arranged at the upper end of the crushing guide seat body, a first arc-shaped groove for installing the crushing mechanism is formed in the crushing guide seat body below the feed inlet, and a second arc-shaped groove for installing the weighing mechanism is formed in the lower end of the feed inlet. The design has the advantages of simple structure, easy manufacture, practicality and high efficiency.

title_en: Embedded charging pile
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of charging piles, in particular to an embedded charging pile. The invention provides an embedded charging pile which can wind a connecting wire and avoid damage caused by winding and knotting of the connecting wire and external interference. The utility model provides an embedded charging pile, is equipped with outer frame including wall body, outer frame, spool, charging base, charging head and connecting wire etc. in the wall body middle part, and outer frame inside rotation is connected with the spool, and outer frame lower part front side is connected with charging base, and the joint has charging head on the charging base, and charging head downside is connected with the connecting wire. According to the invention, the double-shaft motor on the fixing frame is started, the rotating rod rotates to drive the first belt to rotate, so that the winding frame rotates, and the effects of winding the connecting wire and avoiding damage caused by winding and knotting of the connecting wire and external interference are achieved.

title_en: Safety reverse driving method, device, equipment and medium of cooperative robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safe reverse driving method, device, equipment and medium of a cooperative robot. The method comprises the following steps: determining whether an application operation to a cooperative robot satisfies an entry condition of reverse driving when the cooperative robot is in a standby state; if the application operation meets the entering condition, the reverse driving is carried out, the brake is released, and the motor is controlled to enter a short-circuit braking state; after entering the reverse drive, determining whether the applying operation satisfies an exit condition of the reverse drive; if the application operation does not meet the exit condition, continuously maintaining a short-circuit braking state of the motor and a releasing state of the brake; and if the application operation meets the exit condition, exiting the reverse driving, closing the brake and controlling the motor to exit the short-circuit braking state. The embodiment of the invention can release the band-type brake under the condition of enough safety so as to execute emergency measures.

title_en: Tray vertical conveying screw rod jacking elevator
abstract_en: The invention provides a tray vertical conveying screw rod lifting machine, which comprises a frame, wherein a first supporting plate, a second supporting plate and a third supporting plate are sequentially arranged in the frame from bottom to top, a motor transmission assembly is arranged on the first supporting plate, a low-position transition roller is arranged on the second supporting plate, a middle-position transition roller is arranged on the third supporting plate, a conveying platform driven by the motor transmission assembly to lift up and down is arranged at the upper end in the frame, a high-position transition roller is arranged at the front side of the upper end in the frame, and the high-position transition roller is matched with the conveying platform in the same plane; the invention has simple structure, convenient operation and low height, and can reduce the space size requirement.

title_en: Truss unit hoisting, positioning and butting method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a truss unit hoisting, positioning and docking method, which relates to the technical field of constructional engineering, and adopts a truss unit hoisting, positioning device, and realizes hoisting, positioning and docking of truss units by the docking method, wherein the hoisting, positioning device comprises: base, support column, guide pillar, load-bearing platform, location platform, brace table, supporting leg, horizontal pole, first horizontal pole, second horizontal pole, connecting rod, guiding hole, position fine setting stop gear, first actuating mechanism, second actuating mechanism, the base lower extreme be equipped with the supporting leg, the base upper end rectangular distribution has 4 along the vertical support columns that fixedly set up 1, the inboard of every support column all is equipped with the guide pillar. The invention does not need to use large hoisting equipment, can realize the high-altitude lifting and accurate positioning of the truss unit, and avoids the problems of the existing mode that the truss unit swings in the air, is inconvenient to position and has high butt joint difficulty.

title_en: High temperature rotational viscometer goes in and out robot of stove
abstract_en: The invention discloses a robot arm for a high-temperature rotary viscometer to go in and out of a furnace, which comprises a supporting platform and is characterized in that a first guide rail is vertically arranged on the supporting platform, a first moving assembly is vertically arranged on the first guide rail in a sliding mode, a second moving assembly is transversely connected to the first moving assembly, and a second driving piece is arranged on the second moving assembly. Through setting up motor drive rotary mechanism, indulge moving mechanism, sideslip mechanism at each mechanism and remove the manipulator to the clamping position that needs, the crucible is held to clamping motor drive jack catch, realizes the robot of viscometer and gets in and out the stove, guarantees operation safety and efficiency. After the device is implemented, the problems of high operation strength, safety and the like of personnel can be solved, the operation danger of the high-temperature rotary viscometer in-out furnace manipulator can be effectively reduced, the crucible in-out viscometer under stable conditions is ensured, the problem of personnel operation is not required to be worried about in the viscosity measurement process, and the measurement efficiency is ensured.

title_en: Tray and production system
abstract_en: The application relates to a tray and production system, including bearing subassembly, flexible subassembly and drive assembly, bearing subassembly includes two at least bearing spare, and flexible subassembly connects gradually each bearing spare along setting for the direction, and flexible subassembly is constructed to can be flexible along setting for the direction to change the interval between each adjacent two bearing spare when flexible. The driving component is in transmission connection with the bearing piece positioned at the head end and/or the bearing piece positioned at the tail end in the set direction, and the telescopic component is controlled to stretch and retract by the connected bearing piece. In this application, when the great work piece of bearing in settlement direction size is required, can lengthen the interval between the adjacent bearing piece through the extension of drive assembly control telescopic assembly to make the bearing length of tray longer. When the workpiece with smaller size in the set direction needs to be supported, the telescopic assembly can be controlled by the driving assembly to shorten the interval between the adjacent supporting pieces, so that the supporting length of the tray is shortened.

title_en: Balance tank for a cooling system and cooling system for a traction motor of a motor vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a balancing tank for a cooling system, comprising at least: at least one inlet (3, 4) for cooling oil; a first outlet (6) for cooling oil; a second outlet (7) for gas; and a connecting channel between said at least one inlet (3, 4) and said outlet (6, 7), one (3) of said inlets for cooling oil and the second outlet (7) for gas being arranged always above the first outlet (6) for cooling oil in any operating state by means of a horizontal and/or vertical offset in the installed state. The balancing tank is characterized in particular in that a filter medium for removing particles and/or water from the cooling oil is arranged between the at least one inlet (3, 4) and the first outlet (6). The present invention relates to a cooling system for a traction motor of a motor vehicle. With the balancing tank or cooling system presented herein, direct cooling of the traction motor can be provided in an inexpensive and robust manner over the service life.

title_en: Anti-oxidation preserved duck fresh-keeping packaging system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an antioxidant preserved duck fresh-keeping packaging system which comprises a conveying mechanism, a hanging piece, a cold water tank and a closing component. The closure assembly is provided with a support disc, a rotating member and a plurality of closure members mounted on the support disc. The closing piece is connected with the closing piece through an elastic piece, and when the rotating piece rotates to push the closing piece to move, the elastic piece is kept to be pulled to be opened by the closing piece, so that the injection pipe is opened. The anti-oxidation preserved duck fresh-keeping packaging system realizes automatic conveying of the preserved ducks through the conveying mechanism, and realizes vacuum sealing when the preserved ducks are kept to be resuspended. The automatic operation of material injection and sealing is realized, the material injection and sealing of the pressed salted ducks are realized at one time, the packaging efficiency of the pressed salted ducks is greatly improved, and the labor intensity of workers is reduced.

title_en: Buried scraper conveyor for harmless treatment of solid waste
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of buried scraper conveyors, in particular to a buried scraper conveyor for harmless treatment of solid waste, wherein one end of a conveying shell is communicated with a discharging part, the other end of the conveying shell is communicated with a driven part, a baffle plate is fixedly connected in the conveying shell, a conveying channel is formed between the baffle plate and the upper end of the inner wall of the conveying shell, a first winding preventing mechanism for preventing the winding of the waste is connected in the discharging part, and a second winding preventing mechanism for preventing the winding of the waste is connected in the driven part. According to the invention, the driven shaft is protected through the second winding prevention mechanism, meanwhile, the first roller, the second roller and the third roller form the protective cover to cover the driving shaft, the first roller, the second roller and the third roller isolate solid waste in the rotation process of the driving shaft, and the solid waste is not wound on the driving shaft in the solid waste conveying process, so that the driving shaft is not influenced to drive the scraper chain to convey the solid waste.

title_en: RTP pasting part product transmission system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an RTP pasting part product transmission system, which comprises a shuttle system, a detection system, a Panel, a support frame and a computer, wherein the shuttle system comprises a first shuttle component and a second shuttle component, the first shuttle component comprises a first ascending slide rail, a first upright post and a first grating plate, the second shuttle component comprises a second ascending slide rail, a second upright post and a second grating plate corresponding to the first grating plate, grating grooves between the first grating plate and the second grating plate are staggered, and the gratings of the first grating plate and the second grating plate can be meshed and overlapped. The device PLC is subjected to action modification through GX Works, the original device mechanism is subjected to action step modification, action step optimization is realized, the purpose of man-hour reduction is achieved, after the action of each step of device is analyzed aiming at the development of a control system, part of actions are advanced within the same time, so that after RTP is pasted at a position, the action of Panel mobile transmission is improved.

title_en: Telescopic fork and stacker
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure disclose a telescoping fork and stacker. One embodiment of the telescopic fork comprises: the first single fork mechanism and the second single fork mechanism are used for bearing goods; the first single-fork mechanism and the second single-fork mechanism comprise fixed fork arms, middle fork arms and transmission components, and the fixed fork arms are positioned between the middle fork arms and the transmission components; the driving mechanism is connected with the transmission assembly of the first single-fork mechanism, and the transmission assembly of the first single-fork mechanism is connected with the transmission assembly of the second single-fork mechanism; the middle fork arm is provided with a rack on the end face facing the fixed fork arm, and the rack extends along the length direction of the middle fork arm; the transmission assembly comprises a transmission gear and is fixed on the fixed fork arm; the fixed fork arm is provided with a matching through hole, and the transmission gear is meshed with the rack on the middle fork arm through the matching through hole. This embodiment relates to warehouse logistics technology and realizes the telescopic movement of fork through gear drive structure. The device can be more compact in structure, and transmission noise can be reduced.

title_en: Automatic manufacturing process for efficiently producing traffic safety facilities
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic manufacturing process for efficiently producing traffic safety facilities, which comprises the following steps of firstly, placing a workpiece to be processed on a conveying mechanism, conveying the workpiece by the conveying mechanism, driving the conveying mechanism by a stepping motor so that the conveying mechanism can intermittently convey the workpiece, and secondly, conveying the workpiece to a first pre-processing station by the conveying mechanism in the conveying process of the workpiece. In the process of the invention, through the process, after a worker places the workpiece on the conveying mechanism, the position of the workpiece can be automatically placed, so that the workpiece can enter a machining position in a correct posture, and the position of the workpiece can be fixed through the clamping mechanism, so that the stability of the workpiece in machining is ensured, and when the workpiece is machined, the end part of the workpiece can be placed on the edge of the conveying mechanism, so that the workpiece is supported, and the workpiece can be machined.

title_en: Automatic hose boxing machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic hose boxing machine which comprises a frame, a jig mechanism, a first conveying assembly, a pipe pushing mechanism, a box conveying mechanism and a boxing motion mechanism, wherein the first conveying assembly, the pipe pushing mechanism, the box conveying mechanism and the boxing motion mechanism are arranged on the frame, the frame is provided with a boxing station, the first conveying assembly is used for conveying hoses, the jig mechanism comprises a plurality of sleeve jigs sleeved by the hoses, the pipe pushing mechanism is arranged corresponding to the first conveying assembly and can push the hoses on the first conveying assembly to be sleeved on the sleeve jigs, the jig mechanism can enable the hoses to stay on the sleeve jigs or separate from the sleeve jigs, the box conveying mechanism is used for conveying boxes to the boxing station and outputting and blanking the boxes, and the boxing motion mechanism is used for driving the jig mechanism to rotate and move so that the hoses on the jig mechanism can be vertically filled in the boxes of the boxing station. The invention can vertically load the hose into the box with the boxing station horizontally placed, is beneficial to avoiding extrusion deformation caused by stacking of the hose, and is convenient for boxing the hose.

title_en: Cigarette machine blanking plate with self-cleaning function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a blanking plate of a cigarette making machine with a self-cleaning function, which comprises a blanking turning plate (1), wherein a blanking plate position sensor (2) is arranged at a rotating shaft of the blanking turning plate (1), a vibrating device (3) and an air injection device (4) are arranged on two long sides of the blanking turning plate (1), and the blanking plate position sensor (2), the vibrating device (3) and the air injection device (4) are electrically connected with a PLC (programmable logic controller) 5. The invention can automatically clean the tobacco dust accumulated at the edge of the blanking plate, the whole cleaning process is automatically completed, the equipment does not need to be stopped, the operation efficiency of the equipment is greatly improved, and the hidden danger of product quality is eliminated.

title_en: Lifting device, container transferring equipment and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lifting device, container transferring equipment and a method, wherein the container transferring equipment comprises a first conveying table, a second conveying table, a main shaft, a plurality of material taking devices, a guiding device, a lifting device and a rotating device; the main shaft is rotatably arranged between the first conveying table and the second conveying table through the rotating device, and two ends of the main shaft are respectively positioned above the first conveying table and the second conveying table; the material taking devices are respectively arranged at two ends of the main shaft and are used for grabbing materials on the first conveying table and placing the materials in the container on the second conveying table under the rotation action of the rotating device; the guiding device is arranged between the main shaft and the container and is used for guiding and positioning materials in the material taking device and the container; the two ends of the lifting device are respectively connected with the main shaft and the rotating device. The invention can realize rapid transfer, realize multi-container nesting assembly, realize accurate nesting of containers and materials and improve transfer efficiency.

title_en: Prediction method of motion trail of wafer handling mechanical arm based on time sequence
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of mechanical arm motion trail prediction, and discloses a prediction method of a mechanical arm motion trail based on time sequence wafer handling; acquiring historical mechanical arm vibration frequency corresponding to the characteristic time sequence data; extracting features from the feature time series data; training a mechanical arm vibration frequency prediction model for predicting future time based on the characteristic time sequence data after the characteristic extraction; the feature time series data acquired in real time is input into a mechanical arm vibration frequency prediction model after feature extraction is completed, mechanical arm vibration frequency at a future moment is output and predicted, and whether an abnormal mechanical arm vibration frequency early warning instruction is generated or not is judged; compensating the characteristic time sequence data from the end of the previous moment to the abnormal time; the motion track of the mechanical arm moves according to the standard track, so that the stability and safety of the motion of the mechanical arm are improved, and the wafer is protected from being damaged.

title_en: Container underframe and container
abstract_en: The application discloses a container chassis and container. The container chassis includes a floor, a subfloor, a bottom corner fitting, a foam layer, and at least one support member. The floor and the sub-floor are respectively positioned on the upper surface and the lower surface of the container underframe, and the sub-floor and the floor are arranged at intervals in the height direction. The bottom surface of the bottom corner fitting and the bottom surface of the sub-floor are positioned on the same horizontal plane. The foaming layer is positioned between the floor and the subfloor. The support is at least partially embedded in the foamed layer. The support piece comprises a connecting plate and two rib plates which are oppositely arranged in the width direction. The connecting plate is connected between two gusset. The utility model provides a container chassis when receiving the pressure that gross weight of equipment such as fork truck produced or rolling the dynamic load that produces, the support piece plays the effect of supporting and restriction displacement to the foaming layer, and the gusset can offset at least partial horizontal component, and the pressure distribution of foaming layer can be improved to the connecting plate, strengthens the compressive capacity of foaming layer and chassis, prevents that the foaming layer from producing the deformation of collapsing because of the crushing, prevents that the chassis from breaking and damaging.

title_en: Medical material box
