abstract_en: The invention provides a medical material box, relates to the technical field of medical supplies, and solves the technical problem that the operation of changing the size of an independent space by adopting a plug-in type material box in the prior art is troublesome. The device comprises a basket body, a sliding partition plate and a slideway, wherein the slideway is fixedly arranged in the basket body, the sliding partition plate can be placed in the basket body, and the side end of the sliding partition plate is in sliding connection with the slideway.

title_en: Wire ingot management system based on elasticizing process
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a wire ingot management system based on a texturing process, and relates to the field of computer technology. The specific implementation scheme is as follows: the AGV transport vehicle is used for responding to a production instruction triggered based on an order, and transferring POY precursor ingots from a raw material warehouse to a target precursor rack filament loading position of the elasticizer; the texturing machine is used for processing the POY precursor wire ingot by a texturing process to obtain a DTY wire ingot, storing the DTY wire ingot in a wire ingot temporary storage area and triggering a doffing signal; the transport system is used for responding to the doffing signal and storing the DTY wire ingots into a three-dimensional warehouse; and the packaging system is used for responding to the packaging instruction, taking out the DTY wire ingots from the three-dimensional warehouse and carrying out packaging treatment. The embodiment of the disclosure provides a conveying system and a packaging system, so that the generation from POY precursors to DTY ingots is realized, and then the full-automatic process is realized in the whole process of taking out the packaged DTY ingots, thereby improving the production efficiency.

title_en: Concrete spreader
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of concrete distributing machines, in particular to a concrete distributing machine which comprises a base, wherein a vertical frame is arranged on the base, a balance bracket is arranged on the vertical frame, a conveying pipe is arranged on the balance bracket, a plurality of first rollers are arranged at the bottom of the base, rotating drums are arranged around the base, one ends of the rotating drums are rotatably connected to the side wall of the base through horizontal shafts, second rollers are arranged at the other ends of the rotating drums, and inserted bars are arranged in the rotating drums in a sliding mode; the side walls around the base are provided with main oil ducts, the middle part of each main oil duct is communicated with the inside of the rotating cylinder through soft branch oil ducts, and push columns and pressing columns are respectively and slidably embedded in the two ends of each main oil duct; the pushing column is provided with a rack, a gear is meshed with the rack, and the gear is fixedly sleeved on the horizontal shaft; the stand is provided with a hydraulic cylinder, and piston rods of the hydraulic cylinders are connected with all the compression columns through the connecting frame. The concrete spreader can solve the problems of poor trafficability and poor stability of the existing concrete spreader.

title_en: Pipeline threading device for electric power construction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pipeline threading apparatus for electric power construction, which comprises a workbench, a wire arrangement mechanism and a supporting mechanism; a working table: the rear end of the upper surface of the wire arranging bin is fixedly connected with symmetrically-distributed brackets, the upper end of the wire arranging bin is rotatably connected with a second rotating shaft, the middle part of the second rotating shaft is fixedly connected with a winch, the middle part of the winch is provided with a wire harness, the front end of the upper surface of the working bin is provided with a wire arranging bin, the front end of the wire arranging bin is provided with a rectangular opening, the rear end of the wire arranging bin is provided with a circular hole, and the rectangular opening and the circular hole are matched with the wire harness; this a pipeline threading apparatus for electric power construction for pipeline threading apparatus for electric power construction can carry out the winding displacement work of different specification pencil, and is applicable to different operational environment, has effectively improved the convenient degree that is used for pipeline threading apparatus pipeline threading work of electric power construction, and then has effectively improved the work efficiency that is used for pipeline threading apparatus pipeline threading work of electric power construction.

title_en: Full-automatic high efficiency seal case and paste ticket all-in-one
abstract_en: The application relates to a full-automatic high-efficiency box sealing and ticket pasting integrated machine, which comprises a frame; the machine frame is provided with a sealing tape machine, a ticket pasting device and a control system, the machine frame is provided with a workbench, the workbench comprises a first conveying table and a second conveying table, the first conveying table is provided with a pushing component, and the pushing component is used for conveying a box body from the first conveying table to the second conveying table; one end of the second conveying table is communicated with the box body output port and is provided with a conveying assembly for conveying the box body to the outlet and a correction mechanism for correcting the conveying direction of the box body; the sealing tape machine is arranged above the first conveying table in a suspending way and is used for sealing the box body; the ticket pasting device is arranged above the second conveying table in a suspending way and is used for pasting tickets to the box body; the application adopts a double-station design, simultaneously adds the pushing component to accelerate the conveying speed of the box body, and adds the correction mechanism to ensure that the conveying direction of the box body is not deviated, thereby having the advantages of high efficiency, accurate conveying and the like.

title_en: Grain and oil storage equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses grain and oil storage equipment, and relates to the technical field of storage. The invention provides grain and oil storage equipment which comprises a storage tank, wherein the storage tank is fixedly connected with a fixed cover, a cavity is formed between the storage tank and the fixed cover, the storage tank is communicated with a flange pipe, the storage tank is communicated with a discharging pipe, the discharging pipe is provided with a ball valve, the fixed cover is fixedly connected with a circumferentially-arrayed air cooler, guide plates which are uniformly distributed circumferentially are fixedly connected between the storage tank and the fixed cover, the storage tank penetrates through symmetrically-distributed round pipes, and the round pipes are fixedly connected with first piston cylinders for storing thermal expansion and contraction agents. The invention fully utilizes the oil temperature to automatically control the starting of the air cooler, thereby automatically reducing the temperature of the edible oil to be within a reasonable storage range and being convenient for controlling the storage temperature of the edible oil.

title_en: Underwater multifunctional all-position welding repair system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides an underwater multifunctional all-position welding repair system and method; the system comprises a magnetic adsorption mobile robot for walking on the metal surface in a magnetic adsorption mode, a welding repair mechanical arm for implementing underwater welding repair, an underwater wire feeding system for feeding welding wires, a dry drainage cover and a local drainage cover; the dry-method drainage cover is connected with the magnetic adsorption mobile robot through a lifting mechanism; the welding repair mechanical arm and the underwater wire feeding system are positioned in the dry-method drainage cover; the local drainage cover is arranged at the execution end of the welding repair mechanical arm. The system can adopt three underwater welding repair schemes including a dry method, a local dry method and a dry method-local dry method, has the advantages of the dry method and the local dry method, and can automatically match with an optimal repair scheme through an underwater welding repairability evaluation and decision method so as to realize underwater various damage types and all-position welding repair.

title_en: Transmission device for metering and packaging for medical cotton swab production
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transmission device for metering and packaging for medical cotton swab production, which comprises a transmission device body, wherein the transmission device body comprises a first auxiliary processing device and a second auxiliary processing device, the first auxiliary processing device and the second auxiliary processing device are arranged in a cavity, a transmission plate is arranged between the first auxiliary processing device and the second auxiliary processing device, the transmission plate is provided with a first section, a second section, a third section, a fourth section and a fifth section, a U-shaped groove is arranged on the transmission plate, a first belt conveyor and a second belt conveyor are arranged on the bottom of the U-shaped groove, the first belt conveyor is positioned in the first section, the second section and the third section, a lifting guide part is arranged between the first belt conveyor and the second belt conveyor, and the first belt conveyor comprises a driving wheel I and a driven wheel I. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: the efficient sterilization in the medical cotton swab transmission process is improved, and the secondary crushing utilization of the medical cotton swab is improved.

title_en: Remote palmprint recognition elevator multimedia calling device and implementation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of elevators and discloses an elevator multimedia calling device for remote palmprint recognition and an implementation method thereof. The invention realizes identity recognition and completes authority management of elevator calls by recognizing palmprint characteristics of human bodies, can display information such as arrival, uplink and downlink, floors and the like of elevators, and can provide information such as humiture, time and advertisements and videos put in by operators which are concerned by users; meanwhile, the intelligent control of the elevator is integrated, and the conditions of calling out, arriving and the like of the elevator are intelligently controlled by adopting one or more combination modes of a palm print as a main mode, an IC card password, voice and a human face as auxiliary modes, so that a safer living environment is provided for owners.

title_en: Extension tray rotating device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an extension tray rotating device which comprises a shaft arranged on the tail of a box body, wherein a shaft sleeve is sleeved on the shaft, two side plates are sleeved on the shaft sleeve, the bottoms of the two side plates are provided with the same bottom plate, and the tops of the two side plates are provided with the same locking block seat plate. The tray is lengthened, fixed by using the rotary lock, can carry the shelter, has a simple structure and firm installation, and is suitable for various extension devices.

title_en: Automatic disassembling device for cigarette case
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic disassembling device for a cigarette case, which at least comprises a first cutting part, a second cutting part, an adjusting part, a transparent film removing part and a cigarette taking-out part, wherein the first cutting part cuts two ends of a transparent film, the second cutting part cuts two side walls of a case body and the transparent film, the adjusting part comprises a first adjusting part and a second adjusting part, the first adjusting part is arranged to rotate in a first plane, the second adjusting part is arranged to rotate in a second plane, the first plane and the second plane are mutually perpendicular, the first adjusting part and the second adjusting part are mutually matched to adjust the cigarette case to a preset gesture, the transparent film removing part sends the cigarette case with the transparent film removed by the first cutting part, the second cutting part and the adjusting part into a discharging mechanism in the preset gesture, and the discharging mechanism comprises a flip mechanism and a discharging mechanism. The invention can automatically disassemble the cigarette case and take out cigarettes, thereby improving the working efficiency.

title_en: Food detection sterile transport container with antibacterial function
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of transport containers, in particular to a food detection sterile transport container with an antibacterial function, which comprises a first box body and a second box body, wherein an opening and closing structure is connected between the first box body and the second box body, a closing structure is arranged on the outer sides of the first box body and the second box body, a sealing structure is connected between the closing structure and the second box body, a fixing structure is arranged on the inner sides of the first box body and the second box body, a buffer structure is arranged on the inner sides of the fixing structure, and a supporting structure is connected with the end parts of the first box body and the second box body; can fix the various angles that open and shut of box through the structure that opens and shuts, can carry out quick closure and opening to the transportation box through the structure that closes, can carry out abundant sealedly to the box through seal structure, can preserve different sample storage containers through fixed knot structure, can reduce the damage that jolts and cause the sample through buffer structure.

title_en: Paper feeding roller
abstract_en: To provide a paper feed roller which facilitates judgment of the life of the roller. The paper feed roller 10 includes a shaft 12, and an elastic body layer 14 formed on the outer peripheral surface of the shaft 12, wherein the outer diameter of the elastic body layer 14 is 10mm to 50mm, grooves 16 extending in the axial direction are formed in an amount of 1 to 8 inclusive in the circumferential direction on the outer peripheral surface of the elastic body layer 14, the grooves 16 are grooves having a constant groove width W in the depth direction or grooves having a gradually decreasing groove width W in the depth direction, the groove width W of the grooves 16 is 0.2mm to 1.0mm inclusive, and the groove depth D of the grooves 16 is 0.2mm to 1.0mm inclusive.

title_en: Mechanical arm and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a mechanical arm and a control method thereof, comprising the following steps: the right end of the first adjusting part is connected with the first driving part through a bracket, the left end of the first adjusting part is connected with the first mechanical arm body, the control mechanism controls the first adjusting part to adjust the first mechanical arm body through the first driving part to rotate in a hemispherical range with the axial length of the first mechanical arm body as a radius, and the connecting part of the first mechanical arm body and the bracket is used as an origin; the left end of the first mechanical arm body is connected with the right end of the second mechanical arm mechanism; the control mechanism controls the second mechanical arm mechanism to adjust the gesture. According to the invention, the mechanical arm is divided into two-stage structures, and the two-stage structures are driven by different driving parts; the high-precision speed reducer is canceled, and the power of the motor is obviously reduced; the dead weight of the movable part of the mechanical arm is reduced, and the servo motor and other parts do not move along with the equipment, so that the inertia is obviously reduced during movement, and the energy consumption is further reduced.

title_en: Section steel structure elevator shaft installation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of outdoor elevator shaft construction, in particular to a steel-structured elevator shaft installation method which comprises the following steps of dividing a steel-structured elevator shaft into N sections of elevator shaft sections in advance, preparing channel steel support rods and connecting pieces according to the elevator shaft section sizes divided in advance, assembling each elevator shaft section on the ground, connecting the channel steel support rods between two adjacent transverse support legs on one open side of the elevator shaft section through the connecting pieces, hoisting each elevator shaft section from bottom to top section, hoisting the elevator shaft section to an installation position, welding and fixing, and disassembling hoisting steel wire ropes to take down the channel steel support rods and the connecting pieces.

title_en: Rocker assembly equipment and pin feed mechanism thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to rocker assembly equipment and a pin feeding mechanism thereof, wherein the pin feeding mechanism comprises a support, and a feeding assembly, a first material moving assembly, a punching assembly and a second material moving assembly which are respectively connected with the support, wherein the feeding assembly is used for containing a plurality of pin coarse materials and realizing orderly conveying of the pin coarse materials, the first material moving assembly is used for conveying the pin coarse materials on the feeding assembly to the punching assembly, the pin coarse materials comprise at least two pins and rim materials which are used for connecting all the pins into a whole, the punching assembly is used for punching the pin coarse materials so as to separate the rim materials from the pins, and the second material moving assembly is used for conveying the punched pins to a bearing structure and assembling the circuit board. The automation of material loading subassembly, first material subassembly, die-cut subassembly and second material subassembly of moving is realized easily, can cooperate the equipment that the cooperation realized pin and circuit board, promotes packaging efficiency and yields, and after pin feed mechanism is applied to rocker equipment, can promote game paddle's rocker's packaging efficiency.

title_en: Thin film anti-pulling flower type film cutting machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to a film anti-stretching film cutting machine, which comprises a bracket, wherein the bottom of the bracket is rotationally connected with a conveying belt, the top of the conveying belt is contacted with a film, the automatic adjustment of the film tension is realized by utilizing the difference of the thermal expansion coefficients between an upper metal sheet and a lower metal sheet, a local cooling cleaning device sprays cold air to the metal sheets, the contraction degree of the upper metal sheets is larger than that of the lower metal sheets, so that the upper metal sheets and a contact ring are upwards bent, the adsorption force on the film is generated, the tension balance of the film in the transverse direction and the longitudinal direction is kept, the cutting precision is improved, the film is prevented from being stretched in the cutting process, the local cooling cleaning device cools the film, surface impurities and dust are removed, and during cooling, the contact ring shape changes and the material contracts to cause loosening and falling of surface particles; the cold air of the local cooling cleaning device enables the surface of the contact ring to be condensed to form a water film to help to remove dust and impurities, keep a working area clean and improve cutting quality.

title_en: Prefabricated formula home use elevator guider of modularization
abstract_en: The invention relates to a modular prefabricated home elevator guiding device, comprising: bottom plate, guider module and top link support, and the guider module is including bottom guider, middle guider and the top guider that from the bottom up connects gradually, and bottom guider passes through angular bracket and is connected with the bottom plate, and bottom guider, middle guider and top guider all include guide rail assembly, well frame and decorate the apron, and guide rail assembly installs on decorating the apron, and the both sides at decorating the apron are installed to well frame. The modularized prefabricated home elevator guiding device ensures that the space utilization rate of the elevator is high, and home elevator products can be extremely, so that more space is saved for small villas; the requirements on the installation position of the site building are low, and the method can be suitable for various working conditions, such as stairway intermediate type, wall-leaning type, floor slab hole type and the like.

title_en: Elevator Internet of things video anomaly detection method and equipment and storage medium thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses an elevator internet of things video anomaly detection method, equipment and a storage medium thereof, wherein the anomaly detection method comprises the following steps: s1, preprocessing an abnormal video image; s2, matching the detected image characteristics with the abnormal video image characteristics; and S3, marking an abnormal internet of things and early warning. The apparatus includes a memory, a processor, and a computer program stored on the memory and executable on the processor; a non-transitory computer readable storage medium having a computer program stored thereon. The elevator internet of things video anomaly detection method based on image feature matching realizes the function of elevator internet of things video image feature matching. According to the technical scheme, the elevator internet of things video abnormality detection method based on image feature matching realizes an elevator internet of things video abnormality alarm function, and can be widely applied to detection of elevator internet of things videos.

title_en: Coupling device and method
abstract_en: A coupling device for transporting cryogenic fluids, which coupling device is capable of being separated and automatically closed in an emergency situation, the device comprising two pipes (2, 3) for transporting fluids, which two pipes extend in a longitudinal direction and each comprise at a connection end a valve mechanism (4,6,8,5,7,9) configured to automatically close the pipes (2, 3) and allow the pipes (2, 3) to open when the connection ends are coupled, the device (1) further comprising an outer pipe (10, 11) arranged around each of the pipes (2, 3) and defining a vacuum space for thermally insulating the pipes (2, 3), the device (1) comprising quick connection means for quick connection of the two pipes (2, 3), which quick connection means comprise mating mechanical attachment members (12, 13) at each of the two connection ends, respectively, the device (1) further comprising an emergency separation system (24, 15, 16, 17, 18, 19, 21) configured to allow the two pipes (2, 3) to be separated at the connection ends via the first connection members (12, 16, 19) at the first connection members (12, 16) and the second connection members (12, 19) at the first connection members (12, 16) and the first connection members (12, 19) and the second connection members (12, 12) are provided in a configuration, 13 Providing a rigid mechanical connection between the connection end of the first conduit (2, 3) and the rest of the first conduit (2, 3), in this second configuration the connection end of the one or more mechanical attachment members (12, 13) of the first conduit equipped with a quick connection mechanism is detached from the rest of the first conduit (2, 3).

title_en: Telescopic cantilever structure on upper part of double-layer sleeve beam
abstract_en: The invention discloses a telescopic cantilever structure at the upper part of a double-layer sleeved beam, which relates to the field of hoisting and transporting equipment and aims to solve the problems that the existing double-layer telescopic cantilever device occupies an equipment operation space in the using process, excessive driving equipment in the device and larger initial load of the device are caused, and the double-layer telescopic cantilever device comprises a stand column, wherein a fixed arm is fixedly connected onto the stand column, an electric hoist is arranged on one side of the stand column, a movable arm is fixedly connected onto the electric hoist, the movable arm is in sliding connection with the fixed arm, a driving mechanism is fixedly connected onto the movable arm, the driving mechanism is positioned on one side far away from the electric hoist, a leveling mechanism is arranged on the other side of the stand column, and the leveling mechanism is connected between the stand column and the fixed arm, and has the advantages that: the equipment operation space is big, and self counter weight is little, can carry out the limit and stretch out and draw back, satisfies market demand.

title_en: Marking device for architectural decoration engineering design
abstract_en: The utility model provides a marking device for architectural decoration engineering design, including two risers around, the same side of two risers sets up coupling mechanism, T type groove is offered respectively on the opposite face top of two risers, the top in T type groove communicates with each other with the external world, movable mounting T type piece in the T type inslot, the opposite face of two T type pieces rotates the installation branch respectively, the opposite end of two spinal branch poles sets up respectively and prescribes a limit to expanding mechanism, cut the marking adhesive tape through cutting mechanism, easy operation, the user is in marking process, only need remove the riser can, to the holding of riser, coupling mechanism, can select by oneself according to user's self comfort level, suitable position is handheld.

title_en: Winding mechanism of lifting transmission type warp knitting machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a winding mechanism of a lifting transmission type warp knitting machine, which comprises a warp knitting machine frame and a winding roller, wherein the inner wall of the warp knitting machine frame is rotationally connected with a rotating shaft, and the side wall of the rotating shaft is fixedly connected with a mounting frame; the fixing mechanism comprises a first rotating rod, a sliding groove, fixing columns, fixing heads, a screw rod and a rotating hand, wherein the inner wall of the mounting frame is symmetrically and rotationally connected with the two first rotating rods, the two side walls of the first rotating rods, which are close to each other, are respectively provided with the sliding groove, the inner wall of the sliding groove is slidably connected with the fixing columns, the side walls of the fixing columns are fixedly connected with the fixing heads, the inner wall of the sliding groove is rotationally connected with the screw rod, the side walls of the screw rod are in threaded connection with the fixing columns, and one end of the screw rod penetrates through the side walls of the first rotating rods and is fixedly connected with the rotating hand. According to the invention, the fixed head is driven to move by rotating the rotating hand, so that the winding roller can be fixed or detached very conveniently, winding rollers with different lengths can be installed, and the application range is wider.

title_en: Method and device for placing row spacing plates before boxing brick-shaped material bags
abstract_en: A method and device for placing a column partition before a brick-shaped material bag is packaged, which belongs to the field of packaging machinery and comprises a supporting frame, wherein a column partition bin is arranged on the inner side of the front part of the supporting frame, a lifting sucker plate taking mechanism is arranged above the middle part of the column partition bin, a horizontal transfer mechanism capable of moving forwards and backwards is arranged at the upper end of the supporting frame, a lifting and turnover clamping plate placing mechanism is arranged on a transfer frame of the horizontal transfer mechanism, a layer marshalling machine is arranged on the inner side of the rear part of the supporting frame, a column marshalling machine is arranged at the rear part of the layer marshalling machine, the conveying direction of the column marshalling machine is perpendicular to the moving direction of the horizontal transfer mechanism, a bag pushing mechanism capable of moving forwards and backwards is arranged at the rear end of the column marshalling machine, and the bag pushing mechanism can sequentially push marshalling material bags onto the layer marshalling machine. The invention realizes the suction, the handover, the positioning, the transfer and the placement of the partition plates, thereby realizing the automatic work of grouping the partition plates of the material bag placement row, improving the production efficiency and reducing the labor intensity.

title_en: Glass fiber mesh cloth and film composite processing control system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of glass fiber mesh cloth and film composite processing, and discloses a glass fiber mesh cloth and film composite processing control system, which comprises a discharging analysis module, a discharging control module, a tension adjustment module, a gluing control module, a gluing adjustment module, a composite analysis module, a composite control module and a data storage library, wherein the abrasion of equipment is reduced by carrying out speed adjustment on a discharging roller with larger speed deviation degree, the method reduces the probability of mechanical error, and further carries out secondary glue supplementing on the condition that the coating missing area is large by analyzing the complete condition of the glue layer, so that the production quality of products can be improved, and the resource waste is reduced.

title_en: Textile fabric conveying device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of textile machinery, in particular to a textile fabric conveying device which mainly solves the problem of low replacement efficiency of a winding roller of textile fabric in the prior art and comprises a rack, a first guide mechanism, a tensioning mechanism, an anti-deflection mechanism, a second guide mechanism and a winding mechanism, wherein the first guide mechanism is arranged on the rack and used for clamping and conveying the textile fabric, the tensioning mechanism is arranged at the output end of the first guide mechanism, the tensioning mechanism is provided with a winding assembly, is used for winding and storing the textile fabric, realizes the tensioning force adjustment of the textile fabric by the positive and negative rotation of the winding assembly, is arranged at the output end of the tensioning mechanism, is provided with a swinging assembly, realizes the transverse reciprocating swinging of the textile fabric by the swinging assembly, is arranged at the output end of the deflection preventing mechanism, and is arranged at the output end of the second guiding mechanism.

title_en: Accurate pressure control method for vacuum sealing machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pressure accurate control method of a vacuum sealing machine, which comprises the following steps: s1, placing a vacuum bag opening in a vacuum sealing machine, and performing vacuumizing operation; s2, monitoring the internal pressure of the vacuum cavity through a monitoring module, and when the internal pressure reaches a first pressure value, exiting the vacuumizing operation; s3, a controller is used for adjusting the electromagnetic valve to conduct the channel between the blowing motor and the vacuum cavity, and the pressure control state is achieved; the controller starts the blowing motor to pump the gas into the vacuum bag, and the vacuum bag is vacuumized firstly to remove the air in the vacuum bag, so that conditions are created for injecting the protective gas. Through monitoring module real-time supervision pressure variation, make solenoid valve switch on through the controller adjustment and connect the vacuum chamber, start the motor of blowing, pump into the vacuum bag with gas, through setting up successful monitoring module repeated calibration vacuum chamber pressure, and then accurate control vacuum bag internal pressure, and then realize can setting up specific pressure or gas ratio and prolong the function of the article of fresh-keeping time.

title_en: Material conveying equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of material conveying, in particular to material conveying equipment, which comprises a first supporting seat, a storage tank, a second supporting seat, a blanking tank, a filtering scraping unit, a discharging unit, a blanking unit and a conveying unit; when current material conveying equipment is used for high temperature material to carry out refrigerated effect to high temperature material when not possessing the transportation, probably there is partial material adhesion difficult clearance, and because the equipment is fragile that the temperature is too high, personnel are easy to be injured during the discharge. The filtering scraping unit, the discharging unit and the discharging unit adopted by the material conveying equipment are matched with the conveying unit, so that uniform discharging can be realized, the problems that high-temperature materials adhere to the inner wall of the discharging tank and deformation of the propeller blades possibly occurs due to continuous high temperature are avoided, cooling treatment is performed in the conveying process, the problems that the stretching filter holes of the filter cloth become large, hot air is difficult to discharge due to blockage of the filter cloth are avoided, and the problem that staff are easy to be injured during discharging is avoided.

title_en: Aerial working platform fly jib luffing device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fly jib luffing devices, and discloses a fly jib luffing device of an aerial working platform, which comprises a main luffing mechanism, wherein the head of a mast is in transmission connection with a telescopic fly jib through the main luffing mechanism; the invention realizes the up-and-down luffing of the telescopic boom through the main luffing mechanism, wherein the luffing effect of the telescopic boom is mainly achieved through the extension of the luffing cylinder, and the structure arrangement of the main luffing mechanism can ensure the opening and closing degree between the luffing cylinder and the head of the mast without excessively large dimension of the telescopic boom in the height direction, thereby ensuring the strength of the head of the mast and avoiding larger loss of the luffing cylinder.

title_en: Boxing method and equipment with partition plates
abstract_en: The invention provides a packing method and equipment with a baffle plate, which comprises a baffle plate sheet fixed-distance conveying device, a product grouping conveying fixed-distance device, a product placing transfer conveying device and a baffle plate forming mechanism.

title_en: Winding device for tail rope of winch
abstract_en: The invention discloses a winch tail rope winding device, which belongs to the field of tail rope winding devices and solves the problems that the traditional tail rope winding device is inconvenient to carry and easy to turn on one's side. The invention is mainly used for lowering the gravity center of the tail rope winding device during carrying, so that the carrying of the tail rope winding device is easier and more labor-saving.

title_en: A smooth detection device that handles for electric energy meter raw materials processing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a smoothing detection device for electric energy meter raw material processing, which relates to the technical field of electric energy meter detection and comprises two groups of brackets, wherein a fixing frame is arranged between the two groups of brackets, the top end of the fixing frame is provided with a lifting assembly, the bottom of the lifting assembly is provided with a smoothing assembly, one side of the smoothing assembly is provided with a conveying belt, one side of the conveying belt is provided with a test table, the top ends of the test table and the conveying belt are provided with auxiliary assemblies, and the top end of the test table is provided with a control unit. According to the invention, by arranging the smoothing processing assembly, the surface smoothing polishing of the metal raw material can be realized by utilizing the electrolytic polishing technology, the electrolytic polishing current is accurately regulated under the set voltage, the smoothness and luster of the metal surface are effectively improved, the microcrack and stress caused by machining are reduced or eliminated, and meanwhile, the purposes of reducing the leakage of the irritant gas and reducing the noise are achieved, so that the polishing operation is convenient, and the working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Cooperative control system of large-scale ferrofluid droplet robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a cooperative control system of a large-scale ferrofluid droplet robot, which precisely controls a droplet robot group with superparamagnetism through a distributed magnetic field. The system comprises a driving module, a control module and a robot detection-tracking-positioning module, and realizes programmable reconstruction, separation, combination and shape change. The driving module utilizes the electromagnet array to generate a local nonuniform gradient magnetic field to perform addressable operation and precise control. The control module synchronously manages the distributed magnetic field, and the detection module feeds back the position information of the robot in real time through the vision system, so that closed-loop control is realized. The system is suitable for complex environments and minimally invasive surgery, and improves the operation precision and application potential of the ferrofluid droplet robot.

title_en: Online cleaning and sterilizing device for beer outlet of beer barrel
abstract_en: The invention provides an online cleaning and sterilizing device for a beer barrel outlet, which comprises a positioning mechanism and a cleaning mechanism. The positioning mechanism comprises a driving wheel mounting plate and a driven wheel mounting plate which are arranged on two sides of the beer barrel transmission line, a pair of positioning driving wheels are arranged on the inner side of the driving wheel mounting plate, a pair of positioning driven wheels are arranged on the inner side of the driven wheel mounting plate, the positioning driving wheels can rotate in the same direction and at the same speed, the driving wheel mounting plate and the driven wheel mounting plate can horizontally move along the left and right directions, and an inductor is arranged at the center position of the positioning driving wheels. The cleaning mechanism comprises synchronous belts arranged on two sides of the beer barrel transmission line, and a plurality of nozzles are arranged parallel to the synchronous belts. The device can realize the automatic positioning of beer barrel outlet, carries out cleaning and disinfecting in step in the transmission process, holds the ladle body through synchronous belt clamp, can effectively avoid beer barrel in transmission and cleaning process outlet position skew, can directly be applied to beer barrel filling operation assembly line, effectively practice thrift the human cost, improvement production efficiency.

title_en: Reinforcing steel bar conveying device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a steel bar conveying device which comprises a frame, a receiving mechanism, a turnover mechanism and a conveying mechanism, wherein the frame is horizontally arranged left and right; the material receiving mechanism comprises support columns, connecting columns, material receiving assemblies and guide plates, wherein each two support columns are vertically arranged on the front side and the rear side of the top surface of the frame in a group, and a plurality of groups are arranged at intervals along the left-right horizontal direction; the two connecting columns are arranged in the left-right horizontal direction, and the bottom surfaces of the two connecting columns are fixedly connected with the top surfaces of the supporting columns on the front side and the rear side of the top of the frame respectively; the material receiving components are respectively arranged on the connecting columns through the turnover mechanisms; the guide plates are vertically arranged on one side of each group of support columns, one side of each guide plate is inclined downwards, and the other side of each guide plate is arranged at intervals to form a blanking channel; the conveying mechanism is arranged in the middle of the top surface of the frame. The invention has high degree of automation, time and labor saving, labor cost saving, production efficiency improvement and good application prospect.

title_en: Joint control system based on field weakening control
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of joint control, and provides a joint control system based on field weakening control, which comprises a displacement measuring module, a rotating module, a power output module, a control module and a telescopic arm, wherein the telescopic arm comprises a plurality of joints and arm sections, the joints are used for driving the arm sections to enable the telescopic arm to stretch, the rotating module is used for changing the orientation of the telescopic arm through rotation, the power output module comprises a motor, a field weakening control submodule and a signal conversion submodule, the field weakening control submodule is used for determining whether field weakening control is carried out on output current of the motor according to the rotating speed of the motor, and the control module is used for generating a motor control instruction, sending a generator control instruction to the power output module, and enabling the tail end of the telescopic arm to reach the target end point. By adopting the flux weakening control strategy, the efficient operation and the accurate control of the motor are realized, so that the positioning precision and the response speed of the telescopic boom are improved.

title_en: Double unsynchronized slicing device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a double-row unsynchronized slicing device which comprises a supporting frame, strip labels, supporting rods and a controller, wherein cushion seats are arranged on the opposite inner walls of the supporting frame, an upper wheel groove and a lower wheel groove are respectively arranged on the upper side and the lower side of each cushion seat, the upper wheel groove and the lower wheel groove are respectively arranged on the side walls of the supporting frame in a penetrating mode, a guide wheel set and a driving wheel set are arranged in each upper wheel groove, the driving wheel set is used for driving the strip labels to move, the strip labels are kept to be attached to the cushion seats by the aid of the guide wheel sets, the supporting rods are arranged in the middle of the top of the supporting frame, U-shaped sliding rods are arranged on the supporting rods in a sliding mode in a penetrating mode, sliding sleeves with slicing parts at two ends are connected to the U-shaped sliding rods, air cylinders are connected between the side walls of the U-shaped sliding rods and the supporting rods, and the two slicing parts are alternately pressed against the two cushion seats by the aid of the air cylinders in a reciprocating sliding mode, and the controller is electrically connected to a driving wheel set and the air cylinders. The invention can automatically and continuously slice the strip-shaped paper-plastic labels, greatly improves the slicing efficiency of the paper-plastic labels, and is suitable for mass production.

title_en: Winter jujube detection, positioning and mechanical arm picking sequence planning method based on YOLO-MLG and YAGR method
abstract_en: The patent discloses a winter jujube detection, positioning and mechanical arm picking sequence planning method based on YOLO-MLG and YAGR methods. The invention provides a lightweight YOLO-MLG model for detecting winter jujubes, which uses MobileVit to reconstruct a backbone network and lightens the weight of the model. The detection accuracy of the model is improved by introducing LSKblock and GSConv. Then, a winter jujube three-dimensional positioning method based on a depth camera and YOLO-MLG is provided, and accurate 3d positioning of winter jujubes is achieved. Finally, a YAGR method is provided for planning the picking sequence of the winter jujubes with the 3d position information, the method firstly uses an improved aggregation hierarchical clustering algorithm to automatically cluster the winter jujubes, and then uses a genetic algorithm to determine the picking sequence of the winter jujubes in the cluster. The YOLO-MLG and YAGR method provided by the invention can realize accurate detection and positioning of winter jujube, high-efficiency and low-collision picking sequence planning, and can provide technical support for the winter jujube picking mechanical arm to realize coherent picking.

title_en: Lifting module, lifting unit and transport vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a lifting module (10) for a transport vehicle (2), comprising: a lifting element (12) which is movable in a vertical direction (Z) and has a contact element (14); a drive unit (20) which is rotatable about a rotational axis (D) extending in a transverse direction (Y) and has a drive element (22); the lifting element (12) and the drive unit (20) are arranged such that, when the drive unit (20) is rotated about the axis of rotation (D) in a first rotational direction, the drive element (22) drives the contact element (14) such that the lifting element (12) is moved in the vertical direction (Z) from a lower end position to an upper end position, the drive unit (20) having an eccentric (30) of fork-shaped design with two side legs (31, 32) arranged offset from one another and a base leg (33) connecting the side legs (31, 32), the drive element (22) being arranged parallel to the axis of rotation (D) and offset between the side legs (31, 32), the extent of the contact element (14) in the transverse direction (Y) being smaller than the distance of the side legs (31, 32) from one another in the transverse direction (Y). The invention also relates to a lifting unit (50) comprising at least two lifting modules (10) according to the invention, and to a transport vehicle (2) comprising at least one lifting module (10) according to the invention and/or at least one lifting unit (50) according to the invention.

title_en: Energy-saving efficient tea sectional heating and fixation process
abstract_en: The application discloses an energy-saving and efficient tea sectional heating and enzyme deactivating process, which comprises the following steps: s1, adding fresh tea leaves; s2, heating for one period, and rapidly heating fresh tea leaves; s3, performing two-stage heating and heat preservation, performing fixation treatment on tea, and discharging the fixation tea from a discharge hole; dedicated tealeaves segmentation device that completes includes base, mounting panel, mounting bracket, loading hopper, cylinder body and drive assembly, and cylinder body both ends are provided with feed inlet and discharge gate respectively, are provided with a plurality of screw conveyer spare with the laminating of cylinder body inner wall in the cylinder body, are provided with the adjustment mechanism who is used for carrying out the adjustment to screw conveyer spare extending direction on the cylinder body. According to the application, a worker can adjust the extending direction of the spiral conveying piece only through the adjusting mechanism, so that the residence time of tea leaves in the roller body is prolonged, the probability of discharging tea leaves from the discharge hole due to insufficient fixation of the tea leaves is reduced, and the fixation effect and quality of the tea leaves are improved.

title_en: Hoisting method for installing blades of power generation fan
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lifting method for installing blades of a power generation fan, which is applied to the field of installing the power generation fan, wherein the blades are horizontally lifted through a self-correcting lifting frame, the attitude of the blades in the air is monitored in real time by means of an attitude sensor, then the direction of high-pressure gas sprayed by an attitude correcting sprayer is controlled by a self-correcting module, and the air is sprayed by the attitude correcting sprayer along the moving wind direction of a C-shaped frame to resist the movement of the C-shaped frame, so that the shaking of the blades in the air lifting process is effectively weakened, the risk of overturning is avoided, the efficiency of rapid butt joint of the blades and hubs is effectively improved, the intelligent and automatic degree is high, the lifting efficiency is effectively improved, the blades are also clamped in an adaptive manner through an upper clamping pad and a lower clamping seat, the blades are effectively prevented from falling in the processes of damaging the blades and lifting, the horizontal lifting of the single blades is realized, and the lifting safety and the high efficiency are better economical efficiency and applicability are realized.

title_en: Energy loading box
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy loading box which comprises a box cover and a box body, wherein the top end of the box body is provided with the box cover, the front end of the box body is provided with a portable handle, two groups of box buckles are arranged between the box cover and the box body, the right side of the interior of the box cover is provided with an energy loading control device, the energy loading control device is internally provided with a left circulating fan and a right circulating fan, and air outlets of the left circulating fan and the right circulating fan are arranged on the right side of the box body. This energy loading case is through being provided with nanometer heating pipe, box, and this energy case heats the production wave band through the nanometer heating pipe of bottom for daily life's daily life quality of water treatment, daily necessities etc. all accessible energy case loading has comparatively extensive application to agriculture, forestry, fishery, can be better carry out the energy loading to all kinds of products to satisfy people's user demand, solved can not carry out the problem of energy loading to daily all kinds of articles for use.

title_en: Palletizing robot positioning method and palletizing system
abstract_en: The application belongs to the field of stacking systems, and particularly relates to a stacking robot positioning method and a stacking system, the laser radar vision measurement technology is organically combined with the palletizing robot technology, so that the positioning problem of the palletizing robot in the container and the detection problem of the stacking quality of the container parts are solved.

title_en: Turning device for carton printing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a turnover device for carton printing, which comprises a first conveying mechanism and a second conveying mechanism which are sequentially arranged along the moving direction of a paperboard, wherein the turnover mechanism is arranged between the first conveying mechanism and the second conveying mechanism and comprises a fixed frame, a turntable is rotationally arranged on the fixed frame, a plurality of grooves are formed in the turntable, a first clamping component and a second clamping component are respectively arranged on two sides of each groove in the width direction, the first clamping component and the second clamping component are oppositely arranged and jointly enclose into an accommodating space for bearing the paperboard, the first clamping component is in sliding connection with the turntable, and the second clamping component is fixedly connected with the turntable. According to the invention, through the combined action of the first clamping assembly and the second clamping assembly, the paperboards with different widths and different thicknesses placed in the turnover mechanism are limited, so that the paperboards are prevented from moving in position in the turnover process, the accuracy of printing positioning is improved, and the quality of a printed finished product is improved.

title_en: Automatic laying device for communication pipeline
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic laying device for a communication pipeline, which relates to the field of communication pipeline construction and comprises a carrier, a bearing mechanism, a wire coil, a limiting mechanism, an adjusting mechanism, a locking mechanism and a lubricating mechanism, wherein the limiting mechanism is arranged at the top of the carrier and used for limiting a communication line in the wire coil, the adjusting mechanism is arranged at the top of the carrier and used for adjusting the outlet angle of the communication line, the locking mechanism is arranged inside the carrier and used for controlling the starting and stopping of a key pin shaft and the wire coil, the lubricating mechanism is arranged at the top of the carrier and used for smearing lubricant on the outer part of the communication line, and the supplying mechanism is used for supplying lubricant to the lubricating mechanism.

title_en: Stable conductive mechanical arm
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of mechanical arms, in particular to a stable conductive mechanical arm, which comprises a plurality of arm rods, wherein the adjacent arm rods are connected through rotary joints, the connecting ends of the adjacent two arm rods are axially staggered to form an axial gap, a ring sleeve is fixed in the axial gap on the surface of each arm rod, a plurality of electrode rings are axially distributed on the outer surface of each ring sleeve, a ring shell A and a ring shell B are respectively sleeved on the surfaces of the two ring sleeves in the axial gap, a plurality of electrode pieces in one-to-one alignment contact with the electrode rings are arranged on the surfaces of the ring shells A, a plurality of bending guide pieces are annularly distributed in the ring shells B, the joint part of the stable conductive mechanical arm is provided with a ring sleeve for installing the electrode rings, and the ring shells A and B with two split parts are fixedly pulled outside the ring sleeves through tangential screws, so that the bending guide pieces and the conductor rings are respectively in positioning contact with the electrode rings on two sides, the bending guide pieces are in rotary contact with the conductor rings, thereby realizing circuit conduction, and the external conductive circuit is convenient to install, disassemble and maintain.

title_en: Diode welding sorting device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of diode sorting, in particular to a diode welding and sorting device, which comprises a vibrating disc, wherein the lower side of the vibrating disc is connected with a plurality of sorting devices in series, each sorting device comprises a vertical tube, a first guide tube and a second guide tube are fixedly arranged in the upper end and the lower end of each vertical tube respectively, the lower ends of the first guide tubes and the upper ends of the second guide tubes are fixedly provided with flared conical tubes, the large diameter ends of the conical tubes are fixedly connected with the inner wall of the vertical tubes, a plurality of arc-shaped elastic sheets are annularly arranged between the two conical tubes in the vertical tubes, the lower ends of the arc-shaped elastic sheets are mutually closed, the inner side surfaces of the arc-shaped elastic sheets are provided with a plurality of uniformly distributed clamping grooves, a plurality of diodes can be distributed upwards through the sorting devices, and then the diodes can be continuously moved to the next automatic welding procedure to realize sorting by welding, and the direction of the diodes which are not facing to each other.

title_en: Isolation warning device for power equipment and operation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of safety operation of power equipment, and discloses an isolation warning device for the power equipment and an operation method thereof. The isolation warning device for the power equipment comprises a storage barrel, a winding mechanism, a warning belt and a plurality of isolation rods, wherein a storage cavity is formed in the storage barrel, a communication port communicated with the storage cavity is formed in one side surface of the storage barrel, the winding mechanism comprises a motor and a winding rod arranged in the storage cavity, the motor is fixed at the top of the storage barrel, the output end of the motor penetrates through the top of the storage barrel and is connected with the winding rod, one end of the warning belt penetrates through the communication port and is fixed on the winding rod, and the other end of the warning belt is connected to the outer side surface of the storage barrel; the plurality of isolation rods are configured to be inserted into the ground and used for expanding the warning belt and then surrounding the periphery of the power equipment. The isolation warning device for the power equipment and the operation method thereof can realize rapid and automatic winding of the warning belt, improve the automation degree of the isolation warning device, greatly reduce the working time and save time and labor.

title_en: Detection connection device and detection connection method for elevator stretching piece
abstract_en: The invention relates to a detection connection device and a detection connection method for an elevator stretching piece. The detection connecting device is provided with a plurality of electric connecting terminals and is detachably connected with the end part of an elevator stretching piece, the elevator stretching piece is used for suspending a lift car and/or a counterweight and is provided with a bearing part and a covering layer, the bearing part comprises a plurality of independent bearing core wires and is covered by the covering layer, one ends of the electric connecting terminals are respectively and correspondingly and electrically connected with the bearing core wires which are positioned at the end part and are exposed outwards after the detection connecting device is connected with the end part, and the other ends of the electric connecting terminals are respectively and electrically connected outwards. The elevator stretching piece can be conveniently and efficiently connected and the current state of the bearing core wire can be rapidly detected and obtained by adopting the scheme of the invention, and the elevator stretching piece is very suitable for being used in the processes of installation, use, maintenance operation and the like of the elevator stretching piece.

title_en: Body fluid noninvasive detection device and method based on spectral analysis
abstract_en: The invention provides a body fluid noninvasive detection device and method based on spectrum analysis, and relates to the technical field of body fluid detection. The body fluid noninvasive detection device based on spectral analysis comprises a body, wherein a first linear reciprocating mechanism is arranged on the body, an objective table is connected to the first linear reciprocating mechanism, a second linear reciprocating mechanism is arranged on the side face of the objective table, a pushing plate is connected to the second linear reciprocating mechanism, and the pushing plate is flush with the upper surface of the objective table; one side of the machine body is provided with a storage groove, and the position of the storage groove is matched with the limit position of the movement of the push plate. After the sample is detected, the self-cleaning and self-disinfection can be carried out on the placing platform, the cleaning mode and the disinfection mode are simple and reliable, the cleaning is not needed to be carried out by manual disassembly, and the labor intensity of manual work is reduced.

title_en: Power joint mechanism for humanoid robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power joint mechanism for a humanoid robot, which can simultaneously solve the problems of high-explosion and large-torque overload heat dissipation and easy saturation of a magnetic circuit of a stator yoke part, improve the continuous and large-torque capacity, the explosiveness and the overload capacity and has a relatively small volume of a heat dissipation device. It comprises the following steps: a speed reducer (1), a transmission shaft (2), a motor rotor (3), a motor stator (4), a stator yoke (5) and a joint member (6); the motor and the speed reducer are in linkage transmission through a transmission shaft, the motor stator and the joint are installed together by the joint component, the stator yoke part at the periphery of the motor stator extends along the periphery to form a plurality of installation position protrusions (51), and the matched heat conduction heat pipes (7) are welded at the grooves between two adjacent protrusions.

title_en: Crane operation monitoring system
abstract_en: The application discloses a crane operation monitoring system, relates to the technical field of engineering machinery safety monitoring, and solves the technical problem that the prior art does not fully consider the safety influence of environmental factors around a crane on the operation of the crane, so that a certain potential safety hazard exists in the operation state of the crane; the method comprises the steps of preprocessing monitoring video data, inputting the preprocessed monitoring video data into a personnel identification model to obtain personnel labels corresponding to the monitoring video data; when the personnel label is an irrelevant person, generating an irrelevant person approaching alarm signal; generating a fatigue early warning signal according to the vehicle working data; when the working state is a hanging state; the maximum height limit value is generated according to the wind speed data and the cargo data, and the maximum height alarm signal is generated with the lifting height, so that the influence factors of the surrounding environment of the crane during the working process and the influence of the wind speed during the lifting of the cargo are increased, and the safety during the working state of the crane is improved.

title_en: Non-electric triggering type hydrogen safety protection device and hydrogen transportation container comprising same
abstract_en: The invention provides a non-electric triggering type hydrogen safety protection device and a hydrogen transportation container comprising the same, which can be used for carrying out quick slow release on a hydrogen leakage safety accident, and can be used for carrying out emergency fire extinguishment by arranging an emergency fire extinguishing device and/or a ventilation structure in linkage with the non-electric triggering type hydrogen safety protection device, so that the leaked hydrogen is diluted efficiently and quickly, and finally, the batch safe transportation of hydrogen storage automobiles is realized. The non-electric triggering type hydrogen safety protection device is used as a locking piece of the explosion venting port and comprises a protection sleeve, a catalyst, a heat-sensitive safety structural part and a lock head, wherein the heat-sensitive safety structural part is a wire structural part made of low-melting-point alloy, the lock head is fixedly connected with the heat-sensitive safety structural part and locks the explosion venting port, the protection sleeve is a container for containing the catalyst and is sleeved on the outer surface of the heat-sensitive safety structural part, and a plurality of holes are formed in the wall surface of the protection sleeve so as to facilitate hydrogen to enter and contact the catalyst.

title_en: Conveying device for electroscope calibration
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of electroscope test, in particular to a conveying device for electroscope calibration, which comprises a driving roller, a conveying belt, a driving mechanism, a mounting plate, a direction detection mechanism, a reversing mechanism, a contraposition mechanism and a test mechanism, wherein the driving mechanism operates to drive the conveying belt and a positioning seat to intermittently feed leftwards, the feeding interval is the same each time, so that a plurality of electroscopes can be simultaneously conveyed to the position where the test mechanism is positioned, and the functionality of a plurality of electroscope is tested simultaneously through the cooperation between positioning mechanism and the testing mechanism, then the staff picks out the electroscope of which the function is impaired and carries out calibration work, and the mode of testing and calibration is higher than manual testing and calibration efficiency, and reduces the possibility that the staff touches the testing power supply by mistake and contacts, and is safer.

title_en: Engine DPF regeneration test method of crane
abstract_en: The application discloses a DPF regeneration test method for an engine of a crane, which can verify and check the regeneration effect of the DPF of the engine of the crane, has good representativeness and repeatability and strong operability, thereby providing powerful data support and making adaptive adjustment for the working condition of the vehicle of the automobile crane. The continuous operation method comprises the steps of controlling an engine of a crane to start, controlling the engine to perform DPF regeneration when the water temperature of the engine is determined to be higher than a preset temperature, controlling the crane to continuously operate for a first preset time, wherein the continuous operation comprises the steps of sequentially performing non-expanding arm loading operation, non-expanding arm rotation operation, extending arm operation, swing arm operation, arm shrinkage operation, maximum arm expanding loading operation and maximum arm expanding rotation operation, and controlling the crane to intermittently operate for a second preset time after the continuous operation of the crane reaches the first preset time.

title_en: Rotary paper sucking mechanism and method for packaging production line
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rotary paper sucking mechanism and a method for a packaging production line, wherein when a first rocker arm of the rotary paper sucking mechanism rotates clockwise, a sucker shaft revolves around a first supporting shaft as the center of a circle, and simultaneously, the sucker shaft is driven to rotate anticlockwise at a rotation speed which is 1.5 times through a first gear, a first transition gear and a second gear, when the second rocker arm rotates clockwise, the sucker shaft revolves around a second supporting shaft as the center of a circle, and simultaneously, a gas distribution disc is driven to rotate anticlockwise at the same rotation speed through a third gear, a second transition gear and a fourth gear, the rotation speeds of the sucker shaft and the gas distribution disc are inconsistent, and the vacuum on-off of a gas path is controlled through the relative rotation of the gas distribution disc and the sucker shaft. The rotary paper sucking mechanism for the packaging production line has the advantages of small occupied space and high paper sucking efficiency.

title_en: Eight division conductor spacer grabbing device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an eight-split spacer grabbing device which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle, a fixing frame and a manipulator, wherein a fixing pipe is arranged at the bottom of the fixing frame and extends to the outside of the fixing frame, an opening is formed in the lower part of the fixing pipe, a movable adjusting assembly is arranged in the fixing pipe, the end part of the manipulator is connected to the movable adjusting assembly, and the manipulator is arranged on the movable adjusting assembly below the fixing frame, so that when the eight-split spacer grabbing device is used, the manipulator can be driven to axially move by controlling the movable adjusting assembly, the moving range of the manipulator is enlarged, and the flexibility of the manipulator is improved.

title_en: Vertical boxing machine
abstract_en: The invention provides a vertical boxing machine which comprises a frame, a turntable, a first folding mechanism, a second folding mechanism, a third folding mechanism and a fourth folding mechanism, wherein the turntable, the first folding mechanism, the second folding mechanism, the feeding station, the third folding station, the fourth folding station and the blanking station are arranged on the frame at equal intervals in sequence along the circumferential direction of the turntable, an assembly seat is arranged on each of the six stations and used for vertically fixing a box body, the first folding mechanism is used for folding two lower side lugs of the box body, the second folding mechanism is used for folding a lower cover of the box body, the third folding mechanism is used for folding two upper side lugs of the box body, and the fourth folding mechanism is used for folding an upper cover of the box body. The invention realizes full automation of product packaging, has high working efficiency, low cost and high mechanical assembly precision, and is not easy to break the packaging box.

title_en: Spiral conveying device for salt material discharging
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a screw conveying device for discharging salt materials, and relates to the technical field of salt material conveying. The spiral conveying device for salt material discharging comprises a material conveying mechanism and a vibration amplitude adjusting mechanism, wherein the vibration amplitude adjusting mechanism is positioned at the front end of the material conveying mechanism, the vibration anti-blocking mechanism is positioned at the upper part of the front end of the material conveying mechanism, the vibration anti-blocking mechanism is positioned at the rear end of the vibration amplitude adjusting mechanism, the material conveying mechanism is lifted upwards to drive the vibration amplitude adjusting mechanism, and the vibration amplitude adjusting mechanism is used for adjusting the vibration amplitude of the vibration anti-blocking mechanism. According to the lifting height of the transmission barrel, the degree of vibration and salt scattering is adjusted, the problem that salt is agglomerated and accumulated and remains in the feed hopper in the transmission process can be effectively reduced, the salt is uniformly distributed, and the stability of the salt transmission process is improved.

title_en: Packaging component
abstract_en: The invention provides a packaging member, which comprises a pallet with a pallet, an upper box, a buffer member and a slope plate. The pallet with pallet has pallet for placing packaged objects and pallet fixed on the lower surface of the pallet. The upper box is in a cylinder shape with an opening at the bottom surface and covers the side surface and the upper surface of the packaged object. The buffer member is placed between the packaged object and the upper case. The slope plate is connected with the pallet when moving the packaged objects placed on the pallet. The buffer member is disposed as a reinforcing table below a slope plate connected to the pallet with a pallet.

title_en: Brake component, driving device and robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mechanical equipment, and discloses a brake assembly, a driving device and a robot. The brake assembly comprises a brake friction disc, a friction plate, a brake armature, a brake limiting plate and a barrier structure, wherein a first hook groove is formed in the direction of the brake friction disc in an extending mode towards one side of the brake friction disc, a second hook groove is formed in the direction of the brake friction disc in an extending mode towards one side of the brake friction disc, and the barrier structure is formed on the inner side and the outer side of the friction plate by the first hook groove and the second hook groove, so that particle dust generated by collision of the brake friction disc in the braking process is blocked and collected, dust is prevented from entering key moving parts such as a rotating shaft, abrasion of the acceleration moving parts is avoided, the service life of the acceleration moving parts is guaranteed, and the operation reliability of a driving device provided with the brake assembly is improved.

title_en: Petrochemical environment corrosion resistant glass steel is anticorrosive with storage tank structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of glass fiber reinforced plastic storage tanks and discloses a petrochemical environment corrosion resistant glass fiber reinforced plastic corrosion resistant storage tank structure which comprises a tank body and a ladder fixedly connected to the outer wall of the tank body, wherein the top surface of the tank body is provided with a liquid inlet, a cleaning mechanism is arranged at the upper end inside the tank body and is used for cleaning a floating oil layer floating on the surface of petroleum, a driving mechanism is rotated by a worker and drives a mounting rod to rotate in an annular groove so as to limit the mounting rod and the driving mechanism, the mounting rod rotates to drive a cleaning assembly to rotate, the cleaning assembly rotates to clean the floating oil layer floating on the surface of petroleum, long-time floating of the floating oil layer is avoided, corrosion to the inner wall of the glass fiber reinforced plastic storage tank is avoided, and the situation that the service life of the glass fiber reinforced plastic storage tank is reduced is avoided, and the situation that impurities in the floating oil layer are mixed with petroleum and the purity of the petroleum is reduced is also avoided.

title_en: Mechanical arm track tracking control method and mechanical arm
abstract_en: The invention provides a mechanical arm track tracking control method and a mechanical arm, which comprise the steps of carrying out physical modeling on the mechanical arm to obtain a mechanical arm model, carrying out kinematic analysis on the mechanical arm model based on a DH method to optimize the mechanical arm model, carrying out track planning on preset fixed points of the optimized mechanical arm model by using a polynomial interpolation method of 3-5-3 times, and carrying out tracking control on the planned track by adopting a reinforcement learning algorithm. The method comprises the steps of preparing a model for subsequent track planning through kinematic analysis, ensuring the accuracy of the subsequent track planning, carrying out track planning through a polynomial interpolation method, ensuring that the motion track of the tail end of the mechanical arm meets the preset requirement, linking each joint with a connecting rod, carrying out tracking control on the track through a reinforcement learning algorithm, and timely adjusting and optimizing the motion track of the mechanical arm, thereby ensuring that the motion track of the mechanical arm meets the preset requirement in actual application, and solving the problem of poor motion track accuracy of the traditional mechanical arm.

title_en: Wire harness appearance and electrical property detection method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for detecting the appearance and the electrical property of a wire harness, which uses an integrated device for detecting the electrical property and the appearance, and comprises the steps that a worker respectively puts connection structures at two ends of a wire harness product into 2 profiling fixing mechanisms for fixing; the control device controls the electric sliding rail to operate, the wire harness product is conveyed to the position below the visual inspection device, the visual inspection device shoots images of the first connecting structure and the second connecting structure and uploads the images to the control device, the control device judges whether the appearance is qualified according to the images, if the appearance is qualified, the control device instructs the electric sliding rail to convey the wire harness product to the position below the two-dimensional code character detection device, the two-dimensional code character detection device scans the two-dimensional code on the second connecting structure and uploads the two-dimensional code to the control device, the control device associates the images with the two-dimensional code, then the electric sliding rail conveys the wire harness product to the position below the electrical property testing device, and the electrical property testing device tests the electrical property of the wire harness product.

title_en: Inflating device for food nitrogen-filling packaging machine and using method thereof
abstract_en: An air charging device for a food nitrogen charging packaging machine and a use method thereof belong to the field of foods.
