The air storage tank comprises an air storage tank body, wherein two air outlets are formed in the air storage tank body, one air outlet is communicated with an air supplementing tank through a pipe I, a control valve I is arranged on the pipe I, the other end of the air supplementing tank body is connected with an air outlet port through a pipe II, a control valve II is arranged on the pipe II, the other air outlet of the air storage tank body is communicated with the pipe II through a pipe III, and a control valve III and an air pump are arranged on the pipe III. According to the invention, the flow and pressure sensors are replaced by the displacement sensor, and the displacement sensor is arranged outside the equipment, so that the pipeline is not required to be disassembled for maintenance or replacement, the maintenance or replacement is more convenient, and the stability of the connection between the pipeline and the part is not required to be detected again after the maintenance or replacement, so that the possibility of air leakage at the connection position is reduced, and the unstable inflation amount caused by the air leakage at the connection position is effectively avoided.

title_en: Heavy sinking derrick for ultra-deep vertical shaft construction
abstract_en: The heavy sinking derrick for ultra-deep vertical shaft construction comprises a front side beam, side beams, a middle beam and movable beams, wherein the front side beams positioned on the front side and the rear side are rectangular and are fixedly connected with the two side beams positioned on the left side and the right side to form a rectangular frame structure, two ends of the two middle beams are respectively and fixedly connected with the middle parts of the two side beams, four movable beams are vertically arranged on the left parts and the right parts of the upper ends of the front side beams and the middle beams, each movable beam is connected with the front side beams and the middle beams through movable connection structures, four diagonal columns are uniformly distributed below the crown wheel platform in the circumferential direction, an M-shaped assembly, an upper transverse support piece, a W-shaped assembly, a lower transverse support piece and a splayed assembly are sequentially and fixedly connected between every two adjacent diagonal columns from top to bottom, and four diagonal column seats are respectively and fixedly connected with the lower ends of the four diagonal columns. The derrick can flexibly meet the operation requirement of suspending super-large work load in the construction process of the super-deep vertical shaft.

title_en: Magnetic bottom sealing machine for iron shell cup and assembling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an iron shell cup magnetic bottom sealing machine which comprises a workbench, a rotary table, a first vibrating tray, a first receiving mechanism and a first material taking mechanism, wherein the rotary table is arranged on the workbench, the rotary table is rotatable on the workbench, a plurality of first jigs are arranged on the rotary table at equal intervals, the first vibrating tray is arranged on the workbench, a first workpiece is placed in the first vibrating tray, the first receiving mechanism is arranged at a discharge hole of the first vibrating tray, the first receiving mechanism is movable along the width direction of the workbench and is suitable for receiving the first workpiece in the first vibrating tray and moving the first workpiece on the workbench, the material taking mechanism is arranged on the workbench and is arranged at the top of the first receiving mechanism at intervals, and the material taking mechanism is movable along the width direction of the workbench and is liftable along the vertical direction so as to be suitable for placing the first workpiece in the first receiving mechanism on the first jigs.

title_en: Cable crane and crossing type laying method for long-distance pipeline in complex terrain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cable crane and a crossing type paving method of a long pipeline in a complex terrain, comprising the following steps of 1 erecting the cable crane at the complex terrain according to a preset pipeline laying line, arranging support piers which are distributed at intervals along the pipeline laying line in sequence at the complex terrain, 2 hoisting the pipeline to be erected on the support piers one by the cable crane, and carrying out welding treatment on the two adjacent pipelines until the pipeline at the complex terrain is erected in a crossing way, so that the cable crane can be crossed over the complex terrain along the preset pipeline laying line in advance, then arranging the support piers according to the preset pipeline laying line at the complex terrain, and carrying out welding treatment on the butt joint ends of the two adjacent pipelines by the cable crane after the pipeline is dropped to the complex terrain area one by one.

title_en: Electronic faucet, method of conditioning a water or fluid source to a faucet, and method of controlling an electronic faucet
abstract_en: Electronic device (1) for controlling a tap (10), comprising a data processing unit (2) configured to receive at least one identification signal (S) of at least a first conditioned water source or fluid source (22) at an inlet and to store a logical association (30) between the at least first conditioned water source or fluid source (22) and the first inlet (12) in an at least partially automated manner, the electronic device (1) comprising at least a first command (3) for selecting to supply fluid from at least one of a plurality of inlets (12-15) to an outlet (16) of the tap (10), the at least first command (3) being operatively connected to the data processing unit (2), the data processing unit (2) being configured to assign the logical association (30) to the at least first command (3) such that the first command (3) when activated invokes the logical association (30) and causes to supply the outlet (16) of the tap (10) with fluid from the first conditioned water source or fluid source (22) on the first inlet (12).

title_en: Robot system
abstract_en: The robot system includes a robot having a plurality of operation axes, a robot controller that adjusts the posture of the operation axes by operating the plurality of operation axes, an acceleration sensor provided at a tip portion of the robot and measuring the gravitational acceleration of the tip portion, and a terminal device capable of communicating between the acceleration sensor and the robot controller. The robot control device causes the pose of the 1 st axis of motion to be at least 3 different poses, the terminal device stores 3 or more 1 st gravitational acceleration data detected by the acceleration sensor in each of the 3 or more poses, calculates a1 st rotational axis vector of the 1 st axis of motion in the three-dimensional space based on the 3 or more 1 st gravitational acceleration data, and calculates a correction parameter for correcting the pose shift of the robot based on the calculated 1 st rotational axis vector.

title_en: Auxiliary stable support frame for cultural wall installation and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of support frames and discloses an auxiliary stabilizing support frame for cultural wall installation and a method thereof, wherein the auxiliary stabilizing support frame for cultural wall installation comprises a base and pulleys arranged at the lower end of the base, a support column is arranged at the upper end of the base, a threaded rod is connected in the support column in a rotating mode, one end of the threaded rod is connected with an operation plate, the upper end of the operation plate is connected with a first square tube in a sliding mode, and a clamping device is hinged to the upper end of the first square tube. According to the invention, the second sliding rod is pushed to enable the second sliding rod to drive the sucker to be attached to the wall surface, the culture plate is connected with the wall surface by using the nail-free glue or the mounting nails, so that the mounting efficiency of the culture wall is improved, and the first sliding rod is used for driving the auxiliary supporting device to slide towards one end, so that the auxiliary supporting device can be matched with the sucker to support the lower end of the culture plate, and the support stability during mounting is further improved.

title_en: A fast-assembling box for diesel generating set
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quick-mounting box body for a diesel generator set, which relates to the technical field of transportation box bodies and comprises a bottom plate, a buffer frame, a first sliding plate, a second sliding plate, a first spring, a second spring and a movable base, wherein the bottom plate is provided with a first sliding groove, the first sliding plate is arranged in the first sliding groove in a sliding manner, the first spring is arranged between the first sliding groove and the first sliding plate, the buffer frame is provided with a second sliding groove, the second sliding plate is arranged in the second sliding groove in a sliding manner, the second spring is arranged between the second sliding groove and the second sliding plate, the bottom of the movable base is provided with an inserting block, the inserting block is movably arranged in the second sliding groove, the impact force is absorbed and relieved through the elastic force of the first spring, the impact force is prevented from being directly transmitted to the diesel generator set, and damage is avoided, and when the impact force is larger, the impact force and vibration from all directions in the transportation process are effectively absorbed and relieved through the elastic force of the second spring, and damage to the generator set due to vibration or shaking is avoided.

title_en: Conveying device for capacitor stainless steel shell production line
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of capacitor production and transportation, and discloses a conveying device for a capacitor stainless steel shell production line, which comprises a device base, wherein two groups of side baffles are symmetrically riveted at the upper end of the device base, four groups of first chain wheels are symmetrically distributed between the two groups of side baffles, the four groups of first chain wheels are respectively sleeved on two groups of first wheel shafts, two ends of each first wheel shaft are fixed through a first bearing seat and the side baffles, the two groups of first chain wheels on the same side are connected and driven through a first chain, and a conveying belt is arranged outside the two groups of first chains in a surrounding mode. According to the conveying device for the capacitor stainless steel shell production line, the first wheel shaft on the first synchronous chain wheel is caused to rotate by synchronous and same-direction transmission of the second synchronous chain wheel, and the plurality of groups of automatic dispensers on the second chain wheel are driven to do rotary motion by the connection transmission effect of the second chain wheel and the second chain wheel, so that the purposes of saving energy and reducing cost are achieved by sharing one power source.

title_en: Villa elevator intelligent control system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent control system and method for a villa elevator, which are used for confirming an elevator working mode, a normal working mode and a special working mode according to user groups, wherein in the special working mode, after an elevator door is automatically opened, a user enters an elevator car, at the moment, the elevator door is in a normally open state until the user presses a floor key, the elevator door is automatically closed and goes to a corresponding floor after being closed, after the elevator door reaches the corresponding floor, the elevator door is opened and kept in an open state until the user leaves the car, and after a second induction system in the car induces no power in the elevator, the elevator door is closed and waits for the next response. When the elevator door is in a normal open state in a special working mode, the elevator door is in a normal open state, so that the old can conveniently enter and exit the elevator, the elevator door can be closed only by pressing a corresponding floor key, and the old and children can freely enter and exit the elevator when the floor key is not pressed, so that the old and the children are prevented from being trapped in the closed elevator, and the physical and mental health of the old and the children is ensured.

title_en: Robot aluminum alloy knuckle clamp
abstract_en: The invention discloses a robot aluminum alloy knuckle clamp which comprises a mounting seat, wherein a connecting flange is arranged on one side of the mounting seat, a left clamping arm and a right clamping arm are arranged on the other side of the mounting seat, the left clamping arm and the right clamping arm are arranged side by side, a telescopic mechanism is arranged on the connecting flange between the left clamping arm and the right clamping arm, the left clamping arm and the right clamping arm can be contracted or expanded under the action of the telescopic mechanism, and flexible clamps are fixed on the opposite sides of the left clamping arm and the right clamping arm. By adopting the structure, the robot aluminum alloy steering knuckle clamp is installed on the robot through the connecting flange, and the flexible clamp is adopted, so that the damage to the aluminum alloy steering knuckle can be avoided, and the quality of products is improved.

title_en: A safe type transfer device for stem cell detects
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safe transfer device for stem cell detection, which is characterized by comprising a vertical moving bin, a first transverse moving bin and a second transverse moving bin, and is characterized in that a supporting seat is arranged in the vertical moving bin and is connected with a height adjusting module, the height adjusting module comprises a displacement assembly and a driving assembly, the displacement assembly is used for displacing a cell sample in the vertical moving bin, the driving assembly is used for driving the displacement assembly to move, and the supporting seat is I-shaped and comprises an upper transverse plate, a lower transverse plate and a vertical plate connected with the upper transverse plate.

title_en: Pneumatic sampling device and method suitable for online detection of cigarette package tightness
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pneumatic sampling device and a pneumatic sampling method suitable for online detection of cigarette packaging tightness, and belongs to the technical field of detection in the tobacco industry. The automatic box sealing detection device comprises a multi-stage conveying mechanism, a feeding unit, an air conveying transfer unit, a mechanical arm and a box sealing detection unit, wherein the air conveying transfer unit is arranged between the output end of the multi-stage conveying mechanism and the input end of the feeding unit and is used for conveying a box to be detected from the output end of the multi-stage conveying mechanism to the input end of the feeding unit through air pressure, the mechanical arm is arranged at one side of the tail end of the feeding unit, the box sealing detection unit is arranged at the tail end of the feeding unit, and the mechanical arm is used for transferring the box to be detected from the feeding unit to the box sealing detection unit for sealing detection and taking the box to be detected out of the box sealing detection unit. The small box tightness air-assisted sampling on-line detection device has the advantages of being capable of realizing continuous on-line tightness detection and improving the detection efficiency of tightness of small boxes in a laboratory.

title_en: Automatic conveying device for three-dimensional sheep manure in sheep hurdle
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of livestock raising, in particular to an automatic conveying device for sheep manure in a three-dimensional sheep hurdle, which comprises a collecting chamber and is characterized in that a protective shell is arranged on one side of the collecting chamber, a cleaning device for cleaning the sheep manure in the conveying process is arranged in the protective shell, a conveying component for conveying the sheep manure is arranged on one side of the cleaning device, a cleaning component for cleaning the collecting chamber is arranged above the conveying component, a rotating component for cleaning the whole cleaning device is arranged in the cleaning device, a shaking-off device for conveying and collecting the sheep manure is arranged on one side of the cleaning device, and a sliding bottom plate for shaking off the collected sheep manure is arranged in the shaking-off device.

title_en: Transport robot for safety detection and safety detection system
abstract_en: The invention provides a transport robot for safety inspection and a safety inspection system, the transport robot comprising a robot body, an article loading device comprising a transfer mechanism mounted on the robot body, a support surface of the transfer mechanism being substantially flush with a transport surface of the safety inspection device to allow a target tray loaded with an article to be inspected transported on the safety inspection device to be partially translated onto the support surface and the transfer mechanism being configured to drive the target tray into or partially out of the support surface, and a universal movement device mounted on a lower portion of the robot body and configured to move the transport robot.

title_en: Portable ice crystal box made of flexible high-sealing material
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ice crystal boxes, in particular to a portable ice crystal box made of a flexible high-sealing material. Including installation piece and bottom plate, the bottom of installation piece is open mechanism, the box body is installed to the bottom of installation piece, the box body adopts soft high sealing material to make, the bottom plate is installed in the one end that the installation piece was kept away from to the box body, the top of box body is open structure, the water inlet is installed at the top of installation piece, threaded connection has the lid on the water inlet, the adjusting part that is used for adjusting interval between installation piece and the bottom plate is all installed to the both sides bottom of installation piece. The ice crystal box body is made of soft high-sealing materials, has good flexibility and sealing performance, can effectively prevent the ice crystal box from leaking in the use process, is convenient to carry and use, and is not easy to collide with a user.

title_en: Exoskeleton mechanical arm for inhibiting stationary tremor
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power-assisted mechanical arms, and particularly relates to an exoskeleton mechanical arm capable of inhibiting static tremble, which comprises a self-adaptive damping type vibration prevention mechanism, a damping manual preload assembly, a palm fixing mechanism, a forearm fixing mechanism and a forearm fixing mechanism, wherein two groups of self-adaptive damping type vibration prevention mechanisms are arranged, the palm fixing mechanism and the forearm fixing mechanism are in rotational connection through the self-adaptive damping type vibration prevention mechanism, and the forearm fixing mechanism are in rotational connection through the self-adaptive damping type vibration prevention mechanism. According to the invention, through the technical scheme of combining the hydraulic suppression mode and the motor suppression mode, the high-speed response is performed in the initial stage of the high-frequency tremble action in a hydraulic suppression mode, and then the electric control mechanism with general precision is assisted, so that the better technical effect can be realized at lower cost.

title_en: Robot with batch stacking planning function
abstract_en: The invention provides a robot with batch stack type planning, which comprises a sensing unit, a processing unit, a human-computer interface, an input unit, a robot body and a driving unit, wherein the sensing unit comprises cameras arranged at a plurality of different angles and is used for collecting operation environment images, determining the position of a stacking area and materials and the stacking position of the materials, the processing unit is loaded with simulation software and is used for determining various data required by batch stack type planning according to trigger indication information input by the input unit, the processing unit automatically performs stack type planning according to the data to obtain N reference stack types, and the robot body executes stacking tasks according to the planned stack types under the control of the driving unit. Therefore, batch stack type planning of various different materials and different trays can be performed, the stack type planning capability is greatly improved by combining a stack type planning algorithm and a manual auxiliary planning mode, the planning efficiency is high, and the method is suitable for scenes with huge quantity and various materials and has high reliability.

title_en: Automatic filling combined production line and process for large and small bottles
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic large and small bottle filling combination production line and process, comprising a first conveying line and a second conveying line which are arranged in parallel, a large bottle feeding unit, a first filling unit and a first cap screwing unit which are sequentially arranged along the first conveying line, a small bottle feeding unit, a second filling unit and a second cap screwing unit which are sequentially arranged along the second conveying line, a large and small bottle combination mechanism arranged at the common tail end of the first conveying line and the second conveying line, a first conveying mechanism and a second conveying mechanism which respectively convey bottles at the tail ends of the first conveying line and the second conveying line to the large and small bottle combination mechanism, a blanking conveying line which is positioned beside the large and small bottle combination mechanism, and a third conveying mechanism which takes out the combined large and small bottles from the large and small bottle combination mechanism and places the combined large and small bottles on the blanking conveying line. The invention can efficiently realize independent filling of the big bottle and the small bottle and automatic combination output of the big bottle and the small bottle, greatly improves the production efficiency and meets the production process requirement.

title_en: Carbon fiber thermoplastic composite material box and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a carbon fiber thermoplastic composite material box body and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of box body forming. The method comprises the steps of S1, arranging carbon fiber thermoplastic prepregs according to a set layer number to obtain a laminated blank, preheating, S2, carrying out hot press molding on laminated blank areas forming a box body flat plate part, keeping a softened state between adjacent areas to obtain box body flat plates which are distributed and arranged on the laminated blank, S3, carrying out hot stamping on the laminated blank which is kept in the softened state to obtain bulges with the same stamping direction, and S4, carrying out heating bending on the bulged parts of the laminated blank to enable the box body flat plates to enclose a box body structure. The components of the box body are solidified and molded in steps, namely uncured pore channels are reserved in the laminated green body during the first hot press molding, which is favorable for resin flow and gas escape in the laminated structure, so that micro defects are eliminated, and the stability of the product performance is improved.

title_en: Fabric conveying device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fabric conveying device, and belongs to the field of textile processing mechanical equipment. The invention comprises a main support, an upper conveying mechanism and a lower conveying mechanism, wherein the upper conveying mechanism and the lower conveying mechanism are sequentially and horizontally arranged on the upper side of the main support from top to bottom, the discharge end of the upper conveying mechanism is arranged on the upper side of the feed end of the lower conveying mechanism, the upper conveying motor drives the upper conveying belt, the lower conveying motor drives the lower conveying belt, the feed end of the lower conveying support is hinged on the upper side of the main support, the upper side of the main support is provided with a circular arc-shaped guide rail, the two sides below the lower conveying support are respectively provided with guide rollers matched with the circular arc-shaped guide rail, a rotary hydraulic cylinder is horizontally arranged between the lower conveying support and the main support, and two ends of one side of the main support are respectively provided with a material supporting frame. The invention has simple structure, can rapidly, efficiently and continuously convey and split the fabric, improves the efficiency of fabric production and processing, and meets the use requirement.

title_en: 5G-based distress system and villa elevator
abstract_en: The application provides a 5G-based distress system and a villa elevator, which comprise a sensor module. The system has the advantages that the call signal and the video stream can be transmitted in real time, the call center can quickly receive and respond to emergency call, the rescue time is shortened, the life safety is improved, the situation of occurrence of an event can be timely known by the call center through real-time monitoring and tracking of the state and emergency of a villa elevator, the accuracy and the effectiveness of the rescue measure are ensured, the precaution measures are taken, the probability of occurrence of the accident is reduced, the safety and the reliability are improved, the call center and related departments and rescue institutions are tightly cooperated, rescue resources can be quickly coordinated and scheduled, accurate position information is provided, the efficiency and the utilization rate of the rescue resources are improved, residents can conveniently send emergency call signals through mobile application programs, the sound and visual alarm are received, the convenience and accessibility of call help are improved, and the safety sense of residents is enhanced.

title_en: Stable chain type conveying equipment for automobile parts
abstract_en: The invention discloses stable chain type conveying equipment for automobile parts, which relates to the technical field of automobile part production and comprises a main body frame, wherein the main body frame comprises a mounting plate arranged on the main body frame, a thrust mechanism comprises a plurality of thrust rods arranged on the mounting plate, a rotary gear is fixedly arranged on the surface of each thrust rod and meshed with a rack rod, a magnetic attraction mechanism is used for driving the thrust rods to limit a part box, a swing mechanism is used for accelerating the conveying speed of the part box through the thrust rods, the limiting mechanism is used for limiting the thrust rods to reset, a driving mechanism is used for driving the thrust rods to drive the part box to move, the upward movement of the rack rods drives the rotary gear to anticlockwise rotate and then drive the thrust rods to rotate, the opposite thrust rods synchronously rotate, at the moment, the downward sliding part box is blocked by the thrust rods to move upwards, and the part box is stably conveyed in an ascending stage through the supporting function of the thrust rods, so that the purpose of preventing slipping is achieved.

title_en: Automatic sample conveying equipment for pathology laboratory and use method of automatic sample conveying equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a pathology laboratory sample automatic conveying equipment and a using method thereof, relating to the technical field of pathology sample conveying, and comprising the following steps: the automatic sample conveying device comprises a first conveying device and an interception component, wherein a test tube rack is arranged on the first conveying device, a sample test tube is arranged on the test tube rack, a fixing convex plate is fixedly connected to the top of the first conveying device, a supporting vertical plate is fixedly connected to the top of the fixing convex plate, a connecting transverse plate is fixedly connected between the supporting vertical plates, first lugs are fixedly connected to one side of the connecting transverse plate, guide holes are formed in the first lugs, second lugs are fixedly connected to the middle of the same side of the connecting transverse plate, clamping rotating shaft holes are formed in the second lugs, clamping rotating shaft columns are arranged in the clamping rotating shaft holes in a rotating mode, the flexibility of the automatic sample conveying device is improved through the arrangement of the interception component, special samples can be conveyed preferentially, the detection efficiency of the special samples is improved, and the problems that the device lacks flexibility and the special sample detection time is prolonged are solved.

title_en: Ascending protection device for pole-mounted operation
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a climbing protection device for pole-mounted operation, and relates to the technical field of protection equipment. The climbing protection device for pole-mounted operation comprises a climbing module, a fixing module and a control module, wherein the fixing module is connected with the climbing module, the control module is in communication connection with the fixing module and is used for sending a fixing signal to the fixing module when a climbing instruction is received, and the fixing module is used for encircling a line carrier pole after receiving the fixing signal and fixing the climbing module on the line carrier pole. The climbing protection device for the pole-mounted operation provided by the embodiment of the invention realizes the fixation of the climbing module automatically, ensures the safety of operators, does not need extra manpower to protect the operators on the climbing module, and saves the manpower.

title_en: Robot exhibition hall multi-machine linkage coordination system and method based on private deployment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a private deployment-based robot exhibition hall multi-machine linkage collaboration system and method, wherein the system comprises a terminal and an edge end, the terminal comprises a robot and a second-level terminal device, the robot is used for collecting information data of a current exhibition hall scene in real time, the information data comprises user voice, the edge end is used for converting the user voice into a text, returning the reply text based on the text, carrying out semantic disassembly on the reply text to generate a robot task scheduling instruction, and sending the robot task scheduling instruction to the robot through a local area network to enable the robot to disassemble the instruction and distribute the robot to the second-level terminal device for operation, and the system has the advantages that all preprocessing data collected in an exhibition hall are not required to be uploaded to a cloud for calculation and issuing, but are directly subjected to calculation processing at the edge end, so that the requirement on network bandwidth is reduced, the response timeliness of the robot is improved, and meanwhile, the risk of data leakage in the process of uploading the data to the cloud is avoided.

title_en: Water collection assembly for surface water quality monitoring device
abstract_en: The invention provides a water collecting assembly for a surface water quality monitoring device, which belongs to the technical field of water quality monitoring and comprises a box body, wherein a partition plate is arranged in the box body, a telescopic mechanism is arranged on the upper surface of the partition plate, the telescopic mechanism comprises a main movable plate, a C-shaped sliding block is arranged at the right end of the rear side of the main movable plate, a first auxiliary movable plate is movably connected with the right end of the rear side of the C-shaped sliding block, a second auxiliary movable plate is movably connected with the right end of the rear side of the first auxiliary movable plate through the C-shaped sliding block, five groups of second auxiliary movable plates are arranged, and when the device is not used, the main movable plate, the first auxiliary movable plate and the second auxiliary movable plate are all retracted into the box body, and all the movable plates are positioned on the same plane, so that the device can be horizontally moved for the same length, meanwhile, too much occupied space can be avoided when the device is stored, the device is convenient to carry and store by workers, the probability is reduced, and the practicability is higher.

title_en: System and method for monitoring running state of passive mine cage
abstract_en: The invention discloses a passive mine cage running state monitoring system and method, which relate to the technical field of mine cage running state monitoring and comprise a cage body and a remote monitoring terminal, wherein the remote monitoring terminal is communicated with the cage body through a radio receiving box at a wellhead and is communicated with a winch room control box through a data bus, a roller cage ear, a flywheel energy storage device, a cage external monitoring sensor group, a cage internal monitoring sensor group, a substation and a radio transmitting box are arranged on the cage body, and the cage external monitoring sensor group comprises a pressure sensor, a laser range finder, a vibration sensor and a displacement sensor, and comprises a high-definition camera, voice communication equipment and an audible and visual alarm. The invention can realize continuous monitoring of the running state of the mine cage, improve the running stability and safety of the cage and promote the intelligent development of underground cage operation.

title_en: Automatic lifting and lowering control system for oil rig derrick base
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic lifting control system of a derrick base of an oil rig, which comprises a control operation box, a first hydraulic winch, a second hydraulic winch, a first safety tongs, a second safety tongs, a first displacement sensor, a second displacement sensor, a first buffer hydraulic cylinder, a second buffer hydraulic cylinder and a control unit, wherein an oil inlet, an oil return port and an oil drain port are arranged on the control operation box, and the oil inlet is respectively connected with the oil inlets of a first throttle valve and a multi-way valve.

title_en: Automatic processing system for end quenching sample
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of end quenching sample processing equipment, and particularly relates to an end quenching sample automatic processing system which comprises a feeding platform, a visual detection mechanism, a joint robot, a sample processing center and a PLC (programmable logic controller), wherein the feeding platform is used for feeding and positioning samples, the visual detection mechanism is used for detecting angles of the samples, the joint robot is used for clamping, transporting and adjusting the angles of the samples, a clamping turnover mechanism is arranged at the end part of the joint robot and comprises an L-shaped plate, a clamping cylinder and a chuck, the L-shaped plate is arranged on a turnover motor at the end part of the joint robot, the clamping cylinder is arranged at the end part of the L-shaped plate, the chuck is arranged on a clamping jaw of the clamping cylinder, the clamping rotation center of the chuck is concentric with the rotation center of the L-shaped plate, the sample processing center is used for processing the samples, and the PLC is used for program control of the processing system. The invention can realize the automatic processing of the end quenching sample, improves the processing efficiency of the end quenching sample and improves the production benefit of enterprises.

title_en: Robot control method and system based on large language model
abstract_en: The invention provides a robot control method and a robot control system based on a large language model, which adopts a double large language model evaluation mechanism, a large language model of a code generation and modification module uses Claude 3.5sonnet to generate a control class code, and then an evaluation model adopting gpt-4o of OpenAI is adopted to put forward evaluation to optimize suggestions, so that the risk that problems are difficult to find because of homogenization of the same module is reduced, the generation quality, safety and security are improved, besides the double large language model evaluation mechanism, the safety class prompt word is added into a prompt word of the generation model, and a generation template example is provided, the operation of the code generation and modification module in a specific frame can be limited, the possibility of error occurrence is reduced, the specification and safety of the generation effect are further provided, and in addition, a control class verification module can build a simple simulation environment after the control class code is generated, the grammar error and logic error of the generated code can be screened in advance, and the potential safety hazard is further reduced.

title_en: Adhesive tape and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of adhesive tape processing, in particular to an adhesive tape and a preparation process thereof, wherein the adhesive tape comprises the following steps of firstly, respectively placing cut paper drums between a plurality of partition boards 404 by workers, rolling the paper drums onto a drum penetrating table 401 by utilizing inclined planes of material guide boards 403, secondly, enabling a plurality of positioning pieces 303 to slide outwards simultaneously by utilizing a winding drum 101 to penetrate through the paper drums, positioning the paper drums by utilizing a poking board 201, thirdly, fixing the winding drum 101 and an inserting rod 504 by utilizing a positioning pin, driving the inserting rod 504 to rotate by controlling a second motor 502 so as to wind the adhesive tape, fourthly, compacting the adhesive tape by controlling a pressing roller 602 to be in contact with the surface of the winding drum 101, and cleaning the surface of the adhesive tape, and fifthly, removing the winding drum 101, and taking out the adhesive tape roll.

title_en: Shell lifting device for assembling speed reducer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a shell lifting device for assembling a speed reducer, which relates to the technical field of lifting and comprises a shell conveying mechanism, a lifting table, a lifting frame and a movable rod, wherein the shell conveying mechanism and the lifting table are arranged below the lifting frame, a linear moving module is arranged on the lifting frame, a slidable moving frame is arranged on the linear moving module, a lifting mechanism is arranged on the moving frame, two parallel supporting frames are fixed at the bottom of the lifting mechanism, a first driving mechanism is fixed on one supporting frame, a locking mechanism is fixed on the other supporting frame, the movable rod comprises an integrated screw part and an inserting part, the first driving mechanism drives the connecting screw part, the inserting part is arranged on a lifting ring of the shell in a penetrating manner, the outer end of the inserting part can be locked at the position of the locking mechanism, and the shell lifting device can automatically lift the shell, and is time-saving and labor-saving.

title_en: Clamping device for gluing hollow suspension axle
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of clamping equipment, and particularly discloses a clamping device for gluing an empty suspension axle, which comprises a base, a rotary table, a supporting table and a mounting seat, wherein a protection mechanism comprises a rotary table, a sleeve, a protection rope, a connecting piece and an anti-rotation component, the rotary table is arranged on the rotary table, the sleeve is rotatably sleeved on the outer side of the rotary table, the connecting piece is used for detachably connecting the end part of the protection rope to the sleeve, the anti-rotation component comprises a balancing weight, a bag body, a branch pipe, a limiting piece and a blocking part, the balancing weight is slidably arranged in the rotary table, the bag body is arranged between the balancing weight and the rotary table, one end of the branch pipe is communicated with the bag body, the other end of the branch pipe is closed, the limiting piece is slidably arranged in the sleeve, the limiting piece is connected with one closed end of the branch pipe, and the blocking part is used for limiting the rotation of the limiting piece. The application maintains the protective rope in a tensioning state, thereby limiting the axle position through the protective rope and preventing the axle from falling accidentally.

title_en: Stacker crane clamping device
abstract_en: The invention provides a stacker crane clamping device, and relates to the field of stacker cranes. This hacking machine clamping device, including being used for accepting the gliding swash plate of material and being used for the tight pile up neatly platform of material, the bottom fixed mounting of swash plate has the loading board that is used for placing the material, and pile up neatly platform sets up in one side that the swash plate was kept away from to the loading board, and loading board and pile up neatly platform's top is provided with the overhead crane that is used for carrying the material, and the fixed mounting of the upper and lower mobile end of overhead crane has the electro-magnet that attracts the material, pile up neatly platform includes pneumatic telescopic sleeve. This hacking machine clamping device through overturn or not overturn the material in loading board department, hangs the material hoist and mount to pile up neatly platform top, can pneumatic telescopic link extrude the material and make adjacent material hug closely the back and carry out spacing through the electromagnetic plate to hugging closely the material and avoid shifting, through the position of adjusting the push pedal, can both extrude the material when just putting and putting the material in turn to can avoid appearing the loose problem of stack.

title_en: Multi-row uniform-layer stacked material homogenization method
abstract_en: The application discloses a multi-row equal-layer stacked material homogenizing method, which belongs to the technical field of stacking and comprises the following steps of S1, selecting a beam stacker, S2, arranging a lifting type distributing device under the beam stacker, arranging a plurality of discharging openings at equal intervals according to the width of a stacking field, carrying out overflow type discharging on materials through the discharging openings of the distributing device, S3, starting stacking from a starting point A and moving to a terminal point B by the beam stacker, turning from the point B to the point A, reversely running the stacking machine along an initial path, carrying out stacking, reaching the starting point A, and then carrying out recycle and reciprocation so as to form a plurality of longitudinal material layers covering the whole stacking field length, wherein when the first layer stacking is carried out, the initial position of the distributing device is at the lowest point, after each layer stacking is completed, the distributing device is lifted to a set height, and the distributing device is driven by the stacking machine to reciprocate according to a preset speed until the requirement of the storage quantity is met.

title_en: Automatic disc arranging machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automatic tray arranging machine which comprises a machine case, a tray arranging device, a feeding device, a discharging device, a recovery mechanism and a plurality of feeding devices, wherein the tray arranging device, the feeding device, the discharging device, the recovery mechanism and the feeding devices are arranged in the machine case, the tray arranging device is provided with a first conveying mechanism, the feeding device is arranged on one side of the tray arranging device and is connected with a feeding end of the first conveying mechanism, the discharging device is arranged on the other side of the tray arranging device and is connected with the first conveying mechanism, each feeding device is arranged above the tray arranging device, and the recovery mechanism is positioned on one side of the tray arranging device and is used for collecting residual materials in the tray arranging device. According to the invention, the first motor is used for driving the rotating assembly to rotate so as to drive the whole tray mechanism to shake the tray at 360 degrees in the plane where the turnover frame is located, so that the tray can be filled with the grooves of the tray at one time, after the material is filled, the whole tray mechanism is pushed to incline backwards, and the residual material particles in the placing groove are poured out from one side of the movable side plate and fall into the second conveying mechanism, so that the material is finally collected in the recovery bin for continuous use, and the manual operation is effectively reduced.

title_en: Error self-calibration method, device, equipment, system and medium for multi-joint mechanical arm
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method, a device, equipment, a system and a medium for self-calibrating errors of a multi-joint mechanical arm, in particular to the technical field of self-calibrating errors, wherein an objective function for self-calibrating errors of the multi-joint mechanical arm is established according to a kinematic model, a geometric error model and a deformation error model of terminal equipment of the multi-joint mechanical arm which are respectively established, the objective function is utilized to carry out iterative calculation according to a set iterative dataset and a target jacobian matrix and a target iterative step length, the positioning precision value of the multi-joint mechanical arm is obtained by utilizing the objective function, and when the positioning precision value is smaller than a preset value, the iteration is ended and the self-calibrating operation of the errors of the multi-joint mechanical arm is completed.

title_en: Foot-operated maintenance protection device for elevator pit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pedal type maintenance protection device for an elevator pit, which comprises a pedal device and a supporting device, wherein the pedal device is connected with the supporting device through a triggering device, and is trampled, the supporting device can be enabled to act through the triggering device, so that the supporting device can support an elevator car to provide a maintenance space. After maintenance is completed, the supporting rod can be reset through a manual pressing mode, the pedal device can be installed at a proper position in the pit as required, the pedal device can be trampled when maintenance personnel enter the pit, the use is convenient, and the protection effect on the maintenance personnel is improved.

title_en: Double-arm wheel type linear lifting universal intelligent robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-arm wheel type linear lifting universal intelligent robot, which relates to the technical field of intelligent robots and comprises a movable chassis, a robot body and a multi-stage spiral lifting mechanism, wherein the connecting piece spiral lifting mechanism comprises a fixed shell, a rotary power source and a multi-stage transmission assembly, the connecting piece multi-stage transmission assembly is in transmission connection with the connecting piece rotary power source, the connecting piece multi-stage transmission assembly at least comprises a primary transmission assembly and a secondary transmission assembly, and the primary transmission assembly and the secondary transmission assembly comprise a screw rod, a nut and an inner telescopic shell and an outer telescopic shell so as to realize multi-stage nested linkage. According to the invention, the multistage spiral lifting mechanism is adopted to connect the mobile chassis and the robot body, and the synchronous expansion of the telescopic shells of the two-stage and even multistage transmission assembly is realized through the linkage among the screw rod, the nut, the telescopic inner shell and the telescopic outer shell, so that the robot body has a wider operation space due to the fact that the telescopic shells have enough extension distance during extension and minimum value during contraction.

title_en: Automatic stacking and turning blanking equipment for fins
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fin production equipment, and particularly discloses automatic stacking and turning blanking equipment for fins, which comprises a base, wherein a collecting station, a changing station, a turning station and a blanking station are sequentially arranged on the base, a rotating disc is rotationally connected to the changing station, two collecting trucks are jointly and slidably connected to the collecting station, collecting guide grooves are jointly arranged on the collecting station and the rotating disc, a part of semicircular turning guide groove is jointly arranged on the turning station and the rotating disc, the two collecting trucks are in one-to-one corresponding guide connection with the collecting guide grooves and the turning guide grooves, a supporting plate is movably carried on each collecting truck, a collecting frame is movably carried on the supporting plate, the supporting plate and the collecting frame are movably sleeved on collecting needles of the collecting trucks, two lifting mechanisms are arranged on the collecting station at intervals, and a turning blanking mechanism is arranged on the blanking station. According to the invention, through four working procedures, automatic treatment from stacking to blanking of the fins is realized, so that the production efficiency is improved, and the production cost is reduced.

title_en: Automatic counting sub-packaging control system based on machine vision
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of sub-packaging control, and discloses an automatic counting sub-packaging control system based on machine vision, which comprises an image acquisition unit, an image processing unit, an image segmentation unit, an image analysis unit and a sub-packaging control unit; the image classification and identification method comprises the steps of converting a color image into a gray level image, adopting a median or mean filtering algorithm to effectively remove image noise points, accurately determining the edges of materials by using a Canny edge detection algorithm in an image segmentation stage to generate a high-quality edge image, extracting shape characteristics such as circularity, area perimeter ratio and the like in an image analysis link, and comparing the material characteristics by using an Euclidean distance algorithm. The sub-packaging control unit completes packaging distribution according to a preset rule based on the material type and shape characteristics, ensures accurate quantity proportioning, and in addition, each unit of the system works cooperatively to construct a complete and efficient automatic counting sub-packaging process.

title_en: Humanoid robot control method based on image segmentation
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a humanoid robot control method based on image segmentation. Belongs to the technical field of robots. The method comprises the steps of obtaining image information about a target object, dividing the image information of the target object based on an instance division algorithm to obtain a target area corresponding to the target object, obtaining point cloud information corresponding to the target area according to the image information, calculating position information of the target object according to coordinate information in the point cloud information, carrying out principal component analysis on the point cloud information to obtain direction information of the target object, determining grabbing control information of an end effector according to the position information and the direction information of the target object, and controlling the end effector to grab the target object according to the grabbing control information. The method can improve the calculation accuracy of the position information of the target object in the complex scene, thereby being beneficial to improving the grabbing success rate in the scene.

title_en: Electric traction contact net lower train carriage bulk material unloading device and operation method
abstract_en: The electric traction contact net lower train carriage bulk material unloading device comprises a walking trolley, a frame lifting upright post arranged on the walking trolley, a horizontal cantilever beam arranged at the top of the frame lifting upright post, a vertical connecting arm movably connected with the end part of the horizontal cantilever beam, a vertical conveying pipe arranged on the vertical connecting arm and communicated with the horizontal conveying pipe, a second axial rotation of the vertical connecting arm relative to the first horizontal cantilever Liang Raodi, a second axial rotation of the vertical connecting arm, a material sucking working head arranged at the end part of the vertical connecting arm and communicated with the vertical conveying pipe, wherein the material sucking working head comprises a negative pressure material sucking nozzle communicated with the vertical conveying pipe, and a rotary platform for controlling the horizontal cantilever beam to horizontally rotate around the axis of the frame lifting upright post. The invention is used for sucking and discharging materials in the train carriage, has flexible use and can not interfere with an electric traction contact net in the working process.

title_en: Automatic soft drink making and selling machine-based visual positioning method and system for cup receiving position of manipulator
abstract_en: The invention relates to a visual positioning method and a visual positioning system for a cup receiving position of a manipulator based on an automatic soft drink vending machine, and belongs to the technical field of automatic intelligent manufacturing. According to the method, a visual positioning module is triggered by a manipulator, a real-time image is acquired by using a global camera, cup body detection is performed by a lightweight target detection model, and grabbing coordinates are generated by combining pose data of the manipulator. The system comprises a motion triggering unit, a target detection unit and a fusion positioning unit, can realize accurate and rapid cup receiving position positioning, adapts to complex environments and improves positioning robustness and reliability.

title_en: Humanoid quantum robot capable of magnetizing human body magnetic field through handshake
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of robots and discloses a humanoid quantum robot capable of magnetizing a human magnetic field through handshake, which comprises a humanoid robot body, a magnetizing module, a sensing module, a quantum computing processor and a cloud server, wherein the magnetizing module is fixedly embedded in the palm part of the humanoid robot body and is used for magnetizing the biological magnetic field of the hand part of a user when the magnetizing module is in handshake with the user, and the sensing module is used for acquiring multi-mode data of the user; the invention combines physical handshake action and magnetic field regulation technology through the rotating magnetic field design of the magnetization module, creates a new model of 'contact magnetic therapy interaction', senses the change of a biological magnetic field in real time through a magnetic field strength feedback unit, and remarkably improves interestingness and technological sense.

title_en: Automobile sealing strip rubberizing device and rubberizing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automobile sealing strip rubberizing device and rubberizing method, comprising a back plate, wherein an adhesive tape output mechanism is arranged at one side end part of the back plate, the adhesive tape output mechanism comprises a base box, a base sleeve and a plurality of groups of adhesive tape rolls rotatably arranged on the base sleeve, a driving component is arranged in the base box, vertical rods extend downwards at the base sleeve parts at two sides of each group of adhesive tape rolls, a front edge plate is fixed at the bottom end of each vertical rod, an adhesive tape positioning wheel is arranged at the front end of each front edge plate, a first group of adhesive tape rolls are positioned at a feeding position in an initial state, the adhesive tape starting ends of the adhesive tape rolls outside the first group are pulled out and stuck and fixed at the adhesive tape positioning wheel, an infrared sensor is arranged at one side of the base box, which is positioned at the first group of adhesive tape rolls, after the output of the adhesive tape is detected, the driving component is started, the next group of adhesive tape rolls are moved to the feeding position, and the adhesive tape at the tail ends of the previous group of adhesive tape rolls can drop to the positioning wheel to be lapped with the adhesive tape starting ends of the adhesive tape rolls positioned at the feeding position, and the adhesive tape starting ends of the adhesive tape rolls are continuously conveyed.

title_en: Four-degree-of-freedom parallel mechanism based on wheel type driving
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of parallel robots, and particularly relates to a four-degree-of-freedom parallel mechanism based on wheel driving, which comprises a movable platform, wherein parallelogram structures with offset angles are symmetrically arranged on the left side and the right side of the upper surface of the movable platform, the movable platform is connected with a branched chain structure through the parallelogram structures with offset angles, and an output platform is connected below the movable platform.

title_en: Robot system and robot safety control method
abstract_en: The application provides a robot system and a safety control method of a robot. The robot system comprises an upper computer and a robot, wherein the upper computer is configured to acquire safety configuration information, the robot comprises a safety component, the safety component is configured with a safety sensing function and a safety control function, the safety component acquires the safety configuration information from the upper computer, and the safety component outputs a safety control strategy based on the current state information and the safety configuration information of the robot so as to control the robot to execute safety operation. In this way, the application can improve the flexibility of the safety function configuration of the robot and the efficiency of the safety control of the robot.

title_en: Intelligent centralized grounding box for railway traction station
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of grounding, and discloses an intelligent centralized grounding box for a railway traction station, which comprises a centralized grounding box main body and further comprises: and the grounding assembly is fixedly arranged in the centralized grounding box body. According to the invention, the transmission assembly drives the negative pin rod to rotate so as to wind the nylon rope and the connecting cable at the lower end, so that the nylon rope and the connecting cable at the lower end are wound outside the negative pin rod, a plurality of devices are conducted with the standby grounding busbar in the grounding assembly, one of the devices is conducted with the main grounding busbar through the transmission assembly, the grounding of one of the devices can be detected by means of the detection device, each device is sequentially conducted with the main grounding busbar in the grounding assembly along with the movement of the transmission assembly, the grounding condition of each device can be detected independently, the connection of a plurality of devices and the grounding assembly can be avoided in the process, the grounding detection efficiency of the devices is improved, and the detection safety is improved.

title_en: High-barrier antibacterial polylactic acid packaging material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-barrier antibacterial polylactic acid packaging material and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of biodegradable packaging materials. Solves the technical problems that the traditional polylactic acid material has insufficient barrier property and poor antibacterial property and is difficult to meet the packaging requirements of livestock and poultry meat, food and medicine. And carrying out copper ion functionalization treatment on the graphene oxide lamellar material, bridging the graphene oxide lamellar material with tannic acid molecules through copper ions to form nano filler, and then blending the filler with the plasticized polylactic acid solution to prepare the film. Preparing copper ion functionalized dispersion liquid from graphene oxide and copper nitrate, self-assembling with tannic acid under the condition of pH 8-10 to generate nano filler, uniformly dispersing the nano filler, mixing the nano filler with polylactic acid, polyethylene glycol and glycerin according to a specific mass ratio, and obtaining the high-performance packaging material through coating to form a film and controlling solvent volatilization conditions. The method remarkably improves the oxygen barrier property and the antibacterial activity of the material through uniform dispersion of the nano filler and reinforcement of a coordination network. The obtained material is suitable for packaging foods such as livestock and poultry meat.

title_en: Bag supplying device suitable for ultra-soft bag
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bag feeding device suitable for ultra-soft bags, and relates to the technical field of bag feeding of packaging machines. The device comprises a frame component, a paging component, an O-shaped conveying belt component, a sucker support, a handbag blowing component, a cache belt component and a flange component, wherein the paging component comprises a paging frame and a paging module, the paging frame is installed on the frame component, the paging module is located in the paging frame, the sucker support is installed on the paging module and located above the O-shaped conveying belt component and the cache belt component, the cache belt component is installed on the frame component, the O-shaped conveying belt component is installed on a connecting plate at the end part of the cache belt component, and the handbag blowing component is installed in the paging frame and located above the cache belt component. According to the invention, the packaging bags are lifted by negative pressure and the adjacent packaging bags are separated by blowing, so that the effective sorting and conveying of the ultra-soft packaging bags are realized, the folds generated in the sorting process are avoided, and the overall efficiency of the packaging machine is improved.

title_en: Drilling and tapping device with classification function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a drilling and tapping device with a classification function, which belongs to the technical field of mechanical equipment and comprises a left frame, a right frame, a rear frame, a cleaning mechanism, a detection mechanism, a blanking mechanism and a punching mechanism, wherein the cleaning mechanism is arranged on the left frame, the detection mechanism is arranged on the right frame, the blanking mechanism is arranged on the right side of the right frame, the punching mechanism is arranged on the rear frame, the detection mechanism comprises a first linear module, a second linear module, a movable carrier, a fixed carrier, a first cylinder and a thickness sensor, the first linear module is fixedly arranged on the left side of the right frame, the two second linear modules are respectively fixedly arranged on the front side and the rear side of the right frame, and the movable carrier is fixedly arranged at the output ends of the first linear module and the second linear module. Through the mode, the invention can carry out continuous intermittent conveying on a plurality of workpieces and can carry out continuous detection on the workpieces in different directions.

title_en: Robot control method, robot, and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a robot control method, a robot and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of robots, comprising the steps of determining a road network area corresponding to a road network in an external environment in an environment map of the external environment where the robot is located, and determining the maximum inscribed rectangle of the road network area as a task area of the robot; the method comprises the steps of determining path points on a first boundary line and a second boundary line based on cleaning widths of a robot, determining cleaning paths based on connection lines between the path points on the first boundary line and the path points on the second boundary line, determining driving directions of the cleaning paths based on lane directions of a road network, planning the path of the robot based on the cleaning paths to obtain target paths, and controlling the robot to drive according to the target paths. The application reduces the risk of collision between the robot and the vehicle caused by retrograde driving in the complex road network environment, and improves the operation safety of the robot in the complex road network environment.

title_en: Control operation method and device for discharging robot of rare earth metal electrolytic furnace
abstract_en: The application provides a control operation method of a discharging robot of a rare earth metal electrolytic furnace, which comprises the steps that the discharging robot obtains the electrolytic state of the electrolytic furnace through a visual sensor and judges whether the discharging state reaches a discharging standard, after judging that the discharging state reaches the discharging standard, the discharging robot grabs a discharging tool, preheats the discharging tool and moves to a discharging position to prepare for discharging, the discharging robot moves along a planned path, the contact force between the robot and the electrolytic furnace is monitored through a force sensing system, the robot track is corrected according to the contact force, a discharging flow is executed, after the discharging flow is ended, whether discharging is continued is judged, if not, the discharging is ended. According to the application, the visual sensor is used for judging the molten metal discharging standard in real time, dynamically calibrating the furnace mouth position and monitoring the tool deformation, the force sensor is used for realizing the terminal flexible control, the damage to the furnace body in the digging operation is avoided, the manual participation is reduced, and the operation efficiency is greatly improved.

title_en: Small-sized flexible rotary joint and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a small-sized flexible rotary joint and a manufacturing method thereof, which belong to the technical field of flexible response drivers and comprise an intelligent response piece, a torsion spring, a rotor, a bearing and a base, wherein a bearing support is connected with the base through a plurality of support arms, and the bearing support is coaxial with the base; the intelligent response piece comprises a bearing support, a rotor, a torsion spring, an intelligent response piece, a support arm, a support seat, a support, a torsion spring, a mounting point and an intelligent response piece. The intelligent rotary joint has the advantages that the rotor is driven by means of contraction and extension of the intelligent response piece, and the torsion spring enables the intelligent response piece to be kept tensioned through the rotor, so that the periodic angle change of the flexible rotary joint is realized, the basic function of the traditional rotary joint is achieved, the structure is light, the array is easy, the manufacture is simple and convenient, the intelligent rotary joint is suitable for application scenes such as miniaturization, large deformation and quick response, and the intelligent rotary joint has good engineering application prospect.

title_en: Preparation method of high-barrier alumina composite film for food packaging
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a high-barrier aluminum oxide composite film for food packaging, and relates to the technical field of food packaging materials. The high-barrier alumina composite film for food packaging comprises, by weight, 60-90 parts of modified nano alumina, 20-30 parts of silane coupling agent KH-560, 18-28 parts of nano silver, 16-22 parts of compound antioxidant, 4-10 parts of nano titanium dioxide, 22-32 parts of modified polylactic acid, 2-6 parts of graphene quantum dots, 12-16 parts of methyl methacrylate-butadiene-styrene copolymer, 3-6 parts of dodecyl trimethyl ammonium chloride, 10-14 parts of resorcinol tetraphenyl diphosphate and 7-17 parts of stearic acid intercalation modified nano montmorillonite. According to the invention, the nano alumina and the polylactic acid are modified to prepare the high-barrier alumina composite film for food packaging, so that the barrier capability to gas, water vapor and ultraviolet rays is greatly improved, and the high-barrier alumina composite film is oil-resistant and antistatic. The product has high mechanical strength and strong processing suitability, can adapt to complex scenes, and is environment-friendly and safe.

title_en: Head and neck support device for upper limb exoskeleton
abstract_en: The invention discloses a head and neck support device for an upper limb exoskeleton, which relates to the technical field of live working equipment and comprises a head and neck support, a supporting mechanism, a mounting plate and a height adjusting and locking mechanism, wherein the head and neck support is rotationally connected with the upper end of the supporting mechanism and used for lifting the head and neck, the lower end of the supporting mechanism is inserted on the mounting plate and used for supporting the head and neck support, the height adjusting and locking mechanism is mounted on the mounting plate and used for adjusting and locking the height of the supporting mechanism in real time according to the change of the head and neck angle in the working process, the attaching degree and the activity degree of freedom are improved, and a quick-change interface is compatible with various safety helmets and upper limb exoskeleton frames and is used for realizing quick mounting and dismounting.

title_en: Three-mechanical-arm cooperative control method and system for coffee beverage machine in combination with energy consumption analysis
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for cooperatively controlling three mechanical arms of a coffee beverage machine in combination with energy consumption analysis, and relates to the technical field of energy consumption optimization of mechanical arms, wherein the method comprises the following steps: and decomposing real-time order information to obtain a binary component demand-driven process mechanical arm and a substrate carrying sub-arm of the spin-based duplex mechanical arm to pre-receive binary process raw materials, and cooperatively controlling the process mechanical arm and the substrate carrying sub-arm to displace the binary process raw materials to process docking coordinates to execute time-space synchronous processing to obtain the order coffee beverage. The technical problem that the energy consumption of the mechanical arm is high in the coffee making process of a coffee beverage machine in the prior art, and the production cost is indirectly increased is solved. The technical effect of reducing the risk of liquid splashing in the clamping displacement process of the coffee cup is achieved while the operation energy consumption compression cost of the mechanical arm in the coffee making process is reduced.

title_en: Combined type bud vegetable sorting and drying device
abstract_en: The invention provides a combined type bud vegetable sorting and drying device, and relates to the technical field of bud vegetable production equipment. A combined type bud vegetable sorting and drying device comprises a sorting mechanism and a drying mechanism. The drying mechanism comprises a drying box, and a belt wheel conveying mechanism is arranged in the drying box. The sorting mechanism comprises an air separation assembly and a receiving assembly. The gas subassembly includes hot air supply, conveyer pipe and divide the gas dish. The two ends of the conveying pipe are respectively communicated with the outlet of the hot air source and the inlet of the air dividing disc. The material receiving assembly comprises a material receiving part positioned above the belt wheel conveying mechanism at the bottom, one end of the material receiving part extends out of the drying box, a material screening channel is formed between the material receiving part and the drying box, and the discharged gas of the gas distribution disc enables unqualified sprouts on the belt wheel conveying mechanism at the bottom to fall into the material screening channel after being blown up. A plurality of ventilation holes are uniformly arranged on the transmission belt of any belt wheel conveying mechanism at intervals. The invention can realize synchronous sorting and drying of the sprouts, reduces occupied space and improves production efficiency.

title_en: Counterweight device for auxiliary balance of elevator car
abstract_en: The invention provides a counterweight device for auxiliary balance of an elevator car, which relates to the technical field of elevator car counterweights and comprises a gyroscope sensor, a processor, an electromagnetic counterweight disc, an elevator guide rail, an electromagnetic counterweight disc, a support seat and an electromagnet group, wherein the gyroscope sensor is fixedly arranged at the top of the elevator car, the processor is in signal connection with the gyroscope sensor, the electromagnetic counterweight disc is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the elevator car and is in signal connection with the processor, the elevator guide rail is used for guiding the movement direction of the elevator car, sliding guide shoes are arranged on the outer surface of the elevator car in pairs and are in sliding connection with the elevator guide rail, the electromagnetic counterweight disc comprises a support seat and a car fixedly connected with the support seat, the electromagnet group is fixedly arranged at the center of a circle of the support seat, and the two magnetic counterweight discs are in one group, are arranged in 2-4 groups and are movably arranged on the support seat around the electromagnet group. According to the invention, the current gesture of the elevator is sensed in real time through the gyroscope sensor, and the position of the magnetic balancing weight is adjusted through the processor, so that the response speed of the balancing weight is improved.

title_en: Adjustable carrier roller of belt conveyor
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of belt conveyors, in particular to an adjustable carrier roller of a belt conveyor, which comprises a lifting support column assembly, wherein an adjustable steel plate is connected to the bottom of the support column assembly and is in sliding fit with the adjustable steel plate in the transverse direction perpendicular to the conveying direction, the upper end of the support column assembly is connected with a roller group, two ends of the roller group are provided with adjustable supports which are matched with the support column assembly through the adjustable supports, and a plurality of connecting positions for being matched with the support column assembly are arranged on the adjustable supports. The invention realizes the transverse displacement of the roller group by transversely adjusting the position of the strut assembly, thereby adjusting the horizontal radian of the conveyer belt, and the lifting adjustment of the strut assembly can adjust the height of the roller group, and the cooperation of the strut assembly and the adjustable bracket can also realize the adjustment of the vertical radian of the roller group. The invention can adjust the conveyer belt from multiple dimensions, keep the stable and reliable operation of the conveyer belt, and ensure the convenience, high efficiency, stability and reliability of conveying operation.

title_en: Anti-collision stacking and transporting device for high-pressure gas cylinders
