abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of conveying pipelines, and particularly discloses an anti-collision stacking and transporting device for a high-pressure gas cylinder, which comprises a rubber ring mounting mechanism, a chain type transporting mechanism and a flexible pipeline, the chain type conveying mechanism comprises a conveying seat and an automatic lifting assembly, wherein the automatic lifting assembly is arranged at the bottom of the conveying seat in a sliding mode, and longitudinal sliding rods are symmetrically arranged on the conveying seat. The shockproof rubber ring is sleeved outside the gas storage bottle, on one hand, impact can be absorbed through the elastic property of the material of the shockproof rubber ring, meanwhile, a plurality of through holes are uniformly distributed on the shockproof rubber ring, the through holes can be used as the connection characteristic of the stay bars and the shockproof rubber ring, the shockproof rubber ring is just changed from a solid filling structure to a porous structure, and the buffering performance of the shockproof rubber ring can be further improved.

title_en: Robot large model alignment training method and device integrating approval feedback
abstract_en: The disclosure belongs to the technical field of intelligent robots with bodies, and particularly relates to a robot large model alignment training method and device integrating approval feedback. The method comprises the steps of collecting historical operation data of a robot, inputting the data into a pre-trained robot big model to generate initial behavior output, scoring the initial behavior output through manual marking, constructing a manual scoring data set, training a machine rewarding function through supervision learning based on the manual scoring data set, wherein the output value of the machine rewarding function fits the score distribution of manual scoring, taking the output of the machine rewarding function as a rewarding signal, and updating parameters of the robot big model through a reinforcement learning algorithm to optimize the robot behavior strategy. The present disclosure provides a robotic big model training method aligned with the human target and value view.

title_en: Filling method of traditional Chinese medicine pills
abstract_en: The invention provides a traditional Chinese medicine pill filling method, which belongs to the field of traditional Chinese medicine filling and comprises the steps of installing a screening device, a pill conveying device, a medicine bottle conveying device, a filling machine and a packaging device, installing a sealing cover after debugging, filling anion gas with a first preset concentration into the sealing cover by using an anion generator, conveying traditional Chinese medicine pills with a granulating machine to the screening device, screening by the screening device, conveying the screened traditional Chinese medicine pills to the filling machine by using the pill conveying device, conveying the traditional Chinese medicine bottles to the position of an outlet of the filling machine by using the conveying device, performing traditional Chinese medicine pill filling work by using the filling machine, counting by using a counter, conveying the traditional Chinese medicine bottles with the finished traditional Chinese medicine pill filling to the packaging device, and packaging. Aims at solving the problems that the electrostatic adsorption phenomenon of traditional Chinese medicine pill filling in the prior art is serious and can not be eliminated. The method has the technical effects that static neutralization adsorption of the whole flow of traditional Chinese medicine filling is realized.

title_en: Full-automatic reel changing mechanism and battery processing equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full-automatic coil replacing mechanism and battery processing equipment, wherein the full-automatic coil replacing mechanism comprises a first coil discharging mechanism, a second coil discharging mechanism, an uncoiling mechanism, a traction mechanism, a first rubberizing mechanism and a second rubberizing mechanism, the first coil discharging mechanism and the second coil discharging mechanism are used for placing a coil and discharging a coiled material, the uncoiling mechanism is used for detecting an initial section of the coil and tearing the initial section of the coiled material, the traction mechanism is used for dragging the coiled material to rubberizing positions on the first rubberizing mechanism or the second rubberizing mechanism, the first rubberizing mechanism and the second rubberizing mechanism comprise a rubberizing module, a cutting module and a rubberizing module, the rubberizing module is used for sticking adhesive tapes at cutting ports of the coiled materials to complete tape splicing work, and the battery processing equipment comprises the full-automatic coil replacing mechanism. The full-automatic reel changing mechanism and the battery processing equipment have the advantages of high automation degree, labor cost can be saved during application, the tape splicing and production efficiency are improved, the tape splicing consistency is high, the product quality is better, and the management cost is lower.

title_en: Dust cover packaging method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of automatic equipment, in particular to a dust cover packaging method and system. The dust cover packing method comprises the step of stacking and sleeving a plurality of dust covers on the outer peripheral side of the support rod. The support rod is driven to turn to a first state, the second clamping claws are driven to an open state, and at least one group of first clamping claws and one group of second clamping claws are driven to move to a first position in a direction approaching the dust cover. The first position comprises a group of first clamping claws at least partly surrounding the dust cover, the free ends of the first clamping claws penetrate through the lower part of the horizontal plane where the maximum diameter of the dust cover is located, and the dust cover is deformed when the first clamping claws move to the first position. A set of second clamping claws are driven to clamp on the conical surface of the outermost dust cover. The first clamping claw and the second clamping claw are driven to convey the plurality of dust covers to the box body. Thus, the problem of difficult automatic packaging in the production process of the conical dust cover is solved.

title_en: Diagonal elevator fault detection method based on elevator operation data real-time analysis
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of elevator operation monitoring, in particular to a diagonal elevator fault detection method based on real-time analysis of elevator operation data, which comprises the following steps of collecting various monitoring data in the operation process of the diagonal elevator in real time; the method comprises the steps of acquiring the accumulated change degree and the transient deviation degree of various monitoring data at each acquisition time, classifying all the acquisition times before the current time, acquiring the first characteristic value of various instantaneous response states of various monitoring data at the current time and the second characteristic value of various instantaneous response states of various monitoring data at the current time, acquiring the accumulated deviation response characteristic value of various monitoring data at the current time, adjusting the time step when the time sequence of various monitoring data is predicted by adopting a long-short-term memory network algorithm to obtain the prediction result of various monitoring data, and detecting the fault condition of the inclined elevator. The application aims to improve the accuracy and timeliness of fault detection.

title_en: Formwork suspension conveying system for underground pipe gallery construction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a formwork hanging and conveying system for underground pipe gallery construction, which relates to the technical field of conveying and comprises a first mounting frame, a second mounting frame fixedly connected with the bottom of the first mounting frame, and two chain wheels meshed with two sides in the chain, wherein a chain arranged in the second mounting frame is connected with two clamps, each clamp comprises a second transmission shaft, a third transmission shaft, a U-shaped frame and a clamping plate, the bottom ends of the second transmission shaft and the three top ends of the transmission shafts are fixedly connected with transmission circular plates, a plurality of first telescopic rods are arranged between the two transmission circular plates, a formwork is placed on the top of a jacking plate in a clamping box, the hanging and conveying system can hoist the formwork to a higher position for conveying, and the formwork is automatically put down through the arrangement of a sixth positioning plate and the first positioning plate when the formwork is prevented from colliding with sundries on the ground.

title_en: 10 KV switch uninterrupted maintenance and direct-current secondary load transfer device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a 10 kilovolt switch uninterrupted maintenance and direct current secondary load transfer device which comprises a push-pull trolley and a load transfer box, wherein a lifting assembly is arranged above the push-pull trolley, a standby power supply is arranged on the left side of the upper surface of the lifting assembly, the load transfer box is arranged on the right side of the standby power supply, a telescopic insulating rod which is in plug-in connection with the lifting assembly is arranged on the right side of the load transfer box, a portable bypass power supply quick access tool is detachably arranged on the top of the telescopic insulating rod, a rotating rod is arranged on the right side of the push-pull trolley, and a grounding assembly is arranged below the rotating rod.

title_en: Tray structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to a tray structure for loading, storing or transferring articles, which comprises a plurality of lower end frames forming square tube shapes and arranged at intervals along the front-back direction, and a plurality of upper end frames forming square tube shapes and arranged at intervals along the left-right direction, wherein the upper sides of the lower end frames are mutually perpendicular and are in cross connection.

title_en: Warehouse-out and warehouse-in method and device for automatic warehouse system materials
abstract_en: The invention relates to a warehouse-out and warehouse-in method and a warehouse-in device for automatic warehouse system materials, and belongs to the technical field of automatic warehouse. The automatic warehouse control mechanism comprises the steps of determining ex-warehouse guarantee task information of each automatic warehouse according to the current automatic warehouse inventory and the guarantee task scale, acquiring ex-warehouse box information sets closest to an automatic warehouse port according to the ex-warehouse guarantee task information and the respective movable warehouse inventory conditions, determining material ex-warehouse/in sub-task material information according to the ex-warehouse box information sets and the actual material ex-warehouse/in requirements, selecting a box in the ex-warehouse according to the material ex-warehouse/in sub-task material information sets according to set rules, and obtaining an automatic warehouse control mechanism instruction sequence according to the selected ex-warehouse box information and the preparation operation rules before ex-warehouse of the boxes and the automatic warehouse inner box circulation rules. The invention effectively improves the warehouse-out or warehouse-in efficiency of the irregular warehouse materials.

title_en: Automatic feeding method and system for cutting workstation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of data processing, in particular to an automatic feeding method and system for a feeding workstation, wherein the method comprises the following steps of obtaining a feeding task; the method comprises the steps of receiving plate storage information of a material-opening workstation, acquiring a to-be-selected bin position for storing plates with materials and sizes corresponding to a material-loading task, acquiring the current position of a mechanical arm, selecting a bin position closest to the current position of the mechanical arm from the to-be-selected bin position as a target bin position, controlling the mechanical arm to move to the target bin position through a guide rail and grasp first type plates, controlling the mechanical arm to move to a target material-opening station through the guide rail in response to the mechanical arm grasping the plates, placing the grasped first type plates in a material-loading area of the target material-opening station, and notifying a material-opening central control or a material-opening single machine to finish plate-placing in response to the plates being placed in the material-loading area of the target material-opening station. The method can effectively improve the automation degree and the efficiency of feeding of the feeding workstation.

title_en: Sheet conveying device and image forming apparatus including the same
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application relates to a paper conveying device and an image forming device comprising the same, wherein the paper conveying device comprises a conveying roller pair, a curl suppression assembly and a rigidity detection assembly, wherein the conveying roller pair is suitable for rotating to convey paper passing through the conveying roller pair along a conveying direction, the curl suppression assembly is suitable for clamping the paper so that at least the part of the paper, which is positioned between the conveying roller pair and the curl suppression assembly, is parallel to the conveying direction, and the rigidity detection assembly is suitable for pushing the part, which is positioned between the conveying roller pair and the curl suppression assembly, of the paper to detect the rigidity of the paper. The embodiment of the application can be beneficial to reducing the rigidity detection error of the paper conveying device caused by paper curling, and can be beneficial to improving the detection precision of the paper conveying device on the rigidity of paper, and the like.

title_en: High-resilience ceramic fiber product and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-resilience ceramic fiber product and a preparation method thereof, wherein the high-resilience ceramic fiber product comprises a fiber module, a bundling component bundled on the outer side wall of the fiber module and an anchoring component arranged on the side wall of the fiber module, the fiber module comprises a plurality of fiber carpets which are respectively and alternately folded to form a plurality of folding parts and folding seams, the folding parts of one fiber carpet are respectively inserted into the folding seams of the other fiber carpet and then mutually meshed, the fiber carpets are sequentially meshed through the folding parts and the folding seams, and the width of the folding seam on one fiber carpet of two adjacent fiber carpets is smaller than or equal to the width of the folding part on the other fiber carpet, and the preparation method of the ceramic fiber product comprises a cotton collecting procedure, a needling procedure, a folding procedure and a bundling procedure. The invention solves the problems of large gap at the folding position of the traditional ceramic fiber module, high labor and equipment cost and low production efficiency.

title_en: Device for winding film on surface of optical fiber disc
abstract_en: The invention provides a device for winding a film on the surface of an optical fiber disk, which comprises a rack, a disk shaft for sleeving the optical fiber disk, a film frame for installing a film drum, a cutter for cutting the film and a first driving mechanism for driving the cutter to move, wherein the disk shaft and/or the film frame is connected with a driving component for driving the film frame to rotate, the film is wound outside the optical fiber disk by driving the film frame to rotate around the disk shaft, or the film is wound outside the optical fiber disk by driving the optical fiber disk to rotate, or the film is wound outside the optical fiber disk by driving the disk shaft and the film frame to rotate in opposite rotation directions, and the film is cut by driving the cutter to move after being wound. The invention has the beneficial effects that the film frame with the film rotates around the optical fiber disc to realize film coating, so that the film coating of the optical fiber disc can be automated, the labor burden is reduced, and the efficiency is improved.

title_en: Process for improving internal stress of basement membrane
abstract_en: The invention discloses a process for improving internal stress of a base film, which comprises the following steps of setting the belt tension of a master roll winding machine, adopting edge clamping rollers to clamp so as to continuously flatten a film surface, matching initial winding tension of the master roll, dynamically adjusting the real-time winding tension of the master roll according to the actual thickness of the base film, the outer diameter of the master roll winding roller and the real-time winding length of the master roll so as to obtain a flat master roll, setting the slitting initial unreeling tension and the slitting initial unreeling speed of a slitting machine, adopting an arc flattening roller to eliminate uneven transverse stress distribution, winding the base film on a slitting paper tube, matching the initial winding tension, dynamically adjusting the slitting real-time winding tension according to the actual thickness of the base film, the outer diameter of the slitting paper tube and the slitting real-time winding length, and further obtaining the slitting base film roll with stable internal stress and good appearance. The process of the invention improves the internal stress from the combination of theory and practice, effectively solves the problems of stress retraction and placement deformation of the diaphragm, and improves the stability of the diaphragm.

title_en: Automatic battery pack replacing device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of battery pack replacement, and particularly relates to an automatic battery pack replacement device which comprises a base assembly, an operation platform and a lifting mechanism, wherein the base assembly is an integral frame of the automatic battery pack replacement device, the operation platform moves up and down in the base assembly through the lifting mechanism, the operation platform comprises a pushing frame structure, a lifting frame structure, a pushing guide slideway, a pushing motor, an adjusting guide slideway, a pushing screw assembly, a main pushing plate and an adjusting cylinder assembly, the pushing frame structure is connected with the lifting frame structure through the adjusting guide slideway, the main pushing plate is connected with the pushing frame structure through the pushing guide slideway, the pushing screw assembly is arranged on the pushing frame structure, the pushing screw assembly is connected with the pushing motor, and the adjusting cylinder assembly is connected with the pushing frame structure and the lifting frame structure. The device can realize automatic and manual operation of actions such as lifting, advancing, retreating, leveling and the like of the battery pack, and improves the replacement efficiency of the battery pack.

title_en: Input receiving component for robotic microsurgery
abstract_en: An apparatus and method are described that include a control component tool (30) that includes a handle (52) and an input receiving component (50) disposed on the handle (52). The input receiving component (50) includes one or more light sources (56) disposed on a first radial wall (60), one or more light detectors (58) disposed on a second radial wall (62) facing the first radial wall (60), and a deformable sleeve (54) extending axially between the first radial wall and the second radial wall and configured to reduce light directed from the one or more light sources (56) toward the one or more light detectors (58) in response to being pressed. A computer processor (28) receives signals indicative of the reduction of light from one or more light detectors (58) and controls the surgical tool (21) in response thereto. Other applications are also described.

title_en: Container structure comprising accommodating part capable of accommodating outdoor unit
abstract_en: The invention provides a container structure comprising a containing part capable of containing an outdoor unit. According to one embodiment of the disclosure, the container structure comprises a container, a containing part which is formed by surrounding a container main body, a first opening formed on the first surface of the container and a second opening formed on the second surface of the container, a first fixing means which is used for fixing the outdoor unit and is arranged in at least one area of the containing part, at least one through hole which is formed by at least one of a first inner side of the containing part which is upward to the first opening, a second inner side of the containing part which is upward to the second opening and a third inner side corresponding to the upper part of the containing part and enables a pipeline part which is used for connecting the outdoor unit and the inside of the main body to be penetrated.

title_en: Method for generating data for robot control model and related equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a method and related equipment for generating data of a robot control model, and particularly comprises the steps of generating first context characteristic information corresponding to a task instruction based on historical observation data of the robot under the condition that the task instruction is received, wherein the first context characteristic information is used for representing environment state information and task execution constraint parameters required by a task target for executing the task instruction, invoking an observation sequence generation model based on the first context characteristic information to acquire a synthetic observation sequence corresponding to the task target, wherein the synthetic observation sequence is used as a reference of model reasoning or a sample of model training, storing the synthetic observation sequence in a designated storage position under the condition that the execution rationality verification of the synthetic observation sequence is passed, and the designated storage position is used for providing data support when the robot control model performs model reasoning or model training. The embodiment of the application can improve the data acquisition efficiency.

title_en: Screw sleeve robot grabbing system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of automatic grabbing of industrial robots, and discloses a swivel robot grabbing system and a swivel robot grabbing method, wherein the system comprises an image acquisition module, a background segmentation module, a feature fusion module, a pose regression module, a position calculation and judgment module, a motion execution module, a synchronous triggering module and a safety control module, wherein a swivel color image and a swivel depth image are synchronously acquired through a GB-D camera, and a point cloud is generated through processing; extracting CNN texture and PointNet ++ geometric features of the point cloud, splicing and outputting fusion features, converting three-dimensional coordinates and quaternion rotation of the regression key points into six-dimensional pose, judging reachability, outputting effective pose, and executing grabbing after receiving the three-dimensional coordinates and quaternion rotation by a six-axis mechanical arm controller. The detection of the screw sleeve entering the field of view triggers the camera to collect, the confidence of the pose is monitored in real time, and when the voltage is low, the servo power supply is cut off. The screw sleeve pose can be accurately acquired to control the six-axis mechanical arm to grasp, and the advanced algorithm and the real-time monitoring are utilized to improve the grasping accuracy and safety and reduce the operation risk through the cooperation of multiple modules.

title_en: Elevator group control method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of elevator group control, in particular to an elevator group control method and system based on deep learning. The long-period memory network is adopted to model the elevator taking frequency, the call interval and the number of people fluctuation, the periodic characteristics of passenger flows in the working days, the holidays and the peak time periods are extracted, the prediction of the passenger flows of each floor in the future is realized, and the pre-adjustment deployment of the idle elevators is finished in advance. In the dispatching stage, a state input comprising the running state and the predicted flow of the elevator is constructed, a reinforcement learning model is introduced to perform strategy optimization, a reward function is constructed based on the waiting time of passengers, the response overtime and the service completion number, the dispatching strategy is driven to continuously converge, the response allocation, the pre-adjustment position and the path adjustment of the elevator are optimized, and the dispatching intelligence and the service efficiency are improved.

title_en: Automatic inserting equipment for ceramic chips
abstract_en: The invention discloses automatic ceramic chip inserting equipment, which relates to the technical field of ceramic chip cleaning inserting equipment and comprises a conveying frame, a multi-axis robot, an inserting frame, a vacuum chuck assembly, a placing frame, a first tooth-shaped limiting groove and a second tooth-shaped limiting groove. The first tooth-shaped limit groove and the second tooth-shaped limit groove provide inserting and placing isolation spaces for the ceramic chips, mutual isolation between the ceramic chips can be effectively ensured, collision contact of the ceramic chips is avoided, the limit grooves on the limit frame and the bracket are designed into tooth-shaped structures, so that the limit grooves are in a structural shape with large opening size and small inner side size, the extrusion contact limit effect of the inner walls of the limit grooves and the ceramic chips is better, the safety and stability of inserting and placing limit of the ceramic chips can be effectively improved, the placing frame is placed on the corresponding position of the inserting frame, opening work of the clamping assembly can be achieved, the placing frame is taken off from the inserting frame, clamping work of the clamping assembly can be achieved, and the operation is convenient and quick.

title_en: Anti-blocking feeding device for producing degradable plastic films
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of feeding devices, in particular to an anti-blocking feeding device for producing a degradable plastic film, which comprises a feeding bin, wherein the feeding bin comprises a bin barrel, a vibrating part is arranged on the inner side of the bin barrel, a rotating part is arranged at the top end of the bin barrel, a conveying part is arranged at the bottom end of the bin barrel, the rotating part comprises a top cover plate covered at the top end of the bin barrel, a speed change gear box is arranged at the top end of the top cover plate, a driving motor is arranged at the top end of the speed change gear box, and the speed change gear box consists of a box body and two gear ends meshed with different outer diameters. According to the invention, the high-frequency vibration generated by driving the vibrator in the vibrating component is matched with the inclined guide piece, so that hydrophilic degradable plastic particles are effectively dispersed in the feeding process, bridging blockage caused by caking or fine powder accumulation is avoided, particle aggregation is further destroyed by the vibration design of the lining barrel and the extension tube, and the continuous falling of materials to the conveying component is ensured.

title_en: Insert for reinforcing a shipping container
abstract_en: An insert (24) for reinforcing a transport container (2) extends in a longitudinal direction (4), in a transverse direction (6) transverse to the longitudinal direction (4) and in a height direction (8) transverse to both the longitudinal direction (4) and the transverse direction (6), the transport container (2) comprising a bottom (10) as seen in the height direction (8) on which a wall (12) extending in the height direction (8) is placed circumferentially, the wall together with the bottom (10) forming a storage space (14) which can be filled via an access opening (16) located opposite the bottom (10) in the height direction (8), wherein the insert comprises a fabric cover (26) which encloses at least one plate (25) extending in the height direction (8) and which is insertable into the transport container (2) between the bottom (10) and the access opening (16), and the insert comprises at least one fastening element (28) spaced apart transversely to the height direction (8) and which is configured to be detachably fastened to the wall (12).

title_en: Diameter-changing and self-adaptive centering device on transmission line
abstract_en: The invention discloses a variable diameter and self-adaptive centering device on a transmission line, which is supported on the basis of a workbench and integrates a transmission driving system (an asynchronous motor, a first speed reducer and a chain wheel transmission line), a variable diameter-centering system (a bidirectional screw rod, a servo motor, a baffle plate and the like), and a stop control assembly (a double detection switch, a cylinder and a stop block) to realize self-adaptive centering through the angle design of angle A=2. When the automatic centering device works, the servo motor drives the bidirectional screw rod to drive the reducing plate to synchronously reduce, the self-centering mechanism is linked along with the reducing to realize accurate centering of the material taking level, and the stop system is matched with the detection switch to ensure that parts are fed one by one. The device does not need manual intervention in the whole process, has strong suitability, small centering deviation and stable transmission, can meet the requirement of mass automatic production, and improves the transmission efficiency of the transmission line.

title_en: Flexible positioning system for BOP lifting operation platform and operation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flexible positioning system and a flexible positioning method for BOP lifting operation platforms, and relates to the technical field of petroleum drilling equipment, wherein the flexible positioning system comprises at least two lifting operation platforms, wherein the lifting operation platforms are arranged at intervals, and the tops of the lifting operation platforms are matched with each other; at least two lifting devices are arranged on the lifting operation platform in a one-to-one correspondence manner, and the lifting devices drive the lifting operation platform to do lifting motion until the tops of the lifting operation platform are positioned on the same plane; and the control cabinet assembly is connected with the lifting device. The invention also discloses an operation method, namely, an operation is performed by adopting the flexible positioning system for the lifting operation platform. The invention solves the technical problem that the lifting operation platform for installing the existing blowout preventer cannot meet the requirement of the same height after lifting.

title_en: Intelligent tour guide robot for emotion perception of tourists in museum and control method of intelligent tour guide robot
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent tour guide robot for emotion perception of tourists in a museum and a control method thereof, wherein the intelligent tour guide robot structurally comprises the following components: after the tour guide main body, the control keyboard, the lifting rod, the movable base and the commodity shelf are further improved, when the tour guide main body acquires tour guide information of the museum through the visitor touch control display screen, downward pressure can be continuously applied to the display screen, the support assembly can horizontally extend above the pressure sensor, the pressure sensor can capture pressure changes brought by the action, different tour guide services can be better displayed for different visitors, the cleaning assembly can incline on the display screen before and after the visitors leave the display screen, the cleaning assembly can spray cleaning liquid in a fixed quantity mode, the fingerprints on the surface of the display screen can be wiped under uniform stress from top to bottom synchronously, residual stains above the display screen can be scraped and collected in the same direction, the tour guide content of the museum can be clearly displayed, and the intelligent tour guide service effect provided for the visitors by the tour guide robot is improved.

title_en: Double-encoder hollow harmonic reducer joint module integrated with double-sided inductance coil
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-encoder hollow harmonic reducer joint module integrated with double-sided inductive coils, which comprises a shell, wherein an end cover is arranged on the shell, a frameless torque motor is arranged in the shell, a harmonic reducer and a brake are arranged on the frameless torque motor, an inductive encoder assembly and a controller are arranged in the shell, the inductive encoder assembly comprises a motor input end target plate arranged on the frameless torque motor and a deceleration output end target plate arranged on the harmonic reducer, and an eddy current coil detection circuit is arranged between the motor input end target plate and the deceleration output end target plate. The invention adopts the innovative double-sided arrangement eddy current type inductance coil encoder, integrates two sets of independent encoder functions of the motor input end and the speed reduction output end on a single circuit board, replaces the traditional discrete magnetic or optical encoder, and reduces the axial size and the structural complexity of the module.

title_en: Movable equipment Cable laying device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a movable equipment cable laying device, which relates to the technical field of cable wiring and comprises a trolley, wherein universal wheels are respectively and fixedly arranged at four corners of the bottom of the trolley, the universal wheels are provided with locking mechanisms, a cable storage installation device is arranged above the trolley, a power-assisted outgoing line device is arranged on the right side of the cable storage installation device, a tensioning device is arranged on the right side of the power-assisted outgoing line device, a guide device is arranged on the right side of the tensioning device, a support fixing device is arranged above the power-assisted outgoing line device and the tensioning device, and a support is arranged on the right side of the guide device. According to the invention, the cable is led out from the cable storage installation device through the power-assisted wire outlet device, the tensioning device plays roles of tightening the cable and monitoring the wire outlet speed of the power-assisted wire outlet device, and the cable is fed to the reciprocating power-assisted device through the guide device and the bracket fixing device.

title_en: Laser scanning composite vision detection automatic welding robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a laser scanning composite vision detection automatic welding robot, which specifically comprises a composite welding detection platform, an automatic welding mechanical arm, a driving system, a control cabinet and a wire feeding device. The laser line scanner scans the welding part by emitting laser beams, establishes a three-dimensional size model, feeds back a walking route to the control cabinet, and finally controls the welding gun to automatically weld according to the designed route. The welding gun is cooled by a water cooling mode, and the angle and the route of the compound eye camera are accurately regulated by an infrared laser tracker on the visual detection mechanical arm in the welding process so as to judge the welding defects and the quality, thereby realizing long-time high-precision welding of a large number of weldments and achieving the processing targets of uniform components at the joint of the welding seams, high quality and low defects on the surface of the welding seams.

title_en: Hydraulic system for forklift, fork device, forklift and leakage judging method
abstract_en: The invention particularly relates to a hydraulic system for a forklift, a fork device, the forklift and a leakage judging method, wherein an oil return assembly is arranged on the outer wall of an oil cylinder assembly, hydraulic oil in the oil cylinder assembly enters the oil return assembly when an oil seal of the oil cylinder assembly leaks, the oil return assembly comprises a joint and an oil return pipe, the joint is connected with the side wall of the oil cylinder assembly, the oil return pipe is sleeved at the bottom of the joint, a plurality of clamping holes are formed in the side wall of the joint, a clamping block corresponding to the clamping holes is arranged on the inner wall of the oil return pipe, an observation hole is formed between the top surface of the clamping block and the top surface of the clamping hole when the clamping block stretches into the corresponding clamping holes, when whether the oil seal leaks or not needs to be judged, a turnover part connected with the end part of the oil return pipe is turned downwards so that the observation hole is exposed, whether the hydraulic oil exists in the oil return pipe or not is judged through the observation hole, and whether the hydraulic oil exists in the oil return pipe can be judged without completely pulling the oil return pipe out of the joint, and whether the oil seal leaks or not is convenient to judge.

title_en: Mountain crane
abstract_en: The invention provides a mountain crane, which belongs to the technical field of cranes and particularly comprises a lower car structure, a slewing mechanism and a crane arm, wherein the slewing mechanism is positioned above the lower car structure, the crane arm is detachably connected with the slewing mechanism, the crane arm can do circular motion through the adjustment action of the slewing mechanism, an adjusting frame is arranged on the slewing mechanism, the horizontal height of the slewing mechanism is adjusted through the adjusting frame, the slewing mechanism can move horizontally, and the slewing mechanism is connected with the lower car structure.

title_en: Vibration and magnetic control-containing retired power battery special-shaped part nondestructive disassembling holder and disassembling method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of automatic nondestructive disassembly and recovery of a retired power battery pack robot of a new energy automobile, in particular to a retired power battery special-shaped piece nondestructive disassembly clamp holder containing vibration and magnetic control and a disassembly method. Meanwhile, the fingertip with the electromagnet is matched with the rubber strip on the inner side, so that the suitability of the special-shaped workpiece and the stability of the workpiece in clamping can be enhanced, the auxiliary positioning can be realized through magnetic attraction, the buffer protection effect can be realized through the rubber strip, and the nondestructive clamping and separating effects of the special-shaped workpiece can be realized.

title_en: Adjustable positioning seat of tower crane slewing bearing and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an adjustable positioning seat of a tower crane slewing bearing and a use method thereof, relating to the field of building construction, and the technical scheme is as follows: the positioning table comprises a positioning table, a main bevel gear which is manually rotated through an operating part is arranged at the center part of the top of the positioning table, the main bevel gear is fixed through the operating part after the main bevel gear is rotated to a proper position, the effect is that the main bevel gear is manually rotated through the operating part, the main bevel gear is utilized to be meshed with a plurality of auxiliary bevel gears which are circumferentially distributed around the main bevel gear, the transmission components connected with the auxiliary bevel gears are driven to synchronously act, a plurality of mounting plates are driven to synchronously move along the radial direction to adjust the distance, after the distance is adapted to the diameter of a target slewing bearing, the main bevel gear is fixed through the operating part, and then the outer ring of the slewing bearing is arranged on the mounting plates through a connecting piece, so that the cost increase, the stock pressure and the period extension caused by replacing a positioning seat are avoided.

title_en: Automatic stereoscopic warehouse for power environment-friendly equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of automatic stereoscopic warehouses, in particular to an automatic stereoscopic warehouse for electric power environmental protection equipment, which comprises a vertical shelf body, wherein a plurality of fixed support beams are arranged in the vertical shelf body, lateral extension grooves are formed in the two sides of the fixed support beams in a staggered manner, electric control lateral extension plates are slidably assembled on the two sides of the fixed support beams, and a winch type hoisting mechanism is arranged at the lower end of each electric control lateral extension plate. According to the automatic stereoscopic warehouse for the electric power environmental protection equipment, the design of the variable supporting area is adopted, the supporting area and the intelligent level can be freely stretched to two sides according to actual needs, the electric control lateral stretching plates on two sides of the fixed supporting beam can be stretched outwards to cooperate with a winch type lifting mechanism at the bottom to carry out lifting operation, lifting operation on the electric power environmental protection equipment is facilitated, and the loading and unloading efficiency of the equipment is improved.

title_en: Conveying system
abstract_en: A conveying system (10) for conveying objects comprises a fixed sliding track (11) defining a continuous uninterrupted sliding path, a moving unit (12) movable on the sliding track (11) in a direction of travel (A), and a driving means for moving the moving unit (12) on the sliding track (11). The conveying system (10) comprises an inner rolling guide (16) and an outer rolling guide (17) which are respectively arranged at the inner side (30) and the outer side (31) of the sliding rail (11), and an inner rolling unit (18) and an outer rolling unit (19) which are respectively matched with the inner rolling guide (16) and the outer rolling guide (17) according to rolling relation.

title_en: Continuous operation waste textile sterilization and disinfection treatment method and equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and equipment for sterilizing and disinfecting waste textiles in continuous operation. A technological method for sterilizing and treating waste textiles in continuous operation comprises the steps of disassembling packaged waste textiles into a single piece state through mechanical action, and conveying the single piece state to a front transition area; an ultraviolet sterilizing lamp is arranged in a front transition area to primarily sterilize disassembled single clothes, the clothes treated by the front transition area are sent into an ozone sterilizing machine of the sterilizing workshop through a conveying curtain in a sterilizing workshop, on one hand, two sides of the clothes are turned over through a plurality of layers of conveying curtains, on the other hand, the ozone can continuously act on the clothes to realize deep sterilization and sterilization through adjusting the sterilizing time, an extruding device is arranged in a rear transition area to physically extrude the clothes, residual ozone in the fiber of the clothes is discharged, the clothes with residual ozone removed are sent into a blanking area through a conveying system, and the whole treatment flow is completed. The invention has important significance for guaranteeing the sanitation and safety of the recycling of the waste textiles.

title_en: Tendon rope driven special operation robot joint position tracking time delay control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tendon rope driven special operation robot joint position tracking time delay control method which comprises the steps of establishing a dynamic mapping model between joint angles and electric cylinder displacement expansion and contraction quantities, establishing a forgetting factor calculation model, establishing a residual time delay estimation error calculation model, establishing a prediction model of a residual time delay estimation error prediction item at the next moment, establishing a time delay estimation error compensation model, establishing an improved time delay control algorithm control law, calculating displacement expansion and contraction quantities applied to an electric cylinder, calculating displacement reference values of the electric cylinder, and realizing high-precision tracking of the tendon rope driven special operation robot joint positions through position loop, speed loop and current loop control. The method can compensate the delay estimation error and reduce the joint position tracking error, and realizes high-precision tracking of the time-varying signal and overshoot-free tracking of the large-amplitude step signal simultaneously by introducing the forgetting factor and the residual estimation error prediction term into the compensation term, thereby having stronger robustness and expansibility.

title_en: Intelligent suspension conveying system and method for multilayer circuit board processing
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of circuit board processing, in particular to an intelligent suspension conveying system and method for processing a multilayer circuit board, aiming at the problem that in the prior art, a soft material is easy to scrape and collide in the transferring process due to the fact that the middle of the soft material falls down when the soft material is transferred, the intelligent suspension conveying system and method for processing the multilayer circuit board comprises a main support column arranged on the side face of a copper foil conveying rack, a rotating head is arranged at the top end of the main support column, and a main cantilever beam horizontally extending to the upper side of the copper foil conveying rack is sleeved and fixed at the top end of the rotating head. When the copper foil is grabbed, if the middle downward sinking amplitude of the copper foil body is too large, the copper foil is identified and calculated by the distance sensors at two different positions, the corresponding electromagnets are automatically controlled to be electrified after feedback, the swinging amplitude of the rotating rod is regulated, and then the loosened copper foil body is tensioned to be in a plane state, so that the copper foil body is lifted by only a small height during transportation, thereby saving lifting cost and man-hour.

title_en: Multi-degree-of-freedom mechanical arm operation reinforcement learning method from simulation to optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-freedom-degree mechanical arm operation reinforcement learning method which is simulated to be optimized, wherein robot state information and visual images related to the mechanical arm operation process are input into a reinforcement learning network obtained by training, and outputting the angle change quantity of the mechanical arm joint, and controlling the mechanical arm to work through the angle change quantity of the mechanical arm joint. The reinforcement learning network comprises a multi-mode encoder and an action decoder, wherein the multi-mode encoder comprises a visual encoder, a state encoder and a bidirectional cross attention module, an initial strategy is built by utilizing offline teaching data through a simulated learning mode, then online interaction is carried out in the environment, fine adjustment is carried out on the basis of the initial strategy through reinforcement learning based on value, and the trained reinforcement learning network is obtained. According to the invention, through combining simulation learning and reinforcement learning, the success rate of the robot in a multi-stage operation task can be improved under the condition of the same teaching sample, and the operation control of the robot in a complex task environment is realized.

title_en: Intelligent wet spraying machine and spraying control method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of wet spraying machines, and discloses an intelligent wet spraying machine and a spraying control method, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring an actual contour point cloud of a working surface by using three-dimensional scanning equipment; the method comprises the steps of generating deviation data by comparing the deviation data with a design model, planning a movement path of a mechanical arm based on the deviation data, cooperatively controlling the injection flow of a concrete pump and the movement speed of the mechanical arm to accurately match the target injection thickness required by each region, monitoring the injected forming thickness in real time through a post-injection detection device arranged at the tail end of the mechanical arm in the injection process, and dynamically adjusting the follow-up injection parameters according to the fed-back thickness deviation to form closed-loop control of injection quality. The intelligent wet spraying machine disclosed by the invention integrates a gesture sensing module, an environment sensing module, a post-spraying detection device and a control module. The invention can control the injection error in a lower range, reduce material waste, realize unmanned operation and improve construction quality, efficiency and safety.

title_en: Energy storage device, energy storage system and charging network
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an energy storage device, an energy storage system and a charging network, wherein the energy storage device comprises a container, a control module and a thermal management module, the container comprises a container body and a plurality of battery monomers, the battery monomers are accommodated in the container body, at least one of the length direction size, the width direction size and the height direction size of the container is unequal to the corresponding size of a standard container, the control module is used for being electrically connected with the battery monomers to electrically control the battery monomers, the thermal management module is connected with the container and used for managing the temperature of the battery monomers, and at least part of the thermal management module is positioned at the top of the container. Under the condition that the total energy of the container is certain, the container can have smaller volume, so that the energy storage device occupies smaller occupied area, the energy in the unit occupied area of the energy storage device is improved, and the area energy density of the energy storage device is improved.

title_en: Dispensing equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides dispensing equipment which comprises a transmission module, a medicine bag retaining mechanism, a support rail and a support rail, wherein the first side of the medicine bag retaining mechanism is connected with the transmission module, the second side of the medicine bag retaining mechanism is provided with a support wheel, a rotating shaft of the support wheel is perpendicular to an extending path of the transmission module, the support rail is arranged on one side of the transmission module, on which the medicine bag retaining mechanism is arranged, and the extending path of the support rail is parallel to the extending path of the transmission module and is used for bearing the support wheel. According to the invention, the supporting wheel is arranged on one side of the medicine bag holding mechanism away from the transmission module, and the supporting rail for supporting the supporting wheel is arranged, so that the supporting effect on the medicine bag holding mechanism can be improved, the medicine bag holding mechanism is always in a horizontal state in the transmission process, the dispensing precision of dispensing equipment is improved, the abrasion of the transmission module can be reduced, and the service life and the working stability of the transmission module are improved.

title_en: Double-arm frame raking lever type crane propeller strut construction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a double-arm frame rod-type crane propeller strut construction method which comprises the following steps of S1, in-field segmentation manufacturing, S2, in-field assembly folding, namely pre-splicing an upper beam and a front leg, trimming and folding the allowance of a folding opening, folding and assembling all components of the front leg to obtain a front leg sheet body, hoisting the front leg sheet body on a ship, fixing the front leg sheet body by using a technological support, assembling the upper beam and the rear leg into a whole to obtain a total component, integrally machining hinge point holes of the upper beam, installing outfitting pieces, coating, and finally hoisting the coated total component on the ship and the front leg sheet body for final assembly folding.

title_en: Driving device, dexterous hand, robot, and control method for driving device
abstract_en: The invention provides a driving device, a smart hand, a robot and a control method of the driving device, wherein the driving device comprises a base, a driving mechanism, a first driving wheel, a second driving wheel, a driven wheel and a transmission rope structure, and the driving mechanism is arranged on the base; the driving rope structure comprises a first rope part and a second rope part, the first driving wheel is in transmission connection with the driving mechanism, the second driving wheel is in transmission connection with the driving mechanism, the driven wheel is in rotation connection with the base, the driving rope structure comprises the first rope part and the second rope part, the first driving wheel is in transmission connection with the driven wheel through the first rope part, the second driving wheel is in transmission connection with the driven wheel through the second rope part, the first rope part and the second rope part are respectively used for driving the driven wheel to rotate in different directions so that loads can rotate in different directions, and the driving mechanism is configured to be capable of driving the first driving wheel to rotate in a first direction so as to wind the first rope part and driving the second driving wheel to rotate in a second direction opposite to the first direction so as to wind the second rope part. The first rope part and the second rope part can be tensioned, and the transmission precision is improved.

title_en: Robot reinforcement learning walking training method combining minimum free energy principle
abstract_en: The invention provides a robot reinforcement learning walking training method combining the minimum free energy principle, which comprises the following steps: step S1, carrying out exponential sliding average on error items in time; s2, introducing an error term after exponential sliding average into an adaptive weight parameter, and constructing a minimum free energy reward function; and S3, introducing regularization terms into the minimum free energy reward function to obtain a total reward function, so that the robot reinforcement learning walking training method combining the minimum free energy principle reduces the dependence of manual parameter adjustment and improves the training efficiency and the convergence speed through a unified free energy target reward function and self-adaptive weight adjustment mechanism.

title_en: Electric drive's tensioner
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of tensioners and provides an electric-driven tensioner which comprises a frame, wherein supporting legs are arranged at two ends of the frame, a winding drum assembly and a motor assembly for driving the winding drum assembly to work are arranged on the frame, the battery assembly is used for providing electric energy for the motor assembly and comprises a battery management system, a thermal management execution module, a battery pack and a supporting frame fixedly arranged in the frame, the thermal management system comprises a temperature acquisition module, a control module and an energy recovery module, the temperature acquisition module comprises a plurality of temperature sensors arranged in the battery pack, the problem that the temperature of a battery of the electric-driven tensioner is out of control under a complex construction environment is solved, the working stability and the service life of the battery under a wide temperature range are improved, the energy consumption of the thermal management system is reduced through energy recovery, and the electric-driven tensioner is suitable for a service scene without stable power supply in field construction.

title_en: Nondestructive testing device for shaft parts
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of part detection, and particularly discloses a nondestructive detection device for shaft parts, which comprises a chain plate conveyor, a magnetic attraction turnover mechanism arranged on one side of the middle of the chain plate conveyor, a first telescopic cylinder arranged on one side of the magnetic attraction turnover mechanism, a rotating shaft vertically arranged at the output end of the first telescopic cylinder, two guide rods fixed on the lower part of the rotating shaft, a translation assembly fixed on the top end of the rotating shaft, and an installation vertical rod driven by the translation assembly, wherein a second servo motor is coaxially arranged at the bottom end of the installation vertical rod, a rotary table is coaxially arranged at the output end of the second servo motor, and an industrial camera and a positioning probe are arranged below the rotary table. The invention can automatically position the axis of the shaft part conveyed to the inaccurate position, drive the industrial camera to perform equidistant scanning imaging along the axis track of the part, effectively overcome the axis positioning difficulty caused by the randomness of the workpiece conveying position, ensure the constant object distance of the camera in the detection process and eliminate the pixel quantization error caused by the change of the imaging distance.

title_en: Automatic tunnel pipeline installation mechanical arm
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic mechanical arm for installing a tunnel pipeline, which comprises a walking track mechanism, a mechanical arm mechanism, a pipeline clamp mechanism and a pipeline butt joint compensation mechanism, wherein the walking track mechanism is used for driving the mechanical arm mechanism to move along the tunneling direction and the horizontal direction of a section, the mechanical arm mechanism comprises at least one group of mechanical arms with single-action/linkage control modes and is used for grabbing a pipeline to be installed and adjusting the spatial posture, the pipeline clamp mechanism is arranged at the tail end of the mechanical arm and is used for realizing flexible clamping and rigid locking of the pipeline, and the pipeline butt joint compensation mechanism is used for compensating the posture error of the pipeline butt joint position and realizing the accurate alignment of flanges. The invention can realize full-automatic grabbing, transferring, positioning and butting of pipelines in the tunnel, greatly improve the pipeline installation efficiency and butting precision, reduce the manual operation intensity, adapt to various pipeline installation working conditions of shield construction and have strong universality.

title_en: Automatic assembly line for middle section of high-frequency transformer
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of transformer production, in particular to an automatic assembly line for a middle section of a high-frequency transformer, which comprises a magnetic core mounting assembly, a transformer rubber coating assembly, a characteristic testing assembly, a transformer rubber dispensing assembly, a laser marking assembly and a discharging disc which are sequentially arranged, wherein the magnetic core mounting assembly is used for mounting two groups of magnetic cores on the transformer, the transformer rubber coating assembly is used for winding and fixing the two groups of magnetic cores on the transformer through adhesive tapes, the characteristic testing assembly is used for carrying out characteristic testing on the rubber-coated transformer, the transformer rubber dispensing assembly is used for dispensing rubber on the top of the tested transformer, the laser marking assembly is used for marking the rubber-coated transformer, and the discharging disc is used for collecting the marked transformer and is used for carrying out full-flow automatic design of magnetic core mounting, rubber coating, testing, rubber dispensing and discharging so that the production efficiency is improved.

title_en: Yaw driving method of eyeball of bionic robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a yaw driving method of a bionic robot eyeball, which belongs to the technical field of bionic robots and comprises the following steps of driving a yaw motor to enable a yaw rocker arm connected with an output end of the yaw motor to rotate, transmitting the rotation motion of the yaw rocker arm to a transmission assembly through a first yaw connecting rod movably connected with the yaw rocker arm, and transmitting the motion to an eyeball supporting seat by the transmission assembly to drive the eyeball supporting seat to swing left and right, so that the eyeball capable of rotating left and right and arranged on the eyeball supporting seat moves between a left limit position and a right limit position. The invention solves the problems of insufficient motion fidelity, bulkiness and easy interference of a mechanism and no quantization rule of design in the prior art, realizes physiological eyeball yaw motion, compact interference-free layout and quantization design, and improves affinity and motion naturalness of a robot, miniaturization level of head integration, design efficiency and consistency and operation reliability.

title_en: Smoke box clamping device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a smoke box clamping device which comprises two clamping plates which are symmetrically arranged, wherein a plurality of sucker holes (1) are uniformly distributed on each clamping plate surface, a sucker (X) is arranged in each sucker hole, and the disc opening of the sucker (X) faces the inner side of the clamping plate. The invention also discloses a method for clamping the smoke box by the device.

title_en: High-speed wire harness assembly method and system based on intelligent algorithm detection
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of machine vision, in particular to a high-speed wire harness assembly method and system based on intelligent algorithm detection, comprising the following steps: confirming a plurality of original wires based on wire harness specifications, acquiring end face images of the original wires to obtain wire images, confirming the thickness of an insulating layer based on the wire images, stripping the original wires by utilizing the thickness of the insulating layer and a laser wire stripper to obtain qualified stripped wires, detecting the qualified stripped wires to obtain a wire core detection report, confirming a plurality of qualified wires based on the plurality of wire core detection reports, carrying out terminal crimping by utilizing the plurality of qualified wires to obtain a plurality of crimping wires, carrying out crimping quality screening on the plurality of crimping wires to obtain a plurality of qualified crimping wires, and carrying out wire harness bundling on the plurality of qualified crimping wires to obtain a plurality of bundling wires. The invention can solve the problem of low qualification rate of finished products caused by insufficient wire stripping precision and poor crimping quality in the high-speed wire harness assembly process.

title_en: Automatic packaging production device for nursing pads
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic packaging production device for nursing pads, which relates to the technical field of nursing packet packaging and comprises a workbench mechanism, wherein the workbench mechanism comprises a top working plate, the bottom end of the top working plate is fixedly connected with a bottom working plate, two sides of the top end of the workbench mechanism are respectively and fixedly connected with two centrosymmetric separation operation mechanisms, the separation operation mechanism comprises a pushing control motor, the pushing control motor is fixedly connected to the top end of the top working plate, the inner side of the pushing control motor is movably connected with a control push plate, and the front end of the control push plate is provided with a turnover support.

title_en: Cable parallel precise spraying robot oriented to complex curved surface
abstract_en: The patent discloses a large-scale equipment surface macro-micro cooperative driving's parallelly connected spraying robot of cable comprises macro robot, moving platform and spraying module. The macro robot adopts a detachable metal static platform frame and four driving ropes to cooperatively control the multi-degree-of-freedom motion of a disc-shaped movable platform, and three-dimensional accurate positioning is realized through an XY linear translation platform and a scissor type lifting mechanism. The four-head atomizing nozzle system is innovated, the spraying of the priming paint, the color paint and the varnish is completed through 90-degree step rotation, the high surface coverage rate is realized through an S-shaped alternate path, and the saturation of the color paint is controlled by combining six-valve flow. The device can be quickly reconfigured to adapt to different working conditions, the spraying efficiency is greatly improved, and the device is particularly suitable for high-quality spraying operation of large-scale equipment such as airplanes, ships and the like.

title_en: Vibration ejection of compact positioning mechanism
abstract_en: The invention relates to a vibration discharging positioning mechanism, which comprises a supporting positioning platform and a plurality of positioning clamping jaws. The supporting and positioning platform is used for bearing the foot pad of the discharge hole of the vibration disc, a positioning boss is arranged on the supporting and positioning platform, and the bottom of the foot pad is clamped on the positioning boss for preliminary positioning. The plurality of positioning clamping jaws are arranged around the positioning boss and can move towards the foot pad to be close to or far away from the foot pad, and the plurality of positioning clamping jaws are mutually matched to clamp the foot pad to carry out secondary deviation correcting and positioning on the foot pad. The foot pad after discharging the vibrating plate is placed on the positioning boss to perform primary positioning, and the plurality of positioning clamping jaws are mutually matched to clamp the foot pad to perform secondary deviation rectifying and positioning, so that errors of the discharging position of the foot pad are eliminated, the subsequent repair and scrapping of product equipment caused by the fact that the foot pad is not installed in place are avoided, and the stability rate of automatic equipment is improved.

title_en: Elevator car ventilation device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an elevator car ventilation device, which relates to the technical field of elevator car ventilation and comprises a car body, wherein wind binding boxes are fixedly arranged on the left side and the right side of the bottom of the car body, side ventilation grooves are formed in the left side and the right side of the top of the car body, top ventilation grooves are formed in a central position array of the top of the car body, corner ventilation grooves are formed in corners of the bottom of the car body, wind binding plates are arranged at the corner ventilation grooves, and the wind binding plates are fixedly arranged in the car body. According to the invention, through the addition and expansion of the air port and the control of the air channel, the air in the car body can be rapidly discharged when no one is available, so that the peculiar smell, carbon dioxide and the like in the car body can be rapidly discharged, the comfort level of passengers when using equipment can be effectively increased, and most of the air is realized through the movement of the car body and the adjustment of the air channel in the air discharging process, so that the energy consumption is low, the air discharging area is large and the efficiency is high.

title_en: Scraper blade reversed loader aircraft nose unloads coal adjusting device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of a smooth groove scraper conveyor of a fully mechanized coal mining face in a coal mine, in particular to a coal unloading adjusting device of a scraper conveyor head. Because the coal unloading height and angle of the transfer conveyor influence the service life of the belt and the safety of underground workers, hidden dangers of large coal and dust scattering and belt deviation exist. The coal unloading adjusting device for the scraper conveyor head can adjust the coal unloading height of the conveyor head and the coal unloading angle of the conveyor head, and particularly can adjust the coal unloading height of the conveyor head when the belt is damaged and the coal dust is large due to the influence of uneven pavement of a coal mine underground roadway on the coal unloading height angle. Therefore, the service life of the belt can be prolonged to the greatest extent, the maintenance cost is reduced, the safety and reliability in the coal unloading process of the transfer conveyor are ensured, and the operation is convenient.

title_en: Drag device for dual-bearing reel and dual-bearing reel
abstract_en: Provided are a dual-bearing reel drag device and a dual-bearing reel capable of reducing manufacturing tolerances of an operating member and a nut member. The drag device (5) is disposed on the handle shaft (30). The drag device (5) is provided with an operating member (51), a nut member (52), a drag mechanism (53), and an elastic member (55). The operation member (51) has a through hole (51 b) that penetrates in the axial direction of the handle shaft (30) and is configured to be operable around the shaft of the handle shaft (30). The nut member (52) is disposed between the inner peripheral surface of the through hole (51 b) and the outer peripheral surface of the handle shaft (30), and moves in the axial direction in response to the operation of the operation member (51). The drag force of the drag force mechanism (53) changes in response to the axial movement of the nut member (52). The elastic member (55) is elastically deformable and is disposed between the inner peripheral surface of the through hole (51 b) and the outer peripheral surface of the nut member (52).

title_en: Device and method for storing, applying, outputting and/or mixing at least one ink
abstract_en: Device for storing and/or applying and/or outputting and/or mixing at least one ink, comprising at least one storage device (02), at least one handling device and/or at least one transport device (03) and at least one output device (04), wherein the at least one output device comprises at least one receiving device (59) and at least one pouring device (61), wherein the at least one pouring device has at least one holding device (62), wherein the at least one holding device is arranged in a movable and/or pivotable manner about a horizontal pivot axis (64) by means of a drive.

title_en: Aerial work platform for extra-high voltage transmission line engineering
abstract_en: The invention discloses an aerial work platform for ultra-high voltage transmission line engineering, which relates to the technical field of aerial work platforms and comprises a base, wherein a moving mechanism is arranged at the top of the base and comprises four brackets, four guide wheels, four auxiliary wheels, two steel cables and four driving motors, the brackets are fixedly arranged at the top of the base, the guide wheels and the auxiliary wheels are both rotationally connected to the brackets, and the guide wheels and the auxiliary wheels are respectively arranged on the two brackets: through integrated mobile mechanism, stabilizing mean, elevating system, supporting mechanism and safety mechanism, built a multi-functional combined system, mobile mechanism makes the platform remove along transmission line, and stabilizing mean ensures that the whole when removing and operation is firm, and the nimble regulation and the reliable locking of working height are realized with supporting mechanism to the elevating system, and safety mechanism provides direct protection for the personnel, has synthetically solved traditional hanging pulley stability inadequately, the difficult and poor problem of security of altitude mixture control.

title_en: Sorting machine and sorting system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sorting machine and a sorting system, and relates to the technical field of article sorting. The sorting machine comprises a support, a conveying assembly, a marking assembly and a signal receiving and processing assembly, wherein the conveying assembly is connected with the support and conveys packages, the marking assembly is connected with the support to mark the packages, the signal receiving and processing assembly comprises a receiving module and a processing module, the receiving module receives package address information and numbering rules, the processing module outputs numbers according to the package address information and numbering rules, the marking assembly is used for marking the packages according to the numbers in an inkjet mode, and the sorting system comprises the sorting machine, a distributing mechanism and a containing mechanism. The automatic marking device for the package is used for realizing automatic marking of the package sent by the terminal, adapting to personalized numbering rules, replacing manual marks, improving marking efficiency, realizing symbolization and digitization of the ink-jet marking fonts, facilitating quick reading and finishing by an express delivery person, solving the problem of inconvenient pain point of the package sent by the terminal, obviously improving the terminal sending efficiency, and adapting to high-frequency operation requirements due to simple structure.

title_en: Cold chain logistics control by temperature change turnover case
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cold-chain logistics temperature control turnover box which comprises a box body and a box cover, wherein a sinking groove for placing the box cover is formed in the top of the box body, a first cavity and a second cavity are respectively arranged in the inner walls of the front side and the rear side of the box body, the first cavity is separated from the inner cavity of the box body by a first heat conducting partition plate, the second cavity is separated from the inner cavity of the box body by a second heat conducting partition plate, the first cavity is provided with a turnover cover, a dry ice placing groove is formed in the turnover cover, a semiconductor refrigerating sheet and a battery are arranged in the second cavity, a lifting handle is arranged on the side part of the box body, a first locking mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the box body, a second locking mechanism is arranged at the upper part of the box body, and when the box body is stacked and placed, the first locking mechanism is connected with the second locking mechanism. And the first locking mechanism in the upper box body is connected with the second locking mechanism of the lower box body, so that the turnover box can be kept stable after being stacked.

title_en: Automatic force transfer device for offshore floating ball and working method thereof
abstract_en: An automatic force transfer device for an offshore floating ball and a working method thereof belong to the technical field of offshore floating ball transfer. The device comprises a roller track, an intermittent transfer mechanism, an arc baffle, a support frame, a ball collecting lifting appliance and the like, wherein the roller track is provided with an inclination angle, and the inclination angle is matched with a roller on a roller inclined plate, so that the floating ball can be automatically transported under the condition of no external power. The upper and lower guide rails are provided with intermittent transfer mechanisms to realize the transfer between the upper and lower layers of the floating ball, and the floating ball is automatically distributed by matching with a stop lever.
