The invention can recover and stably store the amplified floating ball under the environment of the ocean platform by the aid of the crane, and can control the speed and the position of the floating ball under the unpowered condition, so that the floating ball is safely transported to the release position and sequentially released.

title_en: CMC product serialization production line with fire-retardant function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a CMC product continuous production line with a flame-retardant function, which comprises a feeding mechanism, a discharging mechanism and a conveying mechanism, wherein a conveying chain of the conveying mechanism sequentially passes through a detection heating cabin, a break flame-retardant heating cabin, a transition cabin and a cooling cabin, a plurality of workpiece mounting seat groups are arranged on the conveying chain, each workpiece mounting seat group comprises a plurality of mounting seats, nitrogen can be filled in the detection heating cabin, the entering workpieces can be preheated, the porosity of the workpieces can be detected, the workpieces with the exceeding porosity can be broken in the break flame-retardant heating cabin, flame retardants are added into the break flame-retardant heating cabin, the workpieces can be mainly heated in the break flame-retardant heating cabin, and the nitrogen in the break flame-retardant heating cabin is prevented from being quickly lost when the transition cabin is used for the workpieces to pass. The device can realize automatic detection, initiative breach fire retardant filling, sectional temperature control and continuous operation, fundamentally reduces fire risk and improves production efficiency.

title_en: Material device is prevented throwing by mistake by former feed bin
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-misfeeding device of a raw material bin, which relates to the technical field of agricultural power machinery and comprises a main material bin and a trolley, wherein a plurality of second feeding holes are formed in a rectangular array at the upper end of the main material bin, electromagnetic valves are arranged in the second feeding holes, first infrared receivers are arranged in front of the plurality of second feeding holes at the upper end of the main material bin, second infrared receivers are arranged on the side edges of the plurality of second feeding holes, the trolley is arranged at the upper end of the main material bin, a plurality of feeding bins are arranged in a rectangular array at the upper end of the trolley, a plurality of discharging bins are formed in the surface of the trolley, and the plurality of feeding bins are sequentially communicated with the plurality of discharging bins through conveying pipes. According to the invention, through a series of structures, the main control panel intelligently checks the dual signals, and only the corresponding electromagnetic valve and the discharging control valve are opened after successful matching, so that the problem that the traditional feeding is easy to fall wrong and the raw materials are wasted is thoroughly solved, and the feeding accuracy is ensured.

title_en: Lifter fault injection method, device and medium based on multi-physical-field operation mechanism
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of elevators, and particularly relates to an elevator fault injection method, equipment and medium based on a multi-physical-field operation mechanism, which are used for establishing a digital model of an elevator main body system and an isolation door system and defining an interface. The method comprises the steps of configuring a data acquisition and control module, initializing a multi-physical-field parameter set and determining a fault injection point. And sending a fault excitation signal to drive the joint simulation. Status response data is collected. The fault impact is evaluated and a report is generated. The method is based on a multi-physical field coupling mechanism, realizes the accurate simulation of the fault evolution process, can quantify the influence degree of faults on the performance of the lifter, and accurately positions the fault propagation path. The method is based on accurate modeling of multiple physical field mechanisms, covers fault injection of a core component, and enables joint simulation to truly reflect fault evolution, quantitatively evaluates influences of faults on running performance, and is clear in propagation path, data support is provided for elevator fault diagnosis, preventive maintenance and control system optimization, and running safety and reliability are improved.

title_en: Automatic ceramic tile core plate distributing method and system based on cooperation of multiple mechanical arms
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of building machine control, in particular to an automatic ceramic tile core plate distributing method and system based on multi-mechanical arm cooperation, comprising the steps of utilizing a conveyer belt transmission system to transmit a target core plate to a preset positioning area, suspending the conveyer belt transmission system to obtain a positioned core plate; the method comprises the steps of utilizing a brick preparation robot to grab and place positioned core boards into a distribution workbench according to an arrangement mode to obtain core boards to be distributed, restarting a conveying belt transmission system, obtaining the number of the core boards to be distributed in the distribution workbench to obtain the number of the grabbed core boards, returning to the step of obtaining the number of the grabbed core boards in the distribution workbench when the number of the grabbed core boards is smaller than a batch value, and utilizing the brick preparation robot to grab the core boards to be distributed in the batch value simultaneously when the number of the grabbed core boards is equal to the batch value to obtain a core board sequence to be distributed, and placing the core board sequence to be distributed on a continuous operation production line. The invention can improve the production efficiency and quality of the ceramic tile.

title_en: Automatic change line posture manipulator device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of automatic manipulators, and discloses an automatic row-frame type manipulator device which comprises a movable frame. According to the scheme, the dynamic motion precision and the system stability of the manipulator under the conditions of high-speed and frequent start and stop are improved through the synergistic effect of the two sets of purely mechanical self-adaptive systems, on one hand, the follow-up optimization of the contact stiffness of the guide pair is realized through interface clearance self-adaptive regulation and control, the risk of motion instability is eliminated from the source, and on the other hand, the dynamic disturbance of the cross beam is restrained through the absorption and redistribution of the kinetic energy of the system. The two systems respectively realize the synergistic effect of two dimensions of motion constraint stability and motion driving stability, so that the manipulator can still realize high-precision repeated positioning under the limit working condition, and the comprehensive effect is obviously superior to the simple superposition of the functional modules.

title_en: Cooperative control method and system for substation drainage wire disconnecting robot and related robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a cooperative control method and system for a substation drainage wire disconnecting robot and a related robot, and belongs to the field of live overhaul of power equipment. The method comprises the steps of firstly collecting multi-vision sensing data of an operation area and inputting a pre-constructed IBVS control model to generate a vision servo autonomous control instruction, secondly detecting vision servo operation deviation and abnormal working conditions of field operation in real time and dynamically selecting a control mode, thirdly preprocessing a manual control signal to obtain a standardized teleoperation control instruction, and finally dispatching and fusing the two control instructions through a preset instruction management and control logic to realize organic cooperation of autonomous control and manual control. By the aid of the multi-mode cooperative control, accuracy, stability, anti-interference capability and engineering applicability of the disassembly operation of the drainage wire of the transformer substation are effectively improved, and actual engineering requirements of the disassembly of the drainage wire of the 220kV transformer substation are met.

title_en: Automatic checking and packing integrated machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic inspection and packing integrated machine, which comprises a control cabinet, wherein a connector sequentially passes through a feeding component, a detection mechanism, a replacement component and a packing mechanism which are arranged on the control cabinet, the detection mechanism comprises an electric detection component, a jogged part detection component, a flatness detection component and an appearance detection component, the jogged part detection component comprises a jogged part detector which is fixedly arranged, the circumference of the bottom of the jogged part detector is provided with a plurality of bearing tables, the replacement component comprises a first finished product detector and a second finished product detector which are fixedly arranged for detecting finished products, the top of the control cabinet horizontally moves, and a material taking suction head is arranged on the transverse material taking slide in a vertical direction in a moving way.

title_en: Robot assembly control method and system for vision, force sense and body sense fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a robot assembly control method and system integrating vision, force sense and body sense, and relates to the technical field of intelligent control of robots. The method comprises the steps of obtaining visual images, force sense data and body sense data in the robot assembling process, preprocessing, extracting features of the visual images and the force sense data, fusing the extracted visual features and force sense features to obtain visual force sense fusion features, analyzing the visual force sense fusion features and the body sense data by using a robot assembling prediction model based on diffusion learning to generate a flexible assembling instruction, wherein the feature extraction is carried out on the force sense data by introducing a causal mask based on a unidirectional cross attention mechanism, and the robot performs assembling operation according to the flexible assembling instruction. The invention can realize the end-to-end assembly control with high real-time performance and high safety.

title_en: Novel flexible automatic production line and production process for laser marking of electric energy meter label
abstract_en: The invention provides a novel flexible automatic production line and a production process for laser marking of electric energy meter labels, wherein the automatic production line comprises a turntable, and a label circulating feeding mechanism, a label feeding mechanism, a laser marking mechanism, a label detection mechanism, a finished label blanking mechanism and a finished label circulating storage mechanism which are distributed around the turntable; adopt carousel formula overall arrangement, with a plurality of stations integration in an organic wholes such as feed, material loading, marking, detection, unloading, storage, compact structure, area is little, sign circulation feeding mechanism and finished product sign circulation storage mechanism all adopt circulation pushing materials and many storage silo structures, realized the continuous supply and the storage of sign, possess good flexible throughput, and can be according to the corresponding storage department of changing the adaptation of not unidimensional sign, can compatible multiple model sign, satisfy the production demand of many varieties, small batch.

title_en: Transformer production and processing device
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a transformer production and processing device. The transformer production and processing device comprises a machine base, a feeding conveying mechanism, a clamping and conveying mechanism, a tin dipping mechanism, a detecting mechanism, a discharging conveying mechanism and a defective product conveying mechanism, wherein the tin dipping mechanism is used for tin dipping each pin of a to-be-tin dipped transformer semi-finished product of a tin dipping working position, the detecting mechanism is used for detecting performance of a tin dipping transformer of the detecting working position to judge whether the performance of the tin dipping transformer meets requirements, if so, the tin dipping transformer is a qualified transformer product, the main clamping and conveying mechanism is used for conveying the qualified transformer product from the detecting working position to the placing working position of the discharging conveying mechanism, if not, the tin dipping transformer is a defective transformer, and the auxiliary clamping and conveying mechanism is used for conveying the defective transformer from the detecting working position to the storing working position of the defective product conveying mechanism. The transformer production and processing device has the advantages of lower labor intensity and higher automation degree.

title_en: Intelligent counting suspension conveying system for micro-channel flat tube production for refrigeration
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of condenser flat tubes, in particular to an intelligent counting suspension conveying system for micro-channel flat tube production for refrigeration, wherein a discharging channel with a fixed size is generally adopted in an existing flat tube discharging mechanism, when a porous flat tube sequentially enters a discharging port, a channel space is limited, a subsequent flat tube is easy to interfere with a previous flat tube which is discharging, so that a material clamping phenomenon is caused, and further, feeding interruption or surface damage of the flat tube is caused. A micro-channel flat tube production intelligent counting suspension conveying system for refrigeration is characterized in that when a discharging block extrudes a current flat tube for discharging, a stagnation cavity is expanded into a V-shaped angle expansion state by blocking deflection of a side plate, a sufficient falling space is provided for a subsequent flat tube, and a material clamping phenomenon caused by narrow space is effectively avoided.

title_en: High temperature sample collection transfer device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a high-temperature sample collecting and transferring device, which is suitable for transferring high-temperature samples and comprises a chassis frame, a first cooling mechanism and a second cooling mechanism, wherein the chassis frame is provided with a first storage area and a second storage area for bearing the samples, the first cooling mechanism is detachably arranged in the first storage area and forms a closed refrigerating cavity together with the chassis frame to accommodate the samples to be cooled, the first cooling mechanism comprises at least one refrigerator, the cold end of the refrigerator is positioned in the refrigerating cavity, the hot end of the refrigerator is exposed out of the refrigerating cavity, and the second cooling mechanism is arranged in the second storage area and is configured to forcedly dissipate heat of at least one of the samples positioned in the second storage area and the hot end of the refrigerator.

title_en: Robot power position mixed impedance parameter on-line self-tuning method with complex space constraint
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of robot automatic processing control, in particular to a robot manpower bit mixed impedance parameter on-line self-tuning method with complex space constraint, which comprises the steps of collecting a real-time contact force signal and an auxiliary feedback signal between an end effector and a workpiece; the method comprises the steps of extracting time domain dynamic characteristics from real-time contact force signals, respectively identifying first, second and transitional precursor task phases based on three signal forms of transient step, quasi-periodic fluctuation and transient variation trend in the characteristics, generating target impedance parameters of a force control direction according to the current task phases, applying the target impedance parameters to a force-position hybrid control architecture after smooth transition, applying the parameters to the force control direction, and maintaining constant impedance parameters in the position control direction. The method realizes the impact protection requirement of the contact transition stage and the cutting efficiency requirement of the residual height stable grinding stage in the same welding line grinding process, and solves the technical problem that the conventional fixed parameter method cannot adapt to the multi-stage process requirement.

title_en: General clamping device and method for lifting unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a general clamping device and method for lifting an unmanned aerial vehicle, the device comprises four bidirectional clamping blocks and a bidirectional clamping driving mechanism, wherein the four bidirectional clamping blocks are distributed in a rectangular shape, one bidirectional clamping block is a mounting-end bidirectional clamping block, the opposite angle of the mounting-end bidirectional clamping block is a free-end bidirectional clamping block, the free-end bidirectional clamping block is respectively connected with two adjacent bidirectional clamping blocks through a guide structure, the bidirectional clamping driving mechanism comprises a driving component, a driven driving component and a reversing transmission component, the driving component comprises a driving screw rod, one end of the driving screw rod is rotatably connected to the mounting-end bidirectional clamping block, the other end of the driving screw rod is provided with a thread structure and is connected with one of the bidirectional clamping blocks adjacent to the mounting-end bidirectional clamping block, and the device can realize stable clamping on boxes with different sizes, and remarkably improve stability, safety and automatic operation efficiency in the lifting process of the unmanned aerial vehicle.

title_en: Elevator data processing method and related equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses an elevator data processing method and related equipment, belonging to the technical field of data processing, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining elevator data to be processed of a target elevator; the method comprises the steps of determining a data compression algorithm matched with a data type based on the data type of elevator data, wherein the data type comprises a switch value type and a numerical value type, executing data compression based on the data compression algorithm obtained by determining each elevator data, generating a compression record table, packaging, writing and storing the elevator data subjected to data compression and the compression record table, waiting for data uploading, and finishing data processing of the elevator data. According to the application, the data processing compression is carried out by adopting a specific data compression algorithm based on the time sequence characteristics and the data rule of the elevator switching value and the numerical value type, so that the efficient compression can be effectively realized, the adaptability of cross-platform decompression is effectively improved by constructing the compression record table, the data transmission efficiency is effectively improved, and the transmission cost is reduced.

title_en: Electroplating and transporting device for circuit board
abstract_en: The invention provides a circuit board electroplating transportation device, and relates to the technical field of integrated circuit manufacturing. The circuit board electroplating transportation device comprises a manipulator arranged above an electroplating tank, a material moving assembly in driving connection with the manipulator so as to enable the material moving assembly to perform lifting and/or rotating motion and be used for taking and placing a workpiece basket loaded with a circuit board, and a self-adaptive counterweight unit linked with the material moving assembly and used for automatically adjusting counterweights when the load of the material moving assembly changes. The scheme can inhibit unbalanced load under no-load, full-load and intermediate-load conditions, lighten the radial stress of a mechanical arm driving part, improve the stability of lifting and rotation, and reduce the uneven risk of a plating layer caused by shaking of a circuit board in the plating solution.

title_en: SA/CNFs/HKUST-1@PAs aerogel and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses SA/CNFs/HKUST-1@PAs aerogel and a preparation method and application thereof. The SA/CNFs/HKUST-1@PAs aerogel comprises sodium alginate, cellulose nanofiber and HKUST-1@PA, wherein a crosslinked structure is formed by chemical crosslinking of the sodium alginate, cellulose nanofiber and HKUST-1@PAs composite, and the mass ratio of the sodium alginate, the cellulose nanofiber and the HKUST-1@PAs composite is (60-70): (10-15): 1. The HKUST-1@PA comprises HKUST-1 and phenolic acid active substances, wherein the phenolic acid active substances are loaded on the HKUST-1, and the mass ratio of the HKUST-1 to the phenolic acid active substances is 5 (2-4). The aerogel provided by the invention has strong compression-resistant buffer performance, slow release of phenolic acid active substances and antioxidation, can obviously reduce mechanical damage and microbial spoilage of berries and fruits in long-distance transportation, has green and environment-friendly raw materials, can replace plastic protective foam, and reduces white pollution. The fresh-keeping buffer pad can be used for fresh-keeping and transportation protection after the berries are picked up, so that the circulation loss is effectively reduced, and the shelf life is prolonged.

title_en: Gas boiler fast supplement feeding device for sodium silicate production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a reinforced technical field of sodium silicate kiln discloses a gas boiler fast supplement feeding device for sodium silicate production, the novel nipple rectifier comprises a cylindrical shel, the front fixed surface of barrel installs control switch, and the inside of barrel is provided with drive assembly, the lower fixed surface of barrel installs the second discharge gate, and one side of barrel is provided with transport assembly, the rear fixed surface of barrel installs the battery. The utility model discloses a drive assembly can strike off adnexed material on the barrel inner wall on the one hand, and on the other hand can also prevent that the inside material of barrel from appearing blocking phenomenon, has ensured reinforced normal clear, can carry outside raw materials to the inside of barrel through conveying component reinforced through conveying component, has reduced the artifical intensity of falling the material of staff, has saved the time of falling the material, and this design cost is lower simultaneously, and the suitability is wider, has wide marketing prospect.

title_en: Arrangement underframe assembly for metal plate
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a metal sheet's arrangement chassis subassembly in metal manufacturing technical field, including the layer board, a plurality of stabilizer blades of its downside fixedly connected with for hold a plurality of board rolls, the layer board sets up to the rectangular plate structure, a plurality ofly to limit baffle, install on the layer board along layer board length direction is adjustable, every to limit baffle mutual disposition, wherein, a pair of limit baffle inject a board roll and make the board roll arrange in between the two, the length direction perpendicular to board roll's of layer board axis, the hanging hole of being convenient for lift by crane is offered to the part that the layer board two are close to the broadside. Can intensively place a plurality of plate coils and is convenient for uniform hoisting.

title_en: Packaging film material roll mounting roller
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a packaging film material rolls up installation roller, including the deflector roll, the draw-in groove that the annular set up is seted up at the deflector roll both ends, left draw-in groove and right draw-in groove have been seted up on the deflector roll curved surface, equal fixed mounting has the spring in left side draw-in groove and the right draw-in groove, and spring upper end difference fixed mounting in left draw-in groove and the right draw-in groove has left joint piece and right joint piece, right joint piece lower extreme one side fixedly connected with press the clamp plate, slope has all been seted up to left side joint piece and right joint piece upper end, and two domatic facies deviate from, respectively towards the deflector roll. The utility model relates to an installation roller, in particular to packaging film material book installation roller belongs to sizing material packaging film processing technology field. title_en: Fodder hoisting device with adjustable
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an adjustable feed lifting device, comprising a scraper (4) which is connected with each other and is used for conveying powdery feed; the material enters the scraper conveyor (4) from the feeding hole (21), is firstly transported above the scraper conveyor (4) away from the bucket elevator (5) according to the arrow direction, and then is transported to the bucket elevator (5) below the scraper conveyor (4) according to the arrow direction after the end part is turned over, so that the height of a feed layer determines the volume flow of the whole feed during the transportation above the scraper conveyor (4); a bucket elevator (5) for elevating the powdery feed; the scraper conveyor (4) is provided with an adjusting flashboard (41) for controlling the height of the feed layer of the scraper conveyor (4), and the adjusting flashboard (41) is electrically connected with a motor of the bucket elevator (5). Compared with the prior art, the utility model has the advantages of difficult machine blockage, high efficiency and the like.

title_en: Vegetable oil storage tank for pig feed
abstract_en: A vegetable oil storage tank for pig feed comprises an oil tank, wherein an oil pumping pipe is communicated with the oil tank, a sedimentation pipe is arranged at the bottom of the oil tank, a sewage blocking valve is arranged in the sedimentation pipe, one end of the sedimentation pipe is communicated with a sewage discharge pipe, and a valve is arranged on the sewage discharge pipe; the trash blocking valve comprises a valve pipe arranged in the sedimentation pipe, an opening and an oil inlet hole are formed in the valve pipe, one end of the valve pipe is in transmission connection with a driving device arranged at one end of the sedimentation pipe, and a spiral conveyor is arranged in the sewage discharge pipe. The oil tank bottom impurity cleaning device can clean impurities at the bottom of the oil tank under the condition that normal use of the oil tank is not influenced.

title_en: Dustproof unpacking and feeding vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dustproof unpacking and feeding vehicle, which relates to the field of ton bag unpacking and feeding and comprises a vehicle frame, wherein a moving part is arranged below the vehicle frame, a bearing platform for bearing a material bag is arranged on the vehicle frame, a material guide pipe is arranged below the bearing platform on the vehicle frame, a material inlet and a material outlet are respectively formed at two ends of the material guide pipe, a material guide port communicated with the material guide pipe material inlet is formed in the bearing platform, a fastening component for fixing the edge of the material bag material outlet opening at the material guide pipe material inlet is arranged on the vehicle frame, a dustproof pipe is sleeved on the periphery of the material guide pipe, the dustproof pipe is arranged on the dustproof pipe in a lifting mode, and a sealing element is arranged between the material guide pipe and the dustproof pipe. This application helps preventing to throw volatilizing of material in-process dust.

title_en: Filling equipment of ration control
abstract_en: The utility model discloses filling equipment with quantitative control, which comprises an oil tank, an electric control valve, a timer, a control module and a filling platform, wherein the bottom of the oil tank is communicated with an oil outlet pipe; the electric control valve is fixedly arranged at the outlet end of the oil outlet pipe; the control module is electrically connected with the electric control valve and the timer; the filling table is arranged at the bottom of the oil outlet pipe; the timer is used for recording the opening time of the electric control valve. In the filling equipment with quantitative control, the timer can adjust the preset time according to containers to be filled with different volumes, so that the quantitative oil filling is realized for the containers with different volumes, and the phenomenon of edible oil waste caused by continuous oil filling after the containers are filled with the oil is avoided; the liquid level sensor can detect the full oil signal of the oil tank, and avoids the waste of edible oil caused by excessive oil injection of external oil supply equipment to the oil tank.

title_en: Take chicken feet partial shipment equipment of hot water juice
abstract_en: The utility model relates to chicken claw subpackaging equipment with soup, in particular to the technical field of chicken claw packaging, which comprises a conveying belt, rubber disc placing equipment, chicken claw quantitative subpackaging equipment, rubber film extending equipment and hot melting edge sealing equipment, wherein the rubber disc placing equipment is positioned at one end of the conveying belt, the chicken claw quantitative subpackaging equipment, the rubber film extending equipment and the hot melting edge sealing equipment are sequentially positioned on the conveying belt, the chicken claw quantitative subpackaging equipment comprises a conveying inclined plate, a quantifying device is arranged at the top end of the conveying inclined plate, and a baffle is arranged on one side, close to the rubber film extending equipment, of the conveying inclined plate.

title_en: Tealeaves packing carton convenient to dismantle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tea packing box convenient to disassemble, which relates to the field of tea packing boxes and comprises a first cover detachably clamped at the top end of a box body, a second cover detachably connected with the bottom end of the box body through threads, two mounting boxes are respectively and symmetrically arranged on the inner wall of the top of the first cover, a strip-shaped opening communicated with the mounting boxes is arranged on the outer wall of the top of the first cover, a first L-shaped rod is arranged in each mounting box, the first end of the first L-shaped rod can slide and penetrate through the inner wall of each mounting box to be fixedly connected with a convex block, the second end of the first L-shaped rod can slide and penetrate through the strip-shaped opening to be fixedly connected with a moving block, a spring is arranged between each convex block and the outer wall of each mounting box, the spring is sleeved on the first L-shaped rod, grooves matched with the convex blocks are respectively and symmetrically arranged on the inner wall of the top of the box body, and the grooves are detachably connected with the convex blocks; the tea packaging box is beneficial to disassembling the cover body of the tea packaging box and drying tea in the tea packaging box, and is convenient and practical.

title_en: Kit for determining activity of small molecule inhibitor inhibiting enzyme
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of kits, and discloses a kit for measuring activity of small molecule inhibitors, which comprises a kit body, wherein the kit body is a plate body, the lower part of the kit body is fixedly connected with a connecting seat, the bottom of the connecting seat is rotatably connected with a base through a bearing, a plurality of pipe grooves are arranged at the position, close to the outer edge, of the kit body, a supporting plate is sleeved in the middle of the connecting seat, grooves matched with the pipe grooves are formed in the surface of the supporting plate, positioning strips are arranged on the side walls of the connecting seat, and the supporting plate is fixed on the connecting seat through the positioning strips. This kind of kit that can be used to survey small molecule inhibitor restraines enzyme activity, through set up the layer board of portable regulation on the connecting seat for operating personnel can match the not test tube of co-altitude according to the altitude mixture control layer board position of test tube, makes the kit, has avoided current kit to generally adopt fixed knot to construct, can't carry out the condition of effectual regulation according to the test tube length of reality.

title_en: Hydraulic hand-pushed forklift with anti-tipping function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hydraulic hand-pushed forklift with an anti-tipping function, which comprises a forklift body, wherein two symmetrical supporting rods are fixed on the outer walls of two sides of the forklift body, a sliding groove is formed in the outer wall of one side of each supporting rod, the sliding groove extends downwards to the bottom end of each supporting rod, a sliding block is connected in each sliding groove in a sliding manner, a sliding rod is arranged at one end of each sliding block, one end of each sliding rod is fixed with a same limiting frame, and each limiting frame is of a structure shaped like the Chinese character 'Contraband'; the outer wall of one side of the supporting rod is provided with positioning holes which are uniformly distributed. According to the utility model, by arranging the limiting frame, the sliding block and the positioning knob, a user can put the sliding block into the sliding groove from the bottom of the supporting rod according to the requirement, move the sliding block to the position corresponding to the positioning hole, insert the positioning knob into the corresponding positioning hole, rotate the positioning knob and connect and fix the positioning knob and the sliding block through threads, so that the goods are limited and fixed by the limiting frame in an auxiliary manner, and the anti-tipping effect is achieved.

title_en: Novel thermal insulation bag
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of bags, in particular to a novel heat-insulating bag which comprises a heat-insulating bag body and a heat-insulating bag cover, wherein an upper edge piece is arranged at an opening of the upper part of the heat-insulating bag body, the upper edge piece comprises an annular bulge, a plurality of first magnetic suction pieces are uniformly arranged on the annular bulge, a lower edge piece is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the heat-insulating bag cover, the lower edge piece comprises a concave part corresponding to the annular bulge, a plurality of second magnetic suction pieces corresponding to the first magnetic suction pieces are arranged in the concave part, when the heat-insulating bag cover covers the upper part of the heat-insulating bag body, the concave part is clamped with the annular bulge, and the first magnetic suction pieces are magnetically connected with the second magnetic suction pieces. The novel heat-preservation bag can solve the problems of troublesome use and poor sealing effect of the zipper in the prior art, and is convenient to use and better in sealing and waterproof effects.

title_en: Aviation fuel holding vessel
abstract_en: The utility model provides an aviation fuel storage tank, and relates to the technical field of fuel storage. The aviation fuel storage tank comprises a tank body and a sampling mechanism. The sampling mechanism comprises a sampling tube, an oil suction tube, a first valve, a first piston, a piston rod, a guide block, a sliding block, a spring, a screw rod, an oil taking port, a connector and a sampling bottle. The sampling tube extends into the tank body, the left end of the oil suction tube is communicated with the sampling tube, the first piston is arranged in the oil suction tube in a sliding mode, the screw rod is in threaded connection with the right end of the oil suction tube, and one end of the screw rod is connected with the sliding block through a bearing. The oil taking port is arranged along the radial direction of the oil suction pipe, one end of the connector is fixedly connected with the oil taking port, and the other end of the connector is detachably connected with the sampling bottle. The sampling tube can extend below the liquid level of aviation fuel in the tank body so as to avoid sucking out inert gas in the tank during sampling, and prolong the period of supplementing the inert gas in the tank. In the whole sampling process, oxygen outside the tank cannot enter the tank, so that the quality guarantee period of the aviation fuel oil can be prolonged.

title_en: Lathe feeding track face recognizing and turning device
abstract_en: The utility model is suitable for the technical field of lathes, and provides a lathe feeding rail face recognizing and turning device, which comprises: pan feeding track, and set up in the ejection of compact track of pan feeding track one side, wherein, the pan feeding track with be provided with tilting mechanism between the ejection of compact track, and, the rigid coupling has first fender material part on the pan feeding track, just first fender material part is kept away from one side of ejection of compact track still be provided with the second fender material part of pan feeding track rigid coupling, first fender material part with be provided with first proximity switch between the second fender material part, moreover, correspond first proximity switch go back fixed mounting have a detection part on the pan feeding track lateral wall, when the work piece is carried in the pan feeding track, first fender material part descends, intercepts the work piece, and simultaneously, the second fender material part descends, intercepts follow-up work piece and separates, and telescopic cylinder among the detection part promotes the scraping wings and removes to the work piece.

title_en: Adhesive device with directional moving function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of adhesive tapes and discloses a gluing device with a directional moving function. This adhesive device with directional function that removes, the knob rotates, the knob drives the threaded rod and rotates, threaded connection through movable plate and threaded rod, make the threaded rod rotate and drive the movable plate and remove under the spacing of spout and control, be convenient for control the distance of sticky tape and locating plate, pass the gyro wheel with the one end of sticky tape, it is spacing to make the sticky tape through the setting of limiting plate, fix the bottom on the inclined plane around going up the pinch roller with the one end of sticky tape again, paste the locating plate on the table edge, promote the shell forward, the sticky tape is linear movement under the spacing of limiting plate, rotation through the gyro wheel, the sticky tape of being convenient for slides, roll through the pinch roller, glue the sticky tape on the desktop, setting through the inclined plane, make the sticky tape compaction.

title_en: A displacement device for suction head detects dress box assembly line
abstract_en: The utility model provides a pitch changing device for a sucker detection boxing assembly line. A displacement device for suction head detects dress box assembly line includes: the variable pitch device, the variable pitch device includes displacement mechanism and lower displacement mechanism, it includes the support frame to go up displacement mechanism, one side fixedly connected with of support frame slides the machine, be provided with the slider on the smooth machine, one side fixedly connected with of slider goes up the variable pitch frame, the inside fixed mounting who goes up the variable pitch frame has the variable pitch power supply. According to the distance changing device for the suction head detection and boxing assembly line, the upper distance changing mechanism and the lower distance changing mechanism are arranged in a matched mode, the distance between the disposable suction heads can be conveniently determined in the boxing process, the equal distance between each box of disposable suction heads is guaranteed, the product quality is improved to a certain degree, mass production is facilitated, and convenience is brought to use of workers.

title_en: Floating bracket for mounting chuck of broaching machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a floating bracket for mounting a chuck of a broaching machine, which comprises a first positioning ring and a second positioning ring, wherein the first positioning ring and the second positioning ring are different in vertical height, at least three groups of inclined supports are radially arranged outside the first positioning ring in an annular array, elastic parts are arranged at the positions with the same height as the second positioning ring, the elastic parts are radially arranged and connected with the second positioning ring, and the lengths and the elastic coefficients of the elastic parts between the first positioning ring and the second positioning ring are the same.

title_en: Adjustable lifting type movable support rod
abstract_en: The utility model provides an adjustable lifting type movable supporting rod, and belongs to the technical field of cargo carrying. This adjustable lift-up formula removes bracing piece includes first slider, second slider, extending structure, first promotion structure, connection structure, first bearing structure. The lifting device can be adjusted left and right according to the required space size, the universality of the whole device can be improved, the lifting device is suitable for different space sizes, the whole height is lower, when a higher device needs to be lifted, the whole device can be erected on a device capable of lifting up and down, the lifting device is suitable for more different heights, the application range is wider, the universality is greatly improved, the types of materials are reduced, the structure is simple, and the operation is simple and convenient.

title_en: Carbon ribbon blowing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a carbon ribbon emptying device, which comprises: the device comprises chuck mechanisms which are parallel to each other and are arranged at intervals, wherein a first discharging roller is coaxially arranged on the inner side of one chuck mechanism, a second discharging roller is coaxially arranged on the inner side of the other chuck mechanism, the end parts of the first discharging roller and the second discharging roller can be clamped and fixed together, and fixed rubber sleeves are respectively arranged on the first discharging roller and the second discharging roller; the chuck mechanism includes: the device comprises a limiting chuck, a turntable and balls, wherein the limiting chuck is sleeved on the turntable, an annular chute is formed at the joint of the limiting chuck and the turntable, a plurality of balls capable of freely rotating are arranged in the annular chute, and a first discharging roller and a second discharging roller are fixed on the inner side of the turntable; the outer sides of the limiting chucks are respectively hinged with first supporting rods. The device overcomes the problem that the whole carbon ribbon in the prior art is easy to shake in the process of discharging, so that the carbon ribbon can incline and deviate in the pulling process, and further wrinkles are generated on the periphery of the carbon ribbon, and the printing quality is seriously influenced.

title_en: Quick take-up and pay-off mechanism of portable wire reel
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of wire reels, and discloses a quick take-up and pay-off mechanism of a portable wire reel, which comprises a wire reel body, wherein support columns are fixedly installed at two ends of the top surface of a working base, a transmission shaft is movably installed in a rotating shaft base, a connecting platform is fixedly installed at one side of the transmission shaft, an accommodating column is welded at one side of the connecting platform, opposite perforations are formed in the surface of the accommodating column, a connecting column is fixedly installed at one side of a lifting slider, a rotating base is fixedly installed at one side of the connecting column, a transverse screw rod is movably installed in the rotating base, a transverse slider is connected to the surface of the transverse screw rod in a threaded mode, and a limiting roller is movably installed in the movable base. This quick receipts paying out machine of portable wire reel moves the drive through removing about horizontal slider, moves about moving the removal that drives spacing gyro wheel through removing about horizontal slider, has reached the beneficial effect that drives the automatic range of wire rod.

title_en: Automatic safety detection device for old elevator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic safety detection device for old elevators, which belongs to the technical field of elevator detection and comprises a driving device, a lifting device, an adjusting device, an opening and closing device and a cleaning device, wherein the lifting device is installed at the top of the driving device, the adjusting device is installed at the top of the lifting device, and the opening and closing device and the cleaning device are respectively installed at two ends of the top of the adjusting device.

title_en: Built-in permanent magnet synchronous driving device of screw elevator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a built-in permanent magnet synchronous driving device of a screw elevator, which comprises a motor shell, wherein an encoder is arranged inside the motor shell, an upper end cover is arranged on the motor shell, a friction plate is arranged on the upper end cover, an electromagnet is contacted with the friction plate, a motor stator is fixedly connected inside the motor shell, a motor rotor is rotatably connected inside the motor stator, a hollow shaft is fixedly connected inside the motor rotor, and the hollow shaft is rotatably connected with the upper end cover. According to the utility model, by designing the stall safety brake, when the motor casing stalls in the moving process, the stall safety brake can work, the stall safety brake can lock the screw rod, the motor casing can be limited from moving continuously, the moving safety is improved, and the electromagnet can play a braking role on the movement of the motor casing when being electrified under the action of the electromagnet, so that the safety is higher.

title_en: Safe and rapid fixed-length collection chain link lifting hook
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a safe-to-use and fast-to-length collection chain link lifting hook which comprises a lifting hook body, wherein supporting plates are fixedly connected to the bottoms of the front side and the rear side of the lifting hook body, rotary plates are movably mounted at the bottoms of the front side and the rear side of the lifting hook body through pin shafts and located at the bottom of the supporting plates, a box body is fixedly connected to the top of the supporting plates, limiting grooves are formed in the tops of the rotary plates, and bolts are arranged inside the limiting grooves. The utility model has the advantages of safety and rapidness, solves the problems that the steel wire rope is in contact with the driven wheel body and the chain, the steel wire rope is in mutual friction with the driven wheel body and the chain in the process of lifting the driven wheel by the crown block to adjust the height, the safety risk of cutting off the steel wire rope exists, the potential safety hazard of hurting people exists, the steel wire rope is inconvenient to thread and draw the rope and pick up the crown block lifting hook in the process of lifting the driven wheel by the crown block after penetrating through two sides of the driven wheel shaft, and the time for threading and picking up the rope is about 15 minutes each time.

title_en: Feeding bracket convenient for limiting for machining
abstract_en: The utility model is suitable for the technical field of machining equipment, and provides a feeding bracket for machining, which is convenient to limit and comprises a left mounting frame, wherein a right mounting frame is arranged on the right side of the left mounting frame; be provided with the stopper on the conveyer belt, cooperate with the spacing groove on the elevating gear, carry out the position at the removal in-process of fortune material dolly and inject, the fortune material dolly passes through the conveyer belt and transports to the connecting plate on, the electro-magnet passes through the iron sheet at the fortune material dolly back and will transport the material dolly firmly the adsorption column, guarantees that elevating gear when rising or decline, and the fortune material dolly can not break away from, convenient to use, and the security is high.

title_en: Gypsum board conveying equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the utility model provides gypsum board conveying equipment, which comprises a chain plate type conveying mechanism and a jacking mechanism, wherein the jacking mechanism is matched with the chain plate type conveying mechanism to act; chain slat type conveying mechanism sets to carry the gypsum board stack, and climbing mechanism sets to work as gypsum board conveying equipment carries out loading and unloading work, upwards the jacking and with the gypsum board stack jack-up take the altitude on the chain slat type conveying mechanism.

title_en: Linear conveying device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a linear conveying device, which comprises a base assembly, a conveying assembly and a driving assembly, wherein the base assembly is provided with at least two base units which are sequentially distributed at intervals along a first direction, and the base units are provided with supporting seats which are arranged along a second direction; the conveying assembly is provided with a conveying seat and a plurality of conveying rails, the conveying seat is movably mounted on the conveying rails, and the plurality of conveying rails are respectively mounted on the corresponding supporting seats; the driving assembly is provided with at least two driving pieces, and the driving pieces are used for driving the conveying seat to move along the conveying track. The linear conveying device can convey workpieces with large weight and large size, the conveying is more stable, and meanwhile, the conveying seat is driven by the driving pieces, so that the driving force is larger, the high-speed conveying of the workpieces with large weight and large size can be realized, the automatic conveying of the workpieces with large size is realized, and the production efficiency is improved.

title_en: Nylon yarn winding device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of winding equipment, in particular to a nylon yarn winding device which comprises a rotating seat, a winding drum, a rotating shaft, a motor I and a rack, wherein the rotating seat is arranged on the rotating seat; the rack comprises a first support, a base and a second support; the first support and the second support are respectively positioned at two ends of the top of the base, and the rotating seat is rotatably connected between the first support and the second support; the winding device also comprises a steering mechanism and a pressing mechanism; the steering mechanism is positioned on the base right below the motor I; the pressing mechanism is located between the first support and the second support on one side of the top end of the base. According to the utility model, the rotating seat and the steering mechanism are assembled on the frame, so that the steering mechanism can drive the second bracket of the frame to retreat and steer, the rotating seat is separated, the rotating shaft is exposed, the winding drum can be rapidly assembled and disassembled on the rotating shaft, and the assembling and disassembling convenience of the winding drum are improved; and the movable part of the rotating seat can be adaptively adjusted according to the length size of the winding drum, so that the applicability of the device is improved.

title_en: Stainless steel tank with good sealing and leakage-proof performance
abstract_en: The utility model provides a sealed stainless steel jar that leak protection performance is good, includes a jar body, and one side of jar body is equipped with the apron, and jar body is close to the spacing box of equal fixedly connected with on the both sides wall of apron, and the inside of spacing box is equipped with the swing mechanism, and the apron is close to the one end fixedly connected with connecting plate of the jar body, and the inside symmetry of connecting plate is equipped with two fixed establishment, and beneficial effect is: can play and be convenient for carry out the dismouting operation to the apron, make fixedly stable between the apron and the jar body when fixed to improved the sealed effect of the jar body, it is convenient to dismantle simultaneously, need not consume a large amount of operating time, and then improved the efficiency of work.

title_en: Auxiliary feeding device for cigarette loading and unloading
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of cigarette product loading and unloading, and provides an auxiliary feeding device for cigarette loading and unloading, which comprises a feeding support with a feeding channel, wherein a first supporting piece and a second supporting piece for supporting the feeding support are respectively arranged at two sides of the bottom of the feeding support, and a first hinge point is formed between the first supporting piece and the feeding support; the second supporting piece is of a height-adjustable structure, and a second hinge point is formed between the second supporting piece and the feeding support; when the height of the second supporting piece changes, the feeding bracket rotates around the first hinge point. According to the utility model, the second supporting piece with the height adjusting function is arranged at the bottom of the feeding support, and when the height of the second supporting piece is changed, the inclination angle of the feeding support is changed, so that the cigarette products can rapidly slide into the boxcar from the feeding channel, and therefore, the feeding device can be used under various different height difference conditions, the labor intensity of workers is effectively reduced, and the whole loading process is more efficient and safer.

title_en: Protection mechanism for conveyer belt
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a protective mechanism for a conveyor belt, which comprises a conveyor belt body, wherein mounting bars are symmetrically and fixedly connected to two sides of the conveyor belt body, strip-shaped grooves are formed in the tops of the two mounting bars, protective baffles are sleeved in inner cavities of the two strip-shaped grooves in a sliding mode, extrusion rollers are rotatably connected to the inner cavities of the two strip-shaped grooves and the positions below the protective baffles, driving rods are fixedly connected to one ends of the two extrusion rollers, one ends of the two driving rods penetrate through one side of the inner wall of the corresponding strip-shaped groove and are fixedly connected with a rotating ring, and grooves are formed in one sides of the two mounting bars. According to the utility model, the protective baffle and the squeeze roller are arranged, and the rotation of the squeeze roller drives the protective baffle to move to protrude or enter the strip-shaped groove, so that the protective baffle can protrude out of the strip-shaped groove when the protective baffle is needed to be used and can be accommodated into the strip-shaped groove when the protective baffle is not needed to be used, and the applicability of the conveyor belt is improved.

title_en: Portable portable pay off rack
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of electric tracing band production equipment, and particularly discloses a portable movable pay-off rack. The device comprises two tripods, wherein the two tripods are fixedly connected through a plurality of connecting rods; the top end of the tripod is provided with an arc-shaped groove; the bearing is also matched with a shaft, two bearings are sleeved on the shaft, and the bearings can be placed in the arc-shaped grooves. And movable plugging plates are arranged at two ends of the shaft. And an outer baffle is arranged on the outer side of the arc-shaped groove. An inner baffle is arranged on the inner side of the arc-shaped groove. The inner baffle and the outer baffle are both arc-shaped plates. And a balance plate is arranged on one side of the bottom end of the tripod. The wire coil is simple in structure, light in weight and convenient to carry and use, only the bearing needs to be placed in the arc-shaped groove in the using process, and the wire coil can rotate by pulling the cable in the using process, so that the wire releasing purpose is achieved. And the balance plate plays a balancing role in the using process, so that the tripod can be prevented from being pulled over by the pulling force from the cable.

title_en: Lifting type construction platform for house building engineering
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a lifting type construction platform for house building engineering, which comprises a movable base, wherein a scissor type lifter is fixedly arranged at the top of the movable base, a top box is fixedly arranged on the movable end face of the top of the scissor type lifter, protective frames are welded on the front and back parts of the top box, and a mounting shaft is rotatably arranged between one side of the opposite surfaces of the two protective frames. This a over-and-under type construction platform for housing construction engineering, install electric block additional at the side of top case and be used for hoist and mount material from top to bottom, when needing to deliver article, need not to cut the reciprocating type lift of fork riser, can not influence workman's on the platform normal construction, it does not influence the efficiency of construction not to deliver article from top to bottom, and the hoist and mount board is horizontal level and places when using, when not using, the hoist and mount board is vertical placing, can accomodate the hoist and mount board, avoid when not needing hoist and mount, the platform wholly occupies great space, its structure is more optimized, and the design is more reasonable.

title_en: Combined carrying pole beam for hoisting rolling mill frame
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a combined carrying pole beam for hoisting a rolling mill stand, which comprises a main beam, wherein hoisting points are arranged at two ends of the main beam, an inserting and accommodating hole penetrating through the upper surface and the lower surface of the main beam is formed in the middle of the main beam, the rolling mill stand can be inserted into the inserting and accommodating hole from bottom to top, a connecting port is formed in the main beam, a short beam for supporting the rolling mill stand is inserted into the connecting port, and the short beam penetrates through the inserting and accommodating hole. The utility model adopts the structure of the combined shoulder pole beam, and provides the combined shoulder pole beam lifting appliance with good stability and convenient operation so as to assist in lifting the rolling mill stand.

title_en: Multifunctional medicine box
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional medicine box which comprises a box body, wherein a storage structure is arranged in the box body; the storage structure includes: the utility model relates to the technical field of medicine storage boxes, in particular to a storage structure adopted by the utility model, a plurality of first baffles are arranged in a pull box, the pull box is divided into a plurality of storage spaces through the first baffles arranged in the pull box, medicines can be stored according to dosage, a plurality of storage spaces are separated from the bottle storage box through the second baffles arranged in the bottle storage box, bottled medicines can be stored separately, and the medicines can be added into the pull box conveniently.

title_en: Aluminum plate coil and fixing frame thereof
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an aluminum plate coil, which comprises an aluminum plate coil main body, wherein a hollow area is arranged in the middle of the aluminum plate coil main body; the surface of the aluminum plate is provided with an anodic oxide film, the surface of the anodic oxide film is provided with a protective layer, and the thickness of the aluminum plate is 2.0-4.0 mm; a binding belt is arranged on the aluminum plate roll main body, and a hard board is arranged at a position where the binding belt is contacted with the edge angle position of the aluminum plate roll; steel character codes are arranged on the side surface or the curved surface of the aluminum plate coil main body; the steel character code is positioned close to the binding belt; and the initial end of the aluminum plate is provided with an anti-counterfeiting mark. The scheme also comprises a fixing frame for fixing the aluminum plate coil main body, which comprises a bottom plate, a stand column and a movable wheel. The aluminum plate coil main body in the scheme has the capacity of preventing rust and corrosion, and the fixing frame for supporting the aluminum plate coil is stable in structure, high in strength, simple in structure and convenient to manufacture.

title_en: Environment-friendly transportation device for coke production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an environment-friendly transportation device for coke production, which comprises a shell and a transportation mechanism arranged in the shell; when the coke collecting device is used, the conveying belt and the motor are started, coke is conveyed on the conveying belt, the coke falling from the side edge of the conveying belt falls on the material collecting platform, the material collecting platform is driven by the motor to rotate anticlockwise, the coke on the material collecting platform rotates along the material collecting platform and is transferred to a track between the first baffle and the second baffle, then the coke is transferred to the discharging plate, finally the coke falls onto the collecting net from the discharging pipe, when the collecting net is full, the collecting net is detached from the hook, and the coke in the collecting net is poured onto the conveying vehicle; the device saves manpower, does not need manual work to pick up coke falling on the ground, and further improves the transportation efficiency.

title_en: Conveying device for garment material processing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of fabric processing equipment, in particular to a conveying device for processing garment fabric, which comprises: the base is arranged on a front frame at the upper end of the left side of the base, a pillar arranged at the upper end of the middle of the base and a rear frame arranged at the upper end of the right side of the base; the feeding assembly is arranged at the upper end of the front frame; the material pressing component is arranged at the upper end of the support; the discharge assembly is arranged at the upper end of the rear frame; in the process of conveying the material belt, the material belt to be processed firstly enters from a feeding component position arranged at the upper end of the front frame, then is compressed at a material pressing component position arranged at the upper end of the support column, and finally is discharged from a material discharging component position arranged at the upper end of the rear frame; of course, in the process of conveying the displacement of the material belt, the material belt pressed and displaced can be reversely stretched by changing the output direction of the pressing component, so that the displaced material belt generates buffeting, and further, dust attached to the surface of the material belt can be removed.

title_en: Conveying device for 3D printer patch and production line
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of a 3D printer patch production line, and discloses a patch conveying device for a 3D printer and a production line. The patch conveying device for the 3D printer comprises a lower conveying belt and an upper conveying belt, wherein the lower conveying belt is driven by a lower driving motor, and a part to be conveyed, which is arranged on the lower conveying belt, can move along the X direction; the upper conveying belt is arranged above the lower conveying belt, the length of the upper conveying belt is smaller than that of the lower conveying belt, two ends of the lower conveying belt extend to the outer sides of two sections of the upper conveying belt, the upper conveying belt is driven by the upper driving motor, and parts to be conveyed, which are arranged on the upper conveying belt, can move in the opposite direction of the X direction. According to the utility model, the backflow of the part to be conveyed is realized through the upper conveying belt and the lower conveying belt which are arranged up and down, and the length of the upper conveying belt is set to be smaller than that of the lower conveying belt, so that an operator or a manipulator can conveniently transfer the part to be conveyed between the upper conveying belt and the lower conveying belt, the space is saved, and the operation is convenient.

title_en: Translation type die carrier device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of dies, in particular to a translation type die carrier device which comprises a rack, a bin body used for placing a die, and a driving device arranged on the rack, wherein the bin body is connected with the rack in a sliding manner, the output end of the driving device is in transmission connection with the bin body, and the driving device drives the bin body to translate along the rack. The translation type mould frame device can conveniently carry and take moulds at different positions, and is time-saving and labor-saving.

title_en: Board carrying suction tool and carrying robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wood board carrying suction tool and a carrying robot, and relates to the technical field of wood board carrying devices, wherein the wood board carrying suction tool comprises: a support; two board sucker components are arranged on the bracket at intervals; the material distribution assembly is used for separating the adhered wood boards; the material distributing assembly comprises: the first connecting plate is arranged on the bracket; the first buffer supporting rod is provided with an air inlet channel and is arranged on the first connecting plate; the material distributing sucker is provided with an air inlet and an air exhaust opening, and is arranged at one end of the first buffering supporting rod and communicated with the air inlet channel. The wood board carrying suction tool can realize automatic material distribution, reduce manual intervention and improve production efficiency.

title_en: Auxiliary device for measuring and cutting carbon fiber cloth
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of engineering reinforcement, and discloses an auxiliary device for measuring and cutting carbon fiber cloth, which aims to solve the technical problems in the cutting of the carbon fiber cloth in the prior art. The carbon fiber cloth cutting device has the advantages that the proper number of scale panels can be selected and spliced, the carbon fiber cloth rotates to pass through the supporting device to be supported and passes through the rotating bearing roller according to the scales on the scale panels, the carbon fiber cloth is limited on the scale panels, cutting personnel pull the carbon fiber cloth to easily and visually observe the length of the carbon fiber cloth to be cut, the structure is simple, the scale panels with different lengths can be spliced according to actual conditions, and the carbon fiber cloth with different lengths can be cut.

title_en: Cross case sealer
abstract_en: The application relates to a cross carton sealing machine, and relates to the field of carton sealing machines, which comprises a first machine frame, wherein a first carton sealing machine core for sealing cartons is arranged on the first machine frame, and a plurality of first conveying rollers for conveying cartons are arranged on the first machine frame; the discharging end of the first machine frame is provided with a second machine frame, a plurality of second conveying rollers are arranged on the second machine frame, the second conveying rollers are in the same direction as the first conveying rollers, and a push plate used for pushing the box out of the second conveying rollers along the direction perpendicular to the conveying direction of the second conveying rollers is arranged on the second machine frame; a conveying assembly for receiving and conveying the pushed boxes is arranged on one side of the second machine frame, which is perpendicular to the conveying direction of the second conveying roller and opposite to the push plate; the discharge end of the conveying assembly is connected with a third rack, a plurality of third conveying rollers for conveying boxes are arranged on the third rack, and a second box sealing machine core for sealing boxes is arranged on the third rack. This application has the effect of being convenient for carry out cross sticky tape joint sealing to the case.

title_en: Seed lifting mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a seed lifting mechanism, which comprises a base, wherein a driving shaft bracket and a horizontal moving assembly are arranged on the base at intervals, the horizontal moving assembly can be close to or far away from the driving shaft bracket relative to the base, a lifting assembly is arranged on the horizontal moving assembly, a driven shaft bracket is arranged on the lifting assembly, a driven shaft is rotatably arranged on the driven shaft bracket, and a driven chain wheel is sleeved on the driven shaft; the driving shaft support is rotatably provided with a driving shaft, a driving chain wheel is sleeved on the driving shaft, a conveying belt is connected between the driving chain wheel and the driven chain wheel, a plurality of scraping plates are uniformly distributed on the conveying belt, and an angle adjusting assembly is connected between each scraping plate and the conveying belt and used for adjusting the angle between the corresponding scraping plate and the corresponding conveying belt; the driving shaft is connected with a driving component. The utility model discloses can guarantee the lifting efficiency when effectively having avoided the seed landing.

title_en: Portable reagent storage device for medical examination
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable reagent storage device for medical examination, which comprises a box body, a box cover and a lifting device, wherein the upper side surface of the box body is attached to the lower side surface of the box cover, the box cover and the box body are detachably connected through a buckle, a plurality of lower placing holes are formed in the upper side surface of the box body, upper placing holes corresponding to the lower placing holes are formed in the lower side surface of the box cover, the lifting device is arranged at the bottom of the lower placing holes and can be in sliding connection with the lower placing holes, reagent bottles are placed in the lower placing holes, the bottom surfaces of the reagent bottles are attached to the lifting ends of the lifting device, the upper ends of the reagent bottles are arranged in the upper placing holes, and the top surfaces of the reagent bottles are attached to the top surfaces of the upper placing holes. According to the portable reagent storage device for medical examination, the reagent bottles are stored through the upper placing hole and the lower placing hole which are matched, and the reagent bottles are fixed between the box body and the box cover through the lifting device capable of lifting, so that the purpose of the reagent bottles is achieved.

title_en: Anti-collision unmanned trolley for logistics warehouse
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-collision unmanned trolley for a logistics warehouse, relates to the technical field of logistics warehouses, and aims to solve the problems that an effective anti-collision mechanism is lacked in the using process of the existing unmanned trolley for the logistics warehouse, and the trolley is damaged and goods are wrapped and dropped due to the fact that the unmanned trolley is often collided due to remote control operation errors. The both ends of remote-control car all are provided with the end and extend the plate, all be provided with horizontal connecting rod on the outer wall of end extension plate and the front and back terminal surface of remote-control car, horizontal connecting rod's one end is provided with crashproof rubber sleeve seat, remote-control car all is provided with epitaxial crashproof frame all around, all be provided with the frame connecting seat on the inboard both ends position of epitaxial crashproof frame, the one end of frame connecting seat is provided with end position branch, the one end of end position branch is provided with buffer spring, buffer spring's one end is provided with spring support seat.

title_en: Transfer robot for inclined objects
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a transfer robot for inclined objects, which comprises a moving mechanism, a rotating mechanism, an adsorption mechanism and an adjusting mechanism, wherein the moving mechanism is arranged on the rotating mechanism; the moving mechanism is used for driving the adsorbed object to move; the rotating mechanism comprises a rotating shaft which is rotationally connected with the moving mechanism; the adsorption mechanism is provided with an adsorption end which is used for adsorbing objects; the adjusting mechanism is provided with an adjusting end, the adjusting end is fixedly arranged on the rotating shaft and connected with the adsorption end to drive the adsorption end to move along the direction vertical to the rotating shaft, and the rotation of the rotating shaft is used for driving the adsorption end to synchronously rotate so as to adjust the adsorption angle of the adsorption end; the problem of the surface of the object of treating the transport is not always plane, when meetting the face of treating the absorption and having the inclined plane, current transfer robot is difficult to carry is solved.

title_en: Rolling type adhesive tape flattening and sticking device for automobile adhesive tape
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rolling type flattening adhesive tape sticking device for an automobile adhesive tape, which relates to the technical field of adhesive tape sticking and aims at solving the problem that the existing adhesive tape sticking quality is not qualified, and provides a scheme that the rolling type flattening adhesive tape sticking device comprises two fixing plates, sliding blocks are connected to the inner sides of the two fixing plates in a sliding manner, two adjusting rods which are symmetrical to each other are rotatably connected to the lower sides of the sliding blocks, flattening rollers are rotatably connected to the lower ends of the two adjusting rods, compression springs are fixedly connected to one sides of the two adjusting rods, one ends of the two compression springs are fixedly connected with a fixing block which is fixedly connected with the fixing plates together, an adhesive tape wheel is rotatably connected between the lower sides of the two fixing plates, two return springs which are symmetrical to each other are fixedly connected to the inner sides of the fixing plates, the rolling type flattening adhesive tape sticking device is simple in structure, a sticking part can be flattened before sticking, the adhesive tape can be tightly pressed on the sticking part after sticking, simple operation and convenient use.

title_en: Water-soluble fertile unloading auxiliary transportation device after bagging-off
abstract_en: The utility model provides an auxiliary conveying device for water-soluble fertilizer after being bagged, which comprises a fixed seat, wherein a fixed ring is rotatably connected to the fixed seat, a movable frame is detachably connected to the fixed ring, and universal wheels are mounted at the bottom of the movable frame; a bearing plate is arranged in the movable frame, a group of concave holes are formed in the top of the bearing plate, and rotating rods are rotatably connected in the concave holes; the top of removing the frame is fixed with the montant, sliding connection has the slider on the montant, still be equipped with on the montant and be used for the locking device with its locking after the slider slides, it has threaded connection's iron set to run through on the slider.
