The fertilizer bag provided by the utility model can be effectively moved to a specified position, the fertilizer bag moving-out process is simple and quick, the fertilizer bag cannot be toppled, and meanwhile, when the fertilizer bag is used for loading water-soluble fertilizer, a worker does not need to manually control the fertilizer bag in real time, so that the labor burden of the worker is reduced.

title_en: Intelligent material rack with material information feedback function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of intelligent material racks, in particular to an intelligent material rack with material information feedback, which comprises a material rack, wherein a plurality of partition plates are movably connected in an inner cavity of the material rack, the middle partition plates are fixedly connected with the material rack, a gravity sensor is arranged at the top of each partition plate, two symmetrically-arranged installation grooves are formed in the left side of the inner part of the material rack, a support frame is fixedly connected in the inner cavity of each installation groove, a fixed block is fixedly connected to the center of the back surface of the support frame, and motor shells are arranged at the top and the bottom of one side of the material rack. According to the intelligent material rack with the material information feedback function, the supporting frame, the motor, the first gear, the second gear, the sliding plate, the sliding rail, the transmission mechanism and the teeth are used in a matched mode, so that the function of adjusting the using space between the partition plates and the contact distance between the partition plates and a user is achieved, and the intelligent material rack with the material information feedback function has the advantage that the using space is adjustable.

title_en: Protective cover and storage and transportation equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides a protective cover and storage and transportation equipment, wherein the protective cover comprises: the semi-closed cover body is sleeved outside the vacuum measuring device; the rib plate is arranged on the tank body of the storage and transportation equipment and is positioned on the inner side of the semi-closed cover body; the semi-closed cover body is detachably fixed outside the rib plate; therefore, in actual use, one side of the rib plate can be arranged on a tank body of storage and transportation equipment, and the semi-closed cover body is detachably fixed outside the rib plate, namely the semi-closed cover body is detachably fixed outside the vacuum measuring device; because the semi-closed cover body is arranged outside the vacuum measuring device, the vacuum measuring device can be prevented from being collided by the outside and corroded by seawater, and further the vacuum measuring device is prevented from being damaged, and the measuring precision is ensured.

title_en: Powder conveyor for powder weighing machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a powder conveying device for a powder weighing machine, which comprises a feeding pipe opening, flow dividing pipes, hollow plates, a fixed frame and a cylinder, wherein the flow dividing pipes are arranged at the bottom of the feeding pipe opening, and two groups of symmetrically arranged hollow plates are arranged on the front surfaces of the flow dividing pipes; two groups of straight pipelines which are arranged side by side are arranged at the bottom of the flow dividing pipe, and a fixed frame is arranged on the outer surface of each straight pipeline; the inner wall of one side of the straight pipeline is provided with a groove, a cylinder is installed on the inner wall of the groove, a supporting plate is installed on the outer surface of the cylinder, a weighing device is installed at the top of the supporting plate in an embedded mode, and a rubber block is installed on the inner wall of the groove. According to the utility model, the powder is transmitted at intervals through the two groups of straight pipelines, so that the transmission speed of the powder can be increased, the powder in the straight pipelines is statically weighed through the weighing device, and the powder can be transmitted downwards to the conveying member when the gravity of the powder reaches a set state.

title_en: Carton with safeguard function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of cartons, in particular to a carton with a protection function, which comprises a box body and a protection part made of pearl sponge materials and arranged in the box body, wherein the protection part comprises a bottom protection plate and a top protection plate which are respectively positioned at the bottom and the top in the box body, and a plurality of middle protection plates which are stacked and arranged between the bottom protection plate and the top protection plate, a circular placing groove is formed in the center of each middle protection plate, and a plurality of gaskets with different sizes and annular structures are arranged in each placing groove. According to the utility model, the plurality of stacked middle protection plates are arranged in the box body, and the plurality of washers with different sizes are arranged in the placing groove of the middle protection plate, so that the number of the middle protection plates and the number of the washers in the placing groove can be increased or decreased according to the sizes of products and cartons, the middle protection plates in the cartons can comprehensively and effectively protect the products with different sizes, and the application range and the reuse rate of the cartons are improved.

title_en: Storage box for food detection
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of food detection, in particular to a storage box for food detection, which comprises a body, a bottom plate and a shutter, wherein the left rear end and the right rear end of the body are respectively provided with a rotating hole, the left side and the right side in the body are respectively provided with a storage device, each storage device comprises a threaded rod, one end of each threaded rod passes through the corresponding through hole and extends to the outside of the body, the threaded rods are rotatably connected with the through holes, the circumferential outer wall of each threaded rod is sleeved with a sleeve in a threaded manner, the top end of each sleeve is provided with a plurality of placing plates, the top end of each placing plate is provided with a placing frame, a collecting box is placed in each placing frame, the lower side of each sleeve is provided with a support rod, the top end of each support rod is in sliding fit with the bottom end of the corresponding sleeve, the bottom end of each support rod is fixedly connected with the inner bottom wall of the body, samples can be conveniently taken out at the same time, and the waste of the time is reduced, the efficiency of work is improved, the practicality is improved.

title_en: Groundwater sample storage device for hydrogeological engineering
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a groundwater sample storage device for hydrogeological engineering, which comprises a storage box body, wherein a damping sponge is arranged in the storage box body and is attached to the inner wall of the storage box body, a sample test tube is arranged in the damping sponge, a test tube cover is arranged at the end part of the sample test tube, and a handle is arranged on the test tube cover. According to the utility model, the damping sponge is arranged in the storage box, and the sample test tube is arranged in the damping sponge, so that the sample test tube is prevented from shaking in the storage box, further the sample test tube is broken, an underground water sample in the sample test tube flows out, and the detection of workers is influenced; cover through setting up the sponge rubber pad on the inner wall of the case lid of storing the box and cover at the test tube of sample test tube and set up the handle, conveniently get and put the sample test tube, through the contact of sponge rubber pad with the test tube lid, further improvement the in close contact with of sample test tube with the case lid, avoid the groundwater in the sample test tube to flow from the test tube lid.

title_en: Storage tank for anionic polyacrylamide
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a storage tank for anionic polyacrylamide, which comprises a tank body and a cover body, wherein the cover body is arranged above the tank body in a covering manner, the tank body comprises an outer tank body and an inner tank body arranged in the outer tank body, a cooling cavity is arranged between the outer tank body and the inner tank body, the joint of the outer tank body and the inner tank body is arranged in a sealing manner, and a feeding hole communicated with the inner tank body is formed in the cover body; the utility model adopts a double-layer tank structure, anionic polyacrylamide is placed in the inner tank, a cooling cavity is arranged between the outer tank and the inner tank, and the inner tank is continuously cooled by cooling water, so that the anionic polyacrylamide in the inner tank is prevented from self-polymerizing; the stirring subassembly that sets up in the inner tank body can be turned over the anion polyacrylamide that is located inner tank body middle part and dial inner tank body lateral wall, makes anion polyacrylamide obtain fully cooling.

title_en: Reinforcing bar draw gear that building site was used is built in room
abstract_en: The utility model provides a steel bar traction device for a house construction site, which comprises: the steel bar traction device comprises a traction support frame, wherein a main traction device and an auxiliary traction device are arranged on the upper side of the traction support frame, the main traction device and the auxiliary traction device are arranged on the same horizontal plane, a traction support wheel is arranged on the lower side between the main traction device and the auxiliary traction device, the traction support wheel is installed on a support wheel installation shaft through a support wheel installation bearing, two ends of the support wheel installation shaft are installed on a support wheel installation seat, the support wheel installation seat is installed on the traction support frame, an input end guide device is arranged at one end of the traction support frame, an output end guide device is arranged at the other end of the traction support frame, and a traction compression device is arranged on the lower side of the main traction device.

title_en: Safety supporting facility for hoisting and suspending large cast steel molding sand box
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a safety supporting facility for hoisting and suspending a large cast steel molding flask, which comprises a hoisting and suspending device and a safety supporting rod device, wherein the tail end of the safety supporting rod device is arranged on the rear side of a safety fixed supporting seat through a safety supporting pin shaft and can rotate around the safety supporting pin shaft; the top end of the safety supporting rod device is fixedly arranged in a clamping groove of the safety supporting clamp, the safety supporting clamp is arranged on the bottom plate of the equipment compartment, the hoisting suspension device is fixed on the safety supporting rod device, and the hoisting suspension device is provided with a support and is connected through a support pin shaft and can rotate around the support pin shaft; the handle is welded on the rod wall of the safe supporting rod device. This cast steel major possession molding sand box lifts by crane unsettled support in the motion process that equipment railway carriage or compartment lifted and descend, and operating personnel all need not get into equipment railway carriage or compartment bottom to thoroughly solved operating personnel's potential safety hazard.

title_en: Device for storing and transporting crankshafts
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a device for storing and transporting crankshafts, which comprises a transporting box, wherein a supporting plate is arranged on the lower inner wall of the transporting box, a clamping plate is fixedly connected to the top end of the supporting plate, a buffering cushion is also arranged on the top end of the supporting plate, the clamping plate penetrates through the buffering cushion, the buffering cushion covers the side wall of the transporting box and the upper wall of the supporting plate, a rotating shaft is rotatably connected to the upper end of the side wall of the transporting box, a cover plate is fixedly sleeved on the rotating shaft, a handle is fixedly connected to the top end of the cover plate, and a fixing device is arranged in the transporting box. The utility model has simple structure and convenient operation, can fix the crankshafts in the transportation box, can not collide with each other during transportation, can not deform the crankshafts due to transportation, prolongs the service life of the crankshafts, can directly see the number of the crankshafts in the transportation box through the carving patterns on the transparent shell, and is more intuitive.

title_en: Needle-shaped product conveying and collecting device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a needle-shaped product conveying and collecting device which comprises a mounting plate, wherein the front surface of the mounting plate is rotatably connected with a feeding wheel, a discharging wheel and a driving wheel, and the feeding wheel and the driving wheel are sleeved with a first belt through a first belt groove and a second belt groove which are formed in the outer walls of the feeding wheel and the driving wheel; the shaft of the driving wheel is fixedly connected with a power output shaft of the first driving motor; the blanking wheel is positioned in the middle of the feeding wheel and the driving wheel, and the first belt bypasses the lower surface of the blanking wheel; an operation mechanism is fixedly connected between the blanking wheel and the driving wheel, and the operation mechanism enables the blanking wheel and the driving wheel to rotate in opposite directions. The needle-shaped product conveying and collecting device has the advantages that the blanking mode is extremely light, the effect of conveying and collecting small and fine products is remarkable, and the small and fine products can be completely collected.

title_en: Oil receiving basin device of running vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model provides an oil receiving basin device of a running vehicle. The oil receiving basin device of the running vehicle comprises a basin body; the support plate is arranged at the bottom of the pot body; the two fixing blocks are fixedly arranged on the top of the supporting plate; the base is arranged at the bottom of the supporting plate, and two grooves are formed in the base; and the mounting block is fixedly mounted at the top of the base. The oil receiving basin device for the running vehicle has the advantages that the height of the oil receiving basin can be adjusted, and the phenomenon that engine oil splashes to the ground due to height difference and the burden of workers is increased is avoided.

title_en: Transition speed stabilizing structure for rotor passing magnetic suspension belt junction
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a transitional speed stabilizing structure for a rotor passing through a magnetic suspension belt junction, which is characterized in that a speed stabilizing area is additionally arranged between a magnetic suspension line and a belt line, and a speed stabilizing device is additionally arranged in the speed stabilizing area, so that the purpose of uniformly reducing/increasing the attraction force in the speed stabilizing area can be realized by the speed stabilizing device, the attraction force of the rotor passing through the magnetic suspension line and the belt line is uniformly changed, the load change of a driver in the belt line is relatively gentle, the stable operation of the belt line is ensured, and meanwhile, a coil can be additionally arranged in the speed stabilizing area to act on a permanent magnet of the rotor, so that the motion state of the rotor is correspondingly adjusted, and the rotor is ensured to be more stable when passing in and out the belt line.

title_en: Remote intelligent inspection robot for transformer substation
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of substation equipment state inspection, in particular to a remote intelligent inspection robot for a substation. A remote intelligent inspection robot for a transformer substation comprises a case, a walking mechanism, an obstacle clearing mechanism, an obstacle identification camera and a control system, wherein the control system is arranged in the case; the travelling mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the case and used for driving the case to travel on a track set in the transformer substation; the lower part of the front end of the case is provided with a mounting groove. The robot is patrolled and examined to long-range intelligence of transformer substation, when guaranteeing the clearance effect of the barrier on the track, can avoid the clearance instrument to influence the walking of robot on the track, guarantees that the robot can accomplish smoothly and patrol and examine work, and convenient to use has improved the efficiency of patrolling and examining, has solved current clearance instrument and has influenced the robot walking easily to and block the problem of patrolling and examining the sight of making a video recording easily.

title_en: Wheel driving mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model provides a wheel driving mechanism, and belongs to the technical field of driving mechanisms. The wheel driving mechanism comprises a frame; the upper end of the frame is provided with a speed reducer connected with a motor, and a low-speed shaft of the speed reducer is rotatably connected with a driving gear; bearing boxes are arranged on two sides of the lower end of the frame, the bearing boxes are rotatably connected with a transmission shaft, a driven gear for driving the transmission shaft to rotate is rotatably connected onto the transmission shaft, the driven gear is located between the bearing boxes on the two sides of the lower end of the frame, wheels are arranged on two sides of the transmission shaft, the wheels are located on the outer sides of the bearing boxes on the two sides of the lower end of the frame, and the transmission shaft drives the wheels to rotate; the driving gear is in transmission connection with the driven gear. The wheel driving mechanism provided by the utility model has the advantages of simple structure, convenience in installation and convenience in implementation.

title_en: Plunger type distributor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a plunger type distributor, which comprises a barrel, wherein a feed inlet is formed in the upper end of the barrel, a first discharge outlet and a second discharge outlet are formed in the lower end of the barrel, a rotatable distribution plunger is arranged in the barrel, the distribution plunger is integrally cylindrical, a distribution channel which is recessed from the side face is formed in the distribution plunger, a rotating shaft is installed at the front end of the distribution plunger, and the rotating shaft extends out of the front end of the barrel and is connected with a handle. According to the plunger type distributor disclosed by the utility model, the plunger is adopted for distributing and switching, and compared with the traditional distributing plate type distributing device, the distributing and switching operation is more convenient, and the overall structure is simpler. The plunger adopts the POM ring to replace a bearing, so that the structure is further simplified, and the rotation is more flexible and smooth. The grinding surface and the sealing ring on the surface of the plunger are matched, so that the device is not easy to leak materials.

title_en: Packaging equipment for producing high polymer material
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a packaging device for producing high polymer materials, which comprises a machine body, an impurity removing device and a collecting device, wherein the top end of the machine body is fixedly connected with a plurality of supporting columns, the plurality of supporting columns are fixedly connected with the packaging device, the packaging device is provided with a feeding hopper, the impurity removing device is used for carrying out dust removal operation on high polymer materials entering the packaging device through the feeding hopper, and the collecting device is used for collecting small particle dust in the dust removal process of the impurity removing device. Is convenient for people to use.

title_en: Automatic feeding device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of feeding devices, and discloses an automatic feeding device, which comprises a material rack; the blanking roller path is arranged on the material rack and inclines downwards from left to right; the first material distributing structure is positioned on the right side opposite to the blanking roller path, and the materials are blocked by the first material distributing structure when falling downwards along the blanking roller path; the lifting structure is arranged on the material rack in a lifting manner, the lifting structure jacks up the material on the blanking roller path when rising and rolls along the inclined lifting structure, and the material falls on the first material distributing structure when falling and continues to roll downwards along the first material distributing structure; the conveying structure is arranged on the material rack, and the material can fall off at the conveying structure after rolling along the first material distribution structure, and is moved forwards by the conveying structure. Through the setting of first branch material structure and elevation structure, can carry out the material loading with the partial material of large batch material separation, card material or the circumstances of piling up when having avoided the large batch material to roll down and fall.

title_en: Carrier band coiling mechanism for electronic components
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a carrier tape winding device for electronic components, and belongs to the technical field of carrier tape winding devices. It mainly to the problem that probably drops appears after the carrier band rolling among the prior art, proposes following technical scheme: the vertical column is arranged on the base, the straight rod is rotatably arranged on the vertical column and transversely penetrates through the vertical column, the straight rod comprises a threaded portion, the threaded portion is located on one transverse side of the vertical column, the limiting plate is arranged on the threaded portion, and the limiting plate is in threaded connection with the threaded portion; a clamping groove is formed in one end, far away from the threaded part, of the straight rod; the backup pad sets up on the base, and the backup pad is located the horizontal one side that the straight-bar is close to the draw-in groove. When the utility model is used, the straight rod can be locked, and the carrier band is prevented from falling off when the motor does not work.

title_en: Take-up device of large electromechanical equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a take-up device of large electromechanical equipment, which relates to the field of take-up equipment and comprises a supporting mechanism, a take-up mechanism and a cleaning mechanism, wherein the supporting mechanism comprises a supporting plate and a take-up mechanism, the supporting plate is arranged above the supporting plate, the cleaning mechanism comprises a first supporting box arranged above the supporting plate, a moving assembly arranged on one side of the first supporting box and a transition assembly arranged on one side of the moving assembly, the cleaning mechanism is arranged above the supporting plate and used for cleaning impurities of the electromechanical equipment wire, the supporting plate is arranged above the supporting plate, a base is arranged on one side of the supporting plate, a rotating shaft is arranged on one side of the base and is in rotating fit with the base, and a brush is arranged outside the rotating shaft. According to the take-up device of the large electromechanical equipment, the first motor is started to drive the rotating shaft to rotate, so that the winding shaft rotates, the cable is continuously wound on the winding shaft to be stored, the cable penetrates into the outer portion of the roller, the winding shaft winds the cable when the cable is taken up, the cable rolls on the roller, and the cable is conveyed forwards to be convenient to wind the cable.

title_en: Power cabinet is lift platform for riveting production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a lifting platform for riveting production of a power cabinet, which comprises a working plate, a lifting assembly and a driving assembly, wherein the working plate is provided with a plurality of working holes; the lifting assembly comprises a top disc, a bottom disc and a lifting structure; the lifting structure comprises a first lifting rod with one end rotatably connected to the top disc and the other end slidably connected to the bottom disc and a second lifting rod with one end rotatably connected to the bottom disc and the other end slidably connected to the top disc; the first lifting rod and the second lifting rod are arranged in a crossed manner; the first lifting rod and the second lifting rod are respectively and symmetrically provided with two lifting rods; the driving assembly is connected with the free end of the first lifting rod or the second lifting rod. Through the cooperation of the lifting assembly and the working plate, the riveting device works under the driving of the driving assembly, so that the height required by a product and riveting equipment can be randomly adjusted and placed, the working efficiency is improved, the processing is stable, and the processing quality is ensured.

title_en: Automobile charging device for new energy engineering
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automobile charging device for new energy engineering, and relates to the technical field of automobile charging. The charging device comprises a new energy automobile charging pile, wherein a charging wire winding and unwinding device is arranged at the bottom of the new energy automobile charging pile, and the charging wire winding and unwinding device comprises a protection box, a motor, a rotating winding shaft and a charging connecting rope. According to the utility model, through the operation of the motor, the automatic retraction and release of the charging connecting rope are realized, so that the charging connecting rope is not easy to knot and wind in the use process, and meanwhile, the charging connecting rope is prevented from being aged and damaged due to long-term exposure in the external environment.

title_en: Placing box for slicing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a placing box for slicing, which belongs to the technical field of pathological section placing and comprises a box body and a box cover arranged above the box body, wherein a central column is arranged at the middle position of the box body, an inner clamping ring is arranged at the upper end of the central column, an outer clamping ring corresponding to the inner clamping ring is arranged on the inner wall of the box body, a plurality of corresponding clamping grooves in an annular array are respectively arranged on the inner clamping ring and the outer clamping ring, and a cushion block corresponding to the clamping grooves is arranged at the bottom of the box body. According to the utility model, the cushion block is arranged below the slices, so that the situation that the sealing glue is stuck to the bottom of the box body can be effectively avoided, and the slices are convenient to take out; according to the utility model, the cushion blocks are clamped by matching the inner cushion ring and the outer cushion ring with the cushion blocks, so that when the placing box is accidentally dropped or collided, slices can be effectively protected, and the slices are prevented from being broken.

title_en: Movable electric truck trades power station
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a movable electric truck power exchanging station which comprises ten modules including four battery charging cabins, a power exchanging cabin, an overhaul cabin, a medium-voltage power distribution cabin, two low-voltage power distribution cabins and a control cabin; the battery charging cabin, the battery replacement cabin and the overhaul cabin are communicated through a battery replacement channel, and the battery replacement channel is a steel beam arranged in a hanging manner; the battery replacement equipment moves transversely or longitudinally in the rectangular battery replacement channel so as to automatically exchange batteries among the battery rack, the electric truck and the maintenance cabin, wherein the battery rack is provided with the charging base in advance; a main power supply of the power changing station is led from the outside of the station to a medium-voltage power distribution device in a medium-voltage power distribution cabin to supply power to the whole power changing station; according to the utility model, the power conversion station is arranged into ten modules according to the functional partition, so that the power conversion station is convenient to disassemble and assemble, when the site of the power conversion station needs to be changed, the upper structure of the power conversion station is disassembled into ten independent modules to realize the integral transportation of the single module, the work load of steel structure re-assembly during the transportation of the power conversion station is greatly reduced, the construction period is effectively shortened, and the construction cost is saved.

title_en: Elevator for building engineering with protective structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an elevator with a protective structure for constructional engineering, which comprises a lifting frame, a car body and a base, wherein the lifting frame is fixedly arranged at the top of the base, the car body is supported on two sides of the lifting frame in a rolling manner through supporting wheels, movable frames are fixedly arranged at the front end and the rear end of the car body, a movable door is slidably arranged on the inner side of each movable frame, a movable seat is movably arranged in the car body, a pressure sensor is fixedly arranged at the bottom of each movable seat, supporting legs are fixedly arranged at the bottom of the car body, and feeding seats corresponding to the car body are fixedly arranged on two sides of the base. According to the elevator car body protection device, the movable door is matched with the movable frame, the car body can be protected, the influence caused by the turnover of the movable door is reduced, the safety is improved, the material loading seat is matched with the sliding roller and the walking groove, an operator can conveniently push materials into the car body to transport the materials, and the using effect is improved.

title_en: Textile paper tube tail yarn cutting machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a chemical fiber production facility field specifically is a weaving paper tube tail yarn cutting machine. The utility model provides a weaving paper bobbin tail yarn cutting machine, includes the base, be equipped with the conveying structure on the base, conveying structure top is equipped with cuts the yarn structure, cuts the yarn structure and is located conveying structure left end top, cuts the yarn structure and includes heater strip and compressed air cock, and the compressed air cock is connected with high compression pump, and the conveying structure includes the conveyer belt, and the compressed air through the heater strip heating is from the compressed air cock blowout, cuts off the tail yarn on the weaving paper tube of process on the conveyer belt, accomplishes the processing of weaving paper bobbin tail yarn. The utility model discloses an useful part: utilize chemical fiber raw materials to the characteristics that certain temperature will melt, the high-temperature gas that blows out through two heater strips and compressed air cuts off the yarn waste, only needs the manual material loading that carries out the weaving paper tube, need not the manual work and uses the blade cutting, labour saving and time saving, the treatment effeciency is good, has avoided the safety risk of workman in cutting process again.

title_en: Placing box
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of food detection, in particular to a placing box, which comprises a box body with an inwards concave structure and a box cover hinged on the surface of the box body, wherein the bottom of the box body is provided with an accommodating cavity, a sliding plate is arranged in the accommodating cavity, a reinforcing rib is arranged in the box body, an inner embedded plate is arranged in the box body close to one side of the reinforcing rib, and a plurality of partition plates are arranged in the box body close to the other side of the reinforcing rib; connect box body and lid through the hinge, be equipped with the strengthening rib in the inside of box body, consolidate the inside of box body through the strengthening rib to separate box body inner space, separate embedded plate and baffle, the staff can separate the region here and place the detection membrane, makes things convenient for the staff to use.

title_en: Storage box for rock and ore identification slice
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a rock ore deposit appraisal technical field, in particular to rock ore deposit appraisal storage box for thin slice, its characterized in that: comprises an upper cover and a first box body. At least one fixed column is arranged in the first box body, a plurality of first groove teeth are uniformly arranged on the outer side of the bottom of the fixed column at intervals along the circumference, and a first inserting piece groove is formed between every two adjacent first groove teeth. A groove is formed below the first insert groove, one end of the groove is located below the end of the first insert groove, the other end of the groove extends in the direction opposite to the first insert groove, the width of the groove is the same as that of the first insert groove, and the length of the groove is larger than that of a standard glass slide. A limiting block is arranged on the outer side of the first inserting piece groove and is in sliding connection with the groove. The utility model provides a storage box for rock ore deposit appraisal thin slice not only can place the incomplete piece, can also place and preserve the complete whole piece, consequently can adapt to the thin slice of various different length.

title_en: Automatic feeding device for round pipes
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pipe automatic feeding, including the frame, the top fixed mounting of frame has main bottom plate, and the equal fixed mounting in intermediate position at main bottom plate top has the slider guide rail, and the equal fixed mounting in intermediate position at main bottom plate both ends has the pneumatic cylinder mount pad, and the equal fixed mounting in intermediate position in the pneumatic cylinder mount pad outside has the regulation pneumatic cylinder, and the equal fixed mounting in top bar of slider guide rail removal slider has the slider connecting seat, and the equal fixed mounting in intermediate position of slider connecting seat avris has the pneumatic cylinder connecting seat. The utility model discloses an operation panel control pneumatic cylinder mount pad outside intermediate position's regulation pneumatic cylinder carries out work and drives slider connecting seat one side top fixed mounting's pneumatic cylinder connecting seat and carries out relative inside slip work through the slider guide rail at the intermediate position at main bottom plate top, is convenient for adjust the work to the pipe conveying of equidimension not to avoid appearing the phenomenon that extrusion fracture and pipe drop when conveying the pipe.

title_en: Rewinding machine with automatic tension control mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model is suitable for a rewinding machine technical field provides a rewinding machine with automatic tension control mechanism, including total base, is provided with fixed station and compression roller base in the total base, and the bottom of fixed station is connected with the wire rope that can control the compression roller to go up and down, and the bottom of compression roller base is connected with the other end of wire rope; the compression roller is downwards extruded by the original paper roll which does not start to be rewound due to the thickness and the gravity of the original paper roll, the first spring is extruded to be compressed, the steel wire rope on the left side moves downwards, the steel wire rope on the right side is gradually straightened under the action of the second spring due to the fact that the steel wire rope on the left side is loosened, the compression roller reaches the maximum height, and the tension of paper is maximum at the moment; along with the work of rewinding unit, the thickness and the gravity of former scroll self reduce thereupon, under the effect of first spring, the roller rises gradually and stimulates the left wire rope rebound, and the wire rope on right side then stimulates the compression roller and move down gradually, and the tension of paper reduces thereupon, has realized the real-time control to tension.

title_en: Plastic storage tank with good corrosion resistance
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a plastic storage tank with good corrosion resistance, which comprises a plastic storage tank, wherein a sealing cover is arranged above the plastic storage tank, the upper surface of the plastic storage tank is fixedly connected with a liquid injection pipe, the outer surface of the liquid injection pipe is provided with threads, the outer surface of the liquid injection pipe is in threaded connection with an inner ring of the sealing cover, the inner top wall of the sealing cover is fixedly connected with a temperature-sensitive element, the inner wall of the plastic storage tank is fixedly connected with an inner lining, the inner wall of the inner lining is fixedly connected with a corrosion-resistant layer, the upper surface of the plastic storage tank is provided with a liquid injection hole, and the temperature-sensitive element is positioned above the liquid injection hole. The utility model can enhance the pressure resistance and corrosion resistance of the plastic storage tank to liquid storage, can better store chemical corrosive solution, prolongs the service life of the plastic storage tank, has the characteristic of detecting the temperature of the internal liquid, and is convenient for workers to treat the liquid in the plastic storage tank.

title_en: Down-pressing type pebble coal hopper with rotary resistance type material level switch
abstract_en: The utility model provides a downward-pressing type pebble coal bunker with a rotary resistance type material level switch, wherein a support frame is arranged on a support, a telescopic cylinder is arranged at the top of the support frame, the piston end of the telescopic cylinder is connected with the rotary resistance type material level switch, the moving distance of the rotary resistance type material level switch is controlled through the telescopic cylinder, the telescopic cylinder and a lifting cylinder are enabled to synchronously act, when the lifting cylinder works, the telescopic cylinder retracts to enable a blade of the rotary resistance type material level switch to be separated from the coal bunker, the rotary resistance type material level switch is prevented from being damaged by misoperation when the coal bunker is replaced, the problems that the conventional pebble coal bunker does not have a high material level switch and needs to be continuously patrolled by a special person are solved, and the equipment maintenance cost is reduced.

title_en: Urine sample strorage device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the utility model provides a urine specimen storage device, which comprises a storage container and at least one layer of storage rack arranged in the storage container; the storage rack is provided with a plurality of first holes for placing urine sample test tubes; a group of infrared sensing assemblies are correspondingly arranged on two sides of each first hole; each set of infrared sensing assemblies is configured to emit an indication signal in response to the volume of the urine sample inserted in the test tube in the first well; a control unit connected to the power source and the infrared sensing assembly and configured to issue a prompt in response to the capacity deficiency indication signal. Through the infrared sensing subassembly of first hole both sides, whether the sample volume in the urine sample test tube in the first hole that the detectable was put into is enough to inspect needs, works as when the sample volume in the infrared sensing subassembly senses the sample test tube is not enough, sends the notice to the personnel of taking a sample through the control unit immediately, takes a sample again to avoid making the patient to arrive the hospital sample many times because the sample is improper.

title_en: Storage tank with cleaning function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a storage tank with a cleaning function, which comprises a tank body, an annular water pipe, a sealing cover, a moving wheel and a spray head, wherein the sealing cover is arranged at the top end of the tank body, a sealing plug is fixed at the bottom end of the sealing cover, the bottom end of the sealing plug extends into the tank body and is tightly attached to the tank body, a screw hole is formed in the edge position of the top end of the tank body, a pipe cover is fixed on the outer wall of the top of the tank body, the annular water pipe is arranged in the pipe cover, guide pipes with equal intervals are arranged at the bottom end of the annular water pipe, the bottom ends of the guide pipes penetrate through the pipe cover and extend into the tank body, the spray head is arranged on the inner wall of the top of the tank body, the moving wheel is arranged at the corner position of the bottom end of the tank body, and positioning mechanisms are arranged on the two outer walls of the bottom of the tank body. The tank body cleaning device is convenient to clean the tank body, improves the sealing performance of the tank body, is convenient to move, and saves more labor.

title_en: Cable reel convenient to cable storage is stacked
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of cable storage, and discloses a cable tray convenient for cable storage and stacking, which comprises a barrel body and tray frames, wherein a connecting cylinder with one end extending to the right side of the barrel body is movably arranged in the barrel body, the tray frames are fixedly arranged on the outer sides of the barrel body and the connecting cylinder, compression rollers with one ends extending to the upper part of the barrel body are fixedly arranged on the outer sides of the two tray frames through bolts, a fixing plate is fixedly arranged in the barrel body, and a driving mechanism is arranged in the fixing plate. This cable drum convenient to cable storage is stacked has solved current cable drum usable floor area comparatively fixed, the width of adjustment cable drum of being not convenient for, makes the cable need use a plurality of cable drums to assist in accomodating taking in the in-process, also needs bigger area to stack the cable drum simultaneously, and the end of receiving and releasing of cable is not convenient for fix, makes the cable loose phenomenon appear easily at the rolling in-process, the not strong problem of practicality.

title_en: Core package lifting appliance
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a core package lifting appliance in the technical field of lifting appliances, which comprises a barring bracket, wherein a lifting tool is arranged below the barring bracket, a thrust bearing is also arranged inside the upper part of the barring bracket, two semicircular annular plastic backing plates are arranged on the upper part of the thrust bearing, two semicircular annular bearing plates are arranged on the outer side of the plastic backing plates, through arranging the barring bracket, the hoisting tool and the turning gear bracket are fixed through bolts, the thrust bearing is arranged above the turning gear bracket, the plastic backing plate and the bearing plate are fixed through screws, the two bearing plates are fixed together through the fixing bolts, the hole grooves and the fixing holes, one end of the core bag is fixed on the barring bracket, the lifting device drives the cross lifting appliance to move up or rotate, thereby driving the barring bracket to move upwards or rotate, and driving the core bag to move upwards or rotate, and being convenient for drawing out the core bag.

title_en: Cornea stroma lens save set
abstract_en: The utility model aims to provide a corneal stroma lens storage device, which solves the problem of long-term storage of corneal stroma lenses and comprises a bottle body, a closed silica gel plug and a fixed support, wherein the fixed support is arranged on the closed soft rubber plug, the closed soft rubber plug is matched and sealed with the bottle body, the fixed support comprises a clamp and a pressure arm, the clamp is connected with the pressure arm, and the pressing and releasing of the pressure arm control the opening and closing of the clamp.

title_en: A transmission device that is used for process to pass on in middle of production line
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a transmission device for transferring an intermediate process of a production line, which comprises a rack, a transmission motor, a driving shaft, a driven shaft, a driving gear, a driven gear and chains, wherein the transmission motor, the driving shaft, the driven shaft, the driving gear and the driven gear are arranged on the rack; the number of the driving gears is 2, and the driving gears are respectively arranged at two ends of the driving shaft; the number of the driven gears is 2, and the driven gears are respectively arranged at two ends of a driven shaft; the both ends of frame are provided with feed inlet and discharge gate respectively, and feed inlet and discharge gate department all are provided with the spout. The utility model solves the problems that the prior art has poor transmission stability, easy transmission fault and relatively poor adjustability in the transmission process; the semi-finished products are transferred among all the procedures on the processing production line, and meanwhile, the semi-finished products can be transmitted from bottom to top, so that the requirements of production and processing are met.

title_en: Yarn threading frame
abstract_en: The utility model provides a yarn threading frame, and belongs to the technical field of production equipment of composite pipes. It has solved the problem that current creel yarn wore out and causes the interference easily. This threading frame, including the support body, the support body has that a plurality of can supply the chamber of placing that the cylinder placed, places and is equipped with the loop of threading that yarn passed on a plurality of can supply the cylinder on the roof in chamber, and it is gapped between loop of threading and the cylinder, place and have on the chamber and wear the serial number that the loop one-to-one set up. The yarn threading frame avoids interference with the wound yarns on the roller, improves the stability of yarn leading-out, and avoids the damage of the yarns to a great extent.

title_en: A unloader for phosphorite transportation
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of phosphorite transportation, and particularly discloses a blanking device for phosphorite transportation, which comprises a storage box, wherein the left side and the right side of the storage box are respectively connected with a first side plate the bottom of which is connected with a supporting plate and a second side plate the bottom of which is connected with two supporting rods, the bottoms of the supporting plate and the two supporting rods are connected with a base, the top of the storage box is provided with a feed inlet and a motor, an output shaft of the motor is connected with a rotating shaft provided with a plurality of first crushing teeth, the top of an inner cavity of the storage box is provided with a material blocking cover provided with a plurality of second crushing teeth on the side wall of the inner cavity, the side wall of the inner cavity of the storage box is obliquely provided with a material guide plate and a sieve plate, the top of the second side plate is provided with a collecting box connected with a material guide pipe, the lower part of the left side wall of the inner cavity of the storage box is provided with a material passing mechanism, the left side of the bottom of the storage box is connected with a material discharging pipe, the right side of the storage box is connected with an atomizing nozzle through a vertical rod, and the right side of the supporting plate is hinged with a blanking plate, the diaphragm is installed on the backup pad right side, and the activity is equipped with second electric telescopic handle between flitch and the diaphragm down.

title_en: Narrow frame moves and carries anchor clamps
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of vehicle-mounted industrial control, in particular to a narrow-frame transfer clamp. It at least comprises a connecting plate; the surface of the bottom plate is provided with an electromagnetic valve, one side of the electromagnetic valve is provided with a gas distribution block, the side surface of the bottom plate is provided with a plurality of flexible clamping jaws, the electromagnetic valve is connected with the gas distribution block through a pipe body, and the gas distribution block is connected with the flexible clamping jaws through gas pipes; the rotary cylinder is fixedly arranged on the connecting plate, and the output end of the rotary cylinder is connected with the bottom plate; the inside of spout is equipped with the slider, and the slider is located the inboard slip of spout, and the slider can slide along in the spout. The flexible clamping jaw is used for clamping and positioning the side edges, the transferring is not limited by the size of the frame, the transferring of the narrow frame and the ultra-narrow frame of the glass cover after the glue scraping can be met, the full-automatic process is realized without being limited by a sucking disc, meanwhile, the instability of the small suction nozzle in the transferring process is avoided, and the product yield and the production efficiency are improved.

title_en: Transformer substation's construction environmental protection dust fall grit storage yard
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an environment-friendly dust-settling gravel storage yard for transformer substation construction, which comprises a gravel box and a vertical barrel, wherein the inner wall of the center of the lower end of the gravel box is rotatably connected with the vertical barrel through a bearing, an opening and closing assembly is arranged inside the vertical barrel, the opening and closing assembly comprises a motor, a top plate, a support rod, a worm wheel, a worm, a cushion block, an upright post, a screw, a sleeve and a rack, and the left side and the right side of the lower end of the top plate are fixedly connected with the vertical barrel through the rack. This environmental protection dust fall grit store yard of transformer substation construction, through first motor, the screw rod, the worm, the sleeve, the baffle, the worm wheel, cooperation between rack and the grit case, the output shaft of first motor can drive screw rod and worm and rotate, make screw rod control sleeve move down, make sleeve accessible branch drive baffle internal rotation, steerable first motor reversal when needing, outwards rotate when making the baffle move down and open, the rotation of having avoided the synchronous control baffle of not being convenient for opens and shuts and the problem that the high adjustment leads to appearing the interference easily.

title_en: Novel automatic paper packing device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a novel automatic paper packing device which comprises a base, an aluminum shell feeding module and a paper packing module, wherein the aluminum shell feeding module is arranged on the base; the aluminum shell feeding module comprises a motor fixed on the base, a rotary table connected to the output end of the motor, and a plurality of clamp assemblies fixed on the rotary table, wherein grooves are formed in the clamp assemblies. The novel automatic paper padding device can automatically punch the padding paper on the material belt and press the padding paper into the aluminum shell, and is simple to operate and high in processing efficiency.

title_en: Photovoltaic support hoisting mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of photovoltaic support hoists, in particular to a photovoltaic support hoisting mechanism which comprises supports, wherein three groups of supports are arranged, two groups of rectangular holes are symmetrically formed in two sides of each support, sliding rods are arranged in the rectangular holes and are connected with sliding sleeves in a sliding mode, two groups of hoisting mechanisms are symmetrically arranged on two sides of one group of supports, and hoisting support mechanisms with overturning functions are arranged on the supports; the motor drive lead screw rotates, the rotation of lead screw makes the swivel nut remove, the swivel nut drives the sliding sleeve and upwards moves along the slide bar, the sliding sleeve passes through the crane and makes whole crane mechanism upwards move, therefore when the workman needs to install and inspect photovoltaic module, through elevating system, make the crane mechanism fall to the minimum, thereby be convenient for the workman to install and inspect photovoltaic module, workman's work efficiency has been improved, avoid the workman to scramble the eminence simultaneously, it is safer to make the workman install and inspect photovoltaic module.

title_en: Oil adding and unloading device of large electric oil filling riser
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an oil adding and discharging device of a large electric oil filling riser, belongs to the technical field of oil filling risers, and solves the problems that a pipeline cannot be accurately aligned with a tank opening in a worm gear and worm driving mode and the sealing effect of the oil filling riser to the tank opening is poor. The pipeline is driven in a screw rod transmission mode, so that the pipeline runs more stably, and the pipeline is accurately aligned with the tank opening; a deviation correcting device is added on the sealing structure to improve the sealing performance of the sealing structure.

title_en: Petroleum pipeline transportation positioning frame
abstract_en: Petroleum pipeline transportation locating rack. The product comprises the following components: the cross section of the flat sleeve is rectangular, a top through fixing hole is formed in the top of the flat sleeve, the bottom of the flat sleeve is provided with a bottom through fixing hole, the upper part of the flat sleeve is inserted into the upper adjusting splint, the lower part of the upper adjusting splint is provided with a group of upper adjusting holes, the top through fixing holes are superposed with the upper adjusting holes and are connected with an upper bolt for fixing, the lower part of the flat sleeve is inserted into a lower adjusting splint, the upper part of the lower adjusting splint is provided with a group of lower adjusting holes, the bottom through fixing hole is coincided with the lower adjusting hole and is connected with the lower bolt for fixing, the flat sleeve, the upper adjusting clamping plate and the lower adjusting clamping plate form an adjusting and positioning clamping plate, the head and the tail of 4 adjusting and positioning clamping plates are overlapped to form a diamond-shaped positioning frame, and a fixed petroleum pipeline is loaded in the diamond-shaped positioning frame. The utility model is used for positioning and fixing the petroleum pipeline transportation.

title_en: Material feeding unit, equipment and unmanned aerial vehicle scatter
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a feeding device, sowing equipment and an unmanned aerial vehicle, and relates to the field of material conveying; the feeding device comprises a feeding shell, two feeding pieces and a driving mechanism; the feed housing has an inlet and two outlets; the two feeding pieces are rotatably arranged on the feeding shell and are respectively used for conveying the materials input from the inlet to the two outlets; each feeding piece comprises a feeding shaft and blades spirally wound outside the feeding shaft, and the two feeding shafts are arranged in parallel; the driving mechanism is arranged on the feeding shell and comprises a driving piece and a synchronous transmission assembly, the driving piece is in transmission connection with the synchronous transmission assembly, the synchronous transmission assembly is in transmission connection with the two feeding shafts, and the synchronous transmission assembly is used for synchronously driving the two feeding shafts to rotate to convey materials under the driving of the driving piece. The feeding device drives the two feeding shafts which are arranged in parallel simultaneously through the synchronous transmission assembly to carry out feeding operation, and can effectively improve the synchronous rate of feeding of the two feeding shafts, thereby improving the sowing synchronous rate and ensuring the feeding and sowing quality.

title_en: Lead belt winding tool
abstract_en: The utility model provides a lead belt winding tool which comprises a winding disc and a pressing assembly arranged on the winding disc. The winding disc comprises a winding drum connected with a rotating shaft of the winding device and baffles arranged at two ends of the winding drum. The pressing assembly comprises a pressing plate which is movably connected with the winding disc baffle through a positioning shaft and is used for pressing the lead belt. More than one supporting rod for supporting the pressing plate so that the lead belt can enter the space between the pressing plate and the winding drum is arranged between the pressing plate and the winding drum. And a torsion spring for driving the pressing plate to rotate around the positioning shaft so as to press the lead belt on the winding drum is arranged between the pressing plate and the winding drum. And one end support leg of the torsion spring is abutted against the winding drum, and the other end support leg of the torsion spring is abutted against the pressing plate. According to the utility model, the torsion spring drives the pressing plate to press the lead belt, so that the operation of manual-assisted pressing is realized, and the safety problem caused by manual lead belt guiding is reduced, thereby eliminating potential safety hazards, improving the production efficiency and ensuring the smooth high-efficiency production.

title_en: Multifunctional edge covering device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional edge covering device which comprises a box body, an attaching column, a material box, a coating box and a feeding mechanism, wherein the bottom end of the attaching column is fixed on the top side wall of the box body; feeding mechanism's structure includes the motor, follows driving wheel, belt, the motor is fixed in the back lower part of box, and rotor end is fixed with the action wheel, set up the back upper portion at the box from the driving wheel, the belt centers on the action wheel and follows the driving wheel, be fixed with the fixed block of two symmetries on the belt, it has one to support the post to articulate through the round pin axle that has the torsional spring on every fixed block. The automatic feeding device realizes automatic feeding and is convenient for sticking the edge covering strip.

title_en: Transfer assembly for sizing roller machining
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of sizing roller processing, in particular to a transfer assembly for sizing roller processing, which comprises a transfer frame, wherein a row of vertically-installed rotating shafts are arranged on the right side of the inner space of the transfer frame, fixing plates are circumferentially distributed on the outer sides of the rotating shafts, a limiting plate capable of being vertically inserted and pulled is arranged on the left side of the inner space of the transfer frame, a through hole is formed in the side wall of the transfer frame, which is close to the rotating shafts, a fixing seat is arranged along the upper edge of the through hole, a rotatable limiting rod is arranged in the fixing seat, and the limiting rod rotates towards the through hole and is pressed against the corresponding fixing plate, is more practical.

title_en: Computer-controlled intelligent terminal robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a computer-controlled intelligent terminal robot, which comprises a mounting seat, wherein a robot arm is arranged at an adjusting seat, a shaft is connected between the robot arm and the adjusting seat, an adjusting robot arm adjusting mechanism is connected on the mounting seat, lubricating pieces are arranged at the positions of two sides of the robot arm and the shaft, an oil filling piece is connected between the two lubricating pieces, the bottom of the oil filling piece is connected with the top of the mounting seat, and the oil filling piece is pressed to add lubricating oil into the lubricating pieces, the lubricating pieces at the two ends of the shaft simultaneously perform oil filling treatment on the two ends of the shaft when the oil filling piece is pressed, so that the trouble of lubricating the robot arm one by one in a stop state is reduced, meanwhile, after the lubrication is finished, the shaft and the robot arm are driven by the adjusting mechanism to move and adjust, so that the lubricating oil is fully contacted with the shaft, on one hand, the lubricating process is simplified, on the other hand, the full contact between lubricating oil and the shaft after lubrication is accelerated, and the lubrication process of the mechanical arm is facilitated.

title_en: Division of endocrinology uses sample strorage device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sample storage device for endocrinology, which belongs to the field of endocrine science and technology and comprises a shell and a sealing door plate, wherein the sealing door plate is hinged at the front end of the shell, a sliding disassembly mechanism is arranged in the shell and consists of a sliding chute A, a supporting plate B and a sliding block B, the sliding chute A is embedded into the upper side and the lower side of the front end of the outer wall of the shell, and a plurality of sliding chutes A are symmetrically arranged in parallel up and down. When medical staff need to temporarily store urine samples of patients, after the medical staff carry the samples to be close to the shell, the medical staff open the sealing door plate and screw out the bolts between the sliding grooves A and the sliding blocks B, pull the sliding blocks B at the bottom of the supporting plate A and the top of the supporting plate B to slide out of the inner side of the sliding groove A, and after the medical staff place the samples between the supporting plate A and the supporting plate B, slide the sliding blocks B at the bottom of the supporting plate A and the top of the supporting plate B into the sliding groove A to carry the samples to be stored.

title_en: Elevator landing door sliding block
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of elevator landing door sliding blocks, and discloses an elevator landing door sliding block of an elevator landing door sliding block, which comprises an elevator landing door, a landing door sill and a landing door sliding block, wherein the elevator landing door sliding block comprises a landing door and a landing door sill; the landing door sliding block comprises a connecting cover plate and a right-angle plate, a threaded hole is formed in the right end of the connecting cover plate in a penetrating mode, a fast-assembling bolt is arranged between the right-angle plate and the connecting cover plate in a threaded connection mode, and the fast-assembling bolt is in threaded connection with the threaded hole. The utility model can absorb the force through the buffer spring, reduces the fatigue damage of related components of the sliding block of the landing door, simultaneously enables the opening and closing of the door to be more flow, reduces the noise, and when the force of N occurs, the pressure damage block is extruded by sudden change force to break and randomly enable the buffer sliding device to lose the effect, so that the occlusion column is inserted into the occlusion groove, and simultaneously the right-angle plate jacks up the interlocking pin on the right side of the slideway to enable the interlocking pin to be inserted into the occlusion hole to lock the double-bolt, thereby avoiding the landing door from further deformation and derailment in the first time.

title_en: Special debugging platform of construction elevator scale
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a large-scale special debugging platform for a construction elevator, which comprises a tower body main vertical frame, a main guide rail frame, a detachable guide rail frame, an attachment device, a suspension cage, a transmission mechanism and a travelling crane, wherein the main guide rail frame is connected with the tower body main vertical frame through the attachment device, the suspension cage is arranged on one side of the tower body main vertical frame, the transmission mechanism is arranged above the suspension cage, the travelling crane is horizontally erected at the top of the tower body main vertical frame, and the detachable guide rail frame is detachably arranged beside the tower body main vertical frame. When the large-scale special debugging platform for the construction elevator is used, the suspension cage and the transmission mechanism are installed into the detachable guide rail frame, the detachable guide rail frame is connected above the main guide rail frame to increase the debugging height, and the movable power-on box is electrically connected with the suspension cage for power-on debugging.

title_en: Folding packaging box
abstract_en: The application discloses a folding packaging box, which comprises a triangular cone shell and a triangular cone cover body, wherein the triangular cone shell is an inverted triangular pyramid, a first triangular opening is formed in the top of the triangular cone shell, a containing cavity is formed in the triangular cone shell, the triangular cone cover body is an inverted triangular pyramid, a second triangular opening is formed in the bottom of the triangular cone cover body, the triangular cone shell is connected with the triangular cone cover body, the triangular cone cover body is covered outside the triangular cone shell, the packaging box is enabled to form a triangular cone shape through optimally setting a packaging box structure, an uncovering structure is arranged on the packaging box, the triangular cone cover body and the triangular cone shell are enabled to be folded and separated through the action of a user force, and the operation convenience and the comfort level of a user are improved; set up connection structure on the packing carton for the triangle awl lid can connect parcel triangle awl casing better, promotes the aesthetic property simultaneously.

title_en: Electric power construction pay off rack convenient to loading and unloading

abstract_en: The utility model discloses a product feeding structure, the opposite side of two baffles and locating two baffles that set up including the interval just is close to the extension board on baffle top, the extension board top forms the material loading runner, material loading runner below is equipped with the jacking piece that layer board and drive layer board go up and down, the initial position of layer board is less than the material loading runner, when making the product of transport manipulator on the transport material loading runner, can be in advance through jacking piece jacking layer board, let the layer board hold in the palm the product and be carried by the transport manipulator after lifting up again, avoid because the product bottom sprag area undersize and lead to the transport manipulator to buckle the product when the transport and warp.

title_en: Wax powder filling equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a wax powder filling equipment, which comprises an outer shell, the right side of shell is fixed to be equipped with the set casing, the back fixed of set casing is equipped with first electric telescopic handle, first electric telescopic handle's outer fixed top cap that is equipped with along, the left side of shell is run through there is first conveying pipeline, the outer fixed second electric telescopic handle that is equipped with along of first conveying pipeline, the fixed support frame that is equipped with in bottom of set casing. Through the shell that sets up, set casing, first electric telescopic handle, take out whitewashed pole, stopper, filter screen, air exhauster device for this filling equipment can utilize the air exhauster to the inside decompression of shell after accomplishing single or many times filling, with this come to pile up the wax powder that drops to inside and extract, can send it into simultaneously and collect in the shell, thereby realize retrieving the effect of operation to the wax powder that drops, and then reduced the device filling in-process loss to the wax powder.

title_en: Crane with balance monitoring effect for building
abstract_en: The utility model provides a hoist for building has balanced monitoring effect relates to hoist technical field, including the crane boom, two sets of mounting bars are installed to the bottom of crane boom, the guide rail is installed to the bottom of mounting bar, the lift loop wheel machine is installed to the inboard of guide rail, the jack-up lifting rope is installed to the bottom of lift loop wheel machine, the lifting hook is installed to the bottom of jack-up lifting rope. The utility model discloses a be provided with the hydraulic pump machine, through installing the hydraulic pump machine in the side of support frame through the side mount, can provide the effect of stable support to the jack-up part at support frame and top in the side, and ground such as the planar concrete of the support that the side shoring base can be stable, bottom sprag is installed to the bottom at the side shoring base, then the ground nail of bottom sprag bottom the accessible supports on earth ground, be favorable to holistic stabilizing support, the stationarity of hoist has been promoted effectively, and the flexible of hydraulic pressure bracing piece is adjusted to hydraulic pump machine accessible hydraulic pressure power.

title_en: Automatic conveying device for raw materials
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic raw material conveying device, which belongs to the technical field of conveying devices and comprises an L-shaped baffle, wherein a motor box is arranged at the front end of the L-shaped baffle, supporting legs are fixed at the lower end of the L-shaped baffle, the supporting legs are arranged in a rectangular array, a storage rack is connected between the supporting legs, a material collecting basket is arranged on the storage rack, a feed inlet is formed in the upper end of the material collecting basket, a plurality of brackets are arranged at the upper end of the L-shaped baffle, a rotating shaft is rotatably arranged on each bracket, a rotating roller is fixedly arranged on each rotating shaft, a blanking port is formed between the rotating rollers, chain wheels are fixed at the two ends of each rotating shaft, and the same chain wheel is sleeved on the same side of the chain wheels, so that raw materials can be screened in the raw material conveying process, the processing cost is saved, and the workload is reduced.

title_en: Anti-spillage and anti-leakage conveying system for additive feeding process
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-spillage conveying system in an additive feeding process, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a box body is fixedly arranged at the top of the top plate, a feed inlet is formed in the left side of the top of the box body, a motor is fixedly arranged on the left side of the top of the box body, two groups of damping components are fixedly arranged in an inner cavity of the bottom plate, and movable wheel components are fixedly arranged at four corners of the bottom plate. According to the utility model, through the design of the box body, the feeding hole, the motor, the driving assembly, the transmission assembly and the screw cap, the additive enters the inner cavity of the box body through the feeding hole, the driving assembly is driven to rotate when the motor rotates, and the transmission assembly is driven to rotate when the driving assembly rotates, so that the additive is transmitted to the screw cap through the transmission assembly, then the additive flows out through the screw cap, and the device is more convenient to move through the design of the handle and the movable wheel assembly, so that the device can move in multiple aspects.

title_en: Suspension device for installation of power equipment for power engineering
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of installation of power equipment, and discloses a suspension device for installation of power equipment for power engineering, which comprises a device main body, electric telescopic rods and a top plate, wherein the electric telescopic rods are connected inside the device main body in a nested manner, the bottoms of the electric telescopic rods are fixedly connected with sliding plates, movable gears are movably connected to two sides of the sliding plates, movable shafts are fixedly connected to two sides of the inside of the device main body, the electric telescopic rods are arranged on two sides of the device, stability of suspension operation of the device is improved, the suspension plates are better convenient to fix, enlarged functional equipment is placed, the movable gears on two sides are arranged on the movable shafts arranged on two sides of the inside of the device main body to form sliding rail operation, a clamping and fixing mechanism is used for integrally balancing and positioning the clamping operation, and a guardrail object placing plate is U-shaped, so that the device is well limited and protected, displacement problems in the lifting process are prevented, protection of the suspension equipment is further improved, and practicability of the device is improved.

title_en: Template recovery device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a template recycling device, relates to the technical field of template recycling, and solves the problem that in the prior art, a template recycling device can hoist after binding templates, and the binding process is troublesome. The lifting device comprises a supporting plate and a winch arranged on the supporting plate, wherein the bottom of the supporting plate is connected with supporting rods and wheels, a lifting rope is wound on the winch, and the lifting rope is connected with a lifting frame. A hanging frame is arranged on the hanging rope, so that the templates are conveniently and directly placed in the hanging frame, the templates do not need to be bound, and the templates are conveniently and rapidly lifted.

title_en: Cloth spreading device for clothing fabric
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cloth spreading device of clothing fabric, which comprises: the medium plate, both ends top all has settled the curb plate around the middle part of medium plate, and the wind dish is installed at the top of curb plate, the gas pocket has all been seted up to the upper and lower both ends wall of wind dish, and the inner chamber has been seted up to the inside of wind dish. Through the screw rod rotation, screw rod and the looks screw drive of pulling the frame, let the pulling the frame and remove along the vertical direction of screw rod, change the high position of pulling the frame, auxiliary frame and pull roll that pulling frame side end is connected, also synchronous movement thereupon, the pull roll is used for conveying clothing surface fabric, the position is controllable adjustable, can make clothing surface fabric synchronous movement, after the clothing surface fabric shifts up, the surface fabric is in unsettled state, at this moment, blowing mechanism in the wind ware can blow the deashing clearance to clothing surface fabric, after the clothing surface fabric shifts down, the surface fabric can be hugged closely with the medium plate upper end wall, the clothing surface fabric is put down at this moment and has the supporting point in order to conveniently adopt external ironing structure, iron the processing to clothing surface fabric, the clothing surface fabric of being convenient for handles.

title_en: Medical pressure-sensitive adhesive tape boxing device
