abstract_en: The utility model discloses a medical pressure-sensitive adhesive tape boxing device, wherein box body conveying belts of box body conveying mechanisms are provided with box body conveying clamping positions which are arranged in pairs at intervals, the box bodies conveying clamping positions convey packaging boxes, an opening of each packaging box faces one side of each adhesive tape conveying mechanism, one face of a flip cover for sealing the packaging box is arranged on the upper side of each packaging box, box cover limiting supporting plates are arranged at side flanges of each box body conveying mechanism, and the bottom surfaces of the box cover limiting supporting plates are higher than the upper surfaces of the packaging boxes; the box body conveying mechanism is provided with a box body pressing plate at least at the upper surface of the packing box at the position corresponding to the pushing mechanism; the adhesive tape conveying mechanism conveys the medical pressure-sensitive adhesive tape through an adhesive tape conveying clamping position; the pushing mechanism utilizes the air cylinder and the pushing plate to push the adhesive tape into the packing box conveyed by the box conveying mechanism. The device can keep the flip cover of the packaging box in a jacking state in the conveying process, so that the medical pressure-sensitive adhesive tape can be smoothly and stably pushed into the packaging box.

title_en: Propulsion device for propeller production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of propeller production, and discloses a propeller production propelling device which comprises a workbench, wherein a bracket is fixedly connected to the front side of the middle part of the bottom wall of the workbench, the output end of a servo motor penetrates through the bracket and is fixedly connected with a pinion, the front side of the pinion is meshed with a large gear, the top end of a rotating shaft penetrates through the top wall of the workbench and is fixedly connected with a rotating disc, the periphery of the middle part of the top wall of the rotating disc is fixedly connected with a protruding block, a connecting rod I is rotatably connected to the outer periphery of the protruding block, one end of the connecting rod I, far away from the protruding block, is rotatably connected with a connecting rod II, and one end of the connecting rod II, far away from the connecting rod I, is rotatably connected with a pushing block. According to the utility model, the pushing block is driven to move through the rotation of the turntable, if the pushing block leaves the through hole, satellite propeller parts at the bottommost layer in the feeding pipe can fall into the chute, and the pushing block pushes out the propeller parts falling into the chute after the turntable rotates for one circle, so that the automatic intermittent propulsion effect is realized, and the efficiency is improved.

title_en: Water stop tarpaulin cover device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water stop tape covering device, which relates to the technical field of building construction and comprises a box body, wherein four corresponding supports are welded on the lower side surface of the box body, a connecting hole is formed in the right side surface of the box body, a connecting groove is formed in the left side wall of the inside of the box body, the connecting hole corresponds to the connecting groove, rolling shafts are connected in the connecting hole and the connecting groove through two bearings, a rocker is welded on the right end surface of the rolling shafts, a user can conveniently rotate the rolling shafts through the rocker, the box body is a square box body, the length, the width and the height of the box body are all 0.2m, the supports are telescopic rods, the cross section is square, unused water stops can be rolled in construction, the water stops are protected from being damaged, construction difficulties and problems caused by the breakage of the water stops can be reduced, and the risk of engineering water leakage can be greatly reduced.

title_en: Beverage bottle conveyer is used in production
abstract_en: The utility model provides a beverage bottle conveying device for production, which relates to the technical field of conveying and comprises a shell, wherein an outlet opening is formed in the other end of the shell, a rotating rod penetrates through and rotates at the center of the interior of the shell, a first motor is fixed at the bottom of the shell, the output end of the first motor is fixedly connected with the bottom of the rotating rod, a disc plate is fixed at the top of the rotating rod, a cross plate is fixed at the top of the disc plate, a rotary disc is arranged in the interior of the shell, a square hole is formed in the bottom of the shell and positioned at the outlet opening, and a U-shaped plate is fixed at the bottom of the shell and positioned at the square hole. According to the utility model, the screw cap is rotated to separate from the surface of the screw rod, the circular ring is taken off, and the circular rod is separated from the inside of the circular groove, so that the turntable can be taken out from the surface of the cross plate, the effect of replacing the turntable of different types can be achieved, and the device can be suitable for plastic bottles of different sizes to carry out transmission arrangement.

title_en: Tray for hydration of contact lenses
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a contact lens hydration tray, which comprises a tray, a hydration assembly and a stacking assembly. According to the tray for hydrating the contact lenses, the water inlet holes at the bottom of the placing tray, and the transverse and longitudinal diversion grooves connected between the transverse and longitudinal water permeable holes at the upper end of the tray and the placing tray are convenient for placing the extraction liquid at the bottom of the tray, the extraction liquid flowing into the transverse and longitudinal water permeable holes at the upper end of the tray is convenient for flowing into the inside of the placing tray through the water inlet holes, and the extraction liquid is evenly diverted into the inside of the placing tray through the transverse and longitudinal diversion grooves connected with the placing tray, so that the fluidity and the internal and external exchange performance of the extraction liquid in the placing tray are improved, the effect of hydrating the contact lenses in the placing tray is also effectively improved, and the extraction liquid entering the inside of the placing tray can be moved to the bottom of the contact lenses in the placing tray through the concave grooves, so that the hydrating effect of the double sides of the contact lenses is enhanced.

title_en: Code spraying rewinder
abstract_en: The application discloses spout a sign indicating number rewinding machine relates to lithography apparatus technical field, and it includes the frame, the frame is equipped with unreeling device, spouts a yard device and coiling mechanism, it has spouts a yard shower nozzle to spout a yard device, unreeling device with spout and be equipped with deviation correcting device between the yard device, deviation correcting device including set up in the mount pad of frame and rotate connect in the roller of rectifying of mount pad, the axis of rotation of roller of rectifying is on a parallel with the transverse direction when the trade mark area is carried, the roller of rectifying is equipped with the groove of rectifying, the groove of rectifying is used for supplying the trade mark area to be just through making the trade mark area spouts a yard region of sign indicating number shower nozzle. The deviation rectifying groove is arranged, and the trademark tape can be subjected to position correction after passing through the deviation rectifying groove, so that the code spraying of the trademark tape is more stable.

title_en: Multi-layer cloth piece composite production line for full-automatic feeding lamination pressing and discharging
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi-layer cloth piece composite production line for full-automatic feeding lamination pressing and discharging, which comprises a frame, an automatic conveying belt, an automatic feeding station, an automatic lamination station, an automatic pressing station and an automatic discharging station, wherein the automatic conveying belt, the automatic feeding station, the automatic lamination station, the automatic pressing station and the automatic discharging station are arranged on the frame; the automatic feeding station is provided with a feeding manipulator for feeding towards the automatic feeding station, the automatic lamination station is provided with a lamination manipulator, the automatic lamination station is provided with an automatic lamination module, and the automatic discharging station is provided with a discharging manipulator. Therefore, the automatic feeding, lamination, pressing and discharging of the multi-layer cloth pieces are realized, the degree of automation is high, the efficiency is high, and the product consistency is good.

title_en: Steel wire rope tension detection device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of elevator detection and discloses a steel wire rope tension detection device which comprises a dynamometer main body, wherein a square frame is fixedly connected to the front surface of the dynamometer main body, a rotating hole is formed in the inner wall of the square frame, a rotating shaft is rotatably connected to the inner wall of the rotating hole, a control panel is fixedly connected to the surface of the rotating shaft and is electrically connected with the dynamometer main body, a fixed block is fixedly connected to the surface of the control panel, an inserting hole is formed in the side surface of the fixed block, and a sliding opening is formed in the side surface of the square frame. In the utility model, the T-shaped rod is pulled out of the counter bore, at the moment, the turntable can rotate to drive the rotating shaft to rotate, so that the control panel rotates, after the control panel rotates by 90 degrees, the T-shaped rod moves to the other counter bore and is inserted into the new counter bore under the tension of the tension spring, the position of the turntable is fixed, and the position of the rotated control panel is fixed, so that the control panel is convenient to check.

title_en: Compact high-speed material taking module
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a compact high-speed material taking module, which comprises: the visual positioning device comprises a supporting portal frame, an X-axis linear motor module arranged at the upper end of the supporting portal frame, a first mounting seat arranged on the X-axis linear motor module, a Y-axis linear motor module arranged on one side of the first mounting seat, a second mounting seat arranged on the Y-axis linear motor module, a Z-axis linear motor module arranged on the second mounting seat, a third mounting seat arranged on the Z-axis linear motor module, a visual positioning module arranged on the third mounting seat and matched with the third mounting seat to finish material taking, and a rotary material taking device. Through adopting the mode of stacking to install X axle linear electric motor module, Y axle linear electric motor module, Z axle linear electric motor module together for overall structure is compacter, and is little at the epaxial load, and utilizes linear electric motor's drive mode can realize the motion at X, Y, Z orientation high-speed, low vibrations, thereby realizes getting to put the image processor in the camera equipment process and can not produce vibrations.

title_en: Powder conveying pipeline with high compression resistance
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-pressure-resistance powder conveying pipeline which comprises a storage bin, wherein a powder conveying pump is fixedly connected to the middle position of the top of the storage bin, a feeding pipe is fixedly connected to the input end of the powder conveying pump, a material guiding pipe is fixedly connected to the output end of the powder conveying pump, a Roots blower is fixedly connected to the middle position of the right side of the storage bin, a powder conveying pipe is fixedly connected to the output end of the Roots blower, a stainless steel outer pipe is arranged on the outer side of the powder conveying pipe, a protective sleeve is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the stainless steel outer pipe, a filling sleeve is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the protective sleeve, and a buffer sleeve is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the filling sleeve. According to the utility model, powder transportation is smoother, the application range of the powder conveying pipe is improved, the compression resistance of the pipeline is improved, the service life of the pipeline is prolonged, the tightness of the pipeline connection part is improved, the pollution of leakage of the pipeline connection part to the environment is prevented, and the transportation efficiency is improved.

title_en: Cloth rolling device of large circular knitting machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cloth rolling device of a large circular knitting machine, which comprises a right-angle frame, wherein two groups of right-angle frames are arranged, the opposite surfaces of the two groups of right-angle frames are penetrated with bearings, the interiors of the two groups of bearings are penetrated with rotating rods, the side walls of the two groups of rotating rods are sheathed with clamping pipes in a sliding manner, the side walls of the two groups of rotating rods are provided with two groups of first sliding grooves and first annular grooves, the interiors of the two groups of first annular grooves are provided with two groups of first sliding blocks in a sliding manner, four groups of first sliding blocks are respectively welded with the interiors of the two groups of clamping pipes, the interiors of the two groups of clamping pipes are provided with two groups of second sliding grooves and second annular grooves, and cloth rolling rods are arranged between the two groups of clamping pipes. The beneficial effects are that: the utility model adopts the supporting plate, and can adapt to the installation and use of cloth rolling rods with different lengths through the arranged supporting plate, thereby improving the use practicability of the cloth rolling device of the circular knitting machine.

title_en: Conveyer belt intermediate discharge device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a midway discharging device of a conveyer belt, which comprises a supporting rod, a bottom plate, a cover plate, a lifting assembly and a guide plate. The utility model belongs to the technical field of conveying and unloading equipment, and particularly relates to a conveying belt midway unloading device.

title_en: Fire-resistant mica tape slitting device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a fire-resistant mica tape slitting device, which relates to the field of mica tape slitting and comprises a workbench, wherein a first winding roller and a second winding roller are respectively arranged at two ends of the workbench in a rotating way, the first winding roller and the second winding roller are respectively arranged at two sides of the top end of the workbench in a rotating way, and a first roll shaft and a second roll shaft are respectively arranged at the middle part of the workbench in a rotating way.

title_en: Hoisting tool
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hoisting tool, and relates to the technical field of complete machine hoisting of centrifugal air compressors. The lifting hook comprises a connecting plate, lifting hooks are symmetrically arranged below the connecting plate, fixing columns are fixedly connected to the inner parts of the two lifting hooks, vortex springs are fixedly connected to the outer parts of the two fixing columns, rotating sleeves are fixedly connected to the other ends of the two vortex springs, mounting plates and adjusting plates are respectively and fixedly connected to the outer parts of the two rotating sleeves, one sides of the two lifting hooks are fixedly connected with abutting plates for abutting against the mounting plates, guide grooves for the mounting plates to move are formed in the opposite sides of the two lifting hooks, and guide grooves for the adjusting plates to move are formed in the other sides of the two lifting hooks. Through setting up lifting hook, fixed column, vortex spring, rotating sleeve, mounting panel, regulating plate and conflict board, can very conveniently carry out the unhook to the lifting rope and handle.

title_en: Packaging treatment equipment for transferring chemical products
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of packing treatment equipment, and discloses packing treatment equipment for transferring chemical products, which comprises a device base, wherein the top of the device base is provided with a carrying platform, the interior of the carrying platform is provided with a clamping mechanism, the clamping mechanism comprises a fixed plate, a first fixed frame, a first rotating motor and a fixed shaft, and the bottom of the fixed plate is fixedly arranged with the bottom of the interior of the carrying platform. This kind of a packing treatment facility for chemical industry is transported, the effectual in-service use in-process that has solved, the device can't effectually carry out effectual fixed centre gripping to the chemical of required packing, and then can appear rocking when leading to the chemical when packing, cause the device can't effectually pack sealed problem to the chemical, enable the device carry out effectual fixed centre gripping to the chemical of equidimension in the whole operation process, thereby guarantee that the device can not take place to rock when packing it, the stability of chemical when having improved the packing.

title_en: Filling device for fertilizer processing production
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of fertilizer filling equipment, and particularly relates to a filling device for fertilizer processing production, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a mixing hopper is arranged on the upper side of the bottom plate, a height adjusting structure for adjusting the height of the mixing hopper is arranged on the bottom plate, a first control valve is arranged at the output end of the mixing hopper, a rotating rod is rotationally connected with the mixing hopper, mixing paddles are fixedly connected with the rotating rod, a first helical blade is fixedly connected with the bottom end of the rotating rod, three feeding hoppers are uniformly arranged on the upper side of the mixing hopper, supporting frames are fixedly connected in the three feeding hoppers, and rotating shafts are rotationally connected in the supporting frames. According to the utility model, the three feed hoppers and the mixing hoppers are used for conveniently filling different kinds of fertilizers and the same kind of fertilizers, the flexible adjustment can be carried out according to production requirements, the applicability is stronger, the different kinds of fertilizers are conveniently and uniformly mixed through the rotating rods and the mixing paddles, and the filling efficiency is improved.

title_en: Modularized horizontal silo and conveying integrated system
abstract_en: The utility model is suitable for the field of cement powder conveying equipment, and provides a modularized horizontal silo and a conveying integrated system, wherein the modularized horizontal silo comprises a silo body underframe and supporting legs, and further comprises: the powder bin body is arranged on a bin body underframe, an arch breaking motor is arranged at the lower part of the outer side of the powder bin body, and a pressure safety valve and a pulse dust remover are respectively arranged at the top of the powder bin body; an ash inlet pipe connected with the upper part of the powder bin body is arranged on one side of the bin body underframe; the powder bin comprises a horizontal spiral conveying mechanism and a vertical spiral conveying mechanism, wherein the bottom of a powder bin body is provided with the horizontal spiral conveying mechanism, and the output end of the horizontal spiral conveying mechanism is connected with the vertical spiral conveying mechanism. The horizontal silo structure can reduce the height of the device, the modular structure can improve the installation efficiency, effectively improve the material utilization rate, save the transportation cost, only carry out the installation procedure on site, save the site processing time and improve the station building speed.

title_en: Tongue folding and inserting mechanism of boxing machine and boxing machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tongue folding and inserting mechanism of a boxing machine and the boxing machine, wherein the tongue folding and inserting mechanism comprises a first tongue folding and inserting assembly, a second tongue folding and inserting assembly and a synchronous driving assembly which are oppositely arranged; the synchronous driving assembly is connected with the first tongue inserting assembly and the second tongue inserting assembly and is used for synchronously driving the first tongue inserting assembly and the second tongue inserting assembly to move oppositely or back to each other. The tongue folding and inserting mechanism of the boxing machine provided by the utility model has a simple structure, can reduce the operation complexity of equipment and improves the packaging efficiency.

title_en: Device for adjusting levelness of lifting mechanism of robot and storage robot
abstract_en: The utility model provides a device for adjusting levelness of a lifting mechanism of a robot and a storage robot. A steel strip capable of ascending and descending; the base is fixedly connected with the base plate, and a guide groove is formed in the base; and an adjusting mechanism fixedly connected to the steel strip, the adjusting mechanism being provided to the guide groove, the adjusting mechanism being configured to be movable up and down along the guide groove with respect to the base plate in a vertical direction to loosen/tighten the steel strip. According to the device provided by the utility model, the levelness of the lifting mechanism can be adjusted.

title_en: Conveying device before extrusion molding
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a conveying device before extrusion molding, which comprises a first workbench and a second workbench, and is characterized in that the first workbench and the second workbench are connected with each other through a translation device, a storage groove for storing copper casting bars is formed in one side, close to an extruder, of the second workbench, a plurality of pulleys which incline oppositely are arranged on two sides inside the storage groove, and a conveying belt is arranged in the middle area of the storage groove. According to the round cast rod receiving and delivering device, the storage groove arranged on the second workbench moves horizontally relative to the first workbench through the translation device, so that manual intervention is not needed when the round cast rod is transported, and when the round cast rod is received or delivered, the round cast rod can be prevented from being collided with other objects during transportation due to the pulleys which are oppositely inclined on the two sides of the storage groove, the motor on one side of the second workbench can drive the transmission gear to rotate through the transmission rod, and the fact that manual intervention is not needed when the round cast rod is received or delivered by the conveying belt is achieved. Solves the problems of impurity contamination and easy collision during transporting round cast bars.

title_en: Workbench convenient for fixing motor and used for robot motor maintenance
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a workbench for maintaining a robot motor, which is convenient for fixing the motor, and comprises: a table main body; the utility model provides a workstation main part one side is provided with the drawer, workstation main part top is provided with the control cabinet, this workstation of fixed motor of being convenient for is maintained to robot motor, through being provided with the threaded rod, the carousel, fixed plate and regulating plate form fixed knot and construct, can make the regulating plate remove through rotatory carousel, thereby fix the motor, avoid handheld fixed motor not hard up low problem of work efficiency that leads to, through being provided with the stabilizer bar, the shock attenuation pole, spring and shock attenuation frame form shock-absorbing structure, can carry out certain absorption through rocking that produces when the spring is tested the motor, avoid motor test workstation main part top part problem that drops, through being provided with the connecting rod, bracing piece and light, can adjust the position of light through rotatory connecting rod and supporting rod, the illumination demand of being convenient for satisfy actual maintenance.

title_en: Water quality pH meter for water quality detection
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water quality pH meter for water quality detection, which comprises a pH meter main body and a containing mechanism, wherein the pH meter main body comprises a test tube main body and a connecting wire, the containing mechanism is arranged on the front surface of the pH meter main body, the containing mechanism comprises a bottom plate, a limiting plate, a containing column and a compacting component, the bottom plate is fixed on the front surface of the pH meter main body, the containing column is fixed on the front surface of the bottom plate, the limiting plate is sleeved at the front end of the containing column in a screwing way, and the compacting component is arranged on the front surface of the limiting plate and the rear end of the compacting component is positioned on the side surface of the containing column; according to the utility model, the connecting wire is combined with the storage mechanism, so that the longer connecting wire can be wound, the wound connecting wire is compressed and limited, the situation that the wound connecting wire breaks away from disorder again to influence storage is avoided, the situation that the connecting wire is pulled to drive the test tube body to break away from the falling surface to collide and damage to influence use is avoided, and the detection stability and safety of the pH meter main body are improved.

title_en: Multifunctional manipulator
abstract_en: The application discloses a multifunctional manipulator. The multifunctional manipulator comprises a frame, a workpiece transferring assembly and a tray transferring assembly; the frame is connected with an external power source; the workpiece transfer assembly is arranged on the rack and used for grabbing workpieces from the tray, and comprises a clamping jaw driving piece and a plurality of clamping jaws; the clamping jaw driving piece is arranged on the frame; the clamping fingers are connected with the clamping jaw driving piece, and the pressing parts are used for abutting against the workpiece to adjust the gesture of the workpiece when the clamping fingers grab the workpiece; the tray transfer assembly is arranged on the frame and is arranged at intervals with the workpiece transfer assembly and used for transferring the tray, wherein the frame is driven by an external power source to drive the tray transfer assembly to move away the tray. The multifunctional manipulator reduces the labor intensity of operators and the equipment cost in production.

title_en: Automatic grain surface leveling vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of auxiliary devices of grain storage warehouses, in particular to an automatic grain surface leveling vehicle which can automatically level grain surfaces conveniently and quickly and improve the leveling efficiency and quality of the grain surfaces. The suction grain subassembly includes suction grain motor, suction grain pipe, three group clamps, the sliding sleeve, two sets of electric telescopic ware, go out the grain inner tube, go out the grain outer tube, upper bracket group and camera, the sliding sleeve is installed on the top of upper bracket group, suction grain pipe and sliding sleeve sliding connection, the bottom of suction grain pipe is provided with into the grain mouth, the input of suction grain motor communicates with the top of suction grain pipe, the fixed suit of a set of clamp is in the outside of suction grain pipe, the right-hand member of a set of electric telescopic ware is connected with the left end top of upper bracket group, the output and the bottom of clamp of a set of electric telescopic ware are connected, the left end and the top intercommunication of suction grain pipe of play grain inner tube, the outside sliding connection of the outside of play grain outer tube.

title_en: Reel for textile machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of reels for textile machines, and discloses a reel for a textile machine, which comprises a main body mechanism, an adjusting mechanism and a limiting mechanism, wherein the adjusting mechanism is positioned at the upper end of the main body mechanism, the limiting mechanism is positioned at the upper end of the adjusting mechanism, the main body mechanism comprises a mounting base, a fixed mounting screw hole and a fixed mounting nut, the fixed mounting screw hole is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the mounting base, the fixed mounting screw hole is uniformly distributed at the upper end of the mounting base, the fixed mounting nut is movably arranged at the upper end of the fixed mounting screw hole, and the adjusting mechanism comprises a mounting groove, a motor, a double-sided threaded rod, a first limiting block and a first positioning nut. This reel for spinning machine is through the installation and the improvement to adjustment mechanism for this reel for spinning machine's regulation change ability promotes to some extent, in the in-service use, can be portable according to the reel of using different length of change, has improved this reel for spinning machine's market competition.

title_en: Double-layer floodlight decoration top
abstract_en: The application discloses a double-layer floodlight decoration roof, which relates to the field of elevator car accessories and comprises a connecting frame, a lower decoration plate and floodlight groups; the connecting frame is connected with the upper surface of the lower decorative plate, a first folded edge which is bent upwards is arranged on the periphery of the lower decorative plate, the height of the first folded edge is lower than that of the connecting frame, a mounting groove is formed between the first folded edge and the connecting frame as well as between the first folded edge and the lower decorative plate, and the floodlight group is positioned in the mounting groove; the lower decorative plate is provided with a transparent cover plate for covering the mounting groove. The application utilizes transparent apron to cover the mounting groove of installation floodlight group, and transparent apron is comparatively convenient for clean.

title_en: Pull rod type folding mechanism for aviation hydraulic jack
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pull rod type folding mechanism for an aviation hydraulic jack, which relates to the technical field of aviation jacks, and comprises a jack main body, wherein a base frame is fixedly arranged outside the lower end of the jack main body; the outer part of the base frame is provided with a second pull rod at an included angle of 120 degrees, and each second pull rod is connected with a first pull rod; in the utility model, the first pull rod is connected with the screw cylinder fixing seat, one end of the second pull rod, which is matched with the first pull rod, adopts a one-side chamfering mode, so that the second pull rod and the first pull rod can rotate at an angle, the second pull rod rotates along the pull rod fixing pin and can rotate the second pull rod anticlockwise to be horizontal with the first pull rod, at the moment, the plane of the second pull rod is jointed with the plane of the upper groove of the first pull rod, the limiting effect is achieved, and the rotation of the pull rod is stopped; in the utility model, when the jack is folded, the quick-release pin is pulled out, so that the two short sides of the pull rod are fixed with the folding joint through the quick-release pin after rotating upwards, and the folding of the jack is completed.

title_en: Winding device for towel production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of towel winding devices, and discloses a winding device for towel production, which comprises a base, wherein an inclined seat is fixedly arranged on the side surface of the base, a fixing seat is fixedly arranged at the top end of the base, and a baffle is fixedly arranged on the side surface of the fixing seat. This coiling mechanism is used in towel production, driving motor's output shaft passes through the driving roller and drives the conveyer belt and rotate, the conveyer belt drives the towel and advances, the towel falls to the dead axle on, begin to roll up, labour saving and time saving makes things convenient for the staff to operate, work efficiency has been improved, first loose end of cylinder stretches out in the fixing base, press from both sides the towel in the dead axle and first loose end of cylinder, driving motor's output shaft drives the dead axle through the rotating plate and first rotation of cylinder, the towel rolling is in the dead axle avris, first loose end of cylinder is located the towel avris, be convenient for prevent that the towel from producing to drop at the rolling in-process, the loose end of cylinder promotes the push pedal and advances, push away the towel roll of dead axle avris, make things convenient for the staff to collect the arrangement.

title_en: Novel pass material device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a novel material conveying device, which comprises a chain conveyor for conveying metal bars, wherein a head-end electric carrier roller conveyor and a tail-end electric carrier roller conveyor are respectively arranged at the head end and the tail end of the chain conveyor, the head-end electric carrier roller conveyor is connected with a heating furnace, and the tail-end electric carrier roller conveyor is connected with a discharging table; the frame of the head end electric carrier roller conveyor and the frame of the tail end electric carrier roller conveyor are respectively provided with a mounting frame, two limiting baffles are connected to the two mounting frames, and the distance between the two limiting baffles is adjustable; two ends of each limit baffle are respectively provided with a connecting boss, and the two connecting bosses are respectively lapped on the head end electric carrier roller conveyor and the tail end electric carrier roller conveyor to lift the middle part of the limit baffle away from the chain conveyor. The position of the limit baffles on two sides of the device can be flexibly and conveniently adjusted, so that the device is suitable for conveying requirements of bars with different diameters, and the situation that the bars are transversely arranged and clamped is effectively avoided.

title_en: Rotary sealing valve for preventing blockage and dry quenching system using same
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of dry quenching, and particularly relates to a rotary sealing valve for preventing blocking and a dry quenching system using the same, wherein the rotary sealing valve for preventing blocking comprises a valve body, a feed hopper and a discharging groove, and the valve body is further provided with: the rotor assembly comprises a rotor wheel and a rotor partition plate, wherein the rotor wheel is rotatably arranged in the valve body through a rotor shaft and is driven to rotate through a driving device; the anti-jamming assembly is arranged on the side of the bottom of the valve body and comprises an observation structure, a retaining structure and a magnetic absorption conveying structure, wherein the observation structure is obliquely arranged, the retaining structure is in a ladder shape, the magnetic absorption conveying structure runs in the surrounding space of the observation structure, the retaining structure and the rotor assembly, the retaining structure faces to the feeding direction of the rotor assembly, and a scraping structure for matching with the magnetic absorption conveying structure to scrape materials is arranged on the retaining structure. The utility model can prevent the occurrence of the blocking condition of the rotary sealing valve, saves labor, lightens labor intensity and is more beneficial to improving the dry quenching rate and the generating capacity.

title_en: Gift bag capable of preventing gift from sliding
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a gift bag for preventing gifts from sliding, which comprises a bag body and a hand-held rope, wherein the left side and the right side of the bag body are respectively provided with a supporting frame, the two sides of the supporting frames are rotatably provided with supporting arms, the ends, far away from the supporting frames, of the supporting arms are rotatably provided with clamping plates, and the two ends of the hand-held rope are respectively arranged on the supporting arms on the same side of the two supporting frames. The utility model has the advantages that: the portable rope is arranged on the supporting arms, when the gift bag is lifted, the portable rope straightens the two supporting arms at the two ends of the portable rope to rotate in opposite directions, so that the clamping plate clamps the gift to prevent the gift from sliding; the gift bag is provided with the supporting frame and the bearing plate, so that the side face of the gift bag can be supported, and the gift bag is prevented from being wrinkled; the bearing plate is connected with the supporting frame, so that the gift bag can be prevented from being damaged due to overweight gifts.

title_en: Dampproofing insulating winding film
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a moistureproof insulating winding film, which comprises a winding film base layer, wherein the top of the winding film base layer is fixedly connected with a grid cloth layer, the top of the grid cloth layer is fixedly connected with a moistureproof layer, the top of the moistureproof layer is fixedly connected with a wear-resistant layer, the bottom of the winding film base layer is fixedly connected with an adhesion layer, the bottom of the adhesion layer is fixedly connected with a flame-retardant layer, the bottom of the flame-retardant layer is fixedly connected with an insulating layer, the insulating layer is a polyimide film layer, the flame-retardant layer is a polyvinylidene chloride film layer, the moistureproof layer is a perfluoroethylene propylene film layer, the thickness of the insulating layer is 10-20 mu m, and the thickness of the flame-retardant layer is 15-30 mu m. This dampproofing insulating wound film uses through wound film basic unit, net cloth layer, dampproof course, wearing layer, adhesion layer, fire-retardant layer, insulating layer and enhancement layer's cooperation, has improved the dampproofing insulating properties of wound film, has solved the current problem that the dampproofing insulating properties of wound film is poor, influences the packaging effect of wound film.

title_en: Coal spiral unloader
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a coal spiral unloader, and relates to the technical field of coal spiral unloaders. The device comprises a device body, wherein a discharging pipe is communicated with the bottom of the device body, a fixed pipe is fixedly connected to the surface of the discharging pipe, a conveying pipe is movably connected to the bottom of the fixed pipe, and the top of the conveying pipe penetrates through an inner cavity of the fixed pipe and is communicated with the discharging pipe; through setting up the cooperation use of slide and first spring when the user needs to connect the material between discharging pipe and the conveying pipeline, the user communicates through between discharging pipe and the conveying pipeline to drive the inner chamber that the mount motion got into the fixed shell, the inner chamber that the user control fixture block motion got into concave piece is spacing, and the cardboard motion gets into the inner chamber of spacing groove, the installation of user has been made things convenient for, the practicality of the device has been increased, stop gear, the effectual effect that carries out spacingly to the movable rod, thereby prevented the removal of movable rod, and the installation of conveying pipeline has been made things convenient for.

title_en: Lightweight folding material box
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a lightweight folding material box which comprises a folding assembly, wherein a main body frame member such as a high-strength steel bottom frame is made of a high-strength steel DL700 material, the material thickness is reduced, the purpose of weight reduction is achieved, deformation and damage of a folding mechanism are prevented, an inserting block is removed from an inserting hole through rotation of the inserting block, an upper front frame and a lower front frame are folded through hinges, sliding columns on two sides are different in height through limiting of staggered sliding grooves, the second folding frame and the third folding frame are prevented from interfering each other when being folded, the first folding frame is folded through a pin roll which is rotationally connected with the upper part of the high-strength steel bottom frame, the connection heights of the first folding frame, the second folding frame, the third folding frame, the lower front frame and the high-strength steel bottom frame are different, so that mutual interference is effectively prevented, the bearing capacity after folding of the folding assembly is effectively reduced through bearing capacity after folding, and accidental damage is avoided, and the service life is prolonged.

title_en: Composite portable paper bag capable of preventing handle from tearing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a composite portable paper bag capable of preventing a handle from being torn, and relates to the field of portable paper bags. Including the handbag main part, handbag main part surface is equipped with the handbag surface course, and the handbag surface course surface sets up in first opening, has seted up mounting groove in the handbag main part, and fixed mounting has portable mechanism in the mounting groove, and portable mechanism includes portable rope, second opening, lifting rope blend stop and atress rectangular, and atress rectangular fixed mounting is in mounting groove, and the second opening has been seted up to the rectangular upper end department of atress, is equipped with portable rope in the second opening, and portable rope end is equipped with lifting rope blend stop, and handbag main part bottom fixed mounting has the handbag base. After the handbag base holds up the articles in the handbag main body, the portable rope can be directly connected to the handbag base through the stressed strip, and the handbag main body can not be pulled after the portable rope is directly connected to the handbag base, so that the handbag main body is prevented from being torn.

title_en: Fresh flower fresh-keeping storage rack
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fresh flower preservation storage rack, which comprises a frame component, a first supporting component, a second supporting component and a water storage component; the frame component comprises upright posts, wherein a first transverse support and a second transverse support are arranged between the upright posts, the first transverse support and the second transverse support are fixedly connected with the upright posts, and the first transverse support is perpendicular to the second transverse support; the first supporting component comprises sleeves symmetrically arranged at the upper included angles of the upright posts and the first transverse support, and a first circular tube is inserted between the sleeves; the water storage component comprises a water tank arranged between the cross braces, a partition plate is arranged in the middle of the water tank, water permeable holes are formed in the bottom of the partition plate, a water pipe is arranged below the water tank, and a ball valve is connected to the water pipe. The fresh flower preservation storage rack provided by the utility model is attractive in appearance, can store more fresh flowers, can absorb water and nutrient solution, is smooth in air flow, can prolong the preservation period of the fresh flowers, is convenient to clean, and has good practicability.

title_en: Impact crusher
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an impact crusher, which comprises a box body, wherein a feeding pipe is fixedly connected to the left side of the box body, a discharging pipe is fixedly connected to the left side of the box body, a lower crushing plate is fixedly connected to the inside of the box body, and crushing assemblies are fixedly connected to the inside and the outer surface of the box body. This impact crusher, through adding the material to lower breaker plate through the inlet pipe, then start first motor drive gear rotation, because the gear is incomplete gear, so when the pinion rack risees to certain altitude, the pinion rack can be owing to gravity downwardly moving, the pinion rack removes and drives breaker plate and counter weight board downwardly moving on the connecting rod, hammer the material and smash, drive the baffle through starting first electric putter after the breakage and remove left, the material can drop between stock guide and the broken section of thick bamboo with the situation, drive broken section of thick bamboo through starting the second motor and rotate, mutually support between with the stock guide, can carry out the secondary breakage with the material, thereby reach the effect that crushing efficiency is high.

title_en: Sample transportation and preservation device for flow cytometry
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of transportation of flow cytometry detection samples, and discloses a sample transportation and preservation device for flow cytometry detection. This a sample transportation save set for flow cytometry detects through setting up round bar, ring, movable block, square board and balancing weight, and the center perpendicular to ground of square board can be guaranteed in the setting of balancing weight to guaranteed the stability of square board, avoid the inside sample of test tube to appear unrestrained, through setting up threaded rod and nut, after closing the roof, through rotatory mode, rotate the threaded rod to the inside of cardboard, later through rotatory nut for the top of nut and the bottom butt of cardboard, thereby accomplish the fixing to the roof.

title_en: Phosphogypsum automatic feeding device for producing road water stable material
abstract_en: The utility model provides an phosphogypsum automatic feeding device for producing road water stable materials, which comprises: a loader; the first-stage aggregate bin is arranged on one side of the loader, a first belt conveyor is arranged on one side of the first-stage aggregate bin, a first diffuser is arranged on the other side of the first belt conveyor, a second-stage aggregate bin is arranged on the other side of the first diffuser, a second belt conveyor is arranged on the other side of the second-stage aggregate bin, and a phosphogypsum scale bin is arranged on the other side of the second belt conveyor. The utility model provides an automatic phosphogypsum feeding device for producing road water stable materials, which can effectively prevent materials from accumulating in a feeding device and blocking a discharging opening, and is provided with a two-stage scattering device, so that the lump materials in phosphogypsum can be scattered, the uniformity of phosphogypsum particles is ensured, the uniformity of material mixing in the mixing process of the water stable materials is improved, and the quality of the water stable materials is ensured. In addition, the device has simple structure, convenient operation and strong practicability.

title_en: Hydraulic supporting leg lifting device of gantry crane
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hydraulic support leg lifting device of a gantry crane, which comprises a moving mechanism, a first support frame and a fixed frame, wherein the first support frame is arranged at the top of the moving mechanism, a hydraulic lifting rod is arranged in the first support frame, two support sliding rods are arranged in the first support frame, a second support frame is movably arranged in the first support frame, limit posts are movably arranged in the fixed frame, limit grooves are formed in two sides of the second support frame, a plurality of limit blocks are arranged in the limit grooves at equal intervals, and the limit posts are arranged in a matched mode with the limit blocks. According to the utility model, the pressure born by the hydraulic lifting rod can be reduced through the limiting installation between the limiting column and the limiting block, and the situation that the crane suddenly falls from high altitude can be avoided through the supporting effect of the limiting column on the limiting block when the hydraulic lifting rod suddenly fails in a pressure loss manner during use, so that the safety of the crane during use is ensured.

title_en: Hollow glass inner frame laminating device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hollow glass inner frame laminating device, which belongs to the technical field of hollow glass processing and comprises a workbench, wherein a conveying roller is arranged on the workbench, glass is arranged on the conveying roller, a base is arranged at the lower side of one end of the workbench.

title_en: Environment-friendly recovery bag for managing solid waste
abstract_en: The application discloses an environmental protection recovery bag of management solid waste. The environment-friendly recovery bag comprises a flexible barrel-shaped main body, wherein the main body sequentially comprises a wear-resistant layer, a liquid absorbing layer and a puncture-proof layer from outside to inside. The environment-friendly recovery bag can not be pierced by the internal solid waste, can absorb and lock the effluent liquid of the solid waste, so that liquid leakage can not occur, and secondary pollution can be reduced without cleaning.

title_en: Limiting type paperboard conveying equipment for packaging box processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses limit type paperboard conveying equipment for processing packaging boxes, which comprises a support, a conveying frame and conveying rollers, wherein an adjusting box is arranged below the conveying frame, a synchronous gear is movably connected to the bottom of the adjusting box, racks are arranged on two sides of the synchronous gear in a meshed mode, one end of each rack is fixedly connected with a moving block, the upper end of each moving block is connected with a limit side plate through a supporting rod, and the side face of each limit side plate is connected with a limit top plate through a height adjusting piece. This kind of spacing type cardboard conveying equipment for packing box processing passes through the cooperation of synchronous gear and rack, and the distance between two spacing curb plates of adjustable, the cardboard of the different width of adaptation avoids the cardboard to go out the deviation in the transportation, and the driving method is comparatively simple, utilizes the frictional force between auxiliary wheel and the cardboard, can assist the cardboard to move forward, avoids cardboard and spacing curb plate butt to pass closely and blocked motionless.

title_en: Portable boiler water quality detection case
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable boiler water quality detection box in the technical field of detection boxes, wherein hinges are arranged on the left side and the right side of the top of a box body, the top of the box body is hinged with a box cover through the hinges, inner liners are arranged around the inner cavity of the box body, a partition plate is vertically arranged in the middle of the inner cavity of the box body, a transverse partition plate is transversely arranged in the middle of the right side of the partition plate, and an instrument placement area is arranged on the left side of the partition plate; the operation panel can constitute a little operation panel through the cooperation with cover extension rod, external screw rod, and the bottom of external screw rod is pegged graft on the case lid through the cooperation of spliced eye with the extension rod, sets up like this and can conveniently dismantle, and is connected through hinge one between cover extension rod and the operation panel, can conveniently fold like this and accomodate, after the cover extension rod is folded to the operation panel through hinge one, can put into the box, and the baffle and the transverse baffle that set up this moment can play the effect of supporting the operation panel to place other instruments in the box not influencing.

title_en: Adhesive tape holder with adjustable adhesive tape width
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a tape holder, and discloses a tape holder with an adjustable tape width, which comprises a holder body, wherein a low rod, a first high rod and a second high rod are arranged on the holder body, the positions of the low rod and the second high rod are higher than those of the first high rod, a mounting frame is arranged above the second high rod, a sliding groove is formed in the mounting frame, a cutter rest is connected in the sliding groove, a pair of mounting blocks are arranged above the mounting frame, a threaded rod is connected between the pair of mounting blocks in a rotating way, the threaded rod is in threaded connection with the cutter rest, and a blade is arranged below the cutter rest.

title_en: Raw material feeding auxiliary device for screw production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a raw material feeding auxiliary device for screw production, which comprises a workbench and a steel wire winding drum sleeve arranged on the workbench and used for winding and manufacturing screw raw materials, wherein a rotating assembly used for driving the steel wire winding drum sleeve to rotate automatically is arranged in the steel wire winding drum sleeve, and a motor used for driving the rotating assembly to rotate is arranged at the lower part of the workbench. Make outside arc and the wire reel sleeve inner wall assorted of butt piece, form the fixed to wire reel copper sheathing, spacing to the wire reel, prevent that the position of wire reel from taking place to remove the transport that influences the steel wire at the material loading in-process, the effect of buffering can be played in the setting of spring, prevent to lead to the fact wearing and tearing to the wire reel inner wall at fixed in-process, behind the starter motor, motor power take off end drives the pivot and rotates for the fixed plate rotates, drives the rotation of wire reel cover, need not artifical pulling, has improved work efficiency.

title_en: Anti-falling mechanism of construction elevator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a falling prevention mechanism of a construction elevator, which comprises a base, a bracket arranged at the top of the base and a car sleeved on one side of the bracket, wherein the top of the car is fixedly connected with a mounting plate, and one side of the mounting plate is provided with a power device for driving the car to lift; one side of mounting panel runs through the slip and is equipped with two sets of inserted bars from top to bottom, one side fixedly connected with limiting plate of support, inserted bar and limiting plate cooperation use can prevent that the car from falling, drive mechanism sets up at the top of mounting panel and is used for driving two sets of inserted bars and removes in turn. According to the utility model, the inserted bars can move from the bottom of the limiting plate to the top of the limiting plate through the arrangement of the guide plates and the arc edges, and the cage can be limited through the interference of the inserted bars and the limiting plate when falling, so that the falling position is controlled, and the moving motor can drive the upper and lower groups of inserted bars to sequentially and alternately move, so that the upper and lower groups of inserted bars and the limiting plate are prevented from being blocked when falling.

title_en: Food packaging bag for microwave heating
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a food packaging bag for microwave heating, which comprises an outer bag and an inner bag arranged in an inner cavity of the outer bag, wherein a second tearing line which is closed in an annular shape is formed on the surface of the inner bag; the outer bag is further provided with a first tearing line which is not closed, and a lifting structure is connected to the opening of the first tearing line and used for exhausting the outer bag outwards along the first tearing line at the upper opening of the outer bag. According to the food packaging bag for microwave heating, the annular second tearing line is formed on the surface of the inner bag body, so that liquid in the rear inner bag is heated to form steam, and the bag body is burst and exhausted from the second tearing line. The first tearing line is arranged, so that the bag body can be prevented from being contacted with high-temperature gas when being torn by hands, and the safety is higher; the holding plate is arranged to further insulate heat, and meanwhile, the folding groove and the bending part structure are arranged on the holding plate, so that the bag body is easier to form a bowl-shaped structure when being placed and taken.

title_en: Water supply pump core-pulling bag moving auxiliary mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water supply pump core pulling bag moving auxiliary mechanism which comprises a hanging beam, supporting legs, a split frame, a main slideway, a split slideway, a moving frame and an adjusting bracket; the split frame is arranged at one end of the core pulling bag of the water supply pump and is at the same height with the water supply pump base; legs are inserted into two sides of the split frame; the surface of the split frame is fixedly provided with a main slideway; one end of the main slideway, which faces the water supply pump, is inserted with a split slideway; the other end of the split slideway is lapped on the surface of a base of the water supply pump; a roller way is fixed between the split slide ways; the movable frame moves along the sliding grooves of the main sliding way and the split sliding way; a hoop is fixed at the top of the movable frame; the hoop is sleeved at one end of the core bag; the adjusting bracket is arranged at the other end of the core bag; the bottom of the adjusting bracket moves along a roller way; a hanging beam is fixed on the outer side of the main slideway; the hanging hole of the hanging beam is connected with the hanging ring on the core bag through a hanging rope.

title_en: Belt conveyor and electric roller
abstract_en: A belt conveyor and an electric roller comprise a roller body, a speed reducer and a transmission assembly; the speed reducer comprises a speed reducer shell and an output shaft, a transmission assembly transmits the rotation power of the output shaft to an end cover of the roller body so that the end cover of the roller body rotates, the transmission assembly is provided with an annular force transmission part, and the force transmission part is coaxially arranged with the output shaft and rotates by taking a central shaft of the output shaft as a rotation central shaft; the speed reducer shell is provided with a supporting ring part for supporting the force transmission part. According to the utility model, the electric roller can meet the requirement of conveying a large load and ensure that the output shaft of the gearbox is not deformed under the conditions of not increasing the diameter of the output shaft and not changing the volume.

title_en: Single-leg lifting mechanism applied to cargo transportation
abstract_en: The utility model provides a be applied to single leg lifting mechanism of goods transport, relates to the goods transportation field, including the supporting leg, the fixed guide rail slide that is equipped with of symmetry about the supporting leg, every be equipped with the guide rail spout in the guide rail slide respectively, every slide in the guide rail slide respectively and be equipped with the gyro wheel, every the outside of gyro wheel is provided with the adjusting sleeve respectively, two rotate between the gyro wheel and be equipped with the roller shaft, the epaxial rotation of roller is equipped with the fork link, two install the electric putter between the guide rail slide, the upside of fork link with the screw thread is equipped with fixing bolt between the electric putter, through regard assembled fork panel as independent minor part, the fork panel of different configuration length of being convenient for the fast switch over and specification, satisfy different customer demands fast, also be convenient for later maintenance and realize the configuration of different demands and the environment operating mode of adaptation different pallets at any time.

title_en: Shuttle for rail transportation and rail transportation system using same
abstract_en: The utility model provides a shuttle for rail transportation, which comprises a frame and a functional piece arranged by depending on the frame; the functional piece comprises a workpiece conveying device and a driving device; the frame is provided with a concave part along a tangential plane of the traveling direction of the shuttle, and the conveying device is arranged on the concave part, and the conveying direction of the conveying device is perpendicular to the traveling direction of the shuttle; the concave depth of the concave part can enable the conveying device on the concave part to convey a workpiece to a station arranged beside the traveling direction of the shuttle at a preset height, so that the co-planar butt joint of the shuttle and a receiving station is realized; the driving device is used for driving the shuttle to run on the track. According to the utility model, tedious butt joint links between the shuttle and the receiving station are reduced through the concave parts, so that simple and efficient direct butt joint of the shuttle and the receiving station is realized.

title_en: Photovoltaic optimizer transfer plate
abstract_en: The utility model provides a photovoltaic optimizer transfer plate which is used for placing a photovoltaic optimizer, and the photovoltaic optimizer comprises an optimizer main body and pins and is characterized by comprising a rectangular plate body, wherein the rectangular plate body is provided with a plurality of placement grooves, each placement groove comprises a groove main body and pin accommodating holes, the shape of each groove main body is matched with that of the optimizer main body, the shape of each pin accommodating hole is matched with that of each pin, the groove main body is used for placing the optimizer main body, the pin accommodating holes are used for placing the pins, and a plurality of placement grooves are arranged at intervals in a rectangular array mode along the length direction and the width direction of the rectangular plate body, and positioning holes are formed in two ends of the rectangular plate body along the length direction of the rectangular plate body. The utility model can realize one-time transfer of a plurality of photovoltaic optimizers, realize collective transfer of the photovoltaic optimizers, realize operation of the plurality of photovoltaic optimizers at a processing procedure, avoid the condition of one-time operation of a single photovoltaic optimizer and improve the production efficiency.

title_en: Nursing belt assisting in lifting buttocks
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a nursing belt assisting in lifting buttocks, which comprises a nursing belt main body, wherein an auxiliary sliding plate is fixed at the left end of the nursing belt main body, the nursing belt main body is inserted between a patient body and a bed body through the auxiliary sliding plate, the nursing belt main body can assist the patient in lifting buttocks to move, the left end of the auxiliary sliding plate is connected with a connecting block, a connecting frame is fixed below the connecting block, the side view cross section of the connecting frame is of an L-shaped structural design, the connecting block is clamped at the side edge of the bed body, an insertion groove is formed in the connecting block, and the right side of the insertion groove is of an opening-shaped structural design. This nursing area of lifting buttocks is provided with supplementary slide and connecting block, can be with nursing area main part quick introduction to the patient physically down through supplementary slide, and supplementary slide can be connected fixedly with the connecting block, and the connecting block passes through the link card in bed body side, forms the fixed to nursing area main part tip, can directly follow-up the nursing area main part of pulling at the other end and assist patient's lifting buttocks.

title_en: Chain guide mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fruit and vegetable sorting, in particular to a chain guide mechanism. The chain guide mechanism comprises a supporting piece and a guiding piece, wherein the supporting piece is in relative sliding connection with the guiding piece, the upper part of the guiding piece is used for supporting a chain, the supporting piece is an aluminum profile, the top surface of the supporting piece is in contact with the guiding piece, and a clamping groove matched with the guiding piece is formed in the side surface of the supporting piece. The guide supporting device comprises the supporting piece and the guide piece, wherein the supporting piece is in relative sliding connection with the guide piece, the upper part of the guide piece is used for supporting a chain, the supporting piece is an aluminum profile, and the guide piece is of a strip-shaped structure made of ultra-high molecular polyethylene, so that the guide supporting device is simple in structure, convenient to install, convenient to adjust in length, convenient to detach and maintain after sale, good in wear resistance and long in service life.

title_en: High-efficient whole paper packing integrative device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of paperboard packaging, and provides a high-efficiency paper-finishing and packaging integrated device which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a first electric sliding rail is fixedly connected to the top of the bottom plate, a first electric telescopic rod is connected to the first electric sliding rail in a sliding manner, a placing plate is fixedly arranged at the output end of the first electric telescopic rod, and a paperboard is placed at the top of the placing plate. According to the utility model, after the paperboards are stacked, the paperboards are driven to move to the lower side of the correcting structure through the first electric sliding rail, the correcting box is pushed by the second electric telescopic rod in the correcting structure to move downwards to cover the paperboards, the paperboards with larger angle deviation are smoothed through the inner vertical plates, and then the vertical plates and the pushing plates are respectively pushed by the third electric telescopic rod and the fourth electric telescopic rod to tidy the paperboards, so that the paperboards are tidy, the paperboard deformation caused in the tidying process of the paperboards is avoided, the manual tidying is needed again, and the subsequent packing efficiency is affected.

title_en: Pay-off is used in power cord processing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of power line processing and discloses a pay-off device for power line processing, which comprises a base, wherein a first mounting groove is formed in the upper surface of the base, a fixed seat is fixedly connected to the outer wall of the base, a first motor is fixedly connected to the top of the fixed seat, a two-way screw rod is fixedly connected to the driving end of the first motor, movable rods are connected to the left side and the right side of the outer portion of the two-way screw rod in a threaded manner, a first bevel gear is fixedly connected to the left end and the right end of the two-way screw rod, supporting seats are fixedly connected to the left side and the right side of the base, and threaded rods are connected to the middle portions of the two supporting seats in a threaded manner. According to the utility model, the pay-off rack is automatically detached and replaced, so that the labor force is saved, the continuous processing of the power line is facilitated, the semi-automatic effect is achieved, the power line can be prevented from falling off from the exterior of the pay-off rack in the pay-off process, and the normal running of the pay-off work is ensured.

title_en: Paying-off device for LED module bonding wire procedure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a paying-off device for a wire bonding process of an LED module, and aims to solve the technical problem that the production efficiency of the LED module is low because the existing paying-off device cannot meet the requirement of PCB wire bonding. The paying-off device mainly comprises a paying-off frame, wherein a plurality of wire winding drums for winding and paying-off wires are arranged on the paying-off frame, and one end of each wire is pulled to enable the wire winding drum to rotate so as to realize paying-off action; one side of the pay-off rack is provided with a traction component for traction of the wire, and one end of the wire on the wire coiling roller passes through the wire door and is then pulled by the traction component. According to the utility model, the plurality of winding drums are arranged on the pay-off rack, one ends of the wires on the winding drums penetrate through the wire door and are pulled by the pulling assembly to realize paying-off, so that the wire bonding requirement of a PCB is met, and the wire bonding efficiency is greatly improved.

title_en: Induction type button assembly and operation panel
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an induction type button assembly and an operation panel, wherein the induction type button assembly comprises a circuit board, a shell and a first isolation piece; the circuit board is provided with a button area, the button area is provided with at least one receiving lamp and a plurality of transmitting lamps, and the plurality of transmitting lamps are arranged around the periphery of the at least one receiving lamp; the shell is covered on the circuit board and is provided with an avoidance port which is arranged opposite to the button area; the first isolating piece is connected to the shell and sleeved on the receiving lamp and/or the transmitting lamp so as to isolate the receiving lamp from the transmitting lamp. According to the technical scheme, the triggering range of the induction type button assembly can be increased, and the risk that the first isolating piece is easy to fall off to cause unreliable performance can be reduced.

title_en: Detachable double-bearing-seat structure for pulley support of large hoisting machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a detachable double-bearing seat structure for a pulley bracket of a large hoisting machine, which comprises a pulley bracket, wherein a beam for supporting a rope outlet pulley is arranged on the pulley bracket; an upper bearing seat I and a lower bearing seat I are correspondingly arranged on the cross beam; an upper U-shaped groove positioning interface is machined on the bottom surface of the upper bearing seat I, and the upper bearing seat I is embedded and installed at a preset position on the cross beam through the upper U-shaped groove positioning interface and then welded and fixed; the upper surface of the lower bearing seat I is provided with a lower U-shaped groove positioning interface, and the lower bearing seat I is embedded and installed below the cross beam and below the upper bearing seat I through the lower U-shaped groove positioning interface. During installation, the upper bearing seat I is still fixed and is welded and fixed with the pulley support beam, the lower bearing seat I is changed into a loose piece type, the matching dimension and shape precision between the bearing seats is ensured through the connection and the reset of the locating pins, and the upper bearing seat and the lower bearing seat are connected together through bolts, so that the locking is reliable.

title_en: Novel electronic tray trimmer
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of storage, and discloses a novel electric tray shaping machine, which comprises a fixed frame, wherein a front driving motor, a rear driving motor and a front guide rail are respectively arranged at the top of an upper plate of the fixed frame, the front driving motor and the rear driving motor are connected with a front screw rod and a rear screw rod through cone pulley mechanisms, front and rear connecting rod mechanisms are arranged on the outer walls of the front screw rod and the rear screw rod, and front and rear clamping shafts are connected to the bottoms of the front and rear connecting rod mechanisms. This novel electronic tray trimmer is positive and negative lead screw's setting through front and back lead screw and control lead screw for realize two-way removal work through a power, improved the efficiency of whole work then, and be favorable to reducing energy consumption, make simultaneously in the plastic process, both sides and left and right sides keep the center counterpoint around, and then improved the practicality, replace current pneumatics through electronic simultaneously, effectively avoided starting the impact that leads to and made the condition that the tray damaged easily.

title_en: Microbial fertilizer production loading attachment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a microbial fertilizer production feeding device, which belongs to the technical field of microbial fertilizer production and comprises a base, a screening cylinder and a driving assembly, wherein the top end of the base is provided with a feeding assembly, the feeding assembly comprises a supporting seat, the supporting seat is connected to the top end of the base, one end of the screening cylinder is rotationally connected with the supporting seat, the inner side wall of the screening cylinder is connected with a spiral guide plate, one end of the spiral guide plate extends to the inside of the supporting seat, the top end of the supporting seat is connected with a feeding hopper, the inner side wall of the feeding hopper is rotationally connected with a rotating shaft, the outer part of the rotating shaft is equally connected with a plurality of separation plates, one end of the rotating shaft penetrates through the feeding hopper and is connected with a belt pulley, one end of the spiral guide plate penetrates through the supporting seat and is connected with the belt pulley, and the bottom end of the feeding hopper is provided with a through groove. The utility model has the advantages of avoiding equipment clogging, ensuring normal use of equipment, improving the processing effect of the equipment and reducing the maintenance and cleaning burden of a user.

title_en: Prevent dairy products packagine machine who emptys
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a dairy product packaging machine capable of preventing toppling, which comprises the following components: the device comprises a mounting plate, a feeding port for feeding is arranged at the left end of the mounting plate, a packaging mechanism is arranged on the inner side of the mounting plate, a first conveying belt is arranged on the lower side of the inner part of the packaging mechanism, and a second conveying belt arranged in the mounting plate is arranged on the right side of the first conveying belt; the clamping mechanism is arranged on the outer side of the second conveying belt, a limiting mechanism arranged in the mounting plate is arranged on the upper side of the second conveying belt, a conveying wheel is arranged on the inner side of the second conveying belt, an engagement wheel is arranged at the front end of the conveying wheel, a driving wheel is arranged on the left side of the engagement wheel, engagement teeth are arranged on the outer side of the engagement teeth, and the limiting mechanism comprises a limiting plate, a limiting rod and an adjusting rod. This prevent dairy product packagine machine who emptys can prevent that dairy products from taking place to empty, and can adjust intermittent type pay-off's frequency to it is required to adapt to different production efficiency.

title_en: Rotor sheet feeding device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of motor assembly, in particular to a rotor sheet feeding device which is provided with a frame, and further comprises a plurality of bin plates which are arranged in the frame and are transversely arranged in parallel, a driving mechanism for synchronously driving the bin plates to transversely move, a production line arranged at a discharging opening of the frame, a material shifting mechanism for pushing rotor sheets on the bin plates onto the production line one by one, and a material distributing mechanism arranged at the end part of the production line far away from the frame; the rotor sheet feeding device provided by the utility model has the advantages of simple structural design and high efficiency, and can be compatible with different types of rotor sheets.

title_en: Shell mould fork truck
