abstract_en: The utility model relates to a shell mold forklift, which comprises a movable frame, wherein a fork rod is loaded on the movable frame, a fork head is arranged at the end head of the fork rod, an axial rotating device and a radial rotating device are arranged on the movable frame, the axial rotating device can control the fork rod to rotate on the same plane, and the radial rotating device can control the fork rod to rotate up and down. When the movable frame is used, the fork head is utilized to fork the shell mold, the fork rod and the shell mold are controlled to turn through the radial rotating device, in the whole operation, the distance and the angle of the fork head can be adjusted through the movement of the movable frame and the swinging of the axial rotating device, the movable frame is convenient and practical, most of the weight of the shell mold is born by the fork rod in the whole process, the movable frame is supported by the movement, the working strength of a forking mold worker is greatly reduced, the forking stability of the shell mold is enhanced, molten steel is not easy to spill, the safety of the forking mold worker is guaranteed, and the forming quality of a casting piece is guaranteed.

title_en: Hat metalwork packing tray
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of packaging, in particular to a packaging tray for hat metal parts, wherein a plurality of positioning convex blocks are arranged on the upper surface of the packaging tray, and gaps are reserved between two adjacent positioning convex blocks; when packaging, the cap metal piece is buckled on the positioning protruding block, the positioning protruding block is positioned in the cap metal piece and is contacted with the inner surface of the cap metal piece, and the cap metal piece and the side wall of the packaging tray are not contacted between the cap metal pieces. The utility model has simple structure and convenient package, can avoid bad appearance of the cap contact piece caused by package and transportation, and improves the product quality.

title_en: U-shaped drag chain system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a U-shaped drag chain system, which comprises a drag chain and a winding device for winding and unwinding the drag chain; the device also comprises a drag chain guide rail and a slewing base; the drag chain guide rail is integrally arranged in a U shape and is broken in the middle of the arc section of the drag chain guide rail to be divided into a left half rail and a right half rail; the drag chain guide rail comprises a C-shaped groove with an open end and a cross section, and the opening direction of the C-shaped groove is horizontal and is far away from the circle center of the circular arc section; the drag chain is placed in the C-shaped groove in a posture that the width direction of the drag chain is vertical, and two ends of the drag chain are respectively connected to the winding device and the working device running along the running track; the swivel base is fixedly installed at the break; the winding device is connected to the rotating base. The utility model can adapt to the U-shaped running track of the working device and meet the requirement of providing wired transmission for the working device.

title_en: Roller way conveyer belt convenient for conveying multiple trays
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a roller way conveying belt convenient for conveying multiple trays, which comprises a first linear conveying belt, a first supporting frame, a second linear conveying belt, a second supporting frame, conveying rollers, a first arc-shaped conveying belt, a third supporting frame, a second arc-shaped conveying belt and a fourth conveying frame, wherein the first linear conveying belt is provided with the first supporting frame, the first linear conveying belt is connected with the second linear conveying belt, the second linear conveying belt is fixedly connected with the second supporting frame, the conveying rollers are arranged in the second linear conveying belt, mounting jacks are formed in the second linear conveying belt, a counter is arranged at the end of the conveying rollers, and foreign matter sensors are arranged on the conveying rollers. According to the utility model, through the combination of the plurality of linear conveying belts and the plurality of arc conveying belts, more use scenes can be satisfied, and the whole conveying line can be used in multiple scenes in multiple places through the quick connection of the plurality of mounting jacks and the inserting rods, so that the use rate is improved.

title_en: Blood management system
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of blood management, and particularly relates to a blood management system which comprises a basket loading mechanism, a blood warehouse, a blood sending mechanism, an empty basket temporary storage mechanism and at least three conveying mechanisms; the basket loading mechanism comprises a sorting device, the empty basket temporary storage mechanism is used for providing an empty basket for the sorting device, and the sorting device sorts blood bags and loads the blood bags into the empty basket; the at least three conveying mechanisms comprise a first conveying mechanism, a second conveying mechanism and a third conveying mechanism, the first conveying mechanism is located between the basket loading mechanism and the blood bank, the second conveying mechanism is located between the blood bank and the blood sending mechanism, and the third conveying mechanism is located between the blood sending mechanism and the empty basket temporary storage mechanism, so that an empty basket formed after the blood sending mechanism sends out blood bags is transported to the empty basket temporary storage mechanism for storage, closed-loop management is achieved, and the automation degree of a blood management system is effectively improved.

title_en: Plate receiving device of automatic calcium silicate plate production line
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a plate connecting device of an automatic calcium silicate plate production line, which comprises: the support plate is arranged below the frame; the moving device is arranged at the top end of the frame, and the bottom end of the moving device penetrates through the lower part of the frame; wherein, the mobile device comprises a plate receiving mechanism arranged at the top end of the frame; through setting up fishplate bar mechanism, the output of second motor drives two sockets through taking the second lead screw and moves towards the centre, until two sockets entangle the calcium silicate board from the both sides of calcium silicate board, the output shaft of first motor drives the fly leaf through first lead screw thread and moves towards the right side, until the calcium silicate board moves to the top of layer board put down can to can hold up the calcium silicate board and remove.

title_en: Feeding device for coreless winding machine
abstract_en: The utility model provides a feeding device for a coreless winding machine, which comprises a supporting frame and a conveying mechanism, wherein a driving piece is vertically arranged on the top surface of the supporting frame through a connecting component, a compression plate is arranged on a piston rod of the driving piece, a film to be processed is conveyed through the conveying mechanism, after conveying is stopped, the driving piece is started, and the driving piece drives the compression plate to move to compress the film. The utility model reduces the possibility of rotating the film wound on the unwinding shaft when the coreless winding machine cuts the film.

title_en: Elevator with platform stably rises and prevents rocking structure
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of lifting platforms, in particular to a lifter with a stable lifting anti-shaking structure of a platform, aiming at the problem that the existing lifter is not provided with a protection structure, personnel or articles on the platform fall off the platform easily in the use process to cause casualties, and the personnel below the platform can be injured by the articles falling off the platform in a smashing manner, so that potential safety hazards exist.

title_en: Silica gel sleeve with good corner anti-collision performance
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a silica gel sleeve with good corner anti-collision performance, which comprises a fixed frame and a silica gel inner sleeve, wherein an inner frame of the fixed frame is fixedly connected with the silica gel inner sleeve, the top and the bottom of two sides of the fixed frame are fixedly connected with arc-shaped elastic blocks, a sealing sleeve is fixedly connected to the outer part of each arc-shaped elastic block and positioned on the surface of the fixed frame, a through hole is formed in the middle of the surface of each arc-shaped elastic block, and a sealing tube is communicated with an inner cavity of the through hole on the surface of each arc-shaped elastic block. This silica gel cover that corner anticollision performance is good can strengthen the protective capability of treating protective apparatus by a wide margin, lets elasticity and crashproof ability of this silica gel cover strengthen by a wide margin, and very big reinforcing its resistance moreover possesses resistance and elasticity simultaneously, can also carry out good fixing to the protective apparatus that waits therein when guaranteeing certain elasticity, makes it fix more stable under the prerequisite of guaranteeing crashproof elasticity performance.

title_en: Self-cleaning rubber anti-slip conveyer belt
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of mechanical cleaning, and discloses a self-cleaning rubber anti-skid conveyor belt, which comprises: the bottom plate, the top fixed mounting of bottom plate has the supporting shoe, the inner wall fixed mounting of supporting shoe has the fixed column, the outward flange movable mounting of fixed column has the support bar. This kind of self-cleaning rubber antiskid conveyer belt, then take out the outlet pipe the inside with the water in the storage water tank through the suction pump, then spray the conveyer belt with water through the shower nozzle on the spray pipe, then drive the belt through first motor and rotate thereby drive spacing round and rotate, thereby drive the pivot and rotate, thereby drive the cleaning brush and rotate, thereby wash the conveyer belt of top, the fixed plate on the second fixed block can carry out high regulation to belt cleaning device through the hydraulic stem on the first fixed block, the setting of this structure can wash the spot on the conveyer belt effectively, thereby reach the problem that prevents that the spot on conveyer belt surface from cumulating and influencing the use.

title_en: Double-station feeding and discharging combined connecting line mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a double-station feeding and discharging combined connecting mechanism which comprises a rack, wherein a feeding conveying frame which transversely extends is fixed at the front part of the top surface of a top plate of the rack, and a discharging conveying frame which transversely extends is fixed at the rear part of the top surface of the top plate of the rack; a first transfer device is fixed on the top surface of the top plate of the rack at the left part between the feeding conveying frame and the discharging conveying frame, and a second transfer device is arranged on the top surface of the top plate of the rack at the middle part between the feeding conveying frame and the discharging conveying frame; the automatic feeding device comprises a feeding conveying frame, a discharging conveying frame, a first transferring device and a second transferring device, wherein a robot or automatic processing equipment can be installed at a frame corresponding to an operation horizontal plate of the first transferring device and an operation horizontal plate of the second transferring device, and materials of the feeding conveying frame can be pushed to the corresponding operation horizontal plate to be automatically operated.

title_en: Folding container
abstract_en: The utility model provides a folding container, which relates to the technical field of pet appliances and comprises a first bowl body, a second bowl body and a folding part, wherein the folding part is connected between the first bowl body and the second bowl body; the first bowl body is provided with a first connecting part, the second bowl body is provided with a second connecting part, and the first bowl body and the second bowl body are in a folding state and an unfolding state along the folding part; in the folded state, the second bowl body covers the first bowl body, and the first connecting part and the second connecting part are detachably connected; in the unfolded state, the first bowl body and the second bowl body are oppositely arranged; the technical problems that in the prior art, the external fixing piece and the folding bowl body are in a separated state, the disassembly process is complex, and hidden danger of losing the external fixing piece exists are solved, and the technical effect of bringing convenience to carry of the device is achieved.

title_en: Charging tank for biological fermentation of tobacco
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a charging tank for biological fermentation of tobacco, which comprises a tank body, wherein the tank body is provided with an outer wall and an inner wall, a water filling interlayer is arranged between the outer wall and the inner wall, the top of the tank body is communicated with a feed inlet, and a stirring paddle is arranged inside the tank body; the upper part of the outer side wall of the tank body is provided with a water inlet pipeline, the lower part of the outer side wall of the tank body is provided with a water outlet pipeline, and the water inlet pipeline is communicated with the water filling interlayer; the bottom of the tank body is communicated with a discharging pipe, a steam pipeline is communicated with the discharging pipe, the tail end of the steam pipeline is communicated with a steam generator, and a rotary spray head is arranged in the tank body. Cooling water is introduced into the water filling interlayer of the charging tank, so that the temperature of the feed liquid can be reduced to below 15 ℃, and the feed liquid can be effectively prevented from losing activity in advance under the condition of long-time high temperature in the feed liquid application process and the waiting process before application. Meanwhile, the inside of the tank body is cleaned through the rotary spray head and sterilized under the action of high-temperature steam, and the tank body is purged completely under the action of compressed air, so that the mixed bacteria pollution caused by the residual of a small amount of feed liquid can be effectively prevented.

title_en: Pneumatic clamping device of grabbing type box filling machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pneumatic clamping device of a grabbing type box filling machine, and relates to the field of grabbing type box filling machines. The utility model discloses a bottle cap, which is characterized in that a pneumatic cavity formed by a piston and a sealing cover is communicated with the outside, positive pressure or negative pressure is input through an air hole, the piston can move up and down, and further clamping or releasing of clamping jaws is controlled. In addition, the effect of quick position adjustment can be realized through the design of the connecting structure between the pneumatic clamp and the positioning plate, and clamping type boxing of glass bottles with different sizes can be realized only by replacing the positioning plates with different positioning holes.

title_en: Sterilizing article packing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sterilizing article packaging device which comprises a supporting plate, a conveying mechanism used for conveying sterilizing articles and a clamping mechanism used for clamping packaging bags, wherein the conveying mechanism is positioned above the supporting plate. The beneficial effects are that: the first electric push rods on two sides drive the sliding frame to slide in the sliding rail, the longitudinal hot melt cutters on two sides are driven to move in opposite directions, the front side and the rear side of the packaging bag of the sterilized article are sealed, the packaging bag is opened in an upper side, the sterilized article falls into the packaging bag, then the third electric push rods on two sides push the longitudinal hot melt cutters to slide downwards on the sliding frame, the second electric push rods on two sides push the transverse hot melt cutters on two sides to move in opposite directions, and then the upper port of the packaging bag is sealed and sheared, so that the packaging process of the sterilized article is completed, manual packaging work is replaced, a large amount of manpower and material resources are saved, and the packaging efficiency is improved.

title_en: Textile winding machine for textile workshop
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a textile winding machine for a textile workshop, which comprises a base, supporting legs, fixing blocks, a wire releasing roller, a sliding chute and a sliding frame, wherein the supporting legs are fixedly arranged at the lower end of the base, the fixing blocks are fixedly arranged at the upper end of the base, the wire releasing roller is arranged at the outer side of the fixing blocks, textile wires are wound at the outer side of the wire releasing roller, the tail end of each textile wire is wound at the outer side of the corresponding wire collecting roller, the sliding chute is formed in the inner side of the base, the sliding frame is nested in the inner side of the sliding chute, the wire collecting roller is arranged at the outer side of the sliding frame, a supporting frame is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the base, and a threaded rod is connected at the outer side of the supporting frame. This weaving workshop is with weaving coiling machine runs through between first clamp splice and the second clamp splice with the textile thread, appears the condition that the tensioning force is not enough when the textile thread in the rolling, through rotating the threaded rod to make the first clamp splice of threaded rod downwardly extrusion, drive the textile thread and move down, thereby make the textile thread be in tight state, make the better rolling of textile thread in the take-up roller outside.

title_en: Winding device for packaging FCOB neon lamp strip
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a winding device for packaging an FCOB neon lamp strip, which comprises a workbench, wherein the lower end of the workbench is fixedly connected with four groups of support legs, one side of each support leg is provided with a winding mechanism, one side, close to the winding mechanism, of the interior of the workbench is provided with an auxiliary assembly, the winding mechanism comprises a first motor fixedly connected to the inner wall of the upper side of the workbench, the upper end of a rotating shaft of the first motor is fixedly connected with a tray, the upper end of the tray is fixedly connected with a circular tube, the outer sides of the circular tube are fixedly connected with two groups of limiting strips, and the outer sides of the circular tube and the two groups of limiting strips are movably sleeved with a winding drum. According to the winding device for packaging the FCOB neon lamp strip, disclosed by the utility model, the winding can be rapidly and easily performed through automatic winding, less labor force is output, the working winding efficiency is improved, and the winding of different lamp strips and modes can be completed through the use of the winding mechanism and the auxiliary assembly.

title_en: Lifting device for constructional engineering
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a lifting device for constructional engineering, which belongs to the technical field of constructional engineering auxiliary equipment and comprises a base and a supporting upright post, wherein the bottom of the supporting upright post is welded at the center of the base; the hoisting motor hoistes the hoisting wire rope, and the hoisting wire rope hangs down from the hoisting motor to the pulley. The utility model has the advantages of simple structure, shaping processing, high rigidity, good stability, turnover use, high safety coefficient, quick and convenient processing, quick and convenient operation, labor saving, larger bearing capacity, and can be used for building construction, house reconstruction and factory transportation at each stage.

title_en: Wrapping paper cladding device
abstract_en: A wrapper cladding apparatus comprising: the packaging machine comprises a packaging paper supply device, a packaging paper conveying mechanism, a material conveying device, a cladding device and a control assembly; the cladding device includes: the coating device mounting frame and the second conveying device; a first conveying device and a deflector rod driving device are fixedly arranged on the wrapping device mounting frame, and a wrapping paper deflector rod is slidably arranged on the wrapping device mounting frame; the driving device of the deflector rod is used for driving the deflector rod of the packaging paper to circularly move around the first conveying device; the front end of the second conveying device is opposite to the rear end of the first conveying device; the coating device mounting frame is fixedly provided with a fourth sensor, is positioned above the front end of the first conveying device and is opposite to the first conveying device; the material conveying device is used for supplying materials to the first conveying device; the packing paper conveying mechanism is used for conveying the packing paper on the packing paper feeding device to the first conveying device; the automatic wrapping machine disclosed by the utility model realizes automatic wrapping of the wrapping paper, does not need manual wrapping, and reduces the labor intensity of workers while improving the wrapping efficiency.

title_en: Novel automatic cutting and collecting integrated device for sheet cigarette binding belt
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a novel automatic belt shearing and collecting integrated device for a sheet cigarette binding belt. The device mainly comprises a shearing and belt collecting integrated mechanism, an XYZ coordinate three-axis sliding table mechanism, a sheet tobacco smoke box, a roller wheel conveyor, a box jacking cylinder mechanism and a ribbon collecting box, wherein the shearing and belt collecting integrated mechanism is arranged on a Y-axis linear movement module of the XYZ coordinate three-axis sliding table mechanism and is arranged on one side of the roller wheel conveyor, the sheet tobacco smoke box is placed on the roller wheel conveyor for conveying, the box jacking cylinder mechanism is placed at the bottom of the roller wheel conveyor and is used for jacking the sheet tobacco smoke box, and the ribbon collecting box is placed on one side of the XYZ coordinate three-axis sliding table mechanism. The device can realize the cutting and collecting of the bands of the tobacco flake box, wherein the clamping and cutting of the bands are realized by adopting one drive, so that the cost is saved; compared with the existing mechanism, the mechanism has the advantages of simple structure, high working efficiency, low manufacturing and maintenance cost and the like.

title_en: High strength resistance to compression carton
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-strength compression-resistant carton, and belongs to the technical field of cartons; including the carton body, carton body top is equipped with first top apron, second top apron respectively, the carton body is equipped with the arc respectively in the outside all around, fixedly connected with a plurality of horizontal support bars between arc and the carton body, this internal bottom interval of carton is provided with a plurality of vertical support bars, vertical support bar top fixedly connected with backup pad, carton body bottom is equipped with a plurality of scute. According to the utility model, the compressive strength of the side surface of the carton can be enhanced through the arrangement of the arc-shaped plates and the transverse supporting strips, the compressive strength of the bottom of the carton can be enhanced through the arrangement of the vertical supporting strips and the supporting plates, and the four sides of the bottom of the carton are reinforced through the arrangement of the corner plates, so that the carton is not easy to deform, and the compressive effect of the carton is further enhanced.

title_en: Coal scraping plate structure of scraper
abstract_en: The utility model provides a coal scraping plate structure of a scraper. A coal scraping plate structure of a scraper machine, comprising: the device comprises two connecting pieces, wherein a base is arranged between the two connecting pieces, the base is connected with the two connecting pieces through two bolts, a scraping plate is arranged on one side of the base, a clamping mechanism is arranged on the base, and the scraping plate is connected with the clamping mechanism. The coal scraping plate structure of the scraper machine has the advantages of being convenient to replace, reducing blocking probability and improving operation stability of the scraper machine.

title_en: Material basket with hidden cover plate structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a basket with a hidden cover plate structure, which relates to the technical field of baskets and aims to solve the problem that when materials are in a slender shape, materials exceeding eighty lengths are difficult to be horizontally placed in a frame body with a conventional size, the obliquely placed slender materials are easy to collide with a basket during transportation so as to damage the basket, a first side plate is arranged on the front side and the rear side above a bottom plate respectively, a second side plate is arranged on the left side and the right side above the bottom plate respectively, an adjusting plate is arranged between the first side plate and the second side plate, a cover plate is rotatably arranged on one side of the first side plate through a hinge, four corners above the bottom plate and the middle positions around the bottom plate are respectively connected with the outer parts of the first side plate and the adjusting plate or the outer parts of the second side plate and the adjusting plate through bottom plate connecting blocks, and the inner sides of the first side plate and the adjusting plate or the inner sides of the second side plate and the adjusting plate are connected through positioning mechanisms.

title_en: Large-scale tower section of thick bamboo sheet anti-deformation lifts by crane and transports frock
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of lifting devices and discloses a large tower barrel sheet deformation-preventing lifting transferring tool which comprises a lifting hook, a first steel wire rope and a second steel wire rope, wherein the lifting hook hooks the first steel wire rope and the second steel wire rope at the same time, and the first steel wire rope and the second steel wire rope are symmetrically arranged along the lifting hook. The sheet lifting device has the universality of lifting sheets of various materials, and effectively avoids the problem of lifting slip deformation.

title_en: Lifting machine for glass manufacturing
abstract_en: The utility model provides a lifter for glass manufacturing, which comprises a supporting seat, wherein a worm is connected between inner walls at two sides of the supporting seat through a bearing, a first motor is axially fixed at the right end of the worm penetrating through the supporting seat, a worm wheel is connected with the inner wall at the top of the supporting seat through a bearing, the worm wheel is meshed with the worm, a rotary table is arranged above the supporting seat, a rotary shaft is fixed at the bottom of the rotary table, the bottom of the rotary shaft is fixedly connected with the worm wheel, a mounting block is fixedly connected onto the rotary table, a lifting support is hinged onto the mounting block, a screw rod is rotationally connected onto the lifting support, a second motor is axially fixed at the upper end of the screw rod penetrating through the lifting support, a connecting block is connected onto the screw rod through threads, limiting devices are arranged at the left side and the right side of the connecting block, and a limiting seat is fixed at the top of the connecting block. The device can flexibly adjust the lifting support according to the use condition, improves the practicability of following the utility model, can simultaneously lift and convey multiple groups of glass, reduces the working time and improves the working efficiency.

title_en: Paper wrapping mechanism of printed matter packer
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of paper wrapping mechanisms, in particular to a paper wrapping mechanism of a printed matter packing machine, which comprises a base, wherein a clamping mechanism for positioning printed matters is arranged on the front side, the rear side and the upper side of the base, and the clamping mechanism comprises a sliding groove; the screw, the upright rods and the clamping plates are arranged, so that the front clamping plate and the rear clamping plate move in opposite directions at the same time, and the printed product to be packed is clamped from front to back, and is kept still at the center of the circular ring, so that the subsequent stable packing treatment is realized; through setting up track groove, gear and ring gear, inlay under the spacing of spacing groove at the spacing ring, make the panel at the stable rotation of track inslot, drive the paper roll that is held by the extension board around fluting rotary motion, simultaneously with the outside wrapping paper direct winding of paper roll in printed matter outside, accomplish the paper wrapping operation, improved the efficiency of paper wrapping processing.

title_en: Automatic flanging device for cosmetic cotton
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic flanging device for cosmetic cotton, which belongs to the technical field of textile processing apparatuses and comprises a first supporting plate, wherein a first conveying roller is arranged at the upper end of the side edge of the first supporting plate, a second conveying roller is arranged at the lower end of the side edge of the first supporting plate, metal rings are arranged on the surfaces of the first conveying roller and the second conveying roller, and tooth rings are arranged on the surfaces of a group of metal rings.

title_en: Prevent lifting machine for cable processing of landing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cable processing elevator capable of preventing slipping, which comprises an underframe, wherein supporting rods are respectively arranged at four corners of the underframe, the supporting rods are fixedly connected with the underframe, a driving device is arranged at the top end of each supporting rod, a lifting table is arranged above the underframe, and a clamping device is arranged on each lifting table; clamping device includes baffle, connecting rod, sliding block, threaded rod, rotates the motor, and the elevating platform top is located to the baffle, baffle bottom and connecting rod fixed connection, and the connecting rod below is equipped with the sliding block, and the inside sliding hole that is equipped with of sliding block, threaded rod pass the sliding hole and rotate the motor and be connected, threaded rod one end and base fixed connection, base and mounting bracket fixed connection, mounting bracket fixed connection are in the elevating platform bottom. Through the design of the cable processing elevator capable of preventing slipping, the clamping device is arranged on the lifting platform, so that the cable can be kept stable and is not easy to slip off, and the lifting mode of the lifting platform is changed, so that the lifting platform is more stable to lift.

title_en: Material tray
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a material tray which is used for loading a pipe body, wherein the pipe body is provided with a protruding piece; the charging tray comprises a charging tray main body, a plurality of installation spaces are arranged on the charging tray main body at intervals, each installation space comprises two corresponding first limit grooves and two corresponding second limit grooves, two ends of the pipe body are respectively movably arranged in the two first limit grooves, and the protruding piece is movably accommodated in the second limit grooves. Through setting up a charging tray, two first spacing grooves are arranged in at the both ends of every body, and the protruding part of body holds in the second spacing groove, consequently the body can set up the body on the charging tray fast firmly, also makes things convenient for the clamp of body to get, carry and shift, has improved the speed of body production and processing widely for the production progress of body, the practicality is high.

title_en: Unloading and conveying device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of conveying devices, in particular to a car unloading and conveying device, which comprises a conveying frame, wherein the conveying frame is provided with a conveying channel, sliding rails are arranged on two sides of the conveying channel, a bearing plate for bearing articles to be unloaded is arranged on the sliding rails in a sliding manner, the sliding rails are provided with guide channels, and the bearing plate is provided with a connecting part which can extend into the guide channels so that the bearing plate slides on the sliding rails. According to the utility model, the hopper of the truck can be connected with the ground through the obliquely arranged conveying frame, and the articles to be unloaded can be placed on the bearing plate, so that the articles can slide down to the ground on the sliding rail of the conveying frame, the articles are not required to be manually moved down, and the manpower consumption and the required time are reduced.

title_en: Negative pressure gas circuit connection structure of pad pasting mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a negative pressure air path connecting structure of a film sticking mechanism, which comprises a connecting plate, a fixed seat, a rotary driving assembly for controlling the fixed seat to rotate and a film absorbing plate assembly arranged below the fixed seat; the connecting plate is provided with a negative pressure air passage front section, the rotary driving assembly is internally provided with a negative pressure air passage middle section, the fixing seat is internally provided with a negative pressure air passage rear section, and the film absorbing plate assembly is internally provided with a negative pressure cavity; the negative pressure air passage front section, the negative pressure air passage middle section, the negative pressure air passage rear section and the negative pressure cavity are sequentially communicated to form a negative pressure air passage. Through set up hidden negative pressure gas circuit in connecting plate, rotary drive subassembly, fixing base and film-absorbing plate subassembly to reduce the use of pipeline, simplified the gas circuit structure of pad pasting mechanism, avoided the pipeline to appear buckling, winding, cracked problem, improved equipment reliability, also reduced the whole volume of equipment simultaneously.

title_en: Assembled building board hoist device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of hoisting devices, in particular to an assembled building board hoisting device, which comprises a hoisting base, wherein a hoisting disc is arranged at the top of the hoisting base, a transmission disc is arranged in the middle of the top of the hoisting disc, a connecting belt is arranged on the side of the transmission disc, a rotating shaft is arranged at the end part of the connecting belt, a connecting handle is connected with the side of the rotating shaft, an electric telescopic rod is arranged at the top of the transmission disc, a hanging rod is connected with the end part of the electric telescopic rod, a steel wire rope is connected with the end part of the hanging rod, a building board hoisting box is arranged at the end part of the steel wire rope, a threaded rod penetrates through the top of the building board hoisting box, and a fixed disc is connected with the end part of the threaded rod; according to the utility model, the lifting angle is manually adjusted, so that the lifting angle is convenient to adaptively adjust, and the dangerous situation that the building board slides easily in the lifting process of the building board can be reduced through the arrangement of the fixed disc.

title_en: Loading attachment with high compatibility regulatory function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of transportation production, in particular to a feeding device with a high-compatibility adjusting function. The feeding device comprises a mounting seat, a belt conveying assembly, a width adjusting mechanism and a lifting mechanism. Two brackets are arranged on the mounting seat in parallel and at intervals, and each bracket is provided with a belt conveying assembly which is used for supporting and conveying products. The width adjusting mechanism is arranged on the mounting seat and used for adjusting the distance between the two belt conveying assemblies, the width adjusting mechanism comprises a linear driving assembly, an output end of the linear driving assembly is connected with a support, the linear driving assembly drives the support to move on the mounting seat, the two supports are close to or far away from each other, and further the feeding device is applicable to transportation of products with different sizes. The lifting mechanism comprises a lifting driving piece, and the output end of the lifting driving piece is connected with the mounting seat to drive the mounting seat to move up and down. Namely, the height of the feeding end and the discharging end of the feeding device can be adjusted, so that the feeding device can be in bearing fit with other devices with different heights.

title_en: Special lifting appliance for ship unloader to load and unload bags
abstract_en: The utility model provides a special lifting appliance for loading and unloading bags of a ship unloader, and relates to the technical field of port lifting. According to the utility model, after the grab bucket of the original ship unloader is dismantled, the device is mounted on the ship unloader, 2, 4, 6 and 8 bags of ton bags of goods can be lifted once through a plurality of lifting ropes matched with the lifting hooks after the proper lifting hooks are mounted at the bottoms of the lifting ropes, and then the lifting frame mechanism is driven by the ship unloader matched with the connecting component to directly lift, move and discharge the ton bags of goods, so that the cooperation of an excavator and a forklift is not needed, a part of loading and unloading personnel is omitted, the cost is effectively reduced, and the efficiency is improved.

title_en: Cold rolling accurate seamless steel pipe material loading anchor clamps
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a feeding clamp for a cold-rolled precise seamless steel tube. The technical key points are as follows: the utility model relates to a clamping frame and a connecting mechanism arranged on the upper side of the clamping frame, wherein the connecting mechanism is connected with a portal frame, the inside of the clamping frame is a clamping space, one side of the clamping frame is provided with an opening, the opening is communicated with the clamping space, the opening of the clamping frame is provided with a sealing mechanism, an inner flexible buffer layer is arranged in the clamping space, and an outer flexible buffer layer is arranged on one side of the sealing mechanism, which faces the clamping space.

title_en: Low stress sensitive Mn-Zn ferrite magnetic core
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a low-stress sensitive manganese-zinc ferrite magnetic core which comprises a protective box body, a buffer placing inner box, a first movable rod and a second movable rod, wherein the buffer placing inner box is arranged in the protective box body, and the bottom of the buffer placing inner box is symmetrically and movably connected with the first movable rod. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the first movable rod, the first sliding sleeve, the first sliding rod, the first spring, the second movable rod, the second sliding sleeve, the second sliding rod and the second spring, the stability of movement of the low-stress sensitive Mn-Zn ferrite core body when the low-stress sensitive Mn-Zn ferrite core body is placed in the buffer placement inner box can be ensured, the first spring and the second spring are matched with the first movable rod and the second movable rod, so that the shock force can be buffered when the buffer placement inner box is subjected to external shock, the up-down and left-right shaking force can be buffered, the situation of collision in the process of transporting or transferring the low-stress sensitive Mn-Zn ferrite core body is avoided, and great convenience is brought to the work of staff.

title_en: Clamp rotating device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a clamp rotating device, comprising: the device comprises a mounting seat and a braid, wherein a rotary mechanism is arranged on one side of the mounting seat; the rotating mechanism comprises a rotating cylinder and a rotating seat; the rotary cylinder is fixed on one side of the mounting seat through a bolt, an output shaft of the rotary cylinder is fixedly connected with the rotary seat through a bolt, and the rotary cylinder is used for driving the rotary seat to rotate; the beneficial effects of the utility model are as follows: the rotary cylinder can drive the rotary seat which is connected with the rotary cylinder to rotate, so that the first clamping plate mechanism and the second clamping plate mechanism which are fixed on the rotary seat can rotate along with the rotary seat to achieve the purpose of clamping paper carrier tapes, therefore, the device can clamp the paper carrier tapes which are piled together after one end of the device is produced in a reciprocating manner, and the device is inserted into the receiving rack at the other end of the device in a rotary manner, so that a finished product is separated and packaged, the working efficiency can be accelerated, and the labor cost can be effectively reduced.

title_en: A unloading mechanism for IGBT base plate detects
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a blanking mechanism for detecting an IGBT substrate, which belongs to the technical field of production and transmission, and particularly comprises a second connecting frame, wherein the bottom end of the second connecting frame is fixedly connected with a T-shaped frame, the bottom end of the T-shaped frame is provided with a sucker, and one side of the second connecting frame is provided with an adjusting structure for driving the second connecting frame to carry out position adjustment; the adjusting structure comprises: the utility model can cope with different use scenes, expand the use range and improve the use efficiency by controlling the motor, the motor II drives the connecting frame II, the sucker arranged on the T-shaped frame and the substrate adsorbed on the sucker to adjust the angle.

title_en: Automatic film rolling device for automatically packing uninterruptible power supply cabinet
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of uninterruptible power supply cabinet packaging, in particular to an automatic film rolling device for automatically packing an uninterruptible power supply cabinet, which comprises a rotary table for placing the uninterruptible power supply cabinet, a first driving device for driving the rotary table to rotate, a placing rack for placing a film rolling device and a second driving device for driving the placing rack to vertically move. This application has the problem that can reduce the waste time and the manpower of manual winding roll film.

title_en: Folding type stacking rack
abstract_en: The utility model provides a folding type stacking rack, a structure includes the base, the base bottom surface interval is equipped with two fork truck locating slot, four angles of base up end all are vertical to be equipped with a reference column, the terminal surface is equipped with the rotation constant head tank before the reference column top, the activity of reference column upper end is equipped with the folding leg, adopt the collapsible stacking rack structure of dual mode, during normal use, the folding leg is vertical state with the reference column, can directly place four folding leg inboards with the material, when needing to accomodate the preparation or place low material, but unscrew the restriction bolt, remove the restriction to the hinge pin, can rotate the folding leg, the folding leg rotates ninety degrees with the hinge pin center, the folding leg of control two portions changes to same horizontal line, and the top is relative, magnet piece can be to corresponding iron piece looks actuation, accomplish the location restriction, convenient operation, make the folding of stacking rack be low support body structure, reduce the occupation to the space.

title_en: Mattress processing turning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mattress processing turnover device, which belongs to the field of mattresses, and comprises a base and a vertical frame, wherein the vertical frame is positioned above the base, the vertical frame is U-shaped, a pushing mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the base, the upper part of the pushing mechanism penetrates through the base, the top of the pushing mechanism is connected with the bottom of the vertical frame, a rotating assembly is arranged in the vertical frame, two ends of the rotating assembly penetrate through the left end and the right end of the vertical frame, a power mechanism is arranged on the front surface of the base, the power mechanism is connected with the rotating assembly, and clamping assemblies are arranged at two ends of the rotating assembly. Compared with the turning device in the comparison document, the mattress processing turning device can be connected and matched with an external conveyor so as to finish the automatic turning process of the mattress, does not need manual intervention, and has higher practical value.

title_en: Tobacco leaf material flattening device for conveyor belt
abstract_en: A tobacco leaf material flattening device for a conveyor belt comprises a lower layer conveyor belt and an upper layer conveyor belt, wherein a flattening roller is arranged between the downstream end part of the upper layer conveyor belt and the lower layer conveyor belt, the axial direction of the flattening roller is perpendicular to the axial direction of the upper layer conveyor belt, two rows of material stirring teeth are arranged on the outer surface of the flattening roller, a rotating shaft is fixed at the center of the flattening roller, and the rotating shaft is rotationally connected to a frame and can be driven by a motor. Compared with the prior art, the utility model has the technical effects that the utility model is provided with the spreading roller, if the piled tobacco leaves of the upper layer conveyor belt fall down, part of the piled tobacco leaves are pulled by the pulling teeth and fall late; the other part of the tobacco leaves in the pile is not influenced by the stirring teeth, and the tobacco leaves fall earlier, so that the tobacco leaves in the pile fall on the lower layer conveyor belt in a scattered manner, and the materials are flattened.

title_en: Anti-seize piece conveyor and sorting equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-jamming conveyer and sorting equipment, wherein the anti-jamming conveyer comprises a rack and a group of narrow-band conveying components which are distributed on the rack in a divergent mode, a cover plate is further arranged on the rack, and an avoidance port corresponding to the position of each narrow-band conveying component is formed in the cover plate so that the top surface of the upper layer of a conveying belt of the narrow-band conveying component protrudes out of the top of the cover plate, and the downstream of the output end of each narrow-band conveying component is not provided with a horizontal part of the cover plate. According to the utility model, the avoidance opening is formed on the cover plate, so that the output end of the narrow-band conveying assembly is of an open structure, a gap between the cover plate and the output end of the narrow-band conveying assembly is avoided, the condition of material clamping is effectively avoided, and the stability and safety of sorting are improved.

title_en: Offshore wind turbine generator set hoisting device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hoisting device for an offshore wind turbine, which comprises a hanging bracket, fixing plates and a connecting plate, wherein the fixing plates are fixedly connected to two sides of the bottom of the hanging bracket, a screw rod is connected between the fixing plates at two sides, the left end of the fixing plate at the left side is connected with a positive and negative motor, the output end of the positive and negative motor is connected with the screw rod, two sides of the outer wall of the screw rod are in threaded connection with moving blocks, the bottom ends of the moving blocks at two sides are connected with the connecting plate through a connecting frame, a fifth hydraulic push rod is fixedly connected to the opposite directions of the moving plates at two sides, and the output end of the fifth hydraulic push rod is fixedly connected with a clamping block. The clamping blocks on the two sides are pushed to move relatively through the fifth hydraulic push rod, so that fans of different types are clamped and fixed, the screw is driven to rotate through the positive and negative motor, the moving block of the screw is horizontally moved in a threaded manner, and then the lifting device is driven to move and adjust left and right, so that the installation of the fans is facilitated, and the labor is saved, so that the construction is more convenient.

title_en: Cable processing traction mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cable processing traction mechanism, which comprises a main body and a plurality of clamping assemblies arranged on the inner side of the main body, wherein each clamping assembly consists of a plurality of clamping rollers, symmetrically arranged clamping roller frames and clamping air cylinders, the clamping rollers are arranged between the symmetrically arranged clamping roller frames, and the clamping air cylinders are arranged at the ends of the clamping rollers and the clamping roller frames; through the wearing mechanism of design, improve original cable course of working, when using traction mechanism, because of the tip of clamp roller is direct laminating state with the clamp roller frame, cause the clamp roller when rolling, can produce certain wearing and tearing, through setting up wearing mechanism to the laminating department of clamp roller and clamp roller frame, under the circumstances of guaranteeing normal use, reduce the laminating area of clamp roller and clamp roller frame laminating department, produce wearing and tearing when avoiding using, increase wearability to ensure traction mechanism's life.

title_en: Portable curtain lifting device of movable between building layer
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of curtain wall construction equipment, in particular to portable curtain wall hoisting equipment among floors, which comprises a moving platform, an overhanging component and a hoisting component, wherein the moving platform comprises a frame and a plurality of rollers; the cantilever assembly comprises a first mounting seat, a cantilever hydraulic rod, a pulley mounting seat and a cantilever pulley, wherein the first mounting seat is mounted on the frame, a cylinder body of the cantilever hydraulic rod is rotationally connected to the first mounting seat, the pulley mounting seat is fixedly mounted on a piston rod of the cantilever hydraulic rod, the cantilever pulley is rotationally connected to the pulley mounting seat, the frame is provided with a first driving assembly, and the first driving assembly is used for driving the cylinder body of the cantilever hydraulic rod to rotate; the hoisting assembly comprises a winch, a hoisting rope and a lifting hook, wherein one end of the hoisting rope is wound on a winding drum of the winch, the other end of the hoisting rope is erected on an overhanging pulley, and the lifting hook is arranged on one end of the hoisting rope and erected on the overhanging pulley. This application has the handling curtain of being convenient for to ensure the effect of efficiency of construction.

title_en: Conveyer belt dust collector for mineral processing machinery
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a conveying belt dust removing device for mineral processing machinery, which belongs to the technical field of dust removing equipment and comprises a bottom plate, wherein two groups of symmetrical supporting plates are fixedly connected to the upper surface of the bottom plate, one side surface, close to each other, of each supporting plate is movably connected with a symmetrical rotating roller, belts are wound on the outer surfaces of the two rotating rollers together, symmetrical vertical plates are fixedly connected to the upper surface of the bottom plate, and symmetrical baffle plates are fixedly connected to one side surface, far away from each other, of each vertical plate. Through being provided with the dust-collecting box, replaced the integration dust removal mode of current device, avoided the workman when changing the inside filter mechanism of device, lead to the phenomenon that the device work appears breaking, improved workman and the work efficiency of device by a wide margin, through being provided with the booster pump, can provide required power for the dust removal process of device, avoid the device to appear the phenomenon of dust removal failure because of the power is not enough easily.

title_en: Large-tow carbon fiber precursor doubling device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a large-tow carbon fiber precursor doubling device, which solves the technical problems of uneven thickness, easy bifurcation and rough surface of the existing carbon fiber doubling device after doubling, and is provided with a supporting screw rod and two or more groups of doubling devices, wherein a yarn guide wheel group, a doubling roller group and a doubling ring are sequentially arranged in the doubling devices; the doubling roller set is provided with a primary doubling roller, a first doubling roller, a dancer roller and a second doubling roller; the second doubling roller outlet is provided with a doubling ring, the doubling ring outlet is provided with a supporting screw rod, the supporting screw rod is provided with a transverse frame, and the height of the transverse frame is higher than that of the doubling ring. The utility model can be widely applied to occasions of doubling large-tow carbon fiber precursors.

title_en: Indoor antenna with multiple fixing modes
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of indoor antenna, discloses an indoor antenna with multiple fixed mode, including indoor antenna body, the top fixedly connected with cable of indoor antenna body, the one end fixedly connected with wiring end of cable, the top fixedly connected with bracing piece of indoor antenna body, the top fixedly connected with mounting panel of bracing piece, the outer wall fixedly connected with fixed plate of mounting panel, the second thread groove has been seted up at the top of fixed plate. Through indoor antenna body, cable, mounting panel, fixed plate, fixed column, sealing plug and the threaded rod that set up, press the sucking disc on the ceiling, rotate the threaded rod and drive sealing plug downwardly moving, through atmospheric pressure's effect, realize tightly adsorbing the sucking disc on the ceiling, and then realize that indoor antenna fixed mode is comparatively more, when the ceiling is the material that can not set up the helicla flute such as ceramic tile, plank, also can be convenient install indoor antenna body.

title_en: Box is placed to instrument and equipment for flatcar
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a flat car instrument and equipment placing box which comprises a box body and a cover plate, wherein the cover plate is hinged to the front face of the box body through a hinge, supporting feet are fixed on the left side and the right side of the lower surface of the box body, a placing component used for placing instrument and equipment is arranged in the box body, a telescopic component used for fixing the instrument and equipment is arranged in the box body, the placing component comprises two clamping plates, and a placing plate is connected between the opposite sides of the two clamping plates in a sliding mode. This case is placed to instrument and equipment for flatcar is through will placing the board and pull out from the inside of box, places instrument and equipment on placing the board, promotes to place the board and makes instrument and equipment remove to the inside of box, places the effect that the board played the support through the leading wheel pair, adjusts the height of expansion box according to the size of instrument, promptly through upwards pulling the expansion box, and then adjusts the distance between expansion box and the box to come the space between the two of regulation, and then the adaptation is placed with not equidimension instrument.

title_en: Stereoscopic cable storage rack
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of storage shelves, in particular to a three-dimensional cable storage shelf, which comprises a fixed frame and at least two storage mechanisms which are sequentially arranged in parallel along the length direction, wherein the length direction of the fixed frame is mutually perpendicular to the length direction of the storage mechanisms, and a storage space is formed between two adjacent storage mechanisms; the storage mechanism is provided with at least one bearing mechanism, two adjacent bearing mechanisms of the storage mechanism are positioned on the same horizontal line, and two bearing mechanisms positioned on the same horizontal line divide the storage space into storage unit grids with different specifications. The utility model not only can sort and place a large number of cables with different specifications, but also can save the warehouse space to the maximum extent, the carrying of the cable drum coil is more convenient and reasonable, and the interception and use of the cable are more convenient and flexible.

title_en: Bracket special for replacing steel wire rope of travelling crane hook
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a special bracket for replacing a steel wire rope of a travelling crane hook, which comprises bracket bodies, a bottom plate, pin shafts and hanging holes, wherein the bottom plate is vertically provided with two bracket bodies which are symmetrically arranged, the pin shafts are respectively arranged on two sides of the bracket bodies, and the hanging holes are also formed in the bracket bodies; two sides of the upper end of the bracket body are inclined structures; the two sides of the bracket body extend outwards to form fixed blocks, pin shaft holes are formed in the fixed blocks, and the pin shafts penetrate through the two pin shaft holes and are fixed through nuts so that the pin shafts are respectively arranged on the two sides of the bracket body; the bracket has the advantages of simple structure, convenient use and high safety, and effectively avoids safety accidents.

title_en: Automatic labeling device for self-adhesive labeling
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic labeling device for self-adhesive labels, which comprises a feeding structure, a self-adhesive label roll and a pasting structure, wherein the feeding structure is fixedly connected to the outer side surface of the pasting structure, the self-adhesive label roll is arranged on the inner side surface of the feeding structure, the pasting structure is arranged on the outer side surface of the feeding structure, the feeding structure comprises a shell unit and a device cover unit, and the device cover unit is movably connected to the outer side surface of the shell unit. This automatic labeling device of self-adhesive labeling, settle the self-adhesive labeling volume in the outside of center pole, stretch out the one end of self-adhesive labeling volume from the discharge gate of device shell, drive center pole through power motor and rotate, the hydraulic press drives the bottom plate through the hydraulic stem and extrudees downwards, paste the self-adhesive labeling volume on article, utilize the winding roller to twine the waste paper of self-adhesive labeling volume, like this after pasting, convenient dismantlement and installation.

title_en: Conveying box for loose sandstone rock samples
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a transport box for loose sandstone rock samples. Comprising the following steps: the front end face of the refrigerator body is provided with a door which can be opened and closed; the impact monitoring devices are respectively and uniformly distributed on the bottom wall, the left side wall, the rear side wall, the right side wall and the inner wall of the refrigerator door in the refrigerator body and are used for detecting impact force of the loose sandstone rock sample in the transportation process; and a temperature sensor provided on an upper wall inside the refrigerator body for detecting a temperature inside the refrigerator; and the data storage is arranged on the outer wall of the refrigerator body, is electrically connected with the impact monitoring equipment and the temperature sensor and is used for storing data from the impact monitoring equipment and the temperature sensor. The beneficial effects of the utility model are as follows: the system can provide a low-temperature environment in the transportation process, and can monitor temperature change and impact force in the transportation process; the anti-collision air bag is arranged, so that the damage of the sample in the conveying process can be reduced.

title_en: Sliding rail system capable of utilizing long travel in logistics transportation
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of sliding rails, and discloses a sliding rail system capable of utilizing a long stroke during logistics transportation, which comprises: an upper slide rail member; the utility model is characterized in that the upper sliding rail component is arranged at the uppermost part, the middle sliding rail component is arranged at the middle position, the lower sliding rail component is arranged at the lowermost part and forms a combination with each other, all sliding motions are realized by sliding bearings and engineering plastics, the interval between the bearings is minimized, the bearing and the bearing are designed to bear the load of an integrated load at a certain height, the problem that the conventional common linear guide rail for linear motion is blocked when in linear motion, thereby easily causing damage to sliding parts or faults of sliding rollers, and the problems that the replacement and repair need quite long time and have to bear economic losses are solved.

title_en: Cargo arranging and placing device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of packaging, and particularly relates to a goods arranging and placing device, which comprises: a transmission line for transporting the packaged goods; the goods placing mechanism comprises a rack and a sorting pushing assembly, wherein a sorting guide groove for accommodating and placing goods is arranged on the rack, and the sorting guide groove is positioned below the transmission line and is connected with one end of the transmission line; the sorting pushing assembly comprises a pushing piece for pushing goods and a driving piece for driving the pushing piece to move back and forth, wherein the driving piece is arranged on the frame and is connected with the driving piece, and the pushing piece is located in the sorting guide groove or corresponds to the sorting guide groove. According to the utility model, the goods are prevented from being scattered and piled up, the labor intensity of staff can be effectively reduced, and the box transfer efficiency is improved.

title_en: Four-degree-of-freedom automatic material taking mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of intelligent catering, in particular to a four-degree-of-freedom automatic material taking mechanism, which comprises an automatic catering robot main body, wherein refrigerating bins are arranged on the front side and the rear side of the automatic catering robot main body, a mounting frame is arranged inside the automatic catering robot main body and between two groups of refrigerating bins, a moving mechanism is arranged inside the mounting frame, a first swing arm is arranged in the mounting frame and on the front side of the moving mechanism, a first speed reducing motor is arranged at the bottom of the first swing arm, a second swing arm is arranged at one end of the first swing arm far away from the first speed reducing motor, and a connecting plate is arranged at the joint of the first swing arm and the second swing arm and below the second swing arm.

title_en: Coiling mechanism and flexo printing machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of flexo printing machines, and discloses a winding device and a flexo printing machine. The winding device comprises a first bracket, a second bracket and a winding shaft arranged between the first bracket and the second bracket, wherein a rotating shaft and a driving piece for driving the rotating shaft to rotate are arranged at the first bracket; one end part of the winding shaft is arranged at the second bracket, the other end part of the winding shaft is provided with an inserting block for being inserted into the inserting slot, and the rotating shaft is used for driving the winding shaft to synchronously rotate under the rotating action. The flexo printing machine comprises a winding device. Through the setting of this flexo printing machine, the dismouting time that the wind-up roll is close to the rotor tip can be shortened preferably, and then the change time of rolling up shaft has been saved.

title_en: Multipurpose medicine filling device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of medicine filling production, in particular to a multipurpose medicine filling device, wherein a filling conveyor belt is arranged on a machine body; a filling bracket is arranged above the filling conveyor belt; a filling nozzle bracket is arranged on the filling bracket in a sliding way; the filling nozzle support is connected to the filling support through a filling support sliding block; the filling nozzle bracket is arranged in a circular ring structure; a plurality of filling nozzles are annularly arranged on the filling nozzle support; a spray head telescopic rod is arranged on the filling spray head; the filling spray head is communicated with the liquid medicine storage tank through an independent liquid supply shunt pipe; a filling sealing ring is arranged below the filling nozzle bracket; a bottle cap tightener is arranged on the left side of the filling nozzle bracket; the bottle cap tightener is annularly provided with a plurality of motor bottoms at the bottom of the bottle cap tightener; the bottom of the bottle cap tightener is provided with a telescopic shaft; the bottom of the telescopic shaft is connected with a bottle cap tightening ring; a bottle cap tightening limit ring is arranged below the bottle cap tightening device; the bottle cap hopper is arranged beside the bottle cap tightener, so that the problems in the background art are solved.

title_en: Rotary multi-cavity packaging box
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of packaging boxes, and particularly relates to a rotary multi-cavity packaging box. The utility model comprises a first outer vertical plate and a second outer vertical plate, wherein a flip top mounting piece is arranged between the first outer vertical plate and the second outer vertical plate. When the packing box needs to be closed, the first outer vertical plate, the second outer vertical plate, the third outer vertical plate and the fourth outer vertical plate are surrounded to form a rectangular box body, the flip top mounting piece, the middle mounting piece and the bottom mounting piece are sequentially arranged from top to bottom, when articles need to be placed, the third outer vertical plate and the fourth outer vertical plate are rotated towards one end far away from the first outer vertical plate and the second outer vertical plate, the middle mounting piece and the bottom mounting piece are separated from the flip top mounting piece to expose the containing space, and one containing space is respectively arranged in the flip top mounting piece, the middle mounting piece and the bottom mounting piece to form multi-partition containing, so that the multi-partition placement can be performed on various articles, the structure is simple and convenient, the whole structure is compact, and the practicability is high.

title_en: Sterilized dressing packaging bottle for hyaluronic acid
abstract_en: The utility model provides a packaging bottle, which belongs to the technical field of packaging and comprises a cover body and a bottle body; the cover body is connected above the bottle body; the cover body comprises a liquid storage part and a connecting part, wherein the liquid storage part comprises a shell, an elastic membrane, a cone thorn object and a film, a cavity is arranged in the shell, the elastic membrane is arranged at the upper part of the cavity, the film is arranged at the lower part of the cavity, and the cone thorn object is arranged between the elastic membrane and the film and is connected with the elastic membrane; the liquid packaging bottle and the hyaluronic acid dressing packaging bottle are designed into a whole, the liquid storage part and the bottle body are connected into a whole through the connecting part, when the liquid packaging bottle is used by a wet method, a user pulls the pull ring to pull the shell body open a mouth, so that the elastic membrane is exposed, the user presses the elastic membrane to drive the cone to pierce the membrane, liquid inside the shell enters the bottle body to be regulated with hyaluronic acid dressing powder, the phenomenon that liquid is scattered in the regulating process is avoided, and the collision in the transportation process is avoided.

title_en: Packing box of variable angle shaft hinge
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a packing box with a variable-angle shaft core hinge, and relates to the technical field of packing boxes. Including the box body, the cotton piece of bottom bubble has been placed in the box body, and a plurality of middle part bubble cotton pieces have been placed in proper order from bottom to top to the top of the cotton piece of bottom bubble, and the top of the cotton piece of middle part bubble at top is provided with the cotton piece of top bubble, and a plurality of standing grooves have all been seted up at the top of the cotton piece of bottom bubble and the cotton piece of middle part bubble, and the arc wall has all been seted up to the both sides of standing groove, and a plurality of indent have all been seted up to the bottom of the cotton piece of middle part bubble and the cotton piece of top bubble. The utility model is provided with a bottom foam block, a top foam block and a plurality of middle foam blocks, wherein the bottom foam block, the top foam block and the middle foam blocks are stacked, the variable-angle shaft hinges are arranged in the placing grooves formed by the foam blocks, the bottom foam block, the middle foam block and the top foam block are fixed through the fasteners, the foam blocks are prevented from shifting, the hinges are prevented from shaking in the transferring process, and the hinges are well protected because the foam blocks have good elasticity.

title_en: Target hoisting device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a target hoisting device, which comprises a hoisting tool body and a distance-adjusting mechanism; the lifting appliance comprises a lifting appliance body and is characterized in that the lifting appliance body comprises a lifting appliance support and a lifting ring positioned at the top of the lifting appliance support, the lifting appliance support comprises a plurality of connecting parts and supporting parts, a movable claw and a plurality of fixed claws are arranged on the lifting appliance support, the movable claw is sleeved on the connecting parts, and the distance adjusting mechanism can drive the movable claw to reciprocate along the height direction of the connecting parts so as to clamp a target between the movable claw and the fixed claws. The utility model ensures the stability of the target material when being hoisted, prevents the target material from falling off, saves time and labor, and is convenient and safe.

title_en: Belt conveyor and sorting equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a belt conveyor and sorting equipment, wherein the belt conveyor comprises a frame and rollers arranged on the frame, a first end of a supporting shaft of at least one roller is rotatably arranged on the frame relative to the frame, a rotating shaft around which the roller rotates is perpendicular to a conveying surface of the belt conveyor, and a second end of the supporting shaft is connected with an adjusting mechanism for driving the roller to rotate around the rotating shaft. The belt deviation rectifying device is characterized in that one end of the roller is hinged with the frame, the other end of the roller is connected with the adjusting mechanism, deviation rectifying of the belt can be achieved only by one power source, the structure is simpler, adjustment and control are easier, and equipment cost and use cost are lower.

title_en: Coil unreeling machine
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of steel coil processing, and particularly relates to a steel coil unreeling machine, which comprises a rack, wherein a winding drum is rotatably clamped on the rack, a clamping groove is formed in the rack, a pressing assembly is movably clamped in the clamping groove, an electric telescopic rod is arranged on the rack through a fixing table, and the telescopic end of the electric telescopic rod is abutted with the pressing assembly; the winding drum is provided with an assembly groove, a limiting assembly is arranged in the assembly groove, a notch of the assembly groove is provided with a positioning assembly, and the positioning assembly is used for positioning the limiting assembly and is used for solving the problem that the steel coil is easy to deviate in the steel coil unreeling process of the current unreeling machine, and the follow-up continuous operation unit is influenced.

title_en: Winding tube yarn storage device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of spool yarn storage, and particularly discloses a spool yarn storage device which comprises a box body, wherein a lifting mechanism is arranged in the box body; a tray is placed on the lifting mechanism; a spooling cop is placed on the tray; the lifting mechanism can drive the tray to ascend in the box body; the tray is integrally arranged in a rectangular plate shape; a plurality of cylinders are uniformly arranged on the tray; the cylinder can be provided with a winding cop. Compared with the prior art, through the setting of hoist mechanism and tray, can guarantee that the spool yarn of yarn feeding subassembly is abundant, guarantee that spool yarn in time inserts a section of thick bamboo in the yarn storehouse, guarantee the continuity of production rhythm, avoided leaking the product quality accident that leads to the fact of inserting.

title_en: Motor rotor convenient to transportation
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of motor rotors and discloses a motor rotor convenient to transport, which comprises a rotor body, wherein the rotor body consists of a rotor sheet and a rotating shaft, an L-shaped groove A is formed in the left side of a protection box, an L-shaped groove B is formed in the right side of the protection box, a rectangular groove is formed in the surface of a sealing cover, fixed rubber is fixedly connected to the inner side of the sealing cover, a connecting block A is fixedly connected to the upper side of the protection box, a connecting block B is fixedly connected to the lower side of the protection box, when the motor rotor convenient to transport is transported, the rotor can be placed in the protection box through the L-shaped groove A and the L-shaped groove B, the L-shaped groove can perform a certain fixing effect on the motor rotor, the connecting block A fixedly connected to the surface of the protection box can be clamped with the connecting block B on the other protection box, so that the two protection boxes are connected with each other, and if the motor rotor is transported in a large quantity, the protection boxes can be connected with each other in a clamping manner.

title_en: Feeding machine with discharging butt joint structure
