abstract_en: The utility model discloses a feeding machine with a discharging butt joint structure, which relates to the technical field of feeding machines and comprises a feeding pipe, a screw shaft and a discharging pipe, wherein the screw shaft is arranged in the feeding pipe, a driving motor is arranged at the lower end of the feeding pipe, the output end of the driving motor is connected with the screw shaft through a driving belt, the top end of the discharging pipe is connected with the discharging pipe, an extension mechanism is arranged at the outer side of the discharging pipe, and the extension mechanism comprises a movable block, an extension pipe, a movable groove, a connecting seat, a threaded rod, a fixed seat and a motor, and the movable block is connected with the edge of the outer wall of the discharging pipe. This material loading machine with ejection of compact butt joint structure, through the mutually supporting of motor and threaded rod, can make the extension pipe in the material-discharging pipe outside move down for the material loading machine has ejection of compact butt joint structure, can shelter from the opening of feeder hopper according to actual conditions through the shielding plate, makes the feeder hopper of this material loading machine have dustproof construction.

title_en: Inspection robot with anti-collision function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of inspection robots, and discloses an inspection robot with an anti-collision function, which comprises an inspection robot body and an anti-collision buffer mechanism, wherein the anti-collision buffer mechanism is arranged on the front surface and the rear surface of the inspection robot body, the anti-collision buffer mechanism comprises a fixing unit, a buffer unit, an exhaust unit and an air inlet unit, and the fixing unit is arranged on the front surface and the rear surface of the inspection robot body. This inspection robot with crashproof function, through buffer unit and the exhaust unit in the buffer gear of having installed, after taking place the striking, the striking board promotes the inside air discharge of messenger's rubber sleeve, and according to the impact dynamics difference, the inside pressure of rubber sleeve is different, can promote the slide to the extrusion of second spring this moment, and the distance that the slide moved increases and then can increase exhaust speed, and can not kick-back fast because of installing the check valve messenger rubber sleeve to the purpose to the whole buffering of device has been reached.

title_en: Clamp for grabbing mechanical arm
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a clamp for grabbing a mechanical arm, and relates to the technical field of clamps. The utility model comprises a shell and a rotating motor, wherein the shell is a hollow body with a rectangular cross section, a limit hole is formed in the middle of the bottom end of the shell, a round hole is formed in one end of the shell, a first screw rod is arranged at the output end of the rotating motor, the first screw rod penetrates through the round hole and extends into the shell, the rotating motor is fixed on the outer wall of one end of the shell, a connecting piece is arranged at one end of the first screw rod, a second screw rod is arranged at one end of the connecting piece, and threaded rings are screwed on the outer cylindrical surfaces of the second screw rod and the first screw rod. According to the utility model, the two threaded rings are arranged and matched with the second screw rod and the first screw rod to control the two clamping plates to move, linear motion is used for replacing the arc motion of traditional grabbing, the deviation of grabbing point positions is prevented, the two clamping plates are arranged to perform relative motion for replacing the traditional claw disc grabbing, and the contact surface between grabbing points and objects is increased, so that the grabbing stability is increased.

title_en: Negative pressure conveyor
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of negative pressure conveyors, in particular to a negative pressure conveyor, which comprises: the frame body is provided with an assembly groove; an adsorption assembly; a tensioning assembly; a negative pressure generator; the belt is arranged on the frame body and can cover the top of the hollow section bar; and the driving assembly can drive the belt. Utilize taut subassembly with two independent cavity section bars concatenation equipment formation negative pressure cavity, in the adsorption area of unit area, the area of the inner chamber roof of single cavity section bar can reduce to adsorption area's half, and then reduced the area of being under the force of the inner chamber roof of single cavity section bar, when negative pressure generator during operation, outside atmospheric pressure acts on the outer wall of two cavity section bars, through reducing the area of being under the force of chamber roof, reduce the condition that the cavity section bar leads to the deformation because of the pressurized, on the one hand can avoid the top surface of cavity section bar to break away from with the belt, be favorable to improving the effect of adsorbing the material, on the other hand reduces the hollow section bar and produces abnormal sound in the course of working.

title_en: Ribbon machine with waste collection box
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a strapping machine with a waste collection box, which comprises a shell, a rack arranged on the shell, a guide claw, a push rod and a tensioning mechanism, wherein the guide claw, the push rod and the tensioning mechanism are respectively arranged on the rack; the device also comprises a waste collection box arranged on the frame; the waste collection box is correspondingly matched with the tensioning mechanism, so that the drawstring driving wheel and the drawstring driven wheel can send waste into the waste collection box. The utility model cancels the arrangement of the conveying pipe, so that the problems of the conveying pipe that the conveying pipe needs to be replaced periodically, the conveying pipe is damaged, the conveying pipe is blocked and the like are avoided, and the utility model is greatly convenient to use.

title_en: Photoelectric induction type elevator car
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a photoelectric induction type elevator car, which comprises a first photoelectric induction part arranged in the elevator car, wherein the first photoelectric induction part comprises a first photoelectric inductor and a second photoelectric inductor which are symmetrically and fixedly arranged at the edge of an elevator car door in opposite directions, the first photoelectric inductor sends photoelectric signals to the second photoelectric inductor, after receiving the photoelectric signals, the second photoelectric inductor triggers an instruction, and a central processor arranged in the elevator car controls the closing of the car door.

title_en: Machine-made sand feeding control equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses machine-made sand feeding control equipment, which relates to the technical field of machine-made sand processing and comprises a feeding mechanism and a base, wherein the feeding mechanism comprises a box body, a feeding port is formed in the front face of the box body, a connecting plate is fixedly connected to the position, close to the lower position, of the front face of the box body, a mounting plate is fixedly connected to the position, close to the rear, of the upper surface of the box body, a first motor is fixedly arranged on the front face of the mounting plate, and the output end of the first motor penetrates through the front face of the mounting plate and is fixedly connected with a first belt wheel. The equipment drives the spiral conveying shaft to rotate through the first motor, the first belt pulley, the driving belt and the second belt pulley, conveying machine-made sand starts to move towards the conveying table, feeding efficiency is improved, the feeding hole is adjusted through the first electric push rod according to the height of the machine-made sand pile, the equipment has certain practicability, and finally the height of the conveying table is adjusted through the second electric push rod, so that the equipment can be conveniently abutted to processing equipment with different heights.

title_en: Pipe fitting stacking clamping tool
abstract_en: The application provides a pipe fitting stack chucking frock, include: the mounting plate, its circumference array is equipped with three telescopic links, and contained angle between the adjacent telescopic link is 120, and the front end of telescopic link is equipped with the cardboard, and the draw-in groove has all been seted up to the same one side of three cardboard for the tip of the adjacent pipe fitting of centre gripping, the extending direction of draw-in groove is unanimous with the length direction of telescopic link, and the middle part of mounting plate is equipped with the pull ring, and pull ring and draw-in groove are located the both sides of mounting plate respectively. The rope threading point position can be greatly reduced, and the convenience of pipe fitting fixing operation is improved.

title_en: Five matrix ceramic pump liquid filling machine
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of filling machines, a five matrix ceramic pump filling machine is disclosed, which comprises a frame main body, five filling pumps have been installed to the upper end rear side of frame main part, Z axle drive assembly has been installed to the upper end front side of frame main part is fixed, drag chain board has been installed to the upper end rear side of Z axle drive assembly to the fixed mounting, upper end one side fixed mounting of frame main part has drag chain baffle, the lower extreme output fixedly connected with needle tubing of Z axle drive assembly, five filling tubes have been installed to the fixed mounting on the needle tubing, the horizontal part upper end of frame main part still is connected with two sets of jigs through two sets of X axle drive assembly fixedly. The utility model provides a five accurate filling of ration simultaneously of little dosage pump of five, has effectively improved filling quality and efficiency.

title_en: High-weatherability and stability polymer packaging plastic structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-molecular packaging plastic structure with high weather resistance and stability, which belongs to the technical field of packaging plastic structures, and comprises a packaging plastic box body, wherein a through groove is formed in one side surface of the packaging plastic box body, and a rotating mechanism is arranged in the through groove; the rotating mechanism comprises two rotating plates, the two rotating plates are arranged inside the penetrating groove, a rotating shaft is arranged at the top of each rotating plate, an inner cavity is formed in each rotating plate, and a penetrating sliding groove is formed in one side surface of the inner wall of each inner cavity. According to the utility model, by arranging the rotating mechanism and changing the opening mode of the cover plate of the plastic structure, articles can enter the box body from the side face, the articles can be pushed into the box body by pushing the articles, friction force generated by the movement of the articles is reduced in the pushing process, the storage of large heavy articles in the box body is more labor-saving, the labor is saved, the burden of workers for carrying the articles in the box body is reduced, and the use is more convenient.

title_en: Material twines membrane device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of material film winding, and particularly relates to a material film winding device which comprises a compression chamber bin and a compression chamber storage bin, wherein the top of the compression chamber bin is provided with the compression chamber storage bin, the inner side of the compression chamber bin is provided with a forage pushing device, the inner side of the compression chamber bin is provided with a compression chamber door at a corresponding position of the forage pushing device, the inner side of the compression chamber bin is provided with a vertical film winding roller set device at a corresponding position of the compression chamber door, and the inner side of the compression chamber bin is provided with a horizontal film winding roller set device at a corresponding position of the vertical film winding roller set device. According to the utility model, the material is fed with the film by the horizontal film winding roller set device and the vertical film winding roller set device, and the combination of vertical winding and horizontal winding is realized, so that the film is wound in all directions by the heavy forage bag, the stacking of the material is facilitated, the film winding effect is excellent, and the storage of the material is facilitated.

title_en: Carousel of unreeling steel wire
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of steel wire unreeling, in particular to a turntable for unreeling steel wires, which comprises a support, wherein an annular groove is formed in the bottom end of the inside of the support, a sliding block is arranged in the annular groove, a first turntable is arranged at the top of the sliding block, and a first clamping groove is formed in the middle of the top of the first turntable. According to the utility model, through the mutual matching of the first turntable, the first clamping groove, the unreeling roller, the second turntable, the second clamping groove, the air cylinder, the supporting plate, the rotating shaft and the motor, the installation and operation of the turntable on the unreeling roller of the steel wire are more convenient, time and labor are saved, the unreeling efficiency is indirectly improved, and through the mutual matching of the base, the moving wheel, the fixing plate, the first fixing hole, the fixing rod, the reset groove, the rolling shaft, the L-shaped limiting plate and the second fixing hole, the movement of the turntable is simpler, and the problem that a plurality of persons or professionals need to carry and move the turntable by using special instruments when the placing position of the turntable is required to be moved or adjusted is avoided.

title_en: Kraft paper bag with dampproofing function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kraft paper bag with a dampproof function, and relates to the field of kraft paper bags. The kraft paper bag with the dampproof function comprises a paper bag main body, wherein a dampproof oil film is coated on the outer surface of the paper bag main body; positioning strips are arranged on two sides of the paper bag main body, mounting grooves which are internally and externally communicated are formed on two sides of the paper bag main body, and positioning grooves are formed on the outer surfaces of the positioning strips; both the positioning strips are provided with pull ropes. This kraft paper bag with dampproofing function has strengthened the dampproofing and waterproofing's of container bag main part surface effect through the surface coating at the container bag main part, and then makes locating strip and container bag main part's junction be difficult to wet soft, and the inner wall of the constant head tank of locating strip surface is laminated mutually with the inner wall of mounting groove and the interior external surface of container bag main part simultaneously, when mentioning two stay cords, the atress of locating strip and container bag main part junction is even, the condition that the locating strip is difficult to take place to break away from.

title_en: Tablet counting device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of tablet processing, in particular to a tablet counting device which comprises a feeding hopper, wherein the feeding hopper is fed from the upper part, a discharge hole of the feeding hopper is connected with a downward-inclined conveying cylinder, the higher end of the conveying cylinder is communicated with the feeding hopper, the lower end of the conveying cylinder is a discharge chute, one side wall of the conveying cylinder is connected with an air cylinder, the conveying cylinder is provided with a through hole on the side wall connected with the air cylinder, the diameter of the through hole is smaller than that of a tablet, a fan is arranged in the air cylinder, one side wall of the conveying cylinder is connected with an infrared scanning sensing device, the inside of the feeding hopper is in a spiral channel structure, the tail end below the spiral channel inside the feeding hopper faces the channel direction of the conveying cylinder, a filter screen capable of filtering dust particles is arranged in the air cylinder, and ribs are arranged on the inner side wall of the air cylinder. The beneficial effects of the utility model are as follows: dust particles floating in the equipment channel can be reduced, the influence on the normal counting function of the infrared sensor due to excessive dust particles is avoided, and the normal operation of the subsequent process is ensured.

title_en: Propelling beam and large arm connection auxiliary installation device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a propelling beam and large arm connecting auxiliary installation device, which comprises a motion device and an installation device fixedly connected to the upper part of the motion device, wherein the installation device comprises an installation base, an installation arm, an adjusting arm, a first hydraulic telescopic cylinder, a second hydraulic telescopic cylinder and a clamping component, the installation base is fixedly connected to the motion device, the installation base is fixedly connected with the installation arm, one end of the installation arm is rotationally connected with the adjusting arm, the installation arm is rotationally connected with the first hydraulic telescopic cylinder, the first hydraulic telescopic cylinder is rotationally connected with the adjusting arm, one end of the adjusting arm is rotationally connected with the clamping component, the adjusting arm is rotationally connected with the second hydraulic telescopic cylinder, and the second hydraulic telescopic cylinder is rotationally connected with the clamping component. The utility model relates to the technical field of a propelling beam, which has the characteristic of ensuring that the propelling beam is convenient to install on a rock drill.

title_en: Container with quick fixing assembly
abstract_en: The container with the quick fixing assembly comprises a supporting device, a quick fixing device and a control device, wherein the supporting device consists of a mounting seat, a supporting rod, a resistance increasing plate and a warning board, the quick fixing device is arranged on the mounting seat of the supporting device and consists of a bearing seat, a telescopic push rod, a clamping plate, a sliding block, a fixing hole, the container and an L-shaped limiting plate, and the control device is arranged on the mounting seat of the supporting device and consists of a control panel, an LED display screen and control keys. The utility model is provided with the quick fixing device, a user places the container on the bearing seat, and the user can control the telescopic push rod of the quick fixing device to move, so that the telescopic push rod drives the clamping plate to move, the container is limited left and right, then the user fixes the L-shaped limiting plate on the bolt hole through the fixing bolt, and the front and rear limiting of the container is realized through the L-shaped limiting plate, so that the device can not only quickly fix the container, but also has extremely high stability.

title_en: Push scraping type car dumper
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of car dumpers and discloses a pushing scraping type car dumper which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a placement structure is fixedly connected to the right side of the middle part of the upper end face of the bottom plate, a fixing structure is fixedly connected to the upper end face of the placement structure, an adjusting structure is arranged on the left side of the middle part of the lower end face of the placement structure, a driving structure is fixedly connected to the right side of the upper end face of the bottom plate, a mounting structure is fixedly connected to the left side of the upper end face of the bottom plate, a conveying structure is slidingly connected to an inner cavity of the mounting structure, a mine car is placed and limited in use through the fixing structure of the upper end face of the placement structure, and therefore limiting is carried out when the mine car rotates, lifting is achieved through the adjusting structure of the lower end face of the placement structure in use through left-right sliding of an adjusting block, the inclination angle of the placement plate is adjusted in use, the effect of placing and fixing the mine car in use is achieved, the inner cavity coal dust of the mine car is conveniently dumped in use, working efficiency is improved, and labor intensity is avoided.

title_en: Heavy integral ferrying device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a heavy integral ferry device, which comprises a support plate body, wherein upper rails are fixed on two sides of the top of the support plate body, friction wheel devices are uniformly arranged between the two groups of upper rails, and first electric control locators are arranged at two ends of the top of the support plate body; the bottom both sides of the support plate body are equipped with lower track and roller component, the roller component is located the top of lower track, the second automatically controlled locator is installed at the bottom both ends of the support plate body. The ferry device is used for realizing conversion of production line transfer lines to pouring pedestals and dies, the whole transportation process is realized by positioning materials by the first electric control positioner, and the ferry vehicle is positioned by the second electric control positioner, so that the positioning accuracy is improved. The ferry device has low manufacturing cost, can be repeatedly used, and reduces the cost of the transportation pedestal and the die.

title_en: Conveyor belt machine capable of being automatically adjusted
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatically adjustable conveying belt conveyor, which comprises a frame, a driving roller, a driven roller, a driving motor, a conveying belt, an electric telescopic rod, a laser sensor and a controller, wherein the driving roller is arranged on the frame; two ends of a central shaft of the driven roller respectively penetrate through corresponding strip-shaped holes in a movable mode and are fixedly connected with the extending ends of the electric telescopic rods; laser sensors are respectively fixed on the frames close to the two sides of the driven roller; the signal output end of the laser sensor is connected with the signal input end of the controller through a signal, and the signal output end of the controller is connected with the signal input end of the electric telescopic rod through a signal. The utility model has the advantages that: the utility model has simple structure, easy realization, automatic adjustment of the conveying belt, no need of manual intervention, time saving and labor saving; and the conveyor belt is enabled to stably run; the frequency of the shift of the conveyor belt is reduced.

title_en: General quick feeding and discharging pressing mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model provides a universal quick feeding and discharging pressing mechanism, which aims to solve the problems of inconvenient feeding and discharging of materials and unstable fixation of the tool. The pressing mechanism comprises a fixed block, the fixed block is connected with a compression spring, the upper end of the compression spring is connected with a pressing claw, the lower end of the pressing claw is provided with a pressing claw connecting pin, the pressing claw is clung to a pressing plate, the pressing plate is provided with a pressing plate connecting pin, the pressing plate connecting pin is connected with a height adjusting plate, the height adjusting plate is provided with a screw hole, and the screw penetrates through the screw hole to connect the tool main body with the height adjusting plate. Through a generalized design, can be used to the quick unloading of material of various frock compress tightly, flattening material, improve production efficiency, especially improve the reliability that water gauge photoelectric coding character wheel subassembly electrical property detected.

title_en: Communication engineering construction tool case
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a communication engineering construction toolbox, which relates to the technical field of communication engineering toolboxes, and aims at the problems that the existing toolbox for communication engineering construction cannot roll cables, is easy to cause cable confusion and arrangement, influences construction progress and various works, cannot guarantee that tools are in a dry environment when being stored in the toolbox, is easy to rust due to overlarge humidity in the toolbox, and is inconvenient to use. According to the utility model, the winding mechanism is convenient for winding or paying out the cable, so that the cable is prevented from being arranged in a disordered manner, the dehumidification is performed through the air in the box body of the dehumidification mechanism, the tool is prevented from being wetted, and the normal use of the tool is ensured.

title_en: Bagged fertilizer filling mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of compound fertilizer production, and discloses a bagged fertilizer filling mechanism, which comprises: the device comprises an assembling member, a filling hopper and a sealing device, wherein a rack is arranged on one side of the assembling member, and the filling hopper is arranged on one side of the rack opposite to the assembling member; the mixing component is used for stirring the fertilizer in the filling hopper and comprises a connecting ring rotatably arranged in the frame and a plurality of scrapers arranged on the periphery of the outer part of the connecting ring, one sides of the scrapers, which are opposite to the connecting ring, are contacted with the inner wall of the frame, and one sides of the scrapers are hinged with blades; according to the utility model, through the arrangement of the mixing component, the effect of dispersing and mixing the fertilizer in the filling hopper can be achieved, the scraping of the inner wall of the filling hopper can be realized, the residue of the fertilizer on the inner wall of the filling hopper is reduced, the problem that the filling head is blocked due to the fact that the fertilizer is poured into the filling hopper to form accumulation is avoided, and the filling efficiency of the fertilizer is improved.

title_en: Automatic carton laying device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic carton tipping device, which belongs to the technical field of mechanical equipment and comprises a workbench, a tipping assembly arranged on the workbench, a splicing assembly arranged on the workbench through a shell, and a carton transported to the tipping assembly through a transport assembly in the last procedure. The design of the device combines the pushing and the forward connection to form the purpose of slowly falling, and avoids damaging some valuable products.

title_en: Novel feeding mechanism with encoder feedback
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel feeding mechanism with encoder feedback, which comprises a substrate, wherein a pinch roller mounting bracket is arranged on one side above the substrate, a driving roller mounting bracket is arranged on the opposite side above the substrate relative to the pinch roller mounting bracket, a pinch roller is arranged on the pinch roller mounting bracket, and a driving motor is arranged above the driving roller mounting bracket. Through rotating by motor drive gyro wheel, drive the material that compresses tightly on the gyro wheel and advance, install the encoder in drive roller one side, encoder counter wheel and material contact, rotate along with advancing of material, real-time recording and feed back to the PLC signal, PLC calculates the distance that the material advances, make instruction feedback again and give the pay-off motor, let the motor pay-off or stop, can reflect the material in time and advance the distance and control the material and advance the distance simultaneously, thereby realize the accurate feeding to section bar class material, the position can conveniently be adjusted about the encoder, accommodation is wider.

title_en: Material guiding device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a material guiding device, which relates to the technical field of material guiding devices and aims to solve the problem that powder leaks from one side when a pipeline is opened, and the technical scheme is as follows: the feeding device comprises a feeding bin, a first discharging pipe, a second discharging pipe and a distributing assembly, wherein the distributing assembly comprises a ship-shaped guide plate, a rotating rod, two travel switches, a guide plate and a transmission assembly, and the ship-shaped guide plate is fixedly arranged on one side of the rotating rod. According to the utility model, one of the first discharging pipe and the second discharging pipe can be closed by driving the ship-shaped material guide plate to rotate through the transmission assembly, so that the other one is opened.

title_en: Combined environment-friendly carton
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a combined environment-friendly carton, which belongs to the field of cartons and comprises a lower base, wherein a honeycomb paper enclosing block is arranged in the lower base, an upper sealing cover is arranged at one end of the honeycomb paper enclosing block, one end of the honeycomb paper enclosing block is inserted and installed into the lower base, the upper sealing cover is clamped to the outer side of the edge of an opening at one end of the honeycomb paper enclosing block, right-angle upright posts are arranged at four corners of the honeycomb paper enclosing block, the inner sides of the four right-angle upright posts are respectively and tightly attached to the outer walls of the four corners of the honeycomb paper enclosing block, the right-angle upright posts are right-angle, one end of each right-angle upright post is inserted into the lower base, the other end of each right-angle upright post is inserted into the honeycomb paper enclosing block, and a pair of strip-shaped double-sided adhesives I are fixedly installed on the outer wall of each right-angle upright post, so that the phenomenon of collapsing and collapsing caused by insufficient integral strength in different environments can be prevented.

title_en: Food metering and split charging device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a food metering and split charging device, which comprises a bottom plate, a stirring mechanism and a uniform metering mechanism; a bottom plate: the upper end of the device is fixedly connected with a dustproof metering box through uniformly distributed support columns, the upper end of the dustproof metering box is fixedly connected with a stirring box, the inner wall of the upper end of the dustproof metering box is fixedly connected with a conical discharging pipe, and the lower end of the conical discharging pipe is fixedly connected with a discharging pipe; stirring mechanism: the stirring tank is arranged in the stirring tank; even metering mechanism: the automatic feeding device is arranged on the outer surface of the discharging pipe, the feeding material metering and packaging device is used for preventing uneven metering and packaging of feeding materials due to adhesion of other factors through rotary stirring, the device is used for realizing rapid automatic metering and packaging by limiting the quantity and the quantity time of the feeding materials each time through rotation, and the device is operated through a machine, is simple to operate and easy to operate, can greatly reduce the labor cost and can rapidly achieve the expected effect.

title_en: Liquid cooling assembly for energy storage container
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of containers, and provides a liquid cooling and temperature reducing assembly of an energy storage container. The cooling assembly is arranged, the valve is opened after the recycled cooling liquid returns to the water tank, so that nitrogen in the nitrogen tank is sprayed out through the jet head to rapidly cool the cooling liquid, and the diffusion area of the nitrogen is enlarged along the radian of the gas expansion hopper when the jet head sprays the nitrogen, so that the cooling liquid effect is better, the problems that in the prior art, the water can be increased due to long-time recycling, the cooling effect of the fan blades is limited at the moment, the cooling effect of the water is continuously reduced, the container cannot be cooled normally by the final water, and the cooling effect of the container is poor are solved; the stirring assembly is arranged, the starting motor enables the output end to drive the first gear to rotate and the second gear to be meshed with the third gear, at the moment, the second rotating pipe is opposite to the rotating pipe in rotating direction and drives the mixing pipe to rotate to stir the cooling liquid, and the cooling liquid is enabled to be fully contacted with nitrogen so as to accelerate cooling efficiency of the cooling liquid.

title_en: Anti-toppling mechanism for forming box body
abstract_en: The anti-toppling mechanism is arranged on one side of the transverse conveying belt, a longitudinal conveying belt is arranged on the other side of the transverse conveying belt, the longitudinal conveying belt is higher than the transverse conveying belt, the conveying direction of the longitudinal conveying belt is towards the transverse conveying belt, the anti-toppling mechanism is arranged on one side, far away from the longitudinal conveying belt, of the transverse conveying belt, and the anti-toppling mechanism comprises a clamping assembly and a baffle rod vertically arranged on the clamping assembly; the stop lever includes vertical pole section and the preceding stop lever section that is connected, and preceding stop lever section is located the transverse conveyor and takes the direction of delivery parallel arrangement of transverse conveyor, and preceding stop lever section upper end is less than the height of shaping box body to the height of transverse conveyor. The gear lever can be blocked at the upper part of the forming box body, so that the phenomenon that the forming box body falls forward due to the conveying speed, inertia and self gravity of the longitudinal conveying belt is prevented, a special person is not required to be responsible for correcting the forming box body, and the working strength and labor cost of workers are reduced.

title_en: Silicon wafer conveying mechanism and discharging system thereof
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of silicon wafer manufacturing processes, in particular to a silicon wafer conveying mechanism and a silicon wafer discharging system. The embodiment of the utility model provides a silicon wafer conveying mechanism, which comprises: the conveying belt comprises a clamping plate assembly below the conveying belt, wherein two ends of the clamping plate assembly extend to two sides of the conveying belt, the clamping plate assembly is suitable for stretching along the length direction, and the stretching direction is perpendicular to the conveying direction of the conveying belt; when the silicon wafer moves between the two clamping plate assemblies along the conveying belt, the two clamping plate assemblies are close to each other in opposite directions so as to straighten the silicon wafer. Through set up splint subassembly below the conveyer belt to right the silicon chip that passes through one by one, avoid the silicon chip to drop, detect whether correctly have the silicon chip to carry on every conveyer belt through the detector.

title_en: Air inlet baffle assembly for container and container
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of transportation equipment, and discloses an air inlet baffle assembly for a container. This an air inlet baffle assembly for container includes: the air inlet baffle is provided with a mounting notch; the water collecting box is arranged at the mounting notch and is used for collecting condensed water generated by the container. Through setting up the installation breach at the air inlet baffle, can inlay the air inlet baffle of establishing at the container with the water catch bowl, the comdenstion water that produces in the container directly gets into the water catch bowl to can effectively get rid of the comdenstion water that produces in the container. The application also discloses a container.

title_en: Laminated sealing gasket
abstract_en: The utility model provides a laminated sealing gasket, which belongs to the technical field of sealing parts and comprises a sealing gasket body, wherein the sealing gasket body comprises a sealing gasket inner diameter, a sealing gasket outer diameter and a sealing gasket groove surface, the sealing gasket inner diameter is provided with an inner supporting bar, the sealing gasket outer diameter is provided with an outer supporting bar, each side of the sealing gasket groove surface is respectively provided with a group of assembly groove holes, each group of assembly groove holes comprises three groups of bolt grooves, a group of short convex grooves and a group of long convex grooves, and the bolt grooves are used for penetrating through matched bolts; the outer part of the bolt groove is provided with an annular air cushion, the outer part of the short convex groove is provided with a short groove air cushion, the outer part of the long convex groove is provided with a long groove air cushion, the annular air cushion, the short groove air cushion and the long groove air cushion are communicated through an air guide groove, and the air guide groove is arranged on the groove surface of the sealing gasket; the utility model can solve the problem of poor sealing effect of the sealing gasket.

title_en: High-strength anti-deformation paper bowl
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-strength anti-deformation paper bowl, which relates to the technical field of paper bowls and comprises an outer paper cylinder and a bucket-shaped inner paper cylinder, wherein the outer paper cylinder is arranged in the bucket-shaped inner paper cylinder, the outer paper cylinder is fixedly connected with the bucket-shaped inner paper cylinder, the outer paper cylinder is hollow and cylindrical, an inner cavity is formed between the outer paper cylinder and the bucket-shaped inner paper cylinder, six triangular support paper plates which are uniformly distributed along an annular shape are arranged in the inner cavity, the triangular support paper plates are fixedly connected with the outer paper cylinder and the bucket-shaped inner paper cylinder, a round bottom paper plate is fixedly arranged at the lower end of the inner part of the bucket-shaped inner paper cylinder, and six support bottom paper plates which are uniformly distributed along the annular shape are arranged at the lower end of the round bottom paper plate and are fixedly connected with the round bottom paper plate. According to the utility model, the strength and the deformation resistance of the paper bowl are improved by adding the supporting structure between the inner layer and the outer layer of the paper bowl and the supporting structure at the bottom.

title_en: Fork truck suitable for road surface jolts
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of forklifts and particularly discloses a forklift suitable for bumpy roads, which comprises a frame mechanism and a wheel mechanism, wherein the frame mechanism comprises a chassis, the wheel mechanism comprises a front wheel assembly positioned at the bottom of the front end of the chassis and a rear wheel assembly positioned at the bottom of the rear end of the chassis, the front wheel assembly comprises two groups of first wheel frames, front wheels and driving parts, the first wheel frames are respectively positioned at two sides of the front end of the chassis, the first wheel frames are rotatably fixed on the chassis, the front wheels are fixed at one ends of the first wheel frames, the first wheel frames can be driven to rotate through the driving parts and drive the front wheels to ascend or descend, so that the front wheels can be suitable for bumpy roads, the rear wheel assembly comprises driving wheels, balance wheels and connecting parts, the connecting parts are rotatably fixed at the rear end of the chassis, the driving wheels and the balance wheels are respectively positioned at two sides of the rear end of the chassis, the driving wheels and the balance wheels are respectively connected with two ends of the connecting parts, and when passing through the bumpy roads, the driving wheels and the balance wheels can swing left and right, and then the height of the forklift is adjusted.

title_en: Self-resetting turning floating sucker for robot clamping jaw
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a self-resetting turning floating sucker for a robot clamping jaw, which comprises the following components: a robot flange; the flange connecting seat is arranged at the bottom of the robot flange; the hydraulic buffers are symmetrically and longitudinally arranged on the flange connecting seat in a penetrating manner; the connecting rod is fixed at the bottom of the flange connecting seat; the mounting plate is hinged to the connecting rod, and the output end of the hydraulic buffer is propped against the surface of the mounting plate; the sucking disc mechanisms are arranged in a plurality, and the sucking disc mechanisms are symmetrically and longitudinally installed on the mounting plate in a penetrating mode. Be provided with hydraulic buffer, connecting rod and mounting panel, through its mutually supporting for sucking disc mechanism can angle regulation, thereby makes the sucking disc can adsorb and put back surface non-level or surface originally non-level work piece surface, and its simple structure is ingenious, and is with low costs, and scene suitability is strong.

title_en: Bag taking mechanism for bag bin
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bag taking mechanism of a bag bin, which comprises the following components: a bag bin bottom plate; the bag bin mechanism is arranged on the bottom plate of the bag bin; two groups of bag bin mechanisms are arranged on the bag bin bottom plate in parallel, each bag bin mechanism comprises two bag bin vertical plates, each bag bin vertical plate is slidably arranged on the bag bin bottom plate, and each bag bin vertical plate can accommodate a bag body; the bag bin adjusting mechanism is also arranged for adjusting the sliding of the two bag bins; the bag sucking mechanism is arranged below the bag bin mechanism, can move and adsorb the bag body at the bottom of the bag bin mechanism, changes the single-station single-bag packaging mode of the traditional vacuum packaging machine, realizes single-station double-bag filling and bag taking, and greatly quickens the production speed of single equipment.

title_en: Temporary spool protection device capable of being turned over
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a temporary spool protection device capable of being turned over, which comprises a protection seat, a threaded sleeve, a threaded rod, a hinge ring and an abutting plate, wherein the threaded sleeve is arranged on the protection seat; the center of the top end of the protection seat is provided with a center hole; a protective cavity with a downward opening is arranged in the protective seat, a vertical threaded sleeve is arranged in the protective cavity, and the threaded sleeve is fixedly sleeved in the central hole; the threaded rod is sleeved in the threaded sleeve, and both ends of the threaded rod extend out of the threaded sleeve; two limiting rings are fixedly sleeved at the lower end of the threaded rod; the hinge rings are rotationally sleeved on the threaded rod and distributed between the two limiting rings; the abutting plates are vertically arranged in a plurality of groups around the threaded sleeve; a first connecting rod is arranged between the abutting plate and the threaded sleeve, two ends of the first connecting rod are respectively hinged to the abutting plate and the threaded sleeve, a plurality of first connecting rods are vertically arranged at intervals in parallel, and the lengths of the first connecting rods are equal; two ends of the second connecting rod are respectively hinged on the abutting plate and the hinge ring, and the directions of the first connecting rod and the second connecting rod are opposite.

title_en: Roller type propelling device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a roller type propelling device, which comprises a base, a propelling rod, a rotating carrier roller and a propelling roller, and is characterized in that: the base is rotationally connected with a rotating carrier roller, the base is rotationally connected with two rollers, a power belt is connected between the two rollers, and a pushing rod is fixedly connected to the power belt, so that the beneficial effects of the utility model are as follows: the sliding friction of the sliding plate with the novel structure is changed into rolling friction of the roller, so that friction caused by friction is fundamentally solved, and the rolling of the roller can improve the propelling speed and the working efficiency.

title_en: Sanitary lifting type dish conveying lift car
abstract_en: The utility model provides a sanitary lifting type dish transferring car, which relates to the technical field of dish transferring cars and comprises a car body, wherein a sliding groove is formed in the inner wall of the car body, a slot is formed in the bottom end of the car body, a placing plate is connected to the inner side of the sliding groove in a sliding mode, a movable groove is formed in the bottom surface of the placing plate, an inserting block is connected to the inner side of the movable groove in a sliding mode, and a spring is sleeved on the surface of the inserting block. According to the utility model, through the structures of the carriage body, the sliding groove, the slot, the placing plate, the movable groove, the inserting block, the spring, the pull ring and the like, a worker can place dishes through the placing plate arranged in the dish conveying carriage, so that the worker only needs to quickly detach the placing plate from the carriage when the inside of the carriage needs to be cleaned, and then clean dishes and soup scattered in the placing plate, thereby improving the convenience of the worker in cleaning the inside of the dish conveying carriage, improving the cleaning effect and ensuring the cleanness and sanitation of the inside of the carriage.

title_en: Environment-friendly device applied to film blowing equipment of gold stamping film
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an environment-friendly device applied to film blowing equipment of a gold stamping film, which belongs to the technical field of gold stamping film blowing and comprises a supporting base, wherein the outer surfaces of one sides of two connecting plates which are towards each other are respectively connected with a storage roller and a guide roller in a rotating way, the outer surfaces of the storage roller and the guide roller are both wound with gold stamping film bodies, the top of the supporting base is provided with a limiting assembly, the limiting assembly is connected with a movable clamping assembly, a second driving motor is started in the process of winding the gold stamping film bodies and then can drive a two-way threaded rod to rotate, the two-way threaded rod drives two movable blocks to move oppositely/relatively in the rotating process, so that the clamping blocks on the two connecting blocks can be driven to clamp the gold stamping film bodies, rubber pads on the clamping blocks can prevent damage to the gold stamping film bodies, prevent the gold stamping film bodies from shifting in the winding process, and the matching of the rectangular grooves and the sliding blocks can limit the movable blocks, so that the quality of the gold stamping film in the winding process is improved.

title_en: Bottleneck external member and bottle lid
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the bottle cap field, which is used for solving the problem that the prior bottle cap cannot realize an anti-counterfeiting function under a high-temperature environment, and provides a bottle mouth kit and a bottle cap, wherein the bottle mouth kit comprises a connecting cylinder and a clamping cylinder, the connecting cylinder is used for being in threaded connection with an inner cover, the top wall of the clamping cylinder is connected with the bottom wall of the connecting cylinder, the side wall of the clamping cylinder is provided with an opening, the bottom wall of the opening is provided with a clamping piece, and the clamping piece is used for being clamped with the outer wall of a bottle lip and further comprises: the bottle neck is sleeved in the connecting cylinder, the outer side wall of the bottle neck completely covers the inner side wall of the connecting cylinder, the bottle neck and the connecting cylinder are integrally formed by injection molding, and the thermal deformation temperature of the clamping cylinder is higher than 100 ℃. According to the bottle mouth external member, the bottle mouth external member which is integrally made of PET is divided into two parts, the first part is made of a material with the thermal deformation temperature being higher than 100 ℃, and the bottle mouth is made of PET, so that the clamping piece cannot be softened in a boiled water environment, and the clamping stability with the bottle lip can be maintained.

title_en: Trolley with xy platform and annular production line
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a trolley with an xy platform and an annular production line, wherein the trolley comprises a platform base, a platform moving plate, an X-axis driving mechanism, a load mounting plate and a Y-axis driving mechanism; the platform base is fixedly arranged at the upper part of the trolley, and an X-axis guide rail is arranged on the upper surface of the platform base; the platform moving plate is arranged above the platform base in a sliding way through an X-axis guide rail, and a Y-axis guide rail is arranged on the upper surface of the platform moving plate; the X-axis driving mechanism drives the platform moving plate to move on the X-axis guide rail; the load mounting plate is arranged above the platform moving plate in a sliding way through the Y-axis guide rail, and the upper surface of the load mounting plate is used for placing a load; the Y-axis driving mechanism drives the load mounting plate to move on the Y-axis guide rail. According to the utility model, the platform moving plate is driven to move along the X axis by the X-axis driving mechanism, and the load mounting plate is driven to move along the Y axis by the Y-axis driving mechanism, so that the displacement of the load on the load mounting plate can be realized, the operation is convenient, and the working efficiency of the production line is improved.

title_en: Guiding device and conveying system for coating film of notebook shell
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of notebook shell processing, and discloses a guide device and a conveying system for film coating of a notebook shell. This guider and conveying system for notebook shell coating film through setting up the conveying board, conveniently carries out the material loading to the conveyer belt, through setting up the baffle, can avoid the notebook shell of material loading in-process to take place to drop, through setting up the hand wheel, can drive the screw rod and rotate, the screw rod drives the swivel nut and moves to the inboard, the swivel nut passes through the connecting rod and drives the deflector and move to the inboard, limit and direction are carried out the notebook shell through both sides blotter can not specification, avoid the notebook shell to take place the skew or drop.

title_en: Elevator car anti-falling device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of elevators, and discloses an elevator car anti-falling device, which solves the problems that in the using process of an elevator car, better anti-falling effect is inconvenient to achieve, and the elevator is caused to fall down to cause casualties, so that better safety is inconvenient to achieve; according to the elevator car, the better anti-falling effect can be achieved conveniently in the use process of the elevator car, the condition that the elevator falls to cause casualties is avoided, and therefore better safety is achieved conveniently.

title_en: Rubber belt conveyor
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of adhesive tape conveyors and discloses an adhesive tape conveyor, which comprises a device main body, wherein the device main body comprises a device frame, a transmission belt is arranged in the device frame, a motor body is arranged on the device frame and used for driving the transmission belt, and the device main body further comprises automatic cleaning mechanisms, and the number of the automatic cleaning mechanisms is two. The cleaning base, the cleaning cotton block and the reset spring are arranged, so that the cleaning cotton block can be attached to the outer surface of the transmission belt in actual use, the cleaning work of the outer surface of the transmission belt can be automatically completed when the transmission belt runs, pollution and cross are avoided, and the problems that most of traditional adhesive tape conveyors cannot automatically clean, and if materials which are easy to corrode, adhere or cause harmful substances exist in the conveying process, the substances possibly remain on the adhesive tape and pollute the materials which are conveyed later are solved.

title_en: Paint production filling paint bucket
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of paint barrels, in particular to a paint production filling paint barrel which comprises a barrel body, wherein a bottom plate is fixed at the lower part of the inner wall of the barrel body, a first roller shaft is rotatably arranged on the central point of the bottom plate in a penetrating way, a first scraping plate is fixed on the first roller shaft, a second scraping plate is fixed on one end of the first scraping plate far away from the first roller shaft, the paint is in a viscous liquid state, so that the paint is easy to remain on the barrel wall in the pouring and using process of the paint barrel and is inconvenient to scrape, the first scraping plate and the second scraping plate are clung to the inner wall to scrape the wall in a rotating way through a first rotating handle at the bottom of the bottom plate, and the paint can move out of the barrel body from the bottom of the inner wall of the barrel in a trapezoid structure and an inclined structure of the second scraping plate in the scraping process.

title_en: Multifunctional transfer tray
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of transfer trays, and provides a multifunctional transfer tray, which comprises: the tray assembly comprises a first tray body and a second tray body which are oppositely arranged, and the second tray is rotationally arranged on the first tray body; and the clamping assembly is arranged on the second disc body and comprises a first clamping piece, a second clamping piece and a third clamping piece, wherein the first clamping piece and the second clamping piece are oppositely arranged, the third clamping piece is arranged in a separated mode, the first clamping piece and the second clamping piece are provided with movable strokes which are close to or far away from each other along a first direction and are used for cooperatively clamping two sides of an article to be clamped, and the third clamping piece is provided with movable strokes which slide along a second direction and are used for clamping one end of the article to be clamped. The utility model provides a multifunctional transfer tray, which aims at solving the problems that the tray can not fix articles to be transferred in the prior art and the transfer is unstable. This multi-functional transportation tray can avoid the security risk that the people carried and bring when improving the compatibility, reduces personnel intensity of labour.

title_en: Intelligent storage robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an intelligent storage robot which comprises a driving base, wherein an adjusting mechanism is arranged on the driving base, the adjusting mechanism comprises a driving wheel arranged at the bottom of the driving base, a hydraulic cylinder is fixedly arranged at the top of the driving base, a bearing seat is fixedly arranged at the output end of the hydraulic cylinder, a double-shaft motor is fixedly arranged in the bearing seat, a screw rod is fixedly arranged on an output shaft of the double-shaft motor, and a movable cylinder extending to the outer side of the bearing seat is sleeved on the outer side of the screw rod. This intelligent storage robot, through the adjustment mechanism who sets up, under mutually supporting between each structure on the drive base, remove the bearing seat to the goods bottom with it hold up to adjust the size at bearing seat top according to the size of goods, thereby make the goods more stable transported, reduce the goods and take place to rock the emergence that leads to the condition such as goods collapse in transportation process, thereby help promoting the transportation efficiency of goods, save the transfer time.

title_en: Easily tear attached head and attached device
abstract_en: The utility model aims to disclose an easily-torn attaching head and an easily-torn attaching device, and relates to the technical field of display screen assembly, comprising a mounting seat and a clamping finger assembly arranged on the mounting seat, wherein the clamping finger assembly comprises a first clamping finger and a second clamping finger, the first clamping finger is provided with a first bending part, and the second clamping finger is provided with a second bending part; the first bending part is provided with a first inclined plane, and the first inclined plane is provided with a telescopic cylinder; the height of the first bending part is larger than that of the second bending part; the mounting seat is driven to rotate along the height direction through the first rotary servo motor, and the technical effects are as follows: the first bending part and the second bending part clamp the easy-tearing paste, and when the easy-tearing paste is attached, the telescopic cylinder presses the easy-tearing paste, so that the easy-tearing paste is more firmly attached to the display screen; through X axle moving assembly, Y axle moving assembly and Z axle moving assembly, make the attached head have multi freedom and remove, be convenient for realize pressing from both sides and get easily tear the subsides and paste easily tearing subsides.

title_en: Brick stacking machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a brick stacking machine which comprises a brick clamping mechanism, a brick placing platform, a brick placing plate, a frame, a guide rail assembly, a frame, a guide rail lifting cylinder, a lifting mechanism and an outer frame, wherein the guide rail lifting cylinder is arranged on the frame, the guide rail assembly is connected with the air guide rail lifting cylinder, one end of the guide rail assembly, which is far away from the guide rail lifting cylinder, is connected with the lifting mechanism, and the brick placing plate is arranged at one end of the frame, which is far away from the brick placing platform. According to the brick clamping mechanism, the brick is clamped by the brick clamping mechanism, the brick is fixed by the fixing frame to prevent the brick from falling, and the brick is clamped by the air cylinder and the clamping plate, so that the brick can be conveniently moved. The brick is framed through the frame that sets up on the brick place platform, prevents that the fragment of brick from dropping and shifting at the in-process that stacks.

title_en: Auxiliary carrying device for underground pipeline construction
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of underground pipeline construction and discloses an auxiliary carrying device for underground pipeline construction, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein an electric sliding rail is fixedly arranged at the top of the bottom plate, a moving plate is arranged at the top of the electric sliding rail, a traction assembly is arranged at the top of the moving plate, a positioning assembly is arranged at the bottom of the traction assembly, the electric sliding rail is used for dragging the moving plate to move along the horizontal direction, the traction assembly is used for dragging the positioning assembly to move along the vertical direction, and the positioning assembly is used for fixing the position of a pipeline. When the automatic pipeline positioning device is used, the electric sliding rail can pull the moving plate to move along the horizontal direction, the moving plate moves and drives the positioning assembly to integrally move to the top of a construction trench, the defects in the prior art are overcome, the full-automatic design is adopted, the old pipeline which needs to be replaced in the trench is greatly convenient for workers to move to the ground, and meanwhile, the new pipeline is convenient to move from the ground to the trench.

title_en: Freely-adjustable multi-axial lifting hook
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a free-adjustment multiaxial lifting hook, which comprises a loading beam, wherein two groups of rectangular notches are symmetrically formed in the loading beam; an adjusting part is rotatably arranged in the notch, a lifting hook main body is arranged on the adjusting part, and the lifting hook main body comprises a cylindrical part and a lifting hook part which are integrally formed; still including being used for carrying out the adjustment mechanism who adjusts to the lifting hook main part, adjustment mechanism is including being used for carrying out inclination's cylinder and being used for carrying out rotary adjustment's accommodate motor to the lifting hook main part, the cylinder is installed in one side of breach, accommodate motor installs the top at adjustment portion. This device can drive lifting hook main part through cylinder drive adjustment part and carry out inclination's regulation in order to block and break away from the hoist and mount object, drives lifting hook main part through accommodate motor and carries out the angular rotation and take off the card fast with rotatory mode, can carry out multiaxis regulation completion hoist and mount work in limited space.

title_en: Dustless feeding system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a dust-free feeding system, which comprises a frame, a ton bag chamber, a cantilever crane, a negative pressure dust remover and a negative pressure air delivery pipeline, wherein the frame is provided with a dust inlet pipe; the ton bag chamber is positioned at the upper part of the frame, and the top of the ton bag chamber is provided with a feeding door capable of being opened and closed; the cantilever crane is arranged at the top of the frame; the bottom of the ton bag chamber is connected with a bag opening chamber, and the side surface of the bag opening chamber is provided with a bag opening door capable of opening and closing; the bottom outlet end of the bag opening chamber is connected to a negative pressure air conveying pipeline through a blanking valve; the negative pressure dust remover is fixed on the frame, the top of the ton bag chamber and the bottom of the bag opening chamber are respectively connected with dust collection pipes, and the two dust collection pipes are respectively connected to the inlet end of the negative pressure dust remover; the bottom outlet end of the negative pressure dust remover is connected with a discharge valve, the bottom outlet end of the discharge valve is connected with a discharge pipe, and the lower end of the discharge pipe is connected to a negative pressure air delivery pipeline. The utility model relates to a multifunctional feeding station for dust-free feeding, dust-free bag releasing of ton bags, iron removal.

title_en: Constant-tension filament spreading device applied to filament bundle winding and sheet laying system
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of manufacturing of high-performance fiber unidirectional sheets, and particularly relates to a constant-tension filament spreading device applied to a filament bundle winding and sheet spreading system, which comprises a unwinding shaft, a constant-tension system, a heating and cleaning system, a filament spreading system and a gum dipping system, and is characterized in that: the unreeling shaft is connected with an unreeling servo motor shaft, the unreeling shaft is controlled to rotate through the unreeling servo motor, the unreeling shaft, the constant tension system, the heating and cleaning system and the wire expanding system are basically kept on the same horizontal plane and are sequentially arranged from front to back, the constant tension system is formed by combining a tension guide wheel, a tension wheel, a chute, an upper proximity switch and a lower proximity switch, and the tension wheel is driven by a wire bundle to move up and down freely in the chute.

title_en: Hoisting structure and hoisting system for large-scale hangar door
abstract_en: The application provides a hoisting structure and a hoisting system for a large-scale hangar door, and relates to the technical field of hoisting structures of hangar doors, wherein the hoisting structure comprises a first hoisting assembly and a second hoisting assembly; the first hoisting assembly comprises a hoisting rod body, two first sling pieces and two locking pieces; the hoisting rod body comprises a hoisting buckle part and a rod body part, locking grooves are formed at two ends of the rod body part respectively, and two penetrating through holes are formed in the rod body part; a hoisting through hole is formed on the hoisting buckle part; the first sling piece comprises a first sling and a plurality of first locking blocks which are arranged at intervals, and a second locking block is arranged in the locking groove; the locking piece comprises two locking plates and a plurality of fasteners, a plurality of locking through holes are formed in the locking plates, and a plurality of locking holes corresponding to the locking through holes one by one are formed in two ends of the rod body respectively; the second hoisting assembly is arranged in two, and is connected to the two first hoisting ropes respectively, and the second hoisting assembly is used for being bound with the large-scale hangar door in an unlocking mode.

title_en: Fixing frame for transferring hydraulic cylinder
abstract_en: The utility model provides a pneumatic cylinder shifts and uses mount, including two pairs of spill shells, the spill shell is two liang symmetries setting, be equipped with flexible buffer strip in the spill shell, be equipped with T template between each pair of spill shells that is located the homonymy, be equipped with a pair of pole of wearing on the T template, wear the both ends of pole and wear on the spill shell, the upper and lower both sides of T template are equipped with well bolster respectively, the outside end of T template is equipped with concave side piece, the both ends activity of concave side piece is equipped with the movable block, it has a pair of arm-tie to articulate on the outside end of movable block, the other end of arm-tie is equipped with the spliced pole respectively, the spliced pole is located on the spill shell. The middle position of the concave side piece is provided with a middle seat, a pulling screw rod is rotatably arranged on the middle seat, threads at two ends of the pulling screw rod are oppositely screwed, and two ends of the pulling screw rod are in threaded connection with the movable block. The hydraulic cylinder fixing device can safely and stably fix the hydraulic cylinder, avoids the risk of falling of the hydraulic cylinder during transferring and transporting, and is convenient to fix the hydraulic cylinder.

title_en: Full-automatic washing filling machine for barreled water
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a full-automatic flushing and filling machine for barreled water, which comprises a support base, wherein a base plate is fixedly arranged at the output end of a first electric telescopic rod, a connecting pipe is inserted at one side of one belt pulley, a first guide pipe is inserted at the bottom of the support base, a support ring is arranged on the outer wall of the connecting pipe in a sliding manner, spray heads are arranged on two sides of the top end of the connecting pipe in a rotating manner, and a connecting rod is arranged on one side of each of the two spray heads in a rotating manner; according to the utility model, in the flushing process, the supporting ring is pulled to lift by the first electric telescopic rod so that the supporting ring drives the spray head to rotate on the connecting pipe through the connecting rod, the plot angle of the supporting ring is changed, the supporting ring cannot directly flush against the bottom of the barrel, the height of the wall of the flushing barrel is adjusted by changing the inclination angle, the first motor is started again so that the connecting pipe is driven by the belt pulley and the belt strip to rotate in a reciprocating manner, the spray head can flush the periphery of the wall of the barrel, the wall of the barrel is cleaner, and the quality of the later-stage barreled water is improved.

title_en: Adaptation fixing device and interior inspection robot system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an adaptive fixing device and an internal inspection robot system, wherein the adaptive fixing device is used for being connected with a flange of a feeding port of a transformer oil tank, and comprises a connecting seat and two mounting parts, and the connecting seat is provided with a first connecting part and a second connecting part; the two mounting parts are respectively connected with the first connecting part and the second connecting part, and the end parts of the two mounting parts, which are away from each other, are used for being respectively inserted into the two mounting holes on the flange; wherein at least one of the two mounting parts is movable relative to the connection seat such that the distance between the mutually facing ends of the two mounting parts is adjustable. By adopting the structure, the adapting and fixing device can be suitable for flanges with different sizes, so that the flanges of the transformer oil tank feeding ports with different sizes can be installed by only one adapting and fixing device, the types of materials are fewer, and the cost is reduced.

title_en: Horizontal movement type grabbing device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a horizontal moving type grabbing device which comprises a track, wherein a sliding seat is arranged on the track and horizontally slides in the track, the top of the sliding seat is a cover plate, the bottom of the cover plate is fixed with a chain warehouse, the chain warehouse is positioned in the track, through grooves are formed in the front side and the rear side of the track, side plates are arranged on the front side and the rear side of the through grooves, the top of each side plate is fixed with the cover plate, a rigid chain is wound in the chain warehouse, the rigid chain consists of a plurality of unit chains with the same structure, the upper unit chain and the lower unit chain are connected to form the whole rigid chain, the bottom of the rigid chain is fixedly provided with a connector, and the tail end of the connector is provided with a grabbing device. According to the utility model, the shaking can be avoided within a certain extending length range, and the grabbing device can enable the rigid chain to realize horizontal movement by arranging the sliding rail, so that shaking can not occur.

title_en: Cleaning device for metal conveyor roller
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of roller cleaning, and discloses a cleaning device for a roller of a metal conveyor, which comprises a bottom plate and a bearing plate, wherein a cleaning mechanism is arranged on the upper surface of the bottom plate and comprises a sliding block, a connecting spring, a damper and a handle, and a rectangular groove is formed in the upper surface of the bottom plate. This kind of cleaning device for metal conveyor cylinder, the rectangular channel of seting up through the upper surface of bottom plate, according to the size pulling handle of cylinder, can slide the sliding block to corresponding position at the inner wall in rectangular channel, when the sliding block is gliding, not hard up handle, can be through the effect of the left side fixed mounting connecting spring of sliding block and attenuator, with the one side butt of butt piece and cylinder, the effectual problem of how to the not clear problem of cylinder centre gripping rotation of equidimension that has solved can reach the clean effect of being convenient for, simultaneously, can improve the accommodation in the reality to and improve the result of use in the reality.

title_en: Cigarette storage cabinet with movable separation device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cigarette storage cabinet with a movable separation device, which comprises a cabinet body and a plurality of separation plates, wherein a plurality of layers of horizontally arranged laminates are arranged in the cabinet body, the lower surface of each laminate is provided with a sliding rail, and the length direction of each sliding rail is consistent with the length direction of each laminate; the top of division board is equipped with the pulley, the pulley inlays to be established in the slide rail, and along the slide rail moves about to cut apart into a plurality of cigarettes and place the chamber with the storage space between the adjacent two-layer board, the cigarettes are placed the chamber and are used for depositing different types of cigarettes. According to the utility model, a set of cigarette storage device can be designed for a standard cabinet body for storing cigarettes of retail clients, the retail clients can automatically put cigarettes according to the number of the cigarettes in stock and the size of the cigarettes, the storage space of the cabinet body is optimized, the daily inventory making time of the retail clients is reduced, and the inventory making efficiency is improved.

title_en: Tube feeding mechanism of hose filling and tail sealing machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tube feeding mechanism of a hose filling and tail sealing machine, which comprises a bracket, a two-tube falling mechanism and a tube turning mechanism, wherein the bracket comprises a bottom plate, two upright posts and two support plates, and the two-tube falling mechanism is respectively arranged on the two support plates; the pipe turning mechanism comprises a rotating shaft, two pipe jacking mechanisms, two pipe baffle plates and two hose supporting cups, wherein the two axial ends of the rotating shaft are rotatably arranged on two upright posts, the two pipe jacking mechanisms are arranged on the two upright posts and are positioned on the outer sides of the outlet pipe ends of the two pipe dropping mechanisms, and the two hose supporting cups are arranged on the rotating shaft and are positioned on the outer sides of the outlet pipe ends of the two pipe jacking mechanisms. According to the utility model, the hoses are automatically dropped onto the pipe jacking seat after being sequentially distributed through the pipe dropping box, the pipe jacking seat jacks the hoses upwards to exceed the pipe blocking plate, so that the hoses fall into the hose supporting cup, the hose supporting cup performs 90-degree overturning action, so that the hoses are overturned from a horizontal state to a vertical state and fall onto a hose conveying pipeline from the supporting cup body, and automatic pipe feeding of the hoses is realized.

title_en: Rotatable multi-clack grab bucket
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rotatable multi-flap grab bucket, which comprises a bottom plate, a support column, a circumferential rotating mechanism, a lifting rotating mechanism and a grab bucket mechanism, wherein the bottom plate is movably connected with the support column, the circumferential rotating mechanism is installed on the support column, the lifting rotating mechanism is connected with the circumferential rotating mechanism, the grab bucket mechanism is installed below the circumferential rotating mechanism, the circumferential rotating mechanism comprises a first motor, a first rotating shaft, a main gear, an internal gear and a top frame, the lifting rotating mechanism comprises a first telescopic cylinder, a second motor, a second rotating shaft and a connecting plate, the grab bucket mechanism comprises a mounting block, a second telescopic cylinder and grab bucket blades, the circumferential rotating mechanism allows the grab bucket to rotate in a horizontal plane, so that the working direction of the grab bucket is changed, the grab bucket mechanism can work in a circumferential range, the grab bucket mechanism is multi-flap, the opening and closing state of the grab bucket blades can be adjusted according to requirements, and the equipment can process various objects.

title_en: Arc type dividing knife tool of soft tissue packing machine
