abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of packaging machines and discloses an arc type dividing cutter for a soft tissue packaging machine, which comprises an arc type cutter, wherein the arc type cutter comprises a mounting plate, a sliding strip, an auxiliary strip, an adjusting port, a mounting column, an arc groove, a circular arc, a mounting frame, an arc block, a threaded rod, an adjusting plate, a cutter body and a sliding groove, wherein the sliding strip is arranged at the top of the mounting plate, the adjusting port is arranged at the middle end of the bottom of the mounting plate, the arc blocks are arranged at the two sides of the mounting column, the arc grooves are arranged on the inner walls of the two sides of the adjusting port, the circular arc is arranged at the top of the adjusting port, the mounting frame is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the mounting column, the adjusting plate is arranged at one end of the threaded rod, and the cutter body is arranged at the bottom of the adjusting plate. This soft paper extraction packagine machine's arc formula dividing knife tool carries out position control through rotatory installing frame to the erection column, and arc piece aims at the arc wall and takes off the installing frame, and the regulating plate removes to installing frame both sides along with the spout, and rotatory cutter body can make the cutter body break away from the regulating plate bottom, changes the cutter body.

title_en: Film collecting equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of medical equipment accessories and discloses film collecting equipment, which comprises an upper end cross beam and a lower end cross beam, wherein the upper end cross beam comprises a groove area positioned in a left half area and a flat plate area positioned in a right half area, the groove area is provided with a plurality of grooves which are sequentially arranged at equal intervals, and the grooves are used for placing films; the lower end cross beam comprises a flat plate area positioned in a left half area and a groove area positioned in a right half area, the lower end cross beam and the upper end cross beam are identical in structure and opposite in placement direction, and the upper end cross beam and the lower end cross beam are connected through X-shaped brackets on two sides. The film collecting device disclosed by the utility model can simply and rapidly collect the films after electrophoresis experiments are finished, can simply classify the films, and is convenient to search and take.

title_en: Feeding mechanism of paperboard printing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of paperboard feeding, and discloses a feeding mechanism of paperboard printing equipment, which comprises a printing equipment main body, wherein a material bearing plate is fixedly arranged on the right side of the printing equipment main body, a feeding assembly is arranged on the right side of the printing equipment main body, and paperboard materials are arranged in the feeding assembly. This feeding mechanism of cardboard printing equipment through setting up electric putter and pushing plate, can be automatically with the direct pushing plate that goes up of that part cardboard material that is higher than loading plate level, for printing equipment main part provides material cardboard and is used for the printing, simultaneously, utilize motor and screw rod, make to lift the flitch and can drive the cardboard material and rise, make part cardboard material rise to the position unanimous with loading plate level, prepare for the feeding next time, and then shortened the required time of material loading, reduce the required workman's of material loading quantity, alleviate workman's amount of labour, further made things convenient for user's use.

title_en: Graphite electrode shifts cooperation mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a graphite electrode transfer matching mechanism, which relates to the technical field of graphite electrode production equipment and comprises a low-level rail, a high-level rail, a counter rail, a travelling groove, a sliding seat, a push rod, a lead screw, a sliding block, a first driving motor, a lifting cylinder, a moving plate, travelling wheels and a clamp, wherein the lower-level rail is arranged on the lower-level rail; the tail end of the low-level rail is provided with a high-level rail; a traveling groove is fixed below the high-level rail through a connecting rod, and extends to below the low-level rail; a moving plate is arranged between the travelling grooves; walking wheels are movably arranged in the corresponding walking grooves on two sides of the moving plate; a lifting cylinder is fixed at the bottom of the moving plate; the telescopic end of the lifting cylinder penetrates through the moving plate and is connected with the bottom of the clamp; by the mechanism, the offset of the graphite electrode is corrected while the high and low positions are converted.

title_en: Automatic unloading tongs of going up of module
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a module automatic feeding and discharging gripper, which comprises a gripper body and a gripper tail end arranged on the surface of the gripper body, wherein the gripper tail end is moved to be opposite to the position of a module through the gripper body, and feeding and discharging gripping of the module is completed through the gripper tail end; the gripper end comprises two circular arc clamping jaws on the first side and two bottom hooks on the second side; stable grabbing to the module can be achieved through circular arc clamping jaw and bottom claw cooperation, specifically, two circular arc clamping jaw can carry out spacing grabbing to the module from both sides, can follow the position of bottom through two bottom claws and carry out the bearing to the module, can further guarantee the module stability in last unloading in-process. The utility model can stably grasp the module from two sides of the module, and has good grasping stability and high grasping efficiency.

title_en: Material conveying balance mechanism of laminating machine
abstract_en: The utility model provides a material conveying balance mechanism of a film laminating machine, which relates to the technical field of film laminating machines and comprises a bottom plate, wherein a film laminating machine body is arranged on one side of the top end of the bottom plate, a winding mechanism is arranged on the other side of the top end of the bottom plate, an adjusting mechanism is arranged at the bottom end inside a mounting cavity, an adjusting cavity is arranged above the adjusting mechanism, a lower press roll is arranged at the bottom end inside the adjusting cavity, an upper press roll is arranged above the inside of the adjusting cavity, and a moving mechanism is arranged above the upper press roll; through being provided with adjustment mechanism in the inside bottom of installation cavity, utilize the mutually supporting between adjustment mechanism's the fixed chamber, servo motor, screw rod, swivel nut and the articulated pole, can adjust the high of adjustment chamber and handle, and then adjust the processing to the rate of tension of film when the rolling for the film appears tight state when the rolling, so make the film effect better when the rolling, thereby improved the practicality of this balance mechanism when using greatly.

title_en: A trade electric vehicle transportation guider and trade power station for trading power station
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification discloses a trade electric vehicle transport guider and trade power station for trade power station relates to trade electric technical field, trade electric vehicle transport guider including carrying guide assembly and motion spacing subassembly, carries guide assembly and trade electric vehicle to be connected, and motion spacing subassembly locates and trades electric vehicle on the plane of traveling, carries guide assembly and includes vehicle connecting piece and guiding mechanism, and vehicle connecting piece one end is docked with trading electric vehicle, and the other end is connected with guiding mechanism, and motion spacing subassembly has spacing guide surface, guiding mechanism rotatable edge spacing guide surface removes, drives and trades electric vehicle and remove to trade the electric station. The limiting guide surface in the motion limiting assembly is used for limiting the running process of the battery-powered vehicle, so that the position limitation of the vehicle in the running process is realized, the transportation of the vehicle in a flameout state is realized, the transportation process of the battery-powered vehicle is guided in the direction, and the guiding transportation is realized.

title_en: Medical equipment sterile environment preservation device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of medical equipment preservation devices, in particular to a medical equipment sterile environment preservation device which comprises a shell, wherein a placement structure is arranged on the shell, the placement structure comprises a placement frame, two placement frames are connected onto the shell in a sliding manner, a plurality of partition boards are connected onto the placement frame in a sliding manner, a first screw rod is connected onto the partition boards in a threaded manner, a butting block is connected onto the bottom end of the first screw rod in a rotating manner, the butting block is connected onto the partition boards in a sliding manner and is in butting against the placement frame, two sliding grooves are formed in the placement frame, two ends of the partition boards are respectively matched with the two sliding grooves in a sliding manner, and one end of each sliding groove is provided with an opening; can carry out the centre gripping conflict to medical equipment after medical equipment places save set in being convenient for to can effectually avoid medical equipment and save set to bump and damage at the in-process of transportation, the effectual security when having improved the transportation.

title_en: Adjustable finished raw material strip coil core fixing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an adjustable finished raw material strip coil core fixing device which comprises a fixing seat, wherein a flat sliding groove is formed in the fixing seat, a fixing block is arranged in the flat sliding groove, two arc-shaped abutting plates are arranged above the fixing seat, a sliding block is arranged below the arc-shaped abutting plates, and a spring is arranged between the fixing block and the sliding block.

title_en: Lithium battery double-speed chain line
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a lithium battery double-speed chain line, which relates to the technical field of double-speed chain lines, in particular to a lithium battery double-speed chain line, comprising two symmetrically placed protective shells, wherein the bottoms of the protective shells are fixedly connected with a plurality of uniformly equidistantly arranged supporting blocks; this lithium cell doubly fast chain line, through the setting of devices such as motor, push subassembly, transmission subassembly, conveyer belt and protection pad, when the staff places the lithium cell on the conveyer belt, can pass through transmission subassembly with its conveying to staff position department assemble it, before this, the staff can start the push subassembly, make it push the lithium cell on the conveyer belt to the middle part arrangement of conveyer belt, thereby make the putting of lithium cell comparatively neat and be convenient for the staff assemble it, and then reach convenient and fast, labour saving and time saving's effect, and the effectual work efficiency who improves the staff.

title_en: Forestry is with machine of watering
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a watering machine for forestry, which comprises a conveying frame, a vertical plate fixedly connected to the top of the conveying frame, and a water pipe winding wheel movably connected to the inner side of the vertical plate, wherein the front side of the vertical plate is provided with an intermittent tensioning structure, the left side of the vertical plate is provided with a transmission structure for driving the intermittent tensioning structure, and the intermittent tensioning structure comprises a gear arranged on the front side of the vertical plate. According to the utility model, the oscillating bar carries the tooth block to move to one side of the gear, when the tooth block is meshed with the gear, the water pipe winding wheel can be braked, and meanwhile, the water pipe winding wheel is carried and moved by the conveying frame, so that the water pipe released before is pulled and tensioned by the water pipe winding wheel, the effect of improving the unreeling mode of the pipeline on the surface of the existing irrigation machine is achieved, the pipeline is unreeled in a free rolling mode, the phenomenon that the pipeline is unnecessarily released due to stress is prevented, and the operation steps that a user needs to frequently pull and tension the pipeline are saved.

title_en: Viscose fiber oiling agent preservation equipment
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of viscose fiber oiling agents, in particular to viscose fiber oiling agent preservation equipment, which aims at the problems that a storage barrel is sealed by a threaded sealing cover in the prior sealing method, and when a single threaded sealing cover is used for sealing, the sealing effect is reduced because threads are easy to loosen.

title_en: A send a tub device for municipal administration water supply and drainage
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of municipal water supply and drainage pipes, in particular to a pipe conveying device for municipal water supply and drainage, which comprises a fixed frame, wherein a movable plate is arranged in the fixed frame, the lower end surface of the movable plate is fixedly connected with a plurality of limiting rings, the upper end surface of the fixed frame is provided with two air cylinders with output ends fixedly connected with the movable plate, the lower end surface of each limiting ring is provided with two sliding grooves distributed left and right, the lower end surfaces of two telescopic columns are respectively provided with limiting wheels, the pipes are pushed to the direction close to a conveying roller, the pipes are moved to the upper end surfaces of the conveying rollers, then the air cylinders push the movable plate to move downwards, the limiting rings are enabled to move downwards and contact with the pipes on the upper end surfaces of the conveying rollers, and meanwhile, the two limiting wheels are respectively positioned at the left side and the right side of the pipes through the sliding grooves and the telescopic columns, so that the pipes can have a limiting effect, and the pipes can be conveyed more smoothly, and the pipes are prevented from being offset in the conveying process.

title_en: Movable oiling platform
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mobile oil delivery platform, which comprises a platform main body, wherein two sets of upper loading crane pipes are arranged at the upper part of the platform main body, and two sets of lower loading crane pipes are arranged at the lower part of the platform main body; the upper loading crane pipe comprises an upper pipe fitting, an upper movable pipe is rotatably arranged at the end part of the upper pipe fitting, an upper oil filling pipe is rotatably arranged at the end part of the upper movable pipe, the same upper limit rod piece is arranged between the upper pipe fitting and the upper movable pipe, one end of the upper limit rod piece is rotatably arranged on the upper pipe fitting, and the other end of the upper limit rod piece is clamped on the upper movable pipe; the lower loading crane tube comprises a lower movable tube, the end part of the lower movable tube is rotatably provided with the lower oil filling tube, and the same lower limit rod piece is arranged between the lower movable tube and the platform main body. The movable oiling platform has a compact structure, can be stored in the structural style of the platform, can be integrally transported by a self-loading and unloading vehicle during transition transportation, and is also suitable for railway, waterway, aviation or flat-panel transportation vehicles.

title_en: Stop gear and silicon chip edge breakage detection device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of silicon wafer detection, and discloses a limiting mechanism and a silicon wafer edge breakage detection device. The silicon wafer conveying device has the beneficial effects that the silicon wafer conveying device can realize the silicon wafer conveying through the matching of the supporting frame, the power assembly and the conveying assembly, and can limit the conveying assembly through the effect of the limiting assembly, so that the distance between the two conveying assemblies can be conveniently adjusted by a worker, and the silicon wafers with different sizes can be conveyed; through the setting of auxiliary assembly and camera, can carry out the omnidirectional detection to the silicon chip, throw light on to the silicon chip through auxiliary assembly, realize that the camera observes the more careful to the silicon chip.

title_en: Automatic storage material storehouse of complete drawer type of door and window section bar
abstract_en: The utility model provides a complete drawer type automatic storage material warehouse for door and window profiles, which belongs to the technical field of door and window profile processing equipment and comprises a material storage rack and a support frame which are arranged oppositely, wherein one side, close to the support frame, of the material storage rack is provided with at least one layer of material storage layer, and an input material channel placement area and an output material channel placement area are arranged below the material storage layer; the lifting frame is vertically and slidably arranged on the supporting frame, the feeding frame is horizontally and slidably arranged on the lifting frame, and the feeding frame can be positioned above the storage layer and outside the storage layer in the process of horizontally sliding. The automatic sorting machine has the beneficial effects that the automatic sorting machine can assist the whole production line to realize automatic sorting, combination, automatic material taking, feeding and other actions, thereby reducing the labor intensity of workers and improving the production efficiency; the storage warehouse has the advantages of simple structure, good stability and the like, and can effectively reduce the manufacturing cost of the whole storage warehouse, shorten the manufacturing period of the whole storage warehouse and reduce the subsequent maintenance times.

title_en: Conveyer belt winder
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a conveyor belt coiling machine which comprises a frame, a rotating shaft, a blocking disc, a square tube, a coiling core mechanism, a roller group, a V-shaped pressing plate and a driving mechanism, wherein one end of the rotating shaft is detachably connected with a power output shaft of the driving mechanism through a quick clutch mechanism. The conveyor belt coiling machine is more convenient to operate, the rotating shaft in the middle of the conveyor belt and the driving device adopt the fast-assembling clutch device, the driving device and the coiled conveyor belt can be easily separated, a new rotating shaft can be replaced after the driving device and the coiled conveyor belt are separated, and the next batch of conveyor belt can be coiled; the belt blocking disc is arranged, so that the rolled conveyer belt is tidier; the stop roller and the press roller are arranged, so that the conveyer belt is prevented from deviating when being retracted and released; the driving mechanism is arranged at the side of the frame and can move quickly, so that a plurality of coil racks can share one set of driving device, and great cost of a user is saved; after the coiled conveyer belt is taken down from the frame, the coiled conveyer belt is convenient to transport and place.

title_en: Multifunctional short-range lifting mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of rail transit, in particular to a multifunctional short-distance lifting mechanism, which comprises a lower supporting piece, an upper supporting piece, a lifting supporting piece and a driving piece, wherein the upper supporting piece is fixedly/slidably arranged on a base body, is positioned above the lower supporting piece and is contacted with a main body to be lifted; the lifting support piece is rotationally connected with the lower support piece, and the rotation center of the lifting support piece is along the horizontal direction; the driving piece is arranged on the upper supporting piece, the driving piece is connected with the lifting supporting piece and drives the lifting supporting piece to rotate, and the lifting supporting piece drives the driving piece and the upper supporting piece to lift after rotating.

title_en: Device for producing a container with a beverage and a container closure provided or to be provided, and container produced thereby
abstract_en: An apparatus for producing a container with a beverage and a container closure provided or to be provided, and a container produced thereof, wherein the container closure has: a capping cap, a locking device arranged below the mouth at the container in a longitudinal direction of the container; a connecting section connecting the locking device with the cap; a first fixed portion and a second fixed portion, the connecting section being arranged at the locking device, the device having: a transport means, and an inspection means, which is adapted for determining a rotational orientation of the container closure with respect to the container and/or a rotational orientation of the container closure, whereby the device has an assembly means, which is arranged behind the inspection means in the transport direction, which assembly means assembles a label and/or stamp to the container, wherein the device is adapted and determined for the assembly of the container taking into account the rotational orientation or the screw direction of the container closure.

title_en: Tobacco stack die box and box packing and sealing machine
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of finished cigarette packaging, and discloses a cigarette stack die box and a box packing and sealing machine. The movable plate, the fixed plate and the bottom plate are welded on one side of the bottom plate, the bottom plate is installed on the bottom plate, the movable plate is arranged on the opposite side of the bottom plate, a U-shaped groove is formed by enclosing the movable plate, the fixed plate and the bottom plate, a cigarette stack is placed in the U-shaped groove, an arc-shaped arm is installed on the outer side of the U-shaped groove, a supporting plate is arranged on the lower side of the arc-shaped arm, a cylinder is installed in the bottom plate, the cylinder pushes a telescopic rod to reciprocate, the telescopic rod is fixed on the lower side of the supporting plate, a plug rod is installed on the bottom of the bottom plate, a bearing sleeve is installed at the bottom of the supporting plate, the axis of the plug rod is parallel to the axis of the telescopic rod, a fixing hole is formed in the bearing sleeve, and the plug rod is slidingly plugged in the fixing hole; the problem that movable side plates and fixed plates on YP18F box sealing machines can not clamp cigarettes in a cigarette stack in the prior art is solved.

title_en: Coal transportation train coal freezes separation heating device that unfreezes
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a coal freezing and thawing separation heating device of a coal transportation train, which comprises a door-shaped fixing frame, medium-frequency induction heating equipment and a central control cabinet, wherein the medium-frequency induction heating equipment is in linear connection with the central control cabinet, the bottom of one side of the door-shaped fixing frame is fixedly connected with a speed measuring sensor bracket, the front side of the bottom of the speed measuring sensor bracket is fixedly connected with a speed measuring sensor, induction coils are arranged on two sides of the inner wall of the door-shaped fixing frame, and one side of the door-shaped fixing frame is fixedly connected with a temperature measuring sensor bracket. The utility model can well solve the problem that the coal can not be unloaded when frozen, and can reduce the transportation cost and improve the operation efficiency through the heating thawing disengaging device with accurate temperature control; in addition, the utility model does not need to increase material consumption when heating and thawing, and the melted water can be extended to the guarantee of winter transportation of other water-containing materials.

title_en: Embedded detachable jigger structure of traction machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an embedded detachable jigger structure of a traction machine, which comprises a machine base, wherein a main shaft mounting hole for mounting a main shaft is axially formed in the center of the machine base, a groove is integrally formed in the outer side surface of one end, far away from the traction machine, of the machine base, a detachable jigger gear is mounted in the groove, and the jigger gear is mounted at the end part of the main shaft through a screw. The embedded detachable jigger structure has the advantages that the rear end of the machine base is designed to be concave, the aim of installing and using the jigger device on the existing tractor structure can be fulfilled by only adding one jigger gear and two fixing screws, the installation position of the jigger shaft can be changed by changing the installation hole position, the sizes, the modulus, the gear ratio and the like of the jigger gear and the jigger shaft can be changed, the application under different working conditions can be realized, the requirements on the rear space of the tractor are reduced, the problem that the tractor cannot be jigger due to structural design limitation or special requirements is solved, the safety coefficient is improved, and the cost is saved.

title_en: Transport machine for communication box production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of conveyors, in particular to a conveyor for communication box production, which comprises a hanging conveyor body, wherein a hanging rope is connected to the working moving end of the hanging conveyor body, a positioning assembly is connected to the other end of the hanging rope, the positioning assembly comprises a positioning plate, the top of the positioning plate is connected with the hanging rope, the lower surface of the positioning plate is fixedly connected with two guide plates, a driving shaft penetrates through the centers of the two guide plates, and first conical teeth are arranged at both ends of the driving shaft. The positioning assembly and the adjusting assembly are matched with each other, so that the box body of the communication box can be stably supported internally, the transportation stability of the communication box is ensured, meanwhile, the uniformity of the processing height range of the communication box can be ensured, the communication box can be stably supported and positioned by adapting to the box bodies with different lengths and sizes, meanwhile, the uniformity of the processing points of the communication box is ensured, and the use efficiency of the communication box is greatly improved.

title_en: Manual straight flute tap takes out equipment after breaking
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a device for taking out broken hand straight flute tap, which comprises a material taking head assembly and a positioning assembly, wherein a square connecting plate is arranged on the outer wall of the material taking head assembly, and a mechanical arm is arranged on the outer wall of the square connecting plate; the material taking head assembly comprises a limiting side plate and a motor, wherein the limiting side plate is arranged on the outer wall of the square connecting plate, the output shaft of the motor is fixedly connected with a connecting piece through a coupler, a bolt is arranged on the inner wall of the connecting piece, the material taking head is fixedly connected with the inner wall of the connecting piece through the bolt, and a limiting ring is arranged on the outer wall of the connecting piece; this take out equipment after straight flute tap breaks, through the setting of taking the first subassembly, in use, select suitable taking the stub as required, use through arm and hydraulic stem cooperation, adjust the position of taking the first subassembly, start and control motor, arm and hydraulic stem use, make to get the first inner wall of material and incomplete broken straight flute tap outer wall meshing be connected, increase the effect of forcing of incomplete broken straight flute tap outer wall.

title_en: Anti-falling assembly of escalator
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an escalator anti-falling component, which relates to the technical field of elevators and solves the problems of pinching and impacting and even falling risks caused by the fact that the upper body of an existing passenger stretches out of a handrail device when riding an escalator, wherein the escalator comprises trusses arranged on two sides of an escalator road and dado plate glass arranged on the trusses, and the trusses comprise reinforcing section trusses obliquely arranged and comb plate supporting frames arranged at two ends of the reinforcing section trusses; the outer sides of the two dado plate glass are provided with anti-falling assemblies, each anti-falling assembly comprises a plurality of guardrail posts and guard rails arranged between every two adjacent guardrail posts, the plurality of guard posts are uniformly distributed along the length of the truss, and the bottom ends of the guardrail posts are detachably connected to the truss; the escalator has the advantages of being simple in structure, convenient to process and install, and capable of effectively preventing risks such as falling, collision and squeezing when taking the escalator.

title_en: Tea packaging can
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of packaging cans, in particular to a tea packaging can, which comprises a can body, a containing cavity arranged on the can body, a cover body arranged at the upper end of the can body and positioned in the containing cavity, a fixing device arranged between the cover body and the can body and positioned in the containing cavity, liquid nitrogen filled on the can body and positioned in the containing cavity and used for volatilizing to generate nitrogen to improve the fresh-keeping effect of tea when the cover body is fixed on the can body, a sealing piece arranged between the cover body and the can body and positioned in the containing cavity, an inclined ring block fixedly arranged on the can body and positioned in the containing cavity, and an inclined ring plate arranged at the lower end of the cover body, wherein the side end of the cover body and the upper end of the can body are in clearance fit; an adjusting device is arranged between the cover body and the upper end of the inclined annular plate.

title_en: Logistics storage cabinet capable of preventing water and moisture
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of logistics storage equipment, in particular to a waterproof and moistureproof logistics storage cabinet; technical problems: when the logistics storage cabinet is used, the closed storage cabinet is generally adopted to store goods, and can block part of rainwater, but a plurality of gaps exist at the same time, and when the rainfall is large or the wind speed is large, the gaps can also cause water seepage, so that the goods are water-in, the performance of the goods is influenced, and even the goods are damaged; the technical scheme is as follows: a logistics storage cabinet capable of preventing water and moisture comprises a drying component, a shielding component and a sealing component; compared with the prior art, the closed storage cabinet is used for storing goods, water seepage is caused by the existing gaps, so that the goods are affected by water inflow, the performance of the goods is affected, and even the goods are damaged.

title_en: Electric power construction winding device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electric power construction winding device which comprises a winding table, wherein an adjusting mechanism is arranged above the winding table, a containing mechanism is arranged above the adjusting mechanism, a pressing mechanism is connected above the winding table, a pre-bending mechanism is connected above the winding table, the height of the winding device is adjusted according to the use condition of the electric power construction winding device through the adjusting mechanism arranged on the winding table, workers can conveniently perform winding treatment on cables used for electric power construction at different heights, and meanwhile, the pre-bending mechanism arranged on the winding table is convenient for performing auxiliary pre-bending treatment on the cables used for electric power construction winding, so that the installation efficiency during electric power construction is improved.

title_en: Paper sleeve waste material cleaning device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the utility model provides a paper sleeve waste cleaning device, which comprises two rollers which are arranged close to each other, wherein the two rollers are used for supporting and rotating a paper sleeve; the slideway is arranged between the two rollers and is used for conveying the paper sleeve; the pneumatic valve is arranged on any one of two sides of the two rollers, which are far away from each other, and is connected with the roller, which is close to the pneumatic valve, through an air cylinder, and the air cylinder is used for controlling the two rollers to be far away from each other and reset; before the two rollers are far away from each other, the two rollers are arranged in parallel, and a gap is arranged between the paper sleeve and the slideway; after the two rollers are far away from each other, the paper sleeve contacts the slideway and rolls relatively. According to the utility model, the paper sleeve is supported by the two rollers, and the paper sleeve can be rotated by the two rollers, so that the waste materials of the paper sleeve can be cleaned.

title_en: Feeding structure for meat pigeon breeding and mixing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a feeding structure for meat pigeon breeding and mixing materials, and belongs to the technical field of feed processing. The feeding structure for meat pigeon breeding and mixing also comprises a plurality of anti-slip stickers fixedly arranged on the upper side of the spiral auger; a plurality of rows of ventilation holes are fixedly formed between two adjacent anti-slip stickers by the spiral auger; a charging port is fixedly arranged on the outer side of the lower shell; the lower shell is clamped with a filter screen at a position corresponding to the charging port; the outer side of the lower shell is fixedly provided with an air heater; a hot air pipe is fixedly arranged between the lower shell and the hot air blower; the supporting block is fixedly provided with a vent hole; the lower shell is provided with a feeding hole; the lower shell is communicated with the inner side of the air heater through a hot air pipe and a feeding hole; by arranging the spiral auger and the air holes and matching with the air heater, the feed raw material is dried during feeding, and meanwhile, the hot air flow can only flow upwards, so that the feed raw material is primarily prevented from sliding off; through the anti-slip paste arranged on the spiral auger, the feed raw material is prevented from slipping off in the rotation process of the spiral auger.

title_en: Portal crane walking control device
abstract_en: The application discloses a gantry crane walking control device, and belongs to the technical field of cranes. A gantry crane walking control device comprises a gantry crane main body; the remote control cabinet is arranged at the bottom of the gantry crane main body; the cameras are arranged at the end part of the gantry crane main body and are provided with a plurality of cameras; the control assembly comprises a monitoring panel, an arc-shaped plate is fixedly connected to the end of the monitoring panel, a fixed garment is fixedly arranged at the end of the arc-shaped plate, and a controller is arranged below the monitoring panel. According to the application, the monitor panel and the controller can be separated up and down through the design of the clamping connection rod, so that the height of the monitor panel can be increased, the monitor panel can be conveniently watched by eyes, and the controller can be conveniently operated by hands through the downward design of the controller, so that a worker can more conveniently operate, and the distance between the monitor panel and the controller can be adjusted through the design of the clamping connection block and the clamping connection rod.

title_en: Transformer core sheet tray storage
abstract_en: The utility model provides a storage warehouse of a transformer core sheet tray, which aims to solve the problems that storage of material columns occupies a large area, stacking storage of the material columns and transfer efficiency is low. The utility model mainly comprises a plurality of storage stations which are adjacently arranged, wherein each storage station comprises upright posts which are oppositely arranged, a first conveying line and a second conveying line which are vertically spaced are arranged between the upright posts, one upright post is shared between the adjacent storage stations, each of the first conveying line and the second conveying line comprises a plurality of sub conveying lines, and a tray is arranged on each sub conveying line. When the storage device is used, the storage device is used for storing the material column in a three-dimensional mode, so that the occupied area is reduced, the storage warehouse can also automatically feed and transport, unmanned storage, warehouse in-out and warehouse turnover can be realized by matching with the RGV transfer trolley, and the efficiency is improved.

title_en: Paper machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a paper machine, which has the technical scheme that: including the paper machine body, one side fixed mounting of paper machine body has two first backup pads, one side fixed mounting of paper machine body has the PLC controller, one side of paper machine body is provided with the wind-up roll, changes the subassembly, it is left to change the subassembly setting be located one side of first backup pad is used for right the wind-up roll is changed, it includes first fixed plate to change the subassembly, first fixed plate fixed mounting is left in one side of first backup pad, the bottom surface fixed mounting of first fixed plate has the second backup pad, uses through setting up the mutually supporting of paper machine body, first backup pad, first fixed plate, second backup pad, driving motor, screw thread post, fixed orifices, fixed slot and first movable plate, can reach the purpose of changing the wind-up roll, and the process of changing is comparatively convenient, has saved strength.

title_en: Intelligent roll-to-roll laser marking machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent roll-to-roll laser marking machine which is characterized by comprising an unreeling mechanism, a reeling mechanism and a laser marking system, wherein the reeling mechanism comprises a reeling motor driving device, an air expansion shaft and a roll material edge adsorption connecting device, the motor driving device is connected with the air expansion shaft, and the roll material edge adsorption connecting device is arranged at the tail end of a blank reusable roll material and used for connecting the blank reusable roll material with a marking roll material, so that unnecessary loss in the roll material production process can be reduced. The utility model has good stability and convenient collection, and can reduce unnecessary loss in the production process of coil stock.

title_en: Cam-driven vegetable soup circulation vegetable separating machine
abstract_en: The utility model provides a cam-driven vegetable soup circulation vegetable sorting machine which comprises a vegetable containing device, a cutter cam device, a baffle cam device and a rack, wherein the cutter cam device is arranged on the frame; the dish containing device comprises a closing-in container, a quantitative die and a sealing part, wherein the closing-in container is of a structure with wide upper part and narrow lower part, and the shape of the closing-in container is similar to a V-shaped structure; the quantitative volume of the quantitative mould is not unique, and the quantitative moulds with different volumes can be replaced as required; the sealing component consists of a sealing chute and a sealing strip, and plays a role in sealing the left straight slot of the closing container; the cutter cam device and the baffle cam device drive a cutter in the closing container and a baffle under the quantitative die to do reciprocating motion through a cutter connecting rod and a baffle connecting rod respectively by a cam structure; the lower end surface of the baffle is connected with a soup storage box for collecting the soup, and then the collected soup is sent to the recovery port container again through a pump, so that the reciprocating circulation of the soup is formed. The utility model can solve the problem that the strip dishes are not separated well and the problem that the soup is concentrated at the bottom of the container.

title_en: A separate case for agricultural product vegetables storage is fresh-keeping
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a separate box for storing and preserving agricultural products and vegetables, which comprises a box body, grid plates and supporting tubes, wherein fixing cylinders are arranged at four corners of the box body, bolts are arranged at the centers of front end faces of the fixing cylinders, first grooves are formed in two sides of the top end face of the box body, the grid plates are arranged at the bottom end face of an inner cavity of the box body, first protruding blocks are formed in two sides of the bottom end face of the box body, the supporting tubes are sleeved on the inner surfaces of the four groups of fixing cylinders, a water collecting tank is arranged at the bottom end face of one group of box bodies, and a glass cover is arranged at the top end face of the box body. This a separate case for agricultural product vegetables storage is fresh-keeping, the separate case divide into three and can provide good ventilation nature and air cycle, helps keeping the freshness of vegetables and extension fresh-keeping period, places different kinds or vegetables of different varieties respectively in different cases, and when piling up the separate case through the bolt dismantlement stay tube, three-layer separate case can closely stack together, saves storage space.

title_en: Weighing screw rod packagine machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of weighing type screw packaging, and discloses a weighing type screw packaging machine, which comprises an equipment body, wherein a storage hopper for storing materials is arranged on the upper side of the equipment body, a discharging pipe for discharging is arranged at the bottom end of the storage hopper, the storage hopper is communicated with the discharging pipe, a hanging rod for placing a container is movably arranged on the side part of the equipment body, the discharging pipe is arranged on the upper side far away from the hanging rod, a heat sealing rod for sealing is arranged on the front side of the hanging rod, the heat sealing rod is contacted with the hanging rod through pushing of a pushing cylinder, a supporting rod is arranged on the front side of the equipment body, a fixing plate for fixing the pushing cylinder is arranged on the side part of the supporting rod, a rotating mechanism for rotating the heat sealing rod is arranged between the fixing plate and the heat sealing rod, and the hanging rod is meshed with a heat sealing plate by the abutting cylinder, so that when a plastic packaging belt is sealed each time, the heat sealing of the plastic packaging belt can be continuously sealed due to the fact that a plurality of surfaces of the heat sealing rod are arranged.

title_en: Drawing box
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a drawing box, which comprises a drawer box and a shell, wherein the shell is positioned at the outer side of the drawer box; the inside inner panel that is connected with through the tripe of shell, inner panel bottom and drawer box top contact, inner panel one end is provided with spacing arch, spacing arch extends to drawer box inside. When the drawer box is pulled out, the left side plate of the drawer box hooks the inner plate to drive the swing blades to move in the pulling direction, and the patterns of the shutter are patterns on the right side surface of the shutter; when the drawer box is pushed into the drawer box, the swinging blades are driven to move in the pulling direction, and the patterns of the shutters are patterns on the left side surfaces of the shutters at the moment; the utility model enhances the aesthetic property and the interest of the packaging box.

title_en: Packing box
abstract_en: The application provides a packing box, which relates to the technical field of packaging and comprises an outer box and at least two inner boxes, wherein the outer box comprises a box body, a cover body and a locking assembly, the peripheral sides of the inner boxes are respectively provided with a first buffer piece, at least one partition board is movably inserted into the inner boxes, the partition board divides the inner boxes into at least two accommodating cavities, and a second buffer piece is arranged between every two adjacent inner boxes; according to the packing box, different numbers of partition boards can be inserted into different positions of the inner box according to actual use requirements, so that different numbers and different sizes of accommodating cavities are obtained, different materials can be conveniently placed and packed in a separated mode, the materials are prevented from being mutually collided and damaged or mixed and scattered, the materials with different sizes are conveniently placed, and the applicability of the packing box is improved; the cover body and the box body can be locked and fixed by arranging the locking component, so that the carrying and storage of the packaging box are facilitated; through setting up first bolster and second bolster, promote the buffering damping performance of packing box, improve the protection to the material.

title_en: Conveying roller cleaning device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of conveying roller cleaning, and discloses a conveying roller cleaning device, which comprises a cleaning head, wherein a groove body is arranged on the cleaning head; the first end of the main body rod piece is connected with the cleaning head; wherein, the cell body can hold rubber tyer and main part in first direction, and the cleaning head can be in the removal of third direction along main part, and first direction is perpendicular with the third direction. In this scheme, offer one can hold the rubber tyer and the cell body of main part of conveying roller in the first direction on conveying roller cleaning device's the cleaning head for the cleaning head can remove the pollutant on the rubber tyer through the relative movement of cell body side and rubber tyer surface, simultaneously, the cleaning head can remove and get rid of the pollutant along conveying roller's main part in the third direction through the cell body plane. The cleaning head can enable the cleaning device to be used as a dual-purpose cleaning device for cleaning the conveying roller main body and the rubber wheels, and the cleaning efficiency of the conveying roller is greatly improved.

title_en: Material collecting device for plastic woven cloth production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a material collecting device for plastic woven cloth production, which comprises a base, wherein a dust removing box is arranged on the upper surface of the base, a dust collecting box is arranged on the right side surface of the dust removing box, the lower surface of the dust collecting box is fixed with the upper surface of the base, two first connecting rods are arranged on the front side surface of the dust removing box, a feeding roller is arranged on the opposite side of the two first connecting rods, through holes are formed in the front side and the rear side of the dust removing box, firstly, dust on the upper surface and the lower surface of the plastic woven cloth can be subjected to electrostatic dust removal by an electrostatic dust removing rubber roller, dust with high adhesion can be cleaned by a fixed brush and a movable brush, telescopic rods are arranged at four corners of the lower surface of the movable brush, the fixed brush and the movable brush can be attached to the upper surface and the lower surface of the plastic woven cloth, dust with high adhesion on the upper surface and the lower surface of the plastic woven cloth can be cleaned loose, the subsequent plastic woven cloth can be wound more smoothly, wrinkles can not occur, the practicability is high, and time and labor are saved.

title_en: Printing ink production storage device
abstract_en: The application provides an ink production and storage device, and belongs to the technical field of ink production. The ink production and storage device includes a storage assembly. The storage component comprises a storage tank, a kick type temperature control switch, a connecting pipe, an electric heating pipe, a motor and an electric slip ring, when the ink temperature is reduced to the action temperature value of the kick type temperature control switch during use, the electric heating pipe can heat ink, the motor can drive the connecting pipe to rotate, the ink can be uniformly heated, when the temperature of the ink reaches the reset temperature value of the kick type temperature control switch, the kick type temperature control switch is disconnected, the power supply to the motor and the electric slip ring is stopped, the ink is stopped to be heated, the electric heating pipe is driven by the motor to rotate in real time, the ink can be timely and uniformly heated, and the thermal insulation effect is good, so that the ink is not easy to be influenced by low temperature.

title_en: Plastic film winding device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a plastic film winding device, which belongs to the technical field of film processing, wherein a second rotating roller and a supporting frame are rotationally connected between second support posts, a first rotating roller is rotationally connected to the supporting frame, a stop block is fixedly connected to the first rotating roller, a winding mechanism is rotationally connected to the first support posts, the winding mechanism comprises a driving motor, a rotating shaft, a first sliding block, a first connecting rod, a spring, a second sliding block, a second connecting rod, a connecting block and a fixed block, the driving motor drives the rotating shaft to rotate, the first sliding block slides in a first sliding groove, the second sliding block slides in a second sliding groove, the spring is arranged on the inner wall of a through hole, the first connecting rod and the second connecting rod are rotationally connected to the second sliding block, and the other ends of the first connecting rod and the second connecting rod are respectively rotationally connected to the first sliding block.

title_en: Anti-tilting electric forklift
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of logistics forklifts, and particularly relates to an anti-toppling electric forklift, which comprises: the forklift comprises a forklift body, wherein a vertically arranged lifting bracket is fixedly connected to one side of the forklift body, a lifting mechanism is arranged on the lifting bracket, a lifting arm base is connected to the lifting mechanism in a transmission mode, the lifting arm base is in sliding connection with the lifting bracket, two lifting arms are arranged on one side, away from the lifting bracket, of the lifting arm base, and the two lifting arms are horizontally and parallelly arranged; the lifting arm base is provided with the shell body in the opposite both sides, and the shell body is located the top of lifting arm, and sliding connection has the flexible arm in the shell body. The utility model can effectively prevent the fork truck from tilting/dumping the materials during the transportation of the materials.

title_en: Safety auxiliary device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a safety auxiliary device, which comprises a fixed plate; the front surface of the fixing plate is rotatably provided with an extension mechanism, the front surface of the extension mechanism is fixedly provided with a support frame, one end of the inner wall of the support frame is fixedly provided with an anti-falling mechanism, the inside of the support frame is rotatably provided with a winding mechanism, and the outer side of the winding mechanism is wound with a safety rope main body; the extending mechanism comprises a bidirectional screw rod, a sleeve, a connecting rod and a connecting seat; according to the utility model, the bidirectional screw, the sleeve, the connecting rods and the connecting seat are matched for use, the sleeve can be driven to move by the rotation of the bidirectional screw, when the opening and closing angles of the two groups of connecting rods on the front of the sleeve are maximum, the supporting frame can be positioned on the front of the fixed plate, the device is stored, the occupied space is reduced, and when the opening and closing angles of the two groups of connecting rods on the front of the sleeve are reduced, one end of each connecting rod can be driven to drive the supporting frame to extend out for use, so that the device is beneficial to personnel.

title_en: Dried meat slice cleaning and drying device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a dried meat slice cleaning and drying device which comprises a cleaning assembly, a feeding assembly and a stripper plate, wherein the cleaning assembly comprises an outer housing, a driving part and a filter material mechanism, the driving part is arranged on the outer housing, the filter material mechanism is rotatably arranged in the outer housing, the feeding assembly is movably arranged on the outer housing, the feeding assembly comprises a hollow sleeve, a sealing cover plate, a movable shaft rod, a positioning frame and a material conveying mechanism, the positioning frame is movably arranged on the outer housing, the hollow sleeve is movably arranged on the positioning frame, the movable shaft rod is movably arranged in the hollow sleeve, the sealing cover plate is detachably arranged on the hollow sleeve, the material conveying mechanism is arranged on the movable shaft rod, the material conveying mechanism is movably arranged in the filter material mechanism, and the stripper plate is arranged on the outer housing. Therefore, dried meat slices with different sizes can be screened in the process of cleaning the dried meat slices, and the processing efficiency of the dried meat slices is improved.

title_en: Arbitrary gate gift box
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an arbitrary door gift box, which comprises a top box, a bottom box, surrounding edges and inner supports, wherein the surrounding edges are arranged between the top box and the bottom box, the inner supports are adhered to the inside of the top box and the bottom box, the top box consists of a paperboard A, a paperboard B, facial tissues a and facial tissues B, the side of the paperboard A is adhered to the paperboard B, the facial tissues a are pasted on the outer surface of the paperboard A, the facial tissues B are pasted on the surface of the paperboard B, the paperboard A and the facial tissues a are hexagonal, the paperboard B is long-strip-shaped, and six groups of the paperboard B are distributed in the interior of the paperboard B. This arbitrary door gift box combines arbitrary door theory, fuses make-up product and packing carton, saves the plastic packaging of non-environmental protection, and designs a gift box structure, solves current gift box and lacks interactive characteristics, adds for the product of brand side, also lets the consumer feel the charm from the packing carton simultaneously, gives it additional value beyond the purchase product.

title_en: Oil separation filling machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an oil separation filling machine, which relates to the field of seasonings and comprises a treatment tank body, wherein a supporting upright rod is uniformly abutted to the bottom surface of the treatment tank body, a bottom guide hopper is horizontally welded on the bottom surface of the treatment tank body, an end fixing box is horizontally and fixedly arranged at one end of the treatment tank body, a control panel is fixedly clamped on the outer side edge of the treatment tank body, a top feeding hopper is fixedly welded on the top surface of the treatment tank body, a discharging pipe body is welded at one end of the treatment tank body, which is far away from the end fixing box, a transmission motor is horizontally and fixedly arranged on the inner side edge of the end fixing box, an isolation inner layer is fixedly arranged on the inner side edge of the treatment tank body, a heat preservation inner layer is fixedly arranged on the inner side edge of the isolation inner layer, and a heating wire is fixedly clamped on the inner side wall of the heat preservation inner layer.

title_en: Safety carrying frame for multi-medicine sample inspection
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of medicine transportation, in particular to a safety carrying frame for multi-medicine sample inspection, which comprises a carrying frame, wherein a plurality of loading grooves are formed in the carrying frame, a protection component for protecting medicines is arranged in the loading grooves, the protection component comprises a supporting table arranged in the loading grooves, an extension frame is arranged at the bottom of the supporting table, through grooves are formed in the plurality of loading grooves, sliding grooves are formed in two ends of the through grooves, two connecting rods are arranged in the through grooves, push rods are arranged at one ends, close to the sliding grooves, of the two connecting rods, cavities are formed in two sides of the inner walls of the loading grooves, springs and clamping plates are arranged in the cavities, and soft rubber mats are arranged on one sides of the clamping plates. The utility model realizes the separation placement of the medicines, can prevent the cross contact infection of the medicines, increases the wrapping force on the container when shaking occurs, reduces the shaking amplitude and improves the transportation stability.

title_en: Cable processing surface protection layer spraying processing device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of spraying treatment devices, in particular to a cable processing surface protection layer spraying treatment device, which comprises a bottom plate; support blocks are fixedly connected at the edges of four corners of the upper end of the bottom plate, support rings are fixedly connected on two support blocks on different sides together, dust-proof cylinders are fixedly connected on the inner walls of the two support rings, and supporting frames are fixedly connected at the front end and the rear end of the bottom plate. According to the utility model, paint is sprayed out of the spray head pipe and downwards from the spray head body through the arc-shaped pipe, so that paint is sprayed out of the outer wall of the cable, excessive paint can be blown down onto the third U-shaped block under the action of downward wind force of the fan, then the residual paint can fall down into the recycling box to be recycled through the through hole, part of paint can slide down along the cambered surface of the upper protection block and the cambered surface of the lower protection block, and spraying is performed in a relative sealing space of the dustproof barrel, so that dust can be reduced from falling onto the cable, and the spraying protection on the cable is improved.

title_en: Automatic get material tilting mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic material taking and overturning mechanism which comprises an underframe, a sliding rail, a transverse moving frame, a transverse moving motor, a gear and a rack, wherein the sliding rail is respectively arranged on two sides of the underframe, the rack is arranged in the middle of the underframe, the transverse moving frame is arranged on the sliding rail through a sliding sleeve, the transverse moving motor is arranged on the transverse moving frame, the gear is arranged on an output shaft of the transverse moving motor, the gear is meshed with the rack, the automatic material taking and overturning mechanism also comprises an overturning oil cylinder, a central rotating shaft, an overturning frame, a cantilever plate oil cylinder and a cantilever plate, one side of the bottom of the overturning frame is connected with the transverse moving frame through the central rotating shaft, and a cylinder body of the overturning oil cylinder is connected with the bottom of the overturning frame through the rotating shaft; the cantilever plate oil cylinder is arranged on the transverse moving frame, the cantilever plate is connected with a telescopic shaft of the cantilever plate oil cylinder, and the cantilever plate is vertical to the transverse moving frame. The automatic material taking and overturning mechanism can complete the material taking, carrying, overturning and conveying work of coiled materials at one time, and improves the production efficiency and the automation level.

title_en: Automatic unpacking, distributing and transferring device for steel pipes
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic unpacking and distributing transfer device for steel pipes, which comprises a material rack, wherein the top of the material rack is abutted to a bundling steel pipe, an unpacking trolley is arranged above the bundling steel pipe, a packing belt cutting device and a pipe inserting device are arranged on the outer wall of the unpacking trolley, the bottom of the unpacking trolley is connected with a unpacking cart in a sliding manner, a falling device is arranged at the tail part of the material rack, and a material turning mechanism is arranged between the falling device and the material rack; the steel pipe unpacking and distributing device is reasonable in structural design, can adapt to different unloading positions and steel pipe stacking positions, achieves automatic unpacking, distributing and transferring of bundled steel pipes, improves the efficiency of unpacking, distributing and transferring of the steel pipes, improves the working efficiency by adopting automation, saves labor cost and reduces safety risks.

title_en: Transport case convenient to inside restriction
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a transport case convenient for internal limitation, which relates to the technical field of transport cases and comprises: the novel box comprises a box body and a partition board, wherein the top of the box body is connected with a box cover through a hinge, a lock catch is connected between the box cover and the box body, and the partition board is arranged in the box body. This transport case convenient to inside restriction when using can be according to the user demand, install the inside of box with the baffle, and the baffle is when the motion, it is rotatory through the rack drive gear, it is convenient to carry out spacingly to the position of baffle, then through loosening the pull rod, make the pull rod drive fixture block and gear engagement, also make the gear unable rotate, just so that the baffle can't move along the recess of box this moment, play limiting displacement to the baffle, thereby the person of facilitating the use adjusts the position of baffle, and make the transport case have the effect of layering, conveniently carry out the layering and put, this is the use characteristics of the transport case of this inside restriction of being convenient for.

title_en: Storage device is used in flour production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a storage device for flour production, which relates to the technical field of flour production equipment and comprises a storage barrel, a barrel cover, a controller, a sealing cover and a partition plate, wherein the upper side wall of the storage barrel is connected with the barrel cover through bolts, the controller is arranged on the upper side wall of the barrel cover, the sealing cover is arranged at a feed inlet of the upper side wall of the barrel cover, the inner side wall of the storage barrel is fixedly connected with the partition plate, a transport pipe is arranged on the lower side wall of the partition plate, an electromagnetic valve is arranged on the outer side wall of the transport pipe, the input end of the electromagnetic valve is electrically connected with the output end of the controller, a cleaning component is arranged on the inner side wall of the storage barrel, a metering component is arranged on the inner wall of the bottom side of the storage barrel, and the metering component is arranged under the partition plate. According to the utility model, the scraping plate of the cleaning assembly can clean the inner wall of the storage barrel, the stirring rod can stir the flour in the storage barrel to avoid caking of the flour, and the metering assembly can carry out bearing on the flour and then take out the flour, so that the flour can be taken out conveniently by a required amount.

title_en: Hoisting device for port
abstract_en: The application relates to a lifting device for a port, which relates to the technical field of lifting equipment and comprises the following components: a hanging seat; the hoisting assembly comprises a hanger plate, a bidirectional screw rod and a motor; a stabilizing assembly including a stabilizing portion; the two hanging plates are arranged on the hanging seat in a sliding manner along the directions of approaching or separating from each other, the ends of the two hanging plates, which are far away from the hanging seat, are fixedly provided with hook heads, the two hook heads are positioned on one sides of the two hanging plates, which are close to each other, the bidirectional screw rod is rotationally connected with the hanging seat, the left-handed section and the right-handed section are respectively threaded on the two hanging plates, and the motor is arranged at one end of the bidirectional screw rod; the stabilizing parts are arranged in two, are symmetrically arranged on the hanging seat relative to the sliding direction of the hanging plate, and are used for propping against the machined plate. The application has the effect of reducing the sliding risk of the stacked machined plates in the port lifting process.

title_en: Jacking translation dolly
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a jacking translational trolley, which comprises a flat trolley, wherein the periphery of the bottom of the flat trolley is fixedly connected with first idler wheels, the top of the flat trolley is provided with a jacking structure, the periphery of the top of the jacking structure is fixedly connected with telescopic rods, the top of the telescopic rods is fixedly connected with a material box, the jacking structure comprises a box body, the output end of the motor is rotated to drive a rotary rod to rotate clockwise through a starting motor, the rotary rod rotates to drive the frame to move left to drive the connecting block and the trapezoidal block to move left, the trapezoidal block moves left to extrude the second roller to drive the vertical block to move upwards, the vertical block moves upwards to drive the material box to move upwards, the jacking effect is achieved, the jacking translation trolley has the advantage of jacking, the stability of the flatbed is improved, and the problem that a user is time-consuming and labor-consuming when the material box is manually lifted to a processing position is avoided.

title_en: Automatic filling machine for producing crystal color stone
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic filling machine for producing crystal color stone, which belongs to the technical field of filling machines and comprises the following steps: the base, base top fixed mounting has U type frame, the inside both sides fixed mounting of U type frame has the fixed plate, one side fixed mounting that two fixed plates are close to each other has the storage case, storage case bottom is provided with the shower nozzle, base top fixed mounting has the rectangle case, the inside rotation of rectangle incasement is connected with two-way screw rod, two movable blocks of two screw rod outside threaded connection have, two movable blocks both sides all articulate there is the actuating lever, four actuating lever one side articulates there is the rectangle piece, rectangle piece top fixed mounting has the rectangular plate, the inside slip grafting of rectangular plate has four swash plates. According to the utility model, the periphery of the container can be clamped through the mutual coordination among the rectangular box, the second motor, the bidirectional screw rod, the moving block, the driving rod, the rectangular block, the rectangular plate, the inclined plate, the connecting rod and the clamping plate, so that the container is clamped more stably.

title_en: Food packaging cup
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a food packaging cup which comprises a first cup body, a second cup body, a first paper support and a second paper support, wherein a first cup brim is arranged at the opening edge of the first cup body, a second cup brim is arranged at the opening edge of the second cup body, the first cup body is mutually meshed with the second cup body, the first cup brim is closely jointed with the second cup brim, a containing area is arranged between the first cup body and the second cup body, the second paper support is arranged on the first paper support, and the first cup brim and the second cup brim are clamped between the first paper support and the second paper support, so that the sealing performance of food packaging is improved, the risk of pollution to food in the transportation process is reduced, and the food safety is ensured.

title_en: Adjustable feeding frame for paper tube production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an adjustable feeding frame for paper tube production, which comprises a device main body, wherein the bottom of the device main body is provided with a device main body cavity, the centers of two sides of the top of the device main body cavity are connected with side baffles in a sliding way through second sliding rails, and the front surface of the bottom of the device main body cavity and the centers of the sides of the bottom of the device main body cavity are connected with lifting rods in a sliding way through first sliding rails.

title_en: Dishing system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tray loading system which comprises a bottle feeding conveyor belt, a buffer conveyor belt and a transition conveyor belt, wherein a tray loading machine is in butt joint with the bottle outlet end of the transition conveyor belt, and the bottle feeding conveyor belt, the buffer conveyor belt and the transition conveyor belt are connected through a junction platform. The tray loading system has the advantages of increasing the buffer capacity, improving the overall bottle feeding efficiency and the like.

title_en: Storage device for water sample detection for tap water plant
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a storage device for detecting water samples for a tap water plant, which belongs to the technical field of tap water storage equipment and comprises a storage plate, wherein the top end of the storage plate is respectively inserted with a water sample barrel through a plurality of grooves formed in the storage plate, the bottom end of the water sample barrel is fixedly connected with a magnetic plate II, the bottom end of the magnetic plate II is slidably connected with a rubber block, the bottom end of the rubber block is fixedly connected with a magnetic plate I, the bottom end of the magnetic plate I is fixedly connected with a movable plate, both sides of the movable plate are fixedly connected with limiting plates, the sides of the limiting plates are slidably connected with the storage plate, both ends of the movable plate are fixedly connected with pulling plates, both sides of the pulling plates are fixedly connected with limiting blocks, the top ends of the limiting blocks are inserted with inserting rods through grooves formed in the storage plate, and the top ends of the inserting rods are fixedly connected with movable blocks.

title_en: Magnetic suspension conveying device for conveying smoke boxes
abstract_en: The application relates to a magnetic suspension conveying device for conveying smoke boxes. The magnetic suspension conveying device for conveying the smoke box comprises a support, a mounting frame fixed at the upper end of the support, a conveying groove arranged above the mounting frame, a permanent magnet fixed at the bottom of the conveying groove, and an electromagnet arranged between the permanent magnet and the mounting frame; the upper ends of the supporting blocks are in rolling connection with the bottom surface of the conveying groove through balls, and the lower ends of the supporting blocks are fixedly connected with the mounting frame. The traveling wave magnetic field generated by the electromagnet enables the permanent magnet to drive the conveying groove to move, so that the smoke box is conveyed; the application replaces the traditional chain plate conveying by magnetic suspension conveying, thereby avoiding the problem that the whole chain needs to be maintained or replaced because the chain is easy to be worn due to friction among the chain wheel, the chain and the chain plate in the traditional chain plate conveying.

title_en: Cellulose ether ejection of compact dust keeper
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cellulose ether discharging dustproof device, wherein a dustproof box is arranged at the bottom of a discharging hole, and a treatment box is arranged at one side of the dustproof box; the top of the dust box is provided with a dust collection pipe which extends into the processing box from the dust box, and the part of the dust collection pipe, which is positioned in the processing box, is provided with a dust collection fan; in the discharging process, cellulose ether dust can be dispersed in the dust box, at the moment, the dust suction fan is started, and absorbs the cellulose ether dust dispersed in the dust box through the dust suction opening arranged on the dust suction pipe, so that the cellulose ether dust in the dust box can be effectively sucked into the treatment box, and the working environment is further ensured; and secondly, after dust is sucked into the treatment box, spraying pipes arranged at the inner top of the treatment box spray mist water drops, the mist water drops and cellulose ether dust are combined and settled at the bottom of the treatment box, after the mist water drops are settled for a period of time, clean water is introduced to flush out and collect the mist water drops into a collecting barrel, and the mist water drops can be dried and utilized again.

title_en: Compressor piston dismouting frock
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a compressor piston disassembling tool. Comprising the following steps: the mounting base is fixedly arranged at the upper edge of the compressor; the vertical beam is vertically arranged, and the lower end of the vertical beam is connected with the mounting base; the sliding rail beam is horizontally arranged and axially parallel to the piston of the compressor, and the front end of the sliding rail beam is connected with the upper end of the vertical beam; and the lifting pulley is axially and movably arranged on the slide rail beam and is connected with a piston of the compressor, and is used for driving the piston to horizontally move so as to detach the piston. The beneficial effects of the utility model are as follows: the piston is provided with a mounting base, a vertical beam, a slide rail beam, a lifting pulley and a chain block, and is used for driving the piston to horizontally move so as to detach the piston.

title_en: Reagent transport case for preventing CK-MB reagent raw material transport process from toppling over
