abstract_en: The utility model relates to a reagent transport box for preventing CK-MB reagent raw materials from toppling over in the transport process, which belongs to the technical field of CK-MB reagent transport and comprises a box body, wherein a cover plate is arranged on the box body, a locking device is arranged on the cover plate, a fixing device is arranged in the box body, the fixing device comprises a first fixing plate and a second fixing plate, two ends of the first fixing plate and the second fixing plate are welded in the box body, a plurality of limiting holes are formed in the first fixing plate and the second fixing plate, CK-MB reagent pipes are inserted in the limiting holes, sealing caps are connected to the CK-MB reagent pipes in a threaded mode, a damping device is arranged in the box body, the CK-MB reagent pipes can be vertically fixed in the box body through the fixing device arranged in the box body, the box body cannot be damaged by vibration in the transport process, and the use efficiency of the transport box is improved.

title_en: Multidimensional adjustment transfer equipment and transfer system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a multidimensional adjustment transfer device and a transfer system, which comprise: the lifting adjusting mechanism comprises a frame body, a screw rod and at least one driving connecting rod group, wherein the frame body comprises a base and a top plate, and the driving connecting rod group comprises a first driven rod and a second driven rod; the rotary bearing mechanism comprises a turntable and a bearing assembly, the bearing assembly comprises a mounting plate and a sliding plate, and the sliding plate moves along the length direction of the mounting plate. According to the utility model, the lifting adjusting mechanism is used for carrying and adjusting in the height direction, and meanwhile, the bearing surface of the lifting adjusting mechanism is subjected to angle adjustment and extension movement through the rotary bearing mechanism, so that the multi-dimensional adjustment in height, angle and length can be realized based on the structural arrangement.

title_en: Battery wire box cover feeding assembly and cover device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a battery wire box cover feeding assembly and a cover device, and relates to the technical field of solar battery assembly. The battery box cover feeding component comprises a feeding container and a driving mechanism; the feeding container is used for accommodating a plurality of wire box covers and is provided with a discharge hole; the output end of the driving mechanism is provided with a pushing piece, and the pushing piece is used for moving under the driving of the driving mechanism so as to push the plurality of wire box covers to the discharge hole in sequence. The battery wire box cover feeding assembly is matched with the pushing piece through the driving mechanism, and a plurality of wire box covers in the feeding container can be sequentially pushed to the discharge hole, so that automatic discharging of the plurality of wire box covers is realized, the plurality of wire box covers are not required to be manually carried, and the wire box cover efficiency is effectively improved.

title_en: Wire feeding equipment for cable processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses wire feeding equipment for cable processing, which relates to the technical field of cable processing and comprises a vehicle body, wherein a rotary disk is rotatably and movably installed above the vehicle body, a sliding groove is formed above the rotary disk, two groups of installation racks are relatively and slidably installed in the sliding groove in front and back, two groups of belt pulleys are movably installed at the left end and the right end of the inside of the installation rack respectively, V-shaped belts are installed between the belt pulleys in a tensioning mode, and a conveying cable is clamped between the two groups of V-shaped belts. According to the utility model, the trolley body is lowered to a designated position by pulling the pull handle in cooperation with the universal wheel, then the universal wheel is locked, and the relative distance between the two groups of mounting frames is adjusted by starting the second motor under the rotation of the bidirectional screw rod, so that the two groups of V-shaped belts can be suitable for cables with different specifications, when the conveying angle needs to be adjusted, the first motor is started, and the rotating angle of the rotating disc is adjusted under the cooperation of the gear and the gear ring, so that the device can be suitable for different working conditions.

title_en: Convenient to use's diffuser installation assists utensil
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of diffuser installation auxiliary tools, and discloses a diffuser installation auxiliary tool convenient to use, which comprises a base, wherein a first support frame is fixedly arranged on one side of the upper end of the base, first slide rails are fixedly arranged at the front end and the rear end of the upper end of the base, a second slide rail is fixedly arranged in the middle of the upper end of the base, a gear disc is rotatably arranged at the upper end of the second slide rail in a rear-side rotating way, a second support frame is slidably arranged at the upper ends of the two first slide rails and the second slide rail, a first flange is arranged at the upper end of the first support frame, a second flange is arranged at the upper end of the second support frame, a lifting mechanism is fixedly arranged at one side of the upper end of the base in the front, and a connecting mechanism is fixedly arranged in the middle of the upper end of the base. According to the utility model, through the cooperation of the lifting mechanism and the connecting mechanism, the height and the interval of the second support frame with the first support frame are adjusted, so that the engine and the diffuser are more convenient to install.

title_en: Automatic boxing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides automatic boxing equipment which comprises a feeding mechanism, a shifting mechanism, a sucking boxing mechanism, a packaging box conveying line and a PLC (programmable logic controller) control system, wherein the feeding end of the feeding mechanism is connected with a discharge hole of a heat shrinkage furnace, the shifting mechanism is arranged on one side of a discharging end of the feeding mechanism, a boxing station is arranged at one end of the shifting mechanism, which is far away from the feeding mechanism, the discharging end of the carton conveying line is arranged below the boxing station, the sucking boxing mechanism is arranged above the boxing station, and the PLC control system is respectively and electrically connected with the feeding mechanism, the shifting mechanism, the sucking boxing mechanism and the packaging box conveying line. The utility model has the beneficial effects that: the equipment can automatically arrange the support products subjected to thermal shrinkage operation in the thermal shrinkage furnace and move the support products into the packaging box for boxing and box sealing operation, manual participation is not needed, the packaging speed is greatly improved, the labor intensity of staff is reduced, and the enterprise benefit is improved.

title_en: Cold-proof film storage device with insect prevention effect
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of cold-proof film storage, in particular to a cold-proof film storage device with an insect prevention effect; technical problems: the existing cold-proof film storage device usually adopts a method of placing insecticide to expel insect pests, and the folding surface of the cold-proof film is easy to become a warm bed for survival of a small amount of insects and moulds, so that the cold-proof film is polluted; the technical scheme is as follows: a cold-proof film storage device with insect-proof effect comprises a movable component, a control component, a fixed component, a carbon dioxide component, a sealing component and an insecticide component; compared with the traditional cold-proof film storage device, the cold-proof film storage device has the advantages that insect pests and mold are easy to breed on the folding surface of the cold-proof film in the storage process, so that the damage of the cold-proof film is caused, the insect pests and mold are comprehensively prevented from breeding by adopting a living environment inhibition and insecticide method in the cold-proof film storage device, carbon dioxide is filled in the box to enable the insect pests and mold to suffocate and die, and then the camphor balls are used for emitting odor to prevent external insects from entering and polluting the cold-proof film.

title_en: Yarn conveying frame convenient to tensioning is adjusted
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a yarn conveying frame convenient to tension and adjust, which comprises a workbench and a side frame, wherein yarn limit conveying mechanisms are arranged on two sides of the side frame, a tension preliminary adjusting mechanism is arranged on the side frame and is fixedly connected with one side of the bottom end of an L-shaped limit sliding plate, a tension fine adjusting assembly is arranged on the other side of the top end of the L-shaped limit sliding plate, the fine adjusting assembly comprises a rotating button, a screw rod and a nut sliding block, the rotating button is welded at the top end of the screw rod, the side wall of the top end of the screw rod is rotationally connected with the top end of the L-shaped limit sliding plate, the side wall of the screw rod is in threaded connection with the inner part of the nut sliding block, the nut sliding block is welded at one end of an adjusting rotating shaft, and the fine adjusting assembly is arranged on the tension preliminary adjusting mechanism and is matched with the tension preliminary adjusting mechanism so as to accurately adjust the tension of yarn conveying, and improve the tension and adjusting precision of yarn conveying and adjusting efficiency.

title_en: Double-layer threading mechanism for bundling stacked materials and bundling equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a double-layer threading mechanism and strapping equipment for strapping stacked materials, the double-layer threading mechanism comprises a movable frame, a first driving piece, an upper threading device and a lower threading device, wherein the first driving piece is configured to drive the movable frame to transversely move, the upper threading device and the lower threading device are arranged on the movable frame, the upper threading device comprises a second driving piece and an upper threading assembly, the second driving piece drives the upper threading assembly to move into one pier corner of a pallet of an upper layer material and form an upper threading channel bypassing the pier corner at the corresponding pier corner, the lower threading device comprises a third driving piece and a lower threading assembly, the third driving piece drives the lower threading assembly to move into one pier corner of a pallet of a lower layer material and form a lower threading channel bypassing the pier corner at the corresponding pier corner, and the double-layer threading mechanism respectively realizes automatic threading of the pier corner of the upper layer material and the pier corner of the lower layer material and has high working efficiency.

title_en: Bucket elevator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bucket elevator, which belongs to the technical field of conveying machinery and comprises a base, wherein a shell and a cleaning assembly are assembled on the upper end face of the base, and the cleaning assembly is positioned on one side of the bottom of the shell. The bucket elevator has the advantages of convenient cleaning of residual materials, simple and convenient operation and prolonged service life of equipment, the first sliding block which is arranged on the outer part of the threaded screw rod in a meshed sliding way drives the cleaning brush arranged on the upper part to slide in the travel range of the threaded screw rod, the residual materials at the bottom of the shell are cleaned, finally the materials are discharged from the rectangular opening arranged at one side of the bottom of the shell, the accumulation and accumulation of the materials are avoided, the cleaning and sanitation of the equipment are ensured, the corrosion and damage of the residual materials to the equipment are reduced, the service life of the equipment is prolonged, the cleaning brush can be driven to perform reciprocating cleaning by controlling the second driving motor, the operation is convenient, the cleaning maintenance can be periodically performed, and the workload of manual cleaning is reduced.

title_en: Multi-section mechanical clamping jaw
abstract_en: The utility model provides a multi-section mechanical clamping jaw which comprises a first stepping motor, a connecting disc connected with a motor shaft in the first stepping motor, a second stepping motor arranged on the connecting disc, a first connecting plate with one end connected with the motor shaft in the second stepping motor, a third stepping motor arranged on the connecting plate, a connecting frame with one end connected with the motor shaft in the third stepping motor, a fourth stepping motor with the motor shaft connected with the other end of the connecting frame, a bearing plate connected with a shell in the fourth stepping motor, a fifth stepping motor arranged on the bearing plate, a second connecting plate connected with the motor shaft in the fifth stepping motor and a clamping jaw mechanism arranged on the second connecting plate. According to the multi-section mechanical clamping jaw, the position of the clamping jaw mechanism in the mechanical clamping jaw is positioned through the cooperation of the first stepping motor, the second stepping motor, the third stepping motor, the fourth stepping motor and the fifth stepping motor, the position and the angle of the clamping jaw mechanism are adjusted more conveniently and rapidly, and the mechanical clamping jaw can operate more efficiently and flexibly.

title_en: Packaging sheet with anti-sticking outer surface layer
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an outer surface anti-sticking packaging sheet, which comprises a sheet body, wherein an opposite inserting block is arranged on the left side of the sheet body, an opposite inserting groove matched with the opposite inserting block is arranged on the right side of the sheet body, the opposite inserting block can be inserted into the opposite inserting groove, the sheet body comprises a base layer, an outer film layer is arranged on the outer side of the top of the base layer, an outer anti-sticking surface layer is arranged on the outer side of the top of the outer film layer, an inner film layer is arranged on the outer side of the bottom of the base layer, and an inner anti-sticking surface layer is arranged on the outer side of the bottom of the inner film layer. When the sheet bodies are matched in pairs, the structure of the opposite inserting blocks and the opposite inserting grooves can be combined together, so that the sheet bodies are convenient to use.

title_en: Chemical fiber production master batch conveying mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a masterbatch conveying mechanism for chemical fiber production, which comprises a base, wherein a conveying cavity is arranged on the base transversely, a conveying auger is arranged in the conveying cavity, a feed inlet connected with the conveying cavity is arranged at the upper part of the base, a feed hopper is arranged above the feed inlet, a discharge outlet is arranged at the front end of the conveying cavity, and is connected with a soft conveying pipe.

title_en: Filling equipment is used in production of organic water-soluble fertilizer
abstract_en: The utility model relates to filling equipment for organic water-soluble fertilizer production, which comprises a mounting bracket, wherein a conveying belt mechanism is arranged on the inner side of the mounting bracket, a driven gear is rotatably connected to one side of the mounting bracket, the driven gear is fixedly connected to the conveying belt mechanism through a rotating shaft, a conveying motor is fixedly connected to one side of the mounting bracket, a main shaft of the conveying motor is fixedly connected to a driving gear through a coupler, the driving gear is a sector gear, the driving gear and the driven gear are in meshed connection, and the conveying filling bottles with fixed time and distance can be conveyed through the cooperation of the driven gear and the driving gear.

title_en: Novel cleaning machine
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of cleaning machines, in particular to a novel cleaning device which comprises a connecting frame, a cleaning main body and a wire spool, wherein the cleaning main body and the wire spool are arranged on the connecting frame, the wire spool comprises a left disk, a right disk and a wire pipe, a left connecting piece is formed on the left disk, a right connecting piece is formed on the right disk, both the left connecting piece and the right connecting piece are provided with a mounting part and a mounting groove, the mounting part comprises a left mounting part and a right mounting part, the mounting groove comprises a left mounting groove and a right mounting groove, the left mounting part and the left mounting groove are arranged on the left connecting piece, the right mounting part and the right mounting groove are arranged on the right connecting piece, the left connecting piece is connected with the right connecting piece through the mounting part and the mounting groove, the wire pipe is wound on the left connecting piece and the right connecting piece, the wire spool is simpler in structure and more convenient in connection relation, and the left disk and the right disk are symmetrically arranged, and only one side of the left disk and the right disk are required to be opened when being opened.

title_en: Be used for slag miropowder to carry shedding mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model provides a conveying and discharging mechanism for slag micro powder, which relates to the technical field of slag micro powder discharging and comprises a discharging box, wherein a first discharging hole and a second discharging hole are respectively formed in two sides of the outer wall of the discharging box, a baffle plate is fixedly connected to one side of the inner wall of the discharging box, a storage hopper is fixedly arranged at the top of the discharging box, a conveying cylinder is fixedly connected to the bottom end of a second motor, a stirring rod is connected with a spiral blade through a belt, when the spiral blade rotates to push slag micro powder out of the conveying cylinder, the stirring rod simultaneously rotates in the storage hopper, so that a blanking hole is prevented from being blocked due to powder agglomeration in the storage hopper, larger slag in powder can be separated by a screen mesh at the top of a screening plate, slag can slide out from the first discharging hole, the larger slag can be screened and separated by a guide plate, and an eccentric wheel arranged at the bottom of the screening plate can vibrate a screening net, and the screening efficiency of separation is improved.

title_en: Overflow and back suction type filling head
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an overflow back suction type filling head which comprises a filling part, wherein an inner air passage and an outer liquid passage are arranged in the filling part, the inner air passage is arranged along the height direction of the filling part, an air outlet, an air suction port and a mixing port are sequentially arranged in the height direction of the filling part, liquid outlets are uniformly distributed around an air outlet pipe, the liquid outlets are higher than the mixing port, and a photoelectric liquid level sensor is arranged at the bottom of the filling part. When the liquid level is detected to drop, the air outlet is opened, so that the air outlet and the air suction port form reflux, the liquid in the liquid level is prevented from being continuously absorbed, and the effects of overflowing, flowing back, sucking and improving the mixing effect of the liquid and the air are achieved.

title_en: Box for collecting power supply and cables
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of medical equipment, in particular to a box body for collecting power supplies and cables, which comprises a box body. According to the utility model, the round head threaded knob is screwed, the box cover is opened, equipment is placed in the box body, cables of the equipment penetrate out of the box body through gaps formed between the two corresponding semicircular holes, the box cover is covered, when the cables of the equipment are more, the pull handle is pulled, the pull handle drives the connecting plate to move upwards through the vertical rod, the connecting plate drives the inclined block to move upwards, the round rod slides out of the corresponding round groove, then the movable block moves downwards, when the round groove moves to the next round rod, the pull handle is loosened, the movable block is fixed, the gaps become larger at the moment, and similarly, when the round groove is matched with the round rod at the lowest, the gaps are the largest, so that the sizes of the holes for accommodating the cables can be adjusted, more cables can be accommodated and tidied, the practicality is higher, the operation is simpler, and the movable block can be adjusted quickly.

title_en: Winding device for superfine fiber towel processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a winding device for processing superfine fiber towels, which comprises a winding frame, wherein one end of the winding frame is provided with a feed inlet, two vertical plates which are symmetrically arranged are fixedly connected to the inner wall of one end of the winding frame, one side of each vertical plate is fixedly connected with a bearing, one side of each vertical plate is fixedly connected with a motor, the output end of each motor is fixedly connected with a shaft rod, one end of each shaft rod penetrates through the vertical plate and is fixedly inserted into the bearing, the other bearing of each vertical plate is fixedly inserted with a supporting rod, a winding roller is arranged between each shaft rod and each supporting rod, a rotating rod is fixedly inserted into each winding roller, grooves are formed in each shaft rod and each supporting rod, and positioning rods are fixedly connected into the grooves.

title_en: Material conveying device and PCB (printed circuit board) testing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of PCB testing, and relates to a material conveying device and PCB testing equipment. The material conveying device comprises a conveying mechanism and a plate arranging mechanism, wherein the conveying mechanism is used for conveying materials along a first direction, the plate arranging mechanism comprises a driving assembly, a first base, a second base, a first clapping plate and a second clapping plate, the first base and the second base are oppositely arranged on two sides of the conveying mechanism along a second direction, the first clapping plate and the second clapping plate are oppositely arranged along the second direction, the first clapping plate is slidably connected onto the first base along the second direction, the second clapping plate is slidably connected onto the second base along the second direction, the first direction is not parallel to and not collinear with the second direction, and the driving assembly is used for driving the first clapping plate and the second clapping plate to move oppositely or move reversely. The material conveying device can shape and center the material.

title_en: Crane supporting leg position detection device and detection system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a crane landing leg position detection device and a crane landing leg position detection system, and belongs to the technical field of engineering machinery. The technical problem that a magnetostrictive sensor is arranged inside a supporting leg so as to be inconvenient to assemble, disassemble and maintain in the prior art is solved. The crane landing leg position detection device comprises a guide flange arranged on the outer wall of a landing leg oil cylinder barrel and a support piece arranged at the end part of the landing leg oil cylinder rod, wherein a magnetostrictive sensor is arranged on one side, away from the landing leg oil cylinder barrel, of the support piece, a piston rod is arranged on the guide flange, a magnetic ring is arranged at one end, close to the support piece, of the piston rod, and the piston rod, the magnetostrictive sensor and the magnetic ring are coaxially arranged. The utility model has the beneficial effects that the detection device is arranged outside the supporting leg oil cylinder, the magnetostrictive sensor is arranged in the detection device, and the reliability of the magneto sensor is stronger while the overhaul is convenient.

title_en: Aluminum profile upright post for lifting mechanism of logistics robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an aluminum profile upright post for a lifting mechanism of a logistics robot, which comprises two columns, wherein the aluminum profile upright post is manufactured by adopting an extrusion process, the weight is light, the strength is high, the upright post is designed into a cavity structure, the material weight is reduced on the premise of meeting the use strength of related structures, the upright post is designed into a C-shaped groove structure which is used as a roller running rollaway path of the lifting mechanism, the C-shaped groove structure is integrally formed by adopting a die, the size is stable, the lifting motion is smooth, the upright post is designed into a national standard connecting groove structure, the left upright post and the right upright post are connected into a closed frame structure through standard aluminum profiles, a straight connecting strip and corner fittings, the structure is simple and firm in connection, the upright post is designed into a cavity avoidance structure, the synchronous belt of the lifting mechanism can be connected in a surrounding manner through the cavity, the appearance of the whole is guaranteed, the aluminum profile upright post structure is high in integration level, the function is perfect, and the manufacturing precision is high, and the production efficiency is high.

title_en: Spiral conveying equipment for separating sediment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of sediment separation and discloses spiral conveying equipment for sediment separation, which comprises a fixed frame, wherein one side of the fixed frame is fixedly connected with a fixed plate, the bottom of the fixed frame is fixedly connected with a bracket, the top of the fixed plate is fixedly connected with a first motor, one output end of the first motor is fixedly connected with a rotating column, the top of the fixed frame is fixedly connected with a fixed block, the rotating column is rotationally connected inside the fixed block, one end of the rotating column is rotationally connected with a rotating rod, one side of the rotating rod is rotationally connected with a connecting rod, and one side of the connecting rod is fixedly connected with a connecting frame. According to the utility model, the effect of screening the sediment is achieved through the cooperation between the motor I and the screen, the problems that sediment is easy to accumulate in equipment and cause equipment blockage when a large amount of sediment is treated due to the fact that the screen and the screen are too fixed are solved, and the screening efficiency is improved.

title_en: Portable water hose winder
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable water hose winder, and relates to the technical field of winding tools. The winding component is used for winding the water band, the winding component is provided with two groups of water band clamping rods which are arranged in parallel, and the water band is wound on the two groups of water band clamping rods, so that the water band is provided with a winding center after being wound, and the winding center is positioned between the two groups of water band clamping rods; and the hand lever assembly can execute a rotating action to drive the winding part to rotate so as to wind the water belt.

title_en: Stripping and receiving device
abstract_en: The application discloses a stripping and receiving device which comprises a stripping mechanism and a conveying mechanism, wherein the stripping mechanism comprises an unreeling component, a stripping table and a reeling component, the unreeling component is used for placing products, the stripping table is used for stripping materials on the products, the reeling component is used for pulling a residual bottom film of the products after the products are stripped, a feeding path of the bottom film sequentially passes through the unreeling component, the stripping table and the reeling component, the conveying mechanism is arranged on one side of the stripping table and is used for receiving and conveying the stripped materials in a direction away from the stripping table, and a material passing position is formed between the stripping table and the conveying mechanism so as to enable the bottom film of the products to pass through. The stripping and receiving device can keep the stripped materials in a certain posture, and avoid deviation caused by the fact that the stripped materials touch each other.

title_en: Automatic feeding device for moving contact
abstract_en: The utility model provides an automatic feeding device for moving contact, includes equipment base, transmission device and feed arrangement, feed arrangement includes feeding storehouse, rotatory vibrations dish and peaceful vibration feeding track, transmission device is including connecting in the transmission frame of equipment base, connecting in the conveyer belt of transmission frame, connecting in the feeder hopper of equipment base and being used for driving the driving motor of conveyer belt motion, the conveyer belt includes first conveyer belt and second conveyer belt, first conveyer belt and second conveyer belt integrated into one piece, the direction of motion of first conveyer belt is the horizontal direction, the direction of motion of second conveyer belt is certain oblique angle and this oblique angle is between 0-90 degrees with the direction of motion of first conveyer belt, the position of feeder hopper corresponds with the position that first conveyer belt one end was kept away from to the second conveyer belt, be equipped with spacing recess on the storehouse, the feeding storehouse passes spacing recess, the position of the feeder hopper other end corresponds the central point of rotatory vibrations dish.

title_en: Assembly line lane change mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of pipeline lane changing, in particular to a pipeline lane changing mechanism, which comprises a pipeline conveyor belt, lane changing conveyor belts are arranged on the left side and the right side of the pipeline conveyor belt, separating devices are arranged on the tops of the pipeline conveyor belt and the lane changing conveyor belt, a converging device is arranged above the pipeline conveyor belt through a moving assembly, so that materials above the pipeline conveyor belt can move to the upper part of a supporting plate, a first motor is controlled to drive a screw rod to rotate, the screw rod can drive a sliding block to slide after rotating, materials below the screw rod can be placed above the supporting plate in sequence, a second motor is used to drive a second mounting plate to rotate, and a blanking assembly below the screw rod can be placed above the lane changing conveyor belt on any side, so that the device can transmit the materials to the upper parts of a plurality of lane changing conveyor belts, and the application range of the device is wider.

title_en: Be applied to auxiliary device that box was changed is cut to laser welding machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an auxiliary device applied to box cutting and replacing of a laser welding machine, and belongs to the technical field of strip steel production equipment in the metallurgical industry. The technical scheme includes that the hoisting piece is fixed to the top end of the connecting frame, the plug-in assembly comprises a plug-in shaft and a stop block, one end of the plug-in shaft is detachably connected with the bottom end of the connecting frame, the other end of the plug-in shaft is connected with the stop block, the periphery of the plug-in shaft is fixedly provided with an abutting part, the abutting part and the stop block clamp and fix the front side and the rear side of the laser welder shear box, the rotary blocking hook is arranged between the hoisting piece and the plug-in assembly and comprises a rotating rod and a hook body, one end of the rotating rod rotates on the connecting frame in a pitching mode, and the other end of the rotating rod is connected with the hook body. The utility model has the beneficial effects of reducing the difficulty of disassembling and assembling the box of the welding machine, avoiding the occurrence of safety accidents such as object striking and mechanical injury, improving the working efficiency and reducing the safety risk.

title_en: Air inlet valve for container and container comprising same
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an air inlet valve (1) for a container and a container, comprising a carrier part (2) made of hard material, which has a base (21) and a boss part (22) located above the base, the projection area of which in a projection plane perpendicular to the vertical direction is smaller than that of the base, and an air inlet channel (23) extending upwards from the base (21) to the inside of the boss part but not penetrating the boss part, at least one through hole (25) communicating with the air inlet channel (23) being provided on the side wall of the boss part (22), and a membrane part (3) made of flexible material, which has a void part (31) adapted in shape to the boss part (22) and can be fitted over the carrier part (2) by the void part. The use of the inlet valve and the container provides a good seal when dropped.

title_en: Belt feeder blanking automatic collection device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of belt conveyors, in particular to an automatic blanking collecting device of a belt conveyor, which comprises a base, a belt conveyor main body and a storage box, wherein a support plate for supporting the belt conveyor main body is arranged on the base, a connecting plate is placed on the support plate, a frame for collecting materials is integrally connected onto the connecting plate, a rotating shaft II is rotatably arranged on the base, and a supporting plate is fixedly arranged on the rotating shaft II. According to the utility model, the connecting plate is directly arranged on the supporting plate, so that falling materials can be rapidly intercepted and collected, the materials falling midway are concentrated into the collecting groove and conveyed again, the conveying efficiency of the belt conveyor main body is improved, four circumferentially distributed storage boxes are arranged on the supporting plate, the supporting plate and the storage boxes can intermittently rotate through the driving of a motor, and the filled storage boxes are moved to one side position, so that an operator can collect the materials conveniently.

title_en: Material feeding equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of plant fiber processing, in particular to material feeding equipment which comprises a frame, a sliding device, a lifting device and a hopper, wherein a limiting block is arranged at the top of the frame, the sliding device comprises a lifting frame, a swinging arm and a traction rod, the middle part of the swinging arm is hinged with the lifting frame, one end of the swinging arm is hinged with one end of the traction rod, the lifting device is arranged on the frame, the output end of the lifting device is connected with the lifting frame, the lifting device can drive the lifting frame to lift relative to the frame, two sides of the hopper are hinged on the lifting frame, a discharge hole is formed in the bottom of the hopper, a gate mechanism is hinged on the discharge hole, the gate mechanism can automatically plug the discharge hole, the other end of the traction rod is hinged on the outer wall of one end of the hopper close to the discharge hole, and the end of the traction rod close to one end of the hopper is hinged with the input end of the gate mechanism. The material loading equipment has the advantages that the use process is little affected by the environment, the required unloading space is small, and the material is not easy to scatter in the loading and unloading processes.

title_en: Hoisting mechanical linking device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hoisting mechanical linking device applied to the field of transportation apparatuses, which comprises a supporting transverse plate, wherein both sides of the supporting transverse plate are fixedly connected with horizontal guide rails, one side of the upper surface of the supporting transverse plate is fixedly provided with a servo motor, the output end of the servo motor is in transmission connection with a driving screw rod, the utility model ensures that the driving force required by the transportation assembly during transportation is lower by arranging a transportation pulley in the horizontal guide rails, and the driving screw rod is driven to rotate by the servo motor, the driving sliding block can be driven to displace, so that the driving transverse plate is driven to displace under the driving of the driving sliding block, the lifting assembly is horizontally transported through the U-shaped connecting plate, the driving force required by the servo motor during transportation of the transporting assembly can be reduced through the horizontal guide rail, energy is saved, and the problems that the guide structure adopted in the horizontal transportation of the common horizontal crane generally adopts the mounting plate to directly slide on the guide plate, the energy loss is large, the required consumed electric quantity is more and the economical efficiency is poor are solved.

title_en: Solder feeding intelligent mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent brazing filler metal feeding mechanism which comprises a supporting frame, a first visual positioning assembly, a second visual positioning assembly and a material conveying assembly, wherein the first visual positioning assembly is arranged above the supporting frame, the material position on the material conveying assembly is identified from top to bottom, the second visual positioning assembly is arranged on the side edge of the material conveying assembly, and the material grabbed by a manipulator on the next station is identified and corrected from bottom to top. According to the brazing filler metal feeding intelligent mechanism, the recognition of the material position is realized through designing double-vision positioning, after the mechanical arm grabs the material, the second vision positioning assembly rectifies the grabbed material, if the position of the material grabbed by the mechanical arm is displayed to be not right, the mechanical arm adjusts the angle of the material through wireless information transmission feedback, so that the assembly of the next station is realized, the whole process is fully mechanized and intelligent, the manual error is reduced, and the feeding efficiency is improved.

title_en: Non-woven fabric conveying roller convenient for roller spacing adjustment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of non-woven fabric conveying rollers, in particular to a non-woven fabric conveying roller convenient for roller spacing adjustment. The non-woven fabric conveying device mainly aims at the problems that most of existing non-woven fabric conveying rollers are fixedly arranged, the non-woven fabric conveying rollers are inconvenient to adjust in distance, the non-woven fabric is easy to loosen, the non-woven fabric is wound in the conveying process, and conveying work is affected, and the technical scheme is provided. According to the utility model, the distance between the first conveying roller and the second conveying roller is adjusted, so that the tension degree in the conveying process of the non-woven fabric is adjusted, the non-woven fabrics with different thicknesses can be conveyed, the application range is improved, and the non-woven fabrics are prevented from being wound.

title_en: Linear arrangement shuttle type multi-station cutting production line
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a linearly arranged shuttle type multi-station cutting production line which is provided with a plurality of cutting stations, wherein the plurality of cutting stations are arranged at intervals along a straight line, the linearly arranged shuttle type multi-station cutting production line comprises a conveying line which is arranged along the plurality of cutting stations and used for conveying a tray loaded with materials to be cut to any one cutting station, a cutting machine and a lifter are arranged on each cutting station of the cutting production line, the lifter is used for lifting the tray on the conveying line upwards for the corresponding cutting machine to cut the materials, and when the tray on the upstream cutting station is lifted by the corresponding lifter, the conveying line can convey the next tray to pass through the upstream cutting station to reach the downstream cutting station. The utility model can realize that a plurality of cutting machines work simultaneously on respective cutting stations, greatly improves the efficiency, saves the space, reduces the equipment cost, optimizes the cutting production line structure and has better practicability.

title_en: Heated board, energy storage container and energy storage system
abstract_en: The utility model provides an insulation board, an energy storage container and an energy storage system, wherein the insulation board comprises an inner layer board, an outer layer board and a middle layer board, wherein the inner layer board and the outer layer board are connected in a buckled mode; the middle layer board comprises a main board body and a protruding part arranged on the main board body, the protruding part is formed by protruding the main board body to the outer layer board, fireproof heat-insulating materials are filled in gaps between the inner layer board and the middle layer board and gaps between the middle layer board and the outer layer board. The heat insulation board has good structural strength and heat insulation effect, and can have higher practicability.

title_en: Packing assembly of feed mixer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a packing assembly of a feed mixer, which relates to the technical field of feed mixers and comprises a mixer module, wherein a stirring mechanism is arranged at the top end of the mixer module, the stirring mechanism comprises a mixer body and a discharge hopper, a fixed sleeve is fixedly arranged at the top end of the discharge hopper, extrusion plates are slidably arranged at two side end parts of the discharge hopper, a stabilizer bar is fixedly arranged at the top end of each extrusion plate, a connecting seat is enabled to move towards the top end of the discharge hopper, a deflection plate is driven to deflect in a supporting block, meanwhile, the tail end of the deflection plate is connected with the top end of a telescopic plate, the deflection plate stretches one side of the telescopic plate, the telescopic plate is driven to deflect at the top end of the extrusion plate, the extrusion plate drives the stabilizer bar to rotate at the side end part of the discharge hopper, and the stabilizer bar plays a role in guiding and supporting the movement of the extrusion plate.

title_en: Door plant baling line door plant presss from both sides and gets device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of house door processing, in particular to a door plate clamping device of a door plate packaging line. Including rectangular frame, clamp and get the device, rectangular frame is made for rectangular section bar, fixes a slide rail respectively in longer both sides frame downside, respectively fixes an L shape cylinder fixed plate in both sides frame inboard, respectively fixes a cylinder on the cylinder fixed plate, and a push pedal is connected to the cylinder push rod, and the push pedal is fixed on a diaphragm, and the diaphragm is located the frame downside, and a slider is fixed respectively to both ends upside, and the slider cartridge is in on the slide rail, respectively fixed jack catch in diaphragm downside both ends, jack catch relative arrangement on two diaphragms. The direction of the air cylinder push rods on the two frames is opposite, and the air cylinder push rods face to the edge directions of the two sides of the frame respectively. The slide rail is a rectangular metal strip, semicircular slide ways are arranged on two sides of the metal strip, and the sliding blocks are clamped in the semicircular slide ways. The clamping jaw is a right-angle bracket, a bent plate with an obtuse angle and bending is fixed on the vertical surface of the right-angle bracket, and a baffle plate and a backing plate are fixed on the bent plate.

title_en: Material metering device is used in production of Lipropibicaine cream
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a material metering device for producing a Lipro bicaine cream, which comprises an outer shell, a weighing mechanism, a material metering bin, a feeding pipe, a feeding valve, a discharging pipe, a discharging valve and an extrusion discharging mechanism, wherein a cavity is arranged in the outer shell, the weighing mechanism is arranged in the cavity of the outer shell, the material metering bin is arranged on the weighing mechanism, a feeding hole is arranged above the material metering bin in the cavity of the outer shell, the feeding pipe is arranged on the outer shell and extends to the upper part of the material metering bin, the feeding valve is arranged on the feeding pipe and is suitable for controlling the feeding pipe to feed, the discharging pipe is arranged at the bottom of the material metering bin and is communicated with the material metering bin, and the discharging valve is arranged on the discharging pipe. The utility model can measure and weigh Li Bing the bicaine cream in a clean environment.

title_en: Energy storage battery with fixed wire harness
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an energy storage battery with a fixed wire harness, which relates to the technical field of wire harness fixation and comprises an energy storage battery box and a wire harness fixing box, wherein two arrangement components are arranged in the wire harness fixing box, each arrangement component comprises a rotating plate, a connecting shaft, a limiting sleeve and an adjusting block, a winding positioning groove is formed in the rotating plate, a limiting sliding groove is formed in the connecting shaft, a plurality of limiting clamping grooves are formed in the inner surface of the limiting sleeve, clamping holes are formed in the limiting clamping grooves, a plurality of limiting clamping balls are fixedly arranged on the outer surface of the adjusting block, and the connecting shaft and the rotating plate are driven to rotate by the adjusting block and a clamping rod.

title_en: Tee bend pipe fitting processing material loading machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of feeding machines, in particular to a three-way pipe fitting processing feeding machine which comprises a workbench and a plurality of three-way pipe fittings, wherein a group of single feeding slide ways are arranged on the workbench, the three-way pipe fittings are sequentially arranged on the single feeding slide ways in rows, one side of the bottom of the single feeding slide way is provided with a bracket arranged on the workbench, the three-way pipe fitting processing feeding machine also comprises a group of conveying mechanisms arranged at the bottom of the single feeding slide way, the conveying mechanisms can convey the three-way pipe fittings at the bottom of the single feeding slide way to the bracket, and the opposite sides of the single feeding slide way and the bracket are respectively provided with a through gap matched with the conveying mechanisms.

title_en: Foam cotton rapid clamping device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a foam cotton rapid clamping device which comprises a lifting column, wherein the top of the lifting column is fixedly connected with a supporting rod, one end of the supporting rod is provided with a motor, an output shaft of the motor is fixedly connected with one end of a screw rod, the screw rod is rotatably connected to the inner side wall of the supporting rod, and the outer side wall of the screw rod is in threaded connection with a support. According to the utility model, the air in the exhaust pipe and the slide hole is pumped by the vacuum pump, so that negative pressure is generated in the connecting block, the piston rod is driven to move, the clamping jaw enters the slide hole, the side wall of the slide hole is utilized to elastically deform the clamping jaw, foam cotton is clamped, the clamping speed of the clamping device is improved, the magnet in the mounting hole is utilized to adsorb iron components in the foam cotton of the mobile phone shielding cover, the clamping stability is improved, and meanwhile, the clamping device can select the number of clamping components according to the requirement, so that the number of single foam cotton clamping is increased, and the mounting efficiency of the foam cotton of the mobile phone shielding cover is improved.

title_en: Hemming card sender
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of card readers, in particular to a flanging card reader which comprises a machine table, a storage bin, a feeding belt group, a bracket, a supporting plate, a lower conveying belt group, an upper conveying belt group and two flanging components, wherein the flanging components comprise an L-shaped guide plate arranged on the supporting plate, a flanging plate connected with the L-shaped guide plate and a flanging pressing plate which is arranged above the supporting plate and is positioned at the inner sides of the L-shaped guide plate and the flanging plate, the top surface of the L-shaped guide plate is provided with a tilting guide inclined plane, the inner side surface of the flanging plate is provided with a flanging inclined plane, a material passing gap is formed between the flanging pressing plate and the supporting plate, and the tilting guide inclined plane is inclined from bottom to top along the conveying direction of the upper conveying belt group and is inclined from outside to inside. The utility model realizes single-sheet output of the paper board, can also carry out edge folding molding on the paper board, and can realize edge folding effect on one side or two sides of the paper board by disassembling and assembling the edge folding assembly or adjusting the position of the edge folding assembly according to actual requirements.

title_en: Tension constant device of wire separator
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a tension constant device of a yarn dividing machine, which comprises a mounting seat, wherein the mounting seat is provided with a front baffle, two sides of the front baffle are respectively provided with a first yarn passing device and a second yarn passing device, a third yarn passing device is arranged in the middle of the front baffle, and multifilament yarns sequentially pass through the first yarn passing device, the third yarn passing device and the second yarn passing device from an unwinding device and then enter a yarn dividing roller. The utility model is arranged between the unwinding device of the yarn dividing machine and the yarn dividing roller, and can select proper positions in the transverse groove I and the transverse groove II according to actual needs, so that the tension of the yarn is ensured to be constant in the process of from the unwinding device to the yarn dividing roller, and a foundation is laid for improving the quality of weaving and dyeing.

title_en: Automatic feeding device of cotton fluffer
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of polyester fiber fabric treatment, which is used for solving the problem that raw material feeding for cotton wool processing is easy to move in the conveying process so as to influence cotton wool processing, and in particular relates to an automatic feeding device of a cotton fluffer, which comprises a base, wherein a frame is fixedly arranged at the top of the base, a conveyor belt is arranged in the frame, the cotton fluffer is fixedly arranged at the top of the base, a supporting frame is symmetrically and fixedly arranged at the top of the base, a transverse plate is fixedly connected at the top of the supporting frame, a material pressing component is arranged at the bottom of the transverse plate and comprises a rotary disc and a sleeve I, the center of the transverse plate is movably connected with a rotary shaft through a bearing, and the rotary disc is fixedly connected at the bottom end of the rotary shaft; according to the utility model, the compaction assembly is arranged, the pressing plate is used for continuously compacting the fluffy cotton wool, so that the problem of deviation in the conveying process is avoided, and then the compacted cotton wool is pushed efficiently and safely through the arc push rod.

title_en: Lightweight bridge crane
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a lightweight bridge crane, which comprises a main beam, wherein a lifting mechanism and a trolley are arranged on the main beam, a control box is arranged on the main beam, a mounting frame for mounting various electric appliances, controllers and switches is slidably arranged in the control box, a box door is rotatably arranged at the top of one end of the control box, a connecting rod is rotatably arranged on the inner wall of the box door through a shaft pin, one end of the connecting rod, which is far away from the box door, is movably arranged at one side of the mounting frame, the connecting rod is rotated along with the rotation of the box door to pull the mounting frame to slide out of the interior of the control box, the box door is rotated to drive the connecting rod to pull the mounting frame to move along the track of a guide groove, and the guide rod is slid in the guide groove in the box door rotating process, so that the mounting frame is slid out of the interior of the control box, and various electric appliances, controllers and the like on the mounting frame are convenient to maintain.

title_en: Engineering vehicle operating handle mechanical structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mechanical structure of an operating handle of an engineering truck, which relates to the technical field of handles of engineering trucks and comprises a fixed seat, a rotating shaft, a vertical shaft, a compression spring and a spacer ring, wherein one side of the fixed seat is provided with the mounting plate, a hollow cavity is formed between the fixed seat and the mounting plate in a surrounding mode, the rotating shaft is arranged in the hollow cavity, one end of the vertical shaft is connected with the rotating shaft, the other end of the vertical shaft penetrates through the mounting plate and extends out of the mounting plate, the compression spring is sleeved on the vertical shaft, and the top of the compression spring is provided with the spacer ring which compresses the compression spring. The vertical shaft is more stable in swinging operation, the vertical shaft is driven to automatically reset through the compression spring, the left and right shaking of the operating handle is avoided under the traction of the compression spring, the accuracy of the handle in operation is improved, the stability of the engineering truck in lifting operation is guaranteed, the handle structure is more closed, the penetration of dust, cement and acid and alkali water is effectively isolated, the phenomenon of handle clamping stagnation is caused, and the service life of the operating handle is prolonged.

title_en: Paper changing system without stop of spacing paper
abstract_en: A paper changing system without stop of the spacing paper comprises a machine table, wherein a control system and a plurality of groups of spacing paper storing and changing mechanisms are arranged on the machine table; in summary, the utility model can monitor the surplus of the spacing paper in the two station grooves in real time through the photoelectric sensing module, when the photoelectric sensing module monitors that the spacing paper does not exist in the station grooves, the driving motor can be automatically started, the cam divider is utilized to rotate 180 degrees to exchange the positions of the two station grooves, the feeding of the spacing paper is ensured under the state of no stop line, the utilization rate of the machine table is increased, the product quality is improved, the potential safety hazard caused by stopping paper exchange is reduced, the panel production line is optimized, the further improved automation level is further improved, and the labor cost is reduced.

title_en: Conveying mechanism of automatic paper diaper packaging machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a conveying mechanism of an automatic paper diaper packaging machine, which relates to the technical field of conveying of automatic paper diaper packaging machines and comprises a paper diaper automatic packaging machine body, wherein two symmetrically distributed protection baffles are fixedly arranged at the top of a first connecting seat, two support plates which are vertically distributed are fixedly arranged at the inner ends of the protection baffles, rotating grooves are fixedly arranged on the support plates, rotating shafts which are matched with the rotating grooves are rotatably connected to the inner walls of the rotating grooves, flow-limiting baffles are fixedly arranged between the rotating shafts, and a servo motor is fixedly arranged at the top ends of the rotating shafts. This automatic packagine machine's of panty-shape diapers conveying mechanism fixes the axis of rotation through the backup pad, and servo motor drives the axis of rotation and rotates, and the axis of rotation drives current limiting baffle control and opens and shuts, prevents to take place to block up, and driving motor drives the rotation of transmission fluted roller, and the transmission fluted roller drives the conveyer belt and rolls, is convenient for drive panty-shape diapers business turn over material, conveniently improves packing conveying efficiency, convenient to use.

title_en: Single-head economic frozen seminiferous tube split charging machine
abstract_en: A single-head economic frozen seminiferous tube split charging machine comprises a base, wherein a main motor, a first supporting plate, a supporting frame, a curved guide rail, a driven wheel, a cam, the curved guide rail, the cam and the driven wheel are arranged on the base and coaxial, the main motor drives the driven wheel, the curved guide rail and the cam to rotate, a tube discharging mechanism, a filling mechanism and a sealing mechanism are arranged on the supporting frame, the tube discharging mechanism comprises a tube containing box, a tube discharging roller, a guide tube wheel and a tube discharging motor, the filling mechanism comprises a supporting seat, a second supporting plate, a peristaltic pump, a guide bearing, a guide plate, a left filling needle base, a right filling needle support, a left filling needle support, a right filling needle support and a connecting arm, the sealing mechanism comprises a third supporting plate, a welding guide arm, a Y-shaped connector, a roller, a tension spring, a welding head and a welding seat. The utility model has the advantages that the utility model drives the operation of the pipe discharging mechanism, the filling mechanism and the sealing mechanism through one main motor, saves two motors and related software and hardware, has high efficiency and low cost, and improves the quality and the production efficiency of finished frozen spermaducts.

title_en: Continuous transfer machine after pump shell spraying and drying
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of transfer equipment, and relates to a continuous transfer machine after pump shell spraying and drying. The utility model discloses a transfer machine, which comprises a transfer machine track, wherein a connecting frame is arranged on the transfer machine track, the lower end of the connecting frame is fixedly connected with a rotating piece, the lower end of the rotating piece is fixedly connected with a connecting plate, the side wall of the lower side of the connecting plate is fixedly connected with a U-shaped rod, a hook is hung on the U-shaped rod, the side wall of the lower side of the connecting plate is fixedly connected with a locking mechanism, the locking mechanism comprises a first vertical plate and a second vertical plate which are fixedly connected to the lower side of the connecting plate, jacks are formed in the first vertical plate and the second vertical plate, the same locking rod is movably inserted in the two jacks, and one end of the locking rod is fixedly connected with a baffle plate. The utility model can limit and lock the hook and prevent the hook from being separated from the U-shaped rod, thereby improving the stability of the hook and the safety of the pump shell in the transportation process.

title_en: Bent column lifting device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bent post hoisting tool which comprises a hoisting main rod, wherein the left end of the surface of the hoisting main rod is fixedly connected with a first limit lantern ring, the right side of the surface of the hoisting main rod is sleeved with a second limit lantern ring, the right side of the second limit lantern ring is welded with a positioning ring, the positioning ring and the second limit lantern ring are both sleeved on the surface of the hoisting main rod, and the surfaces of the second limit lantern ring and the first limit lantern ring are both sleeved with steel wire rope bodies. According to the utility model, the bent post is sleeved on the surface of the lifting main rod, the metal ring on the inner side of the limiting lantern ring I plays a limiting role, so that uneven stress on two ends of a lifting appliance caused by movement of a lifting tool in the horizontal through hole of the bent post is prevented, the limiting lantern ring II and the positioning ring are sleeved on the surface of the lifting main rod, then the limiting lock pin on the locking assembly is inserted into the inner cavities of the locking hole I and the locking hole II, the bent post is limited to be separated from the surface of the lifting main rod, and the steel wire rope is sleeved on the inner sides of the limiting lantern ring I and the limiting lantern ring II, so that lifting can be performed.

title_en: Refrigerating apparatus
abstract_en: The utility model relates to refrigeration equipment, which comprises a box body and a cover body assembly, wherein a compressor bin is arranged at the rear side of the box body and used for installing a compressor, the cover body assembly comprises a rear cover body arranged at the rear side of the compressor bin and a storage piece detachably connected to the rear cover body, the rear cover body is in a grid shape, a mounting position is formed on the rear cover body, the storage piece is detachably connected to the mounting position, a storage cavity extending into the compressor bin is formed in the storage piece and used for storing a power wire harness, the power wire harness can be directly placed in the storage cavity in the storage piece, and the storage piece and the rear cover body are assembled and formed after being manufactured independently, so that the processing efficiency is improved, and the protection of the power wire harness is more comprehensive.

title_en: Be used for steel conveying positioner
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a steel conveying and positioning device which comprises a supporting base, a large connecting disc, a belt, a transmission plate and a stabilizing plate, wherein the large connecting disc is arranged at the outer end of the supporting base, the belt is connected in the middle of the large connecting disc, the inner end of the belt is connected with a positioning wheel, the lower end of the positioning wheel is provided with a small connecting disc, the rear end of the small connecting disc is provided with a mounting plate, the inner end of the small connecting disc is connected with a connecting rod, the inner end of the connecting rod is provided with a motor, the outer end of the motor is provided with a protective shell, the transmission plate is arranged at the upper end of the protective shell, the lower end of the transmission plate is connected with a connecting rod, the front end and the rear end of the connecting rod are respectively provided with a different-shaped block, and the upper end of the different-shaped block is provided with the stabilizing plate. This a steel conveying positioner is convenient for transport the steel pipe to required position automatically, uses manpower sparingly, makes the steel pipe transversely align, is convenient for improve follow-up cutting efficiency, is convenient for accomodate the steel pipe is folding, is convenient for store the steel pipe in the narrow and small space.

title_en: A steam plastic package device for body and bottle subsides
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a steam plastic sealing device for bottle bodies and bottle labels, which comprises a steam plastic sealing device body, wherein a supporting leg is fixed at the bottom end of the steam plastic sealing device body, a steam machine is arranged at the top end of the steam plastic sealing device body, guide frames are fixed at two ends of two sides of the steam plastic sealing device body in a transverse penetrating manner of a conveyor conveying belt in the steam plastic sealing device body, connecting sliding blocks are fixed at two ends of a frame, a wet cotton inlet is vertically arranged at the top end of the frame, and a wet cotton body is inserted and assembled in the frame through the wet cotton inlet. This kind of a steam plastic envelope device for body and bottle subsides is through being provided with frame, moist cotton import and moist cotton body when using, and the moist cotton body is in steam plastic envelope device body both sides exit and is close to upper portion position department, reduces steam emission speed, utilizes the effect of moist cotton body to reduce steam simultaneously and arranges in the air, consequently reduces the pollution to the surrounding environment.

title_en: Turning device and industrial assembly line
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a turnover device and an industrial assembly line, wherein the turnover device comprises a frame, a turnover frame, a driving device, a first guide wheel mechanism and a second guide wheel mechanism, wherein a workpiece is borne on the turnover frame, the driving device is arranged on the frame and drives the turnover frame to rotate along the axis of the turnover frame, the first guide wheel mechanism is arranged on the frame and comprises at least two main guide wheels for bearing the turnover frame, the main guide wheels are supported by being in butt joint with the outer side of the turnover frame, the second guide wheel mechanism is arranged on the frame and comprises auxiliary guide wheels, and the auxiliary guide wheels are in butt joint with the inner side of the turnover frame. Compared with the existing manipulator, the turnover device has higher workpiece bearing capacity in the aspect of turnover of workpieces, and can turn over workpieces with larger volumes or larger weights more stably.

title_en: Lifting equipment for maintenance of industrial conveying frame
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of conveying frame maintenance equipment, in particular to hoisting equipment for industrial conveying frame maintenance. The technical scheme includes that the lifting device comprises a supporting frame, conveying equipment and a penetrating groove formed in the top of the supporting frame, a winch is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the supporting frame and located right above the penetrating groove, a lifting rope used for pulling the conveying equipment to lift is arranged on the winch, and a clamping mechanism arranged at the bottom end of the lifting rope and used for rapidly fixing the conveying equipment to be maintained. According to the utility model, the industrial conveying frame can be quickly hoisted after being fixed by utilizing the cooperation of the structures such as the supporting frame, the winch, the clamping mechanism and the driving mechanism, so that the operation time can be reduced, and the overall working efficiency can be improved. Meanwhile, the industrial conveying frame is clamped and fixed rapidly, manual operation links can be reduced, labor intensity of maintenance personnel is reduced, and safety of personnel is guaranteed.

title_en: High-strength traveling wheel assembly for crane
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of cranes, in particular to a high-strength traveling wheel assembly for a crane, which comprises a mounting frame and a traveling wheel main body rotatably arranged in the mounting frame, wherein a first edge reinforcing rib is arranged at the edge of the end surfaces of two sides of the traveling wheel main body, a second edge reinforcing rib is arranged at the edge of a shaft hole, a first annular reinforcing rib, a second annular reinforcing rib and a third annular reinforcing rib are concentrically arranged on the end surface of the traveling wheel main body between the first edge reinforcing rib and the second edge reinforcing rib, a first dispersing reinforcing rib is annularly arranged between the second edge reinforcing rib and the first annular reinforcing rib, a second dispersing reinforcing rib is annularly arranged between the first annular reinforcing rib and the second annular reinforcing rib, a third dispersing reinforcing rib is annularly arranged between the second annular reinforcing rib and the third annular reinforcing rib, and a fourth dispersing reinforcing rib is arranged between the third annular reinforcing rib and the first edge reinforcing rib.

title_en: Buffering lifting device for crane equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a crane equipment buffer lifting device which comprises a bridge frame, wherein a movable trolley is arranged on the upper side of the bridge frame, fixing plates are arranged at two ends of the upper side of the bridge frame, a first hydraulic damping rod is arranged on one side of the fixing plate facing the movable trolley, an abutting plate is arranged at the end part of a telescopic end of the first hydraulic damping rod, a first spring is sleeved on the outer surface of the first hydraulic damping rod, two ends of the first spring are respectively abutted with the fixing plate and the abutting plate, two side blocks are arranged at two ends of the bridge frame in the length direction, the two side blocks are arranged at two sides of the bridge frame in the width direction, and a first cylinder body is arranged on the opposite surfaces of the two side blocks. Through the setting of first hydraulic damping pole and first spring, can play the cushioning effect when travelling car striking on the butt board, slow down travelling car's travel speed, and through the setting of conduction mechanism, the splint of both sides can compress tightly in travelling car's both sides simultaneously, so can further slow down speed and stop the motion.

title_en: Meat chicken fresh-keeping equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses broiler fresh-keeping equipment which comprises a bottom plate, anchor rods, a fresh-keeping barrel, a sealing cover, a refrigerator and a front baffle, wherein the bottom plate is in a disc type design, a plurality of anchor rods are installed on the bottom plate, the anchor rods are driven into the ground, the fresh-keeping barrel is installed on the bottom plate, the sealing cover with a hinge is arranged on the fresh-keeping barrel, a sealing adhesive tape is adhered to the contact position of the sealing cover and the fresh-keeping barrel, the sealing cover is fixed and limited by utilizing a bolt, the refrigerator is arranged on the outer side of the fresh-keeping barrel and contacts with the bottom plate, the refrigerator cools air in the fresh-keeping barrel through a pipeline, the front baffle is arranged on the outer side of the fresh-keeping barrel, and the front baffle is connected with the bottom plate. The rotary table is reasonable in design, and the rotary table can rotate according to the situation, so that the broiler chicken can be placed or taken out easily.

title_en: Combined multi-layer laminated slab transportation frame
abstract_en: The utility model provides a combined type multilayer laminated slab transportation frame, which relates to the technical field of laminated slab transportation frames and comprises a first flat base and a second flat base arranged above the first flat base, wherein a group of symmetrically arranged first corner protection brackets are arranged at two end sides of the top of the first flat base, a group of symmetrically arranged second corner protection brackets are arranged at two end sides of the top of the second flat base, and connecting mechanisms which are symmetrically arranged are respectively arranged at two end sides of each first corner protection bracket. According to the utility model, the first flat base and the first corner protection bracket can be combined and connected with the second flat base and the second corner protection bracket through the right-angle clamping plate and the connecting assembly to form a multi-layer storage unit, so that the loading and transportation work is convenient, the combination can effectively increase the transportation amount on the premise that the stacking amount is not out of specification, the phenomenon of too many layers of each layer of the combination can not occur, and meanwhile, the combination is firm, and the actual use requirement can be met.

title_en: Ton bucket rack connecting piece
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a ton barrel rack connecting piece which comprises an adjusting frame, wherein connecting hooks are respectively arranged on two sides of the adjusting frame, one ends, close to the adjusting frame, of the connecting hooks on two sides are respectively connected with an adjusting rod, an inner cavity of the adjusting frame is rotationally connected with adjusting teeth for adjusting the position of the adjusting rod, positioning pins for fixing the positions of the adjusting teeth are arranged at the upper end of the adjusting frame, storage grooves are respectively formed in side walls of two ends of the adjusting frame, connecting belts are arranged in the inner cavities of the storage grooves, and a winding mechanism is arranged between the connecting belts and the storage grooves. The utility model drives the connecting hooks at two sides to move inwards at the same time, thereby connecting and fixing the ton barrel racks at two sides, and meanwhile, the connecting hooks and the adjusting rods are arranged in a rotating way, so that the angle of the connecting hooks can be adjusted to stably hook the ton barrel racks, thereby ensuring the stability of the connection of the ton barrel racks, and the connecting hooks can be quickly connected and detached, thereby being convenient for quickly moving the stacked ton barrel racks, and simultaneously, the connecting piece can be repeatedly used, thereby avoiding unnecessary waste.

title_en: Walking device
abstract_en: The application provides a walking device, and relates to the technical field of engineering machinery. The traveling device comprises a traveling rail and a traveling mechanism, wherein the traveling rail is arranged along the traveling direction, the traveling mechanism is arranged on the traveling rail, an object to be moved is arranged on one side of the traveling mechanism far away from the traveling rail, the traveling mechanism comprises a traveling driving unit provided with a driver, a driving wheel and at least one traveling wheel, the driving wheel is arranged on the top of the traveling rail, the output end of the driver is connected with the driving wheel, two sides of the traveling rail are recessed to form a fixed groove, the length of the fixed groove corresponds to the travel length of the traveling mechanism, and at least one part of the traveling wheel is positioned in the fixed groove. The walking device provided by the embodiment of the application has the advantages of good adaptability and high loading capacity, and can move the object to be moved on the basis of ensuring that the object to be moved does not topple, so that the operation is simple, the time consumption is short, and the moving cost is effectively reduced.

title_en: Automatic control robot lifting platform
