abstract_en: The utility model provides an automatic control robot lifting platform, which relates to the technical field of robot lifting platforms and comprises a bottom table, wherein welding plates are welded on two sides of the top of the bottom table, a top cover is connected to the top of each welding plate through bolts, driving motors are arranged on two sides of the bottom of each top cover, a screw rod is connected to the bottom end of each driving motor in a transmission mode, lifting sliding blocks are connected to the outer threads of the screw rods in a sliding mode, clamping plates are clamped in the middle of the lifting sliding blocks on two sides, a wireless transmission module is arranged on one side of the front of the bottom table, an object approaching sensor is electrically connected to the front of the wireless transmission module, and when the robot main body is used for feeding, small objects and light weight objects are fed, objects placed on the ground can be automatically placed on the clamping plates, then the robot main body conveys the objects to positions required by workshops, and workers at high positions can take the objects without going down.

title_en: Module packaging structure
abstract_en: The embodiment of the utility model belongs to the technical field of logistics transportation. The utility model also relates to a module packaging structure which comprises a clamping plate main body, wherein a plurality of layers of packaging boxes are stacked at the top of the clamping plate main body, each layer of packaging boxes are arranged in a crisscross manner, limiting mechanisms are arranged at four corners of the clamping plate main body and used for limiting the packaging boxes, limiting frames are arranged between the tops of the four limiting mechanisms, and a protective film layer is wound between the limiting frames and the outer surfaces of the limiting mechanisms. According to the utility model, the four corners of the clamping plate main body are provided with the limiting mechanisms, the limiting mechanisms can limit the multi-layer packaging boxes, the plurality of packaging boxes can be protected and limited through the mutual matching of the limiting frames and the protective film layers, and each layer of packaging boxes are arranged in a crisscross manner, so that the overall firmness is improved, and the condition that the packaging boxes are easy to incline or shift when being subjected to external force is reduced.

title_en: Anti-press device of bucket elevator and bucket elevator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-press device of a bucket elevator and the bucket elevator, which comprise an open type air charging box, a fan and a dust collector, wherein the open type air charging box is fixedly arranged on the peripheral side of a tail wheel of the elevator and on the inner wall of a shell at the bottom of the tail wheel of the elevator, an air inlet of the open type air charging box is communicated with an air outlet of the fan through a ventilating duct, at least one dust outlet is formed in the shell above the open type air charging box, the dust collector is fixedly arranged on the outer wall of the shell, and a dust collection inlet of the dust collector is communicated with the dust outlet. The open type air charging box is supplied with air through the fan, piled powdery materials are activated, the phenomenon of hopper pressing is prevented, labor force is reduced, automation level is improved, the structure is simple, and the service life of the bucket elevator is prolonged.

title_en: Roof placing executing device for material collecting and discharging shaft
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a top placing executing device of a material collecting and releasing shaft, which comprises supporting frames on two sides and an air expanding shaft axially fixed between the supporting frames, wherein a transmission mechanism is arranged on the supporting frame on one side to drive the air expanding shaft to rotate, a top clamping mechanism is arranged on one side of the air expanding shaft, a deviation adjusting mechanism is arranged on the other side of the air expanding shaft, conical parts are arranged at two ends of the air expanding shaft, an external gear is arranged at one end, close to the top clamping mechanism, of the air expanding shaft, the top clamping mechanism comprises a first conical top part and an internal gear, the first conical top part is attached to the conical parts, the internal gear is arranged at the periphery of the first conical top part, and when the first conical top part is attached to the conical parts, the external gear is meshed with the internal gear.

title_en: Paste canning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a canning device for paste, which relates to the field of cosmetic canning and comprises a supporting table, wherein the upper end of the supporting table is provided with a canning machine body, the upper end of the canning machine body is provided with a feed cylinder, the front side of the canning machine body is fixedly connected with a discharge pipe, and a control valve is arranged in the discharge pipe; the quick-mounting and dismounting device has the advantages that quick-mounting and dismounting of the placing seat can be realized through the threaded sleeve, the clamping ring, the threaded column and the like, so that workers can easily clean the cosmetic paste falling on the placing seat, meanwhile, the design of the placing seat prevents the residual paste from directly falling on the ground, the difficulty of cleaning is obviously reduced, the position of the fixing clamp can be adjusted through the telescopic rod, the spring, the moving block, the short block, the pushing block and the like, the bottle to be filled can be further fixed, cosmetic overflow or shortage caused by movement of the bottle is avoided, and meanwhile, the filling quality of the whole device can be improved.

title_en: Steel needle feeding device for adjusting motorcycle shock absorber
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an adjusting steel needle feeding device of a motorcycle shock absorber, which comprises a vibration feeding mechanism and is characterized in that a carrying manipulator is arranged along the output direction of the vibration feeding mechanism, an adjusting steel needle detecting mechanism and an adjusting steel needle oiling mechanism are sequentially arranged along the carrying moving direction of the carrying manipulator, the adjusting steel needle detecting mechanism is used for visually detecting the appearance of an adjusting steel needle, and the adjusting steel needle oiling mechanism is used for oiling threads on the adjusting steel needle. The utility model has the advantages of simple structure, cost saving, high working efficiency, labor cost reduction, labor intensity reduction, low production cost, good product quality and high yield.

title_en: Wash simple and convenient stoste partial shipment equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a stock solution split charging device easy and convenient to clean, which belongs to the technical field of protein stock solution treatment and comprises a frame, a mounting plate vertically fixed on the side edge of the frame, a storage box positioned at the top of the mounting plate and used for storing stock solution, cylinders vertically fixed at two ends of the storage box, a diaphragm positioned between the output ends of two groups of cylinders and a split charging head arranged at the bottom of the diaphragm and communicated with the interior of the storage box, wherein a partition plate is fixedly arranged on the side edge of the mounting plate and positioned below the split charging head, and holes matched with the split charging head are uniformly formed in the partition plate. According to the utility model, the partition plate is vertically arranged on the mounting plate, the through holes matched with the split charging heads are formed in the partition plate, and the flushing mechanism consisting of the cleaning water tank, the water pump, the drain pipe, the annular water tank and the drain hole is matched, so that the outer side of the flushing heads can be cleaned regularly in the using process, the use is more convenient, and the practicability is higher.

title_en: Wine box production line connection conveying device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of wine box production and discloses a connecting and conveying device for a wine box production line, which comprises a supporting base, wherein two sides of the top end of the supporting base are fixedly connected with telescopic supporting legs, a conveying frame is arranged at the top end of each telescopic supporting leg, a conveying belt is arranged in each conveying frame, a conveying motor is arranged at one side of one end of each conveying frame, a fixing plate is fixedly utilized at one side of each telescopic supporting leg, a hydraulic cylinder is arranged at the bottom end of each fixing plate, casters are fixedly connected to the output ends of the hydraulic cylinders, and first limiting plates are arranged at two ends of the top of each conveying frame. This conveyor is connected to wine box production line can clean the dust on conveyer belt surface through the board that washs, and dirt and dust under the brush can drop in the inside of collecting the box, regularly take off the clearance with the collection box, need hold earlier the handle and outwards stimulate when taking out the collection box, avoid wine box surface adhesion dirt and dust, solved inconvenient clean conveying equipment's problem.

title_en: Automatic pass feeding subassembly for post machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of automatic column passing machines, and discloses a feeding component for an automatic column passing machine, which comprises a bearing plate and a feeding clamping component. This automatic cross feeding subassembly for post machine, through the design of sliding tray and joint groove, fixed module can install on the bearing plate fast, conveniently, improve installation effectiveness, snap ring and little spliced pole and the grafting structure of spliced groove, and the butt of spacing ring and snap ring, the connection stability between fixed module and the bearing plate is strengthened, prevent to take place to drop or remove in the course of the work, screw thread connection design of dwang and card foot, distance between the clamp splice can conveniently be adjusted, in order to adapt to the not unidimensional material, the frictional force between the rubber block of clamp splice one side has increased and the material, stability and reliability of centre gripping have been improved, the landing or the skew of material in the transportation process have been prevented, the spliced structure of dwang and fixed orifices and regulation hole has been realized, the stability and the persistence of clamping state are ensured.

title_en: Lens blank separating device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a lens blank separating device which comprises a conveying pipe, a distributing mechanism and a self-locking mechanism, wherein the conveying pipe is internally used for conveying lens blanks side by side from top to bottom, the distributing mechanism comprises an upper blocking part and a lower blocking part, the upper blocking part and the lower blocking part are arranged in the conveying pipe, the lens blanks can push the upper blocking part and the lower blocking part to move out of the conveying pipe, the self-locking mechanism is connected with the lower blocking part and is also used for being clamped with the upper blocking part so that the upper blocking part positioned in the conveying pipe is in a locking state, and when the lower blocking part moves out of the conveying pipe, the self-locking mechanism is separated from the upper blocking part. The utility model has the advantages that the separation of the lens blank can be completed without electric drive, and the production cost is reduced.

title_en: Paste extruder
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a paste extruder in the field of paste extrusion tools, which comprises a paste tube for accommodating paste, wherein a discharge nozzle is arranged at the upper end of the paste tube, a paste outlet is formed in the discharge nozzle, a movable cover plate capable of moving is arranged on the paste tube outside the discharge nozzle, a first limiting piece is arranged on the movable cover plate, a second limiting piece is arranged on the discharge nozzle, and the movable cover plate is connected to the discharge nozzle through the matching between the first limiting piece and the second limiting piece and seals the discharge nozzle. The utility model can solve the problems that in the prior art, the aluminum plastic foil is required to be arranged on the discharging nozzle in the toothpaste filling process to prevent leakage, and the operation is troublesome in tearing off during use.

title_en: RGV dolly for high density storage
abstract_en: The utility model provides an RGV trolley for high-density storage, which relates to the technical field of RGV trolleys and comprises a trolley body, wherein a loading platform is arranged at the top of the trolley body, the loading platform can be overturned through a turnover mechanism positioned at one side of the trolley body, so that goods positioned on the loading platform can slide down to a designated place along the loading platform, a protection structure is further arranged at the back side of the loading platform, when unloading is required, the turnover mechanism can drive the loading platform to overturn, so that the loading platform is in an inclined state, the goods positioned on the loading platform can slide to the protection structure, a protection seat of the protection structure can rotate to a state parallel to the ground through a driving motor, and at the moment, an air pump can inflate the air bag through a connecting air pipe, so that the air bag can bulge and be higher than the outer surface of the protection seat, and further can be contacted and buffered with the air bag after the goods fall, so that the goods can be protected.

title_en: Toughened glass placing cabinet
abstract_en: The application provides a toughened glass placing cabinet, and relates to the field of toughened glass. The toughened glass placing cabinet comprises a base, a separating mechanism and a conveying mechanism, wherein the separating mechanism is located on the upper surface of the base and comprises a placing groove and an isolation pad, the placing groove is used for aligning and fixing toughened glass, the placing groove is located below the isolation pad, and the isolation pad is used for isolating the toughened glass aligned in the placing groove. Through the cooperation use between separating mechanism's standing groove and the isolation pad, be convenient for stabilize toughened glass through the standing groove and place, keep apart the operation with toughened glass through the isolation pad, avoid toughened glass to paste together and be inconvenient for take out, improved staff's transport or the efficiency of placing, drive the threaded rod through the motor and rotate in the inside of recess, the operation is moved to the threaded rod linkage slider, the slider drives the backup pad and removes the regulation afterwards to be convenient for take out or place toughened glass.

title_en: Ejection type detachable storage box
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an ejection type detachable storage box, which belongs to the technical field of paper products, and the technical scheme is characterized in that the ejection type detachable storage box comprises a box body, wherein the box body consists of an outer box body and an inner box body, the inner box body is slidably arranged in the outer box body, an ejection mechanism is arranged on the inner bottom surface of the outer box body, a locking hole is arranged on the side wall of the ejection plate, a round hole is formed in the side wall of the outer box body, a locking component for fixing the ejection mechanism is arranged in the round hole, the locking component comprises a fixing sleeve and a fixing cap, the fixing head and the fixing cap are arranged in the round hole in a threaded manner, a cavity is formed, sliding holes with the same size and shape are formed at one ends of the fixing sleeve and the fixing cap, a locking rod is slidably arranged in the cavity and the sliding hole, an inclined plane is arranged at the end part of the locking rod, a baffle is slidably arranged in the cavity, and a second spring is arranged between the baffle and the inner side wall of the cavity.

title_en: Overlapped discharging device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an overlapping discharging device which can realize overlapping of paper and alignment of icons. The overlapped discharging device comprises a frame, a steering platform and more than two steering guide rollers, wherein each steering guide roller is horizontally arranged above the steering platform at an inclined angle of degrees, and the overlapped discharging device is characterized in that: the front of the steering platform is provided with a mark aligning mechanism, the mark aligning mechanism comprises a support, a feeding guide roller, a regulating roller and a discharging guide roller, the feeding guide roller and the discharging guide roller are both arranged at the lower part of the support, the regulating roller is arranged on the support in an up-and-down adjustable manner, and the regulating roller is positioned at the upper position between the feeding guide roller and the discharging guide roller. The overlapped discharging device ensures that the paper can be overlapped and the icons on the paper can be aligned by arranging the steering guide roller and the alignment mechanism.

title_en: Cable production is with steady line device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of cable production, in particular to a cable stabilizing device for cable production, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein at least two groups of frames are arranged on the bottom plate, a bearing plate is fixed on the frames, four groups of maintenance and stabilization mechanisms distributed in a cross shape are arranged in the frames, wherein the two groups of maintenance and stabilization mechanisms and the other two groups of maintenance and stabilization mechanisms are arranged in a staggered mode, each maintenance and stabilization mechanism comprises a shell fixed in the frame, a movable rod is slidably arranged on the shell, a top plate and a rack are respectively fixed at two ends of the movable rod, a suspension spring is sleeved on the movable rod, and guide rollers in contact with the surface of a cable are rotatably arranged on the rack. According to the stabilizing mechanism distributed in the shape of the Chinese character jing, the input cable passes through the four groups of guide rollers, and under the action of the suspension springs, the four groups of guide rollers apply pressure inwards to squeeze and restrain the cable, so that multidirectional limitation is realized, the stability of cable output is improved, and the follow-up stable winding is ensured.

title_en: Automatic lifting device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of conveying equipment, and provides an automatic lifting device which comprises a frame body, a moving table, a swinging arm, a rod body and a second driver, wherein the moving table can move on the frame body along a preset path, the first driver is used for driving the moving table to move, one end of the swinging arm is rotatably arranged on the moving table around a first horizontal axis, a notch is formed in the other end of the swinging arm, the swinging arm can be switched between a falling position and a rising position, and the second driver is used for clamping the rod body into the notch and driving the swinging arm to rotate from the falling position to the rising position.

title_en: Multifunctional environment-friendly carton
abstract_en: The utility model provides a multifunctional environment-friendly carton which comprises a box body, wherein a sliding component is arranged in the box body, a lifting component is arranged in the box body, the lifting component comprises a lifting belt, the lifting belt is movably connected to the inner surface of the box body, a connecting component is arranged in the box body, a package is movably connected to the inner surface of the box body, a protecting component is arranged at the top of the box body, the sliding component comprises a connecting plate, the connecting plate is fixedly arranged at the left end and the right end of the box body close to the bottom, and a sliding groove is formed in the connecting plate. According to the multifunctional environment-friendly carton provided by the utility model, the package is placed on the surface of the lifting belt in the carton body, so that the lifting belt can drive the package to move out of the carton body by pulling the connecting assembly, the package is conveniently taken, meanwhile, the damage to the package caused by dumping is reduced, and the protection plate is arranged at the bottom of the sealing cover, so that the package is prevented from being scratched when the adhesive tape is scratched.

title_en: Double-driving-block transportation trolley for suspension conveying line
abstract_en: The utility model provides a double-driving-block transportation trolley for a suspension conveying line, which comprises a trolley body, wherein bearing wheels are respectively arranged on two sides of the trolley body, and the bearing wheels are movably connected with a trolley body shaft. The two ends of the vehicle body are respectively provided with a stacking rod, the vehicle body is provided with a shaft sleeve, the shaft sleeve is vertically arranged, the stacking rod passes through the shaft sleeve, the power and free rod is connected with the shaft sleeve in a sliding manner, the upper end of the power and free rod is connected with a driving block, and the driving block is horizontally arranged. The power and free wheel is connected to the lower end of the power and free rod, the power and free rod is sleeved with a spring, the spring is arranged between the vehicle body and the driving block, the upper end of the spring is connected with the driving block, and the lower end of the spring is connected with the vehicle body. According to the utility model, 2 driving blocks are arranged, so that the friction force between the trolley and the belt is increased, the driving force of the bicycle is improved, the slipping phenomenon in the transportation process is avoided, and the adaptability of the transportation trolley is improved.

title_en: Steel overhead hoist
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a steel lifting device which comprises a lifting beam, an adjusting structure and a binding structure, wherein the top of the lifting beam is provided with a lifting lug, the adjusting structure is arranged at the bottom of the lifting beam, the binding structure is arranged below the adjusting structure, the adjusting structure comprises an adjusting bin, an adjusting screw and an adjusting sliding block, the adjusting bin is arranged at the bottom of the lifting beam, the bottom of the adjusting bin is provided with a guide groove, two ends of the adjusting screw are rotatably arranged on opposite side walls in the adjusting bin, one side of the adjusting bin is rotatably provided with an adjusting block, the adjusting block is connected with one end of the adjusting screw, two groups of screw groups with opposite screw directions are arranged on the adjusting screw, the two groups of adjusting sliding blocks are arranged on the two groups of screw groups with opposite screw directions through screw connection, and the bottoms of the two groups of adjusting sliding blocks penetrate through and are slidably arranged in the guide groove. The utility model relates to the technical field of steel transportation, and particularly provides a steel lifting device.

title_en: Plank sideslip of hasp stamping equipment rolls and send mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wood board transverse rolling and conveying mechanism of lock catch stamping equipment, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a top plate is arranged above the bottom plate, side support frames are arranged on two sides of the top end of the top plate, a roller belt conveying mechanism is arranged on the inner wall between the side support frames, equidistant limit rollers are rotatably arranged on the inner wall of the side support frame below the roller belt conveying mechanism, a gear motor is arranged on the outer wall of one side support frame, two positioning seats are arranged on the outer wall of the side support frame, upright posts are arranged inside the positioning seats, a first cross rod is arranged on the outer wall of the upper end between the upright posts, an equidistant bearing frame is arranged on the outer wall of the first cross rod, and equidistant partition plates are arranged above the roller belt conveying mechanism. The utility model not only improves the conveying efficiency of the rolling mechanism to the wood board when in use, but also ensures the cleanliness of the surface of the roller belt conveying mechanism, and is convenient for conveying the wood board to the processing equipment with the designated height so as to improve the application range of the rolling mechanism.

title_en: Magnetic drive conveying system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a magnetic drive conveying system which comprises a rotor module, a stator module and a lifting mechanism, wherein the rotor module comprises a rotor base and a permanent magnet array arranged on the rotor base, the permanent magnet array comprises a first permanent magnet array extending along a first direction and a second permanent magnet array extending along a second direction, the first direction and the second direction are arranged at an included angle, the stator module comprises at least two conveying lines with different heights on the same horizontal plane, the conveying lines are magnetically coupled with the rotor module and are used for driving the rotor module to move, and the lifting mechanism is used for lifting and conveying the rotor module positioned on one conveying line to the other conveying line.

title_en: Telescopic material conveying arm
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a telescopic material conveying arm, which comprises a mounting chamber, wherein a conveying mechanism is arranged in the mounting chamber, and the movable end of the conveying mechanism penetrates through one end of the mounting chamber and is connected with a material plate; the telescopic mechanism is characterized by comprising a rotating shaft, wherein the rotating shaft is rotatably connected between two opposite side inner walls at one end of a mounting chamber, a gear is sleeved on the rotating shaft, a movable rod assembly is slidably arranged on one side inner wall of the mounting chamber and comprises a toothed plate strip, the toothed plate strip is meshed with the gear, one end of the movable rod assembly extends out of one end of the mounting chamber, which is close to the rotating shaft, and is connected with a material plate through a connecting seat, telescopic movement is realized in a mode of driving the movable rod assembly to move through the gear, long-distance telescopic action can be realized as long as the length of the toothed plate strip in the movable rod assembly is long enough, the telescopic transmission stroke of the material plate is increased, and the requirements of users can be better met.

title_en: Positioning assembly of conveying device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a conveyor's locating component, includes two sets of mounting panel (1) and two sets of running roller (2), two sets of mounting panel (1) on all be equipped with limiting plate (4), limiting plate (4) sliding connection have regulating plate (5), regulating plate (5) on set up mounting groove (6), mounting groove (6) internal rotation be connected with drive belt (3) complex prevent off tracking roller (7), two sets of mounting panel (1) between rotate be connected with regulating plate (5) threaded connection's two-way lead screw (8), two-way lead screw (8) one end fixedly connected with adjustment handle (9). Under the action of the anti-deviation roller 7, the driving belt 3 is prevented from deviating, and as the guide grooves 11 are formed in the roller 2, the driving belt 3 is provided with the guide blocks 12 matched with the guide grooves 11, and under the matching of the guide grooves 11 and the guide blocks 12, the driving belt 3 is further prevented from deviating.

title_en: Mechanism for measuring depth of water body
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a mechanism for measuring the depth of a water body, and belongs to the technical field of water body detection devices. A mechanism for measuring depth of water body comprises a base, a movable support is arranged above the base through a transverse moving device, and is characterized in that the movable support comprises a base, a vertical plate arranged on the base, a transverse plate is arranged on the upper portion of the vertical plate, a wire hole is formed in the bottom of the vertical plate, a wire guide wheel is arranged in the wire hole, the wire guide wheel is arranged on the base through supporting upright posts on two sides, a paying-off control rod is hinged to one side of the vertical plate, a measuring rope is wound on the wire guide wheel, a hanging wheel with a lifting function is arranged on the transverse plate, the measuring rope on the wire guide wheel bypasses the wire guide wheel and then bypasses the hanging wheel, a hanging assembly is arranged at the end portion of the hanging assembly, and an electronic device for signal transmission is arranged in the device bin.

title_en: Reversible bin-matched type belt conveyor dustproof sealing structure
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of conveying, in particular to a dust-proof sealing structure of a reversible bin-matched belt conveyor, which comprises a track, wherein the upper part of the track is provided with the reversible belt conveyor, the reversible belt conveyor can move left and right along the track under the drive of a power mechanism, the lower part of the reversible belt conveyor is provided with a cover plate in a fixed structure mode, the cover plate is positioned in the track, the front end and the rear end of the reversible belt conveyor are provided with sliding covers in a fixed structure mode, the sliding covers cover the track and are provided with rollers in a rotating structure mode, the rollers are in rolling connection with the track, the tracks on the two sides of the reversible belt conveyor are covered by the sliding covers, and the cover plate is used for covering the bottom of the reversible belt conveyor, so that the escape of dust in a bin is reduced as much as possible, the working environment is improved, the pollution is reduced, the health of workers is guaranteed, the explosion caused by excessive dust accumulation is avoided, and the safety of production is improved.

title_en: Sand and stone aggregate storage yard structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of sandstone yards and discloses a sandstone aggregate yard structure, which comprises a yard, wherein a support frame is fixedly connected to the top of the yard, a first motor is fixedly connected to one side of the support frame, a rotating column is fixedly connected to the output end of the first motor, one end of the rotating column is rotatably connected with a crank, a connecting rod is fixedly connected to one side of the crank, a fixed block is fixedly connected to the top of the support frame, a rotating rod is rotatably connected to one side of the fixed block, a connecting frame is fixedly connected to one side of the rotating rod, a screen is fixedly connected to the inside of the connecting frame, and a fixed frame is fixedly connected to one side of the connecting frame. According to the utility model, the screen is driven to work by the rotating column and the crank, so that the effect of screening sand and stone is realized quickly, sand and stone aggregates with different particle sizes and specifications cannot be screened quickly in the stacking process, and the problem of difficulty in distinguishing different types of materials is solved, so that the applicability of a storage yard is improved.

title_en: Automatic feeding device for gasket
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic feeding device for washers, which comprises a bracket, wherein a turnover assembly, a feeding assembly, a clamping assembly and a limiting assembly are connected to the bracket, the turnover assembly is connected with the feeding assembly, the clamping assembly is arranged on one side of the turnover assembly and is rotatably connected with the bracket through the turnover assembly, the limiting assembly is arranged above the bracket and is connected with the feeding assembly, one side of the feeding assembly is also connected with a supporting plate, the limiting assembly comprises a limiting rod, a limiting slide block, a limiting stop block and a limiting column, one end of the limiting rod is connected with the feeding assembly, the other end of the limiting rod is connected with the limiting slide block, the limiting slide block is connected with the bracket in a sliding manner through a limiting track, the limiting stop block is fixed on one side of the limiting slide block, and the limiting column is arranged on the upper surface of the bracket. According to the utility model, the feeding component controls the overturning component, so that the overturning component controls the clamping component to move, clamping, overturning, pushing and placing of the gasket are realized, automatic feeding of the gasket is realized, and the working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Quick-change device for rotary pipe device
abstract_en: The application relates to a quick-change device for a rotary pipe device, which comprises a frame, wherein a first moving mechanism, a fixing mechanism and a second moving mechanism are arranged on the frame, the first moving mechanism is used for conveying materials to the fixing mechanism, the fixing mechanism is used for enabling the materials to pass through, the second moving mechanism moves to an initial position of the first moving mechanism after the first moving mechanism leaves and is used for replacing the first moving mechanism to be communicated with the fixing mechanism for other materials to pass through, the first moving mechanism comprises a moving assembly, a support and a moving guide piece, the moving assembly is used for being in sliding connection with the frame, the moving guide piece is arranged on the support, the moving guide piece is used for enabling the materials to pass through, and the fixing mechanism comprises a fixed guide piece, and the fixed guide piece is used for being communicated with the moving guide piece for enabling the materials to pass through. The application has the advantage of higher material conveying efficiency.

title_en: Elevator overload detection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an elevator overload detection device, which belongs to the field of elevator overload detection and comprises a detection assembly, wherein the detection assembly comprises a bottom plate, a bearing plate is arranged at the upper end of the bottom plate, a plurality of buffer seats are connected between the bottom plate and the bearing plate, gravity sensors are arranged at the upper ends of the plurality of buffer seats, the upper ends of the gravity sensors are connected with sensor contacts, buzzers are embedded in the bottom plate, buffer springs are connected between the bottom plate and the bearing plate, a plurality of first screw holes are formed in the upper end of the bottom plate, and screws are connected in the first screw holes.

title_en: Buffer structure and packing carton
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a buffer structure and a packing box, and belongs to the field of packing articles. The buffer structure comprises a ventilation layer, a first buffer layer and a second buffer layer. At least one buffer layer of the first buffer layer and the second buffer layer is provided with a plurality of ventilation holes. After buffer structure and product laminating, because the ventilative layer can be ventilative with the bleeder vent intercommunication, consequently can avoid buffer structure and the junction surface place of product to be the vacuum state in the position department, make the pressure between buffer structure and the product keep unanimous with the pressure in the external environment to can avoid between buffer structure and the display panel to adsorb each other.

title_en: Film splicing table, device and rewinder
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of manufacturing of current collector film materials, and particularly relates to a film material splicing table, a film material splicing device and a rewinding machine. The membrane material splicing table comprises an adsorption base, a movable pressing bar and a limiting block. The adsorption base comprises a base plate and an adsorption structure, wherein the adsorption structure is connected to the base plate and forms an adsorption area on the plane where one side surface of the base plate in the thickness direction of the membrane material is located, the movable pressing strips are connected to the adsorption base and located on two opposite sides of the adsorption area in the extending direction of the membrane material, the movable pressing strips can adjust gaps with the base plate in the thickness direction of the membrane material for the membrane material to pass through and are used for attaching the membrane material on the plane where the adsorption area is located, limiting blocks are arranged at two ends of each movable pressing strip in the width direction of the membrane material, at least one of the limiting blocks at the two ends is detachably connected with the movable pressing strips, and the mounting positions of the movable pressing strips can be adjusted in the width direction of the membrane material. The limiting blocks mark the two ends of the film material to be spliced in the width direction, and the uniformity of the end faces of coiled materials formed after the film material is wound is ensured.

title_en: Rubber plane plastic tray
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of trays, and particularly relates to a rubber plane plastic tray which comprises a tray body, wherein a foot pad is fixedly connected to the bottom of the tray body, a rubber surface is fixedly connected to the top of the tray body, a fork inlet is formed in the side face of the tray body, a fixing opening is formed in the top of the fork inlet, an anti-slip pad is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the fixing opening, connecting rods are arranged on two sides of the fixing opening, a clamping block is fixedly connected to the outer side of the connecting rods, an upper sliding surface is arranged below the side face of the clamping block, a lower sliding surface is arranged above the side face of the clamping block, a connecting block is fixedly connected to the inner side of the connecting rod, a guide groove is formed in the inner side of the tray body, a telescopic rod is fixedly connected to the inner side of the connecting block, a shrinkage groove is formed in the other end of the telescopic rod, and a spring is fixedly connected between the shrinkage groove and the connecting block. The utility model has reasonable structural design through improving the tray and adopts the technologies of fork feeding, fork fixing and the like, thereby effectively solving the current situation that the function of the existing tray is not perfect.

title_en: Moistureproof device for storing corrugated board
abstract_en: The moistureproof device for corrugated board storage comprises a box assembly, an exhaust unit, a placement device and a detection device, wherein the exhaust unit is fixedly communicated with the lower end of the box assembly, the placement device is fixedly arranged in the box assembly, and the detection device is fixedly communicated with the top of the box assembly. The corrugated board can solve the problems that the corrugated board is easy to damp, deform and mould to influence use caused by stacking after the existing corrugated board is manufactured.

title_en: Winding pipe processing clamping device convenient to unload
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a winding pipe processing clamping device convenient for discharging, which comprises a machine base, wherein supporting piles are fixedly connected to the lower ends of the machine base, which are positioned at the left side and the right side, supporting seats are fixedly connected to the opposite side walls of the two supporting piles, a driving assembly is arranged at the upper end of the right side of each supporting seat, a groove is arranged at the upper end of the machine base, and a conducting mechanism is arranged on the inner walls of the left side and the right side of each groove. According to the utility model, the plurality of conveying rollers are driven to simultaneously rotate in the same direction through the gear motor, so that the winding pipe is conveniently conducted to carry out loading and unloading operations, manual operation is not needed, time and labor are saved, rapid loading and unloading are convenient, the structure is simple and practical, the two clamping seats are driven to relatively move through the linear guide rail matched with the movable guide block until the winding pipe is inserted into the two arc-shaped grooves and is pressed against the plurality of positioning rollers, the winding pipe is effectively clamped and positioned, the driving motor is matched with the plurality of positioning rollers to drive the winding pipe to rotate and adjust, manual rotation and adjustment are not needed, the labor intensity is reduced, and the machining efficiency is improved.

title_en: Tapping alignment assembly for film sleeving machine
abstract_en: The utility model provides a flapping alignment assembly for a film sleeving machine, which comprises a connecting bracket, a driving assembly and a flapping assembly, wherein the driving assembly is fixed below the connecting bracket and comprises a push rod air cylinder, a first connecting base is fixed on an air cylinder rod of the push rod air cylinder, a second connecting base is connected below the connecting bracket in a sliding manner, the driving assembly further comprises a linkage mechanism used for driving the second connecting base to move, and the flapping assembly comprises a first flapping plate and a second flapping plate, the first flapping plate is fixed on the first connecting base, and the second flapping plate is fixed on the second connecting base. The beating and aligning assembly can realize that two beating plates move in opposite directions simultaneously, so that the foaming cotton plate in the film sleeving machine is aligned, and the next film laminating action is facilitated.

title_en: Anti-clamping flat steel for current divider
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of conveying and shunting, in particular to anti-clamping flat steel for a shunt. The conveyor comprises a conveyor, wherein a splitter plate is arranged at the upper end of the conveyor, flat steel is arranged on the front channel of the splitter plate, the flat steel is positioned between a conveyor frame and a belt, the belt passes through the flat steel, and a height difference is formed at the position of the flat steel. Compared with the prior art, the novel belt conveyor has the advantages of simple structure, easiness in processing, capability of being rapidly installed on a conveyor sliding table, and capability of avoiding the risk of small packages clamped in gaps on the basis of not changing the integral structure and damaging the belt.

title_en: Mechanical arm for fine butt joint of metal wires
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mechanical arm for fine butt joint of metal wires, which belongs to the technical field of bubble generation and comprises a support frame and two transmission arms rotatably connected to the support frame, wherein wire feeding mechanisms are arranged at the tail ends of the two transmission arms, the wire discharging directions of the wire feeding mechanisms are opposite, the transmission arms are used as execution modules, and the driving modules are used as power sources for the rotation angles and the directions of the transmission arms. The driving module and the executing module adopt a mechanical transmission mode to realize the accurate control of the positions of the metal wires at two ends, realize the automation and the mechanization of the butt joint of the metal wires, solve the problems of inaccuracy and unsafe caused by manually lapping copper wires in the existing experimental device, and eliminate the potential safety hazard caused by manual operation in a conductive medium.

title_en: Intelligent hank making machine for color yarn production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of yarn production devices, and particularly discloses an intelligent stranding machine for yarn production, which comprises a bottom plate, a rotating motor, a sliding block and a moving frame, wherein a vertical plate is arranged on the bottom plate, the vertical plate is arranged on one side of the bottom plate, the rotating motor is arranged at the top position of the side surface of the vertical plate, a rod body is arranged on the rotating motor, the rod body penetrates through the vertical plate to be provided with the rotating plate, a sliding connecting rod is arranged on the rotating plate, a sliding groove is arranged on the sliding connecting rod, the sliding block is arranged in the sliding groove, a winding rod is arranged on the sliding block, the moving frame is arranged on the side surface of the vertical plate, the moving frame is positioned at the bottom of the rotating plate, a moving block is arranged on the moving frame, and a threading hole is formed in the moving block.

title_en: Metering bin discharging device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a metering bin discharging device which comprises a metering bin, wherein hinged arms are welded on two sides of the metering bin, the metering bin further comprises a relay bin, a collecting groove is formed above the relay bin, hinged shafts are fixedly arranged on two sides of the relay bin and are in running fit with the hinged arms, the discharging mechanism comprises a discharging cylinder and a transparent cover, the transparent cover is rotatably arranged on the discharging cylinder, the discharging cylinder is welded on the front face of the metering bin and is communicated with the inside of the collecting groove, and the sealing mechanism is connected with the metering bin and the collecting groove. Through articulated arm and articulated shaft normal running fit, with relay storehouse rotation installation in measurement storehouse top, start the adjustment pneumatic cylinder and can drive relay storehouse rotation, relay storehouse rotation can drive discharge mechanism rotation to adjust the height of discharge mechanism port, make discharge mechanism can adapt to the loading utensil of not co-altitude, directly with the material output to in the loading utensil.

title_en: PO film unreels accuse fast structure
abstract_en: The application provides a PO film unreeling speed control structure, and belongs to the technical field of PO films. The PO film unreeling speed control structure comprises a film roll, wherein two ends of the film roll are provided with supports, a rotating shaft is fixedly connected to the film roll, the rotating shaft is rotationally connected with the supports, a transmission part and a friction part are arranged on the rotating shaft, a control rod is movably connected to the supports, and the control rod is respectively and movably connected with the transmission part and the friction part. The application has the following effects that the control rod can be connected with the transmission piece to control the film roll to rotate so as to realize unreeling and reeling, and can be disconnected with the transmission piece and connected with the friction piece when unreeling, the speed of unreeling the film roll is controlled by friction with the rotating shaft, so that controllable and rapid unreeling is realized.

title_en: Efficient bundling machine for pipe profiles
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-efficiency bundling machine for pipe profiles, which comprises a workbench, wherein supporting plates are symmetrically arranged at the bottom of the workbench, a movable frame is arranged on one side of the top of the workbench, bundling mechanisms are arranged in the movable frame and on the top of the workbench, guide rails are symmetrically arranged on one side of the top of the workbench, the movable frame is in sliding connection with the two guide rails, an installation frame is symmetrically arranged at the top of the workbench, electric push rods are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the two installation frames, the electric push rods are fixedly connected with the workbench, an alignment assembly is arranged at the bottom of the workbench, and a placement assembly is arranged in the two installation frames, wherein the alignment assembly comprises an installation plate fixedly arranged between the two supporting plates, so that one end of a pipe can be aligned before bundling, the pipe cannot be aligned after bundling is avoided, and the subsequent transportation and the transportation are prevented from being influenced.

title_en: Buckle cover positioning mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of packaging machinery, in particular to a buckle cover positioning mechanism which comprises buckle cover positioning adjusting bases arranged at two ends, wherein buckle cover box interval adjusting mechanisms are symmetrically arranged between the buckle cover positioning adjusting bases, each buckle cover box interval adjusting mechanism comprises an upper shaft and a lower shaft which are arranged in parallel, two ends of each shaft are respectively provided with a distance plate, one end of each distance plate is vertically provided with a first cylinder, a connecting plate is arranged between the shafts, two sides on each connecting plate are symmetrically and vertically provided with sliding blocks along the length direction, the upper parts of the sliding blocks are provided with fixing seats, and one end of each connecting plate, which is close to the first cylinder, is connected with a second cylinder. Compared with the traditional mechanism, the buckle cover positioning mechanism has the advantages of low cost, convenience in operation, stability and high efficiency, and capability of freely changing positions and numbers, and is suitable for packaging requirements of various packaging boxes.

title_en: Tensioner with automatic winding function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of tensioners, in particular to a tensioner with a self-winding function, which comprises a mounting rack, wherein a sliding hole is formed in the side surface of the mounting rack, a mounting plate is arranged on the side surface of the mounting rack, the mounting plate is opposite to the sliding hole, a mounting groove is formed in the side surface of the mounting plate, a release wheel is arranged in the mounting groove, a connecting rod is fixedly connected to the side surface of the release wheel, the tail end of the connecting rod is rotationally connected with a sliding block, the sliding block is positioned in the sliding hole and is in sliding connection with the sliding hole, a rotating motor is arranged on the side surface of the sliding block, the release wheel is rotationally connected with the sliding block through the connecting rod, the output end of the rotating motor penetrates through the sliding block and is fixedly connected with the connecting rod, and then after the rotating motor is started, the release wheel can rotate to wind up a binding belt, and simultaneously the rotating motor can be stopped at any time, so that the binding belt can be conveniently adjusted, and the working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Automatic napkin separate-packaging equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses automatic napkin split charging equipment which comprises a workbench, a conveying unit and a split charging unit, wherein the conveying unit is positioned in the middle of the workbench, the split charging unit is positioned at the top of the workbench, the workbench comprises a first supporting beam and a second supporting beam, the split charging unit comprises a fixing piece and a lifting hydraulic rod, a clamping roller is movably inserted at the bottom of the fixing piece, a hot plate is arranged at the bottom of the fixing piece, the lifting hydraulic rod is fixed at the top of the second supporting beam, a hot strip is arranged at the inner side of the lifting hydraulic rod, and a cutter is movably inserted at the hot strip. The automatic feeding and discharging device has the advantages that the device is provided with the conveying belt, automatic feeding and discharging treatment can be carried out on napkin paper, feeding uniformity is guaranteed, labor force requirements are reduced, labor cost is reduced, the packaging unit is provided with the packaging film rolling shaft, automatic feeding of packaging materials can be achieved, and the clamping roller and the hot plate are arranged and matched to achieve automatic scalding treatment of edges of the packaging materials.

title_en: Protector of feed bin feed opening
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of blanking of a storage bin, in particular to a protection device for a blanking opening of the storage bin, wherein the blanking opening is arranged at the bottom of the storage bin, the protection device comprises baffle plates fixedly connected with a pair of inclined inner walls of the blanking opening respectively, a reserved groove is formed between each baffle plate and the inner wall of the blanking opening, and a concrete layer is arranged in the reserved groove. According to the protective device for the feed opening of the feed bin, disclosed by the utility model, the material falls onto the baffle after passing through the feed bin, and is discharged downwards after being contacted with the baffle, so that the baffle and the concrete layer have the effects of reducing the possibility of grinding and leaking the inner wall of the feed opening in the material falling process, the service life of the feed opening is prolonged, the feed opening is not required to be maintained regularly by workers, and the labor intensity of the workers is reduced.

title_en: Air bag type electronic product packaging box
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an air bag type electronic product packaging box which comprises a box body structure, wherein the box body structure consists of a polypropylene packaging box, a fixing hole, a connecting structure, a frame structure and an air bag structure. The connecting structure is used for fixing the frame structure on the inner wall of the polypropylene packaging box through the cross-connection cavity and the limiting cavity, and the air bag structure is arranged inside the polypropylene packaging box through the frame structure. The first air bag and the second air bag of the air bag structure are pressurized and expanded through the air duct and the one-way valve, and can provide protection for electronic products. The safety valve is used for relieving pressure when the air bag is impacted, so that the safety of packaging is improved. The design has good shock resistance, and the air bag structure and the frame structure can effectively improve the stability of the polypropylene packaging box and the safety of electronic products.

title_en: Belt flange mechanism, belt transmission mechanism and sorter
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to the field of belt conveying, in particular to a belt flange mechanism, a belt conveying mechanism and a sorting machine, wherein the belt flange mechanism is applied to the belt conveying mechanism and comprises a belt and racks positioned on two sides of the belt; the belt flange mechanism comprises a support, a rubber, a supporting rib plate and a supporting rib plate, wherein the support is of a plate-shaped structure and extends along the conveying direction of the belt, the support is arranged above the outer side edge of the belt and comprises an inclined portion, the inclined portion is obliquely arranged on the outer side of the belt, the rubber is of a sheet-shaped structure and extends along the conveying direction of the belt, the upper portion of the rubber is fixed with the surface of the inclined portion of the support, which faces the inner side of the belt, the lower end of the rubber is used for being abutted with the belt and used for blocking materials conveyed on the belt to move towards the outer side of the belt, and the supporting rib plate is fixedly arranged on the back side of the inclined portion of the support and is fixedly connected with the frame so as to support the support. The novel anti-overflow device can prevent dust and particulate matters from overflowing, blocking materials and the like, and can resist the impact of large materials.

title_en: Speed-adjustable rhythm control device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of milk candy processing, in particular to a speed-adjustable rhythm control device. The technical scheme includes that the workbench, a conveyor belt and a first rotating plate are arranged on the upper surface of the workbench, a first groove is formed in the upper surface of the workbench, two sides of the inner wall of the first groove are respectively connected with rotating rollers in a rotating mode, the rotating rollers are sleeved with the conveyor belt, fixing plates are respectively fixed at the front end and the rear end of the upper surface of the workbench, the rear end of each fixing plate is rotationally connected with a first rotating shaft, the first rotating shaft is fixed with the first rotating plate, a second groove is formed in one side of each rotating plate, two ends of the front end and the rear end of the inner wall of the second groove are respectively rotationally connected with the second rotating shaft, a second rotating plate is fixed at the rear end of the second rotating shaft, and a scraping plate is fixed at one side of the second rotating plate. The utility model has the advantages that the speed of the conveyor belt can be adjusted at any time according to the state of the sugar body, and meanwhile, the adhered toffee on the conveyor belt can be cleaned, so that the time and the labor are saved, unnecessary bad and waste can be reduced, and the working intensity of staff can be lightened.

title_en: Production line for gluing and assembling office chairs
abstract_en: The utility model provides a production line of office chair rubber coating equipment, includes the transfer chain that is used for carrying the seat support, has set gradually first automatic rubber coating device, bottom plate installation device, second automatic rubber coating device, viscose cloth device, nail cloth repair device, back of the body shell installation device and subsides mark bagging apparatus from the material loading end to the unloading end on the transfer chain, and the position that corresponds first automatic rubber coating device, second automatic rubber coating device on the transfer chain is provided with visual scanning device. The production line can carry out the procedures of gluing and assembling on the seat of the office chair, the gluing and assembling of the seat are completed on the same conveying line, the production efficiency of the office chair is greatly improved, the seat is automatically glued through the automatic gluing device, the intelligent degree is high, the production efficiency is high, the labor cost is saved, the seat is visually scanned through the visual scanning device before being glued, the gluing position is accurately judged, and the accurate gluing of the seat by the automatic gluing device is realized.

title_en: Cutter disc locking structure of label sleeving machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of label sleeving machines and discloses a label sleeving machine cutterhead locking structure which comprises a box body, wherein a rotating shaft and a vertical plate are arranged on the inner bottom surface of the box body, a first air cylinder is arranged on the outer side surface of the vertical plate, a first baffle is connected with an output shaft of the first air cylinder, a partition plate and a second air cylinder are arranged on the inner side surface of the box body, a discharging pipe is arranged in the partition plate, a second baffle is connected with an output shaft of the second air cylinder, and a first synchronous wheel and a second synchronous wheel are arranged on the outer side surface of the rotating shaft. According to the utility model, the servo motor is started, the output shaft of the servo motor can drive the third synchronous wheel to rotate, the third synchronous wheel can drive the second synchronous wheel and one of the rotating shafts to rotate through the second belt, the first synchronous wheel can drive the other first synchronous wheels and the rotating shafts to rotate together through the first belt, and then the four blades can be effectively driven to rotate and the label can be cut.

title_en: Conveyer is used in urea resin production
abstract_en: A conveying device for urea resin production comprises a tray and a plurality of barrel bodies matched with the tray, wherein each barrel body comprises an outer wall, an inner wall and a cavity formed by the outer wall and the inner wall, a plurality of anti-shaking plates are arranged on the inner side of the inner wall, a launder is reserved between each anti-shaking plate and the inner wall, a tray structure is used for fixing and limiting a storage plastic barrel of urea resin, meanwhile, limiting plates attached to the barrel walls are arranged, the stability of the plastic barrel in the driving process can be guaranteed, meanwhile, the tray structure can be used for placing a plastic barrel at one time, loading and unloading are convenient, the loading process before and after transportation is accelerated, heat preservation is needed to be paid in the urea resin transportation process, the plastic barrel is of a two-layer structure, and the influence of the outside air temperature on the inner cavity of the plastic barrel can be effectively reduced.

title_en: Frozen storage pipe cover of adapter screwing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a frozen storage tube cover of an adaptive cover screwing device, which relates to the technical field of tube covers of frozen storage tubes, and comprises a tube cover body, wherein the upper end of the tube cover body is provided with a step ring, the inner side of the step ring is provided with a plurality of first grooves distributed along the circumferential direction, the outside of step ring is equipped with a plurality of division boards that distribute along circumference, is equipped with the second recess between two adjacent division boards, and division board is equipped with the face of keeping away from one side upper portion of step ring, keeps away the face and adopts arcwall face or inclined plane, and the lateral wall of tube cap body can be dismantled and be connected with the colour identification ring. The utility model not only can increase the operation space of the cap screwing device and improve the operation accuracy, but also is convenient for distinguishing.

title_en: Tail car belt replacing device for equipment with tail car system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a tail car belt replacing device for tail car system equipment, which comprises a belt replacing mechanism and a belt winding drum mechanism, wherein the belt winding drum mechanism is arranged above the belt replacing mechanism, the belt replacing mechanism comprises two upright posts, a bottom plate, a pressing plate and a control mechanism, the bottom plate is welded between the two upright posts in a horizontal mode, the pressing plate is arranged right above the bottom plate, guide grooves are formed in the inner sides of the two upright posts, and two ends of the pressing plate are arranged in the guide grooves. The control mechanism comprises a photoelectric sensor, an electric hydraulic pusher and a mounting base, wherein the mounting base is welded on the bottom plate, and the electric hydraulic pusher is fixed on the mounting base through bolts. The lifting lugs are arranged on the pressing plate, the electric hydraulic pusher is provided with pins, and the pins of the electric hydraulic pusher are connected with the lifting lugs on the pressing plate through connecting rods. The design of the utility model can improve the replacement efficiency of the tail car belt and reduce the labor cost.

title_en: Pipeline collecting and positioning device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of pipeline arrangement and discloses a pipeline collecting and positioning device, which comprises a supporting plate, wherein a movable clamp for limiting is fixedly arranged at the top of the supporting plate, a clamping seat for winding a pipe is fixedly arranged at the top of the supporting plate, a line plate for limiting is fixedly arranged at the top of the supporting plate, and a partition plate for supporting is fixedly arranged at one side of the supporting plate. This locator is collected to pipeline, cooperation through activity clamp and cassette sets up, can utilize the activity clamp to carry out spacingly to the pipeline, and utilize the cassette to twine, can collect and arrange in order to the pipeline, avoid influencing normal use because of the pipeline overlength, the reliability of device has been increased, cooperation through line board and baffle sets up, can utilize line board to fix a position the pipeline, avoid appearing the crossing condition that leads to the jam of pipeline, the baffle can separate the arrangement to the pipeline, so that better use, the convenience and the practicality of device have been increased.

title_en: Fork truck reloads into case operation fork utensil
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a forklift reloading box feeding operation fork tool which comprises a fork sleeve and a fork rod, wherein the fork sleeve is used for being inserted and matched with forklift tines, the fork rod is used for carrying out fork picking operation, the forklift reloading box feeding operation fork tool is characterized in that the fork rod is provided with a connecting section and a fork picking section which are integrally formed, the connecting section is used for being welded with the fork sleeve, the fork picking section is used for carrying out fork picking operation, the connecting section and the fork picking section of the fork rod are both provided with square steel structures welded by steel plates, the upper end face, which is contacted with the inner ring face of a steel coil, of the fork rod is provided with an arc face, the fork sleeve comprises a pair of frames which are identical in structure and are arranged front and back at a preset interval, the middle parts of the two frames are welded with the connecting section of the fork rod, and a pair of fork tine holes are correspondingly arranged at the left side and the right side of the two frames. The utility model has scientific and reasonable structural design, ensures the overall strength and toughness of the whole operation fork on the basis of weight reduction, effectively avoids breakage, has stable and reliable operation process and prolongs the service life of products.

title_en: Lifting device and mobile robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a lifting device and a mobile robot, wherein the lifting device comprises a first platform, a second platform, a driving mechanism and a traction mechanism, wherein the second platform is arranged above the first platform, an installation space is formed between the first platform and the second platform, the driving mechanism is installed in the installation space and comprises a linear module which is arranged on the first platform and hinged with the first platform, the lifting mechanism comprises a lifting platform which is arranged below the first platform in a lifting manner, the traction mechanism comprises a first traction sleeve which is fixed on the second platform, a second traction sleeve which is fixed on the first platform and a flexible traction piece, one end of the flexible traction piece is connected with the movable end of the linear module, and the other end of the flexible traction piece sequentially penetrates through the first traction sleeve and the second traction sleeve and then is connected with the lifting platform. The utility model reduces the space adjustment difficulty and the structural design difficulty of the mobile robot.

title_en: Pearl film bubble bag
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pearl film bubble bag, and relates to the technical field of bubble bags. Including the bag body, the fixed bubble membrane body that is provided with of outer wall of the bag body, the outer wall of bubble membrane body is provided with the pearly-lustre membrane, the fixed horizontal pole that is provided with in the front portion of bag body bottom, the fixed connecting seat that is provided with in one side at fixed horizontal pole top, the inside activity of connecting seat is provided with the centre gripping horizontal pole, the centre gripping horizontal pole is kept away from the inside of connecting seat one end and is offered spacing chamber, and spacing intracavity activity is provided with spacing ring plate, the fixed threaded rod that is provided with of inner wall of spacing ring plate, the fixed nut that is provided with of one end of threaded rod, the outside activity of nut is provided with the protecting crust. Through setting up the pearly-lustre membrane, the pearly-lustre membrane not only has better dampproofing and waterproofing performance, can prevent effectively that steam from corroding commodity, and the pearly-lustre membrane has the attractive luster of pearl like moreover, can show the whole aesthetic measure that promotes the packing.

title_en: Take magnetism to inhale fixed magic subsides to accomodate and bind area
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a magic tape storage binding tape with magnetic attraction fixation, which comprises a binding tape main body and a binding section, wherein the binding section is arranged at one end of the binding tape main body, the other end of the binding tape main body is provided with a fixing section, a magnetic attraction mechanism is arranged at one side of the binding tape main body, the bottom of the magnetic attraction mechanism is connected with the binding tape main body through a connecting tape, the magnetic attraction mechanism comprises a shell, a reserved groove and a magnet sheet, the reserved groove is formed in the shell, and the magnet sheet is arranged in the reserved groove. According to the utility model, the binding belt main body, the fixing section, the binding section, the fixing ring and the magnetic attraction mechanism are arranged, so that the stored articles can be adsorbed on the wall surface with magnetic force, can be conveniently taken at any time, do not need to be found in a locker or a drawer, improve the living efficiency, and can be stored on the wall when not in use, and are convenient to take and not easy to lose when not in use.

title_en: Heating type slurry dipping machine
abstract_en: The utility model provides a add hot type dipping machine, relates to meat sizing apparatus technical field, including the frame, is equipped with the thick liquid groove in the frame, and end connection has the heating basin under the thick liquid groove, is equipped with the heating pipe in the heating basin, and the one end rotation of frame is equipped with the pan feeding guipure, still is equipped with the dipping guipure in the frame, through linkage structure synchronous motion between pan feeding guipure and the dipping guipure. The utility model solves the problems that when the pulp dipping machine in the prior art wraps syrup, chocolate and other pulp with required temperature outside foods, the pulp dipping requirement of the foods cannot be met, and when one driving structure fails, the motion synchronism among the mesh belts cannot be ensured, so that the pulp dipping quality of the foods is affected.

title_en: Food packing can
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of food packaging cans, in particular to a food packaging can, which comprises a can body, and further comprises a can cover arranged at one end of the can body and provided with an opening, wherein the center of the top of the can cover is provided with a jogged groove, one end of the inner bottom of the jogged groove is provided with a through groove extending to the bottom of the can cover, the inner wall of the through groove is provided with a storage piece in a sliding manner, the storage piece comprises a main rod, the main rod is vertically and slidably arranged in the through groove through guide rails at two sides, both ends of the guide rails are fixedly provided with limiting blocks, and a storage box is fixedly arranged at one side of the bottom of the main rod. In the embodiment of the utility model, the through groove penetrating through the top and the bottom of the tank cover is formed in the embedded groove at the top of the tank cover, and the storage part is arranged in the through groove in a sliding manner, wherein the storage part stores and hides the spoon at the inner bottom of the tank cover by arranging the storage box, and the spoon in the storage box can be fixed and taken out by mounting the main rod and the auxiliary rod, so that a safe, hidden and firm storage environment is provided for the spoon.

title_en: Arm pin plugging device and crane
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of engineering machinery and discloses an arm pin plugging device and a crane. The arm pin inserting and pulling device comprises mounting seats and driving pieces, wherein the mounting seats are suitable for being fixedly connected to basic arms of a crane arm, the number of the mounting seats is equal to that of first pin holes in the basic arms and corresponds to that of the first pin holes in the basic arms one by one, the number of the driving pieces is equal to that of the mounting seats and corresponds to that of the driving pieces one by one, each driving piece comprises a fixing part and a telescopic part, the fixing parts are connected to the corresponding mounting seats, the telescopic parts are connected to one side, close to the first pin holes, of the fixing parts, the telescopic parts can be selectively telescopic relative to the fixing parts, the telescopic directions of the telescopic parts are coincident with the central lines of the first pin holes, and the telescopic parts are suitable for driving pin shafts to be inserted and pulled in the first pin holes. The driving piece is not directly connected with the telescopic arm, the pin shaft can be plugged and unplugged without depending on the telescopic operation of the lifting arm, the use is convenient, and each driving piece can independently control the plugging and unplugging of the corresponding pin shaft, so that the convenience of the pin shaft in disassembly and assembly is further improved.

title_en: Bag opening mechanism of packaging bag
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of bag opening equipment and discloses a bag opening mechanism of a packaging bag, which comprises a support and a bag opening mechanism, wherein the bag opening assembly comprises a support, a power piece, a first rod body and a second rod body, the first rod body and the second rod body are arranged side by side, one end of the first rod body, which is far away from the first support, is provided with a first suction piece, one end of the second rod body, which is far away from the first support, is provided with a second suction piece, the second suction piece is positioned right in front of the first suction piece, a bag opening space for opening the packaging bag is formed between the second suction piece and the first suction piece, and the power piece is used for driving the first rod body and the second rod body to move in a staggered manner so as to realize bag opening of the packaging bag positioned in the bag opening space. The bag opening mechanism of the packaging bag can realize automatic operation, is convenient to operate, does not need to manually open the bag, reduces the labor intensity of workers, and improves the bag opening efficiency.

title_en: Storage device for building decoration material
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of storage devices, in particular to a storage device for building decoration materials, which comprises a storage box, wherein a plurality of groups of storage cylinders are arranged in the storage box, a top cover is arranged at the top of the storage box, a fixed plate is fixedly connected to the outer part of the top cover, a positioning groove is arranged outside the fixed plate, at least one side of the outer part of the storage box is rotationally connected with a swing arm, one end of the swing arm is rotationally connected with a positioning column, and compared with the prior art, a limiting component for locking the swing arm is also arranged outside the storage box.

title_en: Auxiliary material package storage equipment
