abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of disinfection supply centers, in particular to auxiliary material bag storage equipment, which comprises a storage rack, wherein a discharge mechanism is arranged in the storage rack, a pushing mechanism is arranged at the top of the storage rack, a controller is arranged on the side wall of the storage rack, a power plug is arranged on the outer wall of the storage rack, the discharge mechanism comprises a baffle fixedly connected to the outer wall of the storage rack, a rotating shaft is fixedly connected to the back surface of the inner center of the storage rack, a rotating plate is fixedly connected to the outer wall of the rotating shaft, and the pushing mechanism is arranged in the storage rack.

title_en: Electric tower climbing device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an electric tower climbing device which comprises a lifting assembly and a fixing assembly, wherein the lifting assembly is connected to an electric tower through the fixing assembly, the lifting assembly is used for helping technicians to climb to the top of the electric tower, the lifting assembly comprises a rotary table, a steel wire rope and a driving motor, the output end of the driving motor is connected with the rotary table, the steel wire rope is wound on the rotary table, the bottom end of the steel wire rope is connected with a life jacket on the technician through a lifting hook, the fixing assembly comprises a spring ring and an iron chain, the rotary table is connected with the spring ring through the iron chain, and the spring ring is used for connecting the rotary table on the electric tower. Two ends of the turntable are provided with limiting baffles, the steel wire rope is positioned between the two limiting baffles, the limiting baffles are provided with two pairs of connecting holes, each pair of connecting holes is respectively connected with a spring ring through an iron chain, and the spring rings are connected to the electric tower. The utility model not only can improve the climbing speed and the climbing efficiency, but also can reduce the labor intensity of technicians.

title_en: Robot whole-layer cage loading system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a robot whole-layer cage loading system, which comprises a carrying plate, two pairs of lifting hydraulic push rods, a pair of support brackets and an adsorption clamping structure, and relates to the technical field of whole-layer cage loading; the combined use of the L-shaped extrusion block, the support bracket and the horizontal screw rod module further enhances the stability and the adjusting capability of the system in multiple dimensions, the system allows the raw materials or plates with different sizes and shapes to be adapted by adjusting the distance between the two pairs of the L-shaped support blocks and the negative pressure L-shaped shaft tube, the universality and the flexibility of the equipment are improved, and the auxiliary adsorption assembly and the air pump are used, so that the system can adjust the force and the position of negative pressure adsorption according to the requirement, and the adjustability is further enhanced.

title_en: Pallet stack clamping device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of clamping devices and discloses a tray stack clamping device which comprises a U-shaped underframe, wherein two ends of the top of the U-shaped underframe are fixedly connected with support columns, rectangular holes are formed in the tops of the two support columns, a stabilizing mechanism is arranged at the tops of the two support columns and comprises two pressing plates which are respectively and slidably connected in the two rectangular holes, the tops and the bottoms of the two rectangular holes are respectively and rotatably connected with a same screw rod, screw threads of the two screw rods penetrate through the pressing plates which are close to each other, screw rod nuts matched with the screw rods are fixedly sleeved on the two pressing plates, the screw threads of the two screw rods are opposite, and the rotating rod drives the two screw rods to synchronously and reversely rotate through a first bevel gear and a second bevel gear. The utility model realizes stable movement of the tray stack during transfer, does not have the risk of toppling, ensures the safety of operation, improves the working efficiency and reduces the technical effect of injury risk possibly caused by manual transportation.

title_en: Beverage self-output filling and capping integrated machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a beverage self-output filling and capping integrated machine which comprises a base, a conveying table and a filling machine arranged at the top of the base, wherein the conveying table is arranged at the top of the base through a connecting part, the filling machine is positioned above the conveying table, the top of the conveying table is fixedly connected with a frame, a sliding plate is arranged in the frame, the top of the frame is provided with a power part for driving the sliding plate to move, the top of the sliding plate is provided with a plurality of avoidance openings, the inside of the avoidance openings is provided with a plurality of sliding grooves, sliding columns which are equal to the sliding grooves in length are slidably connected in the sliding grooves, one end of each sliding column is provided with a square groove, and the square groove is rotationally connected with a roller extending out of the sliding groove. The bottle cap can calibrate the bottle, avoid the deviation of the position of the bottle, improve the capping effect of the bottle, and elastically clamp the bottle, so that the bottle cannot easily move, and improve the capping stability of the bottle.

title_en: Dust removing device of rubber belt conveyor
abstract_en: The utility model provides a dust removing device of a rubber belt conveyor, which relates to the technical field of dust removing equipment and aims to solve the problem that the dust removing device of the rubber belt conveyor cannot effectively remove dust on a wrap angle roller at the lower side of the rubber belt conveyor in the prior art, wherein the dust removing device of the rubber belt conveyor comprises a spiral dust scraping assembly, a dust hood assembly and an auger conveying assembly, the spiral ash scraping assembly is arranged close to a wrap angle roller at the lower side of the rubber belt conveyor, the dust hood assembly is arranged at the lower side of the spiral ash scraping assembly, the auger conveying assembly is connected to the bottom end of the dust hood assembly, an ash discharging valve is connected to the outlet of the auger conveying assembly, and the lower end of the dust hood assembly is connected with the negative pressure device. The dust removing device of the rubber belt conveyor provided by the utility model realizes the dust removing function of the head wrap angle roller of the rubber belt conveyor, and effectively reduces the influence of dust particles on the rubber belt conveyor.

title_en: Novel stack formula gripping apparatus on multilayer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel multilayer upper stacking gripper, and relates to the technical field of packaging machinery. The gripping apparatus is sequentially connected with a connecting block 1, a pressure equalizing cavity 2 and a stacking bin 3 from top to bottom, negative pressure air pipe connectors 4 are arranged on two sides of the middle of the pressure equalizing cavity 2, air cylinders 5 are connected on two sides of the stacking bin 3, bin doors 6 are arranged on the western parts of the stacking bin 3, and push rods of the air cylinders 5 are downwards connected to the bin doors 6. The multi-layer stack storage grabbing is realized by adopting the upper stack type storage bin, the efficiency is improved, and the material belt is ensured not to be thrown out in the placing and moving process by adopting the bin gate opening and closing type arrangement, so that the material is stably discharged.

title_en: Ground sesame seed oil filling device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of ground sesame seed oil filling, and discloses a ground sesame seed oil filling device, which solves the problem that the ground sesame seed oil filling device cannot ensure sanitation and safety in filling. According to the utility model, the electric push rod, the ultraviolet lamp, the steam sterilizing rod and the steam generator are used, the electric push rod is used for pushing the mounting plate to move up and down, the position sensor is combined to sense the relative position of the mounting plate and the split-bottles, the steam sterilizing rod can be inserted into the split-bottles, then the valve is opened, steam generated by the steam generator enters the box body through the connecting hose and is sprayed out from the bottom of the steam sterilizing rod for sterilization, and meanwhile, the ultraviolet lamp is started for irradiating the outer surface of the split-bottles, and the two sterilization modes are combined, so that various bacteria and microorganisms can be comprehensively and effectively killed, and the sanitation and safety of filling are ensured.

title_en: Capacitive mechanical sensor based on elastic electrode, electronic skin and robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a capacitive mechanical sensor, electronic skin and a robot based on elastic electrodes. The sensor comprises a substrate, a capacitance-to-digital conversion circuit and a processing module, wherein the surface of the substrate is provided with an action electrode which is an elastic bending electrode, one or more static electrodes are arranged above or below the action electrode, the projection of each action electrode relative to the static electrode at least covers part of the area corresponding to the static electrode, at least one end of the bending electrode is fixed on the substrate to be positioned, the other end of the bending electrode is bent to form a suspension end far away from the static electrode, the action electrode is isolated from the static electrode through an insulating layer, the action electrode deforms under the action of external force to change the indirect contact area of a bending part on the static electrode, the capacitance-to-digital conversion circuit is coupled with the corresponding electrode to obtain the capacitance between the action electrode and the static electrode, and the processing module is coupled with the capacitance-to-digital conversion circuit and is used for outputting an electric signal representing acting force according to the capacitance.

title_en: Beverage filling sealing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses beverage filling and sealing equipment which comprises a U-shaped equipment seat, wherein a chain type conveying belt is arranged in the U-shaped equipment seat, a placing box for placing filled solid beverages is arranged on the surface of the chain type conveying belt at equal distance, an n-shaped plate is fixedly arranged between the middle parts of the tops of the two sides of the U-shaped equipment seat, two fixing plates are fixedly arranged on the tops of the inner sides of the n-shaped plate, telescopic parts are symmetrically arranged at the lower parts of the two fixing plates, an electric heating and sealing mechanism is arranged between the opposite ends of the two telescopic parts, an adjusting part for adjusting the two telescopic parts is arranged in the n-shaped plate, and a motor in transmission connection with the adjusting part and the chain type conveying belt is arranged on one side of the n-shaped plate.

title_en: Packaging structure applied to television backboard
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a packaging structure applied to a television backboard, which comprises a packaging box, L-shaped partition boards and strip-shaped partition boards, wherein the packaging box is a cuboid which is formed by splicing flat boards and is hollow in the inside, the L-shaped partition boards are formed by two mutually perpendicular flat boards and are arranged on edges and corners in the width direction of the packaging box, the outer walls of the L-shaped partition boards are tightly attached to the inner walls of the packaging box, a plurality of first grooves are formed in the inner wall surfaces of the L-shaped partition boards, each first groove is used for wrapping four corners of the vertically placed television backboard, the strip-shaped partition boards are arranged on the inner wall in the width direction of the packaging box, a plurality of second grooves are formed in the wall surfaces, facing the inside of the packaging box, of each strip-shaped partition board, and each second groove is used for wrapping four sides of the vertically placed television backboard. The utility model can realize vertical stable stacking and placement and improve the stacking protection of the television backboard.

title_en: Pipeline leakage monitoring system for vehicle urea filling machine
abstract_en: The application relates to a pipeline leakage monitoring system for a vehicle urea filling machine, which comprises a liquid storage tank, wherein a first electric valve body is arranged on the liquid storage tank, the filling machine is provided with a filling metering pipeline assembly which is connected with the liquid storage tank, the joint of the filling metering pipeline assembly is an easy leakage point, a liquid receiving disc is arranged in the filling machine and is provided with a liquid leakage sensor, a liquid leakage signal is sent out when the liquid leakage sensor detects urea solution, an alarm device alarms when the liquid leakage signal is received, the alarm linkage control device can control the first electric valve body on the liquid storage tank to be closed when the liquid leakage signal is received, and an operation management platform receives the liquid leakage signal for remote alarm. When the filling machine disclosed by the application leaks, the leakage sensor is conducted so as to send out a leakage signal, the alarm linkage control device controls the alarm device and the first electric valve body to alarm and interrupt the circulation of urea solution after receiving the leakage signal, the detection mode is quick and effective, the detection cost is low, and the remote alarm is realized through the operation management platform.

title_en: Chain plate type mud scraper chain wheel tensioning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a chain plate type mud scraper chain wheel tensioning device which comprises an adjusting plate, a supporting plate and a tensioning structure, wherein the adjusting plate is provided with a long hole and an adjusting hole, and the adjusting hole is arranged on the supporting plate and is matched with an adjusting bolt and an adjusting nut in the tensioning structure to realize effective tensioning of the chain plate type mud scraper chain wheel. The device has simple structure and convenient operation, can effectively solve the problem that the chain is extended and loosened, and improves the running stability and efficiency of the mud scraper.

title_en: Loading and unloading device for cargo transportation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a loading and unloading device for cargo transportation, which comprises a main body unit, wherein the main body unit comprises two groups of supporting plates, the lower ends of the two groups of supporting plates are fixedly connected with a mounting plate, a top plate is fixedly connected between the two groups of supporting plates, and the surfaces of the two groups of supporting plates are provided with two groups of lifting grooves. According to the utility model, the worm is driven to rotate by starting the telescopic motor, the worm wheel in meshed connection with the worm drives the rotating rod to rotate, so that the rotating rod drives the gear to synchronously rotate, the rack plate in meshed connection with the gear drives the telescopic plate to move outwards of the carriage, goods clamped by the clamping plate are moved out of the carriage, the lifting motor is controlled to rotate the first threaded rod, the lifting rod is driven to move downwards by the threaded sleeve in threaded connection with the first threaded rod, and the goods are placed at the designated position, so that the goods at the outer edge of the carriage can be loaded and unloaded, the goods in the carriage can be loaded and unloaded normally, and the loading and unloading efficiency is improved.

title_en: Stacker crane floating platform
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a stacker crane floating platform, belongs to the technical field of stacker crane floating platforms, and solves the technical problem that the position of a material tray is inconvenient to adjust at present. The stacker crane floating platform comprises a fixing piece, a placing plate and a spring, wherein the placing plate is slidably arranged on the fixing piece, one side, far away from the fixing piece, of the placing plate is used for placing a tray, the spring is arranged in a cavity, one end of the spring is connected with the fixing piece, the other end of the spring is connected with the placing plate, and in a reset state, the spring drives the placing plate to cover the fixing piece. Therefore, the floating platform of the stacker crane provided by the utility model is convenient for adjusting the position of the tray so as to move the tray, and the placing plate automatically resets after the tray is moved so as to adjust the position of the subsequent tray, so that the stacker crane is convenient to use.

title_en: Grabbing and clamping mechanism for aluminum template reinforcing ribs
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a grabbing and clamping mechanism for aluminum formwork reinforcing ribs, which comprises two groups of clamping assemblies which are oppositely arranged, wherein each clamping assembly comprises a linear driving device, a positioning plate is fixed at the driving end of each linear driving device, a sliding groove is formed in the surface of one side, far away from each linear driving device, of each positioning plate, a sliding block is connected in a sliding manner in each sliding groove, an elastic piece is fixed at the top of each sliding block, and one end of each sliding block is fixedly provided with a clamping plate for clamping the reinforcing rib. Compared with the prior art, after the reinforcing rib is clamped by the clamping plate, if the length of the reinforcing rib is too long, a larger reaction force is applied to the clamping plate on the inner walls of the two sides of the aluminum template due to contact of the reinforcing rib, so that the sliding block overcomes the elasticity of the elastic piece to slide upwards, the reinforcing rib can not continuously descend along with the descending of the mechanical arm, and the problem that the two sides of the aluminum template are outwards protruded due to forced clamping of the reinforcing rib into the aluminum template is avoided.

title_en: Powder holding vessel is used in concrete production
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of concrete production, and discloses a powder storage tank for concrete production, which comprises a cylindrical tank body and a conical discharge hopper below the cylindrical tank body, wherein a slewing bearing is arranged at the bottom of the inner wall of the tank body, an outer ring of the slewing bearing is connected with the inner wall of the tank body, a connecting ring is arranged at the bottom of the inner ring, a plurality of arch breaking rods are arranged at the bottom of the connecting ring in an extending way towards the direction of a discharge pipe, a driving assembly for driving the inner ring of the slewing bearing to rotate is arranged above the slewing bearing, a ring-shaped guard plate is arranged on the inner wall of the tank body in an inclined downward way from the upper part of the driving assembly, the bottom edge diameter of the ring-shaped guard plate is smaller than the inner diameter of the inner ring of the slewing bearing, a ring-shaped guard plate is arranged on the bottom edge of the ring-shaped guard plate in a downward extending way, a first sealing adhesive tape is arranged on one side close to the slewing bearing, and one side of the first sealing adhesive tape is attached to the inner wall of the inner ring of the slewing bearing. Through annular backplate, annular baffle and first joint strip, protect slewing bearing, drive assembly, guaranteed the flexibility of drive assembly and slewing bearing motion.

title_en: Plateau low-pressure low-oxygen environment simulation facility
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a plateau low-pressure low-oxygen environment simulation facility, which relates to the technical field of environment simulation and comprises a simulation cabin, wherein the bottom of the inner cavity of the simulation cabin is fixedly connected with a mounting table, the inside of the simulation cabin is provided with a liquid cavity, the top of the simulation cabin is fixedly connected with a second joint, one side of the simulation cabin is fixedly connected with a first joint, one ends of the second joint and the first joint extend to the inside of the simulation cabin, the top of the simulation cabin is fixedly connected with a fresh air joint, the top of the simulation cabin is fixedly connected with a pressure regulating joint at one side of the fresh air joint, one ends of the fresh air joint and the pressure regulating joint extend to the inside of the simulation cabin, one side of the simulation cabin is fixedly connected with a fixing frame, and the plateau low-pressure low-oxygen environment simulation facility can simulate dust and snowing weather when an automobile is subjected to plateau environment test by the aid of a snowmaking machine, a collecting cover and a conveying box.

title_en: Ventilating and crushing integrated device for cocoa bean silo
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a ventilating and shattering integrated device of a cocoa bean silo, which is characterized in that the ventilating and shattering integrated device is added in a temporary storage silo, a spiral discharging chute is utilized to enable cocoa beans to slowly slide to the bottom of the silo, and simultaneously, a ventilating hole arranged on a spiral shaft in the center of the spiral discharging chute is synchronously ventilated, so that fresh air and the air of the sliding cocoa beans are ventilated and heat exchanged, and the cocoa beans are kept ventilated through the ventilating hole during temporary storage of the silo, so that the temperature and humidity of the cocoa beans can be effectively controlled through the measures of ventilation and shattering, and the shattering rate of the cocoa beans in the discharging process can be reduced.

title_en: Lifting mechanism, conveying device and sheet arranging machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a lifting mechanism, a conveying device and a sheet arranging machine. The driving piece comprises a fixed part and a movable part, the movable part is provided with a first end and a second end which are opposite, the first end is connected with the fixed part, the movable part is driven to move along a first direction relative to the fixed part, the supporting piece is connected with the second end, the supporting piece moves along the first direction relative to the movable part, the transferring piece is connected with the supporting piece, a through hole is formed in the transferring piece along the first direction, the through hole corresponds to the movable part, and the transferring piece moves along the first direction along with the supporting piece. The lifting mechanism can adjust the height of the transfer piece and reduce the influence of torsion on the deformation of the transfer piece. The conveying device with the lifting mechanism also has the advantages. The sheet arranging machine with the conveying device also has the advantages.

title_en: Power supply type rail flat car with limit structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of rail flat cars, in particular to a power supply type rail flat car with a limiting structure, which comprises a mounting frame, a flat car frame, moving wheels, a transmission module, a mounting plate, an air cylinder, a guide rail and a movable plate, wherein the upper end of the mounting frame is provided with the flat car frame, the lower ends of two sides of the flat car frame are symmetrically provided with a plurality of groups of moving wheels for sliding, the lower end of the flat car frame is positioned between the two groups of moving wheels and provided with the transmission module for transmitting power to the moving wheels, the power supply type rail flat car with the limiting structure is matched with the guide rail on the movable plate through the limiting groove, so that the flat car is ensured to always move along a preset rail, the operation accuracy is improved, and the maintenance and the transfer are more convenient due to the fact that the cylinder and the lifting function matched with the connecting spring are used.

title_en: Carrying manipulator for 8-inch wafer box
abstract_en: The utility model provides a carrying manipulator for an 8-inch wafer box, which solves the problem that the carrying of the existing wafer box cannot meet the multi-angle requirement, and the main scheme comprises the following steps: the manipulator comprises a base, a manipulator big arm, a manipulator small arm and an executing piece, wherein one end of the base is vertically and rotatably connected with an exposed driving shaft, the other end of the base is internally fixed with a driving piece, the bottom end of the driving shaft is coaxially and fixedly provided with a first driven wheel, the top end of the driving shaft is coaxially and rotatably connected with a second driven wheel, the driving piece can independently drive the first driven wheel and the second driven wheel to rotate, the manipulator big arm sequentially passes through a first driven shaft, a second driven shaft and the executing piece in a belt transmission manner, the executing piece comprises a supporting seat and supporting arms which are oppositely fixed on two sides of the supporting seat, an embedding table is fixedly arranged on one opposite surface of the supporting arm, and a positioning opening for limiting an external wafer box is concavely arranged on the top surface of each embedding table.

title_en: Stacker crane
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a stacker crane which comprises a supporting frame, a roller conveyor and a supporting plate, wherein the roller conveyor is arranged on the supporting frame, a sliding rod is fixedly connected to the supporting frame, a sliding block is sleeved on the sliding rod in a sliding mode, a fixed plate is connected between the sliding blocks, a sliding column is arranged on the fixed plate, the sliding of the sliding column penetrates through the fixed plate, one end of the sliding column is connected with a support, the supporting plate is arranged on the side wall of the support, a connecting plate is arranged at the other end of the sliding column, a tension spring I is arranged between the connecting plate and the fixed plate, a guide rail plate is arranged on the supporting frame, a cam plate is movably arranged on the side wall of the support, and the cam plate and the guide rail plate do contact movement. The utility model belongs to the technical field of stacker cranes, and particularly relates to a stacker crane.

title_en: Clamping manipulator and carrying equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides a clamping manipulator and carrying equipment, wherein the clamping manipulator comprises two clamping devices, the clamping devices comprise clamping components, lifting components and moving components, the clamping components comprise clamping assemblies, each clamping assembly comprises a mounting seat, a rotating unit and a clamping unit, the rotating units are arranged on the mounting seats, the clamping units are arranged on the rotating units, the lifting components are used for driving the mounting seats to lift, and the moving components are used for driving the mounting seats to translate. The clamping unit clamps materials, the rotating unit drives the clamping unit to rotate, the lifting component drives the mounting seat to lift, the moving component drives the mounting seat to translate, the clamping feeding action with multiple degrees of freedom of the clamping device is realized, meanwhile, the two clamping devices alternately clamp the materials from two sides of the clamping manipulator to the middle feeding point to clamp the materials, and the carrying efficiency is convenient to improve.

title_en: Trolley step walking auxiliary device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a platform truck step walking auxiliary device, including two triangle-shaped supports, a corner of triangle-shaped support is right angle or obtuse angle, and two triangle-shaped supports set up relatively, and the equidistance is fixed with a plurality of fixture blocks side by side on the long limit of triangle-shaped support and wherein two fixture blocks are located the position that approaches both ends respectively, and two triangle-shaped support long edges have a plurality of crossbeams through the joint of fixture block one-to-one together; the utility model discloses simple structure, the flexible operation, safe practical can accelerate the construction progress of dam panel concrete, is connected with the panel through first absorption pole and second absorption pole, can ensure the stability of platform truck in the in-process of traveling, and the edge of a wing tip and the fixture block looks butt of I-steel can enough chucking I-steel, can ensure again that the platform truck can not roll the edge of a wing tip in traveling, has protected platform truck and I-steel simultaneously, and the operating personnel conveniently dismantles, carries, can use on some steps and abrupt slope, and auxiliary vehicle is current.

title_en: Sucking disc dress trigger with self-correcting function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sucker plate loading machine with a self-correcting function, which comprises a mounting frame fixedly mounted with production line equipment, wherein a negative pressure fan and a driving motor are fixedly mounted on the left side of the mounting frame by bolts, a guide frame which is transversely arranged is fixedly mounted on the upper end of the mounting frame, a connecting sleeve is mounted on the outer part of the guide frame, a penetrating sliding structure is formed between the connecting sleeve and the guide frame, a supporting cross beam is mounted between the connecting sleeves on the left side and the right side, and the supporting cross beam is divided into a fixed beam and a movable beam which are mutually separated. This sucking disc dress trigger with self-correcting function utilizes traditional elevating system to promote the panel to the back of a take the altitude, cooperates negative pressure fan and vacuum chuck to absorb panel and remove under the promotion effect of first cylinder, and the rethread driving motor drives down the compression roller and rotates afterwards, with panel automatic packing to equipment in, the whole in-process does not need manual operation, labour saving and time saving just avoids danger.

title_en: Adhesive tape main roll lifting device
abstract_en: The application relates to a lifting device for a main roller of an adhesive tape, which relates to the technical field of lifting devices for main rollers, and aims to solve the problem that manual adjustment is easy to cause errors, the lifting device comprises a frame body, the main roller is arranged on the frame body, a lifting mechanism for automatic lifting is arranged between the frame body and the main roller, the lifting mechanism comprises a seat body, a lifting rail, a driving block and a driving cylinder, the lifting rail is vertically connected on the frame body, the driving block is slidably connected to the lifting rail, the base is connected to the driving block, the main roller is rotatably connected to the bottom of the base, the driving cylinder is arranged at the top of the frame, the output end of the driving cylinder is connected to the base, the driving cylinder is consistent with the arrangement direction of the lifting rail, and a limiting mechanism for limiting the main roller is arranged on the frame. The automatic lifting mechanism has the advantages that the automatic lifting mechanism can respond quickly, manual observation and manual adjustment are not needed, and the operation efficiency of the production line is remarkably improved.

title_en: Wire recovery, cutting and transferring mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model provides a wire recovery, cutting and transferring mechanism, and belongs to the technical field of machinery. It has solved the inconvenient problem of current cutting equipment use. The wire recovery, cutting and transferring mechanism comprises a support, wherein the left side of the support is provided with a bracket and a translation mechanism, the bracket is connected with the support in a front-back sliding manner, the translation mechanism is used for driving the bracket to slide, a supporting plate is horizontally arranged below the bracket, the length of the supporting plate extends left and right, a lifting assembly used for driving the supporting plate to lift is arranged on the bracket, the left end of the supporting plate is vertically fixed with a first vacuum chuck, the right side of the first vacuum chuck is vertically provided with a second vacuum chuck, the second vacuum chuck is connected with the supporting plate in a left-right sliding manner, and a power mechanism used for driving the second vacuum chuck to slide is further arranged on the supporting plate. The wire recovery, cutting and transferring mechanism is beneficial to use.

title_en: Automatic code printing and labeling machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic coding and labeling machine which comprises an automatic feeding mechanism, a labeling mechanism and a coding mechanism, wherein the automatic feeding mechanism is arranged in front of the labeling mechanism and is used for conveying a material to be labeled to a designated position of the labeling mechanism, the labeling mechanism is used for enabling labels on labels with materials to be adhered to the surface of the material, the coding mechanism is arranged above the labeling mechanism and is used for providing labels with materials for the labeling mechanism, the labeling mechanism comprises a roller supporting plate, a conveying belt and a stripping plate, the roller supporting plate and the stripping plate are arranged above the conveying belt, a receiving roller, a tensioning module and a plurality of guide rollers are arranged on the roller supporting plate, the tensioning module is movably arranged on one side of the guide rollers, and the labels with materials are connected with the receiving roller through the coding mechanism, the tensioning module, the guide rollers and the stripping plate. According to the utility model, the coding mechanism and the labeling mechanism are used in series, the coding mechanism codes the label, and then the label enters the labeling mechanism to be attached to the surface of the material, so that the printing amount is matched with the order amount, and the waste phenomenon is avoided.

title_en: Bandage desktop receiver
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of medical bandages, in particular to a desktop storage box for bandages, which comprises a box body, wherein a plurality of inner cavities are formed in the box body, an inner box is arranged in the inner cavities, notches are formed in the left side and the right side of the inner box, one end of each notch, which faces outwards, extends out of the inner box, convex shafts extending into the notches are fixed on the opposite inner walls of the inner cavity, gaps are reserved between the bottom and the back of each inner box and the inner cavity, the top of each inner box extends upwards to the upper side of the box body, so that convex plates are formed, and a plurality of inclined grooves inclining towards the inner part of the box body are formed in the inner parts of the two side walls of each inner box. This bandage desktop receiver through the interior box that is arranged in the inner chamber, can make the bandage place according to distinguishing specification to make things convenient for medical personnel to find the bandage of adaptation, also can play simultaneously and protect the bandage, avoid taking place cross infection, open the certain distance when interior box simultaneously, also can take out interior box, thereby can accomplish to it and change or disinfect.

title_en: Modular assembled cable reel
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a modular assembled cable reel, which comprises side plates, limiting rings and barrel pieces, wherein the four sides in the barrel pieces are fixedly connected with connecting plates, positioning rods are inserted on the connecting plates, through holes are formed in the two ends of the positioning rods, spring rods are fixedly connected in the through holes, the limiting plates are fixedly connected to the moving ends of the spring rods, protrusions are fixedly connected to one sides of the limiting plates, limiting holes are formed in one sides of the positioning rods, the protruding plates are slidably connected with the limiting holes, male and female grooves are formed in the two ends of the barrel pieces, auxiliary rings are fixedly connected to the inner sides of the limiting rings, the auxiliary rings are provided with auxiliary holes and the auxiliary holes for inserting the positioning rods, annular concave portions are formed in the outer sides of the limiting rings, the annular concave portions are contacted with arc-shaped protrusions.

title_en: Automobile seat product frame
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automobile seat product frame which mainly comprises a bottom plate, upright posts, a middle spandrel girder, a side spandrel girder, two turning plates and a convex matching part. The stand sets up in the bottom plate four corners, and middle spandrel girder and side spandrel girder set up respectively in bottom plate middle part and both sides, and the side spandrel girder is fixed in on the stand. One end of the two turning plates is hinged to the side bearing beam, and the other end is lapped on the middle bearing beam to form a double-opening door type structure. The protruding matching part is arranged on the bottom plate and the turning plate and comprises a black hard bubble for being inserted into a chute on the back of the seat, so that the fixed placement of the seat is realized. According to the utility model, the seat is firmly fixed through the convex matching part, and meanwhile, the turnover plate with the double-door structure is designed so that the process of taking and placing the seat is more convenient.

title_en: Device is equallyd divide to powder
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of medical appliances, in particular to a medicine powder equally dividing device which comprises an equally dividing seat and an adjusting plate which moves up and down relative to the equally dividing seat, wherein more than two powder storage through holes are vertically formed in the equally dividing seat, the powder storage through holes are arranged in parallel, adjusting columns are arranged on the adjusting plate, the number and the positions of the adjusting columns are matched with those of the powder storage through holes, the upper ends of the adjusting columns extend into the corresponding powder storage through holes, the lower ends of the powder storage through holes are blocked, the equally dividing seat is connected with the adjusting plate through a thread lifting mechanism, and the length of the adjusting columns extending into the powder storage through holes can be adjusted by the thread lifting mechanism. The utility model can effectively ensure that the upper surface of the powder in the powder storage through hole is in a horizontal state, and the horizontal error of the surface of the powder is small, and the operation is convenient.

title_en: Coiling mechanism is used in production of plastics braided bag
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of woven bag production, in particular to a winding device for plastic woven bag production, which comprises a supporting mechanism and a fixing plate, wherein the top of the fixing plate is fixedly connected with a first guiding mechanism, the top of the fixing plate is fixedly connected with a second guiding mechanism, the top of the fixing plate is fixedly connected with a winding mechanism, the top of the fixing plate is fixedly connected with a rolling mechanism, and the top of the fixing plate is fixedly connected with a cleaning mechanism. According to the utility model, the first electric telescopic rod extends to drive the first cleaning brush head to move upwards, the second electric telescopic rod extends to drive the second cleaning brush head to move downwards, the top and the bottom of the woven bag are contacted, the cleaning of the outer surface of the woven bag is completed, and the use experience of the woven bag is further improved.

title_en: Safety monitoring system for hoisted articles of tower crane
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a safety monitoring system for a lifted object of a tower crane, which comprises a monitoring module, a data processing module and an alarm module, wherein the monitoring module is used for acquiring monitoring information comprising a lifting hook, the lifted object and obstacles around the lifted object in real time, the data processing module is connected with the monitoring module and used for identifying and determining the inclination angle between the lifting hook and the lifted object and the distance between the lifted object and the obstacles according to the monitoring information, and the alarm module is connected with the data processing module and used for giving an alarm according to the inclination angle between the lifting hook and the lifted object and the distance between the lifted object and the obstacles. The utility model can prompt staff in time, and the whole process can realize automatic identification and judgment of the condition of the lifted object without manual participation in observation and monitoring, thereby improving the safety and the operation efficiency of lifting operation.

title_en: Food fresh-keeping fridge with function of disinfecting
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of refrigerators and discloses a food fresh-keeping refrigerator with a sterilization function, which comprises a fresh-keeping refrigerator main body, ultraviolet sterilization lamps, a scraping and cleaning mechanism and a positioning mechanism, wherein the sterilization refrigerator main body consists of the fresh-keeping refrigerator main body and the ultraviolet sterilization lamps arranged at two ends of the inner wall of the fresh-keeping refrigerator main body. According to the utility model, the scraping and cleaning mechanism and the positioning mechanism are arranged, so that sliding displacement can be realized rapidly through the scraping and cleaning mechanism sleeved outside the ultraviolet germicidal lamp, and at the moment, the scraping and cleaning mechanism is attached to the outside of the ultraviolet germicidal lamp, so that in the displacement process, the outside of the ultraviolet germicidal lamp and dead angle parts where the ultraviolet germicidal lamp cannot be cleaned manually can be scraped and cleaned rapidly, the generated oil film is prevented from influencing the light transmittance of the ultraviolet germicidal lamp, and the scraping and cleaning mechanism can be reset to the original position through the positioning mechanism, so that rapid cleaning of the ultraviolet germicidal lamp is required later.

title_en: Tunnel automatic detection equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides automatic tunnel detection equipment, which relates to the field of automatic tunnel detection and comprises a walking unit for moving, wherein a turntable is arranged on the upper surface of the walking unit, a folding arm is fixedly arranged above a rotating part of the turntable, a laser section meter is fixedly arranged on the upper surface of a hinge part of the final folding unit of the folding arm, the automatic tunnel detection equipment utilizes a six-axis mechanical arm to connect with and take out a corresponding detector from a tool box according to detection items and utilizes the rotation fit of a quick-connection male connector and a quick-connection female connector, and the detector is rotated and moved by the six-axis mechanical arm, the corresponding detector is sequentially taken out from the same working plane to carry out detection by the upward and downward movement of the folding arm and the rotation of the turntable, and after detection is completed, the detector is moved by the walking unit, so that the multi-item detection of a tunnel can be carried out automatically.

title_en: Information acquisition device based on intelligent production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of intelligent manufacturing, in particular to an information acquisition device based on intelligent production, which comprises a scanning gun, a mounting frame, a placing shaft, a label roll, a printer, a feeding pipe, a tensioning assembly, a collecting roller, a compacting assembly and the like, wherein the mounting frame is connected below the scanning gun, the placing shaft and the collecting roller are rotatably connected in the mounting frame, the label roll is sleeved on the placing shaft, the printer is arranged in the mounting frame, the feeding pipe for supplementing pigment is arranged in the printer, the feeding pipe penetrates through a cover plate, the tensioning assembly for tensioning label paper is arranged in the mounting frame, and the compacting assembly for assisting the collecting roller to wind the label paper is arranged in the mounting frame. Through the collaborative work of the scanning gun, the control box, the printer and the motor, the label printing, stripping and attaching processes are automated, operators do not need to frequently walk, the integrated operation of information acquisition and label attaching is realized, and finally the aim of improving the working efficiency is achieved.

title_en: Joint connection structure
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of robots, and discloses a joint connection structure. The joint connecting structure comprises a first joint, a second joint and a connecting flange, wherein the connecting flange is provided with a first mounting surface and a second mounting surface which are oppositely arranged, the first joint is provided with an annular flange, a first locking piece sequentially penetrates through the connecting flange and the annular flange to fix the first joint on the first mounting surface of the connecting flange, a plurality of first locking pieces are circumferentially distributed, and a second locking piece sequentially penetrates through the connecting flange and the second joint to fix the second joint on the second mounting surface of the connecting flange, and the second locking pieces are circumferentially distributed. The first locking pieces are circumferentially distributed, the second locking pieces are circumferentially distributed to provide uniform fixing force, connection looseness of the first joint and the second joint caused by uneven stress is effectively prevented, external torque and shearing force can be better resisted, and rigidity and stability of the joint connection structure are further improved.

title_en: Steel pipe hoist with clamping jaw mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a steel pipe lifting appliance with a clamping jaw mechanism, which comprises a movable bottom plate, wherein a movable wheel is arranged at the bottom of the movable bottom plate, a supporting column is fixedly arranged in the middle of the top of the movable bottom plate, a lifting rod is rotatably connected to the top of the supporting column, a lifting push rod is arranged in the middle of the supporting column, the top of the lifting push rod is rotatably connected with the bottom of the lifting rod, a connecting chain is arranged at the other end of the lifting rod, a mounting frame is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the connecting chain, fixing blocks are fixedly arranged at two ends of the mounting frame, a pull rod penetrates through the middle of the fixing blocks and is slidably connected with clamping jaws, and a lifting block positioned between the two clamping jaws is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the pull rod. The connecting sliding rod is pulled to move along the sliding groove, so that the clamping jaw clamps the steel pipe, the center of gravity of the round steel is effectively prevented from sliding off in the lifting process, and the lifting safety and reliability are improved.

title_en: Skeleton texture, stator unit and linear transmission system
abstract_en: The application relates to a skeleton structure, a stator unit and a linear transmission system. The framework structure comprises an upper framework, a lower framework and a first iron core, wherein the upper framework and the lower framework enclose to form an iron core installation cavity, the first iron core is arranged in the iron core installation cavity, the lower framework is provided with a framework base, and the framework base is used for being embedded into a stator base groove to fix the framework structure. The application realizes the positioning of the framework structure by utilizing the framework and the stator base structure, has simple fixing mode and high positioning precision, simplifies the processing precision and improves the production efficiency.

title_en: Calf milk powder bagging equipment
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of milk powder bagging equipment, and particularly relates to calf milk powder bagging equipment which comprises a storage box, a bagging piece and a supporting piece, wherein an opening of the top surface of the storage box is provided, a sealing plate is inserted into the opening of the storage box, a bagging piece is arranged on the bottom surface of the storage box, the supporting piece is vertically arranged below the bagging piece, the bagging piece comprises a push-pull frame box, a material containing frame and a blanking frame, the push-pull frame box is horizontally arranged below the storage box, the middle part of the top end of the push-pull frame box is vertically communicated and fixed with a blanking frame, the top end of the blanking frame is fixedly communicated with the bottom surface of the storage box, and the material containing frame is assembled in a sliding manner inside the push-pull frame box. According to the utility model, the preset material containing frames with different volume capacities are used for quantitatively receiving the milk powder during bagging, and the material containing frames are used as the milk powder volume specific weighing components, so that the volume of the milk powder bagging can be controlled according to actual requirements, and the accuracy of the milk powder bagging volume is improved.

title_en: Portable food packaging box easy to open
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an easy-to-open portable food packaging box, which relates to the field of packaging boxes, and comprises a box body, wherein a box cover is arranged on one side of the opening of the box body, the box cover is provided with a sealing plate part for sealing the opening of the box body and a wrapping part magnetically attracted on the outer wall of one side of the box body, and the easy-to-open portable food packaging box can be opened by using a clamping piece on a handle belt when a user holds the handle belt to lift and move the whole packaging box, so that the clamping piece on two sides can be pressed on the outer sides of the box body and the box cover by the handle belt by using gravity to firmly clamp the box body and the box cover, thereby assisting a magnet, ensuring the tightness of the cover closure of the box cover without the step of additionally sleeving the whole packaging box into the handle belt, simplifying carrying operation, and simultaneously ensuring that the clamping piece is more convenient to open after the handle belt is released by putting down the packaging box, and the packaging box can be opened.

title_en: Wire drawing box
abstract_en: The utility model provides a winding and pulling wire box which comprises a box body and a fixed disc, wherein the box body is provided with an opening through which a wire rope passes, the fixed disc is arranged in the box body, a clamping structure, a spring component and the wire rope are arranged on the fixed disc, the wire rope is connected with the spring component, the clamping structure comprises a limiting block, a limiting component and an annular groove for the limiting block to move, and the limiting component and the limiting block are arranged on the outer side of the annular groove. The utility model not only can be used for winding and pulling the cable, but also can prolong the service life of the winding and pulling box.

title_en: Liftable cover plate system for gantry type large crane rail groove
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of crane track grooves, and particularly discloses a liftable cover plate system for a gantry type large crane track groove, which comprises a foundation for installing a cover plate, wherein the foundation is U-shaped, the inner sides of the front end and the rear end of the foundation are respectively provided with an installing groove, a lifting plate is installed in each installing groove through a driving part, the upper end of each lifting plate is provided with a cover plate through a spring, pressure sensors are fixedly installed on the front side and the rear side of the left end and the right end of the upper end of each lifting plate, when a crane passes through, when the crane shields two laser sensors on one side of the foundation, the crane is detected to be close, the laser sensors send a signal to a PCL controller, the PCL controller controls a hydraulic rod to shrink, the cover plates are lowered to expose the track, after the crane passes through, the crane shields the two laser sensors on the other side of the foundation, the laser sensors detect that the crane is separated, the PCL controller sends a signal, the PCL controller controls the hydraulic rod to stretch, and the cover plate is lifted to restore to be level with the ground.

title_en: Interval adjustable metal rack trolley
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of metal material rack trolleys, in particular to a metal material rack trolley with adjustable space, which comprises four wheel bases, wherein four limit rods are connected in screw holes at four corners of the upper surface of each wheel base in a threaded manner, a plurality of limit holes are connected to the outer surfaces of the limit rods in a sliding manner, the four limit holes are respectively formed at four corners of the upper surface of a partition plate, movable grooves are formed in the upper surfaces of each wheel base and the partition plate, two bidirectional screw rods are connected to the left side surface and the right side surface of the inner wall of each movable groove in a rotating manner, two thread sleeves are connected to the outer surfaces of each bidirectional screw rod in a threaded manner, four corners of a cross lifting frame are driven to be far away from each other through reversing hand wheels, the partition plates are mutually close to each other, the partition plates are simultaneously close to the four wheel bases, the limit rods are separated from the screw holes at the upper surface of each wheel base through the reversing limit rods, and the size of the device is reduced, so that the whole device of the existing device is huge in size and inconvenient to store.

title_en: Multilayer food packaging box
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of packaging boxes, in particular to a multilayer food packaging box, which comprises a lower layer, a middle layer and an upper layer, wherein a turnover part is formed at the top of the middle layer, a clamping part capable of being turned inside and outside through the turnover part is arranged outside the turnover part, the clamping part can be contained in the lower layer after being turned inside, the clamping part is turned outside and then is buckled on the lower layer, when the turnover part and the clamping part are turned inside, the middle layer and the lower layer can be smoothly covered and closed, the containing effect of the middle layer in the lower layer is ensured, the turnover part and the clamping part can be buckled on an outer clamping ring after being unfolded, and the outer fit is formed.

title_en: Rain cover with water passing structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a rain cover with a water passing structure, which can effectively solve the problem of rainwater accumulation by reserving a water passing channel between a swinging bucket and a fixed bucket, thereby reducing the damage risk of rainwater to equipment and the rain cover. The rain-proof cover of present case has only contained fixed bucket, pendulum fight, supplementary roller train, the setting of first connecting seat, has reduced part quantity and tie point to reduced complexity and the cost of installation and maintenance, still reduced the trouble risk because of the part damages or looseness leads to.

title_en: Reactor core graphite grabbing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a reactor core graphite grabbing device which comprises a driving mechanism, grabbing parts, a clamping force detecting part, a friction coefficient detecting part and a controller, wherein the clamping force detecting part acts on the grabbing parts and is used for detecting the clamping force of the grabbing parts for clamping graphite, the friction coefficient detecting part acts on the graphite on the grabbing parts and is used for detecting whether the grabbing parts and the graphite relatively move or not, and the controller is used for receiving detection signals sent by the clamping force detecting part and the friction coefficient detecting part so as to control the driving mechanism to drive the grabbing parts to grab and move the graphite. The method and the device ensure the grabbing and assembling of the core graphite, effectively avoid the damage caused by the graphite, improve the grabbing and assembling quality of the core graphite, ensure the reliability, reduce the manufacturing cost and provide powerful guarantee for the safe operation of the nuclear reactor.

title_en: Sample allies oneself with pipe warehousing and transportation cup
abstract_en: The utility model is suitable for the field of sample detection equipment, and provides a sample joint pipe storage and transportation cup which comprises a cylindrical cup body, a cover body detachably connected to the top of the cup body and a joint pipe fixing frame arranged in the cup body, wherein the joint pipe fixing frame comprises a first abutting part, a second abutting part and a guide rail arranged between the first abutting part and the second abutting part, and a detachable sampling joint pipe is slidably connected to the guide rail. Therefore, the device can be flexibly applied in different experimental scenes, is particularly suitable for frequent carrying and carrying of a small amount of PCR8 connecting pipes between experimental departments, greatly reduces the workload of experimental staff, and improves the overall convenience and practicality of sample storage and transportation.

title_en: Lifting supporting leg with auxiliary supporting structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a lifting support leg with an auxiliary supporting structure, which comprises a telescopic support leg and a foldable auxiliary support leg arranged on the side surface of the telescopic support leg, wherein the auxiliary support leg can be used for carrying out auxiliary support on the telescopic support leg during operation, so that the pressure of equipment on the telescopic support leg is reduced, the service life of the telescopic support leg is prolonged, the use safety of the equipment is ensured, a guide hole is formed in the auxiliary support leg, a bolt is arranged in the guide hole, and the folding of the telescopic support leg can be guided through the bolt when the auxiliary support leg is contracted, the auxiliary support leg is prevented from being blocked, and the use safety of the equipment is ensured.

title_en: Feeding mechanism of tubular object
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tubular material feeding mechanism which comprises a feeding channel, a bearing seat and a pushing plate, wherein one end of the feeding channel is connected with a material arranging machine, the bearing seat is provided with a pushing channel matched with the feeding channel, the bearing seat is connected with a first driving device, the front of the pushing plate is provided with a feeding area, the first driving device can drive the pushing channel to horizontally move between a position opposite to the feeding channel and a position of the feeding area, the front of the feeding area is provided with a positioning roller, the pushing plate is connected with a second driving device, the second driving device is used for driving the pushing plate to push the tubular material of the pushing channel onto the positioning roller, when the bearing seat moves, the side wall of the bearing seat seals the feeding channel, so that the movement of a single tubular material is realized, and then the pushing plate pushes the tubular material positioned in the pushing channel onto the positioning roller through a second driving device to attach labels, so that the feeding of a single tubular material is realized.

title_en: Anti-falling and anti-seismic domestic ceramic
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-falling and anti-seismic domestic ceramic, which comprises a ceramic tank body; the protection support is arranged at the bottom of the ceramic tank body; the ceramic tank has the beneficial effects that the protection treatment is carried out on the tank mouth of the ceramic tank body by the rubber protection blocks which are arranged on the outer side of the outer rubber ring at equal intervals by arranging the outer rubber ring and the rubber protection blocks, and the anti-slip support is carried out on the placement position of the ceramic tank body by the anti-slip rubber pad at the bottom of the outer support base by arranging the protection support, the outer support base, the anti-slip rubber pad and the fixed base, so that the slowing down treatment is carried out when the ceramic tank body is placed by combining each anti-slip rubber pad by the fixed base.

title_en: High-efficient hydraulic drive device of hoist
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-efficiency hydraulic driving device of a crane, which belongs to the technical field of crane driving devices and is characterized by comprising a base, wherein a supporting table is fixed at the top of the base, a hydraulic cylinder main body is fixedly connected to the left side of the top of the supporting table, and a filtering assembly is arranged to effectively remove various impurities such as metal particles, organic impurities and moisture in hydraulic oil, so that the impurities can be prevented from entering hydraulic elements such as a hydraulic pump and the hydraulic cylinder main body, the abrasion and blockage of the elements caused by the impurities are avoided, the service life of the hydraulic elements is prolonged, and a conveying assembly is arranged to limit the impurities on a path leading to the filtering assembly, so that the impurities can be timely removed in the circulating process of the hydraulic oil, the damage of the impurities to other key hydraulic elements is avoided, and the high-efficiency normal operation of the whole hydraulic driving device is protected.

title_en: Electronic hardware detection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electronic hardware detection device which comprises a conveying component, a mounting frame, a detection component, a first driving component and a second driving component, wherein the conveying component is suitable for carrying and conveying electronic hardware, the mounting frame is arranged on one side of the conveying component, the detection component is arranged above the conveying component and is suitable for detecting the electronic hardware conveyed by the conveying component, the first driving component comprises a limiting piece, a first transmission component and a second transmission component, the first transmission component is suitable for rotating relative to the mounting frame and driving the detection component to reciprocate in a linear direction, and the second driving component is connected with the conveying component and is suitable for driving the conveying component to intermittently operate. The electronic hardware detection device can be suitable for electronic hardware with different sizes, can realize accurate positioning relative to the electronic hardware, and has high detection precision and small error.

title_en: Clapping mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a material beating mechanism which comprises a support frame, wherein a plurality of upper conveying rollers and lower conveying rollers are respectively arranged at the upper end and the lower end in the support frame, and conveying belts for conveying materials are arranged on the upper conveying rollers and the lower conveying rollers. The beating mechanism can effectively vibrate or impact the surface of the conveyor belt by virtue of the beating force, so that the materials adhered to the beating mechanism are subjected to enough external force, overcome the adhesive force, smoothly separate from the conveyor belt and fall into the collecting container under the action of gravity. Therefore, the materials which are difficult to fall off in time originally can be efficiently collected, and the efficiency and the integrity of material collection are obviously improved.

title_en: Railway freight platform rail type cargo carrying heavy-duty mechanical lifting appliance
abstract_en: The utility model provides a railway freight platform rail type heavy-load mechanical lifting appliance for carrying cargoes, which belongs to the technical field of mechanical lifting appliances and comprises a lifting frame, wherein a chain is fixedly arranged at the top of the lifting frame, the other end of the chain is fixedly arranged at the bottom of a lifting plate, a lifting lug is fixedly arranged at the top of the lifting plate, a permanent magnet synchronous motor is fixedly arranged in the middle of the top of the lifting frame, an output shaft of the permanent magnet synchronous motor is fixedly connected with a rotating shaft, a bearing is arranged on the outer wall of the rotating shaft, and a rotating block is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the rotating shaft.

title_en: Foldable lifting type electric hand-push forklift
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of forklifts and discloses a foldable lifting type electric hand-push forklift which comprises a forklift frame, wherein an electric lifting mechanism and a fork main body mechanism are respectively arranged on the forklift frame, an output structure of the electric lifting mechanism is in transmission connection with the fork main body mechanism and can enable the fork main body mechanism to reciprocate in the forklift frame, two fork bodies are arranged outside one side of the fork main body mechanism, and a rotation adjusting device is arranged between one end of each fork body and each fork main body mechanism. After the fork main body mechanism, the rotatable adjusting and folding device, the movable supporting mechanism, the plurality of spring retainers, the fork truck frame, the electric lifting mechanism and the two fork bodies are comprehensively assembled and used, besides meeting the use requirements of lifting cargoes, the two fork bodies and the two supporting legs serving as the outer convex structures can be stored and adjusted under the support of the rotatable adjusting and folding device and the self adjustment of the movable supporting mechanism.

title_en: Double-station semi-finished product turnover machine for ALC plate production line
abstract_en: A double-station semi-finished product turnover machine for an ALC plate production line comprises a turnover machine and an edge cleaning device. The turnover machine further comprises a turnover device, a turnover table translation device and a side plate lateral movement device. The turnover device comprises a turnover support, a rotating shaft, a rotating support, a first oil cylinder, a second oil cylinder, an oil cylinder support and a supporting upright post. The overturning platform translation device is further provided with a first synchronization device, and the first synchronization device comprises a synchronization shaft, a gear and a rack. The lateral plate traversing device is also provided with a clamping device. The edge cleaning device comprises a scraper rest and a lifting device, wherein the lifting device comprises a guide frame, a lifting column, guide wheels, guide rails and a fifth oil cylinder. And a second synchronization device is also arranged on the edge cleaning device. The double-station semi-finished product turnover machine for the ALC plate production line realizes synchronous in-out of the ALC plate after uncleaned and cleaned, and compared with the single-station turnover machine, the double-station semi-finished product turnover machine has the advantages that the structural complexity is not increased, the working efficiency is improved, and the production process flow is optimized.

title_en: Net belt friction winding device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a net belt friction winding device which comprises a fixing frame, wherein one end of the fixing frame is provided with a cloth guide bracket, a rotating net belt is arranged in the fixing frame, the cloth guide bracket is used for placing a winding roller, and the net belt is attached to the winding roller. The wind-up roller is driven to rotate by the friction force of the mesh belt to assist the winding of the melt blown cloth, so that the use cost is reduced, and the use space is reduced. Meanwhile, the defect that the low-gram-weight material is easy to stretch and deform due to light gram weight in the rolling process of the traditional rolling method can be overcome through a friction rolling mode.

title_en: Automatic sealing mechanism for garbage bags and intelligent cat toilet
abstract_en: The application discloses an automatic garbage bag sealing mechanism and an intelligent cat toilet, which are characterized in that a first packing press rod and a second packing press rod are respectively connected with two parallel side edges of a driving belt, the driving motor drives the driving belt to rotate forwards and reversely, and drives the first packing press rod and the second packing press rod to slide oppositely and reversely so as to reciprocate between the limit opening position and the limit sealing position. Adopt driving belt to realize the reciprocal drive of two packing depression bars, drive structure simplifies, realizes simultaneously that the disposal bag closes up and packs at garbage bin open-ended middle part, and the packing process atress everywhere is even, reduces the extravagant problem of disposal bag.

title_en: Transformer handling device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of transformers and discloses a transformer carrying device which comprises a main support plate, wherein the main support plate extends forwards and backwards, the rear ends of the left side wall and the right side wall of the main support plate are respectively and fixedly connected with a first connecting shaft, the opposite ends of the first connecting shafts are respectively and fixedly connected with a fixed rod, the fixed rods extend backwards, the outer walls of the rear ends of the fixed rods are rotatably provided with rollers I, the front sides of the left side wall and the right side wall of the main support plate are respectively and fixedly connected with a second connecting shaft II, the opposite ends of the second connecting shafts are rotatably provided with rollers II, the front ends of the main support plate are fixedly connected with a handle I, the front sides of the top of the main support plate are fixedly connected with a secondary support plate, the top ends of the secondary support plate are fixedly connected with a handle II, a suspension arm is arranged above the main support plate, the rear ends of the suspension arm extend upwards in a tilting manner, the rear ends of the suspension arm are in a sliding insertion telescopic arm, the rear ends of the telescopic arm are rotatably provided with a lifting hook I, and a lifting hook is arranged below the lifting hook. The utility model uses lever principle to carry the transformer, which saves manpower and improves carrying efficiency.

title_en: Loading tray convenient to installation copper foil
abstract_en: The utility model provides a loading tray convenient for mounting copper foil, which relates to the technical field of loading trays and comprises a bottom plate and a copper foil coil, wherein a blocking piece for fixing the position of the copper foil coil is arranged above the bottom plate, an isolating block for limiting the placement position of the copper foil coil is arranged above the bottom plate in a laminating manner, a first isolating plate, a second isolating plate and a top plate which play an isolating role are arranged above the bottom plate, a limiting column which sequentially penetrates through the first isolating plate, the second isolating plate and the top plate and plays a stabilizing role is connected above the bottom plate, the concave surface of the copper foil coil is laminated and placed, the blocking piece is blocked on the other side of the copper foil coil, a bolt penetrates through the blocking piece and is inserted into a screw hole, the purpose of fixing the copper foil coil is achieved, the limiting column is screwed to complete the connection with the bottom plate, and the top end of the limiting column is locked through a nut.

title_en: Material self-discharging and vehicle-mounted lifting appliance control parallel working hydraulic system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hydraulic system for controlling parallel operation of a material self-unloading and truck-mounted crane, which comprises an energy storage unit, a power unit, a control unit and a driving unit, wherein a gear pump is arranged on a hydraulic oil tank and is connected with a self-unloading valve group through a single oil pipe. According to the material self-discharging and truck-mounted crane control parallel working hydraulic system, through the interaction of the energy storage unit, the power unit, the control unit and the driving unit, the self-discharging oil cylinder is conveniently controlled by one oil pipe, and the parallel connection of the material self-discharging hydraulic system and the lifting appliance control hydraulic system can be realized, so that a hydraulic pipeline is simplified, the hydraulic oil allowance in the oil pipe is reduced, and the power output cost is further reduced.

title_en: Bottle cap device for quantitatively taking medicine and good in controllability
abstract_en: A bottle cap device which is used for quantitatively taking medicine and has good controllability. The medicine taking device comprises at least an inner medicine taking cover, an operating rod, a spring and a baffle plate, wherein the inner medicine taking cover is provided with a plurality of medicine taking holes, the quantity of pills which can be taken by the medicine taking holes at one time is the quantity of medicines taken by the medicine packaging bottle quantitatively at each time, the medicine taking holes extend from the bottom surface of the inner medicine taking cover to one side of the outer cover, the middle of the inner medicine taking cover is provided with an operating hole for installing the spring and the operating rod, the plurality of medicine taking holes are distributed around the operating hole, the operating rod is divided into an upper part, a middle part and a lower part with the decreasing diameter, the operating hole comprises an upper hole and a lower hole which are coaxial and the decreasing diameter is arranged in the operating hole. According to the bottle cap device, the operating rod and the baffle plate are arranged in the medicine taking inner cap, pills on one side of the medicine packaging bottle can be conveniently separated through up-and-down movement of the operating rod, and meanwhile, the pills are convenient to pour out, so that quantitative medicine taking controllability is good.

title_en: Running tool and running kit
abstract_en: The utility model provides a running tool and a running kit, which are used for running a current collector of a battery in a battery manufacturing process. The running tool of the present utility model includes a handle and at least three bars extending from the handle in the first direction, each of the at least three bars extending in the first direction and being radially spaced apart, the at least three bars being configured to be capable of engaging different locations of a current collector so that the at least three bars are capable of loading a plurality of current collectors. The running tool can conveniently pick up and deliver the current collector, and the current collector can be stored in the bearing tool matched with the running tool for a long time, and the current collector can not be deformed and adhered to each other after long-time storage.
