title_en: Movable hydraulic pipe storage device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a movable hydraulic pipe storage device, which belongs to the technical field of storage equipment and comprises a box body, wherein a storage cavity and a plurality of storage cavities are formed in the inner side of the box body, a motor is installed on the back surface of the storage cavity, the output end of the motor is connected with a rotating shaft, the outer wall of the rotating shaft is detachably connected with a wire reel, the side wall of the storage cavity is provided with a threading hole, the outer wall of the storage cavity is fixedly connected with a mounting frame, a cleaning block is installed in the inner side of the mounting frame, a fan is installed at the top of the box body, and the air outlet end of the fan faces the storage cavity. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the wire spool, when the hydraulic pipe is not used, one end of the hydraulic pipe passes through the threading hole and is wound on the wire spool, and the motor is used for driving the wire spool to automatically wind the hydraulic pipe, so that the labor can be saved, the working efficiency is improved, and due to the arrangement of the mounting frame, the cleaning block is placed into the mounting frame before winding, and the outer wall of the hydraulic pipe can be cleaned during winding, so that putty pollution is prevented.

title_en: Feeding device for production of insulating heating block
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a feeding device for producing an insulating heating block, which comprises a feeding box and a feeding assembly, wherein ceramic heating bodies are stacked in the feeding box, the feeding assembly comprises a jacking assembly and a second transferring assembly, the jacking assembly is positioned below the second transferring assembly, the output end of the jacking assembly enters the feeding box from a jacking channel below the feeding box and is in contact with the ceramic heating bodies positioned at the bottom, the second transferring assembly grabs the ceramic heating bodies at the uppermost part of the feeding box and transfers the ceramic heating bodies, the second transferring assembly is used for transferring the ceramic heating bodies once, the output end of the jacking assembly is propped for a set distance, the ceramic heating bodies in the feeding assembly are grabbed by the feeding assembly and transferred to a ceramic heating body inlet of a placing device, so that stable and reliable feeding is realized, and the reliable operation of a subsequent placing device and the placement of the ceramic heating bodies instead of manpower are ensured.

title_en: Remote powder conveying device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a powder remote conveying device, which relates to the technical field of wind power feeding, and comprises a sliding frame which is connected to a frame body in a sliding manner, wherein a plurality of material storage boxes are fixedly arranged on the sliding frame, a bracket is fixedly arranged at the middle position of the frame body, a material receiving hopper is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the bracket, the lower end of the material receiving hopper is connected with a material conveying pipe, one end of the material conveying pipe is provided with a wind power conveyor in a matching manner.

title_en: Refrigerator cargo compartment loading and unloading system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a refrigerator cargo compartment loading and unloading system which comprises a refrigerator track assembly, a tail plate switching assembly and a cargo compartment track assembly, wherein a first end of the refrigerator track assembly is in butt joint with a conveying line in a refrigerator, a second end of the refrigerator track assembly is in butt joint with the tail plate switching assembly, the tail plate switching assembly is in butt joint with the cargo compartment track assembly at the same time, the cargo compartment switching assembly is used for transferring a loading and unloading container on the refrigerator track assembly to the cargo compartment track assembly, the cargo compartment track assembly is arranged in a cargo compartment, and after the loading and unloading box is transferred to the cargo compartment track assembly and limited, the cargo compartment can be stably loaded in the cargo compartment. The loading and unloading box for loading and unloading dead animal carcasses can be conveniently transferred between the refrigeration house and the cargo box, the whole process is efficient and reliable, manual carrying and other operations are not needed, meanwhile, weighing and recording and the like can be carried out on the dead animal carcasses, and the system is also suitable for other types of fixed places such as factories and wharfs, and improves the use flexibility.

title_en: Automatic induction wire feeding device
abstract_en: The utility model provides an automatic induction wire feeding device, and belongs to the technical field of wire feeding devices. The automatic lifting device comprises a fixed sealing plate, a rope sending part and a rope clamping part, wherein the fixed sealing plate comprises an upper sealing plate and a lower sealing plate, a limit guide rail shaft is arranged between the upper sealing plate and the lower sealing plate, the rope sending part comprises a lifting platform penetrating through the limit guide rail shaft and a lifting motor fixedly arranged at the top of the upper sealing plate and used for driving the lifting platform to lift, and the rope clamping part comprises a pair of clamps positioned below the lower sealing plate and a clamp motor fixedly arranged on the lifting platform and used for driving the clamps to rotate. The utility model can automatically sense and send wires under the combined action of the rope sending part, the rope clamping part and the wire coiling part, does not need long-term operation of the unattended equipment, reduces the use cost of later operation, and can continuously use the upper part after the rope is cut off, thereby saving the cost.

title_en: Novel breast milk storage bag
abstract_en: The utility model provides a novel breast milk storage bag which comprises a bag body provided with an opening and a low-temperature cavity, wherein the bag body is internally provided with a milk storage cavity, the outer surface of the opening is provided with external threads, the external threads can be in airtight connection with a cover provided with corresponding internal threads, the external threads can also be connected with a tee part provided with corresponding internal threads of a breast pump, and the low-temperature cavity is detachably connected to the periphery of the bag body and used for placing ice cubes. The novel breast milk storage bag can be directly communicated with the breast pump through the opening, so that the breast milk squeezed from the breast pump directly enters the storage bag, the breast milk is prevented from being transferred back and forth, the novel breast milk storage bag is clean and sanitary, and the breast pump does not need to carry milk-receiving devices such as milk bottles and the like when in use. And in addition, materials such as ice blocks and the like which can provide a low-temperature environment can be placed in the low-temperature cavity of the novel breast milk storage bag, so that the low-temperature environment is provided for the preservation and transportation of breast milk, and bacterial breeding and deterioration are avoided.

title_en: Sound insulation car wall for elevator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sound insulation sedan wall for an elevator, which comprises an outer panel and an inner panel which are arranged in parallel at intervals, wherein a plurality of first steel bars which are arranged horizontally and a plurality of second steel bars which are arranged vertically are arranged between the inner panel and the outer panel, the outer side of each first steel bar is connected with the outer panel, the inner side of each second steel bar is connected with the inner panel, the outer side of each second steel bar is connected with all first steel bars, a first sound insulation channel which extends horizontally is formed between two adjacent first steel bars, a first sound insulation cotton sliver is inserted in the first sound insulation channel in an adapting mode, a second sound insulation channel which extends vertically is formed between two adjacent second steel bars, and a second sound insulation cotton sliver is inserted in the second sound insulation channel in an adapting mode. The sound insulation sedan-chair wall has the characteristics of high structural strength and good sound insulation effect, and is perfect in overall function and high in practicality.

title_en: Automatic conveying device for edge wires
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a limit silk carries technical field, and this disclosure provides an automatic conveyor of limit silk, and it includes the conveying piece, and the conveying piece has the conveying passageway, is used for carrying the limit silk in the conveying passageway, and couple cyclic movement sets up in the conveying passageway, and the couple is used for hooking the limit silk, and when the limit silk got into the conveying passageway, the couple in good time hooked the limit silk, and the motion along with drive mechanism drives the limit silk and removes in the conveying passageway. The conveying channel is provided with an ascending section, and the edge wires cannot ascend in the ascending section due to insufficient friction force between the edge wires and the bottom wall of the conveying channel, so that the edge wires are prevented from gathering in the conveying channel by the design of the hooks. The automatic conveying of limit silk is realized to the couple, reduces manual operation, improves production efficiency. The hooks move circularly and can continuously convey the edge yarn. Through the technical scheme, the technical problem that the phenomenon of accumulation frequently occurs when the edge coil is conveyed in the prior art is solved.

title_en: Loading attachment is used in ore raw materials processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a feeding device for ore raw material processing, which relates to the technical field of ore processing, and comprises a conveying device body, wherein the outer wall of the conveying device body is rotationally connected with a supporting rod, the bottom end of the supporting rod is fixedly connected with a bottom plate, a baffle plate is uniformly arranged on a conveying belt of the conveying device body, the upper surface of the bottom plate, far away from the supporting rod, is provided with an adjusting mechanism, and the upper surface of the bottom plate, close to the adjusting mechanism, is provided with a buffer mechanism.

title_en: Raw coal bin separating and feeding device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of coal feeding, in particular to a raw coal bin separating and feeding device which comprises a base, an output pipe fixedly connected in the base, a pushing unit arranged on the base and used for pushing coal materials, and a supporting unit arranged on the base and used for supporting the pushing unit, wherein the pushing unit comprises a first pipe body arranged at the top of the supporting unit, a frame body is arranged in the first pipe body, the top of the frame body is fixedly connected with a first motor, the driving end of the first motor penetrates through the top of the frame body and is fixedly connected with a rotating rod, the tail end of the rotating rod is rotatably connected to the inner top of the frame body, the raw coal bin separating and feeding device can sequentially push the coal materials to pass through in a wave-type operation mode, so that caking is avoided, meanwhile, as the roller can rotate and combine with wave-type motion, the force generated in the pushing mode is small, and damage to the coal materials can be reduced.

title_en: Film winding device integrating chromogenic reaction
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of film winding devices and discloses a film winding device integrating a color reaction, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a bidirectional screw is rotatably connected in a first chute, the outer surface of the bidirectional screw is in threaded connection with a supporting plate, mounting holes are formed in two ends of a winding roller, and a shell is mounted in the mounting holes in a matched manner. According to the utility model, the first motor is started to drive the bidirectional screw to rotate, so that the two support plates are driven to synchronously move in opposite directions or back to back along the first sliding groove of the bottom plate, the distance between the fixing structures on the two support plates is adjusted, the aim of adapting the winding rollers with different lengths is fulfilled, meanwhile, compressed gas is injected into the rubber air bags through the air inlet nozzle, the radial thrust generated by expansion of the rubber air bags is utilized to eject the fixing blocks outwards from the shell through openings, the outer surfaces of the fixing blocks are tightly abutted against the inner walls of the winding roller mounting holes, the reliable fixing of the winding rollers is realized through the friction self-locking principle, and the problem of quick adaptation of the winding rollers with different specifications is solved.

title_en: Be used for mechanical production centre gripping propelling movement material loading manipulator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a clamping, pushing and feeding manipulator for mechanical production, which belongs to the technical field of mechanical equipment, and comprises a mounting upright post, wherein a linear module is horizontally arranged at one side of the top of the mounting upright post, a mounting seat is fixedly connected to a moving block of the linear module, a lifting mechanism is arranged at one side of the mounting seat, an electric claw clamp is arranged at one side of the lifting mechanism, two clamping plates which are symmetrically arranged are arranged at one end of the electric claw clamp, the two clamping plates can be used by utilizing the mutual matching of the linear module and the lifting mechanism, so that the electric claw clamp can be quickly adjusted in the horizontal and vertical directions to the most stable position of raw materials, and meanwhile, a driving assembly is additionally arranged to enable the electric claw clamp to clamp the raw materials, rotate a supporting plate to the bottom of the raw materials in the raw materials transferring process, and perform bottom holding on the bottom of the raw materials under the action of a first hydraulic cylinder, thereby greatly improving the stability of the whole clamping.

title_en: Special dust collector of lithium carbonate packing mouth
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of lithium carbonate packaging, in particular to a dust collector special for a lithium carbonate packaging port. The utility model provides a special dust collector of lithium carbonate packing mouth, including the support frame, the bracing piece, the guide piece, the inlet pipe, the valve, the conical tube, the trachea, air pump and first dust absorption ring, two bracing pieces of support frame left part fixedly connected with, fixedly connected with guide piece between two bracing piece tops, guide piece upper portion fixedly connected with inlet pipe, and the inlet pipe passes the guide piece, inlet pipe upper portion fixedly connected with valve, inlet pipe bottom fixedly connected with conical tube, and intercommunication between inlet pipe and the conical tube, the first dust absorption ring of guide piece inboard fixedly connected with, first dust absorption ring centers on in the conical tube outside. According to the utility model, the air pump is matched with the first dust collection ring and the second dust collection ring to clean lithium carbonate dust generated in the process of packaging lithium carbonate, so that the production safety is improved, the physical health of workers is protected, and the environmental pollution is reduced.

title_en: Automatic lifting device for monitoring
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a monitoring automatic lifting device which comprises a shell, wherein a microcontroller, a communication module, a driving module and a power supply control module are fixedly arranged on the inner wall of one side of the shell, a speed reduction driving assembly is fixedly arranged in the shell, a main shaft is fixedly connected to the movable end of the speed reduction driving assembly, an encoder fixedly arranged at the inner bottom of the shell is arranged at one end of the main shaft, an input shaft of the encoder is fixedly connected with the main shaft, and the main shaft penetrates through the shell and is fixedly connected with a winch. According to the utility model, three defects of the traditional lifting device in petrochemical oil storage tank area application are effectively overcome through integrating the microcontroller, the communication module (comprising LoRa, 4G and GPS modules), the encoder and the speed reduction driving assembly, firstly, wireless control is realized through the remote communication module, so that operators can accurately adjust the lifting of the antistatic fiber belt in a safe area, and the problems of safety risk and low efficiency of local manual operation are overcome.

title_en: Product packaging box
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of product packaging and transportation, and particularly relates to a product packaging box which comprises a base, two first side plates, a second side plate, an auxiliary side plate, a limiting part and a top plate, wherein the two first side plates are oppositely arranged on the front side and the rear side of the base, the second side plate is arranged on one side of the base, the auxiliary side plate is arranged on the base and is respectively positioned on the left side and the right side of the base with the second side plate, the limiting part is arranged on the inner side of the auxiliary side plate and is used for limiting the slope block in installation when the auxiliary side plate is assembled and disassembled, the auxiliary side plate and the slope block form a slope structure, the surface of one side of the slope block matched with the auxiliary side plate is a slope surface, the auxiliary side plate, the second side plate and the two first side plates enclose a containing space for containing equipment, and the top plate is covered above the containing space. The utility model solves the problems of inconvenient loading and unloading or limited space and inflexible loading and unloading of heavy equipment with casters, has simple and reliable limiting mode and good bearing and damping effects, and can separate, overturn, move and splice the slope blocks and the auxiliary side plates, thereby improving the flexible applicability and the aesthetic property of the whole box body.

title_en: Cold chain logistics insulation can convenient to it is fixed
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cold-chain logistics insulation can convenient to fix, and belongs to the technical field of cold-chain logistics. The utility model relates to a cold chain logistics insulation can convenient to fix, which comprises a box body, a cover body arranged at the bottom of the box body, a mounting frame fixedly connected to the top of the cover body, wherein the bottom of the box body is fixedly connected with a mounting bar, the front side of the mounting frame is provided with a mounting groove matched with the mounting bar, a limiting rod slidingly arranged on the mounting frame, the outer side of the mounting frame is provided with a limiting groove matched with the limiting rod, and the mounting frame is provided with a limiting part for driving the limiting rod to enter and exit the limiting groove.

title_en: Material receiving device convenient for discharging
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a receiving device convenient for discharging, which relates to the technical field of discharging equipment and comprises a receiving hopper fixedly arranged on a supporting frame, wherein the bottom end of the receiving hopper is provided with a mounting shell, a pull plate is connected in a sliding manner in the mounting shell, one end of the pull plate is provided with a fixed rod, two pull ropes are arranged on the fixed rod, an electric push rod for driving the fixed rod is arranged on the mounting shell, a cross rod is arranged on the pull plate in a sliding manner, two ends of the cross rod are provided with sliding grooves for the pull ropes to penetrate through, a first spring and a second spring are sleeved outside the pull ropes, the first spring is fixedly connected between the cross rod and the inner wall of the receiving hopper, the second spring is positioned inside the sliding grooves and is fixedly connected with the inner wall of the sliding grooves, the other end of the second spring is provided with a triangular clamping block, the free ends of the two pull ropes are respectively fixedly connected with the two triangular clamping blocks, and a guide mechanism for angle adjustment is arranged on the inner side of the cross rod, and the inner side of the receiving hopper is provided with a guide mechanism for angle adjustment.

title_en: Metal particle leak protection transportation grab bucket
abstract_en: The application discloses a metal particle leakage-proof transportation grab bucket. Including the left bucket body and the right bucket body that axisymmetric set up, the top coaxial coupling unit that is provided with of left bucket body and right bucket body, equal fixedly connected with base on two lateral surfaces of the X direction of left bucket body and right bucket body, every the tip of base is all rotated and is connected with the spliced pole, fixedly connected with elastic component that can elastically stretch out and draw back between the spliced pole of left bucket body and the spliced pole of right bucket body, the spliced pole all is provided with in the both sides of X direction the elastic component. The metal particle leakage-proof transportation grab bucket solves the technical problems that the metal particles are difficult to closely attach at the connecting position of the grab bucket due to the limitation of the matching precision of a mechanical structure and the influence of external force factors such as vibration, jolt and the like in the lifting process after the grab bucket grabs the metal particles, so that the metal particles are leaked at the gap.

title_en: Feeding structure of automatic box filling machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of feeding, and provides a feeding structure of an automatic box filling machine, which comprises supporting legs, wherein the tops of the supporting legs are fixedly connected with a bottom plate, the tops of the bottom plate are provided with a feeding protection assembly, the feeding protection assembly comprises a shell, the shell is arranged on the side surface of the bottom plate, the tops of the bottom plate are provided with a box, the side surface of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a supporting rod, one end of the supporting rod is fixedly connected with a motor, an output shaft of the motor is fixedly connected with a rotating rod, the circumferential surface of the rotating rod is provided with a conveying belt, the outer wall of the supporting legs is fixedly connected with a supporting plate, the tops of the supporting plate are fixedly connected with an electric cylinder, the side surface of the bottom plate is rotatably connected with a rotating rod, the circumferential surface of the rotating rod is fixedly connected with a protection plate, and one end of the rotating rod is fixedly connected with a gear. Through above-mentioned technical scheme, the problem that can't prevent that the material from accidentally dropping in the transportation among the prior art has been solved.

title_en: Cross-linked insulating material processing feed mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a crosslinked insulating material processing feed mechanism, which comprises a housin, the casing upper surface is located equal fixedly connected with drum in four corners department, and drum internal thread connection has the thread bush, and the top of thread bush is rotated through the bearing and is connected with the fixing base, and is a plurality of the top fixedly connected with roof of fixing base, the round hole has been seted up at the top of roof, fixedly connected with unloading pipe in the round hole, the utility model discloses not only can drive the thread bush and rotate in the drum, make the thread bush drive the roof and go up and down to adapt to the height of different production facility, need not with the help of extra appurtenance, reduce intensity of labour, increase production efficiency, can ensure the coordination uniformity of four corners lifting movement moreover, avoid leading to equipment slope or material distribution inequality because of high deviation, promote machining precision and security, can also realize the continuous stable transport of insulating material, reduce manual intervention and putty risk.

title_en: Sensor heart yearn tensile wire storage device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sensor core wire tensile wire storage device which comprises a wire storage box connected to the end head of a sensor, wherein a wire inlet is formed at one end of the wire storage box, a wire outlet is formed at the other end of the wire storage box, and a containing cavity is formed in the wire storage box. A part of the sensor core wire is prestored in the wire storage box in a stacked mode, and after the core wire is pulled abnormally, the core wire in the wire storage box can extend out of the box body, so that the situation that the sensor core wire is broken in a stretching mode is prevented.

title_en: High-precision cooperation box filling machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-precision collaborative box filling machine, which relates to the technical field of collaborative box filling machines and comprises a machine base and a limiting assembly, wherein a first rotary table is arranged at the upper end of the machine base, the limiting assembly for positioning and increasing the box filling precision is arranged at the upper end of the first rotary table, the limiting assembly comprises a rotary plate, a limiting plate, a positive and negative tooth screw rod, an adjusting block, a limiting clamping plate and a movable frame, the limiting plate is arranged at the upper end of the rotary plate, the positive and negative tooth screw rod is arranged in the limiting plate, the adjusting block is arranged outside the positive and negative tooth screw rod, and the limiting clamping plate is arranged at the upper end of the adjusting block. This cooperation case packer of high accuracy passes through the orientation of rotor plate control limiting plate, the unloading after the material loading of the box of being convenient for and the vanning, and positive and negative tooth lead screw receives motor drive control regulating block and spacing splint's interval, and spacing splint play the side centre gripping spacing to the box is located the positive center of limiting plate, improves the precision of vanning.

title_en: Anti-drop locking protection mechanism for crane hook
abstract_en: The utility model provides an anti-falling locking protection mechanism for a crane hook, and belongs to the technical field of hook anti-falling. The lifting hook comprises a lifting hook body, a protection component and an anti-falling component, wherein the protection component is arranged on the lifting hook body and comprises a fixed shaft fixed on the inner side of the lifting hook body, a sleeve is arranged on the outer side of the fixed shaft, the anti-falling component is arranged at two ends of the protection component and used for limiting displacement of a lifting rope, the anti-falling component comprises side plates fixed at two ends of the sleeve, threaded columns are connected to the side plates, limiting plates are connected to the threaded columns in a sliding mode, when the lifting rope is arranged in the lifting hook body, the protection component is arranged on the surface of the sleeve, sliding friction between the lifting rope and the lifting hook body is converted into rolling friction, abrasion of the surface of the lifting rope is reduced, the problem that outer steel wires are broken due to repeated friction and even the lifting rope is broken is solved, the service lives of the lifting rope and the lifting hook are protected, and stability of equipment in the use process is improved.

title_en: Auxiliary device for installing track bend of monorail crane
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an auxiliary device for installing a curve of a monorail crane track, which relates to the technical field of auxiliary devices for installing curves, and comprises a monorail crane track, wherein the bottom of the monorail crane track is connected with an auxiliary installation lifting mechanism, auxiliary installation positioning devices are symmetrically arranged on the upper surface of the auxiliary installation lifting mechanism and are connected with the monorail crane track, and the auxiliary installation positioning devices are symmetrically arranged.

title_en: Transfer equipment for assembling industrial and commercial energy storage cabinet
abstract_en: The utility model discloses transfer equipment for assembling industrial and commercial energy storage cabinets, which comprises a stand column, wherein a cross beam is arranged on the stand column, a transverse moving assembly is arranged on the cross beam, a moving plate is arranged on the transverse moving assembly, a mounting plate is arranged on the side face of the moving plate, a lifting column is arranged in the mounting plate, a cylinder and a first motor which are matched with the lifting column are arranged on the mounting plate, a positioning plate is arranged at the bottom of the lifting column, a movable Z plate is arranged at the bottom of the positioning plate, a movable auxiliary plate is arranged at the bottom of the Z plate, a clamping motor is arranged at the end part of the auxiliary plate, a three-jaw chuck is arranged at the output end of the clamping motor, and two symmetrical side clamping jaws are arranged on the side face of the clamping motor. The multi-angle and multi-range adjustment of the utility model can lead the moving range of the whole equipment to be large, and simultaneously, the three-jaw chuck and the side clamping jaw at the end part can realize the clamping of the bottom and the side under different states, thereby having wide application range.

title_en: Flattening device for EPDM (ethylene-propylene-diene monomer) sheet
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an EPDM sheet flattening device which comprises a main frame of a flat cutting machine, wherein a fixed seat is fixedly connected to one side of the outer surface of the main frame of the flat cutting machine, a servo lifting assembly is arranged on the fixed seat, a transverse seat is fixedly arranged at the movable end of the servo lifting assembly, and two pressure sensors are symmetrically and fixedly embedded at the bottom of the transverse seat. According to the utility model, the servo lifting assembly drives the quick-release pressing roller to apply controllable pressure to the EPDM sheet, and the transverse moving assembly is matched to drive the adsorption workbench to move relatively, so that automatic flattening operation of the sheet is realized. The pressure sensor monitors the pressure of the quick-release press roller in real time, ensures uniform and stable flattening force, and effectively solves the problem that the deformation and wrinkling of the EPDM sheet are difficult to eliminate by only relying on induced draft fixation of the traditional flat cutting machine. The flattening effect of the sheet is remarkably improved, the size of the subsequent cutting procedure is guaranteed, and the quality problems of uneven thickness and the like caused by uneven EPDM sheet are avoided.

title_en: Novel buckle formula carton
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a novel buckle type carton. The novel plastic bending device comprises a first side plate, a second side plate, a third side plate, a fourth side plate, a first cover plate, a second cover plate, a third cover plate and a fourth cover plate, wherein the bottom of the second side plate is connected with a first bottom plate, two sides of the first bottom plate are also connected with a first bending piece and a second bending piece, the first bending piece is provided with a first slot, the second bending piece is provided with a second slot, the bottom of the fourth side plate is connected with a second bottom plate, two sides of the second bottom plate are also connected with a third bending piece and a fourth bending piece, the third bending piece is provided with a first inserting piece, the fourth bending piece is provided with a second inserting piece, the first side plate is provided with a third slot, and the third side plate is provided with a fourth slot. The utility model is provided with the first bottom plate and the second bottom plate, and the peripheries of the two bottom plates have good fixing effect, so that the bottom of the utility model has excellent deformation resistance effect and good overall bearing capacity.

title_en: Steel-engineering bamboo container suitable for lifting and forklift
abstract_en: The invention relates to a steel-engineering bamboo container suitable for hoisting and forklift. The steel frame mainly comprises a 'mesh' -shaped bottom rectangular steel frame, a top engineering bamboo rectangular frame, an engineering bamboo longitudinal middle beam, an engineering bamboo transverse beam, an engineering bamboo corner column, an engineering bamboo middle column, an inclined strut, a peripheral engineering bamboo plate, a goods inlet and outlet door and a connecting piece; the container can be arranged at one, two or three positions of the top, the side surface and the end surface, and the loading and unloading efficiency is high. The container has the advantages of light dead weight, high strength, safe and reliable structure, corrosion resistance, impact resistance, fatigue resistance, freezing resistance and the like, reduces the use of mineral materials such as steel, aluminum alloy and the like, and is low-carbon and environment-friendly.

title_en: Water storage tank convenient to clearance spot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water storage tank convenient for cleaning stains, which relates to the technical field of water storage tanks and comprises a water storage tank body, wherein the bottom of the water storage tank body is fixedly connected with at least three supporting legs, the eccentric position of the bottom surface of the water storage tank body is fixedly connected with a drain pipe, the utility model discloses a water storage tank, including water storage tank body, water storage tank body front side top fixedly connected with filling pipe, water storage tank body right side below is provided with the manhole, water storage tank body rear side fixedly connected with level gauge, the inside clean subassembly that is provided with of water storage tank body. The cleaning device has the advantages that full-automatic cleaning is realized through the cleaning assembly, the servo motor drives the rotating shaft to drive the cleaning brush to rotate, the elastic telescopic rod enables the brush hair to be always clung to the inner wall of the tank body, cleaning of the inner wall of the water storage tank can be rapidly completed by matching with water spraying flushing of the spray heads of the annular pipes, three groups of mounting frames are uniformly distributed at 120 degrees, 360-degree dead-angle-free cleaning is formed when the cleaning brush rotates along with the rotating shaft, and the cleaning rate of dirt on the tank wall can be improved by matching with fan-shaped water flow sprayed by the spray heads.

title_en: High stability flannelette compression roller
abstract_en: The application relates to a high-stability flannelette press roller, which relates to the technical field of textile machinery and comprises a rotating shaft and a roller body arranged on the rotating shaft, wherein an adjusting device for dynamically adjusting the roller body is arranged on the rotating shaft, and the adjusting device comprises an adjusting ring, a first adjusting block and a second adjusting block. According to the application, the adjusting ring is arranged on the rotating shaft, and then the first adjusting block and the second adjusting block are detachably arranged on the adjusting ring through the first installing mechanism and the second installing mechanism, so that the number and the positions of the first adjusting block and the second adjusting block on the adjusting ring can be used for adjusting the whole dynamic balance of the press roller, and the stability of the press roller during rotation is ensured.

title_en: Two-sided labeling mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a two-sided labeling mechanism, which comprises a main frame and an auxiliary frame, wherein an output rod is driven by a starting motor to rotate, a roller and a conveyor belt are driven to move, materials are conveyed, an air cylinder pushes arc-shaped guide plates on two sides, the positions of the materials are adjusted, the materials enter a labeling area in the middle, label rolls on a discharging shaft are guided to a stripping plate through guide rollers, label paper is stripped and adhered to the top of the materials, the first side adhesion is realized, residual base paper is recovered by a winding pipe, a box part is driven to drive the winding pipe to rotate, the labeled materials enter the auxiliary frame, a rod body is driven by a driver to rotate, a clamping groove on a rotating disc is driven to grasp the edges of the materials, the rod body is rotated by 180 degrees, the materials are turned to the other side upwards, labeling treatment is carried out on the other side of the materials manually, the conveyor belt is enabled to stably convey the materials to the clamping groove on the other rotating disc, the materials are enabled to rotate to the front side, and the stable grasping of the materials is ensured by the clamping groove design of a turnover mechanism, and the falling-off is avoided.

title_en: Automatic feeding device for thermistor chip
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic feeding device for a thermistor chip, which relates to the technical field of production of thermistor chips and comprises a feeding machine body, a feeding frame and a feeding machine body, wherein the feeding frame is arranged above the feeding machine body, the feeding machine body is arranged at an outlet of the feeding machine body, a baffle plate is connected to the feeding frame, a first motor is arranged on the feeding machine body, a rotating wheel is arranged on an output shaft of the first motor, a shifting plate for separating two material groups is arranged on the rotating wheel, a sliding block is arranged below the baffle plate, a limiting plate is arranged on the feeding machine body, and a conveying mechanism is arranged between the limiting plate and the sliding block.

title_en: Pull formula packing carton of electrified instruction manual two-dimensional code
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of packaging boxes, and particularly relates to a drawing type packaging box with electronic specification two-dimensional codes, which comprises a flat square outer box and an inner box and is characterized in that the top surface and the right side surface of the outer box are of an open design, an outer box top surface opening and an outer box right side opening are respectively arranged, the left side surface of the inner box is of an open design, an inner box left side opening is arranged, the right end of a bottom plate of the outer box is provided with an outwards extending turnover plate, crease lines are arranged between the turnover plate and the right end of the bottom plate of the outer box, the turnover plate is adhered to the outer wall of a right side plate of the inner box, and the electronic specification two-dimensional codes are printed on the outer wall of one side plate of the inner box or the outer box. The utility model has the advantages of reasonable structure, convenient manufacture and flexible and convenient use. The inner box adopts a rotary drawing opening mode, is novel in opening mode, is matched with the two-dimensional code of the electronic specification which can be hidden, is flexible and convenient to use, and has a certain anti-counterfeiting effect.

title_en: Supporting device for air pipe machining
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a supporting device for air duct processing, which relates to the technical field of air duct processing and comprises a first mounting seat, wherein a second mounting seat is arranged on one side of the first mounting seat, a supporting component for supporting a plate during conveying is arranged between the first mounting seat and the second mounting seat, the supporting component comprises cross frames arranged on one side of the first mounting seat, and the number of the cross frames is two, and the supporting device has the beneficial effects that: through setting up the stability when supporting component can be convenient for improve panel transport, the grid-type cross frame that this strutting arrangement adopted forms grid-like structure through criss-cross, and this kind of design can effectively disperse panel atress, avoids local stress concentration to showing and promoting whole rigidity, in panel transport process, grid-type structure can stabilize the bearing panel, reduces by a wide margin because of rocking or the position offset problem that warp leads to, guarantee transport stationarity and machining precision.

title_en: Spiral conveying type feeding device for garbage disposal
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of garbage treatment, and discloses a spiral conveying type feeding device for garbage treatment, which solves the problem that the position of a shell is inconvenient to adjust according to the requirement at present, and comprises a conveying cylinder, wherein a base is arranged below the conveying cylinder, an adjusting mechanism is arranged between the base and the conveying cylinder, the top of the conveying cylinder is fixedly connected with a feeding hopper, one end of the conveying cylinder is provided with a discharge hole, the other end of the conveying cylinder is fixedly provided with a frame, a conveying motor is fixedly arranged on the frame, a conveying shaft is fixedly connected to the conveying motor, one end of the conveying shaft, far away from the conveying motor, is rotationally connected with the inner side wall of the conveying cylinder, and the outer side of the conveying shaft is fixedly connected with a spiral blade positioned inside the conveying cylinder; the utility model is convenient for adjusting the height of the conveying cylinder, and is convenient for the circumferential rotation of the conveying cylinder by the coordination among the adjusting motor, the driving shaft, the mounting disc, the supporting column and the balls, thereby being convenient for adjusting the position of the conveying cylinder according to the requirement.

title_en: Plug installation structure for bottle body
abstract_en: The application relates to a plug mounting structure for a bottle body, which relates to the technical field of automatic processing and comprises a frame, a rotary table, a cleaning assembly, a feeding assembly and a pressing assembly, wherein the frame is used for supporting the plug mounting structure, the rotary table is mounted on the frame and used for conveying the bottle body, the cleaning assembly is mounted on the frame and used for cleaning the bottle body, the feeding assembly is mounted on the frame and used for conveying rubber sleeves to the rotary table, the pressing assembly is mounted on the frame and used for pressing the rubber sleeves onto the bottle body. The application omits manual pressing in of the rubber sleeve, reduces the embedding difficulty of the rubber sleeve, and improves the production efficiency and the product reliability.

title_en: Round tray with dampproofing structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a round tray with a dampproof structure, which relates to the technical field of trays and comprises a tray body, wherein a placement groove is formed in the middle of the top of the tray body, an annular flat cutting groove is formed in the edge of the tray body, an annular groove is formed in the bottom of the annular flat cutting groove, an organ cover is arranged in the annular groove, a cover plate is arranged above the organ cover, and the cover plate is arranged in the annular flat cutting groove.

title_en: Automatic stacking device for melamine board production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic stacking device for melamine board production, and relates to the field of stacking devices. The automatic stacking device for melamine board production comprises a conveying unit, a stacking unit, a hairbrush assembly, a height adjusting assembly and an impact assembly, wherein the stacking unit is arranged at the side end of the conveying unit and is used for stacking the conveyed melamine boards, the hairbrush assembly is arranged on the stacking unit and is used for cleaning dust on the surfaces of the melamine boards in the conveying process, and the height adjusting assembly is arranged on the stacking unit and is used for adjusting the height of the hairbrush assembly. According to the automatic stacking device for melamine board production, the hairbrush assembly can be adjusted to be matched with the melamine board surfaces of different thicknesses in height through the height adjusting mechanism, so that the thickness of the melamine boards is different, the hairbrush assembly is ensured to always clean dust on the melamine board surfaces at the optimal position and pressure, the dust cleaning effect is improved, and the production quality of melamine boards is ensured.

title_en: Antiwind drum
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-winding wire coil which comprises a central shaft, wherein edge rings are symmetrically and fixedly arranged on two sides of the central shaft, a mounting groove is formed in the middle of the central shaft, the mounting groove is annular, a plurality of fixing holes are formed in the bottom wall of the mounting groove, a middle separating ring is movably arranged in the mounting groove, the middle separating ring is formed by splicing a half-ring I and a half-ring II, the half-ring I and the half-ring II are fixedly connected through embedded bolts, and fixing rods corresponding to the fixing holes are fixedly arranged on the inner wall of an inner ring of the middle separating ring.

title_en: Material box taking and placing robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bin picking and placing robot which comprises a vehicle body, a telescopic fork, a distance sensor and a control device, wherein the telescopic fork comprises a supporting base part and a fork body, the supporting base part is connected with the vehicle body, the supporting base part is provided with a bearing area, the fork body is arranged on the supporting base part, the fork body is telescopic, the distance sensor is arranged on the supporting base part and connected with the control device, the distance sensor is used for detecting the distance between the distance sensor and the bin, and the control device is used for controlling the fork body to stretch or stop stretching according to the distance detected by the distance sensor. The technical scheme can solve the problem that the bin picking and placing robot in the related art can easily turn over the bin located on the goods shelf or bring the bin located on the goods shelf down when picking and placing the bin from the goods shelf.

title_en: Production line of ice making equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a production line of ice making equipment, which comprises a first conveying rail and a second conveying rail, wherein an assembling unit, a performance detecting unit, a drying unit and a line discharging unit are sequentially arranged on the production line along the first conveying rail, a plurality of movable tooling plates are arranged on the first conveying rail and are used for installing the ice making equipment, the movable tooling plates drive the ice making equipment to sequentially pass through the assembling unit, the performance detecting unit, the drying unit and the line discharging unit, the end point of the line discharging unit is communicated with the starting point of the assembling unit through the second conveying rail, the second conveying rail is used for conveying the movable tooling plates of the line discharging unit to the assembling unit, and after the conveying of the ice making equipment is completed, the movable tooling plates can automatically return to the starting point through the second conveying rail, so that the automatic circulating conveying of the movable tooling plates is realized, and the efficiency of the whole production flow is improved.

title_en: Cantilever fixing structure of crane
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cantilever fixing structure of a crane, which belongs to the technical field of cranes and comprises a crane main body and a cantilever, wherein one end of the cantilever is welded with a connecting disc, the connecting disc is fixedly connected with the crane main body through a plurality of bolts, a fiber grating sensor is used for monitoring a welding fusion line in real time, early recognition of fatigue cracks of a welding line is realized, a strain mutation signal is captured, the linkage response of a controller and an alarm is matched, early warning can be performed in time before the cracks are expanded to dangerous degree, the hysteresis and the limitation of traditional manual inspection are changed, a transverse moving assembly is used for realizing transverse fine adjustment of a wire winding and unwinding assembly through a transmission structure such as a motor II, a threaded rod and the like, and the horizontal alignment of a hook can be completed without moving the crane main body, so that the operation is convenient.

title_en: Automatic slice arranging machine for quartz crystals
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of quartz crystal processing, in particular to an automatic sheet discharging machine for quartz crystals, which comprises a sheet discharging machine body, wherein a controller is arranged on the surface of the sheet discharging machine body, detection cameras are arranged on the inner walls of the sheet discharging machine body, supporting bottom plates are arranged on the inner walls of the sheet discharging machine body, a frame plate is arranged above the supporting bottom plates, a material plate body is arranged above the frame plate, a centralized collecting mechanism is arranged on the surface of the frame plate, and an automatic material vibrating mechanism is arranged on the surfaces of the frame plate and the material plate body. According to the utility model, the quartz crystals on the surface of the material plate body can be vibrated when the automatic sheet discharging machine is used, the phenomenon of stacking between the quartz crystals is avoided, meanwhile, the manual vibration operation is not needed, and the detected defective products can be collected together in a concentrated manner when the automatic sheet discharging machine is used, so that a user can conveniently carry out concentrated treatment on the defective products.

title_en: Fiber blended fabric winding device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a fiber blended fabric winding device which comprises a supporting seat, a winding roller arranged at the tail end of the supporting seat, a compression roller arranged at the front end of the supporting seat, and a static eliminating device arranged at the top of the supporting seat, wherein the static eliminating device comprises a fixed plate connected with the top of the side wall of the supporting seat, an ion wind static eliminating rod connected with the fixed plate, a fabric guiding device is connected to the static eliminating device, the fabric guiding device is provided with a fabric channel, and the distance between the outlet position of the fabric channel and the ion wind static eliminating rod is in the working area of the ion wind static eliminating rod. The compression roller presses the fabric in the fabric advancing process, so that the fabric is kept in a tensioned state and further smoothly passes through the fabric channel, the fabric channel enables the fabric to be in the working range of the ion wind static eliminating rod after being discharged, the change of the diameter of the rolled fabric roll cannot be caused, the static eliminating effect is always stable, the rolled fabric is prevented from being charged with static, and the fabric rolling quality is guaranteed.

title_en: Gravity sliding type tire inflation roller conveying line
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a gravity sliding type tire inflation roller conveying line, and belongs to the technical field of tire inflation conveying lines. A gravity sliding type tyre inflation roller conveying line comprises an inclined bracket and a conveying roller which is rotationally connected on a mounting plate; the tire conveying device comprises a mounting plate, a symmetrically arranged adjusting plate, a limiting roller and a limiting roller, wherein the mounting plate is fixedly connected to the top of the inclined bracket, the symmetrically arranged adjusting plate is detachably connected to the mounting plate, and the limiting roller is rotatably connected to the adjusting plate.

title_en: Device convenient for lifting concrete cover plate
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a device for conveniently lifting and placing a concrete cover plate, and aims to solve the problems that manual lifting of the cover plate by a crowbar is time-consuming and labor-consuming and has potential safety hazards. The lifting assembly comprises a lifting assembly and a lifting assembly, wherein the lifting assembly comprises a crossed steel wire rope and an L-shaped steel bar hook, the lifting assembly is provided with an adjustable force arm lifting rod, the position of a rotating shaft of the lifting assembly is adjustable, and one end of the lifting assembly is provided with the hook connected with the steel wire rope. The hanger also comprises a supporting vehicle, the lifting rod can slide and rotate, and the hanger is provided with a locking structure. The device is laborsaving high-efficient, can stably lift and put the apron, adapts to multiple scene, promotes security and convenience.

title_en: Filling and sealing device for liquid medicament
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a filling and sealing device for liquid medicines, which relates to the technical field of medicine filling and sealing, and comprises two horizontally arranged frame bases, wherein a mounting bracket is fixedly connected above each frame base, a medicine filling mechanism is movably connected in a rectangular array in one mounting bracket, an energy converter is fixedly connected below each medicine filling mechanism, a splash-proof exhaust head is fixedly connected below each energy converter, the splash-proof exhaust head comprises an extending pipe, a conical sealing head is slidably matched with the outer side of the extending pipe, and an exhaust channel is formed in the conical sealing head in an annular array.

title_en: Anti-solidification quick cleaning discharge valve of asphalt tank truck
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of valves, and relates to an anti-solidification rapid cleaning and discharging valve of an asphalt tank truck, which comprises a valve main body, wherein a hollow groove is formed in the middle of the valve main body, the hollow groove is connected with a heating assembly through a steam conveying pipeline, and a plurality of groups of air dispersing holes matched with the heating assembly are formed in the top of the valve main body; the heating component is a miniature electric heating steam generator. The utility model can heat the asphalt discharging valve main body, thereby relieving the cooling speed of asphalt when the asphalt discharging valve main body discharges asphalt, further preventing the asphalt from being solidified easily due to temperature reduction, thereby causing the valve main body to generate blocking phenomenon and affecting the discharging efficiency, and simultaneously, the utility model can drive the hollow disc and the rubber ring to move by the servo motor, so that distilled water attached to the inner wall of the asphalt discharging valve main body is separated, thereby reducing the phenomenon that distilled water is attached to the inner wall of the asphalt discharging valve main body for a long time and scale is easy to generate.

title_en: High-safety permanent magnet manipulator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-safety permanent magnet manipulator which comprises a fixed plate, wherein an electro-permanent magnet is fixedly arranged on the outer surface of the lower end of the fixed plate, a connecting arm is fixedly arranged in the middle of the outer surface of the upper end of the fixed plate, auxiliary clamping structures are arranged at four corners of the outer surface of the upper end of the fixed plate, and each auxiliary clamping structure comprises a fixed seat, a first fixed shaft, a hydraulic rod, a second fixed shaft, a driving arm, a supporting arm, a third fixed shaft, a supporting column, a connecting block, a clamp block, a antiskid plate, a first connecting sleeve and a second connecting sleeve. According to the high-safety permanent magnet manipulator, through the auxiliary clamping structure, the permanent magnet is convenient to fix after the electric permanent magnet is adsorbed on the plate, stability of the plate after the plate is fixed is improved, safety is improved, and through the anti-skid plate, stability of clamping the plate is convenient to improve.

title_en: Vacuum pumping equipment for seafood packaging
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of seafood processing, in particular to a vacuum pumping device for seafood packaging, which can not only prevent liquid in seafood packaging from leaking out and ensure stable operation of a device, but also facilitate driving materials to be discharged after packaging is completed, thereby improving the working efficiency; the seafood packaging and sealing device comprises a working box, a sealing mechanism, two groups of discharging mechanisms, a packaging mechanism and an air extracting mechanism, wherein the sealing mechanism is arranged on the working box and enhances the sealing effect of the device, the two groups of discharging mechanisms are arranged on the working box and facilitate the discharge of seafood packages, the packaging mechanism is arranged on the working box and seals the seafood packages, and the air extracting mechanism is arranged on the working box and extracts the air in the device.

title_en: Convenient clear pipe chain machine silica gel piece structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a convenient-to-clean silica gel sheet structure of a pipe chain machine, and belongs to the technical field of cleaning of silica gel sheets of pipe chain machines. Comprises a fixed disc, a silica gel cleaning sheet and a fixed stainless steel sheet, wherein the fixed disc, the silica gel cleaning sheet and the fixed stainless steel sheet are respectively provided with corresponding threaded holes, the fixed disk, the silica gel cleaning sheet and the fixed stainless steel sheet are fixedly connected through bolts. The novel disc type chain-free mounting structure can directly mount the existing disc without a special structure, the disassembly-free chain mounting structure reduces maintenance difficulty, also avoids the influence of chain damage on strength, is good in fastening of the stainless steel sheet, and meanwhile is convenient to safely and stably replace, and reduces maintenance cost.

title_en: Paint bucket lifting mechanism for paint filling
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of paint bucket lifting, in particular to a paint bucket lifting mechanism for paint filling, which comprises a workbench, wherein a double-shaft motor is fixedly arranged in a mounting groove formed in the top of the workbench, a first lead screw is fixedly arranged at the output end of the double-shaft motor, a round groove is formed in the top of the workbench, and the height of a paint bucket main body can be adjusted by the air cylinder through the arrangement of the workbench, the double-shaft motor, the first lead screw, the round groove, a sliding block, a clamping block, a mounting frame, an air cylinder, a placing table and the paint bucket main body, so that the paint bucket main body can be conveniently pushed to the bottom of a discharging head, and meanwhile, the output end of the double-shaft motor can drive the first lead screw to rotate, so that the clamping block can clamp the paint bucket main body, and the paint bucket main body is prevented from moving during filling.

title_en: Triangle lifting adjustable transmission device of packaging film covering machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a triangle lifting adjustable transmission device of a packaging film laminating machine, which comprises a fixed underframe, a first triangle arranged on the fixed underframe, a connecting mounting seat arranged on the fixed underframe, and an induction probe arranged on the first triangle and the connecting mounting seat. The connecting rotating seat on the adjusting hinge is driven to rotate through the rotating connecting rod, the rotating threaded rod is driven to rotate through the connecting rotating seat, the second triangular plate on the sliding connecting plate is driven to adjust under the condition that the rotating threaded rod is in threaded connection with the sliding connecting plate, the triangular plate is lifted, wrinkles or breakage of the coating film due to too small angle in the wrapping process can be avoided, and when a shorter object is packaged, the triangular plate is lowered, the coating film can be guaranteed to be closely attached to the surface of the object, and waste of redundant coating films is reduced. The characteristic enables one device to meet the film coating requirements of various products, and the device does not need to be configured for different specifications of products independently, so that the universality and the application range of the device are greatly improved.

title_en: Clamping jaw for mechanical arm of luggage truck grabbing robot
abstract_en: The application relates to a clamping jaw for a mechanical arm of a luggage cart grabbing robot, which comprises a clamping jaw body, a pressing block and a driving part, wherein one end of the clamping jaw body is provided with a hook claw which is hooked with a luggage cart frame body, the pressing block is positioned on one side, close to a luggage cart handle, of the clamping jaw body, one end of the pressing block is rotationally connected with the clamping jaw body, the other end of the pressing block corresponds to the position of the luggage cart handle, and the driving part is arranged on the clamping jaw body and drives the pressing block to rotationally press the luggage cart handle. The application has the effects of integrating grabbing and unlocking of the luggage van, reducing maintenance cost and using a threshold.

title_en: Flexible buffer receiving platform of conveyor
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of material conveying, in particular to a flexible buffer material receiving platform of a conveyor. Including support frame, lifting plate piece, adjusting screw, bull stick and attenuator etc. the support frame quantity is two, and is the both sides of arranging at the conveyer in tandem, and support frame upper portion all sliding type is connected with the lifting plate piece, and front side support frame middle part rotation is connected with adjusting screw, and adjusting screw top rigid coupling has the bull stick, and front side lifting plate piece is connected with adjusting screw thread, and two equal fixed mounting in lifting plate piece upper portion have two attenuators. According to the utility model, an independent support frame structure is adopted, the flexible buffer material receiving platform is not rigidly connected with the conveyor body, the original conveying equipment is not required to be modified, the platform can be put into use only by moving to the feeding end of the conveyor during installation, and the platform can be quickly moved away during disassembly, so that nondestructive and non-invasive deployment is realized, and the use flexibility of the equipment is greatly improved.

title_en: Hand-held suction cup device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a handheld sucker device which comprises an assembly die, a suction device and two pairs of center positioning mechanisms. A strip-shaped groove is cut in the assembling die. The suction device is arranged above the assembly die and comprises a positioning outer frame, two pairs of support arms, a mounting plate, a negative pressure adsorption disc and a buckle assembly. The positioning outer frame is sleeved outside the assembly die, and the two pairs of support arms are respectively fixed at four corners of the positioning outer frame. The four corners of the mounting plate are all fixed with the otic placode, and two pairs of otic placodes slide respectively on two pairs of support arms, and the mounting plate both sides all are fixed with the handle. The negative pressure adsorption disc is arranged on the mounting plate. The buckle assembly is fixed on two sides of the positioning outer frame, which are close to the handle. The two pairs of center positioning mechanisms are respectively arranged on the inner side walls of the periphery of the positioning outer frame, and each center positioning mechanism comprises an installation groove, a rotary pressing assembly and a pair of torsion springs. According to the utility model, the center positioning mechanism is arranged, so that the efficiency of placing the strip-shaped laminating piece into the die by the sucker device is effectively improved.

title_en: Quick-dismantling type double-layer constant-temperature heat sealing mechanism of heat sealing machine
abstract_en: The utility model provides a quick-dismantling type double-layer constant-temperature heat sealing mechanism of a heat sealing machine, which has the technical scheme that: the heating device comprises a heating body and a heat sealing machine base, wherein the heating body is detachably connected with the heat sealing machine base through a push-type knife bolt, the other surface of the heat sealing machine base is fixedly connected with a stroke cylinder, and a heating rod is embedded in the heating body. The utility model has the advantages of (1) improving the convenience of disassembly and assembly, reducing the shutdown loss, (2) optimizing the heating stability, prolonging the operation and maintenance period, (3) precisely controlling the temperature to prevent fluctuation, avoiding the sealing defect, and (4) strengthening the heat sealing laminating degree and ensuring the sealing quality.

title_en: Wire harness winding device integrated with lifting drive and multi-core wire harness assembly line
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an integrated lifting-driving wire harness winding device and a multi-core wire harness assembly line, wherein the wire harness winding device comprises a winding jig used for providing wire harness winding support, a first constraint mechanism fixedly connected with or arranged side by side with the winding jig, a winding module comprising a rotating mechanism, a lifting mechanism and a second constraint mechanism, wherein the second constraint mechanism is used for connecting the other end of the wire harness, the rotating mechanism is connected with the winding jig and/or the second constraint mechanism, the rotating mechanism can drive the winding jig to rotate or drive the second constraint mechanism to circulate around the winding jig, the lifting mechanism is connected with the winding jig and/or the second constraint mechanism, and the lifting mechanism is used for driving the winding jig and/or the second constraint mechanism to move along the extending direction of the axis of the winding jig so as to enable the wire harness to be spirally stacked and wound on the winding jig. The multi-core wire harness assembly line employs the wire harness winding device described above.

title_en: Medical packaging film crimping device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a medical packaging film crimping device which comprises a supporting component, a film feeding component and a crimping component, wherein the supporting component comprises a first supporting frame which is symmetrically arranged, the film feeding component comprises a first film feeding roller, a second film feeding roller and a third film feeding roller which are rotatably arranged on the supporting frame, the first film feeding roller, the second film feeding roller and the third film feeding roller are vertically staggered, the crimping component comprises a second supporting frame which is symmetrically arranged and a turning roller which is rotatably arranged on the second supporting frame, turning frames are arranged on two sides of the turning rollers, a first winding roller and a second winding roller are rotatably arranged on two sides of the turning frames, and a first winding motor and a second winding motor are correspondingly arranged on side edges of the turning frames. According to the scheme, the overturning frame and the double winding rollers are matched, so that the winding direction of the film material can be switched, and the roll changing function without stopping machine is realized.

title_en: Clamp for assembling motor assembly
abstract_en: The utility model provides a clamp for assembling a motor assembly, and belongs to the technical field of clamps. It has solved the problem of current anchor clamps function singleness. This a anchor clamps for motor element assembly includes connecting block, the mounting panel, set up actuating source on the mounting panel, a plurality of is rectangular form splint, a plurality of first connecting strip and a plurality of slide rail of linking firmly on the mounting panel, the actuating source can drive connecting block reciprocating motion, the slide rail uses the actuating source to be radial outwards and arranges, equal sliding connection has splint on every slide rail, the inside wall and the lateral wall of splint outer end all are the arc, the one end of first connecting strip is articulated mutually with the middle part of the splint that corresponds, the other end of first connecting strip is articulated mutually with the connecting block, the connecting block removes and can drive splint along the slide rail through first connecting strip and remove. The clamp for assembling the motor assembly has the advantages of being capable of clamping a plurality of parts of the motor assembly and reducing cost.

title_en: Attaching mechanism for enameled wire production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an attaching mechanism for enameled wire production, and relates to the field of enameled wire production equipment. The paper feeding device comprises a paper feeding support, a paper feeding mechanical arm and a paper feeding sucker, and is used for transferring and attaching the paper to enamelled wire on the side face of the wire coil, and the paper is wound along with the rotation of the wire coil to finish attaching. The automatic attaching device for the enameled wire paper-sticking realizes automatic attaching of the enameled wire paper-sticking, reduces labor intensity, improves production efficiency, ensures paper-sticking quality, has a concise structure and strong suitability, and is suitable for an automatic paper-sticking attaching scene of enameled wire production.

title_en: Storage barrel
abstract_en: The application discloses a storage barrel which is characterized by comprising a counterweight base and a barrel body arranged on the counterweight base, wherein the barrel body is of a conical structure and comprises a barrel body and an inlet arranged on the barrel body, the inlet is positioned at the position where the cross section of the barrel body is maximum, the conical tip of the barrel body is detachably connected with the edge of the counterweight base, when the counterweight base is horizontally placed, the barrel body is obliquely placed on the counterweight base, and the included angle between the central axis of the barrel body and the plane of the counterweight base is smaller than 90 degrees. The storage barrel is obliquely supported by the base, and the opening of the barrel body faces towards a human body, so that the storage barrel is more in accordance with human engineering, and is convenient for operations such as garbage throwing or clothes storage.

title_en: Elevator calling box convenient to disassemble, assemble and maintain
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of elevator outbound boxes, and discloses an elevator outbound box convenient to disassemble and maintain, which comprises a bottom box fixed on a wall surface and a panel covered on an opening of the bottom box, wherein a first connecting structure and a second connecting structure are respectively arranged on two opposite sides of the opening of the bottom box, a third connecting structure matched with the first connecting structure and a fourth connecting structure matched with the second connecting structure are correspondingly arranged on the inner side of the panel, the panel is matched with the first connecting structure in a clamping way through the third connecting structure, and the fourth connecting structure is matched with the second connecting structure in a sliding guide way, so that the elevator outbound box is detachably arranged at the opening of the bottom box. The utility model realizes the rapid and nondestructive disassembly and assembly of the panel by the connection mode of combining the clamping connection and the sliding guide. The whole process does not need to use any tool, so that the elevator is greatly convenient for daily maintenance work, the working efficiency is improved, and meanwhile, the damage to parts caused by frequent disassembly and assembly is avoided.

title_en: Coreless rolls of a tissue paper product and methods of manufacturing coreless rolls
abstract_en: This disclosure relates to a coreless roll of a tissue paper product, such as toilet paper, made of a spirally wound continuous web of tissue paper product having a first end and a second end and having an outer diameter in the range of 95 to 150 mm. The web of tissue paper product is wound such as to define an axially extending inner hole centrally positioned relative to the coreless roll and such that the first end is located on the outer side of the coreless roll and the second end is located at the inner hole. A diameter of the inner hole is in the range of 20 to 50 mm. A density of the coreless roll is in a range of 80 to 150 kg/m<sup>3</sup>. A caliper ratio of the roll is in a range of 10% to 80%. The tissue paper product comprises between two and four plies, wherein the plies are ply-bonded. At least one ply is made of Conventional Wet Press paper (CWP), and at least one ply is a structured ply. The grammage of the tissue paper product is in a range of 24 g/m<sup>2</sup> to 125 g/m<sup>2</sup>.

title_en: Automatic adapter spotting for automotive lift
abstract_en: An apparatus for operating a vehicle lift (100) comprises at least one lifting assembly (110), a control unit, and a control pendant (150). The control pendant is configured to remotely control the motion of the vehicle lift through the control unit and to permit the lifting of a vehicle by the push of a single button on the control pendant and/or positioning of lift features in preparation for lifting a particular vehicle by the push of a single button. A menu screen (164) and a plurality of menu buttons may be used together by a user to select one vehicle profile from a plurality of vehicle profiles. The selected vehicle profile may correspond to the vehicle being lifted and provides specific data with respect to how the at least one lifting assembly and/or the lift features should be moved for the particular vehicle being lifted.

title_en: Container with scalable features
abstract_en: A container for containing a fluid. The container includes a sidewall construct that includes an inner sidewall extending at least partially around an interior of the container and having an inner lower edge, and an outer sleeve attached to the inner sidewall, the outer sleeve has an outer lower edge that is spaced below the inner lower edge. The container also includes a closed bottom defining a bottom of the interior of the container.

title_en: Apparatus, system, and method of using depth assessment for autonomous robot navigation
abstract_en: An apparatus, system and method of operating an autonomous mobile robot having a height of at least one meter.
