The robot body; at least two three-dimensional depth camera sensors affixed to the robot body proximate to the height, wherein the sensors are directed toward a floor surface and, in combination, comprise a substantially 360 degree field of view of the floor surface around the robot body; and a processing system for receiving pixel data within the field of view of the sensors; obtaining missing or erroneous pixels from the pixel data; comparing the missing or erroneous pixels to a template, wherein the template comprises at least an indication of ones of the missing or erroneous pixels indicative of the robot body and a shadow of the robot body; and outputting an indication of obstacles in or near the field of view based on the comparing.

title_en: Adjustable shaping shoulder
abstract_en: The invention relates to a shaping shoulder for shaping a planar packaging material web into a tubular bag having a fin seam, which shaping shoulder has a movable adjustment element (4) at least at one point in a region which is passed over during the shaping of an edge (8) of the packaging material web, which movable adjustable element acts on the web edge (8) from the side, the adjustment of said movable adjustable element changing the running direction of the packaging material web.

title_en: Lid with a secure opening
abstract_en: The invention relates to a lid (1) with a secure opening for a container (2), comprising: - a first part (10) designed to be secured to said container, defining an outlet orifice of the container, - a second part (11) mounted on the first part (10) so as to be pivotable about a longitudinal axis (X) of the lid, comprising a fastening ring (110) and a cap (111) secured to the fastening ring by a hinge (114), the first part (10) comprising a rib (100) defining a groove (101) extending over part of the circumference of the first part, and a slot (102) extending from the groove towards the outlet orifice, the cap comprising a lug (112) configured to slide in the groove (101) and in the slot (102), the slot (102) being configured in such a way that the second part (11) of the lid can be manipulated with respect to the first part (10) between: - a closed position in which the lug (112) is retained in the groove (101), the cap (111) closing off the outlet orifice, - an unlocking start position in which the lug (112) is positioned in the groove (101) facing the oblique slot (102), - an unlocking end position in which the lug (112) is positioned facing the slot (102) away from the groove (101), said opening end position being angularly offset in relation to the unlocking start position, and - an open position in which the cap (111) frees the outlet orifice, the lug (112) and the rib (100) having respective shapes designed to allow closure of the lid by latching the lug (112) in the groove (101) in any position other than the unlocking start position.

title_en: Vial closure assembly
abstract_en: A vial closure assembly (10) for sealing a container (12) includes a ring (28), a cap (32), a shell (70), and an optional cover (30). The ring has a first top wall (34) defining a first central through-opening (29) and a skirt (36) extending downwardly from the first top wall that includes a plurality of locking tabs. The cover includes a second top wall (54) defining a second central through-opening (58), a sidewall (56) extending downwardly from the second top wall, and an interior cavity (57) defined by the second top wall and the sidewall. The cap includes a plurality of tabs (66) configured to engage the first or second top wall. The shell includes a barrel-shaped body (71) having an inwardly radially extending upper (72) and lower lip (74), such that the shell is configured to captivate the cover or ring. The upper lip includes at least one rail (76) for sliding contact with a top surface of either the first or second top wall.

title_en: Blank for forming a package and a package
abstract_en: A blank for forming a package comprising a set of side wail panels (101, 102, 103, 104) and a set of top panels (201, 202, 203, 204), wherein a second and a fourth side wall panel (102, 104) each comprises a cut-out (214) configured to form a handle in the side wall panel (102, 104), wherein a respective second and fourth top panels (202, 204) each comprises a cut-out (212), wherein when the blank (100) is erected into a package (200), the second and fourth top panels (202, 204) are folded relative to the second and fourth side wall panels (102, 104) such that the cut-out (214) of the respective side wall panel (102, 104) and the cut-out (212) of the associated top panel (202, 204) overlap and together form a handle, wherein a third top panel (203) is configured to be folded such that it at least partly overlaps a first top panel (201), and wherein the third top panel (203) comprises two locking flaps (216), each locking flap (216) being configured to be folded into the cut-outs (214, 212) forming handles, and thereby putting the package (200) in a closed state.

title_en: Transport device for timed transport of packaging items for use in filling systems
abstract_en: The invention relates to a transport device (2) for the timed transport of packaging items (4), more particularly cartons, bottles or cans, for use in filling systems for filling the packaging items (4) with flowable or pourable substances, comprising at least one guide rail (6), on which the packaging items (4) rest at least in some regions and along which the packaging items (4) can be displaced, and a transport rod (8) which extends parallel to the guide rail (6) and can be pivoted about the longitudinal axis thereof and can be displaced back and forth along the guide rail (6), wherein the transport rod (8) has at least one transport element (10) for displacing the packaging items (4) along the guide rail (6), which element can be brought into contact and out of contact with at least one of the packaging items (4) by the pivoting of the transport rod (8).

title_en: Multi-purpose rail for decontaminating objects
abstract_en: The invention relates in particular to a modular apparatus for treating objects, comprising a guide apparatus (1) in which the objects are in motion, the guide apparatus being capable of being combined with an apparatus (2) for treating the moving objects on at least one portion of the guide apparatus (1). The guide apparatus (1) comprises a tunnel (13) defining a closed chamber around the guide rails (10-12) between which the objects move between the inlet (14) and the outlet (15) of the apparatus, the tunnel (13) comprising a tunnel wall having a tunnel opening (16) suitable for providing a passage for the treatment performed by the treatment apparatus (2) when it is combined with the guide apparatus, and the tunnel is provided with at at least one functional tool which uses a mode for operating the guide apparatus and the treatment apparatus when the guide apparatus is combined with the treatment apparatus.

title_en: Automated storage device for storing laboratory objects
abstract_en: An automated device for storing a plurality of laboratory objects (20) comprises an access robot (30) for accessing the objects in storage locations (20) of a storage chamber (12). The access robot (30) has a carriage (32) that can be displaced horizontally and/or vertically in storage chamber (10). An object carrier (42) for accessing the storage locations (20) is arranged in the carriage. A camera (52) is located in the carriage (32) for viewing the storage locations (20) and the object carrier (42). The camera (52) pivots with the object carrier (42) and can be used to monitor the device and/or to adjust offsets stored in the control unit (66) of the device.

title_en: Systems and processes for coffee distribution including coffee supply containers
abstract_en:
The present invention relates to systems and processes for distributing coffee to a plurality of consumption locations (A) where the supply of roast and ground coffee beans to beverage preparation apparatus, including espresso coffee and similar, is required. In particular, the systems include reusable supply containers (3) for collecting a quantity of coffee beans or substance derived therefrom, and adapted so that can be remotely operated in discharge relative to beverage preparation apparatus. 
     The supply containers (3) can be associated with respective displacement means (30) so that can be moved off-board from a transport vehicle (1), and vice versa, as well as can be moved into a discharge operative position (I) that can be connected to discharge means (7), and vice versa.

title_en: Walking assistant device deformable based on thigh shape
abstract_en: A walking assistance device deformable based on a thigh shape includes a hip joint actuator, an upper thigh frame connected to the hip joint actuator and configured to receive power from the hip joint actuator and rotate about a first axis and rotate about a second axis intersecting the first axis, a motion frame connected to the upper thigh frame, the motion frame including a plurality of segment frames configured to rotate relative to each other, and a lower thigh frame connected to the motion frame.

title_en: Container management system
abstract_en: A container management system (10) comprises a lid assembly (17) configured to engage/disengage a collar (12) of a container (11) to close and open an aperture (13) thereof, wherein the lid assembly (17) comprises: an interior lid compartment (31) in communication with an interior portion of the container (11) when the lid assembly (17) engages the collar (12), a reactive substance (35) configured to undergo a physical change in response to a change of an environment condition at the aperture (13) when the lid assembly (17) engages the collar (12). The physical change of the reactive substance (35) turns the lid assembly (17) from a first operative condition wherein the lid assembly (17) can be disengaged from the collar (12) to open the aperture (13) to a second operative condition wherein a portion of the lid assembly (17) cannot be disengaged from the collar (12) and closes the aperture (13).

title_en: Non-plc-based conveyor controller
abstract_en: Disclosed is a non-PLC-based conveyor controller that controls object transport on a conveyor through communication between controllers with embedded software includes a first controller-connector that performs transmission/reception of data and operation signals with a left non-PLC-based conveyor controller, a second controller-connector that performs transmission/reception of data and operation signals with a right non-PLC-based conveyor controller, an input section through which an object detection signal from a sensor for an object transported on the conveyor is input, an output section that outputs a motor driving signal for operating the conveyor, and a control section that when the object detection signal is input, transmits an entry prohibition signal to the right controller through the first controller-connector, transmits a progress signal to the right controller through the second controller-connector, and outputs the motor driving signal through the output section so that the object is transported to the conveyor controlled by the right controller.

title_en: System and method for dynamic nest and routing adjustment
abstract_en: A system and method for dynamic nest and routing adjustment in an automation system. The method includes: operating the automation system; receiving operational data related to the automation system from a conveyor system and at least one automation station; analyzing the operational data to determine if adjustment of nest offsets or routing of parts is required; determining an adjusted nest offset or part routing; implementing the adjusted nest offset or part routing; and return to operating the automation system. The system includes: a controller to operate the automation system; an input for receiving the operational data; a machine learning (ML) module to analyze the operational data to determine if adjustment of nest offsets or routing of parts is required; a processor to determine an adjusted nest offset or part routing; and a configuration module to implement the adjusted nest offset or part routing.

title_en: Receptacle accessory for fitting on a package of consumer goods
abstract_en: A receptacle accessory for fitting on a package for consumer goods, the package having a body portion and a lid portion hingedly attached to the body portion, wherein the receptacle accessory comprises a cap portion configured to receive and releasably retain the lid portion of the package by an interference fit, the cap portion comprising a front wall, a rear wall and a lateral top wall connecting the front wall and the rear wall, and wherein the receptacle accessory further comprises a compartment configured to receive and retain used consumer goods, the compartment being disposed on a face of the front wall facing away from the rear wall.

title_en: Systems and methods relating to medical applications of inverse thermosensitive polymer foam formulations
abstract_en: Disclosed herein is a pressurized therapeutic composition configured to be stored in a valved container designed to maintain an inverse thermosensitive polymer foam composition under pressure and dispense the composition upon opening the valve thereof. After the composition is dispensed from the container the evaporation of an expanding component (e.g., compressed gas or volatile liquid) can cause the inverse thermosensitive polymer solution to foam. The reduced pressure produced from dispensing the inverse thermosensitive polymer solution can reduce its temperature so as to facilitate distribution in a more liquid foam form. The inverse thermosensitive polymer solution can undergo a reverse phase change from a liquid to a gel upon warming (e.g., once dispensed onto or into a body part).

title_en: Bracket, assembly and method for inserting a conduit into a reservoir
abstract_en:
The invention is concerned with a bracket (100) for being positioned in a manhole (320) of a cover plate (310) of a reservoir. The bracket comprises a U-shaped part with a first leg (110), a second leg (120) and a connecting piece (130); the distance between the first and second legs is at least equal to the thickness of the cover plate. The first leg comprises a first fastening means (111) for a line, which lies in the plane of the first leg. The second leg comprises a second fastening means (121) for a line, which lies in a plane which makes an angle in relation to the plane of the first leg. 
     The invention is furthermore concerned with a method for positioning a line in a reservoir by means of the bracket (100). The bracket is positioned on the cover plate (310); the line is fastened in the first and second fastening means.

title_en: Magnetic field-based fresh-keeping storage container and refrigerator
abstract_en: A magnetic field-based fresh-keeping storage container (200) and a refrigerator (10). The magnetic field-based fresh-keeping storage container (200) comprises: a storage assembly (210), in which a storage space for placing a storage subject is defined; a magnet assembly (220) comprising a first magnet component (221) and a second magnet component (222) respectively disposed on a group of opposite sides of the storage assembly (210), and forming a magnetic field in the storage space using the first magnet component (221) and the second magnet component (222); and a magnetically conductive assembly (230) having a first magnetically conductive member (231) corresponding to the first magnet component (221), a second magnetically conductive member (232) corresponding to the second magnet component (222), and a magnetically conductive connection member (233) connected between the first magnetically conductive member (231) and the second magnetically conductive member (232), the first magnetically conductive member (231), the second magnetically conductive member (232), and the magnetically conductive connection member (233) forming an annular magnetically conductive path outside the storage space. A uniform magnetic field having strength that satisfies the requirement for improving storage quality is formed in the storage space. The container has a compact structure and is easy to mount, and the use requirements for a smart refrigerator are met.

title_en: Pallet pack, packing system, and packing method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a pallet pack (1), to a packing system (50), and to a packing method (100) for palletized goods (60). A pallet belt (2) is provided, by means of which the entire periphery of the palletized goods (60) can be surrounded, and a closure assembly (3) is provided for closing the pallet belt (2) surrounding the entire periphery of the palletized goods (60) by releasably connecting two end sections (4a, 4b) at opposite ends (2a, 2b) of the pallet belt (2). According to the invention, the closure assembly (3) has a hook-and-loop fastener.

title_en: Double-layer kiln with double-track external circulation line
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a double-layer kiln with a double-track external circulation line. by providing an inner track line and an outer track line cooperating with a lower kiln body and an upper kiln body to cyclically convey a sagger carrying a blank material to be sintered, the sagger and the blank material are moved and transported to a charging port of the kiln for loading, without manually moving and transporting the sagger and the blank material for loading, which can reduce manual labor intensity and improve loading efficiency and working efficiency of the kiln. The sagger is able to be exchanged and transported between the inner track line and the outer track line via a reversing mechanism, and when a time required for sintering the kiln is short and a loading frequency is fast, the lower kiln body and the upper kiln body are loaded and unloaded respectively via the inner track line and the outer track line so as to meet requirements for loading and unloading the kiln. However, when the blank material is sintered for a long time and the loading frequency is slow, a main conveying line of the inner track line is able to be stopped, and only a main conveying line of the outer track line cooperates with other conveying lines to load and unload two kilns, so that the purpose of energy saving can be achieved.

title_en: Retort sterilization film laminate and packaging material comprising same
abstract_en: A retort sterilization film laminate according to an embodiment of the present invention includes a first OPP film formed of oriented polypropylene (OPP), a first CPP film formed of cast polypropylene (CPP) and laminated on one surface of the first OPP film, a second OPP film formed of oriented polypropylene and laminated on one surface of the first CPP film, and a second CPP film formed of cast polypropylene and laminated on one surface of the second OPP film.

title_en: Robot controller and method for comparing control software before and after update
abstract_en: The robot controller includes a communicator, a storage, and a processor. An input signal is input to the communicator. The storage stores the control software. The processor creates the command signal including the command value for operating the robot based on the input signal and the control software. The processor reads out the past input signal and the past command signal from the storage or from external source. After updating the control software, the processor creates a confirmation command signal based on the past input signal and the control software. The processor compares the past command signal with the confirmation command signal and outputs the comparison result.

title_en: Moulded pulp lid
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a removable lid (100) for closing in an attachment direction (190) an opening (211) of a receptacle (210) for holding food products (220), whereby the receptacle (210) has a circumferential rim portion (212) surrounding the opening (211). The lid (100) is composed of two or more individual lid parts (101, 102) that are respectively integrally made by moulding pulp and that complement each other to form the lid (100). The lid (100) comprises a cover portion (110) for covering the receptacle opening (211), a skirt portion (120) that extends from the cover portion (110) to circumferentially delimit together with the cover portion (110) a receiving space (105) for receiving the rim portion (212) inside the lid (100) when closing the opening (211) with the lid (100), and a fastening structure (140) for providing a form- and/or force-closed connection. The fastening structure (140) protrudes laterally from a lateral inner side (121) of the skirt portion (120) towards and into the receiving space (105) in a direction transversely to the attachment direction (190). Therein, at least two of the lid parts (101, 102) comprise each at least a section of the fastening structure (140). The invention relates further to as system (200) for storing food products (220), comprising said removable lid (100) and a receptacle (210) for food products.

title_en: System for automatic loading of postal items into a rack unit of a delivery vehicle and corresponding method
abstract_en: The invention refers to a system for automatic loading of postal items into a rack unit of a delivery vehicle, comprising a sorting conveyor configured for providing a plurality of postal items, e.g. parcels and/or packages, intended for a delivery run of a delivery vehicle; at least one delivery conveyor for delivering the postal items from the sorting conveyor to a handling area of a rack unit configured to be accommodated in a loading space of a delivery vehicle; at least one automatic loading unit configured to load postal items from the handling area into rack unit compartments of the rack unit. The invention further refers to a corresponding method for automatic loading of postal items into a rack unit of a delivery vehicle.

title_en: Ferromagnetic lyobead handling
abstract_en: An automated handling system for ferromagnetic lyobeads can include a plurality of quills that have tips to at least partially receive the ferromagnetic lyobeads. At least one of the quills can include a controllable magnet that can be controlled to vary a magnetic force at the tip of the quill in order to controllably retain or release one of the ferromagnetic lyobeads from the tip.

title_en: Modular container and system including same
abstract_en: A modular container is disclosed. The modular container includes a housing defining an internal cavity configured to contain a contents, a port configured to selectively allow the contents to enter and exit the internal cavity, and a vent configured to allow particles of a predetermined size to enter and exit the internal cavity when the modular container is oriented in a first position. The valve is further configured to prevent the contents from exiting the internal cavity when the modular container is oriented in a second position. The modular container also includes a mechanical interlock system which includes a first interlock element and a second interlock element, wherein the first interlock element is configured to mechanically engage with a corresponding second interlock element of a separate modular component, and wherein the second interlock element is configured to mechanically engage with a corresponding first interlock element of a separate system component.

title_en: Call-source-dependent control of an elevator display device
abstract_en: The invention relates to an elevator system (1) having an elevator controller (13) which is connected to a communication interface device (30) and to a communication network (22). Elevator display devices are connected to the communication network (22) and are assigned, on floors (L1, Ln), to an elevator car (10). Via the communication network (22), the elevator controller receives an elevator call coming from an elevator operating device (5) on a call input floor (L1, Ln), said elevator operating device (5) constituting a first call source. Via the communication interface device (30), the elevator controller (13) receives an elevator call coming from a mobile communication device (4) on a call input floor (L1, Ln), said mobile communication device (4) constituting a second call source. The elevator controller (13) generates a control signal for the elevator display device (3) which is assigned, on the call input floor (L1, Ln), to the elevator car (10) answering the elevator call. The control signal indicates whether the elevator call comes from the first or the second call source. Upon receipt of the control signal, the elevator display device (3) communicates an indicator (4a, 6a) which is perceptible on the call input floor (L1, Ln) and which indicates the first or the second call source.

title_en: Capsule
abstract_en: The deep-drawn aluminum cup (2) according to the present invention is provided on one side with a bottom (3) with an outlet opening (31) defined by a nozzle (32), and on the opposite side an inlet opening (21) defined by a rim (4) protruding externally. The bottom (3) is a wall (8) with inner reliefs (310', 320, 340, 360) and outer reliefs (911, 930, 950), wherein the inner reliefs define the outer recesses (910, 941, 960), and the outer reliefs define the inner recesses (311, 330, 350). Furthermore, the bottom (3) comprises a plurality of radial outer reliefs (930), arranged uniformly around the nozzle (32), and each radial outer relief (930) defines a corresponding radial inner channel (330). Innovatively, such deep-drawn cup makes it possible to produce a capsule that is provided with the necessary functional means for the correct delivery of the beverage, without the need for an internal insert.

title_en: Container aligning device (Machine-translation by Google Translate, not legally binding)
abstract_en: Device for aligning containers characterized in that it comprises - a first conveyor belt (1) that rotates at a first speed; - a second conveyor belt (2) aligned with the first conveyor belt (1) that rotates at a second speed greater than the first speed, such that said second conveyor belt (2) is configured to extract the packages from the first conveyor belt (1) and align said containers in rows; - a third conveyor belt (3) that is not aligned with the second conveyor belt (2) and rotates at a third speed greater than the second speed, the third conveyor belt (3) being configured to remove the aligned containers from the second belt conveyor (2); and - a plurality of parallel straight rods (4) located longitudinally to the direction of advance of the containers, on the second conveyor belt (2) and at least a part of the first conveyor belt (1). title_en: Packaging removal apparatus
abstract_en: A blade 50 and an apertured surface 61 can remove an item from a bag. The blade can cut the bag and the item can be pushed through the aperture which is too small for the bag leaving the bag behind. The bag can be held by a gripper on a robotic arm 40 and the bag can be pushed by a rod, both controlled by a computer. The item may be inserted into the aperture before or after the bag is cut. There can be input and output conveyors 10, 80. A sensor can visually monitor the bag to detect position and automatically reject leaking containers prior to opening. The cut can be closer to the bags end than double its diameter. Ideally the surface is planar. The object can be a 5-60mm diameter circular cylindrical vial and the hole can be a circle 1.17-4.85 times wider. The bag can be 50-535mm wide with a flextural modulus of 0.2-3.5GPa and a coefficient of friction between 0.1 and 1.

title_en: A Material Handling Machine
abstract_en: A compact telehandler 10 comprises telescopic lifting arm 14 mounted on the lifting arm side of the fore and aft centreline (30 figure 1) of the telehandler 10 within a lifting arm housing comprising sidewalls and a base wall 24_1 to 24_3 and a cab 13 mounted on the cab side of the body adjacent to the lifting arm housing, the cab 13 having an internal width of at least 700mm and the telehandler having a weight of less than 2950kg. A prime mover or engine 20 may be located on the lifting arm side of the telehandler 10 opposite the cab 13 and extending through an aperture 24_1a in a side wall 24_1 of the lifting arm housing and under the lifting arm 14. The aperture 24_1a may have a lobed profile with part of the prime mover received in the lobes (24_11 to 24_14 figure 5).

title_en: Conveyor providing an electrical continuity clip
abstract_en: A continuity clip 10 for a conveyor (Fig 5) is provided to reduce static accumulation associated with movement of conveyor components. Clip 1, made from a conductive material such as steel comprises has at least one first tooth / teeth (20, Fig 2) to penetrate a support stand 12, and second tooth /teeth (22) to penetrate frame (26, Fig 4). Opening 24 at least partially surrounds a portion of a bolt (52, Fig 9) that extends through stand 12 and frame (26) openings. At least part of clip 1 has an alignment formation (18) positioned within, and a flange (16) overlying support stand 12 opening and from which teeth (20, 22), which extend between 0.1-4mm, project at an angle of 5 to 90 degrees. Static accumulation generated in the conveyor frame is dissipated via clip 10 to support stand 12 and onwards to be ‘earthed’ An associated conveyor, support stand and method of clip formation are also disclosed. title_en: Container content take-out method and container content take-out device
abstract_en: To prevent liquid dropping from a nozzle when allowing a liquid which is a content to flow out from the nozzle of a container or stopping the outflow of the liquid, by reversing the container between a standing posture and an inverted posture.SOLUTION: When reversing a container 100 kept in a standing posture to an inverted posture, and when reversing the container 100 from the inverted posture to the standing posture, by utilizing the recovery of a trunk wall 110 which has been deformed in a concave shape in advance, the outside air is sucked in the container 100 from a nozzle 120. Thereby, liquid dropping from the nozzle 120 is prevented.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 9

title_en: Printer
abstract_en: To provide a printer in which an optical sensor can be prevented from occurrence of malfunction.SOLUTION: A printer, which cuts a recording paper by a first blade and a second blade, has a drive mechanism for moving the first blade. The drive mechanism comprises: a gear; a projection member which projects from a first face of the gear; a coating member which covers at least a part of the projection member; and an optical sensor which is provided on the coating member, and has a light emission part which emits light in a direction crossing the projection member, and a light reception part which receives the light. The coating member is provided with a passage route having such a width that the projection member can pass, and the width of the passage route is a distance between the light emission part and the light reception part or less.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Control device of robot, control method of the robot, and program
abstract_en: To provide a technique which can suppress careless interference between a robot and an operator when the robot of a robot device and the operator cooperate.SOLUTION: A control device of a robot which cooperates with an operator includes: a radar transmitting/receiving part which transmits a radar wave to a cooperation area as an area in which the operator and the robot cooperate, and receives a reflection wave generated when the radar wave reflects on an object in the cooperation area; a radar data processing part which operates reflection power of the object existing in the cooperation area on the basis of the reflection wave received by the radar transmitting/receiving part; and a control part which executes interference suppression processing as processing for suppressing interference between the robot and the operator when the object having the reflection power operated by the radar data processing part being a predetermined threshold or more, exists in the cooperation area.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Plug
abstract_en: To provide a plug in which a flow rate can be easily adjusted, and which can discharge even a liquid of high viscosity in a short period of time.SOLUTION: A plug 10 which allows a liquid packaging container 1 to be opened/closed comprises: a spouting tube part 22 which is connected to the liquid packaging container 1; a spout 24 which is provided at a tip of the spouting tube part 22 to pour out content fluid of the liquid packaging container 1; and a plunger 31 which controls an opening of the spout 24 by advancing and retreating between a closing position and an opening position of the spout 24. An outline of a graphic form ABCD formed by projecting the spout 24 with respect to a virtual plane ZX including a center axis O of the plunger 31 is not formed in a circular shape, and includes at least four vertices where the curvature takes the maximum value. A first vertex A and a second vertex B among the vertices are aligned along a direction Z in which the plunger 31 moves back and forth. A fourth vertex D and a third vertex C among the vertices are positioned opposite to the first vertex A and the second vertex B in a manner where the center axis O is interposed, and aligned along the direction Z in which the plunger 31 moves back and forth.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: Image reading device and medium inclination calculation method for use in image reading device
abstract_en: To provide an image reading device and a medium inclination calculation method for use an image reading device, with which it is possible to suppress a decrease in accuracy of medium inclination calculation with respect to a conveyance path.SOLUTION: An image reading device 10 comprises: a plurality of electrodes 41 contacting a medium M under conveyance; charge detection circuits 42 respectively corresponding to the electrodes 41; a reading part 12; and a control part 60. The control part 60 carries out inclination estimation processing for calculating an inclination of the medium M with respect to a conveyance path 100 as an inclination estimation value on the basis of a signal from each charge detection circuit 42, inclination detection processing for deriving the inclination of the medium M with respect to the conveyance path 100 as an inclination detection value on the basis of a result of reading by the reading part 12, and correction value derivation processing for storing a correction value based on a difference between the inclination detection value and the inclination estimation value in a storage part 61. If a correction value is stored in the storage part 61, the inclination estimation processing is carried out so that an inclination estimation value is calculated with consideration given to the correction value.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Conveyor belt with cleat
abstract_en: To provide a conveyor belt with a cleat for handling a product that makes it easy to fold the body part that defines the loading surface of the conveyor belt.SOLUTION: A conveyor belt 50 includes: a body part 52 that has a loading surface 106; and a cleat 108 that extends in the traverse direction against the advancing direction of the belt from the loading surface of the body part of the belt. The cleat has segments 112, 114 that are separated by the slots extending at the acute angle against the surface thereof, making it easy to fold the body part around the horizontal axis against the advancing direction of the belt. Each slot extends from the distal end of the cleat to the slot expansion part with an U-shaped slot formed close to the loading surface. The pair of slot expansion parts form a neck 122 that causes the cleat segments to easily twist at the proximal ends of the respective cleat segments defined by the pair of the slots.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 16

title_en: Retention mechanism, transfer device, handling robot system, and unloading device
abstract_en: To provide a retention mechanism, a transfer device, a handling robot system, and an unloading device that are capable of easily holding an article.SOLUTION: A retention mechanism includes: a base having one end, a structure connection mechanism, a drive part, and a regulation member. The structure connection mechanism includes a connection member for connecting at least two or more structures with the structure, and is rotatable in a first rotation direction about a first shaft, whereas partly restricted in rotation in a second rotation direction about the first shaft. The regulation member is provided at a prescribed distance from the one end. The drive part moves the structure connection mechanism in a first direction from the one end toward the regulation member. According to drive of the drive part, a projection part of the structure connection mechanism projecting beyond the one end projects in a second direction substantially orthogonal to the first direction after passing between the one end and the regulation member. The regulation member regulates movement of the projection part in the first direction.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Manipulator system for medical use
abstract_en: To facilitate setting of a servo amplifier connected to a servo motor with a plurality of axes, in a robot system comprising a plurality of robots.SOLUTION: A control device 6 is for a robot system (100) comprising a plurality of robots having servo motors with a plurality of axes. The control device 6 comprises a plurality of servo amplifiers 12 that drive the servo motors with the plurality of axes of the robot respectively and a plurality of controllers 11 having control units 13 for controlling the plurality of servo amplifiers 12. Depending on the robot connected to each of the plurality of controllers 11, each control unit 13 determines a driving speed of the servo motor with a plurality of axes and sets a parameter of the servo amplifier 12 that drives the axes of the servo motor corresponding to the determined driving speed.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Construction machine
abstract_en: To provide a construction machine comprising a revolving structure, and mounting on a travel body, a battery, an engine, and a motor, and capable of securing properly, balance of a load applied to a front axle and a rear axle.SOLUTION: A construction machine comprises: a travel body; a revolving structure; an engine; a motor; and a battery. In the travel body, a front axle and a rear axle are fitted to a chassis frame, the revolving structure is installed on a frame upper surface of the chassis frame so as to revolve freely to the travel body around a revolving shaft as a rotation center. The revolving shaft of the revolving structure is provided between the front axle and the rear axle in a cross direction of the travel machine body, the engine and the motor are arranged on a rear side to the revolving shaft of the revolving structure. The battery is installed on a position which is a front side to the front axle on the frame upper surface of the chassis frame and is separated from the revolving shaft relative to a revolving locus of the revolving structure.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Earthquake sensor
abstract_en: To provide an earthquake sensor capable of determining the influence affected by the intrusion of water into a pit.SOLUTION: An earthquake sensor 10 includes a seismometer 13, a submergence detection unit 16, and a control unit 19. The seismometer 13 is stored in a case 11. The case 11 is mounted on a bottom surface of a pit. The seismometer 13 measures a swing due to an earthquake. The submergence detection unit 16 detects that the submergence water pressure exceeds a first water pressure when the pit is submerged. The submergence water pressure is a water pressure received by the case 11 when the pit is submerged. The first water pressure is a preset value of water pressure. The control unit 19 measures the submergence continuation time in which the submergence water pressure exceeds the first water pressure.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Package
abstract_en: To provide a package having improved convenience.SOLUTION: A package 10 includes: a base material 20; a film 30 for covering a content 100 placed on the base material 20; an easy peel structure 40 for joining the base material 20 to the film 30 so as to seal the content 100; and a vapor permeable part 50 for discharging vapor emitted from the content 100. The vapor permeable part 50 has seal strength which is weaker than seal strength of the easy peel structure 40.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Sheet processing device
abstract_en: To provide a sheet processing device in which alignment property of sheets is improved.SOLUTION: A sheet processing device comprises: a placing part on which sheets are placed; a discharge part for discharging sheets to the placing part; an alignment part for aligning the sheets placed on the placing part; and a control part for controlling the discharge part and the alignment part. The control part can execute interruption alignment processing for aligning the sheets placed on the placing part by the alignment part before discharging the sheets to the placing part by the discharge part after interrupting a job for discharging the sheet to the placing part.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: Water refill control method, water server, and program
abstract_en: To provide water refill control or a water server for refilling water into a tank from a raw water container using a water refill pump, in which the water refill control or water server realizes stabilization of water refill without causing water refill defect.SOLUTION: A method of controlling water refill of a water server for refilling raw water into a cooling water tank (8) from a raw water container (4), comprises the steps of: detecting, by a water level sensor (14), a water level of the cooling water tank; refilling, by a water refill pump (6), the raw water of the raw water container through a water refill pipe; and obtaining, by a control part (16), a detected water level of the water level sensor to determine the water level of the cooling water tank and determine whether the raw water container is set, and operating the water refill pump when the water level keeps under a normal water level for a predetermined time and the raw water container is set.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7

title_en: Multi-chamber container
abstract_en: To surely prevent liquid leakage of a multi-chamber container of the present invention for use for infusion solution and the like when opening a sealing part of an inner container by a pressure from an infusion solution storing part of an outer container.SOLUTION: An infusion solution bag includes an outer bag 10 and an inner bag 12, and the outer bag 10 includes a main cell partitioned by a weak seal. The inner bag 12 includes a releasable outer peripheral seal part along a whole outer periphery. An opposite face of the outer bag 10 and the inner bag 12 is strongly sealed at the main cell along a long part of the outer peripheral seal part on a proximal side, and strongly sealed at the peripheral edge seal 16 of the outer bag 10 along a short side on a proximal side. The opposite face of the outer bag 10 and the inner bag 12 are weakly sealed 50 on a main cell side of a connecting part with the peripheral edge seal 16 of the strong seal. The weak seal 50 mitigates an impact of the heat and pressure when forming the strong seal on the inner bag outer peripheral seal part 38-3a immediately below, and prevents agglutination. On a main cell side, the outer peripheral seal of the inner bag 12 secures an opening property down to a root portion, which can mitigate stress concentration and prevent breakage of the film and liquid leakage.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 18

title_en: Press-fitting device
abstract_en: To flexibly correspond to changes in press-fitting position.SOLUTION: A press-fitting device 1 has: a robot arm 21 capable of arranging a transmission case 90 gripped by a hand 4 at designated coordinates; a servo press machine 7 in which a press-fitting jig 72 to which a bearing 95 is mounted and a backup jig Bk are arranged to face each other on a common center line C7; and a slider 75 which is provided so as to be movable in a center line C7 direction, and in which the transmission case 90 gripped by the hand is positioned on the center line C7 when the slider is engaged with a part on the hand side. In the servo press machine 7, when the part on the hand 4 side engages with the slider 75, the slider 75 moves in the center line C7 direction, and the transmission case 90 gripped by the hand 4 is supported by the backup jig Bk. Subsequently, the press-fitting jig 72 is displaced in the center line C7 direction, and the bearing 95 is press-fitted into the transmission case 90 supported by the backup jig Bk.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: Replacement working method of control panel and base mount
abstract_en: To provide a replacement working method of a control panel capable of replacing an elevator control panel without causing an inconvenience to both workers and users.SOLUTION: A replacement working method of a control panel removes an old control panel 106 installed on a floor 801, and opens a floor opening to guide a cable 804 laid below the floor 801 and connecting the old control panel 106 and a plurality of constituent parts, to the old control panel 106. Next, a base mount 600 comprising a supporting plate 601 the outer edge shape of which has a plate shape larger than a floor opening 803, and an opening 602 for a new control panel that penetrates the supporting plate 601 in the plate thickness direction and that opens smaller than the bottom opening of a new control panel 400 is installed on the floor 801 in the state in which the supporting plate 601 faces the floor opening 803 and then the new control panel 400 is installed on the opening 602 for a new control panel in the base mount 600 installed on the floor 801. A cable 804 is routed from the floor opening 803 to the new control panel 400 via the opening 602 for a new control panel and connected.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 8C

title_en: Empty container supply tool
abstract_en: To provide an empty container supply tool with versatility and a simple structure for supplying empty containers for tangible object filling used in the pre-stage or post-stage of cleaning with a container cleaning device.SOLUTION: An empty container supply tool includes: a container storage part that is formed in a hopper shape with at least four side walls and stores empty containers for tangible object filling supplied from a wide-width opening of an upper end so that they are stacked in a falling state and a vertical direction; a container alignment part that controls the empty containers continuous with this container storage part and gradually displacing from the top to the bottom in the falling sate so as to be in a row; and a container takeout part which has an upper wall having a laterally long opening on a lower side from which the empty containers continuous so as to project forward of the container alignment part in the falling state can be taken out.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Conveying device
abstract_en: To provide a conveying device in which complication of the device configuration is suppressed.SOLUTION: There is provided a conveying device for conveying a belt-like material, in which the conveying device comprises: a plurality of servomotors having an encoder for detecting rotation and outputting a rotation signal indicating the rotation; an active roller which is connected to a portion of the plurality of servomotors and is rotationally driven by the servomotor to execute at least one of unwinding, winding and conveying the material; a driven roller which rotates following a material to be conveyed and is rotatably connected to a portion of the plurality of servomotors; and a servo amplifier which acquires the rotation signal from an encoder possessed by the servomotor connected to the driven roller.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Interior sheet
abstract_en: To facilitate work of installing a cushioning material in a box body in a suspended state.SOLUTION: An interior sheet 5 assembled into an interior body installed in a box body includes: a sheet-like mount 6 in which two surface areas 61, 61 are located adjacent to each other in a lateral direction D2 through a breaking assist part 62 extending in a vertical direction D1 in a plan view; and a sheet-like cushioning material 7 which is overlapped with the mount 6 across the breaking assist part 62. In the mount 6, the surface areas 61, 61 are divided from each other by breaking along the breaking assist part 62. The cushioning material 7 is bonded to bonding areas 63 set in the respective surface areas 61. title_en: Luggage loading device and method
abstract_en: To provide a luggage loading device and a method capable of securing a stable luggage loading rate in a container regardless of the luggage conveyance order.SOLUTION: A luggage loading device 1 has: a second luggage detection unit 29 for detecting dimensions of luggage 3 conveyed by a main conveyor 5; a loading robot 15 for loading, in a conveyance order, the luggage 3 conveyed by the main conveyor 5 into two containers 2; and a loading computation unit 33 and a loading control unit 38 that control the loading robot 15 to load in priority on the basis of the dimensions detected by the second luggage detection unit 29, of the luggage 3, the luggage 3 into the containers 2 different from one another for each dimension.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Assist device
abstract_en: To reduce burden on a waist and knees of an operator, and to reduce the operator's sense of pressure on legs.SOLUTION: An assist device comprises a body part 1 attached to an upper half body of an operator. The assist device comprises a leg support part 3 which is attached to a thigh portion of the operator and is oscillatively connected to a lower part of the body part 1, and supports the upper half body, to which the body part 1 is attached, while oscillating according to a forward-bent posture of the upper half body. The assist device comprises a knee lower support part 21 which is attached to a knee lower portion of the operator and is oscillatively connected to a lower part of the leg support part 3, and supports the thigh portion, to which the leg support part 3 is attached, while oscillating according to a bent posture of a knee of the operator. The leg support part 3 is provided with a first action part 13 which contacts and acts on the thigh portion from the front. The knee lower support part 21 is provided with a second action part 30 which contacts and acts on the knee lower portion from the rear.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Transportation system, processing system, and method of manufacturing goods
abstract_en: To provide a levitation type transport system, a processing system, and a method for manufacturing goods, capable of transporting a plurality of movable elements with higher accuracy.SOLUTION: A transportation system has: movable members capable of moving along a first direction; stators that each have a plurality of coils arranged along the first direction, and each apply a force to the movable member to transport the movable member in the first direction while floating, by the plurality of coils to which electric current is applied, in a second direction intersecting the first direction; and a control unit that controls operation of the movable member by controlling the current applied to the plurality of coils. The control unit controls a levitation posture of the movable member by controlling the current applied to the plurality of coils and using machine difference information of the movable member.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Robot system, robot, and transport device
abstract_en: To improve convenience of change of the layout of a robot.SOLUTION: A robot system 1 includes: a robot 5; a transport device 7 which may be attached to the robot 5 or detached from the robot 5 and is used to transport the robot 5; and monitoring devices 47, 49 which are disposed in the robot 5 and monitor existence or non-existence of an object in a detection area in a periphery of the robot 5. The transport device 7 has a handle part 69 which is erected at the lateral side of the robot 5 when the transport device 7 is attached to the robot 5. The robot 5 has a housing part 109 which houses at least part of the handle part 69 at the inner side of the robot 5 relative to the monitoring device 49 when the transport device 7 is attached to the robot 5.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Laminate, package, food package, and method for producing package
abstract_en: To provide a laminate that can achieve a package having excellent gloss feeling and depth feeling.SOLUTION: A laminate contains a first layer containing polypropylene having smectic crystals, and a second layer containing colorant.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: packaging container
abstract_en: To provide a packaging container which facilitates pour-out of a storage article.SOLUTION: A packaging container includes a container body including a storage part formed by overlapping a first sheet material containing paper and sealing an end edge, and a pour-out auxiliary member formed of a second sheet material containing paper, wherein the pour-out auxiliary member is provided by sandwiching the first sheet material with the second sheet material on one end of the storage part, and an opening is formed by separating the first sheet material and separating and the second sheet material, and a storage article can be poured out.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Attachment for grab dredge, grab bucket for dredge, and dredge method
abstract_en: To provide an attachment for grab dredge, a grab bucket for dredge, and a dredge method allowing surplus water loaded under dredge work to be effectively reduced in a simple configuration.SOLUTION: A dredge method includes a descent process descending a grab bucket 10 for dredge toward a water bottom ground B after attaching on an inner wall 12 of a bucket shell 11 of the grab bucket 10 for dredge a deformable bag portion 2 in which gas G is included, to make the bag portion 2 in a contracted state. An ascent process ascending the grab bucket 10 for dredge thereafter discharges surplus water W in the bucket shell 11 out of the bucket shell 11 by relaxing the contracted state of the bag portion.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Cap unit and container with cap
abstract_en: To provide a cap unit facilitating attachment/detachment of a tea strainer member and capable of improving washability of the tea strainer member.SOLUTION: A cap unit includes a cap body 8 detachably attached to a container body 2, with it fitted inside the container body 2 with an open upper part, water stop packing 20 attached to an outer periphery of a lower end side of the cap body 8 and sealing between an overhang part 7 provided inside the container body 2 and the cap body 8, and a tea strainer member 10 detachably attached to the cap body 8. The tea strainer member 10 is attached with it clamped between the lower end of the cap body 8 and the water stop packing 20.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Take-up type slider
abstract_en: To provide a take-up type slider which is lightweight and easily transportable, greatly improves space-saving property during storage, and enables transfer in multiple directions.SOLUTION: There is provided a take-up slider 10 having a plurality of sliders (dome type) 1a arranged at regular intervals in a transport direction of an article 3, in which bottom portions 2d of the plurality of sliders 1a are joined to a surface 2a of a substantially rectangular sheet 2, and in the shape at the time of deployment, the plurality of sliders 1a are joined to the surface 2a of the sheet 2 adjacent to each other at equal intervals E over an entire length in a direction of a side 2c of the sheet 2, and in a stored shape, the sheet 2 has the plurality of sliders 1a joined to the surface 2a, and is spirally wound around an axis S parallel to the side 2b. The slider 1a has a substantially semi-elliptical shape having a chord 1i in a cross-sectional shape A perpendicular to one side 2b, and since the article 3 and the slider 1a are in sliding motion, the article can be rotated and obliquely transported without any problem.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Dispenser for imparting liquid, especially pharmaceutical liquid, and set including such dispenser
abstract_en: To provide a dispenser set which can detect a liquid amount to be imparted, estimate a liquid residual amount of a liquid reservoir, and inform a user of it.SOLUTION: A dispenser set includes a dispenser having a housing 20 having an applicator opening for applying liquid, a liquid reservoir 30 for storing the liquid prior to the application, and a ventilation duct 40, and, with the ventilation duct, ambient atmosphere is coupled to the liquid reservoir to allow the air to flow in the liquid reservoir after applying the liquid. A detection module 80 composed to detect air flowing through a measurement duct 44 of the dispenser is coupled externally to the housing of the dispenser. The measurement duct has a coupling opening 45 and the coupling opening is coupled to communicate with a guide opening 41 of the ventilation duct of the dispenser when the detection module is coupled to the housing.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4A-4B

title_en: Recording device and recording position deviation suppression method in recording device
abstract_en: To provide a recording device capable of appropriately performing adjustment to reduce deviation in a width direction between a medium and a recording head and a recording position deviation suppression method.SOLUTION: A recording device includes: a cassette or a feed tray on which a medium can be placed; a conveyance unit that conveys the medium placed on the cassette or the feed tray; and a recording head that records on the medium. Further, the recording device includes a medium detection device and a deviation amount acquisition unit. The medium detection device detects at least one side end out of both side ends in a width direction crossing a conveyance direction of the medium conveyed from the cassette or the feed tray (step S12). The deviation amount acquisition unit acquires a deviation amount in the width direction of the medium with respect to the recording head based on at least one side end detection position detected by the medium detection device (step S13).SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 14

title_en: Method for controlling terminal route contour error of robot
abstract_en: To provide a method for controlling a terminal route contour error of a robot.SOLUTION: A method for controlling a terminal route contour error of a robot includes: a step S10 of acquiring an initial signal; a step S20 of inputting the initial signal to an external calculation module, and acquiring a preset trajectory of a terminal actuator; a step S30 of constructing an equivalent prediction model; a step S40 of inputting the preset trajectory to the equivalent prediction model, and acquiring an equivalent prediction trajectory; a step S50 of determining a difference between the preset trajectory and the equivalent prediction trajectory, and acquiring a preset follow-up error trajectory; a step S60 of overlapping the preset trajectory and the preset follow-up error trajectory, and acquiring a first trajectory; and a step S70 of inputting the first trajectory as a start signal to an input end of a servo control unit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: automatic warehouse system
abstract_en: To provide an automatic warehouse system capable of reducing manpower or space for picking.SOLUTION: An automatic warehouse system 100 comprises a storage shelf 22 having a plurality of storage parts 26 for storing a cargo 10, a picking device 18 for moving a first cargo stored in a first storage part 26p to a second storage part 26s in which a second cargo is stored, and a carrying-out device 28 for carrying the first cargo and the second cargo stored in the second storage part 26s together out of the storage shelf 22.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Cap and capped container
abstract_en: To provide a cap and a capped container that prevent content tampering and allow for easy unplugging.SOLUTION: A cap 20 comprises a top portion 21, an inner cylindrical portion 22 that extends from the top portion 21, an outer cylindrical portion 23 that is positioned radially outside of the inner cylindrical portion 22, a band portion 30 that is provided between the inner cylindrical portion 22 and the outer cylindrical portion 23, and a plurality of ribs 40 that mutually couple the inner cylindrical portion 22, the band portion 30 and the outer cylindrical portion 23 together. The band portion 30 has a cut portion 31 made smaller in thickness than its surrounding portion, a protrusion portion 32 projecting radially inward and a deformation portion 33 made smaller in thickness than its surrounding portion. Between the ribs 40, the deformation portion 33, the protrusion portion 32 and the cut portion 31 are arranged in this order along the unplugging direction of the cap 20.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: compact container
abstract_en: To provide a compact container that prevents such a problem as an applicator falling out from a container body, facilitates a user to take out the applicator stored in the container body, and can use a larger size mirror.SOLUTION: A compact container 10 includes: a container body 1A for storing an inner tray 5 storing a content and an applicator 6 for applying the content; a lid body 3 capable of swinging relative to the container body 1A and including a mirror 4 in the inner surface thereof; and an inner lid 7 capable of swinging relative to the container body 1A separately from the lid body 3. The inner lid 7 includes: an inner lid top wall 7a for covering the applicator 6 in a close posture; and a holding part provided in the inner lid top wall 7a to hold the applicator 6.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Package for refilling
abstract_en: To provide a package for refilling that can stably refill contents into a container, without coming-off a pour-out port during the refilling of the contents.SOLUTION: A package 1 for refilling, which refills contents into a container 20 having an opening part 21 in a circular shape whose inner diameter is a (mm), has at a central part of one side a pour-out port 11 for pouring out the contents and has respective dents 12 formed at left and right shoulder parts of the our-out port, where a distance x(mm) between the insides of the left and right two recesses is represented by a relational expression of a≤x≤1.5a and an angle α(°) formed by a straight line passing on the centers of the recesses and a straight line passing on the center of the pour-out port is represented by a relational expression of 0≤α≤60. The left and right two recesses are formed to be bilaterally symmetrical with respect to the straight line passing on the center of the pour-out port.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: robot hand
abstract_en: To easily change a positional relation between a plurality of fluid pressure actuators to improve gripping performance.SOLUTION: A robot hand 10 is provided with: a base actuator 20 in a cylindrical shape configured so that one side of a cylinder periphery is contracted and curved in a cylinder shaft direction by increase of inner pressure in a cylinder; a frame member 60, arranged along the cylinder shaft direction of the base actuator 20 to support the base actuator 20, and having an extending/contracting part 65A that extends and contracts following curve deformation of the base actuator 20; and a plurality of finger actuators 40 in a cylindrical shape, which are separately mounted on the frame member 60 in an extending direction of the base actuator 20 so that one ends thereof are fixed to the frame member and the other ends become free ends, so as to extend in a direction crossing the cylinder shaft, so that one side of the cylinder periphery is contracted and curved in the cylinder shaft direction by increase of inner pressure in the cylinder.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Storage bag with zipper
abstract_en: To provide a storage bag with a zipper which can be used without touching the uneven part of the zipper when taking out a content from the storage bag with zipper .SOLUTION: In a storage bag with a zipper, a pair of zippers each are attached to the inside and the outside of the bag. A skirt part is formed above the zipper attached to the outside of the bag, and a content is prevented from touching the uneven part of the zipper by taking out the content from the skirt part.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Processed water-based sweets package and method for removing partition member from the package
abstract_en: To provide a processed water-based sweets package that allows you to enjoy water-based sweets such as three-dimensional agar, three-dimensional kudzu, mizuyokan, jelly, and nata de coco while enjoying a raw flavor and texture, and a method for taking out a partition member easily from this package.SOLUTION: A processed water-based sweets package A of the present invention includes a partition member 20 that separates processed water-based sweets a, a... housed in a container 10 into three-dimensional shapes, the partition member 20 having partition portions 23 and 23 in which a large number of processed water-based sweets are partitioned into three-dimensional shapes by partition walls 21 and 22, in which an opening 13 of the container 10 is sealed by adhering or welding a peelable film-like lid 30 to an upper surface of a flange portion 11 of the container 10 and an upper surface of a central portion of the partition member 20. A method for taking out the partition member 20 from the package A is such that when the film-like lid 30 is peeled off and separated, the partition member 20, which is integrated with the film-like lid 30 by adhesion or welding, is also removed from the package A at the same time.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Packing gap member, packing body, and member
abstract_en: To provide a packing gap member, a packing body, and a member that are easy to manufacture.SOLUTION: A packing gap member comprises a pair of supports, a first spacing restriction portion, and a tongue. The pair of supports extend at least in a first direction and face each other. The first spacing restriction portion connects the pair of supports at an end of the pair of supports in the first direction and maintains a spacing between the pair of supports. The tongue is connected to an end on the opposite side in the first direction of the support and is located closer to the side of the support opposite the support than the support. At least a portion of the tongue is bendable to face the first direction relative to the support to be connected.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Management Device
abstract_en: To provide a management device that enables a user to intuitively grasp an occurrence state of a communication abnormality in a yarn processing device.SOLUTION: A management device manages a yarn processing device that winds a yarn to produce a package. The management device includes a display part, a display control part, a communication part, and a detection part. The display part displays information related to the yarn processing device. The display control part controls a display content of the display part. The communication part communicates with each of a plurality of units constituting the yarn processing device. The detection part detects a communication abnormality in the unit. The display control part displays on the display part a network configuration diagram using a node representing the plurality of units and a link representing a communication path connecting the units. The display control part displays on the display part the communication abnormality detected by the detection part by being superimposed on a position corresponding to an occurrence location of the communication abnormality in the network configuration diagram.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Fluid Transport Device
abstract_en: To provide a fluid transport device.SOLUTION: A transport device for transporting a fluid material between a first storage tank and a second storage tank is proposed. A transport device (100) comprises a loading device (106) attached to a support structure (101). The loading device (106) comprises multiple loading arm sections (103-105) mechanically connected by pivot joints (113, 116, 118). The transport device further comprises a transport line (122) that connects the first and second storage tanks. The transport line (122) is composed of rigid and flexible transport lines (123-126, 133). The flexible transport line connects rigid transport line sections. At an upstream end, at least one rigid transport line section branches into multiple flexible transport lines which are fluidly merged into the next rigid transport line section in a flow direction.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Shaft coupling device and elevator
abstract_en: To provide a shaft coupling device capable of coupling in the state securing inertial force even if the axial length of one shaft among connected two shafts is less than the axial half-length of an entire shaft coupling device.SOLUTION: A shaft coupling device 1 connects a rotatable rotational shaft 103b and a rotatable driving shaft 104a facing the rotational shaft 103b in the axial direction. This coupling device 1 comprises a first member 2 fixed to the rotational shaft 103b, and a second member 3 fixed to the rotational shaft 103b and to the driving shaft 104a and connected to the first member 2. The axial length of the rotational shaft 103b is different from the axial length of the driving shaft 104a.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: Device and method for controlling robot action, device and method for generating operation program, computer program, and operation program
abstract_en: To solve a conventional problem that the action of a robot with a multi degree of freedom used to be instable owing to significant points and the like.SOLUTION: A device 100 which generates an operation program OP for regulating actions of a robot 12 having a multi degree of freedom comprises: an input receiving part 62, receiving the input for designating one of a first control system for realizing actions with a multi degree of freedom, and a second control system for realizing actions with a degree of freedom one or more less than the first control system; and a program setting part 68 for designating, according to the input which the input receiving part 62 has received, one of the first control system and the second control system for the operation program. The operation program makes the robot 12 execute actions on the first control system or the second control system designated by the program setting part 68.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7

title_en: Robot control system, and robot control program
abstract_en: To directly execute a plurality of kinds of work including gripping a cargo by a gripping part, and reduce a control burden.SOLUTION: A robot system grips a cargo 100 using a gripping part 20 for the main purpose, in the case in which the kind of work for the cargo 100 is not gripping but other kind of work, tools corresponding to various work are gripped by the gripping part 20, the robot system can also face the cargo 100. When continuously performing the same kind of work, a burden of maintenance control (relative position control between gripping part and gripped tool) in the gripping state is large. Thus, in place of the gripping part 20, according to the kind of work for the cargo 100, as shown in Fig. 1 and Fig. 4, the robot system includes a robot tool 21EX (in first embodiment, three kinds of 21EXA, 21EXB and 21EXC), as necessary, the gripping part 20 is replaced with the robot tool 21EX, the robot system is configured to perform work according to the kind of work different from the gripping of the cargo 100.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Blow molded containers and methods of making the same
abstract_en: To provide blow molded containers and methods of making the same.SOLUTION: A container, e.g., bottle, is formed by a blow molding process. The container includes a base and a sidewall extending from the base. The base and the sidewall define an interior configured to house at least one product. At least one of the sidewall and the base has a barrier layer and a desiccant layer attached to the barrier layer. The barrier layer and the desiccant layer are each blow molded together. The barrier layer is located external relative to the desiccant layer and is made of a plastic material. The desiccant layer is made of a monolithic composition comprising a mixture of a base polymer, a desiccant, and a channeling agent.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Operation trajectory generation method and operation trajectory generation device
abstract_en: To provide an operation trajectory generation method capable of inhibiting an increase in load for a user for generating an operation trajectory even when there are three or more access points.SOLUTION: An operation trajectory generation method generates an operation trajectory T of a substrate transporting robot 100 including a robot arm 30 attached with a hand 40 for holding a semiconductor substrate W. The operation trajectory generation method comprises: receiving settings of a disposition region 210 where the robot arm 30 and the semiconductor substrate W are disposed; receiving settings of three or more access points P which the hand 40 accesses in the disposition region 210; and calculating, by simulation, the operation trajectory T that has been optimized on the basis of predetermined conditions including a time required for transporting the semiconductor substrate W for all combinations of the three or more access points P.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Method for manufacturing glass article, glass film, and glass package
abstract_en: To avoid breakage of a glass film when executing a step of applying treatment to a glass film in transit when manufacturing a glass article using a glass film as a component.SOLUTION: A method for manufacturing a glass article includes a treatment process (cleaning process P1) of applying treatment while transporting a rectangular glass film 1. In the treatment process (cleaning process P1), treatment (cleaning) is applied to the glass film 1 while a protective tape 8 is attached along at least two sides 4, 5 extending in a transportation direction of the four sides 2-5 of the glass film 1.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 9

title_en: Sorting System
abstract_en: To provide a sorting system that enables workers to check whether they have accurately picked the specified commodities and to accurately associate the picked commodities with delivery notes for collection.SOLUTION: The sorting system includes: a management computer that creates badge information using the picking and collection of sorting tasks as one unit; a work instruction terminal that presents the work for each badge to workers based on the badge information; a wireless tag with commodity information that is affixed to a commodity; a first reader-writer that writes tag information as commodity-related information into the wireless tag; a collecting shelf that collects commodities with a badge unit; and a worker terminal that has a second reader-writer that reads the tag information from the wireless tag affixed to the picked commodities.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: container
abstract_en: To provide a container that improves cold and heat retention while protecting a connection mechanism and stabilizing a connection state.SOLUTION: A container body 2 includes: a bottom wall constitution part 4 including a bottom wall part 5 having a substantially rectangular shape in a plan view and base parts 6 and 7 projecting upward along a side part of the bottom wall part 5; and side wall parts 8 and 9 connected to the base parts 6 and 7 of the bottom wall constitution part 4 so as to be rotatably displaceable. The side wall parts 8 and 9 and the bottom wall constitution part 4 have internal spaces 12, 32 and 62, respectively, and heat insulating members 10 are provided in the internal spaces 12, 32 and 62. The short side wall part 8 and the short side base part 6 are provided with a side wall side engaging part 104 and a base side engaging part 103 that can be irregularity-engaged with each other in a horizontal direction when the container body 2 is in an assembled state. When the container body 2 is assembled, the side wall side engaging part 104 and the base side engaging part 103 are configured such that the side wall side engaging part 104 and the base side engaging part 103 sandwich between the heat insulating members 10 in a horizontal direction and a vertical direction.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 19

title_en: Packaging bag and sheet package
abstract_en: To provide a packaging bag which is easy to open, and in which a sheet is easy to take out, the sheet to be taken out is hard to break, and the sheet hardly breaks at the time of taking out, even in the case where the packaging bag has hardly any flexibility.SOLUTION: In a packaging bag, a plurality of laminated sheets are stored, and a sheet take-out port is provided at a top surface. The take-out port has: a pair of first perforations extending in a first direction of the packaging bag, and arranged having a predetermined interval in a second direction orthogonal to the first direction; a pair of second perforations continued to end parts of the first perforations and extending in the second direction between the first perforations; and a pair of third perforations which are continued to the end parts of the first perforations and extending in a direction separated from the first perforations, and in which the interval in the second direction becomes larger as it is further separated from the first perforations.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Transport system, management device, and management method of transport system
abstract_en: To smoothly switch self-location estimation modes.SOLUTION: A transport system comprises: a transport device that transports an object to be transported in a travel area; a management device that controls the movement of the transport device; a sensor that senses a surrounding environment and markers installed in the travel area; a drive device that causes the transport device to travel in the travel area; and a control device that estimates a position of the transport device and controls the drive device.
