abstract_en: The invention is a method for calibrating the components of robotic equipment, comprising the following steps: positioning a laser pointer on a robot of the robotic equipment; determining the position of a zero point on said robot at the point where said laser sensor is positioned; positioning the robot in such a way that said pointer can detect a plurality of points on a component whose position and/or shape are/is to be acquired; determining a reference zero point of said component; determining the position of said zero point of the component with respect to said zero point of the robot, wherein said position is calculated by the robot itself. The present patent also concerns the system implementing said method.

title_en: Device for winding a material web
abstract_en: The invention relates to a system (1) for producing a planar material web (2) composed of a fiber-containing material, to a winding device (4), and to a method for the open-loop and/or closed-loop control of the moisture content of the material web (2). The system (1) comprises a continuous belt (3) for supporting and transporting the material web (2) and the winding device (4) for winding the planar material web (2). The winding device (4) comprises a negative-pressure-generating unit (6), a negative-pressure roller (7) and a storage roller (5), the negative-pressure roller (7) comprising a cylindrical shell (9) having through-holes (11), and the through-holes being operatively connected to the negative-pressure-generating unit (6). The negative-pressure roller (7) also comprises a rotary drive (13) at least for rotating the cylindrical shell (9) in a direction of rotation (15). During operation of the system (1), the material web (2) can adhere to the cylindrical shell surface (10) at least along an angle of wrap (16) by means of a negative pressure present at the through-holes (11) and can be pulled off the continuous belt (3) by driving of the negative-pressure roller (7) by means of the rotary drive (13).

title_en: Structural arrangement for a bottle-holder tray
abstract_en: The present utility model relates to a structural arrangement for a bottle-holder tray that aims to overcome the drawbacks described in the prior art by means of a package having detachable side handles and inner tabs for storing and transporting bottles and which can be displayed at the point of sale to improve visual communication and be reused by the final consumer, reducing the need to use plastic bags. This novel bottle-holder tray has a structure that facilitates handling and transport by the consumer due to the presence of side handles. This novel tray takes less time to assemble, has a smaller area resulting in a greater quantity of boxes per pallet, and contains a set of tabs arranged on the edges, which allows greater stability of the bottles inside the box thus avoiding breakages due to rattling.

title_en: Application station and application method
abstract_en: An application station (1) for applying a venting device (50) to a predetermined position of a bag material (101), comprising a feed (2) and a discharge (3) for bag material, wherein a welding device (4) comprising a welding unit (5) and a counterpart (6) is arranged between the feed (2) and the discharge (3), wherein the bag material (101) can be transported between the welding unit (5) and the counterpart (6). This allows a venting device (50) to be fed to the welding device (4). The bag-making apparatus (200) comprises a store (201) with a bag material (101) and also comprises a moulding device (202) with a welding station (203), wherein such an application station (1) is located between the store (2) with bag material (101) and the moulding device. In the method for applying a venting device (50) to a predetermined position of a bag material (101) with such an application station (1) and/or with such a bag-making apparatus (200), a venting device is fed to the welding device (4) and is applied to the bag material by means of the welding device (4).

title_en: Charging apparatus and method for charging a mixing vessel with bulk material
abstract_en: The invention relates to a charging apparatus which is intended for bulk material and has a charging bin (20), which can be pivoted on a mixing vessel (12) between a receiving position and a discharging position for the bulk material, the discharging position opening out into the mixing vessel (12) from above, and also has a scraper bucket (22), which can be moved in the direction of the charging bin (20), preferably by means of a pulling cable (26), thereby receiving bulk material, and in the receiving position can be emptied into the charging bin (20). According to the invention, it is proposed that the charging bin (20) should have a holding mechanism (28) for the scraper bucket (22), wherein the scraper bucket (22), which can be brought into engagement with the holding mechanism (28), is prevented from falling when the charging bin (20) is being pivoted.

title_en: Lined paper-based container
abstract_en: A container including a paper-based cradle, a paper-based insert, and a thermoplastic film. The cradle has exterior corner panels that form a transition between the exterior end panels and exterior side panels. The cradle and insert are held together by the thermoplastic film that is thermoformed into conformance with the cradle and insert. The exterior corner panels at the junctures between the exterior end panels and exterior side panel can reduce the potential for defects in the thermoformed thermoplastic film.

title_en: Method for manufacturing an ecological product from dryly placed fibers
abstract_en: The method for manufacturing a product, the method comprising - providing a stock (110) of a first material (11), the first material (11), in the stock, constituting a sheet material forming a first layer comprising a water- soluble polymer material; - producing a blank structure (10) comprising superimposing the first layer and a third layer and, between the first layer and the third layer, a second layer, the second layer comprising, in particular at at least 50% by weight, more particularly at at least 75% by weight, a fibrous material obtained from dryly placed fibers; - shaping the blank structure (10) in a molding step.

title_en: Converted elevator system for mixed-use building
abstract_en: In a building having an elevator system (1), an additional shaft door (4b) is installed on a lobby floor (S0) in addition to an existing shaft door (4a) on the lobby floor (S0). The existing shaft door (4a) faces an existing elevator lobby (L1), and the additional shaft door (4b) faces a newly created elevator lobby (L2). The elevator system (1) has a car (10) having two car doors (6a, 6b), each one serving one of the two elevator lobbies (L1, L2) on the lobby floor (S0). The elevator system (1) is configured so that a travel path of a counterweight (8) does not overlap with a zone of the additional shaft door (4b). The second shaft door (4b) includes a passage insert (47, 48) that bridges a gap between the second shaft wall (11b) and the second car door (6b), wherein the gap is larger than a thickness of the counterweight (8).

title_en: Attachment for a self-propelled working machine, vehicle recovery system, and method for towing a vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to an attachment (5) for a self-propelled working machine (2), in particular a telescopic loader, the attachment (5) comprising: - a coupling frame (8), wherein the coupling frame (8) is designed for detachable coupling to the interchangeable receptacle (4) of the self-propelled working machine (2); - a holding arm (9) which is arranged on the coupling frame (8); a spectacle lift (10) which is pivotally accommodated on the holding arm (9), wherein the spectacle lift (10) has a first wheel receptacle (12) and a second wheel receptacle (13) for receiving the two front wheels (25) or the two rear wheels (26) of a vehicle (24) to be towed.

title_en: Control method for self-collision avoidance of walking robot having manipulator, and walking robot for performing same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a control method for self-collision avoidance of a walking robot equipped with a manipulator and a walking robot performing the same, the control method including the steps of: modeling a first collision-possible part of a manipulator and a second collision-possible part of a robot body into three-dimensional shapes each having line segments and a circular cross section; calculating the shortest distance between a first line segment with respect to the modeled first collision-possible part and a second line segment with respect to the modeled second collision-possible part; calculating a relative Jacobian between first and second points by applying a Jacobian matrix to the first point of the first line segment and the second point of the second line segment connecting the shortest distance; and calculating a speed for avoiding collision between the manipulator and the robot body by using the size of the three-dimensional shapes, the shortest distance between the first and second line segments, and the relative Jacobian between the first and second points.

title_en: Valve for dispensing a liquid or a pasty product with a large outlet
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a dispensing valve (10), comprising at least one channel (25) connecting an upstream end (11) of the valve to a product outlet opening, consisting of a stem (20); an elastically deformable plug valve (30), consisting of an upright portion (31) surrounding the stem (20); a plug wall (32); an annular connection zone (33), the plug wall (32) being penetrated by the outlet opening (12) formed in a plug zone (322) that can move between a closed position and an open position, characterised in that the upright portion (31) comprises an attachment zone (312) located in its upstream portion and providing the fixed connection with the stem (20), and an annular deformation zone (313) located in its downstream portion connecting the attachment zone (312) with the downstream end (311) of the upright portion (31); the deformation zone (313) being spaced apart from the stem (20) in any plane P2 perpendicular to the flow axis (X); and the annular connection zone (33) is movable in a radial direction oriented toward the stem (20).

title_en: Section for an accumulating roller transporter
abstract_en: The invention relates to a section (2) for an accumulating roller transporter. It comprises a series of rollers (5), a section drive mechanism (17), configured to drive the series of rollers in rotation, and a motive power input (47). The section drive mechanism is switchable between a transport state and a stopping state. In the transport state, the section drive mechanism is coupled to each of the series of rollers, and is coupled to the motive power input to transfer motive power from the motive power input to each of the series of rollers; and in the stopping state, the section drive mechanism is coupled to each of the series of rollers, and is decoupled from the motive power input.

title_en: Packaging film, packaging bag, and packaged product
abstract_en: A packaging film according to the present invention comprises an ink layer, a base material layer, an adhesive layer, and a sealant layer in the stated order. The ink layer is coated with a coating layer, and the coating layer is obtained using a coating layer resin composition containing a polyurethane resin and a curing agent, or a coating layer resin composition containing a polyamide-imide resin. The ink layer is obtained using an ink containing a polyurethane resin.

title_en: Container, container body, discharge cap, and discharge member
abstract_en: The present invention has: a container body that has a mouth part; and a discharge cap that is screwed onto the mouth part and discharges the contents of the container body. At an inner circumferential surface or an upper surface, the mouth part has a body-side engagement part that engages the discharge cap. The discharge cap has: a discharge member in which a discharge opening for discharging the contents is formed and onto which a cap member that closes the discharge opening is screwed; and an attachment member that is rotatably attached to the discharge member so as to cover an outer circumferential surface of the discharge member from the outside and is screwed onto the mouth part. The discharge member has a cap-side engagement part that engages the body-side engagement part and thereby keeps the discharge member from rotating relative to the container body when the discharge cap has been screwed onto the mouth part and thereby attached to the container body.

title_en: Rope guide mechanism and rope hoist
abstract_en: Provided is a rope guide mechanism capable of reducing man-hours during installation, making the dimension around a rope drum smaller, and reducing friction caused by contact with a rope groove. A rope guide mechanism 150 comprises a rope guide set 170 which is in threaded engagement with a rope groove 121 and is provided in an arc shape, and a support member 160 which guides sliding of the rope guide set 170. The rope guide set 170 comprises: at least two guide members 200, 210 which freely move while being in contact with the support member 160; a first guide member 180 which comprises a ridge 182 in threaded engagement with the rope groove 121 and to which one guide member 200 is attached; a second guide member 190 to which the other guide member 210 is attached; and a pressing roller body 220 which comprises a pressing roller 222 for contacting a wire rope W wound around the rope groove 121 and a biasing member 223 for applying a biasing force.

title_en: Keg system
abstract_en: A keg system (10) for dispensing a liquid (12) has an air compressor device (20) with a pump (22) operably controlled by a controller (24) powered by a power source (26), the pump (22) functioning to pump air from an air intake (25) to a port (29) that is connected with a pneumatic hose (28). The air compressor device (20) further has a pressure sensor (23) operably connected with the controller (24) so that the pump (22) is automatically stopped once a sensed pressure reaches a predetermined selected pressure. The keg system (10) further has a keg container (40) having a base (42) and an upwardly extending sidewall (44) that extends upwardly from the base (42) to a top portion (46) to form an interior chamber (48), the interior chamber (48) being adapted to contain the liquid (12). A coupler (50) is mounted the top portion (46) of the keg container (40), and an air inlet port (52) of the coupler (50) is in fluid communication with an air outlet (54), so that when the pneumatic hose (28) is connected with the inlet port (52), air pumped from the air compressor device (20) flows into the keg container (40) for pressurizing the interior chamber (48) of the keg container (40). The system further has a dip tube (64) for dispensing the liquid (12) from the keg container (40).

title_en: Exoskeleton device
abstract_en: An exoskeleton device, comprising: a waist rod module (10), a left leg module (20) and a right leg module (30). The left leg module (20) and the right leg module (30) are separately connected to the waist rod module (10). The left leg module (20) and the right leg module (30) respectively comprise a hip joint driver (1), a thigh module (2), a knee joint driver (3) and a shank module (4) which are sequentially arranged in series, the hip joint drivers (1) being connected to the waist rod module (10). Each shank module (4) comprises a shank link assembly (41) and a shank strap assembly (42). Each shank link assembly (41) comprises a shank lateral swing hinge (411), and each shank strap assembly (42) is connected to a knee joint driver (3) by means of a shank lateral swing hinge (411).

title_en: Garment hanger handling device drive dog
abstract_en: The invention relates to a garment hanger handling device drive dog (13) for transporting a garment hanger (5) comprising a hook structure part (13a) comprising a hook structure (13b), and a closure part (13c) comprising a closing structure (13d) being rotationally attached to the hook structure part (13a). In a closed state, the closing structure (13d) of the closure part (13c) abuts the hook structure (13b) such that the hook structure (13b) and closing structure (13d) create an enclosure, and in an open state, the closure part (13c) has rotated around a rotational axis arranged on the hook structure part (13a) such that the closing structure (13d) moves away from the hook structure (13b), thereby allowing a hanger to enter into or exit from the hook structure (13b). The closure part (13c) of the drive dog (13) is rotationally attached to the hook structure part (13a) and is biased to move the closure part (13c) to the closed state.

title_en: Elevator system
abstract_en: An elevator system having a vertical elevator shaft (7), in which an elevator car (2) can be moved up and down, comprises guide rails (5), which are formed by cross-sectionally T-shaped profiles, for guiding the elevator car (2), wherein a receptacle (30) created by a lug (32) for receiving the rail foot (12) at the edge is provided on one side for fixing the guide rails (5) in the respective mounting bracket (10). On the opposite side, the guide rails (5) are fastened to the mounting bracket (4) by means of a rail clamp (20). Furthermore, rails (6, 6') for guiding counterweights (3, 3') are mounted on the mounting bracket (10). In each case one rail (6), which serves for guiding a respective counterweight (3), is designed as a sheet-metal part and has two spring-forming longitudinal guides (13, 14) arranged in alignment.

title_en: Wet wipe stacking structure, wet wipe packaging pack thereof, individual wet wipe pull-out sheet for wet wipe packaging pack, and dedicated pressing device for wet wipe packaging pack
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a wet wipe stacking structure, a wet wipe packaging pack thereof, an individual wet wipe pull-out sheet for the wet wipe packaging pack, and a dedicated pressing device for the wet wipe packaging pack. When a wet wipe disposed in an upper portion on one side inside a wet wipe case is pulled out through a dispensing opening of the wet wipe case, the trailing edge of the wet wipe disposed above is stacked so as to overlap the leading edge of a wet wipe disposed below, and thus the trailing edge of the wet wipe stacked above can continuously pull the leading edge of the wet wipe stacked below out a certain pull-out length above the dispensing opening of the wet wipe case. The pull-out length of the leading edge of the wet wipe stacked below when the wet wipe stacked above inside the wet wipe case is pulled out through the dispensing opening is shorter than the distance from the dispensing opening to the outer edge of a dispensing cap. Consequently, it is possible to prevent the exposed upper portion of the wet wipe from drying out or becoming contaminated with bacteria due to the pulled-out wet wipe being positioned between the dispensing cap and a cap lid such that the cap lid is unable to seal the upper portion of the dispensing cap when sealing the upper portion of the dispensing cap with the cap lid.

title_en: Tubular structure
abstract_en: Tubular structures (104), systems, and methods are generally directed to support structures having structural properties similar to thick-walled structures while being formed using materials having thickness amendable to rolling and welding and, thus, useful for rapid and cost-effective fabrication. In particular the tubular structures comprise a tubular base (106) and a wrap (108) supported on the base.

title_en: Apparatus for deseeding a sorrel bud
abstract_en: An apparatus for separating a calyx and a seed pod of a sorrel bud, whereby the apparatus can include a holder configured to hold the sorrel bud; a cutter movable in relation to the holder, the cutter configured to cut an opening in a base of the calyx to provide a cut calyx; and a separator movable in relation to the holder, the separator configured to separate the seed pod from the cut calyx via the opening. Movement of the cutter and the separator can be automatic.

title_en: Chip removal and electric arc addition of material hybrid processing production system
abstract_en: HYBRID PROCESSING PRODUCTION SYSTEM The production system for hybrid processing by chip removal and electric arc addition of material, according to the utility model, comprises a lathe center (1) with computer numerical control, which performs removal of material by chip removal and a robotic module (2) connected to an electric arc source (7) for carrying out the number of processing with the addition of metal by electric arc layering, as the additive material is in the form of a thread (10). The system also comprises an aspiration system (4) for discharge the gases formed during the processes of adding material.

title_en: Device and method for roughing and fine-machining of gears
abstract_en: A method and a device for cutting teeth into working gears (1) using a tool (2) having a multiplicity of cutting teeth (3) which are arranged about an axis of rotation (5), and which protrude radially from the main part (11) of the tool, the said cutting teeth (3) forming an end face (7), two tooth flanks (6, 6') facing away from each other, and cutting edges (18, 19), wherein in a first step in a first position of the tool (2) relative to the working gear (1) tooth flanks (14, 14') in the working gear (1) are produced with the cutting edges (18, 19) by means of a machining process, and in a second method step, the tooth flanks (14, 14') of the working gear (1) are fine-machined by an abrasive tool surface. The abrasive tool surfaces are formed by the tooth flanks (6, 6') of the tool (2).

title_en: Parts processing apparatus with detachable parts holder
abstract_en: A shaft and spindle assembly for retaining a part in a part processing assembly povides part retention on the shaft via a downward force from a part hold-down assembly.  The shaft is retained in the spindle assembly that is coupled to a turntable of the part processing assembly. The shaft includes an annular step that abuts against a portion of the spindle assembly to block downward movement of the shaft when the downward force is applied. In this way, the part is retained in a precise location relative to processing nozzles of the part processing assembly even after multiple parts are held down by the part hold-down assembly and processed.

title_en: Quick release tool bag securing system
abstract_en: A quick release securing system is disclosed. The system may include a first plate, a second plate, a third plate, and a quick-release assembly. The first plate is coupled to an inside surface of a container, such as a tool bag, and to a second plate on the outside surface of the tool bag with fastening means. The second plate is releasably secured to the third plate which is fixedly coupled to a support structure, such as a UTV or an ATV. The second plate and third plate are quickly and easily attachable and detachable from each other by user operating a quick-release assembly of the system.

title_en: Apparatus and method for making a coil, preferably for an electrochemical cell intended for the production of batteries
abstract_en: An apparatus (100) for making a coil (B) comprises a feed unit (2) configured to feed at least one strip-shaped article (N) and a winding unit (1). The winding unit includes a plurality of winding heads (10) and a movement device for moving (3) said winding heads (10) configured to displace said winding heads (10) along a working path (P). Each winding head (10) is configured to wind said strip-shaped article (N) so as to make said coil (B) during a displacement, carried out by said movement device (3), of the winding head (10) along an operative segment (P1) of the working path (P).

title_en: Method for manufacturing high-absorptivity ferrous metal by modifying ultrashort pulse laser surface structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for manufacturing high-absorptivity ferrous metal by modifying an ultrashort pulse laser surface structure. The method can realize the rapid and large-area uniform surface modification of the area, and can also realize the surface modification of the mu m-order area by changing the focusing degree of laser focusing. In addition, the method can also carry out surface modification on magnetron sputtering, vacuum ion plating and plasma spraying plating under the condition of not influencing the substrate.

title_en: CNC stud welding special plane
abstract_en: The invention discloses a CNC stud welding special machine, and relates to the technical field of welding machines; the automatic welding machine comprises a base, a working platform, an X-axis movement mechanism, a Y-axis movement mechanism, a Z-axis movement mechanism, a nail feeding mechanism and a welding gun mechanism; the working platform is arranged on the base, and a sheet metal part is arranged on the working platform; the Y-axis movement mechanism is arranged on the base, and the X-axis movement mechanism comprises a cross beam which is arranged on the Y-axis movement mechanism; a plurality of Z-axis movement mechanisms are arranged on the X-axis movement mechanism side by side, a plurality of welding gun mechanisms are arranged on each Z-axis movement mechanism, and each welding gun mechanism comprises a gun barrel and a welding gun chuck; the nail feeding mechanism is positioned behind the base and connected with the gun barrel of the welding gun mechanism through a nail feeding pipe; the invention has the beneficial effects that: the welding heat influence area on the welded sheet metal part is small, no deformation or color change exists on the sheet metal part, the welding quality is improved, the yield is greatly improved, the welding production efficiency is improved, and the manufacturing cost is reduced.

title_en: Automatic production device for clothes hanger connecting rod
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automatic production device for a clothes hanger connecting rod, which comprises a working platform, a feeding mechanism, a station transferring unit, a bending unit, a flattening mechanism and a punching mechanism. The feeding mechanism is used for conveying the connecting rod materials to the station transfer unit; the station transfer unit is used for sequentially transferring processing stations of the connecting rod materials according to the production procedures of the connecting rod of the clothes hanger; the bending unit is used for bending the connecting rod material to form a first hanger connecting rod semi-finished product; the flattening mechanism is used for flattening two ends of the first hanger connecting rod semi-finished product to form a second hanger connecting rod semi-finished product; and the punching mechanism is used for punching two ends of the second hanger connecting rod semi-finished product to form the hanger connecting rod finished product. The invention realizes the integrated production of the clothes hanger connecting rod, can meet the automatic production of the clothes hanger connecting rod with multiple processing requirements, has high automatic production level, greatly improves the production efficiency and the production yield of the clothes hanger connecting rod, and has strong practicability and popularization value.

title_en: Assembly of elements made of sheet metal comprising a flange
abstract_en: The invention relates to an assembly (2) of at least two elements (4, 4') made of sheet metal, each element comprising edges (6, 6') which are superposed to form joined flanges (8) of the element, the flanges comprising free ends (14), and the edges being assembled by: -welding points (10) distributed along the flange according to a first axis; and at least one glue strip (12) in the flange extending along the flange according to a second axis; the second axis is offset relative to the first axis in a direction opposite the free end of the flange. The invention also relates to a method for producing such an assembly (2).

title_en: Combined cutting tool
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a gang tool. The invention aims to reduce the weight of a cutter used for a single-plate cutting device and adjust the height of a cutter point of the cutter. A first screw (11) is screwed into a first female screw (7G) through a first hole (9C) to integrate a first cutter (7) and each first support member (9) into a first combined cutter (P2), and a third screw (15) of the first combined cutter (P2) screwed into a second female screw (9D) is rotated to change the length of the head (15A) side protruding from the first support member (9) and adjust the height (L1) to a desired amount, and then the first nut (13) is rotated to press-contact the first support member (9) to fix the third screw (15).

title_en: Single-station semi-automatic AA equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses single-station semi-automatic AA equipment, which comprises an AA device and a loading and unloading device; the loading and unloading device is arranged above the AA device and is used for loading the first material and the second material to the AA device and unloading finished products or defective products in the AA device. According to the invention, the image acquisition module is used for transmitting the acquired target image or speckle pattern back to the background program for processing so as to control the six-degree-of-freedom high-precision AA alignment, so that higher field definition can be achieved, and the yield of Sensor and Lens assembly is improved; meanwhile, full-automatic dispensing, broken glue detection and UV curing can be realized.

title_en: Press subassembly and oil press
abstract_en: The invention provides a squeezing assembly, which comprises a squeezing cylinder and a squeezing screw, wherein the squeezing cylinder comprises a conveying cavity and a squeezing cavity communicated with the conveying cavity; the pressing screw comprises a conveying section and a pressing section connected with the conveying section, the pressing screw is arranged in the pressing cylinder, the conveying section is positioned in the conveying cavity, the pressing section is positioned in the pressing cavity, a first thread and a second thread which is spaced from the first thread are arranged on the pressing screw in the direction from the conveying section to the pressing section, and the rotation direction of the first thread is the same as that of the second thread; from the direction of conveying section to the section of squeezing, the diameter of squeezing the screw rod is crescent, the screw tooth height of first screw thread is tapered, the screw tooth height of second screw thread is crescent, just the screw tooth height of second screw thread is within the screw tooth height of first screw thread. The invention solves the technical problem of insufficient squeezing.

title_en: Key groove processing device for rudder stock hole of rudder
abstract_en: The key groove processing device for the rudder stock hole of the rudder comprises an upper guide rail, a lower guide rail, a screw rod and a polished rod, wherein the screw rod and the polished rod are connected by a reduction gearbox, a movable frame is embedded between the upper guide rail and the lower guide rail to form a relative sliding structure, a main shaft and a secondary shaft are arranged in the movable frame, the main shaft and the screw rod form a turbine worm structure, the polished rod transmits rotation to the secondary shaft through a space gear train, the autorotation of a milling cutter arranged at the shaft end of the secondary shaft is realized, and the milling cutter rotates at a high speed while moving along with the movable frame to finish the processing of the key groove; the device is compact in structure and reasonable in design, after the device is fixed, the motor outputs power, the screw rod drives the movable frame to move, the feed of the milling cutter is realized, the polish rod transmits rotation to the auxiliary shaft, the autorotation of the milling cutter is realized, and superposition of the movement and the autorotation is shown as the fact that the milling cutter processes a key slot on a rudder stock hole.

title_en: Auxiliary shaving element for an upper blade of a shaving apparatus
abstract_en: The invention provides an auxiliary shaving element for a blade on shaving equipment, which comprises a hair pulling base layer and a thickening layer, wherein the hair pulling base layer and the thickening layer are formed by split independent processing, the thickening layer is provided with at least one layer, the hair pulling base layer is provided with a plurality of bending and tilting elastic arms, the elastic arms and the thickening layer adopt a split structure, and the thickness of the thickening layer is selected according to the auxiliary shaving effect requirement; the upper end of the elastic arm is connected with the thickening layer. The hair pulling base layer and the thickening layer are designed in a split mode, the thickness of the thickening layer is flexible and changeable, and the hair pulling force can be controlled freely, so that the hair pulling quantity of various different degrees can be provided.

title_en: Manufacturing process of austenitic stainless steel pipe fitting
abstract_en: The invention discloses a manufacturing process of an austenitic stainless steel pipe fitting, which comprises a pipe layer and a resistance reducing layer embedded in the inner wall of the pipe layer, wherein the pipe layer is manufactured by the following process steps of blanking; heating; welding; heat treatment; surface treatment; the resistance reducing layer is prepared by the following process steps: preparing a water phase; preparing an oil phase; adding the prepared oil phase into an oil phase reaction kettle, introducing nitrogen to drive oxygen, dropwise adding the water phase into the oil phase, introducing nitrogen again to drive oxygen, measuring the conductivity, initiating polymerization reaction at a certain temperature when the conductivity is at a proper value, and continuously heating and preserving heat for a period of time after the initiation temperature is stable to ensure that the reaction is complete; after the reaction is finished, cooling a product, alternately precipitating a polymer by using acetone and ethanol, and drying the polymer in a drying oven to form polymer powder; the polymer powder was poured into an extruder and finally the drag reducing layer was obtained in a ring shape. The invention has the following advantages and effects: has the advantages of high dissolving speed, uniform dispersion and high resistance reduction efficiency.

title_en: Device for automatically classifying rivets
abstract_en: The invention provides a device for automatically classifying rivets, comprising: the nail separating device comprises a nail separating base, a nail separating sliding plate, a sliding plate pushing plate and three cylinders, wherein the nail separating base is provided with n nail feeding holes, the nail separating sliding plate is provided with m nail feeding holes, and the nail separating sliding plate is arranged above the nail separating base in a sliding manner; the sliding plate push plate is fixedly arranged on one side of the nail separating sliding plate; the three cylinders are respectively arranged on the nail separating base, the first cylinder and the second cylinder are positioned on one side of the sliding plate push plate, the piston rod of the second cylinder is connected with the sliding plate push plate, the third cylinder is positioned on the other side of the sliding plate push plate, and the piston rods of the first cylinder and the third cylinder can both contact with the sliding plate push plate; the three cylinders act on the sliding plate push plate respectively, so that the nail separating sliding plate is pushed to do linear reciprocating motion, one nail feeding hole of the nail separating sliding plate corresponds to different nail feeding holes in the nail separating base at different time respectively, and different types of rivets are output by the nail separating sliding plate. The automatic nail feeding system solves the problems of complex structure and high cost of the automatic nail feeding system, saves the cost, simplifies the structure and reduces the failure rate.

title_en: Aluminum alloy plate welding method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a welding method of aluminum alloy plates, which comprises the following steps: horizontally butting two groups of aluminum alloy plates to be welded to form a workpiece to be welded, polishing the butting surface between the two groups of aluminum alloy plates before butting, and preheating to 310 ℃; and placing an ER5356 welding wire into a gap of a to-be-welded part, wherein the diameter of the ER5356 welding wire is 3.5mm, and performing filling welding on the front surface of the to-be-welded part in a TIG (tungsten inert gas) welding mode to form a welding bottom part. According to the welding method of the aluminum alloy plate, firstly, the defects of back weld pores and unfused welding generated by a single-side welding process can be overcome, the tensile strength can be improved, the parts to be welded are more compact, secondly, the number of the pores between the parts to be welded can be better reduced, the welding tightness between the parts to be welded is further improved, the plate between the gaps of the parts to be welded can be better melted and fused, the fusion degree between the parts to be welded is improved, the parts to be welded can be better integrated, and better use prospects are brought.

title_en: Method for vacuum compression and densification of wood material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for vacuum compression and densification of a wood material, and belongs to the field of production and preparation of wood materials. According to the invention, the wood is subjected to hot press setting treatment under a vacuum condition, the specific modulus of the treated wood is large, and the technical problems of long hot press setting time, low manufacturing efficiency, color change, size instability and the like of the conventional wood compression and compaction technology are solved; the compression and densification manufacturing of the wood material is carried out under the vacuum condition, and the bonding strength of the wood bonding material is also improved.

title_en: Automatic bamboo splitting machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automatic bamboo splitting machine, which comprises a workbench, a feeding conveyor belt, a rack, a cutting device, a bamboo splitting device and a pushing device, wherein the feeding conveyor belt is positioned on the left side of the workbench and used for conveying bamboo materials, the rack is fixed right above the workbench through a support column, the cutting device is fixed at the left end of the rack and used for cutting the bamboo materials, the bamboo splitting device is fixed at the right end of the rack and used for splitting a bamboo rod into a plurality of bamboo chips, the pushing device can transversely move left and right in a reciprocating manner and is connected to the rack, and the pushing device is positioned between; the measuring device who is used for measuring bamboo material pay-off length is installed to the left end of workstation, still installs the PLC controller on the workstation and is used for transporting the conveyer belt with higher speed of bamboo material, should be located the measuring device right side relatively and with the corresponding distribution of pan feeding conveyer belt with higher speed the conveyer belt, pan feeding conveyer belt and with higher speed the conveyer belt electricity respectively connect in the PLC controller. The bamboo splitting machine can improve the bamboo splitting efficiency and save labor.

title_en: Rail-mounted automatic welding assembly line
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of welding, in particular to a rail type automatic welding assembly line, which comprises a welding frame, a feeding frame, an upper layer rail frame, a conversion frame, a welding machine and a discharging frame, wherein the welding frame is a rectangular frame, the number of the welding frames is two, the two welding frames form a U-shaped frame, and the conversion frame is arranged on the other side of the welding frame and forms a closed rectangle with the welding frame; the production line can form a closed loop, the input end and the output end of the workpiece are convenient to collect and transport the workpiece, the space occupation of the whole production line is smaller, the area is saved, the production cost is reduced, an upper-layer track frame is arranged at the top and used for conveying the workpiece, a plurality of material frames are slidingly connected on the U-shaped frame which is formed by two welding frames, the whole production process can enable the material frames to be continuously recycled, secondary placement is not needed, resources are saved, and the labor cost is reduced.

title_en: C-type air chuck and production method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a C-shaped pneumatic chuck which comprises a chuck main body, a slip body and a power mechanism, wherein the chuck main body comprises a base and a centralizing frame, a dental lamina is arranged in the slip body, the power mechanism comprises an air cylinder assembly, a connecting rod driven by the air cylinder assembly, a left crankshaft assembly connected with the connecting rod and a right crankshaft assembly connected with the connecting rod, the left crankshaft assembly comprises a left shaft, a left crank arm and a left connecting shaft, the right crankshaft assembly comprises a right shaft, a right crank arm and a right connecting shaft, the left connecting shaft and the right connecting shaft are fixedly connected with the connecting rod, the left shaft and the right shaft are respectively fixedly connected with the slip body through rotating arms, and a valve is connected between a left front section and a right front section of the base through valve pins. The C-shaped pneumatic chuck has the advantages of low processing and manufacturing difficulty, high connection strength, long service life and convenience in installation.

title_en: Clamp for welding upright post of car transporting vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides a clamp for welding a stand column of a car, which relates to the field of clamps and comprises a rack, wherein the rack comprises two longitudinal beams which are arranged in parallel, the form and position tolerance between a limiting block and a main body is ensured through a limiting device, the welding quality is ensured, the operating efficiency is improved, a shaft sleeve is arranged in the limiting device, the lower end of the shaft sleeve is buckled on the lower end face of a main cross beam and abuts against a limiting shaft, the purpose of positioning the limiting shaft is achieved, the lower end face of the main cross beam is provided with a lower limiting block for lengthening the lead of a main shaft, the stability of the main shaft is improved, the upper limiting block of the main shaft is provided with a waist-shaped hole and a notch, four-sided rectangular sections of the main shaft can freely slide in the waist-shaped hole, when the main shaft enters the notch, the main shaft can only slide left and right, the rotation of the main shaft is limited, the upper end of the main positioning block is provided with the notch which is matched with the lower section of the main shaft, the main limiting block is consistent with the rotation of the main shaft, the upper end face and the side face of the main positioning block are provided with round corners, and the interference with the inner side of the stand body is avoided when the main limiting block rotates.

title_en: Automatic waste collecting slat punching machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of stamping. Aims to provide a waste automatic collection batten punching machine with high automation degree. The technical scheme adopted by the invention is as follows: an automatic waste collecting batten punching machine comprises a rack, a conveying device and a punching device; a waste collecting channel extending along the width direction of the frame is arranged on the bottom plate of the frame below the female die, two ends of the waste collecting channel are communicated with waste guiding channels extending out of the left side plate and the right side plate of the frame, and the waste guiding channels incline downwards and slantwise towards the outside of the frame; and a material pushing plate is arranged in the waste collection channel, the width of the material pushing plate is matched with the waste collection channel, and the material pushing plate can reciprocate along the length direction of the waste collection channel under the driving of the driving assembly. The automatic punching machine can quickly and automatically collect waste materials generated by punching, improves the automation level and reduces the labor intensity of workers.

title_en: Machine tool with active vibration damping device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a machine tool with an active damping device, comprising a suspended component (10) having a longitudinal wall (11), wherein during machining vibrations are generated in accordance with at least the main bending directions (D1, D2) of the suspended component (10); a head (20) arranged on one free end of the suspension member (10); an actuating means (30) for actuating the head (20), arranged on one of the longitudinal walls (11) of the suspension member (10); and a damping means (41, 42) configured to generate at least a force (F1, F2) in a main bending direction (D1, D2) of the suspended component (10), wherein the damping means (41, 42) is arranged in a local transverse section (12) of the suspended component (10) of the longitudinal wall (11) on which the actuating means (30) is arranged, the local transverse section (12) being located between the actuating means (30) and a free end of the suspended component (10) on which the head (20) is arranged.

title_en: Pressure system
abstract_en: Provided is a pressure system which provides excellent energy efficiency for the entire pressure system and can achieve low price. A die cushion apparatus (160-1) constituting a press system (10) supports a cushion pad (128), and includes a hydraulic cylinder (130), the hydraulic cylinder (130) generating a die cushion load on the cushion pad (128) when a ram (110) of the press (100-1) is lowered, the press (100-1) including a hydraulic cylinder (137), the hydraulic cylinder (137) generating a part of the pressure load on the ram (110) when the ram (110) is lowered. For the period in which the die cushion load acts, the pressure generation chamber (130 b) of the hydraulic cylinder (130) for generating the die cushion load and the pressure generation chamber (137 b) of the hydraulic cylinder (137) for generating a part of the pressure load may communicate with each other via the pipes (152, 155) and the first logic valve (171).

title_en: Key clamp
abstract_en: The invention discloses a key clamp which comprises a base, a clamp body and a locking device, wherein a fixing plate is arranged on the base, the clamp body comprises a first clamping block and a second clamping block, a plurality of key clamping structures are sequentially formed when the first clamping block and the second clamping block are connected in a butt joint mode, the first clamping block and the second clamping block are locked through the locking device, the first clamping block and the second clamping block are further fixed on the fixing plate through the locking device, the first clamping block is connected with the fixing plate in a contact mode, at least one limiting raised line is arranged on the fixing plate, grooves matched with the limiting raised line are formed in one face, close to the fixing plate, of the first clamping block, each limiting raised line corresponds to a plurality of grooves, and the grooves corresponding to the same limiting raised line are arranged in a staggered mode. The key clamp can be combined with a plurality of key clamps, free switching can be realized, the operation is flexible and convenient, the positioning is accurate, and the work of processing keys is reduced due to the adoption of various types of keys. The invention is applied to the technical field of key processing.

title_en: High-pressure annular pipeline welding equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses high-pressure annular pipeline welding equipment which comprises a main body, wherein a rotating cavity is arranged in the main body, the rotating cavity is rotatably provided with a rotating shaft which is symmetrical left and right, the outer wall of the rotating shaft is provided with a rotating semi-ring positioned in the rotating cavity, wherein the rotating half rings at the left side and the right side can be mutually contacted and matched to form a circle, the rotating half rings are provided with sliding blocks in a sliding way, the bottom end of the sliding block is provided with a welding head for welding, the invention has simple structure, convenient operation and convenient maintenance, in addition, the equipment does not need personnel interference in the process of welding the pipeline, improves the welding efficiency of the pipeline, avoids the phenomenon of unsatisfactory welding effect caused by insufficient experience of welding personnel, has better welding effect and stable welding effect, and the working intensity of workers is reduced, so that the equipment has higher use and popularization values.

title_en: Round steel processing equipment for building
abstract_en: The invention discloses round steel processing equipment for buildings, which comprises a rectangular workbench, wherein one end of the rectangular workbench is provided with a round steel bending forming device, the side surface of the rectangular workbench is provided with a controller, one end of the rectangular workbench is provided with a rotary hydraulic cutting device, the upper surface of the rectangular workbench is provided with a raw material conveying device, the rotary hydraulic cutting device can cut round steel under the telescopic action of a hydraulic cylinder, and the raw material conveying device drives the round steel to perform positioning movement through the movement of a sliding block. The invention has the advantages of simple operation and strong practicability.

title_en: Composite roll for rolling and method for manufacturing same
abstract_en: The present invention provides a composite roll for rolling, which has a structure in which an outer layer and an intermediate layer made of a Fe-based alloy, which are centrifugally cast, and an inner layer made of spheroidal graphite cast iron are welded and integrated, wherein the outer layer has a composition comprising, on a mass basis, 1 to 3% of C, 0.3 to 3% of Si, 0.1 to 3% of Mn, 0.5 to 5% of Ni, 1 to 7% of Cr, 2.2 to 8% of Mo, 4 to 7% of V, 0.005 to 0.15% of N, 0.05 to 0.2% of B, and the balance of Fe and unavoidable impurities, the intermediate layer contains 0.025 to 0.15% of B, the B content of the intermediate layer is 40 to 80% of the B content of the outer layer, and the total content of Cr, mo, V, nb, and W of the intermediate layer is 40 to 90% of the total content of Cr, mo, V, nb, and W of the outer layer.

title_en: Battery piece series welding equipment and battery piece series welding method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a battery piece series welding device and a battery piece series welding method, wherein the battery piece series welding device comprises a welding conveying device, a battery piece feeding device, a welding strip feeding device, a pressure welding strip tool and a welding device; the width of the welding conveying device is larger than the sum of the widths of at least two battery pieces so as to form at least two laying lines on the welding conveying device; the battery piece feeding device is positioned at a front station of the welding conveying device, and the battery pieces are paved on at least two paving lines; the welding strip feeding device is positioned at a front station of the welding conveying device, and welding strips are paved on at least two paving lines; the welding strip tool compresses the battery pieces and the welding strips stacked on the welding conveying device; the welding conveying device conveys the stacked and laid battery pieces and the welding strips to a welding station; the welding device is used for welding the battery piece and the welding strip which are positioned on the welding station. According to the technical scheme provided by the invention, at least two battery strings can be welded in one welding process, so that the production efficiency of the battery strings is greatly improved.

title_en: Gear polishing equipment that polishing precision is high
abstract_en: The invention discloses gear polishing equipment with high polishing precision, which comprises a rack, wherein a fixed base is arranged on the rack; an adjusting groove is arranged on the fixed base, and a hydraulic cylinder, a fixed plate, a fixed rod and two automatic stabilizing devices are arranged in the adjusting groove; a plurality of measuring rods with height detection devices are arranged on the fixing plate; one side of the fixed base is provided with a lifting seat, the lifting seat is provided with two electric slide rails and a lifting plate, and the lifting plate is provided with a fixed top seat; the fixed top seat is internally provided with an annular main pipe, an air inlet pipe, a supercritical carbon dioxide air supply bottle, a plurality of air outlet pipes, a plasma pipe and an annular feed pipe, and the top surface of the annular feed pipe is connected with the plasma gas bottle; the fixed top seat is provided with a plurality of piezoelectric sensors. The invention can improve the processing precision, and has the advantages of low labor intensity, high working efficiency, wide application range, good processing stability, high safety, convenient use, convenient maintenance, convenient cleaning and long service life.

title_en: Electromagnetic forming coil unit and method for manufacturing formed body using same
abstract_en: Provided are an electromagnetic forming coil unit and a method for manufacturing a formed body using the electromagnetic forming coil unit, wherein the electromagnetic forming coil unit can prevent a tubular member from contacting a conductor or conductors from contacting each other when a current is applied to the tubular member, and can stably process a plurality of positions in the longitudinal direction of the tubular member. The electromagnetic forming coil unit includes: a resin shaft core member; a conductor having a winding portion wound around the shaft core member and a pair of conductor extension portions; an insulating support; and a resin coating layer formed on the outer peripheral surface of the winding portion. The insulating support is formed with conductor holding portions for holding the conductor extending portions so as to be separated from each other in the longitudinal direction.

title_en: Automatic assembly device of adjustable temperature control switch and working method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of assembly devices, and particularly relates to an automatic assembly device of an adjustable temperature control switch and a working method thereof. The device comprises: the rack is provided with a feeding, discharging and positioning conveying mechanism along a straight line; the positioning and conveying mechanism conveys the switch base output by the feeding mechanism to the discharging mechanism, and the first, second and third assembling mechanisms are arranged along the conveying path of the positioning and conveying mechanism; the first assembling mechanism assembles the lower static contact, the first terminal and the first screw on the switch base; the second assembly mechanism is used for assembling the reed component, the second terminal and the second screw on the switch base; the third assembling mechanism assembles the upper static contact, the third terminal and the third screw on the switch base. The device is characterized in that the switch base is assembled once through three assembly mechanisms respectively, and a plurality of small-volume accessories are assembled on the switch base. The automatic assembly of the adjustable temperature control switch is realized, manual completion is not needed, labor intensity is reduced, assembly accuracy is improved, and assembly yield is improved.

title_en: Rolling tool
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rolling tool (10) having a base body (12) extending along a longitudinal center axis (11), at least one roller carrier (14) arranged on the base body (12) in a radially adjustable manner, which roller carrier holds a rolling roller (15) in a rotationally movable manner, and having an adjusting mechanism (16) arranged in the base body (12), which adjusting mechanism interacts with the roller carrier (14) in order to adjust the roller carrier (14) in a radial direction. According to the invention, the roller carrier (14) has a holding arm (18b) which holds the stitching rollers (15) and which can be pivoted by means of an adjusting mechanism (16) in a pivotable manner in the radial direction relative to the base body (12).

title_en: Strip nail making machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a chain riveting nail making machine, which comprises a blanking mechanism, wherein a material pushing mechanism and a material arranging mechanism are respectively arranged on two sides of the blanking mechanism, when a chain riveting material is punched, the material pushing mechanism horizontally pushes chain riveting to the material arranging mechanism, the material arranging mechanism orderly stacks the chain riveting layer by layer on a tray, the tray is placed on a conveying belt, after the chain riveting in the tray is stacked to a preset layer number, a driving cylinder drives a connecting plate to move upwards until the lower end surface of a positioning sleeve completely leaves the chain riveting on the uppermost layer of the tray, the conveying belt conveys the chain riveting to a packaging station, automatic assembly line processing is realized, and the working efficiency is improved. The strip nail making machine disclosed by the invention can automatically push the punched strip nails to the next station, and then automatically stack and stack the pushed strip nails, so that the existing manual stacking is replaced, and the working efficiency is high.

title_en: Forming method for milling conical bottom melon petal with large wall thickness
abstract_en: The invention provides a forming method for a milling cone bottom melon petal with large wall thickness number, which comprises the steps of arranging auxiliary ribs, sequentially arranging a first auxiliary rib and a second auxiliary rib at the short arc position of the top end of a fan-shaped plate, arranging a third auxiliary rib at the long arc position of the bottom end of the plate, and adopting annular and longitudinal rib distribution in the same grid area at the flange hole position of the fan-shaped plate to avoid the distortion at the position and form a plate rolling cone; further, the center connecting line of the inner surface of the plate is coplanar with the axes of the upper roller and the lower roller of the rolling device, and the pressing amount and the inclination angle of the left roller and the right roller at two sides of the lower roller of the rolling device are adjusted. According to the forming method for the milling cone bottom melon petal with the large wall thickness, the auxiliary ribs are arranged and the rolling cone parameters are optimized, so that the grid area and the welding allowance area are prevented from cracking due to stress concentration, manual trimming is reduced, the forming precision and the surface quality are ensured, and the production efficiency is improved.

title_en: Forging and pressing die
abstract_en: The invention relates to a forging die, which comprises an upper die base, wherein a guide sleeve is arranged on the bottom surface of the upper die base, a guide pillar is arranged in the guide sleeve in a penetrating manner and fixed on the lower die base, a through hole is formed in the center of the lower die base, a push rod is movably inserted in the through hole, the forging die further comprises a fixing plate, an upper combined die, a lower combined die and an ejection device, the top surface of the lower die base is provided with the fixing plate, the upper combined die comprises an upper outer die, an upper inner die and an upper die core, the upper die core is a combined body formed by an upper plate body and a round rod, the combined body is arranged in a second upper groove of the upper inner die, the bottom surface of the upper plate body is provided with a frustum-shaped hole, the lower end of the round rod extends out of a first through hole and is arranged in the frustum-shaped hole, the lower combined die comprises a lower outer die, a lower inner die and a lower, the inner wall of the die cavity is easy to crack at the sudden change position, and the forge piece is easy to deform during unloading.

title_en: Stamping tool
abstract_en: The invention discloses a stamping tool which comprises a base, wherein a lower positioning block is welded and installed on the upper end face of the base, an arc-shaped positioning block is welded and installed on the left end face of the lower positioning block, a lower clamping groove is formed in the upper end faces of the lower positioning block and the arc-shaped positioning block, a vertical cylinder is welded and installed on the upper end face of a supporting block, an upper positioning block is welded and installed on the upper portion of the left end face of the vertical cylinder, and a limiting groove is formed in the upper end face of the upper positioning block.

title_en: Sleeper bolt feeder
abstract_en: The application discloses a sleeper bolt feeder, which comprises a vibration disc for arranging bolts into a row and sending out the bolts one by one, wherein a bolt blanking mechanism is arranged at an outlet of the vibration disc, the bolt blanking mechanism comprises a cutting block, the cutting block is connected with a blanking cylinder, a clamping groove for clamping the head of the bolt is arranged at the position, which is opposite to the outlet of the vibration disc, of the cutting block, a clamping jaw for clamping the lower part of the bolt is arranged below the clamping groove, one side of the clamping jaw is provided with a bolt turnover mechanism, the clamping jaw is connected with a traversing cylinder for pushing the bolt to the bolt turnover mechanism, the bolt turnover mechanism comprises a turnover shaft, two turnover clamping jaws are arranged on the turnover shaft, the turnover shaft is connected with a rotating cylinder for rotating the turnover shaft, a guide rail is arranged at the bottom of the bolt turnover mechanism, and a shifting cylinder is arranged at one side of the bolt turnover mechanism and moves on the guide rail by pushing the bolt turnover mechanism, so that the two turnover clamping jaws are aligned with the clamping jaw of the bolt blanking mechanism in sequence, and two turnover feeding is completed.

title_en: Method and device for producing a wood composite panel
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for producing a wood composite panel (2), wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of (a) spreading a plurality of wood particles into a particle cake, (b) applying a binder to at least a portion of the wood particles during and/or prior to spreading, (c) compressing the particle cake at an elevated pressure and an elevated temperature, wherein the amount of binder applied to the wood particles is varied according to the intended location of the wood particles in the particle cake.

title_en: Processing device for extra-long foam with two special-shaped ends and use method of processing device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a processing device of extra-long-strip-shaped foam with two special-shaped ends and a using method thereof, belonging to the field of foam processing. A processing device for extra-long foam cotton with two special-shaped ends comprises a base and a bottom plate, wherein the top of the base is connected with a feeding roller, and the outer wall of the top of the bottom plate is respectively connected with a first supporting plate, a second supporting plate and a third supporting plate; the top parts of the first supporting plate and the second supporting plate are respectively connected with a first air cylinder and a second air cylinder, and the bottom part of the sliding block is respectively connected with a blade A and a blade B; the top of the third supporting plate is connected with a third air cylinder, the output end of the third air cylinder is connected with a second sliding plate, and the bottom of the second sliding plate is connected with a plurality of blades C in a sliding manner; the bottom plate is also connected with a material receiving roller; the long-strip-shaped foam forming machine can conveniently perform punching forming on long-strip-shaped foam with the special-shaped structures at two ends and larger than 1200mm, is low in use cost, improves the processing efficiency, and can meet the requirements of most enterprises.

title_en: Heat pipe production device, production control method and computer program product
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of heat pipe production, and discloses a heat pipe production device, a production control method and a computer program product, wherein the heat pipe production device comprises: the device comprises a production video acquisition module, a temperature acquisition module, a main control module, a video enhancement module, a heating module, a shaping module, a filling module, a cutting module, a hardness testing module and a display module. According to the method, the video enhancement module respectively provides a judgment standard and an enhancement algorithm for the strong boundary pixel, the weak boundary pixel and the smooth pixel, so that the enhancement effect of the processed image is better; the problems of serious picture graininess left by an enhanced image and image quality loss and edge blurring caused by the conventional denoising algorithm in the prior art when noise data is eliminated are solved, the video image is enhanced and denoised simultaneously to obtain better image quality, and the image effect after processing is integrally improved; meanwhile, the hardness data of the heat pipe can be accurately tested through the hardness testing module.

title_en: Electron beam corrugated tube
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of mechanical vacuum sealing, and particularly relates to an electron beam corrugated pipe which comprises a metal corrugated pipe, two bidirectional connecting screws and a connecting shaft, wherein the corrugated pipe is respectively connected with a motor shaft and a flap valve through the two bidirectional connecting screws and the connecting shaft penetrating through the inside of the corrugated pipe, so that the sealing connection between a vacuum welding chamber of an electron beam welding machine and the motor is realized, the localization of corrugated pipe parts of the electron beam welding machine is realized, the time period and the cost of purchasing the corrugated pipe parts are reduced, the problem of difficulty in purchasing spare parts is solved, the failure probability and the maintenance difficulty caused by the breakage of a motor shaft are reduced, the assembly precision and the equipment stability of the corrugated pipe are improved, and the maintenance is convenient.

title_en: Portable tool box
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable tool box which comprises a box body and a plurality of box bodies, wherein the box bodies are arranged in the box body through lifting and turning devices, and the lifting and turning devices are used for turning the box bodies in the box body in the horizontal direction and the vertical direction. The invention has the advantages of convenient taking, no unstable gravity center in the taking process, vertical arrangement of the recovered box bodies after use, convenient taking away, no collision, simple structure, strong practicability and convenient operation.

title_en: Alloy wire winding method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an alloy wire winding method, which uses automatic winding equipment, wherein the automatic winding equipment comprises a bottom plate, a winding device, a supporting device and an auxiliary device, and the specific method flow when the automatic winding equipment is adopted to wind the alloy wire is as follows: the winding device comprises a first mounting plate, a second mounting plate, a winding roller, a winding motor, a rotating gear, a lifting rack, a rotating shaft and arc-shaped convex strips. According to the invention, the coiling device, the supporting device and the auxiliary device are matched together to complete the coiling work of the alloy wire, the supporting device can stack the wire to carry out annular support in the coiling process so as to prevent the wire from deforming, the auxiliary device can uniformly distribute the wire on the coiling device, the coiling roller is of a position-adjustable structure, and the wire can be taken down after the coiling is finished without disassembling the coiling roller.

title_en: Universal swing angle device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a universal swing angle device which comprises a mounting seat, a plurality of elastic pieces and a pushing assembly, wherein the mounting seat comprises a base, a carrying disc and a supporting piece, the supporting piece is rotatably arranged on the base in a penetrating mode, one end, away from the base, of the supporting piece is in sliding abutting joint with the carrying disc, the carrying disc is used for carrying a workpiece to be processed, the elastic pieces are arranged around the supporting piece, two ends of each elastic piece are respectively connected with the base and the carrying disc, the pushing assembly comprises a driving piece and a pushing piece connected with the driving piece, the driving piece is arranged on the supporting piece, one end, away from the driving piece, of the pushing piece is in abutting joint with the carrying disc, and the driving piece drives the pushing piece to drive the carrying disc to swing. The universal swing angle device provided by the invention can realize multidirectional and multi-angle inclination of the workpiece to be processed, and improves the processing efficiency of the workpiece to be processed.

title_en: Production and processing method of self-tapping screw
abstract_en: The invention relates to a production and processing method of a self-tapping screw, which uses a shaping and stamping device, wherein the shaping and stamping device comprises a base, a cutting unit and a stamping unit, wherein the left side of the upper end of the base is provided with a cutting groove, the inner wall of the rear end of the cutting groove is provided with the cutting unit, and the inner wall of the left end of the cutting groove is provided with the stamping unit; according to the invention, the steel column strip is kept in a fixed state through cutting and transportation, and after the steel column strip is limited by the stamping unit, the fixed state of the steel column strip is released through a simple mechanical mechanism, so that the problem that the steel column strip is fixed and limited and is difficult to feed and discharge from a transportation mechanism is solved; the invention solves the problem of complicated steps in the stamping process by a method of stamping the nail head and then immediately forming the cross groove, and improves the production efficiency of the self-tapping screw.

title_en: Preparation method of high-strength bamboo veneer
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a high-strength bamboo veneer, which comprises the steps of pretreating a bamboo tube by adopting a mixed solution of sodium chlorite and hydrogen peroxide, removing partial hemicellulose and lignin in the bamboo tube, opening hydrogen bond connection between the celluloses to enable the bamboo tube to have plasticity, unfolding the bamboo tube by using a simple process, and finally combining a large number of cellulose hydroxyl groups in bamboo materials in a hydrogen bond mode at high temperature and high pressure under the condition of keeping a certain water content to form the whole bamboo veneer with high compactness. The method has the advantages of simple process, low cost, short time and the like, does not need a special bamboo flattening machine, can realize the preparation of the high-strength bamboo veneer through simple equipment, and is suitable for large-area popularization and application.

title_en: Multi-angle dustproof cutting device for metal processing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-angle dustproof cutting device for metal processing, which comprises a workbench, wherein a mounting frame is arranged at the upper end of the workbench, a cutting mechanism is arranged on the top wall of the mounting frame, two supporting mechanisms are symmetrically arranged at the upper end of the workbench, a workpiece to be cut is jointly placed at the upper ends of the two supporting mechanisms, limiting mechanisms are arranged on opposite side walls of the mounting frame, the bottoms of the two limiting mechanisms are respectively abutted against the upper ends of the opposite supporting mechanisms, a dustproof mechanism is arranged at the upper end of the workbench, a U-shaped plate is jointly and fixedly connected with the bottoms of the two limiting mechanisms, the U-shaped plate penetrates through the side wall of the workbench and is in sliding connection with the side wall of the workbench, and the free end of the dustproof mechanism penetrates through the workbench and is fixedly. The scrap iron collecting device is reasonable in structural design, not only can guarantee the stability of a workpiece to be cut in the cutting process, but also can fully collect splashed scrap iron, and the threat to the human body and the environment is avoided.

title_en: Traditional Chinese medicine slicing machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a traditional Chinese medicine slicing machine, wherein a roller is fixed on a support, a rotating shaft is rotatably arranged in the roller along the axis of the roller, the end part of the rotating shaft sequentially and movably penetrates through the end surface of the roller and the side wall of the support to extend outwards, a plurality of stirring units are arranged on the outer wall of the rotating shaft at intervals along the axis of the rotating shaft, a feed inlet is arranged on one side wall of the roller, a columnar shell is arranged on the other side of the roller, a discharge outlet is arranged at the bottom of the roller, a central shaft is rotatably arranged in the shell, a plurality of blades are arranged on the outer wall of the central shaft at intervals along the axis of the central shaft, the blades and the stirring sheets are. According to the invention, the existing slicing mode is changed, and continuous slicing operation is carried out by utilizing the linkage and matching of the shifting unit and the blade, so that the process of simultaneously slicing single or multiple hard rhizome fibrous traditional Chinese medicinal materials can be realized, the treatment efficiency of the medicinal materials is accelerated, and the traditional Chinese medicinal materials are prevented from being damaged due to excessive extrusion in the slicing process.

title_en: Universal pliers
abstract_en: A universal pliers comprises a fixed handle unit, a movable handle unit and a quick release unit. The movable handle unit is movably arranged in the fixed handle unit and comprises a front movable handle capable of pivoting and a rear movable handle, the front movable handle is provided with a sliding guide groove, and the sliding guide groove is provided with a locking groove part, a loosening groove part and a central groove part. The rear movable handle is provided with a limiting guide groove. The quick release unit comprises a trigger which is rotatably arranged on the front movable handle and an elastic group which is movably connected with the trigger and the movable handle unit. The trigger is used for driving the elastic group to be switched between a locking state that the rear movable handle cannot pivot relative to the front movable handle and a non-locking state that the rear movable handle can pivot relative to the front movable handle. Thereby, the universal pliers can be operated by one hand.

title_en: Chip overlapping assembling device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a chip overlapping assembly device, which belongs to the field of quick assembly process tools of friction plate groups of gearboxes, and comprises two main body panels and chip mounting blocks, wherein gravity-free folding support frames are arranged at the bottoms of one ends of the two main body panels, the other ends of the two main body panels are connected through pin shafts, limiting springs are arranged on the pin shafts, each main body panel is provided with a mounting groove, and the chip mounting blocks are arranged in the mounting grooves; the chip installation block comprises a handle, a base and a groove body, wherein the handle is connected with the base, a plurality of groove bodies are arranged on the base, a plurality of vertical upward spacing bars are arranged between the groove bodies, two sides of each spacing bar are respectively provided with an arc-shaped trimming edge, and the positions of the trimming edges are arranged at positions close to the top surfaces of the spacing bars. The invention is convenient to operate; the assembly speed is high, and the error probability is low; the mechanism is simple and convenient to maintain; the investment cost is low.

title_en: Welding and clamping pressing process for butt-joint connecting section bar
