abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of profile welding, and particularly relates to a welding and clamping process for butt-joint connecting profiles, wherein a welding auxiliary device used in the process comprises a connecting plate; an auxiliary welding module is arranged on the connecting plate; the auxiliary welding module is used for assisting in welding the section bar and comprises a sliding block, a supporting spring and a positioning bulge; the connecting plate is provided with an accommodating groove which is connected with the sliding block in a sliding manner; the number of the sliding blocks is two, and the sliding blocks correspond to the accommodating grooves one to one; according to the invention, the connecting plate is pushed to move, so that the sliding block moves between the two profiles, and the connecting position of the profiles is supported, the deformation caused by the fact that the flanges of the profiles are not supported during welding is avoided, the connection strength between the two profiles is influenced, the sliding block moves between the two profiles by pushing the connecting plate to move, the connection position of the profiles is further supported, and the deformation caused by the fact that the flanges of the profiles are not supported during welding is avoided, and the connection strength between the two profiles is influenced.

title_en: Cutting, grinding and machining integrated device for wall plastering and cleaning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cutting and grinding integrated device for cleaning wall plastering, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a rotating mounting plate is arranged on the bottom plate, a telescopic rod is arranged on the rotating mounting plate, a mounting plate is arranged on the telescopic rod, a barrel shaft is arranged on the mounting plate, a movable rotating shaft is arranged in the barrel shaft in a sliding limiting manner, a cutting knife wheel is arranged on the periphery of the barrel shaft, a polishing wheel is arranged at the tail end of the movable rotating shaft in an assembling connection manner, a transverse plate is fixedly connected to one side of the mounting plate, a limiting plate is arranged on the transverse plate, and the limiting plate is rotatably connected with the tail end of the movable rotating shaft, which is far away from the polishing wheel. According to the wall surface grinding device, the cutting knife wheel and the grinding wheel can form two modes of synchronous rotation and independent rotation of the cutting knife wheel under the driving of the limiting plate, the grinding processing and the cutting processing of a wall surface can be finally completed by matching the rotation of the rotating mounting plate, the grinding wheel is separated from the synchronous rotation and is positioned on one side of the cutting knife wheel to limit the cutting depth, the wall surface grinding device is more flexible and convenient to use, the processing precision is higher, and the damage to the wall body is avoided.

title_en: Integrated circuit pin arrangement equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses whole foot equipment of integrated circuit, including workstation, supporting leg, screw thread mobile jib, elevator, slide rail, slider, fixed knot construct, drive structure and whole foot structure, the central point of workstation puts the department and has seted up the spout, sliding connection has the slider in the central spout of workstation, rotate the one end that is connected with the screw thread mobile jib on the slider, threaded connection has the elevator on the arcwall face of screw thread mobile jib, fixed mounting has whole foot structure on the elevator. This equipment structure is reasonable, uses in a flexible way, can adjust integrated circuit's stitch through putting the foot structure to adapt to the circuit board, make things convenient for integrated chip's installation work, put the foot structure simultaneously and both can be with the inside adjustment of stitch, also can be with the outside adjustment of stitch, the adjustment is nimble.

title_en: Manufacturing process of motor stator core with straight tooth groove and special-shaped notch
abstract_en: The invention discloses a manufacturing process of a motor stator core with a straight tooth slot and a special-shaped notch, which comprises the following process steps: step A, feeding: taking the strip material and feeding the strip material into a punch; b, punching a guide hole; step C, punching a positioning groove; step D, punching a variable notch: in the process of feeding the bar material forwards in a stepping manner, after each stepping, the bar material is stamped by a stamping device with a rotatable concave-convex die for a variable notch, wherein the inner contour of the stamped variable notch comprises a section of part with the same shape as the outer contour of the notch part of the stator iron core; e, blanking: obtaining a group of stator core monomer sheets with consistent notch parts; f, rotating the concave-convex die clockwise or anticlockwise for a certain angle; g, repeating the steps D to F for multiple times to obtain multiple sets of stator core monomer sheets with the same slot part outline shape and gradually changed lengths; and H, assembling. The invention has the advantages of high production efficiency and high performance of the stator core and the manufacturing cost of the stator core.

title_en: Formula and process of zirconium-plated carbonized high-strength heat-dissipation rail cutting grinding wheel
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rail cutting, and discloses a zirconium-plated carbonized high-strength heat-dissipation rail cutting grinding wheel formula and a process, wherein the grinding wheel formula mainly comprises the following components in percentage by weight: 39.22% of zirconium-plated white corundum, 19.61% of calcined corundum, 19.61% of brown corundum, 2.35% of iron sulfide, 4.71% of cryolite, 21.57% of KEP, 0.39% of carbon black and 12.55% of resin.

title_en: Toughened glass forming system
abstract_en: The invention provides a toughened glass forming and processing system, which comprises a bottom plate, a fixing device and a polishing device, wherein the bottom plate is provided with a plurality of grooves; the invention can make the I-shaped air bag generate deformation through the mutual matching of the air cylinder, the piston, the I-shaped air bag and the vent pipe, and the I-shaped air bag, the movable rod, the I-shaped wheel and the rubber belt can drive the I-shaped wheel and the rubber belt to expand and deform towards two ends when the I-shaped air bag expands through the mutual matching of the I-shaped air bag, so that the contact area between the rubber belt and the surface of the glass is increased, the friction force between the rubber belt and the glass is increased, the glass is more stable in the polishing process, and the device can adapt to the glass with various specifications by changing the expansion degree of the I-shaped air bag.

title_en: Stabilize efficient car articles for use sand blasting unit
abstract_en: The invention provides a stable and efficient automobile article sand blasting device, which belongs to the technical field of automobile article sand blasting devices and comprises a base, wherein sliding rails which are parallel to each other are symmetrically arranged on the base, a first movable seat and a second movable seat are connected to the sliding rails in a sliding mode, connecting belts are connected between the first movable seat and the second movable seat, bearing plates are fixedly connected between the first movable seats and between the second movable seats, and stabilizing parts are connected to the opposite sides of the bearing plates. This stabilize efficient car articles for use sand blasting unit, through stabilizing member, sliding seat one, sliding seat two, elastic component and connecting band intercombination, combine universal seat and moving part simultaneously, can form the power of a stable centre gripping to the substrate and drive the substrate rotation simultaneously, not only reduced staff's working strength, improved the stability of substrate in the sand blasting process and sand blasting processing's efficiency simultaneously, in addition further improved the device's application scope on the foretell basis.

title_en: Microwave circulator production system
abstract_en: The invention provides a microwave circulator production system, which comprises a storage box and a press, wherein a conveying belt is obliquely arranged at one end of an inner cavity of the storage box, the top of the conveying belt extends upwards out of the storage box to form an output end, lateral baffles are arranged at two sides of the conveying direction of the conveying belt, a guide rod is obliquely arranged between the upper parts of the two lateral baffles, a feeding supporting plate is arranged on the surface of the conveying belt along the conveying direction, a support leading-out port is arranged at the upper part of one lateral baffle, the support leading-out port is positioned below the higher end of the guide rod, and a discharging plate is fixed at; the lower die assembly is mounted on a processing table of the press, the upper die is mounted at the bottom of the lifting arm above the lower die assembly, and the material pushing assembly is arranged on one side of the lower die assembly. Rational in infrastructure after this scheme of adoption, excellent in use effect, degree of automation are high.

title_en: Automatic detection and positioning mechanism for feeding of lower ball seat of tubular lock
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic detection and positioning mechanism for feeding of a lower ball seat of a tubular lock, which comprises a detection mechanism, an overturning and moving mechanism and a positioning mechanism, wherein the detection mechanism is used for detecting the feeding of the lower ball seat of the tubular lock; the detection mechanism is provided with a first detection head and a pair of rotating wheels, and the lower bead seat is driven by the rotating wheels to rotate; the overturning moving mechanism comprises a linear slide rail, a lifting cylinder and a fixed frame, the fixed frame is provided with a clamping cylinder and a first chuck, and the first chuck is connected with a rotating mechanism; the positioning detection mechanism comprises a positioning head, a stepping motor and a second detection head, and the second detection head is arranged on the side surface of the positioning head. The invention has compact structure, corrects error by using the structural characteristics of the bead seat, ensures the qualification rate of finished products in subsequent automation steps and greatly improves the working efficiency.

title_en: Heavy horizontal turn-milling center Y-axis driving device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Y-axis driving device of a heavy horizontal turn-milling center; the device comprises an upright post, a milling mechanism and a Y-axis speed reducing mechanism; wherein, the upright post is provided with a longitudinal rail; the milling mechanism comprises a sliding plate matched with the longitudinal rail, a speed reducing mechanism and a milling head which are arranged on the sliding plate, and a hydraulic locking mechanism which is arranged on the sliding plate and acts on the longitudinal rail, wherein the speed reducing mechanism is connected with the milling head; the Y-axis speed reducing mechanism is arranged on the upright column, connected with the milling mechanism and used for driving the milling mechanism to move up and down; the milling head can improve the stability of the milling head during operation and effectively improve the processing precision.

title_en: Electromagnetic force assisted cutting device, cutting machine tool and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an electromagnetic force assisted cutting device, a cutting machine tool and a method, wherein the electromagnetic force assisted cutting device comprises a cutting tool and an electromagnetic coil, wherein the cutting tool and the electromagnetic coil can move synchronously, the electromagnetic coil is connected with a direct current power supply, and the electromagnetic coil is configured to generate magnetic field force which acts on chips and enables the chips to be far away from the cutting tool after current is introduced.

title_en: Stamping and integrally-formed production process of anti-theft door
abstract_en: The invention provides a stamping and integral forming production process of an anti-theft door, which belongs to the production process of the anti-theft door and comprises a door frame and a door plate, wherein the door frame comprises a front door frame, a rear door frame and a first elastic sealing material, the door plate comprises a front plate, a rear plate and a second elastic sealing material, the front door frame and the rear door frame are stamped into a rectangular frame by steel plates, groove-shaped grooves are formed in four sides of the rectangular frame, the front door frame is matched with the rear door frame through the first elastic sealing material, the front plate and the rear plate are respectively stamped into a first rectangular plate and a second rectangular plate by the steel plates, a first bend and a second bend are arranged on the first rectangular plate, a third bend and a fourth bend are arranged on the second rectangular plate, and the front plate is matched with the rear plate through the. The invention has the beneficial effects. The door frame and the door plate can be formed by punching and molding without welding, so that the door frame and the door plate are firmer, and the welding cost is reduced.

title_en: Sheet metal meshing structure, water selling station shell, water selling station and manufacturing process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sheet metal meshing structure, a water selling station shell, a water selling station and a manufacturing process thereof, wherein the sheet metal meshing structure comprises a first sheet metal part and a second sheet metal part, an arc-shaped bending part is arranged at the edge of one side of the first sheet metal part, the arc-shaped bending part forms a groove which is narrow in the middle and wide at two ends, and the opening of the groove is opened outwards; one side edge of the second sheet metal part is provided with a right-angle bending part formed by bending once, and the right-angle bending part is in plug-in fit with the groove. The water selling station shell and the water selling station are formed by splicing metal plate meshing structures, a welding installation mode is replaced, welding spots are avoided, the installation is convenient, the time is saved, the processing cost is reduced, the connection strength is good, the deformation is not easy, water is not easy to enter, the foaming layers are filled in the water selling station shell and the water selling station inner shell, the heat preservation effect is good, the hardness of the foaming layers is high after the foaming layers are cured, and the integral strength and the service life of the water selling station are improved.

title_en: Electrical punching device for electrical construction and use method
abstract_en: The application provides an electric punching device for electric construction and a using method of the electric punching device, and the electric punching device comprises a table body, wherein a limiting plate is arranged at the upper part of the table body, the limiting plate is parallel to the table body, and an interval adjusting part is arranged between the table body and the limiting plate; the table comprises a table body, a table top and a table top, wherein two ends of the top of the table body are respectively provided with a support frame, a movable transverse plate is arranged between the two support frames, the movable transverse plate is connected with the support frames in a sliding manner, and a first limiting part is arranged between the movable transverse plate and the support frames; the drill bit is characterized in that a movable rod is arranged on the movable transverse plate and is in sliding connection with the movable transverse plate, a second limiting part is arranged between the movable rod and the movable transverse plate, a motor is arranged at the bottom of the movable rod, a rotary sleeve is arranged at the output end of the motor, a drill bit is arranged at the bottom of the rotary sleeve, and the rotary sleeve is in threaded connection with the drill bit. The application provides an electric perforating device for electrical construction is rational in infrastructure, and the simple operation has avoided thereby the loss that the metal accessories produced deformation and even broke and cause punching process, has improved security and the accuracy of using, has saved the cost.

title_en: Spring plate seat positioning tool for axle body welding
abstract_en: The invention discloses a spring plate seat positioning tool for welding an axle body, which comprises a frame, a mounting seat and a positioning mechanism for positioning four plates of the spring plate seat, wherein the mounting seat is slidably arranged on the frame, and the positioning mechanism is arranged on the mounting seat. The positioning tool has the advantages of being simple and reliable in structure, capable of achieving accurate positioning, capable of improving welding quality and welding efficiency and wide in application range.

title_en: Intermediate alloy for improving oxidation resistance of solder
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intermediate alloy for improving the oxidation resistance of a solder, which consists of Sn, P and X, wherein the mass percentage of P is 0.2-10%, X is one or more of Ga, Ge and In, the mass ratio of P to X is 1: 0.1-10, and the balance is Sn; the intermediate alloy can be added into the solder preparation process to prepare an antioxidant solder, so that the solder has excellent oxidation resistance when in use; or directly added in the using process, the rate of the oxide slag is reduced, and the solder has continuous oxidation resistance.

title_en: Pump station pump head processingequipment for coal mine
abstract_en: The invention relates to a pump station pump head processing device for a coal mine. The pump station pump head processing device for the coal mine comprises a shell main body, wherein a connecting sleeve is sleeved on the outer surface of the shell main body, a pressing mechanism is detachably connected to the outer surface of the connecting sleeve, an external bottom plate is fixedly connected to the outer surface of the shell main body, a buffer spring is fixedly connected to the outer surface of the external bottom plate, the upper end of the buffer spring is fixedly connected with the connecting sleeve, a rubber cutting sleeve is fixedly connected to the outer surface of the lower end of the shell main body, a positioning column penetrates through the lower end of the shell main body, a bag piece is connected to the outer surface of the positioning column, an air pump piece is connected to the interior of the shell main body, an air pipe is connected to the interior of the positioning column, and one end of the air pipe is communicated with the bag piece; this pump station pump head processingequipment for coal mine, simple structure, convenient operation uses in a flexible way, can effectual improvement pump head machined part machining efficiency, convenient to popularize and use.

title_en: Quick positioning and mounting device for bolt
abstract_en: The invention provides a quick positioning and mounting device for a bolt, which comprises: the two ends of the fixing frame are provided with height adjusting devices for supporting; and the bolt positioning devices are arranged on the fixing frame at intervals along the length direction of the fixing frame and comprise a cross beam arranged on the fixing frame along the width direction of the fixing frame, a rack arranged on the cross beam along the length direction of the cross beam, a clamp detachably arranged on the cross beam, a gear meshed with the rack and limited at the inner side by the clamp, and a positioning mechanism arranged on the clamp and used for positioning the bolt. The invention can meet the requirement of quick positioning and installation of a large quantity of bolts, has accurate positioning, avoids the loss caused by measurement errors and greatly improves the installation efficiency of the track bolts.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted camera lens processing equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to lens treatment equipment, in particular to vehicle-mounted camera lens treatment equipment which comprises a water treatment mechanism, a polishing mechanism and a drying mechanism, wherein the equipment can be used for polishing, can be used for filtering and realizing self-cleaning, can be used for drying, can be used for treating water vapor in a centralized manner, and is connected with the drying mechanism, and the polishing mechanism is connected with the drying mechanism.

title_en: Rotary disc type centering device of ship tail pipe sealing device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rotary disc type centering device of a ship tail pipe sealing device, which comprises a rotary disc mechanism, a rotary disc seat, a meter frame, a connecting plate and a supporting seat, wherein the rotary disc mechanism comprises a rotary disc body, the inner wall of the rotary disc body is provided with an arc-shaped bearing installation groove, rolling bearings are respectively installed in the bearing installation groove corresponding to each group of shaft installation holes, the outer wall of the rotary disc seat is circumferentially provided with a bearing placing groove, the rotary disc seat is arranged on the inner side of the rotary disc body, the rolling bearings are placed in the bearing placing grooves, the rotary disc seat is installed on the connecting plate, the connecting plate is installed on the supporting seat, and the meter frame is installed on the rotary disc body. The tail pipe sealing device is simple in structure and convenient to use, the problem that the tail pipe sealing device is difficult to install due to delayed installation of the main engine or the intermediate shaft in the prior art can be solved by using the tail pipe sealing device, the installation accuracy of the tail pipe sealing device can be improved, and the installation strength of constructors can be reduced.

title_en: Plastic barrel cover injection molding rear cover edge cutting device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of plastic product processing, in particular to a plastic barrel cover injection molding rear cover edge cutting device which comprises a rack, a cutting rotating mechanism, a barrel cover clamping size control mechanism and the like; the bottom of the frame is provided with a cutting rotating mechanism, and the middle part of the frame is provided with a barrel cover clamping mechanism and connected with the cutting rotating mechanism. According to the barrel cover cutting and clamping device, the barrel cover clamping mechanism and the barrel cover cutting and rotating mechanism are arranged, so that the barrel cover clamping mechanism is used for clamping a passing barrel cover, then the barrel cover cutting and rotating mechanism is used for cutting the fixed barrel cover, and the function of accurately cutting the passing barrel cover edge is realized.

title_en: Rolling mill roller lubricant spraying structure and spraying method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rolling mill roller lubricant injection structure and an injection method thereof, and the rolling mill roller lubricant injection structure comprises a bottom plate, a lifting mechanism, injection pieces and an infusion pump, wherein struts are fixed at four corners of the top end of the bottom plate, the tops of four groups of struts are connected with a support plate, the top end of the bottom plate is fixed with the lifting mechanism and a liquid storage tank, the top end of the lifting mechanism is connected with a top plate, a filter piece and the infusion pump are fixed at the top end of the liquid storage tank, a liquid inlet pipe of the infusion pump extends into the liquid storage tank, a liquid outlet pipe of the infusion pump is connected with a three-way pipe, the three-way pipe is connected with two groups of hoses, the end parts of the two groups of hoses far away from the three-way pipe are respectively connected with two groups of guide pipes, the end parts of the two groups of guide pipes far away from the three-way pipe respectively penetrate through two groups of adjusting pieces and two groups of supporting pieces and are respectively connected with the two groups of injection pieces, and the two groups of adjusting pieces are both fixed on a guide rail. The rolling mill roller lubricant spraying structure and the spraying method thereof are convenient to adjust and use and are beneficial to spraying of the lubricant.

title_en: Production method of aluminum foil for high-adhesion lithium ion battery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a production method of an aluminum foil for a high-adhesion lithium ion battery, which specifically comprises the following steps: s1, rough rolling and medium rolling: carrying out rough rolling and medium rolling on the aluminum foil by using a roller with the roughness of 0.11-0.13 mu, and using rolling oil with the temperature of 30-50 ℃ during rolling; s2, finish rolling: finish rolling the aluminum foil by using a roller with the roughness of less than 0.06 mu and the reduction rate of 37-40%, controlling the rolling speed to be less than 550m/min, and spraying rolling oil with the temperature of more than 52 ℃ during finish rolling; s3, standing and volatilizing: and (4) placing the aluminum foil coil after finish rolling until rolling oil in the aluminum foil coil is dissipated and volatilized. The scheme uses large reduction rate, low roughness, high rolling oil temperature and controls the rolling speed, so that the volatilization of rolling oil is increased while the surface quality of an aluminum foil finished product is controlled. And the high oil temperature can further volatilize the rolling oil in the process of placing the finished aluminum foil material, thereby further reducing the oil film on the surface of the aluminum foil.

title_en: Alternating-current magnetic field assisted laser deep fusion welding method for reducing aluminum alloy weld joint air holes
abstract_en: An alternating current magnetic field assisted laser deep fusion welding method for reducing air holes of an aluminum alloy weld joint is characterized in that an alternating current magnetic field is preset below a sample to be welded after the bottom of a butt joint part of the sample to be welded is suspended, a laser welding working head above the sample and the alternating current magnetic field below the sample are kept static in the laser welding process, a laser beam is focused on the upper surface of the aluminum alloy, and the action range of the magnetic field always covers the whole molten pool area until laser deep fusion welding is completed. The method ensures that the weld penetration is not changed, and simultaneously reduces the porosity of the weld to the maximum extent, namely increases the bearing area of the weld. In addition, irregular fluctuation of the original weld surface due to the presence of pores is also suppressed, and the improvement of the surface shaping also contributes to the improvement of the joint strength.

title_en: Comprehensive evaluation method for welding thermal crack sensitivity
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive evaluation method for welding thermal crack sensitivity, which can simultaneously evaluate thermal cracks such as solidification cracks, liquefied cracks, high-temperature ductility loss cracks and the like in the welding process and is suitable for austenitic stainless steel and nickel-based materials. The method comprises the steps of performing fixed spot welding at the center of a sample, bending after arc contraction, observing the areas near a welding line and a fusion line by using an optical microscope, distinguishing the types of the thermal cracks, counting the number of the cracks of different types, the total length of the cracks, the maximum length of the cracks, the distribution range of the cracks and the like, establishing a corresponding relation with strain, and evaluating the sensitivity of the thermal cracks of different types. The method is simple, easy to judge the type of the hot cracks, low in cost, real and reliable in test result and has important significance for evaluating the sensitivity of the welding hot cracks.

title_en: Comprehensive evaluation method for welding thermal crack sensitivity
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive evaluation method for welding thermal crack sensitivity, which can simultaneously evaluate thermal cracks such as solidification cracks, liquefied cracks, high-temperature ductility loss cracks and the like in the welding process and is suitable for austenitic stainless steel and nickel-based materials. The method comprises the steps of performing fixed spot welding at the center of a sample, bending after arc contraction, observing the areas near a welding line and a fusion line by using an optical microscope, distinguishing the types of the thermal cracks, counting the number of the cracks of different types, the total length of the cracks, the maximum length of the cracks, the distribution range of the cracks and the like, establishing a corresponding relation with strain, and evaluating the sensitivity of the thermal cracks of different types. The method is simple, easy to judge the type of the hot cracks, low in cost, real and reliable in test result and has important significance for evaluating the sensitivity of the welding hot cracks.

title_en: Forming device and forming method for small-diameter no-pressure-head short barrel
abstract_en: The application discloses forming device and forming method of a small-diameter short cylinder without a pressure head, and aims to solve the technical problems that only one-half forming can be performed and the pressure head needs to be left in the prior art. The device comprises a pressure mechanism and a tooling mechanism. The tooling mechanism is detachably connected to the inner side of the pressure mechanism and can extrude the plate under the driving of the pressure mechanism, so that the plate is bent into an arc shape along a plain line until the whole plate is bent into a cylindrical shape; after the tool mechanism is disassembled, the plate processed into the cylindrical shape can be integrally moved out. The device is through connecting frock mechanism detachable in the pressure mechanism inboard for processing into cylindric panel, can wholly break away from frock mechanism through frock mechanism's dismantlement end, effectively solved and can only make the half shaping among the prior art, and need leave the technical problem of pressure head, and then realized the one-time compression moulding of barrel, improved work efficiency, practiced thrift material cost.

title_en: Ammeter case equipment workstation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric meter box assembling workbench which comprises a workbench body (50), a first supporting seat (20), a first clamp (10), a second supporting seat (40), a second clamp (30) and an industrial personal computer (60); the first supporting seat (20) and the second supporting seat (40) are arranged on the surface of the workbench body (50), a first guide rail (21) is arranged between the first supporting seat (20) and the second supporting seat (40), and the first clamp (10) and the second clamp (30) can move along the direction of the first guide rail (21); the industrial personal computer (60) is arranged in the workbench body (50), and the industrial personal computer (60) is used for controlling the first clamp (10) and the second clamp (30) to complete grabbing and mounting of corresponding target equipment. According to the embodiment of the invention, the electric meter box assembly can be completed by controlling the movement matching of the first clamp 10 and the second clamp 30, so that the installation efficiency and the installation quality of the electric meter box are improved.

title_en: Wood board processing device for pencil processing
abstract_en: The invention provides a wood board processing device for pencil processing, which comprises a water storage tank and a soaking tank arranged on the upper surface of the water storage tank, wherein one side surface of the water storage tank is connected with a water pump through a connecting pipe, the water outlet end of the water pump is provided with a water delivery pipe, the upper end of the water delivery pipe is arranged at the upper part of one side surface of the soaking tank and communicated with the soaking tank, a plurality of supporting plates for supporting and lifting wood boards are uniformly arranged in the soaking tank, the lower surfaces of the supporting plates are provided with detachable floating plates, two ends of each supporting plate are respectively provided with a vertically arranged U-shaped groove, the U-shaped grooves are fixedly connected with the soaking tank, two ends of each supporting plate are respectively fixed with a sliding block, and the upper surface of each supporting plate is provided with an inserting groove for inserting wood boards, and compared: the wood board can fall slowly, and the probability of water splash splashing when the wood board is placed is reduced.

title_en: Concealed hydraulic automatic tool changing system for machining center tool magazine
abstract_en: The invention provides an inner concealed hydraulic automatic tool changing system for a machining center tool magazine, which comprises an oil distribution seat, wherein 4 oil way holes are formed below the left side of the oil distribution seat, a mounting hole is formed in the middle of the oil distribution seat, a force output shaft is mounted in the mounting hole, a piston rod is mounted in the force output shaft through a sealing ring, the left end of the piston rod is fixedly provided with a rear end cap of the force output shaft through a bolt, a signal induction coil is fixedly sleeved outside the rear end cap of the force output shaft, an oil cylinder assembly is mounted on the right side of the oil distribution seat, the oil cylinder assembly is sleeved outside the force output shaft, an oil cylinder end cover is fixedly arranged on the right side of the oil cylinder assembly in a threaded manner, a guide groove is formed in the side surface of the force output shaft, a tool arm is mounted on the outer side of the force output shaft, a guide cylinder is fixedly arranged on the right side of the tool arm, a guide cylinder is movably mounted on the outer side of the force output shaft, a front end cap of the force output shaft is mounted on the right end of the force output shaft, and a guide cylinder end cover is fixedly arranged on the right end of the force output shaft.

title_en: Bamboo wood processing is with high-efficient peeling device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-efficiency peeling device for bamboo wood processing, in particular to the technical field of bamboo wood processing, which comprises a workbench, a rotary fixing component, a moving component, a lifting component, a translation component, a peeling component and a dust collection component, the rotary fixing components are arranged in two groups, the two groups of rotary fixing components are symmetrically arranged on the workbench, the two groups of moving components are symmetrically arranged on the workbench, the two groups of lifting components are respectively arranged on one group of moving components, the translation components are fixedly arranged on the two groups of lifting components, the peeling component is fixedly arranged at the working end of the translation components, the dust collection assembly is fixedly arranged on one side of the workbench, so that the working efficiency is greatly improved, the quality of the peeling operation is ensured, the manpower and material resources are saved, and the practicability of the device is greatly improved.

title_en: Cup bottom punching device of disposable plastic cup
abstract_en: The invention provides a cup bottom punching device of a disposable plastic cup, which comprises a punch component, a cup edge forming component and a female die, wherein the punch component comprises an upper fixing plate, a punch is arranged at the lower end of the upper fixing plate, and a first driving mechanism is arranged on the upper fixing plate; the cup edge forming assembly comprises a lower fixing plate, a pressing block is arranged at the lower end of the lower fixing plate, an annular blade is sleeved on the outer wall of the pressing block and can move up and down on the pressing block, and a second driving mechanism is arranged on the lower fixing plate; and a cavity matched with the punch is arranged on the female die, and a second annular groove matched with the pressing block is formed in the upper end of the cavity. The cup bottom punching device of the disposable plastic cup has the advantages of novel structural design, convenience and quickness in use, convenience in blade detachment, high economic value and high forming efficiency.

title_en: Clamping device for overhauling and installing electromechanical equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electronics, and discloses a clamping device for overhauling and installing electromechanical equipment. At the in-process of electromechanical overhaul installation, the operation hydraulic press, can make hydraulic telescoping rod reciprocate, thereby the removal dish that drives the bottom reciprocates, again because the removal dish size is less than the size of function board export and import under, make the removal dish can contact with the electromechanical device of bottom, four movable blocks of rerun, make the rubber slab of grip block press from both sides electromechanical device tight fixedly, then shift up electromechanical device through hydraulic telescoping rod, it is simple swift, the practicality of improvement, and the rubber slab can reduce the damage that electromechanical device received when pressing from both sides tightly, increase electromechanical device's life.

title_en: Hot rolling equipment and hot rolling method for hot-rolled galvanized plate
abstract_en: The invention discloses hot rolling equipment and a hot rolling method for hot-rolled galvanized plates, relates to the technical field of hot-rolled galvanized plate production, and aims to solve the problems that the existing hot rolling equipment for hot-rolled galvanized plates is single in function and reduces the use flexibility due to simple structure. The top of base is provided with first backup pad, the second backup pad is installed to one side of first backup pad, the inside of base is provided with the holding tank, the internally mounted of holding tank has the lead screw, install first rough roll between first backup pad and the second backup pad, the second rough roll is installed to the top of first rough roll, first finishing roll is installed to the rear of first rough roll, the second finishing roll is installed to the rear of second rough roll, first finishing roll is all installed to the below of first rough roll and the top of second finishing roll, the second finishing roll is all installed to the below of first finishing roll and the top of second finishing roll.

title_en: Environment-friendly industrial solid waste recycling and extruding device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an environment-friendly industrial solid waste recycling and extruding device which comprises a machine body, wherein a feeding opening is formed in the upper side wall of the machine body, a feeding frame is fixedly connected to the upper side wall of the machine body at a position corresponding to the feeding opening, a drying mechanism, a crushing mechanism and an extruding mechanism are sequentially arranged inside the machine body from top to bottom, a material taking opening is formed in the outer side wall of the machine body, and a material taking sealing door is hinged in the material taking opening. Has the advantages that: the three steps of drying, crushing and extrusion forming are integrated into one step, the process is simplified, the equipment cost is saved, additional equipment does not need to be purchased for waste transfer, the time and the labor are saved in the whole process, the recovery period is short, and the recovery efficiency is high.

title_en: Automatic discharging mechanism for laser cutting machine
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of laser cutting, and particularly relates to an automatic blanking mechanism for a laser cutting machine, which comprises an operation table, wherein a transmission cavity is arranged in the operation table, a supporting plate strip is arranged at the upper end of the transmission cavity, a movable plate is fixedly connected to the lower side of the supporting plate strip, two supporting rods are symmetrically arranged on the lower side of the movable plate, a control screw rod is connected to the lower side of each supporting rod in a threaded manner, a fixed supporting frame is arranged in the middle of the transmission cavity, two driven gear sets are symmetrically arranged at the left end and the right end of the fixed supporting frame, and a transmission chain is arranged between the two driven. When the blanking device is used, laser cutting operation is convenient to carry out through the rising of the supporting lath, and when blanking is needed, only the descending of the supporting lath needs to be controlled, so that the cut plate stays at the upper side of the conveying chain and moves along with the rotation of the conveying chain, and the purpose of blanking is achieved.

title_en: Transverse displacement device for pipeline welding
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transverse displacement device for pipeline welding, which comprises a frame body, wherein a fixed table is arranged on the top surface of the frame body, a central rod is arranged on the fixed table, a first inner top block is arranged in the middle of the central rod, and a first roller is arranged on the inner top block; second inner top blocks are arranged on two sides and the lower side of the end part of the central rod, and second rollers are arranged on the second inner top blocks; the middle part of the frame body is provided with a mounting frame, the mounting frame is provided with a first motor, and the output end of the first motor is provided with a first belt wheel; a frame body is arranged at one end of the top surface of the frame body, moving guide rails are respectively arranged at the upper end and the lower end of the frame body, two clamping blocks are arranged between the moving guide rails, and a roller is arranged in the middle of each clamping block; a positive and negative screw rod penetrates through the lower end of the frame body, a second belt wheel is arranged at one end of the positive and negative screw rod, and the second belt wheel is connected with the first belt wheel through a belt; the threaded ends of the positive and negative screw rods are respectively in threaded connection with the corresponding clamping blocks; the invention can stably and transversely move the pipeline, is convenient to disassemble and assemble, and saves time and labor.

title_en: Rolling machine and rolling method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rolling machine and a rolling method thereof, and the rolling machine comprises a rack, an axle coupler, an axial gear and a rolling device, wherein the rack is symmetrically arranged on the left side and the right side, a rolling shaft mechanism is arranged between the racks, the rolling shaft mechanism comprises a fixed roller arranged above and a first rotating roller and a second rotating roller arranged below, the racks are respectively provided with a rectangular leaning opening and a circular notch, so that the axle coupler can be respectively and fixedly connected with the first rotating roller and the second rotating roller through the circular notch, the side end of the fixed roller passes through the rectangular leaning opening and is fixedly connected through a bolt, and the rolling device controls the first rotating roller and the second rotating roller to roll. The double-plate rolling device has the beneficial effects that the feeding structures on the left side and the right side are arranged, so that the effect of simultaneously rolling double plates can be realized, the rolling is accurate, the rolling efficiency is improved, the whole device is easy to operate, and the integral rolling performance is improved.

title_en: Four-chuck laser pipe cutting system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a four-chuck laser pipe cutting system which comprises a four-chuck laser pipe cutting machine, a feeding mechanism and a discharging mechanism, wherein the feeding mechanism and the discharging mechanism are arranged in front of the four-chuck laser pipe cutting machine, and each of the feeding mechanism and the discharging mechanism consists of a plurality of material rack modules arranged at intervals; the material rack module comprises a rack, a material storage mechanism and a transverse moving material conveying mechanism, wherein the material storage mechanism and the transverse moving material conveying mechanism are arranged on the rack, the material storage mechanism on the material feeding mechanism is driven by a material feeding synchronous driving mechanism, and the material storage mechanism on the material discharging mechanism is driven by a material discharging synchronous driving mechanism. The feeding mechanism and the discharging mechanism are both set to be universal material rack modules, so that the structure of the feeding and discharging rack is simplified, and the universality is improved.

title_en: Hot melting cutting machine for wool cotton cloth special-shaped materials
abstract_en: The invention relates to a hot melting cutting machine, in particular to a hot melting cutting machine for a plush cotton cloth special-shaped material. The technical problem to be solved is as follows: the plush-cotton-cloth special-shaped material hot melting cutting machine can realize automatic up-and-down pressing and moving. A hot-melting cutting machine for plush cotton cloth special-shaped materials comprises an operating platform and a fixed pile, wherein one side of the top of the operating platform is connected with the fixed pile; the fixing pile is connected with a vertical rod; the vertical rod is connected with a lifting rotating mechanism; the lifting rotating mechanism is connected with the moving mechanism; the moving mechanism is connected with the separating mechanism; and the hot melting mechanism is connected between the moving mechanism and the separating mechanism. Through the cooperation between lifting and rotating mechanism, moving mechanism, hot melt mechanism and the disengagement mechanism, can rotate this device and place the cotton into, carry out the hot melt cutting to the cotton is automatic afterwards, need not artifical continuous luffing motion arm cutting like this, improve people's work efficiency.

title_en: Ultrathin welding gasket, preparation method, welding method and semiconductor device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an ultrathin welding gasket, a preparation method, a welding method and a semiconductor device, and relates to the field of soldering lugs. The ultra-thin bonding pad includes: the solder layer is formed by uniformly attaching solder liquid to the surface of the internal support structure. The preparation method of the ultrathin welding gasket comprises the following steps: and immersing the internal support structure subjected to the surface treatment process into the welding flux liquid, and then taking out and cooling. The welding method based on the ultrathin welding gasket is to place the ultrathin welding gasket between welding surfaces to be welded and then carry out reflow welding to form the semiconductor device. The ultrathin welding gasket is flat and free of warping, the welding flux is uniform, the minimum thickness of a single layer is only 5 micrometers, and the requirement for high-precision welding can be met.

title_en: Electrolytic aluminum anode bar cleaning equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses electrolytic aluminum anode bar cleaning equipment, which mainly relates to the technical field of cleaning equipment and comprises a basic unit, a polishing unit, a scraping unit and a control unit, wherein the polishing unit, the scraping unit and the control unit are all arranged on the basic unit, the basic unit comprises a box body, a workbench, a cross beam and two upright columns, and the polishing unit and the scraping unit are arranged below the cross beam according to the sequence of cleaning anode bars. The polishing unit and the scraping unit are arranged, the two units adopt different cleaning modes, one is friction collision cleaning, the other is scraping wiping cleaning, the two units can be used for cleaning independently or together, the application range is wide, and the cleaning quality is good; the grinding cylinder is arranged to clean the broken scrap iron and the outer wall of the anode rod by friction and collision, so that the process is simple and the anode rod is convenient to popularize and use; the scraping cylinder is arranged, the anode rod is descended to automatically scrape and wipe multiple layers, the cleaning is thorough, and time and labor are saved.

title_en: Plane inclined hole puncher
abstract_en: The invention discloses a plane inclined hole punching machine, which comprises a storage body, wherein a storage cavity is arranged in the storage body, a working body is fixedly arranged at the upper side of the storage body, the working body is provided with a working cavity, a communicating cavity is communicated between the working cavity and the storage cavity, an electric telescopic rod is fixedly arranged at the bottom wall body of the working cavity, and a middle rod is fixedly arranged at the shaft end part of the electric telescopic rod. Damage to the device and the workpiece.

title_en: Photoelectron spot welding head based on temperature automatically regulated heating range
abstract_en: The invention provides a photoelectron spot welding machine head capable of automatically adjusting a heating range based on temperature, and relates to the technical field of photoelectron device manufacturing. This photoelectron spot welding head based on temperature automatically regulated heating range, including engine body shell, engine body shell's inside fixed mounting has the heating core, the heat transfer spring is in the one end fixedly connected with gas tank of keeping away from the heating core, the inside swing joint of gas tank has the slurcam, the slurcam is in the one end fixedly connected with spring post of keeping away from the gas tank. The temperature through the heating core rises, makes the inside gas expansion of gas tank drive catch bar and removes, uses the drive magnetic pole through the cooperation of spring post with the electro-magnet to remove to make the slider drive the baffle and remove, reduce the scope of heating, reached the effect of automatically regulated heating range, the removal through the slider drives the ratch and removes, thereby makes the rotor at the inside removal of body shell, has reached the effect of clean welding slag.

title_en: Decomposition method for lower end bearing of main oil regulating pump of aircraft engine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of maintenance of aero-engines, in particular to a method for decomposing a lower end bearing of a main oil regulating pump of an aero-engine, which can improve the decomposition efficiency and reduce the scrapping cost, and comprises the following steps: a. firstly, tensioning the puller rubber at the puller ends of two decomposers, then respectively arranging the two decomposers in an inner hole of a driving gear bearing and an inner hole of a driven gear bearing, and then fixedly arranging a punch hammer at the top of each decomposer to take out a driving gear bearing assembly and a driven gear bearing assembly upwards; b. secondly, separating the driving gear bearing from a side plate of the driving gear bearing; c. next, pulling out the bearing side plate of the driving gear by a side plate pulling-out structure of the side plate pulling-out device; d. after the bearing side plate of the driving gear is decomposed, the driving gear bearing is taken out; e. repeating the modes from the step b to the step d, and taking out the driven gear bearing; f. and (5) polishing burrs. The invention is particularly suitable for the decomposition process of the lower end bearing of the main oil regulating pump of the aircraft engine.

title_en: Polishing method based on drive axle housing polishing device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a polishing method based on a drive axle housing polishing device, which realizes the fixation and the positioning of the whole device by a fixing auxiliary component and a positioning fixing component which are arranged on the outer wall of the rear end of a cylindrical housing in the drive axle housing polishing device, so that the whole device is positioned at the center; through the connection auxiliary assembly, the gear assembly that cylindrical casing front end set up, in time transmit the transmission for polishing subassembly, utilize a plurality of polishing subassemblies to polish respectively the transaxle housing inner space and polish. The polishing method based on the drive axle housing polishing device can polish and polish the inner wall of the complex structure in the drive axle housing, and has the advantages of easy operation, high efficiency, good effect and convenient use.

title_en: Forging processing method for TC32 titanium alloy large-size bar
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of titanium alloy forging, and particularly discloses a forging processing method of a TC32 titanium alloy large-size bar. The invention can realize the precise regulation and control of the tissue to obtain the required mechanical property, improve the consistency of the flaw detection level of the bar, ensure the uniform tissue and performance and increase the yield.

title_en: Split type extruder
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of compression, in particular to a split type extruder which comprises an extruder body and is characterized in that the extruder body comprises a motor, a speed reducer, a machine tool, a main shaft and a differential unit, wherein the motor and the speed reducer are fixedly arranged on the machine tool through a base, the motor is connected with the speed reducer, and the main shaft is driven by the speed reducer to transmit, so that the problem that the forward pushing force of a fed material is small is solved, the pushing force required by rear-section extrusion is effectively provided, and the problem of material blockage caused by too large extrusion force of the extruder is solved.

title_en: Full-automatic workpiece arrangement device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full-automatic workpiece arrangement device which comprises a support frame, a workpiece placement device, a workpiece calibration device, an air compressor and a control circuit, wherein the workpiece placement device and the workpiece calibration device are arranged on the support frame. The workpiece placement device can rapidly arrange the workpieces on the placement frame, and then the workpiece alignment device is used for alignment and alignment to finish the arrangement and placement of the workpieces. The invention can rapidly, accurately and efficiently put the workpieces in order for subsequent processing. The invention has reasonable structure and low manufacturing cost, can greatly improve the production efficiency, saves the labor cost and has good market value.

title_en: A equipment for dustpan dish cutting is polished
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cutting and polishing device, in particular to a dustpan disk cutting and polishing device. The equipment for cutting and polishing the dustpan disc can control the speed and the quantity of discharging, fix the dustpan disc and achieve high cutting and polishing efficiency. The invention provides a device for cutting and polishing a dustpan disk, which comprises: the bottom plate is used for mounting the whole equipment; the fixed seat is arranged on one side of the top of the bottom plate; the servo motor is arranged in the fixed seat; the clamping mechanism is arranged at one part of the top of the bottom plate; and the rotating mechanism is arranged in the middle of the top of the bottom plate. The convex circle, the wedge block and the clamping rod are matched, when the convex circle rotates to upwards push the second connecting plate, the wedge block is driven to inwards push the clamping rod, the push rod pushes one dustpan disk forwards, and the clamping rod abuts against the dustpan disk above the clamping rod, so that intermittent feeding is performed by controlling the dustpan disk.

title_en: Server PCBA welding compression fittings
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of welding and laminating devices, in particular to a server PCBA welding and laminating device, which comprises a clamp base, wherein limiting rods are correspondingly arranged at the corners of the upper surface of the clamp base, the upper surface of the clamp base is connected with a 5GMOBPCB through the limiting rods, clamping grooves are correspondingly arranged on the upper surface of the clamp base and positioned at the front side and the rear side of the 5GMOBPCB, through holes are correspondingly arranged on the upper surface of the clamp base and positioned at the inner sides of the clamping grooves, PAM plates are correspondingly arranged on the upper surface of the 5GMOBPCB, clamp glands are correspondingly arranged on the upper surface of the clamp base and positioned above the 5GMOBPCB, buckles are correspondingly arranged on the front side and the rear side of the bottom of the clamp glands, positioning rods are correspondingly arranged on the front side and the rear side of the bottom of the clamp glands and positioned at the inner sides of the buckles, the invention can improve the overall convenience, stability, accuracy and practicability of 5G mainboard production through design.

title_en: Vertically-moving type machine head multi-head hoop bending machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-head hoop bending machine with an up-and-down movable machine head, which relates to the technical field of hoop bending machines and comprises a hoop bending device, wherein the hoop bending device comprises: the machine head assembly comprises a machine head body, a sliding frame, a first vertical linear driving device, a vertical rack and a second vertical linear driving device, wherein the machine head body is slidably arranged on the sliding frame and is connected with the first vertical linear driving device; the crank arm assembly comprises a crank arm body and a gear shaft arranged on the crank arm body, and the gear shaft is rotatably arranged on the machine head body and meshed with the vertical rack; and the die assembly comprises a horizontal linear driving device, the horizontal linear driving device is connected with the mandrel, and the die is detachably arranged on the mandrel. The hoop bending machine is labor-saving and time-saving, and has good processing quality.

title_en: Multi-station rotary tool rest
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of tool rests, and particularly relates to a multi-station rotary tool rest which comprises a base, a tool rest mechanism arranged on the base, a rotating mechanism arranged on the base and driving the tool rest mechanism to rotate, a driving mechanism arranged on the tool rest mechanism and driving the tool rest mechanism to work, and a braking mechanism arranged on the base and preventing the tool rest mechanism from shaking. The tool rest mechanism comprises a tool rest body, a main shaft, a bearing and a tool chuck, wherein the tool chuck is arranged at the outer end of the main shaft, and a first bevel gear is arranged at the inner end of the main shaft; the driving mechanism comprises a driving motor and a second bevel gear in transmission connection with the first bevel gear; the rotating mechanism comprises a rotating motor, a worm wheel, a rotating shaft and a second bearing, the base comprises an upper base and a lower base, the upper base is fixedly connected with the worm wheel, and the rotating motor is provided with the worm in transmission connection with the worm wheel; the brake mechanism comprises a brake disc arranged on the upper base and a brake caliper fixed on the lower base. The cutter is convenient and quick to switch and high in working efficiency.

title_en: Touch-sensitive screen mount that fixed stability just can prevent to empty is made to intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of touch screen manufacturing, and discloses an intelligently manufactured touch screen fixing frame which is stable in fixing and capable of preventing toppling. This touch-sensitive screen mount that fixed stability just can prevent to empty is made to intelligence, and to the touch-sensitive screen automatic fixation that needs processing, and the intensity of ability control fixed power, prevents that the too big touch-sensitive screen that leads to of fixed dynamics from appearing damaging, when the touch-sensitive screen of processing appears turning on one's side the phenomenon, stabilizes it automatically, prevents that the touch-sensitive screen from dropping and leads to economic loss.

title_en: Environment-friendly flame-retardant light office furniture board and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an environment-friendly flame-retardant light office furniture board and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the field of beauty cosmetics. The environment-friendly flame-retardant light office furniture board and the preparation method thereof have the advantages of light weight, environmental protection, flame retardance and insect prevention in the aspect of products, glue, a modifier and the like used in production are non-toxic or high-temperature-resistant materials, so that negative effects of harmful gas emitted by burning of the board in case of fire on the surrounding environment and people are avoided, in the aspect of the method, chips produced in the process of slotting the protective base layer are used as raw materials of the powder layer, the consumption of the materials is reduced, and the problems of large material consumption and low production efficiency in the existing part of preparation methods are solved.

title_en: Support device, machine tool and method for supporting a rod-shaped workpiece
abstract_en: The invention relates to a support device, a machine tool and a method for supporting a rod-shaped workpiece. In particular, the support device comprises at least one double support adapted to support a portion of the workpiece in a support area, wherein the double support comprises two support elements each rotatable about a rotation axis, wherein each of the rotation axes is perpendicular to the longitudinal axis, wherein each support element comprises a sector-shaped support surface which together form a semi-circular support surface adapted to support a portion of the workpiece, wherein the support area comprises an open side opposite the semi-circular support surface, and wherein the support elements are adapted to provide a varying diameter of the semi-circular support surface based on a rotational position about the rotation axis in order to support the varying workpiece.

title_en: Fastening structure
abstract_en: The invention provides a fastening structure, which comprises a head part, a rod body and an assembling body, wherein the head part is connected with the rod body; the head part is provided with a lateral setting part and a straight penetrating part; the rod body is provided with a lateral assembling part and a buckling body; the rod body is arranged in the penetrating part of the head part in a penetrating way, the group arranging part corresponds to the arranging part, and the group connecting body is arranged in the group arranging part and the arranging part in a penetrating way and is used for combining the head part and the rod body; in addition, the body part can be movably combined with the head part. Therefore, when at least two objects are combined, the head part can be operated, the buckling part of the rod body is driven, the buckling part penetrates through the first object and then is buckled on the second object, when the head part is moved reversely, the buckling part is moved away from the second object, and then the first object and the second object are separated, so that the effects of quick combination and easy removal are achieved.

title_en: Transverse riveting machine
abstract_en: The invention provides a transverse riveting machine, which structurally comprises a base, a pedal, a machine body, an adjusting wheel and a riveting machine, wherein the riveting machine comprises a pedestal, a nail head machine, a clamping table and a chuck device, the invention is characterized in that two half hoops are oppositely placed and combined by opening an opening ring opening in a fixed ring, so that the half hoops are fixed on an inner ring strip, a pull rod is pulled backwards to enable the middle part of a ring disc to be drawn inwards, the pull rod is better attached between ring walls by virtue of a roller, metal scraps falling off during riveting can fall along with an inclination angle and can not be left in the ring disc, the gap between the hoop and the inner ring strip is prevented from being enlarged, meanwhile, the hoop is clamped and fixed on a placing table by virtue of side clamping rods on two sides of a top plate, the nut is prevented from deviating during riveting, the top fixing plate is moved left and right before riveting, so that the position of a hoop hole can be adjusted to reduce the error of the hoop, and the distance between the clamping plates can be reduced, so that small parts can be fixed, and the application range is enlarged.

title_en: Threaded part assembling tool suitable for narrow cylindrical clamping surface
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a screw member assembling tool suitable for a narrow cylindrical clamping surface, wherein the tool comprises: the clamping device comprises a clamping base body (1), tooth-shaped clamping jaws (2), large head screws (3), elastic pressing sheets (4) and limiting pins (5); tooth type jack catch (2) are installed in the inside annular slot of centre gripping base member (1), are pushed down by the elasticity preforming (4) of both sides, and elasticity preforming (4) are by spacer pin (5) restriction position, and big head screw (3) are followed centre gripping base member excircle screw hole screw in, withhold tooth type jack catch (2). The device has simple structure and easy operation, can transmit larger torque without other tools during installation, is particularly suitable for assembling the optical lens with the ultra-narrow knurled clamping surface, and can not damage the knurled clamping surface.

title_en: Method for preventing laser head from being damaged due to collision and anti-collision damage device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of laser cutting, in particular to a method for preventing a laser head from being damaged due to collision and an anti-collision damage device.A user firstly tests the electromagnetic force required by the laser head not to fall off during the idle running at the maximum acceleration and tests the electromagnetic force required by the laser head to fall off during the idle running at the maximum acceleration under collision, and the user adjusts the current in an electromagnetic coil to ensure that the electromagnetic force generated by the electromagnetic coil is moderate in size; if the electromagnetic force generated by the electromagnetic coil enables the laser head not to fall off when the laser head runs at the maximum acceleration in an idle running mode, the laser head can fall off when the laser head runs at the maximum acceleration in an idle running mode due to collision, and the laser head is not damaged, the current with the proper magnitude is obtained. When current with proper magnitude is loaded in the electromagnetic coil, the laser head can not be damaged even if the laser head collides with an obstacle at the maximum acceleration; if the laser head drops, the laser head can be held by the anticreep cable wire, avoids the damage that the laser head dropped and leads to.

title_en: Automatic detection equipment for numerical control machine tool
abstract_en: The invention discloses automatic detection equipment for a numerical control machine tool, which relates to the technical field of numerical control machine tools and comprises a workbench, a processing table, a supporting guide rail and a sliding plate, wherein the top of the workbench is fixedly connected with the bottom of the processing table, one side of the supporting guide rail is fixedly connected with the outer wall of the workbench, the inner wall of the sliding plate is slidably connected with the outer wall of the supporting guide rail, the outer wall of the sliding plate is in threaded connection with a connecting plate, one side of the connecting plate is provided with a sleeve, a loop bar and a detection roller, and the outer wall of the loop bar is fixedly connected with a micro blower. The invention is convenient for the detection roller to extend back and forth on the surface of the processing table through the matching of the sleeve and the loop bar, can better adapt to the length of the processing table, can blow away the debris in front of the detection roller through the miniature blower arranged on the surface of the loop bar, and avoids the abrasion of the detection roller or the surface of the working table when the detection roller rolls the debris.

title_en: Adjusting device of vehicle-mounted camera
abstract_en: The invention discloses an adjusting device of a vehicle-mounted camera, which comprises a supporting plate, a supporting rod, a supporting roller, a position adjusting mechanism, a supporting sliding rod and an angle adjusting mechanism, wherein the supporting plate is connected with the position adjusting mechanism through the supporting rod and the supporting roller, and the position adjusting mechanism is connected with the angle adjusting mechanism through the supporting sliding rod. The position adjusting mechanism comprises an upper base, a screw rod, a sliding block and a supporting roller, wherein a groove is formed in the top of the upper base, the screw rod and the sliding block are arranged in the groove and are in sliding connection, the supporting roller is arranged at the bottom of the sliding block, and the supporting roller is in sliding connection with the groove. The invention can quickly correct and greatly reduce the pressure of the slide block and the screw rod; through the cooperation of position control structure and angle modulation structure, can be effectively with the automatic quick alignment of the on-vehicle look around camera on the vehicle test, supporting roller and backing roll can support the vehicle that awaits measuring when adjusting the position of the vehicle that awaits measuring, prevent that the atress is too big on the lead screw from resulting in its easy deformation.

title_en: Steel base material preprocessing device for building construction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a steel base material preprocessing device for building construction, relates to the technical field of building construction, and solves the problems that the existing building steel base material cannot well cut workpieces with different angles and lengths in the cutting process, and simultaneously, the cutter and the motor of the existing cutting device are synchronously lifted, the weight of a machine head is heavy in cutting, the operation is inconvenient, and the use is inflexible; the top of the mounting base is rotatably connected with a group of rotary working tables; the front end surface of the rotary workbench is vertically and slidably connected with a group of lifting components; the bottom of the lifting component is connected with a group of front and rear sliding components in a front and rear sliding manner. The invention realizes the cutting of parts with different angles and different widths, has higher practicability, simultaneously, the motor and the cutting tool are separately designed, and only the tool is lifted and slid in use, so the operation is more portable and flexible, the use convenience is improved, and the cutting angle and the cutting depth are better controlled.

title_en: Numerical control electric spark reciprocating wire cutting machine Z-axis structure
abstract_en: The invention provides a Z-axis structure of a numerical control electric spark reciprocating wire cutting machine tool, which comprises a main shaft, a sliding seat and a pressing component, wherein the main shaft is connected with the sliding seat; a sliding hole for the main shaft to pass through is formed in the sliding seat, the main shaft moves and displaces in the sliding seat along the Z-axis direction, and a pressing assembly is arranged on the sliding seat; a sliding joint surface for positioning, guiding and preventing torsion with the sliding seat is arranged on the cylindrical surface of the main shaft along the axial direction; the sliding seat is provided with a first combination surface and a second combination surface on the hole wall of the sliding hole, the first combination surface is tightly attached to the sliding combination surface of the main shaft and is in surface-to-surface sliding fit, the second combination surface is parallel to the axis of the main shaft, and the second combination surface is tightly attached to a generatrix of the excircle of the main shaft and is in surface-to-surface sliding fit with at least one generatrix. This scheme provides good structure for director motion accuracy in the wire-electrode cutting processing, can reduce manufacturing, assembly requirement, improves main shaft motion accuracy, makes production, the application of Z axle construction more convenient, swift, can be applied to mass production, assembly and debugging.

title_en: Device and method for thermally separating hot-feeding hot-charging hot-forging mechanical parts by utilizing high-temperature sensible heat of metallized pellets
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device for separating hot-feeding hot-charging hot-forging mechanical parts by utilizing high-temperature sensible heat of metallized pellets, which sequentially comprises a reduced iron kiln, a heat-resistant steel flow sieve, a high-temperature storage bin, a heat-resistant conical spiral chute and a hydraulic machine according to a process flow; a discharge port of the reduced iron kiln is communicated with a heat-resistant steel flow sieve, and a high-temperature bin is arranged below the heat-resistant steel flow sieve; a discharge hole of the high-temperature bin is communicated with a heat-resistant conical spiral chute; the discharge port of the metallized pellet of the heat-resistant conical spiral chute is communicated with the die cavity of the hydraulic press. The invention also discloses a method for thermally separating, feeding and hot-loading hot forging mechanical parts by utilizing the high-temperature sensible heat of the metallized pellets. The invention creatively develops a new method for producing a product capable of replacing a casting machine part blank by organically combining the direct reduction iron of the iron concentrate powder and the metal powder hot forging technology, and has the characteristics of short flow, energy conservation, emission reduction, high yield, high efficiency, ecology and environmental protection.

title_en: Solder for LED die bonding, preparation method thereof and LED die bonding method
abstract_en: The invention provides a solder for LED die bonding, a preparation method thereof and an LED die bonding method, wherein the solder comprises uniformly mixed solder paste and first soldering flux, and the solder paste comprises solder alloy and second soldering flux; the solder provided by the invention also comprises the first soldering flux which is additionally added and uniformly mixed with the solder paste besides the second soldering flux contained in the solder paste, so that compared with the existing solder paste, the first soldering flux and the second soldering flux in the solder can better cover metal particles in the solder paste, and the metal particles are prevented from being oxidized because of not being covered; meanwhile, the situation that metal particles are oxidized due to volatilization of soldering flux can be reduced, so that the metal shell in the tin paste is melted and gathered in the welding process, the tin melting effect is improved, the product quality is ensured, and the product reliability is improved.

title_en: Machining method of aviation thin-wall aluminum part
