abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tool fixtures, in particular to a machining method of an aviation thin-wall aluminum part, which comprises the following steps: step 1), blanking, cutting an aluminum plate to form an aluminum piece with a shape to be processed; step 2), roughly machining the aluminum piece, respectively clamping one end of the aluminum piece, and machining the other end of the aluminum piece to meet the technological requirements; step 3), performing finish machining on the aluminum piece, wherein the outer conical surfaces and the molded surfaces at two ends of the aluminum piece are respectively subjected to finish machining to meet the process requirements; wherein in step 2 and step 3, the centre gripping frock of chooseing for use all can with aluminium part laminating adaptation, and all adopt the nature inefficacy to release machining stress after each position processing, the aluminium part is through rough machining, finish machining, chooseing for use different frock and machining at every turn after the nature inefficacy handle combine, has solved current aviation annular forging machine tooling yielding, difficult processing, difficult problem of controlling machining dimension.

title_en: CNC numerical control machining center disc type tool magazine
abstract_en: The invention provides a CNC (computer numerical control) machining center disc type tool magazine which comprises a disc tool magazine, a photoelectric protection mechanism, a tool holder mechanism, a sliding mechanism, a driving mechanism and a cylinder mechanism, wherein a tool holder main body is made of aviation aluminum, the whole weight of the lower tool holder mechanism is reduced, the use strength of the tool holder mechanism is improved, the wear resistance of the tool holder mechanism is enhanced, a rolling wheel is arranged at the front end of the tool holder mechanism, the friction between a tool and a clamping jaw is reduced when the tool is changed, a connecting rod and a return spring at the inner side end of the clamping jaw improve the gripping force of a first tool clamping jaw and a second tool clamping jaw, the situation that the tool drops to delay the machining progress is avoided, the working efficiency is improved, and the maintenance.

title_en: High-intelligent automatic aluminum alloy stamping device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-intelligent automatic aluminum alloy stamping device which comprises a stamping die cavity and an upper die, wherein a gas transfer device for compressing gas is arranged at the bottom of the stamping die cavity, a plurality of support rods are vertically arranged on the upper surface of the stamping die cavity, a top plate is fixed at the tops of the support rods, a sliding hole is formed in the middle of the top of the support rods, the upper die slides in the sliding hole through stamping rods arranged at the tops of the support rods, a gas compression device is arranged in the support rods, hollow springs are wound on the outer side walls of the stamping rods, and the hollow springs are communicated with the gas transfer device through the gas. According to the invention, the annular sealing ring is arranged below the piston moving groove, the top of the annular sealing ring is flush with the bottom of the piston moving groove, and the annular sealing ring is fixedly arranged on the inner side wall of the moving groove, so that gas cannot leak into the piston moving groove when being compressed, and the compressed gas fails.

title_en: Self-adaptive processing machine tool for beveling elbow pipe fitting
abstract_en: The invention relates to a self-adaptive processing machine tool for beveling an elbow pipe fitting, and belongs to the technical field of pipe fitting processing. The machine tool comprises a cutter head; the groove tool apron is arranged on the cutter disc, and the position of the groove tool apron can be adjusted and locked on the cutter disc according to the caliber of the elbow pipe fitting so as to process the grooves of the elbow pipe fittings with different calibers; the groove cutter and the profiling conical roller are arranged on the groove cutter seat, and the position of the groove cutter can be adjusted and locked on the groove cutter seat according to the wall thickness of the elbow pipe, so that grooves of elbow pipes with different wall thicknesses can be machined.

title_en: Protective cover structure for machining equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of machining, and discloses a protective cover structure for machining equipment, which comprises a base, wherein four corners of the upper surface of the base are provided with support columns, a protective baffle is arranged between the support columns on the left side and the right side, the top of each support column is provided with a rotating seat, the upper part of each rotating seat is rotatably connected with the lower part of a sliding block, the upper part of each sliding block is slidably connected with the middle part of the lower surface of a sliding seat, one end of each sliding seat, which is close to the center of a device, is provided with a first rotating shaft, the middle part of each rotating sleeve is rotatably connected with one end, which is close to the center of the device, of a protective cover plate, the right side of the base is rotatably connected with a first lead screw, the middle part of the first lead screw is in threaded connection with the middle part of a sliding plate, and the right side of the sliding plate is provided with a first rotating shaft. The invention is suitable for a protective cover structure of machining equipment, and the upper part of the device can be completely opened by arranging a first driving motor to drive a sliding seat to move along a sliding block.

title_en: A processingequipment for wooden tray
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of wood processing, and particularly discloses a processing device for a wood tray, which comprises a processing table and a plurality of nailing units capable of vertically nailing, wherein a first caulking groove for embedding a batten is arranged on the upper surface of the processing table, a plurality of second caulking grooves for embedding single supporting strips are horizontally arranged at the center of the processing table, the first caulking grooves are communicated with the second caulking grooves, the axis of the first caulking grooves is vertical to the axis of the second caulking grooves, the plurality of nailing units are respectively opposite to the communicated parts of the first caulking grooves and the second caulking grooves, and the nailing units are vertically and slidably mounted on the upper surface of the processing table. The position of corresponding nailing unit cooperatees with the position of support bar and lath laminating department in this scheme, and the nailing is handled when realizing a plurality of nailing positions, and the nailing process is rapid, and can effectual improvement wooden tray's machining efficiency.

title_en: Water cooling system for extruder
abstract_en: The application relates to a water cooling system for an extruder, which comprises a bracket positioned on one side of an extruder body, wherein the upper surface of the bracket is fixedly connected with a cooling tank; the cooling groove is gradually inclined downwards from one end close to the extruding machine body to one end far away from the extruding machine body; a conveying pipe is inserted in the cooling tank, the conveying pipe is of a rectangular tubular structure, the conveying pipe penetrates through the side wall of the cooling tank and is in sliding connection with the cooling tank, and one end of the conveying pipe is communicated with a discharge port of the extruder body; a supporting component is arranged between the conveying pipe and the cooling tank, and a stopping component is arranged at one end of the cooling tank, which is far away from the extruder body; backstop subassembly is kept away from one side of extruder body and is provided with and is used for the dry subassembly of section bar, and this application has the good effect of section bar cooling effect.

title_en: A terrace die reposition of redundant personnel discharge apparatus that is used for Gleeble-3500 testing machine extrusion to press
abstract_en: The invention relates to a male die flow dividing and discharging device for extrusion molding of a Gleeble-3500 testing machine. The technical problems that the temperature of a male die is too high and the overall temperature distribution of the die and a sample is not uniform in the existing die adopting the rotary extrusion process are mainly solved. The technical scheme adopted by the invention is as follows: the utility model provides a punch reposition of redundant personnel discharge apparatus for Gleeble-3500 testing machine extrusion, includes terrace die and die, wherein: still include down flow distribution plate, go up flow distribution plate, a plurality of screw rod resistance and a plurality of pressure spring of unloading, go up the flow distribution plate and adorn in the bottom of die with a plurality of locking screw, the flow distribution plate is established on the top surface of terrace die down, the unthreaded hole that the screw rod resistance passed down the flow distribution plate setting is connected with the screw hole that goes up the flow distribution plate setting, pressure spring of unloading dress is on the screw rod resistance and is located between flow distribution plate and the lower flow distribution plate. The invention has the advantages of simple structure, convenient use, suitability for various deformation materials and the like.

title_en: Ultrasonic welding device and method for manufacturing metal foil stack
abstract_en: The invention relates to an ultrasonic welding device (2) for introducing an embossing surface (16) into a stack of metal foils (14) for a cell of a lithium ion battery, comprising an ultrasonic oscillation unit (4) and an anvil (6), wherein the anvil (6) or the ultrasonic oscillation unit (4) has a number of first projections (8) rising relative to a working surface (4c or 6a) of the anvil or the ultrasonic oscillation unit in order to form the, in particular, rail-like embossing surface (16) by pressing the stack of metal foils (14). The invention further relates to a method for producing a metal foil stack from a metal foil, in particular by means of such an ultrasonic welding device (2), for a cell of a lithium ion battery.

title_en: Adjustable sensor fixing device capable of being rapidly assembled and disassembled
abstract_en: The invention discloses an adjustable sensor fixing device capable of being quickly assembled and disassembled, which relates to the technical field of lathe machining and comprises a fixing plate for fixing a sensor, wherein a fastening bolt is installed at the top of the fixing plate, fixing plate positioning holes are formed in two ends of the fixing plate and used for inserting fixing columns, a plurality of layers of limiting rings are arranged on the fixing columns, the fixing columns are simultaneously inserted into assembling and disassembling base positioning holes in the lower portion, the limiting rings are used for adjusting and fixing an assembling and disassembling base, and a limiting sliding block and a reset spring are installed inside the assembling and disassembling base. According to the invention, the limiting slide block is separated from the fixed column by pressing the limiting slide block, so that the assembling and disassembling base can be moved, the rapid assembling, fixing or disassembling of the tested mechanisms and the sensors with different specifications can be realized, the pressure borne by the sensors can be adjusted by the fastening bolts at the top of the fixed plate, the design is reasonable, the assembling and disassembling steps and difficulty of the sensors are simplified, and the workload is effectively reduced.

title_en: Method and device for detecting contour defects of strip steel plate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for detecting contour defects of a strip steel plate, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring plate outline data of the strip steel, and selecting a judgment interval; according to a preset method, determining a target judgment point in the judgment interval to mark the position where the strip steel profile changes; and determining the slab profile defect points of the strip steel according to the target judgment points so as to determine the quality of the strip steel. The invention discloses a method and a device for detecting the outline defects of a strip steel plate, which are used for solving the technical problem that the quality problem caused by the fact that the strip steel with over-specification flows into the subsequent process because no effective method is used for accurately positioning the outline grade of the hot-rolled strip steel in the prior art.

title_en: Automatic recovery plant that peels off of laminate polymer battery chip
abstract_en: The invention discloses automatic stripping and recycling equipment for soft package battery chips, which comprises a base station, a turnover component and a film rolling component, wherein the base station is arranged on a workbench through a support, the turnover component is arranged on one side of the base station, the film rolling component is arranged at the bottom of the base station, the turnover component and the film rolling component are both arranged on the workbench, a stripping knife is arranged on the base station, and the turnover component is used for flatly laying an object on the base station. The battery pieces do not need to be tiled manually, the operation process is simple, convenient and efficient, and the recovery efficiency of the battery pieces is greatly improved.

title_en: Electric field assisted water-conducting laser cutting device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric field assisted water-guide laser cutting device, which is used for solving the problems that the existing water-guide laser cutting device is high in nozzle cost and difficult to improve processing precision. The device connects high voltage on the nozzle of water-jet guided laser cutting device, the substrate is grounded, and a high-voltage electric field is generated between the substrate and the nozzle, liquid is drawn out from the nozzle through electric field force and columnar jet flow is generated, laser is incident into water and focused on a proper focus, and as light can be totally reflected in the water jet flow, high-energy laser beam can reach the surface to be processed along with the water jet flow, and the purpose of cutting a workpiece is achieved. Compared with a common water-guide laser cutting device, the device can generate jet flow with the diameter smaller than that of the nozzle, so that the purpose of improving the processing precision is achieved; meanwhile, because high pressure is not used for generating water jet, the nozzle does not need to select materials with high hardness, and the manufacturing cost of the nozzle is reduced.

title_en: Polishing device for aluminum product surface strengthening
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polishing device for strengthening the surface of an aluminum material, which comprises a rack, a placing table arranged on the inner side of the rack, fixing mechanisms arranged on two sides of the rack, a moving mechanism arranged on the rack and a polishing mechanism movably arranged on the moving mechanism, wherein the polishing mechanism comprises a moving block movably arranged on the moving mechanism, a first hydraulic rod fixedly arranged below the moving block, a first motor fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the first hydraulic rod and a polishing wheel arranged at the bottom end of the first motor and connected through a connecting column, and a first spring is connected between the connecting column and the polishing wheel. The polishing device for strengthening the surface of the aluminum material can conveniently adjust the contact stress between the polishing wheel and the surface of the aluminum material when the surface of the aluminum material is polished, and improves the polishing quality of the aluminum material to a certain extent.

title_en: Coated cutting tool
abstract_en: The coated cutting tool of the present invention has a hard coating film on the surface of a base material. The hard coating is a nitride of Al, cr, and Si, wherein Al is 50 at% or more, cr is 30 at% or more, si is 1 at% or more and 5 at% or less. The hard coating film contains Ar in an amount of 0.02 at% or less, and has an atomic ratio A and an atomic ratio B of nitrogen satisfying a relationship of 1.02.ltoreq.B/A.ltoreq.1.10, and shows a maximum intensity by a diffraction peak caused by the (111) plane of the face-centered cubic lattice structure. In the section observation of the hard coating film, the droplets with a circular equivalent diameter of 3 μm or more are deposited every 100 μm  2  Less than one. The surface of the hard coating film has an arithmetic mean curvature Spc (1/mm) at the peak-to-peak point specified in ISO25178 of 5000 or less.

title_en: Machining method of pipe connecting piece
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of pipe fitting machining, and particularly relates to a machining method of a pipe fitting, which comprises the following steps: intermittently placing a blank of the pipe connector on a load-bearing rotary processing seat, intermittently and rotatably connecting the load-bearing rotary processing seat in a supporting fixed seat, and sequentially passing through two combined hole drills and a processing top plate and staying; during the stay period, the machining connector drives the two combined drilling devices, the plurality of drilling heads, the plurality of thread taps and the machining top plate to simultaneously and downwards drill and thread the blank pieces of the pipe connecting piece passing through the machining connector; meanwhile, the groove milling variable-frequency driver moves upwards under the driving of the machining variable-frequency main driver, and the groove milling is carried out through the jacking of the machining top plate; after drilling, thread drilling and groove milling are sequentially carried out, the processed pipe joint piece is taken out; a plurality of sealing threaded holes, a milling groove and a sealing groove which are communicated with each other are formed in the pipe connector.

title_en: Pollution prevention device for welding power battery cover plate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pollution prevention device for welding a power battery cover plate, which comprises a battery positioning and clamping mechanism and a protective cover plate taking and placing mechanism; the protective cover plate taking and placing mechanism comprises a telescopic cylinder, a lifting cylinder fixing seat connected to the end part of a horizontal piston rod of the telescopic cylinder, a lifting cylinder fixed on the lifting cylinder fixing seat, a magnet fixing seat fixed on a piston rod of the lifting cylinder, a positioning pin mounting sleeve fixedly connected to the position right below the magnet fixing seat and a protective cover plate, wherein the positioning pin mounting sleeve is connected with a positioning pin for positioning the protective cover plate. The invention realizes the purposes of plugging the protective cover plate before the power battery arrives at the welding station and removing the protective cover plate after the welding is finished, realizes the plugging of the liquid injection port on the battery cover plate in the welding process through the shielding of the protective cover plate, and effectively avoids the problem that welding slag enters the power battery through the liquid injection port to pollute the liquid injection port.

title_en: Stamping die
abstract_en: The application relates to a stamping die, which comprises a lower die holder, an inner cylinder, an extrusion piece and an inner driving piece, wherein the lower die holder is provided with a lower die seat; the inner cylinder is connected with the lower die holder and is used for coaxially sleeving the pipe; the extrusion parts are arranged at intervals along the circumferential direction of the inner cylinder and correspond to the fins one by one; the extrusion part is connected with the inner cylinder in a sliding way and slides along the radial direction of the inner cylinder; the extrusion part faces away from the axis of the inner cylinder is used for extruding the fin; the inner driving piece is used for driving the extrusion piece to slide reciprocally. The pipe is sleeved outside the inner cylinder, the inner driving piece drives the plurality of extrusion pieces to synchronously keep away from the axis of the inner cylinder, and therefore a plurality of fins are bent at one time, and machining efficiency is improved.

title_en: Safety fire-fighting device for numerical control machine tool
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fire fighting devices, in particular to a safe fire fighting device for a numerical control machine, which comprises: fire extinguishing mechanism, feed mechanism, coupling mechanism and monitoring mechanism, fire extinguishing mechanism including set up in the main truss of digit control machine tool top, activity card adorn in truss removal machine on the main truss, install in the switching box of truss removal machine, set up in be used for the control valve of pipe connection in the switching box, connect in the inlet pipe that the control valve is used for the feeding, connect in the row's material pipe that the control valve other end is used for arranging the material. According to the invention, the fire extinguishing mechanisms are distributed above the numerical control machine tool in the workshop, so that the fire can be extinguished at the first time after the monitoring mechanism monitors that the numerical control machine tool is in fire, the automatic fire fighting function of workshop operation is realized, manual operation is not needed, the fire extinguishing efficiency is higher, the loss caused by fire is effectively reduced, the structural design is novel and reasonable, and the popularization and the use are convenient.

title_en: Multilayer board drilling method, system, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a method, a system, a device, equipment and a storage medium for drilling a multilayer board, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining an initial positioning hole drilled on the multilayer board for the first time; establishing a coordinate system of the multilayer board by taking the initial positioning hole drilled for the first time as a coordinate origin; determining coordinates of drill holes to be drilled on the multilayer board under a coordinate system based on a preset first drill hole interval, a preset second drill hole interval and coordinates of initial positioning holes drilled for the first time, wherein the first drill hole interval indicates the distance between two adjacent positioning holes with the same vertical coordinate, and the second drill hole interval indicates the distance between two adjacent positioning holes with the same horizontal coordinate; and controlling the drilling equipment to drill the multilayer board according to the coordinates of the drill hole to be drilled. Because the coordinates of the drill holes to be drilled can be determined, the drilling equipment can sequentially drill the multilayer boards based on the coordinates.

title_en: Spring and buckle assembly quality of product
abstract_en: The invention provides a spring and buckle assembling device of a product, which comprises a base, a workbench arranged on the upper end surface of the base, and an assembling mechanism arranged on the workbench, wherein the assembling mechanism comprises a sliding plate connected to the upper end surface of the workbench in a sliding manner, a fixing component positioned on the sliding plate and used for fixing the product, a compression component positioned on one side of the sliding plate and used for compressing a spring, an assembling component positioned on one side of the sliding plate and used for driving a buckle and a spring to be assembled, and a moving component driving the fixing component and the assembling component to move in the horizontal direction. The invention has the characteristics of time and labor saving, high automation degree and difficult damage to the surface of the product.

title_en: Steel wire production is with wire drawing equipment that has protective structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wire drawing device with a protective structure for steel wire production, which relates to the technical field of steel wire production and comprises a machine frame, a lubricating mechanism and a display screen, wherein a winding drum is arranged on the lower left side of the outside of the machine frame, a steel wire main body is arranged on the outer side of the winding drum, a water cooling tank is fixed on the lower left side of the inside of the machine frame, the steel wire main body penetrates through a hollow groove in the water cooling tank, a first transition wheel, a guide wheel and a wire drawing die are sequentially arranged on the outside of the steel wire main body from left to right, an electric push rod is arranged on the lower inside of the machine frame, a support is fixed above the electric push rod, a tension wheel is arranged in the support, and the tension wheel is positioned on the outside of the steel wire main body: the first transition wheel, the guide wheel, the wire drawing die and the tensioning wheel in the device are a drawing process, and the upper side and the lower side in the machine frame are provided with four drawing processes, so that the drawing precision can be effectively improved while the occupied area is saved.

title_en: Cylinder processing centering device with anti-tilting function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cylinder barrel processing centering device with an anti-inclination function, which comprises a centering structure, wherein the centering structure comprises a clamping body, the clamping body is communicated with a lifting body through a clamping plate, and a restoring body is arranged below the lifting body; the lifting body comprises a mounting rod connected with the clamping plate, an upper mounting plate and a lower mounting plate are arranged at the lower end of the mounting rod, a side block is fixedly mounted at one end of the lower mounting plate, the upper part of the side block is rotatably connected with a semicircular lifting block through a turntable, the top surface of the lifting block is in contact with the sliding rod, and the top end of the sliding rod is in sliding connection with the mounting rod through the arranged lifting plate; the body that resets is fixed mounting including the end bar that sets up, end bar through with the connecting plate on the clamping body, has cup jointed the board that resets between the end bar, and the board that resets is connected with through the surface rotation and changes the board, and the one end that changes the board that resets is equipped with the guide arm that resets. After the cylinder barrel is fixed, the possibility of inclination is reduced, and the processing stability of the cylinder barrel is improved.

title_en: Extrusion method of shape memory alloy material and equal-channel angular extrusion die
abstract_en: The invention provides an extrusion method of a shape memory alloy material and an equal channel angular extrusion die, wherein the method comprises the following steps: providing a shape memory alloy blank with required size and a low-carbon steel sheath; assembling the shape memory alloy blank and the low-carbon steel sheath into an extrusion blank in a matching manner; and heating and extruding the extruded blank through the equal-channel angular extrusion die at a preset temperature to obtain the shape memory alloy material with the target grain size. The scheme of the invention can realize equal channel angular extrusion large deformation of the material difficult to deform below the dynamic recrystallization temperature.

title_en: Boring tool, boring machine, and boring method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a boring tool (40) which is attached to a processing machine and is used for cutting a hole (13) on the large diameter side of a stepped hole of a workpiece (10), wherein the boring tool (40) comprises 2 boring tools (40) in 1 group, each boring tool (40a, 40b) in 2 boring tools (40) in 1 group comprises a shaft portion (41), a cutting edge (42) protruding from each shaft portion (41) in the transverse direction, and an abutting surface (43) formed at the tip of each shaft portion (41) and used for abutting the tip of each shaft portion (41), and each boring tool (40a, 40b) performs cutting while rotating 2 boring tools (40a, 40b) integrally around the center line of the shaft portion (41) in a combined state that the tips of the boring tools (40a, 40b) abut against each other.

title_en: Automatic assembling system for child chair
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic assembly system of a child chair, which comprises a transmission part which is arranged in an extending manner and used for transmission, wherein a seat bottom cover transmission mechanism, a cup holder transmission mechanism, a seat upper cover transmission mechanism, a screw locking mechanism, a riveting mechanism, a quality inspection mechanism, a labeling mechanism, a belt protective sheet mechanism, a headrest providing mechanism, a backrest providing mechanism, a packaging mechanism and a stacking device are sequentially arranged along the transmission part; after the user acquires the packed child chair, the backrest is arranged on the seat base, and the headrest is arranged on the backrest, so that the child chair can be used and assembled conveniently and quickly.

title_en: Post-processing equipment for semiconductor electronic device production
abstract_en: The invention discloses post-processing equipment for semiconductor electronic device production, and relates to the technical field of semiconductor processing. The invention comprises a cover plate, wherein three groups of proximity switches and a group of motors are fixedly arranged in the middle of the top of the cover plate, and an eccentric transmission disc is fixedly arranged at the bottom of each motor. The invention solves the problems that the processing equipment used at present does not have the stretching function of automatically positioning and bending the stitch and does not have an automatic swinging and extracting structure for realizing conveying; eccentric transmission dish and U-shaped frame's setting provides automatic fixed point for processing equipment and puts a function, and eccentric transmission dish passes through the eccentric bar and drives the bar frame and last reciprocating motion, and then utilizes the bar frame to drive the swinging arms and swing, continuously adjusts cylinder A's position, realizes the change to snatching the position to can pass through the conveyer belt during the motion process, make the work piece of accomplishing the bending fall at the top of conveyer belt, and then directly carry.

title_en: Numerical control machine tool for automatically transferring crankshaft storage position
abstract_en: The invention relates to a numerical control machine tool for automatically transferring a crankshaft storage position, which comprises a frame, wherein a material tray for placing a plurality of workpieces is arranged on the frame, the workpieces are vertically arranged on the material tray, a grabbing mechanism for grabbing the workpieces, a first moving mechanism for controlling the material tray to move towards the grabbing mechanism and a second moving mechanism for controlling the grabbing mechanism to slide in a reciprocating manner are arranged on the frame, and a workpiece to-be-processed placing mechanism connected with the grabbing mechanism is further arranged on the frame. The grabbing mechanism comprises a grabbing device for clamping and loosening workpieces, a rotating device for adjusting the horizontal state and the vertical state of the grabbing device, and a lifting device for controlling the grabbing device and the rotating device to move towards the workpieces of the material tray, wherein the grabbing mechanism clamps the workpieces of the material tray and adjusts the workpieces to be in the horizontal state through the rotating device, and the grabbing mechanism places the workpieces in the horizontal state on a workpiece to be processed placing mechanism so as to finish the displacement of the workpieces.

title_en: Forming die of pin head forging and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forming die of a pin head forging, which comprises an upper half die, a lower die plate, a square punch and a round punch, wherein the upper half die and the lower half die are arranged up and down; the invention also discloses a manufacturing method of the pin head forging, which comprises the following steps: preparing materials, heating, pre-forging and finish forging. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the pin head forging piece has the advantages that the defects of cracks, folding, overheating, overburning and the like can be avoided, no flash is generated, the trimming process is not needed, the production efficiency is high, and the production cost is low.

title_en: Puller assembling and dotting device
abstract_en: The invention provides a puller assembling and dotting device which comprises a dotting die upper die mechanism, a dotting die lower die mechanism arranged below the dotting die upper die mechanism, a movable base core clamping mechanism arranged at the bottom of the dotting die upper die mechanism and used for clamping a puller, a lifting mechanism connected with the dotting die upper die mechanism and used for driving the dotting die upper die mechanism and the movable base core clamping mechanism to move up and down, and a puller positioning mechanism arranged on the dotting die lower die mechanism and positioned below the movable base core clamping mechanism; and the lower dotting die mechanism is provided with dotting knife assemblies in a sliding manner on two sides of the puller positioning mechanism, and the upper dotting die mechanism is provided with a guide mechanism for guiding the dotting knife assemblies on two sides to approach to the middle to perform dotting operation when descending. The invention has the advantages that: the dotting efficiency can be greatly improved, and the requirement of large-scale production is met; meanwhile, the accuracy of the dotting position of the pull head can be ensured, and the stable quality of the produced product can be ensured.

title_en: Machining device and machining method for driving wheel box body of storage vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides a machining device and a machining method for a driving wheel box body of a storage vehicle, and relates to the technical field of machining. The utility model provides a storage vehicle drive wheel box processingequipment for the clamping that the drive wheel box was processed on the lathe, including the ring flange, the ring flange is connected with the main shaft of lathe, still includes: backing plate, locating component and clamping component, backing plate set up on the ring flange, and support with the drive wheel box and lean on the cooperation, and locating component is including setting up first location axle and the second location axle on the ring flange, first location axle and second location axle respectively with the locating hole cooperation on the drive wheel box, clamping component is used for fixed drive wheel case. The first positioning shaft, the second positioning shaft and the base plate are used as positioning references, the machining precision of the driving wheel box body is improved, and meanwhile, the first positioning shaft and the second positioning shaft are arranged on the flange plate instead of the base plate, so that accumulated errors can be reduced as much as possible.

title_en: Plate shearing machine is used in stainless steel processing with automatic feed function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a stainless steel processing plate shearing machine with an automatic feeding function, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a side plate is welded at the lower end of the bottom plate, a motor is fixedly installed on the side plate, a rotating shaft is arranged on the motor, the rotating shaft is connected with the rotating shaft in a rotating manner, a square block is welded at one end, away from the motor, of the rotating shaft, a rotary plate is clamped at the outer side of the square block, a square hole is formed in the rotary plate, the square block is clamped in the square hole, a fixing pin is connected to one end, away from the rotating shaft, of the square block through threads, a baffle is sleeved on the outer side of the fixing pin in a sliding manner, one end of the baffle is in contact connection with the rotary plate, and the rotary plate is in contact connection with the rotating shaft. The invention relates to a stainless steel processing plate shearing machine with an automatic feeding function, which has the characteristics of automatically feeding materials to the plate shearing machine and avoiding material jumping during steel plate processing.

title_en: A tailor device for battery diaphragm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cutting device for a battery diaphragm, which relates to the technical field of cutting devices and comprises a processing table, wherein a cutter is arranged above the processing table, the left side and the right side of the cutter are respectively fixed with a piston rod of an air cylinder on the side surface of the working table through a fixing plate, a base plate is fixed under the cutter on the working table, a cutter groove matched with the cutter is formed in the top of the base plate, a leveling mechanism used for leveling the battery diaphragm is further arranged on the base plate, a film conveying mechanism used for conveying the battery diaphragm is arranged on the rear side of the cutter, and an unwinding mechanism used for placing a battery diaphragm roll is arranged on the rear side of the film conveying mechanism. The battery diaphragm cutting machine can avoid the wrinkle bending of the battery diaphragm when cutting the battery diaphragm, so that the cutting surface of the battery diaphragm is cut smoothly.

title_en: General type frame assembly riveting tools
abstract_en: The invention discloses a general type riveting tool for a frame assembly, which comprises a base, a fixed supporting seat and a movable supporting seat connected with the base through a Y-direction sliding rail pair; the fixed supporting seat is connected with the movable supporting seat through two servo electric cylinders; the fixed support seat and the movable support seat are fixedly provided with an end frame support seat and a plurality of sliding frame support seats arranged through an X-direction guide rail and a sliding seat, one side of each end frame support seat and each sliding frame support seat, which is adjacent to each other, is provided with a support platform, each end frame support seat and each sliding frame support seat are hinged with an oil cylinder and a pressing block, a piston rod of each oil cylinder is connected with one end of each pressing block, and the other end of each pressing block is provided with a pressing head; longitudinal pin penetrating grooves which are overlapped in the Y direction are formed in the fixed supporting seat and the movable supporting seat; the invention has the advantages of high positioning precision, reliable clamping, convenient operation, good universality, high production efficiency and high product precision, and can reduce the investment cost of later-stage tools and save the cost.

title_en: Equipment and method for preparing heating material
abstract_en: The invention relates to a device and a method for producing a heating material, characterized in that both the device and the method involve: (1) incoming material conveying mechanism; (2) a material storage mechanism; (3) a cutting mechanism; (4) a grooving mechanism; (5) a glue spraying mechanism; (6) a parting mechanism; (7) an inflatable mechanism; (8) a blanking conveying mechanism. The invention adopts an automatic mode to work, thereby reducing the manual participation; the equipment ensures the compounding and the full fitting between the processed material and the metal thin material.

title_en: Drainage pipeline repairing process
abstract_en: The application relates to a drainage pipeline repairing process, which comprises the steps of cutting off a damaged section of a drainage pipe to enable the drainage pipe to form two connecting ends; taking a first standby pipe with the same specification as the drain pipe; processing a notch on the first standby pipe, wherein the notch penetrates through two ends of the first standby pipe; closing the gap of the first spare pipe to reduce the outer diameter of the first spare pipe and form an inserting pipe; coaxially embedding the insertion pipe into the connecting end, wherein one end of the insertion pipe extends out of the connecting end; taking a second spare pipe with the same specification as the drain pipe; coaxially sleeving a second standby pipe to the periphery of one end, extending out of the connecting end, of the splicing pipe; and taking the connecting pipe, sleeving one end of the connecting pipe to the periphery of the second standby pipe, and sleeving the other end of the connecting pipe to the periphery of the other connecting end. The water drainage pipe is extended by utilizing the inserting pipe and the second standby pipe, so that the water drainage pipe extends out of the floor slab and extends out for enough length for the installation of the connecting pipe; the repair of the drainage pipeline can be completed without digging a floor slab.

title_en: Fastening device for processing machine tool
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fastening device for a processing machine tool, which comprises a floating assembly, a clamping assembly and a cylinder assembly, wherein the floating assembly comprises an installation frame, a fixed plate arranged on the installation frame, a first optical axis arranged between the installation frame and the fixed plate and a vertical spring sleeved outside the first optical axis; the clamping assembly is arranged on the mounting frame and comprises a pressing plate, a left clamping seat and a right clamping plate, wherein the left clamping seat and the right clamping plate are arranged on two sides of the pressing plate; the air cylinder assembly comprises an air cylinder mounting seat, an air cylinder arranged on the air cylinder mounting seat and an air cylinder connecting seat connected with the air cylinder; the fastening device provided by the invention provides a functional taking and placing fastening device which is matched with a robot or a three-coordinate device for use, the gripper has the advantages of up-and-down floating, workpiece pressing and left-and-right floating, a double-cylinder floating device is adopted for clamping, certain deviation can be allowed during gripping, a machining machine tool can be quickly modified through connecting devices such as a hanging ring, and the fastening device has high universality under different modification conditions.

title_en: Machining center for machining profile
abstract_en: A machining center for machining a profile (2), in particular a profile (2) made of aluminium, light alloy, polyvinyl chloride or the like, is provided with: -a plurality of compacting units (14), said compacting units (14) being movable along the base (3) and being designed to hold at least one profile (2); -a bridge crane (21), which bridge crane (21) is movable along the base (3) and is provided with at least one operating head (24) to cut and/or process the profile (2); a signal emitting unit (29), the signal emitting unit (29) being provided with a plurality of light devices (30) arranged along the base (3); and an electronic control unit (31), the electronic control unit (31) being configured to selectively turn on the light (30) and to send a position signal of each profile (2) to be loaded in the respective compacting unit (14) to the responsible operator.

title_en: Auxiliary welding device and welding method for large conical workpiece
abstract_en: The invention provides a welding auxiliary device and a welding method for a large conical workpiece, wherein the conical workpiece is formed by welding fan-shaped metal plates, and the welding auxiliary device comprises a first fixing sleeve, a second fixing sleeve, an adjusting screw rod and an adjusting nut, wherein the first fixing sleeve and the second fixing sleeve are fixedly welded with plates on two sides of a notch of the fan-shaped metal plates; when a conical workpiece is prepared for welding, after the adjusting screw penetrates through the first fixing sleeve and the second fixing sleeve, the adjusting nut is screwed in from the rod part of the adjusting screw, so that the notch of the fan-shaped metal plate is gradually closed, and the fan-shaped metal plate is formed into a conical shape to be convenient for welding. The auxiliary welding device for the large conical workpiece has the advantages of wide part sources, convenience in local material taking and low cost; the practical application effect is good, the welding operation of the base plate of the tapered tank body can be independently finished by a single person, and the manpower use is greatly reduced; and the molding quality of the conical workpiece is good, and the requirements of users are met.

title_en: Preparation method of beryllium material with high micro-yield strength and high elongation, product and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of beryllium material with high micro-yield strength and high elongation, a product and application thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps: and (3) sequentially carrying out high-temperature annealing before forging, four-stage dynamic recrystallization forging and post-forging stabilization treatment on the isostatic beryllium material to obtain the beryllium material with high micro yield strength and high elongation. The method of high-temperature annealing before forging, four-stage dynamic recrystallization forging and stabilization treatment after forging can obviously improve the tissue homogenization of the beryllium material, refine crystal grains, eliminate the residual stress of the material and improve the stability of the beryllium material. The micro yield strength of the beryllium material treated by the method is improved from 30-40MPa to more than 60MPa, the elongation is improved from 1% to more than 8%, and the dimensional change of the beryllium material after being placed at room temperature for six months is less than 0.01%. Compared with the hot isostatic pressing beryllium material, the beryllium material obtained by the method has higher density which reaches over 99.5 percent.

title_en: High-efficient semisteel line apparatus for producing
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of communication cables, especially, relate to a high-efficient semisteel production device, it includes the fixing base, top one side of fixing base is provided with the die holder, one side of die holder runs through and is provided with the fixed orifices, the die holder is based on the fixed orifices is provided with drawing die utensil, one side of fixing base goes up and down to be provided with the tray that is used for bearing semisteel, semisteel with drawing die utensil sliding connection, the fixing base is provided with and is used for driving semisteel towards keeping away from the drawing mechanism that the direction of die holder removed. The semi-steel wire drawing processing method has the effects of reducing the semi-steel wire drawing processing cost and improving the semi-steel wire drawing processing efficiency.

title_en: Intelligent horizontal positioning device for electromechanical equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent horizontal positioning device for electromechanical equipment, which comprises a supporting seat for supporting the electromechanical equipment, wherein a centering device is arranged below the supporting seat, the centering device comprises a swing rod mechanism, the swing rod mechanism comprises a supporting frame and a swing shaft fixed on the supporting frame, a swinging frame capable of swinging and two synchronous swing rods are arranged on the swing shaft, the swinging frame comprises a vertical rod and a working surface vertical to the vertical rod, the two synchronous swing rods are positioned on two sides of the vertical rod in the swinging direction and are not coplanar, the bottom of each synchronous swing rod is connected with a heavy hammer, the heavy hammer can touch the vertical rod in the swinging process, and the supporting seat is positioned on the working surface. The supporting seat of the electromechanical device is provided with the centering device below, the vertical rod is corrected through the oscillating rod and the heavy hammer structure, the centering is adjusted, the influence of the ground condition is avoided, the mechanical device is suitable for inclined ground, and the applicability is high. The horizontal placement of the electromechanical equipment is ensured, and the precision of the equipment can be effectively improved.

title_en: Novel sickle elbow part pre-control method
abstract_en: The invention provides a novel sickle elbow part pre-control method, which comprises the following steps: s1, calculating the rigidity K of the two sides of the zero adjustment of each rack according to the data of the zero adjustment process of each rolling mill ios0 、K ids0 (ii) a S2 reading the tested rigidity K of two sides of each stand from the control system of the rolling mill iosT 、K idsT (ii) a S3, calculating rigidity K of two sides of each rack according to the zero adjustment rigidity and the test rigidity ios 、K ids (ii) a S4 calculating the roll gap S of the base of each stand according to the rigidity of the two sides of each stand i0 (ii) a S5, performing curve processing on the center line of the rough rolling outlet, and calculating the camber bending L of the camber of the current intermediate billet c (ii) a S6 calculating the roll gap regulating quantity delta S for eliminating the camber bending quantity according to a formula i : s7 calculating roll gap pre-swing value S of each frame i ：S i ＝S i0 +ΔS i And transmitting to a pressing system for execution. According to the method, the influence of the camber part of the intermediate billet on the deviation of finish rolling can be eliminated. Can solve the problem that the stability of finish rolling is influenced by the camber defect of a rough rolling intermediate billet, and reduce the deviation of the strip steel between framesSteel piling accidents are avoided, and the stability of hot rolling production is improved.

title_en: Gas cylinder hot spinning machining method based on finite element modeling
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of hot spinning closing-in, and particularly relates to a gas cylinder hot spinning processing method based on finite element modeling. The method of the invention can not only obtain accurate and reliable hot spinning closing-in process parameters and reduce the actual research and development cost and time cost of enterprises, but also can quickly determine the hot spinning closing-in processing parameters of new products and overcome the problem of low analysis efficiency and precision of the existing finite element model.

title_en: Low-hydrogen anti-cracking flux-cored wire and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to components of a low-hydrogen anti-cracking flux-cored wire, which comprise a low-carbon steel strip and medicinal powder, wherein the medicinal powder comprises the following components: silicon-manganese alloy, electrolytic manganese, nickel powder, magnesia, iron alloy, ferrotitanium, reduced iron powder, high-grade 97-degree rutile, potassium titanate, quartz sand and sodium fluoride. The preparation method comprises the following steps: and (2) drying silicomanganese alloy, electrolytic manganese, nickel powder, magnesia, ferrotitanium and reduced iron powder in the welding wire powder components at low temperature, drying high-grade 97-degree rutile, potassium titanate, quartz sand and sodium fluoride in the welding wire powder components at high temperature, uniformly mixing the dried powder, wrapping the powder by a steel belt, and drawing the powder for multiple times to obtain the finished welding wire.

title_en: Laser welding method for high-grade silicon steel plate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a laser welding method of a high-grade silicon steel plate, and aims to improve the quality of a welding seam before a normalizing process and the quality of a welding seam after the normalizing process, avoid welding defects and cracks, reduce the strip breakage rate of a silicon steel plate in a continuous production process and improve the production efficiency. The Si content of the silicon steel plate is 1.75-3.45%, the Si content is mass ratio, and the thickness is 1.85-2.90 mm. The method is characterized in that the welding power of laser welding and the heating annealing power of a post-heating annealing process are adjusted according to the total Si content (Si1+ Si2) and the total thickness (h1+ h2) of the front and rear high-grade silicon steel plates, and single-side splicing welding is realized. The method gives specific laser welding technological parameters according to the difference of the total Si content and the total thickness of the steel. By adopting the method, the microstructure of the welding seam can be improved, the hardness difference between the welding seam area and the base metal area is reduced, the welding stress is reduced, and the welding seam quality is improved; in addition, the welding energy consumption is low.

title_en: Preparation method of brazing assistant slurry, brazing assistant slurry and application thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of brazing, and particularly discloses a preparation method of brazing auxiliary agent slurry, the brazing auxiliary agent slurry and application thereof; a method for preparing a brazing assistant slurry, comprising the steps of: weighing cellulose and water in a weight ratio of 1:20-100, dissolving the cellulose in the water and not dissolving the cellulose in alcohol, and stirring until the cellulose is dissolved to obtain a mixed solution; weighing the mixed solution and alcohol according to the weight ratio of 1:5-100, stirring and distilling to obtain a mixture; weighing the mixture and the soldering flux powder according to the weight ratio of 1:1, and stirring to obtain a finished soldering flux slurry; preparing brazing auxiliary agent slurry by adopting a preparation method of the brazing auxiliary agent slurry for brazing; use of a brazing aid slurry for brazing comprising the steps of: coating the brazing auxiliary agent slurry on the position of a welded joint of the materials to be welded, and spraying water on the position of the joint after coating to obtain a finished brazing assembly; has the advantages of easy coating in the coating process and reduction of disordered flowing after coating.

title_en: Manufacturing method of fireproof formaldehyde-free plywood
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of plywood, and discloses a manufacturing method of a fireproof formaldehyde-free plywood, which comprises three boards, wherein the three boards are connected through glue in a hot pressing mode, the three boards are a panel, a middle board and a bottom board from top to bottom, the middle board comprises the following raw materials, 20-40 parts of straw residues, 20-30 parts of bamboo boards, 50-60 parts of rock wool, 10-20 parts of aluminum hydroxide flame retardant, 1-3 parts of antibacterial agent and 100 parts of glue and 140 parts of sand. According to the manufacturing method of the fireproof formaldehyde-free plywood, the bottom plate and the middle plate both have good fireproof performance, glue used in production is reasonable in raw material proportion, does not contain formaldehyde harmful substances, is good in bonding performance and stability, and has good water resistance, so that the effect of environmental protection is achieved.

title_en: Finger stall processing packagine machine
abstract_en: A finger stall processing packaging machine. Solves the problems that the existing finger stall is difficult to process and can not be produced continuously and reliably. The feeding device comprises a frame body, wherein the frame body is provided with a discharging device for discharging coiled materials, a deviation correcting device for correcting deviation during feeding, a material folding device for folding the coiled materials, a die cutting device for die cutting the folded coiled materials and a material collecting device for collecting the die-cut materials, the discharging device, the deviation correcting device, the material folding device, the die cutting device and the material collecting device are sequentially connected, and the material collecting device comprises a conveying mechanism for receiving the die-cut materials and providing negative pressure. The invention has the beneficial effects that the discharging device, the deviation correcting device, the material folding device, the die cutting device and the material receiving device are arranged, so that the discharged product can be processed and molded on a machine, and negative pressure is provided during material receiving, material deviation is avoided, and the product receiving is convenient and reliable.

title_en: Positioning device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a positioning device (1) comprising a base (2) and a positioning element (3), the positioning element (3) being adapted for six degrees of freedom adjustment relative to the base, wherein the positioning element is coupled to the base via at least three pairs of electrically powered leg elements (4) of variable length, each leg element being connected at its respective end to the base and the positioning element via a hinge element (5), wherein a respective pair of legs protrudes through the other pair of legs, each pair of legs being arranged perpendicular to the respective other pair of legs. According to a basic feature of the invention, each hinge element (5) associated with a leg element (4) has only two rotation axes (DA) arranged perpendicular to each other, such that the hinge element allows a pivoting movement of the respective leg element in exactly two planes perpendicular to each other and penetrating the longitudinal axis of the leg element, while preventing a rotational movement about the longitudinal axis of the leg element.

title_en: Automatic processing system for electric vehicle hub
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hub machining, and discloses an automatic machining system for a hub of an electric vehicle, which comprises a factory building, wherein the left side in the factory building comprises a support frame, a positioning barrel, a motor, a rotating rod, a bearing, a limiting plate, a limiting groove, a roller, a supporting leg, a deflector rod, a sliding block, a sleeve, a sliding groove, a first spring, a tray and a brush, the bottom of the support frame is fixedly connected with the left side of the ground of the factory building, the automatic processing system for the hub of the electric vehicle is characterized in that in work, through the matching arrangement of the arranged positioning barrel, the upper rotating roller, the longitudinal transmission belt, the transport disc, the lower rotating roller, the electric push rod II, the clamping plate, the feeding push groove, the linkage frame, the limiting push plate, the limiting push groove, the rubber pad, the sliding rod, the sliding rail, the feeding port and the transverse transmission belt, when wheel hub carries out the texture fluting in needs, a workman can directly stand and put wheel hub on the outward horizontal transmission area of factory building.

title_en: Portable micro-abrasive water jet modification device suitable for stress concentration area
abstract_en: The invention relates to a portable micro-abrasive water jet modification device suitable for a stress concentration area, which comprises a tank body, wherein a grinding chamber is arranged at the center of the tank body, a wear-resistant pipe is connected onto the bottom end face of the grinding chamber, a nozzle is connected onto the bottom end of the wear-resistant pipe, a limiting hole is arranged on the side face of the wear-resistant pipe, the limiting hole penetrates through the side wall of the wear-resistant pipe and is communicated with the inside of the wear-resistant pipe, a flow regulating rod is horizontally and slidably connected into the limiting hole, the flow regulating rod is arranged in an installation cavity on the side wall of the tank body, the other end of the limiting hole is connected with an input pipeline through a communication channel A, the input pipeline is connected with a pipe joint on the top end face of the tank body, an end enclosure is connected onto the top end face of the grinding chamber, a horizontal hole is arranged in the end enclosure, the horizontal hole is connected with a feed inlet at the center of the end enclosure, and the outer end of the horizontal hole is connected with the input pipeline through a communication channel B; the invention has small structure and can realize the purpose of modifying a small-sized stress concentration area.

title_en: Automatic peeling sleeve device
abstract_en: An automatic peeling sleeve device comprises a workbench, a transmission device, a cutting peeling mechanism and a sleeve mounting mechanism. The cutting and peeling mechanism comprises a cutting unit and a peeling device. The cutting unit comprises a cutting mounting frame, an upper cutting unit and a lower cutting unit. The peeling device comprises a first guide rail, a peeling sliding table, a peeling clamping device, a peeling sliding driving device and a peeling driving device. The sleeve installation mechanism comprises a blanking unit, a sleeve transfer transmission device and a sleeve installation device. The blanking unit comprises a vibration blanking device and a sleeve pushing device. The sleeve pushing device comprises a pushing sliding device and a pushing rod. The sleeve transfer transmission device comprises a transfer transmission slide rail, a sleeve transmission slide table and a sleeve installation part. The automatic peeling sleeve device realizes automatic peeling and sleeve installation, improves the production efficiency and reduces the labor intensity.

title_en: Portal steel constructs processing and uses drilling equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a door type drilling device for steel structure processing, which is technically characterized in that: the machine comprises a machine body, wherein a processing table is arranged in the machine body; a drilling mechanism; the drilling mechanism comprises a drilling assembly and a displacement assembly; an angle adjusting mechanism; the angle adjusting mechanism comprises a lifting assembly and a positioning member, a processing table is connected inside the lifting assembly in a sliding mode, and the positioning member for positioning the processing table is arranged inside the lifting assembly. Through opening first drive component, first drive component drives the processing platform at the lifting unit internal rotation, can carry out angle modulation to the processing platform, through the locating component for the locating component fixes a position processing platform and lifting unit, opens first drive component, and first drive component drives the whole upward activity downwardly movement of processing platform and lifting unit, realizes the adjustment to the height of processing platform, can realize finely tuning the height of processing platform, improves the advantage to the machining precision of steel member body.

title_en: Automatic tin coating tool for axial insertion of components after taping and use method
abstract_en: An automatic tin-coating tool for axially inserting components after taping comprises a tool bottom plate, a clamping plate and a locking device; the tool bottom plate is provided with a first clamping position, a first clamping surface and a first tin coating area; the clamping plate is provided with a second clamping position, a second clamping surface and a second tin coating area; when the tool bottom plate and the clamping plate clamp the braid and then the components are axially inserted, the tool bottom plate and the clamping plate are locked through the locking device. The use method of the tool comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of arranging a workpiece to be enameled on a tool bottom plate, arranging a clamping plate on the tool bottom plate, clamping the component to be processed, locking the tool bottom plate and the clamping plate by using a locking device, fixing the tool on a selective crest welder, carrying out tin enameling, and completing the automatic tin enameling process of the component in batches. This frock passes through bottom plate, grip block and locking device makes components and parts fixed, reasonable in design, and easy operation is swift, can realize the automatic tin-enameling operation of axial cartridge components and parts behind the braid, effectively improves tin-enameling efficiency and quality.

title_en: Pipeline installation auxiliary supporting device for construction site
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of building construction, and provides an auxiliary supporting device for pipeline installation for a building site, which comprises a working platform and also comprises: the positioning mechanism comprises a first mounting piece, the top end of the first mounting piece is provided with an inlet pipe orifice, the side wall of the first mounting piece is provided with a butt joint, a positioning assembly is arranged in the first mounting piece, the positioning assembly comprises a second mounting piece and a first transmission piece, a third clamping piece is arranged on the second mounting piece, the first transmission piece is connected with a second transmission piece, and the second transmission piece is provided with a clamping part; and the butt joint part comprises a first connecting piece, a guide groove is formed in the second mounting piece, a mounting cavity is formed in the working platform, and a butt joint assembly is installed in the mounting cavity. The device centre gripping is convenient, can be applied to the pipeline of multiple size, can carry out automatic concatenation to the pipeline simultaneously, the simple operation, excellent in use effect.

title_en: Counter character wheel assembly machine and assembly method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a counter character wheel assembly assembling machine and an assembling method thereof, wherein the assembling machine comprises a workbench, a moving track arranged on the workbench, a wheel group placing station, a character wheel shaft penetrating station and an assembling station which are sequentially arranged along the moving track, a whole code station is arranged between the character wheel shaft penetrating station and the assembling station, a moving seat is arranged on the moving track, a combined die is arranged on the moving seat, a combined groove matched with a character wheel is formed in the combined die, a whole code assembly matched with the moving seat and the workbench is arranged on the moving seat, and the shaft adjusting assembly is used for adjusting the exposed length of two ends of the character wheel shaft. The assembly machine and the corresponding assembly method are adopted for assembly, so that the orientation adjustment of the transition wheel and the correction of character wheel codes can be realized rapidly, secondary operation is reduced, meanwhile, the man-machine combination can effectively simplify the equipment structure, the whole body is compact, the implementation is convenient, better reliability is realized, the assembly efficiency and quality are ensured, and the equipment manufacturing cost is reduced.

title_en: Reciprocating ceramic tubular moving knife and processing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a reciprocating ceramic tubular moving knife and a processing method thereof, which is characterized in that a moving knife body is integrally formed by ceramic materials, the section of the moving knife body is tubular, the thickness of the tube wall of the moving knife body is more than or equal to 0.8mm, and a plurality of arc-shaped grooves which are arranged at intervals are arranged on the moving knife body to form a plurality of cutting teeth on one side of the tube wall of the moving knife body. The invention has the advantages that the traditional stainless steel moving blade is changed into a tubular shape and is integrally formed by ceramic, thereby reducing the production cost of the moving blade, realizing the one-step forming of the moving blade and improving the production benefit of the moving blade; because the smoothness and the hardness of the surface of the ceramic are higher than those of the traditional movable knife, the sharpness of the movable knife can be improved while the hardness of the cutting edge of the movable knife is ensured; secondly, the moving knife is changed into the ceramic material, which is equivalent to changing the moving friction between the traditional moving knife and the static knife into the sliding friction, so that the friction coefficient between the static knife and the moving knife is lower, the temperature rise between the static knife and the moving knife body is obviously reduced, and the use comfort of the shaver is improved.

title_en: Device and method for processing sharpness of antenna target plate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for processing the sharpness of an antenna target plate, wherein the processing device comprises a target plate transfer mechanism, a conveying mechanism, a sand blasting mechanism and a protective shell; the protection shell comprises a target board base and a target board upper cover, the target board upper cover is buckled on the target board base, and a target board is placed in the protection shell; the target plate transfer mechanism is used for transferring the protective shell to the conveying mechanism; the sand blasting mechanism comprises a sand blasting pool and a plurality of sand blasting heads, and the sand blasting heads are used for blasting sand to the target plate; conveying mechanism includes two sets of conveying boards, two conveying chains and the second motor that set up relatively, and each conveying board of group is including relative planking and the inner panel that sets up, and a conveying chain is located between planking and the inner panel, is used for placing the protection casing on the conveying chain, and makes the protection casing remove to the other end from the one end of sandblast mechanism. The protrusions can be uniformly blasted individually to reduce the mechanical strength of the protrusions; after the etching treatment, the antenna with the sharpness of less than 20 mu m can be obtained.

title_en: Simple welding device for interior of U-shaped rib
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simple welding device for the interior of a U-shaped rib, which solves the technical problem of high cost of U-shaped rib welding equipment in the prior art. The welding gun comprises a walking trolley capable of freely walking in the U-shaped ribs and a carbon dioxide welding gun arranged on the walking trolley and used for welding construction, wherein an adjusting mechanism used for adjusting the position of a welding gun head of the carbon dioxide welding gun is arranged between the carbon dioxide welding gun and the walking trolley. The welding device has the advantages of simple structure, scientific and reasonable design and convenient use, realizes walking in a narrow space by utilizing the walking trolley, simultaneously welds two sides of the opening end of the U-shaped rib by utilizing the two carbon dioxide welding guns, has high welding efficiency and good effect, is simple, convenient and easy to realize, has low cost and can meet the welding requirement of the U-shaped rib.

title_en: Indexable pressing device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an indexable pressing device, which comprises: the pressing mechanism is arranged on the indexing mechanism, and the indexing mechanism drives the pressing mechanism to rotate. The invention provides an indexable pressing device which comprises a pressing mechanism and an indexing mechanism, wherein the pressing mechanism is arranged on the indexing mechanism; when an operator loads materials, the indexing mechanism can be started, and then the indexing mechanism drives the pressing mechanism to rotate for 90 degrees, so that the workpiece can effectively avoid the interference of the pressing mechanism; then the indexing mechanism rotates 90 degrees to the original position in a reverse direction, and then an operator drives the pressing mechanism to press and fix the workpiece.

title_en: Plastic granules prilling granulator that can classify
abstract_en: A classifiable plastic particle granulating device comprises a granulating unit, wherein the device comprises a classifying box body and a crushing box body, the classifying box body is positioned above the crushing box body, the bottom surface of the classifying box body is open and is communicated with the crushing box body, the feeding end of the classifying box body is communicated with the outside, the discharging end of the classifying box body is communicated with the feeding end of the crushing box body, and the discharging end of the crushing box body is communicated with the feeding end of the granulating unit; the plastic bottle sorting device is characterized in that a sorting unit for separating the plastic bottle body, the label, the bottle cap and the bottle cap ring is arranged in the sorting box, and a crushing unit for respectively crushing the plastic bottle body, the label, the bottle cap and the bottle cap ring is arranged in the crushing box. The invention realizes the automatic separation of the plastic bottle body, the label, the bottle cap and the bottle cap ring, saves labor, improves the working efficiency, makes different materials granulate respectively, and is beneficial to improving the granulation quality.

title_en: Assembling equipment and assembling method for metal plug connector and sealing ring
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of metal plug connector assembling equipment, and particularly relates to assembling equipment and an assembling method of a metal plug connector and a sealing ring, wherein the assembling equipment comprises the following steps: the machine table is provided with a rotary material conveying device which rotates relative to the machine table, and processing jigs are arranged on the rotary material conveying device at intervals; the assembling device comprises a snap ring feeding assembly, a first seal ring feeding assembly, a fixed ring feeding assembly, a second seal ring feeding assembly, a plug connector feeding assembly, an assembling assembly, a material carrying assembly and a defective product discharging assembly which are sequentially arranged around the rotary material conveying device in a radial manner; the mounting device is arranged corresponding to the material handling assembly so as to mount the locking ring into the plug connector; the blanking device is arranged on one side of the mounting device. The invention can realize one-time assembly of the metal plug connector and the sealing ring, has high assembly consistency and high assembly efficiency, can ensure the installation quality of the metal plug connector and the sealing ring, and can meet the large-batch production requirements of customers.

title_en: Electric power fitting U-shaped hanging ring punching device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of machining equipment, and particularly discloses a punching device for a U-shaped hanging ring of an electric power fitting; the rotary feeding mechanism comprises two vertical plates, two rotating plates are arranged between the two vertical plates, a plurality of cross rods are arranged between the two rotating plates in an annular array shape, a plurality of hanging wheels are arranged on the cross rods at intervals, and a driving device for driving the rotating plates to rotate at a fixed angle is arranged on the vertical plates; the tapping mechanism comprises a rack and a bar-shaped moving seat moving to the rotary feeding mechanism along the rack, tapping motors corresponding to the hanging wheels are arranged on the bar-shaped moving seat at intervals, a drill bit is connected to an output shaft of each tapping motor, and the clamping and positioning mechanism comprises an upper pressing device and a lower opening positioning device which are arranged above and below the end part of the rotary feeding mechanism; the U-shaped suspension ring perforating device disclosed by the invention is high in machining efficiency and precision, simple in feeding and discharging process and excellent in practical use effect.

title_en: Floating rotation detection mechanism for automatic press fitting of planetary wheel shaft
