abstract_en: The invention discloses a floating rotation detection mechanism and equipment for automatic press fitting of a planetary wheel shaft, which relate to the technical field of assembly of speed reducers and comprise a base, wherein a positioning mechanism for positioning and installing a planetary support is arranged above the base, the positioning mechanism can vertically move up and down, a first elastic component is arranged between the positioning mechanism and the base, the positioning mechanism is rotationally connected with the base and comprises a positioning tool substrate and a sliding sleeve, a plurality of positioning sleeves are circumferentially distributed on the positioning tool substrate, the first in-place detection mechanism comprises a first stroke block component and a first in-place detection sensor, and the first stroke block component is in sliding connection with the positioning sleeves.

title_en: Mechanical perforating device for business administration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mechanical punching device for industrial and commercial management, which comprises: the end point of the cambered surface of the hemispherical entity is connected to the weight increasing base through a universal joint; the fixing plate is arranged on the plane of the hemisphere entity; the two connecting pieces are respectively arranged on the two opposite side surfaces of the fixed plate and are used for being detachably connected with the weight increasing base; the placing box is of a non-top and non-bottom cuboid structure, is arranged at the top of the fixing plate and is used for placing paper documents; the extruding device is used for extruding the paper documents; and the punching device is used for rotationally punching the paper document. According to the invention, the hemisphere entity is shaken left and right and front and back, so that the paper documents placed in the box above the hemisphere entity can be regulated; after the paper file rule, fix half ball entity through the connecting piece, make the paper file no longer rock, rethread extrusion device extrudees the paper file from the top, punches the paper file through punching device this moment, and its accuracy of punching is high, has improved the effect of punching.

title_en: Parlor house beautifies with elliptical mirror marking device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of home installation, and aims to solve the problem of limited tool application range, in particular to an elliptical mirror marking device for living room home beautification. The invention is convenient for scribing different sizes, different arc-shaped figures or straight lines, has wider application range and does not need to climb up and down by personnel.

title_en: Automatic transfer position type positioner
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automatic position adjusting type positioning device which comprises a material placing plate, an upper plate, a positioning piece, a first position adjusting piece and a second position adjusting piece, wherein the material placing plate is provided with a first material inlet and a second material outlet; the material discharging plate is provided with a positioning column, the upper plate is connected with the material discharging plate through a connecting column, a pushing part is arranged on the upper plate, the positioning part is movably connected with the upper plate through a pushing rod of the pushing part, the first position adjusting part and the second position adjusting part are symmetrical about the positioning column, the first position adjusting part and the second position adjusting part respectively comprise a pushing plate, an upper positioning block and an inductor, the upper positioning block is movably connected with the pushing plate through a guide resetting part, the inductor corresponds to the upper positioning block in position, and the first position adjusting part and the second position adjusting part are both connected with the material discharging plate through a power cylinder. The invention provides an automatic position adjusting type positioning device, which reduces the requirement on the accuracy of part placement and improves the placement efficiency.

title_en: High-adaptability clamping device for special-shaped workpiece of numerical control machine tool
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-adaptability clamping device for a special-shaped workpiece of a numerical control machine, which relates to the technical field of numerical control machine equipment and comprises the following components: the workbench is used for bearing subsequent components, and a plurality of supporting slideways are arranged on the workbench; fixing mechanism for the fixed work piece of treating processing, fixing mechanism connects on a plurality of support slides, and includes slip post, control spring and annular bag, and wherein, a plurality of slip post one-to-one sliding connection is on a plurality of support slides, and is a plurality of the slip post middle part all runs through and has seted up the sliding tray, under the pulling effect of a plurality of slip posts, forms comprehensive contact effect to the special-shaped workpiece periphery through deformable annular bag to under the electrorheological fluids effect of solidification, the cooperation slip post forms the fixed effect of centre gripping to the work piece, compares in the mode that utilizes hydraulic means to promote fixed plate centre gripping work piece, has the condition that fixed plate centre gripping work piece shape is limited, greatly improves the fixed adaptability to different work piece centre gripping.

title_en: Biological cutting fluid circulation processing system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a biological cutting fluid circulating treatment system, which comprises: the upper end of the filter box is provided with a first liquid inlet, the lower end of the filter box is provided with a first liquid outlet, and the first liquid inlet is used for introducing biological cutting fluid; the quartz sand filter plate is arranged in the filter box; the activated carbon adsorption screen plate is arranged in the filter box and is positioned below the quartz sand filter plate; the inlet of the first pump is connected with the first liquid outlet through a pipeline; the oil-water separation tank is provided with at least one second liquid inlet, and the second liquid inlet is connected with the outlet of the first pump through a pipeline; the oil outlet is arranged at the upper part of the oil-water separation tank; the second liquid outlet is arranged at the lower part of the oil-water separation tank; the oil storage tank is connected with the oil outlet through a pipeline; the inlet of the liquid purifying tank is connected with the second liquid outlet through a pipeline; the circulating pipeline is connected with the outlet of the liquid purifying tank; the second pump is arranged at the outlet of the liquid purifying tank; and the air pump is connected with the circulating pipeline. The processing system can realize filtration and sterilization of the cutting fluid and ensure the recycling quality of the cutting fluid.

title_en: Self-locking clamping device for spring chuck
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of spring chuck devices on pipe mills, and discloses a spring chuck self-locking clamping device which comprises a pipe mill, a trolley and an outer cylinder, wherein the trolley is positioned on one side of the pipe mill, the outer cylinder is arranged on one side, close to the pipe mill, of the trolley, and one end of the outer cylinder is fixedly connected with a mounting flange. The spring chuck self-locking clamping device drives a chuck to clamp a pipe blank through a seven-degree inclined plane by utilizing the pretightening force of a spring, when a trolley moves, the other end of the pipe blank is positioned in a pipe rolling machine, the trolley drives an outer cylinder to move in the same direction, at the moment, the collet chuck and the trolley move in the same direction through the clamping of a bolt and a clamping hole, the clamping force of the pipe blank by the pipe rolling machine and the forward feeding force of the trolley are utilized, meanwhile, the collet chuck moves forwards to enable the conical surface at the end of the collet chuck to compress the inclined plane at the joint of the collet chuck and a pipe barrel, and meanwhile, the pipe blank is pressed against a top plate by one end of the pipe blank under the clamping force of the pipe rolling machine.

title_en: Cooperative processing method of multilayer PCB
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cooperative processing method of a multilayer PCB, in particular to the technical field of PCB, which comprises the following specific processing steps: s1, positioning the PCB: firstly, preparing a PCB raw material to be processed, then placing three groups of PCBs on the surface of a PCB preset platform, and horizontally displacing the whole PCB preset platform structure through a second electric push rod, and then clamping and positioning the center of the side surface of the PCB after displacement adjustment through a cooperative positioning mechanism; according to the invention, through the structural cooperation of the cooperative punching mechanism, the positioning holes which are completely consistent can be punched into the four corners of a plurality of groups of PCBs at the same time, the mounting base is integrally lifted through the scissor-type lifting platform, so that the punching operation and the laminating operation of the PCBs are combined with each other, and the control is carried out through the group of positioning structures, so that the switching process of punching and laminating operation is omitted, the consumption of driving force and structure and the cost are reduced, and the working efficiency of the multilayer PCBs is greatly improved.

title_en: Automatic bending device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of aviation breaker accessory preparation devices and discloses an automatic bending device. The automatic bending device comprises a frame, wherein a moving mechanism and a bending mechanism are arranged on a workbench of the frame, the moving mechanism comprises a bimetallic strip limiting module, and the bimetallic strip limiting module is movably arranged on the workbench along a first direction; the pressing and bending mechanism comprises a pressing component and a pressing and bending component, the pressing component and the pressing and bending component are movably arranged on the workbench along the vertical direction, and when the pressing component is positioned at a pressing station, the pressing component presses two to-be-screwed rod parts of the bimetallic strip blank positioned at the bending position; the press bending assembly is used for moving along the vertical direction when the press assembly is in the press station so as to bend the middle connecting part of the bimetallic strip blank. The automatic bending device can realize the accurate positioning of the bimetallic strip limiting module and the bimetallic strip blank through the moving mechanism, and the bending mechanism can realize the bending deformation from the bimetallic strip blank to the bimetallic strip semi-finished product.

title_en: Extraction device and extraction method of rhizoma polygonati extract
abstract_en: The invention provides a device and a method for extracting a polygonatum sibiricum extract. The extraction device and the extraction method of the polygonatum sibiricum extract comprise the following steps: a crushing structure for crushing sealwort, a mixing structure for mixing crushed sealwort and an extrusion structure for squeezing crushed sealwort slag. The invention provides an extraction device and an extraction method of a polygonatum sibiricum extract, wherein a crushing structure, a mixing structure, an extrusion structure and an extracting solution treatment structure are assembled together for use to form an integrated polygonatum sibiricum extraction device, and the polygonatum sibiricum can be crushed, mixed, extruded, sterilized and filtered, so that a set of complete extraction treatment can be performed on the polygonatum sibiricum, all the structures are connected in sequence, and after each treatment is completed, the polygonatum sibiricum is directly conveyed to the next structure for secondary treatment, so that the intermediate transfer operation is omitted, the processing treatment can be continuously performed, and the treatment speed is greatly increased.

title_en: Roller processing device and method
abstract_en: A roller processing device and a processing method relate to the technical field of roller processing, and are used for solving the problems that the roller processing device occupies large space, needs manual repeated cleaning and is troublesome to clean, the manual cost and the cleaning time are increased, automatic blanking is inconvenient after waste collection and the increased manual operation is troublesome in the prior art, the invention arranges a waste collection part at the lower end of a main control platform, a waste extrusion mechanism is arranged on the waste collection part, an automatic discharging mechanism is arranged at the lower end of the waste collection part, a roller is fixed by a first roller fixing mechanism and a second roller fixing mechanism, then a turning tool table moving mechanism is started to drive a turning tool table to cut the roller, the cut waste falls into the waste collection part, is compressed and formed by the waste extrusion mechanism, and is automatically discharged by the automatic discharging mechanism, can realize that the waste material is convenient for collect and transport, artifical use cost is low practices thrift artifically, and then improves production efficiency.

title_en: Automatic change swift current smooth machine of unloading production high outward appearance die casting
abstract_en: The application relates to an automatic change swift current smooth machine of unloading production high outward appearance die casting belongs to the field of swift current smooth equipment technique. It includes swift current smooth quick-witted body and control cabinet, be provided with preceding dodge gate and back dodge gate relatively on the smooth quick-witted body of swift current, be provided with actuating mechanism on the smooth quick-witted body of swift current, actuating mechanism is connected with preceding dodge gate and back dodge gate, actuating mechanism is used for driving preceding dodge gate and carries out the switching with the back dodge gate, the smooth quick-witted is provided with the slide rail that is fillet rectangle outward, dodge gate (11) and back dodge gate before one side of slide rail is passed, be provided with a plurality of mounting brackets on the slide rail, can dismantle on the mounting bracket and be provided with the work or material rest, it is used for carrying out the centre gripping to the work piece fixed to go up the work or material rest, be provided with moving mechanism on the slide rail, moving mechanism links to each other with a plurality of mounting brackets, moving mechanism is used for driving a plurality of mounting brackets and removes along the slide rail. This application has the effect of improving the problem that the work piece was easy fish tail, was damaged in the manual unloading in-process of going up.

title_en: Low-alloy high-strength hot-rolled coil Q390C rolling process
abstract_en: The invention relates to a low-alloy high-strength hot-rolled coil Q390C rolling process, which comprises the steps of S1, heating a plate blank; step S2, roughly rolling the plate blank; step S3, performing finish rolling on the plate blank; and step S4, coiling the blank. In step S3, the thickness of the slab is detected by the thickness detection device, the central control module selects an initial finish rolling speed, and the initial finish rolling speed of the first finish rolling device is further adjusted by detecting the real-time temperature and the flatness of the slab, when the temperature of the slab is high, the plasticity of the slab is strong, and the finish rolling speed can be properly increased to improve the working efficiency, when the temperature of the slab is low, the generation of defects of the finish rolling slab is reduced by reducing the finish rolling speed, and the mechanical damage of the finish rolling component caused by the over-high hardness of the slab is prevented, so that the service life of the finishing mill set is prolonged, and the finish rolling speed and the finish rolling thickness of the first finish rolling device are adjusted by detecting the finish rolling pressure of the second finish rolling device, so that the generation of defects of the finish rolling slab is further reduced.

title_en: Fixture tool for motor gear
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fixture tool for a motor gear, which comprises a workpiece, wherein an arc clamping jaw is arranged on the outer surface of the lower end of the workpiece, a fixed sleeve body is arranged on the outer surface of the lower end of the arc clamping jaw, and a pin shaft and a jackscrew are arranged on the outer wall of the fixed sleeve body. The fixture tool for the motor gear ensures the coaxiality of the workpiece by positioning the central holes at two ends of the workpiece through a double-center clamping method, is matched and connected with a taper hole on a gear hobbing machine workbench through a Morse taper shank at the lower part, is connected and adjusted with a center through threads in the hole, is fixed by a jackscrew after being adjusted, is connected with a fixed sleeve through a pin shaft and can rotate around the pin shaft, and the adjustment nut rotates and adjusts to drive the taper sleeve to tightly jack the arc jaw to clamp the short end of the workpiece.

title_en: Automobile spare and accessory part processing grinding device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of automobiles, in particular to an automobile part machining and polishing device which comprises an operation table, a driving device, a part fixing device, a front polishing device, a rear polishing device and a polisher, wherein the driving device, the part fixing device, the front polishing device, the rear polishing device and the polisher are arranged on the operation table, the part fixing device, the front polishing device and the rear polishing device are arranged on the driving device in a linkage mode, the front polishing device and the rear polishing device are movably arranged on the operation table, and the polishers are movably arranged on the front polishing device and the rear polishing device. The double-side polishing device can fix the brake disc piece with any size, the thickness of the brake disc piece, the pitch of the assembling holes and the aperture of the assembling holes do not influence polishing and fixing, the universality is strong, the front side and the back side of the brake disc piece are simultaneously polished and processed by one motor, and the contact and separation of the polishing head and the brake disc piece can be controlled by rotating the second rotary piece, so that single-side polishing is realized.

title_en: Oil residue secondary squeezing and stripping device for oil production and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a secondary squeezing and stripping device and a secondary squeezing and stripping method for oil residues for oil production, belongs to the technical field of oil production, solves the problems of low oil yield and poor quality of the oil residues, and comprises an oil liquid cylinder, an oil residue cylinder, a movable base, a left lifting mechanism, a right lifting mechanism, a pressurizing mechanism and a bearing mechanism, wherein the oil liquid cylinder and the oil residue cylinder are arranged below the movable base and are respectively used for collecting liquid oil and oil residues, the movable base is connected with the left lifting mechanism and the right lifting mechanism in a sliding manner, and the right lifting mechanism is connected with the pressurizing mechanism in a rotating manner. Utilize the plate body of mutual level parallel to each other to heat and extrude the dregs of fat, improve the dregs of fat oil rate to with two parallel plate body counter rotation 90 degrees after the dregs of fat are oily, thereby make the heat dissipation that the dregs of fat do not have the cover and utilize two plate body to go up and down, the translation, scrape each other and get the residual panel and remain, improve production efficiency, there is not the dregs of fat to remain, improve fluid quality.

title_en: Railway wheel hub burr equipment of polishing
abstract_en: The invention discloses railway wheel hub burr grinding equipment and relates to the technical field of mechanical grinding. This railway wheel hub burr equipment of polishing includes the base, the top of base is fixed with the storage water tank, one side surface of storage water tank has the inlet channel through the fixed intercommunication of ring flange, the top of storage water tank is close to the fixed intercommunication of center department and has the connecting tube, the play water end of connecting tube has the atomizing shower head through the fixed intercommunication of ring flange, one side surface fixed connection of storage water tank has grapple mechanism, and the top fixed connection of one side surface and base of grapple mechanism, the top of base is fixed with the slide bar, one side surface sliding connection of slide bar has control mechanism, one side surface fixed connection of control mechanism has the adapter sleeve, has solved the dust that current wheel hub burr equipment of polishing produced at the in-process of polishing the burr and has harmd the problem of the personnel's of polishing health easily.

title_en: Assembly holder, transfer mechanism and locking wheel assembly device thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of assembly equipment of dust collector parts, in particular to an assembly clamping seat, a transfer mechanism and a stop wheel assembly device thereof. It includes assembly seat and assembly pole, the assembly pole slides and connects on the assembly seat, the external diameter of assembly pole is greater than the aperture of rubber circle, when assembling the locking wheel, the lower terminal surface of second spacing dish with the up end butt of assembly pole. This application has the effect that reduces the assembly degree of difficulty of locking wheel.

title_en: Integral type panel cutting drilling equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an integral type panel cutting drilling equipment belongs to the technical field of panel cutting equipment, and it includes the operation panel, fixed mounting has the saw bit on the operation panel, slidable mounting has perforating device on the operation panel, perforating device is including removing the subassembly and punching the subassembly, it installs to remove the subassembly on the operation panel, it installs to punch the subassembly remove on the subassembly, the subassembly that punches includes the electric drill that is reciprocating motion along vertical direction, and the electric drill is used for driving panel after punching and removes, removes extremely the saw bit position cuts. This application has the effect that improves panel and punches, cutting process efficiency.

title_en: Highlight and flame-retardant marble-imitated wallboard and processing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a processing method of a highlight and flame-retardant marble-imitated wallboard, which comprises a foaming base material layer, a spray printing layer and a highlight protective layer, wherein the spray printing layer is flatly pasted on the top end surface of the foaming base material layer, the highlight protective layer is flatly pasted on the top end surface of the spray printing layer, a glass fiber material is added on the foaming base material layer, a micro-foaming cement board is introduced into the foaming base material layer, and the fire-retardant grade can reach incombustible (A grade) through GB8624 test; can reach A-level fire prevention; the surface pattern can realize customized production and has strong selectivity; the appearance visual effect is similar to that of high-gloss marble; the thinnest thickness produced is only 3mm, and the product is light in weight.

title_en: Full-automatic assembly conveying device and conveying method for movable cutter parts
abstract_en: The invention relates to a full-automatic assembly conveying device and a conveying method for movable cutter components, wherein a movable cutter clamp taking unit takes a movable cutter from a production line clamp and puts the movable cutter into the movable cutter component conveying unit; the movable cutter part conveying unit keeps clamping the movable cutter, conveys the movable cutter to a movable cutter assembling station and keeps clamping the movable cutter; the base assembly device is used for taking the over-travel spring base, the centering spring at one end of the movable cutter base and the centering spring base at one end from the production line clamp and is sequentially installed on the movable cutter; the pin shaft assembling device is used for taking a large pin shaft, a small pin shaft, the other end centering spring and the other end centering spring base from the production line clamp, and is sequentially installed on the movable cutter. The invention realizes automatic clamping and assembling of all parts of the movable cutter part into the movable cutter part and automatic conveying of the movable cutter part.

title_en: Rust prevention process for end face of shaft head of ceramic printing roller
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ceramic printing rollers, in particular to a shaft head end face rust prevention process of a ceramic printing roller, which comprises the following steps: grinding the shaft head part of the machining workshop strictly according to the dimension required by a drawing, and marking the ceramic spraying part corresponding to the printing roller before delivery; carrying out sand blasting operation and spraying operation on the shaft head and the end face of the printing roller respectively; firstly, carrying out sand blasting operation on the layout of the printing roller, and then carrying out sand blasting operation on the shaft head and the end face of the printing roller independently; then, spraying operation is carried out on the layout and the shaft head, and then spraying operation is carried out on the end face; and after the shaft head and the end face are sprayed, the shaft head and the end face are statically cooled and then coated with the hole sealing agent. The invention shortens the processing period, saves time and labor, reduces the use of polluting materials, is green and environment-friendly, and reduces the quality rework rate and the production cost.

title_en: Machine-building stamping device
abstract_en: The invention provides a mechanical manufacturing stamping device, and relates to the technical field of mechanical stamping. The stamping assembly is arranged above the mounting base through a support arm frame, a sliding platform is arranged on the upper end face of the mounting base, the sliding platform is connected with the stamping assembly through a linkage assembly, when the linkage assembly enables the action end of the stamping assembly to move downwards, the sliding platform horizontally moves on the upper end face of the mounting base, and when the sliding platform moves to the maximum distance away from the mounting base, a stamping die is enough to be separated from the lower area of the stamping assembly; when the manual stamping is carried out, the manual force can be converted into the stamping pressure to the greatest extent, so that the labor intensity of personnel is reduced, and the stamping effect is improved; and in the process of taking and placing the stamped parts, accidental injury to personnel can be avoided, and meanwhile, the stamped parts can be easily taken out, so that the whole device has higher practicability, flexibility and safety when in use.

title_en: High-strength corrosion-resistant aluminum alloy drill rod and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-strength corrosion-resistant aluminum alloy drill rod and a preparation method thereof: (1) Refining the aluminum alloy cast ingot to remove oxides and impurities; pouring refined aluminum alloy molten metal into a crucible and preserving heat; (2) Atomizing aluminum alloy metal liquid in a crucible, spraying at high pressure, uniformly depositing, and quickly solidifying to form an aluminum alloy billet on a material bearing plate; (3) Heating the aluminum alloy billet to be semi-solid, and performing densification treatment and seamless aluminum alloy pipe extrusion forming by using a double-acting reverse extrusion process; (4) Acid washing is firstly carried out on the aluminum alloy pipe, and then sand blasting is carried out; (5) ultrasonically cleaning the aluminum alloy pipe; (6) carrying out supersonic flame thermal spraying on the aluminum alloy pipe; (7) carrying out heat treatment after spraying; (8) And heating the aluminum alloy pipe, impregnating the aluminum alloy pipe in a resin solution for hole sealing, and obtaining the high-strength corrosion-resistant aluminum alloy drill rod. The preparation method is simple, the production efficiency is high, and the prepared drill rod has the characteristics of high strength, high hardness, salt spray corrosion resistance and the like.

title_en: Handle intelligence erection equipment of fire extinguisher production line
abstract_en: The invention provides intelligent handle mounting equipment for a fire extinguisher production line, which comprises an intelligent mounting arm, a base and a mobile station mechanism, wherein the bottom of the mobile station mechanism is fixedly connected with the top of the base, and the rear side of the mobile station mechanism is fixedly connected with the front side of the intelligent mounting arm. According to the invention, through the matched use of the intelligent mounting arm, the mobile station mechanism, the rotary toggle mechanism and the adjusting mechanism drive the fire extinguisher tank to move continuously, so that a plurality of structures can move simultaneously, energy is saved, meanwhile, the continuity is strong, the operation is easy, and the problems that the existing handle mounting equipment for fire extinguisher production is inconvenient to convey the fire extinguisher tank and a handle in the use process, the conveying and fixing of the fire extinguisher are usually used independently and cannot be continuous, the middle moving process is not continuous, the fire extinguisher processing and production speed is slow, and the continuity is poor are solved.

title_en: Multifunctional quality inspection table for hardware product processing
abstract_en: A multifunctional quality inspection table for hardware product processing is characterized in that two support columns are fixedly connected to one side of the top of a workbench relatively, a connecting plate is fixedly connected between the tops of the two support columns, a placing tray is movably connected to one side, close to the workbench, of the connecting plate, a limiting box is fixedly connected to the middle of the top end of the workbench, a placing groove is formed in the middle of the top end of the limiting box, a supporting plate is connected to the inside of the placing groove in a sliding mode, one side, close to the connecting plate, of the workbench is rotatably connected with a first transmission rod, the guide plate can be rotated onto a conveying belt only by pushing a T-shaped transmission rod at the bottom of the workbench to move through feet, workpieces are convenient to take off from the conveying belt, sampling inspection can be conducted at any time, the sampling randomness is improved, and the sampling difficulty is reduced; the top of workstation is equipped with the spacing box that promotes through the chest, when placing the work piece on the layer board in the standing groove, presses the stripper plate through the chest, can make the extrusion strip on No. three transfer lines extrude the work piece in the side of standing groove, realizes the purpose that presss from both sides tightly the work piece fast.

title_en: Rope bundle fixing device for surveying and mapping engineering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rope bundle fixing device for surveying and mapping engineering, and belongs to the technical field of auxiliary instruments for surveying and mapping engineering. A rope bundle fixing device for mapping engineering comprises a box body, wherein a fixing plate is welded on the inner wall of the right side of the box body, a motor A is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the right side of the box body, a winding rod is arranged on the left wall of the fixing plate, a measuring rope is wound on the outer wall of the winding rod, an adjusting rod is arranged above a limiting plate, a cleaning box is welded on the front wall of the box body, two U-shaped frames are symmetrically arranged in the cleaning box in the left-right direction, extrusion wheels are arranged in the U-shaped frames, and through the arrangement of the extrusion wheels, when in winding, the motor B is utilized to drive one extrusion wheel to rotate, so that the rotating gear drives the other meshed gear, then the U-shaped frame connected with the T-shaped rod drives the two extrusion wheels to move towards the middle by utilizing the spring, so that the measuring rope containing water is extruded, thereby extrude the water in the measuring rope to guarantee that the measuring rope can rapid draing, great improvement the life of measuring rope.

title_en: Leak dropping board machine-shaping device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a processing device, in particular to a processing and forming device for a dung leaking plate. The invention aims to solve the technical problem of how to design a dung leaking plate processing and forming device which is simple to operate, can improve the working efficiency and saves manpower. In order to solve the technical problem, the invention provides a processing and forming device for a dropping leaking plate, which comprises: the top parts of the two brackets are connected with a frame; the frame is connected with the mounting rack; the mounting frame is provided with a cylinder; the telescopic rod of the air cylinder is connected with the extrusion block; and the clamping mechanism is arranged between the frame and the mounting frame. The excrement leakage plate is processed by the cooperation of the extrusion block and the clamping mechanism, so that the effect of processing the excrement leakage plate is achieved.

title_en: Automatic filler device of timber slicer
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic filling device of a wood slicer, which comprises a machine table, a conveying belt body arranged at the top of the machine table and a slicing feeding position at the edge position of the machine table, wherein a servo motor is arranged on the surface of one side of the machine table; through the arrangement of the structure, the tearing prevention mechanism can prevent the conveyer belt from being torn and damaged, reduces the loss of resources, improves the service life of equipment, can improve the conveying efficiency, can also enable the timber to be located in the middle position of the device, is convenient for the processing of slicing machine equipment, can also improve the efficiency of timber processing, and avoids the condition that the conveyer belt is damaged by retreating the timber in the processing process.

title_en: Three-station circulating device applied to extrusion equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-station circulating device applied to extrusion equipment, which comprises an extrusion beam, an extrusion rod seat, an upper guide support, a lower guide support, a connecting frame, a hydraulic oil cylinder, a pressure bearing pad, a base plate, a pressure ring, a plug, a pressing cylinder, a stuffy car pad, a stuffy car sleeve, a stuffy car protective sleeve and a mold taking manipulator, wherein the upper guide support and the lower guide support are respectively arranged at the upper part and the lower part of the extrusion beam, and the extrusion rod seat is arranged between the extrusion beam and the upper guide support and the lower guide support; the hydraulic oil cylinder is arranged on the extrusion beam, the piston rod is connected to the connecting frame through the spherical hinge ear ring, and the connecting frame is connected to the extrusion rod seat; the pressure bearing pad is arranged in the extrusion beam, the base plate, the pressure ring and the plug are arranged in the extrusion rod seat, and the pressing cylinder applies force to the base plate through the extrusion rod seat; the extrusion rod seat is provided with a first stop block and a second stop block, and the lower guide support is provided with a first limit block and a second limit block. The invention can rapidly realize the switching among the extrusion station, the mold taking station and the closed station, each station is accurately positioned, and the extrusion production efficiency is improved.

title_en: Corrugated medium presses stupefied trimming device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a corrugated medium edge pressing and trimming device, which relates to the technical field of corrugated paper processing and comprises a machine base, wherein a lower pressing plate and an upper pressing plate are arranged at the top of the machine base, wavy bulges for edge pressing are arranged on the lower pressing plate and the upper pressing plate, a paper roll is arranged at one end of the machine base, raw paper of the paper roll passes through the space between the lower pressing plate and the upper pressing plate after bypassing the top of the machine base, the lower pressing plate is slidably arranged at the top of the machine base, the lower pressing plate is connected with an automatic reset elastic assembly, and a lifting guide mechanism for transversely moving and guiding the upper pressing plate is arranged at the top of the upper pressing plate. According to the invention, the base paper is subjected to edge pressing molding by utilizing the extrusion of the upper pressing plate and the lower pressing plate, and the edge cutting knife cuts the redundant edge along the side walls of the lower pressing plate and the upper pressing plate.

title_en: High-plasticity magnesium alloy and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-plasticity magnesium alloy which comprises the following chemical elements in percentage by mass: 1.0 to 8.0 percent of Gd, 5.5 to 10 percent of Li, and the balance of Mg and inevitable impurities, wherein the total content of the impurities is less than or equal to 0.3 percent. The invention also discloses a preparation method of the high-plasticity magnesium alloy. According to the high-plasticity magnesium alloy provided by the invention, a beta-Li phase with a BCC structure and more slip systems is introduced into an alpha-Mg phase to construct a dual-phase structure, so that the plasticity of the magnesium alloy is improved; a certain amount of Gd element is added into the Mg-Li alloy, so that the texture is weakened, and the non-basal plane slippage is promoted; the introduction of beta-Li phase with good plasticity and the plasticizing method of weakening texture and the like are combined, so that the plasticity of the magnesium alloy is improved compositely.

title_en: Processing equipment and process for output shaft of driving motor for new energy automobile
abstract_en: The invention discloses processing equipment and a processing technology for a driving motor output shaft for a new energy automobile, and the processing equipment comprises a base, wherein the upper surface of the base is fixedly connected with a first vertical block and a second vertical block, the first vertical block and the second vertical block are both provided with circular holes, the circular holes of the first vertical block and the second vertical block are both rotatably connected with a rotating block through a bearing, and a polishing mechanism is arranged in the first vertical block; the grinding mechanism comprises a reciprocating lead screw, and the reciprocating lead screw is connected with the first vertical block and the second vertical block in a penetrating and rotating mode. Has the advantages that: the processing equipment provided by the invention can absorb metal dust generated in the processing process, avoid the pollution to the processing environment caused by diffusion of the metal dust, ensure the health of processing personnel, automatically coordinate the traveling speed and the rotating speed, ensure the processing quality, automatically feed and discharge materials, and has the advantages of higher automation degree, lower processing labor intensity, higher processing efficiency and wider application range.

title_en: Automatic arc welding equipment for plates
abstract_en: The invention discloses automatic arc welding equipment for plates, which comprises a processing platform, wherein the processing platform is provided with a welding head; the horizontal activity of one end of processing platform upper surface is provided with the pay-off base plate, the plate has been placed to pay-off base plate upper surface, pay-off base plate upper surface is provided with stop gear, stop gear is including fixing a pair of casing at pay-off base plate both ends, it is a pair of grip block is provided with between the casing, and is a pair of the grip block is located the both sides of plate respectively, the inside slidable mounting of casing has a pair of slider, and is a pair of two-way threaded rod is worn to be equipped with by the screw thread between the slider, two-way threaded rod rotates to be installed inside the casing, all rotate on the slider and be connected with and push away the arm. This an automatic arc welding equipment for plate can accomplish the even welding to the plate when the plate is carried, and has roller brush clearance function.

title_en: Copper-coated steel round wire welding device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a copper-coated steel round wire welding device, which belongs to the technical field of welding and comprises a copper-coated steel round wire centering and clamping mechanism, a copper-coated steel round wire stress application welding mechanism, a rack assembly, a motor, a speed reducer and a transmission chain; a movable V-shaped block component in the copper-clad steel round wire centering and clamping mechanism is used for positioning the copper-clad steel round wire at the front end; the adjustable V-shaped block assembly is used for positioning the rear end copper and covering the steel round wire, the adjustable V-shaped block assembly can achieve X, Y displacement adjustment and Z-direction displacement adjustment, rapid centering can be achieved when the front end copper is covered on the steel round wire in welding, the copper is covered on the steel round wire welding pressurizing mechanism, variable force pressurization of the copper covered on the steel round wire is achieved through the cam mechanism, the reset spring is arranged in the rack assembly, and the fact that the copper is covered on the original position can be guaranteed after the welding of the adjustable V-shaped block assembly of the steel round wire centering clamping mechanism. The invention can better overcome the defects in the welding process of the existing copper-clad steel round wire and is convenient for the quick high-quality welding of the copper-clad steel round wire in the production process of the copper-clad steel round wire.

title_en: Automatic blanking device and method for small stamped metal parts
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic blanking device and method for stamped small metal pieces, which comprises a blanking machine, wherein a cutting frame is arranged at the upper end of the blanking machine in a sliding manner, a transmission mechanism capable of being continuously adjusted is arranged on the inner side of the blanking machine, the transmission mechanism comprises a support, a rotating shaft, a disc, an output shaft, a first gear, a second gear, a push rod and a lug, the support slides on two sides in the blanking frame, the rotating shaft is hinged to the inner side of the lower end of the support, the disc rotates on one side of the rotating shaft, the output shaft rotates on the back of the disc, the lugs on two sides of the lower end of a rotating disc are sequentially pushed horizontally, then the rotating disc rotates in an angle manner, the rotating disc drives a connecting rod and a sleeve to rotate when rotating, further the rotating disc can drive the stamped metal on the inner side of the sleeve to rapidly and automatically move, so that the blanking device can automatically switch the position of the stamped metal after single stamping, thereby ensuring the working continuity of the blanking device, the condition that the existing blanking device needs to stop working and discharge continuously is avoided.

title_en: Automatic cutting equipment for mechanical engineering
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of cutting equipment, and discloses automatic cutting equipment for mechanical engineering, which comprises a machine base, a screw rod, a hydraulic driving rod, a cutting motor, a clamping and pressing plate, a cutting workbench, a conveying belt and a fine scrap collecting tank, wherein the machine base is provided with a guide rail; a cutting workbench is supported and mounted above the machine base through a machine column, an organic transverse frame is fixedly mounted on the top end of the machine column, and a fine scrap collecting tank and a coarse scrap collecting tank are arranged below the cutting workbench through a supporting plate; a screw rod is arranged in the transverse frame, and a screw rod motor which is in driving connection with the screw rod is arranged at one end of the transverse frame; the hydraulic driving rod is arranged on the screw rod through a screw rod sliding seat, and the bottom end of the hydraulic driving rod is provided with a cutting motor through a motor mounting seat. According to the automatic cutting machine, a transmission belt transmits a to-be-cut accessory, the accessory is clamped and fixed by the pressing plate, the electric cabinet orderly controls the cutting height and position to be adjusted, automatic cutting is achieved, and the cutting quality is improved; the labor intensity of workers is reduced, the working environment is improved, and the effect of effectively collecting and cleaning the scraps is achieved.

title_en: Cutting and polishing integrated machine for electronic product accessories
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cutting and polishing integrated machine for electronic product accessories, which comprises a base, wherein the top wall of the base is provided with a conveying groove, the top wall of the base is symmetrically and fixedly connected with vertical plates, the inner side walls of the two vertical plates are fixedly connected with a sealing box, the inner part of the sealing box is hermetically and slidably connected with a magnetic plate, the side wall of the sealing box is fixedly connected with a plurality of guide rods, the side walls of the plurality of guide rods are slidably connected with a moving block, the inner wall of the moving block is provided with a sliding cavity, the inner wall of the sliding cavity is symmetrically and slidably connected with a piston, the side walls of the piston are fixedly connected with a second connecting rod, and the second connecting rod penetrates through the inner wall of the corresponding sliding cavity and then is fixedly connected with a magnetic ring. According to the invention, through arranging the box body, the conductive spring, the moving block and other structures, currents with different magnitudes are introduced into the conductive spring, so that the circular motion track of the grinding machine is changed and is respectively abutted against the inner side wall and the outer side wall of the circular tube type electronic product fitting, and then the inner surface and the outer surface of the grinding machine are ground.

title_en: Device for carrying out high-precision self-adaptive grinding on swash plate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device for carrying out high-precision self-adaptive grinding on a swash plate, relates to the technical field of grinding devices, and is used for solving the technical problems that the traditional high-precision grinding can have adverse effects on the body and environment of an operator and is not beneficial to field production safety management. Wherein: pressure device, grinder and grinding platform distribute from top to bottom along the space of triaxial manipulator, pressure device and grinder synchronous motion, and a plurality of swash plates of waiting to grind are installed in grinder, and pressure device provides pressure for grinder, waits to grind the swash plate and contact with grinding platform under grinder drives, and triaxial manipulator drives pressure device and grinder and presses the orbit motion of predetermineeing in the plane, treats to grind the swash plate and grinds. The device for carrying out high accuracy self-adaptation to sloping cam plate grinding simple structure, convenient to use can process simultaneously a plurality of sloping cam plates and grind, has improved the efficiency of processing, uses safe and reliable more, has very high practicality.

title_en: Clamping device for door and window processing
abstract_en: The invention provides a clamping device for door and window processing, which comprises a workbench, wherein two grooves are arranged on the surface of the workbench side by side, the inner walls, close to each other, of the two grooves are connected with a first rack in a sliding manner, the inner walls, far away from each other, of the two grooves are connected with a second rack in a sliding manner, a gear meshed with the first rack and the second rack in the same groove respectively is connected in a rotating manner in the middle of each groove, a first clamping plate is fixedly connected to the first rack in the two grooves, a second clamping plate is fixedly connected to the second rack in the two grooves, the first clamping plate and the second clamping plate are arranged oppositely, and a driving mechanism for driving the first clamping plate and the second clamping plate to approach or separate from each other is arranged on the workbench. The invention can clamp and fix the sectional materials with different sizes, and is convenient and quick to operate.

title_en: Processing equipment for anti-skid patterns of track beam
abstract_en: The invention discloses a processing device for anti-skid patterns of a track beam, which comprises: the lathe bed component is in a strip shape; the fixing component is used for fixing the track beam plate material to the lathe bed component; the machine head assembly comprises a machine frame and a cutter, the machine frame is arranged on the machine body assembly and can move relative to the machine body assembly, the cutter is arranged on the machine frame and can move relative to the machine frame, and the cutter is used for processing anti-skid patterns on the surface of the rail beam plate material; the driving assembly comprises a first driving device, a second driving device and a third driving device, wherein the first driving device is used for driving the frame to move along the length direction of the lathe bed assembly so that the frame drives the cutter to move along the length direction of the rail beam plate, the second driving device is used for driving the cutter to rotate around a preset axis relative to the frame, and the third driving device is used for driving the cutter to move along the width direction of the lathe bed assembly relative to the frame. The processing equipment is suitable for processing curved track beam plates.

title_en: Three-dimensional printing system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a three-dimensional printing system, in particular to a three-dimensional printing system which has flexibility and a non-contact forging function compared with the existing laser coaxial wire feeding three-dimensional printing technology, and belongs to the technical field of additive manufacturing. Compared with the existing coaxial wire feeding three-dimensional printing technology based on laser heating, the method has the advantages that: flexible heating strategies can be realized; printing supporting finer structures; excessive heating of the just deposited molten raw material can be avoided; the metal crystal grains can be subjected to strong modulation in the three-dimensional printing process, the stirring effect is generated on the molten pool, the area where the molten raw material is deposited can be preheated in advance, the hot cracking can be restrained, and the part with higher comprehensive performance is obtained; the laser cleaning can be integrated in the three-dimensional printing process, so that the three-dimensional printing of the metal can be realized on the premise of not using protective gas in the air; the mechanical assembly precision of the laser path is extremely high in fault tolerance. The invention has outstanding substantial progress.

title_en: Method for grinding a tooth profile or contour of a workpiece
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for grinding a tooth profile (1) or contour of a workpiece (2), in particular a gear, wherein the workpiece (2) has a rotational axis (a) and wherein a margin (A) is ground off from the surface of the tooth flank of the tooth profile (1) or contour. In order to optimize the grinding process, according to the invention, the method comprises the following steps: a) measuring the position of the surface of the tooth flank of the tooth profile (1) or contour, wherein the measurement is carried out in at least two positions (P1, P2) of the workpiece (2), which positions (P1, P2) are arranged offset in the direction of the axis of rotation (a); b) determining the actually present residual quantity (A) of the workpiece (2) that has not yet been ground on the basis of the measured values determined in step a); c) -establishing at least one grinding parameter (v) such that during grinding the material removal rate does not exceed a predetermined value; d) grinding the workpiece (2) according to the grinding parameters (v) established in step c).

title_en: Wire shaping tool for wire pinching
abstract_en: The invention discloses a metal wire shaping tool for wire pinching and drawing, and belongs to the technical field of artistic auxiliary appliances. The clamping jaw mainly comprises a containing unit, a handle assembly arranged on the containing unit, a bending assembly arranged on the containing unit, a stretching assembly arranged on the containing unit and a limiting assembly matched with the bending assembly, wherein the stretching assembly comprises a cylinder body, two connecting pipes fixedly connected with two sides of the cylinder body respectively, a hollow disc which is connected with one end of the connecting pipe far away from the cylinder body in a penetrating manner and fixedly connected with the outer surface of the containing unit, a first pneumatic telescopic shaft which is connected with the hollow disc in a penetrating manner, a second push rod fixedly connected with one end of the first pneumatic telescopic shaft far away from the hollow disc, and a movable clamping jaw fixedly connected with one end of the second push rod far away from the first pneumatic telescopic shaft. According to the invention, the metal wire is clamped in the movable clamping jaw, the gas in the cylinder body is controlled to enter the first pneumatic telescopic shaft to stretch the first pneumatic telescopic shaft, and the movable clamping jaw is driven to stretch the metal wire towards the two ends, so that the metal wire is shaped.

title_en: Thin-wall array bulge structure forming tool and forming method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a forming tool and a forming method for a thin-wall array bulge structure, wherein the forming tool comprises a female die and a male die which are oppositely arranged; the female die and the male die conform to the shape of the thin-wall array to be formed, and the other surfaces of the female die or the male die except the highest position of the bulge structure corresponding to the thin-wall array are integrally removed by a certain thickness. The forming method comprises the following steps: designing the shapes of a female die and a male die according to the shape of the thin-wall array to be formed; removing a certain thickness on the whole of the other surfaces of the female die or the male die except the highest position of the bulge structure corresponding to the thin-wall array; and carrying out hot press forming on the thin-wall array bulge structure by adopting a hot press mode on the female die and the male die. The invention can well solve the problem that the thin-wall array bulge structure is easy to crack in the extrusion forming process, and greatly improves the quality of the formed product.

title_en: Rotary sealing element machining equipment and machining method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rotary sealing element processing device and a processing method, belonging to the technical field of sealing element processing, and comprising a base, wherein two conveying shells are fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the base, two first rotating shafts are rotatably arranged in the conveying shells, conveying rollers are fixed on the outer surfaces of the first rotating shafts, the two conveying rollers are in transmission connection through a conveying belt, and side baffles are arranged on the front side and the rear side above the conveying belt; through the conveyer belt that sets up workstation and workstation both sides, use through belt and band pulley and bevel gear linkage between the pivot one of workstation both sides and the workstation, can realize that the conveyer belt goes up the synchronous rotation of unloading and workstation, and the cooperation is sheared sword, the cooperation of punching press head scraping wings and is used, realizes that the material loading is carried, the punching press, is cuted, is pushed away the synchronous continuous of material and unloading transport and goes on, and multiple processing procedure goes on in succession, and whole mechanical linkage nature is strong, effectively promotes work efficiency.

title_en: Hardware instrument positioning and punching equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hardware processing, in particular to a hardware instrument positioning and punching device which is convenient for improving the automation degree of drilling, improving the processing efficiency, saving labor and time and improving the practicability and safety of the device; the workbench comprises a workbench, the mobile device, the mount, the pole setting, the crossbeam, elevator motor, drilling motor and cleaning device, the workstation bottom end symmetry is provided with two sets of backup pads, mobile device fixed mounting is on the workstation top and the top is provided with the shifting chute, mount movable mounting is in mobile device's shifting chute, the mount top is provided with three solid fixed splint of group, pole setting fixed mounting is at workstation top rear portion, crossbeam fixed mounting is in the pole setting and crossbeam rear end and pole setting front end top are connected, elevator motor fixed mounting is anterior at crossbeam top, elevator motor's output is provided with the connecting rod, the connecting rod passes crossbeam to crossbeam below, drilling motor top and connecting rod bottom fixed connection.

title_en: Junction box welding equipment for photovoltaic panel
abstract_en: The invention relates to photovoltaic panel welding equipment, in particular to junction box welding equipment for a photovoltaic panel. Provided is a photovoltaic panel junction box welding device capable of automatically performing welding work of a photovoltaic panel junction box, and having high work efficiency. The invention is realized by the following technical approaches: the utility model provides a terminal box welding equipment of photovoltaic board, including base, guide holder, first installation piece, mounting panel, electric welding torch etc. is equipped with the guide holder in the middle of the base top rear side, and the slide type of guide holder upside is equipped with first installation piece, and first installation piece lower part evenly slidingtype is equipped with four mounting panels, and the mounting panel front side all is equipped with the electric welding torch that is used for carrying out welding work. Through control cylinder, electric welder and servo motor work, alright carry out the terminal box of photovoltaic board automatically and carry out welding work, so need not the manual work and weld, work efficiency is high, still can avoid the workman to have the risk of scalding from electric welder too closely.

title_en: Medium manganese steel part treatment method based on combination of plastic forming and heat treatment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for processing a medium manganese steel part based on combination of plastic forming and heat treatment, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of: (1) heating the medium manganese steel part to 30-50 ℃ above the austenite transformation finishing temperature Ac3, and keeping the temperature for 5-10 minutes to ensure that the structure is completely austenitized; (2) then carrying out hot stamping forming on the medium manganese steel part between the martensite transformation starting temperature Ms point and the martensite transformation finishing temperature Mf point, and maintaining the pressure for 0-20s, wherein the pressure maintaining pressure is 3000 KG; (3) transferring into a heating furnace, performing carbon partition heat treatment for 10-60 s at a temperature 30-50 ℃ higher than the martensite transformation start temperature Ms point, and cooling to room temperature; (4) and finally, the steel is sent to a heating furnace to carry out annealing heat treatment in a critical region between an austenitizing transformation starting temperature Ac1 point and an austenitizing transformation finishing temperature Ac3 point, and the steel is air-cooled to room temperature.

title_en: High-strength wear-resistant aluminum alloy hub and forging device thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-strength wear-resistant aluminum alloy wheel hub and a forging device thereof, and relates to the technical field of high-strength wear-resistant wheel hubs. According to the invention, the high-strength hardening layer is used for protecting the external impact, the hardness on the surface of the hub is increased, the compression layer is matched for compressing the extrusion on the surface of the hub, the buffer layer is used for buffering the impact force of the extrusion on the tire core, and the anti-rust layer is matched for preventing water on the surface of the hub, so that the high-hardness characteristic of the hub is increased, the problem that the surface of the traditional hub is easy to crack when being extruded by point positions is solved, and the effect of increasing the high-hardness characteristic of the hub is achieved.

title_en: Oxidation-resistant preformed soldering lug and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides an oxidation resistance preformed soldering lug, which comprises a soldering flux core layer and a solder alloy shell layer arranged on the periphery of the soldering flux core layer, wherein an oxidation resistance film layer is arranged on the periphery of the solder alloy shell layer; by coating an oxidation resistant film on the solder alloy shell layer, the oxidation resistance of the solder metal outer layer is improved, and the solder alloy shell layer is easy to store; the polysiloxane has stable property and good insulativity, is used as an antioxidant film, and is modified by adopting phenyl and polyether organic matters, so that the stability and ductility of the antioxidant film on the surface of a solder metal are improved, the antioxidant film has excellent antioxidant capacity, and the surface of an electronic product is not damaged by no residue after welding, thereby realizing high-precision and high-reliability brazing.

title_en: Thick plate welding method in low-temperature state
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of thick plate welding, in particular to a thick plate welding method in a low-temperature state, and the following scheme is proposed, which comprises the following steps: s1 pretreatment of blank: cutting and polishing the welding end of the thick steel plate to be welded into a slope shape, polishing and cleaning the slope, and polishing the cut impurities; s2, placing the pre-processed blank on a welding device for clamping and fixing: placing the cut and polished thick steel plates on a welding device for positioning and clamping, so that the gaps between the two groups of thick steel plates are kept consistent; s3: pre-heating treatment of the blank: and (3) preheating the thick steel plate positioned and clamped on the welding device. The clamping and positioning device can be adaptive to clamping and positioning operations of thick steel plates with different widths and lengths, and an isolation cavity for heat preservation is formed in a self-adaptive mode according to the width of the thick steel plates when the thick steel plates are subjected to heat preservation, so that the cost input of a welding device is reduced, the application range of the welding device is enlarged, the welding range of the welding device is enlarged, the cost is saved, and the welding efficiency is improved.

title_en: Tool for horizontally calibrating cam oscillating bar of shuttle
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of calibration tools, and particularly relates to a tool for horizontally calibrating a cam oscillating bar of a shuttle. According to the invention, the side plate bolt unit, the L-shaped lifting plate unit and the vertical push plate unit are arranged on the main body plate unit, so that the horizontal calibration operation of the cam oscillating bar is more comprehensive and flexible. The invention has the following advantages: firstly, the parallel operation of the tool and the upper and lower edges of the shuttle frame plate is simple and convenient, the tool can be placed on a horizontal plane, and can also be hung after the upper surface is clamped, so that the tool is not limited by the flatness of a supporting plane during installation; and secondly, the tool can be adjusted up and down compared with the shuttle frame body plate, so that the cam swing rods at different mounting positions can enter the side plate bolt units.

title_en: Turning and milling composite seven-shaft machine tool
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a seven compound lathe of turnning and milling relates to digit control machine tool technical field, which comprises a frame, the turnning and milling machine constructs including rotating the electric main shaft that sets up in the frame, set up the support in the frame, set up the milling cutter that carries out the turnning and milling to criticizing first raw materials on the support, be equipped with drive milling cutter pivoted rotating assembly on the support, be equipped with the removal subassembly that the drive support slided in the frame, rotating assembly sets up the pivot on the support including rotating, set up drive pivot pivoted rotating electrical machines on the support, milling cutter sets up in the one end that the pivot is close to electric main shaft. This application utilizes rotating electrical machines to drive milling cutter through setting up the pivot and rotates to make milling cutter's angularly adjustable, the milling cutter of being convenient for will criticize first tip and process out the heliciform, also can will criticize first tip simultaneously and process out cross or a word, make the lathe various to the kind of criticizing first processing, thereby have the advantage that improves the lathe suitability.

title_en: Welding device with workpiece multi-angle adjusting function for robot machining
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of robot machining, and particularly relates to a welding device with a workpiece multi-angle adjusting function for robot machining, which comprises a fixed table, wherein a fixed seat is welded on the upper surface of the fixed table, and a first motor is fixedly arranged on the front surface of the fixed seat; two splint or four splint centre gripping work pieces through the symmetry, start the second motor, the second motor drives the splint rotation that corresponds, thereby it rotates in step to drive the work piece, reach the purpose that the work piece was adjusted to the multi-angle, need not the manual upset of personnel or remove the work piece, the welding jobs that carries on of the continuity of being convenient for, improve work efficiency, cooperation adjustment subassembly, the second extensible member on the base drives the whole surperficial lateral sliding at the fixed station of fixed plate, the cooperation of spout and cassette, do benefit to the gliding stability of fixed plate, be wear-resisting material because of the articulamentum, reduce the clearance between cassette and the spout, improve the stability between cassette and the fixed station, realize the work piece position adjustment on a large scale.

title_en: Nano-polarization system and polarization method and depolarization method in ferroelectric material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ferroelectric material internal nano polarization system, a polarization method and a depolarization method. The invention has higher precision and can carry out three-dimensional reconstruction.

title_en: Straightening machine for adjusting surface flatness of aluminum alloy template
abstract_en: The invention relates to a straightening machine for adjusting the surface flatness of an aluminum alloy template, which is convenient for protecting equipment during material transportation by arranging a limiting device, can effectively reduce the phenomenon of material deviation caused by vibration generated during the transportation of the equipment, reduces the condition that the material deviation needs manual adjustment, further improves the integral stability of the equipment, comprises a machine body, a rolling shaft and a limiting device, wherein an illumination structure is arranged on the machine body, one side of the machine body is fixedly connected with a conveying frame, the utility model discloses a leveling machine, including a body, a leveling shaft, a feeding frame, a limiting device, a fixing frame, a leveling shaft, a leveling device and a driver, wherein the feeding frame is arranged on the other side of the body, a plurality of rolling shafts are arranged on the inner wall of the body, the leveling shaft is arranged above the rolling shafts, two adjusting rods are arranged on the two sides of the leveling shaft, the adjusting rods are in threaded connection with the inner wall of the body, the driver is arranged on one side of the body, the limiting device is arranged on the surface of the feeding frame, and the limiting device comprises a fixing frame which is fixedly connected with the surface of the limiting device.

title_en: Bio-based composite material production line for producing automobile door plate interior trim parts
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of automotive interior production, and particularly relates to a bio-based composite material production line for automotive door sheet interior production, which comprises a base, wherein the four corners of the top of the base are provided with brackets, the top of each bracket is provided with a processing table, the top of each processing table is provided with a transmission device, the four corners of the top of each processing table are provided with upright posts, and the top of each upright post is provided with a footstock; the lifting cylinder is arranged on the left side of the top of the base, a carrying plate is arranged at the top of the lifting cylinder, hinge brackets are arranged on two sides of the top of the carrying plate, a driving motor is arranged on one side of each hinge bracket, a discharging roller is arranged between the hinge brackets, and the output end of the driving motor penetrates through the hinge brackets and is connected with the discharging roller; the liquid storage tank, the liquid storage tank sets up in the top left side of footstock, and its is rational in infrastructure, in the in-process of use, the material can be cut simultaneously to convenient material loading unloading.

title_en: Electronic component manufacturing equipment and manufacturing process
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electronic component manufacturing device and a manufacturing method, and the electronic component manufacturing device specifically comprises the following steps: the top of the workbench is fixedly connected with a support frame, the top of the support frame is fixedly connected with a lifting seat, and the bottom of the lifting seat is fixedly connected with a stamping cylinder; one side of the stamping device is fixedly connected with the inner wall of the support frame, and the top of the stamping device is connected with the stamping cylinder; the conveying belt is arranged at the top of the workbench, and a supporting device is fixedly connected onto the conveying belt; the punching device includes: the invention relates to the technical field of electronic components. According to the manufacturing equipment and the manufacturing method of the electronic component, the punch is simple to replace and operate, the punch does not need to be disassembled or assembled, the use is convenient, and punching scraps can be collected.

title_en: Laser/ultrasonic composite auxiliary bending forming method and device for titanium alloy plate
abstract_en: A laser/ultrasonic composite auxiliary bending forming method and a device for a titanium alloy plate belong to the field of bending forming of titanium alloy plates. The bending forming method comprises the following steps: removing impurities from the titanium alloy plate, blackening the titanium alloy plate, fixing the titanium alloy plate by using a deformation part of a device, repeatedly scanning a bending deformation area of the titanium alloy plate by adopting laser, applying ultrasonic vibration to the titanium alloy plate to gradually bend the titanium alloy plate to a preset angle, and keeping the bending deformation area for 90-120 seconds; stopping laser scanning and ultrasound, loosening the deformation part of the device, and cleaning to obtain the titanium alloy plate bending part. According to the method, the local thermal effect of laser-assisted forming is used, the forming of the small-radius bending part is realized, and the bending performance of the titanium alloy is improved; and by means of the ultrasonic vibration effect of the material, uneven thermal stress generated in a forming area after repeated scanning of laser is eliminated, the problems of warping, distortion and the like of the titanium alloy bending piece are reduced, and the quality of the titanium alloy bending piece is improved. Meanwhile, the method has the advantages of low energy consumption, low production cost and the like.

title_en: Car hinge section bar milling unit convenient to material loading
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of automobile hinge machining, in particular to an automobile hinge section milling device convenient for feeding. The problems to be solved are that: the manual feeding of workers is tedious, slow, low in precision and high in risk, so that the quality of a finished product after processing does not reach the standard. The technical implementation scheme of the invention is as follows: a milling device for automobile hinge section bars convenient for loading comprises a protective shell, milling equipment and the like; and a protective shell is arranged on the milling equipment. The automobile hinge section bar loading device has the advantages that the automobile hinge section bar is convenient to load, workers do not need to place the automobile hinge into the milling equipment, the loading danger is greatly reduced while the loading is convenient, the loading process is simple and rapid, after the loading is completed, the position and the state of the automobile hinge on the milling equipment are automatically adjusted, the machining precision of the automobile hinge is improved, the waste scraps remained on the milling equipment are automatically removed, and the collection is performed after the removal, so that the manual later-period cleaning is saved.

title_en: Intelligent control motor with good temperature control function and processing device thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent control motor with a good temperature control function and a processing device thereof, and belongs to the technical field of air springs.

title_en: Automatic blind nail planting equipment
