abstract_en: The invention discloses automatic blind nail planting equipment, which comprises: the feeding part, the nail planting part and the material receiving part are sequentially arranged; the feeding part comprises a first frame, a storage rack, a feeding table and a material taking sucker, wherein the storage rack is arranged on the side edge of the first frame, the feeding table is arranged above the first frame, and the material taking sucker is movably arranged above the feeding table; the nail planting part comprises a conveying mechanism and a nail planting mold, the nail planting mold is symmetrically arranged about the conveying mechanism and comprises a sliding part, a mold bracket, a gasket part, a top pressing part and a top bending part; the material receiving part comprises a second frame and a material receiving frame, and the material receiving frame is arranged on the two sides of the second frame. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: the pushing plate can be pushed by the rotating shaft, the rocker arm and the pushing arm, so that the material taking sucker moves above the material storage rack and the feeding table, and the shutter in the material storage rack is automatically moved to the feeding table to be sent out.

title_en: Semi-automatic assembly machine for golf accessory foot stool
abstract_en: The invention discloses a semiautomatic assembling machine for a foot rest of a golf accessory, which comprises a working rack, a stepping conveying device, an automatic screw feeding mechanism, a first screw mounting device, a second screw mounting device, a workpiece rotating device, a foot sleeve pressing device and a discharging device, wherein the stepping conveying device is arranged on the working rack; the first screw mounting device is used for mounting a first screw; the second screw mounting device is used for being sleeved into the chicken leg and mounting a second screw; the screw automatic feeding mechanism is used for feeding screws to the first screw mounting device and the second screw mounting device; the workpiece rotating device is used for rotating the aluminum pipe; the foot sleeve pressing device is used for pressing and sleeving the foot sleeve; the discharging device is used for pushing out the finished golf accessory foot rest; the aluminum pipes are assembled in pairs; the invention has the advantages that: the original manual operation is converted into automatic equipment to be carried out, the working efficiency is improved, and the labor expenditure is reduced.

title_en: Friction stir welding device for hub manufacturing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a friction stir welding device for manufacturing a hub, and relates to the technical field of hub manufacturing. This kind of wheel hub makes friction stir welding device, including bottom plate, anchor clamps body and wheel hub body, the wheel hub body includes rim and radials, the upper side wall of bottom plate is connected with the movable plate through elevating system, and the dead lever that two symmetries set up of lower lateral wall fixedly connected with of movable plate, the lower extreme fixedly connected with fixed cover of dead lever, the rubber strip that the lower lateral wall fixedly connected with annular of fixed cover set up, and the lower lateral wall rotation of movable plate is connected with the dwang. Can avoid the piece in the welding process to splash, safer, simultaneously for it is more convenient to collect the piece, can carry out reuse with the piece of collecting simultaneously, carries out quantitative feed to repair welding process, avoids extravagant, practices thrift the cost more, and, can grind crushing to the piece of collecting before the feed, effect and efficiency when guaranteeing repair welding.

title_en: Cooling device for automobile beam thermoforming mold
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cooling device for a thermoforming mold of an automobile beam, which comprises a mounting seat, a hydraulic cylinder positioned at the upper end of the mounting seat, a pushing column positioned at the output end of the hydraulic cylinder, an upper base positioned at the lower end of the pushing column, an upper mold positioned at the lower end of the upper base, a lower base positioned on the mounting seat, a lower mold positioned at the upper end of the lower base and positioned below the upper mold, a cooling component positioned on the mounting seat and used for cooling the upper mold and the lower mold respectively, an upper base positioned at one side end of the upper base, a lower base positioned at one side end of the lower base and used for starting the cooling component, a power supply piece positioned in the lower base and used for realizing automatic opening and closing of the cooling component, and a driving piece positioned in the lower base and used for switching the power supply piece and guiding the thermoforming mold. According to the cooling device for the automobile beam thermoforming die, disclosed by the invention, the automatic opening and closing of the cooling assembly are completed, the operation steps of operators are simplified, and meanwhile, compared with a manual control mode, electric energy is saved.

title_en: Small-bending-radius external bending method for angle steel
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a small-bending-radius external bending method for angle steel, which comprises the following steps: determining the bending center of the angle steel; heating the bending center and the adjacent positions of the left side and the right side of the bending center; flatly paving the horizontal side face of the angle steel on a horizontal bottom plate, and keeping a right-angle opening of the angle steel towards the inner side; clamping the left side and the right side of the bending center by a fixed side pressing block and a movable side pressing block respectively; and rotating the movable side pressing block to the outer side to a preset bending angle. According to the technical scheme, the thermal deformation bending process is adopted, and the plurality of pressing blocks and the base plate are arranged in the bending equipment, so that the angle steel to be bent is reliably fixed in all directions, and the problems of folds, cracking and the like after the angle steel is bent outside with a small bending radius are avoided.

title_en: Installation equipment for piston ring assembly
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mounting device for piston ring assembly, which comprises a sliding frame, wherein the front surface of the sliding frame is connected with a lifting table in a sliding manner, the inner surface of the lifting table is provided with a lifting column, the lifting column capable of moving up and down is arranged in the lifting table, then a servo motor in a hoisting box is utilized to enable two thread blocks to move towards opposite sides, the piston ring can be horizontally unfolded by matching with a clamping block on a moving plate, the piston ring is prevented from being distorted up and down, the piston ring can be transported by a limiting sleeve on a connecting rod, and after the piston ring moves to the peripheral surface of a piston, the two clamping blocks move towards the relatively close side to enable the piston ring to recover to an initial state, so that the piston ring is sleeved on the piston, the piston ring is assembled by the structure, the piston ring cannot be damaged, and the assembling effect of the piston ring is improved.

title_en: Intelligent transportation system for photovoltaic module production line
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent transportation system for a photovoltaic module production line, which comprises a raw material screening module, a battery module production module and a module quality inspection module, wherein the raw material screening module is used for selecting proper raw materials according to different photovoltaic module requirements, the battery module production module is used for producing battery silicon wafers by using the raw materials, the module quality inspection module is used for detecting the production quality of photovoltaic modules, the raw material screening module is electrically connected with the battery module production module, the battery module production module is electrically connected with the module quality inspection module, the research photovoltaic panel production comprises two parts of a silicon wafer battery and a metal frame, the raw materials are divided into two forms of a silicon rod and a silicon ingot so as to generate the single crystal silicon wafers and the polycrystalline silicon wafers, the two silicon wafers can generate different photovoltaic panels, the silicon rod or the silicon ingot is selected according to the requirements to complete the photovoltaic panel production, the invention has the characteristics of accurate quality inspection of the photovoltaic cell and qualified frame.

title_en: Water flow cutting machine water tool bit direction adjusting mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water cutter head direction adjusting mechanism of a water flow cutting machine, which comprises parallel supporting legs, wherein the supporting legs are movably connected through a transverse plate, an object to be cut is clamped in a circular groove through a clamping structure, a rotating shaft is driven by a motor to enable a gear to rotate, the gear drives a flat gear to move up and down, further a sliding sheet and a connecting plate are lifted up and down, further a carving box structure on the connecting plate is lifted up and down, a cylinder stretches out and draws back a middle piece, the middle piece moves forwards and backwards through a limiting groove in an internal frame, further a carving head on the middle piece moves, the carving head moving forwards and backwards can more completely achieve the omnidirectional cutting effect on the object, waste scraps and waste water generated by carving can more conveniently flow into the circular groove while the carving head is carved, and the waste scraps and the waste water can enter a collecting box through filtering and guiding of a filter screen and a leakage hole, thereby collecting the generated wastewater and impurities.

title_en: Full-automatic bearing forging and pressing production line
abstract_en: The invention relates to a full-automatic bearing forging and pressing production line which comprises a first forging and pressing table, a second forging and pressing table and a third forging and pressing table, wherein a first material channel is arranged in front of the first forging and pressing table, a feeding and sequencing mechanism is arranged on the first material channel, a heating device is arranged at the tail end of the first material channel, the full-automatic bearing forging and pressing production line further comprises a first feeding manipulator and a first discharging manipulator, the first feeding manipulator clamps a workpiece onto the first forging and pressing table from the heating device, the first discharging manipulator transfers the forged and pressed workpiece passing through the first forging and pressing table onto the second material channel, and the second material channel is positioned between the first forging and pressing table and the second forging and pressing table; the invention has the beneficial effects that: 1. the bearing forging and pressing workpiece is subjected to three processes in a mechanical full-automatic mode, three times of forging and pressing of the workpiece are completed, and the full-automatic operation greatly reduces the manual operation amount. 2. And the three material channels are provided with positioning mechanisms and buffer mechanisms, so that complete position correction is realized in the transportation process, and the transportation and processing precision of workpieces is good.

title_en: Robot tail end constant force floating device and polishing system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a constant-force floating device at the tail end of a robot and a polishing system. The robot terminal constant force floating device includes: the first moving platform is movably matched with the fixed base and is in transmission connection with the first driving mechanism; the second moving platform is movably matched with the first moving platform and can move along a first direction together with the first moving platform, the third guide mechanism is respectively connected with the second moving platform and the second driving mechanism, and the third guide mechanism can enable the second moving platform and the second driving mechanism to generate relative motion along the first direction. The robot tail end constant force floating device provided by the invention reduces the difficulty of robot track planning and improves the polishing efficiency; the weight of the moving part is reduced, and the response speed is improved.

title_en: Automatic production line for ultra-wide aluminum foil boxes
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automatic production line for ultra-wide aluminum foil boxes, which comprises an aluminum foil conveyor, a punching machine and a packaging machine which are sequentially arranged from left to right; the punching machine comprises a workbench, a driving box is fixedly arranged right above the workbench, a lifting plate is arranged between the driving box and the workbench, a lifting system is arranged on the driving box and drives the lifting plate to lift, and a plurality of actuating mechanisms sequentially arranged from front to back are arranged on the lifting plate; this super wide aluminium foil box automation line, the function of impurity on the automatic clear aluminium foil has been realized, prevent that impurity from influencing the aluminium foil box quality, and, through promoting aluminium foil box and die cavity separation, can prevent that the aluminium foil box from taking place the adhesion, in addition, on using die cavity inner wall through the air, can also clear away the impurity in the die cavity, further avoid impurity to influence aluminium foil box quality, secondly, through using the thrust that produces on the aluminium foil box from clean hole exhaust air, can also be convenient for the aluminium foil box remove to packagine machine.

title_en: Double-polishing process and device for germanium wafer and germanium wafer
abstract_en: The application discloses a double polishing process and device of a germanium wafer and the germanium wafer, which are used for simultaneously polishing the two sides of the germanium wafer, wherein the double polishing process comprises the following steps: the first rough polishing process adopts a first rough polishing solution and a first polishing cloth; the second rough polishing procedure adopts a second rough polishing solution and a first polishing cloth; the first fine polishing procedure adopts a first fine polishing solution and a second polishing cloth; the second fine polishing procedure adopts a second fine polishing solution and a second polishing cloth; the relation of the rotational speeds in each process is as follows: the first rough polishing procedure is less than the second rough polishing procedure is less than the first fine polishing procedure is less than the second fine polishing procedure; the hardness of the first polishing cloth is greater than that of the second polishing cloth; the polishing temperature in each step is 35-40 ℃. The double polishing process of the germanium wafer provided by the embodiment of the application adopts a combination mode of two rough polishing and two fine polishing, realizes the matching between chemical polishing and mechanical polishing by matching different parameters, realizes the rapid polishing of the germanium wafer, and obtains better fine polishing surface quality.

title_en: All-in-one machine integrating feeding, CCD (charge coupled device) detection, assembly and discharging
abstract_en: An integrated machine integrating feeding, CCD (charge coupled device) detection, assembly and discharging comprises a double-station feeding unit, an automatic feeding assembly, a CCD detection unit, an assembly unit, a discharging assembly, a machine table and a machine case cover, wherein the double-station feeding unit is used for feeding workpieces; the automatic feeding assembly can transfer the workpiece on the double-station feeding unit to the CCD detection unit; the CCD detection unit is used for carrying out photographing detection on the workpiece; the assembling unit is used for assembling the workpiece and the product main body; the blanking assembly is used for blanking the assembled products on the assembling unit. The automatic feeding and discharging integrated machine integrates continuous feeding, carrying, assembling and automatic discharging of workpieces, is compact in overall structure by integrating photographing detection and assembling, greatly shortens the occupied area of a product assembling part on an overall production line, saves the installation space, can realize full-automatic production of the production line, can realize assembly of large-batch products, and is particularly suitable for occasions where two parts are assembled.

title_en: Cable bending device for power construction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cable bending device for electric power construction, which comprises a base, wherein four corners of the upper part of the base are supported by a workbench through upright posts, two support plates are arranged on the upper part of the workbench, a positioning wheel assembly and a bending assembly which is arranged correspondingly to the positioning wheel assembly and is used for fixing and bending a cable are arranged on the upper part of each support plate, the bending assembly comprises a sleeve, a guide plate is movably spliced in the radial direction of a sleeve body of the sleeve, one end of the guide plate is connected with a pressure head which is matched with the cable through a spring, the upper part of the sleeve is rotatably matched with a rotating rod, the rod body of the rotating rod is connected with an arc plate through a connecting plate, when the rotating rod rotates, the rotating rod drives the arc plate to rotate through the connecting plate, and the guide plate is in contact with the arc block and pushes the pressure head to move the cable, and at the moment, the push plate pushes the cable to bend. The invention has convenient operation, time saving and labor saving, can realize the cable fixing and bending operation simultaneously by rotation, is suitable for various use situations and has wide application range.

title_en: High thickness fabric perforating and sewing device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of high-thickness fabric sewing, and discloses a high-thickness fabric punching and sewing device which comprises a sliding table, wherein a screw is rotationally arranged in the sliding table, a clamping plate is arranged on the sliding table in a sliding way in a left-right sliding way, a nut seat is fixedly arranged on the lower side of the clamping plate, the nut seat is in threaded connection with the screw, the high-thickness fabric punching and sewing device further comprises at least one electric telescopic rod and at least one pipe storage box, a punching pipe is coaxially and fixedly arranged at a telescopic end of the electric telescopic rod, a hollow pipe is arranged in the pipe storage box, a second mounting plate and a first mounting plate are fixedly arranged on two sides of the sliding table respectively, the electric telescopic rod is fixedly arranged on the second mounting plate, and the pipe storage box is slidably arranged on the first mounting plate. According to the invention, the 2.5D three-dimensional fabric is replaced by a fiber cloth layering and stitching process, so that the characteristics of high fiber content and high interlayer connection of the composite material fiber reinforcement are met, the device is used for punching, the hole spacing is determined by the first reserved holes and the second reserved holes, and compared with manual punching, the device is convenient and efficient, and safer.

title_en: Electric appliance and method for operating an electric appliance
abstract_en: The invention relates to an electric appliance (10) having at least one hand grip (28) for the secure guidance of the electric appliance (10) by an operator and having a safety system (54), at least two grip areas (30) which are spaced apart from one another and each have at least one touch sensor module (52) being provided on the hand grip (28). According to the invention, each touch sensor module (52) has at least two sensor electrodes (64, 66) which are each electrically connected to a safety system (54), the safety system (54) being designed such that an operator must touch at least one first and at least one second sensor electrode (64, 66) of the touch sensor modules (52) using at least one body part, in particular using a part of at least one hand, for reliable operation of the electrical appliance (10). The invention also relates to a method for operating a power tool (10) by an operator, which in a first step (128) has to actuate an electromechanical key (94) before the power tool (10) is started in order to supply energy (130) to a safety system (54) and a touch sensor module (52) of the power tool (10).

title_en: Tail size control method and device in steel rail rolling process and steel rail
abstract_en: The application discloses a tail size control method and device in a steel rail rolling process and a steel rail, wherein the steel rail is rolled by a universal rolling mill, the universal rolling mill comprises a roughing mill, an edging mill and a finishing mill, and the steel rail to be rolled sequentially passes through the roughing mill, the edging mill and the finishing mill in the steel rail rolling process. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a first countdown time of rolling the tail of the rail to be rolled by the roughing mill when the rail is rolled, and reducing the rolling speed of the rail to be rolled by the roughing mill according to a set speed reduction ratio when the first countdown time is smaller than or equal to a set time threshold value so as to reduce the size fluctuation of the tail of the rail to be rolled by the roughing mill. The technical scheme of the application can control the tail size in the rail rolling process and relieve the problem of tail fluctuation in the rail production process.

title_en: Steel construction field welding device for bridge construction
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the field of bridge construction, and provides a steel structure on-site welding device for bridge building construction, which comprises a base, and a fixing plate and a vertical plate which are fixedly arranged on the base, wherein a clamping mechanism for fixing a steel pipe is arranged on the vertical plate; a hollow rod is fixed on the fixed plate, a working box is fixed on the hollow rod, an adjusting mechanism connected with the working box is arranged on the fixed plate, a plurality of groups of sliding grooves which are circumferentially arranged at equal intervals are formed in the working box, sliding blocks connected with the adjusting mechanism are slidably arranged in the sliding grooves, clamping plates are fixed on the sliding blocks, and the adjusting mechanism drives the clamping plates to move through the sliding blocks; the fixed plate with be provided with lateral shifting mechanism between the riser, be provided with on the base with the actuating mechanism that lateral shifting mechanism connects, be fixed with on the actuating mechanism and be used for welded welder, the actuating mechanism drive welder is circular motion.

title_en: Taper sleeve locking steel bar joint production process and production line thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a taper sleeve locking steel bar joint production process and a production line thereof, and solves the technical problems that in the prior art, a taper sleeve locking steel bar joint is complex in processing procedure, high in material consumption, high in cost, insufficient in mechanical strength and incapable of meeting the requirement of mass production. The invention provides a taper sleeve locking steel bar joint production process, which comprises the following steps: s1, uncoiling and leveling; s2, trimming; s3, milling an inclined plane; s4, cutting a material sheet; s5, milling threads; s6, a punch forming process; s7, laser trimming: and (3) removing the allowance of the product after the punch forming by using laser, and processing the product into a taper sleeve locking steel bar joint finished product. And simultaneously, a taper sleeve locking steel bar joint production line matched with the taper sleeve locking steel bar joint production line is also provided. The taper sleeve locking steel bar joint can be widely applied to the technical field of taper sleeve locking steel bar joint production.

title_en: Long-life cable ventilation and heat absorption pipe pressing forming device with ventilation and heat absorption pipe and using method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a long-life cable ventilation and heat absorption pipe pressing forming device with a ventilation and heat absorption pipe and a using method thereof; the invention comprises a conveying bin, a cable conveying mechanism arranged on the conveying bin and a grading extrusion forming mechanism arranged on the conveying bin; the cable conveying mechanism comprises a power bin arranged on the conveying bin and three extrusion bins arranged on the conveying bin in a circumferential array manner, and the extrusion bins can extrude the cable to the surface of the power bin so as to drive the cable to move; hierarchical extrusion mechanism includes that extrusion storehouse and symmetry set up in the inside extrusion wheel of extrusion storehouse, wholly need not the manpower to assist it and can transport the circuit, has reduced the consumption of manpower, has improved production efficiency to reduced and depend on at the cable surface and cause the influence to the cooling tube installation because of the dust, avoided because of pressure is suddenly too big, and cause certain influence to cooling tube or cable, increase whole off-the-shelf quality.

title_en: Header for boiler unit with temperature of 650 ℃ and above and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a header for a boiler unit with the temperature of 650 ℃ and above and a preparation method thereof, and the header comprises a header body and a tube connecting seat, wherein the header body and the tube connecting seat are welded and connected, the header body and the tube connecting seat are both made of precipitation-reinforced nickel-iron-based superalloy, the header body and the tube connecting seat are the same in material, and welding materials adopted by welding the header body and the tube connecting seat are solid-solution-reinforced superalloy. The header body and the connecting tube seat are the same in material, and welding materials adopted by welding the header body and the connecting tube seat are solid solution reinforced superalloy. The solid solution strengthening type superalloy has the characteristics of structural stability and good plasticity and toughness in a wider temperature range, and can be used as a welding material to simplify welding and post-welding heat treatment processes and reduce the cracking risk of a welding joint. Meanwhile, in order to obtain the more consistent tissue performance of the heat affected zone near the fusion line at the two sides of the welding line, the header body and the connecting pipe seat are made of the same alloy material, so that the post-welding heat treatment process of the alloy is greatly simplified.

title_en: A intelligent filter pressing device for water treatment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent filter pressing device for water treatment, which comprises a filter pressing box, wherein prefilter boxes are symmetrically arranged at the left side and the right side of the filter pressing box, a hydraulic cylinder is fixedly arranged at the top of an inner cavity of the filter pressing box, a filter pressing plate is fixed at the bottom of the hydraulic cylinder, movable grooves matched with the filter pressing plate are symmetrically formed in the left side wall and the right side wall of the inner cavity of the filter pressing box, a rotating shaft is rotatably connected at the center of the bottom of the filter pressing plate, stirring blades are symmetrically arranged at the left side and the right side of the rotating shaft, a bearing plate is horizontally arranged in the inner cavity of the filter pressing box, a communication port is formed between the filter pressing box and the prefilter boxes, a drain pipe is arranged at the bottom of the right side of the filter pressing box, and a slag discharge port is formed in the rear side wall of the filter pressing box.

title_en: High-sealing-capability plane processing texture and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a plane processing line with high sealing capability and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein a multi-tooth surface milling cutter is adopted for processing, the multi-tooth surface milling cutter comprises a milling cutter disc, a conventional milling cutter blade and an inner milling cutter line blade are respectively arranged on the milling cutter disc, the plane processing line comprises a first line part and a second line part, the first line part is a conventional processing line, the second line part is arranged at the inner side of the first line part, and the second line part and the first line part are arranged in a non-penetrating way, so that the sealing glue originally smeared in the sealing glue is extruded by two smooth planes after the two planes are bonded, the glue storage is less and uneven, and the problem of poor sealing performance of the plane structure is caused.

title_en: Assembly process of magnetic pole A side and production process of magnetron anode assembly
abstract_en: The invention provides an assembly process of a magnetic pole A side, which is used for assembling the magnetic pole A side of a magnetron anode assembly, the anode assembly further comprises an anode cylinder and an anode plate, a lower convex part, an antenna hole, a first center hole and a first mounting surface are arranged on the magnetic pole A side, and the assembly process of the magnetic pole A side comprises the following steps: s1: feeding on the side of the magnetic pole A; s2: automatically screening the magnetic pole A side so that the screened first mounting surface faces the second mounting surface of the anode cylinder; s3: automatically correcting the side A of the positioning magnetic pole, so that the antenna hole after correction positioning corresponds to the antenna slot on the anode plate; s4: and automatically grabbing and pressing the side A of the magnetic pole after the correction and positioning into the anode cylinder. Compared with the prior art, the assembly process of the magnetic pole A side can realize automatic screening, positioning and assembly of the magnetic pole A side, and greatly improves the production efficiency; on the other hand, the assembly precision of the magnetic pole A side is guaranteed, and the yield is improved.

title_en: Pipeline welding inner wall polishing and cleaning tool and method and pipeline welding seam repairing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pipeline welding inner wall polishing cleaning tool and method and a pipeline welding seam repairing method, belonging to the technical field of pipeline welding inner wall polishing, wherein the pipeline welding inner wall polishing cleaning tool comprises a polishing assembly, the polishing assembly comprises a rotating shaft and a polishing piece, the first end of the rotating shaft can be connected with a driving mechanism, and the polishing piece is driven to rotate by the driving mechanism so as to realize circumferential polishing operation of the polishing piece on the pipeline welding inner wall; the cleaning assembly comprises a fixing shaft and a cleaning piece, the first end of the fixing shaft is rotatably connected with the second end of the rotating shaft, and the radial dimension of the cleaning piece is larger than that of the pipeline, so that the axial cleaning operation of the pipeline is realized through the axial movement of the cleaning piece. According to the invention, the welding seam is polished through the rotating polishing piece, so that black spots on the pipeline can be effectively removed, and meanwhile, the inner cavity of the pipeline is plugged through the cleaning component, so that welding slag and dust can be effectively prevented from entering the deep part of the pipeline, and the interior of the pipeline is effectively ensured to be tidy by matching with the axial movement of the cleaning component.

title_en: Semi-automatic arc welding machine
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of welding processing, and particularly relates to a semi-automatic arc welding machine; the processing platform of the semi-automatic arc welding machine main body is provided with a welding machine moving frame and two clamping devices, the two clamping devices are respectively positioned on two sides of the welding machine moving frame, and the welding machine moving frame is connected to the processing platform in a sliding mode, so that the welding gun welding area on the welding machine moving frame is changed; the middle part of the processing platform is fixedly connected with a groove plate through a fastener, the groove plate is connected with a welding machine moving frame in a sliding mode, a lead screw is rotatably connected between two ends of the groove plate, the welding machine moving frame is connected with the lead screw through thread transmission, a welding gun is installed on the welding machine moving frame and drives the lead screw to rotate, the welding machine moving frame is driven to slide in the groove plate, and a welding gun welding area on the welding machine moving frame is changed; and (3) auxiliary bending processing of the two plates during welding preparation, so that the welding capacity of the welding machine for the workpiece is increased.

title_en: Platinum-gallium alloy for platinum jewelry or platinum spring and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a platinum-gallium alloy for platinum jewelry or a platinum spring and a preparation method thereof, wherein the mass ratio of metal gallium to metal platinum in the platinum-gallium alloy is (0.01-0.06): 1. The platinum-gallium alloy has high hardness, white color and bright surface; the platinum jewelry prepared from the platinum-gallium alloy is not easy to wear and stretch and deform; the platinum spring prepared from the platinum-gallium alloy has good elasticity and is durable; the preparation method is simple, high in efficiency, low in platinum loss and easy to industrialize.

title_en: Metal pipeline cutting machine tool based on refrigerating system
abstract_en: The invention provides a metal pipeline cutting machine tool based on a refrigerating system, which comprises a bed body, wherein the top of the bed body is connected with a moving mechanism in a sliding mode through a sliding rail, the top of the moving mechanism is fixedly connected with a cooling piece, one side of the bed body is electrically connected with a control mechanism through a wire, the left side of the top of the control mechanism is fixedly connected with a wire conveying mechanism, the right side of the top of the control mechanism is electrically connected with a cutting mechanism through a wire, and a water guide piece is fixedly installed inside the bed body. According to the metal pipeline cutting machine tool based on the refrigerating system, the cooling piece and the water guide piece are matched with each other, so that metal is kept at low temperature continuously in the cutting process, and the metal cutting efficiency is improved.

title_en: Automatic water cup aligning and bottom pressing production line and processing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a production line and a processing method thereof for automatically aligning and pressing a cup bottom, which can meet the automatic alignment assembly of a cup body and a cup bottom with alignment requirements and have high precision and high efficiency, and the production line comprises a cup body conveying mechanism, a steel bottom conveying mechanism, a clamping jaw assembly, a pressing mechanism, a spider manipulator, a cup body vision camera, a steel bottom vision camera and a transfer mechanism which are in circuit connection with an industrial personal computer; the clamping jaw assembly, the pressing mechanism and the transferring mechanism are arranged on the cup body conveying mechanism at intervals, the cup body vision camera acquires cup body image information clamped by the clamping jaws and transmits the cup body image information to the industrial personal computer, and the clamping jaws are controlled by the industrial personal computer to rotate, adjust and then put back; the steel bottom vision camera is positioned below the spider manipulator, acquires steel bottom image information clamped by the spider manipulator, transmits the steel bottom image information to the industrial personal computer, controls the spider manipulator to rotate and adjust by the industrial personal computer, then assembles the spider manipulator on the cup body, and completes bottom pressing under the action of the pressing mechanism; and finally, transferring the product to the next production line by a PPU manipulator of the transfer mechanism for continuous processing.

title_en: Stamping process and stamping machine for processing EVA foam sound absorbing sheet for new energy automobile
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of stamping, in particular to a stamping process and a stamping machine for processing an EVA foam sound absorbing sheet for a new energy automobile; it includes: the conveying equipment is used for conveying the EVA foam cotton material; the conveying apparatus includes: the two supports are arranged and arranged in parallel at intervals; the lower conveying mechanism is arranged between the two brackets and comprises two conveying belts which are arranged in parallel at intervals and rotate synchronously, and friction bulges are arranged on the outer surfaces of the conveying belts at intervals; the upper smoothing mechanism is arranged between the two brackets and comprises two smoothing belts which are arranged in parallel at intervals and rotate synchronously, and the rotating directions of the smoothing belts and the conveying belt are the same; the smoothing belt has a certain pressure effect on the EVA foam material, and the side of the smoothing belt, which is in contact with the EVA foam material, is just opposite to the conveying direction, so that the smoothing belt can smooth the EVA foam material.

title_en: Sludge strip extruding machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sludge strip extruding machine which comprises a strip extruding machine main body, wherein a feeding hole is formed in the upper end of the strip extruding machine main body, and a stirring mechanism is arranged in the strip extruding machine main body below the feeding hole and used for mixing and stirring sludge; the lower part of the stirring mechanism is communicated with the inlet end of the screw conveyor, the outlet end of the screw conveyor is provided with an extrusion plate, the outer part of the extrusion plate is provided with a movable plate matched with the extrusion plate, and the size of extruded sludge is changed through the outline formed by the extrusion plate and the holes formed in the movable plate. The device can adjust the size of extruding the mud strip according to the mud water content, makes follow-up efficiency at the stoving higher, also can carry out self-cleaning to whole device through wiper mechanism simultaneously, avoids the mud solidification in the inside of device.

title_en: Vegetable cutting module and kitchen cutting and matching machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vegetable cutting module which comprises a second cutter rest (3) and cutting assemblies, wherein the cutting assemblies comprise a second rotating shaft (40) rotatably connected to the second cutter rest (3), a cutter disc coaxially arranged on the second rotating shaft (40) and cutters arranged on the cutter disc, and the vegetable cutting module is characterized in that the number of the cutting assemblies is three, the cutting assemblies share the same second rotating shaft (40), the cutter discs of the second cutting assemblies, the first cutting assemblies and the third cutting assemblies are sequentially arranged at intervals along the axial direction of the second rotating shaft (40), in the first cutting assemblies, the cutter disc is cylindrical, a cavity (411) is formed in the cutter disc in a hollow mode, and the cutter disc is provided with a feeding side positioned on the outer side of the peripheral wall of the cutter disc and a discharging side positioned on the inner side of the peripheral wall of the cutter disc. The invention also discloses a kitchen cutting and matching machine with the vegetable cutting module. Compared with the prior art, the vegetable cutting module can simultaneously provide the functions of cutting blocks, slicing and shredding, and has a compact structure.

title_en: Sheet stamping equipment and sheet stamping method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a piece stamping device and a piece stamping method, wherein the piece stamping device comprises a stamping device, a transfer device and a blank pressing device; the stamping device is used for stamping a workpiece to form a sheet stamping part with the contour shape consistent with that of a target product, and the thickness of the sheet stamping part is smaller than or equal to a preset value; the transfer device is used for transferring the sheet stamping part discharged from the stamping device to the position of the edge pressing device; the edge pressing device comprises an upper die and a lower die which are arranged up and down, the opposite surfaces of the upper die and the lower die are parallel to each other, the sheet stamping part is positioned between the upper die and the lower die, and the upper die and the lower die are close to each other and are leveled to remove burrs on the edge of the sheet stamping part to obtain a target product.

title_en: Welding manufacturing process for silencing tile
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of silencing tiles, and particularly relates to a welding manufacturing process of a silencing tile, which comprises the following steps: marking welding points, welding an iron frame, welding a lead block and welding a tungsten steel block. The invention aims to provide a welding manufacturing process of a silencing tile, which has the advantages of stable structure, good silencing effect and simple manufacturing.

title_en: Bearing press-fitting device and method for bearing assembly
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bearing press-fitting device and method for bearing assembly, belonging to the field of bearing assembly and comprising a shell, wherein the middle position of the upper surface of the shell is rotatably connected with a turntable; the upper surface of the turntable is annularly embedded with bearing positioning mechanisms which are uniformly distributed; a bearing feeding station is arranged on the upper surface of the shell at a position close to the left side of the turntable; an automatic bearing placing mechanism is arranged on the upper surface of the shell at the position close to the rear side of the bearing feeding station; the rear side edge of the upper surface of the shell is fixedly connected with an installation frame; the upper surface of the mounting frame is fixedly connected with a hydraulic unit; the upper surface of the shell is provided with a check ring feeding mechanism at a position close to the rear side. According to the automatic bearing placing mechanism, the automatic bearing placing mechanism is matched with the turntable and the bearing positioning mechanism, so that the bearing can be automatically loaded, meanwhile, equipment does not need to be stopped, and the bearing is placed manually, so that the press-fitting efficiency is improved.

title_en: High-efficient grinding device of optic fibre capillary
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-efficiency polishing device for an optical fiber capillary, which comprises a base, wherein two sides of the top of the base are fixedly provided with a support frame; first removal subassembly and second remove the subassembly setting in the top both sides and the spout of base, first telescopic link and second telescopic link are at flexible in-process transmission support body, the support body at this moment receives the pulley of its bottom of certain thrust and can slide, first removal subassembly and second remove the subassembly and remove to the middle regional removal of polishing simultaneously at the removal in-process, make can send the optic fibre in the capillary of both sides to the region of polishing simultaneously, because two relative polishing face parallel of polishing dish, so also be parallel to each other after the polishing face of two capillaries is polished and is accomplished, even polish the dish and polish into the inclined plane with the polishing face of one of them capillary, the polishing face of another capillary also is the inclined plane, and the inclination on two inclined planes is the same, so two capillary m also can dock.

title_en: Preparation method of hot-rolled strip steel for guardrail plate
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of hot-rolled strip steel for a guardrail plate, which comprises the following steps: s1, feeding molten iron into a converter for smelting, and adjusting the components of the molten iron by adding materials after smelting; the final components of the molten steel comprise the following components in percentage by mass: c: 0.04-0.08%, mn: 0.6-0.8%, si: 0.15-0.25%, S is less than or equal to 0.030%, P: 0.010-0.025% of Al:0.015% -0.040%, the rest is Fe and unavoidable impurity; and S2, casting the molten steel into a steel billet through a continuous casting machine, heating and rolling the steel billet through a heating furnace, cooling and coiling the steel billet into a steel coil to obtain the hot-rolled strip steel for the guardrail plate. According to the invention, the quality of the hot rolled steel strip is ensured by controlling the final components of the molten steel, the galvanizing speed and the zinc layer thickness of the subsequent guardrail plate are ensured, and the qualification rate of the hot rolled steel strip in the hot dip galvanizing process is improved.

title_en: Seamless steel tube for non-quenched and tempered non-excavated drill rod and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a seamless steel tube for a non-quenched and tempered non-excavated drill rod, which comprises the following steps: smelting a tube blank: smelting according to the mass percentages of the components of the steel pipe to obtain a pipe blank; heating a tube blank: the heating temperature of the tube blank is 1180-1290 ℃; perforating: the perforation temperature is 1170-1280 ℃, and a capillary tube is obtained; and (3) cooling: cooling the capillary tube to 350-500 ℃; reheating: reheating the cooled capillary tube at 860-960 ℃; and (3) tension reduction: carrying out stretch reducing on the reheated capillary, wherein the stretch reducing start rolling temperature is more than or equal to 820 ℃, and the stretch reducing finish rolling temperature is 850-900 ℃; air cooling after rolling: the cooling speed of the steel pipe is controlled to be between 0.1 and 3 ℃ per second, the cooling speed of the steel pipe is controlled to be between 0.2 and 2 ℃ per second after the steel pipe is cooled to 600 to 500 ℃, and the tempering temperature of the hot rolled pipe is between 250 and 500 ℃. The method improves the mechanical property of the steel pipe, has better wear resistance, can ensure that the steel pipe is used on a non-quenched and tempered non-excavated drill rod, simplifies the process and reduces the production cost.

title_en: Laser rail break system and method for sleeper
abstract_en: The invention discloses a laser rib breaking system and method for a sleeper. According to the laser sleeper bar breaking system, an automatic robot motion technology is adopted, a high-power fiber laser QBH is selected, a specially designed laser cutting head is matched, a 3D vision positioning system is utilized, accurate cutting of sleeper reinforcing steel bars can be automatically achieved, non-contact cutting is achieved, and adverse effects on the bond stress between the sleeper end reinforcing steel bars and concrete cannot be caused due to the fact that a heat affected zone is small, so that the service life of sleeper products is guaranteed; the cutting speed is high, the cutting seam is narrow, the verticality of the cutting seam edge is good, and the cut edge is smooth; the noise is low, the energy consumption is low, the safety is high, and the like; the laser cutting head has small volume, good flexibility, automatic identification and positioning and stable laser output power; anticollision institution has the effect that resets of high accurate location, and the buffers are longer, and buffer range is big.

title_en: Multifunctional lock-detaching buckle assembly, lock-detaching method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional lock-detaching buckle assembly, a lock-detaching method and a device, wherein the multifunctional lock-detaching buckle assembly comprises a base plate, a plurality of sets of lock-detaching buckle assemblies, a rotary driving device and a lifting plate assembly, the lock-detaching buckle assembly comprises a hollow rotating shaft, a transmission part, a connecting sleeve and a lock-detaching head, the hollow rotating shaft can be rotatably assembled on the base plate in a penetrating manner, the hollow rotating shaft, the connecting sleeve and the lock-detaching head are assembled into a whole, a lock-detaching groove is formed in the lock-detaching head, the rotary driving device drives all the hollow rotating shafts to synchronously rotate, the lifting plate assembly comprises a lifting plate, an elastic part and a plurality of detection rods, the lifting plate can be assembled above the base plate in a lifting manner, the top ends of the plurality of detection rods are fixedly connected to the lifting plate, and the bottom ends of the plurality of detection rods sequentially penetrate through the corresponding hollow rotating shafts and the connecting sleeves and then extend into the lock-detaching groove. The multifunctional lock-detaching buckle assembly is simple in structure, reasonable and compact in layout and ingenious in design; and the manufacturing cost of the equipment is reduced, and the locking and unlocking efficiency of the buckle is improved.

title_en: Method for manufacturing aluminum nitride substrate, and method for removing strain layer introduced into aluminum nitride substrate by laser processing
abstract_en: The problem to be solved by the present invention is to provide a novel technique capable of removing a strained layer introduced into an aluminum nitride substrate. The present invention is a method for manufacturing an aluminum nitride substrate, including a strain layer removing step of removing a strain layer of the aluminum nitride substrate by heat-treating the aluminum nitride substrate in a nitrogen atmosphere. Thus, the present invention can remove the strain layer introduced into the aluminum nitride substrate.

title_en: High-hardness corrosion-resistant alloy steel for offshore wind power bolt bar and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses high-hardness corrosion-resistant alloy steel for offshore wind power bolt rods and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: putting the round steel bar into quenching equipment, quenching at 890 ℃, wherein the quenching time is 70min, putting the quenched round steel bar into a tempering device, tempering at 550-700 ℃, wherein the tempering time is 80min, and cooling the tempered round steel bar by water; and (3) performing pre-straightening on the round steel bar subjected to heat treatment by using a pre-straightening machine, peeling by using a centerless lathe, performing fine straightening by using a roll finishing fine straightening machine, and performing cutting treatment by using a cutting machine as required to obtain the alloy steel. According to the invention, graphene prepared from graphite powder is combined with polyetherimide generated by anhydride and diamine, so that the adhesive is strong, and the graphene can be firmly combined with the surface of alloy steel; the toughness is good, and the material is not easy to break; the corrosion resistance is strong, and the alloy steel can be effectively prevented from being corroded; and the coating has low toxicity and good practicability and application prospect.

title_en: Preparation method of bamboo-wood composite floor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a bamboo-wood composite floor, which is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 40-60 parts of polyvinyl chloride, 8-15 parts of diatom ooze, 10-15 parts of calcium carbonate, 1-5 parts of silicon dioxide, 1-4 parts of perlite, 0.1-1 part of oxidized polyethylene wax, 0.1-0.5 part of AC foaming agent, 0.2-1 part of acrylate copolymer, 10-15 parts of machine-made charcoal, 0.1-1 part of talcum powder, 80-100 parts of bamboo and 20-30 parts of plates, and the method comprises the following steps: s1: preparing raw materials: selecting bamboo and plates growing for 4-6 years, and sawing the bamboo and plates according to the required length; s2: splitting and rough milling: the method comprises the steps of breaking fresh bamboo into pieces, roughly milling the fresh bamboo pieces by using a milling tool to leave a proper amount of bamboo green, and simultaneously processing the board for later use. The bamboo-wood composite floor prepared by the method can reduce the using amount of the boards by utilizing the bamboo and the boards for composite production, and meanwhile, the bamboo can be used for processing the boards, so that the production cost of enterprises is reduced, and the product competitiveness is improved.

title_en: Fire hose detects uses fire hose end fixing device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of detection equipment, in particular to a fire hose end fixing device for detecting a fire hose, which comprises a support frame, a sealing water injection assembly and a plug-in fixing mechanism, wherein the support frame is provided with a water inlet and a water outlet; the supporting frame comprises a supporting base, a supporting ring is arranged above the supporting base, and a fixing pipe is arranged in the supporting ring; the sealing water injection assembly is arranged in the fixed pipe and comprises a water injection pipe capable of sliding left and right on the fixed pipe, a sealing sleeve is arranged on the outer wall of the left end of the water injection pipe, and a stop block close to the sealing sleeve is arranged on the outer wall of the water injection pipe; the bayonet fixed establishment sets up in the outside of sealed water injection subassembly, and bayonet fixed establishment includes two at least extension rods that set up in support ring one side, and the other end of extension rod is provided with the pivot, and the pivot outside is provided with the lantern ring, and lantern ring left side is provided with the kelly that can block fire hose, and the lantern ring right side is provided with the dysmorphism pole with dog matched with. The water hose connector can be quickly connected with a water source and fixed, and the detection efficiency is high.

title_en: Coaxial fixed connecting device for welding steel bars
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of building construction, and provides a coaxial fixed connection device for welding steel bars, which comprises an installation frame and also comprises: the adjusting assembly is arranged on the mounting frame, the mounting frame is connected with two coaxial fixing mechanisms through the adjusting assembly, and the coaxial fixing mechanisms comprise mounting sleeves, second hand wheels, synchronous driving assemblies, transmission assemblies and fixing force locking assemblies; the mounting sleeve is arranged on the adjusting assembly, a plurality of guide sliding sleeves are fixed in the mounting sleeve, guide sliding blocks are connected in the guide sliding sleeves in a sliding manner, fixing plates are fixed on the guide sliding blocks, and a first notch for avoiding a steel bar is formed in the mounting sleeve; the synchronous driving assembly is arranged on the mounting sleeve. The application easy operation of self only needs to place the reinforcing bar in first breach to rotate the second hand wheel and can accomplish the fixed of reinforcing bar, need not abundant operation experience also enables two reinforcing bars and keeps coaxial.

title_en: Rotary-cut rounding assembly, rotary-cut rounding mechanism and rounding device
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a rotary-cut rounding assembly, rotary-cut rounding mechanism, and rounding device for manufacturing spherical products. The rotary-cut rounding assembly comprises: a material extrusion element comprising a material inlet at a first surface, a material outlet at a second surface, and a material passageway between the material inlet and the material outlet, the material passageway comprising a first portion having a cylindrical shape and a second portion having a conical shape, and the second surface being configured as an inwardly concave surface; and a rotary cutting member including a rotary arm and two rotary cutters respectively mounted at both ends of the rotary arm, each rotary cutter being obliquely fixed to a corresponding one of both ends of the rotary arm, the second surface of the material extruding member facing the rotary cutter of the rotary cutting member when assembled into the rotary-cut rounding assembly. The rotary-cut rounding assembly can efficiently and stably manufacture spherical products with perfect roundness, and is particularly suitable for rounding high-viscosity materials.

title_en: Grinding and polishing roller translation mechanism for water drill grinding and polishing machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a grinding and polishing roller translation mechanism for a rhinestone grinding and polishing machine, which comprises a grinding and polishing roller translation mechanism body, wherein a mounting substrate is arranged on the grinding and polishing roller translation mechanism body, fixed slide rails are symmetrically arranged on the upper surface of the mounting clamping plate close to two sides, an upright post is arranged on the upper surface of a movable slide rail on each fixed slide rail close to one end, a regulating screw B and a movable base block are arranged inside a movable base block regulating groove inside the upright post, an annular bearing is arranged on the inner side of a matching and mounting groove inside the movable base block, a polishing roller is arranged between the matching and mounting grooves of the two movable base blocks, one end of the polishing roller is provided with a high-speed motor, a matching and connecting rod is arranged between the two movable slide rails close to one end of the movable slide rail, a regulating screw A is arranged inside a threaded groove connecting block below the matching and connecting rod, and one end of the regulating screw A is provided with a driving motor A.

title_en: Self-positioning trimming device for solid wood furniture plate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-positioning trimming device for a solid wood furniture plate, which comprises a chamfering device, wherein the chamfering device is mainly divided into a driver and a cutter head; further comprises: the disc, the periphery side of driver output shaft is located through bearing rotation cover to the disc, the bottom fixed round bar that has installed of driver output shaft, the periphery side of round bar is located to the fixed cover of tool bit. This improved generation chamfer ware carries out chamfer deburring of wood furniture panel when, and accessible disc, spacing ring and positioning bearing have the three sides of wood furniture panel to carry out the location between chamfer ware and the panel automatically, and the location effect is strong, and the tool bit is difficult to produce the inclination, and the device carries out the chamfer processing of panel through pivoted tool bit, can carry out stable removal along the panel cambered surface, and device small portable, the user demand of on-the-spot manufacturing wood furniture that satisfies that the device is small that can be fine, device easy operation.

title_en: Electric-drive self-adaptive centering servo clamping system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric-drive self-adaptive centering servo clamping system which comprises a chuck fixing frame, wherein a fluted disc is connected in the chuck fixing frame through a bearing; the chuck fixing frame is uniformly provided with at least three jaw sliding rails corresponding to the number of jaws in the circumferential direction, the jaws are connected in the jaw sliding rails in a sliding manner, the top of the fluted disc is provided with planar threads which are uniformly distributed in the circumferential direction and have Archimedes spiral shapes corresponding to the number of the jaws, the bottom of each jaw is provided with planar threads matched with the planar threads on the top of the fluted disc, and each jaw is in threaded connection with the fluted disc; the fluted disc is meshed with a pinion which is connected with the driving assembly; the clamping jaw is connected with a clamping chuck pressing block, and the inner side of the clamping chuck pressing block is provided with a clamping assembly.

title_en: Screw thermal elongation compensation method, numerical control system, drilling and tapping machine and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lead screw thermal elongation compensation method, a numerical control system, a drilling and tapping machine and a readable storage medium, which comprise the following steps: setting the tool length of a reference tool which does not participate in machining as the reference tool length, and acquiring an error threshold allowed by a part to be machined to execute a machining program; before any subprogram of the machining program of the part to be machined is executed, a current error value is calculated by measuring the current tool length of a reference tool, whether the current error value exceeds an error threshold value or not is judged, and if yes, machining is stopped. Compared with the traditional scheme, the method has the advantages of low cost and strong anti-interference capability, and the measured value is directly the thermal elongation of the lead screw instead of the approximate elongation through temperature conversion, so the method has more accurate value and stronger stability. The measuring method is simple to operate, has high stability, can be applied to any numerical control system, and can be widely applied to various machining center equipment.

title_en: Low-cost Q500GJ steel plate for high-rise building and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-cost Q500GJ steel plate for a high-rise building, which comprises the following chemical components: c:0.06% -0.09%, si: 0.20-0.35%, mn:1.30% -1.60%, P: less than or equal to 0.015 percent, S: less than or equal to 0.005 percent, cr: 0.35-0.55%, nb: 0.035-0.050%, V: 0.015-0.035%, ti:0.009 to 0.020%, al: 0.020-0.040%. The balance of Fe and inevitable impurity elements; also disclosed is a method for producing the steel sheet. The invention adopts the design of low C, low carbon, microalloying and low noble metal components, and the alloy cost is low; the production process of precise rolling and cooling control is adopted, the rolling process of strictly controlling the temperature and the compression ratio in the two-stage rolling process is assisted with a cooling control mode, and the process cost is low.

title_en: Multi-station rotary disc type full-automatic screw machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-station rotating disc type full-automatic screw machine, which belongs to the field of screw machines, wherein a regulating valve and a product clamp are matched with each other, negative pressure is generated in the regulating valve in the actual use process, one part of the negative pressure enters an inner ring chamber and an adsorption bin and adsorbs a workpiece, the other part of the negative pressure enters an outer ring chamber and a detection bin and is sucked in an air way through an unlocked screw hole, when a screw fed by a locking mechanism moves downwards, the screw hole can be aligned by utilizing the air suction operation, the locking precision of the screw hole is improved, after the screw hole on the workpiece is sequentially locked, the screw hole is closed due to the locking of the screw, the air suction action disappears, the adsorption force transmitted to a valve core is increased at the moment, the valve core is driven to overcome the elastic force of a tensioning spring to move downwards, the adsorption force disappears, and the unloading is convenient.

title_en: Plasma surfacing welding machine
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of plasma surfacing equipment and discloses a plasma surfacing machine, wherein the conventional plasma surfacing equipment is only provided with one nozzle, only one workpiece can be machined each time, the machining speed of parts is low, although the plurality of nozzles are arranged on the conventional machine tool moving frame to realize synchronous movement of the plurality of nozzles so as to achieve the effect of machining the plurality of workpieces, but the size of the moving frame and the number of the nozzles cannot be adjusted in the mode, so that the adjustment cannot be carried out according to actual conditions, and the resource utilization rate is reduced.

title_en: Automatic welding and pressing device and method for large-diameter opening welding line of end socket
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic welding and pressing device and method for a large-diameter opening welding seam of a seal head, wherein the device comprises the following components: the lifting pressing mechanism comprises a fixed beam, a lifting pressing mechanism and an independent rotating shaft; the fixed beam is arranged on the suspended welding system platform through a bolt; the fixed beam and a rotating film tire arranged on the suspended welding system platform are mutually independent, and the rotating film tire is used for fixing a workpiece to be welded; the lifting pressing mechanism is arranged on the fixed beam through an independent rotating shaft. The invention realizes the automatic TIG suspension welding of the large-diameter opening welding line of the pressure vessel end enclosure and the bottom of the carrier rocket tank.

title_en: Preparation method of super-amphiphobic surface with inclined stepped mushroom head micro-column structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a super-amphiphobic surface with an inclined stepped mushroom head micro-column structure, which comprises the following steps of: continuously drawing a two-dimensional circle on the surface of the polyethylene terephthalate adhesive tape/contracted polystyrene plate double-layer film by using femtosecond laser, separating the polyethylene terephthalate adhesive tape/polystyrene plate double-layer film in the two-dimensional circle from the matrix of an x-y plane under the cutting action of the laser to form a mushroom head micro-column, and scanning a semicircle at the bottom of the grown mushroom head micro-column structure by using the femtosecond laser due to different laser scanning times among different rows to form an inclined stepped mushroom head micro-column structure; finally, the sample is modified by fluorosilane and is sprayedSO  2  @ fluoroPOS suspension. The inclined stepped mushroom head microcolumn structure prepared by the invention shows excellent repulsion to low surface tension liquid, and can realize directional bounce of low surface energy mixed liquid drops.

title_en: Crushing device and crushing process for producing biological granular fuel
abstract_en: The utility model provides a reducing mechanism and crushing technology are used in production of bio-pellet fuel, includes dustcoat protection mechanism, dustcoat protection mechanism upper end is connected with the hopper, the hopper lower extreme just is located dustcoat protection mechanism internally mounted and has feedstock channel, feedstock channel is last just to be located dustcoat protection mechanism internally mounted and have drive adjustment mechanism, the feedstock channel lower extreme just is located dustcoat protection mechanism internally mounted and has two sets of bilateral symmetry's material collection mechanism, every group the quantity of material collection mechanism is two and is the mirror image setting, two sets of relative dustcoat protection mechanism central line bilateral symmetry, every group the material is collected the mechanism lower extreme and is provided with shredding mechanism. Dredge the inside timber waste of feedstock channel through mediation ration unit, avoid the inside condition that blocks up that appears of feedstock channel, dredge ration unit interval nature simultaneously and descend to control blanking volume avoids equipment machining power too big, influences life's the condition.

title_en: Frozen meat roll cutting device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a frozen meat roll cutting device and a frozen meat roll cutting method, which belong to the field of meat product processing, and the frozen meat roll cutting device comprises a frame plate, wherein a frame is fixedly connected to the position, close to one end, of the upper surface of the frame plate, two groups of fixing frames are fixedly connected to the position, close to the lower end, of the side surface of the frame, the side surface of one group of fixing frames is fixedly connected with a second motor, the output end of the second motor penetrates through the fixing frames in a sliding mode and is fixedly connected with an accidental rotating column, one end of the rotating column is rotatably connected with the other group of fixing frames, and the outer circular surface of the rotating column is fixedly connected with uniformly distributed cutting knives.

title_en: Boring device and method for marine engine connecting rod
abstract_en: The invention discloses a boring device and a boring method for a marine engine connecting rod, and the boring device comprises a machine tool, a fixture body for clamping a workpiece, and a first main shaft and a second main shaft which are arranged on a machine tool body of the machine tool in parallel, wherein the first main shaft corresponds to the position of a large end hole of the marine engine connecting rod, and the second main shaft corresponds to the position of a small end hole of the marine engine connecting rod; at least two first boring cutters are fixed on the first spindle at intervals along the axial direction, and the heights of the plurality of first boring cutters protruding out of the surface of the first spindle are gradually increased from the end part to the machine tool; at least two second boring cutters are fixed on the second spindle at intervals along the axial direction, and the heights of the plurality of second boring cutters protruding out of the surface of the second spindle are gradually increased from the end part to the machine tool; the spacing distance between the adjacent first boring cutters and the spacing distance between the adjacent second boring cutters are not less than the thickness of the workpiece, namely the marine engine connecting rod. The boring efficiency of the bearing holes at the large end and the small end of the connecting rod of the marine engine can be effectively improved, and the production cost is reduced.

title_en: Machine tool changing device and machine tool
abstract_en: The application provides a machine tool changing device which is used for changing a cutter on a cutter holder, wherein the cutter holder comprises a mounting hole for mounting the cutter; the locking unit comprises a locking piece and a reset elastic piece, and the locking piece is arranged in the mounting groove in a sliding manner; the reset elastic piece is arranged on the locking piece and elastically props against the locking piece and the mounting groove; the driving unit is connected with the locking piece; the driving unit drives the locking piece to slide along the mounting groove and compress the reset elastic piece, and the locking piece slides into the mounting hole and locks the cutter. The utility model provides a lathe toolchanger fixes and changes the cutter through locking unit and drive unit, has avoided adopting the mode of artificial twisting bolt to change the cutter, has stopped the emergence of the not good condition of bolt-up effect, has saved manpower and materials when more having the security.

title_en: Sand blasting cleaning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sand blasting cleaning method which comprises the steps of providing a base material and sand grains, carrying out chemical modification on the sand grains to form charged sand grains, carrying out sand blasting on the base material by using the charged sand grains, and applying an electric field on the base material containing the charged sand grains after sand blasting to enable the charged sand grains to fall off after being repelled. The method is simple to operate, convenient for cleaning and recycling sand grains and less in influence on the base material. Compared with the laser polishing, the method can uniformly treat the substrate to be cleaned, and avoids damage to the substrate caused by local high-temperature treatment.

title_en: Production process of ultrathin flexible glass and glass thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a production process of ultrathin flexible glass, which sequentially comprises the steps of groove cutting on the surface of the glass, chemical thinning, glass cutting, edge polishing, chemical toughening, acid pickling and cleaning according to the process flow; when the surface is grooved, grooves with the width of 0.02-1mm are cut on two sides of the same surface of the glass, and the depth of the grooves is 30-60% of that of the glass; when the glass is cut, the waste edges and the groove parts are cut off. The preparation and strengthening processing technology of the ultrathin flexible glass can effectively optimize the problem of low strength caused by the application of the plane ultrathin glass to the cover plate, has reasonable process route, extremely high yield in the production process of the ultrathin glass, higher impact resistance and mass production of finished glass, and can effectively solve the problems of crease marks of the plastic cover plate and insufficient strength of UTG.

title_en: Oil and slag removing device based on super-hydrophobic oleophylic sponge material
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of oil-water separation, and discloses a deoiling and deslagging device based on a super-hydrophobic oleophylic sponge material, which comprises a shell, a conveying belt, a power transmission device and a cleaning structure, wherein the conveying belt is arranged in the shell in a transmission manner, the power transmission device is arranged on the shell and is used for driving the conveying belt to transmit, and the cleaning structure is used for extruding the conveying belt; the conveyer belt will the casing inner chamber is separated for oil-water mixture district and clear water district, the conveyer belt by the oil-water mixture district to clear water district slope sets up just the conveyer belt butt in the inner wall of casing, the conveyer belt moves out from the oil-water mixture district and passes through enter into behind the clean structure clear water district. The oil-water separator has the advantages of good oil-water separation effect, wide applicability, low operation cost and no secondary pollution.

title_en: Fixing device for drilling of large-modulus spiral bevel gear
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fixing device for drilling a large-modulus spiral bevel gear, which relates to the field of clamping devices of workpieces and comprises a supporting table arranged on a machine tool workbench and a cover plate arranged at the upper end of the supporting table, wherein a rotating mechanism is arranged on the cover plate; and a collecting box and a collecting groove for collecting scraps and waste liquid are integrated, so that pollution to a machine tool workbench is reduced in the drilling process.

title_en: Method and product for producing 65Mn cold-rolled steel strip by eighteen-roller single-frame rolling mill
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a product for producing a 65Mn cold-rolled steel strip by using an eighteen-roller single-frame rolling mill, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S10 providing a 65Mn hot-rolled pickled plate, and S20 cold-rolling the 65Mn hot-rolled pickled plate by using the eighteen-roller single-frame rolling mill to obtain the 65Mn cold-rolled steel strip.
