The 65Mn hot-rolled pickled plate is rolled for 5 times by using an eighteen-roller single-frame rolling mill, and the rolling rate, the inlet unit tension, the outlet unit tension and the rolling force of each pass are controlled, so that the 65Mn cold-rolled steel strips with different specifications can be stably produced, and the thickness precision of the 65Mn cold-rolled steel strips can be remarkably improved.

title_en: Production method of titanium alloy cold-rolled strip for folding screen
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cold rolling production method of a metal strip, in particular to a production method of a titanium alloy cold-rolled strip for a folding screen. The method is characterized in that titanium alloy TA4 with the thickness of 0.5mm is selected as a raw material, and the titanium alloy strip meeting the use requirement of the folding screen can be produced through cold rolling for at least 12 times, cleaning and annealing leveling treatment. In the production method, no intermediate pass annealing process is adopted, the annealing after rolling and the withdrawal straightening are combined into a whole, the process steps are simple, the risk is low, and the manufacturing cost can be reduced. And titanium alloy TA4 is adopted as a raw material, and the produced titanium alloy strip is stable in magnetic conductivity to 1.000 (at H=50), high in tensile strength, good in anti-radiation effect, better in stability and free from transition risk through special process steps.

title_en: Method for machining eccentric excircle of double-eccentric gear
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of double-eccentric gear machining, in particular to a method for machining an eccentric excircle of a double-eccentric gear, which uses a boring and milling machine to machine an eccentric excircle datum to replace a lathe to align the eccentric excircle datum, and specifically comprises the following steps: the highest point of the eccentric excircle is found out through a boring and milling machine, the connecting line of the highest point and the circle center is parallel to the machine tool coordinate, and then the actual center of the eccentric excircle is determined through the machine tool coordinate. The transfer of the alignment datum on one side to the other side is realized through the boring and milling machine, so that the highest point of the eccentric excircle does not need to be aligned again during the reverse side processing, and the adjustment is realized only through a simple mode of marking a meter in the horizontal direction. The processing method of the invention can simplify the working procedures, reduce the processing error, shorten the processing time and greatly improve the processing efficiency.

title_en: Polishing equipment for metal ring production
abstract_en: The invention discloses polishing equipment for producing metal ring pieces, which comprises a bottom plate and an annular seat rotatably connected to the top of the bottom plate, wherein the top of the annular seat is fixedly connected with a workbench, the top of the workbench is fixedly connected with a circular sand paper board, and the top of the bottom plate is provided with a surface polishing mechanism. This throwing optical equipment is used in metal ring production can carry out polishing treatment to the inner wall and the surface of metal ring through inner wall polishing mechanism and surface polishing mechanism's setting, and the jacking setting of cooperation electric putter can be applicable to the metal ring of not co-altitude and diameter size in a certain extent, has enlarged this throwing optical equipment's application scope, and when polishing, the upper and lower plane of metal ring can be polished to the circular sand cardboard on the sanding plate on the clamping plate and the workstation, has realized the omnidirectional polishing work of metal ring, has not had the burr dead angle, has improved polishing quality.

title_en: Automatic abrasive paper replacing device of polishing robot
abstract_en: The utility model provides an automatic change abrasive paper device of polishing robot, includes box, first backup pad, electromagnetism valves, first air-vent valve, second backup pad, door, third backup pad, briquetting, glues abrasive paper part, tears abrasive paper part, grinding tool, vacuum chuck, support, waste material fill, hinge, second air-vent valve. Through reasonable structural design of the abrasive paper tearing component, the abrasive paper sticking component, the abrasive paper detection component and the like, the automatic abrasive paper replacing device of the robot can be used for filling abrasive paper with different sizes, different forms and different granularities, the universality is strong, and the pressing type abrasive paper tearing mode of the abrasive paper tearing plate can be used for stably and reliably tearing sand; this automatic change device of abrasive paper has effectively improved the automatic reliability, stability and the practicality of trading abrasive paper of robot to the deployment efficiency of robot automation application is accelerated to standard modular form, the indirect stability of having guaranteed the process of polishing and the automatic stable operation of polishing of robot.

title_en: Lithium battery pole piece flaking system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lithium battery pole piece flaking system. As shown in the figure, the system comprises pole piece lug laser forming, pole piece slitting and pole piece V angle punching. The device comprises an installation vertical plate, a discharging module, a laser cutting module, a pole piece slitting module, a first quality inspection module, a V-angle punching module, a second quality inspection module and a winding module. In this equipment, the material area is exported from the blowing module, and the slitting module divides the strip to the material area, and the laser cutting module carries out utmost point ear shaping cutting to the material area, and the die-cut cutting of V angle die-cut module carries out die-cut cutting to the material area, and through three cutting procedures, twice quality control, the material area rolling is in the rolling module. The pole coil is divided into strips by the dividing cutter, the pole piece and the pole lug are cut by the pulse laser, then the V angle is cut by the cutter die, and the double winding and the double unwinding are realized, so that the full-automatic work is realized. Compared with the traditional mechanism, the invention is more stable and efficient, and realizes integrated automatic production.

title_en: Metal material processing auxiliary production equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of metal material processing equipment, in particular to auxiliary metal material processing production equipment which comprises a containing pipe with a through front end, wherein the front end of the containing pipe is provided with a clamping assembly for clamping and fixing a metal pipe fitting, a strip-shaped air bag is arranged in the containing pipe, the rear end of the containing pipe is provided with an air control assembly, the rear end of the strip-shaped air bag is connected with the air control assembly, the front end of the strip-shaped air bag freely penetrates through the front end of the containing pipe, the air control assembly supplies air to the strip-shaped air bag, so that the strip-shaped air bag expands to penetrate into the metal pipe fitting to support the inner cavity of the metal pipe fitting.

title_en: Equipment is tailor to steel band
abstract_en: The invention provides steel strip cutting equipment which comprises a frame, a feeding structure, a cutting structure, a conveying structure, a discharging structure and a stacking structure, wherein the feeding position, the cutting position, the conveying position, the discharging position and the storing position are sequentially arranged on the frame along the conveying direction of a steel strip, the feeding structure is positioned at the feeding position and is used for conveying the steel strip to the cutting position, the cutting structure is positioned at the cutting position and is used for cutting the steel strip into steel blocks, the conveying structure is positioned at the conveying position and is used for conveying the steel blocks to the discharging position, the discharging structure is positioned at the discharging position and is used for transferring the steel blocks to the storing position, and the stacking structure is positioned at the storing position and is used for collecting the steel blocks. The invention has the advantages of automation degree, replacement of manual labor force and improvement of working efficiency.

title_en: Server CPU module and assembly method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a server CPU module and an assembly method, relating to the field of server modules, comprising a carrying disc, a supporting disc and a supporting disc, wherein the carrying disc is used for placing a CPU, a CPU fixing frame and a radiator; the loading disc feeding and separating mechanism is used for disassembling, feeding and recycling empty discs; the CPU material taking module and the clamp are used for taking out materials and clamping the CPU into the placement jig; assembling the three-axis module and the clamp by the CPU fixing frame, and clamping the fixing frame into the turntable jig; the radiator taking and mounting robot and the clamp grasp the radiator and move to the upper part of the turntable radiator jig; the heat-conducting silicone grease protection cover picking and recycling mechanism of the heat radiator is used for picking and recycling the heat-conducting silicone grease protection cover of the heat radiator; the CPU module is provided with a turntable to drive the jig to rotate; the automatic problem of CPU module assembly in the server assembly process is solved, the assembly quality and efficiency are effectively improved, and the labor input is reduced; the compatible design of the clamp and the carrying disc can be adapted to most Intel M5/M6 platform products, and the flexibility and the utilization rate of the device are effectively improved.

title_en: Orderly-distributed diamond particle distributing device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a diamond particle distributing device for orderly distributing, which can drive a first driving cylinder to push a diamond particle distributing mechanism to move towards a material tray, wherein a needle head contacts with diamond particles or is immersed in the diamond particles, and negative pressure gas is communicated to enable the needle head to absorb the diamond particles, then the diamond particle distributing mechanism absorbed with the diamond particles is moved to the upper part of a diamond substrate layer, the negative pressure gas is cut off, and the diamond particles are orderly paved on the diamond substrate layer.

title_en: Special encapsulation equipment of detector
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of detector production equipment, and provides special packaging equipment for a detector, which comprises a mounting table, a cooling plate and the like; the mounting table is connected with the cooling plate. The special packaging equipment for the detector, which is described herein, is characterized in that a lifting carrier mechanism uses a conventional mechanical lifting mode to support each group of detector packaging modules to complete laser welding packaging processing in a working cabin, when the detector packaging modules have an overhigh temperature phenomenon, the thermosensitive emergency risk avoiding mode of the lifting carrier mechanism is triggered to complete cooling processing of the detector packaging modules in time, and meanwhile, the temperature of a cooling plate is guided by the heat sprayed by a hot gas conveying mechanism to descend in a stepped manner, so that the detector packaging modules are prevented from being greatly cooled. The technical problems that the chip of the detector packaging module is damaged due to the fact that the surface temperature is not controllable, and cracks are prone to occurring due to uneven cooling of the detector packaging module are solved.

title_en: Machining method of gear shifting control valve
abstract_en: The invention discloses a machining method of a gear shifting control valve, which mainly comprises the following steps: blanking → heat treatment → lathing → boring → drilling → boring → milling and clamping → heat treatment → straightening → clamping → lathing → grinding → clamping → heat treatment → clamping, → grinding → clamping → warehousing. The invention enables a common machine tool to be effectively connected with a numerical control machine tool, fully exerts the advantages of various machine tools, and inserts reasonable heat treatment and auxiliary procedures, so that the processing flow is more reasonable, and the operation method is simple and convenient. The gear shifting control valve processed by the processing method of the invention has the advantages that the qualified rate of workpieces is 100 percent, the processing time is shortened by 23 percent compared with the original method, and the processing cost is reduced by 12 percent. The wear resistance and the precision of the gear shift control valve are improved, so that the stability and the service life of the gear shift controller assembly are improved.

title_en: Metal plate grinding device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a metal plate grinding device, which belongs to the technical field of metal plate grinding and comprises a machine base and a machine table, wherein the machine table is fixedly arranged at the top of the machine base, the top of the machine table is fixedly provided with a mounting plate, a groove is arranged on the mounting plate, a limit column is fixedly arranged on the inner side wall of the groove, a sliding block is movably arranged on the limit column, a first spring is fixedly arranged on one side of the sliding block, a clamping plate is fixedly arranged at the top of the sliding block, a metal bent plate is arranged on one side of the clamping plate, a micro cylinder is fixedly arranged at the top of the mounting plate, an impurity removing mechanism is arranged at the top of the mounting plate, a mounting groove is arranged at the top of the machine table, a conversion motor is fixedly arranged on the inner side wall of the mounting groove, a rotating rod is fixedly arranged on an output shaft of the conversion motor, impurities on the metal bent plate can be removed through the impurity removing mechanism, and the bent metal bent plate can be subjected to flattening treatment through the cooperation of a flattening cylinder and a flattening plate after the impurities are removed.

title_en: Automatic production line for tower internals
abstract_en: The present utility model relates to an automatic production line for tower internals, comprising, arranged from upstream to downstream: a cutting unit (1), a deburring unit (2), a punching unit (8), a leveling unit (3), a profiling unit (4), a bending unit (5) and having more than one production mode which can be switched instantaneously by the factory informatization system, wherein in a first production mode the cutting unit (1), the deburring unit (2), the leveling unit (3), the profiling unit (4), the bending unit (5) are put into operation, whereas the punching unit (8) is not put into operation; in the second production mode, the cutting unit (1), the deburring unit (2), the punching unit (8), the leveling unit (3), the profiling unit (4) and the bending unit (5) are all put into use.

title_en: Welding device for repairing mold
abstract_en: The invention discloses a welding device for repairing a die, which belongs to the technical field of electric welding machines and has the technical key points that: the mold repairing device comprises an angle rotating assembly, a clamping assembly, a contact assembly, a rotating assembly and a positioning assembly, wherein when the mold is repaired, the mold is placed on the angle rotating assembly, and the clamping assembly is rotated, so that the clamping assembly can drive the contact assembly to clamp and fix the mold. And after the positioning component is separated from the rotating component, the rotating component is rotated, and can drive the angle rotating component to rotate, so that the angle rotating component can drive the die to conduct angle adjustment through the clamping component. When the rotation angle range of the angle rotating assembly is required to be adjusted, the adjusting assembly is loosened, so that the position of the rotating assembly can be adjusted, the rotation angle range of the angle rotating assembly can be adjusted, and the angle needing to be adjusted during repairing of moulds in different batches can be adapted.

title_en: Drilling machine, precision compensation method and device thereof and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a drilling machine, and a precision compensation method, a device and a storage medium thereof, wherein the precision compensation method comprises the following steps: acquiring hole position detection data of a processed plate drilled by a drilling machine; acquiring the expansion coefficient of the processing plate according to the hole site detection data; and compensating the grating ruler of the drilling machine according to the expansion coefficient. Therefore, the complexity of compensating the grating ruler can be effectively reduced, and the cost is low.

title_en: Gear shaft tooth alignment mark marking machine and marking method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gear shaft tooth alignment mark marking machine and a marking method, wherein the gear shaft tooth alignment mark marking machine comprises a base component, a marking machine driving component is arranged on the base component, a part conveying component is arranged on one side of the marking machine driving component, an image acquisition component is arranged above the base component, the marking machine driving component comprises a first linear guide rail, a support bracket is connected to the first linear guide rail in a sliding mode, a second linear guide rail is arranged on the support bracket, a laser marking machine is arranged on the second linear guide rail, the part conveying component comprises a lifting tray unit, the lifting tray unit is connected with a driving unit, the lifting tray unit is arranged below the laser marking machine, the device can be used for directly marking a gear shaft system after tooth alignment is assembled at the same time, the problem that during tooth alignment before tooth alignment is performed, due to unconscious errors of workers, the fact that the gear alignment after tooth alignment is performed is higher in accuracy, marks are more wear-resistant through marks made by the laser marking machine, and during maintenance after sales, the phenomenon of the gear alignment errors cannot occur.

title_en: Interlayer film for laminated glass, method for producing embossing roller, and method for producing interlayer film for laminated glass
abstract_en: The present invention aims to provide an intermediate film for laminated glass, which has a groove-like recess on both surfaces, can exhibit excellent degassing properties when producing laminated glass, and can suppress the generation of a moire pattern when being wound out from a roll, a laminated glass using the intermediate film for laminated glass, a method for producing an embossing roller suitable for producing the intermediate film for laminated glass, and a method for producing the intermediate film for laminated glass. The present invention provides an interlayer film for laminated glass, which has a plurality of concave parts on both sides, wherein the concave parts have a groove shape with continuous bottoms, the concave parts with continuous bottoms are arranged in a regular way, the glossiness of the surface with the plurality of concave parts measured according to JIS Z8741-1997 exceeds 3%, or the haze value of the interlayer film for laminated glass measured according to JIS K7105-1981 is below 87%.

title_en: Hobbing cutter for machining externally-inclined back taper teeth and design method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a hob for processing an external bevel back taper gear and a design method thereof, relating to the field of external bevel back taper gear processing, wherein the actual helix angle beta  1L  of a left tooth surface and the actual helix angle beta  1R  of a right tooth surface of the external bevel back taper gear to be processed are determined by using the helix angle and an indexing cone angle of the external bevel back taper gear to be processed; the method comprises the steps of determining a left tooth surface actual normal modulus m  n1L  and a right tooth surface actual normal modulus m  n1R  according to beta  1L  and beta  1R  and helix angles and normal modulus thereof, determining a left tooth surface actual normal pressure angle alpha  n1L  and a right tooth surface actual normal pressure angle alpha  n1R  according to beta  1L  and beta  1R  and helix angles and normal pressure angles thereof, determining a left tooth surface pressure angle alpha  n0L  and a right tooth surface pressure angle alpha  n0R  of the hob according to normal modulus m  n1L 、α n1L  and m  n1R  and alpha  n1R  respectively, and determining the rest parameters of the hob. According to the design, the hob with the external bevel back taper teeth obtained by processing has high precision.

title_en: Biplate welding set
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-piece welding device which comprises a limiting rod, wherein connecting plates are symmetrically and fixedly arranged at the upper end and the lower end of the limiting rod, the limiting rod is symmetrically arranged at the left side and the right side of the connecting plates, sliding blocks are symmetrically and movably arranged at the upper side and the lower side of the outer surface of the limiting rod, the sliding blocks are movably connected with a control plate through connecting shafts, and a heating plate is arranged at the output end of the control plate. The control panel position is adjusted so that the control panel controls the heating plate to heat two sides of the panel to meet the welding requirement, the limiting rod and the connecting plate are arranged to limit the sliding block, meanwhile, the control panel is enabled to have better flexibility by matching with the connecting shaft, the angle of the control panel can be changed to heat the tubular material, a worker can pull the connecting block to lift by rotating the adjusting bolt, the telescopic rod pulls the movable block inside the limiting block to achieve the purpose of controlling the angle of the control panel, and the practicability of the device is improved.

title_en: High-energy-absorption high-manganese steel solid welding wire and welding process thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a high energy absorption high manganese steel solid welding wire, which comprises the following chemical components in percentage by weight: c: 0.6-0.8%, mn: 20.0-24.0%, si: 0.4-0.6%, W: 3-5%, ce: 0.02-0.04%, P is less than or equal to 0.002%, S is less than or equal to 0.001%, and the balance is Fe and unavoidable impurities. According to the invention, the strength of the obtained weld metal is improved by adding the carbon element with higher content into the welding wire, and meanwhile, the influence of welding performance reduction caused by high carbon content is reduced by adding a small amount of cerium element, so that the mechanical strength of a welded joint is improved; cerium element also acts together with other elements in the welding wire alloy system to obviously improve the toughness of the obtained weld metal. The welding wire alloy disclosed by the invention is simple in system and low in price, and the weld metal forms a full austenitic structure, so that excellent room-temperature toughness and mechanical strength are ensured.

title_en: Automobile meshing sleeve polishing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automobile meshing sleeve polishing device, which relates to the technical field of tooth sleeve processing and comprises a clamping part, a processing unit and a collecting unit, wherein the processing unit comprises a support frame III, a support frame IV is slidably arranged on the support frame III, a polishing unit is arranged on the support frame IV, the collecting unit comprises a mounting barrel, the mounting barrel is connected with the support frame III, a collecting box is slidably arranged on the mounting barrel, the collecting box collects waste scraps which are polished, a door is rotatably arranged on the mounting barrel, a meshing sleeve collecting assembly is arranged in the mounting barrel, and inner teeth and end face teeth of the meshing sleeve are polished through the processing unit, so that the working efficiency is improved; the clamping part can clamp a plurality of meshing sleeves with different sizes and polish the outer surfaces of the meshing sleeves; the waste scraps generated in the grinding process of the meshing sleeve are collected through the collecting unit, the meshing sleeve after finishing grinding can be collected, and the space utilization rate is increased.

title_en: Worn lead screw repairing device and method for applying same
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of screw rod repair. Specifically, it relates to a worn screw repairing device and a method of applying the device, the worn screw repairing device includes: the workbench is provided with a clamping seat, a scanning device, a first grinding head, a laser cladding head, a second grinding head and an operating system. The scanning device can carry out full-range detection to wearing and tearing lead screw raceway, confirm wearing and tearing interval, the setting of first grinding head, laser cladding head, second grinding head can carry out accurate restoration to wearing and tearing interval, and whole device realizes detecting, restoration overall process, need not frequently change different equipment and carries out lead screw restoration, and first grinding head can carry out preliminary grinding to lead screw wearing and tearing region before the step is clad to laser, eliminates wearing and tearing region and peels off the position easily, increases cladding area, improves bonding strength. The device is suitable for screws of different types, has good repairing effect, reduces labor cost, reduces uncertainty caused by experience, and improves repairing quality of the screws.

title_en: Preparation method of aluminum-copper composite welding material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of an aluminum-copper composite welding material, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of sequentially spraying a first alloy layer and a second alloy layer on the surface of an aluminum alloy substrate by adopting a plasma spraying method, wherein the spray coating of the first alloy layer comprises the following components in percentage by mass: 50% -60% of pure aluminum powder, 20% -30% of pure copper powder and 10% -20% of copper oxide powder, wherein the spray coating of the second alloy layer comprises the following components in percentage by mass: 60% -80% of pure copper powder, 10% -20% of copper-tin alloy powder and 5% -20% of copper-zinc alloy powder, wherein the mass ratio of the first alloy layer to the aluminum alloy base material is 2-3: 1, the mass ratio of the second alloy layer to the aluminum alloy base material is 2-3: 1. the welding material prepared by the invention can be used for welding dissimilar metals of copper and aluminum to obtain a welding joint with higher tensile strength.

title_en: Method for obtaining high-performance copper alloy wire through continuous drawing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for obtaining a high-performance copper alloy wire through continuous drawing, which takes copper as a raw material and performs smelting with Be and other alloy components to obtain a metal melt; then forming by using a hot continuous casting process to obtain a beryllium copper alloy rod blank with a fixed length; performing two groups of continuous stretching operations on the beryllium copper alloy rod blank by using a stretching die, obtaining a reinforced interface between the two groups of continuous stretching operations by using a mode of spraying a reinforced composite material, forming a copper alloy shell layer added with Mg and Co on the outer side of the reinforced interface, and repairing the shell layer to the diameter of the rod before the secondary stretching rod material is not stretched to obtain a copper alloy wire master batch; and then continuously stretching the copper alloy wire master batch by using a stretching die again, drawing the copper alloy wire master batch into a copper alloy wire, annealing the copper alloy wire, and cleaning the surface to obtain a finished product. The high-performance copper alloy wire prepared by the method has higher strength and toughness, higher tensile strength, higher conductivity and excellent processability.

title_en: High repetition frequency laser space-time coupling processing device and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a high repetition frequency laser space-time coupling processing device and a method, wherein femtosecond laser pulses are transmitted to a double-pass pulse stretcher through a beam splitter, the double-pass pulse stretcher stretches the high repetition frequency femtosecond laser pulses, the high repetition frequency femtosecond laser pulses return to the beam splitter through a primary path of the double-pass pulse stretcher and are reflected by the beam splitter to generate laser pulses with group velocity dispersion, the stretched laser pulses pass through a grating compressor, the double-pass pulse stretcher is compensated to introduce group velocity dispersion and realize the spatial dispersion of different frequency components, the spatial chirp is introduced, the spatially dispersed light is focused through an objective lens, so that the time and the spatial recombination of the different frequency components of the laser pulses at a focus position is realized, and the pulse width outside the focus is rapidly stretched.

title_en: Electromagnetic pump assembly riveting machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electromagnetic pump assembling riveting machine which comprises a conveying belt, wherein a lower magnetizer feeding station, a coil feeding station, an upper magnetizer feeding station and an upper magnetizer and lower magnetizer riveting station are sequentially arranged in the conveying direction of the conveying belt, the lower magnetizer feeding station comprises a positioning mechanism, the positioning mechanism guides the lower magnetizer to be conveyed to the conveying belt, the coil feeding station comprises a clamping mechanism, the clamping mechanism clamps a coil to the lower magnetizer, the upper magnetizer feeding station comprises a clamping rotating mechanism, the clamping rotating mechanism clamps the upper magnetizer to the coil, and the upper magnetizer riveting station and the lower magnetizer riveting station comprise a left riveting device and a right riveting device, and are used for respectively riveting opposite joints on two sides of the upper magnetizer and two sides of the lower magnetizer. The invention realizes automatic assembly of the electromagnetic pump, improves the production efficiency of products and ensures the quality of the products.

title_en: Mixed abrasive water jet nozzle and synchronous antirust compound device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mixed abrasive water jet spray head and synchronous rust-proof composite device, which comprises a water jet spray head, an annular rust-proof liquid pipe and a control system, wherein the annular rust-proof liquid pipe is arranged on the water jet spray head, at least one rust-proof liquid input port is arranged on the annular rust-proof liquid pipe, and when the mixed abrasive water jet spray head and the synchronous rust-proof composite device work, the annular rust-proof liquid pipe can move along with the water jet spray head in multiple directions, wherein a wireless acceleration sensor for sensing acceleration in the corresponding direction is arranged on the annular rust-proof liquid pipe and corresponds to each moving direction, the wireless acceleration sensor is connected with the control system, at least one nozzle is arranged on the annular rust-proof liquid pipe and corresponds to each moving direction, a sliding switch mechanism for opening and closing the nozzle in the corresponding direction is arranged on the annular rust-proof liquid pipe and corresponds to the position of the nozzle in each direction, and the sliding switch mechanism is connected with the control system. After the water jet rust removal is finished, the spraying of the rust-proof liquid is synchronously finished.

title_en: Tilt sensor assembly line
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of product assembly and spare and accessory part assembly, and particularly relates to an inclination sensor assembly production line, which comprises a first module, a second module and a third module, wherein the first module comprises a first manipulator, a power-on detection device, a breakpoint welding device and a first assembly device, wherein the power-on detection device, the breakpoint welding device and the first assembly device are arranged beside the first manipulator; the device comprises a first manipulator, a second module, a third module and a third module, wherein the first module comprises a first manipulator, a first assembling device and an ultrasonic welding device, the first assembling device and the ultrasonic welding device are arranged beside the manipulator, and the third module comprises a third manipulator, an airtight testing device and a functional testing device, and the airtight testing device and the functional testing device are arranged beside the third manipulator. Through each device on first module, second module and the third module mutually supporting, realize tilt sensor's full-automatic equipment and quality detection, degree of automation is high, reduces the cost of labor, avoids the error that the manual assembly brought simultaneously, improves holistic yields, and production efficiency is higher.

title_en: Filter seat bottom surface polishing assembly and polishing method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a polishing assembly and a polishing method for the bottom surface of a filter seat body. According to the invention, on the basis of mounting and fixing the filter base, by controlling the small-angle rotation of the filter base and the alternate implementation of polishing of a single linear area on the bottom surface of the filter base, the full-area automatic polishing of the bottom surface of the filter base can be realized, so that the labor force consumption is greatly reduced, the operation is convenient, and the polishing efficiency is relatively improved.

title_en: Machine tool for processing face gear
abstract_en: The invention discloses a machine tool for processing an end face gear, which belongs to the technical field of gear forging and pressing, and particularly relates to a machine tool for processing an end face gear, comprising a machine tool body, wherein the machine tool body can drive a limiting device, can place a driving device, is connected to a driving end of the machine tool body in a sliding manner, can limit a pressed gear blank, is arranged at the left end of the machine tool body, can drive an outer wall notch forging device and a forging device, is connected to the outer wall of the driving end of the driving device, can forge and press the side edge of the gear blank, can forge and repair the inner wall and the outer wall of the pressed gear blank, can control the inner diameter of the inner wall of the gear blank, does not need to change a forging die, and can increase forging efficiency and production efficiency.

title_en: Welding equipment with magnesium aluminum tray clamp
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of welding manufacture of magnesium aluminum trays, and particularly relates to welding equipment with a magnesium aluminum tray clamp, which comprises a welding table, a magnesium aluminum tray clamp, a displacement adjusting mechanism, a welding mechanism and a guide bracket; the welding rotary table of the welding table is arranged above the welding base and can horizontally rotate so as to drive the magnesium-aluminum tray clamp on the welding rotary table to rotate; the welding head rotating table of the displacement adjusting mechanism is arranged above the welding rotating table; the middle part of the guide bracket of the welding head guide device is hollowed out and is used for extending in a welding head of the welding mechanism; the compression wheel is connected to the guide bracket in a rolling way and downwards presses the transverse ribs or the longitudinal ribs; the two ends of the guide bracket are tapered, and the sliding stop block is pushed open when the welding joint welds the overlapped part of the transverse ribs and the longitudinal ribs. The scheme can rapidly position the magnesium aluminum ribs; and by utilizing the linear movement of the welding head, automatic welding is realized, the welding labor intensity of the magnesium aluminum tray is reduced, and the labor cost is saved.

title_en: Multi-station self-discharging punch press
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of expansion joint nodes, in particular to a multi-station self-discharging punch press, which comprises a press machine body, wherein the press machine body is in a C-shaped arrangement, a workbench is arranged at the C-shaped bottom end of the press machine body, a punching assembly is arranged at one side of the top end of the workbench, a punching driving assembly is arranged at the top end of the press machine body, a discharging device is arranged at one side of the punching driving assembly, and a cleaning device is arranged at one side of the workbench.

title_en: Combined layered square hole drill bit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a combined layered square hole drill bit which is used for processing square holes and comprises a cutter assembly and a round hole drill bit, wherein the cutter assembly comprises a plurality of layers of cutters movably sleeved on the periphery of the round hole drill bit layer by layer, so that each layer of cutters can axially slide along the round hole drill bit respectively, the round hole drill bit can rotate around a shaft relative to the cutter assembly, the periphery of the round hole drill bit is gradually expanded layer by layer, and the cutter assembly is in a square section corresponding to the outline of the square hole at the outermost layer of cutters. The invention can realize one-step forming of square holes.

title_en: Superconducting tape joint welding method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for welding a superconducting tape joint, which relates to the technical field of superconducting tapes and comprises the steps of obtaining application requirements and selecting a joint type according to the application requirements; acquiring the type of the superconducting tape and the type of the solder, and determining a distribution ratio according to the type of the superconducting tape and the type of the solder; acquiring a relation curve of a welding influence factor and joint resistance during cold joint, and determining a welding length interval value based on the relation curve of the welding influence factor, application requirements and the joint resistance during cold joint; determining a three-layer structure resistance value based on the welding length interval value, and determining a welding interface resistance value based on the three-layer structure resistance value and the distribution ratio; determining a target welding parameter according to a relation curve of the joint resistance; and correcting the target welding parameters based on the interface resistance value of the welding position, and controlling the welding process of the joint according to the type of the joint and the corrected target welding parameters. The accuracy of the joint welding process is improved, and the welding effect is improved, so that the effective utilization of the superconducting strip is improved.

title_en: Flexible tool positioning device for automobile front wall plate cross beam
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of automobile fitting positioning, in particular to a flexible tool positioning device for a cross beam of an automobile front wall plate, which is used for solving the problems that an existing positioning mechanism is in rigid contact with the inner part and the outer part of the cross beam and is large in contact surface, and the cross beam is easy to damage, and the cross beams of different types cannot be matched; compared with the prior art, the invention can flexibly position the cross beams with different types, and can effectively avoid the phenomenon of damage caused by contact with the inside and the outside of the cross beam in the positioning process.

title_en: Nondestructive anti-damage cold-rolled oriented silicon steel strip leveling equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses nondestructive anti-damage cold-rolled oriented silicon steel strip leveling equipment, which belongs to the technical field of metal cold rolling, and comprises a supporting machine tool, wherein a feed inlet is arranged on the supporting machine tool, the feed inlet is in sliding connection with the supporting machine tool, a feed roller and a feed auxiliary roller are arranged on the feed inlet, a leveling box is arranged on the supporting machine tool, the leveling box is communicated with the feed inlet, a leveling roller group is arranged in the leveling box, two ends of the leveling roller group are respectively provided with an adjusting hydraulic rod, a monitoring component is arranged in the leveling box, the monitoring component is connected with the adjusting hydraulic rods through a wire, a cooling pipe is arranged on the leveling box, a cooling pump is arranged on the cooling pipe, the cooling pump is communicated with the cooling pipe, a discharge hole is arranged on the supporting machine tool, the discharge hole is connected with one side of the leveling box far away from the feed inlet, a catching groove is arranged in the discharge hole, a catch wheel is arranged in the catching groove, and a impurity removing cylinder is arranged on the discharge hole and is in rotary connection with the discharge hole.

title_en: Machine tool with cleaning function for machining oilfield steel pipes
abstract_en: The invention discloses a machine tool with a cleaning function for machining oilfield steel pipes, and relates to the technical field of steel pipe machining. The utility model provides a lathe is used in oil field steel pipe processing with clearance function, including the operation panel, the operation panel is provided with control terminal, the operation panel rigid coupling has equidistant arc that distributes, the steel pipe has been placed to equidistant arc, the operation panel has the collection case through landing leg rigid coupling, the collection case rigid coupling has the electric putter who is connected with control terminal electricity, electric putter's flexible end rigid coupling has the motor cabinet, the motor cabinet rigid coupling has the servo motor who is connected with control terminal electricity, servo motor rotates through the L shaped plate and is connected with first drilling rod, servo motor's output shaft passes through power component and first drilling rod transmission, sliding connection has the second drilling rod that the diameter is less than first drilling rod in the first drilling rod. In the process of drilling the steel pipes, the second drill rod with the small diameter is used for drilling the holes with the small diameter, so that the metal bonds between the steel pipes are damaged.

title_en: Surface treatment device and method for gear milling blade
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of milling cutter surface treatment, and particularly discloses a surface treatment device and a surface treatment method for a gear milling cutter blade, wherein the surface treatment device comprises a base, support mechanisms are fixedly arranged at four corners of the bottom of the base, a rack is fixedly arranged at the top of the base, and a polishing mechanism is fixedly arranged at the left side of the top of the rack; compared with the prior art, this technical scheme cooperatees through polishing mechanism and fixture, can carry out comprehensive polishing to milling cutter's surface, whole polishing process all can use equipment to polish, whole polishing efficiency is comparatively high-efficient, manpower consumption has been saved, and fixture can be adjusted as required, be convenient for carry out the centre gripping to not milling cutter of equidimension, and then be convenient for carry out the processing to not milling cutter of equidimension and polish, whole polishing adaptability is stronger, holistic machining's comprehensive efficiency is higher, make this equipment, holistic polishing machining efficiency is comparatively high-efficient, application prospect is comparatively extensive, be worth using widely.

title_en: Table and welding system with table and welding device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a table (80) of a welding system, and to a welding system. In addition to the table, the soldering system comprises an electrical soldering device (10), in particular a soldering iron, which soldering device (10) has a shank (12) and a soldering tip assembly (14), a heating element (18) being arranged on the shank (12), the soldering tip assembly (14) being releasably fixable to the shank (12) and having a holding element (26). The welding head assembly (14) is fixed to the handle (12) by a bayonet-type fastening such that the handle (12) can be brought from a fixed position to a removal position by rotating the handle (12) relative to the holding element (26) and can be removed from the removal position in a proximal direction of the welding head assembly (14). The invention is characterized in that the table (80) has at least one exchangeable holder (82, 84, 86, 88) which is formed about an insertion axis (94) and is designed to be at least partially complementary to the holding element (26) such that a welding head assembly (14) arranged on the shank (12) can be introduced into the exchangeable holder (82, 84, 86, 88) along the insertion axis, and the exchangeable holder (82, 84, 86, 88) has an anti-rotation element (100) which interacts with the holding element (26) such that the holding element (26) is rotationally fixed in the exchangeable holder (82, 84, 86, 88) when the welding head assembly (14) is inserted into the exchangeable holder, in the case of rotation of the shank (12) from the fixed position into the removed position.

title_en: Technological method for controlling core wave shape of thin-specification strip steel coil
abstract_en: The invention provides a process method for controlling the core wave shape of a thin-specification strip steel coil, which comprises the following steps of preparing an acid-washed flat coil by main procedures of uncoiling, welding, descaling, acid washing, flattening, withdrawal straightening, oiling, coiling and the like based on raw material strip steel subjected to endless rolling, and simultaneously adopting corresponding adjustment for the procedures, wherein the convexity of the raw material is pre-controlled, the elongation and the rolling force are controlled in the procedures of descaling, flattening and withdrawal straightening, the material used by a coiling machine reel is adjusted in the coiling process, and the coiling tension is adjusted in the coiling process. The process method for controlling the core wave shape of the thin-specification strip steel coil realizes the improvement of the hot-rolled thin-specification soft steel coil core wave shape after pickling, improves the quality of a product object, and improves the market competitiveness of the product.

title_en: Self-aligning roller bearing fit material arranging device and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a self-aligning roller bearing fit material arranging device and a self-aligning roller bearing fit material arranging method, which relate to the field of tapered roller assembly equipment and comprise a material arranging device, material arranging rollers and a material arranging groove, wherein the material arranging rollers comprise two rollers which are arranged in parallel at intervals, a material arranging channel parallel to the axes of the rollers is formed in the material arranging groove, a guide groove is formed on one side of each of the two rollers, which faces the material arranging channel, and the guide groove is communicated with an opening below the material arranging channel; the material tidying device comprises a plurality of material tidying fan blades arranged on the rotating shaft, the material tidying fan blades comprise a rigid plate and an elastic plate which are in butt joint, the shape of the rigid plate is the same as the section shape of the material tidying channel, and the elastic plate can be inserted into the guide groove to stir the tail end of the tapered roller to enable the tapered roller to adjust the gesture or pass through the tapered roller through deformation; the rollers conforming to the postures penetrate through the material arranging fan blades to enter the downstream, the rollers not conforming to the postures are stirred, then the postures are adjusted and kept away from the position of the stirring fan blades, the blocking problem in the roller conveying process is reduced, and the requirements of material arranging and outputting according to the required postures are met.

title_en: Lathe for fireproof door production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a lathe for producing fireproof doors, which relates to the technical field of fireproof door production equipment and solves the technical problem of inconvenience in drying.

title_en: Office chair five-star foot quality detection equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of office chair quality detection, in particular to office chair five-star foot quality detection equipment. The existing detection equipment only carries out pressure bearing detection or appearance detection on five-star feet, but does not detect the wood of a solid wood board and the stability of the wood board installation. The technical proposal is as follows: the office chair five-star foot quality detection equipment comprises a collecting box, a collecting barrel, a sampling drill bit, a first power component, a backfilling system and the like; the collecting box is connected with a first power assembly; the right side of the first power component is connected with a collection cylinder; the collecting cylinder is connected with a sampling drill bit; the left side of the first power assembly is connected with a backfill system and the like; the collecting cylinder is used for collecting wood chips obtained from the solid wood board; the backfill system is used for backfilling the sampling holes drilled on the solid wood board. According to the invention, the wood chips are lifted by blowing to the collecting cylinder, so that the dryness and the humidity of the wood chips are imaged, the device can rapidly detect and judge the wood condition of the solid wood board, and the detection efficiency is greatly improved.

title_en: Press mounting process for connecting disc-belt universal joint and universal joint fork assembly for transmission shaft
abstract_en: The invention provides a press-fitting process of a connecting disc with a universal joint and a universal joint fork assembly for a transmission shaft, which belongs to the field of automobile part processing and comprises twenty-six steps of automatic feeding connecting discs, automatic clamping connecting discs, automatic feeding universal joints, automatic feeding shaft bowls, corresponding shaft bowls for press-fitting, automatic feeding clamping springs, corresponding clamping springs for press-fitting, automatic feeding shaft bowls, corresponding clamping springs for press-fitting, automatic back pressure, automatic feeding universal joint forks, automatic clamping universal joint forks, automatic feeding shaft bowls, corresponding shaft bowls for press-fitting, automatic feeding clamping springs, corresponding clamping springs for press-fitting, automatic back pressure, automatic detection of clamp spring states, automatic detection of swing torque of universal joints and automatic unloading.

title_en: Environment-friendly aluminum profile cutting machine and aluminum profile processing assembly line
abstract_en: The invention discloses an environment-friendly aluminum profile cutting machine and an aluminum profile processing assembly line, which comprise a cutting platform and an aluminum profile body, wherein the top side of the cutting platform is provided with a cutting conveying notch, the aluminum profile body is placed in the cutting conveying notch, a lifting component is arranged on the cutting platform, the bottom side of the lifting component is connected with a bottom mounting plate, a moving component is arranged on the bottom mounting plate, the environment-friendly aluminum profile cutting machine starts a telescopic cylinder on the lifting component to operate during cutting, the bottom mounting plate moves downwards, a plate pressing component can be pressed on the top side of the aluminum profile body, the aluminum profile body can be stably die-cast through two sides, a rotating motor on the moving component is started to operate after the pressing, a moving screw rod sleeve sleeved on a rotating screw rod is driven to move, the cutting motor operates in the moving process, the cutting cutter disc is driven to rotate while moving, and the aluminum profile body which is fixed in a pressing mode can be cut.

title_en: Resin bond superhard abrasive grinding wheel and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a resin bond superhard abrasive grinding wheel and a preparation method thereof, wherein the resin bond superhard abrasive grinding wheel comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 75-120 parts of abrasive, 46-63 parts of resin binder and 30-45 parts of auxiliary materials. According to the invention, si-C bonds and Si-O bonds with higher bond energy are introduced into a macromolecular structure of the phenolic resin, and epoxy groups are simultaneously introduced into a molecular chain of the phenolic resin, so that the heat resistance and mechanical property of the grinding wheel can be greatly improved. The invention also carries out iron coating treatment on the surface of the grinding material, and combines the prepared resin bonding agent, so that the mechanical strength and heat resistance of the prepared grinding wheel are improved.

title_en: Diesel engineering dumper cab overturning welding tool
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a diesel engineering dumper cab overturning welding tool which comprises a bottom plate, wherein an overturning mechanism is arranged in the middle of the top end of the bottom plate, supporting rods are fixedly arranged at four corners of the top end of the bottom plate, the top ends of the four supporting rods are fixedly connected with the four corners of the bottom end of a top plate respectively, a moving mechanism is arranged in the middle of the top end of the top plate, and a clamping mechanism is arranged at the bottom end of the moving mechanism. According to the utility model, the turnover mechanism is matched with the clamping mechanism arranged at the bottom of the moving mechanism, the electric hydraulic cylinder hinged with the support frame in the turnover mechanism drives the turnover angle plate to drive the cab to turn over ninety degrees, the moving mechanism is matched with the clamping mechanism, the cab can be clamped and lifted after the turnover of the cab is finished, at the moment, the turnover mechanism is restored, the cab falls on the turnover mechanism again to turn over the turnover mechanism again, the cab can be turned over for multiple times, welding of multiple surfaces of the cab is ensured, the welding is more convenient, and the welding efficiency is improved.

title_en: Method for fastening tension clamp drainage plate bolt, overhauling robot and medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a method for fastening a strain clamp drainage plate bolt, an overhaul robot and a medium, wherein the method for fastening the strain clamp drainage plate bolt comprises the following steps: generating a depth image by acquiring depth data within a field of view based on the detection device; judging whether a drainage plate exists in the visual field range based on the depth image; if the displacement device is arranged, the displacement device is controlled to stop moving, and the angle of the detection device and the fastening device is controlled to be adjusted, so that the sight line of the detection device is perpendicular to the drainage plate; based on a depth image generated by the depth data in the visual field range acquired by the detection device after the angle adjustment, identifying the position of the bolt on the drainage plate; the fastening device is controlled to move so as to be vertically aligned with the center of the position, and the fastening device is controlled to perform fastening work on the bolt. Solves the problems of low working efficiency and untimely fastening of the strain clamp drainage plate bolts in the related art.

title_en: Circular seam welding equipment for electric hot water bottle production
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the field of household appliance production equipment, and provides girth welding equipment for electric hot water bottle production, which comprises an equipment base and an equipment stand, and further comprises: the device comprises a bearing plate, wherein two bearing plates are fixed on one side of a device stand, a swivel is rotatably arranged on the bearing plate, and a driving assembly for driving the two swivel to synchronously rotate is also fixed on the device stand; the clamping rods are circumferentially distributed on the swivel rings in a sliding manner, clamping assemblies are adjustably mounted on the clamping rods between the two swivel rings, a control assembly connected with the clamping assemblies is further mounted on the equipment stand, and the control assembly is used for simultaneously controlling the clamping assemblies to be close to or far away from each other; the supporting and adjusting assembly is also arranged on the equipment base and connected with the clamping rod. The clamping device has good clamping consistency and high efficiency on production materials, and can meet the requirements of clamping and fixing the production materials with different appearance shapes and welding adjustment.

title_en: Film laying seeder and film breaking belt device and method thereof
abstract_en: A film laying seeder and a film breaking device and a film breaking method thereof are provided at the rear end of the film laying seeder, the device comprises a frame, a parallel grabbing mechanism installed on the frame and used for grabbing mulching films and/or drip tapes and fixing the mulching films and/or drip tapes in the air, a telescopic shearing mechanism symmetrically installed on two sides of the frame corresponding to the parallel grabbing mechanism and used for shearing the mulching films and/or drip tapes, a central line of the telescopic shearing mechanism and a symmetrical central line of the parallel grabbing mechanism are located in the same plane, a surrounding embedding mechanism installed on the frame and in front of the parallel grabbing mechanism and used for embedding the mulching films and/or drip tapes before and after shearing and moderately compacting to ensure stable laying, and a measurement and control system installed on the frame and used for detecting and controlling working parameters of the mechanisms in real time so as to realize efficient film breaking and automatic film filling and tape working. The invention also discloses a film strip breaking method.

title_en: Drilling equipment for processing leakage-free gas-liquid mixed pump body
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of pump body machining, in particular to drilling equipment for machining a leakless gas-liquid mixed pump body. The pre-tightening group is arranged in the application, firstly, the base of the placed pump body is pre-tightened and fixed in the left-right direction under the cooperation between the inclined plate and the U-shaped plate, so that the subsequent clamping operation is facilitated, then, the clamping plate and the limiting plate are moved to the appointed position by driving the group I to work, meanwhile, the two clamping plates are mutually matched to limit the pump body in the front-back direction, meanwhile, the limiting plate has downward acting force on the base of the pump body to limit the pump body in the up-down direction, then, the corresponding two limiting plates are mutually matched to clamp the reinforcing plate on the base of the pump body through the cooperation of the bidirectional threaded shaft and the connecting strip, the fixing firmness of the pump body is further improved, the stability of the pump body in the drilling operation is ensured, and the problem that the drilling operation is influenced due to shaking of the pump body is avoided.

title_en: Tool for repairing mold and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a mold repair tool and a use method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of molds. Solves the problem that the iron plate at the repair position can not be supported comprehensively and reliably during repair in the prior art. The repair area of the die is provided with a tool body, the tool body comprises a positioning plate and supporting pieces, a power supply plug is arranged on the rear side of the positioning plate, electrorheological fluid electrically connected with the power supply plug is arranged in the positioning plate, the outer end face of the positioning plate is in contact with an iron plate at the repair area, the supporting pieces are symmetrically arranged on the two sides of the inner end face of the positioning plate, and the other end of the supporting pieces is connected with the inner wall of the die. It is mainly used for repairing mould.

title_en: Novel biodegradable material preparation processing equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation and processing device for a novel biodegradable material, and relates to the technical field of biodegradable material processing. This new biodegradable material preparation processing equipment, including smashing the case, smashing the outside of case and including power component, feeding subassembly, furnace return subassembly, including sliding plate, slip cap, spring, splint, bolt one in the feeding subassembly, the inner wall of sliding plate is connected with the one end of spring, the other end of spring is installed on the inner wall of slip cap, the inner wall of slip cap is installed on the outer wall of sliding plate, one side outer wall of splint is installed on the outer wall of slip cap, the inner wall of splint and the outer wall connection of bolt one, the outer wall of bolt one is installed on the inner wall of slip cap, only needs a power component can guarantee the operation of a plurality of processes, saves equipment cost more, simultaneously can effectually improve resource utilization, according to the different grade type of product of preparation, cuts out the billet of different thickness, establishes through perpendicular with feeding subassembly, saves equipment area more makes the factory building of same area can put more equipment and improves output simultaneously.

title_en: Conveying device for gear forging
abstract_en: The invention discloses a conveying device for gear forging, which belongs to the technical field of gear machining and comprises a workbench, wherein a third cavity is formed in the workbench, a conveying assembly is arranged in the third cavity, a fixing assembly is arranged on one side of the conveying assembly, a mounting box is arranged above the conveying assembly, the top of the mounting box is fixedly connected with a material box, the top of the material box is rotatably connected with a door plate, and a discharging assembly is arranged on one side of the interior of the mounting box. According to the invention, the sliding seat and the forging head are driven to move up and down by the air cylinder, so that the quick transmission of gear raw materials and the automatic feeding of the forging machine are realized, the transmission and feeding time cost of the device is reduced, the forging efficiency of the gear is improved, the energy consumption in the transmission and feeding processes is reduced, and the economic loss of enterprises is assisted and saved.

title_en: Cutting device for processing metal doors and windows
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of metal door and window processing, and discloses a cutting device for metal door and window processing, which comprises a workbench, wherein a cutting mechanism and a cleaning mechanism are arranged on the workbench, the cutting mechanism comprises a cutting piece and a placing plate, a first moving block is movably connected to the top of the workbench, and a first electric telescopic rod is fixedly arranged at the top of the first moving block. This a cutting device for metal door and window processing, after metal frame one side cutting, start the third electric telescopic handle and retract right, make the metal frame keep away from the section, then start first motor and make and place the board rotation, carry out rotary adjustment to the metal frame position of placing on the board, make the metal frame need cut out the edge and aim at the section, the third electric telescopic handle of rethread extends to the left, make the metal frame move left to the cutting of section department, need not manually put the position of metal door frame again, thereby the regulation cutting of the different sides of metal door frame of being convenient for.

title_en: Welding fixture for heater, double-sided laser welding mechanism and four-station welding equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a welding fixture for a heater, a double-sided laser welding mechanism and four-station welding equipment, wherein the welding fixture comprises a fixture body, a first driving mechanism and a second driving mechanism, the first driving mechanism drives side pressing pieces on two sides to be matched and pressed to prevent the heater from moving left and right, the second driving mechanism drives a top pressing piece to be matched with a positioning piece to prevent the heater from moving up and down, so that the heater is clamped in a vertical posture, positioning is accurate, the four-station welding equipment and the method are used for feeding manually at a feeding station, cleaning the heater by an air knife at a cleaning station, and simultaneously welding two sides of the welding fixture from welding corresponding holes on two sides of the heater by the double-sided laser welding mechanism at a welding station, and automatically blanking at a blanking station.

title_en: Auxiliary polishing device for electronic communication parts
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electronic communication part production, in particular to an auxiliary polishing device for electronic communication parts. The invention provides an auxiliary polishing device for electronic communication parts, which can automatically salvage. The utility model provides an auxiliary polishing device of electronic communication part, includes base, protecting crust, magnetic force machine, rotates bucket, discharge opening and support frame etc. the protecting crust rigid coupling is in the middle part upside of base, and the magnetic force machine is installed in the protecting crust, rotates the bucket and rotates to connect in the protecting crust, rotates the bucket lower part both sides and has seted up the discharge opening, and the support frame rigid coupling is on the base. According to the invention, the screw rod is driven to rotate by the starting motor, the screw rod rotates to drive the filter vat to move upwards, so that the discharge hole of the filter vat is aligned with the discharge frame, the grinding magnetic needle and the part are lifted by the upward movement of the filter vat, and liquid flows down into the rotary vat from the filter hole at the bottom of the filter vat, so that the automatic fishing of the part and the grinding magnetic needle is completed, and the automatic fishing is more convenient.

title_en: Particle reinforced 7075 aluminum alloy seamless cored wire for double-wire arc material increase
abstract_en: A particle reinforced 7075 aluminum alloy seamless powder core wire for double-wire arc material increase belongs to the technical field of material increase manufacturing, and consists of metal powder and a seamless aluminum tube sheath, wherein alloy element components in the powder core and mass percentage thereof are, metal Mg powder 0.4% -1%, metal Zn powder 25% -35%, metal Cu powder 6% -8%, metal Cr powder 0.2% -0.4%, metal Ti powder 1% -3%, micro-nano particle powder 1% -5%, micro-nano particle is at least one of TiB  2 , siC, tiC, tiN and the like, the balance is metal Al powder, an outer cladding can be aluminum-magnesium alloy seamless tube, and the powder filling rate is 20% -25%. The composite mechanical property of the additive component adopting the flux-cored wire is obviously improved.

title_en: Zinc-white copper alloy and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a zinc white copper alloy, which comprises the following components in percentage by weight: 48.0 to 53.2 weight percent of Cu,5.8 to 8.0 weight percent of Ni,1.0 to 3.0 weight percent of Mn,1.0 to 2.8 weight percent of Pb,0.0001 to 0.3 weight percent of Fe, and the balance of Zn and unavoidable impurities; the microstructure of the cross section of the zinc-white copper alloy contains twin crystals, and the average width of the twin crystals is 0.5-5 mu m. The invention can realize that the yield strength of the zinc white copper is more than or equal to 520MPa, the tensile strength is more than or equal to 580MPa, the hardness HV is more than or equal to 155, the elongation is 8-15%, the weight loss rate is less than or equal to 0.02 percent after corrosion for 48 hours, the zinc white copper is repeatedly bent for 180 degrees, the zinc white copper is not broken within 6 times of bending, and the processing and use requirements are met, namely, after the alloy is stamped into a sample blank, the surface of the sample blank has no crack, the dimensional tolerance is less than or equal to +/-0.02 mm, the zinc white copper is loaded with a load of 1.0Nm, the deformation angle is less than 5 degrees, and the drop test requirement is met.

title_en: Stamping and cutting die
abstract_en: The application discloses a punching and cutting die which is used for cutting side edges of a workpiece and comprises an upper die and a lower die, wherein the upper die comprises a punching group; the lower die comprises an inner cutter set capable of moving up and down and an outer cutter set arranged outside the corresponding side of the inner cutter set; the inner cutter set comprises an inner cutter, wherein the inner cutter comprises a loading part for loading a workpiece and a first cutting edge formed at the corresponding side edge of the loading part; the outer cutter groups comprise outer cutters, and second cutting edges are formed on the inner side edges of the outer cutters, corresponding to the first cutting edges; when the die is assembled, the stamping group downwards stamps the inner cutter group, and the inner cutter group drives the first cutting edge to downwards move so as to be matched with the second cutting edge to cut the side edge of the workpiece. The stamping and cutting die can rapidly cut a workpiece and can replace different knife sets according to the shape of the cutting surface of the workpiece.

title_en: Manufacturing method of bimetal band saw blade tool bit
abstract_en: The invention provides a manufacturing method of a bimetal band saw blade tool bit. The manufacturing method of the bimetal band saw blade cutter head comprises the steps of cutter head particle forming: the cutter head takes the steel wire as a raw material, firstly straightens the steel wire, and then cuts particles of the cutter head for forming processing; and (3) heat treatment: heating the tool bit particles in vacuum, preserving heat for a certain time to austenitize, rapidly cooling to room temperature in a medium to quench, and tempering the tool bit particles in vacuum for n times, wherein n=2-6; polishing: polishing the cutter head particles on a vibration polishing machine; nickel plating: nickel plating is carried out on the tool bit particles in a chemical plating or electroplating mode; annealing: and (5) stress-relieving and annealing the cutter head particles to finish the cutter head processing. According to the invention, the steel wires are straightened before online cutting, and the straightened steel wires are not easy to skew during online cutting, so that the uniformity of the cutter head size is ensured.

title_en: Connection structure of rolling ring and rotary shell and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a connecting structure of a rolling ring and a rotary shell and a manufacturing method thereof, comprising the following steps: blanking, namely selecting a plurality of metal plates, and reserving redundant machining allowance; step two: and (3) arc pressing, namely performing arc pressing treatment on the metal plate, independently forming the rolling ring base plate, and checking the diameter of the inner circle of the rolling ring base plate by using a roundness sample plate, wherein the gap between the inner circle of the rolling ring base plate and the roundness test sample plate is required to be smaller than the machining amount of the inner circle of the rolling ring base plate. In the working process of the rotary shell, the temperature of the materials in the rotary shell is higher, the temperature difference change is larger in the process, if the rolling ring backing plate is welded with the rolling ring, the rolling ring or the rolling ring backing plate can be damaged due to different temperature difference shrinkage rates of the rolling ring and the rolling ring backing plate, the problem can be well solved by adopting the detachable rolling ring backing plate, the temperature difference change is large, the rolling ring and the rolling ring backing plate can be freely shrunk, and the rolling ring backing plate can be worn and replaced when in use after a certain time because the rolling ring backing plate is not welded and fixed.

title_en: 690 MPa-level H-resistant 2 Coiled plate for S-stress corrosion oil sleeve and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of oil casing production, in particular to a 690 MPa-level H-resistant pipe  2  A coiled plate for S-stress corrosion oil sleeve and a manufacturing method thereof. The chemical components of the paint are as follows by weight percent: c:0.13 to 0.17 percent, si:0.15 to 0.30 percent of Mn:1.40 to 1.70 percent, P: less than or equal to 0.013 percent, S: less than or equal to 0.004 percent, ti:0.01% -0.03%, nb:0.06% -0.10%, V:0.04 to 0.08 percent of Mg:0.005% -0.007%, zr:0.001% -0.004%, rare earth elements: 0.001 to 0.003 percent of Al:0.02% -0.06%, N: less than or equal to 0.008 percent, and the balance of Fe and unavoidable elements. The material has high strength, better low-temperature toughness, excellent SSC resistance, can prevent the brittle failure of the oil well pipe, and has higher safety. The final structure of the coiled plate is acicular ferrite; pcm is lower than 0.25%, the class A/B/C/D inclusion grade is lower than 1.0, the class sum grade is lower than 1.5, the band structure is lower than 0.5, and the impact energy at-10 ℃ is higher than 180J.

title_en: CNC machining center cartridge clip material loading clamping mechanism
abstract_en: The invention provides a CNC machining center cartridge clip feeding clamping mechanism which has high feeding efficiency and low cost, and can be increased to 1 person to 3 persons from 1 person originally; the labor cost is reduced. It comprises the following steps: CNC magnetic platform; a feeding placement seat; the magazine feeding mechanism; the finished product material box is used for placing products processed by the CNC processing center; a pen-shaped cylinder; a product clamping mechanism; a material taking clamping jaw; a transfer product manipulator assembly; a plurality of groups of product clamping mechanisms which are sequentially arranged are arranged on the CNC magnetic attraction platform, and N product clamping cavities are arranged at the upper part of each group of product clamping mechanisms; the feeding placing seat is arranged at one end of the CNC magnetic attraction platform, the feeding placing seat is provided with a magazine feeding mechanism, the bottom of the magazine feeding mechanism is provided with N product output ports, the magazine feeding mechanism is provided with N groups of product clips, and the discharge port of each group of product clips corresponds to a pen-shaped cylinder.

title_en: Automatic machine for loading iron shell
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic iron shell loading machine which comprises a workbench, a feeding mechanism, a multi-station distributed riveting mechanism and a material guiding and conveying mechanism.
