One side of workstation is located to feed mechanism, and feed mechanism includes a pair of material loading vibration dish, and one side that a pair of material loading vibration dish pressed close to the workstation all is connected with the stock guide, and one side that a pair of stock guide kept away from the material loading vibration dish all is equipped with the material loading cylinder, and the one end fixedly connected with material loading kicking block that the material loading vibration dish was kept away from to the piston rod in the material loading cylinder, material loading kicking block and stock guide phase-match. The multi-station distributed riveting mechanism is arranged on the workbench and comprises a riveting guide sliding rail, and a loading driving plate is arranged on one side of the riveting guide sliding rail. According to the invention, through the arrangement of the multi-station distributed riveting mechanism, different riveting assemblies can be arranged according to actual production requirements, so that the automatic iron shell loading machine can be used for assembling and processing connector iron shells of different types, and the applicability of the automatic iron shell loading machine is obviously improved.

title_en: Deformation correction clamp and method for titanium alloy thin-wall welding support
abstract_en: The invention relates to a deformation correction clamp and method for a titanium alloy thin-wall welding support, and belongs to the technical field of metal material machining. The invention uses the novel process technology and utilizes the characteristics of heat treatment and forming temperature approaching to each other of the titanium alloy to realize the internal stress elimination and shape correction of the welding seam in the same process. By means of the combined type contractible special correction clamp, the spatial position relation between the base assembly molded surface of the support part and the axis of the pipe end is effectively guaranteed, meanwhile, the internal support of the thin-shell structure is realized, the effect of correcting the full molded surface of the support is achieved, and the correction method has reference significance for the heat treatment correction mode of the hollow thin-wall structure of the type.

title_en: PCB single-sided board positioning and punching processing equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses positioning and punching processing equipment for a single-sided PCB (printed Circuit Board), which comprises a workbench, wherein a conveying belt is arranged on the left side of the workbench, a transfer assembly is arranged on the right side of the conveying belt, a baffle is arranged at the bottom of the transfer assembly, an arc-shaped plate is arranged below the baffle, intermittent assemblies are arranged on two sides of the transfer assembly, a driving motor is arranged on one side of each intermittent assembly, a turnover assembly is arranged on the right side of each intermittent assembly, and a punching assembly is arranged above the right side of each transfer assembly; the invention relates to the technical field of punching processing. This PCB single face board location processing equipment that punches a hole through under the effect of upset subassembly for the baffle is in the horizontality, makes the baffle support placing the board, and then is convenient for punch a hole the subassembly and carry out the processing of punching a hole to the PCB single face board, realizes rotating the assigned position with the PCB single face board according to certain interval, discharges and collects the processing, can conveniently carry out automated processing and production operation like this.

title_en: Aluminum-based composite material plate and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an aluminum-based composite material plate and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of aluminum-based composite materials. The technical scheme mainly adopted is as follows: the preparation method of the aluminum-based composite material plate comprises the following steps: aluminum powder and TiO  2  Mixing the particles and SiC particles to form a first raw material; sintering the first raw material to obtain a first plate; aluminum powder and TiO  2  Mixing the particles into a second raw material; sintering the second raw material to obtain a second plate; selecting an aluminum alloy plate as a third plate; and stacking the first plate, the second plate and the third plate in sequence from top to bottom, and then performing friction stir welding processing to obtain the aluminum-based composite plate. The invention is mainly used for preparing the composite board with high-temperature strength, wear resistance, processability and economy.

title_en: Installation method of shell-clamping coupling
abstract_en: A method of installing a pod coupling, the method comprising: the first step: centering the first shaft section and the second shaft section, checking centering conditions by using a centering tool and two dial indicators, and adjusting the positions until the difference value meets the requirement; rotating the centering tool to check the centering condition again; and a second step of: fixing the push-pull rod, the feedback bracket and the piston rod, and adjusting the connection condition and the position of the push-pull rod and the piston rod until the requirements are met; and a third step of: the shell-clamping couplings are connected one by using one to twelve stud nuts; adjusting the upper gap to be the same as the lower gap; tightening the first to twelfth stud nuts for a plurality of times by using a small to large moment, and enabling the upper clearance to be the same as the lower clearance until a set elongation is reached; fourth step: and (3) performing a jigger process, checking the end face runout amount by using a dial indicator, and adjusting until the end face runout amount meets the requirement. Therefore, the shaft section of the design is accurate in centering and the installation quality of the shell-clamping coupling is good.

title_en: Bilateral direct transmission device for four-roller plate and strip rolling mill supporting roller
abstract_en: The application discloses a bilateral direct transmission device for supporting rolls of a four-roll plate and strip rolling mill, and particularly relates to the technical field of rolling mill transmission devices. According to the application, through the corresponding matching use of each structure, the manufacturing cost of the device can be effectively reduced, the distance between the two devices is conveniently adjusted, the rotating shaft is limited through the limiting rings and the limiting ejector rods, the bearing performance of the rotating shaft is increased, the mechanical load of each structure in use is reduced, the service life of the mechanism is prolonged, the structure is locked in a tooth meshing mode, the torsional vibration can be reduced, meanwhile, the first gear and the second gear are prevented from rotating, the stability of the first gear and the second gear in rotation is increased, the stability of the structure in operation is also increased, and the use is convenient.

title_en: Automatic feeding and discharging device of steel tube sealing machine
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of steel tube sealing machines, and provides an automatic feeding and discharging device of a steel tube sealing machine, which comprises a device frame, discharging units and a plurality of groups of feeding units, wherein all the feeding units are arranged at intervals along the length direction of the device frame; the feeding unit comprises a blocking seat, a feeding mechanism and a positioning mechanism, wherein the blocking seat is partially higher than the device frame, and a placing station for placing the steel pipe fitting is formed at the front side of the blocking seat; the positioning mechanism is arranged on one side of the baffle seat away from the placing station and is used for clamping and fixing the steel pipe fitting; the discharging unit is arranged below the positioning mechanism and is used for lifting the steel pipe fitting to leave the positioning mechanism; the feeding mechanism comprises a material taking plate and a first driving piece, wherein the material taking plate is used for receiving a single steel pipe fitting located on the placing station, and through the action of the first driving piece, the material taking plate can lift the steel pipe fitting and transfer the steel pipe fitting to the positioning mechanism for clamping and positioning. Based on this, can accomplish the automatic feeding unloading operation of steel pipe fitting, have the advantage that reduces operating personnel intensity of labour.

title_en: Full-automatic high-pressure inflation and welding equipment for sealing cavity and operation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses full-automatic high-pressure inflation and welding equipment for a sealed cavity and an operation method thereof, which belong to the technical field of welding equipment. The device realizes the purpose of automatic inflation, plugging and whole-course automatic welding of the gas storage type gas generator.

title_en: Stamping device for metal gears
abstract_en: The invention provides a stamping device for a metal gear, which relates to the technical field of gear shaft hole stamping and comprises the following components: the gear chuck limiting mechanism and the stamping mechanism; the gear chuck limiting mechanism comprises limiting blocks and U-shaped connecting rods, wherein the limiting blocks are provided with two groups and are respectively arranged in limiting block penetrating holes of the upper base plate, and two ends of each U-shaped connecting rod respectively penetrate through clamping grooves upwards to be fixedly connected with the limiting blocks; the stamping mechanism comprises a stamping cylinder, a U-shaped frame and a stamping head, wherein one end of the top of the stamping head is provided with an inclined notch and inclines downwards towards one side, the other end of the stamping head is connected with an arc-shaped guide plate, and the top end of the arc-shaped guide plate inclines obliquely towards one side. After the gear chuck moves to the bottom of the stamping head, the gear chuck is limited by the limiting block, the bottom end of the gear shaft hole can be polished, and when the gear chuck moves to the receiving piece groove, the gear chuck can be turned over to discharge the gear, so that the problem that burrs are stored on the bottom side after the shaft hole is stamped is solved.

title_en: Dust cover press riveting and quantitative grease injection equipment for transmission shaft and assembly method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dust cover riveting and quantitative grease injection device and an assembly method of a transmission shaft, wherein the dust cover riveting and quantitative grease injection device of the transmission shaft is integrated on one device, so that the feeding and discharging time and the number of operators of a workpiece are saved; because the two procedures are operated on the same equipment, the relevance between the two process data can be established, and the tracing of one workpiece is convenient.

title_en: Sleeve disassembly assembly
abstract_en: The application discloses a sleeve disassembly assembly, which relates to the technical field of disassembly tools and comprises a fixed piece, a movable piece and a driving piece, wherein the fixed piece comprises a first end part, a second end part and a flange, the flange is arranged around the periphery of the fixed piece, and the distance between the side surface of the flange and the central shaft of the fixed piece increases gradually in the direction from the first end part to the second end part. The movable piece is sleeved on the fixed piece and is in sliding connection with the fixed piece. The driving piece is movably connected to the first end part of the fixed piece, and can drive the movable piece to slide relative to the fixed piece when moving relative to the fixed piece so as to enable the end part of the movable piece to prop open under the supporting and pressing of the side surface of the flange; the driving piece can be relative when the tip of moving part struts the mounting is motionless, and the tip of moving part can be maintained in the state of strutting, is connected with the inner wall stability of external member, is difficult for skidding at the in-process of extracting the external member, convenient to use.

title_en: Control method and device for upper and lower cooling beds of steel plate, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a control method and device for an upper cooling bed and a lower cooling bed of a steel plate, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to steel plate processing. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a first position and a second position of a steel plate, wherein the first position is a feeding position of a feeding assembly line, and the second position is a discharging position of a cooling bed; after the steel plate moves to the first position, the transfer trolley ascends to transfer the steel plate to the feeding position of the cooling bed, and the steel plate is fed; the steel plate moves to the second position under the action of the cooling bed; when the steel plate moves to the second position, the blanking mechanism ascends to transfer the steel plate to a blanking assembly line, and blanking of the steel plate is completed. The application does not need manual participation in the whole process, improves the automation degree of equipment, and can realize standardized operation.

title_en: Stamping equipment is used in metal building panel production
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of metal building board production, and discloses stamping equipment for metal building board production, which comprises an equipment shell, wherein a stamping groove is formed in the equipment shell, a protection collecting assembly is arranged on the bottom wall of the stamping groove and used for collecting stamped fragments, a clamping and fixing mechanism is arranged at the top of the protection collecting assembly, a tubular board is arranged on the inner wall of the clamping and fixing mechanism, and the clamping and fixing mechanism is used for clamping and fixing the tubular board and is matched with the protection collecting assembly to collect the fragments. This stamping equipment is used in metal building panel production is through placing tubular panel in the inside of centre gripping fixture and centre gripping fixed, then starts the punching press ware body, and the punching press ware body drives collar and punching press piece and descends the punching press to punch out the wire casing at tubular panel's surface, the device not only can carry out the punching press wire casing on tubular panel surface, can also increase tubular panel's usage.

title_en: Manufacturing process and equipment of fluororubber O-shaped sealing ring
abstract_en: The invention discloses a manufacturing process and equipment of a fluororubber O-shaped sealing ring, and relates to the technical field of fluororubber O-shaped sealing rings.

title_en: HB400 grade wear-resistant corrosion-resistant steel based on continuous heat treatment production line and production method
abstract_en: HB400 grade wear-resistant corrosion-resistant steel based on continuous heat treatment production line comprises the following components in percentage by weight: c:0.10 to 0.18 percent, si: no more than 0.2%, mn:0.2 to 0.9 percent, P is less than or equal to 0.020 percent, S is less than or equal to 0.010 percent, als:0.03 to 0.06 percent of Ti: 0.005-0.01%, cu: no more than 0.2%; the production method comprises the following steps: conventionally smelting and casting into blanks; heating a casting blank, hot-rolling and coiling; continuously uncoiling and quenching; cooling at a high speed; tempering after transverse cutting according to a fixed length; naturally cooling to room temperature. The invention ensures that the product hardness HB is not lower than 400, the yield strength is not lower than 950MPa, the tensile strength is not lower than 1220MPa, the elongation is not lower than 10 percent, and the product has simple components, uniform quality and performance and reduced production cost by not lower than 2 percent on the premise of corrosion resistance.

title_en: Resistance spot welding method
abstract_en: The object is to provide a resistance spot welding method. The present invention provides a resistance spot welding method, which is characterized in that at least 2 steel plates including at least 1 galvanized steel plate are joined, wherein the current application has a first current application step and a second current application step, in the first current application step, when the thickness of the thinnest steel plate in the overlapped steel plates is set as t, a nugget with a nugget diameter of 3-4.5-t is formed by setting a current value I1 (kA) and a current application time, in the second current application step, the nugget is enlarged by repeating a cooling step of keeping a non-current application state for a period of 10-160 ms and a current application step of current value I2 (kA) for a period of 20-200 ms.

title_en: Pipeline auxiliary support device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an auxiliary supporting device for a pipeline, which relates to the technical field of pipeline supporting and comprises a fixed supporting unit, a driving assembly, a fixed assembly arranged in the middle of the driving assembly, a locking assembly arranged on the side surface of the fixed assembly, two groups of supporting assemblies symmetrically arranged on two sides of the fixed assembly, and a lifting assembly arranged on the top of the supporting assembly. According to the invention, the fixed supporting unit is arranged, the rotation driving assembly drives the fixed assembly to move towards the middle, the lifting assembly is pulled to descend to fix the pipeline in the middle, the clamping force of the pipeline in three directions is improved, the clamping stability is improved, the operation is simple, the locking assembly is driven to lock after the device is fixed through the movement of the fixed assembly, the reduction or cancellation of the clamping force on the pipeline caused by the false touch during the further processing of the pipeline is avoided, and the stability in the processing process is ensured.

title_en: Cutting and code spraying integrated laser cutting machine
abstract_en: The application discloses a cutting and code spraying integrated laser cutting machine, which is characterized by comprising a frame, wherein the frame is fixedly connected with a cross beam, a first screw rod and a second screw rod are fixedly connected in the cross beam, the first screw rod is connected with a first motor, the second screw rod is connected with a second motor, a laser cutting assembly in threaded connection with the first screw rod and a code spraying assembly in threaded connection with the second screw rod are also connected with the cross beam in a sliding manner.

title_en: Automobile seat part machining equipment and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automobile seat part processing device and method, which are used for processing a backrest or a cushion of a seat and comprise a frame, a driving assembly, a carrying assembly, a clamping assembly, a polishing assembly, a detecting assembly and a control assembly, wherein the driving assembly is used for driving parts of the seat to circulate at different stations, the carrying assembly is used for carrying the backrest or the cushion, the clamping assembly is used for clamping objects to be clamped on the backrest or the cushion so that a vent hole formed after the objects to be clamped are taken out is communicated with a ventilation cavity in the backrest or the cushion, the polishing assembly is used for polishing and cleaning the vent hole, the detecting assembly is used for detecting air flow of the vent hole, and the control assembly is used for controlling operation of the driving assembly, the clamping assembly, the polishing assembly and the detecting assembly. The processing equipment for the automobile seat parts can efficiently process the backrest or the cushion.

title_en: Processing system capable of flushing paper
abstract_en: The invention discloses a processing system for flushable paper, and relates to the field of flushable paper. An unreeling mechanism, a cutting mechanism and a collecting mechanism are arranged in the cutting box; the unreeling mechanism comprises an unreeling roller, a mounting seat, a clamping seat and a rotating shaft, wherein the unreeling roller horizontally rotates around a fixed shaft in the mounting seat, and one end of the unreeling roller is clamped in a placing groove of the clamping seat; the mounting seat and the clamping seat are respectively connected with a rotating shaft, and the rotating shaft is rotationally connected with the fixed seat; the cutting mechanism comprises a driving air cylinder, a mounting plate and a cutting knife, wherein the bottom of a driving rod of the driving air cylinder is connected with the mounting plate, and the cutting knife is mounted at the bottom of the mounting plate; a blowing pipe is arranged on the inner wall of the cutting box; the collecting mechanism comprises a collecting tank, and the bottom of the collecting tank is connected with the recycling bin through a conveying pipe. The invention has the advantages that: the unreeling roller does not need to be disassembled when the roll paper is mounted, the mounting operation is more convenient, and the unreeling roller cannot shake when unreeling; paper scraps are pumped into the recycling bin to be made into paper pulp for reuse, and the product quality is ensured.

title_en: Train hook dismounting accessory
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of coupler assembling and moving, in particular to a train coupler disassembling and assembling accessory which comprises a mounting frame, a box body, a positioning piece and a piece moving mechanism, wherein the mounting frame is arranged on a forklift, the box body moves synchronously along with the mounting frame, one end of the box body is provided with a coupler yoke pin hole, the positioning piece is positioned in the box body, the piece moving mechanism is arranged on the box body and can enable the positioning piece to be inserted into the coupler yoke pin hole of the coupler, one end of the coupler for assembling the train coupler is moved into the box body to be fixed in position, then the coupler is assembled with a coupler tongue, after the assembly is completed, the forklift can directly move the assembled coupler to a designated position to store the coupler, the process from the completion of the assembly to the beginning of the movement of the coupler is removed, the time required by the process from the beginning of the assembly to the completion of the movement of the coupler is reduced, and the convenience is realized.

title_en: Intelligent temperature regulation workbench based on software development
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent temperature regulation workbench based on software development, which comprises a workbench body, wherein two symmetrical station shells are fixed at the top of the workbench body, mounting brackets are fixedly connected to the top of the station shells, mounting sliding grooves are formed in one sides of the two mounting brackets opposite to each other, mounting sliding blocks are connected inside the mounting sliding grooves in a sliding manner, and mounting concave blocks are fixedly connected to the side walls of the mounting sliding blocks. According to the invention, heated wind is discharged into the interior of the coiled pipe through the third branch pipe, so that the water is heated in a conduction way, meanwhile, the electric heating conduit conducts heat to the station shell, then the evaporated gas after heating is discharged through the pressure relief pipe, and meanwhile, the heated wind is discharged from the fourth branch pipe, so that the water conducts heat uniformly to the workbench body, the workbench can be heated sufficiently, heat conduction is uniformly conducted, and the use effect is improved.

title_en: Electrical engineering and automatic welding device for same
abstract_en: The application discloses an electrical engineering and an automatic welding device thereof, which belong to the field of workpiece welding equipment, and comprise a first processing table, a second processing table and a welding mechanism arranged above the first processing table, wherein the first processing table and the second processing table are respectively provided with a support column for supporting, and the welding device is characterized in that: the processing bench is connected with the side roller in a rotating way corresponding to the side of the processing bench, the top roller is arranged below the outside of the side roller, the driving motor is started to drive the bidirectional reciprocating screw rod to rotate, the bidirectional reciprocating screw rod jacking mechanism is matched with the driving mechanism to drive the hinge rod to correspondingly deform, so that the top of the top roller can jack up a processed workpiece, meanwhile, the toothed plate is driven to move upwards by the matched gear, the toothed roller is enabled to rotate continuously, the push plate is driven to move towards the workpiece, the lateral thrust is applied to the workpiece, the workpiece can be automatically pushed away from a processing area by the matched push plate after the jacking, and the physical strength consumed by workers is effectively reduced.

title_en: Block terminal shell cutting device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cutting device for a shell of an electric distribution box, which comprises a pair of supporting tables, wherein the bottoms of the supporting tables are fixedly connected with a plurality of supporting bases, welding frames are welded between the supporting tables, the welding frames are rectangular, collecting hoppers are arranged between the welding frames, a plurality of fixing rods are fixedly connected between the welding frames, a pair of supporting vertical rods are fixedly arranged on the surfaces of the supporting tables, and fixing plates are arranged on the side walls of the supporting vertical rods; compared with the prior art, the limiting bolt is rotated, so that the limiting block can move in the limiting groove, the position of the movable inserted link can be adjusted according to the arc shape or the distance of the cutting part, the movable block at one end is limited, the movable block is matched with the transmission shaft to move with the sliding plate, the side wall of the plate can be rapidly polished, the buffer plate can move in the polishing process, the uneven side edge after cutting is propped between polishing blocks, the self-adaption of different conditions can be realized, the polishing effect of equipment is ensured, and the missing condition in the polishing process is reduced.

title_en: Method for measuring perpendicularity in high-precision taper hole machining process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for measuring perpendicularity in a high-precision taper hole machining process, which comprises the steps of inserting a standard core rod with taper consistent with a high-precision taper hole into the standard core rod, selecting two planes which are perpendicular to the standard core rod and have a distance H and are parallel to a perpendicularity measuring standard on a cylindrical surface of the standard core rod, acquiring contour line coordinate information on the standard core rod corresponding to the two planes through a machine tool measuring head, further calculating a central coordinate point, and then carrying out technical perpendicularity. The invention can detect the verticality of the hole to be processed in real time, has simple measurement principle and convenient operation, and is beneficial to implementation, popularization and application.

title_en: Precise assembly device and method for air-floating supporting structure of air-floating guide rail
abstract_en: An air-floating guide rail air-floating supporting structure precise assembly device and method belong to the technical field of ultra-precise assembly. The device is as follows: the guide rail is fixed on the big bottom plate along the Y direction of big bottom plate, dipperstick mount passes through connecting block and guide rail sliding connection, dipperstick cover and mount fixed connection, the dipperstick is worn out the dipperstick cover along the X direction slip of big bottom plate, the steering platform is fixed on the big bottom plate, steering platform and guide rail parallel arrangement, the air supporting guide rail assembly table passes through swivel bearing and is connected with the steering platform, I shape structure is on a parallel with the guide rail setting and with air supporting guide rail assembly table locating connection, L shape structure and I shape structure looks parallel arrangement and fixed mounting are on the air supporting guide rail assembly table, clearance between L shape structure and the I shape structure is the same with air supporting guide rail's air film thickness. The device and the method are convenient for assembling the L-shaped structural member and the I-shaped structural member, the time and the labor are saved in the assembling process, the assembling efficiency and the assembling precision are effectively improved, and the high requirements of ultra-precise equipment and devices can be met.

title_en: Double-mounting-plate blade handheld polishing clamp and polishing method
abstract_en: The polishing clamp comprises a clamp main body, wherein a U-shaped groove is formed in the clamp main body; circular counter bores are respectively arranged on the two side walls of the U-shaped groove, a rotatable angle adjusting block is arranged in the circular counter bore on one side, and a rotatable compressing block is arranged in the circular counter bore on the other side; slots are respectively arranged on the opposite surfaces of the angle adjusting block and the compressing block; mounting plates at two ends of the blade to be polished are respectively inserted into slots of the angle adjusting block and the compressing block; an angle adjusting rod is arranged at one end of the clamp main body, and the inner side end of the angle adjusting rod is fixedly connected with the angle adjusting block; the other end of the clamp main body is provided with a compression screw through threaded fit, and the inner side end of the compression screw abuts against the compression block. The polishing method adopts the polishing clamp. The invention improves the manual polishing efficiency, improves the comfort level of workers, reduces the potential safety hazard and reduces the production cost.

title_en: Discontinuous gradient structure 6xxx series aluminum alloy and friction stir additive manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a 6xxx series aluminum alloy with a discontinuous gradient structure and a friction stir additive manufacturing method thereof, wherein a T6-state Al-Mg-Si alloy sheet is subjected to layer-by-layer cumulative forming through a friction stir additive manufacturing technology to obtain an Al-Mg-Si alloy with a discontinuous grain size gradient structure in the thickness direction, and the synergistic effect of different grain size areas is utilized to obtain an aluminum alloy with excellent comprehensive performance, wherein the tensile strength parallel to the processing direction is 240-260 MPa, the failure strain is 19.2% -22.3%, and the mechanical property of the aluminum alloy is obviously improved. The raw materials used in the invention have wide sources, are nontoxic and environment-friendly, are energy-saving at normal temperature in the preparation process, and have simple and feasible process and lower cost.

title_en: Gear pump body output shaft end face finish milling fixture
abstract_en: The invention provides a finish milling fixture for an output shaft end face of a gear pump body, which belongs to the technical field of gear pump machining and comprises a machining base, wherein two positioning blocks are arranged at the top of the machining base, and a gear pump is arranged at the top between the two positioning blocks; a pump body fixing mechanism is arranged at one end of the processing base, which is close to the gear pump, and comprises a lower pressing plate capable of lifting; the invention can clamp and fix gear pumps with different models and sizes, can realize micro rotation of the output shaft of the gear pump, and can perform stable and accurate finish milling.

title_en: Production device for producing battery cover plate
abstract_en: The utility model provides a production device for producing a battery cover plate, and belongs to the technical field of battery cover plate production equipment; the device comprises a C-arm machine, wherein a cutting component and a collecting component which are connected are arranged on the C-arm machine; the cutting part comprises a placing table arranged on the supporting seat of the C-arm machine. According to the utility model, the cutting part is arranged, and the first knife groove and the second knife groove which penetrate through the placing table and the first knife blade and the second knife blade which are matched with the first knife groove and the second knife groove are arranged, so that the knife blade which is firstly contacted with the battery cover plate can cut redundant materials on two opposite sides of the battery cover plate, and the cutting of redundant materials on two opposite sides of the battery cover plate is completed along with the continuous descending of the other two knife blades.

title_en: Embedded electrode deep hole electrolytic electric spark machining device and machining method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an embedded electrode deep hole electrolytic spark machining device and a machining method, wherein the device comprises a working power supply, an electrode feeding unit, an electrode rotating unit, an embedded electrode, an auxiliary electrode, an electrolyte tank, a machining tank and an electrolyte supply system, wherein the electrolyte supply system supplies electrolyte in the electrolyte tank to the embedded electrode, the embedded electrode is arranged on the electrode rotating unit and is driven to rotate by the electrode rotating unit, the electrode rotating unit is arranged on the electrode feeding unit and is driven by the electrode rotating unit to drive the embedded electrode to do lifting motion relative to a workpiece, the embedded electrode comprises an insulated electrode tube, a conducting wire and a tool electrode, the conducting wire is arranged in the insulated electrode tube, one end of the conducting wire is connected with a negative electrode of the working power supply, the other end of the conducting wire is connected with the tool electrode, an electrolyte spray hole is formed in the insulated electrode tube, one end of the insulated electrode tube is communicated with the electrolyte supply system, the other end of the insulated electrode is connected with the tool electrode, and the auxiliary electrode is connected with a positive electrode of the working power supply. The method adopts the device for processing.

title_en: Device of gas-assisted polishing system and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of gas-assisted polishing, and provides a device of a gas-assisted polishing system and a use method thereof, wherein the device comprises a support frame, the top end of the support frame is fixedly connected with a support plate, the outer side wall of the support plate is provided with an instrument panel, a pressurizing mechanism is arranged at the top end of the support frame, and the pressurizing mechanism also comprises a water injection mechanism and a ventilation mechanism; the invention prepares the gas supersaturated solution by utilizing the hydrophobic membrane contact system, the whole CMP system is accommodated in a sealed pressure tank, the deviation between the gas dissolution amount in the gas supersaturated solution and the air contact of the solution in the atmospheric environment can be avoided, the pressure in the polishing tank can be changed in the polishing process, the production efficiency can be greatly increased in industry, the invention is possibly applicable to all slurries by a nano-bubble auxiliary method, and the bubbles can exist in water stably for a longer time than normal millimeter or submillimeter bubbles.

title_en: Polishing device for super mirror polishing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polishing device for super mirror polishing, which comprises: a sample fixing part configured to clamp a sample and drive the sample to rotate around its own axis; a base configured to be movable in a lateral direction, a longitudinal direction, and a height direction, respectively; the polishing part extends along the height direction, is arranged on the base below the sample, is configured to rotate around the axis of the polishing part, and linearly moves back and forth along the transverse direction, the longitudinal direction and the height direction along with the base so as to adjust the relative position between the polishing part and the sample; and a polishing liquid conveying part having one end mounted on the polishing part and configured to quantitatively convey one of the plurality of polishing liquids alone to the polishing part or to convey a mixed polishing liquid mixed by the plurality of polishing liquids in a predetermined ratio to the polishing part; the working conditions with different polishing coefficients are formed according to the components and the conveying amount of the polishing liquid, the material type of the polishing medium and the polishing pressure applied on the sample, wherein the components and the conveying amount of the polishing liquid are conveyed to the polishing part by the polishing liquid conveying part.

title_en: Auxiliary device for maintaining ship engine
abstract_en: The invention discloses an auxiliary device for maintaining a ship engine, which relates to the technical field of engine maintenance equipment and comprises a base, wherein a support frame, a rotating ring, a speed reduction adjusting assembly, an elevation angle adjusting assembly and a support assembly are arranged on the base; the number of the supporting frames is two, and the tops of the two supporting frames are provided with coaxially arranged mounting rings; the rotating ring is of a columnar hollow structure, the rotating ring is rotatably arranged between the two mounting rings, and an out-of-control self-locking structure is arranged between the rotating ring and the mounting rings; the speed reduction adjusting assembly is used for supporting the engine and controlling the circumferential angle of the engine; the elevation angle adjusting component is used for controlling the rotation of the rotating ring and adjusting the installation elevation angle of the engine. The invention utilizes the matching of the worm wheel and the worm to freely control the angle of the installation shaft, is beneficial to inspection and maintenance, and can be more convenient for maintenance personnel to observe and inspect the engine so as to determine the specific position and property of the problem, thereby being beneficial to improving the maintenance efficiency and accuracy.

title_en: Synchronous punching device for large-section beam side templates and construction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a synchronous punching device and a construction method for a large-section beam side template, wherein the synchronous punching device comprises a stepping mechanism at the front end and a punching mechanism at the rear end, and the stepping mechanism is connected with the punching mechanism through a middle rod group; the stepping mechanism comprises a stepping rotating shaft, the middle part of the stepping rotating shaft is rotationally connected with a first pivot connecting seat, two ends of the stepping rotating shaft are respectively provided with three rod frame mechanisms, and the three rod frame mechanisms are provided with three supporting feet which are uniformly distributed in the circumferential direction by taking the central shaft of the stepping rotating shaft as the center; the punching mechanism comprises two groups of double-rod vertical rail frames which are symmetrically distributed left and right, the double-rod vertical rail frames are provided with punchers with drill bits facing outwards, and the two double-rod vertical rail frames on two sides are movably connected through a vertical rail distance-adjusting rod group; the invention reduces the probability of positioning error through the cooperation of the stepping mechanism and the punching mechanism, and simultaneously innovates the technological method, and the accurate and effective hole making can be realized through rolling continuous construction steps, and meanwhile, the complete consistency of the hole making positions at the two sides of the template can be ensured.

title_en: Protection ring and turntable application structure with protection ring
abstract_en: The application relates to a protection ring belongs to revolving stage protection technical field, and it includes: the novel shaft-shaped structure comprises an outer ring part and an inner ring part, wherein the outer ring part and the inner ring part are integrally formed, the middle part of the inner ring part is provided with a space for sleeving and inserting the shaft-shaped structure, and the outer ring part and the inner ring part are provided with thickness differences. In order to reduce the use influence of scraps on a turntable structure, improve the use precision and the service life of the turntable, the application provides a protection ring and a turntable application structure with the protection ring.

title_en: Method for inhibiting plasma shielding effect and improving femtosecond laser processing efficiency
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for inhibiting a plasma shielding effect and improving the processing efficiency of femtosecond laser, and belongs to the technical field of metal material processing by femtosecond laser micro-nano. According to the invention, the femtosecond laser-induced metal plasma plume is solved based on multi-physical field coupling, a dual-temperature model is adopted to simulate the interaction of the femtosecond laser and a copper target, so that the surface temperature of the copper target is obtained, when the temperature exceeds a boiling point, the copper target generates gas eruption, the movement track of each material particle and the collision between each material particle and background gas are simulated through a DSMC method, and the change of the speed and the direction of the particle is obtained. The invention can simulate the interaction process of the erupted metal plasma plume and the background gas, thereby accurately representing the interaction of laser and materials, melting the materials and forming plasma, obtaining plume distribution under the scale related to experiments, reducing the shielding effect of the plasma plume on the laser by optimizing the density and the speed distribution of the plume, and improving the femtosecond laser processing efficiency.

title_en: Welding set that rectangle metal pipe fitting processing was used
abstract_en: The invention discloses a welding device for processing rectangular metal pipe fittings, which comprises a frame, wherein inner walls at two sides of the frame are rotationally connected with a rotary drum, one side of a belt, which is far away from a first motor, is sleeved on the outer wall of the rotary drum, a fixing mechanism comprises connecting rods, first springs and clamping plates, the connecting rods are rotationally connected with the inner walls of the rotary drum through rotation bolts, the connecting rods are arranged at two sides of the center of the rotary drum and symmetrically arranged, the first springs are fixedly connected with the side surfaces of the connecting rods, the connecting rods start to rotate towards the center of the rotary drum after being extruded, then the clamping plates clamp the rectangular metal pipe, so that the effect of clamping the metal pipe is achieved, and as the clamping plates are symmetrically arranged relative to the center of the rotary drum, the extruding plates simultaneously act on all the connecting rods, and after the connecting rods are extruded, the clamping plates synchronously clamp the metal pipe from the two sides of the metal pipe to the center of the rotary drum, so that the self-centering clamping effect is achieved.

title_en: Production method of aluminum alloy forging
abstract_en: The invention provides a production method of an aluminum alloy forging, which comprises the following steps: a) Performing four-time drawing and four-time upsetting on the aluminum alloy cast ingot to obtain a primary processing product; b) Carrying out solution treatment on the primary processed product, and then rapidly cooling; c) And C) carrying out cold compression on the product obtained in the step B) in the height direction, and finally carrying out aging treatment. The application provides a production method of an aluminum alloy forging, which respectively upsets and lengthens cast ingots from longitudinal, transverse and high directions, effectively breaks up cast structures from all directions, reduces anisotropy of aluminum alloy materials, obtains high-level aluminum alloy with small circumferential and radial high indexes and small performance difference, and particularly obtains a 2195 aluminum lithium alloy forging with high performance.

title_en: Method for manufacturing vacuum switch tube assembly by using welding treatment chamber
abstract_en: The application relates to a method for manufacturing a vacuum switch tube assembly by utilizing a welding treatment chamber, which relates to the technical field of vacuum switch tube production, and comprises the following steps that S1, firstly, a welding flux is coated at the connecting part of a vacuum switch tube and is fixed through a fixing piece to form a piece to be treated; s2, placing the piece to be treated formed in the S1 into a welding device, firstly preheating, and preheating the piece to be treated to 100-150 ℃; s3, conveying in a welding device, and carrying out high-temperature brazing on the workpiece to be treated preheated in the step S2, wherein the brazing temperature is 600-900 ℃; and S4, cooling the vacuum switch tube subjected to brazing in the step S3, and realizing slow cooling of the vacuum switch tube. The application has the advantages that pretreatment, welding and cooling are conveniently carried out in a segmented mode, the production efficiency of the vacuum switch tube is improved, and the energy waste is reduced.

title_en: Plasma cutting machine
abstract_en: The invention provides a plasma cutting machine, which belongs to the technical field of heating cutting, and comprises a lathe bed, a cutting machine body arranged above the lathe bed, a moving plate, a high-pressure spray head, a rotating mechanism, a collecting box, an air supply assembly and a moving assembly, wherein the moving plate is arranged above the lathe bed; the moving plate is arranged inside the lathe bed; the high-pressure spray heads are arranged on the moving plate at intervals and face the inner bottom wall of the lathe bed; the rotating mechanism is used for driving each high-pressure spray head to swing; the collecting box is used for receiving the cleaned slag; the air supply assembly is used for supplying air to each high-pressure spray head; the moving assembly is used for driving the moving plate to move towards a direction approaching or separating from the collecting box. According to the invention, the high-pressure spray heads are used for spraying gas to slag in the lathe bed, so that the slag is gradually cleaned to the end part of the lathe bed and then enters the collecting box, and the rotating mechanism drives each high-pressure spray head to swing, so that the slag can be cleaned more cleanly and thoroughly.

title_en: Method for repairing cracks of deformation energy absorbing element
abstract_en: A crack repairing method of a deformation energy absorbing element comprises the following steps: (1) disassembly: disassembling the deformation energy absorption unit; (2) cleaning: cleaning greasy dirt and silt on the surface of the deformation energy absorption unit component; (3) paint removal: removing paint on the surface of the component to expose the natural color of the metal; (4) flaw detection: flaw detection is carried out on the welding seam and the arc transition part of the steel cylinder; (5) decomposition: decomposing the component into a steel cylinder and a bottom plate; (6) removing cracks: removing the cracks using a lathe apparatus; (7) a re-probing inspection: flaw detection is carried out on the turned steel cylinder, and cracks are not allowed; (8) welding repair: welding and repairing the steel cylinder welding body; (9) a re-probing inspection; (10) assembling. The welding process method for repairing the cracks of the deformation energy-absorbing unit by adopting the lathe and the cutting knife to machine and turn the welding cracks of the deformation energy-absorbing element is adopted, and the repair qualification rate of the deformation energy-absorbing unit is improved.

title_en: Electric hammer or electric spanner adapter for electric tool
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electric tool accessories, and particularly relates to an electric hammer or an electric wrench adapter for an electric tool. The invention provides an electric hammer or an electric spanner adapter for an electric tool, which is used for realizing turning round of an electric spanner, turning round of a square handle and turning round of a round handle, and aims to solve the problem that in the prior art, the electric hammer or the electric spanner is inconvenient to operate when being replaced by electric hammers or electric spanner adapters with different specifications. An electric hammer or an electric wrench adapter for an electric tool comprises a shell, wherein a first conversion head which is clamped with the electric tool is arranged in the shell, a second conversion head which is clamped with the electric hammer or the electric wrench adapter is also arranged in the shell, and a torque transmission mechanism is arranged between the first conversion head and the second conversion head; the first conversion head is used for installing electric hammers or electric wrench adapters with different specifications, and can conveniently realize turning of an electric wrench, turning of a square handle, turning of a round handle.

title_en: Wear-resistant corrosion-resistant antifouling antibacterial composite modified layer for metal surface and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of metal surface composite modification, and particularly discloses a metal surface wear-resistant corrosion-resistant antifouling antibacterial composite modified layer and a preparation method thereof. The composite modified layer comprises a micro-texture layer, wherein a nitriding layer is arranged on the micro-texture layer, and a lubricant and antibacterial silicon balls are coupled in the micro-texture layer. The surface of the antibacterial silicon sphere is covered with a layer of hydrophobic organic molecules, and antibacterial particles are loaded in holes of the antibacterial silicon sphere. The prepared composite modified layer has both wear resistance and antibacterial and anti-biological adhesion properties, and has wider application range. The preparation method mainly comprises the following steps of preparing S1 alkylated silver-loaded mesoporous silicon spheres, designing micro-textures on the surface of S2 metal, preparing a nitriding layer on the surface of S3 metal, constructing a nano-antibacterial lubricating/micro-texture/nitriding coupling layer on the surface of S4 metal, and finally assembling the antibacterial silicon spheres in the micro-textures to prepare the composite modified layer with better wear resistance and outstanding antibacterial anti-adhesion performance.

title_en: Metal spinning product processing equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a metal spinning product processing device, which relates to the technical field of combined processing and comprises a combined processing table, wherein a control device is arranged on the combined processing table, a first chute is formed on the combined processing table, a first motor chute is formed on the combined processing table, a second chute and a third chute are formed on the surface of the combined processing table, which is provided with the first chute, a second motor chute and a third motor chute are formed on the surface of the combined processing table, which is provided with the first chute, and a clamping mechanism, a spinning mechanism and a turning mechanism are arranged on the combined processing table. Compared with the prior spinning device, when the part to be spun is clamped and fixed, only the part to be spun with a fixed shape can be clamped and fixed, so that the spinning processing range of the prior spinning device is limited; the clamping assembly is arranged on the device, so that the device can clamp the parts to be spun in various shapes, the spinning processing range of the device is greatly improved, and the processing applicability of the device is improved.

title_en: Tool for fastening and releasing wall anchors
abstract_en: A wall anchor fastening and release tool comprising a tool body forming a slide housing, a handle rigidly protruding from the slide housing, a slider arranged inside the slide housing, and a first lever pivotally connected to the handle and arranged to move the slider in the slide housing between a first position and a second position, wherein when the first lever is in the first position, a screw clamping end of the slider is adjacent a first housing end, and wherein when the first lever is in the second position, the screw clamping end of the slider is retracted into the slide housing, and a screw pushing end of the slider is adjacent a second housing end, the screw clamping end of the slider is arranged to clamp under a head of a wall anchor center screw, and the second housing end is arranged to clamp under a wall anchor collar.

title_en: Support device and system for realizing stable groove type of replica grating
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of semiconductor mechanisms, in particular to a supporting device and a supporting system for realizing the stability of a replica grating groove type. And a rigid structure with a preset angle is arranged in a part of the structure in the supporting structure and is used for forming a replica grating groove type so as to fix at least a part of the whole replica grating groove type. The first structure is arranged on two sides of the supporting structure and plays a supporting role on the whole main body of the supporting structure. The second structure performs positioning locking on the degrees of freedom of the replica grating groove patterns with different sizes. One end of the supporting plate is connected with a rotatable first connecting point of the rigid structure, and the other end of the supporting plate is connected with a rotatable second connecting point of the first structure. The second structures are arranged at different positions on two corresponding sides of the supporting plate so as to control the positioning precision between the replica grating groove type and the master grating groove type. The supporting device of the application ensures the consistency of the groove pattern between the replica grating and the master grating.

title_en: Pine wood nematode epidemic wood treatment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pine wood nematode epidemic wood treatment method, which comprises the following steps: spraying liquid medicine on the trunk of pine tree with nematodiasis by unmanned aerial vehicle, and keeping the trunk surface moist; and (5) felling: cutting down the diseased pine tree by using an electric saw, and enabling the pine tree to fall in a direction not to contact other pine trees; cutting: cutting pine into tree sections of 5-7 m, paving a film with the diameter of 2 m on the ground of the cutting position when cutting, placing the cutting position of the pine at the center of the film, cutting, and continuously spraying the cutting position by using liquid medicine while cutting by an electric saw so that wood chips cannot be suspended in air; transportation: spraying liquid medicine on the cut-off section of the cut-off pine tree section, paving a layer of film on a carriage of a transport vehicle, then placing the cut-off pine tree section on the film for stacking, then turning over two sides of the film, wrapping the pine tree section, and transporting the pine tree section to a treatment plant.

title_en: Fault diagnosis system and method for aluminum foil rolling for double-zero aluminum foil production
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fault diagnosis system and a fault diagnosis method for aluminum foil rolling for double-zero aluminum foil production, comprising the steps of obtaining running state data of an aluminum foil rolling machine, and processing the running state data of the aluminum foil rolling machine to obtain working condition values of the aluminum foil rolling machine; acquiring aluminum foil rolling quality data according to the working condition value of the aluminum foil rolling machine, and identifying the state of the aluminum foil rolling machine based on the aluminum foil rolling quality data; according to the scheme, the working condition value is obtained by processing the maximum temperature value of the compression roller bearing of the aluminum foil rolling mill during rolling, the maximum noise decibel value of the aluminum foil rolling mill during rolling and the electric energy critical loss value of the aluminum foil rolling mill during rolling, the primary detection state of the aluminum foil rolling mill is identified based on the working condition value, the primary detection normal signal of the aluminum foil rolling mill and the fault signal of the aluminum foil rolling mill and the primary detection normal signal of the aluminum foil rolling mill are obtained, the rolled aluminum foil size is processed based on the primary detection normal signal of the aluminum foil rolling mill, and the state of the aluminum foil rolling mill is identified.

title_en: Wire drawing process and processing device for outer surface of seamless stainless steel tube
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a drawing process and a processing device for the outer surface of a seamless stainless steel pipe, and aims to provide a drawing process and a processing device for the outer surface of the seamless stainless steel pipe, which are capable of preventing deformation of a steel pipe body and improving drawing efficiency and precision. The automatic wire drawing device comprises a base, wherein the base is connected with a fixed support, a moving seat and a pushing assembly, the moving seat and the pushing assembly are movably connected with the base, the moving seat is provided with two inner supporting rollers and moves relatively in the direction, a main bracket and a slave bracket are detachably connected to the fixed support, the main bracket is arranged between the two moving seats, the two sides of the two moving seats are respectively provided with the slave bracket, the wire drawing assembly and the waste collection assembly are detachably connected to the moving seats, the wire drawing assembly, the main bracket and the slave bracket are respectively provided with a pipe body connecting hole, an inner supporting roller is inserted into the pipe body connecting holes, and a cooling groove is formed in the moving seat. The beneficial effects of the utility model are as follows: the device is efficient and comprehensively wire-drawing; the structural loss is reduced; collecting the waste material immediately; the continuous production is convenient; the high strength ensures that the steel pipe body is not deformed.

title_en: Manufacturing method of thin-wall tube type heat exchanger requiring postweld heat treatment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the manufacture of a thin-wall tube type heat exchanger, and discloses a manufacturing method of the thin-wall tube type heat exchanger requiring postweld heat treatment, which comprises the following steps: determining the tolerance range of the tube plate opening through process trial production; decomposing a tube plate into tube plate sheets for modularized manufacturing so as to control the straightness of four sides of the tube plate by using a deformation prevention tool, reserving cutting gaps between adjacent tube plate sheets, and uniformly arranging lifting holes on the tube plate sheets; a horizontal stand on the assembly platform adopts a special adjustable supporting, adjusting and positioning tube plate; using a detachable process bearing pipe to assist in completing pipe penetration; sealing and welding the tube plates, preheating a proper number of tube holes in batches in different areas, sealing and welding, and performing split welding and flaw detection; and (3) carrying out heat treatment on the two end pipe plates subjected to seal welding by utilizing the local heat treatment tool, and cutting each deformation-preventing tool along the cutting gap. The device can control the straightness of the spot seam of the tube plate, meet the heat treatment requirement, control the heat treatment deformation, improve the production efficiency and ensure the processing quality.

title_en: Shaping device for orifice of high-pressure oil pipe
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of high-pressure oil pipe orifice shaping equipment, and particularly discloses a high-pressure oil pipe orifice shaping device which comprises a shaping device body and four supporting legs arranged at the bottom of the shaping device body, wherein a through groove is formed in the top of the shaping device body, storage mechanisms are slidably arranged at two ends of the inside of the through groove, a feeding mechanism is slidably arranged at the top of the shaping device body along the length direction, fixing mechanisms are slidably arranged at two ends of the top of the shaping device body, each fixing mechanism comprises a first mounting plate and a plurality of fixing sleeves, the first mounting plate is slidably arranged at one end of the top of the shaping device body, and the fixing sleeves are circumferentially arranged on one side outer wall of the first mounting plate. Through setting up fixed establishment, fixed establishment is at the in-process that fixed connector and oil pipe mouth were installed, and when the connector inserted inside high-pressure oil pipe, branch can support inside the oil pipe, prevents at the in-process of connector and oil pipe's installation, and oil pipe takes place to warp and influences installation effectiveness.

title_en: Automatic wire cutting, winding and stripping device for optical fiber array
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of optical fiber array production, and particularly relates to an automatic wire cutting, winding and stripping device for an optical fiber array. The aim is that: through the setting of cutting knife and wire stripping clip, after the wire winding of wire winding roller is accomplished to the optical fiber ribbon, the push-and-pull rod can inwards push away the cutting head, make wire stripping clip can block into the plastic sleeve at optical fiber ribbon both ends, simultaneously cut off the optical fiber ribbon that the structure is inside to be located from the middle part, follow the rotation of wire winding roller later, make the optical fiber ribbon that is cut off can be taken out from the structure of cutting, simultaneously the plastic sleeve of optical fiber ribbon head can be left in the structure of cutting by wire stripping clip, through above-mentioned structure, make the optical fiber ribbon after the wire winding is accomplished, can cut off the optical fiber head and carry out wire stripping operation simultaneously, the production process has been simplified, further improved production efficiency.

title_en: Quantitative cutting device and method for bead ring machining
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cutting devices and discloses a quantitative cutting device and a quantitative cutting method for processing a bead ring.

title_en: Die cutting machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a die cutting machine which comprises a frame, wherein the frame is used for providing support, a shell is arranged on the frame, a fixed plate and a limiting plate are arranged in the shell, an inlet is formed in a first end of the shell, an outlet is formed in a second end of the shell, and a discharging assembly is arranged on the first end of the shell; the embossing assembly is arranged on the shell and is close to the discharge end of the discharging assembly; the first driving component is arranged on the shell, and the output end of the first driving component is connected with the input ends of the discharging component and the embossing component; the stamping component is arranged on the discharge end of the embossing component, and the output end of the stamping component is arranged towards the second end of the shell; the second driving component is arranged on the shell, and the output end of the second driving component is connected with the stamping component; the guide assembly is arranged in the shell. The invention processes and treats through different components, and the die cutting machine can produce the cutlery boxes with different thickness and different structures, thereby meeting different requirements.

title_en: Integrated platform of combined clamp element and assembly thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an integrated platform of a combined clamp element and a component thereof, which comprise two conveyor belts and a baffle plate arranged on the outer sides of the conveyor belts, wherein a plurality of groups of support rods are arranged between the two conveyor belts, limiting grooves are formed in the inner sides of the conveyor belts, the end parts of the support rods are connected with the conveyor belts through limiting components, and a push rod is fixedly arranged on one side surface, close to the support rods, of the baffle plate; through the cooperation of bracing piece and roof for the bracing piece that hangs can rotate to the state parallel with the conveyer belt, at this in-process, the bracing piece that is connected originally with the conveyer belt also rotates 180 for the slide bar, thereby compress the wind spring, after follow-up this bracing piece breaks away from with the conveyer belt, can drive the stopper through the wind spring and rotate, make the third inclined plane on the stopper cooperate with the baffle, utilize this structure, can overturn it at the in-process of carrying the work piece, be favorable to the workman to process its another side.

title_en: Filling material for improving copper-aluminum welding performance and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of brazing materials, in particular to a filling material for improving copper-aluminum welding performance and a preparation method thereof, wherein the filling material for improving copper-aluminum welding performance comprises a three-layer structure: the outer layer, the inner layer and the brazing flux layer are sequentially arranged from outside to inside; the brazing flux layer is a cylinder with a conical bottom end 1.5-2 mm high; the outer layer completely wraps the inner layer, the outer layer is wound around the periphery of the brazing flux layer to be smaller than the brazing flux layer, and the lower part is wound to at least half of the conical part of the brazing flux layer by taking top alignment as a standard; the outer layer is silver-zinc alloy; the inner layer is tin-bismuth alloy; the brazing flux layer comprises an epoxy resin layer and a solid brazing flux wire, and the epoxy resin layer wraps the solid brazing flux wire. The melting point of the filler material for improving the copper-aluminum welding performance is below the liquidus temperature of the aluminum plate base metal, the joint has higher tensile strength, the risk of secondary oxidation of the aluminum plate base metal can be prevented in the brazing process, and in addition, the use method of the filler material is simple.

title_en: Forming die for processing new energy automobile longitudinal beam and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a forming die for processing a longitudinal beam of a new energy automobile and a use method thereof, and relates to the technical field of dies. The invention solves the problems that the longitudinal beam is inconvenient to be quickly demolded, the manufacturing efficiency of the longitudinal beam by a die is affected, and the practicability of the die is reduced.

title_en: Motor housing processing frock
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of motor shell machining tools, in particular to a motor shell machining tool which comprises a fixed seat, wherein two groups of support frames are symmetrically and fixedly arranged on one side of the fixed seat, a bearing sleeve is movably arranged in each support frame, a fixing component for fixing a motor shell is arranged on one side of the bearing sleeve, and the fixing component comprises: the transmission shaft rotates to be connected with the socket, rotates to install at epaxial fly leaf of transmission, fixed mounting is at the clamp plate of transmission shaft tip, and spacing, clamp plate movable mounting is in spacing, and the activity is pegged graft two sets of first guide pillars on spacing, and first guide pillar fixed mounting is in spacing, and the cover is established the first spring on first guide pillar, and fixed subassembly not only can be spacing to motor housing, and the staff can overturn the motor housing under the not motor housing circumstances of dismantling simultaneously, saves the time of installing and dismantling motor housing to motor housing machining efficiency has been improved.

title_en: Anti-falling fine adjustment gasket suitable for installation on rail separation surface and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-falling fine-tuning gasket suitable for being installed on a rail separation surface and a use method thereof, wherein the gasket comprises the following components: the first adjusting area, the second adjusting area, the screw positioning area and the perforation area; one end of the screw positioning area is integrally connected with the perforation area; one side of the screw positioning area is integrally connected with the first adjusting area; the other side of the screw positioning area is integrally connected with the second adjusting area. The invention effectively solves the problem of floating of the gasket, realizes the control of the surplus of the separating surface, and ensures the long-term reliable and safe operation of astronauts and aircraft movement equipment.

title_en: Production method of high-hardness high-elongation cold-rolled austenitic stainless steel strip
abstract_en: The invention relates to a production method of a stainless steel belt, in particular to a production method of a high-hardness high-elongation cold-rolled austenitic stainless steel belt. The method selects high silicon molybdenum SUS301 or 301 austenitic stainless steel strips added with silicon molybdenum as raw materials, and the hardness of the finished stainless steel strips is HV430-470, the elongation is larger than or equal to 15%, and the fatigue times are larger than or equal to 100 ten thousand after primary rolling, primary cleaning, solution treatment, secondary rolling, secondary cleaning and withdrawal straightening. Therefore, the stainless steel strip prepared by the method has high hardness, high elongation and no limitation on the application range. Meanwhile, the stainless steel strip prepared by the method meets the requirements of high hardness and high elasticity, and meanwhile, higher fatigue times are obtained, so that the service life of the stainless steel strip is greatly prolonged.

title_en: Universal upper die device for magnetic circuit part roll riveting
abstract_en: The invention provides a general upper die device for magnetic circuit part roll riveting, which comprises an upper die base; the upper die base is provided with two roller fixing blocks capable of moving transversely relatively, rollers are sleeved in the roller fixing blocks, the rollers are locked and limited through locking blocks, first screws are installed on the upper die base at positions on the side surfaces of two sides of the rollers in a penetrating mode, the inner ends of the first screws are abutted against the side walls of the roller fixing blocks, and standard nuts are arranged on the first screws at positions on the outer walls of the upper die base; the lower end surface edge of the roller is of a chamfer angle inclined surface structure. According to the invention, the relative positions of the roller fixing blocks at two sides can be adjusted and locked according to the magnetic circuit parts with different diameters, so that the rolling riveting of the magnetic circuit parts with different diameters can be realized, the defect that the special upper die device is required to be designed for the outer diameters of the magnetic circuit parts is avoided, and the design and manufacturing cost is greatly saved.

title_en: Detection device, series welding machine and detection method for battery series welding effect
abstract_en: The application relates to a detection device, a series welding machine and a detection method of battery series welding effect. The detection device comprises a base, a detection assembly, a picking and placing assembly and a stirring assembly, wherein the base is used for placing a battery string, the picking and placing assembly is used for transferring the battery string on the base into a detection area of the detection assembly, the detection assembly is arranged on the base and used for detecting the position of a welding problem in the battery string, and the stirring assembly is used for stirring a welding strip positioned at the position of the welding problem. The stirring assembly comprises a first stirring piece and a second stirring piece, when the battery string is located in the detection area of the detection assembly, the first stirring piece and the second stirring piece can stir the welding strips on two sides of the thickness direction of the battery piece so as to judge the specific positions of the welding problems in the welding strips on two sides of the thickness direction of the battery piece, and if the welding strips are displaced, the welding problems exist.

title_en: Automatic welding device for building steel structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of steel structure welding processing, in particular to an automatic welding device for a building steel structure, which comprises a placing table for placing I-steel, wherein the placing table consists of a placing plate and automatic clamping blocks which are symmetrically arranged at the upper end of the placing plate in front-back mode, and a fixed clamping mechanism and a rotary welding mechanism are arranged between the upper ends of the automatic clamping blocks. The invention utilizes the fixed clamping mechanism to realize synchronous clamping and fixing of the triangular connecting pieces which are bilaterally symmetrical, is different from the traditional manual supporting triangular connecting pieces for welding, effectively avoids position errors caused by instability in the manual supporting triangular connecting piece process, ensures stable and accurate butt joint of the subsequent triangular connecting pieces and I-steel, ensures accurate and uniform relative welding positions of the triangular connecting pieces on the left side and the right side, and greatly improves welding precision and steel structure prefabricated member forming quality.

title_en: Gear honing robot with controllable grinding force
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gear honing robot with controllable grinding force, which relates to the technical field of gear manufacturing and comprises a six-axis industrial robot, wherein the six-axis industrial robot comprises a mechanical arm, a six-dimensional force sensor is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the mechanical arm through a bolt, a servo spindle is movably arranged at the bottom end of the mechanical arm, a honing cutter is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the servo spindle through a bolt, a gear workpiece to be machined is movably connected with the honing cutter, and a servo turntable is arranged below the gear workpiece to be machined. According to the invention, the accurate grinding processing of the gear is realized by accurately controlling the cutting force in the gear honing process, so that the gear honing process is safer, more stable and controllable, the industrial robot monitors the stress condition of the tail end main shaft in real time through the force sensor and adjusts the motion track and the tool posture of the industrial robot so as to ensure the processing quality and the processing precision, and the mechanical manual gear honing technology can not only greatly reduce the cost of processing equipment, but also improve the processing precision and the processing efficiency of the gear.

title_en: Method for improving five-axis positioning measurement precision based on-machine measurement technology
