abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving five-axis positioning measurement precision based on an on-machine measurement technology, which comprises the steps of creating a common reference and a measured element reference on a model to be processed, and constructing workpiece position compensation of the measured element by using the common reference and the measured element reference, and measuring the measured element based on the workpiece position compensation so as to reduce measurement errors among the measured elements, which are affected by machine tool compound errors, and improve measurement accuracy. The method can improve the five-axis positioning measurement precision, improve the processing yield, has wide application range, supports multiple types of machine tools, reduces manual participation, reduces error rate, improves user executability and standardizes operation steps.

title_en: Mechanical interlocking type timber double-end perforating tenoning machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mechanical interlocking type timber double-end perforating tenoning machine, which comprises a cabinet body, a base fixedly arranged on the base, a gap reserved between the cabinet body and the base, a traversing plate movably arranged on the base and connected with traversing driving mechanisms arranged in the gap, wherein the base and the traversing plate are respectively provided with a group of clamping and fixing mechanisms, the traversing driving mechanisms are used for driving the traversing plate to move on the base so that two groups of clamping and fixing mechanisms are respectively positioned at two ends of timber, and a transmission mechanism is connected between the two groups of clamping and fixing mechanisms so that the two groups of clamping and fixing mechanisms can synchronously clamp the two ends of the timber.

title_en: Production process of electronic booster
abstract_en: The invention provides a production process of an electronic booster, which comprises the following steps: feeding materials for inspection, and if the materials are unqualified, placing unqualified products into a defective product rotating box; transferring the qualified products to a first assembly station, and assembling the qualified products to form a plurality of first semi-finished products; after quality inspection is carried out on the plurality of first semi-finished products respectively, transferring the qualified first semi-finished products to a second assembly station for secondary assembly to form second semi-finished products; and (5) performing quality inspection on the second semi-finished product before warehousing, packaging if the second semi-finished product is qualified, and warehousing after marking the second semi-finished product as a qualified product. The invention is used for realizing batch and standardized production according to the production process when the electronic booster is produced, and improving the production efficiency and the production quality.

title_en: Spiral rapid pear-shaped rope sleeve and manufacturing device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of steel wire rope connectors and discloses a spiral rapid pear-shaped rope sleeve and a manufacturing device.

title_en: Spiral rapid pear-shaped rope sleeve and manufacturing device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of steel wire rope connectors, and discloses a spiral rapid pear-shaped rope sleeve and a manufacturing device, which comprises a shell, wherein a cavity formed in the shell is conical, two connecting lugs are symmetrically arranged at the top end of the shell, a connector is arranged in the shell and comprises an upper half part and a lower half part, the upper half part and the lower half part are both of a truncated cone structure with the diameter of the upper top surface being larger than that of the lower bottom surface, a plurality of first spiral grooves are uniformly distributed on the outer side wall of the lower half part, the top surface equipartition of lower half is provided with a plurality of first horizontal grooves corresponding with first helicla flute, and the one end and the first helicla flute of first horizontal groove are connected, and the bottom of upper half is provided with a plurality of second horizontal grooves with first horizontal groove assorted, and the one end that the second horizontal groove inwards is connected with vertical and runs through the first through-hole of upper half, and the top of through-hole one is connected with the third horizontal groove that sets up the top surface of upper half, and the third horizontal groove extends to the upper half lateral wall, is connected with the second helicla flute that the upper half lateral wall set up.

title_en: Installation process of large-sized shielding motor stator bottom cover bolt
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mounting process of a stator bottom cover bolt of a large-sized shielding motor, in particular to the field of stator bottom cover bolts, which comprises the following steps: a. installing a bottom cover bolt and measuring an initial length; b. the bottom cover bolt applies an initial moment; c. heating the bottom cover bolt; d. the bottom cap bolt elongation was evaluated. The invention reduces the knocks and grinding injuries of the bottom cover stud in the installation process and reduces the installation difficulty of the bottom cover stud. Meanwhile, the elongation of each bottom cover bolt is accurately controlled, the pretightening force of all the bottom cover bolts is ensured to be consistent, and the assembly quality of the bottom cover bolts is improved.

title_en: Reinforced wood and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reinforced wood and a preparation method thereof, wherein the reinforced wood comprises a delignified wood fiber framework and regenerated plant fibers, gaps of the wood fiber framework are filled and bonded by the regenerated plant fibers, and the wood fiber framework and the filled regenerated plant fibers are tightly crosslinked with each other to form a compact microstructure. The preparation method comprises the following steps: immersing wood in an etching solution for pretreatment to obtain a first intermediate; immersing the first intermediate into a plant fiber solution for perfusion treatment to obtain a second intermediate; taking out the second intermediate, shaping and drying, cleaning with water, and drying to obtain the reinforced wood. The method solves the problem of how to reinforce the wood by using the plant fiber, fully plays the filling and crosslinking roles of the regenerated cellulose based on the etching step, realizes the purpose of greatly improving the mechanical strength of the wood by using the plant fiber solution, and has better application prospect.

title_en: Self-feeding type laser cutting machine for batch processing of precise metals
abstract_en: The invention discloses a laser cutting machine for self-feeding type precise metal batch processing, which belongs to the technical field of laser cutting machines and comprises a support frame, wherein a driving roller is arranged on the inner side of the support frame, a plurality of driving rollers are uniformly distributed on the inner side of the support frame at equal intervals, a servo motor is fixedly connected to the inner part of a transverse plate, a driving screw rod is fixedly connected to the output end of the servo motor, a moving rod is arranged on the driving screw rod, and the lower end of the moving rod is fixedly connected with a laser cutting head; further comprises: the front side and the rear side of the lower end of the transverse plate are fixedly connected with pressing rods, limiting blocks are arranged on the inner sides of the lower ends of the pressing rods, and the limiting blocks are fixed at the upper ends of the correction plates. This from laser cutting machine for precision metal batch processing of pay-off can conveniently carry out automatic correction to the panel of waiting to cut after the pay-off, can protect the laser head simultaneously, causes light pollution when avoiding the laser head cutting, can filter the emission to the smoke and dust that produces when laser cutting simultaneously.

title_en: Fine grinding equipment for ceramic product production
abstract_en: The invention relates to fine grinding equipment for ceramic product production, which comprises a support frame, a first guide rod, a second guide rod, a placing frame, an air cylinder, a side support, an inner polishing mechanism, an outer polishing mechanism, an end surface polishing mechanism and a clamping mechanism, wherein the first guide rod and the second guide rod penetrate through the support frame, the placing frame is fixedly arranged on the first guide rod and the second guide rod, one end of the air cylinder is fixedly arranged on the support frame, the other end of the air cylinder is fixedly arranged on the placing frame, the side support is fixedly arranged on the support frame, the inner polishing mechanism is arranged on the side support, the outer polishing mechanism is arranged on the inner polishing mechanism, the end surface polishing mechanism is arranged on the side support, and the clamping mechanism is arranged on the placing frame. The invention realizes polishing of the inner surface, the outer surface and the end surface of the electronic ceramic simultaneously, and has comprehensive polishing and high polishing efficiency.

title_en: XPS heated board extrusion equipment and extrusion line
abstract_en: The invention discloses XPS insulation board extrusion equipment and an extrusion production line, which comprise a primary feeding belt, a secondary feeding belt, a cooling assembly and a supporting assembly, wherein the supporting assembly comprises a movable roller which is rotatably arranged, a pointed part is arranged on the circumference of the movable roller to form a supporting groove, the movable roller is driven to rotate so that the pointed part sequentially supports against the lower part of a material, and a cutting knife which keeps driven to keep vertical reciprocating movement. According to the XPS insulation board extrusion equipment and the extrusion production line, the material is cooled by the cooling component to reduce the elasticity of the material, and the pointed parts of the movable rollers are propped against the two sides of the cutting point of the material by the cutting knife, so that the traditional cutting mode of mutually approaching the cutting knife and the surface is changed into a mode that the cutting knife is vertically cut downwards, the two sides of the cutting position of the cutting knife are material supporting points, and the problem that the cutting surface is uneven due to deformation caused by extrusion of the upper side and the lower side of the cutting point of the material during cutting is avoided.

title_en: Strip steel size judging method and system based on rule configuration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a strip steel size judging method and system based on rule configuration, wherein the method comprises the following steps: extracting original data from a raw material table and a production performance table of a production process control system; judging whether the steel coil is produced according to the original data; if the steel coil production is completed, screening out the actually measured value of the dimension of each point in the length direction of the strip steel from the dimension detection device; calculating to obtain the deviation between the measured dimension value and the dimension preset value by combining the dimension preset value of each point in the length direction of the strip steel; configuring a size judgment rule of a continuous rolling mill set in a cold rolling centralized control management platform; and based on the deviation, judging the data of different steel grades according to the size judgment rule. Thickness data and abnormal data of different strip steel in the length direction are accurately marked on the cold rolling centralized control management platform in a visual flexible configuration mode, so that quality information of the strip steel can be tracked better, and production quality of steel coils is guaranteed.

title_en: Heat pipe processing method
abstract_en: The application relates to a heat pipe processing method, which comprises the following steps: selecting a long tube; one end of the long tube is connected with the vacuumizing device, liquid working medium is injected into the long tube, non-condensable gas is discharged, and the vertical height of the long tube connected with one end of the vacuumizing device is lower; clamping and sealing one end of the long tube far away from the vacuumizing device; starting a vacuumizing device to suck liquid working medium in the long tube, and enabling the liquid level of the working medium in the long tube to be reduced to a first preset height; clamping and sealing the first preset position of the long tube; pinching off the long tube from the first preset position; starting the vacuumizing device to continuously suck the liquid working medium in the long tube, and enabling the liquid level of the working medium in the long tube to be reduced to a second preset height; clamping and sealing a second preset position of the long tube; pinching off the long tube from the second preset position; and so on until the fabrication of the desired number of heat pipes is completed. The heat pipe processing method provided by the application solves the problem of lower processing efficiency of the heat pipe manufacturing method.

title_en: Quick replacing method for sintering circular cooler trolley
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of overhauling and replacing spare parts of sintering circular coolers, and particularly discloses a rapid replacing method of a trolley of a sintering circular cooler. The trolley shafts on two sides are cut off by using an oxygen blowing rod to melt and cut the trolley shafts; generating 3600 ℃ high temperature by using an oxygen blowing rod, axially punching a long shaft section of the trolley shaft, then locally cooling water, and taking out the trolley shaft by utilizing the principle of thermal expansion and contraction of the trolley shaft; the positioning and the transporting of the trolley shaft waste and the hydraulic jack are realized by means of the special lifting tool, the problem of difficulty in repeated displacement of the hydraulic jack is solved, the quick separation of the trolley shaft and the trolley and the quick and efficient replacement of the trolley are realized, and the method is convenient and practical, can greatly reduce the working time, reduce the maintenance links and reduce the safety risk.

title_en: Automatic feeding and discharging device for right-angle connector machining
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic feeding and discharging device for right-angle joint machining, which comprises a frame, wherein a clamping rotary host machine is arranged on a top plate of the frame, the right end of a rotating shaft of the clamping rotary host machine extends out of the clamping rotary host machine and is fixedly provided with a centering clamping jaw, an upper support frame is arranged on the top plate of the frame, a transverse moving mechanism is fixedly arranged on the upper part of the upper support frame, a vertical supporting rod is fixedly arranged on the bottom surface of a transverse moving block of the transverse moving mechanism, a vertical lifting mechanism is fixedly arranged on the vertical supporting rod, and a grabbing rotary cylinder is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of a vertical grabbing rod of the vertical lifting mechanism; the clamping device can automatically grab and place right-angle connectors on the discharging template on the centering clamping jaw of the clamping rotary main machine, the centering clamping jaw of the clamping rotary main machine is convenient to clamp and fix and process, and meanwhile, the machined right-angle connectors can be grabbed and placed in the discharging chute body to discharge, so that the discharging chute body is convenient to assemble and disassemble, the machining efficiency is greatly improved, and the manual labor is reduced.

title_en: Ball valve core polishing equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses ball valve core polishing equipment which comprises a supporting frame, a driving device, a first telescopic device, a first polishing device, a second telescopic device and a second polishing device, wherein the supporting frame comprises a supporting frame, a supporting table, a sleeve and a supporting disc, and the supporting table is arranged on the supporting frame; the sleeve is vertically and fixedly arranged on the supporting table, and the bottom end of the sleeve penetrates through the supporting table; the supporting disc is sleeved on the sleeve and fixedly connected with the supporting table; the driving device is arranged in the sleeve in a lifting and moving manner; the first telescopic device is arranged on the supporting frame. From this, can carry out polishing to the inside and outside surface of ball valve case simultaneously, not only shortened polishing time, promoted production efficiency, alleviateed the manual work burden moreover, reduced use cost, ensured the smoothness and the uniformity on case surface simultaneously, in addition, this equipment can also be applicable to multiple not unidimensional case, has the advantage that accommodation is wide.

title_en: Auxiliary positioning device for welding mechanical pipe fitting
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mechanical pipe fitting welding auxiliary positioning device, which relates to the technical field of auxiliary positioning and comprises a working table plate, wherein a working frame is arranged at the top end of the working table plate, the working frame and the working table plate are of rectangular structures, and a welding mechanism comprises an electric push rod and a mounting block, the electric push rod is arranged in the middle of the top end of the working frame, and the mounting block is arranged at the bottom end of the electric push rod. When two pipe fittings are welded, opposite ends of the two pipe fittings extend to two sides of the inside of the working frame and are fixed by the movable fixing mechanism, the pipe fittings are driven to move by the movable mechanism after the pipe fittings are fixed, the welding mechanism is started to weld after the pipe fittings are moved, the reinforcing mechanism is triggered by the welding mechanism, and the stability of the welding rod in the use process is improved.

title_en: Adjustable fixture positioning pin structure and adjusting method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an adjustable clamp positioning pin structure, which comprises a supporting bottom plate, wherein the supporting bottom plate is horizontal; the bottom of the movable plate is attached to the supporting bottom plate, and the top of the movable plate is vertically provided with a positioning pin; the length direction of the transverse strip is X direction; the length direction of the longitudinal strip is Y-direction, an adjusting space is formed between the transverse strip and the inner side of the longitudinal strip, and the movable plate is movably positioned in the adjusting space; the first adjusting mechanism is used for adjusting the distance between the movable plate and the transverse strip, and the second adjusting mechanism is used for adjusting the distance between the movable plate and the longitudinal strip. The adjustable fixture locating pin structure provided by the invention can improve the product qualification rate.

title_en: Multifunctional circular sawing machine
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of cutting equipment, and particularly relates to a multifunctional circular sawing machine, wherein a fixing device and a conveying device are matched to automatically move and fix materials to be cut when the multifunctional circular sawing machine is used, so that labor-saving operation is realized in the use process of the circular sawing machine, the manual load is greatly lightened, the whole operation of the circular sawing machine is simpler, the machining efficiency of the circular sawing machine is improved, the friction between the materials and a vertical roller wheel can be increased, meanwhile, the interference on the materials when the materials move left and right can be avoided, a limiting component can be used for determining the length of the materials to be cut, a control panel can control the conveying device and the limiting component, and the cooperation of a pressure sensor and a controller panel can prevent the materials from interfering a positioning plate on the right side to generate offset when the materials move rightwards, so that the cutting precision of the circular sawing machine is improved.

title_en: Adsorption pad
abstract_en: An adsorption pad (10) is provided with a pad body (12) having a negative pressure chamber (16) and a plurality of connection passages (18) communicating with the negative pressure chamber, and a sponge member (20) having a plurality of hollow portions (22) opening toward a workpiece. The hollow portion communicates with the negative pressure chamber via a connection passage, and a flow path adjusting valve (26) for adjusting the flow path area is disposed in the connection passage. The adsorption pad is provided with a pressure detection port (50) for detecting the pressure of one or more hollow parts among the plurality of hollow parts.

title_en: Polishing equipment and method for forklift driving axle housing machining
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of processing of driving axle housings, in particular to polishing equipment and a method for processing the forklift driving axle housings, which comprise a supporting bench group, wherein the upper ends of supporting benches of the supporting bench group are respectively provided with a sliding rail, the surfaces of the two sliding rails are respectively connected with a rotating mechanism in a sliding way, the upper end of rotary mechanism has placed the transaxle shell, and the intermediate position protrusion department laminating of transaxle shell has grinding machanism, and supporting bench one side of supporting bench group is provided with the arm, and the end and the upper end centre gripping of grinding machanism of arm are connected. This equipment of polishing, through setting up grinding machanism, the protruding position of circular cover complete adaptation transaxle housing, when the arm drove circular cover high-speed rotation, use cheaper abrasive paper to polish, abrasive paper easily makes into the shape with circular cover looks adaptation simultaneously, the spherical structure of abrasive paper has reduced the time of polishing of the protruding position in the middle of the transaxle housing when not changing the effect of polishing, has promoted polishing efficiency, still is convenient for simultaneously to the change of the abrasive paper of making a jam.

title_en: Auxiliary tool for repairing composite insulator umbrella skirt damage
abstract_en: The application relates to an auxiliary tool for repairing the damage of a composite insulator umbrella skirt, which comprises a base, wherein the base is provided with a guide rod; the fixed stamping die is arranged on the base; the operating handle is movably arranged on the guide rod; the movable stamping die is connected to the operating handle, the movable stamping die is opposite to the fixed stamping die at intervals and surrounds a punching station, the punching station is used for installing the standby insulator umbrella skirt, and the movable stamping die and the fixed stamping die move relatively to punch the standby insulator umbrella skirt to form the repair insulator umbrella skirt. The auxiliary tool of the scheme can replace hands to complete automatic punching of the umbrella skirt of the standby insulator, is time-saving and labor-saving, is high in cutting efficiency, can obtain very high cutting precision by means of rigid matching and guiding of the guide rod, the movable die and the fixed die, reduces or even eliminates cutting phenomenon, avoids material loss and reduces repair operation cost.

title_en: Cast rod peeler
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of cast rod processing, in particular to a cast rod peeling machine, which comprises a working frame, wherein a feeding component is arranged on one side of the working frame, a pair of receiving rollers are rotatably arranged in the working frame, and an output motor is arranged at the end part of each receiving roller; when the cast rod peeling machine is used, the cast rod is supported by the pair of supporting rollers, and the pair of supporting rollers are arranged to rotate in opposite directions, so that the cast rod is driven to roll at a high speed, an oxide layer on the surface of the cast rod is thrown out when the cast rod rolls, and the oxide layer is crushed when the surface of the cast rod contacts with the surface of the supporting rollers; further thrown out; when the surface of the casting rod is uneven, the bearing roller can drive the casting rod to roll, and oscillation fluctuation is generated during the rolling, and an oxide layer on the surface rapidly drops off due to the oscillation; therefore, the peeling treatment can be fully carried out on the surface of the casting rod through the action of the pair of receiving rollers, and the peeling effect cannot be influenced when the surface of the casting rod is uneven.

title_en: Method for replacing cylindrical roller bearing of gear box
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for replacing a cylindrical roller bearing of a gear box, belongs to the technical field of bearing disassembly, and solves the problems that the working efficiency is low and the production efficiency is affected due to the lack of a quick replacement method of the bearing; the method comprises the following steps: placing a plurality of disassembly pieces in gaps between the inner ring and the outer ring of the bearing, synchronously and equidirectionally rotating bolts on the disassembly pieces, and taking out the outer ring after the disassembly pieces drive the outer ring to loosen; and (3) abutting the bulges of the disassembly pieces with the flanges of the inner ring, taking out the inner ring after the disassembly pieces drive the inner ring to loosen, and then taking out the damaged bearing and replacing the new bearing. The invention greatly shortens the bearing replacement and maintenance time, reduces the maintenance cost, and has the advantages of strong practicability, convenient maintenance, simple dismounting structure and good use effect.

title_en: Forging equipment and method for producing and processing wind power gear box die forging
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of forging, in particular to forging equipment and a method for producing and processing a wind power gear box die forging, aiming at the problems that extrusion friction is easily generated between a die and the inner wall of a positioning device when the die is repeatedly subjected to impact forging, the generated extrusion friction easily causes the position deviation of the die to move and simultaneously causes irreversible damage to the positioning device, so that workers are required to continuously take and position the die, the labor intensity of the workers is increased, and the use is limited. The forging equipment and the forging method for producing and processing the wind power gear box die forging disclosed by the invention have the effects of reducing extrusion friction generated between the die and the inner wall of the positioning device, quickly rebounding when the cover plate die is deviated so as to return to the central position again, avoiding the repositioning of workers, reducing the labor capacity of the workers and avoiding the damage to the positioning device caused by the deviated thrust.

title_en: Bacterial strain capable of degrading PBAT plastic at normal temperature and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an Aspergillus niger F2 capable of efficiently degrading PBAT at normal temperature, which is classified as Aspergillus niger (Aspergillus niger) and preserved in China general microbiological culture collection center (CGMCC) with the addresses of North Star Xiyu No. 1, 3 in the Chaoyang area of Beijing city, CGMCC No.40926 and the preservation time of 2023, 11 months and 17 days. According to the measurement, the degradation rate of the Aspergillus niger F2 on the PBAT film is 63% after 56 days of degradation at 20-25 ℃, and the degradation rate of the PBAT powder can reach 63% after 10 days and 91% after 30 days. The Aspergillus niger F2 degradation PBAT plastic has the advantages of high efficiency, simplicity, convenience, low cost and environmental protection, and has great application potential in the aspect of PBAT agricultural film degradation.

title_en: Workpiece self-propelled and self-rotating shot blasting machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-propelled and self-rotating workpiece shot blasting machine which is technically characterized by comprising a shot blasting chamber, a transmission mechanism, a carrying mechanism and an auxiliary mechanism, wherein a plurality of shot blasters are arranged in the shot blasting chamber and used for throwing shots to workpieces passing through the shot blasting chamber, the transmission mechanism is used for driving the workpieces to pass through the shot blasting chamber, the plurality of shot blasters are respectively arranged above two sides of the transmission mechanism and obliquely throw the shots downwards towards the workpieces on the transmission mechanism, the carrying mechanism is provided with a plurality of carrying mechanisms and is arranged on the transmission mechanism, the workpieces are fixed on the carrying mechanism, and the carrying mechanism entering the shot blasting chamber can rotate around a vertical axis through the arrangement of the carrying mechanism and the auxiliary mechanism, so that all parts of the workpieces can be uniformly exposed under the shot blasters on two sides of the transmission mechanism, and all parts of the workpieces can be uniformly treated.

title_en: Intelligent wheel turnover machine and turnover method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of rail transit wheel processing and manufacturing, and discloses an intelligent wheel turnover machine, which comprises an upright post, a cross beam, a lifting mechanism, a traversing mechanism, a clamping mechanism, a turnover mechanism and a control system, wherein: the upright posts are arranged on the ground at two sides of the wheel transfer line and support the whole device; the cross beam is arranged at the top of the upright post and used for installing the transverse moving mechanism and providing a transverse moving space; the lifting mechanism is fixed on the transverse moving mechanism to realize lifting motion in the vertical direction; the transverse moving mechanism horizontally moves left and right on the cross beam to drive the wheels to reach a preset position; the clamping mechanism is arranged below the mounting plate of the lifting mechanism and used for clamping the wheels; the turnover mechanism is arranged on the clamping mechanism to realize turnover operation of the wheels; the control system controls the motion and logic judgment of the whole device. The description also discloses a wheel overturning method of the overturning machine, which can clamp, loosen, lift, overturn and transversely move the wheels conveniently and efficiently.

title_en: Apparatus and method for repairing warp value of substrate
abstract_en: The invention discloses equipment and a method for repairing warp value of a substrate, comprising a support frame, a displacement table, a sensor, a laser engraving head and a central control system; the support frame is used for installing the sensor and the laser engraving head; the upper end of the displacement table is provided with a bearing surface, the bearing surface is suitable for placing a substrate, the bearing surface can move along a first direction and a second direction of the equipment, and the first direction is intersected with the second direction; the sensor is adapted to detect a warp value of the substrate; the laser engraving head is suitable for engraving the substrate; the central control system is used for receiving and processing data detected by the sensor, controlling the work of the laser engraving head and controlling the movement of the displacement table in the first direction and/or the second direction. By arranging the sensor and the laser engraving head, the warp value of the substrate of the crystal bar after the multi-line cutting is finished can be detected and repaired, and the uniformity of the warp value of the substrate is improved, so that the problem that products are degraded or scrapped due to the fact that the warp value of the substrate is out of specification in the cutting process is solved.

title_en: Die holding cylinder for sheet die cutting machine
abstract_en: The mould-holding cylinder (1) comprises a surface (3) and engagement means, the surface (3) being provided with a plurality of internally threaded holes (4), the holes (4) assuming a grid layout formed by a plurality of rows and a plurality of lines in coordinate axes "X" and "Y", the engagement means being composed of a plurality of fastening assemblies (5), each fastening assembly having a retractable bolt (7) protruding from the surface of the cylinder (1) defining a geometric centre and a geometric axis, the bolts (7) being intended to be connected to a mould, wherein the geometric axes of the bolts (7) of the fastening assemblies (5) are positioned in such a way that: are respectively distributed between two internally threaded holes (4) and are axially aligned on a coordinate axis "X" passing through the two holes and are located at equal distances between said two holes (4).

title_en: Riveting device for automobile part production and processing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of automobile parts and discloses a riveting device for producing and processing automobile parts, which comprises a bottom plate and supporting legs, wherein a cleaning mechanism is arranged above the bottom plate and comprises a placing plate, a fixing frame, an electric fan, a mounting sleeve and an electric telescopic rod, wherein the bottom of the placing plate is fixedly connected with the top of the bottom plate, the bottom of the fixing frame is fixedly connected with the top of the bottom plate, one side of the fixing frame is fixedly connected with one end of the electric fan, the bottom of the fixing frame is fixedly connected with the top of the mounting sleeve, the inner wall of the mounting sleeve is fixedly connected with the outer wall of the electric telescopic rod, and one end of the electric telescopic rod is fixedly provided with a cleaning plate.

title_en: Modifier for stabilizing wood size and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a modifier for stabilizing the dimension of wood, which comprises, by mass, 7% -12% of magnesium chloride, 1% -2% of sodium hydroxide, 3% -5% of ethyl orthosilicate, 4% -7% of polyethylene glycol, 1% -1.5% of sodium lignin sulfonate and the balance of water, wherein the modifier for stabilizing the dimension of the wood is used for improving the dimension stability of the wood. The modifier for stabilizing the wood size adopts cheap raw materials, utilizes the synergistic effect of the raw materials, improves the effect of magnesium chloride on improving the wood size stability, and further obtains a modification application method with good stability and low cost.

title_en: Take initiative protection's digit control machine tool
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of numerically-controlled machine tools, and particularly discloses a numerically-controlled machine tool with active protection, which comprises a machine body, wherein an installation carriage and a base station are respectively arranged at two sides of the machine body, a three-jaw chuck is arranged on the installation carriage, and a moving table with a cutter disc is arranged on the base station; further comprises: the rotary driving mechanism is used for driving the three-jaw chuck to rotate; a disengaging mechanism for disengaging the rotary drive mechanism from the three-jaw chuck; and the splash-proof mechanism is used for wrapping the three-jaw chuck and the cutter head. When the cutter is collided, the slip ring slides into the induction zone of the inductor under the action of inertia to generate a trigger signal, the synchronous belt is immediately separated from the driving belt wheel through the separation mechanism, a torque transmission path between the driving motor and the three-jaw chuck is cut off, damage to the motor is avoided, the protective cover is triggered to be unfolded, the three-jaw chuck and the cutter disc are wrapped, splash generated by the cutter is prevented from threatening operators and other equipment, the protective response speed is high, and the protective performance is high.

title_en: Track traffic upset support welding position frock
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of overturning welding, in particular to a welding positioning tool for a rail transit overturning bracket, which comprises a main body plate, wherein the lower end of the main body plate is provided with a lifting moving mechanism, the lower end of the main body plate is symmetrically provided with first limiting grooves, the two first limiting grooves are respectively and slidably provided with a first connecting plate, the lower ends of the two first connecting plates are respectively and fixedly connected with a second connecting plate, the lower ends of the second connecting plates and the main body plate are provided with an overturning clamping mechanism for clamping and rotating a rail, and the center of the lower end of the main body plate is provided with a polishing welding mechanism for polishing and welding two sections of rails, so that the welding tool has the advantages that: the coincidence degree of the side surfaces of the rails at the joint can be measured through the numerical value of the pressure sensor, when the numerical value displayed by the pressure sensor is consistent, polishing is stopped, the side surfaces of the joints of the two rails are completely coincided at the moment, and the stability of welding seams at the joint during subsequent welding is ensured.

title_en: Guide joint forming equipment and endoscope production line
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of endoscopes, and discloses a guide joint forming device and an endoscope production line, wherein the guide joint forming device comprises: a base table; the invention provides a stamping unit, which comprises a bearing component, a first stamping component and a second stamping component, wherein the bearing component comprises a stamping internal mold, the first stamping component is provided with two first stamping structures, the second stamping component is provided with two second stamping structures, and a driving unit, the periphery of the stamping internal mold is respectively provided with the first stamping component and the second stamping component, after a connecting ring is placed at a stamping position, the two first stamping structures of the first stamping component and the two second stamping structures of the second stamping component can stamp four directions of the connecting ring simultaneously, and the connecting ring can form a required structure through one stamping process.

title_en: Circuit board semiconductor welding positioning device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a circuit board semiconductor welding positioning device, relates to the field of electric appliance welding, and solves the problem of fixing a special-shaped circuit board and the problem of double-sided soldering tin. The circuit board semiconductor welding positioning device comprises a fixed top plate, a host bottom plate, a hollow supporting rod, a special-shaped circuit board fixing mechanism and a second welding electric iron, wherein the special-shaped circuit board fixing mechanism further comprises a special-shaped working table surface, a side position fixing assembly, a reinforcing assembly and a reverse side soldering tin assembly, the reverse side soldering tin assembly is arranged at the bottom of the side position fixing assembly, the reverse side soldering tin assembly can simultaneously weld the reverse side of the circuit board, the reverse side soldering tin assembly comprises a first welding electric iron, the fixing effect of a semiconductor welded object is enhanced through the special-shaped circuit board fixing mechanism, the effect of the semiconductor welded object can be achieved, the fixing effect and the fixing effect of the special-shaped circuit board fixing mechanism are better compared with those of a sucker, and the special-shaped working table surface can bear larger impact force.

title_en: Automatic welding production line for T-beam bottom web plate
abstract_en: The application discloses an automatic welding production line for a T beam bottom web, which relates to the field of constructional engineering and comprises two support rods, wherein a cross rod is fixedly arranged between the tops of the two support rods through bolts, a fixed slide rail is arranged on the lower surface of the cross rod, a top plate is arranged on the fixed slide rail in a sliding manner, a welding mechanical arm is arranged on the lower surface of the top plate, a welding head is arranged at the end part of the welding mechanical arm, a placing table is symmetrically arranged under the cross rod, the welding head is positioned above the placing table, a plurality of limiting struts are fixed on the upper surfaces of the two placing tables, a bottom web stirrup is arranged between the plurality of limiting struts, a mounting frame is arranged on the cross rod, and the bottom end of the mounting frame is fixedly connected with the outer side of the upper surface of the top plate.

title_en: Metal cutting machine tool with multichannel spindle cooling mechanism
abstract_en: The application relates to a metal cutting machine tool with a multichannel main shaft cooling mechanism, which comprises a frame; the main shaft shell is arranged on the frame, and a motor stator is arranged on the inner side of the main shaft shell; the spindle is rotatably penetrated through the spindle shell, and a motor rotor matched with the motor stator is arranged on the outer side of the spindle; the cooling sleeve is fixedly sleeved on the mandrel, the cooling sleeve is positioned on the inner side of the motor rotor, the cooling sleeve is provided with cooling channels, liquid inlet channels and liquid outlet channels, the cooling channels are annular, a plurality of cooling channels are distributed along the axis of the mandrel, the cooling channels are not communicated with each other, the liquid inlet channels are communicated with the cooling channels, and the liquid outlet channels are communicated with the cooling channels; the inlet and outlet sleeve is sleeved on the mandrel and connected with the main shaft shell, and is provided with a liquid inlet channel and a liquid outlet channel which are communicated with each other. The application has the effect of more uniformly cooling the area where the mandrel is positioned in the stator and the rotor of the motor.

title_en: Repairing device, disassembling method and assembling method for filling machine clamp inflating head
abstract_en: The invention discloses a repairing device, a disassembling method and an assembling method of a filling machine clamp inflating head, wherein the repairing device of the filling machine clamp inflating head comprises the following components: base, dead lever, place platform and crimping device. The bottom placing platform is arranged at intervals with the fixed rod and is arranged at the top of the base. The placement platform comprises a fixed through hole and a drain region. The fixed through hole is arranged at the top of the placement platform and is used for placing the inflating head of the clamp of the liquid injection machine. The drain region is arranged at the bottom of the fixed through hole. The crimping device comprises a pressing piece and a driving device. The ejector pin extends along the first direction, is arranged at the other end of the crimping device along the second direction, and is arranged at the bottom. The thimble and the fixed through hole are correspondingly arranged along the first direction. The driving device is used for driving the ejector pin to move along a first direction relative to the placement platform, so that the ejector pin is inserted into the internal channel and abuts against the ejector pin, and the ejector pin is pressed down into the drain contact region.

title_en: Pulse light generating device, pulse light generating method, and processing device
abstract_en: The pulse light generating device comprises: a nonlinear optical crystal to which the 1 st pulse light emitted from the pulse light source is incident, and which emits the 2 nd pulse light having the wavelength converted 1 st pulse light; and a diffraction grating which is arranged on the travel path of the 2 nd pulse light emitted from the nonlinear optical crystal and emits the 3 rd pulse light in which the ratio of the variation of the output angle emitted from the nonlinear optical crystal to the variation of the frequency included in the frequency band of the incident pulse light is reduced for each frequency component of the pulse light.

title_en: Automatic dismounting machine for fatigue test of radio frequency connector
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic disassembling and assembling machine for a fatigue test of a radio frequency connector, which is characterized by comprising a structural base, a power device, a transmission device, a safety device and a control device, wherein the base comprises a shell, a fixed shaft, a motor cover plate and a front cover plate; the power device is a motor and provides motive power for the automatic dismounting machine system; the transmission device comprises a driving gear, a driven gear, a batch head, a safety wheel and a bearing transmission part, wherein the transmission system is a group of reduction gear sets, and high-rotation-speed and low-torque power provided by the motor is converted into low-rotation-speed and high-torque power; the safety device is a set of force-unloading wheel device and comprises a main wheel which independently rotates in the driven gear and a group of braking pins which are propped against the outline of the outer ring by springs; the control device is connected with the motor and controls the rotation direction of the connector nut by controlling the motor to rotate forwards and backwards. The invention solves the problem of the working efficiency of the automatic disassembly and assembly machine for fatigue test, and the automatic disassembly and assembly machine has the characteristics of compact structure, convenient operation, low cost, reliable quality and the like.

title_en: Method for manufacturing semiconductor device
abstract_en: The present embodiment relates to a method for manufacturing a semiconductor device. According to one embodiment, a method of manufacturing a semiconductor device is provided. The method for manufacturing a semiconductor device includes preparing a1 st substrate on which a plurality of two-dimensionally distributed convex portions are formed. A method for manufacturing a semiconductor device includes laminating a1 st film on a plurality of convex portions of a1 st substrate. A method for manufacturing a semiconductor device includes depositing a2 nd film on a2 nd substrate. The method for manufacturing a semiconductor device includes bonding a main surface on the opposite side of a1 st substrate in a1 st film to a main surface on the opposite side of a2 nd substrate in a2 nd film. A method for manufacturing a semiconductor device includes irradiating laser light from the 1 st substrate side. The method for manufacturing the semiconductor device comprises peeling the 1 st substrate. The diameter of the spot region of the laser light is larger than the average arrangement pitch of the projections on the main surface of the 1 st substrate.

title_en: Argon arc welding method for low-alloy high-strength steel end part and thin-wall rod pipe component
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of aeroengine welding, and relates to an argon arc welding method for low-alloy high-strength steel end parts and thin-wall rod pipe components, which aims at the problems that when the low-alloy high-strength steel thin-wall rod pipe components (wall thickness is less than or equal to 2 mm) and the end parts are subjected to argon arc welding, the components are excessive in welding seam metallurgical defects, low in hardness of a heat affected zone, out of tolerance in welding deformation and the like due to structural configuration, and adopts a mode of full-automatic argon arc welding without beveling, filling welding wires and adopting a part self-locking bottom structure, so that the assembly gap of the components to be welded is ensured, the part dislocation is reduced, after positioning welding, the automatic argon arc welding technological parameters are precisely regulated, the copper sleeve is assisted for heat exchange cooling, and the qualification rate of related products is greatly improved. The welding seam cracks of the components are effectively eliminated, the metallurgical quality of the welding seam is greatly improved, the welding manufacturability is good, the mechanical property of the joint meets the design requirement, and the product percent of pass is greatly improved.

title_en: Extrusion filter for fine chemical production
abstract_en: The invention discloses an extrusion filter for fine chemical production, which comprises an extruder, wherein an outer pipe body is sleeved outside the extruder, a cold air clamping cavity is formed between the outer pipe body and the extruder, a bulk material dredging mechanism is arranged in the extruder and close to a discharging pipe, and the bulk material dredging mechanism sprays air in the cold air clamping cavity to the discharging pipe; the feeding pipe is provided with a pre-separation mechanism. The invention relates to the technical field of fine chemical engineering, which adopts a pre-separation mechanism to centrifugally separate, extrude and separate chemical materials before entering an extruder, wherein the pretreated chemical materials can be directly put into the extruder for use. Simultaneously, the temperature of the extruder in the extrusion process can be reduced by cooling the extruder through the cold air clamping cavity, and chemical material micro-reaction is avoided. Meanwhile, the bulk cargo dredging mechanism can directly convey cold air into the extruder, and can loosen the caking chemical materials at the discharge pipe when the chemical materials are directly cooled.

title_en: Plastic product production equipment for producing composite plastic
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of plastic product production, in particular to plastic product production equipment for producing composite plastic, which comprises a machine table, a plurality of conveying rollers and an inflation assembly, wherein one side of the machine table is rotationally connected with a bidirectional screw rod, the other side of the machine table is fixedly connected with a fixing rod, two hot pressing assemblies are arranged between the bidirectional screw rod and the fixing rod, each hot pressing assembly comprises a hot pressing frame, two sides of the hot pressing frame are fixedly connected with sliding blocks, the two sliding blocks are respectively connected with the fixing rod and the bidirectional screw rod, the two sliding blocks are connected with sliding rods through first springs, and each sliding rod is fixedly connected with an ear plate and a hot pressing plate. The invention can carry out continuous hot pressing, inflating and sealing treatment on the packaging plastic film, and has better continuity in the production of the packaging plastic film, thereby leading the production efficiency of the packaging plastic film to be higher and being beneficial to the production of the packaging plastic film.

title_en: Cutting insert and turning tool
abstract_en: The invention provides a cutting insert which can be used for copying a small space and has good economical efficiency. The first end (4) and the second end (5) of the cutting insert (3) are formed in approximately the same shape. The cutting edge (10) of the first end portion (4) includes a curved corner cutting edge (13) and a pair of side cutting edges (11, 12) provided across both ends (13L, 13R) of the corner cutting edge (13). The pair of transverse cutting edges (11, 12) are formed in a straight line shape and have an acute angle (gamma). The side surface (9) has an angular flank surface (94) and a flat surface (95) at a position adjacent to the angular cutting edge (13), the angular flank surface (94) being connected to the angular cutting edge (13), the flat surface (95) being disposed closer to the bottom surface (8) than the angular flank surface (94).

title_en: Automatic welding device for gate construction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of welding equipment, in particular to an automatic welding device for gate construction, which comprises a detection module, a control module and a control module, wherein the detection module is used for detecting parameters such as welding current, voltage, speed and the like in real time; the data processing module calculates and predicts the quality of the welding head according to the parameters, determines the position and the posture of the welding gun and creates a welding parameter set; the adjusting module is used for comparing the predicted welding head quality with the target welding quality and adjusting the actual welding quality; the judging and executing module judges target welding efficiency according to actual welding quality and determines the number of transmission nodes; the control module is used for receiving the welding parameter set and adjusting the number of the transmission nodes according to the feedback parameters; and the receiving module is used for receiving the welding parameter set, calculating the actual welding quality according to the parameter set and welding. The device realizes the automation and the intellectualization of the welding process through real-time monitoring and adjustment, improves the welding quality and the efficiency, and reduces the production cost.

title_en: Preparation method of high-entropy alloy valve core of swing type high-pressure coal slurry conveying valve
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a high-entropy alloy valve core of a swing high-pressure coal slurry conveying valve, which adopts a laser cladding method, cladding a layer of high-entropy alloy on the surfaces of the valve head, the valve seat and the base material of the guide assembly of the valve core so as to improve the characteristics of wear resistance, corrosion resistance, high temperature resistance and the like of the valve core assembly. By utilizing the characteristic of coke residue, the sealing surface forms a thin uniform coking layer by rotating the valve head, so as to achieve the characteristics of coke wear resistance, corrosion resistance and high temperature resistance. The valve seat adopts an ellipsoidal concave arc design, is tightly attached to the ellipsoidal structure of the valve head, and is coated with different high-entropy alloys at the sealing surfaces of the valve head and the valve seat, so that the hardness of the valve seat is higher than 100-200HV of the hardness of the valve head, and the sealing effect is improved. The valve head is provided with a unilateral contact type guide mechanism, and the valve head rotates by 15-45 degrees in the falling and rising processes. The high-entropy alloy metals of the valve head, the valve seat and the guide rail are as follows: AI. Co, cr, fe, ni; each element ranges from 0 to 50%.

title_en: Precise progressive die with in-die tapping structure and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a precise progressive die with an in-die tapping structure and a use method thereof, and belongs to the field of progressive dies. The utility model provides a accurate progressive die with in-mold tapping structure, includes the base to and fix the workstation at the base top, still include: the conveying mechanism is arranged at the top of the base and used for clamping and conveying the stamping raw materials above the workbench; the support frames are fixed on two sides of the workbench, and the top of the workbench is fixedly connected with a lifting mechanism; the die assembly is arranged between the workbench and the lifting mechanism and is used for performing stamping molding on the stamping raw material; the tapping assembly is fixed under the lifting mechanism and is used for tapping the inside of the stamping raw material; the invention can automatically correct the position when clamping the two sides of the stamping raw material, prevents the consistency of processing due to different center positions in the stamping process, and further improves the working operability of the continuous die.

title_en: Machine head with multi-angle adjusting cutter for cutting and processing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of sewing machine manufacturing production, in particular to a machine head with a multi-angle adjusting cutter for cutting processing, which comprises a headstock, wherein the front end of the headstock is provided with a lifting seat which moves up and down along the lifting direction, be convenient for follow-up collection, no matter be bigger piece metal or tiny dust, all can fall into in collecting the piece through the mode of difference, realized automatic collection, improved operational environment's clean and tidy degree, when the cutter was polished, magnet cover in magnet state can be through running through the groove attraction dust, make the dust gather near the magnet cover, lose magnetism after polishing, the dust falls into collecting the piece, this kind of design makes the dust more easily by attraction and gathering, has improved dust collection efficiency.

title_en: Grain processing lathe
abstract_en: The invention provides a grain processing lathe which comprises a frame, a rotating chuck, a feeding strip seat, a pushing rod, a cutting tool and a pushing sleeve, wherein the rotating chuck is arranged on the frame, a feeding hole is formed in the rotating chuck, the pushing rod is positioned at one end of the feeding strip seat far away from the rotating chuck, the cutting tool is positioned at one side of a main shaft of the rotating chuck, the pushing sleeve is connected to the frame to the upper side in an axial sliding manner along the rotating chuck, and the pushing sleeve is rotatably connected to the pushing sleeve, and the end face of the pushing sleeve is used for being abutted with the end face of a grain so as to limit the axial position of the grain. According to the grain processing lathe provided by the invention, the grain on the feeding bar seat is pushed into the passing hole of the rotary chuck by utilizing the pushing rod, the grain is clamped and driven to rotate by utilizing the rotary chuck, the outer end face of the grain can be limited by utilizing the jacking sleeve by the jacking seat, and then the grain is cut or cut by utilizing the cutting tool, so that the accuracy of the grain processing diameter or processing length is ensured, the grain cutting efficiency is improved, and the potential safety hazard is avoided.

title_en: Automatic cutting device for lens antenna shell
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of turning, and particularly discloses an automatic cutting device for a lens antenna shell, which comprises a machine body and a chuck rotatably arranged on the machine body, wherein a mounting frame is fixed on a claw of the chuck, and an outer supporting piece is rotatably arranged on the mounting frame; the claw is also provided with a driving piece, and the driving piece is used for driving the outer supporting piece to switch the storage state and the unfolding state; in the turning process of the inner conical surface, the turning block is driven to be turned to be in an unfolding state by the driving piece, at the moment, the main supporting plate is attached to the outer conical surface of the shell, the main supporting plate and the auxiliary supporting plate are utilized to simultaneously support the outer conical surface, so that the contact area of the whole outer supporting piece and the outer conical surface is improved, radial runout and deviation of the shell caused by cutting force applied to the inner conical surface by the cutting piece are avoided, and the cutting precision is ensured.

title_en: Cutting device is used in processing of aluminum alloy door and window
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of section bar cutting, and particularly relates to a cutting device for processing an aluminum alloy door and window. The invention adopts a rotating mechanism and a grooved pulley transmission mode, adopts a spherical grooved pulley transmission mode, realizes the rotation of a fixed angle of a cutting disc, realizes the 90-degree and 45-degree cutting operation of an aluminum alloy profile, avoids cutting errors in the cutting process, simultaneously adopts a synchronous lifting mode, adopts a claw-shaped sliding arm, a spline shaft and a fixed roller, clamps the profile by the fixed roller through moving the claw-shaped sliding arm, simultaneously utilizes the characteristic that the spline shaft can stretch and draw back and drive, and ensures that the fixed roller and the profile lift together, so as to avoid sliding of the profile in the process of moving the profile, and solve the technical problem of high defective rate caused by loosening of the large profile in the transportation and cutting process.

title_en: Outer ring deformation repair device and method for constant-section thin-wall bearing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of repairing of constant-section thin-wall bearings, and particularly discloses an outer ring deformation repairing device and method of a constant-section thin-wall bearing, comprising a workbench, wherein a clamping assembly is arranged on the workbench, a mounting groove is formed in the workbench, a push rod, a pressing rod and a guide block are arranged in the mounting groove, the guide block slides along the direction vertical to the workbench, the push rod and the pressing rod both slide to be in abutting connection with the bearing, an inclined plane is formed on the guide block, the guide block moves to drive the push rod and the pressing rod to move through the inclined plane, the pressing rod is used for fixing the bearing, an adjusting assembly is arranged on the workbench, the adjusting assembly is used for driving the push rod to rotate and is used for repairing the bearing, a pushing piece is arranged on the workbench, and the pushing piece and the guide block are connected for adjusting the position of the guide block; the outer ring deformation repair device and method for the constant-section thin-wall bearing have the effect of improving repair efficiency.

title_en: Production device and method for main clutch tensioning wheel
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of automobile part processing, and discloses a production device and a production method of a main clutch tensioning wheel. The invention realizes the sequential actions of the splitting wheel, the preformed wheel, the spreading wheel and the forming treatment wheel by utilizing the movable adjusting components of the two sides of the top of the base, cuts the ring groove on the outer side of the blank by the splitting wheel, extrudes and pushes the outer side of the split and cut blank into the main form of the tensioning wheel by utilizing the spreading wheel and the preformed wheel, the preparation production mode that adopts the molten metal to pour is avoided, the preparation production degree of difficulty is reduced, and improvement production efficiency can directly perceivedly quick completion main separation and reunion take-up pulley's production preparation, and the actual use is effectual, and ejection of compact is effectual, avoids the difficult problem of taking off of material that the casting preparation exists, has higher machining precision and better surface quality, and production effect is good.

title_en: Photovoltaic aluminium alloy processing automatic cutout equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses automatic cutting equipment for processing photovoltaic aluminum profiles, which relates to the technical field of photovoltaic aluminum profile cutting and comprises a cutting frame, wherein a conveying device is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the cutting frame, a collecting device is fixedly connected to one side of the cutting frame, the rotation of a cleaning rod is driven by the rotation of a cutting blade, the cleaning of the blade by the cleaning rod can be realized, meanwhile, under the support of a bent shaft and an extrusion spring, the cleaning rod can be tightly attached to the surface of the blade for removing impurities, and the damage of chips attached to the surface of the blade to the cleaning rod can be effectively reduced in the cleaning process of the blade. The rubber plates arranged on two sides of the blade can prevent the blade from shaking due to faults after long-time cutting, when the blade shakes and is detected by the vibration sensor, the rubber plates on two sides limit and squeeze the blade, the rubber plates cannot damage the surface of the blade, the effect of protecting the sensor is achieved, and the elasticity of the rubber plates is beneficial to transmitting pressure to the sensor.

title_en: Processing device for forklift hand brake connecting rod and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a processing device of a forklift hand brake connecting rod and a using method thereof, and relates to the field of forklift hand brake connecting rods. This processingequipment of fork truck hand brake connecting rod includes the numerical control drilling machine main part, the outside of numerical control drilling machine main part is provided with the brace table, the dust collection box is installed in the top of brace table, the inside activity of dust collection box is provided with the main part board, the outside of main part board rotates and is connected with the rotor plate, the inside activity of fixed box is pegged graft has the grip block, the outside activity of grip block has cup jointed the spring, the spring setting is in the outside of grip block, the activity of pushing away flitch sets up in the below of dust collection box, the side of pushing away the flitch is provided with the connecting rod, the connecting rod sets up the side at the main part board. This processingequipment of fork truck hand braking connecting rod drives the flitch through the removal of main part board and promotes the piece, accomplishes the process of collecting the piece under the drive of clamping structure, in time collects the piece after a round of processing.

title_en: Actuator lock pin clearance adjustment device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an actuator lock pin gap adjusting device, which relates to the technical field of sprocket lock pin gap adjustment and comprises an operation plate and a front cover plate positioning pin, wherein a movable plate is arranged in the middle of the operation plate, a rotor is arranged in the movable plate, a front cover plate is arranged in the rotor, the front cover plate positioning pin is arranged in the front cover plate, a plum blossom handle is arranged on one side of the movable plate, a spring is arranged on one side, far away from the plum blossom handle, of the outer surface of the movable plate, a first installation block is arranged at the end part of the spring, and a dial indicator is arranged on one side of the first installation block. According to the actuator lock pin gap adjusting device, the lock pin gap value is determined by fixing the positions of the front cover plate and the chain wheel, the adjustment is mainly achieved by rotating the angle of the chain wheel, the adjustment of the lock pin gap of the actuator is finally achieved by adjusting the readings of the dial indicator through the conversion of the straight line and the angle, the dial indicator value is confirmed, repeated adjustment is not needed in the follow-up process, and a large amount of time and labor cost are saved.

title_en: Ship position submerged arc welding device
abstract_en: The invention provides a ship position submerged arc welding device, which relates to the technical field of welding and comprises a main position sliding rail and a positioning support plate, wherein an extension sliding rail is arranged in the inner side of the main position sliding rail in a sliding manner, driving cylinders are arranged on two sides of the top of the positioning support plate, movable plates are arranged at the output ends of the driving cylinders on two sides of the top of the positioning support plate, springs are arranged at the bottoms of the movable plates, welding carrier plates are arranged at the bottoms of the movable plates through the springs, a welding module is arranged at the bottom of the welding carrier plate, a fixing piece is arranged on the side face of the welding module, and a positioning rod is arranged at the top of the fixing piece in a penetrating and sliding manner. The narrow welding seam is polished by using the polishing wheel module, so that the welding pool flows to the welding seam deeply, the welding firmness of the welding seam is improved, and the problem that the welding firmness of part of the welding pool is poor due to the fact that the molten welding pool is difficult to sufficiently flow to the deep part of the welding seam due to the limitation of the width of the welding seam is solved.

title_en: Laser processing apparatus
abstract_en: The invention discloses a laser processing device, comprising: truss; the laser device comprises an X-axis module arranged on the truss, a mounting seat connected to the X-axis module in a transmission way, a Z-axis module arranged on the mounting seat and a laser connected to the Z-axis module in a transmission way; the dust removing device comprises a first sliding rail arranged on the truss along the X-axis direction, a first sliding block in sliding connection with the first sliding rail and a dust remover fixedly connected with the first sliding block; the transfer device is positioned below the laser and comprises a transfer platform and a Y-axis module in transmission connection with the transfer platform; the dust remover is located below the mounting seat and is arranged adjacent to the laser, and the dust remover is in magnetic attraction fit with the mounting seat. By adopting the structure, the invention can improve the feeding and discharging efficiency, and the dust remover can smoothly and synchronously move along with the laser and simultaneously reduce the performance requirement of the X-axis module.

title_en: Sponge processing equipment and method for sofa
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of sponge processing, in particular to sponge processing equipment and a method for a sofa, wherein the sponge processing equipment for the sofa comprises a cutting mechanism, a first conveying mechanism and a second conveying mechanism, the cutting mechanism comprises a cutting knife which moves in a vertical plane, with cut the sponge, first conveying mechanism sets up in one side of cutting mechanism for carry the sponge and change the sponge and face the terminal surface of cutting mechanism, second conveying mechanism sets up in the opposite side of cutting mechanism, and second conveying mechanism is used for driving the sponge and moves in the horizontal direction. The application has the effect of improving the problem of lower processing efficiency of the existing sponge.

title_en: Corrosion-resistant wear-resistant slag welding wire and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of welding materials, in particular to a corrosion-resistant wear-resistant slag welding wire and a preparation method thereof. The raw materials used for the corrosion-resistant and wear-resistant slag-based welding wire comprise a flux core and a steel belt, wherein the raw materials used for the flux core comprise micro-carbon ferrochrome nickel powder, ferroboron, high-carbon ferromanganese, ferrosilicon, aluminum powder, rutile powder, quartz powder, fluorite powder, ferrovanadium, ferroniobium, cobalt powder, tungsten powder, potassium carbonate powder, fused magnesia, marble powder, ferrotitanium, fluxing agent and iron. The product of the application can realize semi-automatic or full-automatic welding of spiral welding and swing welding, and the welding wire has strong air hole resistance, high wear resistance and good corrosion resistance, and can obviously improve the hardness of the welding part and the air hole resistance of the welding seam.

title_en: Trimming head structure and trimmer
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mechanical grinding equipment, in particular to a trimming head structure and a trimmer, which realize up-and-down movement of a diamond drilling disk by arranging a diaphragm, and can be better matched with a grinding pad when the diamond drilling disk moves up and down due to the elastic action of the diaphragm, so that the pressure distribution of the diamond drilling disk applied to the grinding pad is more uniform, the removal rate of the grinding pad is more uniform, and the flatness of the grinding pad is higher. In addition, by setting the pressure of the air pressure detecting sensor detecting terminal, whether the trimming head is pressed down or not can be determined, so that the completion of grinding is ensured, and the defect of a product is prevented.

title_en: Valve body forging device with automatic flushing and spraying functions
abstract_en: The invention discloses a valve body forging device with automatic flushing and spraying, which comprises a base (1), wherein a die (2) is arranged on the base (1), a slidable forging seat (3) is arranged above the base (1), and a hammer head (4) is arranged at the lower end of the forging seat (3); base (1) one side be equipped with curb plate (5), be equipped with translation subassembly (6) on curb plate (5), be equipped with grudging post (7) on the mobile terminal of translation subassembly (6), one side of grudging post (7) is equipped with swing cylinder (8), the warp bearing is equipped with crossbearer axle (9) on grudging post (7), the one end of crossbearer axle (9) is equipped with crossbearer (10), the end that stretches out of swing cylinder (8) is connected with crossbearer axle (9) through the connecting block. The invention realizes the integrated operation of cleaning and release agent spraying, stably and uniformly realizes the spraying of the release agent and improves the spraying efficiency.

title_en: Thin substrate clamping mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a thin substrate clamping mechanism, and aims to solve the defect of inconvenient clamping and positioning of a thin substrate. The invention comprises a bottom plate and positioning grid pieces, wherein a spring plate which is movably arranged between the bottom plate and the positioning grid pieces is arranged, a plurality of positioning slotted holes are arranged on the positioning grid, embedded spring plates are arranged on the spring plate in one-to-one correspondence with the positioning slotted holes, elastic heads are arranged on the embedded spring plates, the embedded spring plates are arranged in the positioning slotted holes, and a substrate clamping groove is formed between the embedded spring plates and the side walls of the positioning slotted holes. The thin substrate clamping mechanism can conveniently and rapidly finish clamping work of the substrate in a thin substrate surface mounting scene, and clamping and positioning are stable and reliable.

title_en: Automatic-alignment pneumatic press-fitting device for rotor bearing of brushless motor
abstract_en: The invention provides a self-aligning pneumatic press-fitting device for a brushless motor rotor bearing, which comprises a buffer press-fitting assembly; the device is characterized in that the buffer press-fitting component is fixedly arranged on the control cabinet, a supporting base is arranged at the bottom of the control cabinet, the rotor guiding component is fixedly arranged on the supporting base and arranged right below the buffer press-fitting component, a rotor component positioning tool is arranged on the rotor guiding component and used for clamping the rotor component, the rotor component positioning tool can be electrically controlled to lift on the rotor guiding component, the axle center of the buffer press-fitting component is opposite to the axle center of the rotor component, and a pressure display is arranged on the side face of the control cabinet and used for controlling the buffer press-fitting component and the rotor guiding component. The invention can realize semi-automatic press mounting of the bearing, not only can ensure the press mounting speed, but also can realize the self-alignment of the press mounting, reduce the impact of the shaft and the bearing under the rapid press mounting, ensure the press mounting efficiency of the press mounting process of the rotor assembly bearing, and simultaneously ensure the quality of the press mounting of the bearing, so that the process avoids the quality problem of manual assembly.

title_en: Abrasive flow mortise burr removal machining clamp and method
