abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of machining of turbine discs of aeroengines, and provides a clamp and a method for removing burrs of mortises by abrasive flows, wherein the clamp comprises a base, a clamping assembly, an outer clamp body, a positioning shaft, a lock nut and a mounting positioning block, the outer clamp body is fixedly arranged on the base, the clamping assembly comprises an upper clamp body and a lower clamp body which are provided with guide grooves, and the guide grooves are used for guiding abrasive into and guiding abrasive out of the mortises; the positioning shaft is fixedly connected to the base and used for realizing radial positioning of the lower clamp body, the turbine disc and the upper clamp body; the locking nut is connected to the upper end of the positioning shaft so as to lock the lower clamp body, the turbine disc and the upper clamp body; the installation locating block is matched with the mortises and the diversion trenches in shape, so as to be inserted into the mortises and the diversion trenches, and the relative rotation among the lower clamp body, the turbine disc and the upper clamp body is limited when the locking nut is screwed. The invention can avoid dislocation of the diversion trench and the mortise in the process of clamping the turbine disk, thereby avoiding adverse effects caused by dislocation and improving the reliability of the clamp.

title_en: Valve and manufacturing process thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of valve manufacturing, in particular to a valve and a manufacturing process thereof, wherein the valve comprises two mutually buckled valve body shells, the two valve body shells are fixedly connected with each other, a sealing ring is arranged between the two valve body shells, connecting pipelines are fixedly connected to the two valve body shells, the positions of the two connecting pipelines correspond to each other, a rotating shaft is rotationally connected between the two valve body shells, a flow regulating disc is fixedly connected to the rotating shaft, the flow regulating disc is positioned between the two valve body shells, and a flow regulating hole is arranged on the flow regulating disc; the process comprises the following steps: step one: fixing and clamping the flow regulating disc, and driving the punching mechanism to punch holes close to the flow regulating disc; step two: adjusting the relative distance between a plurality of punching cutters on the punching mechanism, and further adjusting the punching diameter of the punching mechanism; step three: the punching mechanism is used for processing a plurality of flow regulating round holes with different diameters on the flow regulating disc, or the punching mechanism is used for processing flow regulating arc holes with gradually increased width from one end to the other end on the flow regulating disc.

title_en: Tank wall reinforcing device and reinforcing method for oil storage tank
abstract_en: The invention relates to a reinforcing device for a tank wall of an oil tank and a reinforcing method thereof, belonging to the technical field of oil tank reinforcement, wherein a movable shell is arranged, the movable shell can slide on the tank wall of the oil tank, and further a welding component, a positioning component and a pressing component which are carried on the movable shell are driven to move on the same as the tank wall of the oil tank, and the reinforcing plate is welded on a to-be-reinforced position of the tank wall of the oil tank through the cooperation of the welding component, the positioning component and the pressing component. The safety risk of operators is increased, welding quality is unstable due to the fact that the operation environment is limited, and the overall structural strength and the sealing performance of the oil storage tank are affected.

title_en: Leak-proof assembly machine for drain valve sealing ring
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of drain valve processing, in particular to a drain valve sealing ring leak-proof assembly machine, which comprises: the device comprises a shell cover, a feed inlet and a discharge outlet which are formed in the shell cover, a fixing frame fixed on the side edge of the shell cover, a chassis arranged in the middle of the shell cover and a mounting plate rotationally connected above the chassis, wherein a plurality of U-shaped mounting holes are formed in the mounting plate, and a clamping assembly is arranged in the mounting holes; the clamping assembly comprises two clamping rings, a hinge part, two connecting pieces and a spring column, wherein the two clamping rings are symmetrically arranged, one ends of the clamping rings are connected in a rotating mode through the hinge part, an oval clamping space is formed between the two clamping rings, a splayed opening is formed in one end, away from the hinge part, of each clamping ring and used for guiding in a drain valve, and the two connecting pieces are fixedly connected to two sides of the hinge part respectively. The invention can effectively clamp and fix the drain valves with different diameters, thereby ensuring the installation precision of the sealing ring.

title_en: Aluminum alloy cutting tool for industrial casting
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of machine tool parts, in particular to an aluminum alloy cutting tool for industrial casting, which comprises the following technical scheme: the machine tool platform assembly and the two transmission assemblies which are slidably mounted on the surface of the machine tool platform assembly, wherein the machine tool platform assembly comprises a supporting platform of which the inside is provided with a processing waste collection frame. According to the invention, the two aluminum alloy clamping blocks and the positioning long rod are used for clamping three points of the aluminum alloy, the center area of the aluminum alloy is clamped, so that the processing stability of the aluminum alloy is improved, as the center of gravity of the aluminum alloy moves downwards, the residual materials cut on the surface of the aluminum alloy can fall into the processing waste collection frame more accurately, and the residual materials are blocked by the telescopic vertical positioning plates on the two sides, so that the residual materials are prevented from being scattered, corresponding clamping is performed according to the actual conditions of the aluminum alloy, different aluminum alloys are always clamped stably, and meanwhile, the recovery of the residual materials is facilitated.

title_en: Semicircle bamboo flattening device
abstract_en: The invention provides a semicircular bamboo flattening device which can continuously flatten the whole semicircular bamboo at one time, has high operation efficiency, does not crack bamboo chips and improves the utilization rate of the bamboo. The bamboo wood circumferential pressing machine comprises a frame, a gradual change type working table, a radial pressing device, a tangential pressing device and a conveying system, wherein the feeding end of the gradual change type working table is in a semicircular arc shape, the arc is gradually flattened when the gradual change type working table extends to the discharging end until the discharging end is completely in a plane, the conveying system comprises a plurality of pairs of rollers and a conveying driving device, a plurality of holes are formed in the working table from front (feeding section) to rear (discharging section), a pair of rollers are arranged at the position of each hole, the radial pressing device comprises an arc-shaped pressing ring and a plurality of small rotating pressing rollers arranged on the pressing ring, gaps between the small pressing rollers and the upper surfaces of the opposite working table are not larger than the thickness of the bamboo wood, and the tangential pressing device applies pressure to the thickness surfaces on two sides of the bamboo wood along the tangential direction of the arc of the bamboo wood and realizes circumferential pressing of the arc-shaped bamboo wood together with the working table.

title_en: Roller supporting cylinder rotating mechanism and cylinder clamping method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a roller support cylinder rotating mechanism which comprises two roller support cylinder rotating units and a rotary encoder elastic mounting assembly, wherein the roller support cylinder rotating units are consistent in structure, a track of rollers is longitudinally arranged on a table surface of a machine frame, the first roller support cylinder rotating unit is fixedly arranged at the end of one end of the track, a rotating unit moving assembly is arranged on the track, the second roller support cylinder rotating unit is arranged on the upper surface of the rotating unit moving assembly, and the rotating unit moving assembly can carry the second roller support cylinder rotating unit to longitudinally and horizontally move on the track. The invention belongs to the technical field of rotary mechanical equipment, and solves the problems of inconsistent arc length and insufficient suitability in the rotation process caused by uneven diameter and size of a cylinder. The invention also discloses a roller supporting cylinder clamping method, which solves the problems that the requirement on a part to be processed is higher and the selection and the installation under a specific working condition can not be met when the existing mechanism rotates and clamps.

title_en: Cold rolling mill is used in mirror surface aluminium production
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of cold rolling mills, in particular to a cold rolling mill for producing mirror aluminum, which comprises a bracket, wherein a cold roll set and a liquid spraying unit are arranged on the bracket, the cold rolling mill further comprises a liquid collecting hopper and a filter box, the filter box is connected with the liquid spraying unit through a pump, a plurality of filter boxes are arranged in the filter box, the filter boxes are rotationally connected with the filter box through a horizontal shaft, a left baffle plate is arranged on the left side of the filter boxes, a right baffle plate is arranged on the right side of the filter boxes, and a shovel plate is arranged on the right baffle plate. The coolant liquid that flows from aluminum plate surface will flow into the filter box of topside through gathering the liquid fill, at the in-process that the filter box was close to baffle upset right, the shovel board will last to conflict in the interior diapire of filter box and finally conflict in left baffle, the upper surface of left baffle and right baffle and the front and back both sides inner wall of filter box will enclose jointly into the edulcoration chamber for impurity gathers together, so that impurity is cleared up fast, and the filtration of coolant liquid still can continue to carry out to other filter boxes. The cold rolling method has the beneficial effects that the cold rolling efficiency of the aluminum plate is improved.

title_en: Laser welding equipment and method for machining building steel templates
abstract_en: The invention discloses laser welding equipment and a method for processing a building steel template, and relates to the technical field of laser welding, wherein the laser welding equipment for processing the building steel template comprises a base, a laser welding mechanism is arranged on the base, an automatic assembling mechanism is also arranged on the base, the automatic assembling mechanism comprises a tool frame body and a guillotine type positioning tool arranged on the tool frame body, a template length direction positioning plate, a template width direction positioning plate, a template length direction positioning cylinder and a template pushing positioning cylinder are arranged on the table surface of the tool frame body, wherein the template length direction positioning plate is arranged opposite to the template length direction positioning cylinder, and the template width direction positioning plate is arranged opposite to the template pushing positioning cylinder; the knife gate type positioning tool can be overturned relative to the tool frame body, and a workpiece on the table surface of the tool frame body can be pressed downwards after the knife gate type positioning tool overturns. The invention solves the technical problem of large deviation after the steel template is assembled in the prior art, and improves the production efficiency.

title_en: Polisher for producing roll forging casting
abstract_en: The invention discloses a grinding machine for producing roll forging castings, which comprises a grinding machine tool body, wherein a clamp for fixing a roll is arranged in the middle of the grinding machine tool body, a grinding assembly is arranged in the middle of the grinding machine tool body and corresponds to the position of the roll, the grinding assembly can move forwards and backwards and leftwards, a fixing frame is fixedly arranged at the top of the grinding assembly, a sliding frame is slidably arranged at one end of the fixing frame far away from the grinding assembly, a mounting frame is arranged at the bottom of the sliding frame, a water absorbing sponge is pressed close to the bottom of the sliding frame, the water absorbing sponge is driven to rotate through the operation of a motor, the water on the roll can be absorbed, the inner ring of the pressing frame is used for pressing the water absorbing sponge, the water inside the water absorbing sponge is extruded, the water absorbing sponge can be absorbed at all times, the observation of people on the grinding condition of the roll is facilitated, the positions between the fixing frame and the sliding frame are adjusted, and the upper and lower positions of the water absorbing sponge are used for pressing the water absorbing sponge to the rolls with different diameters.

title_en: Low-temperature-resistant corrosion-resistant steel wire drawing device for ship
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-temperature-resistant corrosion-resistant steel wire drawing device for ships, which relates to the technical field of steel wire drawing devices and comprises a base and a workbench fixedly arranged on the base, wherein a roller is rotatably arranged on the workbench, a powder box is fixedly arranged on the base, a fixed frame is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the powder box, a rotating ring is rotatably arranged on the fixed frame, a fixed cylinder is fixedly arranged on the fixed frame, fan blades are fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the rotating ring, an inner ring is fixedly arranged at one end, far away from the rotating ring, of each fan blade, a spiral plate is fixedly arranged on the inner ring, and a connecting frame is fixedly arranged on the fixed frame. The spiral plate can be driven to rotate through the movement of the steel wire, so that the spiral plate is tightly attached to the surface of the steel wire and scrapes the wire drawing powder on the surface of the steel wire, and meanwhile, the fan blades are driven to rotate along with the rotation of the spiral plate to suck air, so that waste and injury to workers caused by overflow of most of the wire drawing powder are avoided.

title_en: Auto-parts welding frock clamp
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of welding clamping and discloses an automobile part welding fixture which comprises a supporting unit, a centering adjusting unit and a clamping fixing unit. When the electric push rod pushes the slide rod to slide, the slide rod drives the rocker arm at the tail end to rotate around the rotation center, the position of the ejector block on the rocker arm changes, the ejector block drives the ejector rod to move towards the inside of the supporting beam, the ejector rod can drive the X-axis pressing plate to slide towards the inside, further the workpiece on the supporting beam is pushed forward and backward, the ejector rod can also drive the connecting plate to slide synchronously, the slide plate on the connecting plate slides along the inclined pressing groove at the moment, the Y-axis pressing plate can be pushed to move towards the side wall of the supporting beam through the guiding effect of the pressing groove, the workpiece on the supporting beam is pushed to be pushed to the left and the right, the workpiece is automatically located at the center of the supporting beam through the mutual combination of the forward and backward extrusion and the left and right extrusion, manual adjustment is not needed, and the operation is simpler.

title_en: Laser welding machine for assisting workpiece movement
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of laser welding machines, in particular to a laser welding machine for assisting in moving workpieces, which comprises a workbench, wherein a laser welding mechanism is arranged on the workbench, a rotating mechanism is further arranged on the workbench, a first lifting rod is arranged on the rotating mechanism, a merging component is arranged on the first lifting rod, two groups of second guide rails are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the rotating mechanism on the workbench, a second mounting seat is arranged on the second guide rails, a second lifting rod is arranged on the second mounting seat, a first mounting box is arranged on the second lifting rod, a first servo motor is arranged in the first mounting box, a turnover disc is arranged at the output end of the first servo motor, a driving component is arranged in the turnover disc, four groups of clamping components are symmetrically arranged on the turnover disc around the circle center of the turnover disc, the clamping components are connected with the driving component, and the driving components drive two groups of the same side to move in opposite directions so as to clamp rectangular plate-shaped workpieces.

title_en: Intelligent transfer chain of automobile welding dress
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of conveying lines, in particular to an intelligent conveying line for automobile welding, which comprises a conveying frame, wherein a conveying vehicle body is movably arranged at the top of the conveying frame, a guide groove is formed in the top of the conveying frame, rollers are rotatably arranged at the bottom of the conveying vehicle body and are matched with the guide groove, an adjusting plate is arranged at the top of the conveying vehicle body, a placing plate for fixedly placing an automobile to-be-welded part is rotatably arranged at the top of the adjusting plate, two rotating shafts are rotatably arranged on the inner walls of the front side and the rear side of the conveying frame, chain wheels are fixedly arranged on the rotating shafts, chains are sleeved on the corresponding two chain wheels in a transmission mode, and a plurality of fixing plates are fixedly arranged on the chains. The invention has reasonable design, the conveying vehicle body is connected with the connecting plate, the rotation of the chain can drive the conveying vehicle body to convey through the connecting plate, and the purpose of adjusting the welding position of the automobile to-be-welded piece on the placing plate can be realized by moving and rotating the placing plate.

title_en: Anti-fragmentation polishing method for TGV product
abstract_en: The invention discloses a grinding and polishing method for preventing a TGV product from being broken, which belongs to the technical field of grinding and polishing of the TGV product and comprises the following steps of S1, bonding, namely attaching a UV film to the surface of the TGV product, removing the edge part of the UV film, enabling the UV film to be completely attached to the surface of the TGV product, S2, grinding, namely loading the TGV product, carrying out chemical corrosion and mechanical grinding on the TGV product through CMP equipment, realizing efficient removal of redundant materials on the surface of the TGV product and planarization of the surface of the TGV product, S3, spin-drying and cleaning, namely placing the TGV product on a spin dryer, spraying cleaning liquid to the surface of the TGV product through a high-speed rotating spray head, removing surface pollutants through physical brushing, S4, performing glue removal, namely placing the TGV product in a UV glue remover, and completing glue removal operation, S5, separating the TGV product from the UV film, and removing the UV film from the surface of the TGV product. According to the invention, the UV film is attached to the surface of the TGV product, so that the problem that the TGV product is broken or warped in the grinding and polishing process can be effectively avoided.

title_en: Asymmetric pipe diameter oscillation heat pipe grinding wheel and manufacturing method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an oscillating heat pipe grinding wheel with an asymmetric pipe diameter, a manufacturing method and application thereof. The front and the back sides of the oscillation heat pipe matrix are respectively provided with the oscillation heat pipe flow passages in a staggered way. The oscillating heat pipe flow passage is in end-to-end connection with a plurality of single-loop asymmetric pipe diameter structures. The structure can utilize structures with different pipe diameters to form different pressure gradients in the flow channel, provide additional pressure difference for the flow of internal working media, and promote the internal working media of the oscillating heat pipe to form stable unidirectional circulating motion. The oscillating heat pipe grinding wheel with the asymmetric pipe diameter can still maintain high-efficiency heat transfer performance and working stability under the high-speed grinding condition.

title_en: Laser welding machine for alloy resistor
abstract_en: The invention provides a laser welding machine for an alloy resistor, which comprises a material guide mechanism, a leveling mechanism, a cleaning mechanism, a welding mechanism, a material receiving mechanism and a rolling disc which are sequentially arranged along the feeding direction of an alloy resistor belt material. The welding mechanism comprises a double-head welding platform and a jig, wherein two avoidance ports are formed in the jig, two laser welding heads and a translation sliding table matched with the laser welding heads are arranged on the double-head welding platform, each laser welding head faces one avoidance port, the translation sliding table is used for driving the two laser welding heads to translate, and the two laser welding heads are staggered. The two laser welding heads are staggered and simultaneously welded, the welding process of the alloy resistance strip can be reduced by half by single feeding to two different parts, the welding efficiency is improved, the transmission distance of the alloy resistance strip is reduced by half, and the welding equipment does not need to be arranged for secondary welding, so that the equipment manufacturing cost is saved, and the space is saved.

title_en: Full-automatic outer spherical ball bearing ball seat assembly machine
abstract_en: The invention provides a full-automatic spherical ball bearing ball seat assembly machine which comprises a feeding mechanism and a discharging mechanism which are sequentially arranged along a feeding direction, wherein a pre-pushing mechanism and a prying seat mechanism are arranged between the feeding mechanism and the discharging mechanism, the full-automatic spherical ball bearing ball seat assembly machine further comprises a controller, the feeding mechanism, the discharging mechanism, the pre-pushing mechanism and the prying seat mechanism are electrically connected with the controller, the pre-pushing mechanism and the prying seat mechanism comprise workpiece fixing devices, the workpiece fixing devices are used for fixing workpieces during assembly, the pre-pushing mechanism comprises a first driving source, a push rod and a first assembly table, a first fixing position is arranged on the first assembly table, the first driving source can drive the push rod to move towards the direction of the first fixing position, the prying seat mechanism comprises a driving device, a prying rod and a second assembly table, a second fixing position is arranged on the second assembly table, and the driving device can drive the prying rod to move towards the direction of the second fixing position. The whole assembly process is automatically operated, and the assembly efficiency is higher.

title_en: Heavy-duty special-shaped blank tilting gear and tilting method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heavy-duty special-shaped blank tilting gear and a tilting method, and belongs to the technical field of hot rolling production lines. The invention relates to a heavy-duty special-shaped blank tilting machine, which comprises a hydraulic cylinder support, a hydraulic cylinder rotationally connected in the hydraulic cylinder support, a guide support, a slewing mechanism rotationally connected with a telescopic rod of the hydraulic cylinder, and a tilting hook rotationally connected with the slewing mechanism, wherein the working end of the tilting hook comprises a hook head and a hook back, the front end surface of the guide support is a guide track, when the heavy-duty special-shaped blank is tilted, the slewing mechanism drives the hook back to ascend along the guide track, the hook head hook lifts the special-shaped blank to tilt in situ without transversely moving, so that the end surface of the horizontal special-shaped blank is directly tilted to form a special section of the heavy-duty special-shaped blank, and the special section rolling requirement of the heavy-duty special-shaped blank is met. The technical problem that a tilting gear without pushing bed clamping correction is applied to heavy-duty special-shaped blank tilting steel and the rolling center line is deviated due to the separate actions of transverse movement and tilting in the prior art is solved.

title_en: Repair welding host head for temperature control plug of carrier rocket storage tank
abstract_en: The invention discloses a main nose for repairing and welding a temperature control plug of a carrier rocket storage tank, and relates to the technical field of repairing and welding of the carrier rocket storage tank plug. The temperature control plug repair welding main machine head of the carrier rocket storage tank comprises a main machine shell and a control system box, wherein the rear end face of the main machine shell is fixedly connected with a middle shell, the rear end of the middle shell is fixedly connected with a pulling and pressing shell, the outer surface of the main machine shell is provided with a water cooling device, the water cooling device comprises two connectors, the two connectors are fixedly connected to the outer surface of the main machine shell, the outer surfaces of the two connectors are fixedly connected with water pipes, the problem of poor quality of a welding seam after high-revolution braking is solved through automatic control of temperature, pressure, rotating speed and the like of the welding position, the welding heat affected zone is reduced, the residual stress of the welding seam is reduced, the welding deformation is reduced, the mechanical property and fatigue strength of the welding seam are improved, the comprehensive performance of the welding connectors is improved, the stability of the heat input quantity of friction welding is ensured, the process control difficulty of the welding process is reduced, and the accurate control of the welding process is realized.

title_en: Cooling device of electric welding machine and using method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cooling device of an electric welding machine and a using method thereof, relating to the field of welding and solving the problems that the position of a nozzle is difficult to switch and use when the cooling device of the traditional electric welding machine is used and the service life of a welding gun is prolonged, comprising a cooling water tank, a switching mechanism, a cooling mechanism and the welding gun, wherein a water cooling pipe and a water return pipe are fixedly connected on the welding gun, the switching mechanism comprises a rotating disc, a nozzle and a conveying piece, the cooling mechanism comprises a spiral pipe and a connecting pipe, according to the invention, when the temperature of one group of nozzles is continuously higher than a set value, the rotating disc is driven to rotate, the positions of the nozzles are switched, so that the two groups of nozzles are alternately used, meanwhile, the switching of the positions of welding wires and the switching and conveying of protective gas can be ensured in the switching process, cooling water in a water cooling pipe is conveyed into a spiral pipe in the running nozzle for water cooling and cooling, and the output water is circulated into the other group of spiral pipe through a connecting pipe for heat preservation of the nozzles, so that the cooling is prevented from being too fast.

title_en: Bending U positioning device of bending sleeve integrated machine and working method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a U-shaped positioning device of a sleeve bending integrated machine and a working method thereof, wherein the device comprises a push pipe assembly, a core pulling assembly, a bending assembly and an upper material returning assembly, wherein the bending assembly is connected to the push pipe assembly, the core pulling assembly is connected to the push pipe assembly, and the upper material returning assembly is connected to the push pipe assembly; the push tube assembly comprises a first-stage moving structure and a plurality of position fine-tuning structures, and the first-stage moving structure is connected with the position fine-tuning structures. The device can solve the problems of complicated feeding position and limit adjustment caused by the multichannel design of the traditional small U-shaped bending machine, and frequent shutdown and debugging are needed to ensure that the size meets the requirements.

title_en: Table type laser engraving machine
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of desktop laser engraving, and provides a desktop laser engraving machine. The desktop type laser engraving machine comprises a frame, a mounting assembly, a lifting assembly and a vibrating mirror assembly, wherein the mounting assembly is used for mounting a machining workpiece, the lifting assembly is mounted on the frame, the vibrating mirror assembly is mounted on the lifting assembly, the lifting assembly is used for driving the vibrating mirror assembly to move relative to the mounting assembly, and the vibrating mirror assembly is used for emitting laser beams to the machining workpiece. According to the desktop type laser engraving machine provided by the embodiment of the application, the vibrating mirror assembly can be driven to move relative to the workpiece to be processed, so that the distance between the vibrating mirror assembly and the workpiece to be processed is adjusted, the focus of laser emitted by the vibrating mirror assembly can accurately fall on the target position of the workpiece to be processed, the automatic adjustment of the vibrating mirror assembly is realized, the using steps of the desktop type laser engraving machine are effectively simplified, the processing precision of the desktop type laser engraving machine is ensured, and the intelligent degree of the desktop type laser engraving machine is improved.

title_en: Special fixture for milling bearing saddle
abstract_en: A special milling fixture for a bearing saddle belongs to the technical field of special milling fixtures; through setting up special mount pad, utilize the semicircle locating piece to fix a position the bearing saddle clitellum in the bearing saddle, the upset clamp plate of cooperation both sides compresses tightly the both sides of bearing saddle, carry out the position to the bearing saddle through the semicircle locating piece and prescribe a limit to, the uniformity of bearing saddle position after can realizing clamping each time, thereby avoid repeated location after clamping each time, can further promote the milling efficiency of bearing saddle, through increasing the length of mount pad, can realize clamping a plurality of bearing saddles simultaneously on the mount pad, utilize stretching out the hydro-cylinder and stretch out, simultaneously, the bearing saddle is pressed from both sides tightly, can realize a clamping process a plurality of bearing saddles, further promote the milling efficiency of bearing saddle.

title_en: Seat cushion fixing pin blank extrusion molding device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of seat cushion fixing pin processing, and provides a seat cushion fixing pin blank extrusion molding device which comprises a workbench, wherein two fixing seats are fixedly connected to the workbench, a fixing pipe is rotationally connected between the two fixing seats, a station disc is fixedly connected to the fixing pipe, a movable seam matched with the station disc is formed in the workbench, a preformed hole assembly is mounted on the station disc, a plurality of output ends are arranged on the preformed hole assembly, and the plurality of output ends of the preformed hole assembly are uniformly distributed around the axis of the station disc. According to the invention, the separable modules and the reserved hole assembly are arranged, so that the aluminum alloy blank can be directly extruded and molded, after the aluminum alloy blank is molded, the two modules are separated, the fixing pin body is conveniently taken down from the reserved hole assembly, then the hole at the bottom of the fixing pin body is tapped, and the taper pin can be machined.

title_en: High-precision welded pipe orifice cutting device with accurate clamping structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-precision welding pipe orifice cutting device with an accurate clamping structure, which comprises a cutting table, wherein clamping mechanisms are symmetrically arranged on two sides in the middle of the upper end of the cutting table, each clamping mechanism comprises a placing frame, mounting legs, a driving assembly and an electromagnetic clamping seat, the lower end of the placing frame is symmetrically provided with the mounting legs, the driving assembly is arranged on the inner side of the placing frame, and two sides of the upper end of the driving assembly are connected with the corresponding electromagnetic clamping seat. This high-accuracy welded tube mouth of pipe cutting device with accurate clamping structure, through being connected welded tube bottom and putting the electromagnetism piece magnetism that the base upper end set up, then rethread first electric telescopic handle extends for the head rod drives the second connecting rod and removes, makes the promotion seat promote the electromagnetism holder and carries out the centre gripping with welded tube both sides, and fourth connecting rod pulling third connecting rod simultaneously, makes the sliding sleeve move down on the upstand, thereby need not artifical manual operation, and can carry out the centre gripping to the welded tube of different chi footpath, the practicality of improvement use.

title_en: Pressing rivet nut machining device and operation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a press-riveting nut processing device and an operation method thereof, which belong to the technical field of nut processing and comprise a vibration disc, wherein an outlet of the vibration disc is connected with a nut channel, and the nut channel is connected with a plurality of tooling stations, and nuts falling on the tooling stations are transferred into the auxiliary assembly by the transfer assembly. This device has carried out the processing operation of punching a hole in advance to the nut, and whole automatic operation, can avoid the smear metal to influence the nut simultaneously, and can immediately wash the stoving to the nut, the staff of being convenient for observes the state of punching a hole in advance of nut, and can carry out the reprocessing immediately to can guarantee the processingquality of punching a hole in advance.

title_en: Spiral lip face drill bit
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of spiral lip face drill bits and discloses a spiral lip face drill bit which comprises a drill body, a spiral matrix and a guide cutting body, wherein the spiral matrix is arranged at the top of the drill body, a spiral inner lip is arranged on the outer side of the spiral matrix in a surrounding mode, the guide cutting body is arranged on the inner side of the spiral inner lip, a spiral outer lip is arranged on the outer side of the spiral matrix far away from the outer side of the spiral inner lip, an inner lip groove is arranged in the spiral outer lip, an inner groove is arranged on the inner side of the top of the spiral matrix, a processing drill bit is arranged on the top of the spiral matrix, and a cutting arm is arranged on the outer side of the top of the spiral matrix.

title_en: High-efficient saw board double-sided mill device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-efficiency saw plate double-sided grinding device, which comprises a machine body, wherein a transfer arm is connected with the middle part in the machine body in a swinging way through a rotating shaft, the transfer arm comprises a connecting seat, a first arm body which is connected to the connecting seat in a rotating way through a rotating table, a second arm body which is connected to the first arm body in a telescopic way, and an electromagnet which is arranged at the front end of the second arm body.

title_en: Firm high-temperature alloy easy welding and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of alloy materials, in particular to a firm high-temperature alloy easy-to-weld and a preparation method thereof. The technical scheme adopted by the invention is as follows: c: less than or equal to 0.06 percent; si: 0.35-0.60%; mn: less than or equal to 0.80 percent; cr:15.0 to 18.0 percent; AL: less than or equal to 0.40 percent; s: less than or equal to 0.008 percent; p: less than or equal to 0.020%; fe: less than or equal to 1.0 percent; la: 0.050-0.080; ce:0.10 to 2.50 percent, and N is less than or equal to 0.020 percent; o is less than or equal to 0.003 percent of Zr: 0.05-0.11%, the balance being Co and unavoidable impurities. The invention has the advantages that: the produced high-temperature alloy material has better performance by being matched with the addition of different substances, the content of sundries and the number of air holes can be effectively avoided when the strip is processed, and the toughness of the product is better.

title_en: Die-free-die multi-step spinning forming method for thin-wall rotary body component
abstract_en: The invention provides a die-free-die multi-step spinning forming method for a thin-wall rotary member, which aims to simplify the spinning flow of a large-sized member. The method comprises the steps of firstly preforming the plate material through die-free spinning, flexibly setting single pass or multiple passes, and introducing intermediate heat treatment when necessary. And finally, finishing the final-pass die spinning on the only set of core dies, and ensuring the forming precision. The invention not only reduces the cost of die replacement and debugging, but also greatly shortens the manufacturing cost and production period, and is particularly suitable for the aerospace field with strict requirements on bearing performance, shape precision and light weight, such as the manufacturing of components such as rocket fuel tanks and the like.

title_en: Cold roll forming processing technology for stainless steel high-frequency welded pipe of highway guardrail
abstract_en: The application relates to a cold-bending forming processing technology of a stainless steel high-frequency welded pipe of a highway guardrail, which relates to the technical field of the processing technology of the stainless steel welded pipe and comprises the following steps of S1 uncoiling; leveling S2, detecting S3 band tails, cutting S4 band tails, detecting S5 band heads, cutting S6 band heads, aligning S7, chamfering S8, welding S9, planing S10, storing S11, forming S12, high-frequency welding S13, scraping S14, cooling S15, sizing S16, and correcting S17. The application can optimize the shearing butt welding procedure of the steel strip coil without cutting off the welded section of the two steel strip coils in the stainless steel welded pipe.

title_en: Polishing-free preparation process and application of double-layer metal composite ultrathin belt
abstract_en: The invention provides a polishing-free preparation process and application of a double-layer metal composite ultrathin belt, and relates to the technical field of double-layer metal composite ultrathin belts. The polishing-free preparation process of the double-layer metal composite ultrathin belt comprises the steps of metal base material cutting, annealing before rolling, cleaning, combined rolling of a texturing roller and a traditional flat roller, annealing after rolling, cooling and the like. According to the invention, any two metals such as copper foil, titanium foil and stainless steel are used as base materials, and the high-efficiency compounding under the condition of low reduction rate is realized by optimizing the annealing temperature and the reduction rate, so that the process flow is simplified, and the production efficiency is improved. The surface of the composite ultrathin belt prepared by the invention is in a regular pit array structure, so that the interface bonding strength is obviously improved, and the composite ultrathin belt has the characteristics of hydrophobicity, low thermal conductivity, resistance reduction and electromagnetic wave anti-reflection performance, is suitable for high-end application in aerospace and electronic industry, and has wide prospect.

title_en: Small-aperture intermittent deep hole machining process
abstract_en: The small-aperture intermittent deep hole machining process is formed by machining a small-aperture intermittent deep hole machining tool set, wherein the small-aperture intermittent deep hole machining tool set comprises a first tool, a second tool, a third tool, a fourth tool and a fifth tool. The multi-edge support structure plays a supporting and guiding role in the front section hole during machining through the first multi-edge support shaft and the second multi-edge support shaft, so that the integral machining rigidity and stability are enhanced, the cutter breakage is avoided, the cost of the integral cutter is low, and the machining of the small-aperture intermittent deep hole can be efficiently and reliably completed.

title_en: Vertical machining center
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vertical machining center which comprises a machining table, a Y-axis substrate vertically moving on the machining table, a liquid storage barrel fixedly connected to the Y-axis substrate, a disc rotationally connected to the outside of the liquid storage barrel, a machining assembly arranged on the disc, a water spraying assembly and a chip removing assembly arranged on the disc, wherein during machining, the position of the water spraying assembly is adaptively adjusted through a trigger mechanism, and water spraying, cooling and dust removing are carried out on apertures with different depths at the machining position. When the processing subassembly drills to the work piece, the top surface and the trigger mechanism contact of its work piece, when the degree of depth of processing subassembly drilling increases gradually, trigger mechanism receives the blocking of work piece top surface to trigger water spray subassembly constantly adjustment position, so that the adaptation carries out water spray cooling dust removal to the work piece processing department of different degree of depth, and the cooperation sets up the chip removal subassembly in the processing subassembly both sides, can adsorb the iron fillings that splashes.

title_en: Air tightness test clamp and method for annular channel of combustion chamber diffuser
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of aeroengine manufacturing, in particular to an airtight test clamp and method for an annular channel of a combustion chamber diffuser. The clamp comprises a bottom plate and a cover plate, wherein the bottom plate is used for supporting the diffuser, the cover plate is used for being pressed on the top surface of the diffuser, a lower sealing ring is adhered on the top surface of the bottom plate, an upper sealing ring is adhered on the bottom surface of the cover plate, a stand column is arranged at the central position of the bottom plate, the upper part of the stand column is provided with a screw rod section, a first nut is screwed after the screw rod section extends out of a central hole of the cover plate, a plurality of studs are arranged on the bottom plate, a second nut is screwed after the upper ends of the studs penetrate through the cover plate, and an air nozzle is arranged on the cover plate and is communicated with an annular channel of the diffuser after the diffuser is assembled in the air tightness test clamp. The clamp can seal the upper end face and the lower end face of the diffuser, and effectively detects the air tightness of the annular passage of the diffuser.

title_en: Control method for effectively improving hot feeding and hot loading efficiency of thin pickling plates
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control method for effectively improving the hot feeding and hot loading efficiency of a thin pickling plate, which comprises the following steps of presetting two continuous casting machine split rolling production lines, namely a 2250 production line and a 1780 production line, conveying molten steel to a continuous casting machine for casting, controlling multiple-furnace tapping in a single casting mode to obtain a plate blank, conveying the plate blank to a hot rolling plate blank warehouse, dynamically tracking the cutting time of the plate blank, intensively stacking the plate blank at a stack position if the plate blank can be pre-determined to be filled in a heating furnace within 4 hours, loading the plate blank into the heating furnace in batches, intensively stacking the plate blank in a slow cooling area if the plate blank can be pre-determined to be filled in the heating furnace within 4 hours, and controlling the plate blank to be loaded into the heating furnace in batches within 10 hours to program a rolling plan of the tapping amount of the plate blank. The method can raise the charging temperature of the plate blank, shorten the heating time of the plate blank, reduce the fuel investment and ton steel burnup of the plate blank heating, improve the rolling stability of the thin plate, reduce the number of times of scrap steel and the rolling breaking rate, and reduce the manufacturing cost of the pickling plate.

title_en: Method for brazing graphite/copper dissimilar materials by using diamond particle reinforced AgCuInTi composite solder
abstract_en: A method for brazing graphite/copper dissimilar materials by using diamond particle reinforced AgCuInTi composite solder relates to a method for brazing graphite/copper dissimilar materials. The invention aims to solve the technical problem that the reliable joint cannot be obtained because the direct brazing mode generates great residual stress in the joint due to the great difference of the thermal expansion coefficients of graphite and copper. The AgCuInTi brazing filler metal and diamond particles are uniformly mixed in a ball milling mode to prepare the composite brazing filler metal which is used for brazing graphite/copper dissimilar materials under vacuum. The invention successfully realizes the reliable connection of the graphite/copper dissimilar materials, the room-temperature shearing strength of the joint can reach 30MPa, the problem of high residual stress in the dissimilar material joint is solved, and the application of the graphite/copper dissimilar material component in the fields of nuclear power, radiation protection and the like can be realized.

title_en: Turning process for processing sink roll
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of turning for processing a sink roll, and discloses a turning process for processing the sink roll, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein two sides of the top of the bottom plate are fixedly connected with fixed shells respectively, the sink roll is clamped between the inner walls of two rotating rings, a motor is started, the motor drives a rotating shaft to rotate, the rotating shaft drives a belt to rotate, the belt drives the rotating rings to rotate, the rotating rings drive the sink roll to rotate, the rotating shaft drives a reciprocating screw rod to rotate, the reciprocating screw rod is limited by the bottom plate, the reciprocating screw rod drives a threaded block to reciprocate, the threaded block drives a square shell to reciprocate, the square shell drives a lifting plate to reciprocate, the round rod drives a turning shell to reciprocate, and the turning shell contacts with the rotating sink roll in the reciprocating movement process, so that burrs are removed from the outer wall of the sink roll and residual metal scraps are removed, and the turning effect of the sink roll is improved.

title_en: Nut lifter capable of giving way
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mechanical parts, in particular to a abdication-capable nut lifter, which comprises a screw rod and a supporting rod fixedly connected with the outer wall of the screw rod, wherein the outer wall of the screw rod is provided with an outer meshing layer, the outer wall of the screw rod is slidably provided with a nut in meshed connection with the outer meshing layer, the nut comprises a nut body and a nut inner cavity penetrating through the upper end and the lower end of the nut body, the nut body is penetrated and provided with a through groove with the same angle as the inclination of the outer meshing layer of the screw rod, the through groove is of a spiral groove structure extending downwards from top to bottom along the nut body, a plurality of stabilizing devices are arranged outside the screw rod, the outer wall of each stabilizing device is in meshed connection with the outer wall of the nut body, the upper end and the lower end of each stabilizing device are movably clamped with a limiting box, a rotating shaft is arranged in each limiting box, the stabilizing devices are fixedly sleeved on the rotating shaft, and grooves allowing the screw rod and the supporting rod to penetrate through the limiting box are penetrated and arranged below the limiting box.

title_en: Charging and clamping all-in-one machine for detecting PVC insulating layer on surface of new energy copper bar
abstract_en: The invention relates to a feeding and clamping integrated machine for detecting a PVC insulating layer on the surface of a new energy copper bar, which comprises a processing table and a storage seat arranged on the processing table, wherein a clamping assembly and a rear hanging bracket are also arranged on the processing table, and a carrying assembly is arranged on the rear hanging bracket. The storage seat is respectively provided with a storage groove, carrying convex strips and a pushing component. According to the invention, the loaded copper bar is positioned, and is clamped and fixed for two times in a limiting mode, so that the effect of being convenient to detect is achieved, and the clamped copper bar can be turned by 90 degrees, so that the two parts of the copper bar can be detected by an instrument conveniently.

title_en: Control information correction method, control information correction device, and program
abstract_en: Design information relating to the pass and the shape of the weld bead is acquired, a weld bead model of the weld bead formed in the weld bead layer is obtained based on the design information, and a first overlapping distribution of overlapping regions where the weld bead models overlap with each other is obtained. A narrow part of the weld bead models, which is not overlapped sufficiently, is determined based on the first overlap distribution, and an additional welding amount of the machining material, which is insufficient to complement the overlap of the narrow part, is calculated. The control information is corrected based on the additional welding amount. The additional welding amount is a total value of the missing compensation amount for filling the missing portion and the height adjustment compensation amount for aligning the fusion surface formed by fusing a part of the weld bead with the surface around the missing portion.

title_en: Cutting device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a cutting device, includes guard shield, fuselage, actuating mechanism, output shaft and cutting piece, is equipped with switch, trigger and aggregate unit in the fuselage, aggregate unit include around first axis pivoted push rod, with push rod transmission connection's degree of depth connecting rod, around second axis pivoted axle lock connecting rod and with output shaft complex axle locking plate. The cutting device has a push-down locking state and a push-down unlocking state, the shaft locking plate has an output shaft unlocking position and an output shaft locking position, and the trigger has a safety position and a use position. Shaft lock connecting rod separate transmission the push rod and the shaft locking plate are connected. The shaft lock connecting rod is in a first state before rotation, namely, the cutting device is in a pressing and locking state, the shaft lock plate is in an output shaft unlocking position and the trigger is in a safety position, and is in a second state after rotation, namely, the cutting device is in a pressing and unlocking state, the shaft lock plate is in an output shaft locking position and the trigger is in a safety position. The arrangement is simple and convenient to operate, the hands are liberated, and the cutting piece can be replaced more safely.

title_en: Multi-energy field cooperative auxiliary cutting system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of part cutting processing, in particular to a multi-energy field cooperative auxiliary cutting system. The multi-energy field cooperation auxiliary cutting system comprises a supporting base body, a cutting tool, an electric pulse device and an ultrasonic vibration device, wherein the ultrasonic vibration device comprises an ultrasonic vibration generation module, the cutting tool is arranged at the output end of the ultrasonic vibration generation module, the ultrasonic vibration generation module comprises an ultrasonic module installation seat which is arranged on the supporting base body in a position-adjustable mode, the ultrasonic module installation seat is arranged at the position of a wave node of the ultrasonic vibration generation module, which corresponds to ultrasonic vibration, an electric connection module of the electric pulse device comprises a pulse module installation seat and an electric connection piece arranged on the pulse module installation seat, the electric connection piece is used for being electrically connected with a workpiece to transmit pulse current with the workpiece, and the pulse module installation seat is arranged on the ultrasonic module installation seat to realize integrated installation, thereby being beneficial to simplifying an installation structure and reducing cost.

title_en: Continuous casting and rolling unit for aluminum-titanium-boron alloy rod
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hot continuous rolling, in particular to an aluminum titanium boron alloy rod continuous casting continuous rolling unit which comprises a row of hot rolling mills in butt joint, wherein two adjacent hot rolling mills are relatively distributed, each hot rolling mill comprises a machine tool, two symmetrically distributed roll shafts driven on the machine tool, a roll fixed at one end of each roll shaft, an L-shaped shaft seat for supporting the roll shafts, and an assembly mechanism for lubricating and cooling water supply attached to the L-shaped shaft seat, wherein a heat exchange tube cavity is formed in a solid formed by the roll shafts and the roll shafts.

title_en: Circular capacitor strip cutting device and cutting method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of sawing devices, in particular to a circular capacitor strip cutting device which comprises a support, wherein the top end of the support is fixedly connected with a second frame, a fixing assembly, a conveying assembly and a cutting assembly are arranged in the second frame, a placing assembly is arranged at the top end of the support, the fixing assembly comprises a conveying opening fixedly connected to the middle of the second frame, a plurality of second pneumatic rods are arranged on the outer side of the conveying opening, and a device box is arranged in the second frame.

title_en: High-strength and high-toughness aluminum alloy single wire and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-strength and high-toughness aluminum alloy single wire, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the high-strength and high-toughness aluminum alloy single wire comprises ：Si 0.40-0.70wt％,Mg 0.50-0.90wt％,Fe 0.10-0.20wt％,Ni 0.05-0.20wt％,Cu 0.005-0.01wt％,B<0.03wt％,Mn+Ti+V+Cr<0.02wt％, percent of Al in balance by mass percent. The aluminum alloy single wire provided by the invention has the advantages that the tensile strength and the elongation of the single wire are effectively improved while the high conductivity of 52.5% IACS are ensured, the strength of extension is higher than 363MPa, the elongation is higher than 4.5%, the aluminum alloy single wire is used for an aluminum alloy core of an overhead conductor, the wire tension-weight ratio is effectively improved, and the power transmission loss and the production cost are reduced.

title_en: Brush carrier assembly equipment
abstract_en: The application provides brush holder assembly equipment which comprises a machine table, a circulating material assembly, a brush holder feeding assembly, a material moving seat, a material moving position moving unit, an assembly seat and an assembly lifting piece. The automatic feeding device can realize automatic feeding operation of the brush holder body through the brush holder feeding assembly, the brush holder body on the brush holder feeding assembly can be picked up and transferred to an assembly position through the material transferring seat and the material transferring position shifting unit, the circulating movement of a plurality of material seats can be realized through the circulating material assembly, and each material seat can be used for supporting a motor shell. When the material seat bearing the motor casing moves to the assembly position, the assembly lifting piece drives the assembly seat to ascend, so that the material seat is matched with the assembly seat to clamp and fix the material seat, and the brush holder body on the material seat can be assembled on the motor casing. Therefore, the brush frame assembly equipment can realize automatic feeding of the brush frame body, automatic feeding of the motor shell and automatic assembly of the brush frame body and the motor shell, is beneficial to improving the automatic assembly capability and reducing the labor cost.

title_en: Perovskite battery double-light-path laser etching method and device
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of laser etching and discloses a perovskite battery double-light-path laser etching method and device, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out deposition treatment on a perovskite substrate to obtain a perovskite battery basic structure; the method comprises the steps of collecting optical parameters of a perovskite battery basic structure to generate structural parameter data, carrying out parameter sampling based on the structural parameter data to obtain a double-light-path laser etching initial parameter set, carrying out three-dimensional convex polyhedron construction and point coordinate projection on the double-light-path laser etching initial parameter set to obtain a double-light-path laser etching process constraint model, carrying out mixed integer linear programming calculation on a front light path and a back light path to obtain optimal etching parameters, and applying the optimal etching parameters to a double-light-path laser system to carry out synchronous etching treatment on the perovskite battery basic structure to obtain the perovskite battery etching structure.

title_en: Method for preparing ultra-wide spectrum and ultra-high absorption aluminum plane black body by using inert gas to assist femtosecond laser
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing an ultra-wide spectrum and ultra-high absorption aluminum plane black body by using an inert gas assisted femtosecond laser, which belongs to the technical field of laser micro-nano processing. The method is to adjust the background gas used in the femtosecond laser processing process into inert gas, the plasma shielding effect in the laser processing process is restrained, the corresponding conical micro-nano composite structure has higher aspect ratio and sharper conical tip, the primary reflection of the conical micro-nano composite structure is small, the incident electromagnetic wave can be ensured to completely enter the gap of the adjacent conical micro-nano composite structure, and the incident electromagnetic wave is absorbed layer by layer through multiple internal reflection. The typical structure features of the invention are conical micro-nano composite structure, and the aluminum alloy plane black body with light absorption of more than 98.5% in the range of ultraviolet to long-wave infrared is prepared by optimizing the geometric light capturing effect of the microstructure, the effective medium effect of the nano oxide layer and the nitride layer and the resonance light absorption.

title_en: Manufacturing method of high impact-resistant and corrosion-resistant four-way joint for fracturing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a manufacturing method of a high impact-resistant and corrosion-resistant four-way body for fracturing, which comprises the following steps of S1 preparing a raw material blank of the four-way body, S2, opening and thickening the raw material blank of the four-way body and performing heat treatment, S3, drilling another vertical central channel I of the four-way body, S4, fixing the four-way body on a lathe, finish turning the central channel I, finish turning the central channel II, reaming a hole III at the junction of the finish turning central channel, S5, polishing a large round angle IV at the junction of the central channel, S6, cleaning and drying the four-way body, S7, performing heat spraying tungsten carbide hardening treatment on the inner surface V at the junction of the central channel of the four-way body by using HVOF equipment, S8, finishing six faces of the four-way body, finishing ring grooves and four end face wire-planting holes connected with the drilled central channel holes, S9, checking and printing marks.

title_en: Special welding device for high-temperature-resistant special gate valve
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of welding facilities and discloses a special welding device for a high-temperature-resistant special gate valve, which comprises a supporting mechanism, wherein the supporting mechanism comprises a first supporting frame, a first groove is formed in the inner wall of the first supporting frame, a first connecting block is fixedly connected to the outer wall of the first supporting frame, a second connecting block is fixedly connected to the outer wall of one end, far away from the first supporting frame, of the first connecting block, which is positioned at the left side and the right side, when the valves for mounting pipelines with different diameters are subjected to welding operation, the welding areas of the valves with different diameters are positioned through an adjusting mechanism, when the special gate valve is subjected to welding operation, a plurality of surfaces of the special gate valve possibly need to be subjected to processing welding, and a third driving motor is used for enabling a second sliding frame to rotate, so that after the processing welding operation of one surface is finished, the valves do not need to be disassembled and then are re-fixed, and the welding efficiency is improved.

title_en: Ultrasonic vibration auxiliary grinding and polishing device
abstract_en: An ultrasonic vibration assisted grinding and polishing device comprises a shell unit, a main shaft unit, a power supply unit, a vibration reduction unit and a grinding and polishing unit. The spindle unit includes a rotating shaft capable of rotating and defining a hollow portion. The vibration unit is arranged in the hollow part in a penetrating way and is spaced from the rotating shaft, and is used for converting electric energy into ultrasonic vibration energy. The vibration damping unit comprises a plurality of buffering pieces which encircle between the rotating shaft and the vibration unit. The grinding and polishing unit comprises a conducting disc connected with the rotating shaft and the vibration unit, and a grinding wheel detachably arranged on the conducting disc. The conductive disc is for conducting the vibrational energy to the grinding wheel. Therefore, the vibration unit is supported by the buffer piece, vibration conduction to the rotating shaft is reduced, and concentricity and stability of the vibration unit and the rotating shaft are improved.

title_en: Nib protective sheath installation mechanism and installation line
abstract_en: The invention provides a nib protective sleeve mounting mechanism and a mounting line, and relates to the technical field of nib protective sleeve mounting, wherein the nib protective sleeve mounting mechanism comprises a protective sleeve runner for orderly supplying protective sleeves for subsequent steps; the pen comprises a sheath flow channel, an opening and closing control module, a sheath mounting mechanism and a rotary driving mechanism, wherein the sheath flow channel is controlled to be cut off, the sheath mounting mechanism is used for accommodating a sheath supplied by the sheath flow channel, the rotary driving mechanism is used for driving the sheath mounting mechanism to rotate, and the power mechanism is used for mounting the sheath in the sheath mounting mechanism on the pen. The automatic pencil point protection sleeve mounting device can automatically take the protection sleeve, then the protection sleeve is mounted on the pencil, and further the manual mounting of the protection sleeve is replaced, so that the automatic pencil point protection sleeve mounting device has the advantages of being higher in efficiency and lower in cost, the mounting line in the scheme can also realize automatic adjustment of the feeding posture of the pencil rod and defective product removal after the protection sleeve is mounted, and the automation degree and the production efficiency of the pencil point protection sleeve mounting are further improved.

title_en: Lifting hook type shot blasting machine for elevator traction sheave
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lifting hook type shot blasting machine for an elevator traction sheave, which comprises a shot blasting machine body, wherein a door-shaped support is arranged on a side surface of the shot blasting machine body, a horizontal conveyor is fixedly arranged on the door-shaped support, a horizontal moving seat is arranged on the horizontal conveyor, and a hydraulic component is fixedly arranged at the lower end of the horizontal moving seat. According to the invention, the conical brackets on the connecting seats are matched through the first connecting rods, the spring buffer rods and the second connecting rods between the first rotating connectors and the second rotating connectors, so that stable support is effectively provided for the traction sheave hanger which is matched with the hanging tool and the hanging ring for hanging, the traction sheave hanger is prevented from shaking greatly when moving, the shot blasting processing effect is ensured, the hanging tool is driven to vertically descend through the hydraulic component matched with the frame type frame, the hanging rod and the hanging hook, and the hanging tool is pulled to be matched with the lock chain to be connected with the hanging ring in a hanging mode for hanging the traction sheave hanger, so that the butt joint operation is convenient, time and labor are saved.

title_en: Welding device and welding method for special-shaped butt joint part
abstract_en: The invention discloses a welding device and a welding method for special-shaped butt joint parts, which relate to the technical field of special-shaped part welding and comprise a clamping unit, a welding device and a welding device, wherein the clamping unit comprises a mounting seat and a mounting shell arranged on the mounting seat, and the clamping part is arranged on the installation shell and comprises a rotating assembly and a clamping assembly, wherein the rotating assembly is arranged on the installation shell. According to the invention, the rotating assembly and the clamping assembly are arranged, so that the special-shaped parts can be stably fixed on a horizontal plane when being processed, the accurate alignment and stability of the parts in the welding process are ensured, the welding precision is improved, the special-shaped parts are uniformly rotated in the processing process, the welding defects caused by local overheating or uneven heating are avoided, the pause time in the welding process is reduced, the welding speed is improved, the whole welding period is shortened, the production efficiency is improved, meanwhile, the possible errors in the manual operation process are reduced, and the labor intensity of operators is also reduced.

title_en: Mechanism for precisely assembling display inner screen by multiple acupuncture points and implementation method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of display screen assembly devices, and particularly relates to a mechanism for accurately assembling a display inner screen by multiple acupuncture points, wherein the assembly mechanism comprises an inner screen supplying module, a manipulator module, an inner screen positioning module, an inner screen taking and placing module and a product positioning module; the manipulator module is used for taking the inner screens with the same number as that of the inner screen acupoints from the inner screen supply module at one time and placing the inner screens in the inner screen acupoints, the inner screen positioning assembly is used for adjusting and positioning the positions of the inner screens in the inner screen acupoints, the product positioning assembly is used for adjusting and positioning the positions of the products in the product acupoints after the product carrier is loaded with the products to a set position, and the inner screen taking and placing module is used for taking all the inner screens at the inner screen positioning module at one time and moving the inner screens to the positions above the product positioning module to finish assembly. The invention is used for solving the technical problem that the conventional display inner screen assembly equipment cannot realize simultaneous and accurate assembly of a plurality of products at a time.

title_en: High-strength copper steel bimetal composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-strength copper steel bimetal composite material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps of: selecting copper and steel base materials for preparing the high-strength copper-steel bimetal composite material, welding the copper and steel base materials by adopting an electron beam additive manufacturing technology, scanning welding seams of the copper-steel bimetal composite material by utilizing an ultrasonic detection system, analyzing and processing scanned images by a computer, carrying out secondary processing on the copper-steel bimetal composite material by adopting a rolling compounding method, quenching the copper-steel bimetal composite material, checking the performance of the high-strength copper-steel bimetal composite material, and storing preparation data to a cloud end by a computer. According to the method, the electron beam additive manufacturing technology is combined with the rolling compounding method, so that the strength of the copper-steel composite material can be improved in the preparation process, the composite material is detected through the ultrasonic detection system, the qualification rate of the composite material can be screened, and the performance of the composite material can be further enhanced through annealing treatment.

title_en: Arc additive manufacturing process for homogeneous and heterogeneous low-alloy high-strength steel structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses an arc additive process of a homogeneous and heterogeneous low-alloy high-strength steel structure, which relates to the technical field of arc additive manufacturing and comprises the steps of carrying out heat treatment and tensile test on a low-alloy high-strength steel wire to obtain test data, establishing a process parameter-performance prediction model according to the test data, obtaining the performance requirement of a target structural member, utilizing the process parameter-performance prediction model to draw the process parameter according to the performance requirement, carrying out arc additive on the low-alloy high-strength steel wire by utilizing an arc additive manufacturing system to obtain the low-alloy high-strength steel structural member, utilizing an infrared thermal imager to obtain the temperature information of the low-alloy high-strength steel structural member, regulating the process parameter according to the temperature information in real time to obtain the target structural member, realizing gradient distribution of precipitation strengthening phases, realizing in-situ strengthening of homogeneous and heterogeneous low-alloy high-strength steel materials by alloy elements, and meeting the diversified requirements of the target structural member on different strengths and plasticity.

title_en: Aluminum plate-based energy-saving curtain wall material production method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of defect detection, in particular to a production method of an energy-saving curtain wall material based on an aluminum plate, which comprises the steps of determining folds to be processed on the aluminum plate to mark bending characteristic areas, screening bending defect risk areas according to area images and the folds to be processed, carrying out sectional bending on the aluminum plate, determining characteristic monitoring time windows according to the position distribution of the bending defect risk areas, irradiating each bending defect risk area on the aluminum plate to obtain reflected light intensity, determining bending defect characterization values of all bending defect risk areas to judge whether bending defects exist in the sectional bending, punching, welding and surface treatment are performed on the aluminum plate subjected to bending so as to finish processing of an aluminum plate material, and further, the rapid detection and identification of the bending defect risk areas in the production process of the aluminum plate-based energy-saving curtain wall material are realized, the detection means are adaptively adjusted, the yield of the aluminum plate is improved, and the overall quality of the curtain wall is improved.

title_en: Device for continuously cutting lithium belt by laser and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses equipment for continuously cutting a lithium belt by laser and a using method thereof, and relates to the technical field of lithium metal battery processing. Including unwinding shaft and winding shaft, set gradually vacuum income traction roller, laser cutting mechanism, vacuum play traction roller and the subassembly of unloading between unwinding shaft and the winding shaft, unwinding shaft with connect from the type membrane between the winding shaft, from the lithium area that the sticky wait to cut of type membrane upper surface, vacuum income traction roller and vacuum play traction roller pull jointly from the type membrane from unwinding shaft forward motion to winding shaft, from the type membrane from unwinding shaft forward motion to winding shaft in-process, laser cutting mechanism will glue the lithium area that glues at from type membrane upper surface and cut into a plurality of lithium pieces, the subassembly of unloading is with the lithium piece that cuts from type membrane upper surface transfer collection. The equipment can be used for mass production of lithium metal pole pieces, and has the advantages of high production efficiency, stable equipment, high speed, high cutting precision, easy control of product size and high cutting precision.

title_en: CCD automatic pre-alignment inner layer punching machine for PCB
