abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of punching machines and discloses a CCD automatic pre-alignment inner layer punching machine for a PCB, which comprises a bottom frame, wherein the inner side surface of the bottom frame is fixedly connected with a bottom plate, the upper part of the bottom frame is fixedly connected with a top frame, the bottom surface of the bottom plate is provided with a driving mechanism, the upper part of the bottom plate is provided with a punching mechanism, the lower part of the punching mechanism is provided with a supporting mechanism, the left side and the right side of the bottom plate are both provided with positioning mechanisms, the punching mechanism comprises a moving block, the bottom surface of the moving block is fixedly connected with a hydraulic rod, the outer wall of the hydraulic rod is fixedly connected with a fixing plate, the upper surface of the fixing plate is fixedly connected with four vertical guide rods, the outer surface of the vertical guide rods is in sliding connection with a sliding plate, the middle position of the sliding plate is fixedly connected with an inner cavity pressing rod, and the bottom end of the inner cavity pressing rod is in threaded connection with a punching tool bit.

title_en: Titanium steel dissimilar metal welding device, method and application based on infrared laser-blue laser
abstract_en: The invention provides a device, a method and application for welding dissimilar metals of titanium steel based on infrared laser-blue laser, belonging to the technical field of composite welding, wherein the device comprises: the laser system is arranged on the six-axis mechanical arm and comprises a beam splitting module, a blue laser collimation module and an infrared laser collimation module, wherein the beam splitting module is connected with a CCD vision sensing module, the CCD vision sensing module is respectively connected with a video monitor and an optical path reflecting device, the video monitor is connected with a terminal controller, the infrared laser collimation module is connected with an infrared laser, the blue laser collimation module is connected with a blue laser, the blue laser and the infrared laser are respectively connected with a water cooling device through pipelines, and the water cooling device is connected with a composite laser controller. The invention has strong process flexibility, is suitable for different thicknesses and joint types by adjusting the laser power and the wire feeding speed, overcomes the problems of unstable molten pool and poor interface combination in dissimilar metal welding, and provides a reliable scheme for complex structure welding.

title_en: Low-resistance aluminum alloy conductor and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of aluminum alloy conductors, and provides a low-resistance aluminum alloy conductor and a preparation method thereof. The low-resistance aluminum alloy conductor comprises the following components in percentage by mass: yb:0.03% -0.07%, er:0.02% -0.03%, sc:0.005% -0.007%, Y:0.008% -0.020%, zr:0.02% -0.06%, nb:0.04% -0.12%, ti:0.008% -0.025%, mg:0.5% -0.8%, si: less than or equal to 0.10 percent, zn:0.15% -0.30%, the balance being Al and unavoidable impurities. According to the low-resistance aluminum alloy conductor, the aluminum alloy conductor material with uniform alloy components, good conductivity and stable mechanical property is realized by optimizing the raw material proportion and the preparation process.

title_en: Side frame auxiliary welding frock
abstract_en: The invention discloses an auxiliary welding tool for a side frame. The utility model provides a limit car frame auxiliary welding frock, including the first positioning mechanism that is used for fixing a position first steel pipe, a second positioning mechanism that is used for fixing a position the second steel pipe, a third positioning mechanism that is used for fixing a position the third rod end, a fourth positioning mechanism that is used for fixing a position the protection steel pipe, a drive screw that is used for driving second positioning mechanism and third positioning mechanism and a power unit that is used for driving drive screw, power unit is connected with drive screw, first positioning mechanism, a second positioning mechanism, a third positioning mechanism, fourth positioning mechanism slides and establishes on the base, fourth positioning mechanism is connected with third positioning mechanism, drive screw has first screw thread section and second screw thread section, first screw thread section and third positioning mechanism spiro union, second screw thread section and second positioning mechanism spiro union, the pitch of first screw thread section is less than the pitch of second screw thread section. The auxiliary welding tool for the side frame can align the welding positions of all steel pipes of the side frame at one time.

title_en: Stamping die for intelligent manufacturing of server case shell
abstract_en: The invention discloses a stamping die for intelligent manufacturing of a server chassis shell, which relates to the technical field of intelligent manufacturing and comprises a frame and a positioning assembly, wherein the positioning assembly is arranged around the frame and comprises a transmission wheel set, the transmission wheel set is symmetrically arranged around the frame, one end of the transmission wheel set is connected with a driving wheel, the other end of the transmission wheel set is provided with a synchronous wheel, one side of the synchronous wheel is provided with a rack, one side of the rack is connected with a positioning plate, and two sides of the positioning plate are symmetrically provided with limiting plates. When the automatic positioning device is used, after the materials are placed, the materials can be automatically positioned through the mechanical structure, so that positioning deviation caused by camera pollution or light and other problems in vision auxiliary positioning is avoided, scraps and lubrication can be removed from the materials in the stamping process, excessive abrasion of the device and the materials caused by scraps blockage or overlarge friction is avoided, and the materials can be jacked up to be convenient to discharge after the stamping is completed.

title_en: Integrative equipment of tooth is attacked in fastener cold heading
abstract_en: The invention provides a fastener cold heading and tapping integrated device, which belongs to the technical field of cold heading and tapping, and comprises a workbench, wherein a bearing mechanism, a forming mechanism, a moving mechanism, a tapping die holder mechanism, a shielding backflow assembly, a detection blanking assembly, a laser sensor, a vibration sensor and a vibration sensor, wherein the vibration sensor is matched with the rotation of an electromagnetic plate, the nut can be detected from different angles and positions, detection blind areas are avoided, when the electromagnetic plate rotates to an inclined state, the space structure formed at the upper part of two sides of the die holder box can shield external light interference, the electromagnetic plate not only provides an installation basis for the laser sensor to drive the sensor to change the angle so as to realize multi-angle detection, but also participates in the blanking process after the detection is qualified, the detection and blanking function integration are realized by controlling the rotation angle of the electromagnetic plate and the contact and separation of a contact switch, and the blanking signal is triggered, and the vibration generated when the nut is adsorbed on the electromagnetic plate can shake oil scraps and reduce stress.

title_en: Filling material for 6XXX series aluminum alloy and welding process thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a filling material for 6XXX series aluminum alloy and a welding process thereof, belonging to the technical field of aluminum alloy. The filling material comprises the elements of ：Si 0.5%-2.00%、Mg 0.80%-2.00%、Cu 0.20%-3.00%、Cr 0.20%-0.50%、Mn 0.50%-0.80%、Ti 0-0.10%、Zn 0.15%-2.00%、Fe 0-0.15%、 percent by mass, the balance of Al and other unavoidable impurities, and the total impurity is 0-0.15 percent. The filler material has good weldability, promotes a precipitation strengthening mechanism, has the same composition as the strengthening elements of the base metal of the 6XXX series aluminum alloy, can be applied to the welding of the 6XXX series aluminum alloy in a plurality of welding modes, reduces the dilution of the strengthening elements of the welding line, and can effectively and simultaneously improve the mechanical properties of the welding line and the heat affected zone of the joint.

title_en: Grinding wheel self-sharpening enhancement method and device and wafer thinning equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of semiconductor wafer processing, and provides a grinding wheel self-sharpening enhancement method and device and wafer thinning equipment. The method includes determining a main flushing position, judging whether the grinding wheel is processed by an outer edge based on the position of a grinding line of the grinding wheel for grinding a wafer and the rotation direction of the wafer, if so, the main flushing position is outside the grinding wheel, if not, the main flushing position is inside the grinding wheel, setting the spraying pressure and the swinging frequency of the flusher at the main flushing position to be respectively larger than those of the flusher at the opposite side, determining the flushing direction of the flusher based on the adhesion state of abrasive particles forming the grinding wheel and the adhesion state of pollutants on the grinding wheel, and adjusting the spraying pressure and the swinging frequency of the flusher based on the ratio of the feeding speed of the grinding wheel to the set feeding speed in the grinding process. The grinding wheel self-sharpening device can effectively enhance the self-sharpening property of the grinding wheel, simultaneously provide protection for tooth grinding, and improve the thinning quality and efficiency of the wafer.

title_en: Reinforcing bar torsion device for reinforcing bar mechanical connection
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of steel bar mechanical connection, in particular to a steel bar torsion device for steel bar mechanical connection, which comprises a carrying operation vehicle for moving, wherein a control assembly for personnel to operate is fixedly connected to the top surface of the carrying operation vehicle, a three-phase asynchronous motor is arranged below the control assembly and fixedly connected with the carrying operation vehicle, a torque wrench for clamping steel bars is connected to an output shaft of the three-phase asynchronous motor through a transmission assembly in a transmission manner, and the control assembly is electrically connected with the three-phase asynchronous motor. According to the three-phase asynchronous motor, the torque wrench is driven by the transmission assembly to accurately fasten the straight threaded sleeve, so that the strength and stability of the connecting joint are effectively ensured. The invention has reasonable design and simple and convenient operation, greatly reduces the investment of labor cost, effectively improves the construction efficiency, and effectively ensures the safety in the operation process through the control component.

title_en: New process for producing seamless steel tube and titanium alloy seamless tube in parallel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new process for producing seamless steel pipes and titanium alloy seamless pipes in parallel, which is additionally provided with an electric furnace and an induction coil, and can well realize the aim of alternately rolling the seamless steel pipes and the titanium alloy seamless pipes by arranging a series of technical measures such as a material distribution form of a heating furnace, a discharging rule of a pipe blank, a rapid switching rule of a rolling mode and the like, wherein the quality and the dimensional precision of seamless steel pipes and titanium alloy seamless pipe products all meet the expected requirements.

title_en: Multistation plate punching and feeding production line
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-station plate punching and feeding production line, which belongs to the technical field of hydraulic equipment and comprises a punching hydraulic unit consisting of N hydraulic presses, wherein a directional conveying frame is fixedly matched with a hydraulic platform of each hydraulic press, a pulley guide frame is fixedly matched with one side of the directional conveying frame, which is low in horizontal height, a feeding conveying frame is fixedly matched with the left side of the pulley guide frame, a connecting conveying frame is fixedly matched with the right side of the pulley guide frame, when N is set to be 2, a discharging conveying frame is fixedly matched with the right side of a second pulley guide frame, when N is set to be more than 2, a connecting conveying frame is fixedly matched with the right side of the second pulley guide frame, and the like, a connecting conveying frame of N-1 is fixedly matched with the left side of the N pulley guide frame, a discharging conveying frame is fixedly matched with the right side of the N, wherein N is a positive integer greater than or equal to 2. The plate punching feeding and discharging process can realize efficient, accurate and high-automation plate punching feeding and discharging processes.

title_en: Composite material for fire-fighting blanket and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a composite material for a fire-fighting blanket and other methods thereof, belonging to the technical field of fire-fighting materials. The composite material for the fire-fighting fire blanket comprises, by weight, 40-50 parts of phenolic resin, 20-30 parts of acrylic resin, 4-8 parts of hexamethylenetetramine, 1-3 parts of polyol glycidyl ether, 15-20 parts of ammonium polyphosphate, 4-10 parts of pentaerythritol, 1-2 parts of a dispersing agent, 10-15 parts of a fire extinguishing agent microcapsule, 5-10 parts of poly N-isopropyl acrylamide and 5-10 parts of a solvent. In addition, the invention also provides a preparation method of the composite material for the fire blanket. The composite material provided by the invention can realize repeated fire extinguishment of the fire blanket.

title_en: High-pressure valve surface polishing device and polishing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-pressure valve surface polishing device which comprises a main body unit and an operation unit, wherein the main body unit comprises a box body, the operation unit comprises a first partition plate, a screen plate is connected to the inner wall of the box body in a sliding manner, abrasive materials are filled above the first partition plate, a plurality of vertical plates are symmetrically and fixedly connected to the bottom surface of the screen plate, gas collecting pipes are symmetrically and fixedly connected to the bottom wall of the box body, lifting assemblies for driving the vertical plates to move are symmetrically arranged on the gas collecting pipes, a plurality of gas outlet assemblies are symmetrically arranged on the box body, a charging assembly is arranged on the bottom wall of the box body, a power assembly is arranged on the charging assembly, and a pushing assembly is arranged between the power assembly and the charging assembly. According to the invention, the electromagnetic valve is opened, the first piston plate is driven to move outwards under the air pressure, so that the ejector rods move to two sides, the vertical plate is driven to move upwards through the cooperation of the ejector rods and the inclined openings, the screen plate is driven to move upwards, and the processed valve is lifted upwards, so that the valve is convenient for workers to take.

title_en: Robot clamping jaw and discharging method
abstract_en: The application discloses a robot clamping jaw and a blanking method, which relate to the technical field of semiconductor manufacturing, the robot clamping jaw comprises an upper sheet control device, a lower sheet control device, a supporting structure connected to the end parts of the upper sheet control device and a plurality of absorption part groups uniformly arranged on the supporting structure, and a telescopic moving mechanism is arranged on part of the absorption part groups. When the movable mechanism is extended or shortened, the planes of the wafers on the adsorption piece group connected with the movable mechanism and the planes of the wafers on the rest adsorption piece groups are parallel to each other and form an interval, so that the picking and placing of a plurality of wafers can be realized simultaneously. Through the arrangement, the wafer picking and placing device has the advantages that the technical effect of picking and placing a plurality of wafers at a time is achieved, the wafer picking and placing efficiency is improved, and meanwhile the occupied time of the robot clamping jaw is reduced.

title_en: Cutting method of main beam of retired wind power blade
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cutting method of a retired wind power blade girder, which comprises the following steps of S1, screening girders, S2, S3, web cutting, S4, skin cutting, S5, and S5, cutting a girder plate into girder strips on a fourth cutting platform, wherein the girders with unqualified sizes are sent to the first cutting platform, and the girders with unqualified sizes are cut into qualified sizes. Compared with the prior art that the main beam strip is firstly processed and then the web plate and the skin are cut off, the method adopts the steps that the web plate and the skin are firstly removed, and the main beam strip is manufactured after the main beam plate with qualified size is obtained. Because the size of the girder plate is qualified, the girder bar with qualified size can be directly manufactured through the fourth cutting platform, and the problems of low cutting efficiency, high cost and large deviation of the girder bar size in the prior art are effectively solved.

title_en: Chip centralized chip removal machine for machine tool
abstract_en: The invention discloses a chip centralized chip removing machine for a machine tool, which belongs to the technical field of chip removal of machine tools and comprises a frame, a separation type conveying mechanism and a compact type collecting structure, wherein a material collecting box is fixedly arranged on the frame, the material collecting box is fixedly provided with the separation type conveying mechanism, the compact type collecting structure for collecting chips is arranged on the material collecting box, the lower side of the left end of the separation type conveying mechanism is provided with the compact type collecting structure for collecting chips, the separation type conveying mechanism comprises a magnetic absorption conveying assembly, the separation type conveying assembly and a cleaning mechanism, the magnetic absorption conveying assembly is arranged on the material collecting box, the separation type conveying assembly is provided with the separation type conveying mechanism, the movable end of the separation type conveying assembly is sleeved on the outer side of the movable end of the magnetic absorption conveying assembly, and the cleaning mechanism for further cleaning the separation type conveying assembly is arranged on the left side of the magnetic absorption conveying assembly. Through the mode, the movable ends of the magnetic adsorption conveying assembly and the separating mechanism are attached in the material collecting box and separated at the upper side of the compact collecting structure, so that the adsorption force on chips is changed.

title_en: Tool for trimming retainer of aligning roller bearing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of bearing retainer trimming, and discloses a trimming tool for a self-aligning roller bearing retainer, which comprises a dust collection bin, wherein a supporting ring is supported at the top of the dust collection bin, a supporting mechanism is supported at the inner side of the supporting ring, the supporting mechanism comprises a supporting disc fixedly connected with the inner side of the supporting ring, a plurality of groups of clamping mechanisms are uniformly arranged at the top of the supporting disc, each clamping mechanism comprises an elastic clamping plate, the trimming tool for the self-aligning roller bearing retainer is used for supporting a retainer main body through the supporting ring, two groups of polishing assemblies are symmetrically arranged on the diagonal lines, trimming and polishing are respectively carried out on open windows at two ends of the retainer main body, the open windows at two ends of the retainer main body can be adapted through the reverse design of two groups of polishing heads, the trimming and polishing work of the open windows at the upper end and the lower end of the retainer main body can be simultaneously completed, further the working efficiency is improved, and the requirement of later overturning is avoided.

title_en: Device for measuring heat conduction silicone grease oil release rate
abstract_en: The application discloses a device for measuring the oil separation rate of heat conduction silicone grease, which comprises a base, a first ground glass sheet and a second ground glass sheet, wherein an inner groove is formed in the top of the base, the first ground glass sheet is combined with the inner groove, a top frame is fixedly arranged on the top of the base through a supporting frame, a driving rod is connected to the top of the top frame in a screwing mode, a pushing rod is connected to the bottom of the driving rod in a clamping mode, and a limiting assembly for limiting axial offset of the pushing rod is arranged between the pushing rod and the top frame. According to the application, the pressing block is stably abutted against the top of the ground glass sheet II under the action of the spring, at the moment, the clamping assembly is used for completing the combined clamping of the ground glass sheet I and the ground glass sheet II, at the moment, the positioning rod is rotated to separate from the outer surface wall of the fixing frame, the integral supporting frame is pushed, the sucker slides along the top of the ground glass sheet II until the sucker is completely separated, and at the moment, the ground glass sheet I and the ground glass sheet II can be separated from each other independently, so that the ground glass sheet I and the ground glass sheet II can be conveniently and conveniently transferred manually.

title_en: Method and system for realizing dynamic regulation and control of vacuum environment micro-area inert gas protection atmosphere
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for dynamically regulating and controlling inert gas protection atmosphere in a micro-area of a vacuum environment, which relate to the field of welding, and are used for establishing a dynamic prediction and closed-loop control system for the atmosphere in the welding area by combining flow field simulation prediction with real-time monitoring feedback of a sensor, and accurately regulating inert gas flow, mixing proportion and vacuum pumping rate in real time, so that the oxygen content in the welding area is ensured to be accurately and stably controlled to be less than or equal to 50ppm, the problem of oxidation defect when easily oxidized metal materials are welded is effectively solved, the welding cost is reduced, the welding quality is improved, and the method and the system are widely applicable to the high-end manufacturing fields such as aerospace, automobile manufacturing and the like.

title_en: Dual-mode energy-saving adjustment method for hot-rolling line heating furnace
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of furnace top reversing control of a heating furnace, and particularly discloses a dual-mode energy-saving adjustment method of a hot rolling line heating furnace, comprising the following steps of 1) controlling the temperature of the heating furnace, namely controlling the temperature of a hot-feeding plate blank in the heating furnace to be above 600 ℃, and controlling the temperature of the environment in the first section of heating furnace to be 900 ℃; the invention adopts the dispersed reversing to flexibly adjust the high temperature section of the heating furnace to balance the temperature difference of the plate blank, the temperature difference of the plate blank is effectively controlled to be within 15 ℃, the low temperature section adopts the concentrated reversing to stop the combustion of the low temperature section by one key with high hot charging rate, the gas consumption is reduced, the oxidation burning loss is reduced by 0.02 percent, and the concentrated reversing and the dispersed reversing are synchronously designed and used by combining the heating technology, thereby realizing the waste heat recovery function of the heat accumulating type heating furnace.

title_en: Diaphragm plate cutting device for manufacturing steel box girder
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of cutting equipment, and particularly relates to a diaphragm plate cutting device for manufacturing a steel box girder, which comprises a base and further comprises: the automatic plate cutting device comprises a conveying mechanism, an automatic cutting mechanism, two groups of extrusion limiting mechanisms, a plate thickness feedback mechanism, a plate cutting in-place feedback mechanism, a pre-cutting starting mechanism and a cutting feeding speed follow-up regulation and control mechanism. The invention can automatically transfer the steel plate to be cut to continuously produce a plurality of transverse baffles, can judge the residual cutting space of the steel plate according to the width of the required transverse baffles to be cut and feed back signals, can automatically regulate and control the extrusion limiting force according to the thickness of the steel plate to avoid the deformation and residual stress of the thin steel plate, can confirm whether to pre-cut according to the thickness and the hardness of the steel plate to prevent cutting cracking and roughening, and can automatically adjust the feeding speed based on the cutting resistance of the disc cutter to prevent overload damage of the cutter.

title_en: Bent pipe flange cutting device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of bent pipe flange machining, and discloses a bent pipe flange machining device which comprises a base, wherein a machine table is fixedly arranged at the top of the base, a cutting opening is formed in the surface of the machine table, a driving motor is arranged on one side of the machine table, a screw rod is rotatably arranged at the output end of the driving motor, a rotary cutting mechanism is arranged on one side of the surface of the machine table, positioning mechanisms are arranged above and below the rotary cutting mechanism, a material removing mechanism is arranged at one end, far away from the rotary cutting mechanism, of the machine table, the bent pipe flange is kept to rotate along the axis of a wheel disc in the rotary cutting process through the arranged positioning mechanisms, the quality difference at the front end and the rear end is prevented, so that the bent pipe flange is prevented from shaking and shifting, the cutting precision is further improved, the material removing operation can be automatically completed through the arranged material removing mechanism, the cutting operation of the next bent pipe flange is convenient to directly and rapidly perform, and the efficiency of the cutting operation is improved.

title_en: Post-treatment trimming equipment for investment casting of pump valve shell
abstract_en: The invention provides post-treatment finishing equipment for investment casting of pump valve shells, which relates to the technical field of pump valve shell machining and comprises a surrounding shell, wherein a welding driving unit is arranged on the surrounding shell and comprises a driving overturning part, a welding part and an overturning guiding part, a sealing unit is arranged in the surrounding shell, a clamping unit is arranged on the welding driving unit, a driving motor in the overturning part is driven to drive a transverse threaded rod to rotate, so that a transverse sliding block slides along a transverse sliding rod to further drive a supporting seat to horizontally move, meanwhile, eccentric columns at two ends of the transverse rotating shaft move in a first horizontal guiding groove, a first inclined guiding groove, a second inclined guiding groove and a second horizontal guiding groove of the overturning guiding part, a welding table is kept in an upward state, after laser welding is finished, the transverse rotating shaft and the supporting seat are overturned, the welding table is adjusted to be in a downward state from the upward state, scraps falling on the welding table in a welding process are conveniently dumped into a scraps collecting bucket, and the production cleanliness is improved.

title_en: Secondary pushing and bending forming device and method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a secondary pushing and bending forming device and a method thereof, wherein the device comprises a die main body, a first pushing component and a second pushing component, the first pushing component comprises a first driving piece and a first pushing head, the first pushing head is provided with a cavity, the cavity penetrates through two ends of the first pushing head, the first pushing head is also provided with an opening, and the opening is communicated with the cavity; the second pushing assembly comprises a second driving piece, a second pushing head and a filling ball body, the filling ball body enters the cavity through the opening, and the second pushing head pushes the filling ball body to move to the inside of the tube blank along the cavity under the driving of the second driving piece. Therefore, the application can form the bent pipe with large pipe diameter and small bending radius by the second pushing component on the premise of not unloading pressure after the primary pushing and bending forming, and can form the bent pipe with larger and more specifications and sizes on the machine tool equipment with limited specifications, thereby saving the cost of the machine tool equipment and improving the production efficiency of the bent pipe.

title_en: Automatic leather sheet cutting device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic skin cutting device, which relates to the field of medical equipment and comprises a base, a control panel, a workbench assembly, a Y-axis moving assembly, a Z-axis moving assembly, a skin cutting assembly, an X-axis skin positioning assembly and a Y-axis skin positioning assembly, wherein the control panel is arranged on the front side of the base, the workbench assembly is rotatably arranged on the top of the base, the workbench assembly is used for placing a skin to be cut, the Y-axis moving assembly is connected to the base in a sliding manner, the Z-axis moving assembly is arranged on the top of the Y-axis moving assembly in a lifting manner, the skin cutting assembly is arranged at the working end of the Z-axis moving assembly, the Y-axis moving assembly and the Z-axis moving assembly are respectively used for driving the skin cutting assembly to move along the Y-axis direction and the Z-axis direction of the base, and the X-axis skin positioning assembly and the Y-axis skin positioning assembly are arranged on the top of the base in an L shape. The automatic cutting and accurate compacting and positioning device for the leather sheet achieves automatic cutting and accurate compacting and positioning of the leather sheet, and accordingly cutting accuracy and quality are guaranteed.

title_en: Transmission line deicing robot capable of crossing spacer
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of deicing robots, and discloses a transmission line deicing robot capable of crossing a spacer, which comprises a hexagonal shell. The ice removing device is provided with driving assemblies, cutting separation assemblies and semicircular shovels which are distributed in a staggered mode, when the ice removing device spans a spacer, the driving assemblies which are distributed in the staggered mode drive driving wheels to perform staggered action, at least half of the driving wheels are always kept in contact with a cable, the gravity center offset is effectively controlled, the risk of high-altitude falling is eliminated, in the ice removing operation, a cutting sheet is cut into an ice layer at a high speed to form a gap, a shovel plate further expands the gap, a friction wheel drives a protrusion to extrude an outer expansion plate to break ice cubes, the whole process is free of vibration, the cable is prevented from being damaged, meanwhile, a conical structure of the semicircular shovel is inserted into water opening to assist in breaking the ice cubes, and the ice cubes are efficiently collected and separated by being matched with a baffle plate, so that no residue is ensured. The working mode of the multi-component cooperation not only remarkably improves the spanning stability and deicing efficiency of the robot and reduces energy consumption, but also avoids cable damage and reduces manual cleaning cost.

title_en: Manufacturing method and application of low-temperature-resistant large-diameter seamless steel tube
abstract_en: The application discloses a manufacturing method and application of a low-temperature-resistant large-diameter seamless steel pipe, which comprises the steps of optimizing material components, improving a processing technology and adopting a plasma boronizing technology. The low-temperature performance of the steel pipe is obviously improved by adding ferronickel, ferrovanadium, ferrotitanium and rare earth element Ce and combining the processes of argon stirring, ceramic filtering, on-line cooling and the like, and the surface is subjected to plasma boronizing treatment to form a high-hardness boronizing layer, so that the wear resistance and corrosion resistance are improved. The steel pipe prepared by the application has the impact toughness of more than 80J/cm  2  under the environment of-60 ℃, the tensile strength of over 900MPa and the yield strength of more than 750MPa, is suitable for extreme working conditions, and has excellent reliability and service life.

title_en: Abrasive distributing arm, semiconductor manufacturing equipment and control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an abrasive distributing arm, semiconductor manufacturing equipment and a control method, wherein the abrasive distributing arm comprises a main body and a bracket, a pipeline system is arranged in the main body, the pipeline system comprises a first pipeline, a second pipeline, a third pipeline, a first circulating pipeline and a storage box, one end of the first pipeline is communicated with a filter box of the semiconductor manufacturing equipment, one end of the second pipeline is used as an outflow end for enabling abrasives to flow out of the abrasive distributing arm, a switch is arranged between the third pipeline and the second pipeline, one end of the first circulating pipeline is communicated to a connection position of the switch and the third pipeline, the other end of the first circulating pipeline is communicated to a connection position of the first pipeline and the third pipeline and is used for being connected with the third pipeline in parallel to form a circulating loop, the storage box is arranged in the first circulating pipeline and is used for storing returned abrasives, the bracket is arranged at the lower end of the main body and is used for supporting the main body, and a driving mechanism is arranged in the bracket and is used for driving the main body to rotate.

title_en: Laser marking method and device for two-dimension code of crankshaft
abstract_en: The invention provides a two-dimensional code laser marking method of a crankshaft, which comprises the steps of determining parameter information required to be contained in the two-dimensional code of the crankshaft and data required to be recorded in each procedure, engraving the two-dimensional code of an initial crankshaft on the crankshaft before the crankshaft enters a production line, scanning the two-dimensional code of the initial crankshaft to obtain identity information of the crankshaft before and after the procedure is started and after the procedure is finished, inputting relevant parameters of the procedure, processing time of the procedure and used equipment information, scanning the two-dimensional code of the crankshaft after all the procedures are finished, associating the two-dimensional code information of the crankshaft with a packing number, and synchronizing all the information to a central database. The invention further provides a two-dimensional code laser marking device of the crankshaft, which comprises an engraving component for engraving the two-dimensional code of the crankshaft, a two-dimensional code scanning module for scanning the two-dimensional code of the crankshaft and transmitting the two-dimensional code to a central database, and the central database for correlating and storing the two-dimensional code information and the process flow information of the crankshaft so as to improve the traceability of the crankshaft.

title_en: Optical filter cutting device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the technical field of filter manufacturing equipment and provides a filter cutting device, comprising a body. The body of the machine is equipped with a lifting cylinder, and the output end of the lifting cylinder is connected to a laser to drive the laser to move up and down. The bottom of the laser is equipped with a laser head, and a receiving chamber for accommodating a carrier plate is opened inside the laser head. One side of the receiving chamber is in an open shape. The present invention overcomes the shortcomings of the prior art, has a reasonable design, and a compact structure. Through the design of the carrier plate and the receiving groove, the laser lens can be quickly disassembled, greatly improving the cleaning efficiency. The design of the telescopic cylinder and the electric gripper can automatically disassemble the laser lens, which is convenient for automatic disassembly of the laser lens in a small space, and improves the flexibility and efficiency of the equipment. Practicality, By designing jet heads on the upper and lower sides of the electric gripper, the disassembly process can be automated to clean the upper and lower sides of the laser lens without the need for manual cleaning.

title_en: Wafer polishing device and wafer polishing method
abstract_en: The invention provides a wafer grinding device which comprises a working disc, a supporting module and a grinding piece, wherein the working disc is rotatably arranged on a base, the supporting module is arranged on the base and used for adjusting the inclination of the working disc, the grinding piece is used for grinding a wafer placed on the working disc, when the working disc is not inclined relative to the base, a reference surface is orthogonal to the rotation axis of the working disc, the base is provided with a center point projected on the reference surface, the center point is overlapped with the rotation axis of the working disc, the supporting module is provided with a fixed supporting piece, a first adjusting supporting piece and a second adjusting supporting piece, the fixed supporting point, a main adjusting supporting point and a fine adjusting supporting point are respectively formed by the three projected on the reference surface, and the connecting line of the fixed supporting point and the fine adjusting supporting point passes through the center point. The invention also discloses a wafer polishing method using the wafer polishing device.

title_en: Automatic processing equipment for bucket teeth
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of bucket tooth machining, in particular to automatic bucket tooth machining equipment which comprises a second abutting block and a bucket tooth machining table, wherein a second sliding groove is formed in the outer wall of the second abutting block, and a first sliding block is arranged in the second sliding groove in a sliding mode. This automatic processing equipment of bucket tooth, release agent atomizer still can control intermittent type removal when the spraying of profile adaptation in the die-casting groove to can carry out the spraying release agent of bigger scope to the transverse space in the die-casting groove, make the more abundant cover of release agent in the inside of die-casting groove, further reduced the dead angle that release agent sprayed, accomplished the spraying to the die-casting groove at the in-process that the forging and pressing of forging and pressing ware was accomplished to reset, accomplish the spraying to the die-casting head surface at the downshift in-process that carries out the forging and pressing next time.

title_en: Predictive control system for wrinkling of automobile bearing stamping part
abstract_en: The application discloses a prediction control system for wrinkling of a stamping part of an automobile bearing, which relates to the technical field of model prediction and comprises a data acquisition unit, a stamping model and a prediction control unit, wherein the data acquisition unit consists of a fluctuation acquisition matrix and a variable acquisition matrix, fluctuation change data of a plate in the stamping process is acquired through the fluctuation acquisition matrix, variable data of the plate in the stamping process is acquired through the variable acquisition matrix, the stamping model is established based on historical stamping data, fluctuation change data is acquired for differential analysis, an abnormal data segment of the historical stamping data is determined, abnormal sound wave and vibration wave characteristics of the plate are determined, the variable data is combined, the wrinkling of the stamping part is predicted through a wrinkling prediction algorithm, and a prediction result is generated. In the process of stamping the plate, the state change of the plate in the die is determined by monitoring the vibration wave and sound wave changes of the plate, so that the purpose of predicting wrinkling is achieved, and the quality of stamping the plate is further improved.

title_en: Kitchen waste processor
abstract_en: The invention provides a kitchen waste processor, which comprises a feeding grinding assembly arranged in a box frame, wherein the feeding grinding assembly comprises a feeding hopper fixedly connected to the outer wall of the box frame, a grinding bin is fixedly connected to the outer wall of the feeding hopper, a driving motor is fixedly connected to the lower part of a sealing bottom plate, the output end of the driving motor is fixedly connected with a rotating column, the rotating column is connected with a rotating disc arranged in the grinding bin, the rotating disc is fixedly provided with a grinding knife, the rotating disc is also provided with a quick-dismantling fixing device, the kitchen waste processor further comprises a multifunctional stir-frying assembly connected with a feeding grinding assembly pipeline, and the multifunctional stir-frying assembly is further connected with a self-cleaning oil-water separation assembly. According to the invention, the quick-dismantling fixing device is arranged, so that the replacement operation of the grinding knife becomes simple and quick. The limit to the spliced pole can be released fast to conveniently dismantle the change with the grinding sword, reduced maintenance time and cost, guarantee that equipment can last stable operation.

title_en: Double-station alternating cooling and shaping device for isothermal forging of titanium alloy forgings
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-station alternating cooling shaping device for isothermal forging of titanium alloy forgings, which relates to the technical field of processing of titanium alloy forgings, and comprises a cooling machine case, a feeding conveyor belt, a feeding alternating distribution assembly, a placement assembly and a cooling assembly, wherein the middle part in the cooling machine case is a feeding chamber, the left side and the right side in the cooling machine case are cooling chambers, and the feeding alternating distribution assembly comprises a feeding mechanism and a distribution roller; the invention can guide the titanium alloy forging into the left or right empty cooling chamber through the distributing roller in the feeding chamber, so that the two cooling chambers are alternately used, the condition that the cooling chambers cannot be used when standing or cleaning is avoided, the forging can be cooled uninterruptedly, and the cooling efficiency of the titanium alloy forging is improved.

title_en: Automobile shifting fork laser welding device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automobile shifting fork laser welding device, which relates to the technical field of laser welding machines and comprises a sliding frame, a rotating plate and an irregular rod, wherein the sliding frame is slidably arranged on the front surface of the laser welding machine, one end of the rotating plate is rotatably arranged at the bottom of the sliding frame, the irregular rod is rotatably arranged at the other end of the rotating plate, and when a cover plate moves to two sides, a welding piece clamped by an elastic telescopic clamp is suspended, so that the thermal stress distribution is more uniform, the phenomenon of stress concentration in a workpiece after welding is reduced, the heat is concentrated in a laser irradiation area, the temperature of a non-welding part is limited, and the wavy deformation caused by the heated softening of peripheral materials is avoided.

title_en: Hot nozzle preparation method and hot nozzle
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of hot runner systems, and discloses a hot nozzle preparation method and a hot nozzle. The hot nozzle preparation method comprises the following steps of processing a heating channel in a hot nozzle body, wherein the heating channel extends to the forefront end of the hot nozzle body, and arranging a heating element in the heating channel, so that a heating area of the heating element at least partially extends to one end of the heating channel, which is close to the forefront end of the hot nozzle body, so as to directly heat the forefront end of the hot nozzle body. The heating element directly acts on the forefront end of the heat nozzle body, so that the heat transfer path is shortened, the heat loss in the transfer process is reduced, and the heat transfer efficiency is improved. In addition, the heating element is used for directly heating the forefront end of the hot nozzle body, so that the forefront end of the hot nozzle body can obtain more direct heat supply, the problem of uneven heat distribution is solved, and the condition of insufficient temperature of the forefront end of the hot nozzle body is avoided.

title_en: Material feeding unit and bush pressure equipment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of material conveying, and particularly relates to a feeding device and bushing press-fitting equipment, which are used for conveying a material carrying box to a discharging station for discharging, wherein the feeding device is provided with a material moving station and a discharging station along a first direction, the feeding device comprises a first conveying line, a second conveying line arranged above the first conveying line and a lifting material moving mechanism arranged above the discharging station and used for lifting the material carrying box, the first conveying line receives the material carrying box at the material moving station, the first conveying line conveys the material carrying box to the discharging station and releases the material carrying box at the lifting material moving mechanism, the lifting material moving mechanism lifts the discharged material carrying box to a preset height so as to enable the material carrying box to be in butt joint with the second conveying line, and the lifting material moving mechanism is also used for transferring the material carrying box to the second conveying line, and the second conveying line conveys the material carrying box to the material moving station. The invention can improve the production efficiency and reduce the occupied space of the feeding device.

title_en: Automatic drilling device for lock core assembly
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of lock processing, in particular to an automatic drilling device for a lock core assembly, which comprises a base, wherein a drilling unit and a clamp workbench are arranged on the left side of the upper end of the base, a chain conveyor is arranged in the middle of the upper end of the base, a lock core supporting table for supporting a lock core is arranged on each chain plate on the chain conveyor, an outer cleaning unit and an inner cleaning unit are arranged on each lock core supporting table, and the automatic drilling device is used for continuously and automatically drilling the lock core.

title_en: Thin L450M pipeline steel plate based on strain design and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a thin L450M pipeline steel plate based on strain design and a manufacturing method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of low-carbon microalloy steel production. The steel comprises, by weight, 0.05% -0.08% of C, 0.15% -0.25% of Si, 1.55% -1.70% of Mn, less than or equal to 0.020% of P, less than or equal to 0.015% of S, 0.02% -0.04% of Nb, 0.008% -0.020% of Ti, 0.015% -0.04% of Al, 0.15% -0.25% of Cr, 0.03% -0.06% of Mo, 0.003% -0.006% of N, and the balance of Fe and unavoidable impurities, wherein the total amount of other impurity elements is less than 0.05%. The manufacturing method comprises the steps of molten steel smelting to continuous casting, casting blank stacking slow cooling, casting blank heating, controlled rolling, relaxation and cooling, and air cooling to room temperature. The steel plate has good toughness.

title_en: Bonding machine fastener
abstract_en: The application relates to a bonding machine wire clamp, which relates to the technical field of bonding machine wire clamps and comprises a wire clamp assembly and a driving assembly, wherein the wire clamp assembly comprises a wire clamp seat, a movable chuck and a fixed chuck, the fixed chuck is connected to the wire clamp seat, a clamping area is formed between the movable chuck and the fixed chuck, the movable chuck is movably connected with the fixed chuck through an elastic sheet so as to change the width of the clamping area, the elastic sheet has a force for driving the movable chuck to move towards one side close to the clamping area under recoverable deformation, the driving assembly is arranged on one side of the wire clamp assembly and comprises a voice coil motor, the voice coil motor comprises a voice coil motor stator and a voice coil motor rotor, the voice coil motor stator is fixedly connected to the wire clamp seat, the voice coil motor stator drives the voice coil motor rotor to slide along a second direction, and one side, far away from the voice coil motor stator, of the voice coil motor rotor is fixedly connected with the movable chuck. The application has the effect of buffering and controlling the movement of the movable sheet of the wire clamp.

title_en: Cup-shaped arc grinding wheel grinding aspheric surface and error compensation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cup-shaped arc grinding wheel grinding aspheric surface and error compensation method, which comprises the steps of obtaining a theoretical aspheric surface generatrix equation required for grinding the aspheric surface, obtaining a movement track of the grinding aspheric surface of the cup-shaped arc grinding wheel, grinding a curved surface of an aspheric surface workpiece into the aspheric surface workpiece, detecting the generatrix surface shape precision of the aspheric surface workpiece after the machining is finished, measuring the surface shape data of the aspheric surface workpiece, making a difference with the theoretical surface shape, recording the difference as a surface shape error, reversely adding a surface shape error numerical value to the theoretical aspheric surface generatrix equation according to the measured surface shape error, calculating the compensation movement track of the grinding aspheric surface of the cup-shaped arc grinding wheel, and carrying out secondary machining on the aspheric surface workpiece until the surface shape error of the aspheric surface workpiece is within an allowable range, finishing the machining, improving the aspheric surface machining efficiency and precision, and solving the problem of limited abrasion control precision.

title_en: Flange plate turning and drilling integrated machine
abstract_en: The invention provides a flange turning and drilling integrated machine, which belongs to the technical field of flange processing equipment and comprises a frame, a turning system, a clamping system and a punching system, wherein the frame comprises a bottom support and a rear support, the rear support is longitudinally arranged at the upper end of the bottom support, the turning system is arranged on the rear support and comprises a first turning component and a second turning component, the first turning component and the second turning component are arranged back to back, the clamping system is arranged on the rear support and comprises a first clamping component and a second clamping component, the first clamping component and the second clamping component are respectively used for clamping an inner ring or an outer ring of a raw material disc, the punching system is arranged in a second working position and comprises a drill bit, and the drill bit is connected with the second turning component. The flange turning and drilling integrated machine provided by the invention has the advantages that the machining efficiency is improved, the back and forth carrying and clamping between different devices are not needed, the conversion time and the auxiliary operation time between working procedures are greatly reduced, and the labor intensity and the operation difficulty are reduced.

title_en: Method for manufacturing tungsten-based alloy by arc plasma
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for manufacturing tungsten-based alloy by arc plasma, which belongs to the technical field of plasma-facing materials in fusion stacks, and adopts a manufacturing method combining arc plasma and a hot-pressing Joule meter, and tungsten wires and other metal wires are used as raw materials; and step three, placing the carbon mould containing the tungsten-based alloy obtained in the step two into a hot-pressing Joule instrument, and simultaneously pressurizing and heating the tungsten-based alloy to obtain the tungsten-based alloy.

title_en: Boring machine for piston pin hole machining
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the field of piston pin hole technology and discloses a boring machine for processing piston pin holes, comprising a base. The inner surface of the base is fixedly connected to a linear motor, and the moving end of the linear motor is fixedly connected to a moving seat. The right side of the moving seat is fixedly connected to a cutting head, which is used to cut the piston. The upper surface of the base is fixedly connected to a fixed seat. In the present invention, a limit arc plate presses the piston, which is convenient for fitting with the surface of pistons of different sizes. The sliding seat resets to drive the conflict arc plate to stick and clamp the piston. Through the cooperation of the conflict arc plate and the limit arc plate, it can adapt to pistons of different sizes and quickly fix them, improving applicability and convenience. The pressing cylinder After fitting with the piston, it is clamped between the fixed seat and the moving seat, which improves the stability of the piston, When the limit ring moves away from the moving seat, pull the spring, and the elastic force generated by the spring compresses the piston, further improving the stability of the piston.

title_en: Efficient gear machining device and gear machining method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-efficiency gear machining device and a gear machining method, which relate to the technical field of gear machining, a telescopic rod is slidably arranged in a guide frame, a telescopic spring is connected between one end of the telescopic rod and one end in the guide frame, the top end of the telescopic rod is connected with a fixed rod, the output end of the fixed electric push rod is connected with a conical block through a linkage plate, the inside of the conical block is slidably connected with a regulating pipe, four folding ports are formed in the top of the outer side of the regulating pipe at equal intervals, an extrusion gear is rotatably arranged at the bottom of the folding ports, and an extrusion rod is welded at the top of the extrusion gear.

title_en: High-quality nonferrous metal forging equipment and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of nonferrous metal forging, in particular to a high-quality nonferrous metal forging device and a high-quality nonferrous metal forging method, which comprise a forging device main body, wherein a discharging mechanism and a forming mechanism are matched for use, so that when a large number of metal blanks are processed, the metal blanks are placed in a specially customized die, the metal blanks are matched with the die through the impact of a forging block, the uniformity of manufacturing the large number of forgings is realized, meanwhile, the forging block is rotated through a rotating module main body and a damping rod, and the forging block automatically discharges after the forging is completed through the forging block, so that the metal blanks are integrally formed into a flow line operation, the working efficiency is further improved, the shape of raw materials forged through the die is more standard and flexible, the working cutting amount of secondary processing is reduced, even secondary processing is not needed, and the production cost is reduced.

title_en: Focus-controllable underwater laser welding device and welding method
abstract_en: The invention provides an underwater laser welding device with a controllable focus and a welding method, and relates to the technical field of underwater welding, wherein the device comprises a drainage cover, a turntable, a moving plate, a wire feeding assembly and a laser head with a protection inflator, and the bottom of the drainage cover is open and is used for being contacted with a part to be welded to form a local dry-type environment; the wire feeding assembly stretches into the drain cover and is used for feeding welding wires, the rotary table is fixedly connected with the laser head, the moving plate is fixedly connected with the laser head, the laser head penetrates through the top wall of the drain cover, the protection inflator is located in the drain cover, the rotary table is rotatably arranged and is used for driving the moving plate and the laser head to synchronously move along the top wall of the drain cover, so that the focal position of the laser is adjusted, and the moving plate always seals the top wall of the drain cover when moving. The conditions of unstable welding or burning-through can be avoided through dynamic power adjustment, the stability of welding seams is kept, slight angle change of the protection inflator can drive the disturbance of a molten pool thermal field, and the device is beneficial to the escape of bubbles and uniform components.

title_en: Instrument board tubular beams assembly examines utensil and detecting system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of instrument board tube beam assembly detection, in particular to an instrument board tube beam assembly detection tool and a detection system, when a first rotating disc rotates a first rotating shaft, a driving gear drives two driven gears to synchronously rotate, and further, a second synchronous wheel, a synchronous belt and a first synchronous wheel drive two bidirectional screws to synchronously rotate, so that C-shaped clamps in two regulating grooves can synchronously move, the problem of inconsistent clamping force caused by sequentially rotating the screws is avoided, the fixing effect and the detection precision of a tube beam are ensured, meanwhile, the number of external teeth of each driven gear is larger than that of the driving gear, the reduction and torque increase effects are achieved, the operation is more labor-saving and the clamping is more stable, two positioning strips are arranged below each C-shaped clamp, two positioning grooves are formed in each regulating groove, and extend into the corresponding positioning grooves, so that the movement of the C-shaped clamps can be guided, and the stability and the precision of the clamping are further ensured.

title_en: High-temperature alloy forging hydraulic press
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of high-temperature alloy processing, in particular to a high-temperature alloy forging hydraulic press, which comprises a machine body, wherein a lower die is arranged at the bottom of the machine body, a middle main cylinder is arranged at the top of the machine body, side main cylinders are respectively arranged at two sides of the middle main cylinder, the output ends of the side main cylinders are connected with outer sliding blocks, an upper die is arranged at the bottom of the outer sliding blocks, a flat end plate matched with upsetting and flattening end surfaces of the lower die is arranged at the bottom of the upper die, an inner sliding block is connected with the output end of the middle main cylinder, the inner sliding block can move up and down in the outer sliding block, and a punch head is arranged at the bottom of the inner sliding block and can penetrate through the flat end plate to extrude upsetting-extruding-flattening end surfaces of workpieces at the same station.

title_en: Special nut's processing forming device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field related to metal part machining, in particular to a special nut machining forming device which comprises a base, a feeding seat, a cutting mechanism, a feeding disc, a hole forming mechanism and a material returning mechanism, wherein the bottom surface of the base is provided with supporting legs, the feeding seat is fixed on the base through supporting rods, a section bar to be fed is placed on the feeding seat, the feeding seat is fixedly provided with a feeding positioning mechanism through a mounting bracket, the feeding positioning mechanism is used for forward feeding the section bar, the feeding positioning mechanism is used for positioning the section bar, the base is provided with a mechanical arm, the cutting mechanism is arranged on the mechanical arm, the cutting mechanism is subjected to position adjustment through the mechanical arm, the base is fixedly provided with a motor support, and four blank grooves are uniformly formed in the feeding disc, so that a plurality of steps of section bar cutting, blank hole forming and nut returning are synchronously completed at the positions of each blank groove, and the machining efficiency of equipment is effectively improved.

title_en: Visual detection method for cross-flow fan blade
abstract_en: The invention discloses a visual detection method for a cross-flow fan blade, which comprises the steps of feeding the cross-flow fan blade to be detected to a detection station, positioning and clamping the cross-flow fan blade, wherein a visual detection device is arranged on the detection station, the visual detection device comprises a detection camera, a coaxial light source and a back side light source, the coaxial light source and the back side light source are distributed along the circumferential direction of the rotation axis of the cross-flow fan blade and have an included angle of 90-130 degrees, the cross-flow fan blade is driven to rotate, and the detection camera shoots the cross-flow fan blade to obtain an image of the whole periphery of the cross-flow fan blade. The included angle between the irradiation directions of the coaxial light source and the back side light source is 90-130 degrees, under the light rays within the included angle range, the light rays of the back side light source and the light rays of the coaxial light source form a good light effect in the shooting area on the cross-flow fan blade, defects on the blade can be more obviously highlighted, the detection precision is improved, and therefore the automatic visual detection of the cross-flow fan blade is achieved, and shooting and detection effects are improved.

title_en: Damper cylinder production system
abstract_en: The application relates to a damper cylinder production system, and belongs to the technical field of damper production. The damper oil cylinder production system comprises a cutting device, wherein the cutting device comprises a cutting execution assembly and a positioning mechanism, the cutting execution assembly cuts a steel pipe into a cylinder barrel, the positioning mechanism comprises a first supporting mechanism and a second supporting mechanism, the first supporting mechanism is used for conveying the steel pipe, the second supporting mechanism is used for fixing the steel pipe, the first supporting mechanism comprises a first supporting module, a stress detection module, a movable module and a control module, the first supporting module supports and conveys the steel pipe, the stress detection module detects stress born by the first supporting module in the radial direction of the steel pipe, the control module is configured to acquire a real-time stress value, compare the real-time stress value with a preset stress threshold value, control the action of the movable module according to a comparison result, and adjust the position of the first supporting module so that the real-time stress value does not exceed the stress threshold value. The damper cylinder production system provided by the embodiment of the application can improve the processing quality.

title_en: Valve sealing face polishing equipment
abstract_en: The valve sealing surface polishing equipment comprises a base, a connecting frame and a fixing seat are fixedly arranged at the top of the base, a rotating assembly for driving a valve core to rotate is arranged between the connecting frame and the fixing seat, a sliding seat is arranged on the base in a sliding mode, a polishing assembly for polishing the valve core is arranged in the sliding seat, a suction assembly is arranged at the bottom of the sliding seat, a blowing assembly is arranged at the top of the sliding seat, a transmission mechanism is arranged between the blowing assembly and the suction assembly, a filter screen is movably arranged in the sliding seat and connected with the transmission mechanism, the suction assembly synchronously drives the blowing assembly to output wind power through the transmission mechanism, when polishing chips accumulated on the filter screen are gradually increased and the filter screen is gradually blocked, the suction assembly forms a negative pressure below the filter screen to drive the filter screen to move, and after the filter screen moves through the transmission mechanism, the wind power output by the blowing assembly is gradually increased. The wind power is gradually enhanced, so that the cleaning force of sweeping scraps can be increased, and the cooling force on the polishing disc and the valve core is synchronously improved.

title_en: Cutter abrasion monitoring method based on physical guide dynamic gate control chart convolution frame
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cutter abrasion monitoring method based on a physical guide dynamic gate control chart rolling frame, which comprises the steps of 1, collecting cutting force signals, bending moment signals and vibration signals of a cutter and a workpiece in the cutter operation process, 2, preprocessing data of an collected multi-source sensor signal sequence, 3, calculating a Pelson correlation coefficient between each feature and cutter abrasion in an original feature set, 4, screening front Top-k features to construct a sensitive feature set of integrating force, vibration and bending moment, 5, extracting cutter abrasion information in the sensitive feature set by adopting a dynamic gate control chart rolling network to establish long-term dependence among the features, 6, outputting and decoding the features after the long-term dependence is established, establishing a mapping relation between cutter abrasion values and input features, and outputting cutter abrasion monitoring values. The invention realizes the deep fusion of the graph structure and the time sequence characteristics, and effectively enhances the accuracy and stability of cutter abrasion prediction.

title_en: Welding device for ventilation pipe production
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ventilation pipe welding, in particular to a welding device for ventilation pipe production. According to the invention, the air pipe fittings are clamped through the matching of the supporting ring and the circular ring I, the edges of the air pipe fittings are aligned, and then spot welding operation is performed, so that the quick and accurate alignment of the edges of the air pipe fittings is realized, the welding efficiency, the sealing performance of welding seams and the overall structural strength of the air pipe fittings are improved, the air pipe fittings are heated through the electrified operation of the heating wires arranged in the limiting columns, and the air pipe fittings are extruded through the movement of the fixing ring I, so that the inner wall and the outer wall of the air pipe fittings are more regular, and the phenomenon that the welding seams between the two air pipe fittings are not flush is reduced.

title_en: Automatic machining production line for non-fixed-length elevator guide rail and production process thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automatic machining production line for non-fixed-length elevator guide rails and a production process thereof, comprising an elevator guide rail milling unit, an elevator guide rail male and female tenon machining unit, an elevator guide rail countersink machining unit and a conveying and feeding unit, wherein the elevator guide rail milling unit, the elevator guide rail male and female tenon machining unit and the elevator guide rail countersink machining unit are transversely arranged and are transversely conveyed to be fed through the conveying and feeding unit, and the elevator guide rails are sequentially conveyed to a first milling machine tool, a second milling machine tool, yang Sun milling power heads, female tenon milling power heads, a first countersink drilling power head and a second countersink drilling power head through the conveying and feeding unit for machining. The invention adopts a full transverse conveying scheme, can be suitable for processing elevator guide rails with multiple specifications, forms relay conveying with the conveying and feeding unit, and has the advantages of step-by-step conveying of positioning precision, high processing precision and high efficiency.

title_en: Four-station full-automatic silicon wafer chamfering machine
abstract_en: The four-station full-automatic silicon wafer chamfering machine has four grinding stations, greatly improves the chamfering processing efficiency of silicon wafers, and replaces the material taking station and the carrying station of the conventional automatic chamfering machine by the wafer robot in circumferential arrangement, so that the structure is more compact, the space utilization rate is high, and the process flow is simpler. The grinding station with four stations can be replaced without stopping if the grinding wheel at one station needs to be replaced in production. The added preliminary positioning device and the vision centering device control and improve the qualification rate of production. The primary positioning device can preliminarily determine the circle center of the silicon wafer, the scanning device can identify and record batch codes on the silicon wafer, the follow-up inspection and finding problem is that the processing batch time is found rapidly, the accurate centering procedure is arranged at the grinding device, and the accurate centering procedure is carried to the grinding table for grinding through the carrying mechanism after the circle center is corrected, so that the grinding precision is improved, and the device has strong practicability and wide applicability.

title_en: Method for fixing marking composition on substrate
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for fixing a marking composition to a substrate by laser irradiation, the marking composition comprising at least one colorant, the method comprising the steps of-depositing (102) the marking composition on at least a portion of the substrate (4), -fixing (104) a portion of the marking composition by moving at least a portion of the marking composition deposited on the substrate by laser irradiation, characterized in that the laser beam in contact with the irradiated marking composition has a power density of 32W/mm  2  to 7.7 kW/mm  2  and the moving speed of the laser beam is 10m ‧ s  ‑1  to 9.0m ‧ s  ‑1  measured relative to the substrate.

title_en: EVA cutting device for photovoltaic board that possesses location direction function
abstract_en: The invention discloses an EVA cutting device with a positioning and guiding function for a photovoltaic panel, which relates to the technical field of EVA cutting equipment, wherein a driving mechanism is arranged in a device main body, the outer side of the driving mechanism is connected with a guiding mechanism, the guiding mechanism comprises a movable frame, the top of the movable frame is connected with an air cylinder, the bottom of the air cylinder is provided with an upper pressing plate, the bottom of the upper pressing plate is provided with a cutting hob, the bottom of the upper pressing plate is provided with a positioning shaft, the bottom of the movable frame is connected with a positioning mechanism, the positioning mechanism comprises a positioning frame, the outer side of the positioning frame is provided with a positioning hole, the bottom of the stretching damping is connected with a pressing frame, and the bottom of the pressing frame is provided with a pressing edge and a frame cutter. The upper pressing plate is driven by the moving frame and the positioning mechanism to be guided to a designated position, then the air cylinder can downwards press the upper pressing plate, so that the upper pressing plate, the positioning frame and the lower pressing frame are fixedly positioned on the EVA material workpiece, and meanwhile, the positioning shaft can downwards push the lower pressing frame to fixedly position the EVA material workpiece, so that the EVA material workpiece is more stable in positioning and cutting.

title_en: Drilling equipment is used in air compressor machine production
abstract_en: The invention relates to a drilling device for air compressor production, which comprises a drilling mechanism arranged above a base in a suspending manner, wherein one side of the top of the base is provided with a fixing plate for installing a motor I, an output shaft of the motor I is provided with a rectangular plate, one side of the rectangular plate is provided with a rectangular frame formed by four groups of drilling templates, the side wall of the drilling template in an opening of the rectangular frame is provided with an electromagnet layer, the other side of the top of the base is fixedly provided with a supporting seat through a fixing seat, the tail end of the supporting seat is provided with a baffle plate for sealing the opening at the lower half of the rectangular frame, one side of the baffle plate is provided with an arc plate extending to the bottom in the opening of the rectangular frame, the side wall of the baffle plate in the opening of the arc plate is respectively provided with a discharging pipe and a dust removing pipe, the middle part of the top of the baffle plate in the opening of the arc plate is also provided with an extending seat extending into the opening of the rectangular frame, and the top of the supporting seat is provided with an installation mechanism capable of being shifted into the opening of the rectangular frame. The invention can drill holes for various products with different specifications.

title_en: Rubber gasket production equipment and processing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to rubber gasket production equipment and a processing method thereof, wherein an air cylinder is arranged on an upper plate, a push plate is arranged at the output end of the upper plate, a first round hole and a second round hole are formed in the push plate, a distance is reserved between the push plate and the upper plate, a first cutter is arranged on the push plate and is positioned on the same vertical line with the round hole, a first connecting rod and a second connecting rod are connected to the upper plate in a threaded manner, a first push ring is arranged at the lower end of the first connecting rod, a second push ring is arranged at the lower end of the second connecting rod, and the first push ring and the second push ring push out the rubber gaskets on the inner walls of the first annular cutter and the second annular cutter along with whether the air cylinder is reset or not, so that subsequent operation is greatly simplified, the rubber gaskets after punching are taken out more conveniently and rapidly, and meanwhile, the production efficiency is improved.

title_en: Laser cutting head device and laser pipe cutting machine tool
