abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of laser pipe cutting machine tools, and particularly discloses a laser cutting head device and a laser pipe cutting machine tool. The first swing assembly comprises a first driving mechanism and a supporting piece, and the second swing assembly comprises a second driving mechanism, a first laser cutting head part and a second laser cutting head part. The laser cutting head device has the advantages of high-precision cutting and high-efficiency cutting, waste of tailings can be reduced, functions of a laser pipe cutting machine tool are enriched, machining quality and yield are improved, and the problems of poor machining precision and low efficiency of the laser cutting head device in the prior art are effectively solved.

title_en: Steel plate butt joint equipment and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses steel plate butt joint equipment and a steel plate butt joint method, which comprise locking clamps I, locking clamps II and connecting components, wherein two locking clamps I are correspondingly arranged on two lateral sides of a steel plate I to be butt-jointed when the steel plate butt joint equipment is used, two locking clamps II are correspondingly arranged on two lateral sides of a steel plate II to be butt-jointed, the two locking clamps I and the two locking clamps II are connected through the connecting components, a connecting cable III in the connecting components is connected to a preset power source, the preset power source is started to enable the steel plate I to be butt-jointed to be close to the steel plate II to be butt-jointed, the steel plate I to be butt-jointed and the steel plate II to be butt-jointed are temporarily fixed after being attached, extra occupied space is not needed, steel plate butt joint can be completed by using lifting equipment in a manufacturing plant after the steel plate is placed on a material frame of a laser cutting machine, production cycle is reduced, running water production efficiency is improved, production cost is reduced, and construction cycle is saved.

title_en: Stamping and welding process for trailing arm
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of automobile part manufacturing, in particular to a trailing arm stamping and welding process, which comprises the steps of firstly uncoiling by a servo-driven uncoiler together with a four-roller precise leveling machine and leveling coiled materials for a plurality of times, then blanking by a numerical control plate shearing machine to obtain plate blanks, drawing left/right trailing arm blanks on a drawing die to form the basic shape of the trailing arm, trimming and punching by a high-precision punch press and a hydraulic press, coiling a working procedure part into a closed tube by utilizing a vertical flanging die and a floating side shaping die flanging and side shaping, then welding the welding seam of the working procedure part at a high speed by adopting double wire welding on a special fixture, precisely cutting the variable-section tube by adopting a 3D laser cutting device and being provided with a visual tracking system, so that the dimensional precision and the shape precision of the left/right trailing arm are effectively ensured, and the problems of difficult control, efficiency cost contradiction and poor process compatibility in the prior art are solved.

title_en: Rapeseed oil extraction process
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rapeseed oil extraction and discloses a rapeseed oil extraction process, which comprises the following steps of S1, stir-frying rapeseeds at a low temperature (the temperature is less than or equal to 120 ℃), S2, squeezing, namely putting the stir-fried rapeseeds into squeezing equipment to squeeze to obtain rapeseed oil, and S3, filtering the obtained rapeseed oil through a filter screen to obtain the rapeseed oil. According to the invention, the long plate is ejected out through the ejection assembly to enable the long plate to be misplaced with the short plate, so that two sides of the long plate and two sides of the short plate are exposed, the situation that the short plate and the long plate sides are mutually blocked is avoided, cleaning of residues on the short plate and the long plate sides and cleaning of stuck rapes can be facilitated, the beating rod is driven to continuously beat the hoop to enable the hoop to vibrate, rapes on the joint surface of the hoop and the long plate are enabled to shake off, the subsequent long plate can be completely reset and attached to the hoop, and normal use of the subsequent platen is ensured.

title_en: Die punch rod with reducing cooling inner hole and special punching device and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a die punch rod with a reducing cooling inner hole and a special punching device and a special punching method thereof, relates to the technical field of punching dies, and is used for solving the problem that a workpiece is rusted due to excessive condensate water on the surface of the punch rod in a high-humidity environment, wherein the die punch rod comprises a working section and a mounting section, the reducing cooling inner hole is arranged in the die punch rod, and the inner hole is formed by three sections: the invention also provides a special punching device, which adopts a step-by-step and layered micro-unit punching mode, ejects out a plurality of groups of punching block units in a circumferential through groove of a positioning column layer by layer through a plug column with a conical surface bearing section, and locally and stably reams a prefabricated equal-diameter hole, thereby efficiently and accurately processing a variable-diameter cooling inner hole.

title_en: Gantry platform
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of gantry correlation, in particular to a gantry platform which comprises first support frames with two opposite sides, wherein a first linear module is arranged on the first support frame on one side, a second support frame is fixedly arranged at the top of the first linear module, a first sliding block is fixed at the bottom of the second support frame, a first sliding rail is fixed at the top of the first support frame, the first sliding block is connected to the outer side of the first sliding rail in a sliding manner, a second linear module is arranged on one side of the second support frame, and second sliding blocks are fixed at the top and the bottom of one side of the second linear module. According to the application, through the structural design of the cleaning mechanism, the surface of the second sliding rail at the front and rear positions of the second sliding block can be cleaned in the process of moving the second linear module, so that dust accumulation on the surface of the second sliding rail is avoided, the accumulated dust or processing scraps are prevented from affecting the movement precision of the second linear module, and the service lives of the second linear module and the second sliding rail are effectively prolonged.

title_en: High-heat-conductivity brazing method for ceramic reinforced titanium-based composite material
abstract_en: A high heat conduction brazing method of a ceramic reinforced titanium-based composite material belongs to the technical field of connection of metal and ceramic heterogeneous materials, and solves the problems of low joint strength and insufficient heat conductivity caused by thermal expansion mismatch in the conventional connection of the titanium-based composite material and SiC ceramic. The method comprises the steps of preparing a ceramic reinforced titanium-based composite material by adopting an additive manufacturing technology, selecting Ag-Cu-Ti brazing filler metal, polishing and ultrasonically cleaning the surface of a material to be welded, assembling the SiC ceramic/AgCuTi brazing filler metal/titanium-based composite material in sequence, and carrying out brazing in a vacuum brazing furnace at 800-900 ℃ for 10 minutes. According to the invention, the thermal expansion coefficient difference is reduced through the composite material, the wettability is improved, the high-strength and high-heat-conductivity joint is realized, and the method is suitable for manufacturing scenes of lightweight heat dissipation parts in an aerospace thermal management system.

title_en: High-precision ball hinge sphere grinding process
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-precision ball hinge sphere grinding process which comprises the steps of preparing a multi-axis linkage grinding device and a grinding cutter, setting parameters, starting the multi-axis linkage grinding device to grind a base and a ball gland, and detecting quality. The grinding cutter selects hard alloy materials, reduces the cost of the grinding cutter, ensures the stability and rigidity in the grinding process, ensures that the grinding part is spherical matched with the hemispherical spherical surface, ensures that the spherical surface can be fully contacted during grinding, realizes uniform grinding, inlays diamond particles in the grinding part, improves the grinding effect and the surface quality, and adopts the design of chip grooves and cooling channels to eliminate heat and chips generated in the grinding process, so that the uniform arc chip grooves on the spherical surface of the grinding cutter can avoid the accumulation of the chips in a grinding area. The grinding fluid is conveyed to the grinding area through the chip removal groove, so that the area temperature is reduced, the abrasion of the grinding cutter is reduced, the service life of the grinding cutter is prolonged, and the grinding efficiency and accuracy are improved.

title_en: Laser cutting machining system and machining method for sheet metal part special-shaped hole array
abstract_en: The invention discloses a laser cutting processing system of a sheet metal part special-shaped hole array, which comprises a laser cutting head arranged at the execution tail end of a mechanical arm, wherein the laser cutting head can cut a vent hole on the sheet metal part under the drive of the mechanical arm, an insect prevention sheet is formed in the vent hole, the root of the insect prevention sheet is integrally connected with the inner contour of the vent hole, a zigzag labyrinth insect prevention ventilation gap is formed between the outer contour of the insect prevention sheet and the inner contour of the vent hole, and two processes of laser cutting and mechanical bending are integrated into one set of system, so that the insect prevention sheet in the insect prevention sheet is controllably bent while the insect prevention vent hole is cut.

title_en: Synchronous traction cutting device and method for fastening tape
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fastening tape processing, in particular to a synchronous traction cutting device and method for a fastening tape. The guiding mechanism forms an adjustable belt passing gap through the left guiding strip and the right guiding strip, the traction cutting mechanism comprises a strip dividing rotary table driven by a driving motor, a cutting module is arranged in the circumferential direction of the strip dividing rotary table, and traction plates are arranged on two sides of a cutter of the cutting module. When the material belt after pre-traction and guiding reaches the cutting traction mechanism, the slitting turntable rotates, the traction plate compresses and pulls the material belt, and the cutter cuts the material belt. The separating structure is combined with the inclined grid plate and the vibration separating mechanism through the blanking gap, and finished products and waste materials are automatically separated and collected. The invention solves the problems of waste traction failure and low separation efficiency in the prior art, and improves the production efficiency and the dimensional accuracy of products in specific working conditions.

title_en: Continuous circulation type automatic wire drawing machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of metal processing and discloses a continuous circulation type automatic wire drawing machine which comprises a support column, wherein a slide rail is fixedly connected to one side outer wall of the support column, a support frame is connected to the outer wall of the slide rail in a sliding manner, a hydraulic cylinder is fixedly connected to one side outer wall of the support frame, one side outer wall of the support frame is connected to the outer wall of the support column in a sliding manner, a second rack is meshed and connected to the tooth end of the second gear, the outer wall of the second rack is fixedly connected to the outer wall of the support column, a synchronous adjusting mechanism is arranged in the support column, and a displacement mechanism is arranged on the lower side of the support column. Through the product of balancing pole jack-up, can smooth the effect to the product of kickdown or camber, the regulating plate can also make one side perk of metal sheet when rising under the drive of regulating block and regulation pole, combines circulation wire drawing mechanism to carry out the wire drawing to one side of metal sheet, avoids because the side of metal sheet pastes tightly places the effect that the platform leads to the unable contact of circulation wire drawing area.

title_en: Production method for improving edge peeling defect of high-grade silicon steel and silicon steel
abstract_en: The application provides a production method for improving the peeling defect of the edge of high-grade silicon steel and the silicon steel, belonging to the technical field of steel smelting. The method comprises the following steps of (1) producing a continuous casting blank by adopting a chamfering crystallizer to obtain a chamfering plate blank, (2) entering a heat preservation pit for heat preservation or directly loading into a heating furnace after the chamfering plate blank is taken off line, wherein the temperature of the entering furnace is not lower than T  0 , (3) heating the chamfering plate blank, controlling the chamfering plate blank to be heated in a preheating section, a first adding section, a second adding section and a soaking section in the heating furnace in sequence, and (4) rough rolling the chamfering plate blank, and controlling the first-pass pressing amount of a rough rolling side vertical roller to be not more than 20mm. The application does not need to carry out complex pretreatment on the defective slab, reduces the production difficulty and cost, considers the influence of the chamfering slab on the edge peeling in the continuous casting process, also considers the effect of the rough rolling process on the edge quality, and can more comprehensively and effectively reduce the occurrence of the edge peeling defect of the high-grade silicon steel.

title_en: Hairpin conductor production die and design method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hairpin conductor production mould and a design method thereof, wherein the hairpin conductor production mould design method comprises the following steps of 1, constructing a three-dimensional model diagram of a target hairpin conductor in a three-dimensional model, and obtaining a central axis of the target hairpin conductor from the three-dimensional model diagram; and step 2, calculating a rebound compensation value of the target hairpin conductor, reconstructing a three-dimensional model diagram of the hairpin conductor before rebound according to the rebound compensation value in the three-dimensional model, and constructing a hairpin conductor production mould according to the three-dimensional model diagram of the hairpin conductor before rebound in the three-dimensional model. The rebound compensation value is designed in during mold design, so that the card-issuing wire before rebound manufactured by the designed mold can rebound automatically after being taken out of the mold, and the target card-issuing wire is obtained.

title_en: Connector spanner locking plate assembly equipment and assembly method
abstract_en: The invention discloses connector spanner locking plate assembling equipment and an assembling method, which solve the problems of low automation degree and low efficiency of spanner locking plate assembling in the prior art. The connector spanner locking plate assembly equipment comprises a rack, wherein a tray feeding module, a locking plate carrying module and a locking plate assembly module are arranged on the rack, a transfer positioning platform is arranged between the locking plate carrying module and the locking plate assembly module, and a secondary positioning mechanism is arranged on the transfer positioning platform. The connector wrench locking plate assembly equipment integrates the functions of automatic feeding, carrying, positioning, assembling and discharging of a tray, realizes unmanned continuous operation, realizes full-automatic production, and improves the wrench locking plate assembly efficiency and the assembly quality.

title_en: Silicon wafer chamfering production system and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of silicon wafer processing, and discloses a silicon wafer chamfering production system and a silicon wafer chamfering production method. The system comprises a feeding mechanism, a grinding mechanism and a clamping piece mechanism which work cooperatively, wherein the feeding mechanism drives a sucker for sucking a silicon sheet body and a silicon wafer turntable to move, the grinding mechanism adjusts a grinding wheel through a lifting table to realize multi-abrasive-material groove switching, an upper clamping block, a lower clamping block, a distance sensor and an independent electric screw transmission mechanism are arranged in the clamping piece mechanism, and elastic materials are arranged on the surface of the sucker. According to the method, the distance is fed back in real time through the distance sensor, the displacement of the clamping block is accurately regulated by matching with the electric screw transmission mechanism, and the silicon wafer body is kept in a limiting state when the abrasive groove is switched. The invention solves the problem that the existing sucker is easy to shift or swing in positioning, improves the clamping positioning precision, avoids deformation and edge breakage during chamfering of the silicon wafer, ensures chamfering uniformity, improves processing yield and efficiency, adapts to various processing scenes and meets the high-standard requirements of the semiconductor industry.

title_en: Cable cutting device
abstract_en: The invention provides a cable cutting device which comprises a sliding rail, wherein the sliding rail is transversely arranged, a sliding seat is slidably arranged on the sliding rail, a first pneumatic clamping jaw is fixedly arranged on the sliding seat, the sliding seat is connected with a transverse translation mechanism, the transverse translation mechanism is arranged below the sliding rail, a shell seat is fixedly arranged at one end of the sliding rail, a cutting mechanism is arranged above the shell seat, the cutting mechanism comprises a cutter body and a lifting cylinder for driving the cutter body to move up and down, a supporting seat is arranged below the cutter body and is used for supporting a cable to be cut, a cutter slot is formed in the top of the supporting seat, the supporting seat is arranged on the shell seat through the lifting mechanism and is used for driving the supporting seat to be retracted into the shell seat or extend out of the top of the shell seat, a wire guide mechanism is arranged at one side of the supporting seat, which is far away from the first pneumatic clamping jaw, the second pneumatic clamping jaw is arranged at the front side of the junction of the shell seat and the sliding rail, and the longitudinal translation mechanism is connected to the bottom of the second pneumatic clamping jaw. The cable cutting machine can realize batch cutting of cables and can automatically send out cables.

title_en: Lifting-free two-piece toothed turntable and working method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rotary tables, in particular to a lifting-free two-piece toothed rotary table and a working method thereof, comprising a shell; the rotary table comprises a shell, a working table surface, an indexing mechanism, a brake mechanism, a piston and a linear driving piece, wherein the working table surface is arranged at the top of the shell, the indexing mechanism is used for driving the working table surface to rotate to realize indexing, the brake mechanism comprises an oil cylinder seat, a piston and a brake disc assembly, the piston is sleeved on the outer side of the oil cylinder seat, the brake disc assembly comprises a fixed fluted disc and a movable fluted disc, key grooves are arranged on the end face, facing the piston, of the oil cylinder seat, positioning keys are arranged on the opposite end faces of the piston and embedded in the key grooves, pressure sensing pieces are arranged on two opposite side walls, in the circumferential direction, of the key grooves, in contact with the positioning keys, of the positioning keys, annular tooth surfaces are arranged on the peripheral wall of the bottom of the oil cylinder seat, racks meshed with the annular tooth surfaces and linear driving pieces for driving the racks to move along the length direction are arranged in the shell, active compensation can be carried out at the circumferential position, the meshing state of the forced tight single side is avoided, the tooth surface abrasion rate is reduced, and the positioning precision and the locking stability of the rotary table are ensured.

title_en: Automobile generator end cover machining, clamping and positioning device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of machining tools and discloses an automobile generator end cover machining clamping and positioning device which comprises a machining table, wherein a rotating table is arranged on the machining table, a rotating shaft is fixedly connected to the center of the bottom of the rotating table, a first limiting mechanism for fixing a center hole of an end cover is arranged in the rotating shaft, a round hole for extending out of the first limiting mechanism is formed in the upper surface of the rotating table, a supporting seat is fixedly connected to one side of the machining table, a lifting seat is slidably connected to the supporting seat in the vertical direction, a second limiting mechanism for fixing an end cover mounting lug is arranged on the lifting seat, a connecting rod is fixedly connected to one side of the lifting seat in the vertical direction, a third limiting mechanism for clamping and fixing two side edges of the end cover is arranged at the bottom of the connecting rod, and a control mechanism for controlling the third limiting mechanism to turn over 180 DEG is arranged on the supporting seat. The invention can restrict the vibration generated by the end cover during processing, prevent the end cover from moving upwards during the rotation processing of the end cover, ensure the clamping stability and ensure the processing effect.

title_en: Welding method and welding device based on waveguide
abstract_en: The invention discloses a waveguide-based welding method and a welding device, and relates to the technical field of microwave welding, wherein the device comprises a workbench, at least two mutually parallel longitudinal guide rails longitudinally arranged on the workbench, a bearing substrate longitudinally and reciprocally moving along the two longitudinal guide rails, a linear driving mechanism for driving the bearing substrate to move, two lifting platforms which are arranged on two sides of the workbench and synchronously lift, and SSPPs waveguide welding modules arranged on the two lifting platforms, wherein the bearing substrate is used for fixing two plates to be welded on the bearing substrate through a locking assembly, and the SSPPs waveguide welding modules comprise gradual bending waveguide components and microwave sources at two ends. The invention uses microwave radiation method to make large-size or complex structure work piece finish local fixed point welding in open space, and finish welding complex structures such as curved surface, gap, etc., concentrate microwave energy in welding area, realize accurate energy focusing, and improve energy utilization rate.

title_en: Surface polishing method for automobile parts
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of automobile part polishing, in particular to a surface polishing method for automobile parts. The method comprises the steps of dividing a surface analysis area before polishing, identifying near-surface defect characteristics and hardness distribution characteristics of the surface analysis area, calculating an area risk coefficient based on the near-surface defect characteristics and the hardness distribution characteristics by combining the thickness to be removed, performing quick polishing or stable polishing, monitoring vibration in polishing, calculating tremble wavelength matching degree, judging surface quality, adjusting technological parameters according to the depth of waves for a disqualified area, performing secondary polishing, verifying a regulation and control effect by calculating a ripple removal index, starting a multistage optimization strategy if the ripple removal index does not reach the standard, and finally judging the qualification of a part by comparing the actual thickness to be removed, thereby finishing polishing. The invention solves the problems of poor quality in the polishing process caused by hidden defects on the near surface of the part to be polished and uneven hardness distribution of the surface material.

title_en: Hierarchical cooperative control method and device for hot rolling warping heads, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a grading cooperative control method of hot rolling tilting heads, which comprises the steps of setting a tilting head quantity threshold range, comparing the collected tilting head quantity with the tilting head quantity threshold range, judging the tilting head condition according to a comparison result, executing primary control or secondary control, and repeating the collection and comparison processes until rolling of all slabs is completed. The invention also relates to a grading cooperative control device of the hot rolling tilting head, which comprises a setting module, an acquisition module, a comparison module and a circulation module. The invention also relates to an electronic device and a storage medium. The grading cooperative control method, the grading cooperative control device, the electronic equipment and the storage medium for the hot rolling tilting head can solve the problems that in the control measure for the tilting head, when the state of a heating furnace is abnormal or the initial temperature field of a slab is obviously unbalanced, the slab is simply dependent on the risk of impacting equipment caused by roller speed adjustment, and the existing slab is easy to excessively treat or severely treat and the subsequent slab is easy to repeatedly tilt and buckle.

title_en: Cable processing and cutting equipment and cutting method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cable processing cutting device and a cutting method, which relate to the technical field of cutting devices and comprise a frame, a cutting mechanism and an end straightening mechanism, wherein the end straightening mechanism comprises a driving cylinder, a fixed seat and a clamping part, a straightening hole is formed in the clamping part, a deformation joint which enables the clamping part to radially and elastically shrink is formed in the periphery of the clamping part, and a cylindrical part is coaxially and fixedly connected with the clamping part; A conical matching structure is arranged between the fixing seat and the clamping part, and the driving cylinder drives the clamping part to move in the conical matching structure so as to enable the clamping part to radially shrink or elastically expand, thereby clamping or loosening the end part of the cable positioned in the straightening hole. According to the invention, the cable end part extends into the straightening hole of the clamping part, and the straightening hole generates forced extrusion force on the cable end part through the elastic shrinkage deformation of the clamping part, so that the cable end part is forcedly straightened, the bending phenomenon of the cable end part is improved, and the subsequent processing or packaging links are facilitated.

title_en: Industrial equipment fault prediction method, system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The present application relates to the field of industrial equipment fault prediction, and more particularly, to an industrial equipment fault prediction method, an industrial equipment fault prediction system, an electronic device, and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining operation data, environment data, historical fault data and spare part data of industrial equipment, extracting characteristics of the operation data, the historical fault data and the spare part data to obtain operation characteristics, historical fault association characteristics and spare part association characteristics, obtaining operation correction characteristics according to an operation characteristic, the environment data and an environment interference processing double model, inputting the operation correction characteristics into a long-period memory network to obtain a first prediction result, inputting the operation correction characteristics, the first prediction result, the historical fault association characteristics and the spare part association characteristics into a gradient elevator model to obtain a second prediction result, and inputting the first prediction result and the second prediction result into an industrial large model to obtain a third prediction result. The method can realize accurate prediction of industrial equipment faults based on processing of multidimensional data.

title_en: Vertical solid-liquid composite forging equipment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of equipment manufacturing and discloses vertical solid-liquid composite forging equipment, which comprises a lower hood, wherein a lower machine foot is arranged on the outer side of the bottom end of the lower hood, a lower cross beam is fixedly arranged at the top end of the lower hood, a lower workbench is arranged above the lower cross beam, an upper working slide block is vertically and movably connected above the lower workbench, a die is arranged between opposite surfaces of the upper working slide block and the lower workbench, a forging cooling composite system is vertically and movably connected inside the lower cross beam, a forging head is arranged at the top end of the forging cooling composite system, and a frame die alignment rod is symmetrically embedded at the top end of the lower workbench.

title_en: Small space large torque pre-tightening method and device based on visual navigation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a small-space large-torque pre-tightening method and device based on visual navigation, wherein the small-space large-torque pre-tightening method and device comprises a supporting seat and a cylindrical straight gear set, the axis of the cylindrical straight gear set is perpendicular to the supporting seat, the cylindrical gear set comprises a driving gear which is internally meshed with a driven gear ring, the driving gear comprises an internal hexagonal wrench caliper which is integrated with the driven gear ring, a photoelectric baffle plate enables a motor to be powered off through shielding a photoelectric switch so as to ensure that the wrench caliper does not move beyond the stroke limit position of the wrench caliper, the space occupied by a traditional external-meshing design is replaced by the internal-meshing design of the gear ring so as to realize small-space assembly pre-tightening, the driving and control of the motor are used for realizing that the pre-tightening torque of a plurality of bolts is consistent and accurate, and the visual navigation is used for driving a mechanical arm to send the large-torque pre-tightening device to an undetectable and inaccessible position for manual assembly operation and preventing collision interference with other equipment and parts in a vehicle.

title_en: Sample preparation device and method for small-diameter metal wire chemical composition inspection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sample preparation device and method for chemical component inspection of a small-diameter metal wire rod, and relates to the technical field of chemical detection. The sample preparation device for the small-diameter metal wire chemical component inspection comprises a sample preparation device base, wherein side sliding rail grooves are formed in two sides of the top of the sample preparation device base, and clamping linkage sliding rods are movably sleeved in the side sliding rail grooves. The device cancels the steps of measuring the thickness of the caliper one by one and manually adjusting the spacing between the clamping plates of the special clamp by the high-precision caliper, avoids errors in the manual measurement, adjustment and clamping processes by the cooperative action of the diameter adaptation module and the preset program, ensures the clamping and positioning precision of each wire to be consistent, simultaneously, does not need to manually align cutting marks in the whole process, reduces repeated manual operation links and reduces the working strength of operators.

title_en: Multi-axis machine tool
abstract_en: A multi-axis machine tool (1) comprising a vertical column (2) movable along a longitudinal base (3), a carriage (6) slidable along the column (2), a transverse slide (8) slidable on the carriage (6) along a transverse rail means (9), and the slide (8) is adapted to support a tool holder head (10) in a cantilever manner. The transverse rail arrangement (9) comprises at least three rails (11A, 11B, 11C) arranged on the sides (8A, 8B) of the slide (8).

title_en: Method for synergistically enhancing dimensional stability of wood by eutectic solvent/lignin
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for synergistically enhancing the dimensional stability of wood by using eutectic solvent/lignin, which activates industrial lignin through the eutectic solvent (DES) and cooperatively impregnates the wood to realize double in-situ modification of cell walls, constructs an exogenous filling/crosslinking and in-situ crosslinking dual enhancing mechanism, breaks through the technical bottlenecks of uneven lignin distribution and unstable structure, reveals a multi-scale synergistic mechanism and provides a new path for quality improvement and synergy of fast-growing wood. The invention is not only beneficial to reducing the treatment cost, but also can promote the high-value reuse of lignin resources and reduce the emission of industrial wastes, has good economic benefit and ecological benefit, is beneficial to promoting the low-carbon transformation of the wood industry, and the prepared multifunctional wood can be applied to the fields of green buildings and high-end wood products and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Glue joint method of aluminum honeycomb structural member
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cementing method of an aluminum honeycomb structural member, which comprises the following steps of S1, carrying out composite surface modification treatment, S2, preparing a nano reinforced adhesive, S3, pre-curing an adhesive film, S4, positioning a honeycomb core and carrying out gradient pressurization, S5, selectively coating and penetrating, and S6, carrying out step-by-step curing, wherein the nano reinforced adhesive is uniformly coated on the cementing surface of the inner surface of the modified aluminum panel. According to the invention, through composite surface modification treatment and addition of nano-reinforced adhesive, a skeleton and filled composite adhesive layer structure is constructed, and the efficient and reliable gluing of the aluminum honeycomb structural member is realized by utilizing the cooperative innovation of gradient pressurization and step-by-step solidification processes, so that the problems of weak interface binding force, poor environmental stability, low peel strength and the like in the prior gluing technology are effectively solved, and the process is simple and convenient and is suitable for industrial production.

title_en: Femtosecond laser-based lens processing method and light diffusion structure array lens
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of femtosecond laser processing, and particularly relates to a lens processing method based on femtosecond laser and an array lens with a light diffusion structure; the lens processing method based on the femtosecond laser adopts a femtosecond laser process of combining layering processing and temperature control on the surface of a base material, can form a subarray microstructure with micropores or V-shaped grooves at the edge with high precision, is beneficial to realizing precise geometric phase modulation and required defocused light field control, and reduces the thermal damage in the processing process and keeps high light transmittance. The lens processing method has the advantages of higher heat dissipation efficiency, smaller heat damage, accurate light field control and high light transmittance on the whole.

title_en: Display screen laser cutting machine
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of display screen processing, in particular to a display screen laser cutting machine, which comprises a machine case, wherein a rack is fixedly arranged at the top of the machine case, a frame is fixedly arranged at the rear side of the top of the rack, a cutting mechanism is fixedly arranged at the top of the frame, bearing mechanisms are fixedly arranged at equal intervals below the frame in a linear arrangement mode on the rack, and a feeding mechanism is fixedly arranged at the front side of the rack. According to the application, the plurality of groups of bearing mechanisms are matched with the two groups of driving modules and the cutting modules, so that multi-station cooperative processing can be realized during use, actions of the mechanisms are alternately connected, waiting loss of single-station processing is avoided, and meanwhile, a plurality of display screens can be adsorbed and cut at one time by arranging the plurality of pneumatic adsorption modules and the bearing seats on the feeding mechanism and arranging the plurality of bearing reservation grooves, so that the effects of continuous operation and single multi-piece processing are achieved, and the production and processing efficiency is improved.

title_en: Special fixture for sheet blanking
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of sheet processing and discloses a sheet blanking special fixture which comprises a square upper clamping plate and a square lower clamping plate clamped on two sides of a sheet, wherein connecting columns are distributed on the lower clamping plate along the circumferential direction of the lower clamping plate, the lower ends of the connecting columns are fixedly connected with the lower clamping plate, the connecting columns are in clearance fit with the upper clamping plate in a penetrating way, a through hole with an inclined surface is formed in the upper part of the connecting columns, a wedge iron is inserted into the through hole in a penetrating way, and the wedge iron is tightly pressed on the top surface of the upper clamping plate. The thin plate can be clamped between the upper clamping plate and the lower clamping plate through the wedge iron, so that the clamping efficiency of the thin plate can be improved. The invention is also provided with an upper pressing die and a lower pressing die, and all wedges can be driven to move simultaneously through the upper pressing die and the lower pressing die, so that the clamping of the thin plate is realized rapidly.

title_en: Method for improving M6 grain size
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of steel rolling and discloses a method for improving M6 grain size, which comprises the steps of S1 heating control, S2 rolling temperature control, S3 Steyr air cooling line cooling control and S4 matched control system application, wherein the S1 heating control comprises S101 billet arrangement and S102 temperature and time control, the S2 rolling temperature control comprises S201 rolling line and wire laying temperature, the S3 Steyr air cooling line cooling control comprises S301 cooling speed adjustment and S302 roller way speed control, the S4 matched control system application comprises S401 temperature detection and S402 central control and execution.

title_en: Machining device and method for aviation turbine blade tooth-shaped crown
abstract_en: The invention provides a processing device and a processing method for a toothed crown of an aviation turbine blade. The machining device for the aviation turbine blade tooth-shaped crown comprises a bottom plate, a tooth-shaped positioning block for clamping a blade tenon groove, a side surface positioning block for being abutted to the side surface of the tenon, a blade crown positioning block for being abutted to the facing surface of a blade crown basin, a first pressing part, a second pressing part, a first supporting mechanism and a second supporting mechanism, wherein the tooth-shaped positioning block, the side surface positioning block, the blade crown positioning block, the first pressing part, the second pressing part, the first supporting mechanism and the second supporting mechanism are all arranged on the bottom plate.

title_en: Welding device and welding method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of welding processing, and provides a welding device and a welding method thereof. The device comprises a gantry frame, an upper welding mechanism, a lower welding mechanism, a transmission mechanism and a measuring mechanism. The upper welding mechanism and the lower welding mechanism are respectively arranged at the upper part and the lower part of the frame and comprise a driving component and a welding electrode, the measuring mechanism detects the height information of the lower welding electrode, and the lower driving component adjusts the height position of the lower welding electrode according to the height information. According to the application, the height difference caused by electrode abrasion can be automatically compensated by the measuring mechanism matched with the active adjustment of the lower driving assembly, and the constant welding reference surface is ensured, so that the welding quality stability is improved.

title_en: Cold heading forming device and method for thin flange electrode terminal
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cold heading forming device of a thin flange electrode terminal, wherein a second die comprises a main die, a first punch and a second punch, the main die comprises a forming die core, a thimble, a fixed seat, an intermediate sleeve and an elastic piece, the second ends of the forming die core and the thimble are abutted against the fixed seat, the intermediate sleeve is arranged on the fixed seat, the elastic piece is arranged between the intermediate sleeve and the fixed seat, a movable part is arranged at the second end of the intermediate sleeve, the movable part is sleeved outside the forming die core, the first punch comprises a first punch used for forming a flange part of a blank, the second punch comprises a second punch and a pressing part, the second punch is sleeved outside the pressing part, and the second punch is used for pressing the intermediate sleeve downwards towards the second end and cutting the edge of the flange part of the blank by matching with the pressing part. The invention can realize the preforming and trimming of the flange part in the same die by a two-die three-punch method, thereby avoiding the problem of damage caused by inconvenient clamping of the thinner flange part.

title_en: Integrated manufacturing device for metal parts of infrared detector
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of equipment manufacturing, in particular to an integrated manufacturing device for infrared detector metal parts. The mechanical arm comprises a mechanical arm, wherein the end part of the mechanical arm is fixedly connected with a support, a guide rail and a slide rail are arranged in the support, a displacement assembly is arranged between the support and the mechanical arm, two ends of the displacement assembly are respectively connected with a pushing structure, the two pushing structures are connected to the top of the support in a sliding mode and are matched with the guide rail in a guiding mode, the end part of each pushing structure is provided with a clamping assembly, the two clamping assemblies are symmetrically arranged and are connected to the top of the support in a sliding mode and are matched with the slide rail in a guiding mode, each clamping assembly comprises a clamping plate, an elastic sheet and a clamping block, the clamping plates are used for clamping a metal shell, the clamping blocks are connected with the clamping plates through the elastic sheets, the displacement assembly drives the two clamping assemblies to move oppositely or reversely along the slide rail through the pushing structures so as to clamp or loosen the metal shell, and when the metal shell is heated and expanded, the expansion stress pushes the two clamping plates to move reversely to compress the elastic sheet so as to release the expansion stress.

title_en: GCM fixed station and swing table frock
abstract_en: The invention relates to a GCM fixing table and swinging table tool, which comprises a positioning disc and a plurality of positioning seats respectively connected with the positioning disc through an adjusting mechanism, wherein the positioning seats can move along the radial direction of the positioning disc, and the positioning seats comprise two mounting surfaces respectively used for clamping the fixing table and the swinging table. The upper end face of the positioning disk is provided with a plurality of guide grooves with flanges, the adjusting mechanism is arranged in the guide grooves, guide pins are arranged between the adjusting mechanism and the positioning seat, clamping plates are arranged on the guide pins in a floating mode and located on the lower sides of the flanges, and the bottom plate is in threaded connection with the clamping plates through screw rods. Through setting up two installation faces on the positioning seat, can adapt to the clamping of fixed station and swinging table respectively, save the design and the manufacturing cost of special frock, show improvement frock commonality and economic nature. The clamping plate and the positioning seat are adopted to tightly clamp the flange, and the locking back force does not pass through the adjusting mechanism, so that the clamping rigidity is ensured, the precision of the adjusting mechanism is protected, and the service life is prolonged.

title_en: Machine vision-based paint lacquering control method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a machine vision-based lacquer lacquering control method and system, and relates to the lacquering control field, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining manufacturing information of a lacquer body, determining a plurality of key lacquering channels and an optimal polishing scheme based on the manufacturing information of the lacquer body and the total channel number of lacquering channels, wherein the optimal polishing scheme comprises polishing numbers corresponding to each key lacquering channel number, determining an optimal illumination parameter based on the manufacturing information of the lacquer body and the plurality of key lacquering channels, collecting a lacquer layer image of the lacquer body corresponding to each key lacquering channel number based on the optimal illumination parameter, identifying polishing defect information corresponding to the key lacquering channel number based on the lacquer layer image of the lacquer body corresponding to the key lacquering channel number, and generating a polishing control strategy of the next lacquering channel number based on the polishing defect information corresponding to the key lacquering channel number.

title_en: Plasma arc welding machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of welding equipment, in particular to a plasma arc welding machine which comprises a ventilation plate, wherein a plurality of ventilation holes are formed in the ventilation plate, a copper pipe is fixedly connected to the ventilation plate, an air inlet connector is fixedly connected to the upper end of the copper pipe, and an air outlet connector is fixedly connected to the lower end of the copper pipe. The ventilation plate is fixedly connected with a lifting column, the lifting column is connected with a lifting plate in a sliding manner, and the lifting plate is fixedly connected with a bottom plate. The breathable plate is fixedly connected with a sliding column, the sliding column is connected with an extension plate in a sliding manner, a fixed angle is connected to the extension plate in a rotating manner, a push plate is connected to the breathable plate in a sliding manner, and a spring is fixedly connected between the push plate and the breathable plate. The screw rod is rotatably connected in the bottom plate, a knob is fixedly connected to one end of the screw rod, a clamping plate is connected to the screw rod in a threaded mode, and the lower end of the clamping plate is slidably connected in the bottom plate. The invention utilizes the characteristic of absorbing heat when the argon state is changed, and enhances the heat radiation capability of the welding machine.

title_en: System, method, device, processor and medium for realizing automatic disassembly of electrode cap
abstract_en: The invention relates to a system for realizing automatic disassembly of an electrode cap, which comprises a driving unit, a mounting cross beam, a driving unit switching mounting plate, a cap disassembly unit, an electrode rod and an electrode cap, wherein the driving unit is fixed on the mounting cross beam through the driving unit switching mounting plate, the cap disassembly unit is in transmission connection with the driving unit, the electrode cap is arranged on the electrode rod, and the electrode cap on the electrode rod is disassembled through the cap disassembly unit. The system, the method, the device, the processor and the computer readable storage medium thereof for realizing the automatic disassembly of the electrode cap can effectively compatible with the dimensional tolerance of the electrode cap by adopting the flexible cap disassembly claw, and the gear is provided with the unique rolling steel ball guide groove, and the cap disassembly unit floats along the axial direction of the electrode cap while rotating by the relative movement of the rolling steel ball guide groove and the rolling steel ball. According to the invention, the screwing and drawing actions are combined, so that the disassembly work of the electrode cap is completed, and the success rate of the disassembly of the electrode cap is greatly improved.

title_en: Device and method for treating vanadium-titanium-iron ore
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of metallurgy, and particularly relates to a device and a method for treating vanadium-titanium-iron ore, wherein the device for treating vanadium-titanium-iron ore comprises a rotary kiln, a feeding system, a ball mill and a magnetic separator, the rotary kiln comprises a cylinder body, a feeding pipe, a discharging pipe and a driving device, a heat insulation layer is arranged outside the cylinder body, at least one heating module is arranged outside the heat insulation layer, the heating module comprises an electromagnetic coil and an electromagnetic variable frequency control cabinet, and the electromagnetic coil is wrapped outside the heat insulation layer in a surrounding manner; the feeding system is connected with a feeding pipe of the rotary kiln, the feeding system comprises a coal feeding system and a vanadium-titanium-iron ore feeding system, and a discharging pipe of the rotary kiln is sequentially connected with the ball mill and the magnetic separator. The rotary kiln of the device adopts electromagnetic induction heating, avoids the quantity of mineral powder taken away by a large amount of flue gas generated by combustion, has uniform and easily controlled temperature in the rotary kiln, realizes the feeding of the powder ore into the kiln by adopting the coal as the reducing agent, has higher reduction efficiency, is more beneficial to the separation of iron from vanadium and titanium, and is beneficial to the efficient recovery of vanadium and titanium.

title_en: Alloy steel mechanical fitting fixed-position welding device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of plasma arc welding and discloses an alloy steel mechanical accessory positioning welding device which comprises a welding table and a driving disc arranged on the top surface of the welding table, wherein a welding seat is fixedly arranged on the top surface of the welding table at the side edge of the driving disc, a plasma arc welding gun is arranged at the movable end of the welding seat, a plurality of uniformly distributed mounting holes are formed in the top surface of the driving disc, and a plurality of supports are arranged on the top surface of the driving disc. According to the invention, the position of the support is adjusted, the support is coaxially arranged in the mounting hole by matching with the limiting plate and the locating plate, the spring telescopic rod is attached to the outer wall of the workpiece through the spring telescopic rod and the pressing strip, the spring telescopic rod is fixed by the locking frame, multi-point adaptive clamping can be formed aiming at irregular shapes of the special-shaped workpiece, meanwhile, the angle locking design of the locking cone pulley and the locking cap is realized, the deviation of the workpiece in welding is avoided, the problem of difficult fixation of the special-shaped alloy steel fitting is solved, the accurate and firm positioning of the workpiece before welding is ensured, and a foundation is laid for high-quality welding.

title_en: Evaporator test fixture
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of evaporator testing, and discloses an evaporator testing tool, which comprises a case and an evaporator body, wherein a detection component is arranged in the case, an auxiliary component is arranged on one side of the case, the evaporator body is arranged in the auxiliary component, a ceramic valve is arranged on the upper surface of the evaporator body, the detection component comprises an airtight pressure regulating value display table, the airtight pressure regulating value display table is arranged on the surface of the case, and an airtight air inlet pressure regulating valve is arranged on the surface of the case. According to the invention, the test pressure is accurately set through the airtight air inlet pressure regulating valve and the air resistance air inlet pressure regulating valve, the manual flow regulating valve can flexibly regulate the air flow, the high-sensitivity flowmeter and the pressure display meter are matched, data are fed back in real time, the PLC automatically completes data acquisition and judgment, the manual reading error is avoided, and the consistency and reliability of the test result are ensured.

title_en: Composite abrasive grain superhard material segment type cutter head and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of tool manufacturing, and discloses a composite abrasive grain superhard material segment type tool bit and a manufacturing method thereof. The tool bit is based on an iron-nickel-cobalt-copper-tin bond and comprises diamond and cubic boron nitride composite abrasive particles. The core technical characteristics are that the surface layer is introduced with strong carbide forming elements and modified carbon-rich polymer precursors, a hard carbide phase which is dispersed and distributed is generated in situ in the hot pressing sintering process, and the inner layer contains hexagonal boron nitride self-lubricating phase and high-heat-conductivity spherical copper powder. The whole tool bit adopts a laminated structure, the mismatch of thermal expansion coefficients among materials is relieved through an interface gradient layer, and directional cooling is implemented in the manufacturing process, so that residual compressive stress is induced on the side surface of the tool bit. According to the application, by utilizing the linkage of the material components and the cooling process, the self-maintenance of the side high wear resistance and the end face U-shaped self-sharpening form is realized, the mechanical holding force of the matrix on abrasive particles is enhanced, and the defects of cutter head wear thinning and jamming in the processing process are effectively overcome.

title_en: Gear grinding clamp
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of machine tool fixtures, in particular to a gear grinding fixture. Including anchor clamps main part and adjusting device, the inside fixedly connected with expansion piece of anchor clamps main part upper end, adjusting device sets up under the anchor clamps main part, adjusting device is including the fixed disk that is located anchor clamps main part bottom, the inside threaded connection of anchor clamps main part and fixed disk has a plurality of installation bolts, the bottom fixed mounting of fixed disk has the adjusting disk, the surface cover of adjusting disk has upper disc and lower disc, insert between upper disc and the lower disc and be equipped with a plurality of gasbags, the gasbag is located one side of adjusting disk, through adjusting device, realize the effect according to lathe part skew condition adjustment anchor clamps position, also can dynamic compensation anchor clamps installation deviation, solve the long-term after the use precision decay of traditional lathe and lead to the anchor clamps position mismatch problem, the gasbag driving method is adjusted in a flexible way, can effective control gear profile, tooth thickness and tooth spacing error, promote gear meshing stationarity and assembly suitability.

title_en: Mobile communication equipment production is with mobile phone location die carrier
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of mobile communication equipment production, and discloses a mobile phone positioning die carrier for mobile communication equipment production, which comprises an upper die holder and a lower die holder, a group of guide posts symmetrically arranged at opposite angles of the bottom surface of the upper die holder, a group of guide sleeves symmetrically arranged at opposite angles of the upper surface of the lower die holder, a bushing detachably embedded in the guide sleeves, wherein the bushing is provided with an inner hole for sliding fit of the guide posts, and a gap compensation mechanism arranged between the guide sleeves and the bushing. According to the invention, through the matched design of the guide sleeve, the bushing and the gap compensation mechanism, the abrasion of the matched gap can be subjected to gap compensation, the maintenance cost and the production cost of products are reduced, the resource utilization rate is improved, the practicability is high, the problems that an operator needs to stop the machine to disassemble and integrally replace the bushing, the maintenance cost is high, a large number of bushings with residual service life are abandoned in advance, and unnecessary resource waste is generated are avoided.

title_en: Intelligent production line for surface treatment of cathode carbon block
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent production line for cathode carbon block surface treatment, which comprises an intelligent production line, wherein the intelligent production line comprises an operation room and a lacquering mechanism arranged in the operation room, one side of the lacquering mechanism is provided with a drying mechanism, one side of the drying mechanism, which is far away from the lacquering mechanism, is provided with a polishing mechanism, one side of the polishing mechanism, which is far away from the drying mechanism, is provided with a detection mechanism, the outer sides of two ends of the operation room are respectively provided with a blanking manipulator and a feeding manipulator, one side of the blanking manipulator is provided with a finished product transferring conveyor, one side of the feeding manipulator is provided with a material preparing conveyor, the upper surface of the material preparing conveyor is provided with a carbon block, and one side of the lacquering mechanism, which is far away from the drying mechanism, is provided with a material feeding conveying mechanism.

title_en: Compression rolling manufacturing device and method for compressor shell
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for manufacturing a compressor shell by pressing and rolling, which relate to the field of machining and comprise a pair of shells which are arranged up and down and respectively correspond to an upper shell and a lower shell of a compressor; the rolling device is arranged in the shell and used for rolling and forming the metal plate, and comprises a mounting plate and a supporting block, wherein the mounting plate is fixedly arranged on the outer side surface of the shell, which is far away from the other shell. The invention can monitor and dynamically adjust the pressure born by different areas of the shell in real time by arranging the main body forming part formed by splicing the plurality of arc contact plates capable of independently and radially moving and the forming surface of the supporting block and matching with the jacking air bag, the hydraulic device and the induction integration device which are arranged in the main body forming part, thereby effectively ensuring the uniformity of the wall thickness and the shape precision of the formed shell.

title_en: Sleeve stretch forming process, sleeve and electrode assembly
abstract_en: The invention relates to a sleeve stretch forming process, a sleeve and an electrode assembly. The process comprises the steps of stamping and stretching a sheet raw material to form a concave part in the middle of the sheet raw material, forming a flanging edge on the periphery of the top end of the concave part, blanking the concave part to form a first through hole, extruding the inner wall of the concave part to enable the concave part to be in a vertical cylindrical structure, shaping the inner cavity of the vertical cylindrical structure, upsetting the lower end face of the vertical cylindrical structure after the upsetting to form a plane, forming a cylinder body by the vertical cylindrical structure, forming a flanging flange by the flanging edge, and forming a sleeve by an integrated structure formed by the cylinder body and the flanging flange. The invention also discloses a sleeve and an electrode assembly. The invention is beneficial to improving the sealing reliability of the electrode assembly.

title_en: Welding detection method for multi-layer heat dissipation structure for integrated circuit
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of welding, and discloses a welding detection method of a multilayer heat dissipation structure for an integrated circuit, wherein a temperature sensor is adopted to collect temperature values of a packaged state vacuum cavity soaking layer in real time in a brazing process, a pressure sensor is adopted to collect contact pressure between a forced cooling pressure head and the packaged state vacuum cavity soaking layer in real time, a control unit calculates temperature change rate dT/dT collected by the temperature sensor in real time, the pressure change rate dP/dT collected by the pressure sensor is lower than a preset first threshold value and the duration exceeds a first preset time, and when the pressure change rate |dP/dt| exceeds a preset second threshold value and the duration exceeds a second preset time, the control unit judges that the packaged state vacuum cavity soaking layer is broken at high temperature so as to respond. The brazing method has the advantages that the brazing method synchronously detects during the brazing process, the temperature and pressure response time is short, the temperature change rate and the pressure change rate are adopted for comprehensive judgment, and false alarm is reduced.

title_en: High-wear-resistance crankshaft and 3D printing preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mechanical transmission devices, in particular to a high-wear-resistance crankshaft and a 3D printing preparation method thereof, wherein the crankshaft comprises a crankshaft eccentric shaft crank, a balance weight connecting disc between the shaft crank, a crankshaft eccentric shaft bearing positioning table, a large gear ring mounting table and a bearing mounting table, a 40CrNiMoA/17-4PH high-strength matrix is adopted to match with a composite structure of a 3D printing wear-resistant layer, WC-Co hard alloy or Cr  3 C 2  -NiCr alloy wear-resistant layers are respectively deposited on key working surfaces, the preparation process comprises matrix preparation adapting to different production requirements, 3D printing wear-resistant layer deposition, sand blasting treatment and special heat treatment and finish machining, and core technological parameters of each procedure are optimized; the invention solves the problems of easy stress concentration, quick abrasion and short service life of the traditional crankshaft, the abrasion rate of the abrasion-resistant layer is reduced to below 0.02mm/1000h, the service life of the crankshaft is prolonged to over 20000h, the performance and the cost are both considered, and the invention is suitable for various transmission working conditions and gear specifications.

title_en: Strip steel uncoiling device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coil steel uncoiling and sampling, in particular to a strip steel uncoiling device, which comprises a coiling machine, a guide plate and a strip steel coil, wherein the coiling machine is used for bearing a strip steel coil and driving the strip steel coil to rotate, the guide plate comprises a guide plate and a support plate, and the guide plate is connected to the support plate and is slidably arranged on one side of the coiling machine. When the strip coil is placed, the guide plate horizontally moves away from the reel-out position. When the strip steel coil is uncoiled, the guide plate can lift the strip steel to pass through the lower part of the coiling machine when the strip steel coil is uncoiled, so that the strip steel is ensured to have a longer free section when the strip steel is uncoiled, the resilience force of the strip steel is reduced, the strip steel has a larger degree of freedom, the deformation of the strip steel during coiling is reduced during coiling, and the coiling quality of the strip steel coil is ensured. The first clamping roller set comprises a first upper roller and a first lower roller, the first upper roller and the first lower roller are arranged at one end of the rolling machine far away from the guide plate, the first upper roller of the first clamping roller set can vertically approach the first lower roller, strip steel which is unreeled from the strip steel roll is flattened, and the subsequent treatment of the strip steel is facilitated.

title_en: Method for processing flatness TTV stability of silicon wafer grinding equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for processing flatness TTV stability of silicon wafer grinding equipment, which belongs to the technical field of semiconductor silicon wafer processing and comprises the following operation steps: the first step is to synchronously collect equipment state signals, wherein the equipment state signals comprise a main shaft X, Y, Z three-way vibration frequency spectrum, a workbench inclination angle and vacuum chuck partition pressure. And step two, in the stage of retracting the grinding wheel after the grinding cycle is finished, rapidly acquiring a thickness profile curve along a preset radius within one circle of rotation of the silicon wafer by using the non-contact measuring head, and calculating a TTV trend value. And thirdly, analyzing the energy change of a specific high frequency band based on the collected vibration spectrum signals, identifying early wear symptoms of the bearing, and sending out predictive maintenance alarms. And fourthly, judging the processing quality based on the calculated TTV trend value, and if abnormality is found, carrying out alarm interception in the current working procedure. By means of on-line monitoring, in-situ measurement and data analysis, a quality firewall in the silicon wafer grinding process is constructed, and the problem of TTV stability control is effectively solved.

title_en: Ultrathin corrugated plate laser welding fixture
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of laser welding, in particular to an ultrathin corrugated plate laser welding fixture which comprises a base, four corners of the bottom of the base are fixedly connected with supporting feet, four groups of supporting feet are used for contacting with external ground ends, a guide rail is fixedly connected to the inner bottom of the base, a sliding block is slidingly connected to the guide rail, the bottom of a contact assembly is connected to the top of the sliding block and is slidingly arranged on the guide rail through the sliding block, a bidirectional screw is rotationally connected to the side wall of the base, the other end of the bidirectional screw is fixedly connected with a handle, and the handle is rotationally connected with the side wall of the base. The upper contact plate and the lower contact plate form an independent clamping unit, a plurality of clamping units are connected through the connecting half plates and can act simultaneously, when the driving screw is rotated, the connecting half plates drive all the upper contact plates to synchronously move downwards and uniformly press the corrugated plates placed on the lower contact plates, and the pressure sensors integrated on the upper contact plates and the lower contact plates can monitor clamping force in real time.

title_en: Lathe for central hole of plunger sleeve of oil pump nozzle
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of oil pump part processing equipment, and discloses a lathe for a central hole of a plunger sleeve of an oil pump nozzle. According to the invention, the screw is driven to rotate by the driving adjusting piece, so that the threaded adjusting plate is accurately and linearly fed along the limiting rod, the drill bit driven by the motor I in the upper shaft drilling assembly is driven to finish the drilling rough machining of the central hole of the plunger sleeve, the stepping motor in the turnover fixture is used for driving the rotating rod to rotate, the surface to be finished of the workpiece is accurately aligned with the lower shaft finish boring assembly, and the finish boring cutter driven by the motor II in the lower shaft finish boring assembly is driven by the driving adjusting piece to finish the precise boring machining of the central hole, so that the rough machining and the finish machining of the plunger sleeve under the condition of one-step clamping of the central hole of the plunger sleeve are realized, the coaxiality and the position degree accumulated error caused by the reference conversion of multiple working procedures are avoided, the machining precision loss problem caused by non-uniform references is solved, and the machining period of the workpiece is shortened.

title_en: Aluminum alloy surface protection method, aluminum alloy workpiece and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an aluminum alloy surface protection method, an aluminum alloy workpiece and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of aluminum alloy surface modification and laser protection. The method comprises the steps of preparing an aluminum alloy surface microstructure, growing an array by anodic oxidation, electrochemically depositing ultraviolet light absorption particles and sealing holes. The dual three-dimensional structure formed by the microstructure substrate and the anodic oxidation array increases the laser contact area, prolongs the laser reflection path, and realizes the efficient absorption of ultraviolet band laser by bismuth doped tin oxide compound light absorption particles, the absorption rate reaches more than 95%, and the stray light inhibition effect is obvious.

title_en: Laser drilling device for electric power iron tower
abstract_en: The invention provides a laser drilling device for an electric iron tower, which relates to the field of laser drilling and comprises a supporting table, wherein a supporting frame is fixedly arranged at the top of the supporting table, a placing frame is fixedly arranged at the top of the supporting frame, a threaded seat is fixedly arranged at the top of the placing frame, angle steel A to be drilled is movably arranged between two groups of placing frames, angle steel B to be drilled is movably arranged at the top of the angle steel A to be drilled, a limiting component is fixedly arranged between the two groups of supporting frames, a fixing structure is arranged at the outer side of the threaded seat, an adjusting mechanism is fixedly arranged at the top of the supporting table, a drilling structure is fixedly arranged at the top of the adjusting mechanism, and the two groups of angle steel can be fixed in a central symmetry mode through the fixing structure and the drilling structure, so that one group of laser drilling heads can simultaneously drill two groups of angle steel, the machining flow is not required to be completed twice, and the drilling efficiency is improved.

title_en: Combined woodworking drill and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a combined woodworking drill and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein stable assembly of a cutter head and a cutter holder is realized through inserting, positioning and welding fixing modes, a cylindrical inserting block is arranged at the bottom of the cutter head, the inserting block is accurately inserted into a slot of the cutter holder, an upper chip groove of the cutter head is overlapped with a lower chip groove of the cutter holder and then welded, the cutter head is in three-blade layout, a positioning tip is formed at the center of the cutter blade, the cutter blade is in an arc-shaped curved surface, a breaking tip is arranged at the tail end of the cutter blade, the positioning tip is matched with a pre-positioning drilling position and prevents a drill bit from shifting, the cutter blade is in an integral structure pressed by hard alloy, the abutting precision of the cutter blade and the cutter holder can be ensured, a thinning groove is formed at one side of the upper chip groove of the cutter blade, the thinning groove can reduce contact between the cutter blade and timber and assist heat dissipation of the cutter head, and the upper chip groove is overlapped with the lower chip groove of the cutter holder up and down, and smooth chip discharging is realized.

title_en: Flaring device and flaring method for metal pipe fitting
abstract_en: The application provides a flaring device and a flaring method suitable for a metal pipe fitting, wherein the flaring device comprises a die fixing mechanism, a flaring die and a workpiece clamping mechanism, the die fixing mechanism comprises a mounting part, one end of the flaring die is fixed on the mounting part, the die fixing mechanism can drive the flaring die to move towards the workpiece clamping mechanism, the flaring die comprises a guide section, a reducing section and a flaring section, the reducing section is connected with the guide section and the flaring section, the flaring section is closer to the mounting part than the guide section in the axial direction of the flaring die, the outer diameter of the flaring section is larger than that of the guide section, and the guide section is provided with an equal-diameter section. According to the application, the guide section is added before the reducing section of the flaring die, so that the number of flaring times is reduced during flaring processing, and the production efficiency is improved.

title_en: Deburring equipment for hydrogen delivery steel pipe orifice
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of steel pipe deburring, and discloses a deburring device for a pipe orifice of a hydrogen-conveying steel pipe, which comprises a processing table and a placing seat, wherein the placing seat is arranged in the middle of the upper surface of the processing table, a blanking groove is formed in the left side and the right side of the upper surface of the processing table, which is positioned on the placing seat, a clamping structure is arranged in the placing seat, when the deburring structure is used for deburring the pipe orifice of the steel pipe, a shielding structure can be driven to be inserted into the inner wall of the steel pipe, a turnover strip and shielding cloth on the shielding structure can be used for shielding generated scraps and dust in the deburring process, and when the shielding structure is extracted after deburring, part of scraps and dust can be directly taken out of the steel pipe through the turnover strip and the shielding cloth, so that the deburring working quality is improved, and meanwhile, the turnover strip can be rotated according to the inner diameter of the steel pipe with different inner diameters through a first adjusting structure, so that the deburring device is more flexible to use.

title_en: Engine rotor blade decomposition device
