abstract_en: The invention provides an engine rotor blade decomposing device which comprises a base component and a blade decomposing component, wherein the base component is used for bearing and positioning a rotor to be decomposed, the engine rotor blade decomposing device comprises a base and a blade storage box arranged at the top of the base, and the blade storage box is used for collecting blades falling after decomposition. The blade decomposition component is detachably arranged above the base component, and after being coaxially aligned with the rotor to be decomposed, the upper end of the blade decomposition component is matched with a press head of the press machine and is used for converting the vertical downward pressure of the press machine into horizontal component force along the mortise direction of the blade disc, so that the whole disc of the rotor blade is synchronously decomposed. The accidental damage caused by uneven stress or dislocation of the blades in the traditional knocking mode is fundamentally avoided, the collision of the blades caused by mutual dislocation superposition is avoided, and the decomposition quality of the blades is improved. The operator only needs to complete the positioning alignment of the rotor and the device of the invention before the disassembly, and can quickly complete the synchronous disassembly of all the blades by starting the press, thereby reducing the labor intensity.

title_en: Method for producing bimetallic strip saw blade by using trimetallic composite belt and saw tooth cutting control system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for producing a bimetallic strip saw blade by a trimetallic composite belt and a saw tooth cutting control system, and belongs to the technical field of bimetallic strip saw blade processing. The method comprises the steps of S1, forming a three-metal composite belt by respectively welding band saw backing materials on two sides of a high-speed steel wire, constructing a saw tooth cutting three-dimensional model for describing a saw tooth cutting process, S2, setting a plurality of monitoring points corresponding to cutting paths in a saw tooth cutting area based on the saw tooth cutting three-dimensional model, establishing a saw tooth displacement difference value data set, a tool bit thermal deformation risk data set and a saw tooth abrasion risk data set, S3, constructing a saw tooth collision difference coefficient at an ith monitoring point for representing a saw tooth collision trend, S4, constructing a cutting risk coefficient at the ith monitoring point, S5, carrying out associated calculation on the saw tooth collision difference coefficient at the ith monitoring point and the cutting risk coefficient at the ith monitoring point, and constructing a comprehensive cutting risk coefficient at the ith monitoring point.

title_en: Die filling height-adjustable sliding block for press machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of presses, and discloses a die-filling height-adjustable sliding block for a press, which comprises four press transmission columns, a die-filling plate, a box-type sliding block, four guide rail assemblies arranged on the box-type sliding block, two die-filling adjusting mechanisms, two groups of die-filling adjusting mechanisms, symmetrically arranged in the box-type sliding block, and a transmission rod penetrating through the box-type sliding block and connected with the die-filling plate, wherein the transmission rod adopts hydraulic power to drive the transmission rod to stretch and retract so as to adjust the height of the die-filling plate, and the dies with different thicknesses are installed and fixed. The die-filling height-adjustable sliding block for the press machine can adjust the die-filling height of the sliding block of the press machine in a rigid driving mode, and can eliminate mechanical gaps in a rigid locking mode to improve the forming quality of workpieces.

title_en: Error proofing device and error proofing method for ultrathin locking gasket of engine
abstract_en: The application discloses an error proofing device and an error proofing method for an ultrathin locking gasket of an engine, and relates to the field of engine assembly and manufacture, wherein the error proofing device comprises a mounting backboard, a groove error proofing block and a proximity switch; the groove error-proofing block is arranged on the mounting backboard and provided with a limiting groove, the effective height dimension of the limiting groove is larger than the thickness of the single locking gasket and a redundant gap is reserved between the limiting groove and the single locking gasket, so that two or more overlapped locking gaskets are prevented from being inserted. The detection end face of the proximity switch faces the end point area of the limit groove, detects the gasket in-place state in real time, and outputs a qualification judgment signal to the programmable logic controller. And after receiving the signals, the programmable logic controller releases the logic interlocking state of the current assembly process. The mechanical interception of multiple gaskets is realized through limit size interference, the neglected loading state is accurately identified by utilizing the proximity switch, and a hard interlocking mechanism of the operation authority is constructed by combining the controller, so that assembly circulation which is not subjected to error proofing verification is avoided.

title_en: Scaffold pressure plate stamping forming die and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a scaffold pressure plate stamping forming die and a method, belonging to the technical field of stamping forming dies, wherein the scaffold pressure plate stamping forming die comprises an upper die frame, an upper punching die, a pushing plate, a lower die fixing plate and a lower die frame, wherein the top surface of the lower die is provided with a plurality of limit pins uniformly distributed on the circumference, and the limit pins primarily limit the outer contour of a circular plate base of the pressure plate to be stamped; the material pushing plate is characterized in that a positioning groove is coaxially arranged on the bottom surface of the material pushing plate, the inner diameter of the positioning groove is matched with the outer diameter of the circular plate base body, and the positioning groove is used for carrying out secondary limiting on the circular plate base body before the punch head of the upper punch die contacts the top surface of the circular plate base body. The invention can perform secondary centering on the disc substrate after discharging, reduce the shape and position errors of stamping processing and improve the stamping quality.

title_en: Anti-loosening bolt connection assembly, assembly method thereof and damper
abstract_en: The application provides an anti-loosening bolt connection assembly, an assembly method thereof and an anti-vibration hammer, and relates to the technical field of bolt connection, wherein the anti-loosening bolt connection assembly comprises a bolt, a connected piece, a shape memory alloy washer and a fastener screwed on the bolt, and the shape memory alloy washer is sleeved on the bolt and is positioned between the fastener and the connected piece; the thickness of the shape memory alloy washer is configured such that when the ambient temperature triggers a phase change of the shape memory alloy washer, the shape memory alloy washer generates a recovery amount sufficient to compensate for an expected amount of axial deformation of the bolted assembly, and the effective annular cross-sectional area of the shape memory alloy washer is configured such that when the ambient temperature triggers a phase change of the shape memory alloy washer, the shape memory alloy washer generates a recovery force that is greater than or equal to an expected amount of pretension loss of the bolted assembly. Therefore, the application realizes the active pre-tightening force compensation based on the deep coupling of the geometric dimension of the gasket and the failure mode of the bolt connection system, and can effectively prevent non-rotary looseness.

title_en: Intelligent tapping integrated device for speed reducer shell
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent tapping integrated device for a speed reducer shell, which comprises a supporting rod, wherein the top of the supporting rod is fixedly connected with a workbench, the top of the workbench is provided with a numerical control rotary table, the outer wall of the workbench is fixedly connected with punching and tapping equipment, the top of the numerical control rotary table is fixedly connected with a rotary block, the outer wall of the rotary block is fixedly connected with a connecting plate, the top of the numerical control rotary table is provided with a tapping integrated mechanism, the intelligent tapping integrated device relates to the technical field of metal machining, and the speed reducer shell punching part passing through and staying for a short time at the moment and the whole surface of the speed reducer shell extend into a brush to brush burrs generated by punching inside and outside the speed reducer shell, meanwhile, liquid which is matched with a water pipe in real time is communicated with the inside of the rotary table through a sliding rotary ring, cooling and scouring of the punched burrs in real time are completed through spraying pipes in the inner wall of the rotary table, and residual cleaning of the burrs at the punching part is further improved.

title_en: Special cutting knife for oil filling hole of tractor oil tank
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a special cutting sword of tractor oil tank oil filler point, the electric iron comprises a handle, the front end external surface of handle is fixed with the U-shaped fork, it has the hexagonal column to articulate in the U-shaped fork, the downside of hexagonal column is established to the tool bit, hexagonal column upper end both sides are equipped with the circle axle, in the U-shaped fork front end preformed groove is advanced to circle axle card, the circle is epaxial to have the nut through threaded connection outward, and it is through adopting tool bit and handle be assembled connection, when tool bit department damages removable tool bit can, can not cause unnecessary extravagant, and the tool bit can be received between the U-shaped fork when not using simultaneously, can not expose, avoids the mistake to touch, uses safelyr.

title_en: Fixing device for aluminum profile cutting
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fixing device is used in aluminium alloy cutting belongs to aluminium alloy processing utensil technical field. It includes the base, and the top of base is rotated and is connected with the installation pole that the horizontal direction set up, and fixedly connected with arc pole is still gone back at the top of base, and the centre of a circle of arc pole is unanimous with the turning point of installation pole, and the bottom fixedly connected with stop collar of installation pole, stop collar and arc pole slip cup joint, and are provided with first tight set bolt on the stop collar, still are provided with a plurality of anchor clamps that are used for fixed aluminium alloy on the installation pole. The utility model discloses a setting of installation pole and arc pole, the aluminium alloy of treating processing passes through anchor clamps to be fixed on the installation pole, and the installation pole rotates under the restriction of arc pole, drives the aluminium alloy and adjusts to each angle to can cut into the tangent plane of various angles, the follow-up operation of the aluminium alloy of being convenient for at the section of aluminium alloy.

title_en: Cutting device is used in corrugated paper production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a corrugated paper production technical field just discloses a cutting device is used in corrugated paper production, including organism, two risers and roof, two the bottom of riser respectively with the left side and the right side fixed connection at organism top, the left and right sides of roof respectively with the top fixed connection of the relative one side of two risers, two electric putter of bottom fixedly connected with of roof, two electric putter's bottom fixedly connected with lift seat. This cutting device is used in corrugated paper production, promote the lift seat through electric putter and descend, the both sides of lift seat are through the movable lantern ring at the surperficial lapse of spacing slide bar, drive cutting blade downstream, when cutting blade moved the position that is close to support panel, the bottom of extrusion piece can earlier with the corrugated container board contact at support panel top, and extrude corrugated container board, fix corrugated container board's position through the extrusion piece, then cutting blade continues downstream, cut off the corrugated paper.

title_en: Electric welding handle and electric welding
abstract_en: This application is applicable to welding equipment technical field, provides an electric welding handle and electric welding, and this electric welding handle includes base and upper cover. The upper cover and the base can be detached and connected, the upper cover comprises a body part and a cover plate part, the body part and the base can be detached and connected, the cover plate part covers the surface of the cover plate part, away from the body part, and an anti-skidding structure is arranged on the surface of the cover plate part, away from the body part. The application provides an electric welding handle is through dividing into apron portion and this somatic part with the apron to further through keeping away from this somatic part at the apron portion be equipped with anti-skidding structure on the surface, thereby guaranteed the feel of contact position, solved original electric welding handle when promoting the product quality and held the bad technical problem of sense.

title_en: Quick collection device of lathe waste material
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a lathe waste rapid collection device, which comprises a lathe body, wherein two sides of the upper end of the lathe body are respectively connected with protective side plates, the upper ends of a group of protective side plates are provided with chutes, slide blocks are connected in the chutes in a sliding manner, the upper ends of the sliders are connected with universal ball bearings, one ends of the universal ball bearings are connected with long rods, one sides of the long rods are connected with brushes, and the upper ends of the lathe body are also provided with material receiving grooves; the utility model discloses a connect the setting of silo for the waste material falls into and connects the workbin, make it rotate on universal ball bearing and adjust the direction through rotating the stock, make the brush towards on the baffle, remove at lathe body up end through promoting the stock, the slider removes in the spout is slided, remaining waste material is cleared up on the baffle to the brush, make the waste material get into downwards and connect the silo to get into and connect the workbin, can accomplish the collection of waste material rapidly, and is efficient, connects the workbin to be convenient for take out and put into, the operation of being convenient for.

title_en: Metal pipe polishing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a metal tubular product burnishing device, including base and rotating electrical machines, still including setting up at the grinding machanism of rotating electrical machines output and the fixed establishment of setting at the base top, grinding machanism is including the sanding dish, sanding block, spring, telescopic link and the board of polishing, rotating electrical machines output fixedly connected with sanding dish, the inside center department of sanding dish is equipped with the sanding block, the inside bilateral symmetry of sanding dish is equipped with two sets of springs. The utility model discloses a set up and polish dish, polishing block, spring, telescopic link and polishing plate, drive the polishing dish and rotate under the effect of rotating electrical machines, the pipe fitting cover that will polish is in the polishing block outside, supports the outer lane of tight pipe fitting under the effect of telescopic link and polishing plate, when rotating electrical machines rotates, drives polishing block and polishing plate and polishes the inside and outside end of pipe fitting respectively, facilitates the use, improves efficiency of polishing and the effect of polishing.

title_en: Hand cranking structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a handle structure, including rocking arm, handle and connecting axle subassembly, the connecting axle subassembly sets up the upper end lateral part at the rocking arm, and the handle setting is at the lower extreme lateral part of rocking arm, and characteristics are that the upper end lateral part of rocking arm is provided with the installation cavity with connecting axle subassembly matched with, are provided with between installation cavity and the connecting axle subassembly and prevent changeing the structure, and the connecting axle subassembly is inhaled through magnetism and is connected fixed mounting in the installation cavity. The magnetic suction type connecting shaft assembly has the advantages that the structure is simple, the convenient disassembly and assembly between the hand crank and the connecting shaft assembly can be realized without any special tool, and the anti-rotation structure between the mounting cavity and the connecting shaft assembly realizes that the connecting shaft assembly and the rocker arm can rotate along with the shaking of the rocker arm after the magnetic suction mounting is completed, so that the use stability of the hand crank is ensured; when the concrete boxing is transported, the front end of the connecting shaft assembly can be directly arranged on related equipment, and the rocker arm and the handle are detached, so that the boxing volume is reduced.

title_en: Chain saw with dust removal function
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the chain saw, refer in particular to a chain saw with dust removal function, including chain saw body and the saw blade of setting on the chain saw body, chain saw body upper end is equipped with dust collector, dust collector is including dismantling the dust storage box that sets up on the chain saw body, set up the dust removal case in dust storage box one side, the dust removal incasement is equipped with the air exhauster, air exhauster one end is equipped with the dust absorption head, and the other end is equipped with the dust exhaust pipe that is linked together with the dust storage box, dust absorption head one side is used for the telescoping device of dust absorption, the telescoping device wears to establish the dust removal incasement. The utility model aims at providing a stable in structure, dust removal effect good, long service life's chain saw with dust removal function.

title_en: Heater capable of adjusting temperature for bead welding machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a surfacing welding machine technical field, and a but temperature regulation's heater for surfacing welding machine is disclosed, outer tube including a plurality of mutual concatenations, the inside heating cavity that all is provided with of pipe wall of a plurality of outer tubes, the inside of heating cavity is provided with the heating pipe, the connecting wire of heating pipe is the outside that runs through to the outer tube, the tip of the connecting wire on two adjacent outer tubes is fixed respectively and is equipped with first connection piece and second connection piece, the fixed lock pin that is equipped with of lateral wall of first connection piece, the slot has been seted up to the lateral wall of second connection piece, the lock pin is located the inside of slot, all be equipped with coupling mechanism between the both sides of first connection piece and second connection piece, the pipe wall both sides of two adjacent outer tubes are all fixed and are equipped with first fixed block and the second fixed. The utility model discloses the coil figure of regulation heater that can be random can adjust the heating temperature of the self of heater, and then has improved the welder practicality of surfacing welding machine.

title_en: Medical cutting machine capable of cutting coiled bags with proper length
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of medical roll bag cutting machines, in particular to a medical cutting machine capable of cutting roll bags with proper length, which comprises a frame, an upper guide rail, a lower guide rail and a cutting knife, wherein a positioning plate capable of horizontally rotating is arranged below the lower guide rail, the inner end of the positioning plate is a movable connecting end, the outer end of the positioning plate is a free end, a corresponding positioning plate is fixed below the frame and supported by the positioning plate, and the support of the positioning plate is positioned below the positioning plate; a scale is arranged on the upper plate surface of the positioning plate; the positioning plate support is provided with the limiting part, and the positioning plate stops when rotating to the position of the limiting part, and the side edge of the rolled bag which penetrates out at the moment just falls on the scale position of the scale, so that the pull-out size of the rolled bag can be measured, the rolled bag with a proper size can be obtained by cutting according to actual needs, the operation is convenient, and material waste is effectively avoided; the positioning plate can rotate to the space between the lower guide rail and the positioning plate support to be hidden, so that the cutting machine is attractive.

title_en: Chinese-medicinal material chinese angelica processing processor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a chinese-medicinal material chinese angelica processing machine, including fixed sill bar, installation layer and box, the top fixedly connected with box of fixed sill bar, and the intermediate position department of box bottom has seted up the discharge gate, the intermediate position department fixedly connected with installation layer of the inside bottom of box, and the even welding of installation layer inside bottom has pneumatic telescopic link, pneumatic telescopic link's top fixedly connected with blade, the inside top fixedly connected with of box washs the case. The utility model discloses install connecting rod and scraper blade, rotate through step motor and drive the dwang and rotate, rotate through the connecting rod in the pivoted, the scraper blade that can drive the outside when the connecting rod rotates, prevents that the dust in the chinese angelica outside is too much, has to remain on the lateral wall of box, can be convenient for with the chinese angelica sanitization, avoids the surface of chinese angelica to have and remains.

title_en: Cutting device is used in production of stone plastic laminate flooring
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cutting device is used in stone plastic composite floor production, including the cutting bed, the equal fixed mounting in both sides of cutting bed has the side riser, the one end fixedly connected with motor housing of connecting the member, motor housing's inside inlays the inside that is equipped with cutting motor bar groove and corresponds with the cutting wheel and is connected, the bottom mounting of cutting bed is equipped with braced frame, braced frame's inside fixed mounting has the draught fan, the output fixedly connected with exhaust duct of draught fan, exhaust duct's one end alternates and is connected with the sweeps filter cartridge, the sweeps filter cartridge is connected with the bottom block in bar groove. The beneficial effects of the utility model are that through the exhaust duct, sweeps filter cartridge and the draught fan that are equipped with, can the active absorption cutting sweeps, the loss of dust when having avoided cutting laminate flooring has solved traditional floor cutting machine and can only detach the dust piece that wafts and fall on the cutting bed, and to the problem of the dust piece beam hand inelegant of loss in the air, guarantee staff's is healthy, and the practicality is strong.

title_en: Machine tool chip bidirectional compression equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of machine tools, in particular to a bidirectional compression device for machine tool cuttings, which comprises a compression box, a transverse compression mechanism and a longitudinal compression mechanism; the transverse compression mechanism comprises a transverse power device and a transverse pressing plate; vertical compressing mechanism includes vertical power device, vertical clamp plate, fly leaf and first spring, the fly leaf sets up on vertical clamp plate along horizontal slip, the utility model discloses utilize configuration fly leaf and first spring on vertical clamp plate, horizontal clamp plate is when compressing the metal smear metal of compression intracavity left, the fly leaf of vertical clamp plate remains throughout and horizontal clamp plate contact, avoid the metal smear metal to spill between horizontal clamp plate and the vertical clamp plate, and can realize that vertical clamp plate and horizontal clamp plate can compress simultaneously, improve compression efficiency, and can compress into regular whole smear metal block structure with the banding metal smear metal of compression intracavity, with the volume of stacking that reduces the banding metal smear metal, reduce the cost of transportation and storage.

title_en: General alloy saw blade double-side surface grinding machine

When the adapter sleeve moves, the gap between the adjacent clamping arms gradually decreases until the conical cavity clamps the valve core, and then the valve core is pulled out through the handle. abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cross cutting machine with insurance mechanism, the on-line screen storage device comprises a base, frame of base upper end outside fixedly connected with, base upper end intermediate position just is located die block of fixedly connected with in the frame, gag lever post of equal fixedly connected with between die block upper end four corners and the frame upper end lateral wall, sliding connection has a cutting die on the gag lever post, and the cutting die both sides all are provided with a protection mechanism, the beneficial effects of the utility model are that: when the cutting die is pressed, and the hand is located between the bottom die and the cutting die, the side plate of the protection mechanism is pushed to move upwards, the driven sliding block can slide downwards to extend out of the driven sliding groove through transmission of the transmission gear, and finally the cutting die is driven to slide downwards to extrude the power-off switch in a synchronous mode, so that the power of the die cutting machine is cut off, the hand is protected from being pressed and damaged, and the safety of the die cutting machine is improved.

title_en: Lubricating oil tank heating structure for six-roller mill
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of metallurgical equipment, in particular to a lubricating oil tank heating structure for a six-roller mill, which comprises a lubricating oil tank and an emulsion tank; the plate type radiator is arranged in the lubricating oil tank and is communicated with the inside of the emulsion tank through a liquid supply pipe and a liquid outlet pipe. The high-temperature emulsion after the roller is cooled flows into the emulsion box firstly, then the high-temperature emulsion enters the plate type radiator along the liquid supply pipe, and the emulsion entering the plate type radiator flows back into the emulsion box along the liquid outlet pipe; thus, the heat carried by the high-temperature emulsion can be transferred to the lubricating oil in the lubricating oil tank. The utility model discloses rational in infrastructure, but make full use of heats lubricating oil for the emulsion waste heat after the roll cooling, has good result of use.

title_en: Tool for replacing cutter
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of cigarette mechanical equipment, in particular to a tool for changing a cutter, which comprises a side plate, wherein a limiting plate is connected on the side plate in a sliding way, the limiting plate comprises a first limiting part and a second limiting part which are fixedly connected, a holding tank is formed between the side plate, the first limiting part and the second limiting part, both ends of the first limiting part are respectively provided with a T-shaped strip, a T-shaped groove is arranged on the side plate, both ends of the top part of the side plate are respectively provided with a mounting seat, a first lead screw and a second lead screw are rotatably arranged between the two mounting seats, a driving sleeve is fixedly connected between the first lead screw and the second lead screw, a driving block is respectively in threaded connection with the first lead screw and the second lead screw, a connecting strip is rotatably connected on the driving block, two hinging seats are symmetrically arranged at the top end of the first limiting part, when the cutter changing device in the prior art is used, the size of a blade extending out of a cutter roller can not be adjusted as a fixed value, the problem of multiple states of the equipment is not met.

title_en: Automatic send glass-frame riser ware guide rail of nail automatic material returned and press device of riveting
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a glass lifter guide rail riveting device with automatic nail feeding and automatic material returning, which comprises a bracket, a punch assembly and a bottom plate, wherein the punch assembly and the bottom plate are arranged on the bracket; the automatic material returning assembly comprises a material returning cylinder and a material returning positioning pin, the automatic screw feeding assembly comprises a mounting frame, a feeding cylinder, a cylinder fixing frame, a screw storage groove, a vertical guide rail and a feeding adjusting cylinder, and a screw outlet is positioned right above the concave module in a feeding or material returning state; and when in a riveting state, the female die block is positioned under the punch. The device can realize sending the nail automatically and returning the material automatically, and degree of automation is high, has effectively reduced workman's work load, and work efficiency is high, can avoid the condition that artifical material returned damage part simultaneously, has guaranteed the riveting quality.

title_en: Eight-shaft gear power head
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of machinery, in particular to an eight-shaft gear power head, which comprises a machine body, wherein the machine body is of a hollow structure, one end of the machine body is connected with a connecting plate, the connecting plate comprises a connecting cover, the connecting cover is covered on the surface of the connecting plate, the connecting cover is provided with a third through hole communicated with the first through hole, the hole wall of the third through hole is provided with a groove, a clamping plate is evenly embedded in the groove and is connected with the groove bottom of the groove through a spring, the clamping plate blocks the third through hole so as to realize the sealing of the connecting plate, when the motor output end of a machine tool is connected with a rotating shaft in the machine body, the motor output end only needs to be pressed on the clamping plate, the clamping plate is pressed into the groove under the action of the spring so as to realize the connection with the rotating shaft, and when the power head is not used, only needs to separate the rotating shaft from the motor output end of the machine tool, the joint board then pops out under the spring action to seal, prevent that the dust dirt from getting into the unit head in, can play good protection to unit head inner structure.

title_en: Welding device for machining right mirror rod of traffic transportation equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a welding set is used in processing of right mirror pole of transportation equipment relates to processing welding technology field, including workstation, protective glass board, processing platform and welding ware, the recess that sinks has been seted up on the surface of workstation, fixedly connected with protective glass board on the surface of workstation, the inside fixed mounting of the recess that sinks has the processing platform, fixedly connected with riser on the left side of workstation surface, fixedly connected with welding ware on the right side surface of riser. title_en: Full-automatic welding machine overturning platform
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a full-automatic welding machine upset platform, it includes mounting bracket, grudging post, rotary device, upset arm, turns over board and sucking disc, the grudging post sets up one side position at the mounting bracket perpendicularly, rotary device sets up on the grudging post, the upset arm sets up on rotary device, the sucking disc sets up on turning over the board. When the product is conveyed to a preset position by the conveying line, the rotating device drives the overturning arm to overturn towards one side of the conveying line, so that the sucking discs on the overturning arm adsorb the product; the rotary device drives the turnover arm to reversely turn over so as to take out the product on the conveying line, turn over the back of the product to the front and move the product to a code spraying position, so that the next code spraying process is convenient to perform, the whole taking-out and turning action is smooth and quick, the production efficiency is greatly improved, the operation is simple, the labor intensity of operators is effectively reduced, and the production benefit is increased; in addition, the whole structure is simple and compact, the cost is low, the realization is easy, and the wide popularization and application are facilitated.

title_en: Vegetable potato slicing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a section equipment especially relates to a vegetable type potato section equipment. The technical problem is as follows: provides a vegetable potato slicing device with high safety and high slicing efficiency. The utility model provides a such vegetable potato section equipment, including shell, portable post, blade, cutting mechanism, pushing mechanism, unloading mechanism and baffle mechanism, shell upper portion is equipped with portable post, and the inboard upper portion of shell is equipped with cutting mechanism, is equipped with the blade in the cutting mechanism, and shell one side is equipped with pushing mechanism, and the inboard middle part of shell is equipped with unloading mechanism, and the bottom is equipped with baffle mechanism in the shell. The utility model discloses a cooperation of cutting mechanism, pushing mechanism, unloading mechanism and baffle mechanism can slice the potato automatically, and slicing efficiency is higher, can avoid the cutter to cause the injury to the human body moreover, and the security is higher.

title_en: Suspension type machine tool magnetic suspension guide rail
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a suspension type machine tool magnetic suspension guide rail, both sides of the lower surface of a fixed plate are respectively provided with a track, the inner side of the track is provided with a chute, the lower end of the chute is provided with an electromagnet mounting groove, the electromagnet mounting groove is internally provided with an electromagnet, both sides of the upper surface of a connecting seat are respectively provided with a suspension plate, a support rod is arranged between the two suspension plates, the outer side of the upper end of the suspension plate is provided with a support arm, the upper surface of one end of the support arm, which is far away from the suspension plate, is provided with a wheel groove, the wheel groove is internally provided with a plurality of support wheels, the upper ends of the support wheels are positioned outside the wheel groove and matched with the upper end of the chute, one end of the support arm, which is close to the suspension plate, is provided with a magnetic block in the magnetic block mounting groove, the magnetic block is matched with the electromagnet, the utility model has reasonable structure, adopts a suspension type structure, solves the problem of overlarge loss of the traditional suspension type guide rail, greatly improves the service life and the precision, and has good stability, simple structure, convenient installation and disassembly, and convenient replacement and maintenance of parts.

title_en: Rotary tablet press for tablet processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rotary tablet press of tablet processing usefulness, including brace table, work box, tablet collecting box, rotary driving subassembly, lifting drive platform, the spacing direction platform in route and preforming subassembly, the work box is located on the brace table, the tablet collecting box is located the work box outside, rotary driving subassembly is located in the brace table, lifting drive platform locates on the work box diapire, the free end of lifting drive platform is located to the spacing direction platform in route, on the rotary driving subassembly is located to the preforming subassembly lower part, on preforming subassembly upper portion locates the roof in the work box, rotary driving subassembly includes rotary driving motor, drive pivot and driving belt, drive pivot upper end is located to the preforming subassembly lower part, be equipped with the feeder hopper on the work box top wall. title_en: Electromechanical slice five metals cutting device that uses of five metals

title_en: Transmission line maintains and uses grinding device

By adopting EtherCAT bus communication, the use of digital signal input and output points is reduced, the cost is reduced, the available space is increased, complicated wiring is removed, the data transmission speed is increased, the anti-interference capability of the system is improved, and the stability of the system is enhanced.

title_en: Sixteen-edge end mill machining waste collecting device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a scrap collecting device for sixteen-blade end mill machining, which comprises a main box body and a working frame, wherein the working frame is arranged at the middle position of the top end of the main box body, the end of the interior of the main box body, which is far away from the working frame, is constructed with a collecting landslide, the middle position of the upper end surface of the working frame is provided with a clamping base platform, the middle position of the bottom end of the collecting landslide is provided with a separation cover, two ends of the separation cover extend into the interior of the main box body and are respectively provided with an air outlet pipe, one side of the main box body is provided with a power supply box, one side of the main box body, which is far away from the power supply box, is provided with a sealing door, the middle position of the interior of the main box body, which is far away from the separation cover, one side of the interior of the power supply box, which faces the main box body, is provided with an air box, the air outlet pipes at two ends of the separation cover are communicated with the air outlet pipes through air blowing pipes, one end of the air outlet pipes is constructed with a filter screen, and the scrap collecting device for sixteen-blade end mill machining, simple structure, garbage collection is convenient, cleans the convenience.

title_en: Punching die with adjustable punching station
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a punching die with an adjustable punching station, which comprises a base, a sleeve, a fixing plate, an L-shaped supporting plate and a clamping plate, wherein supporting legs are arranged at the bottom end of the base, first sliding rails are arranged on the side walls of two ends in the base, a first sliding block is arranged in the first sliding rail, a first connecting plate is arranged at one end, close to each other, of the first sliding block, a connecting block is arranged at the top end of the first connecting plate, the sleeve is arranged at the bottom end in the base, the bottom end of the first connecting plate is hinged with a hinge rod through a hinge shaft, a bottom plate is arranged at the top end of the connecting block, a lower die holder is arranged at the top end of the bottom plate, the fixing plate is arranged at the top end of the lower die holder, a first groove is formed in the top end of the fixing plate, and a second sliding rail is arranged at the bottom end in the first groove. title_en: Steel pipe flange welding positioning machine

title_en: Automatic point grinding equipment for tweezers
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of automatic processing equipment, and particularly discloses tweezers sharpening automatic equipment, which trims a tweezers tip in a grinding mode and comprises a rack and a feeding turntable, wherein the feeding turntable is arranged on the rack in a mode of being capable of rotating intermittently around a fixed axis, a positioning clamp is arranged on the feeding turntable along the peripheral side of the feeding turntable, and a tweezers obtaining unit and a grinding and trimming unit are arranged on the rack along the peripheral direction of the feeding turntable; the forceps acquisition unit comprises a material taking device and a forceps feeding device, the material taking device is configured to grasp a forceps blank by the forceps feeding device and place the forceps blank on the positioning clamp, and the forceps feeding device is configured to intermittently move to transfer the forceps to a grasping position of the material taking device; the grinding and dressing unit comprises a grinding device and a grinding and feeding device, wherein the grinding and feeding device is configured to drive the grinding device to be close to or far away from the tip of the tweezers to grind and dress the tweezers. The production efficiency can be effectively improved.

The mobile phone shell polishing device effectively prevents the mobile phone shell from falling off during polishing, and is convenient for adjusting the polishing angle of a product.

The mask comprises a cylindrical mask body which is of a hollow structure with one open end; the movable columns are cylindrical, are parallel to the axial direction of the cover body and are movably arranged in the cover body, one end face of each movable column is flush with the end face of the opening end of the cover body, and the other end of each movable column is connected with the inner end part of the cover body through a resetting piece; the piece that resets is the elastic component, and the movable column is along the axial motion compression piece that resets after, the piece that resets provides the power that the movable column resets. According to the screwing tool, the movable column can form a limiting space matched with the bolt head around the corresponding bolt head by pressing the cover body downwards, so that the bolt heads in various shapes and sizes can be conveniently screwed effectively by the screwing cover body, the universal function of the tool matched with various bolt heads can be achieved, and the screwing tool has the advantages of being simple in structure, reasonable in design and easy to manufacture.

title_en: Safety tool cabinet
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a safety tool cabinet, which comprises a storage assembly, a cabinet body, a frame plate and a partition plate, wherein the cabinet body is internally provided with an accommodating space, the partition plate is vertically arranged in the accommodating space, and the frame plate is horizontally arranged on two sides of the partition plate and is connected with the side wall in the cabinet body; the safety assembly comprises a first door and a second door, an opening is formed in the cabinet body, the opening is communicated with the inner accommodating space, and the first door and the second door are identical in structure and are arranged on the opening of the cabinet body; the cabinet door can be rotated and pulled open or moved on two sides and then inserted into the door slot, so that inconvenience or collision caused by walking of personnel is avoided, the operation is simple, more space is saved, and the cabinet door is safe and reliable.

title_en: Papermaking bark crushing device

title_en: Building engineering manages with insulation material thickness detection device

abstract_en: The utility model discloses adjustable aluminizer storage equipment for packaging, which comprises an outer box, wherein the outer box is of a double-layer hollow structure, an inner box is embedded in a shell interlayer of the outer box, outer box convex grooves are formed in the peripheral outer wall of the outer box, inner box convex blocks are arranged on the outer wall of the inner box and correspond to the outer box convex grooves, positioning bolts are arranged on the outer wall of the outer box, bolt fixing holes are formed in the outer wall of the inner box and correspond to the positioning bolts, the adjustable aluminizer storage equipment for packaging is matched with the bolt fixing holes through the peripheral positioning bolts, so that the height of the inner box is adjusted, the height of the inner box is shifted down along with taking of the aluminizer, the lower aluminizer is convenient to take, the lower aluminizer cannot be taken due to an overlarge height difference of the storage box, and the practicability is high; the placing separation groove at the bottom of the outer box enables the bottom aluminized film to be stored vertically more neatly and is convenient to store and count.

abstract_en: The utility model discloses a push saw table with a protection function for cupboard production and processing, which comprises a table body and supporting legs, wherein the table body consists of a bottom plate, a left side plate and a right side plate, rectangular notches are respectively formed on the left side and the right side of the front end of the bottom plate, a fixed column is connected on the side wall of the inner side of each rectangular notch, a first pulley is rotatably arranged on each fixed column, fixed blocks are respectively connected on the left side and the right side of the rear end of the bottom plate, limiting rods are respectively connected on the left side and the right side of each fixed block, a second pulley is rotatably arranged on each limiting rod, a fixed circular plate is respectively connected on one end of each limiting rod, which is far away from the fixed block, a push brush plate is respectively arranged on the left side and the right side of the upper surface of the bottom plate, and steel wire ropes are respectively connected on the front surface and the rear surface of the push brush plate.

title_en: High-precision three-coordinate measuring machine convenient to align
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of three-coordinate measuring machines, in particular to a high-precision three-coordinate measuring machine convenient for alignment, which comprises a workbench, wherein the upper surface of the workbench is provided with a chute a, the front surface and the back surface of the inner wall of the chute a are respectively and rotatably connected with one end of the front surface and one end of the back surface of a precision screw rod a through bearings, a motor a, a motor b, a screw rod, a spring, a clamping block a and a clamping block b are arranged, the motor a rotates reversely to drive a threaded sleeve a to move forwards, the threaded sleeve a moves to drive an upright post to move, the motor b is started to drive the threaded sleeve b to move rightwards, the threaded sleeve b moves rightwards to drive a measuring head to move rightwards to be parallel to the upright post for alignment, manual alignment is not needed, equipment loss is avoided, a telescopic rod and the spring on the right side surface of the clamping block b push the clamping block b to clamp a workpiece under the self elastic force of the spring, the workpiece is prevented from shaking in the measuring process, and the detection precision is improved.

title_en: Stamping device for safety support of house building engineering
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a stamping device for a safety support of building construction engineering, and relates to the technical field of stamping devices. The hydraulic press comprises a workbench, wherein a mounting groove, a supporting column and a groove are formed in the workbench, a punching seat is arranged in the mounting groove, a hydraulic cylinder and a hydraulic head are arranged on the supporting column, an adjusting rod is arranged in the groove, a limiting seat is arranged at one end of the adjusting rod, a drawer and supporting legs are arranged on the workbench, and pulley seats are arranged on the supporting legs. According to the utility model, the limiting seat is arranged at one end of the adjusting rod, so that the height of the limiting seat can be conveniently adjusted according to actual conditions, the fixed punching and limiting of the brackets in different shapes can be realized, and the two ends of the bracket can be prevented from tilting; the drawer is arranged on the workbench, so that hydraulic heads and stamping seats in different shapes and sizes can be conveniently stored, and the phenomenon that the hydraulic heads and the stamping seats are lost due to disorder is avoided; still through setting up the supporting leg at the workstation lower surface, be convenient for adjust the height of workstation in a flexible way according to user's demand, increase user's comfort level.

title_en: Novel special drilling machine gear box structure for automobile bearing cover
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel gear box structure of a special drilling machine for an automobile bearing cover, which comprises the following components in part by weight: the special drilling machine gearbox is connected with a motor at one end, a belt pulley is connected at one end of the motor, a bearing seat is connected at one end of the belt pulley, the double-row deep groove ball bearing is connected at one end of the belt pulley, a single-row deep groove ball bearing is connected at one end of the double-row deep groove ball bearing, the first box body cover plate is connected at one end of the special drilling machine gearbox, a second box body cover plate is connected at one end of the first box body cover plate, an inner hole is formed at one end of the second box body cover plate, and one end of the bearing seat is radially connected with the second box body cover plate; according to the utility model, the structure of the gear box is optimized, so that the purpose of reducing the damage times of the bearing is realized, the down time is favorably reduced, and the production efficiency is improved.

title_en: Plate shearing machine for plate processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a plate shearing machine for plate processing, which comprises an installation support, a conveying mechanism, a plate cutting mechanism and a driving mechanism, wherein the installation support is fixedly arranged on the plate shearing machine; the conveying mechanism, the plate cutting mechanism and the driving mechanism are all arranged on the mounting bracket; the plate cutting mechanism comprises a plate pressing mechanism, a cutter frame and a connecting plate; the cutter comprises a first cutter and a second cutter; the pressing plate mechanism comprises a connecting bolt, a pressing plate body and a spring; still be provided with the mounting hole on the connecting plate, connecting bolt passes the mounting hole and extends to the below of first cutter, and connecting bolt is provided with the spring with this body coupling of clamp plate in connecting bolt's the outside. Drive the cut trigger through actuating mechanism and reciprocate to the clamp plate body can also reciprocate along with the cut trigger, accomplishes reciprocal extrusion fixed to panel, does not accomplish the fixed to panel at needs manual work, has improved the cutting efficiency of panel, has reduced intensity of labour, has improved the practicality of device.

title_en: Stamping positioning device
abstract_en: The utility model is suitable for the technical field of stamping processing and provides a stamping positioning device which comprises a base and a supporting table positioned on the base; the workbench is connected with the support table and used for placing a workpiece to be stamped; the positioning mechanism is connected with the supporting platform; the positioning mechanism comprises an adjusting assembly and a fixing assembly, and the adjusting assembly is connected with the fixing assembly and used for fixing a to-be-stamped part on the workbench; and the buffer assembly is used for connecting the support platform and the base. The positioning device is novel in structure, and through the matching use between the positioning mechanism and the buffer assembly, the positioning device is convenient for fixing stamping parts to be stamped of different models, and the practicability of the positioning device is effectively improved.

title_en: Metal hose part polishing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a metal hose part polishing device which comprises a workbench, wherein a pair of brackets are fixedly connected to the workbench, a sliding rod is connected between the brackets, and an installation connecting mechanism is connected to the sliding rod in a sliding manner; the installation connecting mechanism comprises a sliding piece, a telescopic piece is connected to the sliding piece, one end of the telescopic piece, far away from the sliding piece, is fixedly connected with a mounting plate, a joint is sleeved on the mounting plate, a pressing block anti-disengaging mechanism is connected between the mounting plate and the joint, a working chamber is arranged on the workbench, a polishing disc is arranged in the working chamber and used for polishing the joint through the polishing disc, and a motor is installed in the workbench. According to the utility model, by replacing the traditional mode of polishing the metal hose joint by hand, the uniform force application degree of the joint during polishing is easily ensured, the uneven polishing condition of the joint is not easy to occur, the polishing times of a user are reduced, the working efficiency of the user is improved, and the polishing quality of the joint is ensured.

title_en: Long shaft and material pressing device for hydraulic disassembly
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a device for hydraulically disassembling a long shaft and pressing materials, which comprises a bottom plate, a material pressing barrel, a hydraulic rod and a disassembling baffle plate, wherein rollers are arranged below the bottom plate, a supporting plate is arranged above the bottom plate, a handle rod is connected above the bottom plate, the material pressing barrel is arranged on the supporting plate, a connecting rod is arranged on the right side of the material pressing barrel, a cylindrical pin is arranged at the tail end of the connecting rod, the hydraulic rod is arranged on the cylindrical pin, a push rod is connected to the left side of the hydraulic rod, the long shaft is connected to the left side of the push rod, a bearing is arranged on the long shaft, the disassembling baffle plate is arranged on the inner side of the material pressing barrel, and a limiting groove is formed in the end face of the left side of the material pressing barrel. The utility model can be used for two purposes after replacing spare parts, and after the front end of the push rod is clamped and connected with the material pressing plate through the positioning ring, waste metal barrels and other similar large-volume metal materials can be compacted so as to be convenient for storage and other treatment.

title_en: Cutting machine for cylindrical multilayer raw materials
abstract_en: The cutting machine for the cylindrical multilayer raw materials comprises a rack, a fixed rod, a movable rod, a cutting blade and a motor; an air expansion shaft is fixed on the left side of the rack, a left-right moving motor and an electric cabinet are arranged on the right side of the rack, a left-right moving screw rod, an upper fixed rod and a lower fixed rod are respectively fixed on the upper parts of the two sides of the rack, a sliding block is sleeved on the upper fixed rod, an internal thread sliding block is sleeved on the left-right moving screw rod, the right end of the left-right moving screw rod is connected with the moving motor through a coupling, an up-down moving fixed rod and a rack are arranged in the center of the rack, a cutting blade and a photoelectric switch are arranged at the bottom of the up-down moving fixed rod, and the photoelectric switch is used for distance measurement and controlling the cutting depth; a concave sliding groove is arranged on the outer side of the rack; the rack is meshed with the gear, and the cutting motor is fixed at the bottom of the vertical moving fixed rod and the rack; the fixed bottom plate at the rear part of the rack is provided with an up-and-down moving motor, and the concave sliding groove is matched with the gear. The utility model is safe and reliable, and reduces the potential safety hazard; the operation is simple and convenient, the efficiency is high, the automation degree is high, and the labor intensity of workers is reduced.

title_en: Novel hydraulic bending machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel hydraulic bending machine which comprises a bending base, a hydraulic cylinder and an upper die base, wherein the output end of the hydraulic cylinder is fixedly connected with the upper die base, the bending base comprises a control groove and a lower die groove, a rotating shaft is arranged in the control groove in a rotating connection mode, a left lower template and a right lower template are arranged on the rotating shaft in a rotating connection mode, the left lower template and the right lower template are respectively located on two sides of the upper die base, one sides, far away from the upper die base, of the left lower template and one side, far away from the upper die base, of the right lower template are respectively provided with a control structure in a connected mode, the control structures are provided with double-thread lead screws in a threaded connection mode, the double-thread lead screws are arranged in the lower die groove in a rotating connection mode, one ends of the double-thread lead screws are fixedly connected with a motor, and the double-thread lead screws are fixedly connected with the output end of the motor. When different workpieces are bent, the bending die can be adjusted within a reasonable range according to different bending angles of the workpieces, and the bending lower die does not need to be frequently replaced.

title_en: Shaft fork forming system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of automobile shaft forks, and discloses a shaft fork forming system, wherein a first driving mechanism drives a first slide block to move downwards to realize the die assembly of an upper die and a lower die, then a heated blank is put into the shaft fork from a sleeve, a second driving mechanism drives a second slide block to move downwards, a third punch head extrudes the blank along with the downward movement of the second slide block to form a shaft fork shape, meanwhile, the first punch head and the second punch head respectively horizontally act to punch ear holes on two ear parts of the shaft fork, the third punch head synchronously punches a shaft hole in the axial direction of the shaft fork in the downward movement process, so that the shaft fork is formed, as the third punch head forms a hole in the cylindrical sleeve, the two horizontal punch heads form holes on the ear parts, the formation of flash can be avoided, the material is saved, the formability is ensured, and simultaneously, as the upper die and the lower die are in accordance with the axial forming force of the shaft fork through vertical die locking, and the stability of mode locking is ensured.

title_en: Laser marking machine with limiting function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a laser marking machine with a limiting function, which comprises a bottom plate, a box body fixedly connected to the top of the bottom plate, and a marking device fixedly connected to the left side of the top of the box body, wherein a fixed block is fixedly connected to the right side of the top of the box body, a motor is fixedly connected to the right side of the back of an inner cavity of the box body, the output end of the motor is fixedly connected with a rotary table, a rotary pin is fixedly connected to the left side of the front of the rotary table, a first movable rod is sleeved on the surface of the rotary pin, and one side of the first movable rod, far away from the rotary pin, is movably connected with a first pin shaft through a rotary shaft. The laser marking machine with the limiting function solves the problems that the existing laser marking machine directly places the workpiece on the table top during processing, has no limiting structure, is easy to deviate during processing, makes the marked pattern incomplete and affects the processing quality.

title_en: Cutting fluid spraying equipment for CNC machining center
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of machining centers, in particular to cutting fluid spraying equipment for a CNC (computer numerical control) machining center, which comprises a spraying pipe, wherein the front end of the spraying pipe is provided with a fixed sleeve, the fixed sleeve is fixedly sleeved outside the spraying pipe, the front end of the fixed sleeve is provided with a spraying adjusting mechanism, the spraying adjusting mechanism comprises a movable sheet and a slide rail, the front side of the movable sheet is provided with a spraying hole, and two sides of the movable sheet are fixedly connected with slide blocks. Can spray in large area, and is simple and convenient to operate.

title_en: Stamping waste recovery device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a stamping waste recovery device, which comprises a base, a compression mechanism and a separation mechanism, the compression mechanism is composed of a compression bin, a pushing plate, a motor, a reciprocating screw rod, a gear block, a chain, a spring switch, a hydraulic rod and a compression plate, the surface of the base is in matching sliding connection with a compression bin, the surface of the compression bin is provided with a motor, the inner wall of the compression bin is in matching rotating connection with a gear block, and two gear blocks are provided, the surface of the gear block is provided with a chain, the other side of the surface of the gear block is welded with a reciprocating screw rod, the surface of the reciprocating screw rod is connected with a pushing plate by matching threads, the inner wall of the compression bin is provided with a spring switch, the surface of the compression bin is provided with the hydraulic rod, the integral operation is more convenient, one-key compression and separation are realized, the use convenience is greatly improved, and the phenomenon that the waste materials cannot be compressed due to excessive gaps is effectively prevented through the vibration mechanism.

title_en: Vacuum hot extrusion molding device for rare earth terbium target material
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a vacuum hot extrusion molding device for a rare earth terbium target material, which comprises a vacuum tank main body, wherein the vacuum tank main body is provided with a feed inlet, a vacuum port and a discharge port, the feed inlet is provided with a sealing cover, the discharge port is provided with a sealing window, the vacuum port is connected with an external vacuum system, the vacuum tank main body is internally provided with a workbench, an extrusion device and a pushing clamping assembly, the workbench is provided with a heating assembly, the extrusion device comprises an extrusion die and an extrusion punch, and the pushing clamping assembly is used for pushing a material from the heating assembly to the extrusion device and clamping and transferring a formed part to the discharge port. The utility model has the following advantages and effects: the new mechanical structure of this scheme utilization adopts and carries out hot extrusion moulding to tombarthite terbium target under the vacuum condition, can prevent its oxidation to a certain extent, has the effect that the production quality is higher, the reliability is stronger, and production efficiency is also higher.

title_en: Welding alignment device of steel skeleton light plate
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a welding and aligning device of a steel skeleton light plate, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a first L-shaped plate is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the bottom plate, a first vertical plate is fixedly connected to one side, opposite to the first L-shaped plate, of the bottom plate, a groove is formed in the upper surface of the bottom plate, a sliding plate is slidably connected to the inside of the groove, a second L-shaped plate is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the sliding plate, a limiting block is fixedly connected to one side, opposite to the first L-shaped plate, of the second L-shaped plate, a limiting rod is sleeved inside the limiting block, a third spring is sleeved on the surface of the limiting rod, two ends of the third spring are respectively fixedly connected with the limiting block and the outer wall of the limiting rod, a fixing plate is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the sliding plate, a first spring is fixedly connected to one side of the fixing plate, a second vertical plate is fixedly connected to one end of the first spring, a circular groove is formed in the lower surface of the second vertical plate, and manual aligning time is saved, the cost of steel frame scrapping caused by unstable manual fixation is reduced.

title_en: Fixing device for processing seamless steel pipe
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fixing device for processing a seamless steel pipe, wherein vertical plates are fixedly assembled on the left side and the right side of the upper surface of a base, rotary steel pipe clamp assemblies are fixedly assembled on the inner side surfaces of the vertical plates, rotary driving structures are uniformly and fixedly assembled on the left side surfaces of the vertical plates on the left side, the driving ends of the rotary driving structures are fixedly connected with single rotary steel pipe clamps in the rotary steel pipe clamp assemblies, and adjustable supporting pieces are fixedly assembled on the upper surface of the base; the scheme adopts a rotary steel pipe clamp assembly, the steel pipe clamps in three size ranges are arranged in the embodiment, and the combination of the three size ranges increases the adjustment range for clamping seamless steel pipes in different sizes, so that the application range is wider; the scheme adopts adjustable support piece, can adjust the position of support on the seamless steel pipe bottom surface for to the support in seamless steel pipe middle part, reduce the vibration range of seamless steel pipe in the course of working, the seamless steel pipe quality of last processing is more unified controllable.

title_en: Stamping die for automobile seat angle adjuster parts
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of stamping dies and discloses a stamping die for automobile seat angle adjuster parts, which comprises an upper die holder and a lower die holder, wherein the bottom of the upper die holder is fixedly connected with an upper template, the top of the lower die holder is fixedly connected with a lower template, the bottom of the upper template is fixedly connected with an upper backing plate, and the top of the lower die holder is fixedly connected with a guide sleeve. This automobile seat angle modulation ware part stamping die, through the standing groove, the circular slot, the ring, a spring, circular clamping ring, the dead slot, mutually support between spout and the slider, make the clamp plate inside of moving down and entering into the circular slot, and make the bottom of clamp plate and the top overlap joint of ring, and drive the same downstream of ring and circular clamping ring, make the bottom of circular clamping ring and the top overlap joint of the inside angle modulation ware of standing groove, and can fix the angle modulation ware in the inside of standing groove, prevent that the angle modulation ware from taking place the offset, and then be convenient for carry out stamping forming through the drift to the angle modulation ware.

title_en: Full-automatic high accuracy section bar cutting device of numerical control CNC
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a full-automatic high-precision profile cutting device of numerical control CNC (computer numerical control), which comprises a bearing plate, wherein a clamping device is connected to the left end of the top end of the bearing plate, a sliding groove is formed in the front end of the bearing plate, a limiting device is arranged inside the sliding groove, supporting supports are arranged at two ends of the top end of the bearing plate, a first motor is connected to the right end of the top end of each supporting support, a stud bolt is connected to the rotating end of each first motor, sleeves are arranged at two ends of each stud bolt, a cutting blade is connected to the rotating end of a second motor, a bearing column is connected to two ends of the bottom end of the bearing plate, a water storage tank is connected to each bearing column, a water pump is connected to the top end of each water storage tank, a guide pipe is connected to the water outlet end of the water pump, and a spray nozzle is connected to the other end of each guide pipe. Compared with the prior art, the utility model has the advantages that: the utility model can precisely cut the section bar, clamp the material, clean the scraps and move conveniently.

title_en: Aluminum alloy shot blasting cleaning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an aluminum alloy shot blasting cleaning device which comprises a cleaning bin arranged below a shot blasting chamber and shot blasting, wherein the shot blasting is made of an aluminum alloy material, a buffer plate is obliquely arranged in the cleaning bin, one end of the buffer plate is connected with the cleaning bin through a rotating seat, the buffer plate comprises a first plate and a second plate which are arranged in a staggered mode, the lowest end of the first plate is arranged above the highest end of the second plate, a long hole is formed in the first plate, and the width dimension of the long hole is smaller than the diameter dimension of the shot blasting. Compared with the prior art, the utility model has the advantages that: the productivity is greatly improved, shot blasting of the aluminum alloy material is distinguished from a workpiece to be treated through magnetic force, shot blasting is convenient to recover, the first plate and the second plate which are arranged in a staggered mode buffer the shot blasting, and the long holes facilitate waste residues to fall off from the shot blasting; the brake cylinder stretches out and draws back, and the control buffer board rocks from top to bottom to a small extent along rotating the seat, makes things convenient for waste residue separation and the transport of throwing the ball.

title_en: Special sleeve for high-pressure oil pipe bolt
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a special sleeve for a high-pressure oil pipe bolt. The application includes: the device comprises a hexagonal sleeve, a abdicating groove, a connecting beam and a wrench connector; the hexagonal sleeve is arranged at one end of the sleeve and connected with the bolt, and is used for transmitting torque with the bolt when the bolt is disassembled and assembled; the hexagonal sleeve is internally provided with a abdicating groove which is used for accommodating an oil pipe; the connecting beam is arranged in the middle of the sleeve and used for increasing or decreasing the rotation angle of the sleeve; the spanner connector is arranged at the other end of the sleeve and is used for connecting a spanner. When the socket is used, the socket is connected to the wrench, so that the oil pipe is connected with the bolt through the abdicating groove, the hexagon socket is connected with the bolt, the bolt can be disassembled and assembled by rotating the wrench, and the oil leakage condition is reduced.

title_en: Full-automatic blanking processing equipment of blast gate blade axle
abstract_en: The utility model provides full-automatic blanking processing equipment of an air valve blade shaft, which comprises an installation platform, a feeding device, a blanking device, a clamping device and a chamfering device, wherein the installation platform is provided with a feeding hole; the feeding device comprises a feeding frame, a conveying belt and a pressing mechanism; the blanking device comprises a cutting mechanism and a guide rail assembly; the clamping device comprises a fixed clamping table, a translation clamping table and a driving mechanism; the chamfering device comprises a fixed chamfering mechanism fixed on one side of the fixed clamping table and a translation chamfering mechanism arranged on the other side of the fixed clamping table in a sliding manner; the guide rail assembly comprises a movable guide rail and a fixed guide rail, the fixed guide rail is arranged close to the output end of the conveying belt relative to the movable guide rail, and the movable guide rail and the fixed guide rail are parallel and obliquely arranged; the translation clamping table comprises a bearing part, a horizontal connecting part and a vertical part, the lower end of the fixed guide rail and the lower end of the movable guide rail are respectively provided with one translation clamping table, the fixed clamping table comprises a mounting seat and an abutting block, and a gap for the bearing part and the horizontal connecting part to pass through is formed between the lower surface of the abutting block and the upper surface of the mounting seat.

title_en: Flame cutting automatic ignition and flameout device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a flame cutting automatic ignition and flameout device which comprises a guide rail, wherein a power vehicle moves on the guide rail, a workpiece is placed on one side of the guide rail, a connecting rod group is installed on the power vehicle, a cutting nozzle and a flame leading nozzle are installed at the other end of the connecting rod group, the flame leading nozzle is installed on one side of the cutting nozzle, an installation plate is fixed on the connecting rod group, a photoelectric control assembly is fixedly installed on the installation plate, the flame leading nozzle is communicated with an ignition assembly, the cutting nozzle is communicated with a preheating cutting assembly, the ignition assembly is electrically connected with the uniform photoelectric control assembly of the preheating cutting assembly, and the ignition assembly and the preheating cutting assembly are externally connected with a ventilation pipeline. The utility model has the advantages that: the automatic ignition and flameout functions are realized, and the batch processing and production of workpieces are facilitated.

title_en: Voice coil active rotation trolley
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of voice coil trolleys, and particularly relates to a voice coil active rotating trolley which comprises a fixed frame, a voice coil mechanism and a cutting tool, wherein the top of the voice coil mechanism is provided with a connecting frame which moves up and down along with the voice coil mechanism, the fixed frame is provided with a rotary driving mechanism, a connecting rod is arranged above the cutting tool, the top of the connecting rod is fixed on the connecting frame through a bearing, the rotary driving mechanism comprises a fixed sleeve, the fixed frame is provided with a driving motor, the fixed sleeve is fixed on the fixed frame, the connecting rod is fixed on the fixed sleeve through a roller shaft, the lower end of the connecting rod extends out of the fixed sleeve and is connected with the cutting tool, the defects in the prior art are overcome, the connecting rod is fixed through the rotary driving mechanism and then is driven to rotate actively through the driving motor, so that the rolling direction of the cutting tool is always consistent with the cutting direction, and the existence of an included angle is eliminated, the phenomenon of wrinkling is avoided, and the processing quality of the cutting machine is improved.

title_en: Axle and leaf spring's partial shipment frock
