abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of vehicle engineering, and discloses a separate loading tool for an axle and a plate spring, which comprises a base, two plate spring loading mechanisms and two bolt loading mechanisms, wherein the two plate spring loading mechanisms are arranged on the base, the two plate spring loading mechanisms are arranged at intervals along a first direction parallel to the axis of a rolling lug, the distance between the two plate spring loading mechanisms is adjustable, each plate spring loading mechanism comprises a plate spring positioning component and a plate spring supporting component, the plate spring positioning component is configured to position the rolling lug of the plate spring, any end of the plate spring supporting component is configured to support and clamp the other end of the plate spring, the assembly quality of a whole vehicle is improved, the distance between the plate spring positioning component and the plate spring supporting component of each plate spring loading mechanism is adjustable, the bolt loading mechanisms are arranged between the plate spring positioning components and the plate spring supporting components of the two plate spring loading mechanisms, and the distance between the two bolt loading mechanisms is adjustable, the distance between the bolt carrying mechanism and the plate spring positioning component is adjustable, and the bolt carrying mechanism has high universality.

title_en: Steel pipe orthotic devices for construction
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a steel pipe correction device for building construction, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a pair of limiting devices is fixedly connected to the upper end surface of the bottom plate, each limiting device comprises a top plate with an arc-shaped plate structure, an arc-shaped pipe groove is formed in the circumferential outer wall of the top plate, an arc-shaped guide rail is fixedly connected to the front end of the bottom plate, a sliding seat is connected onto the guide rail in a sliding mode, a steel pipe sleeve is fixedly connected to the top of the sliding seat, the arc center of the guide rail is located at the center of the surface of the pipe groove, a group of supporting legs are fixedly connected to the bottom of the bottom plate, a connecting plate is arranged at the lower ends of the supporting legs, and a bolt groove is formed in the connecting plate. The utility model has simple structure, convenient operation and good correction effect.

title_en: Aluminum veneer rounding machine
abstract_en: The application discloses aluminium veneer rounder, relate to the technical field of aluminium veneer processing, it is great and the structure is complicated to improve most of structures of current rounder, it is troublesome to produce the operation when some small-size aluminium veneers are processed, practicality greatly reduced's problem, comprising a base plate, the top bilateral symmetry of bottom plate is provided with the support, below symmetry between the support is provided with the fixed roll, the outside front end of one side support is connected with the gear box, the outside of gear box is connected with first hand wheel, the front end of gear box is connected with the second hand wheel, the inside of first hand wheel and second hand wheel all is connected with the connecting rod, the connecting rod all extends to the inside of gear box, be connected with first gear on the connecting rod of first hand wheel, be connected with the second gear on the connecting rod of second hand wheel, the second gear is connected with first gear meshing. This round rolling machine volume of this application is less, carries out the round rolling processing through manual to aluminium single plate, improves round rolling machine's practicality.

title_en: High-frequency vibration type stainless steel part polishing machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-frequency vibration type stainless steel part polishing machine which comprises a box body, wherein a mounting box is fixedly mounted at the bottom of the box body, protective plates are fixedly mounted on two sides of an inner cavity of the mounting box, a mounting groove is formed in the inner side of each protective plate, a limiting plate is fixedly mounted in the inner cavity of each mounting groove, a connecting plate is movably connected to the bottom of each limiting plate, and a supporting plate is fixedly connected to the inner side of each connecting plate. According to the utility model, the cross section of the stirring blade is designed into a curve shape, so that the material can be effectively driven to be in a vortex shape to be in contact with the surface of the grinding cylinder and ground, the connecting plate can be effectively limited by the arrangement of the mounting groove and the limiting plate, the device is prevented from generating strong vibration and damaging parts, the limiting plate is convenient to mount and protect through the mounting groove, and the problem of low polishing efficiency of common vibration type stainless steel part polishing machines in the market is solved.

title_en: High-efficient sandblast mechanism of sand blasting machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of sand blasting machines, in particular to a high-efficiency sand blasting mechanism of a sand blasting machine, which comprises a shell and a first supporting plate, wherein a sand blasting pipe is fixedly communicated inside the shell, one end of the sand blasting pipe penetrates through the upper surface of the shell and extends to the outer surface of the shell, one end of the sand blasting pipe, which is far away from the shell, is fixedly communicated with a sand blasting gun, a T-shaped groove is formed inside the shell, the T-shaped groove can perform multi-surface sand blasting on a workpiece at one time through the matching between a clamping mechanism and a rotating mechanism, after sand blasting is completed on one workpiece, the next workpiece can be subjected to sand blasting while the workpiece is air-dried, so that the sand blasting efficiency is greatly improved, through the arrangement of a rubber pad, a clamping plate can not damage the surface of the workpiece when the workpiece is clamped and fixed, through the matching between a limiting plate and a limiting shell, when a cylindrical handle is shaken to perform rotary sand blasting on the workpiece, the workpiece is not moved horizontally.

title_en: Sheet metal shaping and displacement structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a metal sheet forming and displacement structure which comprises a forming die, wherein the forming die is used for pressing and forming a metal sheet, the forming die comprises a placing part, the placing part is used for placing the metal sheet, a bottom plate is arranged on one side of the forming die, the bottom plate is positioned on one side close to the placing part, a fixed plate is arranged on the top surface of the bottom plate, a lower air cylinder is arranged on one surface, close to the placing part, of the fixed plate, a positioning plate is arranged on the top of the lower air cylinder, the lower air cylinder is used for driving the positioning plate to ascend or descend, a rotary air cylinder is arranged on the top surface of the positioning plate, a rotary disc is arranged at the output end of the rotary air cylinder, an adsorption structure is arranged on the rotary disc, the adsorption structure is used for adsorbing the metal sheet pressed and formed on the forming die, and can automatically adsorb the metal sheet and move the metal sheet.

title_en: Fixing mechanism for sheet metal wire cutting
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fixing mechanism for sheet metal wire cutting, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein the top of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with two limiting plates, one side of each limiting plate is movably connected with a threaded rod through an embedded bearing, one side of each threaded rod is provided with an L-shaped clamping plate, the top of the bottom plate is provided with a first sliding groove, a first sliding block is movably connected in the first sliding groove, the top of the first sliding block is provided with a mounting hole, a fixing bolt is arranged in the mounting hole, the top of the first sliding block is fixedly connected with a fixing frame, the top of the fixing frame is provided with a threaded hole, a lead screw is connected in the threaded hole in a threaded manner, the bottom end of the lead screw is movably connected with a pressing plate, one end of the threaded rod is fixedly provided with a crank, and one side of the crank is fixedly connected with an anti-skid pad. The fixing device can fix the sheet metal with different thicknesses, can also fix the sheet metal with different thicknesses, and can fix the sheet metal with different lengths, thereby being suitable for fixing the sheet metal with different specifications.

title_en: Positioning fixture for welding steel structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides a positioning fixture for welding a steel structure, which comprises a positioning base, a transmission rod, a positioning hoop, a left support hoop, a left sliding seat, a right support hoop, a right sliding seat, a lead screw and a hexagonal chuck, wherein the lead screw is installed on the upper side inside the positioning base, the transmission rod is welded in the middle of the right end face of the lead screw, the hexagonal chuck is welded on the right end face of the transmission rod, the left sliding seat is meshed on the left side of the annular side face of the lead screw, the left support hoop is welded in the middle of the upper end face of the left sliding seat, the right sliding seat is meshed on the right side of the annular side face of the lead screw, and the right support hoop is welded in the middle of the upper end face of the right sliding seat.

title_en: Cutting surface grinding device for cutting rock plate
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cutting surface polishing device for cutting rock plates, which comprises a fixed table, wherein polishing tables are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the fixed table, a conveying mechanism is arranged at the top of the fixed table, the conveying mechanism comprises a driving roller and a driven roller, a polishing assembly and a fixed assembly are fixed at the top of the polishing table, the polishing assembly comprises an angle polishing piece, a transverse surface polishing piece and a vertical surface polishing piece, the angle polishing piece, the transverse surface polishing piece and the vertical surface polishing piece are all arranged at the top of the polishing table, the fixed assembly comprises a vertical wheel, a transverse wheel and an installation frame, the angle polishing piece can polish the upper right angle part and the lower right angle part of the table to form a certain fillet, and the edge part of the fillet is polished smoothly by the transverse surface polishing piece and the vertical surface polishing piece, so that the polishing can be finished, the device is suitable for polishing rectangular rock plate tables in large batch, and has the advantages of an assembly line compared with a numerical control polishing device, polishing efficiency is higher, and production efficiency is faster.

title_en: Turning system of spring for bed net and spring forming equipment for bed net
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a turnover system of a spring for a bed net and a spring forming device for the bed net, which comprise a spring forming machine and a turnover system of the spring for the bed net, wherein the spring forming machine comprises a spring discharge port; turning system of the spring for the bed net: the turning cabin is arranged at the spring discharge hole, a rotating part of the rotating driving device is connected with the turning cabin, and the rotating driving device comprises a rotating limiting mechanism which limits rotation after the turning cabin rotates for a set angle; the overturning cabin comprises a spring storage channel, the pushing device is positioned beside one port of the spring storage channel and comprises a pushing rod and a pushing driving mechanism, and the pushing rod is arranged on the pushing driving mechanism; the rotary driving device drives the turnover cabin to rotate, so that the spring is turned over from a transverse state to a vertical state, and then is pushed into the next working procedure under the action of the material pushing device. The structure of the bed net enables the springs to be turned over selectively according to the arrangement mode of the springs in the bed net.

title_en: Drilling equipment is used in furniture manufacturing with collect mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a drilling device with a collecting mechanism for furniture manufacturing, which comprises a device main body and a workbench, wherein four groups of supporting legs are fixedly connected to the bottom of the device main body, a collecting frame is arranged between the four groups of supporting legs, two groups of transverse plates are fixedly connected between the four groups of supporting legs, two groups of air cylinders are fixedly connected to the tops of the two groups of transverse plates, the output ends of the two groups of air cylinders penetrate through the horizontal end of the collecting frame, and the output ends of the two groups of air cylinders are in transmission connection with two groups of connecting plates. According to the device, the scraps after being subjected to hole opening fall into the top of the device main body, then the two groups of cylinders are started to drive the two groups of connecting plates to be close to each other, the two groups of connecting plates drive the two groups of scraping plates to move, the scraps on the surface of the device main body are cleaned through the scraping plates, and finally the scraps fall into the collecting frame through the through grooves, so that the scraps are collected, the manual labor force is reduced, and the hole opening efficiency is improved.

title_en: Multifunctional reinforcing steel bar wrench
abstract_en: The utility model provides a multifunctional steel bar wrench, which comprises: the steel bar straightening part comprises a force application plate and a clamping structure arranged on the force application plate, the clamping structure comprises a first buckle and a second buckle which are arranged at intervals, and the clamping structure is suitable for being clamped and matched with a steel bar; the connecting rod, reinforcing bar alignment portion connect in the first end of connecting rod. The multifunctional steel bar wrench is simple and convenient to operate, good in straightening effect, capable of achieving straightening operation only by one person, and high in steel bar straightening efficiency. Simultaneously, to annular joint bar, with first buckle and second buckle respectively with two reinforcing bar joint cooperations of annular joint bar, can straighten annular joint bar. Therefore, the multifunctional steel bar wrench effectively overcomes the defects that a steel bar straightening tool in the prior art is poor in straightening effect, low in straightening efficiency and incapable of straightening annular joint bars simultaneously.

title_en: Combined type protection device for machining
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a combined type protection device for machining, and relates to the technical field of machining. The utility model provides a combination formula protector for machining, includes the protecting crust, the inside both ends of protecting crust all are provided with the slip track, the inside upper end fixed mounting of protecting crust has servo motor seat, servo motor seat's both sides all carry out fixed connection through the inner wall of fixed connecting rod with the protecting crust, servo motor seat's lower extreme moves the board through motor connecting axle fixedly connected with activity, the equal fixedly connected with swing joint spare in both ends that the board was moved in the activity, swing joint spare sets up in the orbital inside that slides, simultaneously the activity moves the lower extreme fixed mounting that the board had drilling mechanism. The utility model can realize processing items of two different conditions of the inside and the outside, and has better use effect.

title_en: Novel stone material cutting is polished device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of stone processing, in particular to a novel stone cutting and polishing device, which comprises a base and a grinding wheel, wherein the base is connected with a sliding seat through a moving device, the sliding seat is provided with a driving motor, the sliding seat is connected with a cutting device and a polishing frame, the polishing frame is rotatably connected with an installation seat through a rotating shaft, the installation seat is connected with a rotating block and a plurality of clamping plates, an installation spring is connected between the rotating block and the clamping plates, the grinding wheel is arranged on the clamping plates, the clamping plates are connected with a limiting block and a clamping block, the sliding seat is connected with a cleaning seat, the cleaning seat is connected with a cleaning frame through an installation bolt, the cleaning frame is connected with a plurality of cleaning frames, the cleaning frames are respectively connected with a cleaning block and a driving block, the cleaning block and the driving block are respectively and rotatably connected with a cleaning rod, the cleaning device is connected on the cleaning rod, and the driving block are respectively provided with a fan and a cleaning motor, the cleaning motor is in transmission connection with the cleaning rod which is rotatably connected with the driving block, and the polishing effect and the cleaning performance are better.

title_en: Y-shaped bent round cone connection box body node
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a Y-shaped bending cone body-connecting box body node, which comprises: the square connecting ring comprises a cross stiffening plate, a square pipe, a square connecting ring, an elliptical cone frustum, an eccentric elliptical cone frustum, a group of lower round pipes and a group of upper round pipes, wherein the gusset plate is arranged at the lower part of the cross stiffening plate, the square pipe, the square connecting ring, the elliptical cone frustum and the eccentric elliptical cone frustum are arranged on the outer side of the cross stiffening plate, the square pipe is arranged on the outer side of the top of the cross stiffening plate, the square connecting ring is arranged below the square pipe, the elliptical cone frustum is arranged below the square connecting ring, the eccentric elliptical cone frustum is arranged below the elliptical cone frustum, the lower round pipes are arranged below the eccentric elliptical cone frustum, and the upper round pipes are arranged at two sides of the elliptical cone frustum. According to the Y-shaped bent round cone connection box body node, the structure of the whole node is optimized, 5 butt joint nodes are realized through the cross stiffening plate structure, the stability and the safety of the structure are guaranteed, and the requirements of special-shaped nodes can be well met through the particularity of each node.

title_en: Machining bench drill capable of being accurately positioned
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a machining bench drill capable of being accurately positioned, which comprises a fixed plate, wherein mounting plates are arranged at the bottom ends of two sides of the fixed plate, an adjusting mechanism is arranged between the two mounting plates, mounting grooves are formed in two ends of one side of the fixed plate, lead screws are arranged on the inner walls of the two mounting grooves, movable plates are arranged on the outer sides of the two lead screws, and drill bits are arranged at the bottom ends of the movable plates. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the screw rods and the mounting grooves, the two screw rods can rotate by the operation of the second motor, so that the heights of the movable plate and the drill bit can be adjusted, meanwhile, through the arrangement of the rotating plate, the driven gear and the movable groove, the installation rod can be driven by the operation of the first motor to rotate, so that the hydraulic cylinder can rotate, further the inclination angles of the parts can be adjusted, and meanwhile, the hydraulic cylinder can be driven to move on the inner wall of the movable groove under the traction action of the rotating plate, so that the two parts with different sizes can be conveniently adjusted by the device.

title_en: Continuous cutting device for superfine glass fiber board
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a continuous cutting device for superfine glass fiber plates, which comprises a workbench and is characterized in that: the cutting machine is characterized in that the workbench is provided with a sliding groove, a screw rod is arranged in the sliding groove, one end of the screw rod is movably connected with one end of the workbench, the other end of the screw rod is movably connected with the other end of the workbench, one side of the workbench is fixedly connected with a first motor, an output shaft of the first motor is fixedly connected with one end of the screw rod, a guide rod is arranged in the sliding groove, two ends of the guide rod are respectively and fixedly connected with one end of the workbench, and a cutting mechanism is arranged in the sliding groove. The utility model relates to the field of cutting equipment, in particular to a continuous cutting device for an ultrafine glass fiber board. The utility model relates to a continuous cutting device for an ultrafine glass fiber board, which is beneficial to realizing the continuous cutting of the ultrafine glass fiber board.

title_en: Charging pile shell polishing mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fill electric pile casing grinding machanism, comprising a base plate, bottom plate both sides fixed mounting has the riser, fixed mounting has the diaphragm on the riser, fixed mounting has the pneumatic cylinder on the diaphragm, fixed mounting has the polisher on the piston rod of pneumatic cylinder, install the cutter of polishing on the polisher, fixed mounting has the square on the bottom plate. The utility model discloses in, put the casing on the square, start the cylinder, the casing is cliied in the motion of drive clamp splice, the through-hole on the guide arm inserted the casing, reinforcing location effect starts the hydraulic cylinder, drive polisher downstream, polisher drive cutter of polishing is polished the casing, the back of finishing of polishing, start hydraulic cylinder drive polisher upward movement, start the cylinder and make the clamp splice leave the casing, the polishing of casing has been accomplished, compare in the manual work and polish, easy operation has improved the efficiency of polishing.

title_en: Silicon rod processing equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the utility model provides a silicon rod processing equipment, silicon rod processing equipment includes: the device comprises a preprocessing device, a cutting line limiting device and a control device, wherein the preprocessing device is used for processing and forming an anti-skidding structure on a silicon rod to be processed, and the anti-skidding structure is used for limiting the restriction of the cutting line; the cutting device is used for cutting in the silicon rod to be processed from the anti-skid structure position to remove the flaw-piece, wherein the axis of the silicon rod to be processed is in the horizontal plane; and the silicon rod conveying device is used for carrying the silicon rods to be processed to move between positions of different devices. The embodiment of the utility model provides an in silicon rod processing equipment only need a clamping can cooperate multichannel process to carry out the processing to help saving the clamping time and reducing the accumulated error of clamping many times. In addition, the anti-slip structure processed and formed by the preprocessing device is also beneficial to improving the cutting quality of the silicon rod to be processed when the silicon rod is cut in a horizontal plane.

title_en: Equipment fixing device for sawing machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an equipment fixing device for a sawing machine, which comprises an operation table, a slide rod, a saw blade, a slide seat, a rotating plate and a clamping seat, wherein the slide rod is arranged on the operation table; the sliding rod block is used for preventing the sliding rail block from rotating, the sliding rod block and the sliding rod are used for driving the rotating plate to move, an object to be cut is in contact with a saw blade for cutting, the rotating plate is rotated through the rotary drum, so that the object to be cut can be cut at multiple angles, the rotating plate is fixed through the angle seat and the angle hole, the plate body is used for bearing and movably clamping the seat, the plate body is rotated through the rotating shaft, the plate body is fixed through the fixing hole, the mounting seat slides on the plate body through the sliding hole to match the objects to be cut with different lengths, the object to be cut is clamped through the movable clamping plate and the fixed clamping plate, the movable clamping plate is pushed through the threaded shaft, the object to be cut can be tightly clamped through the movable clamping plate and the fixed clamping plate, and the threaded shaft can be conveniently rotated through the rotating handle.

title_en: Forming device for blade
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a forming device for a blade, which comprises a base, wherein the outer wall of the top of the base is provided with a punch forming assembly, the punch forming assembly comprises a polygonal lifting block, a female die and a punch knife, each side edge of the polygonal lifting block is rotatably connected with a connecting rod, the other end of the connecting rod is rotatably connected with a sliding block, the sliding block is slidably connected to the top of the base, the female die is fixedly arranged on the outer wall of the top of the base, the punch knife is fixedly arranged on the side wall of the sliding block, and the punch knife is in sliding fit with the female die through a punch sliding groove formed in the female die. According to the utility model, the polygonal lifting block is connected with the driving source, the polygonal lifting block is set to be of a regular polygonal structure, each side surface is connected with the sliding block through the connecting rod, the matching of a plurality of groups of stamping tools and the female die is realized, the simultaneous molding of a plurality of blades can be realized by the driving source through a single reciprocating stroke, and the working efficiency is greatly improved.

title_en: Cutting unloading device for building steel structure engineering
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cutting and unloading device for building steel structure engineering, which comprises a workbench, wherein a cutting table which is arranged on the workbench in a left-right sliding manner is arranged at the top of the workbench, a top plate is arranged right above the workbench, a cutting bracket is arranged between the top plate and the cutting table, a cutting motor is arranged on the cutting bracket, a cutting disc is rotatably arranged at the tail end of a transmission shaft of the cutting motor, a rotating motor for driving the cutting bracket to rotate and adjust is arranged at the bottom of the top plate, a hydraulic push rod for driving the top plate to lift is arranged between the top plate and the workbench, a supporting slide block is arranged at the rear end of the workbench, the screw thread runs through supporting slide and rotates the lead screw of installing in the workstation top, and the one end of lead screw is equipped with drive lead screw pivoted servo motor, and the front end of workstation is equipped with by the push pedal of electric push rod drive just to cutting disc below, and the rear end of workstation is equipped with just to push pedal and open-ended collection box in top.

title_en: Pop can garbage recycling processor
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of garbage recycling treatment and discloses a garbage recycling processor for a pop can, which comprises a base fixedly arranged on the lower surface of a box body, wherein a shell is fixedly arranged in the middle of the upper surface of the box body, a hydraulic pump is arranged in the shell, the lower surface of the hydraulic pump is fixedly connected with the upper surface of the box body, a rotatable door plate is arranged at the top of the surface of the box body, and a handle is fixedly arranged on the inner side of the front surface of the door plate. This easy open can rubbish recovery processor drives the pneumatic cylinder through the hydraulic pump and begins the operation for the stripper plate extrudees the easy open can, makes the easy open can become the platykurtic, has effectually reduced the area of easy open can in the device inside, has increased the device and to the recovery quantity of easy open can, does not need the staff often to clear up the inside easy open can of the device, labour saving and time saving, great reduction staff's intensity of labour, improved the practicality of the device when using.

title_en: CCD visual positioning laser marking machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of laser marking machines and discloses a CCD (charge coupled device) visual positioning laser marking machine which comprises an operating case, wherein a radiating strip is arranged on one side wall of the operating case, a display screen is arranged at one end of the top of the operating case, a control rocker is arranged on one side, close to the display screen, of the top of the operating case, and an operating keyboard is arranged on one side, close to the control rocker, of the top of the operating case. This CCD visual positioning laser marking machine, through the top installation limiting plate at the operation machine case, and can make the slurcam remove through the catch bar, can carry out the clamping to the product of different shapes through slurcam and limiting plate, do not need artifically or fix with the help of other article, through transmission machine case, final drive shaft, drive chain, the transmission shaft, the cylinder, the driven shaft uses with the drive belt cooperation, can make the product after beating the mark remove next position through the drive belt and wait for the cooling, equipment can beat mark to next product in succession.

title_en: Welding fixture for rear auxiliary frame rear frame combination in automobile
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a welding fixture for a rear sub-frame rear frame assembly in an automobile, which relates to the technical field of automobile products and comprises a supporting mechanism, a fixed clamping mechanism, a fixed pressing mechanism and a pressing and clamping mechanism, wherein the supporting mechanism is arranged below the supporting mechanism and is used for supporting other mechanisms; the fixed clamping mechanism is provided with a pair of fixed clamping mechanisms which are symmetrically distributed on the left side and the right side of the first supporting plate, and the fixed clamping mechanisms are used for positioning and clamping the left side and the right side of the front part of the rear frame of the rear auxiliary frame; the constant pressure mechanism is provided with a pair of supporting plates which are correspondingly distributed on the two sides, and the constant pressure mechanism is used for positioning and pressing the left side and the right side of the rear edge of the rear frame of the rear auxiliary frame; the pressing and clamping mechanism is provided with one and is arranged on the third supporting plate in the middle, and the pressing and clamping mechanism is used for pressing and clamping the middle part of the rear edge of the rear sub-frame rear frame. In conclusion, the welding fixture disclosed by the utility model has the characteristics of ingenious design, reasonable structure and convenience in use.

title_en: Compound fixed tool apron
abstract_en: The utility model provides a composite fixed tool apron which comprises a body, a boring tool mounting hole and an end face tool clamping position, wherein the boring tool mounting hole and the end face tool clamping position are mutually independent, the boring tool mounting hole and the end face tool clamping position and the body are of an integrated detachable fixed structure, and the boring tool mounting hole and the end face tool clamping position are mutually perpendicular and arranged on the body. The body is simultaneously provided with the boring cutter mounting hole and the end face cutter clamping position which are mutually independent, so that after a certain workpiece is bored by using the boring cutter mounted in the boring cutter mounting hole, the end face cutter fixed on the end face cutter clamping position can be immediately used for processing the end face of the workpiece without replacing a cutter holder and calibrating a blade of the end face cutter, and the processing efficiency can be improved.

title_en: Pipeline connecting equipment for industrial waste liquid conveying
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pipeline connecting device for conveying industrial waste liquid, which comprises a pair of first supporting plates, wherein the pair of first supporting plates are fixedly connected through a connecting plate, sliding plates are connected to one opposite sides of the pair of first supporting plates in a sliding manner, a second supporting plate is arranged between the two sliding plates, a plurality of clamping blocks are uniformly distributed on one opposite side of the two second supporting plates, a plurality of limiting rods are arranged between the two sliding plates, an air cylinder is arranged between each sliding plate and the adjacent second supporting plate, and a moving mechanism is arranged below one sliding plate. This application is protruding, gag lever post, second backup pad, grip block, tooth, gear, cylinder and spout structure through being provided with first backup pad, connecting plate, driving motor, supporting leg, gyro wheel, slide, bar, this application can be fixed and move the pipeline in the installation, makes things convenient for constructor to dock and calibrate the pipeline.

title_en: Feeding device of automatic magnetic component assembling equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a feeding device of automatic magnetic component assembling equipment, which comprises a vibrating disk and an arrangement track, wherein the discharging position of the vibrating disk is connected with the arrangement track, and the feeding device is characterized in that: the rotary base is provided with a direction-adjusting rotating mechanism for driving the rotary base to rotate, the rotary base is provided with a direction-adjusting groove for placing components, the direction-adjusting groove faces to the side face when the rotary base rotates and is used for receiving the material receiving position of the vertically placed components arranged on the arrangement track and faces to the upper side and is used for allowing the transfer clamping jaw to take away the material taking position of the horizontally placed components, and the transfer clamping jaw is provided with a transfer moving mechanism for driving the transfer clamping jaw to move between the clamp and the rotary base. By adopting the scheme, the utility model provides the feeding device of the automatic magnetic assembly assembling equipment, which changes the discharging direction of the part so as to improve the quality of finished products.

title_en: Rotary knife holder structure of splitting machine
abstract_en: The utility model provides a rotary cutter holder structure of a splitting machine, which comprises a front upper rubber roll and a front lower rubber roll which correspond up and down, a cutter holder and a splitting cutter, a rear upper rubber roll, a rear lower rubber roll, a paper pressing rubber wheel, a cutter supporting roller, a cutter holder hanging plate and a cutter holder rotating assembly, wherein the cutter holder is circumferentially arranged on the cutter supporting roller, the upper plane of the cutter holder is flush with the top surfaces of the front lower rubber roll and the rear lower rubber roll; the paper pressing rubber wheel is arranged on the cutter shaft at the same height as the front gluing roller and the rear gluing roller. The rotary cutter holder structure of the splitting machine, provided by the utility model, has the advantages that the cutter holder can synchronously rotate and lift along with the lower rubber roller, the cutter holder and the paper pressing rubber wheel are mutually matched to compress and convey a cut paperboard, the flatness and the straightness of paperboard slitting are ensured, and the paperboard slitting with shorter length can be completed.

title_en: Garbage disposal device with degerming structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a garbage treatment device with a degerming structure, which comprises an extrusion shell and a guide rod, wherein a first oil cylinder is arranged above the outer part of the extrusion shell, a cover plate is arranged outside the first oil cylinder, a second oil cylinder is arranged on one side of the outer part of the extrusion shell, a pressing plate is arranged outside the second oil cylinder, the guide rod is fixed outside the pressing plate, a guide sleeve assembly for self-lubricating is arranged outside the guide rod, the guide sleeve assembly comprises a hollow guide sleeve, a rotary cover, a sponge core and balls, and the rotary cover is arranged above the outer part of the hollow guide sleeve. This refuse treatment device with degerming structure compares with current ordinary refuse treatment device, screws out the spiral cover and adds lubricating oil in toward cavity guide pin bushing, and lubricating oil is absorbed by the sponge core thereupon, and along with the slip of guide arm, the ball adheres to lubricating oil, lubricates guide arm, ball and cavity guide pin bushing for this refuse treatment device's partial part possesses self-lubricating structure, effectively slows down wearing and tearing.

title_en: Bulb 3D cold carving grinding tool
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a 3D cold-engraving grinding tool for a ball head, which comprises a base, wherein a first support column and a second support column are arranged on two sides of the upper end surface of the base, a top plate is connected between the top ends of the first support column and the second support column, an air cylinder is fixed on the upper end surface of the top plate, an air cylinder piston rod penetrates through the top plate and is connected with a lifting plate, a groove is formed in the lifting plate, a first screw rod is arranged in the groove and is connected with a first sliding block in a sliding manner, the lifting plate is driven by the stretching and retracting of the air cylinder piston rod to move up and down, so that a ball head grinding rod is driven to move up and down, a first bevel gear and a second bevel gear are driven to rotate by a second motor, so that a rotating shaft and the first screw rod rotate to drive the first sliding block to slide, so that the ball head grinding rod is driven to move left and right, a cooling cylinder releases cooling liquid through a spray head to cool the ball head, a third motor drives the second screw rod to rotate, so that a third sliding block slides to drive a placing plate to move back and forth, the engraving is convenient.

title_en: Shearing shaft combined assembling equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a shearing shaft combined assembling device which comprises a base, a hanging bracket and a rotating seat, wherein a pair of linear module translation tables is arranged at the left end and the right end of the base, the hanging bracket stretches across the base and is connected with the moving ends of the pair of linear module translation tables, a hoisting structure is arranged on the hanging bracket, a rotor assembling structure is arranged on the rotating seat, and the rotor assembling structure comprises: the utility model relates to the technical field of hydraulic coupler assembly, in particular to a rotary motor, a rotating column, a telescopic motor, an 'n' frame, a pair of clamping back plates, two pairs of clamping cylinders and two pairs of clamping rubber arms. This technical scheme provides an equipment of assembling the main work piece of hydraulic coupler, and this equipment can help the manual work to install the coupler, increases equipment precision and efficiency, has effectually solved the technical problem who mentions among the background art.

title_en: Cooling structure of die punch
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cooling structure of a die punch, which comprises a punch, wherein a liquid inlet hole is formed in the left side of the inner wall of the punch, a cooling ring is arranged below the liquid inlet hole in a connecting mode through a guide pipe, a cooling hole is formed in the lower side of the cooling ring, a cooling liquid buffer area is arranged below the cooling hole, through holes are formed in the periphery of the cooling hole, and a buffer ring is arranged on the surface of the cooling liquid buffer area, preferably. According to the cooling structure of the die punch, the cooling liquid enters the cooling ring from the liquid inlet hole, then flows into each cooling hole through the cooling ring, then flows to the cooling liquid buffer area from the cooling hole, the cooling liquid flows to the punch head to buffer, then flows to the punch head to realize the cooling effect on the punch, and further plays a role in buffering, the die punch is protected, and the service life of the die from the head is prolonged.

title_en: Stamping device for steel production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a stamping device for steel production, which comprises a body and a clamping part used for fixing workpieces with different widths by the body, wherein the clamping part comprises two sliding grooves arranged on one side of the body, a sliding block arranged on the inner side of the sliding grooves, a through hole arranged between the two sliding grooves, a bidirectional screw arranged on the inner side of the through hole and a clamping frame arranged on the top of the sliding block, the sliding block drives the clamping frame on the top to slide on the top of the body by the arrangement of the body, the sliding block, the bidirectional screw and a guide groove, so that the clamping frame can conveniently clamp and fix the workpieces with different specifications, the problems that the existing equipment cannot clamp and fix the workpieces with different widths, and part of the existing equipment cannot press and fix the workpieces with different thicknesses, the workpieces are easy to shift or shake, and the stamping accuracy of the equipment on the workpieces is influenced are solved, the practicability of the equipment is reduced.

title_en: Composite material single-edge milling cutter
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of milling cutters and discloses a composite material single-edge milling cutter which comprises a milling cutter body and a mounting seat, wherein one end of the milling cutter body is inserted into the mounting seat and the mounting ring, the mounting ring is fixedly connected to one end, close to the milling cutter body, of the mounting seat, and openings are formed in the side faces of the mounting seat and the mounting ring. This combined material single-edge milling cutter, pass the collar with the milling cutter main part and insert the inside of mount pad, rotatory screw ring again, screw ring moves to the right side under the effect of screw thread, make the opening of mount pad and collar close to the centre, the inside buffering circle of collar extrudees to the centre at closed in-process collar, it presss from both sides tight fixedly to drive spherical fixture block to the milling cutter main part, thereby it is fixed to make the device be convenient for press from both sides tight milling cutter, be convenient for change after wearing and tearing appear when milling cutter, then the elastic force effect through buffering circle and extrusion spring, also be convenient for carry out buffer protection to milling cutter at the in-process of work.

title_en: Piston machining clamp capable of achieving quick positioning
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a piston machining clamp capable of realizing quick positioning, which is characterized in that: anchor clamps include the foundatin plate, be provided with tang positioning disk and supporting seat on the top face of foundatin plate, swing joint has two symmetric distributions's location axle in the supporting seat, the tail end and the first link of location axle are connected, and first link on then rotate and be connected with the horizontal adjustment axle, threaded connection between horizontal adjustment axle and the supporting seat still is provided with the handle at the tip of horizontal adjustment axle simultaneously, still be provided with two sets of quick hold-down mechanism symmetrically on the top face of supporting seat, quick hold-down mechanism include through the clamp plate of bolted connection on the supporting seat, the bolt overcoat of clamp plate below has the spring, the one end and the second of clamp plate interlock frame joint, the middle part threaded connection of second interlock frame has the vertical adjustment axle, the top of vertical adjustment axle also is provided with the handle.

title_en: Pneumatic clamping jaw with adjustable clamping position
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a pneumatic clamping jaw with an adjustable clamping position, which comprises a horizontally arranged base; a mounting plate is vertically fixed on the base; the driving device is fixed on the mounting plate and comprises an output shaft which can stretch in the front-back direction; the mounting plate is provided with a through hole for the output shaft of the driving device to pass through; the base is arranged on the base in a guiding and sliding manner and is elastically connected with the mounting plate; a guide rod is arranged on the base in a guiding sliding manner, one end of the guide rod is in transmission connection with an output shaft of the driving device, and the other end of the guide rod is fixedly connected with a propelling block; the base is fixedly connected with a hinge seat, the hinge seat is hinged with two clamping jaws, and the rear ends of the clamping jaws are in transmission connection with the propelling block; a buffer structure is arranged between the hinged seat and the propelling block; the position of the limiting block is adjustable and is arranged on the base, and the limiting block can stop and limit the base in the front and back directions; when the workpiece faces different positions, the position of the limiting block is adjusted relative to the base, and the operation is simple, convenient and quick.

title_en: High-precision circuit board CCD vision drilling device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-precision circuit board CCD visual drilling device which comprises a drilling device main body, a display and a workbench, wherein the display is arranged on the surface of the drilling device main body, the workbench is arranged on the surface of the drilling device main body below the display, a clamping assembly is arranged on the workbench, a protective assembly is arranged on the display, the clamping assembly comprises a movable groove arranged in the workbench, a screw rod rotates in the movable groove, a turntable is arranged on the surface of the outer end of the screw rod, a rotating shaft is arranged on the inner wall of the movable groove on the right side of the screw rod, the screw rod is connected with the rotating shaft, a limiting groove is formed in the surface of the workbench, an auxiliary block rotates in the screw rod, and the auxiliary block is arranged in the limiting groove. Through the movable groove, the lead screw, the carousel, the pivot, the spacing groove, the auxiliary block, first holder and the second holder that set up, the drilling equipment main part of being convenient for carries out the centre gripping to the circuit board of different shapes, makes the device have the variety to the practicality of device has been improved simultaneously.

title_en: Drill bit moving carrier with motor
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of loading of drilling equipment, and particularly relates to a drill bit moving carrier with a motor. This full-automatic drilling equipment removes carrier, put the drilling base and load the incasement, utilize the universal wheel to conveniently remove, hug closely the fixed column with the drilling base, rotate the dwang, the chuck is at the draw-in groove internal rotation this moment, it moves down to drive the sliding plate, the limiting plate follows the sliding plate and moves down, push down the drilling base, it fixes the fixed plate to recycle threaded rod and nut, support the drilling base, rotate the gag lever post at last, let the stripper plate move forward, support the drilling base, will load the case removal with the universal wheel.

title_en: U-shaped folded plate drilling equipment for rehabilitation equipment
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of rehabilitation equipment, and particularly relates to a U-shaped folded plate drilling device for the rehabilitation equipment. According to the utility model, the first pillow block, the second pillow block, the slide rod, the screw rod and the clamping mechanism are arranged, so that U-shaped folded plates with different sizes can be clamped and fixed on the operation table, the applicability of the device is improved, the flexibility of the drill rod during drilling can be improved by arranging the mounting plate, the slide plate and the driving mechanism, the collection box and the box door are arranged, so that scraps and the like generated during drilling can be conveniently collected in a centralized manner, the phenomenon that the scraps are scattered on the operation table to influence the normal use of the device is avoided, and the collection box can be conveniently cleaned by opening the box door during cleaning.

title_en: High-precision numerical control machine tool waste storage tank
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-precision numerical control machine tool waste storage tank, in particular to the field of machine tool machining accessories, which comprises a tank body, wherein an air pressure pipeline is communicated on the tank body, one end of the air pressure pipeline, which is positioned at the outer side of the tank body, is hermetically and elastically connected with a first movable rod, the other end of the air pressure pipeline is hermetically and slidably connected with a second movable rod, a containing plate is fixedly connected on the second movable rod, a filter plate is fixedly connected in the containing plate, a first outlet is formed in the containing plate and positioned below the filter plate, a second outlet is formed in the tank body, the filter plate can play a certain role of solid-liquid separation, waste water can flow out from the first outlet at the lower end of the containing plate, the position of the first outlet and the second outlet when being communicated is determined, the waste water can be conveniently recycled, and when the waste water and waste chips are shaken, the waste water originally positioned above the waste chips can easily enter the lower part of the containing plate, the efficiency of this design classification recovery is improved.

title_en: Fastening device capable of being adjusted in multiple directions for processing ceramic tiles
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fastening device for processing ceramic tiles, which can be adjusted in multiple directions and belongs to the technical field of ceramic tile processing, and comprises a bottom plate and a supporting column, the upper side wall of the supporting column is fixedly provided with a top plate, the inner side wall of the top plate is fixedly provided with a fixed cavity, the inner side wall of the fixed cavity is fixedly provided with an air cylinder, the lower side wall of the air cylinder is fixedly provided with a telescopic rod, a motor frame is fixedly arranged on the lower side wall of the telescopic rod, a motor is fixedly arranged in the inner cavity of the motor frame, the grinding wheel is movably arranged at the rotating end of the motor, the utility model has reasonable design, the cylinder is additionally arranged in the inner cavity of the top plate and is connected with the motor through the telescopic rod, thereby realizing the adjustment of the height of the motor, the shaft sleeve is additionally arranged on the inner side wall of the bottom plate and is connected with the turntable through the rotating rod, thereby realize the direction rotation of carousel, add the fixed block and connect through lead screw and adjustable shelf through the lateral wall of base.

title_en: Veneer pressing machine equipment for processing plywood
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a veneer press device for processing plywood, which comprises a base, wherein an installation frame is fixedly arranged on the upper part of the base, lifting assemblies are fixedly arranged on the left side and the right side of the outer surface of the upper end of the base, a moving assembly is fixedly arranged on the outer surface of the right side of the base, a control panel is arranged on the outer wall of the moving assembly, first oil cylinders are fixedly arranged on the left side and the right side of the outer surface of the upper end of the installation frame, and press plates are fixedly arranged on the outer surface of the lower end of the first oil cylinder. According to the veneer pressing machine equipment for processing the plywood, the two groups of lifting assemblies are arranged, the top plate is driven to lift through the operation of the second oil cylinder, a certain gap is formed between the top plate and the outer surface of the upper end of the base, discharging and feeding are facilitated, the outer surface of the upper end of the top plate is flush with the outer surface of the upper end of the base through contraction of the second oil cylinder, pressing is facilitated, and the height of the control panel is facilitated through the arranged moving assembly.

title_en: Movable water jet cutting head splash-proof device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a movable splash-proof device for a water jet cutting head, and relates to the technical field of cutting. The water cutting machine comprises a water cutting head, a mounting support, a cylinder, a gripper, a connecting frame, a linkage arm and a sand prevention cover, wherein the mounting support is mounted on the water cutting head through screws, the cylinder is fixedly mounted on the mounting support, one end of the gripper is hinged to the bottom of the mounting support through a pin, the linkage arm and the connecting frame are both located in the mounting support, and one end of the linkage arm is hinged to the gripper through a pin. This movable water jet cutting head anti-splash device has adopted the design theory based on gripper structure, drives under the upper and lower of cylinder, can make the sand control cover be the lamella form and outwards opens to make things convenient for operating personnel to observe the tool setting work of water cutting head and work piece before the distance of vertical direction and processing, or inwards close together, shelter from the water cutting head, this kind of form can reach the effect that well restraines the efflux and anti-spatter, does not influence simultaneously again and observes and tool setting work.

title_en: Hub reduction gear capability test installation mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hub reduction gear performance test installation mechanism, which comprises a reduction gear installation part, wherein the reduction gear installation part comprises: the mounting panel, be fixed in the curb plate at mounting panel both ends, install respectively in on the curb plate and about the symmetrical trip shaft that sets up of mounting panel, the mounting panel is located two between the curb plate, the trip shaft is located two the outside of curb plate, the hole of cup jointing has been seted up at the middle part of mounting panel, be equipped with a plurality of fixed orificess around cup jointing the hole, the fixing base of wheel limit speed reducer passes through fixed orifices and bolt assembly with mounting panel looks fixed connection. The assembly is simple; only once hoisting is needed, the hoisting position is ensured to be on the end face of the fixing seat, and the test detection of rapid turnover can be realized.

title_en: Waveguide cavity and cover plate welding device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a welding device for a waveguide cavity and a cover plate, which comprises a bottom plate, the waveguide cavity and the cover plate, wherein two screw rods are arranged above the bottom plate, the front ends and the rear ends of the screw rods are respectively and movably connected with a support plate through bearings, the bottom of the support plate is fixedly connected with the top of the bottom plate, the front ends of the two screw rods respectively penetrate through inner rings of the bearings and extend to the front sides of the support plate to be connected with a belt in a transmission manner, the top of the bottom plate is provided with a motor, the screw rods positioned on the left side are sleeved with worm gears, the worm gears are meshed with worms, the left ends of the worm gears are fixedly connected with output shafts of the motor, the screw rods are provided with threaded wheels, the side walls of the two threaded wheels close to each other are respectively and fixedly connected with a movable plate through first connecting rods, and the bottom of the movable plate is fixedly connected with a first sliding block. The device has the characteristics of high working efficiency, high use efficiency and the like through a series of structures.

title_en: Automatic spring assembling and blanking device
abstract_en: The utility model provides an automatic spring assembling and blanking device, relates to the technical field of automatic assembling equipment, and solves the problems that the blanking structure of the existing spring assembling device is easy to incline when a spring falls, needs later-stage correction and has lower assembling efficiency; a blanking pipe is embedded and mounted on the inner side of the bottom of the feeding pipe; a pipe clamp is fixedly arranged on the outer side of the blanking pipe through a bolt; the top of the right side of the pipe clamp is fixedly connected with a connecting block; a cylinder is fixedly arranged below the right side of the fixed base plate through a connecting frame; the top end of the cylinder is fixedly connected with the bottom of the connecting block. This device can carry out spacing and direction all the time through conveying pipe and blanking pipe cooperation when the spring whereabouts, send the assembly position with the blanking pipe is accurate through the cylinder, the condition that consequently can not appear inclining after the spring whereabouts, and the whereabouts is stable, need not the later stage and corrects, and packaging efficiency improves greatly.

title_en: Grinding device is used in processing of bearing retainer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a polishing device for machining a bearing retainer, which belongs to the technical field of bearing retainer machining and comprises a supporting disc, wherein a convex plate is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the supporting disc, the upper surface of the supporting disc is fixedly connected with the lower surface of a driving device, and a first bearing is arranged in the driving device. This grinding device is used in processing of bearing holder, through setting up drive arrangement, the flange, fan-shaped tooth, the ring gear, the fixed disk, inner circle location structure and outer lane location structure, then this device is under drive arrangement drive fixed disk rotation, make inner circle location structure can and the flange between the extrusion produce expand realize the centre gripping to the work piece inner circle, and when inner circle location structure pine takes off, realize work piece outer lane centre gripping through outer lane location structure under fan-shaped tooth and the ring gear cooperation, with this can the different clamping state of automatic switch-over, the polishing of the interior outer lane of work piece has been satisfied, thereby can bring better result of use.

title_en: Pump body casting processing deckle edge clearing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pump casting processing burr removing device, which relates to the related technical field of pump casting processing devices and comprises a grinding machine body, wherein a rotary table is fixed at one end of the grinding machine body through a rotary shaft, the rotary shaft is fixed with the center of the side surface of the rotary table, an air bag is fixed at one side of the rotary table, which is far away from the rotary shaft, grinding paper is arranged at one side of the air bag, a plurality of grooves are arranged at one side of the air bag, which is connected with the grinding paper, the adjacent grooves are mutually vertical, the centers of the rectangles, where a plurality of groups of grooves distributed in a rectangular shape are positioned, are superposed with the center of the top surface of the air bag, a movable hole is formed in the top surface of the rotary table, a movable rod is slidably arranged in the movable hole, a fixed magnet is arranged in the side wall of the rotary table, a driven magnet is fixed on the end surface of the movable rod, which extends into the rotary table, and the magnetism of the fixed magnet is the same as that of the driven magnet. Through the cooperation use of above each device, can make the unedged convenient more high-efficient of polishing of pump body foundry goods, can reduce labour's input, promote the effect of polishing.

title_en: Guide rail with hard-wire combined structure
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of machine tools, and particularly relates to a guide rail with a hard wire combined structure, which comprises a workbench and a box body, wherein the guide rail is fixedly connected onto the workbench, the guide rail is slidably connected with a base, the base is in contact with the workbench, a cutter is arranged on the base, a blanking groove is formed in the workbench, the lower end of the workbench is fixedly connected with a feed pipe, the interior of the box body is slidably connected with the feed pipe, a first fixing frame is fixedly connected onto the box body, a fixing plate is fixedly connected onto the box body, the interior of the fixing plate is connected with a threaded rod through threads, and a limiting sleeve is rotatably sleeved on the outer side of the threaded rod. The utility model can suck the scraps generated by the machine tool during working into the box body through the feed pipe by using the fan through the fan by arranging the fan, the box body, the feed pipe and other parts, can effectively prevent the scraps from entering a gap of the guide rail, and is provided with the fixing device for fixing the feed pipe.

title_en: Double-chain-plate combined chip removal machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a double-chain-plate combined chip removal machine which comprises a chip removal machine frame body, two layers of chain plates, a speed reducer, a chip removal collecting hopper, a hydraulic cylinder and a compression box, wherein the two layers of chain plates are arranged on the chip removal machine frame body and used for removing chips, the speed reducer is used for driving the two layers of chain plates, the chip removal collecting hopper is used for receiving the chips on the chain plates, and the hydraulic cylinder and the compression box are arranged at the bottom of the chip removal collecting hopper and used for compressing the chips. According to the application, the upper-layer chain plate and the lower-layer chain plate act together, so that the massive cuttings are compressed and conveyed, and the local accumulation and blockage of the conventional casing are prevented; in addition, install the compression case in the bottom of chip removal collection fill to utilize the compression board to carry out compression treatment to the bulk smear metal, and prevent through the striker plate that the smear metal continues the whereabouts in the compression process, discharge through row material telescoping cylinder and discharge gate again at last, thereby reach the volume of compression bulk smear metal, be convenient for carry and transport.

title_en: Bearing roller axle turning lathe
abstract_en: The embodiment of the utility model discloses a bearing roller shaft turning machine tool, which comprises a bedstead, a rotating device, a transmission mechanism, a positioning device, a feeding mechanism and a cutter position adjusting device, wherein the rotating device is positioned in the middle part above the bedstead and is used for clamping and rotating a bearing roller shaft; the transmission mechanism is arranged in the bedstead and connected with the rotating device and drives the rotating device to rotate; the positioning device is positioned at one end of the rotary device in the transverse direction and used for limiting the position of the roller carrier shaft on the rotary device; the feeding mechanism is positioned on the surface opposite to the rotating device and is used for adjusting the longitudinal distance between the cutter position adjusting device and the roller carrier shaft; the cutter position adjusting devices are transversely and symmetrically arranged at two ends of the feeding mechanism and are used for turning two ends of the roller carrier shaft. An embodiment of the utility model provides a bearing roller axle turning lathe to it is many to solve bearing roller axle turning lathe drive mechanism, and the turning resistance is big, and the electric energy loss is great technical problem.

title_en: Heavy-load pure electric bending machine with closed structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heavy-load pure electric bending machine with a closed structure, which comprises a rack, a bending die, an upper cross beam and an upper cross beam lifting driving device, wherein the rack is provided with a bending die; the upper cross beam can be driven by the two groups of upper cross beam lifting driving devices to lift along the lifting holes of the vertical plates; the two groups of upper cross beam lifting driving devices are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the rack, and each group of upper cross beam lifting driving devices comprises a motor and a crank connecting rod mechanism; the crank connecting rod mechanism comprises a crank and a connecting rod which are hinged with each other, one end of the crank is hinged on the upright post through a main hinged shaft, and the main hinged shaft is connected with the motor; the other end of the connecting rod is hinged with the corresponding bottom penetrating end of the upper cross beam; the motion central plane of the crank and the connecting rod is coplanar with the central plane of the upper beam. The lifting driving device can realize lifting driving of the upper cross beam with heavy load of 80 tons or more, and is good in rigidity, low in rack weight, low in manufacturing cost, small in occupied area and good in mechanical property.

title_en: Special robot die forging clamp for forging steel balls
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a forge special robot die forging anchor clamps of steel ball die forging anchor clamps field, including tribit five-way valve, guiding mechanism and robot connecting plate, the equal fixed mounting in below both sides of robot connecting plate has linear guide, and two linear guide's below fixed mounting has the anchor clamps connecting plate simultaneously, the back fixed mounting of robot connecting plate has the cylinder, and cylinder bottom end face assembly plate both ends all rotate through the back middle part of pivot with the anchor clamps connecting plate and be connected simultaneously, the back both sides lower extreme of anchor clamps connecting plate all rotates through the pivot and installs anchor clamps, and two anchor clamps rotate through pivot and cylinder end department assembly plate simultaneously and be connected, the equal fixed mounting in both sides has the extension spring on the assembly plate of cylinder end department. The utility model discloses in, this design has also ensured security and reliability when satisfying the automatic forging process of current steel ball, can not cause the shutdown that damage or trouble lead to the anchor clamps because of forging.

title_en: Tourist bus distance rod beam assembly welding frock
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a welding tool for a thrust rod and beam assembly of a tourist bus, which comprises a fixing frame, a workbench and supporting rods, wherein wheels are fixedly arranged at the bottom of the supporting rods, connecting rods are fixedly arranged between the supporting rods on two sides of the bottom of the workbench, cross rods are arranged between the supporting rods at two ends of the bottom of the workbench, threaded holes are formed in the surface of the top of the workbench at equal intervals, a limiting clamp is movably arranged in the limiting frame, a lower clamping table is fixedly arranged at the top of a fixing seat, the fixing frame is fixedly arranged on the periphery of the lower clamping table, an upper clamping table is arranged at the bottom of an electric push rod in a penetrating mode through the fixing frame, a control box is fixedly arranged on the surface of the other side of the supporting frame, and storage boxes are arranged on the surfaces of two ends of the workbench. According to the utility model, a series of structures are arranged, so that the clamping structure of the device can be adjusted according to the actual processing requirement in the using process of the device, the flexibility of the whole device is strong, the manpower is saved, and the using process is optimized.

title_en: Evaporator fixed connection device
abstract_en: The application relates to an evaporator fixed connection device. The device comprises: the device comprises an evaporator positioning tool and an assembling tool; the evaporator positioning tool is provided with a positioning groove, and the positioning groove is used for placing a first component and a second component to be assembled; the bottom surface of the positioning groove is inclined at an angle matched with the connecting angle of the first component and the second component; the assembly fixture comprises: the connecting piece placing part is used for pushing the fixed connecting piece placed in the connecting piece placing part to the combining part of the first assembly and the second assembly, so that the fixed connecting piece and the combining part are mutually matched. The scheme that this application provided can improve evaporimeter connection efficiency for the progress that the helium examined.

title_en: High-speed edge chamfering machine for wafer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-speed wafer beveling machine which improves the efficiency and the product percent of pass. The utility model comprises a frame, wherein bearing seats are arranged at two ends of the frame, a revolution central shaft is arranged between the two bearing seats, two rotating disks are symmetrically arranged on the revolution central shaft, a power device connected with one of the rotating disks or a forward and reverse motor connected with the revolution central shaft is further arranged on the frame, a plurality of planet ship shafts distributed on the periphery of the revolution central shaft are arranged between the two rotating disks, power transmission belts are arranged between all the planet ship shafts and the revolution central shaft, an eccentric ship body is obliquely fixed on the part of the planet ship shaft between the two rotating disks, a carrier is arranged in the eccentric ship body, a loading groove is arranged on the periphery of the carrier, and a cylindrical clamp is arranged in the loading groove. The utility model is applied to the technical field of chamfering equipment.

title_en: Continuous stamping die for manufacturing washing machine connecting plate
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a continuous stamping die for manufacturing a connecting plate of a washing machine, belonging to the technical field of stamping dies for connecting plates of washing machines, which comprises an intermittent driving box and a discharging component, wherein the discharging component is arranged on the right side of the intermittent driving box, a motor supporting frame is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the intermittent driving box, a speed reducing motor is fixedly arranged on the top of the motor supporting frame, the output end of the speed reducing motor is fixedly connected with a gap turntable, the outer wall of the gap turntable is fixedly connected with a connecting rod, the connecting rod is vertical to the side wall of the gap turntable, the end part of the connecting rod is fixedly connected with a driving lever, and the inner wall of the intermittent driving box is provided with a rotating shaft, and the continuous stamping die has the beneficial effects that: through setting up intermittent type drive case, utilize gear motor drive clearance carousel to rotate to stir the intermittent type wheel under the U-shaped notch effect on driving lever and intermittent type wheel surface, thereby rotate through intermittent type wheel intermittent type drive belt pulley two, because belt pulley one and belt pulley second linear velocity are the same.

title_en: Accurate cutting device of high roughness of mould insert needle incision
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an accurate cutting device with high flatness of a die insert notch, which comprises a machine body and supporting legs, wherein supporting rods are symmetrically arranged on the two side surfaces of the top of the machine body. According to the utility model, the water knife and the positioning sensor are adopted, when in use, the insert needle to be cut can be strongly and powerfully fixed through the symmetrically arranged clamping blocks, the positioning sensor is arranged in the device, the first electric sliding seat and the second electric sliding seat can conveniently detect the positions of the opposite side through the positioning sensor, the alignment and high-precision cutting operation can be conveniently carried out, and once the positions are dislocated during the operation, the rapid adjustment can be carried out, so that the influence on the cutting is avoided.

title_en: Bread slicer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bread slicer which comprises an anti-slip button, wherein a base is fixedly connected above the anti-slip button, a blanking plate is arranged above the base and movably connected with the base, a cutter body is arranged on the base and comprises a support frame, a blade is arranged on the support frame, and a worker dries bread slices in a drying device after slicing the bread, so that the problem that the bread is too wet after slicing is finished is solved, the edible taste of a customer is improved, meanwhile, the worker can operate a blanking knob when the worker is too busy, the height of the blanking plate is operated, the blanking speed of the bread on the blanking plate is greatly improved, and the working efficiency of the worker is improved.

title_en: Deburring tool
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a deburring tool, which comprises a supporting base, wherein two sides of the bottom of the supporting base are respectively and fixedly connected with a guide rail fixing plate through a hexagon head bolt C, the bottom of the guide rail fixing plate is fixedly connected with a guide rail pressing plate through a hexagon head bolt D, the top end of the supporting base is fixedly connected with a supporting lower base plate through a T-shaped nut and a hexagon head bolt B, the top end of the supporting lower base plate is respectively and fixedly connected with a rib plate and a side plate, the top ends of the rib plate and the side plate are jointly and fixedly connected with a supporting upper pressing plate, the top end of the supporting upper pressing plate is fixedly connected with a fixed cutter body, and two sides of the fixed cutter body are respectively and fixedly connected with a lower adjusting bracket and an upper adjusting bracket through adjusting bolts, the arrangement of the adjusting bracket and the upper adjusting bracket in the deburring tool is convenient for better limiting the cutter body pressing cover, thus better deburring can be realized, the arrangement of a movable cutter body is convenient for better deburring can be taken out, the setting of helical extension spring is convenient for better drive cutter body gland to reset.

title_en: Claw repairing tool
