abstract_en: The application relates to a claw repairing tool, which comprises a bush removing tool and a lock pin removing tool, wherein the bush removing tool is used for removing a bush at the end part of a main pin of a steering knuckle, the lock pin removing tool is used for removing a wedge-shaped lock pin, the bush removing tool comprises an ejector rod, a limiting clamping protrusion and a stress rod, the top of the ejector rod props against the end part of the main pin of the steering knuckle in the bush, one end of the limiting clamping protrusion is connected with the tail part of the ejector rod, and the stress rod is connected with the other end of the limiting clamping protrusion; the lock pin dismantling tool comprises a sleeve and an impact column, wherein the sleeve is used for sleeving the end part of the wedge-shaped lock pin, and the tail part of the sleeve is connected with the impact column used for receiving external force impact. The utility model has simple structure and convenient operation, directly applies pressure to the tool and can effectively disassemble the bush of the steering knuckle master pin and the wedge-shaped lock pin.

title_en: Carving tool bit assembly and carving tool
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a carving tool bit assembly and a carving tool, which are characterized in that a shell is a conical cavity with the periphery closed, so that two ends of the shell are communicated, a supporting seat is detachably limited and fixed in the cavity of the shell, and one end of the supporting seat is fixedly connected with a static tool arranged outside the shell; the swing rod is hinged and fixed with the supporting seat, one end of the swing rod is in linkage connection with the movable cutter seat, and the other end of the swing rod is in synchronous linkage with the driving mechanism. The utility model has the advantages that the shell is designed into an integrated cone shape, so that the shell can be conveniently held by fingers when in use, can be more suitable for the carving of complex patterns or characters and letters, and improves the carving accuracy and the working benefit of the carving of the patterns, the characters or the letters. Secondly, establish the conical shell of integral type with the casing, reduced the gap that split type casing exists in the installation, promoted the whole pleasing to the eye of tool bit subassembly or carving tool.

title_en: Oblique cutter structure of planing machine
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of slicing machines, in particular to an obliquely-installed cutter structure of a slicing machine, which comprises a slicing machine platform and a blade, wherein the blade and the slicing machine platform are designed in an inclined manner, the slicing machine platform is provided with a cutter groove and a water flowing groove, the cutter groove is fixedly connected with a plurality of mounting columns, a cross bar and a pressing plate are jointly sleeved on the mounting columns, one of the mounting columns is provided with an external thread, a limiting mechanism is arranged on the external thread, the limiting mechanism comprises a thread sleeve sleeved on the mounting column, an internal thread groove is arranged in the thread sleeve, the upper end of the thread sleeve is fixedly connected with a handle, the thread sleeve is sleeved and fixedly connected with an annular block, the annular block is contacted with the upper end of the pressing plate, the blade and the slicing machine platform are arranged in an inclined manner of 18 degrees, chatter of the blade is reduced, and the blade is tightly pressed by the cross bar, the blade is fixed stably and is convenient to install and disassemble.

title_en: Self-discharging plate shearing machine suitable for metal sheets
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a self-discharging plate shearing machine suitable for a metal sheet, which comprises a machine table, a feeding unit, a shearing unit, a discharging unit and a controller, wherein the feeding unit is arranged on the machine table; the shearing unit is arranged on the machine table and comprises a cutter and a driving cylinder, the tail end of a piston rod of the cylinder is connected with the cutter, and the cylinder is electrically connected with the controller; the discharging unit comprises a connecting rod and a material receiving frame, one end of the connecting rod is fixed on the cutter, the other end of the connecting rod is hinged with the material receiving frame, and the material receiving frame is hinged with the machine table; a chute is arranged at the hinged position of the material receiving frame and the connecting rod; a baffle is arranged at one end of the material receiving frame, which is far away from the cutter; when the cylinder is not started, the height of one end, close to the cutter, of the material receiving frame is higher than that of one end, far away from the cutter, of the material receiving frame; according to the automatic feeding device, the air cylinder is used for driving the cutter to reset and simultaneously driving the connecting rod to ascend, so that one end of the material receiving frame close to the cutter is lifted, automatic discharging, automatic collecting and automatic arranging of the plates are realized, manual operation is replaced, and the production efficiency is improved.

title_en: Machining center strenghthened type stand
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a machining center strenghthened type stand, concretely relates to machining technical field, including the stand body, the top and the bottom of stand body are fixedly connected with footstock and supporting pedestal respectively, two firm extension boards of supporting pedestal's bottom fixedly connected with, the bottom of firm extension board is equipped with anti-skidding wearing layer, a plurality of recess and connecting hole have been seted up to the inside of firm extension board, just the connecting hole is located the recess and is linked together with the recess. The utility model discloses increased contact area and the antiskid wearability of stand body and other devices etc, can support the stand and supplementary firm, and hollow reinforcement and firm extension board etc. have strengthened the intensity and the resistance to compression support nature of stand, and relevant hollow structure, can give off the relevant heat that produces man-hour betterly, improve the heat dispersion and the effect of stand, prevent to lead to the structural strength of stand etc. to descend because of heat altered shape.

title_en: Multifunctional plywood
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional plywood, which comprises an upper board body, wherein a clamping groove is formed in the surface of the upper board body, a clamping block is arranged inside the clamping groove, a plurality of panels are arranged above the clamping block, the panels and the upper board body are fixedly bonded through glue, a waterproof film is arranged below the upper board body, a lower board body is arranged below the waterproof film, the upper board body, the waterproof film and the lower board body are fixedly bonded through glue, heat dissipation holes are formed in the side surface of the upper board body, and the heat dissipation holes and the panels are designed in a corresponding mode. This plywood constitutes a plurality of panels through assembling single panel and wholly is convenient for change when single panel appears damaging, can avoid causing because the panel damage of single position to damage and go on unable the use to whole panel appearance, practices thrift the environmental protection.

title_en: Traction mechanism of environment-friendly copper wire drawing machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a traction mechanism of an environment-friendly copper wire drawing machine, and relates to the technical field of drawing machines. The traction mechanism of the environment-friendly copper wire drawing machine comprises a traction plate, wherein the upper side of the traction plate is rotatably connected with three traction wheels, the three traction wheels are arranged on the surface of the traction plate in a staggered manner, a cleaning box is arranged on the surface of the traction plate, and an adjusting groove is formed in the upper side of the cleaning box. This drive mechanism of environment-friendly copper wire drawing machine, and the clearance cotton of clearance ring inner wall then clears up the residue on copper line surface, the residue that has cleared up then gets into the collecting vat inner wall through the clearance groove and realizes collecting, such mode has ensured that the copper line possesses the simplicity and convenience of table body clearance when pulling the winding, has possessed good table body clearance effect before having ensured the copper line winding, the table body can not get the drawback that in time the clearance led to the fact copper line table body wearing and tearing when having reduced the copper line winding, the protection performance and the quality of the table body when having improved the copper line and pulling the winding.

title_en: Alloy part flower drawing device with impurity collection function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an alloy part flower drawing device with impurity collection, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a flower drawing machine main body is arranged above the bottom plate, a workbench is arranged on one side of the flower drawing machine main body, a flower drawing sleeve for drawing flowers on an alloy part is fixed on the surface of the workbench, a pull rod for driving the alloy part to move is arranged on one side of the flower drawing machine main body, a fixing sleeve convenient for fixing the alloy part is fixed at the output end of the pull rod, a top plate is fixed at the top end of the flower drawing machine main body, a protection plate with a protection effect is rotatably connected to the side surface of the top plate, the flower drawing machine also comprises collection components and spray components, the collection components are positioned on two sides of the flower drawing machine main body, and the spray components are positioned at the top end of the top plate. Simple structure and convenient use.

title_en: Vertical machining center with stable feeding
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of machining centers, in particular to a vertical machining center with stable feeding. The utility model provides a vertical machining center with stable feeding, which comprises: the mobile platform can slide back and forth; the supporting components are arranged on two sides of the top end surface of the moving platform and are suitable for supporting the substrate; a stamping mechanism adapted to stamp the substrate; the shifting rod is hinged to the movable end of the stamping mechanism, and a torsion spring is arranged between the shifting rod and the stamping mechanism; and the supporting component is positioned below the movable end of the shifting rod and is provided with a slope. The utility model provides a vertical machining center with stable feeding, wherein the horizontal displacement of the end of a deflector rod drives a base material to slide when the deflector rod slides along a slope, the blanking of excess materials with different intervals can be adjusted only by adjusting the width of the slope, the structure is simple, the operation is convenient, and the overload of a power source is not needed to be worried about.

title_en: A cutting machine for aluminium alloy processing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of cutting equipment and discloses a cutting machine for processing an aluminum profile, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a supporting plate is slidably arranged in the middle of the upper surface of the bottom plate, teeth are arranged in the middle of the inner wall of the bottom of the supporting plate, supporting plates are respectively arranged on the front side and the rear side of the upper surface of the supporting plate, a shell is arranged on the outer side of the upper surface of each supporting plate, a connecting plate is inserted in the middle of the inner side surface of each shell, and a clamping frame is arranged on the inner side surface of each connecting plate. This a cutting machine for aluminium alloy processing drives the transmission shaft through a driving motor and rotates for the transmission shaft drives drive gear and rotates, and drive gear drives the backup pad through the tooth and carries out longitudinal movement, and the backup pad drives the aluminium alloy through the layer board and carries out longitudinal movement, has realized the regulation to aluminium alloy cutting position, makes the user can adjust the cutting position of aluminium alloy according to the user demand, has guaranteed the cutting effect to the aluminium alloy.

title_en: Pneumatic flower disc for numerical control lathe
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a pneumatic chuck for a numerical control lathe, which comprises a flange plate, a pressing piece mounting plate and a chuck cover, wherein the flange plate is fixedly connected with the chuck cover; the flange plate is fixedly connected with the front end of the lathe spindle, and the outer peripheral surface of the flange plate is provided with an external thread; the clamping piece mounting disc is a movable disc and consists of a movable disc surface and a movable disc shaft, a plurality of threaded holes for mounting the clamping piece of the workpiece are formed in the movable disc surface, the movable disc shaft is coaxially connected with a central hole of the flange disc in a mode that the movable disc shaft is limited in the circumferential direction but can move in the axial direction, an external thread is formed at the end part of the movable disc shaft, and the movable disc shaft is connected with an internal thread hole formed in the front end of a pneumatic tensioning rod of the lathe through the external thread; the flower disc cover consists of a flower disc surface and a vertical annular edge, wherein an internal thread is formed on the inner surface of the vertical annular edge, and the flower disc cover is connected with the external thread on the flange plate through the internal thread; the position that sets up the screw hole on the colored quotation corresponding to the removal quotation is equipped with the hole of stepping down, is equipped with the screw hole between the hole of stepping down. The pneumatic chuck improves the clamping efficiency and the pressing consistency of parts.

title_en: Vertical numerically controlled lathe with two axial rails
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a vertical numerically controlled lathe with two axial rails, which relates to the technical field of lathes and comprises a base, a spindle assembly, a turret assembly and a cooling baffle assembly; the base is respectively provided with a main shaft assembly, a cutter tower assembly and a cooling baffle assembly; the inner wall of the base is funnel-shaped, so that the scraps and the cooling water can conveniently slide into the collecting box of the base to be uniformly collected; the tool turret realizes accurate positioning and turning of workpieces with different sizes through a two-axis rail structure; the lifting seat realizes free lifting of the turret, greatly shortens the force arm of the turret relative to the working table surface and greatly increases the rigidity of the vertical lathe; the cooling water reduces the temperature of the workpiece and the cutter, improves the processing quality of the workpiece, ensures the processing precision, and improves the durability and the production efficiency of the cutter; the arrangement of the baffle can prevent the scraps and the cooling liquid from splashing everywhere, thereby playing the role of protection and isolation; the baffle is arranged in a clamping installation mode, so that the installation and the disassembly are convenient.

title_en: Gear detection tool
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a gear detection tool, which comprises a base, wherein a support frame is arranged on one side of the top of the base, a movable rod is embedded in the top of the support frame, a telescopic rod is arranged at the bottom of the movable rod, one end, far away from the movable rod, of the telescopic rod is rotatably connected with a pressing block, a spring matched with the pressing block is sleeved on the telescopic rod, a sliding groove is formed in the side surface wall of the support frame, a sliding block is slidably connected in the sliding groove, a dial indicator is arranged at one end, close to the telescopic rod, of the sliding block, an installation seat is arranged at the top of the base, the upper surface wall of the installation seat is rotatably connected with a tool table, a driving motor matched with the tool table is embedded in the installation seat, and a workpiece is arranged on the upper surface wall of the tool table. According to the utility model, the movable rod, the telescopic rod, the pressing block and the spring are matched with each other, so that the workpiece can be fixed, and the dial indicator can conveniently detect the jumping of the end surface of the workpiece.

title_en: Testing device for high-sensitivity brush holder
abstract_en: The utility model provides a testing device for a high-sensitivity brush holder, which comprises a fixing assembly, wherein the fixing assembly comprises a detection platform, a cavity, a groove, a connecting plate, a spring, a first flexible steel rope, a pull block, a second flexible steel rope, a rectangular hole and a positioning rod. Draw the piece to drive the connecting plate through first flexible steel cable and remove, the connecting plate drives the movable plate through the flexible steel cable of second and removes, the movable plate drives the arc through the connecting rod and removes, place the brush yoke between two arcs, relax the pulling force to drawing the piece gradually, the extension spring under the compression state resets, the extension spring drives the connecting rod through the movable plate and removes, the connecting rod drives the arc that corresponds and removes and fix with the brush yoke, be convenient for fix the brush yoke of different specifications this moment, the knob rotates, the knob passes through the screw rod and drives the carriage release lever and remove, the carriage release lever drives L shape pole and slides on the square bar that corresponds, the carriage release lever drives the probe and removes, be convenient for adjust the position of probe as required and test.

title_en: Refrigeration house plate layer pressing die
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cold storage slab pressing die which comprises a base, upright columns, a top seat, a first air cylinder, a mounting plate, a pressing plate, inserting columns, inserting ports, limiting through ports, a limiting mechanism, a die, a second air cylinder and an ejector plate. According to the utility model, the base, the stand column, the top seat, the first air cylinder, the mounting plate, the pressing plate, the inserting column, the socket, the limiting port, the limiting mechanism, the fixing seat, the baffle, the limiting block, the pull rod, the connecting plate, the handle, the spring, the mold, the second air cylinder and the ejection plate are matched with each other, so that a user can conveniently detach the pressing plate, the user can conveniently maintain or replace the pressing plate, and the practicability of the cold storage plate laminating mold is greatly improved.

title_en: Stamping die for processing metal plate
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a stamping die for processing metal plates, which adopts the technical scheme that: including the mould body, mould body bottom is equipped with bottom plate and actuating mechanism, the equal symmetry in bottom plate top both ends is equipped with ejection mechanism, ejection mechanism includes fixed block and transfer line, fixed block bottom and bottom plate fixed connection, the transfer line run through the fixed block top and with fixed block sliding connection, transfer line one end is equipped with first scarf, the transfer line other end is equipped with the second scarf, mould body one end fixedly connected with supporting shoe, a stamping die's for sheet metal processing beneficial effect is: according to the utility model, by arranging the ejection mechanism, a user can directly eject the stamping part out of the die body by pressing the shell, so that the workpiece is convenient to demold and take, the manual workload is reduced, the demolding efficiency is greatly improved, and the problem that the efficiency is low because the stamping part is difficult to take out by workers in the demolding process is effectively solved.

title_en: Intelligent machine tool mounting base with buffering function
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of intelligent machine tools, and particularly provides an installation base with a buffering function for an intelligent machine tool, which comprises a base body, wherein the base body comprises a fixed base, a buffering mechanism and a movable base, the buffering mechanism comprises a connecting sleeve, a connecting rod, two electromagnets, a control circuit and an inflating mechanism, the fixed base is provided with an installation hole, the connecting sleeve is embedded in the installation hole, the connecting rod is fixedly arranged on the movable base, the connecting rod is connected with the connecting sleeve in a sliding and sealing manner, the two electromagnets are respectively and fixedly arranged at the bottom of the connecting sleeve and one end of the connecting rod, an air pressure cavity is formed between the two electromagnets, and the inflating mechanism is communicated with the air pressure cavity through an air duct. According to the utility model, through the magnetic force between the two electromagnets and the pressure of gas, the intelligent machine tool can be fixedly or flexibly connected, different use requirements are met, and in addition, through the double-layer buffering effect of the gas and the magnetic force, the damping effect of the machine tool can be improved.

title_en: Excircle workpiece deburring equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an excircle work piece burring equipment, including driving motor one, the mill that is connected with a driving motor output with place the platform, its characterized in that: the workpiece clamping device is characterized by further comprising a bottom plate, the upper end of the bottom plate is rotatably connected with a rotating shaft, the upper end of the rotating shaft is connected with a placing table, a workpiece body is placed on the placing table, the placing table is provided with a clamping device used for fixing the two sides of the workpiece body, the upper side of the bottom plate is provided with a driving mechanism used for rotating the rotating shaft, first supporting rods and a top plate are connected and arranged at the two ends of the upper side wall of the bottom plate, a second supporting rod is connected and arranged at the upper end of the first supporting rod, a supporting plate is connected and arranged at the lower end of the top plate, a supporting plate is connected and arranged at the lower end of the second supporting rod, and a sliding plate is arranged at the lower side of the supporting plate. Compared with the prior art, the utility model the advantage lie in: the precision of polishing is higher, avoids polishing excessive condition, presss from both sides tightly more firm when fixing the work piece body.

title_en: Metal working workbench with adjustable clamping function
abstract_en: The utility model provides a metal processing workbench with an adjustable clamping function, which relates to the technical field of metal processing workbenches and comprises a workbench body, wherein the bottom of the workbench body is rotatably connected with a bidirectional screw rod, the surface of the bidirectional screw rod is rotatably provided with a base, the top surface of the base is provided with a clamping block, one side of the clamping block is fixedly provided with a limiting plate, a threaded rod is rotatably arranged inside the limiting plate, one end of the threaded rod is fixedly provided with a rubber pad, when the metal processing workbench is in actual use, the workbench body, the bidirectional screw rod, the base, the clamping block, the limiting plate, the threaded rod, the rubber pad, a tension spring and a fixed block are arranged, so that metals with different volume specifications can be directly fixed on the surface of the workbench body, the complicated operation of repeatedly replacing a clamp by people is avoided, meanwhile, the clamping can be freely adjusted and clamped, and the clamping block can be rapidly detached from the base by rotating the bidirectional screw rod, make things convenient for people to carry with workstation body and clamp splice separation.

title_en: VCM electronic product disk bending and arranging machine
abstract_en: The utility model provides a VCM electronic product bending and arranging machine which comprises a supporting base, wherein a three-way sliding module is arranged above the supporting base, a arranging disc adsorption mechanism is arranged on a sliding block of the three-way sliding module in the z-axis direction, at least one group of object placing disc mechanisms are arranged below the three-way sliding module, and a bending mechanism is arranged on one side of the supporting base, so that bending failure can be prevented, electronic elements can be bent in a reciprocating manner, the electronic product can be prevented from being too high in ductility to cause bending failure, and meanwhile, the electronic elements after bending is completed when the arranging disc works can be prevented from being damaged.

title_en: Hydraulic forging machine is used in ligature pole production
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of hydraulic forging machines, in particular to a hydraulic forging machine for producing binding rods, which aims at solving the problems that when the existing hydraulic forging machine is used for forging materials, the continuous forging may deform the material, the temperature of the surface of the material may increase, and the material may not be conveniently removed, the following scheme is proposed, which comprises a hydraulic forging machine, wherein the left side and the right side of the hydraulic forging machine are both fixedly provided with butt-joint seats, the hydraulic forging machine is provided with a swivel, the left side and the right side of the swivel are both connected with butt-joint blocks in a sliding way, the utility model arranges a swivel on a hydraulic forging machine, arranges a plurality of materials on the swivel, the hydraulic forging machine forges the materials, the swivel can be rotated to switch the materials on the hydraulic forging machine, meanwhile, the swivel can be separated from the hydraulic forging machine, and materials on the hydraulic forging machine can be taken down through the swivel.

title_en: Outer surface polishing mechanism is used in rubber roll production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an outer surface polishing mechanism for rubber roll production, which comprises a polishing table, wherein a telescopic extrusion limiting structure is arranged on the polishing table, and a polishing structure is arranged on the telescopic extrusion limiting structure; flexible extrusion limit structure includes: the extrusion device comprises a pair of convex movable bearing blocks, a pair of extrusion shafts, a pair of extrusion hydraulic chucks, a pair of extrusion threaded rods, a pair of extrusion threaded pipes, two pairs of extrusion limiting shafts, a speed changer, an extrusion driver, a pair of extrusion telescopic drivers, a pair of extrusion driving gears and a pair of extrusion transmission gears; the utility model relates to the technical field of rubber roller production, wherein rubber rollers with different lengths are subjected to telescopic extrusion and fixation through a telescopic extrusion limiting structure, and the rubber rollers with different diameters can be polished within a certain range through the matching of a polishing structure and the telescopic extrusion limiting structure, so that the height can be adjusted according to different diameters and different rubber roller lengths, and the polishing distance can be adjusted according to different rubber roller requirements.

title_en: Grinding device for wind driven generator blade
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a polishing device for blades of a wind driven generator, which comprises a polishing box, wherein a first supporting plate is fixedly installed on the outer side of the polishing box, a first motor is fixedly installed on the upper surface of the first supporting plate, the output end of the first motor is connected with a first threaded rod through a coupler, a first sliding block is installed on the first threaded rod in a threaded manner, a first servo electric cylinder is fixedly installed at the lower end of the first sliding block, a second motor is fixedly installed in the supporting frame, the output end of the second motor is connected with a polishing knife through the coupler, second servo motors are fixedly installed on two sides of the lower end of the polishing box, clamps are fixedly installed at the output ends of the second servo motors, a second threaded rod is arranged in each clamp, a second sliding block is connected to the second threaded rod in a threaded manner, and a clamping plate is fixedly installed on one side of the second sliding block. The fan blade clamp can clamp the fan blade during grinding, and can collect the ground dust.

title_en: Plastic film's cutting device
abstract_en: The application relates to a cutting device of a plastic film, which relates to the technical field of plastic film production and comprises a rack, wherein a cutting mechanism for cutting the plastic film is arranged on the rack, the cutting mechanism comprises a feed roller, and the feed roller is rotationally arranged on the rack and is used for guiding the plastic film in; the discharging roller is rotationally arranged on the rack, and the plastic film bypasses the discharging roller and is led out; the cutter, the cutter setting just is located between feed roller and the discharge roller in the frame, and the cutter cuts plastic film. This application is walked around the discharge roll after plastic film passes through the feed roll leading-in and is derived, and the cutter setting cuts plastic film between feed roll and discharge roll to need not the manual work and cut, improved plastic film's cutting accuracy.

title_en: Non-oxidation stainless steel welding tool
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a non-oxidation stainless steel welding tool, which comprises a protective cylinder, wherein a protective cavity is arranged in the middle of the protective cylinder, a cooling circulation gas inlet is arranged on one side of the protective cylinder, the cooling circulation gas inlet is close to one end of the protective cavity and is positioned in the protective cylinder, a circulation gas collecting cavity is arranged in the protective cylinder, one end of the circulation gas collecting cavity, which is far away from the cooling circulation gas inlet, is positioned on the surface of the protective cylinder, a cooling circulation gas outlet is arranged on the surface of the protective cylinder, a cooling circulation water inlet is arranged on the top of the cooling circulation gas inlet and is positioned in the protective cylinder, a circulation water collecting cavity is arranged on the top of the circulation gas collecting cavity and is positioned in the protective cylinder, and a cooling circulation water outlet is arranged on the top of the cooling circulation gas outlet and is positioned on the surface of the protective cylinder. Reducing the stainless steel welding seam, improving the deposition rate of the welding wire and realizing long-time welding of the tool.

title_en: Standard part machining tool for aviation
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of standard part machining fixtures, in particular to an aviation standard part machining tool. The clamping structure comprises two holding rods, the arc surfaces of the two holding rods are rotatably connected with the U-shaped plate, the ends, close to each other, of the two holding rods are fixedly connected with a fixing sleeve, the inner wall of the fixing sleeve is in threaded connection with a screw rod, the ends, close to each other, of the two screw rods are rotatably connected with clamping plates, the sides, far away from each other, of the two clamping plates are fixedly connected with limiting rods, one ends, far away from the clamping plates, of the limiting rods are slidably penetrated through the surface of the fixing plate and fixedly connected with the fixing sleeve, and the surface of the U-shaped plate is fixedly connected with two circular plates. The problem of staff when processing to the standard component, inconvenient to the standard component centre gripping fixed is solved.

title_en: Processing die carrier of double-walled steel cofferdam
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a processing die carrier of a double-wall steel cofferdam, which comprises a first processing die carrier and a second processing die carrier; the first processing mold base comprises a first horizontal plane and fillet surfaces which are adapted to the inner walls of the fillet unit blocks of the steel cofferdam, the fillet surfaces are used for supporting and positioning the inner walls of the fillet unit blocks, the first horizontal plane is positioned above the fillet surfaces, and the first horizontal plane is used for aligning with inflection points of the outer walls of the fillet unit blocks; the second processing mold frame comprises a second horizontal plane and a third horizontal plane, the second horizontal plane is used for supporting the inner walls of the straight unit blocks of the steel cofferdam, the third horizontal plane is located above the second horizontal plane, and the third horizontal plane is used for aligning the outer walls of the straight unit blocks. It can make the fillet cell piece of processing and the interior outer wall between the straight cell piece interval unanimous basically, and then makes the final quality difference of the different straight cell pieces or different fillet cell pieces after the processing less, reduces the steel cofferdam and has the possibility that the weld has the wrong platform, has improved the quality after the steel cofferdam machine-shaping.

title_en: Nonrust steel pipe rack
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a stainless steel tube placing rack, which relates to the technical field of stainless steel tube production and comprises an operating platform, wherein a plurality of supporting legs are fixedly arranged on the lower surface of the operating platform, fixing plates are arranged at the bottoms of the supporting legs, a slideway is arranged on the upper surface of the operating platform, a group of horizontal adjusting frames are connected in the slideway in a sliding manner, each horizontal adjusting frame is provided with an installing hole, one end of a transverse adjusting rod is inserted into the installing hole, and the other end of the transverse adjusting rod is rotatably connected with a locking mechanism; the locking mechanism is composed of two groups of fastening frames, the fastening frames are symmetrically arranged relative to the transverse adjusting rod, a cavity is formed in the transverse adjusting rod, an adjusting mechanism is arranged in the cavity, and the adjusting mechanism is meshed with the fastening frames. According to the utility model, the fastening frame is designed, and the stainless steel pipe is fixed by using the fastening frame, so that the placing stability is ensured.

title_en: Automatic carving machine for furniture wood
abstract_en: The utility model provides an automatic carving machine for furniture wood, which comprises a supporting table body, wherein two side plates are vertically arranged at two ends of the top of the supporting table body, a top plate is fixedly connected between the tops of the two side plates, the bottom of the top plate is slidably connected with a clamping device, the clamping device comprises two fourth driving oil cylinders, and the tops of the fourth driving oil cylinders are fixedly connected with a third moving seat; roof bottom both ends all are connected with two third bar seats, two be connected with a plurality of third guiding axles between the third bar seat, the third removes the seat and runs through sliding connection on the third guiding axle, third guiding axle and roof parallel arrangement, one side be connected with third actuating cylinder on the third bar seat, one side of third actuating cylinder and the lateral wall that the third removed the seat are connected. The wood cutting machine can automatically clamp the sectional wood, then put the sectional wood below the graver for rotary carving, and finally fall off the blanking plate.

title_en: Installation adjustable accurate location type machining cutter
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of advanced manufacturing and automation, in particular to an accurately-positioned machining tool with adjustable installation. Including blade 1 and regulation seat 2, blade 1 is kept away from tool bit one end and is rotated with regulation seat 2 and be connected, it is equipped with first sector plate 21 to adjust seat 2, be equipped with a set of chamber 211 of inserting along fan-shaped circular arc circumference equipartition on the first sector plate 21, it is equipped with elasticity bolt 3 to correspond first sector plate 21 one side on the blade 1, 3 tip of elasticity bolt suit with inserting chamber 211, it still is equipped with bolt chamber 40 still to correspond elasticity bolt 3 on the blade 1, elasticity bolt 3 sets up axial displacement in bolt chamber 40. Through keeping away from tool bit one end at blade 1 and setting up regulation seat 2, when needing angle adjustment, rotate blade 1, insert corresponding inserting chamber 211 with elasticity bolt 3 in, accomplish the location. Therefore, the positioning device has the advantages of convenience in operation, accuracy in positioning, firmness in structure and capability of ensuring the machining precision of the formed inclination angle.

title_en: Anti-seismic cutter bar for processing various deep holes or deep surfaces
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-seismic cutter bar for processing various deep holes or deep surfaces, which comprises a cutter bar outer shaft, a cutter bar core shaft and an anti-seismic structure, wherein the top end of the cutter bar outer shaft is provided with an installation connector, the interior of the cutter bar outer shaft is designed in a hollow mode, the bottom of the cutter bar outer shaft is designed in an open mode, the cutter bar outer shaft is provided with a plurality of installation holes for installing cutter bits close to the bottom of the cutter bar outer shaft, the cutter bar core shaft is positioned in the interior of the cutter bar outer shaft, the exterior of the cutter bar core shaft is provided with two annular installation grooves, and the two installation grooves are respectively close to the top end and the bottom end of the cutter bar core shaft. According to the utility model, the outer shaft of the cutter bar is made of steel materials, and the cutter bar core shaft is made of steel shells and lead materials, so that compared with imported anti-seismic cutter bars, the cost of production materials is greatly reduced, the price of the anti-seismic cutter bar is reduced, the anti-seismic effect of the anti-seismic cutter bar is effectively improved, the service life of the anti-seismic cutter bar is prolonged, and the overall practicability is higher.

title_en: Multifunctional laser metal cutting machine tool
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional laser metal cutting machine tool which comprises a supporting table, wherein a supporting frame is arranged behind the upper end face of the supporting table, a moving groove is formed in the front end face of the supporting frame in a penetrating mode, an electric motor is arranged at the right end of the supporting frame in a penetrating mode and corresponds to the inside of the moving groove in a penetrating mode, a motor shaft extends from one end of the electric motor, a lead screw is arranged at one end of the motor shaft, a moving block is arranged at one end of the lead screw in a penetrating mode and is in threaded connection with the lead screw, an auxiliary frame is arranged at the front end of the moving block, a first electric push rod is arranged at the rear end of the inside of the auxiliary frame, a sliding block is arranged at the front end of the first electric push rod, a laser cutting tool is arranged at the lower end of the sliding block and corresponds to the lower portion of the auxiliary frame, and a purification box is arranged at the right end of the auxiliary frame. In the utility model, multifunctional use can be effectively realized.

title_en: Positioning device convenient to adjust for electronic equipment production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a positioning device convenient to adjust and used for electronic equipment production, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein the left side of the top of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a vertical plate, the top of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with an electric telescopic rod, the output end of the electric telescopic rod is fixedly connected with a first transverse plate, the top of the right side of the vertical plate is fixedly connected with a second transverse plate, and the right side of the first transverse plate is fixedly connected with a supporting plate. Through the bottom plate, the riser, electric telescopic handle, first diaphragm, the second diaphragm, the extension board, the box, the dwang, the connecting plate, first gear, including a motor, an end cap, a controller, and a cover plate, the second gear, first fixed plate, the backup pad, the cooperation of threaded rod and second fixed plate, the good purpose of result of use has been realized, multidirectional regulatory function has, thereby avoid bringing the trouble for the user, satisfy the demand in current market, positioner's for electronic equipment production practicality and usability have been improved, the not good problem of positioner result of use for electronic equipment production in the past has been solved.

title_en: Numerical control lathe is used in parts machining with mechanism of making an uproar falls
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of numerically controlled lathes for machining parts, in particular to a numerically controlled lathe with a noise reduction mechanism for machining parts, which comprises a numerically controlled lathe. According to the utility model, a first door plate is horizontally and slidably arranged at the front end part of the numerical control lathe, a second door plate is arranged at the side end part of the first door plate close to the numerical control lathe, and a sliding rod is fixedly arranged between the first door plate and the second door plate. According to the door plate II, the upper slot is driven to leave the clamping plate through the downward movement of the miniature spring, a user can pull the cleaning stick outwards at the moment, the cleaning stick moves outwards to drive the side sliding plate to slide in the rectangular sliding groove, after the upper end part of the cleaning stick is pulled out, the lower end part of the cleaning stick is pulled out of the rotating groove, the glass cover plate of the door plate II is repeatedly cleaned through the cleaning stick, manual cleaning is not needed, the practicability of the device is improved, meanwhile, the disassembly and assembly are convenient, and the operation difficulty is reduced.

title_en: Domestic waste crushing separation processing apparatus
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a household garbage crushing and separating treatment device which comprises a device main body, wherein a connecting shaft is movably connected to the inner surface of the rear end of the device main body, a servo motor is installed on the outer surface of the rear end of the connecting shaft, a driving bevel gear is fixedly connected to the outer wall of the connecting shaft, a connecting plate is fixedly connected to the outer surface of the front end of the device main body, and a U-shaped vertical plate is fixedly connected to the outer surface of the front end of the connecting plate. This broken separation processing apparatus of domestic waste uses through the cooperation of reciprocal compaction subassembly, drives the continuous reciprocating motion of compaction seat, carries out the compaction to rubbish for sewage can be extruded, through the dual filtration sewage of two sets of filters, lets sewage converge sewage and collects the box, just can realize domestic waste's dry and wet separation, reduces breeding of bacterium, uses through the cooperation of extrusion subassembly, and the fly leaf can cover the rubbish inlet port, hinders overflowing of stink, guarantees operational environment's cleanness.

title_en: Full-automatic steel plate double-edge shear
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a full-automatic steel plate double-sided shear, which comprises a bottom plate and a double-sided shear body, wherein the double-sided shear body is fixedly connected to the left side above the bottom plate, and a buffer device is arranged in the middle above the bottom plate. The utility model relates to the technical field of bilateral scissors, in particular to a full-automatic steel plate bilateral scissors, when a processing table is stressed to move downwards, the processing table can drive an inclined rod to move, so that the inclined rod drives a cross rod to move through a first rectangular block, and meanwhile, the first rectangular block can enable a first spring and a second spring to generate elastic deformation by matching with a processing seat, so that the processing table above can be buffered through the elastic properties of the first spring and the second spring and the like; after the steel plate is moved to the feeding plate through the external equipment, the left end of the steel plate can be attached to the outer wall of the first roller wheel, and therefore the steel plate can be driven to move when the first roller wheel rotates, and automatic feeding is achieved.

title_en: Rotary cutter for processing decorative wood boards
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rotary cutter for processing decorative wood boards, which comprises a base, a feeding mechanism arranged on the base, a cutter bed arranged on the feeding mechanism, a driving box arranged on the base, a driving roller set arranged on the side surface of the driving box, a pressure adjusting mechanism arranged at the top of the cutter bed, an abutting roller arranged at one end of the pressure adjusting mechanism, and a waste material guiding mechanism arranged in the cutter bed, wherein the pressure adjusting mechanism comprises a pressure adjusting mechanism body and a waste material guiding mechanism; the waste material guiding mechanism comprises a lifting block, a lifting screw rod, a lifting motor, a feeding hole, a guiding out channel and a cutting blade; through the feed inlet, derive way and pressure adjustment mechanism's cooperation, realize deriving the dirty silo to the saw-dust and the waste material of rotary cutting initial stage to realize timber preliminary treatment and cell-phone waste material, do benefit to the clean degree that improves operational environment, and the sensor of cantilever beam in the cooperation pressure adjustment mechanism, continuously detect the pressure between butt joint roller and the timber, do benefit to the quality that improves the rotary-cut wood chip.

title_en: Industrial machinery automatic stamping device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an industrial mechanical automatic stamping device which comprises a support box, wherein a driving motor is fixedly connected to the rear side of the support box, a cam is fixedly connected to the output end of the driving motor, a pulley is arranged on the surface of the cam, a movable plate is fixedly connected to the top of the pulley, an ejection column is fixedly connected to the top of the movable plate, a stamping die is fixedly connected to the top of the support box through a bolt, a placing groove is formed in the top of the stamping die, a support column is fixedly connected to the top of the support box, a support plate is fixedly connected to the top of the support column, and an air cylinder is fixedly connected to the top of the support plate. According to the utility model, through the matched use of the support box, the cam, the pulley, the movable plate, the ejection column, the stamping die, the placing groove, the support column, the support plate, the air cylinder, the fixed plate, the connecting column, the stamping plate and the controller, a formed workpiece can be ejected upwards after stamping, the taking is convenient, and the stamping efficiency is improved.

title_en: Punching and positioning device for building engineering
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a punching positioning device for constructional engineering, which comprises a connecting plate, wherein the front part of the lower end and the rear part of the lower end of the connecting plate are fixedly connected with two supporting legs, the left part and the right part of the upper end of the connecting plate are respectively provided with a movable groove, the middle part of the upper end of the connecting plate is movably and alternately connected with a plurality of idler wheels at equal intervals, the front part and the rear part of the lower end of the connecting plate are jointly and fixedly connected with a displacement device, the left part and the right part of the upper end of the connecting plate are respectively and fixedly connected with a supporting plate, the upper ends of the two supporting plates are jointly and fixedly connected with a supporting block, the middle part of the upper end of the supporting block is fixedly connected with an electric telescopic rod, the output end of the electric telescopic rod penetrates through the middle part of the lower end of the supporting block and is fixedly connected with a cushion block, and the lower end of the cushion block is fixedly connected with a punching mechanism. The punching positioning device for the building engineering has a good positioning effect, and improves the punching stability of building materials.

title_en: Safety protection device for welding robot workstation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a safety protection device for a welding robot workstation, and relates to the field of welding robots. The utility model provides a safety device for welding robot workstation, includes the base, the left side fixedly connected with mounting panel at base top, the top fixedly connected with welding robot main part of mounting panel, the platform is placed to the right side fixedly connected with at base top, the first electric putter of bottom fixedly connected with on inner cavity of the base right side, first electric putter's top fixedly connected with backup pad. title_en: Numerical control lathe for machining parts
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a numerical control lathe for machining parts, which comprises a machine body, wherein a supporting box is fixedly connected to the bottom surface of the machine body, two refrigerators are arranged in the supporting box, two sliding holes are formed in the inner side wall of the machine body, electric hydraulic push rods are fixedly arranged on the inner top walls of the two sliding holes, sliding blocks are fixedly connected to the telescopic ends of the two electric hydraulic push rods, supporting tables are fixedly connected to one side surfaces, close to each other, of the two sliding blocks, two bases are fixedly connected to the bottom surface of the supporting box, a control panel is fixedly inlaid on the front surface of the machine body, two fixing covers are fixedly inlaid on the inner side wall of the supporting box, and one ends, far away from each other, of the two refrigerators are fixedly connected with the inner side walls of the two fixing covers respectively. This numerical control lathe is used in spare part processing can make the spare part descend to the inside of supporting box and carry out the cooling treatment, avoids the high temperature after the spare part processing to lead to the fact the problem of scalding to the staff.

title_en: Rebound compensation bending die
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rebound compensation bending die which comprises a base, wherein a top plate is arranged at the top of the base, the top plate is fixedly connected with the base through a supporting plate, lower rollers are arranged on two sides of the top of the base, the bottom ends of the lower rollers are movably connected with the base, the top of the lower rollers is in a circular shape, and an electric push rod is arranged at the top of the top plate. This rebound compensation bending die, through second threaded rod and movable rod threaded connection, because the screw thread on second threaded rod surface is two sections, and for opposite setting for the distance between two movable rods enlarges or reduces, through the distance between two lower gyro wheels, can form the work piece of different crookedness, because the diameter of a plurality of drums increases from inside to outside gradually, let the drum all be located roller department, through the merger of last gyro wheel and a plurality of drum, make the width increase together, be convenient for form the work piece of different crookions.

title_en: Shock absorber performance adjustment device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a device for adjusting the performance of a shock absorber, and relates to the technical field of shock absorber adjustment. This shock absorber performance adjusting device aims at solving among the prior art when adjusting the shock absorber, need the manual rotation upper and lower rotation of catch on the shock absorber of manual work, compress and release the spring, realize the regulation of shock absorber performance, wherein the comparatively laborious problem of manual rotation, this shock absorber performance adjusting device includes the mount, the inside left side welding of mount has fixed jaw, the inside right side activity of mount is provided with the fixed plate, the fixed plate is close outside one end welding and has movable jaw, cooperate with fixed jaw, be convenient for press from both sides tightly the catch, the fixed handle of mount lower surface welding, conveniently drive the rotation of catch, wherein the mount surface runs through there is a plurality of locating screw holes, fixed plate surface screw thread fit has the locking bolt, with locating screw thread fit, be convenient for adjust movable jaw and fixed jaw's relative distance, the adjustment of different shock absorbers is used.

title_en: Scribing device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a scribing device, which comprises a circumferential positioning part and a vertical positioning part, wherein the circumferential positioning part is provided with a main body, an arc abutting surface formed on the inner circumferential surface of the main body, an indicating end surface connected with the end edge of the arc abutting surface and a first positioning part, and the indicating end surface is provided with a first size indicating part along the circumferential direction of the arc abutting surface; the vertical positioning component extends vertically and comprises a second positioning part; when the vertical positioning member is connected to the circumferential positioning member through the second positioning portion, the vertical positioning member is supported such that the vertical extending direction is orthogonal to the indicating end face. The circumferential positioning member can be configured to surround the outer periphery of the round steel tube concrete column for positioning the height thereof in the vertical direction relative to the round steel tube concrete column, the vertical positioning member being positioned thereon and being orthogonal thereto when supported thereon, the vertical line being delineated by the first size indication portion on the circumferential positioning member and the vertically extending vertical positioning member.

title_en: Spark machine for die processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a spark machine for mold processing, which belongs to the field of spark machines and comprises a spark machine body, a clamp and an electrode tip, wherein the clamp is fixedly arranged on the spark machine body, the electrode tip is arranged on the clamp, the clamp comprises a mounting seat, at least two sliding blocks, a vertical plate, a first spring, a clamping plate and a bolt, a through hole is formed in the top of the mounting seat, an annular sliding groove is formed in the edge of the through hole, at least two sliding blocks are connected in a sliding manner in the annular sliding groove, the top of the at least two sliding blocks is detachably connected with the vertical plate, a first spring is connected to the inner side of the vertical plate, the clamping plate is connected to the inner end of the first spring, the bolt is in threaded connection with the vertical plate, and one end of the first spring abuts against the clamping plate. The spark machine for die processing is convenient to assemble and disassemble the electrode tip, and can be suitable for the installation of electrode tips with different shapes and specifications.

title_en: Multidimensional magnetic stirring surfacing equipment based on three-foot parallel mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of welding equipment, in particular to multidimensional magnetic stirring surfacing equipment based on a tripodia parallel mechanism. The multi-jaw chuck clamps one end of a welded workpiece, and the plug is tightly propped against the other end of the welded workpiece; the three-degree-of-freedom welding gun pose adjusting system is arranged on a movable welding machine walking bracket, so that the x, y and z three-way position movement adjustment of the welding gun head is realized, and the probe is fixedly connected to the welding gun head; the magnetic stirring head of the magnetic stirring system is fixedly connected to a z-direction sliding guide rail of the three-degree-of-freedom welding gun pose adjusting system, multi-angle swing and rotation are realized through a three-foot parallel mechanism, and the overlaying structure is refined and the overlaying quality is improved through the multi-dimensional electromagnetic stirring effect; and the residual flux recycling system is used for recycling flux and conveying the flux to a flux hopper, so that full-automatic feeding and flux recycling are realized. And the welding process detection and defect early warning effectively reduce the welding defect generation probability, and reduce the welding cost and rejection rate.

title_en: Rotary working platform
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rotary working platform, which relates to the technical field of grinding machine working platforms. According to the utility model, the limiting mechanism is arranged, one end of the extrusion block is extruded by the inner wall of the sliding column, the extrusion block is moved and simultaneously drives the anti-skid blocks to move through mechanical transmission, when the top end of the sliding column is moved to the upper part of the extrusion block, the plurality of extrusion blocks are completely moved to the inside of the fixed column, at the moment, the plurality of anti-skid blocks are in contact extrusion with the outer wall of a workpiece to be polished, then a worker can fix the moved sliding column with the fixed column by inserting a bolt into a clamping groove matched with the outer wall of the fixed column, and the structure is beneficial to clamping and limiting operation on a plurality of workpieces.

title_en: Press machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of presses, in particular to a press which comprises an equipment base, wherein two ends of the top of the equipment base are fixedly connected with two groups of mounting seats, the top of each mounting seat is provided with a mounting groove, the top of the equipment base is provided with a pressure deformation device, each pressure deformation device comprises a first pressure cylinder, a second pressure cylinder, a first pressure deformation head, a second pressure deformation head, a connecting chain and a fixed sprocket, the first pressure cylinder is connected with the first pressure deformation head, the second pressure cylinder is connected with the second pressure deformation head, the connecting chain is arranged at the tops of the first pressure deformation head and the second pressure deformation head, and the connecting chain is meshed with the outside of the fixed sprocket.

title_en: Reinforcing bar material loading delivery device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of steel bar cutting, and particularly discloses a steel bar feeding and delivering device which comprises a trolley, wherein a conveying device for conveying steel bars, a guide ring for guiding the steel bars and a blocking piece for blocking the steel bars after the guide ring is used for guiding the steel bars so that the steel bars are orderly arranged are arranged on the trolley; the guide ring comprises two clamping blocks, the clamping blocks are connected with screws, the screws are in threaded connection with second fixing blocks, and the second fixing blocks are connected with first supporting rods. According to the utility model, the steel bars are conveyed through the belt, the blocking piece blocks the steel bars after the clamping blocks clamp the steel bars, so that the lengths of the front ends of the steel bars are kept consistent spontaneously, and then the steel bars are conveyed to the cutting machine for cutting, so that the hands of a worker are liberated, and the workload of the worker is reduced.

title_en: Right-angle milling head
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a right-angle milling head which comprises a shell, wherein a connecting seat is fixedly connected to the shell, a rotating shaft is connected to the inside of the connecting seat through a bearing, the rotating shaft is rotationally connected with the shell, a first bevel gear is fixedly connected to the rotating shaft, an air cylinder is fixedly connected to the inside of the shell, a side cover is contacted to the shell, a rotating sleeve is arranged inside the side cover through a bearing, a square rod is connected to the inside of the rotating sleeve in a sliding manner, a cutter is fixedly connected to the square rod, and the square rod is contacted with the output end of the air cylinder. According to the utility model, the fixing block is in sliding connection with the shell, so that the vertical direction of the side cover can be limited, and the lug is inserted into the fixing block, so that the horizontal direction of the fixing block can be limited, the purpose of fixing the side cover with the shell is achieved, the lug is conveniently separated from the groove, the side cover is conveniently detached, and the maintenance of the internal structure is convenient.

title_en: Automatic injector percussion assembly fixture
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an automatic injector firing assembly fixture which comprises a base, a fixed ring, an assembly barrel, a push rod and a driving piece, wherein the fixed ring is arranged on the base; the fixed ring and the assembly cylinder are respectively and coaxially arranged at two ends of the assembly cylinder, the fixed ring and the assembly cylinder are both connected with the base, and the push rod is axially slidably arranged on the base; one end of the push rod extends into the assembly barrel, and the driving piece is used for pushing the push rod into the assembly barrel; according to the utility model, the shell of the firing assembly is fixed through the fixing ring, the firing assembly is arranged in the assembly cylinder, and the firing assembly can be pushed into the shell of the firing assembly through the push rod to realize assembly, so that the assembly difficulty of the automatic injector is reduced; in addition, the driving piece can adopt an electric driving device to realize automatic assembly, and the assembly efficiency of the automatic injector is further improved.

title_en: Traction mechanism of pipeline production equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a traction mechanism of pipeline production equipment, which relates to the field of machining equipment and comprises a frame, wherein a protective cover is movably arranged on the frame, an output double-shaft speed reducer is fixedly arranged on the frame, two output ends of the output double-shaft speed reducer are fixedly provided with transmission structures, sliding plates are fixedly arranged on the two transmission structures, the two sliding plates are slidably arranged on the top side of the frame, and traction clamping structures are slidably arranged on the top sides of the two sliding plates. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the structures such as the air cylinder, the linkage slide block, the holding clamp and the like, the guide rail is arranged on the frame, the output double-shaft speed reducer is started to operate to drive the swinging rod, the relative movement of the traction clamping structure on the frame is realized, the production and processing of the pipe wire can be completed, the sizing die is arranged in front of the guiding clamp, the reducing and forming of the pipe wire can be completed while the traction is carried out, the production purpose is realized, the structure is simple, the production and the maintenance are easy, and the high mechanical automation is realized.

title_en: Novel steel plate uncoiler
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of steel plate uncoilers and discloses a novel steel plate uncoiler which comprises a base, wherein two sides of the top of the base are fixedly connected with a first supporting plate by one end, one side of the first supporting plate is fixedly connected with a first motor by a first fixing plate by the lower end, the output end of the first motor is fixedly connected with a first rotating shaft, the middle parts of one side of the two first supporting plates are fixedly connected with a second fixing plate by an angle code, the tops of the two second fixing plates are fixedly connected with synchronous motors, the output ends of the two synchronous motors are fixedly connected with a second rotating shaft, the tops of the two second rotating shafts are rotatably connected with threaded rods, and the outer parts of the two threaded rods are sleeved with compression bars by threads. According to the utility model, a certain pressing force is carried out on the steel plate during uncoiling through the pressing rod, so that the coiling force of the uncoiler can be improved, the steel plate is prevented from being loose, and the working quality of the uncoiler is improved.

title_en: Polishing equipment of carbide scraper
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of cutter polishing, in particular to polishing equipment for a hard alloy scraper, which aims at the problems that in the prior art, when the hard alloy scraper is actually used, a scraper with better toughness cannot be fixed for polishing, so that the application range is limited and the hard alloy scraper is inconvenient to use.

title_en: Punching core clamping mould of punching machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a punching sandwich die of a punching machine, which comprises a base, wherein guide rods are arranged at four corners of the upper surface of the base, an upper plate is arranged between the upper ends of the guide rods, a lower die is arranged on the base, a hydraulic rod is arranged in the middle of the lower surface of the upper plate, a lifting plate is arranged below the hydraulic rod, four corners of the lifting plate are respectively in sliding connection with the guide rods, an upper die is arranged below the lifting plate, a blowing die mechanism is arranged in the upper die, a plurality of punching rods are arranged below the upper die, a demoulding mechanism is arranged at four corners of the lower die, a plurality of punching holes are arranged in the lower die and are positioned between the demoulding mechanisms, a plurality of blanking holes communicated with the punching holes are arranged in the lower die, a cavity is arranged in the base, a drawer is arranged in the cavity in a sliding manner, and the blanking holes are all communicated with the cavity, and an agitating mechanism is arranged above the drawer. The punching efficiency is improved, and the waste materials are conveniently demoulded and cleaned.

title_en: Mould structure with product contour without steps
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mould structure with a product contour without steps, which is provided with a protective cover, wherein a driving rod movably penetrates through the interior of the protective cover, and a punching head is fixedly connected to the bottom of the driving rod; comprising the following steps: the piston plate is fixedly sleeved at the upper end of the driving rod, a fixed cylinder is sleeved at the outer side of the piston plate, and a first air pipe and a second air pipe are respectively fixed at two sides of the fixed cylinder; the fixed disk is fixed in the inner wall of protection casing, the inside of fixed disk is fixed with the division board, the one end of loose axle is fixed with the fixed plate, the below meshing of gear has the tooth piece, the activity of loose disk sets up the inside of protection casing. This mould structure of product profile no step after punching a hole once can clear up the metal piece and the impurity of punching a hole head surface adhesion, prevents that the residual of impurity from influencing the punching a hole of follow-up product, and then guarantees the smoothness of hole inner wall after punching a hole, realizes the no step of product profile.

title_en: Vortex ware car adds clamping apparatus
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a turning clamp for a vortex device, which comprises the following components: the bottom surface of the base is fixedly provided with a clamping column; the central shaft is fixedly arranged on the top surface of the base, the central shaft is coaxial with the clamping column, and the top end of the central shaft is provided with a positioning head; the compression fixing assembly is arranged on the periphery of the top end of the central shaft; the sliding sleeve is sleeved on the central shaft in a sliding way and positioned below the compression fixing assembly, and is used for extruding the bottom of the compression fixing assembly to expand so as to shrink the top of the compression fixing assembly and compress and fix the vortex device; the adjustable support assembly is arranged between the base and the sliding sleeve and is positioned on the periphery of the central shaft. The fixture disclosed by the utility model is simple in structure, convenient and fast to install, accurate in positioning, stable in fixation, free from deformation of the vortex device and capable of ensuring the processing quality of parts.

title_en: Long-shaft pump transmission shaft dismounting and mounting device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a long shaft pump transmission shaft dismounting and mounting device, which comprises a two-open type clamping copper sleeve, and a female bracket and a male bracket which are arranged outside the clamping copper sleeve; the double-sided axial symmetry structure of clamp copper sheathing for two semi-circular opposite installations, female support and public support also be semi-circular structure, the one end of female support sets up the mounting groove, the one end of public support sets up the installation piece that can with the mounting groove looks adaptation, this end of female support and public support articulates as an organic wholely with the round pin axle that wears its mounting groove and mounting piece on the round pin axle hole altogether, the installation position of female support and public support inner edge with the circumference mounting groove on the clamp copper sheathing is inlayed and is installed and fixed with fixing bolt, the other end of both is fixed with clamping bolt. The advantages are that: the pump shaft can be detached and installed under the condition that the pump shaft is not damaged, so that the service life of the transmission shaft is prolonged, the labor intensity is reduced, the safety coefficient is improved, and the labor cost is saved.

title_en: Large tonnage large caliber full automatic bulging equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to large-tonnage large-caliber full-automatic bulging equipment, which comprises a first pit and a second pit which are arranged at intervals, wherein a bulging host is fixedly arranged in the first pit, a die holder platform assembly is arranged on the bulging host, a bulging die is arranged on the die holder platform assembly in a matched manner, and an annular workpiece is sleeved outside the bulging die; the second pit is internally and fixedly provided with a hydraulic system, the hydraulic system is connected with the bulging main machine through an oil pipe, and the hydraulic system further comprises an external electric control system, and an operation table is arranged on the electric control system; under the condition of meeting the bulging quality, the automatic control can be realized, the production efficiency is improved, the production capacity range is improved, and the bulging process is stable and reliable.

title_en: Sweeps clearance mechanism and drilling equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a sweeps clearance mechanism and drilling equipment belongs to drilling equipment technical field. The debris cleaning mechanism includes a collection assembly and a blowing assembly. The collecting assembly comprises a workbench and a lifting pocket, wherein the lifting pocket is arranged at one end of the workbench, a chip discharge port is formed in a position, corresponding to the lifting pocket, on the workbench, the blowing and wiping assembly comprises a base, an upright post and an air pipe, the base is fixedly connected with the other end of the workbench, a plurality of slots matched with the upright post are formed in the base, the air pipe is movably inserted into the upright post, and nozzles which are obliquely arranged are uniformly distributed on the air pipe. The utility model provides a through stand and tracheal grafting mode can be convenient adjust jet nozzle jet position, angle and height, adapt to different drilling positions and height, utilize the lift pocket that can height-adjusting to collect the sweeps that will blow and guide the chip discharge mouth department to workstation one end, avoid the workstation sweeps accumulation too much, influence normal drilling.

title_en: Workpiece overturning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a workpiece overturning device, which comprises a base, wherein a workbench is arranged on the base, a pneumatic expansion sleeve clamp is arranged on the workbench, and an overturning mechanism which is arranged on the base and used for overturning a workpiece is also arranged on the base, the overturning mechanism comprises a mounting plate fixedly connected on the base, a U-shaped plate is connected onto the mounting plate in a sliding manner, an operation plate is arranged on the U-shaped plate through a moving mechanism, and one side, close to the pneumatic expansion sleeve clamp, of the operation plate is rotatably connected with a rotating shaft. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the turnover mechanism, the workpiece is clamped under the driving action of the first driving mechanism, the workpiece is moved to a safe distance under the driving action of the second driving mechanism, and the workpiece is turned over under the action of the first motor, so that the turnover operation is not required to be performed manually, the labor intensity of operators is reduced, and the processing efficiency of the workpiece is improved.

title_en: Mechanical part machining clamping table
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of machining of mechanical parts, in particular to a clamping table for machining of mechanical parts, which comprises a lifting table, a base and an operating table; the lifting table is arranged above the base; the operating platform is arranged above the lifting platform, the lifting platform is provided with a rotating seat, and the lifting platform is provided with a power component A for driving the rotating seat to horizontally rotate; the bottom end of the operating table is fixedly connected with a rotating seat, the rotating seat is rotationally connected with the rotating seat through a mounting shaft, and a power assembly B for driving the mounting shaft to rotate is arranged on the lifting table; the upper end of the base is provided with a control button A, a control button B, a control button C and a control button D. According to the utility model, the horizontal rotation of the rotating seat and the up-and-down rotation of the operating table can be controlled in a stepping manner, so that the processing angle of a workpiece can be conveniently adjusted, two hands are liberated, and the working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Vehicle balance bar transfer device
