abstract_en: The embodiment of the utility model discloses a vehicle balance bar transfer device, which comprises: the device comprises a base, a power mechanism, a lifting mechanism, a rotating mechanism and a loading mechanism; the power mechanism is arranged on the base, the power mechanism drives the lifting mechanism, the rotating mechanism is rotationally connected with the lifting mechanism, the loading mechanism is fixedly connected with the rotating mechanism, and the loading mechanism is used for loading the balance rod. The vehicle balance bar transfer device composed of the base, the power mechanism, the lifting mechanism, the rotating mechanism and the loading mechanism is simple in operation, and the balance bar and the hydraulic machine tool are matched with each other.

title_en: Full-automatic cutting machine with multi-angle combination
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a full-automatic cutting machine with multi-angle combination, which comprises a frame, a first supporting plate movably arranged on the frame, a horizontal transfer module for driving the first supporting plate to move between a feeding station and a processing station, a rotary supporting platform rotatably arranged on the first supporting plate, a first motor fixed on the first supporting plate and driving the rotary supporting platform to rotate, a mounting bracket fixed on the first supporting plate, a product pressing mechanism fixed on the mounting bracket and positioned above the rotary supporting platform, a saw blade cutting module fixed on the frame and a waste guide groove for receiving cutting waste. The utility model can realize automatic fixing and multi-angle rotation of the product, realize multi-angle combined multi-face cutting processing, and greatly improve multi-face cutting processing efficiency.

title_en: Electric rotating structure
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of forging and discloses an electric rotating structure, aiming at the problems of the prior art, the utility model provides a scheme which comprises a counterweight base, wherein a mounting bracket is welded on the outer wall of the top of the counterweight base, a limiting hole is formed in the outer wall of the top of the mounting bracket, a limiting bracket is inserted in the inner wall of the limiting hole in a sliding manner, a worm is rotatably arranged at the bottom of the limiting bracket through a bearing, a lower anvil is welded on the outer wall of the bottom of the worm, a forging table is fixed on the outer wall of one side of the mounting bracket, a trapezoid groove is formed in the center of the bottom of the forging table, and two rectangular through grooves are formed in the outer wall of the top of the forging table. According to the utility model, in the process of forging the workpiece, the supporting roller is jacked up by utilizing the expansion of the expansion cylinder, so that the workpiece is supported, and the workpiece is pulled at the moment to convert sliding friction into rolling friction, so that the physical strength can be greatly saved, and the direction can be more conveniently adjusted.

title_en: Chip removal device for drilling of transmission shaft
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a chip removing device for drilling and processing a transmission shaft, which belongs to the technical field of chip removing and comprises a chip removing machine, wherein a chip inlet funnel is arranged at the top end of the chip removing machine, the bottom end of the chip inlet funnel extends to the inside of the chip removing machine, a first electric box is arranged at one side of the chip removing machine, a first motor is arranged in the first electric box, a screening component is arranged at the output end of the first motor, a filtering hole at the bottom of the screening box can drop smaller scrap iron onto a conveyor belt, larger scrap iron falls into a toothed drum from the outlet of the screening box through a pushing rod for screening, guide plates are welded around the top of a supporting frame and are in a horn shape, the scrap iron is prevented from falling into other places, the chip removing device has a guide effect, the scrap iron falls into the toothed drum for extrusion and is extruded into fragments, the scrap iron falls into the conveyor belt for conveying, the blocking of the outlet is avoided, one end of the conveyor belt is exposed outside the outlet, and the scrap iron is provided with a chip collecting box at the bottom of the conveyor belt, so that the scrap iron can flow into the outside and is convenient to clean.

title_en: Laser welding protection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a laser welding protection device, which relates to the technical field of welding protection and comprises a welding table, wherein a welding seat is arranged at the top of the welding table, a support column is arranged at the top of the welding seat, a support plate is arranged at one side of the support column, an illuminating lamp is arranged at the bottom of the support plate, a support rod positioned at one side of the support column is arranged at the top of the welding seat, and a collecting opening is formed in the welding seat. According to the utility model, a series of structures are arranged, the workpiece to be welded is fixedly clamped through the horizontal reciprocating movement of the two clamping discs, so that the laser welding is convenient, the workpiece is prevented from being fixed by a worker by holding pliers, spattering welding slag and molten drops can be generated at high temperature during the laser welding, the hands are easy to scald, or the conditions of being injured by the spattering occur, the workpiece is subjected to overturn welding in the process of welding the workpiece through rotating and fixing the clamping discs, the time and the labor are saved, the welding efficiency is high, the worker is protected, and the use requirement is met.

title_en: Workpiece supporting device for cutting machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a workpiece supporting device for a cutting machine, which comprises a fixed base, wherein one end of the top of the fixed base is movably provided with a first clamping device, the other end of the top of the fixed base is movably provided with a second clamping device, and tubular workpieces are detachably arranged in the first clamping device and the second clamping device. According to the scheme, the clamping blocks are arranged according to the length of the tubular workpiece to clamp the tubular workpiece, so that the supporting device can adapt to the tubular workpiece with different types, the functionality of the device is improved, and the performance of the supporting device is improved; when the shape of the tubular workpiece is curved, the movable base is moved to a proper position by rotating the first rotating disc, and then the other end of the tubular workpiece is clamped by the clamping assembly through the appearance of the tubular workpiece, so that the device is suitable for supporting and fixing the tubular workpiece with different appearances, the application range of the device is improved, the limitation of the device is reduced, and the practicability of the device is improved.

title_en: Press-fit bending die
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pressing bending die which comprises an organism, an upper pressing die, a lower pressing die, a rotating piece, a first elastic resetting piece and a driving device, wherein the upper pressing die is arranged on the organism; the machine body is provided with a workbench, and the lower pressing die is movably reset and arranged above the workbench through a reset device; the upper pressing die is arranged right above the lower pressing die, and the driving device is connected with the upper pressing die; the rotating piece is rotatably arranged on the workbench and is provided with a placing part and a contact part, the placing part is positioned on one side of the lower pressing die, and the contact part is positioned below the lower pressing die; two ends of the first elastic resetting piece respectively act on the workbench and the contact part; therefore, through the design of each part, the upper die and the lower die are pressed down to enable the lower die to contact with the contact part and link the rotating part to rotate inwards, so that the bending of the part to be bent on the placement part is realized, the consumption of equipment is reduced, the production cost of products is reduced, and the application range is wide.

title_en: Automatic four-edge skin removing device for bar Sha Mutao material
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a device for automatically removing four edges of a Ba Sha Mutao material, which belongs to the technical field of Basha wood sheath material processing and production, and comprises a processing table, wherein a fixed frame is arranged at the upper end of the processing table, scrapers are arranged on the inner side walls of the fixed frame, a placing block is connected to the upper end of the processing table and positioned at one side of the fixed frame, a vertical plate is connected to the upper end of the processing table, a transverse plate is connected to the side wall of the vertical plate, which is close to one side of the fixed frame, a movable plate is slidably arranged at the lower end of the transverse plate, a movable assembly for horizontally and transversely moving the movable plate is arranged on the transverse plate, a placing groove is formed in the side wall of the movable plate, which is close to one side of the fixed frame, and the placing groove is aligned with the placing block; according to the utility model, the wood is automatically peeled by arranging the structures of the processing table, the fixed frame, the scraper, the placing block, the vertical plate, the transverse plate, the moving plate, the placing groove, the mounting plate, the motor, the screw rod, the guide rod and the like, so that the labor force is reduced, the time is saved, and the working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Numerical control hydraulic plate bending machine convenient for adjusting bending angle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of bending machines, in particular to a numerical control hydraulic plate bending machine convenient for adjusting bending angles, which comprises a bending machine main body, a threaded rod and an elastic piece, wherein a bearing block is arranged above the threaded rod, a control block is arranged above the bearing block, a connecting column is arranged on one side, close to the bending machine main body, of the control block, a control rod is arranged above the connecting column, one end, far away from the connecting column, of the control rod is provided with the control column, the threaded rod and the control column are arranged, the threaded rod drives the control block to move up and down, the control rod is driven by the control rod to move up and down, the control column connected with the control rod slides along an arc groove in a bearing block under the driving of the control rod, the distance between the control column changes, the control column drives a first die and a second die to rotate around a rotating shaft at the same time, and the angle of an included angle formed between the first die and the second die can be adjusted, so that a worker can adjust the bending angle of a plate in a certain range.

title_en: Feeding device for machining center
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of machining feeding devices, and discloses a feeding device for a machining center, which comprises: the automatic feeding device comprises an X-axis linear motor, a Y-axis linear motor and a double-head clamping cylinder, wherein the Y-axis linear motor is arranged at the top of the X-axis linear motor, a guide pillar is arranged at the top of the Y-axis linear motor, a lifting guide sleeve is arranged at the outer side of the guide pillar, a lifting arm is arranged on one side of the outer wall of the lifting guide sleeve, a rotating arm is arranged on one side of the lifting arm, the double-head clamping cylinder is arranged at two ends of the rotating arm, and the rotating arm is driven by a servo motor to rotate 180 degrees, so that the top-blank double-head clamping cylinder moves to the lower part, a workpiece on a chuck is taken down through the double-head clamping cylinder at the bottom, and then the workpiece to be processed is placed on the chuck through the rotation of the rotating arm in cooperation with the triaxial movement, so that the workpiece is fed, the whole feeding process is not required to be fed manually, and the feeding efficiency is high while the feeding is more accurate.

title_en: Rotating shaft grinding device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rotating shaft grinding device, and relates to the technical field of rotating shaft grinding. This pivot grinding device, including unable adjustment base, clamping assembly and adjusting part, unable adjustment base's top fixed mounting has first fixed riser and the fixed riser of second, and clamping assembly locates on the unable adjustment base, clamping assembly includes driving motor and grip block, and the quantity of grip block is two sets of, is equipped with the centre gripping space between two sets of grip blocks. This pivot grinding device can avoid effectively producing the condition that the removal activity rocked when the pivot was processed, and then increased the accuracy of pivot after processing, improves the quality of processing, can also carry out abrasive machining's in-process in the pivot, highly adjust grinding motor, and then can make grinding motor rotate out the circular of different sizes at the during operation through rotating the axis of rotation, can grind the pivot of different thickness like this, increase the practicality of device when using.

title_en: Full-automatic chamfer of graduated disk formula and drilling all-in-one
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of standard component cylinder drilling equipment, and particularly discloses an index plate type full-automatic chamfering and drilling integrated machine which comprises a feeding mechanism and a chamfering and drilling mechanism, wherein the feeding mechanism comprises a hopper, a slideway and a pushing cylinder, the rear part of a feeding clamping groove is provided with the slideway, and a workpiece in the hopper slides into the slideway through the feeding clamping groove; the chamfering drilling mechanism is provided with a frame, a first chamfering power head, a second chamfering power head, a drilling power head and an indexing turntable, the pneumatic motor is vertically arranged in the middle of the workbench, and four equally divided positioning grooves are formed in the peripheries of the indexing turntable, the rotary die, the workpiece positioning lower plate and the workpiece positioning upper plate; according to the utility model, the drilling and chamfering of the pin shaft and the bolt are synchronously finished in one-time clamping, and meanwhile, the feeding, chamfering, drilling and discharging of a plurality of workpieces are finished step by step, so that the full-automatic work is realized, the labor intensity is reduced, and the working efficiency is improved; positioning the chamfering drill bit and the drilling drill bit, and ensuring higher chamfering and drilling precision.

title_en: Solar aluminum frame punching device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a solar aluminum frame punching device which comprises a supporting table, wherein a punching assembly is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the supporting table, two sliding grooves are symmetrically formed in one side, opposite to the punching assembly, of the upper end of the supporting table, a containing cavity is formed below the sliding grooves, rack plates are arranged in the containing cavity, clamp assemblies are connected in the sliding grooves in a sliding mode, a driving assembly capable of driving the clamp assemblies to move is arranged between the two clamp assemblies at the upper end of the supporting table, and a hole groove is formed in the middle of the upper end of the supporting table. According to the utility model, the rotary rod and the gear which are arranged on the supporting table and drive the lower end of the rotary table are used for rotating, the gear and the rack plate are meshed with each other to drive the fixture assembly fixedly connected with the rack plate to move left and right on the supporting table, so that a plurality of punching operations are carried out on the clamped frame, the punching efficiency is improved, and more time and labor are saved.

title_en: Pin puller equipment for quickly replacing hydraulic support
abstract_en: The utility model discloses pin puller equipment for quickly replacing a hydraulic support, which belongs to the technical field of disassembling tools and particularly relates to pin puller equipment for quickly replacing a hydraulic support. According to the utility model, after the ejector rod is arranged on the outer side of the pin puller main body, the electric telescopic rod radial pushing ring frame can be driven to drive the shaft seat to slide in the through groove, so that the ejector rod can be driven to rotate to jack up the upper end of the pin puller main body, meanwhile, a reverse acting force is formed on the surface of the hydraulic support, the pin body can be directly pulled out, the operation is simple, the pulling operation can be carried out without manual beating, and the practical performance is effectively improved.

title_en: Driving assembly and positioning device
abstract_en: Aiming at the problem that in the prior art, machining scraps easily enter a cylinder to cause easy blocking of a piston and a guide rod of the machining scraps, the utility model provides a driving assembly and a positioning device. The cover body is a drawer cover body structure and is arranged on the bottom plate. A cavity is formed between the cover body and the bottom plate, and the cylinder is fixed in the cavity. The starting end of the sliding block is connected with the guide rod of the air cylinder, and the tail end of the sliding block extends along the extending direction of the guide rod of the air cylinder and penetrates out of the cover body; the tail end of the sliding block is used for connecting the leaning angle. The sliding block is in sliding fit with the cover body and is sealed. Therefore, the problem that machining scraps enter the cylinder to cause clamping can be solved.

title_en: Air tightness detection device for automobile water pump shell
abstract_en: The utility model provides an automobile water pump shell airtight detection device, which relates to the technical field of water pump airtight detection, and comprises a lower box body and an upper box body, wherein the upper box body is fixedly arranged at the top of the lower box body, a booster pump and a top thrust motor are fixedly arranged on the lower surface of the inner part of the upper box body, a fixed seat and a bottom thrust motor are fixedly arranged on the lower surface of the inner part of the lower box body, a water pump shell is arranged on the fixed seat, and a plurality of positioning hole fixing devices for fixing the water pump shell are uniformly distributed on the lower surface of the inner part of the lower box body.

title_en: Color socket wrench for distinguishing specification by utilizing colors
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of mechanical assembly tools, and particularly relates to a color socket head wrench utilizing colors to distinguish specifications, which comprises a wrench head, a handle assembly used for increasing torque and comfort of hands, a connector assembly used for connecting the handle assembly and the wrench head, and a detection assembly used for completing specification distinguishing of the socket head wrench.

title_en: Polishing device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a polishing device. The polishing device comprises a workbench, polishing equipment bodies are arranged on the workbench, three fan-shaped leakage holes are formed in the workbench, a cover body is arranged on the workbench, a frame body is fixedly arranged on the workbench, a U-shaped block is fixedly arranged at the top of the frame body, a rotating shaft is rotatably arranged on the U-shaped block, a motor I is arranged on one side of the U-shaped block, an output shaft of the motor I is fixedly connected with one end of the rotating shaft, a wire wheel is fixedly sleeved on the rotating shaft, a traction wire is fixedly arranged on the wire wheel, the bottom end of the traction wire is fixedly connected with the top end of the cover body, a water storage tank is arranged at the bottom of the workbench, and an air pump is fixedly arranged at the top of the frame body. The polishing device provided by the utility model has the advantages of limiting outward scattering of the scraps, reducing the influence of the scraps on the environment and better collecting the scraps.

title_en: Sheet metal device for producing wallboard
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of decoration, in particular to a sheet metal device for producing wallboard, which comprises a bottom plate; the cleaning device comprises a first servo motor, a first bevel gear and a first bevel gear are fixed at two ends of the rotating shaft, a brush roller and a cleaning roller are rotatably installed at the top side of the bottom plate, the brush roller and the cleaning roller are fixed at the top side of the bottom plate respectively, a pinion and a large gear are meshed with the two bevel gears respectively, the second servo motor is opened, the first bevel gear and the second bevel gear are driven to rotate through the rotating shaft, so that the brush roller and the cleaning roller rotate through the pinion and the large gear, dirt on the surface of a wallboard is removed, and the problem of uneven breakage and fracture of stress due to other impurities is solved when the wallboard is stamped.

title_en: Rotary cutting cone cutter head for push bench
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rotary cutting cone cutter head for a pipe pushing machine, which comprises a connecting column, wherein the front end of the connecting column is fixedly connected with a threaded disc, and the middle position of the front end of the threaded disc is fixedly connected with a rotating disc. According to the pipe pushing machine, the connecting column drives the second fixed ring to rotate through the threaded ring, the reinforcing rib drives the first fixed ring to rotate along with the rotation of the second fixed ring, and the first fixed disc drives the threaded ring to rotate along with the rotation of the first fixed ring, so that when the cutter on the cutter disc rotates to cut a front obstacle, the alloy fiber head on the reinforcing rib also rotates along with the reinforcing rib, the cutting efficiency of the cutter disc on the front obstacle is improved, the connection degree between the reinforcing ribs can be improved through the reinforcing ribs, damping is prevented from occurring in the cutting process, the reinforcing rib is stretched, the cutting efficiency of the cutter disc is improved, and the service life of the cutter disc is greatly prolonged.

title_en: Optical lens milling and grinding machine with overturning assembly
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an optical lens milling and grinding machine with a turnover assembly, which belongs to the technical field of optical lens processing and comprises a working box and a groove type inclined plane, wherein the groove type inclined plane is embedded in the working box, a fixing mechanism which is convenient for fixing an optical lens and a grinding mechanism which is convenient for grinding the optical lens are respectively arranged in the working box, a mounting plate is fixedly arranged above the groove type inclined plane above the working box, and an electric slide rail A is fixedly arranged on one side above the mounting plate. The structure can be used for fixing the optical lens in the use process, and the optical lens is fixed in a three-dimensional manner in the fixing process, so that the milling and grinding machine is more convenient in milling and grinding the optical lens, meanwhile, the structure can be used for directly overturning the optical lens, further, the situation that the optical lens is taken down and the other surface is milled and ground is avoided, and the quality of the device in the use process is improved.

title_en: Rolling channel special for round steel production in steel mill
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of steel rolling equipment, and particularly relates to a special rolling channel for round steel production in a steel mill. The device comprises a guide groove, an observation window is hinged above the guide groove, a support is welded at the bottom of the guide groove, shaft plates are welded at two sides of one end of the guide groove, a wheel shaft is connected to the shaft plates in a penetrating mode, and a supporting wheel is sleeved on the wheel shaft. According to the utility model, the split rolling channel in the prior art is changed into the integral rolling channel, the split rolling channel is not required to be respectively installed and then subjected to multiple adjustment and positioning during replacement and overhaul operations, the operation efficiency is improved, steel is not in contact with the inner wall of the guide groove completely during use, the surface scratch of the steel is prevented, the height of the riding wheel can be adjusted, the whole rolling channel is smoother during operation, the stability of the riding wheel is improved, the service life is prolonged, an observation hole is formed above the guide groove, the operation condition of the rolling channel can be observed through the observation hole, and workers can conveniently and timely know the operation condition of the rolling channel.

title_en: Manual device for quickly and conveniently replacing engineering tool
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a manual device for quickly and conveniently replacing engineering cutters, which comprises a heavy hammer, a connecting rod and the engineering cutters, wherein the movable heavy hammer is sleeved on the connecting rod, a stop block A is arranged at the right end of the connecting rod, a replaceable device is arranged at the left end of the connecting rod, a pin is arranged in a middle hole of the engineering cutters in a penetrating way, and the engineering cutters are arranged on the replaceable device in a penetrating way through the pin. The utility model improves the working efficiency, reduces the workload and the labor intensity of workers, and relatively avoids the industrial accidents caused by knocking tools such as hammerheads and the like; the arrangement of the annular boss prevents the pin from sliding off in the middle hole of the head of the mining cutter.

title_en: Plate cutting mechanism and cutting machine
abstract_en: The utility model provides a plate cutting mechanism, which belongs to the technical field of cutting machines, and comprises a separating and cutting frame which can reciprocate on a cross beam through an adjusting component and can be fixed at any position of the cross beam, wherein the separating and cutting frame comprises a first L-shaped plate which is in an inverted L shape, the first L-shaped plate comprises a transverse plate and a vertical plate, a second L-shaped plate which is in an inverted L shape and can approach or separate from the transverse plate is arranged below the transverse plate, a separating plate for separating a picture with yellow base paper from a plate is arranged on the side surface of the second L-shaped plate, and the position of the separating and cutting frame can be accurately moved through the adjusting component, so that the plate can be accurately cut; the position of the second L-shaped plate can be adjusted by arranging the first adjusting bolt, the second adjusting bolt and the runway groove, and then the position adjustment of the separating plate and the cutting knife is realized, so that different plates can be cut conveniently.

title_en: Necking device for bushing processing
abstract_en: The application discloses necking device is used in bush processing, it belongs to the bush processing field. A necking device for bushing processing, comprising: a base; the hydraulic cylinder is fixedly connected with the base; the driving block is fixedly connected with a driving shaft of the hydraulic cylinder; the guide disc is fixedly connected with the base; the first sliding block is radially and slidably connected with the guide disc; the two ends of the first spring are fixedly connected with the first sliding block and the guide disc respectively; the necking block is abutted with the first sliding block; the second sliding block is horizontally and slidably connected with the first sliding block; the two ends of the second spring are fixedly connected with the first sliding block and the second sliding block respectively; the fastening block is fixedly connected with the second sliding block; the first rotating shaft is rotationally connected with the first sliding block; the screw is fixedly connected with the first rotating shaft; the cam is fixedly sleeved on the first rotating shaft; the driving disc is arranged at the lower end of the screw rod and is fixedly connected with the screw rod. The beneficial effects of this application lie in providing a low-cost bush processing and use necking down device.

title_en: Automobile part side impact positioning device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a side punching positioning device for automobile parts, which belongs to the technical field of dies and comprises a male die, a sliding rail, a sliding table, a slotting tool and a punching needle: the slide rail is provided with a plurality of slide rails which encircle the outer side of the male die; the sliding tables are provided with a plurality of sliding tables which are correspondingly matched with the sliding rails in a sliding way; the punching needles are provided with a plurality of groups, and the groups of punching needles are correspondingly arranged on the sliding tables; the slotting tool is equipped with a plurality of, all sets up on every slip table and has gone up sliding fit's activity hole site about with the slotting tool, wherein: an A structure for driving the punch pin to translate towards the workpiece is arranged between the slotting tool and the movable hole site, and then the workpiece is abutted to realize positioning; and a B structure for driving the punch pin to move away from the workpiece in a translational manner is further arranged between the slotting tool and the movable hole site, so that positioning and separation are realized. According to the utility model, the punching needle is quickly abutted against the workpiece through the structure A, so that the positioning is realized, and the positioning effect is good; the utility model rapidly separates the punching needle from the workpiece through the structure B, thereby realizing rapid positioning and separation.

title_en: Battery cell welding equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides a battery cell welding device, which comprises a feeding device, a dust removing device, a bending and pre-pressing device, a press-fitting device and a detection device, wherein the feeding device, the dust removing device, the bending and pre-pressing device, the press-fitting device and the detection device are sequentially arranged at intervals along the conveying direction of a battery cell; the bending and prepressing device is used for bending the electrode lugs of the electric core after dust removal and prepressing the top cover of the electric core after bending into the shell of the electric core; the press-fitting device is used for carrying out positioning and pressing treatment on the pre-pressed battery cell; the welding device is used for carrying out welding treatment on the positioned and compressed battery cells; the detection device is used for carrying out appearance detection on the welded battery cell. The battery cell welding equipment has good arrangement rationality, high integration level, small occupied area, high operation efficiency and good use effect.

title_en: Assembly profiling clamp suitable for multiple environments
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of numerical control machining, and particularly relates to an assembly profiling clamp suitable for multiple environments, which comprises a frame, wherein a universal wheel is fixedly arranged on one side of the lower part of the frame, a locking pedal is fixedly arranged on one side of the universal wheel, an inclined strut is fixedly arranged on one side of the frame, a fixed shaft is fixedly arranged on the other side surface of the frame, a pin hole is formed in the surface of the fixed shaft, a bearing sleeve is sleeved on the surface of the fixed shaft, a first fixed sleeve is sleeved on the outer surface of the bearing sleeve, a first electric telescopic rod is fixedly arranged on one side of the first fixed sleeve, a second fixed sleeve is fixedly connected on one side of the first electric telescopic rod, a fixed plate is fixedly arranged above one side of the frame, a hydraulic mechanism is fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the fixed plate, a hydraulic rod is fixedly connected on the lower part of the fixed plate, and a first clamping plate is fixedly arranged below the hydraulic rod. The utility model can effectively prevent foolproof and ensure the dimensional positioning precision by carrying out precise profiling according to the internal shape of the product.

title_en: Grabbing device and equipment of polishing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a grabbing device and polishing equipment, and relates to the technical field of locomotive maintenance. The grabbing device comprises a robot, a clamping assembly, a control assembly and a positioning piece; the robot includes a robot arm having multiple degrees of freedom; the clamping component is arranged on the mechanical arm; the control assembly is in communication connection with the robot so that the mechanical arm can drive the clamping assembly to move according to a preset path; the positioning piece is used for placing the contact finger; and the positioning piece is provided with a positioning structure matched with the contact finger so that the clamping component clamps the contact finger. The technical scheme that this application disclosed can be current touch to indicate at the in-process of polishing, treat the touch to indicate and pile up at will on the table or on the ground, be difficult for unified management, and transfer to grinding device after picking up by manual work, the problem of wasting time and energy.

title_en: Laser marking machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a laser marking machine which comprises an operation table, wherein an accommodating groove is formed in the upper end of the operation table, a conveyor belt is connected in the accommodating groove in a rotating mode through a rotating shaft, a lifting column is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the operation table, a scale staff is arranged at the front end of the lifting column, an adjusting knob is arranged at the upper end of the lifting column, a sliding seat is connected to the side face of the lifting column in a sliding mode, a marking assembly is arranged on the sliding seat, a clamping assembly is arranged at the upper end of the operation table, and two groups of clamping assemblies are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the conveyor belt respectively. According to the laser marking device, the motor is arranged on the sliding seat to drive the gear to rotate, so that the toothed plate fixedly connected with the laser marking head is driven to move back and forth, the moving range of the laser marking head is larger, and the laser marking efficiency is higher; and set up the clamping assembly on the operation panel, be equipped with infrared controller and detect accurate to beat the mark product and carry out the centre gripping fixedly to beating the mark product, guarantee to beat the mark product and be difficult to the skew when beating the mark, beat the mark more accurate.

title_en: High-speed servo numerical control machine tool
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of numerically-controlled machine tools, in particular to a high-speed servo numerically-controlled machine tool, which comprises a base and a machine shell arranged above the base, wherein a clamp and a limiting seat are respectively arranged at the left end and the right end of the interior of the machine shell, the front end of the interior of the machine shell is connected with a sliding rail, the exterior of the sliding rail is connected with a movable frame in a sliding manner, a mounting plate is connected on the movable frame, a tool rest capable of moving back and forth is arranged above the mounting plate, a plurality of tools are arranged on the tool rest, a shielding member is arranged at the upper end of the interior of the machine shell and used for shielding the tool rest and the tools, a control box is arranged at the front end of the exterior of the machine shell and can move up and down, an electric push rod III with a power output end connected with the right end of the movable frame is arranged on the right surface of the inner wall of the machine shell, and a fixed contact sheet I is arranged below the inner wall of the machine shell; the utility model better shields the cutter and avoids the contact injury of a user with the cutter when the user enters the machine shell to take out the workpiece.

title_en: Aluminum veneer angle of attack device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of angle attack devices and provides an aluminum veneer angle attack device which comprises a base, wherein a hydraulic cylinder is fixedly connected to the top of the base, an angle attack plate is fixedly connected to the output end of the hydraulic cylinder, an electric cylinder is fixedly connected to the top of the right side of the base, a base plate is fixedly connected to the output end of the electric cylinder, a discharge opening is formed in the left side of the bottom of the base, a fixing box is fixedly connected to the left side of the base, and a worm is movably connected to the left side of the fixing box through a bearing. According to the utility model, the worm and the worm gear rod drive the positioning plate to move rightwards through the L-shaped rod and the square sleeve, the positioning plate positions the aluminum veneer through the scale plate and the base, and finally the hydraulic cylinder drives the punching angle plate to perform the punching angle treatment on the aluminum veneer, so that the advantage of convenience in punching angle is achieved, a user can conveniently put the aluminum veneer to a designated position, the excessive or insufficient punching angle size is not easy to occur, and the quality of a finished product of the aluminum veneer is improved.

title_en: Metal stamping forming die
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a metal stamping forming die, which belongs to the technical field of stamping dies and comprises an upper die holder, a lower die holder and a guide rod, wherein a cooperative mechanism is arranged in the lower die holder, and a stamping discharge mechanism is arranged in the lower die holder; the cooperative mechanism comprises a vertical groove, a first spring, an upright post and an upper positioning piece, wherein when the first spring is deformed, the upright post and the upper positioning piece synchronously move in the vertical direction; the supporting spring is extruded when the workpiece is stamped, so that after stamping is finished, the upright post can be lifted up by utilizing the resilience force of the supporting spring, the original workpiece and the stamping separating piece are separated conveniently, and the workpiece can be stably and fixedly pressed on the surface of the feeding groove when the limiting piece is pressed down, so that the workpiece can be kept in a stable state in the stamping process, and stamping work is facilitated.

title_en: Positioning device for machining circular lamp shell
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a positioning device for processing a round lamp shell, which comprises a base and the round lamp shell, wherein a positioning groove is formed in the round lamp shell, the positioning device comprises a limiting component and a positioning component, the limiting component comprises a rotary table, a pressing plate and a connecting rod, the rotary table is rotatably arranged in the middle of the inside of the base, the rotary table is hinged with the pressing plate through the connecting rod, the positioning component comprises a positioning column, a screw rod and a rotating handle, the screw rod is rotatably arranged in the base, and the bottom of the positioning column is in threaded connection with the screw rod. The utility model has the advantages of stable positioning and strong practicability.

title_en: Double-seat high-speed die cutting machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a double-seat high-speed die-cutting machine which comprises a machine case, four first telescopic rods arranged on one side of the top of the machine case, four second telescopic rods arranged on the other side of the top of the machine case, a first die-cutting seat arranged on the top of the first telescopic rods, a second die-cutting seat arranged on the top of the second telescopic rods and a cleaning component for processing waste materials, wherein the cleaning component comprises a collecting box arranged on one side of the machine case, a dust suction pipe arranged on the top of the collecting box, a dust suction hood connected with the dust suction pipe and an exhaust pipe arranged at the bottom of the collecting box.

title_en: Reticulate pattern cutter
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a reticulate pattern cutter, which relates to the technical field of reticulate pattern cutting devices and comprises a cutter body, wherein one end of the cutter body is a processing end, and the other end of the cutter body is a fixed end; a plurality of tool rest grooves are formed in one surface of the processing end, a fixed included angle exists between the setting direction of the tool rest grooves and the feeding direction of a workpiece to be processed, and a tool body is fixed in each tool rest groove; the tool apron groove is also connected with a fixing device and an adjusting device, the fixing device is used for fixing the tool body, and the adjusting device is used for adjusting the position of the tool body. According to the utility model, a plurality of cutter bodies can be simultaneously installed, so that the machining efficiency can be effectively improved, the cutter seat groove is provided with a fixed included angle, and when the cutter body is replaced by a new cutter body, the angle of the cutter body is not required to be adjusted, and the cutter can be immediately used.

title_en: Large microgravity experimental tower assembly fixture
abstract_en: The utility model provides an assembly fixture for a large microgravity experimental tower, which comprises a base, a plurality of fixing brackets and a middle fixing disc. This assembly fixture adopts regular hexagon design, and with the accurate fixed of two-layer stand position in experimental tower inside and outside, through control frock processing and assembly accuracy, guarantee the uniformity of installation hole site, centre-to-centre spacing, levelness, ensure experimental tower stand position degree, all stands are vertical upwards, are parallel to each other between the stand, and then ensure the assembly accuracy of middle web member between the stand. The tool can effectively reduce the assembly difficulty and improve the assembly precision and the assembly efficiency.

title_en: Stamping die for hardware fitting
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a stamping die for hardware fittings, which comprises a base, wherein a lower die holder is fixedly arranged in the middle of the top end of the base, a forming groove is formed in the middle of the top end of the lower die holder, a mounting groove is formed in the bottom of the inner side of the forming groove, telescopic rods are fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the inner side of the mounting groove, a top plate is fixedly arranged at the top part between a plurality of telescopic rods, and telescopic springs are sleeved on the surfaces of the plurality of telescopic rods.

title_en: Pigskin deoiling equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to pig skin degreasing equipment, which relates to the technical field of degreasing equipment and comprises a supporting table, a conveying device arranged on the supporting table and used for conveying pig skin, and a cutter arranged on the supporting table and used for cutting the pig skin conveyed out by the conveying device along the horizontal direction, wherein an opening is formed in the upper end of the supporting table, the cutter is positioned in the opening, a containing box used for collecting grease layers is arranged below the opening, and a collecting box used for collecting the pig skin is arranged on one side, far away from the conveying device, of the supporting table. According to the utility model, the storage box and the collecting box are arranged, so that after the cutter cuts the pigskin and the oil layer, the pigskin and the oil layer can be directly collected separately, the pigskin can be directly dropped into the collecting box, the oil layer can be directly dropped into the storage box, the situation that the oil layer drops onto the supporting table is reduced, and the pig skin collecting device has the advantage of being convenient for collecting the oil layer cut off from the pigskin.

title_en: Efficient pre-milling cutter
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-efficiency pre-milling cutter, which belongs to the technical field of cutter processing, and is used for pre-milling a plate to be subjected to edge sealing, so that chip removal is smooth, and cutting efficiency is high; comprises a cylindrical cutter body, wherein three groups of lower cutters are uniformly arranged on the upper part of the cutter body from top to bottom, three groups of upper cutters are uniformly arranged on the lower part of the cutter body from bottom to top, each group of lower cutters or upper cutters comprises a plurality of cutting edges which are uniformly distributed along the circumferential direction of the cutter body, one side of each cutting edge is provided with a chip groove, the lower ends of the cutting edge side chip grooves of the uppermost group of upper cutting blades are communicated with the lower ends of the cutting edge side chip grooves of the lowermost group of lower cutting blades, and the upper ends of the cutting edge side chip grooves of the lowermost group of lower cutting blades are communicated with the upper ends of the cutting edge side chip grooves of the intermediate group of upper cutting blades.

title_en: Paper plastic knife
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of paper-plastic products, in particular to a paper-plastic cutter which comprises a grab handle and a cutter head, wherein the grab handle and the cutter head are integrally formed, a concave part is concavely formed on the same side of the grab handle and the cutter head, a convex part is formed on the other side of the grab handle and the cutter head, a plurality of cutting teeth are formed on one side of the cutter head, and reinforcing pieces are arranged on two sides of the lower end of the cutter head.

title_en: Manipulator suitable for metalwork welding
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a manipulator suitable for welding metal parts, which comprises a mounting plate, wherein two groups of left and right opposite mechanical clamping jaws are fixed on the lower end surface of the mounting plate, each mechanical clamping jaw comprises a rectangular base, a notch is formed in the front end surface of the base, a channel penetrating through the lower end of the base is formed in the lower bottom surface of the notch, an obliquely arranged clamping arm is inserted in the channel, a circular connector is formed in the upper end of the clamping arm, a transverse hinge shaft is inserted and connected onto the connector, the hinge shaft is inserted and fixed onto the base, a torsion spring is inserted and sleeved onto the hinge shaft, one end of the torsion spring is inserted and connected onto the connector, and the other end of the torsion spring is inserted and connected onto the base; the lower end of the clamping arm extends out of the lower end face of the base to form a socket, a clamping guide wheel is inserted in the socket of the clamping arm, a pin shaft is fixedly inserted on the clamping guide wheel in a sleeved mode, and the pin shaft is inserted in the clamping arm. The manipulator is convenient for clamping and loading circular metal pipe fittings, and can drive the metal pipe fittings to rotate after clamping the metal pipe fittings, so that the circular welding operation between the pipe fittings can be realized conveniently.

title_en: Full-automatic piston machining center
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a full-automatic piston machining center which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a transmission machine body is arranged above the bottom plate, two groups of sliding frames are arranged at the top end of the bottom plate below the transmission machine body, one side of the inside of each sliding frame is connected with a sliding block in a sliding mode, the top end of each sliding block extends to the outside of each sliding frame and is fixedly connected with the bottom end of the transmission machine body, a telescopic driving piece is arranged at the top end of the bottom plate at one side of the transmission machine body through a support, strip-shaped grooves are formed in two sides of the top of the transmission machine body, a bidirectional screw rod is rotatably connected at the central position inside the transmission machine body, and a rotating handle is arranged on the outer wall at one side of the transmission machine body. The clamping device is convenient for adjusting the position of the piston workpiece according to the requirement, further improves the convenience of the piston workpiece in the subsequent processing, reduces the phenomenon that clamping marks are caused on the outer wall of the piston workpiece by the clamping plates, further ensures the integrity of the outer wall of the piston workpiece, can select and replace the specifications of the clamping plates, and is suitable for clamping the piston workpieces with different specifications.

title_en: Thin-wall plate laser cutting device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a thin-wall plate laser cutting device which comprises a laser cutting table, wherein a supporting plate is symmetrically and fixedly connected to the bottom of the laser cutting table, a fixing plate is fixedly connected to the middle position of the inner side of the supporting plate, an air suction pump is fixedly connected to the top of the fixing plate, an air suction pipe is fixedly connected to the top of the air suction pump, a main connecting pipe is fixedly connected to the top of the air suction pipe, a plurality of taps are fixedly connected to the top of the main connecting pipe, and branch connecting pipes are fixedly connected to the top of the taps. According to the thin-wall plate laser cutting device, the air suction pump is arranged, so that air can be sucked into the air suction pipe, negative pressure is formed in the main connecting pipe and the tapping pipe, the thin-wall plate is adsorbed and fixed by the adsorption hopper, the area of the top of the plate cannot be covered, the automatic cutting of the thin-wall plate by the laser cutting head is facilitated, and the cutting effect is better.

title_en: Vertical multi-station punching tapping machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a vertical multi-station punching and tapping machine, which comprises a workbench, wherein a rotary disc capable of intermittently rotating is arranged in the middle of the top surface of the workbench, a plurality of clamps which are distributed at equal intervals in the circumferential direction are annularly arranged on the top surface of the rotary disc, workpieces can be clamped in an upright state by the top ends of the clamps, a punching station and a tapping station are arranged on the circumferential outer side of the rotary disc, at least one drill bit for punching the workpieces is arranged on the punching station, at least one tapping head for tapping the workpieces is arranged on the tapping station, and driving devices for respectively driving the drill bit and the tapping head to move along the X, Y, Z axial direction are arranged on the punching station and the tapping station. The utility model has the characteristics of automatically and synchronously punching, tapping, chamfering and loading and unloading a plurality of workpieces at the same time, processing a plurality of threaded holes at the same time, effectively improving the processing efficiency and reducing the cost.

title_en: Tool convenient for positioning and installing components in box body
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tool convenient for positioning and installing components in a box body, which comprises a fixed plate, a first measuring arm and a second measuring arm, wherein a component positioning part is arranged on the fixed plate; the fixing plate is provided with a first installation part and a second installation part, the first installation part and the second installation part are respectively connected with the component positioning part, and the first installation part and the second installation part are mutually perpendicular; the first measuring arm and the second measuring arm are respectively installed in the first installation part and the second installation part. According to the utility model, the first measuring arm and the second measuring arm are set to be of preset lengths, so that the problem that the positions of components in the box body cannot be accurately determined during installation is solved, the control of the distances between the components and the inner side surfaces of the box body and between the components and the inner surface of the rear part of the box body is facilitated, reworking conditions are reduced, and meanwhile, the installation and acceptance of the components in the box body are facilitated, and further, engineering quality is improved.

title_en: Building steel cutting device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a building steel cutting device, and belongs to the technical field of building steel cutting. The utility model relates to a building steel cutting device which comprises a mounting frame and a fixing plate, wherein the mounting frame is fixed at the top of the fixing plate, a limiting mechanism comprises a hydraulic cylinder, the hydraulic cylinder is fixed at one side of the mounting frame, a sliding block is fixedly arranged at the output end of the hydraulic cylinder, and a toothed plate is fixedly arranged at the top of the sliding block.

title_en: Heat radiation structure of electric welding machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a heat radiation structure of an electric welding machine, which comprises a protective shell, wherein a guide Wen Hengban is arranged in the protective shell, and a cavity of the protective shell is divided into an upper cavity and a lower cavity by a heat conduction transverse plate; the upper cavity is internally provided with a shell which is arranged on the temperature guide transverse plate, and the shell is internally provided with a working component which is arranged on the temperature guide transverse plate; a refrigeration component is arranged on the side of the working component in the shell on the temperature guide transverse plate, and a blower with blowing direction to the working component is arranged on the side of the refrigeration component on the shell; an air guide pipeline is connected between the upper cavity and the lower cavity, an air outlet hole communicated with the lower cavity is formed in one side of the protective shell, a secondary fan is arranged in the lower cavity, and the blowing direction of the secondary fan faces the air outlet hole. Through set up the casing in the outside of working components and parts, make the heat that working components and parts produced concentrate in the casing, rethread forced draught blower and refrigeration subassembly's cooperation simultaneously blow the heat in the casing to down in the cavity fast, and then follow venthole discharge.

title_en: Screw machine tooling dish
abstract_en: The utility model provides a screw machine processing disc, which comprises a feeding device and a washing tank, wherein one side of the feeding tank, which is close to the washing tank, is provided with a discharge port, the discharge port is fixedly connected with a feeding guide rail, the side of the feeding guide rail is provided with a linear slot, the middle part of the linear slot is transversely provided with a slide bar, the end of the slide bar is provided with a linear guide rail, the two ends of the linear guide rail are fixedly connected with a supporting rod of an outer side wall through a limiting block, the bottom of the supporting rod is provided with a motor, the bottom of the motor is fixedly connected with the side of the washing tank, one side, which is far away from the feeding device, of the washing tank is provided with a heating dryer, one side, which is far away from the washing tank, is provided with a blowing box, the surface side, which is close to the blowing box, of the heating dryer is fixedly connected with a cleaning device, and the other end of the cleaning device is fixedly connected with the edge of one side of the blowing box, the screw machine has the advantages that: can greatly improve the performance and the service life of the screw by small powder scrap iron, greasy dirt and impurities in the screw thread on the surface of the screw.

title_en: Diameter-adjusting machine with diameter-adjusting die protection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a diameter-adjusting machine with a diameter-adjusting die protecting device, which is characterized in that auxiliary mechanisms are arranged on the front side wall, the rear side wall and the lower surface of an inner cavity of a machine body, so that the distance between adjacent auxiliary structures is matched with the size of a workpiece, the phenomenon that the workpiece deviates in the feeding process can be avoided, the protection of the diameter-adjusting die is finished, the auxiliary support can be carried out on the workpiece entering the inside of the die cavity of the diameter-adjusting die through the matched installation of the protecting structure and the die cavity of the diameter-adjusting die, the workpiece is prevented from deviating in the inside of the die cavity of the diameter-adjusting die, and the die cavity of the diameter-adjusting die is worn, therefore, the diameter-adjusting machine with the diameter-adjusting die protecting device can protect the diameter-adjusting die, the buffer plate can provide a buffer effect between the auxiliary structure and the workpiece, and further reduce the abrasion degree of the workpiece to the auxiliary structure, and further improve the service life and the working safety of the diameter-adjusting machine with the diameter-adjusting die protecting device.

title_en: Paper scrap storage device for paper cutting machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a paper scrap storage device for a paper cutter, which relates to the technical field of paper scrap treatment equipment and comprises a workbench, wherein the top end of the workbench is provided with the paper cutter, a blade is arranged in the paper cutter, the front end of the workbench is fixedly connected with a fixed cylinder, the inner wall of the fixed cylinder is sleeved with a connecting rod, the inner wall of the connecting rod is fixedly connected with a round block II, the front end of the round block II is elastically connected with a round block I through an elastic spring, the connecting rod slides on the inner wall of the round block I, and the middle part of the round block I is penetrated and fixedly connected with a pull rod. According to the utility model, the limiting block is moved out of a group of deeper grooves in the sliding groove backwards by pressing the pull rod, so that the limit of the pull rod is relieved, the connecting rod is rotated to drive the blanking plate to rotate to the other side, the other group of storage boxes are blanked, the paper cutting machine is not required to be suspended to process the storage boxes after the storage boxes are full, time and labor are saved, and the working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Rolling oil mist recovery device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of oil mist recovery, and discloses a rolled oil mist recovery device which comprises a recovery outer cylinder and a demisting outer cylinder, wherein an installation cylinder is fixedly connected to one side of the recovery outer cylinder near the upper part of the installation cylinder, a through groove is formed in the recovery outer cylinder near the upper part of the installation cylinder, a cross clamping plate is fixedly arranged in the recovery outer cylinder, a fan is fixedly arranged in the center of the upper end face of the cross clamping plate, a driving motor is fixedly arranged in the center of the lower end face of the cross clamping plate, a rotating bar is fixedly connected to the output end of the driving motor, fixing threaded holes are formed in two sides of the demisting outer cylinder, and fixing threaded rods are sleeved in the two fixing threaded holes. According to the utility model, the efficient oil mist recovery effect can be achieved, the higher-efficiency adsorption effect can be achieved, and meanwhile, the better automatic cleaning and the demister replacement effects can be achieved, so that the demister has better convenience and usability.

title_en: Transmission shaft burnishing device with function of oiling
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of transmission shafts, in particular to a transmission shaft polishing device with an oiling function, which comprises a base and an adjusting device, wherein the upper end of the base is fixedly connected with a workbench, one side, close to the workbench, of the base is connected with a polisher main body in a sliding manner, the upper end of the polisher main body is connected with an oil connecting pipe in a penetrating manner, the upper end of the workbench is provided with a driver, the adjusting device comprises a supporting base, the supporting base is fixedly connected with the upper end of the workbench, one end of the supporting base is fixedly connected with a limiting frame, one end, far away from the limiting frame, of the supporting base is fixedly connected with a supporting column, a user manually dials one side of the transmission shaft to enable the transmission shaft to rotate around between a three-jaw limiting disc and a supporting head, so that polishing treatment is carried out on different surfaces of the transmission shaft by the device, the surface polishing flexibility of the transmission shaft is improved, and the processing efficiency of the transmission shaft is improved.

title_en: Metal cutting lathe headstock device with high accuracy
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of headstocks and discloses a metal cutting lathe headstock device with high precision, which comprises a mounting plate, wherein the top of the mounting plate is fixedly connected with a fixed bin, the outer side of the fixed bin is movably provided with a mounting frame, the top of the mounting frame is fixedly connected with a headstock body, a fixed block is fixedly connected between the inner top wall and the inner bottom wall of the fixed bin, and the inner walls of the left side and the right side of the fixed bin are fixedly connected with limiting rods respectively fixedly connected with the left side and the right side of the fixed block. This metal cutting lathe headstock device with high accuracy through setting up first movable frame, movable rod and second movable frame, and two fixture blocks can be to relative one side motion, breaks away from the installation through-hole motion when no longer spacing the mounting bracket, can take out the mounting bracket from the fixed bin outside, conveniently carries out quick assembly disassembly to the headstock body to the maintenance efficiency of headstock body is effectively guaranteed.

title_en: Gear deburring and polishing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of polishing equipment, in particular to gear deburring polishing equipment, which comprises: the machine body comprises a bottom plate and a gear body, wherein the upper surface of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a supporting side plate, the outer surface of the supporting side plate is fixedly connected with a supporting plate, and the inner side of the supporting plate is fixedly connected with a motor. When the gear is required to be polished, the sliding block is only required to slide on the inner side of the supporting plate under the action of the spring, and then the moving column is moved, when the gear can be installed between two groups of clamping columns, the connecting socket is inserted through the inserting column, so that the position of the moving block is fixed, the gear is further fixed between the two groups of clamping columns, the polishing column is driven to rotate under the rotation of the motor by turning on the power supply, burrs on the gear are polished, and therefore gears of any model can be polished, artificial operation is reduced, and the practicability is higher.

title_en: Turntable type polishing numerical control machine tool
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a turntable type polishing numerical control machine tool which comprises a frame, a detection mechanism, a moving mechanism, a workbench, a polishing mechanism and a turntable mechanism, wherein the detection mechanism and the moving mechanism are arranged on the frame, the workbench is arranged at the output end of the moving mechanism, the workbench moves under the driving of the moving mechanism, the turntable mechanism is arranged in the middle of the workbench, the turntable mechanism is provided with a rotatable rotating disc, a plurality of jigs for positioning workpieces are arranged on the rotating disc at intervals along the circumferential direction of the rotating disc, and the polishing mechanism comprises a plurality of polishing assemblies which are arranged along the rotating disc at intervals. The rotary disc type polishing numerical control machine tool has the advantages of high working efficiency by rotating and switching the cutter.

title_en: Electric power fitting polishing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses electric power fitting polishing equipment which comprises a base, a workbench, a box body and a water tank, wherein the workbench is fixedly arranged at the top of the base, the box body is fixedly arranged at the top of the workbench, a placing groove is formed in the left side of the workbench, a filter plate is movably arranged in the placing groove, and limiting assemblies are arranged on the front side and the rear side of the filter plate. According to the utility model, the limiting groove, the clamping plate and the water pump are arranged, so that the problems that in the using process, the polished electric power fitting cannot be clamped and fixed due to the fact that the clamping function is not arranged at the top of the workbench, the electric power fitting is easy to move and cannot be processed, polished electric power fitting is cooled by water sprayed out of the spray head, polished fragments flow into the water tank together with water flow, and the polished fragments are easy to damage the water pump due to the fact that the water flowing into the water tank is not used as filtering equipment, so that the water pump cannot be used are solved.

title_en: Deburring device for plastic bucket production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a edging device for plastic bucket production, which comprises a plate surface, wherein the upper end of the plate surface is fixedly connected with a bracket, the upper end of the bracket is fixedly connected with a motor, an output shaft of the motor penetrates through the bracket and is fixedly connected with a driving roller, the upper end of the plate surface is provided with a circular groove, the inside of the circular groove is rotationally connected with a cylinder, the upper end of the cylinder is fixedly connected with a fixing disc, both sides of the upper end of the fixing disc are fixedly connected with fixing plates, the outer surfaces of the fixing plates are respectively provided with a fixing assembly, and the driving roller and a driven roller are mutually in transmission connection through a belt. By adopting the structure, the height of the device can be adjusted, so that the device is more flexible and better used when the device is used, and the problem that the height of the workbench of the edge removing device produced by the existing plastic bucket cannot be adjusted, so that the height of an operator cannot be matched with the height of the workbench during operation, and the inconvenience is brought to use is avoided.

title_en: Knife clamping device for knife
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cutter clamping device, which comprises a clamping body, wherein a concave cavity is formed in the clamping body, four clamping blocks are arranged in the concave cavity in an array manner, square holes are formed in the middle of the four clamping blocks, a sealing plate is arranged on the side surface of the clamping body, a step is formed at the bottom of the clamping body, and screws extending into the concave cavity are arranged on the step in a threaded manner; the clamping blocks comprise straight faces, inclined faces and right-angle faces, the straight faces, the inclined faces and the right-angle faces are tightly attached to the inner walls of the concave cavities, and the inclined faces and the right-angle faces are oppositely and perpendicularly arranged and used for positioning between the clamping blocks. The cutter clamping device is small in structure, flexible and convenient to use, and meanwhile, the square hole can stably clamp the cutter bar of the non-standard structure through the matched movement of the four clamping blocks in the concave cavity, and the whole structure is practical and reliable.

title_en: Adjustable spiral hole saw structure for realizing drilling stroke positioning
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an adjustable spiral hole saw structure for realizing drilling stroke positioning, which comprises a drill saw body, wherein the surface of the drill saw body is fixedly connected with a connecting plate, the surface of the connecting plate is fixedly connected with a spiral drill bit, and the surface of the connecting plate is connected with a stabilizing plate through a sliding component. This realize adjustable spiral hole saw structure of drilling stroke location, through promoting the sliding plate, the degree of depth adjustment sliding plate of drilling as required and the distance between the sliding cylinder, rotate the locating knob afterwards and drive fixed plate and stabilizer plate in close contact, the sliding plate can't remove again this moment, starts to bore the saw body and presses down the drilling, when sliding cylinder and sliding plate contact, the spiral drill bit can't drill down any more to can realize the drilling stroke to the hole saw fix a position, and the stroke can be adjusted as required, the effectual availability factor that improves spiral hole saw structure.

title_en: Hardware wheel axle blank equipment of polishing
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of polishing equipment, and particularly relates to hardware wheel axle blank polishing equipment which comprises a support, wherein a platform is fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the support, a first fixing plate is fixedly arranged on one side of the upper surface of the platform, a first screw is movably connected to one side of the first fixing plate, a partition plate is fixedly arranged on one side of the middle of the upper surface of the platform, a second screw is movably connected to one side of the partition plate, a second fixing plate is fixedly arranged on the other side of the upper surface of the platform, a first motor is fixedly arranged on one side surface of the first fixing plate, a second motor is fixedly arranged on one side surface of the second fixing plate, and a first thread bush is in threaded connection with the outer surface of the first screw. According to the utility model, the first screw rod and the second screw rod are arranged, so that the first screw sleeve and the second screw sleeve respectively drive the fixing assembly and the polishing assembly to be adjusted, thereby facilitating polishing of workpieces with different lengths by polishing equipment, and further improving polishing efficiency.

title_en: Gear hobbing clamp for quick gear positioning of duplex gear
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of gear hobbing, and particularly relates to a hobbing clamp for quickly fixing teeth of a duplex gear; comprises a base, a pull rod, a hobbing mandrel, a hobbing lower pad and a hobbing upper pad; the base is fixed on the tool table of the machine tool, the duplex gear is sleeved on the gear hobbing mandrel, a spline of the duplex gear is positioned in the gear hobbing lower pad, the gear hobbing upper pad is pressed on the duplex gear, one end of the pull rod is blocked on the gear hobbing upper pad, and the other end of the pull rod penetrates through shaft holes of the gear hobbing upper pad, the duplex gear, the gear hobbing mandrel and the base and is connected with a hydraulic cylinder in the machine tool; the gear hobbing machine also comprises a fixed tooth pin, wherein a fixed tooth pin hole which radially penetrates through the single side wall is formed in the gear hobbing lower pad, and the fixed tooth pin is inserted into a spline tooth slot appointed by the duplex gear from the fixed tooth pin hole, so that the dislocation of the tooth aligning angle is prevented; the fixed tooth pin is in threaded connection with the fixed tooth pin hole; the mode that the fixed tooth pin is added to the gear hobbing lower pad realizes the tooth angle requirement of the duplex gears Z1 and Z2, and solves the problems of inaccurate tooth adjustment, long adjustment time and high labor intensity in the past.

title_en: Sheet metal drilling device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a metal plate drilling device, which relates to the technical field of metal processing and comprises a storage box, wherein the outer surface of a first motor is fixedly connected with the upper surface of the storage box, the output end of the first motor is fixedly connected with a rotating shaft, the bottom end of the rotating shaft is fixedly connected with a drill bit, a pushing mechanism is arranged in the storage box, a spraying mechanism is arranged on the right side of the storage box, and a clamping mechanism is arranged in the storage box. The utility model has reasonable design structure, can clamp the metal plate by the clamping mechanism when the metal plate is placed on the base through the matching of the pushing mechanism, the clamping mechanism, the motor I, the rotating shaft and the drill bit, and the drill bit starts to drill holes, if one plate needs to drill holes, the clamping plate is loosened, the pushing mechanism adjusts the position of the metal plate on the base, and after the position is adjusted, the clamping mechanism clamps and continues to drill holes, thereby solving the problem of reduced efficiency of drilling holes in the metal plate.

title_en: Novel anti-frock of card of wheel hub
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a clamp and provides a novel hub anti-clamping tool which comprises a base, a plurality of clamping blocks and a plurality of connecting pieces, wherein the clamping blocks are arranged on the base; the base and the clamping blocks are detachably connected with the machine tool; a plurality of sliding holes are formed in the circumferential direction of the side edge of the base, and the extension lines of the axes of the sliding holes are intersected with the axes of the base; a clamp splice is connected with a connecting piece, and a connecting piece slides and locates in a slide hole. The novel hub anti-clamping tool can be efficiently installed and disassembled so as to finish machining of hubs, and the machining time can be remarkably saved.

title_en: Clamping device of triangle wire drawing machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a clamping device of a triangular wire drawing machine, which belongs to the technical field of triangular wire drawing machines and comprises a support frame, wherein the top of the support frame is provided with the triangular wire drawing device, both sides of the triangular wire drawing device are respectively provided with a scrap collecting mechanism, the support frame is provided with a support plate, a plurality of electric hydraulic rods are fixedly arranged on the support plate, the top ends of the electric hydraulic rods are fixedly connected with a movable seat, and the side parts of the scrap collecting mechanisms are provided with sliding grooves.
