According to the utility model, the plates are placed by placing the plates, the extrusion plate is driven by the electric push rod to move so as to clamp and fix the plates, the screw rod is driven by the servo motor to rotate, the plates are driven to move by the cooperation between the screw rod and the U-shaped sliding plate, and the wiredrawing treatment is carried out on the plates by the triangular wiredrawing device, so that the wiredrawing quality is prevented from being influenced by sliding of the wiredrawn plates, and the practicability of the clamping device of the triangular wiredrawing machine is improved.

title_en: Loading attachment of cutting piece production and processing
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of mechanical cutting, in particular to a feeding device for production and processing of a cutting sheet, which comprises two fixing plates; the fixed plate is provided with a first motor, the output end of the first motor is connected with one of the conveying rollers, a plurality of cutting sheet dies are fixedly connected on the conveying belt, the cutting sheet dies are equidistantly arranged, one fixed plate is welded with a fixed frame, the fixed frame is provided with a graduated scale, the end part of the fixed frame is fixedly connected with an upper base, and the upper base is fixedly provided with a telescopic pipe; when limiting the material loading volume, the base under manual promotion makes flexible pipe vertical removal to required position under the cooperation of scale, through locking screw action, fixes the guide bar to can adjust the material loading volume, satisfy the production demand of different specification cutting pieces, also realized the function of ration material loading simultaneously, make the cutting piece specification of producing unified, improved subsequent result of use.

title_en: Glass slotting processing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of glass processing and discloses glass slotting processing equipment, which comprises a workbench, wherein limiting tables are fixedly arranged on two sides of the top of the workbench, a transverse plate is arranged on the front side between two groups of limiting tables, and extension plates are fixedly arranged on the front side and the rear side of the workbench; convex plates are fixedly arranged on the front side and the rear side of the top of the limiting table. The glass grooving device is provided with the springs, the pressing plates and the screw rods, and in the using process of the glass grooving device, the glass can be placed on the workbench by upwards moving the guide rods through the force application, then the guide rods are loosened, the pressing plates are pressed against the glass by the force application of the springs, the positive and negative motors drive the screw rods to rotate, the screw rods drive the pressing plates and the glass on the inner sides of the sliding blocks to move, and the structure is used for replacing manual pushing, ensuring that the pressing plates are always and sufficiently pushed down so as to prevent the shallow situation of the groove body, and effectively reducing the burden of operators.

title_en: Sticky waste residue extruder convenient for discharging
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of extruders, in particular to a viscous waste residue extruder convenient for discharging, which comprises a shell and a discharging collection assembly, wherein one end of the shell is provided with the discharging collection assembly, an extrusion mechanism is arranged in the shell, one end of the shell, which is close to the discharging collection assembly, is provided with a slag outlet port, one side of the discharging collection assembly, which is close to the shell, is provided with a limiting groove, the slag outlet port and the limiting groove are communicated with each other, one side of the discharging collection assembly is provided with uniformly-arranged holes, one side of the discharging collection assembly, which is provided with the holes, is provided with a guide piece, the guide piece is fixedly connected with the discharging collection assembly, and the interior of the discharging collection assembly is provided with uniformly-distributed limiting grooves; finally, the sticky waste residue can be scraped off, so that the blanking is convenient; finally, the viscous waste residue can be collected, and meanwhile, the viscous waste residue is extruded after being collected, so that the occupied space of the viscous waste residue is reduced, and the water content of the viscous waste residue is reduced again.

title_en: Clamping device for processing automobile steering upper pipe column
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of clamping devices and discloses a clamping device for processing an automobile steering upper pipe column, which comprises a main body mechanism, a mounting mechanism and a clamping mechanism, wherein the mounting mechanism is positioned in the main body mechanism, the clamping mechanism is positioned at the upper end of the mounting mechanism, the main body mechanism comprises a main body bottom shell, a shock absorption column, a wire hole site, a side baffle, a sliding upper cover, an opening and closing handle and a transparent window, the lower end of the shock absorption column is fixedly connected to the upper end of an inner bottom wall of the main body bottom shell, the wire hole site is fixedly arranged at the lower part of the right end of the main body bottom shell, the lower end of the side baffle is fixedly connected to the left side and the right side of the upper end of the main body bottom shell, the inner top wall of the sliding upper cover is slidably connected to the upper end of the side baffle, and the rear end of the opening and closing handle is fixedly connected to the middle part of the front end of the sliding upper cover. The clamping device for processing the automobile steering upper pipe column is convenient and quick to position and install when the clamping device is used in the actual use through the structure of the clamping mechanism.

title_en: Material taking mechanism of angle arc forming machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of metal plate processing, and discloses a material taking mechanism of an angle arc forming machine, which comprises a workbench, wherein a driving motor is fixedly arranged at the axis of the bottom surface of the workbench, the output end of the driving motor is provided with a material pressing roller, the upper surface of the workbench is provided with a material passing component, the outer wall of the material pressing roller is fixedly provided with a material clamping component, the side surface of the material passing component is provided with a placing plate, the bottom surface of the placing plate is fixedly connected with a control panel, the material passing component comprises a material passing roller, a connecting block, an adjusting block and an adjusting screw, and the material clamping component comprises an electric telescopic rod, a material clamping plate and a material blocking plate. According to the utility model, the clamping assembly is arranged, the clamping plate and the baffle plate are mutually matched to clamp and fix the plate, the electric telescopic rod is used for driving the clamping plate to move to loosen the plate, a worker can take down the bent plate without manually adjusting the clamping plate, and convenience is brought to feeding and taking out the plate with different thicknesses.

title_en: PVC cable material processing rotary-cut mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of PVC cable material rotary cutting, in particular to a PVC cable material processing rotary cutting mechanism, which comprises a rotary cutting table, wherein a supporting plate is fixedly connected to the rotary cutting table, a motor is fixedly connected to the rotary cutting table, a cutter is fixedly connected to the output end of the motor, a circular handle is rotated, the circular handle rotates to drive a first threaded rod to rotate, the gauze is driven to slide upwards, the gauze slides upwards to drive granular PVC cable materials to move upwards, when the PVC cable materials move to the top of a first sliding groove, the cable materials float out of the water, a second threaded rod is rotated to loosen a fixing rod, a rotary cylinder handle drives a push rod to rotate and keep in a horizontal state, the push rod is driven to slide by pushing the cylindrical handle, the granular PVC cable materials are pushed by pushing the push plate to slide, and the granular PVC cable materials are pushed to a collecting port, so that the PVC cable materials in water can be collected, the problem that the PVC cable materials inconvenient to drop into the water can be solved, and the time is saved and the manpower consumption is reduced.

title_en: Plastic tray for classification
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a plastic tray for classification, which comprises an annular plate and a base, wherein a plurality of cavities are formed in the annular plate, the cavities are circumferentially distributed by taking the axial direction of the annular plate as the center, storage box components are arranged in the cavities, a fixed column is rotationally arranged on the base and is fixed with the annular plate through a connecting frame, and a moving mechanism is arranged on the fixed column and is used for simultaneously moving the storage box components. The beneficial effects are that: through setting up a plurality of storing box subassemblies and be used for placing different components and parts to the storing box subassembly all concentrates the setting on the annular plate, is convenient for look for and take the use to the components and parts, through rotatory annular plate, rotates corresponding storing box subassembly before the staff to the staff puts in the part, all removes the cavity with whole storing box subassembly through moving mechanism in, seals the storing box subassembly through the cavity, can avoid components and parts to spill in the storing box subassembly like this.

title_en: Sheet metal part burr treatment device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a sheet metal part burr treatment device, which comprises: the device comprises a machine base and a machine frame arranged on the machine base, wherein the machine frame is arranged at intervals along the length direction of the machine base; a placing plate capable of moving along the length direction of the frame and used for placing a workpiece; polishing mechanism, including: the left and right polishing assemblies comprise polishing wheels capable of moving left and right and rotating, and the front and rear polishing assemblies comprise polishing wheels capable of moving back and forth; the stop component is arranged at one side of the left polishing mechanism and the right polishing mechanism. Through above-mentioned setting, can polish fast the top of work piece and the side of fore-and-aft direction, the precision of polishing is high, and the left side of work piece can be prevented to scratch by the backstop subassembly.

title_en: Plate shearing machine for aluminum honeycomb composite board production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a plate shearing machine for producing aluminum honeycomb composite plates, which belongs to the technical field of plate shearing machines for shearing aluminum honeycomb composite plates, wherein shearing cutters are arranged at the top and the bottom of an inner cavity of a plate shearing groove, a matched material supporting plate is arranged at the bottom of the front end surface of a plate shearing machine main body, corresponding to the bottom of the plate shearing groove, longitudinal fixing rods are arranged at the left side and the right side of the top of the material supporting plate, and T-shaped sliding grooves are longitudinally arranged on opposite surfaces of the longitudinal fixing rods from front to back; the rear end faces of the pushing plates arranged on the left side and the right side can respectively prop against the left side and the right side of the aluminum honeycomb composite plate, then the pushing plates are pushed to the shearing knife direction by the aid of the handles, so that the aluminum honeycomb composite plate is pushed to move, the pushing plates can drive the connecting rods to move when moving, the connecting rods can play a limiting guide effect on the movement of the pushing plates through the matching of the T-shaped sliding blocks and the T-shaped sliding grooves, and therefore the situation that manual pushing of the aluminum honeycomb composite plate is needed to move can be avoided, and potential safety hazards occur.

title_en: Quick clamping grinds pearl machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rapid clamping bead grinding machine, which comprises a clamping assembly and a polishing mechanism, wherein a polishing machine framework is arranged above the clamping assembly, the clamping assembly comprises a bottom plate, the polishing mechanism comprises a bracket and a polishing assembly, the bracket is fixedly connected with the bottom plate, the polishing assembly is arranged above the bottom plate through the bracket, the polishing assembly is movably connected with the bracket, the bottom plate is provided with a tail top clamping piece in sliding connection, the bottom plate is also fixedly provided with an electric clamping piece corresponding to the tail top clamping piece, the electric clamping piece and the tail top clamping piece are used for rapid clamping of beads, and the electric clamping piece is also fixedly provided with a counterpoint piece; according to the device, the beads to be polished can be rapidly clamped, the beads can be continuously clamped and pre-positioned during polishing, the beads are prevented from falling off in the polishing process through the rapid clamping assembly, the polishing of the beads is more comprehensive, and the alignment piece is arranged to improve the polishing accuracy of the device.

title_en: Electromechanical equipment maintenance case that intensity of use is high
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of electromechanical equipment maintenance boxes, and particularly relates to an electromechanical equipment maintenance box with high use strength, which comprises a main body, wherein a drawer mechanism is arranged on the main body, a storage cavity is arranged in the drawer mechanism, a handle is arranged on the drawer mechanism, a lifting handle is arranged at the top of the main body, a placement cavity is arranged in the main body, a bearing piece is arranged between the outer side of the drawer mechanism and the inner wall of the storage cavity, a limiting piece is arranged outside the bearing piece, a first bearing cavity and a second bearing cavity are arranged in the bearing piece, a supporting piece is arranged in the first bearing cavity, a connecting plate is arranged on the supporting piece, and a supporting plate is arranged on the connecting plate. According to the utility model, the bearing piece, the first bearing cavity, the second bearing cavity, the supporting piece, the connecting plate and the supporting plate can form a stable structure, so that the impact force can be shared when the main body is stressed, the main body generating equipment is prevented from being damaged due to external force impact, the normal use of the maintenance box is ensured, and the overall bearing performance and strength of the main body are improved.

title_en: Stamping device is used in automobile parts processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a stamping device for processing automobile parts, which comprises a mounting seat, wherein the top of the mounting seat is fixedly provided with a mounting cross beam through a bolt, the top of the mounting cross beam is provided with a stamping mechanism, the inner wall of the mounting seat is provided with a positioning mechanism, the positioning mechanism comprises a side plate, the side plate is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the mounting seat through a bolt, the top of the mounting seat, which is close to the side plate, is provided with a transfer mechanism, the transfer mechanism comprises a cylinder A, a connecting seat and a cylinder B, one end of the cylinder B is fixedly provided with a baffle plate, one side of the mounting seat is fixedly provided with a feeding conveyor through a bolt, the other side of the mounting seat is fixedly provided with a discharging conveyor through a bolt, and the bottom of the mounting seat is provided with a collecting mechanism; through being provided with transport mechanism, can whole journey carry out automatic transport operation to spare part, need not too much manual operation, improve the degree of automation and the efficiency of punching press operation, and then improved the practicality of device.

title_en: Mounting structure of precision part cutting tool
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mounting structure of a precise part cutting tool, which relates to the field of cutting tools and comprises a left groove seat and a right groove seat, wherein semicircular notches are formed in the bottom ends of the left groove seat and the right groove seat, a sliding fixing part is fixedly mounted at the top ends of the left groove seat and the right groove seat, a through groove for a sliding rod to pass through is formed in the back surface of the left groove seat, an inner plate is fixedly connected to one side of the sliding rod, a movable plate is welded on the other side of the sliding rod, springs are fixedly connected to two sides between the back surface of the movable plate and the back surface of the left groove seat, a guide rail A for sliding a sliding block A is welded at the side end of the left groove seat, a connecting rod for fixing a head part and a prompting lamp is welded at the side end of the guide rail.

title_en: Variable speed drum punching equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a variable speed drum punching device, which relates to the technical field of punching devices and comprises a box body, a supporting seat and a table top fixed on the box body, a sliding groove arranged on the table top, a punching main body arranged on the supporting seat, a clamping assembly fixedly arranged on the table top, a motor connected with the output end of the motor, two ends of the motor are movably connected with adjusting base posts, a clamping plate base is arranged at the top of the adjusting base posts, and a clamping plate support is fixedly arranged on one side of the clamping plate base. According to the variable speed drum punching equipment, the table top and the clamping assembly are arranged, when the variable speed drum punching equipment is used, the distance between the adjusting base posts is reduced, the length of the variable speed drum element is adapted, the clamping block main bodies are mutually close to prevent the variable speed drum element from shifting, and compared with a traditional mode, the variable speed drum punching equipment is capable of ensuring firm clamping, adjusting the angle of the variable speed drum element more conveniently and reducing hole position deviation.

title_en: Disassembling mechanism of container assembly
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a disassembly mechanism of a container assembly. This detaching mechanism is used for the assembly of container subassembly, and container subassembly includes container and container support, and container support is equipped with the pilot hole, and the container is installed in the pilot hole, and the first end and the second end of container are located the both sides that container support deviate from each other, and detaching mechanism includes: the support piece is provided with a support platform and a first profiling structure, when the container assembly is inverted on the support piece, the support platform is used for bearing the container bracket, and the first profiling structure is used for accommodating the first end of the container; the disassembly mechanism comprises a disassembly piece which can reciprocate in the axial direction of the assembly hole relative to the support piece, the disassembly piece is provided with a second profiling structure, the second profiling structure limits the second end of the container, and the disassembly piece is used for pushing the container to move in the direction of the first end of the container relative to the container support when in motion so as to detach the container from the assembly hole. The scheme provided by the utility model can improve the disassembly efficiency of the container and the container bracket.

title_en: Positioning tool for seamless steel tube
abstract_en: The utility model provides a seamless steel pipe's location frock, includes steel pipe, pinch roller synchronous motor, hydraulic support platform, compresses tightly the platform, goes up and down fixed slide, drive gear, gear drive round pin fixed slide, goes up and down the guide pin, work platform, pinch roller, driving motor, hydraulic ram, goes up blotter, lower blotter, work platform lower part has the brace table, and work platform upper portion has the work recess, and work recess both ends have the pinch roller groove, and the pinch roller groove lateral part has the pinch roller shaft hole, and inside and the pinch roller shaft of pinch roller shaft suits, and inside the pinch roller shaft hole is connected to the pinch roller shaft, and the pinch roller shaft rotates in the pinch roller shaft hole, and work platform upper portion fixed connection hydraulic support, hydraulic support platform lower part fixed connection hydraulic ram, hydraulic ram lower part fixed connection go up the blotter, and the work platform both ends have the motor support, motor support anterior fixed connection pinch roller synchronous motor.

title_en: Blade-mounted gun drill
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a blade-mounted gun drill, and belongs to the technical field of deep hole machining. The bladed gun drill includes a base assembly and a mounting assembly. The base assembly comprises: the drill handle, the drilling rod and the connector, the drill handle with the connector all sets up on the drilling rod, during the use, the guide bar is made with wear-resisting material, and its effect is at the surface in processed hole play supporting role, reduces blade vibration, and this rifle bores connector cutting edge part adopts detachable blade form, need not pull down the drill handle when the blade grinds duly and to remove the regrinding, only need change the blade can, and is convenient, save time, the guide bar adopts high performance material to inlay on the steel material connecting head of low price, and the cost is cheaper than ordinary rifle bores and adopts carbide to grind out the guide part, and the guide bar fastening adopts the interchangeable structure that first screw was last, can change new guide bar after the guide bar wearing and tearing, need not change whole rifle bores, the cost is lower.

title_en: Tool for side bearing seat plate assembly
abstract_en: A tooling for side bearing plate assembly comprising: the tool comprises a tool body, two side bearing plates and a framework side beam, wherein the two side bearing plates are symmetrically arranged on the framework side beam after being positioned through the tool body, the side bearing plates are rectangular plate-shaped structures with through holes in the center, an isosceles trapezoid projection A is arranged at the lower part of one side of each side bearing plate, which is in contact with the tool body, an isosceles trapezoid projection B is arranged at the upper part of the other side of each side bearing plate, the framework side beam is a rectangular plate-shaped structure with a downward convex bottom edge in the middle, the whole tool body is of a rectangular plate-shaped structure, and symmetrical projections C, projections D and projections E are respectively arranged on the upper, middle and lower sides of the left side and the right side of the tool body. The beneficial effects of the utility model are as follows: the fixture can be used for rapidly positioning the side beams of the framework and the side bearing plates, improves assembly accuracy and assembly efficiency, and is simple in structure, easy to process and low in manufacturing cost.

title_en: Side jacking device and numerical control machine tool
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of numerical control machining, and provides a side jacking device and a numerical control machine tool. The first ejector blocks are connected with the bottom plate in a sliding manner, are arranged on two opposite sides of a workpiece to be processed in pairs, are provided with sliding grooves, and the outlet ends of the sliding grooves in the length direction are right opposite to the side walls of the workpiece to be processed; the second top block is in sliding connection with the chute and can be abutted against or away from the side wall of the workpiece to be processed, and the second top block is provided with a conical hole; adjusting bolt and first kicking block threaded connection, adjusting bolt's one end be provided with the grafting portion of bell mouth shape adaptation, grafting portion can peg graft with the bell mouth, along with grafting portion from the big footpath end of bell mouth to the path end removal, the second kicking block can be to waiting that the machined part is located the side to the lateral wall of butt waiting the machined part. When the plane is milled, the side wall of the workpiece to be processed can be clamped, and the plane to be processed is prevented from being deformed.

title_en: Mounting base of cylinder sleeve processing die
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mounting base of a cylinder sleeve processing die, which comprises a mounting base structure arranged at the bottom of the cylinder sleeve processing die, wherein rectangular clamping blocks are fixedly connected to two sides of the cylinder sleeve processing die, the mounting base structure comprises a support which is movably contacted with the bottom of the cylinder sleeve processing die, and a bottom plate is arranged below the support. According to the utility model, the double-shaft driving motor, the thread driving assembly, the L-shaped rod, the guide assembly and the clamping limiting touch assembly are arranged, so that clamping and clamping of the cylinder sleeve processing die are facilitated, automatic convenient positioning and fixing of the cylinder sleeve processing die without tools are realized by using a clamping and matching clamping mode, the fixing efficiency and the fixing automation degree are improved, the double-shaft driving motor is conveniently and automatically controlled to be closed and the prompting lamp is conveniently controlled to be opened when the clamping and clamping are in place by combining the arranged controller and the prompting lamp, the obvious prompting personnel are realized to be in a mounted and in-place state, and the convenience is brought to clear control of the personnel.

title_en: Advertisement card cutting machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an advertising card cutting machine, and relates to the technical field of advertising card processing. Comprises a cutting frame, wherein the bottom surface of the cutting frame is fixedly provided with a stand, and the surface of the stand is fixedly provided with supporting feet. Through the stabilizer blade subassembly structure that sets up, cooperation grudging post subassembly, the user can place the wind-up roll that the rolling has the advertisement paper in the top of baffle, then makes its axle head link to each other with the axle link, alright start the driving machine, make new wind-up roll and the wind-up roll replacement position that finishes of processing, convenient operation is swift, can also reduce artificial work load.

title_en: External surface image acquisition device of small-sized workpiece
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an external surface image acquisition device of a small-sized workpiece, which comprises an image acquisition mechanism, a rotary clamping mechanism, a sliding carrying mechanism and a vertical displacement mechanism, wherein the rotary clamping mechanism realizes the clamping of various small-sized workpieces through the mutual combination of a plug-in type clamp; the sliding carrying mechanism drives the screw rod through a motor to clamp and loosen the workpiece; the rotary clamping mechanism drives the turntable to rotate through a motor, and adjusts a first shooting angle of the workpiece; the vertical displacement mechanism drives the first screw nut and the second screw nut to reversely move through the first vertical screw motor and the second vertical screw motor respectively, and pulls out or withdraws a sliding rod at the free end in the sliding carrying mechanism, so that the sliding carrying mechanism deflects at a small angle, and the second shooting angle of the workpiece is adjusted. According to the utility model, the external surface images of the special postures of the small-sized workpiece are acquired by adjusting the two shooting angles of the workpiece, so that the problem that part of small-sized workpiece has shooting dead angles in the plane detection of a fixed view field is solved.

title_en: Rotary heating device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a rotary heating device, which relates to the technical field of bearing heating and comprises a base; the front end position of base and the lower position fixed connection of heating cabinet rear end, the rear end intermediate position of heating cabinet is provided with the heating tank, and the top position sliding connection of base has the removal frame, and the front end top position of removal frame is provided with the drum. The first motor drives the movable frame to slide to the front position through the cooperation of the threaded rod, the five supporting arms drive the bearing to enter into the heating tank at the rear end of the heating box, the second motor is started next, and the rotating frame integrally rotates through the cooperation of the gear of the second motor and the toothed ring. The problem of current when carrying out heat treatment to the bearing, the bearing position is not changed and is very easily appeared being heated inhomogeneous condition, influences normal assembly, reduces bearing preparation efficiency is solved.

title_en: Photovoltaic module frame corner burring device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a photovoltaic module frame corner deburring device which comprises a conveying frame, wherein supporting mechanisms are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the conveying frame, limiting mechanisms are arranged at the end parts of the conveying frame, the top of the supporting mechanism is connected with a corner polishing box in a sliding mode, a guide block is arranged in the middle of the bottom surface of the corner polishing box, a first threaded hole is formed in the middle of the guide block, the first threaded hole is connected with a bidirectional threaded screw in a matching mode, a driving mechanism is arranged at the end part of the bidirectional threaded screw, and the driving mechanism is arranged on the supporting mechanism and used for solving the technical problem that after splicing of a photovoltaic frame is completed, four corners of the frame need to be polished and deburred.

title_en: Cutting machine convenient to adjust cutting length
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of cutting machines, in particular to a cutting machine convenient for adjusting cutting length, which comprises a workbench and a filter plate, wherein the right side of the workbench is connected with a cross rod, the outer side of the cross rod is provided with an adjusting screw, the outer side of the adjusting screw is connected with an adjusting block, the outer side of the adjusting block is connected with a starting rod, the lower part of the starting rod is provided with a storage rod, the middle part of the workbench is provided with a support frame, the outer side of the support frame is provided with an electric push rod, the bottom of the electric push rod is fixedly provided with a cutting knife, the outer side of the cutting knife is provided with a buffer shock absorber, the filter plate is arranged at the outer side of the workbench, the outer side of the filter plate is provided with a baffle, the outer side of the baffle is connected with an adjusting rod, and the bottom of the workbench is provided with a material collecting box. The cutting machine is convenient to automatically adjust the cutting length of the cloth at any time when in use, the buffer structure is convenient to improve, the service life of the device is prolonged, and the waste is convenient to automatically collect and concentratedly treat.

title_en: Suspension type shot blasting machine for steel structure workpiece
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of shot blasting machines, in particular to a suspension type shot blasting machine for steel structure workpieces, which comprises a machine body and a mounting frame, wherein a sliding groove is formed in the lower surface of the mounting frame, a first servo motor is fixedly connected to the outer wall of the front end of the mounting frame, a threaded rod is fixedly connected to the output end of the first servo motor, a thread sleeve is sleeved on the outer portion of the threaded rod, and a second servo motor is fixedly connected to the lower surface of the thread sleeve. According to the suspended shot blasting machine for the steel structure workpiece, when the workpiece is required to be fed and discharged, the first servo motor drives the threaded rod to rotate, so that the lifting hook is driven to move back and forth, manual feeding and discharging operation is replaced, the labor intensity of workers is reduced, the working efficiency is improved, meanwhile, the workpiece is convenient to place or take down by operators, and the workpiece is not required to be put on or taken out by a part of a body extending into equipment, so that potential safety hazards are eliminated.

title_en: Storage device for medical equipment maintenance
abstract_en: A storage device for medical equipment maintenance, comprising: the device comprises a base, a connecting plate, a plurality of hooks, a pull rope, a first side cover and a second side cover; the middle part of base has been seted up logical groove, the standing groove has been seted up to the lateral wall of base, the connecting plate is connected with the base, the connecting plate has one and puts the object plane, each couple is connected with putting the object plane respectively, the stay cord sets up on putting the object plane, the first end of first side cap is rotated with one side of connecting plate and is connected, the first end of second side cap is rotated with the opposite side of connecting plate and is connected, first side cap and second side cap movable cover are put on the object plane, when the user carries the storage device that medical equipment was used to go on the road of maintenance medical equipment, maintenance equipment in the storage device that medical equipment was used is jolting also can firmly fix on putting the object plane, so, when the user is used in maintenance to medical equipment next time, the great maintenance tool that finds maintenance equipment by the user, thereby improve work efficiency.

title_en: Large-caliber seamless steel pipe for long-distance steam pipe network
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a large-caliber seamless steel pipe for a long-distance steam pipe network, which is produced by combining hot rolling, hot expansion and cold drawing processes, carrying out two-step straightening and rounding on the pipe, carrying out shot blasting on the inner surface and the outer surface of the steel pipe, grinding and polishing, then spraying the inner surface of the steel pipe to form an anti-corrosion drag reduction layer, and spraying the outer surface to form a reflecting layer and a heat insulation layer, wherein the outer diameter of the seamless steel pipe is 559-1420 mm, the wall thickness is 8-45 mm, the diameter-wall ratio is 100, the maximum length is 14m, the outer diameter tolerance is +/-0.75%, the wall thickness tolerance is 0-15%, the straightness is less than 1.2mm/m, the out-of-roundness is less than 1.0% of the average diameter, and the roughness of the inner surface and the outer surface of the steel pipe is less than 6.3 mu m. The large-caliber seamless steel pipe for the long-distance steam pipe network has wide size range, high geometric precision and good internal and external surface quality, and can effectively reduce the temperature drop and pressure drop of the long-distance steam pipe network.

title_en: Workpiece punching device convenient for fixed point
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of workpiece punching marks, in particular to a workpiece punching device convenient for fixed points, which comprises a workbench, wherein a puncher is arranged on the surface of the workbench, and a driving device is arranged at the top of the puncher; the fixing plate is welded on the surface of the guide rod; the bottom of the air pump is welded with a sliding block which is I-shaped; the beneficial effects are as follows: according to the novel workpiece punching device convenient for fixed point, after the plate needing to be punched is fixed on the fixed plate, the knob is rotated along with the plate, the screw rod rotates to drive the sliding block and the air pump to move, the position needing to be punched of the plate is aligned with the positioning groove, the air pump is started to drive the fixed plate and the plate to uniformly move, the punching machine punches uniform holes in the plate, and the air pump is closed after the punching is finished.

title_en: Triode pin cutting equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses triode pin cutting equipment which comprises a machine body, a discharge hole and a collecting box, wherein a connecting plate is fixedly connected to the machine body, a first baffle plate and a second baffle plate are fixedly connected to the connecting plate, a rotating rod driven by a motor to rotate is arranged on the second baffle plate, a notch is formed in the second baffle plate, an eccentric wheel rotating in the notch is fixedly connected to the rotating rod, and an adjusting piece matched with the eccentric wheel to adjust the collecting box is arranged on the connecting plate. According to the utility model, the motor drives the rotary rod to rotate, so that the eccentric wheel pushes the collecting box to move on the connecting plate in the rotation process, and under the action of the spring, the collecting box can reciprocate on the connecting plate, so that the triodes in the collecting box are uniformly distributed, and uneven stacking of the triodes in the collecting box is effectively prevented, and the subsequent triodes are prevented from being ejected out of the collecting box and falling to the ground.

title_en: Cooling and straightening equipment for heat treatment of metal surface
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of metal processing, and discloses cooling and straightening equipment for heat treatment of metal surfaces, which comprises a workbench, wherein the upper end of the workbench is fixedly connected with a rotating frame and a motor, the rotating frame is rotationally connected with a driving shaft, the circumferential surface of the driving shaft is fixedly connected with a first straightening roller, the output end of the motor is fixedly connected with a first sprocket, the circumferential surface of the driving shaft is fixedly connected with a second sprocket, the first sprocket and the second sprocket are connected through a first chain, the second sprocket is connected through a second chain, and the upper surface of the workbench is provided with a cooling mechanism. The utility model can achieve the effect of cooling and straightening the metal by simple operation.

title_en: But quick replacement's hand riveter head
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a quick-replaceable hand riveter head, which comprises a connecting piece, wherein one end of the connecting piece is inserted with a gun head, the other end of the connecting piece is in threaded connection with a fixed head, and the fixed head is inserted with the gun head and is coaxially arranged.

title_en: Burr removing device for machining thin-wall bakelite retainer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a deburring device for processing a thin-wall bakelite retainer, which belongs to the field of retainer production and comprises a deburring structure, wherein one side of a lower box is provided with a movable motor, and the output end of the movable motor is arranged at one end of a positive and negative tooth screw.

title_en: Pin measurement gauge for circuit board
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a testing fixture for measuring pins of a circuit board, which comprises positioning columns, positioning seats, a circuit board main body and positioning convex plates, wherein an installation base is fixedly installed on the lower end face of the positioning seats, a wire installation sleeve is installed at one end of the installation base, an electric connection seat is installed on the inner side of the installation base, a plurality of distance measuring plates are installed on the upper end face of the electric connection seat, the positioning convex plates are arranged on the upper end face of the positioning seat, the circuit board main body is installed on the upper end face of the positioning convex plates, an adsorption positioning plate is installed on the outer side of the circuit board main body, a plurality of positioning columns are installed on the inner side of the circuit board main body, and a plurality of pins are arranged on the inner side of the lower end face of the circuit board main body located on the positioning seats. According to the utility model, the circuit board is positioned, placed and adsorbed and fixed, so that the pin and the checking fixture are accurately inserted, the circuit board is effectively prevented from being scrapped due to damaged pins, and the pin measurement is conveniently kept stable.

title_en: Shape correction die for yaw brake pad
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a correction die for a yaw brake pad, and relates to the technical field of manufacturing dies. The sizing die comprises an upper pressure head, a finishing middle die and a top head. The finishing middle die is a shaping die with the function of changing the shape of the support back plate, the finishing middle die can enable the support back plate to be plastically deformed in the finishing middle die, and the outline shape is changed. The finishing middle die is provided with a through hole, the upper pressure head can be pressed into the through hole from the upper part, and the top head can be pressed into the through hole from the lower part. The lower surface of the upper pressure head is perpendicular to the axis of the through hole. Grooves are formed in two sides of the through hole of the finishing middle die, and the width of the grooves is larger than that of the protruding structure of the supporting backboard. A balance plate is arranged in the groove. The stand column is arranged at the middle lower part of the balance plate, and the balance plate can be pressed down by the convex structure to move. The shape correction die can correct the shape of the support backboard under the condition of not contacting the friction material, optimize the roundness of the support backboard and ensure the shape correction accuracy.

title_en: Automatic welding robot walks on stage
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of welding robots and discloses an automatic walking-stage welding robot which comprises a robot main body, wherein the bottom of the robot main body is movably connected with four mechanical feet, the top of the robot main body is fixedly connected with an adjusting and removing assembly, and the adjusting and removing assembly comprises a round table, a first motor, a second motor, a mechanical arm, a first motor, a mechanical elbow, a second motor, a welding head, a smoke removing box, a screen plate, a fixed frame, an activated carbon filter cotton net, an exhaust fan and a gas collecting hopper. This automatic welding robot walks on stage for the round platform can rotate and then makes the welding head rotate around the robot main part through setting up first motor, thereby increases the welding position, enlarges welded scope, and simultaneously, the second motor that sets up can drive the welding head and do arc motion, fine setting welding head bonding tool's angle, and then makes the welding head be convenient for contact with the welding point, has further increased the welding scope, has improved the convenience in the use.

title_en: Grooving device for cabinet plate machining
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a slotting device for processing a cabinet plate, which comprises: a storage rack, a connecting rack and a grooving mechanism; the connecting frame is fixed on one side of the storage frame, and one side of the connecting frame far away from the storage frame is in sliding connection with one side of the slotting mechanism; the bottom side of the storage rack is provided with a mounting hole, and a transfer assembly is arranged in the mounting hole; one side of the connecting frame far away from the storage frame is arranged on the transfer trolley; according to the utility model, a large number of cabinet plates can be stored through the storage rack, so that a large amount of manpower can be further saved, a certain manpower can be effectively saved through the inclined surface formed on the top side of the connecting rack, meanwhile, the stability of the cabinet plates in moving can be ensured, the smoothness of the cabinet plates in moving to the slotting mechanism can be further improved through the transfer assembly, meanwhile, unnecessary manpower can be further saved, and the cabinet plates with slotting completed can be more conveniently moved to the next process through the transfer trolley.

title_en: Medical bed board blanking die
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of medical bed board processing and discloses a medical bed board blanking die which comprises a workbench, wherein a hydraulic rod is fixedly connected to the front side of the top end of the workbench, the output end of the hydraulic rod is fixedly connected with a mounting plate, the rear side of the interior of the mounting plate is slidingly connected with a limit column, the four corners of the top end of the mounting plate are fixedly connected with support columns, the top ends of a plurality of the support columns are fixedly connected with an air pump, the output end of the air pump is fixedly connected with a connecting pipe, the bottom end of the mounting plate is fixedly connected with a fixing plate, and the bottom end of the fixing plate is fixedly connected with a plurality of punching heads. According to the utility model, generated scraps can be collected in the process of blanking the medical bed board, so that the problem that the scraps are overlapped to influence the blanking effect is prevented, the medical bed board can be lifted in the use process, and the automatic movement can be performed, so that the working intensity of a worker master is reduced, and the overall working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Flange placing frame
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a flange placing frame, which relates to the technical field of flange frames and is characterized in that: comprises a bottom frame and a fixed rod; a chassis: the left side face is fixedly provided with a fixing plate, the front side face and the rear side face of the fixing plate are respectively and rotatably connected with a screw rod, the screw rods are in threaded connection with screw holes on the side face of an adjusting plate, the right side face of the adjusting plate is fixedly provided with a T-shaped block, the T-shaped block is in sliding connection with a T-shaped groove on the right side face inside the underframe, two fixing rods are respectively and longitudinally fixed inside the underframe, the outer side face of the adjusting plate is provided with a limiting unit, and the top face of the underframe is provided with an anti-falling unit; this frame is put to flange, the rubber mount cooperation regulating plate that sets up can fix the flange of dead lever top surface, and the use is adjusted to the flange of the different specifications of being convenient for simultaneously, and the anticreep frame then can push down the flange, and gliding baffle can separate a plurality of flanges and place, and then prevents to collide each other between the flange and cause the damage.

title_en: Power cable scissors
abstract_en: The utility model provides a pair of power cable scissors, which relates to the technical field of cable scissors and comprises a first cutter handle, wherein a second cutter handle is arranged at the top of the first cutter handle, one ends of the first cutter handle and the second cutter handle are connected with an extension handle, one end of the extension handle is provided with a connecting plate, the top of the connecting plate is connected with a fixed shaft, a plurality of swivel rings are arranged on the outer side of the fixed shaft, a connecting frame is connected on the outer side of the swivel rings, and one side of the connecting frame is connected with a handle. According to the utility model, the first cutter handle is arranged, the second cutter handle is arranged at the top of the first cutter handle, so that the cable can be sheared by cross clamping, the force range is effectively prolonged, the safety is improved, the cable shears can be gripped by connecting the extension handles at one ends of the first cutter handle and the second cutter handle, the use experience is improved, the fixed connection of the handles is realized, and the stability of the extension mechanism is improved by arranging the connecting plate at one end of the extension handles.

title_en: Cutting device and head cutting machine
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of material processing, in particular to a cutting device and a head cutting machine. The cutting device that this application provided is through setting up fixed module and cutting module, and wherein fixed module includes first fixing base and installs the solid frock of card in first fixing base bottom, and it has first through-hole to open on the solid frock of card, and open bottom the first fixing base has the opening size to be greater than the logical groove of first through-hole cross section size, the top surface and the logical groove of solid frock of card form the second through-hole. The cutting module is provided with the cutter which is in sliding fit with the second through hole, when the cutter is used, the cutting edge of the cutter points to the first fixing seat and is attached to the top surface of the clamping fixture, an operator passes through the first through hole at one end of a material to be cut, and pushes the cutting module into the second through hole, so that cutting operation can be completed, hands of the operator cannot directly contact the material in the cutting process, and the cutter is far away from, so that the problem of lower safety of the cutting operation in the prior art is solved.

title_en: Vertical processing equipment for silicon rod
abstract_en: The embodiment of the utility model provides vertical processing equipment for silicon rods, which comprises: the station conversion device is used for carrying silicon rods to be converted among different stations, and is provided with a calibration reference surface which is kept relatively static with the station conversion device around the rotation axis of the station conversion device; the measuring head probe is used for measuring the shape and position dimensions of the silicon rod; and when the station switching device switches stations once, the measuring head probe approaches to and contacts with the calibration reference surface to determine a measurement reference so as to calibrate the measuring head probe. The calibration reference surface of the embodiment of the utility model can provide a stable and uniform reference for the calibration of the probe head. The measuring system can ensure that the measuring standard is not influenced by the angle error of the station conversion device, and further measures the shape, position and size of the silicon rod by the calibrated measuring system for subsequent processing.

title_en: Table tapping machine with clamping mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bench tapping machine with a clamping mechanism, which comprises a tapping machine body, wherein the tapping machine body comprises a tapping mechanism, an upright post and a supporting table, the tapping mechanism and the supporting table are respectively arranged at the upper part of the upright post and the lower part of the upright post, the tapping mechanism comprises a tapping power box, a tapping speed reducing motor and a tap quick connecting mechanism which are sequentially arranged from top to bottom, the tapping speed reducing motor is connected with a lifting main shaft of the tapping power box, the tap quick connecting mechanism is connected with a tap, the bottom of the tapping power box is also provided with a tap breakage preventing metal chain, the tap breakage preventing metal chain is uniformly arranged around the tapping speed reducing motor, and the top surface of the supporting table is provided with a hydraulic clamping mechanism. The problem that the existing tapping machine is not provided with a corresponding mechanism to prevent sputtering after the lead screw is broken in consideration of interference of machining is solved.

title_en: Production device for machining parts of diesel generator set
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a production device for machining parts of a diesel generator set, which relates to the technical field of machining parts of the diesel generator set. According to the utility model, the disc and the rod piece are automatically distinguished and separated through the stepping device, and are respectively clamped through the clamping device, so that the functions are complete; the rod piece processing device is used for enabling scraps generated in processing to fall into the collecting box, and the scraps can be pulled out through the side box door for cleaning, so that the scraps are prevented from splashing everywhere; through step device, realize automatic feeding, distinguish and ejection of compact, after adjusting the parameter of each processing subassembly, need not staff's supervision, degree of automation is high, and the integrated level is good.

title_en: Electromechanical positioning tool
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of electromechanical machining, in particular to an electromechanical positioning tool which comprises a fixed base, wherein two clamping plates capable of moving mutually are arranged at the top of the fixed base, fixing strips are fixedly connected to the front surface and the rear surface of the fixed base through bolts, lifting plates capable of lifting are arranged at the top of the fixed base, and a lifting mechanism is arranged in the fixed base and comprises two electric telescopic rods. The electromechanical positioning tool provided by the utility model has the advantages that the object is placed on the lifting plate, the object can be limited and fixed at the moment according to the use requirement, the air cylinder positioned in the fixing strip is started at the moment, the clamping plate can be adjusted to move, the object can be limited and fixed, meanwhile, the objects with different specifications can be clamped, and the two electric telescopic rods positioned in the fixing base are started, so that the effect of lifting the object can be achieved through the lifting of the lifting plate.

title_en: Filter element installation anti-rotation tool
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a filter element installation anti-rotation tool, which comprises an installation sleeve and a screw rod push rod, wherein the screw rod is arranged in the installation sleeve and matched with the installation sleeve; the installation sleeve comprises a nut and a sleeve fixedly connected with the nut, the nut is in threaded fit connection with the screw rod, the lower end of the sleeve is rotationally connected with a limiting block, and the length of the screw rod is greater than that of the installation sleeve. This filter core installation prevents changeing frock through the cooperation of lead screw push rod and stopper for realize opening of stopper under the effect of lead screw push rod, and then rotate the spacing to the filter core through the stopper, prevent that the filter core from taking place to follow the commentaries on classics.

title_en: Roller type scribing tool
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of scribing tools, and particularly relates to a roller type scribing tool which comprises a tool table, wherein a driving box is fixedly connected to the top of the tool table, a three-jaw chuck is fixedly connected to an output shaft of the driving box, a connecting assembly is arranged on the front side of the three-jaw chuck, and two fixing frames are fixedly connected to the top of the tool table. The three-jaw chuck is reasonable in structural design, through the arrangement of the connecting rod, the limiting disc and the pipe fitting connecting column, pipe fittings with different diameters can be fixed on the three-jaw chuck according to the pipe fitting connecting column with different diameters, and the positions of the two scribing rollers can be adjusted in a rotatable mode when the threaded rod is locked through the arrangement of the threaded rod, the nut sleeve and the scribing rollers, the scribing positions on the pipe fitting can be adjusted, meanwhile, the distance between the two scribing rollers can be adjusted, the scribing distance can be adjusted, and therefore the universality of the device is improved.

title_en: Automatic square tube adjusting type five-roller extrusion system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic square tube adjusting five-roller extrusion system, which comprises a base, an upper extrusion assembly, a side extrusion assembly and a lower extrusion assembly, wherein the upper extrusion assembly, the side extrusion assembly and the lower extrusion assembly are arranged on the base, and the automatic square tube adjusting five-roller extrusion system is characterized in that: and scrap iron grooves are formed in the top surfaces of the bases on two sides of the lower extrusion assembly, slots are formed in the bottoms of the scrap iron grooves, slag collecting drawers are inserted into the slots, and the slag collecting drawers are slidably connected in the slots. According to the utility model, the scrap iron groove is formed in the base, so that substances separated from the steel pipe can directly fall into the drawer through the scrap iron groove, the cleaning is convenient, and the cleaning can be realized without stopping equipment, so that the steel pipe is very convenient.

title_en: Refining device for waste ferrous metal smelting rolled product
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a refining device for waste ferrous metal smelting rolled products, which comprises a base, wherein a rolling adjustment mechanism is arranged in the base, the rolling adjustment mechanism comprises a shifting motor fixedly connected with the inside of the base, the output end of the shifting motor is fixedly connected with a transverse bidirectional screw rod, the outer side of the transverse bidirectional screw rod is in threaded connection with two threaded blocks, the top of each threaded block is fixedly connected with a movable frame, and the top of each movable frame is fixedly connected with a clamping motor. This device is thinned to old and useless ferrous metal smelting calendering article can adjust clamping position as required to make calendering article clamping firm accurate, stable with calendering article location between two briquetting, can prevent to lead to calendering article upper and lower both sides atress uneven in the calendering process, influence the calendering precision, and reduced whole device's driving piece, reduced use cost, reached the effect of being convenient for maintain, had higher practical application value.

title_en: Part overturning supporting assembly for machine tool machining
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of machining tools, in particular to a part overturning supporting assembly for machine tool machining, which comprises a workbench, wherein supporting rods are fixedly arranged at the bottom of the workbench at equal intervals, supporting blocks are fixedly arranged at the bottoms of the supporting rods, and expansion plates are embedded at the top of the workbench at equal intervals; the device is spacing the part through the recess that sets up the expansion plate top, increase the frictional force with the part through the inside rubber grain of recess for the expansion plate is more stable when supporting the part, makes the part be difficult for droing from the inside of recess, and the bottom of recess is the surface that the arc form can the laminating part more, and effectual improvement device's stability, the expansion plate is spacing through the inside of stopper embedding spacing groove, and the expansion plate is fixed in the inside of spout, thereby adjusts the position of expansion plate, makes the expansion plate can be according to the part length adjustment interval of difference, the effectual flexibility of improving the device.

title_en: Pipe frock of polishing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of aluminum polishing and discloses a circular tube polishing tool which comprises an equipment box, a fixing frame and a fan, wherein a first motor is fixedly connected to one side of the equipment box, a first driving wheel is fixedly connected to the output end of the first motor, a belt is movably connected to the outside of the first driving wheel, a driven wheel is movably connected to one end of the belt, which is far away from the first driving wheel, a first fixing block is fixedly connected to the top of the equipment box, a rotating roller is rotatably connected to the top of the first fixing block, a second fixing block is fixedly connected to the top of the equipment box, a second fixing roller is movably connected to the top of the second fixing block, a second motor is fixedly connected to the inside of the equipment box, and a second driving wheel is fixedly connected to the output end of the second motor. According to the aluminum polishing machine, the telescopic air cylinder, the clamping air cylinder, the bottom plate, the fixing column and the top plate are arranged, so that the aluminum polishing machine can automatically clamp the aluminum for fixed-point polishing, and the trouble that the aluminum is manually held for polishing in the prior art is avoided.

title_en: Extrusion clamping mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model provides an extrusion clamping mechanism, which comprises a bottom plate, a working plate, a left clamping mechanism, a right clamping mechanism, a left adjusting device, a right swinging rod connecting block, a right swinging rod connecting joint and a cylinder device, and has the beneficial effects that: the round bar column is pressed through the left and right clamping mechanisms, the pressure of the left and right clamping mechanisms is regulated through the left and right regulating devices, the left clamping mechanism and the right clamping mechanism are mutually close to each other for extrusion, the round bar column is clamped, the round bar column to be assembled is protected from being slowly clamped, damage caused by violent extrusion is avoided, and the round bar column clamping device is simple in structure and convenient to use.

title_en: Antistatic combined tool box
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an antistatic combined tool box, which comprises a box body, wherein the top surface of the box body is rotationally connected with a cover plate, one side of the box body is provided with a table plate, electrostatic fans are fixedly arranged on the surfaces of two sides of the box body, the table plate is fixedly arranged on the surface of one side of the box body through a folding assembly, and the table plate can be unfolded by the folding assembly to provide an operation platform for the tool box. The technical effects achieved are as follows: an operation platform can be unfolded through the folding assembly, so that workers can conveniently conduct working operation outdoors.

title_en: Clamping rotating mechanism of polishing device in steel pipe
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a clamping rotating mechanism of a polishing device in a steel pipe, which relates to the technical field of steel pipe machining and comprises a clamping plate, wherein a dust suction pipe is arranged on one side in the middle of the clamping plate, a dust suction box is arranged at the lower end of the dust suction pipe, a dust collection box is arranged in the dust suction box, a filter screen is arranged at the lower end of the dust collection box, a connecting pipe is arranged at the lower end of the filter screen, a blower is arranged on the outer surface of the rear end of the dust collection box, a second motor is arranged on the outer wall of the clamping plate, a rotating disc is arranged on the inner wall of the clamping plate, an electric telescopic rod is arranged at the front end of the rotating disc, and an arc-shaped clamping plate is arranged at the front end of the electric telescopic rod. According to the clamping rotating mechanism of the polishing device in the steel pipe, disclosed by the utility model, the device can absorb and remove scraps on the inner wall of the steel pipe when polishing the inner wall of the steel pipe, so that the scraps are prevented from being scattered out and falling on a workbench when the steel pipe rotates.

title_en: Carton printing and proofing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a carton printing and proofing device which comprises two support plates which are bilaterally symmetrical, wherein a belt conveyor is arranged between the two support plates and is used for conveying cartons placed above the two support plates from front to back; a guide device is arranged between the front ends of the two support plates; a plurality of shells are rotationally connected to the support plates, the shells are uniformly distributed and arranged in front and back, and one end of each shell, which is arranged on the outer sides of the two support plates, is provided with a driving device; one end of the shell, which is arranged between the two support plates, is provided with a compressing unit, and the compressing unit compresses the paper box on the belt conveyor; an air injection unit is arranged on the shell and used for blowing air into the paper box above the belt conveyor; the utility model solves the problem that paper box printing and proofing is easy to deviate.

title_en: Stamping die
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a stamping die, which relates to the technical field of stamping dies and particularly comprises a fixed seat, wherein angle pieces are arranged on the peripheral sides of the fixed seat, nail distances are fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the fixed seat and close to the peripheral sides of the angle pieces, compression springs are sleeved on the outer cambered surfaces of the nail distances, male die installation seats are connected to the tops of the nail distances in a penetrating manner, through holes are formed in the peripheral sides of the surfaces of the male die installation seats, fastening bolts are arranged in the through holes on the peripheral sides of the male die installation seats, the nail distances penetrate through the through holes on the surfaces of the male die installation seats through positioning pieces, the compression springs and the male die installation seats, and the compression springs are sleeved on the outer cambered surfaces of the nail distances to start automatic rebound, so that the positions of the nail distances are fixedly guided, meanwhile, the arc-shaped movable parts on one side of the male die installation seat surface are enabled to play a role in ensuring that the positioning pieces cannot rebound and deform in the pressing process, and meanwhile, a positioning plate is movably connected to the arc-shaped movable parts in order to play a supporting effect, so that assembly errors in the installation process are avoided.

title_en: Pipe cutting machine capable of processing tail
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a pipe cutting machine capable of processing a material tail, which comprises a frame and a feeding box slidingly connected to the frame, wherein a pipe installation shaft is installed on the feeding box, a clamping device coaxial with the installation shaft is arranged in front of the installation shaft, the clamping device is installed on a fixed plate slidingly connected with the frame, a pushing cylinder extending forwards and backwards is installed on the frame, the movable end of the pushing cylinder is fixedly connected with the fixed plate, a cutting device is installed on the frame, the cutting device is matched with the clamping device, the clamping device comprises a mounting plate fixedly connected to the fixed plate, a rotary table rotationally connected to the mounting plate and a plurality of sliding plates slidingly connected to the rotary table, a pipe clamping channel is formed by the matching of the sliding plates, the cutting device comprises a transverse shaft installed on the frame, a vertical shaft is slidingly connected to the transverse shaft in the left-right direction, and a cutter is slidingly connected to the vertical shaft in the up-down direction. The utility model can cut the tail part of the square tube, thereby saving materials.

title_en: Protective device for machining mechanical equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a protective device for machining mechanical equipment, which comprises a supporting plate, wherein a movable wheel is arranged at the bottom end of the supporting plate, a lifting groove is formed in the supporting plate, a lifting plate is arranged in the lifting groove in a lifting adjustable manner, a lifting adjusting structure is arranged between the lifting plate and the supporting plate, an observation window is arranged on the lifting plate, a collecting box is arranged below the inner side wall of the supporting plate, a discharging pipe is arranged at the bottom end of the collecting box in an outward extending manner, a spiral discharging shaft is arranged in the collecting box through a bearing and matched with the discharging pipe, a driving piece is arranged on the collecting box in a transmission connection with the spiral discharging shaft, an electromagnet is arranged on the inner wall of the supporting plate in a matched manner, and the electromagnet is connected with a power supply structure.

title_en: Casting type rocker arm clamping and polishing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses cast rocker arm clamp support polishing equipment which comprises a motor, wherein a bearing frame is arranged on the left side of the motor, the motor is embedded into the bearing frame in a half way, a delivery mechanism is fixedly connected to the left side of the bottom of the bearing frame, a polishing device is connected to the top of the delivery mechanism in a left-right sliding manner, the output end of the motor extends out of the left side of the bearing frame and is fixedly connected with a clamping transmission device, and the polishing device and the clamping transmission device are matched with each other to polish comprehensively and efficiently. The polishing plates are arranged on two sides to polish efficiently and rapidly, and meanwhile, the transverse acting force generated by single-side polishing to the rocker arm is counteracted, so that the problem that the rocker arm bends after polishing is avoided.

title_en: Split type is convenient for dismantle charging tray
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of design of structural components of laser punches, and particularly relates to a split type material tray convenient to detach, which comprises an inner tray, wherein a plurality of inner circular arc holes are formed in the outer circumference of the inner tray, the outer circumference of the inner tray is connected with a ring tray, outer circular arc holes which are in one-to-one correspondence with the inner circular arc holes are formed in the ring tray, the corresponding inner circular arc holes and the outer circular arc holes are butted to form tablet holes, the ring tray is formed by splicing a plurality of circular arc tray bodies, and each circular arc tray body is detachably connected with the inner tray. The split type convenient disassembly tray can disassemble the circular arc tray body, so that the bonded osmotic pump sheets are exposed, and the cleaning is convenient and quick.

title_en: Rotary cutting tool for precision machining of metal parts
abstract_en: The utility model provides a rotary cutting tool for precisely machining metal parts, which relates to the technical field of metal parts machining and comprises a bearing mounting table and a metal workpiece, wherein the top surface of the bearing mounting table is provided with a machining table, the top of the machining table is provided with a cutting device, the cutting device comprises a cutting cylinder, a mounting sleeve and a cutting tool, a positioning device is arranged in the mounting sleeve, the positioning hydraulic cylinder is vertically embedded into the mounting sleeve along the top end of the mounting sleeve, a movable end of the positioning hydraulic cylinder is movably connected with an electric shaft, the bottom surface of the electric shaft is connected with a positioning ball, the cutting tool can realize the rotary cutting and positioning integration of the whole metal workpiece by utilizing the positioning ball and the metal workpiece surface after cutting the metal workpiece surface, the integrated degree of integration is high, and the cutting positioning tool is convenient for the cutting positioning and the metal workpiece.

title_en: Sheet metal part blanking device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of blanking, in particular to a sheet metal part blanking device which comprises a shell seat, a clamping structure and a translation structure, wherein the translation structure is connected with a movable frame, the movable frame is provided with a blanking part for cutting a sheet metal part, and the movable frame is connected with a polishing part for polishing a cutting opening; the polishing part comprises a moving rod fixed with the moving frame, a plurality of groups of polishing members are movably arranged on the moving rod, connecting members for connecting the plurality of groups of polishing members are arranged on the moving rod, and a power member for driving the connecting members is arranged on the moving rod; the polishing and grinding piece comprises an electric push rod II, a motor I is installed at the movable end of the electric push rod II, and a roller brush is installed at the output end of the motor I. According to the utility model, the sheet metal part to be blanked is placed on the shell seat and locked by the clamping structure, the blanking part is moved and controlled to cut, and after the cutting is finished, the polishing part is controlled to polish and burre the position of the cutting opening, so that the blanking polishing integration is realized, and the production and processing efficiency is improved.

title_en: Chip removing device for bearing machining
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a chip removing device for bearing machining, which belongs to the technical field of bearing machining and comprises a machining lathe and a dust cover; the tail end of the hose is connected with the outer wall of the machine at one side of the cutter head through threads; the accommodating structure is arranged at the rear end of the inner wall of the hose and is used for collecting and storing scrap iron; the cleaning assembly is fixedly arranged at the front side of the lower end of the inner wall of the dust cover and is used for cleaning scrap iron. The utility model discloses a tool bit is used to the end screw connection of hose, the outer wall of machinery on one side of tool bit for can aim at the cutting position with the air cock of hose end, make the piece break away from fast, set up the second fixed block in the front side of dust cover simultaneously, in the funnel that the clearance of piece on the lathe was all to the rear side setting, and fall into the collecting box and store, make the piece on the machine tool that can clear away fast, reduce the influence of piece to machinery.

title_en: Board shearing device for printed circuit board production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of printed circuit board production, and discloses a plate shearing device for printed circuit board production, which comprises a workbench, wherein the bottom of the workbench is fixedly connected with supporting legs.
