This board shearing mechanism is used in printed circuit board production is provided with the delivery sheet, first motor, the lead screw, splint, the fixed plate, second motor, screw rod and slide bar, through placing the panel on the delivery sheet, then start first motor drive splint and fix the panel, start the second motor and inwards remove the delivery sheet, send the bottom of shearing mechanism, whole process staff only need place the panel on the delivery sheet, keep certain distance with the staff at the in-process of shearing, reduce the possibility of accidentally injuring the staff, the security of shearing the circuit board panel has been improved greatly, the problem that the manual fixed circuit board panel carelessly can the accidentally injure the staff at the in-process of cutting is solved.

title_en: Cable coating punching machine
abstract_en: The application discloses a cable diolame piercing press relates to piercing press technical field. The utility model discloses a carry the table body, the top of carrying the table body is provided with the support frame, electric putter is installed to the top of support frame, electric putter's output is connected with the hole puncher, be connected with positioning mechanism and fixture on the carrying table body respectively, the top both ends of support frame are fixed with fire extinguishing mechanism and cooling mechanism respectively, in the compressed air that produces it lets in air collecting pipe and play tuber pipe through starting the air-blower, has increased the scope of blowing through setting up a plurality of play tuber pipes, is favorable to carrying out effective heat dissipation to the diolame border after the completion of punching a hole, has solved the structure that lacks the fire prevention on the device when punching a hole to can not carry out effective heat dissipation to the diolame border after the completion of punching a hole, these problems have all increased the problem of potential safety hazard when cable diolame punches a hole.

title_en: Feeding device for slitting machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of slitting machines and discloses a feeding device for a slitting machine, which comprises a supporting table, wherein a cutting box is fixedly connected to the top wall of the supporting table, a motor I is fixedly connected to the outer side wall of the cutting box, a worm is fixedly connected to the output end of the motor I, a worm wheel is connected to the side wall of the worm in a threaded manner, a fixing plate is arranged on the bottom wall of the worm wheel and is fixedly connected to the inner side wall of the cutting box, a threaded column I is fixedly connected to the inner side wall of the worm wheel, a lifting plate is connected to the outer side wall of the threaded column I in a threaded manner, and the threaded column I is rotatably connected to the inside of the supporting table. According to the utility model, the effect of cutting off materials is achieved by mutually matching the supporting table, the cutting box, the motor I, the worm wheel, the fixing plate, the thread column I, the chute I and the blade, and the problem that a large amount of materials are wasted due to the fact that the residual raw materials cannot be collected and cut in time is solved.

title_en: Manual chain grinder
abstract_en: The utility model provides a manual chain grinder, which comprises two handle blocks and is characterized in that a limiting chain grinding structure for grinding a chain is arranged on the two handle blocks; and the handle block and the limiting mill chain structure are provided with a quick assembly disassembly structure for fixing the limiting mill chain structure. When the chain is polished, the chain can be polished without detaching the chain, so that the chain can be polished quickly, and the operation is simple and convenient.

title_en: Pipe machining device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pipe machining device, and relates to the technical field of pipe machining equipment. The pipe machining device comprises a frame, a feeding mechanism, a machining mechanism, a discharging mechanism and a grabbing mechanism, wherein the feeding mechanism is arranged on one side of the frame, the feeding mechanism comprises a wheel disc, a first connecting plate, a jacking plate and a fixing plate, the two fixing plates are fixedly connected with each other and are provided with a feeding groove, a righting plate which is L-shaped is movably connected in each feeding groove, the first connecting plate is obliquely arranged on one side far away from the frame, the jacking plate is arranged between the fixing plate and the first connecting plate, the wheel disc is arranged on the other side of the first connecting plate, and the second connecting plate is obliquely arranged on the other side of the frame. According to the utility model, the wheel disc and the jacking plate are matched to convey the pipe, manual operation is not needed during feeding, the production requirement of a continuous production line can be met, and the production efficiency is improved.

title_en: Railing processing fixed length cutting equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of machine tools, in particular to a railing processing fixed-length cutting device which comprises a base, a cutting mechanism, a clamping mechanism and a piece processing device, wherein the piece processing device comprises a collecting box, a suction fan, a dust collecting assembly, an opening assembly and an auxiliary assembly, the collecting box is detachably connected with the base, the suction fan is detachably connected with the collecting box and fixedly connected with the base, the dust collecting assembly is arranged on the collecting box, the opening assembly is arranged on the base, the auxiliary assembly is arranged on the base, when an aluminum alloy railing is cut, the suction fan is started, the suction fan generates suction force to suck air in the collecting box, negative pressure is formed in the collecting box, suction force is generated through the dust collecting assembly to the position where the railing is located, so that generated pieces enter the collecting box through the dust collecting assembly when the railing is cut, the generated pieces are timely collected, and the chips are prevented from being diffused into the air to pollute the processing environment.

title_en: Polishing device for panel light shell processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a polishing device for processing a panel lamp shell, and relates to the technical field of panel lamp processing. The polishing device for processing the panel lamp shell comprises an operation table and a surface changing mechanism, wherein a strip-shaped opening is formed in the top of the operation table; the surface changing mechanism is arranged at the top of the operating platform and comprises a connecting plate, a locating plate, a band-type brake motor, a rotating rod and a clamping block, wherein the rotating rod is respectively and rotatably arranged on the adjacent sides of the connecting plate and the locating plate, one side of the locating plate is fixedly provided with the band-type brake motor, an output shaft of the band-type brake motor is fixedly connected with one end of one group of rotating rods, the clamping block is fixedly arranged at the other end of the rotating rod, and the panel lamp shell is turned over in the polishing process. After polishing one side of the panel light shell, the shell does not need to be taken down, the panel light shell is automatically polished by changing the surface, the operation steps of the device in use are simplified, and the workload of workers in use is reduced.

title_en: Umbrella middle rod buckling machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an umbrella middle rod buckling and pressing machine, which belongs to the field of umbrella processing equipment, and has the technical scheme that the umbrella middle rod buckling and pressing machine comprises a machine table, wherein a buckling and pressing mechanism is arranged on the machine table and comprises a gear plate, and when the gear plate rotates, the umbrella middle rod is buckled and pressed; the umbrella middle rod is close to the proximity switch when placed in the buckling opening, and the proximity switch transmits a control signal to the controller, so that the driving component is controlled to drive the gear disc to rotate.

title_en: Automatic feeding and discharging mechanism for grinding machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic feeding and discharging mechanism for a grinding machine, which comprises a turnover mechanism, wherein a linear mechanism is fixedly arranged on the turnover mechanism and used for driving a clamping mechanism to move in position, and two clamping mechanisms are arranged. According to the utility model, the turnover mechanism drives the linear mechanism and the clamping mechanism to perform turnover on the position, then the linear mechanism drives the two clamping mechanisms to perform synchronous movement, one clamping mechanism starts the clamping operation on the part, and the other clamping mechanism can take off the processed part along with the reset operation of the turnover mechanism and the driving of the linear mechanism, and then the clamping mechanism with the part clamped can place the processed part on the position to be processed, so that the structure can automatically perform loading and unloading operation on the part, and the efficiency is high, and the work can be performed without personnel.

title_en: Hook type shot blasting machine capable of rotating
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hook type shot blasting machine capable of rotating, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein both sides of the top end of the bottom plate are respectively provided with a fixed plate, one side of the fixed plate is provided with a first motor, a first screw rod driven by the first motor is arranged between the fixed plates, the first screw rod is provided with a first moving block, the top end of the first moving block is provided with a guide structure, the bottom end of the first moving block is provided with a rotation type hooking structure, a shot blasting chamber is arranged above the bottom plate, the top end of the shot blasting chamber is provided with an opening, a movable shot blasting structure is arranged in the shot blasting chamber, and one side of the shot blasting chamber is provided with a return structure connected with the bottom end of the shot blasting chamber. Compared with the prior art, the utility model has the advantages that: not only can the function of continuous rotation of the lifting hook be ensured, but also the shot blasting can be realized by moving the shot discharging box up and down, so that the angles of the product can be cleaned conveniently, and the quality and the strength of the surface of the product can be improved more efficiently.

title_en: Multi-working-position welding equipment for metal fittings
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a multi-working-position welding device for metal fittings, which comprises a machine table, wherein a feeding mechanism, a laser coding mechanism, a first laser welding mechanism, a spot welding mechanism, a second laser welding mechanism, a first conveying mechanism, a second conveying mechanism, a third conveying mechanism and a fourth conveying mechanism are sequentially arranged on the machine table along the conveying direction of a main part of the fitting, the first conveying mechanism is arranged between the feeding mechanism and the first laser welding mechanism, the second conveying mechanism is arranged between the first laser welding mechanism and the spot welding mechanism, the third conveying mechanism is arranged between the spot welding mechanism and the second laser welding mechanism, and the fourth conveying mechanism is butted with the second laser welding mechanism to weld finished products for blanking. The equipment can be used for finishing multiple working procedures of processing and feeding, laser coding, laser welding, spot welding and detecting and discharging, and is high in precision and high in efficiency.

title_en: Steel construction roof color steel tile hem device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a steel structure roof color steel tile flanging device which comprises a processing table, wherein an installation groove is formed in the back surface of the processing table, an installation plate is fixedly connected to the bottom of the inner wall of the installation groove, placing components are arranged on the front surfaces of the two installation plates, a lower die is connected between one opposite sides of the two installation plates in a sliding mode, two rotating components are arranged on the front surface of the lower die, a hydraulic component is arranged between the tops of the two installation plates, and a connecting component I is arranged at the bottom of the hydraulic component. According to the utility model, through the matched use of the structures of the placing assembly, the rotating assembly, the first connecting assembly and the connecting assembly, the lower die or the upper die can be independently and quickly disassembled, so that the production efficiency of the stamping die is ensured, meanwhile, the increase of the processing cost of the color steel tile caused by integral disassembly is avoided, and the practicability of the color steel tile flanging device is improved.

title_en: Pressing riveting die for parts
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a press riveting die for a part, which comprises a press riveting die main body, wherein a connecting pipe is inserted into one side of the top of the press riveting die main body in a penetrating manner, a connecting hole is formed in the top end of the connecting pipe in a penetrating manner, and a U-shaped groove is formed in one side of the surface of the press riveting die main body. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the press riveting die main body, the connecting pipe, the connecting hole and the U-shaped groove, the die is arranged on the pneumatic press riveting machine by the matching work of the U-shaped groove and the connecting hole of the connecting pipe, so that the press riveting die can be suitable for directly press riveting small-size U-shaped pieces, can be used for turning over and riveting small-size U-shaped pieces, and can also be used for indirectly press riveting parts, thereby achieving the press riveting effect on parts with different sizes, the press plate is pressed by the worker, the inserting block is inserted into the press riveting mechanism by the worker, and then the press plate is loosened, so that the compression spring ejects the limiting inserting block on one side of the connecting plate, and the limiting inserting block is inserted into the press riveting mechanism to limit.

title_en: Quick blank device of titanium and titanium alloy section bar
abstract_en: The utility model provides a rapid blanking device for titanium and titanium alloy sections, which comprises the following components: the workbench is characterized in that a mounting frame is mounted on one side of the surface of the workbench, a cutting device is arranged in the mounting frame, the cutting device comprises a hydraulic telescopic rod, the bottom end of the hydraulic telescopic rod is connected with a cutting knife, and a cutting seat is connected to the bottom of the inner wall of the mounting frame and located below the cutting knife; the induction component is arranged on one side of the mounting frame; and the control device is arranged in the workbench. According to the rapid cutting device for the titanium and titanium alloy sections, the mounting frame, the cutting seat, the hydraulic telescopic rod with the cutting knife and the control device are arranged on the surface of the workbench to be matched for operation, so that the cutting speed can be improved when the titanium alloy sections are cut, meanwhile, the cutting surface of the titanium alloy sections can be tidy, and the operation of grinding the cutting surface is not needed again.

title_en: Perforating device with locate function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a perforating device with a positioning function, which comprises a support, wherein a workbench surface is arranged at the top of the support, a dust collection component is arranged at one side of the bottom of the support, a positioning component is arranged at one side of the top of the workbench surface, one side of the top of the support is fixedly connected with a support frame, a sliding rail is arranged at the top of the support frame, a sliding block is connected onto the sliding rail in a sliding manner, a stepping motor is arranged at the top of the sliding block, and a supporting plate is arranged at one side of the stepping motor. According to the utility model, the positioning assembly is arranged, when punching is performed, the wind power equipment assembly needing positioning and clamping is placed on the limiting block, and then the adjusting block is driven to move to the designated position through the hydraulic rod, so that the wind power equipment assembly is positioned and fixed, time and energy are saved, the working efficiency is improved, the artificial error is avoided, the working precision is improved, the operation convenience is improved, the misoperation and damage of the punching device are reduced, the maintenance and replacement cost is reduced, the waste of materials and resources is reduced, and the resource utilization efficiency is improved.

title_en: Sealing gasket manufacturing device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of sealing gasket cutting tools, in particular to a sealing gasket manufacturing device which comprises an angle monitoring component, a displacement monitoring component, a driving component, a screw rod, a first cutting component, a connecting rod and a first fixing component. The sealing gasket manufacturing device can avoid displacement deviation and improve the precision of sealing gasket manufacturing.

title_en: Numerical control high-speed dividing and cutting machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of cutting machines, in particular to a numerical control high-speed cutting machine, which comprises a cutting machine body and a cleaning assembly, wherein the cleaning assembly comprises a mounting frame, a dust collector, a material guide plate and a waste groove, the cutting machine body is used for cutting materials such as paper and films, the cleaning assembly is used for absorbing dust generated during cutting and collecting waste generated during cutting, the phenomenon that the waste is accumulated to prevent the transportation of the materials is avoided, the mounting frame is particularly used for providing a support for the dust collector, the dust collector is used for absorbing the dust generated during cutting, the dust is prevented from drifting to pollute the environment, the cutting waste can fall onto the material guide plate under the action of gravity, and the material guide plate guides the waste into the waste groove for collection, so that the self-cleaning of the waste is realized, and the problem that the phenomenon that the waste is accumulated on the cutting machine to prevent the transportation of the materials is avoided, the transportation of the waste cannot be cleaned timely, and the processing of the high-speed cutting machine is affected is solved.

title_en: Rubber slitter of adjustable strip width
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of rubber processing, and discloses a rubber slitter with adjustable strip width, which comprises a supporting frame, wherein two baffles distributed in an opposite mode are fixedly connected to the top of the supporting frame, bearing bases are fixedly connected to the top of the baffles, a roll shaft is arranged between the two bearing bases, a plurality of sleeves are sleeved on one side of the roll shaft, and cutting sheets are fixedly connected to the circumferential outer wall of each sleeve. According to the utility model, the positioning sliding block is in a movable state in the positioning groove through the unlocking component, then the distance between two adjacent cutting sheets is adjusted by any numerical value, the two adjacent cutting sheets are fixed through the locking component, then the rubber sheets are moved to the lower parts of the cutting sheets through the conveying component, and meanwhile, the continuously moving rubber sheets are segmented through the transmission component, so that the device can perform slitting operation on rubber strips with different sizes, and the using effect of the device is improved.

title_en: Steel bar packing briquetting device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of steel bar treatment, and provides a steel bar packing and briquetting device which comprises a base and a processing box fixedly arranged above the base through a base rod, wherein a pressing mechanism is arranged at the top of the processing box, a vibrating mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the processing box, and a treatment box which is communicated is fixedly arranged at one side of the processing box. Through vibration mechanism and induced draft cooperation, block the filtration through the filter plate in the impurity suction treatment case, back through motor drive reciprocating screw and cam rotation, cam cooperation spring makes filter plate reciprocating motion shake the impurity on its surface off to through the brush board removal, clean the filter plate surface reciprocating, make the impurity of clearance fall into and collect in the box, then realize the effect of automatic clearance to the filter plate at the in-process of induced draft edulcoration, prevent that impurity from remaining to block up the filter plate and influence its permeability, effectively improved effect and the efficiency that impurity was got rid of.

title_en: Anti-lock device of cold shearing machine
abstract_en: The utility model provides an anti-lock device of a cold shearing machine, which comprises: the brake is provided with a detection hole at one end; a reduction gearbox; the clutch is matched with the brake through the reduction gearbox; the brake is connected with the shearing mechanism; the motion assembly is arranged at the action end of the brake and is matched with the detection hole; the detection assembly comprises a fixing frame and a detection element, the detection element is fixed on the fixing frame, a detection hole at one end of the fixing frame, which is close to the brake, is formed in the position right above the detection element; and the programmable controller is connected with the detection element. The clutch is interlocked with the brake through the programmable controller, equipment faults are avoided, and downtime is reduced.

title_en: Guide rod cylinder positioning self-locking mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a guide rod cylinder positioning self-locking mechanism, which comprises: the device comprises a fixed seat, a linear cylinder, a pair of guide mechanisms and a push plate; the linear cylinder is connected with the fixed seat; the pair of guide mechanisms are respectively arranged at two sides of the linear cylinder and are connected with the fixed seat; the push plate is respectively connected with the linear cylinder and the output end of the guide mechanism. The utility model has simple structure, high positioning precision and low cost.

title_en: Discharge mechanism of double-end-face grinding machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a discharging mechanism of a double-end-face grinding machine, and relates to the technical field of double-end-face grinding machines. The utility model comprises a positioning mechanism and a magnetic attraction structure, wherein the magnetic attraction structure is connected to a frame body at the upper end of the positioning mechanism in a sliding manner; the positioning mechanism comprises a rotary machine seat and a fixed sleeve, the upper end of a machine shaft of the rotary machine seat is fixedly connected with the fixed sleeve through a positioning piece, and one side of the fixed sleeve is fixedly connected with a sliding rod for connecting and supporting the magnetic attraction structure; the magnetic attraction structure comprises a sliding block, a hydraulic pusher and a carrying disc, wherein the bottom of the sliding block is fixedly connected with the hydraulic pusher, the lower end of a push rod of the hydraulic pusher is fixedly connected with the carrying disc, and a through fixing hole is formed in the surface of the carrying disc and fixedly connected with the electromagnet through the fixing hole. The utility model solves the problem of troublesome unloading and transferring of the double-end-face grinding machine through the positioning mechanism and the magnetic attraction structure.

title_en: Manual edging of photovoltaic module is with edging sword
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a manual edging cutter for a photovoltaic module, which comprises a cutter shell and an art designer blade arranged in the cutter shell, wherein the art designer blade is in threaded screwing connection with the cutter shell, one side of the cutter shell is in threaded screwing connection with a handle, and the handle is used for holding; according to the utility model, the craft knife blade is arranged in the cutter shell in a screwed mode, so that the craft knife blade and the cutter shell can be additionally connected, a user can conveniently replace the craft knife blade, the damaged craft knife blade can be detached and replaced at any time, the whole device is not required to be discarded, so that loss is reduced, meanwhile, the handle arranged on one side of the cutter shell adopts a unique radian design, the structure characteristics of a human body are met, the operation is convenient, and meanwhile, the detachable connection of the handle and the cutter shell can conveniently replace a part which is singly damaged.

title_en: Electric tail wing defect detection device based on machine vision
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electric tail wing defect detection device based on machine vision, and relates to the technical field of tail wing detection; the utility model comprises a processing plate, wherein a supporting rod is fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the processing plate, a top plate is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the supporting rod, an electric sliding rail is fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the top plate, a driving block is connected to the electric sliding rail and penetrates through the top plate, and a detector is fixedly arranged at the lower end of the driving block.

title_en: Positioning perforating machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a positioning puncher, which relates to the technical field of sofa processing and comprises a top plate and a bearing plate, wherein four corners of the bottom surface of the top plate are fixedly connected with supporting legs, four corners of the bottom surface of the bearing plate are fixedly connected with wheels, the upper part of the bearing plate is used for placing a sofa, a punching mechanism is fixedly connected below the top plate, the supporting legs are fixedly connected with a sliding mechanism, and a positioning mechanism and a dust collecting mechanism are fixedly connected above the bearing plate. According to the sofa punching device, the sofa can be punched at any position in the horizontal direction through the punching mechanism, the sofa with different sizes can be clamped and limited through the mutual matching of the fixed front plate, the screw rod III, the threaded sleeve, the movable side plate, the fixed rear plate, the electric push rod II and the clamping block, and dust and fragments generated in the punching process can be collected and processed in a concentrated mode through the mutual matching of the dust collection box and the dust collector.

title_en: Round tube coiling machine
abstract_en: The application relates to a round tube coiling machine, which relates to the technical field of coiling machines and comprises a frame, a feeding disc for feeding, a feeding device for feeding the tube, a coiling device for clamping and coiling the tube and a cutting device for cutting the tube, wherein the feeding disc, the coiling device, the feeding device and the cutting device are arranged on one side of the frame far away from the ground, the feeding disc and the coiling device are positioned at two ends along the length direction of the frame, the cutting device is positioned between the feeding disc and the coiling device, and the feeding device is positioned on one side of the cutting device close to the feeding disc. The application has the effect of improving the coiling efficiency of the heat shrink tube.

title_en: Rotating wheel fixing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rotating wheel fixing device, and relates to the technical field of hydroelectric generation. The rotating wheel fixing device comprises a bottom plate, a buckling mechanism and a clamping mechanism, wherein a transmission cavity is formed in the bottom plate, the clamping mechanism is arranged on the bottom plate and comprises a motor B, a bidirectional screw rod, sliding rods and a positioning plate, the motor B is fixedly arranged on the outer surface of the front side of the bottom plate, the bidirectional screw rod is rotatably arranged between the inner walls of the front side and the rear side of the transmission cavity, a rotating shaft of the motor B is in transmission connection with the bidirectional screw rod, and two groups of sliding rods are fixedly arranged between the inner walls of the front side and the rear side of the transmission cavity. This runner fixing device, through fixture, positioning groove and the cooperation in track groove, especially the position adjustable design of four sets of gag levers, can be to not unidimensional runner, on different dimension direction, carry out the omnidirectional to the runner and fix, avoid taking place the condition of skew, improved the fixed effect of runner, promoted the practicality of device.

title_en: Product mould gas tightness detection device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of mold detection, in particular to a product mold air tightness detection device, which comprises a base groove, wherein four fixing columns are fixedly connected in the base groove, a fixing plate is fixedly connected on the fixing columns, two first cylinders are fixedly connected on the fixing plate through a mounting frame, and a top plate is fixedly connected on the first cylinders; through setting up the grip block, the starter motor, the motor output shaft drives the pivot and rotates, the pivot drives first belt pulley and rotates, first belt pulley passes through the belt and drives first belt pulley and second belt pulley and rotate, drive two-way threaded rod and rotate, the drive grip block removes, when moving grip block and mould surface contact, close the motor, it is fixed to carry out the centre gripping with the mould, the antiskid cover can increase the frictional force of grip block, strengthen fixed effect, prevent that the mould from producing when going up and down and sliding, unable completely shelter from the die cavity when sealed lid descends, lead to sealing inaccurately, cause gas leakage, make observation result produce the error.

title_en: Deburring mechanism of gear hobbing machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a deburring mechanism of a gear hobbing machine, in particular to the field of deburring mechanisms, which comprises a device body and further comprises: one side of the device body is provided with a friction polishing device which can be compactly clamped in the gear groove and is used for clamping the gear groove by utilizing an elastic mechanism, so that the accurate requirement is reduced, and more compact deburring polishing is realized; an elastic clamping device capable of deburring the upper end is arranged on one side of the device body and used for polishing burrs left at the upper end, so that a more comprehensive deburring effect is realized; the device body comprises a movable column, the movable column is movably arranged at the upper end of the device body, the upper end of the movable column is fixedly connected with a bearing table, the upper end of the bearing table is fixedly connected with a hexagonal clamping block, and the outer surface of the hexagonal clamping block is detachably connected with a gear. The elastic clamping device is arranged, so that the elastic mechanism is favorable for clamping the gear groove.

title_en: Glass positioning mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of glass processing, in particular to a glass positioning mechanism, which comprises a bracket and an upper positioning assembly arranged on the bracket, wherein the upper positioning assembly comprises a workbench, a plurality of placing plates arranged on the workbench and used for placing glass, a first stop block and a second stop block which are respectively arranged on two adjacent sides of the placing plates, a mounting seat which is arranged on the workbench in a sliding manner, and a plurality of third stop blocks which are arranged on the mounting seat at intervals, wherein the third stop blocks are respectively positioned on one side, far away from the first stop blocks, of the placing plates, and a sliding piece which is used for driving the mounting seat to move along the arrangement direction of the placing plates is arranged on the workbench; still include the curb plate, set up in the curb plate on the mounting panel, be provided with a plurality of fourth dog on the mounting panel, the fourth dog is located the one side of placing the board and keeping away from the second dog, is provided with the driving piece that the drive mounting panel moved along being close to or keeping away from the board direction of placing on the curb plate. The utility model has the effects of improving the glass positioning accuracy and improving the efficiency.

title_en: Building materials cutting machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a building material cutting machine, which comprises a cutting machine body, wherein the cutting machine body comprises a supporting frame, a supporting seat and a cutting shaft are arranged on the supporting frame, a connecting sleeve is arranged on the cutting shaft, a connecting bolt is arranged between the connecting sleeve and the cutting shaft, a mounting sleeve and a fixing chuck are fixedly arranged on one side of the connecting sleeve, a movable chuck is arranged on one side of the fixing chuck, a mounting bolt and a saw blade are arranged between the fixing chuck and the movable chuck, a feeding plate is slidably arranged on the supporting frame, a sliding rail is arranged on the supporting frame, a sliding groove is arranged at the bottom of the feeding plate, the cutting shaft rotates between the two supporting seats through the cutting shaft, the stability of the cutting shaft during rotation is improved, the connecting sleeve and the mounting sleeve are conveniently and fixedly connected with the cutting shaft through the connecting sleeve and the connecting bolt, the saw blade is conveniently mounted on the mounting sleeve and the cutting shaft through the fixing chuck, the saw blade is conveniently mounted and maintained, and the moving direction of the feeding plate is limited through the sliding rail and the sliding groove.

title_en: Spot welding device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of welding equipment and discloses a spot welding device which comprises a robot, a walking shaft and a welding gun module, wherein the walking shaft is arranged at the tail end of the robot, the welding gun module is arranged on a moving seat of the walking shaft, the walking shaft is used for driving the welding gun module to move along the length direction of the walking shaft, in practical application, the robot is arranged on a walking ground rail of the robot, at the moment, the robot can move on the walking ground rail of the robot, the tail end of the robot is provided with the walking shaft, the welding gun module is arranged on the moving seat of the walking shaft, at the moment, the robot can drive the walking shaft to move, and the welding gun module can move on the walking shaft.

title_en: Coaxiality assembly quality
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a coaxiality assembly device, which comprises a correction rod, wherein the two ends of the correction rod are respectively provided with a left correction end and a right correction end, a rod body open slot is arranged between a rod body of the correction rod and the left correction end and the right correction end, the left correction end and the right correction end are respectively provided with a cylindrical hole and a conical hole communicated with the cylindrical hole, and a plurality of conical open slots are distributed on the inner wall of the conical hole; the assembly device also comprises a left pressing block and a right pressing block which are respectively matched with the left correction end and the right correction end, a left bolt and a right bolt, and a threaded through hole which is matched with the left bolt and the right bolt is arranged in the rod body. When the coaxial type coaxial connector is used, the rod body opening groove and the conical opening groove are of groove body structures which can be unfolded and contracted, the left pressing block and the right pressing block are extruded during coaxial alignment, the inner wall of the conical hole is pressed, the rod body opening groove and the conical opening groove are unfolded or deformed under the condition of being pressed, the outer side parts of the left and right alignment ends are unfolded and tightly supported with the motor housing bearing chamber and the end cover bearing chamber, the purpose of coaxial high-precision assembly is achieved, the whole process is convenient and rapid, operation is easy, and time and labor are saved.

title_en: Even cutting device of camphor tree section
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of camphor tree section cutting, and discloses a camphor tree section uniform cutting device, which comprises a base, wherein a cutting mechanism for uniformly cutting a camphor tree section into a plurality of pieces is arranged on the base, the cutting mechanism comprises a plurality of rotary saw blades, the axes of the rotary saw blades are parallel to a horizontal plane and are positioned on the same straight line, and the distance between any two adjacent rotary saw blades is the same value; the cutting machine also comprises a motion mechanism, wherein the motion mechanism drives the cutting mechanism to move upwards or downwards. The camphor tree blocks cut by the method are used for cultivating the camphor ganoderma lucidum, so that waste of camphor tree timber can be avoided, and nutrients required by cultivating the camphor ganoderma lucidum can be ensured.

title_en: Multidirectional welding system for grille frame
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi-directional welding system for a grid frame, which comprises a plurality of groups of gate-shaped brackets arranged in parallel, wherein a movable welding device is arranged between two adjacent gate-shaped brackets, the movable welding device comprises a first ground rail component, a second ground rail component, a welding control cabinet, a lifting component, a mounting seat, a multi-axis robot and a welding head, the first ground rail component is arranged in parallel with the gate-shaped brackets, the second ground rail component is arranged on a base of the first ground rail component and is arranged in a crisscross manner with the base of the first ground rail component, the welding control cabinet is fixed on the base of the second ground rail component, the mounting seat is fixed on the side surface of the welding control cabinet through the lifting component, the multi-axis robot is fixed on the mounting seat, and the welding head is fixed at the tail end of the multi-axis robot and is connected with the welding control cabinet. Through the use of the welding machine system, a plurality of mobile welding devices can be welded simultaneously, the welding efficiency is greatly improved, the labor cost is saved, and the welding quality is improved.

title_en: Automatic board-dividing plug-in assembly line
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of lamp assembly, in particular to an automatic board-dividing plug-in assembly line, which comprises a front frame, wherein a light source board processing mechanism is arranged on one side of the front frame, a vibration feeding mechanism is arranged on one side of the light source board processing mechanism, a front section combining mechanism is further arranged on the surface of the front frame, a rear frame is placed on one side of the front frame, a disc is rotatably connected to the surface of the rear frame, a rear section combining mechanism is fixed on the surface of the rear frame and positioned on the outer side of the disc, a lamp cup feeding mechanism is arranged on one side of the rear frame, and a discharging mechanism is further fixed on the surface of the rear frame. The utility model realizes the processes of automatic feeding and discharging, automatic plate separation, resistance protection, lateral line, automatic electrolysis plug-in and the like, and simultaneously realizes the processes of automatic feeding and discharging, automatic wire arrangement, automatic lamp cup feeding, automatic angle adjustment, lateral line hanging, wire cutting and the like; therefore, the full automation can be realized, personnel are saved, the efficiency is improved, the precision is improved, and the production cost is reduced.

title_en: Milling machine positioning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a milling machine positioning device which comprises a base, a sliding block, a driving screw and a first clamping assembly, wherein a first positioning protrusion and a second positioning protrusion are arranged on the base, a first threaded hole is formed in the first positioning protrusion, the sliding block is connected to the base in a sliding mode and is positioned between the first positioning protrusion and the second positioning protrusion, two second threaded holes are formed in the sliding block at intervals, the driving screw is in threaded connection with the first threaded hole, the driving screw abuts against the sliding block, the first clamping assembly comprises a first connecting plate, two first clamping plates and two first adjusting bolts, the first connecting plate is detachably connected to the sliding block, the two first clamping plates are hinged to two ends of the first connecting plate, the first adjusting bolts are in threaded connection with the second threaded holes, and the two first adjusting bolts abut against the two first clamping plates respectively. The milling machine positioning device disclosed by the utility model is not easy to slip when clamping a cylindrical workpiece, and is simple in structure and easy to operate.

title_en: Bolt fastener grinding device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bolt fastener polishing device which comprises a device main body and a roller arranged above the device main body, wherein a sponge sand block is fixedly arranged on the inner side surface of the roller above the device main body, a bearing is arranged on the outer side surface of the roller, and the roller is rotationally connected with the bearing. According to the utility model, the roller arranged above the device main body can be fixed in the bearing, the roller can rotate at the joint of the inner ring and the inner ring in the bearing, and the outer ring of the bearing is fixedly connected with the fixed block, so that the roller can be ensured to be stable while rotation is not influenced, the roller can be fixed through the bearing, the stability of the roller is improved, the sponge sand block fixedly arranged in the roller can be driven to rotate while the roller rotates, the roller can be driven to move up and down through the expansion and contraction of the hydraulic rod, and the bolt surface can be polished, so that the polishing quality is improved.

title_en: Stretching machine tool
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a stretching machine tool, which relates to the technical field of copper pipe stretching and comprises a machine table, wherein side plates are fixed at the tops of two sides of the machine table, a transverse drill chuck is fixed at the inner side of one side plate, a transverse telescopic cylinder is fixed at the inner side of the other side plate, a drill chuck is also fixed at the free end of a piston rod of the telescopic cylinder, a measuring frame is slidably arranged on the top of the machine table, the measuring frame comprises a bottom plate slidably arranged on the top of the machine table, mounting rods are arranged at the tops of the front end and the rear end of the bottom plate close to the bottom plate, scale marks are arranged on the surfaces of the mounting rods, and two elastic clamps which are arranged up and down are arranged between the two mounting rods. After the copper pipe is stretched by the machine, the measuring frame is moved, so that the outer diameters of different positions of the stretched copper pipe can be measured, the machine is very convenient, the time is saved, and the error is not very large.

title_en: Cage apparatus for producing with protective structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides a retainer production device with a protection structure, which relates to the technical field of retainer production and comprises a device body; the device body is provided with the plummer, plummer bottom terminal surface four corners all is provided with the support section of thick bamboo that link up from top to bottom, plummer bottom terminal surface both ends are all provided with the semicircle head piece of the through-hole about taking about, plummer top terminal surface both ends are all provided with the semicircle head post of the through-hole about taking about in the middle of both ends about, plummer top terminal surface periphery has been seted up the ring channel, make things convenient for the cutting protection casing to install through the fixed axle and overturn on plummer, conveniently stop the cutting piece that splashes to the staff through the cutting protection casing, no safeguard measure has been solved on the workstation of processing holder, be easily by the piece accidental injury of holder cutting in-process, inconvenient install safeguard measure additional on the workstation, prevent the problem that the piece splattered to the staff.

title_en: Intelligent bamboo breaking machine centering device
abstract_en: An intelligent bamboo breaking machine centering device relates to the technical field of bamboo breaking machines, in particular to an intelligent bamboo breaking machine centering device. The automatic feeding device comprises a fixed plate, a feeding guide plate, an adjusting rod and a driving assembly, wherein a plurality of feeding guide plates are arranged on the right side face of the fixed plate, the upper plate, the lower plate, the left plate and the right plate in the plurality of feeding guide plates are respectively connected with two driving assemblies through the adjusting rod, each driving assembly comprises a driving cylinder, a push rod, a sliding block, a sliding rail, a connecting rod and a pulling arm, the output end of each driving cylinder is connected with the corresponding push rod, the right end of each push rod is connected with the corresponding sliding block, the sliding blocks are slidably mounted on the corresponding sliding rail, the sliding rails are fixedly arranged on the corresponding connecting plates, and one end of one connecting rod is arranged on two sides of each sliding block. After the technical scheme is adopted, the utility model has the beneficial effects that: the novel bamboo tube centering device is provided with two groups of driving assemblies, and can drive four feeding guide plates to rotate simultaneously, so that the guide plates on the upper side, the lower side, the left side and the right side of the bamboo tube are identical in rotation amplitude, and the effect of accurate centering is achieved.

title_en: Welding device for flexible circuit board processing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of flexible circuit board welding, and discloses a welding device for flexible circuit board processing. The rest of the devices can be installed by installing the mounting plate; the device can be supported and prevented from slipping by installing the supporting legs and the anti-slip pad, so that the stability and the anti-slip performance of the device are further improved; the position of the sliding block can be adjusted when welding is performed by installing the adjusting mechanism, so that the welding efficiency and the welding quality are improved; the threaded rod and the threaded sleeve are arranged, so that the sliding block can be driven to move to adjust the sliding block, and the welding precision and the welding quality of the device are further improved; the flexible circuit board can be clamped by installing the clamping mechanism, and the welding quality of the device is further improved by being matched with the adjusting mechanism.

title_en: Auxiliary tool for dismantling fixing bolt of kitchen oven of airplane
abstract_en: The utility model provides a demolish auxiliary fixtures of aircraft kitchen oven fixing bolt, relates to aircraft maintenance tool technical field, and during the change I rotation of cover, it is along the axial upwards movement, until in hexagonal spanner inserts the hexagonal hole of waiting to demolish the bolt, it is fixed with the structural plane at the left and right sides both ends of the relative aircraft kitchen of supporting seat through two supporting mechanism, and whole frock takes place radial offset at the atress in-process when preventing demolishing, ensures demolishs the effect. Through rotating the bull stick to the drive is criticized first spliced pole and is rotated, can loosen a knot with the bolt, later can dismantle the bolt through the mode of hand. The whole tool is concentric and vertical to the oven bolt in the dismantling process, so that the dismantling effect is ensured, and the dismantling efficiency is improved.

title_en: Clamp for battery liquid injection
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a clamp for battery liquid injection, which comprises: the clamp comprises a clamp body and a carrying disassembly and assembly component for realizing the split and assembly of the clamp, wherein the clamp body comprises a cup body clamp for placing a liquid storage cup, a battery clamp for placing a battery and a locking mechanism for locking the cup body clamp and the battery clamp together. Through the mode, the clamp for battery liquid injection disclosed by the utility model not only can realize the die separation and the die assembly of the cup clamp and the battery clamp, but also can realize the carrying of the cup clamp, and the precision and the working efficiency of clamp assembly and later liquid injection are greatly improved.

title_en: Precious stone level large granule diamond surface polishing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a precious stone grade large-particle diamond surface polishing device, which belongs to the technical field of diamond polishing and comprises a supporting plate and a second movable plate, wherein the top of the supporting plate is fixedly connected with a top shell, the top of the supporting plate is provided with a first bearing, and a first rotating shaft is arranged in the first bearing in a penetrating manner. The diamond polishing device has the beneficial effects that the second motor, the first electric hydraulic push rod and the limiting plate are arranged, the second motor drives the positive threaded column and the reverse threaded column to rotate, the positive threaded column and the reverse threaded column respectively rotate in the two threaded cylinders, the two threaded cylinders respectively drive the two first movable plates to be close to each other through the two connecting blocks, the two first U-shaped shells are close to each other, the diamond is enabled to move between the two first U-shaped shells, the limiting plate is driven to move through the first electric hydraulic push rod, the surface of the limiting plate is overlapped with the surface of the diamond, the diamond polishing device is convenient to fix the position of the diamond, and polishing operation is convenient to carry out.

title_en: Special jig for part machining
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of machining jigs, and discloses a special jig for machining parts, wherein a positioning caulking groove is formed in the upper part of a workpiece positioning seat, a special-shaped part is embedded and arranged on the inner side of the positioning caulking groove, a part fixing bolt is arranged on the upper part of the workpiece positioning seat, the special-shaped part is arranged on the top of the workpiece positioning seat through the part fixing bolt, a special workpiece positioning seat is arranged on the top of the positioning jig, a clamping structure on the upper part of the workpiece positioning seat is arranged according to the structural characteristics of the special-shaped part, the special-shaped part can be quickly and accurately positioned and installed during machining, the jig is simple in structure and reliable in work, the operation difficulty is low, the efficiency is extremely high, the mass production requirement of the special-shaped part can be met, due to the arrangement of the positioning caulking groove and a part positioning pin, the special-shaped part can be accurately positioned, the positioning caulking groove and the part positioning pin adopt a fool-proof design, the reverse assembly of the part can be avoided, and the working reliability of the jig is greatly improved.

title_en: Transformer winding welding device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a transformer winding welding device, which relates to the field of transformer production and manufacturing, and comprises a welding gun and a handle arranged at the input end of the welding gun, wherein a bearing is arranged at the bottom of the handle, a rotating shaft is inserted into the bearing, a transmission part is arranged at one end of the left side of the rotating shaft, a placing part is arranged at one end of the right side of the rotating shaft, a limiting track is arranged on the surface of the welding gun, a thumb is placed on the surface of the transmission part when an operator holds the handle, the thumb pushes a rotating belt on the surface of the transmission part to move to drive a rotating wheel to rotate when the rotating wheel rotates, a solder wire roll is placed in the placing part, the tail end of the solder wire roll is positioned in the limiting track, the solder wire roll continuously sends an internal solder wire into the limiting track until the other end of the limiting track stretches out from the other end of the limiting track and is sent to the vicinity of the output end of the welding gun, the hand of the operator is prevented from receiving flame to bake, or burning is generated because of flame, and the working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Service creeper for automobile maintenance
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automobile maintenance lying plate, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein two rectangular grooves are formed in the lower end of the bottom plate, two bidirectional threaded rods are connected to the inner walls of the left side and the right side of the two rectangular grooves in a rotating mode, two sliding blocks are connected to the two bidirectional threaded rods in a threaded mode, connecting rods are connected to the lower ends of the sliding blocks in a rotating mode, abutting blocks are connected to the lower ends of the connecting rods in a rotating mode, rotating shafts are connected to the adjacent surfaces of the two connecting rods in a matching mode in a rotating mode, and a motor is installed on the right side of the bottom plate. Through setting up to the piece, under the operation of motor for support piece and ground contact, thereby can play limiting displacement, avoid the staff to carry out spacingly with the foot, thereby can improve maintenance efficiency, simultaneously through setting up diaphragm box rectangle box, when making certain instrument and part of needs, can be faster find instrument and part, thereby improve maintenance efficiency.

title_en: Fixing device is used in aluminum alloy cold forging shaping production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fixing device for aluminum alloy cold forging and forming production, and relates to the technical field of aluminum alloy profile production. According to the utility model, the universal wheels are arranged at the bottom of the device, the universal wheels can be used for driving the fixing device to move and carry, meanwhile, when the fixing device is required to be processed, the anti-slip pad is put down by the threaded rod, the fixing device is fixedly supported, the two modes are freely switched, the height of the fixing plate is controlled by controlling the expansion and contraction of the lifting column, the rotating motor is controlled to drive the rotating shaft to rotate, so that the workbench can be driven to rotate, the direction of the workbench is regulated, and the aluminum alloy processing device has the advantages of being convenient for processing different positions of the aluminum alloy, and the problems that the angle of the aluminum alloy cannot be regulated after the existing aluminum alloy fixing device is fixed, so that the processing of different positions of the aluminum alloy is inconvenient and the aluminum alloy processing difficulty is increased are solved.

title_en: Sesame candy forming and dicing integrated machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sesame candy forming and cutting integrated machine, and relates to the technical field of sesame candy forming and cutting. The utility model includes a shaped dicing assembly; the molding and dicing assembly comprises a cylinder, a fixed plate connected to the lower end of the cylinder, a mounting rack connected to the lower end of the fixed plate, an air rod connected to the lower end of the mounting rack, a mounting rod connected to the lower end of the air rod, a molding plate connected to the bottom end of the mounting rod, four mounting plates connected to the upper end of the molding plate and a plurality of cutting plates connected to the lower end of the molding plate; this sesame candy shaping and cutting all-in-one through the shaping cutting subassembly that sets up, can accomplish the preparation back at sesame candy and directly carry out shaping operation to it to need not remove it everywhere after the shaping and can cut the cutting subassembly immediately, saved the step of removal, not only saved manual work and time, still effectually guaranteed the health, the practicality is strong.

title_en: Safety detection system for garbage compressor hopper turn-down area
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a safety detection system of a garbage compressor hopper turning-down area, which comprises a control module serving as a communication master station and communication slave stations respectively connected with the control module, wherein each communication slave station comprises a safety detection device, a hopper position detection device and a voice broadcasting device; the control module is connected with an electromagnetic valve group for controlling the hopper to run, the safety detection device is arranged on the garbage compressor and faces the dangerous detection area and is used for detecting whether people or objects exist in the dangerous detection area, and the dangerous detection area is a transverse area covered by a movement track of the hopper; the hopper position detection device is connected with the hopper arm and is used for detecting the position of the hopper; the voice broadcasting device is used for carrying out voice broadcasting on people or objects in the dangerous detection area. The utility model solves the problem that the potential safety hazard exists when the hopper of the garbage compressor is turned down.

title_en: Laser welding press nozzle and laser welding device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a laser welding press nozzle and a laser welding device, which belong to the technical field of welding equipment and comprise a press nozzle assembly and a laser welding channel penetrating through the press nozzle assembly, wherein the press nozzle assembly is provided with a compaction acting surface positioned on the outer surface of the press nozzle assembly, one end of the laser welding channel is a laser light outlet, the laser light outlet is positioned on the compaction acting surface, the press nozzle assembly comprises a first structural member and a second structural member, the first structural member is detachably connected with the second structural member, and an air guide channel communicated with the laser welding channel is formed between the first structural member and the second structural member in a matched mode. The first structural member and the second structural member are detachably connected, so that the air guide channel is convenient to clean, residual welding slag in the air guide channel is removed, and the air guide channel is prevented from being blocked by the welding slag. Meanwhile, the probability that the residual welding slag in the air guide channel enters the welding position is reduced.

title_en: Material belt supporting and positioning mechanism of laser engraving machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a material belt supporting and positioning mechanism of a laser engraving machine, which comprises the following components: the material belt positioning device and the material belt limiting device; the material belt positioning device comprises a bottom plate, a positioning plate and a pressing strip, the pressing strip is arranged on the bottom plate, and the positioning plate is arranged between the bottom plate and the pressing strip; the material belt limiting device comprises a bearing plate, a sliding plate, a limiting piece, a fixing piece and a compressing piece, wherein the sliding plate is arranged on the bearing plate; according to the material belt carving device, the carving area of the material belt is determined by using the positioning plate in the material belt positioning device, meanwhile, the material belt can be tightly pressed by the positioning plate, the material belt limiting device is arranged behind the material belt positioning device, the distance between the sliding plates in the material belt limiting device can be adjusted, so that the material belt carving device can adapt to various material belts, meanwhile, in the feeding process, the material belt can be limited by the limiting piece, in the carving process, the material belt can be tightly pressed by the limiting piece, the material belt does not need to be manually adjusted by workers, and the processing efficiency is improved.

title_en: Straightening adjusting device for channel steel machining
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of channel steel machining, in particular to a straightening and adjusting device for channel steel machining, which comprises a straightening table, wherein a placing groove is formed in the center of the top surface of the straightening table, two clamping plates are connected in a sliding manner in the placing groove, springs are arranged on the clamping plates, one ends of the springs are fixedly connected with the clamping plates, the other ends of the springs are fixedly connected with one side of the placing groove, and two groups of driving devices are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the top surface of the straightening table. According to the utility model, the pressing device is arranged, the rotating shaft is lowered by rotating the turntable, the movable ring is driven to vertically descend, the two supporting rods are used for supporting the two movable plates, the two pressing plates are tightly attached to the inner wall of the channel steel, the inner wall of the channel steel is flattened, the purpose of straightening the inner side of the channel steel is realized, and the problems that the traditional channel steel straightening device can only linearly roll the surface of the channel steel, can not straighten the channel steel which is stressed to be bent inwards and has a limited application range are solved.

title_en: Cutting device is used in production of system jar seal iron
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of cutting devices, and discloses a cutting device for producing tin printing iron. According to the utility model, the staff puts the iron sheet into the roller, the control panel is opened, the roller starts to operate, when the roller brings the iron sheet into the cutting table, the cutting knife arranged in the shell starts to work, when the iron sheet is cut, the material blocking rod separates the iron sheet, at the moment, the waste for cutting the iron sheet falls into the waste box, the staff can hold the waste box to process the waste through the handle, the crawler belt conveys the cut iron sheet to the collecting box, and the staff collects the waste, so that the workload of the staff is greatly reduced.

title_en: Flexible gantry air-floatation moving platform
abstract_en: The application provides a flexible gantry air-floating moving table, which consists of a fixed table, a linear motor set, a cross beam, a horizontal air-floating guide rail set and the like, wherein the fixed table is provided with a middle table top and bosses extending from two ends of the middle table top to the vertical direction, the linear motor set comprises two linear motors, two motor stators are respectively arranged at the two bosses, meanwhile, two motor stators are respectively fixed with two ends of the cross beam, the cross beam is connected with the horizontal air-floating guide rail set in the horizontal direction, the guide rail set comprises a first horizontal air-floating pad and a second horizontal air-floating pad, the two air-floating pads are respectively arranged at two ends of the cross beam in a flexible connection mode, when the two linear motors do asynchronous movement or reverse movement, the cross beam can slightly rotate, and the parallel degree of the air-floating pad and the side wall of the fixed table is not influenced by the rotation of the cross beam, so that the silicon wafer is provided with support in the processing process, and the processing precision is ensured.

title_en: Metal sheet cutting sawing machine device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of metal plate cutting, and discloses a metal plate cutting sawing machine device, which comprises: the sawing machine is characterized in that a saw wheel groove, a plurality of groups of adjusting grooves and two groups of pushing grooves are formed in the top of the sawing machine; the driving cutting assembly is arranged at the bottom of the sawing machine; and the alignment assembly is arranged on one side of the top of the sawing machine. Through utilizing the concave frame board that one side of sawing machine was established, with its horizontal alignment, this process concave frame board is at regulating tank removal position under the drive of regulating block, regulating spring changes the form, design fluent wheel A improves sheet metal's forward flow stability, when cutting through saw wheel, the push block can be touched on the side that is cut, the push block is promoted for the movable rod can be elongated under the effect of extension spring, the push block resumes the original form under the effect of extension spring after completely cutting, with the cooperation of regulation size subassembly, sheet metal's both sides dual centre gripping improves sheet metal's cutting efficiency and stability.

title_en: Expansion device for turning end face of compressor shell
abstract_en: The utility model provides an expansion device for turning the end face of a compressor shell, which comprises a main shaft, wherein the main shaft is provided with the expansion device, the expansion device comprises a pull rod assembly and a sliding assembly which is matched and connected with the pull rod assembly, and the pull rod assembly drives the sliding assembly to be ejected outwards or retracted inwards when moving forwards and backwards, so that the shell is positioned or released. Specifically, the pull rod assembly moves forwards and drives the sliding assembly to eject outwards, so that the positioning of the shell is realized, the turning process can be further completed on the shell, after the turning is completed, the pull rod assembly moves backwards and drives the sliding assembly to retract inwards, the release of the shell is realized, and the structure is adopted, so that the workpiece cannot run when being expanded, and the machining precision is ensured.

title_en: Clamping and fixing tool for machining disc parts in horizontal machining center
abstract_en: The utility model provides a clamping and fixing tool for processing disc parts in a horizontal processing center, which is characterized in that: the integral tooling platform is placed on the machine tool workbench, and the working side plane of the integral tooling platform is perpendicular to the upper surface of the machine tool workbench; the first compaction module compacts and fixes the integral tooling platform and the machine tool workbench; the excircle of the disc workpiece is placed on a V-shaped groove of an integral V-shaped iron, and the integral V-shaped iron is fixed with a machine tool workbench; the third supporting module supports the disc workpiece; and the fourth compaction module compacts and fixes the disc workpiece and the integral tooling platform. The utility model can finish the processing contents of the center hole and the side hole of the disc on the horizontal processing center, save time and improve efficiency.

title_en: Pipeline bracket mounting tool
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of installation tools, in particular to a pipeline bracket installation tool, which comprises a percussion drill, wherein a storage battery is clamped and installed at the lower end of the percussion drill, an installation head is arranged at the upper side of the left end of the percussion drill, a drill bit is embedded into the left end of the inner side of the installation head, a dust cover is arranged at the outer side of the drill bit, a first fixing plate is arranged at the upper side of the right end of the dust cover, the pipeline bracket installation tool is provided with a first fixing plate, a second fixing plate, an installation rod and a fixing block, the dust cover is installed in the percussion drill when the pipeline bracket is installed, the dust cover is positioned at the outer side of the drill bit at the moment, the dust cover is arranged in a corrugated pipe state and is short and short with the drill bit, so that people can conveniently position the punched position when drilling, the dust cover is pressed along with the driving of the drill bit when the dust cover contacts with a wall body, and dust generated when the drill bit is punched is blocked in the dust cover, and people conveniently use the tool.

title_en: Copper-clad steel strand cutting device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of copper-clad steel strand cutting, in particular to a copper-clad steel strand cutting device. The technical scheme includes bottom plate, measurement frame and cutting frame, bottom plate upper surface both sides position punishment fixed mounting has measurement frame and cutting frame, cutting frame upper surface fixed mounting has the cutting cylinder, the terminal fixedly connected with lifter plate of cutting cylinder output shaft, lifter plate lower surface both sides position department symmetry divide into the spout, two equal slidable mounting has the briquetting in the spout, two equal fixedly connected with spring of briquetting upper surface, lifter plate lower surface intermediate position department fixed mounting has the cutting machine. The cutting device can effectively fix the cutting point of the copper-clad steel strand, so that the cut surface is smooth, the cutting quality is improved, the service life of the cutting blade of the cutting machine is prolonged, and the cutting device is applicable to copper-clad steel strands with different diameters and high in applicability.

title_en: Light guide column assembly fixture of coffee cup
abstract_en: The utility model provides a light guide column assembly fixture of a coffee cup, which comprises: a work table; the jig is fixed above the workbench, a gap is formed between the bottom of the jig and the workbench, a first mounting groove suitable for placing the light guide column is formed in the top of the jig, and the jig is suitable for placing the cup body. When the fixture is assembled, the light guide column is firstly placed in the first mounting groove of the fixture, and then the cup body is sleeved on the fixture, so that the fixture is more rapid and convenient to install compared with the manual installation mode in the prior art; a positioning structure is arranged between the jig and the cup body, and is characterized in that: the two positioning ribs are arranged on the inner wall of the cup body and form positioning grooves for inserting the jig relatively; thus being more beneficial to aligning the light guide column with the cup body, being rapid and convenient to install and further improving the production efficiency.

title_en: Stamping device is used in nut board processing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of nut plate processing, in particular to a stamping device for nut plate processing, which comprises a base, wherein two sliding grooves are formed in the base, a movable sliding block is arranged in each sliding groove, a plurality of lifting columns are arranged on each movable sliding block, a magnetic separation plate is arranged on each lifting column, a baffle is arranged between the two sliding grooves, a lower die is arranged in an inner cavity of the baffle, a plurality of through grooves are formed in the lower die, a hydraulic rod is arranged right above the lower die, and an upper die is arranged on the outer wall of one side below the hydraulic rod, so that fragments generated by stamping can be effectively prevented from being sputtered everywhere, and the fragments generated by stamping can be conveniently collected.

title_en: Screw driver capable of working at angle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of screwdrivers, and particularly discloses a screwdriver capable of working at an angle, which comprises a shell and a rotating shaft, wherein a motor for driving the rotating shaft to rotate is arranged in the shell; the connecting shaft comprises a handheld part and a connecting part, the handheld part comprises an inner shaft, an outer sleeve is sleeved on the inner shaft, the outer sleeve is rotatably arranged on the inner shaft, and a plurality of steel cables are arranged between the inner shaft and the connecting part; the outer sleeve is provided with a sliding rail, the shell is provided with a positioning arm, and the tail end of the positioning arm is provided with a positioning shaft; according to the screwdriver, the sliding rail is matched with the positioning arm, the handheld part can be rotated, so that the screwdriver head switching shaft at the bottom of the handheld part is changed in angle, and after the screwdriver head switching shaft is rotated, the connecting part can throw away the screwdriver head to drive the inner shaft in the handheld part to rotate through the steel cable when rotating, so that the screwdriver can be continuously used in a narrow space through rotating the screwdriver head switching shaft.

title_en: Die cutting device for conductive foam toothed line
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a die cutting device for a conductive foam toothed line, which belongs to the technical field of conductive foam processing devices and comprises a base, a positioning tube, a supporting frame, a driving roller, a driving motor and a plurality of groups of cutter mechanisms, wherein the positioning tube is horizontally arranged and clamped in the base, a plurality of empty avoidance grooves are formed in the positioning tube, the empty avoidance grooves are positioned above the base, and the supporting frame is fixedly connected to the top of the base; according to the utility model, the columnar conductive foam is positioned in the positioning tube, the conductive foam positioned at the void-avoiding groove is exposed, the driving motor rotates to drive the driving roller to rotate, the driving roller rotates to drive the plurality of groups of cutter mechanisms to rotate, and when the cutter mechanisms extend into the void-avoiding groove, the conductive foam in the void-avoiding groove is subjected to tooth-opening linear cutting, so that the structure design is ingenious, the problems that the columnar conductive foam is difficult to position and easy to deform or misplace are solved, and the processing precision of the conductive foam is greatly improved.

title_en: Cold pilger mill gyration case
