abstract_en: The utility model relates to a rotary box of a cold pilger mill, which aims to solve the technical problem that the port of the rotary box is easy to damage due to friction between a current pipe bundling and the port of the rotary box, and comprises a rotary box body, a supporting component and a fixing mechanism; the support component is arranged at the port of the rotary box body; the support assembly comprises a support plate, a guide groove, a guide block, a support piece, a fixing plate and a counter screw; the supporting plate is connected with the rotary box body through a fixing mechanism; a guide groove is formed in one side, away from the rotary box body, of the supporting plate; the two guide blocks are symmetrically arranged in the guide groove, and the end parts of the guide blocks penetrate through the guide groove and extend to the outside; the support piece is fixedly connected with the end part of the guide block; the fixed plate is fixedly arranged on one side of the supporting plate, which is far away from the rotary box body; the opposite screw rod is arranged on the fixed plate and the two guide blocks in a penetrating way, the opposite screw rod is connected with the fixed plate through a bearing, and the opposite screw rod is in threaded connection with the guide blocks.

title_en: Cutting machine capable of preventing scraps from hurting people
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of anti-injury cutting machines, in particular to a cutting machine for preventing chips from injuring people, which comprises an operating table and a supporting frame, wherein a driving motor is arranged at the lower end of the operating table, a dust cover is arranged on the right side of the driving motor, a chip collecting box is arranged on the right side of the dust cover, a central opening is arranged on the surface of the operating table, a cutting knife is arranged in the central opening, the left side of the cutting knife is connected with a rotating shaft, a pressing cover is arranged at the tail end of the cutting knife, movable baffles are arranged at the two sides of the pressing cover, movable columns are arranged at the bottom ends of the movable baffles, a hollowed-out layer is arranged on the surface of the operating table, concave openings are arranged at the two sides of the hollowed-out layer, and a clamp fixing device is arranged on the concave openings.

title_en: High-precision self-adaptive focal length laser inner engraving device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a high-precision self-adaptive focal length laser inner carving device, which relates to the technical field of laser inner carving and comprises a machine body, wherein a panel is arranged at the top in the machine body, a light carving device is arranged at one side, close to the panel, of the top in the machine body, a sliding motor is arranged on the front surface of the panel, a sliding controller is electrically connected to the front surface of the sliding motor, a sliding rail is arranged at the bottom of the panel, a sliding block is connected to the bottom of the sliding rail in a sliding manner, a lifting controller is arranged at the bottom of the sliding block, an object sensor automatically transmits signals to the telescopic controller and a rotary cylinder assembly after sensing a device to be processed, the telescopic controller controls the telescopic cylinder assembly to move towards the direction of the device to be processed after receiving the signals, and therefore the aim of driving the device to be processed to process in multiple directions is achieved.

title_en: Tool grinder capable of trimming grinding wheel
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tool grinding machine capable of dressing grinding wheels, which comprises a machine base, wherein a first workbench capable of axially moving is arranged at the top of the machine base, a second workbench capable of axially moving is arranged at the top of the first workbench, a dresser bracket is slidably connected to the outer wall of the top of the second workbench, a mounting hole is formed in the dresser bracket, the tool grinding machine also comprises a lifting device arranged on the machine base, a first turntable capable of axially rotating is arranged on one side of a fixed disc, a connecting bracket is arranged on one side of the first turntable, a second turntable capable of axially rotating is arranged on the top of the other side of the connecting bracket, a motor base is arranged at the top of the second turntable, and an output shaft on one side of a motor is sleeved with a grinding wheel capable of axially rotating; the grinding wheel surface profile can be polished under the condition of not disassembling the grinding wheel, so that the grinding wheel surface profile can reach the standard, the working efficiency is improved, and the requirement on the skill of an operator is reduced.

title_en: Gear-like damping turnover mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a gear-like damping turnover mechanism which comprises a rotating body, 2 stop blocks, a bracket I, a spring, a support, a buffer, a bracket II, a lock pin and a motion block, wherein the two stop blocks are arranged on the rotating body; the rotating body is provided with 1 stop block, and one side of the rotating body is provided with a latch; the bracket I is rotationally connected with the rotating body, one side of the bottom of the bracket I is connected with the rotating body through 1 stop block, and the other side of the bottom of the bracket I is connected with the buffer; the support is arranged below the bracket I; the bracket II is arranged between the rotating body and the bracket I, the bracket II is fastened with the rotating body, and the bottom of the bracket II is assembled in the assembly hole of the bracket I; the bottom of the moving block penetrates through a through hole in the middle of the support II to extend out of the support II, and a spring sleeved outside the moving block is further arranged in the through hole. The utility model ensures the whole overturning to be stable and controllable in the form of a clamping point through the resistance generated by the spring; the gear-like damping turnover mechanism is simple to operate, smoother in turnover process, stable and controllable, and can be used for some turnover positioning and turnover supporting, and safety risks in the operation process are avoided.

title_en: Low-noise shot blasting machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a low-noise shot blasting machine, which relates to the technical field of shot blasting machine production and comprises an object main body, wherein an upper cover plate is movably clamped on the upper surface of the object main body, a storage shell is movably connected to one side of the object main body, a supporting plate is fixedly connected to one side of the object main body, a telescopic rod is fixedly connected to one side of the supporting plate, a fixing plate is fixedly connected to one side of the telescopic rod, a limiting sleeve is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the object main body, and a clamping rod is movably connected to one side of the limiting sleeve. According to the utility model, when a user needs to process, the user needs to place the shot blasting in the shot blasting shell, and then the user needs to push the telescopic rod, so that the user can push the arranged fixing plate, the user can push the arranged shot blasting shell, the user can push the balls into the storage shell, and the user can process and use the objects in the storage shell efficiently.

title_en: Flavonoid extraction filter device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a flavonoid extraction and filtration device, which relates to the technical field of haw processing and comprises a bottom plate, wherein the bottom plate is rectangular plate-shaped, a pair of fixing frames are fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the bottom plate, rotary shafts are respectively arranged on the fixing frames in a rotating way, a charging barrel is fixedly arranged at one end of each rotary shaft, a rotary ring is fixedly arranged at the other end of each rotary shaft, circular slots are respectively formed in the rotary rings and the fixing frames, circular inserted rods are inserted in the circular slots, a collection box is arranged on the upper surface of the bottom plate and positioned below the charging barrel, a filter box is arranged on the outer wall threads of the lower end of the charging barrel, a filter screen is fixedly arranged in the filter box, and the charging barrel is in a cylindrical shape. According to the utility model, the cylindrical charging barrel is arranged, the filter box is arranged below the charging barrel in a threaded manner, after flavonoids are filtered, the filter box can be quickly taken down, residues on the filter screen are cleaned, the charging barrel is tilted by rotating the rotating ring, and the inside of the barrel is conveniently washed and cleaned.

title_en: Foot-operated hydraulic lifting octagonal welding platform
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of welding devices, in particular to a pedal type hydraulic lifting octagonal welding platform, which comprises a lifting frame, a welding platform plate and bearing connectors, wherein the end part of a telescopic end of the lifting frame is rotationally connected with the welding platform plate through the bearing connectors, and the welding platform plate is connected with the lifting frame through the bearing connectors, so that the welding platform can randomly rotate in angle during welding, welding personnel can weld welding parts at different angle positions in situ, the working strength is greatly reduced, the welding efficiency is improved, and meanwhile, the lifting frame is used as a supporting frame to enable the whole height of the welding platform to be adjusted, so that the welding platform is suitable for use groups with different heights and welding parts.

title_en: Device for machining special friction plate
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of friction plates, in particular to a device for machining a special friction plate, which comprises a grinding tool, wherein a groove is formed at one side of the grinding tool, which is away from a corner, and a brake block steel back is placed in the groove of the grinding tool; the shape of the brake block steel backing is J-shaped, the brake block steel backing is arranged at the groove in a way that the bending part is downwards clamped, an opening is formed in the middle of the vertical part of the brake block steel backing, the opening penetrates through the brake block steel backing, and a friction paste is attached to the side wall of the opening. According to the utility model, the parallelism and the flatness of the processed product are difficult to ensure by the special shape of the brake block steel back, so that the rejection rate of the product is high, and the brake block steel back is completely positioned by the extrusion contact of the positioning block at the bottom of the friction material and the friction paste on the side wall of the opening at the top of the brake block steel back, so that the requirements of the parallelism and the flatness can be met, the capability of the machining process is effectively improved, and the rejection rate is reduced.

title_en: Mecanum wheel assembly jig
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of Mecanum wheels, in particular to a Mecanum wheel assembly jig. The Mecanum wheel assembly jig comprises a jig body, wherein the jig body is provided with a mounting and positioning cavity, and the bottom of the mounting and positioning cavity is provided with a first positioning mechanism for fixing a first side shell of the wheat wheel; the inner periphery of the installation positioning cavity is provided with a plurality of second positioning mechanisms in a mutual way, the second positioning mechanisms are arranged at a preset angle relative to the axial inclination of the installation positioning cavity, and clamping grooves for clamping and positioning the spinning wheel of the wheat wheel are formed between the adjacent second positioning mechanisms. The Mecanum wheel assembly jig provided by the application can ensure that the shaft holes on the first side shell and the second side shell of the wheat wheel are accurately aligned with the spinning wheel, so that the side shells of the wheat wheel and the spinning wheel are quickly abutted and fixed, and the assembly efficiency of the wheat wheel is improved.

title_en: Welding leveling tool for integrated bipolar plate
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of flow batteries, and discloses a welding leveling tool for an integrated bipolar plate. The welding leveling tool for the integrated bipolar plate comprises a lower aluminum fixing seat, a graphite felt, an electrode plate sheet and a resistance welding machine, wherein the resistance welding machine further comprises a lower electrode plate and an upper electrode plate, the top of the lower electrode plate is fixedly connected with the lower aluminum fixing seat which is communicated with the lower electrode plate, the top of the lower aluminum fixing seat is fixedly connected with a lower electrode support plate which is matched with the graphite felt and is communicated with the graphite felt, the device has the advantages of simple operation steps and the like, a series of parts such as the graphite felt, the electrode plate sheet, the lower electrode support plate, a plate peripheral heating frame and the like are assembled, the graphite felt and the electrode plate sheet can be welded, the operation steps are complex, the manufacturing period of a finished bipolar plate is too long, and the problem of low working efficiency is caused.

title_en: Pipeline welding device for controlling cleanliness for clean factory building
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pipeline welding device for controlling cleanliness for a clean factory building, which comprises a welding chamber frame formed by erecting a bracket, wherein a welding chamber with a sealed space is formed inside by covering with three-proofing tarpaulin, a storage rack is arranged in the welding chamber and is of a double-layer structure, a welding machine is arranged at the bottom layer of the storage rack, a pipeline and a tool to be welded are arranged at the upper layer of the storage rack, a ventilation system is arranged in the welding chamber and comprises a blower and an axial flow fan, the blower is used for blowing air in the welding chamber so as to enable air in the welding chamber to flow circularly, the axial flow fan is used for timely pumping out welding replaced argon and welding fume out of the welding chamber, and the surfaces of all objects in the welding chamber form clean surfaces. The utility model can reach the high-cleanliness environment required by the pipeline welding process and obtain the required clean pipeline.

title_en: Quick-dismantling structure for head of electric wrench
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a quick-dismantling structure for the head of an electric wrench, which relates to the technical field of electric wrenches and comprises an aluminum head shell, wherein the surface of the aluminum head shell is fixedly connected with a shell through a clamping block, an output shaft is fixedly connected with the inner part of the aluminum head shell in a rotating way, a matching groove is formed in the surface of the output shaft, a mounting groove is formed in the surface of the wrench head, the inner part of the mounting groove is in sliding connection with the surface of the output shaft, a connecting part is arranged between the wrench head and the output shaft and comprises a sliding block, the sliding block is in sliding connection with the matching groove, the output shaft slides in the mounting groove through the output shaft, the sliding block is extruded to drive the connecting part to move, and after the matching groove on the surface of the output shaft is aligned with the sliding block, the sliding block is driven to slide into or separate from the matching groove through the movement of the connecting part, so that the wrench head is limited or released, no additional tool or complex steps are required, time and workload are saved, and working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Drilling device convenient for cooling and radiating
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a drilling device convenient for cooling and heat dissipation, and relates to the technical field of circuit board processing. This drilling equipment convenient to cooling heat dissipation, including base, U template, back-and-forth movement mechanism and control movement mechanism, be provided with the portal frame on the base, the inner wall fixed mounting of portal frame has the slider, and the quantity of U template is two sets of and set up respectively in the front and back side of portal frame, is provided with the installation cover on the U template, is provided with movable plate and air gun head on the installation cover, and the inner wall fixed mounting of installation cover has the drilling main shaft, and back-and-forth movement mechanism sets up on the base, and control movement mechanism sets up on the portal frame. This drilling equipment convenient to cooling heat dissipation can be to its cooling treatment of blowing when drilling on the one hand, conveniently carries out the heat dissipation processing to its circuit board, and on the other hand can drive two sets of drilling main shafts simultaneously and carry out back-and-forth movement and left-right movement, and the device has two processing stations, has not only improved machining efficiency, and has reduced the device cost.

title_en: Plate positioning mechanism of hydraulic pendulum plate shearing machine
abstract_en: The utility model provides a plate positioning mechanism of hydraulic pressure pendulum-type plate shearing machine, includes the base, and the top of base is equipped with two fixed plates, is equipped with the actuating mechanism that can drive two fixed plates and remove on the base, its characterized in that: the lower side of fixed plate rotates the installation several respectively and rotates the wheel, rotates the wheel and rotates the installation respectively through first axis of rotation and install on the fixed plate, and the one end of first axis of rotation is fixed mounting first worm wheel respectively, and the one side of corresponding first worm wheel is the joint engagement cooperation respectively and is equipped with first worm, and two risers of fixed mounting respectively on the fixed plate, and first worm rotates the installation respectively on corresponding riser. The utility model has simple structure and ingenious conception, can drive the rotating wheels at two sides to move by controlling the movement of the fixed plate, clamps and limits the plate, the length of the plate can not influence the limiting effect, and simultaneously can drive the plate to move by controlling the rotation of the rotating wheels, thereby being more convenient and labor-saving, having simple operation, meeting market demands and being suitable for popularization.

title_en: Flame cutting machine guider
abstract_en: The utility model provides a flame cutting machine guider, relates to guider technical field, includes flame cutting machine host computer, support, first flame nozzle and first trachea, and the support is installed in flame cutting machine host computer intermediate position, and first flame nozzle is installed to support one end, and first trachea intercommunication first flame nozzle and flame cutting machine host computer, its characterized in that installs lead screw subassembly, locking device, second flame nozzle and second trachea on the flame cutting machine host computer; one end of the screw rod assembly is arranged on any side of the flame cutting machine host, and the other end of the screw rod assembly is provided with a locking device. The device can prevent the flame cutting machine from deviating from the plate when being left and right, and can be separated from the limitation of the rail; the bevel on two sides of the plate wiper can be cut at the same time, so that the processing time and the labor cost are saved.

title_en: Welding tool for filter cavity partition plate
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a filter cavity partition plate welding tool, which is characterized in that a clamping groove formed in a block body of a second fixing mechanism is clamped on the side wall of a cavity, the position of the second fixing mechanism is adjusted to enable the adjusting mechanism to be positioned at the position of a partition plate to be welded, a second screw rod is rotated through a second handle to push the second pressing plate to be tightly attached to the side wall of the cavity, so that the second fixing mechanism and the quick fixing are realized, the quick installation of the tool is realized, a U-shaped plate is slid upwards, one end of the U-shaped plate, which is arranged outside a sliding sleeve, extends out of the outer end of the cavity, the partition plate to be welded is attached to a vertical plate of the adjusting mechanism, the quick positioning of the partition plate welding is realized, the U-shaped plate is slid downwards, the U-shaped plate is covered on the partition plate, the fixing of the U-shaped plate is realized, the first screw rod is rotated through a first handle, the first pressing plate is pushed to move, and the partition plate attached to the side wall of the vertical plate is pressed and fixed, and the quick positioning and the fixing of the partition plate to be welded are realized.

title_en: Pipe die efficient milling device with recovery structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pipe die efficient milling device with a recovery structure, which comprises a machine body, a base and a filter plate, wherein a water pipe is arranged in the machine body, one end of the water pipe is connected with a spray head, the base is arranged at the bottom of the machine body, the base is internally divided into a filtering bin and a water bin by the filter plate, an electric push rod is arranged at one side of the filtering bin, a push plate is arranged at one end of the electric push rod, a transmission port is arranged at one side of the filtering bin, the transmission port is communicated with a sorting bin, and a hydraulic cylinder is arranged at the top side of the inside of the sorting bin.

title_en: Surface sand blasting device for electronic processing
abstract_en: The utility model provides a surface sand blasting device for electronic processing, which relates to the field of electronic processing equipment and comprises a frame body and a sand blasting main body device, wherein the sand blasting main body device is arranged in the frame body, a placing disc is also arranged in the frame body, a plurality of fixing devices are uniformly arranged at the upper end of the placing disc, a driving piece for driving the fixing devices is arranged at one side of the placing disc, the device has a simple structure and simple and easy operation, different electronic components are sleeved on a limiting rod in comparison with the traditional device, the device can fix the electronic components with different specifications by adjusting the distance between two clamping plates, and the whole lifting motion is carried out between the two clamping plates by arranging a movable group, so that the universality of the whole device is higher.

title_en: Carbon brush line hole perforating device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of carbon brushes, and particularly discloses a carbon brush wire hole punching device which comprises a device frame, wherein a puncher is fixedly arranged at the top of the inner side of the device frame, a supporting table is fixedly connected to the outer surface of the device frame, a clamping seat is arranged at the top of the supporting table, a clamping groove is formed in the top of the clamping seat, a carbon brush body is movably inserted into the inner wall of the clamping groove, a retaining mechanism used for keeping the carbon brush body stable in the wire hole punching process is arranged at the top of the supporting table, and the retaining mechanism comprises a fixing frame fixedly connected to the top of the supporting table. This carbon brush line hole perforating device inserts the carbon brush in the draw-in groove at screens seat top when punching, can let two sets of first tangent plane posts and second tangent plane posts be close to each other through retention mechanism, all tightly support the carbon brush at last, and two sets of first tangent plane posts and second tangent plane posts form relative triangle form, can firmly fix the carbon brush with triangle-shaped's stability.

title_en: Steel lining tetrafluoro pipeline production welding equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses steel lining tetrafluoro pipeline production welding equipment which comprises supporting legs, wherein the upper surfaces of the supporting legs are fixedly connected with a workbench, the upper surfaces of the workbench are fixedly connected with a clamping device, the outer surfaces of the clamping device are fixedly connected with a transmission device, the upper surfaces of the workbench are fixedly connected with a welding device, and the upper surfaces of the workbench are fixedly connected with a conveying device. The utility model relates to the field of steel lining tetrafluoro pipeline production, and solves the problem that pipelines are not parallel to the horizontal plane by arranging two clamping devices, wherein a bent rod is fixed on a workbench by a clamping frame and a rotating rod, a special-shaped block rotates in the upward movement process, a roller at the top end is close to a pipeline body, the purpose of welding pipelines and flanges with different specifications is achieved by three-point positioning and clamping, and the problem that the pipelines are difficult to rotate in a fixed state is solved by the roller on the bent rod and the special-shaped block, and meanwhile, the production efficiency is improved.

title_en: Soldering station of power adapter
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of power adapter production, in particular to a power adapter soldering station which comprises a support frame, an operating platform arranged on the support frame, a placing frame arranged on one side of the operating platform and an isolation wallboard, wherein a soldering element is arranged on the operating platform and used for soldering the power adapter on the operating platform; one side of the isolation wallboard is attached to the operation table, one side of the isolation wallboard, which is close to the operation table, is provided with a vacuum air port, one side of the isolation wallboard, which is away from the operation table, is provided with a flowing air channel, and the flowing air channel enables the vacuum air port to generate negative pressure for guiding gas generated in a soldering tin process into the flowing air channel from the vacuum air port. The utility model solves the problems of high waste gas treatment cost and complex structure of the existing soldering tin station. According to the utility model, the soldering station is adjacently designed with a workshop for generating a flowing air duct, and a vacuum air port is arranged for vacuum air exhaust, so that waste gas is pumped away, and the soldering environment is ensured.

title_en: Manual tool support
abstract_en: The utility model provides a hand tool holder comprising: the damping hinge is connected to the left side and the right side of the opposite side of the lower plate surface and the middle plate surface, two damping hinges are formed into a group, and a supporting plate is connected between the two groups of damping hinges; the four corners on the surface of the middle plate are connected with hollow pipes, an upper plate surface is arranged between the four hollow pipes, socket head cap screws are arranged between the hollow pipes and the upper plate surface, and a plurality of placing through holes are correspondingly formed in the surfaces of the upper plate surface and the middle plate surface. According to the hand tool support provided by the utility model, the main body is sprayed with plastic by using stainless iron, so that the product is thick and heavy, and the atmosphere is stabilized; the plurality of placing through holes formed on the upper plate surface can be used for placing hand tools with different sizes; go up face and medium plate face and use hollow tube and hexagon socket screw to carry out fixed connection, the hollow tube length is fit for the small-size hand tool length of vast majority, and damping hinge can stop wantonly, makes medium plate face and desktop be arbitrary angle, conveniently takes and puts hand tool.

title_en: Novel ceramic tube and adapter package assembly
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a novel ceramic tube and adapter assembly structure, which comprises a vibrating disc shell, wherein a through hole is formed in the right end of the vibrating disc shell, a blanking tube is arranged in the through hole, a material staggering mechanism is arranged at the lower end of the blanking tube, a pushing mechanism is arranged at the lower end of the material staggering mechanism, a supporting table is arranged at the lower end of the pushing mechanism, a supporting arm is arranged at the lower end of the supporting table, a jacking mechanism is arranged at the front end of the supporting arm, the material staggering mechanism comprises a material staggering main body, a material channel is arranged in the material staggering main body in the vertical middle direction, and the material staggering channel is horizontally arranged in the material staggering main body; continuous feeding of the ceramic tube is realized through the vibrating disc shell, the blanking tube and the staggered feeding mechanism, and the automation level is improved; and the ceramic tube in the blanking hole d is subjected to blowing dust removal treatment through the blowing channel and the blowing hole, so that the clean appearance of the ceramic tube is ensured, and the assembly effect is improved.

title_en: Bending machine for producing excavator covering parts
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of bending machines, in particular to a bending machine for producing excavator covering parts, which comprises a working box, wherein a connecting block is fixedly connected to one side of the working box, a first screw is inserted into the middle position of the connecting block, a fixing block is connected to the outer surface of the first screw in a threaded manner, a bending device is arranged at the top of the working box, and an adjusting device is arranged in the working box. According to the utility model, the first screw rod is rotated to enable the fixed block to move downwards through threads, so that the steel plate on the upper surface of the working box is propped against, the steel plate cannot be tilted in the process of bending by the pressing block, and then a plurality of groups of propping columns are matched to prop and fix the steel plate, so that the steel plate cannot be offset, the pressing block cannot be offset in the process of extruding and bending the steel plate, and the production accuracy of the excavator covering piece is controlled to a certain extent.

title_en: Trimming, distributing and trimming equipment for automobile gearbox piston products
abstract_en: The utility model provides an automobile gearbox piston product's side cut divides material side cut equipment, including upper fixed plate and lower fixed plate, go up fixed plate and down through outer support column fixed connection between the fixed plate, stripper upper surface and cope match-plate pattern lower surface pass through spring coupling, the spring housing is outside at the spacing nail, the setting of stripper makes the cope match-plate pattern support the product when down moving under the hydro-cylinder effect, on the one hand auxiliary product location, on the other hand can not fly in disorder at the piece waste material of side cut in-process product, the cope match-plate pattern drives the degree of depth of edge down side cut and also can control in the lump, through the interval between adjustment locating pin head and the cope match-plate pattern, the upper surface of cope match-plate pattern, the bottom position of aiming at the slide are equipped with blanking basket, the blanking basket slides on the slide rail that the lower bolster upper surface set up, pneumatic clamping device loosens the product after the side cut is accomplished to the product, the product is from slide down to blanking basket, accomplish the unloading.

title_en: Sealing welding machine
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of battery production equipment and discloses a sealing welding machine, which comprises a capping device, a pre-welding detection module, a pre-welding device, a shunting device and a full-welding device, wherein a battery with a top cover is placed on a battery support cup, the battery loading device loads the battery to the capping device, the capping device positions the top cover and a shell and presses the top cover into the shell, the accuracy of the relative positions of the top cover and the shell is guaranteed, then the pre-welding detection station detects the battery after the capping, the pre-welding detection station guarantees the accuracy of the positions of the top cover and the shell through the capping device, the qualified battery after the capping is conveyed to the pre-welding device to pre-weld the top cover and the shell, the positions of the top cover and the shell are guaranteed to be unchanged, the pre-welded battery can be shunted to at least two full-welding devices to seal the top cover and the shell, the full-welding efficiency can be improved, the stay waiting of the battery is reduced, the high-speed sealing welding of the battery is realized, and the production efficiency is improved.

title_en: Assembly fixture for solar photovoltaic panel
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an assembly fixture for a solar photovoltaic panel, which comprises a fixture main body and two movable tables, wherein guide rods are arranged on two sides of the fixture main body, the movable tables are movably arranged on the guide rods and are respectively positioned at two ends of the fixture main body, a linear module mechanism is arranged on each movable table, an L-shaped structural plate is arranged on each linear module mechanism, and the L-shaped structural plates face inwards. The sliding block is arranged on the screw rod and the guide rod of the linear module mechanism, the transverse position of the sliding block can be changed by utilizing the characteristics of the linear module mechanism, the linear module mechanism is arranged on the moving table, and the moving table can move on the guide rod, so that the longitudinal position of the moving table (the sliding block) can be changed, and the sliding block can be changed to adapt to the assembly of solar photovoltaic panels with different sizes and the aluminum alloy outer frame, and the application range is wider.

title_en: Workpiece cutting device based on valve turbine head processing usefulness
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of valve machining and discloses a workpiece cutting device based on valve turbine head machining, which comprises a workbench, a top plate and a cutting piece, wherein the top plate is arranged above the workbench, the cutting piece is arranged at the bottom of the top plate, a clamping assembly is arranged at the top of the workbench, a lifting assembly is arranged at the bottom of the clamping assembly and consists of an inflating unit and a movable unit, the inflating unit is positioned on the outer wall of the workbench, and the movable unit is positioned in the workbench. This work piece cutting device based on processing of valve turbine head is used, through setting up bent lever and splint, because the bottom of bent lever runs through the top of workstation to extend to the inside of workstation, and the outer wall of bent lever and the inner wall sliding connection that the workstation was run through, consequently can accomplish the regulation to splint through the position of adjustment bent lever, make the device be applicable to the work piece processing of equidimension not.

title_en: Pipeline installation location frock
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pipeline installation positioning tool which comprises a frame plate, wherein a connecting shaft is rotatably arranged below the frame plate, a supporting rod is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the connecting shaft, the supporting rod is L-shaped, triangular baffles are fixedly arranged on the side surfaces of the supporting rod, the connecting shafts are divided into two groups and are symmetrically distributed on two sides of the frame plate, the inside of the supporting rod is of a hollow structure, a connecting rod is slidably arranged in a horizontal position on the supporting rod, a tension spring is fixedly connected between the connecting rod and the inner wall of the supporting rod, an air inlet pipe is connected to the side surface of the supporting rod, the end part of the air inlet pipe, far away from the supporting rod, is connected with external compressed air, a driving assembly is arranged on the upper surface of the frame plate, the connecting shaft is driven to rotate through the driving assembly, and the lifting assembly is arranged on the frame plate. According to the utility model, the pipeline can be easily withdrawn from the groove in the whole use process, and the pipeline can be effectively prevented from sliding off, so that the pipeline butt joint work in the groove is greatly facilitated, and the use is more convenient in combination.

title_en: Adjustable pipeline lifting support
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of pipeline supports and discloses an adjustable pipeline lifting support which comprises a balance support, wherein a hydraulic lifting device is arranged at the top of the balance support, a lifting adjusting cylinder is arranged at the top of the hydraulic lifting device, and a solid supporting pipe is connected with the top of the lifting adjusting cylinder in a threaded manner. According to the utility model, the hydraulic lifting device is arranged at the top of the balance support, lifting adjustment can be performed, the solid support pipe can rotate to adjust the angle and the height of the solid support pipe, the two adjustment supports all those present can be combined and spliced to support the pipeline in a V shape, the two adjustment supports are driven to be close to or far away from each other by rotating the threaded adjustment rod, the size adjustment can be freely performed according to the thickness and the model size of the pipeline, and the device is suitable for different pipelines, and has the height lifting adjustment capability, multidirectional adjustment design, convenient installation and disassembly and strong adaptability, and is suitable for the pipeline installation conditions in different sizes and different directions.

title_en: Peculiar smell preventing kitchen waste treatment device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of garbage disposal devices, in particular to an odor-resistant kitchen garbage disposal device, which solves the technical problems: the existing kitchen waste treatment device does not have an oil-water separation function, and the grease at the end after cooling and solidification is easy to block a sewer pipe; the technical scheme is as follows: an odor-proof kitchen waste treatment device comprises a treatment box, a crushing mechanism, a cleaning assembly, a filtering mechanism, a discharging assembly and an oil-water separation assembly; according to the kitchen waste treatment device, the oil-water separation mechanism for separating oil from water by cooling is additionally arranged, the oil-water separation treatment is carried out on the liquid which belongs to kitchen waste and is treated by the filtering mechanism, the oil is cooled and left in the device for independent treatment, and the residual liquid enters the sewer pipe along with the drainage pipeline, so that the problems that the existing kitchen waste treatment device does not have an oil-water separation function and the oil at the cooling solidification end is easy to block the sewer pipe are solved.

title_en: Automatic chamfering device for annular magnetic core
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of chamfering devices, and particularly discloses an automatic chamfering device for an annular magnetic core, which comprises the following components: a material conveying machine, a chamfering machine main body and a dust remover; the discharge end of the material conveying machine faces to the feeding end of the chamfering machine main body; the dust inlet of the dust remover faces to the processing platform of the chamfering machine main body; the chamfering machine main body comprises a frame, an electric control panel, a front chamfering assembly, a back chamfering assembly and a turnover mechanism; the electric control panel is respectively and electrically connected with the material conveying machine, the front chamfering assembly, the back chamfering assembly and the turn-over mechanism; the front chamfering component and the back chamfering component are arranged on the frame up and down; the turnover mechanism is a semicircular double-layer cambered surface slideway, is vertically arranged on the frame, and has an inlet facing the discharge end of the front chamfering assembly and an outlet facing the feed end of the back chamfering assembly. The utility model has the functions of automatically chamfering, dedusting and turning over the front and back sides of the magnetic core, has high automation degree and simpler turning over structure design.

title_en: Auxiliary jig for end inspection instrument
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an auxiliary fixture of an end inspection instrument, which comprises an adjusting component, wherein the adjusting component and an electron microscope are arranged on the same base, the clamping component comprises a fixed clamping piece, a fixed part and a movable clamping piece, the fixed clamping piece is arranged on the adjusting component, the fixed part is arranged on the fixed clamping piece, the movable clamping piece is arranged on the fixed part in an opposite position with the fixed clamping piece, through the matching of the fixed part and the movable clamping piece, the movable clamping piece is close to the fixed clamping piece from one side after the FA optical fiber terminal is firstly put into the fixed clamping piece, the FA optical fiber terminal is placed and clamped once, and then the adjusting component is matched to ensure the observation height of the FA optical fiber terminal and the electron microscope, so that the FA optical fiber terminal can be placed or taken out in a single operation, the offset caused by the fixation of different positions is eliminated, and the influence on the observation of the electron microscope is reduced.

title_en: Special tool for turning vertical diagonal flow circulating water pump
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of special tools for turning of vertical diagonal flow circulating water pumps, and discloses a special tool for turning of a vertical diagonal flow circulating water pump, which comprises a fixed base plate, wherein a hinging seat is fixedly connected to the top of the left side of the fixed base plate; the carousel front fixedly connected with of fixed connection in the positive one end of screw rod rotates the twist grip of connection for fixed connection rotates at the connecting rod of rotating the screw rod outer wall, and the spacing hole inner wall threaded connection who sets up at the connecting rod has adjusting screw, rotates the regulating block of connection, and fixed connection rotates at the adjusting screw of regulating block top, rotates the fixed frame of connecting at the adjusting screw top and removes, and the collar is gone up in fixed frame inner wall bottom fixedly connected with, through the mounting bolt of connection for the last collar and the lower collar of top carry out fixed mounting, will carry out pivoted linkage subassembly fixed mounting in collar and last collar inner wall down, adjusts, can be convenient for carry out holistic height and angle's regulation.

title_en: Expansion device for wheel production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of wheel production, in particular to an expansion device for wheel production, which comprises a bottom block and an expansion mechanism for carrying out expansion treatment on a rim, wherein the expansion mechanism is arranged above the bottom block and comprises a fixing frame and an expansion assembly, and the expansion assembly is arranged on the fixing frame. According to the utility model, when the rims with different sizes are required to be expanded by arranging the expansion mechanism, the knob is rotated, the knob drives the screw rod to rotate, the screw rod rotates to drive the movable plates to move, the two movable plates are mutually far away along the guide rod, the movable plates move to drive the clamping strips to move, when the movable plates move to the corresponding positions, the clamping strips are separated from the clamping grooves on the clamping seat, the clamping seat and the expansion punch are released, a new expansion punch can be installed after the clamping seat is removed from the fixed box, and the expansion punch in the device can be quickly replaced according to the size of the rim, so that the application range of the device is effectively expanded.

title_en: Welding device for metal plates
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of welding, in particular to a welding device for metal plates, which comprises an electric welding device, wherein the left side and the right side of the electric welding device are movably connected with connecting blocks, the left side and the right side of the electric welding device are rotatably connected with fixing frames, the left side of the electric welding device is movably connected with a magnifying glass, and an observation mechanism is arranged on the left side and the right side of the electric welding device and is used for protecting eyes of a user; the assembling mechanism is arranged at the left side and the right side of the electric welding device and is used for fixing the magnifying glass and the sunglasses, the utility model can be clamped at clamping grooves at different positions through the elastic deformation of the clamping blocks, and can enable the fixing frame to rotate left and right for a certain angle and keep continuously, the welding point can be observed in an enlarged mode through the magnifying glass arranged on the fixing frame, in addition, the air guide opening is formed in the upper side of the electric welding device, the thumb-pressed re-springing type air bag can blow away floating metal particles on the welding point after welding through the air guide opening, and rapid welding is facilitated.

title_en: Drill bit for machining engine oil filter of automobile engine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of drill bits, in particular to a drill bit for processing an engine oil filter of an automobile engine, which comprises a drill bit, a drill shank arranged above the drill bit, and a groove block positioned in the drill shank, wherein positioning teeth are arranged above the outer wall of the drill bit, a damping sleeve is fixed above the drill shank, a damping block is arranged in the damping sleeve, a push rod is arranged in the damping block in a penetrating manner, a first rotating shaft is arranged in the groove block, a first connecting rod is arranged on the outer wall of the first rotating shaft, a second rotating shaft is arranged at the other end of the first connecting rod, a second connecting rod is arranged on the outer wall of the second rotating shaft, a limiting rod is arranged in the middle of the second connecting rod, a fixing clamp is fixed at the lower end of the second connecting rod, and a fixing groove is formed in one side of the fixing clamp. According to the drill bit fixing device, the drill bit is fixed through the fixing clips, and the fixing grooves arranged on the inner sides of the fixing clips are in one-to-one correspondence with the positioning teeth above the outer wall of the drill bit, so that the drill bit is prevented from falling off.

title_en: Multifunctional grooving tool positioning fixture
abstract_en: The utility model provides a multifunctional slotting tool positioning fixture which comprises a special-shaped cutter, a high-speed bearing connected with a cutter handle of the special-shaped cutter, a sliding cutter rest connected on the left side and the right side of the high-speed bearing and a linear motion sliding rail movably connected with the sliding cutter rest, wherein an external power source is rigidly connected to the cutter handle of the special-shaped cutter during slotting, so that the square-hole slotting cutter and the V-shaped-groove cutter rotate at high speed to perform linear cutting motion on parts to be machined; the linear motion sliding rail can meet the requirement of cutting distance, and rotary cutting is also performed in the linear motion process; when the cutter is retracted after cutting, the auxiliary fixing device fixes one end of the linear motion sliding rail, which limits all degrees of freedom, and lifts the other end of the linear motion sliding rail, which only has the rotary degrees of freedom and is not limited, so that the special-shaped cutter leaves the position of the opening. The utility model can solve the problems of V-shaped groove opening and square hole processing at one time, and is convenient for combined forming and processing.

title_en: Self-spacing surface polishing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of polishing equipment, in particular to self-distance surface polishing equipment. The utility model aims to provide self-distance surface polishing equipment capable of automatically feeding. A self-spacing surface polishing device comprises a workbench, a first motor, a grinding wheel, a motor and the like; the motor II is installed on the right side of the workbench, a first gear and a second gear are connected to an output shaft of the motor II through a coupling, a first slide rod is connected to the right side of the workbench in a sliding mode, a support plate is connected to the workbench in a sliding mode, a first slide rod is fixedly connected to the support plate, and the motor I is installed on the support plate. The telescopic clamp, the grinding wheel, the motor and other parts are arranged, so that a workpiece can be clamped and polished automatically, labor and time are saved, and efficiency is improved; through being provided with cleaning roller and fan for work piece and workstation can obtain timely cleanness after polishing, have guaranteed the neatly of workstation, the development of being convenient for the next polishing uses manpower sparingly.

title_en: Frame welding fixture with limit structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of welding tools and discloses a frame welding tool with a limiting structure, which comprises a base, wherein a mounting plate is fixedly connected to the upper side of the base, a supporting frame is fixedly connected to the middle part of the upper side of the mounting plate, first movable grooves are formed in the left end and the right end of the supporting frame, two-way screws are rotatably connected to the inside of the first movable grooves, limiting clamping blocks are connected to the front end and the rear end of the two-way screws in a threaded mode, the lower ends of the limiting clamping blocks are respectively and slidably connected to the inside of the first movable grooves, and rotating handles are fixedly connected to the tops of the front end and the rear end of the two-way screws. According to the utility model, the clamping assembly is driven to clamp by the arranged electric push rod, so that the manual clamping and fixing is replaced, the processing and welding efficiency is improved, and the arranged limiting clamping plate moves up and down in the side plate, so that the height is adjusted, and the device is suitable for frames with different sizes.

title_en: Digit control machine tool workstation cleaning device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of numerical control machining, and particularly relates to a workbench cleaning device of a numerical control machine tool, two pushing cylinders are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the workbench in a sliding mode, pushing rods are arranged on the two pushing cylinders in a sliding mode, one ends of the tops of the pushing rods extend out of the end faces of the pushing cylinders and are connected with bending plates, a connecting plate is arranged between the two bending plates in a connecting mode, a plurality of connecting columns are arranged on the end faces of the bottom of the connecting plate, a plurality of first scraping strips are arranged on two sides of each connecting column, notch cleaning assemblies are arranged on the end faces of the bottom of the connecting columns, and a table surface cleaning assembly is arranged on one side of each connecting column between the two bending plates. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the notch cleaning assembly and the pushing cylinder, the device can clean and scrape the long scraps on the end surface of the workbench by being matched with the table top cleaning assembly while the workbench descends at each position and goes deep into the notch, and the cleaning effect is effectively improved.

title_en: Numerical control plate grooving equipment for custom-made cupboard processing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of plate processing, in particular to numerical control plate grooving equipment for customized cabinet processing, which comprises a base, wherein a mounting plate is arranged above the base, a fixed shaft is fixedly connected to the middle part of one side of the mounting plate, a cutter head is rotatably connected to the fixed shaft, a plurality of mounting grooves are formed in the outer side wall of the cutter head, cutters are arranged in the mounting grooves, a driving assembly for driving the mounting plate to move is arranged at the top of the base, and clamping plates are symmetrically arranged at the two sides of the top of the base; according to the utility model, through the connection and fixation of the rotary cutter disc and the corresponding fixing holes by the cooperation of the fixing rods and the different cutters arranged on the rotary cutter disc, on one hand, the connection and fixation of the cutter disc with the rotary motor are realized, on the other hand, the rotation of the cutter disc is synchronously limited, the stability of the cutter disc during groove pulling is improved, and the quick replacement of the different cutters by the rotation of the cutter disc is realized through the separation of the fixing rods and the fixing holes.

title_en: Dust collection device for polisher
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a dust collection device for a grinding machine, relates to the technical field of dust collection devices, and aims at solving the problems that more dust particles are generated in the grinding process in the prior art, the dust collection device is easy to attach to the surface of an operation table, influences the grinding operation, pollutes air and threatens the health of operators. According to the dust collection device, the movable block is driven to move along the mounting seat through the rotating screw rod, then the angle of the adjusting block is sequentially adjusted, the angle of the connecting block is adjusted, the connecting block drives the connected dust collection cover to rotate through the hoops, the dust collection angle is adjusted, the dust collection angle and the dust collection position are matched with each other, and finally dust is sucked into the dust collection box through the hose and the dust collection cover by the fan to be collected.

title_en: Aluminum profile discharging device
abstract_en: The utility model provides an aluminum profile discharging device, and relates to the technical field of profile discharging; the device comprises a discharging auxiliary moving piece, wherein a lifting driving piece is arranged on the discharging auxiliary moving piece; a length adapting piece is fixedly welded on the lifting driving piece; two ends of the length adapting piece are respectively welded with a section bar end positioning piece; straightening clamping pieces are respectively arranged on two sides of the length adapting piece; four movable installation rollers are installed at the bottom of the unloading auxiliary plate; can realize the gyro wheel on supplementary utilization inclined plane, supplementary roll centre gripping section bar can realize supplementary quick centre gripping correction section bar, through the effectual quality of unloading that improves the section bar of this structure, guarantee the precision of work such as follow-up cutting.

title_en: Pressing device for guard rail of car hopper of three-wheeled automobile
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a guard bar pressing device of a car hopper of a three-wheeled automobile, which comprises the following components: the device comprises two groups of supporting plates, wherein two groups of sliding grooves are formed in one end of each supporting plate, two groups of movable plates are connected in the sliding grooves in a sliding mode, an upper driving roller and a lower driving roller are respectively connected between the movable plates in a rotating mode, multiple groups of pressing wheels are connected on the surfaces of the upper driving roller and the lower driving roller in a detachable mode, lifting assemblies are arranged on one side of each supporting plate, and driving assemblies are arranged on one side of each supporting plate. The utility model has the advantages that the clamping blocks are inserted into the clamping grooves and then connected through the bolts, so that the first arc-shaped blocks and the second arc-shaped blocks are connected together to form the pressing wheels for pressing, the distance between the connected pressing wheels is adjusted, meanwhile, the pressing wheels with different sizes are convenient to replace for pressing, the guardrail plates with different patterns are pressed, the distance between the upper driving roller and the lower driving roller is adjusted through the movement of the moving blocks on the surfaces of the threaded columns, and the guardrail plates with different thicknesses are convenient to press.

title_en: Panel stamping die
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a plate stamping die which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a plurality of first connecting blocks are connected to two sides of the bottom plate, a supporting rod is connected to the top of each first connecting block, a second connecting block is connected to the top of each supporting rod, a top plate is connected between the two second connecting blocks, a hydraulic rod is arranged at the top of the top plate, a stamping seat is arranged at the top of the bottom plate, a stamping plate is arranged at the top of the stamping seat, and a stamping groove is formed in the top of the stamping plate. Through the cooperation of clamp plate, connecting rod, stopper and spring, when the hydraulic stem drove the connecting plate and moves down, the clamp plate at first takes place to contact with the material to receive the resistance of material to move up, at the in-process that the clamp plate moved up, the stopper that connecting rod one end was connected then extrudees the spring, and the spring then exerts pressure the stopper, makes the clamp plate pressed in the top of material, thereby fixes the position of material, before guaranteeing that the drift is punching press to the material, the material is in fixed state, thereby makes the punching press more accurate.

title_en: Novel pneumatic chuck clamp
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of round die wood board processing equipment, in particular to a novel air chuck clamp which comprises a base, an air cylinder frame, a driving air cylinder, a driving arm and a driving wheel, wherein the base is provided with a plurality of air chuck holes; the top end of the driving arm is connected with the driving wheel through a connecting component; the top end of the driving arm is provided with a through hole, and the connecting component penetrates through the through hole; the connecting assembly comprises a first connecting shaft, a second connecting shaft and a spring; the first connecting shaft is inserted into the through hole of the driving arm, and the outer end of the first connecting shaft is fixed on the outer side surface of the driving arm; the second connecting shaft is fixed on the driving wheel; the spring is arranged in the through hole of the driving arm, and two ends of the spring are respectively sleeved and fixed on the first connecting shaft and the second connecting shaft. According to the utility model, the connecting block is improved into a connecting assembly composed of the first connecting shaft, the second connecting shaft and the spring, so that the processing technology is simplified, the manufacturing cost is reduced, and meanwhile, the force loss is greatly reduced.

title_en: Boring machine tool
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a boring machine tool, which comprises a controller, a frame, a cross beam, a longitudinal beam, a clamp assembly, a sliding block, a boring cutter assembly and a cutter changing assembly, wherein the boring cutter assembly comprises a main shaft box, a cutter and an electromagnetic clutch locking device for locking or unlocking the cutter, the cutter is arranged above the clamp assembly, the cutter changing assembly comprises a cutter changing frame, a cutter storage disc and a rotating unit, a plurality of notches are arrayed on the circumference of the edge of the cutter storage disc, the cutters are connected at the notches, a magnet is arranged on the edge of the inner wall of the notch, the magnet is used for attaching suction force to the cutter, and a single-plate electromagnetic clutch suction device is electrically connected with the controller. According to the utility model, the cutter changing assembly is arranged on the cross beam, so that a machine tool or a cutter does not need to be manually replaced, and the processing capacity and the processing efficiency of the equipment are improved; the tool of the boring tool assembly is accurately controlled to the workpiece arranged on the clamp assembly through each driving device, and accurate machining of the workpiece can be achieved.

title_en: Ultrathin metal sheet and ultrathin metal sheet pipe
abstract_en: The application provides an ultrathin metal sheet, which comprises a sheet body, wherein the sheet body comprises a first part and a second part, the thickness of the first part is larger than that of the second part, a third part is transitionally arranged between the first part and the second part, the thickness of the third part is uneven, and the thickness change from one end of the third part connected with the first part to one end of the third part connected with the second part is gradual. The ultrathin metal sheet is special-shaped and uneven in thickness, and fills the blank of the special-shaped ultrathin metal sheet in China. The ultrathin metal sheet pipe manufactured by the method changes the traditional pipe manufacturing process, does not need to stretch the metal pipe, overcomes the technical bias of the stretch forming of the ultrathin metal sheet pipe, and avoids the limitation of the prior art that the stretch forming method cannot realize the ultrathin metal sheet pipe; the ultrathin metal sheet pipe is not stretched and formed, the material of the ultrathin metal sheet pipe is not changed in the extending direction, and the ultrathin metal sheet pipe is full of strength and is not easy to break.

title_en: A steel pipe cutting machine for municipal construction
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of building construction, and discloses a steel pipe cutting machine for municipal building construction, which solves the problem that the steel pipe is inconvenient to cut at fixed length at present, and comprises a base, wherein a conveying mechanism is arranged at the top of the base, a fixing mechanism is arranged on the conveying mechanism, the conveying mechanism comprises a supporting plate positioned above the base, supporting columns are fixedly arranged between the positions, close to four corners, of the bottom of the supporting plate and the base, through grooves are formed in the supporting plate, inner rods are fixedly arranged in the through grooves, and sliding blocks are movably arranged on the outer sides of the inner rods; according to the steel pipe cutting device, the first motor is matched with the screw rod and the sliding sleeve, so that the sliding block can move along the inner rod, steel pipes can be conveyed through the matching between the placing plate and the supporting roller, and the moving distance of the steel pipes can be determined through the matching between the connecting plate, the indicating block and the graduated scale, so that the steel pipes can be cut in a fixed length conveniently.

title_en: Clamp for laser cutting machine
abstract_en: The utility model provides a clamp for a laser cutting machine, which belongs to the technical field of laser cutting machines and comprises a frame, a laser cutting machine main body arranged at the upper end of the frame, and a cutting material table group arranged below the laser cutting machine main body, wherein a screw rod transmission mechanism is arranged at the side of the cutting material table group, a movable clamping mechanism is connected to the screw rod transmission mechanism in a screw rod transmission manner, and the cutting material table group, the screw rod transmission mechanism and the movable clamping mechanism are designed in a structure combination manner below the laser cutting machine main body, so that after a plate-shaped material is placed on the cutting material table, a driving force is provided through the screw rod transmission mechanism, the movable clamping mechanism can shift leftwards to automatically buffer and adjust and press the top surface of the material, and the clamp can adapt to buffer compression of materials with different specifications without manual adjustment of staff, and is time-saving and labor-saving.

title_en: Sealing washer sword card automatic assembly mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic assembly mechanism for a sealing ring cutter clamp, which relates to the technical field of sealing ring assembly and comprises a diameter reducing unit and an assembly unit, wherein the diameter reducing unit comprises a mounting plate, a central hole is formed in the mounting plate, an elastic positioning column is arranged in the central hole, two sliding rails are arranged on two sides of the mounting plate, which are positioned on the elastic positioning column, a first inserting plate and a second inserting plate are arranged on the sliding rails, and diameter reducing arc openings are formed in the first inserting plate and the second inserting plate in parallel to the length direction of the sliding rails; one end of the first plugboard and one end of the second plugboard are connected with a driving cylinder, and the driving cylinder can enable the first plugboard and the second plugboard to move in opposite directions; the assembly unit is provided with a first cylinder, the output end of the first cylinder is provided with a second cylinder, the output end of the second cylinder is provided with a first pressure plate, the output end of the first cylinder is provided with a connecting block, the position of the connecting block corresponding to the first pressure plate is provided with a second pressure plate, and the first pressure plate can move in opposite directions relative to the second pressure plate.

title_en: Push rod bending mechanism of handcart
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a push rod bending mechanism of a handcart, which comprises a workbench, and a bending fixed wheel and a bending movable wheel which are arranged at the top of the workbench, wherein the bending fixed wheel is fixed at the top of the workbench, the bending movable wheel is rotatably arranged at the outer side of the bending fixed wheel by taking the bending fixed wheel as a circle center, an abutting pressing plate is fixedly arranged at one side of the top of the workbench, which is positioned at the bending fixed wheel and the bending movable wheel, and an extrusion assembly is arranged on the abutting pressing plate; when buckling the steel pipe, can pass the steel pipe between conflict clamp plate and the extrusion subassembly earlier to stretch into between buckling fixed wheel and the running wheel of buckling, then the accessible rotates the spiral handle and drives the stripper plate and remove, lets the stripper plate cooperation conflict clamp plate firmly extrude the steel pipe, and this kind of design has guaranteed the stability of steel pipe at the in-process of buckling, and the tail end is difficult for the perk, is favorable to going on smoothly of buckling work.

title_en: Welding fixture for excavator bucket
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bucket welding tool, which relates to the technical field of bucket welding and comprises a rotating mechanism fixing mechanism; the rotating mechanism comprises a U-shaped plate, rotating rods are arranged in the middle of two sides of the U-shaped plate in a rotating mode, the two rotating rods penetrate through the middle of two sides of the U-shaped plate respectively, a placing plate is arranged between the two rotating rods, and a sliding groove and a through groove are formed in the middle of the top end of the placing plate respectively; the fixing mechanism comprises a screw rod, the directions of screw grooves at two ends of the screw rod are opposite, the screw rod is in rotary connection with the inside of the chute, one end of the screw rod penetrates through the chute, a sliding block is arranged on the surface thread of the screw rod, a fixing plate is arranged at the top end of the sliding block, and the fixing plate slides at the top end of the placing plate; the beneficial effects of the utility model are as follows: the staff can drive through first motor and place the board and rotate to drive its top fixed bucket and rotate, be convenient for weld the bucket, wherein two clamping plates are fixed the bucket, take place to shift when avoiding welding, influence welded effect.

title_en: Bearing ring assembling clamp
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bearing ring assembling clamp, which comprises: the base, the internal surface fixedly connected with first motor of base, the output fixedly connected with third lead screw of first motor, the surface threaded connection of third lead screw has the slider, the upper surface of third lead screw rotates and is connected with the roof, the quantity of roof is two and controls the distribution, the right side fixedly connected with second motor of roof, the output fixedly connected with revolving plate of second motor, the internal surface fixedly connected with battery of revolving plate makes inner circle and outer lane need not the manual alignment and can realize the installation when carrying out the centre gripping fixed to bearing inner circle and the outer lane of different specifications through setting up first motor, third lead screw, slider, second motor, revolving plate, first double-end motor, improves work efficiency, and makes the perpendicular direction rotatable when carrying out fixed centre gripping to the outer lane, the installation operation of being convenient for.

title_en: Telescope metal structure drilling device capable of collecting scraps
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a telescope metal structural member drilling device capable of collecting scraps, in particular to the technical field of drilling devices. Comprises a bottom plate, a placing table, a clamping component, a supporting arm, a rotating rod, an infrared detector, a drill bit and a chip sucking mechanism. The problem that the collection difficulty is increased because metal scraps generated in the process of drilling can splash to various places in the conventional drilling device is solved; and the existing drilling equipment is not accurate enough to locate the holes, so that the quality problem of products is further affected.

title_en: CO2 gas shielded welding machine for steel structure machining
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of CO2 gas shielded welding machines, in particular to a CO2 gas shielded welding machine for processing a steel structure, which comprises a CO2 gas shielded welding machine main body, wherein a box body is fixedly arranged on the front side and the rear side of the CO2 gas shielded welding machine main body, an inner cavity is arranged in the box body, sliding holes communicated with the inner cavity are arranged on two sides of the bottom of the box body, an adjusting column is slidably arranged in the sliding holes, the adjusting column is convenient to operate and control by rotating a rotating shaft to move in the sliding holes, the CO2 gas shielded welding machine main body is convenient to lift off the ground, a bottom wheel is in contact with the ground, the CO2 gas shielded welding machine main body is convenient to move, a sleeve at the bottom of the CO2 gas shielded welding machine main body and a fixed cone are convenient to contact with the ground, and the CO2 gas shielded welding machine main body is convenient to stably place.

title_en: Automobile mudguard bending and shaping device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automobile fender bending and shaping device which comprises a base, wherein a fixing frame is fixedly arranged at the top of one side of the base, a hydraulic rod is fixedly arranged at the top of the fixing frame, a fixing plate is fixedly arranged at the output end of the hydraulic rod, an upper die is arranged at the bottom of the fixing plate, a lower die is fixedly arranged at the top of the base, an automatic material returning component is arranged between the upper die and the lower die, and a buffer component is arranged between the fixing plate and the upper die, so that the automobile fender can be returned conveniently and rapidly, and the processing efficiency of the automobile fender is improved.

title_en: Lighting apparatus production facility
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a lighting fixture production device, which comprises a support frame and a fixing mechanism; a supporting frame: the upper end of the support frame is fixedly connected with a cavity table, four corners of the lower end of the support frame are fixedly connected with support blocks, the sliding grooves formed in the left side and the right side of the upper end of the cavity table are respectively and slidably connected with a frame, and the upper ends of the opposite inner sides of the frame are respectively and rotatably connected with polishing discs through rotating shafts; the fixing mechanism comprises: which comprises a sliding frame, sliding columns and arc-shaped fixing frames, wherein the sliding frame is respectively and slidably connected in dovetail sliding grooves formed on the front side and the rear side of the upper end of a cavity table, two sliding columns are slidably connected in the sliding frame, an arc-shaped fixing frame is fixedly connected between the two sliding columns which are adjacent left and right, according to the lighting fixture production equipment, the lamp tubes are clamped simultaneously in two directions through the fixing mechanism, so that the axes of the lamp tubes with different diameters can be aligned to the polishing tool, and the clamping process is not needed to be assisted by hands, so that the safety of operators is fully ensured.

title_en: Valve seat precision machining clamping device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a valve seat precision machining clamping device, which comprises a base (10); a turntable (21) rotatably connected with the base (10), wherein a plurality of clamping blocks (22) are slidably arranged on the side surface of the turntable (21); the driving assembly (30) is in sliding connection with the base, the valve seat is abutted with the driving assembly (30) and pushed, the driving assembly (30) slides along the base (10) to drive the turntable (21) to rotate, and the clamping blocks (22) on the side surface of the turntable (21) are driven to slide so as to clamp the valve seat, so that the operation of the clamping process of the valve seat is simple, and the use is convenient.

title_en: Grinding device capable of assembling various hanging tools
