abstract_en: The utility model discloses a grinding device capable of assembling various hanging tools, which relates to the technical field of grinding devices, and can select hanging tools with proper lengths to place according to the number of workpieces to be ground, and then the hanging tools are fixed on a supporting piece through screws penetrating through holes and entering mounting holes, so that the assembling work of the hanging tools with different lengths can be completed, the waste of redundant stations caused when the workpieces are not assembled with the hanging tools fully is avoided, meanwhile, the labor of replacing the hanging tools by the redundant stations is avoided, and the burden of driving the hanging tools to rotate by a driving motor of the device can be lightened.

title_en: Cleaning equipment and workpiece surface treatment device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of cleaning equipment, in particular to cleaning equipment and a workpiece surface treatment device. The cleaning device includes: an apparatus body and an adjustment assembly; the apparatus body is configured to communicate with a cleaning medium source, and the cleaning medium in the cleaning medium source is capable of being ejected from an ejection port of the apparatus body onto a surface of a workpiece, thereby achieving cleaning of the surface of the workpiece. The apparatus body has a plurality of ejection ports; when the ejection port is in an operating state, the cleaning medium in the cleaning medium source can be ejected to the surface of the workpiece through the ejection port; when the ejection port is in the non-operation state, no cleaning medium flows at the ejection port; the adjusting component is connected with the equipment main body and is used for adjusting the number of the jet ports in the working state and the non-working state, so that the equipment main body can be matched with a workpiece better. Compared with the prior art, the cleaning medium waste problem caused by the overlarge spraying range of the device main body does not occur.

title_en: Clamp for processing mold part
abstract_en: The utility model provides a clamp for processing a mold part, which relates to the technical field of part processing and comprises a main body and a clamping mechanism arranged outside the main body, wherein the clamping mechanism comprises a working assembly and a sliding assembly, the working assembly comprises a first motor, the first motor is arranged inside the main body, a supporting shaft is arranged at the top end of the first motor, the top end of the first motor is rotationally connected with a first rotating shaft, the outer wall of the first rotating shaft is fixedly connected with a rotating block, the first motor is arranged to generate power to drive the first rotating shaft to rotate, so that the rotating block is driven to rotate, a second rotating shaft on the outer wall of the rotating block can drive a connecting rod to rotate, the rotating shaft at the other end of the connecting rod is fixed at the bottom of a moving plate, the clamp body at the top end of the moving plate can shrink inwards on a limiting column to clamp a part, the size of an object can be adjusted, and the processed part is clamped more stably.

title_en: Boring fixture for forklift reduction gearbox
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a boring fixture for a forklift speed reduction box body, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a supporting table and two supporting columns are arranged on the bottom plate, the vertical surface of the forklift speed reduction box body is kept horizontal through the supporting columns and the supporting columns, a left horizontal jacking mechanism, a right horizontal jacking mechanism and a bottom horizontal jacking mechanism are respectively arranged on the bottom plate corresponding to the two sides and the bottom surface of a base of the forklift speed reduction box body, an inclined horizontal jacking mechanism is respectively arranged on the bottom plate corresponding to the two sides of the top surface of the forklift speed reduction box body, and a top pressing mechanism and a left pressing mechanism and a right pressing mechanism are respectively arranged on the top and the left and right sides of the vertical surface of the forklift speed reduction box body corresponding to the base. The utility model is specially used for horizontally clamping and stabilizing the vertical surface of the forklift speed reduction box body during boring of the forklift speed reduction box body, is convenient for clamping and positioning, greatly facilitates boring of the forklift speed reduction box body, greatly improves the processing efficiency, saves the processing time, improves the processing precision, saves the labor force and reduces the cost.

title_en: Automatic trimming mechanism for angle brackets of electrical cabinets
abstract_en: The utility model provides an automatic trimming mechanism for an electrical cabinet angle bracket, which relates to the technical field of amorphous alloy manufacturing and comprises an operation table, wherein a trimming and polishing assembly is arranged on the surface of the operation table and comprises a screw groove and a threaded rod, the screw groove is formed in the operation table, the threaded rod is arranged in the screw groove, a bearing is arranged at one end of the threaded rod, a rotating motor is arranged at the other end of the threaded rod, a moving block is arranged on the surface of the threaded rod, a threaded hole is formed in the bottom of the moving block, and a supporting plate is fixedly connected to the top of the moving block. According to the utility model, when the angle bracket needs to be trimmed, the angle bracket can be firstly placed on the operating platform and is close to the screw groove, and then the rotating motor can be started to drive the threaded rod to rotate, so that the moving block drives the polishing wheel to automatically trim the angle bracket, the problem of lower manual trimming efficiency is avoided, and the production efficiency of the amorphous alloy angle bracket is improved.

title_en: Feeding device for chamfering alpenstock pipe fitting
abstract_en: The utility model provides a feeding device for chamfering alpenstock pipe fittings, which comprises side plates symmetrically arranged left and right, wherein blanking pieces are vertically arranged on the inner sides of the side plates, mounting blocks are arranged at the rear of the blanking pieces, L-shaped blanking grooves are formed in the inner sides of the blanking pieces, pushing plates which are used for pushing the pipe fittings backwards and forwards and are corresponding to the mounting blocks to clamp the pipe fittings are slidably arranged on the inner sides of the lower ends of the blanking pieces in a sliding mode, the pushing plates are driven by air cylinders, and a backward supporting component which is connected with the mounting blocks and is used for supporting the pipe fittings backwards is arranged at the blanking pieces. The utility model has the advantages that: the push plate pushes the pipe fitting of supporting behind to move backward and press from both sides tightly, and after the chamfer was accomplished, the pipe fitting was automatic to drop when the push plate resetted, and degree of automation is high.

title_en: Stainless steel sheet leveling equipment for medical instrument production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses stainless steel sheet leveling equipment for medical instrument production, which relates to the technical field of medical instruments and comprises a bottom plate, wherein supporting legs are welded on the periphery of the outer wall of the bottom plate, the bottom plate top is offered the recess that runs through the bottom plate, the fixing base is installed to the recess inner wall, the fixing base is located bottom plate top outer wall intermediate position. According to the utility model, when the stainless steel leveling device works, whether the surface of the stainless steel is flat or not is judged through the receiving condition of the infrared rays of the infrared receiver, if the surface of the stainless steel is uneven, the corresponding infrared receiver cannot receive the infrared rays, at the moment, the hydraulic cylinder can move to the upper part of the uneven part of the surface of the stainless steel, so that the knocking block is driven to reciprocate to knock the stainless steel to level the stainless steel, compared with a mode of observing and leveling by naked eyes, the infrared ray leveling is more accurate, the error is smaller, the leveled stainless steel is flatter, manual operation is not needed in the whole process, and the use is more convenient.

title_en: A processing platform for base plate processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a processing platform for processing a substrate, which belongs to the field of laser marking and comprises a platform main body, wherein the platform main body is provided with a hollowed-out part, the surface of the platform main body provided with the hollowed-out part is provided with an adsorption hole, the adsorption hole is arranged along the upper edge of the hollowed-out part, the hollowed-out part is internally provided with a supporting part for supporting the substrate, and the supporting part can adjust the distance between the supporting part and the side wall of the hollowed-out part. The substrate can be effectively fixed through the adsorption holes arranged on the surface of the substrate, and machining errors caused by vibration or movement in the machining process are avoided. Meanwhile, the hollow part is arranged to avoid the tin ball to be processed, and the supporting part in the hollow part can also adjust the distance between the supporting part and the side wall, so that the platform can adapt to substrates with different sizes, and the processing precision and flexibility are improved.

title_en: Rotary hydraulic vertical drilling machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rotary hydraulic vertical drilling machine, which comprises a mounting table, wherein the top end of the mounting table is provided with a mounting plate, the top end of the mounting plate is fixedly connected with a first hydraulic cylinder, the output end of the first hydraulic cylinder penetrates through the mounting plate and is fixedly connected with a driving motor, the output end of the driving motor is fixedly connected with a drill bit, two sides of the driving motor are respectively and fixedly connected with a group of limiting sleeves, and two sides of the bottom end of the mounting plate are fixedly connected with limiting suspenders. This rotary hydraulic vertical drilling machine is through being provided with the locating bench, before drilling, places the top at the locating bench with the metal sheet, later starts servo motor and drives two-way silk axle rotation, and two-way silk axle drives the screw sleeve synchronous motion of both sides again, and screw sleeve passes through the connecting plate and drives the motion of location splint, makes two sets of location splint laminating in the both sides of metal sheet to carry out centre gripping location to the metal sheet, the problem of can not fixing a position the metal sheet fast is solved.

title_en: Saw blade lubricating and cooling mechanism for aluminum bar machining
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a saw blade lubrication cooling mechanism for aluminum bar processing, and relates to the technical field of aluminum bar processing; the utility model comprises a bottom plate, wherein a speed change mechanism is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the bottom plate, the speed change mechanism is used for rotating and changing the speed of a saw blade, a heat dissipation mechanism matched with the speed change mechanism is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the bottom plate, the heat dissipation mechanism is used for dissipating heat of the saw blade, the speed change mechanism comprises a shell, a motor is arranged at one side of the shell, a speed change gear is fixedly arranged at the output end of the motor, a rotating gear is connected to the outer surface of the speed change gear in a meshed manner, a rotating rod is fixedly arranged on the inner surface of the rotating gear, two rolling shafts are fixedly arranged on the outer surface of the rotating rod, and a plurality of balls are slidably arranged on the inner surfaces of the two rolling shafts.

title_en: Positioning device of numerical control machine tool
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a positioning device of a numerical control machine tool, and relates to the technical field of numerical control machine tools. The utility model comprises a support, wherein one side of the top of the support is connected with a sliding table in a sliding way, one side of the top of the sliding table is connected with a tool rest in a rotating way, the periphery of the tool rest is provided with a tool setting mechanism, the tool setting mechanism comprises a base, the interior of the base is connected with a lifting block in a sliding way, the top of the lifting block is provided with a sliding groove, the interior of the sliding groove is connected with a sliding block in a sliding way, the top of the sliding block is connected with a positioning plate in a sliding way, the front end of the positioning plate is provided with a mounting groove, and one side of the interior of the mounting groove is fixedly connected with a Hall sensor.

title_en: Sawing device of hacksaw machine for boiler assembly
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of sawing of boiler components and discloses a sawing device of a hacksaw machine for a boiler component, which comprises a machine body, wherein bow-shaped frames are detachably arranged on two sides of the interior of the machine body, adjusting seats are fixedly arranged on the other sides of the two groups of bow-shaped frames, and sawing accelerating mechanisms are detachably arranged in the two groups of adjusting seats. According to the utility model, the boiler component to be sawed is positioned between the two groups of bow-shaped frames, the driving servo motor drives the driving disc to rotate, the connecting shaft positioned on the driving disc can drive the connecting frame rotatably arranged on the other side to reciprocate, so that the saw blade arranged in the saw blade mounting frame is sawed for the boiler component, the saw blade mounting frames are fixedly arranged on both sides of the connecting frame in a matching manner, the electric push rod on one side of the adjusting seat is driven, and the saw blade in the saw blade mounting frame is pushed to synchronously saw the both sides of the boiler component, so that the sawing time of the boiler component can be greatly shortened, and the sawing efficiency of the boiler component is improved.

title_en: Sliding table structure of hard alloy cutter grooving machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a sliding table structure of a hard alloy cutter grooving machine, which belongs to the technical field of hard alloy processing equipment and comprises a lathe bed, wherein a middle carriage is arranged on the lathe bed in a sliding manner in a left-right manner, a small carriage is arranged on the middle carriage in a sliding manner in a front-back manner, the middle carriage is arranged on the lathe bed in a sliding manner through a first sliding block sliding rail set, a first linear motor device is arranged between the middle carriage and the lathe bed, the first linear motor device pushes the middle carriage to slide in the left-right manner on the lathe bed, a second linear motor device is arranged between the small carriage and the middle carriage in a sliding manner, and the second linear motor device pushes the small carriage to slide back and forth on the middle carriage, and a plurality of convex grooves are formed in the small carriage.

title_en: Pneumatic drilling machine silencing device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of pneumatic drilling machine silencing, in particular to a pneumatic drilling machine silencing device which comprises a processing table, wherein a driving structure is arranged at the top end of the processing table, a noise reduction structure is arranged at the upper side of the processing table and comprises a connecting block, the connecting block is fixedly connected to the output end of the driving structure, a movable groove is formed in the surface of the connecting block, a drill bit is arranged on the bottom surface of the connecting block, a movable block is sleeved on the outer side of the connecting block, a spring is fixedly connected to the top surface of the movable block, a silencing cover is fixedly connected to the outer wall of the movable block, and a guide groove is integrally formed in the inner wall of the silencing cover. According to the utility model, the movable block is arranged, so that the silencing cover can be driven to move up and down on the outer side of the drill bit, when the silencing cover is used, the silencing cover is matched with a workpiece to shade the drill bit, the silencing cover can be used for improving the noise absorption effect, and the gear is arranged to spray cooling liquid to a processing part.

title_en: Special tool for quick repair of aircraft fiber optic bus
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of aviation equipment, in particular to a special tool for quickly repairing an aircraft fiber bus, which comprises a wire mark pipe taking-out tool for taking out a wire mark pipe at a moving position and a fiber connector contact couple taking-out tool for taking out a wire in a dead zone of a connector, wherein a damaged part can be replaced locally through the contact couple taking-out tool of the connector, and replacement of a whole fiber finished wire harness is avoided; in the local replacement process, the wires are taken out and assembled in the blind area of the connector in one-to-one correspondence with the jacks, the optical fiber connector contacts with the even taking and delivering tool to realize the integrity of the original machine wire mark, and the capability of quick repair of the ceramic sleeve of the in-situ optical fiber bus of the aircraft is formed by using the special tool for quick repair of the optical fiber bus, so that the repair quality of the optical fiber cable is improved, and the labor intensity is reduced.

title_en: Plywood edging device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of plywood edging, and provides a plywood edging device which comprises a supporting seat, a bracket and a plywood body, wherein a polishing assembly for simultaneously edging four sides of the plywood body is arranged at the upper end of the bracket, the polishing assembly comprises a first electromagnetic slide rail, a second electromagnetic slide rail and an edging machine body, the first electromagnetic slide rail and the second electromagnetic slide rail are vertically and symmetrically distributed on a plane, two side surfaces of the plywood body are parallel to the first electromagnetic slide rail, the other two side surfaces of the plywood body are parallel to the second electromagnetic slide rail, an electromagnetic slide seat is electromagnetically matched with the outer side surfaces of the first electromagnetic slide rail and the second electromagnetic slide rail, and the upper end of the electromagnetic slide seat is connected with one end of the edging machine body.

title_en: Automobile part checking fixture turnover mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automobile part detection tool turnover mechanism which comprises a base, wherein a group of supporting seats are fixedly arranged at the left part of the lower end of the base and the right part of the lower end of the base, the two groups of supporting seats are distributed in a bilateral symmetry mode, each group of supporting seats is provided with two supporting seats, a support is fixedly arranged at the left part of the upper end of the base, a connecting seat is fixedly arranged at the left side of the upper end of the base, and a sliding strip is fixedly arranged at the right part of the upper end of the base. According to the turnover mechanism of the automobile part detection tool, the support is arranged, the motor drives the rotating column and the main wheel to rotate, the main wheel drives the auxiliary wheel and the first rotating shaft to rotate, the detection tool is convenient to turn under the cooperation of the second rotating shaft, more manpower is not required to be consumed during turning, meanwhile, the labor intensity of workers is reduced, and the height of the whole equipment can be adjusted through the arrangement of the connecting seat, the clamping assembly and the moving seat, and meanwhile, the stability of the automobile part is enhanced.

title_en: Fiber tube production forming device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of production forming devices, in particular to a fiber tube production forming device. The extruder comprises an extruder body, wherein one end of the upper surface of the extruder body is fixedly connected with a rectangular block with a groove, the inner wall of the rectangular block with the groove is provided with a threaded rod, the left side of the rectangular block with the groove is provided with a motor, the output shaft of the motor is fixedly connected with the threaded rod, the outer surface of the threaded rod is in threaded connection with a threaded block, the threaded block slides on the inner wall of the rectangular block with the groove, one side of the outer surface of the threaded block is provided with a cutting knife, the upper surface of the cutting knife is provided with a convenient assembly, one side of the outer surface of the extruder body is provided with a cleaning device, and the problems that as the extruder is usually fixed by using a screw, fiber residues are possibly attached to the surface of the screw due to the cutting knife cutting a fiber tube, and the cutting knife is not easy to detach due to the fact that the screw is replaced, and the cutting efficiency is affected are solved.

title_en: A simple and easy cutting table for appearance line is sheared
abstract_en: A simple and easy cutting platform for appearance line is sheared, including the workstation be provided with cutting device and length cutting mechanism on the workstation, cutting device installs at workstation tip, length cutting mechanism is including scale, slip boss and slip locating plate structure, slip locating plate structure slidable mounting is on the slip boss, scale and slip boss set up along workstation edge side by side, slip locating plate structure has the location panel, and the setting of location panel alignment scale, cutting device is including actuating mechanism, shearing fixed notch and shearing cutter, shearing cutter installs at the actuating mechanism output, just shearing cutter and shearing fixed notch relative motion. The wire harness cutting machine is simple in structure, capable of accurately cutting qualified wire harnesses with different lengths, smooth in cut, safe, convenient and fast, low in manufacturing cost and high in working efficiency.

title_en: Cutting device for wire and cable processing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of wire and cable processing, and discloses a cutting device for wire and cable processing, which comprises a cutting machine case, wherein a vertical plate is fixedly arranged at the top of the cutting machine case, a fixed table is movably sleeved in the vertical plate, a cutting knife is fixedly arranged at the top of the fixed table, a first transmission mechanism is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the cutting machine case, one end of the first transmission mechanism extends into the cutting machine case and is fixedly arranged at the top end of the inner wall of the cutting machine case, and a control mechanism is movably sleeved outside the transmission mechanism and is positioned in the cutting machine case. According to the utility model, the second transmission mechanism is limited to operate through the fixing mechanism, so that the cutting knife starts to descend after the clamp is fixed, the problem that the clamp is not fixed well and the risk of operation is generated when the cutting operation starts is solved, and the transmission mechanism is disengaged from the engagement design, so that the cable to be processed is not excessively fixed, thereby reducing loss and improving efficiency.

title_en: Loading attachment for laser cutting machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a feeding device for a laser cutting machine, which relates to the technical field of laser cutting machines and comprises a U-shaped frame, wherein a conveyor belt is arranged in the U-shaped frame, a supporting component with adjustable height is arranged at the bottom, fixed plates are symmetrically and fixedly connected to the two sides of the outer part of the U-shaped frame, a guide rail is fixedly connected to the top of the fixed plates, a movable frame is arranged above the U-shaped frame, the bottoms of the two ends of the movable frame are slidably connected to the guide rail through supporting seats, a first cylinder is arranged at the inner top of the U-shaped frame, a transverse plate is arranged at the output end of the first cylinder, a vacuum chuck is arranged at the bottom of the transverse plate, a second cylinder is symmetrically arranged at one end of the U-shaped frame, a limiting plate is arranged at the output end of the second cylinder, and an extension plate is detachably connected to one end of the limiting plate. According to the utility model, the distance between the two limiting plates can be adjusted through the extension of the second cylinder, so that the limiting of the plate is facilitated, the limiting effect can be achieved when the plate moves onto the laser cutting machine through the extension plate, and the plate is effectively prevented from deviating in the conveying process.

title_en: Mounting fixture is used in sensor detection
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fixed clamps, in particular to a fixed clamp for sensor detection. Its technical scheme includes the bottom plate, rotate on the bottom plate and install the mounting bracket, still include the slide, slide slidable mounting is between the mounting bracket, rotate on the mounting bracket and install reciprocating screw, reciprocating screw and slide threaded connection, rotate on the bottom plate and install the revolving stage, symmetrical slidable mounting has the slider on the revolving stage, fixed mounting has the fixed block on the slider, it has the mounting panel to articulate on the fixed block, the other end of mounting panel is articulated with the bottom of slide. The utility model realizes the fixation of the sensor, and can change the detection direction of the sensor, so that the sensor is more convenient to take, high in convenience and strong in practicability.

title_en: Rotary riveting positioning device for compression valve assembly of automobile shock absorber
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a spin riveting positioning device for an automobile shock absorber compression valve assembly, and relates to the technical field of positioning tools for the automobile shock absorber compression valve assembly. The automatic riveting device comprises a mounting base, wherein a cylindrical positioning support mechanism is mounted on the upper Fang Caxie of the mounting base, a mandrel is coaxially arranged in the positioning support mechanism in a dismounting mode, a disc-shaped positioning seat is detachably arranged on the top surface of the positioning support mechanism, a vertical through positioning channel is arranged at the axial position of the positioning seat, the end part of the mandrel stretches into the positioning channel, a press-mounting device is coaxially arranged above the positioning support mechanism, the press-mounting device and the positioning support mechanism are coaxially arranged, and a through operation channel for allowing a rivet to pass through is arranged at the axial position of the press-mounting device, so that when the automobile shock absorber compression valve assemblies of different types are rivet soon, the rivet heads, the pressing devices, the supporting mandrels and other components of corresponding types can be quickly switched, and the purpose that one device rivet the compression valve assemblies of various shock absorbers is soon is realized.

title_en: Argon arc welding machine for welding metal products
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of argon arc welding machines, and provides an argon arc welding machine for welding metal products, which comprises a rack and an argon arc welding machine main body, wherein the argon arc welding machine main body is fixed on the rack, fixed columns are fixed at two ends of the surface of the rack, a fixed platform is arranged at the top of the fixed columns, an angle adjusting assembly is arranged between the fixed columns and the fixed platform, a pressing and fixing assembly is arranged on the fixed platform, the pressing and fixing assembly comprises a pair of long grooves, the long grooves are formed at two opposite ends of the outer surface of the fixed platform, round rods are arranged in the long grooves, and movable sleeve frames are connected to the outside of the round rods in a sliding sleeve manner. Through the technical scheme, the argon arc welding machine solves the problems that the existing argon arc welding machine in the related technology is single equipment, has no other supporting and auxiliary structure, needs to be carried to a welding position for operation welding, is inconvenient to fix the object when the object is welded, causes inconvenient personnel to weld, cannot adjust different fixing angles to the object, causes inconvenient welding and poor operation convenience.

title_en: Automatic nailing machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an automatic nailing machine, which relates to the technical field of nailing equipment and comprises a machine table, a conveying belt, a nailing mechanism and a multi-shaft rotating mechanical arm, wherein the conveying belt, the nailing mechanism and the multi-shaft rotating mechanical arm are arranged on the upper side of the machine table, the conveying belt is arranged between the nailing mechanism and the multi-shaft rotating mechanical arm, the nailing mechanism is arranged on the upper side of the machine table in a lifting mode, an electric telescopic rod is vertically arranged at the movable end of the multi-shaft rotating mechanical arm, an inverted L-shaped clamping plate is arranged at the bottom of the electric telescopic rod, the conveying belt is arranged on the machine table and used for conveying a workpiece to a designated position, the workpiece is pressed downwards through the inverted L-shaped clamping plate arranged at the tail end of the multi-shaft rotating mechanical arm to be fixed, and then the front side, the rear side, the front side, the rear side and the left side of the workpiece can be fixed through a clamping assembly, so that the whole nailing mechanism on the right side can be used for nailing the workpiece quickly and stably, and the clamped workpiece can be quickly rotated and conveyed to a station of a next procedure through the multi-shaft rotating mechanical arm after the nailing is finished.

title_en: Planetary reduction gear and rivet gun
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a planetary reduction device which comprises a gear fixing seat, a gear connecting seat and a reduction mechanism arranged between the gear fixing seat and the gear fixing seat, wherein the reduction mechanism comprises a primary planetary reduction group, a planet carrier, a secondary planetary reduction group and a shaft gear, the primary planetary reduction group is assembled at one end of the gear fixing seat, one end of the planet carrier is assembled on the primary planetary reduction group, the secondary planetary reduction group is assembled at the other end of the planet carrier, the shaft gear is assembled on the secondary planetary reduction group, the secondary planetary reduction group comprises a sliding clutch gear ring, a secondary planetary gear set is connected in an inner cavity of the sliding clutch gear ring in a meshed mode, and the secondary planetary carrier is connected to the secondary planetary gear set. The utility model also discloses a riveter applying the planetary reduction gear. The utility model realizes the speed reduction by designing the planetary speed reduction, the two-stage adjustable speed planetary speed reduction and the transmission of the transmission gear on one axis, and the structure and the screw rod structure for driving the rivet gun realize the speed reduction transmission and the riveting.

title_en: Hydraulic pipe bending equipment for electric power engineering
abstract_en: The utility model discloses hydraulic pipe bending equipment for electric power engineering, and relates to the technical field of electric power engineering. The hydraulic pipe bending equipment for the electric power engineering comprises a mounting base and a guide mechanism, wherein an empty groove is formed in the top of the mounting base, sliding grooves are formed in the inner walls of two sides of the empty groove, the guide mechanism is arranged at the top of the mounting base and comprises a circular plate, fixing rods, movable blocks, strip-shaped openings and positioning plates, the top of the circular plate is fixedly connected with one ends of the two groups of fixing rods, the top of the movable blocks is provided with the strip-shaped openings which penetrate through the top and the bottom, one ends of the fixing rods penetrate through the strip-shaped openings, the outer walls of the fixing rods are in sliding connection with the inner walls of the strip-shaped openings, and the positioning plates which are symmetrically arranged are respectively and fixedly arranged on the adjacent sides of the movable blocks. The positioning plate is attached to the front and rear of the metal pipe to limit and guide the metal pipe, rolling deflection of the metal pipe in the pipe bending process is avoided, accuracy of pipe bending of the device is improved, the positioning plate can be suitable for metal pipes with various pipe diameters, and the positioning plate is easy to operate and is easy to operate.

title_en: Industrial robot processing positioning device convenient to operate
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a positioning device for industrial robot processing, which is convenient to operate, and belongs to the technical field of robot processing, and the positioning device comprises a first support frame, wherein the outer wall of the first support frame is fixedly connected with a second support frame, the top wall of the second support frame is fixedly connected with a motor, and the outer wall of the first support frame is provided with a limiting assembly; according to the utility model, the positions of the plurality of extrusion blocks are simultaneously adjusted by the aid of the arranged clamping components matched with the limiting components, so that all-dimensional clamping of parts of the industrial robot is realized, the surfaces of the parts of the industrial robot can be better adapted by the aid of the telescopic rods and the strong springs, the unstable clamping of the special-shaped surfaces is prevented, and the problem that the contact surface of the device facing the parts of the special-shaped industrial robot in the prior art is possibly smaller, so that deflection is easier to cause is solved.

title_en: Hydraulic tailstock buffer gear
abstract_en: The utility model provides a hydraulic tailstock buffer mechanism which comprises a tailstock, a tip assembly, a buffer spring, a rear end cover and a tension bolt, wherein the upper part of the tailstock is provided with a tip sleeve, the tip assembly comprises a tip, an outer sleeve, an inner sleeve, a first bearing and a second bearing, the outer sleeve is inserted into the tip sleeve and can axially move in the tip sleeve, the inner sleeve is rotatably supported in the outer sleeve through the first bearing and the second bearing, the rear end of the tip is inserted into an inner sleeve, the rear end of the tip sleeve is sealed with a plurality of rear end covers, the buffer spring is elastically supported between the rear end of the tip assembly and the rear end covers, and the tension bolt penetrates through the rear end covers from back to front and is connected with the tip assembly and can axially move synchronously along with the tip assembly. The hydraulic tailstock buffer mechanism not only can buffer the clamping force when clamping a workpiece, but also can realize the requirements of different clamping forces by adjusting the buffer spring, and can meet the requirement of workpiece rotation.

title_en: Steel pipe straightener
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of steel pipe machining equipment, in particular to a steel pipe straightening machine. Including the mount, the inside alignment mechanism that rotates that is provided with of mount, alignment roller and driving motor that alignment mechanism installed at the inside rotating turret of mount, rotating turret inner chamber installation including rotating, driving motor passes through gear and gear circle and is connected with the rotating turret transmission, and alignment roller upper and lower symmetry is provided with two lines, and every line all is provided with a plurality of, and rotating turret inner chamber one end is the fixed plate that the equiangular is provided with arc structure still, and the fixed plate inner wall is provided with the spoke, and mount left side one end is provided with feeding mechanism, and mount right side one end is provided with discharging mechanism. Can be to the rotatory alignment of steel pipe, can apply effort alignment to steel pipe all directions, polish the steel pipe after the alignment simultaneously.

title_en: Punching shear device for angle steel
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a punching shear device for angle steel, which relates to the field of galvanized iron tower production and comprises a table body, wherein a feeding hole is formed in the rear end of the table body, a supporting frame is fixedly connected to the top of the table body, an angle steel punching mechanism is arranged at the top of the supporting frame, an automatic feeding mechanism is arranged in the table body, a finishing frame is arranged at the front end of the table body, a conveying mechanism and a deburring mechanism are arranged in the finishing frame, and a collecting box is connected below the deburring mechanism in a sliding mode. The automatic feeding mechanism is arranged in the table body, the synchronous belt component and the anti-skid leather roller of the automatic feeding mechanism can convey angle steel of a feeding hole to a cutter, the second motor controls the feeding length, the punched angle steel is conveyed to a V-shaped groove of a grinding machine by a conveying belt, the two ends of the angle steel are ground by the grinding machine, burrs are removed, then an output shaft of the first motor rotates, the angle steel which is processed in the V-shaped groove is adjusted into a collecting box, and the workload of operators is reduced.

title_en: Torque spanner
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a torque wrench which comprises a wrench head part and a handle part, wherein an inner steel pipe is arranged between the wrench head part and the handle part to realize connection between the wrench head part and the handle part, an adjusting component is arranged on the wrench head part, the adjusting component comprises a ratchet wheel and a stirring part, the stirring part is matched with the ratchet wheel to realize conversion of the direction of the wrench head part, and a sleeve is sleeved on the inner steel pipe. The wrench head is connected with the grab handle portion through the inner steel pipe, the overall stability and the firmness of the torque wrench are guaranteed, the sleeve is sleeved on the inner steel pipe, the attractiveness of the wrench is improved, meanwhile, the holding comfort of the grab handle portion is enhanced, the change of the direction of the wrench head is achieved through the adjusting assembly, the shape and the size of the grab handle portion are suitable for the hand shape of most people, and comfortable holding experience is provided.

title_en: Diamond tool bit with chip removal radiating effect
abstract_en: The diamond tool bit with chip removing and heat radiating effects comprises two layers of first blades, two layers of second blades and two layers of third blades, wherein the first blades are provided with a first easily-ground area without diamond particles and two first grinding work areas with diamond particles, the second blades are provided with a second easily-ground area without diamond particles and a second grinding work area with diamond particles, the third blades are provided with a third easily-ground area without diamond particles and a third grinding work area with diamond particles, the first, second and third easily-ground areas form easily-ground areas and are provided with overlapped parts, chip removing grooves are formed in the grinding process, chip removing functions can be achieved, the diamond particles are completely wrapped in matrix powder when the diamond tool bit is formed, the bonding is firmer, the diamond tool bit is not easy to fall off, the wear resistance is good, the service life is long, the diamond particles exposed on the side wall of the chip removing grooves form new sharp edge points, the degree is improved, and the cutting efficiency is improved.

title_en: Mounting structure of protective curtain for workpiece welding
abstract_en: The utility model provides a mounting structure of a protective curtain for welding workpieces, which comprises a mounting assembly, wherein the mounting assembly comprises a mounting fixing plate, a mounting hook plate, a fixing piece, a limiting connecting piece and a protective curtain connecting plate, the protective curtain is arranged on the protective curtain connecting plate, the bottom end of the mounting fixing plate is provided with the mounting hook plate, the protective curtain connecting plate is provided with the limiting connecting piece, the bottom end of the mounting hook plate is provided with a baffle plate extending upwards and outwards, a mounting interval is formed between the baffle plate and the side wall of the mounting hook plate, more than one mounting groove is formed in the baffle plate, the limiting connecting piece extends into the mounting interval through the mounting groove to be arranged, and the limiting connecting piece is limited by the fixing piece, so that the limiting connecting piece cannot be separated from the mounting interval, the protective curtain can be guaranteed to be mounted and fixed by only loosening the fixing piece if the fixing piece is required, the protective curtain is taken down from the mounting hook plate, the structure is simple, and the mounting and dismounting process is convenient.

title_en: Fixing tool
abstract_en: The application relates to a fixing tool which comprises a main body section and an extension section, wherein the main body section is provided with a first plug-in column, the first plug-in column is used for being in plug-in fit with a positioning hole of an engine cylinder body, the extension section is connected with the main body section, the extension section is provided with a second plug-in column, and the second plug-in column is used for being in plug-in fit with a mounting hole of a connecting rod so as to limit movement between the engine cylinder body and the connecting rod. Therefore, the connecting rod and the engine cylinder body can be relatively fixed, so that the movement between the engine cylinder body and the connecting rod is limited, the connecting rod is prevented from shaking when the crankshaft is installed, the crankshaft is convenient to install, errors in the installation position can be avoided, and the assembly precision and the assembly efficiency of the crankshaft are improved. Meanwhile, the original hole-shaped structures of the engine cylinder body and the connecting rod are utilized to be relatively fixed with the fixing tool, so that the processing steps can be simplified.

title_en: Water circular cutting device convenient for adjusting cutter
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of grain cutting machines, in particular to a water ring cutting device convenient for adjusting a cutter, which comprises a machine base, wherein one side of the machine base is provided with a bracket through a rotating assembly, the upper end of the bracket is provided with a cast aluminum water ring cover, the output end of a motor body is connected with an output shaft, the output shaft is connected with a grain cutting shaft through an adjusting mechanism, a cutter body is arranged on a cutter seat, and a cutter pressing mechanism is arranged on the outer side of the grain cutting shaft.

title_en: Welding structure of nonstandard structural part
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of welded structures and discloses a welded structure of nonstandard structural members, which comprises an operation table, wherein a fixed seat is fixed at one end of the top of the operation table, a circular seat is arranged on the side wall of the fixed seat, a rotating mechanism for rotating the circular seat is arranged on the outer side wall of the fixed seat, a first clamping mechanism for clamping the nonstandard structural members is arranged at the top of the circular seat, a bottom plate is arranged at the top of the operation table, a power mechanism for moving the bottom plate is arranged at the top of the operation table, a base is arranged at the top of the bottom plate, and an arc-shaped groove is formed in the top of the base. According to the welding device, the nonstandard structural members with different sizes can be fixed through the first clamping mechanism and the second clamping mechanism, the practicability of the welding device is improved, the round seat is driven to rotate through the rotating mechanism in the welding process, the structural members are driven to rotate through the first clamping mechanism, manual overturning is not needed, more time is saved, the working efficiency is improved, the consistency and the stability of welding joints are guaranteed, and the welding quality is improved.

title_en: Hardware edge angle polishing device with waste recycling function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hardware corner polishing device with a waste recycling function, which comprises a supporting table, wherein side plates are fixed on two sides of the top end of the supporting table, a top plate is fixed between the two groups of side plates, a support is fixed at the bottom end of the supporting table, a collecting box is arranged in the support, supporting bars are fixed at two ends in the collecting box, a motor II is fixed at the bottom end of a motor push rod II, and a motor I is arranged at the top end of the outer side of the side plate. According to the utility model, the collecting box is arranged, the fan is started, the fan rotates in the collecting box, so that negative pressure is generated in the collecting box, dust generated by polishing can enter the collecting box through the air suction inlet, then the dust falls into the filter frame, the sucked air is discharged through the air outlet, and when the filter frame is cleaned, the filter frame is driven to be pulled out from the collecting box by pulling the pull handle to one side, so that the filter frame can be cleaned and recovered.

title_en: Blade detection device
abstract_en: The utility model is suitable for the technical field of blade detection, and provides a blade detection device which comprises a base, a detection assembly and a detection assembly, wherein the top surface of the base is provided with a plurality of brackets, the detection assembly comprises a middle ring which is connected with a sliding seat in a sliding manner, the sliding seat is connected with the base in a sliding manner, two sides of the middle ring are respectively provided with a side ring in a sliding manner, a rotating shaft is rotatably arranged in the middle ring, two moving blocks are arranged on the rotating shaft, one side of the rotating shaft is provided with a mounting plate, a connecting rod is rotatably arranged between the mounting plate and the moving blocks, the mounting plate is elastically connected with a plurality of detection probes, two ends of the rotating shaft are respectively provided with a matched gear, the side rings are respectively provided with an annular gear, a driving shaft and a plurality of driven shafts are rotatably arranged above the base, a sleeve shaft is rotatably arranged on the sliding seat, a gear shaft and a side gear are rotatably arranged on the sleeve shaft, a plurality of first inserting rods and second inserting rods are slidably arranged in the sleeve shaft, a matched gear ring is arranged on the middle ring, an outer gear ring is arranged on the side ring is rotatably sleeved on the driven shaft, a ratchet wheel is arranged on the sleeve, a belt is arranged between the sleeve ring and the driving shaft, and a plurality of second circulating grooves are respectively arranged on the driven shaft. Therefore, the utility model can not only carry out comprehensive and effective detection on the surface of the blade, but also automatically adjust the position of the detection probe, thereby improving the detection efficiency and reducing the labor intensity of users.

title_en: Grooving device for processing color steel plates
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of milling engineering and discloses a slotting device for processing color steel plates, which comprises a processing platform and a cutting machine, wherein a triaxial gantry truss is arranged on the upper side of the processing platform, the cutting machine is arranged on the upper side of the processing platform through the triaxial gantry truss, a telescopic rod is slidably arranged on the side surface of the processing platform, one end of the telescopic rod can be slidably inserted into the processing platform, a first telescopic cylinder for driving a first positioning plate to move left and right is arranged on the lower side of the processing platform, and a second positioning plate is slidably arranged on one side of the processing platform. According to the scheme, the size of the processing platform is reduced, the first positioning plate is used as a processing auxiliary platform, the first positioning plate and the second positioning plate are used for propping the two ends of the material to be processed tightly, the positioning function is achieved, the first positioning plate stretches out and draws back the material to be processed to one side, the two ends of the material to be processed can be grooved and processed on the upper side of the processing platform, the auxiliary pushing and positioning effects are achieved, and the processing auxiliary platform is more labor-saving and convenient to use.

title_en: Stainless steel cutting device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a stainless steel cutting device which comprises a water storage tank and a support frame fixedly connected to the top of the water storage tank, wherein a hydraulic telescopic rod is fixedly connected to the top of an inner cavity of the support frame, a cutting mechanism is arranged at the telescopic end of the hydraulic telescopic rod, and the cutting mechanism comprises a motor. This stainless steel cutting device drives motor and cutting piece downwardly moving through control hydraulic telescoping rod, and the motor drives the cutting piece and rotates, makes the cutting piece cut the stainless steel, and the motor drives the pulling board through first tooth dental lamina, gear and second tooth dental lamina simultaneously and upwards moves, and the pulling board can drive the sealing plate through the breather pipe and upwards extrude water, makes the water in the water storage tank spray stainless steel cutting department through the shower nozzle, can prevent well that stainless steel cutting from producing the spark and splash, can not scald the staff to through the wet stainless steel, cut more smooth.

title_en: Window frame cutting device for door and window production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of door and window production equipment and discloses a window frame cutting device for door and window production, which comprises a positioning plate, wherein a top plate is welded at the upper end of one side of the positioning plate, a sliding rail is arranged at one end of the upper surface of the top plate, a sliding table is connected to the sliding rail in a sliding manner, a protection plate is arranged at one side of the sliding table, and through the cooperation among the top plate, the guide rail, the protection plate, a carrier and a positioning mechanism, a third cylinder drives a sliding block to move so that the sliding block drives a vertical plate to move, a pressing plate on the vertical plate compresses a window frame placed on the carrier, thereby improving the stability of the window frame during cutting, avoiding the influence of shaking on the quality of a section during cutting of the window frame, protecting scraps produced during cutting through the protection plate, improving the cutting safety, and enabling the scraps to fall into the bottom of the positioning plate through a slag collecting groove, and further facilitating the collection of scraps produced during cutting.

title_en: Water pump assembly workbench
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of water pump assembly work tables, and discloses a water pump assembly work table which comprises a work table for assembly and supporting legs for supporting the work table, wherein the tops of the supporting legs are fixedly connected with four corners of the bottom of the work table, a protective cover is fixedly arranged on the rear side of the top of the work table, and a collecting assembly is arranged at the bottom of the work table. When the collecting box is used, the power source of the whole collecting assembly is realized by manually pulling the pulling handle, and the collecting box is driven to move while the pulling handle is pulled, and meanwhile, the T-shaped block is driven to slide in the T-shaped groove, so that the collecting box can be pulled out from the lower part of the workbench, and meanwhile, the position of the collecting box is limited by the T-shaped block and the T-shaped groove, so that the collecting box is ensured to be stable while collecting.

title_en: Titanium alloy sheet material inching type press conveying mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of plate processing, in particular to a titanium alloy plate inching press conveying mechanism, which aims at the problems that the existing manual plate conveying mechanism wastes time and energy, the fixing effect on the plate is not good enough during processing, the processing efficiency of the plate is not high enough and the like, and the utility model provides a proposal that the utility model comprises a inching press main body, wherein a hydraulic cylinder is arranged in the inching press main body, two sides of the inching press main body are fixedly provided with placing tables, the top of the two placing tables is provided with the same moving plate in a sliding way, the top of the moving plate is provided with at least one titanium alloy plate main body, in the utility model, the inching press conveying mechanism can better clamp the titanium alloy plates, can carry out better regulation to the position of panel during the centre gripping, it is comparatively convenient to use to utilize the cylinder to promote the movable plate, labour saving and time saving is convenient for process the going on of work.

title_en: Perforating device for antenna part processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an opening device for processing antenna parts, and relates to the technical field of antenna parts processing devices. The drilling device comprises a workbench and a drilling device, wherein a sliding rail is arranged on one side of the workbench, the drilling device is connected to the sliding rail in a sliding mode, a screw rod motor is arranged at the bottom of the sliding rail, the output end of the screw rod motor is connected with a screw rod, the drilling device is fixedly connected with a nut, the nut is rotationally connected to the screw rod, the drilling device comprises a right-angle supporting plate, a pulse power supply is fixedly installed on the supporting plate, an electric spark processing head is installed at the bottom of the pulse power supply, elastic rods are installed at two sides of the pulse power supply, and the bottom of the elastic rods is connected with a fixing block. According to the utility model, the screw rod motor is started to rotate, the nut displacement can be controlled accurately to control the displacement of the support plate, the drilling device can be positioned accurately on the workbench, the machining precision and efficiency are improved, and the device is combined with the pulse power supply and the electric spark machining head to further improve the production efficiency.

title_en: Novel double offset ring spanner
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of hand tools, in particular to a novel double offset ring spanner, which comprises an elongated handle and a double offset ring spanner body used for tightening screws or nuts, wherein a quick disassembly head is arranged on the double offset ring spanner body, and a clamping limiting block matched with the quick disassembly head is arranged at the end part of the elongated handle; the double offset ring spanner body is detachably arranged on the clamping and locating block of the lengthening handle through the quick dismounting head, the novel double offset ring spanner can realize quick connection between the double offset ring spanner body and the lengthening handle through the quick dismounting head and the clamping and locating block, so that the double offset ring spanner body has the action of adding force when screwing or dismounting screws and nuts, the box end wrench is convenient to disassemble or tighten the screw and the nut, and because the lengthened handle and the box end wrench body are of detachable design, the box end wrench body with different sizes and the lengthened handle with different lengths can be matched for matching and use according to the needs during use, and meanwhile, the box end wrench is convenient to carry, and the space required for carrying is saved.

title_en: Automatic positioning cutting device for pipe production line
abstract_en: The utility model provides an automatic positioning cutting device for a pipe production line, which relates to the technical field of pipe cutting and comprises a workbench and a cutting mechanism, wherein the cutting mechanism is arranged at the top end of the workbench, the cutting mechanism comprises a conveying component, a positioning component and a cutting component, the conveying component is arranged at the top end of the workbench, the positioning component is arranged at the inner side of the conveying component, the cutting component is arranged at one side of the workbench, the pipes can be fixed through the matching of a telescopic rod and a clamping plate during use by the arrangement of the cutting mechanism, the pipes can be prevented from shaking in the cutting process, the accurate position of the pipes in the cutting process is further ensured, the pipes are effectively conveyed to the next workbench along the conveying belt through the matching of the conveying belt and a motor, the conveying and positioning of the pipes are realized, the cutting work of the pipes can be rapidly and accurately completed through the matching of a hydraulic rod and a cutting knife, and the efficiency of the production line is further improved.

title_en: Novel front-mounted air chuck
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of chuck devices, in particular to a novel front-mounted air chuck, which comprises a front-mounted air chuck main body, wherein four independent cylinder power sources are arranged in the front-mounted air chuck main body to drive clamping jaws, so that four clamping jaws are in linkage with each other to realize automatic centering, and do not interfere with each other to realize high efficiency and high precision, a clamping jaw assembly is firstly provided with an induction check valve in an air path to realize air path pressure maintaining, the pressure maintaining time can be longer than 12 hours, the product can not be influenced by sudden air interruption when air flow enters a lower cylinder seat part to push the piston in a first clamping cylinder, the air flow flows to a second clamping cylinder to push the piston in the second clamping cylinder, the pistons are respectively driven, and a long connecting rod and a short connecting rod pull a short cylindrical rack and a long cylindrical rack to drive the clamping jaws to start reciprocating motion through synchronous gears, so that two groups of clamping jaws simultaneously clamp a workpiece in a straight line motion towards the center of a chuck, and the double-transmission clamping can be realized, and the workpiece can be automatically aligned with the center of the chuck.

title_en: Plate shaping and trimming device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of plate trimming and discloses a plate shaping trimming device which comprises an L-shaped assembly frame, wherein a transversely arranged trimming cylinder and a driving piece for driving the trimming cylinder to rotate are arranged on the L-shaped assembly frame, a through polishing channel is formed in the trimming cylinder, a grinding wheel ring and a fan piece are respectively arranged at two ends of the polishing channel, a chip removing cover is arranged on the side face of the L-shaped assembly frame, a chip removing cavity communicated with the polishing channel is formed in the chip removing cover, a spraying dispersing piece connected with the fan piece is rotationally connected to the chip removing cavity, and a water supply piece for supplying water to the spraying dispersing piece is arranged on the chip removing cover. The utility model provides a plate shaping and trimming device, which solves the problems that a large amount of fine particles and powder are generated in the operation process of a grinding machine, the substances are usually sticky and easily adhered to a table top, the cleaning of the substances is troublesome, and the subsequent grinding effect is affected.

title_en: Firm article device of getting of spinning-lathe
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of spinning machines, and discloses a stable product taking device of a spinning machine. The stable product taking device of the spinning machine comprises a rotating base assembly, wherein a position moving assembly is arranged at the upper end of the rotating base assembly, a connecting plate is arranged at the upper end of the position moving assembly, a telescopic rod is connected to the right side of the upper end of the connecting plate, a first fixing block is arranged on the right side of the telescopic rod, a second fixing block is arranged on the left side of the first fixing block, a taking adsorption assembly is arranged at the upper end of the position moving assembly, a first receiving rod is arranged at the upper end of the taking adsorption assembly, an adjusting ball is arranged on the left side of the upper end of the first receiving rod, and the stable product taking device can effectively prevent a product taking device from taking by using a mechanical arm when taking, can not stably take a finished product with an irregular shape, and causes the finished product to drop when taking, and economic loss and the like.

title_en: A cover sword top core device for full-automatic cover all-in-one that punches
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of magnetic material processing, in particular to a cutter sleeving and core jacking device for a full-automatic perforating integrated machine. The novel oil storage device comprises a sliding table (1), a tool rest (2), a chuck (3) and an oil inlet seat (4), wherein an oil inlet is formed in the oil inlet seat (4), one end of the oil inlet is communicated with one end of an oil inlet pipe, the other end of the oil inlet pipe is communicated with oil inlet equipment (5), the other end of the oil inlet is communicated with a cutting hole in a trepanning tool (6) clamped on the chuck (3), the novel oil storage device further comprises an oil storage cylinder body (8), a piston (9) and a cylinder (10), the oil inlet pipe comprises a first oil inlet pipe (11) and a second oil inlet pipe (12), the first oil inlet pipe (11) is communicated with the oil storage cavity (7), and the second oil inlet pipe (12) is communicated with the oil storage cavity (7) and the oil inlet equipment (5). The core jacking device has a simple structure.

title_en: End polishing device for cosmetic egg production
abstract_en: An end polishing device for making up eggs relates to the technical field of making up egg forming, and solves the problems that in the prior art, single-station processing can only be performed, feeding of making up eggs is required to be performed manually and sequentially, and working efficiency is low. The end polishing device for the cosmetic egg production comprises a driving base, wherein a turntable is connected to the driving base, the driving base drives the turntable to rotate, a plurality of clamping devices are uniformly connected to the periphery of the turntable, an automatic feeding box is arranged at the upper end of the turntable, a channel is arranged in the automatic feeding box, a baffle plate is connected to the bottom of the channel in a sliding mode, a first automatic opening and closing device is arranged at the position, corresponding to the automatic feeding box, of the driving base, a polishing mechanism is arranged on one side of the automatic feeding box, and the polishing mechanism is connected in a dust cover in an automatic sliding mode. The automatic feeding device has the beneficial effects that the automatic feeding device can automatically feed the make-up eggs and sequentially process the make-up eggs through rotating the turntable.

title_en: Drilling device with clearance structure for machine part processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a drilling device with a cleaning structure for machining mechanical parts, which belongs to the technical field of machining mechanical parts and comprises a base, wherein a support column is connected to the base, a drilling tool is arranged on the support column, a guide rod is rotationally connected to the support column, one end of the guide rod is connected with a workbench, a clamp is arranged on the side face of the workbench, an auxiliary frame is connected to one side of the base, a sliding block is connected to one side of the auxiliary frame in a sliding mode, and a cleaning soft bar column is rotationally connected to the sliding block. This drilling equipment is used in machine part processing with clearance structure is through setting up the soft strip post of clearance, rotating plate, spur gear, half gear and connecting plate, and this drilling equipment passes through the cooperation between locating lever, spur gear and the half gear for the soft strip post of clearance can realize reciprocating motion's function in the auxiliary frame, and the soft strip post of clearance can rotate when removing, and the soft strip post of clearance during rotation can clear up the piece in workstation and the anchor clamps.

title_en: Movable integrated welding machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a movable integrated welding machine, which relates to the technical field of welding, and comprises a bottom plate and a storage box fixedly arranged at the upper end of the bottom plate, wherein the inner cavity of the storage box is divided into two storage cavities which are respectively positioned in a first storage cavity and a second storage cavity, the device combines a three-level distribution box, an electric welding machine, a gas cylinder and the like into a whole, is convenient to move when a working surface is transferred on site, the connection between other devices is not required to be dismantled, only a three-phase power supply connected by a small three-box of the electric welding machine is required to be dismantled, when the construction is started again, the work can be started only by connecting the electric welding machine with a three-phase power supply nearby, so that the time and labor are saved, the electric safety risk is reduced, the work efficiency is greatly improved, two directional wheels are arranged at the bottom of the whole device, a universal wheel and a control rod are arranged at the front end of the device, the device can be pushed to move to a welding place, the use is more flexible, the advantages of simplicity in operation, convenience in use, safety, reliability and the like are achieved, the daily output is high, and the work efficiency can be effectively improved.

title_en: Heavy-calibre thick wall elbow stamping equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses large-caliber thick-wall elbow stamping equipment which comprises a bottom plate and a top plate, wherein the bottom plate is connected with the top plate through stand columns, a lower die assembly is arranged on the bottom plate, an upper die assembly is arranged on the top plate, the lower die assembly comprises a lower die frame, two groups of lower die holders and two groups of bearing tables, the upper die assembly comprises two groups of upper die holders, through grooves are formed in the bearing tables, a plurality of groups of positioning columns are arranged on the bearing tables, a positioning area is formed by the plurality of groups of positioning columns, plates are placed in the positioning area, hydraulic cylinders are arranged on two sides of the bottom plate and used for driving the bearing tables to axially move, the two groups of lower die holders and the two groups of upper die holders together form two groups of stamping forming positions, so that two groups of forming parts can be stamped at one time, the stamping forming efficiency of the stamping equipment is improved, after stamping forming, the bearing tables are jacked up and reset by the hydraulic cylinders, the bearing tables synchronously jack up the forming parts, so that the forming parts are separated from a male die, and demoulding is realized.

title_en: Code printing auxiliary device and stamping code printing line
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of automobile manufacturing, and discloses a coding auxiliary device and a punching coding line. The stamping and coding line comprises a multi-joint mechanical arm, a laser generator and a coding auxiliary device. The code printing auxiliary device is arranged on the laser generator, the laser generator is arranged at the output end of the multi-joint mechanical arm, and the code printing auxiliary device is used for simulating the setting code printing angle and the setting code printing focal length between the laser lens of the laser generator and the code printing surface of the workpiece. The coding auxiliary device comprises a mounting seat, a telescopic rod and a positioning piece, wherein the mounting seat is fixedly connected with a laser lens of the laser generator. One end of the telescopic rod is in universal connection with the mounting seat, the locating piece is arranged at the other end of the telescopic rod after the workpiece reaches the position of the laser generator, and the multi-joint mechanical arm can drive the laser generator to drive the coding auxiliary device to move, so that the locating piece is abutted with the coding surface. The utility model simplifies the debugging operation and improves the production efficiency.

title_en: Equipment for assembling plate
abstract_en: The application provides equipment for plate pieces, which comprises a bottom plate and at least one paper card attached to the bottom plate, wherein the equipment comprises a conveying mechanism, a bottom plate feeding mechanism, a dispensing mechanism, a paper card feeding mechanism and a monitoring mechanism, the conveying mechanism is used for conveying the plate pieces, the bottom plate feeding mechanism is arranged on one side of the conveying mechanism and is used for conveying the bottom plate to the conveying mechanism, the dispensing mechanism is arranged on one side of the conveying mechanism and is positioned at the downstream of the bottom plate feeding mechanism and can be used for dispensing the bottom plate on the conveying mechanism, the paper card feeding mechanism is arranged on one side of the conveying mechanism and is positioned at the downstream of the dispensing mechanism and can be used for conveying the paper card to the conveying mechanism, so that the paper card is adhered to the bottom plate after being dispensed, the automatic assembly of the bottom plate and the paper card is realized, the utilization of manpower resources is reduced, and the labor cost is lowered. Meanwhile, at least one of the bottom plate feeding mechanism, the dispensing mechanism and the paper card feeding mechanism can be monitored through the monitoring mechanism without manual monitoring, so that the utilization of human resources can be further reduced.

title_en: Die casting mechanism convenient to adjust for aluminum alloy die casting machine
abstract_en: The utility model provides a die casting mechanism convenient to adjust for an aluminum alloy die casting machine, which relates to the technical field of aluminum alloy die casting machines and comprises an operating table, wherein the top of the operating table is provided with a die casting machine main body, the surface of the operating table is provided with a quick assembly disassembly component, the quick assembly disassembly subassembly includes notch and bottom plate, the surface at the operation panel is seted up to the notch, the bottom surface of notch is provided with the bottom plate, the top surface of bottom plate is provided with the bed die. According to the utility model, when the lower die needs to be replaced, the lower die can be pulled to two sides, so that the insert blocks can be pulled out from two sides of the lower die, and then the second spring can push the lower die to be pushed out of the notch, so that quick disassembly is completed, when the lower die needs to be installed, the lower die is directly pushed into the notch, the problem that the existing lower die is fixed through bolts, and inconvenience in replacement and disassembly is avoided, and convenience in replacement of the lower die is improved.

title_en: Transmission mechanism of steel bar bender
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a transmission mechanism of a steel bar bending machine, which comprises a motor, wherein an output shaft of the motor is connected with a rotating shaft through a coupler, one end of the rotating shaft is connected with a fixed disc, a first limit gear is annularly and uniformly fixed on the outer wall of one side of the fixed disc, a threaded rod is fixed at the center of the outer wall of one side of the fixed disc, one end of the threaded rod is in threaded connection with a mounting block, a cavity is formed in the opposite side of the mounting block and the fixed disc, a second limit gear is slidably connected to the inner wall of the cavity, the bottom surface of the second limit gear is an inclined surface, the second limit gear is slidably matched with the first limit gear, a limit spring is fixed on the outer wall of one end of the second limit gear, a driving gear is fixed on the rotating shaft, and a driven gear is in transmission engagement on one side of the driving gear. According to the utility model, the fixed disc, the first limiting tooth, the second limiting tooth, the limiting spring and the cavity are arranged, so that the rotating shaft cannot rotate after rotating for a certain number of turns, and overrun protection of the device is realized.

title_en: Pipe bending device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pipe bending device, which comprises a base, wherein a plurality of fixed plates and movable plates are arranged on the base, and the pipe bending device is characterized in that: the pipe clamping structure is arranged on the fixed plate and the movable plate, and the first adjusting structure and the second adjusting structure are respectively arranged on the fixed plate and the movable plate. The device has an adjusting function, can realize the thickness adjustment of the matched pipe, and can also realize the bending adjustment of the pipe. Because of the arrangement of the pipeline clamping structure, the bending device can be specially used for bending the pipe, and is not easy to slip and deviate when bending.

title_en: Precast beam board reinforcing bar positioner
