abstract_en: The utility model provides a precast beam slab reinforcing steel bar positioning device, which relates to the field of building engineering auxiliary equipment and comprises a base and four groups of positioning mechanisms, wherein two groups of positioning mechanisms are fixedly arranged at two ends of the base along the width direction of the base and used for positioning transverse reinforcing steel bars, the other two groups of positioning mechanisms are slidably arranged at two ends of the base along the length direction of the base and used for positioning longitudinal reinforcing steel bars, each positioning mechanism comprises an adjusting component and a plurality of positioning blocks which are arranged side by side, positioning grooves are formed in the positioning blocks, and the adjusting component is connected with each positioning block and used for synchronously adjusting the distance between the positioning blocks. The utility model solves the problems that the precast beam slab reinforcement positioning device in the prior art can only bind reinforcement cages with fixed intervals and has poor universality.

title_en: Plywood compression fittings
abstract_en: The utility model provides a plywood pressing device which comprises a frame, wherein a placing table used for placing boards is arranged on the frame, pressing components used for gluing the boards placed on the placing table are arranged above the placing table and on the frame, and a plurality of elastic supporting components used for supporting and limiting the pressing components are uniformly distributed on the left side and the right side of the placing table. According to the utility model, when the pressing assembly performs pressing operation on the plates, the elastic supporting assembly can be used for realizing upward elastic supporting operation on the pressing assembly, so that the plywood is prevented from being broken due to overlarge pressure during pressing, unnecessary plate loss is avoided, the rejection rate is reduced, the pressing efficiency is improved, and the operation is simpler and more convenient.

title_en: Scrap metal hydraulic baling press goes out package jar with fixing device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of waste metal hydraulic balers, in particular to a waste metal hydraulic baling press bale discharging cylinder with a fixing device, which comprises a bale discharging cylinder arranged on a baling press panel, wherein an end fixing plate is fixedly arranged on the front side surface of the bale discharging cylinder, a bolt hole is formed in the corner position of the end fixing plate, the end fixing plate is fixedly arranged on the baling press panel through a fastening bolt, the section of the bolt hole is L-shaped, a base plate is arranged at the bottom of the bale discharging cylinder, a supporting assembly is arranged on the baling press panel, the supporting assembly comprises a front side panel fixedly arranged on the baling press panel, a top plate for supporting the base plate is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the front side panel, a bottom plate is fixedly arranged on the bottom plate body of the front side panel, two mutually symmetrical supporting ribs are fixedly arranged between the bottom plate and the top plate, and a side supporting rod is fixedly arranged between the supporting ribs and the bottom plate. The utility model has firm and stable structure, can play a better fixing effect and is convenient to use.

title_en: Iron wire punching and drilling equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides iron wire stamping and drilling equipment which comprises a wire feeding disc, a straightening assembly, a stamping assembly and a center hole machining assembly, wherein the wire feeding disc is used for continuously conveying coiled iron wire raw materials backwards, the straightening assembly is used for straightening iron wires, and through sequential arrangement and process matching of the wire feeding disc, the straightening assembly, the stamping assembly and the center hole machining assembly, stamping forming and drilling of a large number of iron wires can be automatically, efficiently and high-quality completed, the iron wire stamping and drilling equipment is suitable for production in a pipelining mode, and after the iron wires are straightened, the iron wires are cut off and stamped by a hydraulic punch press at one time, meanwhile, the iron wires are positioned based on the arrangement of a die structure, and accurate machining of the center hole machining assembly is ensured.

title_en: Umbrella handle equipment of polishing of umbrella processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses umbrella handle polishing equipment for umbrella processing, which comprises a frame, wherein a conveying mechanism is arranged on the inner wall of the frame, a limiting mechanism is arranged at the top of the frame, the limiting mechanism comprises a mounting seat, a mounting plate, a limiting sliding groove, rollers, a mounting shaft, a mounting bracket and a connecting plate, a driving mechanism is arranged at the top of the mounting plate, an adjusting mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the mounting bracket, polishing mechanisms are arranged on one side of the adjusting mechanism, a plurality of groups of polishing mechanisms are driven to move through the cooperation of the limiting mechanism and the driving mechanism, multi-station polishing processing of umbrella handles is realized through the cooperation of the polishing mechanisms and the adjusting mechanism, the polishing operation efficiency is improved, the automatic polishing processing of umbrella handles is realized through a simple structure, and the polishing efficiency of umbrella handles is improved on the premise of ensuring the production and running cost of equipment, and the processing efficiency of umbrellas is further improved.

title_en: Quick clamp replacing device
abstract_en: The clamp quick-change device is used for quick-change of a positioner clamp and comprises a clamp support and active pin penetrating device, a clamp support and passive pin penetrating device, a trolley positioning device and a clamp quick-change trolley, wherein the clamp support and active pin penetrating device is arranged at the driven end of the positioner, the clamp support and passive pin penetrating device is arranged at the driving end of the positioner, the trolley positioning device is arranged between the clamp support and active pin penetrating device and the clamp support and passive pin penetrating device and used for positioning and locking the clamp quick-change trolley, and the clamp quick-change trolley is used for carrying a quick-change clamp and is matched with the clamp support and active pin penetrating device and the clamp support and the passive pin penetrating device to finish quick-change clamp replacement. The clamp quick-changing device reduces the time occupied by clamp switching, reduces the requirements on operators and special auxiliary equipment, and is applicable to both fixed clamp switching and rotary positioner clamp switching.

title_en: Diesel engine assembly quality
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a diesel engine assembly device which comprises a rectangular tube seat, a movable adjusting mechanism and an auxiliary mounting mechanism, wherein the movable adjusting mechanism is arranged in the rectangular tube seat, the movable adjusting mechanism comprises a sliding component, a driving component, supporting plates and a movable component, the sliding component is arranged in the rectangular tube seat and drives the sliding component to slide, the supporting plates are fixedly arranged at two ends of the sliding component, the movable component is fixedly arranged at the top of the supporting plates, the auxiliary mounting mechanism is arranged at the top end of the movable component, the two supporting plates are positioned at the outer side of the end part of the rectangular tube seat, and in the using process, the auxiliary mounting mechanism is used for enabling a movable clamping plate to move through the rotation of a bidirectional threaded rod and matching with a limiting rod, so that the diesel engine models of different types can be placed and used conveniently, and the using cost is reduced.

title_en: Shearing mechanism of bamboo shearing clamp
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a shearing mechanism of a bamboo shearing clamp, which comprises a bamboo shearing clamp main body, wherein a positioning shearing clamp and a movable shearing clamp are arranged on the bamboo shearing clamp main body, one end between the positioning shearing clamp and the movable shearing clamp is fixedly penetrated by a rotating shaft, a fixing plate is also arranged on the bamboo shearing clamp main body, one side of the fixing plate is provided with a mounting seat, the rotating shaft is assembled in the mounting seat, the side surface of the mounting seat is provided with a connecting seat, an electric driving rod is movably connected onto the connecting seat through a bolt structure, the movable end of the electric driving rod is connected with the movable shearing clamp through a shaft lever, and the electric driving rod is started after being connected with a power supply, so that the movable shearing clamp can be pushed to rotate around the rotating shaft to mutually shear the movable shearing clamp and the positioning shearing clamp. The shearing mechanism of the bamboo shearing clamp can be used in a fixed mode and a handheld mode as required, and one of the shearing mechanisms is arranged to be of an arc-shaped structure so that the bamboo is positioned, and the shearing treatment efficiency of the bamboo is higher.

title_en: Plastic pressure limit cutting device is used in speaker production
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of loudspeaker processing, in particular to a plastic edge pressing cutting device for loudspeaker production, which aims at solving the problems that manual feeding and discharging are troublesome and leftover materials are difficult to collect in the prior art. According to the utility model, the vacuum chuck can continuously adsorb the loudspeaker on the inner circular plate, the second air cylinder can control the rotating seat in the pressing plate to tightly press the loudspeaker, and the clamping plate is controlled to move along with the electric guide rail and the third air cylinder, so that not only is the automatic feeding and discharging of the loudspeaker realized, the production efficiency improved, but also the stability of the cutting of the loudspeaker ensured, the positioning accuracy improved, the annular blanking of the cutter realized along with the rotation of the inner circular plate driven by the speed reducer, the waste materials can be uniformly fed into the slideway along the guide plate, the difficulty of waste collection is reduced, and the cleanliness of the cutting device is improved.

title_en: Fine grinding machine for wood chip processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fine grinding machine for wood chip processing, which comprises a grinder and a motor arranged on one side of the grinder, wherein a moving component for moving the position of the motor is arranged on one side of the grinder, the moving component comprises a fixed block fixedly connected on one side of the grinder, the bottom end of the motor is fixedly connected with a connecting block, the bottom end of the connecting block is fixedly connected with a sliding block, the top of the fixed block is provided with a sliding groove matched with the sliding block, and the middle part of the sliding block is provided with a moving piece for moving the sliding block. According to the belt pulley, through the design of the connecting block, the sliding groove, the moving piece and the positioning piece, when the belt at the output end of the motor is required to be disassembled, the sliding block is driven to move through the moving piece, and the motor is driven to move through the sliding block, so that the belt pulley at the output end of the motor is close to the belt pulley on the grinder, the tensioned belt is loosened, the belt is directly disassembled from the belt pulley, and other tools are avoided when the belt is disassembled.

title_en: Welding seam mechanism of automobile radiator
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of welding of automobile radiators, in particular to a welding seam mechanism of an automobile radiator, which can automatically position a square frame structure workpiece of the automobile radiator, saves working time and has high working efficiency; the welding machine comprises a frame, a working frame, a plurality of shaft rods, a plurality of workpiece frames, a plurality of handles, a plurality of joists, a plurality of clamping assemblies and a welding mechanism, wherein the working frame is in a square frame shape, the shaft rods are arranged on four sides of the working frame, the middle parts of the workpiece frames are hinged with the shaft rods respectively, the handles are arranged on the outer sides of the workpiece frames, the joists are arranged on the inner sides of the workpiece frames, the clamping assemblies are arranged on two sides of the joists, the two clamping assemblies on the joists clamp one side of a frame structure forming an automobile radiator, the joists rotate to the inner side of the working frame, and then the four workpieces are spliced into the square frame structure of the automobile radiator, and the welding mechanism is arranged on the joists and welds on the welding seam of the workpieces.

title_en: Surface grinding device for automobile machined parts
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of automobile accessory machining, and discloses a surface grinding device for an automobile machined part, which comprises a supporting base, a mounting frame, a lifting adjusting piece, a grinding wheel, a first motor, a moving part, a guide rail, a guide block, a translation part and a turnover part, wherein the mounting frame is fixedly connected to the top of the supporting base, the lifting adjusting piece is arranged at the top of the mounting frame, the grinding wheel is arranged on one side of the lifting adjusting piece, the first motor is arranged on the other side of the lifting adjusting piece, and the moving part is arranged at one end of the top of the supporting base. This automobile parts is with surface grinding device drives the turning block through the second motor and rotates for the automobile parts of grip block centre gripping can overturn, polishes the work to automobile parts's positive and negative surface, and the cooperation first cylinder is adjusted the removal of rotor, can carry out the centre gripping to not unidimensional automobile parts.

title_en: Special hand-held grinding wheel for steam repair
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a special handheld polishing wheel for automobile repair, which comprises a polishing machine body, wherein the polishing machine body comprises a driving end, a fixed chassis arranged at the bottom end of the driving end and a polishing wheel rotatably connected to the bottom end of the fixed chassis, and a protective component is arranged at the bottom end of the fixed chassis and positioned at the outer side of the polishing wheel; when a worker needs to polish an automobile by using a polishing machine body, the fixing ring is sleeved to the periphery of the fixing chassis from the bottom end of the driving end, then the fixing rod on the inner side of the fixing ring is pushed, the fixing rod is inserted into the fixing slot hole on the periphery of the fixing chassis, then the rotating handle is rotated to drive the rotating clamping rod on one end of the fixing rod to rotate in the rotating clamping groove on the inner side of the fixing slot hole, the protection component is quickly fixed on the periphery of the fixing chassis, and the splashing of scraps can be reduced when the polishing wheel polishes through the protection plate on the bottom end of the fixing ring, so that the damage to the worker caused by the scraps is reduced, and the operation safety of the worker is improved.

title_en: Aluminum plate processing equipment with quick positioning structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses aluminum plate processing equipment with a rapid positioning structure, which comprises a polishing platform, wherein a polishing output assembly is arranged at the center of the position right above the polishing platform, aluminum plate elements are placed at the center of the top of the polishing platform, sliding rails are symmetrically fixed on the front and back of the top of the polishing platform, the sliding rails are erected in the left-right direction, a plurality of driving sliding seats are slidingly matched on the sliding rails at equal intervals, a frame shaft is fixedly connected to the upper parts of the front and back opposite sides of the driving sliding seats, rotating ring sleeves are rotatably matched on the outer sides of the front and back opposite ends of the frame shaft, the bottoms of the rotating ring sleeves are in rolling contact with the aluminum plate elements in an extrusion mode, an aluminum plate is pressed down through a plurality of groups of rotating ring sleeves erected oppositely and is in rolling contact with the sliding seats along the upper surface of the aluminum plate, pressing stable operation of the aluminum plate is alternately completed, and the polishing equipment is convenient to stably and accurately polish the upper surface of the aluminum plate, and accordingly efficiency and quality of the whole aluminum plate during processing are improved.

title_en: Wind-powered electricity generation blade drilling equipment
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of drilling processing, and particularly relates to wind power blade drilling equipment, which comprises a supporting table, wherein two supporting frames are fixedly connected to the top of the supporting table, the two supporting frames are oppositely arranged, two first sliding grooves are formed in the side walls of the supporting frames, a first supporting plate is slidably connected to the inside of each first sliding groove, two hydraulic cylinders are fixedly connected to the top of the supporting table, the tops of the two hydraulic cylinders are fixedly connected to the bottom of each first supporting plate, two second sliding grooves are formed in the side walls of the first supporting plates, an electric push rod is slidably connected to the inside of each second sliding groove, a connecting rod is fixedly connected to the end part of each electric push rod, a sliding block is slidably connected to the middle of each connecting rod, two first fixing plates are hinged to the side walls of each sliding block, and are oppositely arranged.

title_en: Welding fixture for machining automobile chassis parts
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of auto parts processing, concretely relates to welding jig for auto chassis parts processing, including the base, the swivel mount rotates to be connected in the base, fixed establishment sets up on the swivel mount, the recess is the ring-shaped distribution set up in the top surface of base, the bottom surface fixedly connected with lug of swivel mount, wherein, fixed establishment includes adjustment portion, adjustment portion sets up on the swivel mount, be provided with rotation portion on the adjustment portion, be provided with clamping part on the rotation portion. The utility model discloses a through the cooperation use of rotation portion and clamping part, compare with the welding jig who mentions in the background art, this anchor clamps need not to change clamping assembly, only need the clamping face of adjustment grip block can realize the centre gripping to different shape parts, and the operation is more convenient, and at welding process, the rotatable swivel mount of user to weld the different faces of part.

title_en: Food processing material filament cutter
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of food processing, in particular to a food processing material shredder which comprises a lower fixing box and a fixing frame, wherein a fixing rod is fixedly arranged on the fixing frame, a fixing disc is fixedly arranged at the fixing rod, a cutting tool is fixedly arranged on the front end face of the fixing disc, an upper sealing box is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the lower fixing box, a centrifugal barrel capable of rotating at a high speed is arranged between the lower fixing box and the upper sealing box, the fixing disc is positioned in the centrifugal barrel, protection plates are fixedly arranged at the front end parts of the lower fixing box and the upper sealing box, the protection plates are arranged in a front-back opening manner, a feeding port is fixedly arranged at the front end opening of each protection plate, evenly-distributed discharge ports are arranged on the centrifugal barrel, and the protection is carried out through the protection plates, so that a user can be effectively prevented from accidentally contacting a cutter in the operation process, the cutter is kept stationary in a centrifugal manner, and the operation safety is further improved.

title_en: Intermediate frequency direct current contravariant spot welder
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intermediate frequency direct current inversion spot welder which comprises a spot welder body, wherein a spot welding table is fixedly connected to one side of the spot welder body, a first adjusting through hole is formed in the top end of the spot welding table and near one side of the spot welding table in a penetrating mode, a first adjusting screw rod is connected inside the first adjusting through hole in a rotating mode, and one end of the first adjusting screw rod penetrates through one side wall inside the first adjusting through hole to be in transmission connection with a servo motor. According to the spot welder, the second adjusting screw rod is rotated to drive the object placing frame to move on the movable plate, so that the position to be spot-welded is located under the spot welding head, then the servo motor is started, the servo motor drives the first adjusting screw rod to rotate, so that the movable plate meshed with the first adjusting screw rod moves on the spot welding table, the spot welder body can spot-weld the spot welding position on the same line, the structure is simple, the adjustment is convenient, and the spot welding efficiency of the aluminum plate is improved.

title_en: Stamping die for manufacturing automobile body panel, automobile body panel and electric automobile
abstract_en: The application discloses a stamping die for manufacturing a vehicle body panel, a vehicle body panel and an electric vehicle. The stamping die comprises a blanking die part having a knife block assembly for punching out a raw material out of an opening, the knife block assembly comprising a plurality of knife blocks each having a knife edge at an edge thereof, and the plurality of knife blocks being arranged to have a profile corresponding to the opening shape, wherein the plurality of knife blocks comprises at least a first knife block having an arc-shaped knife edge and a second knife block adjacent to the first knife block, the first knife block corresponding to an arc-shaped section of the opening shape, and the second knife block corresponding to another section different from the arc-shaped section, wherein the first knife block and the second knife block are arranged on the blanking die part with a parting line between them being offset from a demarcation position between the arc-shaped section and the other section. The application can improve the quality of forming the opening by redesigning the tool setting block arrangement.

title_en: Cutting device is used in processing of nonferrous metal calendering material
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of nonferrous metal processing, and discloses a cutting device for nonferrous metal rolled material processing, which comprises a workbench, wherein a left fixing frame and a right fixing frame are sequentially fixed on the right side of the workbench, a movable frame is arranged in the left fixing frame in a sliding manner, a pressing roller is connected to the lower part of the movable frame in a rotating manner, a movable plate is arranged in the right fixing frame in a sliding manner, a cutting knife is arranged at the bottom of the movable plate, first air cylinders are respectively connected to the upper middle parts of the left fixing frame and the right fixing frame in a penetrating manner, first extending ends of the first air cylinders are respectively connected with the movable frame and the movable plate, cutting grooves are formed in the right side of the workbench, first sliding grooves are formed in the middle part of the left side of the workbench, so that the spacing between a group of material limiting U-shaped frames can be conveniently adjusted, and the spacing between the group of nonferrous metal with various widths can be used for limiting and fixing different nonferrous metals through the pressing plate.

title_en: Nail shooting fixing device in nail shooter
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a nail shooting fixing device in a nail shooter, which comprises a nail shooting pipe, wherein a baffle ring is fixedly connected in the nail shooting pipe, the outer side of the baffle ring is propped against a bottom plate, a nail rod is horizontally fixed on the outer side of the bottom plate, the bottom plate is axially and slidably connected with the inner part of the nail shooting pipe, a cartridge is horizontally fixed on the rear side of the bottom plate, the cartridge is axially and slidably sleeved in the baffle ring, the outer part of the nail shooting pipe radially penetrates through two radial symmetrical countersunk holes, the two countersunk holes are communicated with the inner part of the nail shooting pipe, and an elastic component is respectively arranged in each countersunk hole. According to the utility model, the elastic component is arranged in the nail shooting pipe, the nail rod is arranged in the nail shooting pipe by utilizing the guide block and the guide groove, so that the positioning and mounting effects on the nail rod are realized, and the nail rod is positioned in the nail shooting pipe without other accessories, so that the connection between the nail rod and the nail shooting pipe is more convenient and quick.

title_en: Electronic component welding equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides electronic component welding equipment which comprises an operation table, wherein clamping assemblies are slidably arranged on two sides of the operation table, positioning grooves are formed in the clamping assemblies, positioning plates are detachably limited in the positioning grooves, electronic component positioning holes are formed in the positioning plates, when electronic components are welded, a circuit board is only required to be clamped on the clamping assemblies, the positioning plates provided with proper electronic component positioning holes are selected to cover the circuit board along the positioning grooves, the exposed positions of the electronic component positioning holes are just the positions of the electronic components, the electronic components to be welded are placed in the electronic component positioning holes, and the electronic components can be perfectly overlapped with welding spots, so that the welding precision and quality are improved.

title_en: Low-pollution chain saw
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a low-pollution chain saw, which comprises a chain saw main body, wherein a connecting seat is arranged at the upper end of the chain saw main body, a filter box is arranged at the upper end of the connecting seat, a plurality of clamping blocks are arranged on the inner wall of the filter box, filter screens are connected inside the plurality of clamping blocks in a sliding manner, the upper end of the filter box is communicated with an exhaust pipe, two clamps are connected on the upper surface of the connecting seat in a sliding manner, and the inner walls of the two clamps are mutually attached to the outer side of the filter box. Through the structure, the filter box is connected with the exhaust port, and the exhausted gas is filtered by the filter box and then exhausted into the air, so that the pollution to the environment can be reduced.

title_en: Butt joint processing device for building pipelines
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of pipeline processing and discloses a building pipeline butt joint processing device which comprises a bottom plate, wherein side plates I are fixedly connected to the left side wall and the right side wall of the bottom plate, sliding rails I are fixedly connected to the front side and the rear side of the top of the bottom plate, a screw rod I penetrates through the middle parts of the two side plates I and is rotationally connected with the screw rod, a motor I is fixedly connected to the left side wall of the left side plate I, an output shaft of the motor I is fixedly connected with the left end of the screw rod I, a moving plate I is arranged between the tops of the two sliding rails I, sliding blocks I are fixedly connected to the front side and the rear side of the bottom of the moving plate I, the sliding blocks I are in sliding fit with the sliding rails I, and screw rod nuts I are fixedly connected to the bottom center of the moving plate I.

title_en: Aluminum veneer surface polishing processing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses aluminum veneer surface polishing processing equipment, which comprises a processing table, wherein a conveying mechanism is arranged above the processing table, an auxiliary mechanism is arranged above the processing table, a polishing mechanism is arranged on the inner wall of the conveying mechanism, a cleaning mechanism is arranged on the inner wall of the auxiliary mechanism, the auxiliary mechanism arranged on the processing table is convenient for shielding splashed or floating impurity dust during the aluminum veneer surface polishing processing equipment, and meanwhile, the cleaning mechanism arranged on the auxiliary mechanism can not only carry out auxiliary adsorption collection on the splashed or floating impurity dust, but also can carry out auxiliary conveying on the aluminum veneer by adhering scraps and impurities on the surface of the conveyor and the processed aluminum veneer, and the conveying mechanism arranged on the processing table is beneficial to carrying out polishing processing treatment on the aluminum veneer better, but also can carry out auxiliary guiding treatment on the conveyed aluminum veneer, so that the placed aluminum veneer is placed at an accurate processing position conveniently.

title_en: Reed board cutting device with compressing assembly
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a reed plate cutting device with a pressing component, which comprises a cutting box, wherein a movable cutting device is arranged on the top surface of the cutting box, a positioning component is arranged in the cutting box and comprises a layered plate fixed above the inside of the cutting box, the top surface of the layered plate is symmetrically provided with a movable plate, the middle part of the top surface of the layered plate is rotationally connected with an elliptical rotary disk, pressing mechanisms are arranged on the same side of the two movable plates, sliding blocks are symmetrically and fixedly connected with the bottom surface of the movable plate, sliding rails fixed on the surface of the layered plate are in sliding connection with the sliding blocks, a plurality of movable columns are fixedly connected with the top surface of the movable plate, and the movable columns drive friction blocks to push and press the reed plates from two sides through the movable plates, so that the device can clamp and position reed plates with various sizes, and the practicability of the device is improved.

title_en: Band saw light structure
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application aims to provide a band saw lamplight structure, wherein a first rotating seat and a second rotating seat are arranged on a motor shell, a notch is arranged between the first rotating seat and the second rotating seat, the lamplight structure is arranged in the notch, one end of the lamplight structure is provided with a rotating part, and the rotating part is arranged to drive the lamplight structure to rotate. The light structure is hollow structure, and the light structure is the solid of revolution. A damping component is adhered to the motor shell at the position corresponding to the rotating component. The damping component is in arc fit with and concentric with the rotating component. The rotating shaft rotates around the rotating shaft between the first rotating seat and the second rotating seat. The light structure is provided with light-emitting parts which are distributed along the axial line of the light structure in a straight line. The technical scheme is that the lamplight structure is placed on the motor shell, and the lamplight structure can rotate, so that the irradiation angle is adjustable, and the irradiation range is large.

title_en: Automatic turning device of welding
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic welding turnover device which comprises a device base, a device support and a turnover platform, wherein the turnover platform is connected with a driving device and a driven structure on the inner side of the device support through fixing structures at two ends. This automatic turning device of welding carries out preliminary location through fixed knot constructs's locating hole, constant head tank and the constant head tank of rotatory end to the welding section bar, cooperates with the elastic positioning of the elasticity external member in constant head tank and the locating hole, realizes the stable location of section bar, through rotatory in the driving motor rotatory end, drive the welding section bar of treating of location on fixed knot constructs and carry out angle adjustment, in order to guarantee the welding work of welding manipulator multi-angle, and the central authorities of upset platform set up a plurality of cavity regions, the 360 full angles of welding manipulator of being convenient for weld the section bar, and the section bar other end is rotatory round the bearing frame along with corresponding fixed knot constructs's rotation axis, and turning structure is simple, and is with low costs, takes up an area of for a short time.

title_en: Clamping mechanism, electric screwdriver component and nut locking device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a clamping mechanism, an electric screwdriver component and a nut locking device, wherein the clamping mechanism comprises a base body, a plurality of clamping parts and elastic parts, the clamping parts are arranged and are distributed at intervals along the circumferential direction of the base body, the clamping parts are provided with driving ends and clamping ends which are oppositely arranged, the middle parts of the clamping parts are rotatably arranged on the base body, the elastic parts are arranged among the clamping parts and are respectively connected with the driving ends of the clamping parts, and the elastic parts respectively provide mutually far-away acting forces for the driving ends so that the clamping ends of the clamping parts are mutually close to clamp nuts. Through this scheme, can solve the manual pre-screwing nut among the prior art, its intensity of labour problem greatly.

title_en: Numerical control hammer for forging processing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of numerical control hammers and discloses a numerical control hammer for forging processing, which comprises a supporting seat, a fit groove, a driving device and a driving rod, wherein a number control hammer is arranged at the bottom of the driving rod, a disassembly and assembly base is arranged at the bottom of the number control hammer, an assembly screw groove penetrating through the disassembly and assembly base is arranged at the top of the number control hammer, and an assembly bolt is arranged in an internal thread of the assembly screw groove.

title_en: Automatic feeding and discharging truss of lathe
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of loading and unloading equipment, in particular to an automatic loading and unloading truss of a lathe, which comprises a lifting frame, a lifting frame and a lifting frame, wherein the lifting frame is arranged on a truss body; the clamping assembly is arranged on the mounting plate and comprises a deflection structure, the deflection structure can drive two groups of clamping pieces symmetrically arranged on the mounting plate to be mutually far away or close, when the two groups of clamping pieces are mutually close, the tightening structure can drive the two groups of clamping pieces to stably clamp a workpiece, the reversing structure is arranged on the truss body and matched with the driving rod, when the lifting frame slides relative to the truss body, the reversing structure can drive the driving rod to rotate relative to the object placing plate, and when the driving rod rotates, the tightening structure can strengthen the clamping force of the clamping pieces on the workpiece, so that the workpiece in the clamping plate is prevented from being separated in the rotation process.

title_en: Weaving machine accessory grinding device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of textile machine accessory production, in particular to a textile machine accessory polishing device, which comprises a base, wherein two symmetrically arranged support plates are fixed on the base, a motor is arranged on one side of the support plate, a grinding wheel is arranged between the two support plates, and the polishing device also comprises a reciprocating mechanism for driving a workpiece to reciprocate and a clamping mechanism which moves along with the reciprocating mechanism and clamps the workpiece. Through installing two symmetrical rotary rods between two backup pads and installing the spring driving lever on planar guide rail, realize the long distance reciprocating motion that is driven by the rotary rod, simultaneously through the regulation to the stop piece, realize the control to reciprocating distance, through the fixture centre gripping work piece of installing on the removal slide rail, when concomitantly removing slide rail reciprocating motion, can fix centre gripping work piece, stop the work piece and take place not hard up condition when polishing the work piece.

title_en: Steel pipe polisher
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a steel pipe grinding machine which comprises a workbench, a first rotating shaft, a first motor, a supporting cylinder, a plurality of rollers, a grinding wheel and a second motor. In the use process of the steel pipe polishing machine provided by the embodiment of the utility model, the steel pipe to be polished is placed on the roller and the supporting cylinder, the axial direction of the steel pipe to be polished is parallel to the axial direction of the first rotating shaft, the first motor drives the first rotating shaft to rotate, the first rotating shaft drives the supporting cylinder to rotate, the supporting cylinder can drive the steel pipe to be polished to rotate, the steel pipe to be polished can move towards the polishing wheel under the guiding action of the roller while rolling, so that the steel pipe to be polished automatically moves and passes through the lower part of the polishing wheel, and the polishing wheel polishes the steel pipe to be polished. The whole polishing process does not need manual operation by personnel, the automation degree is high, the labor intensity of workers is greatly reduced, and the operation safety risk caused by manual operation is avoided.

title_en: Suspended ceiling screw rod mounting device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a suspended ceiling screw rod mounting device which comprises a vertical rod, a handle and a sleeve head, wherein the sleeve head is fixed on the side surface of the top end of the vertical rod, and the handle is fixed at the bottom end of the vertical rod. The installation device is used for pushing the suspended ceiling screw rod upwards to penetrate into the screw rod hole, so that the screw rod is tightly combined with the top plate, and the effect of firmly fixing the suspended ceiling screw rod on a ceiling is achieved by rotating the handle. The utility model replaces the traditional climbing ladder operation, and solves the problems of difficult movement, climbing danger, low efficiency and the like of people on the ladder. The probability of high falling risk of an installer is greatly reduced while the installation efficiency of the screw rod is improved. Has the advantages of simple structure, cheap material, easy manufacture, convenient use, industrial processing, turnover use and environment friendliness and is recyclable.

title_en: Rolling structure of channel steel
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rolling structure of channel steel, relates to the technical field of channel steel production, and aims to solve the technical problems that the current forming of arc channel steel needs to sequentially carry out two steps of rolling forming and bending processing, and is inconvenient to improve the processing efficiency, and the rolling structure comprises a bracket component with an upper die component movably arranged inside, a lower die component rotatably arranged in the bracket component, positioning components fixedly arranged on two sides of the lower die component in the bracket component, the upper die assembly comprises a mounting plate, wherein the two sides of the lower end face of the mounting plate are respectively provided with an ear plate, a first roll shaft is rotatably arranged in the ear plates, an upper die ring is arranged on the outer edge face of the first roll shaft in a centering mode, inclined face portions I which are concave in the tangential direction are formed at the outer edge positions of the two sides of the upper die ring, and the lower die assembly comprises a second roll shaft rotatably arranged between the support assemblies. The utility model has the advantages of improving the processing efficiency and reducing the plastic damage to the channel steel at the bending position.

title_en: High-efficient aluminum plate right angle type plate folding machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-efficiency right-angle aluminum plate folding machine, and belongs to the technical field of plate processing equipment. The utility model discloses a high-efficiency right-angle aluminum plate folding machine, which comprises a frame, a bearing plate, a pressing plate, a limiting assembly and a bending plate, wherein the bearing plate is arranged on the frame in a lifting mode, the bending plate is rotatably arranged on one side of the bearing plate, a lifting part for driving the bearing plate to lift is arranged on the frame, one end of the pressing plate is rotatably arranged on the frame, the bearing plate is positioned below the pressing plate, the limiting plate is fixedly arranged on the frame, the bottom of the other end of the pressing plate is propped against the top of the limiting plate, and the limiting assembly for limiting the rotation of the pressing plate is arranged on the limiting plate.

title_en: Butterfly muscle automatic welder
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of steel bar welding, in particular to an automatic butterfly bar welding device which comprises a tool main body, a positioning assembly and a turning assembly, wherein the tool main body comprises a first support frame, a second support frame and a splayed bar installation part, the splayed bar installation part is arranged between the first support frame and the second support frame and is supported by the first support frame and the second support frame, the positioning assembly is arranged in the splayed bar installation part and is provided with a plurality of groups, the plurality of groups of positioning assemblies are linearly arranged in the splayed bar installation part and are used for adjusting the position of a splayed bar, the turning assembly is arranged on one side of the first support frame and is connected with the splayed bar installation part, and the splayed bar installation part is driven to turn through the turning assembly. The utility model can accurately control the position of the splayed rib and improve the welding quality of the butterfly rib.

title_en: Welding equipment for walking frame fittings
abstract_en: The utility model discloses welding equipment for a traveling frame accessory, which relates to the technical field of welding equipment and comprises an operation table and a welding assembly, wherein an upright post is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the operation table, a rotating sleeve is rotatably connected to the upright post, a first support is fixedly connected to the outer wall of the rotating sleeve, a square cylinder is rotatably connected to the first support, a pressing plate for extruding the accessory from top to bottom is slidably arranged at one end of the square cylinder, far away from the first support, the welding assembly is positioned above the operation table, the welding assembly comprises a base and a welding device, the base is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the operation table, and the welding device is fixedly connected to the top of the base. This welding equipment for moving frame accessory is through setting up square tube, clamp plate isotructure, because the clamp plate can carry out position, inclination in a flexible way adjustment, and the distance between clamp plate and the square tube is adjustable to be convenient for carry out the centre gripping location to the accessory of different shapes, size, improve welded efficiency and quality.

title_en: EBS valve body side cap lock screw device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of screw locking devices, and discloses an EBS valve body side cover screw locking device which comprises an electric batch body, wherein a first transition support plate and a second transition support plate are arranged outside one side of the bottom of the electric batch body, one side of the first transition support plate is arranged on the surface of one side of the bottom of the electric batch body, and a reinforcing cylinder and a guide rod are arranged between the first transition support plate and the second transition support plate. According to the utility model, after the long screw is initially engaged and connected with the corresponding threaded hole by the electric screwdriver body, the magnetic attraction limiting assembly is arranged to magnetically attract the workpiece, then the long screw is continuously rotated and pressed down by the working end of the electric screwdriver body, so that the long screw is completely locked into the corresponding threaded hole, and in the engagement process, the success rate of installation of the long screw and the corresponding threaded hole can be fully improved by limiting, guiding, restraining and abdicating between the guide rod and the first transition support plate, and the poor processing rate is reduced.

title_en: Island type automatic production system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an island-type automatic production system which comprises a standard machine tool, a mirror image machine tool and an automatic feeding system, wherein the standard machine tool and the mirror image machine tool are arranged in the same direction and distributed on the left side and the right side of the automatic feeding system, and the structure of the mirror image machine tool is symmetrical to that of the standard machine tool. The utility model has compact and beautiful overall layout, small occupied area and convenient and quick operation.

title_en: Processing platform with antistatic function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a processing platform with an antistatic function, which relates to the technical field of metal processing platforms, and comprises a bench and a bench body fixedly connected to the upper surface of the bench, wherein an antistatic plate is arranged on the upper surface of the bench body, the upper surface of antistatic backing extends to the stage body below and is provided with the earth connection, the right side surface fixedly connected with of stage body adds the board, it is provided with fixed establishment to add the right side surface upside position of board, the lower surface of rack runs through and is provided with fixed establishment down. This processing platform with antistatic function compares with current ordinary processing platform, and this device rotatable first screw makes briquetting crimping on the conducting strip of earth connection upper end, screws up the dead screw on the screw mount again, makes it fix the lower extreme of earth connection, rotates the second screw and makes the ground cone laminating in ground, and the spring of spring housing inside is compressed, and this design can guarantee that the stage body is when processing, and the vibrations of rack can not cause antistatic failure with rocking.

title_en: Patch tray clamp with uniform stress
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a patch tray clamp with uniform stress, which relates to the technical field of tray clamps and comprises a flat plate, a clamping assembly and a fixing assembly, wherein a plurality of baffles are fixedly arranged at the upper end of the flat plate, the clamping assembly is rotatably arranged in the flat plate and comprises a central shaft, the central shaft is fixedly arranged in the flat plate, a plurality of torsion springs are fixedly arranged on the central shaft, and a clamp member is rotatably arranged at one end of the central shaft through the torsion springs. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the clamp members, the clamp members can clamp objects with various shapes and sizes in mutually independent directions, and meanwhile, the mutually independent clamp members can clamp the objects from multiple directions to form multi-point positioning, so that the stability and accuracy of clamping are improved, and in the clamping process, the clamp members can be tightly attached to the surfaces of the objects, and the offset phenomenon caused by irregular shapes or uneven surfaces of the objects is reduced.

title_en: Binding device with trimming function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a binding device with a cutting edge function, which comprises a fixed support and a base, wherein the left side of the fixed support is provided with a controller, the inside of the fixed support is provided with the base, the lower part of the base is provided with 12 groups of damping springs, the upper part of the base is provided with a telescopic device, the right side of the telescopic device is provided with a movable plate, the lower part of the movable plate is provided with a fixed plate, the right side of the movable plate is provided with a first hydraulic cylinder, the lower part of the first hydraulic cylinder is provided with a cutter, and the right side of the first hydraulic cylinder is provided with a telescopic rod.

title_en: Curtain cutting forming machine
abstract_en: The application discloses a curtain cutting machine which comprises a workbench, a pressing component and a cutting component, wherein the pressing component is arranged on the workbench, the cutting component is used for cutting a curtain, the pressing component comprises a mounting frame arranged on the workbench and a first telescopic cylinder arranged on the mounting frame, the first telescopic cylinder is connected with a connecting rod, the lower end of the connecting rod is provided with a fixed plate, the lower end of the fixed plate is provided with a pressing piece, an elastic component is arranged between the pressing piece and the fixed plate, the first telescopic cylinder drives the fixed plate to drive the pressing piece to move in the vertical direction, and the pressing piece presses the curtain under the action of the elastic component. When the thickness of the curtain is changed, the elastic component can automatically adjust the shaping variable according to the thickness of the curtain, and finally the pressing component is abutted against the curtain, so that the first telescopic cylinder does not need to be adjusted every time the thickness of the curtain is changed.

title_en: Tapping machine
abstract_en: The application discloses a tapping machine, which comprises a vertical shaft, a first main arm, a second main arm, a magnetic drill and a tapping machine, wherein the vertical shaft is vertically fixed on the ground, the first main arm is connected to the vertical shaft in a sliding manner, a lifting mechanism for driving the first main arm to lift is arranged on the vertical shaft, the first main arm can rotate around the vertical shaft along the axial direction, one end of the first main arm, which is far away from the vertical shaft, is connected with the second main arm in a rotating manner, the first main arm and the second main arm are horizontally arranged, and the magnetic drill and the tapping machine are connected to one end of the second main arm, which is far away from the first main arm in a rotating manner. The application can simultaneously meet the punching and tapping operation demands at the locking station, the door leaves do not need to change positions, the lifting link is omitted, and the labor intensity is reduced.

title_en: Dactylotheca cuts membrane device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a fingerstall film cutting device which comprises two vertical plates arranged in parallel, wherein a film cutting assembly moving along the vertical direction is arranged between the vertical plates, a receiving plate is arranged below the film cutting assembly, a cross bar, an arch support, an air cylinder and a scalding needle are arranged below the receiving plate, the cross bar is horizontally arranged on the side parts of the two vertical plates, the bottom of the front end of the receiving plate is respectively hinged with the cross bar and the movable rod end of the air cylinder, and the fingerstall film cutting machine disclosed by the utility model is used for driving the receiving plate to move through the air cylinder, and is matched with the scalding needle and the film cutting assembly to finish pressing, orderly and orderly stacking according to processing requirements can be realized, and workers can directly use the blanking in batches without performing operations such as secondary stacking, stripping and alignment calibration.

title_en: Welding device and pile driver
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of welding, and particularly discloses a welding device and a pile driver, wherein the welding device comprises a fixed seat, a mechanical arm and a welding gun; be provided with first magnetism on the fixing base and inhale the piece, the fixing base is inhaled the piece magnetism through first magnetism and is inhaled in the pile driver, and the arm is located on the fixing base, and welder locates the drive end of arm. The utility model does not need to move the whole welding device, is not influenced by the surrounding environment of a piling area of a piling machine, and meanwhile, the mechanical arm can adjust the welding path of the welding gun according to requirements, so that the welding device has the advantages of short operation preparation period, simple use and operation, wide application range, high operation effect, stable welding quality and capability of realizing automatic welding. Wherein, the fixing base is attracted in the pile driver through first magnetism to welding set's dismouting is simple, is convenient for transport, and convenient maintenance and storage, whole welding set do not receive any ground environment's influence, can expand welding construction operation fast when arriving the new work position.

title_en: Efficient sander for bow sheet processing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of bow piece processing, and discloses a high-efficiency sander for bow piece processing, which solves the problem that the prior art is inconvenient to polish two sides of a bow piece at the same time, and comprises a base, wherein the top of the base is provided with a polishing mechanism and a fixing mechanism, the polishing mechanism comprises a top block fixed at the top of the base, an L-shaped round rod II is fixedly connected between the top block and the base, and a sliding plate is movably sleeved on the outer side of the L-shaped round rod II; according to the utility model, the first air cylinder is matched with the movable plate and the first L-shaped round rod, so that the second grinding wheel descends to clamp the bow between the first grinding wheel and the second grinding wheel, the first grinding wheel and the second grinding wheel rotate stably to polish the bow through the matching between the first motor, the transmission shaft and the L-shaped plate, and the second grinding wheel and the screw rod are matched with the sliding plate and the second L-shaped round rod, so that the surface of the bow is polished comprehensively through the horizontal movement of the first grinding wheel and the second grinding wheel.

title_en: A prevent pressing unilateral roller structure for butyl rubber gasket cross cutting
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-pressing unilateral roller structure for die cutting of butyl rubber gaskets, which comprises a shaft body, wherein two ends of the shaft body are rotatably connected with mounting clamping blocks, two rollers are sleeved on the shaft body in a sliding manner, and the rollers are matched with the shaft body through a locking mechanism to form a structure for fixing the relative position between the rollers and the shaft body. The utility model has the advantages of effectively avoiding the products from being crushed and reducing the rejection rate.

title_en: Structure is inhaled to cutlery box side cut magnetism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a trimming magnetic structure of a cutlery box, which relates to the technical field of cutlery box processing and comprises a base, wherein a supporting frame is arranged at the top of the base, a driving motor is arranged on one side of the supporting frame, a reciprocating screw rod is arranged in the supporting frame, two movable rod mounting seats are symmetrically arranged on one side of the supporting frame, close to the base, of the supporting frame, a reciprocating movable rod is arranged at the bottom of the reciprocating screw rod, an electric push rod is arranged at the bottom of the reciprocating movable rod, a sucker mounting seat is arranged at the bottom of the electric push rod, an air cylinder component is arranged in the sucker mounting seat, a plurality of electromagnetic sucker components are uniformly arranged at the bottom of the sucker mounting seat around an axis, and a plurality of pull rods are uniformly arranged at the bottom of the air cylinder component around the axis. Through the structure, the utility model can adjust the opening distance between the electromagnetic suckers according to the cutlery boxes with different sizes, ensure the contact area between the electromagnetic suckers and the cutlery boxes, improve the running stability of the equipment, and has simple structure and convenient maintenance.

title_en: Tool for machining wave box plug
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of plug production, in particular to a tool for machining a wave box plug. The polishing device comprises a polishing box, a stirring mechanism, a sliding rod and a turning component, wherein a discharging hole is formed in the bottom end of the polishing box, a discharging plate is arranged at the bottom end of the polishing box in a sliding mode, a linear driving mechanism used for driving the discharging plate to move is arranged on the polishing box, the stirring mechanism is arranged on the polishing box and comprises a power piece, an inner cylinder body, an outer cylinder body and a plurality of stirring rods, the sliding rod is connected with the outer cylinder body, a circle of sliding grooves are formed in the inner wall of the polishing box, the end portions of the sliding rod are movably arranged on the inner sides of the sliding grooves, and the turning component is arranged on the outer cylinder body and used for turning abrasive materials in the polishing box. The utility model has good stirring effect on materials, so that the plug can be polished rapidly and uniformly.

title_en: Safety fixing frame for lifting of brake calipers of new energy vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a lifting safety fixing frame of a new energy vehicle brake caliper, which comprises a device body, wherein the device body comprises a hydraulic lifting rack, a workbench, a rotating device, a fixing device and a base, the hydraulic lifting rack is arranged at the top of the base, the workbench is arranged at the top of the hydraulic lifting rack, the rotating device is arranged at the left end of the top of the workbench, the fixing device is arranged at the driving end of the rotating device, the fixing device comprises a mounting block, a guide rod, a double-thread rotating bolt, a first brake block and a second brake block, the guide rod is arranged in the mounting block, the first brake block and the second brake block are respectively sleeved in the guide rod, limiting blocks are arranged at the left end and the right end of the guide rod, the double-thread rotating bolt is arranged between the first brake block and the second brake block through threads, braking hooks are arranged at the bottoms of the first brake block and the second brake block, and the braking hooks are in an L-shaped structure. The device can firmly fix the brake caliper in the process of disassembly and assembly, thereby reducing accident risk.

title_en: Quick mould sheet material positioner
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a quick die plate positioning device which comprises a mounting plate, wherein a groove plate is fixedly arranged on the right side of the top surface of the mounting plate, a positioning plate is movably arranged on the top surface of the groove plate, a supporting and positioning mechanism is arranged on the top surface of the mounting plate and used for positioning a die plate, the supporting and positioning mechanism comprises a moving assembly and a supporting assembly, the moving assembly is arranged on the top surface of the mounting plate and used for adjusting the position of the positioning plate, and the supporting assembly is arranged inside the positioning plate and used for supporting the die plate. This quick mould sheet material positioner conveniently fixes a position the sheet material through backup pad and the extension spring that sets up, puts the sheet material in the backup pad during the use, and the backup pad supports the sheet material when can pulling the connecting plate through the pulling force of extension spring at this moment and fixes a position, has guaranteed the level and smooth of flitch, avoids producing crooked condition and can't keep the uniformity because of the weight of sheet material self to the great part of profile radian.

title_en: Fascia rifle driving medium processing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses fascia gun transmission piece processing equipment, which relates to the technical field of fascia gun processing equipment and comprises a frame, wherein a rotary table and a driving motor for driving the rotary table to rotate are arranged on the frame, a cam feeding mechanism, a crank feeding mechanism, a first screw punching mechanism, a second screw punching mechanism and a discharging mechanism are sequentially arranged on the side of the rotary table, a plurality of fixing seats are arranged on the rotary table, the cam feeding mechanism and the crank feeding mechanism respectively place a cam and a crank on the fixing seats, the first screw punching mechanism is used for connecting and fixing the cam and the crank through screws, the second screw punching mechanism is used for mounting the screws on the side of the cam, and the discharging mechanism is used for grabbing an assembled product from the fixing seats and conveying the product to the next procedure. The utility model can realize the full-automatic assembly of the fascia gun transmission part, has high assembly efficiency, effectively improves the production efficiency and increases the benefit.

title_en: Granulating mechanism for granulating production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a granulating mechanism for granulating production, which comprises a driving component and a cutting component, wherein the output end of the driving component is in driving connection with the input end of the cutting component, the cutting component comprises a mounting seat, a main shaft and cutters, the driving component is connected to one side surface of the mounting seat, one end of the main shaft is connected to the output end of the driving component through the mounting seat, the other end of the main shaft is connected with the cutters, the cutters comprise a transmission component and a plurality of blades, one end of the transmission component is connected to one end of the main shaft facing the blades, the plurality of blades are arranged on the side surface of the transmission component, the plurality of blades are arranged at equal intervals along the circumferential direction of the side surface of the transmission component, each blade is connected to the transmission component through a cutter bar, and each cutter bar is connected to the side surface of the transmission component along the radial direction of the transmission component. The cutter changes the stress direction of the blade, and avoids the lateral force applied to the blade by the driving component, so that the probability of torsion of the blade in the cutting process is reduced.

title_en: Mould burnishing device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of mold polishing, and particularly relates to a mold polishing device. The pneumatic grinding machine comprises a base, an air source is arranged on the base, the air source is connected with a pneumatic grinding machine, a bottom plate is arranged on the base and is in front-back sliding fit connection with the base, a fixed plate is hinged to the right end of the bottom plate, the right end of the fixed plate is hinged to the bottom plate, hydraulic cylinders are hinged to the front side surfaces of the bottom plate and the fixed plate, cylinder bodies of the two hydraulic cylinders are respectively hinged to the bottom plate and the fixed plate, piston rods of the two hydraulic cylinders are hinged to each other, two clamping plates are arranged on the bottom plate, a first clamping plate and a second clamping plate are sequentially arranged on the bottom plate from left to right, the second clamping plate is fixed to the right end of the fixed plate, a cylinder is connected to the left side surface of the first clamping plate, a piston rod of the cylinder is connected with the first clamping plate, and a drawer is arranged at the right end of the base. The front and back positions and the inclination angle of the die can be adjusted, so that the working convenience and the comfort are improved.

title_en: Magnetic ring pin cutting processing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses magnetic ring pin cutting processing equipment, which belongs to the field of processing equipment and comprises a pin cutting cylinder, wherein a plurality of support plates distributed in an array are arranged on the inner wall of the pin cutting cylinder, a support cylinder is arranged on the side wall of the support plate, a mounting ring is arranged on the inner wall of the support cylinder, a support column is arranged at the upper end of the mounting ring, a sliding cylinder is connected with the inner wall of the support cylinder in a sliding manner, a mounting frame is arranged on the side wall of the pin cutting cylinder, an electric push rod is arranged at the lower end of the mounting frame, a ring cutter is arranged at the output end of the electric push rod, the electric push rod penetrates through an inner cavity of a magnetic ring to limit the magnetic ring through the sliding cylinder, the stability of the magnetic ring is conveniently maintained by combining with the support cylinder, and simultaneously the outer wall and the inner wall of the magnetic ring are conveniently cut through the ring cutter, so that the magnetic ring cutting efficiency is improved.

title_en: Adjustable function's welding platform for high frequency straight seam welded tube machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a welding platform with an adjustable function for a high-frequency straight seam pipe welding machine, which belongs to the technical field of pipe fitting welding and comprises a welding platform, an electric sliding table, a supporting frame and a welding mechanical arm, wherein the outer wall of the welding platform is provided with an adjusting mechanism, the adjusting mechanism comprises two adjusting plates which are connected to the outer wall of the top of the welding platform in a sliding manner, the outer wall of the top of the adjusting plate is fixedly provided with a fixed sliding seat, and the outer wall of the fixed sliding seat is connected with two adjusting seats in a sliding manner. This but high frequency straight seam welded pipe machine adjustable function's welded platform is convenient for adjust the distance between four grip posts about through the effect of two-way threaded rod, regulating seat and spacing slider, adjusts the interval of two adjacent grip posts through the effect of mounting bracket, two-way lead screw, loose axle and motor, adjusts the interval between two regulating plates through the effect of electric telescopic handle, is applicable to the pipe fitting of multiple size difference.

title_en: General dental bar guide device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a commonality dental pole is led and is just installed belongs to dental pole and leads technical field, the on-line screen storage device comprises a workbench, workstation top surface fixedly connected with installation cover, sliding connection has first supporting seat in the installation cover, first supporting seat one side fixedly connected with guide rail, dwang outer wall fixedly connected with second bevel gear, workstation one side is equipped with leads the normal subassembly; the utility model discloses in, through being provided with the amesdial including, when detecting the bending department of tooth pole, start hydraulic push rod, thereby hydraulic push rod's output drives briquetting down to contact with the tooth pole and leads it, through this design, realized the synchronous motion of amesdial and hydraulic push rod to make the hydraulic push rod can be accurate move to the bending department directly over, thereby can carry out accurate leading to the bending department, thereby improve the accuracy of leading, and thereby can be quick lead the tooth pole and lead the efficiency of leading.

title_en: Modularized reamer head
abstract_en: The utility model provides a modularized reamer head which comprises a cutterhead, wherein the cutterhead is disc-shaped, the cutterhead is provided with a blade mounting groove and a cutter handle connecting end, the blade mounting groove and the cutter handle connecting end are respectively arranged at two ends of the cutterhead, and a reamer blade is arranged in the blade mounting groove. The shank connecting end comprises an end face, an embedded connecting part is arranged on the end face, and an empty cutter groove is formed in the end face. The utility model can reduce abrasion of the grinding wheel in the processing process, improve the processing quality, reduce the times of dressing or replacing the grinding wheel, improve the production efficiency, reduce the production cost, avoid the phenomenon of 'convex' on the end surface, improve the stability of the connection between the reamer head and the cutter handle, improve the installation precision of the reamer head and the cutter handle, improve the processing precision of the reamer and improve the processing stability.

title_en: Multifunctional cutting device for beveling production of edge of lining layer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional cutting device for beveling production of edges of an inner liner, which comprises a mounting cross rod, fixing gaskets, sliding grooves, sliding blocks, inclined cutters, hydraulic cylinders, hydraulic rods and hydraulic connecting hoses, wherein the two sides of the top of the mounting cross rod are provided with the fixing gaskets, the two sides of the mounting cross rod are provided with the sliding grooves, the sliding blocks are arranged in the left and right sliding grooves, the inclined cutters are arranged at the bottoms of the sliding blocks, the hydraulic cylinders are arranged at the bottoms of the centers of the mounting cross rod, the hydraulic rods are arranged in the tops of the hydraulic cylinders, the hydraulic connecting hoses are arranged below the left and right sides of the hydraulic cylinders, the hydraulic connecting hoses on the left and right sides are respectively connected with the inclined cutters on the corresponding sides, and the inclined angles of the inclined cutters are controlled by the hydraulic cylinders. The utility model has reasonable design, realizes the aim of thinning the edge thickness of the inner liner, effectively improves the problems of bubble and delamination at the bead mouth of the finished product, eliminates the bubble at the bead mouth of the wheel, effectively eliminates the hidden danger of quality and improves the quality of the product.

title_en: Wood board edge bonding machine for furniture processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wooden plate edge banding machine for furniture processing, which aims to solve the technical problem that the edge banding machine is inconvenient to discharge and collect edge-banding plates in the prior art. The plate transporting device comprises a base and a round shell, wherein a processing box is assembled on the base, a supporting roller is assembled on the front side wall of the base, a conveying belt is arranged on the base, the round shell is arranged on one side of the base, a support is fixedly connected to the bottom surface of the round shell, a circular plate is rotationally connected to the top surface of the support, a motor is fixedly connected to the bottom surface of an inner cavity of the circular plate, an output shaft of the motor is fixedly connected with the circular plate, a plurality of storage boxes are uniformly arranged on the top surface of the circular plate, and supporting components are arranged in the storage boxes.

title_en: Cold bending forming device for forming large-diameter steel pipe
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of cold roll forming devices for forming large-diameter steel pipes, in particular to a cold roll forming device for forming large-diameter steel pipes, which comprises a cold roll forming table, a first support plate, a second support plate, a clamping groove, a sliding plate, a supporting block and an adjusting screw, wherein one side of the top of the cold roll forming table is provided with the first support plate; the cold-bending forming device for forming the large-diameter steel pipe has the beneficial effects that when the cold-bending forming device is used for forming the large-diameter steel pipe, the clamping blocks are firstly pulled out of the clamping grooves through the pull rods, then nuts on the adjusting screw are screwed according to the length of the steel pipe, and the adjusting screw drives the clamping blocks to stretch and retract, so that two groups of clamping blocks are just clamped on two groups of the steel pipe.

title_en: Quick positioning tool for perforated workpiece
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a quick positioning tool for a workpiece with a hole, which comprises a tool assembly, a movable assembly and a clamping assembly, wherein the tool assembly comprises a tool body, the movable assembly comprises a movable ring, a supporting ring, a fixed block, a first fixed shaft, a connecting rod, a second fixed shaft and a clamping block, the movable ring is connected to the outer surface of the tool body in a threaded manner, the supporting ring is sleeved at the upper end position inside the movable ring, the fixed block is fixedly connected to the peripheral position of the upper end of the supporting ring, and the first fixed shaft is fixedly connected to the inner position of the fixed block. The movable ring is driven to move downwards through the rotation of the movable ring, the movable ring rotates to drive the supporting ring to move downwards, the supporting ring drives the fixing block to move downwards and drives the first fixing shaft to move downwards, the first fixing shaft drives the connecting rod to move downwards, the connecting rod drives the second fixing shaft to move inwards, and the second fixing shaft drives the clamping block to move inwards again, so that the clamping block can clamp a workpiece fixedly.

title_en: Polishing device for rigid contact net contact line
