abstract_en: The utility model provides a polishing device for a contact line of a rigid contact net, which relates to the field of polishing of contact lines of the rigid contact net and adopts the scheme that the polishing mechanism comprises a polishing motor and a polishing wheel, wherein the polishing motor is arranged on a support plate I, the support plate I is of an L-shaped structure, the support plate I is connected with a wing plate on the outer side of a movable seat through a guide post I, the support plate I and the guide post I can relatively move, a follow-up spring I is vertically arranged between the support plate I and the movable seat, the follow-up spring I is sleeved on the guide post I, the upper end of the guide post I penetrates through the support plate I and is provided with a limit nut I, a straight hole groove I is vertically arranged at the corresponding position of the movable seat, a motor shaft of the polishing motor stretches into the straight hole groove I to be connected with the polishing wheel, and the axis of the polishing wheel is perpendicular to the advancing direction of the movable seat. The polishing mechanism can float along with the diameter change of the contact line, and deformation caused by bearing a large load is greatly avoided.

title_en: CNC processing platform
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a CNC machining table which comprises a machine frame, a swinging seat, a swinging driver, a swinging mechanism, a rotary table, a rotary driver and a rotary mechanism, wherein the swinging seat is arranged on the machine frame in a swinging mode, the swinging driver is fixedly arranged on the machine frame, the swinging seat is in transmission connection with the swinging driver through the swinging mechanism, the rotary table is rotatably arranged on the swinging seat, the rotary driver is fixedly connected with the swinging seat, the rotary mechanism is arranged in the swinging seat, and the rotary table is in transmission connection with the rotary driver through the rotary mechanism. The utility model can automatically adjust the processing angle and the processing direction of the workpiece, saves the long stop caused by manually adjusting the processing direction of the workpiece, effectively improves the processing efficiency, and effectively improves the processing precision, thereby improving the processing quality.

title_en: Reinforcing steel bar clamping device for commercial concrete prefabricated part production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of production of commercial concrete prefabricated parts, in particular to a reinforcing steel bar clamping device for production of commercial concrete prefabricated parts. According to the utility model, the bottom plate, the top plate, the guide rods, the first springs, the rotating rods, the clamping blocks and the shifting sheets are matched for use, when in clamping, the bottom plate and the top plate are sleeved from the end faces of the steel bars arranged side by side, then the top plate is pressed down, when the top plate descends, the four corners of the top plate slide down along the four guide rods and compress the first springs until the clamping seats in the bottom plate and the top plate clamp the steel bars for fixing, then the shifting sheets are shifted, and the shifting sheets drive the rotating rods to rotate, so that the clamping blocks are clamped on the upper end faces of the two sides of the top plate, and the aim of facilitating rapid clamping is achieved.

title_en: Polishing machine for stainless steel tableware production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of tableware production and processing, in particular to a polishing machine for stainless steel tableware production, which comprises a machine body, a polishing roller rotatably assembled with the machine body, and a driving mechanism assembled on the machine body and used for driving the polishing roller, wherein the driving mechanism comprises a rotating component used for rotating the polishing roller and an adjusting component used for adjusting the longitudinal distance of a polishing channel, the rotating component comprises a sliding tensioning wheel, a sliding frame, a motor, a driving wheel, a belt, a connecting arm used for connecting the adjusting component and the sliding tensioning wheel, and a driven wheel assembled with the polishing roller, the sliding frame is assembled on the machine body, the sliding tensioning wheel and the sliding frame are transversely and slidably assembled, two ends of the motor are respectively connected with the machine body and the driving wheel, the belt is sleeved on the outer annular wall of the driving wheel, the outer annular wall of the sliding tensioning wheel, the outer annular wall of the driven wheel, the polishing roller utilization rate is improved, and the transmission structure of the polishing roller is simplified.

title_en: Enameled wire clamping device for detecting integrity of paint film of U-shaped enameled wire
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an enameled wire clamping device for detecting the integrity of a paint film of a U-shaped enameled wire, which comprises a base, a bracket and a supporting rod, wherein the base comprises a hollow metal frame body with an upward opening, steel ball clusters are arranged in an inner cavity of the frame body, a plurality of insulating supporting columns and a grounding needle are arranged on the bottom surface of the frame body, the bracket comprises two cross rods and at least two vertical rods, a graduated scale is arranged on at least one vertical rod along the length direction of the vertical rod, a transverse through groove and a longitudinal through groove are arranged on any cross rod, at least one screw hole is arranged on the side wall of the cross rod, a fastening bolt is arranged on the screw hole, and thread sections are respectively arranged at two ends of the supporting rod. The utility model has the beneficial effects that the installation efficiency and the detection efficiency of the enameled wire are improved.

title_en: Floating type plate clamping clamp on numerical control punch
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of numerical control punching machines and discloses a floating plate clamping clamp on a numerical control punching machine, which comprises a mounting seat, wherein an adjusting mechanism is arranged in the mounting seat, a dial is arranged at the top of the mounting seat, a fixed seat is rotationally connected to the top of the dial, a limit bolt is arranged on one side of the fixed seat, an adjusting seat is arranged at the top of an inner cavity of the fixed seat, a clamping mechanism is arranged at the top of the adjusting seat, the angle of the fixed seat is adjusted by the dial and the limit bolt after a workpiece is fixed on the adjusting seat, a rotating handle is rotated to drive a stud to move downwards, a second rotating shaft in a groove and a rotating shaft in the fixed seat are matched in the process, the angle of the workpiece fixed on the adjusting seat can be adjusted, the workpiece is adjusted at multiple angles, the applicability of the clamping clamp is improved, and the problem that the angle of the workpiece is difficult to adjust according to processing requirements of the existing clamping clamp is solved.

title_en: Automobile label cutting device
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of automobile label processing equipment, in particular to an automobile label cutting device, which comprises a fixed base, wherein a processing table and a mounting frame are arranged on the fixed base, a positioning assembly for fixing the position of a plate raw material is arranged on the processing table, a triaxial driving device is arranged on the mounting frame, a cutting assembly and a protection assembly are arranged on the triaxial driving device, the cutting assembly is used for cutting the plate raw material, the protection assembly is used for protecting the surface of the plate raw material, and the triaxial driving device is used for driving the cutting assembly and the protection assembly to synchronously move. The application has the effect of preventing the scraps from leaving scratches on the surface of the plate raw material, thereby guaranteeing the processing quality of the automobile label.

title_en: Do benefit to timber cutting machine of sweeps recovery
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of cutting machines, in particular to a wood cutting machine which is beneficial to recycling scraps, comprising a cutting machine main body and a band saw power seat, the band saw power seat is installed on the upper side of the cutter main body, the saw blade is installed in the band saw power seat, and a dust hood is arranged on one side of the saw blade. This do benefit to wood cutting machine that sweeps was retrieved, when wood cutting machine was processed the plank, rotatory screw rod, make the screw rod drive the suction hood and be close to the plank, make the suction hood adjustable and the plank between the interval, start the air extraction fan this moment, make the air current of suction hood below can drive the saw-dust and get into the inside of collecting box, the filter shakes simultaneously, can prevent that the saw-dust from blockking up the filter, make the filter keep stable filtration efficiency, the saw-dust can concentrate the inside of collecting box at this moment, and after the chamber door was opened to the staff, alright clear up the saw-dust of collecting for the saw-dust is difficult for splashing when wood cutting machine operation leads.

title_en: Pressing device for diamond machining
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pressing device for diamond machining, which belongs to the technical field of pressing and comprises a box body, wherein two sides of the inner wall of the box body are respectively provided with a second chute, a sliding plate is connected in a sliding manner in the second chute, one side of the sliding plate is fixedly connected with a mounting plate, the top of the mounting plate is provided with a first groove, the opposite inner walls of the first groove are respectively provided with a first bearing, two first bearings are respectively connected with a first rotating shaft in a rotating manner, the opposite ends of the two first rotating shafts are fixedly connected with the same two bidirectional threaded rods, the surfaces of the bidirectional threaded rods are in threaded connection with two first threaded blocks, one side of the mounting plate is fixedly connected with a first shell, the first driving motor works, and the second rotating shafts drive the bidirectional threaded rods to rotate, so that the two first threaded blocks and the two arc clamping pieces are driven to move in opposite directions, the purpose of fixing sleeves applicable to different sizes can be achieved, and the practicability of the device is improved.

title_en: Planer-type milling machine that possesses cooling structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of planer milling machines and discloses a planer milling machine with a cooling structure, which comprises a milling machine body, wherein a collecting assembly is arranged at the bottom of the milling machine body, a cooling assembly is arranged at the left side of the collecting assembly, a lubricating assembly is arranged at the rear side of the collecting assembly, the collecting assembly comprises a water tank, the outer part of the water tank is fixedly connected with the inner side of the milling machine body, an operating table is fixedly connected with the top of the water tank, a motor is fixedly connected with the rear side of the water tank, and a magnetic shaft is fixedly connected with the output end of the motor. According to the utility model, the magnetic shaft is driven to synchronously rotate by the driving motor, the water pipe cools the milling machine body, meanwhile, the scraps are flushed to the right side of the water tank together, liquid directly flows into the water tank, the scraps can be sucked away by the magnetic shaft and scraped down onto the collecting plate by the scraping plate, and finally the scraps slide into the collecting frame, so that the scraps can be automatically separated and collected in the cooling circulation process, and time and labor are saved.

title_en: Accurate grinding and polishing tool for improving machining precision of optical lenses
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fine grinding and polishing tool for improving the processing precision of an optical lens, which comprises a polishing rack, wherein the polishing rack is of a rectangular frame structure, a polishing table is arranged on the polishing rack, a polishing main shaft is arranged on the polishing rack corresponding to the polishing table, and the end part of the polishing main shaft is connected with a polishing installation head through a coupling; the utility model relates to the technical field of fine grinding and polishing tools, in particular to a fine grinding and polishing tool for improving the processing precision of an optical lens, which adopts a flexible connecting sleeve with a split structure and a disc-shaped fixing seat to jointly form a specific polishing actuating mechanism, adopts a sleeving manner to mount the disc-shaped fixing seat during mounting, and be provided with the guide limit rod of helicitic texture and realize the locking to fixing base and the installation head of polishing, guarantee the stability of polishing to carry out spacingly to flexible limit sleeve through dish structure, avoid flexible limit sleeve atress to take place excessive deformation, effectively improve the precision of polishing.

title_en: Extrusion rust cleaning device for cold heading steel wire
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of steel wire rust removal, in particular to an extrusion rust removal device for cold heading steel wires, which comprises a workbench, wherein a feeding frame is fixedly arranged at the rear side of the upper end of the workbench, a dust cover is arranged at the side of the upper end of the workbench, a rust removal assembly is arranged at the inner side of the dust cover, a high-pressure spray head is arranged at the upper end of the inner side of the dust cover, a water collecting tank is fixedly arranged at the lower end of the workbench, a filter screen is arranged in the water collecting tank, a water removal frame is fixedly arranged at the side of the upper end of the workbench, a polishing roller is arranged at the front side of the water removal frame, a steering roller is fixedly arranged at the front side of the upper end of the workbench, and a display screen is fixedly arranged at the front side of the left end of the workbench.

title_en: Pathological specimen slicing knife
abstract_en: The utility model provides a pathology sample slicing knife, includes knife rest, blade, locking strip, driving lever, drive connecting rod, installation brace, accuse position pole, the blade rest has the mounting groove, and the mounting groove suits with the blade, and the blade is connected the mounting groove, and the blade both sides have the draw-in groove, and the blade rest both sides have the card strip, and the card strip suits with the draw-in groove, the card strip is connected the draw-in groove, the blade has the holding tank, and the blade has the locking groove, holds groove and locking strip and suits, and locking groove connects locking strip upper portion, and the groove is accomodate in locking strip lower part connection, and spring strip one end is connected to the locking strip, and the blade rest is connected to the spring strip other end, and the blade rest has the slide hole, and the locking strip has the fixed slot, and the slide hole is passed to the dead lever, and the fixed slot is connected to the inner of driving lever.

title_en: Reinforcing bar orthotic devices is used in building engineering construction
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a reinforcing steel bar correcting device for construction engineering, which comprises a supporting component and a correcting component, wherein the correcting component comprises a driving motor, a screw rod, a movable rod, a first sliding block, a fixed ring, a through hole, a movable column and a correcting wheel, the driving motor is fixedly connected to the top end position of a supporting frame, the screw rod is fixedly connected to an output shaft of the driving motor, the movable rod is in threaded connection with the outer surface position of the screw rod, the first sliding block is fixedly connected to one end position of the movable rod, the fixed ring is fixedly connected to the other end position of the movable rod, and the through hole is formed in the peripheral position outside the fixed ring. The support frame is placed on the concrete floor, the steel bars penetrate through the fixed circular ring, the driving motor drives the screw rod to rotate, the screw rod drives the fixed circular ring to vertically move upwards through the movable rod, the fixed circular ring moves to drive the correction wheel to move from the outer surface of the steel bars through the movable column, and the correction wheel corrects the steel bars.

title_en: Take cavity to take out material milling cutter mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of milling cutters and discloses a milling cutter mechanism with a hollow pumping function, which comprises a protection shell, wherein a rotating main shaft is arranged in the protection shell through a bearing, the rotating main shaft is in hollow through arrangement, a servo motor is fixedly arranged at the lower part of the protection shell, the servo motor drives the rotating main shaft to rotate through a transmission assembly, the lower part of the rotating main shaft is connected with a milling cutter part through a connecting thread, the milling cutter part is in hollow through arrangement, and a pumping port is arranged at the lower end surface of the milling cutter part. According to the utility model, through the milling cutter, the suction hole, the suction port, the rotating main shaft and the dust extraction joint, the chips can be sucked through the suction hole and the suction port during milling, so that the purpose of timely cleaning the chips is achieved, the milling quality is ensured, and through the end sealing assembly, a good sealing effect can be provided for the bearing component inside, the service life of the bearing component is prolonged, and the maintenance cost is reduced.

title_en: Portable jump ring mounting tool
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable clamp spring mounting tool which is characterized by comprising a pressing sleeve main body, a pressing assembly sleeve, a pressing claw and a fixing pin, wherein the pressing claw is mounted on the pressing sleeve main body through the fixing pin, one end of the pressing assembly sleeve can slidably extend into the pressing sleeve main body, and the diameter of the other end of the pressing assembly sleeve gradually increases towards the direction away from the pressing sleeve main body to form a conical end. The device can quickly respond to the replacement work of the clamp spring to the client, is more portable and convenient, can save the back and forth transportation cost, can directly process the clamp spring at the client, and can save the client time more quickly.

title_en: Tooth slot edging device for gear manufacturing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tooth socket edging device for gear manufacturing, which comprises a bottom plate, a vertical plate, a top plate, a rotary table, a clamping structure, a fixing structure, an adjusting structure and a dust removing structure, wherein the vertical plate is fixedly connected to one side of the top of the bottom plate, the top plate is fixedly connected to the top of the vertical plate, the rotary table is arranged on one side of the vertical plate, the clamping structure is arranged in the rotary table, the fixing structure is arranged on one side of the rotary table, the adjusting structure is arranged on the top plate, and the dust removing structure is arranged at the bottom of the adjusting structure. Compared with the prior art, the utility model has the advantages that the four groups of clamping blocks can be driven to fold or open, the tooth sockets of the gears are clamped through the tail ends of the clamping blocks, the gears are fixed in all directions, the stability of the fixed gears is ensured, the iron filings floating in the air can be collected, the floating iron filings and dust are prevented from entering eyes of people, meanwhile, the dust is prevented from being raised conveniently, and the health and sanitation of the working environment are protected.

title_en: Workpiece loading and unloading auxiliary supporting device of numerical control machine tool
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of auxiliary support, and discloses an auxiliary support device for loading and unloading workpieces of a numerical control machine tool, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a pushing groove is formed in the top surface of the bottom plate, a movable seat is arranged on the top surface of the bottom plate and is movably connected with the pushing groove, a first electric telescopic rod is fixed on the top surface of the bottom plate, a second electric telescopic rod is fixed on the top surface of the movable seat, a guide component for supporting and guiding the workpieces is arranged at the top end of the first electric telescopic rod, a clamping component for fixing the workpieces is arranged at the top end of the second electric telescopic rod, the guide component can be rotationally adjusted, so that the workpieces with different sizes and different shapes can be supported and guided, one end of the workpieces can be clamped and fixed by the clamping component, the workpieces can be pushed and processed conveniently, automatic pushing and feeding of the device can be realized, the adaptability of the device is improved, and the practicability of the device is improved.

title_en: Automobile part punching, taking and placing clamp
abstract_en: The utility model provides a stamping, taking and placing clamp for automobile parts, which is characterized by comprising a moving structure, a main body structure and a clamp structure, wherein the moving structure is arranged below the main body structure, the moving structure is connected with the main body structure in a welding mode, the clamp structure is arranged on the side face of the main body structure, and the main body structure is connected with the clamp structure.

title_en: Back pressure type fluid polishing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of fluid polishing, in particular to back pressure type fluid polishing equipment which comprises a workbench, an upper hydraulic component and a lower hydraulic component, wherein the upper hydraulic component is arranged at the upper end of the workbench, the lower hydraulic component is arranged at the lower end of the workbench, the upper end of the lower hydraulic component penetrates through the workbench and is connected with a carrier component arranged on the workbench, a product to be polished is arranged on the carrier component, during polishing, the upper hydraulic component is in downward contact with the product, the upper hydraulic component is communicated with the lower hydraulic component through the product, the upper hydraulic component upwards extrudes a fluid medium, and when the fluid medium flows to the upper hydraulic component, the upper hydraulic component extrudes the fluid medium to provide back pressure. When the fluid medium flows upwards, the first piston moves upwards and simultaneously provides downward pressure, and when the fluid medium flows downwards, the second hydraulic cylinder moves downwards and simultaneously provides upward pressure, so that the fluid medium always has larger pressure, and the fluid medium generates larger friction with a product, thereby greatly improving polishing efficiency.

title_en: Screen welding rotary conversion die device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of net cover processing, in particular to a net cover welding rotary conversion die device, which comprises a bottom plate and a bracket fixed on one side of the bottom plate, wherein a winding device is arranged on the surface of the bracket, a support column is rotatably connected above the bottom plate, a turntable is fixedly connected to the top end of the support column, four groups of mounting boxes which are in annular arrays are fixedly connected to the surface of the turntable, a net cover supporting die is arranged above the mounting boxes, the turntable and a plurality of groups of net cover supporting dies are arranged above the mounting boxes, the turntable can drive the net cover supporting die to circularly move at a plurality of groups of stations through rotation of the turntable, so that the net cover can efficiently perform feeding, winding, welding and discharging operations of the net cover, the net cover welding processing efficiency is improved, the limiting disc can be driven to stably rotate through a limiting disc and a sliding block, the net cover supporting die can be ensured to accurately move to a proper station, and the positions of the net cover supporting die can be locked through matching with arc-shaped blocks and arc-shaped grooves on the surface of the limiting disc, and the stability of net cover processing is ensured.

title_en: Battery case welding device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of battery shell welding, in particular to a battery shell welding device which comprises a shell and a bearing table, wherein clamping parts are respectively arranged at the top of the bearing table at intervals, a driving mechanism is arranged between the two clamping parts and used for driving the two clamping parts to be relatively close to or far away from each other so as to increase or reduce the distance between the two clamping parts, the clamping parts comprise L-shaped clamping plates, clamping columns and a motor I, and the clamping columns are rotatably arranged on the clamping plates and driven to rotate by the motor I. According to the utility model, the two clamping parts are relatively close to each other through the driving mechanism, so that the clamping columns on the clamping plate tightly clamp the two sides of the shell, the stability of the shell is ensured, the shell is convenient for a user to weld, then, the clamping columns are driven to rotate through the motor, so that the displacement of the clamping columns is adjusted while the shell is fixed, the clamping columns are aligned with the welding head mastered by the user, and the difficulty of the user in welding the shell is reduced.

title_en: Cooling device for section bar production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cooling device for profile production, which relates to the technical field of profile cooling and comprises a transmission support frame, wherein a plurality of transmission rollers are arranged in the transmission support frame in a matched manner, a plurality of second fans are fixedly arranged at the bottom of the transmission support frame, so that the cooling quality of the profiles is guaranteed by the second fans when the bottoms of the profiles are cooled by the second fans, a mounting frame is further arranged at the top of the transmission support frame, a plurality of first fans are arranged on the mounting frame in a matched manner, the produced profiles are placed on the transmission rollers in the cooling process to realize the transmission effect, the bottoms and two side surfaces of the transmitted profiles are cooled by the second fans arranged at the bottoms of the transmission support frame, and the cooling effect of the first fans on the tops and the two side surfaces of the transmitted profiles is realized by opening the first fans, so that the temperature difference of the profiles in the cooling process is effectively avoided, and the rapid and uniform cooling is realized.

title_en: Processing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides processing equipment, which comprises a lathe bed, a stand column, a workbench and a spindle box, wherein two independent working areas, namely a first lathe bed space and a second lathe bed space, are formed on the lathe bed, each space is provided with at least two movable workbenches and the spindle box, and spindles are matched with the workbenches and the spindle box one by one. The design greatly improves the working efficiency and flexibility of the processing equipment, so that different cutters can be quickly replaced and the position of a workbench can be adjusted when different parts are processed, the processing diversity and adaptability are effectively improved, and meanwhile, the operation independence of each working area and the reasonable utilization of the space are ensured.

title_en: Cutter head cleaning assembly and grinding device with same
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cutterhead cleaning assembly and a grinding device with the same, wherein the cutterhead cleaning assembly comprises a mounting seat, a cleaning barrel and a powder sweeping barrel, the mounting seat is used for being detachably arranged on a grinding cavity of a machine body, the cleaning barrel is movably arranged in the mounting seat in a penetrating mode and is used for being covered outside an inner cutterhead, at least one group of first cleaning bristles used for being in contact with the outer wall of the inner cutterhead are arranged on the inner side wall of the cleaning barrel, the powder sweeping barrel is rotatably sleeved on the cleaning barrel, and at least one group of second cleaning bristles used for being in contact with the bottom of the grinding cavity and in driving fit with a powder sweeping plate are arranged on the bottom wall of the powder sweeping barrel. Meanwhile, the second cleaning brush hair on the powder sweeping cylinder can completely sweep out residues falling to the bottom of the grinding cavity, so that the problem of residual powder in the grinding cavity is avoided.

title_en: Handheld laser welding gun with lens detection function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a handheld laser welding gun with a lens detection function, which comprises a gun body, wherein water circulation holes are formed in the front side and the rear side of the left side wall of the gun body, an air passage hole is formed in the middle of the lower side of the left side wall of the gun body, a photosensitive sensor is embedded in the left side of the front side wall of the gun body, a protective gas guide ring is clamped on the left side of an inner cavity of the gun body, a protective drawer is inserted on the top of the gun body and positioned on the right side of the protective gas guide ring, a protective mirror is clamped on the inner cavity of the protective drawer, the protective mirror is fixedly installed through a protective compression ring, a focusing drawer is inserted on the top of the gun body and positioned on the right side of the protective drawer, and a focusing mirror is clamped in the inner cavity of the focusing drawer.

title_en: Jewelry polishing machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a jewelry polishing machine, which relates to the technical field of jewelry polishing and comprises a shell, wherein a polishing device is arranged on the shell, a connecting cloth sleeve is arranged on the shell, a glass plate is fixedly embedded on the side wall of the shell, cleaning pieces fixedly arranged on the inner side wall of the shell are respectively arranged on two sides of the glass plate, the section of each cleaning piece is in a saw-tooth shape, a moving strip is arranged on the inner side wall of the shell through a moving control mechanism, an installation strip is in sliding fit with the upper surface of the moving strip, a cleaning soft brush is fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the installation strip, a T-shaped connecting piece is fixedly arranged on the outer side wall of the installation strip, and the connecting piece is movably embedded into the moving strip.

title_en: High-power medium-high frequency induction heating dismounting interference fit large shaft sleeve or coupling device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses high-power medium-high frequency induction heating dismounting interference fit large-shaft sleeve or coupling equipment, which comprises an electric control cabinet, a water pump and a circulating water tank, wherein a high-power medium-high frequency induction heating circuit is arranged in the electric control cabinet. The utility model has the following technical effects that the induction heating cable is wound on the interference fit shaft sleeve or the coupling through induction heating to form an induction heating coil, the shaft sleeve or the coupling is heated to expand and can be installed or pulled out, and the induction heating cable is particularly suitable for assembling and disassembling the large interference fit shaft sleeve or the coupling and is uniformly heated. Deformation and damage of the heating component can not be caused, the induction heating cable is cooled by water, and damage of the induction heating cable due to overhigh temperature is avoided. The induction coil is made of a cable, is flexible, can be wound on the interference fit shaft sleeve or the coupling on site to form a spiral induction coil, and is particularly suitable for mounting and dismounting the large interference fit shaft sleeve or the coupling.

title_en: Pressing mechanism with pressure sensor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pressing mechanism with a pressure sensor, which comprises a three-dimensional motion system, a lifting frame connected with the three-dimensional motion system, a lifting module elastically connected with the lifting frame, and a pressure head support movably connected with the lifting module, wherein a pressure head is arranged at the bottom of the pressure head support, the pressure sensor is arranged between the pressure head support and the lifting module, a pair of pressure head supports are arranged left and right, a pair of clamping jaws are arranged between the pair of pressure head supports, the clamping jaw cylinders are arranged on the clamping jaw cylinders, and the clamping jaw cylinders are fixedly connected with the lifting frame through cylinder connecting frames. The upper support is clamped by the pair of clamping jaws, the upper support and the lower support are aligned vertically under the cooperation of the industrial camera, the lifting frame descends, the pair of pressure heads press the left side and the right side of the upper support, and the upper support is pressed on the lower support. The design provides a mechanical structure for the cooperation of the upper bracket and the lower bracket, and provides hardware support for the automation of product assembly.

title_en: Polishing apparatus
abstract_en: The utility model discloses polishing equipment, which relates to the technical field of polishing processing, and comprises a frame, wherein the frame comprises a processing table and a rotary driving assembly, a movable star wheel is arranged on the processing table, a plurality of placing holes for placing products to be processed are formed in the movable star wheel, a lifting driving mechanism and an upper polishing disk are arranged above the processing table, a plurality of polishing brushes are arranged on one side of the upper polishing disk, which faces the movable star wheel, the lifting driving mechanism is used for driving the upper polishing disk to move towards the movable star wheel so as to enable the polishing brushes to be in contact with the upper surface of the products to be processed, and the frame further comprises a pressure sensor electrically connected with the lifting driving mechanism.

title_en: Dismounting tool for axle pin of traction belt of ring rail of spinning frame
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of textile auxiliary tools, and particularly relates to a spinning frame ring plate traction belt shaft pin dismounting tool which comprises a vertical positioning piece and a horizontal positioning piece connected to the top of the vertical positioning piece, wherein a positioning notch is formed in one end of the outer side of the horizontal positioning piece, a movable ejector rod is arranged on the vertical positioning piece, and the shaft pin is ejected out through the movement of the movable ejector rod.

title_en: Anti-torsion electric tool
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-torsion electric tool, and relates to the technical field of electric tools. The electric tool comprises a handle, wherein the upper end of the handle is connected with a main body, a motor is arranged in the main body, an output shaft of the motor is connected with a driver through a speed reducer, the driver is connected with a drill clamp arranged at the front end of the main body, a connecting seat is arranged at the lower end of the handle and used for being connected with a power supply, a trigger is arranged on the handle, a control chip is arranged in the handle or at the lower side of the handle and electrically connected with the motor, an electronic gyroscope is arranged on the control chip, the trigger is pressed down, the control chip controls the motor to rotate, and when the electronic gyroscope detects that an electric tool runs suddenly, the control chip controls the motor to stop rotating. The electric tool is suddenly twisted due to unexpected resistance or improper operation, the electronic gyroscope rapidly transmits signals, the motor is stopped, the risks of hand injury of operators and damage to workpieces and tools are effectively avoided, the safety is improved, meanwhile, the abrasion and damage of the electric tool are reduced, the service life is prolonged, and the cost and the replacement frequency are reduced.

title_en: Plunger pump processing mounting fixture
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a plunger pump machining fixing clamp, and relates to the field of plunger pump machining. The fixing clamp comprises a support unit, wherein the support unit is provided with a clamp unit, the support unit comprises a bottom plate, a support rod and a base plate, the bottom of the support rod is fixedly connected to the bottom plate, the base plate is fixedly connected to the top of the support rod, the clamp unit comprises a conical sleeve seat, an elastic conical ring, an expansion sleeve and a fastening bolt, the conical sleeve seat is arranged at the upper position of the base plate, the elastic conical ring is fixedly connected to the conical sleeve seat, the expansion sleeve is sleeved on the elastic conical ring, and the fastening bolt is inserted into the expansion sleeve. This mounting fixture is through rotating fastening bolt for fastening bolt shifts out from the hydraulic stem top, takes out fastening bolt in the follow expansion shell, and then makes the expansion shell can follow the toper cover seat and take off, makes the expansion shell model can change, and then can adapt to the fixed of the plunger pump cylinder body of different internal diameters.

title_en: Press mounting device with automatic feeding and discharging function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of press-fitting devices, and discloses a press-fitting device with automatic feeding and discharging, which comprises a press-fitting device and a material taking device, wherein the material taking device is arranged at the front side of the top end of the press-fitting device, the press-fitting device comprises a placing plate, the top end of the placing plate is fixedly connected with a supporting plate at the rear side, the top end of the supporting plate is fixedly connected with a top plate, the top end of the placing plate is fixedly connected with a working shell at the rear side, two sides of the bottom end of the inner side wall of the working shell are respectively fixedly connected with a second telescopic rod, the top end of the working shell is fixedly connected with the press-fitting shell, and two sides of the bottom end of the inner side wall of the press-fitting shell are respectively provided with a top block. According to the utility model, the press-fitting device with automatic feeding and discharging functions is provided, the workpiece can be effectively ejected out by means of the second telescopic rod, and the workpiece can be effectively taken out by means of the material taking device and discharged by the conveyor belt.

title_en: Clamping and positioning mechanism for die processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mold processing clamping and positioning mechanism, and relates to the technical field of positioning mechanisms. The utility model comprises a base, wherein a supporting table is fixed on the upper side of the base, two positioning seats are oppositely and slidably matched on the upper side of the supporting table, a first driving mechanism for driving the two positioning seats to oppositely slide is arranged on the upper side of the base, two clamping blocks are oppositely and slidably matched on one side of the positioning seat, and a first bidirectional threaded rod in threaded fit with the two clamping blocks is rotatably matched on one side of the positioning seat. According to the utility model, the die is placed on the supporting table, the second driving mechanism is started to drive the two worms to synchronously rotate, the worms drive the two clamping blocks to oppositely slide through the first bidirectional threaded rod, so that the positions of the four clamping blocks can be conveniently and quickly adjusted, the four clamping blocks are kept symmetrical in pairs, the stability of die positioning is kept, the first driving mechanism is started to drive the two positioning seats to oppositely slide, the die is clamped through the four clamping blocks, and the die positioning of different sizes can be conveniently adapted.

title_en: Tapping machine with protective structure
abstract_en: The utility model is suitable for the technical field of tapping machines, and provides a tapping machine with a protective structure, which comprises a base, wherein a box body for storing cooling liquid is fixedly arranged at the top of the base, a supporting block is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the bottom of the box body, a transverse plate is fixedly arranged at the top of the supporting block, two strip-shaped holes are formed in the transverse plate, a base plate for placing metal pieces is fixedly arranged on the transverse plate, a support is fixedly arranged at the top of the base, an electric push rod is fixedly arranged on the support, a support column is fixedly arranged on an output rod of the electric push rod, a motor is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the support column, and a tapping head is fixedly arranged on an output shaft of the motor. The tapping machine with the protection structure provided by the scheme solves the problems that an existing tapping machine is lack of cooling of a tapping head and is lack of effective fixing of a metal piece.

title_en: Tripod processing tool
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a tripod processing jig which comprises a processing seat component with adjustable angles, a fixed end and a limiting component, wherein the fixed end is used for being inserted into a hollow tripod, the limiting component is arranged on the top surface of the fixed end of the processing seat component, the pressing end is telescopic and tightly presses the top surface of a tripod workpiece, the limiting component comprises a rotary driving component arranged on the top surface of the fixed end of the processing seat component, and a plurality of groups of pressing plate components which are arranged on the output end of the rotary driving component at intervals and are used for tightly pressing a plurality of sides of the top surface of the tripod are driven to stretch out and draw back through rotation of the rotary driving component.

title_en: Scrap guiding device of tapping machine
abstract_en: The application discloses a tapping machine scrap guiding device which comprises a mounting base, a collecting box and a fan, wherein a tapping machine body is arranged on the left side of the upper end of the mounting base, a workbench is arranged in the middle of the upper end of the mounting base, the collecting box is arranged on the outer side of the upper end of the mounting base and is positioned on the inner side of the lower end of the workbench, a box door is arranged on the outer side of the right end of the collecting box through a hinge, the fan is arranged in the left end of the collecting box, and a collecting cavity is formed in the collecting box. The application belongs to the technical field of collecting chips of tapping machines, and aims to solve the problems that in the prior art, the guiding and collecting efficiency of chips is low and the collected chips are complicated to clean. The novel dust collector has the advantages that the guide collection efficiency of the dust is improved conveniently, and the dust can be cleaned conveniently by opening the box door subsequently.

title_en: Folding electric saw protection cover
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of garden tools, and discloses a folding electric saw protection cover, which comprises an electric saw shell, wherein a track sheet is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the electric saw shell, one end of the track sheet extends out of the electric saw shell, the outer end of the track sheet is connected with a saw chain in a sliding manner, the outer end of the electric saw shell is rotationally connected with a mounting plate, one end of the mounting plate, which is far away from the electric saw shell, is provided with a protection plate, one end of the protection plate is fixedly connected with a connecting block, one end of the mounting plate, which is close to the protection plate, is provided with a connecting groove for the outer end of the connecting block to be inserted in, and the upper surface of the protection plate is provided with a containing groove.

title_en: Electric hair clipper head mechanism capable of freely adjusting force
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electric hair clipper head mechanism capable of freely adjusting force, which comprises a cutter head main body, wherein a fixed cutter holder is arranged on the cutter head main body, a first screw is connected with the inner thread of the fixed cutter holder, a lower cutter is fixedly connected with the lower surface of the fixed cutter holder, a movable cutter holder is arranged in the cutter head main body, a guide rail is arranged in the movable cutter holder, an upper cutter is fixedly connected with the lower end of the movable cutter holder, a second screw is connected with the inner thread of the cutter head main body, a main spring piece is arranged in the cutter head main body, pressure is applied to one end of a subsidiary spring piece through a pressure adjusting screw, one end of the subsidiary spring piece is propped against one side of the main spring piece, and one end of the main spring piece is propped against the guide rail of the movable cutter holder, so that the distance of the pressure adjusting screw can be adjusted to control the pressure on the main spring piece, the adhesion force between the upper cutter and the lower cutter is controlled, the influence on the shearing force after the pressure is reduced, and the experience of a user is improved.

title_en: Water-saving numerical control water cutting device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a water-saving numerical control water cutting device. The water cutting device comprises a water tank, a placing frame, a moving mechanism and a jet cutting head, wherein the placing frame is arranged in the water tank, the placing frame is used for placing materials to be cut, fixing mechanisms are detachably connected to the placing frame, at least two groups of fixing mechanisms are arranged on two corresponding sides of the components to be cut respectively, pressing components are connected to the fixing mechanisms and used for pressing the materials to be cut on the surface of the placing frame, the moving mechanism is connected to the edge of the water tank, the jet cutting head is located above the placing frame and connected to the driving end of the moving mechanism, the detachable fixing mechanisms are arranged on the placing frame, the pressing components are connected to the fixing mechanisms, and the cutting device can well fix the plates to be cut through the cooperation of the detachable fixing mechanisms and the pressing components, so that the flatness of the cutting surface of the plates is improved.

title_en: Adhesive sticker labeling residual material separating mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of self-adhesive labels and discloses a self-adhesive label residue separating mechanism which comprises a workbench, wherein a supporting leg is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the workbench, a discharging frame is fixedly arranged at the left side position of the rear end of the top of the workbench, a discharging rod is movably arranged at the front end of the discharging frame, a separating part is arranged on the right side of the discharging rod at the top of the workbench, the separating part comprises a screw frame fixedly arranged at the front end and the rear end of the top of the workbench, screws are fixedly arranged between the two groups of screw frames, a cutter plate is movably arranged on the surface of each screw, and the self-adhesive label after the residue is separated is conveniently collected through devices such as a mounting workbench, the discharging rod, a limiting rod, the cutter plate, a rotating ring, a cutter blade, an arc-shaped frame groove, a receiving frame and a receiving rotating rod.

title_en: Cloth cutting device is used in clothing processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cloth cutting device for clothes processing, which relates to the technical field of cutting equipment and comprises a supporting device, wherein the supporting device comprises a supporting table, a staff gauge is fixedly connected to the outer wall in front of the supporting table, a clamping assembly and a cutting assembly are arranged at the top of the supporting table, the clamping assembly comprises a connecting frame, the front connecting frame and the rear connecting frame are fixedly connected to the front outer wall and the rear outer wall of the supporting table, a pressing plate is enabled to move downwards to clamp cloth on an L-shaped bottom plate by starting a first electric push rod, the output end of the first electric push rod is enabled to rotate to drive a first screw rod to rotate by starting a first motor, the first screw rod is enabled to drive a first sliding block to move under the limiting action of a limiting rod, and accordingly the movable frame is driven to move above the supporting table, the distance of the movable frame is adjusted through the staff gauge, and the cutting length of the cloth is adjusted, so that the cloth is cut to be in a specified length.

title_en: High-strength laser machine tool body
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-strength laser machine body, which comprises a machine body, a separation bin and a chip collecting bin, wherein the separation bin is arranged in the machine body, one side of the separation bin is provided with a control motor, the output end of the control motor is fixedly connected with a screw rod, the surface of the screw rod is in threaded connection with a ball sliding sleeve, one side of the ball sliding sleeve is connected with a sliding block, the bottom of the sliding block is connected with a brush, both sides of the inside of the separation bin are respectively provided with a conveying opening, the conveying openings are communicated and connected with the chip collecting bin, a hydraulic cylinder is arranged on the chip collecting bin, and the output end of the hydraulic cylinder is fixedly connected with a pressing plate.

title_en: Synchronous processing device for double-head threads of U-shaped bolt of axle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a synchronous processing device for double-end threads of an axle U-shaped bolt, which relates to the technical field of double-end thread processing of the axle U-shaped bolt and comprises a double-end numerical control machine tool body, wherein a workbench is fixedly connected to the outer surface of the double-end numerical control machine tool body, one side of the workbench is provided with a multi-layer processing mechanism, the multi-layer processing mechanism is used for carrying out solid-liquid separation processing on a mixture of scraps and cooling liquid generated during synchronous processing of the double-end threads of the U-shaped bolt, and carrying out replacement processing on the separation structure in the solid-liquid separation processing.

title_en: Large shell turnover mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a large shell turnover mechanism which comprises a driving platform, wherein the driving platform is provided with a driving assembly, the driving assembly is provided with a long shaft, two ends of the long shaft are provided with guide flat keys which are axially distributed, the two guide flat keys are respectively provided with a transmission assembly in a sliding manner, a clamping assembly is connected to the transmission assembly which is far away from one side of the guide flat keys in a pivot manner, a transmission carrier plate of the transmission assembly is provided with an adjusting cylinder, the piston end of the adjusting cylinder is fixed on the driving platform through a connecting piece, the telescopic movement of the adjusting cylinder can drive the transmission assembly to move back and forth on the guide flat keys, the clamping assembly is provided with a fixed clamping end and a movable clamping end, and the movable clamping end moves up and down under the driving of the clamping cylinder. The clamping assembly is driven to turn over through the transmission assembly, meanwhile, the clamping assembly can clamp the product by driving the clamping cylinder, the structure is compact, and the requirements of production layout are met.

title_en: Reverse osmosis membrane gas tightness detection device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of reverse osmosis membrane air tightness detection, and discloses a reverse osmosis membrane air tightness detection device which comprises a workbench, wherein the front part of the top end of the workbench is fixedly connected with a base, the rear part of the top end of the workbench is provided with an air pump, the top end of the base is provided with a groove, the inner wall of the middle part of the groove is provided with a gear, the outer wall of the gear is in meshed connection with two racks, the front side of the rack is connected with the inner wall of the groove through a sliding component, one end of the rack, far away from the gear, is fixedly connected with a bottom block, the top of the bottom block is fixedly connected with a supporting block, and the top of the supporting block is fixedly connected with a top block. According to the device, the rack is pulled by the electric push rod, so that the bottom block, the top block and the clamping blocks are driven to move, two ends of the reverse osmosis membrane body can be clamped, clamping limit of reverse osmosis membrane bodies with different lengths is achieved, and adaptability of the device to reverse osmosis membranes with different specifications is effectively improved.

title_en: On-line atomization cooling device for stainless steel production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an atomization cooling device, belongs to the technical field of stainless steel production, and particularly relates to an online atomization cooling device for stainless steel production; according to the utility model, the cooling assembly is matched with the first water tank, the first spraying piece, the second water tank and the second spraying piece to simultaneously perform atomization cooling on two sides of stainless steel, so that the atomization cooling efficiency of the device is improved, the water pump is matched with the filter screen to filter and collect redundant sprayed water, the collected water is guided into the first water tank by the water pump to be used for a second time, the effect of saving water is achieved, the spacing assembly is matched with the fixing frame, the bidirectional screw rod, the threaded plate and the spacing column to adjust the distance between the two threaded plates, so that stainless steel with different widths is adapted, the spacing column is used for propping against two sides of the stainless steel, the stainless steel is ensured to be always parallel to the conveying belt in the moving process, the stainless steel is prevented from being deviated, and the atomization cooling effect is affected.

title_en: Metal tube forming auxiliary device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of metal tube forming, and mainly discloses a metal tube forming auxiliary device which comprises a lifting mechanism, wherein the lifting mechanism comprises a main body, the main body is arranged at the top of a moving mechanism, a rotating handle is arranged at the top of the main body, a sliding plate is arranged on one side of the main body, a workbench is arranged on one surface of the sliding plate, the rotating handle is connected with a screw rod, the rotating handle and the main body are fixed through a first bearing, a rotating mechanism is arranged at the top end of the workbench, the rotating mechanism comprises a turntable, an installation shaft is arranged at the central point of one side of the turntable, the bottom end of the installation shaft is vertically arranged at one side of a gear, a rack is arranged at one side of the first support frame, a sliding groove is arranged at the other side of the rack, the moving mechanism comprises a base, and rotating pulleys are arranged at four corners of the bottom of the base. The rotary table is simple in structure and convenient to move, the upper and lower positions of the workbench are adjusted by rotating the rotary handle, and the rotary mechanism arranged on the workbench is pumped to enable the turntable to perform rotary motion.

title_en: Plastic shell surface polishing device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of plastic processing, and particularly relates to a plastic shell surface polishing device which comprises an operation table, wherein a chute is formed in the operation table, a polishing device is arranged on the outer wall of the operation table, a plastic part is arranged right below the polishing device, a clamping device is arranged on the operation table and comprises a motor, the output end of the motor is fixedly connected with a bidirectional screw rod, and a thread block is penetrated by the bidirectional screw rod and is in threaded connection with the bidirectional screw rod. This plastic shell surface polishing device, through motor drive bi-directional screw rod, a series of transmission structures of cooperation, like articulated rod, sliding block, sliding plate etc. realized the diversified stable centre gripping to the working of plastics, not only have the clamp plate to push down the working of plastics from the top, but also the clamp lever carries out the centre gripping from the side, can prevent effectively that displacement or rocking take place at the in-process working of plastics of polishing to guaranteed the quality and the precision of polishing, improved production efficiency and product qualification rate.

title_en: Angle welding machine with guider
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of metal processing, in particular to a fillet welding machine with a guiding device, which solves the problems that the fillet welding machine is easy to deviate from a preset track due to the influence of external factors in the moving process, the welding efficiency is reduced, and the quality defect of a welding joint is possibly caused due to the occurrence of the deviation phenomenon. The angle welder with the guide device comprises a guide table, the angle welder and a driving box, wherein two guide plates are arranged on one side of the top of the guide table, the bottom of the angle welder is connected with a guide base, and guide wheels matched with the guide plates are rotatably connected to two sides of the guide base. The guide plate on the guide table and the guide wheel on the guide base are matched with each other to form a stable guide system, and the system ensures that the fillet welding machine can stably and accurately move along a preset track in the welding process.

title_en: Polishing and grinding device for butterfly check valve body
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a polishing and grinding device for a butterfly check valve body, which relates to the technical field of butterfly check valve production and comprises a base, wherein the outer wall of the base is fixedly connected with a fixing structure, a polishing structure and a cleaning structure, the fixing structure comprises a hydraulic rod, the outer wall of the hydraulic rod is fixedly connected with the outer wall of the base, the outer wall of a piston rod of the hydraulic rod is fixedly connected with a fixing disc, the outer wall of the fixing disc is rotationally connected with a connecting rod, the outer wall of the connecting rod is rotationally connected with a fixing block, the outer wall of the fixing block is slidingly connected with a fixing frame, the fixing structure is driven by the hydraulic rod, and the butterfly check valve bodies with different sizes can be tightly attached by matching with the linkage design of an arc-shaped fixing block and the fixing frame, so that firm fixing is realized, the valve body displacement is effectively prevented in the grinding process, the grinding precision is ensured, the operation is simple and the machining error caused by unstable fixing is reduced.

title_en: Sputtering target polishing clamp
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sputtering target polishing clamp, which comprises a workbench and further comprises a fixing assembly arranged on the workbench and used for fixing a sputtering target in the grinding process, wherein the fixing assembly comprises a bottom plate fixedly connected to the workbench, the bottom plate is connected with fixing cylinders through a plurality of connecting columns, each fixing cylinder is provided with a positioning assembly used for positioning the sputtering target, the side wall of each fixing cylinder is provided with a plurality of arc clamping plates, and each fixing cylinder is provided with a driving assembly used for driving each arc clamping plate. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the fixing component, the sputtering target material with poor magnetism is clamped and fixed, and meanwhile, the multi-point clamping of the sputtering target material is formed, so that the clamping force is uniformly distributed on the circumferential surface of the sputtering target material, and the risk of clamping deformation of the sputtering target material caused by stress concentration is reduced.

title_en: Be used for water and electricity piping setting-out appurtenance
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an auxiliary tool for drawing lines of hydropower distribution pipes, which comprises a die, a T-shaped horizontal device and a handle. The mould is a rectangular steel plate, four corners are processed into small round corners, a plurality of hollowed-out drawing line auxiliary patterns are engraved in the middle, and the mould mainly comprises three long scribing lines and four short scribing lines, wherein the three long scribing lines and the four short scribing lines have the same diameter, the same circle center and the same horizontal line, are parallel to each other in the same width shape, and have the small round corners at the two ends; the T-shaped horizontal device consists of a transverse bubble tube and a vertical bubble tube and is fixed on the die, the handle is a fold line type handle, and one end of the handle is fixed on the die. The utility model has the beneficial effects of solving the problems of low line drawing speed, low efficiency and the like of the hydropower distribution pipe. The material is convenient to obtain, the cost is low, the manufacturing is simple, the turnover use can be repeated, the popularization in the field of building construction hydropower installation is facilitated, the cost can be effectively reduced, and the production efficiency is improved.

title_en: Moment of torsion box processing frock
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a torque box processing tool which comprises a rotary connecting beam, wherein the middle part of the top surface of the rotary connecting beam is movably connected with a horizontal rotating plate through a hinge shaft, the middle part of the top surface of the horizontal rotating plate is fixedly provided with a vertical fixing connecting plate, the top surface of the vertical fixing connecting plate is fixedly provided with a top horizontal connecting plate, the middle part of the front part is fixedly provided with two vertical plates extending up and down, the top of each vertical plate is fixedly arranged on the bottom surface of the top horizontal connecting plate, the bottom of each vertical plate is fixedly arranged on the top surface of the horizontal rotating plate, the two left torque boxes and the two right torque boxes can be clamped at one time, the front surfaces of the left torque boxes and the right torque boxes at the two front parts can be processed at one time, meanwhile, the back surfaces of the left torque boxes and the right torque boxes at the upper part can be processed at one time, the processing efficiency is greatly improved, and the loading and unloading times are reduced.

title_en: Angle steel unloading storage rack and angle steel cutting device with same
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an angle steel blanking storage rack and an angle steel cutting device with the same, comprising a supporting base and a supporting table fixed on the supporting base, wherein the supporting table comprises a plurality of supporting angle steels which are arranged in the same length direction, the supporting angle steels extend along the length direction of the supporting base, a containing groove is formed between two adjacent supporting angle steels in a connecting mode, the supporting base comprises a front end and a tail end which are connected, two ends of the supporting angle steels are connected with the front end and the tail end respectively, and a limiting piece is arranged at one end, close to the tail end, of the supporting angle steel, and extends along the width direction of the supporting angle steel. The utility model solves the problem that the leftover materials are difficult to utilize after the angle steel section is cut, realizes the reutilization of resources, has better economical practicability, reduces the economic cost of enterprises and reduces the resource waste.

title_en: Copper-clad plate brushing and grinding equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of brushing equipment and discloses copper-clad plate brushing equipment, which comprises a box body, wherein openings are formed in two sides of the box body, one side of the opening is provided with a roller conveying mechanism, the other side of the opening is provided with a discharging mechanism, a conveying assembly is arranged in the box body, the conveying assembly comprises a plurality of driving rollers, the driving rollers are all rotatably arranged in the box body, a rotary driving device is arranged on one side of the box body and is used for driving the driving rollers to rotate, and two brushing pieces are arranged, so that two surfaces of a copper-clad plate can be continuously cleaned without turning.

title_en: Auxiliary machine for feeding of punching machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a feeding auxiliary machine of a punching machine, which comprises a feeding trolley and a V-shaped material bearing platform, wherein a supporting plate is arranged on one side of the V-shaped material bearing platform, rotating shafts are arranged on two sides of the V-shaped material bearing platform, a hinge rod is hinged to the outer wall of the rotating shaft, a sliding plate is connected to the inner wall of the hinge rod in a sliding manner, two sliding plates are connected through a positioning rod, a spring is arranged on the inner wall of the rotating shaft, one end of the spring is connected with the sliding plate, a sliding frame is connected to the outer wall of the hinge rod in a sliding manner, a mounting plate is arranged on the sliding frame, a laser locator is arranged on the mounting plate, the position of the V-shaped material bearing platform can be positioned according to the size of a coiled material, and the sliding frame, the mounting plate and the laser locator are matched with the corresponding positions of the center of the coiled material frame, so that the device can conveniently position the coiled material, push the coiled material to the outer side of a coiling drum, and accurately position the coiled material.

title_en: Clamp for numerical control machine tool
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of machine tool equipment and discloses a fixture for a numerical control machine tool, which comprises a platform, wherein an adjusting device is arranged in the platform, an electric push rod I and an electric push rod II are respectively fixed on the adjusting device, a fixing box is fixed at the upper end of the electric push rod I, a rotating device I is fixed at one side of the inside of the fixing box, a rotating device II is fixed at the upper end of the electric push rod II, and clamping devices are arranged in the rotating device I and the rotating device II.

title_en: Straightening device for billet continuous casting machine
abstract_en: The application relates to a straightening device for a square billet continuous casting machine, which belongs to the technical field of straightening equipment of the square billet continuous casting machine, and comprises a continuous casting machine, a straightening table and a collecting table, wherein a discharge hole of the continuous casting machine, the straightening table and the collecting table are connected smoothly, a plurality of transmission rollers are rotationally arranged on the straightening table, a plurality of bearing brackets are fixed on the transmission rollers at intervals, a straightener is arranged between two adjacent transmission rollers, the straightener comprises a clamping plate and an auxiliary clamping plate, the clamping plate and the auxiliary clamping plate can clamp and correct the periphery of a square billet, and a sliding component for driving the clamping plate to move and a rotating component related to the sliding component are arranged in the straightening table.

title_en: Automatic change punch press
abstract_en: The utility model provides an automatic punching machine, which comprises a punching machine body, a driving assembly, a rotary transmission assembly, a guiding assembly, a punching assembly, a conveying assembly and a limiting assembly, the utility model realizes the conveying of materials through the cooperative work among a rotary motor I, a conveying roller and a supporting roller, saves the loading and unloading time without manually loading the products, increases the production efficiency, through setting up movable support, realized leading the product transverse direction, effectually prevent that this product from taking place the skew when carrying, guaranteed the conveying precision of this product to guarantee the die-cut precision of this product, fix the lower mould through setting up the fixed block, prevent that this lower mould from vibrating when carrying out die-cutting to the product, thereby increased the die-cut quality of finished product.

title_en: Transition device for installing hot pressing stopper
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a transition device for installing a hot-pressing stopper, which comprises a main body assembly and a transition assembly, wherein the transition assembly comprises a limiting block, a supporting plate, supporting blocks, a stop block, a transition bracket, a clamping plate and a clamping groove, the limiting block is fixedly connected to two sides of the upper end of a bottom plate, the supporting plate is fixedly connected to two sides of the upper end of the bottom plate, the supporting blocks are fixedly connected to the upper end of the supporting plate, the stop block is fixedly connected to two ends of the bottom plate, and the transition bracket is fixedly connected to the outer end of the stop block. The stopper is arranged at the upper end of the stop block and inside the stop block respectively, the stopper can be kept at two sides of the upper end of the bottom plate under the limit of the stop block, the stop block and the transition bracket, and the clamping plate is clamped on the supporting frame of the rolling machine through the clamping groove, so that the transition bracket can be fixed on the rolling machine, and the original stopper can be installed on the rolling machine of a new hot-pressing line under the condition of not manufacturing the new stopper.

title_en: Triaxial sensor receives sense portion assembly fixture
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a triaxial sensor sensing part assembly tool, belongs to the technical field of piezoelectric sensors, and solves the problems of high assembly difficulty and low assembly precision of the existing triaxial sensor sensing part. According to the utility model, the assembly efficiency and the assembly precision are improved, three positioning through grooves on the positioning clamp can be sequentially fixed on the horizontal mounting surface through the rotating disc and the limiting piece, the sequential assembly of the triaxial parts of the sensing part of the triaxial sensor is realized, and the three mutually perpendicular positioning through grooves ensure the fitting degree among the piezoelectric ceramics, the conducting strip and the mass block and the coaxiality with the mounting surface of the base, so that the three-axis sensor has the characteristics of high assembly precision, high efficiency and low cost, and is particularly suitable for small-batch production.

title_en: Pressure sensitive adhesive separating and cutting machine with cutter cleaning device
abstract_en: The application provides a self-adhesive slitting machine with a cutter cleaning device, which comprises a platform, wherein a vertical plate is fixedly connected to the front side and the rear side of the upper end surface of the platform, a locking device is arranged on the left side of the front end surface of the vertical plate on the rear side, a paper roll is fixedly connected to the front side of the locking device, a tightening roller is fixedly connected to the middle parts of the front and rear vertical plates, a slitting roller is movably connected to the middle parts of the right side of the front and rear vertical plates, a slitting knife is uniformly and fixedly connected to the outer wall of the slitting roller, a bearing roller is fixedly connected to the middle parts of the right side of the front and rear vertical plates, a fixing plate is arranged on the right side of the slitting roller, cleaning cotton is uniformly and fixedly connected to the upper end surface of the fixing plate, a drip tube is uniformly arranged on the upper part of the cleaning cotton, a fixing rod is fixedly connected between the adjacent drip tubes, a plugging plug is arranged in an inner cavity of the drip tube, and a lifting device is arranged on the front end surface of the vertical plate.

title_en: Tool
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of nuclear power equipment dismounting tools, in particular to a tool for dismounting a reactor core detector assembly and a cable assembly, which comprises an opening head, wherein the opening head comprises a head main body, a first end face of the head main body is vertically and convexly provided with two protruding blocks, the two protruding blocks and the head main body jointly enclose into a semi-closed open slot, the width of each protruding block is smaller than a first threshold, the width direction of each protruding block is the direction in which the two protruding blocks are close to each other, and the first threshold is the minimum distance between the threaded fastening parts of two adjacent reactor core detector assemblies or cable assemblies.

title_en: Buffer device for preventing steel head from ejecting
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a buffer device for preventing steel heads from being ejected, which is arranged at a hot saw blanking opening and comprises lateral fixing plates, a rotating shaft, connecting plates and buffer pieces, wherein the two lateral fixing plates are arranged at two sides of the hot saw blanking opening, the top edge of each lateral fixing plate is provided with a mounting position, the bottom end of each mounting position is an arc surface, the two ends of each rotating shaft are respectively inserted into the mounting position, the top ends of the connecting plates are provided with butt joint holes, the rotating shaft penetrates through the butt joint holes of a plurality of connecting plates, so that the rotating shaft is rotatably connected with the connecting plates, the bottom ends of the connecting plates are provided with jogged positions, the top edge of each buffer piece is embedded into the jogged positions of the two connecting plates, the buffer pieces are fixedly connected with the connecting plates, and the buffer pieces are positioned outside the hot saw blanking opening and cover the hot saw blanking opening.
