The utility model greatly reduces the number of steel head catapulting, leads the steel heads to completely enter the collecting hopper, and effectively reduces the production safety risk.

title_en: Punching equipment for manufacturing power electronic components
abstract_en: The utility model discloses punching equipment for manufacturing power electronic components, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein the top end of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a guide rail, the top of the guide rail is connected with a sliding block in a sliding manner, the top end of the sliding block is fixedly connected with a moving plate, the top end of the moving plate is fixedly connected with a first swivel mount, the interior of the first swivel mount is rotationally connected with an electric push rod, one side of the electric push rod, which is far away from the first swivel mount, is rotationally connected with a second swivel mount, and one side of the second swivel mount, which is far away from the electric push rod, is fixedly connected with a connecting frame. According to the utility model, the electric push rod is started, the output rod of the electric push rod pushes the movable plate to move, and the movable plate slides on the surface of the guide rail through the sliding block, so that the movable plate drives the electronic components to move forwards and backwards, the punching position is adjusted, and the second swivel mount and the first swivel mount are respectively arranged on the connecting frame and the movable plate, so that the rotation of the electric push rod during working is adapted, and the movement interference is avoided.

title_en: Battery pole piece punching machine
abstract_en: The utility model provides a battery pole piece punching machine, which relates to the technical field of punching machines and comprises a supporting seat and a hydraulic telescopic cylinder, wherein an upper frame is arranged on the upper end face of the supporting seat, the hydraulic telescopic cylinder is arranged in the middle of the upper frame, an upper connecting block is fixed at the lower end of the hydraulic telescopic cylinder, an upper lifting plate is fixed at the lower end of the upper connecting block, a male die is arranged at the lower end of the upper lifting plate, a punching block is arranged at the lower end of the male die, a lower template is arranged on the upper end face of the supporting seat, a lower base plate is arranged at the upper end of the lower base plate, a female die is arranged at the upper end face of the female die, a plurality of groups of punching grooves are formed in the upper end face of the female die, supporting legs are arranged on the left side and the right side of the lower end face of the supporting seat, and the lower ends of the supporting legs are fixed on a base. The utility model is convenient to position and accurately punch the battery pole piece, and can rapidly push the battery pole piece into the collecting box after punching, so that workpieces can be intensively loaded, and the battery pole piece can be conveniently moved in and out, thereby being more efficient, convenient and trouble-saving.

title_en: Device for quickly replacing side handles and electric tool thereof
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a device for quickly replacing a side handle and an electric tool thereof, belonging to the technical field of electric tools; the electric tool comprises a side handle shaft, a first clamping block is fixedly connected to the side handle shaft, a second clamping block is arranged on the sliding sleeve, fastening structures are arranged at the bottoms of the first clamping block and the second clamping block, the fastening structures are connected and locked with the electric tool through the first clamping block and the second clamping block, an elastic structure used for enabling the second clamping block to be close to the first clamping block is arranged on the side handle shaft, a clamping structure used for locking the second clamping block is arranged between the second clamping block and the side handle shaft, the fastening structures are arranged at the bottoms of the first clamping block and the second clamping block, the first clamping block and the second clamping block are connected and fastened with the electric tool through the clamping structure, the second clamping block is locked with the side handle shaft, and the first clamping block is fixed on the side handle shaft and can be firmly connected with the electric tool, and is not easy to loosen.

title_en: Whole-disc plastic cup cutting device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a whole-disc plastic cup cutting device which comprises a mounting seat, a clamping mechanism, a cutter and a driving mechanism, wherein a placing plate is arranged on one side of the mounting seat and used for accommodating a whole disc of plastic cups after cutting, the clamping mechanism is arranged at the top of the mounting seat and can clamp the whole disc of plastic cups, a sliding rail is arranged on the mounting seat, the cutter is in sliding connection with the sliding rail, and the driving mechanism drives the cutter to slide on the sliding rail. The whole-disc plastic cup cutting device can clamp and cut plastic sheets of plastic cups processed by a plastic cup forming machine to obtain whole-disc plastic cups, stacks the cut whole-disc plastic cups into a placing plate, and is convenient for cutting the whole-disc plastic cups one by one to obtain single plastic cups, and belongs to the technical field of plastic cup processing.

title_en: Dust removing equipment for cutting bamboo boards
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of bamboo board cutting dust removing equipment, in particular to dust removing equipment for bamboo board cutting, which comprises a base, wherein a through groove is formed in the base in a penetrating manner, a first motor is fixedly embedded in the base, the output end of the first motor extends into the through groove and is fixedly connected with a cutting blade, a support is fixedly arranged at the top end of the front side of the base, a shell is slidably arranged between vertical parts of the support, baffles are slidably embedded at two sides of the shell, fixing seats are fixedly arranged at the bottom ends of the baffles, compression rollers are rotatably arranged in the lower parts of the fixing seats, a dust box is fixedly arranged at the rear side of the support, a dust extractor is fixedly arranged at the top end of the front side of the dust box, and a dust extraction pipe is fixedly connected with the input end of the dust extractor.

title_en: Control circuit and control device for preventing welding machine from generating impact current
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a control circuit and a control device for preventing a welding machine from generating impact current, and particularly relates to the technical field of electromechanical products, wherein the control circuit comprises a first node for receiving welding feedback current, a second node connected with a given input end of a PI circuit of the welding machine, a welding current feedback unit, an arcing current control unit and a PI voltage control unit, wherein a first connecting end of the welding current feedback unit is connected with the first node, a second connecting end of the welding current feedback unit is connected with a first connecting end of the arcing current control unit, and a third connecting end of the welding current feedback unit is connected with a first connecting end of the PI voltage control unit; the second connecting end of the arcing current control unit is connected with the second node and the second connecting end of the PI voltage control unit, and the third connecting end of the arcing current control unit is connected with the input end of the working voltage.

title_en: Continuous processing equipment for corner connecting piece of iron tee joint of electrical cabinet
abstract_en: The utility model discloses continuous processing equipment for corner connectors of an iron tee joint of an electrical cabinet, which comprises a processing machine group, a feeding assembly and a conveying assembly, wherein the processing machine group is formed by a plurality of multi-shaft drilling machines which are arranged side by side according to the sequence of working procedures, the multi-shaft drilling machines are provided with a machine table, two lifting drill bits are arranged at the top of the machine table, a processing channel is arranged between the two lifting drill bits, the feeding assembly is arranged at the upstream end of the processing machine group, the conveying assembly is arranged in the processing channel and is used for sequentially conveying workpieces to corresponding processing stations, a plurality of groups of multi-shaft drilling machines are arranged side by side according to the sequence of corresponding working procedures, the feeding assembly capable of realizing automatic discharging is adopted for feeding, the conveying assembly capable of realizing automatic conveying function is adopted for sequentially processing the workpieces through the multi-shaft drilling machines, the aim of automation is achieved, and the processing efficiency is improved.

title_en: General type compresses tightly tool
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a general type compression jig which comprises a jig body for positioning products, a mounting beam arranged along the length direction of the jig body and positioned above the jig body, and a plurality of compression modules which are vertically movably arranged on the mounting beam and used for compressing the products, wherein the jig body is provided with a plurality of positioning holes and threaded holes, and a first positioning pin is selectively arranged in part of the positioning holes and/or a first screw is selectively arranged in part of the threaded holes so as to position the products with different sizes, and the number of the compression modules is increased or reduced to enable the arrangement layout of the compression modules to be correspondingly arranged with the products so as to compress the products with different sizes. The utility model can realize the positioning and compaction of products with different sizes and has higher universality.

title_en: Grinding device of magnesium oxysulfate board
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of magnesium oxysulfide plate production, in particular to a polishing device for a magnesium oxysulfide plate, aiming at the problems that in the prior art, in the process of producing and polishing the magnesium oxysulfide plate, workers are often required to manually take and polish, the working efficiency is low, and the safety is low, the polishing device comprises a base; the polishing device comprises a base, a support frame, a polishing plate and a control panel, wherein the support frame is fixedly connected to the top of the base, the polishing plate is fixedly connected in the support frame, the magnesium oxysulfide plate is placed on the base and moves by pulling the control panel, the control panel can assist the contact panel to be matched with the auxiliary panel to fix the magnesium oxysulfide plate, meanwhile, the auxiliary vertical panel is connected with a U-shaped plate, the electric push rod is controlled to work at the moment, the electric push rod controls the vertical panel to move, and the magnesium oxysulfide plate is driven to contact with the bottom of the polishing plate, so that an automatic polishing effect is achieved.

title_en: Pretreatment device for surface mirror processing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of clock surface processing, in particular to a pretreatment device for watch and mirror processing, wherein the upper end of a movable frame is connected with a supporting table in a sliding way, one side of the upper end of the supporting table is connected with a limit frame, the upper end of the supporting table is fixedly connected with a mounting plate, the upper end fixedly connected with electric telescopic handle of mounting panel, electric telescopic handle's flexible end passes the mounting panel to fixedly connected with clamp plate, the four corners position department of mounting panel all is connected with electric vacuum chuck ware. According to the utility model, the pressing plate is driven to move downwards for a set distance after the electric telescopic rod is electrified and started, the pressing plate drives the electric vacuum chuck devices to move downwards for a set distance, the electric vacuum chuck devices are contacted with the upper surface of the clock mirror, the clock mirror is adsorbed and fixed after the electric vacuum chuck devices are started, and the clock mirror is fixed and limited under the cooperation of the limiting frame, so that the clock mirror cannot slide in the processing process.

title_en: Deep hole drill device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a deep hole drilling and expanding integrated deep hole drill body, a two-stage cutter bar and a cutter holder, wherein the deep hole drilling and expanding integrated deep hole drill body comprises a centering drill (4), a cutter blade (7) and a cutter body (10), deep holes are drilled and expanded in a fusion mode that the centering drill and four polygonal cutter blades are staggered relatively, and a ductile iron integrated casting cutter holder with excellent shock resistance is adopted. The problem of metal work piece deep hole, large-scale drill bit and vibrations too big and produce the tolerance out of tolerance and lead to the part to scrap is solved in the large aperture course of working. The precision of the deep holes of the metal parts is guaranteed, and in the process of machining metal workpieces with different deep holes, the two-stage cutter bar is creatively designed, so that the problems of repeated disassembly and assembly of cutters and cutter bars are solved. The deep hole drill device has the advantages of high stability, simplicity in operation and good shock resistance. The processing range is wide, and the applicability is strong.

title_en: Gondola water faucet processing polisher
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a shower processing and polishing machine, which belongs to the technical field of shower processing and comprises a fixing frame, wherein a first driving motor is fixedly arranged at the right end of the upper side of the fixing frame, a first threaded rod is fixedly connected with the output end of the first driving motor, two moving blocks are connected with the outer side of the first threaded rod in a threaded manner, a first sliding rod is sleeved on the inner wall of the upper side of the moving blocks in a sliding manner, a connecting rod is sleeved on the lower side of the moving blocks in a rotating manner, a connecting frame is sleeved on the lower side of the connecting rod in a rotating manner, a second driving motor is fixedly arranged on the upper side of the connecting frame, and a polishing disc is fixedly connected with the output end of the second driving motor. This gondola water faucet processing polisher, through clamping device to the gondola water faucet centre gripping of different models, the polishing dish aligns gondola water faucet surface and polishes the processing, and the dust of production can be absorbed by dust absorption fan and adsorb on the surface of dust screen, the later stage of being convenient for unifies the processing.

title_en: Wire shearing device for single chip microcomputer chip production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of wire shearing for chip production and discloses a wire shearing device for single-chip microcomputer chip production, which comprises a workbench, a wire shearing device and a wire shearing device, wherein the workbench is used for supporting wires for single-chip microcomputer chip production during shearing; according to the utility model, through the matching of the threaded rod and the limiting plate, the quick installation and positioning of the wire winding drum are realized, and a user can drive the limiting plate to slide on the chute through the threaded connection only by simply screwing the threaded rod, so that the winding drum is stably limited, the installation flow is simplified, the working efficiency is improved, the subsequent winding drum replacement operation is also convenient, in addition, the user can easily realize the pulling and fixing of the wire through the linkage mechanism of the pedal, the connecting rod, the wedge block, the sliding column and the circular gear, and the support column can be automatically reset and fixed after the pedal is loosened after the wire is pulled to the required length, so that the stability and the accuracy of the wire before cutting are ensured, and the cutting efficiency and the accuracy of the wire are greatly improved.

title_en: Welded pipe support
abstract_en: The application discloses a welded pipe support, which belongs to the technical field of welded pipe supports and comprises two bases, a fixed seat fixedly arranged on the bases, a movable seat which is connected with the bases in a sliding manner and is far away from one end of the fixed seat, a driving mechanism which is arranged on the bases and is used for enabling the movable seat to move close to or far away from the fixed seat, a fixed wheel and a movable wheel which are respectively connected with the fixed seat and the movable seat in a rotating manner and are used for clamping pipes, a rotating motor fixedly arranged on the fixed seat and used for driving the fixed wheel to rotate, and rubber sleeves respectively fixedly sleeved on the outer sides of the fixed wheel and the movable wheel. This welded tube support rubber has increased the contact area and the frictional force with the body through setting up anti-skidding groove, has ensured welded tube support to the powerful holding power and the stability of body, and the kind design has reduced the risk that the body that leads to because of the exogenic action in processing or transportation slides or shifts to holistic security and reliability have been improved.

title_en: Hardware bending device for hardware production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hardware bending device for hardware production, which comprises a frame body, a processing table, a shaping assembly, a pressing assembly and a grid blocking piece, wherein the processing table is provided with an auxiliary assembly, the shaping assembly comprises an L-shaped support fixedly arranged on the outer wall of the processing table, a swinging plate is arranged at the top of the L-shaped support, the swinging plate and the L-shaped support are rotatably arranged through bearings, the shaping assembly comprises a sleeve fixedly arranged in the middle of the processing table, and the shaping mold is provided with the grid blocking piece for blocking reinforcing steel bars. Through setting up subassembly and design subassembly exert pressure, utilize the conical advantage in design mould top, cooperate its lift regulatory function, can buckle the operation to the type of bending of multiple difference, utilize this mode, the staff need not frequently to change the design mould, still reduced the work degree of difficulty of staff when improving whole machining efficiency, in addition, through setting up the check and keep off the piece on the design mould, can intercept and stabilize the reinforcing bar in the folding process.

title_en: Manufacturing auxiliary device of aluminum coiled tube type heat exchanger
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an auxiliary device for manufacturing an aluminum coiled tube heat exchanger, and belongs to the technical field of heat exchanger manufacturing tools. The device provided by the utility model comprises a manufacturing platform, an automatic pipe feeding machine, two turntables, a central cylinder and a track. Each turntable is fixedly arranged on the manufacturing platform through a roller frame, the central cylinder is horizontally arranged between the two turntables, two ends of the central cylinder are respectively fixedly connected with the turntables through clamps, and the central axis of the central cylinder and the central point of the turntables are at the same horizontal height. The automatic pipe feeder is arranged on one side of the manufacturing platform and is in sliding connection with the rail. An automatic lifter is arranged on the automatic pipe feeder. The operator can flexibly adjust the conveying speed of the aluminum pipe through the automatic lifter and the automatic pipe conveying machine, and ensure that the aluminum pipe is tightly attached to the central cylinder or the upper layer of aluminum pipe, thereby improving the flatness and the gap precision of the coiled pipe. Meanwhile, the automatic pipe feeding machine can move left and right along with operators, so that the convenience and efficiency of pipe winding work are further improved.

title_en: Fixing device is used in pull rod production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of pull rod production, in particular to a fixing device for pull rod production, which comprises a working box, a fixing disc is arranged on one side of the working box, a clamping mechanism is arranged at one end of the fixing disc, the clamping mechanism comprises a driving disc rotationally connected to the inner wall of the fixing disc, clamping frames which are distributed annularly are slidingly connected to the inner wall of the driving disc, the surfaces of the clamping frames are slidingly connected to the inner wall of the fixing disc, the three clamping frames are mutually close and clamp a pull rod through a servo motor, a first gear, a second gear and the driving disc, and the clamping force of the pull rod is uniform through a rubber block, a sliding frame and a one-way air outlet pipe.

title_en: Assembling jig of automatic assembling equipment for lighter head
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an assembling jig of automatic assembling equipment of a lighter head, which comprises a supporting seat, wherein a jig lug is arranged above the supporting seat, a positioning convex part is arranged in the middle of the upper part of the jig lug, a limiting guide post is arranged in the jig lug, two ends of the limiting guide post are respectively provided with a sliding block mounting seat and a connecting block, a cushion block piece, a positioning sliding block and a compacting block are respectively arranged above the sliding block mounting seat, meanwhile, a pressing head part arranged at the inner end of the positioning sliding block is inserted into the lighter head, a top block is arranged above the positioning convex part, a stripping spring and a guide rod piece are respectively arranged in the positioning convex part, the jig lug and the supporting seat, and a T-shaped positioning column and a supporting plate are respectively arranged below the guide rod piece.

title_en: Cutting clamp
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cutting clamp, which relates to the technical field of cutting machine tools and comprises a fixed clamp, a fixed seat and a receiving table, wherein the fixed clamp is rotationally connected with the fixed seat, the fixed clamp comprises an upper clamp and a lower clamp, the upper clamp is used for being connected with the lower clamp, the upper clamp and the lower clamp are used for clamping a workpiece together, the receiving table is connected to the lower clamp and is used for being placed below a clamping surface of the lower clamp, the receiving table can receive cutting, the fixed clamp can rotate relative to the fixed seat to drive one end of the workpiece which is not cut to turn to a cutting device, the working efficiency is improved, the receiving table can receive cutting fluid flowing down in the cutting process, the cutting fluid is prevented from directly flowing to the ground to cause wet and slippery ground of a processing field, and the working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Laser welding workstation
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a laser welding workstation, and belongs to the field of automobile welding. The laser welding workstation comprises a clamp, a rotating mechanism, a clamping assembly and a welding mechanism, wherein the clamp is used for fixing a white car body, the rotating mechanism is rotatably arranged on the ground, the rotating axis of the rotating mechanism is parallel to the gravity direction, the clamping assembly is arranged on the rotating mechanism and used for releasably clamping the clamp, the welding mechanism is arranged on one side of the rotating mechanism, the clamping assembly is provided with a first position located between the rotating axis and the welding mechanism and a second position located on one side of the rotating axis away from the welding mechanism, and the rotating mechanism is used for driving the clamping assembly to switch between the first position and the second position.

title_en: Grinding head with diameter larger than diameter of wafer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a grinding head with the diameter larger than that of a wafer, which comprises a swing arm and a grinding head, wherein the diameter of the grinding head is larger than that of the wafer, an infusion device is arranged on or in the swing arm, the infusion device is communicated with the grinding head, and a plurality of liquid guide tanks are arranged at the bottom of the grinding head. By the design of the structure, the defect of the existence of an untrimmed area is eliminated by adopting the grinding head with the super wafer size (the diameter of the grinding head is larger than that of the wafer). As shown in fig. 1, the use area of the wafer is always located in the dressing range of the grinding head, and when the diameter of the grinding head reaches 1.2-1.5 times of the diameter of the wafer, the surface of the grinding pad (the use area of the wafer) can be ensured to achieve 100% dressing coverage no matter how the swing amplitude and the swing frequency are regulated, so that the periodic non-dressed area is completely eliminated. And continuously conveying cleaning or polishing liquid to the grinding head through the infusion device, continuously supplying liquid to the contact surface of the grinding head and the grinding pad and the area except the contact surface, and flushing to remove residual pollutants.

title_en: Dynamic balance plug screw installation device
abstract_en: A dynamic balance screw plug installation device. When the rotor performs on-line dynamic balance, the dynamic balance screw plug is often required to be installed on the rotor through a manhole or a corresponding window after the stand-by group is cooled, and the conventional installation method is time-consuming and labor-consuming, consumes manpower and seriously affects the working efficiency. The utility model relates to a dynamic balance screw plug, which comprises a support rod and a sliding sleeve, wherein the sliding sleeve is in sliding fit with the support rod, two groups of connecting rod groups penetrate through the sliding sleeve and are connected with the sliding sleeve through bolts, the sliding sleeve comprises a square ring sleeve, two sides of the square ring sleeve are respectively fixed with a fixed plate, and the upper side and the lower side of the fixed plate are respectively provided with a notch for the connecting rod groups to penetrate through.

title_en: Vertical roll forming machine for steel shell
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a vertical rolling machine for a steel shell, which comprises a frame, wherein a motor is arranged on the back of the frame, the motor is connected with a main shaft through a transmission component, the top end of the main shaft is fixedly connected with a workpiece seat, the steel shell is provided with a vertical rolling machine, a seamless steel pipe is sleeved on the workpiece seat, a motor and a first hydraulic motor are started, a secondary cylinder and a translation cylinder are started again to adjust the positions of a large airplane seat and a small airplane seat, so that a rolling wheel on a rolling shaft in the small airplane seat is contacted with the top of the seamless steel pipe, the top of the seamless steel pipe is subjected to profiling and closing, then the position of the rolling wheel is continuously adjusted to carry out spinning plane, rough spinning and fine spinning on the seamless steel pipe, after the subsequent cutting work is completed, a hydraulic rod is started, a second hydraulic motor is started, the rolling mould is close to the seamless steel pipe after the cutting section, the formed steel pipe is taken down, and new seamless steel pipe is assembled for continuous production.

title_en: Quick replacement mechanism for auxiliary materials of liquid crystal display
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a quick replacement mechanism for auxiliary materials of a liquid crystal display, and aims to solve the problems that a traditional Teflon disc replacement process is tedious and time-consuming. The mechanism comprises an assembly ring, a first magnet, a disassembly cap and a second magnet. The first magnet is fixed on the Teflon disc and is positioned at the center of the assembling ring. The disassembly cap is cylindrical, one side is an assembly surface, a bump matched with the groove is circularly arranged on the assembly surface in a surrounding mode, and a second magnet is assembled. The magnetic poles of the outer side faces of the first magnet and the second magnet are opposite, and quick positioning is achieved. The detachable cap is provided with anti-skid patterns, so that the operation is convenient. The grooves and the convex blocks are uniformly arranged in a surrounding mode at equal intervals, and stable connection is guaranteed. The teflon disc is also provided with an annular groove and an observation hole, so that the teflon disc is convenient to coil and observe the residual condition. According to the utility model, through the matching of the magnetic attraction and the convex block-concave groove, the quick replacement of the teflon disc is realized, the production efficiency is improved, and the operation difficulty is reduced.

title_en: Automatic inhale waste material device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of waste suction of processing punches, in particular to an automatic waste suction device, which adopts a shell, a sealed box body, a vacuum pump, a suction pipe and a vacuum pump, wherein the sealed box body is provided with two sealed discharge valves; when the vacuum suction device is used, the vacuum suction fan continuously vacuumizes the sealed box body to provide suction force for the suction pipe so as to suck waste materials to the punching machine, a sealing discharge valve is opened after a certain amount of waste materials are to be collected, so that the waste materials fall into the next sealing discharge valve of the sealed box body to be accumulated, at the moment, the sealed box body can still continuously vacuumize and keep the suction force, then the sealing discharge valve is closed, the next sealing discharge valve is opened, so that the accumulated waste materials are discharged out of the sealed box body, a ton bag is arranged below the sealed box body in actual use, a large amount of waste materials can be collected for a long time, and then the ton bag is directly transferred and replaced by the fork truck, so that the punching machine does not need to frequently stop the waste material taking box, and the processing efficiency of the punching machine is improved.

title_en: Cutting device with automatic clear function of piece
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cutting device with an automatic scrap cleaning function, which relates to the technical field of cutting equipment and comprises a cutting frame and a cleaning assembly, wherein a cutting saw is arranged in the cutting frame, the cleaning assembly for automatically cleaning scraps is arranged on the outer side of the cutting saw, the cleaning assembly is symmetrically arranged in two groups relative to the vertical central axis of the cutting frame, the cleaning assembly comprises an adjusting cavity, an adjusting screw rod, an adjusting block, an outer shield and a suction pipe, and the adjusting screw rod is vertically arranged in the adjusting cavity. This cutting device with automatic clearance function of piece removes along with the removal of cutting frame and cutting saw through outer guard shield, carries out outside guard shield to the cutting position, avoids splashing of piece, carries out automatic suction clearance to the piece under the suction tube effect of connecting the dust extractor simultaneously, and adjusting screw drives regulating block and outer guard shield under the drive of motor and carries out altitude mixture control to the piece clearance effect when satisfying different degree of depth cutting.

title_en: Sheet metal part machining and polishing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sheet metal part machining polishing device which comprises a polishing main body, wherein supporting plates are fixedly connected to two sides of the top of the polishing main body, an adjusting frame is fixedly connected to the top of each supporting plate, an adjusting groove is formed in the top of each adjusting frame, a movable frame is movably connected to the top of each adjusting frame through each adjusting groove, a limiting rod is fixedly connected to the inner side of each movable frame, a movable nut seat is movably connected to the outer side of each limiting rod, a lifting frame is movably connected to the front side of each movable nut seat, a first rotating motor is fixedly connected to the inner side of each lifting frame, a rotating support is fixedly connected to the driving end of each first rotating motor, and a second rotating motor is embedded into the back side of each rotating support.

title_en: Perforating device for automobile gasket production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of perforating devices, in particular to a perforating device for producing automobile gaskets, which comprises a base, wherein a first groove is formed in the base, an electric push rod and a moving assembly are arranged in the first groove, a plurality of through grooves and a plurality of lower dies are arranged on the moving assembly, a sliding column is arranged in the through grooves in a sliding manner, a spring and a perforating cutter are fixedly arranged on one side of the sliding column, a second groove is arranged between the lower dies and the through grooves, a plurality of direction marks are arranged on the surface of the outer wall of one side of the moving assembly, flexibility and universality are improved, gasket perforating requirements of different shapes, sizes and specifications can be met, and the perforating device is particularly suitable for small-batch and multi-variety production modes, and a production line can rapidly respond to different order demands.

title_en: Spinning machine clamping device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of spinning machines, and particularly relates to a spinning machine clamping device which comprises a processing table, wherein a cavity is formed in the processing table, a clamping mechanism is arranged in the processing table, the clamping mechanism comprises a central shaft, two central shafts are connected to the inner wall of the processing table through bearings, rotating rods are sleeved on the surfaces of the two central shafts respectively, one end of each connecting rod is connected to two ends of each rotating rod through a rotating shaft, vertical rods are connected to the other end of each connecting rod through rotating shafts respectively, the bottoms of connecting blocks are fixedly connected to the tops of the vertical rods respectively, and the tops of the connecting blocks penetrate through the tops of the processing table. The utility model provides a spinning machine clamping device which can clamp and process two workpieces simultaneously, can reduce workpiece clamping and unloading time in each processing, is suitable for mass production, and effectively improves the overall production efficiency.

title_en: Non-standard plate grooving equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides non-standard plate grooving equipment, which relates to the technical field of non-standard part grooving, and comprises a grooving box, wherein a position adjusting device is arranged on the outer side of the grooving box, the end part of the position adjusting device is connected with a two-dimensional moving mechanism, the two-dimensional moving mechanism is connected with a grooving mechanism, a fixing mechanism is arranged opposite to the grooving mechanism and is arranged on the inner wall of the grooving box, a discharge groove is formed in the bottom surface of the grooving box, a safety door is hinged to the side surface of the grooving box, and two sides of the bottom of the grooving box are fixedly connected with supporting plates.

title_en: Automatic seaming machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic seaming machine, which belongs to the technical field of seaming machines, wherein a horizontal forming pile with an arc top is fixedly arranged in the middle of a supporting frame, a transverse frame is arranged at the top of the supporting frame, an air cylinder is arranged at the top of the transverse frame, an upper die is fixedly arranged at the output end of the air cylinder, a telescopic cavity is arranged in the upper die, a lower die is movably arranged in the telescopic cavity, a first seaming cavity is arranged at one side of the lower die, a first seaming seat matched with the first seaming cavity is arranged at one side of the upper die, a second seaming cavity is arranged at the other side of the upper die, a second seaming seat matched with the second seaming cavity is arranged at the other side of the lower die, and a fan is further arranged on the supporting frame. When the air pipe is in seaming, the left side of the air pipe is placed between the first seaming cavity and the first seaming seat, the right side of the air pipe is placed between the second seaming cavity and the second seaming seat, and the upper die and the lower die automatically spring out under the action of the reset spring after stamping.

title_en: Stable feeding tooth welding equipment for processing saw blade
abstract_en: The utility model discloses stable feeding tooth welding equipment for processing saw blades, which belongs to the technical field of saw blade processing and comprises a feeding part and a tooth welding part, and is characterized in that the feeding part comprises a rotating plate, a carrier is fixedly arranged at the upper part of the rotating plate, a vibrating disc is fixedly arranged at the upper part of the carrier, a straight channel is fixedly arranged at one side of an outlet of the vibrating disc, a curve is fixedly arranged at one end of the straight channel, a vertical plate is fixedly arranged at the upper part of the rotating plate and below the curve outlet, a material plate is fixedly arranged at the upper part of the vertical plate, a second movable seat is slidably arranged at one side of the vertical plate, a push plate is fixedly arranged at the upper part of the second movable seat, the push plate is positioned above the material plate, a controller is fixedly arranged at the lower part of the carrier, the tooth welding part comprises a lower base, an upper base is fixedly arranged at the upper part of the lower base, a lower welding plate is fixedly arranged at one side of the upper base close to the feeding part, and the upper surface of the lower welding plate is equal to the upper surface of the material plate.

title_en: Sand blasting machine for machining side cover of automobile engine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sand blasting machine for machining a side cover of an automobile engine, and belongs to the technical field of automobile machining. The utility model comprises a protective cover, the bottom end of the protective cover is communicated with a dust hopper, a filter screen is lapped in the protective cover, the top end of the protective cover is communicated with a wind pipe, one end of the wind pipe is provided with a fan, a sand blasting component is arranged on one side of the inner wall of the protective cover, the sand blasting assembly comprises a frame, a first driver is arranged on one side of the top end of the frame, one end of the first driver is rotationally connected with a rotating rod, a nozzle is arranged on the rotating rod, and a supporting rod is arranged on one side of the frame in an extending mode. The second driver in the sand blasting assembly drives the rotary table to rotate so as to enable the workpiece to rotate, and the first driver drives the rotary table to adjust the spray nozzle sand blasting angle, so that the sand blasting requirement of complex curved surfaces of the engine side cover is met.

title_en: Welding power supply integrated equipment of welding robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of welding robots, and particularly discloses welding power supply integrated equipment of a welding robot, which comprises a supporting shell, wherein a protective top plate is fixed above the supporting shell, a cleaning component is arranged in the protective top plate, an integrated power supply shell is movably arranged in the supporting shell, lifting components for adjusting the height of the integrated power supply shell are arranged around the integrated power supply shell, each lifting component comprises a lifting screw rod rotatably arranged in the supporting shell, the surface of each lifting screw rod is connected with a connecting frame through a wire sleeve, and the connecting frame is fixed around the integrated power supply shell. According to the integrated power supply shell, the cleaning assembly is matched with the lifting assembly, so that the surface of the integrated power supply shell can be cleaned, the normal heat dissipation of the integrated power supply shell, which is influenced by the fact that dust blocks the integrated power supply shell, is avoided, and the integrated power supply shell adopts a rigid filter screen and cannot deform due to high temperature.

title_en: Frock is dismantled to bearing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of bearing disassembly, in particular to a bearing disassembly tool which comprises a bearing mounting seat and an auxiliary mechanism and is characterized in that a bearing hole is blocked on the upper surface of the bearing mounting seat, a bearing body is arranged in the bearing hole, the auxiliary mechanism is positioned at the top end of the bearing body and comprises a pressing block, a screw rod, a cross beam and a fixing arm, the stability of connection is ensured through the welding fixation of the pressing block and the screw rod, the pressure can be effectively transmitted, the red copper block and the rubber block play a role in protecting equipment and enhancing the stability of the tool, the smooth performance of bearing disassembly is ensured, the equipment is protected from being damaged, the service life is prolonged, the device is simple in structure and low in cost, and the production operation and the use are convenient.

title_en: Tectorial membrane device is used in production of intelligent floor
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of floor production and discloses a film laminating device for intelligent floor production, which comprises a frame, wherein a conveying mechanism is respectively arranged on the left side and the right side of the interior of the frame, a dust removing mechanism extending to the upper part of the conveying mechanism is arranged on the left half section of the frame, a film laminating mechanism is arranged between the two conveying mechanisms on the frame, a cutting mechanism is arranged on the right side of the film laminating mechanism on the frame, an electric heating roller is arranged on the right half section of the interior of the frame, the dust removing mechanism comprises a brush, a dust collector, a conduit and a dust collecting nozzle, the brush and the dust collector are both fixed with the frame, the dust collector is connected with the dust collecting nozzle through the conduit, and the brush and the dust collecting nozzle are both positioned on the upper side of the conveying mechanism. According to the utility model, the dust is brushed off by the brush, and then the dust is further adsorbed by the dust collector, so that the dust removing effect is better, the subsequent film coating effect is better, and the film coating is convenient to cut off after film coating, so that the film coating machine can be used continuously.

title_en: Two-jaw hollow power chuck
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a two-jaw hollow power chuck, which belongs to the technical field of clamping equipment and comprises a chuck main body and L-shaped mounting frames, wherein mounting grooves are formed in two sides of the upper surface of the chuck main body, movable blocks are movably connected in the two mounting grooves, a connecting assembly is fixedly connected to the upper surface of each movable block, a sliding groove is formed in the upper end of each L-shaped mounting frame, a sliding plate is movably connected in each sliding groove, clamping jaws are fixedly connected to the front surface of each sliding plate, and a fixing plate is fixedly connected to the back surface of each sliding plate. According to the utility model, the connecting assembly is arranged, the steps in the installation process are clear, the operation is simple, complex tools and complicated processes are not needed, the installation difficulty and time cost are reduced, the equipment deployment efficiency is improved, the clamping requirements of workpieces with different sizes are met by arranging the movable blocks, the device is suitable for diversified production scenes, the moving direction of the clamping claw is ensured to be accurate and stable, and the clamping precision is improved.

title_en: External die matching mechanism
abstract_en: The application relates to an external die matching mechanism, which precisely controls a die stamping frame to move along a linear guide rail through a screw rod nut driving mechanism, combines a positioning component on the die stamping frame with a positioning pit on the die stamping frame, realizes the pre-precise alignment of a die stamping seat and a die stamping seat in a wide space outside a cold header, effectively overcomes the inconvenience of operation caused by space limitation and interference of other parts during the internal die matching, effectively shortens the equipment downtime, improves the die matching precision, and reduces the labor intensity of operators.

title_en: Trigger structure with gear adjustment and nail gun
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a trigger structure with gear adjustment, which comprises a trigger, an adjusting wheel and an elastic piece, wherein the trigger is provided with an adjusting wheel accommodating cavity, one side of the trigger is provided with a first notch communicated with the corresponding adjusting wheel accommodating cavity, the other side of the trigger is provided with a second notch communicated with the adjusting wheel accommodating cavity, and the trigger is provided with an elastic piece accommodating cavity communicated with the adjusting wheel accommodating cavity; according to the trigger structure with gear adjustment, the first step surface and the second step surface which are different in height on the adjusting wheel are matched with the trigger rotating structure, so that the differential control of the pushing distance of the control rod is realized on the premise that the rotation angle of the trigger is kept constant each time, and the position of the trigger, which is correspondingly contacted with the control rod, is changed along with the rotation of the trigger to a fixed angle due to the different heights of the step surfaces, so that the displacement of the control rod is changed, and finally, the aim of switching different nailing modes of the nailing gun is fulfilled.

title_en: Roll shaft dismounting equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses roll shaft dismounting equipment, and relates to the technical field of glass fiber production equipment. The roll shaft dismounting device comprises a frame, a dismounting device and an ejection device, wherein the dismounting device is arranged on the frame and comprises a sleeve, a first driving mechanism and an ejection device, the sleeve is used for being sleeved on a fastening piece, the fastening piece is used for connecting a roller of a workpiece and a roll shaft, the first driving mechanism is connected with the sleeve and used for driving the sleeve to rotate so as to dismount or mount the fastening piece, and the ejection device is arranged on one side of the dismounting device and used for ejecting the roll shaft from the roller or ejecting the roll shaft into the roller. The roll shaft dismounting device can dismount and mount the roll shaft, and has the advantages of low labor intensity and high production efficiency.

title_en: Labor-saving wrench structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides a labor-saving wrench structure, and belongs to the technical field of mechanical hardware tools. The labor-saving wrench structure comprises an adjusting assembly, a steering assembly and a steering assembly, wherein the adjusting assembly comprises a central disc, a clamping disc and a U-shaped block, a clamping groove is formed in the central position of the central disc, a short arc groove is formed in the outer portion of the central disc, a long arc groove is formed in the outer portion of the central disc, a primary groove is formed in the central position of the clamping disc, a sliding groove is formed in the center of the clamping disc along the corner direction of the primary groove, multiple groups of short arc grooves and long arc grooves are circumferentially distributed outside the central disc in pairs, the steering assembly is arranged outside the adjusting assembly and comprises a curved handle portion, a folded handle portion, a steering shaft, a finger grip and a palm grip, and the tail ends of the grasping handles are connected through elastic binding belts. The utility model has the advantages of adapting to bolts with different specifications and adjusting the space required by operation.

title_en: Multi-purpose carpenter's clamp splice stack
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of clamps and discloses a woodworking multipurpose clamp splice set, which comprises a guide rod, wherein a fixed seat is arranged at one end of the guide rod, a sliding seat is arranged in the middle of the guide rod, clamping heads are arranged on the fixed seat and the sliding seat, and each clamping head comprises a double-head planar clamping block, a double-head V-shaped clamping block, a double-hole bottom clamping block and a single-head lengthened clamping block. The utility model is suitable for a carpenter's multipurpose clamp splice stack, and the clamping heads with four different structures are respectively connected with the fixed seat and the sliding seat, so that the whole device can effectively clamp different parts.

title_en: Forming device for stainless steel gasket
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of metal forming equipment, in particular to a forming device for stainless steel gaskets, which comprises a forming assembly, wherein an adjusting assembly is arranged on the forming assembly, the problem that the stainless steel gasket forming device can only punch and form gaskets with the same size is solved, the forming assembly and the adjusting assembly are arranged, a lower die with the proper size is selected to be placed on a connecting block according to the size of the stainless steel gasket to be formed, the stainless steel gasket is clamped and positioned with a clamping groove through a clamping block, then screw the screw rod again and drive the protection pad and remove, move it to contradict with the bed die lateral wall to consolidate spacingly to the bed die, and the protection pad is the silica gel material of tooth trace form, can carry out crooked regulation according to the outer wall shape of bed die, also plays the antiskid effect simultaneously, can put stainless steel gasket raw materials on the bed die this moment, opens the hydro-cylinder and drives the mould and go up stainless steel gasket raw materials stamping forming, reaches the stainless steel gasket shaping effect to equidimension.

title_en: Welding spot reinforcing device for thermocouple production of semiconductor diffusion furnace
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of thermocouple welding, and discloses a welding spot reinforcing device for thermocouple production of a semiconductor diffusion furnace, which comprises a welding table and two fixing rings, wherein the outer surface of the top of the welding table is fixedly connected with a fixing frame, a first electric push rod and a second electric push rod are fixedly arranged on the outer surface of the downward top of the fixing frame, a welding gun is arranged at the output end of the first electric push rod, a transverse plate is fixedly connected with the output end of the second electric push rod, a first rotating seat is fixedly connected with the outer surface of the bottom of the transverse plate, a rotating block is rotatably connected with the outer surface of the first rotating seat, and a spray gun is arranged on the outer surface of the rotating block. The welding gun is driven by the first electric push rod to be in contact with the welding position of the thermocouple wire for welding, and the second electric push rod is used for driving the welding gun to spray the coating liquid to form a protective layer, so that the welding position is reinforced, and the possibility of disconnection of the subsequent welding point is reduced.

title_en: Radiator guiding and positioning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a radiator guiding and positioning device which comprises a radiator pushing table, a radiator bearing assembly and a radiator pushing assembly, wherein the radiator pushing table is arranged close to a chassis conveying assembly, a positioning pressing table is arranged on the chassis conveying assembly, the radiator bearing assembly and the radiator pushing assembly are fixedly arranged on the radiator pushing table and are matched with a chassis on the positioning pressing table, and the radiator bearing assembly and the radiator pushing assembly are electrically connected with a control center. Under control center's effect, through the collaborative work of radiator bearing assembly and radiator propulsion unit, can be with the accurate propulsion of heat dissipation to quick-witted incasement, through other equipment installation screw, can effectual improvement machining efficiency.

title_en: Punching forming machine
abstract_en: The utility model provides a punching forming machine which comprises a mounting frame, a sliding plate, an upper die, a lower die and a driving piece, wherein the upper die is arranged right above the lower die, the upper die is mounted on the sliding plate, the lower die is mounted on the mounting frame, the sliding plate is slidably mounted on the mounting frame in a direction approaching or far away from the lower die, the driving piece is used for driving the sliding plate to slide, the upper die is fixedly provided with an upper mounting plate, one side of the sliding plate, which is close to the lower die, is provided with an upper sliding rail, the upper mounting plate is slidably mounted on the upper sliding rail, the sliding plate is provided with a first locking piece for locking the position of the upper mounting plate, the mounting frame is provided with a lower sliding rail, the lower die is fixedly provided with a lower mounting plate, the lower mounting plate is slidably mounted on the lower sliding rail, and the mounting frame is provided with a second locking piece for locking the position of the lower mounting plate. The utility model has the advantages of improving the replacement efficiency of the upper die and the lower die, and further improving the processing efficiency.

title_en: Electric power construction power tube cutting device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of power pipe cutting and discloses a power pipe cutting device for power construction, which comprises a working frame, wherein a connecting component is fixedly connected to the upper side of the working frame and is used for conveniently clamping and limiting a power pipe, a bushing plate is fixedly connected to the upper side of the inner part of the working frame, push rods are fixedly connected to the two sides of the inner part of the working frame, a scraping plate is fixedly connected to the output end of each push rod, a fixing frame is fixedly connected to the inner part of the working frame, a collecting box is slidingly connected to the inner part of the fixing frame, and a water storage tank is fixedly connected to the lower side of the inner part of the working frame. According to the utility model, the device is provided with the automatic waste cleaning structure, so that the device can automatically clean after cutting is completed, the cleaning difficulty of operators is greatly reduced, the automatic cutting treatment of the power tube is realized, and the problems of low efficiency and poor precision in the traditional cutting are effectively solved.

title_en: Composite steel fireproof detection device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of composite steel detection, in particular to a composite steel fireproof detection device, which comprises a box body, wherein a round rod which rotates along the axial direction of the box body is horizontally arranged in the box body, one end of the round rod is fixedly connected with a gear, a group of racks are vertically arranged in a detection furnace, the racks are matched with the gear, a vertical plate is fixedly arranged in the detection furnace, one side of the vertical plate, which is close to the box body, is fixedly provided with a pair of L-shaped plates, the L-shaped plates are arranged on the same vertical line in a mirror image mode, extrusion grooves are respectively formed in the L-shaped plates, the extrusion grooves are arranged on different L-shaped plates in a mirror image mode, a connecting rod which is parallel to the round rod is slidably arranged in the box body, one side of the connecting rod is fixedly provided with a deflector rod, one end of the connecting rod is connected with a rotating shaft at the center of the gear, and the composite steel can be driven to overturn through the cooperation of the round rod, the gear, the racks, the L-shaped plates, the extrusion grooves, the connecting rod and the deflector rod.

title_en: Shock absorber performance testing device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of automobile engineering, in particular to a shock absorber performance testing device. The utility model provides a shock absorber performance testing device which can simulate different temperatures and adjust different pressures to carry out extrusion test on a shock absorber, is convenient for comprehensively evaluating the performance, reliability and durability of the shock absorber and improves the test reliability. The utility model provides a bumper shock absorber capability test device, includes base, revolving door and cage etc. the front left side rotation of base is connected with the revolving door, and the base upside is connected with the cage. According to the utility model, the adjusting plate is pushed to move, so that the telescopic frame stretches and contracts, the pressure is adjusted fixedly, the shock absorber is installed, the shock absorber is extruded and tested by the upward and downward movement of the first sliding frame, and the temperature is adjusted by the cold or heat medium entering the circulating pipeline, so that the shock absorber can be extruded and tested by simulating different temperatures and adjusting different pressures, the performance, the reliability and the durability of the shock absorber can be evaluated comprehensively, and the reliability of the test is improved.

title_en: Permanent magnet direct-drive band sawing machine
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of band sawing machines, and particularly relates to a permanent magnet direct-drive band sawing machine, which comprises a machine base, wherein the upper end of the machine base is fixedly connected with a connecting frame, the upper end of the connecting frame is fixedly connected with an adjusting box, the upper end of the machine base is fixedly connected with a flat plate, a feeding mechanism is arranged on the flat plate, a saw blade is arranged in the machine base, two symmetrically distributed guide rods are fixedly connected in the adjusting box, the outer side of each guide rod is connected with a wheel frame in a sliding manner, and a supporting wheel is arranged in the wheel frame through a bearing. According to the utility model, the supporting wheel, the supporting frame, the screw and other structures are additionally arranged in the adjusting box, the supporting frame can be driven to move through threaded fit between the screw and the supporting frame in the using process, and the elastic value of the first spring can be adjusted in the moving process of the supporting frame, so that the supporting wheel can be driven to tension the saw blade through the elastic value of the first spring, and the loosening of the saw blade can be effectively avoided.

title_en: Material guiding device for section steel straightener
abstract_en: The application relates to a guide device for a section steel straightener, and relates to the field of section steel straighteners. The automatic feeding device comprises a seat box, wherein a processing table is fixedly arranged on the upper end face of the seat box, a device shell is fixedly arranged on the rear end face of the seat box, a detection table is vertically arranged on the upper end face of the processing table, the detection table is fixedly connected with the processing table, a positioning clamping seat is arranged on the detection table, the positioning clamping seat is fixedly connected with the detection table, two groups of material guide plate groups are symmetrically arranged on the inner side face of the positioning clamping seat, and the material guide plate groups are in sliding connection with the positioning clamping seat. According to the application, through the accurate positioning and guiding of the positioning clamp seat and the material guide plate group and the flexible adjustment of the distance between the driving piece and the material guide plate group, the device can adapt to the profile steel with different specifications, ensures the stability and accuracy of the profile steel in the conveying process, and improves the material guide precision. The setting of detection case group can carry out real-time detection to the bending condition of shaped steel, provides accurate foundation for the straightening operation.

title_en: Automatic tool changing electric spindle with gas-liquid supercharging function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a gas-liquid pressurizing automatic tool changing electric spindle which comprises a spindle and a tool handle assembly arranged on one end face of the spindle, wherein an air cylinder device is arranged on the other end face of the spindle and comprises a connecting body arranged on the other end face of the spindle, a first air cylinder piece is arranged on the end face of the connecting body, a second air cylinder piece is arranged on the end face of the first air cylinder piece, an end cover is arranged on the second air cylinder piece, a tool unloading air inlet is arranged on the end cover, an air inlet compression cavity is formed between the second air cylinder piece and the end cover, the tool unloading air inlet is communicated with the air inlet compression cavity, and a pressurizing oil cavity is arranged in the second air cylinder piece. The utility model is improved in structure, volume and weight, is beneficial to the installation of corresponding matched equipment, adopts gas compression and liquid pressurization, greatly increases the output power of pressure intensity by adopting mixed output, can better realize the thrust required by knife striking, and further completes knife unloading.

title_en: Conveying roller way device for polishing surface of steel plate
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of metallurgical equipment, in particular to a conveying roller way device for grinding the surface of a steel plate. The roller way surface is also provided with a silica gel material for preventing scratch, the outer side of the device is also provided with a free carrier roller of the surface silica gel material, the roller way device can be used for polishing a narrow plate, the middle roller way is used for driving and conveying, a steel plate with the width of about 4 meters can be polished, the carrier roller can play a supporting role, the defects that a chain conveyor cannot polish the narrow plate and the potential safety hazard of falling the plate are overcome by adopting a delta-shaped design, meanwhile, the speed reducer adopts a hanging type torque arm hollow shaft design to reduce the size of equipment, operators can inspect, detect and polish the surface of the narrow plate at a short distance, and meanwhile, the roller way device is adopted to replace the chain conveyor, so that the structure is simpler, the maintenance is easier, the maintenance cost is lower, and the equipment stable running time is longer.

title_en: Belt cutting and unwinding trolley convenient for feeding
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of tire half-part sizing materials, in particular to a belt ply cutting and guiding trolley convenient for feeding, which comprises a frame, wherein the bottom of the frame is provided with a wheel shaft through a bearing, the axle body of shaft is fixedly connected with directional truckle, the universal truckle is installed to the bottom of frame, STW safety chuck and STO safety chuck are installed through the bolt to the upper end of frame. According to the utility model, the fixed fixing frame is arranged on the frame, and then the large magnet, the small magnet, the unwinding roller and other parts are arranged on the fixing frame, wherein the rubber material with the steel wire is adsorbed by the large magnet and the small magnet which are arranged on the fixing frame, and then is conveyed to cutting equipment after passing through the unwinding roller, so that the steel pressure rubber material is adsorbed by the strong magnet, the frame is quick and convenient, the condition that the material head is folded and deformed to cause waste is avoided, and the problem that unqualified products are caused in the process of taking the rubber belt into the tire can be effectively avoided after the rubber belt is cancelled.

title_en: Cold heading machine capable of automatically calibrating punch
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of cold heading machines, and provides a cold heading machine capable of automatically calibrating a punch, which comprises a cold heading machine body, wherein a control console is arranged on the side surface of the cold heading machine body, the inside of cold heading machine body is provided with the removal case, the drift is installed to the side of removal case, the inside fixedly connected with shaping subassembly of cold heading machine body, the inside of cold heading machine body is provided with calibration mechanism. In the utility model, the bidirectional motor is started to drive the threaded rod to rotate, the limiting shaft drives the threaded sleeve to linearly move, the calibration plate is further driven to move, the punch is pushed to calibrate, meanwhile, the connecting rod drives the push rod to extrude the stressed rod, the force rod enters the hydraulic cylinder, the hydraulic pressure pushes the hydraulic rod to extend out to drive the calibration arc plate to move, and the comprehensive calibration of the punch is completed.

title_en: Flute type pipe welding jig
abstract_en: The utility model discloses the technical field of flute-shaped pipes, in particular to a flute-shaped pipe welding jig which comprises a supporting bottom plate, wherein a C-shaped supporting frame is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the supporting bottom plate, suction holes are symmetrically formed in the inner side wall of the supporting frame close to the top, an absorption and filtration mechanism is fixedly connected below the rear side of the suction holes through a pipeline, and the absorption and filtration mechanism comprises a filter box connected with the suction holes through a pipeline. The utility model can enable the fixed flute-shaped pipe to rotate by 360 degrees through the rotating mechanism, can greatly improve the welding efficiency, can effectively filter the gas and welding slag generated by welding, can ensure the good environment for processing the flute-shaped pipe and the personal safety of workers, and can clamp and fix two groups of flute-shaped pipes at one time by the fixing mechanism, thereby improving the processing precision of the flute-shaped pipe and the processing efficiency of the flute-shaped pipe.

title_en: Chuck for paper tube processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a chuck for processing a paper tube, which relates to a clamp technology and comprises a chuck base body, wherein a polygonal boss is arranged on one side of the chuck base body, a retainer and an expansion ring are sequentially and coaxially sleeved on the outer side of the polygonal boss, a plurality of rollers capable of rotating relative to the retainer are uniformly distributed on the retainer, the outer side wall of each roller is in rolling contact with the side surface of the polygonal boss and the inner side of the expansion ring, a gland is fixed on one side of the chuck base body, and the expansion ring and the rollers are axially limited.

title_en: Magnetic attraction type rapid calibration frame for multistage pump rotor
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of multistage pump rotor machining and discloses a multistage pump rotor magnetic quick calibration frame which comprises a workbench and a fixing frame, wherein a supporting frame is arranged in the workbench, a rotor body is arranged on the upper surface of the supporting frame, a special-shaped frame is connected in the fixing frame in a sliding mode, a magnetic attraction piece is arranged in the special-shaped frame, a T-shaped rod is connected in the special-shaped frame in a rotating mode, a sliding block is fixedly connected to the bottom end of the T-shaped rod, a U-shaped frame is connected in the sliding block in a rotating mode, a sliding seat is connected to the outer wall of the U-shaped frame in a rotating mode, and a connecting rod is fixedly connected to the outer wall of the sliding seat. According to the utility model, the height of the magnetic attraction piece is conveniently adjusted through the cooperation among the fixing frame, the special-shaped frame, the T-shaped rod, the sliding block, the U-shaped frame, the sliding seat, the connecting rod, the first spring and the conical block, so that the magnetic attraction piece is perpendicular to the vertical center of the rotor, the attraction force is kept stable, the rotor with different thicknesses is adapted, and the magnetic piece is convenient to detach and replace.

title_en: Beater roller assembly for cross cutting sponge machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a beater roller assembly for a cross cutting sponge machine, which relates to the technical field of sponge cutting machines and comprises a beater roller mechanism, wherein the beater roller mechanism comprises bearing seats arranged at two ends, rotating shafts are rotatably arranged in the bearing seats at two ends, and the end parts of the rotating shafts are coaxially connected with driven chain wheels. The utility model provides a beater roller assembly for a cross-shaped sponge cutting machine, which comprises a plurality of independent units such as rubber poking sheets or elastic strips, wherein an axial dovetail groove track is arranged on the surface of a rotating shaft, the flexible beater units can axially slide along the surface of the rotating shaft to adjust positions through sliding blocks embedded in the track, the bottom of each flexible beater unit is provided with a locking bolt, the distance can be manually adjusted after loosening, and the operation stability is ensured after fastening, so that the beater roller mechanism provided by the utility model is modularized to support quick replacement, and the flexible beater units with different hardness can be mixedly used, thereby being suitable for the processing requirements of sponges with different densities and materials.

title_en: Photovoltaic support welding assembly
abstract_en: The utility model provides a photovoltaic bracket welding assembly, which belongs to the technical field of photovoltaic bracket welding and comprises a supporting main body, a connecting plate, a fixing assembly, an adjusting mechanism and a welding seat, wherein the supporting main body is of an inverted trapezoid frame structure, a mounting groove is formed in the top of the supporting main body, the connecting plate is arranged in the mounting groove, the connecting plate is of a rectangular plate-shaped structure, through holes are formed in the middle of the connecting plate, 4 bolt holes are uniformly distributed around the through holes, the fixing assembly comprises a fixing base and a fixing rod, the fixing base is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the supporting main body, one end of the fixing rod is connected with the fixing base through the welding seat, the welding seat is of a cylindrical structure, the adjusting mechanism comprises an adjusting shaft and an adjusting arm, the adjusting shaft penetrates through the adjusting hole in the side wall of the supporting main body and is connected with the through holes of the connecting plate, and the technical problems that in the prior art, the photovoltaic bracket welding assembly is insufficient in structural stability, difficult in angle adjustment and poor in welding connection reliability can be solved.

title_en: Safe type glass section bar cutting equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses safe glass section cutting equipment, which belongs to the technical field of glass section processing and comprises a pedestal, wherein two material clamping shells and a material bearing table are arranged on the upper surface of the pedestal, the material bearing table is positioned between the two material clamping shells, one material clamping shell is fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the pedestal, the other material clamping shell and the material bearing table are movably arranged on the upper surface of the pedestal, and the mounting plate, the mounting shell, a spring and a pressing plate are arranged for use.

title_en: Cutting device is used in meat processing
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of meat product processing, in particular to a cutting device for meat product processing, which aims at solving the problems that in the existing meat product cutting processing process, the meat product is not convenient to stably fix, and further the cutting process is easy to deviate and the processing quality is affected, and the cutting device comprises a processing table; the meat product cutting machine comprises a collecting box, a transverse plate, a first cylinder, a cutter and a cutter, wherein the collecting box is arranged on a processing table, a collecting opening is formed in the processing table, a vertical plate is fixedly arranged at the top of the processing table, the transverse plate is fixedly arranged on one side of the vertical plate, a through groove is formed in the transverse plate, a one-way transmission mechanism is arranged in the through groove, the first cylinder is fixedly arranged at the top of the transverse plate, and the cutter is fixedly connected with an output shaft of the first cylinder.

title_en: Building pipe cutting device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a building pipe cutting device which comprises a machine body, wherein an objective table and a cutting table are sequentially arranged above the machine body along the pipe conveying direction. The objective table comprises a slide box, a supporting slide roller, a supporting slide seat and a driving component, wherein an arc-shaped bearing groove of the supporting slide roller is matched with a V-shaped bearing part and a clamping fixing part of the supporting slide seat, and can fix a non-cutting part of a pipe from two ends. The device can adapt to the tubular product of different diameters and lengths, promotes fixed effect, improves cutting accuracy and security, possesses high-efficient regulation and multiple auxiliary function simultaneously, reinforcing cutting efficiency and practicality.

title_en: Numerical control lathe sweeps partial shipment device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a numerical control lathe sweeps partial shipment device, includes the bottom plate, is equipped with the conveyer belt on the bottom plate, and drive conveyer belt pivoted actuating mechanism, fixed mounting several supporting leg on the bottom plate is equipped with adsorption equipment on the bottom plate, and adsorption equipment includes the several magnet.
