The utility model has simple structure and ingenious conception, when the synchronous belt rotates to be attached to the magnet, the magnetic scraps can be adsorbed on the synchronous belt under the action of magnetic force, the separation of the magnetic scraps and the non-magnetic scraps is completed, when the synchronous belt rotates to one side far away from the magnet, the scraps lose the attraction of the magnet, can fall onto the guide plate from the synchronous belt, and then are split-packed in the next step, so that the abrasion caused by scraping is avoided, and the synchronous belt is obliquely arranged, so that the parts with different distances from the conveying belt can adsorb larger scraps firstly, and the parts with smaller scraps are adsorbed later when the distances are closer, the ordered separation is realized, the separation interference is reduced, the separation efficiency is improved, the actual requirement can be met, and the utility model is suitable for popularization.

title_en: Hold device with tiger's mouth protection helping hand
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tiger mouth protection power-assisted holding device, and belongs to the technical field of holding devices. The device comprises a cutter body, a holding component and a fixing component, wherein the holding component is arranged on the cutter body, and the fixing component is arranged at the end part of the holding component. The holding part in the holding assembly is inserted into the tail part of the cutter body, one end of the holding part, which is close to the cutter body, is provided with a convex block with a curved surface contour which is fit with the tiger mouth, and the screw in the fixing assembly penetrates through the holding part and the tail part of the cutter body through threads at the same time, and the end part is fixedly connected with the connecting sheet. According to the utility model, the tiger mouth is protected by attaching the curved surface contour of the tiger mouth, the high-efficiency force generation is assisted, the problems of easy fatigue and unsmooth force application of the tiger mouth in the traditional holding mode are solved, the use comfort and the operation efficiency are improved, and the method can be adapted to various scenes needing to hold and apply force.

title_en: Main shaft protection device of numerical control machine tool
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of machine tool manufacturing and safety protection, and discloses a numerical control machine tool spindle protection device which comprises a shell, wherein a cavity is formed in the shell, a connecting ring is detachably connected to the inner wall of the left side of the cavity, a supporting layer is fixedly connected to the right side of the connecting ring, an axial flow fan is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the supporting layer, a heat dissipation layer is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the supporting layer, a protection layer is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the heat dissipation layer, and a plurality of through holes are formed in the heat dissipation layer and the protection layer respectively. According to the utility model, the efficient heat dissipation of the main shaft and the workpiece is realized through the synergistic effect of the axial flow fan and the foamed aluminum heat dissipation layer, the reduction of processing precision and equipment loss caused by high temperature are effectively avoided, and the honeycomb butyl rubber layer is utilized to absorb vibration, through holes and the dissipation noise of the confluence cavity structure, so that a multilayer protection system is constructed.

title_en: Water cutting device with remote control function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water cutting device with remote control function belongs to water cutting technical field, including the base, the top fixed mounting of base has the panoramic camera that is used for observing cutting environment, one side fixed mounting of panoramic camera has the receiving antenna that is used for promoting signal intensity, and the bottom rotation of base is connected with the gyro wheel structure that is used for remote control to remove, and the top rotation of base is connected with the main shower nozzle that is used for cutting, the utility model discloses during the use, through set up the outlet pipe in the both sides of main shower nozzle, make the outlet pipe with the high-pressure rivers of reposition of redundant personnel with 45 angle symmetry blowout, utilize the reverse moment that rivers jet produced to offset the transverse vibration of main shower nozzle, ensure cutting precision, simultaneously, the spun rivers can in time wash the piece that the cutting produced, keep the operation scene clean, the axial component that activity shower nozzle produced sprays backward dip angle, the recoil force when effectively offset main shower nozzle sprays, further reduction equipment is because of the displacement error that the reaction force produced.

title_en: OCA laminating device of flexible OLED screen
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a flexible OLED screen OCA laminating device, which relates to the technical field of OLED screens and comprises a machine body, a working cavity, a placing mechanism, a laminating mechanism and a buffer piece, wherein the working cavity is arranged on the machine body, the placing mechanism is arranged in the machine body, the laminating mechanism is arranged in the machine body and comprises a fixed ring, a hydraulic cylinder, a plurality of mounting grooves and a plurality of springs, the hydraulic cylinder is arranged on the fixed ring, the mounting grooves are formed in the machine body, the mounting plate is arranged on the hydraulic cylinder, the springs are formed in the plurality of springs and are arranged in the mounting grooves, and the buffer piece is formed in the plurality of buffer pieces and is arranged on the mounting plate. This device is through setting up laminating mechanism, can play good cushioning effect when laminating, prevents that hard contact from leading to the screen damage, and pressure sensor can real-time supervision laminating in-process pressure simultaneously ensures that the laminating effect reaches the best.

title_en: Five double-end cutting machines
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a five-axis double-head cutting machine which comprises a base component, wherein a portal frame component, a moving component, a workpiece mounting component, a left tool changing component and a right tool changing component are arranged on the base component, the workpiece mounting component is arranged on the moving component and slides on the moving component, the portal frame component is positioned at the rear side of the workpiece mounting component, a cutting component is arranged on the portal frame component in a sliding mode, the left tool changing component and the right tool changing component are respectively positioned at two sides of the workpiece mounting component, and the left tool changing component and the right tool changing component are used for changing tools of the cutting component. The utility model adopts a five-axis adjusting mode, realizes automatic replacement of the cutter, improves the machining precision and improves the production efficiency.

title_en: Cutting and receiving integrated device
abstract_en: The application relates to a cutting and receiving integrated device, which relates to the technical field of cutting devices and comprises a processing table, a pressing plate is arranged above the processing table, the outer surface of the processing table is fixedly connected with two side plates, and the outer circumferential surface of each side plate is rotationally connected with a first screw rod. According to the application, the pressing plate is arranged above the processing table, so that the separation of the tag and the waste can be assisted, the tag is pressed when the tag and the waste are separated, the tag is prevented from being synchronously brought into alignment by the waste, the separation effect of the tag and the waste is optimized, the pressing plate is driven to lift under the action of the threaded pipe when the first screw rod rotates, the distance between the pressing plate and the processing table is conveniently adjusted according to the requirement, the operation convenience is improved, the pushing plate is driven to move by rotating the second screw rod, the top plate and the rubber pad are driven to move towards the outside of the chute under the action of the bulge and the inclined plane, the waste winding drum is further propped up, the installation and the disassembly of the waste winding drum are facilitated, and the operation efficiency is improved.

title_en: Liquid crystal display film preparation system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a preparation system of a liquid crystal display film, which comprises a conveying device, a sealing device and a cutting device, wherein the conveying device is provided with a feed inlet and a discharge outlet, a first display film and a second display film are conveyed from the feed inlet to the discharge outlet, an injection space is formed between the first display film and the second display film at intervals, the sealing device is positioned between the feed inlet and the discharge outlet, a bonding material and a liquid crystal material are injected into the injection space to form a plurality of bonding areas and a plurality of liquid crystal areas, so that the first display film and the second display film are bonded and form a plurality of liquid crystal display film areas in the injection space, the cutting device comprises a cutter die and a cutter, the cutter die is provided with a plurality of acupuncture points, each acupuncture point corresponds to one liquid crystal display film area, the cutter cuts the liquid crystal display film area of each acupuncture point to obtain a plurality of liquid crystal display films, and the liquid crystal display films are conveyed to the discharge outlet through the conveying device.

title_en: Building steel pipe equipment of bending
abstract_en: The utility model provides a construction steel pipe bending device, when in use, an inserting iron sleeve is lifted upwards and rotated 90 degrees clockwise around the front-rear direction, so that an opening faces left, a left inserting plate and a right inserting plate are respectively inserted into an upper inserting groove and a lower inserting groove from right to left, a limiting inserting hole is positioned in the inserting hole, the middle part of a rotating plate horizontally rotates 180 degrees relative to a limiting column and moves downwards, so that a limiting inserting rod is vertically inserted into the inserting hole and the limiting inserting hole, a connecting plate is positioned in front of a guide groove, a steel pipe passes through the position between the bending groove of a bending wheel and the guide groove of the guide wheel from back to front and is inserted into the inserting iron sleeve, a driving device drives the guide wheel to horizontally rotate clockwise, under the limit of the inserting iron sleeve, the steel pipe is bent, the limiting inserting rod is pulled upwards to pull the inserting hole and the limiting inserting hole, and the limiting inserting iron sleeve can be pulled out rightwards at the moment, and the steel pipe can be detached. The steel pipe bending machine can bend the steel pipe, and the bent steel pipe is convenient to take out and use.

title_en: A plate shearing machine material feeding unit for wind channel
abstract_en: The application relates to a feeding device of a plate shearing machine for an air duct, which comprises a workbench, wherein a rack is arranged on the workbench, a plate shearing device is arranged on the rack, a supporting frame is erected on one side of the workbench, which is close to an outlet of the plate shearing device, a containing shell is arranged in the supporting frame, a distance plate and a driving assembly are arranged in the containing shell, the driving assembly drives the distance plate to slide in the containing shell along the vertical direction, and when the distance plate is abutted against the inner side wall of the containing shell, which is close to the workbench, the distance plate is abutted against the surface of the workbench. The application has the effect of improving the shearing efficiency of the plate.

title_en: Solenoid valve assembly workbench
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electromagnetic valve assembling workbench, which comprises a workbench, wherein an assembling plate for assembling an electromagnetic valve is arranged on the workbench, clamping assemblies for fixing a valve body of the electromagnetic valve are arranged on two sides of the assembling plate, and rotating assemblies are arranged at the side ends of the assembling plate, wherein the assembling plate fixes the valve body through the clamping assemblies, and the assembling surface of the valve body is adjusted through the rotating assemblies. According to the clamping assembly, the electromagnetic valve body can be rapidly positioned and fixed on the assembly plate through the cooperation of the clamping plate, the guide shaft sleeve, the guide rod and the clamping spring. The linear movement of the clamping plate and the design of the anti-slip protrusions enable the valve body to be stably clamped, time for manually adjusting and fixing the position of the valve body is reduced, and initial positioning efficiency of assembly is improved.

title_en: Water-cooling nozzle with coating and welding gun
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water-cooling nozzle with a coating and a welding gun, which comprise a first section and a second section which are detachably and fixedly connected, wherein the first section and the second section are respectively provided with a hollow inner hole which is communicated with each other in a penetrating way, and an inlet and an outlet which are respectively arranged at two ends of the inner hole, the inner hole of the second section and the inner hole of the first section can be communicated with each other and accommodate the extension of the head of the welding gun, the inlet of the second section is used for being connected with the welding gun, the outlet of the second section can be detachably connected with the inlet of the first section, and the side wall of the second section is connected with a cooling waterway which is communicated with the inner hole of the second section. The external water pipe is eliminated in the design of cut straightly formula water route, firm in connection saves space, the inside and outside surface of first section and second section all covers and has the coating. The inner and outer double-sided composite coatings are sprayed on the inner wall, the outer wall and the threaded connection parts of the nozzle in a full-coverage manner, so that the blind area of the traditional single-sided spraying is eliminated. The coating can realize the effects of high-temperature non-tackiness, easy cleaning, automatic falling off of welding slag when the welding slag is touched, and long-acting protection.

title_en: Anti-splashing electric punching shear scrap collecting box
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of machining and discloses an anti-splashing electric punching shear chip collecting box which comprises an electric punching shear, wherein a connecting block is contacted with the outer wall of the electric punching shear, the outer wall of the connecting block is fixedly connected with the collecting box, the outer wall of the collecting box is slidably connected with a casing, the side wall of the casing is fixedly connected with a pressing rod, the outer wall of the pressing rod is slidably connected with a sleeve, the inner wall of the pressing rod penetrates through and is in threaded connection with a limit bolt, and the bottom end of the pressing rod is elastically connected with the sleeve through a reset spring. According to the utility model, the expansion and the retraction of the casing can be rapidly completed by inserting and pulling the limit bolt and utilizing the self elasticity of the reset spring, when the casing is expanded, the flexible part at the upper part of the casing can be closely attached to the plate, so that the splashing of scraps during cutting is effectively prevented, the clean working environment is ensured, and when scraps are cleaned, the limit block is moved, and the collection box can be opened to pour the scraps by rotating the rotating plate.

title_en: Forming die for preparing biomass fuel from straw
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a biomass fuel forming die prepared from straws, which comprises a lower die body arranged on a base, wherein a die cavity is formed in the center of the top of the lower die body, a hardening layer and an elastic demolding layer are sequentially arranged on the inner wall of the die cavity, a net-shaped heating element and a temperature sensor are embedded in the lower die body, an upper die body is arranged above the lower die body, the upper die body is arranged below a lifting seat, the top of the lifting seat is connected with a hydraulic cylinder, a pressing seat is arranged at the bottom of the upper die body, a wear-resistant bushing is detachably arranged in a yielding groove of an outer ring of the pressing seat, a mounting hole is formed in the outer side of the wear-resistant bushing, and a bolt is connected with the mounting Kong Naluo. The utility model has scientific and reasonable structural design, realizes independent replacement of the easily worn parts, reduces maintenance cost, prolongs the service life of the die, and solves the problems of easy adhesion of fuel to the die cavity and high breakage rate in the conventional die stripping process by utilizing the low adhesion characteristic of the elastic stripping layer and the wear resistance characteristic of the hardening layer.

title_en: Embedded module dismounting device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of module disassembly, in particular to an embedded module disassembly device which comprises a die body, wherein an object placing cavity is formed in the die body, a crankshaft is arranged in the object placing cavity, one end of the crankshaft is connected with a knob, the knob is arranged outside the die body, the outside of the crankshaft is connected with a transmission rod, the top end of the transmission rod is provided with a movable disc, the top end of the movable disc is provided with six groups of second connecting lugs, a clamping plate is arranged in the second connecting lugs, one end of the clamping plate is provided with a first connecting lug, and the other end of the first connecting lug is provided with a push rod.

title_en: Drilling device for bridge construction
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of bridge construction, in particular to a drilling device for bridge construction, a dust suction box is arranged at one side of the bottom of a mounting frame, a dust suction opening is communicated between the dust suction box and the mounting frame, baffle plates are arranged at the top and bottom sides of the dust collection opening, a plurality of locking grooves are symmetrically formed in the baffle plates to install a connecting frame, and a dust collection cloth bag is arranged at one side of the connecting frame. According to the utility model, the drilling machine can realize stable unidirectional displacement feeding through the mounting frame so as to ensure the stability of drilling, meanwhile, the dust suction mechanism at the bottom of the mounting frame can effectively control dust generated by drilling so as to reduce dust flying, and in the subsequent maintenance of the dust suction mechanism, the dust collection cloth bag can be rapidly maintained only through stirring and plugging, so that the working efficiency is effectively improved, and the effective dust suppression is realized.

title_en: Bottom cleaning knife
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bottom cleaning cutter which comprises a cutter handle, a cutter head and at least one group of cutting edges, wherein each cutting edge comprises a bottom edge and a peripheral side cutting edge, a plurality of axial chip grooves are formed in the circumferential direction of the cutter head, each axial chip groove corresponds to one group of cutting edges, the front side of the peripheral side cutting edge in the rotating direction is in smooth transition connection with the axial chip grooves through a front cutter face, the rear side of the peripheral side cutting edge in the rotating direction is provided with a rear cutter face, the rear cutter face is in tangential transition connection with the rear cutter face through a trimming arc, and the trimming arc presses a processed surface in the cutting process. In the utility model, the peripheral side cutting edge is in tangential transition with the rear cutter surface through the trimming arc, the processed surface is flattened through ironing in the cutting process, and the quality of the processed surface is improved.

title_en: Fixing device of laser engraving die
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fixing device of a laser engraving die, which comprises a workbench; the utility model effectively limits the displacement of the rotary table in the vertical direction by the matching design of the limiting groove and the limiting block, ensures that the rotary table rotates only in a horizontal plane during rotation, and the balls symmetrically arranged at the bottom of the limiting block greatly reduces the friction force between the limiting block and the limiting groove when the rotary table rotates, the balls roll, reduces the abrasion among components, prolongs the service life of the device, ensures smoother rotation process and can realize more accurate angle fine adjustment, thereby further meeting the requirements of personnel on carving different angles of the die and improving the convenience and the working efficiency of the device after fixing the die.

title_en: Motorcycle frame pipe end notch processingequipment
abstract_en: The application relates to a motorcycle frame pipe end notch machining device, which belongs to the technical field of motorcycle frame machining and comprises a bottom plate, wherein a cutting mechanism, a polishing robot and a feeding mechanism are respectively arranged on the bottom plate, the cutting mechanism and the polishing robot are respectively arranged beside the feeding mechanism, and the feeding mechanism comprises a cam divider, a turntable and a plurality of clamping assemblies arranged on the turntable. The application has reasonable structural design and convenient use, and through the cooperation of the cutting mechanism, the polishing robot and the feeding mechanism, the whole processing process is realized by only installing the frame tube on the clamping assembly in the feeding mechanism by a worker, and one-time clamping can be used for two processing actions of cutting and deburring, thereby greatly improving the production efficiency.

title_en: Full-automatic feeding slope laser cutting equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides full-automatic feeding slope laser cutting equipment which comprises a lathe bed main body, a full-automatic feeding frame, a follow-up assembly, a rear clamping assembly and a front clamping assembly, a cutting head assembly and a cutting head assembly, wherein the full-automatic feeding frame is fixed on the lathe bed main body and used for automatically feeding pipes to a cutting station, the follow-up assembly is arranged on the lathe bed main body and used for lifting and adjusting the heights of the pipes with different diameters, the rear clamping assembly and the front clamping assembly are used for clamping and positioning the pipes, and the cutting head assembly comprises a Z-axis motor, an X-axis motor, a bevel motor and a cutting head, and the bevel motor can drive the cutting head to rotate for +/-45 degrees around the Y-axis direction to cut the bevel of the pipes. Through full-automatic material loading frame and stretch over material mechanism, keep off material subassembly, pushing components and fold the cooperation of material subassembly, realize the automatic feeding of whole bundle of tubular product, the cutting head subassembly is equipped with the groove motor and realizes that the cutting head is rotatory around Y axle + -45, can carry out groove cutting to the tubular product terminal surface, makes follow-up welded joint laminate more easily, improves welding quality and yield.

title_en: Multi-point adjustable planet carrier positioning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multipoint adjustable planet carrier positioning device which comprises a tool bottom plate, two first linear positioning mechanisms, two second linear positioning mechanisms, a clamp module and a magnetic attraction module, wherein the first linear positioning mechanisms are parallelly fixed on the tool bottom plate, the two second linear positioning mechanisms are arranged between the first linear positioning mechanisms in a sliding mode, the clamp module can slide along the second linear positioning mechanisms, the magnetic attraction module is arranged below the clamp module, the first linear positioning mechanism and the second linear positioning mechanism respectively comprise a guide rail with a linear motor module, each linear motor module can be independently controlled to drive the clamp module to position in an X plane and a Y plane, the magnetic attraction module is of an electromagnet structure and can be adsorbed and fixed on the tool bottom plate, a zero point positioning chuck is arranged at the top of the clamp module, a pneumatic locking mechanism is arranged in the clamp module, elastic lifting is realized between the magnetic attraction module and the clamp module through a sliding shaft-sliding cavity structure, and a quickly-changeable scraping plate is arranged to push away scraps.

title_en: Paste granule board production with pressing subsides device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of plate processing, in particular to a pressing device for producing a pressing particle plate, which comprises a machine body, wherein a top plate is welded at the top of the machine body, a hydraulic cylinder is connected to an inner bolt of the top plate, a movable plate is connected to an output end key of the hydraulic cylinder, a driving assembly and two groups of adjusting assemblies are arranged in the movable plate, one side of each adjusting assembly is meshed with one side of each driving assembly, and after the hydraulic cylinder is started, the output end of the hydraulic cylinder drives the movable plate to longitudinally displace. The pressing device for producing the pressing particle board is matched with the transverse plate through the swinging plate, and then the sliding block is pushed to displace in a mode of pushing the transverse plate when the swinging plate swings, and the position of the pressing plate is changed through the movement of the sliding block, so that the device can conveniently adjust the pressing working range, and further the device can adapt to particle boards with different sizes and different specifications, and the situation that partial areas are not pressed in place or uneven in pressure distribution is avoided.

title_en: Clamping conveying device for machining
abstract_en: The application discloses a clamping and conveying device for machining, which relates to the field of clamping and conveying equipment and comprises a machining table, wherein two clamping rails are arranged above the machining table in parallel, first driving mechanisms for driving the two clamping rails to perform centering or separating movement are arranged on two sides of the clamping rails, elastic clamping assemblies for clamping workpieces are arranged on adjacent sides of the two clamping rails, lifting pieces for driving the first driving mechanisms to lift are arranged on two sides of the machining table, and a second driving mechanism for driving the elastic clamping assemblies to move with the workpieces is arranged on one side of the machining table. The application not only can carry out self-adaptive adjustment according to the small size difference of the same workpiece and stably clamp the workpiece, but also can adjust the clamping distance according to different types of workpieces, and has strong adaptability.

title_en: Shaft sleeve machining centering device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of shaft sleeve processing, and discloses a shaft sleeve processing centering device, which comprises a base, wherein the upper surface of the base is connected with two centering components in a sliding manner, the centering components comprise a moving block, the upper surface of the moving block is fixedly provided with two fixed rings, and one side surface, close to each other, of each fixed ring is connected with a rotating ring in a rotating manner. This axle sleeve processing centering device carries out centering centre gripping through setting up the both ends of two centering subassemblies to the axle sleeve at the upper surface of base, at the in-process of centre gripping, drives the swivel becket through the electric putter and rotates, and the rotation of swivel becket drives the removal cover and removes, through the articulated of removal cooperation flitch and the solid fixed ring of removal cover for the supporting wheel that corresponds moves to the center in step, accomplishes the centre gripping to the axle sleeve, drives the regulation that the track piece removed two centering subassembly intervals through the rotation of two-way threaded rod simultaneously, and then the axle sleeve of different length of adaptation.

title_en: Handle-free slot cutter
abstract_en: The utility model provides a pair of exempt from to draw in groove sword, including handle of a knife, tool bit and cutting edge, the tool bit sets up the one end of handle of a knife, the tool bit includes cutting part and connecting portion, cutting part passes through connecting portion with the handle of a knife is connected, cutting part is used for slotting and cuts, the cutting edge slope sets up the handle of a knife surface, and sets up the tool bit top; adopt above-mentioned technical scheme, this application is with tool bit part and cutting edge part separately design, during the fluting, earlier use the tool bit to carry out the fluting, reuse cutting edge part cuts out the limit, the components of a whole that can function independently design has improved the life of exempting from the handle slotting cutter greatly to during the fluting, and compare in traditional slotting cutter saw-dust discharge more quick more high-efficient, and the oblique sword releases down the cutting force along with handle of a knife operation, has continuous down force when letting panel fluting, lets slotted panel not shift and not the off tracking fluting precision is higher.

title_en: Old glue stripping device of belt roller
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of glue removing equipment, and particularly discloses a device for stripping old glue of a belt roller, which comprises a workbench and a motor I, wherein the motor I is fixedly connected with the workbench, the output end of the motor I is provided with a chuck I, the workbench is provided with a sliding mechanism and a moving mechanism, the sliding mechanism is fixedly connected with a baffle plate, a bearing is arranged on the baffle plate, a rotating shaft is fixedly connected with an inner ring of the bearing, the other end of the rotating shaft is fixedly connected with a chuck II, the moving mechanism is positioned on one side of the sliding mechanism, and a blade is detachably connected with the moving mechanism. According to the utility model, the belt roller is clamped by the two chucks, the roller is driven to rotate by the motor, and then the blade is driven to move by the moving mechanism, so that the old adhesive layer of the roller is rapidly removed, and the problems that the old adhesive layer of the roller is not completely removed, residual old adhesive exists and the working efficiency is low in the manual removal of the old adhesive layer of the roller in the prior art are solved.

title_en: Precision tool holder
abstract_en: A tool holder including a main body, an activation button coupled to the main body, a tool securing portion at least in directly coupled to the activation button, wherein the activation button can be activated into a first state for coupling a tool to the tool holder and a second state for decoupling a tool from the tool holder.

title_en: Milling tool with helix angle transition
abstract_en: The invention relates to a milling tool (1) having a front end (2), a rear end (3), and a longitudinal axis (C) extending therebetween, wherein the milling tool comprises a shank portion (4) and a cutting portion (5). The cutting portion extends along the longitudinal axis from the front end towards the shank portion, and comprises a plurality of teeth (6) separated from each other by a corresponding number of flutes (7), wherein the teeth (6) extend axially along the cutting portion (5) following a curved helical path around the longitudinal axis. Each tooth (6) extends at a first helix angle (α) from the front end (2) to a helix transition (8), and at a second helix angle (β) from the helix transition towards the shank portion. The second helix angle (β) is greater than the first helix angle (α) by at least 2° and at most 15°. The first helix angle (α) fulfills 33° ≤ α ≤ 50°, whereas the second helix angle (β) fulfills 40° ≤ β ≤ 55°, and the helix transition (8) is axially located within a distance, from the front end (2), of 0.2 to 0.7 of the longitudinal length of the cutting portion (5).

title_en: Welding jig device and production method for component
abstract_en: To facilitate a welding operation. A device is used for forming a part (5) by welding a plurality of members (W) together, and includes a jig (10) on one side having a joint face (12) on one side, which is adapted to contact one of faces (W11) exposed on the outer surface sides of the plurality of members (W) overlaid one on top of the other, and an opening (13) on one side corresponding to a portion of desired welded portions (53) of the part (5); a jig (20) on another side having a joint face (22) on the other side, which is adapted to contact another face (W21) of the faces exposed on the outer surface sides of the plurality of members (W), and an opening (23) on the other side corresponding to another portion of the desired welded portions (53) of the part (5) and not corresponding to the opening (13) on one side; a laser welding machine (2A) on one side that is configured to emit a laser beam toward the opening (13) on one side; and a laser welding machine (2B) on the other side that is configured to emit a laser beam toward the opening (23) on the other side.

title_en: Hand held power tool
abstract_en: The present specification relates to a hand held power tool (1) comprising a housing (10), the housing (10) comprising a back handle portion (20) at a back end thereof. And a front handle (40) portion at a front end thereof, wherein a motor is arranged in the back handle portion (20) and coupled to an outgoing axle (50) extending through the front handle portion (40). Wherein the front handle portion (40) comprises an inner tubular structure (60) and an outer tubular gripping sleeve (70). The outer tubular gripping sleeve (70) is circumferentially supported by at least two vibration absorbing resilient elements (81, 82) arranged around the inner tubular structure (60), such that a circumferential gap is formed between the inner tubular structure (60) and the outer tubular gripping sleeve (70).

title_en: Method to increase barrier film removal rate in bulk tungsten slurry
abstract_en: The invention relates to a chemical-mechanical polishing composition comprising (a) a first abrasive comprising cationically modified colloidal silica particles, (b) a second abrasive having a Mohs hardness of about 5.5 or more, (c) a cationic polymer, (d) an iron containing activator, (e) an oxidizing agent, and (f) water. The invention also relates to a method of chemically mechanically polishing a substrate, especially a substrate comprising tungsten and barrier layers (e.g., nitrides), with the polishing composition.

title_en: A method and a system for controlling an actuator of a ram of a press
abstract_en: The method and the system for controlling a cylinder actuator (115) of a ram of a press comprises: a motor group (101) that actuates a pumping group (102); a ram that is hydraulically connected by a hydraulic system with the motor group (101) and/or pumping group (102) and that is movably actuated between a first stroke of approach to a piece to be worked, a second working stroke of the piece to be worked, and a third return stroke from a worked piece; an accumulator (105) being connected with a chamber (113) on the rod side of the cylinder actuator (115), a pressure reducer (108) to control the pressure inside the accumulator (105), in which the motor group (101) connected with the pumping group (102) controls the approach stroke and/or the working stroke and/or the return stroke.

title_en: Method for electrical discharge machining
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and device for electrical Wire electrical discharge machining method (WEDM) for forming a desired pattern on a workpiece by a WEDM machine tool, in which a preliminary voltage pulse is applied to a gap between a wire electrode and a workpiece, and in which, at the breakdown of said preliminary voltage pulse, a first machining discharge pulse is applied to the wire electrode. A discharge position of said first machining discharge pulse along the engagement line of the wire electrode and the workpiece is determined in real time based on the voltage signals and/or current signals generated by said first machining discharge pulse,and that at least one additional machining discharge pulse is selectively applied directly after the first machining discharge pulse, in which said selective application of the additional machining discharge pulse is based on the determined discharge position and based on a digital pattern representing the desired pattern.

title_en: Machining line system
abstract_en: Provided is a machining line system comprising a plate material supply device capable of supplying a plate material so as to improve production efficiency. This machining line system 101 comprises: a machining device 102 which machines a plate material 100; a plate material feeding device 103 which intermittently conveys the plate material 106 to the machining device 102; and a plate material supply device 104 which supplies the plate material 106 from an uncoiler 105 to the plate material feeding device 103, wherein the plate material supply device 104 is configured to be capable of changing the speed of supplying the plate material 106 to the plate material feeding device 103 according to steps of the machining device 102 for the plate material 106.

title_en: Method for connecting an electrical aluminium line to a connection element made of a metal material of a different kind
abstract_en: A method for connecting an electrical line (8), comprising at least one wire made of an aluminium or an aluminium alloy, to a connection element (9) which consists of a metal material of a different kind as compared to the electrical line (8), and a device for carrying out the method are to be developed by the invention such that electrical connections that are stable for long periods between electrical lines (8) made of aluminium or an aluminium alloy and connection elements (9) made of a metal material of a different kind, for example copper, are ensured and additionally can be created quickly and economically. To this end it is proposed that a compression process with breakup of the aluminium oxide layers and a subsequent welding process without an interruption to the pressure and without a change in position between the electrodes (7, 10) of a resistance welding device are carried out.

title_en: Housing windows in personal care product
abstract_en: The present invention is directed to a personal care product (10) including a treatment sheet (40) having a lower surface (42), a housing (20) including a floor surface (280) and a plurality of columns (220), and a cavity (290) formed by a volume extending from the lower surface to the floor surface. The volume extends from an inner column wall (217) of the housing. The plurality of columns is formed in a side wall (210) of the housing. The cavity has a height H2 of at least one-fifteenth of a height HI of the personal care product and/or a height of at least about a height H3 of one of the columns. The columns extend upward from the floor surface of the housing or to a lower ledge (262) of a carrier (230) of the housing. The floor surface is flat or shaped (e.g., a dome or a cone shape). Fluid flows within the cavity, into and out of windows (260) between the columns.

title_en: Unloading device for a laser machining system
abstract_en: An unloading device (30) for unloading tubular or bar-shaped workpieces (13) from the unloading region (152) of a laser machining system (11) is provided, the unloading device (30) comprising: a guide element (32) which extends in a longitudinal direction (L) of the unloading device (30); two substantially U-shaped frame elements (34a, 34b) which are arranged on the guide element (32) parallel to one another and spaced apart from one another in the longitudinal direction (L); wherein each of the frame elements (34a, 34b) comprises a carrier belt (35) which is tensioned in order to receive the tubular or bar-shaped workpieces (13) in an upper region of the respective frame element (34a, 34b); wherein the carrier belt (35) is attached such that it can be lowered in the respective frame element (34a, 34b); and wherein the two frame elements (34a, 34b) can be moved along the guide element (32) in the longitudinal direction (L) of the unloading device (30). Furthermore, an unloading system comprising the unloading device (30) is provided.

title_en: Method of manufacturing a gripping surface for an end effector and surgical instrument comprising a gripping end effector
abstract_en: A manufacturing method by wire electro-erosion comprising the following steps of providing a wire electro-erosion machine (2) having a cutting wire (3); mounting at least one workpiece (11) to the wire electro-erosion machine; making a surface micro-topography by wire electro-erosion; performing a first through cut on the workpiece (11) according to a cutting path (21) comprising peaks (12) and valleys (13), thus exposing an exposed portion (14) on the workpiece (11) comprising reliefs (15) and recesses (16) corresponding to said peaks and valleys of the first cutting path (21). A surgical instrument comprises at least one gripping surface comprising a surface micro-topography.

title_en: Method and apparatus for calibrating crankshaft to be processed
abstract_en: A method for calibrating a crankshaft (10) to be processed is disclosed. The method comprises: causing a positioner (40) to rotate to at least three different angles, wherein the positioner (40) is configured to support the crankshaft (10) and drive the crankshaft (10) to rotate; causing, for each of the at least three different angles, a probe (20) arranged on a robot (30) to touch a plurality of points on a first cylindrical crankpin (101) of the crankshaft (10) respectively to obtain coordinates of the plurality of points in a robot coordinate system; fitting, for each of the at least three different angles, the coordinates of the plurality of points on the first cylindrical crankpin (101) respectively to obtain a respective pose of the first cylindrical crankpin (101) relative to the robot coordinate system; and determining a pose of a rotating axis of the crankshaft (10) relative to the robot coordinate system based on the respective pose of the first cylindrical crankpin (101). The pose of the rotating axis of the crankshaft (10) can be calibrated quickly and accurately. An apparatus for calibrating a crankshaft (10) to be processed is also disclosed.

title_en: Power tool with coupling mechanism
abstract_en: Disclosed herein is a power tool (1, 301) comprising a motor (4), a drive shaft (6) connected to the motor, the drive shaft defining a longitudinal axis (a), a front end (2, 102, 202, 302) having at least one through hole (32, 132, 232, 332), said front end defining a cavity (12, 112, 212, 312) comprising a tool side end (28, 128, 228, 328) 5and a free end (30, 130, 230, 330), and a coupling mechanism (10, 110, 210, 310) for releasably connecting a removable tool head (8, 308) to the drive shaft. The coupling mechanism comprises an outer sleeve (16, 116, 216, 316) arranged at least partially around the cavity, the coupling mechanism further comprises a first biasing element(18, 118, 218, 318), at least one ball (24, 124, 224, 324) arranged at least partially 10within the at least one through hole and on an inner side of the outer sleeve, the outer sleeve comprising an inclined inner surface (38, 138, 238, 338) and an inner projection (40, 140, 240, 340) adjacent to the inclined inner surface, the first biasing element being arranged at the front end abutting the outer sleeve and the front end, the coupling mechanism being arranged to be moved between an open position, in 15which the power tool can receive the removable tool head and a closed position, in which the removable tool head is connected to and locked in the power tool, whereby in the open position the at least one ball can be displaced in an outward direction away from the longitudinal axis (a) and in the closed position the displacement in the outward direction of the at least one ball is prevented by the inner projection of the 20outer sleeve, whereby the coupling mechanism further comprises an inner sleeve (20, 120, 220, 320) arranged at least partially within the cavity, and a second biasing element (22, 122, 222, 322) abutting the tool side end of the cavity and the inner sleeve, whereby in the open position the inner sleeve is preventing the inner projection from abutting the at least one ball.

title_en: Insert holder having weight-reducing voids and cutting tool
abstract_en: An insert holder (22) includes a cutting portion (38) and a shank portion (46). The insert holder further includes a cavity (56) which includes a cavity chamber (58) and a plurality of cavity through recesses (66) which serve to reduce the weight of the insert holder. The plurality of cavity through recesses open out to the cavity chamber and to the periphery of the shank portion. A cutting tool is provided having a cutting insert (24) releasably attached to the insert holder.

title_en: Chuck with lock sleeve
abstract_en: A chuck (300) may include a lock disk (380), a ball retainer (350), a lock sleeve (360), a wedge pin (371), and a pin drive spring (320). When the lock sleeve (360) is disposed in the locked position, the wedge pin (371) may be positioned by the pin drive spring (320) in a wedged engagement between a pin engaging surface of the ball retainer (350) and a lock disk wall (381) of the lock disk (380) to prevent rotation of a first sleeve (30) and a nut (40) relative to a body (41) in a first rotational direction but permit rotation in a second rotational direction.When the lock sleeve (360) is disposed in the unlocked position, the wedge pin (371) may be positioned by the pin drive spring (320) such that the wedge pin (371) is not in the wedged engagement to permit rotation of the first sleeve (30) and the nut (40) in the first rotational direction and second rotational direction.

title_en: Tube cutter for cutting a round tube and method for cutting a round tube to length
abstract_en: The invention relates to a tube cutter (1; 1.1) for cutting a round tube (100). The tube cutter (1; 1.1) comprises a main body (2; 2.1), a cutting device (3) assigned to the main body (2; 2.1), and a rotary guide (4) for the main body (2; 2.1). The rotary guide (4) is designed to rotatably receive the round tube (100) in order to allow for a rotation of the tube cutter (1; 1.1) about the central axis (110) of the round tube (100) along its outer circumference (120). The cutting device (3) has a cutting part (5) with a blade (6) lying in a cutting plane (7) and is designed such that, with a rotation of the tube cutter (1; 1.1) about the round tube (100), the blade (6) executes a circumferential cut (400) in the cutting plane (7). In the tube cutter (1; 1.1), at least one forming element (8) is also provided, which protrudes into the cutting plane (7) or is positioned at least in the cutting plane (7) and is designed such that, with the rotation of the tube cutter (1; 1.1) about the round tube (100), it acts in a forming manner on the outer circumference (120) of the round tube (100), in order to form a bevel (131; 141) at an end of at least one of the tube parts (130, 140), created by the cut (400) of the blade (6), by means of material displacement. The invention also relates to a method for cutting a round tube (100) to length.

title_en: Leak resistant joint forming apparatus and process
abstract_en: The invention provides a automatable joint forming apparatus and process forleak resistance assembly of a flexible fluid conduit to a rigid fluid conduitincluding insertion of the rigid conduit and a sliding shape conforming die.

title_en: Cavitation processing device and cavitation processing method
abstract_en: Provided is a cavitation processing apparatus for providing cavitation effects such as residual stress evenly on the surface and inner part of the component. The cavitation processing appratus includes: a nozzle 2 that ejects cavitation fluid C to a workpiece W; a direction changing member 3 that changes a flow direction of the cavitation fluid C that collided with the workpiece W to be branched toward inside; a driving apparatus 4 including a rotary shaft 4a, the driving apparatus 4 that rotates the workpiece W together with the rotary shaft 4a; and a support member 5 supporting one end of the rotary shaft 4a.

title_en: Cutting tool
abstract_en: Provided is a cutting tool, which relates to the technical field of tools. The cutting tool includes a housing, a battery pack coupling portion, an electric motor, a control motherboard, a control unit, and a display assembly. The battery pack coupling portion is configured to be connected to a battery pack for powering the cutting tool. The electric motor can drive a working accessory to rotate and is electrically connected to the control motherboard. The cutting tool further includes a display mechanism. The display mechanism includes the control unit and the display assembly. The control unit is electrically connected to the control motherboard. The display assembly is electrically connected to the control unit. When the control unit transmits an electrical signal to the display assembly, the display assembly displays a rotation direction of the electric motor or other information. Thus, a user intuitively observes a direction in which the electric motor currently drives or is about to drive a consumable accessory to rotate or the other information, thereby improving user experience.

title_en: Food product slicer and associated gauge plate slide assembly
abstract_en: A food product slicer includes a base, a knife mounted for rotation relative to the base, a carriage assembly mounted to the base for reciprocal movement back and forth past a cutting edge of the knife, and a gauge plate mounted for movement between a closed position that prevents slicing and multiple open positions that permit slicing at respective thicknesses. A gauge plate adjustment system includes a knob with an associated cam, a follower that is engaged with the cam and moved by rotation of the knob and cam, wherein the follower linked for moving the gauge plate, wherein the follower rides on a slide rail, wherein the slide rail comprises a plate member.

title_en: Safety razor, and connector and handle for a safety razor
abstract_en: A safety razor has a blade unit with a housing and a razor blade, and an elongated handle having a uniform thickness and having a first end including an aperture extending into the thickness, and an opposed second end. The safety razor also has a connector to connect the blade unit to the handle. A body of the connector has a recess with an opening, and a user-operable latch including a protrusion extending into the recess. The first end of the handle is removably received in the recess and the protrusion is received in the aperture to secure the handle to the connector. The protrusion is releasable from the aperture by a user-applied force to a lever at an end of the latch opposite the protrusion end to release the first end of the handle from the recess.

title_en: Flatbed laser cutting machine, system and method
abstract_en: The present disclosure concerns a flatbed laser cutting machine for cutting sheet metal workpieces (12). The machine comprises a laser cutting head (10), a processing laser source and a workpiece support for supporting a sheet metal workpiece (12), the machine being equipped for causing the laser cutting head (10) to move relative to the workpiece support in two dimensions and being equipped to emit a beam of processing laser radiation (21) from the laser cutting head for making a controlled cut in a workpiece (12). The machine further comprises a vibrometer (22) and is equipped for the laser cutting head (10) to emit vibrometer probing radiation (29), of the vibrometer (22). The machine is further equipped for a reflected portion of the vibrometer probing radiation to enter the laser cutting head (10) and to then be used for measuring vibration of the workpiece (12). Since radiation is used to measure the vibration, the vibration is measured in a contactless manner.

title_en: A clutch body ring and method of manufacturing thereof
abstract_en: A method (100) for forming a clutch body (CB) ring includes a step of preparing a machined blank (W4); and carrying out a first cold forging (110) operation on the machined blank (W4). The machined blank (W4) is compressed within a cavity of a die for forming a partial spline teeth on the machined blank (W4) during the first cold forging (110) operation. Further, the method (100) includes another step of carrying out a second cold forging (112) operation on the first cold forged blank (W5) such that a pair of roof angles and a teeth back taper (204) are forged on each tooth of the partial spline teeth of the first cold forged blank (W5) to form a second cold forged blank (W6).

title_en: Apparatus and method for bending bars
abstract_en: Apparatus for bending bars comprising an input for receiving a plurality of bars for bending, a bending device for bending at least one bar and a transfer unit for transferring at least one bar from said input to said bending device, wherein the apparatus further comprises a rotating mechanism arranged for rotating a bar along its longitudinal axis towards a predefined orientation on the bending device, wherein the rotating mechanism is movable along a longitudinal axis of the bar between an engaged position for engaging and rotating the bar and a disengaged position.

title_en: CLAMPING DEVICE FOR A PIECE TO BE WELDED (Machine-translation by Google Translate, not legally binding)
abstract_en: Device (1) for holding a piece to be welded (10) comprising: - at least one contact surface (2) with the piece to be welded (10), - at least one protective gas supply conduit (3), - at least one main chamber (4), - at least one uniformization chamber (5) adjacent to the main chamber (4), where said uniformization chamber comprises: a first separating wall (5a) with a plurality of perforations (6); and at least one outlet surface (7) which in turn comprises a region (7a) adjacent to the contact surface (2), where the region (7a) adjacent to the contact surface (2) comprises a plurality of alveoli (8), and where the at least one supply conduit (3) is fluidically connected to the main chamber (4), the uniformization chamber (5) and the outlet surface (7).  (Machine-translation by Google Translate, not legally binding)

title_en: Wear-resistant film layer, method for forming the same, cutter ring for roller cutter for shield machine, roller cutter for shield machine, and shield machine
abstract_en: To provide a wear-resistant film layer, a method for forming the same, a cutter ring for a roller cutter for a shield machine, a roller cutter for a shield machine, and a shield machine.SOLUTION: A wear-resistant film layer 1 includes at least two basically similar brazing material film layers. The brazing material film layer is formed of a material containing 3 to 10 parts by mass of fine diamond powder, 2 to 6 parts by mass of an alcohol solvent, 1 to 5 parts by mass of sodium fluoride, and 81 to 93 parts by mass of nickel brazing material. The wear-resistant film layer 1 is a film layer formed of a plurality of basically similar thin film layers. The overlay welding method alleviates the problem of thermal stress when forming a thick film layer, suppresses cracking and expansion to some extent, and can contribute to improving the uniformity of diamond fine powder, which is a hard phase. It has the advantages of small thermal damage, high uniformity of the hard phase, and less peeling.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Cutter for cutting processing
abstract_en: To provide a cutter for cutting processing configured so that positional shift of a notch generation blade with respect to a cutter main body can be effectively prevented.SOLUTION: A cutter 1 for cutting processing for forming a slit on a sheet material comprises a cutter main body 2, grooving blades 3 that form slits, and a notch generation blade 4 that forms an end part of the slits. The cutter main body 2 is formed in a fan-shape and comprises a bolt hole 21 at one end side thereof, and the grooving blades 3 are provided along both side edges respectively in a thickness direction of the cutter main body 2. The notch generation blade 4 comprises an attachment part 41 that is detachably attached to one end side of the cutter main body 2 and a blade edge part 42 formed at one end part of the attachment part 41. The attachment part 41 is formed to correspond to the bolt hole 21 of the cutter main body 2, and comprises a through-hole in a long hole-shape disposed along a radial direction of the cutter main body 2 and a rough surface part formed on one-side surface at a side at which the part contacts a bolt head that a bolt 50 installed in the bolt hole 21 through the through-hole has.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: High chromium creep resistant weld metal for arc welding of thick walled steel members
abstract_en: To provide a high chromium creep resistant weld metal for arc welding of thick walled steel members.SOLUTION: Steel weld metal compositions can include from 10.75 to 12.00 wt.% chromium, from 0.09 to 0.13 wt.% carbon, from 0.2 to 0.5 wt.% manganese, from 0.1 to 0.3 wt.% silicon, from 0.2 to 0.7 wt.% nickel, from 0.1 to 0.5 wt.% molybdenum, from 0.8 to 1.2 wt.% cobalt, from 0.03 to 0.08 wt.% niobium, from 0.8 to 1.2 wt.% tungsten, from 0.3 to 0.8 wt.% copper, from 0.10 to 0.15 wt.% vanadium, from 0.01 to 0.05 wt.% titanium, from 0.005 to 0.010 wt.% boron, from 0.005 to 0.015 wt.% nitrogen; wherein the balance of the steel weld metal composition is iron and unavoidable impurities. Methods of depositing the steel weld metal compositions on a workpiece by an electric arc welding process are also described. Consumable electric arc welding electrodes producing high chromium creep resistant steel weld metal compositions are also described.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Heat exchanger and its manufacturing method
abstract_en: To provide a heat exchanger capable of reducing the number of components and the number of assembling works.SOLUTION: A heat exchanger P1 includes an exterior body 2 having a skin part composed of a laminate material in which a resin layer is laminated on at least one surface of a metallic heat transfer layer. The exterior body 2 is divided into an intermediate connection portion 22, a one-side heat transfer portion 21 disposed at one side of the intermediate connection portion 22, and an other-side heat transfer portion 21 disposed at the other side, and is constituted so that the one-side heat transfer portion 21 and the other-side heat transfer portion 21 are arranged in parallel at an interval to each other through the intermediate connection portion 22 formed in a folded manner, and a heat exchange medium flowing from an inlet/outlet 25 of the one-side heat transfer portion 21, circulates in the one-side heat transfer portion 21, the intermediate connection portion 22 and the other-side heat transfer portion 21, and flows out from an inlet/outlet 25 of the other-side heat transfer portion 21.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Outer ring pressing structure of bearing and spindle device
abstract_en: To provide an outer ring pressing structure of a bearing for preventing the deformation of an outer ring raceway by equalizing a fastening margin, and elongating a life of the bearing.SOLUTION: An outer ring pressing structure of a bearing comprises a housing 5 having a fitment inner face for fitting an outer ring 9 of the bearing 6 thereto, and an outer ring pressing member 16 attached to the housing 5, and pressing an end face of the outer ring 9 in an axial direction. The housing 5 comprises a plurality of screw holes 18 formed at the end face in the axial direction with intervals in a peripheral direction, and the outer ring pressing member 16 comprises a circular disc-shaped outer ring pressing face 16a which tightly adheres to the end face of the outer ring 9, a plurality of penetration holes 21 formed outside the outer ring pressing face 16 in a radial direction, and making bolts 22 to be fastened penetrate the screw holes 18, and a stiffness reduction part 23 arranged between the outer ring pressing face 16a and the penetration holes 21, and locally reducing the stiffness of the outer ring pressing member 16.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Soundproof cover for crushing tool
abstract_en: To provide a soundproof cover for a crushing tool which is compactly attached to a tool body, achieves high sound insulation, and prevents reduction of a striking force of a crusher.SOLUTION: A soundproof cover for a crushing tool is used for a crushing tool which vertically moves a crusher attached to a lower end of a tool body 20 with a pressure of high pressure air and is attached to an outer periphery of the tool body 20 so as to cover an exhaust port 26 of the tool body 20. The soundproof cover is formed by an elastic body including: fastening cylinder parts 2, 3 disposed along the outer periphery of the tool body 20 above and below the exhaust port 26; and a sound absorption cylinder part 4 which is an intermediate portion disposed between the fastening cylinder parts 2, 3 and forms a space with the outer periphery of the tool body 20. A peripheral wall of the sound absorption cylinder part 4 has a wavy shape in which mountain lines 4a and trough lines 4b extend in a vertical direction. Further, a net-like cushioning material 5 is stretched at the inner side of the peripheral wall of the sound absorption cylinder part 4 and exhaust passages 7, each of which allows an inner upper part and an outer lower part of the peripheral wall of the sound absorption cylinder part 4 to communicate with each other, are formed.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: impact rotary tool
abstract_en: To reduce vibrations in a radial direction that are caused when tightening an object to be tightened.SOLUTION: An impact rotary tool 10 comprises an anvil 1 that transmits impact rotating force from a hammer 30 to a tip tool 20. The anvil 1 is constituted of a first member 11 and a second member 12. The first member 11 holds the tip tool 20. The second member 12 is fitted with the first member 11 and is applied with the impact rotating force. A fitted part 100 which is a part at which the first member 11 and the second member 12 are fitted to each other has permitting mechanisms (111A and 121A). The permitting mechanisms (111A and 121A) permit a first rotating shaft AX1 to directionally deviate with respect to a second rotating shaft AX2. The first rotating shaft AX1 is a rotating shaft of the first member 11 and the second rotating shaft AX2 is a rotating shaft of the second member 12.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Method of brazing
abstract_en: To provide a method of brazing that can increase a brazing length without using an intermediate member when brazing a stainless-steel base material having low-wettability to a brazing material.SOLUTION: A method of brazing includes a step of brazing a first stainless-steel plate 21 including a metal susceptible to oxidation more than Cr to a second stainless-steel plate 22 substantially not including a metal susceptible to oxidation more than Cr.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Grinding device and wafer grinding method
abstract_en: To provide a grinding device for performing grinding by a first grindstone and a second grindstone which uniformizes grinding time and grinding amounts for respective chuck tables at the time of grinding by the second grindstone, and achieves efficient wafer grinding.SOLUTION: A grinding device includes a turntable (30) where a plurality of chuck tables (31) are arranged, wherein a control part (80) positions the chuck tables at a first grinding position where a wafer (90) is ground by a first grindstone (51) and a second grinding position where the wafer is ground by a second grindstone (61), a first inclination control part (81) controls an inclination adjustment mechanism (33), sets a chuck spindle (312) of the chuck table positioned at the first grinding position at an angle previously set relative to a first spindle (52), and a second inclination control part (82) controls the inclination adjustment mechanism, and sets the chuck spindle of the chuck table positioned at the second grinding position at an angle previously set relative to a second spindle (62).SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Electronic device and welding device including the same
abstract_en: To provide an electronic device capable of surely preventing unauthorized access from another electronic device connected to a USB terminal.SOLUTION: A welding power source 10, which is an electronic device, is configured to be able to connect to a USB memory 80 and includes at least an input section 12, a display section 16, a USB connection section 17, and a USB control section 14. When the USB memory 80 is connected to the USB connection section 17, the USB control section 14 permits power supply to the USB connection section 17 and permits access from the USB memory 80 to the welding power source 10 if a password input from the input section 12 matches a predetermined password. If the password does not match the predetermined password, the USB control section 14 prohibits the power supply to the USB connection section 17 to prohibit the access from the USB memory 80 to the welding power source 10.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Break setting device and cutting apparatus
abstract_en: To improve the inefficient work which is performed when pre-forming multiple unit sheets into strips from a sheet-like indeterminate-shaped object, and which includes: manually weighing each unit sheet after cutting, to inspect whether or not each unit sheet is within a specified weight range; and removing sheets that are not within the specified weight.SOLUTION: A break setting device 10 according to the present invention includes a placing stand 12 on which a kneaded rubber sheet GS is placed, multiple thickness detection sensors 13 which detect a thickness h of each part of the kneaded rubber sheet GS, and a transport mechanism 14 which supports a group of the thickness detection sensors 13 movably in XYZ axial directions orthogonal to each other on a base 11. The break setting device sets a break L for each target weight Mt (target volume Vt) for the kneaded rubber sheet GS. The transport mechanism 14 includes a pressure roller 15 that is located on a front side in the relative movement direction with respect to the group of thickness detection sensors 13 and presses a surface of the kneaded rubber sheet GS on the placing stand 12.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Wafer Processing Method
abstract_en: To easily remove a ring-shaped reinforcing portion of a wafer by efficiently forming a separation groove for separating a circular recessed portion and the ring-shaped reinforcing portion in a short time, regardless of the step between the circular recessed portion and the ring-shaped reinforcing portion.SOLUTION: A wafer processing method includes: a first fixing step of fixing the back surface of a wafer W to a first resin sheet S1 such that the first resin sheet S1 conforms to a circular recess W1 and a ring-shaped reinforcing portion W2 of the wafer W; a second fixing step of fixing a second resin sheet S2 to the first resin sheet S1 fixed to the ring-shaped reinforcing portion W2 to form a cavity S between the first resin sheet S1 and the second resin sheet S2 corresponding to the circular recess W1 after the first fixing step; a holding step of holding the second resin sheet S2 of the wafer W on a chuck table 1 after the second fixing step; and a groove forming step of forming a separation groove Wa that separates the circular recess W1 and the ring-shaped reinforcing portion W2.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Metal plate connecting method
abstract_en: To provide a metal plate connecting method which can rigidly and accurately connect even metal plates that are made from different kinds of materials from each other.SOLUTION: A metal plate connecting method of the present invention includes: forming a through-hole at the same locations on a plurality of metal plates vertically stacked on each other; inserting into the through-hole a plug having a cross-sectional shape approximately equal to the cross-sectional shape of the through-hole and having a higher hardness than both of the metal plates; pressurizing the periphery of the plug at least on the surfaces of outermost two metal plates of the stacked metal plates and causing the metal plates to plastically deform in a surface direction of the plug to apply a fastening stress to the plug, thereby connecting the plurality of metal plates to each other through the plug.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Method for applying residual stress and steel pipe with residual stress applied thereto
abstract_en: To provide a method for applying residual stress by which it is possible to apply compressive residual stress to an internal surface of a steel pipe.SOLUTION: A method for applying residual stress is intended to apply compressive residual stress to an internal surface of a steel pipe 10. The method includes a compression step of disposing a first member 20 on one side in a radial direction of the steel pipe 10 and a second member 30 on the other side, and bringing the first member 20 and the second member 30 close to each other so as to compress the steel pipe 10 in the radial direction. The first member 20 establishes line contact with an external surface of the steel pipe 10, and the second member 30 establishes surface contact or line contact with the external surface of the steel pipe 10.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Web switching device and web switching method
abstract_en: To provide a web switching device and a web switching method capable of keeping the joints and cut portions of a web in good condition and switching the web without adversely affecting the process after switching.SOLUTION: The web switching device switches a web whose length direction is the conveying direction from a first web to a second web by joining the first web and the second web. The web switching device comprises pressure joining means, first web contact means and a cutting blade that cuts the first web when at least one of the first web contact means or the cutting blade moves.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Wafer grinding device
abstract_en: To provide a wafer grinding device capable of grinding a wafer in a state where a grindstone unit that grinds the wafer is accurately mounted.SOLUTION: A grinding device 1 includes a spindle 4 that is provided in a vertically movable manner and rotates about a rotation shaft CL, and a mounting section 6 that automatically magnetically attaches a grindstone unit 5 to the spindle 4, and grinds a wafer 10 by rotating the grindstone unit 5 mounted by the mounting section 6. A pipe 44 is inserted through the rotation shaft CL of the spindle 4, and air is made to pass through the pipe 44. A pressure sensor 92 detects the mounting state of the grindstone unit 5.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: Coating part and coating tool including coating part
abstract_en: To provide a coating part with a high-durability diamond film when used, the diamond film with a high-adhesion being stably deposited in production.SOLUTION: A coating part includes a base material, and a hard film that is formed on a surface of the base material and has multiple layers. The hard film is constituted so as to have a diamond layer constituted of polycrystalline diamond, and a carbon layer that is formed between the surface of the base material and the diamond layer, constituted of a carbon-based material, and has a hardness higher than that of the diamond layer.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Welding teaching system, welding teaching method, welding teaching control method, and welding teaching control program
abstract_en: To secure legal safety and conduct teaching related to welding of a robot.SOLUTION: A welding teaching system includes: a control device which selects, on the basis of a distance between a welding torch of a welding robot and a workpiece being an object to be welded, one of a first teaching mode or a second teaching mode as a teaching method for causing a welding robot to operate during welding; and a display device which presents the selected teaching method so that a worker can grasp the result intuitively.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Method for producing marked product
abstract_en: To provide a method for producing a marked product, which is increased in machining speed.SOLUTION: This method for producing the marked product comprises: conveying an object on a conveyance path; disposing a beam forming mechanism for forming a regular intensity distribution of laser beams by splitting the laser beams generated from a laser oscillator in accordance with a prescribed pattern or blocking some of the laser beams in accordance with a prescribed pattern between the laser oscillator and the conveyance path; disposing a mask member in which a transmission pattern corresponding to a design of a mark added to the object is formed between the laser oscillator and the conveyance path; generating laser beams from the laser oscillator; and irradiating the currently conveyed object with the laser beams passed through the beam forming mechanism and the mask member. The advancing directions of the laser beams emitted from the beam forming mechanism is one direction which is similar to the advancing direction entering the beam forming mechanism.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Processing mechanism, medium processing apparatus, processing method, and program
abstract_en: To suppress rotation of a cutting blade during movement between cutting positions when cutting a sheet-like medium.SOLUTION: A processing mechanism for cutting media (S) includes a blade shaft (55a) having a cutting blade (56) at a tip end thereof, the cutting blade (56) being configured to be pressed against the media to cut the media, a blade shaft holder (51) configured to rotatably hold the blade shaft via a bearing (52), and a magnetic body mechanism (54) configured to attract the blade shaft in a direction opposite to a direction in which the blade shaft is pressed against the media.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Welding bead inspection apparatus
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a welding bead inspection device and more specifically, capable of precisely inspecting a welding bead. The welding bead inspection device inspecting whether there is a defect of the welding bead (20) of a pipe (10) comprises: a housing (100) surrounding the pipe (10) to cover the welding bead (20) and forming an inner sealed inspection space (S); an inspection means (200) installed in the housing (100) to check a state of the welding bead (20) in the inspection space (S); and a defect determination unit determining whether there is the defect of the welding bead (20) based on the state of the welding bead (20) checked through the inspection means (200).

title_en: Apparatus for decommissioning pressure heavy water reactor facilities
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for dismantling a heavy water reactor facility, which comprises: a withdrawal unit for withdrawing a double tube including a calandria tube extending in a horizontal direction inside a calandria supported by a calandria vault and a pressure tube positioned inside the calandria tube, in the horizontal direction from the calandria; a heating unit disposed adjacent to the calandria in the horizontal direction, and heating the double tube withdrawn from the calandria by the withdrawal unit; a compression cutting unit disposed adjacent to the heating unit in the horizontal direction, compressing the heated double tube and cutting the same into a chip-shaped cut object; and a packaging unit positioned at a lower side of the compression cutting unit, and packaging the cut object dropped from the compression cutting unit. Therefore, the calandria tube and the pressure tube positioned inside the calandria are withdrawn to the outside to be dismantled.

title_en: Seaming apparatus
