abstract_en: The present application relates to a laser energy delivering system for an additive manufacturing system and corresponding additive manufacturing systems utilizing an optical light valve (10) configured to spatially modulate the intensity of a laser beam (12), in conjunction with a writing and erasing subsystem (14) configured to repeatedly write and erase patterns in the optical light valve (10) to repeatedly vary the spatial modulation of the laser beam (12). In some implementations, the systems employ additional laser beams or other energy sources that are not spatially modulated by the optical light valve (10). In some implementations, the systems employ additional laser beams or other energy sources configured to reduce surface roughness of the powder or other material being used for additive manufacturing.

title_en: Air-floating guide rail type switchable rigid-flexible coupling motion platform
abstract_en: An air-floating guide rail type switchable rigid-flexible coupling motion platform, comprising: an air-floating guide rail (1), a rigid-flexible coupling platform (2), a driving component (3), a detection component (4) and a contact switching device (5), wherein the rigid-flexible coupling platform (2) comprises a frame (21), a working platform (22) and a flexible hinge component (23); and the working platform (22) is connected to the frame (21) by means of the flexible hinge assembly (23). When working, a long-stroke motion is realized by means of the air-floating guide rail (1), and nano-level positioning is realized by means of the elastic deformation of a flexible hinge of the rigid-flexible coupling platform (2). When the motion stroke is greater than the maximum deformation of the flexible hinge, the contact switching device (5) controls the frame (21) and the air-floating guide rail (1) such that same are switched to a non-contact state, and the rigid-flexible coupling platform (2) moves freely; and when the error of displacement of the motion platform is less than the maximum deformation of the flexible hinge, the frame (21) and the air-floating guide rail (1) are switched to a contact state, so that the fluctuation, on the air-floating guide rail (1), of the frame (21) of the rigid-flexible coupling platform (2) is eliminated, such that the precision of a nano platform can be achieved.

title_en: Hair cutter cap and hair cutter with cap
abstract_en: :A cap for a hair cutter and a corresponding hair cutter is provided. The cap (10) comprises a body (12) comprising a main surface (120) facing towards a subject; and a protrusion (14) protruding from the main surface (120) along a first direction (L1) perpendicular to the main surface (120). The protrusion (14) comprises a plurality of ribs (140) extending along a second direction (L2) perpendicular to the first direction (L1), the plurality of ribs (140) parallel to each other and spaced apart from each other in a third direction (L3) perpendicular to the first and second directions (L1, L2).

title_en: Ultra-lightweight steel wheel for commercial vehicle
abstract_en: The present application relates to an ultra-lightweight steel wheel (1) for a commercial vehicle. The steel wheel has excellent material properties and advanced design. The wheel consists of a rim (2) for mounting a tire and spokes (3) having a hub flange (5) for detachably connecting to a wheel hub or axle. The rim (2) and/or the spokes (3) are made of a steel material having a carbon content between 0.18 wt% and 0.37 wt%, and which has been heat treated and hardened. The spokes (3) and/or the rim (2) primarily are primarily formed from a martensite microstructure and have a tensile strength of at least 900 MPa. A maximum thickness (T3) of the rim (2) is less than 4.50 mm, and/or a maximum thickness (T1) of the spokes (3) is less than 12.00 mm. A wheel diameter (D) multiplied by a wheel width (W), then divided by a wheel mass, is greater than 4000mm 2 /kg.

title_en: Ratcheting open wrench
abstract_en: A compact three torque application point, ratcheting open- wrench, wherein the operated first and third torque application points are under tension gripping and pulling around their corresponding fastener driven half face whilst the second torque application point is under compression pushing its corresponding fastener driven half face. Contact with the worked fastener driven half faces being in generally the same point within each driven half face largely equalizing any lever arm force applied. The head portion fastener access being approximately at 90 degrees to the handle portion and the second torque application points radiused leading edge is incorporated near the extremely strong point of convergence between the handle portion and the head portion resulting in a far greater inherent ratcheting open- wrench torque capability as there is now no circumstance that the normally susceptible second jaw can either flex or fail as in effect there is no second jaw as such.

title_en: Coil feeding device for electroportable tools
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a power supply device for coils for a portable electric tool (20), said portable electric tool comprising a casing (40) forming a cylinder (10) in which a movable piston (1) slides between a start position at the start of travel of the piston and an end position at the end of travel of the piston. More specifically, the power supply device comprises: at least one battery intended to supply power to the coils; a first, fixed coil (4) located in the cylinder (10) at the start of travel of the movable piston (1); a second, movable coil (5) located facing the first, fixed coil (4) and secured to the movable piston (1); and power supply routing means (61, 62) for the second, movable coil (5), these means being secured to the piston and intended to channel the power supply from the battery so as to supply power, preferably in series, to the first, fixed coil (4) and the second, movable coil (5). Each power supply routing means being configured to cooperate with connectors (71, 72), each of which is connected to one and the same terminal of the battery over at least a displacement distance (X) of the piston between the start position and the end position of the piston, said distance (X) being less than or equal to a distance (D) corresponding to the maximum distance travelled by the piston between the start position and the end position.

title_en: Tapered lobular surgical driver and implant system and technique for disengaging driver during surgery
abstract_en: A surgical technique can be performed utilizing a detachable driver-implant system and comparatively small surgical incision. The clinician can make an incision through the skin of the patient and retract the skin along the incision to expose a first bone region. The clinician can insert an implant into one or more bone portions using a detachable driver-implant system and then detach the driver, leaving the implant in the one or more bone portions. The clinician can reposition the skin of the patient at least partially over the end of the implant to expose a second bone region not exposed while the first bone region was exposed. After optionally performing one or more surgical steps on second bone region, the clinician can reposition the skin to again expose the first bone region. The clinician can then reattach the driver to the implant and remove the implant from the bone portions.

title_en: Method and device for intermittently supplying a strip- or wire-form semifinished material to a press
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for intermittently supplying a strip- or wire-form semifinished material to a press, preferably to a punch press. In the process, the semifinished material to be supplied is fed in a feeding phase by means of a sliding gripper (14) which is driven by a first drive (1) during feeding. In a non-feeding phase, the semifinished material to be supplied is held fast by means of a stationary clamping gripper (18) and the sliding gripper (14) is retracted by a second drive (6) which is formed separately from the first drive (1). The method according to the invention makes it possible to optimize the drive in servo-gripper feeds. The use according to the invention of separate drives (1, 6) for the feeding movement and the retracting movement of the sliding gripper (14) makes a distinct downtime available for each of the drives (1, 6), with the result that, compared with the currently known solutions, with the same feed performance, a clear reduction in thermal load becomes possible or, with the same thermal load, a clear increase in the drive performance becomes possible.

title_en: Laser irradiation method and laser irradiation device
abstract_en: The present invention comprises: a photonic-crystal surface-emitting laser (PCSEL) element (110) that emits a laser beam (LB); a laser head (24) that condenses the laser beam (LB) with a condensing lens (27) at optical transmission paths (25, 30) through spatial propagation of the laser beam (LB) emitted from the PCSEL element (110); and movement mechanisms (22, 23, 24) that, through the relative movement, along the optical axis direction of the laser beam (LB), of the condenser lens (27) relative to an irradiation target object (W) of the laser beam (LB), causes the irradiation target object W to be irradiated with the laser beam (LB) condensed by the condenser lens (27) at any irradiation position within a Rayleigh length (Z R ) range regardless of a beam waist (BW) position in the optical axis direction of the laser beam (LB).

title_en: Punch device
abstract_en: A punch device for generating breakthroughs for cable screw connections in a sheet-like material (17), having: an upper stamp (3) with a punching face (31) for generating at least one breakthrough in the sheet-like material (17), wherein at least one contour (171A-171N, 173A-173N) of the breakthrough is formed in the sheet-like material (17); and a counter-holder (5), wherein the upper stamp (3) with the punching face (31) is arranged to be lowerable in the direction of the counter-holder (5), wherein the punching face (31) is designed extending obliquely in order to reduce a punching force when generating the breakthroughs with different diameters. The invention further proposes an arrangement having a punch device, and a method for generating breakthroughs for cable screw connections in a sheet-like material.

title_en: Laser rotary cutting system and rotary cutting method
abstract_en: A laser rotary cutting system, comprising a laser device (1), a wedge lens group, a focusing lens (4) and an angle adjustment lens, wherein the wedge lens group is arranged downstream of the light path transmission of the laser device to achieve the translational motion of a light beam; the focusing lens is arranged downstream of the light path transmission of the focusing lens to focus the light beam; the angle adjustment lens is arranged on a light path between the wedge lens group and the laser device, or on a light path between the focusing lens and the wedge lens group; and the angle adjustment lens is used to adjust the flight angle of the light passing through the angle adjustment lens, and the angle adjustment lens and the wedge lens group rotate synchronously. The present invention further relates to a rotary cutting method using the rotary cutting system. The laser rotary cutting system has a simple structure, and is convenient to adjust.

title_en: Head height & material measurement
abstract_en: A computer-implemented method of determining a property of a fastener. The method comprising receiving a stored deflection factor, the stored deflection factor relating a deflection of a fastener setting tool to the peak force exerted by the fastener on a die. The method further comprising receiving a determined peak force, the determined peak force corresponding to the peak force exerted by a punch of the fastener setting tool on the fastener. The method further comprising receiving a determined thickness of a work piece, receiving a determined position of a top surface of the fastener; and determining the head height of the fastener.

title_en: Whole-board street lamp
abstract_en: A whole-board street lamp, said street lamp comprising a light-emitting assembly, a power supply assembly, and a lamp housing (3); the light-emitting assembly comprises a lens board (1) and a light-emitting board (2); a light-emitting mounting portion of the lamp housing (3) is provided with a mounting surface, the light-emitting assembly being fixed to the mounting surface (3-3); a power supply mounting portion (3-1) of the lamp housing (3) is provided with an electric appliance chamber (3-4), the power supply assembly being mounted in the electric appliance chamber (3-4); an edge fastening structure (4) comprises edge inserts (4-1) provided on the lens board (1) and edge slots (4-2) provided on the mounting surface, the edge inserts (4-1) being inserted into the corresponding edge slots (4-2) so as to form an interference fit. Since the lens board (1) is directly inserted in an interference insertion mode into the lamp housing (3), the lens board (1) can continuously apply a pressing force to the light-emitting board, so as to ensure that the light-emitting board (2) is tightly attached to the mounting surface (3-3) of the lamp housing (3), thereby improving the heat dissipation performance of the street lamp. In addition, a hook slot (1-2) which facilitates a user prying up the lens board is provided on the outer side surface of the lens board (1), helping to remove the lens board (1), thereby improving the maintainability of the whole-board street lamp.

title_en: Stand for supporting a bicycle in a raised position
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a stand for a bicycle that enables raising of the bike to an elevated position thereby allowing maintenance or inspection. there is a support stand for assisted lifting of a bicycle to an elevated position, the support stand comprising: - a support structure; - a clamp arrangement for clamping onto a bike, the clamp arrangement being mounted to a carriage, the carriage being moveable along the support structure for enabling height adjustment of the clamp arrangement between a lowered and an elevated position; - a biasing arrangement secured to the carriage for biasing the carriage toward the elevated position from the lowered position; and - a user actuable securing arrangement moveable between an engaged and a disengaged configuration, where in an engaged configuration the securing arrangement is arranged to engage with the support structure and carriage and maintain the carriage at an elevated position.

title_en: Stone processing and cutting production line in the mine
abstract_en: The stone cutting machine described is a comprehensive setup for precise stone cutting, comprising two arm assemblies for longitudinal and transverse cuts, a chassis with rails for movement guidances motor-driven pulley system with flexible and adjustable pulleys for tensioning, a cutting wire, cooled by an air blower, a carriages on vertical and horizontal rails for movement, with microswitches for movement limitation and a cooling channel and a control system for site operation coordination. The flexibility of machine prevents wire overstretching, and the adjustable pulley manages wire tension. The vertical carriage's robust bearing allows for arm rotation, and the horizontal carriage is supported by threaded bearings for smooth movement. The air blower cools the cutting wire efficiently. The process starts with positioning the device, selecting the cutting site, and activating the engine and blower. A gear wheel can rotate the arm for various adjustments, enhancing the system's functionality for different cutting needs. This setup aims to optimize the stone cutting process, ensuring safety, precision, and efficiency.

title_en: Pressing plate assembly, welding system, and welding method
abstract_en: The present application discloses a pressing plate assembly, a welding system, and a welding method. The pressing plate assembly comprises a pressing plate and a rotating pressing arm; the pressing plate is used for covering the end surface of a welding part; and the rotating pressing arm is connected to the pressing plate, the rotating pressing arm is used for pressing the welding part by means of the pressing plate, and the rotating pressing arm extends in a direction moving away from the pressing plate and can rotate relative to the welding part, so as to change the position of the edge of the welding part blocked by the rotating pressing arm and/or the pressing plate. Therefore, the pressing plate covers the end surface of the welding part, the rotating pressing arm is connected to the pressing plate, and the welding part can be pressed by means of the rotating pressing arm and the pressing plate, so that the welding part closely fits with other components, facilitating welding of the welding part, and improving the stability of welding; additionally, the position of the edge of the welding part blocked by the rotating pressing arm and/or the pressing plate can be changed by means of the rotating pressing arm, facilitating welding along the edge of the welding part while pressing the welding plate, thereby improving the reliability of welding and the convenience of a welding process.

title_en: Carbon-coated current collector with controllable coating structure and preparation method therefor, and secondary battery
abstract_en: A preparation method for a carbon-coated current collector with a controllable coating structure. The method comprises: using laser to ablate a carbon coating of a carbon-coated current collector, so as to obtain a carbon-coated current collector having a controllable structure. In the method, the laser is used to perform ablation treatment on the carbon coating, such that the nano-scale treatment of the coating can be realized, and the thickness and areal density of the carbon coating can also be reduced, thereby realizing the thinning treatment and structural design of the carbon coating; and the universality of a plate roller can be realized, and the range of application is wide. The present application further relates to a carbon-coated current collector with a controllable coating structure, and a secondary battery.

title_en: Tool for internal screw bush
abstract_en: The invention relates to a tool comprising a first part and a second part, a connecting portion and a fastening portion; wherein the first part and the second part extend from the connecting portion and together form an opening; wherein the tool comprises a bearing portion and an immersion portion, wherein the immersion portion extends from the bearing portion parallel to the opening and has an at least partially reduced wall thickness in relation to the bearing portion, and wherein the immersion portion comprises at least a first and a second engagement surface, wherein the first engagement surface and the second engagement surface lie opposite one another and point in the direction of the opening.

title_en: Method and apparatus for treating welded joint between hot-rolled steel rail and heat-treated steel rail
abstract_en: A method and apparatus for treating a welded joint between a hot-rolled steel rail and a heat-treated steel rail. The method comprises: performing zonal controlled cooling on a hot-state welded joint formed by welding a hot-rolled eutectoid pearlite steel rail and a heat-treated eutectoid pearlite steel rail, wherein a heat-affected zone on one side of the hot-rolled eutectoid pearlite steel rail is slowly cooled under the condition of heating temperature compensation, and a heat-affected zone on one side of the heat-treated eutectoid pearlite steel rail is subjected to accelerated cooling under the action of a cooling medium, until the surface temperature of the welded joint is reduced to a temperature threshold value; and cooling the welded joint, which has been subjected to the zonal controlled cooling, in an environment until the surface temperature is reduced to an ambient temperature. The apparatus of the present invention is used for implementing the zonal controlled cooling. The method and apparatus can improve the matching of hardness between the heat-affected zones on two sides of a welding seam and between the heat-affected zones on the two sides and steel rail base materials having different strengths.

title_en: Avian detection systems and methods
abstract_en: Provided herein are detection systems and related for detecting moving objects in an airspace surrounding the detection system. In an aspect, the moving object is a flying animal and the detection system comprises a first imager and a second imager that determines position of the moving object and for moving objects within a user selected distance from the system the system determines whether the moving object is a flying animal, such as a bird or bat. The systems and methods are compatible with wind turbines to identify avian(s) of interest in airspace around wind turbines and, if necessary, take action to minimize avian strike by a wind turbine blade.

title_en: A modular tile, a functionalized batten, a pipe and a method for producing a pipe
abstract_en: It is suggested to provide a tile, preferably a roof tile (1), for collecting energy from kinetic, thermal and light sources. The tile comprises a housing (2) with at least one photovoltaic cell (3) for collecting energy from a light source and at least one thermal collector (4). The tile comprises at least one wind channel (5) with a wind turbine (6).

title_en: Method of pumping in a system of vacuum pumps and system of vacuum pumps
abstract_en:

with a gas inlet port (2) connected to a vacuum chamber (1) and a gas outlet

abstract_en:

title_en: System for powering and controlling an electric motor
abstract_en:
A system for powering and controlling an electric motor comprises a generator assembly 
comprising a prime mover and an alternator for supplying an alternating current to the 
electric motor. The alternator comprises a voltage regulator for controlling a voltage of 
the alternating current, and the prime mover comprises a throttle controller for controlling 
a rotational speed of the prime mover and, therefore, frequency of the alternating 
current. At least one sensor provides information about an operating environment or

title_en: Bidirectional thermally actuated component for use in medical devices
abstract_en: A bidirectional thermally actuated component includes a heating element and wax material provided in an enclosed housing wherein the heating element is activated to melt the wax which expands to cause movement of the housing or an element mounted therein. When the heating element is deactivated, the was hardens and constricts to allow for movement in the opposite direction based on application of a force in the opposite direction, which may be provided by a biasing spring or a second actuator. An adjustable medical device may include the thermally actuated component to control adjustment of the device.

title_en: Operation of a thermal energy storage system
abstract_en: Operation of an energy storage system comprising a thermodynamic cycle including first and second thermal reservoirs (4,5) and a turbomachinery (1, 2, 3, 1', 2', 3') as energy converter for two-way conversion between electrical energy and thermal energy. For controlling the temperature in the system, the compression ratio of the turbomachinery is adjusted in real-time during charging on the basis of temperature measurements downstream of the compression and/or during discharging on the basis of temperature measurements downstream of the expansion.

title_en: A method for the generation of scandium-44
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for generating

title_en: Fan And Light Units And Associated Mounting Arrangement For Use At A Loading Dock
abstract_en:
The invention is a loading dock apparatus which comprises: a light; a fan; and a frame to support the 
light and the fan in fixed relationship to one another, the frame to pivotally couple to an articulated 
arm, the articulated arm to be coupled to a building structure adjacent a vehicle loading dock to 
enable selective positioning of the light and the fan relative to a doorway at the loading dock.

title_en: Machine learning based optimal control system for magnetic continuous variable transmission
abstract_en:
A machine learning based optimal control system used to optimally control a system of 
magnetic variable transmission system for multiple sources of inputs and multiple outputs of 
mechanical power is developed.

title_en: Slow-actuation mechano-liquid piston heat pump
abstract_en: The slow-actuation mechano-liquid piston heat pump (1) comprises a blind liquid cylinder (8) in which a double-acting hydraulic piston (10) which is secured to a connecting rod (11) connected to connecting rod actuating means (144) translationally moves, the piston (10) together with said cylinder (8) forming a compressor variable hydraulic volume (12) which communicates with a compressor gas and liquid tank (14) which accommodates heat exchanging and accumulating means (16) so as to form a compressor (3), and an expander variable hydraulic volume (134) which communicates with an expander gas and liquid tank (137) which accommodates expander heat exchanging and accumulating means (139) so as to form an expander (4).

title_en: Fuel nozzle
abstract_en: A fuel nozzle for a combustor of a gas turbine engine includes a body defining an axial direction and a radial direction, an air passageway defined axially in the body, and a fuel passageway defined axially in the body radially outwardly from the air passageway. The fuel passageway has an outer wall including an exit lip at a downstream portion of the outer wall. The lip generally increases in diameter as it extends downstream.

title_en: Fuel recirculation method and valve
abstract_en: Fuel recirculation methods, fuel supply circuits and fuel recirculation valves for selectively mixing hot return fuel from a diesel engine with fuel from a tank before providing it to back to the engine. In exemplary disclosed embodiments of fuel recirculation valves, the valves are configured to selectively mix the fuel in a controlled manner using a temperature sensitive actuator within the valve such that, when the temperature of the fuel reaches a certain point, the valve restricts flow pathways to reduce heated fuel being mixed with fuel from the fuel tank, and eventually closes to prevent any heated fuel from being mixed and overheating the fuel provided to a fuel filter, a fuel pump and the engine. Disclosed fuel circulation valves are separate from the fuel filter and are placed upstream of the filter.

title_en: Fan case for an aircraft engine
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fan case (1) for an aircraft engine (2) in the region of the fan (3) thereof, comprising a plurality of substantially cylindrically arranged fiber-reinforced plastic layers that are joined together; a reinforcement ply (6) made of glass fiber-reinforced plastic is disposed between an inner layer (4) and an outer layer (5). According to the invention, the reinforcement ply (6) consists of at least 20 plies of glass fiber-reinforced plastic, and deformation layers (7) are disposed on both sides of the reinforcement ply (6), said deformation layers (7) being less strong than the reinforcement ply (6).

title_en: Packing for a well service pump
abstract_en: A packing arrangement for a fluid end of a reciprocating pump is received within a packing box and is arranged to form a seal with a plunger. The packing arrangement includes a plurality of separate annular rings arranged in an abutting relationship with one another within the packing box, and a header ring disposed within the plurality of separate annular rings, the header ring including an inner surface that is non-cylindrical and that is arranged to abut the plunger, a high pressure side that is arranged in a female chevron shape, and a low pressure side opposite the high pressure side. A packing nut is engaged with the fluid end and operable to compress the header ring and the plurality of separate annular rings within the packing box.

title_en: Fuel consumption calculation of a fuel and water mixture
abstract_en: A fuel control system (300) for fuel consumption calculation for a fuel and water mixture is provided. The fuel control system (300) includes a mixer (330), a fuel source (310) fluidly coupled to the mixer (330), the fuel source (310) being configured to measure a flow of fuel to the mixer (330), a water source (315) fluidly coupled to the mixer (330), the water source (315) being configured to measure a flow of water to the mixer (330), and a mixture flow meter (5) fluidly coupled to the mixer (330). The mixture flow meter (5) is configured to receive and measure properties of a fuel/water mixture from the mixer (330).

title_en: System and method for controlling a robotic arm
abstract_en: A robotic arm assembly includes a robotic arm, a base, and a utility member, the robotic arm extending between a root end attached to the base and a distal end including the utility member. A method for controlling the robotic arm assembly includes: determining a position of the base, the root end, or both relative to the environment; determining a task position and orientation for the utility member within the environment; determining a three-dimensional constraint of the environment; and determining a path for the robotic arm through the environment based on each of the position of the base, the root end, or both relative to the environment, the task position and orientation for the utility member within the environment, and the three-dimensional constraint of the environment.

title_en: Direct drive unit removal system and associated methods
abstract_en: Described herein are embodiments of systems and methods for the removal of a direct drive unit (DDU) housed in an enclosure, such as a direct drive turbine (DDT) connected to a gearbox for driving a driveshaft connected to a pump for use in a hydraulic fracturing operations.

title_en: Gas bearing system
abstract_en: This application relates to a bearing assembly for stabilizing rotation of a rotatable element. The bearing assembly includes a gas bearing acting as a bearing for the rotatable element, an ultrasonic vibration pump coupled to the gas bearing for providing pressurized gas to the gas bearing, and a sealed housing enclosing the gas bearing and the ultrasonic vibration pump. The application further relates to a reaction wheel assembly for a spacecraft. The reaction wheel assembly includes a reaction wheel and the bearing assembly for stabilizing rotation of the reaction wheel.

title_en: Containment shell simulation test apparatus
abstract_en: A containment shell simulation test apparatus comprises a containment shell simulator, gas supply system, passive heat removal system and data system. An interior space of the simulator is divided into a bottom space an upper space above the bottom space. The gas supply system includes a plurality of discharge ports provided at different positions in the bottom space and the upper space, configured to selectively release a mixture of gases with different parameters to simulate various accident conditions. The data system includes a data reception unit and a plurality of data collection units. The plurality of data collection units are distributed at different positions in the bottom space and the upper space and configured to collect thermal-hydraulic parameters within the simulator. The data reception unit is electrically connected to the plurality of data collection units and configured to receive the thermal-hydraulic parameters transmitted by the plurality of data collection units.

title_en: Plant based upon combined joule-brayton and rankine cycles working with directly coupled reciprocating machines
abstract_en: The disclosure concerns a waste heat recovery cycle system and related method in which a Brayton cycle system operates in combination with a Rankine cycle system. The Brayton cycle system has a heater configured to circulate a fluid, namely an inert gas, in heat exchange relationship with a heating source, such as an exhaust gas of a different system, in order to recover waste heat from such different system by heating the inert gas. The Rankine cycle system has a heat exchanger configured to circulate a second fluid, in heat exchange relationship with the inert gas of the Brayton cycle system to heat the second fluid while at the same time cooling the inert gas. The second fluid can be selected among fluids having a boiling point at a temperature lower than the temperature of the inert gas from the expansion unit/group in the Brayton cycle system.

title_en: Cooling system for a hydrogen compressor
abstract_en: A hydrogen cooled pressure packer, systems, and methods of operation are provided. The pressure packer can include a flange portion and a plurality of packing cups coupled to the flange portion. One or more packing cups of the plurality of packing cups include at least one injection channel extending therethrough and terminating in at least one injection port. The pressure packer can also include a seal abutted with at least one packing cup of the plurality of packing cups. The pressure packer can be configured for use in a hydrogen compressor operable within a hydrogen vehicle refueling facility.

title_en: Drain electrical devices, methods, and systems
abstract_en: A peristaltic pump that reduces electrical current flowing through a pumping tube segment includes a central rotor mounted on a central rotation axis, a shoe with a curved surface facing toward the central rotor, multiple rollers mounted along the circumference of the central rotor and the pumping tube segment positioned between the curved surface and the central rotor. Each roller of the plurality of rollers is a member of a roller group, each roller group includes at least two rollers, rollers in a particular roller group are physically located closer to each other than to rollers in other roller groups, and at least two rollers pinch a portion of the pumping tube segment against the curved surface through a full rotation of the central rotor.

title_en: Aircraft engine fluid system with bypass valve
abstract_en: An aircraft engine, has: a fluid system including a component adapted for containing a volume of the fluid, the fluid circuit further including a bypass conduit bypassing the component, and a valve fluidly connected to the fluid circuit upstream of the component relative to a flow of the fluid towards the component, the valve having an open configuration fluidly connecting the source of the fluid to the bypass conduit through the valve and a closed configuration in which the valve connects the source of the fluid to the component, the valve movable from the open configuration to the closed configuration in response to the fluid being at a first temperature, and the valve movable from the closed configuration to the open configuration in response to the fluid exerting an opening force on the valve and the fluid being at a second temperature different than the first temperature.

title_en: Rotary engine with dual-fuel injectors
abstract_en: A rotary engine, has: an outer body defining a rotor cavity; a rotor within the rotor cavity and defining at least one chamber; a pilot subchamber defined by the outer body and having an outlet in communication with the rotor cavity; a main fuel source of a heavy fuel; an alternative fuel source of an alternative fuel; a main injector having a tip in communication with the rotor cavity at a location spaced apart from the outlet of the pilot subchamber, the main injector selectively fluidly connectable to the main fuel source or to the alternative fuel source; and a controller configured for: determining that the rotary engine is in a vicinity of a city or an airport; and operating the main injector in a first configuration in which the main injector fluidly connects the alternative fuel source to the rotor cavity while disconnecting the main fuel source.

title_en: Long stroke parallel pump
abstract_en: A pump system may include a drive shaft extending along a longitudinal axis and supplying rotation about the longitudinal axis, a gear system operably coupled to the shaft for 5 changing the orientation of the rotation, and a slider-crank mechanism. The slider crank mechanism may include a rotating member assembly mechanically coupled to and driven by the gear system. The rotating member assembly may include a plurality of rotating members having respective rotational axes offset laterally from one another and generally orthogonal to the longitudinal axis. The slider crank mechanism may also include a sliding member assembly 10 mechanically coupled to the rotating member assembly. The rotating member assembly may be configured to drive reciprocating motion of the sliding member to alternately draw fluid in and discharge fluid. The slider crank mechanism may also include a connecting rod assembly mechanically coupling the rotating member assembly to the sliding member assembly.

title_en: Method and system for monitoring a bleed valve of a gas turbine engine
abstract_en: A method for monitoring a bleed valve of an aircraft engine includes obtaining operational data of the aircraft engine, the operational data indicative of operational performance of the aircraft engine. The method further includes utilizing one or more neural networks to determine a health status of a bleed valve of the aircraft engine based on the operational data, the bleed valve configured to bleed air from a compressor section of the aircraft engine, wherein the one or more neural networks have been trained with root cause data relating to a plurality of potential failure modes of the bleed valve.

title_en: Abnormality detection device, abnormality detection method, and program for control rod drive device
abstract_en: An abnormality detector comprises a specific section extractor, a feature amount calculator, and an abnormality diagnoser. The specific section extractor divides, into specific section data, phase current caused to flow through an electric motor used in a control rod drive device, and extracts the specific section data. The feature amount calculator calculates a feature amount for use in diagnosis in the abnormality diagnoser. The abnormality diagnoser diagnoses a presence or absence of abnormality of the control rod drive device based on the feature amount. The feature amount calculator calculates a natural frequency of the entire control rod drive device based on an electrical parameter of the electric motor and a mechanical parameter of the control rod drive device, and calculates the feature amount by using the natural frequency and an applied voltage frequency to the electric motor.

title_en: Assembly for identifying obstructing foreign matter in an air intake of an aircraft propulsion system and method of using same
abstract_en: An aircraft propulsion system includes an air intake and an air intake control system. The air intake includes an intake body forming an air passage. The air intake control system includes a flow control member disposed within the air intake, a blockage sensor having a sensing area directed to the flow control member, and a controller. The blockage sensor is configured to produce a signal indicative of an accumulation of foreign matter on the flow control member. The controller is configured to identify a presence or an absence of an obstruction condition of the flow control member and remove the foreign matter from the flow control member, in response to identifying the presence of the obstruction condition, by changing a state of the flow control member.

title_en: Aircraft propulsion system thermal management system
abstract_en: A propulsion system for an aircraft is provided that includes a thermal engine, an electrical power motive system, a propulsion unit, and a thermal management system. The electrical power motive system has an electric motor. The thermal management system includes a first heat exchanger, and is configured to cycle a flow of lubricant into and out of the thermal engine and into and out of the first heat exchanger in a first loop, and is configured to cycle a flow of coolant into and out of thermal engagement with the electrical power motive system and into and out of the first heat exchanger in a second loop. The first heat exchanger is configured to permit heat transfer between the flow of lubricant and the flow of coolant to occur within the first heat exchanger.

title_en: Gas turbine engine dual fuel combustor and method of operation
abstract_en: A combustor for a gas turbine engine is provided that includes an annular combustor shell, a plurality of fuel nozzles, a rotary fuel slinger, and a plurality of first igniters. The annular combustor shell includes front and rear annular liners that collectively form the combustor shell and define a combustion chamber that includes inner and outer radial combustion zones. The fuel nozzles are engaged with the front annular liner and the outer radial combustion zone, and the fuel nozzles are configured to inject a first fuel. The rotary fuel slinger is engaged with the combustor shell and configured to deliver a second fuel into the inner radial combustion zone. The first fuel is a different type of fuel than the second fuel. The first igniters are engaged with the outer radial combustion zone and are configured to ignite the first fuel.

title_en: Large-flow remote fire extinguishing system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a large-scale fire extinguishing technology and discloses a large-flow remote fire extinguishing system which is characterized by comprising a rotor water taking pump set and a centrifugal pressure pump set, wherein a water inlet of the rotor water taking pump set is connected to a buoy water taking port through a rotor pump water taking pipe, a water outlet of the rotor water taking pump set is connected to a water inlet of the centrifugal pressure pump set through a remote water conveying pipe, and a water outlet of the centrifugal pressure pump set is connected to a water inlet of a water cannon through a pressure pump water outlet pipe. The remote water supply large-flow fire extinguishing gun can not have the problems of undercurrent, undervoltage, overpressure, overload and the like, and the structure and the operation of the whole system are very simple and reliable. The system can eliminate external factors to maintain the stable flow of the fire extinguishing cannon and can ensure that the water supply pressure of the cannon is controlled and constant.

title_en: Anti-pollution heat exchanger
abstract_en: A heat exchanger for use with an air handling system is disclosed. The heat exchanger may have an inlet, an outlet, and at least one channel fluidly connecting the inlet and the outlet. The at least one channel may include a wall configured to transfer heat between a first fluid within the at least one channel and a second fluid outside the at least one channel. The heat exchanger may also have a plurality of thermally conductive features disposed along the length of the at least one channel and an anti-fouling coating applied to only a subset of the plurality of thermally conductive features.

title_en: Rotary drum filtering type oil-gas separator
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rotary drum filtering type oil-gas separator, which comprises a shell, wherein the shell is provided with an air inlet and an air outlet, a first partition plate and a second partition plate are arranged in the shell, and the interior of the shell is separated into an axial flow air blowing cavity, an oil-gas separation cavity and a centrifugal air suction cavity from bottom to top through the second partition plate and the first partition plate; the axial-flow air blowing cavity is internally provided with an oil-gas first-stage separation device, the oil-gas separation cavity is internally provided with an oil-gas third-stage separation device and an oil-gas second-stage separation device, and the centrifugal air draft cavity is internally provided with an oil-gas fourth-stage separation device. The invention gets rid of the working mode of the existing filtering oil-gas separator, the filtering material is self-cleaning, the structure is compact, and the oil-gas separation effect is good.

title_en: Turbine blisk and method of manufacturing the same
abstract_en: A turbine blisk is provided. The turbine blisk including an inner edge; a plurality of adjacent rotor blades extending radially outward from the inner edge; a shroud segment integrally coupled to each of the plurality of adjacent rotor blades, thereby forming a plurality of adjacent shroud segments; and a gap defined between each adjacent shroud segment. The gap has a geometry that facilitates interlocking the plurality of adjacent shroud segments when a torsional force is applied to the plurality of adjacent rotor blades.

title_en: Automobile fan
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automobile fan, which comprises a rotating shell and a plurality of blades, wherein the blades are arranged around the periphery of the rotating shell at intervals, the root parts of the blades are provided with transmission parts, the transmission parts extend into the rotating shell, an automatic blade angle adjusting mechanism is arranged in the rotating shell and is in linkage connection with the transmission parts, and the automatic blade angle adjusting mechanism drives the transmission parts to rotate so as to adjust the angles of the blades; the automatic blade angle adjusting mechanism has the advantages that the transmission part is driven to rotate to adjust the angle of the blade, so that compared with a traditional manual adjusting fan, the automatic blade angle adjusting mechanism has the advantages that the operation is simple, the blade angle of the fan can be adjusted to a required angle at will, and the angle of the blade can be adjusted only by inputting a signal value in the adjusting process due to the fact that the angle of the fan is adjusted through the automatic blade angle adjusting mechanism, so that the required wind direction and wind force are achieved, and the optimal cooling effect is achieved.

title_en: Coaxial gas injection valve with floating valve seat and adjustable flow cross section
abstract_en: The invention aims to provide a coaxial gas injection valve with a floating valve seat and an adjustable flow cross section, which realizes adjustable gas flow through a structure controlled by double electromagnets with double valve cores. Through the floating valve seat structure, the reverse leakage function caused by unbalanced internal and external pressure of the gas injection valve is avoided, and the working reliability of the gas injection valve is ensured; the outer guide structure is matched with the inner guide cavity and the pressure balance groove, so that the perpendicularity of the valve core is ensured, the stable operation and the reliable operation of air flow are realized, and the high response speed is realized; the high flow is realized by the mixed air inlet mode of direct air inlet of the axial main air groove and air inlet of the circumferential air-filling holes, the air supply efficiency of the engine is effectively improved, meanwhile, the air flow interference can be avoided, and the stability of an air path is realized; the surface sealing and high reliability of the gas injection valve are realized through the multi-channel annular band structure between the valve core and the valve seat.

title_en: Bearing pedestal, screw compressor and air conditioner
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bearing seat, a screw compressor and an air conditioner, and relates to the field of compressors. The bearing seat comprises a body, wherein an annular flow passage is arranged in the body along the circumferential direction of the body, and is provided with a fluid inlet and a fluid outlet. According to the bearing seat provided by the technical scheme, the annular flow passage is arranged in the body, fluid compressed by the compressor is discharged into the bearing seat, and fluid molecules collide with the inner wall of the annular flow passage in the process of flowing along the annular flow passage in the bearing seat, so that energy can be consumed, and noise can be reduced.

title_en: Driving device of fuel injection device
abstract_en: The invention provides a driving device of a fuel injection device, which can detect individual difference of injection quantity of the fuel injection device of each cylinder and adjust injection pulse width and current waveform of a solenoid in a mode of reducing the individual difference of the fuel injection device. The fuel injection device of the present invention comprises: a valve element (114) that closes the fuel passage by coming into contact with the valve seat (118) and opens the fuel passage by separating from the valve seat (118); and a magnetic circuit composed of a solenoid (105), a fixed iron core (107), a nozzle holder (101), a housing (103), and a movable element (102), wherein when current is supplied to the solenoid (105), magnetic attraction is applied to the movable element (102), and after the idle operation, the magnetic circuit collides with the valve element (114) to open the valve element (114), and the change in acceleration of the movable element (102) caused by the collision of the movable element (102) with the valve element (114) is detected by the current flowing through the solenoid (105).

title_en: Supercharged gas control device, supercharged engine for aviation and control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a supercharged gas control device, a supercharged engine for aviation and a control method, wherein an air inlet bypass mechanism is adopted to store redundant gas after supercharging, and a supercharged gas control device is added behind a supercharger compressor to store incomplete gas utilized by an engine when an aircraft flies at low altitude, and when the aircraft flies at high altitude, the redundant gas is reused through an air inlet pipe, so that the loss caused by air inlet can be reduced, the utilization rate is increased, and meanwhile, the energy generated by waste gas is not wasted and is fully utilized.

title_en: Actuator of link mechanism for internal combustion engine
abstract_en: The invention provides an actuator of a link mechanism for an internal combustion engine, which can sufficiently lubricate a speed reducer. Comprising: an oil passage formed in the control shaft for changing the posture of the control link and supplying lubricating oil to the speed reducer; an opening portion, one end side of the speed reducer side of which is open to the speed reducer and the other end side of which is communicated with the oil path; the inner diameter of the opening at one end is made larger than the inner diameter of the oil passage at one end.

title_en: Vortex generating device
abstract_en: A vortex generating device is disclosed that includes a body extending between a leading edge and a trailing edge. In a profile section taken through the spanwise direction, the body exhibits an airfoil-shaped geometry. Each airfoil shaped profile cross-section has camber lines extending from the leading edge to the trailing edge, at least two of the camber lines exhibiting different bend angles such that the body exhibits at least two different flow deflection angles along a span range. The body also includes a first surface extending between the leading edge and the trailing edge on a first side of the respective camber line, and a second surface extending between the leading edge and the trailing edge on an opposite second side of the respective camber line. The trailing edge extends from a first spanwise end to a second spanwise end, and when viewed from a downstream perspective, the trailing edge includes a first section that is convex on one side of the first surface and concave on one side of the second surface, and includes a second section that is concave on one side of the first surface and convex on one side of the second surface.

title_en: Precise determination of the injection quantity of a fuel injector
abstract_en: A method for determining an injection quantity of a fuel injector with an electromagnetic drive of an internal combustion engine of a motor vehicle is described. The method comprises the following steps: (a) determining (510) a first time at which an injection event of the fuel injector starts, (b) determining (520) a second time at which the injection event of the fuel injector ends, (c) calculating (530) a model based on the first time and the second time, the model representing a position of a nozzle needle of the fuel injector as a function of time, and (d) calculating (540) an injection quantity based on the model and a relation between the position of the nozzle needle and a through-flow rate through the fuel injector.

title_en: Recombinant protein and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of molecular biology, in particular to a recombinant protein, a preparation method and application thereof, and specifically relates to an in vitro recombinant expression technology of perna viridis byssus protein gene and functional identification thereof, wherein the amino acid sequence of the recombinant protein is shown as SEQ ID No. 1. The perna viridis byssus recombinant protein Pvfp6 is prepared by a method combining a transcriptome technology and a protein mass spectrometry technology, the molecular weight of the amino acid of the perna viridis byssus recombinant protein Pvfp6 is 13.25kDa, the isoelectric point is 6.48, and the recombinant protein has an effective enrichment effect on heavy metal ions Cd and has potential application value in treatment of heavy metal or radioactive polluted water.

title_en: Self-priming centrifugal pump
abstract_en: The invention provides a self-priming centrifugal pump, and belongs to the technical field of water pumps. It has solved the relatively poor problem of current self priming pump sealing performance. The self-priming centrifugal pump comprises a pump shell with an opening, a nut and a positioning piece, wherein the positioning piece comprises an annular main body and an annular convex edge connected to one end part of the main body, the outer side wall of the pump shell is connected with a positioning ring corresponding to the opening, the other end part of the main body is fixedly connected with the outer side wall of the pump shell, a plurality of lugs protruding outwards radially are arranged on the main body along the circumferential direction, a mounting cavity for positioning the nut is formed between the lugs and the positioning ring, the nut is arranged in the mounting cavity, one side surface of the nut is propped against the positioning ring, the other at least two side surfaces are propped against the lugs, and a yielding hole corresponding to a threaded hole on the nut is formed in the annular convex edge. The structure can not influence the flow passage structure in the pump shell, so that the smoothness of the flow passage in the pump shell is improved, and the water flow is smooth.

title_en: System and method for repairing bearing bore of wind turbine gearbox
abstract_en: A method (300) for repairing a bearing bore (202, 204) within a wind turbine gearbox (100), the wind turbine gearbox (100) having a gearbox housing (102) defining a first bearing bore (202) and a second bearing bore (204), the method (300) may generally include mounting a shaft support member (230) at least partially within the second bearing bore (204), and inserting a rotatable shaft (232) through a shaft opening (256) defined through the shaft support member (230) such that the rotatable shaft (232) is rotatably supported within the shaft opening (256). Further, the method (300) may include establishing a machining cavity (240) between the first axial end (206) and the second axial end (208) of the first bearing bore (202), and rotating a drilling blade (242) positioned within the machining cavity (240) via rotation of the rotatable shaft (232) to machine the inner surface (210) of the first bearing bore (202).

title_en: Tuning liquid column type damping device with power generation function
abstract_en: The invention relates to a tuning liquid column type damping device with a power generation function, which comprises a U-shaped column with two sealed ends, wherein a certain amount of liquid capable of freely flowing is filled in the U-shaped column, more than one turbine is respectively arranged at different parts inside the bottom end of the U-shaped column, each turbine comprises two discs, a rotating shaft, a group of fan blade shafts and fan blades, the two discs are respectively fixed on the upper surface and the lower surface of the bottom end of the U-shaped column, one end of the rotating shaft is connected with the discs through bearings, each fan blade is positioned between the two discs and connected with the rotating shaft through a corresponding fan blade shaft, the other end of the rotating shaft penetrates out from the bottom end of the U-shaped column, and the rotation of the fan blades transmits rotation moment to a generator set outside the column through the rotating shaft to drive the generator set to generate power. The invention can generate electricity while absorbing shock.

title_en: Method for controlling a cooling system for delivering coolant to a heat exchanger in a vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for controlling a cooling system for delivering coolant to a heat exchanger (18) in a vehicle (1). During operating conditions when a thermostat (6) in the cooling system is in a partially open position, the method comprises the steps of: -estimating a desired cooling temperature (T) of the medium in the heat exchanger (18), -calculating a coolant flow rate through the radiator (7b) And a coolant flow rate through the radiator bypass line (9) -calculating a coolant flow rate at which the medium in the heat exchanger (18) is cooled to a desired temperature (T)10 And coolant temperature (t) 3 ) In combination, -adjusting the flow-regulating means (23) so that the coolant is at a selected flow rate And temperature (t) 3 ) Combined down to the heat exchanger (18).

title_en: Piston-hydraulic cylinder refrigerating device based on memory alloy thermoelastic effect
abstract_en: A piston-hydraulic cylinder refrigerating device based on a memory alloy thermoelastic effect belongs to the technical field of refrigeration. The device consists of a motor power system, a memory alloy thermoelastic effect refrigerating body and a double-path controllable liquid flow heat exchange system. The motor drives the piston to do linear reciprocating motion in the hydraulic cylinder through the crank connecting rod. The memory alloy body is arranged in the space between the piston and the liquid cylinder bottom, and the reciprocating motion of the piston enables the memory alloy body to periodically load, deform and unload to recover the shape, so that alternating martensitic transformation exothermic and reverse phase transformation endothermic phenomena are generated correspondingly. The piston valve core and the side wall of the hydraulic cylinder are provided with holes to form two pairs of valve core inlets and two pairs of valve core outlets, and when the piston moves in the upper half cycle and the lower half cycle, the two pairs of valve core inlets and the two pairs of valve core outlets are respectively opened to control one heat exchange liquid flow to enter the hydraulic cylinder and perform heat exchange with the memory alloy body. The piston reciprocates once, heat is transferred from one liquid flow to the other liquid flow through the memory alloy, and a refrigeration cycle process is completed. The device has compact structure and high refrigerating efficiency, and is used for refrigerating systems of air conditioners, refrigerators and the like.

title_en: Floating heating type rapid start diffusion pump
abstract_en: A floating heating type rapid starting diffusion pump comprises a pump body, pump oil, a pump core, an evaporation system, a cooling system, an injection system and a control system, wherein the evaporation system adopts a floating heating mode and comprises an evaporator, a heater and a temperature measurement and control element, the evaporator is provided with a heating area and an oil storage area which are separated by a middle partition plate and communicated through oil holes in the partition plate, and the heater is arranged in the heating area and is used for heating the pump oil in the heating area to instantly evaporate the pump oil into steam; the heater is fixed on the middle partition board, and the middle partition board can float in the pumping oil, so that the heating area is always kept constant in the normal pumping oil range; the heating device is arranged on or around the steam guide pipe in the spraying system, so that the temperature of the pump core and the steam can be increased, the speed and the kinetic energy of the sprayed steam can be increased, and the quick start of the diffusion pump can be realized.

title_en: Linear hydraulic pump for submersible applications
abstract_en: A submersible pumping system has an electric motor (108), a rotary hydraulic pump (106) driven by the electric motor (108), and a linear hydraulic pump (110) configured to move production fluid. The rotary hydraulic pump generates pressurized working fluid that drives the linear hydraulic pump. In another aspect, a method for controlling a temperature of an electric motor within a submersible pumping system disposed in a well is disclosed. The method comprises the following steps: the motor lubricant is circulated through a hydraulically driven production pump to reduce the temperature of the motor lubricant.

title_en: Seawater desalination system with multi-mode heating steam source
abstract_en: The invention discloses a seawater desalination system of a multi-mode heating steam source, which belongs to the technical field of seawater desalination by utilizing steam turbine extraction steam. The system combines a low-temperature multi-effect distillation device with a thermal power generation system to desalinate sea water in multiple modes, and respectively utilizes the communicating pipe steam extraction of a low-pressure cylinder in a turbine with higher parameters, the steam extraction of the low-pressure cylinder with lower parameters and the exhaust steam of the low-pressure cylinder as heating steam of a sea water desalination system.

title_en: Stainless steel boron aluminum composite board for PWR fuel assembly storage cell and manufacturing method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of materials, and particularly relates to a stainless steel boron aluminum composite board of a PWR fuel assembly storage cell and a manufacturing method thereof. The stainless steel framework comprises a stainless steel framework and boron aluminum plates, wherein the sections of two sides of the stainless steel framework are trapezoidal, an included angle is 45 degrees, grooves are formed in the upper surface and the lower surface of the stainless steel framework, and the boron aluminum plates are arranged in the grooves of the two sides and are connected through holes of the stainless steel framework. The cross section of the composite board is trapezoid with a base angle of 45 degrees, and the framework is a 45-degree H-shaped stainless steel framework, so that the rigidity of the composite board is ensured; the upper and lower surfaces of the stainless steel are both made of boron aluminum plates, so that the neutron absorption capacity of the stainless steel is ensured. The stainless steel plate is provided with a communication hole for connecting the upper boron aluminum plate and the lower boron aluminum plate; the stainless steel skeleton can be suitable for welding and assembling, and the defect that the boron aluminum material cannot be welded is overcome.

title_en: Burner and method for improving performance of burner
abstract_en: The combustor (3) is provided with: a fuel injection nozzle that injects fuel; a cylindrical body (24) which is formed in a cylindrical shape having a combustion region in which combustion gas flows and in which a plurality of slits (50) are formed at intervals in the circumferential direction and extend in the circumferential direction; and a throttle plate (60) that is fitted into the slit (50), that protrudes radially inward from the inner peripheral side of the cylinder (24), and that has a throttle surface that extends in the flow direction of the combustion gas from the radially outer side to the radially inner side.

title_en: Linear compressor rotor and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a linear compressor rotor and a manufacturing method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of linear compressors. This linear compressor active cell, active cell seat one side arranges a plurality of magnet piece groups in proper order, magnet piece group is spliced into the annular with active cell seat circumference face by polylith magnet piece head and tail, the border of active cell seat one side sets up the chamfer, the annular glue groove that forms between the interior side of the magnet piece group that is close to the active cell seat and the chamfer is annotated full adhesive, connect the centre between the magnet piece group and keep off the ring and connect, protruding embedding magnet piece on the centre keeps off the ring and splice the gap between, the outside limit of magnet piece group is connected the end and is kept off the ring, protruding embedding magnet piece on the end keeps off the ring splice gap between, annotate full adhesive in each splice gap. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the overall quality is reduced; the material is saved, and the production cost is reduced; the manufacturing process is extremely simple, and the operability is strong; the radial dimension is reduced, so that the radial dimension of the motor is also reduced; the whole assembly is firm, and the operation of the rotor is stable and reliable.

title_en: Submersible electric pump with axial-flow sand-proof structure
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of submersible electric pumps, and relates to a submersible electric pump with an axial-flow sand-preventing structure, which comprises a motor, a water pump and a rotating shaft driven by the motor, wherein an upper bearing seat is arranged between the motor and the water pump, a water inlet joint is fixed on the upper bearing seat, an upper bearing seat, a mechanical seal, an axial-flow impeller, a shaft sleeve and an electric pump impeller are sequentially sleeved on the rotating shaft, a guide sleeve is fixed on the upper bearing seat, the guide sleeve comprises an annular outer shell and an annular inner shell which are coaxially arranged, the inner shell is lower than the outer shell, the outer shell is sleeved outside the axial-flow impeller, the inner shell is sleeved outside a mechanical seal dynamic-static ring joint surface, the guide sleeve and the axial-flow impeller form an axial-flow pump, a gap between the outer shell at the lower end of the guide sleeve and the inner shell is a water inlet, and the upper end of the guide sleeve is a water outlet. Compared with the traditional sand throwing sleeve, the axial flow sand prevention structure of the submerged electric pump has better sand prevention effect, prolongs the service life of the mechanical seal, and further prolongs the service life of the submerged electric pump.

title_en: Air filter for internal combustion engine
abstract_en: An air cleaner of an internal combustion engine is provided with a first housing including an inlet, a second housing including an outlet, and a filter element between the first housing and the second housing. The Helmholtz resonator is disposed inside the first housing. An upstanding wall projects from the bottom wall of the first housing toward the filter element and extends in the axial direction of the inlet. The upstanding walls form the cavity of the Helmholtz resonator. A noise absorbing area is defined by the upstanding wall, the side wall of the first housing, the bottom wall and the filter element. The noise absorbing region opens into the inlet and extends in the axial direction.

title_en: A submersible sewage pump for paper mill sewage treatment
abstract_en: The invention provides a submersible sewage pump for sewage treatment of a paper mill. The cutting method of the submersible sewage pump solves the technical problems that an existing submersible sewage pump is simple in cutting mode, cannot perform multiple cutting on sewage in a pump body, is poor in cutting capability, and is poor in cutting effect. This a submersible sewage pump for paper mill sewage treatment, comprises a workbench, be provided with one on the workstation and adjust its water level height the mechanism that sinks that floats, be provided with one on the workstation and keep its stable balance mechanism, be fixed with the mount pad on the workstation, be provided with a submersible sewage pump on the mount pad, submersible sewage pump includes the pump body, the dive motor, base and side cap, the pump body has water inlet and delivery port, the water inlet sets up at pump body lower extreme, water inlet department is provided with a water inlet filter mechanism who is linked together rather than, the delivery port sets up at pump body lateral part, delivery port department is provided with a delivery port filter mechanism rather than being linked together. The invention has the characteristic of good cutting effect.

title_en: High-pressure common rail system of V-type multi-cylinder diesel engine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-pressure common rail system of a V-type multi-cylinder diesel engine, which is arranged on a cylinder block of the V-type multi-cylinder diesel engine, wherein the cylinder block comprises a plurality of cylinder heads and two rows of cylinders which are arranged in a V shape, and each cylinder head comprises a common rail pipe mounting hole and an oil return hole; the high-pressure common rail system comprises two independent oil supply systems which are symmetrically arranged on the cylinder body, the two independent oil supply systems share an oil tank and an oil transfer pump, each oil supply system supplies oil to one row of cylinders, and each oil supply system comprises a low-pressure oil way and a high-pressure oil way. The high-pressure common rail system of the V-shaped multi-cylinder diesel engine adopts two sets of high-pressure common rail systems which are completely independent and symmetrically arranged to supply oil to the left and right rows of cylinders of the V-shaped multi-cylinder diesel engine respectively, so that the oil injection consistency of the left and right cylinders can be ensured to be better, the oil injection pressure is not influenced by the rotation speed of the engine, and meanwhile, the structure of the engine is compact and the attractive effect is also achieved.

title_en: Intelligent layout design method and device for bolts of low-wind-speed wind turbine and wind turbine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low wind speed wind turbine generator system bolt intelligent layout design method and device and a wind turbine generator system, wherein a bolt is a blade connecting bolt for connecting a pitch bearing and a blade root, and the method comprises the following steps: acquiring input blade root parameters, and determining the position distribution of a plurality of bolts on the circumference of the blade root; obtaining the limit and fatigue load born by each bolt; and determining bolts at different positions according to the safety margin, and completing the layout of all bolts at the root of the blade, wherein the limit load safety margin of all bolts is set to be the same, and the fatigue load safety margin is the same. According to the invention, the bolt design with equal safety margin is adopted on the circumference of the root of the blade, so that the strength risk is effectively avoided, the bolt cost is reduced, and the competitiveness of a unit is improved; in addition, the bolt design of the root of the blade can be popularized to the design of a hub connecting bolt connected with a variable pitch bearing, the design of a tower top connecting bolt connected with a yaw bearing, and the design of a tower bottom connecting bolt connected with a foundation, and the universality is good.

title_en: Rotary machine
abstract_en: An electric compressor (1) is provided with: the compressor impeller is provided with a bearing (20B) for supporting a rotating shaft (12) of a compressor impeller (8), a support wall (23) for supporting the outer periphery of the bearing (20B), a key groove (60) formed in the bearing (20B) and the support wall (23) and extending in the direction of the rotation axis X of the rotating shaft (12), and a key member (70) inserted into the key groove (60), wherein the support wall (23) is provided with an outer limiting part (42a) which can be abutted against one end (70a) of the key member (70) in the key groove (60), an outer ring (51) of the bearing (20B) is provided with an inner limiting part (61a) which can be abutted against the other end (70B) of the key member (70) in the key groove (60), and the distance D between the outer limiting part (42a) and the inner limiting part (61a) is longer than the length L in the direction of the rotation axis X of the key member (.

title_en: Bidirectional rotary spherical pump cooling mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bidirectional rotary spherical pump cooling mechanism, which comprises a feed hole (101), a cylinder cover split flow channel (1005), a cylinder body split flow channel (1007) and a cylinder body guide flow channel (1008), wherein the feed hole is sequentially communicated with the split flow part to form a cooling channel, a main shaft support guide flow channel (1004), a cylinder body lower end return flow channel (1011), a cylinder body upper end return flow channel (1002), the cylinder cover return flow channel (1001) and the feed hole (101) are sequentially communicated with each other to form a return flow part of the cooling channel, a switch valve is arranged on a cylinder body (3), and the switch valve controls the conduction of the cylinder body guide flow channel (1008) and controls the conduction between the cylinder body lower end return flow channel (1011) and the cylinder body upper end return flow channel (1002); can be used for cooling and lubricating under the condition of forward and backward rotation of the spherical pump, and meanwhile, the volumetric efficiency of the spherical pump is not reduced.

title_en: Regeneration power generation equipment for air pollution treatment engineering
abstract_en: The invention relates to a device which can effectively filter dust and other harmful particles in the atmosphere and can convert the flowing atmosphere into electric energy. The regeneration power generation equipment for the air pollution treatment engineering is characterized in that: including consecutive exhaust gas inhalation device and exhaust gas purification device, its characterized in that: the exhaust gas suction device comprises a machine base, a fan blade mechanism, a driving mechanism and a first wind driven generator, wherein the fan blade mechanism, the driving mechanism and the first wind driven generator are arranged on the machine base. The air pollution control engineering regeneration power generation equipment adopts high-speed operation of a built-in fan, generates larger thrust and suction to drive the fan blade to rotate, wind generated by the fan blade enters the waste gas purification device to be purified, and power generated by the fan blade drives the first wind driven generator to generate power, so that two functions of purifying air and generating power by wind are realized.

title_en: Contact type sealed high-pressure oil receiver and full-regulation water pump with same
abstract_en: The invention provides a contact type sealed high-pressure oil receiver and a full-regulation water pump with the same, wherein the oil receiver comprises: the shell is formed into a heat radiation material piece, a cavity is defined in the shell, and a plurality of pressure oil ports and drain holes are arranged on the shell; the rotary shaft is arranged in the cavity, an oil path cavity is defined in the rotary shaft, a plurality of oil inlets corresponding to the plurality of pressure oil ports are respectively arranged on the rotary shaft, and a piston cavity corresponding to the oil path channel is defined in the servomotor; the bush is formed into a heat dissipation material piece, the bush is embedded on the shell, and the wear-resistant soft material piece is embedded on the bush to serve as a sealing piece. The plurality of seals are in contact with the shaft, respectively, to form a contact seal. According to the contact type sealed high-pressure oil receiver, the sealing medium is soft material contact type seal is formed between the bushing and the rotating shaft, so that the rotating shaft and the bushing are prevented from being adhered or blocked when the oil receiver works, an accident of cutting and fixing an oil pipe is avoided, and the safety of an oil receiving system is ensured.

title_en: Dry vacuum system with pre-pump condenser
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of dry vacuum pump systems, and particularly relates to a dry vacuum system with a pre-pump condenser. The system comprises a vacuum pump unit and a pre-pump condensing unit, wherein the pre-pump condensing unit comprises a pre-pump condenser, and the pre-pump condenser comprises five ports; the first port of the condenser before the pump is connected with the vacuum material inlet through the material inlet pipe, the second port is connected with the vacuum pump unit through the first material pipe, the third port is connected with the condensate discharge pipe, and the fourth port and the fifth port are respectively connected with the third frozen brine outlet and the third frozen brine inlet through the third frozen brine outlet pipe and the third frozen brine inlet pipe. The invention provides a dry vacuum system containing a pre-pump condenser, wherein the pre-pump condenser is arranged in front of a vacuum pump and is used as a trapping unit of condensable gas, so that the phenomenon that the vacuum pump and a pipeline are easy to generate water accumulation is improved.

title_en: Jet oxidation reactor
