abstract_en: The invention discloses a jet oxidation reactor, which comprises a liquid-gas injector, a diffusion pipe, a connecting pipe and a recovery pipe, wherein under the action of the suction force of liquid of the liquid-gas injector, the liquid-gas injector sucks oxygen, the oxygen and aqueous solution are fully contacted in the throat of the liquid-gas injector to perform oxidation reaction, and the liquid after the oxidation reaction flows out through the diffusion pipe, the connecting pipe and an output pipe in sequence. The invention eliminates the blockage of the oxygen nozzle of the reaction kettle, reduces the volume of equipment, increases the contact area and time of oxygen and solution, and improves the oxygen absorption efficiency.

title_en: Combined gas cylinder mounting assembly, mounting method and attitude control power system
abstract_en: The application provides a combination formula gas cylinder installation component and installation method, appearance accuse driving system, combination formula gas cylinder installation component includes: the front bracket component is used for supporting the head end of the gas cylinder; the rear bracket is used for supporting the tail end of the gas cylinder; the front bracket component comprises a central supporting mechanism and a peripheral fixing mechanism, and the peripheral fixing mechanism is arranged on the outer side of the central supporting mechanism away from the center; the peripheral fixing mechanism comprises a plurality of front brackets respectively corresponding to the plurality of gas cylinders, and the peripheral fixing mechanism is used for respectively fixing the plurality of gas cylinders through the plurality of front brackets. According to the combined installation device, the front support assembly and the rear support are arranged, the plurality of gas cylinders are combined to be installed, the installation is compact, the integration level of the system can be improved, the structural rigidity of the gas cylinder installation can be improved, and then the space in the space craft cabin can be saved.

title_en: Reactor core power intrinsic orthogonal decomposition online reconstruction method based on tracking calculation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tracking calculation-based reactor core power intrinsic orthogonal decomposition online reconstruction method, which comprises the following steps of: reading the measured value of the neutron detector at the current time of the reactor core; reading the power distribution of the reactor core tracking calculation at the current time and the previous time of the reactor core; selecting power distribution for intrinsic orthogonal decomposition to form a sample of the intrinsic orthogonal decomposition; carrying out intrinsic orthogonal decomposition on the sample subjected to intrinsic orthogonal decomposition to obtain an intrinsic orthogonal base; carrying out function expansion on the power distribution of the reactor core to be reconstructed by using the intrinsic orthogonal basis function; solving an expansion coefficient according to the read measured value of the neutron detector; calculating a reactor core power distribution reconstruction value according to the expansion coefficient and the intrinsic orthogonal base; by applying the intrinsic orthogonal decomposition technology and combining the reactor core power distribution of the reactor core at different moments of the reactor core tracking calculation, the calculation precision of the online reconstruction of the reactor core power distribution is improved, and the decisive influence of the neutron diffusion calculation result on the online reconstruction result of the reactor core power distribution is obviously reduced.

title_en: Cavity-bottom shell structure for engine, manufacturing method of cavity-bottom shell structure, oil-gas separator, oil bottom shell and oil-water separator
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cavity bottom shell structure for an engine, a manufacturing method of the cavity bottom shell structure, and an oil-gas separator, an oil bottom shell and an oil-water separator which are provided with the cavity bottom shell structure. The backflow area of the shell bottom is a plane, or a hydrophobic layer with a lotus leaf effect is formed on the funnel surface with a very slow gradient, so that oil and water can flow back well.

title_en: Control apparatus, storage medium, and method of updating control program of in-vehicle control device
abstract_en: The invention provides a control apparatus, a method of updating a control program of an in-vehicle control device, and a non-volatile computer-readable storage medium storing a computer program. The control apparatus is configured to control updating of a control program of an in-vehicle control device including a drive system control device capable of implementing an automatic stop mode in which a drive source is automatically stopped when a predetermined stop condition is satisfied. The control apparatus includes a determination unit and a control unit that executes control that restricts implementation of intervention control during update of a control program when an update time of the control program is not longer than a predetermined value; the judging unit is configured to: disallowing updating of the control program at the estimated stop position; alternatively, the update of the control program is permitted at the start position of the section in which the number of estimated stop positions included in the predicted travel route is the smallest, and the vehicle is estimated to travel in the section during the update of the control program.

title_en: Fragile airfoil for gas turbine engine
abstract_en: The present application relates to a frangible airfoil for a gas turbine engine. An airfoil is generally provided that defines chord dimensions, span dimensions, a leading edge, a trailing edge, a root, and a tip. The airfoil includes a first material matrix defining a pressure side and a suction side. The first material matrix defines a plurality of discrete volumes extending into the first material matrix from at least one of the pressure side or the suction side. A plurality of discrete volumes are arranged at least partially along the chord dimension, and a second material matrix, different from the first material matrix, is at least partially defined within the volumes.

title_en: Distributed residual pressure power generation system based on reinforcement learning algorithm and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a distributed residual pressure power generation system based on reinforcement learning algorithm and a control method thereof, wherein the system comprises a steam pipeline, a turbine expander, a generator, a frequency converter and a turbine outlet pipeline; the steam pipeline is connected with the turbine expander, the turbine expander is connected with the generator, the generator is connected with the frequency converter, the frequency converter is connected with a user or a power grid, one end of the turbine outlet pipeline is connected with the outlet of the turbine expander, and the other end of the turbine outlet pipeline is led to a low steam pressure user; a first electric pressure regulating valve, a flowmeter, a first electric stop valve and an electric flow regulating valve are sequentially arranged on the steam pipeline according to the steam conveying direction; and a second electric pressure regulating valve and a back pressure valve are sequentially arranged on the turbine outlet pipeline according to the steam transmission direction. The distributed residual pressure power generation control method based on the reinforcement learning algorithm enables the residual pressure power generation system to achieve the purpose of high-efficiency stable operation by dynamically controlling equipment such as each electric regulating valve, a generator, a frequency converter and the like of the power generation system in real time.

title_en: Supercritical carbon dioxide boiler working medium temperature adjusting system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a working medium temperature regulating system of a supercritical carbon dioxide boiler. The invention further provides a method for regulating the temperature of the working medium of the supercritical carbon dioxide boiler. The invention effectively solves the problem of adjusting the temperature of the working medium of the supercritical carbon dioxide boiler. The temperature of the low-temperature carbon dioxide working medium entering the temperature regulating point of the supercritical carbon dioxide boiler is quickly and flexibly regulated by keeping reasonable temperature and flow of the low-temperature carbon dioxide working medium, so that the overtemperature of the heating surface of the boiler is avoided, the operation safety of the system is obviously improved, and the service lives of the high-temperature heating surface, the pipeline and the turbine blade in the system are greatly prolonged.

title_en: Annular sealing member positionable against a wall element of an offshore structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to an annular seal member (24) comprising a seal body, the seal body comprising: a locating portion (26) positionable against a wall element (5) of the offshore structure (2); an inner surface (24 a); an outer surface (24 b); and a lip portion defining an opening of the sealing member (24) to receive an elongate element (20) therethrough; wherein the seal is positionable against the wall element (5) such that when a net positive pressure is applied to the outer surface (24 b) of the seal when a static pressure acting on the outer surface (24 b) of the seal exceeds a static pressure acting on the inner surface (24 a) of the seal, the outer surface (24 b) is at least partially deformed inwardly to provide a portion of the seal to seal against an outer surface of the elongate element (20). The present invention relates to an offshore structure.

title_en: Method for operating an internal combustion engine with a fuel detection function
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for operating an internal combustion engine, having the function of detecting fuel for injection. In the method, the modulus of elasticity of the fuel to be injected is known at a first injection pressure and a second injection pressure. A difference value is calculated from the difference of the two elastic modulus values, which difference value is associated with the pressure difference, and the difference value is compared with a discrimination value. The fuel used is identified based on whether the difference is above or below a discrimination value. The method is particularly suitable for distinguishing diesel fuel EN590 from biodiesel.

title_en: Design method of fault-tolerant controller for actuating mechanism of aviation electric fuel pump
abstract_en: The invention discloses a design method of a fault-tolerant controller of an actuating mechanism of an aviation electric fuel pump, which establishes a mathematical model of the electric fuel pump. The mathematical description of the whole system is completed aiming at a motor pump system directly connected by an external gear pump and a brushless direct current motor. And analyzing and modeling the end face leakage and the radial leakage in the gear pump, and equating the influence of the end face leakage and the radial leakage into the uncertainty and the interference of the system, so that the control problem of the aviation electric fuel pump is converted into a system robust control problem containing mismatching uncertainty. The method can estimate the fault of the actuating mechanism on line without buffeting, does not need filtering processing, and avoids phase lag of an observation result. The fault-tolerant control system can achieve better fault-tolerant control effect when processing faults of the executing mechanism, particularly time-varying faults.

title_en: Universal attachment rod type branch node connector for lattice type concrete filled steel tube wind power tower
abstract_en: The invention provides a universal attachment rod type branch node connector of a lattice type concrete filled steel tube wind power tower, which comprises attachment plates, tube bodies, bolt balls, locking pieces and bifurcated rods, wherein the attachment plates are divided into two pieces and wrapped on the surface of a tower column; the attachment plate is provided with a plurality of through holes, blind holes are formed in the positions, corresponding to the through holes, of the tower column, and the attachment plate is fixedly connected to the surface of the tower column through fixing bolts penetrating through the through holes and screwed into the blind holes. The joint connector provided by the invention avoids the influence of aging, contraction and expansion deformation of the tower frame on the connection strength of the tower frame and the attachment plate; the crotch bar is used for connecting the web members, so that the end points of the web members connected with the bolt ball are reduced, and the limitation on the rotation angle of the bolt ball is reduced.

title_en: Evaporated fuel processing apparatus, control device for evaporated fuel processing apparatus, and purge gas concentration detection method
abstract_en: When the purge control valve is in a supply state in which the purge gas is supplied from the canister to the intake pipe and the pump is driven, the concentration detection unit detects the concentration of the purge gas when the purge control valve is in an open state when the duty ratio of the purge control valve is equal to or greater than a predetermined value, and detects the concentration of the purge gas when the purge control valve is in a closed state when the duty ratio of the purge control valve is less than the predetermined value.

title_en: Mixed-flow compressor of refrigerating system
abstract_en: An impeller mountable within a centrifugal compressor comprising: a hub having a front side and a rear side, the hub rotatable about an axis of rotation; and a plurality of blades extending outwardly from the front side of the hub such that a plurality of channels are defined between adjacent blades. The plurality of blades are oriented such that flow outputs from the plurality of channels adjacent the rear side of the impeller are arranged at an angle of less than 20 degrees to the axis of rotation.

title_en: Siemens 9F gas turbine combined cycle unit constant exhaust cylinder temperature clutch engagement control method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a constant exhaust cylinder temperature clutch engagement control method for a Siemens 9F gas turbine combined cycle unit, which comprises the following steps: 1) an SSS clutch is adopted for meshing between the generator of the unit and the steam turbine; 2) setting the temperature of lubricating oil of a unit as T, the absolute vacuum degree corresponding to the T as P1, the ambient atmospheric pressure as P0, and the relative vacuum degree setting value of a steam turbine as P2 before an SSS clutch is meshed with a steam turbine shaft; 3) the relative vacuum degree setting value P2 of the turbine is obtained by the calculation of the two equations, and the relative vacuum degree of the turbine is set to P2. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the operation method is simple and easy to implement, and the bearing block body or the bearing block system does not need to be changed. Need not do equipment transformation to gas turbine unit, need not extra input cost, easy operation only needs suitably destroy the vacuum during the unit starts, increases the #8 bearing expansion volume of installing in the condenser, can effectively reduce the unit and start the vibration during to guarantee the security and the stability of unit.

title_en: Nozzle suitable for gas fuel and liquid fuel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nozzle suitable for gas fuel and liquid fuel, which comprises a needle valve body, wherein an accommodating cavity is arranged in the needle valve body, an insulating needle valve and a grounding electrode are arranged in the accommodating cavity, the needle valve electrode comprises an electrode boss, an electrode table and an electrode rod which are connected, and the electrode boss is connected with an electromagnetic valve b through a steering valve; the electrode rod is positioned in the insulating needle valve, a gap between the electrode rod and the insulating needle valve is an ionization space, the grounding electrode wraps the periphery of the insulating needle valve, an insulating sleeve is arranged on the periphery of the electrode table, and the insulating sleeve is fixed on the upper part of the needle valve body through a positioning pin; in order to improve the lubricating performance, the self-rotating mode of the needle valve is adopted, and the distribution of lubricating liquid on the surface of a moving part is improved.

title_en: Linear compressor
abstract_en: A linear compressor of an embodiment of the present invention is characterized by comprising: a cover case forming a refrigerant discharge space; a discharge cover inserted into the cover case so as to be in contact with an inner peripheral surface of the cover case, and shielding an opened surface of the cover case; and a fixing ring provided on an inner peripheral surface of the discharge cover, the fixing ring being formed of a material having a thermal expansion coefficient larger than that of the discharge cover.

title_en: Waste heat utilization device for thermal generator set
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of thermal power generation, in particular to a waste heat utilization device for a thermal generator set, which comprises a processing box, a heating cavity arranged in the processing box and a processing cavity arranged in the inner bottom wall of the heating cavity, wherein a heating pipe is arranged in the heating cavity, the top of the processing box is provided with a smoke inlet pipe communicated with the heating pipe, and the inner top wall of the heating cavity is provided with a turbofan mechanism for converting thermal energy into mechanical energy; the device has simple structure and simple and convenient operation, can recycle the heat in the flue gas in the combustion power generation process, can perform desulfurization and precipitation operation on the flue gas, and can greatly improve the environment-friendly and energy-saving properties.

title_en: Air compression treatment system
abstract_en: The utility model provides an E0-level air compression treatment system, which is internally and sequentially connected with an air filter element, a two-stage variable-frequency air compressor, a coarse filter, a post-cooling system, a precise filter, a cold dryer, an ultra-precise filter, a post-treatment oil remover and an air treatment host. The air is filtered by an air filter element to remove large-particle impurities, and enters a two-stage variable-frequency air compressor to obtain compressed air; the compressed air passes through a coarse filter to filter out solid or liquid particles larger than 3 mu m in the compressed air; then passing through a cooling system, and then passing through a precise filter to filter out solid or liquid particles larger than 0.01 mu m and 99.99% of oil mist; filtering solid or liquid particles larger than 0.01 mu m and 99.999% of oil mist by a cold dryer and an ultra-precise filter; and filtering oil in the compressed air by a post-treatment oil remover, and finally treating the compressed air reaching ISO8573.1E0-level standard by a molecular sieve adsorption container in an air treatment host.

title_en: Single screw fan
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of screw fans, and particularly relates to a single screw fan which comprises an electric drive module, a round rod, a spiral plate A, a shaft B, a shaft sleeve, a spiral plate B and a sealing structure, wherein two ends of a cylindrical cavity A in a shell are respectively communicated with two cavities B symmetrically distributed on two sides of the cavity A through a round groove A; in the air exhaust process, air between the spiral plate B and the spiral plate A spirally moves along the spiral plate A under the extrusion of the spiral plate B, the air is spirally pushed by the spiral plate A, the air is compressed to a certain degree, the pushed air is not easy to flow back, and the blast efficiency is high; meanwhile, the air moves along the spiral plate A, the shape stroke of the air is large, the round rod, the spiral plate A and the spiral plate B which are continuously cooled by the cooling system cool the air flowing on the round rod, the spiral plate A and the spiral plate B, the air volume is further promoted to be condensed, the air volume blown out in unit time is increased, and the blowing efficiency of the screw type fan is further improved.

title_en: Liquid supply type gas compressor
abstract_en: The invention provides a liquid supply type gas compressor capable of monitoring the liquid level in a gas-liquid separator. The oil supply type air compressor of the present invention comprises: an oil separator for separating and storing oil from the compressed air discharged from the compressor body (1); a sampling pipe having an inlet side connected to a predetermined height position of the oil separator, the sampling pipe allowing a fluid from the predetermined height position of the oil separator to flow therein by a pressure difference between the inlet side and the outlet side; a pressure sensor for detecting the pressure of the fluid flowing in the sampling pipe or flowing through the sampling pipe; a control device for determining whether the pressure detected by the pressure sensor exceeds a set value (P1) or not and whether the pressure is lower than the set value (P2) to determine whether the fluid flowing through the sampling pipe is air or oil; and a notification device that notifies the determination result of the control device.

title_en: H-3 silicon carbide isotope battery and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an H-3 silicon carbide alloyThe bit cell comprises an N-type highly-doped SiC substrate and a P-type SiC ohmic contact doping region from bottom to top, wherein a partial region on the upper part of the P-type SiC ohmic contact doping region is provided with a first N-type SiC epitaxial layer, a second N-type SiC epitaxial layer is arranged above the first N-type SiC epitaxial layer, a region on the upper part of the P-type SiC ohmic contact doping region except the first N-type SiC epitaxial layer is provided with a P-type ohmic contact electrode, a partial region on the upper part of the second N-type SiC epitaxial layer is provided with an N-type ohmic contact doping region, an N-type ohmic contact electrode is arranged above the N-type ohmic contact doping region, and a region on the upper part of the second N-type SiC epitaxial layer except the N-type ohmic contact doping region is provided with 2 Passivation layer on SiO 2 An H-3 radioactive isotope source is arranged above the passivation layer. The invention has novel and reasonable design, can effectively solve the problem of the recombination loss of the irradiation charge carriers of H-3 on the surface, and effectively improves the output power and the energy conversion efficiency of the isotope battery.

title_en: Engine misfire detection method, device and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a misfire detection method, a device and a system of an engine, wherein the method comprises the following steps: an acquisition step of acquiring first data detected by a crankshaft sensor in the engine and current data detected by a knock sensor in the engine; a transit time calculation step of calculating a transit time for each of a plurality of cylinders in the engine based on the first data; calculating a misfire judging parameter, namely calculating the kinetic energy difference between the current cylinder and other cylinders in the plurality of cylinders according to the passing time, and taking the maximum kinetic energy difference as the misfire judging parameter; a filtering parameter calculation step of calculating current filtering data according to the current data and historical filtering data; and judging the fire of the current cylinder when the fire judging parameter is larger than or equal to a first threshold value and the current filtering data is smaller than a second threshold value.

title_en: Rotary connection structure and wind generating set
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a rotary connection structure and a wind generating set. This swivelling joint structure includes: a connecting cylinder and a yaw assembly; one end of the connecting cylinder is used for connecting an engine room component of the wind generating set, and the other end of the connecting cylinder is used for connecting a tower cylinder of the wind generating set; the yaw assembly is respectively connected with the tower drum and the connecting drum and used for driving the connecting drum to rotate relative to the tower drum. Wind generating set, comprising: the rotary joint structure, the generator, the nacelle assembly and the tower as provided in the first aspect above; the nacelle assembly includes: the base, the second truss and the cabin cover; the generator is rotatably connected with the base; the connecting cylinder of the rotary connecting structure is provided with one end of a yaw assembly and is rotatably connected with the tower cylinder through the yaw assembly; one end, far away from the yawing assembly, of a connecting cylinder of the rotary connecting structure is fixedly connected with the cabin assembly. The embodiment of the application is beneficial to reducing the size or the weight of the cabin assembly, and improves the transportability.

title_en: Miniature electromagnetic oscillation check pump
abstract_en: The invention discloses a miniature electromagnetic oscillation check pump, which comprises an outer cylinder and a lower end cover, wherein a coil framework and a permanent magnet are arranged in the outer cylinder; the center of the coil framework is provided with a first shaft sleeve, the first shaft sleeve is provided with a mounting cavity, and the mounting cavity is provided with a first one-way valve; a mandrel is arranged between the first shaft sleeve and the lower end cover, a lug is arranged on the outer surface of the mandrel, and a first spring and a second spring are respectively sleeved outside the mandrels at two sides of the lug; the upper end of the mandrel is arranged in the mounting cavity through a first sliding bearing, and the lower end of the mandrel is arranged on the lower end cover through a second sliding bearing; the mandrel is provided with a hollow cavity, and a second one-way valve is arranged in the cavity; a water outlet is arranged outside the lower end cover, the water outlet is communicated with the cavity, and the water outlet is provided with a third one-way valve; the outer cylinder and the lower end cover are provided with a cylinder cover, the cylinder cover is provided with a liquid inlet and a liquid outlet, the liquid inlet is communicated with the mounting cavity, and the liquid outlet is communicated with the liquid outlet pipe through a third one-way valve; the invention has the characteristics of constant flow, constant pressure, non-return pressure maintaining and long service life.

title_en: Preparation method of ZnO-Ga polymer scintillation conversion screen
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a ZnO-Ga polymer scintillation conversion screen, which can be used for preparing an ultrafast ZnO-Ga scintillation conversion screen. The invention utilizes a hydrothermal reaction method to prepare ZnO-Ga nanocrystals, and then mainly adopts resin, polystyrene or organic glass as an organic material, so that the ZnO-Ga nanocrystals are combined with the organic material to prepare the ZnO-Ga polymer scintillator. The ZnO-Ga scintillator obtained by the method has no defect luminescence and slow components, the luminescence decay time is dozens of nanoseconds, only the forbidden band edge emits ultrafast luminescence, and the luminescence decay time reaches subnanoseconds. Meanwhile, the thickness and the diameter of the composite material can be conveniently regulated and controlled according to actual needs, and the composite material is strong in adaptability and wide in application. The method has the advantages of simple preparation process, low cost, short preparation period, good scintillation luminescence property and capability of preparing scintillation conversion screens with various sizes and different thicknesses.

title_en: Steam turbine for pyrolysis gas device and pyrolysis gas system
abstract_en: The application provides a steam turbine and a pyrolysis gas system for a pyrolysis gas device, which relate to the technical field of steam turbines, the whole structure adopts single-cylinder single-exhaust steam arrangement, the rotor system is supported by radial bearings of various types and sizes, so that the rotor system is ensured to have enough avoidance intervals, excellent vibration performance and anti-interference performance. The turbine engine adopts a full-circumference steam inlet structure, optimizes a steam inlet flow passage, strengthens structural strength and rigidity, designs a through flow into a back flow structure, effectively reduces axial thrust of the turbine, adopts a high-temperature side guide structure, can prevent cold and hot state gap changes caused under a high-temperature running environment and under the condition of abrupt change of working conditions, solves the problem of centering of a turbine cylinder, adopts a detachable split valve regulating quick-closing structure, simplifies installation and disassembly inspection modes, and optimizes rigidity and thermal stability of the exhaust cylinder in a multi-point supporting mode. Therefore, the single-machine 100MW industrial turbine can drive a 150 ten thousand ton ethylene pyrolysis gas compressor unit, and the requirements of various working conditions and rotation speed change of the compressor unit are ensured.

title_en: Camshaft adjuster having a stator and a rotor with a concentric spring receptacle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a vane-type camshaft adjuster for an internal combustion engine, having a stator and a rotor (3) which is arranged inside the stator and can rotate relative to the stator and is used for adjusting the phase angle of a camshaft, wherein a spring (4) is arranged between the stator and the rotor (3) in order to align the stator and the rotor (3) with each other in a rest position, wherein the spring (4) is coupled to the rotor (3) via a spring receptacle (5), wherein the spring receptacle (5) is designed as a sleeve-type spring receptacle (5) which is concentric to the rotor (3).

title_en: Can generate electricity marine buoy
abstract_en: The invention relates to a self-generating marine buoy device, and belongs to the field of marine equipment. The device is composed of a floating ball, a floating ball connecting rod, a floating body, an upper body support, a storage battery, a solar panel, an indicator light, a radar reflecting device and a positioning device, when the device is placed on the water surface, the floating body can show good stability along with the fluctuation of seawater, and can drive a permanent magnet generator to generate electricity through a series of mechanical transmission along with the fluctuation of the seawater, and then the device is matched with solar power generation, the two are complementary, sufficient electric energy can be provided in any environment, and the device is provided with a radar reflector and is easily captured by a ship radar, so that the ship can predict the existence of the floating body in advance.

title_en: Water delivery device using plunger electromagnetic pump
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water delivery device of a plunger type electromagnetic pump, which belongs to a device using water as a working medium or raw materials, wherein the water delivery device of the plunger type electromagnetic pump is easy to cause the phenomenon that the device cannot normally deliver water and can normally use due to the adhesion between a rubber plug and a corresponding matching piece. Thus, the plunger type electromagnetic pump can be switched to the working state for working or the storage state for storage through the control mechanism. Because the water outlet plug leaves the cut-off mouth to be suspended when in a storage state, the water outlet plug does not contact other structures, and adhesion cannot be caused, so that the device cannot deliver water and cannot work due to adhesion.

title_en: Rectifying diffuser and assembling method thereof
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of rectifier diffuser structural design, concretely relates to rectifier diffuser includes: an outer ring, one end of which is a first outer ring end and the other end of which is a second outer ring end; the inner wall of the first outer ring end is provided with a first outer ring protrusion, and the first outer ring protrusion is provided with an outer ring mounting opening; the inner wall of the second outer ring end is provided with a second outer ring protrusion; the inner ring is arranged on the inner side of the outer ring, one end of the inner ring is a first inner ring end, and the other end of the inner ring is a second inner ring end; the outer wall of the first inner ring end is provided with a first inner ring bulge, and an inner ring mounting opening is formed in the first inner ring bulge; the outer wall of the second inner ring end is provided with a second inner ring bulge; a plurality of straightening vanes, each straightening vane having a first end, a second end opposite the first end; the first end of each rectifying blade is abutted with the first outer ring bulge and the first inner ring bulge, and the second end of each rectifying blade is abutted with the second outer ring bulge and the second inner ring bulge. And to a method of assembling the above-described commutating diffuser.

title_en: Preformed plug with inter-blade profile for a hydraulic turbine
abstract_en: The application relates to an inter-blade profile (14) for a turbine runner blade, said inter-blade profile (14) comprising a profile (16) and a plug (18), the plug (18) forming a seat for the profile (16) and intended for insertion into a corresponding hole (21) made in the blade.

title_en: Fuel filler opening structure of fuel tank
abstract_en: A filler structure of a fuel tank is provided with a filler pipe (11), a filler opening (13), and a deflector (20). The flow guide (20) is provided with: a main guide wall (24) that divides a fuel introduction region (19) inside the filler pipe (11) into an upper space (22) that communicates with the tank main body side and a lower space (23) that communicates with the filler opening (13) side; and a partition wall (26) that is provided in connection with the main guide wall (24) and that blocks a gap between the upper surface side of the main guide wall (24) and the inner surface of the filler pipe (11). The main guide wall (24) has a bent inclined portion (27) bent and inclined downward from a middle portion, which is a middle portion of the main guide wall (24) from the filler opening (13) side toward the tank main body side. The bent inclined portion (27) is formed in a shape such that the width in plan view becomes narrower as the bent inclined portion is inclined downward.

title_en: Water cooling mechanism for medical isotope production target
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medical isotope production targets, in particular to a water cooling mechanism for a medical isotope production target. The utility model provides a water-cooling mechanism for medical isotope production target, is including the medical isotope production target body, production target front end housing and the water-cooling closing plate that are connected, one of them one end shaping of medical isotope production target body has the cooling tank, and the cooling tank includes intake channel, play basin and connects the heat exchange groove of intake channel and play basin, water inlet and the apopore that is linked to each other with the intake channel are seted up on the water-cooling closing plate and are linked together with the play basin. Cooling water is injected into the cooling tank through the water inlet hole, enters the water outlet tank after passing through the heat exchange tank from the water purifying tank, and is discharged through the water outlet hole. Because the heat is taken away by the cooling water, and new cooling water is continuously input into the cooling tank, the water cooling mechanism can be kept in a high-efficiency cooling state.

title_en: Method for inspecting performance of fuel injector matching complete machine
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for checking the performance of an oil sprayer matching complete machine, which comprises an oil sprayer to be tested, wherein a vibration sensor is arranged at the inlet position of the oil sprayer to be tested, one end of the oil sprayer to be tested is arranged on an oil sprayer performance tester in a calibration state, the other end of the oil sprayer to be tested is connected to a common rail pipe for testing, and a signal of the vibration sensor is connected to an electronic control unit for testing the performance of the oil sprayer to acquire a normal working vibration signal of the oil sprayer; when the whole diesel engine is matched, one end of an oil injector to be tested is installed on a cylinder of the diesel engine, the other end of the oil injector to be tested is connected to a high-pressure oil pipe of the diesel engine, and a vibration sensor is connected to an electronic control unit of the diesel engine in a signal mode and used for collecting vibration signals of the oil injector; and comparing the normal working vibration signal of the oil sprayer with the vibration signal, and detecting the working state and the performance rule of the oil sprayer to be detected when the oil sprayer is matched with the whole machine for test. The method for inspecting the performance of the fuel injector matching complete machine can improve the testing precision and reduce the testing cost under the condition of not influencing the sealing and the performance of the fuel injector.

title_en: Pump body assembly, rotary compressor and air conditioner
abstract_en: The invention provides a pump body assembly, a rotary compressor and an air conditioner. The pump body assembly comprises an exhaust cavity, wherein the exhaust cavity is provided with a first exhaust port, a silencer is arranged at the downstream of the first exhaust port and used for buffering and reducing noise of air flow exhausted by the first exhaust port, a second exhaust port is arranged on the silencer, the flow area of the first exhaust port is S1, the flow area of the second exhaust port is S0, and S0/S1 is less than 0.865. The pump body assembly, the rotary compressor and the air conditioner provided by the invention can reduce the oil discharge rate of the compressor, reduce the reliability risk of the compressor caused by insufficient lubrication due to the over high oil discharge rate, and improve the refrigerating capacity of the compressor to realize the high efficiency of the compressor.

title_en: Large two-stroke uniflow scavenged gaseous fuel engine and method for reducing pre-ignition/diesel knock
abstract_en: A large two-stroke turbocharged uniflow-scavenged internal combustion engine and method of avoiding or reducing pre-ignition/diesel knock thereof are provided. The internal combustion engine includes: a combustion chamber defined by a cylinder liner, a piston, and a cylinder head; a gas discharge outlet disposed in the cylinder head and controlled by a discharge valve; a plurality of gaseous fuel inlet openings for admitting received gaseous fuel into the combustion chamber via the gaseous fuel valve; a combustion gas outlet controlled by a combustion gas valve; a combustion gas flow path extending from an outlet of the combustion gas valve to an inlet of the gaseous fuel valve or a dedicated combustion gas injection valve, the engine being configured to inject gaseous fuel into the combustion chamber using the combustion gas inlet opening during a fuel injection event and simultaneously, sequentially or overlappingly, to inject combustion gas into the combustion chamber using the combustion gas inlet opening or the dedicated combustion gas injection valve to increase the momentum of material injected into the combustion chamber during the fuel injection event.

title_en: Blade fault monitoring method and device based on double arrays
abstract_en: The invention relates to a blade fault monitoring method based on a double array, which comprises the following steps: s1, arranging a first array, and monitoring and acquiring blade fault information; s2, positioning the fault; s21, estimating a fault azimuth angle to obtain a minimum fault azimuth angle, and positioning by using the first array; and S22, arranging a second array, and positioning the fault by matching the first array with the second array. The invention also discloses a blade fault monitoring device based on the double arrays. In the invention, the first array and the second array are combined, so that the problem that the positioning accuracy is lower and lower when the included angle between the first array and the rotating plane is increased is solved; the accuracy of estimating fault points is improved, the number of the arrays is greatly reduced, fault location under the condition that the blade rotating shaft rotates along with the wind direction can be completed only by the first array and the second array, the number of the arrays is greatly reduced, and the cost is reduced.

title_en: Method and device for detecting fire of whole vehicle
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of vehicle engines, and particularly relates to a method and a control device for detecting fire of a whole vehicle. The invention discloses a method for detecting fire of a whole vehicle, which comprises the following steps: acquiring gear information and the current rotating speed of the engine, and determining teeth on an engine rotating speed signal panel corresponding to each cylinder according to the gear information and the current rotating speed of the engine; acquiring the time length for tooth rotation on the engine speed signal panel when the engine speed signal panel rotates for one period, and extracting a time length curve for tooth rotation of a corresponding order according to the time length for tooth rotation; comparing teeth on the engine speed signal panel corresponding to each cylinder with a time length curve to determine the response time length of each cylinder; and calculating the time deviation of each cylinder according to the response time of each cylinder, judging that the time deviation of each cylinder is greater than a preset deviation value, and determining that the current cylinder catches fire. The influence of the matching of the whole vehicle on the rotating speed phase is introduced, the influence of the gear of the whole vehicle is considered, and the accuracy of judging the cylinder when the fire is caught after the matching of the whole vehicle is improved.

title_en: Stack valve assembly
abstract_en: The valve combination comprises a seat plate (120, 220) having a top surface (121, 221) and a bottom surface (129, 229), a plurality of first valve modules (170, 270) arranged in a first layer (130, 230) with respect to the seat plate (120, 220), and at least one second valve module (170, 270) arranged in a second layer (150, 250) with respect to the seat plate (120, 220), such that a first seating surface (171, 271) of each of the plurality of first valve modules (170, 270) is substantially coplanar with a first plane (135, 235), the first plane (135, 235) is substantially parallel with at least one of the bottom surface (129, 229) and the top surface (121, 221) of the seat plate (120, 220), such that a second seating surface (171, 271) of the at least one second valve module (170, 270) is coplanar with a second plane (155, 255), the second plane (155, 255) is substantially parallel with the first plane (135 ), 235) Wherein the second plane (155, 255) is offset from the first plane (135, 235) by a first distance (151, 251).

title_en: Piston type linkage water heat energy conversion device and operation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a piston type linkage water heat energy conversion device and an operation method thereof, wherein the device comprises a power unit, a heat energy transfer unit and a heat energy output unit, wherein the power unit comprises a driving motor and a driving shaft, and the driving shaft is connected with the output end of the driving motor; the heat energy transfer unit comprises a piston assembly and a pipeline assembly, and the pipeline assembly is connected with the piston assembly; the heat energy output unit is connected with the pipeline assembly and comprises a water tank assembly and a compensation assembly, and the compensation assembly is matched with the water tank assembly; according to the invention, geothermal water is input into the heat energy transfer unit, and the heat energy in the geothermal water is transferred to the heat energy output unit through the auxiliary pressurization of the power unit, so that the output of the heat energy can be greatly improved through a small amount of mechanical energy input, and the heat energy output does not destroy the ecology of underground water, and is safe and sustainable.

title_en: Ageing, washing and drying device for uranium dioxide gel balls
abstract_en: The invention discloses a uranium dioxide gel ball aging, washing and drying device which comprises a support, a first rotating shaft, a second rotating shaft, an inner cylinder, an electric heating assembly, an electric slip ring and a vacuum condensation assembly. The first rotating shaft and the second rotating shaft are rotatably supported on the bracket, and the second rotating shaft is provided with an axial hollow channel; one end of the inner cylinder is fixed with one end of the first rotating shaft, and the other end of the inner cylinder is fixed with one end of the second rotating shaft; the electric heating component is fixed on the outer surface of the inner cylinder so as to uniformly heat the inner cylinder; the electric slip ring is fixed on the first rotating shaft or the second rotating shaft and is electrically connected with the electric heating assembly; the vacuum condensation assembly comprises a vacuum tube, a condenser and a vacuum pump, the vacuum tube penetrates through the hollow channel, one end of the vacuum tube is located in the inner barrel, the other end of the vacuum tube is communicated with the condenser, and the vacuum pump is communicated with the condenser. The invention has the advantages of shortening the operation time of the aging, washing and drying process by more than half, along with large equipment handling capacity and the like.

title_en: Micro-electromechanical pump module
abstract_en: A microelectromechanical pump module comprising: a microprocessor for outputting a constant voltage and a variable voltage; a micro-electromechanical chip electrically connected to the microprocessor, the micro-electromechanical chip comprising: a chip body, which is a rectangular shape and has a long side; the MEMS pumps are arranged on the chip body and respectively provided with a first electrode and a second electrode; the plurality of connecting electrodes are arranged on the chip body and are adjacent to the long edges, and the connecting electrodes are respectively and electrically connected with the first electrodes of the MEMS pump; the common electrode is arranged on the chip body and is adjacent to the long edge, and the common electrode is electrically connected with a second electrode of the MEMS pump; the microprocessor is electrically connected with the connecting electrode and the common electrode respectively so as to transmit a constant voltage to the common electrode and transmit a variable voltage to the connecting electrode.

title_en: Electric water pump with control panel mounted in middle of water pump
abstract_en: The invention relates to an electric water pump with a control panel arranged in the middle of a water pump, which comprises a water pump volute, a water pump impeller, a pump cover, a water pump control panel, a rotor cover, a shell, a rear bearing, a stator, a thrust ring and a front bearing, wherein the water pump volute is arranged on the front end face of the pump cover, the water pump control panel is arranged on the rear end face of the pump cover, a port of the rotor cover is sleeved on the outer circle of a boss at the rear end of the pump cover, a pit is arranged at the rear end of an inner cavity of the rotor cover, the front bearing is arranged in a front bearing mounting hole on the pump cover, the rotor is arranged in an inner cavity of the rotor cover, a rotor blade is arranged on the rear end face of the rotor, an axle center through hole of the thrust ring is sleeved on the outer circle of the boss at the front end of the rotor, the water pump impeller is arranged on the outer circle at the front end of the rotor shaft, the stator is sleeved on the outer circle of the rotor cover, and the inner cavity of the shell is sleeved on the outer circle of the stator. The electric water pump has a good internal cooling system, has a good cooling effect on the control board, the rotor and the stator, and has small heat load and high working reliability.

title_en: Low-thrust radio frequency ion thruster for cusp field
abstract_en: The invention provides a cusp field low-thrust radio frequency ion thruster, belongs to the technical field of spacecraft propulsion, and particularly relates to a cusp field low-thrust radio frequency ion thruster. The problem of current radio frequency ion thrustor thrust lower limit higher is solved. The ionization chamber is a cylindrical discharge cavity, the working medium conveying channel is connected with the ionization chamber, neutral gas enters the ionization chamber through the working medium conveying channel, the radio frequency power supply is arranged outside the ionization chamber, the radio frequency antenna is arranged at the top of the ionization chamber and is connected with the ferrite in a matching mode, two ends of the radio frequency antenna are respectively connected with two poles of the radio frequency power supply, the permanent magnet is arranged around the ionization chamber and is of a multi-stage structure, the polarity of the permanent magnet is opposite, and the grid device is respectively connected with the positive pole and the negative pole of the direct current power supply. The method is mainly used for the radio frequency ion thruster.

title_en: Engine and oil injector thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an engine and an oil sprayer thereof, wherein the oil sprayer comprises an oil inlet part and an oil spraying part, the oil inlet part is provided with an oil inlet, the oil spraying part is provided with an oil spraying port, and the oil inlet part is communicated with the oil spraying part so that fuel oil can enter the oil spraying part from the oil inlet part; the oil inlet portion and the oil injection portion are arranged in a split mode, the oil inlet portion is fixed to a cylinder cover of an engine, the rotating portion is used for driving the oil injection portion to rotate and comprises a rotating shaft and a stator and rotor assembly, the stator and rotor assembly is used for driving the rotating shaft to rotate, and the rotating shaft is fixedly connected with the oil injection portion. Because the oil spout portion can rotate under the drive of rotation portion to make the fuel in this oil spout portion rotate thereupon, when spouting to the engine cylinder from the nozzle, this part fuel continues to rotate because of inertia, thereby makes fuel and air have relative motion, improves the homogeneity that the two mixes in the cylinder, and then improves the combustion efficiency of fuel, reduces the engine and leads to the pollutant emission because the burning is incomplete.

title_en: Compressor rotor, compressor and refrigerant circulation system
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a compressor rotor, a compressor, and a refrigerant circulation system. The compressor rotor comprises a motor rotor, a locking rod, a compression unit rotating part and a locking part, wherein the motor rotor comprises a plurality of rotor sections fixedly connected along the axial direction, the rotor sections are provided with axial through holes, the locking rod penetrates through the axial through holes, the compression unit rotating part is positioned at the end part of the motor rotor and connected to the locking rod, the locking part locks the compression unit rotating part on the locking rod, and the locking rod, the compression unit rotating part and the locking part form a compression structure for applying pressure towards the inner side of the axial direction to the motor rotor. The compressor rotor of the present disclosure can make connection between rotor sections of a motor rotor having a plurality of rotor sections more reliable and firm while sectionally processing the motor rotor.

title_en: Small high-speed direct current fan with double-picking bearing structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a small high-speed direct current fan with a double-picking bearing structure, which comprises an air duct assembly, wherein a rotor assembly (1) and a stator assembly (2) are arranged in the air duct assembly, an impeller (3) connected with the rotor assembly (1) is arranged at the air inlet end of the air duct assembly, the air duct assembly comprises an air duct body (4) and a support body (5), a first bearing chamber (41) is arranged at the air inlet end of the air duct body (4), the support body (5) is connected with the air outlet end of the air duct body (4), the support body (5) comprises a ring body (51) with the same diameter as the air duct body (4), a second bearing chamber (52) is arranged on the central axis of the ring body (51), and the second bearing chamber (52) is connected with the ring body (51) through a plurality of cross beams (53). The invention has the advantages of high stability, good product control, low reject ratio and long service life during operation.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle micro hybrid power system integrating starting and launching and starting method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle micro hybrid power system integrating initiation and a starting method, belonging to the technical field of hybrid power supply. The system comprises a two-stroke piston engine, a starting and starting integrated motor, a position sensor, a motor controller and a power supply, wherein a rotor shaft of the starting and starting integrated motor is connected with a crankshaft of the two-stroke piston engine; the motor controller comprises a driving circuit, a rectifying circuit, a charging and discharging circuit, a first diode, a second diode and a double-path relay; the driving circuit comprises a driving chip, one end of the rectifying circuit is connected with the power supply, the other end of the rectifying circuit is connected with the ground, and the output end of the rectifying circuit is connected with the starting integrated motor; the charging and discharging circuit comprises a first super capacitor and a second super capacitor, and the first super capacitor is connected with a first diode in series to form a first series circuit; the second super capacitor is connected with the second diode in series to form a second series circuit, and the first series circuit and the second series circuit are connected with the rectifying circuit in parallel. The advantage of the invention is to reduce starting resistance and resistance torque fluctuation.

title_en: Axial-flow compressor characteristic line self-adaption method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a characteristic line self-adaption method of an axial-flow compressor, which is characterized in that a thermodynamic model of a multistage axial-flow compressor is established through a step-by-step superposition calculation method according to a general-stage characteristic curve calculation formula of each stage of the axial-flow compressor; the method comprises the steps of collecting gas path measurement parameters of a gas turbine of an actual object, taking root mean square error between the gas path parameters obtained through calculation of a thermal model and gas path measurement data obtained through collection of the gas turbine of the actual object as a target function, iteratively optimizing shape coefficient vectors of all levels of general level characteristic curves in the thermal model through a particle swarm optimization algorithm, and generating an axial flow type compressor general characteristic line matched with the compressor characteristics of the gas turbine of the actual object. Thereby eliminating the uncertainty introduced by manufacturing and mounting deviation among different combustion engines of the same type; the uncertainty introduced by different interferences and unknown initial conditions is eliminated; and errors caused by the assumed conditions are calculated in a step-by-step overlapping mode during generation of the component characteristic lines, so that the accuracy of the component characteristic lines of the gas compressor is improved.

title_en: Numerical control fan convenient to adjust wind-force gear
abstract_en: The invention discloses a numerical control fan convenient for adjusting wind power gears, which relates to the field of numerical control fans and comprises an installation shell, a fan sleeve, fan blades, an installation seat, a driving motor, an anti-displacement supporting bottom plate and a driving motor, wherein the installation seat is fixedly installed at the bottom of the installation shell; the fan sleeve is rotatably arranged, when the air outlet angle of the fan needs to be changed, the integral fan device does not need to be moved, the fan sleeve is directly rotated, the air outlet angle of the fan can be quickly changed, the adjustment is convenient, the driving gear is arranged in the fan, the movable meshing teeth are regularly arranged outside the fan sleeve at equal intervals, the fan sleeve can rotate at a constant speed when the angle is changed through gear meshing transmission, and the gear transmission stability is high.

title_en: Replacement insert for repairing a joint connecting a wind turbine rotor blade to a rotor hub
abstract_en: A replacement insert for repairing a joint connecting a wind turbine blade to a rotor hub of a wind turbine is disclosed. The replacement insert includes a liner having a first end, a second end, an outer surface, and an interior passage. The replacement insert further includes a cover surrounding at least a portion of the outer surface of the liner. The replacement insert may have a non-circular cross-sectional profile. The cover defines an outer surface and a plurality of protrusions extending from the outer surface of the cover. The protrusion is configured to act as a spacer when the replacement insert is positioned in a liner cavity in the wind turbine blade to define a gap between the replacement insert and a wall of the liner cavity.

title_en: Integrated rotor and machining method thereof, pump body assembly and vacuum pump
abstract_en: The invention provides an integrated rotor and a processing method thereof, a pump body assembly and a vacuum pump, wherein the processing method of the integrated rotor sequentially comprises the following steps: the integrated rotor blank is inspected by a three-coordinate measuring instrument, the integrated rotor blank is finely processed by a grinding mode, in the fine processing process, the circular runout of a rotating shaft of the integrated rotor blank is in the range of 0-0.012mm, the surface finish is in the range of 0-0.8 mu m, and the verticality of blades of the integrated rotor blank relative to the rotating shaft of the integrated rotor blank is in the range of 0-0.02 mm; and carrying out dynamic balance measurement on the integrated rotor blank, and screening out the integrated rotor blank meeting the dynamic balance standard to obtain the integrated rotor with six blades. The technical scheme of this application has solved effectively among the relevant art when fixing the blade to the pivot, can produce too big local stress and easily damage the problem of pivot in fixed position department.

title_en: Graphite nodule moderated molten salt reactor
abstract_en: The invention relates to a graphite nodule moderated molten salt pile, which comprises a reflecting layer accommodated in a cladding, wherein the reflecting layer defines an active zone, the active zone comprises a first zone and a second zone, molten salt for liquid fuel flows from bottom to top to fill the first zone and the second zone, and a plurality of graphite nodules playing a role of moderating are only piled up in the first zone. According to the graphite nodule moderated molten salt reactor, liquid molten salt is used as fuel, and graphite nodules are used as moderator, so that the advantages of the molten salt reactor are inherited, the material changing cost and the technical difficulty are reduced, the manufacturing process is simplified, the graphite nodule is simple in shape, the manufacturing equipment is miniaturized, the reactor is more flexible to enter and exit, and the technical difficulty in operation is greatly reduced.

title_en: Molecular pump fault diagnosis prediction system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a molecular pump fault diagnosis prediction system, which comprises: the fault simulation system, the vacuum cavity, the vacuum air extraction system and the molecular pump diagnosis system are connected in sequence; the fault simulation system comprises a needle valve, a gauge pipe, a VDE valve and a VDE valve controller; the fault simulation system is used for simulating the sudden situation of leakage of the vacuum cavity and entry of foreign matters, so as to cause the fault of the molecular pump; one end of the vacuum air extraction system is connected with the vacuum cavity through a gate valve, and the other end of the vacuum air extraction system is connected with the mechanical pump; the molecular pump diagnosis system comprises a multi-state monitoring sensor, a data acquisition device, a data calculation device and a fault diagnosis prediction result output device; the multi-state monitoring sensor acquires real fault state data of the molecular pump and provides data guarantee for online real-time analysis of a molecular pump diagnosis system. The invention provides a quick, economical and efficient solution, and solves the problem that a molecular pump diagnosis and prediction system cannot be effectively built due to insufficient fault data of the molecular pump.

title_en: Aquaculture uniform aeration culture tank adopting Roots blower unit
abstract_en: The invention relates to an aquaculture uniform aeration culture tank adopting a Roots blower set, and belongs to the field of aquaculture equipment. The uniform aeration aquaculture tank adopting the Roots blower unit is divided into a single water channel or a plurality of water channels, each water channel end is provided with an aeration pipeline, the aeration pipelines are respectively connected with an external Roots blower system, the Roots blower system is connected with the Internet of things control unit and controls the Roots blower system by the Internet of things control unit, and the Internet of things control unit is communicated with a user side through a wireless signal through an external transmitting end. The uniform aeration aquaculture tank adopting the Roots blower unit can be additionally provided with remote control equipment on the basis of assembling and forming aquaculture facilities, can accurately control aquaculture environment, and can monitor the conditions in the aquaculture facilities in real time.

title_en: Closed self-adaptive tide level swing plate wave power generation device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a closed self-adaptive tide level swing plate wave power generation device, which comprises: the device comprises a sealing main body, a swinging plate, a swinging frame, an anchor cable and a sinking block; the swinging plate is connected with the swinging frame, the swinging frame is movably connected with the airtight main body, the airtight main body is connected with the anchor cable, the anchor cable is connected with the sinking block, and the sinking block is anchored on the sea floor; the swing frame is provided with a long swing rod and a short swing rod, the long swing rod and the short swing rod are respectively provided with a ball node, and the ball nodes are movably connected with the sealing main body; the sealed main body is internally provided with a power generation device which comprises a rocker arm, a one-way clutch, a rotating shaft, a generator and an inertia wheel; the rotating shaft is connected with a driving shaft of the generator, the rotating shaft is connected with an inertia wheel, the rocker arm is movably connected with the long swing rod, the rocker arm is connected with the one-way clutch, the one-way clutch is connected with the rotating shaft, and when the rocker arm swings, the one-way clutch drives the rotating shaft to rotate towards a single direction, and the generator is driven to rotate unidirectionally to generate electricity. The invention has the advantages of good adaptability, high power generation efficiency, reliable transmission, strong corrosion resistance of the motion joint, simple maintenance and the like.

title_en: Infusion pump easy to replace pipeline
abstract_en: The invention discloses an infusion pump easy to replace a pipeline, which comprises a first pump shell, a second pump shell, a locking part for locking the first pump shell and the second pump shell, an eccentric main shaft assembly which is arranged between the first pump shell and the second pump shell and can axially move, and a wobble plate assembly which is arranged on the eccentric main shaft assembly, wherein a first pipeline accommodating groove and a second pipeline accommodating groove for clamping an elastic pipeline are respectively arranged on opposite sides of the first pump shell and the second pump shell, a first elastic part is propped between one end of the eccentric main shaft assembly and the first pump shell, and a second elastic part is propped between the other end of the eccentric main shaft assembly and the second pump shell. The invention has the advantages of simple and reliable structure, easy replacement of the pipeline, etc.

title_en: Southern city sewer pipe inspection well cover and matched fence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a southern city sewer pipe inspection well cover and a matched fence, aiming at the problems that an inspection well cover fence is inconvenient to mount and unstable to place, is easy to topple and damage under strong wind and heavy rain and cannot meet the warning effect, the southern city sewer pipe inspection well cover comprises a ring iron and a well cover, and is characterized in that short shafts are welded on the inner walls of two sides of the ring iron, one ends of the short shafts are connected with the well cover in a sleeved mode, a well cover fixing mechanism is arranged on the outer walls of the tops of the ring iron and the well cover, a sleeve is fixed on the outer wall of one side of the well cover through screws, supporting rods are sleeved on the inner walls of the sleeve and a slot, and the top ends of the supporting rods are connected with a connecting plate through hinges. According to the invention, the support rod and the well lid are firmly clamped through the fixing spring, and the base can be turned at a certain angle at the bottom of the support, so that the contact area between the base and the ground is increased, the placing stability of the fence is improved, the placing is reliable, the operation and the installation are simple and convenient, and the warning effect is ensured.

title_en: Water turbine impeller capable of generating electricity by ocean current energy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water turbine impeller capable of generating electricity by ocean current energy, which comprises a main body mechanism, a sliding mechanism, blades, screws, a fixing mechanism, a rotating shaft, a fixing plate, a connecting rod and a telescopic spring. The invention has the beneficial effects that: a plurality of blade is cyclic annular slip in the major structure, screw threaded connection is in the inner wall of major structure, the pivot is rotated in the inside and pivot lateral wall of major structure and is connected in the fixed plate, a plurality of connecting rod is cyclic annular and installs in the fixed plate bottom, and the connecting rod block in the fixed plate inner wall, expanding spring installs in the inside and cup joints in the connecting rod tip of major structure, twist and move screw and major structure and separate partly, the connecting rod separates with expanding spring, the pivot rotates and makes the fixed plate rotate, the connecting rod is through rotating the tip separation with the blade, and then make operating personnel can directly extract out the blade that damages and maintain the change, be favorable to preventing to dismantling the condition that leads to spare part damage with the impeller is whole, operating personnel's work efficiency has been improved.

title_en: Method for diagnosing engine oil pressure insufficiency
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for diagnosing engine oil pressure insufficiency of an engine, which is used for monitoring the engine oil pressure in real time, reversely judging whether the engine oil pressure is too low through the duty ratio of VVT, and taking effective protective measures for the engine by an ECU when detecting that the engine oil pressure is too low. When the low-oil-pressure interval works, the controller can find the low-oil-pressure interval in time and optimally adjust the running of the engine, such as forbidding VVT (variable valve timing) to protect the engine.

title_en: Impurity concentration measuring method applied to magnetic confinement fusion reactor device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of monitoring of density/concentration of impurities in operation of a fusion reactor, and particularly relates to an impurity concentration measuring method applied to a magnetic confinement fusion reactor device, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps: injecting hydrogen or isotopes thereof into the plasma by a neutral beam system on the magnetic confinement fusion device to generate a neutral beam emission spectrum and excited hydrogen-like ions, and then radiating a charge exchange composite spectrum; step two: bremsstrahlung of the corresponding spectrum and the adjacent wavelength of the corresponding spectrum are respectively measured by the charge exchange composite spectrum diagnosis system, and the charge exchange composite spectrum system is calibrated by using the bremsstrahlung; step three: and carrying out a ratio of the charge exchange composite spectrum radiated by the impurities to the emission spectrum of the neutral beam to obtain the impurity concentration R. The invention realizes the calibration of the system and the acquisition of the impurity concentration in the process of polluting the light path by synchronously measuring the charge exchange composite spectrum, the neutral beam emission spectrum and the bremsstrahlung of the wavelengths adjacent to the charge exchange composite spectrum and the neutral beam emission spectrum.

title_en: Cover structure and transport container
abstract_en: The present invention provides a cover structure and a transport container, the cover structure comprising: the device comprises a cover body and a pressing mechanism arranged at the bottom of the cover body. According to the cover structure, as the pressing mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the cover body, when the cover structure is arranged on the nuclear fuel transport container, the pressing mechanism can be used for rapidly pressing and fixing the nuclear fuel assembly in the transport container, so that the loading and unloading efficiency of the transport container can be improved in the process of loading the nuclear fuel assembly, and meanwhile, the safety of the nuclear fuel assembly in the process of transport is ensured.

title_en: Modularized space nuclear reactor power generation unit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power generation unit of a modularized space nuclear reactor, which comprises a power generation chamber, wherein the power generation chamber comprises a modularized core area, two ends of the modularized core area are respectively provided with a small turbine and a gas compressor, the small turbine is connected with a small generator, and the gas compressor, the small turbine and the small generator are all positioned in the power generation chamber; the head end and the tail end of the power generation cavity are provided with satellite external ports, and a first power generation unit master control room and a second power generation unit master control room are respectively arranged between the satellite external ports and the power generation cavity; the power generation cavity is connected with a heat exchanger, the heat exchanger is connected with a heat pipe main pipe of a space heat radiation radiator, and a small heat pipe of the space heat radiation radiator is arranged on the heat pipe main pipe of the space heat radiation radiator. The reactor core adopts the multiple heat pipes to conduct the heat power, thereby avoiding the influence of the emergency shutdown of the reactor caused by the failure of a single heat pipe, conforming to the redundancy principle of the safety of the nuclear reactor and being beneficial to improving the reliability of the heat transfer of the reactor core.

title_en: Draught fan stall intelligent early warning method based on actual critical stall curve of draught fan
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent early warning method for stall of a draught fan based on an actual critical stall curve of the draught fan, which comprises the following steps: step 1, calculating the specific pressure energy of an induced draft fan; step 2, cleaning and fault removing are carried out on the historical operation condition sample data, and a working condition point set of normal operation of the induced draft fan is determined; and step 3, fitting the upper boundary point of the working condition point of the normal operation of the induced draft fan obtained in the step 2 through a polynomial fitting method. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: compared with the conventional DCS system, the method has the advantages that the distance between the actual operation working condition point and the critical stall curve is used as a judging method by a single-parameter alarming method, so that early warning can be performed in advance according to the distance change; meanwhile, when the operating condition point reaches or exceeds a critical stall curve, the alarm can be given out in time; the actual critical stall curve of the fan is obtained through long-term historical operation data fitting, is close to the actual operation condition compared with the stall curve given by a fan manufacturer, and is favorable for realizing accurate early warning of the stall of the fan.

title_en: Liquid compressed air energy storage peak shaving system and method for cascade utilization of steam heat
abstract_en: The invention discloses a liquid compressed air energy storage peak shaving system and method for cascade utilization of steam heat, wherein the system comprises a plurality of low-pressure heaters and a plurality of high-pressure heaters; the exhaust steam of a low-pressure cylinder in the coal-fired power generation unit enters a condenser for heat exchange, sequentially passes through a plurality of low-pressure heaters after passing through a condensate pump, sequentially passes through a deaerator and a water supply pump, sequentially enters a plurality of high-pressure heaters, and then returns to a boiler in the coal-fired power generation unit; each section of extraction steam of a high-pressure cylinder in the coal-fired generator set is respectively introduced into each high-pressure heater; the extraction steam of each section of the low-pressure cylinder is respectively introduced into each low-pressure heater; the third-stage steam extraction of the medium-pressure cylinder is introduced into a last low-pressure heater from a condensate pump to the deaerator, the second-stage steam extraction is introduced into the deaerator, the first-stage steam extraction is introduced into an air heater, and the first high-pressure heater from the deaerator to the boiler after heat exchange.

title_en: Centrifugal fan
abstract_en: The invention provides a centrifugal fan, comprising: the volute comprises a front plate, a rear plate and a surrounding plate, wherein the molded line of the surrounding plate comprises an initial straight line section, a transition rounding section, a first spiral line section, a second spiral line section, a third spiral line section, a fourth spiral line section, a fifth spiral line section, a sixth spiral line section and a final straight line section which are connected in a smooth transition mode in sequence, and the first spiral line section, the second spiral line section, the third spiral line section, the fourth spiral line section, the fifth spiral line section and the sixth spiral line section are arranged concentrically; and an impeller disposed within the volute. The air channel flow field in the volute of the centrifugal fan is improved, and the performance of the centrifugal fan is improved.

title_en: Electric waste gas bypass valve control method and device, vehicle and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for controlling an electric waste gate valve, a vehicle and a storage medium.
