The method comprises the following steps: when the valve closing voltage value correction condition is met, adjusting the voltage value of a driving motor of the driving motor to a preset voltage initial value; increasing the voltage value of the driving motor by preset step length, and monitoring the sliding change condition of the waste gate valve in real time; and when the sliding change condition of the waste gate valve meets the voltage determination condition, saving the voltage value of the driving motor at the current moment as a default value of the valve closing voltage. The invention solves the problems that the driving motor can not accurately control the opening of the waste gas bypass valve and the driving connecting rod is prevented from being deformed due to overlarge stress, realizes the automatic correction of the corresponding relation between the driving voltage value of the driving motor and the opening of the waste gas bypass valve, and achieves the effects of prolonging the service life of the turbocharger, improving the performance of the engine, saving energy and reducing emission.

title_en: Method for measuring radial clearance of turbine blade top, capacitance sensor and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for measuring the radial clearance of the blade top of a steam turbine, a capacitance sensor and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first distance between an inner cylinder of a steam turbine and the top of a blade; acquiring a steam seal tooth installation length value of the steam turbine; and calculating the difference value between the first distance and the mounting length value of the steam seal tooth to be used as the measured value of the radial clearance of the blade top of the steam turbine. The method for measuring the radial clearance of the blade top of the steam turbine, the capacitance sensor and the storage medium can be used for detecting the radial clearance of the blade top during the assembly or overhaul of the steam turbine, ensure that the through-flow clearance of the steam turbine is in a design range, overcome the defects of the traditional rubberized fabric pasting method and lead wire pressing method, and can measure the radial clearance of the blade top under the turning conditions of a half cylinder, a full cylinder and a rotor.

title_en: Fan master control system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fan master control system, wherein a digital quantity module, an analog quantity module and a bus expansion module are electrically connected with a fan output power supply, the digital quantity module is electrically connected with a first storage battery, the first storage battery is connected with the fan output power supply in parallel, the analog quantity module is electrically connected with a second storage battery, the second storage battery is connected with the fan output power supply in parallel, the bus expansion module is electrically connected with a third storage battery, and the third storage battery is connected with the fan output power supply in parallel. Compared with the prior art, the damage of surge to the digital quantity module, the analog quantity module and the bus extension module can be prevented, and therefore the fault that the PLC module is burnt out in the 24V electricity stopping process of the fan is prevented.

title_en: Finger pressing fan
abstract_en: The invention discloses a finger-pressing fan, which comprises a lower shell and an upper shell, and is characterized in that the surfaces of two sides of the lower shell are provided with cylinders, the surfaces of two sides of the upper shell are provided with movable grooves, the cylinders are movably arranged in the movable grooves in a penetrating way, the outer end surfaces of the lower shell and the upper shell are respectively provided with pull rings for sheathing fingers, a fixed plate is arranged in the lower shell, a fan is arranged in front of the lower shell, the fan is inserted in the fixed plate through a fan shaft, the fan shaft is provided with a gear, a first driving device and a second driving device which can drive the fan to rotate are respectively arranged in the lower shell and the upper shell, the surface of the front side of the upper shell is provided with a water spraying device which can spray water to reduce the temperature, the invention drives the first driving device and the second driving device to stagger back and forth by arranging the gear on the fan shaft of the fan and then extruding and opening the upper shell and the lower shell back and forth, thereby achieving the rotation of the fan.

title_en: Lightning discharge system for a wind turbine
abstract_en: The invention relates to a lightning discharge system for a wind turbine. The invention relates to a lightning discharge system for a wind turbine, the wind turbine comprising: a hub (1); a hub cap (2) defining a protected space in which the hub (1) is arranged; a blade (3) fixed to the hub (1); and a nacelle (4). The exhaust system comprises a blade band (101) attached to the blade (3), a ring (102) facing the nacelle (4) and attached to the band (101) and said nacelle (4), respective contact means (103, 104) connecting the band (101) to the ring (102) and the ring (102) to the nacelle (4). A band (101) and a ring (102) are arranged in the space, and the ring (102) is further attached to the hub (1) such that it faces the nacelle (4) through a rear opening of the hub casing (2).

title_en: Horizontal liquid separator and compressor
abstract_en: The application provides a horizontal knockout and compressor. The horizontal liquid separator comprises a shell, a liquid inlet pipe, a liquid outlet pipe and a liquid outlet pipe, wherein the shell is horizontally arranged, one end of the shell is a material inlet end, and the other end of the shell is a material outlet end; a gas-liquid separation piece is arranged in the shell and is arranged in the feeding end; a partition is arranged in the shell and used for partitioning the feeding end and the discharging end; the upper part of the isolating piece is provided with a vent hole, and the bottom of the isolating piece is provided with an oil hole. The gas-liquid separation piece and the isolating piece are arranged in the shell which is horizontally placed, gas and oil separated by the gas-liquid separation piece can flow back through the isolating piece, and the problem that the liquid is carried in the air suction of the compressor is avoided.

title_en: Electromagnetic braille display device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of Braille display, in particular to an electromagnetic Braille display device which comprises a display area, a control area and a transmission area, wherein at least one row of Braille display units are arranged on the display area, one Braille display unit comprises six touch holes, a page turning button and a switch button which are used for controlling the Braille information switching on the display area are arranged on the control area, a motor is arranged in a motor chamber of the transmission area, and a cross-flow centrifugal impeller is arranged in a fan chamber; the display area with the touch holes is designed, the supercharging device is used for controlling the air flow of the local touch holes, the air columns which are sprayed outwards are realized, and a user can feel the bulges formed by the air columns when touching the positions of the touch holes to replace the original rigid bulges, so that the condition that the normal movement of the lifting structure is influenced due to the fact that sweat stains and dust are filled into gaps is effectively avoided, the use is more convenient, and more cleaning and management are not needed.

title_en: Hanging neck fan
abstract_en: The invention discloses a neck hanging fan, which comprises an arc-shaped support and fans connected to two ends of the arc-shaped support, wherein a battery and a massage assembly are further arranged in the middle of the arc-shaped support, the battery is respectively and electrically connected with the fans and the massage assembly, the massage assembly comprises a motor positioned in the arc-shaped support and a massage head which is connected with the motor in a driving manner and is exposed out of the inner side of the arc-shaped support.

title_en: Control system for cutting radioactive solid waste
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a control system for cutting radioactive solid waste for automated cutting of radioactive solid waste in a shielded space by remote control, comprising: the monitoring subsystem is used for carrying out video monitoring on the working state of each device in the shielding space and acquiring a video signal, and each device comprises a cutting device and a clamping device; the master control subsystem is arranged outside the shielding space and used for receiving the video signals and analyzing and processing the video signals to obtain an operation instruction; the operation subsystem is arranged outside the shielding space and used for acquiring an operation instruction of an operator or an operation instruction sent by the master control subsystem through input equipment; the PLC subsystem is arranged between the operation subsystem and the driving subsystem and used for determining a clamping signal, a feeding signal and a rotating speed signal according to an operation instruction; the drive subsystem passes through clamping device with radioactive solid waste clamping during the cutting process, and cutting device extrudees the cutting to radioactive solid waste.

title_en: Heat insulation component
abstract_en: The heat insulating member of the present invention has a substrate and a heat insulating film on a surface of the substrate. The heat insulating film comprises a porous layer having at least closed pores, the porous layer containing a resin and a carbon-based filler, and has a heat insulating film which has both low thermal conductivity and small heat capacity and can improve fuel efficiency.

title_en: Cooling system of supercritical wind driven generator and permanent magnet generator
abstract_en: The invention discloses a supercritical wind driven generator and a cooling system of a permanent magnet generator, and relates to the technical field of wind driven generators. The invention comprises a motor shell and a motor rear cover; the fixedly connected with dry powder of one side of motor casing subsides of putting out a fire, the inside stator spare that has installed of motor casing. The dry powder fire extinguishing paste is arranged on the inner wall of the motor shell, the equipment does not need any power supply, does not need special smoke and temperature controllers, does not need responsible equipment and pipelines, and can accurately and effectively detect and extinguish a fire source by only being pasted in the equipment, so that accidents are killed at the initial stage. The built-in water-cooling of cooperation stator to having played the dual fail-safe effect to the fan, through the water-cooling compress pipe that sets up, the direct nuclear core part that generates heat from the motor of water-cooling compress pipe also is the stator piece heat dissipation at copper line place, and the heat need not to shift from the stator to the casing again, is discharging at the heat-dissipating pipe from the casing, thereby is showing very high cooling efficiency.

title_en: Method for adjusting adjustable guide vanes of compressor part of aircraft engine for coping with temperature distortion
abstract_en: The application provides a method for adjusting adjustable guide vanes of a compression part of an aircraft engine for coping with temperature distortion, which comprises the following steps: arranging at least two temperature sensors at different circumferential positions of an engine inlet or a compression part inlet, wherein the temperature sensors are used for measuring the temperature of the engine inlet or the compression part inlet; judging the difference value between the highest value and the lowest value of the temperature sensors, and if the difference value between the highest value and the lowest value is larger than a preset value, taking the numerical value of the temperature sensor with the highest value in the temperature sensors as a control input to adjust the angle of the adjustable guide vane of the compression part; and if the difference value between the highest value and the lowest value is smaller than a preset value, taking the average value of the temperature sensor as control input, and adjusting the adjustable guide vane angle of the compression part. The method can improve the temperature distortion resistance of the engine, has small performance sacrifice, can realize stability expansion only when encountering temperature distortion, and is favorable for improving the performance of other flight positions except a temperature scene in a full envelope.

title_en: Air duct structure and air conditioner indoor unit with same
abstract_en: The invention provides an air duct structure and an air conditioner indoor unit with the same, wherein the air duct structure is used for guiding air flow and comprises: the first air duct is internally provided with a first fan blade assembly; the first air duct is communicated with the second air duct, and a second fan blade assembly is arranged in the second air duct so as to rotate around a preset axis in the same direction, so that the airflow is sucked by the first air duct and then blown out by the second air duct or is sucked by the second air duct and then blown out by the first air duct; the air conditioner comprises a first air duct, a second air duct and a flow guide assembly, wherein the flow guide assembly is arranged between the first air duct and the second air duct so as to guide the air flow in the first air duct into the second air duct or guide the air flow in the second air duct into the first air duct, and therefore the problem that the air conditioner in the prior art is low in energy utilization rate of the air flow is solved.

title_en: Window capable of being cleaned automatically in rainy days
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of window cleaning, and discloses a window capable of being automatically cleaned in rainy days, which comprises a window frame and glass, wherein the glass is fixedly arranged in the window frame, and the window is characterized in that: four automatic rotating devices are respectively installed at four corners in the window frame, the automatic rotating devices can utilize mechanical transmission devices in a second water storage shell in the automatic rotating devices to convert gravitational potential energy of rainwater into elastic potential energy of a spring and kinetic energy of clockwise rotation of a window wiping strip, when the rainwater enters a lower cavity of the second water storage shell from a third through hole of the automatic rotating devices, the elastic potential energy of the spring can be converted into the kinetic energy of anticlockwise rotation of the window wiping strip, periodic rotation of the window wiping strip by utilizing the rainwater is achieved, rainwater is transmitted between the automatic rotating devices by utilizing a water pipe, the automatic rotating devices are sequentially automatic, interference of the window wiping strip cannot occur, meanwhile, the window is cleaned in a rainy day, water resources can be saved, and ornamental effect of the rainy day is improved.

title_en: Arrangement structure of integrated wiring harness of engine
abstract_en: The invention discloses an arrangement structure of an integrated wire harness of an engine, relates to the field of engine assembly, and solves the technical problem that the wire harness layout on the engine is disordered and irregular at present. The battery comprises a battery connecting wire harness, a first bus wire harness and a transition wire harness; the starter B terminal is respectively connected with a generator B + terminal and an air inlet preheating relay; one end of the first bus harness is connected with a D + terminal of the generator and a plug connector of the air-conditioning compressor respectively, and the other end of the first bus harness is connected with a first plug connector; one end of the transition wiring harness is connected with a port of an engine ECU, and the other end of the transition wiring harness is connected with two second plug connectors. The invention can optimize the wiring harness direction arrangement and the wiring harness length on the engine, thereby improving the appearance of the engine and reducing the potential safety hazard of wiring harness arrangement.

title_en: Method for applying spark advance degradation based on duration between two knocks
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for applying a predetermined nominal first value (degn) of a remedial spark advance degradation (DegAV) to a thermal engine after detection of a first knock (Cl1, Cl2, Cl5) during engine operation, characterized in that the application of the remedial spark advance degradation (DegAV) is discontinued when a second knock (Cl3) is not detected within a predetermined first time interval (T1s) from the detection of the first knock (Cl1, Cl2, Cl 5).

title_en: Boil-off gas compressor for LNG fuel powered ship
abstract_en: A boil-off gas compressor for an Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG) fueled ship using LNG as its fuel for propulsion engines, the boil-off gas compressor comprising: a compressor housing (24a, 24b) having an impeller (30a, 30b) rotatably disposed therein; a motor housing (12) having a motor (14) therein for driving the impellers (30a, 30 b); a bearing (18) rotatably supporting a rotary shaft (16a, 16b) for transmitting a rotational driving force of the motor (14) to the impeller (30a, 30 b). The compressor housing (24a, 24b) may be integrally formed with the motor housing (12).

title_en: Fan tower barrel rust removal method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fan tower barrel rust removal method, which comprises the following steps: the fan tower barrel is used as a cathode plate, the tower barrel metal structure surface corrosion material is used as an electronegative corrosion material anode plate, direct current is applied to the protected tower barrel metal structure surface, cathode polarization is generated, when the potential of metal is negative to a set potential value, the tower barrel metal structure surface corrosion material is continuously dissolved and consumed, and corrosion of the tower barrel metal structure surface is inhibited. The invention discloses a rust removal method and a rust removal device for a tower drum of a draught fan, wherein the tower drum is used as a cathode, and a rust substance is used as an anode, so that the rust removal treatment is carried out on the tower drum.

title_en: Shape memory alloy sleeve support assembly for a bearing
abstract_en: A support assembly for a bearing of a gas turbine engine, the gas turbine engine comprising a shaft extending in an axial direction. The support assembly outer race positioned radially outward of the bearing such that the outer race supports the bearing. Further, the support assembly includes a shape memory alloy damper positioned radially outward of the outer race and at least partially supporting the outer race. Further, the shape memory alloy damper includes a plurality of sleeves. At least one of the plurality of sleeves comprises a shape memory alloy material.

title_en: Exhaust waste heat utilization system of gas turbine hot channel cooling air heat exchanger
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gas turbine hot channel cooling air heat exchanger exhaust waste heat utilization system which mainly comprises a gas compressor inlet channel, a gas turbine, a waste heat boiler, a steam turbine, a gas turbine hot channel cooling air heat exchanger and an air channel. According to the invention, the high-temperature exhaust energy of the heat exchanger of the cooling air of the heat channel of the gas turbine, which is originally directly discharged to the atmosphere, is used for heating the air inlet of the gas turbine air compressor, so that the air inlet temperature of the air compressor is increased, the load rate of the combined cycle unit under the partial load working condition is increased, the power generation efficiency of the combined cycle unit is further improved, and the beneficial effect of improving the running economy of the combined cycle unit under the partial load working condition is achieved.

title_en: Self-cooling high-speed ram air turbine generator
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-cooling high-speed ram air turbine generator, wherein a generator stator coil is fixedly connected in a shell of the self-cooling high-speed ram air turbine generator, and a rotor mandrel is rotationally connected in the shell of the self-cooling high-speed ram air turbine generator; the rotor core shaft is fixedly connected with generator rotor magnetic steel which is positioned in a generator stator coil; the generator turbine adopts a centripetal radial-axial flow impeller form, supplies air through a radial cascade, has small axial through-flow sectional area, has the characteristics of high enthalpy drop, large output torque and the like, and has simple and compact structure, light weight, wide range of application to aircrafts and wide range of flight envelope lines.

title_en: Injection valve
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of engines, and particularly relates to an injection valve which comprises an injector body, a valve sleeve, a needle valve body, a long needle valve and a lift adjusting assembly, wherein the injector body is provided with a valve seat; the injector body is provided with a high-pressure cavity, the valve sleeve and the needle valve body block two ends of the high-pressure cavity, and the long needle valve is slidably arranged in the valve sleeve and the needle valve body; the valve sleeve is provided with a first end surface positioned in the high-pressure cavity, and one end of the needle valve body, which is far away from the valve sleeve, is provided with a jet hole; a control cavity is formed between the long needle valve and the valve sleeve, the long needle valve is provided with a supporting section and a sealing section, the supporting section is provided with a supporting ring, and the sealing section is used for periodically plugging the spray hole along with the sliding of the long needle valve; the lift adjusting assembly is detachably sleeved outside the supporting section and is positioned between the first end face and the supporting ring; when the sealing section blocks the spray hole, a distance H1 is reserved between one end, away from the support ring, of the lift adjusting assembly and the first end face. The injection valve provided by the invention overcomes the defect of static leakage of the injection valve, can adjust the lift of the needle valve, and is convenient to assemble and debug parts.

title_en: High-air-volume radiating fan
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large-air-volume cooling fan which comprises a fan frame, a motor mounting seat, a motor and fan bodies, wherein the motor mounting seat is fixed at a rear air inlet of the fan frame through a flow deflector, the motor is arranged in the motor mounting seat, the fan bodies are arranged on an output shaft of the motor, at least three flow deflectors are arranged, the flow deflectors are uniformly distributed in a circumferential manner by taking the motor mounting seat as a center, the flow deflectors are arc-shaped, the rear side surface of each flow deflector is a forward-concave arc surface, and the front side surface of each flow deflector is a forward-convex arc surface. The invention adopts the arc-shaped flow deflector, which can not increase the production cost, not only has the supercharging effect and can greatly improve the air quantity, but also the backward arc surface of the flow deflector can be directly used as a wire inlet groove of a wire, and the structure is more reasonable.

title_en: Supercooling signal identification method and device for nuclear power unit of nuclear power station
abstract_en: The application provides a supercooling signal identification method and device for a nuclear power unit of a nuclear power station, wherein the nuclear power unit comprises N loops and M devices, and the signal identification method comprises the following steps: acquiring first temperature values of N loops; acquiring second temperature values of the M devices; when the difference value between the first temperature value and the second temperature value meets a first threshold condition, the nuclear power unit generates a supercooling signal; the subcooling signal is displayed on a display device. According to the method, whether the nuclear power unit generates the supercooling signal or not is represented by a method of respectively acquiring the difference value of the temperature values of the two loops of the nuclear power unit, the supercooling signal is displayed on a display device, and an operator is assisted to further determine whether the supercooling signal is generated really or not.

title_en: Centrifugal pump is inhaled to intelligence end
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of centrifugal pump equipment, in particular to an intelligent end suction centrifugal pump which comprises a centrifugal pump and a control box which are fixedly arranged on a mounting plate from left to right in sequence. According to the invention, the mounting frame is arranged at the pipe orifice of the feeding pipe of the centrifugal pump, the water level sensor is fixedly arranged on the mounting frame, the water level condition of a work material area can be monitored in real time, when the water level is lower than a set value, the controller controls the relay to be powered off, the equipment is stopped to run, and the equipment damage caused by the idling of the centrifugal pump is avoided.

title_en: Remote control system of air compressor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote control system of an air compressor, which comprises a camera monitoring unit, a regional information acquisition unit, a regional information analysis unit, an early warning unit, a prompt unit, a control unit and a data transmission unit, wherein the camera monitoring unit is used for monitoring the regional information of the air compressor; the camera monitoring unit is used for shooting the surrounding environment when the air compressor works and generating monitoring information, and sending the monitoring information to the early warning unit through the data transmission unit; the regional information acquisition unit is used for acquiring working information of the air compressor, and the working information comprises sound information, surface temperature information and air particulate matter information; the invention discloses various aspects for solving the problems that the working condition of the air compressor cannot be acquired in real time and the operation of the air compressor can be controlled in time in the existing scheme, and the working efficiency of the air compressor cannot be influenced by finding out the abnormal condition of the air compressor in time and processing the abnormal condition.

title_en: Yaw control method, system and device of wind generating set
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a yaw control method, a system and a device of a wind generating set, wherein the yaw control method comprises the following steps: in the yawing process of the wind generating set, when the yawing gear ring is broken, determining the broken position range of the yawing gear ring and the real-time position of each yawing motor in the plurality of yawing motors; judging whether the real-time position of at least one yaw motor in the yaw motors falls into the broken position range or not; when the real-time position of the at least one yaw motor falls into the broken position range, the output torque of the at least one yaw motor is reduced, the output torques of other yaw motors except the at least one yaw motor are adjusted, and the wind generating set is controlled to yaw. According to the method and the device, the fault-tolerant control of yaw can be realized, the maintenance cost and maintenance shutdown loss of the wind generating set are reduced, and the yaw reliability and safety of the wind generating set are improved.

title_en: Air supply device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of air conditioning equipment, and particularly relates to air supply equipment. The air supply equipment comprises a shell, a wind wheel, an induction heat source and a coil disc, wherein the wind wheel is arranged inside the shell, the induction heat source is arranged on the wind wheel, or at least one part of the wind wheel is the induction heat source, and the coil disc is arranged inside the shell and used for causing the induction heat source to generate heat. According to the air supply equipment, the induction heat source is arranged on the wind wheel, and the induction heating of the induction heat source is caused by the magnetic flux change of the coil panel in the power-on state, so that the wind wheel has the functions of supplying air and heating surrounding air, and further the heat efficiency is improved.

title_en: Compact structure's integrated form air compressor
abstract_en: The invention discloses an integrated air compressor with a compact structure, which relates to the technical field of compressor design and aims at the problem of noise generation in the prior art.

title_en: Extraction equipment and method for reactor core nuclear detection instrument assembly
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of operation and maintenance of nuclear power stations. The invention provides a device and a method for extracting a reactor core nuclear detection instrument assembly, which aim at the problem that the existing tool for extracting the reactor core nuclear detection instrument assembly is limited by the length of the instrument assembly and has the exceeding radiation dosage in the extracting process environment. The drawing process is that the clamp descends, the clamp grabs the target IITA component, the clamp lifts, the clamping roller clamps, the IITA component bends, and the IITA component is wound, drawn and spit back and sheared. The length range of the instrument component which can be extracted through the extraction equipment is larger, so that the irradiation dose risk can be effectively avoided, the equipment is flexible to move, and the extraction and positioning are accurate.

title_en: Ship power generation device utilizing ocean energy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ship power generation device utilizing ocean energy, which comprises a ship body, wherein a plurality of water bags are arranged on two sides of the ship body, pipelines are respectively arranged on one sides of the water bags, a cavity is arranged in the ship body, a water collecting pipe communicated with the pipelines is arranged in the cavity, one end of the water collecting pipe is communicated with a water inlet pipe, one end of the water inlet pipe is communicated with a volute positioned at the bottom of the cavity, a rotating wheel is arranged in the volute, a protective shell is arranged on the outer wall of the volute, a first generator is arranged in the protective shell, a first rotating shaft is fixedly arranged on an output shaft of the first generator, one end of the first rotating shaft is fixedly connected with the rotating wheel, a water outlet pipe is arranged on one side of the volute, and a wind power generation device and a solar power generation device are respectively arranged at the top end of the ship body. According to the invention, wind energy and solar energy are respectively converted into electric energy through the wind energy power generation device and the solar energy power generation device, then the rotating wheel is driven to rotate through ocean wave energy, and the generator is driven to operate when the rotating wheel rotates, so that mechanical energy is converted into electric energy.

title_en: Engine fan installation position calibration method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for calibrating the installation position of an engine fan. The method for calibrating the installation position of the engine fan comprises the following steps: driving an operating engine fan to move in an air guide cover of an engine radiator, and simultaneously detecting each air quantity parameter of the engine fan in the moving process; and selecting the position of the engine fan when the air quantity parameter is maximum as a fan mounting position and calibrating. Compared with the prior art that the fan installation position is judged only through experience, the calibration method and the calibration system for the engine fan installation position can realize accurate measurement of air volume so as to accurately position the fan, thereby facilitating accurate fan installation in mass production.

title_en: Timing signal spinning belt pulley and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The timing signal spinning belt pulley comprises a spinning belt pulley body, wherein the spinning belt pulley body comprises a cylindrical barrel, the outer surface of the cylindrical barrel is a toothed surface matched with a timing belt, one end of the cylindrical barrel is a mounting web plate, the other end of the cylindrical barrel is connected with an outer circular plane web plate, the outer circular plane web plate comprises a transition web plate positioned in the middle and timing signal teeth which are annularly arranged at one circle of the edge of the transition web plate, and the outer ring of the outer circular plane web plate is bent to form a flanging. The manufacturing method comprises the steps of deep drawing, spinning, stamping and shearing the cold-rolled thin steel plate. The belt pulley has the advantages of light weight, high strength, high production efficiency and low cost, and the timing signal working face is redesigned, so that the area of the timing signal working face is increased through a flanging process.

title_en: Oil pressure is low from opening high alarm pump station controlling means
abstract_en: The invention discloses an oil pressure low self-starting high alarm pump station control device, which comprises a main loop and a control loop, wherein the main loop comprises a total circuit breaker, an inlet of the total circuit breaker is connected with a three-phase alternating current power supply, an outlet of the total circuit breaker is respectively connected with a main contact of a main oil pump contactor and a main contact of an auxiliary oil pump contactor in parallel, the main contact of the main oil pump contactor is connected with a main oil pump, and the main contact of the auxiliary oil pump contactor is connected with an auxiliary oil pump; the control loop comprises a manual-automatic switch, a main oil pump stop button, a main oil pump start button, a main oil pump indicator lamp, an auxiliary oil pump stop button, an auxiliary oil pump start button, an auxiliary oil pump indicator lamp, a first relay, a second relay, a third relay, a time relay, a stop button and a buzzer; the main oil pump is provided with a main pressure gauge, and the auxiliary oil pump is provided with an auxiliary pressure gauge; the device can automatically start the auxiliary oil pump when the main oil pump fails, can give an alarm when the main oil pump runs in overpressure, has a simple structure and is convenient to use, and the device can adapt to the needs of various sites.

title_en: Pulverized coal drying system for coal pulverizer, pulverized coal drying method for coal pulverizer, pulverized coal drying program, coal pulverizer, and gasification combined power generation device
abstract_en: Provided are a pulverized coal drying system for a coal pulverizer, a pulverized coal drying method for the same, a pulverized coal drying program, a coal pulverizer, and a gasification combined cycle power plant, wherein the pulverized coal drying system can stably dry a carbon-containing solid fuel regardless of the coal type of the carbon-containing solid fuel used. The device is provided with a flow rate control unit (50) of a mill (10) for drying a supplied solid fuel containing carbon by using a drying fluid, wherein the flow rate of the drying fluid is controlled within the upper and lower limits of the flow rate of the drying fluid set for drying a plurality of solid fuels containing carbon having different moisture contents so that the temperature of the drying fluid discharged from the mill (10) approaches a target temperature.

title_en: Method for directly identifying actual state of fault equipment by nuclear power station operator station
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for directly identifying the real state of fault equipment by an operator station of a nuclear power station, which is characterized in that a novel data acquisition structure and a novel state display interface are designed, configuration design is carried out on the novel data acquisition structure and the novel state display interface, 32-bit signal references for data analysis in DCS two-layer system software are modified, and equipment real state signals are mapped to the novel state display interface, so that the operator can identify control command faults and field equipment real states. The invention obviously improves the intelligence of the man-machine interface and greatly improves the accuracy and efficiency of the operator to judge the state of the field real equipment.

title_en: Layered cooling water jacket structure of engine
abstract_en: The invention relates to a layered cooling water jacket structure of an engine, and belongs to the technical field of engines. The method mainly comprises the following steps: cylinder block, cylinder jacket, outer water jacket, inlayer water jacket, water inlet, delivery port, through-hole, sealing washer. The outer water jacket is arranged in the cylinder body, the outer diameter of the middle lower area in the axial direction of the cylinder sleeve is smaller than that of other areas, the cylinder sleeve and the cylinder body are in interference fit and then form the inner water jacket in the area with the smaller outer diameter, and the inner water jacket is communicated with the outer water jacket through the through hole. The lower region in the axial direction of the cylinder sleeve is in contact with the cooling liquid of the inner water jacket, the heat exchange coefficient is small, and the structural temperature of the cylinder sleeve in the region is improved, so that the axial temperature gradient of the cylinder sleeve is reduced, and the friction loss of a piston ring is reduced.

title_en: Automatic oiling control system suitable for liquid
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic oiling control system suitable for liquid, which belongs to the technical field of automatic oiling control and is controlled by dividing an MCU into two paths, wherein the two paths comprise an automatic control mode of a main oil pump and a manual control mode of a standby oil pump and the automatic control mode of the standby oil pump, and the two control modes work in an interlocking state. This automatic oiling control system suitable for liquid is through upgrading traditional secondary circuit into integrated secondary circuit of modularization, can realize standardized production, can improve production efficiency by a wide margin, and the product is more reliable, safer in the course of the work, and furthest has promoted the whole quality of product, simultaneously also very big reduction the fault rate of product, and the whole overall arrangement of product is more normal, more pleasing to the eye, more saves space.

title_en: Centrifugal air compressor for fuel cell system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a centrifugal air compressor for a fuel cell system, and relates to the technical field of fuel cell automobiles. The invention comprises a support ring which is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of a shell through a plurality of support rods; a cavity is arranged inside the support ring; the inner ring of the support ring close to the rotating shaft is provided with a first air outlet hole, a second air outlet hole and a third air outlet hole; at least one support rod is provided with a first air inlet channel along the length direction; one end of the first air inlet channel is communicated with the cavity, and the other end of the first air inlet channel is communicated with a second air inlet channel which is arranged along the axial direction of the shell; the second intake passage communicates with the exhaust port. According to the invention, a part of air compressed by the air compressor is introduced to the support ring for supporting the rotating shaft, and an air film is formed between the support ring and the rotating shaft, so that the rotating shaft is not contacted with the support ring in the rotating process, the friction force between the rotating shaft and the support ring can be effectively reduced, the rotating speed of the rotating shaft is improved, and the abrasion of the support member is reduced.

title_en: Automatic detection equipment and method for wind turbine generator bolt
abstract_en: The invention provides automatic detection equipment and method for a wind turbine generator bolt, which comprises a power supply device, a small rail car, an installation support, a signal transmission device, a control device, a sensor device and an annular slide rail, wherein the installation support is arranged on the small rail car; the annular sliding rail is fixed on the inner side of a flange connected between stages of the wind turbine generator, and inner teeth are arranged on the inner side of the annular sliding rail; the sensor device collects sampling stress data of the bolts and sampling image data of nuts matched with the bolts, the control device controls the rail trolley to move along the annular sliding rail, one bolt is moved to the next bolt after detection is finished, the sampling stress data and the sampling image data are received to be processed, and a processing result is sent to the background server. The automatic monitoring equipment for the wind turbine generator bolt is provided with the multifunctional sensor, can freely and annularly move on the inner side of the wind turbine generator flange, regularly monitors the running state of the bolt on line in real time, judges the pre-tightening state and the stress condition of the bolt in time, puts forward the maintenance requirement in time, does not need manual field inspection, reduces the workload, reduces the cost, improves the efficiency and the detection precision, and is time-saving and labor-saving.

title_en: High-efficiency kinetic energy conversion equipment and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of machinery, in particular to high-efficiency kinetic energy conversion equipment and method. The power part drives the gears to rotate, and further drives the first power wheel (5) to be meshed with the second power wheel (6) to rotate reversely; the first power wheel (5) is meshed with the second power wheel (6) and rotates reversely to further drive the second hinged connecting rod (9) and the first hinged connecting rod (15) to move relatively, the second lever (10) and the first lever (18) are further pushed to rotate around a fulcrum, and a clamping gap is formed between the lower counterweight moving plate (19) and the upper counterweight moving plate (26); the moving directions of the lower counterweight moving plate (19) and the upper counterweight moving plate (26) are opposite, and when the distance between the lower counterweight moving plate (19) and the upper counterweight moving plate (26) is reduced to move, an object in the clamping gap can be clamped.

title_en: City sewage pipeline marsh gas power generation safety device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a methane power generation safety device for an urban sewage pipeline, which comprises an integrated box, wherein the middle part of the integrated box is provided with a mixing box, the mixing box comprises a gas mixing cavity, the middle part of the gas mixing cavity is provided with a trapezoidal frame, three gas mixing rotating shafts with blades are arranged in the trapezoidal frame, and belt pulleys are fixedly arranged at the upper end parts of two gas mixing rotating shafts at the left side and the right side in the gas mixing rotating shafts; according to the safety device for methane power generation of the urban sewage pipeline, disclosed by the invention, methane gas is isolated, after oxygen mixing treatment, chemical energy is converted into mechanical energy by igniting in a single-cylinder piston, and the mechanical energy is converted into electric energy by a generator and stored in a storage battery.

title_en: Air compression intelligent operation and maintenance method based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of operation and maintenance methods, in particular to an air compression intelligent operation and maintenance method based on the Internet of things. Detecting whether the air compressor controller equipment meets operation and maintenance conditions; accessing the protocol and the interface data to the air compressor controller equipment; accessing the application scene information into a controller, acquiring a function in the controller according to the requirement, and acquiring data information required by the function from an air compressor controller device by the controller; processing the acquired data in a processor; backing up and intensively forwarding the processed data storage modules to a server; the server analyzes, queries, distributes and pushes the data set forwarded to the server. The remote monitoring of the air compressor is realized, the message application is pushed in time, and the intellectualization and the informatization degree of the air compressor group are improved.

title_en: Pump body assembly and fluid machinery with same
abstract_en: The invention provides a pump body assembly and a fluid machine with the same. The pump body assembly comprises a cylinder, a first crankshaft, a second crankshaft, a roller and a roller, wherein the cylinder is provided with an air inlet part, an inner cavity and a sliding vane groove, the air inlet part and the sliding vane groove are communicated with the inner cavity, the first crankshaft comprises a long shaft section and a first eccentric section connected with the long shaft section, the second crankshaft comprises a short shaft section and a second eccentric section connected with the short shaft section, the roller is positioned in the inner cavity and sleeved outside the first eccentric section and the second eccentric section, the eccentric amount of the first eccentric section and the eccentric amount of the second eccentric section are both e, and the radius of the first eccentric section is equal to the radius of the second eccentric section. The invention effectively solves the problems that the rolling rotor compressor in the prior art cannot be small in concrete and large in discharge capacity.

title_en: Reinforcing structure of electric compressor
abstract_en: The purpose is to provide a reinforcing structure for an electric compressor, wherein when an installation leg is formed on the outer side surface of a cover provided on the most axial end side of the electric compressor in an inverter housing, even if a strong force is applied to the electric compressor due to a frontal collision of a vehicle or the like, the space in the inverter housing is not destroyed. A housing (6) of an electric compressor (1) has an inverter housing (9) which is configured from a side wall (91) and a partition wall (92) and houses an inverter device (5), the inverter housing (9) is configured such that the front of the electric compressor (1) is blocked by a cover (10) formed with mounting legs (103), and hollow protrusions (104) protruding in a dome shape around the mounting legs (103) are provided on the outer side surface of the cover (10), so that a load applied from the front of the electric compressor (1) is dispersed, and the space in the inverter housing (9) is prevented from being broken.

title_en: Aero-engine vector spray pipe structure
abstract_en: The application belongs to aeroengine vector spray pipe structural design technical field, concretely relates to aeroengine vector spray pipe structure, includes: a nozzle connecting cylinder; the inlet ends of the two spray pipe shunt cylinders are connected with the outlet ends of the spray pipe connecting cylinders, and the distance between the outlet ends is gradually enlarged towards the direction far away from the spray pipe connecting cylinders to shield the spray pipe connecting cylinders; the inlet end of each spray pipe convergence section is correspondingly butted with the outlet end of one spray pipe shunt cylinder and extends along the axial direction of the spray pipe connecting cylinder; and the inlet end of each spray pipe expansion section is correspondingly butted with the outlet end of one spray pipe convergence section and extends along the axial direction of the spray pipe connecting cylinder.

title_en: Novel double-body floating type wind turbine platform with fractal structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel double-body floating type wind turbine platform with a fractal structure, which comprises: the device comprises blades, a generator room fixedly connected with the blades, a supporting column fixedly connected with the generator room, an upper floating cabin fixedly connected with the supporting column and a lower ballast connected with the upper floating cabin through tendons; the upper floating cabin comprises an upright post fixedly connected with the support post and a floating box fixedly connected with the upright post, the floating box adopts a hollow box structure, and fractal waffle cells are arranged on the bottom of the floating box. According to the invention, the stability of the platform is improved, the economic practicability is realized, and the hydrodynamic stability is good.

title_en: Mobile electronic irradiation device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mobile electron irradiation device, which comprises a shielding body, an irradiation article transportation channel and an accelerator module, wherein the irradiation article transportation channel adopts a vertical turning motion structure; the transmission device for irradiating the articles adopts double-chain vertical turning transmission or vertical turning sectional transmission. The invention has the advantages that: a vertically-turning irradiated article transmission channel is provided, and a mode of separately constructing and installing an accelerator module and a shielding module of an electron irradiation accelerator device is provided, and double-chain transmission or vertical-turning segmented transmission is adopted. The two innovations of the vertical turning transmission mode and the split construction installation mode greatly reduce the volume, the weight and the construction cost of the shielding body of the accelerator, so that the movement of the 10MeV electron irradiation accelerator is possible, and meanwhile, the irradiation rate of the irradiated objects can be improved. The double chain drive makes it possible to circulate the article cassettes carrying the irradiated articles in the transport path.

title_en: Three-position power accumulation generating mechanism of body builder
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-position power accumulation generating mechanism of a body builder, which comprises a general assembly bottom plate, a power accumulation spring storage mechanism, a generator and a self-comparison transmission assembly, wherein the general assembly bottom plate is provided with a power accumulation spring; the power storage spring storage mechanism stores the work done by the fitness equipment and transmits energy to the generator through the self-comparison transmission assembly, the number of the power storage spring storage mechanisms is three, the self-comparison transmission assembly automatically compares the energy in the three power storage spring storage mechanisms, and the energy of the person with the highest energy is transmitted to the generator. The invention subverts the design mode of the power generation device of the existing body builder, and uses a novel three-position power accumulation power generation mechanism to meet the requirement that the multi-position comprehensive body builder shares one power generator. The invention integrally improves the use performance and the power generation efficiency of the body builder, can continuously, effectively and stably provide kinetic energy for the generator, stabilizes the power generation power, reduces the production cost of the comprehensive body builder, and realizes the maximized energy conversion and the minimum resource allocation.

title_en: Axial flow fan impeller assembled in modularized split mode and assembling method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a modularized and split-assembled axial flow fan impeller and an assembling method thereof, wherein the impeller comprises an installation shaft sleeve, a hub, a wheel disc and blades; the wheel hub is sleeved in the middle of the mounting shaft sleeve, the wheel disc comprises a first wheel disc and a second wheel disc, the first wheel disc and the second wheel disc are respectively clamped on two sides of the mounting shaft sleeve and are connected with the wheel hub, and the blades are clamped between the first wheel disc and the second wheel disc and are fixedly connected with the first wheel disc and the second wheel disc; during assembly, firstly, a hub is clamped in the middle of the mounting shaft sleeve and fixed through bolts, the first wheel disc is clamped on one side of the mounting shaft sleeve and fixed with the hub through bolts, and after the blades are fixed with the first wheel disc, the second wheel disc is fixed with the hub and the blades respectively; the blade provided by the invention is reasonable in structural design, has higher assembly stability and reliability, and is suitable for large-scale popularization.

title_en: Automatic pipe replacing device for vertical centrifugal pump test and working method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automatic pipe replacing device and a working method thereof, and belongs to the field of water pump detection equipment. The water inlet pipe replacing device comprises a water inlet pipe base, a water inlet pipe replacing rotating wheel support, a water inlet pipe replacing upper support, a water outlet pipe replacing rotating wheel support, a water outlet reducing pipe, a water outlet pipe base and a water inlet reducing pipe, wherein the left end of the water inlet pipe replacing rotating wheel support is installed on the water inlet pipe base, the right end of the water inlet pipe replacing rotating wheel support is installed on the water inlet pipe replacing upper support, and the water inlet pipe replacing upper support is installed on the water inlet pipe base; the left end of the water outlet pipe changing rotating wheel bracket is arranged on the water outlet pipe changing upper bracket, and the water inlet pipe changing upper bracket is arranged on the water inlet pipe base; the water inlet reducer pipe is arranged in a plurality of through holes of the water inlet pipe changing runner bracket; the outlet reducer pipe is arranged in a plurality of through holes of the outlet pipe-changing rotating wheel bracket. The invention has simple and reasonable structural design and convenient operation, can realize automatic replacement of the reducing piezometer tube, improves the detection efficiency of the vertical centrifugal pump and meets the use requirement.

title_en: Single-piece injector and injection system for injecting a medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a single-piece injector (1) for injecting a liquid or gaseous medium, comprising a reciprocable nozzle needle (2) for releasing and closing at least one injection opening (3), wherein the nozzle needle (2) is opened against a spring (4) and/or delimits a control chamber (5) that can be loaded with a control medium and can be unloaded as a function of the switching position of a control valve (6), whereby the control pressure applied to the nozzle needle (2) can be varied in order to actuate the nozzle needle (2). According to the invention, a pressurizing device (8) is arranged in the supply path (7) for the medium, said pressurizing device being used to increase the pressure in the supply path (7). The invention also relates to an injection system having a single-component injector (1) according to the invention.

title_en: Wave energy and tidal current energy combined power generation device
abstract_en: The invention provides a wave energy and tidal current energy combined power generation device, and belongs to the technical field of generators. The ocean power generation device solves the technical problems of high cost, low efficiency and the like of the existing ocean power generation device. The wave energy tidal current energy combined power generation device comprises a plurality of upright posts, wherein ocean platforms are arranged at the upper ends of the upright posts, at least one group of tidal current power generation mechanisms are arranged on each upright post, each tidal current power generation mechanism comprises a vertical shaft water turbine and a generator, and the vertical shaft water turbine is sleeved on each upright post; a plurality of mount pads have set firmly near the border on the platform's the side, all are equipped with a permanent magnet generator on every mount pad, are connected with the pivot on permanent magnet generator's the rotor, are connected with the transmission connecting rod of buckling in the pivot, extend to platform's below and this end is equipped with the body after buckling of transmission connecting rod's one end. The integrated power generation mode of combining tidal current energy and wave energy is integrally adopted, the application range is wider, the application conditions are more complex, and the ocean energy power generation efficiency can be improved to the greatest extent.

title_en: Fan system and range hood with same
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fan system which comprises a volute and an impeller arranged in the volute, wherein an air outlet is formed in the volute, an air inlet hole is formed in the position, located at the air outlet, of the volute, an air outlet hole is formed in the impeller, the air inlet hole is communicated with the air outlet hole through a pipeline, a one-way pressure conduction device is arranged on the pipeline, and the one-way pressure conduction device is selectively conducted according to the pressure difference between the air inlet hole and the air outlet hole, so that gas introduced from the air inlet hole can be sprayed out of the air outlet hole to accelerate the impeller. Also discloses a range hood applying the fan system. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages that: the air outlet of the fan system is connected with the interior of the impeller through a pipeline, the air outlet of the fan system and the pressure difference of the interior of the impeller are utilized, the air at the air outlet can be forced to flow and be sprayed out of the air outlet hole of the interior of the impeller, the pressurization mode is started, passive acceleration is realized, the rotating speed is instantaneously increased, and the air input is increased.

title_en: Energy-saving load-reducing energy-increasing device for automobile
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy-saving, load-reducing and energy-increasing device for an automobile, which comprises an airflow passage arranged at the front bottom of the automobile, wherein an impeller revolving cabin which is semicircular upwards and is arranged in front of and behind the airflow passage and impellers are arranged, the impellers are contracted and fixed to a reinforced automobile front cabin bottom plate through turbine shafts at two ends of a central shaft, wheel bearing containing cabins are arranged at two sides of the impeller revolving cabin, generators driven by turbines are arranged at two ends of the central shaft of each group of impellers, and the engines are fixed on a fixing frame arranged in the automobile front cabin; the invention discloses a method for reducing the load of an automobile, which comprises the steps of arranging a group of airflow channels on the top of the automobile, arranging a front impeller rotating cabin and a rear impeller rotating cabin which are downward semicircular and are provided with impellers, contracting and fixing two ends of an impeller center shaft to a reinforced turbine shaft contracting cabin and a generator cabin by the turbine shaft, driving a generator by turbines at two ends of each group of impeller center shaft, arranging a front generator in the engine cabins at two sides, and arranging a rear generator at two sides of an automobile rear car.

title_en: Air supply arrangement and dust catcher
abstract_en: The invention provides an air supply device and a dust collector, wherein the air supply device is provided with an air supply outlet and comprises a rotating shaft, an impeller arranged on the rotating shaft and a diffuser positioned on one side of the impeller, which is far away from the air supply outlet; the diffuser comprises a base and a plurality of stationary blades which are convexly arranged on the outer ring surface of the base at intervals along the circumferential direction; the rack is fittingly installed at one end of the diffuser, which is far away from the diffuser, and a convex block which is convex towards the diffuser is arranged between the inner wall surface of the outer cylinder and the outer wall surface of the inner cylinder; the lug and the adjacent stationary blade are arranged at intervals relatively to form a flow guide channel, and the flow guide channel gradually turns to the outer wall surface of the inner barrel in the direction from the impeller to the rack. According to the technical scheme, the air flow can be effectively guided, so that direct impact of the air flow on components such as the motor is reduced, the flow loss can be reduced, the efficiency of the air supply device is improved, and the power consumption is reduced.

title_en: Method for relieving cavitation erosion of diesel engine body
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of diesel engine equipment, and relates to a method for relieving cavitation erosion of a diesel engine body. The method for relieving the cavitation erosion of the diesel engine body comprises the steps that a pressure reduction device is arranged in a shell of the diesel engine body, and the pressure reduction device is provided with a throttling orifice plate and a bursting plate II which are perpendicular to the water flow direction; an exhaust channel communicated with the exhaust pipe is formed between the throttling orifice plate and the crumple plate II; the back of the throttling orifice plate is provided with a bursting plate I; the back of the orifice plate is also provided with fan blades for dispersing water flow; the process is continuously repeated in the operation of the diesel engine, the gas content in the cooling water is gradually reduced, and after the air bubbles are repeatedly discharged, the gas content in the cooling water can be kept at a lower level, so that the cavitation caused by the repeated collapse of the air bubbles to the water cavity of the engine body is limited. The invention has simple structure and convenient disassembly and assembly; the gas content in water can be continuously reduced in the operation of the diesel engine, and the cavitation erosion caused by bubble collapse to a water cavity and the like can be effectively relieved under the condition that the sealing of a cooling system is good.

title_en: Method for determining target opening of mixing valve of EGR system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for determining a target opening of a mixing valve of an EGR (exhaust gas recirculation) system, which comprises the steps of determining an initial opening of the mixing valve according to engine operation parameters after the opening control of the mixing valve is activated, sequentially decreasing according to priority to judge whether five working condition conditions are met or not one by one, and determining a target opening change rate of the mixing valve according to the current conditions if the former conditions are not met and the current conditions are met; if the five working conditions are not met, the target opening change rate of the mixing valve is the sixth opening change rate; and finally, determining the target opening of the mixing valve according to the initial opening of the mixing valve, the target opening change rate of the mixing valve and the control period of the mixing valve. The invention can accurately control the opening of the mixing valve in the EGR system, thereby not only ensuring the stability of the supercharging capacity, but also improving the response precision and accuracy of the EGR rate control, and further improving the important function of the opening control of the mixing valve in the EGR rate control process.

title_en: Connecting piece, compressor and refrigeration equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a connecting piece, a compressor and refrigeration equipment. The connecting piece comprises a connecting wire and a protection device, wherein the connecting wire is suitable for connecting power supply equipment and a compressor to enable the power supply equipment to supply power for the compressor, and the protection device is arranged on the connecting wire and used for controlling on-off of current in the connecting wire so as to protect at least one of the compressor and the power supply equipment. The connecting piece of the invention is convenient for installation and assembly, thereby improving the production efficiency of the compressor.

title_en: Turbine power generation system and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a turbine power generation system and a using method thereof, the structure of the turbine power generation system comprises a generator, a turbine mechanism, an air vent, a base and an electric connection box, the turbine mechanism is embedded and fixed at the right end position of the generator, the base is welded at the bottom position of the generator, the electric connection box is arranged at the upper end position of the generator, the air vent and the turbine mechanism are an integrated mechanism, when the turbine mechanism stops working, a swinging plate on the air vent can recover to a closed state, so that the sea wind is resisted at the outer surface of the swinging plate, thereby the sea wind brings the sea salt buckets to be intensively attached to the outer surface of the swinging plate, the open-close plates on the protective surface can be folded and closed by the extrusion of the protective surface when the linkage plate slides forwards, thereby make the transfer line on the protection face can follow the open-close board and carry out synchronous closure, and the connecting rod that makes and be connected with the transfer line can drive the sliding block and strike off the adnexed sea salt of open-close board inboard.

title_en: Rapid forming device and forming method for impeller blades
abstract_en: The invention provides a device for quickly forming impeller blades, which comprises a base, wherein supporting legs are fixedly connected below the base, a driving motor is fixedly connected below the base, a rotating shaft is movably inserted in the base, a supporting plate is fixedly sleeved on the rotating shaft, electromagnet devices are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the rotating shaft, a lower plate positioning plate is movably arranged above the supporting plate, a supporting plate is fixedly connected to one side of the lower plate positioning plate, which is far away from the supporting plate, a plurality of step grooves are symmetrically formed in the edges of the upper end and the lower end of the supporting plate, and blade positioning devices are correspondingly arranged on the outer side wall of the supporting plate. The blades can be fixed and positioned, and the working speed and the working efficiency of the forming device are improved.

title_en: Improved rotor blade sealing structure
abstract_en: The invention provides an improved rotor blade seal structure. A rotor blade (26, 30) is provided. The rotor blade (26, 30) includes a body (35) having a shank (38), an airfoil (36) extending radially outward from the shank (38), and a platform (42). The body (35) includes a pressure side impact surface (56) and a suction side impact surface (58). A slot (70) is defined within each of the pressure side impingement surface (56) and the suction side impingement surface (58). The slots (70) of the pressure side impingement surface (56) and the slots (70) of the suction side impingement surface (58) each include an upstream end portion (74) defining an end portion (72) and a body portion (90) extending from the upstream end portion (74). The upstream end portion (74) tapers from the end portion (72) to the body portion (90). The body portion (90) further includes a retaining wall (78) covering a portion of the end portion (72) and defining an opening (80). The retaining wall (78) also includes an internal retaining surface (102). The retaining wall (78) defines an offset (150, 152) from the opening (80).

title_en: Tool and method for separating gripper head from fuel basket center column
abstract_en: The invention particularly relates to a tool for separating a gripping apparatus head from a central column of a fuel basket, which comprises a driving rod, a guide hub, a swinging rod, a turntable, an operation long rod and a bayonet lock, wherein the middle part of the turntable is provided with the guide hub, the end of the turntable is provided with a bayonet lock, one end of the swinging rod is connected with the lower end of the guide hub, the other end of the swinging rod is connected with one side of the bayonet lock, and the operation long rod is connected with the bayonet lock. The separation tool disclosed by the invention is simple to operate and strong in practicability, can realize separation of the gripper head and the fuel basket central column, ensures safe, efficient and orderly production of spent fuel dry storage, and provides technical support and reference for related projects of subsequent similar power stations.

title_en: But cigarette air compression big gun that goes out of color mark target
abstract_en: A kind of smoke-extinguishing air compression cannon which can mark the target by color includes a jet mechanism and a compression air pump, the jet mechanism is installed in the ceiling, the top of the jet mechanism is opened with a gas storage box cavity, the top of the gas storage box cavity is fixedly installed with a ring-shaped gas storage box, the gas storage box is opened with a gas storage cavity, the bottom of the gas storage box cavity is opened with a screw hole which is through up and down, the invention combines the air compression cannon with fire extinguishing, the compressed gas process is combined with the door plank, the noise in the compression process is reduced, the strong noise of the air cannon gas compression is solved, and a large amount of energy consumption is reduced, the cannon is installed in the public place and can automatically extinguish the smoke of the smoker, the cannon has the effect of forbidding the smoking in some areas, the smoking problem in the public place is solved, at the same time, the pigment box is added, the pigment can be, has the function of theft prevention.

title_en: Impeller-free high suction range gas-liquid lift pump
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vane-less high suction lift gas-liquid lift pump, which comprises a main lifting pipeline, an air inlet pipe, an air compressor and a PID control system, wherein the main lifting pipeline is connected with the air inlet pipe; the main lifting pipe comprises a pipeline liquid phase region, a gas-liquid acceleration region, a material lifting region and a material slowly-lifting region from bottom to top, wherein the diameter of the material slowly-lifting region is larger than that of the material lifting region; the PID control system comprises a PID controller, a sensor, a detecting element, a fluid flowmeter and a one-way valve, wherein the sensor is arranged at the bottom outlet of the main lifting pipe, the fluid flowmeter is arranged on the air inlet pipe, the one-way valve is arranged at the joint of the air inlet pipe and the air compressor, the sensor and the fluid flowmeter are respectively and electrically connected with the detecting element, and the PID controller is respectively and electrically connected with the detecting element and the one-way valve. The invention can effectively promote solid-liquid waste deposited in sewage tanks, river channels, silt tanks and industrial plants, and has the characteristics of low energy consumption, high treatment efficiency and continuous work.

title_en: Safety shell built-in efficient heat exchanger adopting cutting and striking type air suction system
abstract_en: The invention provides a safe shell built-in high-efficiency heat exchanger adopting a cutting-impact type air suction system, which comprises a water conveying structure, a jet flow structure, an air suction structure, a drain pipe and an exhaust pipe. The cutting-beating type air suction system can convert the water flow potential energy of steam condensation into jet flow energy to drive the air suction structure to rotate, and generate suction force, so that a non-condensable gas film near the heat exchange tube is sucked away, and steam is enabled to be better condensed and heat exchanged on the outer surface of the heat exchange tube. The invention can efficiently take away the heat in the containment when a break accident occurs in the containment, effectively thin the non-condensable gas film by utilizing the cut-and-strike type air suction system, enhance the contact between steam and the tube bundle, realize efficient heat transfer, ensure the efficient temperature and pressure reduction in the containment under the accident condition, enhance the safety of the containment and provide a feasible scheme for reducing the construction cost of the containment.

title_en: Integrated all-metal screw pump oil production device with external rotor and pump
abstract_en: The invention relates to a screw pump oil production device, in particular to a machine-pump integrated all-metal screw pump oil production device with an external rotor, and belongs to the technical field of oil production machinery. The all-metal screw pump comprises a shell, a machine-pump integrated all-metal screw pump positioned in the shell, a dynamic seal positioned at the lower end of the machine-pump integrated all-metal screw pump, and a motion conversion mechanism positioned at the lower end of the dynamic seal. The invention improves the trafficability of the deflecting section of the horizontal well with the middle and short curvature radius by reducing the integral length of the unit through the integrated arrangement of the pump and the motor, thereby avoiding the blockage of the unit due to scaling and the failure of well tripping and workover caused by overlong underground service time; meanwhile, the invention can be suitable for the heavy oil thermal recovery working condition by adopting the all-metal screw pump; in addition, the motion conversion mechanism can realize the cooling and lubrication of the motion conversion mechanism while completing the conversion of the rotation of the fixed shaft of the motor rotor into the eccentric rotation of the screw pump rotor relative to the screw pump bushing, thereby greatly prolonging the service life of the motion conversion mechanism.

title_en: Mixed material pultrusion plate, wind power blade and wind power generator set
abstract_en: The invention provides a mixed material pultrusion plate, a wind power blade and a wind generating set. The mixed material pultrusion plate comprises: a plate body; at least one pair of first material layers which are oppositely arranged on two sides in the plate body; each first material layer is provided with at least one outer connecting surface which can be exposed outside the plate body, and each first material layer is provided with at least one inner protrusion part on the inner side of the plate body; at least one second layer of material is connected between each pair of first layers of material. The mixed material pultrusion plate integrates the first material layer and the second material layer in the same plate body, and the second material layer is positioned between each pair of the first material layers, thereby being more beneficial to leading out electric charges; and, with the inner protrusion provided in the plate body, the area of the first material layer within the plate body is increased and sufficient support strength of the second material layer is ensured. Therefore, the mixed material pultrusion plate has the advantages of mechanical property and cost, is more convenient to use, and has more uniform and stable performance.

title_en: Oil return and ventilation structure for transmission of aircraft engine accessories
