abstract_en: The invention discloses an oil return and ventilation structure for aircraft engine accessory transmission, which comprises a bearing cavity A, wherein one end of the bearing cavity A is provided with a bearing cavity B, a hollow pull rod is arranged on the bearing cavity A and is communicated with the bearing cavity B, an accessory transmission cavity F is arranged above the bearing cavity A, the bearing cavity A and the bearing cavity B are front and rear bearing cavities of a gas generator rotor, the bearing cavity A is connected with the accessory transmission cavity F by adopting a hollow support plate, a centrifugal ventilation device is arranged on the accessory transmission cavity F and is communicated with the atmosphere, a lubricating oil tank ventilation opening is arranged on the accessory transmission cavity F, an oil return pipeline A is arranged on the bearing cavity A, an oil return pipeline B is arranged on the bearing cavity B, and the oil return pipeline A and the oil return pipeline B are both connected with an oil pump, the structure of the engine is compact; the number of parts of the engine rotor is reduced, the weight of the engine is reduced, and the reliability is improved.

title_en: Wind generating set, environmental control system and environmental control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind generating set, a ring control system and a ring control method, wherein the ring control system comprises a condensing device positioned outside a cabin, an air-liquid heat exchanger positioned inside the cabin, a refrigeration cycle device and a draught fan, the ring control system comprises two sets of heat exchange devices of the air-liquid heat exchanger and the refrigeration cycle device, one or two sets of heat exchange devices can be reasonably selected to cool and dehumidify cabin gas according to the working conditions of the cabin environment, a main bearing and other parts, single-stage cooling and dehumidification can be realized, two-stage cooling and dehumidification can also be realized, the use flexibility of two cold sources is greatly improved, main heat exchange parts in the ring control system are positioned inside the cabin, and the refrigerating capacity is relatively high, so that all or most of heating parts of the wind generating set positioned at the top of the tower can be intensively installed inside the cabin, and the ring control system is beneficial to optimizing the structural arrangement inside the cabin.

title_en: Anti-blocking centrifugal pump with impeller protecting function and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of centrifugal pumps, in particular to an anti-clogging centrifugal pump with an impeller protecting function and a method thereof, aiming at the problem that the impeller of the centrifugal pump is damaged due to the impact of impurities, the invention provides a scheme that the anti-clogging centrifugal pump comprises a centrifugal pump, wherein the input end of the centrifugal pump is fixedly connected with a first conduit, the left side of the first conduit is fixedly communicated with a cleaning box, the left side of the cleaning box is fixedly communicated with a second conduit, and the centrifugal pump, the first conduit, the cleaning box, the second conduit, a filter screen, a closing mechanism, a power box, a transmission mechanism, a shaking mechanism, an inclined ring, a third sealing ring, a bearing, a fixed rod, a second fixed block and a tension spring are matched for use, so that the problems that a large amount of impurities are easy to be sucked in the use process of the existing centrifugal pump, and the impeller is damaged and, thereby causing a problem that the centrifugal pump cannot be used.

title_en: Marine navigation mark lamp
abstract_en: The invention discloses an offshore navigation mark lamp, which comprises a base, a lamp body arranged at the top end of the base, a lamp shade arranged outside the lamp body, and a wind power driving mechanism arranged on the base and connected with the lamp shade, wherein the wind power driving mechanism is used for driving the lamp shade to rotate around the lamp body. The invention can be convenient for cleaning the seawater on the lamp shade, and can effectively protect the marine navigation mark lamp when the lamp shade is impacted and in windy weather.

title_en: Seal box door assembly and seal box
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sealing box door assembly and a sealing box, which are used for opening or sealing the sealing box and comprise a first heavy door and a second heavy door, wherein the first heavy door is used for being in sealing butt joint with a sealing box door, and the second heavy door is arranged on the outer side of the first heavy door; when the sealed box door is closed, the first heavy door is in sealed butt joint with the sealed box, and the second heavy door exerts lateral pressure on the first heavy door by partial or all gravity of the second heavy door to push the first heavy door to the sealed box. The invention ensures the purity in the operation space of the seal box by using the double door structure and pressing the first heavy door by using the gravity of the second heavy door, effectively prevents the leakage and invasion of external substances possibly caused by the existence of gaps or fine diffusion, and effectively controls the gas purity.

title_en: Centrifugal fan and air supply device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a centrifugal fan and an air supply device, wherein the centrifugal fan comprises: a volute having an installation space therein; the wind wheel is arranged in the installation space, the volute is provided with a volute tongue and a throat part, and the distance between the volute tongue and the wind wheel is smaller than that between the throat part and the wind wheel. From this, through the distance that the distance of snail tongue and wind wheel is greater than the distance of throat and wind wheel, can reduce centrifugal fan's noise at work, can noise abatement to environmental pollution to can promote user experience, and, also can slow down the spiral case gas leakage, can promote centrifugal fan's air output, thereby can promote the work efficiency of spiral case, and then can promote centrifugal fan's work efficiency.

title_en: Wind wheel device and wind generating set
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind wheel device and a wind generating set, the wind wheel device comprises blades, connecting pieces and a variable-pitch bearing, the blade root of each blade is connected to the variable-pitch bearing through a plurality of connecting pieces, the blade root is provided with a heavy load area, the connecting end of the blade root is provided with a reinforcing part, the reinforcing part is arranged in the heavy load area, the variable-pitch bearing is provided with a connecting part, the connecting part and the reinforcing part are correspondingly arranged, and one part of the connecting pieces are connected with the reinforcing part and the connecting part. The wind wheel device is additionally provided with the reinforcing part in the heavy load area on the blade root connecting end surface, and meanwhile, the connecting part is correspondingly additionally arranged on the variable pitch bearing, so that more space setting connecting pieces are arranged on the blade root and the variable pitch bearing, the outer diameter size of the whole blade root does not need to be increased, the sizes of the variable pitch bearing and the hub which are correspondingly matched with the blade root do not need to be increased, the connecting strength of the blade in the heavy load area and the variable pitch bearing is improved, and the economic benefit is improved.

title_en: Vibration anti-icing type wind driven generator blade
abstract_en: The invention provides a vibration anti-icing type wind driven generator blade, wherein a main impact ball is fixedly arranged on one side of a main connecting rod, which is far away from a rotating rod; the auxiliary striking ball can strike the struck block; the embedded setting of heat-conducting piece is on the surface of blade, the heat-conducting piece is including first heat-conducting plate and the second heat-conducting plate of cross arrangement, the equal activity in both sides of first heat-conducting plate and second heat-conducting plate is provided with the protruding type piece, the below of protruding type piece is provided with the regulation gasbag, adjust gasbag and total gasbag intercommunication, the cam is at rotatory time intermittent type ground extrusion total gasbag for adjust gasbag intermittent type nature inflation outwards ejecting with protruding type piece. The invention provides a vibration anti-icing type wind driven generator blade which can realize vibration with better effect on the blade, and can crack a large ice layer into small ice layers.

title_en: Diaphragm compressor
abstract_en: A diaphragm compressor comprises a diaphragm head part, a transmission part, a crankcase, a booster oil pump, an oil cooling system and a detection early warning system, wherein the booster oil pump comprises a primary oil injection booster pump and a secondary oil supplement booster pump, the primary oil injection booster pump and the secondary oil supplement booster pump are sequentially sleeved on the crankshaft, the primary oil injection booster pump injects oil into a piston cavity in the crankcase through an oil injection pipeline, the secondary oil supplement booster pump supplements oil for an oil cavity through an oil supplement pipeline, and the primary oil injection booster pump and the secondary oil supplement booster pump are communicated through an oil way; the oil cooling system is arranged on the outer side of the crankcase, the two-stage booster oil pump is coaxially and directly driven by the crankshaft of the diaphragm compressor, additional driving is not needed, the structure is compact, the oil injection phase of the oil pump and the oil piston phase of the compressor can be accurately controlled, and the reliability is improved. The detection early warning system is used for carrying out all-round real-time monitoring on the diaphragm compressor, so that the fault position can be known in time, and the internal state of the compressor can be conveniently analyzed, thereby being beneficial to correcting the internal state of the compressor.

title_en: Vibration sensor with diagnosis function and method for detecting vibration of moving equipment thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vibration sensor with a diagnosis function, which comprises: an embedded central processing unit; the low-frequency vibration collector is used for collecting vibration data of the natural frequency of the mobile equipment in a non-running state and storing the vibration data in the storage unit, and the storage unit is also pre-stored with fault frequency data corresponding to different types of faults generated according to the vibration data of the natural frequency of the mobile equipment; the high-frequency vibration collector is used for collecting vibration data of the mobile equipment in a running state; the embedded central processing unit filters the natural frequency vibration data from the vibration data collected by the high-frequency vibration collector, compares the processed data with the prestored fault frequency data, and if the processed data is consistent with the prestored fault frequency data, a fault occurs and alarm information is generated. The sensor can effectively remove interference data generated by the inherent frequency characteristics of the mobile equipment, so that the obtained data is more accurate and real, and meanwhile, real-time diagnosis and real-time early warning can be realized. The invention also provides a vibration detection method of the mobile equipment.

title_en: Refrigerator with compressor
abstract_en: Refrigerated cabinet (2) comprising a coolant compressor (50) comprising a hermetically sealed housing (52) and a drive unit arranged within the housing having a unit for circulating a coolant for compression and an electric motor for driving the unit, wherein the coolant compressor (50) further comprises at least one connection (70) for connecting the compressor (50) to a mounting structure (64) of the refrigerated cabinet (2), wherein the connection (70) comprises an inner element (82) and an outer element (84) surrounding the inner element (82), wherein the inner element (82) has a greater stiffness than the outer element (84), wherein both the inner element (82) and the outer element (84) are constructed with a respective resilient element (82, 84).

title_en: Electronic throttle valve control method and electronic control unit
abstract_en: The invention provides an electronic throttle control method and an electronic control unit, which judge whether an engine is in a gas cut-off (FSO) mode through an ECU; if the engine is in the FSO mode, judging the state of the engine based on a braking signal; and if the engine is in a dragging state, starting a timer to control the opening of the electronic throttle valve based on the running time of the engine, or monitoring the exhaust temperature of an exhaust manifold and controlling the opening of the electronic throttle valve based on the exhaust temperature. According to the scheme, the opening of the electronic throttle valve in the dragging state is intelligently controlled according to the running time or the exhaust temperature of the engine, so that the exhaust temperature cooling rate is reduced, the thermal fatigue load when the ignition state is switched to the dragging state is relieved, and the purpose of prolonging the service life of the exhaust manifold is achieved.

title_en: Engine idling control method and device based on double-storage-battery power supply system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an engine idle speed control method and device based on a double-storage-battery power supply system, wherein the control method comprises the following steps: when the vehicle is in an idling state, acquiring the current rotating speed of an engine and the duty ratio of a generator; judging whether the duty ratio is larger than a first preset duty ratio or not; if yes, acquiring the state information of the two storage batteries; the state information comprises the on-off state of the relay, the current electric quantity of each storage battery and the charge-discharge state of each storage battery; and determining the rotating speed increasing amount of the engine according to the state information and the current rotating speed. The technical scheme provided by the invention can control the rotating speed of the engine to be increased to different rotating speeds according to different idling working conditions, and improves the practicability, flexibility and convenience.

title_en: Engine protection control method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides an engine protection control method, an engine protection control device, engine protection control equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining operating parameters of the engine, the operating parameters including at least one of: engine speed, air rail pressure, and injection valve failure status; determining a required air charge limit of the engine under the current engine speed, air rail pressure and fault state of an injection valve; a desired air charge for the engine is determined based on the desired air charge limit for controlling an air-fuel ratio of the engine based on the desired air charge. The embodiment of the invention can determine the required air charge under different working conditions, further control the air-fuel ratio of the engine to be kept in a preset range interval according to the required air charge, and effectively protect the components of the engine and an aftertreatment device.

title_en: Piston steam engine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a piston type steam engine which comprises a vaporizing device, a first gas acting unit, a second gas acting unit and a condensing device. The vaporizing device is used for heating and vaporizing the liquid working medium to form a gaseous working medium with preset temperature and pressure. The first gas working unit is used for continuously heating the gaseous working medium while the gaseous working medium expands to work. The second gas acting unit enables the gaseous working medium which does work in the first gas acting unit to expand to do work. The condensing device is used for condensing the gaseous working medium to return to the liquid working medium after the second gas working unit works.

title_en: Engine super knock suppression method, storage medium, controller and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a super knock suppression method for an engine, which comprises the following steps: dividing the operation condition of the engine into a plurality of working condition areas according to the rotating speed of the engine, the load of the engine and the inlet air temperature of the engine; enabling the engine to operate in each working condition area, and identifying the occurrence frequency of super detonation in each working condition area; and adjusting the protection concentration of the combustible mixed gas of the engine at least once according to the occurrence frequency of the super detonation in the working condition area. The invention can execute active control before the engine super detonation occurs, reduce the occurrence probability of the engine super detonation, avoid the engine from being damaged by the super detonation and improve the safety.

title_en: Full-computer upper control system for controlling high-voltage nitrogen making machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of nitrogen making machine control systems, and discloses a full-computer upper control system for controlling a high-voltage nitrogen making machine, which comprises: the system comprises an industrial computer upper computer controller, a switch, a USB, a PLC, a soft starter, a frequency converter, a pneumatic valve, a temperature sensor and a pressure sensor; the industrial computer upper computer controller is used for running special control software developed by self, an instruction is sent to a lower PLC, a switch is used for connecting data exchange connection between upper computer PLC nitrogen making machines, a USB is used for guaranteeing control assembly voltage supply, a series of adverse consequences caused by power failure are prevented, the PLC is used for controlling all actions on equipment, a soft starter is used for controlling a main motor to run, a frequency converter is used for controlling a piston main motor cooling fan to run, a pneumatic valve is used for controlling the opening and closing of a pipeline gas circuit, a temperature sensor is used for detecting and feeding back temperatures of all levels, and a pressure sensor is used for detecting and feeding back pressures of all levels.

title_en: Aircraft jet engine nacelle air intake and method of deicing thereof
abstract_en: De-icing device for an air inlet (2) of a nacelle of a turbine jet engine (1) of an aircraft, the turbine jet engine extending along an axis (X) in which an air flow flows from upstream to downstream, an inner wall (21) comprising a plurality of blowing ducts (3), each blowing duct (3) comprising a plurality of through-openings (4) for outputting a basic flow (Fe) for de-icing the inner wall (21), the basic flow being supplied by a hot air source, the blowing ducts (3) being parallel to one another in a cylindrical projection plane (P), each blowing duct (3) having a depth P3 extending in the X-axis direction and a length L3 extending in the Y-axis direction in the cylindrical projection plane (P), two adjacent blowing ducts (3) being spaced apart in the Y-axis direction by a distance D3, the distance ratio L3/D3 being between 1 and 2.

title_en: Steam turbine for dry quenching waste heat power generation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a steam turbine for dry quenching waste heat power generation, which relates to the technical field of steam turbines and comprises a steam turbine and a bearing arranged on a rotating shaft of the steam turbine, and further comprises a thermostat, a lubricating oil monitoring system, a thermostat, a filter, a first oil tank, a second oil tank, a first oil pump and a second oil pump. Temperature and viscosity of lubricating oil in the intelligent recognition bearing oil pocket, when effectual solved the steam turbine and just started, lubricating oil is because of the temperature low, make viscosity high, the oil film is difficult to the formation problem, the lubricating effect of lubricating oil to the bearing has been improved, and heat through steam, need not increase other heating system, manufacturing cost is reduced, the cooling water of condenser department cools down lubricating oil, abundant utilization the energy among the dry coke quenching waste heat power generation system, realize the lubricating oil that must change many to impurity and new lubricating oil switch, the life of production efficiency with improved the bearing, do not need artifical monitoring discernment constantly, the amount of labour has been saved.

title_en: Novel many inclined hole board ellipsoid pendulum cooling structure for aeroengine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel cooling structure of an ellipsoid pendulum with multiple inclined hole plates for an aerospace engine, wherein cooling inclined holes are connected with air entraining channels, the air entraining channels extend to the inner side of a flame tube of a combustion chamber and are communicated with a spherical shaft, an ellipsoid is positioned between the adjacent cooling inclined holes on the inner side of the flame tube wall of the combustion chamber, the major axis of the ellipsoid is in the front-back direction, the ellipsoid is provided with an inner cavity, the spherical shaft is positioned in the inner cavity of the ellipsoid, an exhaust channel which is communicated with the outer surface of the ellipsoid and the inner cavity is arranged on the ellipsoid, a hole is formed in the spherical shaft, the ellipsoid can rotate around the spherical shaft, and the spherical shaft is connected with the ellipsoid through a spring. The invention can ensure the normal conveyance of cold air to the downstream and enhance the cooling effect under the condition of small amount of cooling gas, and can avoid the problem that the downstream can not stabilize the gas film coverage due to jet flow wall separation when the air speed of the blown cold air is high when the amount of the cooling gas is large.

title_en: Steam control system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a steam control system and a method, comprising a boiler, at least one group of back pressure turbines, at least one group of production devices, a pressure reduction station and a desuperheater: the steam exhaust end of the boiler is sequentially connected with a pressure reducing station and a desuperheater, the steam exhaust end of the desuperheater is connected with a production device, the steam exhaust end of the boiler is also connected with the steam inlet end of a back pressure turbine, the steam exhaust end of the back pressure turbine is connected to a pipeline at the exhaust end of the pressure reducing station, and the steam inlet end of the desuperheater receives steam generated by the exhaust end of the pressure reducing station and the steam exhaust end of the back pressure turbine. After the desuperheater is added to the steam pipe network, the back pressure steam turbine can be timely adjusted according to the steam temperature index condition of the main pipe in the processes of heat supply network combining and heat supply network clearing, and the problem that the back pressure steam turbine is easy to cause over-temperature tripping of a subsequent production device in the processes of heat supply network combining and heat supply network clearing is solved.

title_en: Gas compressor
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of automatic equipment, and particularly relates to a gas compressor which comprises a protective cover, a rock wool board, a spring II, a mass ball, buffer liquid, a resistance rod and a hollow ball.

title_en: Energy-saving screw air compressor
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy-saving screw type air compressor which comprises a compressor body, wherein the compressor body is provided with an air outlet, the air outlet is connected with a vertical air pipe I, the air pipe I is connected with a horizontal air pipe II, the air pipe II is connected with a vertical air pipe III, the air pipe III is connected with a machine, the air pipe II is provided with a rotating mechanism, the rotating mechanism is connected with a cleaning mechanism I for cleaning the inner wall of the air pipe II, the cleaning mechanism II is arranged in the air pipe I and the air pipe III, a connecting mechanism is arranged between the cleaning mechanism II and the cleaning mechanism I, the air pipe I and the air pipe III are provided with oil stain outlets, and valves are arranged on the oil stain outlets. The air compressor can prevent the air pressure price from reducing when the air tank passes through, and can clean oil stains in the air pipe.

title_en: Thin gas transmission device
abstract_en: A thin gas delivery device comprising: an air inlet plate; a resonator plate; an actuator coupled to the fixed portion of the resonator plate; a first insulating frame coupled to the actuator; an electrically conductive frame, having: a conductive outer frame combined with the first insulating frame; one end of the elastic conductive pin is connected with the inner edge part of the conductive outer frame, the other end of the elastic conductive pin obliquely extends towards the direction of the actuating piece and forms a bending part which abuts against the actuating piece and is electrically connected with the actuating piece, and the bending part is in a strip shape; and a conductive tab connected to an outer edge portion of the conductive outer frame; and a second insulating frame coupled to the conductive outer frame.

title_en: IGCC generator combined gas sensible heat recovery steam load distribution method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of integrated gasification combined cycle power generation, and provides a method for distributing sensible heat recovery steam load of gas combined by an IGCC generator.

title_en: Mountain wind power blade capable of reducing influence of environmental change
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountainous wind power blade capable of reducing the influence of environmental change, wherein fixed blocks which are uniformly distributed are fixedly arranged on the surface of a wind power blade body, a movable block is movably connected to the outer side of the top end of the fixed block 10, a fixed groove is formed in the movable block, a penetrating hole is formed in the bottom of the movable block, a fixed plate is slidably connected to the inside of the fixed groove, the top end of the fixed block penetrates through the penetrating hole and then extends to the inside of the fixed groove and is fixedly connected with the fixed plate, a plurality of air springs are uniformly and fixedly connected to the top surface of the fixed plate, the other end of each air spring is fixedly connected with the inner wall of the fixed groove, fixed pipes which are uniformly distributed are fixedly connected to the top surface of the movable block, a limiting plate is slidably connected to the inside of each fixed pipe, a connecting block is fixedly connected to the top end of each limiting plate, and the top end of each connecting block extends to the outer side of each fixed pipe. This wind-powered electricity generation blade in the use wind-powered electricity generation blade body is difficult to receive striking such as hail or flyrock, avoids its surface to take place the damage.

title_en: Water pump test system, long-term service life test method and locked rotor test method
abstract_en: The application provides a water pump test system, a long-term service life test method and a locked rotor test method. The system includes at least one test unit, the test unit including: the tank body is used for storing liquid for testing, and a water inlet of the water pump is immersed in the liquid; the fixed platform is used for installing a water pump and is provided with at least one pump position; the U-shaped pipes are in one-to-one correspondence with the pump positions and are vertically arranged, the bending ends of the U-shaped pipes are far away from the tank body, the inlet ends of the U-shaped pipes are connected with the water outlet of the water pump, and the outlet ends of the U-shaped pipes are connected with the tank body, so that liquid in the tank body can return to the tank body after being pumped into the U-shaped pipes by the water pump; the water flow switches correspond to the U-shaped pipes one by one and are arranged at the outlet ends of the U-shaped pipes; and the control device is electrically connected with the water pump and is in communication connection with the water flow switch. The system can be used for long-term service life testing and locked rotor testing, so that the reliability of the water pump is detected, and the reliability of the water pump leaving a factory is guaranteed.

title_en: Positive pressure detection device and method and vehicle comprising device
abstract_en: The invention provides a positive pressure detection device, a positive pressure detection method and a vehicle comprising the device, which belong to the technical field of internal combustion engines, wherein the positive pressure detection device comprises: a fuel tank, a carbon canister, a positive pressure generator, an engine, a fuel vapor concentration detector, a self-circulation conduit, and a controller. The fuel tank is provided with an exhaust port and an oil outlet; the carbon tank is provided with an atmosphere communication port, an adsorption port and a desorption port, and the adsorption port is communicated with the exhaust port; the positive pressure generator is arranged on the atmosphere communication port, and the air blowing port is communicated with the atmosphere communication port; the engine is provided with an oil inlet and an air inlet, the oil inlet is communicated with the oil outlet, and the air inlet is provided with an air inlet pipeline; the fuel vapor concentration detector is arranged on the desorption pipeline; one end of the self-circulation pipeline is communicated with the desorption pipeline, and the other end of the self-circulation pipeline is communicated with the adsorption pipeline; the controller is electrically connected with the fuel vapor concentration detector and the positive pressure generator. The concentration can be detected without starting the engine.

title_en: Paediatrics is with preventing playing by device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medical instruments, in particular to a pediatric quilt kicking prevention device which comprises a base, wherein two rotating shafts which are correspondingly arranged are rotatably arranged on the upper surface of the base along the length direction of the base, a cross rod is fixedly arranged at the top ends of the two rotating shafts, one end of a pull rope is respectively fixed at two ends of each cross rod, pull rope guide mechanisms are fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the base at two sides of each rotating shaft, the pull rope guide mechanisms are arranged in a one-to-one correspondence manner with the pull ropes, a quilt fixer is fixedly arranged after one end of each pull rope passes through the corresponding pull rope guide mechanism, and a limiting mechanism corresponding to one end of each cross rod is arranged on one side of each cross rod. The quilt can prevent the quilt from being kicked off, and can accelerate the discharge of hot air in the quilt, so that children can sleep with high quality.

title_en: Carbon nanotube gas field ionization thruster with double-gate structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a carbon nano tube gas field ionization thruster with a double-grid structure, and belongs to the technical field of space propulsion. The invention mainly comprises a gas diffusion chamber, an ionization chamber and a secondary acceleration chamber. The gas diffusion chamber comprises a ventilation base, a first isolation layer, an emitting electrode base, a carbon nano tube emitting electrode and an emitting electrode cold-pressing wiring terminal. The gas enters the gas diffusion chamber through the ventilation base to be diffused; the gas working medium enters the ionization chamber through the vent hole on the carbon nano tube emitter, and the gas ionization and one-time acceleration are realized in the ionization chamber by electrifying the emitter cold-pressing wiring terminal and the extraction grid cold-pressing wiring terminal. The ionized gas ions enter the secondary acceleration chamber through the air holes of the extraction grid, the cold-pressing wiring terminal of the extraction grid and the cold-pressing wiring terminal of the acceleration grid are electrified, the ions after secondary acceleration are sprayed out through the air holes of the acceleration grid, and the control of the particle speed is met by changing the potential difference between the extraction grid and the acceleration grid of the secondary acceleration chamber.

title_en: Intelligent group control method for centrifugal air compressor unit based on energy efficiency real-time monitoring
abstract_en: The invention relates to an air compressor control technology, and aims to provide an intelligent group control method for a centrifugal air compressor set based on energy efficiency real-time monitoring. The method improves the traditional single machine adjustment into self-adaptive group control on the premise of minimizing the emptying and the energy consumption. The integral bleeding air quantity in the operation process is continuously minimized aiming at the given selected centrifugal air compressor unit, the opening degree of the inlet guide vane of the whole centrifugal air compressor unit is maximized, and the operation energy efficiency is maximized. The core of the invention is to perform optimized group control based on single machine control on the running centrifugal air compressor unit, the control mode is applicable to classified or non-classified air compressor systems, and the aim is to control the centrifugal air compressor unit within the range of the pressure level or the quality level. The invention is the foundation for establishing a generalized group control system comprising circulating water, compressed air post-treatment, an overflow system and terminal control. From this point of view, the invention is the basis of the efficient operation and intelligent control of the oil-free air compression station.

title_en: Energy-saving refrigerating device and control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy-saving refrigerating device and a control method. When the indoor temperature is higher than 28 ℃, the computer controller starts the outdoor single-phase asynchronous motor to drive the rotary piston compressor to rotate. The gas refrigerant in the gas storage tank enters the rotary piston compressor, the temperature of the gas refrigerant is raised to 120 ℃ after the gas refrigerant is compressed by the rotary piston compressor, and then the gas refrigerant passes through the check valve and then passes through the copper pipe of the stator magnetic pole of the thermomagnetic motor, so that the thermomagnetic material of the stator magnetic pole of the thermomagnetic motor is heated to more than 70 ℃, and the thermomagnetic material is changed from a non-magnetic material into a magnetic material. The computer controller energizes the stator coil and the rotor winding of the thermomagnetic motor, the magnetic field of the stator coil of the thermomagnetic motor is amplified by the stator magnetic pole of the thermomagnetic motor and then provides power for the rotor of the thermomagnetic motor to rotate, and the heat energy of the stator magnetic pole of the thermomagnetic motor is converted into magnetic energy to drive the rotor of the thermomagnetic motor to rotate. The 70 ℃ gas refrigerant enters a condenser, is cooled to 45 ℃ by the refrigerant in the air storage tank, the 45 ℃ liquid refrigerant enters an indoor evaporator, and the evaporation fan blows out cold air.

title_en: Locking mechanism for wind turbine generator
abstract_en: A generator (24) for a wind turbine (1) comprising a rotor (32) having an axis of rotation, a stator and a radial locking mechanism and/or an axial locking mechanism. The radial locking mechanism includes a plurality of radial locks (60) having a stationary portion (70) coupled to the stator and a movable elongated portion (72) configured to move radially relative to the stationary portion (70) and relative to the rotational axis to lock the stator in a radial direction. The rotor (32) may include at least one locking engagement feature (86) disposed at an end surface thereof and an end cap (90) positioned axially outward and at least partially adjacent the end surface. The end cap (90) includes at least one opening that enables access to an end surface of the rotor (32). The axial locking mechanism may include at least one axial lock (80) including a removable block (82) configured to partially cover at least one opening of an end cap (90) and a rotor engagement tool (84) for engaging the removable block (82) with at least one locking engagement feature (86).

title_en: Oil-gas separation device, compressor and air conditioner
abstract_en: The invention provides an oil-gas separation device, a compressor and an air conditioner, wherein the oil-gas separation device is arranged in an exhaust cavity and comprises a support rod arranged at an air inlet, and a flow guide channel and a guide hole are formed in the support rod; the oil-gas mixture enters the flow guide channel through the air inlet and contacts and collides with the inner wall of the flow guide channel; the oil-gas mixture is discharged to different areas of the inner side wall of the exhaust cavity, so that the contact collision probability and the contact collision area between oil drops and the inner side wall of the exhaust cavity are increased; the oil-gas separation device also comprises a commutator, wherein the oil-gas mixture discharged from the guide hole enters the reversing hole, contacts and collides with the inner wall of the reversing hole, and is discharged to different areas of the inner side wall of the exhaust cavity again; the structure is simple, the oil-gas separation efficiency is high, and the separation is more thorough; when being applied to the compressor, the oil-gas separation device realizes multiple times of oil-gas separation by enabling the oil-gas mixture to reach the inner side wall of the exhaust cavity through the supporting rod and the commutator, reduces the oil yield of the compressor and improves the efficiency of the heat exchanger.

title_en: Control method of non-backfire hydrogen-ammonia dual-fuel zero-carbon rotor machine
abstract_en: The invention designs a control method of a non-tempering hydrogen-ammonia dual-fuel zero-carbon rotor machine, and particularly relates to a control method for eliminating the tempering problem of a hydrogen rotor machine by combined combustion of hydrogen and ammonia. The invention takes the engine speed sensor and the air inlet pressure sensor as signals to judge the running condition of the rotor machine, and selects the hydrogen-ammonia mixing proportion suitable for the current working condition to inhibit the occurrence of the no-backfire phenomenon, thereby realizing the zero-carbon emission rotor machine with high dynamic property and high safety.

title_en: Large displacement pump with rapid pressure cut-off protection function and protection method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a large displacement pump with a rapid pressure cut-off protection function and a protection method thereof, wherein the large displacement pump with the rapid pressure cut-off protection function comprises a closed pump (1), a closed pump displacement control valve (2) and a closed pump working oil port selection valve (3) which are sequentially connected, the large displacement pump with the rapid pressure cut-off protection function further comprises a safety protection circuit, the safety protection circuit comprises a shuttle valve (4) and a monitoring control module (5), and when the outlet pressure of the shuttle valve (4) is greater than the preset pressure, the monitoring control module (5) can cut off a closed pump displacement control oil supply pipeline (31) and enable the closed pump displacement control valve (2) to be changed into a closed state. The large displacement pump with the rapid pressure cut-off protection function comprises a safety protection loop for comparing pressure and controlling oil on-off of displacement, so that the problem that a hydraulic system has safety risks due to overload pressure overshoot of the large displacement pump with the rapid pressure cut-off protection function is solved.

title_en: Automatic cleaning device for dust accumulated on surface of engine radiator
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of automobile engine heat dissipation, in particular to an automatic cleaning device for dust accumulated on the surface of an engine radiator, which comprises a radiator fan frame, a power mechanism, a trigger mechanism, a scraping mechanism and a collecting mechanism, wherein a plurality of electric heat dissipation fans are arranged in the fan frame, the power mechanism comprises a first belt pulley, a second belt pulley and a hexagonal block, the rear side wall of the fan frame is rotatably connected with the first belt pulley, the rotating shaft of the first belt pulley is fixedly connected with the rotating shaft of each electric heat dissipation fan, the rear side wall of the fan frame is rotatably inserted with the second belt pulley, the rotating shaft of the second belt pulley penetrates through the side wall of the fan frame and is fixedly connected with the hexagonal block, a transmission belt is arranged between the first belt pulley and the second belt pulley, the trigger mechanism is used for inducing the air flow caused by the fans and driving a scraping rod to scrape when more dust is accumulated, and the mobile phone with the scraped dust can be placed in the collecting box, so that the dust is prevented from blocking again.

title_en: Rural well inside rubbish clearance ware
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of wells, and particularly relates to a garbage cleaner in a rural well, which comprises a connecting column, wherein a drainage box is arranged at the bottom of the connecting column, a water pumping pipe is arranged at the bottom of the drainage box, collecting boxes are arranged at two ends of a driving column, a drainage hole is formed in the top of the drainage box, and a dewatering hole is formed in the bottom of the collecting box; the inside of drainage box is provided with the guard box. At the during operation, the inside pumping fan blade that the accessible motor drove the pumping pipe rotates, can rotate the inside that can take the inside water suction of water well into the pumping pipe through pumping fan blade, when water and the inside of aquatic rubbish enter into the pumping pipe, rotate the inside that can take the pumping pipe out with the rubbish of aquatic through the holding back, get into the inside of collecting box, can clear away the rubbish of aquatic, well water can continue to remove to the top of pumping pipe, finally discharge through the drainage box, two collecting boxes can be more effective with setting up of holding back, more quick rubbish of cleaing away.

title_en: Method for judging running state of unit based on vibration data characteristics of water turbine generator unit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for judging the running state of a unit based on the vibration data characteristics of a water-turbine generator unit, which comprises the steps of carrying out singular value decomposition on collected vibration data of an original noise-containing unit, obtaining a singular value difference spectrum according to the singular value decomposition to determine the reconstructed order, thereby achieving the denoising effect and restoring the actual vibration data of the unit; and drawing a waveform diagram, a frequency and an axis track diagram of actual unit vibration data after denoising, so that operation and maintenance personnel can conveniently judge the running condition of the unit according to the characteristics in the diagrams. The invention has the characteristic of accurately and timely judging the running state of the unit.

title_en: Maximum power point tracking control method and device for wind power generation system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device and a storage medium for tracking and controlling the maximum power point of a wind power generation system, wherein the method for tracking and controlling the maximum power point of the wind power generation system comprises the following contents: by combining a three-phase reversing function of the direct-current brushless generator and utilizing a switching technology of a power converter, the wind power generation system can generate power at any rotating speed at a maximum power point. The invention has better accuracy and stability.

title_en: Air compressor air suction pretreatment system and control method thereof
abstract_en: The utility model provides an air compressor machine pretreatment of breathing in system and control method thereof, the system includes the air compressor machine, a heat exchanger, closed cooling tower, the cooling water set, the cold water tank, circulating water pump, spray pump and control flap, heat exchanger water route exit linkage to closed cooling tower entry, closed cooling tower exit linkage to cooling water set evaporimeter water route entry, cooling water set evaporimeter water route exit linkage to cold water tank entry, cold water tank exit linkage to water pump entry, water pump exit linkage to electronic three-way control valve, electronic three-way control valve is connected to heat exchanger water route entry all the way, another way is connected to heat exchanger water route export, heat exchanger air outlet connects the air compressor machine entry. According to the invention, the closed cooling tower and the water chilling unit are combined to operate, the air at the air suction end of the air compressor is cooled by using cold water, and meanwhile, the air suction temperature of the air compressor is accurately controlled by using the sensor, so that the liquid carrying in the air suction of the air compressor is avoided, and the problems of high energy consumption and low stability of the air compressor caused by overhigh air suction temperature are solved.

title_en: Control device, electric compressor, and control method
abstract_en: One aspect of the present invention is a control device including: an electrical detection unit that detects an electrical physical quantity related to a main capacitor provided between a direct-current power supply and a switching element of an inverter; and a protection control unit that controls the switching element of the inverter so as to prevent a current from flowing to the main capacitor in accordance with a change in the electrical physical quantity.

title_en: Rotor pump rotor with corrosion-resistant rubber lining
abstract_en: The utility model provides a rotor pump rotor with corrosion resistant lining is glued, belongs to rotor pump technical field, installs in the rotor pump shell, includes: the cooling oil in the oil storage cavity flows back to the oil storage cavity through an oil pipe arranged in the rotor body so as to cool the rotor body; the circulating assembly is arranged between the rotor pump shell and the rotor body and is used for driving cooling oil in a closed space formed by the oil pipe and the oil storage cavity to circularly flow; the bottom plate is fixedly connected with the rotor pump shell; the cooling mechanism is arranged on the bottom plate and is rotationally connected with the rotor body, and cools the cooling oil in the oil storage cavity in the process that the cooling oil circularly flows to cool the rotor body in the working state, so that the rotor of the rotor pump is cooled in the working process of the rotor pump.

title_en: System for improving summer operation vacuum of direct air cooling unit and operation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for improving summer operation vacuum of a direct air cooling unit, wherein main equipment of the system comprises a medium pressure cylinder, a refrigeration heat pump, an air cooling radiator, a cold water disc tube bundle and an air cooling fan, a steam driven heat pump refrigerating device is arranged in the system, steam discharged by the medium pressure cylinder is extracted to serve as driving steam to prepare cold water, the cold water disc tube bundle is arranged in front of an air cooling fan outlet and an air inlet of the air cooling condenser, the cold water disc tube bundle is pressurized by a circulating pump to flow through the tube bundle additionally arranged in front of the air cooling fan outlet and the cold air inlet of the air cooling condenser, and cold energy is transmitted to cooling air and then returned to the refrigeration heat pump. Compared with the existing capacity-increasing and water consumption peak cooling technology of the air-cooled radiator, the invention achieves a larger energy-saving effect with smaller transformation investment, realizes zero water consumption in the whole life cycle, and realizes operation vacuum lifting and unit energy consumption reduction at the cost of partial steam exhaust consumption.

title_en: Wind turbine with sea level wave characteristic determination
abstract_en: The invention relates to a wind turbine (1) configured to be arranged in or above a sea bed (S). The wind turbine (1) comprises: a tower (2) configured to protrude from the sea level (S) and having a transmitter (20, 20A; 30) configured to transmit electromagnetic waves (100) to be reflected on the sea level (S), and a receiver (20, 20B; 40) configured to receive the reflected electromagnetic waves (200), wherein at least one of the transmitter (20, 20A; 30) and the receiver (20, 20B; 40) comprises a leakage feed (20); and a processing unit (7) in communication with the receiver (20, 20B; 40) and configured to analyze the reflected electromagnetic waves (200) such that the wave characteristics of the sea level (S) are determined.

title_en: Cooling system for rotating electric machine
abstract_en: A rotating electric machine includes a stator (11), a rotor, a plurality of coils, and a plurality of spacers. The stator (11) has a stator main body (16) and a plurality of stator poles (17). Each stator pole (17) has a pair of opposing side surfaces. The rotor is positioned within the stator (11) and has a plurality of rotor poles. One coil is disposed around each stator pole (17). A spacer is disposed between one of the coils and at least one of the inner surface of the stator body (16) and the side surface of the stator body to define a fluid flow opening between the coil and the stator (11).

title_en: Energy-saving utilization system of toughened glass heating furnace
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy-saving utilization system of a toughened glass heating furnace, which comprises a closed heating furnace body, wherein through holes for toughened glass and a roller rod to pass in and out are formed in two sides of the furnace body; the exhaust flue gas in the preheating section is connected with a second heat exchanger through a fan, and the second heat exchanger is connected with a third heat exchanger through a pipeline. The invention has the following advantages: the waste heat discharged from three working areas in the production process is fully recovered, and the increase of energy consumption caused by the fact that a large amount of external cold air enters the furnace can be avoided in the closed space; meanwhile, the preheating temperature of the toughened glass is increased, so that the energy is further saved and the consumption is reduced; the waste heat of the kiln can be fully utilized, the operation cost can be saved, and the emission of gas pollutants can be reduced.

title_en: Blade tip structure connecting device of horizontal shaft wind generating set
abstract_en: The invention provides a connecting device for a blade tip structure of a horizontal-axis wind generating set, which comprises a blade body connecting body made of the same material as a blade body and a blade tip connecting body made of the same material as the blade tip, wherein the blade body connecting body and the blade tip connecting body are connected in a contact extrusion manner, the blade body is connected with the blade body connecting body, and the blade tip is connected with the blade tip connecting body; the invention avoids the condition of adhesive connection between parts made of different material systems, effectively improves the connection design precision of the blade tip structure, improves the related safety and reliability and reduces the failure probability; meanwhile, the invention can solve the connection problems of increased size and increased weight of the blade tip, play a role in effectively connecting and manufacturing the blade body and the blade tip in sections, widen the selection range of production materials and production processes of the blade of the wind generating set, reasonably reduce the difficulty of the production molding quality control of the large-scale composite material blade, and effectively improve the product quality of the blade tip, thereby reducing the manufacturing and transportation cost of the components of the wind generating set.

title_en: Dustproof shell for wind driven generator convenient to maintain and wind driven generator set
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dustproof shell for a wind driven generator convenient to maintain and a wind driven generator set, wherein the dustproof shell comprises a fixed box body, and a dustproof mechanism is arranged at the top of the fixed box body; the dustproof mechanism comprises a cover plate sealing strip, a gauze is arranged at the top of the cover plate, a vibration exciter and a radiating fin are arranged on the cover plate, and the vibration exciter is connected with the end part of the gauze; the cover plate is hinged with the fixed box body, a sealing strip is arranged at the joint of the cover plate and the fixed box body, and a rain-proof plate is arranged above the fixed box body; not only can directly open the device through the apron to maintain the inside motor of the device, the gauze cooperation fan that sets up through the apron top simultaneously not only can prevent that the dust from getting into the inside of the device, still can dispel the heat to the device.

title_en: Method and system for evaluating service life of blade of horizontal axis wind generating set
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating the service life of a blade of a horizontal axis wind generating set, which are used for obtaining a thermal insulation protective coating damage expansion rule curved surface, namely a function relation of the volume reduction rate of a test piece thermal insulation protective coating along with experiment time; obtaining a service life calibration curved surface of the thermal insulation protection coating on the front edge of the blade, namely a function relation of the volume reduction rate of the thermal insulation protection coating on the front edge of the blade along with the spanwise position and the service time of the blade; according to the volume reduction rate of the thermal insulation protection coating at the front edge of the blade, calibrating a curved surface by using the service life of the thermal insulation protection coating at the front edge of the blade, and calculating to obtain the service time of the thermal insulation protection coating coated at the current time on the front edge of the section where the corresponding spanwise position of the blade is located; the service time of a certain spanwise position of the blade is the sum of the service time of each previous coating of the heat-insulating protective coating on the front edge of the section where the blade is located, and the service life of the blade is the average value of the service time of each spanwise position of the blade. The sensor does not need to be installed on the blade, and the service life of the blade can be obtained.

title_en: Sealing device and fluid valve
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a sealing device for a fluid valve, the sealing device comprising: a separate first sealing element (10) for sealing against a valve housing (100) of the fluid valve; a separate second sealing element (20) for sealing contact against an adjustable, in particular rotatable, valve body (200) of the fluid valve; and a separate, elastically deformable intermediate piece (30) which is arranged in the axial direction between a first wall (12) of the first sealing element (10) facing the second sealing element (20) and a second wall (21) of the second sealing element (20) facing the first sealing element (10) in order to elastically separate the two sealing elements (10, 20), wherein, in at least one axial section of the intermediate piece (30), the intermediate piece (30) has an axial cross section with a first circumferential surface (31) and an opposite second circumferential surface (32), wherein the first circumferential surface (31) is convex and the second circumferential surface (32) is concave, flat or less convex than the first circumferential surface.

title_en: Vent valve assembly, compressor and air conditioner
abstract_en: The application provides an exhaust valve assembly, a compressor and an air conditioner. This exhaust valve subassembly includes flange (1) and exhaust subassembly, flange (1) is provided with disk seat (2), disk seat (2) are provided with exhaust groove (6), the bottom of exhaust groove (6) is provided with gas vent (3), exhaust subassembly sets up on disk seat (2), exhaust subassembly is including valve block (4) that can seal gas vent (3), be provided with exhaust valve gasket (7) in exhaust groove (6), exhaust valve gasket (7) are made by damping material, exhaust valve gasket (7) structure and exhaust groove (6) adaptation, exhaust valve gasket (7) are gone up and are provided with refrigerant circulation hole (5) corresponding gas vent (3), exhaust valve gasket (7) highly flush or be higher than the installation face height that sets up valve block (4) with the installation face height that sets up valve block (4). According to the exhaust valve assembly, the acting force of slapping the valve seat when the valve plate is closed can be effectively reduced, and the noise of the compressor is reduced.

title_en: Method for determining the camshaft position of an internal combustion engine
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for determining a combination of an actual intake camshaft phase (1) of an intake camshaft (2) and an actual exhaust camshaft phase (3) of an exhaust camshaft (4) of a series internal combustion engine (5), which series internal combustion engine (5) has at least one cylinder (6), wherein the method is carried out during operation of the series internal combustion engine (5), the respective actual phases (1, 3) of the camshafts (2, 4) being determined relative to an operating point (7) of the series internal combustion engine (5).

title_en: Design method for middle-stage anti-surge bleeding flow of gas turbine compressor at low rotating speed
abstract_en: The invention aims to provide a design method for the middle-stage anti-surge bleeding flow rate of a gas turbine compressor at low rotating speed, which comprises the following steps: obtaining a characteristic curve of the gas compressor and a stall region position at a surge boundary point at a low rotating speed through three-dimensional CFD calculation, and obtaining a common working line of the gas compressor according to the gas compressor characteristic curve obtained through the three-dimensional CFD calculation; and then determining the deflation operation working condition range and the initial deflation amount of the gas compressor according to the minimum surge margin requirement, determining the interstage deflation position of the gas compressor according to the stall region position, designing different deflation amount schemes according to the determined deflation position and the initial deflation amount, performing three-dimensional CFD calculation on the gas compressor for the different deflation amount schemes, and determining the final deflation amount scheme. The invention can obtain the optimal air bleeding amount of the anti-surge air bleeding of the air compressor at low rotating speed, fully considers the balance between the surge margin promotion and the performance loss of the air compressor, and reduces the influence of the interstage air bleeding on the internal flow of the air compressor to the minimum.

title_en: High-pressure oil pump with pressure stabilizing function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-pressure oil pump with a pressure stabilizing function, which comprises a main body, wherein a pipeline joint is fixedly connected to the upper end of the main body close to the middle position, a pressure regulating valve is fixedly connected to the lower end of the main body close to the middle position, a fixing plate is sleeved on one side of the main body, a plunger is movably connected to one end of the fixing plate, a connecting pipe is fixedly connected to the other end of the main body, a fixing mechanism is arranged on the outer side of the connecting pipe, and the fixing mechanism comprises a cylindrical shell arranged on the outer side of the connecting pipe. According to the high-pressure oil pump with the pressure stabilizing function, the fixing knob is in threaded connection with the cylindrical shell, the stable structure can promote the stability of oil pressure to play a stabilizing role, the pressure instability in the high-pressure oil pump caused by pressure leakage due to deformation can be avoided, and the pressure stabilizing performance of the high-pressure oil pump can be guaranteed.

title_en: Suspension inflator pump
abstract_en: The invention discloses a suspension inflator pump.A pneumatic exhaust valve of the suspension inflator pump comprises an exhaust cover, an exhaust piston, a first spring, a second spring and an exhaust plug, wherein the first spring and the second spring are arranged between the exhaust cover and the exhaust piston, and the first spring is surrounded by the second spring; the exhaust plug is arranged in the exhaust piston, two ends of the second spring are respectively contacted with the exhaust cover and the exhaust piston, and two ends of the first spring are respectively contacted with the exhaust cover and the exhaust plug; the first spring and the second spring are respectively responsible for resetting the corresponding parts, so that the service lives of the first spring and the second spring are prolonged, and the exhaust effect of the exhaust valve is better; the pneumatic exhaust valve of the compressor part of the suspension inflator pump comprises a piston connecting rod and an air inlet valve plate, wherein the air inlet valve plate is arrow-shaped and is connected with the piston connecting rod by a rivet; the air inlet valve plate is arrow-shaped, so that the connection between the air inlet valve plate and the piston connecting rod is firmer and more stable.

title_en: Fan blade state prediction method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for predicting the state of a fan blade, and relates to the technical field of wind power generation. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring actual environment parameters and actual power values of the target fan blades; acquiring an expected power value of a target fan blade based on actual environment parameters; acquiring a power drop index based on the actual power value and the expected power value; acquiring an icing risk index of a target fan blade based on the real-time environmental temperature in the actual environmental parameters; and predicting whether the target fan blade is in an icing state based on the power sag index and the icing risk index. By the method, the prediction of whether the fan blade is in the icing state based on the operation data of the fan blade and the environmental parameters is realized, the accuracy of predicting whether the fan blade is in the icing state is improved, the cost of icing state prediction is reduced, and the icing state prediction method is not limited in use and can be widely applied.

title_en: Submersible pump motor housing for improved accessibility of a submersible pump
abstract_en: A submersible pump, characterized by: a motor; a run/start capacitor; a housing having a motor housing portion and a run/start capacitor housing portion separated by a housing wall, the motor housing portion having a motor housing chamber for immersing the motor in an oil bath, the run/start housing portion having a run/start housing chamber, a connection port allowing a sealed connection between electrical components in the motor housing portion and the run/start capacitor housing portion; a removable motor housing cover for closing the motor housing portion; a removable run/start capacitor case cover to close the run/start capacitor case portion; and a capacitor cup removably disposed in the run/start capacitor housing chamber, the run/start capacitor being contained in the capacitor cup, the capacitor cup having a connection port allowing a sealed connection between the run/start capacitor connector and an electrical component in the motor housing portion for coupling the run/start capacitor to the motor.

title_en: Micro-ocean current generator and production equipment thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a micro-ocean current generator and production equipment thereof, wherein the micro-ocean current generator comprises a shell provided with a cabin, a generator and a driver are movably arranged in the cabin, fixing plates are fixed on the outer walls of the generator and the driver, a first sliding groove is formed in the left and right directions on two opposite inner walls of the shell, the two fixing plates are slidably arranged in the first sliding groove, a first sealing plate for dividing the cabin into a left cavity and a right cavity is also arranged in the cabin, the right side wall of the shell is a second sealing plate, the right end of the shell is fixedly provided with a flange for installing the second sealing plate, the second sealing plate is in sealing connection with the flange of the shell through screws, the first sealing plate and the second sealing plate are arranged in parallel, and a linkage mechanism is arranged on the side wall of the first sealing plate and the second sealing plate.

title_en: Cylindrical prefabricated body, light high-temperature-resistant composite piston and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: A cylindrical preform, light high temperature resistant composite piston and its preparation method, said preparation method comprises, adopt the three-dimensional cylindrical preform that the axial carbon fiber non-woven cloth compound carbon fiber net child pricks, the annular carbon fiber twines compound carbon fiber net child needle pricks continuously, impregnate the densification with carbon-containing resin and/or pitch after heat treating the cylindrical preform, and/or adopt the chemical vapor deposition to densify, and/or adopt and impregnate and combine mode of chemical vapor deposition to densify, form carbon fiber reinforcement carbon matrix composite, in order to open the hole in high temperature heat treatment under inert atmosphere; machining a piston blank from the cylindrical composite material by adopting a machining method; then adopting a melting siliconizing process to densify the piston blank, and processing the piston blank into a final size after the required density is reached; and finally, carrying out heat insulation and anti-oxidation treatment on the top of the piston and the combustion chamber. The piston of the invention has the characteristics of low thermal expansion coefficient, small thermal deformation, low density, high temperature resistance, self lubrication and the like.

title_en: Condensation pump
abstract_en: The invention discloses a condensation pump, which comprises a pump body, an impeller arranged in the pump body and a pump cover connected with the pump body, wherein a liquid inlet is formed in the pump cover, a pump body liquid outlet is formed in the pump body, a backflow control valve is arranged at the liquid outlet of the pump body, a liquid outlet and a backflow port are formed in the backflow control valve, and a backflow assembly is arranged between the backflow port and the liquid inlet. The condensation pump has a backflow function, can delay cavitation and reduce cavitation allowance.

title_en: Combined switch and generator set
abstract_en: The invention discloses a combined switch and a generator set. The combined switch comprises a knob and a mounting seat which are sequentially arranged along the axial direction. The knob comprises a start button and a knob shell which is rotationally sleeved on the start button. The knob shell is rotationally connected to the mounting seat. The mounting seat is provided with a starting switch, a flameout switch, a choke valve switch and an oil switch. The start button is moved axially to trigger the start switch. The oil switch comprises a rotating shaft, the knob shell is sleeved on the rotating shaft, the rotating core is sleeved on the rotating shaft, the knob shell can drive the rotating shaft and the rotating core to synchronously rotate when rotating, and the on-off state of the oil switch is switched through the rotation of the rotating shaft. The rotary core is provided with a flameout trigger key to switch the on-off state of the flameout switch through the rotation of the rotary core. The choke slider of the choke switch is sleeved and fixed on the rotating core, so that the choke slider rotates and the open and close states of the choke switch are switched. The combined switch can realize multiple functions of controlling the oil switch, the air door, the starting and flameout functions, and is convenient to assemble and operate.

title_en: Oil casing head pressurized leakage blocking system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for leaking stoppage of an oil casing head under pressure, wherein the system comprises a liquid leaking stoppage device and a solid leaking stoppage device; the liquid leakage stopping device comprises a high-pressure grease injector, an explosion-proof hydraulic pump station, a hydraulic pipeline, a first stop valve and a first grease injection pipeline; the high-pressure grease injector is connected with the first stop valve through a first grease injection pipeline; the oil inlet and the oil outlet are respectively connected to the explosion-proof hydraulic pump station through a first hydraulic pipeline. The solid leakage stopping device comprises a reciprocating injection molding gun, a second grease injection pipeline and a manual pump; the reciprocating injection molding gun is connected with the manual pump through a second grease injection pipeline. According to the invention, the pressurized grease injection maintenance work of the wellhead gate valve is carried out under the condition that the wellhead is not closed and decompressed, so that the working efficiency is greatly improved. The liquid plugging agent or the solid plugging agent can be selected according to specific conditions in actual production, and the injection molded product has the advantages of high compressive strength, good cementing quality, elasticity, no permeability and small shrinkage after solidification.

title_en: Variable valve device of high-power internal combustion engine
abstract_en: The invention relates to a variable valve device of a high-power internal combustion engine, which comprises: a valve assembly, a rocker arm assembly, a tappet assembly, and an adjustment bevel gear assembly connected to the tappet assembly for adjusting a tappet length; the tappet group comprises a lower tappet, an upper tappet and a loose piece positioned between the upper tappet and the lower tappet, and one end of the loose piece is connected to the lower tappet through threads; the adjustment bevel gear assembly includes a flat bevel gear connected to an outer circumference of the lower tappet and a bevel gear shaft connecting the flat bevel gear to the gear transmission unit; the flat bevel gear drives the lower tappet to rotate so as to adjust the length of the lower tappet screwed into the movable block. The length of the tappet can be reliably adjusted by means of mechanical adjustment of the gear, and the problem of oil leakage of a hydraulic adjusting unit does not exist.

title_en: Thermal insulation assembly of reactor vessel
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a heat preservation assembly of a reactor container, which comprises: the heat insulation layer is arranged outside the reactor vessel; the heat-insulating layer supporting part is loaded on the heat-insulating layer supporting part; and the fixing assembly is connected with the heat-insulating layer supporting part and the outer wall of the reactor vessel and is used for fixing the heat-insulating layer supporting part on the outer wall of the reactor vessel. Under earthquake load, the connecting parts between the heat-insulating layer and the reactor container can keep structural integrity, and the earthquake-resistant effect of the heat-insulating layer is improved.

title_en: Mining air source power generation intelligent equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses mining air source power generation intelligent equipment which comprises a shell, an air motor, a generator and a storage battery, wherein the air motor, the generator and the storage battery are arranged in the shell, an air inlet, an air outlet and a power supply port of the air source are formed in the shell, the air inlet of the air source is communicated with an air inlet hole of the air motor through an air inlet channel, an air outlet hole of the air motor is communicated with the air outlet through an air outlet channel, the air motor is in driving connection with the generator, the generator is connected with the storage battery, the storage battery stores electric energy output by the generator, and the storage battery is connected with the power supply port. The device utilizes the wind power of the existing compressed air source under the mine, drives the generator to do work through the air motor, converts the wind energy into electric energy to be stored in the storage battery, and the air coming out through the air motor can be reused without any waste, does not need to change underground facilities, does not generate any pollution, can solve the unsafe problem brought by the traditional power generation device, and provides safe and reliable power supply for some devices under the mine.

title_en: Rotating device
abstract_en: The invention provides a rotary device capable of realizing miniaturization requirement. The rotating apparatus (1) includes a shaft member (5), a cylindrical rotating body (3) rotatable with respect to the shaft member (5), a cylindrical housing (7) surrounding the rotating body (3), a bearing (4) supporting the rotating body (3) with respect to the shaft member (5), a stator (2) located inside the rotating body (3), and one or more moving blades (6) provided at the rotating body (3).

title_en: Intelligent machine of windowing for fire control
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent window opener for fire fighting, which relates to the technical field of fire fighting and comprises the following components: the combined frame is formed by splicing four groups of strip-shaped plates; the number of the U-shaped frames is two, and the two groups of U-shaped frames are fixedly arranged on the inner walls of the two sides of the combined frame; the U-shaped frame includes: the top of the middle of the U-shaped frame is fixedly provided with two groups of frame blocks, and the middle of the two groups of frame blocks is rotatably provided with a transmission shaft; the window opener of each embodiment of the invention can provide a control mechanism of fault tolerance rate, and can still achieve the window opening effect through one group of electric cylinders even if one group of electric cylinders fails; in addition, still provide and spray the humidification function, can cut off the conflagration and spray for the personnel that pass the window, it is more to have solved the control space that the machine of windowing that uses at present occupies, and the fault-tolerant rate is low, to the low problem of help effect of fire control.

title_en: Motorcycle engine timing synchronization method based on intake manifold
