abstract_en: The invention provides a motorcycle engine timing synchronization method based on an intake manifold, which comprises the following steps: step S1, the engine controller obtains a crankshaft signal acquired by the crankshaft position sensor and obtains a real-time pressure value acquired by the intake manifold pressure sensor in an intake stroke in the working process of the motorcycle engine; step S2, the engine controller obtains the tooth missing position of the crankshaft on the motorcycle engine according to the processing of the crankshaft signal and obtains the pressure minimum value in the intake stroke according to the processing of the real-time pressure value; and step S3, the engine controller obtains the number of teeth of the crankshaft corresponding to the pressure minimum value according to the pressure minimum value, the tooth missing position and the crankshaft signal processing, and obtains the number of turns of the crankshaft according to the number of the teeth of the crankshaft so as to complete timing synchronization. The method has the advantages that the intake manifold of the motorcycle is fully utilized, the camshaft signal sensor is replaced by the intake manifold pressure sensor, the cost is reduced, and the timing synchronization is carried out by combining the elements of the motorcycle.

title_en: Buoyancy water lifting device for water conservancy and hydropower
abstract_en: The invention discloses a buoyancy water lifting device for water conservancy and hydropower, which comprises a floating air bag body, wherein a bearing plate is fixedly connected to the bottom of an inner cavity of the floating air bag body, a buoyancy water lifting mechanism is arranged at the center of the top of the bearing plate, a floating positioning assembly is arranged on the outer side of the buoyancy water lifting mechanism, four corners of the bottom of the bearing plate are fixedly connected with wheel columns, and moving wheels are arranged at the bottoms of the wheel columns; the floating positioning assembly comprises a main power mechanism, driven power mechanisms are arranged at the left end and the right end of the front side of the main power mechanism, the main power mechanism and the driven power mechanisms are located on the upper surface of the bearing plate, and positioning mechanisms are arranged at the front end and the rear end of one side, away from the center of the inner cavity of the bearing plate, of the driven power mechanisms. The invention is convenient for fixing the device in the underwater working area, thereby being beneficial to carrying out buoyancy water lifting work, improving the working efficiency and reducing the influence on the working progress.

title_en: Underground is visited thing and is used muddy water extraction equipment based on energy-efficient motor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-efficiency energy-saving motor-based muddy water extraction device for an underground object, and relates to the technical field of underground detection equipment. The muddy water extraction equipment comprises a muddy water extraction assembly, wherein the muddy water extraction assembly comprises a motor shell, a flange plate, an installation shell and an impeller shell which are sequentially arranged from top to bottom, a stable base is arranged at the bottom of the impeller shell, a plurality of smashing and drilling assemblies are arranged on the periphery of the installation shell, and an efficient energy-saving motor assembly is arranged in an inner cavity of the motor shell; the efficient energy-saving motor assembly comprises an energy-saving motor and a heat conduction cavity, wherein a heat conduction cavity is arranged between the outside of the energy-saving motor and the heat conduction cavity, heat conduction oil is filled in the heat conduction cavity, an air cooling cavity is arranged at the top of the energy-saving motor, and an exhaust fan is arranged in the air cooling cavity. The invention can slow down the vibration and the offset generated by the energy-saving motor, and the combination of two cooling modes of liquid cooling and air cooling promotes the rapid cooling, thereby improving the cooling efficiency, keeping the high-efficiency and low-energy-consumption operation of the energy-saving motor, and ensuring that the mud water extraction process is more stable and has low energy consumption.

title_en: Throttle valve ice breaking method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of vehicles, in particular to a method and a device for ice breaking of a throttle valve, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method is applied to a vehicle engine system, a throttle valve is arranged on a cooling pipeline, and a throttle valve bypass valve is arranged near the throttle valve; an exhaust gas recirculation system connects the turbocharger and the intake manifold, the exhaust gas recirculation system further including a bypass and an EGR bypass valve, the method comprising: judging whether the throttle valve is frozen so that the engine cannot be started; if so, controlling the throttle valve bypass valve to open so that outside air enters the engine through the throttle valve bypass valve and the vehicle enters a limp-home mode; and after the exhaust gas generated by the engine reaches the air inlet manifold through the exhaust gas recirculation system, controlling the EGR bypass valve to be opened when the exhaust temperature of the engine reaches a preset value after the engine is started, so that the heat exhausted by the engine is led to the throttle valve through the branch, ice blocks at the throttle valve are melted, and the purpose of quickly starting the vehicle is achieved.

title_en: Limiter, compressor and refrigeration equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a limiter, a compressor and refrigeration equipment, wherein the compressor comprises an exhaust valve seat and an exhaust valve plate, the exhaust valve seat is provided with an exhaust hole, the exhaust valve plate is used for opening or closing the exhaust hole, the limiter comprises a mounting part and a limiting part, and the mounting part is connected with the exhaust valve seat; the limiting part is connected with the mounting part, extends along the length direction of the limiter and corresponds to the exhaust valve plate so as to limit the exhaust valve plate; the one end that spacing portion kept away from the installation department is equipped with the damping section, the thickness orientation of damping section is kept away from the direction of installation department reduces gradually, makes the damping section thinner and thinner, and the tip of stopper is continuous to be narrowed like this, when spacing portion received the slapping of exhaust valve block, can reduce the vibration response of stopper through the damping section, is favorable to the noise that the suppression produced because of vibration transmission, and the reliability is high, and it is effectual to make an uproar to fall.

title_en: Body suitable for magnetic confinement device divertor and assembly method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a body suitable for a magnetic confinement device divertor and an assembly method thereof. The body comprises a longitudinal beam assembly and a positioning assembly arranged at the end part of the longitudinal beam assembly; the longitudinal beam assembly comprises two longitudinal beams which are arranged in mirror symmetry, an included angle between the two longitudinal beams forms an indexing angle of the divertor target plate, and a gap formed by the included angle between the two longitudinal beams is a particle discharge channel; and each longitudinal beam is provided with a plurality of through holes for installing the communicating pipe below the longitudinal beam. The invention adopts truss configuration, solves the problems well, has simple and reliable structure, can protect the communicating pipe from being corroded by plasma, provides a spacious discharge channel for impurity particles, reduces the resistance for discharging the impurity particles, and greatly improves the comprehensive performance of the divertor.

title_en: Unit start-stop safety management method, device and system
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a device and a system for safely managing the start and stop of a unit, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring actual operation duration corresponding to at least one target operation time period and an alarm value of a designated parameter corresponding to the target operation time period in the target operation process of the unit; calculating a time safety evaluation index value corresponding to the target operation process according to the actual operation duration corresponding to at least one target operation time period; calculating a parameter alarm safety evaluation index value corresponding to the target operation process according to the actual operation time length corresponding to at least one target operation time period and the alarm value of the designated parameter; calculating a system safety evaluation index value corresponding to the target operation process based on the time safety evaluation index value and the designated parameter alarm safety evaluation index value; and displaying various time, various parameter alarm values and various evaluation index values involved in the target operation process so as to enable working personnel to maintain the unit. The safety of the unit starting and stopping process can be improved.

title_en: Cascade type static hydrogen pressurization system and method based on hydrogen storage material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascade type static hydrogen pressurization system and a pressurization method based on hydrogen storage materials. The pressurizing system comprises a plurality of stages of static hydrogen pressurizing devices which are connected in series, wherein an air inlet valve is arranged on an air inlet pipeline of the first stage of static hydrogen pressurizing device, an air outlet valve is arranged on an air outlet pipeline of the last stage of static hydrogen pressurizing device, and connecting valves are arranged on gas pipelines which are connected with adjacent static hydrogen pressurizing devices; the outer side of each static hydrogen supercharging device is wound with a heat exchange coil, and the inner part of each static hydrogen supercharging device is provided with a hydrogen storage material; for the hydrogen storage material in any stage of static hydrogen supercharging device, the low-temperature hydrogen absorption pressure is lower than the high-temperature hydrogen release pressure of the hydrogen storage material in the previous stage of static hydrogen supercharging device, and the high-temperature hydrogen release pressure is higher than the low-temperature hydrogen absorption pressure of the hydrogen storage material in the next stage of static hydrogen supercharging device. The invention controls the working temperature of each stage of hydrogen supercharging device through the circulation of heat transfer liquid, and performs low-temperature low-pressure hydrogen absorption and high-temperature high-pressure hydrogen release step by step to finally obtain the required high-pressure hydrogen.

title_en: Wind pressure formula shutter and use scavenger fan of this shutter
abstract_en: A wind pressure type shutter and a ventilation fan using the shutter are provided. The wind pressure formula shutter includes wind gap and hides the venetian blind who separates this wind gap: the plurality of groups of hinges are positioned on a plurality of horizontal lines distributed on the air port from top to bottom, and the corresponding number of integrated sheet-shaped window leaves are opened or closed around the hinge positioned on one of the horizontal lines; the thickness of the lamellae of each louver above its hinge axis is greater than the thickness of the lamellae of each louver below its hinge axis when the venetian blind is in the closed position. The wind pressure type louver can obtain a larger opening angle, and thus reduce wind resistance and noise.

title_en: Wind guide ring structure beneficial to reducing rotation order noise and arrangement method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an air guide ring structure beneficial to reducing rotation order noise and a setting method thereof, wherein the air guide ring structure is arranged at an air outlet of a fan cover, the air outlet of the fan cover comprises an air guide ring, a plurality of bosses which are arranged around the circumference are arranged on the air guide ring, the upper part of any one boss is connected with a check ring of the air outlet of the fan cover through a reinforcing rib, an open slot with an upward opening is arranged on the air guide ring between any two adjacent bosses, and at least one air guide blade is arranged in the open slot; one end and the bottom surface of the air guide blade are connected with the open slot close to the air guide blade into a whole, and a first space is reserved between the other end of the air guide blade and the open slot close to the air guide blade. The invention adopts the structure that the plurality of open slots are arranged on the wind guide ring, and the specific position, angle and height of the wind guide blade to be added on the wind guide ring are analyzed according to the design blade profile of the existing wind blade and the combination of the flow field analysis and the sound field distribution of the noise test, so that the application range is wide; the insert is added on the basis of the existing die to produce the guide blade, so that the die does not need to be re-opened, and the production cost is reduced.

title_en: Oil supply atomizing device, combustion chamber device and miniature jet engine
abstract_en: The invention discloses an oil supply atomization device, a combustion chamber device and a miniature jet engine, which comprises an oil supply ring, a combustion chamber device and a miniature jet engine, wherein the oil supply ring is connected with an oil supply main pipe; the evaporation tube comprises a preheating part and an evaporation part, one end of the preheating part is connected with the oil supply ring, the other end of the preheating part is connected with the evaporation part, and the periphery of the preheating part is coated with a heat conducting piece. During operation, the fuel supply main pipe supplies fuel to the fuel supply ring, the fuel enters the evaporation pipe from the fuel supply ring, the fuel firstly enters the preheating part, the heat conduction piece can quickly transfer the heat in the combustion chamber to the fuel entering the preheating part, the fuel enters the evaporation part after being quickly preheated, the fuel is further transferred by the evaporation part and then sprayed out, the fuel is fully preheated before entering the combustion chamber, the fuel is fully evaporated, atomized fuel hot steam with uniform distribution is formed, the atomization degree of the fuel is high, the combustion is more full and stable, stall is not easy to occur in the combustion chamber, surge, air stopping and other conditions are not easy to occur in the miniature jet engine.

title_en: Floating wind turbine comprising an integrated substation
abstract_en: The present invention relates to wind turbines comprising integrated substations, and floating offshore wind farms, which are optimized with respect to investment costs, economic efficiency and installation space requirements.

title_en: Beta radiation volt effect device
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to an apparatus for generating electrical energy, a method for generating electrical energy, a product for use in an apparatus for generating electrical energy, and a method for producing an apparatus for generating electrical energy. In certain embodiments. The present disclosure provides an electric energy generating apparatus. The device includes at least one cell comprising spaced first and second electrodes, the first electrode comprising a low work function material and the second electrode comprising a high work function material, and a semiconductor material and a beta particle emitting radionuclide disposed between the first and second electrodes, the semiconductor material capable of generating electron hole pairs in response to beta particle emission from the radionuclide.

title_en: Structure of full-variable air distribution device
abstract_en: The invention aims to provide a structure of a fully variable valve actuating device, which comprises a cam shaft, a rocker, a push rod and an air valve, wherein an air inlet cam and an air outlet cam are arranged on the cam shaft, the air inlet cam is matched with a roller at the front side rod end of the rocker, the air outlet cam is matched with a roller at the rear side rod end of the rocker, the rocker rotates around a first pin fixed on a cylinder body, one end of the push rod is connected with the rocker through a pin, the other end of the push rod is connected with an upper rocker and a lower rocker through a pin, the upper rocker and the lower rocker rotate around a second pin fixed on the cylinder, one sides of the upper rocker and the lower rocker are provided with an air valve sleeve, and the air valve sleeve is fixed at the top end of the air valve. The invention is provided with the energy storage spring device, can provide proper damping effect in the opening process of the air valve, reduces the influence of gravity inertia on the movement of the air valve, simultaneously releases elastic potential energy stored in the opening process of the air valve when the air valve is closed, facilitates the closing of the air valve, promotes the reversing of the driving device, and accelerates the speed of switching the air distribution working condition.

title_en: Wet helium gas circulating water and electricity cogeneration system based on solar drive and working method
abstract_en: A wet helium gas circulating water and electricity cogeneration system based on solar drive and a working method belong to the field of humidification turbine circulation and solar energy utilization. The system comprises a low-pressure compressor, a high-pressure compressor, a solar thermal collector, a heater, a heat storage tank, a turbine, a generator, a main shaft, an intercooler, an economizer, a condensate tank, a crystallizing tank, a saturator, a heat regenerator, a water pump, an air pump and a central clapboard. The solar energy is used as main supply energy of the system, so that the combustion process is avoided, the generation and discharge of pollutants are greatly reduced, and fresh water and crystals are obtained by processing seawater, thereby meeting the strategic requirements of national energy conservation and emission reduction and water resource sustainable development.

title_en: High-frequency noise elimination method and device and vector control system
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a method and a device for eliminating high-frequency noise and a vector control system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a target current spectrogram to be identified; identifying target higher harmonics generated in the running process of the compressor based on the target current spectrogram; and eliminating high-frequency noise generated in the operation process of the compressor in response to recognizing the existence of the target higher harmonic, wherein the high-frequency noise is generated by resonance of the compressor caused when the operation frequency of a current loop of the compressor is coupled with the vibration frequency of the compressor. In this disclosure, the elimination of high-frequency noise is realized through the adjustment to the operating frequency of current loop, has reduced the elimination degree of difficulty of high-frequency noise, does not rely on other silencing equipment, has reduced the elimination cost of high-frequency noise, has optimized the elimination effect of high-frequency noise.

title_en: Manual water pump
abstract_en: The invention relates to a water pump, in particular to a manual water pump, which solves the problem that the market lacks a manual water pump with small volume, fast water production and large pressure, and comprises a chamber, wherein a piston is arranged in the chamber, the lower part of the chamber is a water inlet channel, the side wall of the chamber is provided with a water outlet channel, the top of the piston is provided with a handle for lifting and pressing the piston, the water inlet channel is internally provided with a water permeable disc and a first valve core, the water outlet channel is provided with a one-way valve, the one-way valve comprises a valve body and a second valve core, the valve body is internally provided with a first step surface for supporting the front end surface of the second valve core, the rear end of the front end surface of the second valve core is sequentially provided with a second step surface and a third step surface, the annular wall between the second step surface and the third step surface is uniformly provided with a plurality of water outlet holes, the rear end surface of the second valve core is in an open shape and is provided with a spring, the manual water pump has small volume, energy conservation, environmental protection and convenient carrying.

title_en: Control system and control method of air compressor unit
abstract_en: The application discloses control system and control method of air compressor unit relates to automatic control technical field to solve the relatively poor problem of reliability that adopts DCS system control air compressor unit among the correlation technique, control system includes: the system comprises an air compressor unit, a distributed control module and a local control module; the air compressor unit is respectively connected with the decentralized control module and the local control module; under the normal state of the decentralized control module, the decentralized control module is used for controlling the air compressor unit; and under the fault state of the distributed control module, the local control module is used for controlling the air compressor unit.

title_en: Blade adjusting and hoisting device for wind driven generator
abstract_en: A blade adjustment lifting device for a wind driven generator comprises two blade clamps and a tower top support, wherein the two blade clamps are connected through a fixed rod, an external gear disc is movably connected to the fixed rod, an internal gear ring is arranged on the outer surface of the external gear disc along the edge position, an external gear is arranged on the external gear disc in a deviating axis mode, the external gear ring of the external gear is meshed with the internal gear ring of the external gear disc, a central shaft of the external gear is in transmission connection with a driving end of a rotating motor, the rotating motor is installed on the fixed rod through an installation frame, a movable guide rail is installed on the upper surface of the tower top support, a sliding block is slidably connected in the movable guide rail, a telescopic motor is fixedly installed at the end portion of the movable guide rail, a telescopic end of the telescopic motor is fixedly connected with one sliding block, a lifting machine is fixedly installed on the sliding block, and the driving end of the lifting machine is connected to the external gear disc through a steel wire rope. The invention overcomes the defects of the prior art, does not need large hoisting equipment in the whole process, and greatly saves the replacement cost of the blade.

title_en: A kind of compressor
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of compressors, in particular to a compressor which comprises a motor, a motor connecting gear, a gear meshed rotary column, at least one first connecting pipe and at least one second connecting pipe, wherein the left end of the rotary column is connected with the first connecting pipe and the second connecting pipe in a sliding manner; a first air pumping chamber and a second air pumping chamber which correspond to the first connecting pipe and the second connecting pipe in quantity and are communicated with each other are arranged in the inner air pumping cylinder, pistons are connected in the first air pumping chamber and the second air pumping chamber in a sliding and sealing mode, and the pistons are respectively connected with the first connecting pipe and the second connecting pipe in a sealing mode; the bottom ends of the first air extracting chamber and the second air extracting chamber are respectively provided with a first one-way valve, and the centers of the two pistons are respectively provided with a second one-way valve; the first one-way valve and the second one-way valve are open to the same. The bending angles of the first connecting pipe and the second connecting pipe can be changed according to different application scenes, and the invention is more convenient and flexible to apply.

title_en: Fuel metering valve with movable iron core capable of rotating automatically
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electromagnetic valves, and discloses a fuel metering valve with a movable iron core capable of rotating automatically, which comprises an equipment shell, and further comprises a driving motor, a machining cutter, a speed sensing assembly, a liquid supply pipeline and an adjusting assembly, wherein the driving motor is fixedly connected to the front surface of the equipment shell, the machining cutter is fixedly connected to the front surface of the driving motor, the speed sensing assembly is fixedly connected to the inside of the machining cutter and used for sensing the speed change of the machining cutter, the liquid supply pipeline is fixedly connected to the inside of the equipment shell, and the adjusting assembly is fixedly connected to the inside of the liquid supply pipeline and used for adjusting the liquid outlet rate of cutting liquid of the liquid supply pipeline. This but movable iron core autogyration's fuel metering valve, the heating wire temperature is higher for thermistor's resistance is lower, thereby makes the shortening volume behind the circular telegram of electrostriction axle big more, thereby makes the exposure bore of drain tank big more, and the play liquid volume of cutting fluid is big more this moment, has improved cooling and lubricated effect, further improves the processing quality.

title_en: Device for disinfecting air by electromagnetic radiation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a device for disinfecting air with electromagnetic radiation, comprising: a radiant chamber through which air can flow along a flow path from an inlet side to an outlet side; at least one radiation source designed to generate electromagnetic radiation in the microwave range and to emit electromagnetic radiation into the radiation chamber in order to apply the electromagnetic radiation to the air flowing through the radiation chamber, wherein the device further has at least one ventilator with an impeller designed to suck air in at the air inlet side, to convey the air along the flow path through the radiation chamber to the air outlet side, and to blow the air out of the radiation chamber at the air outlet side, wherein at least the impeller is arranged in the radiation chamber and the impeller has a plurality of blades which are formed at least in part by a material capable of deflecting electromagnetic radiation.

title_en: Helium xenon cooling reactor, reactivity control evaluation method, device and equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a helium xenon cooling reactor, a reactivity control evaluation method, a device and equipment, wherein the helium xenon cooling reactor comprises a reactor core and a drawing type reflecting layer; the drawable reflecting layer comprises a plurality of drawable reflecting blocks, wherein the drawable reflecting blocks are arranged on the outer side of the reactor core along the axial direction of the reactor core, and at least one drawable reflecting block can move along the axial direction of the reactor core so as to change the reflecting effect of the drawable reflecting layer. The embodiment of the application adopts the drawing type reflecting layer which can move along the axial direction of the reactor core, so that on one hand, the control drum with a relatively complex structure and a driving mechanism thereof are reduced, the manufacturing cost and the occupied space are saved, and on the other hand, the drawing type reflecting layer is relatively compact and convenient in drawing type design, simple and convenient to control, the hidden trouble of the drum falling, the clamping drum and the like are avoided, the control mode is safer and more efficient, and the differential value of the reflecting layer is more beneficial to optimization and promotion.

title_en: Intelligent distribution immersion type multistage centrifugal pump
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent distribution immersion type multistage centrifugal pump, which relates to the technical field of immersion type multistage centrifugal pumps and is characterized in that a fluid acquisition module, a fluid operation module, a deflection angle simulation module, an element execution module, a micro-pressure regulation and control assembly and a micro-pressure locking assembly are arranged to realize acquisition, calculation and processing of hydraulic pressure, liquid speed and liquid level of each pipeline of circulating liquid, so that a fluid attenuation control signal is generated and the micro-pressure regulation and control assembly and the micro-pressure locking assembly are controlled to work, the pipeline fluid is automatically processed in the circulating liquid to enable the time to be in a constant state, the equipment is more intelligent and convenient in use, and the problem that the traditional equipment cannot intelligently cope with fluid attenuation in a remote transportation process is solved.

title_en: Liquid storage tank
abstract_en: A liquid storage tank includes a tank body for storing a coolant, an inflow pipe for feeding the coolant into the tank body, a discharge pipe for discharging the coolant from the tank body, and a columnar member provided upright in the tank body, the inflow pipe being connected to the tank body at a position lower than a liquid surface of the coolant stored in the tank body in a vertical direction, and the columnar member extending in a substantially vertical direction as viewed along a center line of the inflow pipe, and a part of the columnar member being disposed on an extension line of the center line of the inflow pipe.

title_en: Cylinder cover assembly and assembly method thereof, and thermodynamic single cylinder engine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cylinder cover assembly, an assembly method thereof and a thermodynamic single cylinder machine, and solves the technical problems that the conventional single cylinder machine is high in test cost, only suitable for development of a new machine type and not suitable for technical upgrading of a mass-production machine type. The cylinder head assembly provided by the invention comprises a cylinder head and a cover plate, wherein the cylinder head has all functional structures of an engine cylinder head. The cylinder head and the cover plate are arranged side by side along the cylinder arrangement direction of the cylinder block, and the cover plate is used for sealing other cylinders of the cylinder block of the multi-cylinder engine. Therefore, after the cylinder cover is assembled with a cylinder body of a mass-production multi-cylinder engine, a novel engine system can be obtained, the formed thermodynamic single-cylinder engine has the advantages of rapidness, low cost, easiness in adjustment and the like of the thermodynamic single-cylinder engine, the existing prototype boundary and the test tool of the mass-production multi-cylinder engine can be utilized, and the optimal technical effects of the aspects of cost, period, test effect and the like are finally achieved.

title_en: Amortization fan
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an amortization fan relates to ventilation equipment's field, its include the casing and install in impeller in the casing, the casing is provided with the air outlet, the casing along the lateral wall of impeller rotation direction is provided with two slides, the casing is in two be provided with between the slide and inhale the cotton layer of sound, the slide lateral wall is provided with a plurality of restrictions that are used for inhale the hold-down mechanism on the cotton layer of sound, the casing in air outlet department is provided with and is used for changing inhale the feed mechanism on the cotton layer of sound. This application has the effect of making an uproar of realizing falling of fan, is convenient for simultaneously change and inhales the cotton layer of sound, ensures that the fan falls the normal clear of the work of making an uproar, promotes the feature of environmental protection of fan greatly.

title_en: Pump prying system and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a pump prying system, which is arranged on a cylinder foundation in contact with the ground and used for pumping water in the cylinder foundation out or pumping water into the cylinder foundation, and comprises: the mixing device comprises a steel pipe, a mixing chamber and a mixing device, wherein the steel pipe is hollow, two ends of the steel pipe are open, a first fluid channel is formed in the steel pipe, one opening of the steel pipe is communicated with a cylinder foundation, the other end of the steel pipe is communicated with the mixing device, an inlet and an outlet are formed in the mixing chamber, and the inlet is positioned at the bottom of the mixing chamber and communicated with the steel pipe; the water pump comprises a water inlet flow path and a water outlet flow path, one end of the water inlet flow path is communicated with one end of the water outlet flow path in a gathering mode and is communicated with an outlet of the mixing cavity, the other end of the water inlet flow path is provided with a water inlet, the other end of the water outlet flow path is provided with a water outlet, and the water inlet flow path and the water outlet flow path are provided with a plurality of valve bodies and pump bodies so as to supply water to a cylinder foundation or pump out water in the cylinder foundation.

title_en: High-efficient intelligent air compressor machine detection auxiliary assembly that leaks
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of pipeline maintenance, in particular to a high-efficiency intelligent air compressor water leakage detection auxiliary device which comprises an air pump body, wherein a digital display pressure controller for controlling air pressure, a relay for controlling a circuit of the digital display pressure controller and a remote control receiver for remotely controlling the start and stop of the air pump body are arranged on the air pump body, a tee joint is communicated with an air outlet pipe of the air pump body, and a pressure sensor probe and a second air pipe are respectively communicated with the tee joint. The automatic circulation device can automatically circulate from 0 kg of low pressure to 13 kg of high pressure in any interval, but needs to pump 13 kg of high pressure to 17 kg when detecting an iron pipe or a micro-leakage, and needs to press the pressure release valve by hand to carry out a high-pressure working state.

title_en: Composite dehumidifier
abstract_en: The invention provides a composite dehumidifier. The composite dehumidifier comprises a generator set, a dehumidification unit and at least comprises a refrigeration dehumidifier, a solution dehumidification component and a rotating wheel dehumidification component, wherein the generator set is provided with a generator body and a generator cooling circulation system, the generator body is used for generating electricity and generating smoke and heat, the heat heats the generator cooling circulation system, the smoke emitted by the generator body enters the heat recovery device through an air inlet pipeline, the heat recovery device outputs steam and hot air through an exhaust pipeline, the generator set is electrically connected with the dehumidification unit, the heated generator cooling circulation system transmits heat to a regeneration solution of the solution dehumidification component, and the steam and the hot air transmit heat to fresh air of the rotating wheel dehumidification component. The composite dehumidifier provided by the invention can solve the problems of high energy consumption, low dehumidification efficiency, inconvenient operation and incapability of cascade utilization of energy sources in the dehumidification device in the prior art.

title_en: Filter element, air cleaner assembly, and methods of use and assembly
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a filter cartridge comprising: a filter media having a pleated media disposed about a central open space extending from a first end to a second end; and a first end cap and a second end cap. The first end of the filter media extends into the first end cap and the second end of the filter media extends into the second end cap. The first end cap includes an inner surface forming an opening through the first end cap, wherein the filter cartridge includes a central axis extending through the central open space, the second end cap, and the opening in the first end cap. The inner surface includes a sealing surface configured to form a seal against the air cleaner sealing surface. The inner surface includes a plurality of outwardly projecting and axially extending portions and a plurality of inwardly projecting and axially extending portions. The sealing surface includes greater than 20 radially outwardly projecting and axially extending portions alternating with greater than 20 radially inwardly projecting and axially extending portions.

title_en: Intake air heating control method and device, electronic equipment and computer storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a control method and device for intake air heating, electronic equipment and a computer storage medium, wherein the control method for intake air heating comprises the following steps: firstly, judging whether a first control condition is met currently or not according to the water temperature, the ambient temperature, the engine oil temperature and the working temperature of the heating grid; then, if the current state of the starter relay is judged to meet the first control condition, the current state of the starter relay is determined; if the current state of the starter relay is a closed state, judging whether a second control condition is met currently according to the air inlet temperature and the air inlet pressure; and if the current second control condition is met, controlling the heating grid relay to be opened. Therefore, the purposes of avoiding the electric quantity loss caused by the simultaneous work of the starter and the heating grid, improving the air inlet temperature in the starting process and improving the starting performance are achieved.

title_en: Energy-saving high-pressure pneumatic diaphragm pump
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of diaphragm pumps, in particular to an energy-saving high-pressure pneumatic diaphragm pump which comprises an air inlet component, a first loose joint hose, a boosting module, a connecting tee joint, a second loose joint hose, an L-shaped supporting plate and a diaphragm pump body, wherein the boosting module is integrated on the diaphragm pump body through the L-shaped supporting plate and a corresponding pipeline, so that the high-pressure conveying distance is shortened, the loss is reduced, the energy-saving high-pressure pneumatic diaphragm pump has the advantages of simple structure, small volume and high pneumatic efficiency, is driven by a cylinder in the boosting module, and automatically switches high and low air sources through piston movement, integrates the double functions of a common isobaric diaphragm pump and a boosting diaphragm pump, and the output pressure can be regulated and controlled through a back pressure valve, so that the technical problem that the boosting diaphragm pump cannot realize direct pumping of materials by primary pressure in the diaphragm pump in the existing diaphragm pump in the filter pressing industry is solved.

title_en: Scroll compressor shafting lubricating structure, scroll compressor and air conditioner
abstract_en: The invention provides a scroll compressor shafting lubricating structure, a scroll compressor and an air conditioner, wherein the scroll compressor shafting lubricating structure comprises a crankshaft, a movable scroll and an upper bracket, wherein the movable scroll is provided with a movable disk bearing seat, a crankshaft eccentric part arranged on the crankshaft is rotatably inserted in the movable disk bearing seat, a sleeve matching hole is formed in the upper bracket, the scroll compressor shafting lubricating structure further comprises a balance sleeve which is provided with an inner hole and an outer circle, the movable disk bearing seat is rotatably inserted in the inner hole, the balance sleeve is rotatably inserted in the sleeve matching hole, the circle center of the outer circle coincides with the rotation center of the crankshaft, the circle center of the inner hole does not coincide with the circle center of the outer circle, and a first lubricating flow path is arranged between a sleeve trimming and the sleeve matching hole. According to the invention, the weight of the balance weight is smaller, so that the deformation of the crankshaft is reduced, and the vibration and noise of the compressor are reduced; the friction pair of the pump body can be fully lubricated.

title_en: Fuel filter exhaust structure, fuel filter and engine oil supply system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of vehicles and discloses a fuel filter exhaust structure, a fuel filter and an engine oil supply system. The fuel filter exhaust structure provided by the invention is provided with the gas guide channel and the vent pipe, and the gas in the top gas cavity is sent to the oil outlet channel through the gas guide channel through the vent pipe. In the working process of the fuel oil filter, the gas in the top gas cavity contains oil mist, so that the gaseous fuel oil in the gas in the top gas cavity can be recycled, and the fuel oil waste, air pollution and the like caused by directly discharging the gas in the top gas cavity into the atmosphere can be avoided. The upper end of the gas guide channel is higher than the top wall of the filter element, the fuel filter is inclined or blocked, the probability that fuel in the oil cavity before filtration and fuel in the oil cavity after filtration flee with each other through the top gas cavity can be reduced, and the filtering effect of the fuel filter is ensured.

title_en: Correcting blade pitch in wind turbines
abstract_en: A method (40) of correcting blade pitch in a wind turbine (10) having a tower (12) and a plurality of rotor blades (18) is provided. The method (40) comprises receiving (410) sensor output data from one or more wind turbine sensors (141), the sensor output data comprising data indicative of tower (12) excitations for a plurality of different pitch angles of a particular one of the blades (18), determining (420) a corrected pitch reference of the particular blade (18), the corrected pitch reference corresponding to a minimum tower excitation based on the received sensor output data, and transmitting (430) the corrected pitch reference to a pitch actuator system (24) of the particular blade (18).

title_en: Novel variable circulation turboshaft engine structure
abstract_en: The application discloses a novel variable-circulation turboshaft engine structure, which comprises an engine outer casing, wherein a core engine, an outer duct, a power rotor and a geometric adjustable mechanism are arranged in the engine outer casing; the air flow enters the outer casing from the air inlet, the fan rotor and the fan guide vane divide the air flow into an inner air flow and an outer air flow, the first air flow continuously passes through the core machine, the second air flow passes through the outer duct, the geometric adjustable mechanism is used for mixing the second air flow with the first air flow, the geometric adjustable mechanism can adjust the flow area of the mixed air flow, the mixed air flow flows to the power turbine guide vane, so that the power turbine rotor is driven to do work, and finally the air flow is discharged from the exhaust frame; a transmission device for outputting power is connected to the power turbine rotor.

title_en: Mine ventilation structure capable of effectively controlling air flow
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mine ventilation structure, in particular to a mine ventilation structure capable of effectively controlling air flow, which comprises a first trapezoidal support frame, a second trapezoidal support frame, a filtering support frame, a ventilation three-way pipe and the like; the first trapezoidal support frame and the second trapezoidal support frame are fixedly installed on the mine installation structure, the second trapezoidal support frame is provided with a filtering support frame, and the first trapezoidal support frame is fixedly provided with a ventilation three-way pipe. The input air flow is filtered through the filter screen barrel, and then the filtered fresh air is conveyed into the mine, so that the oxygen concentration in the mine can be increased and supplied to underground workers for use, and toxic and harmful gases and dust in the mine can be diluted and removed.

title_en: Internal combustion engine, exhaust system and method for operating an internal combustion engine
abstract_en: The invention relates to an internal combustion engine (100), an exhaust system (101) and a method for operating an internal combustion engine (100). The internal combustion engine (100) has at least one cylinder (1). The internal combustion engine (100) comprises an intake system (3) and an exhaust system (101). The exhaust system (101) comprises an exhaust gas receiver (4) connected to the cylinder (1) via an exhaust port (25) for discharging exhaust gas from the cylinder (1), and an exhaust gas treatment unit (5) comprising at least one exhaust gas cooler (6) and comprising a conduit system (7) for guiding a cooling medium, such as water. The exhaust system (101) comprises at least one heat exchanger (11 a,11 b), the at least one heat exchanger (11 a,11 b) comprising a first fluid line (12 a,12 b) fluidly or fluidly connectable to the conduit system (7) and being configured to receive the cooling medium from the at least one exhaust cooler (6).

title_en: Thermostat shell assembly
abstract_en: The invention discloses a thermostat shell assembly, belongs to the field of thermostats, and solves the problem that the connection strength of a manifold of an existing thermostat shell is not enough. It includes temperature saver seat and temperature saver lid, temperature saver seat and temperature saver lid between be connected through first fastening bolt, just temperature saver seat and temperature saver lid between be equipped with first sealing washer, the temperature saver seat on keep away from the one end of temperature saver lid and seted up the water inlet, inlay on the outlying temperature saver seat of water inlet and be equipped with the second sealing washer, temperature saver seat lateral wall is equipped with the installation boss, the installation boss on install the manifold flange board through second fastening bolt, be equipped with first manifold and second manifold on the manifold flange board, first manifold and second manifold all communicate with temperature saver seat, manifold flange board and installation boss between be equipped with the third sealing washer. The thermostat shell assembly provided by the invention has the advantages that the connection strength is effectively improved, the thermostat shell is ensured not to lose efficacy in a service period, and meanwhile, the thermostat shell assembly is more convenient to disassemble, assemble and maintain.

title_en: Scroll compressor including lubrication system provided with oil agitating device
abstract_en: A scroll compressor (1) is provided with: a fixed scroll (7); an orbiting scroll (8); a support means (5) comprising a thrust bearing surface (9) on which the orbiting scroll is slidably mounted; an anti-rotation device configured to prevent rotation of the orbiting scroll relative to the fixed scroll and comprising orbiting plates (28) each rotatably mounted in a circular receiving cavity (29) on the support means, each of the orbiting plates being provided with an outer circumferential bearing surface (31) configured to cooperate with an inner circumferential bearing surface (32) on the respective circular receiving cavity; and a lubrication system configured to lubricate the inner and outer circumferential bearing surfaces using oil supplied from an oil sump (36); the lubrication system includes oil reservoirs (43), each of which is disposed in a bottom surface of the corresponding circular receiving chamber, and oil agitating devices, each of which is configured to agitate oil contained in the corresponding oil reservoir.

title_en: Centrifugal urea pump
abstract_en: The invention discloses a centrifugal urea pump, which relates to the technical field of urea filling pumps and comprises a pump shell and a fixed shell, wherein a partition plate is arranged in the pump shell, the inner space of the pump shell is divided into a containing cavity and a liquid inlet cavity by the partition plate, a liquid inlet and a liquid outlet are arranged on the pump shell, a driving mechanism is arranged in the fixed shell, the driving mechanism comprises a rotary driving assembly, a fixed driving assembly and a driving shaft, a shifting adjusting assembly and a fixed assembly are arranged at one end of the driving shaft, a first impeller and a second impeller are arranged on the shifting assembly, a shell cover is arranged in the containing cavity, the shell cover is respectively and fixedly connected with the partition plate and the pump shell, a connecting port is arranged on one side of the shell cover, a first mounting cavity, a second mounting cavity and a buffer cavity are arranged in the shell cover, a connecting pipe is arranged outside the shell cover, and a through hole is arranged on the shell cover. The invention can carry out fine adjustment according to the stress conditions of the first impeller and the second impeller, prolongs the service life of the equipment, and is fixed through the fixing component after fine adjustment, thereby further prolonging the service life of the equipment.

title_en: Multifunctional fan blade linkage mechanism
abstract_en: The invention provides a multifunctional fan blade linkage mechanism, which is characterized by comprising: the fan blade invisible unit and the air ring control unit; compared with the prior art, the fan blade invisible unit has the advantages that due to the adoption of the modular combination design, the fan blade invisible overall decoration effect is good, and due to the arrangement of the air ring control unit, the unfolding angle of the fan is controllable, so that the fan blade invisible unit is suitable for spaces with different sizes, and blowing is more targeted; because the fan blade buffer is arranged, each wind ring can create vivid natural wind under different wind speeds; due to the arrangement of the intelligent control system, short-range control can be realized through a remote controller or a voice password, remote control can be realized through a mobile phone APP, and automatic control can be realized through a detector; the multifunctional fan lamp manufactured by the multifunctional fan blade linkage mechanism has the advantages of strong function, simple manufacture and wide application range.

title_en: Turbine lubricating oil return oil filtering system and using method
abstract_en: A turbine lube oil return filtration system comprising: the oil tank comprises an oil return area, a middle area and an oil suction area; the oil return area is separated from the middle area by a first partition plate assembly; the first partition plate assembly is provided with a first vertical filter screen plate for carrying out first filtration on the lubricating oil of the steam turbine; the middle area and the oil absorption area are separated by a second clapboard component; the second vertical filter screen plate is arranged on the second partition plate assembly to carry out secondary filtration on the lubricating oil of the steam turbine; and the top of the oil tank is also provided with a liquid level difference meter for monitoring the liquid levels of the three regions. The turbine lubricating oil return oil filtering system disclosed by the invention not only can be used for filtering turbine lubricating oil twice, but also can be used for realizing online replacement of the filter screen, improving the working efficiency, monitoring whether the filter screen is blocked in real time and sending an alarm signal to a remote monitoring end.

title_en: Novel NbHfZrU series uranium-containing high-entropy alloy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Nb-Hf-Zr-U system structure function-based integrated high-entropy alloy containing uranium and capable of being used as nuclear fuel, which belongs to the field of high-entropy alloy materials, and comprises the following components in atomic percentage: niobium: 15-60%; zirconium: 10-35%; hafnium: 10-35 percent; uranium: 15-50%; aluminum: 0.01-10%, and the balance of chromium and inevitable impurities. Aiming at the bottleneck problems that the traditional metal type fuel with poor radiation resistance performance such as alloys of UZr, UAl and the like is easy to change phase at high temperature, is easy to generate radiation damage after a reactor irradiates for a long time, and radiation swelling caused by fission products, and the like, and other researches do not pay full attention to the research on U, Hf-containing high-entropy alloy fuel, the invention provides the high-entropy alloy based on the Nb-Hf-Zr-U system, and fully considers the special action of U, Hf elements, thereby realizing the structural function integration of the high-entropy alloy.

title_en: Stirling engine cooler and characteristic test bed thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Stirling engine cooler and a characteristic test bed thereof, relates to the technical field of Stirling engine coolers, and aims to solve the problems that the existing cooler has a low heat transfer coefficient, a small heat exchange area and a small heat transfer temperature difference due to a simple heat transfer process through a flat wall when heat is transferred to a cold fluid through a cylindrical wall. The utility model discloses a cooler, including cooler body, installation piece, installation channel, installation piece, lower installation piece, cooler upper cover, cooler body's intermediate position department is provided with the cooler shell, and the cooler shell is provided with two, and is adjacent be provided with cold fluid between the cooler shell, the inside that cold fluid imported and exported is provided with the capillary, and the capillary is provided with three hundred seventy six, installation piece and lower installation piece are installed respectively to the upper and lower both ends of cooler body, the outer wall of going up the installation piece and installing the piece down all is provided with the installation passageway, the one end that capillary was kept away from to last installation piece and lower installation piece is provided with mounting groove, upper end the top of mounting groove is provided with the cooler upper cover.

title_en: Integrated internal spiral hollow screw rotor
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of vacuum oilless screw pumps, in particular to an integrated inner spiral hollow screw rotor. Comprises a rotating shaft and a helical blade arranged on the rotating shaft; a central hole is arranged on the rotating shaft along the axis direction; the helical blade is of a hollow structure and is communicated with the central hole through a helical groove on the surface of the rotating shaft; the central hole of the rotating shaft and the hollow structure of the helical blade integrally meet the static balance of any section, the mass center of the helical blade is positioned on the central axis of the rotating shaft, and the non-uniform design of the closed end surface enables the screw rotor integrally to meet the dynamic balance requirement on the basis of the static balance. Because of the internal spiral hollow structure, the invention has lighter weight, lower energy consumption, higher dynamic balance performance, stronger vibration resistance and smaller noise; because the hollow structure of the inner spiral can be filled with medium gas, the hollow structure has good heat dissipation performance, reduces the thermal deformation of the rotor, enhances the fatigue resistance and prolongs the service life.

title_en: Fuel rail for a fuel injection system of a combustion engine
abstract_en: A fuel rail of a fuel injection system of a combustion engine, in particular for a fuel injection system for injecting an emulsion of fuel and water into a cylinder of a combustion engine, having: a first fitting for a pump; a second fitting for the injector; a first storage volume to which an emulsion of fuel and water can be supplied via a first connection and from which an emulsion of fuel and water can be removed via a second connection; and a second storage volume coupled to the first storage volume by at least one connection, the first storage volume being defined by a first wall that is inelastic or not elastically deformable even at pressure peaks of the operating pressure condition, the second storage volume being defined by a second wall that is elastic or elastically deformable at pressure peaks of the operating pressure condition, the first wall at least partially surrounding the second wall and the second wall being connected by a connecting plate that is elastic or elastically deformable at pressure peaks of the operating pressure condition.

title_en: Energy recovery type compressor test system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of compressor test systems, and provides an energy recovery type compressor test system, which at least comprises: a compressor; the output shaft of the motor is connected with the input shaft of the compressor through a first clutch and is suitable for driving the compressor to work; the gas inlet of the gas collecting chamber is arranged corresponding to the gas outlet of the compressor so as to store compressed gas; the output shaft of the expander is connected with the input shaft of the motor through a second clutch; the air inlet of the expander is arranged corresponding to the air outlet of the air collecting chamber, and the compressed air expands in the expander to do work, so that the motor is forced to rotate and the compressor is indirectly driven to work. This energy recuperation formula compressor test system has realized the energy recuperation in the compressor test process and has utilized, and electric energy utilization is high, has reduced the energy waste, and the system is low carbon environmental protection.

title_en: Roots vacuum pump
abstract_en: The application relates to a Roots vacuum pump, which comprises a pump shell, wherein a Roots cavity and a gear cavity are formed in the pump shell, a circulating water cooling device is detachably connected to the pump shell, a water cooling spiral channel is formed in the pump shell, the Roots cavity and the gear cavity are wrapped in the water cooling spiral channel, a water inlet pipe and a water outlet pipe which extend out of the pump shell are respectively fixed at two ends of the water cooling spiral channel, and the circulating water cooling device is used for inputting water in a container from the water inlet pipe and sucking the water from the water outlet pipe. An operator uses a circulating water cooling device to communicate a water inlet pipe and a water outlet pipe, the water cooling device inputs water in the container and sucks water from the water inlet pipe, the water sucked from the water outlet pipe is cooled and enters from the water inlet pipe, so that continuous circulation of water is realized, the water cools the Roots vacuum pump, and the probability of failure of the Roots vacuum pump is reduced.

title_en: Spent fuel storage system-based negative pressure adjusting method for discharging bulb tube
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for adjusting the negative pressure of a discharging bulb tube based on a spent fuel storage system, which comprises the following steps: the discharging element flows out of the discharging device into a secondary discharging pipe; the gas separator divides the gas flow at the first preset position; the discharge element flows with the first gas flow and enters the discharge element tank under the action of gravity; the first air flow is sucked through a first air return valve, the second air flow is sucked through a second air return valve, and the air flows are divided; the first air flow and the second air flow after being sucked are converged and flow to the Roots blower; and part of the gas flow passing through the Roots blower is discharged to the atmosphere through the exhaust valve, and the other part of the gas flow flows back to the secondary discharge pipe. The invention has the technical effects that the design is reasonable, the secondary discharge pipe is favorable for maintaining a better negative pressure environment, and therefore, the overflow of substances such as graphite dust and the like can be prevented.

title_en: Finished automobile required torque control method
abstract_en: The invention provides a finished automobile demand torque control method, which comprises the steps of firstly, dividing an accelerator pedal interval, and mapping the actual opening of an accelerator pedal to an opening correction value of the accelerator pedal according to the divided accelerator pedal interval so as to realize finished automobile torque preprocessing; then, calculating the initial request torque of the whole vehicle according to the opening correction value of the accelerator pedal and the speed of the whole vehicle; calculating the driving intention and the driving mode of the whole vehicle according to the acceleration required value and the actual value of the acceleration of the whole vehicle; then filtering is carried out after the corrected torque of the whole vehicle is calculated, and finally the required torque of the whole vehicle is output; meanwhile, the control of the required torque of the whole vehicle is carried out by combining the opening degree of an accelerator pedal, the vehicle speed, the acceleration and the driving intention, so that the driving feeling is ensured, and the dynamic property and the economical efficiency of the whole vehicle are also ensured.

title_en: Control method and device for vehicle temperature control module
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for controlling a temperature control module for a vehicle, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring the water temperature of a cylinder cover of a water outlet of a cylinder cover of the engine and the water inlet temperature of a water inlet of the engine, determining a control mode of a temperature control module according to the water temperature of the cylinder cover, acquiring the real-time rotating speed and the real-time load of the engine if the control mode of the temperature control module is determined to be a closed-loop control mode, inquiring the target water temperature corresponding to the real-time rotating speed and the real-time load in the first preset data, determining the target opening of the temperature control module according to the inlet water temperature and the target water temperature, and controlling the opening of the temperature control module according to the target opening, the opening degree of the temperature control module is adjusted through the target water temperature and the water temperature at the water inlet of the engine, the time from execution of the temperature control module to response of the water temperature of the engine is shortened, the response speed of the temperature control module is improved, accurate closed-loop control of the water temperature of the engine is realized, and finally the water temperature of the engine reaches a target value so as to meet the actual requirement of the engine.

title_en: Method, device and system for identifying compression direction of air compressor
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of new energy vehicles, in particular to a method, a device and a system for identifying the compression direction of an air compressor, wherein the system comprises the following components: the air flow meter is connected with the air compressor and used for counting the actual air flow entering the air compressor; the compressed air cooling device is connected with the air compressor and used for cooling the entering air, and the outlet of the compressed air cooling device is connected with the fuel cell; the air pressure sensor is connected with the compressed air cooling device and used for detecting the actual air pressure of the entering air; the controller is connected with the air flow meter and the air pressure sensor and used for judging whether the compression direction of the air compressor is abnormal or not based on the world air flow, the actual air pressure, the preset flow data and the preset pressure data, and further quickly judging the abnormal condition of the compression direction of the air compressor by adopting the data of the air flow and the air pressure entering the air compressor, so that the production efficiency is improved.

title_en: Using GMA/H 3 PO 4 Method for treating uranium-containing wastewater by modified natural fibers
abstract_en: The invention provides Glycidyl Methacrylate (GMA) and phosphoric acid (H)  3  PO  4  ) A method for modifying natural luffa fiber is used for treating uranium-containing wastewater. According to the method, natural loofah sponge fibers are used as a matrix material, ammonium ceric nitrate oxidizes loofah sponge to generate an active site when pH=4 by a hydrothermal method, meanwhile, glycidyl methacrylate C=C is broken, GMA is grafted onto the loofah sponge by a single carbon bond, then a ring-opening reaction is carried out on phosphate groups and the GMA to graft onto the matrix material, and the hydrophilic and efficient selective adsorptivity GMA/H is prepared  3  PO  4  Loofah sponge fiber. The adsorption quantity of the fiber prepared by the method to uranium reaches 235mg/g under the condition of solution pH=6, the removal rate is more than 90%, and the selective adsorption of the modified fiber to uranium is not influenced under the condition of high salt. The natural modified fiber material provided by the invention has the advantages of simple preparation method, stable performance of grafted functional groups, good hydrophilicity, high adsorption capacity and certain environmental and social benefits.

title_en: Method and system for comprehensively utilizing steam source energy of back pressure steam turbine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for comprehensively utilizing steam source energy of a back pressure steam turbine, wherein the system comprises a three-level comprehensive energy utilization system, and the first-level comprehensive energy utilization system is used for converting heat energy into electric energy by utilizing extracted steam from a main steam turbine to do work and generate power through a high back pressure steam turbine or a low back pressure steam turbine; the second-stage energy utilization system is used for discharging exhaust steam of the backpressure steam turbine into a steam-water heat exchanger such as a raw water heater or a primary heat supply network heater or a heat supply network water supplementing deaerator and the like, and utilizing the latent heat of vaporization of the steam to respectively heat chemical raw water or primary heat supply network circulating water or supplement water for the heat supply network to deaerate; and the third-stage energy utilization system is used for sending the condensed water of the exhaust steam of the back pressure turbine to a heat supply network water replenishing heater, draining the water, releasing heat, heating the heat supply network water replenishing and then discharging the water into the main condenser.

title_en: Two-stage fan control method, device, medium and equipment
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a two-stage fan control method, apparatus, medium, and device. The method comprises the following steps: after detecting that a power assembly of the vehicle is flamed out, controlling the two-stage fan to operate at a low speed for a preset first time period; acquiring the voltage of a storage battery and the temperature of a first temperature zone, wherein the first temperature zone is an area where one or more of a gear shifting inhaul cable, a chassis heat dissipation water pipe, a chassis wire harness, a chassis fuel oil pipeline and a chassis brake oil pipe of the vehicle are located; and if the voltage of the storage battery is greater than the preset voltage and the temperature of the first temperature zone is greater than a first temperature threshold value, controlling the two-stage fan to run at a high speed. Therefore, heat exchange can be enhanced through wind power generated by high-speed operation of the two-stage fans, heat dissipation is accelerated, the risk of fire hazard is reduced, and safety of vehicles is effectively improved.

title_en: Intercooling control method and device for diesel vehicle and vehicle
abstract_en: The application provides an inter-cooling control method and device for a diesel vehicle and the vehicle, wherein the inter-cooling control method comprises the following steps: collecting the actual air inlet temperature of the diesel engine; when the actual air inlet temperature is greater than the preset air inlet temperature, the EGR waste gas is radiated by the EGR cooler; the method comprises the steps of obtaining the actual surface temperature of the intercooler, the actual environment humidity of the environment where the intercooler is located and the actual environment temperature, and when the actual environment humidity is larger than the preset environment humidity and the temperature difference between the actual environment temperature and the actual surface temperature of the intercooler is larger than the preset difference value, utilizing the intercooler to radiate EGR waste gas and utilizing heat generated by radiation to heat the intercooler. According to the intercooling control method for the diesel vehicle, the problems that in the related art, the air inlet temperature of a supercharged diesel engine in extremely cold areas is too low, the combustion efficiency is reduced, and water is accumulated in an intercooler in rainy days under high humidity in summer are solved.

title_en: Method and system for controlling separation time of electric control silicone oil fan
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of engines, and provides a method and a system for controlling the disengagement time of an electric control silicone oil fan, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a set fan rotating speed and an actual fan rotating speed of the electric control silicone oil fan, and determining the fan output duty ratio of the electric control silicone oil fan according to the set fan rotating speed and the actual fan rotating speed; determining the fan meshing rotating speed of the electric control silicone oil fan, judging whether the set rotating speed of the fan is greater than the fan meshing rotating speed in real time, and adjusting the fan output duty ratio of the electric control silicone oil fan in real time according to the judgment result so as to enable the fan output duty ratio to be output according to a first threshold value or a second threshold value. The fan output duty ratio of the electric control silicone oil fan is adjusted in real time, so that when the electric control silicone oil fan reaches the highest rotating speed, the high-frequency switching of the fan duty ratio among different thresholds is always kept, the silicone oil is ensured to circulate in a critical saturated state, and when the rotating speed required by the fan is reduced, the fan is quickly disconnected, and the disconnection time of the electric control silicone oil fan is greatly reduced.

title_en: Non-contact high-temperature mechanical sealing device
abstract_en: The invention provides a non-contact high-temperature mechanical sealing device which comprises a shaft sleeve, a movable ring, a stationary ring, a pumping blade I, a pumping blade II and a secondary gland, wherein the shaft sleeve is provided with the pumping hole I and the pumping hole II, and by utilizing the rotation motion of a shaft, a structure of connecting 4 pumps such as the pumping hole I, the pumping hole II, the pumping blade I, the pumping blade II and the like in series is adopted, so that cooling liquid flows sequentially around the inner cavity of the stationary ring, heat applied to a sealing ring and a lubricating film by friction of a high-temperature medium and a sealing surface is taken away, the temperature of the sealing ring and the lubricating film is reduced, vaporization of the lubricating film is inhibited, and the effect of mechanical sealing is improved. The pumps are connected in series to form a stronger cooling liquid conveying driving force, so that the self-circulation flowing cooling of the cooling liquid can be realized, meanwhile, the pumping capacity of the pumping holes I, II and the pumping blades I, II is positively correlated with the sealing rotation speed, when the friction temperature rise of the sealing end surface is increased due to the increase of the rotation speed, the pumping capacity can be automatically improved, the cooling force is increased, and the effect of automatically adjusting the cooling strength is achieved.

title_en: Piston design method suitable for gas engine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a piston design method suitable for a gas engine, which comprises the following steps: determining a compression ratio boundary corresponding to a knock occurrence limit based on the straight-opening piston; determining a target compression clearance with the shortest combustion duration based on a compression ratio boundary and a preset squish area; determining a target squeezing area based on a compression ratio boundary and a target compression clearance; and determining a target combustion chamber linear type with the shortest combustion duration based on the target compression clearance and the target squish area. The invention considers the knock when designing the compression ratio of the piston, and reduces the knock occurrence rate of the gas engine. The compression clearance can be properly increased during design, the quenching phenomenon caused by the over-small compression clearance is overcome, and the combustion duration is favorably shortened. Meanwhile, the invention also reasonably optimizes and matches the strength of the vortex, the tumble and the extrusion flow in the cylinder by adjusting different combustion chamber line types after fixing the compression clearance and the extrusion flow area to obtain the combustion chamber line type suitable for fast combustion, which is beneficial to improving the thermal efficiency of the gas engine.

title_en: Intelligent power engine
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent power engine, which comprises a gas circulating device, a power conversion device and an electric control device, wherein the gas circulating device comprises a gas storage tank, a valve, a power cylinder, a gas spring, a safety valve, a one-way valve, a gear, a filter, a gas pipe, a flywheel, a power arm, a control shaft sleeve, a connecting pipe seat, an exhaust valve, a power input shaft and a piston, a plurality of gas storage tanks prestore unequal pressures and are arranged in sequence, the power conversion device comprises a hydraulic oil spring, a power speed regulator, a hydraulic motor, a hydraulic oil tank, a safety valve, a power output shaft, a motor, a gear box, a speed regulating energy discharge pipe, an inner plug speed regulating shaft, an inner plug screw rod, a speed regulating energy discharge hole, an energy delivery hole, a hydraulic spring power shaft, a liquid filter, a liquid oil return pipe and a liquid oil delivery pipe, and the electric control device comprises a stop inductor, a deceleration inductor, an acceleration inductor, a touch sensor, a control device and a control device, The device comprises a touch pull wire, a pressure relay, an energy supplementing valve, an induction energy inlet, a ring-like tension spring and a speed regulating wire.

title_en: Centrifugal pump, centrifugal pump control system and control method and high-speed centrifugal pump unit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a centrifugal pump, a centrifugal pump control system and control method and a high-speed centrifugal pump unit, wherein the centrifugal pump comprises the following components: a volute; an impeller assembly is arranged in the volute, and a sliding sleeve arranged along the horizontal direction is arranged at one end of the volute, which is positioned at the water inlet end; an inlet ring; the inlet type ring comprises an adjusting sleeve matched with the sliding sleeve, and the adjusting sleeve stretches into the sliding sleeve to form sliding fit with the sliding sleeve; a working condition adjusting mechanism; the working condition adjusting mechanism is used for adjusting the position of the inlet type ring in the volute along the horizontal direction, and the working condition of the centrifugal pump is adjusted by changing the size of the working cavity.
