According to the invention, the pump body structure is designed, the working condition flow is regulated by regulating the size of the working chamber in the running process of the centrifugal pump, and the centrifugal pump can be restored to the normal working condition by fine-adjusting the size of the working chamber when the centrifugal pump is in an abnormal condition.

title_en: Steel for thick-specification high-strength nuclear reactor containment vessel and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to steel for a thick-specification high-strength nuclear reactor containment vessel and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the steel comprises the following components: c: 0.06 percent to 0.12 percent; si: 0.25 to 0.40 percent; mn: 1.60% -2.0%; p is less than or equal to 0.010 percent; s is less than or equal to 0.005 percent; cu: 0.35 to 0.55 percent; cr: 0.41 to 0.60 percent; mo: 0.60 to 1.25 percent; v: 0.020% -0.050%; nb: 0.010% -0.030%; ti: 0.050% -0.080%; al: 0.025 percent to 0.050 percent; [ O ] is less than or equal to 8 ppm; [H] less than or equal to 1.5ppm, and the balance of Fe and inevitable impurities. The steel has high purity, high strength, good low-temperature toughness, fine grains and uniform and stable structural performance, and meets the high standard requirement of the new generation of pressurized water reactor nuclear power stations on the steel for containment equipment.

title_en: Braking system and vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a braking system and a vehicle, wherein the braking system is applied to a hybrid vehicle, the vehicle is provided with a generator and an engine which are in transmission connection and used for generating electricity to drive a hub motor of the vehicle, and an exhaust butterfly valve is arranged on an exhaust port of the engine; the brake system includes: a braking device and a vehicle control unit; an air path valve of the braking device is communicated with the exhaust butterfly valve, and the air path valve is opened when braking is carried out so as to push the exhaust butterfly valve to be closed; the vehicle control unit is provided with an input end and an output end, wherein the input end is electrically connected with the hub motor, and the output end is electrically connected with the generator and used for transmitting the electric energy output by the hub motor to the generator during braking so as to drive the engine to consume. The electric energy output by the hub motor is transmitted to the generator in the braking process of the braking system, the generator is used as a motor to drive the engine, the exhaust brake is used as a load to completely consume the electric energy, and therefore the braking safety of the vehicle is improved.

title_en: Water pumping compressed nitrogen energy storage system and control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pumping compressed nitrogen energy storage system and a control method, wherein a water source is connected with a booster pump inlet, a booster pump outlet is connected to a liquid phase inlet of a water-nitrogen coexistence tank, a first liquid phase outlet of the water-nitrogen coexistence tank is connected to a first water turbine inlet, a shaft end of the first water turbine is connected with a first motor group, a first water turbine outlet is connected to a first inlet of a second water turbine, a second liquid phase outlet of the water-nitrogen coexistence tank is connected to a second inlet of the second water turbine, a shaft end of the second water turbine is connected with a second motor group, and a second water turbine outlet is connected to the water source; the first pipeline is connected to the inlet of the compressor, the shaft end of the compressor is connected with the driving motor, the outlet of the compressor is connected to the pressurizing inlet of the high-pressure nitrogen storage tank, and the outlet of the high-pressure nitrogen storage tank is connected to the gas phase inlet of the water-nitrogen coexistence tank; the method involves several aspects of auxiliary pressurization, energy storage and energy release. The invention solves the problem of dependence of traditional pumped storage on special terrain conditions, and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Quick induced air device in tunnel of tunnel engineering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid air inducing device in a tunnel of tunnel engineering, which comprises a fan body, wherein the bottom end of the fan body is provided with a moving structure, the moving structure comprises a track plate vehicle attached to the bottom end surface of the fan body, four groups of sliding grooves formed in the track plate vehicle, a sliding block embedded in the sliding grooves, a threaded rod arranged in the sliding grooves in a rotating mode, a rotating handle connected with the outer tail end of the threaded rod, a supporting piece arranged on the top end surface of the sliding block, rotating shafts arranged on the two side surfaces of the supporting piece, four groups of limiting plates attached to the surface of the fan body and rotating grooves formed in the inner side surfaces of the limiting plates, and the rotating grooves are embedded with rotating shafts; through the moving structure and the fixture block and the like that set up, effectively avoided because the fan is fixed mounting subaerial, demolish comparatively loaded down with trivial details with the installation operation, can't remove the problem of adjustment at any time, improved the convenience of device.

title_en: Mixed flow fan and air duct machine
abstract_en: The invention provides a mixed flow fan and a duct type air conditioner. The mixed flow fan comprises a volute, an impeller, a front guide vane structure and a rear guide vane structure. According to the mixed flow fan and the air duct machine provided by the invention, the first distance between the front guide vane structure and the impeller and the second distance between the rear guide vane structure and the impeller are respectively limited, the first distance can improve the air inlet flow field of the impeller and reduce the air inlet resistance of the impeller, the second distance can enable the pressure head of the impeller to meet the preset requirement, namely, the effective flow guiding can be carried out on the air inlet and the air outlet of the impeller, the size of the volute of the mixed flow fan can be ensured to meet the requirement of rotation in the air duct machine, the front guide vane structure and/or the rear guide vane structure are matched with the air flow direction discharged by the impeller as far as possible, the working effect of the mixed flow fan is further ensured, when the air inlet and outlet direction of the air duct machine is changed, the mixed flow fan can integrally rotate as required without interfering with the air duct machine, and the air outlet effect of the air duct machine is ensured.

title_en: Preparation and application of metal organic framework composite material for radionuclide treatment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation and application of a metal organic framework composite material for radionuclide treatment, which comprises the following steps: zrCl is added to  4  And terephthalic acid dissolved in DMF to form a homogeneous mixture; acetic acid and MnO  x  Sequentially adding colloid solution into the mixture, stirring, transferring to a stainless steel high-pressure reaction kettle with polytetrafluoroethylene as a lining for high-temperature reaction, naturally cooling to room temperature, centrifuging, collecting powder, and vacuum drying to obtain MnO  x  UiO-66; mnO is added to  x  UiO-66 and Ti  3  C  2  T  x  Grinding the colloid solution to dryness, and then ball milling to obtain MnO  x  /UiO‑66/Ti  3  C  2  T  x  I.e. a metal organic framework composite for radionuclide treatment. The composite material has higher removal rate of U (VI) in the U (VI) solution under the illumination condition, and the composite material has excellent U (VI) extraction capability in various U (VI) wastewater and real seawater with marked U (VI).

title_en: Oil field oil stain injection equipment with self-cleaning function
abstract_en: The invention relates to oil sludge injection equipment with a self-cleaning function for an oil field, which comprises an oil sludge tank, a hydraulic profile control injection pump and a cleaning system, wherein the oil sludge tank is connected with the hydraulic profile control injection pump through a first pipeline; the device combines the cleaning system and the oil sludge tank, can automatically and thoroughly clean the slurry inlet pipeline, the valve box and the slurry outlet pipeline in time when the valve box and the pipeline retain more oil sludge, and can thoroughly wash away the retained oil sludge in time so as to always maintain higher injection displacement when the hydraulic profile control injection pump performs injection operation, thereby ensuring higher injection efficiency.

title_en: Integral lifting and mounting method for offshore wind turbine
abstract_en: The invention discloses an integral lifting installation method of an offshore wind turbine, which comprises the following steps: firstly, installing a truss transported by a fan on an installation ship; fan shifting systems are arranged on the left side and the right side of the truss; the draught fan is integrally assembled on the wharf and fixed on a hoisting base, and the hoisting base is fixedly connected to a hoisting platform at the edge end of the wharf; moving the installation ship to the wharf in place, connecting the hoisting base to the fan displacement system through a rigging, and displacing and fixing the fan to the left side and the right side of the truss by the fan displacement system; the installation ship moves to a wind field to be in place, and the fan shifting system shifts the fan to a fan foundation and installs and fixes the fan; and the connection between the hoisting base and the fan shifting system is released, and the offshore installation work of the fan is completed. The invention gets rid of the dependence of offshore wind turbine installation on the floating crane, improves the offshore installation efficiency, and is beneficial to promoting the development of the marine new energy field in China.

title_en: Deep well pump and shaft end supporting structure thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a shaft end supporting structure of a deep well pump, wherein a transmission shaft extends out of a pump body and is connected with a driving motor through a coupler, a swinging supporting seat is fixedly arranged at one end of the pump body, which is positioned at an inlet seat, and a swinging supporting structure which flexibly supports the radial direction of the transmission shaft is arranged in the swinging supporting seat. The swing supporting seat carries out the flexible support to the end that stretches out of transmission shaft, takes place radial deflection back at the transmission shaft, and the transmission shaft is radially supported by swing bearing structure, realizes the rotation center of transmission shaft to a certain extent and adjusts, and flexible bearing structure avoids producing rigid impact to the transmission shaft, satisfies the self-alignment function to the transmission shaft, guarantees the support equilibrium of transmission shaft. The invention also provides a deep-well pump.

title_en: Valve mechanism and oil pump
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of valves and discloses a valve mechanism which comprises a valve seat, wherein an oil inlet valve plate for controlling an oil inlet to be opened and closed is arranged on the valve seat in a sliding mode through a valve rod, the valve rod and the valve seat are in dynamic sealing insertion connection, the oil inlet valve plate and the valve rod are located on the same side of the oil inlet, a driving mechanism is connected onto the valve rod, and the driving mechanism drives the valve rod to reciprocate so that the oil inlet valve plate can enter an opening station and a closing station respectively. The valve rod does not need to penetrate through the oil inlet, so that the diameter of the oil inlet can be minimized under the condition of ensuring that the oil passing amount of the oil inlet reaches the standard, and the sealing effect of the oil inlet valve plate is better; meanwhile, when the oil inlet valve plate enters the opening station and the closing station, an additional driving device is not needed to be added, so that the structure is simplified, and the reliability and the stability of oil supply are improved; and the timeliness of entering a closed station and the running stability of the valve mechanism can be improved.

title_en: Driver capable of realizing complex motion and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a driver capable of realizing complex motion and a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of drivers; the driver consists of a graphene oxide film with a certain shape, and a quantum confinement superfluid channel is formed by multilayer stacking of graphene oxide nanosheets in the graphene oxide film; fixing the graphene oxide film into a specific shape under the action of humidity and external force, keeping the specific shape, and then removing the humidity and the external force to keep the specific shape to form a driver; the driver can be applied to humidity driving and preparation of robots; the driver has humidity response capability and can realize complex motion; meanwhile, the problem of weak interlayer binding force of a traditional double-layer structure driver is solved, and the stability of the device is improved.

title_en: Compact type aviation hydraulic variable pump swash plate variable mechanism and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a compact aviation hydraulic variable pump swash plate variable mechanism and a compact aviation hydraulic variable pump swash plate variable mechanism method, wherein the compact aviation hydraulic variable pump swash plate variable mechanism comprises a shell (8), variable sleeves (3) which are axially distributed are arranged in the shell (8), one ends of the variable sleeves (3) are provided with adjusting seats (10), the other ends of the variable sleeves (3) are provided with mounting seats (1) matched with the shell (8), and the inner sides of the mounting seats (1) are provided with spring seats (2) positioned in the variable sleeves (3); a variable piston (4) is arranged in the variable sleeve (3), and a return spring (5) is arranged between the variable piston (4) and the spring seat (2); and a roller (7) is embedded in the inner hole of the variable piston (4), and a swash plate (6) is arranged on the roller (7). The invention has the characteristic of effectively reducing the installation size and the quality of the variable displacement pump.

title_en: Heat radiation structure of secondary structure pump
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heat dissipation structure of a secondary structure pump, which comprises a shell, a water tank, a floating seat and an atomization assembly, wherein the shell is used for surrounding an oil cylinder and/or a piston; the floating seat is provided with a through hole for installing a pipeline so as to obtain water in the water tank and transmit the water to the atomization assembly; the upper end and the lower end of the floating seat corresponding to the water surface are square, the peripheral edge of the floating seat can be connected with a buffer plate in a way of swinging up and down along with the water surface, and a limiting buffer piece is arranged between the buffer plate and the floating seat so as to limit the maximum overturning angle of the buffer plate and provide overturning buffer for the buffer plate; the bottom of the floating seat is connected to the bottom of the water tank through a connecting line. The invention can avoid the problem that the existing heat dissipation is frequently maintained due to vibration for a long time, and can be more convenient to use.

title_en: Submersible sewage pump with adjustable impeller clearance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a submersible sewage pump with adjustable impeller clearance, which comprises a pump shell, wherein an output pipe is arranged on the outer wall of one side of the pump shell, a pump seat is fixedly connected with the outer wall of the bottom of the pump shell, openings are formed in the outer walls of the pump seat, a protective net is fixedly connected with the inner walls of the openings, a mounting plate is fixedly connected with the inner wall of the pump shell, a partition plate is fixedly connected with the inner wall of the pump shell, the partition plate is positioned below the mounting plate, and an impeller is arranged on the outer wall of the bottom of the partition plate. According to the invention, the adjusting mechanism is arranged on the partition plate, and the adjusting shaft on the adjusting mechanism is connected with the impeller, so that the adjusting shaft is conveniently matched with the lead screw arranged in the adjusting mechanism to move, the position of the impeller is conveniently and properly adjusted by adjusting the movement of the adjusting shaft, the gap between the impeller and the partition plate is conveniently adjusted, and the gap of the impeller is adjusted.

title_en: Ventilating device for environmental protection system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ventilation device for an environmental protection system, which comprises a volute and an impeller, wherein the impeller is positioned in the volute, and the volute comprises an inlet plate (1), a back plate, a volute plate (2) and an outlet plate (3), and is characterized in that a guide plate (6) is arranged at one side of an air outlet (5), and the guide plate is arranged close to a tongue of the volute. The ventilator can reduce turbulent flow at the outlet of the ventilator through the design of the guide plate structure, and reduce noise.

title_en: Combined cycle combined cooling heating and power system integrating fuel cell and solar energy
abstract_en: The invention relates to a combined cycle combined cooling heating and power system integrating a fuel cell and solar energy, and belongs to the technical field of combined cooling, heating and power. This joint supply system includes: a solid oxide fuel cell subsystem; the solar heat complementation gas and steam combined cycle subsystem comprises a gas turbine subsystem and a steam cycle subsystem; and a double-effect absorption lithium bromide refrigeration subsystem. The gas turbine subsystem is respectively connected with the solid oxide fuel cell subsystem and the steam circulation subsystem; the steam circulation subsystem is also connected with the double-effect absorption type lithium bromide refrigeration subsystem. The solid oxide fuel cell subsystem can perform power generation and afterburning, the solar thermal complementary fuel gas and steam combined cycle subsystem can perform power generation and provide heat load for a user side, and the double-effect absorption type lithium bromide refrigeration subsystem can provide cold load for the user side, so that the energy loss of the system is reduced under the condition of meeting various energy requirements of the user on cold, heat and electricity, and the working capacity of the system is improved.

title_en: Combustion chamber of gas turbine and design method thereof
abstract_en: A combustion chamber of a gas turbine and a design method thereof comprise a combustion chamber casing, an annular flame tube, a flame tube head, a nozzle assembly, a nozzle mounting seat and a design method thereof, wherein the flame tube head is uniformly distributed along the circumferential direction, and the nozzle assembly is correspondingly arranged and fixed on the combustion chamber casing through the nozzle mounting seat. Through the design of flame tube head and nozzle assembly, obtain stronger backward flow district, good fuel atomization evaporation and oil gas blending combustion, compare present gas turbine combustion chamber, hold hot strength high, can improve gas turbine work load, secondly straight hole and chute complex swirler have strengthened the gas blending when guaranteeing combustion stability, have effectively reduced the pollution emission. The method for designing the combustion chamber determines the total open area based on the jet flow speed of the flame tube, and excavates the combustion potential of the large air inflow of the head part on the basis of guaranteeing the cooling requirement of the combustion chamber.

title_en: High-altitude quick-starting ignition system based on evaporating pipe combustion chamber
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-altitude quick-start ignition system based on an evaporating pipe combustion chamber, which comprises a combustion chamber casing, a turbine casing, an oxygen supplementing device, an oil supply device, an evaporating pipe combustion chamber, a pyrotechnic igniter and a gunpowder starter. The oxygen supplementing device comprises an oxygen supplementing ring, the oil supplying device comprises a fuel ring, and the oxygen supplementing ring and the fuel ring are arranged at the head part of the combustion chamber of the evaporating pipe. The gunpowder starter generates high-temperature and high-pressure gas, so that the engine rotor system is rapidly accelerated to the starting ignition rotating speed; oxygen and fuel oil are respectively fed into the evaporating pipe through the throttling oxygen supplementing nozzle and the fuel oil nozzle, are preliminarily atomized under the impact of high-pressure oxygen and then are mixed with oxygen, are further atomized under the action of the pyrotechnic igniter, and are ignited after entering the combustion chamber. Compared with the prior art, the evaporation tube has the advantages that the oxygen distribution in the combustion chamber is more uniform, the fuel is atomized in two steps, the effect is good, the atomization is more thorough, the engine can be rapidly ignited and flame-combined under the high-altitude environment, and the rapid starting is realized.

title_en: Hydraulic pump flow distribution pair oil film characteristic online test device based on end cover transformation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an end cover transformation-based hydraulic pump flow distribution pair oil film characteristic online testing device, which comprises: the flow distribution plate comprises a flow distribution plate, a connecting sleeve, a bushing, a bearing and a positioning sleeve, wherein the bushing is arranged between an end cover and the flow distribution plate and is arranged in the connecting sleeve; the connecting sleeve is arranged between the pump body and the end cover, a plurality of temperature detection blind holes, a plurality of pressure oil leading holes and a plurality of displacement detection holes are formed in the valve plate, a temperature sensor wiring hole communicated with the temperature detection blind holes, a pressure detection hole communicated with the pressure oil leading holes and a displacement sensor wiring hole communicated with the displacement detection holes are formed in the bushing respectively, a first wire outlet hole and a second wire outlet hole which are communicated with each other are formed in the bushing and the connecting sleeve respectively, and the first wire outlet hole is communicated with the temperature sensor wiring hole, the pressure detection hole and the displacement sensor wiring hole respectively. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the characteristics of simple operation, rich functions, lower cost, portability, reliability and the like.

title_en: Composite cooperative power generation device, control method and control system
abstract_en: The invention provides a composite cooperative power generation device, a control method and a control system, which relate to the field of new energy equipment and comprise a photovoltaic device, a vertical axis wind turbine and a tower barrel, wherein a main shaft is arranged in the tower barrel, a driving motor is arranged on the side edge of the tower barrel, the vertical axis wind turbine comprises a lifting force type blade, a blade support, a rotating shaft and a permanent magnet generator, the photovoltaic device comprises a photovoltaic array and a photovoltaic base, a mounting protective plate is obliquely arranged on the non-focusing side of the photovoltaic array, and a guide plate is arranged between the photovoltaic array and the photovoltaic base. The present application achieves compactness of the overall structure and reduction in cost by a plurality of common structural members. The device gives priority to photovoltaic power generation in daytime, can realize the operation of a photovoltaic and wind power mode, and realizes the maximum power generation power of the device. The device switches to run in "wind" mode at night. When the vertical axis wind turbine exceeds the rated wind speed, the device can reduce the capture of wind energy, and the speed is reduced by the electromagnetic brake until the brake is stopped.

title_en: Control device for hybrid system
abstract_en: A control device for a hybrid system including an internal combustion engine and a motor generator connected to each other via a belt, wherein the control device for the hybrid system includes a processing circuit configured to execute: a power generation process of controlling the motor generator to generate power to apply a load to the internal combustion engine when a 1 st execution condition of the idle stop is satisfied; a slip ratio calculation process of calculating a slip ratio of the transmission belt from a rotation speed of the internal combustion engine and a rotation speed of the motor generator during execution of the power generation process; a determination process of determining whether or not a 2 nd execution condition of the idle stop is satisfied after waiting until a predetermined period elapses, when the slip ratio is equal to or greater than a threshold value; and an idle stop process executed when it is determined that the 2 nd execution condition is satisfied.

title_en: Device for converting temperature difference into mechanical rotation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device for converting temperature difference into mechanical rotation, which comprises a heat transfer base and a rotating shaft, wherein the rotating shaft is fixedly connected to the middle parts of two sides of the surface of the heat transfer base, the surface of the rotating shaft is fixedly connected with a communicating device, the device for converting temperature difference into mechanical rotation is characterized in that two sides of the surface of the communicating device are respectively and fixedly connected with a cold end heat exchange cavity and a hot end heat exchange cavity, and an inner cavity of the hot end heat exchange cavity is filled with a working medium. This temperature difference conversion is mechanical pivoted device, its beneficial effect does: the device has the advantages of simple and reliable structure, miniaturization, low cost, no need of initial driving force and the like, and has wide potential application value in the fields of low-grade heat energy utilization, low-noise heat energy-to-mechanical energy conversion, miniaturization of a heat energy-to-mechanical energy device and the like.

title_en: Low-noise fan
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-noise fan; wherein, micropores are uniformly distributed on the impeller, the stator outer sleeve and the upper and lower covers, so as to form acoustic impedance; the large outer sleeve of the fan is used as a structural member, a cavity is formed in an interlayer of the large outer sleeve, micropores are formed at the upper end and the lower end of an inner layer of the large outer sleeve, a noise elimination structure is formed, and the large outer sleeve has a noise elimination effect on air inlet and exhaust noise; the multi-stage blades are adopted to meet the performance and reduce the rotating speed of the fan, and each stage of blades have different blade numbers, so that the passing noise frequency of each stage of blades is different, and the high modulated scattered noise generated by the superposition of noise energy of the blades with the same frequency is avoided; a rubber layer is arranged between the stator outer sleeve and the large outer sleeve, so that high structural vibration noise generated by the transmission of vibration generated by the motor and the rotating body to the large outer sleeve is effectively reduced; the application thus effectively reduces aerodynamic noise and structural vibration radiation noise.

title_en: Hydraulic pump fault detection system in hydraulic system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydraulic pump fault detection system in a hydraulic system, which comprises a hydraulic pump main body and a detection platform, wherein an oil particle counter is fixedly arranged in the hydraulic pump main body, an integrated filter pipe joint is fixedly connected to the input end of the hydraulic pump main body, and the oil particle counter is connected in parallel in the hydraulic pump main body, so that large particle pollutants are prevented from entering the oil particle counter to block the oil particle counter under the condition of affecting the test precision. The inlet of the oil particle counter inside the hydraulic pump is connected with the integrated filter pipe joint, so that large particle pollutants are prevented from entering the oil particle counter to block the oil particle counter under the condition of affecting the test precision, and meanwhile, the oil particle counter is used for acquiring the pollution information of hydraulic oil passing through the pump in real time, so that early faults of the hydraulic pump are identified, the hydraulic pump is maintained according to conditions, and the service life of the hydraulic pump is prolonged.

title_en: Fuel leakage diagnosis method and device based on OBD
abstract_en: The invention discloses an OBD-based fuel leakage diagnosis method and device, which are used for detecting whether fuel leakage exists in a fuel system and comprise the following steps of S1: collecting the internal pressure P of the fuel tank, comparing the internal pressure P with a preset pressure threshold value M, and entering a step S2 when P is less than or equal to M; when P > M, proceed to step S3; s2: simultaneously opening the reversing valve and the oil tank isolating valve, and comparing the current value I of the inflator pump with the nominal value N; s3: and opening the reversing valve without opening the oil tank isolation valve, and comparing the current value I of the inflator pump with the nominal value N. When I is larger than or equal to N, the fuel system does not have fuel leakage; and when I is less than N, indicating that fuel leakage exists in the fuel system, and sending an alarm prompt. According to the invention, by acquiring the pressure in the fuel tank and adopting a corresponding diagnosis method according to different pressures, the situation that the reversing valve is reset when the pressure in the fuel tank is too high is avoided, the safe pressure relief range of the fuel system is kept, and the safety of the fuel system is improved.

title_en: Method for eliminating large cold start expansion difference of ultra-high Wen Ya critical unit
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for eliminating large cold-state starting expansion difference of an ultrahigh Wen Ya critical unit, which comprises the following specific steps of (1) igniting and boosting, vacuumizing, carrying out preheating by a shaft seal steam source, (second) carrying out punching and revolving heating, (1) selecting punching and revolving parameters, (2) controlling back pressure of the unit, carrying out direct speed-up 1300r/min for medium-speed heating for 30min when the speed-up is up to 500r/min, carrying out high-speed heating when the speed-up is up to 2500r/min, carrying out constant-speed heating, carrying out heating for 20-30 min when the speed-up is up to 3000r/min, carrying out grid-connected initial load heating, carrying out grid-connected initial load 5-10% rated load, continuing heating, and carrying out five-step load heating, and continuing to lift the main and reheat steam temperature for 20-30 ℃ when the temperature of a cylinder is up to be less than 40 ℃ different from the main steam temperature, and continuing heating. The method solves the problems that the cold start expansion difference of the ultra-high Wen Ya critical generator set is large, the start speed is low, and even the generator set falls off, improves the quick load efficiency of the generator set, and obviously reduces the economic loss.

title_en: Sealed container equipped with a bi-material flange
abstract_en: The invention relates to a sealed container (1), comprising: container body (2) with a through hole (8) delimited by a flange and closed by a removable door (7) mounted on the flange, and an annular seal between the flange and the door (7), characterized in that the flange consists of two separate concentric sleeves, one of which defines an outer flange body (5) arranged to allow the connection of the container body (2) to a flange having a complementary shape on the outer shell, the other sleeve defines an inner flange body (6) arranged to allow the connection of the door (7) to the flange, the outer flange body (5) being made wholly or partly of a resistant plastic material selected from the group consisting of autoclaving cycle plastics, while the inner flange body (6) is made of a metal alloy.

title_en: Circumferential limiting system for gas turbine blade set
abstract_en: The invention discloses a circumferential limiting system of a blade group, which comprises the blade group and a circumferential limiting structure, wherein the blade group comprises a plurality of circumferentially distributed blades, the circumferential limiting structure is arranged in a circumferential gap between two adjacent blades in the blade group, and when the blades in the blade group are moved in a circumferential direction, the circumferential limiting structure is in surface contact with the blades so as to reduce the contact stress between the blades and the circumferential limiting structure, thereby reducing the strength requirement of the circumferential limiting structure. The tolerance degree of the accumulated error generated by processing each stationary blade is higher by adopting a circumferential limiting structure in a self-adaptive mode; the requirement of slotting precision of each stator blade is reduced, so that the production and manufacturing cost of the blades is greatly reduced, and the economic value is improved.

title_en: Real-time online cloud detection system for air compressor
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of air compressor detection, and particularly discloses a real-time online cloud detection system for an air compressor, which comprises a central processing unit, and an air compressor control module, a dryer control module, a data acquisition module, an energy monitoring module, a function module and a cloud server which are connected with the central processing unit; the air compressor control module and the dryer control module are respectively connected with the air compressor and the dryer, and at least one group of air compressor control module and dryer control module is arranged; the data acquisition module, the air compressor and the dryer are arranged in the air compression station together, and the data acquisition module acquires the operating parameters of the equipment and feeds the operating parameters back to the central processing unit; the energy monitoring module is arranged aiming at the air compression station, acquires the air consumption and the electricity consumption of the air compression station and feeds the air consumption and the electricity consumption back to the central processing unit; the detection system provided by the invention can realize remote real-time monitoring of the air compressor, reduce the workload of daily managers and improve the working efficiency of the air compressor.

title_en: Anti-scaling induced draft fan
abstract_en: The invention provides an anti-scaling induced draft fan, which comprises a fan main body, wherein a rotor impeller, an air inlet and an air outlet are arranged in the fan main body; an air outlet of the fan main body is provided with an air guiding pipe, the tail end of the air guiding pipe is connected with a dust remover, the outlet end of the dust remover is connected with an air supplying pipe, the air supplying pipe stretches into the vicinity of the non-working surface of the impeller at the air inlet end, and a spray head pointing to the non-working surface of the impeller is arranged at the tail end of the air supplying pipe; the air guiding pipe and the air supplying pipe are respectively provided with an independently controlled valve; and a direction changing mechanism for fine adjusting the blowing direction of the spray head is further arranged between the air supply pipe and the spray head. The invention leads out a high-pressure flue gas from the outlet of the sintering denitration induced draft fan, and returns to the air inlet end of the induced draft fan to purge the non-working surface of the rotor impeller after dust removal by the dust remover, so that the soft deposited dust adhered to the impeller is purged in time, the deposited dust is prevented from scaling, thereby ensuring the balanced rotation of the fan impeller and reducing the occurrence of vibration phenomenon.

title_en: Air suspension compressor system and air path structure thereof
abstract_en: An air suspension compressor system and its gas circuit structure, the air suspension compressor system includes the air filter linking with air inlet and outlet, the air filter connects the air suspension compressor unit through the muffler, the gas outlet of the air suspension compressor unit connects the gas pressure distributor, distribute and lead into high-pressure gas holder, low-pressure gas holder and air spring used for supporting the car body through the gas pressure distributor after compressing; in the quick inflation mode, low-pressure gas in the low-pressure gas storage tank is compressed and then is conveyed to the high-pressure gas storage tank or the air spring; in the exhaust back-blowing mode, the low-pressure gas in the low-pressure gas storage tank is exhausted to the atmosphere through the inside of the motor to cool the motor; and the high-pressure gas in the high-pressure gas storage tank is exhausted out of the atmosphere through the dryer, and the moisture in the high-pressure gas is exhausted out. The invention can avoid the conditions of icing, water inlet, rusting and the like, has higher safety and reliability, improves the performance of the compressor, and has simple structure and easy realization.

title_en: Method for reducing vibration intensity of water pump
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for reducing the vibration intensity of a water pump, which comprises the following steps: measuring the flow velocity of the liquid in the pipeline according to a remote flow meter; obtaining the size of a flow angle at an impeller in the water pump; adjusting the frequency of the variable frequency water pump based on the flow angle; obtaining the pipeline pressure in the remote transmission pressure gauge A and the remote transmission pressure gauge B again; adjusting the opening and closing degree of the throttle valve to adjust the resistance of the pipeline; obtaining the liquid flow velocity in the remote flow meter after secondary adjustment; obtaining an adjusted flow angle; judging the sizes of the adjusted flow angle and the water pump installation angle; and finishing the adjustment of the vibration intensity of the water pump. According to the invention, through the combined action of the throttle valve and the frequency converter, the variable flow regulation of the pipe network is more flexible and reliable, the characteristic change of the water pump is adapted to the frequency change under the coordination linkage of the water pump frequency and the pipe network resistance, and the reduction of the operating efficiency of the variable frequency water pump and the damage to the water pump caused by the overlarge vibration intensity due to the regulation of the pipe network flow by changing the frequency are avoided.

title_en: Sealing device for gaseous fuel supply and burner replacement method
abstract_en: A sealing device for gaseous fuel supply and a combustor replacement method relate to the field of combustion chambers of gas turbines. In the sealing device, a fuel supply through hole is formed in the fuel cover plate; threads are arranged at two ends of the fuel supply pipe; the first sealing piece and the fuel cover plate are of an integrated structure, the first sealing piece is in close contact with the second sealing piece, and through holes are formed in the first sealing piece and the second sealing piece; the fuel supply pipe penetrates through the sealing structure and the fuel cover plate, and the fastening nut is used for fixing the second sealing piece. The method comprises the following steps: disconnecting the fuel supply pipe from the fuel intake pipe; sequentially disassembling the fastening nut, the round table sealing piece and the fuel cover plate; disconnecting the fuel supply pipe from the burner; changing a new burner; and then the sealing device is arranged on the experiment table according to the opposite steps, so that the replacement of the burner is completed.

title_en: Integrated reinforcing structure for spray pipe expansion section, construction method of integrated reinforcing structure and spray pipe
abstract_en: The invention provides a spray pipe expansion section integrated reinforcing structure, a construction method thereof and a spray pipe, and belongs to the technical field of space engines, wherein the spray pipe expansion section integrated reinforcing structure comprises: a heat insulating layer constituting an inner wall layer of the expansion section; a case covering an outer layer of the heat insulating layer; a hoop laminated layer simultaneously covering the tail of the shell and the outer layer of the heat insulation layer; according to the integrated reinforcing structure for the expansion section of the spray pipe, the connection part of the tail part of the shell and the heat insulation layer is reinforced and connected and sealed through the annular laminated layer, and the annular laminated layer can simultaneously have the effect of reinforcing the connection firmness and the sealing performance between the shell and the heat insulation layer.

title_en: Self-adaptive adjustment type Roots pump bypass device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-adaptive adjustment type Roots pump bypass device. The invention adopts an electromagnetic regulating valve as a gas path regulating unit of the Roots pump inlet and outlet bypass device, utilizes a first Wheatstone bridge, a second Wheatstone bridge and an automatic regulating circuit to jointly form a circuit system of the bypass device, and is used as a center of the bypass device for power supply, signal processing and signal execution, hot wire resistors of the first Wheatstone bridge and the second Wheatstone bridge are used as measuring units of the inlet and outlet temperatures of the Roots pump, and the opening of an electromagnetic valve is regulated in real time by utilizing the balance of the Wheatstone bridge, so that the differential pressure at the inlet and outlet of the Roots pump is accurately controlled within a reasonable range, and the increase of energy consumption caused by the rough exhaust of a mechanical overflow valve is effectively reduced.

title_en: Graded single-tube combustion chamber
abstract_en: The invention discloses a grading single-tube combustion chamber, wherein an air inlet of the combustion chamber is connected with a casing through a diffuser, a flame tube is arranged in the casing, a class-level concave cavity is arranged at the upstream of the flame tube, a main combustion-level combustion part is arranged at the downstream of the flame tube, a class-level nozzle, an air inlet slot and an ignition electric nozzle are arranged in the class-level concave cavity, and stable vortex structures are formed in the concave cavity through reasonably organizing air entering the concave cavity, so that flames in the concave cavity can be combusted stably in a wider working condition range; air flows into the main combustion stage combustion part through the cyclone, under the action of the cyclone, fuel provided by the main combustion stage nozzle can be mixed with air uniformly and quickly to accelerate combustion, and the problems of large windward area, difficult ignition, unstable combustion and the like of the single-tube combustion chamber are solved through the structural design and arrangement of the on-duty stage concave cavity and the main combustion stage combustion part.

title_en: Power generation device for generating power by heavy-duty vehicle in downhill
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power generation device for generating power by a heavy-duty vehicle in a downhill, which comprises the heavy-duty vehicle and a ramp, and is characterized in that: the top of ramp is open structure, and the inner wall correspondence of ramp is connected with the pivot through the bearing rotation, the outside of pivot is cup jointed through the key-type connection and is provided with the band pulley, two synchronous belt has been cup jointed between the band pulley, the bottom of heavy duty vehicle has the wheel, and the wheel contacts with synchronous belt, there is the backup pad through welded fastening between the both sides inner wall of ramp, the top of backup pad is even to be rotated through universal bearing and is installed the ball, the ball contacts with synchronous belt's medial surface, synchronous belt has a plurality of groups, and the synchronous belt of a plurality of groups is linear arrangement, two along the surface of ramp be provided with middle partition post between the synchronous belt, the both sides of middle partition post are fixed mutually through the welding with the inner wall of ramp, and the device has solved the poor problem of current practicality.

title_en: Electronic blower and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electronic blower and a control method thereof, and relates to the field of blowers, the electronic blower comprises a case and an H-shaped partition plate, the inside of the case is divided into a first cavity, a second cavity, a third cavity and a fourth cavity by the H-shaped partition plate, the second cavity and the third cavity are sequentially arranged between the first cavity and the fourth cavity along the gravity direction, one end of the second cavity is communicated with the third cavity and the first cavity, two ends of the third cavity are respectively communicated with the first cavity and the fourth cavity, two ends of the case are respectively provided with a main air inlet part and an auxiliary filter screen, one end of the H-shaped partition plate, which is positioned in the first cavity, is provided with a filter part, one end of the H-shaped partition plate, which is positioned in the fourth cavity, is provided with a detachable part for closing or opening a second groove, a control box and a centrifugal fan are arranged in the second cavity, one end, which is far away from the first cavity, is provided with an air inlet, and the case is provided with a control panel and an exhaust pipe. The circulation direction of the fourth cavity, the third cavity and the second cavity can be selected to be opened or not according to needs, the air flow can take away the heat of the control box, and air pollutants are filtered through the filter element and the secondary filter screen.

title_en: Valve tappet anti-rotation device for engine
abstract_en: The application discloses be applied to valve tappet rotational lock for engine in engine valve tappet field, this valve tappet rotational lock is through installing the slider of vertical setting at the top of hydraulic valve tappet, and will encircle the spout that establishes at the outer terminal wall intermediate position department of stainless steel cam with slider looks adaptation, with the help of the cooperation restriction between spout and the slider, can be avoiding stainless steel cam rotation in-process, the slider with spout matched with takes place the skew, and then ensure hydraulic valve tappet reciprocates stably, avoid hydraulic valve tappet to reciprocate in-process and take place radial rotation inside the engine bulkhead, can effectively avoid its working process because take place to rotate and increase and the friction between the engine bulkhead end wall, the daily wear rate of hydraulic valve tappet has been reduced to a certain extent, be favorable to ensuring hydraulic valve tappet to the leakproofness and the life of peripheral structure, and can reduce effectively because wearing and tearing and leading to the probability that the abnormal sound produces.

title_en: In-cylinder brake mechanism and method for engine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of in-cylinder braking of engines, in particular to an in-cylinder braking mechanism and a method of an engine, wherein the existing hydraulic braking has a plurality of defects due to the attribute of a hydraulic system; the method is realized by the following scheme: the rocker arm can swing around a rocker arm shaft configured on the rocker arm, one end of the rocker arm is a power input end, the other end of the rocker arm is a power output end, and a sliding pin cavity and a piston cavity are arranged at the power output end; the piston is in sliding fit with the piston cavity, keeps in contact with the valve ejector rod and pushes the valve ejector rod to move; and the sliding pin is in sliding fit with the sliding pin cavity and moves to realize the contact or the separation of the sliding pin and the top end of the piston.

title_en: Combustion system and gas engine
abstract_en: The invention relates to a combustion system and a gas engine, wherein the combustion system comprises a main combustion chamber and a precombustion chamber, the top of a piston of the main combustion chamber is provided with a combustion chamber pit, and the circumferential side wall of the combustion chamber pit comprises a plurality of spiral curved surfaces which are sequentially connected along the circumferential direction; a plurality of circumferential spray holes are arranged at intervals in the circumferential direction of the precombustion chamber, the included angle between the projected two ends of the axis of each circumferential spray hole on the cross section of the precombustion chamber and the connecting line of the center of the precombustion chamber is greater than 0, and each circumferential spray hole is arranged opposite to each spiral curved surface in a one-to-one correspondence manner; when the device is applied, as the piston moves upwards, the combustible mixed gas entering the pre-combustion chamber through each circumferential spray hole of the main combustion chamber spirally rises, so that the mutual influence of air intake of each circumferential spray hole is avoided, and the scavenging in the pre-combustion chamber is more sufficient; after the flame catches fire in the precombustion chamber, the flame is spirally sprayed to the corresponding spiral curved surface along each circumferential spray hole, so that the flame propagation direction is spirally propagated, and the partitioned combustion is formed in the pits, so that the combustion in the cylinder is more sufficient.

title_en: Heat dissipation method and device for wind turbine generator
abstract_en: The application provides a heat dissipation method and a heat dissipation device for a wind turbine generator, which relate to the field of wind power generation, and the method comprises the following steps: acquiring working condition parameters of the wind turbine generator under the condition that the working temperature of the wind turbine generator meets preset heat dissipation conditions; determining a heat dissipation plate angle parameter of the heat dissipation device corresponding to the working condition parameter according to the working condition parameter; adjusting the angle of each heat dissipation plate of the heat dissipation device according to the angle parameters of the heat dissipation plates so as to improve the air flow passing through the heat dissipation device; the angle parameter of the heat dissipation plate comprises the angle parameter of each heat dissipation plate of the heat dissipation device. The heat dissipation method and device for the wind turbine generator are used for improving the heat dissipation efficiency of the heat dissipation device of the wind turbine generator, so that the heat dissipation device is always in the optimal heat dissipation state.

title_en: Assembling equipment for fan sectional type blades
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an equipment of fan sectional type blade. The assembling equipment comprises a first tool, a butt joint tool, a fourth tool and a positioning device. The first tool is used for supporting the rear end of the blade root section and providing adjustment of the rotation of the blade root section around the axial direction of the blade. The butt joint tooling is used for butt joint assembly of the front end of She Genduan and the rear end of the blade tip section, comprises an assembly platform, and a second tooling and a third tooling which are arranged on the assembly platform, is used for flexibly supporting the front end of She Genduan, and provides fine adjustment of rotation of the blade root section around the axial direction of the blade and overturning of rotation around the chordwise direction of the blade; the third tool is used for supporting the rear end of the blade tip section, and the third tool has multiple degrees of freedom on the assembling platform so as to provide multiple degrees of freedom adjustment of the blade tip section. The fourth tool is used for flexibly supporting the front end of the blade tip section. The positioning device is arranged on the butt joint tooling and used for accurately positioning She Genduan and the blade tip section in the butt joint process.

title_en: Electron beam generating source, electron beam irradiation apparatus, and X-ray irradiation apparatus
abstract_en: The electron beam generating source includes: an electron emitting portion that extends on a desired axis and emits electrons; a movable portion connected to one end of the electron emission portion; a support portion that supports the movable portion so that the movable portion is movable along the axis; and a tension maintaining part for maintaining the tension of the electron emitting part by applying a pressing force or a stretching force to the movable part. The movable portion and the tension holding portion are disposed on the axis line, respectively.

title_en: Tritium production cladding
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of nuclear materials, and particularly discloses a tritium production cladding which comprises a first wall, sleeves, a neutron multiplier container and a shielding plate, wherein the shielding plate is supported on one side of a vacuum chamber, the neutron multiplier container is supported on one side of the shielding plate far away from the vacuum chamber, the first wall is sleeved outside the neutron multiplier container, the free end of the first wall is fixedly connected to the shielding plate through welding, the sleeves are positioned inside the neutron multiplier container, and a plurality of sleeves are distributed inside the neutron multiplier container at intervals. The tritium production cladding has the advantages of simple structure, high tritium production rate and simple and convenient maintenance, and can effectively improve the tritium proliferation rate of the cladding and reduce the economic cost of consumed materials.

title_en: Diesel engine combustion chamber capable of reducing cooling loss
abstract_en: The invention discloses a diesel engine combustion chamber capable of reducing cooling loss, relates to the field of diesel engines, and solves the technical problem that the extrusion speed of combustion gas is difficult to further reduce due to the restriction of the ratio of the diameter of the combustion chamber to the diameter of a cylinder. The combustion chamber comprises a combustion chamber cavity arranged on a piston, wherein the combustion chamber cavity comprises a secondary combustion chamber and a main combustion chamber; the secondary combustion chamber is arranged at one end close to the cylinder cover of the piston and used for reducing the flow extrusion speed of combustion gas entering the main combustion chamber; the primary combustion chamber is disposed below the secondary combustion chamber. The invention effectively reduces the flow squeezing speed and the dynamic vortex ratio in the cylinder, thereby reducing the cooling loss, having higher relative thermal efficiency and having the potential of reducing the fuel consumption and the thermal load of the piston, the cylinder sleeve and the cylinder cover.

title_en: Ocean wave power generation device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ocean wave power generation, in particular to an ocean wave power generation device which comprises a support column, wherein a generator is fixed at the top end of the support column, a transmission shaft is fixed at the output end of the generator, a bracket is fixedly connected to the top of the support column, a plurality of groups of support assemblies are fixed on the top surface of the bracket in an annular equal-angle crossed manner, and two wave transmission mechanisms are fixedly connected to the top of each support assembly. According to the invention, the plurality of wave blocking plates are arranged on the outer side of the transmission shaft, the directions of the wave blocking plates at different positions are different, the wave blocking plates at different directions are convenient to contact with waves in different directions, the wave blocking plates are pushed to transversely reciprocate by means of the impact force of the waves, and the plurality of wave blocking plates transversely reciprocate and all drive the transmission shaft on the generator to clockwise rotate, so that the electricity generation is realized by utilizing the waves in different directions, the impact force of the waves and the potential energy raised from the water surface at the wave positions are combined to generate electricity, and the efficiency of ocean wave electricity generation is favorably improved.

title_en: Method and system for turbine bypass
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides "methods and systems for turbine bypass". Methods and systems for a turbocharger are provided. In one example, a method may include bypassing exhaust gas flowing to the turbocharger in response to a catalyst temperature being below a threshold temperature. The bypassing includes opening a bypass valve and adjusting a position of one or more turbine nozzle vanes.

title_en: End wall self-adaptive jet device of axial flow compressor
abstract_en: An end wall self-adaptive jet device of an axial flow compressor. The turbine blade is installed on the outer surface of a casing corresponding to the position of the static blade and is a circular gradually-reduced pipeline formed by sweeping along a central line, the central line is formed by fitting a Bezier curve, one end of the central line is an air inlet, the air inlet penetrates through the casing where the front edge of the static blade is located and then is tightly attached to a pressure surface of the static blade, the other end of the central line is an air outlet, and the air outlet penetrates through the casing where the middle part of the axial chord length of the static blade is located and then is close to a suction surface of the static blade. The invention has the following effects: the pressure surface and the suction surface of the stator blade on the axial flow compressor are connected, high-energy jet flow acting on the corner area separation area is formed through the pressure difference between the air inlet and the air outlet, and self-adaptive adjustment can be achieved according to the change of the working condition of the axial flow compressor. Under proper design parameters, the method can effectively act on the angular region flow field of the static blade, reduce the angular region separation range, reduce the total pressure loss, improve the load of the static blade, and improve the total pressure ratio and the isentropic efficiency under the working condition of small flow.

title_en: Reverse single working medium steam combined cycle
abstract_en: The invention provides a reverse single working medium steam combined cycle, belonging to the technical field of thermodynamics, refrigeration and heat pumps. Reverse single working medium steam combined cycle, is formed from M  1  Kilogram and M  2  Eight processes-M-carried out separately or together with one kilogram of working medium  1  The kilogram working medium absorbs heat and is vaporized 12,M  1  Kilogram working medium pressure rising process 23, (M)  1  +M  2  ) Kilogram working medium endothermic process 34, (M)  1  +M  2  ) Kilogram working medium pressure rise process 45, (M)  1  +M  2  ) Kilogram working medium heat release process 56, M  2  Decompression process with kilogram working medium 63,M  1  Kilogram working medium exothermic condensation process 67,M  1  And (5) a kilogram working medium depressurization process 71-a closed process formed.

title_en: Method for activating boost pressure control
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for activating a boost pressure control for a combustion engine (1) comprising, in a flow-through direction, a compressor (3), a boost air line (4), a throttle valve (5), an intake pipe (6), at least one combustion chamber (7) and a turbine (9) coupled to the rotational speed of the compressor (3), wherein the opening area of the throttle valve (5) is controllable, wherein the turbine (9) is controllable by the actuation of an exhaust gas flow, and wherein the method comprises: -presetting (S2) a theoretical intake pipe pressure (p  sr,soll ), -calculating (S3) a simplified backflow amount characteristic curve (L) of the throttle valve (5), -calculating (S3) a pseudo-theoretical opening area (Ã  DK,soll ) of the throttle valve (5) based on the simplified backflow amount characteristic curve (L) and the theoretical intake pipe pressure (p  sr,soll ), and-controlling (S5) the steering of the turbine (9) from the exceeding of the pseudo-theoretical opening area (Ã  DK,soll ) of the throttle valve (5) based on the maximum opening area (a  DK,max ) of the throttle valve (5).

title_en: Low-pollution tower type coaxial grading cyclone for liquid fuel ship
abstract_en: The invention aims to provide a low-pollution tower type coaxial grading cyclone for a liquid fuel ship, which comprises a fuel oil main pipe, a main combustion stage tower type cyclone, a primary axial cyclone, a secondary cyclone and a splash guard, wherein the secondary cyclone is positioned in the primary axial cyclone, the primary axial cyclone is positioned in the main combustion stage tower type cyclone, a venturi is arranged between the main combustion stage tower type cyclone and the secondary cyclone, the fuel oil main pipe is respectively connected with a main combustion stage oil circuit and a duty stage oil circuit, and the rear part of the main combustion stage tower type cyclone is connected with the splash guard. The invention adopts the air atomizing nozzle at the main combustion stage to improve the fuel oil atomizing level, so that the high-temperature oil-gas mixture enters the flame tube along with high-speed airflow, and the spontaneous combustion of the high-temperature oil-gas mixture in the throat is avoided. Meanwhile, the annular wake air is introduced, so that the dependence of the spray penetration distance on the fuel flow can be effectively reduced, and the influence on the penetration force of the liquid drops in the spray center area and the outer edge can be ignored while the liquid drops in the spray near-wall area are lifted.

title_en: Engine camshaft assembly, engine and vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to an engine camshaft assembly, an engine and a vehicle. A decompression groove is arranged at the position tangent to the base circle of the exhaust cam of the camshaft; the pressure reducing piece is movably arranged in the pressure reducing groove, so that the pressure reducing piece has a pressure reducing position and a failure position; the timing chain wheel is coaxially connected with the camshaft; the pressure reducing rocker arm is hinged with the timing chain wheel, the pressure reducing rocker arm is provided with a limiting bulge, the timing chain wheel is provided with a limiting groove, and the limiting bulge slides in the limiting groove when the pressure reducing rocker arm rotates relative to the timing chain wheel so as to limit the pressure reducing rocker arm to rotate between a first position and a second position relative to the timing chain wheel; the pressure reducing transmission structure is in transmission fit with the limiting protrusions between the pressure reducing rocker arm and the pressure reducing part, and the limiting grooves are formed in the timing chain wheel, so that the structure of each part is simpler, the processing difficulty is lower, and the processing cost is reduced.

title_en: Wind power generation device and control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind power generation device and a control method, wherein the device comprises: the ventilating duct is arranged in the hollow bricks of the building wall body to form a through air duct in the adjacent hollow bricks and used for collecting and conveying natural wind; the wind turbine component unit is arranged in the ventilation pipeline and consists of a plurality of blade units, a coaxial transmission device and a gearbox; each blade unit is respectively connected to a corresponding sleeve of the coaxial transmission device; each sleeve is connected with the gearbox through a terminal sawtooth. The methodThe method comprises the following steps: acquiring wind speed data of an area where each wind turbine component unit is located, wherein the area is sequentially arranged in a ventilation pipeline; when the regional wind speed V reaches the minimum generating wind speed V  1  And below the maximum bearing wind speed V  2  When the wind energy is used, the rotating speed of blades of the wind motor component unit is controlled by a power signal feedback method, and the maximum wind energy is obtained; when the regional wind speed exceeds the maximum bearing wind speed V  2  In the meantime, the rotating speed of the blade of the previous wind motor component unit is adjusted to the maximum bearing wind speed V  2  Thereby reducing the regional wind speed V to the maximum bearing wind speed V  2  The following is a description.

title_en: Construction warning board with wind power generation device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of warning boards, in particular to a construction warning board with a wind power generation device, which comprises a warning board, wherein a support is arranged on the bottom surface of the warning board, a plurality of groups of light-emitting diode groups are arranged on the surface of the warning board, a breeze wind power generation set is arranged at the top end of the warning board, an intelligent charge-discharge controller and an energy storage battery are arranged on the surface of the warning board, and the breeze wind power generation set, the intelligent charge-discharge controller, the energy storage battery and the light-emitting diode groups are connected through wires; the beneficial effects are that: the construction warning board with the wind power generation device adopts the wind power generator to convert wind energy into direct current electric energy, the energy storage battery is charged through the intelligent charging and discharging controller, the electric energy of the energy storage battery is output to the light emitting diode group through the intelligent charging and discharging controller, the light emitting diode group is controlled to generate a warning and lighting effect, and the construction warning board is completely powered by the wind energy without commercial power.

title_en: Annular segmented micro-array type wind wave coupling power generation device based on Spar platform
abstract_en: The application discloses combine little array unrestrained coupling power generation facility of annular segmentation based on Spar platform belongs to the power generating equipment field, and it is great that wave energy power generation facility rocks amplitude at sea among the prior art to have ended, and the safety and stability is not enough, and the electricity generation way is single, can not utilize wind energy and wave energy comprehensively, and the less not enough of generating efficiency. In the technical scheme, the oscillating floaters are annularly and uniformly distributed at intervals around the side part of the Spar platform, and slide on the side surface of the Spar platform; the sliding direction of the oscillating floater is parallel to the axis of the Spar platform cylinder; the energy conversion system converts the oscillation energy of the oscillating floater into electric energy; the PTO system adjusts the motion state of the oscillating floater by adjusting the damping parameters of the energy conversion system. The application has the advantages that: the total energy obtaining efficiency and the safety stability are considered, the safety cost of wave energy is reduced, the motion compensation is easy to realize, and the stability of the unit is improved.

title_en: Fault diagnosis method, device and medium for hydraulic gear pump of automobile production line
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of data processing, and discloses a method, a device and a medium for diagnosing faults of a hydraulic gear pump of an automobile production line. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring the current measured pressure of the hydraulic gear pump, and calculating pollution abrasion volumetric efficiency according to the current measured pressure; acquiring vibration signals of the hydraulic gear pump, determining vibration characteristic data of the hydraulic gear pump, and inputting the vibration characteristic data into a data driving fault diagnosis model to obtain a diagnosis result of whether the hydraulic gear pump has faults or not and a corresponding diagnosis accuracy rate; acquiring weight values preset for pollution abrasion volumetric efficiency and diagnosis accuracy respectively; and correcting the diagnosis accuracy corresponding to the diagnosis result according to the pollution abrasion volumetric efficiency, the corresponding weight value, the diagnosis accuracy and the corresponding weight value to obtain corrected diagnosis accuracy, and outputting the diagnosis result and corrected diagnosis accuracy. The invention ensures that the diagnosis accuracy rate better accords with the current performance condition of the hydraulic gear pump.

title_en: Novel heating urea pipe structure in water pipe for diesel engine
abstract_en: The invention provides a novel urea tube heating structure in a water tube for a diesel engine, which comprises an outer water tube and a urea tube, wherein cooling liquid is introduced into the outer water tube, and urea solution is introduced into the urea tube; more than two urea pipes are assembled in the outer water pipe along the direction of the outer water pipe, and the water inlet and outlet directions of the outer water pipe are the same as the axial direction of the outer water pipe; the multi-head type urea pipe is characterized in that one end of the outer water pipe is coaxially communicated with a multi-port connector, a pipe outlet corresponding to the urea pipe is designed on the side wall of the outer water pipe, the head end of the urea pipe is fixedly assembled with the multi-head connector, the tail end of the urea pipe extends out of the pipe outlet, and the tail end of the urea pipe is hermetically assembled with the inner wall of the pipe outlet. The structure heats the urea pipe by utilizing waste heat of the engine, is energy-saving and environment-friendly, and has the advantages that the outer water pipe and the urea pipe are designed in the same direction, so that the structure is the same as the original heat dissipation pipeline, the replacement is convenient, and the pipeline is simple; the piping and assembly process can be greatly simplified.

title_en: Heat dissipation method and device for vehicle retarder
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heat dissipation method and a heat dissipation device for a vehicle retarder, wherein the method comprises the following steps: an auxiliary heat dissipation water tank and an electronic fan are arranged between the engine and the retarder; when high-temperature water in the retarder enters the main radiating water tank, the high-temperature water in the main radiating water tank is cooled by the main fan and then enters the engine; according to the water temperature of the retarder during working, the PWM duty ratio of the electronic fan controller is adjusted, and the high-temperature water flowing into the auxiliary heat dissipation water tank is cooled for the second time through the electronic fan; and (4) dissipating heat of the vehicle retarder by using the water subjected to secondary cooling. This application can increase retarber during operation, promotes the braking security to can adjust fan rotational speed, predict the fan operating time, maintain engine water temperature in reasonable interval, promote fuel economy and use car and experience.

title_en: Compressor rotor blade airfoil
abstract_en: A rotor blade (44) is provided that includes an airfoil (100) having an airfoil shape (150). The airfoil shape (150) has a nominal profile substantially in accordance with Cartesian coordinate values of X, Y and Z set forth in Table I. The Cartesian coordinate values of X, Y and Z are non-dimensional values from 0% to 100% convertible to dimensional distances in distance units by multiplying the Cartesian coordinate values of X, Y and Z by a scaling factor of the airfoil in distance units. The X and Y values, when connected by smooth continuing arcs, define airfoil profile sections at each Z value. The airfoil profile sections at the Z values are joined smoothly with one another to form a complete airfoil shape (150).

title_en: Storage device for storing and/or transporting nuclear fuel assemblies with low cost design
abstract_en: The invention relates to a storage device (1) for transporting and/or storing nuclear fuel assemblies (2), which is intended to be housed in a cavity of a package for transporting and/or storing nuclear fuel assemblies and which comprises adjacent shells (4, 4'), which device comprises a plurality of transverse structures (11) spaced apart by spacers (16) and sleeves (9) each passing through an opening (13) of at least one transverse structure of the plurality of transverse structures (11), each sleeve (9) being made of a flat piece (14a, 14b). According to the invention, in at least one transverse plane of the device passing through the sleeves, at least one of the sleeves has a housing inner delimiting surface (10) formed in part by: -an inner surface (14 a') of a first flat (14 a) comprising boron; and-an inner surface (14 b') of a second flat piece (14 b) free of boron.

title_en: Breathing machine
abstract_en: The present application provides a ventilator. The breathing machine comprises: the air inlet is connected with the first gas pipeline; the high-pressure oxygen inlet is connected with the second gas pipeline; the high-pressure oxygen regulating device is connected in the second gas pipeline at the downstream of the high-pressure oxygen inlet and at the upstream of the mixing chamber; a blower connected in the third gas line downstream of the mixing chamber and upstream of the patient interface; at least one flow sensor connected in the first gas line, the second gas line and/or the third gas line; and at least one pressure sensor connected to the first gas line, the second gas line, and/or the third gas line.

title_en: Anti-overturning ship body with wind driven generator and working method
abstract_en: The anti-overturning ship body with the wind driven generators and the working method thereof are characterized in that at least one wind driven generator is arranged on the ship body, blades of the wind driven generator comprise a plurality of elastic self-adaptive opening and closing window sashes, and the ship body is prevented from overturning by opening the window sashes under strong wind. The invention also discloses a working method of the anti-overturn ship body with the wind driven generator. On one hand, the wind driven generator is arranged on the ship body, the blades of the wind driven generator are designed into the window sashes capable of being opened and closed elastically, and the window sashes are opened automatically under strong wind to avoid the strong wind, so that the impact force borne by the blades can be eliminated, the blades, the tower frame and other parts are protected from being damaged, and the ship body can be prevented from overturning under the strong wind by opening the window sashes; on the other hand, the width of the blade is 3 to 5 times of that of the traditional blade, and the framework of the blade is of a truss structure, so that the blade can be widened on the basis of light weight, the air capture rate of the blade is greatly improved, and the power generation efficiency is further improved.

title_en: Propulsive force generating device and propulsive force generating method
