abstract_en: The invention provides a propulsive force generating device and a propulsive force generating method which can efficiently obtain propulsive force from the rotation motion of a rotating body based on theoretical research and verification experiments. The propulsive force generating device comprises: a female rotating body rotatably disposed; at a rotational angular velocity ω  0  A means for rotationally driving the female rotor; n (n is an integer not less than 1) sub-rotors arranged on the rotor, each of the sub-rotors having a rotation axis in a circumferential direction of the main rotor; using flexible connections to rotate angular velocity omega  1  A unit for rotationally driving the sub-rotor at a rotational angular velocity ω  0  With angular velocity of rotation omega  1  Have the same symbols and satisfy the following formula.

title_en: Mechanical seal of multi-layer slurry pump
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mechanical seal of a multi-level slurry pump, which comprises a pump cover, a rotating shaft, a shaft sleeve, a connecting flange, a movable ring sleeve and a second stationary ring, wherein the end part of the pump cover is provided with an end cover flange; the second stationary ring is arranged on the inner side wall of the pump cover, and the second stationary ring is attached to the end face of the second movable ring; and the mechanical sealing performance of the slurry pump is further improved by arranging a plurality of layers of mechanical sealing structures.

title_en: Bearing cleaning method and bearing cleaning device
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a bearing cleaning method and a bearing cleaning device. The bearing cleaning method may include controlling a first lubrication pump to fill a cleaning agent to a bearing in response to receiving a bearing cleaning instruction, wherein the first lubrication pump is configured to pre-load a specific amount of the cleaning agent for a bearing type, determining whether the first lubrication pump meets a condition to stop filling the cleaning agent to the bearing, and controlling the first lubrication pump to stop filling the cleaning agent to the bearing and controlling a second lubrication pump to fill a lubricant to the bearing in response to the first lubrication pump meeting the condition to stop filling the cleaning agent to the bearing. The on-line cleaning and the automatic grease filling are integrated, so that the efficiency of bearing cleaning is improved, and the economic loss caused by cleaning the bearing by stopping is reduced.

title_en: Fan noise reduction device and aircraft engine comprising same
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fan noise reduction device and an aircraft engine comprising the same, wherein the fan noise reduction device is arranged in a casing, airflow passing through the fan noise reduction device enters a fan, the fan noise reduction device comprises an inner surface flow channel and a noise reduction liner, and the inner surface flow channel is arranged on the inner surface of the casing; the noise reduction lining is arranged on the inner surface flow channel and comprises a resonant cavity, a back plate and a double-inclined-surface sound guide device, and the double-inclined-surface sound guide device is in a sawtooth type or a wave type. The double-inclined-plane sound guide device is a sawtooth type or a wave type, so that the low-frequency large-scale pulsating fluid structure can be accelerated to be broken into a high-frequency small-scale pulsating fluid structure which is easier to dissipate, and the backboard and resonant cavities with different heights integrally act to form an innovative noise reduction effect. The design of the sawtooth type double-bevel sound guide device changes the sound propagation path of noise entering through the small holes, and the heights of all resonant cavities are different, so that the broadband noise reduction effect is formed.

title_en: Method for operating a large engine and large engine
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for operating a large engine and a large engine. The large engine is operable at least in a gas mode in which a certain amount of gas is introduced as fuel into the cylinder, said gas being mixed with scavenging gas and ignited at an air-gas ratio by means of pilot injection to start combustion. During operation in the gas mode, at least one control parameter is determined, which control parameter characterizes the combustion quality in the cylinder, wherein an upper threshold value and/or a lower threshold value is predetermined for the control parameter, and wherein at least one operating parameter is adjusted such that the control parameter is at least as large as the lower threshold value and/or at most as large as the upper threshold value. The at least one operating parameter includes a pilot injection timing that determines a start of the combustion or a combustion speed adjustment for the combustion speed. Furthermore, a large engine is proposed.

title_en: Refrigerating machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a refrigerator, which comprises an evaporator, a compressor, a condenser, a filter and an expansion valve which are sequentially connected to form a closed loop, wherein a high-pressure liquid refrigerant pipeline is connected between the condenser and the expansion valve, one end of the high-pressure liquid refrigerant pipeline, which is far away from the condenser, is provided with a refrigerant turbine, the middle part of the refrigerant turbine is fixedly connected with a main shaft, the front end of the main shaft can penetrate through the high-pressure liquid refrigerant pipeline, the front end of the main shaft is fixedly connected with an exhaust turbine, the front surface of the condenser is provided with a cooling impeller, a transmission structure is arranged between the cooling impeller and the main shaft, an exhaust gas discharge window capable of being opened or closed is arranged in front of the condenser, and one side of the condenser, which is close to the main shaft, is fixedly connected with a waste gas discharge pipe.

title_en: Rotary escalator fishway and operation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fishways, in particular to a rotary escalator fishway, which comprises a fishway wing wall device arranged on a dam surface, wherein a rotary escalator device is arranged between two side wing walls of the fishway wing wall device, the rotary escalator device is fixed between the dam surface and the two side wing walls through a lifter device, a baffle and a power generation assembly are arranged on the surface A of an escalator of the rotary escalator device, water is retained between the rotary escalator device and the dam surface through a water retaining device, and a power control system is arranged on a dam body and provides power support for the rotary escalator device and the lifter device, wherein the lifter device adjusts the height of the rotary escalator device to adapt to different water level heights.

title_en: Cleaning and detecting integrated method for aircraft engine boosting fuel manifold
abstract_en: The invention discloses an integrated cleaning and detecting method for a boosting fuel header pipe of an aircraft engine, which is provided with a booster pump, wherein the booster pump is connected with one end of a conversion valve, the other end of the conversion valve is connected with one end of a liquid integration box, and four pipelines, namely a clean water pipeline, a carbon deposition cleaning liquid pipeline, a coloring cleaning liquid pipeline and a developer pipeline, are uniformly arranged in the liquid integration box; the other end of the liquid integration box is connected with one end of a pipeline system with a nozzle, the other end of the pipeline system with the nozzle extends into a detection position of the afterburner main pipe from a tail nozzle, a residual liquid collecting splash guard is further arranged at the front end of the pipeline system with the nozzle, and the residual liquid collecting splash guard is fixed on a pull rod in the afterburner, so that the invention has the advantages that: the method for realizing the integration of cleaning and nondestructive testing has the advantages of high integration, high testing precision and short time consumption, and greatly facilitates the use and maintenance of the stressing fuel oil main pipe.

title_en: Engine fuel system timing monitoring method based on injection teeth
abstract_en: The invention discloses an injection tooth-based engine fuel system timing monitoring method, which comprises the steps of determining the injection timing, the number of an injection cylinder and the top dead center crankshaft tooth number of the current injection cylinder number of a current engine, and calculating the injection tooth number of a command injection moment according to the injection timing, the number of the injection cylinder and the top dead center crankshaft tooth number of the current injection cylinder number of the current engine; storing a time stamp and a corresponding tooth number of each crankshaft tooth falling edge in real time, and determining the injection tooth number at the actual fuel injection moment; and comparing the injection tooth number of the command injection time with the injection tooth number of the actual fuel injection time, judging whether the difference value between the two exceeds a set value, if not, correctly executing the fuel injection timing, and if so, incorrectly executing the fuel injection timing. The monitoring method designed by the invention can more accurately judge whether the injection timing of the fuel system is correctly executed.

title_en: Take extension board flame holder of trapezoidal rib and triangle lug
abstract_en: The invention relates to a supporting plate flame stabilizer with trapezoidal ribs and triangular lugs, which consists of a V-shaped surface, a straight section, a vertical tail edge and a nozzle, wherein 3-5 pairs of trapezoidal ribs are arranged on two side surfaces of the supporting plate flame stabilizer, and a triangular lug is arranged behind each pair of trapezoidal ribs. The advantages and the obtained beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: the supporting plate flame stabilizer with the trapezoidal ribs and the triangular lugs is adopted in the combustion chamber of the scramjet engine, so that the combustion area is large, the combustion speed is high, and the flow resistance loss is small.

title_en: Method and system for monitoring online state of hydroelectric generating set
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of monitoring of hydroelectric generating sets, and discloses an online state monitoring method of a hydroelectric generating set, which comprises the following steps: a. establishing fuzzy rules and a membership function library of typical symptoms of each sub-neural network; b. expressing the fuzzy rule and the membership function by a neural network; c. training a neural network to modify parameters of the membership functions to obtain an accurate fuzzy rule; d. and extracting the modified membership functions and fuzzy rules from the neural network, and storing the rules and the membership functions in an expert system knowledge base to help explain the internal representation and operation of the neural network. According to the method and the system for monitoring the online state of the water-turbine generator set, on the premise of not disassembling the water-turbine generator set, standard steps and methods are adopted, the accuracy of signal acquisition of each channel of core equipment of the online state monitoring system is verified on site, and the amplitude-frequency analysis function and the alarm logic of software are verified on site, so that the problem of on-site verification of the online state monitoring system of the water-turbine generator set is solved.

title_en: High-pressure submersible pump
abstract_en: The application discloses a high-pressure submersible pump. This high-pressure immersible pump includes: pump main part and high pressure drive division, high pressure drive division are fixed in pump main part through the mount pad, and the both sides of pump main part dispose the pump cover subassembly respectively, be equipped with the cavity in the pump main part, dispose linkage subassembly, first plunger and second plunger in the cavity, first plunger and second plunger parallel arrangement, and both ends imbed respectively in the pump cover subassembly, the linkage subassembly includes: the linkage mechanism comprises a first linkage rod and a shaft, wherein the shaft is arranged in the middle of the first linkage rod, two ends of the first linkage rod are respectively connected with the first plunger and the second plunger, one side end of the first linkage rod is connected with an eccentric wheel device, and the eccentric wheel device is connected with a high-pressure driving part. The high-pressure submersible pump adopts a double-plunger structural design, so that when one plunger moves forwards, the other plunger just moves reversely, the two plungers move forwards and backwards synchronously, and the mutual generated forces just form balance, so that the vibration and noise of the pump are reduced.

title_en: Self-adaptive variable damping wave energy power generation device and method based on friction nano power generation technology
abstract_en: A self-adaptive variable damping wave energy power generation device and method based on a friction nanometer power generation technology belong to the field of wave energy power generation devices. The invention comprises a wave absorbing device, a hydraulic transmission device, a friction nanometer generator, a fixing device and a damping self-adaptive adjusting device; the oscillating float of the wave absorbing device moves up and down with the waves; the hydraulic transmission device transmits a hydraulic signal to the hydraulic motor through a hydraulic pipeline and an energy accumulator, and changes the relative reciprocating motion of the wave absorbing device and the fixing device into rotary motion; the main shaft of the friction nano generator is driven by a rotating shaft of the hydraulic motor to perform rotary friction power generation; the damping self-adaptive adjusting device comprises various sensors, a decision module device and a control module device. The invention introduces a friction nano power generation technology, designs a self-adaptive variable damping wave power generation device, weakens interference factors under various wave states, and increases the power generation efficiency in a wave power generation working interval and a low-frequency wave state.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted air purifier control method, vehicle-mounted air purifier and automobile
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control method of a vehicle-mounted air purifier, the vehicle-mounted air purifier and an automobile, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining the rotation speed gear of the fan, and determining the compensation coefficient of each gear according to the rotation speed gear of the fan; defining the gradual change time of the rotating speed; recording a current rotating speed gear as a first gear; switching the rotating speed of the fan, and taking the switched rotating speed gear as a second gear; constructing a rotation speed gradual change algorithm according to the rotation speed gradual change time, the compensation coefficient of the first gear and the compensation coefficient of the second gear; and adjusting the current compensation coefficient of the fan according to a rotation speed gradual change algorithm, so that the fan gradually changes from the compensation coefficient of the first gear to the compensation coefficient of the second gear within the rotation speed gradual change time. The invention can realize smooth gradual change of the compensation coefficient, so that the change amplitude of the air quality number is not overlarge due to sudden change of the compensation coefficient when the fan switches the rotating speed.

title_en: Cylinder cover and cylinder cover assembly
abstract_en: The invention provides a cylinder cover, which relates to the field of vehicles and comprises: the fuel injector mounting hole and the igniter mounting hole are arranged in the middle area of the cover body at intervals in the first direction; the cover body is also provided with an air inlet valve mounting hole and an air outlet valve mounting hole at intervals along a second direction, the air inlet valve mounting hole and the air outlet valve mounting hole are respectively positioned at two sides of the middle area, and the second direction is vertical to the first direction; along the second direction, at least one side of the middle area is provided with an air compression structure protruding out of the bottom surface of the cover body. The present invention also provides a cylinder head assembly that can improve the combustion efficiency of an engine that ignites and ignites under compression.

title_en: Combustion chamber and gas engine
abstract_en: The invention relates to a combustion chamber and a gas engine, wherein the combustion chamber comprises a combustion chamber pit positioned on the top surface of a piston, the bottom of the combustion chamber pit is provided with a central boss, the circumferential side wall of the combustion chamber pit around the central boss is sequentially provided with a wave-shaped connecting stage and an annular boss section along the direction from the top surface of the piston to the bottom of the combustion chamber, the wave-shaped connecting stage is connected with the annular boss section through an annular conical surface, the annular conical surface is in smooth transition connection with the annular boss section and the wave-shaped connecting stage, the annular conical surface and the wave-shaped connecting stage gradually shrink along the direction from the top surface of the piston to the bottom of the combustion chamber, and the wave-shaped connecting stage is formed by at least two circular arc curved surfaces in smooth transition connection; this combustion chamber utilizes annular boss section and wave to link the design in stage, and the control gas has improved gas and air mixing process along wave even stage rational distribution and water conservancy diversion even, and then improves whole combustion process, improves combustion efficiency, reduces gas consumption rate and soot and discharges, has reduced heat transfer loss through reducing the face-to-face ratio simultaneously.

title_en: Control method of engine supercharging system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control method of an engine supercharging system, which comprises the steps of firstly obtaining a torque demand N1, a real-time torque N2, a current supercharging pressure and a supercharging pressure target value; then calculating a pressure difference value delta P; judging whether N1 is larger than N2; judging whether the delta P is larger than the maximum value of the difference value; if the values are larger than the values of the electric air compressor, starting the electric air compressor; acquiring a target pressure ratio coefficient K1 of an engine and a current pressure ratio coefficient K2 of an electric compressor; judging whether K1 is equal to K2; if the unequal adjustment K2 is close to K1; if the current outlet pressure is equal, the current boost pressure is close to the target value of the boost pressure; judging whether the K1 is in the pressure ratio range or not; if the time length of the K1 in the pressure ratio range is judged to be greater than a preset time length threshold value; and if the pressure is larger than the pressure, stopping the electric compressor. Therefore, the invention enables the current boost pressure to reach the target value of the boost pressure by controlling the electric compressor, and solves the problems of low engine torque, high oil consumption and black smoke emission when the engine runs at low speed.

title_en: Motorcycle ignition and oil tank integrated equipment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of motorcycle fuel tanks and fuel tank locks, and particularly relates to a motorcycle ignition and fuel tank integrated device which comprises a fuel tank, a shell, a plug, a lock cylinder A, a lock tongue, an exhaust mechanism, a sliding sleeve, a limiting rod A, a limiting rod B, a limiting rod C, a winding wheel and the like, wherein the shell is covered on the outer side of the fuel tank with a mounting groove at the lower end, and a gap for draining water and buffering the fuel tank when being impacted is arranged between the shell and the fuel tank. Compared with the motorcycle oil tank lock structure disclosed in patent number 012038873, the motorcycle oil tank lock structure can be opened and closed by the ignition switch lock through the stay cord, the lock state of the lock core A lock tongue is locked by the stop lever C when the stay cord C and the stay cord D are sheared through the cooperation of the unlocking hole on the stop lever A and the stop lever B, and the lock of the lock core lock tongue by the stop lever C can not be unlocked no matter how the stay cord C is pulled, so that the oil inlet of the oil tank can not be opened when an oil thief shears the stay cord C and the stay cord D, and the safety is improved.

title_en: Elastic flange device for mounting ceramic matrix composite mixer
abstract_en: The invention relates to an elastic flange device for mounting a ceramic matrix composite mixer, which aims to solve the technical problems of poor thermal adaptation and poor vibration resistance of a ceramic matrix composite when the ceramic matrix composite mixer is connected with a metal casing. The device comprises a support ring, a lining ring and a mounting screw; the support ring is of a revolving body structure and comprises a casing mounting flange and a mixer mounting flange fixed on the casing mounting flange; the mounting flange of the mixer comprises a plurality of independent elastic connecting sheets, and gaps are formed between the adjacent elastic connecting sheets; the elastic connecting piece is provided with a mixer mounting hole; the inner lining ring is provided with mixer connecting holes which are in one-to-one correspondence with the mixer mounting holes; the mounting screws are in threaded connection with the corresponding mixer mounting holes and the mixer connecting holes. The invention solves the problem of thermal adaptation between metal and composite material, and simultaneously avoids the damage or failure of the ceramic composite material mixer in a vibration environment for a long time.

title_en: Vertical windmill with wind aligning device
abstract_en: The application provides a vertical windmill with a wind aligning device, and belongs to the field of wind power generation. A vertical windmill with a wind-aligning device includes a main shaft, a blade assembly, a sleeve, a wind-aligning device, and a bearing assembly. The vertical windmill is provided with a wind-facing state and a power generation state, the bearing assembly is configured to ensure that the main shaft rotates when the vertical windmill is in the power generation state, the sleeve does not rotate, the sleeve rotates when the vertical windmill is in the wind-facing state, and the main shaft does not rotate.

title_en: Novel turbine expansion power generation all-in-one
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of turbine expansion generators and discloses a novel turbine expansion power generation integrated machine which comprises an air inlet cavity section, an expander cavity section, a generator cavity section and an air collecting cavity section which are sequentially arranged, wherein the air inlet cavity section is used for inputting working medium gas, the expander cavity section is used for conducting expansion work on the working medium gas, a nozzle and an impeller are sequentially arranged in the expander cavity section, the working medium gas is sprayed to the impeller from the nozzle and drives the impeller to rotate, a main shaft is arranged in the generator cavity section, a rotor and a stator are sleeved on the main shaft, the impeller is used for synchronously driving the main shaft to rotate so as to achieve power generation of a generator, a first air hole is formed in a first cover plate, the working medium gas passing through the first air hole flows to a first gap and a second gap according to a preset proportion, and the air collecting cavity section is used for collecting and discharging the working medium gas flowing out of the generator cavity section. The self-cooling device has the advantages of good self-cooling performance, no need of an additional cooling device, simple structure, small volume and good operation stability.

title_en: Fuzzy self-adaptive hydrogen injection control system and method for composite hydrogen injection engine
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fuzzy self-adaptive hydrogen injection control system and a fuzzy self-adaptive hydrogen injection control method for a composite hydrogen injection engine, wherein the system comprises an engine control unit, a supercharger, an air inlet injector, an in-cylinder injector, an air flow sensor, a NOx sensor and an aftertreatment device; the supercharger is connected with an air inlet pipe and an exhaust pipe of the engine; the air flow sensor is arranged on the air inlet pipe; the air inlet injector is arranged on an air inlet pipe between the supercharger and the engine; the in-cylinder injector is mounted in the engine cylinder; the post-treatment device is arranged on the exhaust pipe at the downstream of the supercharger; the NOx sensor is mounted on the exhaust pipe downstream of the aftertreatment device. Compared with the prior art, the hydrogen injection control system is provided with the air inlet injector and the in-cylinder injector, the hydrogen injection mode of the hydrogen engine is switched under different loads in the control method, the hydrogen injection timing, the hydrogen injection quantity of the air inlet injector and the air inflow of the supercharger are adjusted in real time, and the aftertreatment device is matched, so that the NOx emission is reduced.

title_en: Electrohydraulic push rod pump valve integrated assembly
abstract_en: An electrohydraulic push rod pump valve integrated assembly. To improvements to hydraulic integrated lock structures. The valve comprises a valve body, an overflow valve seat, a gear pump assembly and a pump shell, wherein a balance valve hole A/B is symmetrically formed above a main hole of the valve body, oil return channels A/B are respectively formed in the balance valve hole A/B, a throttle oil channel A/B communicated with the main hole and a balance oil channel A/B communicated with the balance valve hole A/B are transversely formed in the throttle valve hole A/B, and working oil channels A/B are respectively formed in hole walls on two sides of a main valve core. The invention breaks through the technical problem of high integration in a limited volume. A pair of balance valve holes and throttle valve holes are designed on the valve block, and are combined with a main hole, a pair of oil inlets, a working oil port and the like, and an oil source and an executing part are connected by combining a bypass pore canal and related valve parts, so that the high-integration of a hydraulic system is realized while the high-efficiency, high-precision and high-reliability operation of the electro-hydraulic push rod is ensured. The invention integrates the overflow, throttling and balance adjusting functions, so that the pressure is stable and the speed and the throttling are sensitive when the system operates.

title_en: Thrust system of liquid rocket engine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a thrust system of a liquid rocket engine, which comprises a plug core, a first bottom main body, a second bottom main body, a third bottom main body and a thrust chamber main body which are fixedly connected in sequence, wherein a flame spraying gap required under the working condition is obtained by controlling the outer diameter of an expanding section and the inner diameter of a reducing section, so as to form an effective throat for spraying high-temperature fuel gas, the molded surface of the expanding section on the plug core and the molded surface of the reducing section on the thrust chamber main body form a pneumatic plug type spraying structure, the large-size flaring structure at the tail part of the thrust chamber main body in the prior art is structurally replaced, the structural weight of a rocket stage is reduced due to the thrust chamber main body structure with shorter length, and under the condition of giving the length of the thrust chamber main body, the effective load of the rocket is greatly increased through the improvement of performance; and no matter the engine is under the sea level, low latitude or high latitude's operating mode, thrust and specific impulse loss can not produced because of the gas underexpansion to the thrust chamber main part.

title_en: Rotary grid type rear duct ejector for variable cycle engine
abstract_en: A rotary grid type rear duct ejector for a variable cycle engine can effectively increase the mixing of inner and outer duct airflow under the low-duct ratio mode of the variable cycle engine, improve the mixing efficiency and further improve the combustion efficiency of an afterburner. Duct ejector adopts 32 rotatory regulation that carry out the area of being located the grid that outer duct exported behind the rotatory grid formula, and outer duct air current passes through from the space between the grid, because the special construction of grid when the air current passes through the grid, can produce the swirl of high strength, and every grid has certain inclination, and the air current of connotation can be fine diffusion to whole mixed section, and the air current misce bene is contained in the messenger of bigger degree, very big reduction the distance of mixing. The trapezoidal grid arranged on the grid has the drainage capacity, so that the total pressure loss can be effectively reduced, the mixing efficiency is improved, and the stable combustion of the afterburner and the good inlet condition of the afterburner are ensured.

title_en: Engine cooling control method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides an engine cooling control method, an engine cooling control system, engine cooling control equipment and a storage medium, wherein the engine cooling control method comprises the following steps: acquiring the real-time temperature of engine cooling liquid; according to the real-time temperature and the working condition of the engine, a cooling component MAP is called, and a cooling component request instruction is output; controlling the cooling assembly to run according to the cooling assembly request instruction; according to the application, the cooling component is called to realize the temperature reduction of the engine cooling liquid according to the real-time temperature of the engine cooling liquid and the working condition of the engine at the temperature; therefore, the damage to the engine caused by overheating due to the overhigh temperature of the engine cooling liquid can be avoided, the probability of the failure of the engine is reduced, and the service life of the engine is prolonged.

title_en: Tandem type diesel engine double-combustion-chamber mechanism
abstract_en: The invention provides a tandem type diesel engine double-combustion-chamber mechanism which comprises a lower cylinder body, wherein a cylinder sleeve is arranged inside the lower cylinder body, a piston cylinder is arranged inside the cylinder sleeve in a sliding manner, the bottom end of the piston cylinder is connected with a crank connecting rod assembly, the top of the lower cylinder body is assembled and connected with a cylinder cover, a piston pit is formed in the middle of the top surface of the piston cylinder, the bottom surface of the cylinder cover and the position, opposite to the piston pit, of the piston pit are thermal surfaces, and an area between the thermal surfaces and the piston pit is a second combustion chamber; and an air guide hole is formed in one side of the cylinder cover, an air inlet and outlet valve is arranged in the air guide hole, and the air inlet and outlet valve is arranged on one side right above the piston pit. According to the invention, under the action of the air squeezing channel, the air pressure of the first combustion chamber is greater than that of the second combustion chamber, and by utilizing the pressure difference between the two combustion chambers, the flame jet flow can generate larger air flow disturbance in the second combustion chamber, so that the combustion is more complete compared with a direct injection diesel engine only provided with the combustion chamber in a piston cylinder, the two-time combustion duration is long, the vibration and the noise of the engine are small, and the emission is good.

title_en: Petiole connection structure of large-scale wind-tunnel blade
abstract_en: The invention discloses a petiole connecting structure of a large wind tunnel blade, which comprises a petiole connected with the blade and a joint, wherein the petiole is provided with a sleeving space with an opening at an inner connecting end, the joint comprises a sleeving section and a fixing section, the sleeving section is positioned in the sleeving space of the petiole, the fixing section extends out of the opening of the sleeving end of the petiole through the sleeving space, and a clamping structure for preventing the sleeving section from axially moving in the sleeving space is arranged between the sleeving section and the inner wall of the sleeving space of the petiole. The petiole and the blade are longitudinally split and buckled into two sections. The advantages are that: the joint and the blade shank can be firmly clamped together, the outer layer is tightly wound by carbon fiber prepreg, and the blade shank can be prevented from being thrown off from the joint in a high-speed rotation state of the blade; the material consumption of the whole wind tunnel fan can be greatly reduced, and the weight of the whole wind tunnel fan can be reduced; the blade can be prevented from twisting in a high-speed rotation state of the blade and stepless adjustment of the blade angle can be realized.

title_en: Filter shell
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of filters, in particular to a filter shell, which comprises a base, a plurality of bolts, a shell body and a mounting mechanism, wherein the bolts penetrate through the base, the shell body is arranged on the base, the mounting mechanism comprises a ring block, a screw rod, a bushing, two connecting blocks, two engaging blocks, two abutting pieces and a pressing piece, the base is provided with a groove, a sliding groove and two abutting grooves, one end of the screw rod penetrates through the shell body and is inserted into the groove, the two engaging blocks are both in sliding connection with the sliding groove, the ring block is fixedly connected with the screw rod, the ring block is in rotary connection with the shell body, the bushing is in threaded fit with the screw rod, one end of the two connecting blocks is hinged with the bushing, the other end of the two connecting blocks is respectively hinged with the corresponding engaging blocks, the pressing piece is detachably connected with the screw rod, and the two abutting pieces are respectively fixedly connected with the corresponding abutting blocks and are arranged in the corresponding abutting grooves.

title_en: Rocker arm type ocean wave energy power generation platform
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the technical field of wave energy power generation devices, and provides a rocker arm type ocean wave energy power generation platform which comprises a support frame, a swinging piece and a rotating piece; the rotating piece is respectively in rotating fit with the supporting frame and the swinging frame; the inner wall of the sliding channel is provided with a first electromagnet; the sliding channel is in sliding fit with a reset piece; the inner bottom surface of the sliding sleeve is provided with a second electromagnet; the sliding sleeve is in sliding fit with the lifting piece; the swinging piece comprises a floater and a swinging arm arranged on the side surface of the floater; the swing arm is in running fit with the rotating piece; a connecting rope is fixedly connected between the lifting piece and the swing arm. The device has solved the rocking arm formula wave energy power generation facility energy transmission link of current fluid pressure type power uptake system and has been many, and the structure is complicated, the low technical problem of generating efficiency for the float can slightly adjust the direction along with the change of wave propagation direction, but make the float automatically regulated turn to the form, but make the float self-adaptation wave propagation direction, improve the float to the wave energy's of ability of utilization.

title_en: Piston structure and have its hydraulic piston pump
abstract_en: The invention provides a piston structure and a hydraulic piston pump with the same, wherein the piston structure comprises a baffle type piston and a hollow cylinder with two open ends; the baffle is arranged in the hollow column body, is connected with the inner wall of the hollow column body along the circumferential direction of the inner wall of the hollow column body, and divides the inner cavity of the hollow column body into a first cavity and a second cavity along the axial direction of the inner cavity of the hollow column body; the baffle plate is arranged on the plunger shaft in a penetrating way, the plunger shaft is provided with an inner cavity, and the axes of the baffle plate, the hollow cylinder and the plunger shaft are overlapped; wherein, a plurality of water distribution ports are uniformly distributed in the circumferential direction of the hollow column body part a corresponding to the first cavity; and a plurality of water distribution ports are uniformly distributed in the circumferential direction of the hollow cylinder part b corresponding to the second cavity. The problems that the hydraulic flow loss in the existing pump is serious, the structural flow distribution window is small, the flow distribution process time is short, the flow velocity of a working medium is too large, cavitation is easy to occur and the like can be solved.

title_en: Method and device for controlling self-starting process of coal-fired generator set
abstract_en: The application relates to a method and a device for controlling a self-starting process of a coal-fired power generation unit. The specific scheme is as follows: in response to receiving a starting instruction of a target process, determining a pre-starting process corresponding to the target process from a plurality of processes according to a pre-set process starting sequence; acquiring operation data of a coal-fired power generation unit; determining whether the pre-start-up process is started normally or not based on the operation data; the method comprises the steps of responding to normal starting of a pre-starting process, and controlling starting of a target process; and in response to the abnormal start of the at least one pre-start process, controlling the at least one pre-start process to start according to a preset process start sequence, and repeatedly executing the step of determining whether the pre-start process starts normally. The method and the device improve the flexibility of starting each process of the coal-fired unit.

title_en: Intelligent diagnosis system for planetary gear set of gearbox of wind generating set
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of wind power generation, and relates to an intelligent diagnosis system for a planetary gear set of a gearbox of a wind generating set. The invention provides an intelligent fault diagnosis system for a planetary gear set of a wind driven generator gearbox, which comprises four modules of interference suppression, algorithm optimization, characteristic enhancement and intelligent diagnosis. Under the action of the system, the vibration signal can remove the interference of the working condition change and the high-frequency vibration of the coupling component through the interference suppression module, select the diagnosis part through the algorithm optimization module and optimize the structure and parameters of the algorithm, highlight the fault characteristics in the signal through the characteristic enhancement module, and diagnose through the intelligent diagnosis module. After diagnosis is finished, the system returns to the algorithm optimization module to diagnose other parts and output a conclusion. Compared with the traditional gearbox fault diagnosis method, the method overcomes the interference of the working condition change of the wind driven generator and the high-frequency vibration of the coupling component, forms a perfect intelligent diagnosis system, and effectively improves the accuracy of fault diagnosis.

title_en: Closed water inlet air temperature adjusting device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a closed water inlet air temperature regulating device which comprises an inlet air preheating unit, an impurity removing unit, a filter screen plate, a cleaning component, an impurity collecting component and a vibrating component, wherein the inlet air preheating unit comprises an inlet air heater shell, an air inlet arranged on the inlet air heater shell, a spraying component arranged inside the inlet air heater shell, the impurity removing unit is arranged inside the inlet air heater shell, the filter screen plate is arranged on the filter screen plate, the impurity collecting component is arranged below the filter screen plate, and the vibrating component is arranged below the filter screen plate. The gas entering the air inlet heater shell can be sprayed and heated by the spraying component, and the gas after being sprayed and heated can be dried by the drying unit, so that the gas entering the gas turbine is effectively preheated, and the efficiency of the gas turbine is improved.

title_en: Gas injector
abstract_en: The present application relates to a gas injector. The gas injector comprises an injection shell, an electromagnet, a first armature, a second armature, a needle valve and an armature spring, wherein the injection shell is provided with a gas inlet and a gas outlet; the electromagnet is arranged in the injection shell and is provided with a first suction part and a second suction part; the first armature is arranged at one end of the electromagnet, which is close to the air inlet; the second armature is arranged between the electromagnet and the first armature; the needle valve spring is elastically connected between the needle valve and the second armature; and three different working conditions are set. The gas injector controls the gas quantity of different sizes, can be applied to the working scene of higher gas medium pressure, has larger flow characteristic, synchronously realizes the control of the gas quantity of the size, and simultaneously adopts two-stage sealing to improve the integral sealing performance of the injector.

title_en: Impeller, impeller assembly, compressor and air conditioning system
abstract_en: The invention provides an impeller, an impeller assembly, a compressor and an air conditioning system, and relates to the technical field of air conditioning systems, wherein the impeller comprises: the fixed wheel cover is arranged on the wheel disc and is communicated with the wheel disc, and the wheel disc and the fixed wheel cover are arranged outside the blade; the fixed wheel cover is far away from the end of the wheel disc and is provided with an avoidance structure, and the avoidance structure is used for providing a movement space for the adjusting piece, so that the size of a gap between the top of the adjusting blade and the adjusting piece is adjusted. The impeller provided by the invention relieves the technical problem that the impeller is in an unstable flow state when the compressor in the related technology is in surge.

title_en: Annular spraying type anti-wear scale-inhibiting underground jet flow drainage device and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of underground jet flow drainage, in particular to a circular jet type anti-wear scale-inhibiting underground jet flow drainage device and a use method thereof. The technical proposal is as follows: an upper annular spraying pump body and a lower annular spraying pump body are arranged in an oil well casing, the upper end of the upper annular spraying pump body is connected with an oil pipe, the upper annular spraying pump body and the lower annular spraying pump body are connected through an intermediate oil pipe, the lower part of the lower annular spraying pump body is connected with a lower oil pipe, a leather cup seal is arranged between the lower oil pipe and the oil well casing, and a lower check valve is arranged at the lower end of the lower annular spraying pump body; the beneficial effects are that: the invention adopts a liquid flow mixing mass transfer transduction lifting structure of the power liquid at the outer circle and the pumped stratum liquid at the inner circle, effectively reduces the problem that the stratum liquid wears the inner wall of the pump body, and in addition, as the power liquid adopts a circular spraying structure, the flow rate of the power liquid is increased in a narrow space in the pit, thereby improving the liquid production amount; in addition, the invention reduces the occurrence of blockage of the nozzle by sand bridging, improves the sand discharging and blocking removing capability, prolongs the service life and enhances the durability.

title_en: Diesel engine control method and device based on combination of LSTM algorithm and PID
abstract_en: A diesel engine control method and device with feedback based on LSTM algorithm and PID, relates to the technical field of diesel engine rotational speed control, solves the technical problem of how to provide a diesel engine control method which can be applied to an initial state and has high accuracy, and comprises the steps of collecting diesel engine parameters; the method comprises the steps of inputting diesel engine parameters into an LSTM network for iterative training until a predicted rotating speed meeting preset requirements is obtained, carrying out difference between the predicted rotating speed meeting the preset requirements and the actual rotating speed at the last moment and inputting the difference into a PID network to obtain an optimal rotating speed, and carrying out prediction in a feedback link by adopting an LSTM algorithm and obtaining the optimal rotating speed together with a PID control algorithm to control the diesel engine.

title_en: Screw rotor molded line for high-flow high-pressure differential compression
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of energy power, in particular to a screw rotor molded line for high-flow high-pressure difference compression, wherein the tooth ratio of an asymmetric male rotor and an asymmetric female rotor is 5:7; the rotor molded line is designed to be a curve comprising a plurality of sections of continuous conductive elliptical arcs, quadratic curves and circular arc envelope curves; the curve curvature in different sections of the screw rotor molded line is determined by combining the actual working pressure state between rotor teeth, so that the workability of the precise molded line is realized, and the meshing gap is reduced to improve the volumetric efficiency. The integral molded line adopts a hydrodynamic design, has no common points, straight lines and cycloids in the traditional molded line, avoids the connection similar to sharp points, and solves the reliability problems of rotor rigidity, rotor dynamics and the like caused by high linear speed of a rotor under a high-flow working condition.

title_en: Double-stage series control method for Roots vapor compressor
abstract_en: The invention provides a two-stage serial control method of a Roots vapor compressor, which specifically comprises a test run starting control method of the Roots vapor compressor; the start-up control method of the Roots vapor compressor; a method for controlling the normal operation of a Roots vapor compressor; the alarm protection interlocking control method for the Roots vapor compressor during normal operation; the method for controlling the lock of the shutdown alarm protection in normal operation of the Roots vapor compressor comprises the steps that when a shutdown alarm protection condition is met, an alarm indicator is lightened and gives out an audible alarm, a shutdown signal is transmitted to a DCS, an electric butterfly valve is opened, a variable frequency motor and a variable frequency motor cooling fan are closed after the shutdown signal is completely released, all electromagnetic valves are closed, and cooling water is closed. The intelligent control degree of the double-stage series control of the Roots vapor compressor is improved, and the normal operation of the Roots vapor compressor is effectively protected.

title_en: Capsule tumbler type wave energy piezoelectric power generation device
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of wave energy power generation, and provides a capsule tumbler type wave energy piezoelectric power generation device which comprises a wave energy primary transduction structure consisting of a tumbler head, a fixed upper base, a supporting cylinder, a guide pillar, a floating column, a fixed lower base and a tumbler base, and a piezoelectric power generation system consisting of a shell, a piezoelectric cantilever beam, a spring and a magnet block, wherein the center of the shell is vertically penetrated by the guide pillar and the floating column; the spring housing is outside the guide pillar, and the magnet piece bonds in piezoelectricity cantilever beam free end and float post side, has on the outer disc of float post with magnet piece complex mounting groove, and magnet piece on the float post is annular equidistance array overall arrangement, and piezoelectricity cantilever beam is annular equidistance on the casing and sets up with the magnet piece on the float post relatively. The invention solves the technical problems of lower total power generation efficiency of the wave energy device, non-compact structure of the piezoelectric power generation device and inconvenient assembly, and achieves the technical effects of prolonged service life, convenient assembly, compact structure and high overall power generation efficiency.

title_en: Zero-leakage sealing groove structure for end face sealing of aviation gear pump
abstract_en: The invention discloses a zero-leakage sealing groove structure for end face sealing of an aviation gear pump. Because the end face of the aviation gear pump is processed with certain flatness tolerance and a gap with certain width is formed between the end faces, the invention can effectively avoid the fuel leakage from the gap of the end face of the aviation gear pump. The end face sealing groove of the gear pump designed by the invention is a circular sealing groove, a pressure balancing groove structure is designed at the inner side of the sealing groove, the inward depth of the sealing groove is t3, the height is h1, and the structure realizes that the pressure applied to the sealing ring within 360 degrees is kept balanced; two sealing inclined plane structures are designed in the sealing groove, the included angle between the sealing inclined plane 1 and the horizontal plane is theta 1, the included angle between the sealing inclined plane 2 and the vertical plane is theta 2, and the sealing ring can be prevented from creeping in the sealing groove by the structure. The packing rate of the sealing ring is adjustable, the direction of the pressing force of the sealing ring is more reasonable, the pressing and positioning effects of the sealing ring are improved, and the breathing phenomenon of the sealing ring of the aviation gear pump is avoided. The invention realizes zero leakage of the end face of the aviation gear pump, improves the reliability of the aviation gear pump and prolongs the service life of the aviation gear pump.

title_en: Wear-resistant ceramic impeller
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wear-resistant ceramic impeller which mainly comprises an impeller body and a lining plate, wherein the impeller body comprises blades, a front cover plate and a rear cover plate, and the lining plate comprises a blade lining plate, a front lining plate and a rear lining plate. The front lining plate is arranged on the front side surface of the runner and fixedly connected with the front cover plate, the rear lining plate is arranged on the rear side surface of the runner and fixedly connected with the rear cover plate, the blade lining plate is arranged on the working surface of the runner and fixedly connected with the blade, and a low-stress coupling structure for reducing looseness and cracking is further arranged between the front lining plate and the front cover plate and between the rear lining plate and the rear cover plate. The invention has the advantages of high wear resistance, high reliability and long service life.

title_en: Vacuum pump
abstract_en: The invention provides a vacuum pump capable of effectively inhibiting performance degradation caused by thermal expansion. The vacuum pump is provided with an outer casing (203), a rotor (103), a screw groove stator (131), and a screw groove (131 a), wherein the outer casing (203) is provided with an air inlet (101), the rotor (103) is enclosed in the outer casing (203) and rotatably supported, the screw groove stator (131) is arranged on the outer periphery of the rotor (103) and takes a substantially cylindrical shape, the screw groove (131 a) is engraved on at least one of the outer peripheral surface of the rotor (103) or the inner peripheral surface of the screw groove stator (131), the rotor (103) is rotated, the air sucked from the air inlet (101) side is discharged to the outside of the outer casing (203), a limiting mechanism (220) is arranged on the outer periphery of the screw groove stator (131), and the limiting mechanism (220) is formed of a material having a lower linear expansion coefficient than the material of the screw groove stator (131), so that the radial deformation of the screw groove stator (131) during thermal expansion is reduced.

title_en: Zero cold water terminal controller and zero cold water system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a zero cold water terminal controller and a zero cold water system, comprising: a valve body and a water flow generator arranged on the valve body; the utility model is characterized in that, be provided with hot water inlet on the valve body, cold water inlet, hot water delivery port, cold water delivery port are connected with communicating pipe between hot water inlet and cold water delivery port and cold water inlet be equipped with on the communicating pipe be used for controlling the stop valve of communicating pipe break-make, the rivers generator includes: the device comprises a valve body, a first water wheel arranged in the valve body and close to a hot water inlet, a second water wheel arranged in the valve body and close to a cold water inlet, and a generator, wherein the first water wheel is in transmission connection with the generator through a first unidirectional transmission assembly, and the second water wheel is in transmission connection with the generator through a second unidirectional transmission assembly. The power supply problem of the terminal controller of the zero cooling water system is solved, and the power generation frequency and the power generation capacity are improved.

title_en: Environment-friendly ammonium phosphate salt dry powder extinguishing agent and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an environment-friendly ammonium phosphate salt dry powder extinguishing agent, and belongs to the technical field of extinguishing agents. The ammonium phosphate salt dry powder extinguishing agent comprises the following specific components: 80-100 parts of monoammonium phosphate, 20-30 parts of ammonium sulfate, 3-15 parts of sodium chloride, 8-10 parts of calcium chloride, 3-10 parts of magnesium hydroxide, 20-30 parts of modified attapulgite, 8-15 parts of quartz sand, 10-18 parts of silicone oil, 5-8 parts of modified vermiculite, 5-15 parts of modified gadolinium oxide and 5-15 parts of filler. According to the invention, the attapulgite is modified, and the modified attapulgite is added into the dry powder extinguishing agent, so that not only can the toxic and harmful substances generated by combustion in the fire process be adsorbed, but also the anti-afterburning performance of the extinguishing agent can be enhanced. By adding the modified vermiculite, the dry powder extinguishing agent has certain cooling performance. By adding modified gadolinium oxide, the shielding effect on gamma rays and neutrons is achieved.

title_en: Drainage pump control system, drainage pump control method, drainage pump control device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a drainage pump control method which comprises the steps of obtaining a water collecting well water level, determining the number of drainage pumps to be started based on the water collecting well water level in response to the water collecting well water level meeting preset water level conditions, determining the value of a pump starting mark to be a first preset value in response to the number of the drainage pumps to be started not meeting the first preset condition, determining the value of the pump starting mark to be a second preset value in response to the number of the drainage pumps to be started meeting the first preset condition, determining a first target drainage pump based on preset starting rules, determining historical operation records of the first target drainage pumps, wherein the preset starting rules are related to all the drainage pumps, determining the value of a pump stopping mark to be the second preset value in response to the water collecting well water level not meeting preset water level conditions, sequentially determining the second target drainage pumps based on preset pump stopping rules, and sequentially stopping the second target drainage pumps until the number of the current operation drainage pumps meets the preset number conditions.

title_en: Micro-mixing nozzle structure with staggered outlet speeds and combustion chamber
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of jet propulsion, and provides a micro-mixing nozzle structure with staggered outlet speeds and a combustion chamber. The micro-mixing nozzle structure comprises a mounting seat and a first nozzle unit, wherein the first nozzle unit comprises a plurality of premixing micro-pipes which are arranged side by side, one part of the premixing micro-pipes is a datum-position premixing micro-pipe, the other part of the premixing micro-pipes is a staggered-position premixing micro-pipe, the premixing micro-pipe is provided with an inlet end, an outlet end and a gas channel along the axial direction of the premixing micro-pipe, the inlet end is provided with an oxidant inlet, the side wall of the premixing micro-pipe is provided with a fuel inlet communicated with the gas channel, and the effective areas of the oxidant inlets corresponding to the staggered-position premixing micro-pipe and the datum-position premixing micro-pipe are different, so that the jet flow speeds of the outlet ends of the staggered-position premixing micro-pipe and the datum-position premixing micro-pipe are different. According to the invention, different premixed microtubes are staggered according to jet flow speed, so that staggered arrangement of flame delay time of different premixed microtubes is realized, combustion oscillation is effectively inhibited, and flame combustion stability can be ensured.

title_en: Self-sealing oil pan
abstract_en: The application provides a self-sealing oil pan applied to the field of engine oil pans, wherein through the matching arrangement of an upper sealing ring and a compensation sealing ring, when the oil pan is connected with a crankcase, the upper sealing ring is extruded by a connecting surface and can deform inwards towards the compensation sealing ring so as to enable the upper sealing ring to be in extrusion contact with the compensation sealing ring, the compensation sealing ring can deform downwards to a certain extent, when the upper sealing ring is sealed and damaged, the compensation sealing ring can gradually recover deformation so as to generate upward pushing force on the inner changing ring, the tightness between the upper sealing ring and the crankcase due to damage is effectively compensated, in addition, in the process of gradually recovering the deformation of the compensation sealing ring, the extrusion force of sealing assisting liquid received by a sealing measuring ring is gradually reduced so as to gradually recover the deformation, and at the moment, the force measuring ring generates obvious data change, thereby timely playing a reminding role on workers, and effectively reducing potential safety hazards compared with the prior art.

title_en: Prefabricated wind power tower drum, construction method thereof and bending-resistant bearing capacity calculation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a prefabricated wind power tower cylinder, a construction method thereof and a bending-resistant bearing capacity calculation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of wind power generation, wherein the prefabricated wind power tower cylinder comprises prefabricated sections, the prefabricated sections are hollow cylindrical structures, and the prefabricated sections are fixedly spliced by a plurality of fragments; a plurality of prefabricated sections are vertically fixed and spliced in sequence to form a wind power tower barrel structure; the method for calculating the bending bearing capacity of the prefabricated wind power tower can be used for calculating the bending bearing capacity of the horizontal joint.

title_en: Pump body front end cover and pump body displacement prevention structure and pump
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pump body front end cover, which comprises a front end cover body of an integral stretching and shaping structure, wherein a pump body limiting ring is integrally bent on the edge of the front end cover body, a pump body matching structure is arranged on the front end cover body along the radial direction towards the center, and the pump body limiting ring and the pump body matching structure are matched to form a pump body sealing limiting ring groove. Pump body displacement prevention structures and pumps are also disclosed. This pump body front end housing through carrying out integrative tensile plastic preparation to the front end housing body, has guaranteed the accuracy of size, has effectively promoted the reliability of assembly, and the material that rust resistance is good does not need subsequent processing, also does not need surface rust prevention, can realize the long-term effective rust prevention of front end housing. The pump body is limited through the pump body limiting ring so as to prevent the pump body from generating displacement due to water pressure, the service performance of the pump is greatly improved, the inner periphery of the front end cover of the pump body is sealed through the pump body matching structure, the sealing effect is guaranteed, and the strength of the front end cover is also improved.

title_en: Double-pendulum vibration energy collector
abstract_en: The application discloses a double-pendulum vibration energy collector. The application adopts a two-section pendulum structure, and amplifies the movement of the swing rod through the movement of the U-shaped connecting rod, thereby improving the energy output efficiency of the device; on the other hand, a plurality of mounting holes are uniformly distributed at the tail end of the swing rod at intervals, and the resonance frequency of the distance adjusting device from the pendulum to the rotating shaft can be adjusted, so that the frequency working range of the device is widened, the adaptability to the environmental vibration frequency is enhanced, and the existing vibration energy collecting device is improved and enriched.

title_en: Electronic hydraulic pressure initiative clearance self-adaptation mechanism of comb tooth seal
abstract_en: The application provides a comb seal electro-hydraulic active clearance self-adaptive mechanism, which comprises an eddy current sensor front-end processor, a current amplifier, an engine main shaft, and a comb seal piece and a static casing which are sequentially sleeved outside the engine main shaft; the comb teeth sealing piece is provided with a plurality of voltage type electric vortex sensors, the stationary casing is provided with a plurality of mounting grooves, and the mounting grooves are internally provided with a miniature motor and a miniature hydraulic pump. The application converts the change of the gap between the engine main shaft and the rotor when the engine main shaft eccentrically rotates into a voltage signal, converts the voltage signal into current through the eddy current sensor front-end processor, drives the micro motor to rotate to provide supporting power for the micro hydraulic pump, realizes that the gap between the comb teeth sealing piece and the engine main shaft is kept unchanged, and achieves the self-concentricity purpose of the engine main shaft and the comb teeth sealing piece.

title_en: Control device for vehicle
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a control device for a vehicle, which is capable of reducing the size of an electric oil pump device while supporting the starting of an engine using a starter motor. In the case where the output voltage of the power supply device is reduced in association with cranking, the electric oil pump device can be operated normally without using a high-function device that can be operated even when the voltage is reduced in the electric oil pump device. This makes it possible to reduce the size of the electric oil pump device while supporting the starting of the engine using the starter motor.

title_en: System and method for controlling wind farm operation during low grid conditions
abstract_en: A method for controlling wind farm operation during weak grid conditions includes determining when a threshold number of a plurality of wind turbines have tripped based on one or more inputs received. Further, the method includes determining a sampled power output of the wind farm based on the received sensor data after determining that the threshold number of the plurality of wind turbines have tripped. In addition, the method includes, after determining that the threshold number of the plurality of wind turbines has tripped, controlling operation of one or more of the plurality of wind turbines that have not tripped such that a power output of the one or more of the plurality of wind turbines that have not tripped is less than or equal to the sampled power output.

title_en: Exhaust gas recirculation system, power assembly and vehicle
abstract_en: The application relates to an exhaust gas recirculation system, a power assembly and a vehicle, wherein the exhaust gas recirculation system comprises a catalyst, an air inlet manifold, an exhaust gas pipeline, an air taking sleeve and an air taking pipeline, and the catalyst is used for receiving exhaust gas generated by an engine cylinder; the air inlet manifold is used for communicating the throttle valve with the engine cylinder; the air outlet of the waste gas pipeline is communicated with the air inlet manifold; a mounting channel is formed in the gas taking sleeve, the catalyst passes through the mounting channel and is fixedly connected with the mounting channel, and a closed gas taking cavity is formed in the side wall of the mounting channel; an air inlet of the waste gas pipeline is communicated with the air taking cavity; the gas taking pipeline is arranged on the side wall of the installation channel, one end of the gas taking pipeline is communicated with the gas taking cavity, and the other end of the gas taking pipeline is communicated with the inside of the catalyst. The application can buffer the waste gas in the gas-taking cavity before the waste gas enters the waste gas pipeline so as to reduce the fluctuation of the pressure of the waste gas, thereby stabilizing the flow of the waste gas in the waste gas pipeline and stabilizing the waste gas after the waste gas enters the gas-taking manifold.

title_en: Device for generating kinetic energy by changing moment through magnetic force
abstract_en: The invention relates to a device for generating kinetic energy by changing moment through magnetic force, which is characterized by comprising a frame body, a central shaft arranged on the frame body and a cylinder barrel frame body which is in rotary fit with the central shaft; the upper beam and the lower beam of the frame body are respectively fixedly provided with a magnet; the central shaft is fixed on the middle beam of the frame body and cannot rotate, an upper magnet frame and a lower magnet frame are respectively and fixedly arranged on the upper part and the lower part of the central shaft, and magnets are respectively and fixedly arranged at the top end and the bottom end of the upper magnet frame and the lower magnet frame; the cylinder barrel frame body rotates by taking the central shaft as an axis, a plurality of cylinders are arranged on the cylinder barrel frame body in an annular array, pistons are arranged in the cylinders, and a piston inner magnet and a piston outer magnet are arranged at two ends of each piston. The invention makes the pistons in the two cylinder barrels rotating to the upper and lower parts of the central shaft move upwards under the action of magnetic force through the magnets fixedly arranged on the upper and lower beams of the frame body and the upper and lower magnet frames of the central shaft, so that the piston at one side of the central shaft is always far away from the central shaft, the piston at the other side of the central shaft is always close to the central shaft, and the kinetic energy is generated by utilizing the gravity difference generated by the pistons at the two sides of the central shaft.

title_en: Connection system for attaching a blade access system to a nacelle of a wind turbine and method of use
abstract_en: A blade access system (24) includes a support frame (28), the support frame (28) configured to be coupled to a nacelle (14) of a wind turbine (10), the support frame (28) having at least one connection member (42), the connection member (42) configured to be selectively attached to and detached from at least one connection member (40) included in the nacelle (14). The nacelle (14) includes at least one connection member (40), the at least one connection member (40) being configured to be coupled to at least one connection member (42) of a support frame (28) of the blade access system (24). The at least one support frame connection member (42) is configured to cooperate with the at least one nacelle connection member (40) to define an unlocked position configured to allow the support frame (28) to be attached to the nacelle (14) and to allow the support frame (28) to be detached from the nacelle (14), and a locked position configured to prevent the support frame (28) from being detached from the nacelle (28). A method of connecting a blade access system (24) to a nacelle (14) is also disclosed.

title_en: Non-rotating particle separator and aeroengine
abstract_en: The application discloses a non-rotating particle separator, wherein the inner wall of the non-rotating particle separator is arranged in a rotating surface, and the position with the largest distance between the inner wall and a rotating center line forms a vertex; the outer wall is arranged outside the inner wall in a surrounding manner, a separation channel is formed by surrounding the outer wall and the inner wall, one end of the separation channel is an inlet, the other end of the separation channel is an outlet, and the sectional area of the separation channel is gradually increased from the vertex position to the inlet and the outlet; the flow dividing piece is arranged at the outlet end of the separation channel and divides the outlet of the flow dividing channel into a cleaning channel close to the outer wall and a gas channel close to the inner wall; the inner wall forms a windward surface from the top position of the inlet of the separation channel, an exhaust port is arranged on the windward surface, a leeward surface is formed at the top position of the outlet of the separation channel, an air suction port is arranged on the leeward surface, an air guide channel is arranged between the air suction port and the exhaust port, the air guide channel is positioned outside the separation channel, and a pumping device for conveying air of the air suction port to the exhaust port is arranged in the air guide channel. The application solves the technical problem of contradiction between air inlet loss and fine sand separation efficiency, and has less influence on the air inlet loss while improving the fine sand separation efficiency.

title_en: Screw pump
abstract_en: The application discloses a screw pump, and belongs to the technical field of screw pumps; the screw pump includes: the device comprises a pump shell, a sealing seat, a driving shaft, an elastic ejector and a sealing sleeve; an output window is formed in the pump shell, the driving shaft penetrates through the output window, and the driving shaft is provided with a conical frustum part coaxially arranged on the driving shaft; the sealing seat is provided with a sealing through hole, the driving shaft penetrates through the sealing through hole, and the sealing seat is arranged in the pump shell so as to seal the output window; an inner conical surface is formed on the inner wall of the sealing sleeve, the sealing sleeve is sleeved on the conical frustum part and is in sealing butt joint with the inner wall surface of the sealing through hole, the inner conical surface is in butt joint with the outer conical surface of the conical frustum, and the diameter change trend of the inner conical surface is consistent with that of the conical frustum along the axial direction of the driving shaft; the elastic ejector is elastically abutted between the sealing seat and the sealing sleeve. The screw pump provided by the application has good sealing performance and sealing life.

title_en: Centrifugal fan with airflow self-dedusting function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a centrifugal fan capable of automatically removing dust by airflow, which comprises a centrifugal fan main body and a dust screen, wherein the centrifugal fan main body comprises a main shell, an impeller, a rotating motor, a rotating shaft, an air inlet and an air outlet. This kind of air current is from centrifugal fan who removes dust, through the dust removal mechanism who sets up, because the back shaft passes through the pulley group linkage with the axis of rotation for at axis of rotation pivoted in-process, back shaft, worm rotate together, make worm wheel, the axis of rotation, the dust removal brush rotates together, thereby can be convenient for realize the clearance to dust and impurity on the dust screen through the dust removal brush, and then can prevent dust and impurity adhesion pile up on the dust screen and lead to its ventilation effect bad, through this kind of structure, can make this kind of air current from the centrifugal fan who removes dust need not the condition of inspection dust removal mechanism of operating personnel's for the operation process is comparatively simple and convenient, and reduced the frequency of dismantling the dust screen, make can improve work efficiency to a certain extent.

title_en: Method and device for coping with boron misdilution risk
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for coping with the risk of boron misdilution, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1: identifying a boron misdilution source and a risk of the boron misdilution source introduced by a commissioning coolant degassing system from a definite theoretical angle in a full range; s2: the operation state combination of the main pump and the waste heat discharge pump and the mixing condition thereof are combined to classify the type of the boron misdilution accident; s3: analyzing a plurality of physical phenomena caused by each type of boron misdilution accident type in different operation stages of the unit; s4: according to physical phenomena and based on the existing system configuration scheme, corresponding preventive measures are formulated in a targeted manner: s5: corresponding protection measures are formulated in a targeted manner according to physical phenomena and based on the deep defense concept. The method and the device for coping with the boron misdilution risk can save a key path, improve the availability of the unit, ensure that the coolant degassing system can be restarted to carry out degassing after the waste heat discharging system is connected in the unit downlink period until the cooling system is opened, and avoid introducing the boron misdilution risk.

title_en: Rotation monitor for shielding pump
