abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of canned motor pumps, in particular to a canned motor pump rotation monitor, which comprises a shell, a main shaft, a reciprocating screw rod, a limiting plate, a first pressure sensor and a second pressure sensor, wherein the main shaft is positioned in the shell, and one end of the main shaft is coaxially provided with a thread groove; one end of the reciprocating screw rod is inserted into the thread groove, and the other end of the reciprocating screw rod is connected with a sliding rod; the limiting plate is arranged in the shell, and a limiting hole for the sliding rod to penetrate is formed in the limiting plate; the first pressure sensor is rotationally connected to the limiting plate through a connecting piece, and is positioned at one end of the sliding rod far away from the main shaft, and the pressure sensor is electrically connected with the control center; the second pressure sensor is arranged on the inner wall of the shell, is positioned at one end of the first pressure sensor far away from the sliding rod, and is electrically connected with the control center. The application has the effect of improving the accuracy of monitoring the rotation speed of the pump by the monitoring device.

title_en: EGR cooler, control system of EGR cooler and control method of EGR cooler
abstract_en: The application relates in particular to an EGR cooler, a control system of the EGR cooler and a control method thereof, wherein the EGR cooler comprises a main body, a cleaning assembly and a cooling piece. The main body is provided with an air inlet chamber, a cleaning chamber, a cooling chamber and an air outlet chamber which are sequentially communicated. The cleaning component is arranged in the cleaning chamber and comprises a heating piece and a filtering piece, the heating piece is arranged close to the air inlet chamber and used for heating air flowing out of the air inlet chamber, the filtering piece is arranged close to the cooling chamber, a plurality of filtering pipelines are arranged on the filtering piece, and the plurality of filtering pipelines supply air to flow to the cooling chamber. The cooling member is disposed in the cooling chamber. According to the EGR cooler, the filter piece and the heating piece are sequentially arranged on the air inlet side of the cooling piece, so that pollution of soot to the cooling piece is reduced, the risk of blockage of the cooling piece is reduced, and waste gas can be subjected to heating treatment, so that carbon attached to the filter piece can be removed from the heated waste gas, and self-cleaning of the EGR cooler is realized.

title_en: Built-in circulation heat radiation structure of pump and this kind of pump
abstract_en: The invention relates to a built-in circulating heat dissipation structure of a pump, which at least comprises a liquid separation inner sleeve, an end cover butted with a port of the liquid separation inner sleeve, a main shaft, a magnetic core rotor, a pump cavity and a pump impeller, wherein: at least one hollow runner penetrating through two ends of the magnetic core rotor is arranged in the magnetic core rotor, and a gap is formed between the outer wall of the magnetic core rotor and the inner wall of the liquid separation inner sleeve; at least one group of through holes which are communicated with the pump cavity and the inside of the liquid separation inner sleeve are formed in the end cover; the hollow runner of the magnetic core rotor, the gap between the outer wall of the magnetic core rotor and the inner wall of the liquid separation inner sleeve, the through hole and the pump cavity form a heat dissipation runner for liquid circulation. The built-in circulating heat dissipation runner and the structure thereof of the pump have built-in liquid flow space communicated with the pump cavity and a power structure for forcedly pushing liquid to flow, so that the heat dissipation effect and the self-cleaning effect of the pump can be greatly enhanced, the working stability of the pump and the motor can be ensured, the service life of the pump and the motor can be prolonged, the power of the pump and the motor can be further increased, and the market requirement can be better met.

title_en: Adjustable air-clamping direct-injection device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an adjustable air-clamping direct-injection device, belongs to the field of internal combustion engine accessories, and solves the problem that the universality of parts is reduced because an aptamer is required to be independently replaced aiming at engines with different displacement of the existing air-clamping direct-injection device. The novel fuel oil mixing device comprises a fuel oil nozzle, an air clamping nozzle and an adapter body, wherein an oil duct, an upper premixing cavity, an adjusting hole and a lower premixing cavity are respectively arranged in the adapter body, the oil duct, the upper premixing cavity, the adjusting hole and the lower premixing cavity are sequentially communicated, the oil duct is communicated with an oil injection port of the fuel oil nozzle, the lower premixing cavity is communicated with an air inlet of the air clamping nozzle, a compressed air interface communicated with the lower premixing cavity is further arranged on one side of the adapter body, a detachable adjusting column is arranged in the adjusting hole in a sealing mode, and a runner communicated with the upper premixing cavity and the lower premixing cavity is arranged in the adjusting column. The adjustable air-clamping direct-injection device is matched with different engine requirements, and the universality of parts and the accuracy of early-stage test verification are greatly improved.

title_en: Supercritical carbon dioxide circulating power generation system and method based on spectrum modulation
abstract_en: A supercritical carbon dioxide circulating power generation system and method based on spectrum modulation, the system is composed of a solar heating part, a carbon dioxide storage part, a compression part and a power generation part; the solar heating part comprises a radiation heater and a mirror field; the carbon dioxide storage section includes an energy balancer 2; the compression part comprises a driving motor, a compressor, a cooler and a heat regenerator; the power generation part comprises a turbine and a generator. According to the invention, the solar visible spectrum is regulated to an infrared band capable of absorbing carbon dioxide by utilizing the spectrum modulation coating, the solar rapid heating characteristic is utilized by utilizing solid particles to absorb solar energy, the carbon dioxide is rapidly heated to a high temperature state by means of radiation coupling convection and then participates in power generation circulation, and meanwhile, the supercritical energy balancer is arranged for balancing solar energy intermittence and recycling of waste electricity at night.

title_en: Combined pedal type pedal power generation device and house park intelligent street lamp and urban road intelligent street lamp comprising same
abstract_en: The invention relates to a combined plate type pedal power generation device, and a residential park intelligent street lamp and an urban road intelligent street lamp comprising the same.A supporting ring is arranged at the center of the bottom surface of a pedal, the supporting ring is arranged in a columnar structure, and a spherical cavity is formed at the center of the inside of the supporting ring; the intelligent street lamp comprises a fixed plate, a spherical cavity, a spherical magnet, an annular coil, a combined plate type pedal generating device, a residential park intelligent street lamp and an urban road intelligent street lamp, wherein the annular coil is wound along the inner wall of the spherical cavity, the spherical magnet is arranged in the center of the surface of the fixed plate, the spherical magnet is embedded in the spherical cavity around which the annular coil is wound, when a pedal plane is pedal, the side edge of the pedal inclines to the matched side edge of the fixed plate, the annular coil in the magnetic field of the spherical magnet generates induced current, and the intelligent street lamp comprises the combined plate type pedal generating device. The invention solves the problems of high energy consumption, inconvenient operation and maintenance, untimely monitoring of traffic accidents in urban roads, inaccurate tracking and positioning of escaped vehicles, insufficient energy of new energy vehicles and the like of the street lamps in residential communities.

title_en: Nuclear reactor main circulation pump shaft displacement fault detection method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fault detection, and particularly relates to a nuclear reactor main circulation pump shaft displacement fault detection method. The method comprises the following steps: the first step: acquiring main pump shaft displacement data through monitoring equipment; and a second step of: sampling a data sliding window; and a third step of: data enhancement is carried out, and filling data with the length of m is added at two sides of a sliding window; fourth step: inputting the data set into a spectrum residual error network, performing significance research, and extracting a data spectrum residual value; fifth step: inputting the spectrum residual data into a DAGMM network for anomaly detection; sixth step: and outputting an abnormality detection result through data analysis and comparison. The beneficial effects are that: (1) The spectrum residual error network technology means realizes the significance research on the main pump shaft displacement data and successfully distinguishes the normal data from the abnormal data. The accuracy of the anomaly detection can be improved, and erroneous judgment in the anomaly detection process is avoided.

title_en: Hydraulic system with energy supplied by double-input vane pump
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydraulic system powered by a double-input vane pump. The invention comprises a double-input vane pump, a power source and an actuator, wherein a first input shaft of the double-input vane pump is connected with the first power source, a second input shaft of the double-input vane pump is connected with the second power source, and a first oil port of the double-input vane pump is connected with the actuator through an oil way, and a second oil port of the double-input vane pump is connected with an oil tank through an oil way. The invention can control the output flow of the double-input vane pump by controlling the rotating speeds of the rotor and the floating stator. Through the speed regulation of the two power sources, the flow of the hydraulic pump is changed according to the load demand, so that energy conservation is realized.

title_en: Fan bearing temperature prediction early warning system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The application provides a fan bearing temperature prediction early warning system based on artificial intelligence, which comprises a data acquisition module, a real-time prediction module, a state evaluation module and a maintenance guiding module, wherein the data acquisition module acquires historical data and real-time data of relevant parameters causing fan bearing temperature rise and bearing cooling medium temperature, the real-time prediction module establishes a bearing temperature model according to a mechanism model and a machine learning method, inputs the historical data and the real-time data into the bearing temperature model to predict the fan bearing temperature in real time, the state evaluation module establishes an abnormal judgment model based on the artificial intelligence, inputs the predicted fan bearing temperature into the abnormal judgment model to obtain a real-time evaluation result of fan bearing state, and predicts a fault when the real-time evaluation result is the fault, and the maintenance guiding module guides maintenance of a system which possibly influences the bearing temperature according to the fault type of the real-time evaluation result. The application avoids the occurrence of destructive faults, realizes the system design targets of small accidents and early discovery, and improves the running reliability and stability of equipment.

title_en: Dampproofing dustproof shock-proof automation equipment regulator cubicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a moistureproof, dustproof and shockproof automatic equipment electrical cabinet which comprises a double-impeller type bottom air flow control mechanism, a single-drive control type flow channel control mechanism, a dust-proof and heat-dissipating mechanism and an external shell assembly. The invention belongs to the technical field of electrical cabinets, and particularly relates to a moistureproof dustproof shockproof automatic equipment electrical cabinet; the invention creatively provides a double-impeller type bottom air flow control mechanism and a single-drive control type flow passage control mechanism, a group of air extraction type air blower drives to realize the internal space of the whole external shell assembly, and air at all positions circularly flows, thereby not only simplifying the structure, reducing the production and manufacturing cost, but also saving energy, improving the running stability, reducing the number of fans and achieving the technical effect of reducing vibration and noise.

title_en: Magnetic suspension centrifugal blower convenient to equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of magnetic suspension centrifugal blowers, in particular to a magnetic suspension centrifugal blower convenient to assemble. The air blower comprises a mounting component, wherein the top of the mounting component is provided with an air blower component, the air blower component comprises an air blower body, an exhaust pipe is communicated with one side wall of the air blower body, a plurality of groups of clamping pipes are distributed at equal intervals at the edge of one end of the exhaust pipe away from the air blower body, a group of second inflatable bags are arranged on the outer wall of each group of clamping pipes, a second inflatable structure is arranged on the outer wall of the exhaust pipe, the input ends of each group of second inflatable bags are communicated with the second inflatable structure, and a clamping mechanism is sleeved on the outer wall of the exhaust pipe; the clamping mechanism comprises a disc body, and a first electric push rod is arranged on one side wall of the disc body. The working effect of the device is improved while the assembly effect of the device is improved.

title_en: Tangential push-type water turbine
abstract_en: The invention relates to a tangential push-type hydraulic turbine, which comprises a rotating shaft (1), a rotating column (2), a telescopic device, a shell ( 6 ) and a control head (8). The high-pressure water entering the water tank (7) has large power moment to the pressure of the rotary column (2), the high-pressure water entering the water tank (7) has more work to the rotary column (2), the pressure energy of the high-pressure water is converted into mechanical energy of the sliding block (4) and the rotary column (2), the efficiency of the hydraulic turbine is high, the distance between the water inlet (8 d) and the water outlet (8 e) is small, the efficiency of the hydraulic turbine is high, the sliding block ( 4 ) does not collide with the control head (8) in the rotating process, the rotary column (2) rotates stably, the power selection range is large, the maximum power can exceed 100 kilowatts, the current hydraulic turbine is invented by foreigners, and the tangential push hydraulic turbine is invented by Chinese, unfortunately.

title_en: Intelligent grouting pump and grouting method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent grouting pump and a grouting method thereof, which relate to the technical field of grouting equipment and comprise the following steps: the top of the moving mechanism is provided with a grouting mechanism, the grouting mechanism comprises a protective shell, one side of the outer wall of the protective shell is fixedly provided with a second motor, the inner surface wall of the first protective shell is movably inserted with a crankshaft, one end of the outer wall of the crankshaft is fixedly connected with the output end of the second motor, and the inner surface wall of the protective shell is fixedly provided with two first cylinder sleeves and two second cylinder sleeves. The device can transmit grouting pressure to the control terminal in real time, the real-time grouting pressure can be checked through a pressure change curve, when the pressure reaches the set pressure, the solenoid valve is closed, the solenoid valve is opened, and the other solenoid valve is opened, so that grouting condition can be traced to source and engineering quality can be analyzed.

title_en: Wind power and photovoltaic natural gas combined power generation system utilizing hydrogen energy storage and control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind power and natural gas combined power generation system utilizing hydrogen to store energy and a control method, wherein the wind power and natural gas combined power generation system comprises a renewable energy power generation subsystem and a hydrogen and natural gas combined power generation subsystem; the renewable energy source power generation subsystem comprises a wind power generation device and a photovoltaic power generation device, generated electric energy is transmitted to a power grid, when the generated power is larger than the required power of the power grid, surplus electric energy is transmitted to an electrolytic cell, and when the total power transmission of the renewable energy source power generation subsystem can not meet the power grid requirement due to the change of external conditions such as illumination, wind speed and the like, the total output power of the system is kept stable by transmitting electric energy to the power grid through the hydrogen and natural gas combined power generation subsystem. According to the invention, wind-solar combined power generation is supplemented by introducing hydrogen energy storage and natural gas steam combined power generation, and the comprehensive power generation system is dynamically controlled according to short-term weather prediction and the storage quantity of the hydrogen and oxygen storage tanks, so that the problem of large fluctuation of wind-solar power generation is effectively solved, and meanwhile, the near-zero carbon emission of the system is realized.

title_en: Noise-reduction type artificial fish reef and offshore wind power and ocean pasture fusion system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a noise-reduction type artificial fish reef and a marine wind power and marine pasture fusion system, which comprises an artificial fish reef body, wherein at least one fish reef wall of the artificial fish reef wall body is used as a noise-reduction fish reef wall, a plurality of noise-reduction channels which are arranged in a crossing way are arranged in the noise-reduction fish reef wall to form a net hole positioned in the noise-reduction fish reef wall, the set noise-reduction channels extend to the outer side surface of the noise-reduction fish reef wall so as to enable the net hole to be communicated with the outer space of the noise-reduction fish reef wall, and the noise-reduction type artificial fish reef disclosed by the invention realizes the fusion of a marine wind power motor marine pasture and avoids the noise pollution of a marine fan to a marine environment.

title_en: CO2Quality estimation system, exhaust gas composition ratio estimation method, and CO2Quality estimation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a system for estimating the emission quality of CO  2 . The CO  2  mass estimation system includes detection value acquisition means for acquiring detection values corresponding to the concentrations of oxygen, H  2  O, and CO  2  contained in the engine exhaust gas, which are output from a gas sensor capable of outputting detection values corresponding to the concentrations of oxygen, H  2  O, and CO  2  contained in the measured gas, air-fuel ratio setting means for setting the air-fuel ratio of the mixture, and calculation means for calculating the mass of CO  2  in the exhaust gas, wherein the calculation means estimates the mass of CO  2  by calculating the concentrations of oxygen, H  2  O, and CO  2  in the exhaust gas based on the sensor detection values, acquiring the concentrations and the air-fuel ratios of oxygen and H  2  O in the atmosphere, calculating the composition ratio of at least C atoms contained in the fuel based on the concentrations, and the air-fuel ratios in the exhaust gas, and estimating the mass of CO  2  contained in the exhaust gas based on the composition ratio and the injection amount of the fuel to the engine.

title_en: System for controlling the exhaust door of a turbomachine
abstract_en: The invention relates to a system (27) for controlling the discharge gates (26 a-26 f) of a turbomachine, said system comprising a ring (28) and means for connecting the ring (28) to each discharge gate (26 a-26 f). According to the invention, the ring (28) is constituted by a plurality of rods (29 a-29f,31a-31 f) connected end to end by means of rotary connectors (32) to ensure that: one lever member itself pivots causing the other lever member (29 a-29f,31a-31 f) to itself pivot, and each drain door (26 a-26 f) is connected to the corresponding lever member (31 a-31 f) to open or close when the lever member pivots.

title_en: Low-temperature pump rapid regeneration system and method suitable for tokamak steady-state operation
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a low-temperature pump rapid regeneration system and a method suitable for Tokamak steady-state operation, wherein the system comprises a low-temperature pump, a mechanical pump, a mass spectrometer, an adjustable radio frequency source and a system controller; the mass spectrometer monitors the gas content in the cryopump; the low-temperature cold plate in the low-temperature pump comprises a stainless steel plate layer with a nickel layer plated on one side, and an adsorbent is arranged on the outer side of the nickel layer; the system controller controls and adjusts the working parameters of the adjustable radio frequency source according to the judgment result of the temperature signal; the adjustable radio frequency source provides current to the induction coil, and the magnetic field generated by the induction coil causes the low temperature Leng Ban to generate current and the temperature to rise; the low-temperature pump regeneration system heats the low-temperature cold plate through induction heating and utilizes the skin effect of induction current to realize the rapid temperature rise of the surface layer of the low-temperature cold plate, thereby enabling the low-temperature pump to regenerate rapidly. In addition, according to the temperature signal transmitted by the temperature sensor, the temperature of the low temperature Leng Ban can be accurately controlled during desorption of the low temperature pump by adjusting the working parameters of the adjustable radio frequency source.

title_en: Water pump control system
abstract_en: The invention provides a water pump control system, which relates to the technical field of water pump systems and comprises a control panel, wherein the control panel comprises an on/off button, a mode selection button, a timer button and a locking/unlocking button, the on/off button is pressed for two continuous pressing operations, and the design of preventing false touch is as follows: in the design of the starting/closing button, the mode selection button, the timer button and the locking/unlocking button, the requirement of error touch prevention is considered, the water pump can be started or closed after the starting/closing button is pressed for two continuous pressing operations, the timer button and the locking/unlocking button can enter corresponding modes after being continuously clicked four times, and the design can effectively prevent users from operating error due to carelessly touching the buttons, so that the use safety of the system is improved.

title_en: Scroll compressor having a rotor with a rotor shaft having a rotor shaft with a
abstract_en: The application relates to a scroll compressor, comprising: the compression mechanism comprises a fixed vortex and an movable vortex, the fixed vortex and the movable vortex are matched to form a series of compression cavities for compressing working fluid, and the fixed vortex comprises a fluid channel; and a floating seal provided at one side of the non-orbiting scroll to define a back pressure chamber between the floating seal and the non-orbiting scroll, the back pressure chamber being communicated with a middle pressure compression chamber among the compression chambers via a fluid passage so that the floating seal can axially float under the action of compression chamber fluid from the middle compression chamber, an air flow reversing structure being provided between the fluid passage and the floating seal, the air flow reversing structure being configured to regulate a direction of compression chamber fluid discharged from the fluid passage. The present application provides a scroll compressor that improves upon the floating seal to achieve a reliable seal.

title_en: Parallel gravity heat pipe chimney power generation device, system and waste dump temperature treatment method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of manufacturing of special equipment for environmental protection such as comprehensive utilization of solid wastes, and particularly relates to a power generation device and system of a chimney with parallel gravity heat pipes and a waste dump temperature treatment method. The waste heat treatment device solves the problem of waste heat treatment inside waste heat hills, and comprises a gravity heat pipe, wherein a wind power generation device is arranged at the top of the gravity heat pipe, a gas circulation accelerating device is sleeved at the upper part of the gravity heat pipe, and the gas circulation accelerating device accelerates the gas at the middle part and below the gravity heat pipe to the top of the gravity heat pipe and outputs the gas to the wind power generation device. The wind power generation device and the electric energy storage device in the gravity heat pipe chimney power generation device are characterized in that the lower end of the gravity heat pipe chimney power generation device is connected with a hollow heat pipe paved on the side slope surface of the gangue hill, and the hollow heat pipe is communicated with a vertical pipe inserted into the gangue hill. The invention uses chimney effect to drive air to concentrate and strengthen convection, and then drives fan to generate wind power.

title_en: Mass spectrometer and method for forming vacuum system thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a mass spectrometer and a method for forming a vacuum system thereof. The technical scheme of the invention can be applied to a desk-top and even portable mass spectrometer, and the requirements of the mass spectrometer on low energy consumption, miniaturization and vacuum degree are considered.

title_en: Insulation and pressure resistance test fixture for compressor
abstract_en: The invention provides a compressor insulation and pressure resistance testing tool which comprises a first butt joint assembly and a second butt joint assembly, wherein the first butt joint assembly is connected with an air suction pipe of a compressor, the second butt joint assembly is connected with a binding post of the compressor so as to conduct insulation and pressure resistance testing on the compressor, the binding post is located on a shell of the compressor, and the air suction pipe is located on a liquid distributor at the outer side of the shell. According to the insulating and withstand voltage testing tool for the compressor, the test connecting piece is in butt joint with the compressor exhaust pipe and is in butt joint with the compressor air suction pipe, so that the two test connecting pieces can keep a sufficient distance, the butt joint of the test connecting piece and the compressor is convenient, the occurrence of the power-on ignition condition caused by the fact that the test connecting piece is too close in distance is avoided, and the problem that abnormal alarm is high due to poor contact and ignition of the test connecting piece in an original industry test mode is solved.

title_en: Operation method and device of refrigerating system and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to an operation method and device of a refrigeration system and electronic equipment, wherein the method is applied to the refrigeration system, the refrigeration system comprises a refrigeration module, a power supply module, a heat recovery module, a dehumidification module and an electric equipment module, and the method comprises the following steps: in the running process of the refrigerating system, the power supply module is used for supplying power to the refrigerating module, the heat recovery module, the electric equipment module and the dehumidifying module, wherein the power supply module is used for supplying power by utilizing solar energy; in the process that the refrigeration module carries out refrigeration through the refrigerant, the heat recovery module carries out heat recovery on the refrigerant output by the refrigeration module; the heat recovery module is used for providing heat for the dehumidification module so that the dehumidification module dehumidifies for the refrigerating system. Therefore, the energy consumption during ice temperature control of the ice rink can be reasonably planned, and the energy is recovered, so that the energy consumption is reduced, and the operation efficiency of the refrigerating system is improved.

title_en: Cylinder head, engine and motorcycle
abstract_en: The application relates to a cylinder head, an engine and a motorcycle. The cylinder head includes cylinder body and camshaft, and bolt hole, first oil circuit, second oil circuit and cam chamber have been seted up to the cylinder body. Wherein the bolt hole is used for inserting the fixing bolt of cylinder head in order to fix the cylinder head, and the bolt hole is used for communicating to the lubricated oil pipeline of engine. The first oil way is communicated with the bolt hole and the cam cavity, the second oil way is communicated with the cam cavity, an oil outlet is formed at one end of the second oil way, the oil outlet faces the exhaust valve of the cylinder head, and preferably, the oil outlet faces the oil seal of the exhaust valve. The camshaft rotationally sets up in the cam chamber, and the centre bore has been seted up to the camshaft and oil outlet, and the centre bore runs through the one end of camshaft and communicates with the cam chamber along the axial of camshaft, and the oil outlet is seted up on the global of camshaft and communicates with the centre bore. The cylinder head increases the quantity of lubricating oil on the exhaust valve, and improves the lubricating and cooling effects of the exhaust valve.

title_en: Supercharger
abstract_en: The supercharger is provided with: the compressor includes a rotor including a compressor impeller, a bearing for rotatably supporting the rotor, and a bearing housing the bearing. The bearing table is formed with: the supercharger is provided with a cooling space formed on the back surface side of the compressor impeller, a bearing accommodating space accommodating the bearing, a lubricating oil flow path for communicating the cooling space with the bearing accommodating space in order to convey lubricating oil from the cooling space to the bearing accommodating space, and a lubricating oil supply port formed on the outer surface of the bearing table and communicating with the cooling space, and further provided with a lubricating oil supply line configured to convey lubricating oil from the outside of the supercharger to the cooling space through the lubricating oil supply port.

title_en: Fluid filter and production method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fluid filter and a production method thereof, wherein a front seat is arranged in one end of a shell, a rear seat is arranged in the other end of the shell, a communicating pipe is arranged between the front seat and the rear seat, filtering paper is sleeved on the outer ring of the communicating pipe, a limiting groove is formed in the inner wall of one side opposite to the front seat and the communicating pipe, and a movable rod is slidably connected with the inner wall of the limiting groove.

title_en: Composite circulation power control method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a system for controlling composite circulating power, wherein the method comprises the steps that a control module obtains the current running state of an engine; the control module receives an environmental signal; the control module determines the operation state of the engine according to the environmental signal; and under the condition that the current operating state of the engine is inconsistent with the operating state of the engine, the control module controls the engine to execute switching operation, the current operating state of the engine is switched to the operating state of the engine, and if the current operating state of the engine is in a closed cycle state and the operating state of the engine is in an open cycle state, the control module controls the engine to be switched to the open cycle state; and if the current running state of the engine is an open circulation state and the running state of the engine is a closed circulation state, the control module controls the engine to be switched to the closed circulation state, and the engine is switched to the open circulation state or the closed circulation state in real time.

title_en: EGR flow closed-loop control system and control method for natural gas engine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a natural gas engine EGR flow closed-loop control system and a control method, wherein the control system comprises the following components: the controller is used for determining EGR demand flow according to the actual working condition of the engine; the controller is used for acquiring the pressure of the air and gas mixture detected by the air inlet pressure sensor; or determining the pressure of the air and gas mixture according to the EGR demand flow, the threshold flow, the maximum opening of the EGR valve, the actual opening of the EGR valve, the gas flow and the fresh air flow; the controller is used for determining the EGR actual flow according to the acquired pressure of the air and gas mixed gas, the partial pressure of the gas in the cylinder, the conversion slope of the pressure and the flow, the gas flow and the fresh air flow; determining an EGR flow correction value according to the obtained EGR actual flow and the EGR demand flow; and adjusting the opening degree of the EGR valve according to the EGR flow correction value so as to enable the EGR actual flow to reach the EGR required flow and realize the EGR flow closed-loop control. The invention can realize the accurate control of the EGR flow in two modes.

title_en: Electromagnetic diaphragm pump
abstract_en: The application provides an electromagnetic diaphragm pump, comprising: a housing forming a chamber inside the housing for accommodating an electromagnetic assembly; the air inlet piece is provided with a first air inlet; the air chamber component is used for injecting external air into the cavity on the shell through the air inlet piece under the action of the electromagnetic component and discharging the air in the cavity to the air storage box; the end enclosure plate can simultaneously cover the opening of the shell and the opening of the gas storage box; the air outlet is used for exhausting the air storage box outwards; the shell comprises an air inlet plate, an installation side plate, a plugboard and a limiting plate device, wherein the air inlet plate, the installation side plate, the air storage box, the plugboard and the limiting plate device are integrally formed. According to the electromagnetic diaphragm pump, the air inlet structure of the electromagnetic diaphragm pump, the air outlet structure of the air chamber component and the structure of the air storage box are improved, so that the electromagnetic diaphragm pump is compact in structure, convenient to install, stable in connection and high in air tightness, and the working performance of the electromagnetic diaphragm pump is greatly improved.

title_en: Vortex reducer mechanism of gas turbine compressor
abstract_en: The application discloses a turbine reducer mechanism of a gas turbine compressor, which belongs to the field of aeroengines and comprises an axial air-entraining section, a drum, a front-stage compressor disk and a rear-stage compressor disk which are oppositely arranged, wherein two ends of the drum are fixedly connected to the opposite inner sides of the front-stage compressor disk and the rear-stage compressor disk respectively, the front-stage compressor disk, the rear-stage compressor disk and the drum enclose a disk cavity, the disk cavity is communicated with the axial air-entraining section, a plurality of drum holes are formed in the outer peripheral surface of the drum, the plurality of drum holes are respectively communicated with the disk cavity, an annular partition plate is arranged between the front-stage compressor disk and the rear-stage compressor disk, a plurality of drainage holes corresponding to the plurality of drum holes are formed in the outer peripheral surface of the annular partition plate, a plurality of groups of guide assemblies are arranged between the front-stage compressor disk and the rear-stage compressor disk, and the plurality of guide assemblies correspond to the plurality of drainage holes respectively. The application has the effect of reducing the pressure loss of the cold air.

title_en: Motor housing for magnetic suspension molecular pump and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a motor housing for a magnetic suspension molecular pump and a manufacturing method thereof. The motor shell comprises a shell body and a cooling pipeline, wherein the shell body is a die casting and is provided with a cylindrical part, and the cooling pipeline comprises a cylindrical spiral part which is pre-buried in the cylindrical part of the shell body, an inlet part and an outlet part which penetrate through the outer surface of the shell body and are sequentially connected with two ends of the cylindrical spiral part. The motor shell can improve the cooling effect of the cooling liquid on the magnetic suspension molecular pump, in particular to the motor, and is beneficial to prolonging the service lives of the motor and the magnetic suspension molecular pump.

title_en: Plunger pump performance test device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a plunger pump performance test device, which relates to a hydraulic test device, comprising: a main oil tank; the waste oil tank is used for collecting waste oil; the pump source assembly comprises a first driving motor for driving the plunger pump to be tested; an oil inlet and an oil drain of the plunger pump to be tested are respectively communicated with a main oil tank; the control unit comprises a high-pressure filter, a first flowmeter, a first one-way valve, a multi-way valve and a boost control integrated valve block which are sequentially communicated, wherein the first one-way valve is communicated with a P port of the multi-way valve; an oil inlet of the high-pressure filter is communicated with an oil drain port of the plunger pump to be tested; the oil return filter assembly comprises an oil absorption filter, a first oil pump, a first-stage oil return filter and a second-stage oil return filter which are sequentially communicated, wherein the oil absorption filter is arranged in the waste oil tank, and an oil outlet of the second-stage oil return filter is communicated with the waste oil tank. The invention improves the testing efficiency of the plunger pump.

title_en: Combustor with dilution cooling liner
abstract_en: A combustor for a gas turbine has a combustor liner including an upstream liner portion and a downstream liner portion. The upstream liner portion includes an outer shell and a baffle plate with a baffle cavity therebetween. The housing includes a housing cooling opening for providing a flow of compressed air to the baffle cavity, and the heat shield includes a heat shield cooling opening at a downstream end of the heat shield. A rail is disposed on the downstream side of the heat shield cooling opening and extends beyond the hot side surface of the heat shield into the combustion chamber. The heat shield cooling openings provide a flow of compressed air therethrough from the baffle cavity for cooling the heat shield and for providing at least a partial dilution of the combustion gases within the combustion chamber.

title_en: Method and device for measuring flux map of unbalanced state of unit, storage medium and terminal
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method, a device, a storage medium and a terminal for measuring a flux map of a machine set in an unbalanced state, which comprise the following steps: simulating theoretical neutron flux data under test conditions; calculating a relative rate of change of theoretical core flux distribution during flux map measurement under transient conditions based on the theoretical neutron flux data; measuring flux map under unbalanced working condition of the unit to obtain actual measured reactor core flux distribution data under unbalanced working condition; and correcting the measured core flux distribution data through the relative change rate of the theoretical core flux distribution to obtain the core flux measurement data of the unit under the unbalanced working condition. The invention can measure the flux map in the unbalanced state of the unit, thereby providing basis for the safety evaluation of the reactor core, executing the periodic test in the unbalanced state after transient state, avoiding the over-period risk of the periodic test, greatly shortening the waiting and stabilizing time of the platform and shortening the uplink critical path after the overhaul of the unit.

title_en: Automatic voltage control system and method for nuclear power unit
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic voltage control system and method for a nuclear power unit, and relates to the technical field of power plant voltage control, wherein the system comprises: the automatic voltage control upper computer of the power plant is used for acquiring the bus voltage value of the current power plant end, the system impedance value of the current power plant end and the target bus voltage value of the power plant end; generating a total reactive power value born by the power plant end according to the numerical value; generating target reactive power output values of all the units according to the unit allocation strategy and the total reactive power output value born by the power plant end; generating a magnetic increasing/decreasing signal according to the target reactive output value of each unit; the automatic voltage control lower computer of the power plant is used for generating magnetic increasing and decreasing pulses according to the magnetic increasing and decreasing signals; and the power plant unit control module is used for adjusting reactive output values of all units according to the increase and decrease magnetic pulses so that the bus voltage value at the power plant end reaches the target bus voltage value. The system can realize the purpose of automatically adjusting the target bus voltage value of the power plant end according to the real-time working state of the power grid.

title_en: Waterproof fan with motor stator adopting injection molding and vacuum filling and sealing assembly structure
abstract_en: The application discloses a waterproof fan with a motor stator adopting an injection molding and vacuum filling and sealing assembly structure, which comprises a fan frame, a stator coil, fan blades and a circuit board, wherein an installation seat is arranged in the fan frame; a layer of outer edge sealing glue is arranged outside the stator coil, so that the stator coil and the outer edge sealing glue form a combined body; the circuit board is placed on the bottom surface of the combination body and is put into the mounting seat of the fan frame, and the waterproof and heat-conducting liquid sealant is poured into the mounting seat and solidified to form solid pouring sealant so as to realize sealing, thereby achieving the effects of fixation and waterproof sealing. Therefore, the circuit board does not need to be subjected to injection molding, and electronic elements on the circuit board can be prevented from being damaged due to high injection molding temperature, so that the yield can be remarkably improved. Meanwhile, the circuit board can be independently tested and then is installed into the fan frame, so that the problem that the circuit board is damaged and must be scrapped together with the stator coil can be avoided.

title_en: Wind turbine generator set safety monitoring method and system based on Beidou positioning
abstract_en: The application discloses a wind turbine generator safety monitoring method and system based on Beidou positioning, comprising the following steps: acquiring real-time position information of a target wind turbine, and carrying out position deviation analysis on the target wind turbine according to the real-time position information to obtain position deviation analysis information; acquiring real-time stress information of a target wind turbine generator, and carrying out stress abnormality analysis by combining the position deviation analysis information to obtain stress abnormality analysis information; carrying out abnormality cause analysis on the target wind turbine generator according to the position deviation analysis information and the stress abnormality analysis information, and carrying out early warning; acquiring position change information and unit stress information of a target wind turbine in severe weather, and performing state analysis and accident prediction on the target wind turbine to obtain state analysis information and accident prediction information; and acquiring real-time weather information, judging whether the remediation can be carried out, and making a remediation scheme. A more reliable and real-time monitoring method is provided to ensure the safety and performance of the wind turbine generator.

title_en: Design method of fan protective cover
abstract_en: The application discloses a design method of a fan protective cover in the technical field of ventilation device manufacturing, which comprises the following steps: 1. and acquiring the shape and the size of the outer frame of the fan guard, and presetting the size of the center plate. 2. And a foundation rib is arranged between the central disc and the outer frame, the centers of the foundation rib, the central disc and the outer frame are overlapped, and a plurality of closed areas are formed in the outer frame. 3. Arranging radiation ribs in a closed area where the radiation ribs are to be arranged, wherein each radiation rib on the protective cover is intersected with at least two basic ribs; the radial line is connected between the starting point of the radial rib and the center of the outer frame, the radial rib meets the requirement of the outward divergence direction along the center of the protective cover, and the included angle between the extending direction of the radial rib and the radial line is gradually increased. The radial ribs are intersected with at least two basic ribs, the radial ribs connected with the outer frame at least cross two closed areas, and the radial ribs connected with the central disc at least cross two closed areas. The length of the radiating ribs is long, so that the radiating ribs are beneficial to controlling air flow guiding; the included angle between the connecting line of the starting point and the ending point of the radial line of the radial rib is small, which is favorable for gathering the air outlet.

title_en: Method and apparatus for improving engine charge control model
abstract_en: The present invention relates to engine control technology, and in particular to a method, apparatus, computer storage medium and computer device for improving an engine charge control model. A method for improving an engine charge control model according to one aspect of the present invention comprises the steps of: performing an engine working condition experiment by using a space filling method to acquire engine working condition point data; dividing the collected engine operating point data into machine learning training operating point data and machine learning checking operating point data; constructing a machine learning model according to the engine inflation control model and training the machine learning model based on the machine learning training operating point data; and optimizing a calibration set-point for a pulse chart and an interpolation look-up table of the engine charge control model based on the trained machine learning model.

title_en: Combined efficient axial flow fan blade
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of fan blades, in particular to a combined efficient axial flow fan blade, which comprises: the blade hub is provided with a mounting notch at the edge, and a plug notch is arranged in the middle of the inner wall of the mounting notch; the blade handle is of a hollow structure, and the opening end of the blade handle is fixedly provided with a limiting ring; the arc-shaped clamp is fixed with the fan blade hub through a limiting chute; the angle adjusting disc is positioned in the inner cavity of the limiting ring, and the annular outer gear ring is meshed with the annular inner gear ring; the beneficial effects are as follows: through the tip fixed mounting at fan blade has the petiole, and the open end of petiole is provided with annular ring gear, and fan blade hub edge level grafting is installed and is adjusted the angle scale, is provided with the annular outer ring gear with annular ring gear meshing on the angle scale to guarantee that the contained angle between fan blade and the fan blade hub can be adjusted along with the use scene, and then change the amount of wind and the wind pressure of whole axial fan.

title_en: Burglary-resisting door that security performance is high
abstract_en: The invention discloses a burglary-resisting door with high safety performance, which comprises a door frame and a door body, wherein the cross section of a gravity rod is semicircular, a third through groove is formed in the surface of a first barrel body, the gravity rod is arranged in the third through groove at the top end and is attached to the surface of the door frame, an internal thread cylinder matched with the T-shaped through groove is sleeved on the T-shaped through rod, a toothed ring is fixedly sleeved on the internal thread cylinder, a first sliding groove is formed in the top surface of the first barrel body at the top end, an L-shaped sliding rod is fixedly arranged in the first sliding groove in a sliding manner, the cross section of a vertical rod of the L-shaped sliding rod is an arc surface, a reset spring is fixedly connected with the top surface of the L-shaped sliding rod, the reset spring is arranged in the first sliding groove and is fixedly connected with the surface of the first barrel body, the bottom end of the L-shaped sliding rod is arranged in a positioning groove, and the model of an amplitude motor is Y-160M1-2.

title_en: Divertor structure unit of controllable nuclear fusion device and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: A structure unit of a divertor of a controllable nuclear fusion device and a preparation method thereof relate to the field of advanced design and manufacture application of divertor components in the controllable nuclear fusion device, and comprise a plasma load area, a transition area and a heat sink heat exchange area, wherein a cooling medium flows to an inlet circulation cavity through an inlet to play a role in stabilizing flow of the cooling medium, and when the cooling medium flows to an outlet confluence cavity after heat exchange through a dispersion channel, the cooling medium plays a role in rectifying flow of the cooling medium, so that the flow field of the cooling medium of the subsequent serial divertor structure unit is convenient to control stably. The invention introduces the system idea of the functional multi-material fusion structure design of the structure unit of the divertor, adopts a specific cooling channel to maximize the heat exchange quantity of the heat sinking and exchanging area of the structure unit of the divertor, adopts a structure form of regional dispersion in the plasma load area, combines with the SLM to realize the rapid preparation of the multi-material of the divertor, breaks through the limitation of the traditional preparation method on the structure function of the divertor, and provides support for the development of the divertor of the controllable nuclear fusion device.

title_en: Self-priming centrifugal pump and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a self-priming centrifugal pump and a manufacturing method thereof, the self-priming centrifugal pump comprises a pump body, wherein an inlet end and an outlet end of the pump body are both connected with a tee joint, one group of interfaces between the tee joint are communicated through a circulating pipe, the other two interfaces are respectively connected with a water inlet pipe and a water outlet pipe, a switching valve is arranged between the tee joints to switch the tee joint to be in a state of being directly communicated through the circulating pipe or respectively communicated with the water inlet pipe and the water outlet pipe, a liquid level sensor is arranged to sense the starting of the liquid level height control switching valve, the circulating pipe which is communicated through the switching valve is arranged between the inlet end and the outlet end of a valve body, when the self-priming pump is not required to operate, a switching liquid path is controlled through the switching valve, the inlet end and the outlet end of the valve body are directly communicated through the circulating pipe to form a circulating liquid path, frequent starting and stopping of the self-priming pump are avoided, the air mixing in the starting process is avoided, the fault rate is further reduced, the service life of the self-priming pump is prolonged, and the self-priming pump has good development prospect.

title_en: Control system and method suitable for rail pressure substitution value of high-pressure common rail system of diesel engine
abstract_en: The invention relates to a control system suitable for rail pressure substitution values of a high-pressure common rail system of a diesel engine, which comprises a hydraulic system and an electronic control system EDC; the hydraulic system comprises a high-pressure oil rail and a high-pressure oil pipe. The invention also relates to a control method suitable for the rail pressure substitution value of the high-pressure common rail system of the diesel engine, which comprises the following steps: calculating to obtain rail pressure control deviation; calculating to obtain the required fuel oil variation; calculating to obtain the required fuel flow; calculating to obtain the actual oil inlet amount and the actual oil outlet amount; and calculating to obtain an estimated rail pressure. The invention provides a solution when rail pressure is abnormal; and accurately estimating rail pressure change generated after the high-pressure oil pump and the electric control pressure relief valve act.

title_en: Battery system for heat supply pipeline
abstract_en: The invention provides a battery system for a heating pipeline, comprising: the rotating piece is arranged in the heat supply pipeline and is provided with blades, and when water passes through the heat supply pipeline, the blades can be pushed to rotate; the power generation device is arranged outside the heat supply pipeline; the transmission assembly is in transmission connection with the rotating piece and the power generation device, mechanical energy is transmitted to the power generation device to generate power when the rotating piece rotates, through the arrangement mode, power can be generated through water flow in a heat supply pipeline, power is supplied to electric equipment such as an electromagnetic valve, a controller and a signal transceiver, so that heat supply faults caused by mains supply faults can be avoided, and the power generation device is arranged at the end part of the supporting pipe so as to be arranged outside the ground, so that the power generation device is convenient to overhaul.

title_en: Inertial navigation-based fan blade attitude monitoring method, system and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system and a medium for monitoring the posture of a fan blade based on inertial navigation, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring test parameters of each test point based on inertial navigation, wherein the test parameters at least comprise position parameters, speed parameters and attitude angle parameters; obtaining monitoring data of the blade posture of the fan based on the test parameters, wherein the monitoring data at least comprise blade position data, blade rotating speed data and blade direction angle data; and comparing the monitoring data with corresponding safety limit values to output an operation report, wherein the operation report comprises an alarm report. The invention can acquire the working state of the fan blade based on the inertial navigation system, and realizes the daily management of the attitude of the fan blade by utilizing the autonomous monitoring with low cost, thereby outputting alarm reminding when the fan blade is abnormal, helping a user to maintain in time, reducing the cost investment, and realizing the purposes of monitoring the attitude of the fan blade, and the like.

title_en: High-reliability bearing unit of offshore ultra-high-power wind driven generator
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-reliability bearing unit of an offshore ultra-high-power wind driven generator, which comprises a bearing unit body, wherein one end of the bearing unit body is a non-wire-connection end, the other end of the bearing unit body is a wire-connection end, the bearing unit body comprises a hollow shaft and a bearing seat, the two ends of the bearing seat are respectively sleeved on the hollow shaft through single-row conical bearings, the mounting positions of the single-row conical bearings of the non-wire-connection end are provided with mounting free sections, the mounting positions of the single-row conical bearings of the wire-connection end are provided with mounting positioning steps, and the bearing unit is matched with two single-row conical bearings, so that the high-operation load of the ultra-high-power wind driven generator can be borne, the operation reliability of a unit can be improved, the axial play of the two single-row conical bearings can be controlled according to actual working conditions, the operation of a motor can be guaranteed to reach the optimal state, the working life of the bearing can be prolonged, and the operation stability of the whole equipment can be improved.

title_en: CO is adopted 2 Method for cooling and protecting direct reduced iron DRI
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for using CO  2  A method for cooling and protecting direct reduced iron DRI belongs to the technical field of gas-based direct reduced iron. The method washes and purifies CO from top gas of a blast furnace system  2  The gas is pressurized by a compressor and separated by a separating tank, and then enters the bottom of the absorption tower to transfer heat and mass; absorbs CO  2  The rich amine solution of the gas is discharged from the bottom of the absorption tower, and the hydrogen and CO gas are flashed off; the semi-lean liquid after flash evaporation enters againThe top of the raw tower is in countercurrent contact with stripping steam and flash gas at the middle and lower parts of the tower from top to bottom, and most of CO is desorbed  2  Heat exchange with hot DRI. The method can save the cost of separating nitrogen from compressed air, and can separate CO from the process  2  The method has the advantages of realizing functional utilization, improving heat energy utilization, directly converting heat energy into electric energy, saving investment of a compressor, reducing energy consumption of the whole process and achieving the purposes of energy conservation and emission reduction.

title_en: High-heating steam extraction-water supply bypass combined auxiliary AGC (automatic gain control) adjusting method for heat supply unit
abstract_en: The invention provides a heating unit high-pressure steam extraction-water supply bypass combined auxiliary AGC (automatic gain control) regulating method, which is characterized in that when a power grid load instruction rises, the opening of a valve is controlled, the water supply flow entering a high-pressure heater is reduced, the pressure in the high-pressure heater is increased, the pressure difference between a third high-pressure heating cylinder and a middle pressure cylinder of a steam turbine is reduced, the steam extraction amount is reduced, and the work of the steam turbine is increased. When the power grid load command is lowered, the steam extraction amount of the heat supply bypass is increased, so that the pressure in the high-pressure heater is reduced, the pressure difference between the third high-pressure adding and the middle pressure cylinder of the steam turbine is increased, the steam extraction amount is increased, and the work of the steam turbine is reduced. The turbine functional force is changed along with the load instruction, and the quick response AGC adjusting capacity of the unit is improved. The invention has the advantages of simple structure, convenient operation, strong innovation, low cost for modifying the existing equipment, high load-changing speed of the unit and capability of realizing the purpose of high-quality primary frequency modulation requirement of the power grid.

title_en: Control method, device, equipment and storage medium for inhibiting surge
abstract_en: The application provides a control method, a control device and a control storage medium for suppressing surge. The method comprises the steps of determining that a supercharger is in a surge susceptible state based on opening information of a current accelerator pedal and a gear box gear, determining to carry out torque filtering based on current torque of an engine, current torque change rate or pre-calibrated torque filtering standard quantity, determining a to-be-determined torque change rate from a corresponding relation among the preset gear box gear, engine required torque and the to-be-determined torque change rate according to current gear box gear and engine required torque, and determining a torque output value of the engine after torque filtering based on the to-be-determined torque change rate, pre-calibrated torque change rate constant and current torque of the engine so that the engine carries out torque output based on the torque output value after torque filtering. According to the application, after the supercharger is determined to be in a surge-prone state, the torque output value after torque filtering is determined based on the torque change rate, so that the surge can be restrained.

title_en: Wind driven generator blade clearance monitoring method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of wind power generation, in particular to a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for monitoring the clearance of a wind power generator blade, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring current image information of a clearance area acquired by a clearance sensor; calculating a current empty value based on the current image information; judging whether the current clear value is not larger than a first preset distance or not; if the current headroom value is not greater than the first preset distance, acquiring corresponding first adjusting power based on the current headroom value; and adjusting the operating power based on the first regulated power. The present application has the effect of reducing the possibility of occurrence of a blade sweep tower, thereby reducing the possibility of occurrence of loss.

title_en: Dihydro supply system for aircraft engines
abstract_en: The invention relates to a supply system (250) for an aircraft, wherein the supply system has a supply module (249) with an outlet pipe (253 a-b), a feed pipe (251 a-b) connected to a dihydro reservoir (110 a-b), and means for guiding the dihydro in the feed pipe (251 a-b) to the outlet pipe (253 a-b), a distribution module (248) with an inlet pipe (255 a-b) connected to the outlet pipe (253 a-b) via a heater (152, 154), a distribution pipe (257 a-b) connected to an engine (106), and means for guiding the dihydro in the inlet pipe (255 a-b) to the distribution pipe (257 a-b), and means for commanding the supply module (249) and the distribution module (248) in dependence on information provided by a detection means. Such a supply system makes it possible to supply the engine with dihydro even in the event of an accident.

title_en: Reciprocating compressor state monitoring and protecting method based on dynamic angle domain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a state monitoring and protecting method of a reciprocating compressor based on a dynamic angle domain, which comprises the following steps: s1: defining an angle domain according to the category of the measuring point; s2: synchronously collecting all sensor signals; s3: judging the reliability of the sensor signals acquired in the step S2, and ignoring signals with low reliability; s4: cutting the sensor signal reserved in the step S3 to obtain an angle domain waveform signal, extracting a signal characteristic value, and storing required signal data; s5: calculating the signal data stored in the S4, and judging the faults according to a preset threshold and a fault judging basis; s6: based on the result of S5 fault judgment, corresponding fault alarm information is pushed to the outside. According to the characteristics of the reciprocating compressor, the fault monitoring protection mode based on the dynamic angle domain can identify more fault categories, and early warning is given to operation staff in advance so as to protect the safety of equipment operation and further reduce loss.

title_en: Hydraulic diaphragm compressor system
abstract_en: The invention provides a liquid-driven diaphragm type compressor system, which relates to the technical field of diaphragm compressors and comprises a diaphragm head, a hydraulic pump, a reversing valve and an integrated decompression cylinder; the parallel system of the double hydraulic pumps and the double reversing valves is adopted, so that the displacement of the whole system is simply and effectively improved; in the layout, the two sides of the membrane head are symmetrically arranged, and the simple and efficient layout provides a foundation for the expansion of the whole machine; the function of the integrated decompression cylinder is utilized, and the extremely large installation space and the processing and manufacturing cost are saved on the basis of realizing larger exhaust capacity by using the hydraulic pump with lower displacement; the integral pressure reducing cylinder greatly saves the volume of a communication oil path from the reversing valve to the integral pressure reducing cylinder, so that the requirement on the discharge capacity of the hydraulic pump is further reduced on the premise of ensuring the performance and the discharge capacity of the whole machine.

title_en: Wind-force adaptability windmill shock mitigation system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of wind power generation, and particularly discloses a wind power adaptability windmill damping system. The outer side surface of the shock absorber block is fixedly provided with a plurality of hydraulic cylinders, hydraulic pistons are arranged in the hydraulic cylinders in a sealing sliding manner, an outer bearing structure is sleeved on the periphery of the shock absorber block, and the inner surface of the outer bearing structure is in sliding contact with the end parts of the hydraulic pistons. The rear bearing structure is arranged at the rear of the shock absorber, and the rear bearing structure is also provided with a hydraulic cylinder and a hydraulic piston which are mutually matched. The hydraulic cylinder also comprises an air chamber, and each hydraulic cylinder and the air chamber are mutually communicated. Each hydraulic cylinder is filled with liquid, and the air chamber is internally sealed with gas and liquid. The rear end of the windmill rotating shaft is provided with a thrust bearing, and the rear end of the thrust bearing is propped against the end part of the hydraulic piston on the rear bearing structure. The hardness of the hydraulic damping system can be automatically adjusted according to the wind power, so that the stability and reliability of the windmill are improved.

title_en: High-pressure oil-gas centripetal turbine structure considering axial force balance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-pressure oil gas centripetal turbine structure considering axial force balance, which relates to the technical field of impeller mechanical engineering and comprises a turbine front cover plate, an impeller and a turbine casing, wherein a wheel back cover plate is arranged in the turbine casing, the wheel back cover plate is connected with a motor casing, one side of the motor casing is fixedly connected with a machine seal shell through countersunk screws, an expansion ring is arranged between the machine seal shell and the motor casing, an impeller is fixedly arranged on a rotating shaft through interference fit, a shaft end retainer ring is sleeved on one side of the rotating shaft, far from the impeller, is in threaded connection with a shaft end nut, one side, far from the shaft end nut, of the rotating shaft is provided with a sleeve through interference fit, and the sleeve is sleeved with a stele seal. According to the invention, by adopting the structures of the arc-shaped blades, the annular through holes, the trapezoid comb teeth and the like, the total axial force borne by the impeller is greatly reduced by reducing the pressure difference between the front disc and the rear disc of the impeller and reducing the stress area of the front disc and the rear disc of the impeller on the premise of not changing the flow direction of the main flow.

title_en: Oil supplementing device for front pipeline of oil suction pump
abstract_en: The invention discloses an oil supplementing device for a front pipeline of an oil suction pump, and belongs to the technical field of oil filling devices. The invention solves the problem that the prior diesel oil supply system cannot absorb oil after the oil suction pump is started because the front pipeline of the oil suction pump is oilless or the oil is not full. The oil supplementing device is arranged between the oil sucking pump and the lower oil storage container, and the oil sucking pump is connected with the lower oil storage container through a pipeline in front of the oil sucking pump; the second oil supplementing unit comprises a second oil supplementing pipeline; the upper end opening of the second oil supplementing pipeline is used as an oil supplementing inlet; the lower end of the second oil supplementing pipeline is communicated with the front pipeline of the oil suction pump. According to the invention, the front pipeline of the oil suction pump is filled with oil by supplementing oil to the front pipeline of the oil suction pump, so that the oil suction pump can suck oil from the lower oil storage container through the front pipeline of the oil suction pump when the oil suction pump is started.

title_en: Ventilation oil tank for aircraft lubricating oil system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ventilation oil tank for an aircraft lubricating oil system. The oil tank comprises a cylindrical oil tank main body, wherein the top of the cylindrical oil tank main body is provided with a vent pipe communicated with the external atmosphere, a vent hole of the vent pipe is opposite to air inflow, and the side wall of the cylindrical oil tank main body is respectively provided with a connector I connected with an oil-gas separator in an oil-lubricating system and a connector II connected with an engine oil-lubricating oil return port in the oil-lubricating system; the joint I is communicated with an oil injection pipe arranged in the cylindrical oil tank main body, and the joint II is connected with a condensing pipe arranged in the cylindrical oil tank main body; the bottom of the side wall of the cylindrical oil tank main body is also provided with an oil outlet which is connected with an engine oil tank in an oil system; a condensing plate is arranged at the nozzle of the oil injection pipe in the cylindrical oil tank main body. The invention improves the safety of the lubricating oil system, reduces the consumption of lubricating oil, and improves the safety of the aircraft.

title_en: Underground coal fire treatment and resource comprehensive utilization system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for treating underground coal and fire and comprehensively utilizing resources, which relate to the technical field of underground coal and fire treatment and resource comprehensive utilization and comprise a ground heat utilization device, an ultra-long gravity heat pipe heat extraction device, a gas transmission device and a gas collection device; the gas transmission device is used for conveying gas into a coal bed of an underground coal fire area to perform exothermic reaction, high-temperature gas generated after the reaction flows through the ultra-long gravity heat pipe heat extraction device and transfers heat to the ultra-long gravity heat pipe heat extraction device, the ultra-long gravity heat pipe heat extraction device provides heat energy for the ground heat utilization device, the gas collection device is used for recovering the high-temperature gas, and the ground utilization device is used for providing energy. The invention can fully utilize the temperature of high Wen Meihuo and the heat convection characteristic of the combustion product gas, expand the heat taking range of the ultra-long gravity heat pipe and enhance the sustainability of the heat taking performance of the system.

title_en: Heat dissipation type power engine oil pan and forming process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heat dissipation type power engine oil pan and a forming process thereof, and relates to the technical field of oil pan forming. According to the invention, the milling cutter is pushed by the second electric push rod to remove burrs and burrs on the edge of the oil pan main body, and the edge surface of the oil pan main body is polished by the grindstone arranged on one side of the milling cutter, so that the surface of the oil pan main body is smooth and flat, and the scratch of workers is avoided.

title_en: Fan hub power supply equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to fan hub power supply equipment, which effectively solves the problems of high use cost, poor stability and reliability of the existing wind generating set hub power supply equipment; the technical scheme for solving the problems comprises the following steps: a power shaft is coaxially arranged in the mounting cylinder and driven by a motor arranged outside the mounting cylinder, a permanent magnet rotor is arranged on the power shaft, and a stator winding matched with the permanent magnet rotor is arranged on the inner wall of the mounting cylinder; one side of the mounting barrel, which is away from the motor, is fixedly mounted with the hub shaft through a flange assembly, and liquid cooling assemblies are arranged in the mounting barrels positioned at two sides of the stator winding; according to the scheme, power supply from the cabin side of the wind generating set to the hub side can be realized under the condition of no abrasion, so that the maintenance cost is reduced, and meanwhile, the running reliability of equipment such as the wind generating set is improved.

title_en: High reliability fan
abstract_en: The application provides a high reliability fan belongs to fan structure technical field, the fan includes the casing, with the axle sleeve of casing connection, with the external diameter interference of axle sleeve be connected stator module, with the rotor subassembly of stator module cooperation production magnetic field, support rotor subassembly's bearing, provide the spring of bearing pretightning force, be used for controlling the spring housing of spring compression volume, with the rear end cap of casing connection and with the controller subassembly of casing connection, the casing with be equipped with dust ring subassembly on the rotor subassembly. According to the high-reliability fan, the dust ring assembly is arranged, so that external sand and dust are prevented from entering the fan to damage a control panel and a bearing; meanwhile, a spring sleeve is arranged in the shaft sleeve to limit the axial displacement of the fan rotor and control the pretightening force of the bearing, so that the reliable operation of the fan in a vibration environment is satisfied.

title_en: Sealing suitable for coolant circulating pump of ship power device
