abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mechanical seals, in particular to a seal for a coolant circulating pump of a ship power plant, which comprises the following components: the sealing device comprises a first sealing component and a second sealing component, wherein a sealing chamber is formed between the first sealing component and the second sealing component, the sealing chamber comprises a first part, a second part and a mixing part, the first part is located on the first sealing component side, the second part is located on the second sealing component side, the mixing part is respectively communicated with the first part and the second part, a discharge hole is formed in the lowest liquid level position of the mixing part, and the communicating position of the second part and the mixing part is located at the highest liquid level position of the mixing part. The first sealing component and the second sealing component can be cooled through the gas medium and the liquid medium, so that the first sealing component and the second sealing component work in a specified temperature range, and the probability of safety risks of the first sealing component and the second sealing component due to high temperature is reduced.

title_en: Large wind turbine structure running state evaluation system and method based on fixed camera
abstract_en: The system comprises an image acquisition subsystem (6) and a tower drum fixed monitoring device (5), wherein the image acquisition subsystem is used for acquiring visual data of a blade (1) and a tower drum (4) through a cabin fixed monitoring mechanism (3); the monitoring data processing subsystem (7) carries out structural response calculation and data normalization processing on the monitored visual data; the state evaluation subsystem (8) performs dynamic characteristic parameter identification and state evaluation; the emergency treatment subsystem (9) assists in automatic early warning and stopping when extreme loads threaten the safety performance of the wind turbine structure; the nacelle fixed monitoring mechanism (3) is used for carrying out video shooting on the blades at the nacelle. The method can avoid the problem of overhigh cost caused by the traditional wind turbine health monitoring method which mainly takes people and consumes time and labor, and can realize long-term health monitoring and state evaluation of the running state of the omnibearing, long-time-effect, low-cost, high-precision and non-contact large wind turbine structure in various environments.

title_en: Operation optimization method for regional electricity-hydrogen mixing natural gas comprehensive energy system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method for optimizing the operation of a regional electricity-hydrogen mixing natural gas comprehensive energy system, which comprises the following steps: providing a discretized hydrogen-mixed natural gas hydrogen-adding ratio model; establishing an energy station equipment model of a regional electricity-hydrogen mixing natural gas comprehensive energy system; an operation optimization model of the regional electricity-hydrogen mixing natural gas comprehensive energy system is established, a linearization solving method of the model is provided, the operation optimization model of the regional electricity-hydrogen mixing natural gas comprehensive energy system can be established, and flexible adjustment capability of hydrogen and hydrogen mixing natural gas related equipment can be comprehensively excavated by using the operation optimization model.

title_en: Intelligent cryogenic pump
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of cryopumps, in particular to an intelligent cryopump. The technical problems to be solved are as follows: in the regeneration process of the cryopump, a large amount of water can be generated, and then the coating in the shielding cylinder is influenced, so that the coating is fallen, the surface pollution of the cold umbrella is caused, the refrigeration speed and the refrigeration efficiency of the cryopump are reduced, in the reduction process, the gas condensation and the icing adsorbed on the inner side of the shielding cylinder and the gas condensation and the icing adsorbed on the cold umbrella are carried out, the heat temperatures contacted at the same time are different, the icing gasified at the same time is not the same atom, and the screening effect of the cryopump on the atoms in the gas is influenced. The technical scheme of the invention is as follows: an intelligent cryopump comprises a compressor, a transmission pipe and the like; a transmission pipe is arranged above the compressor. The invention realizes interception of the dropped coating through the filter screen, prevents the coating from being adsorbed on the surface of the cold umbrella, causes pollution on the surface of the cold umbrella, reduces the reflection effect of the cold umbrella and leads to temperature rise at the inner side of the shielding cylinder.

title_en: Device and method for diagnosing faults of aviation electric fuel pump
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fuel control of aero-engines, and discloses a fault diagnosis device and a fault diagnosis method for an aviation electric fuel pump, wherein the control device comprises: the vibration sensor is arranged at the motor stator end cover of the electric fuel pump and used for converting mechanical vibration of the electric fuel pump into an analog voltage signal, and the sensor signal conditioning module is used for conditioning the analog voltage signal output by the vibration sensor; the vibration signal acquisition processing module is used for carrying out analog-to-digital conversion, buffering, filtering and FFT (fast Fourier transform) on the conditioned analog voltage signal to generate a real-time frequency spectrum signal; the prior vibration frequency spectrum identification module is used for identifying the frequency spectrum of the electric fuel pump when no fault occurs in advance as a prior frequency spectrum; the fault diagnosis module is used for identifying the real-time spectrum signal based on the prior spectrum and diagnosing whether the electric fuel pump has faults or not in real time; the fault state reporting module is used for reporting the fault state and the fault vibration frequency point of the electric fuel pump to the upper controller in real time.

title_en: Cold pump and semiconductor processing equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a cold pump and semiconductor processing equipment, relates to semiconductor processing technology field. The cold pump is used for vacuumizing the reaction chamber and comprises a pump body and a heating device, wherein an exhaust port of the reaction chamber is communicated with an inner cavity of the pump body; the heating device comprises at least one heating component, the heating component comprises a heating sleeve and a ventilation pipeline, the heating sleeve is provided with a mounting cavity, the ventilation pipeline is arranged in the mounting cavity, an air outlet of the ventilation pipeline is communicated with an inner cavity of the pump body, and an air inlet of the ventilation pipeline is used for communicating an air source so as to introduce air into the ventilation pipeline; on the cross section of heating jacket, the heating jacket includes inlayer, heater wire, heat preservation and the skin that set gradually along deviating from the installation cavity direction, and the heater wire can electrically conduct and generate heat. The utility model provides a install in the installation cavity of heating jacket through the vent line, the gas in the vent line and heater wire do not direct contact, can guarantee to let in gaseous cleanliness to the pump body inner chamber, be favorable to prolonging the life of the pump body.

title_en: Fan fault diagnosis method based on CapBLSTM-MOHHO
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fan fault diagnosis method based on CapBLSTM-MOHHO, which comprises the steps of carrying out feature selection through SCADA historical data, obtaining non-redundant feature data related to wind power, preprocessing the non-redundant feature data, adopting extremum theory to analyze residual errors between predicted values and actual values, determining an alarm threshold value, constructing a prediction model, inputting SCADA online data to be diagnosed into the prediction model, outputting the predicted values, and determining the running state of a fan based on the predicted values and the alarm threshold value, wherein the prediction model comprises a plurality of prediction units, the prediction units are constructed by adopting a capsule-bidirectional long-short-time memory network, and the prediction units are obtained through training of the preprocessed non-redundant feature data. The method can effectively process the sequence data and accurately predict the wind power, realize the fault early warning of the fan, and is suitable for multiple wind fields managed by the wind power centralized control center.

title_en: Railway-based direct air carbon dioxide capture system and method
abstract_en: Systems and methods for capturing and removing carbon dioxide gas (COz) directly from ambient air on a billion ton scale and powering it with renewable energy sources using rail transit equipment. Additional systems and methods for eliminating locomotive emissions and eliminating local air pollution in urban areas are described and powered by renewable energy sources that also utilize rail transportation equipment.

title_en: Power supply energy storage system using carbon as medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power generation of power systems, in particular to a power supply energy storage system taking carbon as a medium.

title_en: Energy-saving diesel generator set
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy-saving diesel generator set, which belongs to the technical field of diesel generator sets and comprises a base, wherein a generator, a diesel engine and a heat dissipation part are arranged on the base, the diesel engine further comprises a cylinder body, a crankshaft is rotationally connected to the cylinder body, a plurality of combustion chambers are fixedly connected to the cylinder body, pistons slide in the combustion chambers, and the rotation of the crankshaft is realized through the sequential longitudinal reciprocating motion of the plurality of pistons. According to the invention, the compression ratio of the combustion chamber can be dynamically adjusted without stopping, so that the diesel engine outputs different powers, the generator supplies corresponding loads, and the diesel consumption is reduced; the stability of each part can be improved when the compression ratio of the diesel engine is changed, the shake of the engine is reduced, and the working condition is improved; after the compression ratio is changed, the heat dissipation part can synchronously respond, so that the temperature of the engine tends to be constant, and the optimal working condition of the engine is ensured; the stepped heat dissipation mode ensures that the diesel engine can have good working conditions and saves energy.

title_en: Improved method for estimating and setting exhaust purge time in combustion system and combustion system thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a method for estimating and setting an exhaust purge time in a combustion system comprising a gas turbine, configured for estimating whether a purge cycle is required based on values collected by a pressure detector arranged upstream of the gas turbine, in particular inside a fuel gas compartment feeding the gas turbine. The present disclosure also relates to a combustion system for performing such a method.

title_en: Method for large-scale combustion of methanol by diesel engine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for combusting methanol in a large proportion by a diesel engine, which relates to the field of combusting methanol in a large proportion by the diesel engine and comprises the following operation steps: cold air enters the inner cavity of the metal shell through the cold air inlet pipe, at the moment, gas entering through the exhaust inlet pipe of the engine heats the metal pipe arranged at the metal shell through self heat, the cold air enters the inner cavity of the metal shell and is heated by the metal pipe, hot air is formed and then is introduced into the air inlet pipe of the engine, methanol is sprayed to the metal pipe in the inner cavity of the metal shell through the methanol nozzle, and at the moment, gasification treatment can be completed on the methanol. The method for combusting the methanol in a large proportion of the diesel engine can solve the problem of combustion of the methanol in a large proportion, and can lead the proportion of the methanol to the diesel oil to be as high as 85 percent by heating air inlet and gasifying the methanol: 15, when in use, the phenomenon of engine flameout can not occur, and the use cost can be effectively reduced by greatly improving the proportion of the methanol.

title_en: Rotating wheel type working medium-free propeller
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rotating wheel type working medium-free propelling device utilizing centrifugal force difference; a novel propulsion unit for object movement belongs to the field of mechanical engineering. The device is driven by input power to rotate the rotating wheel at high speed, so that the sliding shaft in the sliding shaft sleeve obtains a centrifugal force center, when the sliding shaft passes through the long diameter position and the short diameter position of the shell at high speed, the speed and the radius are different, the generated centrifugal force is also different, and a centrifugal force difference appears, and the centrifugal force difference promotes the device to move towards the long diameter direction, so that the working medium-free propulsion effect is achieved. The device is mainly used for moving objects such as airplanes, aerocars, rockets, space vehicles, ships and warships and the like. The application of the propeller can greatly improve the propelling efficiency and the accelerating efficiency. The invention provides and discloses various novel vehicles to realize urban three-dimensional traffic and thoroughly solve urban traffic jam; provides technical support for deep space and ultra-deep space flight and also provides new bright spots for economic growth.

title_en: Nuclear power station steel containment system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a steel containment system of a nuclear power station, which comprises a steel containment and a water tank containment, wherein the steel containment and the water tank containment are fixed on a bottom plate, the steel containment and the water tank containment which correspond to the water tank containment are enclosed together to form a water tank, a deformation connection structure is arranged between the steel containment and the water tank containment to prevent vibration deformation of the steel containment from being transmitted to the water tank containment, and the water tank of the steel containment system is arranged in a mode of reducing space waste and is not limited by the steel containment.

title_en: Pre-evaporation type flame air inlet preheating device, diesel engine and air inlet preheating method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pre-evaporation flame air inlet preheating device, a diesel engine and an air inlet preheating method, which belong to the technical field of diesel engines and comprise an electric control oil sprayer, an electric heating evaporation pipe, a flame stabilizer and an electric heating piece; the flame holder is provided with a cavity with one end open and the other end closed, and the wall surface of the cavity is provided with a through hole and two symmetrical wing plates; the oil injection outlet of the electric control oil injector is communicated with one end of an electric heating evaporation tube, and the other end of the electric heating evaporation tube is communicated with the inlet of the flame stabilizer; the electric control fuel injector can inject fuel to the electric heating evaporation pipe to heat the fuel into gaseous fuel, the gaseous fuel is sprayed out from the through hole after entering the cavity, the gaseous fuel sprayed out from the through hole can flow along the outer wall of the wing plate towards the tail end of the wing plate under the pushing of incoming air in the air inlet pipe of the diesel engine, and a vortex backflow area is formed at the tail end of the wing plate; the electric heating element is arranged in the vortex backflow area. The intake preheating device realizes the improvement of the intake temperature of the diesel engine and improves the cold starting performance of the diesel engine.

title_en: Rotary device, motor, and pump
abstract_en: The present invention provides a novel technique which uses a vibrator and can be applied to various applications. The rotating device includes a vibrator having a vibration surface perpendicular to a vibration direction and a counter element having a counter surface facing the vibration surface and rotating around the vibration direction of the vibrator. The vibration surface and the facing surface have parallel regions facing each other in parallel and impeller regions formed in at least one of the three dimensions.

title_en: Cooling medium for aircraft-mounted electronic equipment and lubricating oil cooling system for bearing in engine
abstract_en: The application relates to a cooling medium of an aircraft airborne electronic device and an engine inner bearing lubricating oil cooling system, which comprises the following components: an aircraft fuel tank; the inlet of the airborne electronic equipment heat dissipation pump is communicated with an aircraft oil tank through a pipeline; the heat radiator of the airborne electronic equipment is characterized in that a hot side of the heat radiator of the airborne electronic equipment is connected with a cooling medium pipeline of the airborne electronic equipment, and a cold side inlet of the heat radiator of the airborne electronic equipment is connected with a heat dissipation pump outlet of the airborne electronic equipment through a pipeline; the stamping radiator is opposite to a stamping air inlet formed in the machine body, and a movable air inlet grille is arranged in the stamping air inlet; the hot edge inlet of the stamping radiator is communicated with the cold edge outlet of the radiator of the airborne electronic equipment through a pipeline, and the hot edge outlet is communicated with the aircraft oil tank through a pipeline; the inlet of the bearing lubricating oil heat pump is communicated with an aircraft oil tank through a pipeline; the hot side of the bearing lubricating oil radiator is connected with a bearing lubricating oil pipeline, the cold side inlet of the bearing lubricating oil radiator is connected with the bearing lubricating oil heat pump outlet through a pipeline, and the cold side outlet is communicated with the hot side inlet of the stamping radiator through a pipeline.

title_en: Blade positioning device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a blade positioning device which comprises a machine head, wherein a transmission shaft is rotatably arranged in the machine head, the transmission shaft penetrates through the machine head to be fixed with a hub, two blades are fixed on the hub, the transmission shaft is fixed with a first gear through a one-way bearing, the first gear is meshed with a second gear, the second gear is fixed with an output shaft of a first motor, a cam is further fixed on the transmission shaft, a rack is further slidably arranged in the machine head, a positioning block which is matched and clamped with the cam is fixed on the rack, the rack is meshed with a gear on the output shaft of the first motor, and an elastic piece which drives the rack to be meshed with the gear on the output shaft again is arranged on the rack. Compared with the prior art, the invention can realize the positioning of the blade under no wind and wind through the cooperation of the first gear, the one-way bearing, the second gear, the first motor, the rack, the positioning block, the cam and the elastic piece, and then the blade is lowered to the lower part of the photovoltaic panel, thereby avoiding the hot spot effect.

title_en: Device and method for disassembling filter element of radioactive filter
abstract_en: The invention relates to a disassembly device for a radioactive filter element, which comprises a disassembly box, an oven, a core flushing device, a preparation device, a manual adhesive cleaning device and an automatic adhesive cleaning device, wherein the disassembly box is a sealed shell, and the core flushing device, the preparation device, the oven, the manual adhesive cleaning device and the automatic adhesive cleaning device are sequentially arranged in the disassembly box according to the disassembly sequence. A method for disassembly of a radioactive filter cartridge, comprising the steps of: negative pressure is started, the equipment is disassembled, the impact coring is performed, the height is Wen Rongjiao, the manual glue cleaning is performed, and the automatic glue cleaning is performed. The invention aims to automatically disassemble the low-radioactivity waste filter and classify the materials, so that the shell can be completely separated, the recycling of the shell is realized, the resource utilization rate is improved, and the sustainable development is realized; simultaneously, the emission of solid wastes is reduced, the problem of overlarge temporary pressure of the waste filter in the nuclear power station is successfully solved, and the radioactive filter element disassembling equipment is provided.

title_en: Device for dispensing a fluid
abstract_en: A reusable fluid dispenser (100) and a disposable fluid pack (200) for use with the reusable fluid dispenser (100) are provided for dispensing fluids. The plurality of different disposable fluid packages (200) are interchangeably usable with the same reusable fluid dispenser (100) such that a plurality of different fluids can be dispensed at a plurality of different flow rates without cross-contamination of the fluids. The reusable fluid dispenser (100) includes a housing (102), a motor (106), a controller (114), a power supply (104), and a decoder (110), and a lens array (116). The disposable fluid pack (200) includes a fluid reservoir (202), a pump (204), and an encoder (206).

title_en: Heating, feeding, water taking and draining circulation system suitable for nuclear power physical model test
abstract_en: The invention relates to a heating, feeding, water taking and draining circulation system suitable for a nuclear power physical model test, which comprises the following components: the water taking assembly comprises a primary mixing barrel, a secondary mixing barrel and a reagent barrel, wherein the primary mixing barrel is communicated with the water taking assembly, the secondary mixing barrel is respectively communicated with the primary mixing barrel and the reagent barrel is communicated with the primary mixing barrel so as to convey reagents into the primary mixing barrel, a stirrer and a heating element are arranged in the primary mixing barrel and the secondary mixing barrel, the water taking assembly is used for pumping water into the primary mixing barrel, the water discharging assembly is used for discharging liquid in the secondary mixing barrel, and a heating feeding water taking and discharging circulating system suitable for nuclear power physical model test is adopted to provide technical support for water taking outlet temperature rise and liquid effluent physical model test research of related marine nuclear facilities.

title_en: Novel thermal power fused salt energy storage power generation system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of electricity molten salt energy storage and power generation, and discloses a novel thermal power molten salt energy storage and power generation system, which comprises the following components: the energy storage circulating system is used for continuously heating the cold molten salt through water vapor exothermic liquefaction; the energy release circulation system releases heat energy stored by the hot molten salt so as to heat water vapor to overheat and cool the hot molten salt to circulation of cold molten salt; the power generation circulation system is used for enabling superheated steam to enter the steam turbine to perform working power generation and circularly pressurizing and heating cooled water, and through the design of the scheme of the invention, the efficiency of the system is higher than that of the coal-fired unit with the same scale at present.

title_en: Offshore wind power single pile foundation scouring treatment device and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ocean engineering, in particular to a scouring treatment device for a single pile foundation of offshore wind power, which comprises a seabed bottom surface, a single pile body arranged on the surface of the seabed bottom surface, and a treatment mechanism arranged on the surface of the single pile body, wherein the treatment mechanism comprises a treatment component, a covering component, a stirring component and a splicing component, the treatment component is arranged on the surface of the single pile body, the covering component is arranged on the surface of the treatment component, the stirring component is arranged on the surface of the covering component, and the splicing component is arranged on the surface of the treatment component; the device is installed on the surface of the single pile body in a splicing mode, so that the effect of protecting the single pile body is achieved, the hard ropes are facilitated to stir on the sea bottom, the sediment is enabled to be piled up inside the first semi-cylindrical clamping plate and the second semi-cylindrical clamping plate more rapidly, and firmness in the using process of the device is improved.

title_en: Conveying system and method for deep sea spiral axial flow type oil-gas mixed conveying pump
abstract_en: The invention discloses a conveying system and a method for a deep sea spiral axial flow type oil-gas mixing conveying pump, wherein the conveying system comprises the following steps: the gas-liquid mixing and homogenizing system is characterized in that an upstream pipeline is connected with a central platform through a first bypass pipeline and a spiral axial flow mixing and homogenizing pump through a second bypass pipeline respectively, and is connected with a tubular spiral homogenizer; the gas-liquid mixed transportation measurement system is provided with a first pressure temperature sensor, a second pressure temperature sensor and a measurer for measuring the thickness of a liquid film at the output end of the tubular spiral homogenizer; the gas-liquid mixing and conveying control system is provided with a controller. According to the invention, the first bypass pipeline, the second bypass pipeline and the upstream pipeline are switched and adjusted to be suitable for different production scenes, the influence of intermittent change of gas content and pressure on the spiral axial flow mixed transmission pump is avoided through the tubular spiral homogenizer, the action of the spiral axial flow pump and the opening of the throttle valve are regulated and controlled in real time, and the real-time and closed-loop regulation and control of the flow conditions of the inlet end and the outlet end of the spiral axial flow mixed transmission pump are realized.

title_en: Thermal power plant and regional boiler room coupled heating system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of central heating, in particular to a heat supply system and a method for coupling a thermal power plant and a regional boiler room. The thermal power plant and the regional boiler room coupling heat supply system and the method realize the communication of the thermal power plant heat supply system and the regional boiler room heat supply system, break the limit of a single heat source, switch different heat sources in time, provide another effective heat supply method, further improve the heat supply capacity and ensure safe and stable heat supply.

title_en: Design method for low-flow-loss small radial gap of adjustable stationary blade of axial-flow compressor
abstract_en: The application provides a design method for low-flow-loss small radial clearance of an adjustable stationary blade of an axial flow compressor, which belongs to the technical field of multistage axial flow compressors and specifically comprises the steps of taking the relative chord length between a blade adjusting rotating shaft and a blade when the front edge of the blade is covered by a rotating circular table or the front edge of the blade is not covered by the rotating circular table as a design basis, adjusting the position of the blade adjusting rotating shaft, the inclination angle of the blade adjusting rotating shaft and the size of the rotating circular table, and solving interference points or clearance characteristic points of a stator blade within the range of the maximum blade adjusting angle according to the determined three parameters and the maximum blade adjusting angle; and carrying out flow channel curve fairing based on the interference points and the clearance characteristic points to obtain a process fairing curve, and carrying out three-dimensional simulation on the single blade row of the current stator blade based on the curve until the total pressure recovery coefficient and the outlet airflow angle meet preset requirements. The scheme of the application reduces the attenuation of the stator gap to the performance of the compressor and improves the overall performance of the compressor.

title_en: Large and small hole air film cooling layout structure of turbine blade gill region of aero-engine
abstract_en: The invention relates to a large-small hole air film cooling layout structure of a turbine blade gill region of an aeroengine, and aims to improve cooling efficiency and reliability of the turbine blade gill region. The structure is particularly suitable for the gill region of the blade with the characteristic of large curvature change, and high-efficiency and uniform air film coverage is realized by the way of interval arrangement of the big holes and the small holes. The small holes are responsible for providing basic air film protection, while the large holes effectively inhibit adverse effects caused by high curvature, high pressure gradient and secondary flow of the gill region of the blade, so that complete good air film coverage of the gill region is realized together. The layout is designed according to the geometric characteristics and flow characteristics of the gill region of the blade, and the blade root is flexibly arranged from the blade tip to the blade root so as to adapt to different cooling requirements. The design of the invention not only simplifies the processing technology and reduces the cost, but also obviously improves the cooling efficiency of the turbine blade and the performance of the whole engine, prolongs the service life of the turbine blade, and has important practical value and wide application prospect.

title_en: Centrifugal impeller and centrifugal fan
abstract_en: The invention provides a centrifugal impeller and a centrifugal fan, wherein the centrifugal impeller comprises a wheel disc and blades, the outline shape of the wheel disc is cylindrical, the blades are fixedly connected to the end face of the wheel disc, the two ends are respectively a first end close to the axis of the wheel disc and a second end far away from the axis, a plurality of first comb teeth are arranged on the second end, the projection shape of each first comb tooth is a shape gradually reduced towards the axis far from the wheel disc on a plane parallel to the axis of the wheel disc, and the plurality of first comb teeth are sequentially distributed along the axial direction of the wheel disc. The invention has the advantages of effectively reducing noise during operation and further reducing noise pollution.

title_en: Broadband monitoring and protecting method and system for wind power generation system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a broadband monitoring and protecting method and system for a wind power generation system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: step 1, sampling VT voltage signals and CT current signals, and collecting VT voltage CT current Step 2, correcting the voltage signal and the current signal by adopting an integrated empirical mode decomposition method; step 3, performing self-adaptive detection on the voltage signal and the current signal by adopting fast Fourier transform to obtain each subharmonic component; step 4, calculating the voltage signal and the current signal to obtain the ratio of the harmonic voltage and the harmonic current to the allowable value under different frequencies, and obtaining the ratio of the operation amplitude of each harmonic to the allowable amplitude   Wherein i represents a harmonic frequency and j represents a load amount; step 5, according to And determining the running mode of the fan according to the fluctuation and change condition of the numerical amplitude. The invention realizes the monitoring and protection of the wind power generation system to the broadband oscillation from the source.

title_en: Motor, compressor and refrigeration equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a motor, a compressor and refrigeration equipment, and relates to the technical field of refrigeration equipment, wherein the motor comprises a rotor, the rotor is provided with a plurality of magnet grooves and a plurality of magnetic barrier groups, the magnet grooves and the magnetic barrier groups are all arranged at intervals along the circumferential direction of the rotor, two ends of the magnet grooves extend towards the edge of the rotor, the magnetic barrier groups are arranged on one side, far away from the center of the rotor, of the magnet grooves, at least one of the two ends of the magnet grooves is provided with a magnetic conduction modulation opening towards one side of the magnetic barrier groups, the width of the magnetic conduction modulation opening along the circumferential direction of the rotor is B1, and the depth of the magnetic conduction modulation opening along the radial direction of the rotor is B2, and 2 XB 2 is less than or equal to B1. According to the technical scheme, the cogging torque and the output torque fluctuation of the permanent magnet motor can be weakened, and the running stability of the motor is ensured.

title_en: Automobile carbon tank with multi-cavity filtration
abstract_en: The application relates to an automobile carbon tank with multi-cavity filtration, and belongs to the technical field of carbon tanks. The novel adsorption device comprises a shell, an adsorption pipeline and a ventilation pipeline, wherein the shell comprises a first cavity, a second cavity and a third cavity, the first cavity is communicated with the adsorption pipeline, a first filter piece, a second filter piece, a third filter piece, a first ventilation piece and a reset component are arranged in the first cavity, the first ventilation piece is connected with the first cavity, the first filter piece and the second filter piece are both connected with the side wall of the first cavity in a sliding mode along a first direction, a diversion trench is formed in the side wall of the first cavity, the first filter piece is matched with the first end of the diversion trench, the second end of the diversion trench is arranged between the second filter piece and the end face of the first cavity, the reset component is connected with the first filter piece, the third filter piece is arranged on the side wall of the first cavity, the second cavity is empty and is communicated with the first cavity through the first ventilation pipeline, and a fourth filter piece is arranged in the third cavity. The application has the effect of improving the filtering effect of the carbon tank.

title_en: Ignition module circuit capable of preventing negative pressure conduction of comparator
abstract_en: The invention relates to an ignition module circuit for preventing negative pressure conduction of a comparator, wherein a diode D2 is connected in series between an RC charge-discharge loop and a comparator U1B, the positive electrode of the diode D2 is connected with the RC charge-discharge loop, the negative electrode of the diode D2 is connected with a non-inverting input end U1B_5 of the comparator U1B through a series resistor R8, meanwhile, the negative electrode of the diode D2 is connected with the other end of a resistor R12 to form a negative pressure protection circuit, the diode D2 is connected with the resistor R12 in series to form a discharge loop of a capacitor C1 and a capacitor C3, the other ends of the resistor R1 and the resistor R2 are connected with an inverting input end U1B_6 of the comparator U1B, the resistor R1 and the resistor R2 are connected in series for dividing voltage, the RC charge-discharge loop receives an input signal S1, the negative pressure protection circuit processes the input signal, the voltage of the comparator U1B compares the voltages of the two ends, and the output end U1B_7 of the comparator U1B outputs a signal S2. The invention prevents the ignition coil from being misfiring caused by negative pressure interference and reduces the risk of various vehicle faults caused by the occurrence of the ignition coil misfiring.

title_en: Multi-dimensional composite sensing technology intelligent device for wind power and state monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of multi-dimensional compound sensing of wind power, in particular to an intelligent device and a state monitoring system for the multi-dimensional compound sensing technology of wind power, and aims at solving the problems that in the prior art, in the using process, the utilization rate and the accident rate of a wind turbine cannot be improved, the maintenance difficulty and the workload are high, and the scheme is provided. The invention has simple structure, obtains the abnormal state information of the fan in advance, prevents the occurrence of serious safety accidents in early stage, early stage abnormal early warning, avoids unplanned shutdown, improves the generated energy, reduces the times of maintenance on the fan, reduces the times of taking the large part off the rack, reduces the operation and maintenance cost, promotes the maintenance without humanization by innovative function and informatization management, reduces the workload and is convenient for people to use.

title_en: Cooling tower protector and cooling tower
abstract_en: The invention provides a cooling tower protection device and a cooling tower, and relates to the field of cooling tower protection, comprising a cooling tower main body; the cooling tower is characterized in that a fixed cage is fixedly arranged at the top of the cooling tower body, a rotary cage is rotationally connected to the outer side of the fixed cage, a protective top cover is slidably connected to the top of the rotary cage, a driving motor is fixedly arranged at the top of the outer wall of the front side of the cooling tower body, a rotary ring is slidably connected to the outer side wall of the cooling tower body at the bottom of the driving motor, a protective fence plate is arranged on the outer side of the rotary ring, and six protective net plates are fixedly arranged in the middle of the outer side wall of the cooling tower body in an annular array. After rotatory halter passes through keyway and key shaft connection, radiator fan just can drive rotatory halter synchronous rotation to through the rotation of rotatory halter, make rotatory halter's groove and radiating groove crisscross constantly, avoid the foreign matter to drop in the cooling tower main part from the radiating groove of fixed halter, and further improvement radiating effect, solve the thermovent and receive the high altitude to weigh down the thing and lead to the flabellum to damage and the easy problem of blockking up of air inlet.

title_en: Inter-stage bleed structure of compressor and compressor
abstract_en: The structure is arranged between a first casing and a second casing, comprises a plurality of lap joint parts and a plurality of air entraining grooves, wherein the first casing comprises a plurality of lap joint extension plates, the second casing comprises a plurality of lap joint tables, and the lap joint extension plates and the lap joint tables are lapped with each other to form lap joint parts; the plurality of air entraining grooves are defined by the first casing and the second casing in opposite directions and are circumferentially and alternately arranged with the lap joint part; the surface of the first casing, which defines the air entraining groove, is a first inclined surface, the surface of the second casing, which defines the air entraining groove, is a second inclined surface, and part of the second inclined surface is not parallel to the first inclined surface, so that the air entraining sectional area of the air entraining groove is amplified. The inter-compressor stage bleed air structure can remarkably increase the inter-compressor stage bleed air amount. A compressor is also provided.

title_en: Thermal power generating unit peak regulation method, system, equipment and medium based on molten salt system
abstract_en: The application relates to a thermal power generating unit peak regulation method, a system, equipment and a medium based on a molten salt system, wherein the method is used for obtaining the power of a plurality of thermal power generating units according to the heat supply working conditions of the molten salt system by constructing the molten salt system and a peak regulation model of the thermal power generating unit; and constructing a fused salt heat storage and release model, wherein the fused salt heat storage and release model is used for selecting a peak regulation model matched with the current heat supply working condition in the peak regulation model according to the current heat supply working condition of the thermal power generating unit, and controlling the heat storage or release of the fused salt system so as to obtain the current power generation of the thermal power generating unit. The thermal power generating unit can realize peak shaving of the thermal power generating unit based on a peak shaving model according to the current thermal power generating unit heating working condition. The problem that the effect is poor in the variable-working-condition peak regulation coupling operation of the molten salt system and the thermal power unit in the related art is solved, and the peak regulation accuracy of the thermal power unit is improved.

title_en: Ternary advection centrifugal fan
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ternary advection centrifugal fan, which relates to the field of centrifugal motors and comprises a base and a fan shell, wherein the fan shell is arranged at the top of the base, a starting motor is arranged on the surface of the fan shell, and an output shaft of the starting motor penetrates through the fan shell. According to the ternary advection centrifugal fan, the clamping groove, the clamping block and the impeller are arranged, in the rotating process, due to the fact that a certain gap exists between the impeller and the rotating shaft, the impeller can shake during rotation, and the risk of shaking is larger and larger along with gradual acceleration of the rotating speed due to the action of inertia, so that the clamping block in the rotating shaft can do centrifugal motion during rotation and gradually clamp into the clamping groove, the impeller is supported, and the centrifugal acting force is increased along with the increase of the rotating speed, so that the propping action is firmer, the impeller is firmer, and the front-back movement of the impeller is avoided.

title_en: Shielding type multiphase mixed transportation pump
abstract_en: The invention discloses a shielding type multiphase mixed transportation pump, which comprises a motor driving device with a central shaft and a pump body connected with an output shaft of the motor driving device, wherein a pressure vessel is coaxially arranged outside the motor driving device, one end of the pump body, which is far away from the motor driving device along the central shaft, is externally connected with a first flushing lubrication pipe, one end of the motor driving device, which is far away from the pump body, along the central shaft, is externally connected with a second flushing lubrication pipe, the mechanical seal is externally connected with a cooling pipe, a mechanical sealing component in the pump body can be cooled, and meanwhile, bearings in the pump body and the motor driving device are flushed and lubricated, so that an additional cooling system can be reduced, manufacturing and maintenance costs can be reduced, unnecessary energy consumption can be saved, and the service life of the bearing can be prolonged.

title_en: Current loop parameter determination method, device, medium, program product and control system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a device, a medium, a program product and a control system for determining current loop parameters, wherein the method comprises the following steps: detecting whether the current variation of a bearing coil of a magnetic suspension bearing of the magnetic suspension compressor exceeds a preset current threshold value; when the current exceeds a preset current threshold value, recording the displacement precision of the magnetic suspension bearing at the moment as initial displacement precision; and continuously modifying the current loop parameter twice to respectively obtain a first alternative current loop parameter and a second alternative current loop parameter, and determining whether the first alternative current loop parameter or the second alternative current loop parameter is currently used according to a first difference value between the absolute value of the initial displacement precision and the absolute value of the first displacement precision after the modification of the first current loop parameter and a second difference value between the absolute value of the initial displacement precision and the absolute value of the second displacement precision after the modification of the second current loop parameter. The scheme of the invention can solve the problem that the response speed of the running current of the unit cannot be met in all aspects due to the fixed parameter value of the current loop.

title_en: Brushless motor with good noise reduction effect
abstract_en: The application provides a brushless motor with good noise reduction effect, and relates to the technical field of food processing. According to the side air guiding mode of the flat shell of the variable frequency motor, the defects of unstable air flow and large wind noise of the centrifugal fan during reversing are overcome, stable and reliable wind outlet in the reversing high-speed driving mode is realized, and the overall air inlet and outlet guiding efficiency is improved.

title_en: Positive spiral pile-suction barrel composite foundation and installation and recovery method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a positive spiral pile-suction barrel composite foundation and an installation and recovery method thereof, comprising the following steps: the suction barrel comprises a top cover, an inner barrel and an outer barrel, and the inner barrel and the outer barrel are coaxially arranged; one end of the inner barrel and one end of the outer barrel are fixed with the top cover, the inner barrel and the outer barrel form an annular barrel with an opening at the bottom, and one end of the inner barrel, which is far away from the top cover, extends out of the inner part of the outer barrel; the top cover is provided with a mounting part, an inner barrel water pumping hole and an outer barrel water pumping hole which respectively correspond to the inner barrel and the outer barrel, the mounting part is provided with a positive spiral pile which is detachably connected with the mounting part, and the positive spiral pile can be inserted into the inner barrel from the mounting part and extend out of the inner barrel. On the premise of ensuring reliability, the composite foundation convenient to assemble and disassemble is provided.

title_en: Low-pulsation and low-impact modularized hydraulic plunger pump/motor cylinder body
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-pulsation and low-impact modularized hydraulic plunger pump/motor cylinder body, which comprises a plunger cylinder and a modularized distribution surface structure; an annular groove is formed in the flow distribution end face of the plunger cylinder, and plunger holes, an inner radial groove and an outer radial groove are uniformly distributed in the annular groove along the circumferential direction; the modularized flow distribution surface structure comprises an annular flow distribution plate, an inner end surface boss and an outer end surface boss which extend inwards and outwards respectively along the radial direction of the flow distribution plate; the inner end face boss is matched with the inner radial groove, and the outer end face boss is matched with the outer radial groove, so that the modularized flow distribution plane structure is nested in the annular groove of the plunger cylinder, and a flow distribution plane of the cylinder body structure is formed; the distributing plate is provided with a plurality of distributing windows which are uniformly distributed along the circumferential direction, and the distributing windows are in one-to-one correspondence with the plunger holes; the end part of the flow distribution window of the flow distribution plate is provided with a vibration reduction structure. The invention can realize modularization and seamless switching between the opening and closing type pump and the motor.

title_en: Thermal management device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a thermal management device which comprises a shell, a sealing assembly, a ball valve and an outer circulation joint, wherein the shell comprises a main cavity, an inner circulation joint, a cooling liquid inlet, a bypass inlet and a bypass outlet which are formed in the shell, the ball valve is arranged in the main cavity, the sealing assembly, the outer circulation joint, the shell and the ball valve are matched to form a bypass valve, an inner through valve and an outer through valve, and the opening and closing and the opening degree of each valve in the bypass valve, the inner through valve and the outer through valve can be controlled by rotating the ball valve. The bypass valve is controlled to control the flow rate of the coolant for bypass circulation, the inner communication valve is controlled to control the flow rate of the coolant for inner circulation, and the outer communication valve is controlled to control the flow rate of the coolant for outer circulation. In this way, the flow of coolant in various cycles can be precisely controlled to provide more flexible and precise thermal management of different parts of the vehicle.

title_en: Nuclear power plant radiator fan control method, system and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control method, a system and a medium for a radiator fan of a nuclear power plant, and relates to the technical field of digital instrument control; performing state maintenance judgment based on the preliminary fault judgment result and the running state parameters of each fan assembly, and correspondingly adjusting the control parameters of each fan assembly when the fan assembly is in fault; outputting maintenance reminding or normal running state according to the state maintenance judging result; the method is improved on the prior fan control technology, the state maintenance judgment is carried out based on the preliminary fault judgment result and the running state parameters of each fan assembly, and the maintenance prompt or the normal running state is output according to the state maintenance judgment result; when part of fan components in the cooling fan are damaged or a cooling fan fails, other fan components in the cooling fan or fans adjacent to the failed fan can be automatically controlled according to the temperature in the cabinet, so that delayed maintenance is realized, and the overall usability is improved.

title_en: Circumferential field coil fixing device and tokamak device
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of nuclear fusion, in particular to a circumferential field coil fixing device and a tokamak device. The annular field coil fixing device comprises an upper fastening ring, a lower fastening ring, a clamping connecting device and an inclined strut, wherein the upper fastening ring is respectively located at the upper end part and the lower end part of the annular field coil, the upper fastening ring is respectively connected with the annular field coil through the clamping connecting device, and the inclined strut is arranged between the upper fastening ring and the lower fastening ring. Compared with the prior art, the annular field coil fixing device and the tokamak device provided by the application can effectively bear the expansion force and the overturning force of the coil, and avoid the annular field coil from generating expansion deformation in the radial direction and torsional deformation in the tangential direction.

title_en: Engine rotation speed control method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for controlling the rotating speed of an engine, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining the current rotating speed of the engine, the load torque of the engine and the friction torque of the engine under the condition that the engine is in a preset idle working condition; determining a difference value between the current rotating speed and a preset rotating speed set value; determining a control torque of the engine based on the difference; calculating a target control torque of the engine according to the control torque, the load torque and the friction torque; the engine operation is controlled based on the target control torque to adjust a current rotational speed of the engine. By applying the method provided by the embodiment of the invention, the problem of overlarge transient control fluctuation in the rotating speed adjusting process can be avoided.

title_en: Variable geometry throat for variable structure RBCC combustion chamber
abstract_en: The invention discloses a variable geometry throat for a variable structure RBCC combustion chamber, wherein the variable geometry throat is a shell with openings on the left side and the right side, the opening on the left side of the shell is a throat inlet, and the opening on the right side of the shell is a throat outlet; the shell is formed by sequentially and integrally connecting an upper wall panel, a rear wall panel, a lower wall panel and a front wall panel; an adjusting groove is formed in the upper wall panel along the direction of the throat; according to the invention, the servo motor is used for controlling the throat plate to slide back and forth along the left and right directions to change the geometric throat area, and the throat area is adjusted by moving the throat plate under different Mach numbers; the throat plate is seamless under the height of each throat, so that a sealing structure can be omitted, the sealing difficulty is greatly reduced, and in the flight process, the engine moves back and forth along the upper wall panel according to the change of the flight state, and the throat height change is adjusted; can meet the wide-range work of Ma 2-6.

title_en: Fluid kinetic energy capturing device based on rigid relaxation semi-column and flexible wake flow beating plate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fluid kinetic energy capturing device based on a rigid relaxation semi-column and a flexible wake flow beating plate, wherein a flexible wake flow beating energy collecting system is arranged behind the relaxation semi-column energy collecting system at intervals in the incoming flow direction; when the fluid flow speed is greater than the critical speed of relaxation instability of the relaxation semi-column energy collection system, the relaxation semi-column energy collection system generates relaxation oscillation to collect fluid kinetic energy, and meanwhile, the flexible wake flow flapping energy collection system assists in capturing the fluid kinetic energy; when the fluid flow speed is smaller than the critical speed of relaxation instability and the relaxation semi-column energy collecting system cannot be started to vibrate, the flexible wake flow beats the energy collecting system to capture the fluid kinetic energy under the action of unsteady flow vortex environment falling off from the rear of the relaxation semi-column energy collecting system. The invention can effectively improve the working capacity of the relaxation energy-collecting device before the relaxation instability critical speed, has high energy conversion rate, is green and environment-friendly, and is suitable for underwater environment.

title_en: Mine exhaust gas utilization method and system based on mixed catalytic oxidation reaction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine exhaust gas utilization method and system based on a mixed catalytic oxidation reaction, and relates to the technical field of clean energy utilization, wherein the method comprises the following steps: mixing the mine emission gas and the low-concentration extraction gas to obtain mixed gas; carrying out dehumidification and enthalpy increasing treatment on the mixed gas to obtain high-temperature mixed gas; carrying out catalytic oxidation reaction by using high-temperature mixed gas to obtain high-temperature flue gas; heating water in the waste heat boiler by utilizing high-temperature flue gas to obtain high-temperature and high-pressure steam; and respectively driving the turbine units to generate power and heat the heat users by utilizing the high-temperature and high-pressure steam. According to the invention, the low-concentration extracted gas with the gas concentration lower than 10% is mixed with the mine exhaust gas to obtain the mixed gas with the gas concentration of 1.2%, so that the low-concentration extracted gas and the mine exhaust gas which cannot be utilized at the present stage are fully utilized, the near zero emission of the gas is achieved, and the benefit can be created while the environmental pollution is reduced.

title_en: Netted valve plate and valve assembly thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of valve components, in particular to a net valve plate and a valve component thereof, comprising a valve plate body, wherein the bottom end of the valve plate body is provided with a supporting ring, the bottom end of the supporting ring is provided with an assembly part, the inner wall of the supporting ring is fixedly connected with a mounting block, the top of the valve plate body is hinged with a dismantling block, the top end of the valve plate body is provided with a connecting groove, and the dismantling block is in sliding connection with the inside of the connecting groove; after the connection relation between each arc plate I and each arc plate II is relieved, the top of the valve sheet body is not restricted any more, each dismantling block is overturned along the hinging position of the valve sheet body and each dismantling block until each dismantling block is clamped into the inner cavity of each connecting groove, each installing block is extruded out of the inner part of each connecting groove, one surface of each installing block to be dismantled is flush with the valve sheet body, the dismantling blocks are naturally dismantled, and the valve assembly can be dismantled by lifting the adjusting handle through the automatic fixing mechanism.

title_en: Drying method and device for wind power generation equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a drying method and a drying device for wind power generation equipment, and belongs to the technical field of wind power generation; solves the problem of preferential selection of the drying method under different dryness indexes; the method comprises the following steps: obtaining predicted data of wind power generation equipment; obtaining estimated parameters of the drying device; calculating the estimated parameters to obtain normalized estimated parameters; calculating the normalized estimated parameters to obtain estimated parameter coefficients; calculating the normalized estimated parameters and the estimated parameter coefficients to obtain environment parameters, position parameters and equipment parameters; calculating environmental parameters, position parameters and equipment parameters to obtain a detection drying index, and obtaining a prediction model according to an algorithm; obtaining a dryness index ZH2 according to the prediction model and the prediction data; analyzing according to the dryness index ZH3 to obtain the distribution condition of ZH2; and analyzing the ZH2 distribution condition and ZH2 to obtain a preferred section of the drying method.

title_en: Vertical shaft small-sized wind power generation device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wind power generation, in particular to a vertical-axis small-sized wind power generation device which comprises a base, a connecting column, fan blades and a controller, wherein a mounting shell is fixedly arranged on the base, a generator for generating electricity is fixedly arranged in the mounting shell, a rotating supporting seat is rotatably arranged at the upper end of the base, a bottom mounting box is fixedly arranged below the base, and a main shaft of the generator is fixedly connected with the rotating supporting seat. According to the wind power generation device, according to the measurement of the wind power outside the anemometer, the fan blades are switched to be in a storage state and fixed in the strong wind weather, and the rotation supporting seat and the main shaft are separated to avoid overload operation of the generator caused by the strong wind weather; meanwhile, the wind receiving surface of the blade surface can be effectively reduced, so that faults caused by the fact that the rotation supporting seat is severely rotated and worn in strong wind weather are avoided, the abrasion and the fault rate of the vertical-axis small wind power generation device in strong wind weather can be effectively reduced, and the service life is prolonged.

title_en: Single-channel air compensation type EGR (exhaust gas recirculation) mixer, mixing system and control method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a single-channel air compensation type EGR (exhaust gas recirculation) mixer, a mixing system and a control method, wherein the EGR mixer comprises a control unit, a TVA valve, a high-flow air nozzle, an air inlet manifold and an EGR core, wherein the air inlet manifold is provided with four communication ports, the first communication port is communicated with one end of the high-flow air nozzle, and the other end of the high-flow air nozzle is used as a high-pressure air inlet to be communicated with a whole vehicle air storage tank; the second communication port is communicated with an engine exhaust pipe after passing through a TVA valve and an intercooler air passage; the third communication port is communicated with an engine air inlet pipe; an EGR (exhaust gas recirculation) core is arranged in the fourth communication port and is communicated with an EGR system; the control unit is arranged on the TVA valve and is connected with the ECU through a connecting wire. The invention is mainly used for improving the mixing uniformity and emission of the medium-low speed medium-low load working condition area, and is suitable for small-displacement engines (below 9L); all subsystems and parts in the mixing system are mutually cooperated to realize the air inlet compensation of the engine and improve the mixing uniformity and the engine emission.

title_en: Oil pump motor based on voice recognition and outlet pipeline working condition abnormality monitoring method thereof
abstract_en: The voice recognition technology is applied to a hydropower station speed regulation hydraulic system, the oil pump motor and the outlet pipeline operation condition of the oil pump motor are monitored in real time through reasonable layout of on-site voice print sensors, the intelligent level of equipment management is improved, and an industrial demonstration effect is achieved. Through the deep learning analysis of multidimensional factors such as pressure, liquid level, temperature and the like, a logic judgment flow of multidimensional factors of abnormal working conditions of an oil pump motor and an outlet pipeline based on voiceprint recognition is designed, and counter measures such as automatic switching of a main oil pump motor unit and a standby oil pump motor unit or automatic adjustment of unit load and the like are timely adopted. The state of the field device is monitored in real time by utilizing the voiceprint sensor and voiceprint recognition technology, so that uncertain factors of manual inspection are eliminated, and the fault diagnosis analysis efficiency is improved.

title_en: Control method and device for cooling fan of motor controller, vehicle and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of vehicles, in particular to a control method and device of a cooling fan of a motor controller, a vehicle and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: and when the motor controller of the vehicle is detected to be in the preset fault mode, controlling the cooling fan by using the first target fan opening, otherwise, determining a second target fan opening of the cooling fan according to the motor rotating speed, the motor torque and the IGBT temperature of the motor controller when the motor controller is judged to be in the torque mode or the target fault mode, so as to control the cooling fan. According to the embodiment of the application, the cooling fan can be controlled by utilizing the first target fan opening degree under the condition that the motor controller is in a certain fault mode, otherwise, the cooling fan is controlled by utilizing the second target fan opening degree when the motor controller is judged to be in a torque mode or a target fault mode, so that the reliability of noise reduction of the cooling fan is improved, and the driving comfort of a user is improved.

title_en: Quick roller lifting hydraulic system of cement vertical mill
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid roller lifting hydraulic system of a cement vertical mill, which comprises two groups of hydraulic differential circuits in differential connection, wherein each group of hydraulic differential circuits comprises a hydraulic variable pump and two hydraulic cylinders, and the hydraulic variable pump is connected with the two hydraulic cylinders through a pressure maintaining control valve circuit to provide pressure oil; each hydraulic variable pump is connected with a motor for driving, and is connected with a filter and then connected with a pressure maintaining control valve loop. The scheme adopts the double constant pressure variable plunger pump and has a loop with differential connection, so that the grinding roller can quickly pass through a severe vibration area, and production accidents caused by vibration stop of the vertical mill due to material fluctuation, agglomeration in winter and large foreign matter entering are effectively prevented.

title_en: Fan
abstract_en: The application discloses a fan, belongs to the technical field of household appliances, and aims to solve the technical problem that the air output of the existing fan is small. The fan includes: the shell is provided with a first air channel, a second air channel, a first air inlet, a second air inlet, a first air outlet, a first air channel and a second air channel which are communicated with each other, the first air inlet is communicated with the first air channel, and the first air outlet is communicated with the second air channel; the air flow adjusting component is arranged in the first air channel, and the air outlet fan is arranged in the second air channel. The air in the first wind channel after the air current adjusting part adjusts enters into in the second wind channel, blows out from first air outlet after the acceleration of air-out fan, can make the user feel bigger air-out volume, can accelerate indoor gaseous circulation, better regulation air current to improve user experience and feel.

title_en: High-efficient heat dissipation type wind driven generator gear box heat abstractor and gear box
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of gearboxes, in particular to a high-efficiency heat-dissipation type wind driven generator gearbox heat dissipation device and a gearbox, wherein the high-efficiency heat-dissipation type wind driven generator gearbox heat dissipation device comprises a controller, a heat dissipation water tank and a filtering water tank; the radiating water tank is internally provided with a mounting plate which is transversely connected with a first connecting pipe in a sliding manner; the rear end of the filtering water tank is provided with a first connecting seat which is matched with the first connecting pipe; the rear end of the first connecting pipe is provided with a connecting plate and a hose, one end of the hose is communicated with the rear end of the first connecting pipe, the other end of the hose is communicated with a water inlet of the radiating water tank, the first connecting pipe is provided with an electromagnetic valve, the filtering water tank is provided with a tension bolt in a penetrating way, the front end of the connecting plate is provided with a tensioning internal thread cylinder matched with the tensioning bolt, a passive proximity switch assembly is arranged between the mounting plate and the connecting plate, and the passive proximity switch assembly and the electromagnetic valve are connected with the controller. According to the invention, the condensed water is filtered through the filtering water tank, so that the radiating effect of the radiating water tank can be ensured, and the passive proximity switch is used for conducting control, so that the filtering water tank is convenient to disassemble.

title_en: Supply system
abstract_en: A supply system (S) for supplying ozone to an engine (71) includes an electrolysis unit (1) that electrolyzes water to generate hydrogen and oxygen, a first supply unit (21) that supplies the hydrogen generated by the electrolysis unit (1) to an intake pipe (80) of the engine (71), an ozone generation unit (5) that generates ozone from the oxygen generated by the electrolysis unit (1), and a second supply unit (22) that supplies the ozone generated by the ozone generation unit (5) to the intake pipe (80).

title_en: Short-distance detonation pre-detonation tube ignition device with pre-mixing cavity
abstract_en: The invention relates to an ignition initiation device of a rotary detonation engine, in particular to a short-distance initiation pre-detonation tube ignition device with a premixing cavity, which is used for solving the defects that the existing RDE is used for initiating the pre-detonation tube, the ignition energy is insufficient, the tempering problem caused by premixing injection, the slow combustion-to-detonation transition speed is slower, the pre-detonation tube is increased in size and weight, and the pre-detonation tube design is difficult to balance. The short-distance detonation pre-explosion tube ignition device ensures that the fuel and the oxidant are quickly and uniformly mixed through the fuel supply shell, and the activity of reactants and the detonation wave ignition energy are improved; secondly, active disturbance to flame is added through a plurality of detonation turbulent flow circular rings of a turbulent flow detonation cavity, so that slow combustion to detonation conversion is realized rapidly in a shorter distance, and meanwhile, the flow loss of the detonation wave frontal surface is reduced; and finally, on the premise that the same outlet diameter and jet energy are ensured by the section expansion section, the length of the turbulent flow detonation section can be effectively shortened, and the weight and the volume of the invention are reduced.

title_en: Manufacturing process of rotor for rotor type phase-change liquid-cooled pump
abstract_en: The invention discloses a manufacturing process of a rotor for a rotor type phase-change liquid-cooled pump, which comprises the following steps: s1, rotor body processing and forming, S2, driving rotor fixed assembly, S3, driving rotor engineering plastic layer injection molding, S4, driven rotor fixed assembly, S5 and driven rotor engineering plastic layer injection molding. The invention can not only improve the injection molding quality of the engineering plastic layer on the outer surface of the rotor body, but also realize the injection molding processing of the engineering plastic layer of the same pair of driving rotor and driven rotor by the same injection mold, thereby greatly improving the practicability and reducing the manufacturing cost.

title_en: End cover structure and air compressor
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of air compressors, and provides an end cover structure and an air compressor, wherein the end cover structure comprises a cover body, a first oil baffle part, a second oil baffle part and a breathing nozzle, when the air compressor is in overturning packaging, lubricating oil in a first cavity is positioned above the second oil baffle part, and because a third communication hole is higher than the height of the oil liquid level in the first cavity in an inversion state, the lubricating oil in the first cavity can not flow to the second cavity to a great extent or completely in the inversion process, so that the phenomenon that the residual lubricating oil in the air compressor flows out from the breathing nozzle when the air compressor is in inversion packaging can be avoided to a great extent or even completely avoided, and further, the pollution to a packing material when the air compressor is in overturning packaging can be avoided. In addition, the second communication hole that sets up can constitute the intercommunication ware structure between the inside of first cavity and crankcase to the air compressor machine is in the course of the work, in order to accurately acquire the volume of first cavity inside lubricating oil.

title_en: Method and device for controlling stop of coaxial water supply pump
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for controlling the stop of a coaxial feed pump, and relates to the technical field of stop control of feed pumps; when the coaxial feed pump fails or needs to be shut down for maintenance, the rotating speed of the coaxial feed pump is controlled to be reduced, when the rotating speed of the coaxial feed pump is reduced to be smaller than the first preset rotating speed, an electric feed pump and pump program is called and executed, and when the electric feed pump and pump program is executed, the rotating speed of the coaxial feed pump is controlled to be reduced to zero by controlling the hydraulic coupler and the disc brake in sequence, so that more accurate and reasonable stop control logic of the coaxial feed pump can be provided, the safe operation of a steam turbine coaxial drive feed pump system applying a steam turbine coaxial drive feed pump technology is ensured, the automation degree of equipment operation is improved, the manual workload is reduced, and the possible error caused by equipment failure is avoided.

title_en: Annular filtering adjusting type water pump
abstract_en: The invention discloses an annular filtering adjusting type water pump, which comprises a water pump body, wherein an input pipe, a filter pipe, a rotating rod and a moving rod are arranged on the outer surface of the water pump body, impurities in a water source are filtered and separated through an annular filter screen, large-particle impurities naturally fall to the bottom of the filter pipe to precipitate, meanwhile, fibers of a filter ball expand due to the permeation and impact effects of water to form a denser filter layer, finer suspended matters in the water are effectively intercepted, a plurality of arc-shaped bulges are arranged on the outer surface of the filter ball, the contact area of the required water source and the filter ball is increased, the capturing rate of the impurities is improved, the filter ball can float in a layered manner through large counterweight balls and small counterweight balls with different weights, the water flow can uniformly and fully flow through each filter ball, the contact efficiency of the water body and filter materials is improved, and the pollutant removing effect is enhanced.

title_en: Efficient new-configuration single-stage turbine design method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-efficiency new-configuration single-stage turbine design method which comprises the following steps of defining a bionic blade structure, generating wave characteristics of the bionic turbine blade, aligning an original blade profile curve with the wave curve, and optimizing the wave curve by using a global optimization algorithm based on machine learning to determine specific design parameters of a guide blade and a movable blade, wherein multiple objective functions are set to be total pressure loss coefficients and total efficiency of turbine blade grid outlets under different flow rates and rotating speeds. The use of asymmetric wave relief structures simulating seal whiskers in the middle of the vanes produces counter-rotating vortices to inhibit flow separation, and the use of more pronounced wave relief structures in the end wall positions inhibits secondary flow development, so that the turbine stage improves stage efficiency and reduces flow losses over a wide range of rotational speeds.

title_en: Marine fan jacket foundation capable of adjusting natural frequency and motion damping and control method
