abstract_en: The invention discloses a sea fan jacket foundation capable of adjusting natural frequency and motion damping and a control method thereof, comprising a jacket, a tuning liquid damper system, a flow monitoring and control system and an acceleration data acquisition and analysis system, wherein the tuning liquid damper system comprises a central liquid bin and a distributed liquid bin, the central liquid bin is communicated with sea water, the central liquid bin and the distributed liquid bin are in liquid conveying through pipelines, the flow monitoring and control system acquires information of reserves of each liquid bin through acquisition data, the acceleration data acquisition and analysis system acquires acceleration data at key nodes of the jacket foundation, pumps on each pipeline are controlled based on the acquired data to realize redistribution adjustment of the liquid storage and liquid level of each liquid bin of the damper system in a short time, and the mass distribution of the jacket structure is adjusted so as to adjust the natural frequency and the motion damping. The invention has the advantages of convenient construction, convenient operation and accurate control, and is suitable for being used as a foundation form of the open sea fan which is subjected to long-term dynamic load.

title_en: Dry tail gas post-treatment device for mine diesel engine and mine diesel engine system
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a dry type diesel engine exhaust aftertreatment device for a mine and a dry type diesel engine system for a mine, the dry type diesel engine exhaust aftertreatment device for a mine includes: a heat insulation interlayer is arranged in the circulating water tank, the outside is provided with a water tank water cooling jacket; the fuel oxidation catalyst, the diesel particle catcher and the selective catalytic reduction are sequentially communicated, and are integrally arranged in the heat insulation interlayer; a radiator configured to cool the water tank water-cooling jacket; wherein the internal temperature of the heat insulation interlayer is higher than the temperature in the water cooling jacket of the water tank.

title_en: Box-type generator set with automatic sealing and ventilation functions
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of generator sets and discloses a box-type generator set with an automatic sealing and ventilation function, which comprises a box body with a generator set inside, wherein a box door is rotatably arranged at the front end of the box body, a heat dissipation shutter is embedded at one end of the box body far away from the box door, side doors are rotatably connected to the tops of the left end and the right end of the box body, a through hole is formed in the upper part of the side door, an air inlet shell is arranged at one end of the through hole, and a ventilation assembly is arranged at the air outlet end of the air inlet shell and at the inner side wall of the side door; according to the invention, by integrating the high-efficiency ventilation system and the automatic cleaning mechanism, the functions of effective heat dissipation, isolation of external impurities, automatic cleaning maintenance and the like of the generator set in the operation process are realized, and the stable operation and the service life prolongation of the generator set are ensured; the filter screen automatic cleaning system reduces the manual maintenance cost, improves the running efficiency of the unit and prolongs the service life.

title_en: Rotary compressor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rotary compressor. The rotary compressor includes a housing, a cylinder, main and sub bearings, a rotation shaft, rollers, and at least one vane, and at least one elastic deformation portion may be provided in the cylinder to absorb impact with the vane. Accordingly, frictional loss and/or abrasion between the cylinder and the vane is suppressed by absorbing collision force caused by the shaking phenomenon of the vane, so that the efficiency of the compressor can be improved while reducing vibration noise, and initial start can be rapidly performed.

title_en: Sealing compensation type ceramic pump
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ceramic pump manufacturing, and provides a sealed compensation type ceramic pump which comprises a pump body, wherein the pump body is communicated with a water pipe, the water pipe is fixedly connected with a threaded pipe, the water pipe is fixedly connected with two first telescopic rods, the two first telescopic rods are symmetrically arranged about the center of the water pipe, the telescopic ends of the two first telescopic rods are fixedly connected with second telescopic rods, a clamping mechanism is arranged between the telescopic ends of the two second telescopic rods, the clamping mechanism can clamp and fix a connecting pipeline, an adsorption mechanism is arranged in the clamping mechanism, and the adsorption mechanism can be adsorbed and fixed with the surface of the connecting pipeline. The control module is used for controlling the clamping mechanism, the adsorption mechanism and the sealing mechanism, and guaranteeing the sealing effect between the threaded pipe and the connecting pipeline.

title_en: Form-reconfigurable multifunctional rotary detonation engine exhaust system and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a form-restructurable multifunctional rotary detonation engine exhaust system and a use method thereof, wherein the exhaust system comprises the following components: the flange plate is installed to the outer ring, straight sections such as inner ring hollow cylinder, interior anchor ring etc., inner ring face shrink section, truncated axisymmetric stopper cone, outer ring face shrink section, outer ring lip cover. The outer side of the outer ring mounting flange plate is provided with a one-way valve, a spark plug mounting hole and a pressure sensor interface. The hollow cylindrical surface of the inner ring is connected with the inner ring surface and other straight sections. The straight sections of the inner ring surface can be connected with the contraction section of the inner ring surface and also can be connected with the truncated plug cone. The outer ring lip cover can be connected with the outer ring surface contraction section and also can be connected with the outer ring mounting flange plate. The components are fastened by radial threaded bolts. The invention obtains 7 pneumatic molded surfaces in total by increasing and decreasing components and recombining the form of an exhaust system of a rotary knocking engine, namely, a short blunt end, a long blunt end, lip cover fixing/plug shrinking, plug cone fixing/lip cover shrinking, no dislocation of a throat and lip cover fixing half-bucket type and no lip cover plug, thereby being beneficial to the thermal state experiment of pedigree.

title_en: Compressed air energy storage system and power generation equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power generation equipment, and discloses a compressed air energy storage system and power generation equipment. The compressed air energy storage system comprises a first heating component, a compressor, a gas storage component and a turbine; the first heating assembly is used for heating the outside air. An air inlet of the compressor is communicated with an air outlet of the first heating component. The air inlet of the air storage component is communicated with the air outlet of the air compression component and is used for storing compressed air. The air inlet of the turbine is communicated with the air outlet of the air storage component, and the air outlet of the turbine is used for discharging air. According to the invention, by arranging the first heating component, the heating of the external air can be realized, the heated air can be conveyed to the compressor, the exhaust temperature of the compressor is increased, and the power of the compressor is increased, so that the power absorption capacity of the energy storage system to the electric power can be improved. The power plant provided by the invention has at least the advantages described above, as it comprises a compressed air energy storage system as described above.

title_en: Self-flushing cooling system of system pressure regulating valve and spiral vane type mixed delivery pump
abstract_en: The invention relates to a self-flushing cooling system of a system pressure regulating valve and a spiral vane type mixed delivery pump, and belongs to the field of pumping devices. The system pressure regulating valve comprises a valve body, a first regulating piece, a first elastic piece and a second regulating piece. The valve body is provided with a first accommodating cavity and a second accommodating cavity which are arranged along a first direction, and is provided with a liquid inlet channel for liquid to enter the second accommodating cavity and a liquid outlet channel for liquid to flow out of the second accommodating cavity. The first adjusting piece is provided with an isolation part and a plugging part which are connected with each other, the isolation part is arranged in the first accommodating cavity to divide the first accommodating cavity into a first subchamber and a second subchamber, the second subchamber is communicated with the second accommodating cavity, and the first subchamber is communicated with the liquid outlet channel. The blocking part is configured to block the liquid inlet channel when being positioned at the first position; the liquid inlet channel is not blocked when the liquid inlet channel is positioned at the second position. The first elastic piece is abutted with the isolation part. The second regulating part is elastically connected with the valve body, and part of the second regulating part is positioned at the joint of the second accommodating cavity and the liquid outlet channel so as to block part of the liquid outlet channel.

title_en: Design method of mask plate in Mathieu geometric mode
abstract_en: A design method of a mask plate in Mathieu geometric mode comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of selecting a spiral Mathieu mode as a substrate, expanding the spiral Mathieu mode into a group of coherent modes under the control of m and n, acquiring an electric field expression of the Mathieu geometric mode according to a stable coherent state representation method, combining the amplitude, the phase and a blazed grating of the Mathieu geometric mode to obtain a transmittance function of a mask plate of the Mathieu geometric mode, namely the mask plate of the Mathieu geometric mode. Therefore, the method has very important application prospect in the field of space structure light field and complex particle operation.

title_en: Engine control method, vehicle-mounted controller, system, automobile and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an engine control method, a vehicle-mounted controller, a system, an automobile and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring noise data in a vehicle; carrying out noise duty ratio analysis on noise data in the vehicle, and determining the noise duty ratio of the engine; the engine operation is controlled based on the engine noise duty cycle. The method can effectively improve the NVH performance of the whole vehicle, can be applied to the development stage of the vehicle to optimize the NVH performance of the whole vehicle, can control the engine in real time in the actual use process of a user after leaving a factory, realizes the real-time optimization of the NVH performance of the whole vehicle, is not limited by the environment and the scene of the vehicle, realizes the more effective and timely optimization of the NVH performance of the whole vehicle, does not need to consume longer time and more manpower and material resources, and has higher economic value and application value.

title_en: Special injector of single-component liquid rocket engine for satellite
abstract_en: The invention provides a special injector of a satellite single-component liquid rocket engine, which relates to the field of liquid rocket engines, and comprises the following components: the device comprises a collector, a bracket, an injection plate, a capillary tube and a heat conducting block, wherein one end of the bracket is connected with the collector, the other end of the bracket is connected with the injection plate, the capillary tube and the heat conducting block are respectively connected with the collector, and the capillary tube is contacted with the heat conducting block. According to the invention, the heat conducting block with strong heat conducting capability is arranged to transfer the temperature of the capillary tube to other positions, so that the temperature of the capillary tube is reduced, and the problems of capillary tube explosion, air inclusion and the like possibly existing in the satellite unit liquid rocket engine injector are solved.

title_en: Afforestation drainage system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an landscaping drainage system which comprises a drainage pipe and a detention box, wherein the drainage pipe is arranged on the upper end face of the detention box, the drainage structure comprises the detention box, the detention box of the drainage structure is sequentially connected with a filter box and a protective box through a drainage pipeline, and a water wheel rotating structure is arranged in the protective box. Through the jacking setting of well lid and regulation well piece under among the drainage structure, realized the lower water ability adjustment of well lid, when the regulation well piece down-ward movement to the spacing platform of contact, the well pipe water yield maximize this moment, consequently the lower water ability of drainage system will not be limited, and the limitation reduces, when the circumstances of needs big displacement in the face, can not lead to the condition of ponding because of the displacement is not enough, has improved the suitability of whole drainage system.

title_en: Control method, device, equipment and medium of transient exhaust gas recirculation system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a control method, a device, equipment and a medium of a transient exhaust gas recirculation system, which comprise the following steps: determining a load state of the engine according to a first required boost pressure of the engine, and if the load state of the engine is a medium-low load working condition, determining a required charge change rate of the engine according to the opening degree of an accelerator to judge whether the engine enters a transient state or not; if the engine is judged to be in a transient state, determining a first transient state degree factor of the exhaust gas recirculation system as a preset fixed value; inputting the first actual rotation speed and the first actual charge into a transient exhaust gas circulation rate MAP and a steady-state exhaust gas circulation rate MAP respectively, and outputting a first transient exhaust gas circulation rate and a first steady-state exhaust gas circulation rate; determining a first target EGR rate according to the first transient degree factor, the first transient exhaust gas circulation rate and the first steady-state exhaust gas circulation rate; the exhaust gas recirculation system is controlled in accordance with the first target EGR rate. The method of the embodiment of the application improves the response speed of EGR and the initial power of the engine.

title_en: Mineral exploitation ventilation device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mineral exploitation ventilation device which comprises a base, an air duct and a fan, wherein the fan is arranged in the air duct, one side of the air duct is provided with a filter screen, the filter screen is used for filtering air flow, the outer side of the air duct is provided with a plurality of dust removing mechanisms, the dust removing mechanisms are used for dust removing and cleaning of the filter screen, each dust removing mechanism comprises a housing, an air cover and a driving component, the housing is arranged outside the air duct, one side of the housing is provided with an air hole, the housing is fixedly connected with an air pipe at the air hole, the air pipe faces the filter screen, the air cover is arranged inside the housing, the driving component is used for adjusting the positions of the air cover in the housing and the air duct, and the air cover is used for guiding the air flow in the air duct into the housing. According to the invention, the fan cover is adjusted to deflect into the air duct, so that air flow generated by rotation of the fan blade can be collected and blown out along the surface of the filter screen through the air pipe, and under the condition, the air flow in two directions exists at the outer surface of the filter screen, so that turbulent flow can be formed to blow away dust.

title_en: Toggle type bionic rotary actuator based on shape memory alloy driving
abstract_en: The invention discloses a toggle type bionic rotary actuator based on shape memory alloy driving, and belongs to the technical field of mechanical automation. The invention adopts the shape memory alloy wires as driving materials, and the driving mechanisms which are uniformly distributed are matched with the rotor, and the three shape memory alloy springs are used for driving the rotating shaft to rotate together through rotor transmission by utilizing the tension matched cooperation of the three shape memory alloy springs. Because of the super elasticity, high tapping ratio and high driving force capacity of the shape memory alloy, compared with the traditional actuator, the actuator in the scheme has stronger driving force and stronger anti-interference capacity and simple structure, and has wide prospect in the fields of precise instruments such as aerospace, biomedical treatment, automation and the like.

title_en: Liquid chromatograph with brand-new diaphragm type pump head structure
abstract_en: The invention provides a liquid chromatograph with a brand-new diaphragm pump head structure, which is formed by at least one diaphragm component in a parallel or serial mode, wherein the diaphragm pump head structure is used for avoiding the problems of abrasion, liquid leakage and the like of a plunger rod, reducing the maintenance cost, having more stable mobile phase conveying performance, effectively reducing pressure fluctuation and flow fluctuation, improving the analysis accuracy and repeatability, reducing the pressure fluctuation generated when a plunger circularly pumps liquid, and achieving better balance between the control precision of a small flow rate and the output of the pump.

title_en: Hose roller pump
abstract_en: A peristaltic pump is described, in particular for delivering a fluid in a device for extracorporeal blood treatment. The peristaltic pump has a pump housing in which a rotor is accommodated which is rotatable about a rotor axis, the rotor having at least two pressing elements which are offset from one another in the circumferential direction, and the pump housing having a support surface which extends arcuately about the rotor axis and is radially spaced apart from the rotor and is provided for supporting a hose section which can be introduced radially between the rotor and the support surface. In order to increase the service life of the pump and to reduce fluctuations in the pump volume, guide surfaces are provided which rotate together with the rotor and are arranged and designed adjacent to one another in the circumferential direction on both sides of the pressing element in each case, such that the guide surfaces and the support surfaces each form an arcuate guide channel in which the hose section can be radially fastened with a predetermined clearance fit.

title_en: Pump with a pump body
abstract_en: The utility model provides a pump, includes casing subassembly and power pack, and casing subassembly includes the water knockout drum, and the water knockout drum includes diapire portion, and power pack includes first pole, and first pole includes supporting part, and supporting part is fixed with diapire portion, and power pack includes rotor subassembly, rotor subassembly includes magnetic part, first friction piece, second friction piece and impeller, magnetic part first friction piece second friction piece with impeller is an organic whole piece, rotor subassembly includes the supporting part the axial of first pole, first friction piece is located one end of supporting part, second friction piece is located the other end of supporting part defines, and the face of perpendicular to first friction piece's axis is first face, first friction piece's projected inner circle is located the supporting part is in the projected inner circle of first face, second friction piece is located the projection of first face the supporting part is in the projected inner circle of first face. And the working efficiency of the pump is improved.

title_en: Tunnel air quality remote monitoring and intelligent ventilation control system and method in construction period
abstract_en: The application relates to a system and a method for remote monitoring and intelligent ventilation control of tunnel air quality in construction period, which relate to the field of intelligent monitoring and comprise the steps of acquiring air detection parameters and adjacent detection parameters; the method comprises the steps of calculating a difference value between an air detection parameter and an adjacent detection parameter to be used as a detection difference value, controlling a movement detection device to detect air quality in a tunnel according to a movement detection path based on the condition that the detection difference value exceeds a reference difference value, outputting the movement detection parameter, obtaining an external wind speed value of a tunnel portal, matching a ventilation device number and a ventilation power value corresponding to the ventilation device number from a ventilation database according to the external wind speed value and the movement detection parameter, and controlling the ventilation device corresponding to the ventilation device number to ventilate the tunnel according to the corresponding ventilation power value. The application has the effects of improving ventilation efficiency and reducing energy consumption.

title_en: Variable exhaust valve assembly
abstract_en: An example variable exhaust valve assembly for a gas turbine engine is disclosed herein, including a port extending radially outward from a compressor section of the gas turbine engine, the port defining a variable exhaust valve cavity, the port resonating at a resonance frequency based on an operating condition of the gas turbine engine, and an acoustic inhibitor positioned on a wall of the port, the acoustic inhibitor extending circumferentially along the wall for a length greater than a cross-sectional width of the acoustic inhibitor, the acoustic inhibitor defining a resonance cavity based on the length and the cross-sectional width, the acoustic inhibitor including a perforated portion, the acoustic inhibitor tuned to resonate at the resonance frequency based on the length and the perforated portion.

title_en: Full-flow automatic operation control method for secondary intermediate pressure turbine island
abstract_en: The invention relates to a full-flow automatic operation control method for a secondary medium pressure steam turbine island, which comprises the following steps of step 1, starting and checking, step 2, auxiliary machine starting, step3, step 4, step 5, step 6, automatic stopping, and step 7, automatic operation of an abnormal working condition bypass. The scheme reduces the operation of operators and improves the automation level of the unit. The invention also provides a control method for economic and safe operation of the steam turbine based on boundary control.

title_en: Metal fuel ramjet engine, aircraft and metal fuel engine operation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a metal fuel ramjet engine, an aircraft and a metal fuel engine operation method, which relate to the technical field of aerospace, wherein a heat conduction device is connected with a molten metal injection device, the heat conduction device is in heat conduction connection with an engine runner and/or an aircraft body, the metal fuel in a molten state is injected into the engine runner through the molten metal injection device, and high-enthalpy air inflow and the molten metal fuel are fully mixed and combusted in the engine runner to do work to generate propelling force. In addition, the heat of the engine runner and the aircraft body is utilized to heat the metal fuel, so that the metal fuel can be ensured to maintain a molten state, and the high-temperature wall surfaces of the engine body and the runner can be cooled and absorbed, so that the equivalent fuel energy and the energy utilization rate are improved, the working condition requirement of high flight Mach number is met, and compared with the powder fuel supply, the molten metal fuel supply structure is easier to arrange and the structural size of the engine is reduced.

title_en: Diffuser and gas cooling device
abstract_en: The invention provides a diffuser and a gas cooling device, which relate to the technical field of aerospace, and mainly comprise a plurality of sections of diffuser units which are connected in a head-to-tail sealing mode, wherein the diffuser units can provide a vacuum environment for a vacuum cabin of an engine, the diffuser units are of a tubular structure, when gas is injected to the diffuser units, the pressure of the vacuum cabin is reduced, the vacuum environment is realized, the diffuser units at two ends are simultaneously installed inside the vacuum cabin and outside the vacuum cabin, the diffuser units at the middle position are installed at the outlet of the vacuum cabin, so that the diffuser units at different sections can be replaced according to requirements, the diffuser units at different sections of the vacuum cabin can adapt to engines of different types, any section of diffuser unit is damaged, the vacuum cabin and the narrow space of a cabin passing flange can be fully utilized, and the cost of the diffuser can be reduced.

title_en: Nuclear power steam generator pipe plugging equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a pipe plugging device of a nuclear power steam generator, which greatly simplifies the operation flow of pipe plugging and reduces the working strength of operators through the arrangement of a driving device and a fluid guiding device. Through the cooperation of hydraulic guide subassembly and gas guide subassembly, can accomplish the stifled pipe work of end cap heat transfer pipe fast, reduce the time that the stifled pipe needs, improved the efficiency of stifled pipe operation. Furthermore, the pipe plugging device of the nuclear power steam generator can be suitable for heat transfer pipes of different sizes and types, can be used in different nuclear power station environments, and has good universality and adaptability.

title_en: Fan structure, heat dissipation system, air conditioner and control method
abstract_en: The invention provides a fan structure, a heat radiation system, an air conditioner and a control method, wherein the fan structure comprises a fan component, a heat radiation system and a heat radiation system; the control module is in signal connection with the fan component so as to send a driving signal to the fan component, and the power generation module is arranged corresponding to the fan component, and generates power by utilizing the kinetic energy of the fan component when the fan component rotates so as to send an electric signal to the control module. When the fan component moves, the power generation module is driven to generate power, and the control module deduces whether the fan component moves or not according to the electric signal generated by the power generation module, so that whether the fan component works normally or not can be judged. Because the generation of electric energy happens instantaneously, a worker can know the change of the state of the fan component at the first time, so that the technical problem that the fan is not easy to find in time when abnormal conditions occur is solved.

title_en: Mechanical tensioning gravity energy storage power generation device based on rail train and power generation rail line thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mechanical tensioning gravity energy storage power generation device based on a rail train and a power generation rail line thereof, comprising a power station below the rail, wherein two rows of driving plates are arranged at the bottom of the train, the power station comprises a box body buried below the rail, a power generation assembly is arranged in the box body, the power generation assembly is arranged in the middle of the rail, the power generation assembly is connected with a tensioning rope assembly, the tensioning rope assembly comprises a tensioning steel wire rope, one end of the tensioning steel wire rope is connected with the power generation assembly and is arranged in the box body, the other end of the tensioning steel wire rope is connected with a mechanical tensioning adjusting assembly, the mechanical tensioning adjusting assembly is arranged at the outer side of the rail, and the mechanical tensioning adjusting assembly drives the power generation assembly to be pressed towards the driving plates on the train by adjusting the tensioning force of the tensioning steel wire rope. The invention adopts the design of the mechanical tensioning rope to realize the compression of the power generation assembly and the train driving plate, thereby avoiding the compression of the power station from being influenced by the environmental temperature, improving the applicability of the power station and being more convenient to overhaul and adjust.

title_en: Multiple self-locking type blade telescopic rotation adjusting device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multiple self-locking type blade telescopic rotation adjusting device, which relates to the field of fan and water pump blade design and is characterized by comprising a supporting platform, the device comprises a rotary driving device, a blade length telescopic adjusting device, a blade angle rotary adjusting device, a displacement sensor, an angle encoder, a control system and the like. The mechanism mainly comprises a rotary driving device for fixing the blades and the telescopic rotating device on a supporting platform, so that the rotation of the blades is realized. Meanwhile, the mechanism realizes the telescopic adjustment of the length of the blade through the worm gear and the planetary roller screw, realizes the angle adjustment of the blade through the motor and the worm gear, and realizes the multiple self-locking of the length position and the angle through the motor self-locking, the worm gear self-locking and the electromagnetic brake. The mechanism can adjust the telescopic length and the rotating angle of the rotating blades according to the operating conditions, meets the requirements of high-efficiency energy-saving operation under all operating conditions, and realizes the maximization of energy benefit.

title_en: Automatic water feeding and liquid supplementing device and method for slurry pump
abstract_en: The application provides an automatic liquid supplementing device and method for feeding water to a slurry pump, which relates to the field of intelligent equipment, adopts a data coding and processing technology based on artificial intelligence to extract local time sequence characteristics of a time sequence set of pressure data at the outlet end of the slurry pump, then carries out time sequence association on the local time sequence characteristics of the pressure at each outlet end, and simultaneously, carrying out multi-gate structure propagation on the pressure local time sequence characteristics of each outlet end, so as to control the rotating speed value of the variable frequency motor at the next time point in a self-adaptive manner according to the obvious propagation representation of the pressure time sequence characteristics of the outlet end and the fusion representation of the pressure local time sequence distribution characteristics of the outlet end after time sequence association. Therefore, the working parameters of the variable frequency fluid infusion pump can be timely adjusted through the change feedback of the outlet pressure of the slurry pump, the timely and proper fluid infusion is ensured, and the working efficiency and the stability of the slurry pump are further improved.

title_en: Ultrasonic decontamination auxiliary device for pipeline hot spot of pressurized water reactor nuclear power station and use method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ultrasonic decontamination of pipeline hot spots of pressurized water reactor nuclear power plants, in particular to an ultrasonic decontamination auxiliary device for the pipeline hot spots of the pressurized water reactor nuclear power plants and a use method thereof. The local heating avoids large-scale energy waste, and the device is suitable for pipelines with different specifications through compact modularized design, so that the device is convenient and quick to assemble and disassemble, and the operation difficulty and the time cost are reduced. In addition, the sealing performance at high temperature and high pressure is ensured by combining the application of the sealing silica gel with the multi-layer sealing design of the sealing ring and the sealing chamber, and leakage of solution and heat is prevented. The ultrasonic vibrator enhances the chemical decontamination process, particularly removes refractory corrosions, ensures the thoroughness of decontamination and reduces residual radioactive substances. These advantages make the device have a wide application value.

title_en: Testing device of artificial heart pump
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial heart pumps, and discloses a testing device of an artificial heart pump. The test device of the artificial heart pump comprises a simulated left atrium cavity, a simulated mitral valve, a simulated left ventricle cavity, a simulated aortic valve cavity and a simulated venous cavity which are used for forming a blood circulation flow system, so that the blood circulation process in a human body can be simply and accurately reproduced, the blood flow dynamics characteristics of the natural heart of the human body under different failure degrees and different physiological states can be simulated, the blood pumping assisting effect of the artificial heart pump under different failure degrees and different physiological states of the simulated left ventricle cavity and the simulated left atrium cavity can be tested, and the hydraulic performance experiment and the extracorporeal blood circulation experiment of the artificial heart pump can be carried out based on the test device, so that the accuracy of the test result and the integrity of the test performance of the artificial heart pump are ensured.

title_en: Energy storage cabinet cell level fire-fighting system and method
abstract_en: The invention aims to provide the battery cell level fire-fighting system and the method of the energy storage cabinet, which have the advantages of simple structure, accurate alignment of a fire source, more accurate fire extinguishing agent spraying time and longer continuous fire extinguishing time. The system comprises a fire extinguishing medium storage device, a fire detection tube, a composite detector, a trigger and a controller, wherein the controller is in communication connection with a system background; the fire-fighting method of the system comprises the following steps that a controller controls the system to stop when a combustion factor is detected, b, a composite detector drives a trigger to trigger a fire-extinguishing medium storage device to release fire-extinguishing medium into a fire detection pipe, c, an alarm is sent out and a smoke exhaust fan is informed to work, d, when the fire detection pipe is softened by high-temperature open fire and is blasted by high-pressure fire-extinguishing medium, the fire-extinguishing medium is released to a fire source point of a battery cell, e, when fire is not extinguished or the battery cell is reburned, the high-temperature triggers a shower head glass ball to blast, and fire water is injected into an energy storage cabinet through a fire-extinguishing pipeline to extinguish fire. The invention is applied to the technical fields of new energy and energy storage.

title_en: Compressor cylinder, manufacturing method thereof, pump body assembly, compressor and electric appliance
abstract_en: The invention provides a compressor cylinder and a manufacturing method thereof, a pump body assembly, a compressor and an electric appliance, wherein the compressor cylinder comprises a cylinder body, a compression cavity is arranged on the cylinder body, a hollow groove is arranged between the compression cavity and the outer wall of the cylinder body, and the hollow groove extends along the circumferential direction of the compression cavity; at least one reinforcing rib extending along the radial direction of the cylinder body is arranged in the hollow groove in the axial direction of the cylinder body, a foam plastic layer is filled in the hollow groove, and the reinforcing rib is coated by the foam plastic layer. The compressor cylinder can avoid loosening and falling of noise-reducing heat-insulating materials in the compressor cylinder.

title_en: Sand-proof, anti-leakage and anti-blocking deep well pump
abstract_en: The application relates to a sand-prevention anti-leakage anti-blocking deep well pump which comprises a shell, a sand-prevention structure and a main shaft, wherein the large-mouth end of a static sand-prevention conical sleeve is fixed on a supporting inner cylinder, a mechanical seal is arranged on one side of the static sand-prevention conical sleeve far away from a pump cavity, the large-mouth end of a dynamic sand-prevention conical sleeve is coaxially and rotatably connected with the small-mouth end of the static sand-prevention conical sleeve, the static sand-prevention conical sleeve is provided with a ring groove, the peripheral wall of the large-mouth end of the dynamic sand-prevention conical sleeve abuts against the inner wall of the ring groove, the static sand-prevention conical sleeve is provided with a convex ring, the dynamic sand-prevention conical sleeve is provided with an abutting wall, an anti-friction ring is arranged on the abutting wall, and the convex ring rotates to abut against the anti-friction ring. According to the scheme, the outer peripheral wall of the large opening end of the dynamic sand control conical sleeve is abutted against the inner wall of the annular groove, the convex ring is abutted against the abutting wall through the friction control ring, the oil seal is arranged, the end part of the coupler, which faces the driving cavity, is tightly held by the loudspeaker, the quadruple sand control effect is achieved, the sand is not easy to damage mechanical seal, the sealing performance of the driving cavity is good, and the service life of the deep well pump is prolonged.

title_en: Magnetic suspension variable frequency compressor underframe for air conditioning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of air-conditioning external machines and discloses a magnetic suspension variable frequency compressor chassis for air conditioning, which comprises an air-conditioning external machine and a magnetic suspension variable frequency compressor arranged in the air-conditioning external machine, wherein the magnetic suspension variable frequency compressor comprises a crankshaft, the first chassis, the second chassis and the third chassis are arranged in the embodiment, vibration generated when the magnetic suspension variable frequency compressor surges can be effectively absorbed, buffer in X, Y, Z directions is realized through a first buffer rod, a second buffer rod and a buffer spring, damage to the air-conditioning external machine is avoided, meanwhile, an air pressure sensor is used for monitoring air pressure change of an air outlet of the magnetic suspension variable frequency compressor, a claw hand in an intervening component is driven to grasp the crankshaft, the regulation of the crankshaft rotation speed of the magnetic suspension variable frequency compressor is realized through the cooperation of a force application spring and an electromagnetic piece, the surge state is quickly separated, and stable operation of equipment is ensured.

title_en: Multi-gear compatible few-gear control method and direct current brushless motor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control method of a multi-gear compatible few gears and a direct current brushless motor, which comprises the steps of presetting N normal gears and M combined gears on a microprocessor MCU, respectively setting preset values for the normal gears and the combined gears, at least triggering one normal gear by one combined gear, when the normal gears are detected, operating the preset values of the corresponding normal gears by the microprocessor MCU, and when the combined gears are preset to be 0 and the combined gears are detected, operating the combined gears to trigger the combined gears, taking the maximum target value or the minimum target operation of the combined gears, or when the combined gears are not preset to be 0 and the combined gears are detected, operating the combined gears to trigger the preset values of the corresponding combined gears, and realizing the control of the multi-gear compatible few gears by the processing of software logic, thereby avoiding the problems of shutdown and logic error alarm when the redundant gears are not preset or the preset values are zero.

title_en: Gear pump
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of tooth top clearance leakage, and discloses a gear pump, aiming at solving the problems of leakage jet caused by larger tooth top clearance inside the gear pump so as to reduce the performance, the running efficiency and the running stability of the gear pump. The driving gear and the driven gear of the gear pump are arranged in the pump body and are connected in a meshed mode, and the driving gear and the driven gear are used for driving fluid to flow in the pump body. At least one of the driving gear and the driven gear is provided with a jet channel at the gear teeth. The jet flow channel is provided with a flow inlet and a jet flow outlet which are communicated, when the gear teeth rotate to the high pressure side, the flow inlet is arranged at the high pressure side of the gear teeth, and is used for enabling part of fluid to enter the jet flow channel from the flow inlet and be sprayed out from the jet flow outlet so as to increase the drainage resistance of the tooth top gap. The self-generating jet injected through the jet channel and the leakage jet in the gap between the tooth tops form convection so as to reduce the flow speed of the leakage jet and further increase the leakage resistance, thereby improving the performance, the running efficiency and the running stability of the gear pump.

title_en: Clean, efficient and stable ammonia humidifying combustion power generation system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a clean, efficient and stable ammonia humidifying combustion power generation system and method, and belongs to the technical field of ammonia fuel clean, efficient combustion power generation. The device comprises an ammonia fuel supply unit, an air supply unit, an oxygen supply unit, a water supply unit, a heat recovery unit and a stage combustion chamber unit, wherein the ammonia fuel supply unit is used for supplying fuel for the stage combustion chamber unit, the air supply unit is used for supplying air for the stage combustion chamber unit, the oxygen supply unit is used for supplying oxygen for the stage combustion chamber unit, the water supply unit is used for supplying water for the stage combustion chamber unit, the heat recovery unit is used for recovering heat energy of the stage combustion chamber unit, and the stage combustion chamber unit is used for doing work to generate electricity. The invention adopts water as a diluent and a humidifying strategy far away from a reaction zone at the root of a flame, increases the mass flow of the system, effectively inhibits the temperature of a combustion chamber, improves the power generation efficiency of ammonia combustion, reduces the heat load of a turbine machine, and improves the ignition characteristic of ammonia flame and the stability of a power generation system by arranging an ammonia oxygen-enriched on-duty flame at the root of an ammonia/air main flame.

title_en: Magnetic suspension compressor shutdown control method, device, medium, controller and product
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a device, a medium, a controller and a product for controlling the shutdown of a magnetic suspension compressor, wherein the method comprises the steps of controlling the running frequency of the magnetic suspension compressor to rise according to a preset frequency-raising rate after receiving a shutdown instruction of the magnetic suspension compressor; and controlling the magnetic suspension compressor to perform sectional frequency reduction, wherein the magnetic suspension compressor is controlled to perform sectional frequency reduction by controlling the magnetic suspension compressor for two times, namely, reducing the frequency to reach the critical speed and then increasing the frequency. The scheme provided by the invention can avoid surging caused by that the idle rotation speed of the rotor is faster than the change speed of the differential pressure in the shutdown process, and ensures the stability of the unit in the shutdown process.

title_en: Irradiation sample hole plug for irradiation sample rack of nuclear power unit
abstract_en: The application provides an irradiation sample hole plug used on an irradiation sample frame of a nuclear power unit, which comprises an upper cylinder body, a pin, an outer spring, an inner spring, a core bar, a claw spring, a plug body and a claw. The upper cylinder is mounted on the plug body by 2 pins. An outer spring is arranged between the upper cylinder and the plug body, and the upper cylinder compresses the outer spring by moving up and down in pin holes at two sides of the plug body. The inner spring is arranged at the gap between the core rod and the plug body. The hook claw is fixed on the plug body through a pin and is configured to rotate around the pin shaft, and the hook claw is driven by the core bar and the hook claw spring. The application adopts mechanical self-locking, optimizes the structure without changing the original design, adopts a hook claw structure, and increases the anti-flushing function so as to solve the technical problem of how to reduce the problem of easy flushing of the irradiation sample hole plug in the prior art.

title_en: Fuel supply unit device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fuel supply unit device which comprises an electric heater, an automatic backflushing filter, a plate cooler, a viscometer, a supply pump, an expansion tank, a mixing tank, a flowmeter, a booster pump, a duplex filter, an electric control system, a bypass, a steam heater and a pressure control system. According to the invention, the fuel is heated to achieve better fluidity and combustibility, so that the heat value of the fuel is improved, the exhaust emission is reduced, the utilization rate of the fuel is improved, and the operation cost is reduced. Meanwhile, the heater can also prevent the fuel from freezing in a low-temperature environment, and ensure the normal operation of a fuel system. The invention has the advantages of high environmental protection degree, good reliability, continuous production and the like.

title_en: Fuel element containing moderator and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fuel element containing a moderator, which comprises a shell and a core block, wherein the core block is encapsulated in the shell and comprises fuel particles which are dispersed in the moderator, and the shell is a ceramic shell or a metal shell and consists of a shell body and a cover body which are connected in a sealing way. The invention also relates to a preparation method of the fuel element containing the moderator. According to the fuel element containing the moderator, the shell is prepared by hot-pressing sintering or additive manufacturing forming technology, and then the densification packaging of the moderator and the fuel is realized by combining a heat treatment process, so that the problems of easy oxidation, easy corrosion and the like in the use of the moderator and the fuel are solved, and the design requirement of an advanced nuclear reactor on the fuel element containing the moderator is met.

title_en: Single-machine double-stage screw compressor
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of single-machine double-stage screw compressors, and discloses a single-machine double-stage screw compressor, which comprises a frame, a bottom plate and a compressor body, wherein a cooling assembly is arranged in the frame, a lubricating assembly is arranged in the compressor body, a vibration damping assembly is arranged at the bottom of the bottom plate, a worker starts a second motor through the cooling assembly, the second motor drives a threaded rod to rotate, the threaded rod rotates, a cooling fan slides on the inner wall of the frame to suck out heat generated by the compressor body in the operation process, the cooling effect is achieved, meanwhile, the worker starts a water pump, the water pump can pump out cooling water in a cooling water tank and conveys the cooling water into a circulating pipe, so that the cooling water can cool the heat generated by the compressor body in the operation process, and the cooling fan sucks out the heat in the process and is matched with the cooling fan to cool the compressor body.

title_en: Fan control method and device, vehicle controller and vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control method and device of a fan, a vehicle controller and a vehicle. Therefore, the problems that the normal operation of the fan is influenced and even the fan fails due to pollution can be avoided.

title_en: Method for synthesizing perovskite quantum dots by using low-temperature polar solvent
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for synthesizing CsPbX  3  perovskite quantum dots by using a low-temperature polar solvent, which comprises the steps of 1) preparing a cation precursor, namely taking corresponding acetate with required amount, adding a polar solvent and octanoic acid as solvents, 2) preparing an anion precursor, namely taking the polar solvent as a solvent, adding corresponding halogen acid and oleylamine, 3) mixing the anion precursor and the cation precursor, and adding a certain amount of nonpolar solvent when mixing, wherein the nonpolar solvent can be added when mixing or can be added when preparing a precursor solution, the volume ratio of the nonpolar solvent to the polar solvent is 1:3, and stirring and reacting to obtain the perovskite quantum dots. The invention has the advantages of large and simple yield, low cost and continuous and adjustable luminescent color.

title_en: Adjustable sliding vane type compressor
abstract_en: The invention relates to an adjustable sliding vane type compressor which comprises a cylinder, wherein end covers are arranged at the front end and the rear end of the cylinder, the end covers are in sealing connection with the cylinder, a rotor which is eccentrically arranged is arranged in the cylinder, a plurality of sliding vanes which are uniformly distributed are further arranged on the rotor, a plurality of air inlet cavities and compression cavities are formed in the space in the cylinder by dividing the sliding vanes, a mounting shaft and a transmission shaft are respectively arranged at the two ends of the rotor, an oblong groove is further arranged on the end cover, a movable shaft sleeve is arranged in the oblong groove, the mounting shaft and the transmission shaft are arranged in the shaft sleeves at the two ends, an adjusting screw is further arranged on the shaft sleeve, one end of the adjusting screw is connected with the shaft sleeve, and the other end of the adjusting screw penetrates through the end cover to be provided with a rotary handle.

title_en: Floating type marine pasture and supply sea cable for same
abstract_en: The invention discloses a feeding sea cable for a floating type marine pasture and the floating type marine pasture, and belongs to the technical field of sea cables; the invention relates to a floating type marine pasture compensating sea cable, which comprises a cable core, a first inner sheath layer, a first steel wire armor layer and a first outer sheath layer, wherein the first inner sheath layer is wrapped on the outer side of the cable core; the cable core comprises a supply pipeline which is arranged in the center and used for conveying objects, and an electric power wire core, a signal control wire core and an optical fiber communication wire core which are annularly arranged around the peripheral surface of the supply pipeline.

title_en: Wind power generation system and installation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a wind power generation system and an installation method thereof. The tower is provided with a tower base, a bearing seat and a horizontal rotating shaft, the horizontal rotating shaft is arranged at the rear side of the bottom of the tower, the tower is arranged in the bearing seat through the tower rotating shaft, the bearing seat is arranged in the tower base, the top of the tower is provided with a fixed pulley block and a fixing device, a cabin is fixedly arranged on a limiting sliding rail through the fixing device in a sliding manner, a lifting rope of a crane is fixedly connected with the cabin after bypassing the fixed pulley block, the wind gathering device is obliquely arranged at the wind receiving side of the tower, the wind speed can be improved, the wind speed difference in the vertical direction is reduced, the wind energy utilization rate and the integral stability of the operation of the wind turbine are improved, the manufacturing cost of the wind power generation system is lower, the structure is simple, the wind turbine and the cabin can be automatically hoisted and disassembled, the installation and maintenance are very simple and convenient, and the installation and maintenance cost is greatly reduced.

title_en: Centralized wind power thermal management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind power centralized heat management system, which relates to the technical field of wind power generator heat management, wherein each node in the system is provided with a pressure sensor and a temperature sensor for detecting the pressure and the temperature value of cooling medium of each node, manual stop valves are arranged at inlets and outlets of each component, so that pipelines are conveniently blocked and cooling medium leakage is prevented when the system is maintained, components with similar required flow are connected in series and are connected in series according to the sequence of the flow from large to small, a three-way valve automatically adjusts the opening of a valve core according to the temperature value T3 or T7 fed back by the temperature sensor, adjusts the flow Q1 and Q4 of the cooling medium fed into each heating component by configuring a flow dividing valve, and simultaneously more cooling medium pipelines can be added on the basis of the manual stop valves so as to meet the cooling flow requirements of each component, thereby improving the practicability and the flexibility of the whole system.

title_en: Rocket-based rotary detonation engine combustion chamber structure and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rocket-based rotary detonation engine combustion chamber structure and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of rocket engine research. The combustion chamber structure comprises an isolation section, an equal-straight oil injection section and an expansion-concave cavity section which are sequentially connected, wherein a central rocket is arranged in the isolation section and the equal-straight oil injection section, four groups of first ring injection points are arranged on the equal-straight oil injection section, two groups of second ring injection points are arranged on the central rocket, and two groups of third ring injection points are arranged on the expansion-concave cavity section. According to the invention, oil is injected at first through the inside of the expansion-concave cavity section and the pre-explosion tube is adopted to ignite the oil-gas mixture, so that a rotary detonation wave is formed, the built-in central rocket can provide thrust for an aircraft and form injection effect air suction when the ground is at zero speed, and provide additional thrust when the cruising thrust of the aircraft is insufficient, and a flame stabilizing mechanism is provided for rotary detonation combustion when the rotary detonation combustion is in flameout boundary, so that stable work of rotary detonation combustion in a wide speed domain and a wide height domain is realized.

title_en: Solar-energy-based multi-energy complementary building energy supply system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a solar-based multifunctional complementary building energy supply system, which relates to the technical field of building energy supply and comprises a solar photovoltaic panel, wherein an inverter is connected with a storage battery and an air source heat pump through wires. The invention converts light energy and wind energy into electric energy through the operation of the solar photovoltaic panel and the wind power generator, meanwhile, the direct current provided by the solar photovoltaic panel and the wind power generator is converted into alternating current through the inverter, one part of the alternating current converted by the inverter is supplied to the air source heat pump, the other part of the alternating current is stored through the storage battery, meanwhile, the stored electricity of the storage battery can be supplied to the charging pile, when the air source heat pump is electrified, the heat storage tank and the cold storage tank can be used for supplying energy to an air conditioner, when the air source heat pump encounters overcast and rainy days, the storage battery can be used for supplying energy to the air source heat pump, and the continuous and stable energy supply of the air source heat pump is realized through the cooperation of the solar photovoltaic panel, the wind power generator and the storage battery.

title_en: Compressor assembly and temperature regulating device
abstract_en: The application discloses a compressor assembly and temperature regulating equipment, wherein the compressor assembly comprises a compressor shell, an impeller and regulating blades, a compression cavity and an air inlet channel communicated with the compression cavity are formed in the compressor shell, the impeller is rotatably arranged in the compression cavity, the regulating blades are rotatably arranged in the air inlet channel to regulate the air inflow of the air inlet channel, a rotating shaft of each regulating blade is orthogonal with the extending direction of the air inlet channel, and an air guide channel is formed on each regulating blade, so that the stability of the compressor under the working condition of small flow can be improved.

title_en: Rotary engine with axially symmetrical ring gear
abstract_en: An improved rotary engine having a symmetrically disposed ring gear.

title_en: Prediction method for equivalent mileage of valve clearance adjustment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a valve clearance adjustment equivalent mileage prediction method which comprises the steps of performing a reliability test on an engine, determining valve clearance adjustment reliability time T according to recorded detection data of valves before and after the reliability test, obtaining road spectrum hundred kilometers oil consumption K of a comprehensive working condition through a road test, obtaining a reliability test average hour oil consumption K recorded by a bench test, calculating an equivalent road spectrum mileage D=k/K100 per hour of the reliability through an equivalent oil consumption method, obtaining an engine average rotating speed N of the comprehensive working condition through the road test, obtaining an average rotating speed N of a reliability test circulation working condition through the bench test, calculating an acceleration factor R=n/N, and obtaining the valve clearance adjustment equivalent mileage S=T.times.D.times.R of the whole vehicle. The invention relates to a whole vehicle road test, and the adjustment mileage of the valve clearance of the whole vehicle is effectively estimated and predicted through equivalent operation and acceleration factor calculation.

title_en: Power supply conversion control device suitable for nuclear power emergency diesel generator set
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power supply conversion control device suitable for a nuclear power emergency diesel generator set. The high-frequency power supply device comprises a power supply conversion main circuit and a power supply conversion controller, wherein the primary side conversion circuit is adaptively connected with a primary side coil of a high-frequency transformer, chops a connected alternating current input voltage into a high-frequency input signal, loads the chopped high-frequency input signal to the primary side coil of the high-frequency transformer, and the secondary side conversion circuit is adaptively connected with a secondary side coil of the high-frequency transformer, converts a high-frequency voltage signal generated by conversion of the high-frequency transformer into a power supply voltage and provides the power supply voltage to a connected load unit. The invention can improve the stability and reliability of power supply to the load.

title_en: Jet combustion system of ammonia internal combustion engine and combustion control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of internal combustion engines, and provides a jet combustion system of an ammonia internal combustion engine and a combustion control method thereof, wherein a main combustion chamber and a jet chamber are formed in an inner structure of a cylinder, and the main combustion chamber is communicated with the jet chamber; the device comprises an air cylinder, an ammonia injector, an ignition device and a jet flow chamber, wherein the air cylinder is arranged according to a preset inclination angle, the ammonia injector is used for injecting liquid ammonia into the main combustion chamber for the first time in an air inlet stroke to enable the main combustion chamber to form ammonia mixed gas, the ammonia injector is used for injecting liquid ammonia into the main combustion chamber for the second time in a compression stroke and enabling the liquid ammonia to enter the jet flow chamber under the action of airflow movement to form over-concentrated ammonia mixed gas, the ammonia mixed gas is modified on line to generate hydrogen at a high temperature and high pressure state to enable the jet flow chamber to form ammonia-hydrogen mixed gas, and the ignition device is arranged in the jet flow chamber and is used for igniting the ammonia-hydrogen mixed gas of the jet flow chamber to form flame jet flow. The invention not only can stabilize the ignition of the internal combustion engine using ammonia as fuel and accelerate the combustion process, but also can simplify the structural arrangement of the internal combustion engine system and reduce the running cost by adopting a single fuel supply system.

title_en: Oxygen-enriched low-concentration gas dynamic blending system, power generation system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an oxygen-enriched low-concentration gas dynamic blending system, a power generation system and a method, and relates to the technical field of low-concentration gas power generation. One end of the mixing pipeline is used for communicating a gas extraction pump station, the other end is used for communicating a gas generator; the gas supply system is used for inputting combustible gas into the mixing pipeline, the oxygen supply system is used for inputting oxygen into the mixing pipeline, and the control system is used for controlling the gas supply flow of the combustible gas supply system in real time according to the concentration of methane in the produced gas at the upstream of the mixing pipeline.

title_en: Biochar-zero-valent iron composite material for efficiently removing radionuclide in aquatic products and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of composite materials, and provides a biochar-zero-valent iron composite material for efficiently removing radionuclide in aquatic products and a preparation method thereof, wherein the composite material consists of biochar and nano zero-valent iron loaded on the biochar, the biochar is prepared by cracking wheat straw for 2-3 hours at 600-700 ℃, soaking for 12-24 hours with 0.5-1M acid solution, washing to neutrality with distilled water, and drying for 6-12 hours at 80-105 ℃; the method of the invention realizes the efficient removal of the radionuclide in the aquatic product by adopting the composite material of the biochar and the nano zero-valent iron, utilizing the high specific surface area and rich pore structure of the biochar and the strong reducibility of the nano zero-valent iron, and has the advantages of high efficiency removal of the radionuclide in the aquatic product, reduced operation cost, reduced influence on the environment, wide raw material sources, low cost, obvious technical advantages and wide application prospect.

title_en: Plunger pump motor discharge high-frequency response adjusting device
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of plunger pump motors, and particularly relates to a plunger pump motor discharge high-frequency response adjusting device which comprises an axial plunger pump motor, a nozzle baffle valve, a first piston, a second piston, a third piston and a fourth piston, wherein the first piston and the third piston are positioned on one side of a sloping cam plate of the axial plunger pump motor, the second piston and the fourth piston are positioned on the other side of the sloping cam plate of the axial plunger pump motor, and the nozzle baffle valve comprises a first nozzle unit and a second nozzle unit.

title_en: Combustion system, engine, control method and vehicle
abstract_en: The application discloses a combustion system, an engine, a control method and a vehicle, wherein the combustion system comprises an oil sprayer, a hydrogen supply mechanism and a spark plug, wherein the oil sprayer is used for spraying traditional fuel into a combustion chamber, the spark plug is arranged in the combustion chamber, an air outlet hole is formed in the spark plug, the hydrogen supply mechanism is communicated with the air outlet hole so as to supply hydrogen into the combustion chamber, and the spark plug is suitable for igniting the hydrogen. On the one hand, hydrogen is easy to gather near the spark plug, so that the hydrogen diffusion is avoided, the layering effect can be improved, the lean combustion effect is improved, and the emission of the engine is further improved, on the other hand, a hydrogen nozzle is not required to be arranged, the overall cost of the engine can be reduced, the arrangement difficulty of parts in the engine is reduced, the consistency of hydrogen in a plurality of combustion chambers can be ensured, and the engine can be operated more stably and reliably.

title_en: Pneumatic vectoring nozzle capable of deflecting at large vector angle and having rapid thrust reversing function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pneumatic vector spray pipe with a high-vector angle deflection and a rapid reverse thrust function, which belongs to the field of an engine exhaust system of an aerospace aircraft, and can rapidly realize the high-vector angle deflection and reverse thrust control of a main spray flow through the injection and the interception of a passive secondary flow so as to achieve the thrust multi-mode switching of an aircraft propulsion system. The invention comprises a main runner, a secondary runner, an expanding runner, a reverse thrust runner and an outlet runner. The jet pipe only carries out deflection control on jet flow through the tiny disturbance of passive secondary flow in the secondary flow channel and the double-side Coanda wall facing jet flow in the expansion flow channel, distributes jet flow of the reverse thrust flow channel and the outlet flow channel, realizes large vector angle deflection and reverse thrust function of the jet flow, can rapidly complete reverse thrust control within 0.2s, and has a reverse thrust coefficient of 0.215. The invention can realize rapid deflection, rapid thrust change and reverse thrust control of jet flow vectors without complex mechanical moving parts and a high-pressure air source control device, and has the advantages of large deflection vector angle, rapid control response, rapid reverse thrust and the like.

title_en: Recoverable hybrid energy dissipation connecting node for wind power tower
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wind power tower structural engineering, in particular to a recoverable hybrid energy dissipation connecting node for a wind power tower. The friction energy dissipation device comprises a tower section, a friction energy dissipation component and a self-recovery component. The friction energy dissipation assembly comprises a plurality of friction groups, each friction group comprises a variable-section stiffening plate assembly and a pair of friction clamping blocks, the friction clamping blocks are connected with the variable-section stiffening plate assembly through first bolt pairs, the self-recovery assembly comprises a plurality of recovery groups, and the recovery groups comprise elastic pieces and second bolt pairs. The recovery groups and the energy dissipation groups are uniformly arranged at intervals along the circumferential direction of the tower barrel and are connected with the upper tower barrel section and the lower tower barrel section together. According to the invention, the hybrid energy dissipation and self-recovery effect is achieved through the synergistic effect of the friction energy dissipation assembly and the self-recovery assembly, the energy dissipation capacity and the anti-seismic performance of the wind power tower connection node are improved, and the stability and the durability of the structure are enhanced.

title_en: Fuel cell automobile fan control method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a method and a device for controlling a fan of a fuel cell automobile, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of fuel cell automobiles. The method is applied to a controller in communication with a heat sink, a fan, and a plurality of temperature sensors. The method comprises the steps of determining the heat generation quantity of the galvanic pile, and respectively acquiring the ambient temperature and the outlet temperature of the radiator based on each temperature sensor. And determining the total heat dissipation demand according to the heat generated by the electric pile, the ambient temperature and the outlet temperature of the radiator. And determining a target fan duty ratio based on the total heat dissipation demand, and controlling the running state of the fan according to the target fan duty ratio. The invention can more reasonably radiate the heat of the vehicle through the fan.

title_en: Thermostat, heat radiation system and vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of temperature control devices, in particular to a thermostat, a heat dissipation system and a vehicle, wherein a first passage, a second passage, a third passage and a fourth passage are arranged in the thermostat; the thermostat can preheat the radiator when executing small circulation at low temperature by additionally arranging a second passage in the thermostat, and automatically decompress in a high-pressure state by additionally arranging a fourth passage in the thermostat. The invention solves the problems that the existing thermostat has single function and low integration level, can only control the opening and closing of small and large circulation of an oil way, and simultaneously has larger thermal shock and pressure impact to a radiator by high-temperature oil when the large circulation is opened, thereby influencing the reliability of a radiating system and simultaneously having the problem that the pressure of the system cannot be released in time when the pressure of the system is too high.

title_en: Method and system for controlling vibration of variable capacity compressor of refrigeration system
abstract_en: A method for vibration control includes receiving a request to change a rotational speed of a variable capacity compressor from a current rotational speed to a reference rotational speed, verifying whether the reference rotational speed is required to minimize compressor vibration, defining a reference rotational speed range in which the reference rotational speed is within, defining a maximum rotational speed within the rotational speed range and a minimum rotational speed within the rotational speed range, comparing the reference rotational speed with the current rotational speed, changing the rotational speed of the compressor, measuring compressor vibration within the reference rotational speed range, defining a minimum vibration rotational speed and a maximum vibration, defining a vibration difference, establishing a vibration difference reference, comparing the vibration difference with the vibration difference reference, and defining a final rotational speed at which the compressor operates.

title_en: Scheduling hydrogen production system for coupling solar energy storage and adsorption strengthening methane steam reforming
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of energy and chemical industry, and particularly relates to a scheduling hydrogen production system for coupling solar energy storage and adsorption-enhanced methane steam reforming. The system comprises a reaction module, a heat exchange module and a storage module, wherein the operation mode is divided into a daytime mode and a nighttime mode, the reaction module comprises a calcination reactor, a first gas-solid separator, a first adsorption-enhanced methane reforming reactor, a second gas-solid separator, a carbonation reactor, a third gas-solid separator, a second adsorption-enhanced methane reforming reactor and a fourth gas-solid separator, and the heat exchange module comprises 12 heat exchangers and 2 turbines. The system uses renewable energy solar energy as a system energy source, uses calcium-based material as an energy storage medium and an adsorption-reinforced methane steam reforming medium, can realize continuous utilization of solar energy and dispatch preparation of high-purity hydrogen, and has important significance for promoting renewable energy utilization and clean energy preparation and constructing a clean low-carbon energy system.

title_en: Manufacturing process optimization method and system for wind motor gear
abstract_en: The invention provides a manufacturing process optimization method and a manufacturing process optimization system for a wind turbine gear, which relate to the technical field of data processing, and a plurality of groups of gears with the same performance and a plurality of gear processing raw materials are obtained by synchronizing performance information of K groups of gears to a performance deviation analysis module; and performing optimizing milling according to the specification information of the gears and the specification information of various standard materials to obtain a plurality of groups of plate milling strategies so as to perform batch milling manufacturing of the K functional gears. The gear processing method solves the technical problems that in the prior art, gears of the wind turbine are processed in a batch processing mode of gears with the same design parameters on blanks, processing raw materials are wasted, and production cost is high. The technical effects of performing multi-specification parameter gear adaptation processing of blanks based on gear formation of the wind turbine case are achieved, and production cost is reduced while waste of processing raw materials is reduced.

title_en: Valve wave-absorbing structure and manufacturing system thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a valve wave-absorbing structure and a manufacturing system thereof, and relates to the technical field of civil air defense engineering, wherein the valve wave-absorbing structure comprises a framework, a door plate, a controller and a conversion assembly, the conversion assembly is connected with the controller through a signal wire, the door plate is arranged on the front side of the outer wall of the framework, the controller is arranged in the middle of the inner wall of the framework, the conversion assembly is arranged on the front side of the outer wall of the door plate, and the conversion assembly comprises: the pressure sensor, elastic element, buffer chamber, transducer and energy storage room, pressure sensor passes through the signal line and is connected with the controller.
