According to the invention, the conversion assembly is arranged, so that the function of converting the shock wave energy is realized, the problems of structural damage and shock wave energy waste caused by untimely elimination of the shock wave energy by the valve wave-absorbing structure are solved, the protection capability of the valve wave-absorbing structure can be enhanced, the shock wave energy is converted in time, the damage to the structure is reduced, the service life of the valve wave-absorbing structure is prolonged, and the energy utilization rate is improved.

title_en: Intelligent diesel generator operation control system based on high efficiency and energy conservation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of control of diesel generators, in particular to an intelligent diesel generator operation control system based on high efficiency and energy conservation, which comprises a parameter control analysis module, an emission monitoring feedback module, a cooling operation judgment module, a wear influence evaluation module and a management terminal; according to the invention, the parameter control analysis module is used for analyzing the parameter control performance in the running process of the diesel generator, the emission tail gas of the diesel generator is monitored and analyzed by the emission monitoring feedback module when the generator parameter control qualified signal is generated, the heat dissipation and cooling performance of the diesel generator is analyzed by the cooling running judgment module when the emission flammability qualified signal is generated, the abrasion hidden danger of the diesel generator is analyzed by the abrasion influence evaluation module when the cooling qualified signal is generated, the comprehensive monitoring and control of the diesel generator is realized, the safe and stable energy-saving running of the diesel generator is ensured, and the running supervision difficulty of the diesel generator is low.

title_en: Wind turbine generator system headroom measuring device
abstract_en: The invention provides a clearance measuring device of a wind turbine, which comprises a control main body, a radar and a radar controller, wherein the radar controller comprises a connecting part and a radar adjusting mechanism arranged at least one end of the connecting part so as to install the control main body and the radar and adjust the position of the radar, the two-position control part and the connecting part can deflect relatively, when the two parts deflect relatively, the elevation angle of the radar can be driven to change, so that the detection wave emitted by the radar can point to a designated fan blade area, the two-position control part is positioned between two deflection angle adjusting blocks and can rotate so as to adjust the deflection angle of the radar, the detection wave emitted by the radar can avoid a cabin and a tower rod, the effective detection wave acted on the fan blade is increased, the clearance monitoring error is reduced, and the radar obtains more return data under the cooperation of the deflection angle and the elevation angle two-position control, so that the clearance monitoring error is smaller.

title_en: Virtual sensing fusion method of wind turbine generator based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a virtual sensing fusion method of a wind turbine generator set based on machine learning, which comprises the following steps of selecting a subsystem of the wind turbine generator set as a research object, acquiring historical operation data, preprocessing the historical operation data, carrying out correlation analysis on the preprocessed data, selecting data with high correlation, establishing a sensor information correlation model based on machine learning according to the selected data with high correlation, judging the fitting effect of the sensor information correlation model, establishing a virtual sensor information reconstruction model, detecting a sensor and alarming faults, verifying the virtual sensor information reconstruction model and carrying out on-hook testing, and completing virtual sensing fusion of the wind turbine generator set.

title_en: Belt-driven synchronous polymer injection device and multistage continuous injection method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a belt transmission synchronous polymer injection device and a multistage continuous polymer injection method thereof, comprising a rotating mechanism, wherein the rotating mechanism is provided with a piston rod, and further comprises a reversing mechanism and a transmission mechanism, the reversing mechanism is provided with a piston sleeve and an intermittent reversing mechanism, the front end of the piston rod is inserted into the piston sleeve, the intermittent reversing mechanism is connected with a rotating part of the rotating mechanism through the transmission mechanism, and the intermittent reversing mechanism is used for switching a liquid inlet channel and a liquid outlet channel according to the movement direction of the piston rod. The invention has no flow channel cross section shape change, no flow around and other phenomena in the sucking and discharging process, has less damage to polymer molecular chains, can continuously operate, and realizes the regulation of polymer outlet pressure by regulating resistance.

title_en: System and method for multi-energy coupling and utilization based on salt cavern hydrogen storage
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of new energy storage and utilization, in particular to a salt-cavern-based hydrogen storage multi-energy coupling and utilization system and method, wherein the system comprises a hydrogen storage salt cavern, a natural gas storage salt cavern and a carbon dioxide storage salt cavern; the system comprises an electrolysis water hydrogen production unit, a fuel cell power generation unit, a natural gas blending unit, a methanol synthesis unit and a synthesis gas synthesis unit, wherein the electrolysis water hydrogen production unit is used for driving an electrolysis tank to produce hydrogen by using electric power, the hydrogen is stored in a hydrogen storage salt pit after being compressed, the fuel cell power generation unit is used for taking out hydrogen from the hydrogen storage salt pit and generating power by using the hydrogen to be transmitted to a power grid, the natural gas blending unit is used for mixing the hydrogen in the hydrogen storage salt pit and the natural gas in the natural gas storage salt pit according to a target proportion to form mixed fuel gas, the mixed fuel gas is transmitted to a natural gas pipe network to be prepared, and the methanol synthesis unit is used for mixing the hydrogen in the hydrogen storage salt pit and the carbon dioxide in the carbon dioxide storage salt pit, preparing synthesis gas by using reverse water gas conversion reaction. Therefore, the problems that the energy conversion efficiency is low, and the hydrogen, the natural gas and the carbon dioxide face challenges in space are solved.

title_en: Processing technology of cylinder mosaic blocks in rotor type compressor pump body
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of compressor pump bodies, in particular to a processing technology of a cylinder mosaic block in a rotor type compressor pump body, which comprises the following steps of selecting proper sectional materials, and cutting the sectional materials after cold drawing by a cold drawing die to form a first semi-finished product; the method comprises the steps of carrying out primary processing on two end faces of a first semi-finished product to form a second semi-finished product, carrying out clamping on a plurality of second semi-finished products, carrying out opening processing on air suction holes and sliding vane grooves to form a third semi-finished product, carrying out secondary processing on the sliding vane grooves of the third semi-finished product to form a fourth semi-finished product, carrying out secondary processing on two end faces of the fourth semi-finished product to form a fifth semi-finished product, carrying out processing on inner arc faces and outer arc faces of the fifth semi-finished product to form a mosaic block finished product, and carrying out processing molding on a section bar to the mosaic block finished product.

title_en: Integrated monitoring method for compressed air energy storage compressor
abstract_en: The application relates to an integrated monitoring method of a compressed air energy storage compressor, which comprises the steps of constructing a compressor model corresponding to a target compressed air energy storage system, collecting real-time operation data of the target compressed air energy storage system, acquiring instruction data corresponding to the target compressed air energy storage system, calculating a surge line expression and a choke line expression of the compressor model, utilizing a preset integrated monitoring unit to monitor the target compressed air energy storage system in real time according to the surge line expression, the choke line expression and the real-time operation data to obtain a fault signal index, and judging whether the operation state of the target compressed air energy storage system meets preset safety requirements or not according to the fault signal index, wherein if the operation state does not meet the preset safety requirements, determining the fault information of the target compressed air energy storage system. Therefore, the problems of high cost, complex monitoring method, poor system universality and the like of the existing integrated monitoring system of the compressor are solved.

title_en: Bearing support structure of centrifugal or turbine fluid machinery
abstract_en: The bearing supporting structure of the centrifugal or turbine fluid machinery adopts a cylindrical roller bearing and a thrust roller bearing which are combined to be used as a bearing supporting structure of a driving part, a self-aligning ball bearing and a thrust ball bearing are combined to be used as a bearing supporting structure of a driven part, and two-stage springs are combined to weaken the influence of superimposed vibration or disturbance, so that the running stability is improved, and a double-suction impeller is arranged on a rotating shaft in a balance shell and accelerates the flow of cooling fluid in a driving cooling flow channel and a driven cooling flow channel, so that the bearing structure is easier to dissipate heat and runs stably. The active lubrication flow passage is communicated with the cavity of the active buffer spring, and the active cooling flow passage is in fluid communication with the right inlet of the double-suction impeller; the arrangement of the structure ensures that the bearing structures on two sides have better lubrication effect, reduces friction loss and prolongs the service life.

title_en: Solar unmanned ship for marine environment monitoring
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of ocean monitoring, and particularly discloses a solar unmanned ship for ocean environment monitoring, which comprises a ship body, wherein monitoring equipment for monitoring the environment is arranged on the ship body, a turnover assembly is arranged on the ship body, a turnover plate is arranged at the output end of the turnover assembly, a power generation assembly electrically connected with a storage battery is arranged on the turnover plate, and a rotating assembly connected with the power generation assembly is arranged on the turnover plate. According to the invention, two different states can be realized according to the change of ocean weather, the ship body can normally navigate in sunny weather, the ocean environment is monitored by utilizing solar energy, electric energy is supplemented by utilizing wind energy to generate electricity in overcast and rainy weather, the ocean environment is monitored in a gap under rain stop, the energy supply capacity of the device is improved, the cruising capacity of the device is improved, the continuous monitoring work of the unmanned ship is facilitated, and meanwhile, the unmanned ship can break away from severe dilemma by itself, and the capability of the unmanned ship for adapting to various ocean weather is improved.

title_en: Unmanned reconnaissance engine power system and control method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to an unmanned reconnaissance engine power system and a control method thereof, wherein the unmanned reconnaissance engine power system comprises an engine, a superconducting motor, a liquid hydrogen storage tank, a hydrogen burning generator and a comprehensive energy management system, the superconducting motor is provided with an electric mode and a power generation mode, is arranged in a front cavity of the engine and comprises a motor rotor and a motor stator, wherein the motor rotor is sleeved on a high-pressure shaft of the engine, the motor stator is sleeved on the periphery of the motor rotor and is connected to the inner side of the front cavity of the engine through a pull rod, a heat exchange channel is arranged on the periphery of the motor stator, the liquid hydrogen storage tank is arranged on the outer side of the engine and is communicated with the heat exchange channel through a liquid hydrogen pipeline, the hydrogen burning generator is arranged on the outer side of the engine and is communicated with the heat exchange channel through a gas hydrogen pipeline, and the comprehensive energy management system has an electric energy storage function and is arranged on the outer side of the engine and is connected with the superconducting motor and the hydrogen burning generator through a cable and is connected with an unmanned aerial vehicle power supply system and an engine power supply system.

title_en: Vacuumizing device for ultrahigh-speed low-vacuum pipeline
abstract_en: The application relates to a vacuum pumping device for an ultra-high-speed low-vacuum pipeline, which relates to the technical field of vacuum pumping devices and comprises a vacuum pump and a filter mechanism, wherein the filter mechanism comprises a filter box, a filter assembly, a dust removing assembly and an azimuth adjusting assembly, the filter assembly comprises a moving track, a circulating pipeline and a filter ball, the dust removing assembly comprises a blowing part and a collecting part, the azimuth adjusting assembly comprises an adjusting iron ring and an adjusting magnetic ring, the filter ball which circularly slides in the moving track and the circulating pipeline can filter dust, the blowing part and the collecting part can purge the filter ball in cooperation to restore the filtering capability of the filter ball, the adjusting magnetic ring drives the adjusting iron ring to rotate the filter ball, so that the purging dust removing effect of the filter ball is better, and the filter mechanism filters in a mode of self-restoring the filtering capability, so that the filter mechanism is not easy to be blocked. The application has the effect that the running pipeline is not easy to be blocked due to a large amount of dust when being vacuumized.

title_en: Pump control device and method for data center cooling system and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a pump control device, a pump control method and a storage medium of a data center cooling system, wherein the device comprises a control module, a driving module and a plurality of circulating pumps in the data center cooling system, the control module is used for acquiring a pump control mode and generating a control instruction according to the pump control mode, and the driving module is used for receiving the control instruction and driving voltage and driving each circulating pump by utilizing the driving voltage according to the control instruction. The application can realize automatic control of the circulating pump, improve the operation persistence of the circulating pump, improve the control effect of the circulating pump, improve the power supply and control reliability of a cooling system of a data center, and can be widely applied to the technical field of heat dissipation of the data center.

title_en: Gradient proportional valve
abstract_en: A gradient proportioning valve for liquid chromatography includes a plurality of inlet ports configured to receive a plurality of fluids, a manifold connected to each of the plurality of inlet ports, the inlet ports configured to mix the plurality of fluids in a controlled manner to provide a liquid composition, the manifold including a plurality of conduits inside the manifold, each of the plurality of conduits receiving a fluid through a respective one of the plurality of inlet ports, an actuation mechanism having a piston within a borehole structure surrounding the piston, the actuation mechanism configured to open and close at least one of the plurality of conduits in a controlled manner, wherein the piston and the borehole structure have tight tolerances configured to create a fluid tight seal, and a common outlet port configured to receive the fluid composition.

title_en: Filling pump test system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of filling pump testing, and provides a filling pump testing system which comprises a filling pump, a testing pressure control valve and a remote controller. The filling pump comprises a discharge hole and a hopper feed hole. A test pipeline is connected between the discharge port of the filling pump and the feed port of the hopper, and a test pressure control valve is arranged on the test pipeline and used for adjusting the pressure of the test pipeline. The remote controller is arranged in a remote area which is convenient to operate and safer, the remote controller is connected with the test pressure control valve, the valve opening of the test pressure control valve can be steplessly adjusted, and then the pressure of the test pressure control valve is changed to conduct durability tests under different pressure states. The staff can be through the stepless valve port aperture of test pressure control valve of remote control ware, and then, the loading pressure of long-range stepless regulation filling pump test system. Therefore, not only the accuracy of the test pressure adjustment can be improved, but also the safety of operation can be improved.

title_en: Impeller with flow dividing structure and fan with impeller
abstract_en: The impeller with the flow dividing structure comprises N flow dividing rings which are arranged in a staggered manner along the radial direction of the blades, wherein N is more than or equal to 3, the flow dividing rings are arranged around a hub and are connected with a plurality of blades, the radial intervals among the flow dividing rings are unequal, the flow dividing rings are overlapped and arranged along the axial direction of a pressure surface/a suction surface of the blades, the flow dividing rings close to the hub side are first flow dividing rings, the outlet ends of the first flow dividing rings are positioned on the blades and are spaced from the rear edges of the blades, the flow dividing rings far away from the hub side at the outermost side are N-th flow dividing rings, and the inlet ends of the N-th flow dividing rings are arranged protruding out of the front edges of the blades. Through the improved design to the impeller, especially be the design to N shunt ring, can make the fan under variable speed running state, reduce the impeller shake to can improve fan flow and ensure fan flow stability, homogeneity, improve fan efficiency.

title_en: Multifunctional soap dispenser capable of automatically discharging liquid and pump body control method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pumping control of cleaning products and discloses an automatic liquid-discharging multifunctional soap dispenser and a pump body control method, wherein the automatic liquid-discharging multifunctional soap dispenser comprises a machine base, a scale removing liquid discharging component, a control device and a control device, wherein the machine base is provided with a pumping component, the pumping component can detect that an object is close to a first liquid discharging hole and/or a second liquid discharging hole so as to output a first preset amount of liquid soap and/or a second preset amount of foam soap, the scale removing liquid discharging component can detect dirt at the bottom of a first liquid storage cavity and can heat the heated liquid soap, and the control device comprises a PCB control board, when the detection value of dirt detection sensor is larger than a preset value, the PCB control board controls the heating device to output a third preset amount of liquid soap after controlling the heating device to preset time, and the third preset amount is larger than the first preset amount. Through the dirt of automated inspection bottom, adopt intelligent "hot melt + physics to dash to arrange" clean logic, realize the automatic liquid scale removal of automation degree of depth and clean, can show extension manual cleaning cycle and equipment life.

title_en: Device and method for predicting scouring depth and scouring range of foundation of five-connection jacket
abstract_en: The application discloses a device and a method for predicting the flushing depth and the flushing range of a penta-connected jacket foundation, which relate to the technical field of offshore wind power engineering, the device comprises a simulation end and a control end, the simulation end comprises a water tank, a penta-connected jacket foundation model and acquisition equipment, the device is used for simulating the flushing process of the penta-connected jacket foundation model according to a determined test scheme to obtain corresponding original flushing data, the control end is used for deducing a model prediction formula according to the original flushing data and working condition parameters in the test scheme, converting the model prediction formula into a prototype prediction formula through scale conversion, calculating the flushing depth and the flushing range of the basic object of the five-connection-barrel jacket according to the prototype prediction formula, and deducing and verifying the five-connection-barrel flushing depth prediction and range formula through a large amount of test data, so that the method can be used for quickly predicting the flushing depth and the flushing range of the follow-up similar basic type.

title_en: Decarbonizing coal-electricity system coupled with reversible Brayton cycle heat pump and operation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a decarburization coal-electricity system coupled with a reversible Brayton cycle heat pump and a method thereof, wherein the decarburization coal-electricity system comprises a coal-fired power generation subsystem for converting heat into electric energy, a decarburization subsystem for treating carbon dioxide emission, and a heat pump heat storage subsystem for improving energy utilization efficiency; the boiler smoke in the coal-fired power generation subsystem enters the absorption tower after passing through a smoke cooler in the decarburization subsystem, the coal-fired power generation subsystem sends high-temperature steam generated by the boiler into the heat pump heat storage subsystem through the high-pressure cylinder and the medium-pressure cylinder, and the heat pump heat storage subsystem stores high-temperature molten salt after heat absorption into the high-temperature storage tank. The heat pump heat storage subsystem constructed by reversible Brayton cycle adopts supercritical carbon dioxide as a cycle working medium and phase change materials and molten salt as a heat storage medium, so that the energy storage density is improved, the stability and the high efficiency of the heat storage and release process are ensured, the system can be better adapted to the fluctuation of the power grid load, and the quick response is realized.

title_en: Wind driven generator fault detection device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind driven generator fault detection device, which relates to the technical field of wind driven generators and comprises a detector, a fastening frame and a storage box, wherein the detector is in sliding clamping connection with the middle part of the fastening frame, locking plates are sleeved at two ends of the fastening frame and are positioned and locked on the fastening frame through locking mechanisms, a sliding plate is arranged in the locking plates in a sliding manner, and a temperature sensor for detecting a supporting bearing is detachably arranged in the middle part of the sliding plate. The invention is convenient for installing and dismantling the temperature sensor by arranging the fastening frame, can prevent the storage box from being opened accidentally, can conveniently install the temperature sensor by arranging the sliding plate through the locking groove in the sliding plate, can also assist the fastening frame to fasten the storage box, and can also achieve the effect of closing and protecting the storage box by arranging the locking mechanism and using the positioning of the locking plate to install the fastening frame between the front end bearing seat and the rear end bearing seat.

title_en: Rotation preventing mechanism for scroll compressor
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-rotation mechanism for a scroll compressor, which comprises an movable scroll, a fixed scroll and at least two rotation stopping parts, wherein the movable scroll is provided with a scroll part and a chassis, the chassis is provided with a rotation stopping base line, the rotation stopping base line is provided with a rotation stopping part, the end of the scroll part is provided with an arc-shaped flange, the fixed scroll is provided with rotation stopping grooves matched with the rotation stopping part and the flange, in the rotation process of the movable scroll, at least two rotation stopping parts are meshed with the rotation stopping grooves, the rotation stopping grooves are provided with envelope surfaces matched with the rotation stopping parts, the meshing surfaces are meshed with the envelope surfaces, and the rotation of the movable scroll is limited by the meshing surfaces. The invention is arranged on the bodies of the movable vortex plate and the fixed vortex plate, is processed together with vortex structures on the movable vortex plate and the fixed vortex plate, does not need to be provided with other structures, reduces the centrifugal force generated when the compressor works, and avoids assembling other parts and assembly errors.

title_en: Continuous gravity energy storage system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of gravity energy storage, in particular to a continuous gravity energy storage system, wherein an upper-layer storage unit and a lower-layer storage unit are both arranged on a building main body, a lifting module comprises a frame, and a lifting unit, a transportation supporting unit and a transition supporting unit which are both arranged on the frame, wherein the lifting unit is used for driving the transportation supporting unit to continuously move in the vertical direction relative to the frame and the transition supporting unit, and the weight is transmitted between the transportation supporting unit and the building module through the transition supporting unit so as to be transmitted between the upper-layer storage unit and the lower-layer storage unit. The application aims at providing a continuous gravity energy storage system aiming at least one technical problem related to the background technology.

title_en: Water supply system of water ramjet engine with following combustion surface water injection
abstract_en: The invention relates to a water supply system of a water ramjet engine, which is used for injecting water along with a combustion surface, and comprises a water ramjet engine shell, a guide hose, an atomizing nozzle, a control connecting rod, a control motor and a propellant, wherein the propellant is filled in the water ramjet engine shell, the atomizing nozzle is spherically connected with the water ramjet engine shell and lubricates the connecting contact surface, the rotating freedom degree of the connecting contact surface is reserved while the nozzle is fixed, the water ramjet engine shell is provided with a spherical interface at the front position of the propellant, the middle position of the atomizing nozzle is provided with a spherical positioning pin, and the spherical positioning pin is equal to the spherical interface of the engine shell in size, so that the two are exactly embedded, and the tightness of the engine shell is ensured. The invention realizes the effect that atomized water always approaches the combustion surface of the explosive column, and improves the performances of the engine such as combustion efficiency, flame stability, heat power conversion efficiency and the like.

title_en: Novel pumped storage system and energy storage method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a novel pumped storage system and an energy storage method. The novel pumped storage system comprises a pressure storage tank, a reservoir, a water turbine and a generator, wherein a water storage space is formed in the pressure storage tank, the water storage space is completely filled by a plurality of compressible gas capsules, a valve is arranged at the opening of the pressure storage tank and is connected with the water inlet of the water turbine through a first pipeline, the reservoir is connected with the water outlet of the water turbine through a second pipeline, and the water turbine is connected with the generator and drives the generator to generate power. The energy storage method adopts the novel pumped storage system and comprises two stages of energy storage and energy release. The novel pumped storage system and the energy storage method are improved on the basis of a conventional pumped storage system and a conventional compressed air energy storage system, water in a reservoir can be pressurized and injected into a pressure storage tank when the load of a power grid is low, and when the load of the power grid is high, water in the pressure storage tank pushes a water turbine to apply work at high pressure, so that a generator is driven to generate electricity.

title_en: Totally-enclosed refrigerant pump
abstract_en: The invention discloses a totally-enclosed refrigerant pump, which relates to the technical field of refrigerant pumps, wherein the totally-enclosed refrigerant pump comprises a pump shell and an impeller structure; according to the technical scheme, the impeller structure and the driving part are integrated in the fully-closed pump shell, the influence on the continuous operation of the system caused by leakage of fluid such as refrigerant and the like in the system is avoided, the impeller structure rotating in the impeller cavity realizes the repeated stirring and pressurizing of the gas-liquid two-phase fluid to fully mix the fluid, the liquefied gas is liquefied so as to realize the cavitation resistance of the pump body and the gas-liquid mixing and conveying function, the liquid inlet and the liquid outlet are mutually close, and both the liquid inlet and the liquid outlet are close to the outer surface of the pump shell, so that the movement stroke of the fluid in the rotation and pressurizing of the impeller structure is increased, the liquefaction degree of the vaporized fluid and the gas-liquid mixing efficiency are improved, the continuous output of the gas-liquid mixed fluid is realized in the output process, and the negative pressure is continuously formed at the liquid inlet due to the rotation of the impeller structure so as to realize the self suction.

title_en: Combined telegraph pole
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of combined telegraph poles, and discloses a combined telegraph pole which comprises two first rod bodies, two second rod bodies and three rod bodies, wherein the inside of the combined telegraph pole is hollow, the second rod body is arranged above the first rod body, the third rod body is arranged above the second rod body, the bottom of the first rod body is fixedly connected with a base and is used for being connected with a foundation, and a plurality of mounting holes are formed in the outer wall of the third rod body and are used for mounting cross arms. According to the invention, the radiating mechanism is arranged, the unpowered hood, the transmission shaft, the cross fixing rod, the telescopic cylinder and other structures are utilized, the hood is driven to rotate by natural wind power, so that negative pressure is formed to discharge hot air and suck fresh air, the transformer is effectively radiated, an additional power source is not needed, the energy is saved, the environment is protected, the running cost is low, the telescopic cylinder and the spring are structurally designed, the interference plate in the suction cover can be tightly attached to the radiating fins of the transformer, the radiating efficiency is improved, and the service life of the transformer is prolonged.

title_en: Buoyancy self-adaptive vibration energy storage system based on closed mine vertical well water recharging
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fluid power generation, and particularly relates to a buoyancy self-adaptive vibration energy storage system based on closed mine shaft water recharging, which comprises a plurality of guide rails fixedly arranged on the inner side wall of a mine, wherein the guide rails are parallel to the axis of the mine, the guide rails are circumferentially arranged at equal intervals along the inner side wall of the mine, a connecting assembly is slidably connected with the guide rails, an energy storage power generation assembly is fixedly arranged at the top end of the connecting assembly and used for converting impact potential energy of the recharging water entering the mine into elastic potential energy and converting the elastic potential energy into electric energy, a buoyancy assembly is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the connecting assembly and used for providing buoyancy for the connecting assembly and the energy storage power generation assembly, and a limiting assembly is arranged at the top end of the guide rails and used for preventing the buoyancy assembly from driving the energy storage power generation assembly to float out of a mine wellhead. The invention can automatically adapt to water level change and efficiently capture the kinetic energy of vertical water flow.

title_en: Compressed air energy storage control method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of air energy storage, and discloses a compressed air energy storage control method and a system, wherein in a first preset time period, the electricity utilization information of a target electricity storage system is collected at fixed time intervals; the method comprises the steps of dividing energy storage tanks of a target electric storage system, wherein the energy storage tanks are used for taking M energy storage tanks as buffer units, the second division is used for taking N energy storage tanks as energy storage units, the buffer units are used for storing input electric quantity of the target electric storage system in a first air compression ratio, the energy storage units are used for storing the input electric quantity of the target electric storage system in a second air compression ratio, processing and analyzing power consumption information at K moments in a first preset time period to obtain predicted input electric quantity and predicted output electric quantity of the target electric storage system in a second preset time period, and dynamic energy storage planning is conducted on the buffer units and the energy storage units based on the predicted input electric quantity and the predicted output electric quantity of the target electric storage system in the second preset time period.

title_en: Maximum wind energy capturing control method and system applied to wind turbine generator
abstract_en: The invention provides a maximum wind energy capturing control method and a maximum wind energy capturing control system applied to a wind turbine generator, and relates to the field of wind power generation, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining a plurality of key wind speed detection positions; the method comprises the steps of establishing a multi-target tip speed ratio optimizing function, acquiring a real-time wind speed matrix based on a plurality of key wind speed detection positions, carrying out feature extraction to generate a real-time wind speed feature matrix, generating a tip speed ratio value range and a reference tip speed ratio based on the real-time wind speed feature matrix through a tip speed ratio optimizing model, generating a plurality of sampling tip speed ratios based on the tip speed ratio value range, calculating an optimized value of each sampling tip speed ratio through finite element analysis, the multi-target tip speed ratio optimizing function and the reference tip speed ratio, determining an optimal tip speed ratio of the wind turbine generator based on the optimized value of each sampling tip speed ratio through a genetic algorithm, and controlling the wind turbine generator to capture wind energy according to the optimal tip speed ratio of the wind turbine generator, so that the wind energy capturing efficiency of the wind turbine generator is improved.

title_en: Control method, device and equipment of hydrogen engine and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control method, a device, equipment and a storage medium of a hydrogen engine. The control method comprises the steps of obtaining the rotating speed and the torque of the engine, determining the operation area of the engine according to the rotating speed and the torque of the engine under the transient working condition of the engine, and controlling a driving motor, a mechanical transmission assembly or an exhaust turbine according to the operation area. According to the technical scheme, the engine rotating speed and the engine torque are obtained in real time, the engine operating area is judged, different supercharging modes are determined according to the operating area of the hydrogen engine by utilizing the exhaust turbine, the driving motor and the mechanical transmission assembly, the problem of poor transient power performance is effectively solved, the transient power performance of the hydrogen internal combustion engine is improved, and the efficient cleaning application is realized.

title_en: Isotope production solid target device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a solid target device for isotope production, which comprises a target device and a shielding device, wherein a main body of the target device is a target body fixing device, a target box, a plurality of target bodies, a target body slideway, the shielding device is arranged below an outlet at the bottom of the target body slideway and used for bearing the target bodies, a water cooling circulation mechanism, a target body multifunctional mechanism and a target body propelling mechanism. The invention can continuously irradiate a plurality of targets, and can produce different radionuclides in a group of experiments by changing different targets and energy-reducing sheets (namely the sealing film 264). The structure with the purging function is introduced, so that the target body can be kept dry after water cooling, radioactive substances generated by the fact that residual cooling water contacts the target piece in the process that the target body falls into the shielding cylinder are prevented from leaking, and the air path and the water path are universal in one channel, so that the complexity of the mechanism is greatly reduced.

title_en: Turbojet engine and aircraft
abstract_en: The application provides a turbojet engine and an aircraft, which relate to the technical field of aeroengines and comprise a casing with a combustion chamber, a gas compressor and a turbine which are respectively arranged at a gas inlet and a gas outlet of the casing, and a tail nozzle connected with the turbine, the compressor is connected with the turbine in a transmission way, and a microperforated plate metal foam composite structure is arranged on the inner wall of the air inlet of the casing along the circumferential direction so as to reduce noise generated when air enters the casing. The inner wall of the tail spray pipe is provided with a plurality of airflow channels extending along the axial direction at intervals along the circumferential direction, each airflow channel comprises a plurality of communicated airflow grooves, the plurality of airflow grooves forming the same airflow channel are sequentially connected end to end along the axial direction of the tail spray pipe so that each airflow channel is in a Tesla valve structure, the flow guiding direction of the Tesla valve structure is consistent with the direction of the airflow sprayed out from the casing to the atmosphere, noise is effectively restrained from a sound source, the broadband noise reduction effect is realized, the complexity and the weight of a system can be reduced, and the thrust loss is controlled at an extremely low level.

title_en: Sealing test cabin device for simulating train running wind and wind speed control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fully-sealed test cabin device for simulating train running wind and a wind speed control method thereof, and relates to the technical field of sealed test cabins of train running wind, comprising a sealed test cabin, a blower, an air inlet duct, a wind speed sensor, a sealed test cabin, an air guide duct, an induced draft fan, wheels for test and a motor transmission controller; the invention calculates and sets the wind speed, the wind speed of the blower and the rotation speed of the induced draft fan according to the collected vehicle speed, the wind speed changes along with the vehicle speed in the test process and forms micro negative pressure in the test bin, and different wheels or brake discs have specific fitting curves through characteristic calibration, so that the test bed can accurately simulate running wind under different braking working conditions.

title_en: Control method and device of fan integrated power generation system
abstract_en: The specification provides a control method and device of a fan integrated power generation system. The method is applied to a fan integrated power generation system, when waves exist on the sea, a wave wing in a wave wing module is utilized to drive a power generation ring to rotate around a stand column under the action of the waves, a main shaft in the power generation module is utilized to drive a gear box to rotate for carrying out first-class power generation, meanwhile, a fan is utilized to receive the action of wind for carrying out second-class power generation, a controller forms a target moment opposite to the rotation direction of a driven shaft in the power generation process, and the target moment is used for acting on the wave wing module through the main shaft so that the wave wing module generates acting force opposite to the wave direction to weaken swinging of the stand column. Based on the control method, on one hand, the cooperative power generation of wave energy and wind energy is realized in the fan integrated power generation system, and on the other hand, the controller is utilized to form a target moment under the wave action, so that the running stability of the platform and the reliability of the power generation system are enhanced.

title_en: Cylinder wall high-temperature heating kerosene and dynamic temperature control system for rotor engine and temperature control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a cylinder wall high-temperature heating kerosene and dynamic temperature control system for a rotor engine and a temperature control method thereof. The method comprises the steps of detecting the temperature of kerosene in an oil tank, transmitting temperature data to an ECU, enabling one end of an oil supply pipeline to be connected with the oil tank, enabling the other end of the oil supply pipeline to be connected with an oil pump, enabling an output end of the oil pump to be connected to an oil injector, enabling the oil pump to be output to the oil injector through a first output end after the kerosene is pressurized and then to be sent to a combustion chamber of a rotor engine, enabling a second output end of the oil pump to be connected to one end of a heat exchange channel of the rotor engine through a heat exchange oil return pipeline, enabling a heat exchange oil return channel electromagnetic valve to be arranged on the heat exchange oil return pipeline, enabling a second output end of the oil pump to be connected to the oil tank through a non-heat exchange oil return pipeline, enabling a non-heat exchange oil return channel electromagnetic valve to be arranged on the non-heat exchange oil return pipeline, and enabling the ECU to control opening and closing states of the heat exchange oil return channel electromagnetic valve and the non-heat exchange oil return channel electromagnetic valve according to the temperature of the kerosene. The invention dynamically controls the fuel temperature by adjusting the oil return path and the flow ratio.

title_en: Jet deflection module for a thrust reverser of an aircraft turbine engine
abstract_en: The invention relates to a jet deflection module (26) for a thrust reverser (10) of an aircraft turbine engine, the module (26) extending in a surface (P) and comprising-longitudinal members (32) spaced apart from and parallel to each other, -at least one deflection member (34) extending between the longitudinal members (32) and connected to the longitudinal members (32), -two attachment profiles, respectively a front profile (36) and a rear profile (38), connected to the longitudinal members (32) and forming, together with two of the longitudinal members (32), a peripheral profile of the module (26), a first one of the attachment profiles (36, 38) comprising at least two U-shaped joints (90) parallel to each other and to the longitudinal members (32), and each U-shaped joint comprising a hole (92), the hole (92) of the U-shaped joint (90) being aligned with a pivot axis (A) of the module (26) and defining the pivot axis (A) of the module (26), characterized in that the U-shaped joint (90) extends in a continuation of the longitudinal member (32).

title_en: High-strength radiation-resistant molybdenum-rhenium alloy for fuel element cladding and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of molybdenum alloy, and provides a high-strength radiation-resistant molybdenum-rhenium alloy for fuel element cladding and a preparation method thereof, wherein the high-strength radiation-resistant molybdenum-rhenium alloy comprises the following components in percentage by weight: 1 to 9 weight percent of Re powder, 0.1 to 2 weight percent of Zr powder and the balance of Mo powder; the preparation method comprises the following steps: uniformly mixing molybdenum powder, rhenium powder and zirconium powder to obtain mixed powder; carrying out cold isostatic pressing forming and grading pressure relief on the mixed powder to obtain a material pressed compact; sintering the material pressed compact to obtain a sintered material; rolling and annealing the sintered material to obtain molybdenum-rhenium alloy; the strength of the molybdenum-rhenium alloy with low rhenium content can be obviously enhanced, and meanwhile, the irradiation resistance of the molybdenum-rhenium alloy with low rhenium content can be improved.

title_en: Flame stabilizer for combustion chamber of gas turbine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of gas turbines, in particular to a flame stabilizer of a combustion chamber of a gas turbine, which comprises a main cylinder, wherein an opening at one side of the main cylinder is provided with an air inlet end communicated with the main cylinder in a sliding way, the inner side wall of the main cylinder is provided with a plurality of swinging grooves distributed along the axis of the main cylinder, a swinging shaft is rotated in the swinging grooves, the outer side of the swinging shaft is sleeved with a swinging plate, the outline of the outer side of the swinging plate is triangular, a blocking unit for making up a gap between the swinging plates is arranged between the swinging plates, the inner side wall of the main cylinder is also provided with an annular sleeve positioned at one side of the swinging plates, the inner diameter of the annular sleeve is provided with an injection unit for injecting natural gas, the flow rate and range of the gas are regulated through the contraction and expansion of the swinging plate, and the clearance of the swinging plate are filled by using a blocking cloth and a reset tension spring of the blocking unit, so that a sealing conical ring is formed, and the flow rate of the gas input at the air inlet end can be dynamically regulated along with the flow of the gas, the expansion of the swinging plate increases the blowing range when the air inlet is large, and the air speed is prevented from excessively high blowing and flame is extinguished.

title_en: Quick jigger device of pump group
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid jigger device for a pump group, belongs to the technical field of jigger devices, and solves the problems of inconvenient disassembly and assembly and low efficiency of the conventional jigger device; the motor main shaft comprises a jigger shaft head and a static cylinder body, wherein the static cylinder body is arranged at the end part of a static motor body, the jigger shaft head is positioned in the static cylinder body, the static cylinder body is connected with the motor main shaft, a jigger tool is detachably connected to one end of the jigger shaft head, which is far away from the motor main shaft, the static cylinder body comprises a cylinder body, one end of the cylinder body is connected with a second flange, and the other end of the cylinder body is movably connected with a cover plate assembly. In the invention, the whole jigger shaft head is packaged in the motor static body after the cover plate assembly is closed, so that the jigger shaft head can be well protected, the operation risk caused by foreign matters entering the rotating jigger shaft head is prevented, the jigger tool is directly arranged on the jigger shaft head during use, the jigger can be started without disassembling or installing a static cylinder body, and the jigger is convenient to use and high in working efficiency.

title_en: Active variable cross-section adjusting mechanism for centrifugal compressor inlet
abstract_en: The invention provides an active variable cross-section adjusting mechanism for an inlet of a centrifugal compressor, which comprises a base, a power disc, a plurality of blades and a plurality of driving discs, wherein the base is of a cylindrical shape with a hollow inside, one end of the base is fixed on a rim cover plate of the centrifugal compressor through a fixing piece, the driving disc is used as a power transmission mechanism and is rotatably arranged between the other end of the base and an inlet pipeline of the centrifugal compressor, the blades are arranged in an inner cavity of the base, are arranged in an annular structure along the circumferential direction of the inner cavity, are respectively of irregular geometric shapes and are connected with the driving disc, can move in the cavity of the base along with the rotation of the driving disc, a plurality of raised cylindrical transmission parts are arranged on the surface of the driving disc facing the base along the circumferential direction, grooves are respectively arranged on the ends of the blades facing the driving disc, and the raised cylindrical transmission parts of the driving disc are inserted into the grooves and slide, and are driven by the rotation of the driving disc to change the direction in the cavity of the base. The invention directly controls the flow area of the inlet pipeline of the centrifugal compressor from the physical and geometric aspects.

title_en: Multi-quality steam heating system and operation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-quality steam heating system and an operation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of coal-fired cogeneration. According to the multi-quality steam heating system, the high-pressure steam of the boiler and the low-pressure steam of the medium-pressure cylinder are received through the steam ejector, the SSS clutch is arranged between the medium-pressure cylinder and the low-pressure cylinder rotor, the high-pressure steam valve, the low-pressure steam valve and the butterfly valve are controlled to control the mass flow ratio of the high-pressure steam and the low-pressure steam through controlling the engagement relation of the SSS clutch, the medium-pressure steam supply and the low-pressure steam supply of different pressure levels are achieved, additional complicated equipment is not needed, flexible adjustment of steam parameters can be achieved only through adjusting the steam ratio, and therefore requirements of different heat users are met, meanwhile, energy mixing is achieved through low-pressure steam ejection, and energy waste caused by throttling and depressurization is reduced.

title_en: Laser fusion driver
abstract_en: The application provides a laser fusion driver, which relates to the technical field of laser fusion energy, and comprises a pulse amplification module, an optical fiber beam splitter, a plurality of laser sub-beam structures, a closed-loop controller and a vacuum target chamber, wherein the pulse amplification module is connected with the optical fiber beam splitter, the optical fiber beam splitter is respectively connected with the plurality of laser sub-beam structures, an optical cavity input mirror, an intracavity gain medium and an optical cavity total reflection mirror in each laser sub-beam structure form an optical gain cavity corresponding to the laser sub-beam structure, the plurality of laser sub-beam structures are connected with the closed-loop controller, the vacuum target chamber is internally provided with target pills, and the plurality of optical gain cavities are arrayed at equal intervals along the circumferential direction of the target chamber, so that gain output pulses in all the optical gain cavities are coaxially converged on the target pills. The application converts the pulse sequence with high repetition frequency, high average power and low energy into the pulse sequence with low repetition frequency, high average power and high energy by utilizing the optical gain cavity, thereby being beneficial to reducing the technical difficulty of the existing fusion laser driver and improving the pulse gain in the optical gain cavity.

title_en: Solid-state hydrogen storage system based on hydrogen energy gas turbine
abstract_en: The invention relates to a solid hydrogen storage system based on a hydrogen energy gas turbine, which comprises at least one solid hydrogen storage module, wherein an air port of the single solid hydrogen storage module is connected with a hydrogen supply main pipe through a hydrogen supply connecting pipe group, the hydrogen supply main pipe is also connected with a hydrogen inlet of a buffer tank through a first hydrogen supply pipe group, a hydrogen outlet of the buffer tank is connected with a hydrogen inlet of the hydrogen energy gas turbine through a second hydrogen supply pipe group, the hydrogen supply main pipe is connected with a hydrogen source, the hydrogen source is used for respectively providing hydrogen for the solid hydrogen storage module and/or the buffer tank through the hydrogen supply main pipe, the solid hydrogen storage material is arranged in the single solid hydrogen storage module, the single solid hydrogen storage module is used for providing hydrogen for the hydrogen energy gas turbine, the hydrogen in the hydrogen energy gas turbine is combusted to convert chemical energy into mechanical energy, and flue gas is generated, and the flue gas heats each solid hydrogen storage module through a direct heat exchange mode or an indirect heat exchange mode. The system has the advantages of good safety and stability, compact structure, low cost and low energy consumption.

title_en: Axial plunger pump with self-adaptive regulating and controlling flow distribution pair lubricating film thickness
abstract_en: The invention provides an axial plunger pump with a self-adaptive flow distribution pair lubricating film thickness regulation function, which relates to the technical field of hydraulic transmission and comprises a cylinder body, wherein the cylinder body is arranged in a shell, the cylinder body is supported on a flow distribution plate through a cylinder body lining plate, a plurality of groups of permanent magnets are arranged on the cylinder body lining plate in an array manner, a coil is arranged at the second end of the shell and positioned at the outer side of the cylinder body lining plate in a surrounding manner, a coil is wound on a coil winding bracket at the inner side of the coil ring, a transmission shaft drives the cylinder body to rotate, the cylinder body lining plate and the permanent magnets are driven by the cylinder body to rotate, a periodically-changing space magnetic field is generated in the circumferential direction of the coil, so that the coil generates an induction magnetic field and interacts with the space magnetic field generated by the permanent magnets to generate magnetic force, the thickness of a liquid film of the flow distribution plate and the cylinder body gesture can be self-adaptively regulated by utilizing the axial component of the magnetic force, so that the abrasion of the flow distribution plate and the cylinder body lining plate and the leakage of liquid are effectively reduced, and the efficiency, reliability and service life of the axial plunger pump are improved.

title_en: Automatic fluid infusion structure, automatic fluid infusion method, engine and ship
abstract_en: The application provides an automatic fluid infusion structure, an automatic fluid infusion method, an engine and a ship. The automatic fluid infusion structure comprises an expansion tank, a liquid storage tank, a valve and a control assembly, wherein the control assembly comprises a floater and a transmission part, the liquid storage tank, the valve and the expansion tank are sequentially connected, the floater can float along with the liquid level change of cooling fluid in the expansion tank, one end of the transmission part is connected with the floater, the other end of the transmission part is connected with the valve, the transmission path of the automatic fluid infusion structure is configured in such a way that the liquid level of the expansion tank drops to drive the floater, the floater drives the valve to open through the transmission part, the liquid storage tank is communicated with the expansion tank, and therefore the cooling fluid flows from the liquid storage tank to the expansion tank through the valve under the action of gravity.

title_en: Wind power tower does not have cavity basis prestressing force anchor structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to a wind power tower, in particular to a hollow foundation prestress anchoring structure of a wind power tower, a cylindrical convex column extending upwards and with an upward cylinder opening is connected to a foundation at the bottom of the tower, the convex column is inserted into a lower end pipe opening of a tubular tower body lattice column, the lower end of a prestress cable bundle extends from the tower top to the cylinder cavity of the convex column along the middle pipe cavity of the tower body lattice column, the lower end of the prestress cable bundle is connected with a lower anchor ring, and a limiting mechanism for limiting the upward displacement of the lower anchor ring is arranged in the cylinder cavity of the convex column. The tower bottom foundation only needs to be poured with an upper foundation, the setting of an operation cavity is canceled, the convex column is used as a prefabricated member, when the tower body is built, the convex column is fixedly arranged on the tower bottom foundation, the convex column and the tower body constructional column form an inserting fit, the lower anchor ring connected with the prestressed cable bundle is lowered into the convex column cylinder cavity and limited by the limiting mechanism, the lower end anchoring operation of the prestressed cable bundle can be realized, the integral construction speed of the wind power tower is high, and meanwhile, the pouring engineering quantity and the pouring cost of the tower bottom foundation are reduced.

title_en: Thrust regulating valve for low-temperature propellant rocket engine
abstract_en: The invention relates to a thrust regulating valve for a low-temperature propellant rocket engine, which comprises a middle shell, motor bases and rear end covers which are respectively arranged at two ends of the middle shell, and a motor arranged on the motor bases. The middle shell is internally provided with a propellant inlet and a flow cavity which are mutually communicated, and the rear end cover is provided with a propellant outlet which is communicated with one end of the flow cavity far away from the propellant inlet. The output end of the motor is positioned in the motor base and is in transmission fit with an adjusting cone, the adjusting cone is in sliding fit with the inner wall of the motor base, and at least two first leakage-proof mechanisms are arranged at the sliding fit position of the adjusting cone and the inner wall of the motor base along the axial direction of the adjusting cone. The motor base is provided with a first one-way exhaust mechanism. The thrust regulating valve can reduce the whole volume and the weight of the thrust regulating valve, and can also ensure the torque output capacity of a motor and the normal operation of the thrust regulating valve.

title_en: Frame construction of gravity energy storage and gravity energy storage system thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of gravity energy storage, in particular to a gravity energy storage frame structure and a gravity energy storage system thereof, comprising two energy storage building bodies which are respectively arranged at the top and the bottom of a mountain; the gravity blocks on the second conveyor belt are conveyed onto the first conveyor belt in the conveying frame through a conveying passage opening, the gravity blocks on the first conveyor belt are clamped by an electric sliding rail and clamping jaws on a lifting device main body and are conveyed into a conveying frame on a mountain top, the gravity blocks are conveyed onto the second conveyor belt by the first conveyor belt in the conveying frame on the mountain top, the gravity blocks are orderly arranged on a backing plate of the first layer through the first sliding rail and the second sliding rail, and the first conveyor belt is required to move upwards through a lifting plate until the first conveyor belt is horizontally aligned with the second conveyor belt on the second layer after the gravity blocks on the first layer are conveyed, and the gravity blocks are continuously supplied.

title_en: Wind power blade forming device, wind power blade forming method and wind power blade
abstract_en: The application relates to a wind power blade forming device, a wind power blade forming method and a wind power blade. The edge of the flexible piece is connected with the base in a sealing way and forms a forming cavity, and the forming cavity is used for containing forming materials. The vacuum pumping assembly includes a vacuum pump and a first conduit in communication with the vacuum pump. The first cooling assembly includes a second conduit and a circulation pump coupled to the second conduit. The flexible piece is provided with a first communication port communicated with the forming cavity, the base is provided with a second communication port communicated with the forming cavity, the first communication port is selectively communicated with the first pipeline and the second pipeline, when the first communication port is communicated with the first pipeline, the second communication port is closed, and when the first communication port is communicated with one end of the second pipeline, the other end of the second pipeline is communicated with the second communication port. According to the embodiment of the application, the wind power blade forming device can improve the cooling efficiency of the wind power blade in the forming process.

title_en: Energy-saving temperature regulating device of cold and heat source system of marine methanol supply system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy-saving temperature regulating device of a cold and heat source system of a marine methanol supply system, and relates to the technical field of temperature regulation of marine methanol supply systems. When the invention is used, the first positive and negative motor drives the driving gear and the chain to rotate, drives the four driven gears and the four rotating rods to rotate together, and further the plurality of blocking blocks rotate, so that two adjacent impact pipes are always switched back and forth in a one-to-one state, namely, the two sides of the swinging fin are pushed back and forth to swing, so that the two heat exchange pipes are driven to swing, the stagnation layer on the inner wall of the pipe is flushed and mixed by fluid in a main flow area, the turbulence intensity is enhanced, the thermal resistance is reduced, the heat exchange efficiency of methanol fuel and hot air is improved, the flowing direction of hot air is disturbed, the hot air is more uniformly wrapped around the heat exchange pipes, and extra energy consumption is not required for reaching the target temperature.

title_en: Noise reduction device for range hood and range hood
abstract_en: The invention relates to a noise reduction device for a range hood and the range hood, wherein the range hood comprises a shell, the noise reduction device comprises a sound absorbing piece which is arranged in the shell, a piezoelectric regulating layer made of piezoelectric materials is further arranged on one side, at least facing the inside of the shell, of the sound absorbing piece, the piezoelectric regulating layer is configured to regulate the vibration frequency of the surface of the piezoelectric regulating layer through inverse piezoelectric effect according to the frequency and intensity of incident sound waves, and receives an external voltage signal and generates vibration, so that the acoustic impedance of the surface of the sound absorbing piece is regulated to reduce sound wave reflection. The sound absorbing material has the advantages that the problem of the surface acoustic impedance of the sound absorbing piece can be effectively solved, the sound absorbing and noise reducing efficiency is improved, and the thickness requirement of the traditional sound absorbing material is further reduced.

title_en: Pouring method of large-volume concrete of fan foundation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a casting method of large-volume concrete of a fan foundation, which belongs to the technical field of fan power generation equipment construction, and comprises the following steps of S1, preparing before construction, S2, installing embedded parts and cable pipelines, uniformly arranging a plurality of groups of embedded parts along the central line of a foundation pit in the circumferential direction, arranging a bottom backing plate above the embedded parts, S3, constructing a foundation cushion layer, S4, installing a second sleeve and a top backing plate, arranging the top backing plate on the upper part of the second sleeve, S5, carrying out primary foundation casting, arranging a template, arranging a foundation reinforcing steel wire net in a casting area, pumping concrete into the template until the top backing plate is cast, S6, installing a foundation ring, S7, installing anchor rods, S8, carrying out secondary concrete casting, casting between the template and the foundation ring and a casting foundation, and a joint, and carrying out backfilling, and S9, removing the template. The invention has the advantages of high stability and long service life.

title_en: Combined non-contact fingertip sealing device with reed on back baffle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a combined non-contact fingertip sealing device with a back baffle plate and reeds, which comprises a front baffle plate, a high-pressure fingertip sheet, a low-pressure fingertip sheet, a plurality of lifting force boots, a back baffle plate and a plurality of reeds, wherein the high-pressure fingertip sheet is positioned behind the front baffle plate, the high-pressure fingertip sheet is provided with a plurality of first fingertip beams, the low-pressure fingertip sheet is positioned behind the high-pressure fingertip sheet, the low-pressure fingertip sheet is provided with a plurality of second fingertip beams, the lifting force boots respectively extend backwards from the inner ends of the plurality of second fingertip beams, the back baffle plate is positioned behind the low-pressure fingertip sheet, the outer edge of each reed is connected with the inner peripheral surface of the back baffle plate, the reeds are all positioned outside the lifting force boots, the reeds are arranged in a plurality of circumferential intervals, and each reed extends backwards and inwards in an inclined manner from the front edge of the inner peripheral surface of the back baffle plate. The combined non-contact fingertip sealing device with the reed on the rear baffle plate has the advantages of small hysteresis effect, good sealing effect and the like.

title_en: Underwater remote replacement method for lock nut of supporting column of pressurized water reactor internals
abstract_en: The invention particularly relates to an underwater remote replacement method for a lock nut of a supporting column of a pressurized water reactor internals, which belongs to the technical field of maintenance and comprises a method for disassembling an old lock nut and a method for installing a new lock nut. The invention establishes a coordinate system for replacing the locking nut of the pressurized water reactor hanging basket assembly, provides a concept of replacing a working channel of the locking nut of the pressurized water reactor hanging basket assembly and establishes a concept of maintaining a platform, solves the problems of high irradiation, long distance and underwater of the pressurized water reactor of a nuclear power plant, replaces the locking nut of the supporting column of the hanging basket assembly, has high accuracy, furthest keeps away from a high irradiation environment and greatly reduces the irradiation dose of operators.

title_en: Environment-friendly damping cabinet type fan
abstract_en: The application discloses an environment-friendly damping cabinet type fan, and belongs to the field of cabinet type fans. The dust-proof device comprises a cabinet type fan and a dust-proof component, wherein the dust-proof component comprises a dust-proof part for filtering dust at an air inlet flange, a switching part is arranged on the dust-proof part, a first driving part is arranged on the dust-proof part, two groups of wind speed sensors are arranged on the inner wall of the air inlet flange and at the right side of a first filter screen and a second filter screen, a controller is arranged on the cabinet type fan, the dust-proof component comprises a first driving part and two groups of suction parts for sucking away impurities such as cleaned dust, and the dust-proof part is provided with a second driving part for driving the two groups of suction parts to operate. According to the environment-friendly damping cabinet fan, dust cleaned by the cleaning brush rod and dust at the friction rod can be sucked through the suction part and the driving part II of the dust removing assembly, the filter screen and the switching mechanism are kept clean, the filtering and switching effects are guaranteed, and the adhesion of dust to core components such as fan blades and motors is reduced.

title_en: Cut-off equipment for water conservancy construction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cut-off device for water conservancy construction, which relates to the field of water conservancy construction and comprises a cut-off device, wherein the cut-off device comprises a first baffle, a second baffle and a bottom bracket, the first baffle and the second baffle are fixed on two sides of the bottom bracket, a fixing bolt is arranged between the first baffle and the second baffle and penetrates through the bottom bracket, the bottom end of the bottom bracket is connected with a plurality of groups of locking bolts, the second baffle is in contact with water, and the bottom end of the first baffle is connected with two groups of water suction pumps. According to the invention, through the arranged cut-off device, water flow can be collected, after entering the cut-off device, the water flow is continuously filtered through the coarse filter screen and the middle filter screen, and the filtered impurities are flushed into the collecting box through the water flow, when the water flow needs to be cleaned, the collecting box is pulled out of the isolation plate through the pull rope, so that the interference of the impurities on the water suction pump can be effectively reduced, and the service life of the water suction pump is prolonged.

title_en: Novel pumped storage power station power generation combination system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel pumped storage power station power generation combination system which comprises a pumped storage system and a power generation system, wherein the pumped storage system comprises a water discharge pipeline, a water storage tank, a water pumping pipeline, a three-stage water storage tank, a two-stage water storage tank and a one-stage water storage tank, one end of the water discharge pipeline is connected with the water storage tank arranged at a mountain top, the other end of the water discharge pipeline is connected with a power plant, the water discharge pipeline and the water pumping pipeline are provided with a plurality of water storage tanks, the multi-stage water storage tank is arranged at the position of the adjacent mountain top, the power generation system comprises a power generation unit, an impeller, a connecting shaft and a transmission, a connecting pipe is arranged in the power generation unit, and one end part of the connecting pipe is connected with sea water. The novel power generation combination system of the pumped storage power station utilizes the condition of low salt content of seawater at the valley, selects the valley to pump water in the land, and a little filtration is performed to obtain an inexhaustible large amount of water sources, so that the problem that the traditional pumped storage power station is lack of water due to the lack of resident water or drought and dead water seasons is solved, the guarantee is provided for pumped storage, and a reservoir with extremely high requirements is not required to be built.

title_en: System and method for recommending items to be recovered from recyclable materials using machine learning
abstract_en: A method for identifying and recovering a target commodity from a composite wind turbine blade, wherein a computing device receives quality grade data indicative of a quality grade of a respective material included within the turbine blade and commodity data of a plurality of candidate commodities capable of being recovered from one or more materials of the turbine blade. The computing device determines an expected profitability of each of the plurality of respective candidate good, wherein the quality grade data of the respective material and the good data of the plurality of candidate good are provided as inputs to the data model such that the data model determines the expected profitability of each of the plurality of respective candidate good. The computing device determines a recommendation based on the expected profitability, the recommendation indicating, for the respective material of the turbine blade, one or more target good to be restored using the respective material. The device delivers the recommendation to another device or recipient so that a restoration of the target commodity can occur.

title_en: Cable protective sleeve
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of wind power generation equipment, in particular to a cable protective sleeve which comprises a cable fixing tube, a flexible anti-abrasion protective sleeve and a rigid limiting protective sleeve, wherein the flexible anti-abrasion protective sleeve is arranged corresponding to the cable fixing tube and is wrapped at the outer surface of a required protective cable to provide anti-abrasion protection for the surface layer of the required protective cable, and the rigid limiting protective sleeve is arranged inside the cable fixing tube to limit the required protective cable in a dividing way. According to the application, the flexible anti-wear protective sleeve wrapped on the outer surface of the cable to be protected provides surface flexible protection for the cable to be protected, the rigid limiting protective sleeve is matched with the cable fixing pipe to form the rigid clamping groove to limit the degree of freedom of the cable to be protected in a dividing way, and the shaking amplitude of the cable is restrained, so that the flexible anti-wear protective sleeve and the rigid limiting protective sleeve are matched in a cooperative way to form a rigid-flexible coupling protection design, and dynamic abrasion at a high-frequency friction point of the cable to be protected is restrained.

title_en: Water power generation device and application method thereof
