abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power generation equipment, and discloses a water power generation device and a use method thereof, wherein the water power generation device comprises the following components: the invention relates to a ship body, a flow passage is arranged in the ship body, a magnetic bearing generator is fixedly arranged in the flow passage, a power generation fan blade is fixedly arranged at the top of the ship body and connected with the magnetic bearing generator, the invention actively utilizes water flow and wind to stably generate power through the magnetic bearing generator and the power generation fan blade, waves formed in the navigation passage can be converted into beneficial kinetic energy, the annular floating ball is enabled to move up and down under the wave action and drives the cleaning brush to automatically clean the filter screen at the water inlet of the runner, so that the efficiency attenuation problem caused by the blockage of the water inlet of the underwater power generation device is fundamentally solved, the water flow efficiency during water flow power generation is ensured, and the stability of the overall power generation effect is ensured.

title_en: Liquid fuel gasification voltage stabilizer and aeroengine with same
abstract_en: The invention discloses a liquid fuel gasification pressure stabilizing device and an aeroengine with the same, the device comprises an exhaust casing with an exhaust runner, a gasifier arranged on the outer peripheral surface of the exhaust casing along the axial direction of the exhaust casing, a gas cylinder connected to the outer wall of the gasifier and extending along the axial direction of the exhaust casing, and a pressure detector connected with an engine fuel regulation system. The gasifier is provided with a fuel inlet, the gas collecting cylinder is internally provided with a gas collecting cavity, the gasifier is communicated with the gas collecting cavity, the gasifier is used for enabling the entering liquid fuel to be heated and gasified to form gaseous fuel under the effect of high-temperature exhaust in the exhaust runner and discharged into the gas collecting cavity, and the wall surface of the gas collecting cavity is also provided with a fuel outlet. The pressure detector is arranged in the gas collection cavity and is used for detecting the pressure in the gas collection cavity so as to enable the engine fuel regulating and controlling system to correspondingly control the flow of liquid fuel entering the gasifier, and further correspondingly regulate and control the pressure of gas fuel in the gas collection cavity. The device can be used on an aeroengine to further improve the combustion efficiency of liquid fuel in the aeroengine.

title_en: Intelligent collaborative planning and control method for vehicle speed and gear, computer system, computer readable storage medium and computer program product
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent collaborative planning and control method for vehicle speed and gear, which is characterized in that an accurate vehicle dynamics model is established and combined with a depth deterministic strategy gradient algorithm, a multi-objective rewarding function is designed, the combined optimization control of the gear and the speed is realized, and the model predictive control is used for carrying out the collaborative control of an engine throttle valve and a clutch. The method has the advantages that the fuel economy and the overall energy utilization efficiency are remarkably improved, the smoothness of the response of the system and the stability of the driving process are effectively improved, the system can continuously learn and adjust the control strategy in complex and changeable road traffic environments through the combination of the depth deterministic strategy gradient algorithm and the model predictive control, and the universality and the robustness of the control system are improved.

title_en: Steam turbine convenient to reform transform
abstract_en: The invention relates to a steam turbine convenient to reform, which comprises a rotor body, a front cover body, a shell and a rear cover body, wherein the front cover body, the shell and the rear cover body are sleeved on the outer side of the rotor body, the front cover body, the shell and the rear cover body are sequentially connected along the axial direction of the rotor body, the shell and the rear cover body are detachably connected, an inner mounting groove which extends in the axial direction is formed in the rotor body in the outer cylinder cavity, a plurality of detachable sleeved impellers are sleeved on the rotor body and are in sliding fit with the inner mounting groove, a plurality of baffle sleeves are arranged on the inner wall of the shell, a plurality of baffle plates are respectively arranged on the baffle sleeves, and the baffle plates and the sleeved impellers are alternately arranged along the axial direction of the rotor body.

title_en: Static pressure annular seal
abstract_en: The invention relates to a seal (201) for an aircraft turbine engine, comprising a plurality of seal segments distributed circumferentially about an axis (X), each seal segment comprising a radially outer annular wall segment (204) and a radially inner annular wall segment (202) which are connected to each other by means of an elastically deformable member (203), wherein the elastically deformable member (203) comprises an inner leg (206) having a radially inner end (208) fixed to the radially inner annular wall segment (202,205) and an outer leg (207) having a radially outer end (209) fixed to the radially outer annular wall segment (204), a radially outer end (210) of the inner leg (206) being connected to a radially inner end (211) of the outer leg (207) by means of a connecting wall (215), the inner leg (206) and the outer leg (207) extending radially such that the radially inner end (211) of the outer leg (207) is located radially inwards of the radially outer end (210) of the inner leg (206).

title_en: Compound and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a compound, a preparation method and application thereof. The compound is represented by the following formula (I), wherein R is a C1 to C14 alkyl group. The compound can efficiently extract tetravalent plutonium in spent fuel aftertreatment flow, has wide applicable nitric acid concentration, fast extraction kinetics and short extraction balance time.

title_en: Intercooler bypass system control method and device, vehicle and computer storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intercooler bypass system control method, an intercooler bypass system control device, a vehicle and a computer storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of vehicle engine air intake, wherein the intercooler bypass system control method comprises the steps of obtaining engine history working condition data, adopting a preset working condition prediction algorithm to predict future working conditions of an engine based on the engine history working condition data, adopting a preset target air intake temperature mathematical model to calculate future target air intake temperature of the engine corresponding to the future working conditions, adopting a preset intercooler bypass mathematical model to determine target opening of an intercooler bypass valve based on the future target air intake temperature of the engine, determining whether the opening of the intercooler bypass valve is required to be pre-regulated based on the difference between the target opening and the current opening of the intercooler bypass valve, and adjusting the opening of the intercooler bypass valve with the aim that the mixed air outlet temperature of the intercooler bypass valve and the intercooler reaches the future target air intake temperature of the engine. The invention can accurately control the air inlet temperature of the engine.

title_en: Pipeline BOG precooling system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a pipeline BOG precooling system and a method, wherein the pipeline BOG precooling system comprises the following components: the system comprises an oxidant system, a fuel system and a system to be precooled, wherein pipelines and valves are arranged in the oxidant system and the fuel system, and the oxidant system and the fuel system are connected with the system to be precooled through the pipelines. And introducing the BOG into a test run pipeline to perform preliminary pre-cooling of the pipeline, and reducing the temperature of the test run pipeline in advance. The pre-cooling mode is BOG preliminary pre-cooling, and long-time pre-cooling can be performed by maintaining states of different valves, and a low-temperature environment is maintained. The BOG pre-cooling process can be performed synchronously on both sides. The consumption of liquid medium can be effectively reduced by using BOG precooling. The low-temperature characteristic of the exhaust gas is effectively utilized, and the consumption of medium precooling is reduced. And meanwhile, the stress impact of the pipeline can be reduced by using gas pre-cooling, the stress change caused by expansion caused by heat and contraction caused by cold in the pipeline is slowed down, and the leakage of the valve and the flange caused by temperature change is avoided.

title_en: Energy-saving control system of air compressor based on AI algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy-saving control system of an air compressor based on an AI algorithm, which relates to the technical field of energy saving of air compressors and comprises an air compressor, wherein an air outlet end of the air compressor is connected with a compressed air transmission assembly, an oil outlet end of the air compressor is connected with a plurality of groups of double heat exchange mechanisms, the groups of double heat exchange mechanisms are positioned in the compressed air transmission assembly, S-shaped gas channels are formed among the groups of double heat exchange mechanisms, a hidden driving mechanism is fixedly arranged at the front side of the top of the compressed air transmission assembly, a sealing pushing mechanism is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the hidden driving mechanism, and the hidden driving mechanism drives the sealing pushing mechanism to seal and push water storage and drainage mechanisms. The invention can actively output the condensed water on the premise of not stopping the recovery of the waste heat of the compressed gas, and ensures the integral energy-saving effect of the air compressor while being convenient to use.

title_en: Hydraulic pump state monitoring system based on multi-mode information fusion and digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydraulic pump state monitoring system based on multi-mode information fusion and digital twin, and particularly relates to the technical field of hydraulic equipment state monitoring, which comprises a hydraulic pump multi-mode data acquisition module, a hydraulic pump multi-mode characteristic engineering module, a hydraulic pump state layered fusion diagnosis module, a hydraulic pump health state and risk assessment module and a digital twin and decision support module; the hydraulic pump multi-mode data acquisition module synchronously acquires key operation parameters of the hydraulic pump through the distributed sensor array and acquires a hydraulic pump multi-mode parameter set after preprocessing, and the hydraulic pump multi-mode data acquisition module respectively constructs a cavitation diagnosis sub-model, a bearing abrasion diagnosis sub-model and an internal leakage diagnosis sub-model by combining the advantages of RF, CNN, LSTM +attention algorithm and the like through the hydraulic pump state layered fusion diagnosis module, can diagnose different fault types, and realizes the automation and the intellectualization from feature extraction to fusion diagnosis.

title_en: Power failure protection system of wind turbine generator and power supply method thereof
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a power failure protection system of a wind turbine generator and a power supply method thereof. The power-losing protection system comprises a small wind power generator set, an MPPT controller, a power-losing protection controller, an anemoclinograph and energy storage equipment, wherein the energy storage equipment is respectively and electrically connected with the power-losing protection controller, the wind power generator set and the MPPT controller, the MPPT controller is electrically connected with the small wind power generator set, the power-losing protection controller is electrically connected with the anemoclinograph, the power-losing protection controller is used for controlling the energy storage equipment to supply power for the wind power generator set according to wind speed and wind direction data acquired by the anemoclinograph in real time when a power grid is in power losing, and the MPPT controller is used for supplementing power for the energy storage equipment by utilizing electric energy generated by the small wind power generator set in the operation process of the small wind power generator set. The power supply system can automatically supply power to key equipment of the wind turbine after the power grid loses power, and meanwhile has a power supplementing path independent of the power grid and the wind turbine.

title_en: Negative pressure unblocking and stratum extrusion filling sand prevention integrated pipe column and process
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of oilfield drilling, in particular to a negative pressure blocking removal and stratum extrusion filling sand prevention integrated tubular column and a process, wherein the tubular column comprises a tail pipe, a packer and a negative pressure blocking removal device from bottom to top, and the negative pressure blocking removing device comprises a negative pressure blocking removing working cylinder and a negative pressure blocking removing working core which can be put into and washed back. According to the invention, the casting and fishing negative pressure blocking removal working core and the fixed negative pressure blocking removal working cylinder are integrated in one pipe column, the venturi jet principle is utilized to realize efficient blocking removal, the negative pressure blocking removal working core can be reversely washed out and recovered after blocking removal is completed, then the pipe column flow passage is switched into a straight-through mode by throwing in a closing sliding sleeve and a steel ball and pumping pressure to seal, thus creating conditions for subsequent sand flushing and extrusion filling sand prevention operation, and realizing continuous construction of three working procedures of blocking removal, sand flushing and sand prevention by one operation.

title_en: Engine, engine control method, engine control device and vehicle
abstract_en: The application provides an engine, a control method, a device and a vehicle of the engine, wherein the engine comprises a cylinder, a piston, an oil sprayer, a driving piece and a driving piece, wherein the piston is positioned in the cylinder, the oil sprayer comprises an integrally formed oil sprayer body and a nozzle, the nozzle is positioned in the cylinder, the oil sprayer body is positioned outside the cylinder, the driving piece is connected with the oil sprayer body and is used for driving the oil sprayer body to synchronously move along with the piston when the nozzle sprays oil, and the problems that the piston moves up and down in the cylinder during oil spraying and the throat of the piston is unstable in the action of separating oil beams, so that the oil-gas mixing is uneven are solved.

title_en: Bearing cavity injection sealing system and method for aero-engine
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a bearing cavity injection sealing system and method for an aeroengine. The auxiliary air supply device is independent of an aeroengine and is used for providing auxiliary air for the ejection nozzle so as to enable the ejector to conduct ejection depressurization, a power supply supplies power to the auxiliary air supply device, and a circuit breaker is used for switching on or switching off connection of the auxiliary air supply device and the power supply, and when the auxiliary air supply device is connected with the power supply, the auxiliary air provided by the auxiliary air supply device is input to the ejection nozzle so as to enable the ejector to conduct ejection depressurization, and therefore the bearing cavity is sealed in an ejection mode. The sealing of the bearing cavity under the low-state and high-state operation of the aero-engine can be completed simultaneously by the hybrid power design technology, and the operation mode is stable and reliable.

title_en: Road bridge high-efficient drainage device
abstract_en: The invention provides a road bridge high-efficiency drainage device, which relates to the technical field of bridge drainage and comprises a pipe body assembly, wherein the pipe body assembly comprises a water inlet pipe and a pressure assembly, the top end of the pressure assembly is fixedly connected with a cleaning assembly, the pressure assembly comprises an inner pipe fixedly connected to the water inlet pipe, the top end of the inner pipe is provided with a filter tank, the inner part of the inner pipe is slidably connected with a piston, both sides of the bottom end of the piston are fixedly connected with a pull belt, the inner wall of the inner pipe is fixedly connected with a transfer column, and one end of the pull belt, which is far away from the piston, is fixedly connected with a spring mechanism.

title_en: Water ramjet engine with blunt body cavity powder inlet structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water ramjet engine with a blunt body cavity powder inlet structure, which comprises a combustion chamber, a gas generator, a powder conveying pipe, a tail nozzle and a cone-shaped blunt body, wherein the gas generator is used for providing high-temperature gas for the combustion chamber, the gas generator is fixedly connected with the front end of the combustion chamber, the powder conveying pipe is fixedly assembled in the gas generator, the front end of the powder conveying pipe is connected with a powder supply device, the rear end of the powder conveying pipe extends into the combustion chamber from an air inlet at the front end of the combustion chamber, the tail nozzle is fixedly communicated with the rear end of the combustion chamber, the blunt body is fixedly communicated with the rear end of the powder conveying pipe, and the opening of the blunt body faces the tail nozzle. The device has better mixing combustion effect and can reduce the deposition on the wall surface of the combustion chamber and the surface of the blunt body.

title_en: Fan blade life prediction and fault early warning method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fan blade operation monitoring and discloses a fan blade life prediction and fault early warning method based on digital twinning; the method comprises the steps of embedding a fiber bragg grating sensor in a blade truss cap fiber layer, arranging an acceleration sensor in a blade root, collecting multi-source data by combining a wind speed sensor, a rotating speed sensor and a pitch angle sensor, establishing a blade finite element digital twin model, combining pneumatic-structure coupling simulation and extended Kalman filtering to realize dynamic assimilation of a stress field, calculating fatigue residual life based on a rain flow count, an S-N curve and a Miner theory, simultaneously evaluating crack extension life by adopting a Paris model, taking the minimum value of the crack extension life and the minimum value as comprehensive life, further constructing a dynamic safety threshold taking wind speed fluctuation, environment temperature and running time into consideration, and triggering early warning when the comprehensive life is smaller than or equal to the threshold. The invention can realize accurate prediction and real-time early warning of the service life of the blade, and solves the problems of insufficient monitoring coverage, incomplete service life assessment and fixed threshold value.

title_en: Energy storage device utilizing steam
abstract_en: The application provides energy storage equipment utilizing steam, which comprises a boiler, a steam turbine, a generator, a cooling tower, a gas-liquid exchange assembly, a water storage body, a plurality of heating devices and an energy supply pipeline, wherein the steam turbine is connected with the boiler, the generator is connected with the steam turbine, the cooling tower is arranged at intervals with the boiler, the gas-liquid exchange assembly and the water storage body are connected with the cooling tower through the gas-liquid exchange assembly, the heating devices are arranged in the water storage body at intervals along the up-down direction, the heating devices correspond to different stratum where the water storage body is located, each heating device is electrically connected with the generator, and the energy supply pipeline is connected with the gas-liquid exchange assembly and/or the water storage body. The technical scheme of the application effectively solves the problem of low energy supply efficiency of the energy storage equipment in the related technology.

title_en: Internal combustion engine oil cylinder for engineering machinery
abstract_en: The invention discloses an internal combustion engine oil cylinder for engineering machinery, which comprises a cylinder barrel, wherein an oil pipe A and an oil pipe B are fixedly connected to the top of the cylinder barrel, a sealing ring is fixedly connected to the inside of the cylinder barrel, the inner wall of the sealing ring is contacted with a piston rod, one end of the piston rod penetrates through the right side of the cylinder barrel and is in sliding connection with the inner wall of the cylinder barrel, and a thermal expansion fastening mechanism is arranged inside the cylinder barrel, and the internal combustion engine oil cylinder relates to the technical field of hydraulic pressure. This internal-combustion engine hydro-cylinder for engineering machine tool is through setting up thermal expansion fastening mechanism to make under different fluid temperatures, nitrogen gas carry out the targeted thermal expansion, thereby get into pushing away the inside lifting block of air groove and carry out outside release slip, the lifting block then pushes away the rubber circle through the push pedal, push away tight with rubber circle and cylinder inner wall, the fluid that avoids the piston both sides takes place to reveal each other the hydraulic pressure work efficiency that leads to descends, and combined the rubber circle to take place the characteristic pertinence of revealing under the different states and make the automatic adjustment to the rubber circle, thereby promote work efficiency.

title_en: Main shaft assembly and wind generating set
abstract_en: The application provides a main shaft assembly and a wind generating set. The hydraulic control device comprises a main shaft, a supporting seat, a plurality of hydraulic cylinders, a hydraulic control assembly and a hydraulic control assembly, wherein the main shaft is arranged on the supporting seat, the hydraulic cylinders are rotatable relative to the supporting seat and the hydraulic cylinders, the hydraulic cylinders are arranged on the periphery of the main shaft, at least one part of the hydraulic cylinders are distributed at intervals in the circumferential direction of the main shaft, the hydraulic cylinders are provided with accommodating cavities, one end of each hydraulic cylinder facing the main shaft is attached to the main shaft, one end of each hydraulic cylinder facing the main shaft is provided with an opening, the accommodating cavities are used for accommodating hydraulic media, the hydraulic media apply an abutting force to the main shaft through the opening, and the hydraulic control assembly is used for controlling the pressure of the hydraulic media in the accommodating cavities of the hydraulic cylinders. Therefore, the main shaft can be always positioned in the center of the supporting seat, and the stability and the reliability of the operation of the main shaft assembly are improved.

title_en: Unmanned three-dimensional operation and maintenance system and method for offshore wind farm
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned three-dimensional operation and maintenance system and method for an offshore wind farm, which comprises three operation and maintenance platforms, wherein the three operation and maintenance platforms are unmanned ships respectively, an edge calculation module is provided for supporting local target identification, track generation and data compression functions, preliminary analysis and data caching are independently completed when a network is unsmooth, the unmanned ships are used as temporary replenishment and instruction relay nodes of the unmanned ships and unmanned submarines, dynamic interaction of multi-platform collaborative tasks is supported, the unmanned ships are provided for supporting local image identification, near contact detection, fault component review and lightweight maintenance capability through a mounted mechanical arm, the unmanned submarines are provided for processing sonar and image data, a buoy uploading module and a breakpoint caching mechanism are provided, and task data are cached to a buoy and local storage when real-time connection is impossible. The invention constructs a three-dimensional intelligent operation framework integrating sea, air and water and is matched with an edge-cloud cooperative computing platform.

title_en: Multi-parameter fusion-based steam turbine variable working condition state visualization method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to a multi-parameter fusion-based steam turbine variable working condition state visualization method and a multi-parameter fusion-based steam turbine variable working condition state visualization system, which belong to the technical field of steam turbine operation and maintenance, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting multi-source heterogeneous parameter data of the steam turbine operation, wherein the multi-source heterogeneous parameters comprise process parameters and mechanical parameters; the method comprises the steps of processing multi-source heterogeneous parameter data through a data fusion algorithm, constructing a space-time correlation matrix and quantifying dynamic correlation among parameters, extracting state features based on the space-time correlation matrix and generating a state index representing the operation comprehensive state of the steam turbine, mapping the dynamic correlation among the state index and the parameters to a visual interface, wherein the visual interface comprises a graph structure for representing key parameters and correlation strength of the key parameters, and further comprises a historical state backtracking channel for supporting real-time comparison of the current operation state and the historical state. The application improves the sensing capability of the variable working condition state of the steam turbine, reduces the risk of unplanned shutdown and provides core technical support for intelligent operation and maintenance.

title_en: Quick response direct-drive type gas injector structure
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of gas injection systems and relates to a quick-response direct-drive gas injector structure, which comprises a valve body, an air inlet connector, an electromagnetic valve part, an armature component, a pressure balance valve core component, a sealing valve seat, a valve rod component, a valve sleeve and a return spring, and is characterized in that the electromagnetic valve part comprises a magnetic yoke, a coil winding and a static iron core component, the static iron core component comprises a magnetic conduction sleeve, a magnetic isolation ring, a static iron core and a first impact ring, the magnetic conduction sleeve, the magnetic isolation ring and the static iron core are fixed through welding, and the first impact ring is fixed with the static iron core component through a press fit mode; the armature component comprises an armature, a second impact ring and a valve rod, wherein the second impact ring is in press fit and fixed with the armature, and the valve rod is in interference press fit and welded and fixed with the armature. The ejector structure is used for a gas injection system, can realize quick response under high and low pressure and is reliable in sealing.

title_en: Energy-saving pump operation control method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy-saving pump operation control method and system, which relate to the field of energy-saving pump operation control and are used for reducing pump energy consumption, improving pump operation stability and ensuring that a pump is stabilized in an optimal efficiency area in most of operation time, and comprise the steps of obtaining a production plan instruction and a pipeline switching instruction sent by an upper manufacturing execution system; identifying a target pipeline number according to a pipeline switching instruction, and calling expected system resistance characteristic data corresponding to the target pipeline number from a database, calculating an initial rotation speed adjustment amount of the pump based on a production plan instruction, the expected system resistance characteristic data and a new target pressure set value, adjusting the rotation speed of the pump in stages by adopting the initial rotation speed adjustment amount and a target smooth transition curve, judging whether the current efficiency of the pump is in an optimal efficiency area or not, and if the current efficiency is not in the optimal efficiency area, finely adjusting the target smooth transition curve to guide the pump to approach to the optimal efficiency area.

title_en: Two-stage liquid ring pump with nested structure
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of liquid positive displacement machines, and particularly relates to a two-stage liquid ring pump with a nested structure, which comprises a shell, wherein a first-stage impeller and a second-stage impeller are arranged in the shell, the second-stage impeller is nested outside the first-stage impeller, a first-stage pump cavity is formed between the second-stage impeller and the first-stage impeller, a motor is arranged on one side of the shell, a driving gear is fixedly arranged on an output shaft of the motor, the driving gear is in transmission connection with the second-stage impeller sequentially through a first-stage transmission gear and a second-stage transmission gear, an end cover is arranged at one end, far away from the motor, of the shell, a distribution disc is arranged between the end cover and the shell, a first-stage pump cavity air suction hole, a first-stage pump cavity air exhaust hole, a second-stage pump cavity air suction hole and a second-stage pump cavity air exhaust hole are arranged on the distribution disc, and a plurality of rib plates are arranged in the end cover. The device can reduce flow resistance and energy loss and prevent the phenomenon of shaft hole backflow.

title_en: Circulating pump control method based on PLC
abstract_en: The invention discloses a circulating pump control method based on a PLC (programmable logic controller), which relates to the technical field of circulating pump control and comprises the steps of collecting key working condition data of a circulating pump, calculating a flow instantaneous deviation value, inputting the deviation and the real-time key working condition data into a lightweight digital twin model embedded in the PLC together, predicting flow output under ideal working conditions, comparing the flow output with an actual value to obtain a deviation factor, correcting a current PID (proportion integration differentiation) parameter based on the deviation factor, calculating a target output frequency by combining the flow deviation, and scheduling a current optimal pump set and a corresponding frequency by combining the target output frequency, health indexes and operation time of each pump by the PLC, and executing soft start and stop control to start a selected pump set smoothly one by one. The invention solves the problems of response lag and rough scheduling of the traditional control method, and remarkably improves the intelligent control level and engineering adaptability of the circulating pump control method.

title_en: Industrial centrifugal ventilator
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of conveying equipment, and particularly relates to an industrial centrifugal ventilator which comprises a dust cleaning mechanism, a low-resistance separating mechanism and a fan shell, wherein the dust cleaning mechanism comprises a sliding cabin, the sliding cabin is assembled in a functional shell in a sliding mode, rotating arm rods are assembled on two sides of the top of one end of the sliding cabin in a rotating mode, sliding arm rods are assembled on two sides of the bottom of one end of the sliding cabin in a sliding mode, dust cleaning brushes for cleaning impellers are assembled at the tail ends of the rotating arm rods and the sliding arm rods in a rotating mode, the low-resistance separating mechanism comprises curved guide plates and guide separating plates, the number of the curved guide plates is the same as that of the guide separating plates, the curved guide plates are assembled on the bottom side in the fan shell in a rotating mode, and are used for guiding part of air flow to the inner sides of the corresponding guide separating plates, and then the air flow is collected into main air flow again after solid-air separation is completed on the inner sides of the guide separating plates. The dust removing device can complete dust removing work on all blades of the impeller without disassembling a precursor of the device, and meanwhile, dust separation is realized through an internal low-resistance separation mechanism, so that the influence of dust particles on the device is weakened.

title_en: Blower with user presence detection
abstract_en: A blower and a method of operating a blower are provided. The blower includes a main body, an air duct extending between an air inlet and an air outlet opposite the air inlet, the air duct including an air duct body, a motor for driving a fan disposed in the air duct body between the air inlet and the air outlet, and a handle coupled to the air duct and including a sensor. The sensor is configured to detect an engaged state of the operator engaging the handle and a disengaged state of the operator disengaging the handle. The blower also includes a controller operatively coupled to the sensor and the motor.

title_en: Improved pressure adapter for hydraulic system
abstract_en: A pressure adapter (100) comprising a first assembly and a second assembly rotatable relative to each other about a main shaft, the first assembly comprising a housing (10) and a cam (20), the second assembly comprising a cylinder (30) having a plurality of pockets (40) in which a piston (50) slides, each piston (50) being positioned in a pocket (40), characterized in that each pairing formed by a piston (50) and a pocket (40) defines a first chamber (60) and a second chamber (70) separate from each other between the piston (50) and the pocket (40), the first chamber (60) and the second chamber (70) defining different displacements, wherein the assembly of the first chamber (60) acts as a hydraulic motor (110) adapted to be connected to a supply source supplying a first flow rate Q1 at a first pressure P1, and the assembly of the second chamber (70) acts as a hydraulic pump (120) adapted to rotate relative to each other, adapted to deliver a second flow rate Q2 at a second pressure P2.

title_en: Liquid rocket engine ignition condition judging method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a liquid rocket engine ignition condition judging method which specifically comprises the following steps of 1, selecting monitoring parameters, 2, determining engine ignition conditions, 3, collecting data, 4, processing the data, 5, judging the satisfaction of the ignition conditions, and 6, outputting judging results. The method can improve interpretation efficiency, enhance interpretation consistency, improve ignition reliability and reduce labor cost. The invention also discloses a device for judging the ignition condition of the liquid rocket engine.

title_en: Cold screen structure in vacuum cavity for nuclear fusion device and hoisting method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of nuclear fusion devices, and discloses a cold screen structure in a vacuum cavity of a nuclear fusion device and a hoisting method. The cold screen structure comprises a first reinforcing annular plate, an upper cold screen and an intermediate cold screen, wherein the first reinforcing annular plate, the upper cold screen and the intermediate cold screen are overlapped from inside to outside and are connected through first bolts, a second reinforcing annular plate, a lower cold screen and the intermediate cold screen are overlapped from inside to outside and are connected through second bolts, a third reinforcing annular plate is overlapped and arranged on the inner side of the upper part of the upper cold screen, an inner flanging of the third reinforcing annular plate is fixed on the top inner surface of the upper cold screen through a third bolt, low-temperature coils are welded on the upper cold screen and the lower cold screen, the intermediate cold screen is surrounded by at least 4 cold screen plates, the upper ends of a plurality of hoisting mechanisms are fixed with a top plate of a vacuum cavity, and the lower ends of the hoisting mechanisms are connected with the upper cold screen and the inner flanging in an adiabatic manner. The invention is suitable for the cold screen of the current lead tank of the nuclear fusion device with larger size, has high installation precision, high deformation control precision, small heat leakage, small stress and deformation after cold shrinkage and convenient maintenance of the internal parts of the cold screen.

title_en: Detection control device, detection control method and neutron tube system for petroleum well logging
abstract_en: The invention discloses a detection control device, a detection control method and a neutron tube system in petroleum logging, wherein the detection control device comprises a radio frequency power supply, an impedance matching module, a filtering module, a current detection module and a control module; the device comprises a radio frequency electrode, a radio frequency power supply, a current detection module, a filtering module, a control module and a control module, wherein the radio frequency electrode is used for providing radio frequency energy to the radio frequency electrode to enable working gas in an ion source in the neutron generator to generate plasma, the current detection module is used for providing direct current voltage to the radio frequency electrode and detecting direct current information flowing through the radio frequency electrode, the filtering module is used for preventing the radio frequency energy from entering the current detection module and preventing direct current from entering the radio frequency power supply, and the control module is used for controlling output power of the radio frequency power supply according to the direct current information. The invention provides a detection control device, a detection control method and a neutron tube system of petroleum logging, which can acquire the density of plasma in a neutron generator in real time, provide stable and reliable feedback signals for the output power control of a radio frequency power supply, and ensure the stability of neutron output.

title_en: Icing monitoring method for fan blade and related device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an icing monitoring method for a fan blade and a related device, which comprise the steps of obtaining real-time operation data of a target fan and real-time monitoring image data of the blade, inputting the real-time operation data and the real-time monitoring image data of the blade into a dynamic performance monitoring model to obtain real-time output power of the target fan, calculating an error value of the real-time output power and the actual power of the target fan, triggering performance degradation alarm when the error value exceeds a preset threshold value, inputting operation data of the target fan in a corresponding period of time into a pre-trained isolated forest model after the performance degradation alarm is triggered, and detecting abnormality of a tip speed ratio and a pitch angle of the target fan.

title_en: Switching device and lubricating pump
abstract_en: A switching device for alternately connecting lines of a hydraulic drive of a lubrication pump to pressure lines and return lines of a hydraulic circuit, comprising hydraulic lines connected to the lines of the hydraulic drive and further hydraulic lines connected to the pressure lines and the return lines, a switching valve configured to interact with the hydraulic lines such that in a first switching state of the switching device at least a first one of the lines of the hydraulic drive is connectable to the pressure lines and in a second switching state of the switching device at least a second one of the lines of the hydraulic drive is connectable to the pressure lines, a hydraulic control unit comprising hydraulic control lines, wherein at least a first one of the control lines is connectable to the pressure lines, the second one of the control lines being configured to switch the lines such that the switching valve is switchable between the first switching state and the second switching state by means of them, the hydraulic lines being conductive for hydraulic fluid of different volume flows than the control lines.

title_en: Fixing device for transportation of wind power generation blades
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fixing device for transporting wind power generation blades, which relates to the field of wind power generation technical equipment and facilities, and comprises a vehicle plate and wind power generation blades, wherein the vehicle plate and the wind power generation blades are fixedly connected through the fixing device; the inside of the connecting belt is provided with a fluid composed of dielectric particles and insulating liquid, the characteristics that the fluid is the fluid in a normal state, the electric wire is instantly solidified into a quasi-solid after being electrified, and the soft state is recovered after the electric wire is powered off are utilized, so that the state of the connecting belt can be changed, the acting force between the wind power generation blade and the sweep plate is adjusted, the probability of resonance between the wind power generation blade and the sweep plate is reduced, and the reliability of the fixing device is improved.

title_en: Variable unloading force steam turbine regulating valve and working method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power generation of turbines of thermal power generating units, and particularly discloses a variable unloading force turbine regulating valve and a working method thereof, aiming at newly designing a regulating valve structure so as to solve the problems of vibration, abnormal sound and load fluctuation caused by valve disc suspension. According to the invention, the valve sleeve of the conventional steam turbine regulating valve structure is provided with the pressure balance hole, and the valve disc is provided with the control unloading structure, so that the pressure of a cavity between the valve disc and the valve sleeve during the valve parameter adjustment is improved, the downward steam force on the valve disc is increased, the unloading force under the valve parameter adjustment working condition is reduced, the valve disc is tightly pressed on the valve rod, and the valve disc is prevented from suspending. The invention solves the defect problem caused by valve disc suspension, thereby improving the economy and reliability of the unit.

title_en: Double-rail gravity energy storage power station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-rail gravity energy storage power station, and belongs to the field of energy application. The gravity block storage device mainly comprises a plurality of gravity block storage layers, wherein an outer rail and an inner rail which are parallel to each other are paved on each layer of telescopic gravity block storage layer, vertical elevator shafts are arranged on two sides of the gravity block storage layer, vertical rails are arranged in the vertical elevator shafts, telescopic arc-shaped rails are arranged on the inner rails, gravity blocks are stored in the gravity block storage layers, outer rail vehicles are arranged on the outer rails, inner rail vehicles are arranged on the inner rails, and the gravity block storage layers can travel onto the inner rails through the arc-shaped rails. According to the invention, the steering operation between the horizontal direction and the vertical direction is realized through the telescopic arc-shaped track, the internal and external travelling crane can finish the gravity block handover in the air, the gravity block descent can continue to generate electricity and feed back to the power grid, the problems of serious redundancy, complex system, low efficiency and high cost of the traditional vertical gravity energy storage equipment are solved, and the structure is simplified, the efficiency is improved and the cost is reduced.

title_en: Solar energy and process waste heat driven temperature control method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a temperature control method and a temperature control system driven by solar energy and process waste heat. The method comprises the steps of collecting solar energy, utilizing the solar energy as refrigerating energy input of a system, collecting process waste heat energy, generating electric energy by using process gas through kalina circulation to drive a compressor, or directly absorbing by adopting ammonia water, and utilizing the solar energy and/or the process waste heat energy to provide a low-temperature cold source for controlling the temperature of an air cooler or a water cooler so as to realize accurate control of the outlet temperature of the air cooler or the water cooler. The invention can improve the system stability, the safe production and the energy-saving and emission-reducing effects of the industrial process.

title_en: Water jet water source supply system and control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water jet water source supply system and a control method, comprising a main body frame, wherein the main body frame is provided with a winder, a water pump system and a control system, the winder is of a coaxial parallel double-drum structure, the winder is driven by a servo motor, double drums are respectively wound on a high-pressure water pipe and a control cable, the water pipe and the cable which are synchronous with the movement speed of a water source supply robot are realized through the rotation of the drums of the winder, the upper end of the main body frame is provided with a driven wheel group which is in rolling fit with a guide rail, and the guide rail is also provided with a patrol robot connected with one side of the main body frame.

title_en: Piston structure of internal combustion engine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pistons of internal combustion engines, and provides a piston structure of an internal combustion engine, which comprises a piston, wherein the piston is provided with a ring groove for installing gas rings or oil rings, at least two gas rings and at least one oil ring are sequentially sleeved outside the piston from top to bottom, the uppermost gas ring is a totally-enclosed piston ring, a back pressure hole is formed in the ring groove between the uppermost gas ring and the uppermost oil ring, the back pressure hole is used for communicating the outer side of the piston with a connecting rod cavity on the inner side of the piston, the back pressure hole is formed in the ring groove between the uppermost gas ring and the uppermost oil ring and is used for communicating the outer side of the piston with the connecting rod cavity by arranging the uppermost totally-enclosed gas ring, the initial sealing performance of the piston and a cylinder wall is improved, the oil backflow is realized so as to reduce the problems of oil channeling and oil burning, and simultaneously high-pressure back pressure in a power stroke is quickly released.

title_en: Two-stroke engine with lubrication deficiency detection
abstract_en: A crankcase scavenged two-stroke engine (200, 900) includes a cylinder wall (260) having an intake port (250) and an exhaust port (251). Wherein the engine (200, 900) is associated with an idle operation mode and an active operation mode, wherein a rotational speed (ωω) of the engine (200, 900) is higher in the active operation mode than in the idle operation mode, the engine (200, 900) comprising at least one engine vibration sensor (270) arranged to sense vibrations of the engine (200, 900) and to output an engine vibration signal (275), and a control unit (280) configured to detect a lubrication deficiency in the engine (200, 900) based on the engine vibration signal (275), wherein the condition of the control unit (280) for the lubrication deficiency detection is that the engine (200, 900) is operated in the active operation mode.

title_en: Gas engine exhaust system and transient torque broadcasting method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a gas engine exhaust system which comprises an exhaust manifold, a one-cylinder ignition coil, a two-cylinder ignition coil, a three-cylinder ignition coil, an air inlet manifold, an air inlet throttle valve, a gas metering valve, an intelligent control module, a four-cylinder ignition coil, a five-cylinder ignition coil, a six-cylinder ignition coil, a crankshaft rotation speed sensor, a six-cylinder exhaust temperature sensor, a five-cylinder exhaust temperature sensor, a rear exhaust pressure sensor, a four-cylinder exhaust temperature sensor, a three-cylinder exhaust temperature sensor, a front exhaust pressure sensor, a two-cylinder exhaust temperature sensor, a one-cylinder exhaust temperature sensor and a control line. According to the invention, the torque broadcast of the gas engine is corrected and an accurate torque value is broadcast, so that the automatic gearbox is convenient to match, and the problems of gear shifting setback and vehicle shake are reduced.

title_en: Pile foundation structure for offshore wind turbine tower
abstract_en: The invention provides a pile foundation structure for a pole tower of an offshore wind turbine, which belongs to the technical field of offshore wind turbines and comprises a pile foundation cylinder with an axis extending along the vertical direction and a filling pile fixedly arranged at the bottom of the pile foundation cylinder, wherein the pile foundation cylinder and the filling pile are coaxially arranged, the filling pile comprises a pile cylinder, the outer wall of the pile cylinder is fixedly provided with a plurality of support fins extending along the axis direction of the pile cylinder, the plurality of support fins are uniformly distributed along the circumferential direction of the pile cylinder, the outer wall of the pile foundation cylinder is in sliding sleeve joint with a protection cylinder, the outer wall of the pile foundation cylinder is fixedly sleeve joint with a fixed pressing sheet, the fixed pressing sheet is positioned above the protection cylinder and used for limiting the movement of the protection cylinder along the axis direction of the protection cylinder, the bottom of the outer wall of the protection cylinder is fixedly sleeve joint with a protection frame, the protection frame comprises a fixed disc coaxially arranged with the protection cylinder, and the bottom of the fixed disc is fixedly provided with two groups of protection pieces, so that the pile foundation cylinder is prevented from sinking and tilting due to geological change after the pile foundation structure is used for a long time.

title_en: Screw compressor and slide valve thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a screw compressor and a slide valve thereof, wherein the slide valve comprises a valve body which is cylindrical and extends in the axial direction, a pressure discharge surface matched with the peripheral outline of a rotor of the screw compressor is arranged on the side surface of the valve body, a discharge hole is arranged at the end part of the pressure discharge surface in the axial direction, a slide block is arranged in the discharge hole and can slide along the radial direction of the valve body, the shape of the outer edge of the slide block is matched with the shape of the pressure discharge surface, and a spring is connected with the slide block and is configured to drive the slide block to slide to the position of the outer edge of the slide block which is flush with the pressure discharge surface. Through above-mentioned slide valve structure, can adjust the discharge position of compressed working medium, change interior volume ratio, realize the matching of internal pressure and external pressure when compression is finished, reduce extra consumption loss, improve the operating efficiency of compressor, can reduce the noise that the pressure mismatch produced simultaneously.

title_en: Single-cylinder rotor aeroengine torque detection method
abstract_en: The invention provides a single-cylinder rotor aeroengine torque detection method, which relates to the technical field of aeroengines, and comprises the following steps of 2, acquiring airflow flow and pressure coupling signals flowing through a valve body in real time during the operation of an engine based on a dynamic pressure sensing hole and a one-way pressure valve, and acquiring original flow time sequence data; and 3, carrying out multidimensional feature analysis on the original flow time sequence data to obtain a plurality of process parameters with inherent relevance, quantifying the cooperative relationship of different parameter change directions by calculating the included angle of tangents of a process parameter change track curve at a feature point, analyzing steady state and transient response characteristics based on the cooperative relationship, and establishing a parameterized correction rule to generate a corresponding correction parameter set. According to the invention, the accuracy and reliability of real-time torque monitoring of the single-cylinder rotor engine under complex working conditions are improved by acquiring and processing the flow signals reflecting the working states of the compression cavities in the engine.

title_en: Integrated dual-mode water pump
abstract_en: The invention relates to an integrated dual-mode water pump which comprises a shell, a transmission mechanism, a low-pressure pump unit, a plunger pump unit and a pump body vibration reduction assembly, wherein the transmission mechanism comprises a gear transmission assembly arranged in a transmission mechanism installation cavity of the shell, the pump wheel is rotatably arranged in a low-pressure pump installation cavity of the shell through a driving shaft, the driving shaft is connected to a first power output shaft of the gear transmission assembly through a first clutch, the plunger pump unit comprises a plunger pump cylinder body arranged in a plunger pump installation cavity of the shell, a transmission shaft of the plunger pump cylinder body is connected to a second power output shaft of the gear transmission assembly through a second clutch, the pump body vibration reduction assembly comprises a vibration absorber arranged in a vibration reduction cavity of the shell, and annular vibration absorbers sleeved on the driving shaft and the periphery of the transmission shaft are fixedly connected to two sides of the vibration absorber respectively. The invention can integrate the low-pressure pump unit and the high-pressure pump unit into a whole effectively, and can maintain the running stability of the equipment after integration effectively.

title_en: Lifting and uncovering integrated container transfer device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lifting and uncovering integrated container transferring device, which belongs to the technical field of transportation and comprises a moving platform, a driving unit, a rotating shaft and a transmission box, wherein the moving platform is provided with a lifting frame used for bearing a container, the driving unit is arranged on the moving platform and used for controlling lifting of the lifting frame, the upper end of the rotating shaft is connected with a cover of the bearing container, the transmission box is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the moving platform, the rotating shaft is connected with the output end of the transmission box, the input end of the transmission box is connected with a starting assembly, and the starting assembly can generate input torque and transmit power to the rotating shaft through the transmission box. The lifting and uncovering integrated container transfer device can carry out linkage control on the opening and closing actions of the cover and the lifting actions of the container through the same set of driving components, so that a coherent and automatic operation sequence is formed between the opening and closing actions and the lifting actions of the container, sequential interference is fundamentally avoided, the equipment structure is simplified, and the transfer efficiency is improved.

title_en: Air flow regulating valve for combustion chamber of gas turbine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of gas turbines, in particular to an air flow regulating valve of a combustion chamber of a gas turbine, which is arranged between a combustion chamber casing and a flame tube, wherein the regulating valve comprises a regulating unit and a communicating unit, an internal channel of the communicating unit is communicated with an air inlet of the flame tube in a sealing way to form a transmission space pointing to the flame tube from the side of the combustion chamber casing, the flux of the transmission space is regulated by the regulating unit, the communicating unit comprises a valve flange connected with the flame tube in a flange manner, the other end of the valve flange is fixedly connected with a valve switching section, the other end of the valve switching section is provided with an air inlet runner, and one end of the valve switching section far away from the valve flange is fixedly connected with the air inlet runner. According to the invention, the air distribution ratio in the combustion chamber can be actively regulated according to the working condition change of the gas turbine, different combustion demands under high and low working conditions are adapted, and the stable working boundary of the low-emission combustion chamber is effectively widened.

title_en: Air filter device
abstract_en: The invention provides an air filter device which comprises a base shell and a filter medium body, wherein the base shell consists of a 匚 type cover body and a lower cover plate, the 匚 type cover body comprises an upper cover plate, a front side plate and a rear side plate, the 匚 type cover body forms outflow sides for outputting fluid to be filtered on the left side and the right side, the filter medium body comprises two zigzag folded air filter elements which are respectively arranged on the left side and the right side of the 匚 type cover body and the lower cover plate, the air filter elements are transversely intercepted on the outflow sides, the base shell is made into an inner box structure, the upper cover plate is correspondingly provided with a flange plate for forming a channel opening, the flange plate is used for separating an outer exhaust side from an inner filter space, so that fluid to be filtered is only allowed to be input into the filter space along the channel opening, and the filtered fluid is output to an outer clean side along the outflow side through the air filter elements, so that the effective filter area is increased, and dust holding capacity and service life of the filter elements are improved.

title_en: Hybrid nuclear energy system
abstract_en: The application provides a hybrid nuclear energy system comprising a fusion core adapted to radiate fusion products, cladding means arranged around the fusion core to receive the fusion products, the cladding means being adapted to contain cladding material comprising fissile material, a fuel circuit connected to the cladding means, the cladding material being adapted to circulate within the cladding means and the fuel circuit, a heat exchange module adapted to contain heat exchange material, at least part of the fuel circuit being located within the heat exchange module or at least part of the heat exchange module being located within the cladding means, and a cooling circuit connected to the heat exchange module, the heat exchange material circulating in the heat exchange module and the cooling circuit and being in heat exchange with the cladding material. The application provides a hybrid nuclear energy system which can improve the energy gain factor of the system and has stronger reliability and safety.

title_en: Guide vane opening monitoring device for water turbine
abstract_en: The application relates to a guide vane opening monitoring device for a water turbine, which comprises a movable rod, a position sensor and a connecting mechanism, wherein the position sensor is provided with an assembly part, the movable rod is arranged on the assembly part and can axially reciprocate along the assembly part, a monitoring head of the position sensor is used for monitoring the position information of the movable rod, the connecting mechanism is arranged on the part of the movable rod protruding out of the position sensor, and the connecting mechanism is used for being connected with a push-pull mechanism. Compared with the prior art, the guide vane opening monitoring device for the water turbine can indirectly monitor the guide vane opening of the water turbine by monitoring the position information of the displacement rod, so that the interference of sundries such as greasy dirt or dust in the environment on a monitoring result is avoided, and the monitoring precision of the guide vane opening is further improved.

title_en: Tripod head equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a holder device, and belongs to the technical field of shooting. The cradle head equipment comprises an equipment main body, a lens assembly and a memory metal piece, wherein the equipment main body is provided with a containing groove, the lens assembly comprises a camera shooting module and a cradle head assembly, the camera shooting module is connected with the equipment main body through the cradle head assembly, the lens assembly can move relative to the equipment main body so that at least part of the lens assembly can be positioned in the containing groove, the memory metal piece is connected with the lens assembly, and the memory metal piece drives the lens assembly to extend out of the containing groove under the condition that the memory metal piece is electrified.

title_en: Exhaust gas monitoring system and exhaust gas monitoring method
abstract_en: An exhaust gas monitoring system and an exhaust gas monitoring method are provided. The exhaust gas monitoring system includes an exhaust gas purification device that purifies exhaust gas discharged from an engine, a first sensor that detects an amount of nitrogen oxides contained in the exhaust gas that has passed through the exhaust gas purification device, a display device that presents information to a user of a vehicle, and a management device. The management device determines that an abnormality has occurred in a component contained in the exhaust gas when the first sensor detects an amount of nitrogen oxides equal to or greater than a threshold value. In the exhaust gas monitoring system, the management device displays the travelable distance, which is the distance up to the predetermined distance from the travel distance after the abnormality is determined to have occurred, on the display device. When the engine is stopped in a state where the distance to be travelled is zero, the management device prohibits the start of the engine even if an operation for starting the engine is performed.

title_en: Sparsity triggered local fluctuation scattered entropy fan blade fault diagnosis method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fan blade fault detection and discloses a sparsity triggered local fluctuation dispersion entropy fan blade fault diagnosis method, which comprises the steps of collecting vibration signals of a fan blade and preprocessing the vibration signals; calculating the time domain sparsity of the preprocessed vibration signal, comparing the time domain sparsity with a first dynamic threshold, locating the impact center moment in the vibration signal if the time domain sparsity is larger than or equal to the first dynamic threshold, intercepting a local signal section by taking the impact center moment as the center, calculating the local fluctuation dispersion entropy of the local signal section, comparing the local fluctuation dispersion entropy with a second dynamic threshold, judging that the fan blade has faults if the local fluctuation dispersion entropy is smaller than the second dynamic threshold, and outputting a fault sign. The invention can effectively distinguish real damage from wind turbulence noise under the conditions of single sensor and no prior model, and improves diagnosis precision.

title_en: Device suitable for radioactive material melting ingot casting in glove box
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application relates to the field of metal remelting, in particular to a device suitable for radioactive material melting ingot casting. The device suitable for the radioactive material melting ingot casting in the glove box comprises a body, a melting assembly, an ingot forming assembly, a cooling assembly, a vacuumizing assembly and a conveying assembly, wherein the melting assembly is fixedly connected with the body, radioactive materials are input into the melting assembly for melting, the ingot forming assembly is fixedly connected with the body, radioactive materials in a molten state flow out of the melting assembly and flow into the ingot forming assembly, ingot is formed in the ingot forming assembly, the cooling assembly cools the ingot forming assembly, the vacuumizing assembly is arranged on the outer side of the body and vacuumizes the melting assembly, the conveying assembly is fixedly connected with the body and communicated with a material outlet of the glove box, so that the radioactive materials are transferred from the ingot forming assembly to the conveying assembly after being formed into ingots by the ingot forming assembly, and are conveyed to the material outlet of the glove box by the conveying assembly, and the operation risk is reduced.

title_en: Wind generating set rotating speed stability control method and system based on far and near wind speeds
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind generating set rotating speed stability control method and system based on far and near wind speeds, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a near point wind speed signal and a far point wind speed signal in front of an impeller of a wind generating set through a laser radar, enabling a measuring distance of the near point wind speed signal to be fixed, enabling the measuring distance of the far point wind speed signal to be dynamically and adaptively determined according to real-time wind conditions of a wind field, then dynamically calculating a near point weight coefficient and a far point weight coefficient, carrying out weighted fusion on the near point wind speed signal and the far point wind speed signal to obtain a fusion wind speed and obtain a fusion wind speed change rate, obtaining a feedforward gain coefficient based on an empirical method, calculating a blade angle feedforward superposition amount, superposing the blade angle feedforward superposition amount with a traditional feedback control output signal, and generating a blade angle command to control. The invention does not need an accurate wind field model, has simple and convenient parameter setting, can effectively inhibit rotation speed fluctuation, reduce power pulsation, reduce pitch frequency, improve the running stability of the unit and is suitable for complex turbulence wind conditions.

title_en: Eccentric screw pump
abstract_en: The invention relates to an eccentric screw pump having a spiral rotor and a stator made of an elastomer material, in which the rotor rotates and forms a plurality of pump chambers, wherein the stator is vulcanization-mounted into a preferably metallic support tube, wherein the stator has at least one sensor which is connected inseparably to the stator, i.e. vulcanization-mounted into the stator.

title_en: Baffle structure, rotor assembly and compressor
abstract_en: The invention provides a baffle structure, a rotor assembly and a compressor, relates to the technical field of compressors, and solves the technical problem that mixed fluid of refrigerating oil and a refrigerant in the prior art is easy to pass through an air gap channel to be discharged out of the compressor, so that the oil discharge rate of the compressor exceeds the standard. The baffle structure, the rotor assembly and the compressor comprise a fixed base, a movable baffle and a movable baffle, wherein the fixed base is arranged on a rotor iron core, a through hole is formed in the fixed base, the movable baffle is arranged above the through hole, and the middle part of the movable baffle is rotatably arranged on the fixed base so that the movable baffle can swing radially along the rotor iron core. The baffle structure, the rotor assembly and the compressor are used for reducing the oil discharge rate, ensuring the oil level in the compressor and ensuring the lubrication effect so as to further improve the heat exchange efficiency, the air conditioner energy efficiency and the operation reliability.

title_en: Nuclear power plant accident diagnosis method, device, medium and equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a nuclear power plant accident diagnosis method, a device, a medium and equipment, which comprise the following steps of S10, S20, S30, S40, analyzing the current state and the historical state of a unit in real time according to the current working condition parameters and the historical data before the unit jumps to obtain an accident diagnosis result, wherein the step S10 is used for obtaining the current working condition parameters and the current state signals, the step S20 is used for judging whether a jump signal is triggered according to the current state signals, the step S30 is used for obtaining the historical data before the jump if the jump is carried out, and the step S40 is used for obtaining the accident diagnosis result. The invention carries out accident diagnosis based on the state change of the machine set after the accident and adopts the time sequence characteristic, solves the defect that the accident is diagnosed only by adopting the current state of the machine set in the prior art, reduces the risk of misdiagnosis, and can give consideration to the large transient accident triggered immediately by a protection system and the accident diagnosis with relatively mild transient accident. In addition, the invention adopts a secondary diagnosis method, so that the accident category can be given out early, and specific accidents can be given out through the subsequent change of the unit state.

title_en: Leak-proof shaft-seal-free magnetic drive pump
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of magnetic pumps, and discloses a leakage-proof shaft-seal-free magnetic drive pump, which comprises a front cover and a rear cover, wherein an excitation winding is arranged in the rear cover, an inner magnetic frame and a plurality of permanent magnets are rotationally arranged in the front cover, one end of the inner magnetic frame is fixedly connected with an impeller, an isolation sleeve is arranged between the inner magnetic frame and the excitation winding, a cavity is arranged on the outer wall of the isolation sleeve, a temperature sensor is arranged in the cavity, a resistance wire coil, a sliding rod electrically connected with the excitation winding, an elastic sliding sheet slidingly connected between the sliding rod and the resistance wire coil, a clamping mechanism for clamping the sliding rod and a jacking mechanism for pushing the elastic sliding sheet are arranged on the rear cover. When the temperature detected by the temperature sensor reaches a first threshold value, the current is locked to prevent the impact deformation of the isolation sleeve caused by the increase of the pump speed, and when the temperature detected reaches a second threshold value, the pump is forced to stop, so that more serious consequences are avoided.

title_en: Method, system and medium for separating and disposing double redundant cold standby liquid cooling pump instructions of airplane
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of aviation aircraft design, and particularly relates to a method, a system and a medium for separating and disposing double redundant cold standby liquid cooling pump instructions of an aircraft, wherein the system comprises a liquid cooling pump, a radiator and a controller, the liquid cooling pump comprises a liquid cooling pump 1 and a liquid cooling pump 2, inlets of the liquid cooling pump 1 and the liquid cooling pump 2 are connected with liquid cooling equipment, outlets of the liquid cooling pump 1 and the liquid cooling pump 2 are connected with the radiator, the radiator is connected with the liquid cooling equipment, the controller comprises a controller A and a controller B, the controller A and the controller B are respectively connected with the liquid cooling pump 1 and the liquid cooling pump 2 in a one-to-one correspondence manner, and the controller A and the controller B are connected with the liquid cooling equipment; the time service device is connected with the controller A and the controller B respectively. According to the invention, the fault autonomous handling method is designed in a bottom-up mode, the actual rotating speed state of the redundancy ring-controlled liquid cooling pump is uploaded to the corresponding controller and information is transmitted to each other, fault monitoring logic is designed according to the state, the ring-controlled liquid cooling pumps are restarted according to the faults, the ring-controlled liquid cooling pump states in all controllers are unified, the system control logic and software complexity are simplified, the system reliability is improved with extremely low cost, a large number of software testing work and interface coordination work are reduced, and the risk of logic defects of software is reduced.

title_en: Pump unit, in particular for delivering a pressure medium in a brake circuit of an electronically slip-adjustable brake system of a motor vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a pump unit (10) for delivering a pressure medium in a brake circuit of an electronically slip-adjustable brake system of a motor vehicle. The known pump unit (10) has a pump cylinder 12 in which a pump piston (14) is arranged that can be driven for a reciprocating movement. The pump piston (14) and the pump cylinder (12) together form a pump working chamber (16), into which the pressure medium flows under the control of an inlet valve (20) and out under the control of an outlet valve (22). The outlet valve (22) comprises an outlet valve sealing seat (34) and an outlet valve closing member (24) cooperating therewith, which is operated by an outlet valve spring (86). The outlet valve (22) has a valve seat contour (28) which is formed by two concentric conical bores (30, 32) which merge into one another and have conical angles of different sizes, wherein an outlet valve sealing seat (34) which cooperates with the outlet valve closing element (24) is arranged at the first conical bore (30) whose conical angle is smaller than the conical angle of the second conical bore (32).

title_en: Wind energy and wave energy integrated power generation platform resistant to wind and anti-toppling method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-wind energy and wave energy integrated power generation platform and an anti-toppling method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of ocean power generation engineering. The power generation platform comprises a floating body platform, a wind power generation assembly, a wave power generation device, a wind resistance stabilizing mechanism and an electric energy collection and storage unit, wherein the wind power generation assembly is arranged at the upper part of the floating body platform, the wave power generation device is arranged at the periphery of the floating body platform on the water surface, the wind resistance stabilizing mechanism is connected to the bottom of the floating body platform and extends to the preset depth under water, the electric energy collection and storage unit is integrated inside the floating body platform and is respectively and electrically connected with the wind power generation assembly and the wave power generation device, and the wind power generation assembly and the wave power generation device are used for capturing wind energy and wave energy in a cooperative mode and converting the wind energy and the wave energy into electric energy, and the electric energy is output after being integrated through the electric energy collection and storage unit. The platform organically integrates a fan, a wave energy device and a small ocean platform structure, and synchronously develops two ocean clean energy sources on a single platform.

title_en: Geothermal energy system and method for coupling hydroelectric power generation
