abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of energy utilization, and relates to a geothermal energy system and a geothermal energy method for coupling hydroelectric power generation. The geothermal energy collecting and circulating unit comprises a water supply pipeline, a geothermal well water inlet pipeline, a geothermal well heat exchange structure and a geothermal utilization end which are sequentially connected, wherein the geothermal well heat exchange structure comprises a sleeve arranged in an underground soil layer, a water injection channel and an outlet channel connected with the water injection channel are arranged in the sleeve, the geothermal well water inlet pipeline is communicated with an inlet of the water injection channel, the geothermal utilization end is communicated with an outlet of the outlet channel, the embedded hydroelectric generation unit comprises at least one power generation module, the power generation module comprises turbine blades and a hydroelectric generator, the turbine blades are arranged in the water injection channel, and the turbine blades are connected with the hydroelectric generator. The invention realizes in-situ coupling and cascade utilization of geothermal energy and hydroelectric power generation, and remarkably improves the comprehensive energy yield of unit water resources and the overall energy efficiency of the system.

title_en: Powder metallurgy aluminum-based vortex plate and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of powder metallurgy, in particular to a powder metallurgy aluminum-based vortex plate and a preparation method thereof. The aluminum-based vortex plate is manufactured by the method. The method comprises the steps of filling powder in a mould, pressing to obtain an aluminum-based movable scroll powder blank and an aluminum-based fixed scroll powder blank, sintering the aluminum-based movable scroll powder blank and the aluminum-based fixed scroll powder blank to obtain an aluminum-based movable scroll sintered blank and an aluminum-based fixed scroll sintered blank, and sequentially carrying out shaping treatment and heat treatment on the aluminum-based movable scroll sintered blank and the aluminum-based fixed scroll sintered blank to obtain the aluminum-based movable scroll and the aluminum-based fixed scroll. The method can simplify the working procedures and reduce the production cost, and the prepared aluminum-based scroll has good forming effect, good strength and wear resistance, and good lubricating effect when the aluminum-based movable scroll and the aluminum-based fixed scroll are assembled and applied.

title_en: Unmanned submarine vehicle underwater charging station for wave energy power generation
abstract_en: The invention provides an unmanned underwater vehicle underwater charging station for wave energy power generation, which takes a floating platform arranged in open sea as a basis of the whole device, captures wave energy through vertical movement of a floater, transmits the wave energy to a rack fixed at the bottom of the floater, further passes through a mechanical power generation system, converts the vertical movement mechanical energy of the floater into high-speed rotation mechanical energy through a gear-rack transmission mechanism and a speed change reversing mechanism, converts the high-speed rotation mechanical energy into electric energy through a permanent magnet synchronous generator, stores the electric energy into a storage battery through an electric energy conversion device, and transmits the electric energy to a charging dock arranged under the floating platform, wherein the inside of the charging dock is used for capturing the unmanned underwater vehicle through a hydraulic lifting system, positioning and clamping the unmanned underwater vehicle, and finally transmits the electric energy stored in the storage battery to the unmanned vehicle needing to be supplemented with the electric energy through an underwater wireless charging system.

title_en: Wind generating set
abstract_en: The application provides a wind generating set, and relates to the technical field of wind power equipment. On the premise of ensuring transmission efficiency and reliability, the length of a transmission chain and the total mass of the tower top can be effectively shortened, and the requirements of reducing the cost of the transmission chain system and the tower foundation are met. The wind generating set comprises a hub, a generator and a gear box, wherein an opening is formed in the hub, at least part of the generator is located outside the hub and located on one side, close to the opening, of the hub, at least part of the gear box is located in the hub, a first transmission connecting portion and a second transmission connecting portion are arranged on the gear box, the first transmission connecting portion and the second transmission connecting portion are respectively in transmission connection with the hub and the generator, and the first transmission connecting portion is located in the hub and located at one end, close to the opening, of the gear box. The wind generating set is used for effectively shortening the length of a transmission chain and the total mass of the tower top.

title_en: Supercritical carbon dioxide power generation system sealed by dry gas and operation method thereof
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a supercritical carbon dioxide power generation system adopting dry gas sealing and an operation method thereof, wherein the system comprises a main circulation loop, a dry gas sealing loop and a bypass loop, wherein the main circulation loop comprises a booster pump, a heater, a storage tank, a compressor, a heat regenerator, a main heat exchanger, a turbine, a precooler and a generator which are sequentially connected; the dry gas sealing loop is independently provided with a sealing gas heater, a filter and a storage tank, and the bypass loop is provided with a compressor anti-surge valve and a turbine bypass valve. The operation method comprises the steps of filling working media through starting a booster pump and a heater, supplying sealing gas to dry gas of a compressor in a sealing mode, starting a motor to drive the compressor to operate, switching a sealing gas supply source from external gas supply to compressor outlet gas supply, inputting an external heat source, heating the working media through a main heat exchanger, and adjusting the temperature, the pressure and the flow of the working media at an inlet of a turbine. The embodiment of the application can effectively solve the sealing problem in the power generation system.

title_en: Intelligent replacement early warning system for gas turbine inlet filter
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of combined cycle power generation, in particular to an intelligent replacement early warning system for an air inlet filter of a gas turbine. The intelligent sensor comprises a sensor module, a data processing module, an intelligent algorithm module, a prompt output module, an opening and closing module, a leakage detection module and a sensor replacement module. The system can flexibly adjust the ash inlet quantity threshold and the replacement standard according to the actual running conditions of different combined cycle generator sets, ensures that the replacement of the gas turbine inlet filter is timely and economical, has high intelligent degree, realizes the accurate judgment of the performance of the gas turbine inlet filter by analyzing the ash inlet quantity data through an intelligent algorithm, reduces the influence of human factors on the replacement decision, further monitors and prompts in real time, detects the ash inlet quantity in real time, and immediately sends out prompt once the gas turbine inlet filter is found to be required to be replaced, so that the set fault caused by the blockage or damage of the gas turbine inlet filter is avoided.

title_en: Deformable slotting joint energy consumption node of segmented wind power supporting structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deformable slotting joint energy consumption node of a segmented wind power support structure, and relates to the field of slotting joint energy consumption nodes. The deformable slotting joint energy consumption node of the segmented wind power support structure comprises a lower segmented tower barrel, an upper segmented tower barrel, a plurality of layers of energy consumption metal plates and a plurality of groups of notch sealing strips. The deformable slotting joint energy consumption node of the segmented wind power supporting structure is characterized in that a plurality of groups of slots are correspondingly arranged at the butt joint positions of an upper segmented tower barrel and a lower segmented tower barrel, a group of slot sealing strips are slidably connected in the slots, the opening and closing of the slots are adjusted by controlling the sliding of the slot sealing strips, a multi-layer energy consumption metal plate is cooperatively matched with the slot sealing strips at the node of the supporting structure to form a multi-level energy consumption mechanism, the performance of the node can be recovered only by replacing the multi-layer energy consumption metal plate in the slots, and the post-earthquake recovery capacity of the mixed tower structure is improved.

title_en: Electric control valve actuator for automobile exhaust system
abstract_en: The invention provides an electric control valve actuator for an automobile exhaust system, which comprises a control module, a driving module and a sealing shell, wherein the control module and the driving module are integrally packaged in the sealing shell, the control module comprises a printed circuit board assembly, the driving module comprises a motor and a worm gear transmission mechanism, the printed circuit board assembly and the motor are electrically connected and mechanically decoupled through a contact pin, a dual-redundancy angle detection unit is arranged on the printed circuit board assembly and comprises a linear Hall sensor and a digital Hall sensor, a magnetic ring of the linear Hall sensor is arranged on an output shaft gear of the worm gear transmission mechanism and is a plurality of pairs of magnetic rings, the digital Hall sensor is arranged on a pinion meshed with a turbine in the worm gear transmission mechanism, the output shaft gear is meshed with the turbine, and a circular through hole is formed in the sealing shell. The invention has the beneficial effects that the integrated requirements of miniaturization, high reliability, ultrahigh precision and high safety of the electric control valve actuator can be realized.

title_en: Fire door closing control method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire door closing control method and device, which are used for acquiring rotation angle data of a front door and a rear door of a fire door by utilizing self-generated electric energy, judging the position relationship of the front door and the rear door of the current fire door according to the angle data when a triggering condition is met, generating a door closing instruction, and sending the door closing instruction to a fire door motor to enable the fire door motor to execute door closing operation according to the door closing instruction. The door closing logic can be automatically realized only through angle data without additional power supply and without manual intervention or additional setting of sequence parameters after the day, so that the problem of inaccurate door closing caused by sequence errors is solved.

title_en: Multi-fuel generator set control system, control method thereof and generator set
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-fuel generator set control system, a control method thereof and a generator set, which are applied to the technical field of generator sets and comprise a multi-fuel generator set and a control system, wherein the control system comprises a fuel change-over switch, an engine starting switch, a carburetor, a fuel gas supply electric control valve, a signal detection module, an ignition device and a control device; the gas fuel supply pipeline of the multi-fuel engine is connected with the gas inlet of the gas supply electric control valve, and the gas outlet of the gas supply electric control valve is connected with the gas fuel inlet of the carburetor. The signal input end of the fuel type detection circuit is connected with the fuel change-over switch. The signal output ends of the oxygen sensors are respectively connected with the signal input ends of the control device. The oxygen sensor is used to detect an oxygen content signal, which is used to adjust the air-fuel ratio. The invention can realize the closed-loop control of the air-fuel ratio through the oxygen content signal acquired by the oxygen sensor so as to adapt to different air oxygen contents brought by different environmental parameters.

title_en: Engine starting method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of engine control and discloses an engine starting method and system, wherein the engine starting method comprises the following steps of controlling a motor to reversely drag an engine, judging that the engine reaches the back of a compression top dead center by detecting the locked state of the motor when the rotating speed is lower than a preset threshold value and lasts for a preset time, and recognizing that the engine reaches the back of the compression top dead center; and controlling the motor to forward output the constrained torque, assisting the engine to pass through a compression top dead center, stopping torque output and oil supply ignition after the rotating speed reaches the standard, and judging that the starting is successful through an idling threshold value and duration time. The invention solves the problems of easy failure of starting a low-torque motor, dragging over-speed, mechanical impact and the like, does not need to increase hardware cost, obviously improves the starting success rate, reduces the current impact of a battery and the motor, prolongs the service life of the hardware and realizes a stable and reliable starting process.

title_en: Automatic reducing vacuum differential component based on iris diaphragm structure
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic variable-diameter vacuum differential component based on an iris diaphragm structure, which can maintain the vacuum gradient between an accelerator and a terminal target chamber as high as possible. The invention comprises two iris diaphragms, three rotary disc surface connecting rods, a plurality of hinge plates, a hinge shaft lever, a vacuum pipeline and a rotary driving assembly, wherein the rotary driving assembly is used for controlling the cross-sectional area change of a closed-loop polygonal channel structure formed by the hinge plates and the hinge shaft lever, and changing the vacuum conductance in the vacuum pipeline. Under the condition of meeting beam flow passing conditions, the vacuum conductance is as small as possible, the vacuum difference between the terminal target chamber and the accelerator is maintained as large as possible, the stability of the accelerator is facilitated, and the time required for vacuumizing the target chamber is reduced. The accelerator is used for carrying out vacuum irradiation tests, the accelerator generally needs to work at a higher vacuum degree, the terminal target chamber can meet the test requirements at a poorer vacuum degree, and a larger vacuum degree requirement difference exists between the accelerator and the terminal target chamber.

title_en: Efficient internal combustion engine with multistage auxiliary cylinder group
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of heat engines, and particularly relates to a high-efficiency internal combustion engine with a multistage auxiliary cylinder group. The engine comprises a positive cylinder group, auxiliary cylinder groups and a gas public channel, wherein the positive cylinder group comprises a plurality of positive cylinders with one end being fed or two ends being fed, fuel is combusted in the positive cylinders, waste gas discharged by the positive cylinder group is utilized by the auxiliary cylinder groups, the auxiliary cylinder groups are arranged in multiple stages, each stage of auxiliary cylinder group comprises n auxiliary cylinders, n is greater than or equal to 1, each auxiliary cylinder is an internal combustion engine type auxiliary cylinder with a bidirectional pushing piston structure, the gas public channel is communicated with an inlet valve of each auxiliary cylinder of the current stage, and the gas public channel supplies gas for each auxiliary cylinder. The invention utilizes the multistage auxiliary cylinder group to apply work for multiple times, almost completely utilizes the energy of the fuel gas, thoroughly solves the problem that the waste gas takes away a large amount of energy, greatly improves the efficiency and the power of the internal combustion engine, has large energy-saving and emission-reducing effects, and has compact structure, high power density and wide application range, and the auxiliary cylinder does not need an oil supply system and an ignition system and is simpler and easier to manufacture than the positive cylinder.

title_en: Wind power generation equipment and method for artificial tornado
abstract_en: An artificial tornado wind power generation device and a method belong to the technical field of wind power generation. The device comprises a shell, a wind collecting tank I, a wind collecting tank II, a plurality of circulating generator sets I, a circulating generator set II and an air delivery pipe, wherein the wind collecting tank I is sleeved in the wind collecting tank II and forms a multi-layer circulating space through a partition plate. The external air source is transported to each layer of space by the air delivery pipe in a layered way, one part of air flows through the air inlet of the air collection tank II and forms a horizontal layer circulation system by the circulating generator set I, the other part of air flows through the spiral air inlet and enters the air collection tank I in a tangential rotational flow mode, and the air flows are converged with the air flow input by the air inlet pipe I at the bottom and spirally ascend, are output to the circulating generator set II through the air crown end and then flow back to the air delivery pipe to form a three-dimensional circulation system. The horizontal layer circulation and the three-dimensional circulation are coupled to form a tornado characteristic integral circulation airflow, and each generator set converts airflow kinetic energy into electric energy and is integrated into a power grid. According to the invention, by means of a double-circulation coupling mechanism, efficient wind power generation in a low wind speed environment is realized.

title_en: Vacuum device system suitable for high-speed flywheel energy storage
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of high-speed flywheel energy storage equipment, and discloses a vacuum device system suitable for high-speed flywheel energy storage, which comprises a flywheel stator, a flywheel rotor coaxially arranged with the flywheel stator, a bearing for supporting the flywheel rotor, a combined sealing structure for preventing gas from entering the flywheel stator and a vacuum pumping device communicated with the inside of the flywheel stator; the vacuumizing device is used for vacuumizing the atmosphere of the flywheel stator and maintaining a high-vacuum environment in the flywheel stator. The invention can greatly reduce the air leakage of the external atmosphere into the flywheel system, ensure the vacuum running environment in the flywheel stator, greatly improve the running efficiency of the flywheel and improve the rotational inertia of the system.

title_en: Hydropower station speed regulator primary frequency modulation self-adaptive control method based on network source cooperation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of automatic control of hydropower stations, and discloses a hydropower station speed regulator primary frequency modulation self-adaptive control method based on network source cooperation, which comprises the steps of obtaining the change rate of the frequency of a power grid, the fluctuation amount of active power and bottom physical data; calculating dynamic water flow inertia time according to physical data, calculating equivalent inertia of a power grid by combining active power fluctuation quantity and frequency change rate, reconstructing a reverse regulation prevention threshold boundary, calculating real-time module length and phase angle of a frequency difference and frequency change rate phase track vector, generating feedforward differential negative compensation quantity based on the frequency change rate when frequency drop and threshold boundary conditions are met, generating dynamic clamping coefficients by utilizing vortex pressure pulsation derivative when judging water flow to establish forward acceleration, limiting a recovery track of main loop proportional gain, and finally fusing all control quantities to generate a comprehensive guide vane opening instruction for issuing and executing. The invention suppresses the water hammer reverse regulation effect in the primary frequency regulation initial stage, reduces the pressure pulsation risk in the regulation later stage, and ensures the stable operation of the unit.

title_en: Electric pump pre-supercharging liquid rocket engine and working method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric pump pre-pressurizing liquid rocket engine which comprises a pre-pressurizing unit, a turbine pump, a gas generator and a thrust chamber connected with the turbine pump, wherein the pre-pressurizing unit comprises a power supply, an oxidant pre-pressurizing assembly and a fuel pre-pressurizing assembly are connected to the power supply, and the oxidant pre-pressurizing assembly and the fuel pre-pressurizing assembly are connected with the turbine pump. The pre-compression pump overcomes the defects that the traditional engine starting initial pre-compression pump cannot provide positive lift and is low in efficiency, is beneficial to improving the adaptability of the whole working process of the engine to low inlet pressure, avoids cavitation of the main pump, and has the advantages of simple engine structure and improved working reliability. The working method of the electric pump pre-pressurizing liquid rocket engine is also disclosed.

title_en: Electromagnetic shot injection device for fracture alleviation of tokamak device
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of electromagnetic track emission, and particularly discloses an electromagnetic shot injection device for fracture relief of a tokamak device. According to the application, through the four contact rails, the four accelerating section reinforcing rails and the four decelerating section reinforcing rails, the accelerating section reinforcing rails are isolated from the contact rails through the insulating plates, and the decelerating section reinforcing rails are isolated from the contact rails through the insulating plates, so that the armature is accelerated and decelerated firstly. The four-rail scheme can increase the system inductance gradient, so that the required current is reduced on the premise of meeting the discharge speed of the projectile, the joule heat generated by the armature is reduced, and ablation is inhibited. If the current of the enhancement rail is increased, the magnetic field intensity can be enhanced, so that the equivalent inductance gradient is further improved, the current of the contact rail is reduced, and the armature ablation is reduced. In addition, the four contact rails are in interference contact fit with the armature tail wing, so that the motion state of the armature can be better limited, the spatial magnetic field distribution is more uniform, the deflection of the armature is restrained, good electrical contact is ensured, and arc ablation is restrained.

title_en: Vacuum arc pulse plasma thruster
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of aerospace propulsion, and particularly discloses a vacuum arc pulse plasma thruster. The vacuum arc pulse plasma thruster comprises a vacuum arc ignition system and a pulse plasma acceleration system. The vacuum arc ignition system ablates metal to form arc based on high-voltage pulse discharge to generate plasma, and the plasma is injected into the pulse plasma accelerating system, which accelerates the plasma axially based on Lorentz force generated by orthogonal electromagnetic field formed inside, and the plasma ejects the discharge channel at high speed to form recoil force. The pulse plasma propulsion acceleration mechanism is introduced to promote efficient conversion from the capacitive energy storage to the axial directional kinetic energy, so that the thrust, specific impulse and energy conversion efficiency of the thruster are improved.

title_en: Wind farm power prediction method and device based on multidimensional redundancy and cross-domain cooperation
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification provides a wind power plant power prediction method and device based on multi-dimensional redundancy and cross-domain cooperation, wherein the method ensures continuity and reliability of data acquisition in extreme environments by constructing an active redundancy sensing and emergency back-pushing mechanism, provides a stable data base for prediction, adopts a scene-triggered dynamic coupling prediction model, realizes self-adaptive fusion of physical laws and data driving, remarkably improves prediction precision and stability in different polar weather, forms a decision optimization chain from accurate prediction to closed-loop execution by establishing a cross-domain linkage correction and credible cooperation framework of a power-operation-power grid, improves overall operation efficiency and power grid suitability, creatively provides a regional cluster cooperation prediction and dynamic power distribution method under privacy protection, realizes large-scale power accurate management and control from a single-field station to a regional cluster, and provides key technical support for reliable absorption of wind power in a novel power system.

title_en: Water supply switching method, device, equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: A water supply switching method, a device, equipment and a readable storage medium, wherein the water supply switching method comprises the steps of controlling a valve of a standby water supply pipeline to open a first opening to switch a main shaft seal of a water turbine from main water supply to standby water supply if a decreasing speed of a guide vane opening of the water turbine is detected to be larger than a first speed and a decreasing speed of a load of the water turbine is detected to be larger than a second speed, controlling the valve of the standby water supply pipeline to open a second opening to switch the main shaft seal of the water turbine from main water supply to standby water supply if a standby water supply switching instruction is detected, and controlling the valve of the main water supply pipeline to close so as to switch the main shaft seal of the water turbine from main water supply to standby water supply, wherein the second opening is larger than the first opening, and the valve opening time and the rate of the standby water supply pipeline and the valve closing time and the rate of the main water supply pipeline are predicted based on an optimization model. According to the application, the risk of water loss of the main shaft seal of the water turbine can be avoided, and zero interruption of water supply is realized.

title_en: Fan lamp
abstract_en: The invention provides a fan lamp which comprises a lighting assembly, a fan assembly and a hanging assembly, wherein the lighting assembly comprises a chassis, a light source module, a driving module and a mask fixedly connected with the chassis, the chassis and the mask form a containing cavity for containing the light source module and the driving module together, the fan assembly comprises a turntable, a fan blade structure which is arranged on the turntable and can be opened or closed relative to the turntable, and a driving piece connected with the turntable, the hanging assembly comprises a ceiling assembly and a hanging rod, one end of the hanging rod is connected with the driving piece, the other end of the hanging rod is connected with the ceiling assembly, a reinforcing part is arranged between the chassis and the turntable and is configured to be attached to the chassis, the reinforcing part is provided with a protruding part and a fixing part, and the fixing part is configured to be torn and formed on the protruding part and protrudes towards the chassis so as to penetrate through holes on the chassis and be fixedly connected with the chassis. The fan lamp provided by the invention has the advantages that the reinforcing part is arranged between the chassis and the turntable, so that the structural strength of the chassis is enhanced, and when the turntable rotates at a high speed under the drive of the driving piece, the chassis can be kept stable and the lighting assembly can be better protected.

title_en: Multi-sensor fused wind power yaw bearing wear state identification method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for identifying the abrasion state of a wind power yaw bearing by multi-sensor fusion, and belongs to the technical field of wind generating set state monitoring. The operation working conditions are divided into static locking, starting transition, steady rotation and strong random load scenes through vibration, acoustic emission, electric parameters and environment sensing multisource sensor signals, and the sensor channels are dynamically activated and the multidimensional characteristic parameters are adaptively extracted under each scene. And constructing a nonlinear product type comprehensive wear index comprising wear torque increment, vibration envelope peak value, acoustic emission impact count, slip rate peak value, ambient temperature and current harmonic distortion rate, realizing multi-source information fusion diagnosis, and predicting the wear depth trend through a differential equation set. The method can adapt to the extreme working condition of the wind power plant, realize accurate identification and residual life prediction in the early stage of abrasion, remarkably reduce the operation and maintenance cost, and has the advantages of non-invasiveness, high robustness and strong interpretability.

title_en: Circulating fan with outlet rectification guide vane structure and machining method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a circulating fan with an outlet rectifying guide vane structure and a machining method, belonging to the technical field of circulating fans, the upper end of the fan shell is fixedly provided with a connecting shell, one side of the fan shell is fixedly provided with a mounting ring, a connecting frame is arranged in the fan shell, and the connecting frame is fixedly connected with a limiting seat; the fan blade cleaning assembly is fixedly installed on the limiting seat, the circulating fan assembly is arranged below the fan blade cleaning assembly, and the rectifying structure is arranged on the outer side of the fan shell. According to the invention, by designing the matched circulating fan assembly and fan blade cleaning assembly, stepless and accurate adjustment of the fan blade angle is realized, different working conditions can be adapted without changing the fan, dust and greasy dirt on the surface of the fan blade can be automatically cleaned by cleaning sponge in the cleaning frame, the service life of the fan is prolonged, and the equipment maintenance difficulty is reduced.

title_en: Floating island type water area rescue life jacket system convenient to automatically wear
abstract_en: The invention discloses a floating island type water area rescue life jacket system convenient to automatically wear, which belongs to the technical field of life jackets and comprises a floating platform which is cylindrical and floats in a water body, wherein most of the floating platform is positioned below the water surface, a plurality of life jacket wearing chambers which are distributed in an annular array are formed in the side surface of the floating platform, the life jacket wearing chambers extend to the top of the floating platform, a plurality of storage cabinets are respectively connected to the inner walls of the plurality of life jacket wearing chambers in a rotating mode, the floating platform is placed in a water area far away from the shore, the life jacket wearing chambers and the storage cabinets are provided by the floating platform, water-based and physical self-rescue personnel can swim to the floating platform, even if the self-rescue personnel are exhausted, the life jacket body can be supported by an auxiliary wearing mechanism, the self-rescue personnel can wear the life jacket body with high weight conveniently, and the self-rescue personnel can take the life jacket body out to rescue other people, and the rescue success rate is improved.

title_en: Method for safe operation of a wind turbine
abstract_en: A method, a safety system and a wind turbine for operating a wind turbine comprising a rotor, at least two variable pitch rotor blades, a pitch system, an operation controller and a safety controller are described. The method comprises the steps of determining a value of at least one safety parameter with a safety controller, comparing the value of the at least one safety parameter with at least one safety threshold value, and if the value is different from the at least one safety threshold value, the safety controller transmitting a warning signal to an operation controller and preventing the wind turbine (100) from starting. Furthermore, a security system comprising a memory and a processor and means for performing the method are disclosed.

title_en: Dust collector of dust removal fan air intake
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dust removal device for an air inlet of a dust removal fan, which specifically comprises a fan shell, a double-shaft motor, a filtering device and a dust removal fan, wherein a support frame is sleeved and fixedly connected to the outer side of the fan shell, one end of the inner wall of the fan shell is rotatably connected with a fan blade, the double-shaft motor is arranged in the fan shell and positioned at one side of the fan blade, the double-shaft motor is fixedly connected with the inner wall of the fan shell through a connecting frame, an output shaft at one end of the double-shaft motor is fixedly connected with the fan blade, and the filtering device is arranged at one end, far away from the fan blade, of the inner side of the fan shell. This dust collector of dust removal fan air intake can filter the large granule impurity in the air, avoids the inside impeller blade of large granule impurity wearing and tearing fan, conveniently clears up filter screen section of thick bamboo and filter screen surface, avoids filter screen section of thick bamboo and filter screen surface to pile up impurity and lead to ventilation efficiency to reduce to the filter screen is convenient to be maintained and change.

title_en: Flexible solar wing spreading module, energy supply method and implementation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flexible solar wing-spreading module, an energy supply method and an implementation method, wherein the module comprises a wing-spreading hinge integrated TENG unit, a flexible solar wing-spreading unit, a foldable small underwater turbine, a structure of a fuselage belly serial sliding type water flow TENG array and an energy management system, the wing-spreading hinge integrated TENG unit, the flexible solar wing-spreading unit, the foldable small underwater turbine and the structure of the fuselage belly serial sliding type water flow TENG array are all connected with the energy management system, and the problems of contradiction between cruising and supplying, insufficient environmental adaptability, impaired maneuverability, low energy utilization rate and poor power supply reliability are solved.

title_en: Electric compressor fault diagnosis method and device based on multi-source data analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric data processing, in particular to a fault diagnosis method and device for an electric compressor based on multi-source data analysis. The method comprises the steps of collecting a direct current intensity sequence and a vibration intensity sequence of an electric compressor, removing base lines of data in respective dimensions in a step response section, carrying out iterative accumulation analysis on each moment in the step response section to respectively obtain a current drive accumulated intensity signal and a mechanical vibration accumulated intensity signal, determining the maximum nonlinear hysteresis quantity through a matching process, taking the maximum hysteresis time corresponding to the maximum nonlinear hysteresis quantity as a reference, backtracking and inquiring driving power as verification power, and taking the verification power and the maximum nonlinear hysteresis quantity together as a fault judgment reference to carry out fault judgment. According to the invention, the fault of the electric compressor can be effectively analyzed from two dimensions, the verification power is taken as judgment constraint, the influence of the inductance working condition on the final fault diagnosis result is avoided, and the detection accuracy of the fault of the electric compressor is improved.

title_en: Air duct and axial flow fan with same
abstract_en: The invention provides an air duct and an axial flow fan with the same, and belongs to energy-saving fans and fans, wherein the air duct comprises a cylinder body and a rack, the cylinder body comprises a first half shell and a second half shell, the rack comprises a first sub-rack and a second sub-rack, the first sub-rack is detachably connected with the first half shell, the second sub-rack is detachably connected with the second half shell, the first sub-rack is detachably connected with the second sub-rack to form a rack, and the first half shell and the second half shell are detachably connected to form the cylinder body. According to the invention, the cylinder body of the air cylinder is designed to be composed of two half shells, and the frame of the air cylinder is designed to be composed of two sub frames, so that after the frame and the cylinder body are assembled together, the four parts of the first sub frame, the second sub frame, the first half shell and the second half shell are all detachably connected together, and therefore, the four parts can be detached before transportation, thus the occupied space of a load can be effectively reduced, and the transportation convenience is remarkably improved.

title_en: Method and regulation device for inhibiting hydrogen engine pre-ignition stage
abstract_en: The invention provides a hydrogen engine pre-combustion grading inhibition method, which aims to solve the problems of failure and excessive energy loss of the existing pre-combustion inhibition strategy means, thereby establishing a pre-combustion closed-loop judgment mechanism. The invention relates to a regulating and controlling device which comprises a signal acquisition module, an ECU, a water heat management assembly, an electric VVT mechanism and a water injection system. The ECU receives and responds to the weak, medium and strong three-level pre-ignition signals and adopts corresponding grading inhibition measures. The method comprises the steps of performing a water thermal management strategy based on exhaust temperature feedback for weak pre-combustion, performing a reduced effective compression ratio strategy for adjusting variable valve timing phase for medium pre-combustion, and performing a dilution cooling strategy for port deionized water injection for strong pre-combustion. After the inhibition measures are executed, the system calculates the actual combustion CA05 phase deviation and the maximum pressure oscillation amplitude by collecting the in-cylinder pressure in real time. The invention also introduces a closed-loop enhancement mechanism and a hysteresis recovery strategy based on threshold judgment, and takes the engine dynamic property and the thermal efficiency into consideration to the greatest extent.

title_en: Hydraulic pump copper steel bimetal rotor blank diffusion welding sheath structure and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydraulic pump copper steel bimetallic rotor blank diffusion welding sheath structure and a preparation method thereof, wherein the hydraulic pump copper steel bimetallic rotor blank diffusion welding sheath structure comprises a cylindrical steel substrate (1), an upper annular groove (2) is formed in the top surface of the steel substrate (1), a plurality of blind holes (3) are formed in the bottom surface of the upper annular groove (2), copper columns (4) are arranged in the blind holes (3), an upper cover plate (5) fixed with the steel substrate (1) is arranged on the bottom surface of the upper annular groove (2), a flange ring (6) is formed by extending the upper end of the steel substrate (1) radially outwards, a positioning hole (7) is formed in the flange ring (6), a lower annular groove (8) is formed in the bottom surface of the steel substrate (1), an annular copper plate (9) is arranged in the lower annular groove (8), and a lower cover plate (10) fixed with the steel substrate (1) is arranged on the lower side of the copper plate (9). The invention has the advantages of improving the qualification rate of the copper-steel bimetallic rotor, improving the production efficiency and reducing the production cost.

title_en: Axial force balancing device for high-speed centrifugal pump of liquid rocket engine
abstract_en: The invention relates to an axial force balancing device for a high-speed centrifugal pump of a liquid rocket engine, which comprises a pump impeller, a pump shell, a turbine, a balancing mechanism and a wheel shaft, wherein the wheel shaft is coaxially arranged in the pump shell, the pump impeller and the turbine are respectively coaxially fixed on the wheel shaft, one axial end of the pump shell is of an open structure and serves as a propellant inlet, a turbine driving opening and a propellant outlet are arranged on the side wall of the pump shell, the propellant outlet is correspondingly arranged on the peripheral side edge of the pump impeller, the turbine driving opening is correspondingly arranged on the peripheral side edge of the turbine, the balancing mechanism comprises a balancing disc and a balancing plate, the inner side wall of the pump shell inwards extends to form a circle of convex ring, the balancing disc is fixed on the convex ring, a first annular interval is reserved between the balancing disc and the wheel shaft, the balancing plate is fixed on the wheel shaft and below the balancing disc, an overcurrent interval is reserved between the balancing disc and the pump shell, a high-pressure cavity is arranged below the pump impeller, and the area below the balancing plate and the second annular interval are low-pressure cavities.

title_en: High-speed electric hair drier axial flow fan with detachable guide piece
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-speed electric hair drier axial flow fan with a detachable guide piece, which comprises an inner shell and an outer shell which are integrally formed, wherein an air channel is arranged between the inner shell and the outer shell, two ends of the air channel are respectively provided with an air inlet and an air outlet which are mutually communicated, one end of the outer shell, which is positioned at the air inlet, is provided with the guide piece which is detachably connected, the guide piece is provided with a three-stage guide structure of a contraction section, a straight section and an expansion section, so that the effective guiding and rectifying of air flow are realized, the working efficiency of the fan is improved, when the guide piece is worn or the guide structure with different specifications is required to be replaced according to different use requirements, a user can conveniently detach, replace or clean the guide piece, a straight section which is in smooth transition with the expansion section is further arranged on the outer shell, and the cross section S1 from the central axis of the outer shell to the straight section is smaller than the cross section S2 at the straight section, so that the flow path of the air flow is further optimized, and the air resistance is reduced, and the air quantity and the air speed are obviously improved on the premise that the power consumption of a motor is not increased.

title_en: Combustor dome assembly
abstract_en: A combustor dome assembly includes an inner liner, an outer liner, a dome disposed over the inner liner and the outer liner, and a fairing coupled to the inner liner and the outer liner, wherein the dome is decoupled from the fairing and defines an annular surface facing the fairing that extends from an outer diameter of the dome to an inner diameter of the dome.

title_en: Sea-air amphibious fuel supply system based on methanol activated aluminum-water system fuel
abstract_en: The invention provides a sea-air amphibious fuel supply system based on methanol activated aluminum-water system fuel, which comprises a high-concentration Al/MeOH fuel liquid storage tank, a pure methanol MeOH fuel liquid storage tank, a mixing device and a magnetic stirring device, wherein the high-concentration Al/MeOH fuel liquid storage tank and the pure methanol MeOH fuel liquid storage tank divide an Al/MeOH fuel inlet into high-concentration Al/MeOH fuel (wt. > 80 wt%) and pure methanol (MeOH) fuel, the flow ratio of the high-concentration Al/MeOH fuel and the MeOH fuel is adjusted according to the requirements of variable thrust force under different working conditions on flow and fuel energy density, the mixing device is respectively communicated with the high-concentration Al/MeOH fuel liquid storage tank and the pure methanol MeOH fuel liquid storage tank, the fuel output by the mixing device is mixed in proportion, so that the aluminum particle concentration is adjustable in the range of 2wt.% to 50wt.%, and the magnetic stirring device is arranged in the high-concentration Al/MeOH fuel liquid storage tank and used for inhibiting sedimentation and agglomeration of metal fuel particles in the tank. The invention constructs a set of flexible, reliable and accurate fuel supply system, and has stronger engineering practical value and application prospect.

title_en: Auxiliary pre-lubrication system and method for wind turbine generator and wind turbine generator
abstract_en: The invention discloses an auxiliary pre-lubrication system and method of a wind turbine and the wind turbine, wherein the system comprises an auxiliary lubrication oil tank, an oil pump, a motor, a first electromagnetic valve, a second electromagnetic valve, a third electromagnetic valve, a control module, a heater, a temperature sensor and a liquid level switch, an oil inlet of the first electromagnetic valve is communicated with an oil supply port of the auxiliary lubrication oil tank, an oil outlet is communicated with an inlet of the oil pump, an oil inlet of the second electromagnetic valve is communicated with an oil supply port of a main oil tank, an oil outlet is communicated with an inlet of the oil pump, an oil inlet of the third electromagnetic valve is communicated with an outlet of the oil pump, a first oil outlet is communicated with each pre-lubrication point, and a second oil outlet is communicated with an oil return port of the auxiliary lubrication oil tank. The invention realizes the switching of three functions of preheating, pre-lubrication, supplementing and storing lubricating oil of the auxiliary pre-lubrication system by respectively controlling the start and stop of one oil pump and the on-off of three electromagnetic valves, and solves the problem of dry friction of the bearing caused by the fact that the main lubrication system cannot be started in time when the unit is low Wen Qiji.

title_en: Compressor and method of assembling a compressor
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a compressor and a method of assembling a compressor. The compressor includes a compressor housing defining an interior volume and including an axial boss. The main bearing housing engages the axial boss and includes a groove. A main bearing alignment bore extends from the top surface and partially through the main bearing housing. The scroll assembly engages a top surface of the main bearing housing. The scroll assembly includes a fixed scroll having a flange. A scroll alignment bore extends through the scroll assembly. Each flange engages the groove to connect and axially constrain the main bearing housing and the scroll assembly. The alignment pin extends through the scroll alignment bore and into the main bearing alignment bore. An end cover is attached to the compressor housing and includes an internal feature that engages the scroll assembly. At least one of the non-orbiting scroll and the main bearing housing is compressed between the compressor housing and the end cover.

title_en: Hot oil pump axle center track detection device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of hot oil pump detection, in particular to a hot oil pump axis track detection device which comprises a sliding mounting platform, wherein a driving part of a hot oil pump structure is slidably mounted on the right side of the sliding mounting platform, a pump shell of the hot oil pump structure is mounted on the left side of the sliding mounting platform, the driving part is connected with the pump shell through a shaft body, and an axis track detection mechanism is slidably arranged on the sliding mounting platform at the position of the shaft body. According to the invention, the driving part, the pump shell and the axis track detection mechanism are respectively arranged on the corresponding sliding mounting plates on the sliding mounting platform, each sliding mounting plate can independently slide along the guiding optical axis and the trapezoid plate, so that flexible position adjustment of each part in the axial direction of the shaft body is realized, the guiding optical axis and the trapezoid plate form a double guiding structure, the stability and anti-overturning capability of the sliding mounting plates in the sliding process are effectively enhanced, and the parallelism and the coaxiality of the sliding mounting plates are ensured.

title_en: Quick-open type high-pressure pump water inlet device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cleaning sewage suction trucks, in particular to a quick-opening high-pressure pump water inlet device which comprises a high-pressure pump fixedly connected with a truck frame, wherein the tail part of the truck frame is rotationally connected with a tank body, two sides of the tank body are fixedly connected with a water tank, the bottom of the water tank is provided with a water outlet pipe with an upper flange, a water inlet pipe with a lower flange is arranged below the water outlet pipe, the water inlet pipe is L-shaped, the other end of the water inlet pipe is connected with the water inlet end of the high-pressure pump, the lower part of the upper flange is in sealing connection with an upper backing ring, the lower surface of the upper backing ring is convexly provided with a round platform part, the upper part of the lower flange is in sealing connection with a lower backing ring, the upper surface of the lower backing ring is concavely provided with a round platform groove, and the lower backing ring is in sealing fit with the round platform groove through the round platform part of the upper backing ring, so that the automatic on-off of a pipeline is realized by combining with the overturning of the tank body, thereby avoiding the pipeline to be worn and torn, the leakage and maintenance cost are reduced, and various defects of the existing hose connection are overcome.

title_en: Fan tower cylinder overhauling platform, mast type overhauling platform system and wind generating set
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wind power generation, and provides a fan tower cylinder overhauling platform, a mast type overhauling platform system and a wind generating set. The overhaul platform comprises a lifting and rotating mechanism and a foldable platform, wherein the lifting and rotating mechanism comprises a lifting frame and a rotating frame, the lifting frame is used for being movably sleeved on the outer side of a mast in a fan tower and is hoisted on the lower side of lifting equipment capable of climbing along the mast, the rotating frame is rotatably sleeved on the outer side of the lifting frame around a vertical axis, and the foldable platform is arranged on one side of the rotating frame and is used for carrying overhaul personnel and transferring the overhaul personnel to one side close to the fan tower. The invention is convenient for overhauling the butt joint of two adjacent fan tower barrels by overhauling staff based on the overhauling platform, has low overhauling cost and convenient operation, improves overhauling operation efficiency and reduces possible operation risks in the overhauling process of the fan tower barrels.

title_en: A multi-purpose vacuum pump of circulating water formula for purifying experimental reagent
abstract_en: The application discloses a circulating water type multipurpose vacuum pump for purifying an experimental reagent, which comprises a shell, two vertical plates, a circulating water tank and a liquid supply cavity, wherein a cavity for containing circulating water is formed in the shell, a cover plate is arranged at the upper end of the shell, a vacuum pump body extending into the cavity is arranged at the upper end of the cover plate, the two vertical plates are vertically arranged on the inner wall of the cavity, a reflux groove is penetrated through the vertical plates close to the vacuum pump body, and the liquid supply cavity is formed between the two vertical plates and the cavity. The motor is used as a single power source, the bevel gear set and the synchronous belt set simultaneously drive the vacuum pump to pump air, the piston to pump circulating water and the filter cover to rotate and self-clean, the circulating water forms a closed loop through the cavity, the piston pump, the filter, the cooling plate, the liquid supply cavity, the reflux tank and the cavity, the circulating water for continuously providing cooling for the vacuum pump body and the cooling liquid for the vacuum pump body can meet the requirement that the vacuum pump body continuously works for a long time, and the filter mechanism automatically cleans and entraps impurities in the rotation without manual intervention.

title_en: Bidirectional unloading type electromagnetic valve and torch igniter propellant supply system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a two-way unloading type electromagnetic valve and a torch igniter propellant supply system, the two-way unloading type electromagnetic valve comprises an electromagnet assembly, a shell, a valve core, a push rod and a reset spring, wherein the electromagnet assembly is assembled on the shell, the valve core is arranged in an inner cavity of the shell and divides the inner cavity into an inlet cavity and an outlet cavity which are mutually communicated, the valve core comprises an upper valve rod section, a valve plate and a lower valve rod section, the upper half section of the upper valve rod section is movably connected with the side wall of the inner cavity of the shell in a sealing way, the lower half section of the lower valve rod section is movably connected with the side wall of the inner cavity of the shell in a sealing way, the communicating juncture of the inlet cavity and the outlet cavity is used as a valve port, the reset spring is sleeved on the lower valve rod section, the cross-sectional area of the connecting position of the upper half section of the upper valve rod section and the side wall of the inner cavity of the shell and the cross-sectional area of the connecting position of the lower half section and the side wall of the inner cavity of the shell are equal to the area of the valve port, and the electromagnet assembly is connected with the upper end of the upper valve rod section through the push rod and drives the valve core to move axially to open or close the valve port.

title_en: Marine ORC waste heat power generation system based on heat source split flow and control method
abstract_en: The invention provides a marine ORC waste heat power generation system based on heat source split flow and a control method. The marine ORC waste heat power generation system comprises a preheater, a cylinder liner water heat exchanger and an evaporator, wherein the water inlet end of cylinder liner water of a host machine is split into two paths through a first three-way valve, one path of the water inlet end is communicated with the first inlet end of the preheater through a first pipeline, the other path of the water inlet end is communicated with the first inlet end of the cylinder liner water heat exchanger through a fourth pipeline, the cylinder liner water heat exchanger is used for exchanging heat between saturated water vapor and the cylinder liner water of the other path of the water, the first outlet end of the cylinder liner water heat exchanger is communicated with the first inlet end of the evaporator through a fifth pipeline, the second inlet end of the preheater is communicated with an organic medium, and the second outlet end of the preheater is communicated with the second inlet end of the evaporator through a tenth pipeline. The invention introduces saturated water vapor, and divides the flow of the cylinder sleeve water of the main machine, and improves the temperature of part of the cylinder sleeve water of the main machine through high-temperature saturated water vapor so as to improve the heat efficiency of the system under the condition of consuming a small amount of high-temperature saturated water vapor.

title_en: Gaseous combustion two-stroke diesel engine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gaseous combustion two-stroke diesel engine, which comprises a cylinder body and a piston, wherein the piston is an I-shaped-like piston, the cylinder body comprises a first piston cylinder and a second piston cylinder, the bottom of the first piston cylinder is communicated with the top of the second piston cylinder through an intermediate cylinder body, the radial cross-sectional area of the intermediate cylinder body is slightly larger than that of a central column, the first layer of piston is positioned in the first piston cylinder, the second layer of piston is positioned in the second piston cylinder, the first layer of piston divides the first piston cylinder into a first air chamber and a second air chamber, the second air chamber is positioned near the intermediate cylinder, the second layer of piston and the second piston cylinder form a third air chamber, one of the second air chamber and the third air chamber is used as an air chamber, an air suction one-way valve and an air outlet one-way valve are arranged on the side wall of the air chamber, an air inlet valve, an exhaust valve and a high-pressure oil nozzle are arranged on the side wall of the combustion chamber, and a high-pressure storage air chamber is arranged between the air outlet one-way valve and the air inlet valve.

title_en: Self-cleaning check valve box type assembly for air bag pump and valve seat flushing flow passage
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-cleaning check valve box type component for an air bag pump and a valve seat flushing runner thereof. The assembly comprises a valve casing, a main runner, a valve seat, a valve core, an elastic piece and an installation interface. The valve is characterized in that a flushing bypass flow passage and a throttling structure are arranged in the valve casing, the flushing bypass flow passage is communicated with the valve seat sealing area and comprises a flushing section arranged along the valve seat sealing area and a communication section respectively communicated with a high pressure side and a low pressure side of the main flow passage, so that when the valve core is in a closed state or is close to the closed state and the two ends of the flushing bypass flow passage form a preset pressure difference in the reciprocating cycle of the air bag pump, a high pressure side medium flows through the flushing section under the flow limiting effect of the throttling structure and flows to the low pressure side along the valve seat sealing area and the adjacent circumferential annular space thereof to form a controlled flushing flow, the valve core is opened under the action of the forward pressure difference of fluid and is closed under the combined action of an elastic piece and a reverse pressure difference, and the elastic piece provides a closing biasing force to reduce the dependence of the valve core back seat on gravity.

title_en: Wave-driven air curtain silt-reducing and photovoltaic panel self-cleaning system and cooperative control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to wave energy technology, and discloses a wave-driven air curtain silt-reducing and photovoltaic panel self-cleaning system and a cooperative control method thereof, which are used for realizing dynamic switching and optimized operation between air curtain silt-reducing and photovoltaic panel self-cleaning functions by converting wave energy into compressed air energy and combining a pressurizing and voltage-stabilizing, intelligent directional air supply and compressed air resource cooperative scheduling mechanism, the system improves the utilization efficiency of compressed air and the comprehensive benefit of the system, reduces the operation energy consumption and maintenance cost of the system, reduces the dependence of external power equipment, realizes the long-term unattended operation of the system, and provides a novel technical scheme which is green, low-carbon, efficient and reliable and has intelligent and self-adaptive operation capability for port channel engineering, breakwater engineering, ocean engineering and offshore photovoltaic systems.

The single cylinder of the star-disk engine is arranged in a star-disk manner; a gear big disc (30) is sleeved on the main body fixed disc (40) concentrically; a transmission shaft (20) is arranged on the central axis of the main body fixed disc (40) and the gear big disc (30), and the gear big disc (30) is connected with the transmission shaft (20); the piston cylinder body (12) of each single cylinder (10) is embedded in the main body fixing disc (40), and the small gear disc (15) and the large gear disc (30) of each single cylinder (10) are meshed; a plurality of gear members (50) are disposed on the periphery of the main body fixed disk (40) and mesh with the gear large disk (30). The series engine set is formed by connecting a plurality of starlike disk engines in series and paralleling on a transmission shaft (20). The utility model has compact space; the components are simple; the maintenance is easy; can be used in series; and energy is saved.

According to the automobile EGR valve control device, the bolt can be prevented from falling off due to jolt of an automobile in the connection process through the elasticity of the elastic gasket, and the installation effect is improved.

The centrifugal pump with the air guide joint of the utility model integrates the air guide joint on the pump body, and can introduce air into the pump equipment without additionally arranging an air inlet on the pump washing equipment, thereby reducing the risk of water leakage of the pump equipment; and an air inlet used for supplying air to the washing equipment covers the interior of a structural part of the pump body, so that the risk of blockage of the washed objects is reduced.

The belt-driven oil-free air compressor comprises an air storage tank, wherein a motor and an air compressor machine head are detachably and fixedly connected to the air storage tank, the air compressor machine head is in transmission connection with the motor through a belt, and a gear device for performing enclosure protection on the belt which is in transmission connection between the motor and the air compressor machine head is further arranged on the air storage tank; including the guard shield, have on the gas holder along the fixed bar platen of gas holder length direction, guard shield demountable assembly in bar platen on and this guard shield encloses the cover with the belt, be provided with between guard shield and the bar platen and enable the guard shield and support the assembly structure that leans on at the bar platen shock attenuation. title_en: Single-inlet double-outlet double-cavity micro pump

Two exhaust valves are arranged in each working cavity, and the exhaust flow area is twice as large as the air inlet flow area, so that the working medium impact on each exhaust check valve is greatly reduced in the exhaust process of the diaphragm movement, and the working life is prolonged; meanwhile, the diaphragms of the two working chambers are controlled by the driving mechanism to alternately reciprocate, so that the air suction and the air exhaust of the two working chambers are alternately performed, and the stability of output parameters is improved.

title_en: Electromagnetic compatibility filter circuit for high-power direct-current fan

title_en: Diesel generator automatic cooling equipment based on principle of thermal expansion and cold contraction

The automatic cooling equipment of the diesel generator based on the principle of expansion with heat and contraction with cold can automatically induce the surface temperature of the generator and cool the generator. The utility model provides such diesel generator automatic cooling equipment of expend with heat and contract with cold principle, including bottom plate, truckle subassembly, support, diesel generator, pushing hands, pushing mechanism and water spray mechanism, bottom plate bottom both sides all are equipped with two truckle subassemblies, and the bottom plate top is equipped with the support, and diesel generator has been placed at the bottom plate top, and bottom plate top one side is equipped with the pushing hands, is equipped with pushing mechanism on the support, is equipped with water spray mechanism between bottom plate top one side and the pushing mechanism. Through the cooperation of pushing mechanism and water spray mechanism, can be when diesel generator surface temperature is too high, give diesel generator water spray cooling automatically, can the automatic shutdown water spray after the cooling, avoid diesel generator to burn out, also make things convenient for people's work.

title_en: Split pump with novel anti-sedimentation blocking balance pipe structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a split pump with a novel anti-sedimentation blocking balance pipe structure, relates to the technical field of fluid machinery, and particularly relates to an anti-sedimentation blocking balance pipe structure applied to split pumps for medium conveying in various industries. The suction pipe of the utility model is connected with the inlet of the split pump; a balance pipe is arranged between the pump cover and the suction pipe. The balance cavity of the pump cover is provided with a through hole and a connecting flange which is connected with the balance pipe through the connecting flange. The balance pipe is positioned at the upper part of the split pump. The technical scheme of the utility model solves the problems that when the existing split pump in the prior art is used for conveying a medium easy to precipitate, under the condition of shutdown, precipitates block a balance pipe, the pressure of a sealing cavity at a discharge side is increased to cause sealing leakage, axial force cannot be balanced to cause overload operation of a bearing, abrasion of a dynamic ring and a static ring, the service life of the pump is shortened and the like.

title_en: Leakage monitoring and protecting device for mining dump truck engine
abstract_en: The leakage monitoring and protecting device for the mining dump truck engine. When the leakage happens, the leakage can not be found in time, and whether the leakage happens on the road after the truck walks can only be seen through workers in the walking process of the truck. The utility model comprises the following components: the detection device comprises a box body (1), wherein a layer of rubber mat (5) is bonded on the bottom surface of the box body, two detection ropes (3) are arranged on the bottom surface of the box body and are arranged in a snake shape, and buckling strips (2) are buckled on the detection ropes to fix the detection ropes; the bottom surface of the box body is an inclined bottom surface. The utility model is used for leakage monitoring and protection of the mining dump truck engine.

The double-sided photovoltaic is arranged on the outer surface of the outer wall of the building, the reflective film is arranged on the inner surface of the outer wall of the building, an air channel is reserved in the middle of the reflective film, ventilation openings are reserved above and below the double-sided photovoltaic and communicated with outdoor air and the air channel, ventilation openings are also reserved above and below the reflective film, the air channel is communicated with an air treatment system consisting of an evaporator, a condenser, a compressor and a throttle valve through the upper ventilation openings, and indoor air is communicated with the air channel through the lower ventilation openings. Through above-mentioned optimal design's two-sided photovoltaic window ventilation system, indoor outer ventilation has been strengthened, and because the positive and negative two sides of two-sided photovoltaic all can generate electricity the characteristic, utilize the reflectance coating to solar radiation's reflection make the generating efficiency at two-sided photovoltaic back obtain improving, can cool off two-sided photovoltaic when the air current flows through two-sided photovoltaic back simultaneously for photovoltaic efficiency further obtains promoting.

The test platform provides basic test conditions for the research of the oil-gas mixed transportation equipment, and is simple and convenient to operate, safe and reliable.

title_en: PVD nose-shaped conical surface piston two rings
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a PVD nose-shaped conical surface piston two-ring, which comprises a piston ring body, wherein a nose-shaped oil scraping blade is arranged on the outer circular surface of the piston ring body, the outer circular surface of the nose-shaped oil scraping blade is a conical surface, an oil storage tank is arranged between the bottom end part of the nose-shaped oil scraping blade and the lower end surface of the piston ring body, the tip position of the nose-shaped oil scraping blade adopts an arc R transition, and PVD coatings are plated on the arc R transition part and the outer circular surface of the nose-shaped oil scraping blade above the arc R transition part. The piston ring has reasonable structural design, and the wear resistance of the piston ring can be improved by plating the PVD coating on the conical surface, the arc R transition and the outer circular surface of the nose-shaped oil scraping blade at and above the arc R transition, so that the service life of the piston ring is prolonged, and the use requirement is met.

title_en: Immersible pump belt cleaning device for coal mine machine electricity
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a submersible pump cleaning device for coal mine machinery, which is characterized in that a box cover is opened by utilizing a handle, a push-pull handle is fixedly arranged on the outer side of a box body, the push-pull handle controls the box body to move left and right through a second chute on the lower side, a submersible pump is placed on a rotary chassis, a driving motor is controlled by a starting power supply outside the box, the driving motor is started to drive the rotary chassis to rotate slowly, water is injected into a first water outlet cover and a second water outlet cover through a water outlet power supply, and a blowing power supply is opened to blow water into the box body for drying after the submersible pump is cleaned.

title_en: Peristaltic dosing pump
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a peristaltic dosing pump, relates to the technical field of peristaltic pumps, and solves the technical problem that the distance between a roller and a hose of a pump head cannot be conveniently adjusted in the conventional peristaltic dosing pump; the gear pump comprises a gear motor and a pump head, wherein one end of the gear motor is fixedly provided with the pump head, the interior of the pump head is connected with a hose through a barrier strip in a clamping manner, the interior of the pump head is provided with a turntable, an output shaft of the gear motor penetrates through the pump head and is fixedly connected with the middle part of the turntable, the surface of the turntable is fixedly provided with a rectangular frame, and the rectangular frame is rotatably connected with a positive and negative screw rod; the gear is rotated by the protrusions on the surface of the gear, the friction force is good, the positive and negative screw rods can be driven to rotate, when the positive and negative screw rods rotate, the two rollers can be driven to move oppositely by the nuts, the distance between the two rollers can be shortened, the distance between the two rollers and the barrier strip can be increased, and the two rollers can be driven to move reversely by the nuts by rotating the gear reversely.

title_en: Starting device for replacing manual irrigation with mixed-flow pump station
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of starting equipment, in particular to a starting device for a mixed flow pump station to replace manual water filling, aiming at the problems that the prior mixed flow pump needs manual water filling before starting, wastes time and labor, has low intelligent degree and is not beneficial to popularization and use, the utility model provides a scheme which comprises a frame, wherein the top of the frame is fixedly provided with a mixed flow pump, the input end and the output end of the mixed flow pump are respectively and hermetically communicated with a pumping pipe and a water outlet pipe, the outer side of the pumping pipe is fixedly provided with a valve block in a sealing way, the top of the valve block is fixedly provided with a control box, the inner wall of the top of the valve block is rotatably provided with a valve core, and the right side and the front side of the valve core are respectively and fixedly provided with an upper arc-shaped plug and a lower plug plate. The use effect is good, and the method is worthy of wide popularization and use.

title_en: Hub structure for large-scale wind turbine generator
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of wind power generation, and provides a hub structure for a large-scale wind turbine generator, which comprises a three-way spherical hub body, wherein a main shaft mounting surface is arranged on the hub body, and three variable-pitch bearing mounting surfaces are uniformly distributed on the side surface of the hub body along the circumferential direction; the utility model overcomes the defects of the prior art and solves the problems that the connection strength between the hub and the variable-pitch bearing is limited and the connecting bolt is easy to loosen and even fall off; according to the utility model, by arranging the fastening ring, the hub body can be further connected in a reinforcing manner through the fastening ring after being connected with the variable-pitch bearing; the ring pressing plate is embedded in the fastening ring to tightly press and fix the connecting bolt, so that the bolt is prevented from loosening and falling off; by arranging the rubber ring, the connection between the hub body and the variable-pitch bearing is further reinforced, and the inner part of the fastening ring can be sealed at the same time, so that the bolts are prevented from rusting by contacting with water in the air, and the service life of the bolts is prolonged; the utility model has reasonable design, simple structure and high practicability.

title_en: Narrow-distance sound-absorbing insulator for magnetic suspension air blower
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a narrow-distance sound-absorbing insulator for a magnetic suspension air blower, which comprises a first sound-absorbing plate, a second sound-absorbing plate, sound-absorbing plates and sound-absorbing strips, wherein the first sound-absorbing plate is arranged on the first side of the sound-absorbing plate; the first silencing plate and the second silencing plate are identical in structure and are arranged in parallel with a gap in the middle; the sound insulation plate is axially parallel to the first sound insulation plate and the second sound insulation plate, and a gas flow passage for air intake of the sound insulation device is formed between the sound insulation plates; the baffle lateral boundary is smaller than the lateral boundaries where the first baffle and the second baffle are placed in parallel; at least two silencing strips are respectively arranged between the sound insulation plate and the first silencing plate and between the sound insulation plate and the second silencing plate, a silencing channel is formed between every two adjacent silencing strips, one side of the silencing channel is communicated with the gas flow channel, and the other side of the silencing channel is a gas outlet used for discharging gas entering the silencing channel into the air blower. The utility model changes the original direct axial air intake into transverse air intake along the silencer channel, increases the silencing length of the air intake through the transverse silencing passage, improves the silencing effect, and greatly shortens the axial size of the silencer.
