title_en: Cooling water heat exchange system of emergency diesel generating set
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cooling water heat exchange system of an emergency diesel generating set, which comprises a first heat exchanger, a second heat exchanger, a water pump, a control valve, a filter, a thermometer and a pressure sensor, wherein cooling intermediate water passes through the filter, the water pump and the control valve, then passes through the second heat exchanger, a generating set water channel and the first heat exchanger, then flows back for cooling and recycling, and continuously cools the generating set; the first heat exchanger is optionally connected into a water channel of the generator set; the control valve, the thermometer and the pressure sensor are arranged on the water pipe and are in telecommunication connection with the control box. The first heat exchanger and the second heat exchanger adopt plate heat exchangers. The system can achieve the function of efficiently and safely cooling the cooling water of the diesel engine set so as to reduce the electric load and increase the reliability of the cooling water system.

title_en: Full monitoring devices of fan drive chain
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a full monitoring device for a fan transmission chain, and relates to the technical field of wind power industry; the device includes: the monitoring assembly is arranged on the fan main shaft, the gear box and the generator; the data acquisition module is electrically connected with the monitoring component and is used for synchronously acquiring different parameter information monitored by the monitoring component; the data analysis module is used for receiving and analyzing the information acquired by the data acquisition module; the communication module is used for communication connection with the server; the monitoring component comprises a temperature monitoring module, a vibration monitoring module and an electric signal monitoring module, wherein the temperature monitoring module comprises at least one temperature probe, the vibration monitoring module comprises at least one vibration probe, and the electric signal monitoring module comprises at least one current-voltage signal probe. The fan transmission chain monitoring device provided by the utility model can complete automatic monitoring work and overcomes the defect that the generator electrical signal cannot be monitored in the prior art.

title_en: Yak is bred with preventing losing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a loss prevention device for yak breeding, which comprises: the device comprises a base, universal wheels are fixedly mounted on two sides of the bottom of the base, fixing mechanisms are arranged on two sides of the base, a supporting column is arranged at the upper end of the base, a hydraulic cylinder is fixedly mounted at the bottom of an inner cavity of the supporting column, a lifting rod is fixedly connected to the output end of the hydraulic cylinder, a connecting column is fixedly connected to the top of the lifting rod, a first fixing plate is welded to the front surface of the connecting column, a protection box is fixedly mounted at the upper end of the first fixing plate, and a driving mechanism is arranged inside the protection box; according to the utility model, under the matching action of the driving motor, the output shaft, the driving gear, the driven gear, the first rotating rod and the bearing seat, the camera can rotate by three hundred sixty degrees, so that large-scale monitoring is carried out, real-time monitoring on large-scale yak groups is facilitated, loss of yaks is prevented, and the practicability of the equipment is increased.

title_en: Automatic ash removal device for fan impeller
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic ash removal device for a fan impeller, which comprises a volute and is characterized in that a plurality of spray gun inlet holes are formed in the volute, sealing elements are arranged on the spray gun inlet holes, a spray gun fixing frame for fixing a spray gun is arranged on one side of each spray gun inlet hole, and the volute is provided with an ash removal hole. The utility model carries out ash removal through the spray gun, discharges dust through the ash removal hole, and ensures that each blade achieves the ash removal effect through the slow rotation of the low-speed driving device in the ash removal process.

title_en: Fan flexible connection formula petticoat pipe
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of kitchen equipment, and particularly discloses a fan flexible connection type smoke hood which comprises a fan and a shell, wherein a water tank is arranged at the lower end of the shell; one end of the water tank is provided with a water inlet pipe, and the other end of the water tank is provided with an overflow pipe; the shell is provided with an air deflector, and a filtering mechanism is arranged in the shell; the filtering mechanism is arranged above the air deflector and below the opening at the top of the shell, and the air inlet of the fan is connected with the opening at the top of the shell through flexible connection. Compared with the prior art, the fan sets up in the casing outside, connects through the flexible coupling, and the vibrations of having avoided fan during operation drive the casing vibrations, have guaranteed the fixed stability of casing, and noise when having reduced vibrations. The arrangement of the water tank reduces the cleaning frequency.

title_en: Fin structure, plate-fin heat exchanger and vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model provides a fin structure, a plate-fin heat exchanger and a vehicle, and relates to the technical field of automobile heat exchangers. The fin structure comprises a fin body, wherein the fin body is provided with an inlet guide section, an opening turnover section and an outlet guide section which are sequentially arranged; the opening turnover section is provided with a plurality of window structures, the opening directions of window sashes of two adjacent window structures are opposite, the window sashes enable the direction of air flow passing through the windows of the window structures to be changed continuously, an air flow boundary layer is damaged, turbulent flow is formed, the air flow stroke is prolonged, and the heat exchange efficiency is improved. The utility model also provides a plate-fin heat exchanger which comprises the fin structure. The utility model also provides a vehicle comprising the plate-fin heat exchanger. The utility model solves the problems of low heat exchange efficiency and complex structure of the existing plate-fin heat exchanger.

title_en: Double-control backspacing type direct current starter
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of starters, in particular to a double-control backspacing type direct current starter which comprises a bottom shell, a top shell and a bottom plate, wherein the top shell is arranged at the top of the bottom shell, the bottom plate is fixedly connected to the bottom of the bottom shell, a connecting assembly is arranged on the outer wall of the bottom shell, the connecting assembly comprises a first fixing plate, a first connecting groove, a connecting bolt and a connecting nut, the first fixing plate is fixedly connected to the top of the outer wall of the bottom shell, and the connecting plate is fixedly connected to the bottom of the outer wall of the top shell. This two accuse backspacing formula direct current starter, operating personnel use the rotatory fixing bolt of apparatus, make fixing bolt and two separation of fixed plate, operating personnel uses apparatus fixed connection bolt afterwards to the swivelling joint nut, until connecting nut and connecting bolt separation, operating personnel alright at this moment with separating drain pan and top shell, thereby overhaul the electronic component to drain pan inside and maintain.

title_en: Electromagnetic double-acting reciprocating pump
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electromagnetic double-acting reciprocating pump which comprises a shell, wherein a cylinder is arranged in the shell, an electromagnetic piston is arranged in the cylinder, and an electromagnet is embedded in the electromagnetic piston; a conductive rail is arranged in the cylinder, and the circuit system is in power supply connection with the conductive rail; the electricity taking terminal of the electromagnetic piston is electrically connected with the conductor rail through an electric brush; one end of the shell is provided with a permanent magnet; the shell is provided with a water inlet and a water outlet; the device has the advantages of reasonable structure, high operating efficiency, good energy saving performance and safe and reliable operation.

title_en: Stepless speed change hydraulic motor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a stepless speed change hydraulic motor, which relates to the technical field of hydraulic motors and comprises a cylinder body and an output shaft, wherein one end of the output shaft is arranged in the middle of the cylinder body, the other end of the output shaft is arranged on the outer side of the cylinder body, one side of the cylinder body is sequentially provided with a partition plate, a stator and a rear cover, the partition plate, the stator and the rear cover are fixedly connected with the cylinder body through hexagonal bolts, the middle of the rear cover is fixedly connected with a plug, the inner side of the output shaft is provided with a first groove, a connecting shaft is arranged in the first groove, the inner side of the stator is provided with a rotor, the inner side of the rotor is provided with needle teeth, the other end of the connecting shaft is arranged on the inner side of the needle teeth, a first limiting block is arranged between the connecting shaft and the rear cover, and the other side of the cylinder body is provided with a front cover. The utility model solves the problems that the existing stepless speed change hydraulic motor causes inconvenient maintenance and repair and inconvenient installation and disassembly of the plug.

title_en: Double-gear auxiliary gear pump
abstract_en: A double-gear auxiliary gear pump comprises an oil pumping gear pair and a driving gear pair, wherein the driving gear pair drives the oil pumping gear pair to work; at the initial working stage of the double-gear auxiliary gear pump, the meshing conditions of the oil pumping gear pair and the driving gear pair are the same, along with the working of the double-gear auxiliary gear pump, the oil pumping gear pair is abraded due to fine solids in heavy oil slurry, the driving gear pair is good in lubrication condition and extremely small in abrasion, at the moment, the meshing conditions of the oil pumping gear pair and the driving gear pair can be changed, the gear tooth surface of the driving gear pair is still in a contact meshing state, and the gear tooth surface of the oil pumping gear pair is separated and is in a non-contact meshing state; after the gear tooth surface of the oil pumping gear pair has a meshing gap, the fine solid components in the heavy oil slurry can not make the oil pumping gear pair continuously generate abrasion, and the driving gear pair is always in a good lubricating state, so that the oil pumping gear pair and the driving gear pair have extremely long service lives.

title_en: Connecting seat for connecting motor and pump body
abstract_en: The utility model provides a connecting seat for connecting a motor and a pump body, which comprises a fixed seat, a positioning seat and a clamping seat which are arranged at the upper end of a base, and a conical head and a rotating disc which are connected at the two ends of a driven shaft, wherein the driven shaft passes through the fixed seat; the utility model greatly reduces the cost of the product and improves the benefit, and the assembly is convenient and rapid by arranging the fixed seat, the positioning seat and the clamping seat, the assembly can be carried out without other tools, the disassembly is simple and convenient, the maintenance is convenient, and the maintenance cost of the product is reduced.

title_en: Automatic partial pressure type duplicate gear pump
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an automatic pressure-dividing type duplicate gear pump, which comprises a pump body, wherein the left end and the right end of the pump body are fixedly connected with fixing blocks, the inside of each fixing block is connected with a bolt column through threads, the bottom of each bolt column is connected with a first bottom plate through threads, and the middle position of the bottom of each first bottom plate is fixedly connected with a pair of supporting columns. The gear pump has the advantages of simple structure, convenience in operation, strong flexibility and wide application range, the first bottom plate supports and installs the pump body, and meanwhile, the second bottom plate props against the ground, so that the situation that the using effect of the gear pump is influenced due to the fact that the whole pump body is driven to move by vibration generated in the working process of the gear pump can be effectively avoided, the normal use of the gear pump is ensured, the working performance of the gear pump is improved, and the contact area between the second bottom plate and the ground is increased by the arrangement of the second bottom plate and the placing plate, so that the supporting capacity of the second bottom plate is increased.

title_en: Sound insulation case cover plate
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sound insulation machine box cover plate, which comprises an upper cover plate, a lower cover plate and a dust screen, wherein the upper cover plate is provided with a first ventilation groove and an installation rail, the first ventilation groove is arranged in the middle of the upper cover plate, the first ventilation groove is provided with a plurality of installation strips, the lower cover plate is provided with a second ventilation groove, a sliding block and a fixing screw hole, the second ventilation groove corresponds to the first ventilation groove, the second ventilation groove is provided with a plurality of insertion grooves, the fixing screw hole is used for realizing the fixing of the lower cover plate, the sliding block corresponds to the installation rail, the dust screen is arranged in the second ventilation groove, the first ventilation groove is attached to the dust screen, the dust screen is provided with a plurality of through holes, the installation strips pass through the through holes to be clamped with the insertion grooves, a sound insulation layer is arranged between the upper cover plate and the lower cover plate, the sound insulation layer is a return-type structure surrounding the dust screen, and a sound insulation filling material is arranged in the sound insulation layer, can improve syllable-dividing effect through setting up the puigging, and can further improve syllable-dividing effect through adding syllable-dividing filler material.

title_en: Octagonal bushing structure for rotor pump
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an octagonal bushing structure for a rotor pump, which comprises a pump body and a bushing body, wherein the bushing body is arranged on the pump body, a plurality of groups of ball head grooves are formed in the bushing body, a plurality of groups of ball head groove arrays are distributed in the bushing body, an annular groove is formed in the bushing body, through holes penetrating through the annular groove are formed in the plurality of groups of ball head grooves, an oil filling hole is formed in the bushing body and connected with the annular groove, and the plurality of groups of ball head grooves are used for reducing the area of the inner wall surface of the bushing body, so that the contact area between an output shaft and the inner wall surface of the bushing body is greatly reduced, the abrasion of the bushing body in use is greatly reduced, and a certain service cycle of the bushing body is effectively prolonged.

title_en: Oil pan of diesel engine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of diesel engines, in particular to an oil pan of a diesel engine, which comprises an oil pan main body, wherein an anti-abrasion fixing device is assembled on the oil pan main body and protects the oil pan main body through the anti-abrasion fixing device, the anti-abrasion fixing device comprises a disc, and a first elastic mechanism is fixedly installed on the left side of an inner cavity of the disc. When the food tray is carrying out the use, the staff at first need assemble the food tray, fix food tray and connecting axle through abrasionproof decreases fixing device when the staff assembles, the effectual food tray junction remain stable when using that has prevented, the food tray carries out high-speed rotation in the use simultaneously, make the friction that produces between food tray periphery and cylinder body, it discharges through the oil outlet to make lubricating oil pass through the high-speed rotation of food tray, the effectual degree that reduces food tray wearing and tearing, and then reduced because the noise that food tray and cylinder body friction produced.

title_en: Reverse current generator
abstract_en: A reverse flow generator comprises a shell, a hydraulic motor, an impeller, a water inlet honeycomb rectifying plate, a flow guide plate and a water outlet honeycomb rectifying plate, wherein the hydraulic motor, the impeller, the water inlet honeycomb rectifying plate, the flow guide plate and the water outlet honeycomb rectifying plate are contained in the shell; the output shaft of the hydraulic motor is connected to the impeller to form a pumping device, a water inlet honeycomb rectifying plate is arranged in the water outlet direction of the impeller, a water sump is formed between the water inlet honeycomb rectifying plate and the water outlet honeycomb rectifying plate, a group of flow guide plates are arranged in the center of the water sump, and two ends of each flow guide plate are fixed to the shell; the rivers that the impeller was taken out pass through into water honeycomb cowling panel, guide plate and play water honeycomb cowling panel in proper order, from the upper strata of play water honeycomb cowling panel effluent water flow to swimming pool, form hydrologic cycle.

title_en: Novel mansion fan
abstract_en: A novel mansion fan comprises a machine body, an air channel and a supporting seat, wherein an air inlet part and an air blower are arranged in the machine body, and the air inlet part, the air blower and the air channel are sequentially communicated; the machine support seat is provided with a plurality of reinforcing ribs for reinforcing and stabilizing the support seat, and the machine support seat is also provided with an aroma box which is arranged close to the air inlet part; the design of the air channel enables the blowing area to be wider, the wind power to be more concentrated and the user to feel more comfortable when using the wind power generator; the fragrance box is arranged, so that blown air has fragrance, and the user experience is better; is provided with a limiting block and a convex block which prevent the champignon box from shifting and sliding out.

title_en: Durable fan heat dissipation axle center
abstract_en: The application discloses durable type fan heat dissipation axle center relates to fan heat dissipation technical field, improves the fan and leads to the easy problem that risees of temperature because of the frictional heat after long-time operation in the pivot, including the mounting panel, one side fixed mounting of mounting panel has the heat dissipation sleeve, the inside packing of heat dissipation sleeve has lubricating oil, the telescopic lateral wall fixed mounting of heat dissipation has seal bearing, seal bearing's inner wall fixed mounting has the pivot, the outer fixed surface of pivot is connected with spacing platform, the spacing groove with spacing platform looks adaptation is seted up to the telescopic inside wall of heat dissipation, the telescopic inside wall fixed mounting of heat dissipation has ball bearing, ball bearing's inner wall and pivot fixed connection. Lubricating oil in the heat dissipation sleeve can absorb friction heat generated by rotation of the rotating shaft, and meanwhile, the sealing bearing and the ball bearing can reduce the rotating friction force of the rotating shaft, so that the generation of the friction heat is reduced, and the service life of the rotating shaft is prolonged.

title_en: Portable high temperature and high humidity radioactive pollution gas emergency treatment device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mobile high-temperature high-humidity radioactive polluted gas emergency treatment device which comprises an air inlet, a heat exchange and dehumidification unit, a set A and a set B of nuclear grade air filtering and adsorbing units, a power unit, an auxiliary matching unit and an air outlet. The device can be arranged on an automobile base provided with a diesel generator set to move, and is transported to a site where sudden harmful gas leakage occurs according to use requirements, and radioactive gas with the temperature of less than or equal to 60 ℃ and the RH of less than or equal to 98% is treated in a staged and multi-link mode. The device is suitable for nuclear facilities, operating units, army and other nuclear-involved places to protect the health and safety of emergency personnel under the condition of nuclear accidents.

title_en: Valve for precision forming high-power engine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a precisely-formed high-power valve for an engine. The valve comprises a valve body, the both sides of valve body are equipped with the valve seat, the top of valve body is equipped with the valve stem, the both sides of valve stem are equipped with the screw hole to the car, the top of screw hole is equipped with the valve pipe, one side of valve pipe is equipped with the guiding hole, the top of valve pipe is equipped with the boss, the top of boss is equipped with the circular recess, the top of circular recess is equipped with the spring holder, the inside of spring holder is equipped with the recess. The utility model reduces the collision between the air valve and the air port, reduces the abrasion of the air port, prevents the spring seat and the air valve rod from falling off, enhances the connection effect between the air valve and the air port and effectively reduces the damage condition of the engine.

title_en: Vacuum blower
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a vacuum blower. A technique is applied in which the structure of the vacuum blower can be simplified and clean air can be blown out from the blow-out port. The vacuum blower may have: an electric motor; a 1 st fan, the 1 st fan being driven to rotate by the electric motor; a 1 st air passage, the 1 st air passage having an air inlet, air flowing in from the air inlet by rotation of the 1 st fan flowing in the 1 st air passage; a 2 nd fan that generates a flow of air that cools the electric motor; and a 2 nd air passage, the 2 nd air passage having an outlet, and through which air flows by rotation of the 2 nd fan. The outlet of the 2 nd air passage may be disposed adjacent to the inlet of the 1 st air passage.

title_en: Waste heat utilization device for generator set
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a waste heat utilization device of a generator set, which comprises a heat insulation component, wherein a locking mechanism is arranged on one side of the heat insulation component; the heat preservation subassembly includes the first heat preservation of a plurality of, first heat preservation one side articulates there is the second heat preservation, a plurality of spout has been seted up to first heat preservation and the inside of second heat preservation, the inboard sliding connection of spout has the slide, slide one side is fixed with the activity and runs through the bracing piece in first heat preservation and second heat preservation one side, bracing piece one side is fixed with the backup pad, through being equipped with a plurality of backup pad in the first pipeline outside, sets up the warning when corresponding alarm and the buzzer after the switch triggers, reminds staff this section of first pipeline inside to have steam to reveal for the workman in time discovers that the pipeline has the leakage, has improved the accuracy that the pipeline revealed the detection, has reduced the waste of vapor waste heat, has improved waste heat reutilization ratio, has reduced the power generation cost of power plant.

title_en: Ventilation device of axial flow fan
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of axial flow ventilators, in particular to a ventilation device of an axial flow ventilator, which comprises a casing, a motor, a plurality of support rods, a connecting rod and a hollow disc, wherein the output end of the motor is fixedly connected with a fixed disc, a plurality of blades are circumferentially arranged on the side surface of the fixed disc, one side of the fixed disc, which is far away from the motor, is fixedly connected with a sweeping device, one end of the connecting rod is fixedly connected with the axis of the fixed disc, the other end of the connecting rod is fixedly connected with the hollow disc, one side of the hollow disc is fixedly connected with a spray washing device, the utility model drives the fixed disc to rotate by starting the motor, drives a connecting rod to rotate, drives an inclined rod to rotate, drives a hairbrush to rotate and sweep a filter screen, drives the hollow disc to rotate by the inclined rod, drives a hollow long plate to rotate, simultaneously opens a water storage tank to enable cleaning water to flow through the hollow disc to the hollow long plate through a water pipe, and sprays the cleaning water to the filter screen through an atomization nozzle to match with the hairbrush to clean the filter screen, the effect of cleaning the filter screen to prevent the filter screen from accumulating dust is achieved.

title_en: Radiator and tractor
abstract_en: The utility model provides a radiator and a tractor. A heat sink, comprising: the core body is arranged between the upper water chamber and the lower water chamber and comprises a plurality of radiating pipes which are distributed at intervals and radiating belts which are arranged between adjacent radiating pipes and are attached to the radiating pipes; the radiating pipe is communicated with the upper water chamber and the lower water chamber; a plurality of partition plates are obliquely arranged in the radiating pipe, and divide the radiating pipe into a first flow passage, a second flow passage and a third flow passage, wherein the first flow passage and the second flow passage are in a right-angle trapezoid shape, and the third flow passage is in a trapezoid shape and is arranged between the first flow passage and the second flow passage in a staggered mode; and turbulence teeth for turbulence are arranged in the first flow channel, the second flow channel and the third flow channel. According to the utility model, the trapezoidal flow channels are arranged in the radiating pipe, so that the contact area of the cooling liquid and the inner surface of the radiating pipe is effectively increased, and the turbulence effect is further increased.

title_en: Air filter capable of automatically dropping ash
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an air filter capable of automatically dropping ash, wherein a filter element is inserted in a shell, the inner cavity of the shell is divided into a clean side and a dirty side, one end of the shell is provided with an end cover, the other end of the shell is provided with an air outlet, and the circumferential wall surface of the shell is provided with an air inlet; a first elastic pad is arranged between the front cover of the filter element and the shell, and a second elastic pad is arranged between the rear cover and the end cover; and limiting structures are arranged between the shell and the end cover and between the shell and the filter element. The two end parts of the filter element are fixed on the shell and the end cover through the elastic pads, the elastic pads can transmit the vibration received by the shell to the filter element and amplify the vibration at the filter element, and the vibration of the filter element can lead the dust impurities deposited on the surface of the filter paper to be vibrated down, thereby realizing the purpose of automatically falling dust, reducing the dust deposition amount deposited on the filter paper, prolonging the service life of the filter element and prolonging the shutdown maintenance period of the filter element.

title_en: Oil guide pipe and fuel filter
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of filters, and discloses an oil guide pipe and a fuel filter, which comprise: the air suction end of the exhaust pipe is positioned at the top of the inner cavity and is used for sucking the gas in the inner cavity of the filter element; the exhaust end of the exhaust pipe is positioned at the bottom of the inner cavity and is used for being connected with the electric pump. The outer wall of the exhaust pipe is provided with a connecting ring, and the connecting ring and the exhaust pipe are coaxially arranged. One side that the go-between is close to the blast pipe is equipped with the oil outlet, goes out the oil pipe and includes the oil inlet end and go out the oil end, goes out oil end and go-between fixed connection, makes the lumen of going out the oil pipe just to the oil outlet, guarantees that the fuel that gets into out the oil pipe can flow smoothly. The distance between the oil inlet end and the air suction end is not more than one fourth of the height of the filter element, and the height of the oil inlet end is raised, so that the clean fuel oil passing through the filter element is accumulated to a higher liquid level and can be discharged from the oil outlet pipe. Along with the rising of the fuel liquid level, the filter element is fully utilized, the utilization rate is improved, and the filter element replacement period is slowed down.

title_en: Heat dissipation valve plate seat
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a radiating valve plate seat, which comprises a body; the body comprises a bottom plate and a barrel body integrally and upwards extending from the surface of the bottom plate, a water inlet hole and a water outlet hole are formed in the bottom plate, the barrel body is provided with a containing cavity with an upward opening and communicated with the water inlet hole and the water outlet hole, and a plurality of radiating fins are integrally and outwards extending from the outer side wall of the barrel body. Through the integrative barrel that upwards extends on the bottom plate surface to an organic whole outwards extends on the lateral wall of cooperation barrel and has a plurality of heat radiation fins, makes the heat that the valve plate seat produced in the course of the work in time discharge through integrated into one piece's heat radiation fins, avoids the valve plate seat inside to make the sealing member receive the damage or even become invalid because of the thermal-arrest, does not need often to change the sealing member, has not only effectively improved the life of air compressor machine, has still reduced the use cost of air compressor machine.

title_en: Vertical dredge pump with prevent blockking up function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a vertical sewage pump with an anti-blocking function, which comprises a buffer seat, fixing plates and a sewage pump body, wherein the lower end of the sewage pump body comprises a water inlet pipe, a rotating shaft is rotatably installed in the water inlet pipe, blades are installed on the rotating shaft, the two fixing plates are symmetrically installed at the side end of the sewage pump body, a supporting seat is welded at the lower end of each fixing plate, the buffer seat is installed at the lower end of the supporting seat, a buffer cavity is arranged in the buffer seat, a second buffer spring is installed on the inner wall of the side end in the buffer cavity, first buffer springs which are symmetrically distributed are installed on the inner wall of the bottom end of the buffer cavity, a supporting plate is installed at the upper end of each first buffer spring, a buffer groove is formed in the upper end of the buffer seat, the supporting seat extends into the buffer cavity from the buffer groove, and the lower end of the supporting seat is in contact with the upper end face of the supporting plate. The utility model has the advantages of anti-blocking function, buffering and vibration damping function and capability of effectively prolonging the service life of equipment.

title_en: High stability automobile blower
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-stability automobile blower, which comprises an impeller, a driving motor and a mounting assembly, the impeller is connected with an output shaft of a driving motor, the driving motor comprises a mounting bottom plate, an annular bulge is arranged on one side of the motor housing of the mounting bottom plate, clamping strips are arranged around the annular bulge at intervals, an annular sleeve is arranged on the outer side of the annular bulge, a step which is clamped and matched with the clamping strip is arranged on the annular sleeve, a tray is arranged outside the annular sleeve, a waterproof rubber sleeve is arranged between the tray and the annular sleeve, an opening is arranged at one end of the waterproof rubber sleeve, and the opening part is provided with an arc bending part extending to the motor rear cover, the motor rear cover is provided with an insertion part for inserting the arc bending part, and the arc bending part is tightly pressed between the insertion part and the tray. The utility model has simple structure and reasonable design, and can effectively improve the waterproof performance of the fan.

title_en: Control system for discharging cleaning sewage of fan impeller of range hood
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a control system for discharging cleaning sewage of a fan impeller of a range hood, which comprises a fan volute, the fan impeller, a wind guide ring and a pressure difference sensor, wherein the fan impeller is assembled inside the fan volute, the wind guide ring is fixedly arranged at an air inlet of the fan volute, the control system also comprises a wind speed gear control device, the pressure difference sensor is arranged inside the fan volute, the pressure difference sensor is fixedly connected with the wind speed gear control device, the pressure difference sensor is provided with a main pipeline A and a main pipeline B, the main pipeline A is connected to the first inner side of the fan volute, and the main pipeline B is connected to the first outer side of the fan volute. The fan volute is simple in structure, the pressure difference between the first inner side and the first outer side of the fan volute is detected through the pressure difference sensor, the corresponding wind speed gear is adjusted according to the pressure difference, the cleaning sewage of the fan impeller is prevented from leaking out of the fan volute, and the cleaning sewage of the fan impeller is guaranteed to be smoothly discharged from the air channel.

title_en: Be applicable to semi-submerged barge and become draft constant voltage sea water supply device
abstract_en: The utility model is suitable for the technical field of seawater supply devices, and provides a constant-pressure seawater supply device suitable for semi-submersible barge variable draft, which comprises: a semi-submersible barge having: the utility model provides a be located the first tower of front end to and relative setting, and be located the tail tower of rear end, the semi-submersible is refuted and is still provided with the generator room, wherein, be provided with generating set in the generator room, and, the organic pump of taking of rigid coupling on the generating set, the bottom of semi-submersible is refuted still has a plurality of ballast tanks at the interval in proper order, and, the bottom of semi-submersible still is provided with a plurality of pump cabins, the embedded sea chest that is equipped with of pump cabin, the rigid coupling has a cooling pump on the sea chest, wherein, the delivery port intercommunication of cooling pump the water inlet of machine belt pump sets up the baffle-box in the generator room, and the capacity of baffle-box is greater than the cooling water consumption of generating set as far as possible, and pump cabin sea water cooling pump outlet pipeline connects to the baffle-box, and the water is got from the baffle-box to the generator set machine belt pump.

title_en: Solid medicine structure of engine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a medicine fixing structure of an engine, and belongs to the technical field of solid rocket engines. The utility model comprises a rear drug hanging plate, a drug column and an ignition device. The rear drug hanging plate is of a honeycomb structure, wherein the drug hanging part is of a counter bore structure with a limiting step, so that the rear drug hanging plate can play a role in positioning when a drug column is installed and can provide an exhaust channel; the non-medicine-hanging part is provided with through holes as many as possible, and the through holes are used as air passing channels. The rear drug hanging plate with the limiting step counter bore structure is used for charging, so that the requirements on drug fixing glue and a curing process are reduced, and the mounting reliability of the drug column is improved; the ignition device is arranged in front, a fire transfer system is optimized, the structural design requirement on the spray pipe blocking cover is reduced, and the optimization of the overall scheme is facilitated.

title_en: Single screw compressor capable of preventing lubricating oil from leaking
abstract_en: A single screw compressor capable of preventing lubricating oil from leaking comprises a rotor and a main bearing seat, wherein a groove body is arranged between the rotor and the main bearing seat.

title_en: Direct-current brushless mute circulating water pump
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a direct-current brushless mute circulating water pump which comprises a pump cover, a pump shell and a rear cover, wherein the pump shell is fixedly connected with the rear cover and the pump cover respectively, a water-isolating sleeve is also fixedly arranged in the pump shell, a first boss and a second boss are arranged on the water-isolating sleeve, a rotor mounting cavity and a shaft fixing cavity are respectively arranged in the first boss and the second boss, a solenoid is arranged on the outer side of the first boss, a control plate is arranged on the outer side of the second boss, a shaft is fixed in the shaft fixing cavity, a rotor matched with the shaft is arranged in the rotor mounting cavity, a plurality of arc-shaped impellers are uniformly arranged on the rotor, and the outer side surfaces of the impellers are oblique side surfaces; the rotor is in a suspension state all the time when rotating, noise generated by mechanical friction is reduced, the rotor and the rotor magnetic ring are molded together in an injection mode and are tightly attached to each other concentrically, water flow is intensively thrown out from the outer side face of the impeller when the rotor rotates, the effects of muting the water pump and quickly exhausting the inner cavity of the water pump are achieved, and in addition, the split structure of the pump shell and the rear cover facilitates filling and sealing in subsequent steps.

title_en: High-efficiency wind power generation device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a high-efficiency wind power generation device, which belongs to the technical field of wind power generation and comprises an outer fixing rod and an inner supporting rod, wherein the outer fixing rod is arranged in a hollow structure, the inner supporting rod is connected into the outer fixing rod in a penetrating manner, a plurality of transition blocks are arranged between the inner supporting rod and the outer fixing rod, one side of each transition block, which is deviated from the inner supporting rod, is connected with a spring rod in a penetrating manner, one end of each spring rod, which is far away from the transition blocks, is fixedly connected with a connecting plate, one side of each connecting plate, which is far away from the spring rod, is attached to the surface of the inner supporting rod, the surface of the outer fixing rod is connected with a plurality of adjusting screw rods in a penetrating manner, and the middle surface of each transition block is provided with an insertion hole penetrating through the transition block. This kind of high-efficient wind power generation set will carry out the member that supports to the blade and divide into two, makes this device when the in-service use, if the member takes place crooked, then can carry out convenient regulation to the member, makes it reform, and the practicality is strong.

title_en: Mechanical sealing structure for pump placed in liquid environment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a mechanical sealing structure for a pump, which is arranged in a liquid environment and comprises a shell, wherein a motor end sealing end cover divides an inner cavity of a pump body into a motor area and a fluid area, a motor pump shaft is rotatably arranged in the motor area, one end of the motor pump shaft penetrates through the motor end sealing end cover and extends into the fluid area, an impeller is fixedly sleeved on the periphery of the part of the motor pump shaft extending into the fluid area, a sealing assembly is arranged between the motor pump shaft and the motor end cover and consists of a rotating unit and a fixing unit, and the rotating unit comprises a sealing shell. The utility model has simple structure and small occupied space; the motor pump shaft and the sealing shell are sealed by the inner lip and the outer lip of the Y-shaped sealing ring, and the inner lip and the outer lip of the Y-shaped sealing ring are fixed and obtain sealing performance under the condition that the rotary ceramic ring is positioned relative to the sealing shell, so that an elastomer thin-wall cavity such as rubber is not needed as an axial sealing element.

title_en: Novel portable irradiation device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel portable irradiation device, which comprises an upright post, a fixed frame, a damping rotating shaft, a radiation lamp, a control panel, a power supply lead, a retraction mechanism and a limiting mechanism, wherein the retraction mechanism is arranged at the upper end of the upright post, a telescopic cylinder is retracted to drive a sliding shaft to slide at the inner side of a sliding chute, and a movable seat is used for driving a supporting seat to swing around a rotating seat, so that the supporting seat rotates clockwise by ninety degrees and is folded, and the advantage of convenient carrying and carrying of the irradiation device is achieved; through having set up stop gear in jack upper end, ninety degrees backs at the supporting seat swing can make the supporting seat imbed in the limiting plate inboard, make stopper and supporting seat lateral wall laminate mutually, resume the elastic potential energy of deformation through the pressure spring simultaneously, drive stopper and supporting seat and closely laminate, reached and to have reached the spacing fixed advantage of supporting seat.

title_en: Neck joint multi-angle hang neck fan
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a neck hanging fan with a neck joint in multiple angles, belonging to the technical field of articles for daily use, comprising a first fan and a second fan, the inner walls of the first fan and the second fan are both fixedly provided with fixed blocks, the side walls of the fixed blocks are provided with fixed grooves, the interior of the fixed groove is detachably provided with a butt-joint block, the side end of the butt-joint block is rotatably provided with a limit block, a connecting block is connected between the two limit blocks in a rotating way, the upper side wall of the fixed block is provided with a baffle plate in a contact way, the first fan and the second fan can be combined into a whole with a connecting piece consisting of the butt joint block, the limiting block and the connecting block through the fixed groove in the fixed block, the first fan or the second fan can be pulled through the mode of rotating connection between the butt joint block and the limiting block, the limiting block and the connecting block are rotatably connected to increase the adjusting angle, and therefore the angle can be adjusted according to the size of the neck.

title_en: Noise reduction device for natural gas compression mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model provides a natural gas compression mechanism is with making an uproar device of falling, the purpose is solved among the prior art natural gas compression mechanism and is produced the noise in the use, causes the problem of injury to surrounding environment and staff's health, provides a natural gas compression mechanism is with falling the device of making an uproar. This noise reduction device includes: the side wall of the box body is provided with a vent; the mounting seat is arranged in the box body, and the top of the mounting seat is provided with a mounting groove; the limiting cylinder is arranged in the mounting groove; the buffer spring is arranged in the limiting cylinder and is connected with the bottom of the mounting groove and the bottom of the natural gas compression mechanism; the baffle is arranged at the top of the natural gas compression mechanism; the shielding mechanism is arranged at the vent; wherein, the box from interior to exterior includes interior acoustic celotex board, guard plate and outer guard plate in proper order, is equipped with the vacuum chamber in the guard plate. The utility model discloses a set up buffer spring in the box, natural gas compression mechanism carries out the part through this buffer spring and eliminates at the noise of course because of rocking the production.

title_en: Fuel control device for engine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fuel control device for an engine, which relates to the technical field of engines and comprises a base body, wherein four corners of the base body are respectively hinged with a dynamic fixing plate through pin shafts, the upper surface of the base body is fixedly connected with an oil storage tank, the outer surface of the oil storage tank is sleeved with a square fixing frame, and the bottom surface of the square fixing frame is fixedly connected with the upper surface of the base body. It can be through setting up the oil distribution mechanism, can carry out evenly distributed to the fuel of engine, avoid fuel in the oil tank to take place to rock when equipment vibrations and lead to follow-up defeated oil pipe in can not receive the fuel supply, through setting up fuel feeding mechanism, can carry out high-efficient many mouthfuls of transport to fuel, the normal operating of each engine in the equipment has been guaranteed, through setting up the dynamic fixation board, can swiftly fix the device, the installation effectiveness of the improvement device, through setting up the booster, can carry out the pressure boost conveying to the fuel of oil bin inside, the efficiency of the fuel feeding is improved.

title_en: Novel blade angle wheel of special fan for livestock raising
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel blade angle wheel of a special fan for livestock raising, which comprises a blade angle wheel body, wherein a blade angle I and a blade angle II are arranged on the outer side of a wheel hub, blades are arranged on the outer sides of the blade angle I and the blade angle II, fixing clamping grooves are formed in the middles of the blade angle I and the blade angle II, springs are clamped in the fixing clamping grooves, blade angle connecting holes are formed in one ends of the blades, reinforcing plates are arranged at one ends of the blades, anti-slip pads are bonded at the bottom ends of the reinforcing plates, and marked arrows are carved on the surfaces of the reinforcing plates, a reinforcing threaded hole II is arranged in the middle of each reinforcing threaded hole II, a buffering gasket is clamped in the middle of each reinforcing threaded rod, a transverse reinforcing rod is welded on the surface of each blade, anti-slip grains are arranged on the surface of each transverse reinforcing rod, the reinforcing threaded rod plays a role in mounting and reinforcing the blades, and a role in fixing the transverse reinforcing rod is added, the service life of the fan blade is prolonged.

title_en: Novel fire pump
abstract_en: A novel fire pump comprises a water inlet pipe (2) and a water outlet pipe (3) which are installed on a pump body (1), an impeller (4) and a motor (5). A cooling water delivery port (6) is arranged on the water inlet pipe (2), and a circulation port (7) is arranged on the water outlet pipe (3); a cooling mechanism is arranged between the cooling water delivery port (6) and the circulation port (7); a gas concentration detector (12) is arranged on the top surface of the cooling mechanism, and a PLC (programmable logic controller) controller (13) and an alarm (14) are arranged on the front surface of the cooling mechanism; the PLC (13) is connected with the gas concentration detector (12) and the alarm (14). According to the utility model, the concentration of natural gas and toxic gas is measured by the gas concentration detector, and signals are transmitted to the PLC, so that the PLC drives the alarm to give an alarm when the concentration exceeds the concentration range, and fire-fighting measures are taken in time to avoid explosion or toxic danger.

title_en: Telescopic circulating fan capable of automatically swinging up and down
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of fans, in particular to a telescopic circulating fan capable of automatically swinging up and down, which comprises a fan head part, a connecting rod and a base, the fan head is arranged on the base through the connecting rod and comprises a front net, a rear net, fan blades and a control host, the control host is connected with the fan blades and is arranged in a cavity formed by connecting the front net and the rear net, the control host comprises a shell and a swing mechanism which is arranged in the shell and is used for driving the head part of the fan to swing up and down, the swing mechanism comprises a driving device, a driving gear, a driven gear and a connecting piece, the driving device is connected with the driving gear, the driven gear is meshed with the driving gear and is connected with the shell through the connecting piece, the driving device drives the driving gear to rotate, so that the driven gear drives the control host to swing up and down through the connecting piece.

title_en: Anti-rotation automobile water pump sealing ring
abstract_en: The utility model is suitable for the relevant technical field of automobiles, and provides an anti-rotation automobile water pump sealing ring, which comprises: the outer side of the mounting ring is provided with a limiting mechanism, the inner side of the bump is provided with a main sealing ring, the inner side of the main sealing ring is provided with an auxiliary sealing ring, and the inner side of the auxiliary sealing ring is provided with a water pump shell; the connecting ring is arranged on the left side of the auxiliary sealing ring, a fixing column is arranged at the right end of the connecting ring, the connecting sealing ring is arranged on the inner side of the connecting ring, a limiting ring is fixed at the left end of the connecting ring, and a blocking ring fixed on the outer side of the water pump shell is arranged on the right side of the connecting sealing ring; and the positioning ring is arranged on the outer side of the water pump shell, and a positioning block for limiting is fixed on the inner side of the positioning ring. The anti-rotation automobile water pump sealing ring provided by the utility model can avoid the rotation of the sealing ring, so that the possibility of poor sealing performance caused by rotation is avoided, and the anti-rotation automobile water pump sealing ring has better sealing performance.

title_en: Building fan
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of building appliances, and discloses a building fan which comprises a fan, wherein a head swinging mechanism is arranged on one side of the fan, a water spraying mechanism is arranged on the front surface of the head swinging mechanism, and a base is arranged at the bottom of the head swinging mechanism; the fan comprises an interface, a connecting block and a fan shell, one side of the fan shell is fixedly connected with one side of the interface, and one side of the connecting block is fixedly connected with one side of the fan shell; the swinging mechanism comprises a motor, a crank, a frame, a rocker, a fixing rod, a connecting rod, a motor shaft and a supporting box, one end of the rocker is fixedly connected with one end of a connecting block through a bolt, two ends of the fixing rod are fixedly connected to the inner wall of the supporting box, one side of the rocker is rotatably connected with one side of the connecting rod through a fixing pin, the fixing rod sequentially penetrates through the frame and the rocker, and one end of the rocker is rotatably sleeved with the fixing rod. Building fan dispels the heat through yaw mechanism to the not building body of co-altitude, and the water spray mechanism of installation makes cooling rate accelerate, improves cooling efficiency and can also reach the effect of washing fan self.

title_en: High-temperature-resistant heavy-load fluorine-lined magnetic pump
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a high-temperature-resistant heavy-load fluorine-lined magnetic pump which comprises a pump cavity mechanism, a transmission mechanism and a magnetic driving mechanism. The pump cavity mechanism comprises a pump cavity, a PEEK impeller and a PEEK pump cavity liner; the transmission mechanism comprises a silicon carbide pump shaft and a sliding bearing which is fixedly embedded in the bearing body and sleeved on the silicon carbide pump shaft, one end of the silicon carbide pump shaft is in transmission connection with the PEEK impeller, and the other end of the silicon carbide pump shaft penetrates through the bearing body and extends out; the magnetic driving mechanism comprises an inner rotor assembly, a PEEK isolating sleeve covering the outer part of the inner rotor assembly, an outer rotor assembly arranged outside the PEEK isolating sleeve and corresponding to the inner rotor assembly, and a driving motor in transmission connection with the outer rotor assembly, wherein the inner rotor assembly is sleeved on the extending end of the silicon carbide pump shaft. Compared with the prior art, the utility model adopts PEEK as the materials of the impeller, the lining and the isolation sleeve, can raise the temperature resistance to 200 ℃, enables the corrosion resistance and the mechanical strength of the magnetic pump to be higher, and is beneficial to expanding the application range of the pump.

title_en: Quick assembling and disassembling joint for marine beam structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a quick dismounting and mounting joint of a marine beam structure. When the marine beam structure quick assembling and disassembling connector is used, the connecting base and the beam structure are connected in a penetrating mode through the pin shaft, the whole marine beam structure quick assembling and disassembling connector is fixedly connected together through the fixing piece, and the beam structure and the whole marine beam structure quick assembling and disassembling connector are fixedly connected through friction force and gravity. The quick dismounting and mounting joint for the beam structure of the ship can solve the problem that the beam structure of the sound insulation cover is dismounted in a mode of limited maintenance time, is convenient to dismount and short in time consumption compared with the traditional joint mode, and can meet the maintenance requirements of modern ships. And the strength of the quick assembly disassembly joint of the marine beam structure meets the use requirement through modal, strength calculation and tests. The disassembly and assembly test time is examined on site, the disassembly and assembly time is greatly reduced, and the maintainability requirement of the diesel generating set is met.

title_en: Split type radiator for wind power generation set
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a split type radiator for a wind power generation set, which comprises a mounting plate, wherein a radiator body is movably mounted in the mounting plate, two mounting mechanisms are arranged on the front surface of the mounting plate, each mounting mechanism comprises two fixed bins which are fixedly connected with the front surface of the mounting plate, the left side and the right side of each fixed bin are movably connected with moving columns, one sides of the four moving columns, far away from the fixed bins, are fixedly connected with moving plates, one sides of the four moving plates, far away from the fixed bins, are fixedly connected with clamping blocks, and four positioning blocks are fixedly connected with the front surface of the mounting plate. This a split type radiator for wind power generation set through setting up installation mechanism, has realized the quick installation and the dismantlement of radiator body, and easy operation is convenient, need not to utilize the instrument alright carry out manual installation and dismantlement to the radiator body, has further improved staff's work efficiency.

title_en: Fan (Ref. TM. Fan)
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fan, which comprises a first shell, a second shell and a fan assembly, wherein the first shell and the second shell are mutually buckled to form an installation cavity with an air outlet channel, an air guide assembly is installed on the air outlet channel, and the fan assembly is installed in the installation cavity; the bottom end of the first shell is provided with a first dismounting piece which is detachably connected with a second dismounting piece connected to the support frame, the support seat or the clamping seat.

title_en: Electric shunt air valve of SPA hydrotherapy machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an electric shunt air valve of an SPA hydrotherapy machine, which comprises an SPA hydrotherapy machine shell and an electric shunt air valve mechanism, wherein the electric shunt air valve mechanism is positioned at the inner side of the SPA hydrotherapy machine shell, the electric shunt air valve mechanism comprises an electric air pump body, an air pipe is fixedly connected to the outer side of the electric air pump body, a fixed seat is fixedly connected to the outer side of the air pipe, an air outlet pipe is fixedly connected to the outer side of the air pipe, a clamping position is arranged at the inner side of the air pipe, a moving piston is movably connected to the inner side of the air pipe, an O-shaped sealing ring is movably connected to the outer side of the moving piston, and a motor is fixedly connected to the outer side of the air pipe. The system of the electric shunt air valve of the SPA hydrotherapy machine sends an instruction to the first motor to move anticlockwise, the rack on the first moving piston is pushed to move to the clamping position in the direction of the electric air pump body to seal the first air outlet pipe, and the electric air pump body is closed to finish the inflation task.

title_en: Dive sediment stuff pump convenient to clearance
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of liquid conveying, in particular to a submersible slurry pump convenient to clean, which comprises a main body, a base and a cleaning device, wherein the surface of the main body is fixedly connected with the base, the cleaning device is arranged on the surface of the main body, the cleaning device comprises a sliding rod, the sliding rod is fixedly connected with the surface of the main body, the surface of the sliding rod is slidably connected with a cleaning ring, the cleaning ring is slidably connected with the surface of the main body, the cleaning ring is vertically arranged, a pushing spring is fixedly connected between the cleaning ring and the main body, the pushing spring is vertically arranged, the pushing spring is sleeved on the surface of the sliding rod, the inner wall of the main body is rotatably connected with a rotating block, the surface of the rotating block is in a round angle, and the rotating block is clamped with the inner wall of the cleaning ring. According to the utility model, the submersible slurry pump is effectively cleaned by the cleaning device, the condition that the submersible slurry pump is damaged is reduced, the practicability of the submersible slurry pump is improved, the service life of the submersible slurry pump is prolonged, and the maintenance cost of the submersible slurry pump is reduced.

title_en: Container type gas engine set
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a container type gas unit, which comprises a container body, a generator set, a radiating pipe assembly and a radiator, wherein the radiator is arranged on the container body; wherein, the generator set and the radiating pipe assembly are integrated into a whole to form an integrated body; the integrated body is arranged in the container body; the radiator is positioned outside the container body and is arranged at the top of the container body; the radiating pipe assembly is communicated with a heat exchanging device and a radiator of the generator set so that cooling liquid circulates between the heat exchanging device and the radiator. The utility model is integrated into a whole, is convenient to transport, avoids the trouble of field installation and can be quickly put into use.

title_en: Automatic measuring device for flatness of swash plate shaft assembly for automobile air conditioner compressor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic measuring device for flatness of a swash plate shaft assembly for an automobile air-conditioning compressor, which comprises a base, a V-shaped seat, a positioning part, an axial limiting assembly, a radial limiting assembly, a measuring part and a photoelectric sensor, wherein the base is provided with a positioning hole; a slope surface is arranged at the bottom of one of the first supports; the utility model limits the mirror image movement of the rotating shaft which is installed and the swash plate shaft component through the combined action of the axial limiting component and the V-shaped seat, and utilizes the positioning component and the axial limiting component to axially position the rotating shaft, so as to stabilize the rotating shaft on the base, and utilizes the measuring component to complete the measurement of the flatness of the swash plate shaft component; compared with the conventional manual spot inspection mode, when the full-automatic detection device is used, only the rotating shaft and the swash plate shaft assembly are required to be arranged on the V-shaped seat, and the full-automatic measurement is carried out through the PLC control in the whole detection process, so that the online full inspection of the flatness of the swash plate shaft assembly is realized, the beat is fast, the precision is high, and the human errors are eliminated.

title_en: Double-suction pump set device installed in non-aligned mode
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a non-aligned double-suction pump set device which comprises a steel structure frame, wherein the steel structure frame comprises a frame base, a plurality of stand columns and a plurality of horizontal supporting rods; the double-suction pump set comprises a first water pump assembly and a second water pump assembly; the pipeline system comprises a first main pipeline, a second main pipeline and a branch pipeline assembly; the first main pipeline and the second main pipeline are respectively and fixedly arranged on the upper side of the horizontal strut; the first main pipeline and the second main pipeline are parallel relative to a first straight line direction and are arranged in parallel with each other, the water inlet ends and the water outlet ends of the first water pump assembly and the second water pump assembly are parallel relative to a second straight line direction and are arranged in a mutually reverse extending manner, and an included angle between the first straight line direction and the second straight line direction is an acute angle; the double-suction pump set is obliquely and laterally installed, so that the whole floor area of the device is reduced, and the space utilization rate is improved.

title_en: Reciprocating compressor crankcase respirator device
abstract_en: The present application relates to a reciprocating compressor crankcase breather arrangement comprising: the lower end of the lower short section assembly is connected with the top of the crankcase; the lower end of the upper short section component is connected with the upper end of the lower short section component; the wire mesh demister is arranged at the top of the upper short section assembly; the breathing cap is arranged at the upper end of the upper short section assembly; and the CO monitoring device is arranged on the breathing cap and used for monitoring CO gas entering the breathing cap from the crankcase through the lower short section assembly and the upper short section assembly. The device has the characteristics of oil leakage prevention and CO monitoring, improves the surrounding environment of the compressor and can eliminate hidden dangers.

title_en: Peristaltic pump type integrated motor
abstract_en: The utility model provides a peristaltic pump type integrated motor, and belongs to the technical field of motors. The utility model arranges the motor at one side of the pump body to form an integral structure, and arranges a plurality of interfaces which are communicated with the inner cavity and the outside on the pump seat of the pump body, after the pump base is installed, the transparent pipe is installed on the interface at the lowest part, so that after the rubber pipe in the body is leaked due to abrasion and wear-out in the subsequent use process, the liquid medium leaked into the inner cavity can flow to the interface at the lowest part and flow into the transparent pipe, and a user can directly observe the leakage problem through the transparent pipe, in addition, the cover plate on the opening of the inner cavity of the pump body is also set to be a transparent cover plate, so that a user can find the leakage problem and the working state of the pump head through the transparent cover plate, more intuitively acquire the state information of the pump body, so as to be maintained in time, avoid resource waste, eliminate potential safety hazards and facilitate the use and popularization of the peristaltic pump type integrated motor.

title_en: Centrifugal fan for thermal power plant
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a centrifugal fan for a thermal power plant, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein the top of the bottom plate is movably connected with a rotary column through a bearing, the top of the rotary column is fixedly connected with a U-shaped plate, the top of the U-shaped plate is fixedly connected with a circular box, a thick pipe is arranged in the circular box, the front wall of the thick pipe penetrates through the inner wall of the front side of the circular box, two annular blocks arranged along the front-back direction are arranged behind the thick pipe, a driving motor is arranged behind the circular box, the top and the bottom of the driving motor are both fixedly connected with an L-shaped rod, the front end of the L-shaped rod is fixedly connected with the rear wall of the circular box, and the front end of an output shaft of the driving motor is fixedly connected with a rotary rod. The utility model has the characteristics of convenient rotation, convenient wind direction adjustment and the like through a series of structures.

title_en: Fan bearing box with good sealing performance
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a fan bearing box with good sealing performance.A left end and a right end of a box body are respectively and fixedly provided with an end cover, the end covers are provided with round holes for main shafts to penetrate through, and sealing rings are arranged between the round holes and the main shafts; the outer side of the end cover is provided with a round platform which is coaxial with the main shaft, one end of the round platform, which is far away from the box body, is coaxially provided with a round groove, one end of the round platform, which is far away from the box body, is also detachably provided with a round cover body, one side of the round groove, which is close to the box body, is coaxially provided with a first round groove, one side of the first round groove, which is close to the box body, is coaxially provided with a second round groove, an annular sealing sleeve is arranged between the second round groove and the main shaft, the inner wall of the sealing sleeve is uniformly provided with a plurality of oil slingers which protrude inwards at intervals at the left and right, and oil absorbent cotton is arranged between the first round groove and the main shaft; the sealing sleeve and the oil absorption cotton are both arranged in the circular groove on the outer side of the end cover, so that the cover body is conveniently detached from the circular table, and the sealing sleeve and the oil absorption cotton are conveniently replaced.

title_en: Anti-creep electric retractable door
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-climbing electric retractable door which comprises a machine head, a main material frame and an auxiliary material frame, wherein the main material frame is arranged on one side of the machine head, the auxiliary material frame is arranged on one side, away from the machine head, of the main material frame, the main material frame and the auxiliary material frame are connected through a cross rod, driven wheels are respectively arranged at the bottoms of the front surface and the back surface of the main material frame, a butt joint seat is arranged on one side of the driven wheel on the front surface of the main material frame, and a first bevel gear is arranged inside the butt joint seat. This anti-creep electric telescopic door, drive the flexible expansion of main work or material rest and auxiliary material rest through the aircraft nose, the positive follow driving wheel of main work or material rest is when rotating, the slider on the drive transfer line of second bevel gear rises, and the extrusion of the first scraper blade and the second scraper blade of slider one side through the torsional spring is opened and can be prevented outside personnel from climbing, and then make things convenient for this electric telescopic door to have high-efficient anti-creep structure when closing the door, it can keep off the rain to set up the air inlet cover that the opening faces down to the air intake of fan, can carry out the protection against insects through the setting of filter screen.

title_en: Impeller, fan system applying same and range hood
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an impeller, which comprises a front disc, a rear disc and a middle disc arranged between the front disc and the rear disc, wherein blades are connected between the front disc and the rear disc, and the impeller is characterized in that: the outlet angle of the joint of the blade and the front disc ranges from 160 degrees to 170 degrees, and the outlet angle of the joint of the blade and the rear disc ranges from 170 degrees to 173 degrees. Also discloses a fan system applying the impeller and a range hood applying the fan system. Compared with the prior art, the utility model has the advantages that: the design that the outlet end of the blade forms the variable outlet angle can inhibit and rectify the flow of the wake of the shedding vortex, further reduce the noise caused by pressure pulsation and wake vortex and improve the noise quality.

title_en: Nursing device for multiple births
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a nursing device for multiple births for infants, and relates to the technical field of nursing for infants. The nursing device for the multiple births comprises a frame and an air outlet mechanism, wherein the frame is provided with nursing beds, and the number of the nursing beds is two. This many births are with nursing device for child raising, can effectually ensure after closing the protection casing, the inside air of nursing bed can flow, the inside air current of nursing bed is not smooth and easy after avoiding closing the protection casing, produce stifled and lead to the baby to produce uncomfortable condition, thereby can improve the effect of baby's nursing, simultaneously can effectually shelter from the wind that the fan produced through setting up of wind scooper, the wind of avoiding the fan to produce directly blows the baby and makes the baby health produce uncomfortable sense, can be located the top of protection casing when steam produces simultaneously, set up like this and blow off steam that can be better, improve the effect that nursing bed and protection casing inside air flow.

title_en: Water ring type vacuum pumping system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water ring type vacuumizing system which comprises a cooler, a plurality of water ring vacuum pumps, a steam-water separator and a heat exchanger, wherein the cooler is arranged at an air inlet; the water ring vacuum pump is communicated with the cooler through an air inlet pipe, and a filter is arranged at the joint of the water ring vacuum pump and the air inlet pipe; the water ring vacuum pump is communicated with the steam-water separator through an exhaust pipe and is used for separating compressed gas from working liquid; and the water ring vacuum pump is connected with the heat exchanger and used for cooling the working liquid of the water ring vacuum pump. This pumping system cools down the gas that gets into in the water ring vacuum pump through the heat exchanger earlier, and the gas temperature that gets into in the water ring vacuum pump is lower, improves water ring vacuum pump's life-span. In addition, impurities in the gas are filtered out through the filter before entering the water ring vacuum pump after the gas is cooled, the internal structure of the pump is prevented from being damaged by the impurities, the fault rate of the water ring vacuum pump is reduced, and the production efficiency is improved.

title_en: Friction winch for high-altitude wind power generation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a friction winch for high-altitude wind power generation, which comprises a rack, a winding drum mechanism, a gear box and a driving mechanism, wherein the winding drum mechanism is arranged on the rack; the winding drum mechanism is arranged on the rack; the output side of the gear box is connected with the winding drum mechanism; the output side of the driving mechanism is connected with the input side of the gear box; and a damping brake is arranged on the gear box. The utility model can meet the complicated and changeable working condition of high-altitude wind power generation.

title_en: Water suction pump base of fertilizer production line
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a water suction pump base of a fertilizer production line, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a sound insulation and shock absorption mechanism is arranged on the upper surface of the bottom plate, the sound insulation and shock absorption mechanism comprises a sound insulation box fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the bottom plate, a slide rail is fixedly arranged on the lower surface of an inner cavity of the sound insulation box, an installation plate is movably arranged on the upper surface of the slide rail, a shock stopping plate is fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the installation plate, adjusting rods inserted into the sound insulation box are movably arranged on the left surface and the right surface of the sound insulation box, and a rubber pad is fixedly arranged at one end, positioned in the sound insulation box, of each adjusting rod. This fertilizer production line's suction pump base through set up sound-proof box, soundproof cotton on the bottom plate, can be effectual adsorb the noise that the suction pump during operation produced, has reduced the production of noise from the source, installs the rubber pad simultaneously on sound-proof box and mounting panel and ends the board that shakes, can cushion the vibrations that the suction pump during operation produced, can improve suction pump's stability.

title_en: Wind power generation equipment with cleaning function
