abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wind power generation device with a cleaning function; comprises a base; a pillar body is arranged in the middle of the top of the base, a fixing ring is arranged on the top of the pillar body, a power generation assembly is arranged on the top of the fixing ring, and ash removal assemblies are arranged in the middle of two sides of the top of the base; the ash removal component comprises a servo motor fixed on one side of the top of the base and a first threaded rod arranged at the output end of the servo motor, a first belt pulley is sleeved on the outer side of the first threaded rod, a second threaded rod is arranged at the middle position of one side, away from the servo motor, of the top of the base, a second belt pulley is sleeved on the outer side of the second threaded rod, and belts are sleeved on the outer sides of the first belt pulley and the second belt pulley; according to the utility model, through the mutual matching among the servo motor, the first belt pulley, the first threaded rod, the second belt pulley, the belt, the first ash removal ring and the second ash removal ring, the dust on the surface of the support column body can be cleaned, and the support column body is prevented from being corroded by the dust.

title_en: Fan lamp
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fan lamp which comprises a first shell, a driving motor, a light source module and fan blades, wherein the first shell is provided with a first opening; the driving motor comprises a second shell and a motor shaft, the first shell comprises a central area combined with the second shell, the central area and the second shell form a shell of the driving motor, the motor shaft penetrates through the central area and the second shell along the height direction, the first shell further comprises a fan blade mounting disc area which extends outwards from the edge of the central area and exceeds the coverage area range of the second shell, and the fan blades are assembled in the fan blade mounting disc area; a first fall along the height direction exists between the central area and the fan blade mounting disc area, and the fan blade mounting disc area and the first shell are positioned on the same side of the central area; the second shell and the first shell can rotate around the motor shaft; the motor shaft possesses the first end that stretches out downwards, first end and light source module fixed connection. The problem that the fan lamp assembly degree of difficulty is great can be solved to above-mentioned scheme.

title_en: Miniature plunger foam pump
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a micro plunger foam pump which comprises a pump body, wherein a cylinder body is horizontally fixed in the pump body, a first cavity is formed in the cylinder body, a piston assembly which is connected with the first cavity in a sliding mode is arranged in the first cavity, a groove is formed in the top of the pump body, an air-water hinge is horizontally arranged in the groove, a first annular groove is formed in the left side of the air-water hinge, a second annular groove is formed in the right side of the air-water hinge, an air-water valve head is fixed in the groove, a first water inlet is formed in the left side of the groove, a first air inlet is formed in the right side of the groove, the first water inlet and the first air inlet are communicated in the first cavity, a second water inlet is formed in the left side of the air-water valve head, a second air inlet is formed in the right side of the air-water valve head, a first through hole is formed in the left side of the top of the cylinder body, and a second through hole is formed in the right side of the top of the cylinder body.

title_en: Water-cooled type screw vacuum pump
abstract_en: The utility model provides a water-cooled spiral vacuum pump, and relates to the technical field of screw vacuum pumps. The spiral vacuum pump comprises a pump body bearing seat; the vacuum pump comprises a vacuum pump body and a vacuum pump body, wherein the vacuum pump body comprises a vacuum pump shell arranged on the pump body bearing seat, a screw assembly is rotationally arranged in the vacuum pump shell and comprises a left-handed screw and a right-handed screw which are mutually rotationally matched, the left-handed screw and the right-handed screw are mutually arranged in parallel, a cooling cavity is arranged on the shell wall of the vacuum pump shell, and a water filling port and a water discharging port which are communicated with the cooling cavity are formed in the outer side of the vacuum pump shell; and the driving motor is arranged on the pump shell of the vacuum pump, and an output shaft of the driving motor is in transmission connection with the screw assembly. The utility model improves the heat dissipation effect of the spiral vacuum pump.

title_en: Multifunctional combined sound-proof housing for small centrifugal fan
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional combined sound-proof cover for a small centrifugal fan, which is a frame and door plate combined structure, wherein a vertical three-dimensional structure is built by taking 12 steel frames (13) as edges, a left side plate (5), a right side plate (3), a rear cover plate (7) and a top cover plate (1) are fixedly assembled, and a front door plate (2) is installed to form a fully-closed three-dimensional cover body. The product is assembled by modules, can be repeatedly disassembled and assembled and is not easy to deform; the sound-proof shield adopts an external insulation and internal absorption mode, so that the sound insulation and absorption quantity is large, and the heat dissipation effect is good; and, at the door plant and centrifuge's air-supply line and the linking position of going out the tuber pipe, adopt original semicircular to embrace pad (15), be aided with soft shock attenuation acoustic material, thoroughly stopped these two places by the syllable-dividing dead angle of having a long time of depositing, made the effect that gives sound insulation promote by a wide margin.

title_en: Air inlet manifold without air distribution pipe
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an air inlet manifold without a gas distribution pipe, wherein an air inlet is formed in one side of the air inlet manifold and communicated with a throttle valve, a gas distribution port is formed in the bottom of the air inlet manifold and communicated with a cylinder, and the bottom of the air inlet manifold is connected with a cylinder cover. The bottom of the utility model is provided with the air distribution port, and the bottom is connected with the cylinder cover, thus omitting the air distribution pipe, reducing the space occupied by the intake manifold and being capable of completing installation in a very small installation space.

title_en: Plunger of timing chain tightener and timing chain tightener
abstract_en: The utility model provides a plunger of a timing chain tensioner and the timing chain tensioner. The plunger of the timing chain tightener comprises a first annular groove, a second annular groove and a third annular groove which are sequentially arranged; the first annular groove is positioned on one side close to the top of the plunger; wherein the second annular groove has a first sidewall and a second sidewall, the first sidewall and the second sidewall having an included angle of greater than or equal to 90 °; the first side wall has a first guide portion located at an end of the first side wall, the second side wall has a second guide portion located at an end of the second side wall; the first clamping ring positioned in the second annular groove can enter the first annular groove through the first guide part, and the second clamping ring positioned in the second annular groove can enter the third annular groove through the second guide part, so that the plunger is prevented from being reassembled under incorrect operation, and the problems of abnormal sound or tooth jumping and the like of an engine are further avoided.

title_en: Scroll compressor with axial compensation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a scroll compressor with axial compensation, which comprises a housing, be equipped with the deciding vortex in the casing, move vortex and rotation driving device, decide the vortex and move the mutual interlock of vortex, rotation driving device includes the main shaft and sets up the eccentric shaft on the main shaft top, it is equipped with the blind hole to move the vortex bottom, install the bearing in the blind hole, the eccentric shaft inserts in the bearing and moves the vortex hookup, the top of eccentric shaft has the support end, support the end and support on the bottom of blind hole, and only bear the eccentric shaft and move the relative extrusion force of vortex by supporting the end, it is in on the axis of eccentric shaft to support the end center, be equipped with the axial squeezer that exerts axial thrust to the main shaft in the casing, can upwards promote the main shaft through the axial squeezer, it is automatic with the deciding vortex laminating to make the vortex, the compensation moves the wearing and tearing volume between vortex and the deciding the vortex.

title_en: Fan with alarm structure for fire protection and smoke discharge
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a fan technical field especially relates to a fire control is discharged fume with fan that is equipped with alarm structure. The technical scheme comprises the following steps: frame, dryer, hoop and U type pole, the lower skin weld of dryer has the supporting seat, the inside of dryer is equipped with the flabellum, the one end outer wall at the dryer is installed to the hoop, the welding of intermediate position department of hoop has the fixing base, the connecting plate is installed through the bolt to the upper surface of fixing base, the upper surface of connecting plate has U type pole through the bolt fastening, the one end that the connecting plate was kept away from to U type pole is located the dryer inside and the welding has wide board, temperature sensor, audible-visual annunciator are installed respectively through the bolt to the lower surface of wide board, temperature sensor, audible-visual annunciator are located the oblique top of frame. The utility model discloses a cooperation between the structure can effectually add the warning structure on the fan, reminds personnel to make the adjustment to the scene, satisfies personnel's user demand.

title_en: Air suspension centrifugal fan output regulation control device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of air suspension centrifugal fans, and discloses an air suspension centrifugal fan output regulation control device, which comprises an intelligent touch controller main body, wherein the outer surface of the intelligent touch controller main body is provided with a fixed mounting assembly, the inside of the fixed mounting assembly is provided with a heat exchange assembly, and a heat dissipation assembly is arranged below the heat exchange assembly; through setting up the fixed mounting subassembly, when intelligent touch controller main part takes place to damage and need maintain, only need hold anti-skidding groove anticlockwise rotation, the threaded rod rotates at two threaded sleeve's inside anticlockwise this moment, cause the second joint frame slowly become the pine to the joint of intelligent touch controller main part, when intelligent touch controller main part can be in first joint frame and the inside activity of second joint frame, alright take out intelligent touch controller main part from first joint frame and the inside of second joint frame and maintain, thereby realized the purpose to the convenient dismantlement of intelligent touch controller main part.

title_en: Valve collet structure, engine and equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of engines, in particular to a valve collet structure, an engine and equipment. The valve collet structure comprises a spring seat, two collet clamps and a retainer ring; the spring seat is provided with a through hole for the valve to pass through, and the two locking clamps are symmetrically arranged between the valve and the spring seat; the check ring is positioned in the through hole and arranged between the two locking clamps and the spring seat, the check ring is provided with a first locking surface for locking the locking clamps, and the through hole is provided with a second locking surface for locking the locking clamps; when the spring seat is acted by an acting force along the first direction, the check ring moves along the first direction, and the first locking surface is matched with the locking clamp to enable the locking clamp to lock the valve; when the retaining ring is invalid, the spring receives the effort along first direction, and second locking surface and first locking surface all cooperate with the collet, and the collet locks the valve. The valve collet structure in this application can also make the valve rotate when pressing from both sides tight valve, and can not break down.

title_en: Pump valve with protective structure
abstract_en: The application discloses pump valve with protective structure relates to pump valve technical field, including the bottom plate, the roof intermediate position department of bottom plate is fixed with the pump valve body, and the four corners position of bottom plate roof all is provided with vertical flexible supporting component, and the roof position of four vertical flexible supporting component of group is fixed with the roof, and the four corners position of roof all is fixed with the backing plate, and four backing plate roof of group all rotate through the bearing and are connected with the installation component, and the upper end that four installation component of group are close to one side lateral wall each other is fixed with the metal chain net. This application is when the bulky foreign object that drops in the top, article drop prevent directly drop to the pump valve body on the metal chain net, owing to adopt the chain net to weave simultaneously and form, prevent that article from dropping on the roof and the bullet is to other places and the person of hindering that splashes, when the small-size foreign object that drops in the top, article drop collect in the roof inner chamber to avoid on the foreign object of volume difference directly drops the pump valve body, avoid causing the damage to the pump valve body.

title_en: Flue gas pipeline corrosion prevention device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a flue gas pipeline corrosion prevention device, including ventilation blower, hot wall flue, waterproof flange, the ventilation blower carries out anticorrosive sealing connection with hot wall flue through waterproof flange, the ventilation blower includes casing, impeller, motor, the casing has the inner chamber, the impeller is set up in the inner chamber with the mode that can rotate, the motor is connected with the impeller, provides power support for the rotation of impeller, the internal surface of casing, the outer wall of impeller all set up the anticorrosive coating, the casing sets up drain; the utility model discloses a set up the anticorrosive coating with casing internal surface, impeller outer wall, can carry the wet flue gas in-process of low temperature at the ventilation blower, carry out the inside whole anticorrosive of ventilation blower to condensate water effectively, even acid condensate liquid, simultaneously through setting up drain, can in time discharge the condensate liquid that collects effectively in the ventilation blower inner chamber, avoid the condensate liquid to cause the interference to the operation of ventilation blower to the guarantee ventilation blower can continuously function effectively.

title_en: Cotton yarn processing is with inhaling cotton fan
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cotton suction fan for cotton yarn processing, which belongs to the technical field of cotton yarn processing, one end of a cotton suction air pipe is closed, the other end is connected with a fan through a cotton filter box, suction heads are equidistantly distributed on the cotton suction air pipe, a through groove is arranged in the cotton filter box, one end of the cotton suction air pipe is connected with the cotton suction air pipe, the other end is connected with a fan air suction inlet, at least two filter screens are inserted in the through groove, an opening is arranged below one side of each filter screen, which is close to the cotton suction air pipe, a brush strip is arranged in the opening, the top of the brush strip is provided with a plurality of brush wires, a connecting rope is bound on the hook, one end of the connecting rope penetrates and extends out of the top of the cotton filter box, the extending end of the connecting rope is connected with a motor, a collecting box is arranged below the opening, the cotton filter box at the cotton suction inlet of the cotton suction fan is generally a single-layer filter screen, manual disassembly and cleaning are needed, and when the filter screens are disassembled, the problem that cotton yarn broken fiber directly enters the inside of the fan is easily caused.

title_en: Novel oil seal device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel oil seal device, which is provided with an oil seal movable ring, an oil seal static ring, a fastening ring, a spring, a movable ring seal and a static ring seal, wherein the oil seal static ring is arranged in a bearing seat and is sealed by the static ring seal, the oil seal movable ring is arranged on a pump shaft and is sealed with a shaft by the movable ring seal, the oil seal movable ring and the oil seal static ring are firstly sealed and are jointed with the static ring seal by the movable ring seal, the compensation is carried out by the spring, and the movable ring seal and the static ring seal relatively operate to prevent the leakage of lubricating oil; the second seal of the oil seal movable ring and the oil seal static ring is sealed through labyrinth seal between the oil seal movable ring and the oil seal static ring, leaked trace lubricating oil flows back to the bearing seat through the oil return hole, and the oil seal prevents the lubricating oil from leaking outside through the two seals, so that the lubricating oil is ensured to be free of leakage. The utility model has the characteristics of simple structure, very big degree prevents lubricating oil outwards to leak, and the oil blanket can be used for a long time, reduces maintenance cost, improves life.

title_en: Radial steam sealing device between outer ring of steam turbine partition plate and moving blade surrounding belt
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of steam turbines, in particular to a radial steam sealing device between an outer ring of a steam turbine clapboard and a moving blade surrounding belt, which comprises an outer ring of the clapboard, a static blade, a clapboard body and a moving blade, wherein the static blade is welded between the outer ring of the clapboard and the clapboard body; dig the recess on the baffle outer loop, the mode that sets up radial gland strip seals the clearance between baffle outer loop and moving blade shroud, realize the radial gland seal between baffle outer loop and moving blade shroud, become radial gland seal by axial gland seal like this, make steam turbine rotating part and static part have had sufficient axial safety clearance between, even move back sound clearance because the thermal expansion or installation error diminish also have sufficient clearance, the sealed effect has also been promoted simultaneously, thereby make the steam leakage volume of steam passage fall to minimumly, this kind sets up the design among the prior art, the leakproofness is better, the steam leakage volume of steam passage is littleer, the interference to the main stream of steam turbine is littleer, the security is higher, and compact structure, and convenient processing.

title_en: Cylinder head cover of integrated silencer and automobile
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of silencers, in particular to a cylinder head cover of an integrated silencer and an automobile, wherein the cylinder head cover of the integrated silencer comprises a cylinder head cover, an air inlet pipe, an air outlet pipe and a cover plate, and a silencer groove is concavely arranged on the inner side of the cylinder head cover; the air inlet pipe and the air outlet pipe are both communicated with the muffler groove at the outer side of the cylinder head cover; the cover plate is connected to the cylinder cover and covers the muffler groove, the cover plate and the inner wall of the muffler groove are enclosed to form a muffling cavity, the cover plate and the cylinder cover are tightened through bolts to form a closed cavity, and the joint direction of an air pressure air inlet pipe and an air outlet pipe on the cylinder cover is determined according to the arrangement position of an air compressor. The utility model provides a cylinder head cover of integrated silencer becomes the silencer structure through the sealed silencer groove of apron, covers the silencer direct integration at the cylinder head, the effectual manufacturing and installation cost who saves the silencer.

title_en: Pneumatic cooling fan for compressor
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a compressor cooling arrangement technical field, specifically speaking relates to a pneumatic cooling fan for compressor. Comprises a fan shell, a fan component and a driving device; the fan assembly comprises a fan blade seat and a plurality of fan blades, and a fan blade shaft is fixed in the fan blade seat; the driving device is an airflow motor and comprises an airflow motor stator and an airflow motor rotor; an air inlet interface and an air outlet interface are fixed on the airflow motor stator; the rotor of the airflow motor comprises a rotating shaft, an upper bearing assembled at one end of the rotating shaft, an upper seal, a lower bearing assembled at the other end of the rotating shaft and a lower seal; the fan blade shaft is in transmission connection with the rotating shaft. The utility model discloses change drive arrangement in traditional cooling blower into the air current motor by the motor, in the course of the work, the air current motor does not have power consumption, and no pollutant discharges, really realizes energy-concerving and environment-protective, moreover, greatly reduced the material of complete machine use and manufacturing cost, simplified the equipment of production technology and complete machine, the suitability is strong.

title_en: Filtering mechanism for water pump input end in municipal sewage treatment
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of sewage treatment device, especially, be a filtering mechanism for water pump input end among municipal sewage treatment, including installing the filtration frame on water pump body inlet port, the inboard of filtering the frame is adapted to be equipped with detachable filtration, filter the frame and include the framework of fixed connection on water pump body inlet port to and set up the joint that is used for with outside water piping connection in framework one side, the inner wall integrated into one piece of framework has two guard plates of symmetric distribution to the T shape track that runs through to the framework top is all seted up to two guard plates. The utility model discloses an installation detachable filtration on filtering the frame, when needing to filter the change clearance of ball, filter, only need extract the pin rod take out filtration can, installation stability is good, realizes the effective processing of sewage, has solved that the current stage dismouting portable is not good, and inconvenient ball, the filter of crossing is changed the problem of clearance.

title_en: Time determination system for gas turbine
abstract_en: The utility model provides a time confirms system (100) for gas turbine. The system (100) comprises: a signal generation unit (110) configured to provide a direct voltage output signal; a frequency converter (120) connected to the signal generation unit and the protection device (140) and configured to receive the direct voltage output signal from the signal generation unit, determine a voltage value of the direct voltage output signal, determine a frequency value corresponding to the voltage value, provide the frequency output signal to the protection device; a time determination device (130) connected to the signal generation unit and the protection device and configured to receive the direct voltage output signal from the signal generation unit and the response signal from the protection device, determine a first time at which the direct voltage output signal having the specific voltage value is received and a second time at which the response signal is received. By presenting the continuously varying frequency signal as a voltage signal that jumps, it is convenient to determine the time difference from the occurrence of an overspeed of the gas turbine to the execution of a protective action by the protection device.

title_en: Automatic drainage system of heating power pipe network inspection well
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a heating power pipe network inspection shaft automatic drainage system, including main steam conduit, inspection shaft and the sump pit that is formed in the inspection shaft still be provided with steam water pumper and controller in the inspection shaft, the steam intake branch pipe of steam water pumper with main steam conduit links to each other be provided with the stop valve on the steam intake branch pipe, the inlet tube of steam water pumper stretches into the bottom of sump pit, the drain connection of steam water pumper is to the drainage shaft nearby still be provided with level sensor in the sump pit, this level sensor with the signal input part of controller links to each other, the signal output end group of controller with the control end electricity of steam water pumper, stop valve is connected. The remarkable effects are as follows: the steam is used as power to automatically discharge accumulated water in a sump of the inspection well of the heating power pipe network, so that the heating power pipe network can be safely and reliably operated.

title_en: Fan spring shock pad for low-noise centrifugal fan
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fan spring shock pad for low noise centrifugal fan, the on-line screen storage device comprises a base, the lower extreme of base is provided with damper, damper is including the fixed plate of fixed setting at the base lower extreme, the fixed mount that is provided with in front end of fixed plate, the inboard activity of mount is provided with the fixed block, the inside activity of fixed block is provided with the loose axle, the fixed regulating box that is provided with of lower extreme of fixed block, the fixed support frame that is provided with of lower extreme of fixed plate, one side activity of support frame is provided with the connecting plate. A fan spring shock pad for low noise centrifugal fan, thereby the elastic action through buffer spring makes the moving speed of movable plate reduce and makes the rotatory angle of regulating plate reduce and make the rotation angle of fixed plate reduce and reach the purpose that the fixed plate has absorbing effect to the motor.

title_en: Static milk making device of single-cylinder piston pump
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a static system milk device of single cylinder piston pump, including premixing mechanism, premixing mechanism discharge port and tee bend inlet pipe feed port intercommunication set up, the tee bend inlet pipe passes through single cylinder piston pump and tee bend discharging pipe intercommunication setting, tee bend discharging pipe discharge port and transportation inlet pipe feed port intercommunication set up, transportation inlet pipe discharge port and transportation discharging pipe feed port intercommunication set up, transportation discharging pipe discharge port sets up in steel band cooling body top. The utility model discloses the productivity can reach 10t/h in the product type emulsion explosive of producer, and the productivity can reach 25t/h in the type emulsion explosive that loads in mixture at the scene, can effectively realize serialization, automated production, and the apparatus for producing that has relatively simultaneously has higher security.

title_en: Installation device and vehicle of sprayer
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the vehicle assembly, a installation device and vehicle of sprayer is disclosed. The mounting device of the oil sprayer is used for mounting the oil sprayer on a cylinder cover of an engine cylinder and comprises a pressing rod, a positioning rod and a connecting rod, wherein a pressing cover is arranged at one end of the pressing rod, and one side, away from the pressing rod, of the pressing cover is matched with the upper part of the oil sprayer; one end of the positioning rod is provided with a connecting structure, and the positioning rod is connected to the cylinder cover through the connecting structure; the connecting rod is connected with one end of the positioning rod, which is far away from the connecting structure, and one end of the pressing rod, which is far away from the gland, is acted by force, which is close to the end of the pressing rod, which is far away from the positioning rod, of the connecting rod, so that the gland is driven to press the oil sprayer, and the oil sprayer is installed on the cylinder cover. The utility model provides a mounting device and vehicle of sprayer can avoid strikeing and cause the sprayer to take place to squint, warp, guarantees that the sprayer installation targets in place, makes the labour saving and operation simultaneously.

title_en: Petrol engine cooling water pump impeller assembly
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of water pump impellers, and discloses a gasoline engine cooling water pump impeller assembly, which comprises a hub, a shaft sleeve and a blade assembly, wherein the hub sleeve is arranged on the shaft sleeve, the hub is arranged into a hollow cylinder body, the blade assembly is arranged into a threaded backward-bending structure, the blade assembly is arranged into a plurality of blades, and the blade assembly is arranged on the outer surface of the hub; the hub is provided with a rear cover plate, the rear cover plate is provided with a front cover plate through a connecting column, the front cover plate is provided with a first water inlet, and the rear cover plate is in seamless connection with the hub; the blade assembly, the front cover plate and the rear cover plate form gaps to form a water outlet. The blade assembly comprises a guide vane, a diffusion vane and a third vane, wherein the area of the diffusion vane is larger than that of the guide vane, and the area of the third vane is larger than that of the diffusion vane. title_en: Energy-saving, efficient and environment-friendly drinking water pump
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an energy-conserving high-efficient environmental protection drinking water pump relates to drinking water production technical field, including the main part device, the main part device is including loading shock attenuation unit, syllable-dividing protection unit and closed unit, syllable-dividing protection unit is located load the top of shock attenuation unit, closed unit is located one side of the protection unit that gives sound insulation, it includes vibration damping mount to load the shock attenuation unit. The utility model discloses an utilize the cooperation of syllable-dividing protection casing, the abatvoix, drier box and shrouding to use for the noise that the pump body produced at the in-process of operation can be absorbed, the harmful effects that the noise abatement caused, and the steam on pump body surface, then can be absorbed by drier box, keep the drying on pump body surface, avoid the corrosion, prolong its life, utilize the shrouding, the cooperation of bottom block and second spacing groove is used, the leakproofness of syllable-dividing protection casing and vibration damping mount to the pump body encirclement has been guaranteed, sound insulation effect and inside aridity have further been guaranteed.

title_en: Generator motor carbon brush device and generator motor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a generator motor carbon brush device, including the rotor sliding ring, fix brush housing and the activity of sliding ring one side and insert the carbon brush of locating in the brush housing, a pot head that the rotor sliding ring was kept away from to the carbon brush is equipped with the lead wire cover, and the lead wire cover activity is inserted and is located the brush housing, is equipped with elasticity on the brush housing and compresses tightly the piece, and elasticity compresses tightly the outside at the lead wire cover, makes the carbon brush support tightly on the rotor sliding ring, is equipped with the wiring subassembly on the lead wire cover. A generator motor is also disclosed, comprising a generator motor carbon brush device. According to the carbon brush device of the generator motor and the generator motor, the lead and the carbon brush can be independently replaced, waste is reduced, cost is saved, and processing difficulty and manufacturing cost are reduced.

title_en: Novel mechanical energy and electric energy conversion equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a mechanical energy electric energy conversion technical field just discloses a novel mechanical energy electric energy conversion equipment, including base and remote pole, the top of base is provided with U type seat, the inner wall rear side of U type seat is provided with the drive assembly that one end extends to its front side, the top of base is provided with the generator assembly who is located U type seat right side, connect through the chain between drive assembly and the generator assembly. This novel mechanical energy electric energy conversion equipment, through setting up first threaded rod, it drives two screw plate back of the body removal mutually to rotate first threaded rod, two screw plate back of the body removal mutually then can drive two joint pieces and the distaff pole is broken away from and is connected, take the inside of distaff pole from the installation frame out at last, then change suitable distaff pole, the first threaded rod of rethread contrarotation drives two screw plates and joint piece relative movement and fixes the distaff pole to the realization can be according to the purpose of user demand change rocker length, the practicality of device has been improved.

title_en: Electromagnetic metering pump
abstract_en: The application provides an electromagnetic metering pump, which is used for sucking and discharging liquid for metering and comprises a shell, a fixed part, a movable part and an adjusting pin; the movable part is controlled by the fixed part to move to deform a deformation space, the volume of the deformation space is increased to suck the liquid, and the volume of the deformation space is reduced to discharge the liquid; the adjusting pin is adjustably fixed with the shell, and adjusts the maximum displacement value of the movable part on the movable path, so as to adjust the maximum volume variation value of the deformation space, and further adjust the suction volume and the discharge volume of the liquid each time. The electromagnetic metering pump provided by the application can adjust the amount of liquid sucked or discharged each time.

title_en: Air compression mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an air compression mechanism, which comprises a driving motor (1), a motor mounting disc (3), a frame (6), an air inlet valve (2), an air outlet valve (8) and a frame bottom cover (18); the machine frame (6) is provided with an even number of symmetrically arranged cylinders (4) and cylinder covers (7); a magnetic driving disc (9), a magnetic guiding disc (10), a magnetic coupling disc (11), a magnetic coupling disc supporting seat (19), a connecting rod (12) and a piston (14) are arranged in the frame (6); when the compressor runs, the driving motor (1) drives the magnetic driving disc (9) to rotate, the magnetic coupling disc (11) is driven to rotate through the magnetic guiding disc (10), the four pistons are driven to do opposite and opposite reciprocating motions simultaneously through the connecting rods (12), air is sucked by the air inlet valve (2), and is discharged by the air outlet valve (8) after being compressed. The utility model has simple structure, low noise and vibration, and can widely meet the air demand of compressed air in various occasions, in particular to equipment with a compressed air source.

title_en: Novel energy-saving environment-friendly mute fan coil
abstract_en: The utility model provides a novel energy-saving environment-friendly mute fan coil, which comprises an outer coil, wherein side holes are formed in the right sides of the front end and the rear end of the outer coil; an inner coil is arranged in the outer coil through bolts; an adjusting support is arranged at the left end bolt of the outer coil pipe; an adjusting air cylinder is connected with the inside of the adjusting support in a shaft way; the front end bolt of the adjusting support is provided with a stepping motor, and an output shaft of the stepping motor is connected with the adjusting air cylinder in an embedded manner; the right side of the inner wall of the outer coil is supported with a detachable support structure; and the left end of the disassembly support structure is supported with a noise reduction protection cylinder structure. According to the utility model, the noise reduction protection cylinder structure is limited and protected by the arrangement of the detachable support structure.

title_en: Volute structure of centrifugal fan
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a centrifugal fan volute structure, which comprises a first volute, a second volute and a quick connecting unit; spiral case one: the middle part of the left surface is provided with an air inlet; spiral case II: the middle part of the right surface of the spiral case is provided with a mounting opening, and the spiral case I and the spiral case II are matched; quick connect unit: including slide bar, rectangular plate, installation cavity and activity cardboard, slide bar sliding connection is in the smooth hole that spiral case left surface edge evenly set up respectively, and slide bar's right-hand member all is equipped with the rectangular plate, and spiral case one's right surface is equipped with the rectangle with rectangular plate one-to-one dodges the groove, spiral case two's surface be equipped with rectangular plate one-to-one's rectangle fluting, spiral case two's right surface edge is equipped with evenly distributed's installation cavity, the installation cavity is linked together with the rectangle fluting that corresponds respectively, this centrifugal fan spiral case structure still makes things convenient for the staff to assemble and demolish when guaranteeing structure overall stability.

title_en: Reed type air valve
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a reed type air valve which comprises a valve cover, a sealing plate and a valve seat which are sequentially connected from top to bottom, wherein the valve cover is provided with an air inlet a and an air outlet d, the valve seat is provided with an air outlet b and an air inlet c, the sealing plate is provided with a reed which is matched with the air inlet a and the air inlet c, the sealing plate is provided with a switching groove at the reed, and the reed is arranged between the switching groove and the air inlet a/air inlet c. The utility model aims at combining the valve cover and the valve seat to form two separated air flow passages through the sealing plate, so that the separation of the air inlet flow passage and the air outlet flow passage is not interfered with each other, the whole structure is compact and flat, and the occupied space of the air valve is reduced.

title_en: Bottom pry fixing structure of compressor
abstract_en: The utility model provides a bottom prying fixing structure of a compressor, which comprises an upper plane and a lower plane, wherein a connecting plate is arranged between the upper plane and the lower plane, a support plate is arranged on the connecting plate and positioned between the upper plane and the lower plane, a supporting space is arranged between the support plate and the lower plane, a connecting hole is arranged on the support plate, a lower through hole is arranged on the lower plane, and foundation bolts penetrate through the connecting hole and the through hole and extend into a foundation. The fixed knot in this scheme constructs can firmly fix the compressor sled and does not occupy the planar space on the end sled again, and the vibration power of transmission compressor that can be fine reaches the basis, plays fine damping effect, great improvement the sexual valence relative altitude.

title_en: Air compressor and fuel cell integrated system with same
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an air compressor and a fuel cell integrated system with the same, wherein the air compressor comprises: the air compressor comprises an air compressor body and a controller, wherein the air compressor body comprises an air compressor shell, the controller comprises a controller shell, the controller shell is provided with a first installation part and a second installation part, the first installation part is connected with the air compressor shell, and the second installation part is suitable for being connected with a fuel cell. The air compressor of the embodiment of the utility model has reasonable structural design, is convenient to assemble and has higher matching degree.

title_en: Pressure regulating air valve and air pump easy to assemble and disassemble
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of pneumatic equipment, in particular to an easily-assembled and disassembled pressure regulating valve and an easily-assembled air pump. It comprises the following steps: the pressure regulating valve comprises a pressure regulating valve body, a rubber propping piece and a pressure relief shell; the pressure release shell is provided with an accommodating groove with an upward opening; the bottom of the accommodating groove is provided with a pressure relief opening, and the opening is provided with a fastener for being buckled with the pressure regulating valve body; the pressure regulating valve body presses the rubber propping piece on the pressure relief opening through the opening of the accommodating groove to form a sealed pressure relief cavity, and the side edge of the top of the pressure regulating valve body is propped against the opening of the pressure relief shell; when the position of the pressure regulating valve body is adjusted, the clamping piece is staggered or buckled with the pressure regulating valve body. The utility model adopts the mode of the buckle to realize the effect that the pressure regulating valve body and the pressure relief shell are easy to install and disassemble, can conveniently replace damaged parts in the pressure relief shell, and avoids the condition that the whole pneumatic product cannot work due to the damage of individual parts, thereby avoiding wasting part of good parts and better realizing environmental protection.

title_en: Reciprocating plunger pump
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a reciprocating plunger pump which comprises a pump body, a left end cover, a right end cover, two rotating shafts and a driving mechanism. The utility model provides a reciprocating plunger pump which has the advantages of small internal leakage, low noise, high output pressure and stable flow. The reciprocating plunger pump has high energy efficiency utilization rate, compact structure and no dead point in starting. The device has the characteristics of high temperature resistance, low noise, small internal leakage, high output pressure, constant output flow and strong self-priming capability; can convey various mediums such as oil, water, air and the like.

title_en: Air cleaner and filter element assembly thereof
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an air filter and a filter element assembly thereof, wherein the filter element assembly comprises a shell and a filter element arranged in the shell, one end of the shell is provided with an air inlet, and the other end is provided with an air outlet; the filter is located between air inlet and gas vent to make the air that gets into by the air inlet discharge from the gas vent after the filter filters, filter inside is equipped with the cavity, is equipped with the sealing washer with dust collector sealing connection in the cavity. The utility model can be applied to an air filter, and the filter element component can be connected with a main filter element of the air filter in series to realize the purpose of double-stage filtration. Through set up the well hollow in the filter, make dust collector's blowback head can directly pass in the well hollow of filter extends to main filter core, make this filter core subassembly overall structure compact, small, the installation of being convenient for, and through the sealing washer that sets up in the well hollow, can prevent to appear the phenomenon of cross gas between two filter cores in the air cleaner, effectively improved the filter effect.

title_en: Fan impeller and fan comprising same
abstract_en: The present utility model relates to a fan impeller and a fan including the same. The fan impeller includes wheel hub and a plurality of blade, the blade with wheel hub links to each other and along its circumference interval arrangement, be provided with on the wheel hub and prevent the structure, prevent the structure and construct: when the fan impeller is mounted in a fan to rotate, and the displacement of the hub relative to the shield of the fan in the axial direction reaches a preset value, the blocking structure abuts against the shield to block the fan impeller from rotating. The utility model can effectively avoid scraping or impacting other parts under the condition that the fan blade is bent and deformed during working, thereby being beneficial to ensuring the reliable operation of equipment and enhancing the safety performance of the system.

title_en: Balance weight anti-swing damper of pumping unit
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of pumping units, in particular to a balance weight anti-swing damper of a pumping unit, which comprises a buffer box, a damping rod, a balance weight, a left guide wheel and a right guide wheel, wherein the buffer box is of a box body structure with an open upper end, the lower side of the buffer box can be fixedly arranged with a base of the pumping unit, the damping rod which is vertically arranged is arranged in the buffer box, and a buffer layer is filled in the buffer box corresponding to the outer side position of the damping rod. The utility model has reasonable and compact structure and convenient use, the vibration phenomenon of the counterweight caused by the unbalanced vibration of the pumping unit can be eliminated through the mutual friction between the counterweight and the damping rod and the buffer layer, the damping rod can counteract the acting force of wind force on the counterweight, weaken or eliminate the horizontal swinging phenomenon of the counterweight caused by wind force and vibration, prevent the horizontal swinging amplitude of the counterweight from being aggravated, realize the stable and vertical movement of the counterweight caused by friction damping, reduce the safety risk, and have the characteristics of safety, labor saving, simplicity and high efficiency.

title_en: Filling oil spraying device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a filler oil spraying device, which belongs to the field of oil spraying devices and comprises a front guide sleeve, a rear guide sleeve and an oil filling pipe, wherein a spacer ring and a flow blocking spacer ring are fixedly connected between the front guide sleeve and the rear guide sleeve, between the front guide sleeve and the spacer ring, between the rear guide sleeve and the spacer ring and between the spacer ring and the flow blocking spacer ring, and a filler body is fixedly connected respectively.

title_en: Special converter of negative pressure fan
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a special frequency converter for a negative pressure fan, which comprises a frequency converter shell, wherein the front end of the frequency converter shell is provided with a display, the frequency converter shell below the display is provided with a frequency modulation button, and the bottom ends of the two sides below the frequency converter shell are provided with positioning movement adjusting components. According to the special frequency converter for the negative pressure fan, the moving efficiency is effectively improved, the moving performance is improved, the position of the frequency converter can be changed according to the movement of the fan, when the position is determined, the two-way motor drives the fixed support leg and the movable roller to reversely rotate, the fixed support leg is turned to the bottom end of the shell of the frequency converter to be in contact with the ground, the frequency converter with the determined position is effectively fixed, the stability effect is improved, the overall adjustment flexibility is improved, and the overall practicability is improved.

title_en: Device for gasifying and converting low-calorific-value fuel
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of chemical gas production, and particularly relates to a device for carrying out gasification conversion on low-calorific-value fuel. The utility model adopts oxygen-enriched and oxygen-depleted steam of specific components as gasifying agent to gasify and transform low-calorific-value fuel; the device comprises: normal temperature air separation oxygen generating device, cyclone separator, membrane separator, heat exchanger, supercharging device, etc.; the circulating fluidized gasification bed receives low-heat-value fuel, generates high-heat-value fuel gas containing hydrogen and carbon monoxide and containing less than or equal to 5 percent of nitrogen, and generates byproduct steam for power generation; and the output flue gas is recycled back to be mixed with oxygen to be rich in oxygen after the heat energy is utilized, and the rest is liquefied to be carbon dioxide. According to the utility model, the carbon dioxide background gas mixed pure oxygen is used as an oxygen-enriched fuel and steam is used as a gasifying agent to gasify the low-heat-value fuel, so that the low-heat-value fuel can be efficiently converted into the high-heat-value fuel gas with nitrogen content less than or equal to 5%, the conversion efficiency is high, the operation is simple, the automation degree is high, the economic benefit is good, and the method has remarkable advantages.

title_en: Mobile power supply with fan
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of processing, in particular to a mobile power supply with a fan, which comprises a power supply body, a bracket and a slot for accommodating the bracket and the fan, wherein the front end of the power supply body of the fan is provided with the slot for accommodating the bracket and the fan, the upper end of the bracket is movably connected with the fan, the lower end of the bracket is hinged at the front end of the power supply body and can be embedded into the slot after being rotated at the hinge position of the bracket and the power supply body, so that the bracket and the fan are hidden in the power supply body.

title_en: Corrosion-resistant and wear-resistant metering pump
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a corrosion-resistant and wear-resistant metering pump, which relates to the technical field of metering pumps and comprises a first metering pump and a second metering pump, wherein a positioning column and a positioning frame are fixedly arranged on each of the first metering pump and the second metering pump, a connecting plate is sleeved on the positioning column in a sliding manner, a sliding plate is fixedly connected onto the connecting plate, a sliding frame is slidably arranged on the sliding plate, a clamping block is fixedly connected onto the sliding frame, a limiting piece which is spliced with the positioning frame is slidably connected onto the clamping block, and an abutting block is radially slidably arranged on the positioning column; the sliding frame is connected with the inserted link in a sliding manner, the sliding plate is provided with a slot matched with the inserted link, the section of the limiting piece is concave, and the section of the clamping block is T-shaped. The insertion rod is inserted into the slot to limit the movement between the sliding frame and the sliding plate, and the insertion rod is inserted into different slots to quickly adjust the distance between the first metering pump and the second metering pump.

title_en: Water pump with inner sealing device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of water pumps, in particular to a water pump with an inner sealing device, which comprises a water pump, wherein a first flange is fixedly connected to the top of the water pump, a second flange is arranged above the first flange, and threaded rods are connected with the inner walls of one side of the first flange and one side of the second flange in a threaded manner. Through the cooperation of water pump, the base, the bottom plate, flange one, flange two, the rubber pad, horizontal piece, the threaded rod, nut and seal structure, be close to flange two with flange one, and then make the rubber sleeve get into flange two's inner wall, make rubber sleeve and horizontal piece laminate mutually, flange two continue the downwardly moving, and then horizontal piece and rubber sleeve downwardly moving, the rubber sleeve drives annular plate downwardly moving, annular plate drives montant downwardly moving, the montant compresses the spring, be connected flange one and flange two, the spring gives montant ascending power this moment, make rubber sleeve and horizontal piece closely laminate, and then be convenient for seal in the inboard of water pump, improve sealed effect.

title_en: Leak detection device applied to diaphragm compressor
abstract_en: The application provides a be applied to diaphragm compressor's leak hunting device, including the gas tray, the food tray is installed to the bottom of gas tray, install the diaphragm between gas tray and the food tray, first connecting pipe is installed to the leak hunting point of gas tray, first check valve is installed to the internally mounted of first connecting pipe, the second connecting pipe is installed to the leak hunting point of food tray, the internally mounted of second connecting pipe has the manometer, the internally mounted of second connecting pipe has the second check valve, the end of first connecting pipe is linked together through the tee bend with the end of second connecting pipe, the discharge pipe is installed to the tee bend export, the attach fitting is installed to the end of discharge pipe, fifth connecting pipe is installed to attach fitting's first interface, pressure transmitter is installed to fifth connecting pipe's end, the third connecting pipe is installed to attach fitting's second interface, the internally mounted of third connecting pipe has the third check valve. The leak detection device applied to the diaphragm compressor, provided by the application, is reasonable in structure and low in price compared with a conventional leak detection device.

title_en: Engine cylinder work detection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an engine cylinder work detection device, which is characterized in that a temperature sensor is arranged on an exhaust manifold of each cylinder, temperature data of the exhaust manifold of the corresponding cylinder is acquired twice by the temperature sensor when and after a certain time after an automobile is started and is transmitted to an electronic control unit, the electronic control unit acquires the temperature detection data of the exhaust manifold of each cylinder twice before and after operation comparison, and then the working state of the exhaust manifold of each cylinder can be judged according to the comparison result, and the working state detection result of the exhaust manifold of each cylinder is generated and transmitted to a display for display, so that a driver can intuitively see the working state of each cylinder of the automobile. The utility model can judge the working state of the corresponding engine cylinder by utilizing the change of the temperature of the exhaust manifold of the cylinder after the engine is in a cold state and started for a certain time, and effectively realizes the automatic detection of the working state of the cylinder.

title_en: Adsorption drying structure of air compressor
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of air compressors, in particular to an adsorption drying structure of an air compressor, which comprises an inlet and a fixing frame, wherein one side of the fixing frame is provided with a filtering mechanism, the filtering mechanism comprises an active carbon plate, a protective box, a telescopic pipe, a box body, a limiting block, a water-absorbing cotton plate, a connecting pipe and an open pipe, the connecting pipe is fixedly connected below the open pipe, the box body is movably connected below the connecting pipe, the limiting block is fixedly connected to one side of the inside of the box body, external air is pumped in through the open pipe, then the air is input into the box body through the connecting pipe, then the air passes through the water-absorbing cotton plate, moisture is arranged on the water-absorbing cotton plate, dust in the air is adsorbed, then the air after the dust is adsorbed is input into the protective box through the connecting pipe, then the air passes through the active carbon plate, and then the active carbon plate adsorbs oily impurities in the air, so that the dust and the oil in the air can be filtered better.

title_en: Improved structure for preventing lubricating oil of low-pressure air compressor of hydropower station from being emulsified
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an improved structure for preventing lubricating oil of a low-pressure air compressor of a hydropower station from being emulsified, and relates to the technical field of operation of air compressors of hydropower stations. The air compressor is characterized in that an air storage tank is connected to an air outlet of the air compressor through an air outlet pipe, a control loop drives the air compressor to start and stop, the air outlet pipe is provided with an exhaust branch pipe, the exhaust branch pipe extends to the outside, a manual control valve and an electromagnetic air valve are sequentially arranged on the exhaust branch pipe, a control branch is additionally arranged in front of a remote control switch of the control loop, the control branch is connected with the remote control switch through one fixed contact of a change-over switch, a time relay and an intermediate relay are arranged in parallel, an electrifying delay disconnection contact of the time relay is electrically connected with the electromagnetic air valve, and a normally open contact of the intermediate relay is connected with the control loop. Through set up exhaust branch pipe on the outlet duct, outwards discharge compressed gas through electromagnetic air valve control, the operating time after the low-pressure air compressor machine was opened at every turn is prolonged, avoids its circumstances to appear because operating time is short leads to lubricating oil emulsification.

title_en: Air-cooled air compressor motor and air compressor
abstract_en: The application relates to an air-cooled air compressor motor and an air compressor, comprising a motor body, a motor rotor, a rotor hollow shaft and a fan, wherein the motor rotor, the rotor hollow shaft and the fan are arranged in the motor body; the rotor hollow shaft is arranged at the center of the motor rotor, and the motor rotor is fixedly connected with the main shaft of the air compressor head through the rotor hollow shaft; the fan is arranged relative to the motor rotor and is positioned at the rear end of the motor body; the application provides an integral type, compact structure, air compressor machine motor that radiating effect is good, realizes that the motor directly drives the air compressor machine aircraft nose main shaft and rotates after the circular telegram, adopts independent fan design simultaneously, can adjust the amount of wind at any time, guarantees to have sufficient amount of wind.

title_en: Quick dismantlement structure and air compressor machine
abstract_en: The application provides a quick dismantlement structure and air compressor machine relates to air compressor machine technical field. The utility model provides a quick dismantlement structure, sets up on the air compressor machine body, one side of air compressor machine body is provided with the recess, recess embeds first filter screen, first filter screen with spacing block, slide bar symmetry rigid coupling in spacing, the slide bar spacing slide in the recess lateral wall, the spring set up in the lateral wall of recess, the both ends of spring contradict respectively in the lateral wall of recess with the slide bar, the spacing that the symmetry set up, slide bar and spring on it cooperate can realize in the recess elastic expansion change, when the spacing that the symmetry set up receives spring force to be close to each other for form the block between spacing and the first filter screen, spacing to the first filter screen is spacing, and the spring receives the extrusion time, the spacing that the symmetry set up will keep away from each other, breaks away from the restriction to the first filter screen, makes the installation of first filter screen or dismantle comparatively convenient.

title_en: Impeller structure of adhesive-coated double-screw pump
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an impeller structure of a glue spreading double-screw pump, which comprises a driving shaft, a driven shaft, a dismounting assembly and an adjusting assembly, wherein the adjusting assembly comprises a fixed seat, a sliding seat and a third bolt, the sliding seat is horizontally connected inside the fixed seat in a sliding manner, two groups of sliding seats are arranged, the driving shaft and the driven shaft are respectively inserted into the two groups of sliding seats, and the third bolt penetrates through the fixed seat and is connected in the sliding seat in a threaded manner. The utility model solves the problems that the interval between two groups of impellers is inconvenient to adjust and the attached impurities are removed through the adjusting component, and the impellers are convenient to detach through the detaching component, so that maintenance is carried out and the service life is prolonged.

title_en: Energy-saving multi-stage vacuum generator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an energy-saving multistage vacuum generator, which comprises a hollow shell, wherein one end of the shell is provided with an air inlet for compressed air to enter an inner cavity of the shell, the other end of the shell is provided with an air outlet for air to exit the inner cavity of the shell, one side of the shell is provided with a vacuum suction port for sucking air, the energy-saving multistage vacuum generator also comprises a multistage vacuum component, the multistage vacuum component comprises a partition plate, an expansion pipe and a control group, the inner cavity of the shell is divided into a first cavity and a second cavity which are bilaterally symmetrical by the partition plate, the first cavity is communicated with the outside through the air inlet, and the second cavity is communicated with the outside through the air outlet; the control group controls the main expansion pipe to be opened and the auxiliary expansion pipe to be closed, so that a large-displacement vacuum adsorption mode is realized; the control group controls the main diffusion pipe and the auxiliary expansion pipe to be opened simultaneously, so that a high-efficiency vacuum adsorption mode is realized; can be adjusted according to the use requirement of a user, and the application range of the vacuum generator is improved.

title_en: Wind power and diesel oil mixed generator
abstract_en: The utility model provides a wind-diesel hybrid generator, which comprises a frame and a power generation box rotatably arranged on the frame, wherein one side of the power generation box is provided with a diesel engine, the other side of the power generation box is provided with a wind wheel assembly, and the frame is also provided with a control box which is electrically connected with the diesel engine and the power generation box; the power generation box is rotationally provided with a wheel shaft, one end of the wheel shaft is in transmission connection with the diesel engine, the other end of the wheel shaft is connected with the wind wheel assembly through a shaft disengaging mechanism, a belt pulley is fixedly arranged on the wheel shaft and is in transmission connection with the generator through a belt, and therefore two power generation functions of diesel and wind power are achieved. The wind power and diesel oil hybrid generator is provided with a diesel engine and a wind wheel assembly, can realize the switching between wind power generation and diesel power generation, and avoids the problem of personnel electricity consumption caused by weather influence. The off-axis mechanism is used for connecting and disconnecting the gear shaft and the wheel shaft so as to reduce the resistance of the rotation of the wind wheel assembly when the diesel engine is used, thereby improving the power generation efficiency.

title_en: Novel pump source control system for vacuum pipeline structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel pump source control system for a vacuum pipeline structure, which comprises a basic installation module for installing components, an air conveying module arranged on the basic installation module, an on-off control module connected with the air conveying module, a vacuum conveying module connected with the on-off control module, and a terminal connection module arranged on the basic installation module and connected with the on-off control module, wherein the on-off control module is connected with the terminal connection module. The pump source control system has the beneficial effects that the pump source control system can well control the vacuum pipeline to work, has good use effect and compact structure, and can protect the pump source in the working process.

title_en: Sun-proof equipment for loading pump
abstract_en: The application discloses sun-proof equipment for loading pump relates to loading pump technical field. The technical key points are as follows: the small cold box body of the loading pump is provided with a baffle plate above the small cold box body of the loading pump, and the upper end of the baffle plate is provided with a awning; a heat dissipation motor is arranged below the awning, the output end of the heat dissipation motor is connected with a first gear, and a plurality of heat dissipation units are arranged on the outer side of the first gear; the heat dissipation unit comprises a second gear meshed with the first gear, the lower side of the second gear is fixedly connected with one end of the driving rotating shaft, the other end of the driving rotating shaft penetrates through the partition plate and then is connected with the heat dissipation fan, and the driving rotating shaft is rotationally connected with the partition plate. Through the fan on the baffle is being cooperated to the awning that sets up in loading pump small cold box body top, can make the wallboard temperature of loading pump small cold box body obtain effectively reducing to reduced the production of evaporation gas, not only can make the pump body steady operation, also can guarantee the loading volume of the inside loading of vehicle storage tank when loading, guarantee the effect of loading.

title_en: Mounting structure of fuel injector of throttle valve assembly of motorcycle
abstract_en: The utility model provides a mounting structure of a fuel injector of a throttle valve assembly of a motorcycle, and belongs to the field of motorcycle accessories. The problem of inconvenient design of current sprayer has been solved to it. The mounting structure of the fuel injector of the throttle valve assembly of the motorcycle comprises a bar-shaped fuel injector shell and a valve body with an air passage, wherein the valve body is provided with a mounting hole communicated with the air passage, one end of the fuel injector shell is inserted into the mounting hole, a block body is formed on the valve body, and a positioning step is formed between the block body and the valve body; the positioning step consists of a step side wall and a step bottom wall, the oil sprayer shell is positioned in the positioning step, the mounting hole is formed in the step bottom wall, and the oil sprayer shell is formed with a shaft shoulder surface which is annular and tightly pressed on the step bottom wall; the block is fixedly provided with a locating rack, the locating rack comprises a sheet body parallel to the bottom wall of the step, and the sheet body is tightly pressed on the end face of the other end of the oil sprayer shell. The mounting structure of the fuel injector of the throttle valve assembly of the motorcycle is beneficial to the design of the fuel injector.

title_en: Novel handheld fan
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel handheld fan, which comprises a fan main body and a shell component arranged on the fan main body, wherein the fan main body comprises a main shell and a fan rotating shaft rotatably arranged at the upper end part of the main shell, fan blades are arranged on the fan rotating shaft, a motor is arranged in the main shell, and a power output shaft of the motor is connected with the fan rotating shaft; the shell component comprises a sliding sleeve shell and a cover shell, the lower end part of the main shell is provided with a sliding sleeve part, and the sliding sleeve shell is sleeved on the periphery of the sliding sleeve part of the main shell in a sliding manner; when the novel handheld fan is not used, the sliding sleeve shell moves to a lower limit position relative to the sliding sleeve part, the cover shell is sleeved at the upper end part of the sliding sleeve part, and the cover shell covers the upper end part of the main shell; when the novel handheld fan is used, the sliding sleeve shell moves upwards to the upper limit position relative to the sliding sleeve part, and the cover shell is sleeved at the lower end part of the sliding sleeve part. Through the structural design, the portable electric power device has the advantages of novel design, simple structure and convenience in carrying and use.

title_en: Portable air compressor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a movable portable air compressor, which comprises an air compressor body, a shockproof assembly and a mounting seat, wherein a shock absorption plate is arranged at the bottom of the air compressor body; the vibration-proof assembly comprises a first vertical vibration-proof piece arranged at the bottom of the vibration-proof plate and a plurality of lateral vibration-proof pieces arranged at the periphery of the vibration-proof plate; the mounting seat comprises a mounting cavity, a limiting part arranged above the mounting cavity and a moving assembly arranged on the bottom surface of the bottom plate of the mounting cavity; the damping plate is arranged in the installation cavity through the first vertical damping piece, and the limiting part is used for limiting the damping plate to be separated from the installation cavity. The technical scheme of the utility model has excellent shockproof effect, and can prevent the air compressor body from generating severe vibration, thereby prolonging the service life of the air compressor body.

title_en: Air compressor machine filter equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of air compression and discloses an air compressor filter device which comprises a filter box body, wherein an air inlet pipe is arranged on one side surface of the filter box body, one end of the air inlet pipe is fixedly connected with an air injection plate, and the inner wall of the filter box body is provided with a sliding groove. The utility model has the following advantages and effects: can make it absorb most harmful gas in the air, make follow-up gas after the air compressor machine pressurization safer, through the setting of dry board, can effectively detach the moisture in the air, through the gathering effect of gathering the gas groove, the air duct is carried to the outlet duct to follow-up processing equipment by the outlet duct, the equal fixedly connected with slider of activated carbon sheet and dry board can drive the adsorption plate through the slip of slider in the spout, and activated carbon sheet and dry board shift out the spout to reach and dismantle abluent purpose to it, through the setting of chamber door, can prevent that the air in the filter box body from revealing.

title_en: Adjustable mounting bracket of industrial fan
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an adjustable mounting bracket of an industrial fan, which comprises a mounting rod, wherein a fixed block is arranged on the mounting rod, a telescopic rod is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the fixed block, a mounting groove is arranged at the bottom of the telescopic rod, an industrial fan body is arranged below the telescopic rod, the top of the industrial fan body is fixedly connected with the mounting groove through the mounting block, hinged seats are fixedly arranged at two sides of the bottom of the telescopic rod, sliding blocks are arranged at two sides of the fixed block, the bottom of the sliding block is connected with the hinged seats through inclined supporting rods, when the adjustable mounting bracket is mounted, the length of the telescopic rod is conveniently adjusted according to the needed position of the industrial fan, so that the mounting height of the industrial fan is changed, meanwhile, the sliding blocks can move at two sides of the fixed block to form a triangle with the telescopic rod after being fixed, the integral strength of the mounting bracket is increased, and the stability of the telescopic rod is ensured, so that the stability in use is ensured, the shaking and the use safety is improved.

title_en: End cover, compressor, air conditioning system and vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model provides an end cover, a compressor, an air conditioning system and a vehicle, wherein the end cover is used for a body of the compressor and comprises: the cover body is provided with a mounting groove at one side deviating from the body; the sound insulation piece is arranged in the mounting groove and used for absorbing sound waves; at least one convex rib is arranged on the wall of the mounting groove, and the sound insulation member is provided with an avoidance groove for avoiding the convex rib. Through set up the sound insulating part in the lid of end cover one side that deviates from the body of compressor to can absorb the noise that parts such as motor and automatically controlled portion formed in the compressor through the sound insulating part, with the noise radiation who weakens the compressor towards the external world, and then make the end cover play the function of making an uproar. Through set up protruding muscle at the cell wall of mounting groove, the intensity of accessible protruding muscle promotes the lid, and then promotes the reliability of end cover to dodge the groove through setting up on the sound insulation piece, thereby can dodge protruding muscle through dodging the groove, avoid taking place to interfere between protruding muscle and the sound insulation piece.

title_en: External water cooling machine filter screen of fan
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an external water cooler filter screen of a fan, which comprises a supporting device, wherein a sliding device is arranged in the supporting device in a sliding manner, a cleaning device is arranged at the front end of the sliding device in a sliding manner, the sliding device comprises a top frame, a filter screen, sliding keys, a supporting front frame and guide rails, the sliding keys are fixedly arranged at two ends of the filter screen, the supporting front frame is symmetrically and fixedly arranged at the front end of the filter screen, the guide rails are fixedly arranged in the supporting front frame, the top frame is fixedly arranged between the two supporting front frames, the cleaning device comprises a rotating buckle, a supporting transverse frame, a contact brush strip and a positioning block, the rotating buckle is equidistantly and rotatably arranged at the top of the front end of the supporting transverse frame, and the supporting transverse frame is fixedly arranged between the two positioning blocks. The utility model realizes the aim of cleaning the surface while the filter screen is convenient to install by arranging the sliding device and the cleaning device.

title_en: Thermal management control module
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a thermal management control module, which is characterized in that two mutually independent valve cavities are arranged in an outer shell, connector pieces communicated with the valve cavities are arranged on the outer shell, rotary valves driven by a driving mechanism to rotate are respectively arranged in the valve cavities, valve ports are arranged on the outer walls of the rotary valves, and the connector pieces are communicated to the opening ends in the valve cavities and are in sliding contact with the valve ports. The thermal management control module has the advantages of high flow rate and high integration level.

title_en: Electromagnetic speed-regulating water pump using integral magnet fixed disc and vehicle
