abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electromagnetic speed-regulating water pump using an integral magnet fixed disc and a vehicle, and relates to the technical field of electromagnetic speed-regulating water pumps. The novel magnetic iron fixing device comprises a shell and a magnet fixing disc, wherein a shaft connecting bearing is arranged in the shell, the magnet fixing disc is pivoted to the shell through the shaft connecting bearing, the magnet fixing disc comprises a shaft sleeve part and a fixing disc part, and the shaft sleeve part and the fixing disc part are of an integrated structure. The utility model includes. The utility model adopts the integral magnet fixed disc without assembly, reduces the processing cost, the assembly cost and the tolerance, and simultaneously reduces the jumping of the bulge of the fixed disc part relative to the hole of the shaft sleeve part.

title_en: Agricultural water purification circulating pump
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water purifying circulating pump for agriculture, and relates to the technical field of agriculture cultivation. Comprises a water inlet channel for guiding agricultural water into a water purifying circulating pump; the chassis is communicated with the water inlet channel at one side; the input end of the water pump is communicated with the inside of the chassis and is used for guiding out agricultural water in the chassis; and the drain pipe is communicated with the output end of the water pump, so that the agricultural water circulation is realized. The utility model ensures that the space surrounded by the outer wall of the channel can be communicated or closed along with the position of the hemispherical valve through the matched use of the outer wall of the channel and the hemispherical valve, thereby creating a proper space for the cleaning work of the filter screen; simultaneously, through the setting of backwash tube, wash the filter screen when the passageway outer wall seals to in the space that goes into ejection of compact lateral wall and enclose with the impurity on the filter screen, by cooperation flitch push in with impurity impressing pond bottom silt, thereby reach the mesh of carrying out cleanness to the filter screen.

title_en: Fan with fan body
abstract_en: The utility model is applicable to the technical field of fans, and provides a fan, which comprises: the air duct part comprises a main body, an air guide cavity is arranged in the main body, air outlets and air inlets are formed in the opposite ends of the air duct part, the air outlets and the air inlets are communicated with the air guide cavity, and positioning convex columns are arranged in the main body; the air blowing part comprises a rotating fan blade and a driving part in driving connection with the rotating fan blade, and the rotating fan blade is rotatably arranged in the air guide cavity and is arranged towards the air outlet; the driving part comprises a stator and a rotor sleeved outside the stator, the rotor is fixedly arranged on the rotating fan blade and is coaxially arranged with the rotating fan blade, and the stator is fixedly sleeved on the positioning convex column. The fan provided by the utility model can directly transmit the power generated by the driving part to the rotating fan blade through the rotor, and a transmission device is not required to be arranged between the driving part and the rotating fan blade, so that the transmission efficiency of the fan provided by the utility model is effectively improved.

title_en: Double-blade fan
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a double-blade fan, and relates to the technical field of fans. The utility model comprises the following steps: a bracket; the motor is arranged in the bracket and comprises a motor body and a motor shaft; the first fan blade is arranged on one side of the bracket and is meshed with the motor shaft; the second fan blade is arranged on the other side of the bracket, is meshed with the motor shaft, is symmetrical to the first fan blade based on the bracket, and has a rotation direction opposite to that of the first fan blade. According to the utility model, the motor, the first fan blade and the second fan blade can be supported through the arranged bracket, and the first fan blade and the second fan blade can rotate under the drive of the motor and generate wind power in the rotating process, so that the requirement of a user on large-scale air supply is improved.

title_en: Control rod driving mechanism of high-temperature gas cooled reactor
abstract_en: The utility model provides a high-temperature gas cooled reactor control rod driving mechanism which comprises a driving rod, a driving gear, a transmission gear, a connecting shaft, a first power component, a meshing frame, a first fixed support and a second power component, wherein the driving rod is connected with the driving gear; the driving rod is fixed at the top of the control rod; the driving gear has a first position, and the driving gear in the first position can be meshed with the driving rod; the driving gear and the transmission gear are coaxially arranged on the connecting shaft, the connecting shaft and the first power component are respectively arranged on the meshing frame, the connecting shaft is positioned at the first end of the meshing frame, and the second end of the meshing frame is hinged with the first fixed support; the second power assembly is used for driving the meshing frame to rotate around a hinge point between the meshing frame and the first fixed support. The utility model has the technical effects that the design is reasonable, the safety of the downward insertion of the control rod is ensured, and the reliable falling of the control rod is ensured.

title_en: Sealed internal engagement mute pump
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of mute pumps, and particularly relates to a sealed internal meshing mute pump which comprises a pump body, wherein an oil injection mechanism is arranged on an oil inlet pipe and comprises a miniature motor, an auger, a first bevel gear, an oil injection cylinder, a fixed disk, a filter screen, a fixed rod, a rotating rod, a second bevel gear, a sliding block, an elastic piece and a scraping plate. According to the utility model, through the sealing ring arranged on the end cover, sealing treatment can be carried out between the end cover and the pump body so as to improve the sealing effect of the mute pump, oil can be added into the oil inlet pipe through the arrangement of the oil injection cylinder, impurities can be filtered out of the oil under the action of the filter screen, friction noise can be reduced under the action of the oil, the oil can be pushed by driving the auger to rotate through the motor, normal injection of the oil is further ensured, and impurities attached to the filter screen can be cleaned under the action of structures such as the bevel gear I, the bevel gear II, the rotating rod, the scraping plate and the like, so that the blocking problem of the filter screen is avoided.

title_en: Parallel runner structure with transverse corrugated profile
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fuel assemblies, and particularly discloses a parallel runner structure with a transverse corrugated profile, wherein the parallel runner structure is composed of a transverse corrugated narrow runner and a parallel communication runner; the transverse corrugated narrow flow channel has a sinusoidal outer contour in the width direction; the top and bottom contours of the transverse corrugated narrow flow channel can be completely spliced and embedded; the parallel connection flow channels adopt array cylindrical flow channels and are used for connecting an upper transverse corrugated narrow flow channel and a lower transverse corrugated narrow flow channel, and the parallel connection between two water gaps can be realized. The parallel runner structure with the transverse corrugated profile provided by the utility model increases the heat transfer area between the heat transfer wall surface and the coolant, enhances the transverse turbulence mixing effect between the water gaps of the upper and lower narrow runners, can realize the enhanced heat exchange under the low Reynolds number operation condition of the pressurized water reactor, and increases the safety and the economical efficiency of the nuclear reactor.

title_en: Prefabricated pump station with unpowered automatic ventilation system
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of pump stations, and particularly relates to a prefabricated pump station with an unpowered automatic ventilation system, which comprises a cylinder body, wherein the automatic ventilation system is arranged in the cylinder body and comprises a water wheel, a transmission device, an inlet fan, an exhaust fan and a suction pipe, the water wheel is driven to rotate by sewage impact and simultaneously drives the inlet fan and the exhaust fan to work through the transmission device, the inlet fan is used for inlet air into the cylinder body, and the exhaust fan is connected with the suction pipe and is used for exhausting waste gas out of the cylinder body. The utility model converts the potential energy of municipal water inflow into the power of the water inlet fan and the exhaust fan by utilizing the water wheels, and simultaneously supplies air and exhausts air in the cylinder body, so that the air in the cylinder body is circulated more, and the ventilation effect is further enhanced.

title_en: Guide vane end face sealing device of hydroelectric generating set
abstract_en: The utility model provides a sealing device for the end face of a guide vane of a hydroelectric generating set, wherein a central groove for installing a sealing rubber strip is processed at the central part of a seat ring, a spring installation hole is processed at the middle part of the sealing rubber strip, a spring is installed in the spring installation hole, and the bottom end of the spring is contacted with the top end face of the central groove; the top end surface of the sealing rubber strip is supported with a copper strip sealing strip, and two sides of the copper strip sealing strip are respectively pressed and fixed through a first sealing pressing plate and a second sealing pressing plate; the first sealing pressing plate and the second sealing pressing plate are fixedly arranged at the top end of the seat ring. Through adopting foretell sealing device, through set up the spring at the back of sealing rubber strip, can compress tightly sealing rubber strip through the spring, and then make it compress tightly the copper bar sealing strip all the time, and then guaranteed to hug closely movable guide vane terminal surface under arbitrary operating mode, play fine stagnant water function, solve present sealing clamp plate bolt fracture, effectively avoid copper bar cavitation to be close, protect overcurrent element.

title_en: Corrosion-resistant vertical vortex pipeline pump
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a corrosion-resistant vertical vortex pipeline pump, which comprises a motor and a shell, wherein the shell is fixedly connected with the bottom of the motor through a flange, the bottom end of the shell is fixedly connected with a pump cover, a hollow structure is arranged in the pump cover to form a runner, the output end of the motor is fixedly connected with a rotating shaft, a connecting frame is arranged in the pump cover, a static ring is arranged at the front end of the connecting frame, a movable ring is sleeved outside the rotating shaft and is clamped with the static ring, a cavity is formed between the top end of the connecting frame and the shell, two ends of the pump cover are respectively communicated with a water inlet and a water outlet, corrosion-resistant material layers are coated on the inner walls of the pump cover, the water inlet and the water outlet, the connecting frame structure of stainless steel materials on the outer sides of the pump cover is used for reinforcing the connectivity of the rotating shaft and the pump cover, and the corrosion-resistant material layers coated on the inner side walls of the pump cover, the water inlet and the water outlet can play a role of protecting, and the smoothness and the corrosion resistance of impeller part and the inner cavity of a pump body are improved, so that the friction loss of fluid is reduced and the service life is prolonged.

title_en: Novel centrifugal blower
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel centrifugal blower, which comprises a first blower housing and a second blower housing, wherein stator fixing barrels are arranged in the middle of the first blower housing and the second blower housing, stators are arranged in the stator fixing barrels, rotors are arranged on the outer sides of the stators, rotating shafts are arranged in the middle of the rotors, two ends of each rotating shaft are fixedly connected with impellers, one end of each stator fixing barrel is connected with a first dust cover, the first dust cover is provided with a first dust screen, the centrifugal blower drives the rotors to rotate through the same stator, so that two impellers are driven to rotate, the two impellers are utilized to rotate to supply air, the air supply quantity and speed are improved, meanwhile, the rotating speed of a centrifugal motor can be adjusted, the air quantity and speed are increased, the overall stability is high, the operation is very simple and convenient, and the operation and the use of people are convenient.

title_en: Lightning protection grounding mechanism for wind power generation equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a lightning protection grounding mechanism for wind power generation equipment, which relates to the technical field of wind power generation and comprises a mounting plate, wherein a fixing bin is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the mounting plate. It can drive the erection column through servo motor and rotate, the erection column can drive the generator body and carry out the direction regulation, the cable is a while to be pulled to cable two, cable two promotes the runner, the runner promotes the loop bar, make the loop bar promote telescopic spring, the telescopic loop bar shrink advance telescopic inside, the length of cable two that makes becomes long, then when leading to cable two overlengths through generator body adjustment process, telescopic spring promotes the loop bar and pops out from telescopic inside, the loop bar promotes the runner, the runner promotes cable two, fold cable two, make its whole can be effectual to carry out spacingly to cable two overlengths, avoid cable two overlengths, lead to twining with surrounding article in the adjustment process, influence lightning protection earthing device's normal use.

title_en: Air can water heater fan
abstract_en: The utility model provides a fan of an air energy water heater, which relates to the field of air energy water heaters and comprises a fan body and a base, wherein the top of the base is provided with the fan body, the tops of the bases at two sides of the fan body are respectively provided with a limiting seat, the inner sides of the limiting seats are respectively provided with a shock pad, the tops of the fan body at the tops of the bases are respectively provided with a baffle, and the two sides of the bottoms of the bases are respectively provided with a roller.

title_en: Housing assembly for a motor pump unit and motor pump unit
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a housing assembly of a motor pump unit and a motor pump unit, the housing assembly comprising a first motor housing (1), a second motor housing (2), a controller housing (3) and a seal (4), the first motor housing and the second motor housing being detachably connected together along an axial direction, the controller housing being arranged on one side of the first motor housing and the second motor housing and being detachably connected together with the first motor housing and the second motor housing, respectively, the seal being located between the first motor housing and the second motor housing, between the controller housing and the first motor housing, and between the controller housing and the second motor housing, respectively. Through above-mentioned technical scheme, the shell subassembly of the motor pump unit that this disclosure provided makes things convenient for dismouting and sealed effectual.

title_en: Truss type supporting girder wind turbine blade and wind turbine
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of wind generating sets, and discloses a truss type support girder wind turbine blade and a wind turbine, wherein the blade comprises a girder and a skin, the girder comprises a plurality of girder sections which are sequentially connected along the radial direction of the wind turbine, and the skin is arranged outside at least one girder section of the girder, which is close to the tail. The main beam is of a sectional structure, each beam section can be manufactured and transported independently, so that the manufacturing cost and the manufacturing difficulty are reduced, meanwhile, the transportation cost of the blade and the damage probability in the transportation process are reduced, the maintenance difficulty of the blade is also reduced, the replacement and maintenance operation are convenient, the service life of the blade is prolonged, the main beam structure is convenient to recycle, and the whole service period of the fan is prolonged by phase change; the main beam is utilized to replace the area outside the tail of the traditional blade, and the skin is reserved only at the tail, so that wind resistance of the area outside the tail can be reduced by the main beam, the power generation efficiency of the blade is guaranteed at the tail skin, and the running benefit of the wind generating set is improved.

title_en: Energy-saving water chiller
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an energy-saving water chiller, which has the technical scheme that: the water chiller comprises a water chiller body and a base, wherein the water chiller body is fixed on the base and comprises a refrigerating water tank, an evaporator, a compressor, a condenser and a shell, a plurality of groups of heat energy power generation assemblies are arranged between a cold water pipe and a hot water pipe in the condenser, a heating assembly is arranged in the hot water pipe of the condenser, a water flow power generation assembly is arranged in the refrigerating water tank, a storage battery is arranged at the upper end of the base, the heat energy power generation assemblies and the water flow power generation assemblies are electrically connected with the storage battery, the heat energy power generation assemblies comprise heat energy generators, a heat source absorption plate and a cold source absorption plate of the heat energy generators are respectively arranged in the hot water pipe and the cold water pipe in the condenser, and a plurality of groups of heat energy power generation assemblies are connected with the storage battery.

title_en: Height-adjustable fan
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a height-adjustable fan which comprises a base, a telescopic frame and a fan mechanism, wherein the base is fixedly connected with the telescopic frame, a telescopic column is arranged on the telescopic frame, a first through hole and a second through hole are formed in the telescopic frame, one end of the telescopic column penetrates through the first through hole and is in sliding connection with the second through hole, and the fan mechanism is fixedly connected with the telescopic column. The utility model aims to provide a height-adjustable fan, which is characterized in that a telescopic bracket is connected with a telescopic column in a sliding way, so that a user can slide the telescopic column to adjust the height of the fan, the structure is simple, the operation of the user is convenient, and the convenience in use of the fan is improved.

title_en: Pump with a pump body
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of pumps, and provides a pump which comprises a pump body and a bearing seat, wherein a first step is arranged at a port of the pump body; one end of the bearing seat is propped against the first step, a volute is arranged on the inner side of the bearing seat, and a bearing is arranged in the center of the bearing seat; the included angle alpha between the water diffusion section at the outlet of the volute and the tangent line of the outer edge of the volute ranges from 30 degrees to 40 degrees; the outlet diameter D1 of the water diffusion section at the outlet of the volute is more than or equal to 16mm. The volute is arranged on the bearing seat of the pump, so that the die opening difficulty is reduced, the production is reduced, and the hydraulic performance of the pump during operation is improved.

title_en: Self-adaptive peristaltic pump with thin-wall hose
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a self-adaptive thin-wall hose peristaltic pump which comprises a rear shell, a front shell, a roller assembly and a pressing block, wherein the front shell is positioned below the front side of the rear shell, the roller assembly is rotatably connected between the front shell and the rear shell, the pressing block is matched with the roller assembly and used for extruding a hose, a spanner shaft is hinged to the pressing block, an eccentric wheel is fixedly connected to the free end of the spanner shaft, a spanner is vertically connected to the spanner shaft, when the spanner shaft is rotated, the eccentric wheel is driven to rotate, the pressing block is opened and closed, an elastic connecting piece is arranged between the eccentric wheel and the rear shell, and the elastic connecting piece can absorb upward rigid thrust from the eccentric wheel. The self-adaptive thin-wall hose peristaltic pump comprises an elastic pressure tube eccentric wheel structure with the wall thickness of the self-adaptive hose, can adapt to certain wall thickness errors and part manufacturing errors, and solves the problems that a thin-wall hose is free from water feeding, low in flow and easy to leak, and the motor is not rotated, the hose runs out, the service life is short and the like due to the fact that the pressure force of the thick-wall hose is too large.

title_en: Braking and enclasping device of wind driven generator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a braking and enclasping device of a wind driven generator, which comprises a braking box, wherein the inner wall of the braking box is rotationally connected with a generator main shaft, the inner wall of the braking box is rotationally connected with a bidirectional threaded rod, the surface of the bidirectional threaded rod is in threaded connection with a braking friction block, the braking box is fixed on a small wind driven generator through a mounting plate and a mounting hole by using a bolt, a servo motor is started to drive the braking friction block to contact with a first braking block through a worm, a worm wheel, the bidirectional threaded rod and a limiting plate so as to reduce the rotating speed of the generator main shaft, a hydraulic push rod is started to push a bracket and a braking ring to move to contact with a second braking block so as to secondarily reduce the rotating speed of the generator main shaft, the aim of conveniently carrying out secondary braking and deceleration on the fan main shaft under extreme weather with higher wind speed is fulfilled, and the problem that the existing small wind driven generator cannot meet the braking requirement of a fan under extreme weather and finally cause the fan burnout due to the adoption of a short circuit braking mode mostly is avoided.

title_en: Plunger pump with guide structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a plunger pump with a guide structure, which comprises a guide structure; the guide structure comprises a guide frame and a guide seat, wherein the guide seat is detachably assembled on the guide frame and can reciprocate along the guide frame in an assembled state; the guide seat comprises a cylindrical sleeve, one end of the cylindrical sleeve is closed, and an assembly seat which is in assembly connection with the eccentric connecting rod is arranged at the outer side of the closed end; the plunger rod is arranged on the plunger rod side, the plunger rod is connected with the plunger rod, and the plunger rod is connected with the plunger rod; the plug body can reciprocate in the cylindrical sleeve along the smooth inner wall of the cylindrical sleeve, and the plug body and the moving direction of the guide seat on the guide frame are in the same straight line when moving. The utility model can effectively improve the stability of the plunger pump in the process of pumping the uneven medium, reduce abrasion and prolong the service life of parts.

title_en: Anti-blocking filtering structure for road rainwater drainage outlet
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-blocking filtering structure of a road rainwater drainage outlet, which comprises a fixed frame and an anti-blocking component; fixing frame: the outer edge of the upper surface of the filter plate is provided with a step groove, a cover plate is arranged in the step groove, large filter holes are uniformly formed in the cover plate, a collecting hopper is arranged on the right wall surface of the inner part of the fixed frame, a filter plate is arranged between the left side surface of the collecting hopper and the inner wall of the left end of the fixed frame, and small filter holes are uniformly formed in the filter plate; anti-blocking assembly: the middle part in the filter is connected in the rotation, the left side wall upper end of collecting the fill is equipped with the incision one that corresponds with prevent stifled subassembly, the bottom plate of collecting the fill is equipped with evenly distributed's hole that leaks, and this road rainwater outlet prevents stifled filtration, can effectively avoid rubbish backward flow, makes impurity precipitation such as grit, reduces the inside odor of sewer simultaneously and outwards overflows, convenient clearance has improved work efficiency.

title_en: Exhaust gas circulation system of engine, engine and vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an exhaust gas circulation system of an engine, the engine and a vehicle thereof, comprising: including an EGR valve and a differential pressure measurement module. The EGR valve is provided with an air inlet and an air outlet, the air inlet is communicated with the first air outlet, and the air outlet is communicated with an air inlet system of the engine through a pipe joint. The gas outlet is provided with a first gas taking pipe, and the central axis of the first gas taking pipe of the third gas taking pipe is parallel to the rotation axis of the valve plate of the EGR valve. The differential pressure measuring module is used for detecting the gas pressure of the gas inlet and the gas outlet. According to the exhaust gas circulation system of the engine, the air flow of the first air taking pipe is not limited by the opening angle of the valve plate, so that the stability of detecting the pressure of the first air taking pipe can be improved, and the pressure difference measuring module can be used for accurately detecting the pressure difference between the air inlet end and the air outlet end of the EGR valve.

title_en: Axial flow cooling fan
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an axial-flow cooling fan, which comprises a central hub and a group of fan blades, wherein the inner side ends of the group of fan blades are fixed with the central hub, the outer side ends of the group of fan blades are fixedly provided with pressure maintaining rings, the central hub is provided with a plurality of mounting holes, each pressure maintaining ring comprises a cylindrical pressure maintaining ring body which extends axially and a reinforcing flanging which is arranged on the windward side of the pressure maintaining ring body, the outer side ends of the fan blades are connected with the inner side surface of the pressure maintaining ring body to form an intersecting contour line, and the windward side of the pressure maintaining ring body is provided with a notch at the intersecting position of the air outlet side of the pressure maintaining ring body and each fan blade, and the contour of the notch is the intersecting contour line. The heat radiation fan can avoid dust accumulation and improve the performance of the fan.

title_en: Air supply arrangement and dish washer of dish washer
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of tableware cleaning devices, and discloses an air supply device of a dish washing machine and the dish washing machine. The air supply device of the dish washer comprises a ducted fan and a fan protection cover; the fan protection cover comprises a sleeve structure sleeved on the outer peripheral surface of the ducted fan shell; the ducted fan is provided with a ducted fan shell, and the inner peripheral surface of the fan protection cover is arranged at intervals with the outer surface of the ducted fan shell; and a filter hole is formed in the peripheral wall of the fan protection cover. According to the air supply device of the dish washer, the filter holes are formed in the peripheral wall of the fan protection cover, so that wind in multiple directions around the ducted fan can be absorbed by the ducted fan, the air inlet efficiency of the ducted fan is greatly improved, the drying efficiency of the dish washer can be improved, and the use experience of a user is improved.

title_en: Light piston of aviation heavy oil two-stroke engine
abstract_en: The utility model aims to provide a lightweight piston of an aviation heavy oil two-stroke engine, which comprises a piston body, wherein the piston body is provided with a piston skirt part, the piston skirt part is designed with a through piston pin hole and four symmetrical lightening holes, one side of the piston skirt part is provided with two scavenging channels, the skirt part is designed with a reinforcing rib, the included angle between the reinforcing rib and a horizontal line is 27.5 degrees, and the thickness is 4mm. Compared with the prior art, the piston is simple and compact in structure, the weight of the piston can be reduced through the four lightening holes of the skirt and the two scavenging channels of the skirt, the advantages of light weight and energy consumption reduction are achieved, and the strength of the piston is guaranteed through the design of the two reinforcing ribs.

title_en: Waste oil cleaning device for wind turbine generator
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of waste oil cleaning devices of wind turbines, in particular to a waste oil cleaning device of wind turbines, which comprises a wall climbing robot, wherein a cleaning component is arranged on a base surface of the wall climbing robot, the cleaning component comprises a protective cover, the waste oil is firstly washed through a spray head and then is scrubbed through a cleaning brush, the waste oil is more effectively cleaned, when the cleaning brush is worn or damaged, a fixed block is driven to be pulled outwards through a pulling button, then the fixed block is limited through a limiting rod by rotating the pulling button, so that the fixed block can be prevented from entering the inside of a fixed groove, the cleaning brush can be detached by pulling a supporting rod outwards, the cleaning brush is convenient to replace, the cleaning brush can be cleaned better during installation, the cleaning effect is better, and the whole device has a simple structure, is convenient to operate and has higher practicability.

title_en: Oil-gas mixing structure of diesel engine
abstract_en: The diesel engine oil-gas mixing structure comprises a cylinder body, wherein an air inlet is formed in one end of the cylinder body, a fuel oil inlet is formed in the circumferential wall surface of the cylinder body, and a flow guide pipe is arranged in the cylinder body. The utility model provides a diesel engine oil-gas mixing structure, a flow guide pipe is arranged in a cylinder body, premixed oil gas firstly enters an air inlet pipe section of the flow guide pipe, and the inner diameter of the air inlet end of the air inlet pipe section is larger than that of the air inlet end of the oil-gas mixing pipe section, so that the oil gas conveyed to the mixing pipe section from the air inlet pipe section is compressed along with the inner diameter of the oil-gas mixing pipe section, the oil gas enters the oil-gas mixing pipe section, the gas pressure is increased, and the air and the oil mist are forced to be mutually accelerated and spread, so that the mixing uniformity of the air and the oil mist is improved, and the full combustion of the mixed gas is facilitated.

title_en: Heat exchange, separation and cooling container device suitable for compressed air energy storage power station
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a heat exchange, separation and cooling container device suitable for a compressed air energy storage power station, and relates to the technical field of non-afterburning compressed air energy storage power stations. The device comprises an outer shell, an inner shell, a compressed gas inlet and a compressed gas outlet, wherein a heat exchange area, a first gas-water separation device, a cooling area and a second gas-water separation device are sequentially arranged in the inner shell from left to right; the heat exchange area comprises a plurality of layers of first heat exchange tube bundles, a heat storage medium inlet header and a heat storage medium outlet header; the cooling zone comprises a plurality of layers of second heat exchange tube bundles, a cooling medium inlet header and a cooling medium outlet header. The utility model solves the problems of large occupied area and low system integration degree of the separated arrangement of the heat exchanger, the gas-water separator and the cooler, and can maximally improve the heat exchange effect, reduce the amount of compressed air pipeline engineering, reduce the flow resistance of compressed air, improve the electric conversion efficiency of the whole plant and reduce the manufacturing cost of the whole plant on the premise of ensuring that the water content of air reaches the standard.

title_en: Cylinder cover of diesel engine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a diesel engine cylinder head which comprises a cylinder head body, wherein a mounting cavity is formed in the cylinder head body, a valve assembly is arranged in the mounting cavity, a first rocker arm seat and a second rocker arm seat are integrally formed in the mounting cavity, a rocker arm shaft is connected between the first rocker arm seat and the second rocker arm seat, two ends of the rocker arm shaft are respectively connected with a first valve rocker arm and a second valve rocker arm, the valve rocker arms are matched with a reset spring of the valve assembly, a combustion chamber cavity is further formed in the cylinder head body, an insert is arranged at the bottom of the combustion chamber cavity, a groove is formed in the top of the insert, a hemispherical cavity is formed at the bottom of the combustion chamber cavity, and the hemispherical cavity is communicated with the groove. The cylinder cover is simple in structure, and the mode of integrally forming the two rocker arm seats enables the cylinder cover to be more convenient and stable in operation during manufacturing and assembling.

title_en: Beam type connecting bridge made of steel plate and used for valve driving mechanism of heavy-duty internal combustion engine
abstract_en: A beam-type connecting bridge for a valve train of a heavy-duty internal combustion engine is proposed, made of sheet steel, for transmitting cam strokes to two equivalent gas exchange valves, the cross section of the connecting bridge being of inverted U-shape and having two side walls connected by a cross beam, wherein the longitudinal ends of the connecting bridge are each provided with a step, which is provided with a contact surface for the gas exchange valve at the underside of the cross beam, which steps extend in a roof-like rising section in the direction towards the longitudinal center of the connecting bridge, which sections are bridged by a connecting surface located in the longitudinal center, which connecting surface has a contact area for the rocker arm base on the upper side of the cross beam, in each roof-like section on the upper side at least one longitudinally extending oil channel, wherein the respective oil channel leads to an oil sump on the upper side of the cross beam in the respective step, and wherein the oil opening extends from each oil sump through the cross beam to the contact surface.

title_en: Exhaust silencer of refrigeration compressor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an exhaust silencer of a refrigeration compressor, which comprises a silencer main body, wherein the bottom of the silencer main body is communicated with a connector, the surface of the silencer main body is provided with a fixed ring, the inner wall of the fixed ring is fixedly connected with a stop block, the silencer main body is positioned at the inner side of the stop block, the surface of the fixed ring is fixedly connected with a connecting block, the right side of the connecting block is provided with a fixed plate, the surface of the fixed ring is fixedly connected with a connecting plate, the left side of the fixed plate is fixedly connected with a long plate, the inside of the long plate is provided with a long groove, and the front side and the rear side of the connecting block are fixedly connected with sliding blocks which are in sliding connection with the long groove. The utility model uses the mounting component to mount and fix the exhaust silencer, and after the exhaust silencer is connected with the compressor, the exhaust silencer can be mounted and fixed, so that the exhaust silencer can not be randomly placed, and the safety is higher.

title_en: Energy-saving equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides energy-saving equipment, which comprises an energy-saving box, wherein two supporting plates are arranged at the bottom of the inner wall of the energy-saving box, ventilation grooves are formed in the two supporting plates, a water tank is arranged at the top of the two supporting plates, a water level sensor is arranged at the corner of the inner wall of the water tank, a ventilation hole is formed in the top of the water tank, and a transmission mechanism is communicated with the top of the energy-saving box in a sealing manner: when gas enters the energy-saving box, the gas firstly contacts the bottom of the water tank, the water tank is heated at high temperature, then the water tank is heated to be hot water, then the gas enters the top of the inner wall of the energy-saving box through the ventilation groove formed in the supporting plate, and enters the air delivery channel through the filter screen, and when the gas flows back from the air delivery channel, the power generation fan can be driven to rotate, then the power generated by the power generation fan is converted into electric power, the gas flows back to the boiler through the first connector for secondary use, and the utilization rate is improved.

title_en: Anti-freezing type chemical corrosion-resistant centrifugal pump
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-freezing type chemical corrosion-resistant centrifugal pump, which comprises a centrifugal pump body, wherein a base is arranged at the bottom end of the centrifugal pump body, a protection box body is sleeved outside an impeller bin, the top surface of the base is positioned on the centrifugal pump body, the protection box body consists of a first protection cover and a second protection cover, thread abdicating holes are formed in the surfaces of the first protection cover and the second protection cover in a penetrating manner, and semicircular threaded holes are formed in the top ends of the first protection cover and the second protection cover. According to the centrifugal pump, the protection box body is arranged, so that the impeller bin inside the centrifugal pump body is protected conveniently, when the centrifugal pump body is assembled, the first protection cover and the second protection cover are closed from the two ends of the impeller bin, so that the impeller bin is wrapped inside the protection box, and then the protection box is fixed.

title_en: Stall-preventing structure of axial flow fan
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an anti-stall structure of an axial flow fan, which comprises an air duct, an outer cylinder and a guide vane, wherein the air duct is integrally formed and coiled into a circle, a plurality of through holes penetrating through the inner wall are formed in the inner wall of the air duct, the through holes are distributed in two groups along the direction surrounding the axis of the air duct, the outer cylinder is arranged on the outer wall of the air duct in a surrounding manner, an airflow space is formed between the outer cylinder and the outer wall of the air duct, and the two groups of through holes are communicated with the airflow space; the air flow space is internally provided with a reinforcing plate, two ends of the reinforcing plate are respectively connected with the inner wall of the outer cylinder and the outer wall of the air cylinder, the reinforcing plate is positioned between two groups of through holes so as to separate the two groups of through holes, and the guide vane is arranged in the air flow space. The stall-preventing structure of the axial flow fan can ensure uniform gap between the air duct and the blades, is simple and convenient to form, saves raw materials and saves working hours.

title_en: Generator set chassis and generator set
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a generator set chassis and a generator set, which comprises a generator set chassis body, wherein an oil tank and a drain board are arranged in the generator set chassis body, the drain board is arranged in front of the oil tank, the bottom of the drain board is positioned below the top of the generator set chassis body, a drain chamber is formed by the drain board and the inner side of the generator set chassis body, and a drain outlet is formed in the position of the drain chamber on the inner side of the generator set chassis body. According to the novel sewage disposal device, on one hand, the sewage disposal plate is arranged in front of the oil tank, and the sewage disposal plate and the inner side of the chassis body of the generator set form a sewage disposal chamber, so that the sewage disposal chamber is separated from the oil tank. In addition, the inside of generating set chassis body has seted up the drain in drain room position to avoid the drain head to sink into the oil tank, lead to the oil tank to have the oil leak risk. On the other hand, the bottom of the blowdown plate is positioned below the top of the generator set chassis body, so that a gap exists between the blowdown port and the top of the diesel generator set chassis, and sewage residue is avoided.

title_en: Floating hydroelectric power station
abstract_en: The utility model provides a floating hydroelectric power station, which comprises a retaining dam and an overflow dam which are arranged on branches, a floating platform used for bearing a power generation system, a T-shaped slideway connected with the retaining dam, and a telescopic steel pipe, wherein the T-shaped slideway is used for limiting the floating platform to slide up and down along with the rising and falling of river water, the telescopic steel pipe is used for connecting the river water of an upstream dam to the floating platform below the dam, and is connected with a hydroelectric generating set in a power plant built on the floating platform, the floating platform is arranged in a downstream river channel of the retaining dam, the retaining dam is built in the branches, so that the water level is kept basically stable, no land is exposed, a lot of mountain collapse is reduced, and sediment in the branches can not directly enter the river channel of a storage area, thereby being beneficial to the sectional treatment of the sediment. The retaining dam is utilized to lift the tributary river water, and the tributary river water and the reservoir water level form a height drop to generate electricity, so that the abandoned water energy resource is fully utilized, and good social and economic benefits can be brought.

title_en: Connecting ring for plunger pump
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of plunger pumps and discloses a connecting ring for a plunger pump, wherein an upper ring body and a lower ring body are spliced to form the connecting ring; the inner wall and the outer wall of the connecting ring are only provided with the lubricating port, compared with the prior art, the lubricating oil groove is additionally arranged, the loss of lubricating grease can be reduced, the damage to the connecting rod and the crankshaft can be avoided when the lubricating grease flows in the oil storage box, the step that the connecting ring is required to be filled with oil in real time by using the oil nozzle in the prior art is saved, the oil storage box can be moved out of the oil storage cavity, the subsequent oiling of the oil storage box is convenient, the working cost and the subsequent maintenance cost of the connecting ring, which are caused by oiling the connecting ring by using the oil pump and the oil nozzle in use, are saved, the problem that the inner oil groove, the lubricating oil groove and the crankshaft and the connecting rod are worn due to the fact that the lubricating oil is interrupted and conveyed in the prior art is solved.

title_en: Roots blower with air inlet treatment function
abstract_en: The utility model is applicable to the technical field of Roots blowers, and provides a Roots blower with an air inlet treatment function, which comprises a sealing hole, a mounting plate and a shell connected with the mounting plate in a detachable manner; the inside detachably of casing is provided with the filter screen, the filter screen is the slope form setting. This roots blower with air inlet processing function is connected through the dismantlement that sets up casing and mounting disc for the device accessible bolt is connected with the air intake of sealed hole, and then when gas passes through the inside that the casing got into the sealed hole, the filter screen can filter gas, makes the inside that the dust can't get into the sealed hole through the filter screen, promotes the sliding plate when the dust on filter screen surface is more, makes the sliding plate drive the movable plate through the connecting rod and slides from top to bottom, makes the cleaning brush clear up the dust on filter screen surface, and the dust that the clearance was got off can drop and collect in the inside of collecting vessel, makes the filter screen can keep normal filtration.

title_en: Sealing structure of high-temperature fan end face
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sealing structure of an end face of a high-temperature fan, which comprises a fan cavity, wherein a rear cover plate and a compression steel plate welding plate are respectively arranged on one side of the fan cavity, a fixed steel plate and a compression steel plate are sequentially arranged on the rear cover plate, and a variable frequency motor flange is arranged on the compression steel plate welding plate. The utility model has the beneficial effects that: a circle of thick-wall steel plate is welded at the rear wall plate of the shell, and then the thick-wall steel plate is connected with another T-shaped annular thick-wall steel sleeve in a stepped mode, so that internal gas does not leak at one point under the condition of a stepped connection structure, hydrogen gas in the fan is sealed, an operation test is conducted at the connection flange of the motor and the fan, the test time is 12 hours, and the gas leakage amount is measured to be zero.

title_en: Electronic water pump
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of liquid pumps, in particular to an electronic water pump. The electronic water pump comprises a volute, an impeller and a thrust component; the volute is provided with a volute chamber and a volute liquid inlet hole, and the impeller and the thrust member are both arranged in the volute chamber; the front cover plate of the impeller comprises a boss and an impeller liquid inlet hole, the middle part of the boss is provided with the impeller liquid inlet hole, and the impeller liquid inlet hole is communicated with the volute liquid inlet hole; the thrust component is arranged between the end surface of the boss far away from the impeller and the surface in the volute chamber close to the liquid inlet of the volute; the boss is kept away from the terminal surface of impeller and is equipped with logical groove, and the one end of logical groove is located the pore wall of impeller feed liquor hole, and the other end of logical groove is located the lateral wall of boss, and the clearance between logical groove intercommunication impeller feed liquor hole and volute and the impeller. The electronic water pump of this application has guaranteed that thrust component has good lubrication with the contact surface of impeller under the condition of effectively solving the assembly clearance liquid leakage problem between impeller and the volute, reduces wearing and tearing, guarantees product performance and life.

title_en: Bearing system and centrifugal compressor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bearing system and a centrifugal compressor, which mainly realize the active oil filling into a bearing hole of a bearing bush by arranging an oil supply system and an oil filling hole, realize the filling of lubricating oil between a rotating shaft and the inner wall of the bearing hole before the rotation of a rotor, avoid the dry friction of the rotor during the starting, avoid the damage of the bearing and reduce the rotation moment. The main technical scheme of the utility model is as follows: a bearing system comprising a bearing assembly comprising a bearing shell and a bearing housing; the bearing bush comprises bearing holes, the bearing holes penetrate through two ends of the bearing bush, at least one oil filling hole is further formed in the bearing bush, the oil filling hole is communicated with the bearing holes, and the bearing bush penetrates through the bearing seat and is fixedly connected with the bearing seat; the bearing seat is provided with at least one oil filling hole, and the oil filling holes are communicated with the oil filling holes in a one-to-one correspondence manner; the oil supply system comprises an oil pump assembly, and the output end of the oil pump assembly is communicated with the oil filling hole. The utility model is mainly used for bearing lubrication.

title_en: Fan and surface cleaning equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses fan and surface cleaning equipment relates to surface cleaning technical field. The fan comprises a shell assembly and a movement, wherein the movement is arranged in the shell assembly; the end plate at one end of the shell component is convexly provided with a guide plate facing one side of the movement, the guide plate is arranged on the periphery of the movement in a surrounding way at intervals, a first gap is arranged between the movement and the guide plate, and the guide plate is spaced from the side plate group of the shell component and forms a second gap; an air outlet of the movement is communicated with the first gap, and a first gap which is communicated with the first gap and the second gap is formed in one side, away from the air outlet, of the guide plate; the side plate group is provided with an air outlet communicated with the second gap and the external environment of the shell assembly, and the air outlet is positioned on one side of the movement close to the air outlet. The fan that this application provided can realize the function of making an uproar falls, improves user's use experience.

title_en: Air supply arrangement and dish washer of dish washer
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of tableware cleaning devices, and discloses an air supply device of a dish washing machine and the dish washing machine. The air supply device of the dish washer comprises a duct fan and a shock pad; the duct fan is provided with a duct fan shell, and the shock pad is sleeved on the periphery of the duct fan shell. According to the scheme provided by the utility model, the damping pad is sleeved on the shell of the ducted fan, so that noise generated by high-frequency vibration of the ducted fan in the running process can be reduced, and the user experience is improved.

title_en: Fan with fan body
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fan, comprising: the motor seat is supported on the base; the fan head, the fan head with the motor cabinet links to each other along first direction, first direction is crossing with vertical direction, just the fan head with the junction of motor cabinet is equipped with clearance adjustment portion, clearance adjustment portion is used for the fan head with the motor cabinet is connected the back reduces the top fit clearance of junction. According to the fan provided by the embodiment of the utility model, the clearance adjusting part is arranged, so that when the fan head is connected with the motor base, the fit clearance at the top of the joint of the fan head and the motor base can be reduced, the stability of the fan during operation is improved, the use comfort of a user is further improved, the attractiveness of the fan can be ensured, the use effect is better, and the application range is wider.

title_en: Tidal current energy pile foundation structure and tidal current energy platform system
abstract_en: The application provides a tidal current energy pile foundation structure and a tidal current energy platform system, and belongs to the technical field of ocean energy equipment. The pile foundation structure comprises a tower and at least one J-tube comprising a straight section, a turning section and a submarine cable entry section. The straight line section and the turning section are both arranged inside the tower barrel, and the submarine cable inlet section passes through the tower barrel and then is exposed outside the tower barrel. The J-shaped pipe of pile foundation structure of this application installs Yu Datong inside, reduces the underwater area of J-shaped pipe, when satisfying the structural safety requirement, guarantees sea cable turning radius, improves the protection level, has guaranteed in addition that pile foundation structure surface does not have bulky attached equipment to satisfy the realization of tidal current energy unit along tower section of thick bamboo lifting function in the tidal current energy platform system.

title_en: Water pump detection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water pump detection device, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a control module is fixedly arranged on one side of the top of the bottom plate, and a detection barrel rotating mechanism, a detection mechanism and an automatic water adding and discharging mechanism are arranged on the top of the bottom plate; detect bucket slewing mechanism and include worm, worm wheel, motor and detection bucket, the worm wheel rotates the middle part of installing at the bottom plate top, the top of worm wheel and the middle part fixed connection who detects the bucket bottom, the material that detects the bucket is transparent ya keli material, motor fixed mounting is in one side at bottom plate top, the output shaft of motor and the one end fixed connection of worm, this water pump detection device can make the water pump shell rotate when detecting, makes people can see the gas leakage position on the clear water pump shell, and the people of being convenient for judge the not good reason of water pump shell gas tightness to can make the water pump shell expose outside after detecting, the taking out of the water pump shell of being convenient for.

title_en: Drilling separate-layer fracturing pipeline system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a well drilling layering fracturing pipeline system, including the nitrogen gas injection pipe, a plurality of pit shaft plugging device, power generation facility and PLC controller, each pit shaft plugging device upper and lower space suit is on the nitrogen gas injection pipe, be connected with interval adjustment mechanism between two adjacent pit shaft plugging devices, the well drilling section that encloses between two adjacent pit shaft plugging devices is the fracturing interval, all be provided with a plurality of pneumatic fracturing pipes in each fracturing interval on the nitrogen gas injection pipe, be provided with first explosion-proof solenoid valve on the pneumatic fracturing pipe, power generation facility provides power for PLC controller and each interval adjustment mechanism respectively, the PLC controller respectively with each pit shaft plugging device, each interval adjustment mechanism and each first explosion-proof solenoid valve signal connection, PLC controller and the indoor remote control system signal connection of well outer control. The utility model can adjust the fracturing range according to the position and thickness information of the multi-layer coal seam, and simultaneously fractures the multi-layer coal seam, and has the advantages of high fracturing efficiency, low energy consumption, high economic benefit and simple operation.

title_en: Quick installation device of fan pipeline
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of fan equipment, and particularly relates to a rapid installation device of a fan pipeline, which comprises the following components: the pipeline body, install a plurality of locking mechanism that are used for locking with another pipeline body on the pipeline body, locking mechanism includes: the installation seat is characterized in that a plurality of installation seats are arranged on the pipeline body, the installation plate is connected in a sliding manner on the installation seat, a plurality of locking blocks are connected with the installation plate in a sliding manner, a plurality of locking holes are formed in the pipeline body in a matched manner, the pipeline body is locked by the locking holes and the locking blocks, the locking blocks on one pipeline body slide into the locking holes on the other pipeline body, and the two pipeline bodies are installed together by using the installation seat and the installation plate, so that the installation process is simplified, the labor intensity of an installer is reduced, and the installation efficiency is improved.

title_en: Water removal high-order air inlet channel assembly
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water removal high-order air inlet channel assembly, which comprises: the air inlet grille, the air inlet channel body, the water blocking ring and the dust exhaust bag; the air intake grille includes: the water collecting device comprises a grid main body frame, blades and water retaining blades, wherein the grid main body frame, the first connecting ribs and the water retaining blades enclose to form a water collecting tank, and the grid main body frame is provided with a water outlet. The air inlet grille is designed with a water collecting tank and a water outlet structure, water blocked by the grille blades is prevented from being sucked back into the high-order air inlet duct, meanwhile, water in the high-order air inlet duct is filtered through the water retaining ring and the dust exhaust bag, and the two-stage filtering mode improves the water removal efficiency and the water removal effect of the high-order air inlet duct.

title_en: High-efficiency side outlet marine pipeline pump
abstract_en: The utility model provides a high-efficiency side-outlet marine pipeline pump which comprises a motor, a pump body and an impeller, wherein a power shaft of the motor penetrates the pump body and is fixedly connected with the impeller, the pump body is fixed on the side wall of the motor, a water inlet pipe and a water outlet pipe are arranged on the pump body, the water inlet pipe and the water outlet pipe are communicated through a connecting port, the impeller is positioned in the water outlet pipe, a first sealing ring which is in contact with the edge of the impeller is fixedly connected on the inner wall of the connecting port, a supporting seat is fixedly connected on the side wall of the water inlet pipe, a sliding groove is arranged on the supporting seat, the sliding groove is communicated with the inner wall of the water inlet pipe, a supporting frame is slidably connected in the sliding groove, a filter screen positioned in the water inlet pipe is fixedly connected in the supporting frame, a second sealing ring which is in contact with the inner wall of the sliding groove is fixedly connected on the outer wall of the supporting frame, one end of the supporting frame away from the filter screen is positioned outside the water inlet pipe, and a power structure for pulling the supporting frame to move away from the water inlet pipe is arranged on the supporting seat so that the impeller is not easy to damage.

title_en: Stirring type sewage and dirt submerged electric pump
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of submersible pumps, and particularly relates to a stirring type sewage and dirt submersible pump which comprises a motor and a pump body, wherein the motor is provided with a rotor shaft and a motor end cover, one end of the rotor shaft extends out of the motor end cover along the axial direction, the pump body is arranged on one side of the motor positioned on the motor end cover, an inlet is formed along the axial direction of the motor, and an outlet is formed along the radial direction of the motor; the pump body is internally provided with a first impeller which is sleeved on the rotor shaft, and one end of the rotor shaft far away from the motor is detachably provided with a stirring shaft and a second impeller, wherein the second impeller is arranged at one end of the stirring shaft far away from the first impeller; through setting up the output shaft into the rotor shaft with stir the split type setting of axle, be convenient for process it, split type design simultaneously, when taking place wearing and tearing after long-time use, only need to stir the axle change can, the maintenance is convenient and with low costs, will stir axle and second impeller simultaneously and install in other immersible pumps, effectively improve its commonality and interchangeability, the adaptation of the production and the operating mode of being convenient for.

title_en: Device for generating power by using hot air waste heat of kiln head cover of rotary kiln
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of hot air waste heat power generation, in particular to a device for generating power by using hot air waste heat of a kiln head cover of a rotary kiln. The technical proposal comprises: the utility model provides an utilize device of rotary kiln hood hot-blast waste heat electricity generation, includes Laval pipe, vortex tube and exhaust-heat boiler, the inlet end of vortex tube communicates with Laval pipe through first pipe, laval pipe and kiln hood intercommunication, the hot junction export of vortex tube is connected with the connecting pipe through the second pipe, the vortex tube passes through connecting pipe and exhaust-heat boiler intercommunication, be equipped with the joint on the exhaust-heat boiler. The utility model effectively improves the air inlet temperature of the kiln head boiler, ensures the evaporation capacity of the kiln head boiler and ensures the generating capacity of the boiler.

title_en: High-precision stable type sea heater pump
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-precision stable type sea-air pump which comprises a pump body, wherein one end of the pump body is fixedly connected with a protection frame, the inside of the protection frame is rotationally connected with a screw rod, one end of the screw rod is fixedly connected with a first bevel gear, one end of the protection frame is fixedly connected with a fixed block, the inside of the fixed block is rotationally connected with a rotating rod, one end of the rotating rod is fixedly connected with a second bevel gear, the second bevel gear and the first bevel gear are meshed with each other, one end of the rotating rod is fixedly connected with a rotating disc, the inside of the rotating disc is slidably connected with a magnetic rod, a plurality of limiting holes are formed in the inside of the fixed block, and the size of the limiting holes is matched with one end of the magnetic rod.

title_en: Novel variable-frequency water pump
abstract_en: The utility model provides a novel variable-frequency water pump. The novel variable-frequency water pump comprises: base, inverter motor, inverter controller, pump head, impeller, inlet tube and outlet pipe, inverter motor sets up the top at the base, inverter controller fixed mounting is at inverter motor's top, inverter controller and inverter motor electric connection, the pump head sets up in inverter motor's one side, the impeller sets up in the pump head, impeller and inverter motor's output shaft, inlet tube fixed mounting is in one side of pump head, outlet pipe fixed mounting is at the top of pump head. The novel variable-frequency water pump provided by the utility model has the advantages that the expansion of the water pipe caused by the water pressure change at the joint of the external water pipe and the water pump can be avoided, and the tightness of the joint is improved.

title_en: Efficient cooling structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-efficiency cooling structure which comprises a mounting shell, wherein a mounting groove is formed in the middle of the back surface of the mounting shell, a mounting plate is fixedly connected to the middle of the mounting groove, a mounting bottom is fixedly arranged in the middle of the mounting plate, a mounting frame is fixedly connected to the middle of the mounting bottom, eight uniformly distributed mounting reinforcing plates are fixedly connected to the middle of the mounting frame, and a first cooler, a second cooler, a third cooler and a fourth cooler are respectively and fixedly arranged between the mounting frame and the mounting bottom.

title_en: Centrifugal pump structure for storage tank
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a centrifugal pump structure for a storage tank, which comprises a storage tank, a mounting plate, a pump body and a liquid outlet pipe, wherein the mounting plate is arranged on an inlet and an outlet of the storage tank, the pump body is arranged on the mounting plate, the output end of the pump body is connected with the liquid outlet pipe, the output end of the liquid outlet pipe extends out of the surface of the mounting plate, at least one mounting opening is formed in the mounting plate, and a detection component is arranged on the mounting opening. Compared with the prior art, the utility model can solve the problem that the self-priming pump cannot suck materials in the discharging process of the storage tank.

title_en: Cleaning device for radiator of wind turbine generator
abstract_en: The utility model provides a cleaning device for a radiator of a wind turbine generator, which relates to the cleaning field of the radiator of the wind turbine generator, and comprises the following components: the radiator cleaning frame, the radiator cleaning frame inboard is connected with the movable plate through electric lift mechanism, the radiator cleaning frame is connected with the washing roof through the articulated shaft, surface mounting has the shower nozzle under the washing roof, driving motor is installed to the movable plate inboard, driving motor is connected with the rotary disk through the pivot, the right-hand member spiro union of movable plate has the installation pole, the installation pole surface cup joints and is fixed with the cleaning brush section of thick bamboo. The utility model solves the problem that the radiating fins of the radiator in the prior art are distributed at equal intervals, and the radiating fins are difficult to sufficiently clean the inner side surface when the water inlet hose is washed.

title_en: Portable outdoor generator set structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of generators, in particular to a portable outdoor generator set structure, which comprises a mounting frame, wherein the lower end of the mounting frame is provided with a mounting plate, a generator is arranged above the mounting plate, the upper end of the generator is connected with an oil tank through a pipeline, the lower end of the mounting plate is provided with a push-pull component, the push-pull component is used for moving the generator, and a lifting component is also arranged on the mounting frame.

title_en: Noiseless heat dissipation shell of computer
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of computer housings and discloses a computer noiseless radiating housing, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein the front surface of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a panel, the back surface of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a back plate, the surface of the back plate is fixedly connected with a radiating component, the back surface of the back plate is fixedly connected with a vacuum dustproof component, one side of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a right side plate, and symmetrical surfaces of the panel and the back plate are provided with sliding grooves. This noiseless heat dissipation casing of computer, through the setting of vacuum dustproof subassembly, will inlay the inside of establishing the hole and insert the HEPA cassette for outside dust is blocked in the outside of ventilation box, avoids the surperficial ash of cooling fan to get into the casing or even the dust, has indirectly improved radiating efficiency, and the sound of cooling fan work partly is blocked by the vacuum connection frame, falls the heat dissipation of making an uproar to the whole computer, can keep the dustproof effect of casing through changing the HEPA cassette simultaneously.

title_en: Box-type natural gas generator set
abstract_en: The utility model provides a box-type natural gas generator set, and belongs to the technical field of box-type natural gas generators. The utility model relates to a box-type natural gas generator set, which comprises a mounting frame and a mounting mechanism, wherein the mounting mechanism comprises a supporting plate, the supporting plate is arranged in the mounting frame, and the top of the supporting plate is provided with a box-type natural gas generator set main body.

title_en: Integrated support of muffler and engine stabilizer blade
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an integrated bracket of a muffler and an engine support leg, which comprises the following components: muffler mounting panel, support mounting panel, bend board and bumper shock absorber installation cushion are equipped with the muffler mounting hole on the muffler mounting panel, are equipped with the support mounting hole on the support mounting panel, and the both sides of bending the board are connected with muffler mounting panel and support mounting panel respectively, and the bumper shock absorber installation cushion is located on the bend board. When installing, can pass through the support bolt cross-under on support mounting hole and engine, the muffler passes through the muffler bolt to be installed on the muffler mounting panel, and the bumper shock absorber passes through the bumper shock absorber mounting pad piece to be installed on the board of bending. Through the integrated support, can be convenient for the installation of muffler, but also can install the bumper shock absorber, consequently can effectively reduce the occupation in space, can satisfy the engine demand of space compact overall arrangement.

title_en: Adjustable centrifugal ventilator
abstract_en: The utility model provides an adjustable centrifugal ventilator, which relates to the field of centrifugal ventilators, and comprises a movable plate, wherein an installation plate is fixedly connected to the outer side wall of the upper end of the movable plate, a driving motor is fixedly connected to the outer side wall of the installation plate, the output end of the driving motor is fixedly connected with a threaded rod, a driving piece is sleeved on the threaded rod in a threaded manner, an angle adjusting rod is rotatably connected to the outer side wall of the driving piece, and an overturning platform is rotatably connected to the end part of the movable plate.

title_en: High-concentration ozone plasma beam gear ring releaser for automobile
abstract_en: The application provides a high-concentration ozone plasma beam gear ring releaser for an automobile, which is provided with a negative electrode component which is connected with a rubber pipe and is provided with a first channel, a square frame body which is arranged in the first channel, high-voltage components which are circumferentially distributed in an array manner and are electrically connected with the positive electrode component and the negative electrode component, and a first gap for forming an ozone plasma beam.

title_en: Floating body device for submersible electric pump and submersible electric pump equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides a floating body device for a submersible electric pump and submersible electric pump equipment, and relates to the technical field of submersible electric pumps. This body device for submerged motor pump includes installation skeleton and buoyancy body, and the installation skeleton is used for fixed mounting submerged motor pump, and the buoyancy body includes two components of a whole that can function independently floats, and two components of a whole that can function independently floats can be fixed mounting in the relative both sides of installation skeleton respectively, and two components of a whole that can function independently floats are located the upside of installation skeleton and laminate each other, and the installation cavity that mutually support is used for holding the installation skeleton is seted up to the downside of two components of a whole that can function independently floats. According to the technical scheme, the floating body device for the submerged electric pump can provide buoyancy for the installation framework and the submerged electric pump so as to enable the submerged electric pump to float in water, and therefore the inlet of the submerged electric pump is prevented from being blocked.

title_en: Impeller assembly structure with wear-resisting bush
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an impeller assembly structure with a wear-resistant bushing, which comprises an impeller and the wear-resistant bushing which are sequentially sleeved on a shaft, wherein the impeller and the wear-resistant bushing are connected with the shaft through keys, one end of the wear-resistant bushing is sleeved on the outer side of a rear hub of the impeller, a sealing ring is sleeved on the outer side of the wear-resistant bushing, one end of the sealing ring is sleeved with a bearing seat, the other end of the sealing ring is provided with a pressing cover in a pressing mode, the pressing cover is positioned between the impeller and the bearing seat and is fixed on the bearing seat, and the impeller is installed on the bearing seat. The utility model is characterized in that: through setting up the back wheel hub of wear-resisting bush protection impeller and avoid wearing and tearing, change wear-resisting bush and sealing ring when the maintenance can, promote shielding charge pump stability and maintenance economic nature by a wide margin, simultaneously, still have the detachability concurrently, satisfy the demand of detection, maintenance.

title_en: Gas-liquid two-phase energy storage power generation system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of physical energy storage, and provides a gas-liquid two-phase energy storage power generation system, which comprises: the device comprises a gas compression module, a heat accumulator, a cold accumulator, a liquid working medium storage device and a power generation module, wherein the cold accumulator comprises a condensing device and a vaporizing device; the gas outlet of the gas compression module is connected with the gas inlet of the heat accumulator, the gas outlet of the heat accumulator is connected with the gas inlet of the condensing device, the condensed liquid outlet of the condensing device is connected with the inlet of the liquid working medium storage device, the outlet of the liquid working medium storage device is connected with the liquid inlet of the vaporizing device, the gas outlet of the vaporizing device is connected with the gas inlet of the heat accumulator, and the gas outlet of the heat accumulator is connected with the power generation module; the gas outlet of the liquid working medium storage device is connected with the gas inlet of the condensing device. The gas-liquid two-phase energy storage power generation system provided by the utility model solves the defects that the liquid working medium in the existing compressed gas energy storage system is easy to be vaporized, so that the pressure in the storage tank is too high, and the system is unstable.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle engine ignition advance angle ECU electric control device
