abstract_en: The application provides an ECU (electronic control unit) for an engine ignition advance angle of an unmanned aerial vehicle, which is characterized by comprising the following components: the device comprises a signal acquisition unit, a signal processing unit and an ignition driving unit; the signal acquisition unit is configured to acquire working condition signals, convert the working condition signals into electric signals and send the electric signals to the signal processing unit; the signal processing unit responds to the working condition signal converted into the electric signal sent by the signal acquisition unit and sends an ignition pulse instruction to the ignition driving unit; the ignition drive unit includes: an ignition driving circuit, an ignition coil and a spark plug; and an ignition driving unit for controlling the ignition of the spark plug in response to the ignition pulse command. The ignition can be controlled by any given ignition advance angle curve, so that the control precision and the operation reliability of the ignition advance angle electric control system are well ensured.

title_en: Oil field is with well washing sled based on stagnation booster energy-saving pump
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a well cleaning sled for an oil field based on a stagnation pressurization energy-saving pump, which relates to the technical field of well cleaning sled. Through setting up parts such as booster pump and solenoid valve, when the booster pump is to the hot water of heating cabinet inside, through control box electrical control solenoid valve operation, the water that the acceleration was taken out of rising temperature is spouted through the connecting pipe to in the aspect of reducing carbon dioxide emission mainly changes the plunger pump of original oil fuel engine output power into electric drive, has reached energy-conserving purpose, in the aspect of eliminating the potential safety hazard, owing to adopted automated control, becomes automatic control with original manual operation, has kept away from the pump high pressure region, has avoided high pressure to hurt people hidden danger.

title_en: Novel air separation liquid oxygen pump seal gas system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel air separation liquid oxygen pump sealing gas system, which comprises a low-pressure nitrogen pipe network and an argon pipe network, wherein the low-pressure nitrogen pipe network is sequentially connected with a connecting point, a sealing gas system and an air separation liquid oxygen pump through a pipeline provided with a valve I and a valve II; the argon pipe network is connected with the connecting point through a pipeline provided with a valve III, a valve IV and a valve V, and a valve VI is arranged on a pipeline branch between the valve IV and the valve V. The utility model adopts a novel sealing gas system, improves the existing system, can use clean anhydrous argon as the sealing gas of the liquid oxygen pump, prevents water from entering the sealing gas of the liquid oxygen pump, ensures that the liquid oxygen pump can stably run, and prevents the accident of freezing the sealing gas system of the liquid oxygen pump.

title_en: Roots vacuum pump sealing water treatment system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the utility model provides a Roots vacuum pump sealing water treatment system, and belongs to the technical field of energy supply equipment for production of neutral borosilicate glass. The Roots vacuum pump sealing water treatment system comprises: the water tank, the working shaft, the vacuum pump, and first water storage bucket, wherein, this working shaft is used for pumping the sealed water in the water tank for this sealed water flows into the vacuum pump appearance intracavity of this vacuum pump through the sealed water entry of vacuum pump, and this sealed water flows in the first water storage bucket and discharges through the drain valve after the sealed rotor of vacuum pump, and this system still includes: a sealing water recycling unit for realizing recycling of sealing water, the unit comprising: a return pipe connected to the water tank from the front end of the drain valve; and a water return pump in the water return pipe for pumping back the sealing water from the first water storage tank to the water tank. The utility model has the advantages of saving water resources, timely and automatically supplementing sealing water, reducing manpower, controlling water return quantity, saving electric energy and the like.

title_en: Low-power consumption cooling fan wheel of automobile engine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of cooling fan wheels, and discloses a low-power-consumption automobile engine cooling fan wheel, which comprises a positioning frame, wherein a flow guide assembly is arranged on the inner side of the right end of the positioning frame and used for improving heat dissipation efficiency and reducing power consumption, a quick assembly and disassembly assembly is embedded on the outer side of the positioning frame and used for quickly disassembling a main body cover on the outer side, the flow guide assembly comprises a bearing sleeve, a flow guide end head is arranged on the right side of the bearing sleeve, and four groups of flow guide frames are arranged on the outer side of the bearing sleeve. This automobile engine cooling fan wheel of low-power consumption provides the restriction through installing the water conservancy diversion subassembly through being provided with the structure that the bearing housing can be inside, keeps the fan wheel rotatory to remain stable, and the rethread water conservancy diversion end can reduce the resistance, can carry out the water conservancy diversion to the air current of inhaling inside through the water conservancy diversion frame, makes the state that the air current that gets into produce the swirl promote radiating efficiency through the water conservancy diversion to reduce the function.

title_en: Cooling rubber water pipe assembly with water temperature sensor
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a cooling rubber water pipe assembly with a water temperature sensor, which comprises a first cooling water pipe and a second cooling water pipe, wherein a two-way valve is inserted between one end of the first cooling water pipe and one end of the second cooling water pipe and is clamped and fixed through a clamp; the utility model invades the temperature detecting head of the water temperature sensor into the cooling liquid, converts the temperature information into an electric signal and transmits the electric signal to the battery management system, thereby achieving the effect of monitoring the temperature and measuring the temperature of the engine cooling liquid.

title_en: Wind power jacket tower of ascending a height
abstract_en: The utility model provides a wind power jacket ascending tower, which relates to the technical field of jacket construction and comprises the following technical scheme: including a plurality of support bed-jig, a plurality of support bed-jig splice in proper order from bottom to top, support the bed-jig and include the support body, cat ladder mechanism and stop the platform, cat ladder mechanism fixes on the support body, the bottom of cat ladder mechanism and the bottom parallel and level of support body, the top of cat ladder mechanism and the top parallel and level of support body, stop the platform setting on the top of support body, cat ladder mechanism top is close to stop the platform setting, the top that is located the support bed-jig of top is provided with a plurality of pylon and passes a bridge, a plurality of pylon pass a bridge and be circumference array arrangement, the pylon passes a bridge and keeps away from the one end and the jacket connection of support bed-jig, it is provided with a plurality of anti-toppling mechanisms to encircle on the support bed-jig that is located the below. Through this pylon of ascending a height, can construct a plurality of jackets simultaneously, can improve the efficiency of construction to the jacket when controlling construction cost.

title_en: Compression ratio adjusting device of turbocharged diesel engine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a compression ratio adjusting device of a turbocharged diesel engine, which comprises a cylinder sleeve lifting unit, a lifting guide unit and a self-adaptive adjusting unit, wherein two ends of an upper cylinder of the cylinder sleeve lifting unit are respectively fixed between the lower side of an upper plate and the upper side of a cylinder sleeve, and two ends of a lower cylinder are respectively fixed between the lower side of a cylinder sleeve flange and the upper side of a frame. The cylinder sleeve rings are respectively embedded and fixed in the outer edge of the lower part of the cylinder sleeve, and the outer circle of the cylinder sleeve rings is respectively in clearance fit with the cylinder sleeve mounting hole on the upper part of the frame; the upper end and the lower end of the lifting guide unit are fixedly connected with the two ends of the upper plate and the upper side of the frame respectively, and the self-adaptive adjusting unit comprises a control cylinder and a signaling mechanism. The utility model makes the compression ratio of the diesel engine change adaptively along with the load change of the diesel engine. The low-load dynamic property and economy of the diesel engine are obviously improved, knocking of the diesel engine is avoided, and the running safety of the diesel engine is improved.

title_en: Automobile air conditioner compressor fixing frame
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automobile air conditioner compressor fixing frame which comprises a compressor body and a fixing assembly. The both sides of compressor body are equipped with the connecting piece, and fixed subassembly is connected with the connecting piece. The fixing assembly is provided with a fixing seat, a first elastic piece, a second elastic piece and a limiting piece, a mounting hole is formed in the connecting piece, a mounting portion is arranged on the fixing seat, a placing groove for placing the first elastic piece and the second elastic piece is formed in the middle of the mounting portion, retaining portions are arranged on two sides of the placing groove, and the second elastic piece is arranged at two ends of the first elastic piece. This vehicle air conditioner compressor mount simple structure, simple to operate not only can be fixed with the compressor body, but also can play the buffering to the compressor body through first elastic component and second elastic component simultaneously, can make the compressor body can not receive external environment vibration and receive the influence, can prolong the life of compressor body, guarantees simultaneously that the compressor body is in steady state when the operation.

title_en: Heat radiation structure and magnetic suspension fan of magnetic suspension fan motor
abstract_en: The utility model provides a heat radiation structure of a magnetic suspension fan motor and a magnetic suspension fan, and belongs to the field of air blowers, wherein the heat radiation structure of the magnetic suspension fan motor comprises a shell and an air cooling mechanism, the shell is coaxial with the motor, the inner wall of the middle part of the shell is connected with a stator of the motor, the air cooling mechanism comprises a first air cooling component arranged in the middle part of the shell, the first air cooling component comprises a blower and an air cooling channel, the air cooling channel is arranged on the outer wall of the shell in a surrounding manner and corresponds to the stator, the air cooling channel is provided with an air inlet and an air outlet which are respectively positioned on two opposite sides of the shell, the blower is arranged on the outer wall of the shell, and an air blowing port of the blower is communicated with the air inlet. The heat radiation structure of the magnetic suspension fan motor provided by the utility model can solve the technical problems of high risk, high cost, unreasonable structural arrangement of the air cooling structure and poor heat radiation effect of the existing water cooling structure.

title_en: Turbine power generation system capable of carrying out peak regulation in real time
abstract_en: The steam turbine power generation system capable of carrying out real-time peak regulation comprises a steam turbine and a boiler, wherein the steam turbine comprises a high-pressure cylinder, a medium-pressure cylinder and a low-pressure cylinder, the boiler can produce steam for driving the steam turbine to carry out load power generation, and the steam turbine power generation system also comprises a medium-pressure cylinder maintenance temperature steam generator, wherein the medium-pressure cylinder maintenance temperature steam generator is used for producing medium-pressure cylinder maintenance temperature steam with the same or similar temperature to that of steam used for power generation of the medium-pressure cylinder of the steam turbine; when the combustion system of the boiler stops generating electricity, the medium pressure cylinder maintaining temperature steam generator conveys medium pressure cylinder maintaining temperature steam into the medium pressure cylinder of the steam turbine through the steam inlet of the medium pressure cylinder, and the medium pressure cylinder maintaining temperature steam flows out from the steam outlet of the medium pressure cylinder. The purpose of the system is to provide a real-time peak regulation turbine power generation system which enables a turbine to be in thermal state standby in a non-power generation or micro-power generation state, and can quickly respond and thermally start the turbine once power is needed by a power grid, so that the turbine can immediately enter a normal power generation state.

title_en: Wind-force compressed air energy storage device
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of wind energy utilization, in particular to a wind power compressed air energy storage device. The upper guide plates are connected in the upper air inlet holes, and an upper guide channel is formed between two adjacent upper guide plates. An upper guide cylinder with the inner diameter decreasing from top to bottom is connected to the bottom of the upper shell. The bottom of the upper guide cylinder is communicated with the compressed air energy storage equipment through a guide pipeline. After the support shell is suspended, wind enters the upper shell through the upper diversion channel and flows along the inner wall of the upper shell to form vortex airflow, so that the flow speed is increased. The vortex airflow flows upwards to the bottom of the guide cylinder in a vortex track, the flow speed is continuously increased, and high-speed high-pressure airflow is formed and guided to the compressed air energy storage equipment through the guide pipeline to be stored. When the compressed air energy storage device is needed to be used, compressed air stored in the compressed air energy storage device is directly released and taken immediately, and the randomness and intermittence of wind do not need to be worried.

title_en: Novel integrated modularized multi-loop hydraulic pump
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of hydraulic pumps, and particularly relates to a novel integrated modularized multi-loop hydraulic pump which comprises a hydraulic pump body, a connecting shaft and an adjusting fixing seat, wherein the connecting shaft is fixedly connected to a transmission end of the hydraulic pump body, the hydraulic pump body is fixedly connected to the adjusting fixing seat, the adjusting fixing seat consists of a sliding inclined surface seat, a fixing base and a second bolt, and the sliding inclined surface seat is fixedly connected with the hydraulic pump body. According to the novel integrated modularized multi-loop hydraulic pump, through the matching design of the connecting shaft, the hydraulic pump body and motor output shafts with different sizes can be matched and connected for use, the driving use of the hydraulic pump body is met, the applicability is improved, the height of the hydraulic pump body can be conveniently and quickly adjusted for use through the matching design of the adjusting fixing seat, and the height adjustment is ensured not to be changed due to the running vibration of the hydraulic pump body.

title_en: Crankshaft assembly, crank cam mechanism and air compressor
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present utility model relate to an air compression device, and more particularly, to a crankshaft assembly, a crank cam mechanism, and an air compressor, wherein the crankshaft assembly includes: the device comprises a crankshaft, an output shaft and an input shaft; the crankshaft is provided with a tail end and a head end far away from the tail end along the axis direction; the output shaft is connected with the tail end of the crankshaft and is eccentrically arranged with the crankshaft; the input shaft is detachably connected with the head end of the crankshaft and is eccentrically arranged with the crankshaft; the one end that input shaft and bent axle are connected sets up the shaft hole, and the head end of bent axle has the shaft hole of part inserted input shaft to the direction of tail end, and the pore wall in shaft hole has first spacing portion, and the part that the bent axle inserted the shaft hole has second spacing portion, and first spacing portion cooperatees with second spacing portion, makes input shaft fixed each other with the bent axle around its circumference. Compared with the prior art, through the cooperation of first spacing portion and second spacing portion for the input shaft can be fixed each other around its circumference and bent axle, thereby guaranteed the stability that bent axle and input shaft are connected, improved the life of bent axle subassembly.

title_en: Electromagnetic pump with adjustable flow
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of electromagnetic pumps, in particular to a flow-adjustable electromagnetic pump, which comprises a base, an electromagnetic pump body at the upper end of the base and a control device for controlling flow, wherein a guide pipe is arranged on the electromagnetic pump body and is communicated with the control device, and a liquid discharge pipe corresponding to the guide pipe is fixedly arranged on the control device; a plurality of communicating pipes are arranged in the control device, a movable plate is arranged in the control device, and baffle rings are fixedly arranged at two ends of the movable groove; still be equipped with the regulation subassembly of control movable plate position in the controlling means, controlling means is last be equipped with communicating pipe with movable groove matched with seal assembly, through setting up the position of regulation subassembly and movable plate cooperation control movable plate to the communicating pipe and the pipe cooperation of different internal diameters of control realize the multi-gear regulation, can be earlier with communicating pipe and the pipe cooperation of suitable internal diameter restart electromagnetic pump according to the demand, avoid the too big damage equipment of flow.

title_en: Ocean buoy structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a ocean buoy structure, which comprises a floating mechanism, a detection mechanism and a power generation mechanism, wherein the floating mechanism is used for supporting a device to float on the sea surface and preventing the device from being changed in position by collision of sea waves; the floating mechanism is arranged below the detection mechanism, and the power generation mechanism is arranged inside the detection mechanism; in the use process, the small floating body floats on the sea surface, the small floating body makes up-and-down reciprocating motion through sea waves, the small floating body drives the sliding block to make reciprocating motion through the movable plate, the sliding block drives the rotating shaft to rotate through the sliding plate and the rotating plate, and the rotating shaft drives the driving wheel to rotate through the driving belt, so that the power generation is performed through the second motor, the power generation can be performed in the absence of sunlight, and the endurance time of the device is prolonged.

title_en: High-efficiency energy-saving pipeline pump
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-efficiency energy-saving pipeline pump, which comprises a device body, wherein the device body comprises a driving motor, a turbine pipeline and a filtering pipeline, the turbine pipeline is arranged at the driving end of the driving motor, and the filtering pipeline is arranged at the left end of the turbine pipeline; the filter pipeline middle part is equipped with the filtration storehouse, and inside filter equipment that is equipped with of filtration storehouse, filter equipment include preceding filter and back filter, and preceding filter is installed in back filter front end, and preceding filter surface is equipped with preceding filter grille, and back filter rear end is equipped with the filter mantle, and the filter mantle is cylindric structure and front end and rear end be hollow structure, and a plurality of groups filtration pore have been seted up on the filter mantle surface, and the filtration pore is the cross structure, and the filter mantle rear end outside is equipped with the back stabilizer. The device can filter impurities in the water inlet pipeline through the filtering device, so that the purity of water is improved, the pipeline pump body can be protected, and the impurities are prevented from being attached to the inside of the pump body.

title_en: Air outlet channel and air conditioning type range hood provided with same
abstract_en: An air outlet channel and an air conditioning type range hood provided with the air outlet channel are arranged at the rear side of an air outlet frame, one end of the air outlet frame is arranged at the front side of the air outlet frame and extends along the length direction of the air outlet, a sinking main air channel, a sinking left air channel and a sinking right air channel are formed in the air outlet frame, a vent communicated with the air inlet is formed at the rear part of the sinking main air channel, and wind energy entering the sinking main air channel from the vent is shunted to two sides into the sinking left air channel and the sinking right air channel. The wind entering from the wind inlet of the wind outlet channel is blown into the sinking main wind channel from top to bottom, then is split into the sinking left wind channel and the sinking right wind channel from two sides, overflows upwards in the sinking main wind channel, the sinking left wind channel and the sinking right wind channel under the influence of wind pressure, and is finally blown out uniformly at the wind outlet. The air-conditioning type range hood is provided with the air outlet channel on the air inlet body, the air outlet distance is short, the air outlet temperature is low, and the user experience is good.

title_en: Solid transportation system based on gravity energy storage technology
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a solid transportation system based on a gravity energy storage technology, which comprises: the gravity block is arranged between the two conveying assemblies through a fixing piece; the driving wheels of the driving modules are arranged on the two conveying assemblies, so that when the driving modules are started, the two conveying assemblies do circular motion under the action of driving force, and the gravity block is driven to move from a low-altitude position to a high-altitude position and is suitable for storing gravitational potential energy of the gravity block; the power generation module is connected with the conveying system, is suitable for generating power by utilizing gravitational potential energy of the gravity block when the gravity block moves from a high-altitude position to a low-altitude position, and forms an uninterrupted conveying circulation process through a conveying assembly with a closed-loop structure, so that the conveying process is coherent and stable.

title_en: Double-parameter fan early warning device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of fan fault early warning in the fan industry, and particularly relates to a shaft temperature and shaft vibration double-parameter fan early warning device. The fan air inlet temperature sensor, the fan exhaust temperature sensor, the primary fan front shaft temperature shaft vibration two-parameter sensor, the primary fan rear shaft temperature shaft vibration two-parameter sensor, the secondary fan front shaft temperature shaft vibration two-parameter sensor and the secondary fan rear shaft temperature shaft vibration two-parameter sensor circuit are connected with the MCU microprocessor module; the beneficial effects of the utility model are as follows: the operability is strong, and in a normal state, the two-dimensional graph of the shaft temperature in a safe interval and the shaft vibration voltage and time is a zero-voltage straight line; if the two-dimensional graph of the shaft vibration voltage and time is suddenly changed, the shaft vibration voltage breaks through a set threshold value, the device keeps the fault position, automatically alarms, stops, waits for maintenance, prevents the fault from expanding, and does not need to continuously stare at the machine to observe the shaft vibration voltage manually.

title_en: High heat dissipation turbo charging casing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-heat-dissipation turbocharging shell, which comprises a pump impeller and a turbine, wherein the pump impeller and the turbine are connected through a connecting block, a rotating shaft is arranged in the connecting block, two ends of the rotating shaft are respectively arranged in cavities in the pump impeller and the turbine, supercharging assemblies are respectively arranged, and heat dissipation layers are arranged on the wheels of the turbine and the pump impeller. According to the utility model, the interlayer similar to the bone internal structure is added in the wheel body, so that the heat dissipation effect is stronger, and the weight of the wheel body can be reduced.

title_en: Intelligent energy-saving device for water circulation system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of water circulation, in particular to an intelligent energy-saving device for a water circulation system, which comprises a water tank, wherein a connecting rod is fixedly connected to the outer side wall of one end of the water tank, energy-saving equipment is fixedly connected to the top of the connecting rod, a gap is reserved between the energy-saving equipment and the water tank, and filtering equipment is rotatably connected to the connecting rod at the gap. Through cooperation setting between structures such as water wheels, connecting axle, generator and battery, after applying to the clear water backward flow behind the outside mechanical cooling to the power generation box, the clear water is strikeed under the action of gravity and is installed in epaxial water wheels rotation to drive the rotor of generator through the connecting axle and rotate and generate electricity, finally store the electric current transmission to the inside self priming pump that supplies of storing of battery and use, practiced thrift electric power resource greatly, avoided current water circulating device to supply water through the water pump as far as possible, need a large amount of electric power support in the use, cause the extravagant problem of resource.

title_en: Rotor pump for paint production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of rotor pumps and discloses a rotor pump for paint production, which comprises a workbench, wherein a turntable is rotationally connected inside the workbench, a motor I is fixedly connected inside the turntable, a worm is fixedly connected to the output end of the motor I, a rotating shaft is rotationally connected to the upper surface of the turntable, a driving belt is fixedly connected to the front side of the outer wall of the rotating shaft, a turbine is fixedly connected to the middle side of the outer wall of the rotating shaft, the turbine is meshed with the worm, and a connecting rod is fixedly connected to the rear side of the outer wall of the rotating shaft. According to the utility model, the worm is driven to rotate by the motor I, so that the rotating shaft is driven to rotate by the turbine, the connecting rod is driven to rotate, and meanwhile, the sliding plate is pushed to slide on the inner wall of the fixed column, so that the problem that the rotor pump is difficult to accurately adjust in multiple directions is solved, the effect of fully automatically adjusting the direction of the rotor pump is achieved, and the pump can be operated at an optimal working point by adjusting the direction of the rotor pump.

title_en: Circulating water turbine power generation device
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of power generation equipment and discloses a circulating water turbine power generation device which comprises a water storage tank, wherein a water turbine body is arranged in the water storage tank through a rotating shaft, a plurality of guide sliding rods are fixedly connected to the outer wall of the water storage tank, a same sliding seat is sleeved outside the guide sliding rods in a sliding manner, a plurality of push springs sleeved outside the guide sliding rods are fixedly connected to the outer wall of the water storage tank and the side wall of the sliding seat, the upper end of the sliding seat is fixedly connected with a mounting plate, the upper end of the mounting plate is fixedly connected with a power generator body through a plurality of mounting bolts, and one end of the rotating shaft extends out of the water storage tank. The application can firmly clamp and fix the mounting position of the generator body, can realize quick assembly and disassembly, and is convenient for subsequent maintenance and overhaul operation of the generator body.

title_en: Diesel generating set protection type silence big cover
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of diesel generating sets and discloses a protective mute large cover of a diesel generating set, which comprises a mounting frame, wherein a lifting mechanism is fixedly installed in the mounting frame, the top surface of the lifting mechanism is connected with an equipment mounting plate through a screw, the top surface of the mounting frame is connected with the mute large cover through a bolt thread, a sound insulation mechanism is attached to the inner wall of the mute large cover, a heat conducting copper pipe is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the sound insulation mechanism, a servo motor is fixedly installed at the edge of the front surface of the mute large cover, and a transmission rod is connected with an output end spline of the servo motor. This big cover of diesel generating set protection type silence installs diesel generating set on the equipment mounting panel through the setting of sound insulation mechanism, and the big cover of silence protects the equipment mounting panel, and the noise absorption that the micropore abatvoix produced the unit operation, and the acoustic celotex board further gives sound insulation, and the cover body adopts closed structure, and silence effect is good, avoids producing noise pollution.

title_en: Magnetic drive pump capable of idling
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of magnetic pumps, in particular to a magnetic pump capable of running in an idle mode, which comprises a magnetic pump main body, wherein a base is arranged at the bottom of the magnetic pump main body, a rotating shaft is arranged in the magnetic pump main body, a sealing lantern ring is arranged in the magnetic pump main body and positioned at the outer side of the rotating shaft, two groups of bearings are arranged at the outer side of the rotating shaft and positioned in front of the sealing lantern ring, a cooling cavity is arranged between the magnetic pump main body and the rotating shaft and positioned between the two groups of bearings, a shaft sleeve is arranged between the magnetic pump main body and the rotating shaft and positioned in front of the bearings, a pump cover joint is connected with a pump cover through a connecting flange, a gland is arranged between the pump cover joint and the rotating shaft and positioned in front of the shaft sleeve, and an impeller is arranged between the pump cover joint and the pump cover and positioned at the front of the rotating shaft.

title_en: Driving mechanism for sewage lifting device convenient to overhaul
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of sewage treatment, and discloses a driving mechanism for a sewage lifting device, which is convenient to overhaul. The driving mechanism for sewage lifting device of the utility model comprises: the motor comprises a motor barrel, a sealing cover, a motor stator, a motor rotor, a lower end cover, a sealing end cover and an impeller, wherein an observation hole is formed in a top cover of the motor barrel, the lower end cover is arranged on the motor barrel, the sealing end cover is arranged on the lower end cover, the motor stator is sleeved in the motor barrel, the motor rotor is sleeved in the motor stator, a disk shaft hole is formed in the top end of a motor shaft of the motor rotor, the bottom end of the motor shaft extends out of the sealing end cover, and the impeller is sleeved on the motor shaft. The driving mechanism for the sewage lifting device opens the sealing cover, and the conditions in the motor rotor and the motor barrel can be observed through the observation hole; and the motor rotor can be rotated through the disc shaft hole, whether the motor rotor rotates normally or not is judged and confirmed, the state of the motor rotor and whether maintenance is needed or not are known, and the daily inspection and overhaul of the motor rotor are facilitated.

title_en: Anti-blocking device for submersible pump
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-blocking device for a submersible pump, which belongs to the technical field of anti-blocking devices and comprises a pump body, wherein a water inlet pipe is fixedly connected to the side surface of the pump body, a first filter plate and a second filter plate are fixedly connected to the inner wall of the water inlet pipe, a motor shell is fixedly connected to the side surface of the water inlet pipe, a driving motor is fixedly installed in the motor shell, bearings are fixedly connected to the two sides of the inner wall of the water inlet pipe, a rotating shaft is rotationally connected to the two bearings, one end of the rotating shaft is fixedly connected with an output shaft of the driving motor, a plurality of cutting knives are fixedly connected to the surface of the rotating shaft, a water outlet pipe is fixedly connected to the top of the pump body, the purpose of deep water filtration is achieved by arranging the first filter plate and the second filter plate, the rotating shaft is driven to rotate by the driving motor, and the cutting knives are driven to scatter and cut deep water sludge and windings, and the purpose of preventing the blocking of the first filter plate and the second filter plates is achieved.

title_en: Wind power generation is with aerogenerator brake mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of wind power generation equipment, in particular to a wind power generator braking mechanism for wind power generation, which comprises a supporting tower, wherein a generator is arranged at the top of the supporting tower, a blade is arranged on the front surface of the generator, a braking component is arranged at the rear end of the generator, a rotating shaft is arranged between the blade and the braking component, the braking component comprises a brake caliper arranged at the edge of the rear surface of the generator, a brake disc is arranged at the rear end of the rotating shaft, a rotation speed sensor is arranged in the middle of the rear surface of the brake disc, the rotation speed of the blade and the rotating shaft can be detected through the arranged brake disc and rotation speed sensor, and a cylinder and a brake pad are arranged to adjust the rotation speed of the brake disc in a friction force increasing mode, so that the rotation speed of the blade can be intelligently monitored.

title_en: Overhauling platform of large vertical axial flow pump
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of pump station machinery, in particular to a maintenance platform of a large vertical axial flow pump; the device comprises a plurality of brackets which are arranged at intervals along the circumferential direction of the water wheel shell, and an annular platform which surrounds the outer side of the water wheel shell; the bracket comprises a cross brace, a supporting leg and an inclined brace; the cross brace extends along the radial direction of the water wheel shell; the inner end of the transverse support is detachably and fixedly connected to an annular flange on the outer peripheral surface of the water wheel shell; the upper ends of the supporting legs are fixedly connected to the outer ends of the cross braces, the lower ends of the supporting legs are supported on the ground outside the drainage ditches outside the water wheel shell, and the diagonal braces are fixedly connected between the supporting legs and the cross braces; the annular platform is fixedly connected to each cross brace and is formed by sequentially splicing a plurality of pedals along the circumference of the water wheel shell.

title_en: Environment-friendly wardrobe with odor removing mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an environment-friendly wardrobe with a smell removing mechanism, which comprises a wardrobe main body, wherein a first cavity and a second cavity are respectively arranged in the wardrobe main body, two groups of grooves are formed in two sides of the wardrobe main body, a driving motor is arranged in each groove, the output end of the driving motor is fixedly connected with a screw rod, a driving sleeve is arranged outside the screw rod, the bottom end of the driving sleeve is fixedly connected with a movable trundle, and a smell removing fan is arranged at the top end of the wardrobe main body. This environmental protection wardrobe with odor removal mechanism passes through the odor removal fan and gets into the inside heating of heater and forms hot-blast, and hot-blast along the inside of dispersing the wardrobe main part of dispersing the air board even, and the in-process of hot-blast circulation not only can be to the inside peculiar smell of wardrobe remove the flavor, can remove the inside moisture of wardrobe main part moreover, and this structure has realized being convenient for ventilate the function of removing the peculiar smell, has solved the inside poor problem that easily receives the tide and produce the peculiar smell that ventilates of wardrobe.

title_en: Volute of turbocharger
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a volute of a turbocharger, which comprises a volute body, wherein an air inlet runner and a fixed runner are arranged on the volute body, one end of the air inlet runner is provided with an air inlet, the other end of the air inlet runner is communicated with the fixed runner, an air outlet is formed in the fixed runner, at least two fixed blades are arranged on the volute body at intervals along the circumferential direction of the air outlet, and a space is reserved between the fixed blades and the air inlet runner. The volute of the turbocharger has the following advantages: the fixed blades are not in direct contact with the fixed flow channels, so that gas in the fixed flow channels cannot be in direct contact with the fixed blades, but can be contacted with the fixed blades to generate vortex after overflowing from the fixed flow channels, the probability of vortex generation is reduced, and the vortex is mainly generated between the fixed blades and the fixed flow channels, so that the influence of the vortex on the gas in the fixed flow channels is reduced, and the stability of the gas flow in the fixed flow channels is ensured.

title_en: Filtering mechanism for vehicle engine carbon deposit removing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a filtering mechanism for carbon deposit removal equipment of a vehicle engine, and relates to the technical field of filtering mechanisms; the utility model comprises a box body, wherein a feed inlet is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the box body, a feed cover plate is clamped at the upper end of the feed inlet, a water inlet is arranged at one side of the box body, a water pump is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the box body, a water inlet pipe is fixedly arranged at the input end of the water pump, a water outlet pipe is fixedly arranged at one end of the water pump, a water valve pipe is fixedly arranged at one end of the water outlet pipe, a baffle plate is arranged in the water valve pipe, a water valve block is arranged at the upper end of the baffle plate, a plurality of grooves are formed in the outer surface of the water valve block, a threaded rod is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the water valve block, and a water valve cylinder is arranged on the outer surface of the threaded rod.

title_en: Three-dimensional high-power ocean compressor unit that stacks
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a three-dimensional stacked high-power ocean compressor unit, which comprises: the compressor main pry, the container auxiliary pry I, the container auxiliary pry II and the separator pry are connected with each other by adopting a pipeline flange to form a unit main pry, the unit main pry is arranged on the first floor, the stacking frame is stacked above the unit main pry, and the cooler is positioned above the stacking frame; a primary air inlet buffer tank, a primary air outlet buffer tank, a secondary air inlet buffer tank and a secondary air outlet buffer tank are arranged in the compressor main sled; a primary air inlet separator and a primary air cylinder are arranged in the primary container auxiliary sled; a final-stage separator, an inlet pipeline and an outlet pipeline are arranged in the second container auxiliary skid; the separator skid is internally provided with the secondary air inlet separator and the secondary air cylinder, and the compressor is characterized in that the compressor skid adopts a three-dimensional stacking and skid-blocking structure, ensures that the unit meets the ocean operation working condition of high power and large discharge capacity, and has the characteristics of compact integral structure, small occupied space, unit transportation size meeting the land requirement and convenient disassembly and assembly.

title_en: Cooling water control device of compressor heat recoverer and water-cooled compressor
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of compressors, in particular to a cooling water control device of a compressor heat recoverer and a water-cooled compressor, wherein the cooling water control device of the compressor heat recoverer comprises the following components: the first regulating valve is arranged at a first water inlet of a first cooler of the first compression host, and the second regulating valve is arranged at a first air outlet of the first compression host; and the control unit is electrically connected with the first regulating valve and the second regulating valve. The application has the effects of stopping the water supply to the first cooler in time when the high-temperature gas generated by compression is directly discharged without cooling, saving water and reducing the condensation of the air passage condensate water caused by the fact that the first cooler is not used.

title_en: Microplate cell irradiation instrument
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a microplate cell irradiation instrument which comprises an irradiation instrument main body and a base, wherein a first partition plate is fixedly arranged at the bottom end position inside the irradiation instrument main body, a second partition plate is fixedly welded at the top position of the first partition plate, and a third partition plate is welded at one side position of the top of the second partition plate. According to the utility model, through adopting the inlet and outlet grooves and the sealing plate, in the actual use process, the two groups of inlet and outlet grooves are symmetrically arranged in the device, and the purposes of entering and removing the micro-pore plates are respectively carried by the two groups of inlet and outlet grooves, so that the operations of different steps of personnel can be realized at different positions through the separation type arrangement, further, the threat to personnel health caused by the residual X-rays due to the single-side inlet and outlet is avoided, and the sealing plate is also arranged in the area of removing the micro-pore plates to seal the X-ray irradiation area, so that the radiation of the X-rays is prevented from leaking, the operation safety is further improved, the operation is convenient to use better, and the device has the advantages of good protection effect and separation of the inlet and the outlet.

title_en: Tower section of thick bamboo tube coupling and concrete tower section of thick bamboo
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tower tube section and a concrete tower tube, wherein the tower tube section comprises a tube section body, a plurality of embedded sleeves and a plurality of embedded dowel bars, the tube section body is cylindrical, the tower tube section can be connected with the adjacent tube sections through the connecting dowel bars, the connecting dowel bars can extend into the embedded tower tube from the open end parts of the embedded sleeves and are connected with the embedded tower tube through grouting, the connecting dowel bars can extend into the embedded tower tube from the open inner threaded holes of the embedded dowel bars and are in threaded connection with the embedded tower tube section, and further the connecting strength of connecting joints between the tube sections is enhanced.

title_en: Supporting device for compressor installation
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of compressor support devices and discloses a supporting device for installing a compressor, which comprises a fixed plate, wherein the tops of the left end and the right end of the fixed plate are respectively and rotatably connected with a connecting plate, the left end and the right end of the bottom end of the fixed plate are respectively and fixedly connected with a rotating plate, the opposite end of the rotating plate is rotatably connected with a loading plate, the rear end of the inner wall of the loading plate is fixedly connected with a heat dissipation assembly, the left side and the right side of the loading plate are respectively and fixedly connected with a supporting plate, the inner wall of the right supporting plate is rotatably connected with a first screw rod, the inner wall of the right supporting plate is fixedly connected with a first sliding rod, and the top of the front end of the fixed plate is fixedly connected with a fixed pipe. In the utility model, the inclination angle of the compressor can be conveniently changed, the compressor can be parallel to the ground, stable support is provided, vibration and shaking of the compressor during operation can be reduced, heat can be conveniently and freely emitted to the surrounding environment, and adverse effects of heat accumulation on the performance and service life of the compressor are reduced.

title_en: Water pump unit operation data monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water pump unit operation data monitoring device which comprises a monitoring device body, wherein the monitoring device body comprises a camera, a protective cover and a mounting frame, a placement box is fixedly arranged in the protective cover, an electric push rod is arranged in the placement box, one end of the electric push rod is provided with an electric spray gun, a liquid storage box is arranged in the placement box and positioned on one side of the electric push rod, the upper end surface of the liquid storage box is provided with a flexible hose, one end of the flexible hose is connected to the electric spray gun, the rear side of the monitoring device body is provided with a filter screen cover, the inside of the filter screen cover is provided with a heat dissipation plate, the rear side of the heat dissipation plate is provided with a fixing frame, a small motor is fixedly arranged in the middle of the fixing frame, one end of the small motor is provided with a fixing rod, and one end of the fixing rod is fixedly connected to a fan, so that the camera of the monitoring device can be cleaned, the service life of the monitoring device can be prolonged, and the monitoring device can be cooled down quickly.

title_en: Gear chamber structure of making an uproar falls in engine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a noise-reducing gear chamber structure of an engine, which belongs to the technical field of noise reduction of engines and solves the technical problem of gear train noise, the utility model comprises a gear chamber and a gear chamber cover, the gear chamber cover is arranged in the gear chamber, a gear chamber inner cavity is formed between the gear chamber cover and the gear chamber, the inner wall of gear room is equipped with a plurality of first resonant cavities of different sizes, and first resonant cavity is located the outer fringe of gear room, and the inner wall of gear room lid is equipped with a plurality of second resonant cavities of different sizes, and the second resonant cavity is located the outer fringe of gear room lid. The closed installation of the gear chamber and the gear chamber cover forms a first-stage silencing structure, and sound is prevented from being transmitted outwards by the thickness of the casting; the gear chamber and the resonant cavity at the inner side of the gear chamber cover form a second-stage silencing structure; the resonant cavity and the gear chamber cavity form a third-stage mixed silencing structure, and sound waves are continuously reflected, counteracted, damped and attenuated in the mixed silencing structure, so that the purposes of silencing and reducing noise are finally achieved.

title_en: Steam boiler with waste heat recovery function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of steam boilers and discloses a steam boiler with a waste heat recovery function, which comprises a pipeline, wherein a heat conducting pipe is fixedly connected to the right side of the pipeline, a ventilating pipe is fixedly connected to the right side of the heat conducting pipe, a water flow pipe is fixedly connected to the outer side of the heat conducting pipe, a supporting block is fixedly connected to the bottom of the ventilating pipe, a wind driven generator is fixedly connected to the inside of the supporting block, a vertical shaft is fixedly connected to the output end of the wind driven generator, and fan blades are fixedly connected to the outer side of the vertical shaft. This steam boiler who possesses waste heat recovery function possesses advantages such as waste heat recovery function, has solved steam boiler when using, because of its exhaust pipe can discharge a large amount of steam that have heat, and current steam boiler does not have heat recovery function mostly, leads to the loss of heat energy to make steam boiler's availability factor reduce the problem.

title_en: Connecting structure applied to water outlet chamber of automobile radiator
abstract_en: The application relates to a connecting structure applied to an automobile radiator water outlet chamber, which comprises a water chamber, wherein the water chamber is communicated with a first water outlet pipe, the connecting structure also comprises a second water outlet pipe communicated with the first water outlet pipe, a sealing ring is sleeved on the second water outlet pipe, a limiting part positioned behind the sealing ring is also arranged, the periphery of the first water outlet pipe is provided with a pressure structure which is abutted with the limiting part and used for pressing the sealing ring.

title_en: Novel oil nozzle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of oil nozzles, in particular to a novel oil nozzle, which comprises an oil cavity and a clamping device, wherein a nozzle is arranged on the lower surface of the oil cavity, a connecting piece is arranged on the surface of the oil cavity, an oil pipe is arranged on the upper surface of the connecting piece, the clamping device is arranged on the surface of the connecting piece and comprises a mounting frame, the mounting frame is fixedly connected with the connecting piece, a hook is rotatably connected to the surface of the mounting frame, the longitudinal section of the hook is in an L-shaped arrangement, a roller is fixedly connected to the lower surface of the hook, a swing arm is arranged on the surface of the roller, a sliding groove is arranged on the surface of the connecting piece, and a push ring is slidably connected to the inner wall of the sliding groove on the surface of the connecting piece.

title_en: High-efficient refrigerated air compressor machine aircraft nose
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an air compressor head capable of efficiently cooling, and relates to the technical field of air compressors. Including the aircraft nose main part and set up the cooling device in the aircraft nose main part, cooling device sets up respectively at the both ends of aircraft nose main part, every cooling device comprises hollow cooling cylinder and the cooling module of arranging in the cooling cylinder, cooling module includes radiator fan, first radiator, the heat insulating board, semiconductor refrigeration piece, lead cold piece and refrigeration fan, the aircraft nose main part includes the casing, a motor, pump head and cylinder subassembly, it is provided with a cooling device to correspond on every pump head, cooling efficiency has been improved, cooling module installs in the cooling cylinder, the cooling cylinder can directly send the air conditioning to the position that needs the heat dissipation cooling, the cooling effect has been improved, the semiconductor refrigeration piece can last the cold source that produces, refrigeration cooling effect is stable, provide high-efficient, stable refrigeration effect through cooling cylinder and the cooling module of arranging in the cooling cylinder, external factor to equipment radiating influence has been reduced.

title_en: Cylinder sealing device of reciprocating compressor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cylinder sealing device of a reciprocating compressor, wherein a piston rod penetrates through a cylinder body mechanism, a sealing mechanism and a transmission port mechanism, a connecting cylinder is arranged between the cylinder body mechanism and the transmission port mechanism, a sealing ring is arranged between the outer side surface of the connecting cylinder and the cylinder body mechanism and the transmission port mechanism, a transparent connecting pipe is arranged on the connecting cylinder, a bubble pipe is arranged on the transparent connecting pipe, a movable plug is arranged on the piston rod in the connecting cylinder, and sealing oil is filled in the connecting cylinder, the connecting pipe and the bubble pipe; according to the utility model, the connecting cylinder is arranged, the bubble tube is arranged on the transparent connecting pipe, whether the phenomenon of abrasion and air leakage of the sealing structure occur can be judged by whether bubbles occur in the bubble tube, namely the size of the bubbles is changed, and meanwhile, the moving of the movable plug drives the sealing oil in the connecting cylinder to flow, so that the phenomenon that the air leakage bubbles are blocked in the connecting cylinder and cannot be observed is avoided.

title_en: Novel three-tooth gear pump structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides a novel three-tooth gear pump structure, which comprises: the gear chamber is respectively connected with the liquid inlet pipeline and the liquid outlet pipeline, a connecting pipeline is further arranged on the pump body, one end of the connecting pipeline is communicated with the liquid inlet pipeline, the other end of the connecting pipeline is communicated with the second liquid inlet port, the liquid inlet pipeline is further communicated with the first liquid inlet port, a third liquid inlet port, a fourth liquid inlet port and a second liquid outlet port are formed in the position of the inner cover, the first liquid inlet port and the second liquid inlet port are communicated with the gear chamber, then enter the indirect flow channel of the rotor and the rotor cover through the third liquid inlet port and the fourth liquid inlet port respectively, then flow is discharged through the liquid outlet pipeline after flowing to the second liquid outlet port through the indirect flow channel, flow multiplication is achieved under the condition that the volume of the gear pump is unchanged, the flow channel structure is changed into a serial structure from parallel connection, and output pressure flow is more stable.

title_en: Screw pump capable of preventing blocking
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a screw pump capable of preventing blocking, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a screw pump housing is fixedly arranged on the right side of the top surface of the bottom plate, a screw pump body is arranged in the screw pump housing, a plurality of groups of cutting blades are fixedly arranged on the outer ring of the right side of the screw pump housing, a crushing box is arranged on the left side of the top of the screw pump housing, a first crushing gear and a second crushing gear are respectively arranged in the crushing box, and a mounting plate is welded on the left side of the top surface of the bottom plate. This prevent screw pump of putty through setting up driving motor, first crushing gear and second crushing gear and cutting blade etc. can realize smashing harder material through first crushing gear and second crushing gear, and the cutting blade that sets up can cut into little cubic to great massive soft material, when carrying by the screw pump body again this moment, can avoid the jam, improves its conveying efficiency.

title_en: Centrifugal pipeline fan
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a centrifugal pipeline fan, in particular to the technical field of pipeline fans, which comprises a fan shell and a motor, wherein the motor is fixed at the rear end of the fan shell, the front end of an output shaft of the motor penetrates through the fan shell and is fixed with the rear end of an impeller in the fan shell and is used for driving the impeller to rotate, the front end of the fan shell is provided with an air inlet, one side of the fan shell is provided with an air outlet, the outer wall of the air inlet is provided with a filter assembly, the filter assembly comprises a circular plate, the front end of the circular plate is provided with a plurality of through holes, and a filter screen is fixedly arranged in each through hole. According to the utility model, the filter screen is used for filtering outside air, dust and impurities in the outside air are prevented from polluting the inside of the fan shell, meanwhile, the motor drives the cleaning brush on the rotating rod to rotate through the first belt pulley, the second belt pulley, the belt, the linkage rod and the gearbox, the dust and impurities on the surfaces of the filter screens are scraped off by the cleaning brush, and the cleaning is not needed to be carried out manually, so that the use is time-saving and labor-saving.

title_en: Integrated engine remote combustion filtering device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an integrated remote fuel filter device of an engine, which comprises a fuel filter seat assembly and a fuel filter oil inlet and return pipe, wherein: 2 male connectors are arranged on the fuel filter seat assembly; the connecting end of the fuel filter oil inlet and return pipe and the fuel filter seat assembly is provided with 2 female connectors; the fuel filter seat assembly is in snap connection with the fuel filter oil inlet and return pipe through the male connector and the female connector. The utility model can effectively avoid the heat source of the whole vehicle, thus greatly reducing the risk of causing high-temperature accidents; by matching with the existing analysis tool, the oil inlet and return resistance of the pipeline can be accurately analyzed, so that the development period of the product is greatly shortened; meanwhile, the utility model is more convenient to assemble, the problems of nest folding, swing, interference and the like cannot occur in the process of installing the pipeline, and the assembly efficiency of parts and the convenience of after-sale service are improved.

title_en: High-efficient refrigeration industry fan
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of industrial fans, and provides a high-efficiency refrigeration industrial fan, which comprises: the one end fixed mounting of mounting bracket has the fan body, still includes: the protection plate is fixedly arranged at one end of the fan body far away from the center of the installation frame, and a fixing frame is fixedly arranged at one end of the installation frame close to the protection plate; the reciprocating screw rod is arranged at two ends of the fixing frame far away from the center of the fan body through the bearings, when the reciprocating screw rod is used, the moving plate is contacted with the touch switch when moving to the vicinity of the motor I, the touch switch is convenient to control the pump body to work, the spray head sprays water and is absorbed by the sponge strip, then the sponge strip moves to the protection plate and contacts with the protection plate, the water is smeared on the surface of the protection plate, the cooling and the heat dissipation are carried out on the water and the heat near the protection plate is absorbed, the temperature of the fan body in the air inlet process is reduced, and the refrigerating effect of the fan body is improved.

title_en: Wind generating set wind field hub positioning adjustment device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wind field hub positioning and adjusting device of a wind generating set, which comprises a fixed beam and a fixed plate, wherein the bottom of the fixed beam is rotationally connected with a balance block, the top of the fixed beam is rotationally connected with a suspension arm, a hydraulic cylinder is connected between the upper end of the suspension arm and one end of the fixed beam, a lubricating device is arranged on the hydraulic cylinder and comprises an oil box fixed on a cylinder body of the hydraulic cylinder, an oil outlet is arranged at the bottom of the oil box, an oil pipe is connected on the oil outlet, a circular ring is sleeved on a piston rod of the hydraulic cylinder, one end of the oil pipe is connected to one side of the circular ring, and the oil pipe is communicated with the inside of the circular ring. The utility model has reasonable structural design, can lubricate the hydraulic cylinder when the hydraulic cylinder runs, ensures that lubricating oil continuously covers the surfaces of other parts such as a piston, a sealing element and the like, effectively reduces friction and abrasion, can keep a good lubrication state of the internal parts of the hydraulic cylinder through synchronous lubrication, is beneficial to keeping transmission precision, and improves the stability of equipment.

title_en: Negative pressure fan motor mounting structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fans, and discloses a negative pressure fan motor mounting structure which comprises a main body mechanism, an auxiliary mechanism and a dustproof mechanism, wherein the auxiliary mechanism is positioned at the rear end of the main body mechanism, the dustproof mechanism is positioned at the front end of the main body mechanism, and the main body mechanism comprises a device main body, a fixing assembly and a bracket square tube; this negative pressure fan motor mounting structure has realized at the installation of negative pressure fan motor through the installation to main part mechanism, and the mounting panel adopts the welding axle sleeve, is used for fixed motor and rear end cap to make motor safe and reliable, then installs four bellied outer ends on the mounting panel with four support side's pipe, and the mounting panel card is in support side's pipe hole, guarantees holistic structural rigidity and low cost, then installs support side's pipe between fixed subassembly, carries out the fixed installation with the screw at last, and simple structure, intensity is reliable, is convenient for install the motor, has improved negative pressure fan motor mounting structure's practicality.

title_en: Pump body impeller convenient to overhaul
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pump body impeller convenient to overhaul, and relates to the technical field of pump body impellers, which comprises a wheel disc, wherein a plurality of fixing blocks are fixedly connected to the wheel disc, the fixing blocks are arc-shaped, the fixing blocks are uniformly distributed around the axle center of the wheel disc, arc-shaped grooves are formed in two ends of each fixing block, inserted columns are inserted between two adjacent arc-shaped grooves, blades are fixedly connected to the inserted columns, round grooves are formed in the inserted columns in a penetrating mode, positioning assemblies used for fixing the positions of the inserted columns are arranged on the round grooves, each positioning assembly comprises a round rod and a pressing plate, and the round rods are inserted into the round grooves. According to the pump body impeller convenient to overhaul, through the structures of the fixed block, the inserted column, the positioning component and the like, the blades are inserted between the two corresponding arc-shaped grooves through the inserted column, and the positioning component is used for fixing the pump body impeller, so that the pump body impeller is convenient to overhaul; meanwhile, the inclination angle of the blades can be adjusted, so that the applicability of the impeller is improved.

title_en: Slurry pump with anti-blocking function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a slurry pump with an anti-blocking function, which aims to solve the technical problem that a large block-shaped object contained in a mixed liquid entering a pump body is easy to damage impeller blades in the pump body at present, and comprises a motor and a pump body, wherein the output end of the motor is in transmission fit with the driving end of the pump body through a coupler, and the slurry pump also comprises an interception structure; the interception structure is arranged at the water inlet end of the pump body; the interception structure filtering part corresponds to the water inlet port of the pump body; the interception structure comprises a flange A, a sleeve, a flange B and a filter assembly; the flange plate A is fixedly arranged at the water inlet end of the pump body; one end of the sleeve is fixedly arranged outside the flange plate A; the flange plate B is fixedly arranged at the other end of the sleeve; the utility model has the advantages that the large blocks entering the pump body are intercepted, only water and sediment enter the pump body, and the impeller blades in the pump body cannot be damaged.

title_en: Filtration formula drainage equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a filtering type pumping and draining device, and relates to the technical field of pumping and draining. The device comprises a base, a centrifugal water pump, a water inlet pipe, a filtering device, a splicing device, a blocking device and a filter screen, wherein the bottom of the centrifugal water pump is fixedly connected with the top of the base, the outer wall of the water inlet pipe is fixedly connected with the input end of the centrifugal water pump through a bolt, the outer wall of the filtering device is in sliding connection with the inner wall of the water inlet pipe, the outer wall of the splicing device is in sliding connection with the outer wall of the base, the blocking device is fixedly connected with the outer wall of the splicing device, the filtering screen is propped up to increase the blocking area of water flow through the extrusion when the filtering device is fixedly connected with the water inlet pipe, the water flow from a gap between the filtering screen and the water inlet pipe is reduced, the filtered water flow is more thorough, and the purpose of more thorough water flow filtering is achieved.

title_en: Fan module and blowing device
abstract_en: The application discloses a fan module and a blowing device, which comprise a shell, a connecting piece, an assembling base and a fan assembly, wherein the connecting piece is arranged in the shell, an air duct is formed in the connecting piece, the assembling base is connected to the connecting piece, the fan assembly is sleeved and connected to the assembling base, and the fan assembly is connected with the assembling base through a rotating shaft. The fan assembly is connected with the assembly base, and the connection mode of the assembly base and the fan assembly comprises two modes. The first fan assembly part is installed on the assembly base and the second fan assembly part is connected to the assembly base via the rotating shaft. Through the multiplexing connected mode of fan subassembly and assembly base, not only increased the connection stability of fan subassembly and assembly base, simultaneously, this kind of compound connected mode can greatly reduced the space that fan subassembly occupy in the casing, makes the volume of fan module can further descend.

title_en: Wind power tower
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a wind power tower, which belongs to the technical field of wind power and comprises a tower body, wherein a reinforcing pipe is arranged on the inner wall of the tower body, a plurality of groups of detachable reinforcing components are arranged in the reinforcing pipe, a ladder stand is arranged in the reinforcing pipe, a plurality of groups of detachable supporting devices are arranged between a supporting column and the reinforcing pipe, each supporting device comprises three supporting plates, one ends of the three supporting plates are connected with the reinforcing pipe, and the other ends of the three supporting plates are clamped in the supporting column.

title_en: Semi-inlaid high-wear-resistant coating compression ring
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a semi-embedded high-wear-resistance coating compression ring which is arranged in a cylinder body and comprises an upper end face, a lower end face and an outer circular side face, wherein the compression ring comprises a coating and a matrix, an embedded belt is arranged on the outer circular side face of the matrix through the bottom to form a semi-embedded groove, the coating is positioned in the semi-embedded groove and is in smooth transition with the embedded belt, the outline of the outer circular side face formed by the coating is an asymmetric barrel face, and the coating is a PVD (physical vapor deposition) or DLC (digital video camera) coating. The piston ring provided by the utility model has the PVD/DLC coating with the sharp angle of the lower edge of the outer circle, and can simultaneously meet the wear resistance and better sealing function.

title_en: Exhaust gas recirculation intercooling pipeline structure, system, range extender and vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model provides an exhaust gas recirculation intercooling pipeline structure, a system, a range extender and a vehicle, wherein the exhaust gas recirculation intercooling pipeline structure is positioned between an exhaust gas turbine and an intake manifold and comprises a main pipeline, a first pipeline and a second pipeline, wherein the main pipeline is positioned between the exhaust gas turbine and the intake manifold; the two ends of the bypass pipeline are communicated with the main pipeline; in the height direction, the central axis of the main pipeline is higher than that of the bypass pipeline, and the gas output by the exhaust turbine enters the air inlet manifold through the main pipeline and the bypass pipeline. Through adopting the design of two UNICOM pipelines, main line and bypass passageway can all pass through gas, can satisfy range extender performance requirement, have avoided the performance influence to range extender, simultaneously because bypass pipeline is less than main line, the gas that contains steam can pass through bypass pipeline, subsides in bypass pipeline to can collect the steam in gas through bypass pipeline, avoid a large amount of steam to be brought into in the cylinder by gas, avoid range extender fire phenomenon to take place.

title_en: Be used for sweeping floor peristaltic pump of machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a peristaltic pump for a floor sweeping machine, relates to the technical field of peristaltic pumps, and aims to solve the problems that in the operation of an existing peristaltic pump, the service life of a hose is reduced due to the fact that an inner hose needs to be extruded in a reciprocating mode to achieve a fluid moving effect, a pump cover needs to be replaced regularly, and the inner hose needs to be detached and removed in the traditional peristaltic pump, so that the whole peristaltic pump is inconvenient and replacement efficiency is low. The peristaltic pump comprises a peristaltic pump housing, wherein a U-shaped hose clamping groove is formed in the peristaltic pump housing, a hose main body is detachably arranged in the hose clamping groove, a plurality of clamping pieces are arranged at the positions of two ends of the hose clamping groove, arc-shaped grooves are formed in the lower surface of each clamping piece, clamping blocks are arranged on the lower surface of one end of each clamping piece, a plurality of clamping grooves which are transversely arranged at intervals are formed in the outer wall of the end head of each hose clamping groove, the clamping blocks are clamped with the clamping grooves, and a damping rotating shaft is arranged at one end of each clamping piece.

title_en: Overhead air filter assembly
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an overhead air filter assembly which comprises a lower filter shell assembly and an upper filter shell assembly, wherein the lower filter shell assembly is arranged at the top of an engine, the lower filter shell assembly comprises a lower shell, a filter element arranged in the lower shell and a high-frequency silencer arranged in the lower shell, a plurality of mounting cavities are formed in the lower shell, and the lower filter shell assembly integrates a low-frequency resonant cavity, a high-frequency silencing cavity and a filtering cavity.

title_en: Automobile thermostat temperature sensor capable of being quickly docked
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a temperature sensor of an automobile thermostat capable of being quickly abutted, which belongs to the technical field of automobile accessories and comprises a sensor body and a cylinder water channel, wherein an auxiliary plate is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the cylinder water channel, the sensor body is in clamping connection with the cylinder water channel, a fixing plate is fixedly connected to the surface of the auxiliary plate, and the temperature sensor also comprises a positioning rod which is fixedly connected to the outer wall of the auxiliary plate, and a mounting groove is formed in the auxiliary plate. This but car thermostat temperature sensor of quick butt joint, in the use, when needing the butt joint sensor body, will connect the sensor body to insert inside the mounting groove, when fixture block and draw-in groove are in same horizontal direction, the fixture block is under the effect of first spring, enter into the draw-in groove, connect the sensor body at this moment and pass through fixture block and draw-in groove and accessory plate block, and then will connect the sensor body butt joint well, the operation flow is swift convenient, work efficiency is high, need not carry extra instrument.

title_en: Gear pump
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a gear pump, which belongs to the technical field of gear pumps, and comprises a female rotating wheel and a male rotating wheel which are meshed with each other, wherein the tooth profile of the female rotating wheel and the tooth profile of the male rotating wheel are asymmetric, the tooth profile of the female rotating wheel and the tooth profile of the male rotating wheel are matched when the female rotating wheel and the female rotating wheel are meshed with each other Yang Zhuailun, and the tooth profiles of the female rotating wheel and the male rotating wheel are asymmetric, so that the tooth profiles of the female rotating wheel and the male rotating wheel are matched, the female rotating wheel and the female rotating wheel can be completely overlapped when meshed, a closed space is prevented from being formed between teeth, structural support is provided for the female rotating wheel and the male rotating wheel, the female rotating wheel and the Yang Zhuailun are herringbone teeth, the female rotating wheel can be further fully meshed, and the integral stability can be improved to reduce vibration and noise of gears.

title_en: Positioning structure of blower controller
