abstract_en: The utility model discloses a blower controller positioning structure, which relates to the technical field of controller positioning and comprises a protective box, wherein a control terminal is arranged on the front surface of the protective box, an air outlet pipe adapter seat and an air vent are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the protective box, a supporting plate is arranged in the protective box, a blower outlet assembly is arranged at the top of the supporting plate, a controller main body is arranged in the middle of the supporting plate, positioning assemblies for positioning a controller are arranged on two sides of the controller main body, and the positioning assemblies are positioned at the top of the supporting plate. According to the utility model, the positioning of the controller main body is realized through the positioning assembly, and the controller main body is connected between the positioning plate and the supporting seat in a sliding way, so that the effective positioning of the controller main body is realized, the stability of the controller main body is improved, the disassembly and maintenance of the controller main body are convenient to carry out without being fixed through bolts, and the using convenience of the device is improved.

title_en: Air compressor machine with heat radiation structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an air compressor with a heat radiation structure, which relates to the technical field of air compressors and comprises an upper shell, a lower shell and a tank body which are sequentially connected from top to bottom, wherein heat radiation openings are formed in front and rear opposite sides of the upper shell and the lower shell, a driving part, an air guide part, a support, a belt conveying part and a second heat radiation fan are arranged in the upper shell and the lower shell, the driving part is arranged in the middle of the inner part of the lower shell, two output ends which are respectively a first output end and a second output end are arranged on the driving part, the air guide part is arranged on one side of the first output end, the air guide part comprises a first heat radiation fan, the first heat radiation fan is fixedly connected with the first output end of the driving part, the support is arranged on one side close to the second output end of the driving part, and the belt conveying part is arranged on one side close to the second output end of the driving part.

title_en: Material pump capable of reducing vibration
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pumping pump capable of reducing vibration, which relates to the technical field of pumping pumps and comprises a mounting base, wherein a rubber block is arranged at the top of the mounting base, a pump body is arranged at the top of the rubber block, a discharge hole is formed in one side of the pump body, a fixed box is arranged at the other side of the pump body, a feed inlet is formed in the outer part of the fixed box, a mounting groove is formed in the fixed box, a damping strip is connected to the inner part of the mounting groove, a cage plate is arranged on the opposite surface of the damping strip, and a pulling block is arranged at the top of the cage plate. According to the utility model, the pump body, the feed inlet, the fixed box and the cage plate are arranged, and the material in the feed inlet is split through the cage plate, so that the flow speed of the material can be reduced, the impact force of the material on the inner wall of the pump body is reduced, the vibration of the pump body is slowed down, the parts in the pump body can be protected, and the pump has higher practicability.

title_en: Energy supply system of steam turbine low pressure bypass mode coupling cut jar mode
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a steam turbine low pressure bypass mode coupling cuts energy supply system of jar mode, this energy supply system is through setting up and cuts jar energy supply unit and low pressure bypass energy supply unit, makes the partial medium pressure jar exhaust steam or reheat steam in the unit of power plant get into energy supply unit, not only can promote energy supply system external heat supply and reduce the peak regulation lower limit of unit, and then can promote the peak regulation space of unit of power plant, can also realize the purpose of meticulous peak regulation. Meanwhile, the high-quality steam of the medium-pressure cylinder is utilized to drive the back pressure machine to do work, the generated energy of the back pressure machine can provide part of station service electricity, and the comprehensive electricity utilization rate of the power plant is reduced. In addition, the exhaust steam of the back press, the exhaust steam of a part of the medium pressure cylinder and a part of reheat steam are used for driving the heat pump device and the heat supply network water heater, and the heat pump and the heat supply network heater are utilized for recovering the residual heat in the circulating water or the circulating gas, so that the low-grade energy is fully utilized, and the external heat supply quantity can be greatly improved.

title_en: High-performance friction plate sliding bearing brake
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-performance friction plate sliding bearing brake which comprises a lower clamp body, wherein an upper clamp body is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the lower clamp body, symmetrical grooves are formed in the upper surface of the upper clamp body, lower gaskets are arranged in the grooves, side gaskets are fixedly inlaid on the front surface of the lower clamp body, oil inlet holes are formed in the front surfaces of the side gaskets, oil inlet grooves are formed in the front surfaces of the lower clamp body, and the rear ends of the oil inlet holes are communicated with the oil inlet grooves.

title_en: Film coating machine self-assembly equipment for research and development experiments
abstract_en: The application relates to self-assembly equipment of a film coating machine for research and development experiments. The coating agent liquid inlet unit comprises a pulp mixing tank and a peristaltic pump which are used for preparing the coating agent, the pulp mixing tank is communicated with the spray gun unit, the compressed air unit comprises an air compressor and an air pressure tank, the air compressor is communicated with the air pressure tank, and the air pressure tank is communicated with the spray gun unit. The application uses the coating agent liquid inlet unit for the preparation and supply of the coating agent, the compressed air unit provides compressed air, the hot air system and the exhaust system are connected with the coating host, the lower inlet and the upper outlet are further added with the rotation of the coating pan, so that the hot air circulation is more effective, the instant drying of the medicine in the coating process and the control of the coating temperature are ensured, and the application is suitable for the requirements of the existing research and development experiments, the controllable technological parameters and the moderate price.

title_en: Intelligent ventilation control system of transformer substation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent ventilation control system of a transformer substation, which comprises a control module, a sensor module, a fan power module and a communication module, wherein the sensor module comprises a temperature sensor module, a wind speed sensor module, a wind pressure sensor module and a gas sensor module, the temperature sensor module, the wind speed sensor module, the wind pressure sensor module and the gas sensor module are connected with the control module based on the communication module, the fan power module comprises a PWM control module, the PWM control module is connected with the communication module, and a first PID operation module and a second PID operation module are arranged in the PWM control module. According to the intelligent ventilation system and the intelligent ventilation method, through a multisensor data multisource fusion technology and a PID control adjustment technology, intelligent control of the ventilation effect of the fan of the transformer substation is achieved, the ventilation environment of the transformer substation is optimized, and the intelligent ventilation and heat dissipation efficiency of the transformer substation is improved.

title_en: Eccentric sleeve and eccentric sleeve assembly
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an eccentric sleeve and an eccentric sleeve assembly, wherein an axle hole is formed in the eccentric sleeve, the axle hole extends to one axial end of the eccentric sleeve to form an opening, a radially protruding shoulder is arranged outside the eccentric sleeve, one end of the shoulder, which is far away from the opening, is a plane end, one end of the eccentric sleeve, which is provided with the opening, is a first inclined plane end, one end of the eccentric sleeve, which is opposite to the opening, is a second inclined plane end, the first inclined plane end is parallel to the second inclined plane end, and the first inclined plane end is not parallel to the plane where the plane end is arranged and is perpendicular to the axle hole. The bottom end of the eccentric sleeve is arranged at the second inclined plane end parallel to the first inclined plane end, so that when the first inclined plane end is vertical to the motor shaft, the first inclined plane end and the second inclined plane end are both in a horizontal state, and a conventional vertical crimping method and a crimping method with the motor shaft facing upwards are adopted.

title_en: Noise reduction fan current collector
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a noise reduction fan current collector, which relates to the technical field of centrifugal fans and comprises a volute, wherein an impeller is arranged in the volute, an air inlet is formed in the volute, the current collector is arranged in the air inlet, and the impeller, the air inlet and the current collector are coaxially arranged. The flow collector comprises a mounting seat and a hollow guide cylinder arranged on the mounting seat, wherein an annular guide groove is arranged on the outer wall of the guide cylinder, an annular step groove is arranged on the inner wall of the guide cylinder, a noise reduction layer is arranged in an interlayer of the guide cylinder, honeycomb holes are formed in the noise reduction layer, the guide groove can disturb the airflow entering the flow collector, a laminar fluid layer attached to the surface of the flow collector is destroyed to become turbulent flow, the purpose of flow separation in advance is achieved, large vortex is avoided, meanwhile, the noise reduction layer is arranged in the interlayer of the guide cylinder, honeycomb holes are formed in the noise reduction layer, the penetration force of noise can be reduced by the honeycomb holes, the pneumatic noise can be reduced, and the tone of the air inlet noise is reduced.

title_en: Wind driven generator base
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wind driven generator base, which comprises symmetrically arranged coupling assemblies, wherein a connecting column is fixedly connected between the two coupling assemblies, a connecting sleeve is rotatably connected to the outer side of the connecting column, a base plate is fixedly connected to the connecting sleeve, the connecting sleeve can be adjusted, the base plate can be in a horizontal state through adjusting the connecting sleeve under the uneven ground state of a fixed base, additional leveling is not needed, the base mounting operation is simplified, positioning bolts are arranged on the base plate, a pre-positioning assembly is arranged on the inner side of the connecting sleeve, a movable clamping plate is enabled to approach a fixed clamping block through a driving rod piece so as to clamp the connecting column, the connecting sleeve is fixed, the pre-fixing of the base plate is realized, the operation is convenient, when the base plate is in the horizontal state, a cushion block is padded to the lower side of the base plate after the pre-fixing is finished, the base plate can be kept horizontal, and finally the positioning bolts are enabled to be nailed into the ground, so that the base plate is fixed.

title_en: Wind power gear box
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a wind power gearbox (100), comprising a hollow shaft (1) serving as an output shaft of the wind power gearbox, a threading pipe (2) arranged in the hollow shaft and rotatably supported relative to the hollow shaft through a threading pipe bearing (3), the threading pipe bearing being arranged on one side of the threading pipe close to a generator, a sealing end cover (4) arranged on one side of the threading pipe bearing close to the generator and sealing the threading pipe bearing, and a sealing element (5) arranged on the opposite side of the threading pipe bearing from the generator and positioned between the hollow shaft and the threading pipe so as to prevent lubricating oil in the threading pipe from flowing to the threading pipe bearing. According to the utility model, the sealing piece is arranged on one side of the threading tube bearing away from the generator, so that lubricating oil in the hollow shaft can be prevented from flowing to the threading tube bearing and then leaking to the generator.

title_en: Novel air pump and hydrotherapy machine
abstract_en: The utility model provides a novel air pump and a hydrotherapy machine, wherein the novel air pump comprises a mounting shell, a centrifugal component and a heating unit, wherein the mounting shell is provided with a sealed accommodating cavity, a first air inlet, a second air inlet and an air outlet which are respectively communicated with the sealed accommodating cavity, the centrifugal component comprises a first centrifugal component and a second centrifugal component which are arranged in the sealed accommodating cavity in parallel, the first centrifugal component is arranged at the first air inlet, the second centrifugal component is arranged at the second air inlet, and the heating unit is arranged in front of the air outlet and is used for heating air exhausted by the centrifugal component. Through setting up first centrifugal component and second centrifugal component at first air inlet, second air inlet respectively, utilize first centrifugal component and second centrifugal component simultaneous working to carry out the action of blowing, under the output circumstances of long-time, big amount of wind, reduce single centrifugal component's working power, avoid the excessive heat to gather and lead to working temperature too high and guarantee the life of air pump.

title_en: High heat-resistant high-stability fire-fighting smoke exhaust fan
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of smoke exhaust fans, and discloses a high-heat-resistance high-stability fire-fighting smoke exhaust fan which comprises a support frame, wherein an air cylinder is fixedly arranged at the upper part of the support frame, a cold water tank is fixedly arranged at the upper part of the side of the support frame, a semiconductor refrigerator is fixedly arranged at the outer side of the cold water tank, a pump is fixedly arranged at the outer side of the cold water tank, a cooling bin is fixedly arranged at the back surface of the support frame, a motor is fixedly arranged at the back surface of the support frame, a heat conducting plate is arranged on the inner wall of the cooling bin, a plurality of heat conducting bins are fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the heat conducting plate, a heat conducting block is slidably arranged on the inner wall of the heat conducting bins, a heat conducting arc plate is fixedly arranged at the lower end of the heat conducting block, a water pipe is arranged outside the pump, a water suction pipe is communicated with the lower surface of the cooling bin, and a radiating fin is arranged outside the air cylinder. And then can carry out effectual cooling to the motor, make the motor can operate steadily for a longer time to improve the operating time of exhaust fan under the high temperature, improve exhaust fan's life.

title_en: Device for replacing and operating axial flow fan at bottom of tower
abstract_en: The application provides a device for replacing and operating a tower bottom axial flow fan. The device comprises a rectangular operation platform (1), a first supporting rod (2) and a second supporting rod (3) which are used for supporting the rectangular operation platform, wherein the rectangular operation platform (1) comprises a bottom plate (11), two installation frames (12) and a plurality of rolling shafts (13), the two installation frames (12) are respectively and fixedly arranged on two sides of the bottom plate (11), the rolling shafts (13) are arranged on the bottom plate (11) in parallel and are detachably connected with the installation frames (12), protective guards (14) are respectively and fixedly arranged on the two installation frames (12), the first supporting rod (2) is fixedly arranged on the foot portion of the rectangular operation platform (1), the second supporting rod (3) is detachably connected with the first supporting rod (2), and pulleys (31) are arranged at the bottom of the second supporting rod (3). The device can easily move equipment, can stably move the carrying equipment to a target position, and reduces the damage to the equipment caused by lifting.

title_en: Filter convenient to change for automobile engine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a filter for an automobile engine, which is convenient to replace and comprises a filter shell, wherein an oil inlet is formed in the edge position of the upper end of the filter shell, an oil outlet is formed in the middle position of the upper end of the filter shell, butt joint threads are arranged in the oil outlet, a connecting bayonet is arranged at the lower end of the filter shell, a positioning mechanism is connected at the connecting bayonet and comprises a positioning ring connected at the connecting bayonet, an anti-slip pad is arranged in the positioning ring, and a screwing mechanism is connected in a butt joint clamping groove. According to the filter for the automobile engine, the screwing rod can rotate along the movable shaft after the limit screw is loosened, so that the screwing rod can be unfolded, the tail end of the screwing rod can be pressed after the screwing rod is unfolded, the filter shell can be driven to rotate after the tail end of the screwing rod is pressed, and therefore the filter shell is screwed by the screwing rod, and a vehicle owner can conveniently and rapidly replace the filter.

title_en: Oil injection pump roller body assembly
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an oil injection pump roller body assembly, which comprises a shell, wherein a pin shaft is fixedly arranged on the shell, a rolling element is rotatably connected to the pin shaft, the rolling element comprises a roller, a cavity is formed in the roller, penetrating holes communicated with the cavity are formed in the front side and the rear side of the roller and correspond to the position of the pin shaft, a retainer is welded in the cavity through a connecting rod, a through hole is formed in the retainer, and a fixed shaft is welded between the front side and the rear side of the inner wall of the through hole. This injection pump gyro wheel body subassembly, structural design is reasonable, convenient to use, in the during operation all adopts rolling connection to contact each other between gyro wheel surface and shell internal surface, the internal surface of gyro wheel and the round pin axle surface, can effectively reduce the frictional wear who produces each other to avoid the damage or the inefficacy of gyro wheel body subassembly, prolonged life, holistic structural strength is high, can satisfy the user demand of injection pump comprehensively.

title_en: Device for preventing liquid spraying at liquid filling opening of self-priming water pump
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a device for preventing liquid from spraying at a liquid filling port of a self-priming water pump, and relates to the technical field of self-priming water pumps. This prevent to inhale device of water pump filling port hydrojet through rotating adjusting knob drive accommodate the lead screw and rotate, the guide post slides in the through-hole inboard and leads to the lifter, drive the vertical decline of lifter, make the lower extreme of briquetting closely laminate with the upper end of sealed lid, realize compressing tightly fixedly to sealed lid, avoid sealed lid not hard up the normal work that leads to corrosivity liquid splash to influence the water pump body, utilize the rubber material elasticity of slipmat, corrosion resistance is strong, have better shock attenuation antiskid of shock resistance, the briquetting atress produces slight slip in the shock-absorbing groove inboard, shock-absorbing spring buffers the impact that the briquetting received, realize the abundant shock attenuation to the briquetting, reduce the impact that vibrations produced to accommodate the lead screw, the mounting panel, the stability that sealed lid compresses tightly has been increased.

title_en: Sealing detection device for submersible pump
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of submersible pumps and discloses a submersible pump sealing detection device which comprises a pressurizing mechanism, a supporting mechanism, a limiting mechanism, a driving mechanism and a main body mechanism, wherein the pressurizing mechanism comprises an air supply head, an adapter is arranged at the top of the air supply head, a mounting base is arranged at the top of the adapter, the supporting mechanism is arranged at the lower part of the mounting base, the supporting mechanism comprises a supporting upper seat, upper supporting columns are arranged at four corners of the bottom of the supporting upper seat, a buffer seat is arranged at the bottom of the upper supporting columns, the limiting mechanism is arranged at the left side of the lower part of the supporting upper seat, the driving mechanism is arranged at the lower part of the supporting upper seat, the driving mechanism comprises a detection seat, an inspection fixing seat is arranged at the bottom of the detection seat, a sliding seat is arranged at the bottom of the inspection fixing seat, and the main body mechanism is arranged at the lower part of the sliding seat. The utility model applies high-pressure gas to detect, and assists devices such as a slide rail, a limiting mechanism and the like, thereby saving time and labor and improving detection efficiency.

title_en: Water pump
abstract_en: The application provides a water pump, which comprises a shell component and a cover component, wherein the cover component is arranged in the shell component, the cover component is used for installing a motor, a pump cavity is formed between the lower end of the cover component and the inner wall of the shell component, a jack through which a motor rotating shaft passes is arranged on the cover component, the motor rotating shaft passes through the bottom of the cover component and enters the pump cavity to be connected with an impeller, a sealing mechanism is arranged between the cover component and the motor rotating shaft and is used for sealing the cover component and the motor rotating shaft, the water pump also comprises a water seal, the water seal is sleeved on the motor rotating shaft, the upper end of the water seal is attached to the sealing mechanism, and the water seal is used for sealing the motor rotating shaft and the sealing mechanism. In the water pump, the sealing mechanism is arranged between the cover assembly and the motor rotating shaft, the water seal is arranged at the lower end of the sealing mechanism, the requirements on manufacturing materials of the sealing mechanism and the water seal are small, the manufacturing cost can be reduced, the abrasion of the sealing mechanism and the water seal can be reduced, and the service lives of the sealing mechanism and the water seal are prolonged.

title_en: Coupling water pump base support
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a coupling water pump base support, which comprises a submersible sewage pump foundation fixedly arranged at the bottom of a tank, wherein a coupling device of the submersible sewage pump is connected with the top of the submersible sewage pump foundation through bolts, the bottom of the submersible sewage pump is fixedly connected with a round table-shaped base, the base is of a frame structure, and the bottom surface of the base is contacted with the bottom of the tank when the submersible sewage pump is connected with the coupling device. The operation stability of the submersible sewage pump is improved, and the convenience of maintenance of the submersible sewage pump is ensured.

title_en: Roller type flat plate fan lamp
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a dull and stereotyped fan lamp of drum-type relates to fan lamp technical field, and this dull and stereotyped fan lamp of drum-type includes the cylinder flabellum; the rotary shaft at one end of the rotary drum fan blade is connected with a rotary wheel in a matched manner, the rotary wheel is attached to the upper part of the two auxiliary wheels, the two auxiliary wheels are connected with a bearing with a seat arranged on the bearing frame in a matched manner, and the bearing frame is fixed on the corresponding arc-shaped groove frame through bolts; the utility model discloses, the rotation wheel laminating of cylinder flabellum one end is placed on two auxiliary wheels, and when two auxiliary wheels played the bearing, still make things convenient for its rotation, and the cylinder flabellum other end is separated with flabellum driving motor's drive shaft after, and it is more convenient to dismantle and install, and arc frame and arc ring gear can rotate on the arc cell frame to can drive the leading truck of blowing and rotate, it is more convenient when dismantling the leading truck of blowing, the electric heating pipe of the inboard installation of leading truck of blowing can provide the heat when needs air-out warm braw.

title_en: High leakproofness's air cleaner assembly
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-tightness air filter assembly, and particularly relates to the technical field of air filter cylinders, which comprises a filter cylinder, wherein a cylinder cover is arranged at the top of the filter cylinder, an air inlet pipe is arranged at the top of the cylinder cover, a filter mechanism is arranged in the filter cylinder, the filter mechanism comprises a first filter cylinder arranged in the filter cylinder, a first filter core is arranged in the first filter cylinder, a second filter core is arranged on one side of the first filter cylinder, a second filter core is arranged in the second filter cylinder, and a fixing rod is arranged on one side of the second filter cylinder. The utility model can ensure that the air entering the filtering barrel can be uniformly distributed to each part of the first filtering core and the second filtering core, thereby improving the filtering efficiency, improving the filtering effect through multiple times of filtering, and simultaneously ensuring the long-term stable sealing effect.

title_en: Cooling device and air supply device
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a cooling device and air supply device, cooling device is used for the fan, including the casing, the casing connect in the structural wall of fan and follow the circumference setting of the air intake of fan, the inside of casing is formed with the cavity that is used for storing and/or circulate cooling medium for with the structural wall heat conduction of fan. Through the technical scheme, the cooling medium is stored and/or circulated in the cavity so as to be capable of heat-conducting and exchanging with the structural wall of the fan, and then the fan is radiated, in addition, the shell is arranged along the circumferential direction of the air inlet of the fan, so that the normal air inlet of the fan is not influenced, and the possibility of heating caused by the running resistance generated in the air inlet process of the fan is reduced.

title_en: Fixed base for handheld fan
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fixing base for a handheld fan, which comprises a base main body, wherein a clamping mechanism is arranged below the inner part of the base main body, a positioning assembly is arranged at the bottom end of a handheld handle, the clamping mechanism comprises a cavity arranged below the inner part of the base main body, a connecting shell is arranged above the inner part of the cavity, a threaded column is rotationally connected to the bottom of the connecting shell, a threaded sleeve is connected to the bottom of the threaded column in a threaded sliding manner, a lifting plate is fixedly connected to the bottom of the threaded sleeve, a sealing ring is wrapped on the outer side edge of the lifting plate, and the sealing ring is attached to the inner wall of the cavity.

title_en: Engine oil filter
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an engine oil filter, which comprises a mounting frame body, a mounting cavity, a filter element and a filter element cover, wherein the mounting cavity is fixedly arranged in the mounting frame body, the filter element is arranged in the mounting cavity, the filter element cover is arranged at one end of the mounting cavity, the filter element cover comprises a plurality of reinforcing ribs, the reinforcing ribs are arranged at the top of the filter element cover in a surrounding mode, one end of each reinforcing rib is provided with an inclined plane to enable the reinforcing ribs to form a trapezoid, the other end of each reinforcing rib is arranged in a surrounding mode to form a mounting part, the filter element cover is detachably arranged in the mounting cavity through the mounting parts, the filter element cover and the reinforcing ribs are made of aluminum materials, the reinforcing ribs can serve as the reinforcing ribs of the filter element cover, the overall strength of the filter element cover is greatly improved, the filter element cover is more resistant to high temperature and durable, the service life of the filter element cover is greatly prolonged, meanwhile, the filter element cover and the reinforcing ribs are made of aluminum materials, the aluminum materials have good heat dissipation performance, heat generated in the filtering process can be effectively dispersed, and the temperature of engine oil is kept stable.

title_en: Miniature water pump
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a miniature water pump, which comprises a pump main body, wherein a water inlet and a water outlet are arranged on the pump main body, a water guide mechanism for enabling liquid to be transmitted from the water inlet to the water outlet is arranged in the pump main body, an interface groove for enabling a pipeline to extend in is arranged at the water outlet, a locking piece which can be matched with the pipeline in a clamping way is arranged at the circumferential position of the interface groove, the locking piece is detachably connected with the interface groove, the connection stability between the water outlet and the pipeline can be improved by matching the plugging groove with the locking piece, in addition, the disassembly difficulty of the pipeline and the water outlet is reduced, and the production efficiency of water using equipment of the water pump is higher.

title_en: Variable valve lift of pedal motorcycle
abstract_en: The utility model provides a variable valve lift of a pedal motorcycle, and belongs to the technical field of motorcycle engines. The cylinder head is internally provided with an air inlet swing arm shaft positioned above the cam shaft, a first swing arm with one end propped against the first cam, a second swing arm with one end propped against the second cam and a second swing arm are rotatably arranged on the air inlet swing arm shaft, the other end of the first swing arm drives the air inlet valve to move up and down through a spring, a sliding hole is formed in the first swing arm, a lock pin is arranged in the sliding hole in a sliding mode, a pin hole is formed in the second swing arm, and an electromagnetic valve for driving the end portion of the lock pin to slide into the pin hole is arranged on the cylinder head. The utility model has the advantages of increasing torque at low speed, improving fuel economy, improving driving experience and the like.

title_en: Mute air compressor
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of air compressors and discloses a mute air compressor. Comprises a shell, an air compressor, an oil separator, an air storage tank, a gas-water separator, an oil mist separator and an equipment air inlet. The air compressor is arranged in the shell and is connected with the outside air, the oil separator is arranged in the shell and is connected with the air compressor, the air storage tank is arranged in the shell and is connected with the oil separator, the gas-water separator is communicated with the air storage tank, and the oil mist separator is communicated with the gas-water separator. The oil separator comprises a first corrugated pipe and an oil return pipe, and is communicated with the air storage tank through the first corrugated pipe and the air compressor through the oil return pipe.

title_en: Wear-resistant plunger of plunger pump
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wear-resistant plunger of a plunger pump, which relates to the technical field of pump parts and comprises a cylinder, wherein a sealing strip I and a sealing strip II are arranged on the outer side wall of the cylinder, a sealing cylinder is arranged in the cylinder, a diaphragm is arranged in the middle of a cavity of the sealing cylinder, an air storage bag I is arranged at the bottom end of the sealing strip I, and an air storage bag II is arranged at the bottom end of the sealing strip II.

title_en: Terminal head and base integral type fan
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a terminal head and base integrated fan which comprises a shell and a fan assembly arranged in the shell, wherein the shell comprises a base, a bag shooting outer frame, a plurality of connecting rods and connecting plates, the bag shooting outer frame is arranged on the periphery of the base, the connecting rods are connected with the base and the bag shooting outer frame, and the terminal head is connected to one side of the bag shooting outer frame, the base, the bag shooting outer frame, the connecting rods, the connecting plates and the terminal head are integrally formed, PIN needles are injection-molded in the terminal head, PCBA plates are arranged on the bottoms of the base and the connecting plates, and the PIN needles are electrically connected with the PCBA plates. The PIN is injected into the terminal head, so that the stability and the firmness of the PIN can be improved, the PIN is prevented from being torn, the wire harness is saved by integrally forming the terminal head, the injection outer cover frame and the base, the wire harness can be prevented from being pulled to cause broken wires, and meanwhile, the PCBA board can be prevented from being damaged when the wire harness is pulled.

title_en: Multi-head pressure distribution device for pumping energy storage unit pipeline pressing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi-head pressure distribution device for pumping and storing unit pipelines, which belongs to the technical field of pumping and storing unit pipeline pumping and storing, and comprises a pumping and storing unit pipeline pumping and storing assembly, wherein the pumping and storing unit pipeline pumping and storing assembly comprises a distributor pumping and storing plate and a distribution pipe fitting which is connected with the peripheral side outer wall of the distributor pumping and storing plate in a penetrating way, the multi-head pressure distribution assembly comprises an inverted U-shaped erection and storage rod rotatably arranged on the top surface of the distributor pumping and storing plate and distributor pipelines which transversely penetrate through the bottoms of the two ends of the U-shaped erection and storage rod, each distributor pipeline is in sealing connection with the adjacent distribution pipe fitting, and a pumping and storing buffer and shock absorbing assembly comprises extension connecting rod pieces symmetrically arranged on the inner walls of the two sides of the U-shaped erection and storage rod and hydraulic dampers respectively transversely arranged on the inner wall of each extension connecting rod, and damping ends of the hydraulic dampers are abutted against the peripheral side outer wall of the distributor pumping and storing plate.

title_en: Fan control device for electrical equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a fan control device for electrical equipment, and belongs to the technical field of electrical equipment. The fan control device comprises a power supply piece, a control assembly and a timing piece, wherein the power supply piece, a contactor and an opening and closing control piece are all arranged in electrical equipment, the power supply piece is electrically connected with the opening and closing control piece, the contactor and the fan in sequence, the remote control piece is in wireless communication connection with the opening and closing control piece, the timing piece is electrically connected with the power supply piece through the contactor, the opening and closing control piece is closed when receiving an opening instruction sent by the remote control piece, so that the contactor is powered on from the power supply piece, the contactor is electrically connected with the power supply piece and the fan when powered on from the power supply piece, the fan is powered on, and meanwhile the timing piece is started to time the operation of the fan. When receiving a closing instruction sent by the remote control, the opening and closing control is disconnected to enable the contactor to lose electricity. The fan control device provided by the embodiment of the application can save the operation time for ventilation of the equipment and has more accurate control over the ventilation time.

title_en: Petroleum ether conveying device with protective performance
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of petroleum ether and discloses a petroleum ether conveying device with protective performance, which comprises a box body, wherein the inner wall of the box body is provided with a pump body component, the outer surface of the pump body component is provided with a ventilation pipe, the outer surface of the box body is movably connected with a cover plate, the inner wall of the cover plate is provided with a detection component, when the box body is sealed daily, a rubber plate is arranged in a clamping groove in the cover plate and the box body in a cushioning manner, so that the tightness can be further increased when a threaded groove is fixed by a bolt, the cover plate is continuously cut close to the box body when the bolt is continuously twisted, the toothed plate II is continuously extruded to the rubber plate through the transmission of the toothed plate I and a toothed column, the tightness of the rubber plate is further increased, finally, the gap between the multi-layer sealing cover plate and the box body is realized, the cover plate and the rubber plate are prevented from being separated from the box body due to false touch looseness of the bolt, and the problem of gas leakage in the box body is avoided.

title_en: Desktop type multifunctional fan
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a desktop type multifunctional fan which comprises a base, a cylindrical outer shell, a fan body, an inner shell and a mirror body, wherein the cylindrical outer shell is movably connected above the base, the fan body is arranged at the rear end of the inner part of the outer shell, the inner shell is arranged at the front end of the inner part of the outer shell, an annular air outlet grating is arranged on the periphery of the inner shell, a control circuit board, a built-in battery and a display screen for displaying the electric quantity of the built-in battery are arranged on the front side of the middle part of the inner shell, the control circuit board is respectively and electrically connected with the fan body, the built-in battery and the display screen, and the mirror body is arranged on the front side of the middle part of the inner shell and is provided with a light transmission area corresponding to the display screen. The utility model not only has the functions of air supply and a cosmetic mirror of the traditional fan, but also enables a user to know the residual electric quantity of the built-in battery at any time, thereby avoiding the sudden power-off condition caused by insufficient electric quantity in the cosmetic process.

title_en: Refrigerator oil flow speed control device with oil suction pipe
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a refrigerating machine oil flow rate control device with an oil suction pipe, and belongs to the technical field of refrigeration compressors. A refrigerator oil flow rate control device with oil suction pipes comprises a crankshaft arranged on a cylinder seat, wherein one end of the crankshaft, far away from the cylinder seat, is provided with a mounting groove, the inner side of the mounting groove is provided with the oil suction pipe, the outer side of the oil suction pipe is provided with a floating ring, one end of the oil suction pipe, close to the crankshaft, is provided with a connecting seat, the connecting seat and the outer side of the oil suction pipe are respectively provided with guide blocks, the two guide blocks are positioned on the same straight line, the inner side wall of the crankshaft is provided with a limiting groove for the sliding of the guide blocks, and the oil suction pipe can flexibly float along with the change of the liquid level of the refrigerator oil through the combination of the floating ring and the oil suction pipe, so that the oil suction can be effectively sucked under different liquid levels, and the oil suction efficiency and flexibility are improved.

title_en: Powerful fan
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a powerful fan, which relates to the technical field of fans and aims at solving the technical problems that the prior powerful fan has an integral structure, is inconvenient to detach an internal heating mechanism and a high-speed motor provided with the fan, is inconvenient for a user to maintain by himself, and causes inconvenient maintenance in the daily use process of the fan, and comprises a fan assembly and an air outlet assembly detachably arranged at the air outlet end of the fan assembly, the fan assembly comprises two symmetrically arranged shells, one ends of the two shells are detachably provided with front diversion covers, the other ends of the two shells are detachably provided with rear diversion covers, and a high-speed blowing mechanism for drainage is arranged between the front diversion covers and the rear diversion covers.

title_en: Shaft sealing assembly for wastewater treatment water pump
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a shaft sealing assembly for a wastewater treatment water pump, which comprises a shaft, a sealing shell cover, a movable ring, a plurality of springs, sealing rings and the like. The first spring is installed at the bottom inside the sealed shell, the first spring is compressed through the pressure ring, the upper end of the pressure ring is connected with the movable ring, and the movable ring is respectively connected with the spring lower top cover and is provided with the sealing ring. The upper top cover and the lower top cover of the spring press the second spring, and the sealing shell cover is connected with the shell through an extension bolt. Holes consistent with the cross section of the shaft are arranged in the middle of each part, and a plurality of sealing rings are arranged. When in installation, the assembly is required to be clean and harmless, and all parts are installed according to steps. The bidirectional spring of the assembly can maintain uniform pressure of the sealing surface, reduce waste water leakage risk and noise, is convenient to install and detach in a connection mode, and is tightly attached to the bottom end of the sealing shell and the water pump, so that the universality is strong.

title_en: Diaphragm type hydrogen compressor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a diaphragm type hydrogen compressor which comprises a diaphragm type hydrogen compressor body, a support frame fixed at the lower end of the diaphragm type hydrogen compressor body, an air inlet cylinder arranged at the right end of the diaphragm type hydrogen compressor body, a connecting mechanism, wherein the connecting mechanism is arranged at the outer side of the right end of the air inlet cylinder in an equal angle manner, the connecting mechanism is used for limiting between the air inlet cylinder and a metal soft air pipe, and a filter screen is inserted and arranged in the middle of the air inlet cylinder. This diaphragm type hydrogen compressor can realize rising low pressure hydrogen compression to above 5.0MPa of pressure, satisfies the technological requirement, and special structure's positive displacement compressor moreover, compression medium does not contact with any oil, satisfies inflammable and explosive hydrogen compression requirement, through coupling mechanism's setting, is convenient for advance fast and stably dock between inflator and the metal soft trachea, and sealed effectual moreover, can carry out filtration to gas, is convenient for dismantle the clearance to the filter screen moreover.

title_en: Solid rocket engine ignition test thrust transmission tool
abstract_en: The application discloses a thrust transmission tool for an ignition test of a solid rocket engine, which relates to the technical field of solid rocket engines and comprises surrounding walls and a mounting plate; at least one window is arranged on the peripheral wall, one end of the peripheral wall is connected with the mounting plate, the other end of the peripheral wall is detachably connected with the engine, and one side of the mounting plate, which is far away from the peripheral wall, is detachably connected with the thrust sensor. The application is suitable for ground ignition tests of various solid rocket engines, has simple structure and convenient assembly and disassembly, and improves the ignition test efficiency.

title_en: Be used for oil cleaner connection structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides a connecting structure for an engine oil filter, which comprises a shell, a U-shaped supporting plate, four first connecting sleeves and damping springs, wherein the four first connecting sleeves are parallel to each other in the same plane, the inner sides of two side plates of the U-shaped supporting plate are fixedly connected with protruding blocks, four corners inside the shell are respectively fixedly connected with a first connecting sleeve, four corners of the U-shaped supporting plate are respectively fixedly connected with a second connecting sleeve, one end of each first connecting sleeve is fixedly connected with a first baffle, the other end of each connecting sleeve is fixedly connected with a second baffle, each first connecting sleeve is provided with a second connecting sleeve and the damping springs in a sliding mode, one end of each damping spring is propped against the first baffle, and the other end of each damping spring is propped against the second connecting sleeve.

title_en: Centrifugal compressor rotor
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of centrifugal compressors, in particular to a centrifugal compressor rotor, which comprises a rotor body, wherein a limiting shaft is arranged on the inner side of the rotor body, the outer side of the limiting shaft is in interference connection with the rotor body, a connecting shaft is arranged on the outer side of the limiting shaft, a rotating shaft is arranged on the inner side of the connecting shaft, a first bolt can be used for connecting or disassembling a first connecting plate and the limiting shaft, a second bolt can be used for disassembling or connecting a second connecting plate and the connecting shaft, the first spring can smoothly perform vibration resistance and certain buffering on the rotor body and the limiting shaft through the elasticity of the first spring, a clamping block is clamped into the inner side of a clamping groove through the elasticity of the second spring when the clamping block is inserted into the inner side of the clamping groove, and clamping blocks are clamped between the clamping block and the clamping groove, so that when workers connect the second connecting plate with the connecting shaft through the second bolt, the second connecting plate can be relatively stable, and shaking and sliding are difficult to occur.

title_en: Cleaning device for gas compressor of gas turbine
abstract_en: The application discloses a cleaning device for a gas compressor of a gas turbine, and relates to the technical field of cleaning equipment. The cleaning device comprises a water tank, a water outlet pipe, a water pump, a flow adjustable valve and a first water return pipe, wherein the water tank is used for storing cleaning liquid, the water outlet pipe is used for guiding the cleaning liquid to a cleaning pipeline of the air compressor, the water inlet end of the water pump is at least communicated with the water tank, the water outlet end of the water pump is at least communicated with the water outlet pipe, one end of the first water return pipe is communicated with the water outlet pipe, the other end of the first water return pipe is communicated with the water tank, and the flow adjustable valve is arranged on the first water return pipe. The cleaning device for the gas turbine compressor provided by the application can adjust the flow of cleaning liquid entering the gas turbine compressor cleaning pipeline based on the first water return pipe and the flow adjustable valve. That is, the present application can adjust the flow rate of the cleaning liquid based on the actual cleaning requirement of the gas turbine, that is, the cleaning device for the compressor of the gas turbine provided by the present application has strong versatility.

title_en: Anti-blocking submerged pump
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of submerged pumps and discloses an anti-blocking submerged pump which comprises an output motor, wherein an upper pipe body is fixedly arranged at the lower end of the output motor, a telescopic pipe is fixedly arranged at the lower end of the upper pipe body, a lower pipe body is fixedly arranged at the lower end of the telescopic pipe, an impeller assembly is fixedly arranged at the lower end of the lower pipe body, a filter seat is fixedly arranged at the lower end of the impeller assembly, a sealing plate is fixedly arranged at the lower end of the filter seat, and a plurality of filter holes are formed in the outer surface of the filter seat. According to the utility model, impurities are prevented from entering the C-shaped support frame and the suspended filter seat before the pump is started, a plurality of filter holes are matched, so that the blockage is effectively prevented, the flow and the lift of the pump are improved, the maintenance frequency and the cost are reduced, the service life is prolonged, the height of the pump can be flexibly adjusted by matching with the design of the telescopic pipes through the adjusting mechanisms of the upper support plate and the lower support plate, the user can adapt to different liquid depths and operating environments, and the applicability and the operating convenience of the pump are enhanced.

title_en: Backflow-preventing fluid pump
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-backflow fluid pump, which relates to the technical field of fluid delivery and comprises a shell, wherein two pump bodies are fixedly connected inside the shell, a pump body cavity is formed inside the pump body, a piston disc is connected inside the pump body cavity in a sliding manner, a discharge valve plate is formed inside the pump body cavity and positioned on the right side of a discharge hole, and springs are fixedly connected on the discharge valve plate and the discharge valve plate. The two pump bodies are just driven by the same driving source to ensure the coordination of the movement of the two pump bodies, the alternate operation mode ensures that the output of the fluid is always continuous, the pressure stability of the fluid can be maintained, the delivery capacity of the fluid is increased, and in the alternate feeding process, the starting, stopping and rotating speed change of the two pump bodies are controlled by the same driving system, so that the phenomenon of asynchronous pump body work caused by the difference between different driving sources is avoided.

title_en: Vacuum pump with circulating cooling water monitoring assembly
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a vacuum pump with a circulating cooling water monitoring assembly. The pump body is provided with a water inlet and a water outlet, the water inlet is used for supplying cooling water to enter the pump body, the water outlet is used for supplying cooling water to leave the pump body, and the cooling water is used for taking away heat of the pump body. The monitoring component comprises a flow temperature detection part and a pressure detection part, wherein the flow temperature detection part and the pressure detection part are arranged close to the water outlet, the flow temperature detection part is used for detecting the flow and the temperature of cooling water at the water outlet, and the pressure detection part is used for detecting the pressure at the water outlet. The cooling water can take away the heat of the pump body through the cooling water entering and exiting the pump body so as to reduce the temperature of the pump body, and the cooling water at the water outlet is detected through the monitoring assembly so as to discover the abnormal condition of the cooling water in time, so that the vacuum pump is prevented from being damaged or even being in safety accidents due to insufficient cooling, and the vacuum pump can be operated safely, effectively and for a long time.

title_en: Electronic water pump device with installation and running balance self-adaption function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an electronic water pump device with installation and running balance self-adaption, which comprises a pump head, a split embedded pump body, a rear cover, an I-shaped clamping ring, a bump sealing ring, a stator and a rotor eccentric balance self-adaption control system arranged in the split embedded pump body, wherein the rotor eccentric balance self-adaption control system consists of a pressure change sensor, a controller, a flow control device, a discharge control mechanism and the like, from the detection, identification and control of rotor eccentricity to execution and final feedback, a complete closed loop feedback is formed, no matter the rotor eccentricity is towards any side, the eccentricity correction can be completed, the inner pump body and the pump head are connected in a jogged manner through an I-shaped collar, and the bottom of the outer pump body is connected with the rear cover through a clamping column. The utility model thoroughly solves the problems of poor running stability, large noise, poor heat dissipation and insufficient reliability of the electronic water pump caused by rotor eccentricity, and simultaneously improves the running stability, the assembly reliability, the heat dissipation efficiency and the NVH comfort of the electronic water pump.

title_en: Inlet and outlet pipe integrated vacuum pump
abstract_en: The utility model provides an air inlet and outlet pipe integrated vacuum pump, which comprises a box body, a main machine and an oil-gas separator, wherein the main machine and the oil-gas separator are arranged in the box body, the air inlet and outlet pipe are arranged in the top of the box body, a partition plate is arranged in the air inlet and outlet pipe, the partition plate divides the air inlet and outlet pipe into an air inlet pipe section and an air outlet pipe section which cannot be mutually communicated, an air outlet is arranged on the air inlet pipe section, the air inlet and the air outlet pipe section extend out of the top of the box body, an air inlet pipe is further arranged on the air inlet pipe section, the tail end of the air inlet pipe is provided with an air filter assembly, the air filter assembly is connected with the air inlet end of the main machine through an air inlet valve, the air outlet end of the main machine is connected with an oil-gas mixing inlet of the oil-gas separator through an oil-gas mixing pipe, the oil-gas separator is a double-cylinder type oil-gas separator, and the top of the double-cylinder oil-gas separator is provided with two outlets, and the two outlets are respectively communicated with the air outlet pipe section through two air pipes. The air inlet pipe and the two air outlet pipes are integrated on the air inlet and outlet pipe to form an integrated structure, so that the assembly is very convenient.

title_en: Refrigerating showcase with top arranged on compressor
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a refrigerating showcase with a top arranged on a compressor, which aims to solve the technical problems that the existing compressor is arranged at a high place, the installation position is narrow, the disassembly and the maintenance are inconvenient when faults occur, the operation at the high place affects the safety of maintenance staff, the maintenance work cannot be carried out in full, the maintenance time is delayed, and the use of the showcase is affected, the output part of the compressor is communicated with the display cabinet, the left side surface and the right side surface of the installation box are fixedly provided with the limiting parts, and the inserting plates are movably installed in the limiting parts.

title_en: Lead wire plug-in connector of coil assembly
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a lead plug of a coil assembly, which comprises a front lead and a rear lead, wherein the front lead and the rear lead are arranged on the coil assembly, a fixing block is arranged between the front lead and the rear lead, U-shaped holes are formed in the fixing block and positioned at two ends, a plug connector is arranged at one end of each U-shaped hole, a plug connector is inserted into the plug connector, a lateral caulking groove is formed in one side of each plug connector, the corners of the two U-shaped holes are communicated, the front lead and the rear lead respectively penetrate through the two U-shaped holes and mutually abut, the ends of the front lead and the rear lead are clamped on the plug connector, and the rear ends of the front lead and the rear lead are fixed on the lateral caulking groove. The plug connector has the advantages that the front end lead wire on the connecting wire package assembly can be stably connected with the rear end lead wire on the air conditioner compressor, so that the reliability is ensured.

title_en: Remote intelligent monitoring temperature regulation fan
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a remote intelligent monitoring temperature regulation fan which comprises a fan body, a bracket mechanism, a regulating mechanism, a temperature sensor and a PCB circuit board, wherein the bracket mechanism is provided with the fan body, the bracket mechanism is also provided with the PCB circuit board, the PCB circuit board is provided with a wireless module, the bracket mechanism is also provided with the regulating mechanism, one end of the regulating mechanism is provided with the temperature sensor, the regulating mechanism is used for driving the temperature sensor to horizontally move, and the temperature sensor and the fan body are respectively connected with the PCB circuit board. Through being in the same place fan body, temperature sensor and PCB circuit board integration, can play radiating effect, can carry out real-time supervision to the temperature in the rack simultaneously to can realize remote monitoring and control through wireless module.

title_en: Buffer fan
abstract_en: The utility model provides a buffer fan which comprises an outer frame, wherein the outer frame is provided with an assembly seat, the assembly seat is fixedly provided with a connecting seat, the connecting seat is fixedly provided with an elastic sheet through a first bolt, the elastic sheet is fixedly connected with an inner frame through a connecting lug, the inner frame is fixedly provided with a motor and fan blades, the outer frame is provided with a plug-in column, the bottom of the connecting seat is provided with a plug-in hole, and the plug-in column is fixedly plugged with the plug-in hole. The outer frame is provided with the assembly seat, the assembly seat is fixedly provided with the connecting seat, the connecting seat is fixedly connected with the inner frame through the elastic sheet, the outer frame is fixedly connected with the inner frame through the elastic sheet, the filtering vibration effect is realized, the inner frame is fixedly provided with the motor, the motor drives the fan blades to rotate, when the cooling fan operates, vibration generated by the rotation of the motor drives the fan blades of the inner frame is filtered through the elastic sheet, abnormal sound is prevented, and the user experience is improved.

title_en: Variable centrifugal flying rod assembly and small-sized wind turbine comprising same
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a variable centrifugal flyrod assembly and a small wind turbine comprising the same, wherein the variable centrifugal flyrod assembly comprises a centrifugal flyrod base, a centrifugal flyrod guide sleeve, a pre-tightening adjusting assembly, a linear bearing, a centrifugal flyrod guide rod, a centrifugal flyrod spring and a flyrod counterweight sleeve, wherein an end table is arranged at the inner end of the centrifugal flyrod guide rod, the flyrod counterweight sleeve is sleeved on the outer end of the centrifugal flyrod guide rod, the centrifugal flyrod spring is sleeved on the centrifugal flyrod guide rod and limited between the end table and the linear bearing and can be converted between an initial compression state and a recompression state, the centrifugal flyrod guide rod is propped against the pre-tightening adjusting assembly in the initial compression state, and after the rotating speed of a wind turbine reaches the preset rotating speed, the centrifugal flyrod guide rod moves outwards to enable the centrifugal flyrod spring to enter the recompression state. The utility model reduces the highest rotating speed of the small wind turbine again, prolongs the service life of the generator, the main shaft brake and the like, ensures that the small wind turbine can be compatible with a permanent magnet generator with higher voltage, improves the wind energy conversion efficiency of the whole machine, reduces the consumption of red copper and rare earth permanent magnets and reasonably reduces the production cost of the whole machine.

title_en: Fan mounting structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fan installation structure which comprises a motor, a first fan and a second fan, wherein a first bearing seat assembly and a second bearing seat assembly are coaxially installed at two ends of the motor respectively, connecting shafts are rotatably installed in the first bearing seat assembly and the second bearing seat assembly, a power output shaft of the motor is in transmission connection with a power input end of the connecting shaft, the first fan is installed at the end part of the first bearing seat assembly, the second fan is installed at the end part of the second bearing seat assembly, the connecting shaft in the first bearing seat assembly is in transmission connection with a fan impeller in the first fan, and the connecting shaft in the second bearing seat assembly is in transmission connection with the fan impeller in the second fan. Through setting up the connecting axle, make motor main shaft and impeller not lug connection, cooperation first bearing, second bearing and shell directly bear radial jump power and the axial jump power that fan impeller rotated produced through the connecting axle, avoid effort transmission to on the motor main shaft, improve the stability of motor operation.

title_en: Cold pipe structure in air compressor machine
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of air compressors, in particular to an intercooling pipe structure in an air compressor, which adopts the technical scheme that the intercooling pipe structure comprises a first pipe body and a second pipe body, wherein the first pipe body comprises a connecting part, an adjusting part and a plug-in part arranged at one end of the adjusting part far away from the connecting part, an external thread is arranged on the outer side wall of the adjusting part, and an internal thread matched with the external thread is arranged on the inner side wall of one end of the second pipe body close to the first pipe body. The application has the effects of improving the practicability of the intermediate cooling pipe, reducing the possibility of influencing the maintenance efficiency due to the carrying error and other problems in the installation process of workers and improving the installation effect of the intermediate cooling pipe.

title_en: High-temperature gas medium circulating device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-temperature gas medium circulating device which comprises a cylinder body, wherein a piston is connected in the cylinder body in a sliding way and is in transmission connection with a crankshaft, an intake valve core and an exhaust valve core are arranged at the upper end of the cylinder body, the intake valve core and the exhaust valve core are in transmission connection with a cam shaft, and the cam shaft is in transmission connection with the crankshaft. According to the utility model, the crankshaft is connected with the camshaft, so that the valve core of the air inlet valve and the valve core of the air outlet valve connected with the camshaft can be opened and closed along with the rotation of the crankshaft, namely, the valve core of the air inlet valve and the valve core of the air outlet valve can be opened and closed along with the reciprocation of the piston in the cylinder body, and compared with the structure that the common air valve is directly pressed by the internal pressure of the cylinder body to open and close, the working temperature of the air inlet valve and the valve core of the air outlet valve cannot exceed 60 ℃, the utility model can adapt to the compression process of high-temperature gas by changing the driving mode of the valve core of the air inlet valve and the valve core of the air outlet valve, and can better utilize the high-temperature gas generated in industries such as mining, chemical industry, petrochemical industry, smelting and the like.

title_en: Fuel injector seat and bracket block integrated forged fuel injector seat bracket assembly
abstract_en: The utility model provides a fuel injector seat and bracket block integrated forged fuel injector seat bracket assembly, wherein a parting surface of the fuel injector seat bracket assembly is parallel to a hole axis of a fuel injector seat or parallel to a hole axis of a bracket block; or the side parting lines on two sides of the oil sprayer seat support assembly are parallel to the hole axis of the oil sprayer seat or parallel to the hole axis of the support block. The utility model solves the problems of reducing the weight of forging stock required by forging and processing of the oil sprayer seat support assembly and the problem of large subsequent machining allowance in the prior art.

title_en: Guide vane displacement sensor bracket suitable for large hydropower station
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of supporting devices and discloses a guide vane displacement sensor support suitable for a large hydropower station, which comprises an oil cylinder, wherein the upper surface of the oil cylinder is provided with a supporting mechanism, the upper surface of the supporting mechanism is provided with a moving mechanism, the supporting mechanism comprises a rectangular strip, the rectangular strip is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the oil cylinder through a bolt, the front surface of the rectangular strip is fixedly connected with a connecting plate, the right end of the lower surface of the connecting plate is fixedly connected with a supporting rod, the lower surface of the supporting rod is fixedly connected with a fixing plate, and the upper surface of the front end of the fixing plate is provided with an induction rod. According to the utility model, through the cooperation between the fixed plate and the connecting plate which are arranged and the two groups of support rods, the double-rod guide can ensure that the induction rods stably move along with the moving plate, and meanwhile, through the rectangular strips and the clamping hoops which are arranged, the fixed plate and the connecting plate are directly and fixedly connected with the oil cylinder respectively, so that the stability of the bracket is improved.

title_en: Plunger pump and plunger pump assembly
abstract_en: At least one embodiment of the present disclosure provides a plunger pump and a plunger pump assembly including the same. The plunger pump includes a rotary shaft, a first gear non-rotatably coaxially fixed to the rotary shaft to receive rotary power from the rotary shaft, an impeller provided in a suction flow path of the plunger pump for a pressure medium, a second gear engaged with the first gear and connected to the impeller, and a third gear engaged with the first gear to extract the power of the rotary shaft to the outside of the plunger pump. The rotational axis of at least one of the second gear and the third gear is not parallel to the rotational axis of the first gear. The plunger pump allows the impeller and the third gear, which is at least a part of the power take-off, to be arranged in the plunger pump at the same time, and the orientation of the impeller and the power take-off can be adjusted easily.

title_en: Wind-powered electricity generation blade connecting device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wind power blade connecting device which comprises a support, wherein a worm is rotationally connected to the support, a round shaft is rotationally connected to the support corresponding to the worm, a worm wheel is fixedly connected to the round shaft corresponding to the worm, the worm is in meshed connection with the worm wheel, a gear is fixedly connected to one side of the round shaft, which is close to the worm wheel, the support is rotationally connected with a toothed ring corresponding to the gear, transmission grooves are formed in the support corresponding to the gear, and slots which are arranged in an array are formed in two sides of the top end of the toothed ring.

title_en: Portable temperature regulating device
abstract_en: The portable temperature adjusting device comprises a shell, a temperature adjusting piece, a heat exchange piece, a flow channel and an arc-shaped flow guiding structure, wherein the temperature adjusting piece is arranged in the shell and is in heat conduction connection with a first temperature adjusting end of the temperature adjusting piece, the flow channel is formed in the heat exchange piece and used for enabling heat exchange fluid to pass through, each flow channel comprises a connecting flow channel and a plurality of sub flow channels arranged along a first direction, the sub flow channels extend along a second direction, the first direction and the second direction are arranged in a crossing mode, the sub flow channels in the flow channels are sequentially communicated through the connecting flow channels, and the heat exchange piece comprises the arc-shaped flow guiding structure located at the communicating position of the two sub flow channels. The portable temperature adjusting device provided by the embodiment of the utility model can increase the flow rate and the heat exchange efficiency.

title_en: Raise dust on-line monitoring device with flow control function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a dust on-line monitoring device with a flow control function, which comprises a device body, wherein an air inlet is arranged at the top of the device body, a moving mechanism is arranged on the front side surface of a supporting plate, a paper tape is arranged on the moving mechanism, a self-adjusting mechanism is arranged on the rear side surface of the supporting plate, the moving mechanism comprises two rotating seats and two fixed sleeves, the two rotating seats are fixedly connected with positioning seats, and a limiting block is fixedly connected with one side surface of each positioning seat, and the dust on-line monitoring device belongs to the technical field of dust on-line monitoring. This raise dust on-line monitoring device with flow control function moves through rotating the rotating head and driving the catch bar for the catch bar separates with the slope piece gradually, and inside the locating seat was received to movable fixture block, released the constraint to fixed cover, conveniently changed the paper tape, effectively improved the convenience of changing and using to and detect the flow of admitting air through flow sensor, main control chip adjusts the power of air pump according to the air input, reaches the purpose of real-time regulation flow.

title_en: Impeller of two-way air inlet
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bidirectional air inlet impeller which comprises a support plate, wherein annular first cover plates and annular second cover plates are respectively arranged on two sides of the support plate, a first air inlet is formed in the center of each first cover plate, a plurality of first blades which are circumferentially arranged are clamped between the support plate and each first cover plate, a first air outlet is formed between the outer ends of the adjacent first blades, a second air inlet is formed in the center of each second cover plate, a plurality of second blades which are circumferentially arranged are clamped between the support plate and each second cover plate, and a second air outlet is formed between the outer ends of the adjacent second blades. The utility model has the advantages of high air inlet and outlet efficiency, large air quantity and high air speed.

title_en: Gas field wellhead pressure energy utilization device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a gas field wellhead pressure energy utilization device which comprises a cylinder body and a control system, wherein a movable separation mechanism is arranged in the cylinder body and is in sealing connection with the cylinder body, the movable separation mechanism separates the cylinder body into A, B chambers, a distance sensor and an exhaust valve are arranged in each chamber, a first high-pressure suction valve and a first low-pressure suction valve are arranged in the chamber A, a second high-pressure suction valve and a second low-pressure suction valve are arranged in the chamber B, and the distance sensor, the exhaust valve, the high-pressure suction valve and the low-pressure suction valve are all in electric signal connection with the control system. According to the utility model, the high pressure of the new wellhead is utilized to push the movable separation mechanism to move, so that the low pressure energy of the wellhead of the old well is pressurized, the depressurization and the outward transportation of the natural gas of the new wellhead and the pressurization and the outward transportation of the natural gas of the wellhead of the old well are realized, the waste of the pressure energy of the wellhead of the new well is effectively avoided, the investment on the pressurization cost of the wellhead of the old well is reduced, the production efficiency is improved, and the aims of energy conservation and emission reduction are realized.

title_en: Balance block assembly and scroll compressor
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of compressors, in particular to a balance block assembly and a scroll compressor. The balance block assembly comprises a balance block and a rounding block, wherein the balance block comprises a balance block main body, the balance block main body and the rounding block are in a fan ring shape and can be spliced into an annular structural member, the annular structural member formed by splicing can be sleeved on an eccentric shaft of the scroll compressor, meanwhile, the balance block main body and the rounding block have different weights, so that the annular structural member formed by splicing the balance block main body and the rounding block can eliminate the rotation inertia force and the inertia moment generated when the eccentric shaft and the movable scroll rotate, meanwhile, the traditional balance block cover is replaced by the rounding block, the stirring of air flow in the scroll compressor and the influence on the oil discharge rate of the compressor when the balance block rotates are reduced, and compared with the traditional balance block cover, the structure is more stable, the reliability is higher, and the rounding block is not easy to deform when rotating at a high speed.

title_en: Polishing device for inner wall of air passage of end plate of air conditioner compressor
