abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of air-conditioning compressors, in particular to an air-conditioning compressor end plate air channel inner wall polishing device, a sucking disc is arranged above a cylinder body, an air-conditioning clutch adjusting disc is assembled on the surface of the sucking disc, a rear cover is arranged below the cylinder body, a fixed bevel gear is arranged in the middle of the cylinder body, a swash plate is arranged above the fixed bevel gear, a front cover thrust bearing is assembled on the surface of the swash plate, a group of planetary discs are additionally arranged at the bottom of the swash plate for auxiliary fixation, the position of a piston rod is pulled through the bottom of the planetary disc when the piston rod moves, noise emitted by the piston rod is reduced, meanwhile, a piston ring is additionally arranged at the bottom surface of the piston, stability is provided when the piston moves, the collision of the piston rod during movement is reduced, the noise emitted by the air-conditioning compressor during long-time operation is reduced, the safety of the air-conditioning compressor is improved, and the service life of the device is prolonged.

title_en: Mechanical sealing device of desulfurization slurry circulating pump
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a mechanical sealing device of a desulfurization slurry circulating pump, belongs to the technical field of desulfurization slurry circulating pump sealing, and solves the problem that the service life of the existing mechanical sealing device is relatively low. The novel driving seat shaft sleeve comprises a driving seat shaft sleeve sleeved on a shaft, a second clamping mechanism used for clamping the driving seat shaft sleeve on the shaft is arranged at the other end of the driving seat shaft sleeve, the second clamping mechanism comprises at least two clamping blocks, each clamping block is radially inserted into the driving seat shaft sleeve, the inner side surface of each clamping block is provided with an arc-shaped surface matched with the outer wall surface of the shaft, the outer side surface of each clamping block is slidably connected with a wedge block capable of ejecting the clamping block and extruding the clamping block on the shaft, the wedge block is slidably arranged in the driving seat shaft sleeve, one end of each wedge block is rotatably connected with a pushing bolt, and the pushing bolt is in threaded connection with the driving seat shaft sleeve. The mechanical sealing device ensures that the bearing of the shaft sleeve of the driving seat is more uniform, and further prolongs the service life of the mechanical sealing device.

title_en: Offshore wind power integrated blue carbon ecological system
abstract_en: The application relates to an offshore wind power integrated blue carbon ecological system which comprises a blue carbon ecological unit, a friction electric water turbine device and an offshore wind turbine generator, wherein the blue carbon ecological unit comprises an LED lamp strip and seaweed, the LED lamp strip is arranged on the outer side of the seaweed in a surrounding mode, the friction electric water turbine device comprises a rotating part, an upper chassis and friction electric balls, a first friction surface made of friction electric materials is arranged on the wall surface of the upper chassis, the friction electric balls are located in the upper chassis, friction electric materials with the polarity opposite to that of the first friction surface are arranged on the surface of the friction electric balls, the rotating part is movably connected with the upper chassis, the rotating part can drive the friction electric balls to roll in the upper chassis, the friction electric water turbine device is in electric connection with an LED lamp, the friction electric water turbine device can utilize friction nano power generation to supply power to the LED lamp strip, the offshore wind turbine generator is in electric connection with the LED lamp, and the offshore wind turbine generator can utilize wind power generation to supply power to the LED lamp strip.

title_en: Exhaust oil leakage prevention structure for cooling fan
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an exhaust and oil leakage prevention structure for a cooling fan, which comprises a base, wherein the base is provided with a central sleeve with a groove, the outer wall of the central sleeve is sleeved with a stator, the groove is in a ladder shape and is provided with an upper section, a middle section and a lower section, the diameter of the groove gradually decreases gradually towards the direction of the base, a bearing is arranged in the groove, the bearing is internally provided with an axle center for fixing fan blades, the outer diameter of the bearing is matched with the diameter of the middle section of the groove and is higher than the middle section of the groove, the axle center is contacted with the bottom of the groove, the top and the bottom of the bearing are respectively provided with a positioning ring and a retaining ring, the outer diameter of the positioning ring is matched with the diameter of the upper section of the groove, the top of the positioning ring is in an inverted-concave shape, the top end of the positioning ring is flush with the upper end of the central sleeve, a convex part of the positioning ring is used for cutting a sector-shaped notch, and the sector-shaped notch is enclosed with the inner wall of the upper section of the groove to form an exhaust hole. By locating the vent hole at the location in the fan where capillary forces are the weakest, the risk of oil extrusion and leakage due to air expansion is reduced.

title_en: Electric pitching fan
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electric pitching fan which comprises a fan head, a head shaking support and a pitching mechanism, wherein two support plates of the head shaking support are respectively and symmetrically and movably connected to the left side and the right side of a rear shell of the fan head, the pitching mechanism is provided with a head shaking motor, a connecting rod structure and a stress rod, the head shaking motor is arranged on the rear shell of the back side of the fan head, the stress rod is arranged between the two support plates in the middle, one end of the connecting rod structure is in transmission connection with the output end of the head shaking motor, and the other end of the connecting rod structure is movably connected with the stress rod. Therefore, the stress rod through the pitching mechanism is arranged between the two support plates in the middle, and the connecting rod structure is arranged between the two support plates in the middle at the back side of the fan head, so that when the fan head is driven by the oscillating motor to perform up-and-down oscillating motion, the generated force can be intensively decomposed onto the two support plates through the connecting rod structure and the stress rod, the effect of uniform and balanced stress on the left side and the right side of the oscillating support is realized, the fan head and the oscillating support are prevented from tilting and shaking, and the smoothness and stability of the up-and-down oscillating of the fan head are further improved.

title_en: Air supply device and biosafety cabinet
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of biosafety cabinets, in particular to an air supply device and biosafety cabinet, wherein the air supply device comprises a static pressure box, a filter plate and a first fan, the static pressure box comprises a box body, a downward air outlet is arranged at the lower end of the box body, the filter plate is connected at the lower end of the box body to seal the air outlet, the first fan is fixed at the outer side of the box body, the air outlet of the first fan is communicated with the inner cavity of the box body, the air outlet is obliquely arranged downwards towards the filter plate, the first fan is arranged at one side of the static pressure box, the total height of the air supply device is reduced, the air outlet of the fan is obliquely arranged downwards towards the filter plate, the air outlet blown out by the fan can be obliquely blown to the upper end face of the filter plate, and compared with the air outlet which is perpendicular to the filter plate, the air outlet which is obliquely arranged increases the direct contact area between the air blown out by the fan and the filter plate, and is convenient for improving the filtering efficiency of the filter plate.

title_en: Fan bearing seat with cooling function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fan bearing seats and discloses a fan bearing seat with a cooling function, which comprises a first mounting clamping seat and a second mounting clamping seat, wherein the first mounting clamping seat and the second mounting clamping seat are assembled to form a complete bearing seat, mounting insertion pipes are embedded into two sides of the top of the second mounting clamping seat, a conveying pipeline for conveying cooling liquid is sleeved at the outer ends of the mounting insertion pipes, a circulating cooling box for cooling the cooling liquid is arranged outside the first mounting clamping seat, in the novel cooling box, cooling liquid in the circulating cooling box enters the cooling cavity through the mounting insertion pipes after being cooled, then flows into the circulating cavity through the butt joint insertion pipes, the flowing direction of the cooling liquid entering the circulating cavity and the cooling cavity is single, the circulating cooling liquid reduces the temperature generated by friction during operation of the whole device, and the service life of the device is greatly prolonged.

title_en: Silicon oil clutch
abstract_en: The utility model provides a silicone oil clutch which comprises a main rotating shaft, a shell and a driving plate, wherein the driving plate is fixed with the main rotating shaft, the shell rotates on the main rotating shaft, a front cover is arranged on the front side of the shell, an engagement cavity is formed between the shell and the front cover, an oil storage cavity is arranged between the driving plate and the front cover, a separation plate is arranged in the oil storage cavity and axially separates the oil storage cavity into a front oil cavity and a rear oil cavity, an oil outlet and an electromagnetic valve plate for controlling the opening and closing of the oil outlet are arranged in the front oil cavity, the oil outlet is communicated with the engagement cavity and is used for supplying silicone oil of the front oil cavity to flow into the engagement cavity, at least one through hole for communicating the front oil cavity and the rear oil cavity is arranged on the separation plate, the through hole and the oil outlet are respectively positioned on two radial opposite sides of the center of the oil storage cavity, and an oil return channel is arranged on the front cover and is used for returning the silicone oil in the engagement cavity into the front oil cavity. The clutch structure can avoid the engagement of the clutch during cold start, improve the cold start performance and prevent the temperature rise of the engine from being too fast and the oil consumption from being increased.

title_en: Blade bolt operation and maintenance fastening device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a blade bolt operation and maintenance fastening device, and belongs to the technical field of wind blade operation and maintenance. The blade bolt operation and maintenance fastening device comprises a main body, wherein a rotating head and a fixed shell are arranged on the main body, the rotating head is rotationally sleeved inside the fixed shell, a fastening mechanism is arranged inside the fixed shell and comprises a rotating disc, a threaded hole and a fixed ring, the rotating disc is arranged on the rear side of the rotating head, and the rotating disc is fixedly connected with the rotating head through the fixed bolt. According to the utility model, the fastening mechanism is arranged, when maintenance is required, the threaded rod is penetrated into the threaded hole and is rotated, so that the threaded rod and the threaded hole are fixed, the rotating head and the fan blade cannot rotate due to wind power, equipment and staff are prevented from being damaged, and compared with the prior art, the locking device does not need to be additionally carried and installed, thereby being beneficial to improving the maintenance efficiency.

title_en: Air bag component for air bag pump and air bag pump
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of air bag pumps, and particularly relates to an air bag assembly for an air bag pump and the air bag pump. The utility model provides a wind bag subassembly for air bag pump, is in including cylinder and setting the inside air bag of cylinder, the one end of air bag sets up the air bag and connects the end plate, the air bag is connected the end plate and is fixed with the outside piston rod of stretching to the cylinder, the outer wall of cylinder is fixed with sealed adjustment mechanism, sealed adjustment mechanism include hollow casing, with sealing washer, a plurality of run through and threaded connection in the threaded rod of casing curb plate and a plurality of with the threaded rod with the splint of sealing washer butt, the piston rod run through in the casing and with the inner wall sliding connection of sealing washer. The sealing adjusting mechanism can fix the sealing ring, the clamping plate is pushed by the adjusting threaded rod when the sealing ring is worn, the clamping plate clamps the deformation of the sealing ring to adjust and reduce the gap, and in addition, the wearing condition of the internal sealing ring can be observed through the number of screw turns.

title_en: Compressed air energy storage system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a compressed air energy storage system, and relates to the technical field of electric power energy storage. The compressor unit of the compressed air energy storage system comprises at least one stage of compression unit, a water separation heat exchanger is arranged at the outlet of the compression unit from the first stage of compression unit, the cold energy of the cold side of the water separation heat exchanger is from a cooling device, the hot side inlet of the water separation heat exchanger is communicated with the outlet of the first stage of compression unit, high-temperature compressed air flowing out of the outlet of the first stage of compression unit is introduced into the hot side of the water separation heat exchanger, condensed water is separated out after heat exchange is carried out in the water separation heat exchanger, and when the humidity of the air is high, a large amount of condensed water is produced after the air is compressed by the compression unit and then cooled by the water separation heat exchanger. The utility model solves the technical problem that the compressed air energy storage system in the prior art has a large amount of water in the compression unit in the energy storage process.

title_en: Household garbage incineration cascade heat recovery system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a household garbage incineration cascade heat recovery system, which belongs to the technical field of household garbage incineration treatment and comprises an incinerator, a boiler, a steam turbine, a flue gas pollution treatment system for carrying out pollution treatment on high-temperature flue gas generated by incineration, a flue gas waste heat recovery system for recycling waste heat of the flue gas, a steam waste heat recovery system for utilizing steam waste heat generated by the boiler and a waste steam waste heat recovery system for utilizing waste heat of waste steam. Through the mode, the steps of heat exchange in various forms are adopted, links such as flue gas waste heat, biogas, boiler drainage waste heat and exhaust steam waste heat are recycled, the generated electric quantity is greatly improved compared with the electric quantity generated by adopting a steam turbine set air extraction heating mode, biogas generated by landfill leachate treatment is effectively utilized, and economic benefit is improved.

title_en: Plunger, plunger pump and plunger motor
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to hydraulic devices, and more particularly, to a plunger, a plunger pump, and a plunger motor. The plunger outer peripheral surface provided by the disclosure is set to be an arc surface, and the perpendicular distance between the bus end part of the arc surface and the plunger axis is smaller than the perpendicular distance between the bus middle position of the arc surface and the plunger axis, namely, the structure with thick middle and thin two ends. In the working process of the plunger, the outer circumferential surface of the cambered surface of the plunger is continuously contacted with the inner wall of the plunger hole, so that the running stability of the plunger is improved, and the mechanical efficiency of a plunger pump or a plunger motor using the plunger is further improved. The outer circumferential surface of the cambered surface of the plunger is in line contact with the inner wall of the plunger hole, so that the contact mode of the plunger and the cylinder body is improved, and the use function of the plunger is improved. Meanwhile, the arc-surface bus of the plunger is set to be a minor arc section, so that the gap between the plunger and the plunger hole is reasonably utilized, and the gap between the plunger and the plunger hole is prevented from being increased due to the fact that the arc surface is processed on the plunger.

title_en: Oil scraping device for compressor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an oil scraping device for a compressor, which comprises an oil scraping flange sleeved on the outer side of a piston rod, wherein a gland and an oil scraping box sleeved on the outer side of the piston rod are respectively arranged on two sides of the oil scraping flange, a coaxial sealing ring is arranged between the gland and the piston rod, a first accommodating cavity is formed between the gland and the oil scraping flange, and an oil scraping ring group sleeved on the outer side of the piston rod is arranged in the first accommodating cavity.

title_en: Electromagnetic diaphragm pump
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electromagnetic diaphragm pump, and relates to the field of water pumps. The device includes the diaphragm pump body, and diaphragm pump body back end fixedly connected with electromagnetic power spare, both ends fixedly connected with pump body nest of tubes about the diaphragm pump body, fixedly connected with is quick to stop back valve subassembly between the diaphragm pump body and the pump body nest of tubes, and quick to stop back valve subassembly includes check valve casing and check piston spare, and check piston spare sliding connection has seted up the check chamber in the check valve casing, and check piston spare both ends fixedly connected with sealing block has seted up the water delivery through-hole in the check piston spare, and check piston spare bottom is provided with the spring. When the diaphragm piece contracts, the piston in the water outlet pipeline is blocked downwards more quickly under the action of the elasticity of the spring to reduce backflow, the piston in the water inlet pipeline expanded by the diaphragm piece can be blocked downwards quickly to prevent excessive backflow, so that the flow is stable, and meanwhile, the sealing performance of the quick check valve assembly is better by adding the sealing block.

title_en: Aviation heavy oil engine
abstract_en: The invention discloses an aviation heavy oil engine which comprises an oil supply system, a cylinder cover, a piston connecting rod system, a cylinder body system, a crankshaft system and a generator system, and is characterized in that the oil supply system is positioned on one side of the cylinder cover, which is far away from the generator system, the cylinder body system comprises a cylinder body and a crankcase, a piston of the piston connecting rod system slides in the cylinder body, the axial direction of the generator system is parallel to the sliding direction of the piston in the piston connecting rod system, and the crankshaft system comprises an eccentric shaft deep groove ball bearing 1, a deep groove ball bearing 2, a crankshaft assembly, an input spur gear, an intermediate shaft assembly and an output shaft assembly. The aviation heavy oil engine changes the output direction of the single-cylinder piston engine from the conventional 90-degree output direction to the direction parallel to the running axis of the piston, and is favorable for loading the engine on a long and narrow flying projectile.

title_en: Scroll compressor having a rotor with a rotor shaft having a rotor shaft with a
abstract_en: The present disclosure proposes a scroll compressor comprising a housing (100) and two scrolls (200, 300) accommodated within the housing (100), the scrolls of the two scrolls (200, 300) extending along an involute and engaging each other, respectively, the scrolls of at least one scroll being provided with a sealing groove (340) recessed from a top surface thereof, the sealing groove (340) extending along the involute from an inner end wall (341) near a center of an involute base circle to an outer end wall (342) remote from the center of the involute base circle, and being provided with a sealing strip (350) and a pre-tension spring (360), the pre-tension spring (360) being wavy and having a plurality of crest portions (363) against a bottom (351) of the sealing strip (350) and a plurality of trough portions (364) against a bottom wall (344) of the sealing groove (340), and the spring stiffness of the pre-tension spring (360) decreasing in a direction from the inner end wall (341) to the outer end wall (342).

title_en: Vacuum pump
abstract_en: The embodiment of the utility model provides a vacuum pump, and relates to the technical field of vacuum pump cooling. The vacuum pump of the present utility model includes a housing, a heat transfer member, and an air cooling assembly. A cavity is arranged in the shell. The shell is provided with an air inlet and an air outlet which are communicated with the cavity. A pumping device is arranged in the cavity. The pump is used to move the gas from the gas inlet to the gas outlet. The heat conducting piece is embedded in the outer side of the shell and is arranged corresponding to the cavity. The air cooling assembly is fixed on the outer side of the shell and used for cooling the shell. The vacuum pump can control the temperature of the pump body, prevent the temperature of the pump body from being out of control, avoid pollution to the oil of the vacuum pump caused by leakage of cooling liquid, and reduce the production and operation costs.

title_en: Anti-blocking magnetic pump
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-blocking magnetic pump, and relates to the technical field of magnetic pump industrial design and processing. The device comprises a magnetic pump, wherein the magnetic pump is formed by combining a pump body and a motor, one side of the pump body is provided with a water inlet pipe and a water outlet pipe, the inside of the water inlet pipe is provided with an anti-blocking mechanism, the anti-blocking mechanism comprises a filtering column, a filtering plate, a water inlet tank and a water outlet tank, the filtering column is movably clamped with the water inlet pipe, the filtering plate is fixedly connected inside the filtering column, the water inlet tank is arranged on one side of the filtering column, the water inlet tank is arranged on the other side of the filtering column, and the water inlet tank and the water outlet tank are symmetrically distributed. The device replaces originally screen cloth structure with the filter column, can realize preventing the quick dismantlement of jam mechanism, and because the filter is the slope, fluid can promote impurity to one side until it gets into the inside of deposition jar, accomplishes the collection to the impurity, has prolonged the filtration time of filter, need not frequently to change the filter, has promoted maintenance efficiency, satisfies the user demand.

title_en: Movable axial flow fan
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of axial fans and discloses a movable axial fan, which comprises a base, wherein two brackets are arranged on the base, the number of the brackets is two, the two brackets are symmetrically distributed on the base, the axial fans are arranged between the two brackets, sliding grooves are formed in two sides of the bottom of the base, the sliding grooves are in sliding connection with a vibration reduction plate, mounting frames are arranged at four corners of the bottom of the vibration reduction plate, a rotating shaft is rotatably arranged between the two mounting frames, rotating frames are arranged at two ends of the rotating shaft, universal wheels are arranged on the rotating frames, the movable axial fan further comprises a vibration reduction mechanism which is arranged between the vibration reduction plate and the base, a supporting mechanism which is arranged at the bottom of the vibration reduction plate, and the rotating mechanism is arranged on the rotating shaft.

title_en: Operation platform for installing wind power split tower
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an operating platform for installing wind power split tower cylinders, which comprises a main beam frame, wherein a plurality of electric telescopic wheels are arranged at the bottom of the main beam frame, a plurality of electric folding rods are arranged on two sides of the main beam frame, the outer ends of the electric folding rods are connected with auxiliary beams, the auxiliary beams are parallel to the main beam frame and are controlled to be unfolded laterally through the electric folding rods, a plurality of hydraulic columns are arranged at the bottom of the auxiliary beams, a plurality of supporting beams and an electric sliding block I are arranged at the tops of the main beam frame and the auxiliary beams, the electric sliding block I slides along the main beam frame and the auxiliary beams, two ends of the supporting beams are clamped on the electric sliding block I, an electric sliding block II is arranged on the supporting beams, and a hydraulic roof is arranged at the tops of the electric sliding block II. The split tower splicing device has the advantages that the split tower splicing device utilizes the operation platform to splice split towers, eliminates the limitation that the former operation site cannot be operated due to uneven site, does not need to be constructed and adjusted on the site, solves the problem of difficult alignment when the former split towers are spliced, is easy to operate and high in safety, shortens the total splicing time of each segment of tower from 1-2 days to 2 hours, greatly shortens the operation time and improves the operation efficiency.

title_en: Nitrogen sealing device of BOG helium extraction piston type compressor
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of compressors, and particularly relates to a nitrogen sealing device of a BOG helium extraction piston type compressor, which comprises a sealing box, wherein a piston rod is slidably connected with the sealing box, the sealing box is connected with a impurity removing component through a flange, the impurity removing component comprises a cylindrical barrel, a through hole for the piston rod to pass through is axially formed in a shell, an impurity removing channel communicated with the through hole is formed in the shell, a spoiler is arranged between the impurity removing channels, impurity removing materials are arranged between the impurity removing channels, the barrel is divided into an inner barrel and an outer barrel by a shape-finding gap, the two parts of the barrel are connected through a columnar connecting rod, and the impurity removing component is arranged to remove impurities from gas entering the sealing box, so that excessive impurities cannot enter the sealing box within a certain time, damage of the impurities to the sealing filler in the sealing box is reduced, cleaning and overhauling of the sealing box can be reduced, and accordingly the service life of the sealing box can be prolonged.

title_en: Heat dissipation hydroecium connecting piece with double-deck sealed function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of connecting pieces, in particular to a radiating water chamber connecting piece with a double-layer sealing function. The radiator comprises a radiator main body, wherein mounting seats are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the radiator main body, a water chamber main body is arranged in the mounting seats through a pressing-down fixing shell, the mounting seats are fixed with the pressing-down fixing shell through a plurality of bolt groups, a pair of sealing half shells are arranged on the outer side covers of the mounting seats and the pressing-down fixing shell, and the two sealing half shells are fixed with each other through a plurality of groups of bolt groups. According to the cooling device, the cooling liquid leakage at the joint of the water chamber main body and the mounting seat is effectively prevented through the sealing gasket between the mounting seat and the water chamber main body and the first sealing ring at the top of the pressing-down fixing shell, the second sealing ring on the sealing half shell is positioned at the port of the pressing-down fixing shell, the cooling liquid can be prevented from seeping out from the port, and the double-layer sealing structure greatly reduces the risk of the cooling liquid leakage and ensures the integrity and the stability of a cooling liquid circulation system in the radiator.

title_en: Air dispersing structure of warmer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a radiator structure, which comprises a shell, a reflecting cover and blowing equipment, wherein the reflecting cover and the blowing equipment are arranged in the shell, and the reflecting cover is provided with a ventilation opening for ventilation. According to the technical scheme of arranging the air blowing equipment and the reflecting cover with the ventilation opening for ventilation in the shell, the utility model provides the radiator air dispersing structure capable of dispersing heat energy through ventilation, and the problems that the heating range of the existing radiator is small and a radiator which is not in the heat radiation range is difficult to cover are solved.

title_en: Fan and air conditioner
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of air conditioners, and discloses a fan and an air conditioner. The fan comprises a volute casing, an impeller cavity and an adjusting mechanism, wherein the impeller cavity is provided with an air inlet and an air outlet, the adjusting mechanism is arranged at the air inlet and comprises a plurality of adjusting baffle plates and an adjusting ring plate, the adjusting baffle plates are movably connected with the volute casing, the adjusting baffle plates are arranged at the outer edge of the air inlet along the circumferential direction of the air inlet, the adjusting ring plate is provided with a sliding hole, the adjusting baffle plates are slidably arranged in the sliding hole, the sliding hole is obliquely arranged along the circumferential direction of the air inlet, and when the adjusting baffle plates slide along the sliding hole, the adjusting baffle plates reciprocate along the radial direction of the air inlet to adjust the ventilation area of the air inlet. Through adjusting separation blade and slide hole sliding connection, make the ventilation area of air intake like this can continuous adjustment, accommodation is wider, can adapt to different amount of wind demands.

title_en: Vertical axis wind turbine and wind power generation device comprising same
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a vertical axis wind turbine and a wind power generation device comprising the same, wherein the vertical axis wind turbine comprises a column shaft, a vertical axis impeller, an impeller support and a flow arc-winding plate, the column shaft is arranged on the impeller support in a penetrating and rotating mode, the flow arc-winding plate is fixed on the front face of the impeller support, the concave face of the flow arc-winding plate faces the column shaft, the vertical axis impeller arranged on the side portion of the column shaft is arranged on the impeller support, and the wind power generation device comprises a generator and an energy storage battery. The wind power generation device has the advantages that the flow-around arc plate is beneficial to reducing the wind resistance of the whole vertical shaft impeller, improving the downwind rotation speed of the vertical shaft impeller and effectively improving the wind energy conversion efficiency and the output power.

title_en: Hot end system product assembly with backpressure self-adaptive flow mixing adjusting function
abstract_en: A hot end system product assembly with a back pressure self-adaptive mixed flow adjusting function belongs to the technical field of automobile exhaust hot end products. One end of each of the four exhaust manifolds is dispersed and connected with the air inlet flange, the other end of each of the four exhaust manifolds is polymerized and connected with the front end cone of the catalyst assembly through the connecting flange assembly, the connecting hole is formed at the connecting position of the front end cone and the exhaust manifold, the flow guide valve is arranged on the connecting hole, and the oxygen sensor mounting seat is arranged on the front end cone. The utility model provides a method for innovatively optimizing a clam shell structure commonly used in the industry into an independent four-exhaust-pipe design, thereby fundamentally avoiding the problem of engine performance reduction caused by mixed flow. The utility model introduces back pressure self-adaptive regulating mixed flow leaf valve structure at the gathering position of the front end cone. The structure has the advantages that 1, the phenomenon of air flow concentration can be effectively dispersed, 2, the automatic adjustment of the opening amount is realized through the air flow pressure, and 3, the air flow distribution is intelligently regulated.

title_en: Wind power generation tower fixing device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of wind power generation tower stabilizing devices and discloses a wind power generation tower stabilizing device which comprises a base, wherein a clamping groove I is formed in the top of the base, a limiting groove I is formed in the edge of the top of the base, a tower body is installed in the center of the top of the base, a plurality of coamings are installed at the bottom end of the outer wall of the tower body, clamping grooves II are formed in the bottom ends of the outer walls of the coamings, a bottom supporting plate is installed in the clamping grooves II, the bottom of the bottom supporting plate is detachably connected with the clamping groove I, inclined supporting rods II are rotatably connected to the middle ends of the outer walls of the coamings, and mounting seats are rotatably connected to the bottom ends of the inclined supporting rods II. According to the utility model, the multi-element support system and the assembly type structure design are realized, the multi-element support system comprises the bottom diagonal bracing, the side support and the top extension plate reinforcement, the stability and the wind resistance are ensured by matching with the ground anchor, the assembly type structure is connected with the clamping groove in a plurality of convenient splicing modes, the assembly type structure is convenient to install, detach and maintain, and the working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Multiunit pump convenient to connect installation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a plurality of groups of pumps convenient to connect and install, and relates to the technical field of a plurality of groups of pumps. The novel hydraulic pump comprises a base station and further comprises an installation station arranged at the top of the base station, a pump body is arranged at the top of the installation station, spring shock absorbers are arranged at two sides between the base station and the installation station and at two sides of two ends of the base station, and a rotating seat is arranged at the bottom of the pump body. According to the utility model, the rotary positioning assembly is arranged between the bottom of the pump body and the top of the mounting table, and the pump body can rotate at the top of the mounting table by taking the rotary column as the axis during use, so that the direction of the input and output ends of the pump body can be adjusted according to the actual mounting condition, the position angle of the pump body and the connecting conveying pipeline can be conveniently connected and fixed, meanwhile, the positioning stud moves in the opposite reserved groove, and the rotary seat and the pump body can be fixed by respectively tightening the fastening nut and the locknut after the angle of the pump body is adjusted, so that the effect of connecting and mounting the pump machine at multiple angles to cope with complex application scenes is realized.

title_en: Protective cover and horizontal centrifugal pump
abstract_en: The application discloses a protective cover and a horizontal centrifugal pump, wherein the protective cover comprises a wheel-setting protective cover, an end-face protective plate and a bottom-face protective plate, the wheel-setting protective cover is a U-shaped cover body and covers three sides of a coupler, the bottom-face protective plate is positioned at the open end of the wheel-setting protective cover and shields the exposed bottom of the coupler, the end-face protective plate is positioned at two ends of the wheel-setting protective cover along the axis direction of the coupler, and the end-face protective plate is provided with mounting holes matched with the shaft of the coupler and is used for shielding the shaft connected with a water pump and a motor. According to the protective cover disclosed by the application, the wheel protective cover, the end surface protective plate and the bottom surface protective plate are combined to form the closed cover body structure with the same shape as the coupler, and the periphery of the coupler and the end surfaces positioned at two ends of the coupler in the axial direction are shielded, so that the risk of the coupler caused by the exposure of part of the structure is reduced.

title_en: Sealing assembly, heat pump system and heating system
abstract_en: The application discloses a sealing assembly, a heat pump system and a heating system, wherein the sealing assembly comprises a shell, an impeller, a wheel cover and a bushing, an impeller cavity is formed in the shell, blades are formed on the impeller and are rotatably arranged in the impeller cavity, the wheel cover is arranged on the periphery of the impeller in a surrounding mode and is connected with the blades, a first sealing surface is formed on the peripheral surface of the wheel cover, the bushing is sleeved on the periphery of the wheel cover and is accommodated in the impeller cavity, a second sealing surface opposite to the first sealing surface is formed on the inner peripheral surface of the bushing, annular sealing teeth are formed on one of the first sealing surface and the second sealing surface, the annular sealing teeth are arranged at intervals in the axial direction, and a supporting boss is arranged between at least two adjacent annular sealing teeth, so that the sealing strength of the annular sealing teeth can be improved.

title_en: Be used for water supply plant potassium permanganate charge device
abstract_en: A potassium permanganate dosing device for a water supply plant is characterized in that a manual ball valve is arranged on an outlet pipeline at the bottom of a potassium permanganate storage tank, an inlet of a metering pump is connected with the outlet pipeline at the bottom of the potassium permanganate storage tank through a manual ball valve, an electric ball valve and a manual ball valve, a first frequency converter is connected with a first metering pump, a second frequency converter is connected with a second metering pump, an outlet of the first metering pump is connected with a first exhaust valve, an outlet of the second metering pump is connected with a second exhaust valve, the first potassium permanganate storage tank is provided with a first liquid level meter and a first stirrer, the first stirrer is controlled by a PLC controller and used for stirring potassium permanganate in the first potassium permanganate storage tank at fixed time, the second potassium permanganate storage tank is provided with a second liquid level meter and is controlled by the PLC controller and used for stirring potassium permanganate in the second potassium permanganate storage tank at fixed time.

title_en: Desk fan with angle convenient to adjust
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of fans, in particular to a desk fan with an angle convenient to adjust. This convenient angle regulation's desk fan includes the base, the top of base is equipped with the support, rotate on the support and install the casing, be equipped with first motor in the casing, the flabellum is installed in the transmission on the output shaft of first motor, be equipped with the arc rack on the casing, rotate on the base and install the gear, gear and arc rack meshing, rotate on the base and install the second motor, second motor and gear fixed connection. The desk fan with the angle convenient to adjust has the advantages of being convenient to adjust and simple in appearance.

title_en: Air compressor machine filtration
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a filtering structure of an air compressor, which belongs to the technical field of air compressor filtering, and adopts the technical scheme that the filtering structure comprises a filtering shell and a cover plate, wherein a main filter is arranged in the filtering shell, an auxiliary mechanism is arranged at the top of the main filter, a pretreatment mechanism is arranged at the top of the cover plate, the auxiliary mechanism comprises a mounting cover, two net racks, a plurality of active carbon, a mounting groove and a mounting frame, the bottom of the mounting cover extends into the mounting groove and is tightly connected with the inside of the mounting groove, one side opposite to the two net racks is fixedly connected with one side opposite to the mounting cover and the mounting groove respectively, and the top and the bottom of the active carbon are tightly contacted with one side opposite to the two net racks respectively.

title_en: Heating pump and dish washer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a heating pump and a dish washer, and relates to the technical field of household equipment, wherein a pump body of the heating pump, a motor, an impeller assembly and a heating pipe are formed in the pump body, a pump cavity, a water inlet and a water outlet which are communicated with the pump cavity are formed in the pump body, the motor is connected to the pump body, a rotating shaft of the motor penetrates into the pump body, the impeller assembly is arranged in the pump body and is arranged on the rotating shaft, the heating pipe is fixedly arranged in the pump body, the heating pipe comprises a curve section and two straight line sections which are respectively connected with two ends of the curve section, the curve section is positioned below the impeller assembly, the two straight line sections extend upwards and extend out of the pump body, and a fuse is arranged in any one straight line section.

title_en: Water pump seal assembly and water pump
abstract_en: The utility model provides a water pump sealing assembly which comprises a sealing moving ring and a sealing static ring, wherein the sealing moving ring comprises a sealing piece, a first connecting piece and a second connecting piece, the sealing piece slides on the first connecting piece and the second connecting piece to form a moving ring main body, one end of the sealing piece extends out of the moving ring main body from the second connecting piece to be in contact connection with the sealing static ring, one end of the sealing piece, which is far away from the sealing static ring, is provided with a guide rod, the guide rod is inserted into a guide groove arranged in the second connecting piece, a locking bolt and a spring are arranged in the guide groove, the locking bolt is screwed into the guide groove from the end surface of the second connecting piece, which is far away from the sealing static ring, to be in contact connection with the spring, and the locking bolt supports the spring at the tail end of the guide rod, which is inserted into the guide groove. According to the utility model, when the elastic force of the spring is reduced to cause insufficient sealing effect, the disassembly of the sealing movable ring is avoided to finish overhauling, the equipment structure is optimized, the equipment maintenance efficiency is improved, and the equipment maintenance cost is reduced.

title_en: Back pressure turbine and rear turbine condensate pump arrangement structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a back pressure turbine and post turbine condensate pump arrangement structure, which relates to the technical field of energy, and comprises a post machine condenser, a post machine condensate pump and a post machine shaft seal cooler, wherein the post machine condenser is connected with the post machine condensate pump through a post machine condensate pipe, the post machine condensate pump is connected with a back pressure machine condensate pipe through a condensate pipe at an outlet of the back pressure machine condensate pump, the back pressure machine vacuum deaerator is communicated with the back pressure machine condensate pump and the back pressure machine iron remover, and one side of the back pressure machine iron remover is communicated with the back pressure machine shaft seal cooler and the waste heat boiler.

title_en: Piston component of air pump for automobile air suspension system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a piston part of an air pump for an automobile air suspension system, which relates to the technical field of automobile air suspensions, and comprises a primary connecting rod and a secondary connecting rod, wherein an air inlet channel is vertically formed in the bottom of the primary connecting rod, and a primary air suction valve plate is arranged at the bottom of the air inlet channel; according to the utility model, more air inlet channels can be covered through the integrated circular ring, so that the airflow flow is larger, meanwhile, the integrated structure realizes uniform distribution of circumferential force, and local stress concentration is reduced, so that the fatigue fracture risk is reduced, the service life is prolonged, the overall processing is simpler, and the processing cost is reduced.

title_en: Clamp for testing oil pump
abstract_en: The utility model provides a clamp for testing an oil pump, which comprises a clamp plate, a supporting seat, a transmission shaft and a coupler, wherein the clamp plate is provided with a shaft hole, the transmission shaft is arranged in the shaft hole of the clamp plate through a bearing and is vertical to the right side surface of the clamp plate, the left end part of the transmission shaft is used for driving the oil pump to be tested, one end of the coupler is fixedly connected with the right end part of the transmission shaft, the other end of the coupler is used for being connected with a motor shaft, the left end of the supporting seat is fixed on the right side surface of the clamp plate through a bolt, and the right end of the supporting seat is arranged on a rack through a limiting structure, so that the right side surface of the clamp plate is parallel to the outer side surface of the rack. The utility model can ensure the coaxiality of the transmission shaft and the motor shaft, thereby improving the installation precision of the transmission shaft and the rotor center of the oil pump.

title_en: Control device with pneumatic pumping air plug prevention function
abstract_en: A control device with the function of preventing pneumatic pumping air lock comprises a processor, an electromagnetic valve, a pneumatic pump and a pressure regulating valve. The coil unit of the electromagnetic valve is electrically connected with the processor, the pneumatic pump is connected with the first air outlet, and the pressure regulating valve is connected with the second air outlet and the first air outlet of the electromagnetic valve. The processor drives the electromagnetic valve to act, and the first air outlet of the electromagnetic valve outputs a working air source to enable the pneumatic pump to operate and convey chemical liquid. When the electromagnetic valve stops acting, the working air source flows to the second air outlet of the electromagnetic valve and flows to the first air outlet of the electromagnetic valve through the pressure regulating valve, the micro working air source flows to the first air outlet of the electromagnetic valve, chemical liquid is output through the first air outlet to return to the pneumatic pump, the pneumatic pump is used for exhausting, the pneumatic pump maintains positive pressure, and the pneumatic pump diaphragm is ensured to be maintained at a correct position without air lock.

title_en: Anti-blocking negative pressure fan
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of air conditioning equipment and discloses an anti-blocking negative pressure fan, which comprises a machine body, wherein the front end of the machine body is provided with a mounting ring, the mounting ring is detachably connected with the machine body through a fixing assembly, an impeller is arranged in the machine body, the front end of the impeller is fixedly connected with a rotating rod, a rotating sleeve is arranged on the inner side of the mounting ring, a connecting assembly is jointly arranged in the rotating sleeve and the rotating rod, an anti-blocking mechanism is arranged on the inner side of the mounting ring, the anti-blocking mechanism comprises a front baffle, and the rear end of the front baffle is rotationally connected with the front end of the rotating sleeve. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the anti-blocking mechanism, the arrangement of the front baffle and the rear baffle is ensured, so that impurities can be prevented from entering the inner area of the machine body under the condition that part of impurities pass through the front baffle, and in the using process of the equipment, the front baffle can be cleaned, and the situation that the equipment is not easily affected by blocking of the front baffle is ensured.

title_en: Water turbine convenient to disassemble and assemble
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water turbine convenient to disassemble and assemble, which comprises a motor, wherein a driving end of the motor is fixedly connected with a shell, the outer part of the shell is fixedly connected with a movable plate, the inner wall of the movable plate is connected with a pull column in a sliding manner, the outer part of the pull column is fixedly connected with a pressing plate, the outer part of the pressing plate is fixedly connected with a spring, the outer part of the movable plate is fixedly connected with a sliding bar, the outer part of the movable plate is fixedly connected with a limit bar, the outer part of the shell is provided with a water inlet, the outer part of the shell is fixedly connected with a water outlet pipe, and the outer part of the movable plate is connected with a disassembly assembly for disassembling subsequent parts in a sliding manner. According to the hydraulic turbine, the pull column in the movable plate is pulled, the pull column is connected with the pressing plate to extrude the spring, the pull column is contracted by pressure, and the condition that the pull column leaves the inside of the clamping groove and is not clamped is met, so that the whole hydraulic turbine can be quickly disassembled, and the whole hydraulic turbine is quickly disassembled.

title_en: High-resistant Wen Zhengshi chain guide rail
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of chain guide rails and discloses a high-resistant Wen Zhengshi chain guide rail which comprises a fixed seat, wherein a wear-resistant mechanism is arranged in the fixed seat, a detaching mechanism is arranged in the fixed seat, the detaching mechanism comprises the fixed seat, cavities are formed in one end of two sides of the outer wall of the fixed seat, clamping rods are arranged at one end of two sides of the outer wall of the fixed seat, one end of each clamping rod stretches into the cavity, a spring is arranged in the cavity, the spring is sleeved on the clamping rods and is positioned on the inner wall in the cavity, the wear-resistant mechanism comprises a guide rail body, and a high-temperature-resistant layer is arranged in the guide rail body. According to the utility model, the guide rail can be independently replaced through the arranged dismounting mechanism, so that the waste is avoided, meanwhile, the operation is simple, and the guide rail weight can be reduced through the arranged wear-resistant mechanism, and meanwhile, the guide rail has good wear resistance and high temperature resistance through changing the traditional metal materials, so that the service life of the guide rail is prolonged.

title_en: Combined vacuumizing system of hydrogen peroxide production line
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a combined type vacuumizing system of a hydrogen peroxide production line, wherein an outlet of a vacuumizing main pipe is connected with an air extracting opening of a Roots vacuum pump, an air exhaust opening of the Roots vacuum pump is connected with an air extracting opening of a liquid ring vacuum pump in series, an air exhaust opening of the liquid ring vacuum pump is connected with a top air inlet on the left side of a gas-liquid separation tank, an air exhaust opening on the right side of the gas-liquid separation tank is connected with a tail gas collecting device, a vertical middle partition plate is arranged in an inner cavity of the gas-liquid separation tank to divide the tank body into a left cavity and a right cavity, an overflow channel is reserved between the middle partition plate and the tank top, a pure water supplementing pipe is connected into the left cavity of the gas-liquid separation tank through a pure water supplementing valve, a water outlet on the lower portion of the left cavity of the gas-liquid separation tank is connected with a hot side inlet of a cooler through a filter, a hot side outlet of the cooler is connected with a working liquid inlet of the liquid ring vacuum pump, and a water outlet on the bottom of the right cavity of the gas-liquid separation tank is connected with a waste water discharging pipe through a waste water discharging valve. The system can improve the vacuum degree and the air extraction efficiency, realize the automatic adjustment of the vacuum degree and the automatic separation and discharge of waste liquid, and simultaneously reduce the energy consumption.

title_en: Exhaust structure, compressor and air conditioner
abstract_en: The utility model provides an exhaust structure, a compressor and an air conditioner. The exhaust structure comprises a valve plate, a driving structure and a control structure, wherein the valve plate is movably arranged at an exhaust runner of the compressor. According to the exhaust structure, the compressor and the air conditioner, the exhaust pressure and the theoretical pressure of the compressor are detected through the control structure, and then the driving structure is controlled in an electric signal mode, so that the valve plate can be stably moved to realize the opening or closing of the exhaust runner, at the moment, the valve plate is not required to be directly driven to be opened by using the pressure difference in the prior art, the problem that fluctuation exists after the valve plate is opened by the pressure difference in the prior art is solved, the energy loss of exhaust is reduced, the noise generated by collision between the valve plate and the limiting block is avoided, meanwhile, the valve plate can be timely adjusted when the working condition is changed, the problem that the compressor is excessively compressed is avoided, and the working efficiency and the reliability of the compressor are improved.

title_en: Carbon tank installing support with quick detach function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of carbon tank installation, in particular to a carbon tank installation support with a quick-dismantling function, which comprises a support main body and a carbon tank base, wherein a through chute matched with a carbon tank base guide slide card is formed in the support main body, eccentric compression wheels capable of rotating are arranged at four corners of the through chute, arc quick-dismantling grooves matched with the eccentric compression wheels are formed at four corners of the carbon tank base, when the eccentric compression wheels rotate to a vertical state, the eccentric compression wheels can rotate to the arc quick-dismantling grooves and abut against the bottommost parts of the arc quick-dismantling grooves, when the eccentric compression wheels rotate to a parallel state, the eccentric compression wheels are positioned above the arc quick-dismantling grooves and are positioned above the top end face of the carbon tank base, and a locking mechanism capable of positioning the eccentric compression wheels in the vertical state and the horizontal state is further included.

title_en: Water pump inlet and outlet complete equipment with filtering function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to water pump inlet and outlet complete equipment with a filtering function, which comprises a water pump, wherein a water inlet of the water pump is provided with a filter box, an outlet of the water pump is communicated with a water tank through a pipeline, the filter box comprises a first frame, a second frame, a first wire netting and a second wire netting, the first frame is fixedly arranged in the second frame, the first wire netting is fixedly connected with the first frame, the first wire netting completely covers the first frame, the second wire netting is fixedly connected with the second frame, the second wire netting completely covers the second frame, the aperture of the first wire netting is smaller than the aperture of the second wire netting, a baffle is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the second frame, the bottom end of the second frame is sleeved with a surrounding baffle, after the water pump is placed in an area needing water taking, impurities in the water are filtered by the second wire netting on the second frame and then filtered by the first wire netting on the first frame, and large-particle solid impurities in the water are filtered, and the large-particle impurities are prevented from entering the water inlet of the water pump.

title_en: Fan blade mounting structure of ceiling fan
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of ceiling fans. The fan blade mounting structure of the ceiling fan comprises a motor, an outer cover, a fixing screw and a plurality of blades, wherein the outer cover is of an integrated structure, the motor comprises a rotor and a motor shaft, the mounting assembly comprises an inner core member and an outer sleeve member, a notch communicated with the outside from the inner end of the mounting assembly is formed in the mounting portion, the upper portion of the notch extends in a box to form a supporting table, the inner core member is fixedly connected with the bottom end face of the rotor, the outer sleeve member comprises an upper positioning portion and a lower supporting portion, the outer sleeve member is sleeved on the inner core member and can rotate around the inner core member, the inner side wall of the supporting table is attached to the upper positioning portion, the supporting table is located above the lower supporting portion, an overlapping portion exists between the supporting table and the lower supporting portion in a overlooking mode, and the fixing screw penetrates through the mounting portion to be screwed into the bottom end face of the rotor. The utility model can conveniently screw the fixing screw into the bottom end surface of the rotor through the mounting part and mount the blade on the bottom end surface of the rotor.

title_en: Inflation and deflation valve for inflator and air storage inflator
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of inflation equipment, in particular to an inflation and deflation valve for an inflator and an air storage inflator, wherein the inflation and deflation valve for the inflator comprises a valve seat, a transverse valve pipeline in the left-right direction is integrally arranged on the valve seat, the valve seat and the valve pipeline form a T-shaped structure, a valve rod is movably inserted into the valve pipeline, four annular sealing grooves are linearly arranged in the middle part of the outer side of the valve rod at equal intervals from left to right, sealing rings are respectively arranged in the four annular sealing grooves, the middle part of the outer side of the valve rod is sequentially separated from left to right by the four annular sealing grooves to form an deflation part, an inflation part and a closing part, and an upper opening, a lower opening and a T-shaped deflation hole with an opening at the front end are formed in the deflation part.

title_en: Assembled impeller
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fan transmission systems and discloses an assembled impeller which comprises an impeller and a main shaft, wherein the impeller and the main shaft are detachably connected, at least two symmetrically distributed protruding teeth are machined on the end face of the main shaft, grooves matched with the protruding teeth are formed on the end face of an impeller body, torque is transmitted through contact between the protruding teeth and the side faces of the grooves, the contact area is large through the cooperation of the protruding teeth and the grooves, the torque can be effectively dispersed, local stress concentration is reduced, the symmetrically distributed protruding teeth enable stress to be more balanced, and local failure caused by structural deviation is avoided.

title_en: Transmission mechanism of vertical axis wind power generation equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a transmission mechanism of vertical axis wind power generation equipment, which relates to the technical field of wind power generation and comprises a support column, a mounting plate, a power generation mechanism, an auxiliary mechanism and a wind power sensor, wherein the mounting plate is arranged on the support column, the power generation mechanism is arranged on the mounting plate, the auxiliary mechanism comprises a toothed ring, the toothed ring is arranged on the power generation mechanism and used for linkage operation, the mounting plate is arranged on the mounting plate and fixedly connected with the mounting plate, the driving motor is arranged on the mounting plate and fixedly connected with the mounting plate, the gear is arranged at the output end of the driving motor, and the wind power sensor is arranged on the power generation mechanism. The device can assist the blades to rotate through the auxiliary mechanism under the smaller wind power state by arranging the auxiliary mechanism, so that the device performs wind power generation work, and the device can be suitable for more environments.

title_en: Reciprocating motion column for vertical tube tectorial membrane superpressure hydraulic weight lifting energy storage device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a reciprocating column for a vertical column film-covered overpressure hydraulic weightlifting energy storage device, which comprises a reciprocating column side wall (1), a reciprocating column bottom plate (2) and a waste counterweight body (4), wherein the waste counterweight body (4) is a part which consists of waste and has the function of increasing the pressure at the bottom of the reciprocating column, the reciprocating column side wall (1) is connected with the reciprocating column bottom plate (2), the waste counterweight body (4) is placed at the hollow part of the reciprocating column, a sealing layer (7) can be arranged at the periphery of the waste counterweight body, and a telescopic roller (8) can be arranged at the bottom of the reciprocating column, and the plane position of the bottom of the reciprocating column is controlled by restraining the telescopic roller (8) by using the inner wall of the vertical column.

title_en: Multi-fan frequency conversion control circuit with standby frequency converter
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a multi-fan variable frequency control circuit with a standby frequency converter, which comprises a three-phase power supply, a fan loop, a control loop and a switching power supply, wherein the fan loop comprises a first frequency converter, a second frequency converter, a standby frequency converter, a first contactor, a second contactor, a third contactor, a fourth contactor, a first fan and a second fan, the first contactor and the third contactor form an interlocking, the second contactor and the fourth contactor form an interlocking, the third contactor and the fourth contactor form an interlocking, the standby frequency converter is used for starting the first fan when the first frequency converter is stopped, and the standby frequency converter is used for starting the second fan when the second frequency converter is stopped. According to the multi-fan frequency conversion control circuit with the standby frequency converter, when any frequency converter fails, the standby frequency converter can be started automatically and timely, and the fault frequency converter can be overhauled and replaced under the conditions of continuous total power supply and no influence on the operation of other normal fans.

title_en: Oil-gas separation type cylinder and compressor
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of compressors, and discloses an oil-gas separation type cylinder and a compressor. The oil-gas separation type cylinder comprises a cylinder body and an oil component, wherein the cylinder body is of a cavity structure and comprises a main exhaust channel, an auxiliary exhaust channel, a main exhaust hole, an auxiliary exhaust hole, an oil return channel and an air return channel, the top of the main exhaust channel is communicated with the main exhaust hole, the bottom of the main exhaust channel is communicated with the oil return channel through the oil return hole, the auxiliary exhaust channel is positioned on one side of the main exhaust channel, the top of the auxiliary exhaust channel is communicated with the auxiliary exhaust hole, the bottom of the auxiliary exhaust channel is communicated with the oil return channel, the air return channel is positioned on one side of the main exhaust channel, one end of the air return channel is communicated with the oil return channel, the other end of the air return channel is communicated with the main exhaust channel, and the oil component is fixedly arranged in the main exhaust channel and used for separating oil gas entering the main exhaust channel. The oil-gas separation type cylinder can improve the oil-gas separation effect, has a simple structure, and is safe and reliable.

title_en: Compressed gas energy storage device
abstract_en: The application provides a compressed gas energy storage device which comprises a heat storage subsystem, a cold storage subsystem and a cold and hot energy generating subsystem, wherein the heat storage subsystem comprises a first motor, a first compressor and a heat reservoir, an outlet of the first compressor is connected with an inlet of the heat reservoir, the first motor is electrically connected with the first compressor, the cold storage subsystem comprises a cold storage device, the cold and hot energy generating subsystem comprises a second compressor and a first expander which are coaxially arranged, a first three-way valve and a second three-way valve are arranged on pipelines, a first passage of the first three-way valve is connected with an outlet pipeline of the cold storage device, a second passage of the first three-way valve is connected with an inlet pipeline of the second compressor, a third passage of the second three-way valve is connected with an inlet pipeline of the heat reservoir, a fourth passage of the second three-way valve is connected with an outlet pipeline of the heat reservoir, a fifth passage of the third passage of the first three-way valve is connected with an inlet pipeline of the first expander, and a sixth passage of the second compressor is connected with an outlet pipeline of the first compressor.

title_en: Dual-channel piston pump
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of dual-mode pumps, in particular to a dual-channel piston pump, which comprises a protection box, a pump assembly, a detection assembly and an air inflow control assembly, wherein the pump assembly is fixed on the inner wall of the protection box and is used for pumping and discharging liquid, the detection assembly is used for measuring the density of the pumping and discharging liquid, the air inflow control assembly is used for controlling the air inflow through detecting the density of the liquid by the detection assembly, the air inflow control assembly comprises a vertical plate which is fixed on the inner wall of the protection box and is far away from the pump assembly, and an air inlet piece is embedded on the inner wall of the vertical plate and is provided with an air inlet end and two air outlet ends. According to the utility model, different pumping pressures are provided for pumping and discharging the liquid by automatically measuring the densities of different liquids, so that the defect that the pumping and discharging pressures of the double-channel piston pump are insufficient and the liquids with different densities cannot be pumped and discharged during the transportation of the liquid can be effectively avoided.

title_en: Balance weight and compressor
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of compressors, and discloses a balance weight and a compressor. The balance weight comprises a balance weight main body, a sliding block, an adjusting piece and a fastening piece, wherein the balance weight main body is provided with a sliding block groove and an adjusting hole, the adjusting hole penetrates through the groove wall of the sliding block groove, the sliding block is movably arranged in the sliding block groove and is communicated with the sliding block, the adjusting piece penetrates through the adjusting hole and is connected with the sliding block, the adjusting piece can drive the sliding block to move in the sliding block groove to adjust the position of the sliding block in the sliding block groove, and the fastening piece is movably arranged in the sliding block groove and is used for fixing the sliding block when the sliding block moves to a set position. The position of the sliding block in the sliding block groove can be adjusted through the adjusting piece, so that the mass center position of the balancing block is adjusted, unbalanced force and moment caused by part machining and assembly differences are counteracted, the compressor can reach the theoretical optimal vibration noise state, the vibration noise of the compressor is reduced, and the consistency of the vibration noise of the compressor is improved.

title_en: Connection structure of magnetic suspension rotating moving plate and rotor spindle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a connecting structure of a magnetic suspension rotating moving plate and a rotor spindle, and mainly relates to the technical field of magnetic suspension molecular pumps. Including a plurality of connecting rod, rotor spindle's top is equipped with the connecting portion that contacts with integral type moving plate, and the connecting rod sets up on the connecting portion, and integral type moving plate is equipped with a plurality of through-hole, still includes the fixed cap, and connecting rod pass through after the through-hole with fixed cap sliding connection, be equipped with the stopper on the fixed cap, be equipped with on the connecting rod and erect the groove and with erect the spacing groove that the groove is linked together, erect the groove and extend to the outside, the stopper slides in proper order and sets up at perpendicular inslot and spacing inslot, be equipped with the clamp ring between fixed cap and the integral type moving plate. The utility model has the beneficial effects of solving the problem that the existing connecting structure is easy to loose or slightly displace to influence the dynamic balance of the magnetic suspension molecular pump, and improving the stability and efficiency of the connection of the magnetic suspension rotating moving plate and the rotor spindle.

title_en: Mounting bracket of self-coupling submersible pump
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mounting bracket of an auto-coupling submersible pump, which comprises a fixed rod, a group of parallel transverse supporting rods and a group of parallel inclined supporting rods, wherein the fixed rod is bridged between the same side end parts of the transverse supporting rods, the other side end parts of the transverse supporting rods are provided with fixing pieces, the inclined supporting rods are fixedly connected to the bottoms of the transverse supporting rods, guide rods of the auto-coupling submersible pump are fixed on the fixed rod, the fixed rod and the transverse supporting rods are enclosed to form a water outlet pipe penetrating space, and the water outlet pipe of the auto-coupling submersible pump is arranged in the water outlet pipe penetrating space. The utility model overcomes the defects of the original civil engineering conditions, reduces the civil engineering transformation when the submersible pump is installed, provides convenient conditions for the transformation of the submersible pump (the installation of the self-coupling type submersible pump which is replaced due to the replacement of the model), ensures that the scene which is not suitable for the self-coupling type submersible pump originally has the installation conditions, reduces the operation management difficulty of the water pump in the future, and expands the selection range and the use scene of the self-coupling type submersible pump.

title_en: New forms of energy graphite alkene electric heat energy storage equips car
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a new energy graphene electric heating energy storage equipment vehicle, which relates to the technical field of energy storage equipment and solves the problems that electricity generated by a power plant is mostly electricity and is difficult to store energy for recycling at night, a plurality of first cavities filled with heat energy storage materials and a plurality of second cavities provided with heat exchange tube groups are arranged in a shell, the top of each second cavity is provided with a heat exchange tube outlet communicated with a branch air cylinder, the bottom of each second cavity is provided with a heat exchange tube inlet communicated with a water supply tube, an exhaust port of the branch air cylinder is connected with a generator set, and a water inlet of the water supply tube is connected with a water supply system; the electromagnetic coil is used for electromagnetic heating of the heat energy storage material in the first cavity, and the electromagnetic heating system is started when the electricity price is low at night, so that the energy storage material is uniformly heated to a saturated heat storage state, and hot water and hot gas are provided according to the requirements when the energy storage material is in situ or driven to an energy source conveying place in the daytime, or heat energy is converted into electric energy to be output.

title_en: Two-stage compressor resonant cavity structure and compressor shell thereof
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a resonant cavity structure of a two-stage compressor and a compressor shell thereof, wherein the two-stage compressor shell comprises a first-stage air inlet cavity, a first-stage rotor cavity, a first-stage air exhaust cavity, an interstage runner, a second-stage air inlet cavity, a second-stage rotor cavity and a second-stage air exhaust cavity; the secondary perforated plate is arranged between the interstage flow channel and the secondary air inlet cavity, a plurality of small holes are arranged on the secondary perforated plate, boundary layers are formed through the edges of the small holes, and the primary perforated plate, the interstage flow channel and the secondary perforated plate are combined to form a resonant cavity, so that the turbulence intensity caused by concentrated fluid kinetic energy is reduced, and noise generated by vortex shedding and pressure pulsation is reduced.

title_en: Novel portable inflator pump
