The exhaust gas mass flow control is via the variable turbine geometry of the low-pressure turbine 11, and upstream of the high-pressure turbine 8 a controllable tap 13 is arranged on the exhaust line 10, which conducts part of the exhaust gas mass flow of the engine 2 between the engine and the power turbine 3. Furthermore, the invention relates to a method for operating the arrangement.

title_en: Recharging electric vehicle batteries by an inbuilt wind turbine
abstract_en: An air turbine electricity generator for use with electrical vehicles where the generator charges the vehicles battery system. The turbine is powered by air that passes through the structure of the vehicle via a ducting system. The air causes the impeller 1,2 of the turbine that are placed transversely across the width of the vehicle to turn. The shaft of the impeller is connected at each end to electrical generators (A, fig 6) via toothed belts B. Preferably the vehicle has a turbine in front of the bulkhead, and a turbine at the rear of the vehicle, and air flows in ducting between the internal floor of the vehicle and the underside of the vehicle. The ducting may be split (fig 5) to allow sufficient air to drive the turbine at the rear of the vehicle. The air inlet (F, fig 6) and outlet (G, fig 6) may be closed off by the means of flaps (fig 7) when the turbine is not intended to be used.

title_en: Integrated head package
abstract_en: An integrated head package 1 for a nuclear power generation system has a control rod drive mechanism, CRDM, 3. A drive rod 6 has a coupling mechanism 7 for releasably connecting to a control rod assembly within a reactor core, through a closure head 2. The drive rod 6 is moved into a maintenance or refuelling position by uncoupling from the control rod assembly, moving into the body of the integrated head package 1, and secured in position by an engagement portion 9. Removal of the integrated head package 1 does not require lifting above the drive rod 6. The coupling mechanism 7 may be a radially expandable and contactable sector plate actuated by a pneumatic, hydraulic or electro-mechanical actuator. The engagement portion 9 may be a recess which receives the coupling mechanism 7 to secure it in position. A load, velocity, neutronic, optical or position sensor may confirm decoupling of the drive rod 6.

title_en: Fan blade tip operating clearance optimisation
abstract_en: A method of calculating a profile for the internal wall of a housing surrounding a turbine blade such that the blade tip clearance is optimised for a particular operating point, the method including selecting an operating point, determining an initial housing wall profile, determining an operating point casing profile, determining a blade tip clearance for the operating point, determining a profile correction, applying the profile correction to the initial casing profile to determine a modified casing profile that will provide an optimised blade tip clearance. There may also be a method of manufacturing a modified clearance profile, a Gas Turbine Engine fitted with the housing having the modified profile and a computer program to implement the method.

title_en: Turbofan and air conditioner
abstract_en: In this turbo fan, when the leading edge of each swept-back blade is positioned further forward in the rotational direction than the trailing edge, a junction between the leading edge and a main plate is set as a first point, and an intersection of the leading edge and a virtual plane perpendicular to a rotational axis and passing through an outermost circumferential section of a shroud is set as a second point, a first curve (L21) obtained by projecting the leading edge onto the rotational axis perpendicular plane has a first inflection point on the positive side in the rotational direction in a coordinate system where a virtual straight line that passes through the first point and the second point is an abscissa as seen from above in the axial direction of the rotational axis . The first curve has a convex portion that protrudes in the reverse rotational direction at a portion closer to the first point than the first inflection point, and a convex portion that protrudes in the rotational direction at a portion closer to the second point than the first inflection point. The trailing edge follows an arc centered on the rotational axis as seen from above in the rotational direction. A third curve obtained by projecting the trailing edge onto a cylindrical plane coaxial with the rotational axis protrudes in the rotational direction. A junction between the third curve and the shroud is located further rearward in the rotational direction than the junction between the third curve and the main plate. As a result, a reduction in suction efficiency and a deviation in the blade outlet speed distribution are suppressed.

title_en: Gas turbine system and control method therefor
abstract_en: The present invention provides a gas turbine system and a method for controlling the same, the gas turbine system comprising: a gas turbine that includes a compressor which generates compressed air, a combustor which combusts fuel with the compressed air, and a turbine which is driven by combustion gas generated by combustion of the fuel in the combustor; a motor generator that can be driven by the turbine and that can provide rotation power to the gas turbine by electric power supplied from the outside of the gas turbine; a fuel flow rate determination device that determines a parameter setting value which is used to control the flow rate of fuel supplied to the combustor; and a fuel flow rate control device that controls, on the basis of the setting value, the flow rate of the fuel supplied to the combustor. In a reverse electric power operation mode in which the motor generator provides rotation power to the turbine, the fuel flow rate determination device determines the setting value so that the flow rate of the fuel is the lower limit value in the reverse electric power operation mode.

title_en: Vacuum pump
abstract_en: A vacuum pump, in particular a turbomolecular pump, comprises a rotor shaft 16 rotatably supported in a housing 10 by at least one radial bearing 18, 20 and an axial / thrust bearing 44. The axial bearing comprises a yoke 106 connected to the rotor shaft and a first magnetic element 108 connected to the housing and arranged axially next to the yoke to generate a magnetic force to control the axial position of the rotor shaft. The first magnetic element is separated into at least two parts (108A, 108B, figure 3) along a circumferential direction. The first magnetic element may be connected to an electromagnet to create the magnetic force. A second magnetic element 109 may be magnetically connected to the first magnetic element and arranged on the opposite side of the yoke, and may be built as one piece. A method of assembling the vacuum pump comprises providing a rotor including the rotor shaft and at least one pump element, connecting the yoke to the rotor shaft, assembling the first magnetic element around the rotor shaft, inserting the rotor and the first magnetic element into the housing, and connecting the first magnetic element to the housing.

title_en: Method for adjusting a valve lash and monitoring wear of a valve during engine start and valve assembly
abstract_en: Disclosed is a method and apparatus for adjusting a valve lash 234 and/or monitoring wear of a valve in an internal combustion engine. The method comprises the steps of rotating the engine by an engine starter 4, measuring a parameter indicative of a gas pressure in the engine while rotating the engine, determining a corresponding parameter profile based on the measured parameter indicative of the gas pressure in the engine and adjusting the valve lash and/or monitoring wear of the valve based on the determined parameter profile. A valve assembly 2 suitable for carrying out the method comprises at least one sensor device 5 and a control unit 3 communicatively coupled to the at least one sensor device 5.

title_en: An electricity generating device
abstract_en: An electricity generating device comprises an outer pipe 3 and an elongated cylindrical inner volume (pipe) defining a fluid pathway. A turbine 63 is located within the fluid pathway and drives a generator 62 which may be located between the inner and outer pipes. The fluid pathway has a restricting means which may be an ‘iris’ type adjustable aperture 40, to restrict fluid flow through the pathway. The restricting means may not allow the fluid channel to full with water above the axle 61 of the turbine 63. An electrical connection means and a mechanical securement means 6 are provided at each end of the pipe 3. The device can generate electricity from water run-off from a water source or reservoir.

title_en: Mechanical compressor
abstract_en: Compression mechanisms for a mechanical compression pulse spray dryer or a separation device are disclosed. The first mechanism comprises a cylinder block 500 with a piston 506 slidably mounted within, forming a compression chamber 510 between the plunger 506 and cylinder 504 and at least one valve which allows a gas to enter and/or exit the compression chamber. The valve is formed by the cylinder block 500 and piston 506. The valve may comprise a first set of passageways 520,530 formed in the piston 506 and a second set of passageways formed in the cylinder block 500. As the piston 506 moves between a first position and a second position the different passageways 520,530 in the piston 506 and cylinder 504 align to form conduits to and from the compression chamber 510. A second mechanism comprising a rotor, movably mounted within a chamber, whose position selectively opens or closes an opening is also disclosed (see Figure 3).

title_en: Fuel pump and plunger arrangement therefor
abstract_en: A high-pressure fuel pump comprising a two-part pumping plunger reciprocable within a plunger bore 34 of a pump housing 30 along a plunger axis 36. The pumping plunger includes a first plunger portion 102 and a second plunger portion 104 joined such that the first plunger portion and the second plunger portion form a sealing ring groove 64 that is annular in shape and extends about the pumping plunger. There is also provided a plunger sealing ring 66 accommodated within the sealing ring groove 64. Providing the pumping plunger in two parts allows for the assembly of the sealing ring into the plunger sealing ring groove without the need to elastically deform the sealing ring. A method of manufacturing a pumping plunger suitable for a high-pressure fuel pump is also disclosed.

title_en: High-pressure fuel pump
abstract_en: To provide a high-pressure fuel pump capable of securing excellent magnetic characteristics and reliability against cracking.SOLUTION: A fixed core 39 is a precipitation hardening type ferritic stainless (ferritic precipitation hardening type metal). An anchor 36 is a precipitation hardening ferritic stainless that is attracted by the magnetic attraction of the fixed core 39. An outer core 38 has an inner peripheral surface on which the outer peripheral surface of the anchor 36 slides. A seal ring 48 is made of a material having a hardness lower than those of the fixed core 39 and the anchor 36, and connects the fixed core 39 and the outer core 38.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Exhaust sensor arrangement structure
abstract_en: To provide an exhaust sensor arrangement structure capable of avoiding a defect due to attachment and deposition of soot.SOLUTION: An exhaust sensor arrangement structure, to arrange an exhaust sensor 57 detecting pressure of exhaust gas generated through combustion on an engine E, comprises: an opening section 56 which takes the exhaust gas out of an exhaust passage 40; a duct member 60 which supplies the exhaust gas from the opening section 56 to the exhaust sensor 57; and a trap mechanism T which has a trap chamber S to trap soot included in the exhaust gas flowing into the duct member 60. The trap mechanism T is positioned close to the opening section 56 capable of pulverizing soot collected through vaporization of a binder collecting the soot in the exhaust gas while the engine is operated.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7

title_en: Top ring of piston
abstract_en: To prevent oil scared up from an inner peripheral surface of a cylinder with movement of a piston to a combustion chamber side from being scattered in a center direction of the combustion chamber due to inertial force in a case where a piston reaches a top dead center, to reduce an oil consumption.SOLUTION: A top ring is provided at the uppermost one of a plurality of piston rings 4 that is mounted on an upper outer peripheral surface 25 of a piston 2 reciprocating inside a cylinder 1, and in which a ring outer peripheral surface 30 sliding on the inner peripheral surface 1a of the cylinder 1 with the reciprocating motion of the piston 2; on the ring outer peripheral surface 30, a curved surface 41 is formed so as to descend while curved into a blow shape in a radial direction as a whole; and an upper end 41a of the curved surface 41 is formed so as to direct an inner peripheral surface 1a of the cylinder 1 in a cross section along the axial line of the piston 2.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Motor and pump
abstract_en: To cool an electronic component efficiently.SOLUTION: A motor includes a housing unit having an inner surface and an outer surface, a stator, a rotor, and a heat radiation member. The stator surrounds the outer surface of the housing unit. The rotor is disposed inside with respect to the inner surface of the housing unit. In the radial direction, a gap is formed between the inner surface of the housing unit and the rotor. The heat radiation member is disposed inside with respect to the inner surface of the housing unit together with the rotor.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Windmill wake flow calculation device and windmill wake flow calculation method
abstract_en: To provide a windmill wake flow calculation device capable of calculating a state of a wake flow in a windmill with a less number of times of calculations and higher accuracy, and a windmill wake flow calculation method.SOLUTION: A windmill wake flow calculation device according to the embodiment comprises: a calculation lattice generation section which generates a mesh model constituted of a plurality of calculation lattices; a first model generation section which generates an actuator disc part by modeling a wind-receiving surface of a windmill rotor as a fixed resistor within a range of calculation lattices corresponding to at least a portion of a range from a rotation center of a blade to a first diameter; a second model generation section which generates a solid part by modeling the wind-receiving surface of the windmill rotor as a shield part within a range of calculation lattices corresponding to at least a portion of a range from the first diameter to a rotor diameter; and a calculation control section which calculates a wind speed and a wind direction for each calculation lattice by using the actuator disc part and the solid part on the basis of a governing equation.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Water supply apparatus and method for maintenance on water supply apparatus
abstract_en: To provide a water supply apparatus that is compact and resistant to vibrations.SOLUTION: A water supply apparatus 1 comprises a frame 67 on which a control board 10 is mounted. The frame 67 has a stay 100 connected to discharge-side piping 23 of a pump 2.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 30

title_en: In-garment cleaning device
abstract_en: To provide a method and means for effectively removing an odor of air which is developed in a space between a garment and a skin under a condition of a primary in-garment climate.SOLUTION: An in-garment cleaning device has a mechanism including: a small-sized cleaner which is installed between a skin and an underwear and includes a suction part and a discharge part; a sensor through which the air sucked from an in-garment first space by the suction part passes; and a desiccant agent through which the air passes and is discharged from the discharge part.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Soundproof device
abstract_en: To suppress the lowering of a soundproof effect resulting from air column resonance while suppressing the lowering of the heat radiation performance of an internal combustion engine, in a soundproof device having a Helmholtz resonator which is constituted such that a wall part forming a Helmholtz resonance space includes a soundproof cover and an outer wall (sound source member) of the internal combustion engine.SOLUTION: A soundproof device comprises a Helmholtz resonator having a wall part which forms a Helmholtz resonance space, and a first opening part formed at the wall part so as to make the Helmholtz resonance space communicate with the outside. The wall part is constituted while including a soundproof cover and an outer wall of an internal combustion engine as a sound source member for radiating a sound. The Helmholtz resonator includes one or more bulkheads which are formed so as to partition the Helmholtz resonance space into a plurality of regions, and a second opening part formed at one or more of the bulkheads so as to make the plurality of region communicate with one another. One or more of the bulkheads are formed so as to be exposed to the outside while penetrating the soundproof cover from the Helmholtz resonance space, and having heat conductivity higher than that of the soundproof cover.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Diagnostic device and diagnostic method
abstract_en: To properly estimate a damage degree of a supercharging device.SOLUTION: A management device 100 includes: a data acquisition portion 122 for acquiring cumulative data of each parameter relating to stress acting on a compressor 33 for supercharging intake air to an engine and a boost pressure by the compressor 33 from a plurality of vehicles 1; a damage degree specification portion 123 for specifying a damage degree of the supercharging device 32 from the acquired cumulative data; a relationship specification portion 124 for specifying a relational expression indicating a relationship between the specified damage degree and the boost pressure; an object information acquisition portion 125 for acquiring the boost pressure by the compressor 33 from the vehicle 1 as a diagnostic object; and a diagnostic portion 126 for estimating the damage degree of the compressor 33 of the diagnostic object on the basis of the acquired boost pressure and the specified relational expression.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Control device and control method
abstract_en: To effectively secure engine brake force in vehicle braking by optimizing pumping loss in a deactivated cylinder.SOLUTION: A control device 100 of an engine 10 comprising a variable valve mechanism 50 capable of adjusting the opening/closing operation of an exhaust valve 17, comprises: a cylinder deactivation control unit 130 that deactivates a cylinder provided with the exhaust valve 17 by controlling the operation of the variable valve mechanism 50 and opening the exhaust valve 17 at a predetermined opening in a compression stroke; and a braking force increase control unit 140 that when a braking request of a vehicle 1 is detected while the cylinder is deactivated, controls the operation of the variable valve mechanism 50 to reduce the opening of the exhaust valve 17 in the compression stroke from the predetermined opening, thereby increasing engine braking force.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Construction method for floating body type on-water structure and floating body for mooring used for the same
abstract_en: To provide an installation method for a floating body type offshore wind power generator reducing work in installation sea area and capable of efficient installation.SOLUTION: An installation method for a floating body type on-water structure 1 is capable of reducing work in an installation sea area by: having an erected bottom unit floating body structure 2 grasped attachably/detachably by a floating body for temporary mooring 14 after erecting the bottom unit floating body structure 2 in a prescribed temporary mooring sea area 13; and mooring the bottom unit floating body structure 2 in the erected state in the temporary mooring sea area 13 by coupling the floating body for temporary mooring 14 and an anchor body 20 installed on the water bottom by a mooring cable 19.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: Intake manifold
abstract_en: To provide an intake manifold having good quality.SOLUTION: A group of intake branch pipes 6a-6b constituting an intake manifold includes a lower horizontal portion 7 connected to a surge tank 5, and a bent portion 8 rising from the lower horizontal portion 7 and downwardly opened, and a PCV gas distribution passage 15 is provided in the bent portion 8. An inlet 19 of the PCV gas distribution passage 15 is provided on a surface of a portion rising from the lower horizontal portion 7. The PCV distribution passage is spread to a downstream side of the inlet 19.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Radiation generation power eliminator
abstract_en: To provide a radiation generation power eliminator that eliminates radiation generation power of artificial radioactive materials and radioactive disease-causing agents.SOLUTION: A radiation generation power eliminator is formed by: magnetizing an aluminum pipe 1 to have the N-pole on one end and the S-pole on the other end thereof; wrapping the surface of the aluminum pipe counterclockwise from the N-pole end to the S-pole end with a zinc wire 2 A times, which is fastened with tape 3 each time being wound; similarly winding a copper wire 4 B times, a zinc wire C times, an aluminum wire 5 D times, a copper wire E times, an aluminum wire F times, a copper wire G times, an aluminum wire H times, a copper wire I times, and a tin wire 6 J times; stacking K pieces of magnets 7 in the aluminum pipe; and inserting the N-poles of the magnets into the N-pole of the eliminator, and the S-poles of the magnets into the S-pole of the eliminator.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Fuel injector of dual-fuel internal combustion engine and dual-fuel internal combustion engine
abstract_en: To provide a new-type fuel injector of a dual-fuel internal combustion engine, and to provide an internal combustion engine including the same.SOLUTION: A fuel injector 16 of a dual-fuel internal combustion engine is designed in order to feed fuel to a combustion chamber 33 of a cylinder 12 of the dual-fuel internal combustion engine, having a main body 27, having a nozzle needle 28 that is movably guided in a needle guide 30 of the main body, having a needle fuel chamber 31 defined by the main body, which can be coupled to the combustion chamber of the cylinder via orifices 32, where the orifices are open in a first position of the nozzle needle and closed in a second position of the nozzle needle, where a first line 34 is coupled to the needle fuel chamber, where via the first line a fuel can be introduced into the needle fuel chamber, and where a second line 35 that is separated from the first line is formed in the main body, which on the one hand is couple to the needle guide and on the other hand to a control chamber 36 of a control valve 29 of the fuel injector 16, where via the second line a fuel can be fed to the needle guide as barrier fluid and to the control chamber as working fluid.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Compressor
abstract_en: To restrain an outflow of lubricating oil from a compressor.SOLUTION: A compressor comprises: a casing (10) comprising a cylindrical barrel part (11) extending in a vertical direction, and in which lubricating oil is stored in a bottom part; a fixed member (44) comprising a plate-like annular part (44a) formed in an annular shape along an inner peripheral surface of the barrel part (11), and fixed to the barrel part (11); and a compression mechanism (30) fastened to the fixed member (44) by a bolt (73). A lower surface of the annular part (44a) in contact with the compression mechanism (30) is flatly formed over a whole circumference. The ratio of the thickness of the annular part (44a) to the outside diameter of the fixed member (44) is 0.033 or higher.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Heat medium transfer pipe
abstract_en: To provide a heat medium transfer pipe capable of efficiently absorbing and transmitting heat of a geothermal field in order to efficiently take out a heat quantity obtained from a geothermal field to the ground S.SOLUTION: A heat medium transfer pipe 10 which recovers heat of a geothermal field U with a working medium, is used in a geothermal power generator 1 generating electric power with the usage of the heat, and transfers the working medium to the ground includes a medium injection pipe 80 for transferring the working medium to the underground. The medium injection pipe 80 includes a heat absorption pipe 81 for absorbing the heat of the geothermal field U and transmitting the heat to the working medium. In the heat absorption pipe 81, a metal film 84 thinner than a thickness of a main body 83 of the heat absorption pipe 81 is formed on the main body 83 on a side coming into contact with the geothermal field U.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Freezing prevention device
abstract_en: To effectively prevent freezing of an intake passage.SOLUTION: A freezing prevention device 70 for an intake passage 21 in which intake air of an engine 10 is caused to flow includes: a heater 75 capable of heating a predetermined portion 21A of the intake passage 21; determination means 110 determining whether or not the predetermined portion 21A of the intake passage 21 has frozen; and a control section 120 causing the heater 75 to generate heat when the determination means 110 determines the freezing.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Two-stage centrifugal pump
abstract_en: To provide a two-stage centrifugal pump that can prevent pump efficiency from being decreased by a collision between a main flow of liquid to be sucked into a first-stage impeller and a circulating flow.SOLUTION: A two-stage centrifugal pump 1 is constituted so as to attach first and second impellers 4 and 5 to a rotor shaft 3 to be rotated and driven by a motor part (driving source) M, discharge liquid pressurized by the rotation of the impellers 4 and 5, to the outside of a pump case 2, circulate a portion of the liquid discharged from the second impeller 5, through sliding bearings 7 and 8 of the rotor shaft 3, and return it as a circulating flow to the suction side of the first impeller 4, and is provided with a canopy-like guide protrusion (guide means) 24a for guiding the circulating flow of the liquid to a suction port 4a of the first impeller 4 so as to avoid a collision with a main flow of the liquid to be sucked into the first impeller 4.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Turbocharger
abstract_en: To suppress the relative rotation of a housing.SOLUTION: A supercharger comprises: a rotating body including an impeller and a shaft; a first housing (turbine housing 5) in which a part of the rotating body is arranged; a second housing (bearing housing 3) in which the other part of the rotating body is arranged; a fastening member for fastening the first housing and the second housing to each other; an annular member (heat insulation plate 33) including an annular main body part 33a gripped between the first housing and the second housing, an opposing part arranged at the main body part and opposing the second housing and the impeller in a rotation axial direction, and a regulated part (inclination part 39b) arranged at the main body part, arranged in a radius position which is the same as the opposing part, and located at a side closer the second housing than the opposing part; and a regulation part (second opposing face 37b) which is arranged at the second housing, is the same in position in the rotation axial direction with the regulated part, and located in a position different in an impeller rotation direction from the regulated part.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Internal gear pump
abstract_en: To provide an internal gear pump that can further reduce the weight of an externally toothed gear and an internally toothed gear.SOLUTION: In gears 5 and 6, recessed parts 5C and 6C are formed by recessing side surfaces 5B and 6B in an axial direction, and side surfaces 5G and 6G opposed to the side surfaces 5B and 6B are flatly formed. In a pump housing 4, a sliding contact surface 4A with which the side surfaces 5B and 6B of the gear 5 and 6 are in sliding contact is flatly formed, and a suction port 10 communicating with a suction region space to suck liquid, and a discharge port 12 communicating with a discharge region space to discharge the liquid are opened in a sliding contact surface 4B with which the side surfaces 5G and 6G of the gears 5 and 6 are in sliding contact.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Treatment method of chemical cleaning waste liquid
abstract_en: To provide a treatment method of chemical cleaning waste liquid which can efficiently treat dried matter without incinerating dried matter generated in a heating treatment step with an incineration device, thereby solving a problem of the dried matter absorbing water (absorbing moisture) during a long-term storage and an issue of ensuring a storage space.SOLUTION: A treatment method of chemical cleaning waste liquid generated by chemical cleaning using a chelator for an object to be cleaned having a metal compound adhered thereto comprises: a concentration step of concentrating the chemical cleaning waste liquid containing a chelate compound and an ammonia generating compound; a heating drying step of drying the concentrated liquid in the concentration step by heating; a catalytic decomposition step of bringing a gas generated from the heating drying step with oxygen into contact with an oxidation catalyst to decompose ammonia into nitrogen and water; and a carbonization step of carbonizing dried matter from the heating drying step with superheated steam.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Driving source control system
abstract_en: To provide a driving source control system capable of controlling driving force to an appropriate range without depending on another unit even when an abnormality occurs in a certain unit, and capable of suppressing excess or shortage of output of the unit in which an abnormality occurs with respect to output of a normal unit.SOLUTION: A driving source control system is equipped with a plurality of units having a driving source and a control part for controlling an element that affects output of the driving source with required output as a target value. The driving source control system includes a main control part that can communicate with the control part of each unit. When an abnormality occurs in the element, the control part notifies the main control part of an output value that can be output by using another element being operated normally. The main control part notifies each unit of a limit value of the output on the basis of the output value of which the control part notifies. The control part of each unit controls another element being operated normally so that the output of the driving source falls within the range of the limit value of which the main control part notifies.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Vacuum pump
abstract_en: To provide a vacuum pump for suppressing influences on an external pipe due to the contact inconveniences of the rotor during the rotation of the rotor.SOLUTION: In the vacuum pump, a temperature rise ring 301 is provided. To the temperature rise ring 301, an exhaust port 133 is connected to which the external pipe is connected, and rotating force is directly or indirectly applied due to the contact inconveniences of the rotor during the rotation of the rotor. Separately from a connection portion between the temperature rise ring 301 and a casing (an outer cylinder 127a), rotation suppressing means (a hole 301a and a bolt 305) are provided for suppressing the rotation of the temperature rise ring 301 by the rotating force.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Piston ring unit and compressor
abstract_en: To provide a piston ring unit and a compressor which can restrain leakage of compression fluid from a high pressure side to a low pressure side.SOLUTION: A piston ring unit 113 includes a first piston ring 114, a second piston ring 115, and a first inscribed ring 116. The piston rings 114, 115 respectively have abutment joints 114a, 115a. The first inscribed ring 116 has an opening 116a. The first inscribed ring 116 is inserted between a groove bottom of an annular groove 11a of the piston 11 and inner peripheral surfaces 114b, 115b of the piston rings 114, 115. The first piston ring 114, the second piston ring 115, and the first inscribed ring 116 are arranged in such a manner that the abutment joints 114a, 115b and the opening 116a do not overlap with each other. The first inscribed ring 116 is arranged in a state of being extended to all of the first piston ring 114 and the second piston ring 115 in an axial direction of the piston 11.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: pump
abstract_en: To provide a pump having a configuration which can suppress an increase of the number of parts.SOLUTION: A housing has a first housing member, a second housing member fixed to one side of the first housing member in an axial direction, and a pump chamber provided between the first housing and the second housing in an axial direction. The first housing member has a port connected to the other side of the pump chamber in the axial direction, and a first connection flow passage connected to the port. The first connection flow passage has a first flow passage part extending in an orientation obliquely inclined to the axial direction, and connected to the port, and a second flow passage part extending in an orientation obliquely inclined to the axial direction, and connected to the first flow passage part. The first flow passage part is located outside a radial direction as progressing toward the other side in the axial direction from the port. The second flow passage part is located outside the radial direction as progressing to one side in the axial direction from the first flow passage part. An end part of the second flow passage part at an end part of one side in the axial direction is opened at a connection face of the first housing member connected with the second housing member.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Vertical shaft pump
abstract_en: To not only improve pump performance but also to suppress the occurrence of air suction vortex by a movable vane.SOLUTION: A vertical shaft pump 10 comprises a cylindrical pump casing 12, a rotary shaft 27, a vane wheel 30, a plurality of movable vanes 40 provided in the pump casing 12 in such a way as to be located between a suction port 21 and the vane wheel 30, and a vane angle change mechanism 45 for changing the inclination angles of the plurality of movable vanes 40. The plurality of movable vanes 40 includes first movable vanes 40A, 40B, and second movable vanes 40C, 40D spaced from the first movable vanes 40A, 40B in the peripheral direction of the pump casing 12. The vane angle change mechanism 45 can change the inclination angles of the plurality of movable vanes 40 so that the first inclination angle of each first movable vane 40 becomes different from the second inclination angle of each second movable vane 40.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Motor driving device
abstract_en: To provide a motor driving device in which an increase of power consumption due to operation of a fan is not caused, and further, and sludge, etc. can be removed without requiring addition of a mechanism for connecting a rotor and the fan.SOLUTION: A motor driving device 100 drives a motor 30 having a fan unit. The motor driving device 100 includes a start check unit 50 that, upon detecting that power is supplied to a servo amplifier 40 for driving the motor 30, outputs a signal indicating the power supply, and a vibration command unit 60 that, upon receiving the signal indicating the power supply from the start check unit 50, transmits a command for vibrating a rotor 11 of the motor 30 to the servo amplifier 40.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Offshore wind power generation system
abstract_en: To provide a floating type offshore wind power generation system that is suitable in Japan due to geographical conditions, and is expected for increasing capacity of power supply by natural energy, which requires cost reduction therefor.SOLUTION: An offshore wind power generation system installs a plurality of wind power generators (1A, 1B and 1C) at positions that are vertices of planar view polygons on the ocean. One of the vertices is made to be a fixed end floating portion (3) provided on the ocean. Of the plurality of wind power generators (1A, 1B and 1C), one wind power generator (1A) is installed on a fixed end rotary floating portion. The other end side of the coupling portions (5A and 5B) that are the other vertices of the polygons are made to be moving end floating portions (4 and 4). The other wind power generators (1B and 1C) are installed on the moving end floating portions (4 and 4). Coupling portions (5A, 5B, and 5C) operate to a leeward side following movement of a fixed end rotary floating portion (31).SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Control device and vehicle
abstract_en: To reduce a sense of discomfort felt by an occupant while allowing the operation line of an internal combustion engine to be switched irrespective of the operation point of the internal combustion engine.SOLUTION: A control device is applied to a vehicle including an internal combustion engine, a power generator capable of being rotated by the internal combustion engine, a battery for storing power generated by the rotation of the power generator, and an electric motor which is supplied with power from the battery and outputs driving force to a drive wheel. At a timing at which an output requested when the internal combustion engine is operated in such a state that the internal combustion engine and the drive wheel are not mechanically connected to each other, and there is performed stoichiometric operation where the internal combustion engine is operated according to a stoichiometric air-fuel ratio, becomes equal to or greater than a threshold value, the control device starts to increase the rotation speed of the internal combustion engine to a rotation speed set in rich operation where the ratio of fuel to oxygen in the internal combustion engine is higher than the stoichiometric air-fuel ratio.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Engine for automobile
abstract_en: To improve the stiffness of a chain cover in which a mount attachment bracket part is formed, and to simplify seal means, in a monoblock-type engine in which a cylinder block part and a cylinder head part are integrated with each other.SOLUTION: A cylinder block part 1 and a cylinder head part 2 are integrally cast. An upper case part 27 for covering a VVT device 24, and overlapped on a front end face of a head cover 4 is expansively formed at a chain cover 5, and a bracket base part 29b in which a bracket part 29a attached with a mount 28 is protrusively arranged is integrally connected to the upper case part 27. Since a rigid structure is formed of the upper case part 27 and the bracket base part 29b, deformation of an engine caused by its own weight does not occur, and the seal performance of the chain cover 5 and the head cover 4 and the cylinder head part 2 can be easily secured.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Method of disposing of contaminated water containing radioactive substances and treated contaminated water
abstract_en: To provide a method of disposing of either of: contaminated water containing radioactive substances that raise big concerns about changes in growth of marine organisms and ecosystem caused by marine contamination and about health hazards caused by internal exposure to humans through the food chain; or treated radioactive contaminated water.SOLUTION: A method provided herein involves diluting radioactive substance-containing contaminated water or treated radioactive contaminated water, which has water quality different from that of tritium-containing water discharged into the ocean from normally-operating nuclear power plants around the world, 1000 times with uncontaminated tap water or natural water before disposal into the ocean.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: fuel tank structure
abstract_en: To suppress a valve closing of a float of a full-tank regulation valve caused by an airflow.SOLUTION: A fuel tank structure 10 comprises a fuel tank 12, a canister 20 which can adsorb and desorb vapor which is generated in the fuel tank 12, a vapor passage 21 connecting the fuel tank 12 and the canister 20, and a full-tank control valve 40 connected to an end part of the vapor passage 21 on the fuel tank side. The full-tank control valve 40 comprises a full-tank regulation valve 42 having a float 43 which floats with the buoyancy of fuel in the fuel tank 12 and is valve-closed at the time of full tank, and a diaphragm actuator 45 which operates by a pressure difference between an in-tank pressure of the fuel tank 12 and pressure in the vapor passage 21. The diaphragm actuator 45 comprises an operation member 67 which moves in a direction in which the float 43 is pressed through an actuation so as not to move in a valve-closing direction.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Motor control device and electric pump device
abstract_en: To provide a motor control device and an electric pump device capable of detecting occurrence of foreign fluid suction abnormalities in an electric pump.SOLUTION: A motor control device 10 that controls a motor 20 of an electric pump 40, comprises: a drive unit 11 that supplies a drive current to the motor; a control unit 13 that controls a rotation number of the motor by controlling the drive unit on the basis of a rotation number command value; and a current detection unit 12 that detects the drive current supplied to the motor and supplies a current detection value indicating the detection results of the drive current to the control unit. The control unit determines whether or not foreign fluid suction abnormalities occur in the electric pump on the basis of a first current detection value acquired at a first timing when the rotation number command value changes from a first command value to a second command value and a second current detection value acquired after the first timing.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Failure diagnosis device of exhaust emission recirculation system
abstract_en: To provide a failure diagnosis device of an exhaust emission recirculation system which can diagnose a failure in detail while securing the safety of an engine operation.SOLUTION: A failure diagnosis device for diagnosing the presence or absence of a failure of an EGR system 50 of an engine 2 in a plug-in hybrid vehicle comprises: an EGR temperature sensor 56 for detecting a temperature of an EGR gas; and an EGR failure determination part 60 for determining the presence or absence of the failure of the EGR system 50 on the basis of a change in temperature of the EGR gas when opening and closing an EGR valve 54. The EGR failure determination part 60 determines an open failure of the EGR valve 54 on the basis of the temperature change of the EGR gas by closing the EGR valve 54 at a warmup operation after start of the engine 2 at a transition to a series mode from an EV-mode, and determines a closed failure of the EGR valve 54 on the basis of the temperature change of the EGR gas by opening the EGR valve 54 from a closing operation state after the open failure determination.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Power generator
abstract_en: To provide a power generator having a simple power generator structure, capable of generating power under a magnetic field.SOLUTION: A power generator has a plurality of wind receiving parts that are annularly disposed around a rotational axis of a rotation part that is rotatably supported by a support part and that can revolve integrally with wind. Each of the plurality of wind receiving part comprises a coil that generates power with electromagnetic induction based on fluctuation in magnetic fluxes due to revolution. The power generator has a rectifying element that is connected to each coil and rectifies a current generated in the coil.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: oil separator
abstract_en:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an oil separator that makes it easy to check the quantity of drain liquid. 
     SOLUTION: An oil separator 5 comprises: an intake port 16 into which compressed air flows; an exhaust port 17 from which clean air is expelled; a filter part for separating compressed air into gas and liquid; a drain bowl 30 for impounding drain liquid separated from compressed air; and a protective cover 80 for protecting a translucent part. The entire drain bowl 30 is a translucent part through which its inside can be viewed. 
     SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Artificial floating structure sailing on sea for collecting/loading processing of marine pollutants and polluted water
abstract_en: To provide an artificial floating structure capable of performing collecting/loading processing of marine pollutants and polluted water.SOLUTION: An artificial floating structure consists of a floating body Q which comprises a storage part P to store marine pollutants and polluted water, an introduction part 1 with an opening/closing mechanism 2 arranged in front of the storage part P to introduce the marine pollutants and the polluted water, and a discharge part 3 with an opening/closing mechanism 4 arranged behind the storage part P to discharge the marine pollutants and the polluted water.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Knocking estimation device
abstract_en: To improve the accuracy in estimating knocking intensity.SOLUTION: A control device stores mapping data for defining mapping that outputs an output variable indicating knocking intensity by being inputted with an input variable. The control device executes correction processing of offsetting the values indicating frequency intensities of a plurality of bands so that the smallest value among the values indicating the intensities of frequencies of the plurality of bands becomes zero. The control device executes normalization processing in which the values indicating the frequency intensities of the plurality of bands offset by the correction processing are multiplied by the same coefficient to convert the values into values in a predetermined range. The control device executes acquisition processing that is the processing of acquiring, as input variables, the values indicating the frequency intensities of the plurality of bands converted by the normalization processing. The control device executes calculation processing of outputting the value of an output variable by inputting the input variable acquired through the acquisition processing into the mapping.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: oil management system
abstract_en: To provide an oil management system capable of more appropriately reporting recommendation of oil replacement.SOLUTION: A vehicle control device for an oil management system includes: an actual fuel consumption amount calculation section that calculates an actual fuel consumption amount from completion of oil replacement; an engine traveling distance calculation section that calculates an engine traveling distance on the basis of operation and stop of an engine and a traveling distance after replacement from the completion of the oil replacement; an actual fuel consumption rate calculation section that calculates an actual fuel consumption rate on the basis of the engine traveling distance and the actual fuel consumption amount; a prediction fuel consumption amount calculation section that calculates a prediction fuel consumption amount required for traveling for a replacement distance on the basis of the replacement distance and the prediction fuel consumption rate; a correction section that makes a correction so that the prediction fuel consumption amount becomes smaller when the actual fuel consumption rate becomes the prediction fuel consumption rate or lower; a fuel consumption amount comparison section that compares the actual fuel consumption amount with the prediction fuel consumption amount; and a replacement recommendation instruction section that instructs reporting of the recommendation of the oil replacement to a replacement reporting device when the actual fuel consumption amount reaches the prediction fuel consumption amount.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Inscribed gear pump
abstract_en: To provide an inscribed gear pump capable of reducing pump sound generated during driving (when increasing the pressure of oil and discharging the oil).SOLUTION: An inscribed gear pump 20 comprises: a pump housing 21; an outer rotor 23 having internal teeth on its inner peripheral surface, and disposed inside the pump housing 21; an inner rotor 24 having external teeth meshing with the internal teeth of the outer rotor 23 on its outer peripheral surface, disposed inside the outer rotor 23, and rotationally driven by a pump shaft 25; a one-way clutch 28 that is disposed between the pump housing 21 and the outer rotor 23, allows the outer rotor 23 to rotate in a forward direction and prohibits rotation in the opposite direction.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Axial flow fan motor
abstract_en: To provide an axial flow fan motor improved in heat dissipation to a circuit substrate and protecting the circuit substrate.SOLUTION: A fan device 100 has: a hollow cylindrical casing 200 having a suction port 201 at one end and the other exhaust port 301 at the other end in the axis X direction; an impeller 210 having multiple blades 212; a motor 250 for rotating the impeller 210; multiple circuit substrates 400, 500 arranged along the axis X direction on the exhaust port 301 side, having multiple electronic parts 411, 511 provided thereto; and multiple fixed blades 206 arranged upstream the circuit substrates 400, 500 in the casing 200. The multiple circuit substrates 400, 500 are combined in an X shape to be an integrated substrate 600. A cover member 700 fitted to the downstream side of the casing 200 has a ventilation part 730 having a cup-like body 711 for covering the integrated substrate 600 from the downstream side, and having an arm part 712 radially extended from the cup-like body 711 and for passing air generated by the impeller 210.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Impeller attachment/detachment jig for magnet pump, and impeller attachment/detachment device comprising the same
abstract_en: To provide an impeller attachment/detachment jig for a magnet pump that allows a worker to simply and safely facilitate attachment/detachment work without touching it directly.SOLUTION: An impeller attachment/detachment jig for a magnetic pump is composed of: a substantially cylindrical base shaft part 11; arm parts 12 to 14 provided radially on an outer peripheral surface of the base shaft part 11 at equal intervals in a circumferential direction; a weight prat 15 located in a direction opposite to a direction in which the arm parts 12 to 14 extend with respect to the base shaft part 11; and a connection part 16 that connects the base shaft part 11 and the weight part 15 to each other. The arm parts 12 to 14 are bent so that their terminal parts face toward a central axis O from three directions with center angles shifted by 120 degrees on the same plane perpendicular to the central axis O of the base shaft part 11. The arm parts 13, 14 have their terminal parts expandable and retractable in a direction away from the central axis O.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7

title_en: compressible fluid plant
abstract_en: To provide a compressible fluid plant capable of transferring electrical energy from a storage battery to an apparatus to heat compressible fluid.SOLUTION: A compressible fluid plant 1 comprises: an apparatus 2 to heat compressible fluid; a turbine 4 capable of generating kinetic energy through interaction with the fluid; first electrical transformation means 5 to transform at least a first portion of the kinetic energy to electrical energy; a current storage battery 6 configured to store the electrical energy; a motor 3 in fluid passage connection with the turbine 4; and an electronic control unit 7 operably connected to the storage battery 6 so as to enable transferring the electrical energy from the storage battery 6. The storage battery 6 is operably connected to the apparatus 2 to transfer the electrical energy from the storage battery 6 to the apparatus 2.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Woody biomass gas combustion facility and woody biomass gas combustion method
abstract_en: To realize a configuration capable of curbing an increase in a concentration of carbon monoxide contained in processed gas produced after exhaust gas produced when exhaust gas after combustion of thermal decomposition gas undergoes a process in a woody biomass gas combustion facility in which the thermal decomposition gas generated through thermal decomposition of woody biomass undergoes combustion.SOLUTION: A woody biomass gas combustion facility 1 comprises: a filter 23 which collects particles in thermal decomposition gas obtained from woody biomass; oxidation catalyst reaction device 16 which oxidizes carbon monoxide contained in exhaust gas produced when the thermal decomposition gas undergoes combustion with a gas engine 15; a particle removal mechanism 25 which performs particle removal operation; an oxidation gas supply device 40 which mixes the exhaust gas with oxidation gas; and a control device 30 which controls drive of the oxidation gas supply device 40 so as to mix the exhaust gas with the oxidation gas when the particle removal mechanism 25 performs the particle removal operation.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: electric compressor
abstract_en: To provide an electric compressor that can improve cooling performance of a switching element.SOLUTION: A switching element 70 comprises a conductive member 71, and a resin member 72 having a rectangular parallelepiped shape. The resin member 72 comprises: a first end surface 72a that is an end surface in a longitudinal direction, and from which a portion of the conductive member 71 protrudes; a second end surface 72b that is an end surface on a side opposite to the first end surface 72a; and a first side surface 72c connecting the first end surface 72a and the second end surface 72b. The conductive member 71 comprises a heat generation part 73a exposed in the first side surface 72c. The switching element 70 is arranged in an inverter housing chamber S1 in such a manner that the longitudinal direction of the resin member 72 extends in an axial direction of a rotating shaft. A heat dissipation member 80 made of metal is arranged between the switching element 70 and a partition wall 22. The heat dissipation member 80 comprises a first heat dissipation part 81 arranged between the heat generation part 73a and the partition wall 22, and a second heat dissipation part 82 continuous with the first heat dissipation part 81, and arranged between the second end surface 72b and the partition wall 22.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Submerged pump
abstract_en: To provide a submerged pump which can detect liquid leakage from a shaft seal device at multiple steps.SOLUTION: A submerged pump includes: a motor chamber 3 which houses a motor 2 having a motor shaft 2a; a pump chamber 5 which houses an impeller 4 attached to the motor shaft 2a; a shaft seal device 6 which is provided between the motor chamber 3 and the pump chamber 5 and seals the motor shaft 2a; an oil chamber 7 which is disposed between the motor chamber 3 and the pump chamber 5 to store a lubrication oil of the shaft seal device 6; an overflowing water reservoir part having multiple leaking liquid reservoir parts 8a, 8b provided so that a liquid leaking from the shaft seal device 6 to the motor chamber 3 side sequentially flows thereinto to be stored; and overflowing water detectors 9a, 9b which are respectively provided at the multiple leaking liquid reservoir parts 8a, 8b and detect, at the leaking liquid reservoir parts 8a, 8b, the liquids flowing into the liquid leakage parts 8a, 8b.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Oil passage arrangement structure for internal combustion engine
abstract_en: To provide a configuration capable of cooling a knocking sensor while enhancing a knocking detection function by arranging the knocking sensor close to a combustion chamber, make combustion appropriate through highly accurate knocking detection, and contribute to alleviation or reduction of an effect of a climate change by reducing discharge amount of harmful substances.SOLUTION: An internal combustion engine 4 includes: a crank case 40; a cylinder block 42 connected to the crank case and forming a cylinder part 42a; a cylinder head 43 that is connected to the cylinder block and in which an intake port 45 and a discharge port 46 are formed; and a knocking sensor 80 provided in the cylinder block and detecting knocking. In an oil passage arrangement structure for the internal combustion engine, the cylinder block includes a cylinder block inner oil supply passage 91 to which oil is supplied from the crank case side, and the cylinder block includes a support part 81 for mounting at least part of the knocking sensor to face the cylinder block inner oil supply passage.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Wind power generation device control system and blade wind detection device
abstract_en: To provide a wind power generation device control system and a blade wind detection device that can drive a wind power generation device by accurately grasping the state of wind received by the wind power generation device.SOLUTION: A wind power generation device control system comprises a blade wind detection device for detecting at least one of a wind direction and a wind velocity on at least one blade comprised in a wind power generation device, and a blade control device for controlling at least one of the pitch angle of the at least one blade and the yaw angle of the wind power generation device on the basis of the at least one of the wind direction and the wind velocity detected by the blade wind detection device.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Electric fan
abstract_en: To provide an electric fan that can improve stability.SOLUTION: An electric fan comprises an air blowing part 3, a strut part 2 extending downward from the air blowing part 3, and a base part 1 supporting the strut part 2. The base part 1 comprises; a depression part 9 recessed downward in a central part, into which a lower part of the strut part 2 is fitted; a plurality of outer peripheral leg parts 10 protruding downward from a peripheral edge part of the base part 1; and a plurality of inner peripheral leg parts 11 protruding downward from a peripheral edge part of the depression part 9. A ground contact surface on which the base part 1 is placed is in contact with the outer peripheral leg parts 10. The base part comprises a gap 18 between the ground contact surface and the inner peripheral leg parts 11. When the strut part 2 is inclined, the inner peripheral leg parts 11 come into contact with the ground contact surface.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: On-water wind power generation control system
abstract_en: To provide an on-water wind power generation control system capable of preventing tethers of a kite of an approaching floating body from becoming entangled.SOLUTION: An on-water wind power generation control system 100 comprises: a plurality of power generation units 10 that generates wind power generation using kites 26 connected to a floating body 16 via a tether 24; a position information acquisition unit that is provided in each of the plurality of power generation units 10, and acquires position information of the floating body 16 and the kites 26 of the power generation unit 10; a communication unit that is provided in each of the plurality of power generation units 10, and enables the plurality of power generation units 10 to transmit and receive position information to each other; and a control unit 30 that controls a behavior of the floating body 16 so that a distance d between the plurality of power generation units 10 derived on the basis of the position information of each of the plurality of power generation units 10 is maintained at a predetermined distance.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Large two-stroke uniflow scavenged turbocharged internal combustion engine with ammonia absorption system
abstract_en: To provide a large two-stroke uniflow scavenged turbocharged internal combustion engine having at least one operation mode in which ammonia is used as main fuel.SOLUTION: An engine comprises: at least one cylinder having a cylinder liner, a reciprocating piston in the cylinder liner, and a cylinder cover covering the cylinder; a combustion chamber formed between the reciprocating piston in the cylinder and the cylinder cover; an ammonia fuel system (30) configured to supply pressurized ammonia to fuel valves disposed in the cylinder cover or the cylinder liner; and an ammonia evacuation flow path (42, 44, 47) that connects an outlet of the ammonia fuel system to an inlet of an ammonia absorption system. The ammonia absorption system makes ammonia water during use by causing ammonia supplied through the ammonia evacuation flow path to be absorbed in water.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Engine diagnosis method and engine diagnosis device
abstract_en: To ensure diagnostic accuracy for engine torque states, regardless of engine operation states.SOLUTION: There is provided an engine diagnosis method of calculating corrected command torque Ttrg2 by correcting with a correction amount according to the response characteristics of engine torque T, and comparing diagnostic torque Tdia determined on the basis of the corrected command torque Ttrg2 with a torque estimate value Tact to diagnose the state of the engine torque T. In particular, in this engine diagnosis method, it is determined whether a current state is the time when the engine torque T increases or the time when the engine torque decreases, on the basis of a past value Ttrg2_(n) of the corrected command torque Ttrg2. At the time when the engine torque increases, a first filter (62, 72) is applied to the command torque Ttrg to calculate the corrected command torque Ttrg2, and at the time when the engine torque decreases, a second filter (64, 74) is applied to the command torque Ttrg to calculate the corrected command torque Ttrg2.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Heat exchanger configuration with porous layer
abstract_en: To provide a heat exchanger which can inhibit mixing of coolants.SOLUTION: A heat exchanger disclosed herein is made up of a hot flow channel, a cold flow channel, and a porous layer provided between the hot flow channel and the cold flow channel. The heat exchanger is a plate heat exchanger comprising a hot plate and a cold plate. The hot flow channel is formed as first guide channels on a surface of the hot plate, and the cold flow channel is formed as second guide channels on a surface of the cold plate. A porous thermally insulative layer is disposed between the hot plate and the cold plate.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Oil level gauge pipe fixing structure
abstract_en: To provide an oil level gauge pipe fixing structure which is easily adaptable to a variety of vehicle types, and can prevent the interference of an oil level gauge pipe with a constituent component.SOLUTION: An oil level gauge pipe fixing structure S100 comprises: an oil level gauge pipe 10 having a cylindrical shape in which an oil level gauge 11 is accommodated, and which is attached to a constituent component of a vehicle; and a guide member 30 for guiding the oil level gauge pipe 10. The guide member 30 has: a first portion 31 for supporting the oil level gauge pipe 10 from the inside of a bent part at a position at which the oil level gauge pipe 10 is bent; and a second portion 32 which is folded and bent from the first portion 31, extends toward the outside of the bent part above the oil level gauge pipe 10, and regulates a position of an upper limit of the oil level gauge pipe 10.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Electronic control method for throttle and electronically controlled throttle device
abstract_en: To control rotation speed without excessive overshoot for a rotation speed command and to converge the rotation speed to the rotation speed command, in a case of rotation speed control by an electronic control method.SOLUTION: In an electronic control method for a throttle which performs opening/closing control of the throttle while electronic control means generates a control signal based on an inputted data signal, the electronic control means calculates engine speed deviation from a difference between an engine speed and an engine speed command, calculates an engine rotation acceleration based on the engine speed, obtains proportional torque from the product of the engine speed deviation and a proportional torque coefficient, obtains integrated torque by multiplying the integration of the products of the engine RPM deviation and the integration torque coefficient by a forgetting factor, and generates a control signal for the throttle with the sum of the proportional torque and the integrated torque as a torque command value.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: On-vehicle air compressor
abstract_en: To provide an on-vehicle air compressor which can prevent a tire sealant from flowing into an air compressor body with a simple structure.SOLUTION: A bottle cap assembly includes a bottle cap member, and a sealing and flow guide member. The bottle cap member is provided on an air compressor body and has an air introduction port and an air discharge port, and the bottle cap member communicates with the air compressor body by the air introduction port. The sealing and flow guide member is arranged in the bottle cap member, and includes a sealing part 1241 and a flow guide part 1242. The sealing part surrounds the flow guide part, and the flow guide part covers the air introduction port 122a, and has at least one air introduction hole 1242a and one air discharge hole. The flow guide part communicates with the air introduction port by the air introduction hole, and communicates with the air discharge port by the air discharge hole. The air flow from the air compressor body passes through the air introduction port, the air introduction hole, the air discharge hole, and the air discharge port in this order.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 9

title_en: Blower device
abstract_en: To provide a blower device capable of suppressing deterioration in air blowing performance, while achieving reduction in noise.SOLUTION: In a blower device 1, a centrifugal blower 3 in which a suction hole 34 is formed is provided inside a housing 2. The suction hole 34 is positioned at a position being separated from an air supply port 21 in a reference direction set at a noise absorption member 4. On a noise absorption exposure surface 40 of the noise absorption member 4, a noise absorption upper end part 40a is formed in a cross section irregular shape section S. At least a part of the noise absorption upper end part 40a is opposed to the suction hole 34. In the cross section irregular shape section S, on the cross section of the noise absorption member 4 on a flat surface orthogonal to the reference direction, a thickness of the noise absorption member 4 at a position of the noise absorption upper end part 40a is thicker than a thickness of the noise absorption member 4 at a position deviated from the noise absorption upper end part 40a.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Method and system for predictive control of wind turbine
abstract_en: To provide a method for controlling a wind turbine having a plurality of actuators.SOLUTION: A method comprises receiving operating data (366) of a wind turbine and determining an operating state of the wind turbine. Further, the method includes an intensity calculation module (372) for calculating secondary load parameters (374) from loads (375). The method comprises optimizing a cost function over a finite optimization time period, subject to constraints, to determine an optimal trajectory (391) including commands for actuators. Finally, the method includes controlling the actuators using the first commands of the determined optimal trajectory. The present disclosure relates to a wind turbine controller (360) configured to implement such a method.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Compressor and refrigeration cycle device
abstract_en: To control noise of a compressor.SOLUTION: A compressor has: a compressor enclosure; a motor which has a stator; a bearing in which a shaft receiver receiving a drive shaft driven by the motor and an end plate forming a compression chamber are formed integrally, and which supports the drive shaft by the shaft receiver; a discharge valve which opens and closes a discharge part of the compression chamber; a discharge valve presser which restricts an opening of the discharge valve; and an accumulator which is connected to an intake part of the compression chamber through a connection pipe. In compression, a first natural vibration frequency as a natural vibration frequency of the discharge valve pressor is included in a specific frequency band including a second natural vibration frequency as a natural vibration frequency of a component having the largest operation noise in driving of the compressor among components of the compressor other than the discharge valve presser.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Stator vane segment of compressor and compressor
abstract_en: To reduce vibration of stator vanes in a stator vane segment of a compressor.SOLUTION: A stator vane segment of a compressor according to at least one embodiment of the disclosure includes: a plurality of stator vanes disposed in a circumferential direction; a holder attached to inner shrouds of the stator vanes; and a spring member which is disposed between the respective inner shrouds and the holder, extends in the circumferential direction, and applies the biasing force so as to separate the respective inner shrouds and the holder from each other in a radial direction. Each of the stator vanes has a recessed part enclosed at an entire periphery by an inner shroud body and recessed to the radial outer side at the radial inner side of the inner shroud body of the inner shroud. The spring member contacts with the inner shroud body at a position which is not provided with the recessed part to bias the inner shroud to the radial outer side.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Power generation system
abstract_en: To improve power generation efficiency.SOLUTION: A power generation system 100 includes: a fuel cell 1 that generates electricity from hydrogen and oxygen; a combustor 2 that combusts unreacted hydrogen and oxygen supplied from the fuel cell 1 to generate water vapor therein; and a steam turbine 3 that operates using the water vapor supplied from the combustor 2 and drives a generator 4.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Traveling vehicle
abstract_en: To provide a traveling vehicle capable of enhancing the degree of freedom of a layout for mounting an air cleaner.SOLUTION: A traveling vehicle includes a prime mover, an air cleaner that removes dust from air and supplies the air to the prime mover, the air cleaner having an opening / closing lid, and a support device that includes a turning support shaft disposed on a side opposite to the opening / closing lid of the air cleaner and supports the air cleaner turnably around the turning support shaft so that a direction of the opening / closing lid can be changed.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 16

title_en: Intake manifold and intake system
abstract_en: To provide an intake manifold and an intake system capable of simplifying a structure, reducing the number of parts, simplifying assembling work, and reducing cost.SOLUTION: A resin intake manifold applied to an engine includes a surge tank (St) defining an internal space (Is) for temporarily storing intake air, an intake port (120), and a flange portion (140) for attaching a throttle body around the intake port, a plurality of branch pipes (Bp) integrally formed with the surge tank and including a cylindrical fitting portion (120) in each tip end region, and a connecting portion (Jp) integrally formed with the plurality of branch pipes so as to connect the plurality of branch pipes to each other on an upstream side of the cylindrical fitting portion.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Hybrid Air Conditioning System
abstract_en: To miniaturize a hybrid air conditioning system.SOLUTION: The hybrid air-conditioning system includes a refrigerant circuit in which an indoor heat-exchanger and an outdoor heat-exchanger are provided, a motor generator 21 in which MG shaft gears 232, are provided on a rotating shaft 211, an engine 20 in which EG shaft gears 231, are provided on an outputting shaft 201, and compressors 22 in which CP shaft gears 221a, 221b are provided on inputting shafts 233a, 233b and which are operated by supplying a driving force to the inputting shafts 221a, 221b to circulate a refrigerant in the refrigerant circuit. The engine and the compressors 22a and 22b are disposed on one side in a direction parallel to the EG shaft gears, and the motor generator is disposed on a side opposite to the one side.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Heavy door
abstract_en: To provide a heavy door capable of suppressing an increase in force required for operation of a handle even if an extension length of a rod is increased and a reaction force received from a pressing pin is increased.SOLUTION: The heavy door 1 includes a door frame provided in an opening Wa and a door body 2 capable of opening and closing the opening Wa, the door body 2 is displaceable between an open state and a closed state, and the heavy door 1 further includes a pressing means for bringing the door body 2 into close contact with the door frame. The pressing means has a rod 50 capable of advancing and retreating from the door body 2 by the operation of a handle 9, and a pressing pin 53 fixed to the door frame, and the rod 50 is extended in the direction of the door frame by the operation of the handle 9, and an inclined surface 50a formed on the rod 50 abuts on the pressing pin 53, so that the door body 2 is pressed in the direction of the sealed state, and the inclined surface 50a is formed so that the angle between the tangent to the rod 50 and the axial line of the rod 50 becomes smaller as the rod 50 is extended.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 8

title_en: Control device for internal combustion engine
abstract_en: To appropriately suppress torque of an internal combustion engine.SOLUTION: The control device 100 includes a spark ignition type internal combustion engine 1 having a throttle valve 14 and an ignition plug 16 and supplied with alcohol fuel containing alcohol, and a control part 20 controlling intake air quantity and ignition timing of the internal combustion engine 1 by controlling operation of the throttle valve 14 and the ignition plug 16. The control part 20 controls the operation of the throttle valve 14 so as to perform intake air amount limitation for limiting the opening of the throttle valve 14 to a predetermined opening or less when the alcohol concentration of the alcohol fuel is less than a predetermined concentration, and controls the operation of the ignition plug 16 so as to perform ignition timing limitation for limiting the ignition timing to a predetermined ignition timing or more side when the alcohol concentration is the predetermined concentration or more.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Control method for motor of mild hybrid electric vehicle
abstract_en: The object of the present invention is to more effectively protect an engine and improve drivability by preventing in advance the occurrence of abnormal behavior such as fuel injection abnormality or knocking. According to the present invention, a motor control method of a mild hybrid vehicle comprises: an optimal control step of driving the vehicle by determining an output torque sharing ratio of an engine and a motor according to a preset sharing ratio when driver′s required torque is input; an abnormal behavior region learning step of learning driving conditions of the engine in which the engine output decreases due to abnormal behavior while driving the vehicle according to the optimal control step; and a motor torque increasing step of increasing output torque of the motor more than torque determined according to the preset sharing ratio when a driving condition of the engine enters the abnormal behavior region to depart from the abnormal behavior region.

title_en: Oil vapor purification apparatus for turbine generator lubricating oil
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device for purifying oil vapor of lubricating oil of a turbine generator. According to the present invention, the device includes: a supply pipe (P1) which is connected to a lubricating oil tank (10) of a turbine generator and into which oil vapor generated from lubricating oil of the lubricating oil tank (10) flows; a heat exchanger (110) that lowers the temperature of oil vapor supplied from the supply pipe (P1); a first dust collector (120) that collects particles of a first size from the oil vapor passing through the heat exchanger (110) and sends the same to a collection drum (150); a second dust collector (130) that collects particles of a second size from the oil vapor passing through the first dust collector (120) to discharge purified air and sends the collected particles of the second size to the collection drum (150); a blower (140) installed in a pipe at the output end of the second dust collector (130) to forcibly discharge the purified air discharged from the second dust collector (130) to the outside and apply a suction force so that steam is forcibly introduced into the supply pipe (P1); and a collection drum (150) for temporarily storing particles of a first size discharged from the first dust collector (120) and particles of a second size discharged from the second dust collector (130). According to the present invention, a large amount of oil vapor can be quickly and efficiently filtered and purified.

title_en: System and method for maintenance planning in offshore wind farm using deep reinforcement learning
