abstract_en: According to the present disclosure, a maintenance planning method for a marine wind farm comprises: receiving wind turbine information including maintenance period, number of wind turbines requiring maintenance, and a list of the wind turbines requiring maintenance, as well as weather information for the maintenance period; determining an optimal daily maintenance workload that maximizes the total output of the marine wind farm considering the weather information, through reinforcement learning using a first deep neural network, based on the maintenance period and the number of wind turbines requiring maintenance; determining an optimal wind turbine arrangement corresponding to the optimal daily maintenance workload to maximize the total output of the marine wind farm considering the weather information, through reinforcement learning using a second deep neural network, based on the list of wind turbines requiring maintenance; and outputting a maintenance scheduling result based on the optimal daily maintenance workload and the optimal wind turbine arrangement.

title_en: Cryopump with improved regeneration speed
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a cryopump comprises: a refrigerator having a first stage unit and a second stage unit, and cooling the first stage unit and the second stage unit by using a high pressure refrigerant; a second stage panel cooled by the second stage unit and including at least one first fastening unit in at least one array; a first stage panel including a radiation shield which is thermally connected to the first stage unit, surrounds the second stage panel and the first stage unit, and includes a second fastening unit corresponding to the first fastening unit; a housing including a penetration hole in which one side is opened and the other side is combined with the refrigerator, and which corresponds to the second fastening unit; and an expansion unit inserted into the penetration hole, fixed to the first fastening unit and the second fastening unit, and expanded and contracted in a vertical direction to adjust the vertical position of the first stage panel and the second stage panel.

title_en: System Dynamics-Based Reservoir Prediction and Warning Service Method
abstract_en: Provided is a system dynamics-based reservoir prediction and warning service method comprising: a step (S10) for predicting a change in a low water storage capacity according to time; a step (S12) for performing a reservoir flood simulation; a step (S14) for determining whether a standard low water storage capacity is exceeded through a reservoir flood simulation result; a step (S16) for performing monitoring of a reservoir water level change when the standard low water storage capacity is not exceeded in the reservoir flood simulation result; a step (S18) for optimizing inputting and operating timing of an emergency discharge means through correlation analysis between the change in the low water storage capacity and the emergency discharge means; and a step (S20) for issuing a flood warning when the standard low water storage capacity is exceeded even though the emergency discharge is performed, and performing monitoring of the change in the low water storage capacity when the standard low water storage capacity is not exceeded. The present invention supports rapid response by providing a reservoir management entity with the emergency discharge means and operation timing depending on exceeding of the standard low water storage capacity through the prediction of changes in a reservoir water level when extreme rainfall occurs, which can lead to disaster from flooding, thereby effectively preventing reservoir collapse and minimizing damage from the reservoir collapse.

title_en: handy fan with cooler
abstract_en: An object of the present invention is to provide an efficient portable fan capable of increasing cooling performance even in an actual hot environment while reducing weight for carriage. The portable electric fan equipped with a cooling fan comprises: a wing unit generating an air flow while being rotated by a driving unit including a motor driven by power supplied from a battery; a thermoelectric cooling unit including a thermoelectric element driven by power supplied from the battery and lowering the temperature of the air flow generated from the wing unit; a cover unit forming a predetermined inner space for accommodating the motor, the wing unit, and the thermoelectric cooling unit; a grip unit having a predetermined inner space for accommodating the battery; and a steering means inserted into the cover unit and accommodating a predetermined perfume material. According to the present invention, the portable electric fan can improve cooling performance by utilizing the thermoelectric element. In addition, due to an increase in an area in which the support unit is in contact with the ground, the fan can be stably stood on the floor.

title_en: Twin-structured parking lot ventilation and smoke exhaust manned fan capable of automatically restoring direction and horizontal angle when fire is detected
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fan for ventilating and discharging smoke in a parking lot of a twin structure capable of automatically restoring a direction and a horizontal angle when a fire is detected. Accordingly, the technical gist of the present invention is to enable one manned fan to perform both ventilation and smoke discharge. In a general ventilation mode setting, a ventilation system determined in accordance with indoor ventilation regulations of a parking lot is operated, and when a fire is detected, an outlet of the manned fan is immediately rotated or tilted toward an exhaust fan side in the parking lot to promote quick and rapid smoke discharge, thereby minimizing personnel accidents or object accidents (vehicle fires, etc.) caused by the fire.

title_en: Reactivity calculation apparatus for nuclear power generation, calculation method thereof, and computer program for executing the calculation method
abstract_en: Disclosed is an apparatus for calculating reactivity of nuclear power generation, which comprises: a communication device; a memory storing one or more instructions; and a processor executing the one or more instructions stored in the memory. The processor executes the one or more instructions to (a) receive a first current signal, which measures a state of a first position of a nuclear reactor for nuclear power generation, a plurality of times designated through a first digital ammeter, (b) receive a second current signal, which measures a state of a second position of the nuclear reactor, the plurality of times designated through a second digital ammeter, and (c) calculate reactivity of the nuclear reactor based on the current signals received the plurality of times from the first digital ammeter and the second digital ammeter, wherein operations (a) and (b) are performed in parallel, the plurality of times designated is the number of times the first digital ammeter and the second digital ammeter can be measured within a designated time, and the designated time is the time required for the processor to calculate the reactivity. In addition, various embodiments identified through the specification are possible.

title_en: Apparatus for removing polyvinyl alcohol and method for producing polarizer
abstract_en: A polyvinyl alcohol removal apparatus (100) has a liquid outlet (10out), a bubble column (10) for supplying bubbles to a polyvinyl alcohol-containing liquid, a liquid discharge line (L1) connected to the liquid outlet of the bubble column, a first filter (20) installed in the liquid discharge line, and a first pump (30) installed in the liquid discharge line. The first filter (20) is provided between the first pump (30) and the bubble column (10).

title_en: Fuel Supplying System And Method For Ship
abstract_en: Disclosed are a fuel supply system for a ship and a method thereof, which can reduce the cost of installing separate equipment and contribute to securing space inside the ship. According to the present invention, the fuel supply system for a ship comprises: a cargo compressor compressing boil-off gas generated from liquefied gas stored in the ship; a heating medium circulation line through which a heating medium supplied to the cargo compressor circulates; a fuel supply line through which fuel is supplied from a fuel tank provided in the ship to an engine of the ship; and a heater provided in the fuel supply line to heat the fuel to be supplied to the engine. The heater uses the heating medium of the heating medium circulation line as a heat source.

title_en: Method for controlling operation of construction machine
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method of controlling the operation of a construction machine. The method includes: a key-off signal step of a construction machine by a worker; a confirmation step of confirming a safety condition about whether an operation halt delay is necessary; a first temperature determination step of determining whether the temperature of exhaust gas is no less than a predetermined temperature; a logic operation step of preventing a deterioration of an electronic unit by delaying a halt in operation; a second temperature determination step of determining whether the temperature of the exhaust gas is less than the predetermined temperature; and a step to halt operation. Therefore, in spite of a key-off of a worker during restoration work, a halt in operation is delayed preventing damage to an electronic unit caused by heat from high-temperature exhaust gas.

title_en: Swash-type compressor
abstract_en: According to the present invention, provided is a swash-plate type compressor including: a front housing in which a lug plate, a swash plate combined with the lug plate, and a rotary shaft combined with the lug plate and the swash plate are housed in a swash plate chamber formed therein; a rear housing installed in the rear of the cylinder block, and having a suction chamber and a discharge chamber formed therein to suction and discharge a refrigerant; a cylinder block interposed between the front housing and the rear housing, having a cylinder cavity formed to be connected to the suction chamber, having a block flow path having one side connected to the swash plate and having the other side connected to the discharge chamber, and having a connection flow path formed between the cylinder cavity and the block flow path; and a valve structure installed on the block flow path, and selectively compressed by a refrigerant introduced from the discharge chamber to the block flow path. Therefore, the present invention is capable of selectively controlling the amount of refrigerants bypassed from the swash plate chamber to the suction chamber.

title_en: Designing method for Attemperating device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for designing an overheating reduction device, which reduces the temperature of steam supplied from an evaporator to a turbine, comprising the steps of: preparing a sleeve and a spray nozzle; selecting diameter values of a plurality of spray holes; and calculating a mass flow rate value of a coolant to be sprayed, and calculating the total required number of the spray holes.

title_en: Manufacture of ephemeral based on cooling fuel technology
abstract_en: A high altitude aircraft power plant includes an engine, a two-stage turbocharger with an intercooler and an aftercooler, a cryogenic hydrogen fuel source, and a cooling system comprising a hydrogen heat exchanger. With a ram air cooler cooling a coolant to an adjacent ambient temperature, a heat exchanger is configured to use the coolant to heat the hydrogen and cool the coolant to a temperature below an ambient temperature during high altitude flight. The intercooler and aftercooler, like separate sensors, use a coolant below an ambient temperature. The ram air cooler includes a front portion and a rear portion. The cooling system includes three cooling hoops each comprising only the front portion, only the rear portion, and both portions of the ram air cooler.

title_en: Floating offshore structures and floating offshore power plant having the same
abstract_en: According to the present invention, provided is a floating offshore structure that can be installed regardless of the water depth. The floating offshore structure comprises: first to third columns; a plurality of braces connecting upper ends of the first and second columns and upper ends of the first and third columns; first to third pontoons connecting lower ends of the first to third columns; and first and second auxiliary pontoons installed at lower ends of the second and third columns. A polygonal shape is formed by an imaginary line connecting the columns, the first to third pontoons are arranged to correspond to the lines of the polygonal shape, and the first and second auxiliary pontoons may be installed outside the polygonal shape.

title_en: Rocker arm cap pinball and engine valve train having the same
abstract_en: A rocker arm cap is disclosed. A rocker arm cap according to the present invention includes a body cap which has a concave part to which a pinball is rotatably coupled and differs in diameter in upper and lower parts around a groove provided on the outer circumferential surface thereof; and a cover cap which is provided to cover the upper part of the body cap, has a protrusion on the inner circumferential surface thereof to be coupled to the groove, and is provided in a hollow cylindrical shape opened at the top and bottom. The body cap and the cover cap are made of different materials and the cover cap is made of a rubber material, so that the rocker arm cap has improved durability.

title_en: Vertical type wind generator
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a vertical axis wind turbine. More specifically, in the vertical axis wind turbine including blades extending outwards from a central axis, the blade comprises: a frame; a through hole formed through the frame; and a blind provided above the through hole and covering the through hole. As the blind is rotated by a wind, at least a portion of the through hole is opened or closed.

title_en: Cooling system for hybrid vehicle and contol methd for the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a cooling system of a hybrid vehicle, comprising: an engine; a drive motor; a main water pump for selectively supplying coolant to the engine; a cooling line on which a radiator is provided, the cooling line communicating with the main water pump; a heat-exchange line on which a heat-exchange device is provided, the heat-exchange line communicating with the main water pump; a heater line on which a heater and an exhaust heat recovery device are provided, the heater line communicating with the main water pump; a coolant control valve unit communicating with the engine and selectively supplying the coolant to the cooling line, the heat-exchange line and the heater line; a bypass line for connecting a rear of the exhaust heat recovery device and a front of the heater; an auxiliary water pump for selectively supplying the coolant having passed the exhaust heat recovery device to the front of the heater; an operation state signal part for measuring the operation state of the vehicle and outputting a corresponding signal; and a controller for controlling the operation of the engine, the drive motor, the main water pump, the coolant control valve unit and the auxiliary water pump according to the output signal of the operation state signal part. Therefore, provided are a cooling system of a hybrid vehicle and a control method thereof, wherein damage to an exhaust heat recovery device can be prevented.

title_en: Fuel-saving band
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a function improving band of a vehicle, which is applied to an engine which uses a fuel to improve fuel efficiency, minimizes generation of a smoke, and removes a noise. According to the present invention, an active material of an air or the fuel is detachably mounted on a flexible rubber band. Therefore, the functional improving band of the vehicle according to the present invention can be mounted on a fuel tank or an intake pipe. In addition, the functional improving band of the vehicle is injected into the fuel tank after being used so that activation of the fuel can be continuously maintained. In the rubber band (100) made of a certain width and length, one side surface maintains a flat surface status, and an inner groove (110) is formed on the inside.

title_en: Cleaning apparatus for engine attached device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for cleaning an engine attachment to clean the inside of the engine attachment separated from a vehicle, a ship, or a machine. The apparatus for cleaning an engine attachment according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a steam generator that generates steam; an object-to-be-cleaned support that supports the engine attachment; an inlet adaptor that is detachably coupled to an inlet port of the engine attachment; an supply hose which connects the steam generator and the inlet adaptor; a pressure gauge which is mounted on the inlet adaptor or the supply hose to measure a pressure of the steam supplied to the inlet adaptor; a safety control valve which is mounted on the inlet adaptor or the supply hose to control the supply amount of the steam and whether the steam is supplied to the inlet adaptor; and a pressure adjustment valve which is detachably coupled to a discharge port of the engine attachment to adjust a pressure inside the engine attachment.

title_en: Burner and combustor
abstract_en: Provided are a burner, which can flexibly respond to thermal deformation using a bellows and at the same time suppress damage of the bellows, and a combustor. In the burner with a double pipe structure having an outer cylinder and an inner cylinder, the inner cylinder comprises: a tip side support unit fixed to the outer cylinder; a base side support unit fixed to the outer cylinder; a main body unit supported by the tip side support unit; a bellows interposed between the main body unit and the base side support unit; and a partition member mounted at a position between the tip side support unit and the base side support unit. A second gap smaller than a first gap between the outermost peripheral surface of the bellows and the inner peripheral surface of the outer cylinder is interposed between the outer peripheral surface of the partition member and the inner peripheral surface of the outer cylinder.

title_en: Air compressor for vehicle and method for controlling temperature of the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an air compressor for a vehicle and a temperature control method thereof capable of maintaining an internal temperature and a discharge temperature at an appropriate temperature even in a cold environment. The air compressor for a vehicle comprises: a compressor main body driven by a first motor; a support bracket that supports the compressor main body and can be coupled to a vehicle; and a heat exchanger that is installed on one side of the support bracket and raises the temperature of the outside air to generate hot air and provides hot air to the compressor main body.

title_en: A manufacturing method of 3D-type iodine adsorption filter
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an iodine adsorption filter manufacturing method. The method for manufacturing an iodine adsorption filter absorbs iodine by an adsorbent coated on a filter as radioactive waste liquid including iodine passes through the filter, thereby increasing convenience and efficiency in absorbing the iodine in the radioactive waste liquid.

title_en: ventilator for easy installation and uninstallation
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a ventilator which is easy to install and uninstall. The ventilator comprises: a fan rotating by motor drive; a frame supporting the fan and motor, and having a plurality of protrusions protruding forward around the outer circumference of the front end thereof; and a base plate fixed to an opening of a building structure, and having a plurality of grooved parts provided around a central through-hole communicating with the opening to guide the insertion of the protrusions of the frame. The frame is coupled to the base plate by rotating in one direction so that each of the protrusions is inserted into each of the grooved parts of the base plate, and is released from the coupling to the base plate by rotating in another direction so that each of the protrusions exits from each of the grooved parts of the base plate. Therefore, the ventilator can be simply installed and uninstalled in the opening of the building structure, thereby reducing the inconvenience associated with installation and uninstallation.

title_en: Foot valve assembly and submerged pump system
abstract_en: The present invention improves sealability of a foot valve assembly in a submerged pump system. According to the present invent ion, the foot valve assembly (6, 6A) includes: cylindrical adapters (10, 10A), each of which is fitted to the lower opening end (2b) of a cylindrical pump column (2) in which a pump (5) immersed in a handled liquid (Lg) is housed, and in which an intake port (5a) of the pump is housed; disk-like valve bodies (20, 20A), each of which has a flow passage formation surface (21) located below the lower end surface (10a) of the adapter to form an inflow passage (FL) for letting the handled liquid flow toward the pump with the lower end surface, and opens and closes the lower opening (11a) of the adapter; an energizing member (62) which energizes the valve body toward the adapter; and a one-way valve (50) which is arranged in the inflow passage, and is opened according to the pressure of a fluid with respect to the fluid discharged from the lower opening and is closed with respect to the handled liquid flowing toward the lower opening, when the valve bodies are closed.

title_en: Variable quadrupole magnet system for controlling charged particles
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to simplify the configuration of a conventional electromagnet system and provide a charged particle control technology without residual magnetization. A quadrupole magnet system according to the present invention comprises: a support structure; a moving rail supported by the support structure; a fixing frame movably coupled to the moving rail; and four permanent magnets arranged and fixed at predetermined angles inside the fixing frame to surround an acceleration tube located inside the fixing frame.

title_en: Fuel control device using electrochemical compressor
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fuel control device using an electrochemical hydrogen compressor which comprises: the electrochemical hydrogen compressor including a membrane electrode assembly disposed on a movement path of hydrogen and allows the hydrogen to be moved in a compressed state by an oxidation-reduction reaction according to the application of voltage; and a fuel injection unit provided with a fuel tank where fuel is stored and a pressurizing disk movably installed in the fuel tank, disposed to divide a space in the fuel tank into a fuel storage space where the fuel is stored and a hydrogen inflow space (connected to a discharge port of the electrochemical hydrogen compressor) where the hydrogen is introduced, and moved to the fuel storage space by the pressure of the hydrogen flowing into the hydrogen inflow space to pressurize and discharge the fuel contained in the fuel storage space. The present invention has the effect of enabling long-distance propulsion and obtaining strong propulsion compared to solid fuel.

title_en: Control system for compressor
abstract_en: The present invention provides a compressor control system that prevents coupling between controllers and controls compressor discharge pressure without a flow meter. According to an embodiment of the present invention, a compressor control system comprises: a compression unit which compresses fluid; a supply unit to which the fluid discharged through the compression unit is supplied; an inlet guide vane disposed at an inlet of the compression unit; a surge control valve disposed in a flow path connecting an outlet of the compression unit and the supply unit; and a control unit which controls the inlet guide vane and the surge control valve together.

title_en: A cam for EGR valve and an EGR valve
abstract_en: An object of the present invention is to provide an EGR valve absorbing a part of the impact applied to a roller inside a guide groove of a cam. The present invention comprises: a housing in which a driving motor and a gear unit engaged with a pinion of the driving motor to be interlocked are installed; and a valve unit opening and closing an exhaust flow path formed on one side of the housing. According to the cam for an EGR valve and the EGR valve having the same of the present invention, the cam can absorb at least a part of vibration or impact generated between the guide groove and the roller in a process of relatively moving the cam and the roller.

title_en: System and Method for Recovering Boil-Off Gas of Carbon Dioxide and Liquefied Carbon Dioxide Carrier
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and a method for treating boil-off gas of carbon dioxide, capable of effectively recovering boil-off gas generated by vaporizing liquid carbon dioxide, and a liquefied carbon dioxide carrier including the system for treating boil-off gas of carbon dioxide. According to the present invention, a system for treating boil-off gas of carbon dioxide comprises: a boil-off gas compressor compressing boil-off gas discharged from a carbon dioxide storage tank; a first heat exchanger cooling the compressed boil-off gas compressed in the boil-off gas compressor by heat exchange with liquefied gas supplied as fuel of an engine from a fuel tank; and a second heat exchanger further cooling the compressed boil-off gas compressed in the boil-off gas compressor or the compressed boil-off gas cooled in the first heat exchanger by using the boil-off gas discharged from the carbon dioxide storage tank as a refrigerant to re-liquefy the same.

title_en: Water separator with built-in sterilization function and auto drain
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide an improved water separator that separates moisture contained in compressed air, immediately collects the separated moisture, and automatically discharges the collected moisture. The water separator with a built-in sterilization function and an auto drain comprises: a body (10); a cylindrical water separation chamber (11) communicating with an air inlet (12) through which compressed air is introduced and an air exhaust port (15a) placed opposite to the air inlet port (12); an air discharge pipe (14) for generating a vortex through which compressed air is discharged in a circumferential direction to generate a vortex; a water collection chamber (17) having an inverted cone-shaped inclined inner circumferential surface (171); a partition (18) having a plurality of liquid passage holes (18a); a float (20) having a drop drainage channel (24) on the circumferential surface and a valve packing (25) protruding from the lower center and having an inverted cone shape; a liquid collection space unit (172); and a drainage nipple (31) having a vertical drainage hole (32). The water separator, according to the present invention, has the effect of automatically discharging moisture by separating moisture contained in compressed air and immediately collecting the moisture, thereby promoting rapid moisture removal.

title_en: Vehicle emergency starting device using a step-by-step current increase and decrease technique and a control method thereof
abstract_en: A vehicle battery emergency charging device comprises: a first switch; a capacitor module; a second switch; a boosting part; and a third switch. The first switch connects the battery group to an ignition motor of a vehicle, the capacitor module is connected in parallel with the battery group, the second switch connects the capacitor module to the ignition motor, the boosting part boosts the capacitor module using a current supplied from the battery group, and the third switch connects the battery group and the capacitor module through the boosting part. By the configuration such as thereof, the capacitor module can be charged even when a voltage of the battery group is lower than that of the capacitor module, since the boosting part boosts the voltage of the battery group and supplies to the capacitor module, and the voltage for igniting the vehicle can be supplied even when all of the battery group and the capacitor module are discharged.

title_en: Turbine vane repairing method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for repairing a stator blade comprising: a damaged portion removing step of removing a damaged portion in one of two shrouds; a member arranging step of arranging a deformation suppressing member which is in contact with each of the two shrouds and suppresses a change in a relative position between the two shrouds; a build-up welding step of, after the damaged portion removing step and the member arranging step, performing build-up welding on a removed portion of the one shroud from which the damaged portion has been removed to fill the removed portion; a member removing step of, after the build-up welding step, removing the deformation suppressing member from the stator blade; and a finishing step of polishing at least the surface of the build-up welded portion of the one shroud.

title_en: Tube holding device, tube pump system and tube mounting method
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to easily perform the operation of mounting a tube on a tube pump. The present invention provides a tube holding device (300) for holding a tube (200) mounted on a tube pump, the tube holding device (300) comprising: a first mounting part (310) to which a first tube holding member (210) for holding a first area (A1) of the tube (200) is detachably mounted; a second mounting part (320) to which a second tube holding member (220) for holding a second area (A2) different from the first area (A1) of the tube (200) is detachably mounted; and a support part (330) having a support surface (331) having a substantially semicircular cross-section for supporting a part of an outer peripheral surface (201) of the tube (200) in a third area (A3) between the first area (A1) and the second area (A2) of the tube (200) in a state where the first tube holding member (210) is mounted on the first mounting part (310) and the second tube holding member (220) is mounted on the second mounting part (320).

title_en: Fan
abstract_en: The electric fan comprises: a motor base; and a fan head. A driving member is installed within the motor base. The fan head comprises: a mesh cover structure; and an impeller. The mesh cover structure comprises: a first mesh cover; and a second mesh cover. The impeller comprises: a connecting shaft; and a blade. The blade is positioned within a space formed by the first mesh cover and the second mesh cover. The blade is sleeved around the outside of the connecting shaft. According to the present invention, the stability of the electric fan during operation is improved, noise generated during operation is reduced, and furthermore, user comfort, usability, and the scope of application are expanded.

title_en: Dismantling Radioactive Waste Carrying Container
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a dismantled radioactive waste transport container. The dismantled radioactive waste transport container of the present invention includes a transport container main body and a transport container lid. The transport container main body is composed of a bottom part, a long side part, and a short side part. An edge pillar part of a corner of the transport container main body is composed of an edge pillar, a block welded to both ends of the edge pillar, and upper and lower edge irons. A forklift pocket for moving the transport container along the long side is provided below the bottom part of the transport container main body. A packaging container fixing mechanism for fixing the packaging container is installed on the inner bottom part of the transport container main body. A bolt tab is formed on the upper surfaces of the long side part and the short side part of the transport container main body. The transport container lid is provided with a lifting lug hole on which a lifting lug for lifting is mounted, a bolt hole to which the bolt is fastened, and a cutting part at the edge. The transport container main body and the transport container lid are fastened and coupled by a bolt, which is a fastening element inserted into the bolt hole of the transport container lid, to the bolt tab formed on the upper surfaces of the long side part and the short side part of the transport container main body.

title_en: Power generation towers utilizing prying force
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a power generation tower using a praying load applied between segments of a tower using a piezoelectric element. The power generation tower using a praying load applied between segments of a tower using a piezoelectric element comprises: a plurality of segments connected to each other by flanges to form a tower to be stacked; and a power generation unit inserted into a surface where the flanges connecting the segments face each other and come in contact with each other to use a load applied to the flanges. The power generation unit comprises: a piezoelectric layer formed of a piezoelectric element; a first electrode layer stacked on one surface of the piezoelectric layer; a cushion layer stacked on one surface and the other surface of the piezoelectric layer to prevent the piezoelectric layer from being damaged by the load; a second electrode layer stacked on one surface of the cushion layer; and an insulating layer stacked on a surface of the second electrode layer which does not come in contact with the cushion layer to insulate from the flanges.

title_en: Blade cleaning device for wind power generation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a blade cleaning device for wind power generation, and the blade cleaning device for wind power generation includes: a semi-annular base, wherein the inside of the semi-annular base is fixedly connected with a fixing mechanism; a spraying mechanism, wherein the spraying mechanism is used for spraying the downward rotating blades, and includes a slideway; and a cleaning mechanism, wherein the cleaning mechanism is used for cleaning the outside of blade and scraping off impurities outside the blade, and includes an electric push rod, and the outside of the electric push rod is fixedly connected with a U-shaped frame. The invention relates to the technical field of wind power generation. The blade cleaning device for wind power generation achieves the purpose of improving the use efficiency of equipment

title_en: Cellular tube for replacement of traditional gas-charged cartridges in suction stabilizers.
abstract_en: An annular tube (304) (or other shape) of elastomeric cellular material comprising elastomeric closed cells having gas infused therein is supported by structures protruding from the bottom surface of a suction stabilizer's head (204) and/or by structures within the interior volume of the annular body (200) of the suction stabilizer (104), preferably with spacing between the outer diameter of the annular tube of the cellular material and the inner walls of the suction stabilizer body. The gas-infused closed cell material may thus be employed in new suction stabilizer or pulsation dampener or to retrofit existing suction stabilizers or pulsation dampeners designed for a gas-filled bladder.

title_en: Control method for dispensing a hot fluid and device for dispensing a hot fluid.
abstract_en: Described is a control method for dispensing a hot fluid in a fluid dispensing device (1), which comprises a power supply source (E); a source of fluid (2) to be heated; a feed unit (3) configured for picking up the fluid to be heated; a boiler or heat exchanger (4); a dispensing device (5) configured for dispensing the hot fluid and a data control and processing system (6) which actuates the following steps: a measurement of inlet parameters comprising at least an inlet power value and an inlet temperature of the fluid towards the boiler or heat exchanger (4); a cyclical calculation of a quantity of heat generated which must supply the boiler or heat exchanger (4) and/or a quantity of fluid dispensed; consequent adjustment of the value of heat generated by the boiler or heat exchanger (4) and/or the quantity of fluid dispensed, as a function of the measurements of the inlet parameters and of a wanted or desired value of outlet temperature of the fluid; the above-mentioned measurement, cyclical calculation and adjustment steps are performed simultaneously and in real time during a step of dispensing fluid by the dispensing device (5).

title_en: Device for conversion of wave energy into electrical energy.
abstract_en: The device for conversion of wave energy into electrical energy consists of a supporting structure (300), the first working body (200), an anchor (500) and anchor cables (400). The supporting structure (300) is connected to the anchors (500) by anchor cables (400), while the first working body (200) is slidably connected to the supporting structure (300). The motion transformation system (100) is firmly connected to the supporting structure (300) and comprises rigid gears (101a) and (101b) toothed with gears (103a) and (103b) with rolls on one side while on the other side they are hinged to the first working body (200), on the other side of the gears (103a) and (103b) with the rolls, rigid gears (102a) and (102b) are connected at one end, while their other end is hinged to other working body (600).The gears (103a) and (103b) with rolls are connected by shafts with a multiplier that drives the generator (108) that further produces electricity. The device constructed in this way has the possibility of transport to the place of exploitation, because it floats stably on its own. The anchor system (500) is transported to the place of exploitation using a transport body (700) that also has the ability to float on its own and to submerge.

title_en: Non-electromechanical, pumpless liquid recirculation system for air-cooled condenser and cooler adiabatic pre-cooling system.
abstract_en: A non-electromechanical, pumpless liquid recirculation system for adiabatic pre-cooling and evaporative heat exchange systems featuring an ejector device including motive fluid nozzle and an annular recirculating fluid chamber surrounding the nozzle. Motive make-up liquid under pressure is expelled from the nozzle into a mixing chamber. Recirculating fluid is introduced to and entrained with the motive make-up liquid at the outlet of the nozzle, and the motive force of the make-up liquid forces the combined make-up liquid and recirculating liquid out through the outlet of the ejector device to a water distribution system for the heat exchange system.

title_en: Pump with vacuum, self-priming, and booster functions
abstract_en: Disclosed herein is a pump with vacuum, self-priming, and booster functions, which includes a rotor housing (10), a rotor (20), an upper chamber (60), a lower chamber (70) beneath the rotor housing (10), an inlet check valve (100) and (110), an outlet check valve (120) and (130), and an introduction passage (80) connecting the inlet port (61) of the upper chamber (60) to the lower chamber (70). (Fig. 5)

title_en: A fault estimation method and device for a wind turbine transmission system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a technical field of fault diagnosis, to a fault estimation. method. and. device for a wind turbine transmission system. A fault estimation method for a wind turbine transmission. system, comprising: step 1, constructing' a fault mathematical model for the wind turbine transmission system; step 2, constructing an augmentation system of the fault mathematical model for the wind turbine transmission system; step 3, designing an adaptive rate, and constructing an adaptive unknown input observer; step 4, constructing a state estimation error, a measurement output error, a fault estimation error and the adaptive rate, and obtaining an error dynamic equation; step 5, calculating the gain of the adaptive observer for the unknown input according to a Lyapunov stability theory and a linear matrix inequality method; step 6, inputting state data of the wind turbine transmission system into the target observer. (+ Fig. l)

title_en: Hydraulic water wheel for a directional water flow
abstract_en: A hydraulic water wheel assembly and system where optimum results are obtained based upon factors such as the height of the channel, the distance between water wheels, the diameter of the discs, and the number, size, dimensions, and arrangement of the wing blades.

title_en: Method for producing steam turbine member
abstract_en: Provided is a method for manufacturing a steam turbine member that has extremely excellent smoothness. The method for manufacturing a steam turbine member according to the present invention includes: a clad layer formation step for forming a clad layer on a base material at a site prone to corrosion, using a powder material containing a metal; and a surface heating step for heating/melting the surface of the clad layer.

title_en: Laser system for ignition of fuel mixtures
abstract_en: The invention relates to a laser system for the ignition of fuel mixtures. According to the invention, the system comprises a cylindrical active composite medium having a central hole (3) for cooling during operation and consisting of an active laser medium (1) and a passive switching medium (2) soldered to one another, an optical resonator with a mirror (4) deposited on the free surface of the active laser medium (1) and a mirror (5) for the extraction of the laser radiation deposited onto the free surface of the passive switching medium (2), some laser diodes (6a...6d) coupled to some optical fibers (7a...7d), which deliver radiation (8a...8d) at the pumping wave length, the propagation direction being along the system axis, a set of lenses (9a...9d), which focus each pumping radiation, a system of triangular prisms (10a...10d), which changes the laser pumping radiation propagation direction by 90°, followed by another system of triangular prisms (11a...11d), which changes again the laser radiation propagation direction by 90°, so that each pumping radiation is perpendicular on the mirror (4) and introduced and absorbed in determined areas of the active laser medium (1).

title_en: Mechanical generator gm
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mechanical generator GM, which is an electromechanical system which produces mechanical forces, inside the system, forces capable of moving the system or various mechanical structures attached to the system. According to the invention, the mechanical generator produces a mechanical force which results from the vectorial summation of the inertial forces generated by subassemblies (3, 4, 5 and 6) of mechanisms, shown in fig. 2, the total force generated in the system having the same permanent direction, of a constant value, and the force direction is given by the rotation direction of a drive electromotor (1), explanations on the way this total force is achieved and calculated being given in the invention description.

title_en: Autonomous power unit for starting internal combustion engines
abstract_en:
FIELD: electrical engineering. 
     SUBSTANCE: autonomous power unit for starting internal combustion engines contains a drive motor and a generator connected in series, two current sensors, two capacitive energy storage devices, a control device, two comparison devices, a power supply decoupling unit, a control panel and a switching unit. 
     EFFECT: technical result consists in increasing the efficiency with the sequential start of two or more internal combustion engines. 
     1 cl, 1 dwg

title_en: Iron-oxide portland cement for core catcher of nuclear reactor
abstract_en:
FIELD: cements. 
     SUBSTANCE: invention relates to systems for ensuring localisation of the core melt of water-cooled tank reactors in the event of a beyond design basis accident. The composition of an iron oxide Portland cement contains pre-made Portland cement of a class no lower than 42.5 as a binding substance, iron oxide III is used as an active mineral additive and C-3 superplasticiser is used as a surface-active agent at the following ratio of components, % wt.: Portland cement 30 to 50, iron oxide III 50 to 70, C-3 superplasticiser 1 to 2 over 100% of the rest of the components. The method for preparing an iron oxide cement consists in dry grinding of the components to reach a specific surface area of 7000 to 10000 cm 2 /g, then gauging the resulting mixture with water at a water/cement ratio of 0.16 to 0.25, followed by hardening for 28 days with a compressive strength of at least 20 MPa and apparent density 2.40 to 2.85 g/cm 3 . 
     EFFECT: producing a composition with the maximum possible iron oxide content, the minimum possible content of physically and chemically bound water, reduced water requirement, increased apparent density and a specified compressive strength of no less than 20 MPa. 
     4 cl, 1 tbl

title_en: Engine nozzle with mass expiration
abstract_en:
FIELD: engine production.  
     SUBSTANCE: invention relates to engine production, in particular to the method for operation and the design of nozzles with the expiration of masses for various engines. The nozzle of the engine with the expiration of the masses contains a narrow and wide part. The nozzle on the narrow side has inlet openings leading to the channels for supplying the flow of liquid or gas, which lead to spiral grooves inside the nozzle. At the same time, the winding pitch of the turns of the spiral grooves is constantly increasing, as the nozzle diameter increases. The angle of inclination of the turns relative to the horizon is the same, along the entire length of the nozzle grooves.  
     EFFECT: use of the invention makes it possible to increase the thrust of a jet, turbojet or water jet engine, as well as a screw propeller by using the centrifugal force of gas or liquid flows along spiral grooves inside the nozzle.  
     1 cl, 5 dwg

title_en: An electric power-generating device and method of operating such a device
abstract_en: An electric power-generating device, comprising a first container (1), a second container (2), a first channel (3), extending from the first container (1) to the second container, a second channel (5), extending from the first channel (3) or from the first container (1) to the second container, said second channel having a first branch (6) and a second branch (7), wherein each of said first branch and second branch ends in the second container, and a first nozzle (9) arranged at the end of the first branch ending in the second container, and a second nozzle (10) arranged at the end of the second branch ending in the second container. The first nozzle sprays finely dispersed droplets of a liquid that hits a first wall (16) of the second container, and the second nozzle sprays finely dispersed droplets of a liquid into an open space in the second container.

title_en: A fuel system module for hand-held powertools
abstract_en: An integrally formed fuel system module (200, 300, 400, 600) for a crankcase scavenged two-stroke combustion engine (110), the module comprising an input aperture (330) for allowing a flow of clean air into the fuel system module,one or more airhead channel apertures (380) arranged to interface with respective airhead channels (310, 320) for guiding clean air out from the fuel system module,a fuel and air mixture aperture (390) arranged to interface with a conduit (260) for guiding a fuel and air mixture out from the fuel system module,a throttle valve (250) arranged to control the flow of clean air from the input aperture (330) to the one or more airhead channel apertures (380) and to the fuel and air mixture aperture (390), anda fuel injector seat arranged to receive a fuel injector (230), where an aperture into the conduit (260) for guiding the fuel and air mixture out from the fuel system module is formed in connection to the fuel injector seat.

title_en: Wind power generator
abstract_en: Provided is a wind power generator that can make an improvement for achieving both a sufficient amount of power generation and reduction of the load acting on the wind power generator. A wind power generator has a normal operation mode and a low-load operation mode, and operates in the low-load operation mode when wind condition data exceeds a threshold of transitioning from the normal operation mode to the low-load operation mode, wherein once the wind condition data exceeds a normal transition threshold and a transition from the normal operation mode to the low-load operation mode occurs, the transition threshold is reduced for a predetermined period of time.

title_en: Assembly and method for installing a pile into a seabed
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an assembly for installing a pile in a seabed, the assembly comprising a vessel comprising a positioning system for keeping the vessel at an installation location relative to the seabed, the positioning system having a positioning stiffness; a pile guiding system configured to guide the pile during installation thereof, the pile guiding system comprising a base provided on the vessel; a first guiding device connected to the base, the first guiding device being configured to accommodate the pile during installation thereof; a resilient member for providing a resilient connection between the vessel and the pile during installation thereof for allowing relative motions between the pile and the vessel, the resilient member having a connection stiffness, wherein the resilient member is configured and intended to keep a natural period of a pivoting movement of the pile about the seabed caused by waves during installation thereof longer than a dominant wave period of a wave spectrum at the installation location by providing the resilient connection with a low connection stiffness.

title_en: Method of adjusting volume of air chamber
abstract_en: An airflow-generating device with adjustable air chamber and a method of adjusting volume of air chamber thereof are provided. The device comprises an adjustable air chamber and an airflow-generating unit. The adjustable air chamber has an inlet structure, an outlet structure, and an adjustment unit. A deflector structure for adjusting pressure or direction of airflow is arranged in the outlet structure, and an air chamber space is formed between the inlet structure and the outlet structure. The adjestment unit is used to adjust an inlet-outlet distance between the inlet structure and the outlet structure for adjusting a volume of the air chamber. The airflow-generating unit is arranged in the adjustable air chamber and used to generate the airflow introduced from the inlet structure into the air chamber space and exhausted form the outlet structure. The present disclosed example can increase the intensity of the airflow or reduce the noise of the airflow according to the user demand.

title_en: Centrifugal fan
abstract_en: A centrifugal fan is provided. The centrifugal fan comprises a shaft and a plurality of fans. These fans are disposed on the shaft and surrounds the shaft. The outer edges of these fans define a circle, and the circle has an outer region adjacent to the boundary of the circle. The fan has a first line shape and a second line shape within the outer region. Two neighboring fans have an air channel therebetween, which is expanded toward the outer edge of the fan according to an interval expanding ratio.

title_en: An electromagnetic rotary drive, a centrifugal pump and a pump unit
abstract_en: An electromagnetic rotary drive designed as an internal rotor is proposed, with a rotor (3) comprising a ring-shaped or disk-shaped magnetically effective core (31) which is surrounded by a radially externally arranged stator (2), wherein the stator (2) has a plurality of stator poles (21) which are arranged around the magnetically effective core (31) and each of which in each case is delimited by an end face (211) facing the magnetically effective core (31) of the rotor (3), wherein the stator (2) is designed as a bearing and drive stator, by means of which the rotor (3) can be magnetically driven without contact in the operating state about a desired axis of rotation which defines an axial direction (A), and by means of which the rotor (3) can be magnetically levitated without contact with respect to the stator (2), wherein the rotor (3) is actively magnetically levitated in a radial plane (E) perpendicular to the axial direction (A) and is passively magnetically stabilized in the axial direction (A) and against tilting. The magnetically effective core (31) of the rotor (3) has a rotor height (HR) which is the maximum extension of the magnetically effective core (31) in the axial direction (A), wherein the rotor height (HR) is greater than a stator pole height (HS) which is defined by the maximum extension of the end faces (211) of the stator poles (21) in the axial direction (A). Furthermore, a centrifugal pump having such a rotary drive (1) and a pump unit are proposed by the invention.

title_en: Physical distribution simulation system
abstract_en: A physical distribution simulation system is provided. The physical distribution simulation system enables simulation of future physical distribution from storage to transport of waste generated with dismantling a nuclear power facility. The physical distribution simulation system including: an input unit that inputs predetermined information regarding waste generated over time in a dismantling step of a structure to be dismantled; a calculation unit that calculates a storage step indicating a storage state of the waste, in a predetermined period from generation of the waste to transport of the waste to an inside of premises or outside of the premises on the basis of the predetermined information; and a display unit that displays a display image visualizing information indicating a change over time of the storage step in the predetermined period.

title_en: Equipment and manufacturing method
abstract_en: Manufacturing equipment item (1), in particular for semi-conductor components, LEDs or flat screens, comprising at least two process chambers (2a, 2b, 2c, ... 2n) and the same number of turbomolecular vacuum pumps (3a, 3b, 3c, ... 3n) which are fluidically connected to a respective process chamber (2a, 2b, 2c, ... 2n) via respective first isolation valves (4a, 4b, 4c, ... 4n), characterized in that it further comprises: - at least one group of two process rough-vacuum pumps (5a, 5b), the inlets of the process rough-vacuum pumps (5a, 5b) of the group being fluidically connected via respective second isolation valves (6a, 6b) to a common pipe (7) which is fluidically connected to the outlets of the turbomolecular vacuum pumps (3a, 3b, 3c, ... 3n), all the outlets of the turbomolecular vacuum pumps (3a, 3b, 3c, ... 3n) being fluidically connected to the two process rough-vacuum pumps (5a, 5b) of at least one group and - a service rough-vacuum pump (8) which is fluidically connected to the process chambers (2a, 2b, 2c, ... 2n) of the equipment item (1) via respective third isolation valves (9a, 9b, 9c, ... 9n).

title_en: Fan brake mechanism
abstract_en: A fan brake mechanism includes a fan unit and a brake unit. The fan unit includes a frame and fan blades. The frame includes a vertically extending shaft barrel, and the fan blades are vertically mounted on a shaft with a pivot portion positioned within the shaft barrel. The brake unit includes a brake base and a brake module. The brake base is provided with brake pawls, and the brake module includes a body portion, at least one movable member accommodated within the body portion, and a limit pin corresponding to the movable member. The body portion includes a through groove that engages with the pivot portion, allowing the brake module to pivot on the shaft. A limit slot corresponding to the limit pin is positioned between the claw portion and the wind resistor, enabling the movable member to move within the body portion.

title_en: Power generation control method for idle stop-start system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a power generation control method for an idle stop-start system. The idle stop-start system includes a battery system, a starter generator control system, an engine fuel injection control system, an engine with a crankshaft and a throttle. The starter generator control system includes starter generator controller and a starter generator device. The starter generator controller is electrically connected to the battery system and the starter generator device respectively. The engine fuel injection control system is connected to the starter generator controller by communication. The starter generator device is arranged coaxially with the crankshaft, and the engine fuel injection control system is electrically connected to the battery system and the engine respectively. As such, through the power generation control method of the idle stop-start system of the present invention, when the user needs power while riding, starter generator control system can provide driving torque in a timely manner to help the engine accelerate, thereby achieving the overall vehicle power better performance.

title_en: Passive venting arrangement for venting of gases from radioactive materials and containment vessel for storing such materials
abstract_en:
A passive venting arrangement for use in venting of gases produced by radioactive materials includes a source gas region for receiving the gases produced by the radioactive materials; a filter ullage region disposed above the source gas region and segregated therefrom except for a plurality of bore holes which each extend between, and fluidly couple, the source gas region and the filter ullage region; and a plurality of filters disposed in contact with the filter ullage region, wherein each 
filter is structured to provide for the exchange of gases from the filter ullage region through the filter to an ambient environment.

title_en: Rotor cap for turbomolecular vacuum pump
abstract_en:
A rotor cap for a turbo molecular vacuum pump is disclosed. The rotor cap comprises a cover element and a connection element, wherein the side wall and the top surface of the cover element are curved smoothly, and the connection element comprises an extension rod and a hardness and weight adjusting element. The first end of the extension rod is connected to the bottom center of the cover element, the second end of the extension rod is extended in a direction away from the cover element to be adjacent to a rotor shaft, and the hardness and weight adjusting element is connected between the second end of the extension rod and the rotor shaft to reduce the hardness difference between the extension rod 
and the rotor shaft and to provide a counterweight effect to reduce the rotational vibration of the cover element.

title_en: Vacuum pumping system, fluid routing module for the vacuum pumping system, and method for operating the fluid routing module for the vacuum pumping system
abstract_en:
A fluid routing module (112) for a vacuum pumping system, the fluid routing module (112) comprising: a first fluid inlet (110a); a second fluid inlet (110b); a fluid outlet (114); a first fluid line (200) 
coupled between the first fluid inlet (110a) and the fluid outlet (114); a second fluid line (202) coupled between the second fluid inlet (110b) and the fluid outlet (114); a first restrictor (204) configured to restrict a flow of the fluid therethrough, the first restrictor (204) being disposed along the first fluid line (200); a vacuum pump (210) disposed along the second fluid line (202); and one or more valves (206, 212, 214) configured to selectably direct a fluid flow through either the first fluid line (200) or the second fluid line (202).

title_en: Fuel injection valve
abstract_en: Disclosed is a slurry fuel injector valve, comprising: a fuel outlet valve through which slurry fuel is able to exit the slurry fuel injector valve towards a combustion chamber of an engine; a pump cavity; a pump element that divides the pump cavity into a pump chamber and an actuation chamber; a fuel conduit through which slurry fuel is flowable from the pump chamber to the fuel outlet valve; and an actuation fluid conduit through which actuation fluid is flowable from the actuation chamber to the fuel outlet valve.

title_en: Balancer device for internal combustion engine
abstract_en: There is provided a balancer device for an internal combustion engine that suppresses lubricating oil from failing onto a reduction gear and a pump drive gear provided to drive and rotate an oil pump and thereby suppresses an increase in resistance against rotation between the reduction gear and the pump drive gear. The balancer device for the internal combustion engine includes a lower side housing on which a balancer drive gear, a first balancer shaft including a first balance weight, a first gear, a second gear, a second balancer shaft including a second balance weight, and the reduction gear are mounted. The balancer device also includes an upper side housing formed in such a shape that covers the balancer drive gear, the first balancer shaft including the first balance weight, the first gear, the second gear, the second balancer shaft including the second balance weight, the reduction gear, and the pump drive gear from above in the state that the oil pump is assembled with the upper side housing such that the pump drive gear is meshed with the reduction gear. The upper side housing is assembled with the lower side housing. The balancer device further includes an exposure opening formed in the upper side housing such that only the balancer drive gear is exposed from the upper side housing to be meshed with an engine-side gear.

title_en: Quaternary ammonium amide and/or ester salts
abstract_en: The invention relates to quaternary ammonium amide and/or ester salts and their use as additives, including their use in fuels, such as diesel fuel. The invention particularly relates to the use of quaternary ammonium amide and/or ester salts as detergents in diesel fuels.

title_en: Fan
abstract_en: A fan comprising a polyamide resin composition containing a polyamide resin, a plasticizer in an amount of 7 parts by mass or more and 35 parts by mass or less, and one or more components selected from the group consisting of plate-like fillers and acicular fillers in an amount of 15 parts by mass or more and 80 parts by mass or less, based on 100 parts by mass of the polyamide resin. The fan of the present invention can be suitably used in, for example, manufactured articles, such as audio equipment such as speakers, television, radio cassette recorders, headphones, audio components, or microphones, electric appliances, transportation vehicles, construction buildings, and industrial equipment, or parts thereof.

title_en: Method for repairing a component by additive manufacturing
abstract_en: A method for repairing a component is disclosed. The method includes removing a portion originally including a plurality of cooling holes, of the component to form a cavity, forming by additive manufacturing a replacement portion including a plurality of cooling holes, and varying a surface roughness and a diameter of at least one cooling hole of the plurality of cooling holes during the forming by additive manufacturing the replacement portion. The replacement portion replaces the portion of the component.

title_en: Combustion and thermal management strategies using variable valve timing
abstract_en: A system and method for thermal management of an aftertreatment component are described. The disclosed method can employ any one or combination of operating modes that obtain a target condition of the exhaust gas to support or initiate thermal management of the aftertreatment device.

title_en: CRDM internal electrical connector and method of use thereof
abstract_en: A method including providing an internal control rod drive mechanism (CRDM) including an electric motor and a support surface including sealed electrical connectors electrically connected with the electric motor to deliver electrical power to the electrical motor, installing the internal CRDM inside a nuclear reactor, the installing including placing the support surface of the internal CRDM onto a support element inside the nuclear reactor, the placing causing sealed electrical connectors disposed on the support element to mate with the sealed electrical connectors on the support surface of the internal CRDM, wherein the nuclear reactor contains coolant water and the installing is performed with the internal CRDM submerged in the coolant water and the seals of the sealed electrical connectors of the internal CRDM and the support element are effective to prevent coolant water ingress into the sealed electrical connectors.

title_en: Low disturbance cryocooler compressor
abstract_en: A compressor assembly for use with a Pulse Tube cryocooler is disclosed. The compressor assembly includes a central hub having a plurality of faces, and at least four compressor modules mounted on the central hub. Each of the compressor modules is mounted on a face of the plurality of faces. Each compressor module comprises a piston mounted in the central hub and configured to reciprocate along an axis of travel within the central hub. The pistons are mounted head-to-head with each other and collective reciprocation of the pistons along the respective axes minimizes vibration forces of the compressor assembly in X, Y, and Z translational axes of motion.

title_en: Flow-diverting systems for gas turbine air separator
abstract_en: A flow diverter for an air separator of a gas turbine includes a cylindrical body configured to fit within a cooling hole of the air separator. One or more air flow vents are defined through and around a partial circumference of the cylindrical body. A bottom panel closes the cylindrical body at one end. A mounting flange surrounds the cylindrical body at an open end and extends radially outward from the cylindrical body. When the flow diverter is installed, air flows through the open end in a radial direction and exits through the air flow vents in an axial direction. The cylindrical body may include a collapsible region that collapses to engage the air separator and prevent the flow diverter from being dislodged. The air separator may additionally or alternately include supplemental cooling holes in a recessed area proximate to its mounting flange.

title_en: Engine controller
abstract_en: A controller for an engine estimates a temperature of the exhaust gas and controls the engine according to the estimated exhaust temperature. The controller changes the air-fuel ratio to a stoichiometric air-fuel ratio or leaner. The controller calculates the progress of combustion on the basis of signals of sensors, and estimates an exhaust temperature. In the case where the air-fuel ratio is the stoichiometric air-fuel ratio, the controller estimates the exhaust temperature on the basis of the progress of the combustion, the engine temperature, and a first relationship that is at least defined between the progress of the combustion and the exhaust temperature, . In the case where the air-fuel ratio is lean, the controller estimates the exhaust temperature on the basis of the progress of the combustion, the engine temperature, and a second relationship that differs from the first relationship.

title_en: Exhaust gas system with preconditioning
abstract_en: A method and a corresponding apparatus are provided for preconditioning an exhaust gas system ( 100 ) for discharging and purifying combustion exhaust gases of an internal combustion engine ( 1 ), in particular an internal combustion engine ( 1 ) of a motor vehicle ( 200 ). The method includes operating, air being heated by a heating element ( 8 ) in the exhaust gas system ( 100 ) to heat air in the exhaust gas system ( 100 ), operating a fan in the exhaust gas system ( 100 ) for producing a hot air stream with the heated air, using the hot air stream for heating a first catalytic converter ( 7 ) of the exhaust gas system ( 100 ) to a minimum operating temperature.

title_en: Air compressor
abstract_en: Provided is an air compressor which helps to attain a proper discharge air temperature and which is superior in energy saving property. There are provided an air line connecting an air compressor, an oil separator, and an after cooler; an oil circulation line connecting the air compressor, the oil separator, and an oil cooler; a bearing oil supply line connecting one end of an intermediate branching portion disposed at an intermediate point of the oil circulation line between the oil cooler and the air compressor to a bearing oil supply portion of the air compressor; an intermediate portion oil supply line connecting the other end of the intermediate branching portion to an intermediate oil supply portion of the air compressor; a branching line supplying oil to the bearing oil supply portion and the intermediate oil supply portion; a blower sending air to the oil cooler and the after cooler; a bypass line connecting one end of a bypass branching portion disposed at an intermediate point of the oil circulation line between the oil separator and the oil cooler to the downstream side of the oil cooler of the bearing oil supply line; and a control valve controlling the inflow amount of the lubricating oil to the bypass line.

title_en: Deep reinforcement learning for air handling control
abstract_en: An engine system includes an air handling control unit which controls a plurality of air handling actuators responsible for maintaining flow of air and exhaust gas within the engine system. The engine system has a plurality of sensors whose sensor signals at least partially define a current state of the engine system. The air handling control unit includes a controller which controls the air handling actuators of the engine system as well as a processing unit coupled to the sensors and the controller. The processing unit includes an agent which learns a policy function that is trained to process the current state, determines a control signal to send to the controller by using the policy function after receiving the current state as an input, and outputs the control signal to the controller. Then, the agent receives a next state and a reward value from the processing unit and updates the policy function using a policy evaluation algorithm and a policy improvement algorithm based on the received reward value. Subsequently, the controller controls the air handling actuators in response to receiving the control signal. In one aspect of the embodiment, the control signal is a command signal for the air handling actuators.

title_en: Low ambient operation of HVAC system
abstract_en: A heating, ventilation, and/or air conditioning (HVAC) system has a refrigerant circuit that includes a compressor, a condenser system with a first set of tubes and a second set of tubes fluidly separate from the first set of tubes within the condenser system, and a valve positioned downstream of the compressor and upstream of the second set of tubes relative to a direction of refrigerant flow through the refrigerant circuit, in which the refrigerant circuit is configured to direct refrigerant through the first set of tubes and through the second set of tubes. The HVAC system further has a switch configured to detect an operating parameter and to instruct the valve to close based on the operating parameter such that refrigerant flow is blocked through the second set of tubes and refrigerant flow is enabled through the first set of tubes.

title_en: Ram air turbine actuators having damping
abstract_en: A ram air turbine (RAT) actuator piston can include a body defining a piston structure having an inner cavity. The piston can include one or more damping holes axially defined through the body to the inner cavity and a lock rod hole defined axially through the body to the inner cavity. The lock rod hole can have a larger flow area than one or more of the one or more damping holes. The lock rod hole can be configured to receive a lock rod of a RAT actuator to at least partially block flow through the lock rod hole when the lock rod is in a locked position. The one or more damping holes can be configured to allow flow through the damping holes in the locked position to allow the RAT actuator piston to move within the RAT actuator in the locked position to dissipate vibratory loads.

title_en: Coating systems including infiltration coatings and reactive phase spray formulation coatings
abstract_en: A method includes applying an infiltration coating on a thermal barrier coating of an article. The infiltration coating infiltrates at least some pores of the thermal barrier coating. The infiltration coating decomposes within the at least some pores of the thermal barrier coating to coat a portion of the at least some pores of the thermal barrier coating. The infiltration coating reduces a porosity of the thermal barrier coating. The method also includes applying a reactive phase spray formulation coating on the thermal barrier coating. The reactive phase spray formulation coating reacts with dust deposits on the thermal barrier coating.

title_en: Controlled gap seal with surface discontinuities
abstract_en: There is disclosed a controlled gap seal for a gas turbine engine. The seal has a ring annularly and continuously extending about a central axis. A runner that is configured for rotation about the central axis and rotatable relative to the ring. The runner has a face facing a face of the ring. The face of the ring is spaced apart from the face of the runner by a gap. Surface discontinuities are circumferentially distributed around the central axis. The surface discontinuities are located at specific locations and distributed in specific ways. A method of using the controlled gap seal is disclosed.

title_en: Inlet guide vane assembly of gas turbine and gas turbine
abstract_en: An inlet guide vane assembly of gas turbine is disclosed. The inlet guide vane assembly includes: a plurality of inlet guide vanes, each including a fixing shaft disposed at the end away from a fixing part; and a fixing assembly including a support ring, a fixing ring and an abutting member. The fixing ring includes a fixing wall facing towards a support part, the fixing wall forming, in cooperation with a support wall, a plurality of accommodating cavities corresponding to the plurality of inlet guide vanes. The fixing shafts are rotatably inserted into the accommodating cavities, and the abutting member is in interference fit with the inner inlet casing and the fixing ring. The inlet guide vane assembly implements support for the inlet guide vanes without affecting installation of the inlet guide vanes.

title_en: Vehicle start and stop control based on seat heater actuation
abstract_en: Systems and methods for managing auto start of a vehicle during an auto-stop condition may include determining an operational status of a vehicle climate control system; receiving a target air outlet temperature from the vehicle climate control system; receiving data indicating a state of a heated seat of the vehicle; and inhibiting a start-vehicle command to restart the vehicle because of a cabin heating requirement when the data indicates that the heated seat of the vehicle is activated.

title_en: Method and system for detecting an abnormal engine start
abstract_en: Herein provided are methods and systems for detecting an abnormal engine start of a gas turbine engine. An inter-turbine temperature of the engine is measured during engine start. The inter-turbine temperature is compared to an inter-turbine temperature threshold which depends on at least one additional parameter. An abnormal engine start is detected when the inter-turbine temperature exceeds the threshold. The at least one additional parameter may comprise engine rotational speed. The at least one additional parameter may comprise time.

title_en: Wind turbine transmission
abstract_en: A wind turbine transmission includes a high-speed spur gear stage which includes a HSS spur gear and an HSS pinion meshing therewith on a HSS pinion shaft. The HSS spur gear is directly mounted in a transmission housing of the wind turbine transmission. A sun gear shaft of a transmission stage, which is mounted upstream of the high-speed spur gear stage, is directly coupled to the HSS spur gear.

title_en: Control apparatus for vehicle
abstract_en: A control apparatus for a vehicle includes an input-rotation limiting portion configured, when the vehicle starts running and is accelerated, to calculate an estimated speed value that is a speed value of an input rotational speed of an automatic transmission upon elapse of a predetermined length of time, and to calculate an estimated force value that is a force value of a piston pressing force acting on a piston in a forward direction in a released engagement device upon the elapse of the predetermined length of time, based on a centrifugal hydraulic pressure in a pressure chamber of the released engagement device and the centrifugal hydraulic pressure in a canceller chamber of the released engagement device. When the estimated force value is not smaller than a predetermined threshold, the input-rotation limiting portion restrains an increase of the input rotational speed.

title_en: Anti-scatter grid for radiation detector
abstract_en: An anti-scatter grid, a detector with such an anti-scatter grid and a radiation imaging system including such a detector with an anti-scatter grid are provided. The anti-scatter grid includes at least one grid wall. The parameters of the grid wall may be adjusted to arrive a uniform scatter-to-primary ratio. The parameters of the grid wall comprise thickness, height, shape, or position of the grid wall, or width of interspace between two grid walls. The detector includes the anti-scatter grid, at least one photosensor, and at least one scintillator. The radiation system includes a radiation generator, a radiation detector with the anti-scatter grid, and a processor.

title_en: Ultra high vacuum cryogenic pumping apparatus with nanostructure material
abstract_en: Cryogenic pump apparatuses include nanostructure material to achieve an ultra-high vacuum level. The nanostructure material can be mixed with either an adsorbent material or a fixed glue layer which is utilized to fix the adsorbent material. The nanostructure material's good thermal conductivity and adsorption properties help to lower working temperature and extend regeneration cycle of the cryogenic pumps.
