title_en: Dyeing process of polyester cloth
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dyeing process of polyester cloth, which comprises the following steps: s1: desizing the grey cloth. S2: pre-shrinking the grey cloth; s3: flattening the cloth after shaping by using a flattening machine; s4: pre-setting the flattened cloth, guiding the cloth into a setting machine by a cloth feeding machine in the pre-setting process, and pre-setting the cloth by using a setting liquid which comprises the following substances in parts by weight: 20-30 parts of a softening agent; 30-40 parts of disodium hydrogen phosphate; 70-80 parts of a plasticizer; 10-20 parts of glyceryl tristearate; 30-34 parts of polytetrafluoroethylene particles; s5: performing alkali decrement treatment on the pre-shaped cloth; s6: shaping the fabric warp after the alkali decrement is finished; s7: dyeing the cloth after the medium sizing; s8: carrying out post-shaping treatment on the dyed cloth by using a shaping liquid by using a shaping machine; and obtaining the finished fabric through the eight steps. The invention has the advantage of improving the shaping effect of the polyester cloth.

title_en: Antibacterial polyester industrial yarn and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an antibacterial polyester industrial yarn and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: carrying out melt spinning on the high-viscosity polyester melt containing the antibacterial powder to prepare the antibacterial polyester industrial yarn; during melt spinning, the shearing rate at a spinneret orifice is 1700-3000 s ‑1 The temperature of the four rollers and the temperature of the five rollers are 225-235 ℃ and 135-150 ℃ respectively; the content of the antibacterial powder in the finally prepared antibacterial polyester industrial yarn on the surface layer of the antibacterial polyester industrial yarn is 5-10 wt% higher than that of the antibacterial polyester industrial yarn, namely the antibacterial powder is enriched on the surface of the antibacterial polyester industrial yarn, so that the effect of the antibacterial powder can be fully exerted, and meanwhile, the addition amount of the antibacterial powder can be reduced, further, the mechanical property of the antibacterial polyester industrial yarn and the breaking strength of the antibacterial polyester industrial yarn are improved>6.5cN/dtex, elongation at break of 12.5% -20%. The method is simple, and the prepared antibacterial polyester industrial yarn has excellent antibacterial performance and better mechanical property.

title_en: Efficient laser marking material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-efficiency laser marking material, the addition amounts of a laser auxiliary agent and black master batch in a formula system of the high-efficiency laser marking material provided by the invention play a leading role in the printing effect, the mechanical property of the material is not changed greatly along with the increase of the content of the laser auxiliary agent and the reduction of the content of carbon black, but the printing effect is obviously improved. In addition, the laser assistant can assist in improving the absorption of the black PE material to the special wavelength emitted by the laser, so that the polymer surface layer is carbonized, and white appears through foaming, which is in sharp contrast with the black PE sheath.

title_en: Full-automatic clothing template sewing process based on machine identification
abstract_en: The invention provides a sewing process based on machine identification and full-automatic clothes template, which comprises a clothes piece automatic feeding process, a clothes piece automatic sewing process and a clothes piece automatic material taking process, wherein a clothes piece pattern matching process is also arranged before the clothes piece automatic feeding process, the clothes piece pattern matching process comprises a clothes piece identification process for shooting and uploading clothes pieces to be sewn through an image identification system, outputting the types of the clothes pieces after analyzing and comparing the pictures of the clothes pieces, and a template matching and plate taking process for selecting corresponding templates according to the types of the output clothes pieces, and a clothes piece automatic patch process for conveying and pressing the clothes pieces or the surface pieces of the clothes pieces on the corresponding templates selected through the template matching and plate taking process through a template conveying device is also arranged between the clothes piece pattern matching process and the clothes piece automatic feeding process, the template conveying device comprises a pair of first conveying rollers.

title_en: Method for producing microfibrillated cellulose and grinding media, particulate ceramic grinding media
abstract_en: Methods of making microfibrillated cellulose and grinding media, particulate ceramic grinding media. The method comprises the following steps: grinding in the presence of particulate grinding media to microfibrillate the fibrous matrix comprising cellulose, the particulate grinding media being removed after grinding is complete, the particulate grinding media having a specific gravity of at least 3.5, the particulate ceramic grinding media comprising zirconia, ZrO, by sintering 2 And alumina Al 2 O 3 The particulate ceramic grinding media being roughened during grinding such that, after grinding is complete, the surface roughness is greater than the surface roughness at the start of grinding, and/or the average coefficient of friction is greater than the average coefficient of friction at the start of grinding, the surface roughness increasing by at least 5% during grinding, and/or the average coefficient of friction increasing by at least 5% during grinding.

title_en: Melt spinning apparatus
abstract_en: The invention relates to a melt spinning device for producing synthetic threads, having a plurality of spinning positions. Each spinning position has a spinning nozzle device, a cooling device, a yarn guide disc device and a winding device. An automatic operating unit is provided for joining the yarn at the spinning positions, which can be guided to each spinning position for joining the yarn. In order to obtain a reliable guidance and a precise positioning for engaging the yarn, according to the invention the guiding means are formed by a suspended track on which an automatic operating unit is guided, wherein the automatic operating unit is held in a positionally fixed manner in the suspended track in the spinning position by means of a controllable locking mechanism.

title_en: Zinc oxide powder for antibacterial tencel and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses zinc oxide powder for antibacterial tencel and a preparation method thereof. The zinc oxide powder can be directly added into a spinning solution for tencel, and because zinc oxide does not react with NMMO in a strong alkali environment, free silver ions are not generated, and discoloration is avoided, the zinc oxide powder is easy to recover and does not bring impurities, the tencel is not discolored, and the high-efficiency lasting antibacterial performance can be provided for the tencel.

title_en: Multifilament conditioning method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a multifilament yarn conditioning process for conditioning a multifilament yarn for further processing in a melt spinning process. For conditioning, a plurality of filaments forming a thread are combined after melt spinning and cooling by preparation with a high-viscosity fluid having a viscosity of more than 10cSt, preferably more than 30 cSt. Then, after drawing and in preparation for filament entanglement, the filaments are also wetted with a low viscosity fluid having a viscosity of less than 1.1cSt, and then the filaments are entangled by compressed air, thereby producing more than 10 intertwining knots per meter of length of the filaments.

title_en: Vertical transmission link mechanism and double needle bar warp knitting machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vertical transmission connecting rod mechanism and a double needle bar warp knitting machine, wherein a connecting rod machine part comprises a supporting seat, a main shaft hole and a swing arm shaft hole, the upper end of the supporting seat is used for vertical fixation, the lower end of the supporting seat is provided with the main shaft hole and the swing arm shaft hole which are parallel in a staggered manner, the main shaft is assembled in the main shaft hole, a swing arm shaft is assembled in the swing arm shaft hole, a plurality of conjugate cams are connected on the main shaft in series, a plurality of swing arms corresponding to the conjugate cams are connected on the swing arm shaft in series, and the conjugate cams are connected with the swing arms through swing arm connecting rods; the double needle bar warp knitting machine comprises at least 4 groups of vertical transmission link mechanisms which are perpendicular to the upper plane of the machine body, wherein every two groups of vertical transmission link mechanisms share one main shaft, adjacent main shafts are connected through hoop coaxial centers, and the last section of main shaft is connected with the transmission main shaft coaxial centers through hoops. Through the mode, the invention can eliminate errors caused by the installation of each group of supporting seats, and has the advantages of stable and reliable structure, low cost and convenient maintenance.

title_en: Nonwoven fabric for diaper surface layer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-woven fabric for a diaper surface layer, which is formed by sequentially overlapping a skin-friendly non-woven fabric layer, a liquid-guiding non-woven fabric layer and a hydrophilic non-woven fabric layer from top to bottom, wherein a plurality of groups of diversion trenches are uniformly arranged on the liquid-guiding non-woven fabric layer, and the diversion trenches are semi-closed trenches which are not through from top to bottom; the bottom of the hydrophilic non-woven fabric layer is provided with a plurality of groups of convex bodies, and the convex bodies are rolling points formed by hot rolling the hydrophilic non-woven fabric layer; the skin-friendly non-woven fabric layer and the liquid-guiding non-woven fabric layer are subjected to high-temperature oscillation fiber opening treatment. The invention adopts a multi-layer non-woven fabric composite structure, and carries out high-temperature oscillation fiber splitting treatment on the skin-friendly non-woven fabric layer and the liquid-guiding non-woven fabric layer, so that the fiber spacing is increased, the water permeability and the air permeability are increased, and simultaneously, the flow guide performance of the liquid-guiding non-woven fabric layer and the anti-seepage performance of the hydrophilic non-woven fabric layer are optimized, and further, the integral water permeability, air permeability and anti-back seepage performance are optimized.

title_en: Edge cutting and point pressing machine for back button of underwear
abstract_en: The invention discloses an edge cutting and point pressing machine for back buttons of underwear, which comprises a case, a feeding mechanism, a positioning mechanism, a flanging mechanism, a point pressing and edge cutting mechanism and an ultrasonic generator, wherein the feeding mechanism is arranged on the case; the feeding mechanism comprises a material platform, a material plate frame, a pushing plate and a pushing driving device; the pushing plate is provided with a material groove; the feeding mechanism comprises a bottom plate, a clamping driving device and a feeding driving device; the positioning mechanism comprises a moving driving device, a flat pushing driving device and a flat pushing plate; the flanging mechanism comprises a bracket and a flanging plate; the pressure point trimming mechanism comprises a pressure point trimming driving device, a knife rest, a blade, a pressure point needle and a working frame; the ultrasonic generator is arranged in the case. The invention has high efficiency, low cost and good product quality, and can meet the industry requirements of increasingly intense competition.

title_en: Carbon fiber polyimide sizing agent and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a carbon fiber polyimide sizing agent and a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the field of high polymer materials, and the specific scheme is as follows: a carbon fiber polyimide sizing agent comprises polyimide, an organic solvent and deionized water, wherein the polyimide accounts for 0.1-2% of the total mass of the sizing agent, the deionized water accounts for 90-96% of the total mass of the sizing agent, and the balance is the organic solvent; the preparation method comprises the following steps: dissolving polyimide in an organic solvent to form a solution A; dropwise adding deionized water into the solution A to form a suspension type carbon fiber polyimide sizing agent; and (3) dipping the carbon fiber in the carbon fiber polyimide sizing agent for 1-15 s, then carrying out size scraping treatment, and then drying to enable the polyimide to form a film on the surface of the carbon fiber so as to finish sizing treatment. The method can improve the interface performance of the thermoplastic resin-based carbon fiber composite material, and has the advantages of simple and convenient operation, low organic solvent content in a sizing agent finished product, environmental protection and the like.

title_en: Bottom pressing assembly line for shoemaking and bottom pressing method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a bottom pressing assembly line for shoemaking, which comprises an electric control system, a bottom pressing unit and a feeding unit, wherein the feeding unit is provided with a correction mechanism for correcting the posture and the position of a processed object, and the bottom pressing unit comprises a bottom pressing conveyor for conveying the processed object to a working position, side pressing mechanisms arranged on the left side and the right side of the bottom pressing conveyor, a mounting frame arranged above the bottom pressing conveyor, a lifting cylinder arranged at the top of the mounting frame, a mounting plate driven by the lifting cylinder to slide up and down along the mounting frame, a top pressing mechanism arranged at the bottom of the mounting plate and a front and rear tightening mechanism arranged below the mounting plate in a sliding manner through a guide inner frame. The invention can safely convey the processed object to the working position in standard postures through the feeding conveyor, the correction conveyor, the bottom pressing conveyor and the correction mechanism, the left side and the right side are uniformly pressed through the side pressing mechanism, the front side and the rear side are uniformly pressed through the front and rear tightening mechanism, and the integral uniform pressing of the glued surface is realized through the top pressing mechanism.

title_en: One-stop pulping machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a one-stop horizontal pulping machine. The pulping machine comprises a machine body, a turnover plate, a feeding hole, a discharging hole and a motor; the machine body comprises an inner shell and an outer shell; the turning plate is arranged on the inner wall of the inner shell, and the angle of the turning plate enables the turning plate to be inclined to the conveying direction of the materials in the inner shell; the motor is arranged at the end part of the machine body and used for driving the inner shell to rotate along the horizontal central shaft; the feed inlet sets up the one end at the organism, and the discharge gate sets up the other end at the organism, and feed inlet and discharge gate are linked together with interior casing. According to the one-stop pulping machine provided by the invention, the softening and pulping processes can be finished in one stop in the same equipment, and continuous operation production of continuous feeding and continuous discharging can be realized instead of single-pot intermittent production.

title_en: Full-automatic brush making machine
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of brush making, and provides a full-automatic brush making machine which comprises a wire hooking forming device, a hair feeding device, a clamping device, a wire twisting device, an electric control device and a table top, wherein the wire hooking forming device is used for sectionally hooking and forming an iron wire and feeding the formed iron wire to a designated position, the hair feeding device is used for taking and feeding the hair, the clamping device is used for clamping the hair and the formed iron wire from the designated position A to the wire twisting device, the wire twisting device is used for clamping and rotating two ends of the iron wire to kink the iron wire and fix the hair, the electric control device is used for controlling the device, and the table top is used for installing the device.

title_en: Washing-free high-color-fastness pad dyeing process for heavy polyester blanket cloth
abstract_en: The invention provides a washing-free high-color-fastness pad dyeing process of heavy polyester blanket cloth, which comprises the following steps of: 1) preparation of microcapsule-like liquid dye: after ball milling of the powder disperse dye, adding a dispersing agent for continuous ball milling, then adding polybutylene powder and glycerol for continuous ball milling, and adding water to obtain a microcapsule-like liquid dye; 2) preparing a dyeing color paste; 3) padding; 4) pre-baking; 5) color development is carried out at 170-200 ℃ for 80-210 s. Compared with the prior art, the deep soaking dyeing of the terylene polymer is realized by virtue of the high penetrability of the nano-particle size of the liquid dye particles; in addition, the pad dyeing process designed by the invention enables the dyed fabric to have the highest K/S value and excellent color fastness and color vividness.

title_en: Waste liquid container and fitting
abstract_en: The invention provides a waste liquid container and a fitting capable of preventing waste liquid leaked from a waste liquid introducing part from adhering to a contact part of a limited part. A waste liquid container (50) is provided with: a waste liquid introduction section (56) connected to the discharge section when the waste liquid container (50) is mounted in the mounting section; a storage section that stores the waste liquid discharged from the discharge section; and a restricted portion (53) having a contact portion capable of contacting the restricting portion, wherein the restricted portion restricts movement of the waste liquid container (50) in a removal direction opposite to the mounting direction by the contact portion contacting the restricting portion in a state where the waste liquid container (50) is mounted in the mounting portion, and the contact portion is disposed at a position not overlapping with an opening center of the waste liquid introducing portion (56) in a vertical direction when viewed from a side where the waste liquid introducing portion (56) is opened.

title_en: Surface sizing liquid for rice paper and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a surface sizing solution for rice paper and a preparation method and application thereof. The surface sizing solution is prepared from the following raw materials: hydrophilic polymer, color fixing agent, water repellent agent, defoaming agent, oxidant and water. The method comprises the steps of mixing hydrophilic polymer, oxidant and water, and stirring for 10-60 minutes in a water bath environment at the temperature of 60-90 ℃; then adding a color fixing agent, and uniformly mixing; adding water repellent agent; and adjusting the temperature of the obtained system to 45-65 ℃, reacting for 30-90 min, naturally cooling to room temperature, taking out, and adding a defoaming agent to obtain the rice paper surface sizing solution. The rice paper prepared by the surface sizing solution provided by the invention has high color fixing effect and high color density value of ink.

title_en: Online finishing assembly of yarn
abstract_en: The invention provides an online yarn finishing assembly which comprises a yarn guide hook and a steel collar, wherein the yarn guide hook is positioned above the steel collar, a first infusion tube is arranged in the yarn guide hook, a plurality of first atomizing nozzles are uniformly arranged on the inner surface of the annular ring, one end of the first infusion tube is sequentially communicated with each first atomizing nozzle, and the other end of the first infusion tube is connected with a first pressure pump; the ring is annular, a circle of grooves are formed in the ring, a plurality of second atomizing nozzles are uniformly arranged in the grooves, a second infusion tube is arranged below the ring, each second atomizing nozzle is communicated with the second infusion tube through a liquid spraying pipeline, the second infusion tube is connected with a second pressure pump, and a semicircular steel wire ring is movably connected above the ring. The invention has the beneficial effects that: 1) The yarn can be subjected to chemical finishing on line in the yarn forming process, so that the production procedures are reduced; 2) The types of finishing agents can be flexibly adjusted according to yarns with different purposes; 3) The spray rate of the finishing agent can be adjusted according to yarn number, spindle speed, spinning speed and the like.

title_en: Production process of gloves with different knitting materials on front and back surfaces
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of glove production, in particular to a production process of gloves with different knitting materials on the front and back surfaces, which comprises a main yarn nozzle arranged above a front needle plate of a glove knitting machine, and an auxiliary yarn nozzle arranged above a rear needle plate; a front needle for hooking and taking the yarn in the auxiliary yarn nozzle for knitting is arranged on a front needle plate of the glove knitting machine, and a rear needle for hooking and taking the yarn in the main yarn nozzle for knitting is arranged on a rear needle plate; a rear knitting needle selection strip matched with a rear knitting needle and a front left side common needle selection strip matched with a front knitting needle are arranged on a needle selection mechanism of the glove knitting machine, and a front knitting needle selection strip matched with the front knitting needle and a rear right side common needle selection strip matched with the rear knitting needle are arranged on the needle selection mechanism of the glove knitting machine; performing cross knitting to complete knitting of the gloves; the invention has the advantages that: the main yarn nozzle and the auxiliary yarn nozzle are arranged for cross knitting, so that the front side and the back side of the glove knitting machine can be knitted by different materials, the use value of the knitted gloves is improved, and the added value of products is increased.

title_en: Textile actuator
abstract_en: A textile actuator to be worn by a user includes a textile cover defining a chamber that is fluid-tight through a fluid-tight bladder contained in the textile cover and/or a fluid-tight structure incorporated into the textile cover. The textile cover has a predetermined geometry that creates a state of equilibrium at non-180 degrees of displacement and resists further displacement and joint hyperextension upon pressurization of the chamber. Delivering fluid into or out of the chamber to displace the cover of textile primarily by transitioning from an uninflated state to the predetermined geometry due to displacement of the cover of textile, rather than by stretching or shrinking of the cover of textile. When actuated, the textile actuators (a) displace and/or (b) support and hold in place the body segment of the user.

title_en: Vamp grinding device for shoemaking production line
abstract_en: The invention provides a vamp polishing device for a shoemaking production line, which belongs to the field of shoemaking equipment and comprises a tray bottom plate, six mechanical arms arranged on the tray bottom plate, a reversing table support, a shoe side polishing assembly, a sole polishing assembly, a heel polishing assembly and a laser scanning assembly, wherein the reversing table support is used for being matched with the six mechanical arms to realize the adjustment of the direction and the position of a shoe tree, the shoe side polishing assembly comprises a first polishing wheel for polishing the side surface of a shoe, the sole polishing assembly comprises a second polishing wheel for polishing the bottom of the shoe, the heel polishing assembly comprises a tension wheel, the outer side of the tension wheel is provided with a polishing belt, and the polishing belt swings up and down under the action of a grinding shell to polish the heel. The shoe polisher realizes polishing of different positions of the shoe upper, is high in automation degree, reduces cost and improves labor efficiency.

title_en: Bottom lifting device and tension control mechanism
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of knitting machinery, in particular to a lifting device and a tension control mechanism, which comprises a nut seat, a limiting structure, a screw rod, a motor for driving the screw rod to rotate, a lifting seat for driving a lifting comb to lift and a first controller, wherein the nut seat is sleeved on the screw rod, the limiting structure is used for limiting the circumference of the nut seat so that the nut seat is driven to lift by the screw rod, an elastic piece and a sensor are arranged on the lifting seat, the nut seat is used for driving the lifting seat to lift by driving and driving the lifting seat to descend by the elastic piece, the sensor is used for being triggered to generate a signal when the deformation amount of the elastic piece exceeds a set value, and the first controller is used for controlling the motor to slow down or wait according to the signal. According to the technical scheme provided by the invention, the automatic control of the falling speed of the bottom comb which is too fast can be realized.

title_en: Tool and method for embossing a packaging material with an embossing pattern having a low-visibility code and method for reading a code
abstract_en: An embossing tool for embossing a combined embossing pattern into a packaging material, the combined embossing pattern comprising a decorative embossing structure and at least one embossing code, the embossing tool comprising a male and a female embossing device for cooperating with each other, the embossing structures of the male and female embossing devices being formed to produce the combined embossing pattern in the packaging material in an embossing gap, the embossing structures of the male and female embossing devices comprising a first embossing structure, said first embossing structure being intended to form the at least one embossing code, said first embossing structure being a male and a female embossing structure having the inverse of a polyhedron shape, and the decorative embossing structure and the at least one embossing code produced by the embossing structure being arranged such that the at least one embossing code has a reduced visibility compared to the decorative embossing structure.

title_en: Preparation method of antibacterial sports knitted fabric
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of an antibacterial sports knitted fabric, which is characterized in that in the process of preparing circular sheath-core composite fibers from two kinds of PET (polyethylene terephthalate) with different viscosities according to an FDY (fully drawn yarn) process, spinneret holes on a spinneret plate are changed into trilobal shapes from circular shapes, circular blowing cooling is adopted, and the arrangement of the trilobal spinneret holes on the spinneret plate is controlled to meet certain conditions, so that sheath-core polyester fibers are prepared; after yarns a (polyester fibers with circular cross sections) and b (sheath-core polyester fibers) are interwoven into grey cloth, composite finishing is sequentially carried out (firstly, the grey cloth is put into deionized water solution containing a nano-silver antibacterial agent, then paraffin and polyester polyether linear block compounds are added into the deionized water solution, and finally isopropanolamine is added) and relaxation heat treatment is carried out to prepare the antibacterial sports knitted fabric; the gram weight of the finally prepared antibacterial sports knitted fabric is 100-150 g/m 2 The time for dripping water diffusion is less than or equal to2.0s, the wicking height is 13.2-13.9 cm.

title_en: Weaving warp knitting production equipment and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a textile warp knitting production device and a method thereof, wherein the device comprises a base, a winding roller, a cloth delivery mechanism, a cutting mechanism arranged behind the cloth delivery mechanism, a guide mechanism arranged behind the cutting mechanism and a winding mechanism arranged at the tail end of the guide mechanism; after the winding roller of winding mechanism department accomplished the rolling, the cooperation of cloth delivery mechanism cuts the mechanism and cuts the cloth, accomplishes and cuts the back it resets and drives the cloth that unreels along guiding mechanism conveying to winding mechanism department through cloth delivery mechanism at the in-process that resets to cut the mechanism, and winding mechanism cooperation next winding roller continues to carry out the rolling to the cloth. The invention solves the problems that the winding efficiency is low in the cloth winding process, the next winding roller needs to be pulled manually after cutting, time and labor are wasted, the cloth is not wound tightly in the winding process, and the winding space is wasted.

title_en: Disperse red dye composition and dye product
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disperse red dye composition and a dye product, wherein the disperse red dye composition comprises 5-50 parts by mass of a component A and 50-95 parts by mass of a component B, the component A is selected from at least one of the following formulas (I), and the component B is selected from one or more of the following formulas (III), or a combination of one or more of the following formulas (III) and one or more of the following formulas (IV). The disperse red dye product comprises the disperse red dye composition and an auxiliary agent. When the disperse red dye product prepared from the disperse red dye composition is applied to dyeing of hydrophobic fiber materials such as polyester fibers and terylene/spandex fabrics, the disperse red dye product has excellent washing fastness, sublimation fastness and rubbing fastness, good lifting performance and high color yield, and overcomes the defect of poor lifting performance of general high-fastness disperse dyes.

title_en: Degradable polyester fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a degradable polyester fiber and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: the doped and modified ZrO is dispersed therein 2 Extruding the PET melt from a trilobal spinneret orifice on a spinneret plate, cooling by adopting circular blowing, preparing FDY (fully drawn yarn) filaments according to an FDY process, and performing relaxation heat treatment to prepare degradable polyester fibers; the trilobal spinneret orifices on the spinneret plate are spinneret orifices with three leaves of which the lengths are not completely equal and included angles between the three leaves are not completely equal, all the trilobal spinneret orifices are distributed in concentric circles, and the center line of a leaf in each trilobal spinneret orifice, which is opposite to the minimum included angle, passes through the circle center and points away from the circle center; the prepared degradable polyester fiber has a three-dimensional crimp shape, and the intrinsic viscosity of the degradable polyester fiber is reduced by 10-16% after the degradable polyester fiber is placed for 60 months under the conditions that the temperature is 25 ℃ and the relative humidity is 65%. The preparation method is simple in process, and the prepared degradable polyester fiber is excellent in degradability and good in elasticity.

title_en: Method for manufacturing anti-ultraviolet polyester fabric
abstract_en: The invention discloses a manufacturing method of an anti-ultraviolet polyester fabric, and belongs to the technical field of fabrics. The manufacturing method of the ultraviolet-resistant polyester fabric comprises the following steps: desizing, washing, dyeing and post-treatment, wherein the post-treatment comprises softening treatment, color fixation, drying and shaping and packaging. The prepared anti-ultraviolet polyester fabric has excellent anti-ultraviolet performance.

title_en: System, method, and medium for bookbinding of print jobs
abstract_en: A system may include a finishing device to receive a print job. The print job is movable about a first axis of the finishing device. The system further includes a binding device contained within the collating device. The stapling apparatus moves about a second axis of the collating apparatus, and the second axis may be perpendicular to the first axis. A sensor may be located on the binding device to identify a first edge of the print job. The first edge of the print job may be a leading edge of the print job when the print job moves about the first axis.

title_en: Ultrahigh molecular weight polyethylene fiber splicing and pressing device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultrahigh molecular weight polyethylene fiber splicing and pressing device, which comprises a processing box, wherein a processing cavity is arranged in the processing box, a cutting and conveying device is arranged in the processing cavity and used for pulling, cutting and conveying ultrahigh molecular weight polyethylene fibers, a detection cavity positioned on the left lower side of the cutting and conveying device is arranged in the processing cavity, a thickness detection device is arranged in the detection cavity and used for detecting whether the stacking number of the ultrahigh molecular weight polyethylene fiber slices reaches the standard or not, the thickness detection device can spray an adhesive on the ultrahigh molecular weight polyethylene fibers, a push plate conveying device positioned between the thickness detection device and a hot pressing device is arranged in the processing cavity and used for conveying spliced and pressed finished products, and the slicing, cutting and conveying of the ultrahigh molecular weight polyethylene fibers can be realized through one device, Brush processing movements such as lamination, heating are pieced together and are pressed, and degree of automation is higher, and machining efficiency is higher.

title_en: Penetrating type sweat-guiding quick-drying composite fabric and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a penetrating type sweat-guiding quick-drying composite fabric which is formed by weaving an inner layer and an outer layer; the inner layer is a bionic skin-core structure fiber, and the outer layer is a hydrophilic fiber. The invention creates a novel moisture absorption and sweat releasing mode, wherein the soaking radius of the inner layer is small, and the sweat absorbed and retained by the inner layer is less, so that the aim of drying and refreshing the inner layer is fulfilled; the outer sweat diffuses and evaporates the sweat in a relatively larger area, and the sweat naturally dries quickly. Thereby separating the functions of the inner layer and the outer layer of the fabric, leading sweat to be dredged by the inner layer and leading the outer layer to be diffused and evaporated. Sweat in the inner layer penetrates the inner layer in a small area like the stem of a mushroom; the outer layer is diffused and evaporated in a large area like the umbrella part of the mushroom, so that the problems that the chemical fiber cloth does not absorb sweat and the inner layer absorbs too much sweat, is dried slowly and is wet and cold are solved. Meanwhile, sweat on the outer layer of the composite fabric does not contact with the skin, so that discomfort of body sticking or cold and damp cannot occur.

title_en: Gold stamping paste and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of gold stamping paste, in particular to gold stamping paste and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the gold stamping paste consists of the following components in parts by weight: 100-120 parts of emulsion, which comprises styrene-acrylic emulsion and EVA emulsion, and the styrene-acrylic emulsion and the EVA emulsion are mixed according to the weight ratio of 1: 5; 15-25 parts of hot melt powder, wherein the hot melt powder comprises TPU hot melt powder and EVA hot melt powder, and the weight ratio range of the TPU hot melt powder to the EVA hot melt powder is 1:3-1: 4.5; 2-4 parts of chlorinated paraffin; 0.8-1.2 parts of sodium carboxymethyl cellulose; 1-2 parts of a thickening agent; 5-8 parts of a dispersing agent; 0.5-1.0 part of pH buffering agent; 2-3 parts of a stabilizer: 1-2 parts of an emulsifying wetting agent; 1.2-1.5 parts of ultraviolet absorbent. The invention has the following beneficial effects: 1. the gilding paste has better washing fastness. 2. Because the solid content of the emulsion is higher, the concave-convex surface of the printing stock can be covered when the gold stamping pulp is used for printing, and a better smooth surface can be obtained.

title_en: Case printing process adopting water-based environment-friendly ink
abstract_en: The invention discloses a case printing process adopting water-based environment-friendly ink, which belongs to the technical field of printing and is technically characterized by comprising the following operation steps of: unreeling a plastic packaging film, and coating at least one layer of water-based environment-friendly ink layer on one side of the plastic packaging film through a printing machine; then the fan accelerates the drying for 5 to 30 minutes; and continuously coating a gloss oil layer on one side of the water-based environment-friendly ink layer, which is far away from the plastic packaging film, secondarily accelerating and drying for 5-30 minutes by using a fan, rolling the paper on a winding roller after drying, and attaching the plastic packaging film to the case shell in a hot-pressing film laminating mode after the paper is detected to be qualified. According to the invention, the arrangement positions of the water-based environment-friendly ink and the plastic packaging film in the process are improved, so that the water-based environment-friendly ink is firstly coated on the plastic packaging film and then is adhered to the case shell in a hot-pressing film covering manner, thereby reducing the mutual separation of the plastic packaging film and the case shell, improving the connection strength between the plastic packaging film and the case shell, and enabling the case to have good hardness and wear-resistant and scratch-resistant properties.

title_en: Ink box
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of ink-jet printers, in particular to an ink box, wherein the ink box is detachably arranged in an installation part, the ink box comprises a first clamping position and a second clamping position which are oppositely arranged on two sides of the ink box, the first clamping position is matched with a clamping groove of the installation part, the ink box further comprises a movable part, and the second clamping position is connected to the movable part; the second clamping position comprises a first clamping part and a second clamping part; the ink cartridge is arranged in the mounting part, and the movable part can move so that the first clamping part and the second clamping part are simultaneously clamped with the mounting part. Utilize the ink horn that this application provided to when avoiding the ink horn to install in the installation department, the ink horn receives too big effort and causes the risk of dropout.

title_en: External hanging type cloth feeding auxiliary device on sewing machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses an externally hung cloth feeding auxiliary device on a sewing machine, which comprises a detachable driving motor, a lifting mechanism, a cloth feeding mechanism, a return mechanism and a cloth feeding rod, wherein the driving motor is fixed on the outer side surface of a machine head of the sewing machine; the driving motor is connected with the lifting mechanism through a rotating shaft and drives the cloth feeding rod to lift or descend; the cloth feeding mechanism is connected with the rotating shaft and drives the cloth feeding rod to move back and forth; the return mechanism is connected with the lifting mechanism and controls the lifting mechanism and the cloth feeding rod to return to the original position; the cloth feeding rod is connected with a presser foot lifting mechanism on the sewing machine, and the presser foot lifting mechanism controls the presser foot lifting mechanism to lift the cloth feeding rod in a non-working state. The invention can be disassembled and matched with any model sewing machine with the same specification, so that the use cost is reduced, the use range is wider, and the cloth cannot be polluted in use.

title_en: Non-dissolution type long-acting antibacterial protective non-woven fabric and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of antibacterial materials, and discloses a non-dissolution type long-acting antibacterial protective non-woven fabric, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: uniformly spraying the antibacterial solution on the non-woven fabric or soaking the non-woven fabric in the antibacterial solution, polymerizing organic silicon molecules to enhance the binding force of non-woven fabric fibers and antibacterial active substances, and directionally loading the antibacterial active substances such as ammonium salt and nano-silver activity on the surface of the non-woven fabric through high-temperature shaping to prepare the antibacterial protective non-woven fabric; the antibacterial liquid comprises nano-silver gel, quaternary ammonium salt, organic silicon, an auxiliary agent and water. According to the invention, through a chemical bonding method of organic silicon on the surface of the polymer fiber, high-activity quaternary ammonium salt and nano silver are loaded on the surface of the non-woven fabric fiber to form an ultrathin antibacterial layer with positive charges, the fiber structure of the non-woven fabric is basically not damaged, good air permeability is maintained, the rejection rate of the protective non-woven fabric can be obviously improved, and the mask prepared from the non-woven fabric can be repeatedly used.

title_en: Paper strength improving polymer composition and additive system, use thereof and manufacture of paper products
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a polymer composition comprising an anionic synthetic polymer and an anionic polysaccharide. The invention also relates to a strength additive system, its use, a paper product and a method of production.

title_en: Mask nose bridge body adds device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mask nose bridge body adding device, wherein a nose bridge body material firstly enters a first feeding wheel set, the nose bridge body material is conveyed through a preset gap between an annular groove of a lower roller and an annular boss of an upper roller, then the nose bridge body material enters a cutting mechanism under the limit of a first guide mechanism, is conveyed forwards along the annular limit groove under the drive of a cutter roller and an anvil roller, and is cut off by a blade axially arranged, and then the nose bridge body material enters a second guide mechanism, is conveyed backwards along a support plate, enters a strip-shaped groove of a guide plate, is guided and limited and conveyed, and is finally added into a mask body material. Can avoid nose bridge body material to take place offset and direction beat at this scheme in transport, cutting off process, ensure that the nose bridge body is added to the face guard body with correct position and accurate angle fast, improve gauze mask production speed, guarantee the stability and the product quality of gauze mask production.

title_en: Plastic panel printing equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to printing equipment, in particular to plastic panel printing equipment. The invention aims to provide plastic panel printing equipment capable of reducing labor intensity of workers. In order to solve the above technical problems, the present invention provides a plastic panel printing apparatus, comprising: the two sides of the mounting rack are connected with supporting seats; the sliding rod is fixedly connected to the supporting seat and is connected with the sliding sleeve in a sliding mode; the supporting spring is connected between the sliding sleeve and the supporting seat; the moving mechanism is arranged between the front side surfaces of the sliding sleeves; the printing mechanism is arranged on the moving mechanism. The scraper moves leftwards along with the replaceable die, and can uniformly print the pigment on the surface of the plastic panel, so that the surface of the plastic panel is not required to be manually printed, and the labor intensity of workers can be reduced.

title_en: Screen printing plate without net knots and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a non-net-knot screen printing plate which comprises a net gauze and an organic film layer arranged on the net gauze, wherein a plurality of openings are formed in the organic film layer, the net gauze comprises a plurality of warps and a plurality of wefts interwoven with the warps, each opening is parallel to the wefts, and each opening is positioned between two adjacent wefts. Compared with the traditional screen printing plate with the openings parallel to the warps, the screen printing plate without the net knots is a new method, and the openings parallel to the wefts are adopted, so that the problem that the warps are removed in order to avoid the net knots in the traditional plate making process is avoided, and the service life of the screen printing plate is prolonged. The invention also provides a manufacturing method of the screen printing plate without the net knots.

title_en: Paper tensioning and conveying device with paper positioning structure for lithography
abstract_en: The invention discloses a paper tensioning and conveying device for planographic printing and a paper positioning structure thereof, which comprises a conveying plate, wherein a V-shaped groove is formed in one side of the top end of the conveying plate, an air outlet pipe is fixedly connected to the inner wall of one side of the V-shaped groove, a plurality of air outlet holes are uniformly formed in one side wall of the air outlet pipe, a positioning air box is fixedly embedded in the other side of the top end of the conveying plate, a plurality of air suction holes are uniformly formed in the top end of the positioning air box, a mounting groove is formed in the middle of the bottom end of the conveying plate, and a fan is fixedly mounted in the mounting groove. Thereby positioning the brushed-flat paper sheet on the transfer plate by suction.

title_en: Thumb part and palm part connecting method of inner thumb glove
abstract_en: The invention provides a thumb part and palm part connecting method of a glove on the inner side of a thumb, the connection position of the connecting method is smoothly connected, the thumb part and the palm part are integrated, holes are prevented from being generated on the connecting position, the integration is good, the quality and the aesthetic effect of the knitted glove can be effectively improved, and the method comprises the following steps of respectively flatly copying the front knitting layer coil of the palm part and the rear knitting layer coil of the thumb part to be connected: the method comprises the steps of firstly forming overlapped coils, then alternately knitting the overlapped coils on different front and back needle beds along the same direction by using the same yarn nozzle, thereby forming front and back needle-off alternative needle-off coils on the front and back needle beds, overlapping the last needle-off coil of a rear knitting layer of a thumb part on a flat-off end coil of a front knitting layer of a palm part, and overlapping the end coil of the front knitting layer of the thumb part at one end of a palm center on the last needle-off coil of the front knitting layer of the palm part, so that the thumb part and the palm part are smoothly and stably connected into a whole.

title_en: Bale plucking impurity removing device and removing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device for removing impurities in bale plucking, which comprises: the device comprises an impurity removal module, a visual detection module and a foreign fiber removal device, wherein the impurity removal module is used for removing impurities such as cotton seeds, broken shells and scrap iron in cotton fibers, the visual detection module is used for identifying foreign fibers mixed in the cotton fibers and impurities which are not removed in the previous process, and the foreign fiber removal device is used for removing the foreign fibers mixed in the cotton fibers and impurities which are not removed in the previous process, which are detected by the visual detection module; the magnetic force and the negative pressure suction force generated by the magnet and the impurity removal suction nozzle in the impurity removal module can effectively prevent light impurities in cotton fibers from easily returning to the cotton fibers along the blanking channel under the action of fiber conveying negative pressure airflow in the separation process, and the impurity removal effect is good; in the cotton grabbing process, the cotton blocks are further opened by using an impurity removal beater and a cotton carding roller, so that the opening degree of cotton fibers is better; the foreign fiber sorting of the cotton fibers is realized through the visual detection module; the invention has simple structure and good impurity removal effect, and realizes the online cleaning of impurities.

title_en: Glass spacing paper and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to glass spacing paper, which comprises spacing paper pulp and is characterized in that: the space paper pulp comprises 50-70% of native softwood pulp, 10-30% of native hardwood pulp and 10-20% of softwood chemi-mechanical pulp in percentage by mass; wherein the primary softwood pulp and the softwood chemi-mechanical pulp are mixed and pulped, and the pulping degree is 25-30 DEG SR; and independently pulping the primary hardwood pulp, wherein the pulping degree is 20-25 DEG SR. According to the glass spacing paper, a proper amount of needle-leaved wood chemi-mechanical pulp is added into raw materials of the glass spacing paper, and the needle-leaved wood chemi-mechanical pulp has high hardness, so that the air permeability of the glass spacing paper is improved, the glass spacing paper is endowed with high stiffness, the quality of the glass spacing paper is greatly improved, and the glass spacing paper with high stiffness, high mechanical strength and high air permeability is prepared.

title_en: Surface screen printing device for paper handbag
abstract_en: The invention relates to a screen printing device, in particular to a screen printing device for the surface of a paper handbag. The technical problem is how to design a paper handbag surface screen printing device which is more convenient for people to print patterns on paper handbags, has high working efficiency and does not need to be operated by two persons. A screen printing device for the surface of a paper handbag comprises: the supporting seat is fixedly connected with a placing frame at one side outside the supporting seat, and a frame body is hinged to the edge of one side of the supporting seat; the first torsion spring is connected to the hinged position of the placing frame and the frame body, and the number of the first torsion springs is two. According to the invention, the paper handbag is placed in the placing frame, the frame body is pulled to swing downwards to enable the silk screen plate to be in contact with the paper handbag, the handle is pulled to move rightwards, and the scraping plate can extrude ink on the paper handbag through holes of the pattern part on the silk screen plate to complete printing, so that the operation is simple and convenient, and the paper handbag does not need to be pulled back and forth.

title_en: Circulating production line system and operation mode thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a circulating production line system and an operation mode thereof. The device comprises a liquid medicine oven and a glue oven which are juxtaposed, an oven inlet conveying mechanism and an oven outlet conveying mechanism which are respectively positioned at two ends of the juxtaposed liquid medicine oven and glue oven, and a station conveying mechanism which is connected with the oven inlet conveying mechanism and the oven outlet conveying mechanism; a material is placed in a shoe plate module, and can be circularly moved into the liquid medicine oven and the glue oven by the driving of the oven inlet conveying mechanism, the oven outlet conveying mechanism and the station conveying mechanism. Therefore, the waste of working hours is reduced, the production efficiency is improved, and the same oven can be used for repeatedly executing the drying procedures of coating glue for different times, so that the effects of reducing the equipment cost and effectively utilizing the production equipment are achieved.

title_en: Threading method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a threading method, which comprises the following steps of feeding round buttons, wherein the round buttons are fed to a clamping piece of a threading machine by a first button feeding device; feeding the splayed buckles, and feeding the splayed buckles into the buckle grooves of the two clamping arms of the buckle clamping device on the tape threading machine by the second buckle feeding device; conveying the belt, wherein the upper clamping piece and the lower clamping piece on the belt threading machine are matched to clamp the belt in the belt conveying channel and convey the belt into the round buckle; cutting the belt, wherein the belt is cut off at the left end by a cutter on the belt threading machine; pressing the belt, wherein a belt pressing device on the belt threading machine presses the belt; threading the V-shaped button; threading the V-shaped button for the second time; the first transfer transfers the button with the belt to a sewing platform for sewing: transferring the belt sewed with the V-shaped button to the clamping device for the second time, and enabling the two clamping arms of the clamping device to clamp the V-shaped button; and (5) putting back the V-shaped button, and carrying out the steps from the step of putting through the V-shaped button to the step of putting through the V-shaped button for the second time on the end of the belt which is not sewed with the V-shaped button.

title_en: Method for manufacturing honeycomb structure
abstract_en: The present invention provides a method of manufacturing a honeycomb structure, the method comprising: the method comprises the following steps of (1) superposing m corrugated sheets, wherein every two corrugated sheets are parallel, and every two adjacent corrugated sheets are oppositely arranged; n flat plate type reinforcing plates are arranged among the m corrugated plates, n is an integer which is greater than or equal to 1 and less than or equal to m-1, and m is an integer which is greater than or equal to 2. According to the method for manufacturing the honeycomb structure, the flat-type reinforcing sheet is placed between the corrugated sheets when the honeycomb structure is manufactured, so that the strength adjustment of the honeycomb structure is realized. Further, the value of n is different, namely the number of the placed flat plate type reinforcing sheets is different, and the strength of the formed honeycomb structure is different. The method provided by the embodiment of the invention does not need to change the parameters of the honeycomb structure, can avoid a series of problems of sample piece re-manufacturing, complicated process, long time consumption and the like, and has the effects of simplicity and high efficiency.

title_en: Clothing silica gel heat-transfer seal equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a garment silica gel heat transfer printing device, which comprises an imprinting assembly and 2 garment conveying assemblies; the clothing conveying assembly comprises a first supporting rod pair, a second supporting rod pair, a supporting frame, a first roller, a second roller, a first motor and a conveying belt; the first and second pairs of support rods are both in contact with the ground; the first roller is rotatably connected to the top of the first support rod pair; the second roller is rotatably connected to the top of the second support rod pair; the conveyer belt is wound on the first roller and the second roller at the same time and is in a stretched straight state; through setting up two clothing conveying component, the clothing of waiting to carry out the heat-transfer seal is carried simultaneously to two conveyer belts, has improved the work efficiency of impression subassembly to promote the production efficiency of this clothing silica gel heat-transfer seal equipment, and degree of automation promotes greatly.

title_en: Tailoring equipment for tailoring
abstract_en: The invention discloses tailoring equipment for tailoring, which comprises a base, a conveying assembly, an ironing barrel and a tailoring assembly, wherein the conveying assembly comprises a working conveying belt arranged at the top of the base, the ironing barrel is arranged at the top of the left side of the working conveying belt, symmetrically distributed filling wheels are further arranged at the top of the working conveying belt, and the bottoms of the filling wheels and the bottom of the ironing barrel are positioned at the same horizontal height; by the arrangement of the ironing barrel, the fabric is simply ironed before being cut, so that the fabric is smoother, and the cutting precision of the fabric of the garment is improved; due to the arrangement of the cutting assembly, cloth cutting in any shape can be realized through machinery, compared with the traditional manual cutting, the labor consumption is greatly reduced, and the production efficiency and the production quality are effectively improved; furthermore, the arrangement of the stretching roller and the auxiliary conveyor belt realizes the automatic separation of the leftover materials after cutting and the reserved cloth, and reduces the subsequent complicated manual work for separating the leftover materials.

title_en: Method for reducing wrinkles of cigarette tipping paper with visible cavity filter stick
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for reducing wrinkles of cigarette tipping paper with a visible cavity filter stick, which comprises the step of controlling in the production process of the tipping paper and in the cigarette rolling and tipping process. The obtained tipping paper is used for the visible cavity filter stick cigarette without generating wrinkles.

title_en: Built-in efficient full-automatic CCD alignment printing equipment and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a built-in efficient full-automatic CCD (charge coupled device) alignment printing device and method, comprising a workbench, a material lifting and conveying mechanism, a brush head lifting mechanism, a brush head transverse movement mechanism, a brush head, a printing plate fixing mechanism, a second transfer manipulator, a feeding machine, a first transfer manipulator, a primary positioning mechanism and a CCD alignment camera, wherein the feeding machine is provided with the first transfer manipulator, the side part of the feeding machine is provided with the workbench, the second transfer manipulator is arranged between the workbench and the feeding machine, one side of the workbench is fixedly provided with the brush head lifting mechanism for driving the brush head and the printing plate fixing mechanism to lift, the brush head transverse movement mechanism is arranged on the brush head lifting mechanism, the CCD alignment camera for aligning the material position is fixedly arranged at the lower part of the material lifting and conveying mechanism, and the side part of the feeding machine is provided with the primary positioning mechanism. The invention has stable feeding performance, high speed, small occupied space, accurate printing after CCD alignment, flexibility and practicability, greatly reduces investment cost and greatly improves production efficiency.

title_en: Disconnection detection method, disconnection detection device, electronic device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a device for detecting broken lines, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method for detecting the broken lines comprises the following steps: acquiring a plurality of initial images to be detected of an object to be detected within preset time; respectively carrying out image processing on the plurality of initial images to be detected to obtain a plurality of target images to be detected; and judging whether the object to be detected is broken according to the connected domains of the target images to be detected. The method, the device, the electronic equipment and the storage medium for detecting the broken thread are suitable for detecting the broken thread of the warp thread of the textile machine, and can accurately judge whether the warp thread of the textile machine to be detected is broken, so that the condition that the broken thread of the warp thread of the textile machine is missed to be detected or is not detected timely can be greatly reduced, the quality of produced cloth is guaranteed, and the waste of raw materials and the production cost are reduced.

title_en: Flexible package and method of making same
abstract_en: Methods of forming sealable packages, methods of forming contoured flexible containers, apparatuses for forming films into reclosable containers, methods of forming films into reclosable containers using forming apparatuses, reclosable package assemblies, flexible packages, and flexible materials are disclosed. The method of forming a sealable package comprises: providing a web comprising a first sheet; folding the web to define a plurality of walls; sealing edges of the web to define a first seal and a second seal, thereby defining a first sidewall and a second sidewall, wherein the plurality of walls comprises: opposing first and second side walls defining at least one wall of the opening panel, and a second sheet extends at least partially across at least three of the plurality of walls.

title_en: Method for preparing cellulose sponge by using bean dregs
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing cellulose sponge by bean dregs, which comprises the following steps: extracting the cellulose of the bean dregs, wherein the extraction of the cellulose of the bean dregs comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps of performing alkaline pre-impurity removal on the bean dregs, performing deep oxidation impurity removal on the bean dregs, performing cellulose fibrillation separation on the bean dregs, and preparing the bean dreg cellulose sponge, wherein the preparation of the bean dreg cellulose sponge comprises the following steps: dissolving and regenerating cellulose in a filamentation manner, regulating and forming a cellulose sponge pore passage, removing free ions of the cellulose sponge, and cooling and drying the cellulose sponge; the bean dregs are selected as the raw materials for preparing the cellulose, thereby avoiding the generation of toxic gases such as hydrogen sulfide, carbon dioxide and the like when polyurethane and polystyrene are used as the raw materials for preparing the cellulose in the traditional process, simultaneously improving the utilization rate of the bean dregs, and avoiding the problems of high cost and difficult large-scale application of cellulose dissolution in the traditional process by carrying out impurity removal operation on the bean dregs through alkaline solvent and oxidation treatment.

title_en: Colored polyester fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of colored polyester fiber, which comprises the following steps: (a) Fully mixing polybasic acid, polyhydric alcohol and a catalyst, and then carrying out esterification reaction; (b) In the esterification reaction process in the step (a), adding a liquid coloring agent, fully mixing and reacting, and then carrying out polycondensation reaction to obtain a colored polyester melt; (c) Spinning the colored polyester melt obtained in the step (b) to obtain colored polyester fibers; the preparation method of the liquid colorant comprises the following steps: dispersing a surfactant A and a surfactant B in a glycol solution containing pentaerythritol, adding a surface modified pigment, and carrying out dispersion, grinding and filtration processes to obtain the liquid colorant. The colored polyester fiber prepared by the invention has uniform color and good fastness to washing.

title_en: Automatic slotting and slotting depth adjustable device for corrugated boards
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of carton manufacturing, and discloses a device for automatically slotting corrugated boards and adjusting slotting depth. This a device that is used for automatic fluting of corrugated container board and adjustable fluting degree of depth, tooth's socket phase separation on through Z shape pole and the workstation, then promote the third slider and move, has loosened first dead lever when the adjustment staff, first motion pole then resets under the effect of spring leaf for Z shape pole and workstation joint once more, thereby adjust this structure to the distance of motion baffle and reached the fluting degree of depth and can carry out intelligent regulation and the wide effect of application scope.

title_en: Cooling device and cooling method for thermal printing head
abstract_en: The invention discloses a temperature-reducing cooling device for a thermal printing head and a cooling method thereof, wherein the temperature-reducing cooling device comprises a first shell, wherein the inner side wall of the first shell is in threaded connection with a second shell, the outer side wall of the second shell is provided with a black chromium coating, and the inner side wall of the second shell is filled with heat-conducting filling glue; one deck black chromium coating is electroplated at the lateral wall of second casing, then put into the inside of second casing with heat conduction filling adhesive, absorb the heat in the first casing through heat conduction filling adhesive and take place to vulcanize and solidify, conduct the heat conduction copper pipe rapidly with the heat of heat-generating body simultaneously, heat conduction copper pipe conducts the heat to graphite alkene board, then discharge the inside of heat follow first casing through heat conduction copper pole, and in this way, can be to the heat discharge in the first casing, thereby avoided melting of the material in the first casing phenomenon, and then avoided beating printer head's jam, and then can not cause the trouble of printer.

title_en: Intelligent textile fabric jet printing machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent textile fabric jet printing machine, which comprises a workbench, a conveying device and a jet printing device, the middle part of the workbench is provided with a conveying device, the upper end of the middle part of the workbench is provided with a spray printing device, the conveying device comprises a rubber plate, a sponge block, a first motor, a gear wheel, a round roller, a supporting plate, a supporting belt, a pinion, a sleeve and a positioning cylinder, the invention conveys textiles by the conveying device, simultaneously, the surface of the supporting belt is cleaned, the cloth after jet printing is rolled, textile scraps attached to the textile cloth are cleaned and collected through the jet printing device, and the textile cloth is sensed, when the cloth is hollow or made of cotton or hemp, the materials sprayed by the first spray head and the second spray head are only contacted with the part with textile fiber, so as to prevent the waste of materials, reduce the subsequent processing and improve the aesthetic degree of the jet printing of the textile fabric.

title_en: Non-woven fabric dyeing equipment and method for garment production
abstract_en: The invention discloses non-woven fabric dyeing equipment and a non-woven fabric dyeing method for garment production, wherein the non-woven fabric dyeing equipment comprises a dyeing box, a non-woven fabric dust removal unit, a buffer component, a quick-release component, a lifting unit, a dyeing agent dispersion unit and a power unit; the dyeing machine is characterized in that a dip-dyeing cavity and a color printing cavity on the front side are separated from the interior of the dyeing box through a partition plate, the bottom of the ground color dyeing cavity is rotatably connected with a dip-dyeing roller, two ends of the dip-dyeing roller are sleeved with limiting rings, a non-woven fabric dust removal unit is mounted on the upper side of the front end of the dyeing box, grooves are formed in two sides of the middle of the dyeing box corresponding to the position of the dip-dyeing cavity, and a buffer assembly is mounted in each groove; can remove dust to the non-woven fabrics in advance and handle, can avoid influencing the dyeing result to can avoid the pollution of base colour dyestuff, reduce the number of times of changing the coloring agent, and extrude unnecessary base colour rapidly after the base colour has dyed, then carry out the printing and dyeing of other colours, and the even of printing and dyeing can avoid unnecessary dyestuff to cause the dyeing pollution.

title_en: Preparation method of double-sided anisotropic non-ironing fabric
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of textile printing and dyeing, and particularly relates to a preparation method of a double-sided anisotropic non-ironing fabric. Coating waterproof slurry on one surface of the fabric in a scraping way, and drying; baking and finishing the fabric coated with the waterproof slurry in a scraping way; padding the baked and finished fabric with a finishing agent and then drying; and (4) baking and finishing the fabric padded with the finishing agent, and pre-shrinking and finishing to obtain the double-sided anisotropic non-ironing fabric. The invention has short production flow, easy operation and high processing efficiency, can improve the water absorption, the integral anti-wrinkle effect and the washability of the water absorption surface of the single-parent single-waterproof fabric, and is suitable for a large-batch and fast-paced production mode.

title_en: Automatic paper breaking type efficient printing machine and printing process
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic paper breaking type efficient printing machine, a printing process and a printing process, which relate to the technical field of printing machines and comprise a printing box, wherein one side inside the printing box is rotatably connected with a roll paper placing roller, a transmission mechanism is arranged inside the printing box, one side inside the printing box, which is close to one group of transmission mechanisms, is provided with a limiting mechanism, and two guide rollers are rotatably connected inside the printing box, so that the automatic paper breaking type efficient printing machine has the beneficial effects that: the automatic paper-breaking type efficient printing machine can cut off rolled paper immediately after printing by using the built-in paper cutting mechanism, can utilize the paper pressing plate to press and fix the paper while cutting off, avoids paper wrinkles when a paper cutter cuts the paper, enables the cut rolled paper to be sequentially stored on the paper placing plate, can enable the approximate height of the paper not to change due to the supporting force of the second spring, is convenient to take out the paper from the paper storing mechanism, and is more convenient to use.

title_en: Loose fiber dyeing process and matched dyeing treatment system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of dyeing processes, in particular to a process and a treatment system for rapid dyeing of loose fibers, and particularly relates to a loose fiber dyeing process and a matched dyeing treatment system, wherein S1, cotton splitting: s2, immersion liquid: s3, pressing cotton: s4, washing cotton for multiple times: s5, drying: s6, bulk materials are dispersed, and the dyeing process can effectively improve the coloring effect and the coloring uniformity of the bulk fibers and effectively improve the dyeing quality and effect by repeatedly pressing and dip-dyeing the bulk fiber cotton in the dip-dyeing process; compared with the traditional dyeing system, the structure of the whole dyeing system is more reasonable in structural design, and the whole dyeing process is convenient to carry out quickly and effectively; the loose fiber cotton after dyeing can be convenient for the weaving in later stage to use after the bulk cargo of drying, improves the availability ratio in loose fiber cotton later stage.

title_en: Gold stamping device for smart card
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent card gold stamping, in particular to an intelligent card gold stamping device; the automatic feeding device comprises a main machine and a feeding mechanism, wherein an opening is formed in the front side of the main machine, a driving device, a heating plate and a base plate are arranged in the main machine, the base plate is fixedly connected with the main machine, and the heating plate can be movably arranged above the base plate up and down; the driving device is arranged above the heating plate and is fixedly connected with the host, and the output end of the driving device is connected with the heating plate in a matching way; a separated type hot-stamping belt box is arranged in the main machine, and a hot-stamping belt circulation path on the separated type hot-stamping belt box is positioned between the base plate on the inner side of the opening and the heating plate; the intelligent card box is reasonable in structure, the card feeding device transfers the intelligent card to the conveying track, the clamp clamps the intelligent card to enable the intelligent card to be inserted between the heating plate and the base plate through the longitudinal displacement device on the bottom plate, the driving device pushes the heating plate to apply pressure on the hot tape and the intelligent card, the separated hot tape box can be integrally replaced, the usage amount is monitored in real time through the encoder, and the replacement is convenient, so that the influence on the interruption of a production process is small.

title_en: Parallel PET/PBT double-component anti-static anti-ultraviolet fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a parallel PET/PBT two-component antistatic uvioresistant fiber and a preparation method thereof, wherein the parallel PET/PBT two-component antistatic uvioresistant fiber comprises a first parallel structure and a second parallel structure, the first parallel structure is a PET polymer, the second parallel structure is a PBT polymer, and the mass ratio of the PET polymer to the PBT polymer is 0.5-2: 1; wherein the PBT polymer is a polymer of PBT polyester and conductive functional powder; the PET polymer is a polymer of PET polyester and an anti-ultraviolet auxiliary agent. The composite fiber has the functions of resisting static electricity and resisting ultraviolet, and because the antistatic layers of the skin layers of the composite fiber are uniformly distributed, the antistatic function of the fiber is equal to that of a conductive wire, the antistatic performance of the fiber is improved, and the core layer fiber is the PET fiber with the in-situ polymerization uvioresistant function, so that the mechanical property of the PET fiber is maintained, and the weaving performance is good.

title_en: High-speed spinning oil with high permeability and preparation process thereof
