abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-speed spinning oil agent with strong permeability and a preparation process thereof, wherein the superfine silk spinning oil agent comprises the following raw materials, by weight, 20-30 parts of vegetable oil, 1-4 parts of mineral oil, 5-8 parts of fatty alcohol ester, 5-8 parts of polyol ester, 2-5 parts of vinyl ether phosphate potassium salt, 2-4 parts of an antistatic agent, 11-14 parts of a wetting agent, 3-5 parts of an anti-splashing agent, 3-5 parts of polyether polyol ester, 6-10 parts of an emulsifier, 1-5 parts of coconut oil glycol amide, 5-10 parts of a penetrating agent, 1-3 parts of a defoaming agent, 5-7 parts of sodium carbonate and 20-30 parts of deionized water, and after the high-speed spinning oil agent with strong permeability is applied, the wetting permeability of the high-speed spinning oil agent can be optimized, the molecules of the oil agent can be rapidly attached and diffused on the fiber, so that the oil agent is uniformly attached on the spinning, the smoothing effect, the antistatic effect and the bunching effect of the high-speed spinning oil agent can be normally exerted, and the phenomena of fluffiness, spearhead, end breakage, winding of a roller tower, adhesion of equipment and the like of the fiber are avoided.

title_en: Non-woven fabric and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-woven fabric and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) Melting the raw materials of the non-woven fabric, spraying and drafting to form fibers, collecting the fibers through a collecting net, and then printing the fibers through a steel roller mill, wherein the temperature of the steel roller is 100-115 ℃, and the linear pressure is 50-80N/mm, so that the spun-bonded non-woven fabric with patterns is formed; (2) And (2) carrying out hot pressing on the spun-bonded non-woven fabric obtained in the step (1) through a hot smooth roller and a rubber roller, wherein the smooth roller and the rubber roller are arranged in an alignment mode, and thus the non-woven fabric is obtained. The non-woven fabric prepared by the invention has good softness, skin-attaching performance and air permeability, has less hairiness, and can be used as an inner layer of medical protection-grade fabric such as a mask, protective clothing and the like.

title_en: Corrugated container board processing spraying humidification device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a corrugated board processing spray humidifying device, and particularly relates to the field of spray humidifying, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a water collecting tank is arranged at the bottom of the bottom plate, a water outlet pipe is arranged on one side of a manual water tank, a water leakage net is arranged on one side of the bottom plate, an adjusting mechanism is arranged at the top of the water leakage net, a top plate is arranged on one side of the adjusting mechanism, a sliding hole is formed in the top plate, supporting plates are arranged on two sides of the bottom of the top plate, a water supply mechanism is arranged on one side of each supporting plate, the adjusting mechanism comprises a sliding rail bottom plate. By arranging the adjusting mechanism, the invention can use the paperboards with different heights and widths, can increase the application range of the device, greatly increase the economic benefit of the device, ensure that the spraying and humidifying degree of the paperboard cup body can be uniform, and prevent the paperboard body from being damaged when the paperboard body is processed due to non-uniform spraying and humidifying.

title_en: Mechanism for inserting paper slip forward clamp or rejecting paper slip backward clamp
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of equipment for producing paper bags, in particular to a mechanism for inserting a paper strip into a positive clamp or rejecting a paper strip from a negative clamp, which comprises a rack, wherein the rack is rotationally provided with two folding paper clamping components, the two folding paper clamping components synchronously and reversely rotate, the folding paper clamping components are provided with clamping openings, folding paper clamping sheets are arranged in the clamping openings, and the rack is provided with a folding paper clamping control mechanism for driving the folding paper clamping sheets to abut against the side walls of the clamping openings to realize a paper clamping function or driving the folding paper clamping sheets to extend out of the clamping openings to realize the folding function; the two folding paper clamping components are respectively a first folding paper clamping component and a second folding paper clamping component, and when the folding function of the first folding paper clamping component or the second folding paper clamping component is realized, the clamping opening of the first folding paper clamping component is just opposite to the clamping opening of the second folding paper clamping component. This application has the effect of the stability that reinforcing note was rejected.

title_en: Automatic switching device for printing gridding cloth
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of mesh cloth printing equipment, and provides an automatic switching device for printing mesh cloth, which comprises a supporting platform, a printing platform, a supporting assembly and a driving assembly; the printing platform is arranged on the supporting platform; the supporting components are arranged on the supporting platform and positioned on two sides of the printing platform in the conveying direction; the driving assembly is arranged on the supporting platform and used for driving the supporting assembly to move, so that the upper surface of the supporting assembly is higher than the upper surface of the printing platform, or the upper surface of the supporting assembly is lower than the upper surface of the printing platform. The supporting component can be driven by the driving component to enable the upper surface of the supporting component to be higher than the upper surface of the printing platform, and at the moment, the grid cloth can be printed; or so that supporting component's upper surface is less than print platform's upper surface, can print traditional material this moment, realized the quick switch-over between traditional material and the net cloth, and need not dismouting print platform, have switch efficient, easy operation, advantage with low costs.

title_en: Preparation method of antibacterial and antiviral fiber
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of antibacterial and antiviral fiber, which comprises the following steps of carrying out mixed spinning on polyester chips and PHBV according to the mass ratio of 10:1-100:1, wherein the mass percentage of the PHBV granules is 0.5-10%; the method comprises the steps of melt conveying mixed spinning → lateral blowing → bundling → stretching → tension heat setting → curling → loosening → setting → cutting → packaging, wherein the intrinsic viscosity of the mixed material is 0.2-1.5dL/g, the water content is 10-80ppm, the pressure of a spinning assembly is 120-170MPa, the spinning temperature is 270-290 ℃, the blowing temperature is 15-30 ℃, the stretching multiple is 2-5 times, and the tension heat setting temperature is 170-210 ℃, and the invention provides the preparation method of the antibacterial and antiviral fiber for improving the antibacterial effect of the fiber.

title_en: Intelligent automatic double-side jacquard seam covering equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses intelligent automatic double-side jacquard seaming equipment which comprises a disc cutter mechanism, a main frame connected with the disc cutter mechanism and auxiliary frames respectively connected to two sides of the main frame and arranged in a mirror image mode, wherein a cloth pulling assembly body is arranged on the main frame, step moving assemblies are respectively arranged at the left end and the right end of the main frame, a seaming machine, a synchronous belt conveying mechanism, a wire frame and a tangential thermal bonding mechanism are respectively arranged at the front end and the rear end of each auxiliary frame in a mirror image mode, the synchronous belt conveying mechanism is arranged at one side of the seaming machine, the wire frame is arranged at the upper side of the seaming machine, and the tangential thermal bonding mechanism is arranged at one side of the synchronous belt conveying mechanism.

title_en: Cell-phone production is with cell-phone casing pattern printing device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mobile phone production, in particular to a mobile phone shell pattern printing device for mobile phone production, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a U-shaped frame is vertically connected to one side of the bottom plate, a driving part is arranged in the middle of the top end of the U-shaped frame, a printing part is arranged below the driving part, a plurality of clamping mechanisms are arranged at the top end of the bottom plate below the printing part, driving mechanisms are jointly connected below the plurality of clamping mechanisms, each clamping mechanism comprises a horizontally arranged lifting shell, two ends of the bottom of each lifting shell are connected with the bottom plate through lifting plates, a water collecting box is fixedly arranged at the top end inside each lifting shell, four corners of each water collecting box are respectively communicated with and provided with a water distributing sleeve, a first piston plate is hermetically inserted in each water distributing sleeve in a sliding mode, a push rod is fixedly arranged at one end, far away from the water collecting box, of the first piston plate, sequentially. The mobile phone shell pattern printing machine has good positioning and loading effects, and effectively ensures the printing accuracy of mobile phone shell patterns.

title_en: Concrete and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of building materials, and particularly discloses concrete which is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 900-1100 parts of broken stone, 400-600 parts of fine sand, 150-250 parts of cement, 100-300 parts of water, 100-200 parts of filler, 100-200 parts of nickel-titanium alloy, 3-5 parts of water reducer and 1-3 parts of retarder. The preparation method comprises the following steps: s1, weighing broken stone, fine sand, cement, water, a filler, a nickel-titanium alloy, a water reducing agent and a retarder according to parts by weight for later use; s2, uniformly stirring the broken stone, the fine sand and the cement to prepare a mixed dry material; and S3, adding water and a water reducing agent into the mixed dry material, stirring for 5-10 min, adding a filler and a nickel-titanium alloy, continuing stirring for 3-5 min, adding a retarder, and uniformly mixing to obtain a concrete finished product. The concrete prepared by the method has greatly improved surface crack generation.

title_en: Rheology defined lignin compositions
abstract_en: The invention discloses an artificial derivative of natural lignin, which has specific viscoelasticity indexes capable of selectively assisting in processing the lignin derivatives into specific finished products. Such lignin derivativesIs characterized by its rheological indices comprising the minimum storage modulus (G' min ) Softening onset temperature (T) 1 ) And/or a cross-over temperature (T) from predominantly viscous behaviour to predominantly elastic behaviour 2 )。

title_en: Digital array chamber of clothes
abstract_en: A tool allows a user to create new designs for a garment and preview the designs prior to manufacture. Software and lasers are used to dress the garment to produce a desired wear pattern or other design. The tool may provide various ways for a user to interact with his designed garment, for example by means of images, in a special retail environment or in a virtual environment.

title_en: Heat seal lockstitching device for medical mask processing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heat seal edge locking device for processing a medical mask, which comprises a bearing table and an unloading mechanism, wherein the bearing table is fixed at the top of a support, a bearing box is fixed on the upper end face of the bearing table, a support column is fixed on the upper end face of a rotary table, a suction pump penetrates through a through hole, a first bearing frame is fixed on the right side of the upper end face of the bearing table, the unloading mechanism is arranged at the inner top of a second bearing frame, and a third electric telescopic column is fixed on the left side of the upper end face of the bearing table. This heat seal device of lockstitching a border is used in medical gauze mask processing, the layer board is provided with threely, and three layer board can be along with the revolving stage whole clockwise rotation together, convenient and orderly completion material loading, heat seal lockstitching a border and unloading operation, can put medical gauze mask on next layer board when carrying out heat seal lockstitching a border to a medical gauze mask, make whole operation more continuous high-efficient, and the device's degree of automation is high, heat seal lockstitching a border and unloading operation full automation, conveniently alleviate workman's intensity of labour.

title_en: Multi-stress sensing type intelligent electronic textile and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-stress perception type intelligent electronic textile and a preparation method thereof, wherein the textile comprises: a first flexible electronic textile layer, a second flexible electronic textile layer, and a capacitive textile layer disposed between the first flexible electronic textile layer and the second flexible electronic textile layer; the first flexible electronic fabric layer and the second flexible electronic fabric layer comprise elastic conductive yarns, the elastic conductive yarns are connected with the data collector, the capacitance signals generated by the capacitance fabric layer due to pressure are collected through the data collector, and the resistance signals generated by the first flexible electronic fabric layer and the second flexible electronic fabric layer due to tension are collected, so that the pressure and tension dual sensing of the intelligent electronic textile is realized.

title_en: Dustproof effectual fabrics intelligence processing equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of textile processing equipment, in particular to intelligent textile processing equipment with good dustproof effect, which comprises a horizontally arranged support mounting column, wherein two ends of the support mounting column are symmetrically provided with fixed mounting frames, the fixed mounting frames are respectively provided with a fixed mounting hole, the outer side of the support mounting column is horizontally provided with a movable mounting cylinder, two ends of the upper side of the movable mounting cylinder are symmetrically provided with movable guide wheels through mounting frames, the lower side of each movable guide wheel is in contact with the support mounting column, the lower side of the movable mounting cylinder is horizontally provided with a movable mounting plate, the device can adapt to different textile processing stations through guiding movement, the device can be closer to a working area through lifting guiding adjustment, the device can be more attached to the working area through swing adjustment, active and uniform flow guiding and multistage dust removal filtering are matched, and the dust removal quality and efficiency of the device in the textile processing process are obviously improved, the adaptability and adjustability are strong.

title_en: Rotary liquid eyeliner hair end hair scalding machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rotary liquid eyeliner brush hair end hair ironing machine which comprises a pen end workpiece, a hair end workpiece, a first workbench and a second workbench integrally connected to one side of the first workbench, wherein the top of the first workbench is rotatably connected with a rotary table, the upper surface of the rotary table is fixedly connected with a pair of fixed strip blocks in bilateral symmetry, one side of the upper surface of the rotary table, which is positioned on each fixed strip block, is slidably connected with a workpiece clamping strip, and the upper side of each workpiece clamping strip is provided with a plurality of clamping grooves for clamping a single pen end workpiece. The invention can directly carry out extrusion gathering type ironing on the hair workpieces, so that the ironed hair workpieces are gathered and attached, and the hair mold is not required to be heated in advance, thereby improving the energy utilization efficiency; the inner sides of the two electric heating cylinders are provided with the conical grooves which are similar to the shapes of the burr workpieces, so that the burr workpieces can be better attached to the inner walls of the electric heating cylinders; the ironing efficiency is improved through the rotating table.

title_en: Production process for ceramic or glass pasting high-temperature-resistant firing two-dimensional code or one-dimensional code
abstract_en: The invention provides a production process of a ceramic or glass bonded high-temperature-resistant fired two-dimensional code or one-dimensional code, which relates to the technical field of artware production processes.A high-temperature-resistant transparent coating frit is printed on water transfer paper by using a 100-mesh screen with 500 meshes, the coating melting point is 500-mesh, an ultrafine coating solution block and stained paper ink mixing oil are uniformly mixed according to the ratio of 1:0.4 to prepare solution block ink, an ink press with the pressure of 50-100MPa is used for uniformly rolling the solution block ink, then the printing is carried out, and the solution block ink is placed into a drying box and dried at the temperature of 45 ℃ for half an hour; the baked two-dimensional code or one-dimensional code is already fused on the surface of the ware, is not afraid of knife scraping and water bubble and is always fused with the ware; the two-dimensional code or the one-dimensional code produced by the process is a flow code or a special code provided by a database, so that the processing efficiency of the two-dimensional code or the one-dimensional code of the ceramic or glass product is improved, and the market demand of batch production is met; has high practical value.

title_en: Preparation method of low-basis-weight high-wet-strength fine dried noodle cardboard paper
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of low-basis weight high-wet-strength fine dried noodle cardboard paper, which comprises the following steps: pulping, papermaking and surface sizing. According to the invention, different types of nano-cellulose are added in the preparation process of the fine dried noodle cardboard paper, so that the formation of a net structure formed by crosslinking of a wet strength agent, surface sizing and fibers is enhanced, the wet strength of the fine dried noodle cardboard paper is further improved, less paper pulp is used under the same strength, and the prepared fine dried noodle cardboard paper has low quantification and thin thickness.

title_en: Quick dewatering device for papermaking
abstract_en: The invention discloses a papermaking rapid dehydration device, which relates to the technical field of papermaking dehydration and comprises a fixed frame, wherein one side of the top of the fixed frame is provided with a transmission component, a first compression roller assembly is arranged at the top of the interior of the fixed frame, a second compression roller assembly is arranged on the fixed frame and close to the lower part of the first compression roller assembly, a second bracket is arranged on one side of the fixed frame, a first bracket is arranged on one side of the second bracket, a switch is arranged on one side of the first bracket, the top of the first bracket is rotationally connected with a winding drum through a rotating shaft, and the two sides of the winding drum are symmetrically provided with winding grooves, the invention avoids the paper from being damaged by the arranged first clamping plate and the second clamping plate, is convenient for the wet paper to be arranged on the dehydration device, through the second support, be convenient for dismouting paper roll, then the new paper roll of more renew improves work efficiency.

title_en: Degumming and scouring of bast materials for textile and pulp quality fiber production
abstract_en: A method for degumming bast fibres, the method comprising soaking a source of bast fibres in a salt solution. The source of bast fibers may be soaked in a saline solution at a concentration in a range of between less than 1 to about 200 thousandths of a year. The salt concentration can be varied while soaking the bast fiber source, or by alternating the bast fibers between aqueous solutions of different ion concentrations. In one embodiment, the source of bast fibres is immersed in seawater, wherein the salt concentration is varied by alternating salinity with the tide. The source of bast fibers may be hemp.

title_en: Antibacterial cotton product and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of textiles, and particularly discloses an antibacterial cotton product and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method of the antibacterial cotton product comprises the following steps: step 1: firstly, winding the thread into a cloth cover, then placing the cloth cover into the antibacterial slurry for soaking and sizing, and drying; then, slitting and serging the product obtained in the step 1 to finish the preparation of the cotton product; wherein, the antibacterial slurry comprises 95-105 parts of basic slurry and 4-5 parts of copper ion antibacterial agent by weight. The cotton product of the present application can be used for dishwashing, which has the advantage of being able to be antibacterial.

title_en: Fancy yarn manufacturing device
abstract_en: An apparatus for producing a fancy yarn including at least a main yarn and a decorative yarn intermittently cut and interwoven with the main yarn, the apparatus comprising: a joining region that causes the decorative thread to follow the main thread; a main yarn feeding bobbin holder for feeding the main yarn to the joining region; a jet nozzle that supplies the decorative thread to the joining region together with an air flow; a cutter that intermittently cuts the decorative thread; and a twisting device that applies false twist or solid twist to the main yarn accompanying the decorative yarn.

title_en: Synthesis method of amino modified organic silicon polymer
abstract_en: The invention relates to a synthesis method of an amino modified organic silicon polymer, wherein the amino modified organic silicon polymer comprises x mol of a formula (I)) And y mol of a copolymerized unit represented by the formula (II). The synthesis method comprises the following steps: (a) removing low-boiling-point substances from the hydroxyl-terminated oligosiloxane of formula (III) in vacuum in the presence of a desolvation assistant until the solid content is more than or equal to 99.0 wt% at 140 ℃, and (b) carrying out condensation reaction on the hydroxyl-terminated oligosiloxane prepared in step a) and an aminosilane monomer of formula (IV) in the presence of a phosphate catalyst. The concentration of residual cyclic organosiloxanes (D4-D6) in the silicone polymers obtained by the process of the invention is less than 0.1% by weight and is in full accordance with the requirements of the European Union REACH regulations.

title_en: Combing machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to a combing machine (1) having more than eight combing heads, wherein each combing head is designed to be supplied by means of at least one lap or by means of at least one sliver from a can, wherein the combed fibers are integrated for each combing head into a respective individual sliver and are transported to a placement table (5), transported to a drafting device (10) and drafted into slivers, and placed in a can. According to the invention, the drafting device (10) has a working width of more than 180mm, preferably at least 200mm, at the nip line of the main draft.

title_en: Alloy milling cutter preparation is with handle of a knife water transfer device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of water transfer printing of milling cutter handles, and particularly relates to a water transfer printing device for a handle for manufacturing an alloy milling cutter, which aims at solving the problem that the existing water transfer printing device cannot rapidly manufacture transfer printing films with various patterns according to the requirements of people, so that the color and the patterns of water transfer printing are single. The atomizing plate sprays paint uniformly downwards after atomizing, the paint reaches the surface of the transfer printing film through the pattern transmission holes on the template, then the heating plate is started to dry the transfer printing film, and the transfer printing film is put into water transfer printing after drying.

title_en: Tank conveying system
abstract_en: A tank body conveying system comprises a rotary table and a blanking conveying line, wherein the rotary table is rotatably erected through a rotary shaft passing through the circle center of the rotary table; the turntable is integrated with a feeding station and a discharging station of the working procedure; a plurality of tank positioning positions are arranged on the disc surface of the rotary disc in the circumferential direction; the blanking conveying line is arranged corresponding to a blanking station of the turntable. The blanking conveying line is provided with a vertical conveying surface and a transverse conveying surface, adsorption holes are distributed on the conveying surface, and a negative pressure mechanism is arranged on the back surface of the conveying surface; at least two conveying paths are arranged in parallel in the longitudinal direction of the vertical conveying surface, and the area, facing each conveying path, on the rotary table is used as a blanking cross-connection area; in the blanking state, the tank positioning positions in the blanking cross connection area correspond to and align with the conveying channels of the vertical conveying surface one by one, so that the tank body of the blanking cross connection area can be separated from the rotary table and transferred to the corresponding conveying channels. The invention can effectively simplify equipment, reduce cost, and is beneficial to improving flexibility, improving capacity, reducing energy consumption and improving the consistency of product quality.

title_en: Preparation method of water-based self-adhesive anti-counterfeiting emulsion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a water-based self-adhesive anti-counterfeiting emulsion, belonging to the fields of fine chemical engineering and material science. The method is characterized in that a photochromic dye 1'- (2-hydroxyethyl) -6-nitro spiro (2H-1-benzopyran-2, 2' -indoline) and a soft and hard monomer are copolymerized to prepare the waterborne self-adhesive anti-counterfeiting emulsion, wherein the mass percentage of the photochromic dye relative to the total weight of the soft and hard monomer is 0.1-1.5%. The invention prepares the water-based self-adhesive anti-counterfeiting emulsion, and the obtained anti-counterfeiting emulsion is more suitable for textiles. The emulsion is adopted to print the textile, the printed fabric has softer hand feeling, the friction and washing fastness is both 4-5 grades, the printed fabric is changed from colorless or light yellow into red in 150 seconds under the irradiation condition of ultraviolet light (365nm), and the photoresponse speed is high.

title_en: Molded body of cellulose fiber and method for producing same
abstract_en: [ problem ] to provide a molded body of cellulose fibers having an improved tensile modulus, preferably also having an improved tensile strength, and a method for producing the same. [ solution ] A molded body X of cellulose fibers mainly comprises cellulose fibers, wherein the cellulose fibers comprise pulp P and open fibers C, and the open fibers C comprise microfibrillated cellulose. In addition, in the production of the molded article X, a slurry S of cellulose fibers is prepared from the pulp P and the opened fibers C, a wet paper is formed from the slurry S of cellulose fibers, and the wet paper is dewatered and heated under pressure. In this case, microfibrillated cellulose or microfibrillated cellulose and cellulose nanofibers are used as the open fibers C.

title_en: Polyester for heat shrinkable film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of high polymer materials, and particularly relates to polyester for a heat shrinkable film and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: uniformly mixing terephthalic acid, ethylene glycol, dicarboxylic acid, aliphatic diol and a titanium catalyst, inputting the mixture into a first reactor, and carrying out esterification reaction to generate an esterified substance; mixing a hydrophilic modifier, an antioxidant heat stabilizer, an antimony catalyst and an esterified substance, and then esterifying and prepolymerizing to obtain a prepolymer; and carrying out polycondensation reaction on the prepolymer to obtain the heat-shrinkable polyester. The heat-shrinkable polyester prepared by the continuous polyester process production line is adopted, the crystallinity of the polyester is effectively reduced, and the heat-shrinkable polyester has the advantages of high heat resistance, antistatic property, high shrinkage rate, high degradation resistance, high transparency and the like, and is simple, convenient and easy to control, low in equipment requirement, energy-saving and emission-reducing, and good in prospect.

title_en: Tailoring equipment used in clothing manufacturing
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of garment cutting, and particularly relates to cutting equipment used in garment manufacturing, which comprises a mounting shell, a knife sharpening module, a pressing strip, a chassis, a blade guide rail, a flywheel, a mounting sliding block, a swinging plate and a rotating column, wherein two swinging plates are designed on the blade guide rail; the two swinging plates are controlled to be opened to slightly stretch the cut cloth to reduce the friction force between the cut and the blade, so that the cloth can be prevented from being lifted upwards to cause cutting errors when the blade moves upwards.

title_en: Textile pigment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a textile pigment which comprises the following components in percentage by weight: branched acrylic acid resin 15-17%; 11% -13% of sodium nitrite; 6 to 8 percent of acrylic emulsion paint; 3 to 5 percent of surfactant; 9 to 11 percent of wetting agent; 65 to 69 percent of color paste; and the balance of water, the invention provides a textile pigment which has no glue light on the surface, small irritation, soft film forming and environmental protection.

title_en: Fabric winding device for spinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fabric winding device for spinning, which comprises a main table board, a dust removal mechanism, a lifting mechanism, a winding mechanism and an adjusting mechanism, wherein supporting legs are fixedly connected to the periphery of the bottom of the main table board, and cup-shaped supporting legs are fixedly connected to the bottoms of the supporting legs, so that the fabric winding device has the beneficial effects that: according to the invention, two duckbill nozzles with different heights and angles in the dust removal mechanism can uniformly remove dust on the upper and lower surfaces of the fabric, the lifting mechanism is convenient to drive the winding mechanism to lift, the distance between the winding roller and the two guide rollers is changed, the tension degree of the fabric is further changed, the fabric is prevented from being wrinkled, meanwhile, the equipment can be used for winding more fabrics at one time, the winding mechanism is convenient to wind the fabric on the outer side of the winding roller better, the adjusting mechanism is convenient to adjust the positions of the two adjusting rings better, so that the fabric with different sizes is limited better, the fabric is kept to be wound in the middle of the winding roller in a centralized manner, and the position deviation of the fabric during winding is prevented.

title_en: Scratch-resistant sound-insulation leather wallboard
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of plate manufacturing, and relates to a composite wallboard, in particular to a scratch-resistant sound-insulation leather wallboard; the technical points are as follows: the anti-scratch flexible leather-grain sound insulation board sequentially comprises a scratch-resistant flexible leather-grain woven fabric, a PVC board A, a high-molecular sound insulation felt, a PVC board B and a silencing pad from top to bottom; the preparation method specifically comprises the following operation steps: s1, preparing a scratch-resistant flexible leather check woven fabric; s2, preparing a PVC plate A and a PVC plate B; s3, paving the scratch-resistant flexible leather grain woven cloth, the PVC plate A, the polymer sound-proof felt, the PVC plate B and the mute pad in sequence, and laminating through PUR glue. The scratch-resistant sound-insulation leather wallboard provided by the invention has the advantages of wear resistance and scratch resistance, meets excellent transmission loss with high performance and high quality, meets the requirements of water resistance, sound insulation, wear resistance, scratch resistance and diversified styles, and has application value.

title_en: Preparation method of pore-diameter-controllable self-activated lignin-based micro-nano activated carbon fiber
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a pore diameter-controllable self-activated lignin-based micro-nano activated carbon fiber. Acid-method lignin is extracted from a biomass raw material by adopting an acid extraction method, the acid-method lignin is spun into precursor fibers by an electrostatic spinning technology, then the precursor fibers are pre-oxidized and carbonized, and the lignin-based micro-nano activated carbon fibers with controllable apertures are obtained by adjusting the pre-oxidation and carbonization process parameters. The carbon fiber prepared by the invention does not need subsequent activation steps, can be self-activated in the pre-oxidation and carbonization processes, and has higher specific surface area and better electrochemical performance. The active carbon fiber prepared by the invention has the advantages of simple production process, low price, controllable aperture and wider application prospect in the field of super capacitors.

title_en: Single-axial weft knitted fabric and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The single axial weft knitted fabric with high weft extension and high warp strength and the manufacturing method thereof are mainly characterized in that lining warp yarns are staggered and lined between sinker loops of weft plain stitch tissues in a parallel and straight mode, the weft plain stitch tissues are subjected to yarn bending and looping through knitting needles, and then a binding system is formed through threading and sleeving of coils, so that the purposes of high extension and high warp strength of products in the weft direction are achieved, the material can be used as an expansion pipe material for oil exploitation, and the requirements of axial reinforcement and radial high extension of the expansion pipe are met. The manufacturing method of the product mainly comprises the following steps: (1) the lining warp (3) of the row of needles (2) is knitted by the knitting yarn (4).

title_en: Conversion method for pretreating lignocellulose biomass based on hydrothermal coupling eutectic solvent
abstract_en: The invention discloses a conversion method for pretreating lignocellulose biomass based on a hydrothermal coupling eutectic solvent, which selectively separates hemicellulose, cellulose and lignin based on a green and efficient hydrothermal coupling eutectic solvent two-step pretreatment means. The three separated components have the advantages of complete structure, good biocompatibility, high utilization value and the like. Wherein, the hemicellulose, the cellulose and the lignin are respectively prepared into the high-value bio-based nano material: the composite material comprises carbon nano materials with high specific surface area (>2000), lignocellulose nano fibers with high crystallinity (> 70%), high aspect ratio (>140) and lignin nanospheres with core-shell structures and particle sizes as low as 100 nm. The full component conversion from low-value wood fiber waste to a high-value nano material platform is realized, the excellent performance of the prepared nano material is further explored, and a new way is opened up for the industrial application of the nano material.

title_en: Continuous open-width overturning and stacking steaming dyeing method for vegetable dye
abstract_en: The invention provides a plant dye continuous open width overturning stacking steaming dyeing method, which comprises the steps of sequentially passing woven cloth through a cloth feeding device, a padder, a steaming box, a washing box, a drying cylinder and a cloth falling device in sequence; the method comprises the steps of firstly, conveying a semi-finished fabric into a padder for padding a dye solution under the conveying of a cloth feeding device, then feeding the woven fabric into a turning and stacking steaming box for steaming, carrying out multiple overflow spraying feeding and multiple turning and stacking treatments on the woven fabric during steaming, then feeding the woven fabric into a washing box for washing, after the washing is finished, feeding the fabric into a drying cylinder for drying, and finally, carrying out cropping through a cropping device to finish the whole process.

title_en: Method for improving surface glossiness of blended yarns
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of textile processing, in particular to a method for improving the surface glossiness of blended yarns, which uses a blended yarn surface treatment device, wherein the blended yarn surface treatment device comprises a fixing frame, a plurality of wire grooves and fixing grooves, the wire grooves are symmetrically arranged with each other, the wire grooves are arranged at the top of the fixing frame, two ends of each wire groove respectively penetrate through the fixing frame, a plurality of fixing grooves are arranged at the bottom of the fixing frame, the fixing grooves are pairwise corresponding and mutually staggered, two windows are arranged on the inner wall of each wire groove, the windows are mutually corresponding and staggered, the correspondingly arranged windows respectively penetrate through the wire grooves and are communicated with the correspondingly arranged fixing grooves, spring telescopic rods are fixedly arranged on the inner walls of the fixing grooves, and fixing plates are fixedly arranged at the ends of the spring telescopic rods, which are far away from the inner walls of the fixing grooves. The method can quickly and efficiently wax the surface of the blended yarn after processing and forming, and is suitable for popularization.

title_en: Production equipment and production process of compressed facial mask
abstract_en: The invention discloses production equipment and a production process of a compressed facial mask, and the production equipment comprises a workbench, a controller and a pressing table, wherein an extension plate is uniformly arranged on the outer edge of the workbench, a mold is arranged above the extension plate, a first motor is connected below the middle position of the workbench, a base is arranged on the outer side of the first motor, steel balls are embedded below the extension plate, a support rod is arranged on the left side of the base, a discharge conveyor belt is arranged on the left side of the support rod, the controller is fixed on the front surface of the upper end of the support rod, a second motor is arranged at the top end of the support rod, the pressing table is arranged below an air pump, and a hollow box is connected below the pressing table. The four-station automatic production line has the advantages that the four dies belong to four stations, the four-station automatic production line is convenient for workers to operate in sequence and the production line is convenient, the workbench is circular, the overall occupied space is small, the layout is reasonable, the production efficiency is effectively improved, the production line is intelligent, and the automatic production line is suitable for popularization and use.

title_en: Three-dimensional subsides of infusion bag mark letter sorting all-in-one
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medical production automation, in particular to a three-dimensional labeling and sorting integrated machine for infusion bags, which comprises a labeling module and a sorting module, wherein the labeling module is connected with the sorting module through a guide plate, the labeling module comprises a feeding mechanism and a printing mechanism which are sequentially arranged, a counting sensor is arranged between the feeding mechanism and the printing mechanism to detect information of the infusion bags, the printing mechanism prints labels and performs labeling according to the detected information of the infusion bags, the sorting module comprises a blanking device, a sorting device and a plurality of material frames, and the infusion bags on the blanking device are put into the corresponding material frames through the sorting device. The invention provides an infusion bag three-dimensional labeling and sorting all-in-one machine which is simple in structure and can automatically, quickly and efficiently complete label printing and sorting work of intravenous drugs.

title_en: Structure for making vamp by utilizing recovered TPU and polyester covered yarns and processing technology thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of vamp preparation, and discloses a structure of a vamp made of recovered TPU and polyester covered yarns and a processing technology thereof, wherein the structure comprises the following steps: s1: leading out the core material consisting of filament chemical fibers into a covering yarn machine, meanwhile, finely melting the modified TPU composite material, and leading out the yarn covered with the modified TPU composite material through a circular thread hole; s2: cooling and coating, and then rapidly cooling the yarns coated with the modified TPU composite material; s3: dyeing; s4: and (5) drying and shaping. According to the invention, the modified TPU composite material is coated on the outer wall of the filament chemical fiber, so that the strength of the filament chemical fiber is further improved, a new weaving sequence is designed, the vamp with the inner layer and the outer layer is woven at one time, the inner vamp and the outer vamp are connected into a U-shaped tube, the weaving efficiency is improved, the production process is simple, the production efficiency is high, the air permeability of the vamp is good, and the knitted vamp has the functions of water resistance, oil resistance and fouling resistance.

title_en: Preparation method of environment-friendly corrugated base paper for fruit and vegetable cold storage packaging
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of corrugated medium preparation, in particular to a preparation method of environment-friendly corrugated medium for fruit and vegetable cold storage packaging. The preparation method of the environment-friendly corrugated base paper for refrigerating and packaging fruits and vegetables comprises the following preparation steps: selecting raw materials; (2) disintegrating; (3) screening and purifying; (4) washing and concentrating into pulp; (5) a streaming system; (6) forming the slurry on a net; (7) squeezing and pre-drying; (8) sizing; and (9) drying and coiling. The invention provides a preparation method of environment-friendly corrugated base paper for fruit and vegetable cold storage packaging, which can obtain the corrugated base paper capable of keeping high compressive strength for a long time in a high-humidity environment, is not limited by the number of packaging stacked layers, can well utilize cold storage space, and reduces storage cost.

title_en: Cotton yarn preparation combing processing system
abstract_en: The invention provides a cotton yarn preparation combing processing system which comprises a base, a steam unit and a drying unit, wherein a linkage groove is formed in the base; the invention can solve the problem that the cotton yarn needs to be secondarily processed because the majority of the cotton yarn is subjected to steam treatment during the combing processing at present, thereby increasing the workload and influencing the working efficiency; after steam treatment is completed, the existing cotton yarns are generally subjected to heating and drying treatment synchronously in batches, and then the processed cotton yarns are rolled, so that the drying effect cannot be guaranteed, the cotton yarns are easily wound, and then scrapping is caused, thereby solving the problems of production cost waste and the like.

title_en: Spinning process of airflow-imitating super-soft yarn
abstract_en: The invention provides an air-imitated type super-soft yarn spinning process, which comprises a machine body, a feeding bin, a discharging bin, a feeding roller, a first filter plate, a first slag discharge port, a first slag guide plate, a cotton loosening and impurity removing mechanism, a discharging roller, a second precise filter plate, a beating mechanism and an air blower, wherein the feeding bin is fixedly arranged on one side of the outer surface of the upper end of the machine body, the discharging bin is fixedly arranged at the upper end position of the outer surface of one side of the machine body, the feeding roller is movably arranged at the upper end position of one side of the interior of the machine body, the inner surface of one side of the machine body is fixedly arranged below the feeding roller, the first slag discharge port is arranged in the middle position of the outer surface of one side of the machine body, the air-imitated type super-soft yarn spinning process can reduce the phenomenon that the discharging roller is wound by cotton wool during cotton discharging, can effectively reduce the blocking condition of the filter plate, and can prevent impurities from being, the risk of secondary cotton cleaning of cotton wool is reduced.

title_en: Box device and box body make-up machine are detained in shaping
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of box packaging, in particular to a forming box buckling device and a box body forming machine, wherein the forming box buckling device comprises a flanging work station, a trimming work station, a box buckling work station, a blanking work station and a transportation assembly, the transportation assembly is used for transporting materials to all work stations for forming, and forming dies are arranged at positions of the transportation assembly corresponding to all work stations to finish forming box buckling of the materials; a box body forming machine comprises a forming box buckling device, a box cover pre-flanging device and a discharging device, wherein the forming box buckling device, the box cover pre-flanging device and the discharging device are matched with each other to finish corresponding actions of feeding of a material part, pre-flanging of a box cover, forming box buckling and discharging; according to the forming box buckling device, the side edge folding work station, the edge smearing work station, the box buckling work station, the discharging work station and the transportation assembly are arranged, so that the problems that in the prior art, when a box with a box cover is buckled, manual operation is needed, human resources are wasted, and material parts are easily damaged due to manual operation are solved, and the effects of automatic production, efficiency improvement and capacity increase are achieved.

title_en: Preparation method and application of glass fiber cotton filter layer and air filter paper
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method and application of a glass fiber cotton filter layer and air filter paper. The air filter paper prepared by adopting the superfine glass fiber cotton, the glass fiber chopped strands and the polyvinyl alcohol fibers as raw materials has the physical characteristics of high strength and low resistance, so that the ventilation and filtration efficiency is higher, the air circulation is accelerated, and the management and control on the indoor environment are more facilitated.

title_en: In-situ polymerized ZnO composite solid polymer electrolyte and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an in-situ polymerization ZnO composite solid polymer electrolyte and a preparation method thereof, and the preparation method comprises the following steps: use of KMnO under acidic conditions 4 Oxidation of the end groups of PEO to carboxyl groups, followed by addition of Zn (OH) 2 Reacting with the product obtained in the previous step, filtering and drying the product, and reacting with LiOH & H 2 O reaction, liquid separation and drying to obtain the ZnO nanoparticles generated by in-situ polymerizationA polymer of a seed; dissolving a polymer with ZnO nanoparticles and lithium salt in an organic solvent, and uniformly stirring to obtain a spinning solution; and (3) carrying out electrostatic spinning on the spinning solution to a receiver under electrostatic high pressure to obtain the in-situ polymerized ZnO composite solid polymer electrolyte. According to the preparation method, ZnO is generated in situ on the surface of a PEO matrix by adopting a method of combining in-situ synthesis and electrostatic spinning technologies, and then the ZnO is combined with lithium salt to prepare the solid polymer electrolyte; the prepared electrolyte has good electrochemical performance, thermal stability and mechanical performance, and has good application prospect.

title_en: Full-automatic word pressing machine for automobile license plate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full-automatic character pressing machine for automobile license plates, and relates to the technical field of license plate manufacturing. The license plate loading and unloading mechanism of the license plate word pressing machine is characterized in that the loading and unloading assembly and the license plate conveying plate are respectively arranged on one side of the word pressing assembly, and the matrix assembly is arranged on the other side of the word pressing assembly. And in the time that the blank license plate is placed on the license plate conveying plate by the feeding and discharging assembly, the mold pushing assembly can synchronously take out corresponding molds from the mold library and place the corresponding molds into the mold base, so that the simultaneous loading of the license plate and the loading of the molds are realized. After the characters are pressed, the license plate conveying plate is conveyed back to the upper feeding assembly by the first linear driving mechanism from the character pressing station, and the pressed license plate is taken out by the upper feeding assembly. Meanwhile, the second linear driving mechanism sends the matrix seat back to the matrix library, and the mold pushing assembly puts the mold on the matrix seat back to the matrix library. The license plate discharging and the die discharging are carried out simultaneously, and the time for discharging and discharging the die after character pressing is reduced.

title_en: Lustrous crystal polyester filament, preparation method and preparation device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bright crystal polyester filament, a preparation method and a preparation device, which comprise the following components in parts by weight: 3-5 parts of phthalic acid, 30-50 parts of polyvinyl chloride, 11-15 parts of ethylene glycol and 7-10 parts of tetrafluoro terephthalic acid, and also discloses a preparation method of the bright crystal polyester filament: through the structural design, the bright crystal polyester filament and the preparation device can dry the polyester chips, so that the using effect of the bright crystal polyester filament is improved.

title_en: Near-field direct-writing device for axial bending of winding structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of electrostatic spinning manufacturing, in particular to a near-field direct writing device for axial bending of a winding structure, which has the technical scheme that the key points of the near-field direct writing device are as follows: the device comprises an installation platform, a supporting component, an electrospinning mechanism and an adjusting platform, wherein the installation platform is used for providing an installation foundation for each part; the supporting assembly is arranged on the mounting platform; the electrospinning mechanism comprises a cylinder and an electrospinning needle head, the cylinder is arranged on the supporting component in a reciprocating manner in a vertical plane, and the electrospinning needle head is arranged on the bottom surface of the cylinder and used for spraying fluid in the cylinder; the adjusting platform is arranged on the mounting platform and used for receiving the fluid jetted by the electrospinning needle head. The invention has the advantages of strong applicability and high precision.

title_en: Cloth cutting device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cloth cutting device, and relates to the technical field of textile equipment. The cloth cutting device comprises a motor, a connecting shaft is fixedly connected to the front side face of a rotating shaft of the motor, a rotary disc is fixedly connected to the front side face of the connecting shaft, a protruding block is fixedly connected to the circumferential side face of the rotary disc, a first round rod is fixedly connected to the circumferential edge of the front side face of the rotary disc, a transmission rod is rotatably connected to the circumferential side face of the first round rod in a penetrating manner, a second round rod is rotatably connected to the lower end of the rear side face of the transmission rod in a penetrating manner, a sliding block is fixedly connected to the rear side face of the second round rod, sliding groove plates are slidably connected to the left side face and the right side face of the sliding block, and a connecting rod is fixedly connected to the lower surface, because the cloth can become flexible for the blade will roll the bending easily when touching the cloth, lead to the incision of cutting cloth to take place the skew, cause the problem of processing trouble.

title_en: Yellow board case with fresh-keeping effect
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of yellow board cartons, and discloses a yellow board carton with a fresh-keeping effect. The yellow board box is prepared from the following raw materials: 100 parts of raw paper pulp, 40-80 parts of straw pulp, 10-40 parts of diatomite, 5-20 parts of starch-based polyvinyl alcohol, 1-15 parts of vinyl acetate and ethylene copolymerized rubber powder, 1-10 parts of clove powder, 1-10 parts of chitosan, 1-10 parts of tea polyphenol, 1-10 parts of licoflavone, 1-10 parts of ethoxyquinoline, 3-15 parts of hexacyclic stone particles, 3-15 parts of loess stone particles, 3-15 parts of sodium bicarbonate, 1-15 parts of zeolite and 1-15 parts of tea polyphenol. The yellow board box has a good fresh-keeping effect and can meet the requirements of fresh-keeping transportation.

title_en: Device and method for manufacturing high-wear-resistance polyethylene fishing net
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device for manufacturing a high-wear-resistance polyethylene fishing net, which comprises a fishing net thread manufacturing device and a weaving device; the fishing net thread making device comprises a first thread spitting mechanism for outputting a base thread and a first material spitting mechanism for outputting a polyethylene raw material; the first spitting mechanism comprises a first spitting body and a second spitting body; the first material spitting mechanism also comprises a first driving mechanism for driving the first material spitting body to rotate by taking the first material spitting mechanism as an axis, and a second driving mechanism for driving the second material spitting body to reciprocate inside and outside the first material spitting body rotating track, so that the fishing net line production efficiency is high; the manufacturing method of the high wear-resistant polyethylene fishing net comprises the following steps: winding mutually staggered polyethylene wires on the surface of the base line to form a fishing net thread; the fishing net thread is woven to form the polyethylene fishing net, and the manufactured fishing net thread is high in wear resistance and tensile strength.

title_en: Release paper embossing device for water-based leather production and working method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a release paper embossing device for water-based leather production and a working method thereof. According to the embossing device, the embossing piece rotates to be matched with the embossing bottom plate main bodies on the two sides, alternate operation is carried out, and meanwhile, relative movement among the embossed release paper, the pressing plate main body and the embossing bottom plate main body is not generated in the extending direction of the release paper, so that the integrity of the embossing of the release paper is ensured, and the embossing efficiency is improved.

title_en: Needle translation mechanism of ribbon loom
abstract_en: The invention relates to a needle translation mechanism of a ribbon loom, which comprises a seat body, a carrying rod, a transmission wheel and a connecting screw rod. The seat body is fixedly arranged on the ribbon loom and comprises a channel extending in a straight line. The carrying rod penetrates through the channel, and the two ends of the carrying rod are located outside the channel and can move linearly along the channel. The driving wheel is driven by the driving device to rotate. One end of the connecting screw rod is pivoted at one end of the carrying rod, the other end of the connecting screw rod is pivoted at the driving wheel, the joint of the connecting screw rod and the driving wheel deviates from the axle center of the driving wheel, and pivots at two ends of the connecting screw rod are parallel to the axle center of the driving wheel. By arranging the knitting needle at the other end of the carrying rod relative to the connecting screw rod, the carrying rod can carry the knitting needle to move linearly back and forth, so that the edge of the woven belt can be smoothly folded; and the transmission wheel and the connecting screw rod are used as a transmission mechanism, so that the whole structure is simple and is beneficial to manufacturing and maintenance.

title_en: Cutting device for spinning
abstract_en: One or more embodiments of the present specification provide a cutting device for textile, including: the workstation, the support is installed to the workstation tip, installs the blowing roller on the support, still be equipped with the protecting crust on the workstation, the inside holding chamber that is equipped with of protecting crust, holding intracavity internally mounted have the drive roller, go up the drive roller below and be equipped with the drive chamber, drive intracavity internally mounted has down the drive roller, the drive roller side is equipped with the cutter down, be equipped with the through-hole on the workstation, be equipped with the shifting chute on the through-hole lateral wall, install the lead screw slider in the shifting chute, the cooperation of lead screw slider is connected with drive screw, still is equipped with the mount pad on the workstation, and drive screw installs on the mount pad, drive screw tip power is connected with driving motor, the lead screw slider is connected with the layer board, is equipped with infrared switch and. The manual participation degree is reduced, the working efficiency is improved, and the labor intensity is reduced.

title_en: Ink jet printing apparatus
abstract_en: The application discloses inkjet printing apparatus for printing an organic light emitting device, the inkjet printing apparatus includes: the ink-jet device comprises an ink-jet unit, an ink supply unit, a liquid supply unit, a negative pressure unit and a control unit; the ink supply unit is in fluid connection with the ink jet unit and is used for supplying storage ink to the ink jet unit; the liquid supply unit is in fluid connection with the ink jet unit and is used for supplying a solvent to the ink jet unit; the negative pressure unit is in fluid connection with the ink jet unit and is used for providing negative pressure for the ink jet unit; the ink jet unit is used for accommodating ink formed by mixing storage ink and a solvent and controlling the printing of the printing ink; the control unit is used for controlling the supply of the stored ink and the solvent according to the detection value of the ink jet unit.

title_en: Braided wire cutting device based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of internet of things cutting, and discloses a textile wire cutting device based on the internet of things, which comprises a machine body, wherein a cutting mechanism is arranged in the machine body, an electric push rod is fixedly connected in a protective box through a bolt, a base is welded at the bottom of the machine body, a connecting seat and a mounting seat are respectively welded at the top of the base, the connecting seat is positioned at the front part of the mounting seat, a winding mechanism is arranged in the connecting seat, and a wire collecting motor is fixedly connected on the surface of the mounting seat through a bolt. This weaving line surely cuts device based on thing networking through setting up surely cutting mechanism and winding mechanism, utilizes the interoperable between each its inside structure, reaches the automatic yarn to the rolling and carries out the effect of surely cutting, has avoided artifical mode of tailorring to be imprecisely, tailors the unsafe effect of length, reaches the effect of tightening to the yarn of the part of surely cutting when cutting off, reaches the effect of the yarn of being convenient for cut off.

title_en: Prussian blue-like derived metal oxide carbon nitrogen nanofiber flexible electrode material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a Prussian blue-like derived metal oxide carbon nitrogen nanofiber flexible electrode material, a preparation method thereof and application of the Prussian blue-like derived metal oxide carbon nitrogen nanofiber flexible electrode material as a lithium ion battery cathode material. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, preparing Prussian blue-like nano particles, and dissolving the Prussian blue-like nano particles and polyacrylonitrile in an N-N dimethylformamide solution according to different proportions to be used as a spinning precursor. The Prussian blue-like nano particles are dispersed on the surface and in the polyacrylonitrile fiber through electrostatic spinning to obtain a precursor film, and the CoO @ ZnO @ carbon nitrogen nano fiber composite material is prepared through pre-oxidation and carbonization. The composite material can keep a unique frame structure of Prussian blue-like nano particles to be used as a lithium ion storage, the carbon-nitrogen nano fibers can promote electrons to be rapidly transferred so as to improve the conductivity of an electrode material, and a precursor derivative material with a unique structure is embedded on the carbon-nitrogen nano fibers to form a three-dimensional conductive network structure, so that the composite material as a lithium ion battery cathode material shows higher reversible specific capacity and excellent cycle performance.

title_en: Yoga mat printing equipment for sports
abstract_en: The invention relates to printing equipment, in particular to yoga mat printing equipment for sports. The technical problem to be solved is as follows: the yoga mat printing equipment for sports is accurate in printing, not prone to deformation of the yoga mat and capable of reducing accessory loss cost. The technical scheme of the invention is as follows: the utility model provides a yoga mat printing equipment is used in sports, including: the top of the bottom plate is provided with a bearing mechanism; the top of the bottom plate is provided with the printing mechanism; the cylinder, stamp mechanism upper portion is equipped with the cylinder. According to the yoga mat printing device, the lifting mechanism is arranged, and the printing device and the yoga mat on the die plate move and coincide simultaneously, so that the yoga mat can be printed more effectively; through being equipped with the clamping plate, the printing machine when stamp yoga mat, the clamping plate can press from both sides the yoga mat tightly.

title_en: Screw head self-locking buckle for nailing machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to a screw head self-locking buckle for a nailing machine, which is arranged on the nailing machine with a rack and a sole support frame. The invention has the following beneficial effects: according to the screw head self-locking buckle for the nailing machine, the screwdriver clamping groove at the lower end of the screwdriver rod is buckled in a mode of matching the linear part of the spring wire at the upper end of the spring with the cutting groove on the screw head sleeve, the conventional steel ball buckling mode is not adopted, and the lock sleeve with the smaller diameter can be used, so that the lock sleeve with the smaller diameter can be used, the condition that the steel ball is easily abraded or locked by adopting a steel ball fixing structure is avoided, the failure rate of the nailing machine is reduced, the work is more stable, the nailing stability can be well ensured, and the performance is more stable and reliable.

title_en: Environment-friendly sleep-comfort mattress and manual stitching manufacturing process thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mattresses, and discloses an environment-friendly comfortable mattress and a manual stitching manufacturing process thereof, which comprise a jute mattress manufacturing step and key equipment, wherein a support column is fixedly connected to the bottom of a manual manufacturing table, and a height adjusting device is arranged at the bottom of the manual manufacturing table; through the lifter at manual preparation platform bottom fixed connection, can drive the lifter through elevator motor and go up and down, thereby drive the preparation platform of manual preparation platform and go up and down, simultaneously after going up and down to suitable position, drive the dead lever and pull back through bulldozing fixed handle, thereby drive the transfer line and begin to rotate, drive the closed loop pole and slide left and right sides afterwards, the fixed orifices has been seted up in the inside of support column simultaneously, through the joint each other between closed loop pole and the fixed orifices, fix the height of manual preparation platform, will block the inside that the slider inserted the dead lever after fixing, thereby fix the dead lever is whole, reach the effect of manual preparation platform highly convenient regulation.

title_en: Method for dominantly modifying carbon fiber surface by virtue of pearl-like layer structure by virtue of electrostatic acting force
abstract_en: A method for predominantly modifying the surface of carbon fibers by means of a nacreous layer-like structure by means of electrostatic forces, said method comprising: soaking carbon fibers into an excessive acetone solution for extraction for 48 hours, and then filling the carbon fibers and an excessive reaction reagent into a reaction container to negatively charge the surfaces of the carbon fibers; putting the aqueous solution of the carbon fiber and the flexible polymer into a beaker to obtain the carbon fiber with the polymer-rich surface; putting the suspension of the carbon fibers and the rigid nano particles into a beaker to obtain the modified carbon fibers with the pearl-like layer structure; and soaking the carbon fiber into an acetone solution for cleaning and drying. The invention reasonably constructs the nacreous layer-like structure by utilizing the electrostatic acting force, and applies the nacreous layer-like structure to the surface of the carbon fiber in an advantageous manner, thereby not only showing the respective advantages of the flexible polymer and the nano particles, but also realizing excellent composite effect through the synergistic effect between the flexible polymer and the nano particles.

title_en: Anti-counterfeiting card with uncovering verification information and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of anti-counterfeiting marks, and particularly relates to an anti-counterfeiting card for uncovering verification information and a preparation method thereof. The transfer printing film comprises a plastic film layer, a coating, a die-pressing holographic information layer, a transfer coating, a polyamide layer, a first printing layer, a pressure-sensitive adhesive layer, a holographic rainbow transfer layer, a first adhesive layer and a base material layer which are arranged in sequence from top to bottom; the holographic rainbow transfer layer comprises a laser molding information layer and an aluminum-plated layer, and the laser molding information layer is positioned above the aluminum-plated layer; the anti-counterfeiting card can be uncovered and is divided into a stripping part and a bottom retaining part, wherein the stripping part is a part above the transfer coating, and the bottom retaining part is a part below the transfer coating and below the transfer coating. After the anti-counterfeiting card is uncovered, the upper surface and the lower surface of the peeled part both display the hidden laser effect, the bottom part displays the rainbow holographic effect and the hidden laser effect, and a consumer judges the authenticity of the mark by identifying the hidden information and still displays the hidden laser information when the mark is adhered together; the preparation method is simple and easy to implement.

title_en: Replaceable printing device component and printing system
abstract_en: A replaceable printing device component comprising: a printing material reservoir, printing material within the reservoir, and a sensing system including an integrated circuit configured to connect to and communicate over a digital bus. The sensing system includes at least one sensor, a digital controller, an analog-to-digital converter electrically coupled to the digital controller, and a memory array electrically coupled to the digital controller. The digital controller is configured to generate a clock signal for timing operation of the integrated circuit. The operations include activating at least one sensor based on a value stored in a memory array and generating an output of the at least one sensor via an analog-to-digital converter.

title_en: Absorbable suture line and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an absorbable suture line, which consists of an inner core, a first coating and a second coating, and is characterized in that the inner core is obtained by blending and stretching polycaprolactone, poly (lactide-glycolide) copolymer, chitosan, genipin and tartaric acid; the first layer of coating is a tussah silk fibroin grafted polypeptide antibacterial agent coating; the second coating layer is composed of poly (lactide-glycolide) copolymer loaded thrombin-chitosan nanoparticles. Through the mode, the suture line disclosed by the invention has the advantages of higher strength, good biocompatibility, antibacterial property and hemostatic property, and the degradation time can meet the actual requirement.

title_en: Sewing machine shell bottom plate assembling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sewing machine shell bottom plate assembling method, which takes two needle plate mounting holes of a bottom plate as positioning references, adjusts the position of a shell to ensure that the measured value of the center of a needle bar hole of the shell is in an allowed range, and then adjusts the position of the shell to ensure that the measured value of the center of a vertical shaft hole and the center of a lower shaft hole is in the allowed range by taking a lower shaft hole of the bottom plate as a reference; and (6) finishing the assembly. The intelligent assembling device is applied to an intelligent assembling production line of a sewing machine, and realizes intelligent and automatic assembling. The bottom plate positioning reference is a positioning reference when the lower shaft hole is machined, compared with the existing manual assembly mode, the bottom plate positioning reference greatly improves the production efficiency, avoids assembly errors and can be produced in a large scale; in addition, the invention can use parts with different sizes and has good universality.

title_en: Toilet brush hair head forming machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a toilet brush hair head forming machine, which comprises: the operation panel, the top that the upper portion of operation panel was provided with mounting bracket and mounting bracket is provided with the pneumatic cylinder, the power take off end of pneumatic cylinder is provided with flexible connection between briquetting and the mounting bracket, the left side of mounting bracket is provided with the straining ring and the right side is provided with the conveying board, the inside of mounting bracket is provided with and tightens the corresponding through wires hole of ring. The cutting knife is driven to rotate by the driving belt, meanwhile, the side face of the sliding seat is provided with the connecting block, the connecting block is connected with the power output end of the first pneumatic push rod, the sliding seat can be driven to move on the fixed table to be in line contact with the brush hair of the toilet bowl to cut the brush hair of the toilet bowl, so that the brush hair of the toilet bowl and the brush hair of the toilet bowl fall on the blanking plate, the side face of the blanking plate is provided with the second pneumatic push rod, the output end of the second pneumatic push rod is provided with the push plate, the toilet brush is pushed out through the stretching of the push plate, and blanking is completed.

title_en: Heat-resistant back coating material for thermal transfer ribbon and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heat-resistant back coating material for a heat transfer printing carbon ribbon, which comprises, by mass, 2-4 parts of polyvinylidene fluoride resin, 190-220 parts of dimethyl silicone oil, 19-22 parts of methacryloxypropyl trimethoxy silane, 6 parts of dibutyltin dilaurate and 5600-6600 parts of an organic solvent. Also discloses a preparation method and application of the heat-resistant coating material of the thermal transfer ribbon. According to the invention, the polyvinylidene fluoride resin is added, so that the heat resistance of the heat-resistant back coating material prepared by taking the dimethyl silicone oil as the main component is obviously improved, and the carbon belt coated with the heat-resistant back coating material can be used at a higher printing temperature. The back coating material prepared by dissolving the polyvinylidene fluoride resin in the organic solvent has no pungent smell, simple components, good fluidity, uniform film forming and good smoothness. The invention has simple production process and low cost of raw materials, and can improve the heat resistance of the carbon ribbon and simultaneously consider the cost.

title_en: Net pulling machine and net pulling process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a net puller, which comprises a base, wherein the top of the base is provided with a workbench and net pulling devices arranged on the periphery of the workbench, each net pulling device comprises an X-axis clamping device, an X-axis moving device, a Y-axis clamping device and a Y-axis moving device, the X-axis clamping device and the X-axis moving device are arranged at the left end and the right end of the base, and the Y-axis clamping device and the Y-axis moving device are arranged at the front end and the rear end of the base; this kind of net puller's net device draws, through the cooperation between the first chuck of X axle, X axle second chuck, the first chuck of Y axle and the second chuck of Y axle, tensioning silk screen that can be even avoids the silk screen aperture inconsistent, improves the screen printing effect.

title_en: Clothing processing gloves heat-transfer seal improves device
