abstract_en: The invention discloses a heat transfer printing improved device for garment processing gloves, which comprises: the device comprises a base, a controller, a thermal transfer printer, a mounting rack, a rotating mechanism, a moving mechanism, a feeding mechanism, a mounting rack, a discharging mechanism, an electric conveying belt and a feeding mechanical arm; the thermal transfer printer is arranged on the left side of the top end of the base; the mounting rack is arranged at the top end of the base and is positioned on the right side of the thermal transfer printer; the rotating mechanism is arranged at the top end of the mounting rack; the moving mechanism is arranged at the center of the front side of the mounting rack along the front-back direction; the two groups of feeding mechanisms are respectively arranged on the left side and the right side of the top end of the moving mechanism through self; the blanking mechanism is arranged at the top end of the inner side of the fixing frame. This tailoring gloves heat-transfer seal improves device can realize the automatic unloading of going up of gloves heat-transfer seal in-process, need not that the staff is manual to take and place, when practicing thrift the human cost, operates simple and conveniently more, and labour saving and time saving improves gloves heat-transfer seal machining efficiency greatly.

title_en: Shoe processing technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of shoes, in particular to a shoe processing technology, which comprises the following steps: s1, processing the sole with the steel needle by using the sole preparation device; s2, cutting the sole processed in the S1 mode; s3, sewing the upper on the sole; s4, carry out the surface cleaning to the shoes that processing was accomplished, sole preparation facilities includes mould table, riser I, riser II, slip shrouding and line processing component, and fixed connection has riser I and riser II on the mould table, and the equal sliding connection in both ends of riser I and riser II has slip shrouding, is connected with two line processing components that can go up and down on the mould table. The sole preparation device further comprises limiting sliding frames and two-way lead screws, the two sliding sealing plates are fixedly connected with the limiting sliding frames, the two limiting sliding frames are connected with the die table in a sliding mode, the two-way lead screws are connected with the die table in a rotating mode, and two ends of the two-way lead screws are connected with the two limiting sliding frames through threads respectively.

title_en: Production is cut to carbon fiber with high-efficient processingequipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-efficiency processing device for carbon fiber short-cutting production, which comprises a feeding mechanism and a cutting mechanism, wherein a protective cover is arranged outside the cutting mechanism, a dust removing mechanism is arranged in the protective cover, the dust removing mechanism comprises a fixedly arranged dust hood and suction pipes which are respectively connected to two sides of the top of the dust hood, a discharge hole is formed in the lower part of the cutting mechanism, a material receiving funnel is connected to the lower end of the discharge hole, magnets are arranged on the inner side wall of the material receiving funnel at intervals along the circumference, and a vibrator is arranged on the outer side wall of the material receiving funnel. The invention can suck out dust from the protective cover in time, ensures the quality of short carbon fiber and avoids the dust escaping from the device to pollute the surrounding environment; the metal particles possibly existing in the carbon fiber short cut are adsorbed and removed, the quality of the carbon fiber short cut is guaranteed, smooth discharging of the carbon fiber short cut is guaranteed, and blocking is avoided.

title_en: Textile cloth cutting device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a textile cloth cutting device which comprises a box body, wherein limiting blocks are fixedly arranged at the left end and the right end of the top of the box body, a cutting mechanism is arranged at one end, close to each other, of each limiting block, and a single-door is hinged to the front surface of the box body; the cutting mechanism comprises a first fixing block, a hydraulic cylinder, a connecting plate, a spring and a fixing device, the fixing mechanism is arranged to clamp and fix textile cloth placed on a platform, the cut-off angle can be guaranteed not to incline, the friction force between the grinding ball and the textile cloth is increased due to the irregular shape of the grinding ball, the fixing effect is increased to a certain extent, the grinding ball can contract upwards when contacting with the textile cloth due to the elasticity of the spring, the contact area is increased due to the elasticity of the grinding ball due to the fact that the distance of contraction is limited, and the fixing performance is better due to the fact that the contact area is increased due to the fact that the grinding ball stretches towards two sides.

title_en: Micro-nano optical unclonable anti-counterfeiting mark based on electrostatic spinning nanofiber cloth and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of anti-counterfeiting, in particular to a micro-nano optical unclonable anti-counterfeiting mark based on electrostatic spinning nanofiber cloth and a preparation method and application thereof. The structure of the anti-counterfeiting mark comprises: the preparation method of the anti-counterfeiting mark comprises the following steps: the electrostatic spinning nano-fiber containing the fluorescent powder is randomly distributed on the substrate and then encapsulated by the optical transparent adhesive. The application of the anti-counterfeiting mark comprises the following steps: shooting random patterns of the electrostatic spinning nanofiber cloth by using an optical microscope, and performing artificial intelligence deep learning and memory to form a genuine product database; in the commodity circulation link, an optical microscope is used for shooting the anti-counterfeiting mark structure, and then the anti-counterfeiting mark structure is transmitted to an artificial intelligence database and is identified by artificial intelligence; and automatically verifying the authenticity according to the similarity of the artificial intelligence database and the genuine product database.

title_en: Preparation method of flame-retardant waterproof finishing agent
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a flame-retardant waterproof finishing agent, wherein substances with flame-retardant function, such as silicon, phosphorus and the like, are introduced into the flame-retardant waterproof finishing agent, specifically, a phosphorus-containing monomer is introduced into a polysiloxane chain segment, and then a miniemulsion polymerization method is adopted to form an emulsion, so that the compatibility and harmony of various components are improved, and the problems that various functional components are not uniformly dispersed in a system and are difficult to finish fabrics at one time are solved, thereby avoiding mutual exclusion between waterproof and flame-retardant performances and realizing a better effect of one-bath finishing of the waterproof and flame-retardant functions.

title_en: Novel benzamide chelate fiber, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel benzamide chelate fiber, which takes acrylic fiber as a matrix, benzamide as a ligand, triethylamine as a catalyst and DMF as a reaction solvent. The reaction steps are as follows: adding a matrix, a ligand and a catalyst into a solvent respectively, and then reacting by using a microwave heating method to obtain the chelate fiber. The chelate fiber is selectively adsorbed with Cr (VI) and is used for treating pigment waste water such as lead chrome yellow, zinc chrome yellow and the like.

title_en: High-strength low-extension printing silk screen and production process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-strength low-extension printing screen and a production process thereof, and the high-strength low-extension printing screen comprises a mounting frame and a fixing plate, wherein mounting slide rails are arranged on two sides of the inside of the mounting frame and one end of the back of the inside of the mounting frame, overflow grooves are arranged on two sides of the top of the mounting frame, connecting grooves are arranged on the sides, away from each other, of the overflow grooves, ink collecting cavities are arranged on two sides of the mounting frame and one end of the back of the mounting frame, guide pipes are arranged at one ends of the backs of two sides of the ink collecting cavities, a printing plate is slidably sleeved inside the three groups of mounting slide rails, a printing screen is arranged in the middle of the inner side of the printing plate, a metal film is arranged at the edge of the top of the printing screen, and slots are arranged on two sides of one end of the front of the mounting frame. According to the invention, through the mutual cooperation of the overflow groove, the connecting groove, the flow guide pipe and the ink collecting cavity, when a lot of waste ink appears on a printing screen, the waste ink can be treated in time, so that the printed patterns are more beautiful, and the printing quality is improved.

title_en: Preparation method of knitted fabric with moisture absorption, quick drying and unidirectional moisture conduction functions
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of textile fabrics, and particularly discloses a method for preparing knitted fabrics with moisture absorption, quick drying and unidirectional moisture conduction functions. The method comprises the following steps: s1, removing impurities from the cotton fibers, soaking the cotton fibers in a water clarifier for hydrophilic treatment, taking out the treated cotton fibers, drying and spinning to obtain hydrophilic cotton yarns; s2, removing impurities from the cotton fibers, soaking the cotton fibers in a hydrophobic agent for hydrophobic treatment, removing the treated cotton fibers, drying and spinning to obtain hydrophobic cotton yarns; blending hydrophilic cotton yarn and water-soluble fiber to obtain mixed cotton yarn, wherein the blending ratio of the clean water cotton yarn to the water-soluble fiber is 1: 0.3-0.4; s3, mixing the mixed cotton yarn and the hydrophobic cotton yarn 1: 1, mixing and spinning to obtain a mixed fabric; weaving hydrophilic cotton yarns to obtain hydrophilic cloth, and sewing the hydrophilic cloth and the mixed fabric to obtain moisture-conducting cloth; and S4, placing the moisture-guiding cloth in a cleaning tank, and stirring and cleaning to obtain the finished cloth. The cloth prepared by the method can be used for preparing clothes, and has unidirectional moisture permeability.

title_en: Plank stamp line equipment is used in furniture production
abstract_en: The invention relates to wood board embossing equipment, in particular to wood board embossing equipment for furniture production. The invention aims to solve the technical problem of providing the wood board embossing equipment for furniture production, which is relatively low in labor intensity of manual operation and high in efficiency of embossing patterns on the wood board. In order to solve the technical problems, the invention provides wood board embossing equipment for furniture production, which comprises: the mounting seat is connected to one side of the frame; the support frames are at least provided with two, and are connected to the other side of the frame; the collecting box is arranged on one side of the rack, which is close to the supporting frame; the rotating mechanism is connected between the frame and the support frame; and the pressing mechanism is connected between the two supporting frames. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: through the cooperation of slewing mechanism and pushing down the mechanism, can be quick carry out the printing decorative pattern to the plank, improve people's plank and carry out the efficiency of printing decorative pattern.

title_en: Composite nanofiber membrane with biological responsiveness and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of composite fiber membranes. The invention provides a composite nanofiber membrane with biological responsiveness, which is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by mass: 35-55 parts of quaternized chitin; 60-90 parts of silk fibroin; 4-8 parts of a crosslinking agent; 0.5-5 parts of an antibacterial agent. The invention also provides a preparation method and application of the composite nanofiber membrane. The composite nanofiber membrane has long-acting and remarkable anti-inflammatory and antibacterial effects, and the inhibition rate of the composite nanofiber membrane on staphylococcus aureus and escherichia coli is over 98.5%; can promote the wound to heal quickly, is especially suitable for the wound of a digestive system, shows different degradability in different digestive juice environments, and has good biological responsiveness to digestive juice.

title_en: Medical support and braiding method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a medical support and a braiding method, wherein the medical support is formed by spirally encircling and circularly braiding a braiding wire along an axis to form a first parallel wire group and a second parallel wire group which are interwoven with each other, the first parallel wire group comprises a first wire section and a second wire section with the same rotation direction, the second parallel wire group comprises a third wire section and a fourth wire section with the same rotation direction, and the rotation direction of the second parallel wire group is opposite to the rotation direction of the first parallel wire group. The medical stent is only provided with two wire heads, so that when the medical stent advances in a blood vessel of a patient, the damage to the inner wall of the blood vessel can be greatly reduced, and if the wire heads are treated, the treatment time is reduced due to the small number of the wire heads, so that the production efficiency of the medical stent is improved.

title_en: Production method and application of real leather and regenerated leather floor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a production method and application of a real leather and regenerated leather floor, which comprises the following steps: soaking animal hides in saturated saline water for 4-6 h; taking out the soaked animal hide, and directly performing unhairing treatment; tanning the unhaired animal hide to obtain leather; vacuum drying the obtained real leather to form leather; sanding the formed leather flesh side to reduce large fibers; putting the sanded leather on a wooden floor by hot pressing through PUR hot melt adhesive; replace wooden floor and other materials as the surface through the genuine leather, overcome timber apron anisotropy, the dry shrinkage wet swelling, the shortcoming of easy fracture deformation, genuine leather hot pressing after with above-mentioned sand light treatment is on wooden floor through PUR hot melt adhesive to spraying polyurethane seals to the opposite side, guarantees the connectivity between genuine leather and the floor substrate, does not produce the VOC emission that influences the environment, and the feature of environmental protection is good.

title_en: Method for cleaning sundries such as thread ends and fluff
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for cleaning sundries such as thread ends, fluff and the like, which comprises the steps of firstly, sending an article into a fluff cleaning machine from an inlet of a channel, opening a first sliding door after a first door opening sensor senses the article, and closing the first sliding door and a third sliding door at two ends of the channel after the article completely enters the channel; starting a fan to clean sundries such as thread ends, fluff and the like on the surface of an article; the article moves towards the exit direction of the channel, when the second door opening sensor senses the article, the second sliding door is closed, so that the channel is divided into a first chamber and a second chamber, the article is located in the second chamber without wind power, then the third sliding door is opened, and after the article completely moves out of the channel, the third sliding door is closed, and the second sliding door is opened. According to the invention, after the articles are cleaned, the articles are moved to the second cavity without wind power, so that the influence on air draft cleaning in the first cavity caused by opening of the outlet sliding door is avoided, the wind power loss is reduced, and the energy consumption is reduced.

title_en: Method for patterning nylon fabric
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for patterning a nylon fabric, and belongs to the technical field of spinning. The invention relates to a method for patterning a nylon fabric, which comprises the following steps: (1) laser pretreatment: according to the designed pattern, adopting laser to pretreat the nylon fabric to obtain the nylon fabric pretreated by the laser; wherein the power of the laser is 8-12 w; (2) dyeing: and (3) dyeing the laser-pretreated nylon fabric with pomegranate bark dye by adopting a direct dyeing method, and obtaining the patterned nylon fabric through color difference formed by the difference of the dye-uptake of the fabric before and after the laser pretreatment. The invention radiates the pattern drawn by computer aided design software to the fabric through laser, after laser treatment, the dye absorption capacity of the laser area is improved, the maximum color difference is formed after 12w laser and 2% o.w.f pomegranate rind dye are selected for dyeing, and the clear pattern effect is shown on the surface of the fabric.

title_en: Compact module for wet spinning of chemical fibers
abstract_en: A compact module for wet spinning of chemical fibers, of the type comprising: a spinneret (F) of 2 to 8 tows (S), each tow consisting of a plurality of continuous filaments; an associated supply pump (P) of the spinning solution; a coagulation tank (V) containing a coagulation solution; and a plurality of driving rollers (2) and a plurality of corresponding idler-type deflecting rollers (3) defining a zigzag path of the tow (S) downstream of the spinning zone, the liquid-based treatment being carried out on the tow (S) along the straight sections of the zigzag path. The straight sections of the zigzag path are horizontal and the liquid-based treatment on the tow (S) is carried out in a horizontal treatment tray (4) of the spillway type.

title_en: Integrated equipment is decided with cloth transmission to raincoat production
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cloth cutting, and discloses cloth conveying and cutting integrated equipment for raincoat production, which comprises a workbench, wherein a transmission mechanism is fixed on the surface of the workbench, a cutting part is installed in a cutting accommodating cavity of the workbench below the transmission mechanism, a feed box is fixedly arranged on the right side of the transmission mechanism, the feed box comprises a cloth outlet roller and a cloth collecting roller, a leading-out shaft is installed on the axes of the cloth outlet roller and the cloth collecting roller in an interference manner, a ratchet wheel is coaxially installed at the tail end of the shaft, and the mounting directions of the ratchet wheels on the cloth outlet roller and the cloth collecting roller are opposite and are linked with the cutting part. The invention solves the problems of automatically cutting the cloth and automatically supplying and collecting the cloth.

title_en: Package and method of making a package
abstract_en: The invention discloses a package and a method of making the package. The package comprises: a sheet of flexible film material folded in a longitudinal direction to bring edges of the sheet together, the edges being sealed to form a longitudinal back seam; a first end of the folded sheet is sealed by a first end seam and a second end of the folded sheet is sealed by a second end seam to form a space for the article, wherein the space is defined by the sealed ends and a sidewall formed by the folded sheet; an opening initiation point in one of the end seams, the initiation point configured to provide a point for initiating tearing of the flexible film material to form an opening; a tear control element configured to direct a tear starting from a start point in a longitudinal direction from the first end seam to the second end seam and across the sidewall upon application of a tear force.

title_en: Preparation method of sericin reinforced silk non-woven fabric
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of sericin reinforced silk non-woven fabric, which comprises the steps of firstly, degumming; carding by a carding machine; step three, processing the fiber net by a lapping machine; step four, fiber entanglement; step five, drafting; step six, drying and shaping at low temperature; seventhly, carrying out reinforced finishing by using sericin; step eight, drying at low temperature; the thickness of the silk non-woven fabric prepared in the first step to the sixth step is 0.15-0.30 mm; the concentration of the sericin aqueous solution is 0.1-60%. The silk non-woven fabric is produced by using the cocoon filaments, so that the additional value of the cocoon filaments is improved, and the degummed protein is fully utilized. The characteristics of fine and fragile cocoon shell silk are endowed with the characteristics of soft hand feeling and skin affinity of the silk non-woven fabric; the sericin reinforced silk non-woven fabric prepared by the process steps has strong toughness, is soft and skin-friendly, and can be widely used for manufacturing various sanitary product materials such as facial masks, face washing towels, wound dressings, operation pastes and the like.

title_en: Production method of powdery cellulose
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of preparation of high molecular compounds, and relates to a method for producing powdery cellulose, which comprises the following steps: s1, adding a low-concentration hydrochloric acid solution into wood pulp, and preserving heat for 1.5 to 2 hours at the temperature of 60 to 80 ℃ to obtain a slurry material; the mass concentration of the hydrochloric acid solution is 0.03-0.05%; s2, performing filter pressing on the slurry material, and collecting a filter cake; s3, drying the filter cake; and S4, crushing the dried filter cake to obtain powdery cellulose. The invention adopts a production process of preparing powdery cellulose by partially depolymerizing cellulose under the action of chemical energy and then crushing the cellulose by using mechanical energy. Hydrolysis of the fibers by very low concentrations of inorganic acids controls the degree of polymerization and partially depolymerizes the cellulose polymer. After the cellulose is partially degraded by the action of chemical energy, the molecular chain length is shortened under the action of the chemical energy, the strength of the cellulose is reduced, and the cellulose is more easily crushed by mechanical energy to obtain powdery cellulose with different levels of physical property indexes.

title_en: High-concentration mixed pulp grinding device for producing high-strength corrugated paper
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-concentration mixed pulp grinding device for producing high-strength corrugated paper, which comprises an outer cylinder, an inner cylinder, a scraping device, a driving device and a plugging device, wherein the inner cylinder is sleeved in the outer cylinder, the bottom of the inner cylinder is provided with a plurality of first through holes, the position of the side wall of the inner cylinder, which is close to the top, is provided with a plurality of second through holes with the diameter smaller than that of the first through holes, the driving device is arranged between the outer cylinder and the inner cylinder, and two groups of driving devices are arranged on the driving device. And the long fibers flow into the inner barrel, so that the secondary grinding of the long fibers is realized, and the grinding efficiency is improved.

title_en: Chewing gum box forming equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of gum box forming, in particular to gum box forming equipment which comprises a machine table, wherein a feeding mechanism and a pressing-down forming mechanism arranged at one end of the feeding mechanism are arranged on the machine table, the feeding mechanism can move towards the direction of the pressing-down forming mechanism, two shaping mechanisms are fixedly arranged between the feeding mechanism and the pressing-down forming mechanism, the pressing-down forming mechanism can move towards the direction of the shaping mechanisms, a right edge folding mechanism and a left edge folding mechanism are also arranged on the machine table, the right edge folding mechanism and the left edge folding mechanism are symmetrically arranged at two sides of the feeding mechanism and can horizontally slide on the machine table.

title_en: Method for recycling nylon with high relative viscosity
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for recycling nylon with high relative viscosity. The disclosed method relates to a method for recycling high relative viscosity nylon. The process involves melting a base polyamide together with a dry-blended mixture of a dicarboxylic acid and a second polyamide. The disclosed methods provide a means of controlling the relative viscosity of the combined polyamides, and in various aspects the second polyamide may be nylon plop or other polyamide having a high relative viscosity.

title_en: Face fabric conveying mechanism is used in gauze mask production
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fabric conveying mechanism for mask production, which comprises a splitting machine framework, wherein machine case platforms are arranged on two sides of the splitting machine framework, a first machine case and a second machine case are respectively arranged on the machine case platforms on the two sides, a first splitting cutter roller and a second splitting guide roller are arranged between the first machine case and the second machine case, splitting cutters distributed in an array manner are respectively arranged on the first splitting cutter roller, the splitting cutters of the first splitting cutter roller and the second splitting guide roller are distributed in a staggered manner, a first cloth pressing roller and a second cloth pressing roller are also arranged between the first machine case and the second machine case, a splitting platform is also arranged between the first cloth pressing roller and the second cloth pressing roller, and cutter grooves distributed in an array manner are arranged on the splitting platform. The invention is convenient for conveying the fabric for producing the mask, and simultaneously cuts the fabric in the conveying process, thereby not only improving the conveying efficiency of the fabric, but also avoiding the pollution caused by excessive yarn rotation of the fabric in the conveying process, improving the quality of mask production, and being beneficial to saving equipment resources.

title_en: Color bar net weaving machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of netting machines, in particular to a color bar netting machine which comprises a bottom frame, an installation frame, a driving device, a vertical feeding device, a transverse feeding device and a discharging device, wherein the installation frame is fixedly installed at the top end of the bottom frame, a plurality of warps with equal intervals are conveniently and vertically input through the vertical feeding device, the wefts are input to a weaving device through the matching of a conveying device and a positioning device, meanwhile, the wefts are conveniently and transversely input through the transverse feeding device, the wefts are introduced to the weaving device through a thread leading device and are cut through a cutting device, the vertical warps and the transverse wefts are conveniently woven into a net through the weaving device and are conveyed to the discharging device through a rebounding device, the woven color bar net is coiled into a net coil through the discharging device for collection, the weaving is time-saving and labor-saving, the weaving efficiency is high, the woven color bar net finished products are uniform, and the weaving effect is improved.

title_en: Metal screen printing plate capable of improving printing performance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a metal screen for improving printability, which comprises a metal screen main body, wherein a printing channel extending along the printing direction of the metal screen main body is formed in the metal screen main body, a plurality of transition yarns arranged along the extending track of the transition yarns are arranged in the printing channel, two ends of each transition yarn are connected to the printing channel, and each transition yarn is an arc-shaped transition yarn protruding in the back printing direction; the printing channel is linear; the middle part of the transition yarn is raised back to the printing direction; and the distances between two adjacent transition yarns are equal. This metal half tone multiplicable thick liquids crosses black nature, promotes half tone printing performance, and overall function is perfect, and the practicality is strong.

title_en: Heat transfer printing equipment
abstract_en: A thermal transfer printing device comprises a rotary workbench, a thermal transfer printing machine head, a feeding mechanism, a label tearing mechanism and a discharging mechanism; manually loading the fabric to be printed on a working panel of a rotary workbench at a loading station; the rotary workbench rotates and sends the fabric to the upper label station, the label sending mechanism automatically sends the printed label to the upper label station and places the printed label at the label printing position of the fabric, and the thermal transfer printing machine head thermally presses the printed label to transfer the label of the printed label to the fabric; the rotary workbench transmits the transferred fabric to the blanking station in a rotary mode, the label tearing mechanism tears off the base film with the printed label from the fabric, and then the blanking mechanism drops the fabric from the working panel to finish the thermal transfer printing process. The rotary worktable can provide the fabric to be printed with marks to be placed on the working panel in a static way without energy consumption; the label feeding mechanism is convenient for adjusting the position of the printed label so as to realize the purpose of accurately feeding the label and simplify the driving structure; the label tearing mechanism is simple in structure, can realize automatic label tearing and is high in operation efficiency; the reliability of the blanking mechanism is high.

title_en: Textile holding method and textile holding component
abstract_en: The invention relates to a technology for cutting textile to prepare a detection sample, in particular to a textile holding method and a textile holding device, which are used for holding the textile when cutting the textile.

title_en: Wig triple machine capable of being automatically adjusted
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automatically adjustable wig triad, which has the technical scheme that: comprising the following steps: a work table; three electric lockstitch machines for processing wigs, a traction device for conveying and automatically adjusting the wigs processed by the electric lockstitch machines, a gluing device for encapsulating the wigs conveyed by the traction device, and a controller for controlling the electric lockstitch machines and the traction device are sequentially arranged on the workbench; the electric flat seaming machine and the traction device are respectively and electrically connected with the controller; the end part of the traction device is connected with the rubberizing device in a meshed manner; the application has the advantage of automatically adjusting the traction device according to the specification of the wig.

title_en: Method for making crocheted pattern
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for manufacturing crocheted patterns, which comprises the following steps: (1) design of crocheting patterns and determination of tissue combinations. (2) And (4) performing simulation of crocheting patterns in Design software of a wool knitting Design system. (3) And confirming and importing the pattern organization file in Design software of a wool knitting Design system. (4) And (4) manufacturing the weaving and machining file, wherein the manufacturing is finished in Knittpaint programming software of a hair needle design system. (5) And importing the exported on-machine knitting file to a computerized flat knitting machine with a corresponding needle type, setting specific numerical values for parameter values, and starting the equipment for knitting, wherein the flat knitting machine at least comprises a front needle bed and a back needle bed, at least one needle bed can move left and right and has a needle turning function, at least one system is provided, and the number of the yarn nozzles is 4 or more. The method saves time, labor and materials, and the effect of the manufactured crocheted pattern is close to that of a manual crocheted pattern.

title_en: Preparation method and application of sealing paper
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method and application of sealing paper, wherein the preparation method of the sealing paper comprises the following steps: preparing mixed slurry of plant fibers and synthetic fibers, adding a wet strength enhancer, uniformly mixing, diluting the slurry for the first time until the mass concentration is 1.5-2.5%, adding a sizing agent, uniformly mixing, diluting the slurry for the second time until the concentration is 0.08-0.7%, adding a dispersing agent, and uniformly mixing; carrying out net-surfing papermaking treatment on the mixed pulp to obtain a formed wet paper sheet; sequentially squeezing, dehydrating and drying the formed wet paper sheet until the water content of the paper sheet is 3.0-8.0% to obtain raw paper; preparing a sizing agent containing an oil-repellent agent, coating the sizing agent on the surface of base paper, drying and coiling to obtain the base paper. The sealing paper is used for sealing the cigarette cartridge of the non-combustible heated cigarette, and can effectively prevent the sealing paper from completely or partially falling off in the process of bonding with an empty tube or in the process of placing. In addition, the sealing paper has good anti-seepage and air permeability.

title_en: Regenerated cellulose fiber nonwoven fabric, sheet impregnated with chemical solution, and mask
abstract_en: Provided are a nonwoven fabric which has excellent handleability when wet even at low basis weight, high adhesion, and excellent skin feel, and a product using the same, for example, a sheet impregnated with a chemical solution. The nonwoven fabric of the present invention is characterized by comprising regenerated cellulose fibers having a fiber diameter of 0.5-10.0 [ mu ] m, wherein the nonwoven fabric has a surface roughness of 100 [ mu ] m or less in a dry state, a texture index of 250 or less in a dry state, and an initial tensile strength of 0.25-0.75N/50 mm in the weft direction of the nonwoven fabric when wet.

title_en: Cloth with antibiotic and remove mite function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cloth with antibacterial and mite removing functions, which comprises an inner layer and a surface layer compounded on the outer side surface of the inner layer, wherein the surface layer comprises the following components in parts by weight: the inner layer is formed by blending a first weaving line, a second weaving line and a third weaving line, the first weaving line and the second weaving line are warp threads, and the third weaving line is weft threads; the first weaving line is formed by blending polyester fiber filament A, cotton filament and Tencel fiber filament; the second weaving line is formed by blending polyester fiber filament B, hemp filament and wool filament; the third weaving line is formed by blending viscose fiber filaments and polyester fiber filaments C. This cloth with antibiotic and remove mite function, cloth simple structure directly changes cloth spinning raw materials on current cloth production basis, weaves through the blending and forms, can guarantee antibiotic effect and remove mite function etc. guarantees the structural performance of cloth simultaneously, increases thermal insulation performance, guarantees the travelling comfort of dress, is favorable to increasing output, reduce cost simultaneously.

title_en: Vertical type steaming, micro-spraying, pulping, screening and pulp washing integrated machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to a vertical type integrated machine for cooking, micro-jet pulping, screening and washing pulp, which comprises a vertical type pulp cooking function part, a micro-jet pulping function part, a pulp screening function part and a pulp washing function part. Straw slurry enters the inner barrel of the all-in-one machine from the feed inlet, the straw slurry is steamed and boiled in the inner barrel, after the technological requirement is met, the servo motor rotates positively through the ratchet wheel conical grinding disc, the slurry is sprayed into the conical grinding disc through the micro-spraying opening, the ground slurry falls between the pulp washing barrel and the outer barrel through the screen of the screening device, the knot and impurities are discharged through the discharge opening, the screen for pulp washing is integrated with the upper part of the grinding disc on the outer side of the inner barrel, the servo motor rotates reversely and the reverse ratchet wheel drives the pulp washing barrel to rotate together, the inner barrel of the pulp washing barrel is vacuumized and washed, the wall of the outer barrel is provided with a scraper, and the slurry is discharged from the feed port through the spiral feeder. The invention combines the steps of cooking, micro-jet pulping and screening and washing into one device, thereby improving the working efficiency of pulping, reducing energy consumption and reducing the field requirement.

title_en: Fiber structure manufacturing device, fiber structure manufacturing method, and fiber structure
abstract_en: The invention provides a fiber structure manufacturing device, a fiber structure manufacturing method and a fiber structure. A fiber structure manufacturing device (1) is provided with: a deposition unit (60) for depositing a material containing a resin and fibers in a gas to produce a fiber web (Pw); a conveying unit (120) that conveys the produced fiber web (Pw) in a conveying direction; and a heating and pressurizing unit (100) for pressurizing the transported fiber web (Pw) by the heated lower plate (101) and upper plate (102) and melting the resin, wherein the transportation by the transporting unit (120) and the pressurizing by the heating and pressurizing unit (100) are alternately repeated at a predetermined interval shorter than the length of the plates in the transporting direction, thereby forming a liquid absorbent material (Po) having a first region (P1) in which the pressurizing is performed a predetermined number of times and a second region (P2) in which the pressurizing is performed a number of times greater than the predetermined number of times.

title_en: Aqueous inkjet ink, aqueous inkjet ink set, method for producing aqueous inkjet ink printed matter, and printed matter
abstract_en: An aqueous inkjet ink comprising a pigment, a binder resin, a water-soluble organic solvent, a surfactant and water, wherein the binder resin comprises a water-based resin having a structure derived from an acid group-containing ethylenically unsaturated monomer and a structure derived from a hydroxyl group-containing ethylenically unsaturated monomer as constituent units, the resin has a weight average molecular weight of 5,000 to 45,000 and a glass transition temperature of 35 to 110 ℃, and the water-soluble organic solvent comprises SPThe value is 8.5 to 13 (cal/cm) 3 ) 1/2 The first water-soluble organic solvent (2) does not contain a second water-soluble organic solvent having a boiling point of 235 ℃ or higher under 1 atm, and the surfactant contains an acetylene-based surfactant.

title_en: Wool blended woven right twill small jacquard fabric and weaving process thereof
abstract_en: A wool blended weaving right twill mini-jacquard fabric and a weaving process thereof are used for weaving the right twill mini-jacquard fabric, the warp yarn of the fabric is cation polyester fiber, namely Jacell's fiber, 18.4tex compact siro spinning yarn with the wool fiber being 45; the warp density of the fabric is 464.5 per 10 cm of warp in-direction warp yarns, and the weft density of the fabric is 295 per 10 cm of warp in-direction weft yarns; the width of the cloth width is 208.5 cm; the fabric weave is 2-over-2-down-right twill; the weaving process comprises warping, slashing, denting and weaving. The invention adopts five fiber blending to weave the jacquard fabric by different warp and weft yarns, the fabric integrates the characteristics of the five fibers into a whole, so that the fabric feels more comfortable, is more suitable for dyeing of deep color dye, and can be widely applied to the production of high-grade uniform.

title_en: Leather shoveling machine for processing rough edges in leather cutting process and processing technology thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of leather shoveling machine processing, and discloses a leather shoveling machine for processing rough edges in the leather cutting process, which comprises a leather shoveling machine, wherein a protective shell is fixedly arranged at the top end of the leather shoveling machine, a sliding plate is slidably arranged at the top end of the protective shell, a side plate is fixedly arranged at the top end of the sliding plate, a sliding rod is inserted into the side plate, a rotating plate is fixedly arranged at the outer side of the sliding rod, a sleeve ring is sleeved at the outer side of the sliding rod, an inner rod is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the sleeve ring, a bottom plate is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the inner rod, a compression spring is fixedly arranged at the top end of the bottom plate, a positioning plate is fixedly arranged at the top end of the positioning plate, rotary seats are fixedly arranged at the top end of the top plate and the bottom end of the bottom plate, clamping rods are slidably arranged at the left side of the rotary seats, leather is clamped by fixed clamping equipment, and simultaneously, a determined track is utilized for moving, the operation safety is improved, and meanwhile, the movement is more stable.

title_en: Soil restoration material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a soil restoration material which is characterized by being prepared by adopting the following process (1) KMnO  4  And MnSO  4  Dissolving polyacrylonitrile in ethylene glycol, then adding ethylene diamine tetraacetic acid, and uniformly mixing to form electrostatic spinning external liquid; (2) Dissolving polyethylene glycol in ethylene glycol, and uniformly mixing to form an electrostatic spinning internal solution; (3) Coaxial electrostatic spinning is carried out on the external liquid and the internal liquid, and then heat treatment is carried out under the air atmosphere, so as to obtain the beta-MnO with hollow morphology  2  A nanofiber; (4) Dissolving ferrous chloride, tetrabutyl titanate and ethanolamine in deionized water to form a mixed solution, and then adding beta-MnO with hollow morphology  2  Soaking the nanofiber in the mixed solution, and reacting for 10-12h at 90-120 ℃ under ultrasonic condition to obtain beta-MnO  2  ‑Fe  2  O  3  ‑TiO  2  The nanofiber, the soil remediation material disclosed by the application, has high-efficiency removal efficiency on heavy metals and organic pollutants in soil.

title_en: Spinning method for regenerating nylon 66 fibers based on air bag leftover materials
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of spinning, and relates to a spinning method for regenerating nylon 66 fibers based on air bag leftover materials, which comprises the following steps: adding the leftover materials of the nylon 66 safety airbag, which is subjected to polyethylene film removal and crushing, into a first extruder for extrusion granulation to obtain regenerated nylon 66 slices; the regenerated nylon 66 slices are subjected to continuous circulating nitrogen gas dehumidification under the protection of a molecular sieve to obtain dry regenerated nylon 66 slices; and mixing the dried regenerated nylon 66 slices with the auxiliary agent, adding the mixture into a second extruder, carrying out melt extrusion, and then spinning to obtain regenerated nylon 66 fibers. The invention eliminates the water and impurities in the air bag leftover materials in an environment-friendly way to eliminate the influence of the air bag leftover materials on the mechanical property of the regenerated nylon 66 fiber, simultaneously avoids the oxidation reaction of the nylon 66 slices under the corresponding drying temperature condition, improves the quality of the product and keeps the original color of the product, and is added with the auxiliary agent for melting to obtain good performance.

title_en: Intelligent sewing device for cuff and using method thereof
abstract_en: The utility model provides a device is made up to intelligence of cuff vent, gets the transportation platform unit including pressing from both sides to and along the horizontal left preliminary treatment station that sets gradually, left folding station, centre joint system station, right folding station, right preliminary treatment station, all set up a preliminary treatment unit on left side preliminary treatment station, the right folding station, all set up a folding unit on left side folding station, the right folding station, be provided with just right needle from top to bottom on the well station of making up, make up the bottom plate, when using, the preliminary treatment unit is responsible for providing door cuff vent preliminary treatment cloth piece, and the preliminary treatment unit is responsible for providing the cloth piece combination, and centre joint system station and clamp get horizontal, the longitudinal movement device in the transportation platform unit to and presser foot ware are mutually supported, in order to accomplish the cloth piece and close the sewing of a plurality of sides. The sewing procedure is mostly completed by a machine, the intelligent degree is higher, the sewing efficiency is higher, and the labor intensity is lower.

title_en: Cloth pressing device for weaving pleated cloth
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cloth pressing devices and discloses a cloth pressing device for weaving pleated cloth. This a cloth pressing device for machine weaving pleat cloth, when reciprocating cloth upper end locating plate through driving cloth upper end locating plate, can drive cloth upper end locating plate shift position and inject, when bottom slurcam removes, drive the removal of pleat degree of depth locating plate, pleat degree of depth locating plate drives cloth upper end locating plate and removes, carry out simultaneous movement between drive cloth upper end locating plate and the pleat degree of depth locating plate, it extrudees the cloth of being injectd to pleat degree of depth locating plate upper portion to continuously drive cloth upper end locating plate, and influence cloth skew appears when reducing to remove, increase the efficiency when using when cloth pleat is handled.

title_en: Damp-proof thermal fuse and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a damp-proof thermal fuse and a preparation method thereof, the damp-proof thermal fuse comprises a winding ring, the outer wall of the winding ring is wound with a thermal fuse, the outer wall of the thermal fuse is fixedly provided with damp-proof gel, the damp-proof gel is expandable polystyrene, and the damp-proof gel comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: the invention relates to a thermal fuse, which comprises 100-120 parts of styrene monomer, 100-120 parts of pure water, 0.4-0.6 part of initiator, 0.1-0.15 part of dispersant and 5-6 parts of foaming agent, wherein the surface of the thermal fuse is coated with a layer of expandable polystyrene, which can protect the thermal fuse, and the melting point of the expandable polystyrene is lower than that of the thermal fuse, so that the thermal fuse can be prevented from being affected during heating, the thermal fuse has higher adhesiveness, the adhesion of the thermal fuse is more convenient, the use by personnel is more convenient, and the expandable polystyrene has better waterproofness, thereby preventing the thermal fuse from being damaged due to the influence of moisture during storage and protecting the property of personnel.

title_en: Selectable fill modes for printing devices having reservoirs fillable from an external colorant supply
abstract_en: A printing device has a reservoir of colorant that is fillable from an external colorant supply that is temporarily connectable to the printing device. Selectable fill modes of the reservoir are enabled from a plurality of fill modes. The fill mode includes a limited fill mode in which the reservoir is filled from the external colorant supply in response to determining that the external colorant supply may be emptied into the reservoir. The fill mode includes an unrestricted fill mode in which the reservoir is filled from the external supply regardless of whether the external colorant supply is able to empty into the reservoir. In response to the temporary connection of the external colorant supply, the printing device controls filling of the reservoir from the external colorant supply according to the selected filling mode.

title_en: Waist rope feeding and conveying device of bowing rope sewing machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a waist rope feeding and conveying device of a bowing rope sewing machine, which comprises a waist rope feeding mechanism, a rotary pulling mechanism, a feeding mechanism and a rotary clamping mechanism which are arranged on a frame, wherein the waist rope feeding mechanism comprises a feeding guide rail for conveying waist ropes, a feeding roller and a feeding motor for driving the feeding of the waist ropes, and a cutting assembly for cutting out the output waist rope part of the feeding guide rail. The feeding mechanism comprises a first feeding mechanism for clamping the head of the waist rope and a second feeding mechanism for clamping the tail of the waist rope, and the first feeding mechanism and the second feeding mechanism respectively send the head and the tail of the waist rope to the rotary clamping mechanism. The rotary clamping mechanism comprises a rotary clamping installation seat, two bearing seats are arranged side by side in the rotary clamping installation seat, a first rotating shaft capable of rotating is arranged in each bearing seat, the front end of the first rotating shaft is connected with a coil clamping device, and the tail end of the first rotating shaft is connected with a rotary driving motor through a rotary transmission assembly.

title_en: Ink supply system of ink-jet printer
abstract_en: The invention relates to an ink supply system of an ink-jet printer, which comprises an ink storage module, an ink supply module, a flushing module and a plurality of nozzles. The ink storage module includes: a first ink tank and a second ink tank. An ink pump is arranged on a pipeline connecting the first ink barrel and the second ink barrel, and the ink pump can pump ink in the first ink barrel to the second ink barrel. The ink supply module comprises a buffer bin and an ink distributing rail. The inlet of the buffer bin is connected with the outlet of the second ink barrel, and the outlet of the buffer bin is connected with the ink inlet of the ink distributing rail. The ink distributing rail is provided with a flushing port and a plurality of ink outlets, an ink distributing cavity communicated with the ink inlet, the ink outlet and the flushing port is arranged in the ink distributing rail, and the ink outlets are correspondingly connected with the spray heads one by one through pipelines. The flushing module is connected with the flushing port on the ink distributing rail through a pipeline, ink is stored in the flushing module, and the flushing module can inject the ink from the flushing port into the ink distributing cavity, so that the ink in the ink distributing cavity is sprayed out of the spray head.

title_en: Bulletproof military helmet composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bulletproof military helmet composite material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: preparing 10-15% of high-performance carbon fiber, 20-30% of aramid fiber, 15-20% of ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene fiber, 5-10% of glass fiber reinforced plastic, 5-10% of boron carbide, 20-30% of thermoplastic polymer fiber and 10-20% of asbestos flame-retardant fiber according to mass percentage; then, performing blending preliminary hot pressing, honeycomb buffer layer attaching, composite hot pressing, cooling and detection; producing qualified high-strength composite helmet materials; the aramid fiber bears impact force, the mixed spinning material and the ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene are pressed and molded together, the strength is enhanced, the honeycomb buffer layer is bonded on the inner layer, the damage caused by the transmission of the impact force to a human body is reduced, the glass fiber reinforced plastic and the boron carbide are fused into the mixed spinning material together through composite hot pressing again, and the strength of the bulletproof military helmet composite material is enhanced again.

title_en: Horizontal electric heating vacuum cleaning furnace
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of vacuum cleaning furnaces, and particularly relates to a horizontal electric heating vacuum cleaning furnace which comprises an installation table, wherein a furnace body is installed at the top end of the installation table, the bottom end of the installation table is connected with a base, the bottom end of the base is connected with two support frames, and two groups of adjustable moving assemblies are arranged between the two support frames; the adjustable moving assembly comprises a mounting plate, a motor, a first bevel gear, a second bevel gear, a third bevel gear, a fourth bevel gear, a rotating shaft, a screw rod, a threaded block, supporting legs and a universal wheel, the mounting plate is connected between the supporting frames, the motor is mounted in the middle of the top end of the mounting plate, and the output end of the motor is connected with the first bevel gear. The horizontal electric heating vacuum cleaning furnace can be conveniently and easily moved, when the horizontal electric heating vacuum cleaning furnace is not moved, the universal wheels can be contracted, and the supporting frame can continuously keep supporting, so that the supporting is more stable and reliable, and the movement is more convenient.

title_en: Basalt fiber unidirectional cloth for engineering structure reinforcement and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses basalt fiber unidirectional cloth for engineering structure reinforcement and a manufacturing method thereof. The unidirectional fabric comprises a unidirectional fabric main body made of plain weave, wherein the unidirectional fabric main body comprises warp yarns, the warp yarns are prefabricated continuous basalt fibers, and have better flexibility, banding property, self-lubricating property and weaving property, and gaps are formed between the adjacent warp yarns; and the weft yarn is a thermal fuse. The invention adopts a segmented film forming process, reduces the production cost, improves the mechanical property and the stability, the smoothness and the permeability of the cloth cover structure, can effectively avoid wrinkling during construction, and realizes the advantages of convenient construction, good reinforcing effect, high cost performance and the like.

title_en: Four-layer high-yield circulating wood grain transfer furnace device for aluminum profiles
abstract_en: The invention discloses a four-layer high-yield circulating wood grain transfer furnace device for an aluminum profile, which comprises a shell and a wood grain transfer structure, wherein the wood grain transfer structure comprises an electric hydraulic push rod, a support plate and a transfer cylinder, the electric hydraulic push rod is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the inner wall of the shell through a bolt, the support plate is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the electric hydraulic push rod through a bolt, an installation groove is formed in the center of the lower surface of the support plate, the transfer cylinder is rotatably arranged in the installation groove, a micro motor is fixedly arranged at one end of the support plate through a bolt, the output end of the micro motor penetrates through the support plate and is fixedly connected with the central shaft of the transfer cylinder through a bolt, and an air guide cavity is formed in the support plate; according to the invention, the four wood grain transfer printing structures are used for sequentially carrying out wood grain transfer printing treatment on the surface of the aluminum plate, so that the wood grain processing can be carried out on the aluminum plate in a layered manner, and the wood grain transfer printing quality is improved.

title_en: Preparation method and application of periodic fiber woven electromagnetic wave absorption material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a periodic fiber woven electromagnetic wave absorption material, and aims to solve the problem that the intrinsic electromagnetic parameters of fibers cannot be obtained at present, and a wave absorption material which has the broadband electromagnetic wave absorption performance of absorbing multiple functions, is ultrathin, light, high-temperature resistant, can be prepared in batch, is stable and has excellent mechanics is obtained. The invention prepares the periodic fiber woven material for broadband electromagnetic wave absorption by obtaining intrinsic electromagnetic parameters and utilizing a knitting machine to combine the guidance of CST software by utilizing a genetic algorithm. The fiber woven material prepared by the invention is innovative in that intrinsic electromagnetic parameters of the fiber material are obtained, the periodic macroscopic structure of the material is optimized under the guidance of an algorithm and simulation, the electromagnetic loss of the material is fully exerted, and simultaneously, the electromagnetic loss of the material is matched with the resonance loss of the periodic structure. The invention is applied to the field of electromagnetic wave absorption materials.

title_en: Fiber cord impregnating solution and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fiber cord impregnating solution, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the fiber cord impregnating solution comprises the following components: crosslinked products of polyphenol compounds and silane coupling agents, white carbon black, rubber emulsion, pH regulator, other auxiliary agents and deionized water; and coating the surface of the white carbon black with a crosslinked product of the polyphenol compound and the silane coupling agent. The fiber cord impregnating solution can replace RFL impregnating solution to treat rubber framework materials, and improves the interfacial adhesion between the fiber cord and rubber.

title_en: Method for manufacturing anti-virus mask
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of manufacturing of anti-virus masks, in particular to a manufacturing method of an anti-virus mask. The invention aims to provide a method for manufacturing an anti-virus mask, which can enable the anti-virus mask to have the fragrance of mint, so that the nasal cavity becomes fresh when a person wears the anti-virus mask, and the method is helpful for stimulating the nasal cavity to improve the breathing smoothness. The purpose of the invention is realized by the following technical scheme: a method for manufacturing an anti-virus mask comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps: pouring mint leaves into an anti-virus mask manufacturing device in batches for grinding; step two: pricking mint leaves when the mint leaves are ground in an anti-virus mask manufacturing device; step three: smearing the ground mint leaf powder on the inner layer of the anti-virus mask; step four: and (4) conveying the anti-virus mask coated with the mint leaf powder.

title_en: Printing device
abstract_en: The invention provides a printing device, comprising a head unit and an impression unit; the head unit comprises a printing head and a head frame, and the printing head is movably supported on the head frame; the stamping unit comprises a compression roller, and the printing head and the compression roller record information on the printing medium in a mode of clamping the printing medium; the printing apparatus further includes a guide mechanism disposed between the print head and the head frame; the guide mechanism is configured to guide a printing portion of the print head to move in a direction toward a predetermined nip position of the platen during an activity of the print head. Thus, the print head of the head unit is supported on the head frame in a movable manner, so that the print head can be individually moved relative to the head frame. The guide mechanism is configured to guide the printing portion of the print head to move in a direction toward a predetermined nip position of the platen roller during movement of the print head relative to the head frame.

title_en: Liquid ejecting head and liquid ejecting apparatus
abstract_en: The invention provides a liquid ejecting head and a liquid ejecting apparatus capable of improving printing quality by suppressing deviation in ejection characteristics of liquid droplets between nozzle rows. The liquid ejecting head ejects liquid in a +Z direction which is a third direction orthogonal to the first direction and the second direction, and includes a first introduction portion, a second introduction portion, a first filter chamber group having a first filter chamber and a second filter chamber, a second filter chamber group having a third filter chamber and a fourth filter chamber, a first supply flow path for supplying liquid from the first introduction portion to the first filter chamber group, and a second supply flow path for supplying liquid from the second introduction portion to the second filter chamber group, wherein the first introduction portion, the second introduction portion, the first filter chamber group, and the second filter chamber group are arranged in this order toward the +X direction which is the first direction.

title_en: Cloud printing service system and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of printing systems, in particular to a cloud printing service system and a using method thereof; the cloud printing service system comprises a protective shell, a printer body and a storage box, wherein the protective shell is arranged on the outer side of the printer body and matched with the printer body, and the storage box is arranged on the outer side of the protective shell and matched with the protective shell; protecting sheathing includes apron piece, protective housing and base, and the apron piece sets up in the upside of protective housing, and the apron piece rotates with the protective housing to be connected, and the base sets up in the downside of protective housing, and base and printer body cooperation, improve service system's structure, add apron piece and protective housing to effectively promote service system's protective capacities, and then avoid service system to appear the condition of damaging in the use.

title_en: Reactive dye for red wool, preparation method thereof and dye solution
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of dyes, and particularly discloses a reactive dye for red wool, a preparation method thereof and dye liquid. The reactive dye for red wool has a structural formula R1 and R2 are both auxochrome groups, and M is a metal element; the preparation method of the red wool reactive dye comprises the following steps: condensing an ester compound and N-methyl sodium taurate to obtain a first condensation compound; diazotizing the first condensation compound to obtain a diazo; condensing H acid and 2, 3-dibromo propionyl chloride to obtain a second condensation compound; and (4) coupling the second condensation compound with a diazo to obtain the red reactive dye for wool. The reactive dye in the application has short dyeing time and is not easy to generateAnd (4) color spots.

title_en: Football flower type cloth production process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a football pattern cloth production process, which adopts semi-smooth flat filaments as raw materials and comprises the following steps: s1, design: designing the football patterns by adopting design software; s2, yarn finishing: the warping machine performs yarn finishing operation on the semi-gloss flat yarns through a software program to enable the semi-gloss flat yarns to form a combined structure; s3, warp knitting: feeding a combined structure formed by semi-smooth flat yarns onto a working needle of a warp knitting machine in a warp direction to form a knitted fabric; s4, molding: and (4) carrying out carving on the knitted fabric to form the grey fabric with the football pattern. The invention can continuously produce and process the football pattern cloth, has simple and convenient operation, can continuously and quickly realize the processing operation of the football pattern cloth, and can meet the processing quality of the football pattern cloth.

title_en: Papermaking white mud pretreatment system and method for wet desulphurization
abstract_en: The invention provides a papermaking white mud pretreatment system and a treatment method for wet desulphurization, aiming at the characteristic of white mud generated in an alkali pulping and papermaking alkali recovery process, and removing impurities step by step so as to be used in a desulphurization system. Solid-solid separation and solid-liquid separation are carried out on the alkali recovery white mud slurry in a separation unit, high-quality white mud slurry is prepared through the separation unit and an aeration grit chamber, then the high-quality white mud slurry is introduced into an absorption tower, partial flue gas is extracted, and SO is used for removing sulfur 2 In acid precipitation papermaking white mudThe lignin organic matter and the water can be recycled. The invention can absorb a large amount of solid waste of the papermaking white mud, remove impurities in the white mud by stage treatment, and greatly reduce the negative influence of the impurities in the white mud on the operation of a desulfurization system.

title_en: Red dye composition and application and dyeing method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of textile dyes, and particularly discloses a red dye composition, and application and a dyeing method thereof. The red dye composition comprises one or more compounds represented by a general formula (I) and one or more compounds represented by a general formula (II); general formula (I); general formula (II). The red dye composition has good dyeing property and various dyeing fastness, and can be widely applied to fibersThe dyeing process has the advantages that the dyeing process can be simplified, and the dyeing efficiency is improved.

title_en: Preparation method of conductive ultrahigh molecular weight polyethylene fiber
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of polyethylene fibers, and particularly relates to a preparation method of a conductive ultrahigh molecular weight polyethylene fiber, which comprises the following steps of ultrasonically cleaning the ultrahigh molecular weight polyethylene fiber, then carrying out plasma pretreatment on the cleaned ultrahigh molecular weight polyethylene fiber, then mixing the pretreated ultrahigh molecular weight polyethylene fiber with an aniline monomer, and extruding or stripping to obtain the ultrahigh molecular weight polyethylene fiber adsorbed with the aniline monomer; then placing the ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene fiber adsorbed with the aniline monomer into a reaction solution, taking out after reaction, washing and drying to obtain the conductive ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene fiber; the reaction solution is a mixture of formaldehyde solution, surfactant solution, persulfate solution and inorganic acid solution; the invention effectively improves the conductivity of the conductive material.

title_en: Mercerized cotton yarn dyeing process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mercerized cotton yarn dyeing process, which comprises the following steps: step 1, selecting cotton yarns with a certain weight, and removing impurities from the cotton yarns for later use; and 2, placing the cotton yarn into a processing box, adding a sodium hydroxide solvent into the processing box, covering the surface of the cotton yarn with the sodium hydroxide solvent, soaking the cotton yarn for 2min, uniformly stirring the cotton yarn in the processing box by a stirrer in the soaking process, taking out the cotton yarn, placing the cotton yarn into a cleaning pool for water washing, controlling the water temperature in the cleaning pool to be 60-80 ℃, standing for 30-40 min, taking out the cotton yarn, soaking the cotton yarn in cold water for 5-10 min, taking out the cotton yarn, adding the cotton yarn into hydrogen peroxide, standing for 5-8 min, taking out the cotton yarn for water washing, and adding alkyl polyglycol ether and water into the cotton yarn again. By adopting the mercerized cotton yarn dyeing process provided by the invention, the mercerized cotton yarn is bright in color, uniform and soft in dyeing, high in color fixing rate, difficult to fade after dyeing, convenient for manual operation and improved in the yield of products.

title_en: Yarn joining method for spinneret of jet spinning machine and jet spinning machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for joining a spinneret (1) of an air spinning machine, by means of which a yarn (2) is spun from a filament strand (3) during a spinning operation, wherein the filament strand (3) is fed to the spinneret (1) via a guide channel (4). According to the invention, the method comprises at least the following steps: feeding the yarn end (5) against a predetermined spinning direction (S) into a yarn storage section (6) of a diverging self-guiding channel (4) in a spinneret (1); delivering the ends (7) of the strands (3) into the guide channel (4); the yarn end (5) is pulled out of the yarn storage section (6), and the pulling-out yarn end (5) and the end (7) of the conveying filament strand (3) are coordinated with each other, so that the yarn end (5) and the end (7) overlap and jointly move into the region of the inlet opening (8) of the yarn forming element (9) arranged in the spinneret (1), and are connected with each other by means of air vortex. The invention also describes an air jet spinning machine.

title_en: Antistatic clothing fabric winding equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of garment fabric winding, in particular to an anti-static garment fabric winding device which comprises a base, a conveying unit and a winding unit, wherein the upper end of the base is respectively provided with the conveying unit and the winding unit, and the winding unit is positioned on the right side of the conveying unit; the existing winding machine has the following problems when winding the antistatic clothing fabric: the winding machine cannot ensure the flatness of the anti-static fabric during winding, and easily causes the slipping phenomenon of the anti-static fabric in the conveying process; the winding machine cannot remove dust scraps on the surface of the anti-static fabric, so that the cleanliness of the anti-static fabric is influenced; the invention can ensure the flatness of the anti-static fabric during rolling; the anti-static fabric conveying device can avoid the phenomenon that the anti-static fabric slips during conveying; the invention can remove dust and leftover materials attached to the surface of the anti-static fabric, thereby ensuring the cleanliness of the surface of the anti-static fabric.

title_en: Knitted-loop-like fabric and weaving process thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a knitted-simulated terry fabric and a weaving process thereof, wherein the knitted-simulated terry fabric is a single-sided terry fabric with one side being short and the other side being flat cloth, and the single-sided terry fabric is woven by wool warps, ground warps and weft yarns of high count yarns; each short terry is woven by jointly terry weaving with 1 warp yarn, 2 warp yarns and 3 weft yarns; wherein the 1 st ground warp is auxiliary fuzzing ground warp, and the 2 nd ground warp is clamping ground warp; when the short terry is fluffed, the clamping ground warp and the auxiliary fluffing ground warp of each terry are adopted to be respectively and separately wore. The fabric provided by the application breaks through the design of the traditional towel or fabric weaving process, is different from the common towel and the common fabric style, and ensures that the product has more novelty, three-dimensional sense and more creative expression form.

title_en: Preparation method of sound insulation blanket for explosion-proof door
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a sound-insulating blanket for an explosion-proof door, which comprises the following steps: mixing silicate ester A and a solvent B, immersing the mixture in a non-woven fabric C, stirring to obtain a swelled non-woven fabric C, adding deionized water, stirring, adding a weak acid solution D, stirring, adding the solvent B and the deionized water, adding ammonia water to obtain a modified non-woven fabric, rinsing the modified non-woven fabric, immersing the rinsed non-woven fabric in a methylchlorosilane solution or a n-hexane solution, and immersing at the temperature of 50-60 ℃ for 12-24 hours to obtain a non-woven fabric with a colorless and transparent surface; and rinsing the non-woven fabric with a colorless and transparent surface, and naturally drying the rinsed non-woven fabric to obtain the sound insulation blanket for the explosion door. The method has the advantages of simple process and few operation steps, and the sound-insulating blanket prepared by the method has more irregular holes, can better absorb sound waves and greatly improves the sound-insulating effect of the explosion-proof door.

title_en: Sizing machine for papermaking
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sizing machine for papermaking, which belongs to the technical field of papermaking processing equipment, solves the problem of poor control of the glue yield of the conventional sizing machine for papermaking, and has the technical key points that: including the mounting bracket, moving mechanism is installed to one side of mounting bracket, moving mechanism is including gluing the bucket, one side of gluing the bucket is provided with adjustment mechanism, adjustment mechanism is used for controlling the volume of gluing the bucket, adjustment mechanism includes: the fixing frame is used for mounting an outer sleeve part, the outer sleeve part is connected with the glue barrel through a glue outlet part, and the glue outlet part is used for controlling the glue outlet amount; a drive assembly including a first drive element and a first gear, the first transmission assembly including a second gear, a third gear, and a fourth gear; and the adjusting assembly comprises a first rotating piece, a second rotating piece and a third rotating piece, and has the advantage of controlling the glue discharging amount.

title_en: Special-shaped forming and cutting device for carpet
abstract_en: The invention discloses a special-shaped forming and cutting device for carpets, which comprises the following components: the carpet cutting mechanism comprises a transverse track mechanism, a telescopic arm mechanism and a heat cutting device, wherein the telescopic arm mechanism is arranged on the transverse track mechanism, the transverse track mechanism can adjust the transverse position of the telescopic arm mechanism towards the cutting support plate, the heat cutting device is arranged on the telescopic arm mechanism, and the telescopic arm mechanism can control the heat cutting device to stretch and retract over against the cutting support plate; through carrying out the pressfitting to the carpet of transportation in the backup pad for the carpet can form horizontal static region in the backup pad, when making cutting device cut the carpet that is in static region in the backup pad, can not receive the carpet influence of transportation, thereby has promoted the precision of cutting the carpet.

title_en: Water transfer molding equipment for surface patterns of injection molding cup
