abstract_en: The invention discloses water transfer molding equipment for surface patterns of an injection molding cup, which comprises a reservoir, wherein an L-shaped support is arranged on the outer wall of one side of the top of the reservoir, a connecting column is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the top of the L-shaped support, an installation plate is fixedly connected to the outer wall of the bottom of the connecting column, electric push rods are respectively arranged on the outer walls of two sides of the top of the installation plate, lifting blocks are respectively and fixedly connected to the bottom ends of the electric push rods, a plurality of cylinders are respectively and fixedly connected to the outer wall of one side of each lifting block, a plurality of sleeves are respectively arranged on the outer wall of one end of each cylinder, telescopic columns are slidably connected to the tops of the sleeves, air bags are arranged between the telescopic columns and the sleeves, and rubber sleeves are respectively arranged at the top ends of the telescopic columns. The invention can form the patterns of a plurality of injection molding cups at one time by arranging the electric push rod, the lifting block, the cylinder, the sleeve, the telescopic column, the rubber sleeve, the air bag, the air pump, the main air delivery pipe and the branch air delivery pipe without manually holding the injection molding cups in the prior art, and is suitable for injection molding of different sizes.

title_en: Cleaning device for a suction roller and method for cleaning a suction roller
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cleaning device, in particular for a suction roller of a plant for producing or treating a fibrous material web, wherein the cleaning device comprises a distribution line, via which cleaning nozzles can be supplied with a cleaning fluid, and a plurality of cleaning nozzles, wherein at least one, in particular all, cleaning nozzles are embodied as oscillating nozzles. The invention further relates to a suction roller and a method for cleaning a suction roller.

title_en: Preparation method of flame-retardant anti-dripping polyester-nylon composite fiber
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a flame-retardant anti-dripping polyester-nylon composite fiber, and belongs to the field of fiber preparation. A preparation method of flame-retardant anti-dripping polyester-nylon composite fiber comprises the following steps: s1, uniformly mixing the polyester slices, the silicon resin, the hydroxyphenoxy phosphine propionic acid and the antimony trioxide according to a certain proportion, adding the mixture into a screw extruder, and carrying out melt extrusion to obtain a polyester melt; s2, uniformly mixing nylon chips, tetramethylolglycoluril and 4-hydroxymethyl phosphorus sulfate according to a certain ratio, adding into a screw extruder, and carrying out melt extrusion to obtain a nylon melt; s3, adjusting the aperture size of a spinneret orifice on a spinneret plate in advance through an adjusting cylinder; and S4, conveying the polyester melt and the polyamide melt into a spinning box, mixing, spraying through a spinneret orifice on a spinneret plate, and cooling to obtain the flame-retardant anti-dripping polyester-polyamide composite fiber finished product with the required thickness.

title_en: Device for accurately cutting glass fiber biaxial fabric
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of glass fiber fabric processing, and discloses a device for accurately cutting a glass fiber biaxial fabric, which comprises a bottom case and two breast boards which are borne on the edge of the top of the bottom case and distributed left and right, wherein rectangular partition boards are erected on the tops of the two breast boards, the opposite side walls of the two partition boards are provided with the same winding component for winding the glass fiber biaxial fabric to be cut, and the top board surfaces of the two breast boards are respectively provided with a cutting component for cutting and a compaction component for compacting the glass fiber biaxial fabric from front to back. The invention solves the problems that most of the prior art are single in structure, and when the glass fiber biaxial fabric is cut, the glass fiber biaxial fabric is easy to wrinkle and roll, so that certain deviation occurs during cutting, and the modern production standard is difficult to meet.

title_en: Health-care silk fabric and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a health-care silk fabric and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of textiles. The invention relates to a method for preparing health-care silk fabric, which comprises the steps of using nano titanium dioxide composite silk fiber fabric as a fabric base layer, carrying out ultrasonic swelling modification on the fabric base layer by using a modified silane coupling agent, grafting two ends of the modified silane coupling agent on nano titanium dioxide and silk fiber molecules respectively, forming a net structure by cross linking pyrrole compounds between the nano titanium dioxide and silk fiber, enhancing the air permeability of the fabric base layer, polymerizing the pyrrole compounds to form a polypyrrole conductive path by constant voltage electric treatment, enhancing the antistatic property of the health-care silk fabric, embedding and grafting dye into the fabric base layer by using a low-frequency ultrasonic technology, enhancing the color fastness of the moisture-retention silk fabric, and finally forming a metal complex film layer on the surface of the fabric base layer by orthogonal electrostatic field microwave treatment, thereby enhancing the ultraviolet resistance of the moisture-retention silk fabric.

title_en: Paint for printing watercolor drawing paper, printing watercolor drawing paper and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a coating for printing watercolor drawing paper, the printing watercolor drawing paper and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of special paper production, wherein the coating for printing the watercolor drawing paper comprises the following components in parts by weight: 100 parts of silicon dioxide, 23-55 parts of thickening agent, 1-3 parts of color fixing agent, 1-2 parts of mildew preventive, pH value regulator and water. The water color paper disclosed by the invention takes silicon dioxide as a main raw material, and is matched with other components to act together, so that the water color paper can be used for printing after being coated on the water color paper, and the printed picture is bright in color and uniform in color, and has the similar effect of hand-drawn water color pictures. The results of the examples show that the watercolor drawing paper prepared by the coating provided by the invention has printing color uniformity A, color block color gradient A and black saturation A.

title_en: Forming method of paper bag body
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forming method of a paper bag body, wherein a bag body base material forming a winding drum is unreeled through an unreeling component, two groups of bag handles which are arranged at intervals are bonded on the bag body base material, and the bag handles are positioned on the top surface of the bag body base material; the middle part of the bag body base material is turned over by the bag body passing through the first folding stopper to obtain a straight part and a turning part turned over downwards; the paper bag base material is continuously pulled backwards to be unreeled, and the left end and the right end of the straight portion pass through the corresponding concave side component, so that the left end and the right end of the straight portion are formed into side sections with inner concave portions; the container bag substrate continues to stimulate backward and unreels, turns over a portion through infolding guide part, drives and turns over a portion and inwards turns over for straight portion and turn over a portion and correspond from top to bottom, and the bag in straight portion at this moment is up, and the bag in the portion of turning over is provided with the pinch roller of support down, the correspondence is turned over a portion. The outer side wall of the bag handle can be arranged after the paper bag body is formed, the opening and closing of the bag opening can be conveniently realized, and the bag handle cannot be damaged.

title_en: Preparation method of carding roller card clothing surface coating based on micro-arc ion plating and carding roller card clothing
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a carding roller card clothing surface coating based on micro-arc ion plating, which comprises the steps of degreasing, washing and ultrasonically cleaning card clothing of a carding roller to be treated, and drying the card clothing by hot air; then placing the card clothing in a workpiece table in a vacuum chamber of micro-arc ion plating equipment, and sequentially carrying out the steps of ion cleaning, pure chromium priming coat deposition, transition coat deposition, working coat deposition and the like to obtain the carding roller card clothing with a surface coating. The invention also provides carding roller card clothing. The card clothing of the carding roller obtained by the method has the characteristics of certain toughness, high wear resistance, high rotating speed, low vibration and low friction, effectively meets the requirements of carding and transferring of the carding roller to fibers, and obviously and greatly reduces the phenomena of slubby and neps of the fibers.

title_en: Lithographic printing plate precursors and methods of use
abstract_en: Using IR radiation sensitive compositions, IR sensitive lithographic printing plate precursors provide high contrast and stable printed images. The composition comprises: a free radically polymerizable component, an IR absorber, an initiator composition, such as a color forming compound of a specific leuco dye, and a compound represented by the following structure (P): wherein X is-O-, -S-, -NH-or-CH  2  Y is > N-or > CH-, R  1  Is hydrogen or alkyl, R  2  And R is  3  Independently is halo, thioalkyl, thiophenyl, alkoxy, phenoxy, alkyl, phenyl, thioacetyl or acetyl, and m and n are independently 0 or an integer from 1 to 4. The printed image exhibits a color contrast Δe between exposed and unexposed areas of greater than 8. A delta E of at least 5 is maintained between the exposed and unexposed regions with exposure to white light for at least one hour. These precursors can be developed on-press when IR is exposed.

title_en: Preparation method and product of warm regenerated cellulose fiber
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and a product of a thermal insulation regenerated cellulose fiber, wherein functional powder is firstly subjected to heat accumulation and thermal insulation, powder dispersion is completed, wood pulp is dissolved to obtain a cellulose solution, the functional powder dispersion liquid and the cellulose solution are uniformly mixed, and finally, a composite spinning solution is extruded through wet spinning equipment, and the porous structure regenerated cellulose fiber with the thermal insulation function is obtained after shaping in a three-stage gradient coagulation bath. According to the invention, a specific wet spinning solidification forming method is adopted, three-stage gradient solidification is adopted to prepare the regenerated cellulose fiber with a microporous structure, and a green preparation technology of the thermal regenerated cellulose fiber is developed.

title_en: Supply ink box and mixing ink box
abstract_en: Certain examples relate to a mixing and/or supply cartridge for a printing device. One example implementation includes a reservoir to receive printing material from a printing device and return the received printing material to the printing device. The storage medium stores: a reservoir printing material level parameter indicating an amount of printing material in the reservoir; a recirculation cycle counter indicating a number of recirculation events experienced by the ink cartridge; and a maximum recirculation period parameter indicating a maximum number of recirculation events that the cartridge is capable of undergoing.

title_en: Positioning printing equipment for special paper
abstract_en: The invention provides positioning printing equipment for special paper, which comprises a bedplate, wherein side plates are fixedly connected to the middle parts of the left side and the right side of the top end of the bedplate, a hollow plate is fixedly connected to the middle part of the rear side of the top end of the bedplate, a bottom plate is fixedly connected to the middle part of the bottom end of the bedplate, a sliding groove is formed in the middle part of the bottom end of the bottom plate, a sliding plate is connected in a sliding manner in the sliding groove, the front side of the top end of the sliding plate is fixedly connected to the bottom end of a connecting plate, and a rotating plate is connected to the top end of the connecting plate in a rotating manner. According to the invention, the electric telescopic rod and the bidirectional threaded rod can enable the movable block to drive the pressing plate to move left and right and lift, so that the special paper is positioned and fixed, the roller can flatten the special paper to prevent the special paper from being influenced by folds during printing, the dust removing brush can remove dust on the surface of the special paper, the air suction fan can suck the dust into the collecting box, and the influence of the dust on the surface of the special paper on printing operation is prevented.

title_en: Degradable polyester yarn-dyed fabric and weaving method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a degradable polyester yarn-dyed fabric and a weaving method thereof, wherein the fabric comprises a fabric main body, the fabric main body is formed by interweaving warp yarns and weft yarns into a plurality of composite twill weave structures, the warp yarns are first composite yarns, the weft yarns are second composite yarns, a plurality of first composite yarn color mixing units are formed in the warp direction of the fabric main body, a plurality of second composite yarn color mixing units are formed in the weft direction of the fabric main body, and the first composite yarns and the second composite yarns are degradable polyester yarns. The invention also discloses a weaving method of the degradable polyester yarn-dyed fabric, which is used for carrying out specific weaving design, and the fabric obtained by weaving forms a complete jacquard color matching tissue by using the mixed yarn with color matching, so that the fabric disclosed by the invention is novel in pattern, simple and elegant. In addition, the degradable polyester yarn-dyed fabric which is beneficial to degradation is more environment-friendly.

title_en: A intelligent dewatering device of hydraulic loom for textile production
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent dewatering device of a water-jet loom for textile production, which comprises a dewatering device and an intelligent dewatering system, wherein the dewatering device comprises a dewatering box, the front side of the dewatering box is provided with a blower, the blower is connected with an inner pipeline of the dewatering box, a valve is arranged in the pipeline, the rear side of the dewatering box is provided with a waste box, the waste box is connected with the inner pipeline of the dewatering box, an air suction pump is arranged in the pipeline, the upper end of the dewatering box is connected with a box cover in a clamping way, the left side and the right side of the dewatering box are respectively provided with a material opening, the material openings can transmit fabrics, one side of the waste box is provided with a drain pipe, the pipeline is internally provided with a drain valve, the inlet of the drain pipe is provided with a filter screen, the upper end of the box is fixedly connected with a plurality of groups of air cylinders, and the output ends of the plurality of the air cylinders are fixedly connected with vibrating rods, so that intelligent identification and automatic cleaning functions are realized conveniently and efficiently.

title_en: Printing method, projection correction method, projection device and printing machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of printing machines, in particular to a printing method, a projection correction method, a projection device, a printing machine and a storage medium. According to the embodiment of the invention, the information of the printing stock to be printed can be acquired, the reference pattern matched with the printing stock is called according to the information of the printing stock, and the projection image of the reference pattern is projected on one side of the bedplate of the printing machine through the projection device; therefore, the operator can adjust the position of the printing stock placed on the table plate according to the projected image of the reference pattern, so that the printing stock is aligned with the projected image of the reference pattern, and the printing machine can print the target pattern on the designated position of the printing stock. On one hand, the projected image of the reference pattern is positioned above the printing stock and cannot be shielded by the printing stock; on the other hand, the reference pattern projected by the projection device can be automatically changed along with different printing stocks, and a plurality of different reference patterns do not need to be drawn on the bedplate, thereby improving the printing efficiency.

title_en: Special-shaped wine box production line and processing technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a production line and a processing technology of a special-shaped wine box, wherein the production line comprises a first face tissue flying and pasting mechanism, an ash plate visual positioning mechanism, a deviation-rectifying and edge-folding mechanism, a four-side forming machine, an automatic adhesive sheet mechanism and a second face tissue flying and pasting mechanism, the first face tissue flying and pasting mechanism is sequentially butted with the ash plate visual positioning mechanism, the deviation-rectifying and edge-folding mechanism and the four-side forming machine through a first belt conveying mechanism, and the second face tissue flying and pasting mechanism and the four-side forming machine are respectively butted with the automatic adhesive sheet mechanism through a second belt conveying mechanism and a first box conveying belt conveying mechanism; the production method realizes the full-automatic production of the wine box of different sex, reduces the labor cost in the production, has high production efficiency, intelligent operation, simplicity, convenience and suitability for the production of the wine box of different sex.

title_en: Novel cloth transportation device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel cloth conveying device which comprises a supporting frame, a controller, a power supply and a driving motor, wherein a hook is arranged on the outer wall of the top of the supporting frame, an output shaft of the driving motor is connected with a lead screw in a meshed mode through a transmission gear, a through hole is formed in the outer wall of the top of the supporting frame, vertical grooves are formed in the inner walls of two opposite sides of the supporting frame, the lead screw is located in the vertical groove, two sliding blocks are arranged on the outer wall of each lead screw, the outer wall of one side of each sliding block is provided with a vertical plate, a rolling rod is inserted between the two vertical plates, first gears are arranged at two ends of the rolling rod, a mounting groove is formed in one side of each vertical groove, and a meshed part is arranged in the mounting groove. The invention realizes the rolling and the upward movement of the cloth through the driving motor, so that the cloth is cleaner in the transportation process, the generation of flying cotton is reduced, the personnel can conveniently and quickly see the end of the cloth, and the invention has the effects of convenient sewing operation and energy consumption reduction.

title_en: Socks are from transmission turn-over equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses self-conveying turnover equipment for socks, which comprises a conveying part, a supporting frame, a turnover magnetic attraction structure, a jacking assembly and a contact piece, wherein the turnover magnetic attraction structure is movably arranged on the supporting frame along the conveying direction; the overturning electromagnetic adsorption structure comprises a mounting block movably arranged on the support frame, an extensible part connected to the mounting block and capable of being arranged close to or far away from the transmission part, a mounting frame connected to the extensible end of the extensible part, and a magnetic adsorption block rotatably arranged on the mounting frame through a driving structure; the jacking assembly is positioned below the support frame and can be close to or far away from the support frame; the conflict piece includes a set of elasticity strip that sets up relatively to and connect the connection piece of a set of elasticity strip, and be provided with on the connection piece with but magnetism inhale the magnet that the piece magnetism is connected. The mechanized turn-over operation can be completed by matching with a local auxiliary mode in the transmission process, and the operation efficiency is greatly improved.

title_en: Heat-bondable fiber and fiber aggregate for automotive interior/exterior material comprising same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a heat-bondable fiber, and more particularly, to a heat-bondable fiber which has excellent touch, sound absorption, adhesive strength, flame retardancy, and processability, has excellent heat resistance, minimizes a change with time, and remarkably reduces the release of VOCs, and is particularly suitable for an automobile realizing a closed environment, and a fiber assembly for an automobile interior and exterior material containing the same.

title_en: Filter felt and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a filter felt, which comprises the following steps: (1) forming glass fiber from the glass liquid, attaching the glass fiber to a rotating roller to form a cylindrical felt, and spraying an adhesive; the roller reciprocates along the first axial direction relative to the bushing plate, so that the glass fibers extend along a Z-shaped path on the roller and form a bending angle, and two adjacent glass fibers are arranged in a crossed manner along the radial direction; (2) cutting the cylindrical felt along the first axial direction to form a raw silk felt, stretching the raw silk felt along the length direction of the raw silk felt, and curing and shaping to obtain the filter felt formed by the glass fibers. The application also discloses a filter felt. The filter felt that this application formed has the stratiform thing of rhombus net, has the characteristics that surfacing, elasticity are good, the gas permeability is good and structural strength is high, harmful gas such as catching, collection dust and oil mist that can be better.

title_en: Preparation method, product and application of composite waterproof breathable after-finishing agent
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and a product of a composite waterproof breathable finishing agent and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the steps of compounding fatty acid with a waterproof function with alkyl alkoxy silane compound, adding the fatty acid with the waterproof function into purified water, and stirring the mixture uniformly to prepare the composite waterproof agent; and (3) compounding a flexibilizer, namely adding the epoxy modified organosilicon softener HA-920 into the composite waterproof agent, and uniformly stirring to obtain the composite waterproof breathable finishing agent. According to the waterproof fabric, the composite waterproof agent is matched with the softening agent with good compatibility, so that the permeation effect of the composite waterproof agent on the fabric is increased, a uniform film with a certain scale is formed for waterproof during fiber surface solidification, and the waterproof effect, the ventilation effect of micropores generated by the film can be achieved due to the doping of multiple components, the multiple components can be effectively combined to form a synergistic effect, and the waterproof ventilation and the softness of the fabric are endowed.

title_en: SMT welding tin cream printing device with automatic feeding function
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of auxiliary printing equipment, in particular to an SMT welding solder paste printing device with an automatic feeding function. The SMT welding solder paste printing device with the automatic feeding function is capable of reducing solder paste waste. An SMT welding solder paste printing device with an automatic feeding function comprises a discharging mechanism, a solder paste recycling mechanism, a stirring mechanism, a turnover cleaning mechanism, a feeding mechanism and the like; arrange the material mechanism top and be provided with rabbling mechanism, the rabbling mechanism top is provided with upset clearance mechanism, arranges the material mechanism below and is provided with solder paste and retrieves the mechanism, and upset clearance mechanism top is provided with feed mechanism. According to the tin paste feeding device, the tin paste is discharged through the discharging mechanism, a better discharging effect is achieved, the tin paste waste is reduced through the tin paste recycling mechanism, the tin paste in the tin paste tank is cleaned and the tin paste in the storage box is stirred through the matching of the stirring mechanism and the overturning cleaning mechanism, and a better feeding effect is achieved through the feeding mechanism.

title_en: Clothing design system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a clothing design system, which comprises a cloth inspection module, a cloth inspection module and a cloth inspection module, wherein the cloth inspection module is used for inspecting purchased cloth; the cutting module is used for cutting the cloth into a required shape; a printing module for printing the pattern on the cloth; a forming module for making the cloth into ready-made clothes; the quality inspection module is used for performing quality inspection on the finished garment; the packaging module packages the ready-made clothes which are qualified after inspection and then places the ready-made clothes into a warehouse; the cutting module comprises a primary cutting machine and a secondary cutting machine, wherein the primary cutting machine comprises a processing table, a mounting block arranged on the processing table, a mounting plate, a processing cavity arranged on the mounting block, a cutting assembly arranged in the processing cavity, a first fixing assembly and a cloth laying assembly arranged on the mounting plate; the invention can automatically arrange the cut cloth sections and improve the processing efficiency of the ready-made clothes.

title_en: Biodegradable single-cup bag production line and production process
abstract_en: The utility model provides a biodegradable single-cup bag production line, which comprises a feeding unit and also comprises: the arrangement unit is arranged on the side part of the feeding unit; the material conveying unit is arranged below the arrangement unit; the arrangement unit includes: a transmission assembly; the cutting and swinging assembly is arranged below the transmission assembly; the material guide assembly is arranged at the lower part of the cutting and swinging assembly; raw materials continuously enter the material guide assembly through the feeding unit to be leveled left and right, the transmission assembly controls the cutting and swinging assembly to reciprocate up and down, the raw materials are cut off, the surface of the cut raw materials at the material guide assembly is flattened synchronously, and the cut raw materials are moved to the lower portion of the material guide assembly through the material conveying unit to be leveled up and down and transferred. According to the utility model, the second flattening piece is matched with the flattening piece to move downwards, so that the cut raw materials with the bottoms spreading at the upper end of the material supporting sheet are straightened, and the trouble of the soft characteristic of a single-cup bag on placement is reduced.

title_en: Packaging bag forming and flanging device
abstract_en: The invention provides a packaging bag forming and flanging device, which comprises a workbench, wherein a conveying feeding part and a conveying discharging part are respectively arranged at two ends of the workbench, when the opening ends of packaging bags face to the conveying feeding part and the conveying discharging part for conveying feeding and discharging, the side guide posts at two sides of the packaging bags are supported in a tensioning manner, a notch in a shape of a side V is formed at the outer side of each side guide post, the closing ends of flanging strips attached to the notch are extruded and flanging, the packaging bags are further rolled and flattened and formed through a rolling mechanism at the position close to one end of the conveying discharging part, so that stable flanging forming is realized, and meanwhile, as an adjusting mechanism is arranged in each side guide post, the opening angle of the notch is adjusted for packaging bags with different widths, so that the opening angle of the notch is maintained to be tensioned and unfolded.

title_en: Preparation method of meta-aramid/nano TiO2 composite insulating paper with high insulating strength
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of high-insulation-strength meta-aramid/nano TiO2 composite insulating paper, which belongs to the technical field of electrical materials and comprises the following steps of S1, carrying out dopamine pretreatment on nano TiO2, S2, carrying out coupling agent treatment on nano TiO2, S3, preparing the high-insulation-strength meta-aramid/nano TiO2 composite insulating paper, improving the binding capacity of nano fillers and the aramid paper through the synergistic effect of dopamine coating and a silane coupling agent, effectively improving the breakdown voltage of the composite insulating paper in a mode of reducing the bulk conductivity and improving the carrier trap depth of the material, improving the process from the existing process of paper industry production, and being simple to operate, convenient to implement, low in cost and suitable for industrial mass production.

title_en: Broke pulping equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a broke pulping equipment relates to papermaking technical field, including the shredded pulp case, set up the conveying mechanism with thick liquid output on the shredded pulp case, set up the blanking mouth that supplies the broke to fall into on the shredded pulp case, the shredded pulp incasement rotates side by side and is provided with the shredded paper roll that is located blanking mouth below, is equipped with drive shredded paper roll pivoted driving piece on the shredded pulp case, and meshing department between the shredded paper roll is located the blanking mouth under. This application is through setting up shredded paper roll for broken paper dissolves after the breakage of shredded paper roll earlier in getting into the shredded pulp incasement, accelerates broken paper in the dissolving speed of shredded pulp incasement, shortens the broken paper and retrieves when forming thick liquid, improves the recovery efficiency of broken paper, reduces the waste of paper resource, has the effect that reaches energy-concerving and environment-protective.

title_en: Tubular nanofiber material, negative electrode plate and lithium metal battery
abstract_en: The present application relates to a tubular nanofiber material, wherein the tubular nanofiber has a hollow conduit extending axially along the nanofiber tube; lithium-philic materials are distributed on the tube wall of the tubular nanofiber; the two ends of the tubular nano-fiber are of closed structures. The application also relates to a negative electrode plate containing the tubular nanofiber material, an electrochemical device and an electronic device.

title_en: Manufacturing method of inlaid braid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a manufacturing method of an inlaid braid, which comprises the following steps of: the first layer of warp yarns (5) fully lines the width of the whole mosaic webbing, the second layer of warp yarns (6) fully lines the width of the whole mosaic webbing, and the third layer of warp yarns are divided into warp yarns (7-1) and warp yarns (7-2), wherein: the arrangement width of the warp yarn (7-1) and the warp yarn (7-2) is respectively the same as that of the middle left inner layer (2-3-1) and the middle right inner layer (2-3-2). The inlaid braid can be manufactured at one time, the production efficiency is improved, the production cost is reduced, the incision and cutting are not needed, the fabric is free from burrs and falling off, the sewing is convenient, the efficiency is improved, the quality problem is avoided, and the defective products and waste are avoided. The inlaid braid can be embedded into the fastening tape, the braid and the elastic band, and can be used for object fasteners such as sports, body building, leisure clothes, medical appliances, traveling bags, sports equipment and the like, decoration pieces and the like.

title_en: Method for dyeing cotton textile by using pumpkin pigment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for dyeing cotton textile by using pumpkin pigment, which comprises the steps of preparing pumpkin pigment dye liquor; after regulating the pH value of the pumpkin pigment dye liquor, placing the wetted cotton textile into the dye liquor, and simultaneously adding the prepared mordant ferrous sulfate into the dye liquor; heating to dye; after dyeing, cooling to room temperature, washing with water and airing. Dyeing by adopting a same bath medium method, wherein dyed cotton textile has higher affinity; the cotton textile prepared by the method has good dyeing depth and dyeing fastness.

title_en: Automatic yard equipment that spouts of suspension spring with locate function
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of automobile suspension spring production, in particular to automatic code spraying equipment for a suspension spring with a positioning function, which comprises a rack, wherein the rack comprises a slide rail and an object stage, the slide rail is fixedly arranged on the rack, and the object stage is slidably arranged on the slide rail; this application still includes positioner and spouts a yard device, positioner is including location frock and angle fixed subassembly, location frock fixed mounting is on the objective table, the fixed angle fixed subassembly that is provided with on the location frock, the angle fixed subassembly includes the rotation installation piece, the rotary actuator, angle adjustment piece and permanent magnet, the rotatable installation of rotation installation piece is on the baffle, rotary actuator fixed mounting is on the baffle, rotary actuator's drive end and rotation installation piece fixed connection, angle adjustment piece slidable mounting is on the rotation installation piece, permanent magnet fixed mounting is on angle adjustment piece. The method and the device solve the defects that in the code spraying process, a small amount of products are badly sprayed and need to be reworked, but the positions of the manual code spraying are not uniform.

title_en: Cloth and embossing roller contact area adjustable device used in wet transfer printing process
abstract_en: The invention provides a contact area adjustable device of cloth and a printing roller used in a wet transfer printing process. The cloth placing groove is formed in the base, the support plate is vertically arranged on the base, and the first support and the second support are arranged on the base. The cloth placing groove is positioned between the support plate and the first support, and the two printing rollers are respectively and rotatably matched with the first support and the second support in a sliding manner. The contact area of the cloth and the printing roller used in the wet transfer printing process is adjustable, and the printing chain belt and the printing roller are matched with each other through the arranged base, the support plate, the support I, the support II, the two printing chain belts and the printing roller. The invention can control the printing contact area with the cloth in a period of time by controlling the number of the printing plates contacted with the cloth, thereby greatly facilitating the use of personnel.

title_en: Steam forming method of lining non-woven fabric
abstract_en: The invention discloses a steam forming method of lining non-woven fabric, relating to the technical field of lining non-woven fabric preparation, comprising the following steps: the automatic feeding gear pulls the non-woven fabric to a hydraulic shaping device, then the hydraulic shaping device is adopted to drive an upper main die and a lower main die to be closed for carrying out front-side shape pre-pressing, a 3D-shaped part cylinder drives an auxiliary die to be combined for carrying out pre-pressing, steam is sprayed into a die cavity formed by combining the upper die and the lower die to heat and soften the non-woven fabric, then cooling and shaping are carried out, the auxiliary die is withdrawn, the upper main die and the lower main die are opened, and the lining non-woven fabric is obtained after demoulding; the non-woven fabric comprises the following raw material components: low-melting-point fibers for sizing and reducing air permeability, low-melting-point fibers for sizing and increasing hardness, black polyester staple fibers and white 2D polyester staple fibers. The TPU glue film is not needed to be used for manufacturing the sealing bag, the sealing bag is not needed to be disassembled and assembled manually, the steam spraying time is short, the 0-degree clearance between a product and a mould can be ensured, and the shaping effect is excellent.

title_en: System and method for managing device parameters of sewing device and computer storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a sewing equipment parameter management system, method and computer storage medium, the equipment parameter management system includes: the visual terminal is used for generating and sending login information of a user when the user enters a parameter modification page; the server is used for receiving the login information and searching the user authority configuration matched with the user according to the login information; after receiving an operation instruction configured by the visual terminal aiming at the user permission, calling a corresponding interface of the sewing equipment according to the operation instruction, and remotely executing the permission management operation corresponding to the operation instruction through the corresponding interface of the sewing equipment. The invention realizes the remote batch locking of important parameters of the sewing equipment and the like, ensures that the preset parameters are not modified by operators, and improves the management efficiency; through increasing the locking identification position to the controller parameter, the remote adjustment function of thing networking device is more subdivided, guarantees subsequent authority management's strictness.

title_en: Zero-dimensional hybrid perovskite material with convertible crystal structure and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of luminescent materials, and particularly relates to a zero-dimensional hybrid perovskite material with a convertible crystal structure, and a preparation method and application thereof. The invention utilizes the same metal salt and organic amine to successfully prepare three kinds of 0D hybridized antimony halide materials with special PL emission property, namely alpha- [ DHEP (dihydrodihydrodihydrodihydrodihydrodihydrodihydrodihydrodihydrodihydrodihydrofolate)]SbCl 5 (Compound 1) beta- [ DHEP]SbCl 5 ·2H 2 O (Compound 2) and beta- [ DHEP]SbCl 5 (Compound 3). Due to [ SbCl ] 5 ] 2‑ Due to the slight change of the coordination environment, reversible crystal-to-crystal structure transformation can be formed between the compounds 1 and 2 through the triggering of acetone and methanol. In the presence of heatGuest H under Cooling treatment 2 During the release-absorption of O, a reversible PL transition from yellow to red light between compounds 2,3 can be achieved. Compound 3 can also be converted to Compound 1 with complete quenching of the red emission under methanol stimulation. The invention is expected to become an efficient intelligent luminescent material due to the comprehensive advantages of nearly uniform PLQY, ultrahigh PL response selectivity and sensitivity.

title_en: Linkage needling forming equipment for carbon fibers
abstract_en: The invention discloses linkage needling forming equipment for carbon fibers, which relates to the technical field of needling forming equipment of carbon fiber molds in the photovoltaic panel industry and comprises a mechanical arm, a bottom needling component, a shaping bearing device and a side needling device, wherein the end part of the mechanical arm is provided with the bottom needling component; the bottom needling component comprises a needling substrate, the mechanical arm is connected with one side of the needling substrate, and a needling device is arranged on the other side of the needling substrate; the shaping bearing device is provided with a crucible mold, and the bottom of the shaping bearing device is connected with a first sliding rail in a sliding manner; the lateral needling device comprises a lateral needling component, the lateral needling component corresponds to the position of the cylindrical section of the lateral part of the crucible mold, the lateral needling component is arranged on the lateral needling moving matrix, and the bottom of the lateral needling moving matrix is connected with a second sliding rail in a sliding manner. The invention provides linkage needling forming equipment for carbon fibers, which has the advantages of small volume, high needling efficiency and high needling quality.

title_en: Bottom line detection structure of sewing machine
abstract_en: The invention provides a bottom thread detection structure of a sewing machine, and belongs to the technical field of sewing machines. The technical problems that the whole structure of the bottom line detection and blowing cleaning of the existing sewing machine is not compact enough and the like are solved. The sewing machine comprises a mounting seat and a rotating shuttle assembly; the rotating shuttle assembly is provided with a shuttle core; the bottom line detection structure comprises a controller, an air blowing pipe connected with an air source and a sensor assembly fixedly arranged on a mounting seat, wherein the sensor assembly comprises a sensor body and a sensor probe fixedly arranged on the sensor body, the sensor probe is connected with the controller, and the sensor probe is opposite to a shuttle core; the air blowing pipe passes through the sensor body and faces to the sensor probe or/and the channel position between the sensor probe and the shuttle core; or the sensor body is provided with an air blowing port which is communicated with the air blowing pipe and faces to the position of the sensor probe or/and a channel between the sensor probe and the shuttle core. The bottom line detection structure and the blowing cleaning structure are integrated into an integrated structure, so that the structure is compact and the application range is wide.

title_en: Degradable non-woven fabric preparation process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation process of degradable non-woven fabrics, which relates to the technical field of non-woven fabric preparation and comprises the following steps: a1, processing and producing a semi-finished non-woven fabric; a2, bleaching the semi-finished non-woven fabric; a3, enhancing the radiation resistance of the bleached non-woven fabric; a4, coating operation; a5, reprocessing the coated non-woven fabric; a6, an online detection procedure and packaging treatment. The invention relates to a preparation process of a degradable non-woven fabric, which is characterized in that the non-woven fabric is vibrated in a bleaching pool filled with bleaching liquid in a wave-shaped structure in the whole process of producing the degradable non-woven fabric, so that the non-woven fabric can be effectively stretched, the non-woven fabric is prevented from shrinking, the problem that the non-woven fabric cannot be effectively contacted with the bleaching liquid, the bleaching process of the non-woven fabric can be completed in a long time, and the production efficiency of the non-woven fabric is influenced is solved, and the non-woven fabric is subjected to bleaching operation so as to facilitate the post-processing operation of the non-woven fabric.

title_en: Unidirectional moisture-conducting warm-keeping fabric and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a unidirectional moisture-conducting warm-keeping fabric and a preparation method and application thereof. The unidirectional moisture-conducting warm-keeping fabric comprises a matrix layer, wherein a hydrophobic layer is arranged on one side of the matrix layer; the hydrophobic layer comprises the following components: waterproofing agents, silica, thickening agents, and graphene oxide. The unidirectional moisture-conducting thermal fabric is of a double-layer hydrophobic differential structure, so that the unidirectional moisture-conducting thermal fabric reduces residues of sweat on the fabric, and further reduces heat required by sweat evaporation and cooling coefficient of the fabric after sweating.

title_en: Welding suit processing equipment with efficient filtering function and processing technology thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of welding clothes processing, and discloses welding clothes processing equipment with a high-efficiency filtering function and a processing technology thereof. The equipment comprises a machine body, wherein a processing base body is arranged on the machine body, a fixing structure is arranged on the machine body, a processing structure is arranged on the machine body, a welding cap on a welding garment is placed on the processing base body on the machine body, a filter mask is placed on the fixing structure, the filter mask is fixed on the processing base body through the fixing structure and is attached to the welding cap on the welding garment, the welding cap on the welding garment on the processing base body and the filter mask are subjected to heat sealing through the processing structure, and an opening and a cap ventilation ring piece are opened and sleeved at the top end of the welding cap on the welding garment; the processing structure enables the cap breathable ring sheet to penetrate through a welding cap on the welding suit by utilizing the limit of the processing opening, and the cap breathable ring sheet is shaped through the fixing rail.

title_en: Shoe tree quick positioning and clamping device
abstract_en: A rapid positioning and clamping device for a shoe tree comprises a mounting seat and a positioning seat; the mounting seat is used for mounting and fixing a shoe tree; the positioning seat is used for clamping and fixing the mounting seat and comprises a positioning seat body, a positioning shaft arranged on the positioning seat body and a plurality of fixing mechanisms distributed around the circumference of the positioning shaft, the mounting seat is provided with a positioning hole matched with the positioning shaft, and the positioning hole is movably sleeved on the positioning shaft so that the mounting seat can rotate around the positioning shaft between a locking state and a releasing state; the fixing mechanism comprises an arc-shaped positioning block arranged on the positioning seat body and an elastic pressing block arranged on the inner side of the positioning block, a fixing area for fixing the mounting seat is formed between the elastic pressing block and the positioning seat body, and the mounting seat is provided with a clamping part clamped in the fixing area; the elastic pressing block comprises a fixed end and a movable end, and the bottom surface of the movable end is lower than that of the fixed end in a natural state; the mounting seat rotates to a locking state, and the clamping portion is clamped into the fixing area from the fixed end and is downwards extruded and fixed on the positioning seat body by the movable end.

title_en: Yarn loading equipment and method for cotton quilt production
abstract_en: The invention provides yarn loading equipment for cotton quilt production, which comprises a frame; yarn loading modules arranged on the frame and used for loading yarn nets on two sides of cotton; the yarn loading module comprises: the first feeding roller and the second feeding roller are rotatably arranged on the frame, the first feeding roller is provided with two feeding rollers which are arranged up and down, the second feeding roller is provided with two feeding rollers which are arranged up and down, the first feeding roller and the second feeding roller are arranged along the feeding direction, cotton sequentially passes between the two first feeding rollers and between the two second feeding rollers along the feeding direction, the gauze has two parts, the gauze above passes between the cotton and the second feeding roller above, the gauze below passes between the cotton and the second feeding roller below, the first feeding roller and the second feeding roller rotate along the direction which enables the cotton to move towards the feeding direction, the two gauze enter from one side of the second feeding roller which is close to the first feeding roller, the two gauze are respectively wound on the corresponding first charging barrel, and the first charging barrel is rotatably arranged on the frame. The invention can realize automatic yarn loading.

title_en: Self-activated polyacrylonitrile-based nitrogen-containing porous carbon fiber, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of self-activated polyacrylonitrile-based nitrogen-containing porous carbon fibers, which comprises the following steps: (1) uniformly dispersing the potassium salt powder into a polyacrylonitrile solution to form a self-activating spinning solution, and obtaining self-activating fiber precursor through wet spinning; (2) pre-oxidizing the precursor of the self-activated fiber to obtain polyacrylonitrile-based pre-oxidized fiber;(3) carbonizing polyacrylonitrile-based pre-oxidized fiber to obtain the self-activated polyacrylonitrile-based nitrogen-containing porous carbon fiber. The self-activated polyacrylonitrile-based nitrogen-containing porous carbon fiber prepared by the method has high nitrogen content; and the introduction of potassium ions promotes the development of internal pore channels and increases CO 2 The diffusion path of the porous carbon fiber can improve the polarity of the material matrix and promote the porous carbon fiber of the product to react with CO 2 The adsorption of (2); so that the self-activated polyacrylonitrile-based nitrogen-containing porous carbon fiber pair CO 2 Has excellent adsorption performance and can be applied to CO 2 The field of adsorption.

title_en: High-quality laminating device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of printing equipment, and particularly relates to a high-quality laminating device which comprises a laminating platform, a printed matter unwinding mechanism arranged at the front end of the laminating platform, a protective film unwinding mechanism arranged above the laminating platform, a product winding mechanism arranged at the tail end of the laminating platform, a laminating mechanism arranged on the laminating platform and used for coating a protective film on a printed matter, a gluing mechanism arranged between the printed matter unwinding mechanism and the laminating mechanism and used for gluing the surface of the printed matter, and a static removing mechanism which is arranged corresponding to the protective film unwinding mechanism and used for removing static on the protective film. The invention provides a high-quality film coating device which can avoid the defects of film coating wrinkles, bubbles, unevenness, infirmity and the like and effectively improve the film coating quality of the device.

title_en: Braided wire processing device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a braided wire processing device which is characterized by comprising a wire feeding part and a winding part which are sequentially stacked, wherein the wire feeding part and the winding part are driven by a driving part, the wire feeding part, the winding part and the driving part are all arranged on a supporting frame, a plurality of wire feeding wheels wound with wires are rotatably arranged on the wire feeding part, the wire feeding part comprises an upper wire feeding part, a middle wire feeding part and a lower wire feeding part which are sequentially stacked from top to bottom, the wires on the wire feeding wheels on the lower wire feeding part are coated on the wires on the wire feeding wheels on the wire feeding part, and the wires on the wire feeding wheels on the middle wire feeding part are coated on the wires on the wire feeding wheels on the upper wire feeding part.

title_en: Adjustable conveying device of screen printer
abstract_en: The invention discloses an adjustable screen printer conveying device, which comprises: the machine frame comprises a machine frame, wherein a movable mechanism is arranged at the top of the machine frame, a silk screen printing mechanism is arranged on a book conveying shaft of the movable mechanism, a silk screen printing conveying mechanism is arranged at the top of the machine frame, a first receiving conveying mechanism is arranged at the left side of the machine frame, a second receiving conveying mechanism is arranged at the back of the first receiving conveying mechanism, an industrial camera is arranged at the left side of the top of the silk screen printing conveying mechanism, and a control console is arranged on the front side of the machine frame. After the workpiece is printed, the printed matter on the surface of the workpiece is photographed through an industrial camera, photo information is fed back to a control console, the control console can compare the photo information with stored standard information, whether the printing is qualified or not is judged, when the workpiece is moved to the top of the material guiding and conveying mechanism, the control console adjusts the front and back positions of the material guiding and conveying mechanism according to whether the printing is qualified or not, the classification and conveying of qualified printed matter and defective printed matter of the workpiece are realized, the functionality of the device is improved, follow-up detection is not needed, and the working difficulty is reduced.

title_en: Ink residue preventing process for high-speed printing
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ink residue prevention process for high-speed printing, which comprises the following steps of: s1, placing the material to be printed on a discharging conveyor, and presetting the discharging conveying speed of the discharging conveyor; s2, starting the discharging conveyor, detecting the surface tension of the discharged materials in the preset discharging conveyor, and continuously increasing the tension value by 2-5 MPa when the printing tension value is reached; s3, printing the surface of the material to be printed by a printer, and discharging the printed material by a discharging conveyor; s4, adjusting and reducing the discharging speed of the discharging conveyor, and simultaneously carrying out rapid heating drying and blowing treatment on the printed material; s5, increasing the temperature of heating and drying and the drying wind speed, and simultaneously cleaning the residual solvent to completely dry the printed ink; and S6, cooling the material by a cooling machine, inspecting the material after cooling, and completing all printing steps.

title_en: Preparation and application of bio-based waterproof and oil-proof agent
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of waterproof and oil-proof agents, and particularly discloses preparation and application of a bio-based waterproof and oil-proof agent, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: mixing a biomass raw material, a sodium hydroxide aqueous solution, isopropanol and sodium chloroacetate for reaction, adjusting the pH value to 7 after the reaction is finished, dropwise adding absolute ethyl alcohol to obtain a product, and drying the product to obtain a product A; step two, mixing the product A with a solvent, an alkyl ketene dimer and a catalyst for reaction, then dropwise adding isopropanol to obtain a reaction product, washing and drying to obtain a product B; and step three, adding the product B into water, heating and emulsifying to obtain the biomass-based waterproof and oilproof agent. The biomass-based waterproof and oilproof agent does not contain fluorine, is safe and environment-friendly, can improve the waterproof and oilproof performance of the paper-based material, and can directly enter a papermaking recovery system when the paper-based material is recovered, so that the paper base can be recycled by repulping, the problem of difficulty in recovering paper-plastic products is avoided, and the environmental pollution is avoided.

title_en: Flat needling machine
abstract_en: The invention provides a flat needling machine which comprises a rack, a needling mechanism, a product platform and a lifting mechanism, wherein the needling mechanism, the product platform and the lifting mechanism are arranged on the rack along a needling direction; the lifting mechanism is respectively connected with the ends of the needle beam and the hair peeling plate so as to drive the needle beam and the hair peeling plate to move, so that the felting needles continuously penetrate into and pull out the object to be needled on the product platform. The invention designs and provides a flat needle machine with a lower needling structure, which utilizes the lower needling technology of asynchronous movement of felting needles and stripping plates to meet the requirement of Z-direction characteristics of special fiber needling products, has good interlayer bonding strength, high production efficiency and can realize large-batch intelligent production.

title_en: Paper machine dryer scraper equipment for pillow-pack base paper processing
abstract_en: The invention discloses paper machine dryer scraper equipment for pillow wrapping base paper processing, which comprises a dryer, a support plate and a scraper and is characterized in that a shaft lever is arranged in the middle of the dryer, the middle of the shaft lever is fixedly connected with the dryer, the support plates are respectively arranged on two sides of the shaft lever, one side top end of the support plate is respectively and movably connected with the shaft lever, a transmission motor is arranged on the other side top end of the support plate, one side of the transmission motor is fixedly connected with the support plate, a bottom plate is arranged at the bottom end of the support plate, two sides of the top end of the bottom plate are respectively and fixedly connected with the support plate, universal wheels are respectively arranged on the periphery of the bottom end of the bottom plate, the top ends of the universal wheels are respectively and movably connected with the bottom plate, bolts are respectively and spirally connected with the bottom plate, a base is arranged in the middle of the top end of the bottom plate, the bottom end of the base is fixedly connected with the bottom plate, grooves are respectively arranged in the base at equal intervals, and telescopic struts are respectively arranged in the grooves. The invention has simple structure and convenient operation.

title_en: Printing and dyeing processing device
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of printing and dyeing, especially, relate to a printing and dyeing processing apparatus, its technical scheme is, including the install bin, set up in the install bin and be used for conveying the transfer roller of fabrics one, along the clean subassembly of fabrics processing route setting gradually in the install bin, dry subassembly and printing and dyeing subassembly, clean subassembly is including setting up the cleaning member in the install bin and the washing piece that is used for wasing the fabrics. This application has the effect that improves textile printing and dyeing quality.

title_en: Long-acting sterilization school uniform
abstract_en: The application discloses long-acting sterilization school uniform, and relates to the field of school uniforms. The long-acting sterilization school uniform is made of long-acting sterilization fabric, and the long-acting sterilization fabric comprises a basic fabric layer, a water-resistant adhesive layer tightly attached to the basic fabric layer and a sterilization layer arranged on one side, away from the basic fabric layer, of the water-resistant adhesive layer; the water-resistant adhesive layer is a water-resistant waterborne polyurethane emulsion, the sterilization layer is a nano titanium dioxide mucilage, and the nano titanium dioxide mucilage comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 20-30 parts of nano titanium dioxide and 100 parts of dispersion medium. After the long-acting sterilization school uniform is washed by water for 100 times, the sterilization rate is still over 80 percent, and the long-acting sterilization school uniform has a long-term sterilization effect.

title_en: Plastic packaging bag production is with melting and cutting device with leftover bits recovery structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a melting and cutting device with an edge material recycling structure for plastic packaging bag production, and relates to the technical field of plastic bag processing. The movable pipe is driven to move by the first threaded rod arranged in the cleaning mechanism, so that the cleaning roller can send the edge materials into the collecting box for collection, the edge materials are prevented from being accumulated on the processing table to cause pollution, the driving mechanism drives the melting cutter to ascend and descend in a driving mode through the driving mode of the cleaning mechanism, the cleaning roller is driven to clean the edge materials conveniently, and the adjustable pressing plate structure arranged on one side of the cleaning mechanism can facilitate the fixation of the plastic bag raw materials and the melting cutter to melt and cut the plastic bag raw materials.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for calibrating code disc pulse signals of printing system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for calibrating code disc pulse signals of a printing system, and relates to the technical field of inkjet printing. The method comprises the steps of outputting an initial pulse signal to a first drive board card through a control code disc; after the first driving board card is controlled to receive the initial pulse signal, the first pulse signal is output to the second driving board card, after the second driving board card is controlled to receive the first pulse signal, the second pulse signal is output to the third driving board card, and the like, and after the N driving board card is controlled to receive the N-1 pulse signal, the N pulse signal is output; and then, according to the pulse signals output by the driving boards, determining the corresponding calibration pulse number of the driving boards, and calibrating the code disc pulse signals input to the driving boards, thereby realizing that the driving boards connected in a cascading manner in a printing system can trigger the spray heads to spray ink at the same time for printing, and ensuring the printing quality.

title_en: Paper feeding device and image forming apparatus including the same
abstract_en: A paper feeder comprises a sensor, a roller and a bracket, wherein the sensor and the roller are arranged on the bracket. The carriage supports the sensor and the roller such that the sensor and the roller contact the surface of the paper roll. The sensor and the roller are directed towards the axial centre of the roll. The roller and the sensor are disposed at a distance in the circumferential direction of the paper roll. The sensor has a detection accuracy capable of detecting the step of the front end of the roll.

title_en: Pick and place tool for articles
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a pick and place tool for items. Articles with fibers may be picked and placed using a tool head with fiber-engaging hooks. The tool head may include at least one hook and at least one contact surface adjacent the hook. Fiber-engaging hooks may extend from the hook portion. The tool head may be actuatable between at least a first configuration that allows hooks to engage fibers and a second configuration that does not allow hooks to engage fibers. The article may be picked up with the tool head in the first configuration at the starting position and placed in the placement position by moving the tool head and then actuating the tool head to the second configuration.

title_en: Three-dimensional metal lithium-oxide composite negative electrode, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a three-dimensional metal lithium-oxide composite cathode, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) mixing the three-dimensional conductive framework with a metal solution, and carrying out hydrothermal reaction to obtain a substrate material; or mixing the three-dimensional conductive framework, the metal solution and the imidazole solution, and carrying out heat treatment to obtain a substrate material; the metal element in the metal solution comprises any one or the combination of at least two of vanadium, tin, zinc and cobalt, and the substrate material comprises a three-dimensional conductive framework and a metal oxide generated on the surface of the three-dimensional conductive framework in situ; (2) and mixing the substrate material and the molten lithium to obtain the three-dimensional metal lithium-oxide composite negative electrode. The three-dimensional conductive framework and the lithium-philic oxide in the negative electrode are synergistic, the generation of lithium dendrite is inhibited, the specific surface area is large, the appearance is good, the charge can be uniformly conducted, the local charge density is reduced, the volume expansion of the negative electrode is inhibited, and the capacity and the cycling stability in the all-solid-state lithium metal battery are higher.

title_en: Non-woven fabric production line and process for vamp material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-woven fabric production line for vamp materials, which comprises a batch feeder, an opener, a carding machine, a netting machine, a needle loom, a hot mill, a dryer, a needle detector, a lap former and a bottom plate, wherein the upper end of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with the opener, the batch feeder is arranged on the opener, the carding machine is fixedly connected onto the bottom plate, the netting machine is fixedly connected onto the bottom plate, the needle loom is fixedly connected onto the bottom plate, the hot mill is fixedly connected onto the bottom plate, the dryer is fixedly connected onto the bottom plate, the needle detector is fixedly connected onto the bottom plate, the lap former is fixedly connected onto the bottom plate, a filtering mechanism is arranged on the opener, and a dust collecting mechanism is arranged on the opener. The invention relates to a non-woven fabric production line and a non-woven fabric production process for vamp materials, which have the characteristics of good processing quality and good hot rolling effect.

title_en: Antibacterial high-wet-modulus bamboo cellulose fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of antibacterial fibers, and provides an antibacterial high wet modulus bamboo cellulose fiber and a preparation method thereof. According to the invention, the antibacterial high-wet-modulus bamboo cellulose fiber is prepared by adopting the organic silicon quaternary ammonium salt as the antibacterial agent and the bamboo pulp as the raw material through a modal process, the organic silicon quaternary ammonium salt can form a covalent bond with the cellulose fiber, and the prepared antibacterial high-wet-modulus bamboo cellulose fiber has good safety and excellent antibacterial and bacteriostatic properties. In addition, the antibacterial high-wet-modulus bamboo cellulose fiber prepared by the method can meet the definition requirement of the high-wet modulus of modal fiber in the BISFA standard, the dry-wet strength and the wet modulus are greatly improved compared with common viscose fiber, the hand feeling is softer and more smooth compared with modal, and the antibacterial high-wet-modulus bamboo cellulose fiber has a good antibacterial effect on staphylococcus aureus, Klebsiella pneumoniae and Candida albicans.

title_en: Hollow carbon fiber material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of nano material preparation, and particularly discloses a hollow carbon fiber material, a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: preparing a shell spinning solution stock solution and a core spinning solution stock solution; carrying out coaxial electrostatic spinning on the shell spinning solution stock solution and the inner core spinning solution stock solution to obtain a carbon fiber precursor; soaking the carbon fiber precursor in a tetraethyl silicate solution to obtain a coated carbon fiber precursor; sequentially performing pre-oxidation treatment and high-temperature carbonization treatment on the coated carbon fiber precursor to obtain a coated hollow structure carbon fiber; etching the carbon fiber coated with the hollow structure by using an HF solution, and drying to obtain the hollow carbon fiber material. According to the method, the carbon fiber precursor is wrapped by the reticular silica, so that the problem that the carbon fiber precursor is easy to crosslink in the pre-oxidation and carbonization processes is effectively solved, the stability of the carbon fiber is improved, and the specific surface area of the material is increased to the greatest extent.

title_en: Method for purifying and upgrading paper pulp into pulp for lyocell fibers
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for purifying and upgrading paper pulp into pulp for lyocell, wherein the alkali resistance R10 of the finished pulp is more than or equal to 90 percent, R18-R10 is more than or equal to 2.8, and the finished pulp is in a cellulose I type. The method comprises the steps of purifying bleaching pulp and removing metal ions; the purification method comprises N-grade alkali extraction and enzyme treatment, wherein the alkali is sodium hydroxide and potassium hydroxide, and the alkali consumption is 1-10% of the total mass of the slurry; the enzyme preparation is one or more of cellulase, hemicellulase and laccase; the mode of removing the metal ions is acid treatment combined with complexing treatment, and a back washing mode is adopted to reduce the content of iron, calcium, magnesium and copper ions in the paper pulp, and in addition, the content of silicon is also reduced. The purification process of the invention has simple flow, and the prepared pulp for the lyocell fiber has good spinning performance.

title_en: Fabric with cool feeling function and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fabric with a cool feeling function and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of functional fabrics. The fabric with the cool feeling function comprises a first fabric layer and a second fabric layer, wherein the first fabric layer is formed by interweaving moisture absorption yarn materials, the second fabric layer is formed by interweaving heat conduction yarn materials, and the first fabric layer and the second fabric layer are connected through interweaving the moisture absorption yarn materials of the first fabric layer and the heat conduction yarn materials of the second fabric layer to form a junction point. The invention adopts a layered structure weaving method, and the interaction between the moisture absorption yarn material and the heat conduction yarn material can continuously generate the cool feeling effect. The process is the same as the dyeing and finishing process of the common fabric without adding additional working procedures in the dyeing and finishing process, and the prepared fabric has the cool feeling function. The yarns adopted by the invention are mostly conventional fiber materials such as viscose, chinlon and the like, and no additional processing is needed, so that the manufactured fabric has stable performance and is not easy to reduce cool feeling due to repeated washing. In addition, the yarn material which can be selected is relatively low in price, so that the prepared cool fabric is low in cost.

title_en: Copper ion non-woven fabric with sterilization function and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of non-woven fabrics, and discloses a copper ion non-woven fabric with a sterilization function, which comprises a non-woven fabric body, wherein the non-woven fabric body comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: fiber: 1-20 parts of copper and silver ions: 0.5-12 parts of ethyl stearate: 1-6 parts of modified hyperbranched polyester: 2-8 parts of water: 50-100 parts; the fiber adopts plant fiber and mineral fiber; the non-woven fabric body further comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: tourmaline powder: 10-50 parts; the non-woven fabric body further comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: calcium carbonate filling master batch: 5-25 parts; the calcium carbonate filling master batch comprises calcium carbonate and polypropylene. According to the copper ion non-woven fabric with the sterilization function and the preparation method thereof, the added calcium carbonate filling master batch can improve the weather resistance and the temperature resistance of the non-woven fabric, so that the non-woven fabric has better performance, and the non-woven fabric has better use effect.

title_en: Recording apparatus
abstract_en: The invention provides a recording device, which is characterized in that when the inclination of a surface for flowing waste liquid is increased, the height of the recording device is increased. A printer (10) is provided with a recording unit (14), a platen unit (16), a maintenance tank (22), and a guide section (24). The recording unit (14) ejects ink (Q) to the medium (M). The platen unit (16) has a support surface (17) that supports the medium (M), and a disposal unit (18) that disposes waste ink (QW). The maintenance tank (22) recovers waste ink (QW). The guide section (24) has a receiving surface (25) and guides waste ink (QW) to the maintenance tank (22). When a first surface energy (E1) with respect to waste ink (QW) at a first position (P1) where a receiving surface (25) is set, and a second surface energy (E2) with respect to waste ink (QW) at a second position (P2) closer to a maintenance tank (22) than the first position (P1) are set, the second surface energy (E2) is larger than the first surface energy (E1).

title_en: Method for fixing hydroxy acid ester oligomer on fiber surface by SCF technology and antibacterial and antiviral product
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for fixing a hydroxy acid ester oligomer on the surface of a fiber by using an SCF (short-cut-fiber) technology and an antibacterial and antiviral product. The hydroxy acid ester oligomer has good antibacterial and antiviral effects. The SCF dissolved with the hydroxy acid ester oligomer can swell the fiber, and the hydroxy acid ester oligomer permeates into the amorphous area of the shallow surface layer of the fiber and is fixed on the surface of the fiber after the pressure of the SCF is released, so that the durable antibacterial and antiviral effects are directly obtained. In order to obtain stable and efficient antibacterial and antiviral effects on the fiber, the solubility of the hydroxy acid ester oligomer in the SCF is improved by using ethanol as a cosolvent; the loss of the hydroxy acid ester oligomer is avoided by adopting a temperature and pressure control method of raising temperature and pressure in sections and gradually approaching the process temperature and pressure; the periodic motion of dynamic and static combination of the fluid containing the hydroxy acid ester oligomer enables the content of the hydroxy acid ester oligomer in the fiber to be uniform, and the fiber obtains stable fixing amount of the hydroxy acid ester oligomer by combining a slow pressure release mode, thereby obtaining good and durable antibacterial and antiviral effects.

title_en: Silver powder impregnated paper and production process thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of impregnated paper, in particular to silver powder impregnated paper and a production process thereof.
