The silver powder impregnated paper is sequentially provided with a first coating layer, a first glue dipping layer, a silver powder paper layer, a second glue dipping layer and a second coating layer from the upper surface to the lower surface, the first glue dipping layer and the second glue dipping layer are obtained by glue dipping and curing glue dipping glue, the first coating layer and the second coating layer are obtained by coating and curing coating glue, and the coating glue is prepared from the following raw materials: 90-100 parts of melamine glue solution, 3-5 parts of environment-friendly plasticizer, 1.5-2.5 parts of softening agent and 5-8 parts of silver powder fixing emulsion. The silver powder impregnated paper of this application reduces silver powder and drops at the course of working, and then reduces that silver powder impregnated paper surface appears blushing, silver powder inequality, possibility such as blistering, improves the quality and the production efficiency of silver powder impregnated paper.

title_en: Antibacterial and warm-keeping fabric and weaving method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an antibacterial and warm-keeping fabric which comprises an outer layer, a middle layer and an inner layer, wherein the outer layer and the inner layer are connected through the middle layer through a double-faced knitted structure and are woven by hollow warm-keeping fibers, heating fibers, nano-silver composite antibacterial fibers and natural or synthetic polymer fibers. Wherein, the warp yarn is made of natural or synthetic polymer fiber, heating fiber and nano-silver composite antibacterial fiber according to the mass ratio of 10-12:4-6:3-5, selecting natural or synthetic polymer fibers, heating fibers and hollow heat-insulating fibers as weft yarns, and mixing the natural or synthetic polymer fibers, the heating fibers and the hollow heat-insulating fibers according to a mass ratio of (9-11): 7-9:2-3 twisted into a plied yarn. According to the invention, the hollow thermal fibers and the heating fibers are selected to improve the thermal effect of the fabric, the nano-silver composite antibacterial fibers are prepared to resist bacteria, and the fiber twists with different mass ratios of the warp yarns and the weft yarns are arranged, so that the functional fiber content is lower, and a better antibacterial thermal effect can be obtained under the condition of reducing the cost of the fabric.

title_en: Slurry screening rotor and slurry screening equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a slurry screening rotor and slurry screening equipment, which are used for rotating around the axis of the slurry screening rotor under the drive of a pressure screen. The blade comprises a head part, a tail part and a screening part, wherein the outline of the head part is arc-shaped. The width W1 of the screening portion tends to decrease at least partially in the direction from the head portion to the tail portion. The slurry screening rotor has the advantages that the heads of the blades are arc-shaped, smooth transition pulses are generated in the stirring process of the non-wood fiber slurry, the fluidity of the non-wood fiber slurry is improved, the non-wood fiber slurry is processed more gently, the rotation resistance is effectively reduced, the energy consumption of a pressure screen is further reduced, the service life of the blades is prolonged, and the overall reliability of the slurry screening rotor is improved. In addition, the blade with the width reduced from the head to the tail effectively improves the suction area of the pulp, is beneficial to improving the pulp concentration, and further improves the productivity of the non-wood fiber pulp screening equipment.

title_en: Visual detection method and device for metal ions and water-jet printing method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of chemical sensing, and particularly relates to a visual detection method, a detection device and a water spray printing method for metal ions (particularly multiple metal ions). The invention provides a visual detection method of metal ions, which comprises the steps of graphically displaying the color response of a fluorescent material to the metal ions, and identifying and distinguishing the metal ions based on the graphical display. According to the method, different color responses of the fluorescent material after interaction with different metal ions are realized, response results are extracted, radar maps of different metal ions are drawn, and the different metal ions can be more visually identified and distinguished through a visual radar map. The method provides the color change detection and the opportunity of acquiring the chemical sensing technology for the color blindness patient, and is superior and humanized compared with the traditional colorimetric detection method. The invention also provides a visual detection device for the metal ions, and the device adopts the visual detection method to detect the metal ions.

title_en: Antistatic treatment equipment and method for polyester fiber fabric
abstract_en: The invention discloses antistatic treatment equipment and a treatment method for polyester fiber fabrics, wherein the antistatic treatment equipment for polyester fiber fabrics comprises a treatment box, antistatic treatment liquid is stored in the treatment box, three guide rollers are rotatably arranged in the treatment box, the three guide rollers are in V-shaped arrangement, a cleaning box is fixedly arranged on the outer wall of the left side of the treatment box, the right side of the cleaning box is in an opening structure, and a drying box is fixedly arranged on the outer wall of the right side of the treatment box. The invention has reasonable design and good practicability, can realize the integrated operation of sequentially cleaning, dedusting, antistatic treatment and drying the polyester fiber fabric, can uniformly and fully impregnate the polyester fiber fabric in the antistatic treatment liquid, can rapidly and effectively heat and dry the polyester fiber fabric, can avoid the wrinkling of the polyester fiber fabric during drying, and improves the antistatic processing quality and processing efficiency of the polyester fiber fabric.

title_en: Light emitting device and drawing device
abstract_en: The exposure device (40) is provided with a base (42) extending in one direction, a plurality of light emitting units (44) arranged on the front side of the base (42) so as to be offset in a direction intersecting the one direction, wherein the plurality of light sources are supported in one direction by a support (60) extending in the one direction in the light emitting units (44), and a drive substrate (72) provided on the inner side of the plurality of light emitting units (44) in the direction intersecting the one direction of the base (42) along the one direction, respectively, for driving the light emitting units (44).

title_en: Method for making stencil by using foil or film material only
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for manufacturing a stencil by only using a foil or a film material, which is a method for directly driving a laser beam to cut and remove materials by software and selectively manufacturing through openings on a pattern area of a continuous material, and replaces the traditional indirect method for plugging meshes on a non-pattern area of a woven screen material with through openings and keeping the openings of the pattern area in a through state to manufacture the stencil. By adding the structural wires for tensioning and connecting in the opening area, the defects that a metal foil and a high polymer film are used as a screen printing plate, the screen printing plate is not suitable for large opening length-width ratio, large opening area and large opening edge patterns, and the problems of complex template manufacturing process and low automation degree are solved. The stencil has the advantages of high precision and quality, simple and rapid manufacturing process, environment friendliness, easy operation, easily obtained materials and equipment, and low cost, and can be used for distributing various high-performance materials and producing formed stencils.

title_en: Paper cup and production process and equipment thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a paper cup and a production process and equipment thereof, wherein the paper cup comprises a cup body, a cup bottom and a cup mouth, wherein the cup body is formed by rolling and folding a fan-shaped sheet coated with a spray film layer, and comprises an inner layer, an intermediate layer and an outer layer which are mutually bonded through melting the spray film layer, wherein the intermediate layer is a concave-convex surface layer, and a heat insulation cavity is formed between the intermediate layer and the outer layer; the joint of the cup mouth and the cup bottom is a double-layer structure comprising an inner layer and an outer layer; during production, firstly, concave-convex surface pressing is carried out on the area of the unreeled paper corresponding to the middle layer; then carrying out surface laminating treatment on the pressed paper, and cooling to form laminated paper with a laminating layer; cutting fan-shaped pieces on the laminating paper; then, the fan-shaped sheet is rolled and formed by a paper cup forming machine, and the spraying film layer is heated to keep molten in the process so as to facilitate the mutual adhesion of the inner layer, the middle layer and the outer layer; and finally, adhering and forming the edge of the cup opening and the cup bottom. The paper cup has the advantages of high cup body stiffness, strong water seepage resistance and good heat insulation effect.

title_en: Preparation process of cationic coffee carbon thermal fibers
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation process of cation coffee carbon thermal fibers, which comprises the steps of (a) putting regenerated cation polyester chips into a crystallization drying device for crystallization and drying, and putting coffee carbon mother granules into a dryer for drying; feeding the dried regenerated cationic polyester chips and the coffee carbon master batches into a master batch machine according to the proportion for blending; (b) And conveying the obtained blend to a screw extruder for melt extrusion, metering the obtained spinning melt by a metering pump, spinning by a spinning assembly to generate primary yarns, heating the primary yarns, slowly cooling in a windless area, cooling by circular blowing, bundling and oiling, pre-networking, drafting and shaping, and winding to obtain the cationic coffee carbon fibers. The invention can prepare the fiber with good air permeability, heat preservation and dyeing performance, and meets the requirement of environmental protection production.

title_en: High-water-absorption cotton gauze and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides high-water-absorption cotton gauze and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: adding sodium alginate and polyvinyl alcohol into water for mixing, then adding formic acid and N, N-dimethylformamide for mixing, then adding hyaluronic acid and water-soluble chitosan, and mixing to obtain a spinning stock solution; carrying out electrostatic spinning by using the spinning solution to obtain alginate fibers; blending the alginate fibers and the cotton fibers, finishing and drying to obtain blended cotton gauze; and (3) dipping the blended cotton gauze in a hyaluronic acid solution, taking out and drying to obtain the high-water-absorption cotton gauze. The high water absorption cotton gauze disclosed by the invention can reach the water absorption rate of more than 500%, has the bacteriostatic effects on staphylococcus aureus and escherichia coli before and after water absorption of more than 88%, has the anti-pilling fluffing grade of more than 4.4, is flexible in hand feeling and good in mechanical property, and is suitable for medical dressings.

title_en: High-benefit single-product clothes flow production line
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-benefit single-product clothes flow production line which comprises a station switching mechanism a and station switching mechanisms b symmetrically arranged at two sides of the station switching mechanism a, wherein a plurality of supporting mechanisms are arranged along the transmission direction of the station switching mechanism a, a plurality of spray dyeing mechanisms are arranged along the transmission direction of the station switching mechanism b, the supporting mechanisms and the spray dyeing mechanisms are mutually matched to form a closed processing environment for spray dyeing, drying and other steps on clothes under the driving of the station switching mechanism a and the station switching mechanism b, and waste gas generated by mixing hot air and spray dyed pigment can not overflow, so that a working environment is guaranteed for working staff, the health of the working staff is guaranteed, the problems that the existing spray dyeing device can clean, blow and dry clothes in the spray dyeing process, and the like, and the steps can be mixed with spray dyed pigment and generate a large amount of harmful waste gas, so that the health of the working staff is seriously influenced are solved.

title_en: Aramid fiber-assisted polyvinyl alcohol aerogel, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses aramid fiber-assisted polyvinyl alcohol aerogel, and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: providing a composite dispersion liquid containing polyvinyl alcohol, aramid nano-fibers and an organic solvent, and contacting the composite dispersion liquid serving as a precursor with water to realize sol-gel conversion to obtain aramid-assisted polyvinyl alcohol hydrogel; and then carrying out or not carrying out solvent replacement, and then drying to obtain the aramid fiber-assisted polyvinyl alcohol aerogel. The invention also provides an aramid fiber-assisted polyvinyl alcohol aerogel hemostatic material which consists of the above-mentioned assisted polyvinyl alcohol aerogel, has both excellent hydrophilicity of polyvinyl alcohol and excellent mechanical properties of aramid fiber nanofibers, and has a hierarchical pore structure with coexisting nanopores and micropores. The aerogel hemostatic material provided by the invention has good biocompatibility and high water absorption performance, has a quick hemostatic effect, is simple in preparation process, low in energy consumption, suitable for large-scale production and wide in application prospect.

title_en: Dual-purpose cut loop velvet jacquard
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of jacquard, in particular to a dual-purpose cut loop velvet jacquard. The cam of the device comprises a general module, a knife-hook integrated replacement module and a knife-hook separation replacement module, wherein the general module and the knife-hook integrated replacement module are combined to be used for knitting needles with integrated knife hooks, the general module and the knife-hook separation replacement module are combined to be used for knitting needles with separated knife hooks, the cam track comprises a cutter track, a crochet track and a middle needle track, the cutter track is formed on the general module, a crochet needle first lifting section and a middle needle first lifting section are arranged on the knife-hook integrated replacement module, and a crochet needle traversing section and a middle needle traversing section are arranged on the knife-hook separation replacement module. Two working modes can be realized by replacing part of the triangular modules, the production enterprises can quickly switch model types according to actual demands, the product demands are met, and the purchasing cost of the enterprise equipment is reduced by the dual-purpose equipment.

title_en: Ink filtering device of printer and printer
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ink filtering device of a printer and the printer, wherein the ink filtering device of the printer is used for the printer, the printer comprises an ink box, an ink inlet pipe provided with an ink path switch valve and a spray head provided with a spray nozzle, the ink filtering device of the printer comprises a base body, a filtering assembly and an air supply assembly, the base body is provided with a containing cavity, the containing cavity is provided with an ink inlet and an ink outlet communicated with the spray nozzle, the filtering assembly is arranged in the containing cavity, the filtering assembly comprises a first filtering piece provided with a filtering cavity, the oil inlet end of the ink inlet pipe is communicated with the ink box, the oil outlet end of the ink inlet pipe is fixed in the ink inlet and extends into the containing cavity to be communicated with the filtering cavity, the air supply assembly comprises an air supply pipe and an air path switch valve arranged on the air supply pipe, one end of the air supply pipe is inserted into the containing cavity and is communicated with the filtering cavity, and the other end of the air supply pipe is communicated with an external air source. The filter device can avoid ink leakage of the nozzle due to ink pressure impact.

title_en: Breathable quick-drying sun-proof air window fabric and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a breathable quick-drying sun-proof air window fabric and a preparation method thereof, wherein the breathable quick-drying sun-proof air window fabric is woven by fine denier polyamide fibers and polyamide cladding yarn fibers; wherein: the thickness of the fine denier polyamide fiber is smaller than that of the polyamide cladding yarn fiber; adopting a texture structure with changed textures, wherein the warp and weft density at the pattern is smaller than that at the non-pattern; the low density part is fine denier polyamide fiber, and the high density part is polyamide cladding yarn fiber; the breathable quick-drying sun-proof air window fabric has the function of automatically adjusting the body surface temperature. The invention improves the common sultry of the woven sun-proof clothing fabric, so that the woven sun-proof clothing really protects the sun, does not absorb heat and is not sultry, light and easy to store.

title_en: Preparation method of antibacterial protective film of silicon-based material
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a silicon-based material antibacterial protective film. The method comprises the steps of surface oxidation modification of the silicon-based material to form a surface antibacterial film, and then treatment of the immobilized antibacterial film by using an amino-rich long-chain compound solution. In the surface oxidation modification, the epoxy silylation reagent is 3-glycidoxypropyl trimethoxysilane (GPTMS), 3-glycidoxypropyl dimethylethoxysilane (GPDMES), 3- (2, 3) -epoxypropyl methyldimethoxymethylsilane (GPDMMS), or 3- (2, 3) glycidoxypropyl trimethoxysilane (GPTS). The amino-rich long chain compound comprises chitosan, polylysine, polyhistidine, polyethyleneimine or polyallylamine. The filter paper provided by the invention is inoculated with escherichia coli (8099) with the density of 1.8x10  5  CFU/sample, is inoculated with staphylococcus aureus (ATCC 6538) with the density of 1.9x10  5  CFU/sample, and is observed for culturing for 0h and 18h, the bacterial count is calculated to obtain the antibacterial activity of more than 5.7, and the antibacterial rate is 99%.

title_en: Solar energy absorbing material based on biomass melanin ink balls, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biomass materials, and particularly relates to a solar energy absorbing material based on a biomass melanin ink ball, and a preparation method and application thereof. The method comprises the following steps: 1) Dispersing clean biomass melanin ink in distilled water, magnetically stirring at room temperature, washing with distilled water, and vacuum freeze-drying to obtain toner; 2) Treating the powdered ink obtained in the step 1) with concentrated sulfuric acid and sodium carbonate solution, then washing with distilled water, and obtaining ink balls through centrifugation and vacuum freeze drying; 3) And soaking the cellulose fabric in the solution of the ink balls, then putting the cellulose fabric into a vacuum drying oven for drying, and repeatedly soaking and drying to obtain the solar energy absorbing material based on the biomass melanin ink balls. The stable and efficient integrated solar evaporator is prepared by combining the photo-thermal biomass melanin toner and the cellulose fabric. The method is applied to the fields of sea water desalination, wastewater treatment, sewage treatment and the like.

title_en: Intelligent seal and unlocking method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides an intelligent seal and an unlocking method thereof. Wherein, one end of the shell is provided with an opening, and the shell is provided with a locking position and an unlocking position; the electronic control module, the battery and the motor are all arranged in the shell, the first support is connected to the shell in a sliding mode and connected with a driving shaft of the motor, and the first support is switched between a locking position and an unlocking position through driving of the motor; the second bracket is connected with the first bracket in a sliding way; the stamp assembly is connected with the first support. Through the cooperation of casing, motor, first support, second support and seal subassembly, formed a "lock" structure, when not needing to seal, can be located latched position through the first support of motor drive, can't seal this moment. When needing to seal, can be in the unblock position through the first support of motor drive, realize the unblock, can realize the action of stamping through pressing the casing this moment.

title_en: Fabric
abstract_en: A fabric, the filament number of the yarn forming the fabric is more than 0.1 denier, the fabric is measured by a variable angle photometer, the reflection intensity within the range of-90 degrees to-90 degrees of the reflection angle is measured when the incident angle is-60 degrees on one surface or two surfaces of the fabric, the data of every 0.1 degree of the reflection intensity within the range of-90 degrees to-90 degrees of the reflection angle is taken from the photometer, the reflection intensity within the range of-30 degrees to-50 degrees of the reflection angle and the reflection intensity within the range of 50 degrees to 70 degrees of the reflection angle are calculated, and the ratio of the reflection intensity within the range of-30 degrees to-50 degrees of the reflection angle to the reflection intensity within the range of 50 degrees to 70 degrees of the reflection angle is 1.2 to 2.5. The fabric can be any texture, knitted fabric or woven fabric of any thickness.

title_en: Preparation method of aromatherapy down composite fiber
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of aromatherapy down composite fibers, which comprises the following steps of: mixing plant essence, porous silicon dioxide and modified diatom ooze according to the weight ratio of 1: (2-3): (2-4) mixing to obtain a plant essence adsorption carrier; dissolving down powder, nano plant mixed powder and a plant essence adsorption carrier in a solvent to prepare an electrostatic spinning solution with the mass fraction of 10-25 wt%; performing electrostatic spinning on the prepared electrostatic spinning solution to obtain down composite fiber yarns; soaking the woven down feather composite fiber in aromatherapy liquid, and stirring the aromatherapy liquid soaked with the down feather composite fiber by using an ultrasonic stirrer; and dehydrating the soaked down feather composite fiber filaments by a dehydrator and then drying. According to the preparation method of the aromatherapy down feather composite fiber, the plant essence is fully adsorbed, meanwhile, the specific surface area of the fiber is increased, and the aroma retention time of the aromatherapy down feather composite fiber is prolonged.

title_en: Presser foot device of overlock sewing machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to a presser foot device of a overlock sewing machine, which comprises a machine body, wherein the machine body is provided with a shaft connecting hole, a fixing hole and a pressing rod hole, the presser foot device comprises a swinging mechanism, a cloth pressing mechanism and a pressing rod mechanism, the swinging mechanism is provided with a swinging piece, and the swinging piece is pivoted on the shaft connecting hole; the cloth pressing mechanism is provided with a pressing arm and a presser foot connected to the pressing arm, and the pressing arm is connected with the swinging piece; the rod pressing mechanism comprises an actuating element and a rod pressing assembly, wherein the actuating element is connected to the fixed hole in a penetrating way and is provided with a telescopic rod, the telescopic rod is connected to the rod pressing assembly, and the rod pressing assembly is connected to the rod pressing arm in a penetrating way; the pressing arm and the presser foot can be lifted or pressed down together through telescopic movement of the telescopic rod. Therefore, the whole structure of the presser foot device can be simplified, and the lifting height of the presser foot can be increased.

title_en: Special cushion paper for air fryer tray and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of special cushion paper for an air fryer tray, which can prepare the high-temperature-resistant, oil-proof and antibacterial special cushion paper for the air fryer tray, can work for more than 1h at the high temperature of about 200 ℃, has good bursting resistance, high flexibility and remarkable water and oil proofing effects, can reach 6kit, has stable and non-migration components of a blocking material, can meet the requirements of blocking fried food in the air fryer manufacturing process and protecting the wall and the tray sanitation, prolongs the service life of the air fryer, solves the technical problems of poor high temperature resistance and poor blocking effect of the existing food packaging paper, brings good economic and social benefits for enterprises, and improves the brand competitiveness of the enterprises. The invention also provides special cushion paper for the air fryer tray.

title_en: Transmission belt
abstract_en: A transmission belt (B) includes a belt body (11) made of an elastomer and a core wire (12) made of carbon fiber embedded in the belt body. Tape tension T per 1mm tape width at 0.2% tape elongation  0.2  Is 70N/mm or more. Tape tension T per 1mm tape width at 0.5% tape elongation  0.5  Is 220N/mm or more. Tape tension T  0.2  With belt tension T  0.5  The ratio of the ratio is 0.33 or more.

title_en: Method for improving bleaching performance of eucalyptus chemimechanical pulp
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving bleaching performance of eucalyptus chemi-mechanical pulp, which comprises the steps of firstly using a first double-screw extruder to crush and extrude wood chips for the first time before a pre-impregnation dosing step, then soaking the wood chips in high-temperature hot water, carrying out concentration and extrusion through a second double-screw extruder after soaking, and adding a pre-impregnation section chemical into obtained pulp to carry out a normal chemi-mechanical pulp production process. The application firstly provides the influence of the water-soluble carbonyl-nitrogen conjugated structure in the eucalyptus raw material on the subsequent bleaching performance of the eucalyptus chemi-mechanical pulp, and originally provides the method for improving the bleaching performance of the eucalyptus chemi-mechanical pulp.

title_en: Manikin, manikin and transport carriage assembly, machine and system for laser marking pants
abstract_en: The invention relates to a manikin (1) for supporting trousers on which laser marking is performed, comprising two leg structures (2) to be placed inside the legs of the trousers. Each structure has a respective longitudinal axis (20), an upper region (21) and a lower region (22), a front plane (23) and a rear plane (24), an inner portion (25) and an outer portion (26). The spacing between the inner and outer sections is varied by a stretching mechanism (3) to move from an inoperative release position (a) to a maximum limit stretching position (B) for marking. Each leg structure is coupled to a respective main rotation axis (5), each leg structure (2) is rotatable about the respective main rotation axis (5) by a respective hinge portion (51), the manikin (1) is provided with a respective hinge portion (5) for each leg structure (2). The main axis of rotation (5) is parallel or collinear with the direction of the crotch dimensions of the trousers. When the front planes (23) are rotated about their respective main axes of rotation (5), they may form at least two angles greater and/or less than 180 °.

title_en: High-performance ion-electron composite thermoelectric fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-performance ion-electron composite thermoelectric fiber and a preparation method thereof, wherein the composite thermoelectric fiber comprises an ionic liquid gel fiber core layer and an electron thermoelectric coating the ionic liquid gel fiber core layer; the components of the ionic liquid gel fiber core layer comprise: 50-90% of ionic liquid, 7-47% of organic polymer and 3-30% of inorganic nano filler with anisotropy; the electron thermoelectric coating comprises an electron thermoelectric material and an ionic liquid. The electronic thermoelectric coating performs thermal-electric conversion by using a temperature gradient to cause temperature fluctuation, and the ionic liquid fiber core layer performs thermoelectric conversion by using the temperature fluctuation so as to improve thermal voltage and thermoelectric power. The invention obtains the composite thermoelectric fiber with excellent thermoelectric property and mechanical property by controlling the structure of the ionic liquid gel fiber, the structure of the electronic thermoelectric coating and the interface combination of the ionic liquid gel fiber and the electronic thermoelectric coating, so that the composite thermoelectric fiber is more suitable for preparing the high-performance wearable thermoelectric material.

title_en: Preparation method of flexible graphene composite material and product thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to a preparation method of a flexible graphene composite material and a product thereof. In the application, graphene oxide is subjected to grafting modification, and propylene groups and cyanate groups are grafted on the surface of the graphene oxide, so that the graphene oxide can be crosslinked to polyester fiber non-woven fabric through ultraviolet curing, and finally reduced into graphene; mainly make the graphene oxide adhesion in the top layer and the fibre clearance of non-woven fabrics through the crosslinking in this application, can realize the high load capacity of graphite alkene to promote the heat conductivity and the electromagnetic shielding performance of material. Through vacuum pressure impregnation and impregnation + photocuring endless method in this application, can promote the content of the graphite alkene of load on the non-woven fabrics to a great extent promotes combined material's heat conductivility. The ultraviolet curing component in the application is added with the acrylate containing hydroxyl, can react with the propylene group and the cyanic acid group grafted on the graphene oxide, can be better crosslinked with polyester fiber, and improves the crosslinking fastness of the graphite oxide.

title_en: Multifunctional super-hydrophobic fabric and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional super-hydrophobic fabric and a preparation method thereof, wherein the multifunctional super-hydrophobic fabric comprises a fabric and a multi-level micron/nanometer roughened structure on the surface of the fabric; the multi-stage micro/nano-roughened structure is formed by covalent grafting of fluoroalkylaryl radicals to metal oxides. The invention carries out polymerization reaction on the fluorine-containing aromatic free radical on the surface of the fiber to generate a fluorine-containing aromatic polymer chain, then carries out secondary reduction, reduces part of high-valence metal ions into low-valence metal ions, and builds a multi-stage roughening structure on the surface of the fiber in situ. Based on covalent bonding of fluorine-containing aromatic polymers on the surfaces of fibers and metal oxides, and the existence of rich pi-pi stacking, hydrophobic interaction and other non-covalent bond acting forces among aromatic polymer chains, the fabric exhibits excellent soaping and mechanical friction fastness; the fabric treatment process is completed by reduction polymerization of a chemical reducing agent in a dilute acid solution at room temperature, and has the advantages of simple production process, mild reaction conditions and safe operation.

title_en: Protective box for label printer
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of label printers, in particular to a protective box for a label printer, which aims at solving the problem that dust is easy to accumulate when the existing label printer is not provided with a protective mechanism.

title_en: Bio-based real silk covered yarn and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a bio-based real silk covered yarn and a preparation method thereof, wherein the covered yarn comprises a core silk and an outer covering layer, and the outer covering layer covers the core silk and is twisted, interwoven and wound with the core silk; the outer covering layer is real silk, and the core silk is bio-based nylon 56; the content of the real silk is 50 to 90 percent, and the content of the bio-based nylon 56 is 10 to 50 percent. The bio-based covered yarn takes real silk as an outer covering layer, so that the covered yarn keeps the hand feeling and the performance of the real silk; the core yarn is made of bio-based nylon 56, so that the covering yarn and the fabric thereof have biodegradability, are more green and environment-friendly, can ensure the covering effect and show the performance of the core yarn; the two are compounded, so that the softness and the wear resistance of the covered yarn are enhanced, and the comfort, the environmental protection and the light weight of the covered yarn are improved.

title_en: Fragrant microcapsule blended antibacterial cotton fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fragrant microcapsule blended antibacterial cotton fiber and a preparation method thereof, relating to the technical field of spinning, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: dissolving EDC and NHS in ethanol, dissolving collagen in PBS buffer solution, mixing the obtained EDC/NHS solution and collagen solution, and performing electrostatic spinning to obtain collagen primary fiber; adding collagen primary fibers into a glutaraldehyde aqueous solution for dipping reaction, cleaning and drying to obtain collagen fibers; preparing collagen fibers and cotton fibers into yarns through a blending process; carrying out oxygen bleaching dyeing, and adding the obtained product into finishing liquor for padding finishing to obtain the finishing liquor; the finishing liquid consists of aromatic microcapsule emulsion and quaternary ammonium salt type polyether modified polysiloxane. The collagen fiber prepared by the method of combining in-situ crosslinking and dipping crosslinking through an electrostatic spinning technology has the advantages of good thermal stability, good mechanical property, water resistance, comfort and skin friendliness.

title_en: Device and method for producing wheat bran cellulose
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wheat bran cellulose production device and a method, and the device comprises a reaction tank body, wherein the reaction tank body comprises an end cover and a tank body arranged below the end cover, a feeding sleeve group is arranged on the reaction tank body in parallel, the end part of the feeding sleeve group is positioned in the reaction tank body, an equivalent output unit is arranged in the reaction tank body, and the equivalent output unit comprises a storage assembly and a content detection assembly; the wheat bran cellulose production device and the wheat bran cellulose production method have the advantages that the storage frame is used for storing the mixed enzyme preparation or the protease, the content of the material on the surface of the bearing plate is judged according to the descending position of the bearing plate under the action of the content detection assembly, so that the content of the material added into the tank body can be effectively ensured, the condition that the adding amount is too large or too small is prevented, meanwhile, the intermittent gear is meshed with the gear body, and the material adding sequence can be determined according to the rotating direction of the servo motor.

title_en: High emulsification polyurethane mortar terrace coating structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of high-emulsification polyurethane mortar, in particular to a terrace coating structure of high-emulsification polyurethane mortar; a high-emulsification polyurethane mortar terrace coating structure comprises a bottom coating, a cement mortar layer arranged on the bottom coating and a top coating arranged on the cement mortar layer, wherein the top coating is a polyurethane wear-resistant coating; the polyurethane wear-resistant coating comprises the following components in parts by weight: 40-60 parts of polyester polyol, 10-30 parts of polyisocyanate, 4-7 parts of a curing agent, 2-4 parts of a dispersing agent, 1-3 parts of a water reducing agent and 20-40 parts of a filler, wherein the filler is a mixture of calcium carbonate whiskers and corn straw fibers.

title_en: Accurate automatic marking device of hoist and mount area
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of manufacturing and application of hoisting belts, and particularly discloses a precise automatic marking device for a hoisting belt. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the lifting belt feeding assembly and the lifting belt discharging assembly which are reasonably designed can be used for performing horizontal stable and accurate limiting on a lifting belt before marking and after marking on a feeding device and a receiving device in a matching manner, so that an automatic marking machine is assisted to perform high-precision marking action, and meanwhile, the drying assembly is matched with the lifting belt feeding assembly and the lifting belt discharging assembly, so that the lifting belt is quickly dried after marking is realized, and the lifting belt marking production efficiency is improved; the additional auxiliary feeding guide rod through hole, the auxiliary feeding guide rod locking nut and the flexible guide sleeve realize pre-horizontal supporting and guiding of the hoisting belt before entering the hoisting belt feeding assembly, so that the hoisting belt feeding assembly can complete reliable guiding.

title_en: Automatic laser printing equipment for preparing grid line electrode on photovoltaic cell sheet
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of preparation of positive grid electrode wires of photovoltaic cells, and particularly relates to automatic laser printing equipment for preparing grid electrode wires on photovoltaic cells, which comprises a feeding conveying module (1), a feeding moving module (2), a platform conveying module (4), a camera photographing alignment module (5), a support plate turntable module (6), a laser printing module (7), a blanking moving module (8) and a blanking conveying module (10); the battery piece (12) is conveyed on the feeding conveying module (1); the feeding moving module (2) sucks the battery pieces on the feeding conveying module (1) through the upper suction claws and then moves the battery pieces to the UVW positioning platform (404) of the platform material conveying module (4). The invention realizes high-precision automatic continuous production of non-contact printing, and the grid line pattern paste is printed on the surface of the cell piece by laser, thereby avoiding the problems of hidden crack, broken piece, pollution, scratch and the like in screen extrusion printing.

title_en: Heating plate and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: A heating plate and a manufacturing method thereof relate to the technical field of heating plates, and solve the technical defects that the existing heating plate cannot transmit microwave when in operation, and has large volume, uneven heating and the like, and the adopted technical scheme is as follows: the substrate is provided with an insulating base layer, a single strip-shaped heating body is printed on the insulating base layer, the head end and the tail end of the heating body are respectively connected with a positive electrode body and a negative electrode body, the body is respectively coiled and extended along the two sides of the central axis of the substrate in a circuitous way from the head end and the tail end of the body to form a corresponding heating section A and a corresponding heating section B, and a microwave transmission area which is more than 60mm wide and is not provided with the heating body is formed between the heating section A and the heating section B; the substrate is also provided with an insulating covering layer which covers the heating body and exposes the positive and negative electrode bodies. The heating plate can transmit microwaves through the microwave transmission area during operation, effectively avoids the interference of far infrared light waves emitted by the heating body on the microwaves, can realize the dual heating functions of the microwaves and thermal radiation, and has the advantages of small volume, uniform heating, high reliability and long service life.

title_en: Intermittent processing method of flame-retardant cellulose short fiber and obtained flame-retardant cellulose short fiber
abstract_en: The invention discloses a batch processing method of flame-retardant cellulose short fibers and the obtained flame-retardant cellulose short fibers, wherein the method comprises the steps of impregnating the opened cellulose short fibers with a swelling liquid, dehydrating the impregnated cellulose short fibers, then optionally drying the cellulose short fibers by hot air or removing excessive moisture through a high-temperature zone by a crawler-type transmission curtain to control the moisture content of the fibers, then applying a flame retardant aqueous solution of a tetrakis hydroxymethyl phosphonium compound to the obtained cellulose short fibers, draining, dehydrating and drying the cellulose short fibers, then performing ammonification and oxidation on the cellulose short fibers, and then cleaning, applying spinning oil, dehydrating and drying the cellulose short fibers to obtain the flame-retardant cellulose short fibers. Compared with the existing flame-retardant regenerated cellulose short fiber, the strength of the flame-retardant cellulose short fiber prepared by the method is improved by more than 20%, and the flame-retardant property is equivalent.

title_en: Automatic connecting device for lead needle and fiber
abstract_en: The application provides an automatic connection device for a lead needle and a fiber, which comprises a fiber connection mechanism, a diamond Kong Jiuping mechanism, a synchronous belt conveyor, a lead alignment mechanism, the lead needle and a frame, wherein the two sides of the synchronous belt conveyor are respectively provided with the lead alignment mechanism and the diamond Kong Jiuping mechanism, the fiber connection mechanism and the diamond Kong Jiuping mechanism are arranged on the same side of the synchronous belt conveyor in parallel, the lead needle is arranged in a V-shaped block of the synchronous belt conveyor, and the frame is used for installing and fixing all the mechanisms.

title_en: Multifunctional elasticizer
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multifunctional texturing machine, which comprises a raw silk frame, a yarn guide device, a yarn threading device, a texturing hot box, a cooling rail, a false twister, a conveying device, a qualitative hot box, an oiling device and a winding device, wherein the yarn guide device is a W1 yarn guide disc assembly, a spandex device is arranged below the W1 yarn guide disc assembly and comprises a spandex feeding roller, a spandex cake sleeve is arranged above the spandex feeding roller, a spandex cake is arranged on the spandex cake sleeve, and the spandex cake sleeve is connected with a cake sleeve lifting and fixing device. The invention increases positioning on the premise of keeping the machine width basically unchanged, and the arrangement of the spandex device improves the utilization rate of a workshop and the production efficiency of equipment.

title_en: Printing mechanism and printing apparatus
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application relates to the technical field of printing equipment, in particular to a printing mechanism and printing equipment. The jet printing module comprises a jet printing head which is arranged on the support and is used for performing ink jet printing work along a first direction. The first maintenance mechanism comprises a scraping blade, a scraping blade base and a scraping blade driving module, wherein the scraping blade is arranged on one side of the scraping blade base, which faces the jet printing head, the scraping blade driving module is arranged on one side of the scraping blade base, which is far away from the scraping blade, and the scraping blade driving module can drive the scraping blade base to move along a second direction and/or a third direction, and the scraping blade is used for scraping accumulated ink on the jet printing head. The first direction, the second direction and the third direction are perpendicular to each other. Through the structure, when ink accumulation on the jet printing head needs to be cleaned, the scraper driving module drives the scraper base to move so as to enable the scraper to correspond to the jet printing head. The scraper driving module indirectly drives the scraper to scrape the accumulated ink on the jet printing head, so that the jet printing head is cleaned.

title_en: Circuit forming and photosensitive ink curing method for ultra-long flexible packaging substrate
abstract_en: The invention relates to a circuit forming and photosensitive ink curing method for an ultralong flexible packaging substrate, and belongs to the technical field of flexible packaging substrates. In the product design stage, the circuit patterns of the ultra-long flexible packaging substrate are divided into areas and combined and then arranged on the circuit exposure mask plate according to the upper part and the lower part, and the solder resist ink patterns are divided into areas and combined and then arranged on the ink curing mask plate according to the upper part and the lower part. When the reel-to-reel line exposure is carried out, the carrying distance of the 2 times of exposure is set to be2 times of the length of a single exposure area of the mask plate, the exposure areas are sequentially exposed, the reel is turned after the first exposure is completed, the unexposed area is subjected to the second exposure, the exposure pattern transfer of the ultra-long line is completed, and then development, etching and stripping are carried out, so that the ultra-long line forming is realized. And performing roll-to-roll UV photo-curing on the photosensitive ink pattern, and then developing and removing the uncured photosensitive ink, thereby completing the transfer of the photosensitive ink pattern of the ultra-long line.

title_en: Ultraviolet-proof polyester fabric and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an anti-ultraviolet polyester fabric and a manufacturing method thereof, relating to the technical field of spinning. The invention relates to an ultraviolet-proof polyester fabric and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the ultraviolet-proof polyester fabric is obtained by vertically interweaving warp yarns and weft yarns, finishing and drying, a first skin layer made of polylactic acid fibers and soybean protein fibers and a second skin layer made of PBT (polybutylene terephthalate) are used, so that the fabric has the characteristics of silkiness, easiness in dyeing and good moisture absorption, nano zinc oxide and nano titanium dioxide are added in the preparation of master batches, and then an ultraviolet absorbent is impregnated, so that the fabric has a good ultraviolet-proof effect, ultrasonic waves are added, the adhesion speed of the ultraviolet absorbent is increased, the impregnation time is reduced, the first composite fiber filament and the second composite fiber filament are both in a concentric double-ring parallel composite form, so that the hollow effect is formed inside the filaments, the fabric has good moisture permeability and dry effect, and the clothing can not feel hot when being worn.

title_en: Composite carbon paper, preparation method and battery
abstract_en: The invention discloses composite carbon paper, a preparation method and a battery, relates to the technical field of batteries, and aims to solve the problems of uneven stress distribution and poor toughness of carbon paper caused by poor compatibility of phenolic resin on the carbon paper in the existing composite carbon paper. The composite carbon paper comprises carbon paper and a toughening layer formed on the surface of the carbon paper, wherein the toughening layer contains phenolic resin and epoxidized soybean oil. The preparation method is used for preparing the composite carbon paper, and the battery uses the composite carbon paper. The composite carbon paper, the preparation method and the battery are used for improving the compatibility of the carbon paper and phenolic resin, and the tensile strength and the bending strength of the carbon paper.

title_en: Preparation method of fabric antistatic finishing agent
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of an antistatic finishing agent for fabrics, and belongs to the technical field of fabric after-finishing. The method comprises the following steps: reacting diisocyanate monomer with unsaturated dihydric alcohol containing vinyl to form cyanate terminated polyurethane oligomer; then reacting with the conductive filler modified by vinyl, and grafting the conductive filler on the surface of the conductive filler to obtain a synthetic product; then reacting with polyether diol to obtain a polyurethane/conductive filler compound; and finally, mixing the antistatic finishing agent with an emulsifier, a leveling agent, a defoaming agent and a bridging agent, and reacting to obtain the antistatic finishing agent. The fabric antistatic finishing agent prepared by the invention has outstanding antistatic effect and long-term stable antistatic performance under the condition of low filler addition.

title_en: Filter medium for air filter and method for manufacturing same
abstract_en: The invention provides a filter medium for an air filter, which has practically sufficient rigidity and strength and high PF value and water repellency, and provides the filter medium by using an easy manufacturing method. The filter medium for an air filter of the present invention is a filter medium comprising a wet nonwoven fabric containing glass fibers, and is characterized by comprising a cationic binder resin, a fluororesin, and a cationic surfactant, wherein the mass ratio of the fluororesin to the surfactant solid content is in the range of 30/70 to 80/20.

title_en: Powdery polypropylene resin and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: According to the present invention, there is provided a powder type polypropylene resin and a method for producing the same, wherein fluidity in a hopper of an extruder and feeding stability in a feeding zone are improved by morphological optimization such as reduction of fine powder content, narrow particle size distribution, increase of average particle size, high melting point, and the like.

title_en: Electrostatic spinning fiber deposition area regulating and controlling device, regulating and controlling method and application
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of preparation of electrostatic spinning fibers, and discloses a device and a method for regulating and controlling a deposition area of electrostatic spinning fibers and application of the device and the method. The device comprises an electrostatic spinning nozzle, a plurality of jet flows, a lower electrode plate, a plurality of long strip-shaped through grooves, a reciprocating motor, a first high-voltage electrostatic generator, a second high-voltage electrostatic generator and a second high-voltage electrostatic generator, wherein the electrostatic spinning nozzle penetrates through a central round hole of an upper electrode support and is coaxially arranged, the bottom of the electrostatic spinning nozzle extends out of the bottom surface of the upper electrode support, the lower electrode plate is arranged below the electrostatic spinning nozzle in a bearing mode, the upper electrode support is uniformly distributed with the long strip-shaped through grooves in an annular mode, the upper portion of each long strip-shaped through groove is fixedly provided with the reciprocating motor, different-shape electrodes arranged on the upper electrode support are connected with the reciprocating motor through the long strip-shaped through grooves through connecting rods, the different-shape electrodes are connected with the first high-voltage electrostatic generator, and the lower electrode plate is connected with the second high-voltage electrostatic generator. Experiments show that the jet flow expands and contracts along the left-right direction and circulates back and forth when seen from a single electrostatic spinning nozzle, and the macro-scale appearance shows that the superfine fiber felt fibers are uniformly distributed, and the product quality is improved.

title_en: High-speed double-thread chain type industrial sewing machine control system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-speed double-thread chain type industrial sewing machine control system which comprises a sewing machine terminal, a management terminal, a cloud server and a type base station, wherein the sewing machine terminal acquires sewing machine information and uploads the sewing machine information to the cloud server through a micro base station, the management terminal accesses the cloud server to acquire real-time information of a sewing machine, the state of the sewing machine can be better known so as to make a judgment conforming to reality and send an instruction to control the sewing machine, the management terminal sends a control instruction to the sewing machine terminal through the micro base station to be executed, the micro base station can relay and amplify the signal to ensure the stability of the uploaded information and the instruction information, the cloud server enables the management terminal not to be limited to be local, the sewing machine can be remotely controlled only by a network management terminal, each micro base station corresponds to one sewing machine workshop, each sewing machine terminal corresponds to one sewing machine, the hierarchy is clear, the sewing machine terminal is favorable for being quickly accurate to the individual sewing machines, and the management control of the large batch sewing machines in industrial production is facilitated.

title_en: Roving flock recovery device for spinning roving process and use method
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a roving linter recovery device for a spinning roving process and a use method thereof, comprising an installation bottom plate, wherein the top of the installation bottom plate is fixedly connected with a shell, the top of the shell is provided with a sealing cover plate, the left side and the right side of an inner cavity of the shell are respectively provided with an auxiliary frame, the front sides of the opposite sides of the two auxiliary frames are fixedly provided with a screw rod, the surface of the screw rod is sleeved with a filter assembly, and the center of the left side of the shell is fixedly provided with a driving motor. The utility model can be widely applied to recovery devices with different front and back lengths through the matched use of the support plate, the double-head screw rods and the buckling frame; the auxiliary frame, the filter screen plate, the threaded sleeve, the screw rod and the auxiliary frame are matched for use, so that the utilization rate of a filtering space can be improved, and the cleaning frequency of staff is reduced; through movable rod, driving pulley, connecting belt, driven pulley and helical blade cooperation use, can reduce the short velvet plug rate greatly, guarantee that the device carries out normal recovery process.

title_en: Sheet material prepared by flash spinning method
abstract_en: The application relates to a sheet material prepared by a flash spinning method, which comprises polyethylene with a dynamic friction coefficient of 0.07-0.20, wet tensile strength of 3000-4000N/m and wet tensile strength retention of 0.80-0.90. The sheet material of the application has better dynamic friction coefficient and wet tensile strength, thus having wide application prospect.

title_en: Visible light-near infrared spectrum simulated bionic blade and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a visible light-near infrared spectrum simulation bionic blade and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the field of spectrum simulation. The preparation method of the bionic blade comprises the following steps: (1) preparation of porous cellulose film: uniformly mixing a cellulose polymer, a solvent and a colorant to obtain a colored spinning solution; then preparing the colored spinning solution into a porous cellulose membrane through electrostatic spinning; wherein the cellulose polymerization comprises one of pulp cellulose, microcrystalline cellulose, carboxymethyl cellulose and cellulose acetate; (2) hydrophilic modification: performing hydrophilic modification on the porous cellulose membrane obtained in the step (1) to obtain a porous fiber membrane with high hydrophilicity; (3) preparation of bionic blades: immersing the porous fiber membrane with high hydrophilicity obtained in the step (2) in water to enable the porous fiber membrane to reach saturated water content; and then the visible light-near infrared spectrum simulated bionic blade is obtained by packaging and fixing on a porous two-dimensional material.

title_en: Embroidery machine head with integrated independent engraving holes
abstract_en: The invention discloses an embroidery machine head with an integrated independent engraving hole, which comprises a thorn cloth thread-picking mechanism and an engraving hole mechanism which are arranged on a machine shell, wherein the thorn cloth thread-picking mechanism comprises a thorn cloth thread-picking main shaft, an embroidery component, an embroidery transmission component for connecting the embroidery component and the thorn cloth thread-picking main shaft, the engraving hole mechanism comprises an engraving hole main shaft, an engraving hole cutter, an engraving Kong Chuandong component for connecting the engraving hole main shaft and the engraving hole cutter, the engraving Kong Chuandong component and the engraving hole cutter are arranged at the side of the embroidery component, and the engraving Kong Chuandong component and the engraving hole cutter are independent of the thorn cloth thread-picking mechanism. The hole carving mechanism is independent of the thorn cloth thread picking mechanism, particularly the hole carving Kong Chuandong component is independent of the embroidery transmission component, does not interfere with color changing, realizes the matching of independent hole carving of any needle position, and fully utilizes all needle positions to realize embroidery with richer colors. The independent carving holes can be parameterized to adjust the depth of the carving holes, change the size of the carving holes, expand the application of the carving holes, realize better carving effect, improve the efficiency of the carving holes and expand the functions of the embroidery machine.

title_en: Plant fiber extractor
abstract_en: The invention provides a plant fiber extractor, which comprises a blade conveying device, a clamp chain conveying device, an extracting device and a fiber conveying device. According to the invention, the blade is clamped and fixed, and then the fiber is extracted. Wherein, the fiber is extracted by rolling with rollers to separate mesophyll from fiber.

title_en: Color printing paper box production process
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of carton production and processing, in particular to a color printing carton production process, which comprises the following steps: the first step: preparing raw materials, weighing the raw materials in proportion for standby, and processing the raw materials to obtain a carton board; and a second step of: printing a specified image and text on the surface of the carton board by using an offset press, and curing the ink by using ultraviolet lamps to burn the surface of the carton board; and a third step of: cutting the carton board by using a die cutting device, and bonding the die-cut carton board to form a carton; the production process realizes the function of avoiding excessive halation of the ink on the outer side of the paper box, and solves the problems that the existing color printing paper box raw materials are mostly common corrugated paper boards, the water absorption capacity is strong, and the situation that the water in the ink is excessively halated by the absorption color easily occurs in the color printing patterns on the outer side of the paper box.

title_en: Weather-proof breathable composite fabric and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a weather-proof breathable composite fabric and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of fabrics, wherein the weather-proof breathable composite fabric comprises an inner substrate, a nano breathable film layer attached to one surface of the inner substrate in a vacuum coating mode, a nano waterproof layer compounded on the nano breathable film layer and a nano antibacterial layer compounded on the other surface of the inner substrate; the nano waterproof layer is obtained by spinning modified waterborne polyurethane emulsion and modified polyimide fibers after being treated by finishing liquid, wherein the modified waterborne polyurethane emulsion is prepared by mixing trimethyl hexane diisocyanate, dihydroxypolyether, a modified pore-forming agent and glycidyl ether, and synthesizing the modified waterborne polyurethane emulsion by hydrophilic chain extension, neutralization and emulsification; the nano antibacterial layer is obtained by spinning modified polyacrylonitrile fibers and an antibacterial finishing agent after being treated by emulsion. The composite fabric prepared by the nano waterproof layer, the nano antibacterial layer and the nano breathable film layer has the characteristics of good air permeability and moisture permeability, good antibacterial property and high softness.

title_en: Glass panel with three-dimensional textures, manufacturing method thereof and kitchen appliance
abstract_en: The invention provides a glass panel with three-dimensional textures, a manufacturing method thereof and a kitchen appliance, wherein the glass panel comprises a toughened glass layer and a three-dimensional texture layer printed on one side surface of the toughened glass layer; the manufacturing method comprises the following steps: and printing the three-dimensional ink on one side surface of the toughened glass layer by adopting a screen printing plate, and performing first curing to form a three-dimensional texture layer. The glass panel obtained by the invention has a three-dimensional texture effect, has long service life, can resist high temperature and oil stains, and is suitable for kitchen utensils.

title_en: Polyimide fiber with high heat resistance and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high heat-resistant polyimide fiber and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: s1: carrying out polymerization reaction on triethylamine isocyanate hydrate, diamine and dianhydride to obtain polyamic acid spinning solution; s2: defoaming the polyamic acid spinning solution and then spinning to obtain primary yarns; s3: and cyclizing and drawing the primary yarn to obtain the high heat-resistant polyimide fiber. The invention uses the monomer triethylamine isocyanate hydrate containing functional groups to carry out targeted end sealing in the polymerization process, controls the polymerization degree of a polymerization system, releases small molecules to activate the functional groups to continuously participate in the reaction in the high-temperature environment of the cyclization drafting stage of the polyimide primary yarn, and locally forms a bodily form structure, thereby greatly improving the strength and heat resistance of the fiber.

title_en: Spray head sealing and moisturizing device and inkjet printing equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a spray head sealing moisturizing device and ink jet printing equipment, which are applied to the field of ink jet printing and comprise a sealing moisturizing component, a sealing mechanism and a sealing mechanism, wherein the sealing moisturizing component comprises a sealing mechanism which is used for forming a sealing space for a nozzle; the lifting assembly is arranged below the sealing mechanism and comprises a spring mechanism and a driving mechanism, the spring mechanism comprises a plurality of springs and first locating pins, the first locating pins are arranged below the sealing mechanism and are movably connected with the sealing mechanism, the springs are sleeved on the first locating pins, the driving mechanism is used for driving the sealing mechanism to move up and down, and the springs are used for driving the sealing mechanism to move towards the nozzle. According to the application, the sealing mechanism is controlled to move up and down through the driving mechanism, so that the positioning of the sealing mechanism and the nozzle is realized, and when the sealing mechanism moves upwards, the acting force between the sealing mechanism and the nozzle is increased through the spring mechanism, so that the sealing and moisturizing effects of the sealing mechanism on the nozzle are improved, and the occurrence of nozzle blockage is further reduced.

title_en: Recording device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a recording device capable of suppressing rotation of a head unit and driving the head unit with a small load. The recording device is provided with: a head unit including a recording head and movable between a recording position for recording on a medium and a retracted position retracted from a medium conveyance path; a moving mechanism that moves the head unit; and a positioning section for defining a position of the head unit at the recording position, wherein a force applied to the head unit by the moving mechanism and a reaction force received from the positioning section by the head unit generate a moment for rotating the head unit, and wherein the unit pressing mechanism applies a force to the head unit in a direction that counteracts the rotation of the head unit when the head unit is at the recording position presses the head unit in a direction intersecting the moving direction of the head unit.

title_en: Touch frame paper for cigarettes and method for manufacturing same
abstract_en: The invention specifically discloses a touch frame paper for cigarettes and a method for manufacturing the same, wherein the method comprises the following steps of: s1, coloring the surface of a raw paper layer of frame paper by utilizing a pre-prepared mixed coating liquid to obtain a first semi-finished product; s2, coating a layer of pre-prepared aqueous touch sense oil mixed solution on the surface of the first semi-finished product, and drying and solidifying the surface of the first semi-finished product into a layer of touch sense coating to obtain a second semi-finished product; s3, cutting the second semi-finished product into a strip of preset width, rolling or cutting the strip of preset width into a sheet of paper with preset specification, thereby completing the manufacture of the touch frame paper for cigarettes. According to the invention, the surface of the raw paper layer is colored and the surface after coloring is coated with the touch coating, so that the frame paper can meet the requirements of uniform color, full color and plush touch on the surface, and the environment-friendly water-based paint, water-based color paste and water-based touch flocking matte paint are adopted in the manufacturing process, thereby meeting the environment-friendly related requirements and having the characteristic of being green and degradable.

title_en: Acid-resistant aqueous polyurethane slurry and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an acid-resistant aqueous polyurethane slurry, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation raw materials of the acid-resistant aqueous polyurethane slurry comprise a combination of polymer dihydric alcohol, diisocyanate, a hydrophilic monomer, a small molecule chain extender, a catalyst and water, and the hydrophilic monomer comprises a combination of sodium dihydroxypropane sulfonate and ethoxy-terminated polyethylene glycol; the polyurethane sizing agent obtained finally has excellent hydrophilicity and excellent acid resistance by selecting the collocation of the dihydroxypropane sodium sulfonate and the ethoxy end-capped polyethylene glycol as hydrophilic monomers, has higher water solubility under the acid condition, and is suitable for being used as textile sizing agent.

title_en: DTY silk thread and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of DTY (draw textured yarn) wires, in particular to a DTY wire and a preparation process thereof. A DTY silk thread is mainly made of functional POY silk and auxiliary POY silk; the functional POY yarn is mainly prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 100 parts of fiber-grade semi-dull polyester chips, 5-10 parts of compatilizer, 6-8 parts of antistatic mixture, 1-3 parts of coupling agent, 0.5-2 parts of dispersing agent and 0.5-2 parts of anti-aging agent; the antistatic mixture mainly comprises graphene, conductive polyaniline resin and inorganic filler of which the surface is grafted with a conductive substance; the surface grafted conductive material in the inorganic filler with the surface grafted conductive material is a single-wall carbon nano tube or a multi-wall carbon nano tube, and the inorganic filler is superfine arsenic trioxide or superfine tin dioxide. The application has good antistatic and antibacterial properties and lasting antistatic and antibacterial properties.

title_en: Double-swing box nailing machine head
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-swing box nailing machine head, which comprises: the first carton nailing machine head, the second carton nailing machine head and the bottom plate; the first carton stapler head comprises: the device comprises a first rack, a first carton nailing mechanism, a first tool magazine, a first swing servo motor and a first driving swing rod; the first box nailing mechanism is connected with the first frame, and the output end of the first box nailing mechanism is connected with the first tool magazine; the first driving swing rod is connected with the first tool magazine; the second carton stapler head comprises: the second rack, the second carton nailing mechanism, the second tool magazine, the second swing servo motor, the second driving swing link and the driven swing link; the second carton nailing mechanism is connected with the second frame, and the output end of the second carton nailing mechanism is connected with the second tool magazine; the second driving swing rod is connected with a second tool magazine; the top of the driven swing rod is rotationally connected with the second frame; the bottom plate is located the bottom of first tool magazine and second tool magazine. The box nailing machine head does not need to be stopped, and the nailing speed can be ensured.

title_en: Integral leather processing trimmer and processing technology thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an integrated leather processing trimmer and a processing technology thereof, wherein the integrated leather processing trimmer comprises an ironing embossing mechanism and a trimming mechanism matched with the ironing embossing mechanism, the ironing embossing mechanism comprises an ironing embossing mechanism frame, one side of the surface of the ironing embossing mechanism frame is slidably provided with a movable frame, one side of the top of the ironing embossing mechanism frame is fixedly provided with a pushing cylinder, and the trimming machine, the ironing machine and the embossing machine are combined together in a modular manner to form a new device with trimming, ironing and embossing functions, so that the trimming machine, the ironing machine and the embossing machine can be disassembled into separate machines for use and can be combined together for use, the use flexibility is higher, the automation degree is higher, the practical use performance of the device is improved, the trimming size of the trimming machine can be adaptively adjusted according to the size of leather, the processing requirements of leather with different sizes can be met, and the integral performance of the trimming machine is improved.

title_en: Soft finishing agent capable of improving soaping resistance of fabric
abstract_en: The invention discloses a soft finishing agent capable of improving the soaping resistance of fabrics, which comprises the following components in percentage by mass (0.5-1): 30 and a block polyether amino silicone oil emulsion with a solid content of 30-40%. Compared with the amino silicone oil softener in the prior art, the epoxy end-capped polyether is also added in the softening finishing agent, the main structure of the epoxy end-capped polyether is EO and PO polymer, the two ends of the epoxy end-capped polyether are epoxy structures, the addition amount in the softening finishing working solution is small, the epoxy end-capped polyether can be adhered to the surface of a fabric together with the block polyether amino silicone oil through a padding process, one end of the epoxy end-capped polyether is combined with a group on the block polyether amino silicone oil through a chemical bond under a high temperature condition through a heat setting process to form a crosslinked structure, the other end of the epoxy end-capped polyether is combined with hydroxyl on a fiber, the bonding force of the silicone oil and the fiber is increased, and the soaping fastness is improved.

title_en: Preparation method and dyeing process of washing-free pad dyeing dye suitable for polyester super-soft fabric
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of dyeing and finishing, and provides a preparation method and a dyeing process of a washing-free pad dyeing dye suitable for a polyester super-soft fabric, aiming at the problem of poor permeability of the dye in the polyester super-soft fabric, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: adding 300-400 parts of disperse dye filter cake and 70-80 parts of dispersing agent into water according to parts by weight, uniformly mixing, adjusting the pH to 5-10, filtering, and grinding solid particles to 100-800nm to obtain dye; the dyeing process comprises the following steps: adding 6-10 parts of dye, 0-2 parts of leveling agent and 0.1-0.5 part of thickener into water to prepare a dye solution, performing one-dipping one-rolling treatment on the super-soft terylene fabric by using the dye solution, and then baking to obtain the dyed fabric. The invention comprehensively explores the influence of a plurality of factors of the dispersing agent and the dosage thereof, the pH value of the dye liquor and the particle size of the disperse dye on the dispersibility and the storage stability of the dye, thereby obtaining a better dye preparation method, and the prepared dye has good permeability in the super-soft polyester fabric.

title_en: Knitting structure based on texture structure suitable for forced fulling process
abstract_en: The invention provides a knitting method of knitting tissues based on texture tissues, which is suitable for a forced milling process, and the texture tissues can still be maintained under the treatment scheme of forced milling by using the knitting sheet or fabric knitted by the process, so that the effect of ensuring that the patterns of the fabric are not deformed.

title_en: Paper support surface printing device and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of paper support printing, in particular to a paper support surface printing device and method. The device comprises a pressure-bearing block, a large supporting frame, an embossing mechanism and the like; the pressing block is fixedly connected with a large supporting frame, the pressing mechanism is arranged on the large supporting frame, and the pressing mechanism is arranged on the pressing mechanism.
