Firstly, the staff starts electric putter, and electric putter's telescopic link extension can drive and support stores pylon and transfer printing head and all move down, and soft press head can downwardly push the transfer printing head for transfer printing head bottom and paper support top contact is more abundant, thereby makes the transfer printing head more clear to pattern and typeface that the paper support printed, and print quality is better.

title_en: Melamine formaldehyde resin diaphragm, preparation method thereof and lithium battery
abstract_en: The invention relates to melamine formaldehyde resin, a preparation method thereof and a lithium battery. The raw materials for preparing the melamine formaldehyde resin diaphragm comprise the following components in parts by mass: 1 to 30 parts of melamine resin, 20 to 70 parts of formaldehyde solution, 1 to 20 parts of alcohol catalyst, 1 to 10 parts of magnesium plastic reinforcing agent, 0.1 to 10 parts of silane coupling agent and 0.1 to 10 parts of isocyanato catalyst. The combination of these raw materials and the above percentage ranges of the raw materials, which are determined by a large number of experiments, give melamine formaldehyde resin separators prepared using the above raw materials excellent electrochemical and mechanical properties.

title_en: Special-shaped pipe negative pressure grid ring fiber opening type wide whisker steady-state cladding spinning device and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a special-shaped pipe negative-pressure grid ring fiber opening type wide whisker steady-state cladding spinning device and method, wherein the device comprises a feeding unit, a core-wrapping unit and a winding unit; the core-spun unit comprises a conveying component, a negative pressure cladding component and a yarn guide rod, wherein the negative pressure cladding component can open the short fiber strands to widen and spread the short fiber strands to form wide fiber strands of the steady-state cladding core yarn. According to the invention, the core-spun yarn with good coating effect and large core wire occupation ratio is obtained by arranging the core-spun unit, matching with the core feeding mechanism and the staple fiber drafting feeding mechanism and utilizing the mode of coating the special-shaped pipe negative-pressure grid ring to uniformly coat the outer layer of the core wire after the staple fiber strips are opened, thereby realizing maximization of staple fiber utilization, reducing the raw material cost of the core-spun yarn and solving the problems of easy core exposure and small core wire occupation ratio of the traditional ring spinning core-spun yarn. The device is applied to industry by the cooperative coordination of the construction of each unit, realizes industrial high-speed spinning, and has high comprehensive performance and wide market application of the prepared core spun yarn.

title_en: Polyester-vinylon multi-component cotton fabric and production method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a polyester-vinylon multi-component cotton fabric and a production method thereof. The fabric produced by reasonably matching the polyester fiber, the vinylon fiber and the cotton has obvious wear-resistant and soft characteristics and an antistatic function, and can be widely used in various aspects such as outdoors, exploration, tooling and the like.

title_en: Automatic silk screen printing mechanism of control repeated printing formula
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of printing equipment, in particular to a left-right repeated printing type automatic screen printing mechanism which comprises a conveyor and a screen printing screen frame, wherein an installation block is arranged at the top of the screen printing screen frame, two driving parts are arranged on the installation block, two scraping plates are arranged at the bottom of the installation block, two paint conveying channels are arranged on the installation block, one side of the installation block is provided with an installation plate, a reciprocating assembly is arranged on the installation plate, paste is introduced onto the scraping plates through one paint conveying channel close to the middle part of the screen printing screen frame, flows onto the screen printing screen of the screen printing screen frame along the scraping plates to form strip-shaped accumulation, and the paste acts on the printing parts through pattern holes on the screen printing screen through the reciprocating assembly and the driving parts through the cooperation of the scraping plates, so that the problems that the paste of the existing printer is excessively added, most of the paste flows to two sides of the scraping plates, the paste is seriously wasted, and the normal use of the scraping plates can be influenced after the paste is dried are solved.

title_en: Screen frame cleaning and drying system
abstract_en: The application discloses a screen frame cleaning and drying system, which relates to the technical field of printing equipment cleaning and comprises a medicine washing tank, a washing table and a dryer, the medicine washing pool, the washing table and the dryer are sequentially arranged along the feeding direction, one side of the medicine washing pool is a feeding side, and the other side of the medicine washing pool is a discharging side. A transition sliding table is arranged between the medicine washing pool and the washing table and is arranged at the upper end of the medicine washing pool, which is close to the discharging side. Be provided with first transfer mechanism between pond and the washing table are washed to the medicine, first transfer mechanism includes hoisting assembly and second horizontal drive subassembly, and hoisting assembly sets up between pond and transition slip table are washed to the medicine, and hoisting assembly includes hoisting drive spare and hoisting piece, and hoisting drive spare sets up in transition slip table upper end, and hoisting piece one end is around establishing on hoisting drive spare output shaft, and the other end extends in to the pond is washed to the medicine. The application can realize the automatic transfer of the net frame among different cleaning devices and reduce the workload of workers.

title_en: Acid black dye for spandex and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of dyes, and discloses an acid black dye for spandex and a preparation method thereof, wherein the acid black dye comprises the following components: acid black 168, acid black 172, composite modified dispersant, sodium lignin sulfonate; wherein the mixing weight ratio of the composite modified dispersing agent to the sodium lignin sulfonate is 3:1; the composite modified dispersing agent is prepared by taking alkali lignin as a raw material through a multiple modification and compounding process; the composite modified dispersing agent is used for improving the suspension rate of the acid black 168 and the acid black 172 and improving the solubility of the acid black 168 and the acid black 172; the acid black dye for spandex prepared by the invention can enable common spandex to be dyed in the acid black dye prepared by the invention, has higher color fastness, can reduce color difference with opponent yarns, eliminates the phenomenon of white exposure or light of fabric, ensures clear and smoother fabric lines, and improves fabric quality.

title_en: Preparation method of base paper of daily use paper of cream
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of base paper of a cream household paper, which comprises the following steps: s1: providing a fiber raw material, wherein the fiber raw material comprises a bamboo pulp board and a hardwood pulp board, and dispersing the bamboo pulp board and the hardwood pulp board to form bamboo pulp and hardwood pulp; s2: pulping the bamboo pulp, not pulping the hardwood pulp, and mixing the pulping bamboo pulp with the hardwood pulp to form mixed pulp, wherein the content of the bamboo pulp in the mixed pulp is 20-40%, and the content of the hardwood pulp is 60-80%; s3, the mixed pulp is made into the base paper of the cream daily use paper by a paper making machine, wherein a wrinkling scraper with the wrinkling rate of 10-20 degrees is adopted in the wrinkling process, the wrinkling rate is 20-30 percent, the vehicle speed is more than or equal to 1200m/min, the paper making machine is a crescent-shaped paper making machine, and the longitudinal elongation of the base paper of the daily use paper is more than or equal to 20 percent.

title_en: Modularized screen printer and printing system thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a modularized screen printer and a printing system thereof. The printing machine comprises a plurality of working areas which are arranged into a loop and used for continuously conveying the carrier plate, wherein each working area comprises a first operation area, a second operation area, a printing area, a second steering area and a conveying and receiving conversion area; the first steering conveying mechanism is arranged on the upper layer of the second steering area, and the first steering conveying mechanism is arranged on the lower layer; the lifting conversion mechanism can be installed in the conveying receiving conversion area in a lifting manner, the second steering conveying mechanism is installed on the upper layer of the second operation area, and the second directional conveying mechanism is installed on the lower layer; the carrier plate can be driven to move from the first steering conveying mechanism to the second steering conveying mechanism through the lifting switching mechanism, can also move from the first steering conveying mechanism to the lifting switching mechanism, can move downwards along with the lifting switching mechanism to correspond to the first steering conveying mechanism and the second steering conveying mechanism, and can also be positioned on the lifting switching mechanism, and can move upwards along with the lifting switching mechanism to correspond to the first steering conveying mechanism and the second steering conveying mechanism. According to the invention, the unequal printers are connected in series, and the work can be transferred to the motion modes of different printers, so that the effect of improving the space utilization rate is achieved, the on-line quantity of equipment is elasticized, and a small number of various orders can be more easily handled.

title_en: Material turning coding machine and material turning coding method
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of coding equipment and discloses a turning coding machine and a turning coding method, wherein the turning coding machine comprises a rack, a feeding device, a box moving device, a positioning device, a material moving device, a rotating assembly, a driving device and a coding mechanism, wherein the feeding device, the box moving device, the positioning device, the material moving device, the rotating assembly, the driving device and the coding mechanism are respectively connected with the rack, the feeding device is used for driving a box filled with materials to be transported, the box moving device is used for moving the box of the feeding device to the positioning device, the positioning device is used for calibrating the position of the box, the material moving device is used for moving the materials in the box positioned on the positioning device to the rotating assembly, the rotating assembly is used for driving the materials to be turned to a preset posture, the driving device is used for driving the rotating assembly to rotate, so that the materials turned to the preset posture can rotate to the adjacent position of the coding mechanism, and the coding mechanism is used for coding the materials turned to the preset posture. The application mainly solves the technical problem of how to code the end, far away from the cutter head, of the cutter.

title_en: Method and device for detecting injection effect of array injection holes
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of novel display device preparation, and discloses a method and a device for detecting the injection effect of an array injection hole, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining standard injection parameters; the method comprises the steps of adopting standard jet parameters to enable all jet holes of an array jet head to jet ink, detecting ink drops ejected by all jet holes, screening abnormal jet holes according to the volume, speed and jet angle allowed range of the ink drops, screening the abnormal jet holes to obtain the initial quantity of the abnormal jet holes, generating matched printing pattern data based on the screened normal jet holes and printing in a production area, moving the array jet head from the production area to a detection area according to detection frequency in the printing production process, printing and solidifying the ink drops on a hydrophobic film according to a set detection pattern, photographing the detection pattern, and obtaining the detection quantity of the abnormal jet holes according to a detection algorithm. According to the application, abnormal quantity change of the spray holes is confirmed by adopting a printing and curing judgment mode in the production process, so that the production capacity is effectively improved.

title_en: Silicon-containing multielement synergistic flame-retardant finishing liquid, modified nylon 6 fabric and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of flame-retardant finishing of textiles, and discloses a silicon-containing multielement synergistic flame-retardant finishing liquid and a modified nylon 6 fabric and a preparation method thereof. The silicon-containing multi-element synergistic flame-retardant finishing liquid comprises 10-25% of silicon-containing multi-element synergistic flame retardant and 75-90% of organic solvent, wherein the silicon-containing multi-element synergistic flame retardant comprises multi-element organic siloxane flame retardant and synergistic flame retardant. The silicon-containing multielement synergistic flame-retardant finishing liquid prepared by the invention can directly impregnate nylon 6 fabric, the limiting oxygen index of the obtained modified nylon 6 fabric can reach more than 26%, the heat release rate is reduced by more than 40%, flame molten drops are not generated, the change of breaking strength and breaking elongation is smaller, a large amount of toxic byproducts are not generated, the environment-friendly concept of modern society is better met, and the requirement of sustainable development is met.

title_en: Wave-absorbing printing paste, flexible light composite wave-absorbing fabric and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electromagnetic wave absorbing materials, in particular to a wave absorbing printing paste, a flexible light composite wave absorbing fabric, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein graphene, MXene and Fe are subjected to screen printing  3  O  4  The composite sizing agent is coated on the surface of the aramid fiber non-woven fabric in a scraping way, and the soft and light graphene@MXene@Fe integrating antibiosis is prepared by adopting a simple one-step method  3  O  4  Composite wave-absorbing fabricWherein graphene provides dielectric loss, MXene builds a conductive network on the interlaced fibers to adjust impedance matching, and at the same time, magnetic material Fe is introduced  3  O  4  The purpose is to further improve impedance matching and increase magnetic loss. In addition, abundant interfaces exist among the three materials and between the materials and the fabric, so that interface polarization can be generated, the wave absorbing performance is further enhanced, the environment is more protected, the operation is simple and convenient, and a new thought is provided for the green industrial production of the flexible wearable composite wave absorbing fabric.

title_en: Method for preparing high-entropy ferrite/porous carbon composite fiber electromagnetic wave absorption sponge
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for preparing a high-entropy ferrite/porous carbon composite fiber electromagnetic wave absorption sponge, belonging to the fields of material science and engineering technology and electromagnetic wave absorbing materials. The wave-absorbing sponge prepared by the method is mainly used in wave-absorbing materials in the military and civil fields. The electromagnetic wave absorbing sponge is formed by compounding a high-entropy ferrite material with high magnetic conductivity, high corrosion resistance and high stability with a fiber material, wherein the high-entropy ferrite material is made of spinel type MeOFe  2  O  3  (Me＝Ni  2+  、Mn  2+  、Fe  2+  、Co  2+  、Cu  2+  、Mg  2+  、Zn  2+  、Al  3+  、Cr  2+  、Cd  2+  Etc.) are basic configurations, the wave absorbing efficiency of the material is regulated by doping different kinds of metals. The invention has the advantages of good mechanical property, high wave absorbing efficiency, wide wave absorbing frequency band and the like.

title_en: Sheath-core composite spinneret plate
abstract_en: The application discloses a sheath-core composite spinneret plate, which relates to the technical field of textile equipment and comprises a feeding plate and a spinneret plate, wherein the feeding plate and the spinneret plate are connected with each other; a first channel is arranged in the feeding plate, a composite channel is arranged in the spinneret plate, and the first channel is communicated with the composite channel; and a guide pipe is arranged in the first channel and used for conveying the core layer melt, and the guide pipe penetrates through the first channel and the composite channel. This application utilizes the pipe to carry the sandwich layer fuse-element through setting up the pipe, can not make two kinds of fuse-elements deposit simultaneously in the cavity to the pipe link up in first passageway and composite channel for the sandwich layer fuse-element is direct to be carried to composite channel, and two kinds of fuse-elements can not crowded simultaneously in the cavity and flow the jam, and then can not take place the fuse-element and break, has solved the problem of the extremely easy emergence fuse-element of current skin core composite spinneret.

title_en: Bidirectional super-homogenizing yarn-separating smoothing device and method for non-woven fabrics
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of non-woven fabric preparation devices, in particular to a non-woven fabric bidirectional super-homogenizing yarn-separating smoothing device and method, wherein the device comprises a first conveyor, a second conveyor and a guiding smoothing mechanism, one end of the second conveyor is provided with a first smoothing mechanism, the first smoothing mechanism comprises a first smoothing structure and a second smoothing structure, a linkage mechanism is arranged below the first smoothing structure, a second smoothing mechanism is arranged above the other end of the second conveyor, the second smoothing mechanism comprises a fourth smoothing roller, the number of the first smoothing mechanisms is multiple, and a first smoothing mechanism is arranged above each first conveyor; the application is provided with the first conveyor, the second conveyor, the first smoothing mechanism and the second smoothing mechanism, thereby realizing better flatness after a plurality of non-woven fabrics are combined, facilitating the first smoothing mechanism and the second smoothing mechanism on the second conveyor to smooth the combined non-woven fabrics and improving the quality of finished products.

title_en: Anti-curling paper air drying equipment for printing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of paper printing, in particular to anti-curling paper air drying equipment for printing, which comprises a storage rack, an air drying rack positioned on the right side of the storage rack and a guide rack connected to the storage rack and the air drying rack, wherein a plurality of air drying object placing frames for clamping paper are arranged on the storage rack, the air drying object placing frames are sequentially distributed up and down, a shifting mechanism for shifting the uppermost air drying object placing frame to the air drying rack along the guide rack is arranged between the storage rack and the air drying rack, and the bottom of the storage rack is also provided with a jacking feeding mechanism. Compared with the prior art, the four sides of the paper are clamped through the air-drying storage frame, the four clamping bottom plates and the four groups of clamping assemblies, which are arranged at the periphery of the air-drying storage frame, so that the problem that the corners of the paper are easy to curl is solved; through the supporter that sets up, can fix paper on the plane, through the air-dry frame that sets up, can make paper air-dry under vertical state.

title_en: High-performance fiber material stitching device and stitching process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-performance stitching device for fiber materials, which comprises a base, wherein two side walls of the base are fixedly connected with fixing plates, the two fixing plates are vertically arranged, one ends of the two fixing plates are provided with first thread trimming mechanisms, the other ends of the two fixing plates are provided with second thread trimming mechanisms, thread passing mechanisms are arranged on the base and are positioned between the first thread trimming mechanisms and the second thread trimming mechanisms, stitching devices are arranged on the base and are arranged far away from the first thread trimming mechanisms, the first thread trimming mechanisms comprise first thread trimming rollers and second thread trimming rollers, the first thread trimming rollers are positioned between the two fixing plates, and the first thread trimming rollers are connected with the side walls of the fixing plates through first drivers. The plurality of thread passing plates can move in the vertical direction, further stretch the fiber materials in the stitching process, and the working range of the thread passing main body is convenient to adjust and is convenient for users to use.

title_en: High-photothermal conversion efficiency electrostatic spinning hybrid fiber support and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electrostatic spinning hybrid fiber support with high photo-thermal conversion efficiency, and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: modifying the surface of a gold nanorod solution prepared by a gold seed method to obtain a gold nanorod@polydopamine-manganese dioxide aqueous solution with a near infrared two-region (NIR-II) response, and drying to obtain solid powder; fully dissolving the obtained solid powder and block copolymer in an organic solvent to obtain a spinning solution; and spinning the obtained spinning solution through an electrostatic spinning process, and obtaining the electrospun hybrid fiber scaffold loaded with the photothermal agent after the solvent is fully volatilized after the spinning is finished. The preparation process is simple and convenient, the cost is low, the photo-thermal conversion efficiency of the prepared hybrid fiber scaffold is high, the timeliness of magnetic resonance imaging is improved compared with that of single nano particles, and the hybrid fiber scaffold can be used for postoperative recurrence prevention auxiliary treatment of tumors.

title_en: Anti-wrinkling fabric stiffened by pre-cured part and wind power blade
abstract_en: The invention relates to an anti-wrinkling fabric reinforced by a pre-cured part and a wind power blade, wherein the anti-wrinkling fabric comprises pre-cured reinforced resin strips and fabric main yarns which are arranged at intervals in a staggered way, the pre-cured reinforced resin strips are formed by impregnating a yarn main body with resin and curing, and the directions of the pre-cured resin strips and the fabric main yarns are consistent. Compared with the prior art, the anti-wrinkling fabric provided by the invention has the advantages of degree of freedom and rigidity, and has the function of simultaneously resisting in-plane and out-of-plane wrinkling.

title_en: Organosilicon-based fabric softener and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an organosilicon-based fabric softener and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of fabric finishing agent preparation, and comprising the following components: 8-22 parts of modified organic silicon, 0.5-3 parts of emulsifying agent, 0.5-2 parts of coupling agent, 0.1-2 parts of penetrating agent and 100 parts of deionized water, wherein the modified organic silicon comprises methylsilane modified hetero-nitrogen silicon tricyclic ring; the methylsilane modified silazane tricyclic is prepared from 1-vinyl silazane tricyclic and 1,3, 5-heptamethyltrisiloxane through hydrosilylation; according to the invention, the hetero-nitrogen silicon tricyclic is introduced on the basis of the methylsilane, so that the affinity between the hetero-nitrogen silicon tricyclic and the fabric is improved, and the long-acting soft finishing effect and the washing fastness of the fabric are further enhanced.

title_en: Corrugated paper printing laminating process
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of packaging material preparation, in particular to a corrugated paper printing laminating process; the method comprises the following steps: mixing gelatinized starch, titanium dioxide powder and sizing agent additive solution in inert atmosphere, and stirring to obtain sizing complexing agent; coating a sizing complexing agent on the surface of the corrugated paper, paving and flattening a film layer, and then performing photo-curing in an ultraviolet environment to obtain the film-coated corrugated paper; wherein, the sizing agent additive solution comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: ferrous chloride, a photoinitiator, sodium silicate, carboxymethyl cellulose and glutaric anhydride; the smooth laminated corrugated paper material with better strength and hydrophobicity can be obtained by introducing sizing agent additives comprising ferrous chloride, a photoinitiator, sodium silicate, carboxymethyl cellulose and glutaric anhydride and adopting the operation of leveling and ultraviolet light photo-curing.

title_en: Printer state detection method and device and printer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a state detection method and device of a printer and the printer, and relates to the technical field of printers, wherein the printer comprises a light emitter circuit and a light receiver circuit, the light emitter circuit comprises a light emitter, and the light emitter comprises a light emitting state and a non-light emitting state; the optical receiver circuit comprises an optical receiver and a resistance module connected in series with the optical receiver, wherein the resistance value of the resistance module comprises a first resistance value and a second resistance value, and the voltage values at two ends of the resistance module are output voltage values of the optical receiver circuit. According to the scheme, the corresponding control logic is used for controlling the light receiver circuit to be connected with the first resistance value or the second resistance value, and when the light emitter is controlled to be in a light-emitting state or a non-light-emitting state, the output voltage value of the light receiver circuit is obtained, so that the box cover state and the paper state of the printer are detected according to the output voltage value. The state detection of the printer can be completed through one detection module, and the beneficial effect of saving the production cost of the printer is achieved.

title_en: Special-shaped carton and processing method and equipment thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of cartons, in particular to a special-shaped carton and a processing method and equipment thereof, wherein the special-shaped carton comprises a carton body, the top surface of the carton body is provided with two protruding parts and two attaching parts, one cross section of each protruding part is square, the two protruding parts are oppositely arranged and one side is overlapped, each attaching part is positioned between the two protruding parts, the two attaching parts are oppositely arranged, one cross section of each attaching part is isosceles triangle, the sum of the isosceles triangle cross section areas of the two attaching parts is equal to the sum of the square cross section areas of the protruding parts, the processing method of the special-shaped carton comprises die cutting of a paperboard, splicing and nailing of the paperboard, and packaging.

title_en: Alumina fiber loose cotton preparation facilities
abstract_en: The invention discloses an alumina fiber loose cotton preparation device, which belongs to the technical field of fiber cotton preparation, and comprises a spinning module and a counter heating module, wherein the spinning module is fixedly arranged above the inside of the counter heating module, a fiber adsorption collecting module is fixedly arranged below the counter heating module, the fiber adsorption collecting module is communicated with the counter heating module, an alumina gel fiber layer is arranged at the upper end of the fiber adsorption collecting module, a rolling module is fixedly arranged at one end of the fiber adsorption collecting module, a quantitative shearing module is fixedly arranged at one end of the rolling module, hot air can be recycled through the counter heating module and the fiber adsorption module, so that the recycling rate of heat is effectively improved, meanwhile, the production efficiency can be improved through the rolling module, the automation degree of equipment is improved, automatic cutting can be realized through the quantitative shearing module, manual operation is effectively reduced, and the labor cost is reduced.

title_en: Printing cutting equipment capable of accurately controlling rotation speed of press roller
abstract_en: The invention discloses printing and cutting equipment capable of accurately controlling the rotation speed of a press roller, and belongs to the technical field of printing and cutting equipment capable of controlling the rotation speed of the press roller. The utility model provides a printing cutting equipment of accurate control compression roller rotational speed, includes the operation panel, last drive roller, lower drive roller and a plurality of transfer roller are installed at the top of operation panel, go up drive roller and lower drive roller and be the upper and lower level setting, it is terminal that last drive roller and lower drive roller are located the output of operation panel, fixedly connected with first support and second support on the top surface of operation panel, the second support is located the output of operation panel, install compression roller rotational speed adjustment mechanism on the inner wall top surface of first support, fixedly connected with mount pad on the inner wall top surface of second support, fixedly mounted with cutting mechanism on the bottom surface of mount pad. The invention effectively solves the problems that the rotating speed of the press roller is not adjusted in time manually in the processing of the traditional printing and cutting equipment, so that the cutting paperboard does not meet the requirement and even the cutter head is damaged.

title_en: Advertisement printing equipment for packaging design
abstract_en: The invention discloses advertisement printing equipment for packaging design, which relates to the technical field of printing equipment.

title_en: Recycling method of PVDF hollow fiber membrane waste membrane filaments
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hollow fiber membrane waste yarn recovery, and discloses a method for recycling PVDF hollow fiber membrane waste yarn. The invention collects waste membrane yarn in the production process of the hollow fiber membrane component, mixes the waste membrane yarn with brand new PVDF according to the proportion of 5 to 10 percent after pretreatment and cutting, and adds toughening material into the formula to carry out hollow fiber membrane spinning. Experiments show that the membrane yarn obtained by spinning the waste material almost reaches the membrane yarn obtained by new PVDF raw material after toughening, the pure water flux is increased to some extent, and the comprehensive performance is better. The method achieves the double purposes of reducing the disposal of industrial solid waste and saving the cost of raw materials.

title_en: Silk dyeing method using supercritical fluid as medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a silk dyeing method using supercritical fluid as a medium, belonging to the technical field of textile dyeing and finishing processing. The silk dyeing method comprises the following steps of S1, putting a dyeing shaft, a dye, a fixing agent and a dyeing auxiliary agent which are fixed with silk into a dyeing cup, S2, filling supercritical fluid into the dyeing cup, starting a supercritical dyeing system to drive the dyeing cup to rotate, enabling the dyeing shaft, the supercritical fluid, the dye, the fixing agent and the dyeing auxiliary agent which are fixed with silk to perform relative movement, performing uniform circulation treatment, S3, separating, recycling and reusing the dye, the fixing agent, the dyeing auxiliary agent and the supercritical fluid through a separation and recycling system, and S4, cleaning the dyed silk and the dyeing cup through a supercritical cleaning system. The dyeing rate and fixation efficiency of the dye after dyeing by the silk dyeing method are obviously improved.

title_en: Manufacturing equipment
abstract_en: A manufacturing apparatus (10) includes a working portion (22) and a base portion (20). The working portion (22) includes a lower surface (32) and an upper surface (34). The upper surface (34) defines a working three-dimensional Cartesian coordinate system (X-Y-Z). The base portion (20) includes a lower surface (24) and an upper surface (26). A lower surface (32) of the working portion (22) is disposed adjacent an upper surface (26) of the base portion (20). The lower surface (24) defines a non-working three-dimensional Cartesian coordinate system (X  S  ‑Y  S  ‑Z  S  ). The upper surface (34) of the working portion (22) extends at an angle (θ22) relative to the lower surface (24) of the base portion (20) such that a working three-dimensional Cartesian coordinate system (X-Y-Z) is different from a non-working three-dimensional Cartesian coordinate system (X)  S  ‑Y  S  ‑Z  S  ) Angularly offset. Methods (200, 300) are also disclosed.

title_en: Jacquard knife assembly transmission structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a jacquard knife component transmission structure, wherein the other end of a transmission rod is respectively connected with reciprocating rectilinear motion mechanisms at two sides of the inside of a frame, a fixed plate is fixedly connected to the reciprocating rectilinear motion mechanisms, the lower end of the fixed plate is fixedly connected with a straight rack, the straight rack is respectively meshed with a driving gear, right-angle bending plates are respectively fixedly connected to the inner walls of the frames at two sides of the driving gear, rotating shafts at two sides of the driving gear respectively penetrate through and are rotatably connected to the right-angle bending plates, and crank arms are fixedly connected to the rotating shafts of the driving gear between the right-angle bending plates and inner arms of the frames and are connected with needle lifting arms through linkage rods. The invention aims to provide a jacquard knife component transmission structure which is free from a large number of chains to drive, simple in structure, ingenious in design and stable in operation.

title_en: Polyether sulfone/polyetherimide high-temperature energy storage composite medium and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polyether sulfone/polyetherimide high-temperature energy storage composite medium and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of energy storage dielectric materials and preparation thereof. According to the invention, the high-dielectric-constant polyethersulfone is introduced into the polyetherimide polymer, the polarization performance of the composite medium is regulated and controlled by introducing disorder into the polyethersulfone, the interaction between the polymers determines the chain mobility, and a two-phase blending path is used as a barrier for limiting carrier transportation, so that the tortuosity of carrier transportation is increased, the dielectric property of the composite medium is further influenced, the energy storage density and the charge-discharge efficiency of the energy storage medium are improved, and the loss of the energy storage medium is reduced.

title_en: Composite multifunctional warm-keeping garment and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a composite type multifunctional warm-keeping garment and a preparation method thereof, wherein the composite type multifunctional warm-keeping garment comprises a napping layer and a cotton cloth layer, the napping layer is a napped bottom napping fabric formed by knitting with yarn prepared from modified polyester fibers as terry yarns, the cotton cloth layer is a fabric formed by knitting with moisture-absorbing and breathable yarns, and the napping layer and the cotton cloth layer are sewn together through sewing threads. When the napped garment is manufactured, the skin-friendly cotton cloth layer of pure cotton is arranged in the napped fabric, the hand feeling is compact, the fabric is comfortable and soft, the napped fabric is adopted as the outer layer of the napped fabric, and the layer fabric fiber has porosity, and a large amount of air can be accumulated between the fibers, so that the air permeability is good, the water balance state of the fabric can be maintained, the static electricity generation of the fabric is reduced, and the pilling defect is also reduced.

title_en: Corrugated board creasing machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a corrugated board creasing machine, which relates to the technical field of creasing machines and comprises a box body, wherein the bottom of the box body is fixedly connected with supporting legs, a lifting mechanism is arranged in the box body, and a supporting box is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the inner wall of the box body; the lifting mechanism comprises an electric push rod, a fixed block, an inserting block, an indentation die, a square groove, a clamping rod, a groove, a connecting block and a first spring, wherein the fixed block is fixedly connected to the output end of the electric push rod, the electric push rod is fixedly arranged at the top of the inner wall of the box body, the square groove is formed in the bottom of the fixed block, the bottom of the inserting block is fixedly connected with the top of the indentation die, the inserting block is inserted into the square groove, and the clamping groove is formed in one side of the inserting block; according to the invention, the clamping rod is pulled rightwards, and the clamping rod is separated from the inside of the clamping groove, so that the insert block is released from the limit, the disassembly of the indentation die is convenient, and the replacement of the indentation die is convenient.

title_en: Cup surface paste printing device
abstract_en: The application discloses a cup surface slurry printing device, and relates to the technical field of candle cup processing. The cup surface paste printing device comprises a mounting base, wherein a first reciprocating driving piece is arranged on the mounting base, a mounting frame group is arranged at the output end of the first reciprocating driving piece, and a polymer membrane net is arranged on the inner wall surface of the mounting frame group; the mounting base is also provided with a mounting frame, and the mounting frame is provided with a material injection mechanism for injecting sizing agent to the upper net surface of the polymer film net and an imprinting mechanism for imprinting the upper net surface of the polymer film net; the mounting base is also provided with a second reciprocating driving piece, the output end of the second reciprocating driving piece is provided with a supporting mechanism for placing the cup body and supplying the cup body to rotate, the second reciprocating driving piece is used for driving the supporting mechanism to move so that the cup body is propped against the lower net surface of the polymer film net, and the first reciprocating driving piece is used for driving the polymer film net to move so that the imprinting mechanism rolls the slurry on the cup body. The application improves the printing efficiency of the cup body.

title_en: Liquid ejecting apparatus and liquid ejecting method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a liquid ejecting apparatus and a liquid ejecting method. The liquid ejecting apparatus includes a flow path member having a flow path through which a pseudoplastic liquid flows, an actuator that applies pressure to the liquid in the flow path to eject liquid droplets from the flow path member, and a flow rate setting unit that sets a flow rate of the liquid in the flow path. The flow rate setting unit adjusts the circulation flow rate of the liquid circulating in the supply reservoir, the plurality of supply manifolds, the plurality of supply channels, the plurality of pressure chambers, the plurality of recovery channels, the plurality of recovery manifolds, and the recovery reservoir in this order to a predetermined target flow rate. The flow path has a flow path shape in which the average viscosity of the liquid in the supply flow path is half or less of the average viscosity of the liquid in the supply manifold when the circulation flow rate is the target flow rate.

title_en: Nylon industrial yarn for safety airbag and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of nylon industrial yarns, and particularly relates to a nylon industrial yarn for an air bag and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method of the nylon industrial yarn comprises the steps of taking nylon 66 salt and benzotriazole-phosphate derivative as raw materials, carrying out polycondensation under the action of sodium hypophosphite to obtain modified nylon 66 slices, and then obtaining the nylon industrial yarn through melt spinning; the invention adopts a one-step method to directly polymerize and prepare the nylon industrial yarn, can effectively avoid the problem of reduced comprehensive performance caused by flame-retardant modification of the finished nylon 66, has simple preparation process and convenient production, and the prepared nylon industrial yarn has good strength, ageing resistance and flame retardance and has great market application value in the field of automobile safety airbags.

title_en: Thread cutting mechanism and method of sewing machine and sewing machine
abstract_en: The application relates to a thread cutting mechanism and a thread cutting method of a sewing machine, and the sewing machine, wherein the thread cutting mechanism comprises a first thread cutting knife and a second thread cutting knife, the second thread cutting knife is provided with a thread cutting hook for hooking and driving a bottom thread to move towards the first thread cutting knife, the thread cutting mechanism also comprises a fixedly installed thread cutting capturing piece, the thread cutting capturing piece comprises an arc capturing piece arranged along the peripheral side of a rotating shuttle assembly, the arc capturing piece is positioned between the rotating shuttle assembly and the first thread cutting knife, the right side edge of the arc capturing piece is provided with a right-inclined constraint side edge, and a capturing groove is formed in the constraint side edge; the second thread cutting knife rotates towards the first thread cutting knife, the thread cutting hook is intersected with the constraint side edge, and the thread cutting hook drives the bottom thread to move to the catching groove opening along the constraint side edge. The thread trimming mechanism disclosed by the application can catch the thread end of the bottom thread after trimming is completed, stabilize the position of the thread end of the bottom thread and improve the stability in sewing performance.

title_en: Fiber power generation structure with surface micropores, preparation equipment, method and product thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to a fiber power generation structure with surface micropores, and a preparation device, a method and a product thereof, wherein the fiber power generation structure comprises a shell, the shell is hollow, and liquid metal is poured into the shell to serve as an electrode inner core; the shell both ends are equipped with silica gel sealing end, and the silica gel sealing end wears to be equipped with the electrically conductive heart yearn that stretches into shell hollow area. The application can convert high-entropy low-frequency mechanical energy into electric energy, the microstructure effectively increases the specific surface area of the friction material, improves the friction power generation output performance, and meanwhile, the coaxial fiber has larger stretchability, can meet the requirement of weaving into a wearable device, and the liquid metal ensures that the coaxial fiber can maintain a good conductive path in a certain deformation range, thereby ensuring normal function of the device.

title_en: Preparation method of super-amphiphobic moisture-permeable protective fabric
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of super-amphiphobic moisture-permeable protective fabric, which solves the technical problems of complex preparation process or poor stability of the existing super-amphiphobic coating. According to the preparation method, the super-amphiphobic coating is prepared on the surface of the fiber fabric by using Tetraethoxysilane (TEOS) and 1H, 2H-perfluoro decyl trimethoxy silane (FAS-17) as raw materials through a simple one-step method. The whole method is simple and economical to operate, and the stability of the prepared fabric is good because the FAS-17, the nano silicon dioxide and the fiber surface are combined by Si-O-chemical bonds, so that the stability of the coating is improved.

title_en: Down garment double faced adhesive tape pressing device and method
abstract_en: The application relates to a down garment double-sided tape adhesive tape pressing device and method. The glue pressing device comprises a substrate; the first telescopic piece is arranged on the base plate and is used for driving the base plate to move; the second telescopic piece and the heating piece are arranged on the other side of the substrate far away from the first telescopic piece; the length adjusting component is arranged at the output shaft end of the second telescopic piece and is used for adjusting the working length of the heating piece; wherein the heating piece is a plurality of heating plates which are connected together, and the heating plates are independently controlled to be started; according to the application, the deformable heating piece is designed, the heating length of the heating piece is controlled in the hot pressing process, and the cloth piece for clothing production is placed under the heating piece, so that normal glue pressing can be performed on clothing, energy consumption can be saved, and the clothing production cost is reduced.

title_en: Transfer printing device and preparation method thereof, and mass transfer method of micro light emitting diode
abstract_en: The application provides a transfer printing device, a preparation method thereof and a huge transfer method of a micro light emitting diode. The transfer printing device comprises a transfer printing substrate and a plurality of transfer printing heads; the transfer printing heads are respectively connected to one surface of the transfer printing substrate and used for adsorbing and transferring objects to be transferred; wherein the hardness of the transfer head is gradually increased in a direction away from the transfer substrate. The transfer printing device has good wear resistance, effectively prolongs the service life and the replacement period of the transfer printing head, and improves the transfer efficiency; and the overall toughness of the transfer printing head is good, the fatigue resistance of the transfer printing head is improved, the stress damage of the transfer printing head is avoided, and the service life of the transfer printing device is further prolonged.

title_en: Process and equipment for producing special fiber for non-falling down
abstract_en: The invention provides a special fiber production process and equipment for non-falling down, and relates to the technical field of fiber production. Through driving and adjusting the pinion rack and sliding along adjusting the cover piece inside, because of adjusting the pinion rack and adjusting the support mounting through adjusting the extension board for adjust the support and drive first fixed disk, second fixed disk and third fixed disk and promote suitable height, make further control fibrous elasticity, make the fiber control elasticity to single ply and synthetic three ply, reduce the fibre and break away from the recess on the installation concave block, improve the result of use.

title_en: Preparation method of open regenerated fiber hot air non-woven material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of an open regenerated fiber hot air non-woven material, and belongs to the field of textile materials. The method for preparing the open regenerated fiber hot air non-woven material comprises the following steps: (1) Mechanically cutting and opening the waste polyester-cotton blended fabric to obtain polyester-cotton blended regenerated fibers; (2) Uniformly mixing the polyester-cotton blended regenerated fiber and the bi-component PLA fiber, and carding to form a net to obtain a mixed fiber net; (3) And (3) carrying out hot air bonding, cooling and reinforcing on the mixed fiber web to obtain the open regenerated fiber hot air non-woven material. The gram weight of the open regenerated fiber hot air non-woven material prepared by the invention is 150-170g/m  2  The breaking strength reaches more than 8.7N, and the breaking elongation reaches more than 76.3%.

title_en: Lignin-based self-cleaning coating material with wide adaptability and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lignin-based self-cleaning coating material with wide adaptability, and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, dissolving lignin formate in a mixed system of ethanol and water for self-assembly, adding ferric chloride into the mixed system to obtain a lignin formate-iron ion co-solution system, then placing a substrate into the co-solution system, dipping, taking out and drying to obtain the lignin formate-iron ion co-solution. The lignin-based self-cleaning coating material prepared by the method has good degradability and low cost, can greatly increase the contact angle of the fabric, effectively improves the hydrophobic property of the fabric, has good stability and excellent self-cleaning capability, and can be well adapted to severe environments.

title_en: Anti-plate-turnover holographic electrochemical aluminum and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses anti-roll-over holographic alumite, which at least comprises a base film layer, a release layer, an aluminum silver paste ink imaging layer and an adhesive layer which are sequentially arranged; the aluminum paste ink imaging layer comprises the following raw materials in parts by mass: 20-35 parts of thermoplastic acrylic resin, 10-15 parts of aluminum paste, 55-65 parts of solvent and 0-0.5 part of auxiliary agent. The invention also discloses a preparation method of the anti-roll-over holographic electrochemical aluminum, which comprises the following steps: coating a release layer on the base film layer; coating an aluminum silver paste ink imaging layer on the release layer; molding a holographic pattern on the aluminum silver paste ink imaging layer; curing after the mould pressing is finished; and coating a glue layer on the cured aluminum paste ink imaging layer. According to the invention, because the metal aluminum and the thermoplastic acrylic resin are simultaneously present in the imaging layer, when the pattern is to be reproduced by means of alkali liquor washing, the imaging layer pattern can be destroyed while the aluminum and the alkali liquor are subjected to chemical reaction, so that the original holographic pattern is incomplete, the original holographic pattern cannot be reproduced, and the anti-reproduction effect is achieved.

title_en: Plastic bag printing device and printing method
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a plastic bag printing device and a printing method. The plastic bag printing device comprises a supporting mechanism and a printing roller mechanism, wherein the supporting mechanism comprises two supporting plates which are oppositely arranged, and a FLIR high-speed camera and a lifting hydraulic cylinder are arranged on one supporting plate side; the printing roller mechanism comprises a printing roller and a driving structure, wherein the driving structure comprises an outer supporting shaft, a motor, a transmission gear, a driven gear, an inner supporting shaft and a rotating support, two ends of the outer supporting shaft are connected to a supporting plate, at least part of the outer supporting shaft penetrates through the printing roller, the motor is arranged in the outer supporting shaft and is in driving connection with the transmission gear, the driven gear is meshed with the transmission gear, the rotating center of the rotating support is in driving connection with the transmission gear and is in rotating connection with the inner supporting shaft, the free end of the rotating support is clamped on the inner wall surface of the printing roller, the inner supporting shaft is connected with the outer supporting shaft, and the printing roller is in rotating connection with the outer supporting shaft. The technical scheme of the utility model aims to improve the quality of printed patterns while ensuring the production efficiency of factories.

title_en: Football surface pattern printing equipment is used in ball production and processing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of printing equipment, in particular to football surface pattern printing equipment for ball production and processing, which comprises a rack, wherein a conveyor belt is rotatably arranged at the top of the rack, a plurality of limiting blocks are arranged on the surface of the conveyor belt, and a discharging frame is movably arranged between two adjacent limiting blocks. According to the invention, dust is cleaned on the printing surface of the wrapping leather through the cleaning component on one side of the fixing frame, then the printing mechanism is used for carrying out pattern printing processing on the printing surface of the wrapping leather, finally the thermosetting component on the other side of the fixing frame is used for carrying out thermosetting processing on the printing pattern on the printing surface of the wrapping leather, so that efficient printing processing on the football surface pattern is completed, the whole pattern printing process adopts automatic operation, the printing efficiency on the football surface pattern is effectively improved, and the printing processing on different patterns on the football surface can be realized through quick replacement of the pattern printing structure in the printing component.

title_en: Buttonhole opening machine for clothing processing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a buttonhole opening machine for clothing processing, which relates to the technical field of buttonhole opening of clothing and comprises a base, wherein a buttonhole opening machine is arranged on the rear side of the top of the base, a heating body is arranged on the left side of the top of the buttonhole opening machine, a sewing needle is arranged on the front side of the bottom end of the buttonhole opening machine, and a foot support assembly is arranged on the top of the base and is arranged right in front of the buttonhole opening machine. This buttonhole machine is opened in tailoring is through the rotation of pivot, draws together the oblique angle sword arris subtend of first movable plate and second movable plate bottom, still can be through rotatory around the crossbeam pole, changes the contained angle size between first swash plate and the second swash plate, accomplishes the further regulation to horizontal distance between two oblique angle sword arris to this is realized interior to take off the assembly under pedal plate's guide cooperation, the processing is offered to the buttonhole that lies in the inboard different positions of pedal plate, realizes the demand of opening the buttonhole to the different deflection angles of cloth.

title_en: Macrocyclic compound and application thereof, and treatment-free thermosensitive plate precursor containing macrocyclic compound, treatment-free thermosensitive plate and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a macrocyclic compound and its application, include macrocyclic compound's heat-sensitive edition precursor and heat-sensitive edition and application of treatment-free, this macrocyclic compound is the product that is got by resorcinol Calixarene (CR) and isocyanato acrylic ester (ICA) through the urethanization reaction, because this macrocyclic compound contains calixarene, its macrocyclic cup cavity can have enveloping infrared absorbent and thermal initiator, in addition, macrocyclic compound contains strong polar urethanization active double bond, have higher heat-sensitive crosslinking activity, can take place the crosslinking reaction with other components in the imaging layer to form the stereoscopic crosslinked structure, thus solve infrared absorbent and thermal initiator surface migration problem that exists in imaging layer; in addition, the macrocyclic compound contains strong-polarity telechelic urethanized allyl, has higher thermosensitive crosslinking activity and wear resistance, and can effectively improve the image performance of the treatment-free thermosensitive plate.

title_en: Ink box device with built-in standby channel for supplying ink
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ink box devices, in particular to an ink box device with a built-in standby channel for supplying ink, which comprises an ink box shell, wherein a shell cover is fixedly arranged on the ink box shell, a mounting through hole is formed in the shell cover, a positioning ring body is fixedly arranged on the periphery of an orifice of the mounting through hole, positioning jacks are symmetrically formed at two ends of the positioning ring body, an ink tank is fixedly arranged at one end of the inside of the ink box shell, a protruding plate body is fixedly arranged at the lower end of the ink tank, an ink outlet is formed in the protruding plate body, a standby ink supply pipeline and a standby ink outlet pipeline are arranged in the ink box device, and when a main ink supply pipeline and a main ink outlet pipeline are blocked, the main ink supply pipeline and the main ink outlet pipeline can be blocked by rotating a total driving rotating rod, meanwhile, the standby ink supply pipeline and the standby ink outlet pipeline are opened, so that quick connection of ink supply is realized, and normal use of printing equipment is ensured, and large influence on printing efficiency is avoided.

title_en: Nylon production equipment and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses nylon production equipment and a nylon production method, and particularly relates to the technical field of nylon production, the nylon production equipment comprises a support frame, wherein a mixing drum is fixedly arranged in the middle of the support frame, a discharge hopper is integrally formed at the bottom end of the mixing drum, a drum cover is fixedly arranged at the top end of the mixing drum through a bolt, a bearing is fixedly arranged in the middle of the drum cover, a mixing shaft is fixedly arranged in the middle of the bearing, and an inner pipe is fixedly arranged in the mixing drum.

title_en: Filtering device for spinning
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a filtering device for spinning, which comprises a filter screen and two filtering mechanisms, wherein the two filtering mechanisms are respectively arranged at the top and the bottom of the filter screen; the filtering mechanism comprises a porous plate, the porous plate is arranged opposite to the filter screen, the central line of the porous plate is vertically arranged, a plurality of groups of diversion holes are formed in the porous plate, and the plurality of groups of diversion holes are sequentially arranged from inside to outside by taking the central line of the porous plate as the center; each group of diversion holes consists of a first diversion hole and a second diversion hole; this filter equipment for spinning, aperture through first water conservancy diversion hole and the different setting in second water conservancy diversion hole aperture have realized water conservancy diversion and steady voltage, simultaneously, through the guiding gutter on the auxiliary ring, improve melt distribution uniformity, in addition, through the rotation of auxiliary ring, can improve the melt distribution uniformity who passes the guiding gutter again, further promote water conservancy diversion and steady voltage effect to improve melt filtration efficiency.

title_en: Full-automatic shoulder strap edge covering device
abstract_en: The application relates to a full-automatic shoulder strap edge covering device which comprises a workbench, a limiting assembly, a manipulator, an edge covering assembly and a storage assembly, wherein the storage assembly is used for storing a shoulder strap, the limiting assembly and the edge covering assembly are both arranged on the workbench, a conveying assembly is arranged on the workbench and is used for conveying the shoulder strap from the storage assembly to the limiting assembly, and the manipulator is used for sliding the shoulder strap from the limiting assembly to the edge covering assembly for edge covering. The application has the effect of higher efficiency of the edge covering device.

title_en: Bobbin paper squeezes device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of bobbin paper processing, in particular to a bobbin paper squeezing device which comprises a workbench, wherein a water collecting tank is fixedly connected to the left side of the bottom of the workbench, a material collecting box is fixedly connected to the right side of the bottom of the workbench, a squeezing box is fixedly connected to the top of the workbench, an adjusting box is fixedly connected to the top of the squeezing box, a control console is fixedly connected to the left side of the surface of the squeezing box, limit seats are fixedly connected to the two sides of the top of the workbench, a conveying belt is movably connected to the inner wall of each limit seat, a rotating frame is arranged above the conveying belt, the right side of the rotating frame is sleeved on the outer wall of each limit seat, a compression roller is arranged in the rotating frame, a transmission frame is fixedly connected to the surface of the rotating frame, an idle-preventing mechanism is arranged in the transmission frame, a cleaning mechanism is arranged in the rotating frame, and an adjusting mechanism is arranged in the adjusting box. The invention realizes the idle running prevention, automatic cleaning and lifting adjustment of the compression roller, and improves the protection, cleaning and high efficiency of the device.

title_en: Thermosensitive recording layer forming liquid, thermosensitive recording medium, production method thereof, and image recording method
abstract_en: There is provided a thermosensitive recording medium including a carrier and a thermosensitive recording layer disposed on or over the carrier. The thermosensitive recording layer includes a compound represented by the general formula (1) and a styrene-acrylic resin, wherein in the general formula (1), R  2  Is C1-12 straight-chain, branched or cycloaliphatic alkyl, C7-12 aralkyl substituted by C1-12 alkyl, C1-12 alkoxy, C6-12 aryl or halogen, or C6-12 aryl unsubstituted or substituted by C1-12 alkyl, C1-12 alkoxy, C6-12 aryl or halogen, wherein two or more R  2  May be the same or different from each other; and A is  1  Is a hydrogen atom or a C1-4 alkyl group, two or more of which A  1  May be the same or different from each other.

title_en: Noise reduction processing method for production line of printing equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a noise reduction processing method for a printing equipment production line, and relates to the field of noise reduction processing. The noise reduction processing method for the production line of the printing equipment comprises the following steps of S1, determining the occurrence position of noise, and detecting the noise value by adopting professional equipment; s2, classifying generated noise after determining the occurrence position of the noise, classifying according to the occurrence source of the noise and the decibel generated by the noise, and designating different solving means; s3, according to the difference of noise generation sources and noise decibels in the step S2, the method can be divided into: thread end noise, press roller and die cutting machine noise and waste paper conveying pipe noise. By not changing the operation mode, the heat dissipation and the operation of the equipment are not affected, and the two modes of reducing noise and cutting off noise propagation paths are combined at the source, so that the space utilization rate is high, the noise reduction effect is obvious, the station conversion is convenient, and the maintenance is free and convenient.

title_en: Chemical fiber fabric printing equipment and process
abstract_en: The application discloses chemical fiber fabric printing equipment and process, and relates to the technical field of printing ink; comprising the following steps: the base is fixedly provided with a conveying frame; the input end of the transfer printing component is arranged at the output end of the butt joint conveying frame, and the transfer printing component comprises a housing with a protective effect; accomodate the subassembly, dock transfer printing subassembly's output sets up, and accomodate the subassembly and including accomodating axle one and accomodating axle two, transfer printing subassembly still includes: the support frame is fixedly arranged in the housing, and the preheating component and the processing component are sequentially arranged on the support frame; the two supporting plates are symmetrically arranged, the adjacent supporting frames are fixed in the housing, and roller groups are fixedly arranged between the supporting plates; the method can effectively eliminate cracks through preheating the preheating shaft, so that the coating of the transfer paper is more uniform, the definition of the follow-up transfer profile is improved, the time required by heating the follow-up transfer paper and the base cloth in the high-temperature high-pressure treatment stage can be ensured, and the damage of the high-temperature high-pressure on the base cloth is reduced.

title_en: Gamma-aminopropyl triethoxy silane modified silver nanowire/polyimide composite fiber heat conduction film and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a gamma-aminopropyl triethoxysilane modified silver nanowire/polyimide composite fiber heat conduction film, and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the steps of mixing and stirring diamine monomer and dianhydride monomer under ice water bath condition until polymerization reaction is complete, and obtaining polyamic acid solution; carrying out electrostatic spinning on the polyamic acid solution to obtain a polyamic acid fiber felt; carrying out thermal imidization treatment on the polyamide acid fiber felt to obtain a polyimide fiber felt; adding silver nanowires into a silane modifier, heating for reaction to obtain silane modified silver nanowires, and loading the silane modified silver nanowires on the surface of a polyimide fiber felt to obtain the silane modified silver nanowire/polyimide composite fiber felt. The method is simple to operate and reasonable in design, and the dispersibility of the silver nanowires on polyimide is effectively improved through the construction of the silane modified structure, so that the use amount of the silver nanowires is effectively reduced, and the material has good processability.

title_en: Reciprocating linkage self-cleaning guide bar shogging resetting device and high-speed wide-width warp knitting machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of textile, in particular to a reciprocating linkage self-cleaning guide bar shogging resetting device and a high-speed wide warp knitting machine, wherein the reciprocating linkage self-cleaning guide bar shogging resetting device comprises a bracket and a guide bar body arranged on the bracket, and the guide bar body comprises a slat arranged on the bracket in a sliding manner and a plurality of yarn guide needles detachably arranged on the slat; the reciprocating linkage self-cleaning guide bar shogging resetting device further comprises: the device can change the speed of the guide bar body for executing reciprocating transverse movement, and when parameters are adjusted, the conduction quantity of the external air pump to the flying cotton wool absorption transfer passage can be changed, and the device can automatically match the absorption speed of the dust collection plate to the flying cotton wool under different working conditions, thereby ensuring the self-cleaning effect of the device.

title_en: Double-sided nerve nanofiber composite coating and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a double-sided nerve nanofiber composite coating and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: 1) Preparing modified nano zinc oxide; 2) Preparing spinning solution; 3) Preparing a hydrophilic nanofiber composite coating; 4) And (3) preparing the double-sided nerve nanofiber composite coating. According to the invention, kaolin is doped in polyurethane nanofiber by an electrostatic spinning technology, and nanofiber is collected to obtain a hydrophilic composite coating; and spraying an epoxy resin solution with modified nano zinc oxide by an air pressure spraying technology to obtain the double-sided composite coating. The invention solves the defect of poor binding force between the nanofiber prepared by electrostatic spinning and the metal matrix, has simple manufacturing process and low cost, has multiple excellent performances such as high resistance, wear resistance, stripping resistance, antibacterial property and the like, has outstanding durability, and has great application prospect in the aspects of marine corrosion protection and other practical application.

title_en: Electric plate reeling mechanism for water-based printer
abstract_en: The invention relates to an electric plate reeling mechanism for an aqueous printing machine, wherein a plate reeling shaft is embedded on the periphery of a printing cylinder, a printing plate is wound on the printing cylinder, a main supporting shaft penetrates through the middle of the printing cylinder, two ends of the main supporting shaft are rotatably connected with supporting sleeves, the lower side of each supporting sleeve is fixedly connected with a supporting frame, one supporting sleeve is rotatably connected with a driving gear, one side of each driving gear is provided with a transmission gear, one side of each transmission gear is provided with a plate reeling gear, the plate reeling gears are fixedly connected with the plate reeling shaft through a first transmission shaft, a limiting assembly limiting a second transmission shaft is arranged in the printing cylinder, positioning assemblies for positioning the driving gears are arranged on two sides of each driving gear, when the printing plate needs to be replaced, the limiting assemblies and the second transmission shaft are separated, the driving gears and the supporting sleeves are enabled to be relatively stationary through the positioning assemblies again, and the main supporting shaft and the printing cylinder are reversely rotated through the aqueous printing machine, so that the printing plate is quickly replaced.

title_en: Functional protective clothing fabric and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application belongs to the field of materials, and discloses a functional protective clothing fabric and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method specifically comprises the steps of immersing the cleaned cloth in tannic acid solution for reaction for 12-24 hours, taking out deionized water, cleaning and naturally airing. Spraying silver nitrate solution on one side of the dried cloth, and naturally drying; and then spraying silver nitrate solution on one surface, and naturally airing to obtain the functional protective clothing fabric with the hydrophobic thin layer on one side. After the functional protective clothing fabric is prepared into protective clothing, the protective clothing fabric has sweat absorbing, self-cooling and antibacterial functions.

title_en: Ink jet leakage-proof ink sticking device for copper pipe flaw detection
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of copper pipe processing, and particularly discloses an ink-jet leakage-proof ink-sticking device for copper pipe flaw detection, which comprises a controller, an ink-jet box body, and an ink-jet mechanism and an isolation mechanism which are connected with the controller, wherein first through holes for passing through copper pipes are respectively formed in two sides of the ink-jet box body; the ink-jet mechanism is positioned in the ink-jet box body and used for jetting ink to the copper pipe, the isolation mechanism comprises an isolation sleeve, a transverse driving structure and a vertical adjusting structure, the copper pipe can penetrate through the isolation sleeve, the vertical adjusting structure is used for adjusting the vertical position of the copper pipe, and the transverse driving structure is used for driving the isolation sleeve to transversely move so as to isolate and open the ink-jet position on the copper pipe. According to the technical scheme, the effect of preventing ink from adhering to the surface of the copper pipe is achieved by going out of the error area achieved by the ink leakage prevention device, when the isolation mechanism is in the isolated normally closed state, if the ink leakage phenomenon which is not in the marked period occurs in the ink spraying mechanism, the isolation mechanism can effectively isolate ink, and ink is prevented from being directly sprayed to the surface of the copper pipe to form ink adhering.

title_en: Doffing trolley applicable to core spun yarns and working method of doffing trolley
abstract_en: The application discloses a doffing trolley suitable for core spun yarns and a working method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of ring spinning equipment. The doffing trolley comprises a doffing trolley body, doffing trolley travelling wheels are arranged on two sides of the doffing trolley body, a yarn pulling device, a bobbin inserting mechanism and a scissor device are arranged on the doffing trolley body, a full bobbin synchronous conveying mechanism is arranged on one side of the yarn pulling device, the yarn pulling device is used for pulling out the full bobbin and then placing the full bobbin on the full bobbin synchronous conveying mechanism, the full bobbin synchronous conveying mechanism is used for moving the full bobbin to one side opposite to the movement direction of the doffing trolley body, and the scissor device is arranged on the rear side of the doffing trolley body and is used for cutting off full bobbin tail yarns. The doffing trolley solves the problem that the core spun yarn is lengthened, and the tail yarn is cut off by the scissors device after the hollow yarn tube is inserted into the spindle of the spinning frame, so that the problem that the tail yarn rebounds to separate from the spindle is avoided, and the problem that yarn breakage easily occurs is solved.

title_en: Phosphorus-nitrogen hyperbranched flame retardant and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a phosphorus-nitrogen hyperbranched flame retardant, and a preparation method and application thereof. The phosphorus-nitrogen hyperbranched flame retardant has a structural formula shown in the following formula. The flame retardant is environment-friendly, low in cost and good in flame retardant performance, and can reduce the molten drop phenomenon in the combustion process of the polyester and improve the mechanical property and softness of the polyester.

title_en: Melt differential electrospinning core-shell nanofiber filament preparation device
