abstract_en: The invention relates to a melt differential electrospinning core-shell nanofiber filament preparation device, which comprises a spray head, wherein an inner runner (consisting of a head section, a middle section and a tail section) and an outer runner (consisting of a head section and a tail section) are arranged in the spray head; the spray head comprises a central support (comprising an upper section, a middle section and a lower section, wherein the lower section is of an inverted circular truncated cone structure, a hollow part is arranged in the lower section, the hollow part comprises an upper section and a lower section, the lower section is of a circular truncated cone structure I) and a trapezoid table (comprising an upper section, a middle section and a lower section, and the lower section is of a circular truncated cone structure II); the round platform structure I and the inverted round platform structure are coaxial, and the lower ends of the round platform structure I and the inverted round platform structure are flush; the lower surface of the central support is provided with outer flow passage outlets (small holes or slits, which are lower ports of tail sections of the outer flow passages), and the outer flow passage outlets are uniformly distributed around the circumference of the circular truncated cone structure I; the circular truncated cone structure II is positioned in the circular truncated cone structure I, and the circular truncated cone structure II and the circular truncated cone structure I are coaxial and have the same taper to enclose a narrow slit (which is the tail section of the inner runner); the lower extreme of round platform structure II is located round platform structure I's lower extreme top. The invention has controllable melt pressure and no drop.

title_en: Anti-adhesion self-service medical film printing equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides anti-adhesion self-service medical film printing equipment, and mainly relates to the technical field of medical self-service printing equipment. The utility model provides an anti-adhesion even medical film printing apparatus of self-service, includes self-service printing apparatus body, the chamber door is installed in articulated in the preceding lower part of self-service printing apparatus body, the groove has been seted up to the preceding one side of chamber door, the inslot fixed mounting has the guide way, the guide way is towards the play piece mouth of film printer, one side of guide way is equipped with air cooling mechanism, the upper portion at the back of guide way is equipped with the jet module with air cooling mechanism intercommunication. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the invention provides low-temperature air flow for the air jet assembly through the air cooling mechanism, so that the air jet assembly performs air blowing and cooling treatment on the freshly printed film, the surface temperature of the film is reduced, and the film is prevented from being adhered at the film outlet.

title_en: Processing technology of aluminum foil waterproof heat-insulation riveted non-junction tongue carton
abstract_en: The invention discloses a processing technology of an aluminum foil waterproof heat-insulating riveted type knotless tongue paper box, which comprises the following steps of producing an aluminum foil KT plate to ensure that materials are qualified, manufacturing a cutting die diagram and a die, preparing a special transparent adhesive tape, performing die cutting processing, adhering an adhesive tape on the back surface of a rubberizing machine, jointing and riveting, adhering an adhesive tape on the front surface of the rubberizing machine, rolling the adhesive tape, and packaging a molded finished product. The aluminum foil waterproof heat-insulating riveted type non-junction tongue carton provided by the technical scheme aims to increase the air tightness of the carton, prevent scraping products or inner packaging carriers, has simple processing technology and manufacture, can realize automatic production, has short processing time, stable quality, high efficiency, strong practicability, wide product application and high popularization rate, and the manufactured waterproof heat-insulating carton has higher air tightness, better heat-insulating effect and good water leakage prevention and waterproof performance.

title_en: Cosmetic plastic sheet packagine machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of plastic plate packaging, in particular to a cosmetic plastic plate packaging machine which comprises a bearing mechanism, a plate delivery mechanism arranged on the bearing mechanism and a drawing paper rolling mechanism arranged on the plate delivery mechanism. After passing through the bottoms of the linkage guide rollers, the delivered plastic plate can be rolled on the top of the plastic plate by the printing paper transversely guided by the linkage guide rollers, at the moment, the printing adhered to the surface of the printing paper can be tightly printed on the top of the plastic plate, finally, the plastic plate after the printing is carried out can be selectively rolled by the compression rollers after passing through the transverse grooves on the inner side of the top plate, after the excessive printing on the side edge of the plastic plate is required to be removed, the external transmission gear shaft can be driven by using external kinetic energy, and the external transmission gear shaft and the rotation differential speed of the compression rollers and the delivery assembly are changed, so that the printing on the side edge of the plastic plate passing through the compression rollers can be removed at high frequency, and the efficient packaging processing of the printing on the plastic plate is improved.

title_en: Semi-worsted production process of cashmere lyocell phase-change viscose blended yarn
abstract_en: The invention relates to a semi-worsted production process of cashmere lyocell phase-change viscose blended yarn, which comprises the steps of raw material selection, cashmere fiber strip preparation, phase-change viscose lyocell mixed fiber strip preparation, drawing, roving and spun yarn; the preparation of the cashmere fiber strips comprises the steps of combining cashmere fibers, processing and carding; preparing a phase-change viscose lyocell mixed fiber strip: comprises the pretreatment of lyocell fibers, the pretreatment of phase-change viscose fibers, the mixing of phase-change viscose lyocell fibers, the opening and picking and the carding of mixed fibers. The semi-worsted production process of the cashmere lyocell phase-change viscose blended yarn improves the smooth proceeding of the cashmere fiber in the opening and carding process through the sum velvet treatment of the cashmere fiber. And the pretreatment and antigen fibrosis treatment of the lyocell fibers can improve the cohesion and antigen fibrosis of the lyocell fibers. The smooth preparation of the blended yarn with cashmere and lyocell fibers is improved by pretreatment of the phase-change viscose.

title_en: Automatic feeding device for intelligent screen printer and feeding method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic feeding device for an intelligent screen printer and a feeding method thereof, which relate to the field of printing and dyeing equipment and comprise the following steps: the chassis board, the rear side position department slidable mounting of chassis board has place the subassembly, the holistic sliding plate of placing the subassembly department of bright device sets up to articulated mounting means with the connecting plate, can outwards pull open the back swing connecting plate with the sliding plate, play the effect of conveniently bearing the installation printing and dyeing card paper, auxiliary assembly is in the printing and dyeing card paper front end of placing the subassembly, the air current can be blown out by auxiliary assembly's venthole department, slightly blow printing and dyeing card paper, the ejection of compact subassembly that is in printing and dyeing card paper top then can adsorb the printing and dyeing card paper that will be topmost, drive the transportation forward by ejection of compact wheel of ejection of compact subassembly again, printing and dyeing card paper can play supplementary guide effect when passing through guide assembly, be favorable to solving current printing and dyeing card class and carry out the material loading, directly use the sucking disc to adsorb and carry out position movement, the card drop can appear, lead to the holistic problem of production efficiency reduction of device.

title_en: Coating device
abstract_en: The coating device has a supply table, a squeegee, and a transfer section. The supply table has an annular groove in which the viscous material is disposed. The blade is in contact with the viscous material. The transfer portion is movable relative to the supply table and contacts the viscous material in the tank. The supply table has an inner upper surface disposed radially inward of the groove and an outer upper surface disposed radially outward of the groove. The squeegee is disposed across the inner upper surface and the outer upper surface. The blade is in contact with the viscous material in a state of being in contact with the inner upper surface and the outer upper surface.

title_en: Preparation method of super-stretchable aerogel fiber with oriented pore structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of super-stretchable aerogel fiber with an oriented pore structure, which comprises the following steps: 1) Preparing a spinning solution; 2) Spinning the spinning solution, directionally freezing during spinning, and collecting frozen fibers; 3) Freezing the fiber to remove ice crystals; 4) Preparing packaging solution; 5) And packaging the aerogel fiber. Through aerogel fiber encapsulation, the whole diameter of fibre, nuclear layer diameter and shell thickness proportion are adjusted, influence fibre thermal insulation performance and mechanical properties, and when the size proportion matches, fibre thermal insulation performance reaches equilibrium with mechanical properties.

title_en: Screening equipment for preventing damage of pulping machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of special equipment for pulping and papermaking, and particularly discloses screening equipment for preventing a pulping machine from being damaged; according to the invention, through arranging the base, the shell, the screen cylinder, the reducer connecting seat and the heavy slag pot, after the production personnel guides paper pulp into the shell, the reducer connecting seat drives the rotor to rotate, the rotating rotor can drive the paper pulp between the shell and the screen cylinder to rotate, impurities with heavier mass in the paper pulp can slide along the inner wall of the shell under the action of centrifugal force, the sliding heavy impurities can slowly fall into the slag hole after contacting with the slag baffle, the paper pulp can enter the screen cylinder through the holes of the screen cylinder under the action of the rotor, good pulp in the screen cylinder can be discharged from the discharge hole, the inner flow type structure is adopted, the heavy slag removing efficiency is high under the action of the centrifugal force, the service life of the screen cylinder of the rotor is long, and the heavy slag removing efficiency can be improved through the fence effect of the screen cylinder, so that the heavy slag which can damage the pulping machine and the fluffer can be removed as much as possible.

title_en: Double-sided printing machine with high printing efficiency
abstract_en: The invention relates to a double-sided printing machine with high printing efficiency, and belongs to the technical field of printing machines. Including box and printing mechanism, printing mechanism install in the box, printing mechanism includes printing roller and compression roller subassembly, compression roller subassembly includes first roller, second roller, third roller, link and center pin, a plurality of rollers encircle the center pin setting and through the link with the center pin is connected, first roller is used for paper material printing, the second roller is used for cloth printing, the third roller is used for plastic printing, arbitrary roller with printing roller cooperation printing. The automatic roll changing device has the advantages that the automatic roll changing of printing materials with different materials is realized, and the process of changing the rollers is simplified.

title_en: Production process of water electret melt-blown cloth
abstract_en: The invention discloses a production process of water electret melt-blown cloth, which comprises the following steps: melt-blowing production; preparing pure water; the non-woven fabric is conveyed into the water jet electret mechanism through the conveying mechanism, after being subjected to cooling treatment, the prepared pure water is conveyed to the fan-shaped nozzle by the high-pressure water pump, the fan-shaped nozzle carries out water jet penetration on the melt-blown fabric, and charges are generated through friction between the pure water and non-woven fabric fibers; and (5) drying. The non-woven fabric surface is cooled by utilizing the pure water to flow through the cooling assembly, the surface temperature of the non-woven fabric is greatly reduced by water flow which is shunted into the front end cooling assembly, the surface temperature of the non-woven fabric is slightly reduced by water flow which is shunted into the rear end cooling assembly, hot water flow and warm water flow are mixed to perform the water jet work, the surface temperature of the non-woven fabric is greatly reduced before the water jet work, the water flow for performing the water jet work has a certain temperature, and a large amount of steam is generated by the cold-hot phase difference during the water jet electret work, so that the water jet is prevented.

title_en: Silk screen printer with double material tables working alternately
abstract_en: A screen printer with double material tables working alternately has the defects of low alignment precision of a screen frame and low efficiency of a single material table. The technical proposal is as follows: the screen frame compacting cylinder and the screen frame pushing and positioning mechanism are installed on the screen frame mounting plate, and the printing workbench comprises: the upper printing workbench, the lower printing workbench and the workbench transmission mechanism are arranged in parallel, and the workbench transmission mechanism comprises: the power motor, the vertical synchronous belt wheel, the horizontal synchronous belt and the horizontal synchronous belt wheel form transmission connection, and the beneficial effects are that: the printing screen frame is convenient and quick to install on the screen frame mounting plate, accurate in automatic positioning, capable of alternately working and circularly working in the upper printing workbench and the lower printing workbench, saving in material changing time, greatly improving working efficiency, and being high in product consistency and yield. Can be widely applied to high-precision IC board silk screen printing, hole plugging, double-sided silk screen printing of the same product and the like.

title_en: Paper bag arranging device of paper bag production line
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of paper bag production, in particular to a paper bag arranging device of a paper bag production line, which comprises a frame, wherein a conveying mechanism is arranged on the frame, a bottom plate is arranged at the tail end of the conveying mechanism, and a translation mechanism is horizontally arranged on the upper end surface of the bottom plate; the upper end face of the bottom plate is symmetrically provided with turnover plate adjusting mechanisms which are positioned on the front side and the rear side; a turnover mechanism is arranged between the two groups of turnover plate adjusting mechanisms; vertical plates are vertically and symmetrically arranged on two sides of the bottom plate, a pressing plate adjusting mechanism is horizontally arranged between the vertical plates, and a pressing plate mechanism is arranged on the pressing plate adjusting mechanism; an adhesion mechanism is horizontally arranged on the front side of the vertical plate; a sorting mechanism is arranged at the bottom center of the bottom plate. The invention can arrange, fold and bond paper bags with different sizes and edge seams at different positions, and meets the requirements of paper bag flow production lines while reducing labor force.

title_en: Preparation method of reinforcing agent for bonding strength between raw paper layers of bobbin
abstract_en: The reinforcing agent is characterized by comprising the following raw materials in parts by weight: 0.15-0.25 part of hemicellulose, 0.15-0.25 part of starch, 0.05-0.1 part of cation etherifying agent, 0.001-0.005 part of polyaldehyde, 0.02-0.04 part of alkaline substance, 0.02-0.04 part of catalyst and 0.6-0.7 part of water. The reinforcing agent component structure contains a large number of natural polymers, and after modification, the reinforcing agent component structure contains rich hydroxyl, aldehyde and carboxyl, cations, can strengthen the combination between fiber hydroxyl groups, and improve the retention rate of spray glue in paper sheets, thereby improving the interlayer bonding strength, ring pressure strength, bursting strength, folding strength and other dry strength of paper, and simultaneously reducing the dependence of people on edible starch and reducing grain crisis.

title_en: Circuit and method for detecting failure point number of thermosensitive sheet
abstract_en: The invention provides a circuit for detecting the failure point number of a thermosensitive plate and a method thereof, wherein the method comprises the steps that a control center sends a pulse control signal to connect a thermosensitive plate power supply conduction circuit and a heating point detection circuit, the pulse control signal flows to a base electrode of a triode through a fourth resistor, in a state that the triode is conducted and works, a collector electrode of the triode is pulled down, so that a field effect tube enters a conduction state, and current of a power supply VIN flows to a power supply pin of the thermosensitive plate through the field effect tube, namely the thermosensitive plate is powered; the voltage divider circuit is used for sharing the voltage drop of the power supply voltage of the thermosensitive sheet on the heating point of the heating point detection loop, feeding back the voltage of the heating point to the control center, generating a comparison result, and obtaining whether the current heating point fails or not. The invention can accurately and rapidly detect whether the thermal sensitive sheet has the failure point or not, and provide the position and the visual mark of the failure point, thereby shortening the time for detecting the failure point of the thermal sensitive sheet and improving the user experience.

title_en: Display panel and display device
abstract_en: A display panel (100) and a display device (1000), wherein the display panel (100) is uniformly stretchable, the display panel (100) comprising: a plurality of first strip-shaped circuit boards (10), a plurality of second strip-shaped circuit boards (20), a plurality of pixel units (30), a plurality of first knitting lines (40) and a plurality of second knitting lines (50). A plurality of first strip-shaped circuit boards (10) extend along a first direction (X); a plurality of second strip-shaped circuit boards (20) extending along a second direction (Y); the second direction (Y) intersects the first direction (X); the plurality of second strip-shaped circuit boards (20) are arranged to intersect the plurality of first strip-shaped circuit boards (10). A pixel unit (30) is positioned at an intersection position (O) between the plurality of second strip-shaped circuit boards (20) and the plurality of first strip-shaped circuit boards (10) and is electrically connected with the first strip-shaped circuit boards (10) and the second strip-shaped circuit boards (20) at the intersection position (O) at the same time. Wherein the plurality of first knitting yarns (40) and the plurality of second knitting yarns (50) are connected with the plurality of first strip-shaped circuit boards (10) and the plurality of second strip-shaped circuit boards (20) in a knitting way.

title_en: Electrochromic artificial muscle running in air and preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to electrochromic artificial muscle running in air, and preparation and application thereof. The invention solves the problem that the electrochemical artificial muscle is limited to the operation of an electrolytic cell, the problem that the connection between an electrolyte layer and an active layer of the electrochemical artificial muscle is unstable in the stretching process, and the single functional problem of the electrochemical artificial muscle, thereby being beneficial to the preparation of the multifunctional electrochemical artificial muscle.

title_en: Suspension type spliced lawn
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial lawns and provides a suspension type spliced lawn, which comprises a bottom bracket and an artificial grass yarn layer positioned on the bottom bracket, wherein the bottom bracket is formed by splicing a plurality of support components, and the artificial grass yarn layer comprises a base cloth layer and artificial grass yarns on the base cloth layer; the artificial grass filaments are prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 60-90 parts of base resin, 10-30 parts of thermoplastic elastomer, 10-25 parts of wear-resistant master batch, 1-2 parts of antioxidant and 2-4 parts of slipping agent; the wear-resistant master batch comprises the following components in parts by weight: 50-80 parts of polyethylene resin, 40-70 parts of calcium carbonate, 1-2 parts of 2, 4-dimethylaniline-5-sodium sulfonate and 2-4 parts of sodium dodecyl benzene sulfonate. By the technical scheme, the problems of poor wear resistance and ageing resistance and low breaking force of artificial grass yarns in the suspended spliced lawn in the prior art are solved.

title_en: Control method of sewing machine
abstract_en: The invention provides a control method of a sewing machine, which comprises the following steps: acquiring the current thickness value of the stitching material in real time, and judging whether the current thickness value is in an nth stitching material thickness interval and an nth stitching mode to be executed; when the limiting piece is abutted with the tooth lifting eccentric wheel but does not enter the groove, the rotating motor is blocked and fed back to the controller, the controller controls the spindle motor to drive the spindle to rotate until the groove is opposite to the limiting piece, a blocking signal disappears, the rotating motor can continue to rotate to a preset angle to drive the limiting piece to enter the groove, and the rotating motor and the spindle motor stop working at the moment; the angle value of the main shaft is changed according to the parameter setting in the nth sewing mode. The sewing machine control method provided by the invention can complete the adjustment of the cloth feeding time sequence through the cooperative control of the cloth feeding motor, the spindle motor and the rotating motor, judge the clutch condition between the spindle and the lifting tooth eccentric wheel according to the locked-rotor signal of the rotating motor, and control more accurately.

title_en: Production process of U-shaped straw base paper
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of papermaking, and particularly relates to a production process of U-shaped straw base paper. The production process of the U-shaped straw base paper comprises the steps of pulp board, chain plate conveying, pulp kneader, discharging pool, pulp grinder, pulp forming pool, pre-papermaking pool, pulp flushing pump, pressure screen, pulp flowing box, net part, press part, large cylinder, sizing machine, cylinder assembly, calender, coiling part, rewinding, packaging and warehousing. The process is characterized in that the sulfate broadleaf pulp is preferably bleached, the pulping grinding disc selection process is optimized, the concentration of the surface sizing agent is reduced, a metering rod with smaller model is selected, the pressure of a film transfer sizing machine is improved, the sizing amount is moderately reduced under the condition of ensuring the surface strength of the paper, and the softness of the paper is ensured.

title_en: Production process of curtain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a production process of a curtain, which comprises an upper shading cloth, a lower shading cloth and a yarn curtain cloth, wherein a first wrapping edge is sewn at the lower end of the upper shading cloth, a second wrapping edge is sewn at the upper end of the lower shading cloth and the yarn curtain cloth together, the middle part of the first wrapping edge and the middle part of the second wrapping edge are sewn and connected, a plurality of vertical grooves are transversely and equidistantly distributed on the lower shading cloth to form a plurality of strip-shaped cloths, shielding strips covered at the left sides of adjacent strip-shaped cloths are arranged on the right side of the strip-shaped cloths, magnetic sheets are fixedly sewn at the lower parts of the strip-shaped cloths, and iron sheets are fixedly sewn on the upper shading cloth. The curtain is divided into the upper part and the lower part, so that the curtain can be used selectively according to the actual illumination intensity, and the upper shading cloth and the lower shading cloth are made of chenille cloth, so that the curtain has the characteristics of plump down, soft hand feeling, bacteriostasis, mildew resistance, thick and light fabric and the like, and the indoor space is tidier and more attractive.

title_en: Dispersing agent for high-temperature direct-injection blue disperse dye ink and application of dispersing agent in high-temperature direct-injection blue disperse dye ink
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of digital ink-jet printing ink, in particular to a dispersant for high-temperature direct-jet blue disperse dye ink and application of the dispersant in the high-temperature direct-jet blue disperse dye ink. A dispersant of high-temperature direct-injection blue disperse dye ink has a structure shown in a formula I: the main structure of the dispersing agent obtained by the invention corresponds to the structures of a plurality of high-temperature disperse blue dyes, has strong bonding force with dye molecules, can effectively prevent the aggregation of the dye molecules, and keeps a stable dispersion state, thereby improving color pasteDispersion properties. More importantly, the dispersing agent has a very similar conjugated system with the corresponding dye, has similar color, has small color difference between the color-fixed fabric and the standard sample dyed fabric, and can meet the color difference requirement of customers on high-grade fabrics.

title_en: Medical antifogging agent, preparation method and antifogging mirror cloth prepared from medical antifogging agent
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of medical antifogging agents and medical antifogging mirror cloth, in particular to a medical antifogging agent, a preparation method and the antifogging mirror cloth prepared by adopting the antifogging agent, which comprises the following components in parts by weight: alkyl silicone polyethylene glycol (a): 0.1-3 parts by mass; alkyl polyethylene glycol (B): 0.1-3 parts by mass; trifluoroalkyl polyethylene glycol (C): 0.1-5 parts by mass; tridecafluoroalkyl polyethylene glycol (D): 0.1-5 parts by mass; deionized water: 65-85 parts by mass; absolute ethyl alcohol: 10-30 parts by mass; the preparation method comprises the following steps: step one, adding absolute ethyl alcohol into deionized water, and uniformly stirring for 1h at room temperature; sequentially adding the material A, the material B, the material C and the material D into the mixed solution in the step one, and slowly stirring at a certain temperature to obtain a transparent and clear antifogging agent; the antifogging agent has stable product performance, can be used on various endoscope probe mirror surfaces in the medical field, has obvious antifogging effect and has wide application range.

title_en: Paper coffin integral forming equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of forming equipment, in particular to paper coffin integrated forming equipment, which comprises a chassis, a spraying cavity, a detachable mould, a fiber hanging material layer and a controller, wherein the fiber hanging material layer is arranged in the detachable mould, a bottom spraying component and a side spraying component are arranged on an extrusion plate under a hydraulic cylinder through a material storage cavity; the paper pulp can be better attached to the fiber hanging material layer, so that the condition of uneven molding caused by the flow of the paper pulp is avoided; the spray head is obliquely arranged upwards, so that a flow allowance range can be provided for the flow of the paper pulp, and the deposition of the paper pulp is reduced; the double suction pump can collect and recycle redundant paper pulp in the spraying cavity, so that the production cost is saved, the electric heating plate is arranged in the spraying cavity, and when the paper pulp spraying operation is carried out, an operator opens the electric heating plate, so that the forming efficiency of the paper coffin can be improved.

title_en: Printing machine tin cream adds system automatically based on intelligent regulation and control
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of automatic tin paste adding, which is used for solving the problem that tin paste adding equipment in the prior art cannot monitor the equipment in real time and further causes excessive or too little tin paste to be extruded.

title_en: Optimization method and process method of laminated high-frequency inductance printing screen
abstract_en: The invention provides an optimization method and a process method of a laminated sheet type high-frequency inductance printing screen, and relates to the field of sheet type inductances. The optimization method comprises the steps of S1, selecting a plurality of printing screens with different specifications, S2, calculating to obtain the screen opening rate alpha o of the screens with different specifications, S3, sequentially sequencing the printing screens with different specifications according to the screen opening rate alpha o from large to small, S4, drawing a simulated J-shaped arc graph and a printing screen diagram with corresponding specifications by using CAD drawing software, rotating the printing screen diagram with the center point of the J-shaped arc graph, selecting a plurality of different screen stretching angles theta between 0 degrees and 45 degrees, respectively obtaining an actual opening area sigma W  2  and a screen shielding area sigma d  2 , calculating the pulp-penetrating mesh opening rate Ao and the theoretical pulp-penetrating volume sigma V in the arc graph according to a formula, and sequentially sequencing the different screen stretching angles theta according to the opening area sigma W  2  and the pulp-penetrating mesh opening rate Ao in the arc graph from large to small.

title_en: Plasma-assisted insulating surface electrofluid jet printing method and application
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of flexible electronic micro-nano manufacturing, and discloses an insulating surface electrofluidic jet printing method assisted by plasma and application thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps: modifying the surface of the insulating substrate by adopting plasma so as to inject active groups into the surface of the insulating substrate to improve the surface conductivity and bulk conductivity of the insulating substrate, and further performing electrofluidic jet printing; wherein, coral-shaped structures are formed on the surface of the insulating substrate after plasma treatment. The plasma modification treatment changes the micro-nano structure of the surface of the insulating substrate, injects active groups into the surface of the insulating substrate, changes the charge trap level distribution of the surface of the insulating substrate, improves the surface conductivity and the bulk conductivity of the insulating substrate, inhibits the charge accumulation of the insulating surface, accelerates the charge dissipation, and eliminates the distortion of an electric field so as to optimize the electrofluidic jet printing effect of the surface of the insulating substrate.

title_en: Felt transportation grabbing equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of felt transportation, and provides felt transportation grabbing equipment which comprises a transportation table and a sorting mechanism; the conveying device is arranged on the conveying table, a feeding hole and a discharging hole are respectively formed at two ends of the conveying device along the conveying direction, and a baffle plate is convexly arranged on the conveying device; the sorting mechanism comprises a mounting frame, a sorting device and a blowing assembly located above the discharge hole, wherein the sorting device and the blowing assembly are all arranged on the mounting frame in an erected mode, the sorting device can slide relative to the mounting frame, the sorting device comprises a grabbing assembly capable of moving relative to the mounting frame in a lifting mode, and a plurality of limiting clamping pipes are arranged on the grabbing assembly at intervals. The invention solves the problems that felt handling equipment is not firm or is difficult to adapt to felts with different sizes when the felts are transported, and has the advantages of simple structure, capability of replacing part of manual labor and high transfer efficiency.

title_en: CoS (CoS) 2 Carbon nanofiber material with three-dimensional assembly of CoO heterojunction nano-sheets, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a CoS  2  The preparation method of the carbon nanofiber material with the three-dimensional assembly of the CoO heterojunction nano-sheets comprises the following steps: s1, preparing ZIF-67 nano particles; s2, preparing ZIF-67/PAN mixed sol, and carrying out electrostatic spinning to obtain a solid carbon fiber film; s3 in the presence of Co (NO  3  )  2  Co (OH) growth from templates  2  PAN; s4, performing heat treatment in a nitrogen atmosphere at the temperature of 300-600 ℃ according to the mass ratio of the reaction product to the sulfur source 1 (10-40) after pre-oxidation in the air atmosphere at the temperature of 200-300 ℃ to obtain the CoS  2  Carbon nanofiber material with three-dimensional assembly of CoO heterojunction nano-sheets. PAN selected by the method is cheap and easy to obtain, and is catalyzed by the traditional zinc-air battery preparation methodCompared with the method of the agent material, the method has the advantages of simple and feasible process, low cost, simple operation and capability of realizing large-scale production.

title_en: High-temperature-resistant defoamer for polyester dyeing, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of defoamers, and discloses a high-temperature-resistant defoamer for polyester dyeing, a preparation method and application thereof. The high-temperature-resistant defoamer for polyester dyeing comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 12-25 parts of rice bran wax, 8-15 parts of nonionic surfactant, 6-18 parts of polysiloxane-organic silicon rubber block copolymer and 35-60 parts of deionized water; wherein the polysiloxane-organic silicon rubber segmented copolymer comprises polysiloxane, organic silicon rubber, an initiator, an emulsifier and a solvent in a weight ratio of 0.1-0.3:0.2-0.5:0.01-0.05:0.01-0.03:0.3-0.6. The high-temperature-resistant defoaming agent for dyeing polyester prepared by adopting the specific component raw materials maintains good foam inhibition performance and stability in a high-temperature environment, and simultaneously assists the penetration of dye, so that the dyeing processing efficiency and the processing effect of the polyester are improved.

title_en: Ironing device for producing three-dimensional three-layer fabric
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ironing device for producing three-dimensional three-layer fabric, which relates to the technical field of ironing devices and comprises a bottom plate, wherein a portal frame is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the bottom plate, a first ironing box and a second ironing box are arranged in the portal frame, the second ironing box is positioned above the first ironing box, and the first ironing box is fixedly connected to the bottom plate. This three-dimensional three-layer surface fabric production is with device of ironing, the surface fabric is by first ironing between box and the second ironing box, the elasticity that resets of first elastic expansion link makes the second iron the box laminating on the surface fabric simultaneously, guarantee stability and the planarization of surface fabric, improve the efficiency of ironing, it is detachable to be connected with the elasticity at the one side that first ironing box and second ironing box are close to each other and iron the contact layer, the setting of elasticity presses the contact layer can guarantee that the surface fabric keeps three-dimensional effect and irons evenly at the in-process that irones, whole is level.

title_en: Dielectric heating device and liquid ejection system
abstract_en: The present application provides a dielectric heating device and a liquid ejection system, in which a medium is uniformly heated. The dielectric heating device is provided with: a conveying section that conveys a medium; an electrode unit having a first electrode and a second electrode which face the medium in a first direction and to which an alternating voltage is applied, the electrode unit heating the medium by dielectric heating; and a control unit for controlling the conveying unit. The second electrode is configured to surround the first electrode when viewed along the first direction, the first electrode having a first conductor and a second conductor protruding from the first conductor toward the medium, the second conductor being covered by the first conductor when projected to a plane perpendicular to the first direction.

title_en: Flexible vapor chamber and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flexible vapor chamber and a preparation method thereof, wherein the flexible vapor chamber comprises the following steps: the liquid suction device comprises a first shell plate, a second shell plate, a liquid suction core and a coating layer, wherein the liquid suction core is arranged at one end, close to the first shell plate, of the second shell plate and is positioned in a liquid area, the liquid suction core is used for storing liquid working media, the liquid working media are used for being heated and evaporated into steam to enter a steam area, the steam is condensed into the liquid working media to enter the liquid area, the materials of the first shell plate, the second shell plate and the liquid suction core are the same, the materials are flexible polymer materials, and the liquid suction core is of a porous structure; the coating layer is arranged on the outer surfaces of the first shell plate and the second shell plate, and the coating layer is used for improving the barrier property of the first shell plate and the second shell plate. The heat transfer device can ensure that the flexible vapor chamber has good flexibility, bending property and thinness, and can ensure that the bonding strength of the liquid suction core and the second shell plate is higher, the contact thermal resistance is lower, and the heat transfer efficiency is further improved. The liquid working medium can be more effectively stored, and the service time of the flexible vapor chamber is further prolonged.

title_en: Recovery ink box and chip mounting method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a recycling ink box and a chip mounting method thereof, comprising the following steps: through fixing the recovery ink horn and cutting, remove a part of ink horn, the breach after the excision forms the chip installation position, rethread equipment of polishing is with near the burr overlap of cutting opening excision, form smooth complete chip installation position, it is down with the chip mount pad alignment fixed slot installation again, then place the chip on the chip mount pad, accomplish the installation, in this whole installation, process the ink horn makes its structure hold the chip of different models, make under the condition of installing the area battery chip, the electrical interface of chip still can contact with the contact of printer, make the recovery ink horn can normal use.

title_en: Electrostatic spinning photocatalysis nanofiber membrane and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of photocatalytic materials, and particularly discloses an electrostatic spinning mercerized nanofiber membrane and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method of the photocatalysis nanofiber membrane comprises the following steps: dissolving bismuth salt and polyurethane in a solvent, and mixing to form precursor liquid; then carrying out electrostatic spinning on the precursor liquid to obtain a precursor fiber membrane; and then soaking the precursor fiber membrane in an iodized salt solution, heating and reacting to obtain the product. The bismuth oxyiodide polyurethane film surface taking polyurethane as a composite carrier is more hydrophilic, and can enhance the contact with printing and dyeing wastewater, so that the catalytic activity of the fiber film is improved; and the synthesis strategy of precursor fiber membrane and low-temperature in-situ growth realizes the tight combination of precursor fiber membrane and BiOI, does not need high-temperature calcination, effectively avoids the damage to the fiber membrane caused by high-temperature calcination, is beneficial to improving the processability of the fiber membrane and prolongs the service life.

title_en: Heat-resistant oil agent and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a heat-resistant oil agent and a preparation method thereof, which relate to the technical field of spinning oil agents, wherein the heat-resistant oil agent comprises trimethylolpropane trilaurate, polyether silicone oil and C  10  ～C  16  Pentaerythritol esters of saturated fatty acids, sodium alkyl sulfonates and potassium phosphate salts; wherein, each component is calculated according to the weight portion, the trimethylolpropane trilaurate is 10 to 30 portions, the polyether silicone oil is 30 to 80 portions, and the C  10  ～C  16  10 to 40 parts of saturated fatty acid pentaerythritol ester, 3 to 5 parts of sodium alkyl sulfonate and 2 to 6 parts of potassium phosphate salt. The preparation method of the heat resistant oil agent comprises the following steps: trimethylolpropane trilaurate, polyether silicone oil and C  10  ～C  16  Uniformly mixing the saturated fatty acid pentaerythritol ester, sodium alkyl sulfonate and potassium phosphate, and uniformly stirring to obtain a heat resistant oil agent; the mixing is carried out at normal temperature; the temperature of the stirring is 40-55 ℃ and the time is 1-3 h. The present descriptionThe heat-resistant oil agent and the preparation method thereof have excellent heat resistance and smoothness.

title_en: Printer sleeve position deviation compensation displacement equipment and displacement compensation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a displacement compensation device and a displacement compensation method for offset compensation of a printer, wherein the device comprises a printer body, an ERP system and a mounting displacement system are arranged in the printer body, a display screen and a platform top cover are arranged on the printer body in a hinged manner, a code spraying device is arranged on the platform top cover, a scanning mechanism is arranged in the platform top cover, a support frame is arranged at the bottom of the printer body, a transparent sample table for placing test samples is arranged on the support frame, a moisture detection hole is formed in the transparent sample table, the support frame is arranged in a hollow manner, a drying vent hole and a water supplementing vent hole are formed in the support frame, and a moisture detection device, a water supplementing device and a drying device are arranged in the support frame. According to the invention, the device can realize the pre-shift of the sleeve position working procedure in the printing process of the printing machine, realize the sleeve position deviation compensation, ensure the accurate sleeve position in the printing process, avoid one-time trial production and reduce the production cost.

title_en: Communication control method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a communication control method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, which are applied to a stamping machine, wherein the method comprises the following steps: generating signaling based on a signaling protocol of the stamping machine, wherein the signaling based on the signaling protocol of the stamping machine comprises: signaling start code, end code, service code, and signaling class; determining a service function corresponding to the signaling according to the signaling, wherein the service function comprises: handshake, unpacking, stamping, returning seal, closing box and state inquiry; and if the stamping machine meets the execution state of the service function corresponding to the signaling, executing the service function corresponding to the signaling. According to the embodiment of the application, communication interaction between the software subsystem and the hardware subsystem of the stamping machine is realized, the manpower occupied in the stamping process is reduced, and the conventional functions of the stamping machine business are covered.

title_en: Priming socks and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pair of priming socks which are woven by bamboo fiber yarns, organic cotton yarns, soybean fiber yarns and colored spun alginate fiber yarns. Yarn length ratio in the priming sock: the bamboo fiber yarn accounts for 12.5-20%, the soybean fiber yarn accounts for 12.5-20%, the color spinning alginate fiber yarn accounts for 12.5-20%, and the other is organic cotton yarn. The priming socks adopt the organic cotton yarn, the bamboo fiber yarn, the soybean fiber yarn and the color spinning alginate fiber yarn, which belong to environment-friendly materials, can be decomposed in natural environment and have no pollution to the environment. The air-permeable and comfortable fabric has good air-permeable and comfortable feeling, and can keep warm, resist bacteria and resist ultraviolet rays; can have the effect of protecting the skin of the wearer. The invention adopts a mode that the rotating ring of the circular loom can be humidified in a follow-up way, so that the local humidification is realized, on one hand, the health of workers is ensured, and on the other hand, the corrosion rate of other equipment is prevented from being increased due to overlarge humidity.

title_en: Ultralight compressible covalent organic framework aerogel, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultralight compressible covalent organic framework aerogel, a preparation method and application thereof. The method comprises the following steps: (1) Carrying out electrostatic spinning on a DMF solution of urea-based ligand and polyacrylonitrile to obtain an UL/PAN film, crushing the UL/PAN fiber film, and freeze-drying to obtain UL/PAN fibers; (2) The method comprises the steps of dispersing UL/PAN fibers in a mixed solution of Diox/TMB dissolved with Tp, taking acetic acid as a catalyst, reacting to obtain Tp-COFs/PAN wet gel, removing PAN through extraction, and carrying out solvent exchange and freeze drying or supercritical drying to obtain the Tp-COFs fiber aerogel.

title_en: Implant material with antibacterial and osseointegration promoting functions and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an implant material with antibacterial and osseointegration promoting functions and a preparation method thereof. The invention takes the polyether-ether-ketone as a base material, the polyether-ether-ketone is a nontoxic and biocompatible polymer material with mechanical properties equivalent to human bones, and the surface modification treatment is carried out on the polyether-ether-ketone, so that the obtained implant material has the functions of resisting bacteria and promoting osseointegration, and the preparation method is simple and efficient and has good clinical application prospect.

title_en: Weft knitting fabric with adjustable perspective area and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of textile, in particular to a weft-knitted fabric with an adjustable perspective area and application thereof. The weft knitting fabric comprises a perspective area and other non-perspective areas, wherein the perspective area is of a double-layer structure, the direction of the perspective area is the warp direction or weft direction extending direction, the patterns, the shapes, the sizes and the positions of the weft knitting fabric are adjustable, and the other non-perspective areas are of a single-layer structure. The circular double-sided jacquard machine for weft knitting is adopted, yarn feeding and discharging actions of a yarn feeding nozzle are controlled by a computer system to change yarns according to designed patterns, the effect that transparent hollowed-out ventilation is formed by partial monofilament knitting is achieved, other parts are not transparent is achieved, and the weft knitting fabric with an adjustable perspective area is obtained through weaving. The invention breaks through the technical bottleneck that the weft-knitted fabric with a special effect with a certain width can be woven in the weft direction, enhances the richness of the weft-knitted fabric in pattern change and color, and can meet the requirements of different application fabrics on pattern design and yarn materials in a perspective area.

title_en: Mechanical hemp rope braiding device
abstract_en: The application provides a mechanical hemp rope braiding device, belongs to braiding device technical field. This mechanical type twine braiding device, including braider and material loading subassembly, braider one side is provided with the material loading end, the material loading end is provided with the stopper, the stopper is provided with the bolt, bolt one side with inside rotation of stopper is connected, the stopper with pass through between the material loading end bolt fixed connection, the material loading subassembly is including removing automobile body, lifting part, swivel mount, lifting part, bolt screwing piece and electro-magnet, bolt screwing piece with lifting part one side rotates to be connected, the electro-magnet with lifting part one side fixed connection, the electro-magnet adsorbs stopper upper portion, bolt screwing piece rotates the pot head and is in bolt one side outside. In the whole use process, the mechanical feeding of the whole roll of fine hemp ropes is realized, and the manual work load is reduced.

title_en: High-smoothness electrostatic copying paper and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides high-smoothness electrostatic duplicating paper and a preparation method thereof, wherein raw materials comprise raw paper layer pulp and sizing layer pulp, the raw paper layer pulp comprises sulfate hardwood pulp, sulfate softwood pulp, mechanical pulp, filler and alkenyl succinic anhydride, and the sizing layer pulp raw materials comprise starch, surface sizing agent and metal salt. By adjusting different filler types and dosage, combining the control of water in the process and the optimization of overpressure conditions, the dimensional stability and smoothness of paper are improved, and the product has good hand feeling and machine passing performance.

title_en: Inner hydrophilic outer water-repellent antifouling durable antibacterial functional fabric and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an inner hydrophilic outer water-repellent antifouling durable antibacterial functional fabric and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of knitted fabric preparation. The inner layer of the fabric adopts nano zinc oxide durable antibacterial polyester DTY fiber, the middle part adopts high-resistance Wen Anguan as connecting yarn, and the surface layer adopts all-cotton comb compact siro spinning yarn. The woven surface layer has the effect of a bead net eye, and the inner layer has a plain double-sided structure. After hydrophilic functional treatment, the fabric is treated by adding a water-repellent and oil-repellent finishing auxiliary agent on the front surface through a coating method, so that the fabric with the inner hydrophilic and outer water-repellent, dirt-repellent and durable antibacterial functions is obtained and is used for light sport or light business casual clothing. The fabric prepared by the invention is light and thin, the surface layer has texture, the whole body is rich in elasticity, the inner layer is hydrophilic and sweat-absorbing, the outer layer is water-repellent and dirt-proof, and the fabric has lasting antibacterial function.

title_en: Corrugated carton and processing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of corrugated cartons, in particular to a corrugated carton and a processing method thereof; the splicing box body of the corrugated box body is formed by bending and splicing integrated corrugated boards, and a lining connecting piece is fixedly arranged in the splicing box body; the method for processing the corrugated case comprises the following steps: the splicing box body is supported and supported by a placing supporting plate; glue is smeared on the outer side of the lining connecting piece; the lining connecting piece is placed into the splicing box body by using the sucker component; from inside to outside to lining connection spare and concatenation box press, obtain corrugated case, this application is through add the lining connection spare in the box for after the bottom half was laid to the lining connection spare, its both ends extend to the inner wall department of box both sides, make the lining connection spare also can play the effect that holds up to heavy thing, and under the effect that lining connection spare tip and box inner wall pulled mutually, increase corrugated case's load performance.

title_en: Long-acting antibacterial textile fabric
abstract_en: The application discloses a long-acting antibacterial textile fabric, which is prepared by preparing bismuth tungstate nanowire from bismuth nitrate pentahydrate, sodium tungstate, acetone and sodium tartrate by hydrothermal method; the thiouronium and sodium molybdate and formic acid are coated on the bismuth tungstate surface through solvothermal to form a molybdenum disulfide fold-shaped nano sheet, the bismuth tungstate and the molybdenum disulfide with matched energy level structures are compounded, a Z-shaped heterojunction can be formed between the bismuth tungstate and the molybdenum disulfide, the photoresponse range is enlarged, the separation efficiency of photogenerated electrons and holes is improved, the specific surface area of the material is greatly improved by the fold-shaped nano sheet, the micropore net structure is easily formed by the linear structure with high length-diameter ratio, and the two are combined, so that the further improvement of the antibacterial performance is facilitated, and the better antibacterial performance can be realized by using a small amount of antibacterial agents.

title_en: Full-automatic mesh bag lock stitch forming machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full-automatic mesh bag seam locking forming machine, which relates to the technical field of woven bag processing, has the advantages of twice folding of woven bag openings, no need of manpower folding and improvement of processing efficiency, and is technically characterized in that: including the operation panel and be located the sewing machine of operation panel upper surface intermediate position, the operation panel upper surface is provided with two relative settings and is located the assembly plate of sewing machine both sides respectively, and each assembly plate upper surface all is fixed with two ear seats, and every two adjacent ear seat swivelling joint has the horizontal setting and is used for supporting the major axis of pocket, and the pocket cover is established outside the major axis, and the pocket overcoat is equipped with carries out spacing constraint area to the pocket hem position, and the operation panel upper surface is provided with two and is located the major axis side respectively and promotes the first hem subassembly that the pocket mouth was turned over.

title_en: Cleaning anti-adhesion device for wiping textile fabric
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cleaning and anti-adhesion device for textile fabric, which comprises a fixed box A and a rotary drum, wherein a conveying wheel is arranged in the fixed box A, one side of the fixed box A is provided with a fixed box B, the front surface of the inner wall of the fixed box B is fixedly connected with a motor, one end of the motor is fixedly connected with a rotating shaft, the other end of the rotating shaft is fixedly connected with the back surface of the inner wall of the fixed box B, the outer wall of the rotating shaft is fixedly connected with the rotary drum, and a cleaning shake-off vibration mechanism is arranged in the rotary drum, and relates to the technical field of textile fabric. Through setting up the cleanness and trembling vibration mechanism, thereby magnetic path B carries out reciprocating vibrations and promotes the outside rotary tank of business turn over opening and closing plate of air through the air groove is reciprocal to reciprocal promotion opening and closing plate shakes, and opening and closing plate vibrations can promote the brush and carry out reciprocal vibrations through the slider, thereby trembles the residue of brush surface clean wiping cloth off, guarantees the cleanness of brush self, makes its reciprocal clean efficiency improvement to the cloth, can not receive the influence.

title_en: High-yield pulping system
abstract_en: The application relates to a high-yield pulping system which comprises a hydraulic pulper, a low-concentration sand remover and a pressure screen, wherein the hydraulic pulper is provided with a feed inlet and a discharge outlet, the low-concentration sand remover is provided with a pulp inlet and a pulp outlet, the discharge outlet is communicated with the pulp inlet, the pressure screen is provided with a good pulp outlet and a residue outlet, the pulp outlet is communicated with the good pulp outlet, and the residue outlet is communicated with the feed inlet. The crushed slag containing fibers of the pressure screen is conveyed into the hydraulic pulper again for treatment, the operation is simple and convenient, fine screen slag slurry is returned to the hydraulic pulper for cyclic disintegration, the discharge of slag slurry is reduced, the fiber loss is reduced, the slurry yield is improved, and the resource waste is reduced.

title_en: Drawing method of two-piece type hat
abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-piece cap drawing method, which comprises the steps of cutting a cap in a three-piece cap structure along a symmetrical axis in the middle of two cap sides, taking one cap side and one half cap as basic shapes, and determining the sizes of all parts according to the cap height and the cap width for conversion: firstly, cutting the cap into two parts which are respectively connected with the upper side and the rear side of the cap side, then selecting an arc line which accords with the radian of the head of a human body to divide the spliced graph into two parts, and finally respectively carrying out mirror symmetry on the divided graph to obtain a net template. The hat structure tailored by the method is more fit with the radian of the head of a human body, has a certain movable space and is more comfortable to wear; the cap peak has stronger stereoscopic impression, simple and beautiful shape and more stereoscopic overall shape; has waterproof and cold-proof effects; convenient cutting, high production efficiency and easy popularization.

title_en: Aqueous ink, ink jet recording method, and ink jet recording apparatus
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an aqueous ink, an inkjet recording method, and an inkjet recording apparatus. Provided is an aqueous ink for inkjet capable of recording images which have abrasion resistance required in commercial printing and industrial printing and which are suppressed in change in gloss when recorded matter is loaded and their recording surfaces rub against each other. The aqueous ink for inkjet contains a wax, (i) a nonionic dispersant for dispersing the wax, and (ii) an anionic dispersant for dispersing the wax. The nonionic dispersant is a compound represented by the general formula (1) and has an HLB value of 9.0 or more and 18.0 or less. The anionic dispersant is a compound having at least one anionic group selected from the group consisting of a sulfonic acid group, a carboxylic acid group, and a phosphoric acid group.

title_en: Glass fiber edge sealing material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of glass fiber edge sealing, in particular to a glass fiber edge sealing material and a preparation method and application thereof, and the glass fiber edge sealing material comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 100 parts of water-based resin, 0.3-3 parts of organic silicon wetting agent, 0.1-2 parts of film forming additive and 20-30 parts of pure water, wherein the organic silicon wetting agent is polyether modified siloxane phosphate, and the polyether modified siloxane phosphate is a product obtained by carrying out phosphorylation reaction on polysiloxane after unsaturated polyether modification. The glass fiber cloth prepared by taking the formula of the invention as the electronic fiber edge sealing material is obviously superior to the conventional hydrolysate in the aspects of tensile strength and glass cloth coating thickness, the tensile strength of the glass fiber edge sealing cloth is obviously improved, and the edge sealing thickness is reduced.

title_en: Production method of free shuttle concave strip swimsuit fabric
abstract_en: The invention discloses a production method of a free-form shuttle concave strip swimsuit fabric, which comprises the following steps: s1, selecting raw materials required by the fabric; s2, selecting a fabric weaving machine type of a 28-needle 34-inch weft knitting double-sided circular knitting machine; s3, determining a needle arrangement mode, a knitting structure, a doffing mode and a yarn feeding amount in the fabric knitting process, and knitting to obtain a fabric body; s4, dyeing and finishing the obtained fabric body, wherein the dyeing and finishing process is as follows: the method comprises the steps of raw cloth-open width washing-oil removal by a setting machine-double vacuum moisture absorption-primary setting-overflow dyeing-post setting, and finishing processing; the fabric body is provided with a concave strip layer and a convex layer, the concave strip layer and the convex layer are arranged at intervals, the width of the convex layer is larger than that of the concave strip layer, and the fabric is woven by main yarns and lining yarns. Under the action of the concave strip layer, quick water guide is realized, and the resistance during swimming is greatly reduced; meanwhile, through the raw materials of the tissue structure, the fabric of the swimming suit with the shuttle concave strip has the advantages of rapid water guiding, penetration resistance, sun protection, good stretching resilience, comfort and no tightening in wearing and various styles.

title_en: Wrapping positioning device for backpack production
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wrapping positioning device for backpack production, and relates to the technical field of wrapping positioning devices. The invention comprises a bottom plate, a U-shaped rail plate, a back-shaped shell, a driving device and a sewing machine, wherein the U-shaped rail plate is fixed on the top surface of the bottom plate, the back-shaped shell is slidably arranged at the bottom end inside the U-shaped rail plate, the driving device is fixed at the bottom end inside the back-shaped shell, the driving device is slidably arranged in a chute of the U-shaped rail plate, the sewing machine is fixedly arranged on the top surface of the back-shaped shell, the sewing machine further comprises a shaping device, the shaping device comprises a T-shaped plate, an arc-shaped edge-covering plate, a Y-shaped plate and a compacting assembly, the T-shaped plate is fixed on the top surface of the bottom plate, and the T-shaped plate is arranged on the front surface of the U-shaped rail plate. The invention prevents the cloth from being loosened easily to form the cloth with the edge being covered from being attached to the knapsack well, thereby avoiding the problem of poor edge covering effect of the edge covering positioning device.

title_en: Camping carpet and processing device thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a camping carpet and a processing device thereof, and relates to the technical field of camping carpet processing, comprising a device body and further comprising: the first bearing plate is arranged on the device body through the supporting component and is used for bearing the carpet; the second bearing plate is used for supporting the carpet; the support assembly is used for supporting the second bearing plate; the cutting assembly is used for carrying out circular cutting on the carpet; the pressing component is used for installing the baffle ring on the carpet; the shaping assembly is provided with two groups and is correspondingly arranged on the first bearing plate and the second bearing plate and is used for cutting the carpet by matching with the cutting assembly; the pushing assembly is arranged on the device body and used for pushing the first bearing plate and the second bearing plate to perform reciprocating position alternating motion; the cloth collecting assembly is matched with the cutting assembly for use and is used for collecting and processing the cloth cut by the cutting assembly; the invention can cut holes on camping carpets and embed the edge wrapping ring at the cutting holes of the carpets.

title_en: High-color-fastness plant yarn dyeing method based on dyeing before fixation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-color-fastness plant yarn dyeing method based on dyeing before color fixation, which comprises the following steps: (1) Carrying out health care treatment on the plant dyed fibers by using a health care auxiliary agent; (2) Opening and carding the fibers after the health-preserving treatment is finished, fixing colors of the carded web fibers by adopting nano silica sol, and drying fiber strips by a drying device after drawing; (3) And (3) carrying out roving and spinning treatment on the fiber strips to obtain the plant dyed yarn with high color fastness. According to the invention, the hydrophobic health-preserving auxiliary agent is added before carding to carry out health preserving, and the nano silica sol is sprayed after carding, so that the problem that the carding is difficult due to overlarge friction force of the fibers before carding is avoided, and the friction coefficient of the fibers is improved after carding, so that the binding force between the fibers is firmer, the yarn structure is stabilized, the yarn strength is improved, the color fixing effect is achieved, and the high-quality plant dyed yarns can be obtained.

title_en: Preparation method and production equipment of flame-retardant fabric
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fabric production, in particular to a preparation method and production equipment of a flame-retardant fabric, aiming at solving the technical problems of insufficient stability of flame-retardant raw materials and defects in rolling liquid in the prior art, and mainly realizing the preparation method through the following technical scheme: the preparation method of the flame-retardant fabric comprises the steps of fabric cleaning preparation, immersion liquid preparation, fabric padding, drying, heat fixation and after-finishing, wherein the padding bath liquid can achieve a high flame-retardant effect with a small addition amount, and has low overall volatility, no toxicity and high safety; the utility model provides a production facility of fire-retardant surface fabric, includes material feeding unit, padding device, hot drying device and finishing device, and padding device includes two padding pieces, rotating member and well commentaries on classics piece, and hot drying device includes drying device and hot setting device, separates twice immersion process and carries out the pad liquid operation to the fabric two sides when the immersion to the waste of cloth tip also can be reduced when guaranteeing the surplus rate of rolling to obtain the padding effect of higher quality.

title_en: Super-hydrophilic decontamination finishing agent and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a super-hydrophilic decontamination finishing agent and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of hydrophilic finishing of fabrics. The super-hydrophilic decontamination finishing agent provided by the invention is obtained by mixing a surfactant and water; the surfactant accounts for 1% -10% of the total mass of the surfactant and the water. Fabrics treated with the soil release finish of the present invention are converted to amphiphilic character, i.e., hydrophilic/oleophilic in air, hydrophilic under oil. Even if the surface is contaminated by oil stains, most of the stains can be removed by only water. Compared with the traditional super-hydrophilic finishing agent, after the super-hydrophilic decontaminating finishing agent disclosed by the invention acts on the fabric, the hydrophilic property of the fabric can be improved, the moisture absorption and sweat release performances of the fabric can be improved, stains can be effectively removed, and the fabric has a certain washing resistance under the condition that the performance of the fabric is not influenced.

title_en: Antistatic chemical fiber fabric and processing equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an antistatic chemical fiber fabric and processing equipment, which relate to the technical field of chemical fiber fabrics, and the antistatic chemical fiber fabric comprises the following components: the base layer is woven by strong artificial cotton; a hydrophobic layer disposed on the base layer; the moisture absorption layer is arranged between the base layer and the hydrophobic layer, and ventilation holes are formed in the moisture absorption layer. The hydrophobic layer is woven by modified fibers, and the modified fibers are prepared by spraying a layer of polyvinyl alcohol modified material on the surface of common fibers. The invention provides an antistatic chemical fiber fabric and processing equipment, wherein fluff is flocked on one side of the moisture absorption layer, which is close to a base layer: the moisture absorption layer is used for carrying out dipping treatment, after the dipping treatment, the fabric has good moisture absorption performance after the human body sweats, the comfort level of the human body is improved during the sweating, and the generation of static electricity during the fluff friction can be reduced during the body surface drying, so that the comfort level is also improved.

title_en: Method for preparing phase-change polymer fiber by using waste polystyrene foam plastic
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing phase-change polymer fibers by using waste polystyrene foam plastics, which belongs to the technical field of heat preservation and insulation materials and preparation thereof, and comprises the following steps: step one, preparing a phase-change polymer fiber precursor miniemulsion: dissolving a surfactant and polystyrene foam plastic in N, N-dimethylformamide to form a uniform solution, adding solid paraffin into the solution, heating to melt the paraffin, and forming uniform miniemulsion of the mixture under the ultrasonic of an ultrasonic cell disrupter; step two, preparing phase-change polymer fibers: and (3) filling the phase-change polymer fiber precursor miniemulsion prepared in the step (A) into an injector, and continuously injecting the phase-change polymer fiber miniemulsion into hot water through an injection pump to obtain the phase-change polymer fiber. The phase-change polymer fiber prepared by the method has high paraffin content and phase-change latent heat, and has wide application prospect in the aspect of heat insulation materials.

title_en: Outer ring blowing device for melt spinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses an outer ring blowing device for melt spinning, which comprises a blowing chamber, wherein the blowing chamber is connected with a blowing pipeline, the top of the blowing chamber is provided with a melt inlet, the bottom of the blowing chamber is provided with a melt outlet, a supporting cylinder is arranged in the blowing chamber, a lower blowing cavity is arranged between the outer wall of the supporting cylinder and the inner wall of the blowing chamber, the inside of the supporting cylinder is communicated with the melt outlet, an annular blowing cylinder is coaxially arranged at the top of the supporting cylinder, the inside of the annular blowing cylinder is communicated with the melt inlet, an upper blowing cavity is arranged between the outer wall of the annular blowing cylinder and the inner wall of the blowing chamber, and a first rectifying and filtering mechanism is arranged between the upper blowing cavity and the lower blowing cavity. The invention can ensure that the cooling air is uniformly distributed in the lower blowing cavity and uniformly enters the inside of the annular blowing cylinder, thereby effectively avoiding the conditions of vortex, turbulence and the like in the inside of the annular blowing cylinder and ensuring the melt spinning quality of the polyamide 66.

title_en: Composite fiber material containing lanthanum-based metal organic framework and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a composite fiber material containing lanthanum-based metal organic frameworks (La-MOFs) and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of composite materials. Composite fibre material comprising a lanthanum-based metal organic framework, comprising a fibre material carrier and La-MOFs particles supported by the fibre material carrier, the fibre material carrier being made by fibre material spinning. A method for preparing a composite fibrous material comprising a lanthanum-based metal organic framework, comprising the steps of: preparing a La-MOFs precursor solution; carrying out solvothermal reaction on the La-MOFs precursor solution, and carrying out post-treatment to obtain La-MOFs particles; providing a fiber material, and mixing La-MOFs particles with the fiber material to obtain a mixed material; the composite fiber material is formed by spinning the mixed material. The composite fiber material containing the lanthanum-based metal organic framework solves the problems that La-MOFs powder is easy to agglomerate and difficult to recycle. The preparation method of the composite fiber material containing the lanthanum-based metal organic framework is simple and low in cost, and the prepared La-MOFs fiber material has the advantages of large phosphorus adsorption capacity, short adsorption time, high selectivity and wide pH application range.

title_en: Liquid replenishing container
abstract_en: The invention provides a liquid replenishing container which is suitable for reuse and has good convenience. The liquid replenishing container comprises: a liquid storage unit that stores liquid; an outflow portion connected to the liquid storage portion and having an outflow port through which the liquid flows out; and a cap portion that is attached to the outflow portion and covers the outflow portion, wherein the liquid storage portion has a main portion made of metal, and wherein at least one of the liquid storage portion and the outflow portion has a visual confirmation portion made of a transparent or translucent member.

title_en: Nylon cord fabric ultrasonic cutting device and process of tire building machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of nylon curtain cloth cutting, in particular to a nylon curtain cloth ultrasonic cutting device of a tire forming machine, which comprises a bottom plate used for placing nylon curtain cloth, wherein brackets are arranged on two sides of the bottom plate, ultrasonic cutters are arranged at the upper end of the bottom plate, the cutting device comprises a three-axis linkage mechanism and a curtain cloth positioning mechanism, the three-axis linkage mechanism comprises a position adjusting module and a cutting position cleaning module, the position adjusting module is used for adjusting the position of the ultrasonic cutters so as to facilitate cutting the nylon curtain cloth according to requirements.
