title_en: Upper thread conveying mechanism of sewing machine, sewing machine and control method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of sewing machines, in particular to an upper thread conveying mechanism of a sewing machine, the sewing machine and a control method, wherein the conveying mechanism comprises a first thread taking-up mechanism and a second thread taking-up mechanism; the upper shaft motor provides a power source for an upper shaft of the sewing machine and the first thread take-up mechanism; the driving motor is used for driving the second thread taking-up mechanism; acquiring the rotation angle of the upper shaft motor by using a controller of the sewing machine; according to the rotation angle of the upper shaft motor, the thickness of cloth and/or the needle distance, the controller is used for controlling the driving motor to rotate according to a preset angle change table; the actual wire feeding amount is more attached to the required wire arranging amount, so that the last formed upper wire stitch is more neat and attractive, and the wire breakage rate is reduced.

title_en: Adjusting device before installation of electrofluid spray head
abstract_en: The application relates to an electrofluidic sprinkler head pre-installation adjusting device, comprising: the adjusting module comprises an adjusting seat, a clamping assembly and an adjusting driving piece, wherein the clamping assembly is used for clamping a needle body of the electrohydrodynamic spraying head, and the adjusting driving piece drives the adjusting seat to move in a first direction; the imaging module comprises an imaging piece, the imaging direction of the imaging piece is set along the second direction, the imaging piece is used for imaging the needle body, and the visual field range of the imaging piece comprises a calibration point; the positioning module comprises a positioning piece, wherein the positioning piece comprises a first datum surface, and the first datum surface is suitable for being abutted by a first positioning surface of a mounting part of the power supply fluid spray head. The application utilizes the adjusting module to drive the needle tip to move to the position of the standard point in the visual field range of the imaging piece, and then the mounting part is moved to abut against the positioning piece, thus completing the adjustment of the electrofluidic sprinkler. The distance from the spraying position of the plurality of electrofluid spray heads to the positioning surface is consistent, the height consistency of the plurality of electrofluid spray heads at the spraying position is ensured, and the printing precision is ensured.

title_en: Printing nozzle cleaning device and cleaning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a printing nozzle cleaning device and a cleaning method, and belongs to the technical field of printing equipment; comprises a liquid supply container for storing cleaning liquid and a cleaning tank; the liquid supply container is communicated with a liquid inlet and a liquid outlet of the printing spray head through a liquid supply pipeline; a valve, a circulating pump and a buffer bottle are arranged on the liquid supply pipeline; a sealing plate is arranged at the opening of the cleaning tank, and the sealing plate, the printing spray head and the cleaning tank are surrounded to form a sealing bin for preventing the cleaning liquid from volatilizing; a liquid level control port is formed in the side wall of the sealing bin, and the distance between the liquid level control port and the bottom of the cleaning tank is greater than the distance between the liquid spraying surface of the printing spray head and the bottom of the cleaning tank; and a waste liquid outlet is arranged at the bottom of the sealing bin. The invention has the advantages that: the automatic cleaning process of the whole spray head can be realized, the spray holes which are blocked are cleaned, the cleaning efficiency is improved, and the aim of saving cleaning liquid is fulfilled.

title_en: Antistatic cashmere textile new material
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of cashmere spinning, and particularly relates to an antistatic cashmere spinning new material, which comprises, by weight, 10-20% of cashmere, 30-40% of polyester fibers, 10-20% of nylon, 20-30% of cotton and 30-40% of graphene composite fibers; the specific preparation steps of the new antistatic cashmere textile material are as follows: step one: the method comprises the steps of taking 10-20% of cashmere, 30-40% of polyester fiber, 10-20% of nylon, 20-30% of cotton and 30-40% of graphene composite fiber as production raw materials, washing the raw materials with water, drying the raw materials by using a drying device after washing, and drying the raw materials for later use.

title_en: Antibacterial melt-blown nonwoven filter material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an antibacterial melt-blown nonwoven filter material and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of nonwoven filters, wherein a structural layer comprises an outer structural block and a supporting layer, the outer structural block is two groups of lateral supporting structural layers, and the middle part of the outer structural block is provided with two groups of supporting layers; the non-woven fabric core material is two layers of composite melt-blown non-woven fabric materials and is respectively arranged in the cavities at two sides of the supporting layer; and the antibacterial adhesive layer is arranged on the inner side of the outer structural block in a sliding manner, and the antibacterial adhesive layer is arranged on the inner side of the inner adhesive layer. According to the antibacterial melt-blown nonwoven filter material and the preparation method thereof, the size of the inner cavity of the structural cavity between the inner adhesive layer and the supporting layer is fixed, so that the nonwoven core material is placed, the bulk of the nonwoven core material can be better kept, the working state of the nonwoven core material is further optimized, and the filtering performance of the nonwoven core material is continuously ensured.

title_en: Composite elastic fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a composite elastic fiber and a preparation method thereof. The composite elastic fiber is a parallel hollow bi-component composite elastic fiber and comprises a component A and a component B; the nylon 6 elastomer is a linear block copolymer composed of a polycaprolactam hard segment and a polyether or polyether amine soft segment, wherein the mass fraction of the hard segment in the nylon 6 elastomer is 25-90%, and the mass fraction of the soft segment is 10-75%. The composite fiber has high three-dimensional self-crimping capability, has the characteristics of soft hand feeling, high elongation and good recovery after being compounded, can be dyed in a deep way with various dyes, has high moisture regain of nylon 6 and nylon 6 elastomer, has better fluffy feeling by utilizing the hollow-structure composite elastic fiber, and has better air permeability and moisture regain which are far superior to other elastic fibers such as polyester T400, spandex, nylon and the like, and is similar to cotton soft feeling.

title_en: Raw material zirconium carbonate special for synthesizing zirconium carbonate cross-linking agent and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a special raw material zirconium carbonate for synthesizing a zirconium carbonate cross-linking agent and a preparation method thereof. Belongs to a preparation method of zirconium compounds. Provides a zirconium carbonate product which is a special raw material for the zirconium carbonate cross-linking agent and has longer activity retention time, higher solid content, larger particle size and even distribution. The main technical index of the product reaches ZrO  2  to be more than or equal to 40 weight percent, the grain diameter D50 to be more than or equal to 50 mu m and the solid content to be more than or equal to 65 weight percent. The preparation method of the special raw material zirconium carbonate for the synthetic zirconium carbonate cross-linking agent is simple in process flow, convenient to operate and low in production cost. Under the condition that the feeding amounts of the main raw materials zirconium oxychloride and anhydrous sodium sulfate are completely the same, compared with the prior art, the preparation method of the invention improves the yield of the product zirconium carbonate by 15-20%. The acidification process step is omitted, the equipment investment is saved, and the production cost is reduced. The discharge amount of waste water is reduced. Is beneficial to environmental protection.

title_en: Preparation method for continuous steam activation of carbon fibers of battery felt
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method for continuous steam activation of carbon fibers of a battery felt, and belongs to the technical field of carbon fiber production. The method comprises the steps of carrying out addition reaction on N- (2-aminoethyl) maleic acid/manganese serving as an amino component and an olefin part in maleimide; this process typically involves the lone pair of electrons on the amino group attacking the carbon-carbon double bond of the olefin, forming a C-N bond, resulting in an addition product; the use of lithium bis (trimethylsilyl) amide is to provide such an alkaline environment, which accelerates the reaction; in the second step, maleimide and 2-mercaptothiazole undergo a mercapto-olefin click chemistry; this reaction involves the direct attack of the sulfur atom on the mercapto group on the carbon-carbon double bond of the olefin, forming a new C-S bond; the battery felt carbon fiber prepared by the invention has good adsorption and desorption performances, large adsorption capacity, high desorption speed and strong regeneration capacity.

title_en: Minerals to improve thermal insulation for under-hood applications for battery safety automotive electrification
abstract_en: In one aspect of the present disclosure, a thermal runaway protective film for a lithium ion battery is provided, the film comprising at least one protective layer comprising at least one silicone resin and at least one silicate composite in an amount of at least 40 wt% based on the total weight of the at least one protective layer.

title_en: Recoverable plastic woven cloth and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of recyclable plastic woven cloth, which comprises the steps of dragging the plastic woven cloth from an external loom, passing through the top of an outer guide roller, passing through the bottom of a clamping roller at the outer side, passing through a gap between a sliding roller and a main screw rod, passing through the bottom of the clamping roller at the other side, passing through the top of the guide roller at the other side, fixing the end part of the plastic woven cloth on a winding roller, disassembling a recess, and fixing an external standard plastic woven cloth on the recess.

title_en: Adjustable yarn feeding nozzle for textile machine and operation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an adjustable yarn feeding nozzle for a textile machine, which comprises: the yarn feeding device comprises a dismounting mechanism, an anti-loosening mechanism and a yarn feeding nozzle body; the dismounting mechanism comprises a connecting seat, through grooves are symmetrically formed in the connecting seat, inserting rods are inserted into the through grooves, the bottom ends of the inserting rods are fixedly connected to a textile machine support, grooves are formed in the tops of the inserting rods, first springs are fixedly connected to the inner side walls of the grooves, and clamping blocks are fixedly connected to one ends of the first springs; the adjustable yarn feeding nozzle for the textile machine enables the connecting seat to be abutted against the connecting seat under the action of the first spring after the connecting seat is attached to the bracket of the textile machine through the arrangement of the dismounting mechanism and the anti-loosening mechanism, and the L-shaped plate drives the insert block to be inserted into the slot and then can position the ring body; through the arrangement, the problem that the bolt is easy to loose under the vibration force of equipment after the yarn feeding nozzle is adjusted in height is solved, and the yarn feeding nozzle is more convenient to assemble, disassemble and replace.

title_en: Manufacturing process of W-section regenerated semi-optical fiber
abstract_en: The invention discloses a manufacturing process of a regenerated semi-gloss fiber with a W section, which adopts a screw extruder to melt and extrude a crystallized and dried regenerated semi-gloss PET slice to obtain a spinning melt; then conveying the melt to a spinning box body, pressing the melt into a spinning assembly for spinning after metering by a metering pump, and performing post-heating, cooling in a windless area, circular blowing cooling, bundling oiling, pre-networking, drafting shaping and winding forming treatment on the formed primary filament bundle to obtain a W-section regenerated semi-gloss fiber; the spinneret plate of the spinning component during spinning comprises spinneret orifices with inner and outer circles concentrically distributed, the cross section of the discharge end of each spinneret orifice is of a W shape formed by four leaves, and the included angle between two connected leaves is 60 degrees. The surface of the fiber manufactured by the invention is provided with the micro grooves, so that the micro-pore capillary water absorption phenomenon can be generated, the moisture absorption and quick drying effects of the fiber can be effectively accelerated, and the higher requirements of consumers on the moisture absorption and perspiration fabric are met.

title_en: Wear-resistant low-friction coating, preparation method thereof and running plate
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coatings, in particular to a wear-resistant low-friction coating, a preparation method thereof and a running plate, which comprises the following steps: s1: and (3) modification of lubricating powder: placing the lubricating powder and the modifying liquid into plasma enhanced chemical vapor deposition equipment, and starting the plasma enhanced chemical vapor deposition equipment to modify the lubricating powder to obtain modified lubricating powder; s2: stirring: weighing the aqueous resin, the composite resin, the modified lubricating powder and the filler, and putting the aqueous resin, the composite resin, the modified lubricating powder and the filler into a stirrer to be uniformly stirred to obtain a stirred mixture; s3: grinding: grinding the stirred mixture by a grinder, and sieving after grinding to obtain a ground mixture; s4: mixing: and (3) placing the mixture of the curing agent and the ground mixture into a stirrer to be uniformly stirred, so as to obtain the wear-resistant low-friction coating. The wear-resistant low-friction running plate coating disclosed by the invention can enhance the waterproof property and wear resistance of the running plate surface coating and reduce the running machine energy consumption.

title_en: Delinter with impurity removal function
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cotton processing, and discloses a delinter with a impurity removal function, which comprises: the device comprises a fluff collecting machine, a short fluff processing assembly, a five-roller fluff cleaning machine and a short fluff cleaning assembly. The fluff collecting machine is connected with the short fluff conveying channel; the short velvet processing assembly is communicated with the velvet collecting machine and is used for conveying and storing short velvet; the five-roller velvet cleaning machine is communicated with the short velvet processing assembly and is used for cleaning short velvet; the short velvet cleaning assembly is communicated with the five-roller velvet cleaning machine and is used for cleaning short velvet for the second time, the invention can effectively reduce the shutdown rate of the velvet stripping machine, improve the short velvet quality, effectively improves the workshop productivity and the operation reliability of the delinter, and can effectively solve the problems of the influence on the productivity and the quality of the delinter workshop caused by the partial delinting of the delinter, the overhauling of the delinter, the unstable productivity of the delinter and the like.

title_en: Continuous production method of superfine fiber filaments
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of chemical fiber manufacturing, and relates to a continuous production method of superfine fiber filaments, which comprises the steps of firstly heating and melting and extruding a polymer through a screw extruder, conveying the polymer to a spinneret through a micro metering pump, spraying a melt extruded through a spinneret hole downwards under the action of an electrostatic field and an airflow field, twisting and bundling the sprayed fiber filaments under the action of a rotating airflow, eliminating static charges generated by friction between the surface of the twisted and bundled fiber filaments and air through an internal hollow static eliminator, oiling and hot roller drafting the fiber filaments after eliminating the surface static charges in sequence, and finally winding the drafted filament bundles to obtain the superfine fiber filaments; the filament diameter of the superfine fiber filament is 1-3 mu m, the continuous winding time is not less than 1h, the superfine fiber filament can be normally unreeled, and the unreeling speed is more than 300 m/min. The invention can realize continuous production of the superfine fiber filaments with the monofilament diameter of 1-3 mu m.

title_en: Motor drive control device and printing apparatus
abstract_en: The invention provides a motor drive control device and a printing device, which can shorten the stopping time of a motor and reduce the deviation of the stopping time without being influenced by the deviation of the braking time constant of the motor. The device is provided with: an H-bridge driver IC (12) which applies a prescribed voltage to a DC motor (13) to rotate the DC motor in a prescribed direction, and applies a reverse voltage in a direction opposite to the prescribed voltage to the DC motor to apply a brake to the rotation in the prescribed direction; an encoder (14) that detects rotational speed information of the DC motor during the period in which the reverse voltage is applied; and a stop time estimating unit (11 a) that estimates the stop time of the DC motor based on the rotational speed information detected by the encoder, wherein the controller (11) switches from braking by reverse voltage application to short-circuit braking based on the stop time estimated by the stop time estimating unit (11 a).

title_en: Wide color gamut printing method for local stitchable dots
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wide color gamut printing method of local stitchable dots, which comprises the following steps: selecting an offset four-color CNKY from a known set of printing primary ink colors; adding 2-4 spot colors on the basis of offset four-color CNKY to form a color group comprising the offset four-color CNKY and the 2-4 spot colors, wherein the offset four-color CNKY and the 2-4 spot inks are used for performing the printing of the programmable dots to realize high fidelity; including identifying a set of known printing primary ink colors including at least four colors; selecting two or more printing primaries from the set of known printing primaries ink colors; the anti-counterfeit printing is weather durable by replacing each selected printing primary color with a spot color corresponding to the corresponding printing primary color to form the improved ink color set. The invention has the advantages of high fidelity and anti-counterfeiting by adding 2-4 special ink colors to carry out the printing of the stitchable dots on the basis of offset printing four colors CNKY.

title_en: Quick storage device of electric power supply system temporary carpet that connects convenient to adjust
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of carpet storage devices, in particular to a quick carpet storage device which is convenient to adjust and is temporarily connected with an electric power supply system, wherein a first driving wheel is driven to rotate by a second motor so as to drive a second driving wheel and a worm to rotate, the worm drives a first synchronous wheel to rotate when rotating, then the first synchronous wheel is matched with a second synchronous belt to work so as to drive a cleaning roller and a first traceless magic tape to rotate, can adsorb some impurity to the upper surface of power supply carpet through first no trace magic tape, later drive the worm wheel through the worm and rotate to can drive first dwang and rotate, drive disc and cleaning brush by first dwang again and rotate, utilize pivoted cleaning brush can be to the dust on power supply carpet surface clean of entering, prevent that the dust adhesion from at the surface of power supply carpet, and the dust that is cleaned can be adsorbed to the inside of album bits frame by dust absorption pump cooperation breathing pipe and suction nozzle work.

title_en: Moisture permeable hollow-core-free microfiber leather and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of moisture permeable hollow-core-free microfiber leather, which comprises the following steps: immersing the island fiber base cloth into a dopamine buffer solution, and carrying out concussion reaction to obtain a pretreated base cloth; and (3) impregnating the pretreated base fabric with aqueous polyurethane emulsion, drying, carrying out decrement treatment with alkaline water, washing with water, and drying to obtain the moisture-permeable hollow microfiber leather. The invention also discloses a moisture-permeable hollow-core-free microfiber leather, which is prepared according to the preparation method of the moisture-permeable hollow-core-free microfiber leather. The microfiber leather provided by the invention has good moisture permeability, good hand feeling and no hollow core.

title_en: Preparation method of ultra-thick alumina fiber blanket and needling system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultra-high-thickness alumina fiber blanket needling system, and belongs to the technical field of refractory fiber materials. The ultra-thick alumina fiber blanket needling system comprises an electrostatic dissolving and blowing device, a lapping device, a high-temperature sintering device, a glue spraying and softening device, a hot air drying device, a cross lapping device, a compression pre-needling device and a needling device, wherein the devices are sequentially arranged and connected along a net collecting direction through a net conveying device. The invention can rapidly produce the fiber net with good flexibility and uniformity, adopts integrated continuous equipment to form the ultra-thick alumina fiber blanket, greatly simplifies the production flow of the ultra-thick alumina fiber blanket and improves the production efficiency.

title_en: Component-containing heat-proof and heat-insulating fabric and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a component-containing heat-proof and insulating fabric, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the component-containing heat-proof and insulating fabric comprises an outer heat-proof layer and an inner heat-proof layer; the outer heat-proof layer is a quartz fiber fabric layer, and the inner heat-proof layer sequentially comprises a carbon fiber fabric layer, a first needled fabric layer and a second needled fabric layer; the first needled fabric layer and the second needled fabric layer contain heat-insulating coatings; the thermal insulation coating contains a thermal insulation component. According to the invention, the heat insulation components are added in the inner heat insulation layer and are connected with the quartz fiber fabric layer, so that the interlayer connection strength of the high-thickness needled fabric and the heat insulation performance of the inner layer are effectively improved, and the overall uniformity and stability of the fabric are further improved through the design of the carbon fiber mesh fabric in the thickness direction.

title_en: Cotton grabbing device and method for cotton yarn production
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pretreatment of fibers, and particularly discloses a cotton grabbing device and a cotton grabbing method for cotton yarn production, aiming at the problem that the cotton wool adhered to the inner wall of a shell cannot be blown down to cause insufficient utilization of the cotton wool in the shell in the prior art, the invention provides the following scheme, which comprises the following steps: a mounting plate; the workbench, workstation fixed mounting is in the top of mounting panel, fixed mounting has two baffles on the workstation, and fixed mounting has the fixed plate on the workstation, fixed mounting has the toolbox on the fixed plate, fixed mounting has first motor on the toolbox, the one end fixed mounting of fixed plate has the shell, fixed mounting has the feeding case on the shell, movable mounting has the lid on the feeding case, fixed mounting has the round box on the lid, the feed inlet has been seted up at the top of feeding case. The invention can blow down the cotton wool in the shell, so that the cotton wool in the shell can completely fall on the workbench.

title_en: Solvent-free composite positioning anti-counterfeiting transfer paper and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses solvent-free composite positioning anti-counterfeiting transfer paper and a preparation method thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps of generating a transfer film; the method comprises the steps of generating white cardboard, drying and detecting the white cardboard, compounding, namely peeling PET (polyethylene terephthalate) base films on the composite paper after curing the composite paper to obtain solvent-free composite positioning anti-counterfeiting transfer paper, drying the white cardboard through a drying device, detecting ink on the white cardboard through a detecting device, and circularly drying the ink on the white cardboard through a circulating device. The application has the effect of ensuring the drying of the printing ink and improves the quality of the anti-counterfeiting transfer paper finished product.

title_en: Film coated paper drying device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coated paper processing, in particular to a coated paper drying device which comprises a body and two drying mechanisms, wherein the body is fixedly arranged, each drying mechanism comprises a main air pipe and a branch air pipe, the main air pipe is rotatably arranged on the body, one end of the bronchus is fixedly arranged on the peripheral surface of the main bronchus, a spray pipe is rotatably arranged on the bronchus, and the rotation axis of the spray pipe on the bronchus is perpendicular to a radial line on the main bronchus passing through the spray pipe; the spray pipe in one drying mechanism is arranged opposite to the spray pipe in the other drying mechanism, and gas sprayed by the two spray pipes arranged opposite to each other collides with the coated paper at the middle position of the coated paper along the extending direction of the axis of the main air pipe before contacting the coated paper. And the two symmetrically arranged drying mechanisms are arranged at the positions of the gas sprayed out of the two spray pipes in each drying mechanism on the laminated paper, so that the drying effect of the middle part of the laminated paper is better than that of the edge part of the laminated paper, and the local overdrying of the laminated paper is avoided.

title_en: Semiconductor refrigeration piece encapsulation is with adding seal device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an overprinting device for packaging a semiconductor refrigeration piece, which comprises a support frame and a second fixing plate, wherein two groups of first fixing plates are fixedly connected to two ends of the support frame, a conveying mechanism for conveying the semiconductor refrigeration piece is rotatably connected between the two groups of first fixing plates, an adjusting mechanism for adjusting the position of the semiconductor refrigeration piece and cleaning the surface of the semiconductor refrigeration piece is arranged on the upper side of the front end conveying mechanism of the support frame, a printing mechanism for overprinting the surface of the semiconductor refrigeration piece is arranged on one side of the upper end adjusting mechanism of the support frame, and a drying mechanism for drying the overprinted surface ink is arranged on one side of the rear end printing mechanism of the support frame. The invention has the advantages that: the device can avoid the conditions of missing printing, incomplete printing and the like in the process of adding the printing of the semiconductor refrigerating sheet, and can clean impurities on the surface of the semiconductor refrigerating sheet, so that the drying speed of handwriting can be increased, and the working efficiency is improved.

title_en: High-toughness flax blended yarn and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-toughness flax blended yarn and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of textile; the blended yarn is prepared by blending flax mixed fibers and polylactic acid fibers, wherein the flax mixed fibers are prepared by mixing flax fibers, bamboo fibers and cotton fibers through enzymatic degumming and alkali boiling; the polylactic acid fiber is prepared from polylactic acid, poly (butylene adipate-terephthalate), a chain extender and modified polycaprolactone through melt spinning; the flax fiber and the polylactic acid fiber are subjected to the processes of mixed spinning, raw drawing, coarse sand, spinning and spooling to obtain the flax blended yarn, which has stronger breaking strength and breaking elongation, and can solve the defects of low spinnability, insufficient toughness and the like of the flax fiber.

title_en: Preparation method of sun-proof clothing fabric with heat shielding and cooling functions
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a sun-proof clothing fabric with a heat shielding and cooling function, which belongs to the textile field, and comprises the following specific steps of: step 1: the prepared 30D/36F skin-core type heat shielding drop Wen Jinguan FDY is subjected to humidity control for 48H; step 2: warping, namely finishing the winding of 8 warp beams at one time by adopting a GA266 high-speed batch warping machine; step 3: sizing, namely sizing the warp yarns at high pressure by using an GA320 type multi-unit sizing machine and using environment-friendly acrylic ester as sizing agent; step 4: the yarn doubling shaft is used for enabling the total head mark number to reach 12780 after the warp beam subjected to sizing passes through 8, and the spinning mode of the skin-core type structure is adopted, so that the more efficient heat insulation, cooling and sun-proof performance is realized by improving the adding amount of powder, the yarn doubling shaft has excellent anti-ultraviolet and contact cooling effects, and meanwhile, the effects of strong heat insulation, cooling and effective antibacterial are achieved, the yarn doubling shaft is a revolutionary upgrade of the existing sun-proof clothing fabric, and unprecedented wearing experience is brought to consumers.

title_en: Reciprocating pressing device for quilt wadding processing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of quilting and discloses a reciprocating press device for quilting, which comprises a platform, wherein a fixed plate is fixedly arranged on the platform, two sides of the fixed plate are movably provided with side press mechanisms, and the opposite sides of the fixed plate are provided with rolling mechanisms for pressing quilts; the side pressure mechanism comprises three side pressure plates, and first springs are fixedly arranged among the three first springs; the rolling mechanism comprises a rotary drum and a pressing plate, the quilt is placed between the fixing plate and the two side pressing mechanisms, one side of the quilt is leaned against the fixing plate, an external telescopic motor is started, the telescopic motor drives the side pressing mechanisms to extrude the two sides of the quilt wadding, then the external rotary motor is started, the rotary drum and the pressing plate are driven to rotate through the rotary motor, the two sides of the quilt wadding are repeatedly extruded through the side pressing mechanisms, and the effect of reciprocating pressing the quilt wadding is achieved through the beating and extrusion of the pressing plates.

title_en: Contact lens structure, manufacturing method thereof and intelligent contact lens system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a contact lens structure, a manufacturing method thereof and an intelligent contact lens system, and belongs to the technical field of contact lenses. The contact lens structure includes an energy collector structure, a contact lens base structure, and wires at a surface of the contact lens base structure for connecting the energy collector structure to an external load. The energy collector structure is mounted to a surface of the contact lens base structure; the energy collector structure includes a semiconductor wafer, a first electrode layer at a predetermined location on a first surface of the semiconductor wafer, and a second electrode layer at a predetermined location on a second surface of the semiconductor wafer. According to the contact lens structure provided by the embodiment of the invention, the energy collector structure is configured to collect and convert eye energy, and a continuous and stable power supply is provided for the intelligent function of the contact lens structure. This enables the intelligent contact lens structure to be used for a long period of time without requiring frequent battery replacement or charging, providing a convenient, comfortable use experience for the wearer.

title_en: Method for preparing screen printing electrode by one-step method, electrochemical electrode and application
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biosensors, and discloses a method for preparing a screen printing electrode by a one-step method, an electrochemical electrode and application thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps: step 1, preparing enzyme-carrying particles by a coprecipitation method: dissolving enzyme and protein in a coprecipitation precursor aqueous solution, adding a coprecipitation inducer aqueous solution to form coprecipitation particles containing the enzyme, placing the coprecipitation particles in a polymer aqueous solution, and then placing the polymer aqueous solution in a cross-linking agent aqueous solution to form enzyme-carrying particles; step 2, mixing enzyme-carrying particles with conductive ink: mixing the conductive paste with a catalyst to form conductive ink, adding the enzyme-carrying particles prepared in the step 1, mixing, and then screen printing on a substrate to obtain an electrochemical electrode; the mass ratio of the conductive slurry to the enzyme-carrying particles is 100-1000:1.

title_en: Polylactic acid fiber and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses polylactic acid fibers and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of chemical fiber preparation. The preparation method comprises the following steps: carrying out surface modification on CNTs by using a silane coupling agent to obtain a CNTs-coupling agent; performing secondary modification on the CNTs-coupling agent by using long-chain unsaturated olefine acid to obtain CNTs-coupling agent/long-chain unsaturated olefine acid; preparing CNTs-coupling agent/long-chain unsaturated olefine acid-LA by lactide ring-opening polymerization coating CNTs-coupling agent/long-chain unsaturated olefine acid; blending CNTs-coupling agent/long-chain unsaturated olefine acid-LA and polylactic acid slices to prepare composite master batches; blending the composite master batch with polylactic acid slices, and carrying out melt spinning to obtain CNTs-coupling agent/long-chain unsaturated olefine acid-LA polylactic acid fibers. The polylactic acid fiber prepared by the method has good heat resistance, toughness and hydrolysis resistance, and can be widely applied to textile materials.

title_en: Interweaving dip dyeing preventing device and dip dyeing process for mixed color core-spun yarn
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mixed-color core-spun yarn interweaving-preventing dip-dyeing device and a dip-dyeing process, which relate to the technical field of yarn dip-dyeing, and comprise a dip-dyeing box, wherein a plurality of groups of first wire holes and second wire holes are respectively arranged on the outer surfaces of the front end and the rear end of the dip-dyeing box at equal intervals, and the first wire holes correspond to the second wire holes one by one; according to the invention, the conduit is arranged on one side of the first conduit hole and is attached to the yarn, and the flock on the surface of the yarn can be collected outside the dip dyeing box in a concentrated manner, so that the problem that the flock enters the interior of the dip dyeing box along with the yarn and affects the full contact of the yarn and dip dyeing liquid is solved, the yarn coloring rate is improved, the surface of the yarn is prevented from knotting and winding, in addition, in the process of removing the flock, the second motor is controlled to drive the rotating roller to drive the hook-shaped blade to rotate, and when the flock is accumulated to a certain thickness, the hook-shaped blade contacts one end of the conduit with the accumulated flock and rotates to cut the flock and the flock drops, so that the phenomenon that the movement of the yarn is affected due to excessive accumulation of the flock is avoided.

title_en: Spraying printing technology for glass wine bottle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a glass wine bottle spraying printing process, which comprises the steps of polishing and cleaning a spraying part on the surface of a glass wine bottle, and increasing the surface temperature of the glass wine bottle to 60 ℃; the thickness of the bottom layer made of PVC fibers is 0.1 mm, then the surface temperature is raised to 100 ℃, the surface is kept for 30 seconds, the PVC fibers are taken out and rapidly sprayed for the second time, and the PVC fibers are naturally cooled to 55 ℃ after the spraying is finished; and (3) carrying out silk-screen printing on the sprayed part, carrying out third spraying, and sealing the printed part by using flash powder. According to the invention, the roughness is increased by preprocessing the body of the glass wine bottle, and then PVC fibers which can be melted at high temperature are sprayed to serve as the priming layer, so that the priming layer can be completely bonded with the body, and the stability is improved. The second priming can enhance the adhesiveness with the bottle body and further roughen the surface so as to facilitate the fixation of printing paint, and finally, the appearance of the wine bottle forms a unique visual effect through the powder flashing seal layer, thereby being beneficial to market popularization of commodities.

title_en: Preparation process of anti-sticking sofa leather
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of sofa leather preparation, and discloses a preparation process of anti-sticking sofa leather, which comprises the following steps: s1: adding the raw skin into a soaking drum machine for ash leaching and dehairing treatment, and then removing redundant meat residues on the raw skin through a meat removing machine, wherein S2: adding the raw skin into a soaking drum for water washing treatment, and then adding the raw skin into a tanning drum for tanning treatment, wherein S3: tanning treatment, extrusion flattening, drying, moisture regulation through a dampening effect, softening treatment, buffing treatment, rough polishing and fine polishing, and S4: pulling and softening, namely, after the leather is broken, clamping the abdomen of the leather by using a tightening plate clamp, fixing the clamp on the tightening plate, spraying cations, rolling, standing, spraying slurry by a slurry spraying machine, pressing by a flat embossing machine, breaking and softening, coating, spraying anti-sticking surface slurry, spraying anti-sticking fixed gloss oil on the surface of the leather, drying and storing. The anti-sticking sofa leather preparation process can achieve the aim of anti-sticking.

title_en: Polyimide flame-retardant base film with core-shell structure, preparation method thereof and application of polyimide flame-retardant base film in-situ solid-state battery
abstract_en: The invention provides a Polyimide (PI) flame-retardant base film with a core-shell structure, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in an in-situ solid-state battery. The preparation method mainly comprises the steps of dissolving polyamide acid (PAA) in an organic solvent to obtain a shell spinning solution; the polyamic acid is dissolved in an organic solvent and a high temperature resistant flame retardant and a silane coupling agent are added, and as a core layer spinning solution, the flame retardant is preferably high temperature resistant melamine polyphosphate (MPP) and magnesium hydroxide (Mg (OH)  2 ). And (3) obtaining a faint yellow non-woven fabric film through coaxial electrostatic spinning, and then calcining in an air atmosphere at the temperature of 250-340 ℃ to obtain a polyimide flame-retardant base film with a core-shell structure, wherein the polyimide flame-retardant base film is a PI non-woven fabric composite film. The prepared PI composite film has a flame-retardant function, and the flame retardant is arranged on the core layer, so that the electrochemical performance of the battery is not affected. Furthermore, because PI has radiation resistance, the flame-retardant base film can be applied to chemical power systems such as gamma-ray in-situ solid-state lithium ion batteries and the like.

title_en: Print printer
abstract_en: The invention aims to provide a print printer which is suitable for the fixed installation and support of various engraving plates, can freely adjust the positioning of paper according to the size of the engraving plates, has stable paper fixing effect and convenient and fast taking and placing, and provides a convenient printing device for creating early-stage multi-manuscript print proofing for designers.

title_en: Ironing device with guide mechanism for processing novel textile fabric
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of novel textile fabric processing, and discloses a novel ironing device with a material guiding mechanism for textile fabric processing, which comprises a beating mechanism, wherein the beating mechanism further comprises a main body, the bottom of the main body is fixedly connected with a supporting block, the side wall of the main body is fixedly connected with a mounting plate, and the top of the main body is fixedly connected with an electric iron; when the textile fabric needs to be ironed, the textile fabric passes through the rotating roller and the round roller, the driving motor is started again, the driving motor drives the round roller to rotate, under the limitation of the shape of the first sliding groove, the round roller forces the sliding rod to move along the track of the first sliding groove when rotating, so that the L-shaped plate is driven to rotate by taking the fixed rod as a midpoint, the L-shaped plate rotates and then drives the beating block to beat the fabric, when the beating block beats the fabric, dust and tiny fragments adsorbed on the textile fabric can fall off, and under the action of the extrusion spring, the extrusion spring can balance and stabilize the transmission of beating force.

title_en: Printing napkin paper drying equipment with cooling structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses printing napkin paper drying equipment with a cooling structure, which comprises a tunnel dryer, a conveying roller, a driving unit and a wind power heat dissipation unit, wherein a plurality of air outlets on the tunnel dryer are all connected with a main pipe with an air suction pump; the driving unit converts heat energy into kinetic energy which drives the wind power radiating unit to generate wind power by utilizing hot air exhausted by the main pipe, and then the dried printed napkin paper is cooled. Through the driving unit and the wind power radiating unit, the heat energy is converted into the kinetic energy for driving the wind power radiating unit to generate wind power by utilizing the hot air exhausted by the main pipe, and then the dried printed napkin is subjected to cooling treatment.

title_en: Metal marking machine capable of automatically cooling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a metal marking machine capable of automatically cooling, which relates to the technical field of metal marking machines and comprises an equipment main body, marking heads and an air purifying box, wherein the marking heads are movably arranged at the upper end of the equipment main body, the air purifying box is arranged in the equipment main body, a plurality of groups of radiating pipes are arranged in the marking heads, both ends of the plurality of groups of radiating pipes extend to the outer wall of the marking heads, one ends of the plurality of groups of radiating pipes are provided with gas collecting pipes, and a gas outlet pipe is arranged at the gas outlet of the air purifying box and is connected with the gas collecting pipes. According to the invention, the heat radiation effect of the marking head is improved by arranging the gas collecting tube, the radiating tubes, the air purifying box and the fan, the radiating tubes penetrate through the marking head, the radiating tubes absorb heat generated by internal elements of the marking head, the fan rotates, so that gas discharged by the air purifying box is conducted to the gas collecting tube and enters a plurality of groups of radiating tubes through the gas collecting tube, the cooling effect of the radiating tubes is accelerated, and the metal marking processing efficiency is further improved.

title_en: Micro-nano printing cloud film and large-scale manufacturing process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a micro-nano printing cloud membrane and a large-scale manufacturing process thereof, which relate to the technical field of micro-nano printing cloud membranes and aim at solving the technical problems of higher requirements on equipment precision and lower stereoscopic impression of a layout in the existing printing process, and comprise a micro-nano printing cloud membrane component, wherein the micro-nano printing cloud membrane component comprises a grating component with a filling layer arranged at one side, a PET base membrane is arranged at one side of the grating component away from the filling layer, the PET base film is provided with three-dimensional printing layer far away from the one side of grating part, and the grating part is provided with a plurality of lenticular lens three-dimensional light arris A's grating board including the equidistant distribution of surface, and the grating board is located and is provided with lenticular lens three-dimensional grating arris B between two adjacent lenticular lens three-dimensional light arris A, is formed with concave lens three-dimensional light arris groove between lenticular lens three-dimensional light arris A both sides bottom and lenticular lens three-dimensional grating arris B. The invention has the advantage of enhancing the stereoscopic impression of the stereoscopic printing layer.

title_en: Bamboo pulp fiber fibrillation device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of a brooming device, in particular to a bamboo pulp fiber brooming device, aiming at the prior bamboo pulp fiber brooming device, in the process of carrying out brooming beating treatment on bamboo fibers by adopting a thermal mill, a worker is often adopted to manually convey bamboo to the device, the average conveying quantity of raw materials cannot be effectively controlled by the feeding mode, the brooming device has lower brooming efficiency on the bamboo pulp fibers, the invention provides the proposal that the brooming device comprises a thermal mill, a grinding bin is arranged on the thermal mill, a conveying pipe is arranged on one side of the grinding bin, which is far away from the thermal mill, a spiral pushing rod is arranged in the conveying pipe, and a driving motor is arranged on one side of the conveying pipe, which is far away from the thermal mill. The bamboo pulp fiber fibrillation device disclosed by the invention can effectively realize quantitative delivery of raw materials, avoids instability of manually delivering the raw materials, ensures that the raw material delivery capacity and the processing capacity of the device are matched, and ensures the efficiency and the yield of the device.

title_en: Printer with a printer body
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a printer, which forms images on a roll paper and provides a technology capable of correctly setting paper width. The printer (1) is provided with: a case (10) for accommodating the roll paper; a pair of guides (40) provided in the case (10) and configured to be movable in the width direction of the web, respectively, the guides being separated from each other in the width direction so as to hold the web therebetween; sensors (121-124) that detect the positions of the pair of guides (40); and a processor that determines the width of the web based on the detection results of the sensors (121-124).

title_en: Preparation method of composite material with porous coating and porous coating cloth
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a composite material with a porous coating and porous coating cloth, and relates to the technical field of porous composite materials. A method of making a composite material having a porous coating, comprising: applying the aqueous coating slurry to the surface of a substrate, drying for the first time, and soaking in water for a certain time to obtain a pre-expansion coating; the aqueous coating slurry contains 1-25% of water-absorbent resin particles by weight of the aqueous coating slurry; and removing the expanded water-absorbent resin particles in the pre-expansion coating layer, and drying for the second time to obtain the composite material with the porous coating layer. The invention can obtain composite materials with different gas bubble forms and sizes through a simple preparation method.

title_en: Monochromatic thermosensitive erasable paper and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a single-color thermosensitive erasable paper and a preparation method thereof, wherein the single-color thermosensitive erasable paper comprises a protective layer, a thermosensitive coating and a base material which are arranged from top to bottom, and the protective layer comprises the following components in parts by weight: 30-85 parts of thermosetting epoxy resin I, 3-10 parts of curing agent I, 3-8 parts of thermoplastic polyester I, 3-10 parts of lubricant and 10-20 parts of heat conduction auxiliary agent; the thermosensitive coating comprises the following components in parts by weight: 25-100 parts of thermosetting epoxy resin II, 3-10 parts of curing agent II, 3-8 parts of thermoplastic polyester II, 25-40 parts of dye, 20-100 parts of color developing agent and 5-10 parts of filler. According to the invention, the heat-sensitive single-color erasable paper has improved resistance, erasing times and bending resistance through the mixing and synergy of the thermosetting epoxy resin and the thermoplastic resin.

title_en: Recyclable single-component polyester ecological foot pad and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of automobile carpet materials, in particular to a recyclable single-component polyester ecological foot pad and a preparation method thereof, wherein the foot pad at least comprises seven layers of structures, a first layer is PET yarns made of recycled PET materials, a second layer is PET non-woven base cloth, the PET yarns of the first layer are fixed on the PET non-woven base cloth of the second layer through a tufting process, the third layer is PET latex, the fourth layer is PET polyester powder, the fifth layer is PET non-woven fabric middle layer, the sixth layer is PET polyester powder, and the seventh layer is short fiber needled non-woven fabric or fire-burned bottom. The recyclable single-component polyester ecological foot pad disclosed by the invention has the main components of PET, is single in component, is very convenient to recycle, reduces the treatment pressure of waste foot pad products, and is more beneficial to environmental protection.

title_en: Fabric steam treatment device
abstract_en: The invention provides a fabric steam treatment device, which relates to the technical field of structures of quilt cloth processing and winding treatment devices, and comprises a bearing base, a bearing support plate, a bearing side plate, a recovery scraping frame, a shielding bearing frame and a bearing side column; the steam treatment device comprises a bearing base, a bearing support plate, a recovery scraping frame, a shielding support frame, a bearing side column, a supporting box and a positioning support shaft, wherein the bearing support frame is arranged at the bottom of the bearing base, the bearing support plate is arranged at one side of the top of the bearing base, a bearing support groove is formed in the side face of the bearing side plate, the recovery scraping frame is arranged at the side face of the bearing side plate, the shielding support frame is arranged between the bearing support plate and the bearing side plate, the bearing side column is arranged at the side face of the bearing support plate, the surface of a fabric is adsorbed and cleaned through the electrostatic action of an adsorption support shaft, sundries are pushed by a pushing screw to be collected at the inner side of a bearing box, the positioning support shaft positions and supports the steam treated fabric at the inner side of the constant-temperature support frame, and the problems that most steam treatment devices cannot pretreat produced fabrics, and most of the steam treated fabrics are directly exposed to environments with large temperature differences are solved.

title_en: Large-cell high-strength aramid honeycomb core and preparation method and preparation mold thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large-cell high-strength aramid honeycomb core, a preparation method and a preparation mould thereof, wherein the aramid honeycomb core comprises a plurality of layers of aramid thick paper with mutually-alternated upper and lower surfaces and equidistant hot-melt bonding together, A plurality of through hole lattices with regular hexagons in cross section are formed between two adjacent layers of aramid thick paper at intervals, and the aramid thick paper is prepared by a specific preparation mould and a specific preparation method. The invention can carry out honeycomb Kong Geceng compression molding on high-quantitative aramid paper, further can prepare a honeycomb core with large cell size, regular cell size, stable structure and cell wall thickness, so as to improve the mechanical properties of the honeycomb core such as compressive strength, shearing strength and the like, has high bonding strength between papers and good thermal stability, does not generate the defects of cell cracking, deformation and the like, and has the advantage of environmental protection in the production process.

title_en: Stamp forming apparatus
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of printing, and provides a mark forming device. The invention provides an imprint forming device which comprises a printer and a stamp, wherein the stamp can print on a printing carrier to form a first imprint, the stamp is connected with the printer and provided with a stamping end, the stamping end is provided with a printing text, and the stamping end can be abutted against the printing carrier to form a second imprint. The invention provides a mark forming device which is used for solving the technical problem that the mark forming efficiency is low when ink of the mark forming device in the prior art is exhausted.

title_en: Photovoltaic solar printer
abstract_en: The invention provides a photovoltaic solar printer which comprises a printing table, supporting legs, fixed connecting seats, connecting rods, a workbench, limiting blocks, a conversion groove, a first corresponding bucket, a motor, a printing tube structure, a rotatable printing seat replacement structure, a shielding preheating protective shell structure and a collectable buffering protective seat structure, wherein the supporting legs are respectively fixed at four corners of the bottom end of the printing table through bolts, the fixed connecting seats are fixed at the upper part of the left side of the printing table through bolts, and the connecting rods are connected between the fixed connecting seats through pin shafts. The printing seat, the printing groove, the protective shell, the supporting seat, the heating seat, the fixing seat and the heating pipe are mutually matched, so that the printing seat is beneficial to passing through the upper end of the fixing seat in the using process, then the heating pipe is controlled to work, the fixing seat and the workpiece in the heating pipe are heated, the workpiece preheating work is conveniently carried out in work, and the printing effect is improved.

title_en: Preparation method of electron beam grafted antibacterial cotton textile
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of an electron beam grafted antibacterial cotton fabric, which comprises the steps of putting the fabric into an antibacterial working solution, taking out and rolling after dipping, sealing the fabric, grafting by electron beam irradiation and the like. According to the invention, the textile is finished by adopting the antibacterial agent containing unsaturated double bond groups, and the grafting polymerization is promoted by using electron beam radiation, and the high-energy electron beam generated by an electron accelerator can ionize, excite and generate free radicals to cause intermolecular crosslinking and degradation, so that the double bond activity in the antibacterial agent containing unsaturated double bond groups is strong, the electron beam is easy to cause chemical reaction with hydroxyl groups of cellulose, and the antibacterial effect of the textile is endowed, and the prepared antibacterial textile has excellent antibacterial performance. By adjusting the dosage of the antibacterial agent, the padding residual rate during padding, the irradiation dose of the electron beam and other parameters, the staphylococcus aureus and the escherichia coli can be inactivated by 100 percent, and the lower irradiation dose can not influence the performances of the fabric such as color, strength, whiteness and the like.

title_en: Production line and process of vulcanized fiber base paper with high peel strength for electrical insulation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of insulating paper, and particularly relates to a high-peel-strength vulcanized fiber base paper production line and process for electric insulation, comprising a frame, a crushing device, a material boiling device, a pulp washing device, a water filtering device, a drying device and a forming device which are positioned on the frame, wherein an interweaving device is further arranged between the water filtering device and the drying device, the interweaving device comprises a driving mechanism and a needle insertion assembly, the needle insertion assembly has a movement amount which moves up and down in a reciprocating manner towards a conveying belt by virtue of the driving mechanism, and part of transverse fibers of paper pulp on the surface of the conveying belt change direction by virtue of the pressing of the needle insertion assembly and form staggered crisscross with other transverse fibers of the paper pulp. According to the invention, the interweaving device is additionally arranged, and the needle insertion assembly of the interweaving device is utilized to press part of the transverse fibers along the horizontal direction, so that the transverse fibers change direction to form longitudinal fibers along the vertical direction or inclined direction, and the longitudinal fibers and the transverse fibers form interweaving, thereby improving the peeling strength of the base paper.

title_en: Antibacterial and mildew-proof environment-friendly water-based paint and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an antibacterial and mildew-proof environment-friendly water-based paint and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of water-based paint preparation. The antibacterial mildew-proof environment-friendly water-based paint comprises, by weight, 30-50 parts of acrylic resin, 2-4 parts of titanium dioxide, 1-3 parts of defoamer, 1.2-1.8 parts of flatting agent, 1-1.4 parts of dispersing agent, 1.1-1.7 parts of film-forming auxiliary agent, 8-12 parts of composite nanofiber, 1-5 parts of antibacterial mildew-proof agent and 70-80 parts of deionized water. The composite nanofiber and the antibacterial mildew preventive are added into the paint, so that the antibacterial mildew preventive and the environmental protection of the paint can be effectively improved, and the environment protection performance of the paint can be effectively improved by using deionized water.

title_en: Propeller blade or airfoil with hollow composite root
abstract_en: The invention relates to a propeller blade or airfoil (10) for a turboprop engine, which propeller blade or airfoil is made of a composite material and comprises a matrix-densified fibre reinforcement, which propeller blade or airfoil comprises a root (12) and an aerodynamic profile (11) in spanwise direction (D  L ). The fiber reinforcement comprises a fiber preform with a three-dimensional weave, the fiber preform having a root preform portion present in a root (12) and an aerodynamic profile preform portion present in an aerodynamic profile (11), the root and the aerodynamic profile preform portions being connected to each other by a three-dimensional weave. The root preform portion of the fiber preform includes a split at the junction defining a shell inside the root, the shell forming a cavity (14) that opens at a free end (12 a) of the root (12).

title_en: Preparation method of high-modulus low-dielectric-constant bromine element modified PBO fiber
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of high polymer materials, and particularly provides a preparation method of a high-modulus low-dielectric-constant bromine element modified PBO fiber. With the high-temperature heat treatment in the process of preparing the high-modulus PBO fiber, the C-Br bond is broken, the bromine element leaves to cause the fiber to form nano-scale air holes, the method effectively solves the problem of excessive reduction of the mechanical property of the PBO fiber caused by overlarge foaming size or uneven foaming, realizes the reduction of the dielectric constant of the PBO fiber on the premise of ensuring the mechanical property of the PBO fiber to meet the application requirement, and greatly expands the application scene of the PBO fiber.

title_en: Antibacterial and warm-keeping composite fabric and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of thermal fabric, and particularly discloses an antibacterial thermal composite fabric and a preparation method thereof. The antibacterial thermal composite fabric comprises an outer layer fabric and a filler, wherein the outer layer fabric comprises nano silver composite cotton fibers and polyester fibers, and the filler comprises down, and the preparation method comprises the steps of mixing and spinning 70-75% of nano silver composite cotton fibers and 25-30% of polyester fibers to obtain a mixed yarn, preparing the mixed yarn into the outer layer fabric through a braiding machine, performing heat setting on the outer layer fabric after the mixed yarn is woven, tiling the outer layer fabric, uniformly distributing the filler on the outer layer fabric, tiling one layer of the outer layer fabric on the surface of the filler, and laminating the outer layer fabric in a hot-pressing mode to obtain the antibacterial thermal composite fabric. The antibacterial and warm-keeping composite fabric has the advantage of simultaneously meeting the double requirements of consumers on warm keeping and antibacterial performance of clothes.

title_en: Preparation method of piezoelectric self-sterilizing cotton fabric-based pressure sensor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a piezoelectric self-sterilizing cotton fabric-based pressure sensor, which specifically comprises the following steps of preparing a modified boron nitride nano sheet, preparing a modified boron nitride nano sheet/Ag-MOF 545 composite material, preparing a modified boron nitride nano sheet/Ag-MOF 545 cotton fabric-based piezoelectric material, and preparing a self-sterilizing cotton fabric-based piezoelectric pressure sensor, wherein the step of preparing the modified boron nitride nano sheet/Ag-MOF 545 cotton fabric-based piezoelectric material is carried out in a step of preparing the self-sterilizing cotton fabric-based piezoelectric pressure sensor. The piezoelectric self-sterilizing cotton fabric-based pressure sensor is based on piezoelectric polarization effect generated by piezoelectric materials, converts an external strain stimulation signal into a piezoelectric current signal to be output, utilizes the current signal to promote the bacterial cell surface to generate molecular electrolysis, and simultaneously, the electroporation effect generated by current can damage the integrity of a bacterial membrane and induce bacterial metabolism disorder.

title_en: Automatic carton nailing device for carton processing
abstract_en: The application discloses an automatic carton nailing device for carton processing, which relates to the technical field of carton processing and comprises a feeding mechanism, wherein the feeding mechanism comprises a frame body, an adjusting assembly and a feeding assembly, the adjusting assembly comprises an elastic belt, a first driving piece, a plurality of lifting pieces, a plurality of adjusting pieces and a plurality of second driving pieces, the lifting pieces are contacted with the elastic belt above the lifting pieces to enable the elastic belt to be convexly deformed, the feeding assembly comprises a feeding belt, a third driving piece, a main supporting plate, an auxiliary supporting plate, a feeding wheel and a fourth driving piece, a feeding space is formed between the main supporting plate and the auxiliary supporting plate, and a feeding port is formed between the main supporting plate and the auxiliary supporting plate, communicated with the feeding space and communicated with the conveying mechanism. The application can make the feeding of the paper board to be processed more convenient and faster, and can effectively improve the feeding quality of the paper board to be processed, thereby effectively improving the quality of the paper board after the subsequent processing.

title_en: Bio-based polyurethane waterproof finishing agent and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bio-based aqueous polyurethane waterproof finishing agent and a preparation method and application thereof, and the preparation method comprises the following steps of (1) reacting bio-based isocyanate with bio-based polyol under the action of a catalyst, adding a dye and a bio-based chain extender after the reaction is finished, continuing the chain extension reaction, adding a diluent and a blocking agent after the reaction is finished, and performing semi-blocking reaction to obtain a semi-blocked isocyanate intermediate, (2) adding a hydrophobic modified monomer and an initiator into a reaction system of the step (1), adding the blocking agent after the polymerization reaction is finished for blocking reaction, cooling after the reaction is finished, adding a neutralizing agent, removing the diluent after the neutralization reaction is finished, and finishing the bio-based aqueous polyurethane waterproof finishing agent on textiles, wherein the finished textiles are soft in hand feeling and good in air permeability. The waterproof finishing agent not only can be used for waterproof finishing of textiles, but also can be used for waterproof finishing of the fields of umbrellas, tents, vehicle paint, walls and the like.

title_en: Preparation method of hollow microsphere silicon carbide composite wave-absorbing material
abstract_en: The application relates to a preparation method of a hollow microsphere silicon carbide composite wave-absorbing material. The phenolic resin wrapped in the first compound is carbonized to form a hollow structure of the silica/carbon hollow microsphere, the hollow structure is favorable for reducing impedance mismatch, improving the wave absorbing performance of the composite wave absorbing material, and increasing the propagation path of electromagnetic waves due to multiple scattering and reflection of magnetic waves in the microsphere. The first powder is carbonized for the second time to form the hollow microsphere SiC/C/CNF composite wave-absorbing material, and the first carbon layer and the second carbon layer are combined with silicon carbide to introduce more loss mechanisms, so that energy loss modes in the wave-absorbing process are enriched. The carbon nanofiber layer is formed after bacterial cellulose is carbonized and distributed on the outermost layer of the hollow microsphere silicon carbide composite wave-absorbing material, the pores and fibers of the carbon nanofiber layer can effectively capture incident electromagnetic waves, the carbon nanofiber layer can increase impedance matching with air, reflection of electromagnetic waves is reduced, and more electromagnetic waves can enter the composite wave-absorbing material to be lost.

title_en: Online upgrading method of intelligent regulation and control system for noil gauge of comber
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of online upgrading and updating, in particular to an online upgrading method of a noil gauge intelligent regulation system of a comber, which realizes the efficient online upgrading of the system through three steps of module operation analysis, video identification and algorithm adaptation evaluation and algorithm version inquiry and upgrading. Firstly, based on the operation state of a historical monitoring parameter analysis functional module, accurately identifying an offset module, downloading a corresponding update file, and completing dynamic update of the offset module according to the real-time state, secondly, acquiring a raw material video and a combing video in real time, extracting current raw material parameters and combing quality parameters by utilizing image analysis, comparing the current raw material parameters and the combing quality parameters with the application range of an intelligent regulation algorithm, evaluating algorithm suitability and generating an upgrade prompt, and finally, inquiring a remote server to acquire a high-version intelligent regulation algorithm list and executing algorithm upgrade according to working condition requirements. The method improves the accuracy and stability of online upgrade of the system, and ensures the efficient operation and quality optimization of the combing process.

title_en: Carton forming machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a carton forming machine, which is characterized in that a longitudinal paperboard pressing mechanism, a transverse paperboard pressing mechanism and a paperboard punching mechanism are sequentially arranged on a transfer platform according to the conveying direction of a paperboard, a cutter comb is used for replacing a supporting component of the conventional conveying shaft when the paperboard is longitudinally pressed, an open slot is arranged below the transverse pressing position, so that a transverse pressing blade presses the paperboard towards the open slot in the moving process, the corresponding position of the paperboard is bent into a line towards the open slot to realize the transverse pressing work of the paperboard, and a paper pressing wheel is kept to be matched with a roller through a spring to press the paperboard in the punching process, so that the problem that the paperboard is attached to a punching die and rises along with the punching die is effectively solved.

title_en: Gaseous phase antirust paper coating device
abstract_en: The application relates to a gas-phase rust-proof paper coating device which comprises a main body, a plurality of conveying rollers and a coating mechanism, wherein the conveying rollers are arranged in a plurality, the conveying rollers are all rotatably arranged on the main body, the coating mechanism is arranged on the main body, the gas-phase rust-proof paper coating device further comprises a tensioning mechanism, the tensioning mechanism comprises a moving block, a tensioning roller and a moving assembly, the moving block is slidably arranged on the main body through the moving assembly, and the tensioning roller is rotatably arranged on the moving block. The application has the effect of ensuring the final quality of the product.

title_en: Cartridge and liquid ejection apparatus
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a cartridge and a liquid ejection apparatus. The cartridge includes a housing including a storage portion for storing a liquid and a flow path communicating with the storage portion, an element substrate including a jetting port which communicates with the storage portion via the flow path and which jets the liquid contained in the storage portion, and an electrical wiring substrate electrically connected to the element substrate. The housing has a surface to which the element substrate and the electric wiring substrate are fixed. The slit is provided in at least one long side of the outer periphery of the surface as seen in a direction perpendicular to the surface.

title_en: Gold stamping stained paper silk-screen transfer printing device and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of gilding stained paper transfer, in particular to a gilding stained paper silk-screen transfer device and a gilding stained paper silk-screen transfer method, the gilding stained paper silk-screen transfer device comprises a bottom plate, a support plate and two fixing plates are fixedly arranged on the surface of the upper end of the bottom plate, a winding roller and two guide rollers are rotationally connected between the two fixing plates, an air cylinder is arranged at the top end inside the support plate, a transfer plate is fixedly connected at the bottom end of the air cylinder, a plurality of heating rods are arranged inside the transfer plate, gilding paper is wound outside the winding roller, the invention can well smooth the upper surface and the lower surface of the stamping paper through the smoothing mechanism, avoid folds to influence the subsequent transfer operation, and accelerate the air flow of the surface of a transferred target object and accelerate the temperature reduction of the target object and improve the efficiency of printing work through the setting of the auxiliary mechanism during the smoothing operation.

title_en: Process system for applying a process to a workpiece and method for applying a process to a workpiece
abstract_en: The invention proposes a process system 1 for printing on a workpiece 2, comprising a process device 3 for printing the workpiece 2 in a process region 4 in a feed direction V, a relative positioning device 7 for relative positioning of the workpiece 2 and the process device 3 in a transverse direction Q, and a feed device 5 for feeding the workpiece 2 to the process device 3, wherein the feed device 5 is designed to feed the workpiece 2 to the process device 3a plurality of times along at least one circulation path 6 in a cyclic operation.

title_en: Degradable electrostatic spinning slow-release antibacterial fiber membrane and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a degradable electrostatic spinning slow-release antibacterial fiber membrane, and a preparation method and application thereof. The degradable electrostatic spinning slow-release antibacterial fiber membrane disclosed by the invention takes a non-woven fabric layer as a supporting layer and an active film layer arranged on the surface of the supporting layer, wherein the active film layer is prepared by carrying out electrostatic spinning on a mixture of slow-release rosemary extract and a high-molecular polymer. According to the invention, through reasonable design of a material formula, an electrostatic spinning process and a laminated composite structure, the fiber membrane can continuously and stably release antibacterial substances, inhibit growth and reproduction of microorganisms on the surfaces of fruits and vegetables, and reduce respiration intensity and water loss of the fruits and vegetables, so that the shelf life of the fruits and vegetables is remarkably prolonged, and an innovative and efficient solution is provided for fresh-keeping packaging of the fruits and vegetables.

title_en: Intelligent broom hair implantation equipment
