abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of broom processing, in particular to intelligent broom hair implantation equipment which comprises a broom planting machine body, a processing table and a feeding assembly, wherein the feeding assembly comprises a rotating seat, a turnover member, a placing seat, a storage bin, a lifting seat, a supporting rod, a limiting seat and a spring, the rotating seat is driven to rotate by a rotating motor so as to drive the turnover member and the placing seat to rotate, the turnover member drives the placing seat to turn over in the rotating process of the rotating seat, a broom head processed in the placing seat can fall under the action of gravity at the moment, after an inclined plane on the placing seat is abutted with the supporting rod, the supporting rod is lifted under the action of the inclined plane on the placing seat so as to drive the lifting seat to lift, the limiting seat is driven to move, and the limiting seat is retracted at the moment so as to enable the broom head in the storage bin to fall into a placing groove in the placing seat, and the aim of automatically feeding and discharging broom heads is achieved.

title_en: Portable compressed cotton soft towel and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable compressed cotton soft towel and a manufacturing method thereof, and relates to the technical field of daily necessities. The surface structure of cotton soft towel is equipped with draws the hole, draws the structure through drawing the hole connection, and accessible draws the play water of structure control water storage structure, and then wets cotton soft towel skin. The partition structure arranged on one side of the cotton soft towel is used for isolating the wet area from the dry area, so that the dry-wet separation is realized, and the cotton soft towel has the dry-wet dual-purpose function. The cotton soft towel outer layer is made of fiber and chemical additive, and has excellent softness, water absorption and antibacterial effect. The manufacturing method comprises the steps of raw material preparation, mixing and opening, needling and strengthening, after-finishing and the like, and the final finished product is suitable for the environment such as the outdoor environment, the traveling environment and the like.

title_en: Code spraying device, control method and control device thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a code spraying device, a control method and a control device thereof. The code spraying device comprises a code spraying shell, a cover body, a displacement driving assembly, a code spraying vehicle assembly and a controller, wherein a cover opening induction piece is arranged at the edge of an opening of the code spraying shell, the cover body comprises a trigger piece, the cover body is in a cover opening state, the cover body exposes the opening, the trigger piece enables the cover opening induction piece to generate a cover opening induction signal, the displacement driving assembly can drive the code spraying vehicle assembly to move along a first direction, the controller is configured to control the displacement driving assembly to drive the code spraying vehicle assembly to move and control the code spraying vehicle assembly to spray codes after receiving printing task information so as to perform printing operation, and after the cover opening induction signal is received, the code spraying vehicle assembly is controlled to stop code spraying and control the displacement driving assembly to drive the code spraying vehicle assembly to move to a first preset position so as to stop printing operation. According to the code spraying device provided by the embodiment of the application, potential safety hazards can be eliminated after the cover body is opened.

title_en: High-strength and conductive heterocyclic aramid composite fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-strength and conductive heterocyclic aramid composite fiber and a preparation method thereof. According to the invention, single-layer Graphene Oxide (GO) with the size of 2-5um, which accounts for 1-5% of the mass fraction of the heterocyclic aramid fiber, is added into the heterocyclic aramid fiber spinning solution, and the heterocyclic aramid fiber spinning solution with uniformly distributed GO is prepared by stirring. And (3) carrying out wet spinning after defoaming the spinning solution. In the heat treatment process, nitrogen atmosphere is adopted, and graphene oxide in the fiber is reduced into reduced graphene oxide through heat treatment, so that the aramid fiber is endowed with conductivity. The graphene heterocyclic aramid composite fiber prepared by the method has the strength of 5.75GPa, the elongation at break of 3.68%, the resistivity of 0.5 omega m and the conductivity of 2.0S/m. The graphene heterocyclic aramid composite fiber has good heat resistance. After being treated for 24 hours at 200 ℃, the strength of the graphene heterocyclic aramid composite fiber is reduced from 5.75GPa to 4.19GPa by only 27 percent.

title_en: Elastic fiber with high conductivity and insensitive strain as well as preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an elastic fiber which is high in conductivity and insensitive to strain, and a preparation method and application thereof. The fiber prepared by the method has higher conductivity, is insensitive to mechanical strain, and has good application prospect in the flexible wearable field.

title_en: Yarn reducing method for three-dimensional woven fabric
abstract_en: The invention discloses a yarn reducing method of a three-dimensional woven fabric, which comprises the steps of taking a yarn reducing unit as a reference in a three-dimensional four-step weaving process, wherein the yarn reducing unit comprises two rows of odd yarn ingots and two rows of even yarn ingots which are adjacently arranged after 0-4 standard cycles, and yarn reducing operation is carried out on yarn reducing points in the yarn reducing unit in a dispersed state in 0-4 standard cycles, and yarn doubling operation is carried out in an aggregation state. The method has extremely high designability, can ensure the continuity and structural integrity of the three-dimensional fabric, can realize the whole weaving manufacture of the three-dimensional weaving and line-reducing or layer-reducing complex-surface fabric, skillfully utilizes the spindle motion rule of a three-dimensional four-step method, disperses yarn reducing points along with the increase of weaving circulation, then carries out yarn reducing operation, and eliminates the defects caused by concentrated yarn reducing points, thereby ensuring the mechanical property of the composite material, and has simple operation, wide applicability and strong designability.

title_en: Seat cover crease-resistant sewing device and sewing method
abstract_en: The application discloses a seat cover crease-resistant sewing device and a sewing method, and relates to the technical field of sewing, wherein the seat cover crease-resistant sewing device comprises a workbench, a sewing machine, a first supporting plate, a stretching plate, a driving assembly, a first limiting assembly, a second supporting plate, a mounting plate, a clamping assembly, a smoothing assembly and a compacting plate; the sewing machine is fixedly arranged at one end of one side of the top of the workbench, the first supporting plate is vertically and fixedly arranged at the middle position of the other end of the top of the workbench, the first sliding grooves are formed in the other end of the other side of the top of the workbench and the middle position of the other end of the other side of the top of the workbench, the two ends of the bottom of the stretching plate are respectively and slidably arranged with the inner walls of the bottoms of the two sliding grooves through the sliding components, the stretching plate is arranged in parallel with the first supporting plate, and the driving component is arranged between the first supporting plate and the stretching plate.

title_en: Cutting and ironing device with protection function for natural cotton blending processing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cutting ironing device with a protection function for natural cotton blending processing, which comprises a base, a first material conveying pipe, a laser cutting mechanism and a first conveying belt, wherein a cotton blending batting processing assembly, a second conveying roller, an ironing box, an auxiliary fixing assembly, a cutting box and a second U-shaped supporting plate are fixed on the upper side of the base, the ironing box is positioned between the auxiliary fixing assemblies, a first moving mechanism is fixed on the upper side of the inner part of the ironing box, a manipulator is fixed on the upper side of the inner part of the second U-shaped supporting plate, a cleaning assembly is fixed on the right side of the base, and the first material conveying pipe is fixed on the left side of the cotton blending batting processing assembly.

title_en: Combined template for connecting and splicing elastic quilting lines and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a combined template for connecting and splicing elastic quilting lines, which comprises a first cover plate, a second cover plate, a first bottom plate and a second bottom plate, wherein the first cover plate and the second cover plate are arranged above the first bottom plate side by side, the second bottom plate is arranged on the side edge of the first bottom plate, the first cover plate is folded and covered on the first bottom plate along a first folding line along with the second cover plate, a plurality of through sewing channels are arranged at the corresponding positions of the first cover plate, the second cover plate and the first bottom plate, the first cover plate is folded and covered on the second cover plate along a second folding line, the second bottom plate is folded and covered on the first cover plate along a third folding line, a through tenth channel is arranged at the corresponding positions of the first cover plate, the second cover plate, the first bottom plate and the second bottom plate, and is used for simultaneously turning and tightening two cut pieces in a tightening manner, and an elastic fixing piece is further arranged for fixing the tightening degree. The invention can more efficiently and accurately realize the functions of sewing, adding and loosening the integrated thread and connecting the seam, and avoid the occurrence of sewing errors.

title_en: Non-woven fabrics clout cutting equipment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of cloth processing, in particular to non-woven fabric excess material cutting equipment, which comprises vertical cutting equipment, wherein butt joint equipment is arranged below the vertical cutting equipment, stacking equipment is arranged at the front part of the vertical cutting equipment, textile cloth pieces cut off each time can be stacked together by the stacking equipment, side cutting equipment is arranged at the back part of the vertical cutting equipment, and the side cutting equipment can cut off uneven parts of the side surfaces of non-woven fabrics. Before the device carries out vertical slicing to the cloth, can cut off the uneven side in cloth both sides through the slitting saw of inside both sides, cloth piece in middle part and the cloth strip of both sides are divided into to the cloth strip after cutting, because the cloth strip is lighter to do not contact with rotary drum guiding device, so when transporting the cloth piece of middle part, the cloth strip can be to butt joint equipment one side skew, can not be along with the cloth piece in middle part by the slicing equipment section of hanging down, and then play the effect of cutting optimization, guarantee that the side of every cloth is enough level and smooth, do not need subsequent finishing.

title_en: High-strength corrugated carton based on waterproof agent and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-strength corrugated case based on a waterproof agent and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of corrugated cases, wherein the preparation method comprises the following preparation steps of adding a mercaptan curing agent containing a dopamine structure into tetrahydrofuran, and uniformly stirring to obtain a curing agent solution; adding a waterproof agent into tetrahydrofuran, uniformly stirring to obtain a waterproof agent solution, coating a waterproof reinforcing agent on the surface of the corrugated paper box, coating a curing agent solution on a waterproof reinforcing agent layer, finally coating the waterproof agent solution on the curing agent solution layer, curing for 1-2h by ultraviolet irradiation, and drying at room temperature to obtain the waterproof agent-based high-strength corrugated paper box.

title_en: Sewing process without sticking lining
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of sewing technology, and particularly relates to a sewing technology without sticking a lining. The sewing process without sticking lining comprises the steps of cutting the nylon fabric with the content of less than or equal to 50% and the polyester fiber or the tectorial membrane fabric with the content of 40-100%, putting the front surfaces of the style fabric and the inner material with the same shape in a butt joint manner, sewing the front surfaces along the edges, checking whether the front surfaces and the back surfaces of the two layers of the sewn materials are flat, and making the flat clothing by the next procedure. The sewing process without sticking lining has the biggest characteristics that manual sticking cloth sticking production is omitted, only a layer of inner material is needed to be turned on the corresponding part by a machine, the modified part not only keeps the appearance tangible, but also does not influence the hand feeling of the ready-made clothes, and the wearing is milder and more comfortable.

title_en: Temperature-regulating heat-insulating material, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a temperature-regulating heat-insulating material, a preparation method and application thereof. The temperature-adjusting heat-insulating material comprises polyimide aerogel fibers, wherein the polyimide aerogel fibers contain microcapsules, and the microcapsules contain phase-change materials. Therefore, the temperature-regulating heat-insulating material not only has the characteristics of light weight, high strength, weather resistance and low heat conductivity of polyimide materials, but also realizes the dual functions of temperature regulation and heat insulation through the introduction of phase change materials.

title_en: Moisture-absorbing breathable chemical fiber fabric containing fine denier polyester filaments and production process thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fabrics and discloses a moisture-absorbing breathable chemical fiber fabric containing fine denier polyester filaments and a production process thereof, wherein the moisture-absorbing breathable chemical fiber fabric comprises the fine denier polyester filaments, moisture-absorbing fibers, antibacterial fibers, ultraviolet-resistant fibers, far infrared fibers and flame-retardant fibers, fine handfeel and good drapability can be given to the fabric through the fine denier polyester filaments, the moisture-absorbing capacity of the whole fabric can be enhanced through the moisture-absorbing fibers, the moisture-absorbing capacity of the whole fabric can be complemented with the advantages of the fine denier polyester filaments, the growth and reproduction of microorganisms such as bacteria and fungi can be inhibited through the antibacterial fibers, ultraviolet rays can be absorbed and reflected through the ultraviolet-resistant fibers, the damage of the ultraviolet rays to human skin can be effectively reduced, a warm effect can be generated through the far infrared limit, the flame spreading of flames can be prevented when a fire source is met, and the safety of a user is improved.

title_en: Preparation method of long-acting hydrophilic antistatic PET (polyethylene terephthalate) fiber
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a long-acting hydrophilic antistatic PET fiber, which adopts steps of electrostatic spinning, functional modification, coating and curing and the like to form a uniform and stable functional interface layer on the surface of the fiber, so as to obtain the long-acting hydrophilic antistatic PET fiber with high mechanical property. The invention adopts an electrostatic spinning process and a photo-crosslinking technology to prepare the crosslinked PET fiber, utilizes amino acid to carry out surface modification on the PET fiber, further constructs a stable functional interface layer through gelatin coating-crosslinking curing, and the prepared PET fiber has long-acting antistatic property and hydrophilicity, and simultaneously retains the high mechanical strength of the PET fiber.

title_en: Optimal control method and optimal control system for printer
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optimal control method and an optimal control system for a printer, and relates to the technical field of printer control. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a multi-core SOC, wherein the multi-core SOC comprises ARM11 and CORTEX M3, ARM11 is used for processing upper layers, CORTEX M3 is used for mechanical and electrical control of a bottom layer and comprises fixing control, motor control and laser control, obtaining printer application scene information, obtaining a printer scene control strategy according to the printer application scene information by adopting the multi-core SOC, and performing optimal printing control on a printer based on the printer scene control strategy. The technical problems that in the prior art, the printer is difficult to flexibly adjust the control strategy according to different application scenes, so that the printing efficiency and the printing quality are low are solved, the efficient control of the printer under various application scenes is realized through the multi-core SOC, and the control strategy is intelligently selected, so that the technical effect of improving the printing efficiency and the printing quality is achieved.

title_en: Far infrared carbon nanofiber membrane and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a far infrared carbon nanofiber membrane and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of carbon nanofiber membranes; the far infrared carbon nanofiber membrane is prepared by uniformly mixing and stirring modified carbon nanofibers and modified polytetrafluoroethylene according to a mass ratio, then carrying out jet milling, then carrying out high-speed rotary cutting fiberization after reheating, then uniformly spreading in a spreading device and carrying out hot roll forming, wherein the modified carbon nanofibers are prepared by reacting 3, 4-diaminobenzoic acid methyl ester with hydroxylated carbon nanofibers, the modified polytetrafluoroethylene is prepared by grafting and modifying pre-irradiation PTFE (polytetrafluoroethylene) with 4-allylbenzoic acid, and the carbon nanofibers in the far infrared carbon nanofiber membrane prepared by the invention are uniformly dispersed, have good conductivity, smaller current density difference under working voltage, more perfect current distribution and more uniform heating.

title_en: Modified cellulose acetate film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a modified cellulose acetate film and a preparation method thereof, and specifically relates to a method for preparing the modified cellulose acetate film by dissolving cellulose acetate in a solvent mixed by N, N-dimethylacetamide and acetone, adding 2-methylimidazole to form uniform and stable spinning precursor solution, and finally preparing the modified cellulose acetate film by an electrostatic spinning method. The fiber membrane prepared by the application has smooth fiber surface, uniform diameter distribution and good fiber morphology and porosity. The preparation process is simple and easy to implement, has controllable cost, has strong competitiveness in large-scale production and practical application, and is beneficial to popularization.

title_en: Nonwoven material for efficient low-resistance filtration and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-efficiency low-resistance non-woven material for filtration, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the high-efficiency low-resistance non-woven material for filtration is prepared by spunbonding composite fibers with a sheath-core structure, a sheath layer consists of, by mass, 11-49 parts of polyolefin, 0.45-4 parts of electret master batch, 0.05-0.5 part of olefin tackifying resin, 0.05-0.5 part of master batch containing MOF (metal oxide fiber) materials, and a core layer consists of, by mass, 49-80 parts of polypropylene, 0.05-1 part of polypropylene transparent nucleating agent and 0.45-4 parts of electret master batch. The invention adopts composite fiber, adds olefin tackifying resin, can increase the adhesiveness of the cortex and improve the strength of the product, the MOF material provides uniformly distributed adsorption sites, optimizes the micro-pore structure of the fiber, and adds the polypropylene transparent nucleating agent to increase the rigidity of the polypropylene material, thereby being beneficial to the processing and the folding of the product, further increasing the adsorption and interception effects of the nonwoven filter material on the particulate matters due to the electret static effect, reducing the dynamic collision between air flow and the particulate matters and further reducing the air flow resistance.

title_en: Automatic fixed-length cutting equipment for clothing processing
abstract_en: The invention relates to automatic sizing cutting equipment for clothing processing, and belongs to the technical field of clothing processing equipment. The automatic fixed-length cutting device for clothing processing comprises a frame, a mesh belt type conveying belt, a central controller and a numerical control machine head, wherein the mesh belt type conveying belt and the central controller are respectively arranged on the inner side and the outer side of the frame, the numerical control machine head is arranged above the frame, a cooling mechanism is arranged on the surface of the frame, the cooling mechanism comprises a displacement mechanism arranged inside the frame, the numerical control machine head is fixedly connected to the surface of the displacement mechanism, a heat radiation fan is fixedly connected to the surface of the displacement mechanism, and heat radiation air flow is guided into fabric cutting openings in a mode of synchronous air blowing and air suction, so that effective heat radiation can be carried out on friction positions of vibration knives and fabrics, and the problem that the conventional numerical control cutting machine is difficult to effectively cool the continuously running vibration knives, and normal cutting of the fabrics is affected is solved.

title_en: High-precision color separation model of color self-adaptive coding multicolor printer
abstract_en: The application discloses a high-precision color separation model of a color self-adaptive coding multicolor printer, which is characterized in that a multi-color item fitting method is adopted in each sub-color gamut to build a color separation model of each partition, and the optimization treatment of the model is carried out by improving the color mixing local replacement, the color mixing replacement and the shallow ink replacement on the basis. Firstly, a sampling sample is established in each sub-color area of a multicolor printer, a three-color separation model of each subarea is established by adopting a multi-color item fitting method, secondly, a medium color mixing partial replacement relation and a color mixing replacement relation are established based on an establishing method of an ash balance equation, a medium color mixing partial replacement equation and a color mixing replacement equation are adopted for color separation results of each subarea to further separate colors, a model is optimized, thirdly, a critical domain relation between shallow ink and deep ink is established, when the using amount of the deep ink is lower than a critical value, the shallow ink is used for replacement printing, and when the using amount of the deep ink is higher than a critical domain, the deep ink is directly used, so that better and finer color separation effects are obtained.

title_en: Carbon ceramic brake disc with ventilation duct having coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a carbon ceramic brake disc with a coating on a ventilation duct, which comprises an upper friction layer, an upper long fiber area, a core area, a lower long fiber area and a lower friction layer, wherein the upper long fiber area and the lower long fiber area are respectively arranged at two ends of the core area, the upper friction layer is arranged at the other end of the upper long fiber area, the lower friction layer is arranged at the other end of the lower long fiber area, the core area is provided with a plurality of ventilation ducts which are circumferentially distributed, the surface of each ventilation duct is provided with an inner coating, and the heat conductivity of the core area is respectively greater than or equal to the heat conductivity of the upper long fiber area and the heat conductivity of the lower long fiber area.

title_en: Sole cooling equipment for sports shoe production
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of sole cooling, and provides sole cooling equipment for producing sports shoes, which comprises a workbench, wherein the sports shoes are placed in a placing groove, a driving gear set is started to drive a chain to convey a placing box, the placing box drives a guide frame and the sports shoes to move, the guide frame drives a fixed cylinder to move to extrude the lower left corner of a cooling box, the fixed cylinder is pressed to drive a limit sliding block to slide along the track of a third sliding groove and extrude a second spring, when the fixed cylinder is extruded to the tail end of the third sliding groove to be flush with the first sliding groove and enter the first sliding groove, at the moment, the fixed cylinder slides in the first sliding groove, and the fixed cylinder drives a clamping plate to press the sports shoes during the sliding process, so that the shoes are fixed, swing dumping is avoided during transportation, the adhesiveness between shoe uppers and soles is increased, the stability of the sports shoes can be increased through the placing box, and air can be blown in a side direction through the arrangement of a through hole, and the cooling is accelerated.

title_en: Automatic reversing gear mechanism and double-sided printing method
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic reversing gear mechanism which comprises a supporting base body, an input gear, a transmission gear, a first planetary gear set, a second planetary gear set and a switching control part, wherein the input gear, the transmission gear, the first planetary gear set, the second planetary gear set and the transmission gear are connected to the supporting base body, the input gear is meshed with the first planetary gear set, and the first planetary gear set, the second planetary gear set and the transmission gear are meshed with each other. The invention also provides a double-sided printing method, which is used for driving the input gear to perform steering movement, wherein in a first state, the switching control part is locked with the sun gear of the first planetary gear set to drive the transmission gear to rotate along a first direction, and in a second state, the switching control part is locked with the sun gear of the second planetary gear set to drive the transmission gear to rotate along a second direction, and the first direction is opposite to the second direction. The invention has the advantages that the automatic switching of the rotation direction of the output end gear can be realized under the condition of not changing the original main transmission form, the occupied space of the structure is small, and the applicability is wide.

title_en: Automatic lettering line
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic printing line which comprises a roller way mechanism and a printing device, wherein the roller way mechanism comprises a plurality of roller way assemblies distributed along a first direction, the roller way assemblies are used for placing and conveying pipes along the first direction, the printing device is used for printing the pipes, each roller way assembly comprises a flexible roller and at least two first elastic pieces, the two first elastic pieces are respectively abutted to the lower sides of two ends of the flexible roller, the pipes are placed on the flexible rollers, the first elastic pieces give upward elasticity to the flexible rollers, and the printing device can prevent the pipes from jumping through the elasticity of the first elastic pieces while printing the pipes. The invention can ensure that the pipes are on the same horizontal plane, prevent the pipes from rotating, ensure that the printing on the pipes is clear, and ensure that the printed characters are on the same straight line.

title_en: Method for manufacturing concrete surface image
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for manufacturing a concrete surface image, which relates to the technical field of concrete surface image manufacturing and comprises the following specific steps of firstly preparing waterproof spray printing media, secondly preparing cement failure printing ink, grinding pigment and cement failure agent by a sand mill, heating a raw material formula to 60 ℃ and stirring for mixing and filtering, thirdly placing the printing media and the special ink for cement failure in a spray printer to spray-print a mirror image, fourthly, flatly paving the spray-printed media image upwards on a platform, adding a mould frame, pouring special concrete, adding glass fiber grids or metal meshes for reinforcement, and after solidification, flushing the failure cement by a water gun to reveal the color of the underlying aggregate. The manufacturing method fundamentally solves the cost problem, greatly reduces the production cost, has high jet printing speed, can be dried immediately after being printed, adopts sand and stone aggregate, and has the weather resistance as long as the service life of a building.

title_en: Carton slotting, die-cutting and stacking machine with waste removing function
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of carton production, in particular to a carton slotting, die-cutting and stacking machine with a waste removing function, which comprises a conveyor base, slotting equipment modules and die-cutting equipment modules, wherein a plurality of conveying rollers are arranged in the conveyor base, the slotting equipment module and the die cutting equipment module are both arranged on the conveyor base, the slotting equipment module is positioned on the front side of the die cutting equipment module, waste cleaning cylinder seats are arranged on the rear sides of the slotting equipment module and the die cutting equipment module, and the waste cleaning cylinder seats are fixedly arranged on the conveyor base. The automatic waste clearing function is realized through the efficient waste clearing cylinder seat, the cleaning auger and the high-pressure air flow system, so that waste materials of the paper board in the slotting and die cutting processes are cleared in time, the upper surface and the lower surface of the paper board are kept clean and tidy, the automatic waste clearing design effectively avoids waste material accumulation, the precision of equipment and the cleanliness of the paper board are ensured, the manual intervention is reduced, and the production efficiency and the product quality of the paper box are improved.

title_en: High-precision cold-stamping one-piece flow printing process
abstract_en: A high-precision cold-stamping one-piece flow printing process comprises the following steps of S1, coating UV glue on the surface of a printing stock in an ink-jet printing mode, S3, pre-curing by low-energy UV after coating, forming a semi-cured glue layer, S4, bonding a cold-stamping film with the UV glue through an air cushion type laminating roller, then carrying out UV full curing, stripping the cold-stamping film after curing, and reserving a pattern on the printing stock, S5, carrying out color ink overprinting on the hot-stamped pattern to obtain a printing stock, and S6, carrying out on-line detection and slitting on the printing stock. The high-precision cold stamping one-piece flow printing process disclosed by the invention is completed in a whole process on line, step operation is not needed, the production efficiency can be obviously improved, micron-sized pattern control can be realized by adopting ink-jet coating glue, complex patterns are supported, the utilization rate of the glue is higher, the cold stamping film is only partially transferred, the waste film rate is reduced, no ozone is generated by adopting LED-UV curing, the environment is protected, and the energy consumption is smaller.

title_en: Efficient energy-saving dyeing device and process for polyester yarns
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-efficiency energy-saving dyeing device and process for polyester yarns, comprising a dyeing box, a cleaning mechanism and a drying mechanism, wherein the dyeing box is divided into three parts by a partition plate, garbage collection areas are arranged on two sides of the dyeing box, the middle position of the dyeing box is a dyeing area, the cleaning mechanism is used for sweeping dust and absorbing dust on two sides of undyed polyester yarns so as to ensure the dyeing effect of the polyester yarns, and the drying mechanism comprises an air heater and an air pipe and is used for rapidly drying the dyed polyester yarns. According to the high-efficiency energy-saving dyeing device and process for polyester yarns, the heating pipe and the hot air pipe are arranged in the dyeing mechanism, the heating pipe can heat dye liquor, so that dyeing is convenient to quickly and uniformly perform, the heat-conducting metal sheet can uniformly heat dyeing, in addition, hot air can enter the dye liquor through the arrangement of the hot air pipe, the contact area between dye and fiber is increased through bubble attachment, and dyeing uniformity is better.

title_en: Handling robot for moving yarn bobbins of texturing machines
abstract_en: Handling robot for moving bobbins (B) of yarn wound on tubes (5) to feed creels (C) of a texturing machine, comprising a car AGV carrying a bobbin store (1), the store (1) being mounted on a car and equipped with vertical rails (3) for handling devices (2), the handling devices (2) being equipped with gripping members (4) for transferring one or more bobbins (B) or empty tubes (5) between the creels (C) and the car store (1).

title_en: Efficient moisture-absorbing sweat-releasing knitted fabric and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of knitted fabrics, in particular to a high-efficiency moisture-absorbing sweat-releasing knitted fabric and a preparation method thereof, and the high-efficiency moisture-absorbing sweat-releasing knitted fabric comprises the following steps of weighing raw materials according to parts by weight, weighing 15-25 parts of cotton fibers, 30-40 parts of modal fibers and 30-35 parts of Coolmax fibers, and weaving blended yarns by using a 30-inch and 30-needle mode to obtain a woven fabric. According to the knitted fabric, cotton fibers and modal fibers are subjected to high Wen Dingpei and blending treatment in combination with Coolmax fibers, and then subjected to ultrasonic high-pressure immersion treatment in combination with finishing modification liquid, and the moisture absorption and sweat release properties, the antistatic property and the anti-fouling property of the knitted fabric are improved through the blending optimization among the raw materials, so that the performance balance coordination is realized, and meanwhile, the weather resistance and the water washing resistance stability of the product are remarkable.

title_en: Automatic production line of woven bags
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of woven bag production, in particular to an automatic production line of woven bags, which comprises a machine base, a rolling part and a cutting and flattening mechanism, wherein the rolling part is arranged on the machine base, can rotate around a first axis and is configured to roll a circular woven cloth base; the cutting flattening mechanism is arranged on the winding part, is configured to cut the circular fabric base wound by the winding part from inside to outside, and is configured to flatten and collect the cut circular fabric base. Therefore, on one hand, continuous transportation of the round woven fabric base can be realized, the frequency of manual intervention is reduced while the process is simplified, on the other hand, the round woven fabric base can be continuously cut and flattened for collection, the situations of skew, wrinkles and the like are reduced, further adverse effects on subsequent procedures such as carrying and sewing are reduced, and the production efficiency is ensured.

title_en: Double-machine-head continuous cutting equipment applied to leather production and working method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses double-machine-head continuous cutting equipment applied to leather production and a working method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of leather production. Be applied to continuous equipment of tailorring of duplex head of leather production, including tailorring the platform, all weld all around the top terminal surface of tailorring the platform has a piece, and the top terminal surface welding of piece has a standpipe, the top of tailorring the platform is equipped with the roof, and the bottom terminal surface of roof and the top one end welded fastening of standpipe, the smooth mouth has been seted up to one side outer wall of standpipe, the inside slidable mounting of standpipe has the slider, and the one end of slider runs through the smooth mouth, equal spiro union all around the top terminal surface of roof has the support, and the spiro union has first motor on the support. The invention effectively solves the problems that the existing design lacks a fixing component for leather when cutting leather, so that the leather is easy to displace or slide due to the cutting force of a cutter in the cutting process, and the cutting line is inaccurate or deviates from the design contour.

title_en: Spinning apparatus
abstract_en: The invention relates to a spinning device, which can well inhibit heat transfer to a plate-shaped member arranged below a heating box. The spinning device is provided with a heating box (6) on which a spinning unit having a yarn jet head is mounted, a plate-like member (23) fixed to the heating box, and a heat insulation structure (20) for suppressing heat transfer to the plate-like member (23). The heat insulation structure (20) comprises heat insulation materials (21, 22) arranged between the heating box body and the plate-shaped component (23), and a mounting component (40) for mounting the plate-shaped component (23) on the heating box body. The mounting member (40) has a1 st bolt (42) fixed to the heating box, a2 nd bolt (43) for fixing the plate-like member (23) at a position different from the 1 st bolt (42) in the horizontal direction, and a plate (41) disposed inside the heat insulating material (21, 22) for connecting the 1 st bolt (42) and the 2 nd bolt (43).

title_en: Filter manufacturing apparatus and control method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a filter manufacturing apparatus and a control method thereof. The filter manufacturing device comprises a spraying device which is arranged at a distance from a base body and stores solution therein, and a voltage device which applies voltage to the spraying device and discharges the solution stored in the spraying device to the base body, wherein the spraying device comprises a cylinder barrel which forms a space for storing the solution therein, a needle which is arranged at the lower side of the cylinder barrel and discharges the solution stored in the cylinder barrel to form nanofibers, and a vibration device which is arranged at one side of the needle and generates vibration to the needle.

title_en: Preparation process of anti-mosquito fabric and anti-mosquito fabric
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation process of a mosquito-proof fabric and the mosquito-proof fabric, which comprise the following preparation processes of S1, S2, preparation of a molecular nest for loading the active components of catnip, preparation of the molecular nest, loading of the active components of catnip in the molecular nest, S3, spinning, namely, mixing a fabric base material with the molecular nest for loading the active components of catnip, preparing yarns containing the active components of catnip through a spinning process, and spinning the yarns containing the active components of catnip into cloth to obtain the mosquito-proof fabric containing the active components of catnip. The fabric disclosed by the invention is environment-friendly and high in safety, has multiple effects of mosquito repelling, antibacterial, cool feeling and the like, ensures that the catmint active ingredient is kept stable in high-temperature and high-pressure and strong acid-alkali environments for yarn processing through loading catmint active ingredient in a molecular nest, prevents the catmint active ingredient from being deactivated, and ensures the durability and stability of the mosquito-repellent effect after the fabric is manufactured.

title_en: Method for spinning polyimide nascent fiber by dry method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for spinning polyimide nascent fiber by a dry method, which mainly comprises the following steps of mixing and stirring polyimide A solution and polyamic acid B solution to obtain spinning solution, extruding the spinning solution into a dry spinning channel by a spinneret plate through vacuum defoamation and filtration, and solidifying the spinning solution into polyimide nascent fiber under the conditions of flash evaporation and microwave auxiliary heating. The method ensures that the solvent is quickly and uniformly evaporated from inside to outside by a flash evaporation and microwave auxiliary heating method, avoids the skin-core structure and the cross section abnormal shape caused by the uneven diffusion of the solvent, can convert polyamide acid into polyimide to a higher degree under the microwave heating, reduces the proportion of complexing solvent in the fiber, and further reduces the solvent content in the fiber.

title_en: Preparation method of photo-thermal driving liquid metal microsphere-polymer shape memory fiber and infrared anti-counterfeiting application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a photo-thermal driving liquid metal microsphere-polymer shape memory fiber, which is characterized in that liquid metal microsphere LMP and waterborne polyurethane WPU are compounded to form coating slurry with photo-thermal response capability, and the coating slurry is uniformly coated on the surface of a thermoplastic polyurethane/polycaprolactone TPU/PCL shape memory fiber prepared by a wet spinning process to obtain the TPU-PCL/LMP-WPU composite fiber with photo-thermal response capability. The invention has the advantages that illumination or near infrared laser is applied as an activation source, non-contact heating is realized, and fiber deformation can be driven in a short time to finish anti-counterfeiting identification.

title_en: Intelligent production line for warp knitting mesh cloth
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of warp knitting mesh cloth production, in particular to an intelligent warp knitting mesh cloth production line. The technical problem to be solved by the invention is to provide the intelligent warp knitting mesh production line capable of realizing full-automatic pan head assembly and conveying of the warp beam, improving production efficiency, eliminating potential safety hazards of manual assembly and realizing efficient production of warp knitting mesh. The intelligent production line for the warp knitting mesh comprises a bobbin cradle for containing a large amount of cheeses, a warping machine is arranged on one side of the bobbin cradle, a warp knitting machine for warp knitting yarns is arranged on one side of the warping machine away from the bobbin cradle, and a pan head for mounting the pan head produced by the warping machine on a warp beam and conveying the assembled warp beam to upper-shaft conveying equipment for the warp knitting machine. The invention achieves the effects of realizing full-automatic pan head assembly and conveying of the warp beam, improving production efficiency, eliminating potential safety hazards of manual assembly and realizing efficient production of warp knitting mesh cloth.

title_en: Meta-toluidine compound, preparation method thereof and application of m-toluidine compound in thermosensitive color developing agent
abstract_en: The invention discloses a m-toluidine compound, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in a thermosensitive color developing agent, and relates to the technical field of color developing agents. A m-toluamide compound is . Compared with a comparison product, the whole activation temperature of the thermosensitive color developing agent prepared by the method disclosed by the invention has a trend of being reduced, the color developing reaction is easier to trigger, the color developing temperature range is widened, and the temperature differentiation requirements of more different application scenes can be met. The thermosensitive color developing agent prepared by using the m-toluamide compound has higher color developing contrast and more obvious color depth on the color developing effect, can present clearer and clearer color developing results, and is beneficial to improving the visual effect of thermosensitive color developing technology in scenes such as thermosensitive printing.

title_en: Wool blended fabric and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of wool blended fabric, and relates to the technical field of textile composite materials. The method comprises the steps of weaving a functional support bottom layer containing carbon fiber conductive wires through a water jet loom, preparing a wool blending surface layer through a rapier loom, selectively modifying the edges of scales through pretreatment liquid steam treatment containing hydrogen peroxide, chitosan and acetic acid, then implementing diamond grid array dispensing on the surface of a PU-based composite film, prefabricating through micropores, laminating the three layers, hot-pressing, compounding, quick cooling and solidifying, and finally carrying out zonal application of a fluorine-containing water repellent and high-voltage electric field treatment. According to the invention, scale ravines are covered by the chitosan cation film, hydrogen peroxide is used for targeted oxidation, the difference of forward and reverse friction of fibers is reduced radically, strong damage is avoided, and the dendritic anchoring network formed by capillary climbing is decoupled from the moisture permeable channel through the inclined diamond grid and the micropores by the point gluing structure, so that the technical bottleneck that the anchoring strength and the moisture permeable efficiency are difficult to be compatible in the traditional process is broken through.

title_en: Paper product forming machine with back suction pulp function and forming method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of paper products, in particular to a paper product forming machine with a back suction pulp function, which comprises a supporting frame, wherein the top of the supporting frame is fixedly connected with a shell, one side of the shell is fixedly connected with two fixing frames, one sides of the two fixing frames are fixedly connected with motors, the paper product forming processing is conveniently and continuously carried out through arranging a motor, a threaded rod and a driving assembly, the processing efficiency is increased, the paper product processing effect is better through arranging a pressing plate and a heating plate, the paper product is conveniently stored and used through arranging a limiting rod, a sliding sleeve, a placing frame and a handle, the paper product is conveniently stored and used through arranging a storage box, the processing of formed paper products is conveniently carried out through arranging a recording table, the recording of processing data by a worker is conveniently carried out, the checking and the adjustment of the worker are conveniently carried out, and the paper product is conveniently placed to assist by arranging a tool box.

title_en: Edge printing equipment and edge printing method
abstract_en: The invention provides a book edge printing device and a book edge printing method. The book edge printing device is used for printing at least one book edge and comprises a feeding device, at least one clamp, a driving device and at least one printing plate. The feeding device is provided with a flat surface, and the printed book edge is attached to the flat surface. At least one clamp is arranged close to the feeding device. At least one clamp is clamped on both sides of the front cover and the back cover of the book. The clamp comprises a rotating shaft, and can rotate around the rotating shaft to drive the printed book edge to face a preset direction. At least one printing plate is arranged along a path of the driving device driving the at least one clamp to move, the driving device drives the at least one clamp to move to correspond to the position of the at least one printing plate, and the at least one printing plate prints on the book edge to be printed to form a preset pattern. The embodiment of the invention realizes automatic printing of the book edge, improves the printing precision and the printing efficiency, can carry out repeated overprinting on the book edge and improves the product quality.

title_en: Mechanical force-induced brooming recycled aramid pulp and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of aramid fiber recycling, high-performance fiber modification and functional fiber reinforced materials, in particular to a mechanical force-induced scouring recycled aramid pulp and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the steps of physical screening, chemical stripping pretreatment, thread rolling, pulping, mechanical force coupling of pulping, stepped heating and drying and secondary fluffing of an opener, the prepared high-quality aramid pulp is applied to the fields of automobile friction materials, high-performance sealing products and special rubber composite materials, and can effectively solve the problems of poor dispersibility, insufficient specific surface area and weak combination with a matrix interface of the traditional recycled fiber.

title_en: Full-automatic ultrasonic steel mesh cleaning machine
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of steel mesh cleaning equipment, and provides a full-automatic ultrasonic steel mesh cleaning machine which comprises an equipment assembly, a first ultrasonic mechanism, a second ultrasonic mechanism, a spraying mechanism, a drying mechanism and a transferring mechanism, wherein the equipment assembly is provided with a liquid medicine soaking tank for installing the first ultrasonic mechanism, a clear water rinsing tank for installing the second ultrasonic mechanism, a spraying tank for installing the spraying mechanism and a drying cavity for installing the drying mechanism, and the transferring mechanism is used for driving a steel mesh to move in the equipment assembly. The application discloses a full-automatic ultrasonic steel mesh cleaning machine, which aims to improve the cleaning effect of a steel mesh.

title_en: Nano composite antibacterial mildew-proof polyester fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of textile materials, in particular to a nano composite antibacterial mildew-proof polyester fiber and a preparation method thereof, comprising the following steps of preparing TiO  2  @ZnO composite particles with a core-shell structure; the preparation method comprises the steps of preparing a master batch, uniformly mixing the master batch and a pure polyester chip according to a mass ratio of 1:4-4.5, adding the mixture into a spinning system, and carrying out melt spinning molding to obtain the nano composite antibacterial mildew-proof polyester fiber. The prepared material has the characteristics of good bacteriostasis, water washing resistance, good flame retardance and good mechanical property through the adaptive design of components and processes.

title_en: Winding device of circular knitting machine for clothing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of clothing rolling equipment, in particular to a rolling device of a clothing knitting circular knitting machine, which comprises a U-shaped support, wherein a first motor is arranged below the support, a first rotating shaft is arranged on the transverse part of the support, an output shaft of the first motor is fixedly connected with the bottom end of the first rotating shaft, the rolling device of the clothing knitting circular knitting machine drives the support to rotate along with a circular knitting machine main body by utilizing the action of the first motor combined with the first rotating shaft, a cloth rolling roller is driven to roll cloth by utilizing the action of the second motor combined with the action of a clamping assembly, the action of the spring is extruded by utilizing the action of the linkage plate sliding on the U-shaped rod, so that the sleeve is conveniently moved, one end of the cloth rolling roller is conveniently released from fixation, a worker can take down the cloth rolling roller by only moving the sleeve, the operation is time-saving and labor-saving, and the worker can conveniently and quickly operate.

title_en: High-strength antibacterial decorative paper and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of decorative paper, and discloses high-strength antibacterial decorative paper and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the steps of mixing and reacting the aqueous polyurethane prepolymer with antibacterial functionalized polyether to obtain the aqueous polyurethane-polyurea prepolymer, carrying out imidazole end-capping reaction on the aqueous polyurethane-polyurea prepolymer, neutralizing and emulsifying to obtain antibacterial impregnating solution, impregnating the decorative base paper in the antibacterial impregnating solution, taking out and drying after impregnation to obtain the high-strength antibacterial decorative paper. The decorative paper has high strength, excellent wear resistance and good antibacterial property, and the veneer prepared from the decorative paper serving as a veneering material has high bonding strength.

title_en: Hot air heating method and system of pre-oxidation furnace with coupled heat recovery
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of heating of a carbon fiber pre-oxidation furnace, in particular to the technical field of a waste or low-grade fuel combustion method, and particularly relates to a hot air heating method and a hot air heating system of a pre-oxidation furnace for coupling heat recovery. The method comprises the steps of dividing fresh air to be fed into a pre-oxidation furnace into two parts, mixing one part of fresh air with circulating air of the last process flow of the pre-oxidation furnace after multiple times of gradient heating, carrying out third gradient heating, then carrying out fourth gradient heating through a heat conducting oil heater, introducing the other part of fresh air which is heated once and is not mixed, mixing the fresh air with mixed air heated to be higher than the process temperature again, and feeding the fresh air into the pre-oxidation furnace after the process temperature is reached. By controlling the flow of fresh air newly introduced, the effect of precisely controlling the temperature of the mixed air at the process temperature is achieved.

title_en: Dust collector of UV printer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dust removing device of a UV printer, which belongs to the technical field of UV printers and comprises a suction frame, a suction pipe and negative pressure suction equipment, wherein the suction frame is arranged on the outer side of a printer nozzle, the suction pipe is fixedly connected with the suction frame and communicated with the suction frame and the outside, and the suction frame is used for sucking ink particles splashed in the printing process and dust on printing materials when following the movement of the printer nozzle. The invention discloses a printing material cleaning device, which comprises a suction frame, a printer nozzle, a cleaning part, a limiting part, a main shaft, a plurality of silica gel sheets, a negative pressure suction device and a negative pressure suction device, wherein cleaning parts for assisting in cleaning dust on the surface of a printing material are arranged on two sides of the suction frame and the printer nozzle in the moving direction of an X axis, the limiting parts are arranged on two sides of the suction frame and the printer nozzle in the moving direction of a Y axis, the main shaft is rotatably arranged on the side wall of a suction port on the outer side of the suction frame, the silica gel sheets are fixedly arranged on the main shaft, and ink particles are prevented from splashing into the air through negative pressure suction.

title_en: High-air-permeability high-temperature-resistant digital printing decorative base paper and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses high-permeability high-temperature-resistant digital printing decorative base paper and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the field of paper sheet manufacturing, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: preparing high-temperature-resistant resin emulsion, preparing composite nano silicon dioxide, preparing in-machine coating functional coating liquid, and coating; the preparation method comprises the steps of mixing water-based resin with silica sol, stirring uniformly to obtain a mixed solution, mixing the mixed solution with casein and water, and stirring uniformly to obtain high-temperature-resistant resin emulsion; in the preparation method, the special modified resin, the functional auxiliary agent and the filler are adopted for in-machine coating, so that the effects of better air permeability and high temperature resistance can be achieved, and the flatness of the decorative base paper is high.

title_en: Printing machine structure of skew is prevented in broad width paper feed
abstract_en: The invention discloses a printing machine structure capable of preventing wide paper feeding from shifting, which comprises a bottom frame and a printing part, wherein two sides of the top surface of the bottom frame are respectively and vertically fixedly connected with a first side frame and a second side frame; the vacuum adsorption component is matched with the conveying guide belt, the vacuum adsorption component is used for generating vacuum negative pressure and then adsorbing paper through micropores on the conveying guide belt to realize fixation, so that the paper and the conveying guide belt are prevented from generating relative deflection, when deflection correction is carried out, the conveying guide belt is guaranteed to be not deflected, the guide belt deflection correction component is used for realizing real-time deflection correction of the conveying guide belt, the printing paper is not required to be deflected, the deformation phenomenon caused by direct stress of the printing paper for deflection correction is avoided, and the plate type vacuum chamber is independently regulated and independently opened through independently connected high-pressure fans for the vacuum chamber of the paper feeding area, the vacuum chamber of the printing area and the vacuum chamber of the paper discharging area, so that the printing machine can adapt to paper with different gram weights and sizes, and energy consumption is optimized.

title_en: Antistatic clothing cloth and processing technology thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of textile material processing and discloses an antistatic clothing cloth and a processing technology thereof, wherein the processing technology comprises the following steps of firstly preparing a special-shaped fiber, carrying out melt spinning on a polyester slice, extruding the polyester slice by adopting a trilobal spinneret plate, wherein the monofilament cross section is of a ridge structure symmetrically distributed at 120 ℃, the height-groove depth ratio is 1:1.8-2.2, secondly, carrying out graded drafting, namely carrying out three-stage gradient drafting in a spinning channel, wherein the primary drafting ratio is 2.5-3.0 (the temperature is 80-90 ℃), the secondary drafting ratio is 1.8-2.2 (the temperature is 100-110 ℃), the tertiary drafting ratio is 1.2-1.5 (the temperature is 60-70 ℃), and on the antistatic performance, the surface resistance can be as low as 5.5X10  8  Ω/sq, the electrostatic pressure half life is as low as 0.5s as possible, and the electrostatic pressure half life is far superior to the prior art, and the safe requirements in the fields of electronics, chemical industry and the like can be rapidly dissipated.

title_en: Unidirectional moisture-conducting reverse osmosis-preventing multilayer composite sanitary material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a unidirectional moisture-conducting reverse osmosis-preventing multilayer composite sanitary material and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of sanitary materials, the preparation steps comprise respectively obtaining three layers of fiber net by opening and carding fiber raw materials, carrying out water jet strengthening and drying after cross lapping, spraying a hydrophobic antibacterial finishing agent on one side of a surface layer of the three layers of fiber net far away from a middle layer, spraying a hydrophilic antibacterial finishing agent on one side of an inner layer far away from the middle layer, carrying out curing and drying, and carrying out hot rolling to obtain the multilayer composite sanitary material, wherein the fiber raw materials comprise polylactic acid fibers and regenerated cellulose fibers, the weight ratio of the polylactic acid fibers and the regenerated cellulose fibers in the surface layer is (80-90): (10-20), the weight ratio of the polylactic acid fibers and the regenerated cellulose fibers in the middle layer is (40-50): (50-60), and the inner layer is single regenerated cellulose fiber.

title_en: Composite chain warp marshalling loom capable of improving warp tearing property and with full-width weft insertion changing warp insertion
abstract_en: The invention provides a composite knitting chain warp marshalling loom capable of improving tearing property of warp and changing weft insertion, and relates to the technical field of spinning. The composite warp knitting structure is formed by inserting one comb or two comb-inserted warp yarns between the warp knitting structure loops and extension lines in a full-width weft-lined knitting structure in a warp-changing mode, and the warp-inserting is cross-inserted when the two comb-inserted warp yarns are inserted. The invention overcomes the defects of the prior art, can greatly improve the problems of the warp knitting and the weak transverse tearing stress performance of the fabrics of the traditional full-width weft-lined knitting chain, can also improve the defects that the warp yarns of the traditional full-width weft-lined knitting chain are easily pulled out by external force along the reverse knitting direction to cause the coil to be broken, and comprehensively improves the mechanical properties of knitting structures.

title_en: Integrated electric fluid spray head and ink-jet printing system
abstract_en: The application relates to an integrated electric fluid spray head and an ink jet printing system, which comprises a main body part, a needle body, a power supply assembly and a grounding assembly, wherein the main body part is provided with a communication hole along the center line of the main body part, the needle body is inserted into the main body part through the communication hole, the power supply assembly comprises an electrode wire, the electrode wire stretches into the needle body, one end of the electrode wire stretches to the needle head of the needle body, the other end of the electrode wire is communicated with an external power supply device, the grounding assembly comprises a connecting sleeve and an electrode ring, the main body part penetrates through the connecting sleeve from the top end of the connecting sleeve and is in threaded connection with the connecting sleeve, the electrode ring is connected to the bottom end of the connecting sleeve, the center line of the electrode ring and the center line of the needle body are collinear, and the electrode ring is grounded, wherein the relative position of an injection orifice of the needle body and the electrode ring is adjusted by rotating the main body part. According to the application, the grounding assembly and the power supply assembly are integrated, and a stable electric field is formed at the needle point of the needle body, so that electrofluidic printing is realized, the printing is not limited by the material and shape of the substrate, and the printing application range is widened.

title_en: Color separation device and process for three-color BCF (binary coded decimal) high-definition yarns
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of chemical fiber spinning, in particular to a color separation device and a process for three-color BCF high-definition yarns, which comprises a shell, wherein the top of the shell is fixedly connected with a platform, the top of one side of the platform is fixedly connected with a color separation chamber, the side, far away from the color separation chamber, of the platform is fixedly connected with an extension table, the bottom of the extension table is provided with a color separation component, and one side of the color separation component is provided with a wire component.

title_en: Hot-press bonding machine for composite paper cup body and use method
abstract_en: The invention provides a hot-press bonding machine of a composite paper cup body and a use method thereof, which belong to the technical field of hot-press bonding machines and comprise a workbench and a pressing component arranged on the workbench, and are characterized in that a fixing frame is arranged on the side wall of the workbench, symmetrical mounting frames are mounted on the side walls of the mounting frames, motors are mounted on the side walls of the mounting frames, connecting rods are mounted at the lower ends of the mounting frames, forming rollers are mounted between the two connecting rods, forming assemblies are mounted on the inner walls of the working tables, and paper sheets are formed into cup bodies by the forming assemblies. According to the paper cup hot press device, the arranged pressing assembly can synchronously realize hot pressing and cold pressing of the paper cup, so that the complicated step that the paper cup needs to be transferred to an independent cooling station in a traditional cooling mode is avoided, the time loss of the paper cup in a conveying link is effectively reduced, meanwhile, the seamless connection of two key working procedures of hot press bonding and cold press solidification is realized, the integral period of bonding and solidification is obviously shortened, and the integral operation efficiency of a paper cup production line is obviously improved.

title_en: Rapid singeing equipment of white grey cloth for tire ply
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of tire production material processing, and particularly relates to a rapid singeing device for white grey cloth for tire plies, which comprises a singeing device body, wherein the singeing device body comprises a box body, a double roller arranged in parallel is arranged at the geometric center in the box body, a double roller limiting cylinder arranged in parallel is arranged above the double roller, singeing assemblies are arranged in the box body positioned at two sides of the double roller limiting cylinder, cleaning assemblies are arranged at two sides below the double roller, a tensioning assembly with a tight supporting function is arranged on the outer side of the box body close to the cleaning assemblies, and a material collecting and discharging mechanism integrating feeding and collecting functions is arranged at two sides of the box body. The double-sided singeing machine is reasonable in design, simple in structure and convenient to machine, double-sided singeing processing work is carried out on the gray fabric materials, the using functionality of the device is improved, double-sided singeing processing of the double-conveying process of the materials is realized, the processing process is guaranteed, and the use requirement is met.

title_en: Printing method, device and equipment for recognizing and adjusting local deformation of printing stock
abstract_en: The invention discloses a printing method, device and equipment for recognizing and adjusting local deformation of a printing stock, and relates to the technical field of inkjet printing. The method comprises the steps of acquiring an image of an area to be printed in a printing stock through controlling an image acquisition device to obtain a first acquired image, determining a deformation area and deformation parameters of the deformation area in the area to be printed according to the first acquired image, acquiring actual data to be printed after an original image to be printed of the area to be printed is adjusted according to the deformation area and the deformation parameters, and carrying out ink-jet printing on the area to be printed according to the actual data to be printed. The actual printing data is adjusted according to the deformation condition of the deformation area of the area to be printed, so that the image printed according to the actual printing data can be better matched with the area to be printed with local deformation, the image deviation caused by the local deformation is reduced, and the printing quality of the whole image is improved.

title_en: Washable fabric and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a washable fabric and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of fabrics. The preparation method comprises the steps of dyeing the fabric, putting the fabric into a composite treatment liquid which is prepared from 60% -70% of starch, 20% -30% of chitosan, 5% -10% of acrylic acid and 2% -5% of cross-linking agent, soaking, drying and baking. The invention constructs a protection system for dynamically converting the structure of the fabric in a drying/washing state on the surface of the fabric by the composite treatment liquid, ensures good air permeability of the fabric by the open structure of the crosslinked network during drying, and forms a compact wrapping layer by the water absorption expansion of starch and chitosan during washing, thereby effectively preventing dye from dissolving out and migrating, remarkably improving the washing resistance and color fastness of the fabric and reducing dyeing transfer.

title_en: Portable stable A3 printer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable and stable A3 printer which comprises an independent printing head assembly and a plastic part shell, wherein a sheet metal part fixing bottom plate is arranged in the plastic part shell, a screw connection structure is arranged between the sheet metal part fixing bottom plate and the plastic part shell, the independent printing head assembly is arranged on the sheet metal part fixing bottom plate, a plurality of bolt positioning structures are arranged between the sheet metal part fixing bottom plate and the independent printing head assembly, a bolt sliding block assembly for limiting the bolt positioning structures to be separated is arranged on the sheet metal part fixing bottom plate, and a synchronous control structure is arranged between the plurality of bolt sliding block assemblies on the same side.

title_en: Preparation method of 50D fine denier modified polyester fiber
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of 50D fine denier modified polyester fiber, which is produced based on a melt direct spinning device with three ends fully differentiated, and comprises the following steps of PTA+EG raw materials, esterification, prepolymerization, final polymerization, polyester melt, melt delivery pump, melt filter, booster pump, melt cooler, distribution valve, melt pipeline, static mixer, spinning box, metering pump, spinneret plate, circular blowing cooling, oil nozzle oiling, wire guider, pre-network, GR1, GR2, winding forming, fully automatic integrated doffing, inspection, packaging and warehousing, and SIPE modification in the prepolymerization process. Aiming at the characteristic that the cationic polyester melt is easier to thermally degrade when being conveyed in a pipeline compared with other bright and semi-bright polyester melt, the length of a melt pipeline from polymerization to spinning is greatly shortened, the residence time of the melt in the pipeline is reduced, and the effect of effectively controlling the thermal degradation and coking of the melt in the pipeline can be achieved.

title_en: Hot air circulation system of carbon fiber pre-oxidation furnace and temperature uniformity regulating and controlling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a carbon fiber pre-oxidation furnace hot air circulation system and a temperature uniformity regulating and controlling method, which relate to the technical field of pre-oxidation furnaces and comprise a conveying device, a control device for controlling the air inflow of an air blower, and a control device, wherein the control device is arranged on the outer wall of a drying furnace and can be switched between a first state and a second state, one end of a carbon fiber needing to be wound is fixed on the inner wall of a winding wheel in the first state, an air inlet is closed by a closing plate, the interior of the drying furnace can keep heat, the carbon fiber is installed in the second state, the sealing of the air inlet is released by the closing plate, the air blower can convey air towards the interior of the drying furnace, the hot air in the drying furnace can circulate, the air outlet is closed by pushing a push rod I, the intensity of hot air circulation and the heat dissipation speed are directly reduced, and the heat generated by a heating pipe can be kept in the furnace for a longer time.

title_en: Heat sealing device with self-cleaning function for drainage bag
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heat sealing device for a drainage bag with a self-cleaning function, which relates to the technical field of heat sealing devices and is characterized by comprising a base, a supporting piece, a hot-pressing module, a cleaning piece, a material changing module and a trimming piece, wherein the base is fixedly connected with the supporting piece, the material changing module is rotatably arranged on the base, the base is fixedly connected with the trimming piece, the supporting piece is fixedly connected with the hot-pressing module, the cleaning piece is arranged on the supporting piece, the cleaning piece comprises a telescopic rod and a cleaning plate, the telescopic rod is arranged on the supporting piece, the telescopic rod is fixedly connected with the cleaning plate, when the drainage bag is processed, the hot-pressing module is matched with the material changing module to seal the edge of the drainage bag, and after the edge sealing of the drainage bag is performed through hot-pressing, the cleaning piece is used for cleaning plastic filaments adhered on the hot-pressing plate, so that the rate of finished products of hot-pressing edge sealing is ensured.

title_en: Polyethylene stearic acid coated papermaking process and paper
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of pulping and papermaking, and provides a polyethylene stearic acid coated papermaking process and paper, wherein the polyethylene stearic acid coated paper comprises a substrate layer, a paper pulp layer and a paper pulp layer, wherein the substrate layer comprises paper pulp fibers; the functional layer covers at least part of the surface of the transition layer, and comprises polyethylene stearic acid and nano particles. The polyethylene stearic acid coated paper adopts a three-layer composite structure combining a substrate layer, a transition layer and a functional layer, and aims to solve the problems of weak adhesive force, discontinuous film formation, poor folding endurance, unstable barrier property and the like caused by large surface energy difference between the polyethylene stearic acid with strong hydrophobicity and hydrophilic paper pulp fibers.

title_en: Positioning and deviation correcting device for correcting fixed position of carton
