abstract_en: The application relates to a positioning and correcting device for correcting a fixed position of a carton, which relates to the technical field of carton production equipment, and comprises a mounting frame, wherein a linear conveying mechanism is arranged in the mounting frame, a primary folding mechanism and a correcting and crimping mechanism are sequentially arranged on the linear conveying mechanism, and the primary folding mechanism is used for folding a carton; the deviation rectifying and pressing mechanism comprises a fixing frame, wherein the fixing frame is arranged above the linear conveying mechanism and is connected with the mounting frame, a grabbing and pressing assembly is arranged on the fixing frame, a fine adjustment driving assembly is arranged between the fixing frame and the grabbing and pressing assembly, a visual detection mechanism is further arranged on the fixing frame, the detection end of the visual detection mechanism is vertically arranged downwards, and the grabbing and pressing assembly and the fine adjustment driving assembly are electrically connected with the visual detection mechanism. The application can improve the alignment precision between the first paper board and the last paper board, thereby ensuring the forming quality of the paper box.

title_en: Novel blended antibacterial crease-resistant school wear fabric and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel blended antibacterial crease-resistant uniform fabric and a preparation method thereof, and the novel blended antibacterial crease-resistant uniform fabric is characterized by comprising the following steps of S1, flushing fresh first-class flax stems with clear water, drying and finishing, S2, retting with warm water, S3, cleaning, drying, mechanically crushing the stems, scutching, carding, grading and cutting the flax stems after retting with warm water to collect flax fibers, S4, blending the flax fibers and fine cotton to obtain blended yarns, and S5, weaving the blended yarns.

title_en: Full-automatic reciprocating type paper folding production equipment and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses full-automatic reciprocating paper folding production equipment and method, and relates to the technical field of paper filter element production; the invention comprises a base, wherein one side of the top end of the base is fixedly provided with a shell, a reciprocating movement assembly is arranged in the shell, two symmetrically distributed folding assemblies are arranged in the reciprocating movement assembly, the middle part of the top end of the shell is provided with a heating shaping assembly, and a circulating pre-shaping assembly is arranged between the heating shaping assembly and the folding assembly; according to the invention, the driving rod drives the piston rod to reciprocate in the inner cylinder through the circulating pre-shaping assembly, the unidirectional valve is matched to form unidirectional conveying of circulating liquid, the circulating liquid is heated and warmed through conduction of waste heat of the electric heat resistance wire in the circulating process, and then conveyed into the folding plate to raise the temperature of the folding plate, and the folding filter paper is synchronously pre-shaped in the folding process, so that crease deviation and rebound of the filter paper caused by external force or self elasticity before the filter paper is conveyed to the heating shaping assembly are effectively avoided, and crease stability is remarkably improved.

title_en: Wave-absorbing material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wave-absorbing material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the wave-absorbing material is of a multi-layer structure, an inner layer takes PAN-based carbon fiber as a substrate, a middle layer and an outer layer are compounded with magnetic nano particles, the nano particles are uniformly dispersed in the substrate or on the surface, and the magnetic nano particles are Fe/Co/Ni or Fe/Co nano particles. The preparation method comprises the steps of preparing PAN solution A1 by taking DMF as a solvent, adding ferric salt, cobalt salt and nickel salt into the solution A1 to obtain solution A2, adding ferric salt and cobalt salt into the solution A1 to obtain solution A3, carrying out electrostatic spinning on the solution A1 to obtain a fiber film B1, carrying out electrostatic spinning on the solutions A2 and A3 on the surface of the fiber film B1 in sequence, compounding the fiber films B2 and B3 on the surface of the fiber film B1 in sequence to obtain a multi-layer fiber film, and carrying out pre-oxidation and carbonization on the multi-layer fiber film respectively and applying tension in the diameter direction of the multi-layer fiber film. The wave-absorbing material provided by the invention can achieve the effects of gradient structure, excellent electromagnetic wave absorption effect and good impedance matching property.

title_en: Preparation process of gel-like digital printing fabric and product thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of fabric processing, in particular to a gel-like digital printing fabric preparation process and a product thereof, comprising the following preparation steps of S1, spinning lyocell fiber, long stapled cotton, wool and soybean protein fiber into composite yarns, S2, soaking the composite yarns in surfactant solution for 1-2h, taking out, airing to obtain treated composite yarns, S3, dividing the treated composite yarns into warp yarn X1 and weft yarn Y1, setting warp density to 500-600/10 cm and weft density to 350-400/10 cm, spinning, weaving and finishing to obtain the fabric, S4, designing printing in a required pattern, spraying printing ink on the fabric by a digital printing machine, and then carrying out pressing and scalding treatment to obtain the finished product, wherein the problems of uneven ink permeation, reduced glossiness and the like caused by the roughness of the fabric are effectively improved, and the glossiness and the crystal-like crystal-clear effect of gel is beneficial to be exhibited.

title_en: Disc scale for large circle machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to a dial scale for a circular knitting machine, which relates to the technical field of knitting equipment and comprises a scale shell, a sliding block device, a knob device, a primary precision control device, a plurality of secondary precision control sheets and a mounting device, wherein the knob device is in transmission connection with the sliding block device, the primary precision control device is mounted on the scale shell and is pressed against the knob device, the primary precision control device is matched with sounding grooves on the knob device, each secondary precision control sheet is mounted between two adjacent sounding grooves, one side, close to the primary precision control device, of the secondary precision control sheet is provided with a pushing inclined plane, one side, far from the primary precision control device, of the secondary precision control sheet is provided with a scale sensing inclined plane, one side, close to the scale sensing inclined plane, of the secondary precision control sheet is provided with a sensing rod, and the secondary precision control sheet is provided with a reset tension spring, so that the sensing rod is attached to the surface of the knob device, and the secondary precision control sheet and the sensing rod are mutually attracted, thereby realizing precise control.

title_en: Knitted pattern decomposition and transformation method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of knitted fabric design, in particular to a knitted pattern decomposition and transformation method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a plurality of subarea areas by carrying out area selection on an obtained original image, respectively disassembling each subarea area to obtain disassembly information corresponding to each subarea area, respectively setting a line replacement rule based on the disassembly information of each subarea area to obtain the line replacement rule corresponding to each subarea area, and respectively paving the disassembling information of the corresponding subarea areas according to the line replacement rules to obtain unit design drawing sets corresponding to each subarea area, and finally splicing the unit design drawing sets to obtain complete design drawings, and converting the complete design drawings into electronic pattern card data for weaving and manufacturing, thereby meeting the requirements of multiple areas, reducing the decomposition and synthesis time and solving the problem that the uniform replacement line number in the traditional scheme cannot meet the requirements of multiple processes.

title_en: Ribbon flanging device and ribbon processing equipment comprising same
abstract_en: The invention relates to a webbing hemming device and webbing processing equipment comprising the webbing hemming device. The braid flanging device comprises a clamping and positioning driving mechanism, a first rotary driving mechanism, a second rotary driving mechanism, a first clamping assembly and a second clamping assembly. The clamping-in-place driving mechanism is connected to the first rotary driving mechanism and the second rotary driving mechanism for driving the first rotary driving mechanism and the second rotary driving mechanism to move in a first direction. The first rotary driving mechanism is connected to the first clamping assembly and is used for driving the first clamping assembly to rotate. The second rotary driving mechanism is connected to the second clamping assembly and is used for driving the second clamping assembly to rotate. The first clamping component and the second clamping component are opposite and are arranged at intervals and are used for clamping two ends of the webbing in a matching mode. The ribbon flanging device can automatically clamp and flanging the ribbon, and improves the automation degree of ribbon processing and the flanging quality and stability.

title_en: CO utilization2Method for anhydrous consolidation of phase change fluid-reinforced web entanglement
abstract_en: A process for anhydrous reinforcing the entanglement of fibrous web by CO  2  phase-change fluid includes such steps as preparing the fibrous web from raw fibres for preparing non-woven fabric, passing it through entanglement cavity, passing the fluid jet consisting of CO  2  phase-change fluid through the fibrous web to entangle the raw fibres in fibrous web until the fibrous web is passed out of entanglement cavity, and solidifying. The design not only diversifies external acting force, can utilize gasification explosive force or gasification expansion force to strengthen entanglement reinforcement effect, but also has lower water consumption and energy consumption, and is suitable for manufacturing high-end non-woven fabrics.

title_en: Anti-blocking printing nozzle module of plateless printing equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-blocking printing nozzle module of plateless printing equipment, which belongs to the technical field of plateless printing and comprises an ink bin, an ink jet hole and an ink jet driving mechanism, wherein the ink bin is communicated with the ink jet hole through an ink channel, an electromagnetic valve is arranged at the communication part of the ink channel and the ink bin, a sealing cap is arranged at the outlet end of the ink jet hole, the contact surface of the sealing cap and the ink jet hole is a flexible contact surface, a vibration anti-blocking mechanism is arranged on the ink channel and comprises a communicating pipe and a miniature vibrator, an elastic diaphragm is arranged in the communicating pipe, the communicating pipe is divided into a communicating section and a transmission section by the elastic diaphragm, the communicating section is communicated with the ink channel, the transmission section is contacted with the vibration surface of the miniature vibrator, and a transmission medium is filled in the transmission section. According to the invention, the vibration anti-blocking mechanism is arranged to prevent the spray head of the shut-down printing equipment from blocking, so that the ink is prevented from drying or static crystallization from blocking the ink-jet hole in a vibration mode under the condition of not directly contacting the ink.

title_en: High-toughness carton and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-toughness carton and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of papermaking and environment-friendly packaging materials. The carton is made of high-toughness composite corrugated board, and the raw materials of the carton comprise main slurry fibers, crosslinked modified nano cellulose, a modified starch adhesive, a wet strength agent and a rheology modifier, wherein the crosslinked modified nano cellulose is nano cellulose of which the surface is grafted with a hyperbranched supermolecule crosslinking agent. According to the invention, by preparing the nano cellulose with the surface grafted hyperbranched cross-linking agent, a mechanism capable of dissipating energy is constructed in a fiber network, and compared with the prior art, the defect of high brittleness of regenerated fibers can be effectively improved, and the dynamic impact toughness of the carton is obviously improved. The modified starch adhesive has better ductility and interlayer binding force, can follow deformation and is not easy to break when the paperboard is deformed under force, and is beneficial to keeping the stability of interlayer binding.

title_en: Glass powder and glass slurry for thermal print head substrate and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses glass powder and glass slurry for a substrate of a thermal printing head and a preparation method thereof, wherein the glass powder comprises, by weight, 37% -47% of silicon oxide, 3% -13% of boric acid, 2% -6% of aluminum oxide, 1% -5% of zirconium oxide, 37% -47% of alkaline earth metal carbonate, 0% -3% of alkali metal carbonate and 0.3% -4.5% of a surface active ingredient. The glass powder regulates the expansion coefficient of glass and the sintering temperature of glass by introducing alkaline earth carbonate, increases the expansion coefficient of glass by introducing alkali carbonate, increases the surface tension of glass, reduces the sintering temperature of glass, improves the thickening and fattening problem of glass slurry at the corner of alumina, reduces the surface tension of glass and increases the viscosity of glass by introducing surface active ingredients, expands the sintering window of glass, and improves the unevenness of the glass slurry after sintering on the surface of an alumina substrate. By incorporating zirconia, the heat resistance and chemical resistance of the glass are improved.

title_en: Composite solid electrolyte based on aramid nanofiber and lithium sulfur battery
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of polymer electrolytes, in particular to a composite solid electrolyte based on aramid nanofibers and a lithium-sulfur battery. The composite solid electrolyte is prepared by taking a composite aramid nanofiber membrane with a double-layer three-dimensional structure as a base material, wherein an upper polyaniline-based material provides good interface contact stability with a lithium negative electrode, and a lower aramid nanofiber skeleton provides good mechanical support performance for the fiber membrane, and meanwhile, the electrochemical performance of the composite solid electrolyte is comprehensively improved due to the doping of a special porous structure and shell-core porous carbon of the composite solid electrolyte.

title_en: Antibacterial fiber and preparation process
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fibers and discloses an antibacterial fiber and a preparation process thereof, wherein the antibacterial fiber comprises polylactic acid and modified titanium dioxide with the mass ratio of (1-5), and the antibacterial fiber is obtained by adding the modified titanium dioxide and the polylactic acid into a spinning solvent and spinning by an electrostatic spinning machine. The carboxyl of the succinate lactic acid ester and the hydroxyl on the surface of the nano titanium dioxide form interaction, the organically modified titanium dioxide is not easy to agglomerate, more antibacterial sites can be exposed, the antibacterial rate of the fiber is improved, meanwhile, the succinate lactic acid ester contains ester groups and lactic acid ester structures similar to those of polylactic acid, the compatibility of the nano titanium dioxide and the polylactic acid is improved, the nano titanium dioxide and the polylactic acid are uniformly dispersed in a fiber matrix, the breaking strength and breaking elongation of the polylactic acid fiber are improved, and the mechanical property is good.

title_en: Preparation method and application of carbon cloth loaded FeBi-MOF (metal oxide film) thin film material
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method and application of a FeBi-MOF film material loaded on carbon cloth. The preparation method comprises the following steps of S1, sequentially using dilute hydrochloric acid, acetone and deionized water to ultrasonically clean a carbon cloth substrate, vacuum-drying the cleaned carbon cloth, then carrying out plasma treatment on the dried carbon cloth, S2, placing the carbon cloth substrate subjected to the plasma treatment into a DMF (dimethyl formamide) solution containing terephthalic acid and ferric salt, reacting at a certain time and temperature to obtain an Fe-MOF (metal oxide film) material generated on the carbon cloth substrate, S3, placing the carbon cloth loaded with the Fe-MOF material into a concentrated nitric acid solution containing trivalent bismuth salt, and soaking for a period of time under normal temperature conditions to obtain the FeBi-MOF film material. The preparation method is simple, stable and efficient, the film material has large specific surface area and quick reaction kinetics, and the high-efficiency detection of the sulfamethoxazole antibiotics can be realized by using the film material as a modified electrode.

title_en: Biodegradable polyester composition, lifting rope and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of degradable materials, and relates to a biodegradable polyester composition, a lifting rope, a preparation method and application thereof. The biodegradable polyester composition comprises a component A, a component B and a component B, wherein the component A is at least one aliphatic-aromatic copolyester is a copolymer containing repeating units shown in formulas (I) and (II), the component B is at least one aliphatic polyester and contains repeating units shown in formula (III), the content of the component A is 8-50 wt% based on the total weight of the component A and the component B, the content of the component B is 50-92 wt%, the weight average molecular weight of the aliphatic-aromatic copolyester is 50000-300000g/mol, and the weight average molecular weight of the aliphatic polyester is 80000-500000g/mol. The lifting rope obtained by the composition has the advantages of simple preparation method, good comprehensive mechanical property, stable structure, uniform thickness of the lifting rope and quick and stable production in the processing process.

title_en: Waterproof fiber production process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a production process of waterproof fibers, which comprises a step of adding waterproof oil on line by using a DTY (draw-in temperature) and a step of entering a steam oven for drying, wherein the oil-up rate is controlled by using a device for adding waterproof oil on line by using the DTY, so that the liquid rate of fiber ribbons entering the steam oven is controlled below 20 percent, the steam oven adopts a three-stage temperature curve design, and comprises a preheating dehydration section, a rapid dehydration section and a heat preservation shaping section, the total residence time is 60-120s, the initial value of the liquid-up rate is 15-20 percent, the target liquid-up rate is less than or equal to 2 percent, the temperature of the rapid dehydration section is higher than that of the preheating dehydration section and the heat preservation shaping section, the temperature of the heat preservation shaping section is higher than that of the preheating dehydration section and is controlled below 80 ℃, the temperature of the rapid dehydration section is controlled below 110 ℃, and the temperature of the heat preservation shaping section is controlled below 95 ℃.

title_en: Active printing device and process for seersucker fabric
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of textile printing and dyeing, in particular to a seersucker fabric active printing device and a seersucker fabric active printing process, comprising a printing box, wherein a conveyor and a printing machine are assembled in the printing box, one side of the printing box is correspondingly provided with a heating box, the invention constructs an active penetrating three-dimensional heating flow field through the synergistic effect of C-shaped cambered surface bending, three sections of multidirectional steam injection and bottom negative pressure suction, physically breaks down the steam circulation dead angle, solves the fundamental problem of uneven heating of a concave-convex structure, specifically, the mechanical tension generated by the C-shaped bending initially expands the concave-convex texture of the fabric, and on the basis, the sectional directional steam assembly sprays steam from the left, the upper and the right directions, and in combination with negative pressure suction at the bottom of the arc-shaped piece, a forced pressure difference is formed in the thickness direction of the fabric, and the pressure difference forces the steam flow not to stay on the convex surface only but to penetrate fibers, so that cold air staying in the concave gaps is forced to be extruded and replaced.

title_en: Multi-station energy-saving transfer printing equipment based on multi-point temperature measurement
abstract_en: The invention discloses multi-station energy-saving transfer printing equipment based on multi-point temperature measurement, which comprises a multi-station circulating operation unit, multi-point temperature sensing and regulating units, a cross-station thermal energy management unit, a process state monitoring and responding unit and a central controller, wherein the multi-station circulating operation unit is used for carrying out centralized beat management and operation coordination on stations, the multi-point temperature sensing and regulating units are respectively arranged on the stations, the cross-station thermal energy management unit is used for dispatching and recycling thermal energy among the stations of the equipment, the process state monitoring and responding unit is used for monitoring key process parameters and triggering preset coping logic when the key process parameters are abnormal, and the central controller is used for cooperatively controlling multi-station operation.

title_en: Aqueous polyurethane dispersion, prepolymer, and molded article made therefrom
abstract_en: The present application relates to aqueous polyurethane dispersions, prepolymers, and shaped articles made therefrom. Prepolymers, aqueous polyurethane dispersions prepared therefrom, shaped articles comprising the same having improved whiteness maintenance and tensile strength, and methods of their use in shaped articles are provided.

title_en: Method for improving mechanical properties of fibers while reducing PET melt spinning temperature
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of spinning, and relates to a method for improving the mechanical properties of fibers while reducing the temperature of PET melt spinning, wherein the technical process of PET melt spinning comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of melt extrusion of a double-screw extruder, side blowing cooling, oiling, winding, drafting by a drafting machine, and controlling the intrinsic viscosity of PET and carrier PET in the masterbatch, the screw speed of the double-screw extruder and the spinning temperature by introducing silicone with specific content, specific structure and molecular weight into the PET melt in the form of masterbatch, so that the mechanical properties of fibers are effectively improved while the reduction of the PET melt spinning temperature is realized.

title_en: Rope hanging machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rope hanging machine which comprises a sewing machine, a first presser foot, a rope hanging feeding device and a second presser foot, wherein the first presser foot can move in the front-back direction, a feeding group of the rope hanging feeding device is used for clamping and driving a rope hanging part to move in the left-right direction so as to enable the rope hanging part to be fed to a sewing position of a machine head of the sewing machine and press a sewing end of the rope hanging part on the first presser foot, the second presser foot can move in the left-right and front-back directions, the second presser foot is used for pressing an area of the rope hanging part behind the first presser foot on the machine head, and the first presser foot moves forwards from back to back so as to bend the sewing end to the sewing position. The machine head is not required to manually reshape the hanging rope portion and position the reshaped hanging rope portion on the machine head, so that the efficiency is improved, the position accuracy and the stitching quality of the hanging rope portion stitched on the clothes are ensured, the attractiveness of the hanging rope portion on the clothes is also improved, the safety is also improved, and the labor cost is reduced.

title_en: Heterocyclic aramid liquid crystal spinning stock solution and production process and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heterocyclic aramid liquid crystal spinning solution and a production process and application thereof, wherein p-phenylenediamine monomers, heterocyclic diamine monomers and terephthaloyl chloride monomers are subjected to low-temperature polycondensation reaction in a reaction kettle to prepare a polymer solution, and then the polymer solution is filtered and defoamed; the method comprises the steps of extracting, washing and drying a polymer solution subjected to filtration and deaeration to obtain gel filaments, mechanically cutting the gel filaments to obtain fiber chopped strands, drying the obtained fiber chopped strands, and dissolving the dried fiber chopped strands in a strong acid solvent to obtain the heterocyclic aramid liquid crystal spinning stock solution. According to the invention, the preparation process of the existing heterocyclic aramid fiber is optimized, so that the production energy consumption can be obviously reduced, the production efficiency can be improved, and the production cost of the fiber can be effectively reduced. The technical breakthrough promotes the heterocyclic aramid fiber to realize large-scale application in wider market fields.

title_en: Dynamic paper offset compensation method and system based on machine vision
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of printer control, in particular to a dynamic paper offset compensation method and a system based on machine vision, wherein the method comprises the steps of scanning the edge of paper according to a preset sampling period in the printing process to obtain the physical coordinates of the edge of the paper in each sampling period; the method comprises the steps of obtaining offset and rotation angle of paper based on physical coordinates of the edge of the paper in a first sampling period, obtaining state vectors of the paper based on the offset and rotation angle of the paper, filtering and updating the state vectors by Kalman filtering according to a state transition matrix F and an observation matrix H to obtain filtered and corrected state vectors, predicting paper postures in the future N sampling periods based on the filtered and corrected state vectors and the state transition matrix F, and controlling the printer based on the physical coordinates of the edge of the paper in the first sampling period, the offset and rotation angle of the paper and the paper postures in the future N sampling periods.

title_en: Polyimide composite film with high CTI value, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a polyimide film with a high CTI value, a preparation method and application thereof. The CTI value of the polyimide composite film with high CTI value is more than or equal to 600V. The polyimide composite film comprises a first perfluoroalkyl acrylate layer, a nanofiber layer, a polyimide base layer and a second perfluoroalkyl acrylate layer which are sequentially laminated. The polyimide base layer is formed by thermal imidization of a polyamic acid solution. The polyamic acid solution is obtained by polycondensation of a polymeric monomer in a polar aprotic solvent. The polymerization monomer comprises an aromatic diamine monomer containing pyridine ring and a fluorine-containing dianhydride monomer. The nanofiber layer is formed by electrostatic spinning of a mixture of a polyamic acid solution and metal compound nanoparticles. The invention solves the problem of balance between high CTI value and comprehensive performance in mechanism by the synergistic effect of pyridine ring-metal coordination network, organic-inorganic-organic alternate multilayer structure and perfluoroalkyl acrylate layer protective layer, and simultaneously improves the inherent tracking resistance, thermal stability and mechanical property of the film.

title_en: Photo-thermal aging resistant modified polyester fiber and application thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a photo-thermal aging resistant modified polyester fiber and application thereof. On one hand, the application provides a photo-thermal aging resistant modified polyester fiber, which comprises, by mass, 100 parts of a copolymerized modified PET resin, 24-32 parts of polysiloxane acrylate, 14-18 parts of a multifunctional acrylate monomer, 1.5-2 parts of a photoinitiator, 12-18 parts of conductive carbon black, 6-10 parts of carbon nanotubes and 0.24-0.54 part of a Tinuvin 144 light stabilizer, wherein the copolymerized modified PET resin is 2, 4-tetramethyl-1, 3-cyclobutanediol copolymerized modified PET resin. On the other hand, the application provides application of the photo-thermal aging resistant modified polyester fiber. The application has excellent photo-thermal aging resistance, excellent hydrolysis resistance, certain hydrophilicity and good skin contact comfort.

title_en: Aramid fiber impregnating solution, aramid fiber impregnating line and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fiber impregnation, in particular to an aramid fiber impregnation liquid, an aramid fiber impregnation line and a preparation method, wherein the aramid fiber impregnation liquid comprises, by weight, 34-40 parts of an anhydride-polyol copolymer, 17-20 parts of trimethylolpropane polyvinyl ether, 12-15 parts of an aminosilane coupling agent, 0.001-0.01 part of glacial acetic acid and 320-330 parts of deionized water, and two-bath impregnation liquid comprises, by weight, 10-30 parts of epoxy resin, 2-5 parts of a solubilizer, 3-9 parts of a natural polyphenol compound, 4-9 parts of an amine curing agent, 5-12 parts of an anti-humid heat aging auxiliary agent, 180-250 parts of deionized water and 100-160 parts of rubber latex. The impregnating solution is more environment-friendly, and the aramid fiber impregnating line has the advantages of good adhesion with hydrogenated nitrile rubber, environment friendliness, resistance to wet heat aging and the like.

title_en: Oversized roller shutter fabric based on nest-free edge design and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an oversized rolling curtain fabric based on a nest-edge-free design and a manufacturing method thereof, and aims to solve the problem that nest edges are easy to deform in the processing and using processes of oversized rolling curtain fabric with a width of more than 3 m. The roller shutter fabric is of a symmetrical sandwich composite structure and comprises two base fabrics and a polymer film layer positioned between the two base fabrics, wherein the base fabrics are woven by warp yarns and weft yarns, the warp yarns are low-shrinkage polyester filaments, the weft yarns are polyester yarns with hot melting characteristics, after the base fabrics are subjected to shaping treatment higher than the melting point of the weft yarns, a fusion locking structure is formed at the interweaving points of the warp yarns and the weft yarns, so that the warp shrinkage rate and the weft shrinkage rate of the base fabrics are uniformly controlled, and the base fabrics are symmetrically compounded with the polymer film layer, so that the edge curling of the fabric is effectively inhibited under the condition of oversized size. The roller shutter fabric prepared by the structure and the method has the advantages of high dimensional stability, no nest edge, soft hand feeling and suitability for large-span building application.

title_en: Detect and spout sign indicating number paper feed device and use device's ink jet numbering machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a code spraying and paper feeding device and a code spraying machine using the same, which comprises a plurality of guide rollers which play a role in guiding the movement of paper, wherein the guide rollers are sequentially arranged in the movement direction of the paper, the second deviation correcting roller is used for preventing the deviation of the paper, a positioning sensor for determining the spray printing position, a spray head for spraying codes, a picture collecting sensor for collecting code spraying patterns, a solidifying device for solidifying the code spraying patterns, a cooling roller for cooling the paper, the first deviation correcting roller is used for preventing the deviation of the paper, and a cutter device for cutting the paper.

title_en: Polysiloxane modified polyester fiber, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses polysiloxane modified polyester fiber, a preparation method and application thereof. On the one hand, the application provides polysiloxane modified polyester fiber, which comprises, by mass, 100 parts of PET resin, 28-36 parts of hydrophilic polysiloxane polyurethane prepolymer, 8-12 parts of PE wax, 8-12 parts of cinnamaldehyde modified nano titanium dioxide and 0.2-0.5 part of composite antioxidant, wherein the raw material components of the hydrophilic polysiloxane polyurethane prepolymer comprise, by mass, 100 parts of polyether modified isocyanate curing agent, 20-28 parts of amination modified hydroxyl-terminated polysiloxane and 10-14 parts of eugenol. On the other hand, the application provides a preparation method and application of the polysiloxane modified polyester fiber. The polyester fiber has excellent flexibility, skin-friendly property, better air permeability and excellent antibacterial property.

title_en: Preparation method of weft knitting double-sided knitting yoga trousers finished fabric
abstract_en: The application discloses a preparation method of a weft knitting double-sided knitting yoga trousers finished fabric, which comprises the following steps of S1, knitting a raw fabric, namely knitting the raw fabric by using main yarns 40D/34F matte nylon 66 low stretch yarns and cushion yarns 55D lycra spandex, knitting double-rib textures by using the main yarns, knitting the cushion yarns by using an upper needle method to obtain the raw fabric, S2, reserving a blank for the raw fabric, S3, dyeing, S4, loosening and drying, S5, finishing and shaping, and S6, beating and softening. The yoga trousers finished fabric prepared by the preparation method has good stretch recovery performance, finer and tighter cloth cover, good wear resistance and air permeability and excellent freshness.

title_en: Leather grinding machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a leather buffing machine, relates to the technical field of buffing machines, and solves the problems that hands possibly roll into the buffing roller during operation of the equipment, and the service life of the belt A is affected due to larger friction when the belt A is fixed by a brake structure. The utility model provides a leather buffing machine, includes the buffing machine body, the inboard both ends in buffing machine body top all are equipped with a leather roller. According to the invention, when the hands of an operator are too close to the leather grinding roller and sensed by the heat source sensor, the protection device is automatically started, so that the rotating leather grinding roller is quickly fixed, the safety of equipment is improved through the technical scheme, and when the protection device is started, the automatic belt-removing protection device is simultaneously started, so that the driving belt A is loosened, and the situation that the service life of the driving belt A is influenced can be effectively prevented.

title_en: Ink jet control method for printing apparatus, and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an ink-jet control method of a printing device, the printing device and a storage medium, belonging to the technical field of ink-jet printing; the method comprises the steps of performing PID processing according to the actual pressure difference of an inlet and an outlet of a spray head and the target pressure difference of the inlet and the outlet, determining target inlet pressure and target outlet pressure, performing PID processing according to the target inlet pressure and the target outlet pressure, the first inlet detection pressure of a positive pressure ink box and the first outlet detection pressure of a negative pressure ink box respectively to obtain first target positive pressure and first target negative pressure, performing PID processing according to the target positive pressure and the second inlet detection pressure of a positive pressure bottle to obtain second target positive pressure so as to control the pressure in the positive pressure bottle according to the second target positive pressure, and performing PID processing according to the target negative pressure and the second outlet detection pressure of the negative pressure bottle to obtain second target negative pressure so as to control the pressure in the negative pressure bottle according to the second target negative pressure. The embodiment of the application can enable the pressure difference of the spray head to be more constant.

title_en: Method for preparing hyperbranched polyamide surface modified polyvinyl alcohol fiber by one-step method and application
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of surface modification of polyvinyl alcohol fibers, and particularly provides a method for preparing hyperbranched polyamide surface modified polyvinyl alcohol fibers by a one-step method and application of the hyperbranched polyamide surface modified polyvinyl alcohol fibers in cement-based materials. The surface modification method comprises the following raw materials of 1 part of polyvinyl alcohol fiber, 1-3 parts of 3, 5-diaminobenzoic acid, 0.1-0.3 part of 4-dimethylaminopyridine and 100 parts of N, N-dimethylformamide, wherein the surface modification method is to obtain the surface modified polyvinyl alcohol fiber by mixing the raw materials and then keeping the raw materials at a constant temperature of 50-80 ℃ for 2-5 hours. The application comprises the steps of verifying the change of the interfacial strength between the fiber before and after modification and the cement-based material through a single fiber pulling sample, and obtaining the change of the mechanical property parameters of the fiber before and after modification through a single fiber stretching test. Compared with unmodified polyvinyl alcohol fibers, the tensile strength and the elongation at break of the surface-modified polyvinyl alcohol fibers are respectively improved by 1.1-1.6 times and 1.4-2.2 times, the surface-modified polyvinyl alcohol fibers can enhance the interface strength with cement and reach 3.7-6.3 times of the unmodified polyvinyl alcohol fibers, and the method can be widely applied to the field of fiber reinforced cement-based composite materials and has wide application prospects.

title_en: A hydraulic pressure pressfitting machine for production of protective shoes
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydraulic press fit machine for producing protective shoes, which relates to the technical field of shoe production equipment. According to the invention, the protective shoe blank is pressed by the two inclined side pressing plates in a hydraulic manner, the bottom ends of the inclined side pressing plates are firstly contacted with the bottom of the protective shoe blank in the pressing process, and then the inclined side pressing plates are turned over in the pressing process, so that the effect similar to manual pushing and scraping flattening is achieved, the adhesive at the edge of the sole is extruded and paved upwards uniformly, the air in the adhesive is effectively discharged, the uniformity and the fullness of the whole adhesive layer are ensured, and the pressing effect of the protective shoe is effectively improved.

title_en: A health insole containing rhizoma Atractylodis and its preparation method
abstract_en: The application discloses a healthy insole containing rhizoma atractylodis components and a preparation process thereof, the healthy insole comprises a ventilation surface layer, a rhizoma atractylodis functional layer and an elastic base layer which are sequentially arranged from top to bottom, rhizoma atractylodis microcapsules containing rhizoma atractylodis active components are implanted in the rhizoma atractylodis functional layer to realize slow release of the rhizoma atractylodis active components and efficacy, the rhizoma atractylodis functional layer adopts the design of 'locally thickening the rhizoma atractylodis functional layer' in key areas such as soles, heels and the like of an insole body to strengthen herbal curing effects, and ventilation channels are formed in the ventilation surface layer to realize 'strong antibacterial effect during working and energy-saving and efficiency storage during idle time'. The application solves the problems of easy attenuation of the traditional Chinese medicine efficacy, faster medicine release process, lack of key maintenance on key areas and poor prevention and treatment effects of the traditional insole, precisely matches the health function requirements of feet in different states of an idle state and a working state, and combines wearing comfort and health practicability.

title_en: Method and device for forming luminous pattern and luminous product
abstract_en: The method comprises the steps of obtaining a printing task aiming at a pattern to be printed, determining target RGB channel values of pixel points in the pattern to be printed, converting the target RGB channel values of the pixel points according to a target conversion relation between the target color mode and the RGB color mode to obtain target CMYK channel values of the pixel points in the target color mode, and controlling a target printer to print based on the target CMYK channel values of the pixel points to obtain a target pattern corresponding to the pattern to be printed. The method and the device can realize accurate manufacture of the luminous patterns, simplify the process flow and remarkably reduce the production cost.

title_en: Textile treatments for imparting oil repellency include the use of silicone- (meth) acrylate copolymers and urethanes
abstract_en: A textile treatment emulsion that can be prepared by mixing an aqueous emulsion of a silicone- (meth) acrylate copolymer and an aqueous emulsion of an alkyl carbamate. The textile treatment emulsion can be applied to the fabric and heated to increase the oil repellency of the fabric.

title_en: Sweat-hidden core-spun yarn and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a sweat-covered core yarn, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the sweat-covered core yarn comprises a core yarn and an outer covering yarn wrapping the core yarn, the core yarn comprises elastic fibers and the outer cover yarn comprises sweat-absorbent fibers. The fabric made of the sweat-concealed covering yarn is soft, moisture-absorbing and quick-drying, good in air permeability, strong in ultraviolet resistance, good in heat shielding performance, free of peculiar smell, comfortable and durable, and has sweat-concealed effect.

title_en: Bi-component anti-dyeing agent and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of anti-dyeing agents, and particularly relates to a bi-component anti-dyeing agent, a preparation method and application thereof. The two-component anti-dyeing agent comprises a component A and a component B. The double-component anti-dyeing agent provided by the invention has the advantages that the component A is used as a bottom material, so that the fabric is prevented from being remained on the fabric by polyester in the component B, the component B can be firmly grafted, and a hydrophilic barrier layer is formed on the surface of the fiber.

title_en: Preparation method of patch integrating seepage management and pH monitoring
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of medical materials and discloses a preparation method of a patch integrating seepage management and pH monitoring, which comprises the steps of 1) forming a conical through hole array in a central area of a fabric, 2) activating oxygen plasma of the fabric, depositing 1, 3-dichloro tetramethyl disiloxane on the surface of the obtained activated fabric in a vapor phase mode, 3) constructing a hydrophilic area on the surface of the fabric and forming a hydrophilic channel to obtain a fabric A, 4) opening the central area of the fabric B, constructing the hydrophilic area and forming the hydrophilic channel, 5) sewing the fabric A and the fabric B by cotton threads, and 6) arranging a pH detection device. The invention firstly constructs a cascade liquid guide system combining the longitudinal conical through hole array and the plane hydrophilic channel, can realize continuous directional guiding-out and rapid transmission of wound exudates, then integrates the pH sensing device between the two liquid guide modules, can detect the one-way guided-out seepage pH value in situ and in real time, and can provide visual and convenient wound state monitoring means for patients and medical staff.

title_en: Warming and moisture-conducting multilayer composite fabric and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of layered composite fabrics, and discloses a thermal insulation and moisture-transfer multilayer composite fabric, a preparation method and application thereof. The surface layer fabric is formed by heating acrylic fibers and special-shaped cross-section polyester fibers, the inner layer fabric is formed by pure cotton fibers and special-shaped cross-section polyester fibers, and the surface layer fabric is compounded after being subjected to functional finishing by a moisture absorption and sweat releasing finishing agent to form the moisture absorption and moisture conduction double-layer composite fabric, wherein the surface layer fabric is moisture-conducting and heat-preserving, and the inner layer fabric is moisture-conducting and moisture-conducting, so that the multi-layer composite fabric has the two properties of light, thin and heat-preserving, moisture-conducting and quick-drying, can be applied to partition management type thermal wear, and improves the thermal comfort of fabrics.

title_en: Sanitary towel production is with processing equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to sanitary towel production equipment, in particular to sanitary towel production processing equipment, which comprises the following components: the device comprises a base, a guide out plate, moving rods, a cutting unit, moving seats, a storage bin, an exhaust case, guide seats and guide out gaps, wherein the left side and the right side of the base are respectively provided with a supporting plate, one side of each supporting plate far away from the base is provided with the moving seat, the upper parts of the moving seats on the two sides are respectively provided with a guide slot, the moving rods are respectively inserted into the guide slots, the moving rods move along the extending directions of the corresponding guide slots, a cutting unit is connected between the two moving rods, the guide out gaps are inclined from top to bottom and from bottom to the guide out plate, the storage bin is arranged on one side of the guide out plate far away from the base, the exhaust case is arranged below the guide out plate, the guide out gaps are formed between the base and the guide out plate, and one side of the guide out gaps transversely passes through the base and the guide out plate; the invention relates to a pair of sanitary towel cutting and forming processing and manufacturing assembly line equipment, which reduces manual splitting operation.

title_en: Pattern manipulation of a jetting valve dispenser
abstract_en: The jetting valve dispenser is configured to output individual, discrete droplets of material onto a target substrate. The jetting valve dispenser includes a nozzle plate that supports a nozzle through which material is ejected. The nozzle plate is configured to receive one or more compressed gas streams and to output compressed gas to atomize the dispensed droplets of material.

title_en: Yarn tension feedforward control method, device, equipment and medium of embroidery machine
abstract_en: The application is mainly used in the technical field of embroidery machines. The application discloses a yarn tension feedforward control method, device, equipment and medium of an embroidery machine, which are used for acquiring data of a to-be-embroidered sample in a look-ahead buffer zone, detecting a needle pattern switching point of a current needle step and a next needle step, determining a theoretical thread consumption rate mutation value according to the needle step length and the spindle rotating speed of the current needle step and the next needle step, generating a compensation pulse command according to the theoretical thread consumption rate mutation value, synchronizing an execution time parameter of the compensation pulse command with the phase of a starting spindle of the next needle step, and controlling an electromagnetic direct-drive type high-speed response actuator to execute active compensation in a preset window when the spindle runs to the phase so as to offset transient impact of the thread consumption rate mutation on the yarn tension. The application realizes feedforward-feedback composite high dynamic control of yarn tension under the transient state of needle switching, eliminates broken and polished threads and ensures the consistency of the stitch in the transition area.

title_en: Preparation process of high-hydroscopicity brain cotton tablet
abstract_en: The invention aims to disclose a preparation process of a super absorbent brain cotton sheet, which relates to the technical field of brain cotton preparation and comprises the following steps of preparing a hydrophilic spun-laced non-woven fabric layer, uniformly mixing sodium polyacrylate super absorbent resin powder and fluffy cotton fibers according to the mass ratio of (3-5): 1, forming the mixture by a mould pressing or air-laying process to prepare a super absorbent green body layer, paving the grid layer on the surface of the super absorbent green body layer, carrying out hot-pressing and compounding on the grid layer and the super absorbent green body layer by a first hot-pressing process to prepare a super absorbent composite layer, paving annular development lines around the edge of the super absorbent composite layer to prepare a super absorbent intermediate layer, compounding the super absorbent intermediate layer and the hydrophilic spun-laced non-woven fabric layers on the two surfaces of the super absorbent intermediate layer by a second hot-pressing process to obtain a brain cotton sheet substrate, and carrying out hot-pressing on the edge of the brain cotton sheet substrate by a third hot-pressing process to form an annular hot-pressing area, wherein the brain cotton sheet can absorb blood or body fluid which is not less than 4.5 times of the self weight.

title_en: Printing device
abstract_en: A printing apparatus (1) is provided with a processing device (27), a processing roller (21) that conveys a sheet (4) to a position where printing is performed by the processing device (27), a pre-printing processing device (25) that is provided upstream of the processing roller (21), a pre-printing conveying device (16) that conveys the sheet (4) to a position where pre-printing processing is performed by the pre-printing processing device (25) and conveys the sheet (4) to the processing roller (21), a conveying mechanism (26) that conveys the printed sheet (4) to a device of the next step, a reversing roller (45) that reverses the front and back sides of the sheet (4) from the conveying mechanism (26), and a post-reversing conveying device (47) that conveys the sheet (4) that has undergone the front-back side reversing to the upstream side of the pre-printing processing device (25). According to this configuration, even on a sheet that has been turned front-back, an appropriate number of pre-press treatments can be performed.

title_en: Sewing machine needle collecting equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to a sewing machine needle collecting device, which relates to the technical field of waste needle collecting devices and comprises a base, wherein a containing cavity is formed in the upper part of the front side of the base, a mounting cavity is formed in the lower part of the front side of the base, a cover plate is detachably arranged on the lower part of the front side of the base, a feeding through groove is formed in the bottom wall of the containing cavity, a supporting frame is fixedly arranged on the upper part of the inner wall of the mounting cavity, a second unreeling roller is arranged on the upper part of the supporting frame, a first unreeling roller is arranged on the lower part of the supporting frame, a reeling roller is rotatably arranged on the lower part of the supporting frame, a power source is fixedly arranged on the lower part of the supporting frame, a front tensioning roller is rotatably arranged on the rear side of the supporting frame, a rear tensioning roller is rotatably arranged on the middle part of the supporting frame, a bearing plate is fixedly arranged on the supporting frame, a connecting rod is rotatably arranged on the supporting frame, and an elastic piece is fixedly arranged on the upper side of the supporting frame, and a squeezing roller is fixedly arranged on the supporting frame.

title_en: Composite equipment of antibacterial breathable warp-knitted composite fabric and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of composite fabrics, and in particular relates to a composite device of an antibacterial breathable warp-knitted composite fabric and a preparation method thereof. According to the composite equipment of the antibacterial breathable warp-knitted composite fabric and the preparation method thereof, the composite fabric is arranged, the warp-knitted base fabric layer, the melt-blown non-woven fabric middle layer and the skin-friendly inner layer are compounded into a whole by adopting the antibacterial breathable adhesive layer distributed in a dot matrix mode, regular breathable micro-channels are formed among the layers, the blocking of full-width adhesive on the fabric pores is avoided, the synergistic unification of antibacterial performance and breathable performance is realized, meanwhile, the heat-sensitive antibacterial components are effectively protected by the core-shell structure of the antibacterial microcapsule, and the interface anchoring effect of the compatilizer is matched, so that the fabric has a lasting antibacterial effect and good interlayer peeling strength.

title_en: Double-effect heat pipe qi-regulating gel fiber and film with core-shell structure, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of functional nanofiber materials, and particularly relates to a double-effect heat pipe qi-regulating gel fiber and film with a core-shell structure, and a preparation method and application thereof. Preparing a shell spinning solution and a core spinning solution respectively, preparing SiO  2  @BN/PAA hydrogel fiber with a core-shell structure by adopting coaxial freeze spinning, and carrying out freeze drying and thermal imidization treatment to obtain the aerogel fiber. The double-effect heat pipe qi-regulating gel fiber and fiber membrane with the core-shell structure have a unique core-shell structure of 'core-layer pure PI aerogel+shell layer BN/hollow SiO  2  @PI composite aerogel', and have excellent passive radiation refrigeration performance and heat insulation performance. The preparation process is controllable, and the concentrated distribution of the filler in the shell layer and the accurate construction of the core-shell structure can be realized.

title_en: Preparation method of silk-based conductive functional fabric
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of functional textiles and flexible electronics, and particularly discloses a preparation method of a silk-based conductive functional fabric, which comprises two stages, namely, pretreating yam-condensed tannin, and forming a chemically active interface layer on the surface of silk fiber through repeated dip dyeing and drying; in the second stage, reagent-grade humic acid/fulvic acid and soluble ferrous salt/ferric salt are used for preparing Fe-HA-FA colloid, the Fe-HA-FA colloid is premixed with aqueous dispersion liquid of poly (3, 4-ethylenedioxythiophene) polystyrene sulfonic acid, the aqueous dispersion liquid is applied to the surface of pretreated silk fabric by a knife coating method, and the conductive fabric is obtained by low-temperature drying. The method is applicable to the preparation of fabric grade and single yarn grade, the whole process only needs dip coating, knife coating, low-temperature drying and other low threshold operations, does not need special equipment such as photoetching, chemical vapor deposition and the like, and is suitable for implementation in common laboratories or wound space. The prepared fabric has piezoresistive sensing characteristics, washability, maintainability of a coating and an asymmetric double-sided structure.

title_en: Zn/Mo-TiO2Photon capturing-physical shielding dual-mechanism synergistic photo-responsive antibacterial/anti-ultraviolet polyester master batch and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photoresponse antibacterial/ultraviolet resistant polyester master batch adopting Zn/Mo-TiO  2  photon capturing-physical shielding dual-mechanism synergistic effect and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of functional textiles. The Zn/Mo co-doped TiO  2  nano functional powder provided by the invention has the advantages that the light response range is widened by means of Zn and Mo bimetal co-doping, excellent photocatalysis antibacterial and ultraviolet resistance can be exerted under visible light irradiation, and the dispersion uniformity of the nano powder in a polyester matrix is ensured by matching with a surface modification process of vacuum high-temperature high-speed kneading, meanwhile, the interfacial binding force of the powder and the polyester matrix is further improved by the synergistic effect of an ethylene acrylic acid copolymer and maleic anhydride grafted POE, the mechanical property of a composite material can meet the use requirement while the excellent antibacterial and full-band ultraviolet resistance is endowed to the polyester matrix, and the nano powder can be widely applied to the fields of functional textiles, medical packaging and the like.

title_en: Pretreatment process for environment-friendly quality-improving cloth before dyeing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of textile printing and dyeing, in particular to an environment-friendly pretreatment process before dyeing of quality-improving cloth, which comprises the steps of feeding cotton yarn into a mercerizing device for mercerizing, directly feeding the cotton yarn into at least two washing devices connected in series for grading washing without intermediate standing, carrying out two-stage acid washing neutralization treatment on the treated cotton yarn to enable the pH value of the cotton yarn to reach 6.5-7.5, and directly feeding the treated cotton yarn into a dyeing device for dyeing treatment under the set dyeing temperature and reactive dye. The multi-stage washing device is arranged to realize synergistic cooperation of multi-stage washing and acid washing neutralization, ensure thorough alkali residue removal after mercerization, avoid interference of alkali residue on dyeing process, improve soaping fastness and rubbing fastness of cotton yarn cloth by a double fixation mechanism of steaming fixation and saline-alkali fixation, effectively remove floating color, greatly reduce surface dye residue, and remarkably improve dyeing uniformity and chromaticity.

title_en: Insulating paper electric field induction impregnation device and impregnation method
abstract_en: The application discloses an electric field induction impregnation device and an impregnation method for insulating paper, which are used in the technical field of oil paper insulation. The application comprises an insulating oil tank for containing insulating oil, a discharging mechanism, a vacuum mechanism and a clamping mechanism, wherein the discharging mechanism comprises a positive plate, a negative plate and a power supply, the positive plate and the negative plate are all positioned in the insulating oil tank, a pole plate gap is formed by the spacing arrangement of the positive plate and the negative plate, the power supply is connected with the positive plate and the negative plate in a conductive mode, the power supply is used for enabling the positive plate and the negative plate to form an electric field in the pole plate gap, the vacuum mechanism is connected and conducted with the insulating oil tank and used for providing negative pressure for the inside of the insulating oil tank, and the clamping mechanism is fixed in the insulating oil tank and positioned in the pole plate gap and used for clamping insulating paper. According to the application, through the dual functions of vacuum and electric field, the creep of insulating oil into micropores of the insulating paper is promoted, and the impregnation efficiency and the impregnation quality are improved.

title_en: Heat-accumulating temperature-locking layered structure fabric and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heat accumulating and temperature locking layered structure fabric and a preparation method thereof, wherein an ultra-porous network of an aerogel core layer provides ultra-low heat conduction and light adsorption functions, a high-rigidity framework of a basalt shell layer is endowed with high temperature resistance and mechanical support, heat insulation protection and structural stability are achieved through physical cooperation of the core shell, modified montmorillonite is embedded into a molecular chain gap in nylon through an intercalation layer structure, stress buffering of the nylon intermediate layer on the aerogel core and interface bonding of the nylon intermediate layer on the basalt shell are enhanced, heat transfer is inhibited by a heat insulation labyrinth structure of the montmorillonite, the pyrolysis resistance of the nylon is improved, the cooperative stability and environmental adaptability of the core shell are enhanced, the functional complementation advantage of a coaxial structure is maintained, interlayer binding force, high-temperature aging resistance and long-term service stability are improved through intercalation interlocking and heat shield effect of the montmorillonite, and the cooperative enhancement of the composite fabric on heat insulation, protection and durability is realized.

title_en: Niobium-containing polymer film and preparation method and application thereof

The niobium-containing polymer film, the preparation method and the application thereof can provide a space for the deposition of lithium metal, thereby relieving the volume expansion of the lithium metal in the circulating process.
