The device comprises a bottom plate assembly, a first pressing plate and a second pressing plate, wherein the first pressing plate and the second pressing plate are covered on the bottom plate assembly and can be opened; the middle part of the bottom plate component is provided with a positioning groove for accommodating the vamp, two lines of needle seams which are bilaterally symmetrical are arranged in the positioning groove, and a decoration piece positioning area is arranged between the two lines of needle seams; the first pressing plate and the second pressing plate are matched with each other to cover the positioning groove, and the adjacent edges of the first pressing plate and the second pressing plate are positioned in the middle of the positioning groove; the positions, which are opposite to the two lines of needle seams, on the first pressing plate and the second pressing plate are hollowed out. With the help of the utility model discloses sew up the toe cap ornament piece on the toe cap surface fabric subassembly, can reduce the line needle and make up artifical the participation of in-process, easy operation, convenience have improved the efficiency of making up of toe cap surface fabric subassembly greatly, and it is accurate to each surface fabric location simultaneously, and toe cap surface fabric subassembly finished product uniformity is high, has reduced safety shoes manufacturing cost, has improved safety shoes finished product quality.

title_en: Unit flexographic printing machine with quick drying function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a unit flexographic printing machine with quick drying function, including printing machine stoving case and bayonet lock barb, the front end of printing machine stoving case is provided with can dismantle the qianmen, and can dismantle the front end of qianmen and install the bolt, the left side of printing machine stoving case is provided with the circulation of air case, and the top of circulation of air case installs the air circulation mouth, the inside of air circulation mouth is provided with the breakwater, and the internally mounted of breakwater has dustproof gauze, the below of printing machine stoving case is provided with the bottom plate, and the inside of bottom plate is provided with the draw-in groove, the inside of draw-in groove is provided with the rotary column, and the below of rotary column is provided with the slide rail. The utility model discloses be provided with printing machine stoving case and pass through the bolt and can dismantle between the qianmen for threaded connection, can dismantle the qianmen from printing machine stoving case through the bolt like this and dismantle to this makes things convenient for maintenance personal to detect and maintain the inside facility of printing machine stoving incasement portion, thereby increases maintenance efficiency.

title_en: High-efficient heat setting equipment of composite chemical fibre
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of heat setting tool technique and specifically relates to a high-efficient heat setting equipment of composite chemical fiber, including supporting legs, gaseous adjusting device, heat setting machine, control panel, switch board, reinforcement backup pad, the supporting legs connects gradually the rectangle structure and arranges in the heat setting machine bottom, the heat setting machine front side is connected perpendicularly with the switch board back, gaseous adjusting device installs inside the heat setting machine, the control panel side is inlayed in the switch board front side, the switch board bottom welds with reinforcement backup pad top. The utility model discloses in, gaseous adjusting device can cool down the processing to the inside required combustion gas of heat setting machine, can improve staff's operational environment like this, and gaseous adjusting device can carry out the secondary heating to circulating gas simultaneously, can also adjust gaseous circulation speed, so not only can energy-conservingly can also increase the convenience of using.

title_en: Air pressure control device for table of cord fabric weaving machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an atmospheric pressure control device that cord fabric loom board was used, which comprises a bracket, be equipped with the loom body in the support, the rear side of support is equipped with pneumatic auxiliary device, pneumatic auxiliary device includes strutting arrangement, be equipped with the atmospheric pressure sleeve in the strutting arrangement, be equipped with the motor in the atmospheric pressure sleeve, the fixed surface of motor is connected with the extension board, keep away from the one end and the telescopic inner wall fixed connection of atmospheric pressure of motor on the extension board, the left end fixedly connected with pivot of output shaft on the motor, the fixed surface cover of pivot has the cylindrical cam. The utility model discloses, use through the cooperation between the above-mentioned structure, solved in the in-service use, because traditional loom is before carrying out the gumming to the curtain, be difficult to detach the dust and the moisture of curtain cloth adhesion on the surface, make the dust cause the influence to the quality of curtain cloth, also make external moisture cause the influence to gumming liquid concentration simultaneously, bring inconvenience for the use.

title_en: Special creel of circular knitting machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a special creel for a circular knitting machine, which comprises a hanging rack and adjusting frames arranged at two sides of the hanging rack, wherein each adjusting frame comprises an adjusting seat, guide posts are arranged on the adjusting seat, fixed sleeves are arranged on the two guide posts, a fixed crosspiece is arranged between the two fixed sleeves, movable sleeves are respectively arranged above and below the fixed sleeves, a movable crosspiece is arranged between the two movable sleeves at the same vertical height, adjusting holes are respectively arranged on the movable crosspiece and the fixed crosspiece, cross-shaped scissors are respectively arranged between the adjacent two movable crosspieces, between the adjacent fixed crosspiece and the movable crosspiece, a rotating shaft is arranged at the middle hinging part of each cross-shaped scissors, the two adjacent cross-shaped scissors are mutually hinged, the hinging parts are provided with first sliding pins, the uppermost scissors and the lowermost cross-shaped scissors are provided with second sliding pins, and a push rod cylinder is arranged between the two first sliding pins at the same vertical height; the hanger comprises a hanging rod and a hook. The special creel has the characteristics of labor saving in taking and placing the yarn cylinder, convenience in use, perfect overall function and strong practicability.

title_en: Sole vamp laminating device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sole and vamp laminating device, which comprises a first laminating plate, wherein the upper surface of the first laminating plate is rotationally connected with a second laminating plate, the upper surface of the first attaching plate is fixedly connected with a workbench, the inner wall of the workbench is fixedly connected with a motor, one end of the motor is extended with a threaded rod, the upper surface of the workbench is provided with two groups of clamping plates, the threaded rod is connected with a group of clamping plates through threads, the upper surface of the first attaching plate is fixedly connected with a second fixing block, a rotating shaft is arranged at one side of the second fixed block, the outer wall of the rotating shaft is rotationally connected with a first hydraulic cylinder, one end of the first hydraulic cylinder is provided with a first hydraulic rod, one side of the second attaching plate is provided with a first fixed block, and the first fixed block is rotatably connected with the first hydraulic rod through a rotating shaft. The utility model discloses in, the laminating accuracy of sole and vamp is high, and laminating efficiency is fast, and application range is wide.

title_en: Printing device for porcelain production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a printing device is used in porcelain production, including base, brace table and crossbeam, base one end top fixed connection brace table, brace table top fixed connection crossbeam, the base surface is equipped with standing groove and slide, the slide is located the standing groove right side, the standing groove bottom is equipped with rotatory tray, the joint slider in the slide, retaining member lock joint template is passed through on the slider top, the template right side is equipped with the glaze spraying device, electric putter is connected to the crossbeam bottom, electric putter bottom fixed connection pivot, the pivot bottom is equipped with the pressfitting board, relates to stamp porcelain technical field. This printing device for porcelain production reasonable in design, easy operation, the steadiness is strong, can carry out efficient stamp work to the porcelain, conveniently changes the stamp template of different patterns, can carry out the porcelain through pressfitting board and standing groove and fix the position, prevents to add the too big porcelain of leading to of rotatory dynamics to be thrown away and cause the loss man-hour, satisfies the market demand.

title_en: Rolling type cable impressing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rolling type cable embossing device, which comprises a bottom plate, a rolling mechanism and a driving mechanism; a bottom plate: support plates are symmetrically arranged on the left side of the upper surface of the support plate in a left-right mode, the rear ends of the upper surfaces of the two support plates are fixedly connected with the lower surface of the fixed clamping block, the upper surface chutes of the two support plates are respectively in sliding connection with sliding strips correspondingly arranged on the lower surface of the sliding clamping block, the bottom surfaces of the mounting grooves at the upper ends of the fixed clamping block and the sliding clamping block are respectively and rotatably connected with a rotating column, a support is arranged in the middle of the upper surface of the bottom plate, and a rolling frame is arranged on the upper surface of the support; a rolling mechanism: the rolling frame is arranged at the upper end of the rolling frame; a driving mechanism: the left side of the upper surface of the bottom plate is provided with a groove; wherein: still include control switch group, this roll formula cable impression device can carry out the impression of the different degree of depth to the cable of different models, and interval when conveniently controlling the impression can also carry the cable of different models.

title_en: Collective doffing device of flax wet spinning frame
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a flax wet spinning frame collective doffing device relates to flax wet spinning frame technical field. The utility model discloses a rectangle backup pad, the upper end of rectangle backup pad is fixed with the rectangle fixed plate, and one side of rectangle fixed plate is fixed with first motor. The utility model discloses a first motor, first bevel gear, second bevel gear, first screw rod, first straight-toothed gear, the chain, the second straight-toothed gear, the second screw rod, first rectangle connecting rod, mutually supporting of second rectangle connecting rod and rectangle connecting plate, and then can adjust according to the specification of different equipment, the suitability of device has effectively been improved, and through fixed slide bar, square fixed plate, the second motor, the third screw rod, the direction connecting block, the fourth screw rod, square fixed block, splint, mutually supporting of cylinder and rectangle fixed block, can effectually fix the spool, the spool hourglass is got, and then the operating mass with rated load of device has been guaranteed.

title_en: Calico printing machine with locate function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a decorating machine with positioning function, including decorating machine device main part, printing mechanism and defeated material mechanism, the welding of the inside upper end intermediate position department of decorating machine device main part is connected with printing mechanism, the top fixedly connected with of decorating machine device main part is defeated material mechanism, the inside lower extreme central position department of decorating machine device main part installs through bearing rotation and sets up the sleeve pipe, and sets up the inside central position department of sleeve pipe and rotate through the bearing and be connected with the lead screw, the both ends of lead screw all have the movable block by threaded connection, and the upper and lower both ends of two sets of movable blocks all have the welded connection to have the connecting block, the outside of multiunit connecting block is established through the bearing housing and is connected with the transport; the device is through setting up mutually supporting of sleeve pipe, lead screw, movable block, connecting block and transport roller, has avoided the uneven problem that makes cloth or film fold damage of atress appear easily in the mode existence of traditional manual adjustment.

title_en: Bamboo charcoal fiber fly-woven vamp
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bamboo charcoal fiber flying-weaving vamp, which belongs to the field of flying-weaving vamps, and comprises a vamp body, wherein a protective layer is fixedly arranged on the surface of the vamp body in a symmetrical manner, a warm-keeping layer is fixedly arranged on the surface of the protective layer, a hydrophobic layer is fixedly arranged on the surface of the warm-keeping layer, a sweat-absorbing layer is fixedly arranged on the surface of the sweat-absorbing layer, a skin-friendly layer is fixedly arranged on the surface of the sweat-absorbing layer, the flexibility of the vamp body can be improved under the action of the protective layer, the tearing damage of the flying-weaving vamps can be avoided, the warm-keeping performance of the vamp body can be improved under the action of the warm-keeping layer and the hydrophobic layer, the warm-keeping performance of the vamp body can be improved, the water body can be dredged, the permeation problem of moisture can be avoided, the sweat-absorbing performance and the wearing comfort of the vamp body can be improved under the action of the skin-friendly layer, the ankle touch feeling can be improved under the action of the comfortable layer, the elastic bulge and the effect of pressing particles, can slightly massage the foot and face to dredge channels and collaterals.

title_en: Chain stitch rotating shuttle mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of sewing machine, refer in particular to a chain stitch seam rotating shuttle mechanism, including rotating the base, rotating the base on be provided with the main shaft and looper subassembly and dial the line subassembly, the last line ball support that is provided with of rotating the base, the last rotation cover of line ball support is equipped with the line section of thick bamboo that the winding has the bottom line, the front end rigid cover of main shaft has the line cam of sending, rear end and driving source transmission to be connected, the outer end of bottom line supports on the cam surface that sends the line cam through crossing the line subassembly, and the outer end tip of bottom line sets up on the looper subassembly. The utility model discloses the bottom line twines on a thread section of thick bamboo to on its outer end supports the cam surface that send the line cam, drive respectively by the main shaft and send the line cam to rotate, the looper of looper subassembly does circumference reciprocating swing and dial the line bedplate of dialling of line subassembly and do reciprocating sliding all around, make and remain the straight line state of sending of straining all the time at looper reciprocating swing in-process bottom line, can sew up smooth-going chain stitch seam, ensure to possess better the quality of making up.

title_en: Clear water template surface layer composite structure
abstract_en: The application relates to a clear water template surface course composite construction, it includes: leveling the layer and the clear water layer; the flat layer comprises a sheet material and a non-woven fabric, the sheet material and the non-woven fabric are laid and fixed at different angles and in different sequences to form the flat layer, the sheet material is made of a corrosion-resistant material, and one end of the flat layer, far away from the core plate, is connected with a clear water layer; the clear water layer with the core board was kept away from to the tiling layer one end fixed connection, the clear water layer is convenient for the drawing of patterns makes the concrete reach the mirror surface effect. This application has the compound stability and the intensity on tiling layer that has improved, and has improved the effect of the corrosion resistance on tiling layer through non-woven fabrics and the flaky material hot pressing fusion that has corrosion resistance.

title_en: Horse head machine frame and horse head machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a horse head machine frame and horse head machine, horse head machine frame include horse head frame body, shuttle case, as the improvement, horse head frame body and the integrative setting of shuttle case. The utility model discloses frame and horse head machine make the shuttle bed become the support of horse head frame completely, constitute the base of horse head frame through with horse head machine frame and shuttle bed integrated design, compare the obvious base that has enlarged horse head frame of present installation department, the effectual rigidity that has strengthened horse head machine has increased the firm degree of horse head machine to improve horse head machine's stability, be of value to the performance that improves horse head machine. In addition, the length of the horse head cantilever is beneficial to being prolonged, the cantilever with longer length is beneficial to improving the maximum stroke of the horse head machine.

title_en: Belt cleaning device is used in textile raw materials production and processing
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of textile raw materials production and processing, a belt cleaning device is used in textile raw materials production and processing is related to, wherein, the power distribution box comprises a box body, the first bearing of top fixedly connected with of box, first pivot is worn to be equipped with by first bearing internalization, the one end fixedly connected with stirring roller of first pivot, the fixed surface of stirring roller is connected with stirring vane, and stirring vane's quantity has a plurality ofly, the other end of first pivot and the output shaft fixed connection of first motor. Its beneficial effect is, this belt cleaning device is used in textile raw materials production and processing through the setting of dehydration storehouse, electric putter, stripper plate and hole etc. that leaks, extrudees the raw materials after wasing to can dewater textile raw materials, improve the work efficiency of device, through the setting such as second motor, brush, second bearing and second pivot, clean the hole that leaks, avoid the hole that leaks to take place the condition of jam.

title_en: Production of non-woven fabrics is with tailorring device on band-aid
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a non-woven fabrics production is with tailorring device on adhesive bandage, the bracing piece comprises a supporting bar, the equal fixed mounting of one end that is close to each other has first connecting plate between the bracing piece, the one end fixed mounting that is close to each other between two first connecting plates has the bearing, install the live-rollers between two bearings jointly, the erection column is installed to the below of live-rollers, the outer anchor ring fixed mounting of erection column has the sword of tailorring that is the interval setting, the equal fixed mounting in both ends of erection column has the second connecting plate, insert on the second connecting plate and be equipped with vertical ascending locating lever, the bracing piece is kept away from the lower fixed surface of first connecting plate one end and is installed the mounting bracket, the swash plate of the one end fixed mounting that is close to each other between two mounting brackets has the slope form. The utility model discloses at the in-process that uses, can realize controlling the thickness of tailorring of non-woven fabrics, cooperation deburring mechanism carries out the deburring to the non-woven fabrics after tailorring, is favorable to promoting the yield of band-aid, and easy operation is convenient, is favorable to using widely.

title_en: Static electricity removing device for non-woven fabric web former
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of non-woven fabric manufacturing equipment, and discloses a static electricity removing device for a non-woven fabric web former, wherein a static electricity eliminator is arranged at the tail part of the web former, which is close to a hot rolling mill, and the static electricity of a web forming curtain is neutralized by emitting positive and negative charges; an atomizing and humidifying pipe is arranged at the head of the netting machine along the width direction of the netting curtain; one end of the atomization humidifying pipe is connected with the atomization humidifier, and the other end of the atomization humidifying pipe is closed; the horizontal height of one end of the atomization humidification pipe, which is connected with the atomization humidifier, is lower than that of the closed end; the atomizing humidifying pipe is provided with a water mist outlet facing the net forming curtain, and the aperture of the water mist outlet is gradually increased from the end connected with the atomizing humidifier. The utility model discloses an atomizing humidification pipe and updraft ventilator's cooperation can eliminate into the static of wire screen through the humidification on the one hand, ensures water smoke control in the certain limit, directional humidification through updraft ventilator on the one hand.

title_en: Coffee carbon fiber raschel weft knitting fabric
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a coffee carbon fiber raschel weft knitting fabric, which is formed by a veil and a ground yarn through a weft knitting big circle machine, wherein the veil is a coffee carbon fiber composite yarn; the ground yarn is polyester filament yarn, and the coffee carbon fiber composite yarn comprises coffee carbon fiber, cotton fiber and elastic yarn. In the utility model, the coffee carbon fiber composite yarns and the polyester filaments are adopted on the weft circular knitting machine to weave the raschel structure fabric, so that the fabric has strong sweat absorption; the synergistic effect of the coffee carbon, the chitosan and the antibacterial agent is adopted for bacteriostasis and deodorization, so that the bacteriostasis effect is greatly enhanced; furthermore, the utility model discloses a coffee carbon fiber, and then preparation function surface fabric can reduce the ambient pressure and accord with the time theme of "low carbon, environmental protection, health, sustainable" with coffee ground resource utilization.

title_en: Thread trimming and presser foot lifting device of sewing machine
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of sewing equipment, in particular to a thread cutting and presser foot lifting device of a sewing machine; a driving shaft of the driving source is connected with one end of a presser foot lifting and trimming lever through a transmission mechanism, the presser foot lifting and trimming lever is rotatably arranged on the machine shell, the other end of the presser foot lifting and trimming lever is connected with a connecting hole on a trimming driving crank, the trimming driving crank is rotatably arranged on the machine shell, and the other end of the trimming driving crank is connected with a trimming shaft; the presser foot lifting small lever can drive the presser foot arm crank shaft to rotate in one direction and is connected with a presser foot lifting trimming lever through a presser foot lifting lever drag hook; the utility model discloses a driving source realizes lifting presser foot and the drive of trimming action, compact structure, the assembly of being convenient for, reduction in production cost.

title_en: Threading device of sewing machine
abstract_en: The utility model provides a sewing machine threading device adapts to sewing machine's production and application, including aircraft nose and bottom plate, aircraft nose left wall rear side bonds and has the rubber magnetic stripe, and the rubber magnetic stripe left end is inhaled and is had the revolving stage, and the inside scarf joint of revolving stage front side has fluorescent tube, fluorescent tube external power supply, the beneficial effects of the utility model reside in that: the device is characterized in that the rotary table is limited by arranging the lamp tube, the limiting block, the pressure spring, the rubber magnetic strip and the movable block, the lower part of the machine head is illuminated, a user can conveniently observe the threading state and progress subsequently, then the suture is hung on the hook of the thread hook by arranging the plate groove, the connecting plate, the rotating plate, the push plate, the thread hook and the spring rod, the suture is driven to move out of the threading hole under the action of the spring rod, the suture perforation can be conveniently and rapidly completed, and the inconvenience caused by the thread end perforation can be avoided; through setting up interior screwed pipe, intubate and movable block, can avoid the eedle to take place the rigidity contact with hard article, cause the eedle needle body fracture, increase the security performance that the eedle used.

title_en: Ultraviolet (UV) light source processing device with wavelength feedback control
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to UV light source processing field, especially a take wavelength feedback control's ultraviolet UV light source processing apparatus to current ultraviolet UV light source after the transmission, does not carry out corresponding processing, and the ultraviolet UV light source shines measures the individuality after, because the unstability of wavelength, can produce very big influence to the measuring result. The following scheme is proposed at present, and it includes the fixing base, the bottom of fixing base is equipped with UV light source transmitter, the bottom of fixing base is equipped with wavelength feedback controller, wavelength feedback controller and UV light source transmitter electric connection, the utility model discloses rational in infrastructure, the operation is convenient, can adjust the position of two reflectors through driving motor, improves and to UV light source transmission treatment effect, carries out reflection treatment to the UV light source through the reflector panel, has increased the radiant quantity of individual absorption UV light source, plays faster, better solidification effect to the absorption of measuring individual ultraviolet ray.

title_en: Non-woven fabrics screen printing production facility convenient to clearance
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a non-woven fabrics screen printing production facility convenient to clearance, concretely relates to non-woven fabrics production technical field, including base and base frame, one side fixedly connected with fixed column on base top, the bottom fixedly connected with feeding roller of fixed column. The utility model discloses a be provided with the otter board, first fixture block, the second spring, the draw-in groove, the second fixture block, the fixed block, fixing bolt and scraper blade, after the device printing, the otter board that will be full of pigment promotes to one side, the second spring of otter board one side takes place deformation, at this moment alright take out with the second fixture block with the opposite side from the inside of draw-in groove, then take first fixture block out from the draw-in groove again, alright take out with the otter board from the device like this, wash it, the scraper blade that is stained with pigment also can directly be twisted out from between fixed block and the scraper blade with the fixing bolt of scraper blade top both sides, alright clear up with taking off the scraper blade, be convenient for like this to clear up the device, avoid the spot to pile up too much influence printing effect.

title_en: Printing structure of monochromatic screen printing machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a printing structure of a monochromatic screen printing machine, which comprises a frame and a support plate, wherein the lower surface of the frame is fixedly connected with a support leg, the lower end of the support leg is fixedly connected with a pad foot, the upper surface of the frame is fixedly connected with a placing plate, the upper end of the placing plate is provided with a template frame, the center of the template frame is provided with an ink scraping table, the utility model discloses a return ink knife is arranged at the left end of the ink scraping knife, and the ink scraping knife and the ink returning knife are fixed by a fixing clamp, the fixing clamp can adjust the angles of the ink scraping knife and the ink returning knife by a second adjusting valve, then the angle is fixed by a fixing nut, the ink scraping knife scrapes ink leftwards when the angle is adjusted, the ink returning knife gathers ink to the left rightwards for recycling, the waste of the ink can be greatly reduced, the problem of difficult cleaning when the ink is accumulated and solidified is also solved, the time for cleaning and drying the ink by the working personnel is reduced, the working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Drying mechanism of offset press
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a stoving mechanism of offset press, first mount pad and second mount pad that distribute about including, its characterized in that: rotate between first mount pad and the second mount pad and be equipped with cold water roller and deflector roll and fix and be equipped with the UV oven, the UV oven is located the front side of cold water roller, and the UV oven is towards the cooling working face of cold water roller front side, the deflector roll is located the cold water roller under, the outside of first mount pad is equipped with rotary joint, and rotary joint is linked together with the water inlet of cold water roller, the outside of second mount pad is equipped with the power supply, and the power supply links to each other with cold water roller one end transmission. The utility model discloses rational in infrastructure, dry and do not corrugate fast.

title_en: Winding mechanism is used in bandage production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a winding mechanism is used in bandage production relates to bandage production technical field. Including bandage body, leading wheel, clearance mechanism, adjustment mechanism, coiling mechanism and mechanism of flattening, the bandage body loops through leading wheel, clearance mechanism and adjustment mechanism and finally twines to the coiling mechanism on. This winding mechanism is used in bandage production, through setting up adjustment mechanism and winding mechanism, can make the diameter crescent of rolling axle along with the winding of bandage at the in-process of winding mechanism to the bandage rolling, cooperation adjustment mechanism can drive two movable wheels and carry out opposite movement, make the bandage obtain the extension through the distance between two movable wheels, thereby increased the bandage rolling to winding mechanism consuming time, make this mechanism possess the advantage of adjustable rolling speed, the rolling speed of having guaranteed the bandage and the maximum tension phase-match of bandage, the problem of the bandage edge bending unevenness appears easily is solved.

title_en: Fixing device for tailoring of clothing manufacturing cloth
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a clothing manufacturing cloth is tailor and is used fixing device, including bottom plate, conveyer belt and cloth, two mounting panels of last fixed surface of bottom plate are connected with, and swing joint has two transfer rollers between the mounting panel, and the one end of one of them transfer roller passes the mounting panel, transfer roller and conveyer belt swing joint, the last fixed surface of bottom plate is connected with the motor, the first band pulley of one end fixedly connected with of motor output shaft, and one side of first band pulley is equipped with first belt, the one end fixedly connected with second band pulley of one of them transfer roller, and second band pulley and first belt are the round trip, and one side of second band pulley is equipped with the second belt, the last fixed surface of bottom plate is connected with the mount, swing joint has the rotating turret between the mount. The utility model discloses avoid the cloth at the in-process of conveying, the phenomenon of position deviation appears, has solved the problem that can not advance line location to the cloth, has improved the degree of accuracy of tailorring the cloth, satisfies people's requirement.

title_en: Multifunctional ink color developing instrument
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a printing ink color-developing instrument, which discloses a multifunctional printing ink color-developing instrument, comprising a bottom plate, two sides of the upper surface of the bottom plate are connected with side fixing plates, a fixing shaft is arranged between the side fixing plates, a connecting rod B is arranged above the fixing shaft, an ink-evening knife is fixedly connected on the connecting rod B, the rear end of the ink-evening knife is provided with a rotating shaft B, an ink-applying roller is fixedly connected on the rotating shaft B, a rubber roller is arranged below the ink-applying roller, the rubber roller is fixedly connected on a rotating shaft D, two ends of the rotating shaft D are rotatably connected with a connecting block, the bottom end of the connecting block is fixedly connected with a lifting rod, the lifting rod is slidably arranged in a positioning cylinder, the utility model realizes the adjustment of the thickness of the printing ink on the ink-applying roller through a knob A, realizes the adjustment of the height of the rubber roller through the arrangement of the lifting rod, and further realizes the adjustment of the paper pressure by the ink-applying roller, the printing difference caused by different paper thicknesses is avoided, and the accuracy of the device is improved.

title_en: Efficient screen printing screen plate device for stripping screen
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a screen printing equipment for efficiently stripping screen, which comprises a printing base frame and a screen frame, wherein the screen frame is placed on the upper part of the printing base frame, a printing screen is fixedly connected to the middle part of the screen frame, a screen stripping mechanism is arranged on the side edge of the screen frame, and the screen stripping mechanism comprises a screen supporting slider and an upright slide bar; the screen plate frame is characterized in that the number of the upright slide bars is two, the two upright slide bars are longitudinally arranged on two sides of the screen plate frame in a sliding manner, the upper ends of the upright slide bars are fixedly connected with a linkage sliding frame, two pressing toothed bars are rotatably arranged on the linkage sliding frame, and a tension spring is fixedly connected between each pressing toothed bar and the upright slide bar; the net supporting sliding blocks are four in number, the two net supporting sliding blocks on the same side are arranged on two sides of the vertical sliding rod respectively, and the net supporting sliding blocks are arranged on the screen frame in a sliding mode. The utility model discloses a make the stock that holds in the palm the net slider on half tone frame and drive printing silk screen and half tone frame downside stably separate, reduce to shell the printing pattern deformation of net in-process.

title_en: Drying device for digital printing machine
abstract_en: The application relates to a drying device for a digital printing machine, which comprises a shell for drying cloth, wherein a gas collecting pipe communicated with the interior of the shell is fixedly arranged on the shell, and the gas collecting pipe is connected with an air extractor; the outer side walls of the two sides of the gas collecting pipe are provided with mounting holes along the wall thickness direction of the gas collecting pipe in a penetrating manner, and the inner side walls of the two mounting holes are connected with mounting plates in a sliding manner; the mounting plate is provided with a ventilation hole in a penetrating manner along the length direction of the gas collecting pipe, and the inner side wall of the ventilation hole is provided with a filtering piece for filtering flowing gas in the gas collecting pipe; the filter piece comprises a filter screen and an adsorption layer which is positioned on one side of the filter screen close to the air extractor. The mounting panel need not to shut down the calico printing machine by the in-process of replacing to the clearance has been reduced or the change filters the influence to calico printing machine printing efficiency, is favorable to guaranteeing the printing efficiency of calico printing machine.

title_en: Cotton machine is fed to vapour-pressure type
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a cotton machine is fed to vapour-pressure type, which comprises a bod, the organism includes the defeated cotton way of vertical setting, the dust exhaust tuber pipe and is arranged in the first air pump that takes out the gas in the dust exhaust tuber pipe, a plurality of sieve meshes have been seted up on the defeated cotton way inner wall, be equipped with the piece of blowing in the dust exhaust tuber pipe, be used for the second air pump to the air feed of the piece of blowing, be used for the drive to blow the gliding actuating mechanism of piece along defeated cotton way direction of height, the piece butt of blowing is in defeated cotton way outer wall, the piece air outlet of blowing communicates in the sieve mesh. The first air pump pumps out impurities such as air and dust in the cotton conveying channel through the sieve pores through the dust exhaust air pipe, so that raw cotton is pumped in from the upper part of the cotton conveying channel and falls into the machine body through the self weight. Through the setting of blowing piece and actuating mechanism, when the former cotton was adsorbed in defeated cotton way's sieve mesh department by the air current, the piece of blowing removes to this position back through actuating mechanism, blows to defeated cotton in saying through the second air pump, will adsorb the former cotton blow away on defeated cotton way to keep the normal dust work of taking out of sieve mesh all the time.

title_en: Double-sided circular knitting machine
abstract_en: The application relates to a double-sided circular knitting machine, which comprises a dial and a needle cylinder which are vertically arranged, wherein the dial surface of the dial is provided with a plurality of dial grooves along the radial direction, and the cylinder surface of the needle cylinder is provided with a plurality of needle cylinder grooves along the axial direction; the needle cylinder grooves and the needle dial grooves are the same in number and are arranged in a staggered mode; each needle dial groove is internally provided with a transverse latch needle, each needle cylinder groove is internally provided with a vertical latch needle perpendicular to the transverse latch needle, and the horizontal distance between the vertical latch needle and the transverse latch needle adjacent to one side is larger than the horizontal distance between the vertical latch needle and the transverse latch needle adjacent to the other side. title_en: Semi-automatic tiling device of long roll brocade semi-manufactured goods
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a semi-automatic tiling device for long brocade rolls, which comprises: the operation panel, the inside that the both sides of operation panel were provided with transmission case and transmission case is provided with the screw rod, the one end of screw rod extends to the outside of transmission case and the end installs first motor, the upper portion that the surface of screw rod was provided with sliding block and sliding block is provided with the adjustable shelf. The upper end of the adjusting rod extends to the outside of the movable frame and is provided with the hand-operated wheel, the movable blocks are arranged on the surface of the adjusting rod and are in threaded connection with the adjusting rod, the movable blocks can synchronously move in opposite directions through the arrangement, so that the distance between the movable blocks is controlled, the fixed frame is arranged on the side face of each movable block, the first flat paving roller is arranged on the inner side of the fixed frame, the second flat paving roller is arranged on the side face of the other group of movable blocks, and the brocade passes between the first flat paving roller and the second flat paving roller, so that the brocade can be leveled and the uniformity of the brocade can be guaranteed.

title_en: UV makeup machine cleaning device convenient to installation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cleaning device for a UV (ultraviolet) plate splicing machine, which is convenient to install, and comprises a body, wherein the body is prefabricated on the ground, and guide grooves are formed in two sides of the body; the connecting seats are connected by adopting connecting rods; the spray head is arranged above the connecting rod and is arranged between the connecting seats; the water tank is arranged on the left side of the body, and a filter screen is arranged in the water tank; the collector, the collector with install the inboard at basin and connecting seat, and the collector adopts retractable. This UV makeup machine cleaning device convenient to installation can spray water to the device surface under the effect of shower nozzle to the cooperation scraper blade is used, can increase the scavenging degree under the scraper blade effect, and the effect that receives the telescopic link simultaneously makes the device can carry out the back-and-forth movement along the body automatically, the effectual portability that has increased the device, and the in-process collector setting of using simultaneously can play a collection effect to sewage.

title_en: Quantitative let-off roller of water-jet loom
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a quantitative let-off roller of a water-jet loom, which comprises a fixed table, a let-off mechanism and a bearing plate, wherein the let-off mechanism is arranged at the top of the fixed table and consists of a motor, a frame, a correlation photoelectric sensor, a let-off roller and a PLC (programmable logic controller), the motor is arranged on the outer side wall of the frame, the let-off roller is arranged at the output end of the motor, the PLC is arranged on the outer side wall of the fixed table, and the correlation photoelectric sensor is arranged on both the outer side wall of the frame and the outer side wall of the let-off roller. The warp let-off mechanism can accurately let off warp for convenient use by personnel, and the alarm system can alarm the broken yarn to avoid influencing the warp let-off efficiency.

title_en: Clamping device in button sewing machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a clamping device in a button sewing machine, relating to the technical field of sewing machines, and the key points of the technical scheme are as follows: including arm lock mechanism, the bottom plate, demountable installation has the sharp driving source on the bottom plate, the output of sharp driving source cooperatees with arm lock mechanism and makes the sharp driving source can control arm lock mechanism and carry out the centre gripping or loosen the button, still install the rotary driving source on the bottom plate, the output of rotary driving source is fixed with the push rod, the output of push rod can touch or promote the button, under the effect of sharp driving source, arm lock mechanism carries out the centre gripping to the button, when the centre gripping is accomplished, rotary driving source acts on the push rod, make the push rod arrive the assigned position, this assigned position is the position that the button is target in place by the centre gripping just, when the button centre gripping targets in place, the push rod touches with the button, when button slope or skew, the push rod can push it to the position that the centre gripping targets in place, finally reach the effect of rectifying the position of button.

title_en: Device is tailor to product collection decorative cloth of being convenient for
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of decorative cloth processing, in particular to a cutting device for conveniently collecting decorative cloth, which comprises a cutting bottom plate and a first fixing plate, wherein a dust collector is arranged below the cutting bottom plate, a supporting column plate is arranged above the cutting bottom plate, a leakage opening penetrates through the cutting bottom plate, a pipeline is connected below the leakage opening, a waste collection box is fixed below the pipeline, a sliding trolley is embedded on the surface of the cutting bottom plate, a decorative cloth brush is arranged above the sliding trolley, and the upper part of the sliding trolley is connected with a telescopic plate, the first fixing plate and the second fixing plate are connected through a sliding stick, the surface of the sliding stick is connected with a sliding block, and the cutting knife is inlayed to the below of sliding block, the top of tailorring the bottom plate is connected with the conveyer belt, and the cutting cloth collecting box is installed to the below of conveyer belt. This device is tailor to product collection decorative cloth of being convenient for has garbage collection and is convenient for collect the product of tailorring.

title_en: Label printing machine with drying function
abstract_en: A label printing machine with a drying function relates to the technical field of printing devices and comprises a net rack, an embedded block, filter cloth, a fixed frame, a movable plate, a limiting column and a reset spring; the net rack is of a circular ring structure, the upper part of the net rack is provided with a placing groove, and the inner walls of the two transverse sides of the placing groove are provided with limiting holes; the number of the embedded blocks is two, the two embedded blocks are respectively arranged at the two transverse sides of the net rack, and the embedded blocks are positioned below the limiting holes; the filter cloth is arranged in the placing groove; the fixing frame is arranged in the placing groove, is positioned above the filter cloth and is of a circular ring structure, and two cavities are formed in the fixing frame and are respectively positioned on the two transverse sides of the inner circle; the two moving plates are arranged in the two cavities in a sliding mode respectively and slide along the transverse direction. The filter cloth rack can facilitate cleaning and replacement of the filter cloth, and the filter cloth can be fixed on the rack, so that the filter cloth rack is convenient for workers to use.

title_en: Cloth cutter
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cloth cutting knife which comprises a cloth cutting machine and a base arranged below the cloth cutting machine, wherein a supporting rod is arranged on the base, the top of the supporting rod is fixedly arranged below the cloth cutting machine, telescopic supporting components are arranged on the outer walls of two opposite sides of the supporting rod respectively, each supporting component comprises a first supporting column and a second supporting column arranged in the first supporting column in a sliding mode, one end of each first supporting column is hinged to the corresponding supporting rod, a first sliding groove is correspondingly formed in the base, a sliding seat is arranged in the first sliding groove in a sliding mode, and one end of each second supporting column is hinged to the corresponding sliding seat. According to the cloth cutting knife provided by the utility model, the supporting component is locked through the locking fastener, and then one end of the second supporting column is hinged to the sliding seat, namely, the two side walls of the supporting rod can be supported when the locking fastener locks the first supporting column and the second supporting column, so that the supporting stability of the supporting rod can be improved, and the stability of the supporting rod relative to the base is improved.

title_en: Paper rolling rewetting device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a paper rolling and rewetting device, which belongs to the technical field of paper production equipment and comprises a control system, a water storage tank, a water pump and a rewetting unit, wherein the water pump and the rewetting unit are respectively and electrically connected with the control system; the rewetting unit comprises a rewetting component and a water baffle which are arranged in parallel, a paper feeding gap is arranged between the rewetting component and the water baffle, and paper to be rewetted passes through the paper feeding gap through an upper traction roller and a lower traction roller; in the rewetting component, a plurality of throwing disks are uniformly arranged along the length direction of the bottom plate at intervals, so that water can be thrown out to carry out rewetting treatment on paper. The linear velocity sensor is arranged in the rewetting device, the water supply speed and the water supply quantity of the rewetting device can be adjusted in real time according to the traction speed of the paper, the rewetting process is controllable, the rewetting is more uniform, and the rewetting quality of the paper can be ensured; meanwhile, the rewetting device can be additionally arranged on the existing paper winding machine, the whole winding machine is not required to be transformed, and therefore the equipment investment cost is low.

title_en: Color printing packaging printing machine equipment with dust removal device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses color printing packaging printing machine equipment with a dust removal device, which relates to the technical field of color printing packaging printing machines and comprises a printing chamber arranged at the top of a machine base, wherein the top of the printing chamber is provided with a dust collection hole; further comprising: the silencer is arranged in the dust hood and comprises an installation plate which is detachably installed at the top of the dust hood, the bottom of the installation plate is installed and covered outside the dust absorption hole, an inner hood body made of silencing materials is fixed at the inner top of the inner hood body, an inverted splitter cone is fixed at the inner top of the inner hood body, a plurality of air outlets located on the side face of the splitter cone are formed in the side face of the inner hood body, and a gap is reserved between the inner hood body and the dust hood; the silencer is used for silencing by shunting the airflow, so that the silencing effect on the dust hood is better, the structure is simple, and the practicability is high.

title_en: Label printing ink dosing unit
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a label printing ink batching device, which comprises an ink batching device main body, wherein an ink box cover is arranged on the outer surface of the upper end of the ink batching device main body, a three-primary-color ink box is arranged at the lower end of the ink box cover, a flow monitoring device is arranged at the lower end of the three-primary-color ink box, the flow monitoring device comprises a flow control system, a flow meter and a flow output port, a data communication interface end is arranged on the outer surface of one side of the flow monitoring device, an ink mixing box is arranged at the lower end of the flow monitoring device, the ink mixing box comprises a mixing cylinder, a funnel bottom and a mixing box output port, a mixing and stirring system is arranged in the ink mixing box, and the mixing and stirring system comprises a base stirring seat, a supporting frame, a stirring shaft center and stirring blades. The label printing ink batching device provided by the utility model has the advantages of electric control blending, accurate color, high ink utilization rate, no residue, bright color and the like, and brings better use prospect.

title_en: Sizing material information impression device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a sizing material information imprinting device, which belongs to the field of automobile manufacturing equipment and comprises a main wheel, character blocks and a pressing plate, wherein the side surface of the main wheel is provided with a plurality of grooves distributed along the circumferential direction, the grooves extend along the axis direction of the main wheel, one end of each groove, which is positioned on the top surface of the main wheel, is opened, one end, which is close to the bottom surface of the main wheel, is closed, the cross section of each groove is trapezoidal, and the top surface of each groove is positioned on the outer peripheral surface of the main wheel; the character block is detachably arranged in the groove; the pressing plate is detachably and fixedly connected with the top surface of the main wheel and mutually extrudes the main wheel to fix the character block in the groove. The utility model solves the technical problems that the prior manual writing can not prevent errors and the product quality can not be ensured, and has the characteristics of capability of effectively ensuring that the produced semi-finished rubber material has correct surface information, high efficiency and good quality.

title_en: Woven belt with appearance pattern changed after stretching
abstract_en: The woven belt with the appearance pattern changed after stretching comprises a woven belt main body, wherein the woven belt main body comprises at least two sides and at least one basic elastic unit, the basic elastic unit comprises at least two low-modulus regions and at least two high-modulus regions with different elastic moduli, the high-modulus regions are connected with the low-modulus regions, the low-modulus regions are connected with the sides of the woven belt main body, the basic elastic units are circularly arranged along the length direction or the width direction of the woven belt main body, and the elasticity of the high-modulus regions is larger than that of the low-modulus regions. The elastic garment is elastic in the transverse direction and the longitudinal direction, can perfectly fit the curve of a human body in the wearing process, can present different appearance novelty effects according to the change of the curve of the human body, and is novel, unique and fashionable in appearance; the design can perfectly and evenly stretch the woven belt along the motion curvature of the human body, thereby meeting the requirement of human engineering and ensuring that the underwear is very close to the skin, breathable and the like.

title_en: Sewing device for sheet production
abstract_en: The utility model provides a sewing device for sheet production, includes sewing machine body, sleeve pipe, syringe needle, fixed frame, fly leaf, locating lever, thrust spring, pull rod and draws the piece, sheathed tube activity is pegged graft in sewing machine body's aircraft nose bottom, the syringe needle activity is pegged graft in sheathed tube inside, the locating hole that runs through is all seted up to the both sides of syringe needle surface, fixed frame fixed connection is in the sheathed tube outside, fly leaf swing joint is in the inside of fixed frame, locating lever fixed connection is in one side of fly leaf, the one end of locating lever runs through fixed frame and activity and pegs graft in the inside of locating hole. The utility model enables the positioning rod to be separated from the positioning hole on the needle head, and the needle head can be taken down for replacement by pulling the needle head downwards, thereby having simple operation and convenient use, improving the working efficiency, having limited effect on the position of the needle head, preventing the needle head from rotating and improving the use effect.

title_en: Multifunctional baby toothbrush
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional toothbrush for babies, which comprises a handle, a brush head, a first tongue scraper, a second tongue scraper and a third tongue scraper, wherein the first tongue scraper comprises a plurality of semi-spherical salient points which are arranged at intervals, the second tongue scraper comprises a plurality of semi-annular silica gel sheets which are arranged at intervals, the third tongue scraper comprises a plurality of crescent-shaped convex blocks which are arranged at intervals, and the first tongue scraper, the second tongue scraper and the third tongue scraper are respectively arranged on the back surface of the brush head or the front surface of the other end of the handle or the back surface of the other end of the handle. This design adopts brush head and tongue scraper to combine as an organic whole, adopts the tongue scraper of multiple different designs, and parents can adopt the tongue scraper of the different positions of toothbrush as required to carry out the oral cavity to baby and child and clean, convenient to use adopts food level silica gel preparation safety and sanitation.

title_en: Zipper transverse tension protection mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a zipper transverse fixed tension protection mechanism, which is characterized in that: the automatic material-knotting device comprises a material-finishing sensor, a knotting limiter, a floating roller, a front power traction roller and a rear power traction roller which are sequentially arranged along a zipper conveying path, wherein a fixed roller is arranged between the front power traction roller and the rear power traction roller, a front swing roller and a rear swing roller are arranged below the fixed roller, the front swing roller and the rear swing roller are arranged on a swing arm, the swing arm is connected with a tension cylinder, the swing arm is also connected with a potentiometer, and the running speed of the front power traction roller is adjusted and controlled by a potential output signal of the potentiometer. The zipper bag making machine can ensure constant tension of the zipper in the bag making process, can timely find out the zipper problem and stop the operation of the bag making machine, avoids the generation of waste bags, and can prevent the zipper from being broken.

title_en: Reverse dull polish printing system of packing carton
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a reverse frosted printing system for a packing box, which comprises a rack, wherein a first conveying mechanism and a second conveying mechanism are respectively arranged on one side, from left to right, opposite to the rack, the left side of the top of the rack is fixedly connected with a printing device, the left side of the front surface of the rack is fixedly connected with a box body, the top of the left side of the box body is provided with a fan through a support, an air inlet pipe of the fan is fixedly communicated with the left side of the box body, the bottom of the right side of the box body is fixedly communicated with a connecting pipe, and one end, far away from the box body, of the connecting pipe penetrates through an inner cavity of the printing device. The utility model solves the problems that the prior reverse frosted printing device can generate more volatile gas with pungent smell in the processing process, can not treat the volatile gas, has poor environmental protection effect, can not well level paper, is easy to have wrong printing, missing printing and the like in the printing process, and reduces the printing quality.

title_en: Printhead assembly and printer
abstract_en: The utility model provides a printing head assembly and a printer, and relates to the technical field of printers. The printhead assembly includes: the fixed plate, the mount pad, beat the printer head, left locking screw and right locking screw, through rotatory left adjusting screw, can make left adjusting screw take place relative motion in the front-back direction for left boss, because the left stopper and the fixed plate of the tail end of left adjusting screw are connected again, therefore, when rotatory left adjusting screw, left boss and fixed plate take place relative motion, that is to say, beat the left side of printer head and adjusted in the front-back direction, the same thing, behind the rotatory right adjusting screw, can change and beat the fore-and-aft position on printer head right side, can make the parallel of the side of printer head and the side of printing the rubber roll through rotatory left adjusting screw and right adjusting screw, the two adjusts parallel back, reuse left locking screw and right locking screw and fix fixed plate and mount pad lock, burr problem appears when avoiding the bill to print.

title_en: Full-automatic coding machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a full-automatic coding machine, which comprises a coding machine body, a spray head, an adjusting mechanism and an avoiding mechanism, wherein the spray head is connected with the avoiding mechanism, and the avoiding mechanism is connected with the coding machine body through the adjusting mechanism; can place the integrated device beside the conveyer in the in-service use of the production, and wait to beat sign indicating number article through the conveyer transportation, when waiting to beat sign indicating number article through the shower nozzle below, beat the sign indicating number article and beat the sign indicating number article through the shower nozzle and beat the sign indicating number, when piling up or waiting to beat the sign indicating number article and come the shower nozzle the place ahead erect, accessible distance inductor response object, and with signal transmission to beating the sign indicating number machine body, control first driving piece operation afterwards, make first driving piece drive chain and slider, and drive adapter sleeve and shower nozzle through the slider and rise, can avoid not putting waiting to beat that the sign indicating number article causes the collision to the shower nozzle of beating the sign indicating number machine from this, it is impaired to prevent to beat the sign indicating number machine shower nozzle, guarantee the precision of beating the sign indicating number.

title_en: Textile calender
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a textile calender, which comprises a workbench, wherein one end of the workbench is provided with a fabric roller to be calendered, the fabric roller to be calendered is provided with a fabric roll to be calendered, the other end of the workbench is provided with a calendering fabric roller, the calendering fabric roller is provided with a calendering fabric roll, the workbench between the fabric roller to be calendered and the calendering fabric roller is provided with a guide roller, a heating roller and a calendering device, the calendering device comprises a plurality of calendering units, each calendering unit comprises an adjustable upper press roller part and a fixed lower press roller, the fabric to be calendered of the fabric roll to be calendered on the fabric roller to be calendered sequentially winds through the guide roller and the heating roller to enter the calendering device, the fabric entering the calendering device is calendered by the plurality of calendering units to form a calendering fabric, and the calendering fabric is wound on the fabric calendering roller to form a calendering fabric roll. The utility model adopts the scheme of the textile calender with the calendering devices with a plurality of calendering units and has the characteristic of good calendering effect.

title_en: Production of paper recycle bags is with bag end rubber coating device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of production of paper environment-friendly bags and discloses a bag bottom gluing device for production of paper environment-friendly bags. This rubber coating device is used at bottom of bag for production of paper recycle bag, through second electric telescopic handle's setting, second electric telescopic handle's flexible height that can change the push pedal, the push pedal can be extruded the glue solution, and the glue solution can drop on the recycle bag under the effect of gravity, and control second electric telescopic handle's elongation is controlled, control glue coat amount that can be accurate, is convenient for guarantee the quality of recycle bag.

title_en: Printing steel mesh cleaning machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of cleaning of printing steel meshes, in particular to a cleaning machine for printing steel meshes, which comprises a cleaning box, a first motor and a second motor, wherein a rail plate is fixedly connected to the upper side in the cleaning box, a sliding plate is slidably connected to the inner side of the rail plate, a transmission rod is rotatably connected to the right end of the sliding plate, a rotating rod is rotatably connected to the right end of the transmission rod, the first motor is arranged at the rear side of the right end of the rotating rod, the rotating rod is rotatably connected with the first motor through an output shaft, and a cleaning brush is rotatably connected to the lower end of the sliding plate. The cleaning effect of the printing steel mesh is improved.

title_en: Spray-drawing machine shower nozzle device of moisturizing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a spray head moisturizing device of an inkjet printer, which comprises a spraying shell and a water tank, wherein the bottom of the spraying shell is connected with the water tank through an angle steel sheet, the bottom end inside the spraying shell is movably connected with a rotary cylinder, the inside of the rotary cylinder is movably connected with a threaded cylinder, the top of the rotary cylinder is provided with a water receiving box, the bottom end inside the water receiving box is provided with a second spray head, two groups of fixed blocks are respectively welded on two sides inside the spraying shell in an opposite mode, and a transverse plate is fixed between the two sides above the inside of the spraying shell. This inkjet printer shower nozzle device of moisturizing is through welding between the both sides of the inside bottom in basin the filter, and the waste water after the clearance first shower nozzle falls into the basin along the logical groove of a small section of thick bamboo, section of thick bamboo and bottom soon along the small opening, handles partial large particulate matter through the absorption separation of filter plate, alright open the water pump through the leading-in second shower nozzle of tee bend head and two-way shunt tubes after will purifying water and carry out cyclic utilization to practice thrift the processing cost, solved the problem that can't utilize waste water.

title_en: Body type measuring device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a body type measuring device which comprises a measuring device body, wherein the measuring device body comprises a base, an upright rod and a cross rod, two ends of the upright rod are respectively and fixedly connected with the base and the cross rod, and the cross rod is parallel to the base; the base comprises a load-bearing light-transmitting plate, a 2D scanning camera module and a weighing sensor, the 2D scanning camera module and the weighing sensor are arranged below the load-bearing light-transmitting plate, and when the sole is placed on the load-bearing light-transmitting plate, the 2D scanning camera module scans the sole through the load-bearing light-transmitting plate; the ultrasonic radar sensor is arranged on the cross rod and is arranged on one side of the cross rod, which is far away from the vertical rod; the display device is arranged on the upright rod and used for displaying the measurement result; by measuring the height, the weight, the foot length and the foot width of a human body and using the body type data of the human body calculated by an algorithm, the chest circumference, the waist circumference and the hip circumference values of the human body are conveniently and quickly obtained; and non-contact measurement is adopted, so that the operation is simple and convenient, the measurement precision is high, and the error is small.

title_en: Gravure ink groove
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intaglio ink groove, which comprises a groove body, wherein the inside of the groove body is provided with an ink groove, the ink groove is of a top opening structure, the middle position of the side wall on one side of the groove body is provided with an ink inlet, the ink inlet is communicated with the inside of the ink groove, the two sides of the side wall on the other side of the groove body are respectively provided with a first ink outlet and a second ink outlet, the first ink outlet and the second ink outlet are both communicated with the inside of the ink groove, the inner sides of the side walls on the two sides of the ink groove are both of an arc structure, and the two sides of the top of the ink groove are both provided with printing roller placing grooves. According to the utility model, the traditional rectangular three-dimensional groove is designed into the ink groove of which the inner sides of the side walls on the two sides are of the arc-shaped structures, so that the problems that after the traditional rectangular three-dimensional groove is used for a long time, some ink residues are often left at the four right-angled corners in the groove, and the cleaning is inconvenient are effectively solved, and the practicability of the ink groove is improved.

title_en: Cotton suction device for non-woven fabric lapping machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cotton suction device for a non-woven fabric lapping machine, which comprises a base, wherein the upper end of the base is fixedly connected with a U-shaped support frame, a transversely arranged support transverse plate is fixedly connected in the base, the front side of the upper end of the support transverse plate is fixedly connected with a collecting box positioned in the U-shaped support frame, the upper surface of the base is rotatably connected with a screw rod, the upper end of the screw rod penetrates through the upper surface of the support transverse plate and is rotatably connected with the inner wall of the upper end of the U-shaped support frame, the lower surface of the support transverse plate is fixedly provided with a driving motor positioned below a movable door, the output shaft of the driving motor is fixedly connected with a rotating rod, the lower end of the rotating rod is rotatably connected with the upper surface of the base, and the outer circumferential surface of the screw rod is in threaded connection with a lifting block positioned above the support transverse plate. The cotton suction device is compact in structure and low in manufacturing cost, cotton fibers floating at different heights can be sucked, the sucking efficiency is improved, the waste of the cotton fibers is avoided, and the cotton suction device is environment-friendly and practical.

title_en: Feeding mechanism of sewing machine
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of sewing machines, and relates to a feeding mechanism of a sewing machine, which comprises a main motor, a cloth feeding motor, a tooth frame and feeding teeth fixed on the upper end surface of the tooth frame, wherein the main motor is connected with one end of the tooth frame through a tooth lifting mechanism, the tooth frame is driven to reciprocate up and down when the main motor rotates, the cloth feeding motor is connected with the other end of the tooth frame through the cloth feeding mechanism, the cloth feeding motor rotates back and forth within a certain angle to drive the tooth frame to reciprocate back and forth, the cloth feeding mechanism comprises a driven shaft, the driven shaft is arranged in parallel with a feeding shaft, and the driven shaft is simultaneously in transmission connection with the feeding shaft and an output shaft of the cloth feeding motor. The feeding mechanism of the sewing machine provided by the utility model improves the reliability, durability and stability of the cloth feeding mechanism by adding the driven shaft.

title_en: Double-sided steel wire type multi-comb jacquard mesh
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a double-sided steel wire type multi-comb jacquard mesh which comprises a three-layer structure, namely a surface layer, a connecting layer and a bottom layer from top to bottom, wherein the bottom layer and the surface layer are connected through the connecting layer; the surface layer is provided with jacquard textures; the bottom layer is provided with jacquard textures; the jacquard textures on the surface layer are the same or different; the jacquard textures on the bottom layer are the same or different; the jacquard textures of the surface layer and the bottom layer are the same or different; according to the jacquard signal conversion method, the original single signal is converted into multiple signals, and the needle moving requirements of jacquard combs at different positions are met; the machine table steel wire comb is a double-sided steel wire comb and can be designed according to actual requirements; the flexibility of yarn tension is improved by installing a mature creel let-off system; to meet the current personalized requirements.

title_en: Auxiliary material receiving device for production of recycled paper pulp
abstract_en: The utility model provides an auxiliary material receiving device for producing regenerated paper pulp, which comprises an inlet layer, a decomposition swelling layer, a coarse paper layer, a fine paper layer, a paper pulp stirring layer, a heavy slag remover, a light slag remover, a paper pulp container, a waste residue container, a waste water pipeline and a paper pulp output pipeline, wherein a pressure stabilizing pump and a balance bag with a breathing valve are arranged on the waste water pipeline, a paper pulp pump is arranged on the paper pulp output pipeline, a vertical pipe is arranged at the output end of the paper pulp pump, a movable pipeline assembly is arranged on the vertical pipe, the output end of the movable pipeline assembly is positioned in the paper pulp container, a venturi pipe is arranged on the paper pulp output pipeline, an injection pipe is arranged at the output end of the venturi pipe, a one-way valve is arranged at the output end of the injection pipe, and the output end of the one-way valve is connected with the paper pulp container. The waste residue circulation efficiency of this device is high, and the pipeline prevents that the jam effect is better, reasonable in design moreover, simple structure, the ejection of compact is higher with the material receiving efficiency, and the practicality is stronger, and the utilization ratio is higher, is fit for extensive the popularization.

title_en: Cutter device of high-speed bag making machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cutter device of a high-speed bag making machine, which comprises a straight cylinder, wherein a vertical rod is in clearance fit with the inner wall of the straight cylinder, a cutter is arranged below the vertical rod, a rotating structure is arranged on one side of the straight cylinder, the rotating structure comprises a transverse block, a first spring, a straight rod, a sliding block, a sliding rod, a transverse rod and a rotating rod, one end of the sliding rod is fixedly connected with one end of the straight cylinder, and the sliding block is clamped on the outer wall of the sliding rod in a sliding manner. This cutters of high-speed system bag machine, through the cutter, the diaphragm, the montant, a straight section of thick bamboo, and a housing, the square plate, the cooperation of rotating-structure and removal structure, the rotation threaded rod, the threaded rod drives straight piece and outwards removes, straight piece drives the down tube and removes, the down tube drives the bolt rebound, make the bolt leave the horizontal pole, the downshifting straight-bar, the straight-bar drives the slider downshifting, the slider drives the bull stick downshifting, rotate the bull stick, make the horizontal pole leave the bull stick, and then the staff of being convenient for changes the beveling sword, the staff of being convenient for operates, the staff of being convenient for uses.

title_en: Multilayer high strength corrugated container board
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multilayer high-strength corrugated board, which comprises: a paper board is put; a first wave core paper layer arranged on the lower paper board; the reinforcing layer is arranged on the first wavy core paper layer and is provided with reinforcing columns which are closely arranged, and bonding glue is filled in gaps among the reinforcing columns; the second wavy core paper layer is arranged on the reinforcing layer and is symmetrically arranged with the first wavy core paper layer; and the upper paperboard is arranged on the second wavy core paper layer.
