According to the utility model, the first wavy core paper layer and the second wavy core paper layer are arranged symmetrically, the reinforcing layer is arranged between the first wavy core paper layer and the second wavy core paper layer, and the reinforcing layer is provided with the reinforcing columns which are closely arranged. The structure greatly increases the strength of the corrugated board, so that the corrugated board is not easy to damage.

title_en: Intelligent production line is with gloves printing device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of glove production devices, and discloses a glove printing device for an intelligent production line, which solves the problem that the existing glove printing device for the intelligent production line cannot clamp gloves conveniently during working; make this device can press from both sides tightly at the convenient adversary's cover of during operation to can install and dismantle first cylinder as required convenient, the position of change movable block that simultaneously can be random, so that use the job scene of different width, thereby avoided the problem that influences the stamp effect, and then improved the practicality of this device.

title_en: Textile yarn capable of improving strength
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of spinning, in particular to a textile yarn capable of improving strength, which comprises a yarn main body, a tenacity mechanism, a clip mechanism and an anti-static mechanism, wherein the tenacity mechanism is arranged inside the yarn main body and comprises an inner wire, the inner wire is arranged inside the yarn main body, an upper tangent plane is arranged at one end of the inner wire, a lower tangent plane is arranged at the other end of the inner wire, and the clip mechanism is arranged outside the tenacity mechanism. The utility model adopts six groups of single winding wires which are twisted into one yarn, and the tenacity mechanism is arranged in each group of single winding wires, so that the tensile toughness is improved, the clip mechanism is arranged outside the tenacity mechanism, the yarn is formed by splicing two groups of fibers, so that the air-permeable resilience is good, the shaping of the yarn body is ensured, and the anti-static mechanism is arranged outside, so that the effect of efficiently improving the strength of the spun yarn in all aspects is achieved.

title_en: Traditional Chinese medicine pill rubbing and printing device for pediatrics
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a traditional Chinese medicine pill rubbing device for pediatrics, wherein when the rubbing device is used, traditional Chinese medicine pills are placed into a medicine feeding hole, a rotating handle on a power mechanism is rotated to enable a threaded rod to rotate, the threaded rod can drive a moving block and an extrusion block to descend under the effect of the threaded connection with the moving block when rotating, the extrusion block can extrude a mounting disc to descend while descending, an extrusion column extends into the medicine feeding hole to extrude the medicine pills, and the lower end of the extrusion column is provided with patterns, so that the patterns are printed on the traditional Chinese medicine pills, the attractiveness of the outer portion of the traditional Chinese medicine pills is increased, the curiosity of children is improved, the tension and psychological resistance of the children are reduced, and the children can be more easily matched with the function of medicine treatment. After the medicine stamp is manufactured, the pulling ring is pulled, the supporting disc of the pulling ring is pulled out through the pulling rod, and the printed traditional Chinese medicine pills can be pulled out through the supporting disc, so that the function of taking out the printed traditional Chinese medicine pills conveniently is realized.

title_en: Paper cutter for carton production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of paper cutters and discloses a paper cutter for carton production, which comprises a supporting mechanism, a transmission mechanism, a cutting mechanism and a dust collection mechanism, wherein the supporting mechanism comprises a base, supporting legs are fixedly arranged at the lower end of the base, supporting pads are fixedly arranged at the lower ends of the supporting legs, the transmission mechanism comprises a workbench, the workbench is positioned at the upper end of the base, a front transmission belt is fixedly arranged at the left end of the upper end of the workbench, a rear transmission belt is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the workbench in a movable manner, and limiting plates are fixedly arranged at the front end and the rear end of the upper end of the workbench. This a paper cutter for carton production utilizes two-way lead screw to rotate, can be when needs adjust cutting mechanism's cutting size, two-way regulation to cutting mechanism, the effectual convenience that has improved, and two-way lead screw transmission stability is stronger, and the regulation of size is more accurate, further improvement the precision of regulation.

title_en: Plane screen printing machine and circular knife cross cutting machine combination equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of printing and die cutting combined equipment, and provides combined equipment of a plane screen printer and a circular knife die cutting machine, which comprises a die cutting rack, wherein a feed roller for placing raw materials is installed at one end of the die cutting rack, the discharge end of the feed roller is connected with the feed end of a deviation correcting device, the discharge end of the deviation correcting device is connected with the feed end of a first conveying knife holder, the discharge end of the first conveying knife holder is connected with the feed end of the plane screen printer, the plane screen printer is arranged on the die cutting rack in a reciprocating sliding manner through a reciprocating driving mechanism, the discharge end of the plane screen printer is connected with the feed end of a second conveying knife holder, the discharge end of the second conveying knife holder is connected with the feed end of the die cutting knife holder, and the discharge end of the die cutting knife holder is connected with a first material receiving roller. The utility model solves the problems of long product manufacturing period, low production efficiency and high rejection rate of the traditional process of printing first and then die cutting.

title_en: Printing system for reducing static electricity in composite printing process
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a printing system for reducing static electricity in a composite printing process, which comprises an ink cylinder, a printing plate, a composite roller, a paper guide roller, a water brush and a water tank, wherein the printing plate is positioned in the ink cylinder, the composite roller is positioned above the printing plate, printing paper passes through the printing plate and the composite roller, the paper guide roller is used for guiding the composite paper into the position between the printing plate and the composite roller and realizing the composite with the printing paper, the water brush is partially soaked in the water tank, and the water brush is contacted with the paper guide roller and rotates along with the paper guide roller and is used for wetting the paper guide roller and the composite paper. In the utility model, the composite roller can effectively reduce bubbles in the composite sample sheet, and has the functions of compounding, uniformly grinding and defoaming. The guide paper roll is humidified through the water brush, so that static on the surface of the composite film can be effectively reduced, and safe and quick printing is facilitated. The printing system has the advantages of simple structure, convenient operation and convenient maintenance.

title_en: Forming machine is used in processing of paper support
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a setting machine for processing paper holders, which comprises a bottom plate, a lifting frame and a top plate, wherein the lifting frame and the top plate are arranged on the top end of the bottom plate, the top end of the bottom plate is connected with a setting frame, two sides of the top end surface of the lifting frame are both connected with hydraulic rods, the bottom end of the bottom plate is provided with an evaporator, the evaporator is communicated with a plurality of forming grooves formed in the top end of the setting frame through pipelines, the bottom end of the lifting frame is provided with a mounting groove which is inosculated with the gaps of the forming grooves, a dividing knife is embedded in the mounting groove, the top end of the lifting frame is provided with a driving piece which drives the dividing knife to move, the shape of the mounting groove is changed according to the number and the position of the forming grooves, and the bottom end of the bottom plate is provided with supporting rods in a rectangular array.

title_en: Scraper blade subassembly, screen printing mechanism and printing machine
abstract_en: The application provides a scraper blade subassembly, screen printing mechanism and printing machine, wherein the scraper blade subassembly includes the backup pad and disposes the guide bar of backup pad below, slidable elastic connection ink scraping plate on the guide bar, the backup pad top is configured with the limiting plate, the height that highly equals of limiting plate is located the difference in height of silk screen board and ampoule below the ink scraping plate. The thickness of the ink coated on the body of the ampoule bottle can be increased.

title_en: Hand-held ink-jet printer
abstract_en: The utility model provides a handheld ink-jet printer which comprises a shell, a travelling mechanism, an ink-jet mechanism, a control device and a handheld mechanism, wherein the travelling mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the shell, the control device is connected with the travelling mechanism and the ink-jet mechanism, and the ink-jet mechanism comprises a spray head and the handheld mechanism is arranged at the top of the shell. The utility model has the beneficial effects that: the utility model has the advantages of compact mechanism, reduced labor intensity, improved working efficiency, use of large-package ink agent, reduced use cost, less possibility of precipitation and blockage when the pigment ink agent is used due to the design of the circulating pipeline, and reduced failure rate.

title_en: Data security device for water conservancy construction cost
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a data security device for water conservancy construction cost, which comprises a shell, wherein an inner stirring barrel is fixedly arranged in an inner cavity of the shell, a control valve is fixedly arranged at a discharge port at the bottom of the inner stirring barrel, a discharge pipe is fixedly arranged at a discharge port at the bottom of the control valve, a bracket is welded and arranged in the middle of the top of the shell, a driving motor is fixedly arranged in the middle of the top of the shell and positioned in the inner cavity of the bracket, a driving end of the driving motor is fixedly connected with a stirring shaft, one end of the stirring shaft is positioned in the inner stirring barrel, and feeding pipes are fixedly arranged at feeding ports on two sides of the top of the inner stirring barrel. This a secret device of data for water conservancy cost makes paper pulp back with the wastepaper, opens the control valve and gets rid of the sewer with the thick liquid through the blow off pipe for the cost data is destroyed more thoroughly, and unable the recovery avoids leaking, has also avoided the potential safety hazard problem that traditional fire exists.

title_en: Transfer printing device for producing automobile parts
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pad printing device for producing automobile parts, which comprises an ink storage tank and a through pipe, wherein the side wall of the ink storage tank is fixedly communicated with the through pipe, ink absorption cotton is assembled on the inner wall of an ink box, a hollow cylinder is fixedly assembled at the upper end of the ink storage tank and is sleeved on the outer wall of the lower end of the ink box, the upper end of the hollow cylinder is connected with the ink box through an elastic structure, ink is temporarily stored in the ink storage tank and is constantly added into the ink storage tank through the cooperation of the through pipe and an external pump body, the ink absorption cotton can be discontinuously extruded through the cooperation of the ink box, the blocking structure can be opened through the pressure through the action of a piston and the cooperation of the blocking structure, when the piston moves downwards, the blocking structure can be opened through the pressure to extrude the ink to the upper end of the piston, and along with the upward movement of the piston, part of the ink is sent to the ink absorption cotton, so as to ensure the pad printing operation, ink is always available, so that the ink breaking accident is avoided, and the pad printing effect is not influenced.

title_en: High portable fixing base of structural stability for button sewing machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a movable fixing seat with high structural stability for a button sewing machine in the technical field of button sewing machines, which comprises a fixing seat and a roller sliding assembly arranged below the fixing seat, wherein one side of the top end of the roller sliding assembly is provided with an inclined plane, the moving mechanisms are symmetrically arranged in two sides of the fixing seat, one side of the bottom end of each moving mechanism is provided with an inclined plane, a reset mechanism is arranged below the fixing seat, the upper part of the reset mechanism is slidably sleeved with the roller sliding assembly, the top end of the reset mechanism is slidably arranged in the fixing seat, and a driving mechanism is arranged in the middle of the fixing seat, two ends of the driving mechanism are respectively in transmission fit connection with the moving mechanisms in two sides of the fixing seat, the structure is reasonable, the button sewing machine can be moved by the roller sliding assembly, the position of the button sewing machine is greatly convenient to adjust, the arranged reset assembly can reset the roller sliding assembly to be separated from the ground, and the vibration of the button sewing machine can be buffered and damped, and the stability is strong.

title_en: Plate making device for plastic packaging product production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a plate making device for plastic packaging product production, which comprises a machine body, wherein a workbench is arranged in the middle of the upper end of the machine body, a lifting device is arranged at the upper end of the machine body, a manufacturing device is arranged on the lifting device and is correspondingly arranged above the workbench, an equipment bin is arranged on one side of the upper end in the machine body, a flattening mechanism is arranged in the equipment bin, two lead screws are arranged on the flattening mechanism, and two ends of the two lead screws are respectively and rotatably connected to the opposite inner walls of the upper end of the machine body. The automatic flattening device can automatically flatten the material at the upper end of the workbench when the plate making device is operated, can effectively save the trouble of manual flattening, reduce the labor intensity of workers, and simultaneously can ensure the flattening effect of the material and improve the flattening efficiency, thereby ensuring the plate making effect of the plate making device and improving the plate making efficiency of the plate making device.

title_en: Steel wire bundle cutting device of full-automatic shield tail brush hair-combining machine
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of production and manufacturing equipment of shield tail brushes, and provides a steel wire bundle cutting device of a full-automatic shield tail brush combiner, which comprises a machine table, wherein a pair of guide rails are arranged on the machine table, a sliding seat is arranged on the guide rails in a sliding manner, a sliding block movably matched with the guide rails is arranged at the bottom of the sliding seat, an air cylinder is arranged on one side of the sliding seat and comprises a fixed end and a movable end, the fixed end is connected with the machine table, the movable end is connected with the sliding seat, a speed reduction driving mechanism is arranged on the sliding seat, two wire cutting wheels are arranged at the power output end of the speed reduction driving mechanism, the two wire cutting wheels are distributed in a vertically staggered manner, the wire cutting wheels are straight-tooth cylindrical shallow gear rollers, and strip-shaped relief openings are formed in positions, corresponding to the meshing surfaces of the two wire cutting wheels, on the sliding seat. The device has the advantages of reasonable design, simple structure, stronger cutting capacity, higher cutting efficiency, longer service cycle of equipment and higher comprehensive utilization rate, and is suitable for large-scale popularization.

title_en: Full-automatic screen printing machine is with turning over pole
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a turning rod for a full-automatic screen printing machine, which comprises a base and a support arranged on the base, wherein a turntable is movably arranged on the base, a conveying belt is connected to the turntable, and a turnover mechanism is arranged on the turntable; the device can drive the turning rod to turn through the driving component in the turning mechanism, so that the mesh belt is turned, the trouble of traditional screen printing rewinding work is solved, the working efficiency is further improved, the stopping and running of the turning work are controlled through the auxiliary component, and the intermittent working mode of the device is adopted, so that the cost of the device for always working is saved, the energy consumption is reduced, and the resources are saved; the contact area between the turnover rod and the mesh belt is increased through the turnover plate, the larger the area is, the easier the turnover is, and the working efficiency is further improved.

title_en: Multifunctional integrated film color overprinting printing machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional integrated film color overprinting printing machine which comprises an integrated film color overprinting printing machine body, wherein the bottom of the integrated film color overprinting printing machine body is fixedly connected with a base, the bottom of the base is fixedly connected with three box-shaped supports with the tops being provided with openings, the bottom of the base is provided with a rectangular groove, the inner wall of the top of the rectangular groove is rotatably provided with three screw rods, and the bottom ends of the screw rods extend into the corresponding box-shaped supports. The integrated film color overprinting printing machine body is convenient for personnel to move, is convenient for buffering during moving, reduces the vibration force transmitted upwards when uneven ground moves, is convenient for rapidly and synchronously accommodating six universal wheels, increases the contact friction area between the bottom and the ground, improves the parking stability, enables the universal wheels not to be in a support stress state for a long time, prolongs the service life of the universal wheels, and meets the use requirements.

title_en: Oil separation screw
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of industrial sewing machines, in particular to an oil distribution screw. The utility model provides a divide oil screw, includes the body, the body left part is equipped with fastening portion, and the body right part is equipped with connecting portion, and the body middle part is equipped with the three oil outlet that runs through, and the body right part is equipped with the inlet port, and the connecting portion surface is equipped with the external screw thread. The utility model has the advantages that: the oil outlet is added in the middle of the body, and the original solution that an oil separator is added in the middle of an oil pipe for supplying oil in one way is changed into the solution that the oil outlet is added to directly distribute lubricating oil to each movement mechanism at the same time, so that the oil transportation efficiency is improved, intermediate links are reduced, the cost is reduced, and the reliability is improved; the design of the oil outlet is changed from a one-way hole to a two-way through hole, so that the oil distribution lantern ring matched with the oil outlet can be provided with an angle for selection when being installed and positioned, the problem that the oil output is influenced due to the fact that the oil holes of two parts are not aligned because of inaccurate positioning or installation position limitation in the prior art is solved, and assembly and maintenance are greatly facilitated.

title_en: Leftover material removing device for bag making machine production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of leftover material removal, and discloses a leftover material removing device for producing a bag making machine, which is characterized in that the upper surface of a bottom plate is fixedly connected with a frame, a hydraulic rod is fixedly connected inside the frame, the bottom of the hydraulic rod is fixedly connected with a motor shell, the inside of the motor shell is fixedly connected with a motor, the output end of the motor is fixedly connected with a rotating rod, the outer surface of the rotating rod is fixedly connected with a polishing disc, an electric push rod is fixedly connected inside the frame, one end of the electric push rod is fixedly connected with a fixed block, the bottom of the fixed block is fixedly connected with a hairbrush, the upper surface of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with an installation box, a fan is arranged inside the frame, the polishing disc is further used for polishing the unnecessary leftover material, and the operation of the device is time-saving, the labor intensity of workers is reduced, and the operation efficiency is improved.

title_en: Monochrome grooving machine for carton
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a monochrome grooving machine for a carton, which comprises a grooving bearing seat, wherein the top of the grooving bearing seat is fixedly connected with a processing table, the top of the processing table is provided with an adjusting groove, an adjusting block is slidably connected inside the adjusting groove, the top of the adjusting block is fixedly connected with a first support plate, the top of the processing table is fixedly connected with a second support plate, and the side wall of the first support plate is fixedly connected with an adjusting rod. According to the utility model, the driving motor can drive the driving screw to rotate by utilizing the driving assembly, so that the movable sleeve block and the connecting sleeve block can conveniently move on the driving screw and the movable rod, and can be adjusted to a proper position as required, the electric hydraulic rod can drive the installation slotting mechanism to move downwards by utilizing the lifting assembly, slotting can be conveniently carried out according to the heights of different cartons, and different cartons can be adjusted and slotted by the slotting receiving seat, slotting by replacing various devices is not required, time and labor are saved, and the use effect is improved.

title_en: High-efficient air inflation bag pressing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-efficiency air-filled bag pressing device which comprises an installation plate, wherein the installation plate is positioned on one side of an air cushion machine body, a guide mechanism is positioned on the installation plate and comprises a guide post and an extension post, one side of the guide post is fixedly connected with the installation plate, the extension post is positioned on one side of the guide post, a connecting mechanism is arranged between the guide post and the extension post and comprises a connecting plate, one side of the connecting plate is fixedly connected with the extension post, the other side of the guide post is provided with a sliding groove, the connecting plate is connected with an inner cavity of the sliding groove in a sliding penetrating and penetrating manner, the side of the connecting plate is fixedly connected with an installation threaded post, and the side of the inner wall of the sliding groove is provided with a through groove. According to the utility model, the mounting plate, the guide post, the extension post, the connecting plate, the mounting threaded post and the limiting post are mutually matched, and the inflatable bag roll is positioned between the guide post and the extension post, so that the inflatable bag roll is favorably and stably conveyed, and the inflatable bag roll is conveniently smoothed and guided.

title_en: Automatic feeding screen printing machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic feeding screen printing machine, which comprises a bottom plate and a moving assembly, wherein the bottom plate is provided with a feeding hole; a bottom plate: the upper side surface of the bottom plate is provided with a PLC controller, a storage box is fixed on the upper side surface of the bottom plate, and a printing assembly is arranged on the upper side surface of the bottom plate; a moving component: the adjusting mechanism comprises mounting strips, a moving block and a threaded rod, wherein two corresponding mounting strips are fixed at the rear end of the upper side surface of the bottom plate, a threaded hole is formed in the rear side edge part of the moving block, the threaded rod is connected to the internal threads of the threaded hole in a rotating mode and is connected to the corresponding inner side surfaces of the two mounting strips, an adjusting assembly is mounted on the front side surface of the moving block, and the adjusting assembly is driven to move transversely by the aid of the moving assembly; wherein: the output of external power source is connected to the input electricity of PLC controller, the removal subassembly still contains first motor and gag lever post, can automatic feeding to higher precision has.

title_en: Carton processing all-in-one machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a carton processing all-in-one machine which comprises a conveying line and a processing machine arranged at the top end of the conveying line, wherein supporting legs are respectively arranged at four corners of the bottom end of the conveying line, fixed boxes are arranged on the inner sides of the four supporting legs, an accommodating box is arranged in an inner cavity of each fixed box, first baffles are respectively arranged on the front side and the rear side of the top end of each fixed box, second baffles are respectively arranged on the left side and the right side of the top end of each fixed box, sliding assemblies are arranged on the inner sides of the two first baffles, telescopic assemblies are arranged at the bottom ends of the sliding assemblies, and cleaning brushes are arranged at the bottom ends of the telescopic assemblies. This carton processing all-in-one relates to carton processing equipment technical field, has solved the piece that produces directly drops subaerially under the effect of gravity in the use of carton processing all-in-one is in actual use, serious influence the sanitary environment's in the workshop problem.

title_en: Textile cloth defect marking device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a textile cloth defect marking device in the technical field of production and processing marking equipment, which comprises a shell, a fixed block, a water storage tank, a first electric telescopic rod, a second electric telescopic rod, a collecting tank and a mounting block, wherein the fixed block is fixedly connected to the middle of the right side wall of an inner cavity of the shell, the water storage tank is fixedly connected to the upper side of the right side wall of the shell, the first electric telescopic rod is fixedly connected to the left side of the top of the inner cavity of the shell, and the second electric telescopic rod is fixedly connected to the middle of the top of the inner cavity of the shell, so that the structural design is reasonable, the automatic marking function of the device is realized, the problems existing in manual detection are avoided, the detection effect is ensured, the working efficiency in production and processing is improved, the cleaning and the disinfection of the surface of cloth are realized, and the later-stage processing operation of the cloth is facilitated, further improving the quality of the cloth.

title_en: Semi-automatic flat-pressing flat-die cutting machine
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of die-cutting machines, and particularly relates to a semi-automatic flat-pressing flat-die-cutting machine which comprises a base and a machine case, wherein the machine case is fixedly arranged at the top of the base, four corners of the top of the base are fixedly provided with support plates, two support plates positioned on the same side are rotatably provided with the same rotating rod, two chain wheels are fixedly sleeved on the two rotating rods, the four chain wheels are in transmission connection with two chains, a conveying motor is fixedly arranged on the support plate positioned on the right front side and is fixedly connected with the corresponding rotating rod, two strip-shaped plates are fixedly arranged at the top of the base, the same support box is arranged above the two strip-shaped plates, and the top of the support box is in an opening arrangement. The paperboard stacking device is reasonable in design and simple to operate, can effectively stack the paperboards in order, and avoids the situation that the paperboards are damaged easily because the paperboards are directly extruded through the right-angle clamping plates and have large friction force in a static state.

title_en: High-speed intelligent printing machine with power-off protection function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-speed intelligent printing machine with a power-off protection function, which comprises a printing machine body and a base, wherein a display screen is fixedly connected to the surface of the printing machine body, the bottom of the display screen is fixedly connected with an operation panel, and the left side of the top of the printing machine body is fixedly connected with a first movable block. According to the utility model, the temperature of the inner cavity of the printing machine body is monitored in real time through the arrangement of the alarm lamp, the display screen, the operation panel and the temperature sensor, when the temperature is too high, the power-off effect is achieved through the arrangement of the power-off protection switch, the phenomenon that the printing machine body and printing data are damaged due to the fact that the temperature of the inner cavity of the printing machine body is too high is avoided, through the arrangement of the semiconductor refrigerating sheet, the motor, the rotating rod and the fan, when the temperature of the inner cavity of the printing machine body is too high, the inner cavity of the printing machine body is rapidly cooled through the cooperation of the devices, and the service life of the printing machine body is greatly prolonged.

title_en: Special alignment printing machine for laser embroidery
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of cloth printing preparation, in particular to a special alignment printing machine for laser embroidery, which comprises a feeding roller, a winding roller, a printing machine, a feeding end tensioning roller, a receiving end tensioning roller, a heating plate, a telescopic piece and a bearing table, wherein the feeding end tensioning roller is arranged on the feeding roller; a feeding roller, a winding roller, a feeding end tensioning roller and a receiving end tensioning roller are arranged on the printing machine, and the feeding roller and the winding roller are respectively used for feeding and receiving the transfer paper; the printing machine is used for printing the transfer paper; a feeding end tension roller and a receiving end tension roller are respectively arranged at the front end and the rear end of the printing machine; a heating plate is arranged below the printing machine, the heating surface of the heating plate is arranged downwards, a base of the telescopic piece is connected with the bottom of the printing machine, and the telescopic end of the telescopic piece is connected with the upper top surface of the heating plate; a pressure bearing platform is arranged below the heating plate. The problem of ink diffusion is solved by using transfer paper and a heating plate to transfer the printed and shaped patterns on the paper cloth in a transfer printing mode.

title_en: Auxiliary transmission structure of circular knitting machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a circular knitting machine auxiliary transmission structure, which comprises a base, an auxiliary transmission shaft, a belt pulley and a synchronous wheel, wherein the belt pulley and the synchronous wheel are arranged on the auxiliary transmission shaft in a synchronous rotating mode with the auxiliary transmission shaft, two ends of the belt pulley along the axial direction are respectively arranged as a first end and a second end, the first end is provided with a first installation groove extending along the axial direction, the first installation groove is provided with a first groove wall, a second groove wall and a connecting wall connecting the first groove wall and the second groove wall, the first groove wall and the second groove wall are arranged along the axial direction, the second groove wall is positioned on the outer side of the first groove wall, the base extends into the first installation groove and forms a supporting part, a first bearing for assisting the rotation of the belt pulley is arranged between the supporting part and the second groove wall, the inner ring of the first bearing is arranged on the supporting part, and the outer ring of the first bearing is arranged on the second groove wall. The utility model can reduce the radial acting force of the belt pulley on the auxiliary transmission shaft, prolong the service life of the auxiliary transmission shaft and enable the equipment to run more stably.

title_en: Prevent that surface fabric presss from both sides double-layered cloth frame of dress damage
abstract_en: A fabric clamping frame for preventing fabric clamping damage comprises a rectangular fabric clamping frame, wherein the fabric clamping frame mainly comprises a left gear, a right gear, a front gear and a rear gear, the left gear, the right gear, the front gear and the rear gear respectively comprise a frame, a support plate extending horizontally outwards is formed at the lower end of the outer side wall of the frame, an outer baffle plate which is vertically upwards is formed at the outer side edge of the support plate, an inward-concave arc-shaped groove is formed at the lower end of the outer baffle plate, and a plurality of clamping teeth are formed inside the arc-shaped groove; the outer side edge of the outer baffle is formed with a molded supporting plate, and the lower end of the supporting plate is formed with a supporting plate on the inner side of the outer baffle; and an arc-shaped smooth surface is formed between the outer baffle and the support plate. The outer side edge of the improved cloth clamping frame is a straight edge, the phenomenon of 'jump clamping' is not easy to occur, and meanwhile, the upper end of the outer side edge is an arc-shaped smooth surface, so that the fabric is not easy to damage in the clamping process.

title_en: Down production is with preventing eiderdown production facility that wafts
abstract_en: The utility model discloses down feather scattering prevention production equipment for down jacket production, which relates to the technical field of down jacket production and comprises a main body device, a collecting device and a sealing device, wherein the collecting device is arranged inside the main body device, a down feather filling pipe is arranged above the collecting device, the sealing device is arranged on the upper surface of the down feather filling pipe, a collecting tank is arranged on the upper surface of the collecting device, a down feather collecting hopper is fixedly connected to the bottom of the collecting tank, and a down feather collecting bottom pipe is fixedly connected to the bottom of the down feather collecting hopper. According to the down feather filling device, the pushing block is pushed to pull the second traction rope to drive the sealing cover to be separated from the down feather filling pipe, the down feather filling pipe is opened, then the pushing block is loosened, the pushing block and the sealing cover reset under the elastic force action of the first return spring and the second return spring, the down feather filling pipe is sealed newly, the down feather filling device is very quick, scattered down feather is sucked through the collecting tank, and then the down feather is transmitted into the down feather collecting bag to be collected.

title_en: Blanking marking device for brake disc machining
abstract_en: The utility model relates to blanking marking equipment for machining a brake disc, which comprises a support frame, wherein a material receiving device, a material feeding device and a marking device are sequentially arranged on the support frame along the conveying direction of the brake disc, the material receiving device is used for conveying the brake disc in a machining machine tool to the outside of the machine tool, the material feeding device is used for conveying the brake disc on the material receiving device to the lower part of the marking device, and the marking device is used for marking the upper surface of the brake disc after the brake disc reaches a designated position. The automatic feeding device can realize automatic feeding and discharging, the feeding device and the marking device are combined together, and the upper surface of the brake disc is marked while feeding, so that the times of manual carrying are reduced, the labor intensity is reduced, and the working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Tailoring table for garment design
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tailoring table for garment design, which comprises a tailoring table, wherein four corners of the bottom surface of the tailoring table are fixedly connected with supporting legs, a tailoring circular plate is arranged above the tailoring table, a rectangular groove is formed in the right side surface of the tailoring circular plate, sliding grooves are formed in the inner wall surfaces of the front side and the rear side of the rectangular groove, as the thread directions of a first threaded hole and a second threaded hole are opposite, a first long plate and a second long plate are enabled to move close to or away from each other, a pressing plate is enabled to be close to or away from the upper surface of the tailoring circular plate through the mutual approaching or separating movement of the first long plate and the second long plate, cloth is tensioned and placed below the pressing plate, the cloth can be conveniently fixed and taken out, the tailoring circular plate can rotate on the tailoring table due to the arrangement of a round rod and a bearing, a user can conveniently conduct local tailoring on the cloth without moving to other sides of the tailoring table, the operation of the user is convenient.

title_en: Sewing machine head shell with good heat dissipation effect
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sewing machine head shell with a good heat dissipation effect, which comprises a machine head, wherein a protective shell is fixed on the outer wall of one side of the machine head, a protective plate is fixed on the outer wall of one side of the protective shell, a circular through hole is formed in the outer wall of one side of the protective plate, a connecting sleeve is fixed on the inner wall of the circular through hole, a rectangular through hole is formed in the outer wall of the bottom of the protective shell, a ventilation pipe is fixed on the inner wall of the rectangular through hole, a motor is fixed on the outer wall of one side of the machine head, an internal thread ring groove is formed in the outer wall of one side of the machine head, and an external thread lantern ring is connected to the inner wall of the internal thread ring groove through threads. According to the utility model, the filtering wire mesh sleeved on the outer wall of the connecting rod can shield and protect the motor inside, so that dust and cotton wool entering the protective shell through the ventilation pipe are prevented from being adhered to the motor, meanwhile, workers can conveniently clean the dust inside the protective shell, and the problem that a large amount of small impurities such as external dust and cotton wool are adhered to the motor to influence the normal work of the motor is avoided.

title_en: Dress production is with high-efficient processing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses high-efficiency processing equipment for clothing production, which comprises an operation platform, wherein two sides of the middle part of the operation platform are connected with support frames, the support frames are C-shaped, a driving structure is arranged in the center of the bottom of each support frame, cutting structures are symmetrically arranged on two sides of each driving structure, and the two cutting structures are arranged at the bottom of each support frame.

title_en: Rubber coating equipment is used in production of stable form corrugated container board
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a gluing device for producing a stable corrugated board, and relates to the field of corrugated board gluing. The glue cleaning device comprises a workbench, a glue coating box and a glue box, wherein a collecting box is arranged in the middle of the interior of the workbench, a scraping plate is fixed at the top of the collecting box, a flow guide groove is formed in one side of the scraping plate, heating plates are arranged on the other side of the scraping plate and above the inner wall of the collecting box, the collecting box is arranged under a conveyor belt, the scraping plate is arranged at the top of the collecting box, the heating plates are arranged above the inner wall of the collecting box and on the scraping plate, when the conveyor belt is conveyed to the lower side, a worker opens the heating plates, the heating plates can bake the conveyor belt to soften the residual glue on the conveyor belt, the residual glue is scraped off by the contact of the scraping plate and the conveyor belt, the glue can flow along the flow guide groove formed in the scraping plate and finally flows into the collecting box, the residual glue on the conveyor belt can be effectively cleaned, and the cleanness of the conveyor belt is kept.

title_en: high-F-number rayon fabric
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-F-number rayon fabric, which relates to the technical field of rayon fabrics and comprises a first rayon layer and a second rayon layer, wherein the first rayon layer and the second rayon layer both comprise a plurality of rayon yarns, the rayon yarns on the first rayon layer are respectively used as warp yarns and weft yarns and are interwoven with each other, the knitting mode of the rayon yarns on the second rayon layer is the same as that of the rayon yarns on the first rayon layer, stretch yarns are arranged between the first rayon layer and the second rayon layer, and the stretch yarns are in a wave shape. According to the utility model, the inner winding layer and the outer winding layer which are distributed in an annular array are arranged on the outer side of the polyester fiber, the inner winding layer is wound on the outer side of the polyester fiber in a forward spiral mode, and the outer winding layer is wound on the outer sides of the polyester fiber and the inner winding layer in a reverse spiral mode, so that the artificial yarn is not easy to loosen, the woven fabric has better compactness, and the integral quality of the fabric is improved.

title_en: High-precision flat-pressing flat die cutting machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a high-precision flat pressing flat die cutting machine, which comprises a reverse cutting die and a tangent die, wherein the reverse cutting die comprises a reverse cutting upper die, the upper end of the reverse cutting upper die is fixedly connected with a reverse cutting upper fixing seat, the lower end of the reverse cutting upper die is provided with a reverse cutting lower die, the upper end of the reverse cutting lower die is fixedly connected with a cut indentation cutter, the lower end of the reverse cutting lower die is fixedly connected with a reverse cutting lower fixing seat, the inner side of a machine shell is fixedly connected with a first supporting frame, the reverse cutting lower fixing seat is arranged at the upper end of the first supporting frame, the tangent die is arranged at the right side of the reverse cutting die, the tangent die comprises a tangent upper die, the upper end of the tangent upper die is fixedly connected with a tangent upper fixing seat, the inner side of the machine shell is fixedly connected with a second supporting frame, the tangent upper fixing seat is arranged in the second supporting frame, the lower end of the tangent upper die is fixedly connected with a tangent profile cutter, the tangent lower die is arranged below the tangent profile cutter, the lower end of the tangent lower die is fixedly connected with a tangent lower fixing seat, the indentation is firstly cut out, then the outline is cut out, so that the precision of the cut paper is better, and the processing precision of the paper can be well ensured.

title_en: Cutting device for dress designing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cutting device for clothing design, which comprises a platform, a support column and a fixed plate, wherein two sides of the top end of the platform are fixedly connected with a stop block, the inner side surface of the stop block is provided with a limiting mechanism, the limiting mechanism comprises a T-shaped support plate, a limiting plate and a bolt, the inner side plate of the stop block is provided with a sliding groove, and the T-shaped support plate is in sliding connection with the stop block through the sliding groove. The ascending or descending of limiting plate can be controlled to the fixed height that sets up in T type backup pad surface bolt through the adjustment, thereby compress tightly the position of fixed cloth downwards through the limiting plate, treat the position back of having confirmed the limiting plate, screw up the bolt, accomplish the fixed to the cloth, the removal that the sword was tailor in the rethread cylinder drive carries out stable the tailorring to the cloth to avoided taking place the displacement at the in-process cloth of tailorring, the effect of tailorring of influence cloth, greatly increased the stability that the cloth was tailor and improved the yield that the cloth was tailor.

title_en: Waterborne printing groover of autonomic opposite side
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic edge-aligning water-based printing groover, which is characterized in that: the method comprises the following steps: the automatic feeding device comprises a feeding seat, side aligning seats, printing seats, drying seats, slot cutting seats, a plurality of vibration discharging seats and a dust remover, wherein the output end of the feeding seat is provided with side aligning seat input ends; a dust remover is arranged in the opposite side seat, and the dust remover is arranged at the input end of the opposite side seat; correct the carton position through adjustable opposite side structure on the one hand, improve the grooved precision of printing, on the other hand has improved the dynamics of droing of carton waste material through vibration and atmospheric pressure, has avoided the waste material to leave over the problem on the carton, has practiced thrift the human cost.

title_en: Carton stapler is used in carton production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a carton stapler for producing cartons, which comprises a shell, pressing plates positioned on two sides in the shell and a first adjusting frame positioned at the top end in the shell, wherein the shell comprises a fixing plate arranged at the bottom end in the shell, and a hydraulic cylinder is arranged in the middle of the bottom of the shell. According to the nailing machine, the first servo motor drives the first adjusting rod to rotate, the external threads on the outer side of the first adjusting rod are matched with the threaded holes in the first adjusting block, the first adjusting block drives the first adjusting frame to move back and forth, the first adjusting block is limited through the sliding rod, the second servo motor drives the second adjusting rod to rotate, the external threads on the outer side of the second adjusting rod are matched with the threaded holes in the second adjusting block, the second adjusting block drives the nailing machine to move left and right, the second adjusting block is limited through the limiting block and the limiting groove, the adjusting effect of the nailing machine is better, the processing effect of a carton is better, and the working efficiency of the nailing machine is improved.

title_en: Printing roller cooling device for printing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a cooling device technical field just discloses a printing roller cooling device for lithography apparatus, including the printing roller, the top and the bottom of printing roller all are provided with the drive shaft, the front side of printing roller is provided with the cooling duct, the surface of cooling duct is equipped with cooling cylinder, the surface of cooling duct is seted up because the multiunit goes out the liquid hole. This printing roller cooling device for lithography apparatus, through rotary joint, make in heat-conducting medium gets into the cooling cylinder through the cooling conduit, the printing roller drives the cooling cylinder through frictional force this moment and follows driven bearing rotation, the inside heat-conducting medium of cooling cylinder takes place the heat exchange rather than following the rotatory in-process of printing roller, the temperature on printing roller surface reduces gradually in the heat exchange, the probability that the proportion is maladjusted is set for to the ink liquid that has reduced printing roller surface, the printing quality of device has effectively been improved, thereby the practicality of device has been strengthened.

title_en: Height adjusting device of melt-blown fabric web former
abstract_en: A height adjusting device of a melt-blown fabric web former comprises a plurality of supporting plates connected with a shell of the web former, wherein the supporting plates are connected with a worm and gear reduction box, the worm and gear reduction box is used for driving a lifting screw rod to move up and down, a bottom plate is arranged at the bottom of the lifting screw rod, and the bottom plate is used for being connected with a sliding seat; the worm and gear reduction boxes are divided into two groups and are respectively arranged on two sides of the net machine shell, the worm and gear reduction boxes on the same side are connected through a worm driving rod, the two worm driving rods are connected with the driving rod through a first reduction box, and the driving rod is driven by a motor to rotate. The utility model discloses on current lapper height adjusting device's the basis, the lead screw elevating system with four independent control has changed into a motor synchronization control's elevating gear, avoids four not synchronous problems of motor control, perhaps avoids a certain motor to break down and shuts down and leads to the lead screw to bend the deformation problem.

title_en: Carton side setting device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a paper box side surface shaping device which comprises a transmission die, a gluing component and an ear punching component, wherein the gluing component comprises glue spraying heads which are arranged on the left side and the right side of the transmission die; the ear striking component is arranged at an ear striking station and comprises a front ear striking group and a rear ear striking group, the front ear striking group comprises front ear striking blocks arranged at the left side and the right side of the transmission die, the front ear striking blocks are arranged on the front swing arm, the rear ear striking group comprises rear ear striking blocks arranged at the left side and the right side of the transmission die, and the rear ear striking blocks are arranged on the rear swing arm; the ear punching station is arranged in front of the gluing station. The paper box of preliminary shaping is sent to gluing the station by the transmission mould, spouts the glued head and spouts glue to the both sides face of paper box, then is sent to the earning station, and preceding swing arm and back swing arm swing in opposite directions, and the ear at leading flank both ends is folded backward with preceding earning piece, and the ear at back flank both ends is folded forward with back earning piece, makes four ears and controls the side bonding, makes the side of paper box stereotype.

title_en: Decoration printing machine rubber roll installation mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rubber roll mounting mechanism of a decoration printing machine, which comprises a fixed frame and a rotating motor, wherein a bearing sleeve and a threaded sleeve are respectively embedded on the left side wall and the right side wall of the fixed frame, the inner side of the threaded sleeve is rotatably connected with a transmission shaft in a matched manner through a bearing, one end of the transmission shaft outside the fixed frame is fixedly connected with the output end of the rotating motor, one end of the transmission shaft inside the fixed frame is welded with a U-shaped connecting piece, the inner side of the threaded sleeve is in threaded connection with a fastening threaded rod, the fastening threaded rod is rotatably connected with a connecting plate at one end of the inner side of the fixed frame, a printing rubber roll is mounted between the connecting plate and the U-shaped connecting piece, two sliding rods are fixed between the left side wall and the right side wall of an inner cavity of the fixed frame, and a cleaning ring is slidably connected between the two sliding rods. Has strong practical application value.

title_en: Yarn pressing structure of computerized flat knitting machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a computerized flat knitting machine line pressing structure which comprises a computerized flat knitting machine body, wherein supporting rods are symmetrically arranged at the upper end of the computerized flat knitting machine body, groove rods are arranged at the upper ends of the two supporting rods, fixing rods are arranged in the groove rods, a plurality of sliding blocks are sleeved on the outer surfaces of the fixing rods, slots are formed in the rear ends of the sliding blocks, clamping grooves are symmetrically formed in the left and right of the inner walls of the slots, groove blocks are arranged behind the sliding blocks, threaded rods are arranged in the groove blocks, threaded sleeves are symmetrically sleeved on the outer surfaces of the threaded rods, inserting plates are arranged at the front ends of the threaded sleeves, and clamping blocks are arranged at the outer ends of the two inserting plates. According to the utility model, the yarn is extruded by the extrusion roller and the rotating roller, the position of the Contraband-shaped block and the fixed cylinder is adjusted by moving the sliding block outside the fixed rod, so that the position of the yarn is adjusted, and the rotating roller, the extrusion roller and the fixed cylinder are convenient to disassemble and assemble by inserting the inserting plate and the clamping block into the slot and the clamping groove.

title_en: Oil spraying device of large circular knitting machine
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of large circular knitting machines, and particularly relates to an oil spraying device of a large circular knitting machine. This fueling injection equipment of big circular knitting machine, when the oil in the batch oil tank constantly reduces, the fixed plate touches start switch, let the motor start, the pivot can drive the threaded rod and rotate, let the ring descend along the threaded rod, the ring drives the depression bar and descends, let the clamp plate with the oil extrusion, oil can enter into the batch oil tank through the pipe, let fueling injection mechanism oil spout, the oil in the batch oil tank risees gradually, until the inside second piston rod extrusion of top installation piece, this time the first piston rod of this installation piece upper end can rise, the fixed plate will stop switch start, make the motor stop, stop refueling.

title_en: Pure cotton cloth's wrinkle chasing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wrinkle removing device for pure cotton cloth, which comprises a machine body, wherein cloth roller frames are arranged on the left side and the right side of the top of the machine body, two cloth rollers are arranged on the cloth roller frames, and a gap is reserved between the two cloth rollers. A first support frame is arranged on the left side of the top of the machine body, two rotatable impurity removing rollers are mounted on the first support frame, and a gap is reserved between the two impurity removing rollers. And a second support frame is arranged on the right side of the first support frame. The utility model relates to the technical field of fabric wrinkle removal, and discloses a wrinkle removal device for a pure cotton fabric.

title_en: Anti-corrosion chromium-plating gravure plate-making printing roller
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-corrosion chromium plating gravure platemaking roller, which relates to the technical field of printing rollers and comprises two supporting plates, wherein a rotating shaft is connected between the two supporting plates in a rotating mode, a roller body is fixedly connected to the middle position of the rotating shaft, a chromium layer is electroplated on the surface of the roller body, a sprinkling mechanism is fixedly connected to the tops of the two supporting plates, a scrubbing mechanism and a wiping mechanism are arranged at the bottom of the sprinkling mechanism, and the scrubbing mechanism and the wiping mechanism are both positioned right above the roller body.

title_en: Novel portable scanning printer
abstract_en: The utility model provides a novel portable scanning printer, and belongs to the technical field of printers. The portable printer solves the problems that the printer is easy to collide with and the like during carrying in the prior art. The printer comprises a printer body, a protective shell and a locking mechanism, wherein the protective shell is arranged outside the printer body and comprises a bottom plate fixedly arranged at the bottom of the printer body, a first shell and a second shell, the first shell and the second shell are detachably connected with the bottom plate, the first shell and the second shell can move along the length direction of the bottom plate so as to be close to or away from each other, a first handle is arranged on the first shell, a second handle is arranged on the second shell, the protective shell is provided with the locking mechanism, and the locking mechanism is used for locking the first handle and the second handle so as to lock the first shell and the second shell. The utility model has the advantages of protecting the printer from being collided, being convenient to take and the like.

title_en: Cutting device for vamp leather cutting machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cutting device for an upper leather cutting machine, which comprises a bearing table, two supporting plates and an assembling plate arranged on the bearing table, wherein mounting grooves are symmetrically formed in the side wall of the bearing table, movable blocks are arranged in the two mounting grooves, one of the mounting grooves is rotatably connected with a reciprocating screw rod, one of the movable blocks is connected to the reciprocating screw rod, and a leveling roller is rotatably connected to the movable block. According to the leather leveling device, the leveling roller, the limiting rod, the reciprocating screw rod, the gravity plate, the conveying belt, the fixing plate, the fixing pin, the spring, the assembling plate and other structures interact with one another, so that the leather leveling and fixing can be completed, and the burden of workers is reduced.

title_en: Falling object recycling machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a junk recycling machine which comprises a base, a feeding roller, a throwing roller, a wind wheel and a dust cage, wherein the feeding roller, the throwing roller, the wind wheel and the dust cage are all arranged on the base, a motor is fixedly arranged on one side of the base, the motor, the feeding roller, the wind wheel and the dust cage are in transmission connection through chains, one side of the throwing roller is in transmission connection with one side of the dust cage through a triangular belt, and a dust collection assembly is arranged on one side of the base. The utility model improves the effect of separating disposable down and coarse impurities by changing the structure of the traditional falling object recovery machine, simultaneously solves the disadvantages of down falling and roller winding by additionally arranging the wind wheel roller structure at the rear end of the opening roller and utilizing the stripping between the wind wheel and the opening roller to carry out fiber transfer, greatly reduces the labor intensity of workers, reduces the unnecessary secondary damage of down fibers, thereby reducing the energy consumption and improving the economic benefit.

title_en: Sewing clamp
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sewing clamp which comprises a sewing clamping support and is characterized in that the sewing clamping support comprises a sewing lower fixing plate, the sewing lower fixing plate of the sewing lower fixing plate is positioned below the sewing clamping support and is of a strip-shaped plate-shaped structure, a sewing side supporting plate is fixedly arranged at the side end of the sewing lower fixing plate and is fixed, and a sewing upper pressing assembly comprises an upper pressing guide rail with a sliding block, an upper pressing bearing plate arranged on the sliding block and a sewing upper pressing plate arranged on the upper pressing bearing plate and pressing the sewing lower fixing plate. The total length of the lower sewing fixing plate is larger than the width of the cloth to be sewn; the sewing clamp can also clamp single-layer or multi-layer gauze and flexible cloth at the same time.

title_en: Glue spraying structure for full-automatic box pasting machine capable of preventing glue material from solidifying and blocking
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a glue spraying structure for a full-automatic box pasting machine, which can prevent glue from being solidified and blocked, and comprises a charging barrel, wherein a hanging plate is arranged at the rear part of the outer surface of the charging barrel, connecting plates are respectively arranged at the left end and the right end of the hanging plate, a pressure pump is arranged at the upper end of the charging barrel, the output end of the pressure pump is communicated with the inner cavity of the charging barrel, a charging pipe is arranged at the right part of the outer surface of the charging barrel, a control end is arranged at the left part of the outer surface of the charging barrel, a discharging pipe is arranged at the lower end of the charging barrel, a heating ring is fixedly sleeved on the outer surface of the discharging pipe, a spray head is arranged at the lower end of the discharging pipe, and a blocking mechanism is arranged at the right part of the outer surface of the discharging pipe. According to the glue spraying structure for the full-automatic box pasting machine, which is disclosed by the utility model, the aim of glue spraying is realized by arranging the blocking mechanism, the glue solution is kept at an appropriate temperature and cannot be cooled and solidified in the whole glue spraying process, the problem of glue solution solidification blocking is radically solved, and the glue spraying structure is simple in structure, convenient to use and strong in practicability.

title_en: Inclined stretching device for screen cloth
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mesh inclined stretching device, which comprises: the device comprises a left chuck and a right chuck for clamping a pair of opposite sides of a rectangular screen cloth, a horizontally arranged left carrier plate for bearing the left chuck, a horizontally arranged right carrier plate for bearing the right chuck, a horizontally arranged rectangular main frame body for supporting the left carrier plate and the right carrier plate, a horizontally arranged transverse moving driving screw for driving the left carrier plate to move along the left-right direction and a horizontally arranged longitudinal moving driving screw for driving the right carrier plate to move along the front-back direction. The screen cloth inclined stretching device can obliquely stretch the steel wire mesh cloth and stretch the square grids of the steel wire mesh cloth into the rhombic grids.

title_en: Anti-collision structure for digital ink-jet photo machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anticollision structure for a digital ink-jet photo machine, which comprises a photo machine body, wherein a pinch roller is arranged on the surface of the photo machine body, a slide rail is arranged on the surface of the photo machine body, the surface of the slide rail is connected with a trolley in a sliding manner, and a spray head is arranged at the bottom of the trolley; the utility model discloses an in the dolly removal process baffle can make the baffle shrink with the object contact, and the probe discovery baffle shrink can with signal transfer to control center, then control center can make the dolly stop the mode of removal, can reach the high purpose of security, has guaranteed the stability of dolly, has guaranteed to beat the intact of beating printing paper or other article, has improved the practicality, the utility model discloses a remove the ejector pad and make the draw runner drive the fixed block and remove along the spout to cooperation fixed establishment can reach the purpose of being convenient for maintain the probe to its fixed mode, has made things convenient for the operation, has improved maintenance efficiency.

title_en: Napping machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a napping machine, which relates to the technical field of textiles and comprises a bottom plate, wherein a shell is arranged at the top of the bottom plate, the shell is of a hollow cuboid structure, a first motor is arranged on the side surface of the shell, an output shaft of the first motor is inserted into the shell and is connected with a rotating shaft, two ends of the rotating shaft are fixedly sleeved with first bevel gears, two ends of the top of the shell are respectively provided with a threaded column, and the threaded columns are inserted into the shell and are connected with second bevel gears. Compared with the prior art, the height-adjustable cloth rolling device is convenient to adjust along with the rolling of the cloth by arranging the napping mechanism with the flexibly adjustable height, the friction force between the cloth and the napping roller is balanced, the cloth is prevented from being damaged due to overlarge friction force, the use is very convenient, meanwhile, the napping mechanism with the adjustable distance is adopted to carry out napping operation on the cloth, the cloth with different specifications is convenient to install, cooperate and use, and the use is very convenient.

title_en: Full-automatic cutting machine for packaging bags
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of full-automatic cutting machines for packaging bags, in particular to a full-automatic cutting machine for packaging bags, which comprises a bottom plate main machine shell and an auxiliary support, wherein a raw material roller, a cutting table, two material receiving rollers and a plurality of transmission rollers are arranged between the main machine shell and the auxiliary support, a plurality of cutting knife assemblies are fixedly sleeved on the cutting roller, and the plurality of cutting knife assemblies are positioned right above the cutting table. According to the cutting knife assembly, the external cold air of the nozzle is arranged, so that the surface of the cutting knife assembly can be continuously cooled when the cutting knife assembly cuts, the pertinence is strong, the adjustability is achieved, the energy consumption is reduced, the connecting arm drives the main shaft to rotate by controlling the contraction of the electric push rod, two grinding stones are in lap joint with the corresponding surface of the cutting knife assembly, the cutting knife assembly is controlled to rotate, the grinding of the surface of the cutting knife assembly can be achieved, the disassembly is not needed, and the operation and the control are simple.

title_en: External routing structure of sewing machine cam
abstract_en: The utility model provides an external routing structure of a cam of a sewing machine, and belongs to the technical field of sewing machines. It has solved the more problem of current routing device occupation aircraft nose casing's exterior space. The sewing machine comprises a shell, wherein the outer part of the shell is provided with an installation space which is concavely arranged, a routing structure comprises a cam, a routing frame and an auxiliary shaft which is used for being connected with a main shaft of the sewing machine, the auxiliary shaft is arranged in the shell in a penetrating mode, the outer end of the auxiliary shaft is located in the installation space, the cam is fixedly connected to the outer end of the auxiliary shaft, the routing frame is fixedly connected to the outer part of the shell and located in the installation space, a pair of thread passing pieces which are convexly arranged and used for a thread to pass through are arranged on the routing frame, and the cam part can rotate to a pair of thread passing pieces. The external routing structure of the sewing machine cam has the advantages that the threading is broken conveniently by a sewing thread, and the external space occupied by the routing structure is small.

title_en: Cutting device with accurate positioning structure for machining bed sheet
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cutting device with an accurate positioning structure for machining a sheet, which comprises a machine base, an adjusting base plate and a positioning assembly, wherein a material spreading table is installed at the upper end of the machine base, limiting columns are fixedly connected to the upper sides of the front end and the rear end of the machine base, a fixing seat is arranged at the upper end of each limiting column, and a sliding groove is formed in the middle of each fixing seat. This sheet processing is with tailorring device that has accurate location structure is provided with the clamp plate strip, both ends respectively are provided with a clamp plate strip about adjusting the base plate, the clamp plate strip slides down under the drive effect of second hydraulic cylinder, realize the clamp plate strip and assist the bed sheet of stone material bench end to pave under the inside gliding effect of spout is complied to at the upper end adjusting the base plate on the one hand, on the other hand clamp plate strip can closely laminate and compress tightly in the bed list surface, and then when the effect is tailor to the middle part cut-off knife, the clamp plate strip at both ends can carry on spacingly to the bed sheet, effectively prevent the bed sheet fold, influence such as skew, with precision and the efficiency of improving and tailorring.

title_en: Well sealed flexible packaging bag rim charge resection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cut-off device for rim charge of a middle-sealed flexible packaging bag, which comprises an installation support, a fine adjustment mechanism, a manual adjustment mechanism and a cutter assembly, wherein the installation support is erected on a rack of a bag making machine, the fine adjustment mechanism can be movably installed at a guide hole preset at the upper end of the installation support in a left-right mode, the manual adjustment mechanism can be movably installed on the fine adjustment mechanism in the left-right mode, and the cutter assembly is detachably installed on the fine adjustment mechanism and is positioned on one side of the manual adjustment mechanism. The device for cutting off the redundant rim charge of the sealed flexible packaging bag has the advantages of no material breakage during adjustment, convenience, rapidness, stable and reliable rim charge cutting and great improvement of the yield.

title_en: PP spunbonded nonwoven convenient to clean
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a PP glues non-woven fabrics convenient to wash, including the material main part, the inside of material main part is provided with toughening layer, toughening layer includes the wire, the surface of wire is provided with the glass fiber silk, be provided with nylon acrylic fiber silk between glass fiber silk and the wire, the surface of material main part is provided with waterproof and oil-proof layer, waterproof and oil-proof layer includes the polyester fiber. The utility model discloses a waterproof grease proofing layer sets up for the material is when using, can effectually improve its waterproof and grease-proof effect, guaranteed when using, reduced the washing degree of difficulty to the material, so that the result of use of material has been guaranteed, through the setting on layer of toughening, guaranteed that the material is when using, can effectually guarantee the toughness and the intensity of material, so that guarantee its stability of using, avoided when the effect of receiving power, because drag the damage that appears, and then influence the use of material.

title_en: Fixed axial overprinting stabilizing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fixed axial chromatography stabilising arrangement, including two base plates, two the base plate is the symmetry form setting, two the base plate is the longitudinal symmetry fixedly connected with mounting panel from one side lateral wall, both sides wall is symmetry fixedly connected with link about the base plate, the mounting panel is kept away from and has been seted up the mounting hole between the wall about its corresponding one side base plate one side, fixed mounting has mounting bolt in the mounting hole, two on one side the mounting bolt one end fixedly connected with fixing clip in opposite directions. The utility model discloses a be provided with good gravure plate axial stabilization mechanism, can carry out efficient axial bi-polar stable work to different specification and dimension's gravure version, be difficult for causing about the gravure plate to remove, and be provided with good integrated device installation mechanism, when actually carrying out the installation of integrated device and arranging, its installation is arranged reliability and convenience good.

title_en: Multi-station energy-saving and environment-friendly printing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an energy-concerving and environment-protective lithography apparatus of multistation belongs to the lithography apparatus field, including mobile station one, the rigid coupling has slide one on the bottom terminal surface of mobile station one, slide one's other end slides and has cup jointed mobile station two, the rigid coupling has slide two on the top terminal surface of mobile station two, the cavity has been seted up in slide two, and the top surface of slide two installs stoving mechanism, the rigid coupling has the fixed plate in mobile station one and the mobile station two respectively, the rigid coupling has electric putter between the fixed plate, the top surface of mobile station one rigid coupling has printing roller one and printing roller two respectively. This lithography apparatus can adjust the station number according to actual conditions, and then can avoid unnecessary production processes, has reduced the loss of printing cost, has also ensured the efficiency of printing, and can reduce lithography apparatus's volume for lithography apparatus's occupation of land space reduces, does benefit to the reasonable application in space.

title_en: Double-layer adjustable expansion ratio brocade weaving machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a double-layer adjustable expansion ratio brocade weaving machine which comprises a machine frame, an electric extension frame and a connecting rod, wherein six supporting legs are arranged on two sides of the bottom end of the machine frame, the bottom ends of the supporting legs are connected with a base, one end of the machine frame is provided with a unwinding roller, and the middle part of the machine frame is provided with a support.
