Has the advantages that: according to the utility model, the switch can be pressed through the electric extension frame, the switch, the fixing frame, the charging port and the electric quantity indicator lamp, the height of the electric extension frame can be automatically adjusted, manual complicated operation is not needed, and the tightness of different brocade weaving lines can be met, so that the working efficiency of the brocade weaving machine is improved.

title_en: Tableware machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tableware machine, include: the forming machine comprises a frame, a forming machine component, a hot-pressing forming machine component, a trimming component, a robot component and a material taking component, wherein the forming machine component is arranged at one end of the frame, the hot-pressing forming machine component is arranged at the other end of the frame, the trimming component is arranged on the side edge of the hot-pressing forming machine component and is used for trimming and cutting a molded product after hot-pressing forming, a transfer die sucker component is arranged on the robot component, the robot component is arranged at the front end of the frame and used for moving the molded product of the forming machine component to the hot-pressing forming machine component for hot-pressing forming, then the molded product is conveyed to the trimming component for cutting, and the material taking component is used for taking out the cut product of the trimming component. The utility model discloses mainly be used for degradable paper pulp molding products such as paper dinner plate, paper bowl or paper cup production, it is integrated type, hot pressing, side cut, piles up and carry multi-functional full-automatic machine as an organic whole, can reduce artifical intensity of labour by a wide margin.

title_en: Edge cutting device of air jet loom
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an edge cutting device of an air jet loom, which comprises a protective shell and a pressing mechanism, wherein the pressing mechanism comprises a compression roller and a rotating mechanism, the rotating mechanism is arranged above the compression roller and comprises a rotating shaft, the rotating shaft is rotatably and alternately connected with the middle part of the compression roller, connecting blocks are fixedly connected with the two ends of the rotating shaft, a connecting rod is fixedly connected between the tops of the two connecting blocks, a movable rod is fixedly and alternately connected with the middle part of the connecting rod, a fixing mechanism is arranged at the top of the movable rod, and a cutting mechanism is arranged at the bottom of an inner cavity of the protective shell. According to the utility model, the top of the movable rod is rotated to drive the connecting rod to rotate together, so that the connecting block and the compression roller are driven to rotate, and the limiting rod slides in the inner cavity of the sliding groove, so that two ends of the limiting rod are respectively movably clamped in the inner cavities of the corresponding clamping grooves on the two fixed blocks, a certain angle is adjusted on the movable rod, the height of the compression roller is changed, and the flattening effect of the compression roller on the woven cloth is ensured.

title_en: Cloth spreading device for quilting embroidery machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cloth spreading device for a quilting embroidery machine, which comprises a workbench and a support arranged above the workbench, wherein the workbench is sequentially provided with an opposite roller assembly, a cloth spreading assembly, a blowing flat assembly and a press roller assembly from left to right, the opposite roller assembly comprises a mounting plate, an upper roller, a lower roller and a driving device, the cloth spreading assembly comprises a pressing block and a flattening motion belt, the blowing flat assembly comprises an induced draft fan, an air inlet pipe and an air outlet, and the press roller assembly comprises a press roller, a hydraulic cylinder and a press roller seat. The utility model has the advantages that pre-flattening of feeding is realized through the opposite roller assembly, wrinkles of the cloth are removed between the pressing block and the flattening movement belt through the pressing block, the cloth is flattened as much as possible, the cloth is blown flat from the middle part to two ends through the blowing flat assembly, impurities above the cloth can be blown into the wind collecting pipe to be collected, and finally the cloth enters the quilting embroidery machine through the pressing roller to perform next work.

The transverse driving component is used for driving the ink box component to move transversely; the longitudinal driving component is used for driving the transverse driving component to move longitudinally so as to drive the ink box component to move longitudinally, and the ink box component moving transversely and longitudinally carries out ink-jet stamping on the certificate through the stamping hole. This automatic mechanism of stamping is favorable to improving stamping efficiency and reduces manual work burden.

title_en: Automatic carton push mechanism of capper
abstract_en: The application relates to a paper box pushing mechanism of an automatic sealing machine, which comprises a pushing groove and a lower conveying roller, wherein the lower conveying roller is arranged at the bottom of an inner cavity of the pushing groove in a rolling manner, a mounting plate is movably arranged at the top of the pushing groove, an upper conveying roller is arranged at the bottom of the mounting plate in a rolling manner, and adjusting mechanisms are movably arranged on two sides of the top of the pushing groove; the adjusting mechanism comprises a cylinder; by arranging the upper conveying roller, the upper conveying roller is pressed at the position, needing to be sealed, of the top of the paper box, so that the paper boards on two sides of the seal are pressed and shaped, and the paper boards on two sides of the top of the paper box are pressed and leveled during sealing, and the sealing is more convenient to be carried out by sticking adhesive tapes; through setting up adjustment mechanism, make its adjustment mechanism can adjust the height of last transfer roller, go up the transfer roller and adapt to the not carton of co-altitude size like this and convey, improve flexibility and suitability, the data of the removal of transfer roller on the convenient accurate understanding of setting up of scale mark makes it.

title_en: Double needle bar warp knitting machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a double needle bar warp knitting machine, which comprises a frame and a looping device, wherein the looping device is arranged on the frame; the looping device comprises two symmetrically arranged grooved needle components and two symmetrically arranged needle core bed transmission mechanisms, each grooved needle component comprises a grooved needle, a needle body bed and a needle core bed, the grooved needle comprises a needle body and a needle core, a needle groove is formed in the needle body, and the needle core is arranged in the needle groove and moves in the needle groove; a needle body is arranged on each side of the needle body bed, and the needle body bed is used for driving the needle body to move upwards or downwards; the needle core bed on each side is provided with a needle core, the needle core bed on each side is connected with the corresponding needle core bed transmission mechanism on the side, and the needle core bed transmission mechanism is used for driving the needle core bed to move upwards or downwards so as to drive the needle core to move upwards or downwards in the needle groove. According to the technical scheme, the grooved needles are adopted for knitting, and the rigidity of the grooved needles is high, so that missing stitches or wrong yarn laying is not easy to generate during high-speed knitting.

title_en: High-efficient automatic cloth inspection machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a cloth inspection machine technical field discloses a high-efficient automatic cloth inspection machine, including the cloth inspection machine body, the spout has all been seted up to the both sides of cloth inspection machine body inner wall, the bottom fixedly connected with cylinder of spout inner wall, the output fixedly connected with telescopic link of cylinder, the top fixedly connected with connecting rod of telescopic link, the one end fixedly connected with collar of connecting rod. The utility model has the advantages of it is following and effect: the connecting rod drives collar and lifter and adjusts from top to bottom, make the surface of brush hair contact cloth, the height of brush hair slightly is greater than the height of dust removal box and dust absorption box, when the cloth is carried the traction and is passed through, the surface of brush hair friction cloth, brush the superficial float hair of cloth, two dust removal boxes start afterwards, will float the hair and inhale in the dust absorption box from the through-hole, thereby collect the clearance with most float hair on cloth surface, avoid the too much effect that influences the perching of cloth surface float hair, the separation is dismantled with the connecting rod to dust removal box accessible adapter sleeve.

title_en: Paper folding and conveying mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a transport mechanism turns over a book of paper, including the movable support that two symmetries set up, two be provided with the slide rail between the movable support, slide rail both ends position is provided with the slide, two it passes through link fixedly connected with gear motor, two to move the arbitrary one end position of movable support inboard the movable support outside position has the removal hold-in range through belt pulley connection, the removal hold-in range one side position of both sides position and the both ends slide fixed connection of slide rail, link fixedly connected with servo motor is passed through to the arbitrary one side position of slide rail, the slide rail inner wall rotates and is connected with positive and negative lead screw, the arbitrary one end of positive and negative lead screw is passed through the speed reducer and is connected with servo motor's drive end, positive and negative lead screw outside position is provided with a plurality of evenly distributed's a book device. The utility model discloses a make the paper turn over a more pleasing to the eye, and fixed adsorption plate has adsorption equipment, and the paper is pleasing to the eye when guaranteeing to remove, does not have the friction when adsorbable cardboard.

title_en: Weft insertion protection device of air jet loom
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a weaving equipment technical field specifically is an air jet loom's wefting insertion protector, which comprises a bod, the surface mounting of organism has the weaving ware, the organism is equipped with for the position of weaving ware and shelters from the device, shelter from the device and include two backup pads, backup pad fixed connection is on the surface of organism, the last fixed surface of backup pad is connected with spacing frame, two the inner wall sliding connection of spacing frame has the winding up roller, the arc surface fixedly connected with protection cloth of winding up roller, the one end and the organism fixed connection of winding up roller are kept away from to protection cloth, four bull sticks of arc surface fixedly connected with of winding up roller, two liang of a set of bull sticks are two sets of the vertical direction axle cross-section symmetric distribution of bull stick for the winding up roller. This application, solved when the staff when the work around air jet loom, the weaving ware is touched easily to the staff to lead to staff's injured problem.

title_en: Manual cylinder corner pressing structure of double-needle sewing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides a manual cylinder corner pressing structure of a double-needle sewing device, belonging to the technical field of sewing devices and solving the problems that when the existing sewing device is used for sewing cloth, different presser feet are required to be replaced for many times during each product sewing period, and the work efficiency of sewing is influenced by frequent replacement of the presser feet; the method comprises the following steps: the device comprises a cylinder, a fixing plate, a mounting block, a presser leg, a presser piece, a mounting mechanism and an adjusting mechanism; the fixed plate is fixedly connected to the lower end of the telescopic shaft of the air cylinder; the mounting block is fixedly connected to the lower end of the fixing plate; the presser foot legs are connected to the lower end of the mounting block in a sliding manner; the presser foot piece is hinged to the lower end of the presser foot leg; the mounting mechanism is arranged at the upper end of the presser foot leg; the adjusting mechanism is arranged at the upper end of the presser foot piece; through the utility model discloses a setting has realized the installation to presser foot spare and to different thickness, the different sewing of making up the method cloth, has saved the time of changing the presser foot, has improved work efficiency.

title_en: Recovery processing device for small nylon bobbin yarn
abstract_en: The utility model provides a recovery processing device for small nylon bobbin yarns, which comprises an operation concave table, a pushing mechanism and a cutting mechanism, wherein the opening of the operation concave table is upward and is used for bearing the small bobbin yarns; the pushing mechanism is slidably arranged in the inner cavity of the operation concave table; the cutting mechanism is arranged at the top end of the operation concave table and is arranged on one side along the advancing direction of the small bobbin thread; the pushing mechanism pushes the small bobbin silk to continuously advance, and when the small bobbin silk contacts the cutting mechanism, the small bobbin silk is cut by the cutting mechanism, so that the wire collecting bobbin of the small bobbin silk is separated from the silk threads. The utility model discloses a set up pushing mechanism and cutting mechanism, pushing mechanism pushes away the small bobbin silk to cutting mechanism department, is cut by cutting mechanism to make the collection line section of thick bamboo and the silk thread separation of small bobbin silk, reach recovery processing's purpose, the automatic completion of cutting process has not only improved work efficiency, has avoided operating personnel and cutting mechanism direct contact moreover, and personnel's safety has been guaranteed to the at utmost.

title_en: Edge cutting device for clothing production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a trimming device for clothing production, which comprises a frame, wherein a trimming table is arranged on the frame, a trimming frame is arranged on the trimming table, a pressing cylinder is arranged above the trimming frame and is fixed on the frame through a bolt and a nut, and the lower end of the pressing cylinder is fixedly connected with the trimming frame through a bolt and a nut; a cutting device is arranged on the inner side of the cutting frame and comprises a fixed frame, a fixed cutter, a cutting motor, a cam, a cutter tooth, a limiting groove, a limiting stud and a shifting hole; this cutting edge device for clothing production through the frame that sets up, cuts platform, cuts frame, cutting device, cuts sword, mount, stationary knife, joint-cutting, cuts the structure of motor, cam etc. has not only realized the high-efficient cutting edge that the pressure cut and the smooth cutting that combine together of cloth have satisfied multiple cloth, the cutting needs of cladding, has improved the life of cutter moreover, has weakened the cutter passivation.

title_en: Automatic paper feeding device for cake paper support production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a paper holds in palm production facility technical field, specifically be an automatic adsorption paper feeding device for production of cake paper holds in palm, can fix the paper in transportation process, avoid appearing the problem of grabbing empty, can avoid the paper warpage simultaneously, the problem of skew, practical meaning and spreading value have, expect to produce good economic benefits, including the drive roller, conveyor belt, a breathing pipe, the air pump, fly leaf and electro-magnet, conveyor belt cover is located and is driven by the drive roller on the drive roller, the last through-hole that is provided with of conveyor belt, a breathing pipe sets up in conveyor belt below, breathing pipe and each breathing pipe intercommunication, breathing pipe one links to each other with the air pump, the air pump is located the conveyor belt right side, fly leaf and conveyor belt swing joint, the fly leaf sets up along conveyor belt width direction, each row is located and is provided with the magnet piece in through-hole both sides and the fly leaf, the magnet piece that is located in the through-hole both sides fly leaf of same line attracts each other, the electro-magnet is located the conveyor belt right side.

title_en: Integral upper lace shirring component
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an integrated upper lace shirring component, which comprises a flat sewing machine presser foot and an outer straight cylinder, wherein the contour of the inner wall of the outer straight cylinder is strip-shaped, and the width of the contour of the inner wall of the outer straight cylinder is 0.3cm-0.5cm; the outer straight cylinder is arranged on the left side of the flat sewing machine presser foot, the rear side edge of the outer straight cylinder is fixed on the presser foot of the flat sewing machine presser foot, the outer straight cylinder is in an inclined posture with a high left and a low right, and the right side port of the outer straight cylinder is close to a needle hole of the flat sewing machine presser foot. The utility model discloses can take out the pleat to the lace is automatic, take out the automatic sewing of pleat when conveniently sewing, the effect is high, can not take out the pleat volume because of the manual sewing influence of workman, and it is even to knit the mouth, can not appear two stitches.

title_en: Multi-screen filter plain boiled water recovery system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a multi-screen filter white water recovery system, which relates to the technical field of papermaking, and the inside of a layer-by-layer filter tank sequentially comprises an ultra-clear filtrate tank, a clear filtrate tank and a turbid filtrate tank according to the flowing direction of liquid; compared with the prior art, the turbid filtrate tank and the white water tower of the utility model are respectively communicated with the clear water tank, the turbid filtrate tank and the white water tower respectively convey liquid to the clear water tank, a large amount of water is stored in the clear water tank, and the clear water tank is communicated with the mixer to convey liquid, so that sufficient water is input into the mixer; the slurry tank is communicated with the mixer to convey liquid, and the mixer mixes the liquid conveyed by the slurry tank and the liquid conveyed by the clean water tank in the mixer; the mixer is communicated with the mixed pulp inlet of the multi-screen filter, and the mixed liquid is input into the multi-screen filter. The clear water tank can provide sufficient water source, guarantees to input sufficient water to the blender, and then guarantees to provide sufficient water to the multi-screen filter, guarantees that the inside water yield of multi-screen filter is stable.

title_en: Spinning device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of school uniform weaving technique and specifically relates to a weaving device, comprising a base plate, the top fixedly connected with box of bottom plate, the top of box and the bottom fixed connection of diaphragm, the one end of diaphragm and the one end fixed connection of slide bar, the outer wall sliding clamping of slide bar has the riser, the bottom fixedly connected with square plate of riser, the top of diaphragm is equipped with splint, the top of bottom plate is equipped with adjusts the structure, and through bottom plate, box, diaphragm, slide bar, bent plate, electric putter, splint, riser, square plate and the cooperation of adjusting the structure, motor drive gear one rotates, and gear drive gear two rotates, and gear one and gear two drive the down tube and remove, and the down tube drives the square plate and removes, and then with splint adjust suitable position after, electric putter drives splint and move down, and then realize fixing not unidimensional school uniform, degree of automation is high, saves the labour.

title_en: Trapezoidal cup ironing machine frame opening and closing structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a trapezoidal boiling hot cup machine frame open and shut structure in heat-transfer seal equipment field, including frame and square steel one, a frame tip is provided with the plastic rod that is used for the support, a frame tip is provided with the hand (hold), the hand (hold) with be provided with lead screw one between the frame, a lead screw periphery is located the frame and hand (hold) contact department position is provided with the nylon cover, another tip of hand (hold) rotates and is connected with inside lining axle one, inside lining axle one periphery is provided with the hand (hold) axle, hand (hold) axle periphery is provided with the hand (hold) cover, be located between the frame the lead screw one-side is provided with lead screw two. The utility model discloses changed the appearance of equipment, prevented that aesthetic fatigue, the hand (hold) is in same level with operating panel, trapezoidal outward appearance, and bilateral symmetry has the symmetry beautiful, has certain inclined plane to have the gradient to feel, conveniently watches the parameter, and the square is just, and is simple generous, and easy operation has enough big position display operating panel, and is extremely practical.

title_en: Air cushion base cloth for offset printing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of printing technology, specifically be novel air cushion backer for offset printing, the backer body from the top down is equipped with enhancement layer, air cushion layer, tensile layer and second abrasionproof layer in proper order, the upper surface and the lower surface of air cushion layer all are equipped with a plurality of dead levers that run through enhancement layer and tensile layer, through the reinforcing plate, can improve the intensity in backer body week side, the screw can run through the backer body to make the more firm of butt joint between each layer of backer body, a plurality of dead levers that the surface was equipped with about the air cushion layer enable the air cushion layer fixed more firm between enhancement layer and tensile layer, buffering piece and bracing piece can provide a supporting effect for the air cushion layer, can improve the resilience effect on air cushion layer, thereby make the backer body more stable when using.

title_en: Spinning cradle for vortex spinning machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a spinning cradle for vortex spinning machine, which comprises a fixed base and a fixed box, wherein the fixed box is provided with a fixed hole for fixing a cradle shaft; the fixed base comprises an auxiliary fixed plate, a transverse sliding seat is arranged on the auxiliary fixed plate, a longitudinal sliding seat arranged on the transverse sliding seat in a sliding manner and capable of sliding along the transverse sliding seat, and a fixed plate arranged on the longitudinal sliding seat in a sliding manner and used for fixing the shaking table, wherein the fixed plate slides along the longitudinal sliding seat; the peripheral side of the auxiliary fixing plate extends longitudinally to form a longitudinal baffle; the shaking table is arranged on the fixed plate, the fixed plate can rock on the X axis and the Y axis through the longitudinal sliding seat and the transverse sliding seat, and the longitudinal baffle plates arranged on the peripheral side of the auxiliary fixed plate can play a good role in protection, so that the shaking table is prevented from falling off; when the fixed plate slides from side to side, when extremely being close to longitudinal baffle, can avoid vibrations or slide too fast because of the different reverse effort that produces of magnetism, damage equipment.

title_en: Cloth material
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cloth, thread and subline constitute for three layer construction's cloth main part through interweaving, the cloth main part is from the top down in proper order: a matte layer, an elastic layer and a skin-friendly layer; the main lines and the auxiliary lines of the extinction layer and the elastic layer are woven in different modes, and the two adjacent layers are woven together through the main lines. The utility model discloses a mode of adopting the layering to weave divides into the three-layer with the cloth to adopt the mode of three-layer to weave respectively to prepare, through the mode of adopting the main and auxiliary line to weave each other on the extinction layer, constitute a plurality of well word holes, the fixed of the elastic layer of being convenient for, thus constitute the surface unevenness, have the extinction effect, adopt the synthetic fiber of titanium dioxide delustering agent to further improve the extinction effect simultaneously, constitute elastic layer through the main and auxiliary line that adopts parallel arrangement, make it have good ductility and flexibility; the utility model has the characteristics of elasticity is strong, the extinction is effectual.

title_en: Environmental protection wrapping bag production is with cutting device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of packaging bag production, and discloses a slitting device for environment-friendly packaging bag production, which comprises a substrate and a bracket, wherein two guide rollers which are parallel to each other are vertically arranged on two sides of the upper surface of the substrate, a tensioning roller is fixed in the middle of the upper surface of the substrate, and a plastic belt is wound between the two guide rollers and the tensioning roller; the lower part of the support is fixed on the side wall of the roller frame of one of the guide rollers, the upper part of the support is fixed with a bearing platform, and a sliding rail is arranged on the bearing platform. The utility model discloses when the blade is changed to needs, upwards turn the guard shield, lift up the support arm through the round pin axle, the anticlockwise rotation butterfly bolt breaks away from in the bolt hole of inserted bar, and the rotatory location ball guarantees that another piece does not use the blade vertical downwards, and the bolt hole of rotatory butterfly bolt and inserted bar is carried out the screw thread and is twisted up fixedly and just can be fixed the location ball again, turns over the guard shield at last and gets off the blade that does not use the location ball outer wall and protect, improves the security.

title_en: Jacquard vertical needle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a jacquard machine technical field specifically is a jacquard machine pintle, including novel jacquard machine pintle assembly, novel jacquard machine pintle assembly is including pintle main part and pintle installation mechanism, and pintle installation mechanism installs the one side department on pintle main part top, pintle installation mechanism is including the diaphragm simultaneously, riser and spiral mounting groove, this while pintle main part bottom is provided with the pointed end, and one side of pintle main part is close to top department and is provided with the spiral installation screw rod, and through setting up including pintle main part and pintle installation mechanism novel jacquard machine pintle assembly of riser main part and improve current jacquard machine pintle's structure and mounting means, make it be dismantled and assembled structure, adopt spiral mounting's connected mode to make things convenient for the dismouting simultaneously, change, the steadiness after this while installing is strong, the modeling structure that combines the pintle installation mechanism of setting can effectually solve current jacquard machine pintle and easily take place the problem that becomes flexible and drop, guarantee the smooth work that expandes of jacquard machine.

title_en: A suturing device for leisure trousers production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a sewing machine technical field just discloses a suturing device for leisure trousers production, including sewing platform, sewing machine body, sewing machine structure, winding mechanism and stop gear, sewing machine body fixed mounting is on the right side of sewing platform upper end, sewing machine structure is located the lower extreme of sewing machine body, winding mechanism is located the front and back both sides of sewing machine bench end, stop gear is located the upper end of sewing platform. This suturing device for leisure pants production, first motor drives the lead screw and rotates, thereby drive the slider, curb plate and clamp plate side-to-side motion, thereby can carry out spacing suppression to the leisure pants of different width, and, electric putter drives the output lever flexible, thereby drive clamp plate up-and-down motion, thereby can carry on spacingly to the leisure pants of different thickness, make the leisure pants can laminate the upper end at the sewing platform always when sewing up, do not need manually to compress tightly the leisure pants, the operation is more simple and convenient, the security is higher.

title_en: Cutting die of environment-friendly paper packaging box
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cutting die of environmental protection paper packing carton, the on-line screen storage device comprises a base, the top of base is provided with cuts the mechanism, the top fixed mounting of base has the sliding sleeve, the top fixed mounting of sliding sleeve has the motor, the output fixedly connected with threaded rod of motor, the slider is installed to the surface thread of threaded rod, the slider is slidable mounting with the inside of sliding sleeve, a lateral wall fixed mounting of slider has the fixed plate. This cutting die of environmental protection paper packing carton, it rotates to drive the threaded rod through the motor, the threaded rod drives the slider and slides in the inside of sliding sleeve, it moves down to drive the fixed plate through the slider, thereby it is fixed to drive the clamp plate to press down the packing carton, prevent the skew, spring and telescopic link make behind the clamp plate contact packing carton, the slider can continue to move down, it moves down to drive the fixed plate through the slider, and promote the adsorption plate through electric putter, make the adsorption plate with cut cutter and packing carton laminating, thereby glue its surface-adhered's paper sediment.

title_en: Connect dress paper embossing apparatus
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of tipping paper embossing, in particular to a tipping paper embossing device which improves the stability and convenience of equipment use; the embossing device comprises a base, two side plates, two sliding blocks, a cross rod, a rotary sleeve, an auxiliary embossing device and a plurality of embossing assemblies, wherein the auxiliary embossing device is installed on the base; the embossing assembly comprises two first auxiliary plates, a first rotating rod and an embossing roller, wherein the two first auxiliary plates are arranged on the rotating sleeve, the first rotating rod is arranged between the two first auxiliary plates through a bearing, and the embossing roller is arranged on the first rotating rod.

title_en: Waste spray head redundancy utilization mechanism of high-speed digital printing machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-speed digital printing machine waste spray head redundant utilization mechanism, including the shower nozzle bottom plate, be equipped with on the shower nozzle bottom plate along paper feed direction front and back distribution, transverse arrangement's two rows of shower nozzle groups, every row of shower nozzle group all includes a plurality of shower nozzles of interval distribution, and at paper feed direction dislocation distribution between the shower nozzle of front-seat shower nozzle group and the shower nozzle of back row shower nozzle group, its characterized in that: the sprayer bottom plate is provided with transversely arranged slide rails which are positioned at the rear side of the rear row of sprayer groups, a plurality of slide seats are movably adjusted on the slide rails, a locking structure is arranged between the slide seats and the slide rails, the slide seats can be selectively provided with waste sprayers, and the usable parts of the waste sprayers correspond to the damaged parts of the two rows of sprayer groups; and an opening is formed in the spray head bottom plate corresponding to the moving path of the waste spray head. The utility model discloses realize two purpose of scrapping the shower nozzle and merging normal use, can reduce the use cost of equipment by a wide margin.

title_en: Presser foot lifting device for stepping motor of blind stitch sewing machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a step motor of blind stitch sewing machine lifts presser foot device, including lifting the presser foot part, lift the presser foot part and be connected with lower arm seat, wherein, lower arm seat with lift the presser foot device and be connected, lift the presser foot device and include step motor, step motor passes through step motor support fixed connection on the blind stitch sewing machine body, is fixed with on step motor's the output shaft and lifts the presser foot cam, lifts the antifriction bearing that the presser foot cam pressed close to on the adjust stop, adjust stop and the mutual swing joint of adjust block support, adjust block support and lower arm seat looks fixed connection install adjust knob on adjust stop, be equipped with above the adjust knob and can push down adjust knob's elasticity preforming. The novel structure for realizing the pressing action by the stepping motor replaces an electromagnetic valve containing an electromagnet in the prior art to lift the pressing foot device, reduces vibration and noise, reduces the use cost of a machine, reduces the failure rate of equipment, and improves the production efficiency.

title_en: Double-roller supporting platform of flag machine
abstract_en: The utility model provides a two roller supporting platform of flag machine, including setting up at step-by-step backing roll and the driven backing roll of beating the printer head below, step-by-step backing roll with the driven backing roll rotates along the same direction of rotation in step, the upper surface of step-by-step backing roll with form the support transfer passage who supports and carry print medium between the upper surface of driven backing roll. According to the double-roller supporting platform of the flag machine, the pair of driven supporting rollers and the pair of stepping supporting rollers which rotate synchronously are used as the printing platform, so that the flexible printing medium can be tensioned between the driven supporting rollers and the stepping supporting rollers all the time when being sprayed, and the defect of disordered printing pictures is effectively avoided. Meanwhile, the driven supporting roller and the stepping supporting roller synchronously rotate by using the synchronous belt, so that the front-back consistency of the flexible printing medium during stepping is ensured, and the defect of lagging of the rear end of the flexible printing medium is avoided.

title_en: Flannelette winding mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a cloth rolling equipment technical field especially relates to a cotton flannel winding mechanism. The following technical scheme is proposed: including the control box, one side of control box is provided with control panel, the inside of control box is provided with driving motor, driving motor's output shaft passes through transfer line fixedly connected with connecting rod, the inside of connecting rod is provided with spacing fixture, the outside cover of connecting rod is equipped with the wind-up roll that is located between two locating pieces, the outside locating piece can be dismantled with logical groove and be connected, one side of control box is connected with dwang one and dwang two, dwang one all overlaps with the outside of dwang two and is equipped with the glue roller. The utility model has the advantages that the limiting clamping mechanism is arranged in the connecting rod, so that the wind-up roll is positioned and clamped in the middle position of the connecting rod, the smooth rolling is facilitated, and the design mode is convenient to disassemble and has good stability; and can remove the fine hair to the two-sided of cotton flannel when the rolling.

title_en: Cutting fixing device for packaging box
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of life, in particular to a cutting and fixing device of a packing box, which comprises a fixing device main body, a power assembly and a pressing device; the fixing device main body is composed of a movable rod, a positioning block, a groove body, a chassis and a fixing block; one end of the fixed block is integrally connected with the chassis; the other end of the fixed block is movably connected with the trough body, and the fixed block is arranged in the trough body; one end of the movable rod is integrally connected with the groove body, and the other end of the movable rod penetrates through the positioning block; the movable rod, the groove body and the fixed block are arranged in the fixing device main body, so that the chassis can perform circular motion, the packaging box fixed on the chassis can perform circular motion, and the periphery of the packaging box can be conveniently cut and fixed; through set up the spring in closing device, can adjust the size, be convenient for fix the packing carton of equidimension not, can make the packing carton be in the middle part all the time simultaneously, application range is wider, and the practicality is stronger.

title_en: Carton glues compaction device that pastes of punch-out equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a carton production field just discloses a carton glues compaction device of pasting of punch-out equipment, including the curb plate, the positive movable mounting of curb plate has the drive wheel, the outer wall swing joint of drive wheel has the conveyer belt, the positive fixedly connected with fixed block of curb plate, the top fixedly connected with atress board of fixed block, the top fixedly connected with backup pad of curb plate, the bottom swing joint of backup pad has the roof, the bottom fixedly connected with electric putter of roof. This carton glues compaction device of pasting of punch-out equipment through conveyer belt, fixed block, atress board, electric putter, clamp plate, loose axle, reset spring, fly leaf, gyro wheel and the connecting axle that sets up, can make the device possess the effect of convenient to use, carries out effectual compaction operation to the carton through clamp plate cooperation atress board to utilize the gyro wheel can prevent that the both sides of carton from curling, thereby guarantee the stability of compaction, satisfied people's user demand.

title_en: Double-layer paper bag machine printing composite structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a double-layer paper bag machine printing composite structure, which comprises a frame, wherein one end of the frame is respectively provided with an inner layer paper unreeling mechanism and a facial tissue unreeling mechanism, the middle part of the frame is provided with a printing unit, the other end of the frame is provided with a gluing device and a composite device, the output end of the composite device is connected with a paper bag tube forming device, and the inner layer paper unreeling mechanism and the facial tissue unreeling mechanism unreel paper to be conveyed to the corresponding gluing device or the corresponding printing unit through a corresponding front traction mechanism and a corresponding middle guide roller; the feeding end of the gluing device is also provided with a first rear traction mechanism and a first deviation correcting device according to the paper path; and a tension control device, a second rear traction mechanism and a second deviation correcting device are sequentially arranged between the compounding device and the printing unit according to the paper advancing path, and the compounding device is connected with the glue coating device and the discharge end of the second deviation correcting device.

title_en: Financial finance accounting is with automatic device of stamping
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a financial finance accounting is with automatic device of stamping, including bed plate, bracing piece, U type mount, movable rod and U type grip block, welded fastening has the bracing piece around the top of bed plate, welded fastening has U type mount between the top of bracing piece, and U type mount outside one side welded fastening has the rotating electrical machines, and the output of rotating electrical machines is fixed with the cam, and U type mount is located bottom one end welded fastening has the fixed plate, and the hole has been seted up to fixed plate center department, and the outside welded fastening who lies in the hole on the fixed plate has compression spring. Has the advantages that: the arc movable block realizes the up-and-down motion to U type grip block under compression spring and cam cooperation, and T type gag lever post drives the connecting block and carries out the centre gripping to the seal under limiting plate, spacing hole and fixed spring's effect fixed, and easy operation is convenient, and stable in structure safety realizes automatic effect of stamping, and reasonable in design is ingenious, and the stamping is evenly stable, and practicality is strong, is worth wideling produce and popularization.

title_en: Printing device for processing packaging box
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an embossing device for packaging box processing, belonging to the field of packaging box embossing processing, comprising a supporting component and an embossing component, wherein the embossing component is arranged above the supporting component and also comprises a limiting component and a bulletproof component; the supporting component comprises a machine table and an operating table. abstract_en: The utility model relates to a leveling device technical field just discloses a leveling device is used in carton production, including the mount, mount bottom four corners fixed mounting has the bracing piece, and the mount top is provided with the installing frame, and the even interval in installing frame bottom surface is provided with the first gyro wheel that flattens, and installing frame bottom four corners fixed mounting has the guide bar, and inside the guide bar is flexible to be provided with the mount, mount one end outside fixed mounting had first motor, the utility model discloses, drive the belt pulley through starting the second motor and rotate to make the worm with belt pulley connection rotate simultaneously, driven the screw rod on the gear like this and rotated, thereby made the guide bar remove at flexible inslot portion, driven the installing frame simultaneously like this and the first gyro wheel that flattens and reciprocated, thereby realized adjusting the interval between the first gyro wheel that flattens and the second gyro wheel that flattens, can flatten the completion to the carton of different thickness like this and remove the work of wrinkle, thereby effectually enlarged whole suitable scope.

title_en: Roll-over control roller
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a frame technical field specifically is a turnover control roller installs on the frame support, include with support activity articulated fly leaf, it is connected with two compressing rollers to rotate on the fly leaf, two compressing rollers support under the action of gravity and lean on the leather collar, still be equipped with fixed subassembly on the support, be used for the compressing roller breaks away from the leather collar after-fixing, when the yarn broken end, only needs to rotate the fly leaf to it is fixed through fixed subassembly, just can make two compressing rollers break away from the leather collar, thereby the effectual both hands of liberating operating personnel have improved work efficiency, and the yarn quality is better.

title_en: Device for removing foreign fiber matters in textile fibers
abstract_en: A device for removing foreign fiber objects in textile fibers belongs to the technical field of textile equipment; the device comprises a material collecting barrel, wherein a filter screen is arranged at the bottom of the material collecting barrel, an inserting hole is formed in the middle of the filter screen, a rotary drum is arranged at the inserting hole, the bottom of the rotary drum is connected with the ground through a bearing, a power device is arranged on one side of the material collecting barrel, and the output end of the power device extends downwards to the bottom of the material collecting barrel; the utility model discloses a be provided with the filter screen in the bottom of receiving the feed cylinder, the filter screen can be discharged granule in the sponge, thereby cooperates the bottom that the mutual roll extrusion at the rolling cylinder at top and filter screen can extend the twigs in the cotton fibre downwards the filter screen simultaneously, and the convenience is filtered it.

title_en: Mask edge sealing device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the gauze mask production technique and specifically relates to a gauze mask banding device, including base and carriage, the upper end intermediate position department of base rotates and is connected with the rotation platform, the upper end fixedly connected with of rotation platform holds the frame, the lower extreme fixedly connected with drive disc of rotation platform, the lower extreme of rotation platform rotates and is connected with the pressure-bearing ball, the utility model discloses in, through rotation platform, pressure-bearing ball and the carousel that set up, utilize the rotation to the carousel to make the transfer line can drive the drive peg and rotate to make the drive disc can drive the rotation platform and carry out fixed angle and rotate, and then make the frame of holding of rotation platform upper end can carry out fixed angle and rotate, so that hold the frame and can drive the gauze mask and carry out fixed angle and rotate, so that the hot melt plate can carry out accurate banding processing to the gauze mask to the effect of the pressure-bearing ball through the setting can rotate support and the heat-seal support the rotation platform, guarantees the effect to the gauze mask.

title_en: Fly frame ash cleaner
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fly frame deashing ware, including fly frame main part, fly frame keel, two sets of curb plates, two sets of fly frame keel, multiunit right angle fixed block, actuating mechanism, two sets of sliders, suction box and dust absorption mechanism, the top in the fly frame main part is installed to the fly frame keel, both sides around the fly frame keel top are fixed to two sets of curb plate symmetries to the left and right sides between two sets of curb plates is fixed to two sets of fly frame keel symmetries, a serial communication port, still include air-blast mechanism, air-blast mechanism installs on the suction box, and air-blast mechanism is used for blowing up the short flannel or the flying cotton wool of fly frame keel both sides. The utility model discloses a blow to fly frame keel both sides simultaneously, ensured the short flannel or the flying cotton fibre of adhesion on the fly frame keel left and right sides can be abundant raise and collected, improved the clearance effect of device.

title_en: Circular elastic band stitching machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a stitch sewing machine for stitching annular elastic band. The sewing machine comprises a bracket, wherein a working table is arranged on the bracket, and a flat sewing machine is arranged on the working table; a ring-stitching frame is arranged on the bracket corresponding to one side of the head of the lockstitch sewing machine; the ring frame comprises: more than two support arms are arranged on the support, and a roller is horizontally arranged on each support arm. The utility model discloses stitch machine stitch the annular elastic cord, on ordinary stitch machine basis, redesign, cutting the flat bed sewing machine platen to install elastic cord distraction device additional, make the work piece can overlap on equipment platen and elastic cord distraction frame, change the frame size simultaneously, adapt to the little platform version of flat bed sewing machine, guarantee that equipment places stably. Through practical use, the shrinkage of elastic band stitching is uniform, the needle spacing is kept stable, and the requirements of various garment flat seam elastic band stitching procedures are met.

title_en: Indentation card box machine convenient to maintain
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an indentation cartridge machine convenient to maintain, which comprises a base, wherein a supporting frame is fixed on the upper surface of the base, an adjusting mechanism is arranged on the supporting frame, a template is arranged in the supporting frame, and a replacing mechanism is arranged on the base. This indentation card box machine convenient to maintain is provided with change mechanism and adjustment mechanism, mutually support each structure through changing mechanism and adjustment mechanism between, enable the support frame and conveniently dismantle from the base, make the supporting shoe remove in the slide rail back of the body through the slider, the stopper separates with the fixed block along with it, thereby make the fixed block shift out in the recess, thereby make the support frame convenient and the base separation, thereby make the device more convenient in maintaining, still move the clamp plate in the support frame through the operation of cylinder, adapt to the corrugated container board of different thickness through the clamp plate that removes, it is more convenient simultaneously through the cylinder drive, it is more convenient when removing the regulation to make the clamp plate.

title_en: Multifunctional bag making machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional bag making machine, which comprises a bag making machine shell, wherein heat dissipation openings are formed in two sides of the bag making machine shell, a dustproof net is arranged in the heat dissipation openings, support plates are fixedly connected to side walls of two ends of the dustproof net, a plugboard is fixedly connected to one side of each support plate, a slot corresponding to the plugboard is formed in the outer wall of the bag making machine shell, a groove is formed above the slot, a sliding rod is fixedly connected to the groove, an L-shaped clamping rod is sleeved on the sliding rod in a sliding manner, the bottom end of the L-shaped clamping rod penetrates through the groove and extends inwards the slot, and clamping grooves corresponding to the L-shaped clamping rod are formed in the plugboard.

title_en: Improved gravure printing machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an improved gravure rolling machine which comprises a box body, wherein a gravure roller is rotatably connected to the lower end between two ends of the inner part of the box body, a gravure roller is rotatably connected to the inner part of the box body above the gravure roller, a scraping structure is fixedly connected to one side, close to the gravure roller, of the inner part of the box body, a fixed bottom plate is fixedly connected to the bottom end of the box body, a plurality of anti-slip structures are fixedly connected to the bottom end of the fixed bottom plate, the scraping structure comprises a supporting rod, and the supporting rod is fixedly connected to one side, close to the gravure roller, of the inner part of the box body. This gravure press is rolled up to improvement formula can strike off unnecessary printing ink through striking off the structure to make different decorative patterns, increase pleasing to the eye degree, can contact with the outside of embossing roller all the time through striking off the board, can pop out it fast through the elasticity of connecting spring, the flexibility when increasing the use, can make the more smooth and easy that the fly leaf removed through the mutually supporting of slide rail and slider, avoid appearing the condition of card.

title_en: Screen printer
abstract_en: The application relates to a screen printer relates to printing machine technical field, aims at improving whole printing element and moves the mode of printing towards waiting to print the product, has reduced the problem of the operational stability of whole printing machine. The screen printer comprises a workbench and a support frame arranged on the upper surface of the workbench, wherein a screen printing plate is arranged on the support frame, a scraper is movably arranged on the screen printing plate, and a driving assembly for driving the scraper to print is arranged on the workbench; the workbench is provided with a bearing table for bearing products to be printed, and the workbench is provided with a lifting assembly for driving the bearing table to be close to or far away from the screen printing plate. The printing press has the effect of improving the overall running stability of the printing press.

title_en: Tentering setting machine with automatic cleaning air purifying and heat recovering double-effect device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of tentering setting machines, and discloses a tentering setting machine with an automatic cleaning air purification and heat recovery double-effect device, which comprises a setting machine body, supporting legs fixedly arranged at the bottom of the setting machine body, stabilizing plates fixedly arranged at the inner wall positions of the supporting legs, and a processing assembly arranged at the inner wall positions of the setting machine body, wherein the processing assembly comprises a cleaning mechanism arranged at the inner wall positions of the setting machine body, a treatment mechanism is arranged at the inner wall positions of the setting machine body, the treatment mechanism is positioned at the left side positions of the cleaning mechanism, and mounting mechanisms are arranged at the left side positions and the right side positions of the setting machine body. The utility model solves the problems that the tenter setting machine in the prior art is provided with the waste gas purifying device at the top position, but the efficiency of purifying air is further reduced due to the smaller contact area between the surface of the waste gas purifying device and the waste gas.

title_en: Full-automatic sheet-fed printing machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a full-automatic sheet printing machine, which comprises a feeding device, a printing device and a discharging device, wherein the feeding device comprises a feeding storage mechanism and a feeding conveying manipulator for taking out sheets in the feeding storage mechanism and conveying the sheets to a feeding station; the printing device comprises a frame, a positioning module, a printing module and a carrying device, wherein the positioning module is arranged on the frame, the carrying device is used for transferring sheets in a feeding station into the positioning module, transferring sheets which are positioned in the positioning module into the printing module and transferring sheets which are printed in the printing module into a discharging station; the blanking device comprises a blanking storage mechanism and a blanking conveying manipulator used for conveying the sheet materials in the blanking station to the blanking storage mechanism. The full-automatic sheet printing machine can automatically realize the material taking, positioning, printing and discharging of the sheet materials, and has higher degree of automation.

title_en: Edge cutting device of air jet loom
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an air jet loom trimming device, and relates to the technical field of trimming devices. The utility model comprises a bottom plate, wherein a fixed block is slidingly matched with the upper side of the bottom plate, a limit plate is fixed on one side of the fixed block, a screw rod is rotationally matched with the fixed block, an electric push rod is arranged on the other side of the fixed block, a supporting plate is arranged at the output end of the electric push rod, two supporting blocks are slidingly matched with the upper side of the supporting plate, and a threaded rod is rotationally matched between the two supporting blocks.

title_en: Gauze cutter
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a gauze cutter, and relates to the technical field of medicine. The automatic gauze cutting device comprises a placing box, wherein a placing column is fixedly connected to the rear side of the inner wall of the placing box, a gauze roll is sleeved on the surface of the placing column, a movable plate is hinged to the front face of the placing box, a discharge hole is formed in the left side face of the placing box in a penetrating mode, the free end of the gauze roll extends out of the discharge hole, a cutting assembly and an anti-shrinkage assembly are arranged on the left side face of the placing box, the cutting assembly comprises a fixing plate, the fixing plate is fixedly connected to the left side face of the placing box, a sliding groove is formed in the top face of the fixing plate in a penetrating mode, a sliding block is connected to the inner wall of the sliding groove in a sliding mode, a holding rod is fixedly connected to the top of the sliding block, the effect of facilitating rapid continuous cutting of gauze is achieved in use, the situation that the free end of gauze is shrunk in cutting can be avoided, subsequent pulling of gauze cutting is more convenient, and good practicability is achieved.

title_en: Horizontal cord fabric yarn cutting machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a horizontal curtain fabric yarn cutting machine which comprises a release traction mechanism, a cutting conveying mechanism, a switching mechanism, a butt joint conveying mechanism, a deviation correcting and slitting mechanism, a centering mechanism, a laminating mechanism and a winding mechanism; the cutting conveying mechanism, the switching mechanism, the butt joint conveying mechanism, the deviation correcting and slitting mechanism, the centering mechanism, the attaching mechanism and the winding mechanism are sequentially arranged according to the process steps. The utility model combines the working procedures of unreeling, cutting, slitting, attaching, reeling and the like into a production line according to the working sequence of each section, and has the advantage of high automation degree. In addition, the knife felt roller in the deviation rectifying and strip dividing mechanism is composed of the knife felt shaft and the plurality of knife felt small rollers, and after the surface of the knife felt roller is easily damaged, one of the knife felt small rollers is mainly replaced, so that the knife felt roller can be continuously used, and the cost is greatly saved.

title_en: Automatic sliding type film label printing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses automatic sliding type film label printing equipment, which relates to the technical field of printing equipment and comprises a main body, wherein a feeding roller is arranged on the left side of the lower end of an inner cavity of the main body, a driving roller is arranged on one side of the feeding roller, a printer is arranged on one side of the driving roller, and a drying device is arranged on one side of the printer. According to the film label printing equipment, under the combined action of the drying box, the motor, the fan blades, the heating pipe, the fixing rod and the clamping roller, the film label printing equipment has the effect of drying the label after working, and under the combined action of the electric push rod, the first connecting plate, the buffer spring, the fixing block, the second connecting plate, the cutter rest and the cutter, the film label printing equipment has the function of cutting the paper size required by two ends of the film label, and dust collection treatment of the film label printing equipment on the dust on the surface of an internal mechanism is increased under the combined action of the mounting seat, the fan, the dust collection pipeline and the dust storage box.

title_en: Positioning protection device for wood grain printing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a positioning protection device for wood grain printing, which belongs to the technical field of wood grain printing and comprises a workbench, wherein a supporting bearing is clamped in the workbench, a rotating shaft is sleeved in the supporting bearing, a first adjusting plate is clamped on the outer surface of the rotating shaft, the upper surfaces of the first adjusting plate are hinged with the lower surfaces of two second adjusting plates, and the lower surfaces of the second adjusting plates are hinged with the upper surfaces of adjusting blocks. This a location protector for wood grain printing through setting up first regulating plate, second regulating plate, regulating block, control block, rubber positioning roller, protection casing, lead screw, nut, limiting plate and stop screw for this device not only can fix a position the wood grain membrane of equidimension, can smooth the wood grain membrane simultaneously in the location process, can also protect the printing of wood grain membrane, avoids the wood grain membrane to drop because of the foreign matter and leads to the condition that the wood grain membrane takes place to damage in the printing process.

title_en: Auxiliary device of sewing machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an auxiliary device of a sewing machine, which is technically characterized by comprising a machine table, wherein the machine table is provided with the sewing machine and the auxiliary device, the auxiliary device is arranged at a sewing opening of the sewing machine and comprises a folding cylinder and a pinch roller, two ends of the folding cylinder are respectively provided with an inlet end of a semicircular structure and an outlet end of a flat structure, an arc transition section is arranged between the inlet end and the outlet end, a small pressure rod is further arranged on the folding cylinder, the small pressure rod extends from the inlet end to the outlet end and is positioned in the middle of the arc transition section, the pinch roller is positioned at the outlet end and can rotate, and the outer circumferential surface of the pinch roller is tangential to the outlet end of the flat structure. The automatic folding cloth strip folding machine has the function of automatically and quickly folding cloth strips, greatly reduces the labor intensity and improves the working efficiency.

title_en: Transversely-moving embroidery bracket
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a transversely moving embroidery bracket, which comprises a fixed frame, wherein a supporting rod is arranged on the fixed frame, and a leveling device is arranged on the fixed frame; the flattening device comprises two flattening press rolls and a driving mechanism, wherein the driving mechanism drives the two flattening press rolls to move along the length direction of the fixed frame, and the two flattening press rolls respectively move from the middle to the directions of the two material distribution grooves to perform flattening operation on the cloth; this lateral shifting embroidery support through setting up the leveling device of cooperation closing device on fixed frame, uses the preliminary spacing cloth of closing device earlier after the cloth groove of passing of cloth, and the rerun leveling device removes to the both ends of cloth from the central point of cloth to can extend the fold of cloth to both ends and flatten, later the rethread closing device is further compresses tightly fixedly to the cloth in the cloth groove, makes the surface of cloth can not appear the trace such as fold.

title_en: High-temperature-resistant needled felt filter cloth
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-temperature-resistant needled felt filter cloth which comprises a base cloth layer, wherein a flame-retardant layer is arranged on the surface of the base cloth layer, a high-temperature-resistant surface layer is arranged on one surface of the flame-retardant layer, which is far away from the base cloth layer, the surface of the base cloth layer, which is far away from the flame-retardant layer, is fixedly connected with an anti-corrosion layer, and the surface of the anti-corrosion layer, which is far away from the base cloth layer, is fixedly connected with an anti-static layer. The outermost side of the base cloth layer is provided with the high-temperature resistant surface layer and the flame retardant layer, the high-temperature resistant surface layer is composed of polytetrafluoroethylene fibers, aromatic polyamide fibers and polyimide fibers, and the high-temperature resistant surface layer and the flame retardant layer work simultaneously, so that the high-temperature resistant and flame retardant performance of the needled felt filter cloth can be guaranteed, the problem that the needled felt filter cloth does not have the high-temperature resistant and flame retardant functions when in use and is damaged easily when the cloth is subjected to high temperature is solved.

title_en: Flexographic printing device capable of collecting redundant ink
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a flexographic printing device capable of collecting redundant printing ink, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein the upper surface of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with symmetrical supporting plates, the upper surfaces of the two supporting plates are fixedly connected with positioning plates together, the upper surface of each positioning plate is provided with a flexographic printing machine body, the bottom surface of each positioning plate is provided with symmetrical leakage holes, the upper surface of the bottom plate is fixedly communicated with a guide hopper, the upper surface of the guide hopper is fixedly connected with the bottom surface of the positioning plate, the bottom ends of the guide hoppers are fixedly communicated with connecting pipes, and the bottom ends of the connecting pipes are provided with control valves. This device can make unnecessary printing ink leak into the inside of water conservancy diversion fill through the leak opening through the ink discharging nozzle of flexography machine body down, can collect unnecessary printing ink through the water conservancy diversion fill, has reduced the consumption of printing ink, reduces printing cost, and unnecessary printing ink flows into the inside of collecting the box through the control valve, reduces this flexography device's printing ink consumption.

title_en: Elastic nylon yarn spinning fabric
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an elastic nylon yarn spinning fabric which comprises a fabric base layer and first bonding layers, wherein the fabric base layer is provided with a nylon yarn spinning fabric layer, the first bonding layers are provided with two groups, the two groups of first bonding layers are respectively arranged on two sides of the fabric base layer, an elastic layer is bonded on the lower surface of the first bonding layer on the lower side, a first dense weaving layer is bonded on the upper surface of the first bonding layer on the upper side, a second dense weaving layer is arranged above the first dense weaving layer, a fluffy layer is arranged between the first dense weaving layer and the second dense weaving layer, a second bonding layer is arranged on the upper surface of the second dense weaving layer, and a waterproof layer is bonded on the upper surface of the second bonding layer. According to the utility model, the first bonding layer and the second bonding layer are arranged, so that the connection tightness among the layers of the fabric is improved, the overall strength of the fabric is improved, and meanwhile, the elastic layer is arranged, so that the elasticity of the fabric can be increased, and the overall toughness of the fabric is improved.

title_en: Ink supply device and printing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of UV printing ink supply auxiliary components, and provides an ink supply device and printing equipment. The ink barrel is provided with a first output end and a first input end; the spray head is provided with a second output end, a second input end and an ink-jet end; the inlet of the primary ink box is communicated with the first output end of the ink barrel, and the outlet of the primary ink box is communicated with the second input end of the spray head; the inlet of the secondary ink box is communicated with the second output end of the spray head, and the outlet of the secondary ink box is communicated with the first input end of the ink barrel; the ink barrel, the primary ink box, the spray head and the secondary ink box are connected through pipelines to form a circulation passage, and negative pressure is carried out on the primary ink box and/or the secondary ink box. According to the ink supply device provided by the utility model, the process of spraying ink from the spraying end of the spray head is smoother.

title_en: Flat knitting machine capable of compositely displacing knitting needles
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of flat knitting machines and discloses a flat knitting machine capable of compositely displacing knitting needles, which comprises a needle plate (1) and knitting needles (2), wherein needle grooves (11) are formed in the needle plate (1), a needle selecting piece (3) is further arranged, the knitting needles (2) and the needle selecting piece (3) are both arranged in the needle grooves (11), stitch abdicating grooves (12) are formed in the needle grooves (11), downward extending stitches (21) are formed in the lower surface of the rear parts of the knitting needles (2), the stitches (21) are matched with the stitch abdicating grooves (12), and the front parts of the needle selecting pieces (3) are contacted and matched with the rear parts of the knitting needles (2) and push the knitting needles (2) to move forwards. The knitting needle is in a composite displacement knitting needle mode, the knitting needle is enabled to be sunk into or protrude out of the bottom plate intermittently, redundant contact between the knitting needle and the stitch cam is effectively avoided, unnecessary working time of the knitting needle is reduced, the service life of the knitting needle is prolonged, the fabric density is more uniform, and the knitting stability is greatly improved.

title_en: Cutting device convenient to adjust
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cutting device convenient to adjust, which comprises a cutting table, a transmission block, an electric telescopic rod, an electric sliding rail and a laser cutter, wherein the transmission block is movably connected to two sides of the top of the cutting table. According to the leather cutting device, the clamping mechanism is arranged, so that leather can be clamped when the leather cutting device is used, the situation that leather falls off when the leather is fixed, four corners of the leather are fixed through the clamping mechanism, wrinkles on the surface are avoided when the leather is cut, errors are caused in cut patterns, the problem that an existing cutting device is not firm enough in clamping when the leather is clamped is solved, the clamping plate is easy to separate from the leather when the leather is fixed, a certain hidden danger is caused when the leather is fixed, the leather falls off when the leather is cut, deviation is easily caused in the shape of leather cutting, and the problem that the leather cutting is inconvenient when the leather cutting device is used is solved, and the leather cutting device has the advantage that the leather is more convenient to clamp.

title_en: Double-thread sewing equipment for knitted fabric production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of double-thread sewing, in particular to double-thread sewing equipment for producing knitted fabrics, which comprises two square-joint cross bars and two groups of two extrusion rotating rollers which are connected onto the two square-joint cross bars in a sliding manner, wherein the two groups of two extrusion rotating rollers are respectively connected with extrusion bolts through threads, the two groups of two extrusion bolts are respectively contacted with the two square-joint cross bars, the two ends of the two square-joint cross bars are respectively connected with bearing seat plates in a rotating manner, the two groups of two extrusion rotating rollers are respectively provided with a plurality of grooves, the two groups of bearing seat plates are respectively connected with a limiting slide seat in a sliding manner, lifting slide columns are respectively fixedly connected in the two groups of two limiting slide seats, tension springs I are respectively sleeved on the two groups of two lifting slide columns, and the lower parts of the two groups of two tension springs I are respectively connected with the two groups of limiting slide seats in a fixed manner.

title_en: Braiding apparatus
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a braiding device, which comprises a fixed seat, a shaft core clamping assembly, a wire spool assembly, a first driving device and a second driving device, wherein the shaft core clamping assembly is arranged on the fixed seat in a longitudinally movable manner; the wire spool assembly comprises a wire spool bearing part and a wire spool, wherein the wire spool bearing part is fixedly arranged on the fixing seat, the wire spool can be rotatably arranged on the wire spool bearing part around the axis of the wire spool, and a shaft core hole for a shaft core to pass through and a plurality of threading holes for threading are formed in the wire spool; the first driving device is connected with the shaft core clamping assembly so as to drive the shaft core clamping assembly to move longitudinally; the second driving device is connected with the wire spool to drive the wire winding disc to rotate around the axis of the wire winding disc. Different medical blood vessels wound by multiple wires can be woven by staff according to different requirements, and automatic weaving of the wires can be realized, so that the weaving efficiency of the medical blood vessels wound by the multiple wires can be improved, and the workload of the staff is reduced.

title_en: Plastic product packaging film perforating machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a plastic product packaging film perforating machine which comprises a frame, wherein two groups of supporting frames are arranged on the upper surface of one end of the frame, a roller is arranged at the upper end of each supporting frame, a convenient positioning component is arranged in the middle of the upper end of the frame, an adjusting and rolling component is arranged on the outer surface of the other end of the frame, the convenient positioning component comprises a sliding rail, a sliding plate, a perforating machine, a motor, a positioning hole, a conveying belt, a first flattening roller, a second flattening roller, a bottom plate, a connecting plate and a storage plate, and the outer surface of the upper end of the frame is provided with the conveying belt. According to the plastic product packaging film perforating machine, the positioning and perforating positions are convenient to carry out when the packaging film is perforated through the arranged convenient positioning assembly, deviation of perforating is prevented, and the position between the winding roller and the frame is convenient to automatically adjust through the arranged winding assembly, so that winding efficiency is improved.

title_en: Polyacrylonitrile raw liquid ammonia gasification ventilation device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a polyacrylonitrile primary liquid ammonia breather for the ammonia is let in to the polyacrylonitrile primary liquid conveyer pipe, the polyacrylonitrile primary liquid ammonia breather includes: the tank body is provided with a containing cavity, heat-insulating water is contained in the containing cavity, and a water inlet and a water outlet which are communicated with the containing cavity are formed in the shell of the tank body; the air bag is arranged in the tank body, and the volume of the air bag is variable; the first gas transmission pipeline is used for transmitting ammonia gas from outside the tank body to the air bag in the tank body; the second gas transmission pipeline is used for transmitting ammonia gas from the air bag to the polyacrylonitrile stock solution conveying pipe.
