The temperature and the pressure of the ammonia flowing through the first gas transmission pipeline and the air bag can be controlled by controlling the temperature and the pressure of the heat-insulating water in the tank body, so that the temperature and the pressure of the ammonia flowing into the polyacrylonitrile raw liquid conveying pipe are stable, the ammonia metering is ensured to be accurate, the ammoniation modification degree of the polyacrylonitrile raw liquid is kept consistent, and the quality stability of a final formed product is improved.

title_en: Yarn cutter with extrusion function for waste box
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of yarn cutters and discloses a yarn cutter with an extrusion function for a waste box, which comprises a yarn cutter body and a box body connected to one side of the yarn cutter body, wherein the top of the box body is provided with an opening, the top of the box body is movably connected with a cover plate, one side of the cover plate is hinged with a rotating plate, the rotating plate and the cover plate are equal in size, the rotating plate and the cover plate are in sliding connection with the inner wall of the box body, two groups of symmetrically arranged sliding grooves are formed in two sides of the inner wall of the box body, the sliding grooves are positioned at two ends of the cover plate, and springs are fixedly connected to the bottoms of the sliding grooves.

title_en: Indentation equipment is used in carton production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of carton production, and discloses indentation equipment for carton production, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein sliding rods are bolted to two sides of the top of the bottom plate, a top plate is bolted to the top of the sliding rods, a hydraulic telescopic rod is bolted to the bottom of the top plate, a spring is sleeved on the surface of the sliding rod, and a sliding sleeve is sleeved on the surface of the sliding rod in a sliding manner; according to the utility model, the paperboard is placed on the top of the lower pressing plate, the hydraulic telescopic rod is started to push the upper pressing plate to press downwards, so that the upper pressing plate and the lower pressing plate press folds on the paperboard, and the spring is reset to drive the sliding sleeve to slide upwards on the surface of the sliding rod, so that the upper pressing plate can be effectively and stably moved; according to the utility model, one end of the limit bolt is separated from the upper pressing plate by screwing the limit bolt, then the upper pressing plate can be pulled out from the inside of the clamping block, and then the lower pressing plate is taken down from the top of the substrate, so that the upper pressing plate and the lower pressing plate can be effectively and quickly disassembled.

title_en: Unidirectional moisture-conducting knitted fabric
abstract_en: The utility model provides a unidirectional moisture-conducting knitted fabric which comprises a skin-adhering layer formed by spinning nylon filaments, wherein the radial section of each nylon filament is a plane, the planes are formed into channels for moisture conduction by a plurality of cross sections in a staggered mode, and the surface layer of the skin-adhering layer is connected with a moisture-absorbing layer. The moisture absorption layer is woven by cellulose yarns. The nylon filaments with cross sections can timely conduct sweat on the body surface away from the body surface through capillary effect, the surface of the fabric is the cellulose yarn, the moisture absorption rate of the cellulose yarn is far greater than that of the nylon filaments, so that sweat on the body surface can be continuously conducted out of the outer layer of the garment, the relative dryness of the body surface is continuously maintained, and the wearing comfort of the garment is improved.

title_en: Three-layer bubble-pressing packaging paper forming machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of bubble pressing paper equipment, and provides a three-layer bubble pressing packaging paper forming machine which comprises a base, wherein a first paper roll, a second paper roll, a third paper roll and a pressing packaging paper assembly are sequentially arranged on the base from left to right; a gluing component is arranged between the bubble pressing forming combined roller and the second paper roll, a paper cutting bottom plate is arranged at one end, far away from the first paper roll, of the base, execution cylinders are arranged at two sides of the tail end of the pressing support, and the execution cylinders at two sides are connected with the same sawtooth paper cutting knife; the end of the base is provided with a bubble pressing paper winding roller for winding and pressing three layers of bubble pressing paper.

title_en: Variable cross-section composite braiding platform and braiding equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a technical field of braiding machinery, especially, relate to variable cross-section compound braiding platform and braiding equipment, including the platform body and set up the spindle on the platform body, be provided with braiding device on the platform body, braiding device is including setting up on the platform body and being used for the spindle to carry out round flat molded line braiding motion's braiding track, setting up the track switching-over subassembly on braiding the track, setting up the driver plate subassembly on the platform body and being used for driving driver plate subassembly pivoted drive assembly, braiding track includes closed loop "8" word track I and the first "8" word track II of font. The utility model has the advantages of can promote the possibility that satisfies the demand that the user need weave flat line of circle, and then promote the effect of the convenience of weaving the use of platform, be particularly useful for sports medicine usefulness, mainly used tendon, ligament etc. soft tissue prosthetic operation suture's weave.

title_en: Mould-proof corrugated board
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mildew-proof corrugated board, which relates to the field of corrugated boards and comprises a surface layer, wherein an inner layer is arranged on one side of the surface layer, a corrugated paper core is arranged between the surface layer and the inner layer, and the surface layer and the inner layer are respectively bonded on two sides of the corrugated paper core. According to the utility model, the two layers of paperboards are arranged in the surface layer, the kraft paper and the silica gel layer are arranged between the two layers of paperboards, so that the tensile property of the device is improved, meanwhile, the wear-resistant layer is arranged on the outer side of the paperboards, the wear-resistant property of the device is improved, the rubber column and the rubber ring are arranged in the silica gel layer, the annular property of the device is improved, and the antibacterial particles are arranged in the rubber ring, so that the mildew-resistant property of the device is improved.

title_en: Offset press convenient to continuous printing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an offset press convenient for continuous printing, which comprises a bottom plate, and also comprises two guide rails fixedly connected with the upper end of the bottom plate, wherein the upper end of each guide rail is connected with a linear motor, the upper end of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a second bracket, three rollers are connected inside the second bracket, two fixing mechanisms are arranged on two sides of each roller, one side of each fixing mechanism is fixedly connected with a first bracket, the inside of each first bracket is fixedly connected with a telescopic mechanism, one side of each first bracket is fixedly connected with a first motor, one side of each first bracket is fixedly connected with a bearing seat, and the upper end of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a working box. According to the utility model, the fixing mechanism and the telescopic mechanism are added, and the inner cylinder wall is fixed in a mode of extending into the roller, so that the roller is fixed, and shaking and tilting cannot be generated in the rotating process, and the next working procedure is affected.

title_en: Movable cutter structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides a movable cutter structure, which improves the stability of automatic thread cutting, effectively ensures that a suture is hooked during the second needle lifting, thereby ensuring the sewing efficiency and sewing effect.

title_en: Carton forming machine for processing carton production line
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a paper box forming machine for processing a paper box production line, which relates to the technical field of paper box forming machines, in particular to a paper box forming machine for processing a paper box production line. This carton make-up machine is used in carton production line processing, through cavity case, baffle, strip shaped plate, threaded rod, screw thread ring piece, location slider, extension rod and the setting of push pedal, make this carton make-up machine is used in carton production line processing possess the effect that improves shaping efficiency, the cardboard of bending of being convenient for through the lift of cavity case, the extension through the push pedal, the trace of conveniently deepening the cardboard and bending makes things convenient for the shaping of carton, has reached the purpose that improves the practicality.

title_en: Harness cord with long service life
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a heald rod for long-life harness wire assembly, which belongs to the technical field of harness wire assembly and comprises a protection sleeve, wherein a round table type tube is arranged at the upper end of the protection sleeve, a harness wire assembly is arranged in the protection sleeve, two groups of through holes are formed in the outer side of the protection sleeve, a fixing assembly is slidably arranged in the two groups of through holes, a palm eyelet is arranged in the middle of the outer side of the protection sleeve, the harness wire assembly comprises a heald rod, a heald eye is arranged in the middle of the heald rod, a connecting block is fixedly connected to the upper end of the heald rod, a conical tube is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the connecting block, a circular ring is connected to the upper end of the conical tube, a harness wire is connected to the lower end of the heald rod, and a first spring is spirally arranged in the connecting column. Therefore, through the mutual matching of the arranged protective sleeve and the fixed component, friction can be reduced on the heald rod, the fixed effect can be achieved, and the practicability is realized.

title_en: Crease indentation device for carton production
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of carton production, in particular to a crease indentation device for carton production, which comprises a processing table, wherein the top of the processing table is fixedly connected with a supporting frame, the center of the supporting frame is fixedly connected with a lifter, the driving end of the lifter is fixedly connected with a servo motor, the driving end of the servo motor is fixedly provided with a mounting frame, an indentation assembly is arranged below the mounting frame, and the indentation assembly comprises two sliding blocks and two pressing plates; through the position of first driver adjustment clamp plate, the lifter drives the clamp plate and descends and carry out crease indentation to the carton spare, and then the driver drives clamp plate rotatory 90, carries out crease indentation to the carton spare other end and handles, and promotes the extension board through electric putter and rotate, and then adjusts the processing length of clamp plate, adapts to not unidimensional carton spare processing, compares in prior art, need not to change the clamp plate.

title_en: Creel of water spray loom
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a creel of a water-jet loom, which comprises a water-jet loom main body and a creel main body assembled at a discharge hole of the water-jet loom main body, wherein the creel main body comprises a fixed bottom plate, and a bearing disc is assembled at the upper end of the fixed bottom plate; the middle section of the upper end of the bearing disc is provided with a creel outer cylinder, the upper end of the creel outer cylinder is provided with an adjusting port, and a creel inner rod is inserted into the adjusting port; the upper end of the outer part of the creel inner rod is sleeved with a fixed hoop, both outer walls of the two sides of the fixed hoop are respectively provided with a creel support rod, and the end part of the creel support rod is provided with a creel carrier plate; u-shaped steel is uniformly arranged on the side wall of the creel carrier plate, and a yarn cylinder is sleeved outside the U-shaped steel; the inner bottom end of the creel outer cylinder is provided with an electric telescopic rod, the end part of the electric telescopic rod is provided with a balance plate, and the end part of the creel inner rod is connected with the balance plate; the creel of the water-jet loom is matched with the inner rod of the creel through the lifting type creel outer cylinder, so that spinning is conveniently removed, and the processing efficiency is improved.

title_en: Nonwoven fabric diffuser adjustment structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of cloth manufacturing equipment, in particular to a non-woven cloth diffuser adjusting structure, which comprises side plates forming a diffuser channel, wherein the side plates are expanded outwards from top to bottom, the adjusting structure is arranged at the output end of the diffuser, the adjusting structure comprises an adjusting plate, the adjusting plate is connected with the side plates in an adjustable way, the adjusting plate can move up and down along the side plates, on one hand, the length of the diffuser channel of the diffuser can be adjusted by adding the adjusting plate on the diffuser, on the other hand, the distance between the diffuser and a lapping machine can be adjusted, and on the other hand, the uniformity of threads can be improved by increasing the length of the diffuser channel and reducing the distance between the diffuser and the lapping machine, and the production efficiency can be improved according to the condition of the threads.

title_en: Branching mechanism of sewing machine and sewing machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a branching mechanism of a sewing machine and the sewing machine, wherein the sewing machine comprises a stand column and a needle plate, the branching mechanism comprises a rotating shuttle assembly capable of being rotatably arranged on the stand column, a branching cam fixedly arranged on the rotating shuttle assembly, a branching hook seat capable of swinging left and right and a branching hook fixedly arranged on the branching hook seat, the branching hook seat and the branching cam are in propping fit to drive the branching hook seat to swing relative to the stand column when the branching cam rotates along with the rotating shuttle assembly, a wire outlet is formed between the branching hook and the rotating shuttle assembly, a wire outlet groove is formed between the rotating shuttle assembly and the needle plate, when the minimum stroke position of the branching cam is propped against the branching hook seat, the wire outlet groove is closed, and when the maximum stroke position of the branching cam is propped against the branching hook seat, the wire outlet groove is closed, and the wire outlet groove is opened. The branching mechanism has the advantages that the branching process is simple, and fewer parts are included, so that the branching mechanism has a simple structure and is convenient to install and replace.

title_en: Three-dimensional type surface-mounted pad printing machine
abstract_en: The utility model provides a three-dimensional type surface-mounted pad printing machine, which belongs to the technical field of pad printing machines and aims at solving the problems that in the use process of the traditional three-dimensional type surface-mounted pad printing machine, ink is required to be placed on a screen plate for use, and after processing is finished, the ink on the screen plate is required to be cleaned and recovered, so that the working efficiency is not high enough and the labor intensity is high; the sliding plate is connected to the front end face of the fixed plate in a sliding way; the two fixing brackets are respectively fixedly connected to the front end face of the sliding plate; the screen plate is fixedly connected to the inner sides of the two fixing brackets; the printing head is connected to the front end face of the sliding plate in a sliding way; the printing scraper is fixedly arranged at the lower end of the printing head; the recovery scraping plate is fixedly arranged at the lower end of the printing head; by the arrangement of the utility model, the recovery of the printing paint is realized, the operation is convenient, the working efficiency is improved, and the labor intensity is reduced.

title_en: Automatic cloth strip cutting machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic cloth strip cutting machine, which relates to the technical field of cloth strip cutting equipment and comprises a cloth strip cutting bottom plate, a cloth strip cutting unit with a detachable blade and a flock thread end absorbing unit; the cloth strip cutting bottom plate is rectangular; the blade detachable cloth strip cutting unit comprises a vertical supporting plate I, a transverse supporting plate I, a rotating shaft I, a supporting block, a rotating shaft II, a rotating plate, a movable rod, a supporting lug I, a rotating shaft III, a concave sliding rail, a sliding plate, a sliding column, a T-shaped sliding plate, a spring, a limiting block, a fixed column, a through hole, a fixed hole, a blade fixed block, a cutting blade, a fixed groove and a power component; the batting thread end sucking unit is arranged on the upper surface of one end of the cloth cutting strip bottom plate. After the cutting blade becomes blunt for a long time, the cutting blade can be simply and quickly detached, so that the replacement of the cutting blade is convenient, more time is saved, and the production efficiency is improved.

title_en: High-strength wear-resistant nylon fabric
abstract_en: The application belongs to clothing surface fabric field, and this application provides a wear-resisting nylon surface fabric of high strength, and this wear-resisting nylon surface fabric of high strength includes: forming a nylon yarn skin-friendly bottom layer, a face warp wear-resistant layer and a face weft wear-resistant layer which are sequentially compounded through tatting; the nylon yarn skin-friendly bottom layer is close to one side of the skin of a user and comprises two strands of 120-140D high Kong Shuni nylon yarns which are arranged side by side in the warp direction; the face warp wear-resistant layer and the face weft wear-resistant layer are correspondingly formed by nylon coated spandex yarns which are arranged side by side in the warp direction and side by side in the weft direction, the yarn density of the face warp wear-resistant layer is 170-175T, and the yarn density of the face weft wear-resistant layer is 160-165T. The high-strength nylon fabric has excellent elasticity, lower surface tension and the like, has higher wear resistance, is simple and convenient to prepare and lower in cost, and is particularly beneficial to popularization and application in the child clothing fabric.

title_en: Anti-drop slotting injection molding blade with magnetic shielding function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an anti-falling slotting injection molding blade with a magnetic shielding function, wherein a slotting injection molding blade body is an integral component formed by combining a blade main body and a magnetic steel module fixed at the lower end of the blade main body, the bottom of the blade main body is provided with an outwards extending connecting sheet, the magnetic steel module comprises an outer sleeve formed by injection molding and curing, a shielding sleeve is arranged in an inner cavity of the outer sleeve, a U-shaped cavity is arranged in the shielding sleeve, an opening of the U-shaped cavity faces downwards, and magnetic steel is placed in the U-shaped cavity; fixing grooves are formed in two corresponding side faces of the magnetic steel; the outer sleeve formed by injection molding integrates the connecting sheet, the shielding sleeve and the magnetic steel which enter the inner cavity into an integral magnetic steel module, and the fixed groove of the magnetic steel is filled with the solidified plastic.

title_en: Environment-friendly multifunctional composite paperboard
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an environment-friendly multifunctional composite paperboard which comprises a waterproof layer, a flame-retardant layer, an antibacterial layer and a hard paper shell, wherein the waterproof layer comprises a polypropylene film, adhesive glue and a dampproof paperboard, one side of the polypropylene film is provided with the adhesive glue, one side of the adhesive glue is provided with the dampproof paperboard, the polypropylene film and the adhesive glue are mutually adhered, the adhesive glue and the dampproof paperboard are mutually adhered, and one side of the dampproof paperboard is provided with the flame-retardant layer. According to the utility model, the polypropylene film, the adhesive glue and the moistureproof paper board are mutually arranged, and the polypropylene film and the moistureproof paper board have the functions of water resistance, so that the inside of the paper board is separated from the outside environment, and the moisture in the environment is prevented from damaging the paper board due to moisture.

title_en: Steel mesh cleaning machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of steel mesh cleaning, and particularly discloses a steel mesh cleaning machine. Including spray room, cleaning chamber, drying chamber, cooling chamber and the actuating mechanism that drive steel mesh moved along spray room, cleaning chamber, drying chamber, cooling chamber that set gradually, install the partition door between spray room and the cleaning chamber, leave the clearance that can hold the steel mesh to pass through in the middle of the partition door, all install the sealing door between cleaning chamber and the drying chamber, between drying chamber and the cooling chamber, the sealing door top is equipped with the distance sensor that is used for detecting the steel mesh position, the cooling chamber is kept away from drying chamber one side and is installed the sealing door, and the air-cooler of accelerating steel mesh cooling is installed to cooling chamber both sides wall, and the cooling chamber top is opened there is the vent, distance sensor and cold wind electricity are connected with the controller, have solved traditional steel mesh cleaning machine and can not dispel the heat, cool to lead to the steel mesh cleaning cycle length, turnover inefficiency's problem.

title_en: Shuttle for door ring assembly and door ring assembly
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a shuttle for a door ring assembly, which comprises a shuttle bottom plate, a first limit wheel, a second limit wheel, a first sliding seat, a second sliding seat and an adjusting mechanism, wherein the shuttle is provided with a first sliding seat and a second sliding seat; the first limiting wheel is rotationally connected to the first sliding seat, and the second limiting wheel is rotationally connected to the second sliding seat; the adjusting mechanism comprises a screw rod which extends vertically and is rotationally connected with the shuttle bottom plate, and a locking mechanism for locking the screw rod on the shuttle bottom plate; the screw comprises a first thread part and a second thread part. The shuttle in the utility model can adjust the distance between the first limit wheel and the second limit wheel. The utility model also discloses a door ring assembly, which comprises the shuttle, when the first limiting wheel and the second limiting wheel are worn, the distance between the first limiting wheel and the second limiting wheel is increased, so that the first limiting wheel is contacted with the upper door ring again, and the second limiting wheel is contacted with the lower door ring again, and the first limiting wheel and the second limiting wheel do not need to be replaced, thereby saving the cost.

title_en: Automatic blank mark button breaking device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic blank mark button breaking device, which comprises: the workbench is provided with a button nailing mechanism, a blank mark mechanism, a conveying mechanism, a clamping mechanism and a material breaking mechanism; the button sewing mechanism comprises: a button nailing machine head and a button nailing platform; the blank mark mechanism comprises: the sewing machine comprises a bracket and a blank mark wound on the bracket, wherein the sewing part of the blank mark is laid on a button sewing platform; the conveying mechanism comprises: the first driving piece is in transmission connection with the button feeding arm, buttons are placed on the button feeding arm, and the first driving piece is used for conveying the buttons to the sewing part of the blank mark; the fixture includes: the clamping assembly and the second driving piece are arranged on the workbench, and the second driving piece is in transmission connection with the clamping assembly; the material cutting mechanism comprises: the third driving piece drives the cutting piece to cut off the blank label. The utility model improves the efficiency of the nail backup button and reduces the production cost.

title_en: Automatic stamp device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic printing device, comprising: the machine comprises a machine base and a machine frame fixedly connected to the top of the machine base, wherein an unreeling roller is arranged on one side of the machine frame, a reeling roller is arranged on the other side of the machine frame, an electric cylinder is fixedly connected to the top of the machine frame, and a printing mechanism is arranged on an output shaft of the electric cylinder; the printing mechanism is composed of a mounting mechanism and a printing assembly mounted at the bottom of the mounting mechanism; the mounting mechanism comprises a mounting seat fixedly connected to the output end of the electric cylinder, and mounting assemblies are mounted on two sides of the mounting seat. According to the automatic printing device, the machine base, the machine frame, the unreeling roller, the wind-up roller, the electric cylinder and the printing mechanism are matched, so that the automatic printing device is realized, and the printing head of the printing device is convenient to disassemble and assemble, so that a worker can conveniently replace the printing head, printing operations of different patterns can be realized, and the practicability of the automatic printing device is improved.

title_en: Ink cartridge and ink cartridge component
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an ink cartridge and an ink cartridge component with the ink cartridge, wherein the ink cartridge is detachably arranged in an imaging device provided with a frame body, the frame body comprises a bottom plate provided with a through hole, side plates arranged around the bottom plate and a limiting piece movably arranged on one side plate, and the limiting piece comprises two limiting plates oppositely arranged in the y direction; the ink cartridge includes a case formed to contain ink and an ink outlet portion formed to protrude from a lower side wall of the case, the ink outlet portion facing the bottom plate and being for discharging the ink outwardly; the shell is provided with a first side wall and a second side wall which are opposite to each other along the x direction, and the ink outlet part is closer to the second side wall; the ink box also comprises a locking component and a combining piece, wherein the limiting plate is abutted with the combining piece along the y direction in the installation process of the ink box; after the ink box is installed, the locking component enters the through hole and is combined with the bottom plate, so that the locking component and the through hole can be accurately abutted in the z direction, the ink box can be smoothly installed, and the use experience of a user is greatly improved.

title_en: Rubber blanket tensioning device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of printing machines, and particularly relates to a blanket tightening device which comprises a blanket cylinder, wherein a fixing frame is fixedly arranged in the blanket cylinder, a fixing shaft is fixedly arranged on one side of the fixing frame, a fixing shaft is fixedly arranged on one side of the fixing shaft, and an inner fixing frame is fixedly arranged in a groove on one side of the surface of the blanket cylinder. When the device is used, the rubber cloth tensioning screw rod at the inner side of the inner fixing frame is movably arranged in a left-hand manner and a right-hand manner, and the rubber cloth tensioning screw sleeve and the pull rod are movably arranged in a right-hand manner, so that all installation seats of the rubber cloth are driven to swing, and the rubber cloth installation seats are driven to swing through the screwing of the rubber cloth tensioning screw sleeve and the pull rod, so that the rubber cloth is tensioned, and the tensioning side installation seats are divided into two bodies, and the tensioning force can be respectively adjusted, so that uneven compensation of tension is realized.

title_en: Cutting machine for wall cloth
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cutting machine for wall cloth, which comprises a workbench, wherein a side plate is arranged at the top of the workbench, a driving mechanism is arranged on the side plate, and the driving mechanism drives a cutting mechanism and a flattening mechanism; the cutting mechanism comprises an air cylinder, a connecting plate is fixed at the bottom of the air cylinder, and a cutter is fixed at the bottom of the connecting plate; the flattening mechanism comprises two first folding rods and two second folding rods which are detachably fixed on two sides of the connecting plate, and pressing strips are fixed at the bottoms of the first folding rods and the second folding rods. According to the utility model, the motor drives the air cylinder and the cutter to move for cutting, and the bent first folding rod and the bent second folding rod firstly smooth the wall cloth, so that the cutting quality is not affected due to wrinkles in the cutting process, and meanwhile, the cleaning roller moves on the wall cloth, so that on one hand, the effect of flattening is achieved, on the other hand, dust on the surface can be cleaned, and the quality is improved.

title_en: Full-automatic packing lining folding and bonding device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of food packaging box production tools, in particular to a full-automatic packaging lining folding and bonding device, wherein a side pressing plate is rotatably arranged at the upper ends of the left side wall and the right side wall of a workbench through a rotating shaft bearing, a side hydraulic rod is fixedly arranged on a frame, a side footstock is fixedly arranged on an output shaft of the side hydraulic rod, a side pressing plate is rotatably arranged at the upper ends of the front side wall and the rear side wall of the workbench through a rotating shaft bearing, a side hydraulic rod is fixedly arranged on the frame, a side footstock is fixedly arranged on an output shaft of the side hydraulic rod, a bonding hydraulic rod is fixedly arranged on the frame, and a bonding footstock is fixedly arranged on an output shaft of the bonding hydraulic rod; the folding structure of the multistage is arranged, the folding and pressing are carried out on the paper box paperboards respectively, so that the adhesive plate of the paper box paperboards can be adhered to the outer side wall of the side plate after being glued, the glue and the inner side wall structure of the paper box are avoided after being glued, the inside cleanness of the paper box is further guaranteed, the traditional paper box folding procedure is optimized, and the folding and gluing production of the paper box is more convenient.

title_en: Energy-saving environment-friendly polyester cotton-like fabric printing device
abstract_en: The utility model provides an energy-saving and environment-friendly polyester cotton-like fabric printing device. Including carrying the platform, the lateral wall fixedly connected with connecting plate of carrying the platform, the tip of connecting plate is fixed with the fixed plate, hold-down mechanism is installed to the lateral wall of support, the stamp roller is installed to the centre of fixed plate, drying mechanism is installed to the centre of fixed plate, polyester cotton surface fabric has been placed on the surface of carrying the platform. According to the energy-saving and environment-friendly polyester cotton-like fabric printing device provided by the utility model, when the polyester cotton fabric is conveyed to the lower part of the printing roller, the telescopic cylinder is started to stretch, so that the telescopic cylinder drives the crank to rotate, the connecting rod rotates along with the crank to drive the rotary plate to rotate until the rotary plate rotates to the same vertical plane as the conveying table, the telescopic cylinder is stopped to be driven until the rotary plate rotates to the same vertical plane as the conveying table, the manual rotary screw rod slides downwards along the rotary plate, so that the pressing plate at the bottom of the screw rod slides downwards along with the rotary plate to compress the polyester cotton fabric, the stacking wrinkles in the printing process are prevented, the fabric is uniformly printed, and the printing quality is improved.

title_en: Manual cleaning table for screen printing plate
abstract_en: The utility model provides a cleaning table for manually cleaning a screen printing plate, and relates to the technical field of screen cleaning. The cleaning table for manually cleaning the screen printing plate comprises a cleaning table body, wherein the bottom of the cleaning table body is rotationally connected with a sewer pipe, a first pipeline is connected inside the sewer pipe in a sealing mode, a filter screen is fixedly connected inside the first pipeline, and a sliding block is fixedly connected outside the first pipeline. This manual abluent wash platform of screen printing half tone, the slider can be along the inside downwardly sliding of spout, alright can be with the quick dismantlement of first pipeline, conveniently clear up the impurity of interception on the filter screen, avoid impurity to block up first pipeline, cause out water unsmoothly, this structure is convenient for set up the filtration pin at wash platform body top, prevent that the silk screen from directly falling in aqueous, be inconvenient for the later stage to the drying of silk screen and to the final clearance of silk screen, set up the filter screen at the bottom simultaneously and make things convenient for the dismantlement more, the structure is also comparatively simple.

title_en: Cutting device for corrugated carton processing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of corrugated case processing, and discloses a cutting device for corrugated case processing, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a buffer mechanism and an adjusting mechanism are arranged above the bottom plate, the adjusting mechanism comprises an electro-hydraulic push rod, the bottom surface of the electro-hydraulic push rod is fixedly connected with the top surface of the bottom plate, and the top surface of the output end of the electro-hydraulic push rod is fixedly provided with a lifting plate. Can play the buffer effect through buffer gear to the corrugated case in the cutting process for in the cutting process, the corrugated case surface can not collapse, utilizes the damping characteristic of attenuator to slow down the mechanical vibration of spring itself, can make to place the board more stable, through adjustment mechanism, can adjust the position of cutting machine, thereby can make the cutting machine cut in cutting process to a plurality of positions of corrugated case, make the cutting effect better, through hydraulic stem, surplus pressure strip of connecting rod, can prevent corrugated case removal when cutting corrugated case.

title_en: Water-jet loom capable of preventing fold during cloth winding
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water jet loom for preventing wrinkles during cloth rolling, which comprises two support plates, wherein the two support plates are arranged, the positions of the two support plates correspond to each other, a fixing frame is fixedly arranged on the upper end face of each support plate, a tensioning wheel is arranged at the upper end between the two support plates, connecting rods are fixedly arranged at the two ends of each tensioning wheel, openings are formed at the upper ends of opposite side wall surfaces of the two support plates, the connecting rods at the two ends of each tensioning wheel respectively penetrate through the openings of one side wall surface of the two support plates, and electric telescopic rods are fixedly arranged on the side wall surfaces of the two support plates. According to the utility model, the tension wheel is conveniently driven to move up and down by the mutual matching of the connecting rod and the electric telescopic rod, and the tension degree of the cloth in the device can be adjusted by the up-down movement of the tension wheel, so that the problem that local folds of the cloth are generated due to loose tension degree of the cloth in the device, and the processing quality of the cloth is influenced by the local folds of the cloth is avoided.

title_en: Warp stop warning device of textile machine
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of textile machines, in particular to a warp stop motion warning device of a textile machine, which comprises a clamping mechanism, wherein a warp stop motion body is arranged on the side wall of the clamping mechanism; the side wall of the clamping mechanism is fixedly connected with a first fixing frame; an outer shell is fixedly connected to the end part of the first fixing frame; when using, through stopping piece body whereabouts, then can strike the dead lever, the magnetic ball whereabouts can strike the shell fragment, at this moment under shell fragment self elastic action, thereby carry out the suggestion to the staff, this in-process, thereby reduce among the prior art through stopping piece body whereabouts, cause the weaving machine to shut down, lead to the staff can not in time discover, handle through stopping piece body, thereby cause to increase certain work progress, the sound that produces through the magnetic ball striking shell fragment at this moment, and then increase through stopping piece body whereabouts back to the warning effect of staff.

title_en: Eiderdown deodorizing device convenient to throw material
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a down feather deodorizing device convenient for feeding, which relates to the technical field of down feather processing and particularly comprises a feeding mechanism, wherein a box body is arranged on one side of the feeding mechanism, a fluffing mechanism is arranged in the box body and comprises a rotating shaft, a fixed plate is fixedly arranged on the rotating shaft, a first stirring plate is arranged on the fixed plate, a second stirring plate is arranged at one end, far away from the rotating shaft, of the first stirring plate, an adjusting piece is arranged between the first stirring plate and the second stirring plate, the first stirring plate, the second stirring plate, the adjusting piece and other components are arranged, and the second stirring plate component is adjusted to rotate through the adjusting piece through mutual matching between the first stirring plate and the second stirring plate, so that the angle between the second stirring plate component and the first stirring plate component is changed, and the area of the second stirring plate which is flapped on a feather when the first stirring plate and the second stirring plate are driven to rotate is different, so that the flapping effect is better.

title_en: High-gloss coated paper with precoating film
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-gloss coated paper with a precoating film, which comprises a coated paper board body, wherein the coated paper board body consists of base paper, a waterproof high-gloss acrylic ink-absorbing layer, a resin layer and a precoating film layer, the resin layer is smeared on the upper surface of the base paper, the precoating film layer is arranged on the upper surface of the resin layer, the upper surface of the precoating film layer is provided with a primer layer, and the waterproof high-gloss acrylic ink-absorbing layer is arranged on the upper surface of the primer layer; according to the waterproof high-gloss acrylic acid ink-absorbing layer, the waterproof high-gloss acrylic acid ink-absorbing layer is formed on the surface of the waterproof high-gloss acrylic acid ink-absorbing layer through roller coating and drying treatment, so that the waterproof high-gloss acrylic acid ink-absorbing layer has a waterproof high-gloss effect, further has good waterproof effect and ink-absorbing characteristics, and is guaranteed to absorb ink uniformly and resist water when the waterproof high-gloss acrylic acid ink-absorbing layer is subjected to ink-jet treatment.

title_en: Small corrugated carton folding device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of carton production devices, in particular to a small corrugated carton folding device which comprises a machine base, wherein two rotary rollers which are arranged at intervals are rotatably arranged in the machine base, a conveying belt is arranged between the two rotary rollers, air pipes on two sides are communicated and fixedly provided with communicating pipes, the end parts of the communicating pipes are communicated and fixedly provided with extension pipes, a negative pressure pump is fixedly arranged on a carrier plate, the air inlet ends of the negative pressure pump are communicated and fixedly provided with pipelines, the two ends of the pipelines are respectively communicated with the air pipes on two sides, a motor is fixedly arranged on the carrier plate, the small corrugated carton folding device further comprises a linkage mechanism, sealing gaskets on two sides are in contact with two ends on one side of a paperboard, the sealing gaskets are in a sealing state with the paperboard, the air pipes, the communicating pipes and the extension pipes are in a negative pressure state through the negative pressure pump, so that the extension pipes and the paperboard can synchronously move, and the two ends of the paperboard are bent through the motor matched with the linkage mechanism, and the device can replace manual operation and effectively improve the folding efficiency.

title_en: Label gilt cross cutting machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of die cutting machines, in particular to a label gold stamping die cutting machine which comprises a mounting part, a driving device, a mounting rack, a hydraulic cylinder mechanism, a mounting plate, a die, a roller, a winding roller and a rotating shaft, wherein the mounting part is provided with a plurality of rollers; the two mounting parts are arranged, the two rotating shafts are arranged, and the two rotating shafts are rotationally connected with the mounting parts; the two driving devices are respectively connected with the two rotating shafts in a transmission way, the roller is connected with one rotating shaft, and the winding roller is connected with the other rotating shaft and is coaxially distributed with the rotating shaft; two ends of the mounting frame are connected with two mounting parts, the hydraulic cylinder mechanism is connected with the mounting frame, the mounting plate is connected with the lower end of the hydraulic cylinder mechanism, the die is connected with the lower end of the mounting plate, and the lower end of the die is provided with a laser positioning mechanism; a supporting component is arranged between the two rotating shafts and is connected with the two mounting parts; the supporting plate can be adjusted, so that the supporting plate is prevented from being pressed downwards to displace after a long time use of the die; the label tape can be subjected to die cutting continuously, so that the working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Printing machine drying device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a printer drying device, which comprises a drying box, wherein through grooves are formed in two sides of the drying box, a fixing plate is fixedly connected below the through grooves, and transverse plates are fixedly connected on two sides of the surface of the fixing plate.

title_en: Woven bag joint-cutting and printing integrated machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a woven bag slitting and printing all-in-one machine, which belongs to the technical field of woven bag production and comprises a base, wherein two symmetrical straight plates are arranged on one side of the top of the base, two woven bag rolls are arranged between the two straight plates, two sides of the center of the top of the base are connected with side plates, a center rod is connected between the two side plates through bearing rotation, the centers of the peripheries of the two center rods are connected with round rollers, a cutting disc is adhered to the periphery of the round roller above the round rollers, one side of each side plate is connected with a limiting clamping frame, a sewing structure is arranged above each limiting clamping frame in an embedding and clamping mode, two extension plates are symmetrically connected on one side of the top of the base far away from the straight plates, and two printing and dyeing rollers are arranged between the two extension plates. The woven bag slitting and printing all-in-one machine combines trimming, sewing and printing and dyeing together, and further improves the processing efficiency.

title_en: Silk screen printing equipment scraper and ink return knife
abstract_en: The utility model provides a silk-screen printing equipment scraper and an ink return knife, which comprise a scraper component and an ink return knife component positioned at one side of the scraper component, wherein the scraper component and the ink return knife component are both knife mechanisms; the cutter mechanism comprises a cutter bearing plate, a plurality of adjustable cutters are arranged on the cutter bearing plate, each adjustable cutter comprises an adjusting part arranged on the cutter bearing plate, a cutter part is arranged on each adjusting part, and the positions of the cutter parts are adjusted under the driving of the adjusting parts. According to the utility model, through the arranged adjustable cutters, the cutter parts in the adjustable cutters can be driven by the adjusting parts to realize position adjustment, when the typesetting amount of the silk-screen printing products is small, the adjustable cutters positioned at the two sides are lifted, so that the scraping area is reduced, and the problem that the material is wasted due to the use of a large-area scraper and an ink returning cutter in the prior art can be solved.

title_en: Sole pressing device for production of casual shoes
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sole pressing device for producing leisure shoes, which is characterized in that a plurality of support seats are arranged on a rotary support seat, a plurality of lower dies are arranged on the support seats and are uniformly distributed along the circumferential direction, a support frame is arranged on one side of the support seats, a hydraulic press is fixedly arranged on the support frame, an upper die is arranged at the bottom of a telescopic end of the hydraulic press and corresponds to the lower die below the upper die, the lower die comprises a shell and a top plate, the section of an inner cavity of the shell is in the shape of a sole, the top plate corresponds to the section of the inner cavity of the shell in shape and is arranged in the shell in a vertically sliding manner, a through hole is formed in the bottom of the shell, and a jacking mechanism is arranged at the bottom of one side of the support seat away from the support frame and can jack the top plate through the through hole. According to the utility model, the lower die is driven to sequentially rotate below the upper die through the rotation of the supporting seat, the upper die is driven to move downwards through the hydraulic press to press, misoperation of the device is avoided, the hands of workers are prevented from being injured by pressing, and the jacking mechanism is arranged, so that the sole is convenient to demould, and the working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Double-coating wear-resistant thermosensitive plate material for printing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a double-coating wear-resistant heat-sensitive printing plate for printing, and particularly relates to the technical field of printing plates. According to the utility model, through the corresponding matching use of each structure, the typesetting printing columns are limited through the through holes on the first wear-resistant thermosensitive layer and the second wear-resistant thermosensitive layer, so that the stability of the typesetting printing columns on the printing plate main body, the first wear-resistant thermosensitive layer and the second wear-resistant thermosensitive layer is ensured, the typesetting printing columns can be protected during printing through the protection check rings, the damage of the typesetting printing columns and the damage of printed objects by the typesetting printing columns are avoided, meanwhile, the setting of the measuring scale is convenient, and the size of the printed image is observed during the printing of the printing plate main body and the typesetting printing columns, so that the typesetting printing method is more convenient to use.

title_en: Sewing device for seat leather sheath
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sewing device for a seat leather sheath, which relates to the field of sewing devices and comprises a frame and a sewing machine arranged on the frame, wherein a bearing plate is movably arranged on the frame, a clamping plate is movably arranged on the bearing plate, and a compacting component for compacting leather is arranged on the bearing plate. The utility model has the effect that two layers of leather to be sewn are tightly attached together before and after sewing so as to avoid the bulge of the seat leather sheath formed after the sewing is finished.

title_en: Gum protecting carbon wire toothbrush
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of toothbrushes, in particular to a gum-protecting carbon-wire toothbrush, which comprises a toothbrush handle, wherein a connecting rod is fixedly arranged at one end part of the toothbrush handle, a toothbrush head is fixedly arranged at the end part of the connecting rod, carbon-wire bristles are fixedly arranged on the outer wall of the toothbrush head, a base is fixedly arranged at the other end of the toothbrush handle, a guard plate is arranged on the side surface of the toothbrush head, the carbon-wire bristles penetrate through a plurality of through holes in the guard plate and extend to the outer side of the guard plate, the guard plate divides the carbon-wire bristles into a plurality of cleaning areas, a plurality of clamping grooves are respectively formed in two sides of the toothbrush head, plastic plates are respectively fixedly arranged at two sides of the guard plate, and clamping blocks are fixedly arranged on the inner side of the plastic plates and are in clamping fit with the clamping grooves. According to the utility model, the root parts of the carbon fiber bristles can be supported by the guard plate, and the carbon fiber bristles are gathered together, so that the carbon fiber bristles form a plurality of cleaning areas, and tartar can be effectively cleaned.

title_en: Cover mechanism of plate punching machine
abstract_en: The utility model provides a cover body mechanism of a plate punching machine, which belongs to the technical field of plate punching machines and comprises a body of the plate punching machine, wherein a mounting part is slidably arranged on the body, a cleaning part is arranged on the mounting part, a water tank is arranged on the mounting part, water in the water tank can flow onto the cleaning part, and an air bag communicated with the water tank is arranged on the water tank. The utility model has the beneficial effects that: when the novel cleaning device is used, after long-time use, dust can be generated on the cover plate, at the moment, the air bag is pinched by hands, gas in the air bag enters the water tank, the air pressure in the water tank is increased, water in the water tank flows to the second through hole along the first through hole, then the sponge is arranged on the sponge, the installation part is slid, the sponge is driven to move by the installation part to slide on the body after being wetted, dust on the cover body can be cleaned, and the efficiency of cleaning the dust on the cover body is lower.

title_en: Acetate fiber filament spinning frame
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an acetate fiber filament spinning frame, which relates to the technical field of spinning frames and comprises a frame, a conveyor and a material dividing box, wherein a fixing frame is fixedly arranged on one side of the frame, a plurality of feeding boxes are fixedly arranged on the conveyor belt of the conveyor, a plurality of first mounting frames are fixedly arranged at the rear end of the material dividing box, the material dividing box is fixedly arranged at the front end of the fixing frame through the plurality of first mounting frames, a discharging cylinder is fixedly arranged at the lower end of the material dividing box, a plurality of separation plates are fixedly arranged in the material dividing box, the separation plates are in a vertical posture, and a storage channel is formed between the two separation plates. Can store the spool and can realize in the feeding box that the spool was put into on the conveyer in proper order through the setting of ration mechanism, and through first quantitative board and the second quantitative board that can stagger open and shut, can realize the purpose of single release spool, and can not make the spool in the feed box unable quantitative of separating to discharge.

title_en: 180-degree turnover mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a 180-degree turnover mechanism in the field of turnover mechanisms, which comprises a frame, wherein the frame is composed of two cross bars and a connecting beam, the two cross bars are respectively arranged at two ends of the connecting beam, one ends of the two cross bars, which are far away from the connecting beam, are respectively provided with an air cylinder, the air cylinders are connected with the cross bars through fixing pieces, the air cylinders are rotationally connected with the fixing pieces, one ends of the two cross bars, which are close to the connecting beam, are respectively provided with a rotating seat, one side of each rotating seat, which is far away from the connecting beam, is provided with a first gear and a second gear, the first gear and the second gear are in meshed transmission, the air cylinders are in transmission connection with the second gear through a swing arm, one side of each rotating seat, which is close to the connecting beam, is provided with a turnover piece and a turnover plate, the air cylinders push the swing arm, and the turnover plate can reach 180 degrees through the first gear and the second gear, the application range of the mechanism is improved, and the turnover mechanism can be matched and applied on an automatic line.

title_en: Drawing frame heat radiation structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a drawing frame heat radiation structure, which comprises an air inlet cylinder, an air outlet cylinder, two fans and two filter components, wherein the air inlet cylinder is provided with an air inlet end, the air outlet cylinder is provided with an air outlet end, the two fans are respectively arranged in the air inlet cylinder and the air outlet cylinder and are used for forming air inlet air flow from the air inlet end to the corresponding fan in the air inlet cylinder and air outlet air flow from the corresponding fan to the air outlet end in the air outlet cylinder, the two filter components are fixedly connected through a connecting plate, the connecting plate is rotationally connected with the air inlet cylinder and/or the air outlet cylinder, the rotating paths of the two filter components are arranged to cover the air inlet end of the air inlet cylinder and the air outlet end of the air outlet cylinder, and when one filter component is positioned at the air inlet end of the air inlet cylinder, the other filter component is positioned at the air outlet end of the air outlet cylinder; the problem of be used for clearing up couple Yi Ka of filter screen in the hole on the filter screen, the filter screen clearance is inconvenient is solved.

title_en: Quick indentation device is used in carton processing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a rapid indentation device for carton processing, which comprises a base, wherein a first U-shaped frame is fixedly arranged at the top end of the base, a transverse plate is arranged between vertical parts of the first U-shaped frame in a sliding manner, a second U-shaped frame is arranged at the bottom end of the transverse plate in a sliding manner, a rotating shaft is rotatably arranged on the vertical part of one side of the second U-shaped frame, the rotating shaft is positioned at the lower part of the second U-shaped frame, a rotating block is fixedly sleeved on the rotating shaft, the other end of the rotating shaft penetrates through the second U-shaped frame to extend out of the second U-shaped frame and is fixedly connected with a first sprocket, a plurality of supports are fixedly arranged on the outer wall of the rotating block in an annular array manner, and pinch rollers are fixedly arranged on one sides of the supports, which are far away from the rotating block.

title_en: Gill box fancy drafting assembly
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a gill box fancy drafting assembly, which comprises: the back roller subassembly and well roller, well roller sets up in the place ahead of back roller subassembly, back roller subassembly includes first back roller, second back roller, fixed leather roller and adjustable compression roller subassembly, first back roller and second back roller upper and lower parallel distribution, fixed leather roller sets up in first back roller one side, adjustable compression roller subassembly includes pivot and a plurality of compression roller, the compression roller is along pivot length direction interval distribution in the pivot, and the projection at pivot one end is circumference interval distribution, pivot parallel arrangement is in second back roller one side, through the rotation of pivot, selects appointed compression roller and second back roller to contact, normally carries the wool strip of a fixed colour to give well roller through first back roller, and the wool strip of other colours carries out the clearance feeding with the compression roller one-to-one, can obtain the fancy yarn that the colour change is richer.

title_en: Thermal transfer film printer with broken roll detection function
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of printing equipment, and particularly relates to a thermal transfer film printer with a broken roll detection function, which comprises: the coiling mechanism, unreeling device and printing device, unreeling device with be provided with overspeed device tensioner between the printing device, overspeed device tensioner includes: mounting panel, portal frame, commentaries on classics roller A and commentaries on classics roller B rotate between the two the mounting panel is provided with commentaries on classics roller B, commentaries on classics roller B with be provided with between the unreeling device the portal frame, the portal frame includes stand and crossbeam, the lower extreme of crossbeam is provided with two cylinders, the piston rod of cylinder is down and all is connected with detection assembly, detection assembly includes: the utility model does not need staff to watch in front of the printing machine, and has low cost.

title_en: Treatment recovery unit of papermaking tail stock
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a treatment recovery device of papermaking tail pulp, which comprises a primary separation cylinder, a crushing chamber and a secondary separation tank, wherein: the primary separating cylinder is in an inverted circular table shape, a feed inlet of the primary separating cylinder is positioned on the side wall of the cylinder body, and a discharge outlet of the primary separating cylinder is positioned on the upper end surface of the cylinder body; a separation cylinder is arranged in the inner cavity of the primary separation cylinder, one end of the cylinder is fixedly connected with the upper end surface of the primary separation cylinder in a coaxial way, and the other end of the cylinder is suspended in the primary separation cylinder; the lower end of the primary separating cylinder is fixedly connected with the crushing chamber, and the inner cavities of the primary separating cylinder and the crushing chamber are communicated; the lower end of the crushing chamber is communicated and connected with the peripheral surface of the secondary separation tank by a pipeline; the upper end of the secondary separation tank is provided with a discharge hole, and the lower end is provided with a slag discharge hole. The beneficial effects are that: the utility model has the advantages of work efficiency is high, rational in infrastructure, convenient operation, and impurity removal rate is high, and retrieves through twice processing for tail stock utilization ratio is high.

title_en: Equipment for embossing tipping paper foil
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of tipping paper manufacturing, and more particularly to an apparatus for tipping paper foil embossing, wherein the apparatus for tipping paper foil embossing comprises: the machine body is arranged on the ground, a first placing groove is formed in one side of the machine body, which is away from the ground, a second placing groove is formed in the bottom wall of the machine body, the second placing groove is internally provided with a binder, a circulating groove is formed in the side wall of the first placing groove, the circulating groove is communicated with the first placing groove and is positioned at the bottom of the first placing groove, a cavity is formed in the top of the machine body, the cavity is communicated with the circulating groove, and external tipping paper passes through the cavity; the first feeding assembly is rotatably arranged in the second placing groove; and an embossing assembly disposed within the cavity. The utility model can realize the advantages of automatic bonding of the aluminum foil sheet and the tipping paper, mass production and high processing efficiency by effectively utilizing the self structural configuration.

title_en: Turntable mechanism of braiding machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a turntable mechanism of a braiding machine, and particularly relates to the technical field of turntable mechanisms, which comprises a workbench, wherein the top end of the workbench is movably connected with a turntable through a bearing, and four material rollers are fixedly arranged at the top end of the turntable; the outer end of the material roller is provided with a supporting mechanism for fixing the braiding belt wire sleeve; the supporting mechanism comprises a threaded rod arranged inside the material roller, the outer end of the threaded rod is in threaded connection with a threaded block, four supporting plates are arranged at the outer end of the material roller, and a protection mechanism for protecting the turntable is arranged inside the workbench. The utility model not only can prolong the service life, but also can protect the turntable, prevent workers from colliding with the turntable, and increase the safety.

title_en: Printer foot rest leveling mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a printer foot rest leveling mechanism which comprises a top plate, a base, an air cylinder and a pressing block, wherein the air cylinder and the pressing block are arranged between the top plate and the base, a plurality of stand columns are connected between the top plate and the base, a top fastening bolt downwards penetrates through the top plate to be connected with the top ends of the stand columns, a bottom fastening bolt upwards penetrates through the base to be connected with the bottom ends of the stand columns, the top ends of the air cylinder are arranged on the bottom surface of the top plate, the pressing block is arranged on a piston rod of the air cylinder, a product positioning block is arranged below the pressing block, and the product positioning block is arranged on the base. The top fastening bolt and the bottom fastening bolt are used for tensioning the top plate and the base at the top end and the bottom end of the upright post, so that when the pressing block applies specific numerical pressure to the printer foot rest, the pressure can be kept for a specific period of time, and the effect of leveling the printer foot rest is achieved.

title_en: High-strength superfine chemical fiber
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-strength ultrafine chemical fiber which comprises a chemical fiber body, wherein an elastic fiber layer is interwoven on the surface of the chemical fiber body, an inner cavity of the elastic fiber layer comprises an acetate fiber layer, a spandex fiber layer and a nylon fiber layer, the inner surface of the acetate fiber layer is interwoven on the outer surface of the spandex fiber layer, and the inner surface of the spandex fiber layer is interwoven on the outer surface of the nylon fiber layer. According to the utility model, the elastic fiber layer, the acetate fiber layer, the spandex fiber layer and the nylon fiber layer are added, so that the effect of good toughness is achieved, the strength of the chemical fiber body is improved, the chemical fiber body is prevented from being torn and broken in the using process, the service life of the chemical fiber body is prolonged, the trouble of workers is solved, the requirements of the workers are met, and the wear-resistant effect can be achieved by adding the wear-resistant fiber layer, the polyester fiber layer, the acrylic fiber layer and the polyethylene fiber layer.

title_en: Conveying structure of corrugated case printer
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of printers and discloses a conveying structure of a corrugated paper box printer, which solves the problem that the work efficiency is reduced because the waste materials left in front cutting are conveyed through the conveying structure without being processed and the paper board to be printed is blocked.

title_en: Chemical fiber ring air-blowing cooling equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to chemical fiber circular blowing cooling equipment, which comprises a circular blowing piece and a telescopic driving piece, wherein the circular blowing piece is abutted with a filament extrusion assembly, and the telescopic driving piece is used for driving the circular blowing piece to move; the ring is blown the piece and is blown the piece including conical ring and blow in to the ring and blow the dryer, the ring is blown the dryer and is the cavity setting, be provided with the air intake on the lateral wall of ring and blow the dryer, the air intake with blow and connect through flexible bellows between the piece, the inside wall below of ring and blow the dryer is provided with a plurality of wind mouths, be provided with annular deep bead between air intake and a plurality of wind mouths, be provided with a plurality of ventilation holes on the deep bead. The air-out uniformity can be guaranteed to this application to guarantee the effect of the processingquality's of strand silk advantage.

title_en: A evenly discharge jig for thick liquids printing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a uniform discharging jig for printing slurry, which comprises a scraping plate and a guide plate fixed on the scraping plate; a plurality of discharging holes which are arranged in a linear array are formed on the scraping plate; the guide plate is provided with a feeding hole and a plurality of guide grooves which are diverged from the feeding hole; the guide grooves and the discharge holes are equal in number and are arranged in one-to-one correspondence, and the discharge holes are located at the ends of the corresponding guide grooves. When the uniform discharging jig for paste printing is used, the feeding holes are connected with the feeding device for supplying paste, the paste entering the feeding holes flows to the discharging holes along the guiding grooves and is discharged from the discharging holes, the discharged paste flows to the front of the moving direction of the guiding plate, and the scraper is provided with a plurality of discharging holes, so that a plurality of discharging points are arranged in the length range of the scraper, and the paste is easier to spread to the whole length range of the scraper along with the movement of the scraper, so that the printing is uniform.

title_en: Pressing die plate structure for printing fiber products
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a die plate structure for printing fiber products, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein an installation frame is fixed on the upper surface of the bottom plate, a box body is fixed on the inner top wall of the installation frame, a frame is connected inside the box body in a sliding manner, a replacement mechanism is arranged on the frame, a positioning mechanism is arranged on the frame, and a die plate body is connected inside the frame in a sliding manner. This die plate structure for fiber product stamp is provided with change mechanism and positioning mechanism, mutually support between each structure through change mechanism and positioning mechanism, can change the template body, through pivoted commentaries on classics board, can relieve the spacing to the connecting block, make the template body shift out in can follow the frame to change the template body, make the device can print out different patterns, can also fix a position the material in advance simultaneously when the stamp, after the template body removes, through the locating plate of removal, and cooperate the diaphragm, can fix a position the material, in order to improve the stamp effect of template body when the stamp.

title_en: Three-proofing fabric
abstract_en: According to the three-proofing fabric disclosed by the utility model, the warp yarns and the weft yarns are all three-proofing fibers, every six warp yarns in each warp yarn form circulation warp yarns, every three weft yarns in each weft yarn form circulation weft yarns, a first interval is formed between every two adjacent circulation weft yarns, the first interval is 0.08-0.15 cm, the circulation warp yarns and the circulation weft yarns are twisted together to form an interweaving area, the first warp yarn and the fourth warp yarn are arranged on the circulation weft yarns one by one, the second warp yarn, the third warp yarn and the fifth warp yarn are arranged on the circulation weft yarns, the sixth yarn strand is arranged on the warp yarns one by one, and the first warp yarn, the second warp yarn, the third warp yarn, the sixth warp yarn, the fourth warp yarn and the fifth warp yarn are arranged in a vertically crossing manner at the first interval. Compared with the prior art, the waterproof and antifouling fabric has waterproof, antifouling and oil-proof effects, and is also provided with a plurality of through holes, so that the fabric is strong in air permeability and water drops can not drip from the air holes.

title_en: Lapping machine is used in non-woven fabrics production convenient to height-adjusting
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a lapping machine is used in non-woven fabrics production convenient to height-adjusting relates to the technical field of lapping machine, and it includes carries curtain and lapping platform, carry the curtain to include to one side and carry curtain and horizontal conveying curtain, the lapping platform sets up in horizontal conveying curtain below, still including being used for adjusting the horizontal conveying curtain high adjusting column and being used for supporting a plurality of flexible support columns of horizontal conveying curtain and inclined conveying curtain, the adjusting column includes fixed column and lifter, the lifter activity is inserted and is established in the fixed column, the lifter stretches out from the fixed column and is connected with horizontal conveying curtain, the cooperation is provided with lifting assembly on fixed column and the lifter, flexible support column includes a fixed section of thick bamboo and activity are inserted and are established the movable rod in a fixed section of thick bamboo, the movable rod stretches out in from the fixed section of thick bamboo and is connected with horizontal conveying curtain or to one side, be provided with the retaining member that is used for locking the movable rod on the fixed section of thick bamboo. This application has the effect of being convenient for adjust the height between horizontal conveying curtain and the lapping platform.

title_en: Concentration adjusting system, pulping system and pulp production line
abstract_en: The application discloses concentration governing system, slurrying system and paper pulp production line relates to paper pulp technical field, includes: a concentration adjustment system comprising: a first storage tank for storing a first pulp of a first consistency; a second storage tank for storing a second pulp of a second consistency; the pulp mixing pipeline is used for communicating the first storage tank, the second storage tank and the white water tank; the controller is electrically connected with the pulp mixing pipeline and is used for controlling the pulp mixing pipeline to transmit the first paper pulp and the white water of the white water tank and adjusting the first paper pulp and the white water into the second paper pulp to be transmitted to the second storage tank. The paper pulp concentration adjusting device can effectively improve the pulp concentration adjusting efficiency.

title_en: Adjustable crinkling presser foot for sewing machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an adjustable wrinkle-shrinking presser foot for a sewing machine, which is based on a traditional presser foot assembly, namely a hinged support relatively fixed to the presser foot assembly and a presser foot piece hinged to the hinged support through a spring pin shaft, wherein the bottom of the presser foot piece is attached to cloth; 1. the stitching precision and efficiency are improved: the technology solves the defects of the traditional technology in the aspects of stitching precision, efficiency and adaptability by adding the support component and the linear component and using the folding type compression bar as the presser foot component, so that the stitching task can be more accurately finished. 2. Increased adaptability and flexibility: the support assembly provides a first linear degree of freedom for linear adjustment of the orientation of the adaptable hinge support, and the linear assembly provides a second linear degree of freedom for adjusting the maximum center distance of the cloth maximum stitch position relative to the hinge support. The two degrees of freedom can be adjusted manually or dynamically, so that the presser foot of the sewing machine can be flexibly adjusted in different sewing tasks.

title_en: Dressing processing and cutting device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a dressing processing and cutting device, which relates to the technical field of medical dressing production and comprises a third motor, wherein one end of the third motor is connected with a first rotating shaft, one end of the first rotating shaft is connected with a blade, the top of the third motor is connected with a fixed block, the top of the fixed block is connected with a telescopic rod, the top of the telescopic rod is connected with a moving block, one end of the moving block is connected with a screw rod in a penetrating way, and one end of the screw rod is connected with a second motor. According to the utility model, the first rotating shaft is driven to rotate by starting the third motor, the blade rotates along with the rotation of the first rotating shaft, meanwhile, the screw rod is driven to rotate by starting the second motor, the moving block connected with one end surface of the screw rod moves along with the rotation of the screw rod, and then the fixed block descends by adjusting the expansion and contraction of the telescopic rod, so that gauze below the blade is cut.

title_en: Broken wire detection device for large circular knitting machine
