abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of broken wire detection, in particular to a broken wire detection device for a large circle machine, which comprises a U-shaped mounting frame, wherein a rotating shaft is arranged at an opening of the U-shaped mounting frame, a first connecting rod is arranged on the upper side of the rotating shaft, a yarn guiding ring is arranged at the upper end of the first connecting rod, a second connecting rod is arranged on the lower side of the rotating shaft, the length of the second connecting rod is larger than that of the first connecting rod, a mounting block is arranged at the lower end of the second connecting rod, a lamp is arranged at the lower end of the mounting block, the distance between the lamp and the rotating shaft is smaller than that of the U-shaped mounting frame, a stepped hole with the upper part being small and the lower part being big, a battery is arranged in the lower side hole of the stepped hole, the lower end of the battery is connected with a positive electrode of the lamp, a conductive ball is arranged in the upper side hole of the stepped hole, a conductive sheet is arranged on the inner wall of the upper side hole of the stepped hole, the conductive sheet is connected with a negative electrode of the lamp, and the conductive ball always contacts with the conductive sheet when rolling in the upper side hole of the stepped hole.

title_en: Quick-drying polyester viscose woven fabric
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a quick-drying polyester viscose woven fabric, and relates to the technical field of textiles. The key points of the technical scheme are as follows: the utility model ensures ventilation and exchange of air inside and outside the fabric in the use process by arranging the moisture dissipation channels, ensures the integral ventilation and quick-drying performance of the fabric, and has the characteristics of good moisture absorption and quick moisture dissipation.

title_en: Dehairing device that fabrics processing was used
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a dehairing device for textile processing, which relates to the technical field of textile processing equipment and comprises a working frame, wherein edge fixing plates are fixedly arranged at two end positions of one side of the top of the working frame, a plurality of driving rollers which are staggered up and down and are distributed at equal intervals are rotatably arranged between opposite ends of the two edge fixing plates through bearings, one end of one edge fixing plate, which is far away from the driving rollers, is fixedly provided with a driving motor, an output shaft of which is fixedly connected with the driving rollers, chip accumulation grooves are formed in positions right below the driving rollers, and mounting shells are fixedly arranged at positions, between the adjacent driving rollers, of the tops of the chip accumulation grooves. The utility model can improve the dehairing efficiency of the device by the mutual matching of the dehairing mechanism and the hair collecting mechanism.

title_en: Shoe last structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a shoe tree structure, which mainly comprises a high shoe tree seat and a front shoe tree body which can be separated or combined by pushing relative to the high shoe tree seat, wherein the high shoe tree seat is provided with a high shoe tree ankle part, an action curved surface is arranged on the high shoe tree seat, the front shoe tree body is provided with a sliding curved surface which can slide and displace relative to the action curved surface, a transverse cutting space is arranged above the two curved surfaces and used for accommodating and locking a buffer cushion, a group groove is respectively formed between the high shoe tree seat and the front shoe tree body, and components which are connected with each other are correspondingly arranged in the group groove; therefore, the shoe tree structure can be applied to the manufacturing process of the high shoe and can achieve the effect of smoothly removing the shoe tree.

title_en: Paperboard grooving machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a paperboard grooving machine, which comprises a conveying belt and grooving cutters, wherein fixed frames are respectively and fixedly connected to two sides of the bottom of the conveying belt, a moving part for controlling the grooving position is arranged above the conveying belt, an adjusting part for controlling the grooving depth is arranged above the conveying belt, the moving part comprises a supporting frame fixedly connected with the top of the conveying belt, a moving groove formed in the inner bottom of the supporting frame, a moving block arranged in the moving groove, a screw rod connected with the moving block and a first motor connected with one end of the screw rod, and the problems that the grooving machine can prevent the paperboard from jumping and grooving the paperboard, but manually and repeatedly screwing bolts are needed when the grooving depth and the grooving position are adjusted, the adjusting efficiency is low and the machining efficiency is reduced are solved by arranging the conveying belt, the grooving cutters, the fixed frames, the supporting frame and the limiting parts.

title_en: Feeding pasting machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a feeding pasting machine, which relates to the technical field of pasting machines and comprises a bottom plate, wherein four brackets are arranged at the top of the bottom plate, tracks are arranged in the four brackets, a U-shaped supporting plate is arranged at the top of the bottom plate, a pasting machine is arranged outside the tracks, a collecting box is arranged on the right side of the tracks, an auxiliary fixing mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the U-shaped supporting plate, the auxiliary fixing mechanism comprises a machine case, the machine case is fixedly arranged outside the U-shaped supporting plate, a motor is fixedly arranged in the machine case, one end of a reciprocating screw rod penetrates through the U-shaped supporting plate and the machine case to be in transmission connection with the motor, the other end of the reciprocating screw rod is rotatably arranged in the U-shaped supporting plate through a bearing, a limiting ring is fixedly sleeved on the outer side of the reciprocating screw rod, and two lifting columns, a hydraulic cylinder, a supporting frame, rollers and a positioning block are arranged. The utility model can assist in fixing the materials, can save the production cost and is beneficial to the production and popularization of products.

title_en: Yarn shoveling device for spinning
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a yarn shoveling device for spinning, which comprises a discharge hopper and a conveyor belt arranged in the discharge hopper, wherein the feed end of the discharge hopper is fixedly connected with a yarn feeding hopper, the interior of the yarn feeding hopper is fixedly connected with a guide plate, and one side of the discharge hopper is fixedly connected with a yarn shoveling assembly; the material collecting box comprises a main board, a fixing piece and a fork piece, wherein the upper end face of the fork piece is fixedly connected with the fixing piece, the fixing piece is fixedly connected to one side of the front end face of the main board, the front end face of the main board is fixedly connected with a yarn shoveling rod, the yarn shoveling rod comprises an inclined rod, one end of the inclined rod is fixedly connected with an adjusting column, the outer part of the adjusting column is slidably connected with a sleeve, one end of the sleeve is fixedly connected with a gasket, the other end of the sleeve is rotationally connected with an adjusting nut, the other end of the inclined rod is fixedly connected with an elastic rod, and the elastic rod is deviated from the fixed rod at one end of the inclined rod. The utility model has simple structure and can ensure that all the spindle can be sent into the discharge hopper to be collected.

title_en: Edge finding assembly of printing platform
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of large-format ink-jet printers, in particular to a printing platform edge finding assembly which is arranged below a printing platform and comprises a fixed seat, a sliding seat, a driving mechanism, a sensor assembly and a position sensor, wherein a linear through hole is formed in the printing platform, the driving mechanism pushes the sliding seat to drive the sensor assembly to slide along the through hole, and the sensing direction of the sensor assembly penetrates through the through hole and is vertical to the printing platform upwards. The device is used for solving the problems that printing mediums are easy to arch and uneven in the printing process and poor in printing effect and the problem that the alignment between the printing mediums and the inkjet vehicle is not rapid enough, realizing accurate edge finding, aligning the inkjet vehicle with the printing area, saving the placement time of the printing mediums and improving the printing efficiency; the position of the printing medium is controlled in real time to enhance the printing effect.

title_en: Fabric shaping device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fabric shaping device, which is arranged between an unreeling roller and a wind-up roller and is provided with a dust removing component and a shaping component, the fabric is arranged between two roller bodies which are distributed up and down, a plurality of wiping blocks are arranged on the peripheral outer wall of each roller body at intervals, a plurality of through holes are arranged between the two wiping blocks and are arranged on each roller body, one end of each roller body is rotationally connected with a rack through a main shaft, the other end of each roller body is fixedly provided with an end cover with a hollow shaft, the hollow shafts which are rotationally connected with the rack are connected with a negative pressure pump through a connecting head, the connecting head further comprises an air suction pipe and a transition plate, the transition plate is arranged on the peripheral outer wall of the air suction pipe, the outer wall of the rack is provided with supporting legs which are fixedly connected with the transition plate, and the air suction pipe is communicated with the hollow shafts. The fabric shaping device can scrape dust and fluff on the fabric and timely suck the dust and the fluff before heat shaping, so that the flying of the dust and the fluff inside is reduced, and the cleaning effect of the fabric is improved.

title_en: Quick rubberizing device of shoes
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rapid shoe gluing device, which comprises: the device comprises a device main body, wherein a supporting rod is fixedly connected to one end above the device main body, a glue storage cylinder is fixedly connected to one end above the supporting rod, a communicating pipe is fixedly connected to the bottom of the glue storage cylinder, a valve is arranged at one end of the communicating pipe, a conveying bin is fixedly connected to one end of the communicating pipe, a screw shaft is rotatably connected to the interior of the conveying bin, a transverse sliding rod is fixedly connected to the interior of the device main body, and a sliding block is slidably connected to the transverse sliding rod. According to the utility model, the required rubberized soles are placed on the conveyor belt, the soles are brought into the back of the equipment through the conveyor belt, glue flows into the conveying bin from the glue storage cylinder by opening the valve, the glue is input into the hose through the screw shaft in the conveying bin, the glue enters the glue spraying head through the hose, the transverse threaded rod is rotated by the second motor to drive the moving block to slide on the transverse threaded rod, the moving block moves to the position above the required rubberized soles, the glue is sprayed on the soles through the glue spraying opening, and the rubberized soles are sent out through the conveyor belt.

title_en: Cement bag heat sealing machine
abstract_en: The application provides a cement bag heat sealing machine, which comprises a bod, the equal fixed mounting in surface of organism both sides has the mounting panel, and is provided with transport mechanism between mounting panel and the organism, the top fixed mounting of organism has the hydraulic stem, and the fixed surface of hydraulic stem installs the movable block, the inside fixed mounting of organism has the fixed plate, and is provided with heat sealing mechanism between fixed plate and the movable block, the fixed surface of movable block installs the cutter, the top fixed mounting of organism has the air heater. This application is through the use of transport mechanism, will need the braided bag of heat seal processing place on the surface of first conveyer belt, drive first pivot through starting driving motor and rotate, drive the first conveyer belt on surface and move, when conveying the one end of braided bag to the fixed plate surface, carry out the heat seal to it and cut the bag and handle, will cut the braided bag after the bag through the second conveyer belt and convey out afterwards, avoid needing a large amount of manpowers to carry out the material loading, influence work efficiency.

title_en: Spun yarn pipe collecting device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a spun yarn tube collecting device, which belongs to the technical field of textile equipment and comprises a collecting box for collecting spun yarn tubes, wherein a connecting frame is arranged in an inner cavity of the collecting box, a plurality of separation plates for separating the spun yarn tubes are connected to the transverse inner wall of the collecting box, a plurality of support plates for supporting the spun yarn tubes are connected to the inner wall of the connecting frame, two windlass are connected to the side surface of the collecting box, and steel wire ropes of the windlass are fixedly connected with the connecting frame; the top of collecting box is connected with the swash plate through trapezoidal piece can dismantle, and linear motor is installed to the side of swash plate, is connected with the assembly frame between the removal portion of two linear motors, and conveyer is installed to the inner wall of assembly frame, and the inner wall of assembly frame still is provided with the buffer board, and the buffer board is connected fixedly with the assembly frame through a plurality of springs. The spun yarn tube collecting device not only can adjust the height difference of spun yarn tube collection, but also can protect the spun yarn tube collecting device.

title_en: Laminating machine for printing
abstract_en: The utility model provides a film laminating machine for printing. The film laminating machine for printing comprises: a work table; the two side plates are arranged on the workbench; the brackets are respectively arranged on the two side plates; the guide rollers are arranged on the two side plates; the heating rollers are arranged on the two side plates; the transmission mechanism is arranged at the top of the workbench; the driving motor is fixedly arranged on one side of the workbench, and an output shaft of the driving motor is fixedly connected with an output roller of the transmission mechanism; the mounting bracket, mounting bracket fixed mounting is in the top of workstation, the mounting bracket with two curb plate fixed connection. The laminating machine for printing provided by the utility model has the advantages that the paper printed matter is cooled, so that the paper printed matter is cooled rapidly, and people can collect the paper printed matter rapidly.

title_en: Antivirus antibacterial heating double-layer woven cloth
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of woven fabrics, in particular to an antiviral and antibacterial heating double-layer woven fabric which is of a double-layer fabric structure, wherein both a surface layer fabric and an inner layer fabric are of 1/1 plain weave, a binding weave adopts a lower splicing method, the surface layer fabric is composed of antiviral yarns, and the inner layer fabric is composed of far infrared heating yarns. The utility model has the characteristics of good washing fastness, antivirus, antibiosis and far infrared heating.

title_en: Large-stroke parallel beating-up mechanism based on rapier loom
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a large-stroke parallel beating-up mechanism based on a rapier loom, which comprises a rapier and a plurality of fixing columns fixedly connected to the top of the rapier, wherein the top of the rapier is provided with a plurality of positioning holes in a penetrating way, the inner surfaces of the positioning holes are all connected with positioning columns in a sliding way, and the tops of the positioning columns are fixedly connected with rapier heads. This large-stroke parallel beating-up mechanism based on rapier weaving machine, when needs installation, only need aim at the locating hole on the rapier with the reference column of rapier, the pulling movable plate makes the tensile fixed pin of spring remove simultaneously, and the fixed pin no longer blocks up the fixed orifices top this moment, later can make the reference column insert the locating hole and the fixed column inserts the fixed orifices, later unclamp the movable plate and can reset the fixed pin and insert the fixed column in accomplishing fixedly by the spring drive this moment, simplified the installation dismantlement of rapier.

title_en: Jacquard knife fixing structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a jacquard knife fixing structure which comprises a jacquard, wherein power mechanisms are symmetrically arranged at two ends of the jacquard, pressing mechanisms are arranged at the positions, above the power mechanisms, of the two ends of the jacquard, and knife lifting mechanisms are arranged inside the jacquard. According to the lifting knife mechanism, the lifting knife is clamped into the lifting knife rest, one end of the connecting bolt, which is not provided with the fixing clamping groove, is plugged into the first connecting hole and the second connecting hole, the clamping plate is inserted into the clamping groove, the clamping plate is clamped into the fixing clamping groove through the clamping opening of the clamping plate, the connecting bolt is fixed, so that the lifting knife can be fixed to prevent falling, the ejector block is placed into the lifting knife rest, and the connecting magnet is clamped into the third connecting hole and the fourth connecting hole, so that the clamping plate can be fixed to prevent falling.

title_en: Oven is used in sports shoes processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an oven for processing sports shoes, in particular to the field of sports shoes ovens, which comprises an oven body and further comprises: the baking rotating device capable of rotating and baking the sports shoes is arranged at the lower end of the oven body and is used for rotating and baking the sports shoes arranged inside, so that the heated area of the sports shoes is more uniform, and the baking effect is better; the inner side of the oven body is provided with a shoe opening fixing device which can stably fix the sports shoes on the device, and the shoe opening fixing device is used for stably fixing the sports shoes on the device when the sports shoes are baked, so that the sports shoes are prevented from toppling; the lower extreme of oven body is equipped with the supporting legs, the fixed setting of supporting legs is in oven body lower extreme. The baking rotating device is arranged, so that the rotating baking of the sports shoes arranged inside is facilitated, the heated area of the sports shoes is more uniform, and the fixing device with the shoe opening is beneficial to more stably fixing the sports shoes on the device when the sports shoes are baked.

title_en: Surface texture forming device of printing roller
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a surface texture forming device of a printing roller, which comprises a printing roller main body, wherein two symmetrically-distributed mounting grooves are formed in the outer wall of the printing roller main body, and limiting blocks are connected to the inner wall of each mounting groove; the inserted block is inserted into the slot, so that the texture piece can be preliminarily and limitedly connected with the printing roller main body, and the two texture pieces are mutually fixed, the sealing strips are sleeved on the contact surfaces of the two texture pieces to avoid leakage of ink, meanwhile, the limiting block is inserted into the square slot to enable the through holes to be aligned with the screw holes, at the moment, the screw rod passes through the through holes and is in threaded connection with the screw holes, the connecting block is fixedly connected with the printing roller main body, so that the texture piece is fixedly connected with the printing roller main body, if the texture piece is to be replaced, the screw rod is only required to be pulled out, thereby realizing convenient disassembly and installation of the texture piece, utilizing the texture piece with different textures to be replaced, and realizing the required effect of replacing different textures by the printing roller main body.

title_en: Matched device of large circular knitting machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a large circular knitting machine device, in particular to a large circular knitting machine matching device which comprises a safety guardrail, a winding mechanism and a control panel, wherein the winding mechanism comprises two brackets symmetrically arranged in the vertical direction, a mounting plate arranged at the bottom of the brackets and a winding roller arranged on the mounting plate and used for winding; the outer side surface of the bracket is fixedly provided with a purifying device; the utility model has simple structure, can carry out technical upgrading and transformation on the basis of the existing large circular knitting machine, ensures that the large circular knitting machine has the function of collecting dust and cloth flying cotton wool in the cloth collecting process, reduces the adhesion quantity of the produced cloth adhesion dust and cloth flying cotton wool, and improves the quality of products.

title_en: Laminating device of printing package
abstract_en: The utility model provides a film laminating device for printing and packaging, which comprises a shaft rod, wherein a film is wound on the shaft rod, a bottom plate which is arranged in parallel with the shaft rod is arranged under the shaft rod, two ends of the bottom plate are respectively connected and fixed with a vertically arranged supporting plate, the upper parts of the opposite surfaces of the two supporting plates are respectively provided with a bayonet, one side surface of the supporting plate is connected and fixed with a first support arm plate, the other side surface of the supporting plate is connected and fixed with a second support arm plate which is matched with the first support arm plate, a round rod is arranged between the first support arm plate and the second support arm plate, the outer surface of the round rod is fixed with a fine hair part, a plastic sleeve which is in sliding contact with the fine hair part is sleeved on the round rod, the lower part of the outer surface of the plastic sleeve is provided with a drawing rod which is arranged in parallel with the round rod, and one end of the drawing rod far away from the plastic sleeve penetrates through a guide hole: the end part of the film is separated from the film roll, so that personnel can conveniently and rapidly pull the end part of the film, and the film coating efficiency is improved.

title_en: Automatic hot stamping die-cutting device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of hot stamping die cutting, in particular to an automatic hot stamping die cutting device, which is used for conveying materials and hot stamping materials from right to left through a conveying mechanism, combining the hot stamping materials with the materials through the hot stamping mechanism, collecting waste materials of the hot stamping materials through the conveying mechanism, conveying the hot stamping materials to the lower part of a die cutting mechanism, die-cutting the hot stamping materials through the die cutting mechanism, rotating the die cutting mechanism through a driving mechanism during tool changing, and changing tools on the die cutting mechanism through a tool changing mechanism, so that the practicability of equipment is improved; comprises a thermoprinting mechanism and a conveying mechanism; the hot stamping machine also comprises a driving mechanism, a die cutting mechanism and a tool changing mechanism, wherein the driving mechanism and the conveying mechanism are both arranged on the hot stamping mechanism, and the die cutting mechanism and the tool changing mechanism are both arranged on the driving mechanism.

title_en: Laminating anilox roller
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a laminating anilox roller, which relates to the technical field of aluminum foil composite processing and comprises an anilox roller, wherein limiting shaft sleeves are arranged at two ends of the anilox roller, the limiting shaft sleeves are connected with the anilox roller through bolts, a rotating shaft is arranged in the middle of each limiting shaft sleeve, a shaft sleeve is arranged at one end, close to each limiting shaft sleeve, of each rotating shaft, connecting plates are arranged at two ends of each rotating shaft, and a cleaning assembly for cleaning aluminum foil composite paper is arranged in the middle of each connecting plate. According to the utility model, the aluminum foil composite paper to be printed is cleaned through the cleaning assembly, the aluminum foil composite paper is conveyed through the conveying roller, the aluminum foil composite paper is adjusted through the fixing plate and the leveling sliding beads, the aluminum foil composite paper is prevented from being wrinkled, the printing effect is affected, and the cleaning scraper corresponds to the conveying roller, so that the aluminum foil composite paper in conveying is cleaned.

title_en: Circulation film press
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a circulating film press, which comprises: the first box body is provided with a film pressing device and a drying device; the film pressing device comprises a film pressing driving roller, a first driving part for driving the film pressing driving roller to rotate, a film pressing driven roller, a tensioning roller, a second driving part for driving the tensioning roller to lift and a ring-shaped printing film, wherein the film pressing driving roller, the film pressing driven roller and the tensioning roller are parallel, and the ring-shaped printing film is sleeved on the film pressing driving roller, the film pressing driven roller and the tensioning roller simultaneously; the drying device is positioned between the film pressure driving roller and the film pressure driven roller; the second box body is internally provided with a conveying device for conveying the plate; the first box body can move up and down relative to the second box body so that the annular printing film can be closely attached to the upper surface of the plate on the conveying device; this annular printing membrane can cyclic utilization, avoids adopting the traditional printing mode of rolling and unreeling, guarantees the production quality of plate, improves work efficiency.

title_en: Pulping system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pulping system, which comprises a pre-grinding groove, at least two abrasive units and a post-grinding groove, wherein the pre-grinding groove is formed in the surface of the grinding groove; the two abrasive units are connected in parallel between the pre-grinding groove and the post-grinding groove, an inlet of each abrasive unit is connected with the pre-grinding groove, and an outlet of each abrasive unit is connected with the post-grinding groove; the abrasive unit comprises at least a first mill and a second mill which can be connected in series. The utility model can improve the pulping effect, fully reduce the specific energy consumption of the mill and prolong the service life of the grinding disc.

title_en: Silk screen printing equipment for mobile phone shell
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of silk-screen printing equipment, in particular to mobile phone shell silk-screen printing equipment, which comprises a workbench; the top of the workbench is provided with two pairs of deblocking blocks; the adjusting block is fixedly connected to the top of the workbench; the adjusting blocks are symmetrically arranged; the side wall of the workbench is provided with a through hole; the through-hole inside wall is equipped with the slide bar to make the distance of first magnet and second magnet nearer, then the reaction force of the nearer repulsion of distance of first magnet and second magnet is stronger, and then can fix the cell-phone shell extrusion at the middle part of workstation, through the first magnet and the second magnet of setting, the effectual staff of having made things convenient for put to the cell-phone shell, the staff of being convenient for fixes the cell-phone shell at the equipment middle part, improves the convenience of equipment, has reduced staff's work load, has increased the effect of equipment silk screen printing.

title_en: Pull tube device for double-layer hemming seam of clothing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pull cylinder device for double-layer hemming and seaming of clothing, which comprises a U-shaped pull cylinder, an adjusting mechanism and a fixing plate, wherein the fixing plate is fixedly connected to a workbench of a sewing machine, two ends of the U-shaped pull cylinder are inwards bent to form a C shape, the long side of the U-shaped pull cylinder forms a lower layer channel, and the short side forms an upper layer channel; and the U-shaped pull cylinder is fixedly connected with the adjusting mechanism, and the fixing plate is hinged with the adjusting mechanism. According to the utility model, the upper layer and the lower layer of the pull cylinder simultaneously clamp the sewn product to achieve the sewing effect of synchronous upper and lower hemming and seaming, so that the production efficiency is improved.

title_en: Cloth cutting equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses cloth cutting equipment, which comprises: the fixed block is provided with a fixed slot, the left surface inside the fixed block is rotationally connected with a first rotating shaft, the side surface of the first rotating shaft is fixedly connected with an upper fixed wheel, the right surface of the first rotating shaft is fixedly connected with a first motor output end, the right surface inside the fixed block is rotationally connected with a second rotating shaft, the side surface of the second rotating shaft is fixedly connected with a lower fixed wheel, and the left surface of the second rotating shaft is fixedly connected with a second motor output end; the upper surface of the cutting knife is fixedly connected with a cutter; and the movable wheel is fixedly connected with a third rotating shaft on the side surface of the movable wheel. Through above-mentioned structure for this equipment can evenly fix when cutting the cloth, and the incision after the guarantee cloth cuts is level and smooth, has improved product quality, avoids making the cloth incision arc because of fixed inhomogeneous, and then needs carry out secondary operation correction to the cloth, has increased the process, has improved manufacturing cost.

title_en: Batch feeder for non-woven fiber
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a batch feeder for non-woven fibers, which comprises a supporting frame, wherein a hopper is arranged at the front side of the supporting frame, rails positioned on the supporting frame are symmetrically arranged at the two ends of the hopper, each rail comprises a first sliding rail and a second sliding rail, the second sliding rail is positioned behind the first sliding rail, the upper ends of the first sliding rail and the second sliding rail are bent towards the rear, a first pulley and a second pulley are arranged at the two ends of the hopper, the second pulley is positioned above the first pulley, the first pulley slides on the first sliding rail, the second pulley slides on the second sliding rail, and the first pulley is driven by a driving mechanism to move along the first sliding rail.

title_en: Paperboard pushing mechanism for paperboard grooving machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of paperboard slotting, and discloses a paperboard pushing mechanism for a paperboard slotting machine, which comprises a box body, wherein a pushing mechanism is arranged on the left side of the box body, a conveyor belt is arranged in the box body, a slotting mechanism is arranged above the conveyor belt, the pushing mechanism comprises a feeding table, a first motor is fixedly connected to the front surface of the feeding table, a baffle is fixedly connected to the top of the feeding table, a fixing frame is fixedly connected to the top of the baffle, an adjusting plate is arranged on the right side of the fixing frame, and a fixing block is fixedly connected to the top of the left side of the adjusting plate. According to the utility model, the adjusting plate is arranged, and particularly the rotating handle is rotated to drive the threaded rod to rotate, so that the fixed block drives the adjusting plate to move upwards or downwards, the size of the feeding hole at the bottom is adjusted, and the sizes of the paperboards with different thicknesses can be adjusted, so that the paperboards are ensured to enter the box body in sequence, the blockage caused by excessive one-time entry is avoided, and meanwhile, the practicability is improved.

title_en: Feeding mechanism for pulp crushing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of crushers and discloses a feeding mechanism for crushing paper pulp, which comprises a paper pulp crusher, wherein an integrated feeding hopper is fixedly arranged at the top end of the paper pulp crusher, a feeding crushing cylinder is fixedly arranged at the top end of the feeding hopper, the feeding crushing cylinder is vertically penetrated and communicated with the feeding hopper, the periphery of the top end of the feeding hopper, which corresponds to the bottom end of the feeding crushing cylinder, is sealed, a paper pulp pre-crushing assembly is arranged in the feeding crushing cylinder, a transverse rod is fixedly arranged on the outer wall of the side surface of the paper pulp crusher, the paper pulp crusher is connected with an inclined paper pulp conveying belt through the transverse rod, the top end of the paper pulp conveying belt extends to the upper part of the top end of the feeding crushing cylinder, and the paper pulp raw material can be primarily crushed through the paper pulp pre-crushing assembly in the process of conveying the paper pulp to the paper pulp crusher, so that the paper pulp raw material can be conveniently crushed in the paper pulp crusher, and the paper pulp can be crushed more fully.

title_en: Hollow encoder
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hollow encoder which comprises a base, an end cover, a central shaft and an encoder, wherein the base is upwards extended with the hollow shaft, an outer ring of the encoder is fixedly connected with the end cover, a groove is formed in the middle of an inner ring of the encoder, one end of the central shaft is fixedly connected with the base, the other end of the central shaft is fixedly connected with the groove, at least one bearing is arranged between the base and the end cover, and the base is rotatably arranged below the end cover through the bearing. When the rotary cloth winding machine works, the end cover synchronously rotates along with the lathe to drive the outer ring of the encoder to synchronously rotate, the inner ring of the encoder is fixed on the base through the middle shaft and does not rotate, the rotating speed of the inner ring of the encoder is detected through the outer ring of the encoder, the encoder transmits digital information to the control center, the control center controls the large circular knitting machine to rotate according to the obtained digital information, and a signal is transmitted to the servo control system of the lathe through the data wire to adjust the rotating speed of the lathe, namely, the rotating speed of the knitting machine can be synchronous with the rotating speed of the cloth winding machine.

title_en: Silk cutting and flanging device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a silk cutting and flanging device which comprises a first section of workbench and a second section of workbench, wherein the first section of workbench comprises a cutting part and a first section of flanging part, the cutting part is positioned at one end of the first section of flanging part far away from the second section of workbench, a square groove is formed in the top surface of the cutting part, a plurality of ultrasonic cutting knives are arranged in the groove, and the ultrasonic cutting knives are connected with the cutting part in a sliding manner along the groove. According to the utility model, the cutting part of the first section workbench is utilized to cut the silk by the ultrasonic cutting knife in the groove, the first section flanging groove on the first section flanging part can carry out flanging treatment on two sides of the cut silk, the second section flanging groove on the second section flanging part of the second section workbench can carry out flanging treatment on the two sides of the folded silk, wherein the heating plates arranged in the first section flanging groove and the second section flanging groove can provide heating effect, so that the silk is easier to shape during flanging, and the collecting part collects the silk after flanging.

title_en: Cleaning mechanism for plastic flexible package color printing gravure printing device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of cleaning mechanisms, in particular to a cleaning mechanism for a plastic flexible package color gravure printing device, which comprises a printing support piece, a mounting assembly, a rotating assembly, a cleaning assembly and a fixing assembly.

title_en: Tension-adjustable tubular braiding machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tension-adjustable tubular braiding machine, which comprises a tensioning frame, wherein the tensioning frame comprises a bottom plate, two supporting rods are fixed at the top of the bottom plate, an auxiliary roller is rotationally connected between the two supporting rods, L-shaped frames are rotationally connected to the outer sides of the two supporting rods through rotating shafts, compression rollers are rotationally connected between the two L-shaped frames, a turntable is rotationally connected with the rotating shafts on one side of the two L-shaped frames, a clockwork spring is arranged between the L-shaped frames and the turntable, one end of the clockwork spring is fixed with the rotating shafts, and the other end of the clockwork spring is fixed with a connector at the edge of the turntable. According to the utility model, after the relative position between the turntable and the positioning ring is changed by rotating the turntable, the relative position between the turntable and the positioning ring is fixed by the limiting mechanism, so that the L-shaped frame can drive the compression roller to change the acting force of the compression roller on the braided fabric under the torsion action of the spring, thereby realizing the adjustment of the tension of the braided fabric, having a simple and easy-to-operate adjusting structure and improving the tension adjusting effect of the braided fabric.

title_en: Adjustable cashmere rake
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an adjustable cashmere rake, comprising: the connecting block I is fixedly provided with two connecting plates, two fixed mounting on the outer wall of one side that the connecting plates are close to each other has the dwang, rotate on the dwang and install connecting block II, be provided with adjusting part on the connecting block II, adjusting part includes spacing disc, dwang, spacing bayonet catch, circular fixed plate, expansion spring and a plurality of spacing draw-in groove, spacing disc fixed mounting is on connecting block II, the one end of the sub-dwang of dwang fixed mounting, spacing bayonet catch slidable mounting is on the dwang, circular fixed plate fixed mounting is in the one end of spacing bayonet catch, expansion spring slidable mounting is on spacing bayonet catch. The adjustable cashmere rake provided by the utility model has the advantages of being convenient for adjusting the angle between the steel comb and the holding handle and carding the cashmere.

title_en: A buffer stop and cutting bed for cutting bed
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of leather switching, in particular to an anti-collision device for a cutting bed and the cutting bed, which comprise a cutter head capable of moving on a cross beam, wherein anti-collision mechanisms are arranged on two sides of the cross beam, and can move after touching a human body and output signals capable of enabling the cutter head to stop cutting and moving; the detection mode is replaced by physical output in the entity from light induction, after the human body is touched, the anti-collision mechanism can generate position change to output an electric signal for stopping operation, and compared with the control mode brought by direct contact in the prior art, the false alarm rate can be further reduced, and the problem that cutting operation is stopped frequently is solved.

title_en: Paper feeding mechanism for paperboard slotting die-cutting machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a paper feeding mechanism for a paperboard slotting die-cutting machine, which is applied to the field of paper feeding mechanisms for die-cutting machines and comprises a base, wherein a rotating rod is symmetrically and rotatably connected inside the base through a bearing; according to the utility model, the rotating rod is arranged in the groove on the base, the first rotating wheel is arranged on the matching rotating rod, the first transmission belt is arranged between the two first rotating wheels, so that stacked paperboards can be placed on the first transmission belt, the contact area of the stacked paperboards is increased, the occurrence of pressure loss is prevented, the connecting rods are arranged in the two frames, the second rotating wheel is arranged on the matching connecting rods, and the guide belt is matched with the use of the guide belt.

title_en: Automatic ink feeding device of printing machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of printing machines and discloses an automatic ink feeding device of a printing machine, which comprises a device main body, wherein a liquid supplementing mechanism is arranged on the device main body, the liquid supplementing mechanism comprises a connecting block, the bottom of the connecting block is fixedly connected with a movable plate, the outer side of the movable plate is slidably connected with a sliding block, the rear side of the sliding block is fixedly connected with a supporting block, one side of the sliding block is fixedly connected with a connecting rod, the sliding block is fixedly connected with a floating ball through the connecting rod, and one side of the supporting block is provided with a sliding groove; the automatic ink feeding device can automatically adjust the ink feeding amount, avoids the complexity of manual operation, improves the working efficiency, and further realizes that the automatic ink feeding device of the device can accurately control the ink feeding amount, so that the printing quality is improved.

title_en: Signal swing arm support structure of electronic dobby
abstract_en: The utility model provides a signal swing arm support structure of electron dobby, includes the base, the fixed base that is provided with in base top, the fixed base top is fixed to be provided with the stand, the fixed column that is provided with in stand top, column surface fixing is provided with the rotation axis, rotation axis surface fixing is provided with big arm, big arm one side is fixed to be provided with rotating base. The base is fixed through the stationary blade after finding reasonable mounted position earlier, and the person of controlling passes through remote control arm work, and the column spinner is fixed, and the rotation axis is rotatory to drive big arm rotation, and the second column spinner is rotatory to drive the forearm rotation of second rotation axis, and forearm top connecting seat rotates, drives the spliced pole and rotates, and the spliced pole top is provided with the button and connects the fixed block.

title_en: High-speed water spraying loom
abstract_en: The utility model provides a high-speed water-jet loom, which relates to the technical field of scrap removal in the loom processing process, wherein longitudinal grooves are formed in the front side and the rear side of the interior of a base, lifting assemblies are arranged in the longitudinal grooves, the lifting assemblies are provided with two parts in total, the problem that certain yarn scraps remain on the surface of yarns due to the particularity of the yarns in the prior art, the existence of the scraps can influence the subsequent water column injection, the normal weaving effect can be influenced, and the problem of limitation exists is solved, and the rapid scrap removal operation for the produced yarns in the working process is realized by starting a pump arranged at the front end of a bracket to supply air to the interior of a wind groove formed in the bracket and spraying out wind flow.

title_en: Combined template of front door zipper and single open line
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of clothing manufacture, and provides a front door zipper and single-open combined template, which comprises the following components: the first positioning plate, the second positioning plate and the cover plate; two parallel first zipper tooth grooves are formed in the second positioning plate; two first grooves are formed in the second positioning plate; two first open line positioning lines are arranged on the second positioning plate; each first open line positioning line is parallel to each first slot; two second zipper teeth are arranged on the cover plate for grooving; the cover plate is provided with two second grooves, and each second groove is opposite to each first groove; according to the combined template of the front door zipper and the single-open thread, the second zipper tooth grooves are formed, so that the sewing needle can sew the female zipper and the child zipper to the garment through the second zipper tooth grooves, the second grooves are formed, so that the sewing needle can sew the bag tooth bag cloth to the garment through the second grooves, the front-side open thread treatment of the garment can be finished, the template does not need to be replaced, the operation is simple, and the working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Soda water safety traceability system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a soda water safety tracing system. The soda water safety traceability system comprises: the device comprises a conveyor, a water injection frame, a gland device, a lamp inspection device, a code spraying tracing device and a mixing barrel, wherein the water injection frame, the gland device, the lamp inspection device and the code spraying tracing device are all arranged on the conveyor, and the mixing barrel is arranged on one side of the conveyor; the fixed boxes are fixedly arranged at the top of the mixing barrel; the plurality of through openings are arranged at the top of the mixing barrel and correspond to the plurality of fixed boxes respectively; the weighing and discharging mechanisms are respectively arranged in the fixed boxes and used for quantitatively discharging. The soda water safety traceability system provided by the utility model has the advantage that the proportioning and placement amount of the sweetener and the spice can be easily and carefully grasped when soda water is mixed.

title_en: Corrugated paper board flattening device for corrugated paper processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a corrugated board flattening device for corrugated paper processing, which comprises a workbench, a sorting device and a flattening device, wherein the sorting device and the flattening device are respectively arranged on the top surface of the workbench, two groups of side walls on one side opposite to each other of mounting plates are fixedly arranged with a driving component, and the driving component is in threaded connection with a moving component.

title_en: Packing is closing device of color printing machine for color printing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of color printers and discloses a compressing device of a color printer for packaging, which comprises a base, wherein universal wheels are fixedly arranged at the bottom of the base, a conveying table is fixedly arranged at the top of the base, a conveying belt is arranged at the inner side of the conveying table, a color printer main body is fixedly arranged at the top of the base, an operation box is fixedly arranged at the top of the base, a preheating box is fixedly arranged at the left side of the color printer main body, an adjusting mechanism is arranged in the operation box, a drying mechanism is arranged in the preheating box, the preheating box is contacted with packaging paper through a set compression roller, the packaging paper is compressed under the elastic action of a spring, the displacement in the subsequent color printing work is avoided, and the packaging paper with different thickness is compressed by rotating the hand wheels, so that the height of the compression roller is adjusted, and the packaging paper is conveniently and comprehensively compressed.

title_en: Textile machinery movable support
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a textile machinery moving bracket, which comprises a warping machine creel and a moving mechanism connected with the bottom end of the warping machine creel, wherein a screw rod is in threaded connection with a sliding block and penetrates through the sliding block, two sides of a fixed box are respectively and rotationally connected with supporting legs, two ends of the sliding block are respectively and fixedly connected with rack sections meshed with gear sections, the fixed box is connected with a connecting mechanism, the extending end of a telescopic rod is rotationally connected with a rotating rod, and the rotating rod is inserted with a pin shaft through a pin groove.

title_en: Glue pressing equipment for production of women's shoes
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of women's shoes production equipment, in particular to glue pressing equipment for women's shoes production, which comprises an equipment main body, wherein a workbench is arranged in the middle of the equipment main body, a placing component is arranged at the upper end of the workbench and comprises a fixing block I, a telescopic rod I, a placing block and a placing groove, the right side of the fixing block I is connected with the telescopic rod I in a telescopic manner, the right side of the telescopic rod I is connected with the placing block, and the placing groove is formed in the placing block. According to the utility model, through the fixed block I, the telescopic rod I, the placing block and the placing groove in the placing assembly, the women's shoes with different sizes can be placed, the supporting block is used for compacting the women's shoes, the rubberized fabric head is used for rubberizing the women's shoes, the two sides of the raw material of the shoes are not required to be manually pulled for processing, the problem that the adhesive tape deviates from the seam of the shoes when the adhesive tape is pressed does not occur, and the processing quality and efficiency of the women's shoes are improved.

title_en: Folding mechanism is used in carton production
abstract_en: The utility model provides a folding mechanism for carton production. The folding mechanism for producing the paper boxes comprises: the device comprises a device main body, a device bottom plate is arranged on the device main body, an adjusting plate is fixedly connected onto the device bottom plate, a nut block sliding groove is formed in the adjusting plate, a nut block is connected onto the nut block sliding groove in a sliding mode, a second connecting block is fixedly connected onto the nut block, a second baffle is fixedly connected onto the second connecting block, a threaded rod is connected onto the nut block in a rotating mode, a second bearing is connected onto the threaded rod in a rotating mode, the second bearing is fixedly connected with the adjusting plate, a first bearing is connected onto the threaded rod in a rotating mode, and a rotating handle is fixedly connected onto the threaded rod. The folding mechanism for producing the paper boxes has the effect of adjusting the device according to the size of the paper boards and adjusting the height of the device according to the height of a user.

title_en: Paper machine capable of automatically correcting
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of paper machines, and discloses a paper machine capable of automatically correcting. The two correction rods are symmetrically distributed at the upper end and the lower end in the transmission port, the arranged correction rods can generate extrusion force on the lifting main board and the lifting secondary board after the upper hydraulic cylinder and the lower hydraulic cylinder operate, and can effectively separate the lifting secondary board from the lifting main board under the action of the separation bar after a certain height, form the same inclination angle as the correction rods, synchronously extrude the correction rods, enable the correction rods to move up and down on the surface of the chute, correct offset paper, adjust the angle of the correction rods according to the offset of the paper, effectively and rapidly correct the position of the paper, and are convenient and fast.

title_en: Dynamic tension compensation structure for warp knitting warp feeding of mesh cloth
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of warp feeding devices of warp knitting machines, and discloses a dynamic tension compensation structure for warp feeding of mesh fabrics, which comprises a supporting mechanism, wherein a feeding mechanism is arranged in the supporting mechanism, the supporting mechanism comprises a supporting frame, a feeding hole is formed in the top of the supporting frame for threading, a guide frame is fixedly connected in the middle of the supporting frame, a limit groove is formed in the back of the guide frame, and a guide roller is movably connected in the limit groove. This screen cloth warp knitting warp let-off dynamic tension compensation structure is led to the wire material through set up the feed port at the top of support frame and offer the spacing groove at the leading truck back to make the wire material gu straight overlap joint at the surface of backing roll and driving roller, and convey the wire material through the driving roller, and tensile wire material provides tension, thereby make the wire material be in gu straight state all the time in order to avoid the uneven tension of wire material and lead to the screen cloth to weave back elasticity inconsistent, reached the tensile effect of compensation wire material.

title_en: High-elasticity polyester staple fiber
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-elasticity polyester staple fiber which comprises a staple fiber main body, wherein a separation mechanism is arranged on the outer wall of the staple fiber main body and comprises a plurality of bulges and extension parts, the bulges are fixedly arranged on the outer wall of the staple fiber main body, the bulges are arranged in an annular array, the extension parts are respectively fixedly arranged at one ends of the bulges, a reinforcing mechanism is arranged outside the staple fiber main body, and a heat preservation mechanism is arranged inside the staple fiber main body. The utility model utilizes the arrangement of the bulge and the extension part to lead the outside of the short fiber main body to have a plurality of sweat guiding grooves for sweat guiding, and then the short fiber is matched with the reinforcing mechanism, so that after being extruded, the short fiber can recover the original shape after the extrusion disappears, and the closing of the sweat guiding grooves is avoided, thereby ensuring the stable use of the residual sweat guiding grooves and ensuring the sweat guiding effect of the short fiber.

title_en: Screen printing piezoceramics tangential pipe equally dividing device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a screen printing piezoelectric ceramic tangential pipe equal division device, belonging to the technical field of screen printing; the device comprises a dividing head and a silver printing screen plate which are matched with each other, wherein the dividing head is arranged on a bottom frame and is used for placing a tangential pipe; the silver printing screen plate is arranged on the movable base and is used for printing electrodes; the underframe is used for supporting and rotating the dividing head, and the movable base is used for adjusting the position of the silver printing screen plate; the rotary printing of the outer wall electrode and the inner wall electrode of the tangential tube is realized through the dividing head, so that the problem that the radian is limited to a certain extent and the equal division problem during plane printing are solved; in the electrode printing process, the handle is rocked to drive the dividing head to rotate to realize equal-division printing, the inside and outside of the tangential tube are equal in equal division, and the printing interval consistency is good.

title_en: Warping machine lubricating device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of lubricating devices and discloses a warping machine lubricating device which structurally comprises a mounting frame, wherein an electric push rod, a bearing mounting groove and a lubricating fluid storage tank are arranged on the mounting frame, the electric push rod is fixedly connected to one side of the mounting frame, the bearing mounting groove is positioned in the mounting frame, the lubricating fluid storage tank is fixedly connected to the top end of the mounting frame, the output end of the electric push rod is connected with a piston rod through a connecting plate, the bottom end of the lubricating fluid storage tank is connected with a guide pipe through an electromagnetic valve, and the inside of the bearing mounting groove is connected with a whole roller through a connecting bearing. The automatic lubrication device effectively realizes automatic lubrication of the connecting bearings in the warping machine, reduces convenience of operators in maintaining the connecting bearings of the warping machine, reduces labor intensity of the operators in maintaining the connecting bearings of the warping machine, and improves convenience of the warping machine in the maintenance process.

title_en: Gluing and bonding device for packaging plastic bags
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a gluing and bonding device for packaging plastic bags, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein the upper end surface of the bottom plate is provided with a shell, the top end of the shell is provided with an air outlet, the inside of the shell is provided with a conveying roller, the surface of the conveying roller is provided with a conveying belt, a glue storage tank is arranged above the conveying belt, the top end of the glue storage tank is provided with a stirring motor, the side wall of the glue storage tank is communicated with a glue conveying pipe, the glue conveying pipe is connected with the input end of a conveying pump, the output end of the conveying pump is connected with a glue outlet pipe, the conveying pump continuously conveys glue to the glue outlet pipe, the lower part of the glue outlet pipe is provided with a gluing roller, the left side of the gluing roller is provided with a matched scraping plate, the scraping plate uniformly coats the glue on the gluing roller, the glue is coated on a plastic packaging belt conveyed by the conveying belt, a film material on the material roller is attached to a packaging bag after gluing, and is subjected to a pressing roller and a hot air blower, solidification of the glue is accelerated, and in the glue coating process, the glue is continuously and uniformly coated, and the glue bonding effect is improved.

title_en: Adjustable transmission device for polyester fabric conveying
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an adjustable transmission device for polyester fabric conveying, which belongs to the technical field of fabric processing and comprises a workbench, wherein a supporting plate is fixedly arranged on the rear side of the top of the workbench, a mounting seat and a connecting box are sequentially and fixedly arranged on the front side of the supporting plate from top to bottom, a hose is fixedly communicated with the right side of the connecting box, a motor is arranged in an inner cavity of the mounting seat, a cam is fixedly connected with an output shaft of the motor, a vertical rod is arranged in the inner cavity of the mounting seat, the bottom of the vertical rod penetrates through the mounting seat and is fixedly connected with a movable plate, a rubber head is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the movable plate, limit rods are fixedly arranged on the left side and the right side of the top of the movable plate, the top of the limit rods extend to the inner cavity of the mounting seat, and a base is fixedly arranged on the right side of the top of the workbench. The utility model can be convenient for dust removal to the cloth, avoids dust from adhering to the surface of the cloth, improves the quality of the cloth, can also adjust the tension of the cloth, and has simple structure and convenient operation of staff.

title_en: Uniform drying equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses uniform drying equipment which comprises a main mounting assembly, wherein a paperboard conveying assembly is arranged on the main mounting assembly, a side supporting assembly is arranged on the paperboard conveying assembly, a top supporting assembly is arranged on the side supporting assembly, a primary drying power assembly is arranged on the top supporting assembly, a middle drying power assembly is arranged on one side of the top supporting assembly, which is positioned on the primary drying power assembly, a tertiary drying power assembly is arranged on one side, which is far away from the middle drying power assembly, of the top supporting assembly, an auxiliary connecting assembly is arranged above the paperboard conveying assembly in the top supporting assembly, and a drying assembly is arranged on the auxiliary connecting assembly. This even drying equipment, structural design is ingenious, and the practicality is stronger, and the job operation is stable, utilizes this drying equipment, has realized various box automatic conveying after the printing, automatic stoving operation, has effectively guaranteed various box stoving operation's homogeneity, has improved the efficiency of stoving operation, has also improved the efficiency of stoving.

title_en: Cloth winding device of water jet loom
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of textile equipment, and particularly relates to a cloth winding device of a water-jet loom, which comprises a drying box arranged at one side of the water-jet loom, wherein openings for cloth to pass through are formed at two ends of the drying box, guide rollers II are arranged at two ends of the drying box close to the openings, the drying box is penetrated and rotatably connected with a plurality of guide rollers I and guide rollers III, a mounting frame I is fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the drying box, a hot air blower is fixedly arranged on the mounting frame I, ventilation grooves are formed at two sides of the drying box, a connecting seat is fixedly connected to the side surface of the drying box, and a winding mechanism is arranged on the connecting seat; by arranging the winding mechanism, the utility model can effectively avoid the problems of uneven tightness, curling, crossing, dislocation and the like of the cloth in the winding process, thereby improving the winding quality, eliminating wrinkling, folding and loosening in the cloth, adaptively adjusting the tension of the cloth, facilitating the subsequent winding and ensuring the cloth winding quality of the water jet loom.

title_en: Quilting-free wadding
abstract_en: A quilting-free batt comprising an upper surface layer, a batt core layer and a lower surface layer; the upper surface layer, the flocculus core layer and the lower surface layer are all fixed through ultrasonic embossing points; the upper surface layer, the flocculus core layer and the lower surface layer are all fixed by ultrasonic edge embossing points, the embossing points are round, and the area is 0.03cm  2 -0.8cm 2 .

title_en: Screen printer with location stoving function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of screen printing and discloses a screen printer with a positioning and drying function, which comprises a machine shell, wherein the inner wall of the machine shell is movably connected with a supporting plate, the inner wall of the supporting plate is fixedly connected with a grid plate, one side of the supporting plate is fixedly connected with a sliding block, the top of the supporting plate is fixedly connected with a supporting frame, the front surface of the supporting frame is movably connected with a limiting screw rod, the bottom end of the limiting screw rod is fixedly connected with a limiting plate, and the inner bottom wall of the machine shell is fixedly provided with a heating plate. This screen printer with location stoving function through casing, backup pad, grid, support frame, spacing screw, limiting plate, hot plate and the door plant that set up, can make this screen printer have the effect of being convenient for location stoving, and the panel that accessible is simple and swift will need be dried is fixed a position the centre gripping to this avoids the panel to appear rocking the problem at the stoving stage, has satisfied people's user demand.

title_en: Double-sided release paper
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a double-sided release paper, which comprises a double-sided release paper main body, wherein a plurality of quick-break through grooves are formed in the middle of the double-sided release paper main body, accommodating grooves corresponding to the quick-break through grooves are formed in the top end and the bottom end of the double-sided release paper main body, and dimensional stability grooves are formed in the two ends of the accommodating grooves; according to the utility model, through the cooperation of the maintenance component and the quick-break through groove, the double-sided release paper main body can be broken to a proper length for use without a tool, and the section is smooth, so that the convenience of overall application is improved.

title_en: Trimming device for toothbrush production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a trimming device for toothbrush production, which comprises a base, wherein a first chute is arranged on the upper end surface of the base, a polishing device is arranged in the first chute, a second chute is arranged on one side of the first chute, an adjusting device is arranged in the second chute, the adjusting device comprises a double-head screw, the double-head screw is rotationally connected with the second chute, one end of the double-head screw is connected with a rocker, the surfaces of the two ends of the double-head screw are in threaded connection with a slide bar, the inner part of the slide bar is rotationally connected with a rotating column, two rotating columns are respectively provided with a fixed frame at one end, which is close to each other, one side of the adjusting device is provided with a rotating device, one side of the upper end of the base is provided with a fan, the upper end of the fan is provided with an exhaust tube, and one end of the exhaust tube is provided with a gas collecting hood.

title_en: Stepped opening screen-free printing screen
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a stepped opening knotless printing screen plate, which comprises a screen frame and a metal wire mesh, wherein the metal wire mesh is stretched on the screen frame through a stretching wire mesh, the metal wire mesh is formed by mutually intersecting and weaving a plurality of metal warps and metal wefts, a screen coating film layer is coated on the paste printing side of the metal wire mesh, a printing side coating film layer is coated on the screen coating film layer, a screen film wire slot arranged on the screen coating film layer corresponds to a paste printing film wire slot on the printing side coating film layer, and the slot width b of the screen film wire slot is larger than the slot width a of the paste printing film wire slot; the spacing between adjacent wires of the metal warp or the metal weft comprises a single wire spacing w and a double wire spacing L, wherein the double wire spacing L is an integral multiple of the single wire spacing w; the intermediate interlayer wire groove and the film pasting wire groove are positioned between two adjacent wires with the wire spacing of the wire spacing W or the wire spacing L. The screen printing plate without the screen knots can prevent silk thread cross screen knots from occurring in screen printing wire slot areas, and is more suitable for fine printing of solar cells.

title_en: Industrial digital spray head mounting structure and printing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of printing devices and discloses an industrial digital spray head mounting structure and printing equipment, wherein the industrial digital spray head mounting structure comprises a spray head, a bottom plate, a first limit column and a second limit column, a mounting hole is formed in the bottom plate, the spray head is mounted in the mounting hole along a first direction, a plurality of mounting reference surfaces extending along the first direction are arranged on the side wall of the spray head, the first limit column is arranged on the bottom plate and is in one-to-one corresponding abutting connection with the mounting reference surfaces, the second limit column is arranged on the bottom plate and can be close to or far from the spray head in a second direction, the second limit column can be abutted to the spray head, and the first direction is perpendicular to the second direction. The beneficial effects of the utility model are as follows: the whole installation structure is simple, the positioning is convenient, the installation strength is reliable, the installation can be stably completed without other auxiliary equipment, and the aims of reducing cost and enhancing efficiency can be effectively achieved.

title_en: Finished product printing device for cosmetic packaging box
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of package printing and discloses a finished product printing device for a cosmetic packaging box, which comprises a lifting plate, wherein a limiting component is arranged at the top of the lifting plate, a fixing block I is arranged outside the limiting component, a rubber plate is arranged outside the limiting component, a sliding block I is arranged outside the limiting component, a sliding block II is arranged outside the limiting component, a supporting plate is fixedly connected to the top of the sliding block I, a connecting plate is fixedly connected to the outer part of the supporting plate, a rubber pad is fixedly connected to the outer part of the connecting plate, and a fixing plate II is fixedly connected to the top of the sliding block II. According to the utility model, the rotating plate is driven to rotate by the sliding slider II, so that the slider I slides on the surface of the sliding rail I by the rotation of the rotating plate, and the connecting plate is driven to move, so that the rubber pad is close to the rubber plate, and the effect of clamping and printing a plurality of packaging boxes is achieved.

title_en: Rotating shuttle mechanism of rotary template sewing machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rotating shuttle mechanism of a rotary template sewing machine, which comprises a rotating shuttle installation seat arranged below a frame, wherein the middle part of the rotating shuttle installation seat is provided with a rotating shuttle installation part, and a rotating base is arranged in the rotating shuttle installation part; 3 to 6 second adjusting grooves are uniformly formed in the side face of the rotating base, 3 to 6 bolt mounting grooves corresponding to the second adjusting grooves are formed in the side wall of the rotating shuttle mounting portion, and a second adjusting bolt matched with the second adjusting groove is arranged in each bolt mounting groove. According to the rotating shuttle mechanism, the fixed positions of the rotating shuttle mounting seat and the rotating base are adjusted through the second adjusting bolt, and the rotating machine head structure is matched to align the rotating center, so that the machining precision requirement of parts is greatly reduced, and the mounting and maintenance efficiency is improved.

title_en: Tobacco box line pressing humidifying device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a tobacco box line pressing humidifying device, which comprises a pair of side brackets, wherein a pair of connecting frames are detachably arranged between the pair of side brackets, the pair of side brackets and the pair of connecting frames are mutually matched to form a fixed frame, the pair of connecting frames are oppositely arranged, a plurality of atomizing spray heads are slidably arranged on the connecting frames, and the plurality of atomizing spray heads are connected with an external pump body through hoses; the water spraying device comprises a water spraying range limiting device, and is characterized by further comprising a surrounding and blocking assembly used for limiting the water spraying range, wherein the surrounding and blocking assembly is connected with the atomizing nozzle, the surrounding and blocking assembly comprises a protective cover detachably mounted on the atomizing nozzle and provided with a water spraying port, one end edge of the protective cover away from the atomizing nozzle is fixedly connected with a collecting bin, one end of the collecting bin, close to the protective cover, is provided with a water inlet, and a drain pipe used for draining water is connected in the collecting bin. According to the utility model, the two surfaces of the box paper are sprayed with water and humidified simultaneously by arranging the atomizing nozzles oppositely, so that the problem that single-sided humidification bursts during line pressing is avoided, and the surrounding of the atomizing nozzles can be blocked by arranging the protective cover, so that the overlarge water spraying range is prevented.

title_en: Waste recovery device of high-speed bag making machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a waste recycling device of a high-speed bag making machine, which comprises a cutting device, a recycling device and a material guide channel for connecting the cutting device and the recycling device; the cutting device comprises a cutting upper die and a cutting lower die, the cutting upper die comprises a cutting head and an ejector piece arranged in the middle of the cutting head, and the ejector piece can move relative to the cutting head along the cutting direction; the cutting lower die is provided with a material guide channel, the material guide channel is arranged corresponding to the ejector piece, the sectional area of the material guide channel is smaller than that of the cutting head, and the sectional area of the material guide channel is larger than that of the ejector piece; waste materials cut by the cutting device enter the recycling device through the material guide channel. The setting of ejector can avoid the waste material to stop in the mould and influence subsequent processing operation, is favorable to promoting production efficiency. And the scheme integrates two treatment modes of crushing and melting, different treatment recovery modes can be adjusted and selected according to actual recovery requirements, and the flexibility of equipment is improved.

title_en: Ink jet device of environment-friendly printing machine not easy to block
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of printer ink-jet, in particular to an environment-friendly printer ink-jet device which is not easy to block. The technical scheme is as follows: an environment-friendly printer ink-jet device which is not easy to block comprises a printer base, a protective shell, an ink-jet portal frame component, an ink-jet component and a paper conveying component; the top of printer base is provided with the protective housing, and protective housing and printer base's shell bolt fixed connection. According to the utility model, the vibration motor drives the ink box base and the ink box spray bin inside the ink box base to vibrate, the ink in the ink box spray bin is fully mixed, and the problem that a pipeline is blocked by sediments is effectively prevented, so that the problem that an ink-jet end of an existing printer ink-jet device is easily blocked by sediments due to the fact that the ink in the ink box is easy to precipitate after being kept stand for a long time is solved.

title_en: Cloth transfer device of water jet loom
