abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cloth transfer device of a water-jet loom, which comprises a transportation frame, wherein the inner wall of the transportation frame is rotationally connected with a transportation roller, the top end of the transportation frame is fixedly connected with a plurality of round rods, the outer wall of each round rod is fixedly connected with a plurality of circular rings, the outer wall of the bottom end of each circular ring is provided with a sliding groove, and the inner wall of each sliding groove is connected with a sliding block in a sliding way; the brush plate is formed by a plurality of scraping rods, scraps adhered to the upper portion of the cloth are scraped from the cloth through movement of the cloth, meanwhile, the scraping rods are pushed by resistance of horizontal movement of the cloth through the second buffer springs, the scraping rods push the sliding blocks to move, the sliding blocks squeeze the second buffer springs to buffer the distance between the scraping rods, the scraping rods are prevented from scratching the cloth, and when the sliding blocks move upwards, the scraping rods are pushed downwards by the second buffer springs, so that the scraping rods are always kept attached to the cloth, and the scraping rods are ensured to always scrape the scraps damaged by the cloth.

title_en: Fixed subassembly and spouting a yard device are used to power supply board card spouts sign indicating number
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fixing component for code spraying of a power supply board card and a code spraying device, which relate to the technical field of power supply board card processing equipment and comprise a fixing bottom plate, a mounting seat and a fixing mechanism, wherein cushion blocks are fixedly connected to four corners of the bottom of the fixing bottom plate, one side of the top of the fixing bottom plate is fixedly connected to the bottom of the mounting seat, the fixing mechanism comprises a second motor fixedly arranged on one side of the mounting seat, the output end of the second motor is fixedly connected with a bidirectional threaded rotating shaft, two ends of the bidirectional threaded rotating shaft are symmetrically and spirally connected with moving blocks, the tops of the two moving blocks are fixedly connected with moving plates, and one sides, close to each other, of the two moving plates are symmetrically and fixedly connected with a compression spring.

title_en: Transfer printing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a transfer printing device which comprises a pressing mechanism, a label feeding mechanism and a label collecting mechanism which are arranged on the pressing mechanism, and a positioning sensing assembly which is arranged on the label feeding mechanism in a sliding manner, wherein the label feeding mechanism and the label collecting mechanism are arranged on the left side and the right side of the pressing mechanism, and the positioning sensing assembly comprises a sliding block, a bracket connected with the sliding block, a receiver arranged at the upper end of the bracket, and a position sensor arranged at the lower end of the bracket. The label collecting mechanism is used for collecting the hot-pressed material strips, the label conveying mechanism is used for releasing the material strips, and the positioning sensing assembly is used for ensuring that the material strips are accurately aligned in the transfer printing process. The transfer printing device improves the transfer printing efficiency and reduces the labor intensity through the mutual matching of the mechanisms.

title_en: Protective structure of clothing flat sewing machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of clothing flat seaming machines, in particular to a protective structure of a clothing flat seaming machine, which comprises a flat seaming machine main body, wherein a cleaning mechanism is arranged at the top of the flat seaming machine main body, the cleaning mechanism comprises a brushing assembly, a water delivery assembly and a driving assembly, the brushing assembly comprises two groups of fixed plates arranged at two ends of the top of the flat seaming machine main body, moving grooves are formed in opposite surfaces of the fixed plates, threaded rods are rotationally connected to the inner sides of the moving grooves, moving blocks are connected to the outer sides of the threaded rods in a threaded manner, the moving blocks are in sliding connection with the moving grooves, one ends of the moving blocks are clamped with positioning plates through clamping mechanisms, sponge brushes are arranged at the bottoms of the positioning plates, and recovery boxes are arranged at one ends of one group of the fixed plates; the utility model has simple structure and convenient operation, is convenient for the staff to clean the working table surface at regular time, and reduces the labor capacity of the staff.

title_en: Dust collector of high accuracy printing machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a dust removing device of a high-precision printing machine, which belongs to the technical field of printing machine accessories, wherein a lifting device is arranged on a workbench, the lifting device is connected with a dust removing mechanism, the dust removing mechanism is positioned above a workbench conveyor belt, a shell is connected with the lifting device, an electric fan is arranged in the shell, an air outlet of the electric fan is communicated with the shell, install first fixing base and second fixing base in the casing, be connected with between first fixing base and the second fixing base and paste the device, be provided with the motor on the second fixing base, the motor output passes through bevel gear group and is connected with pasting the device transmission, has realized cleaing away the dust that macroparticle and adhesive force are strong, has avoided producing the fold when leading to the fact the tectorial membrane because of the unable clearance of dust.

title_en: Cutting equipment for fabric of western-style clothes
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a piece of western-style clothes fabric cutting equipment which comprises a cutting box body, wherein a supporting plate is arranged at the bottom of the inner wall of the cutting box body, a bottom plate is fixedly connected to the left side and the right side of the top of the supporting plate, and a small electric cylinder is fixedly connected to the top of the bottom plate. When cutting the surface fabric, start small-size electronic jar, electronic jar drives the gear plate and removes to the left side, gear plate drives gear one and rotates, gear one drives the transfer line and rotates, gear two drives gear two and reciprocates, it reciprocates to erect the gear and drives the lifter, the lifter drives the inboard upset of rotating the board, the chucking piece is driven to the inboard upset of rotating the board, chucking piece is turned to the inboard and chucking surface fabric is turned to the inboard, can cut the surface fabric, thereby the advantage of convenient use has been possessed, when clothing surface fabric cuts, compress tightly the surface fabric from upper direction downwardly, effectively prevented that the surface fabric from piling up in the middle and leading to clothing surface fabric processing failure, clothing surface fabric's machining efficiency has been increased.

title_en: Clothing sewing material feeding unit
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a garment sewing and feeding device which comprises an operation table, wherein a sliding plate is fixedly connected to one side surface of the operation table, a bottom plate frame is movably connected to one side surface of the sliding plate, a magnetic attraction piece is connected to the inside of the bottom plate frame in a buckling mode, a convex soft cushion is fixedly connected to one side surface of the bottom plate frame, a sliding rod is fixedly connected to one side surface of the bottom plate frame, and a U-shaped plate is movably connected to one side surface of the sliding rod. According to the utility model, the U-shaped plate is driven to move downwards through the output end of the air cylinder, so that the two convex cushions are close to each other, cloth placed between the two convex cushions is extruded from the middle to two sides by the convex cushions to be more smooth, the two magnetic attraction pieces are attracted with each other magnetically, the extrusion force between the two convex cushions is increased, the two ends of the extruded smooth cloth are clamped by the corrugated plates at the two sides, the flatness of the cloth during processing and transportation is integrally improved, the phenomenon that the cloth is folded and folded is prevented, and the continuous and stable sewing work of the clothing is ensured.

title_en: Full-automatic multicolor intelligent printing machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a full-automatic multicolor intelligent printing machine, which relates to the technical field of printing machines and comprises a printing machine body, wherein a protection mechanism comprises a fixing frame, a fixing groove, a round hole, a fixing rod, a connecting plate, a connecting groove and a protection box, the protection box is pulled upwards at the moment to drive the connecting plate to release the connection between the connecting plate and the fixing groove through the fixing rod, the protection box covers the operating panel, a worker can use the operating panel at the moment, when the printing machine is moved, the protection box is sleeved outside the operating panel, the connecting plate enters the fixing groove, the fixing rod is connected with the connecting groove through the round hole, the connecting plate is fixed inside the fixing groove, the protection box is installed at the moment, the operating panel is protected, and if the protection box collides with other objects in the moving process, the probability of damage of an indicator lamp on the operating panel is reduced, and the service life of the operating panel is prolonged.

title_en: Seal printer
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of printers and discloses a seal printer. The application discloses a seal printer, which comprises an equipment main body, wherein the upper end of the equipment main body is connected with a protection plate in a sliding way, the side surface of the protection plate is fixedly connected with a plurality of threaded holes, the side surface of the protection plate is fixedly connected with a magnetic attraction handle at the middle position of the adjacent threaded holes, then the position of the protection plate at the upper end of the equipment main body is limited by the magnetic attraction effect of the magnetic attraction handle and the metal on the surface of the equipment main body, the protection plate is prevented from shifting during the operation of the equipment, the protection plate is pulled to an initial position again after the operation is finished, a fixing bolt is inserted into the upper operation main body, then the fixing bolt is inserted into the threaded holes arranged on the surface of the protection plate, the fixing bolt is screwed, and the position of the equipment is fixed.

title_en: Batch stamping device
abstract_en: The batch stamping device effectively solves the problem that financial staff has higher working strength when stamping a plurality of files; the device comprises a base, wherein the left end and the right end of the base are respectively provided with a U-shaped rod, the upper end of the U-shaped rod is rotationally connected with a rectangular block, the rectangular block is slidably connected with pressing plates in the vertical direction, a flat plate is arranged between the two pressing plates, an upper axial cylinder and a lower axial cylinder are arranged on the flat plate, the rear side of the base is provided with a U-shaped plate, the front end of the U-shaped plate is provided with an inkpad box with a forward opening, the lower side of the U-shaped plate is rotationally connected with a left axial rotating shaft and a right axial rotating shaft, the left end and the right end of the rotating shaft are respectively provided with swinging rods in the front-rear direction, the front end of each swinging rod is hinged with the pressing plates on the corresponding side of the swinging rods, the left end of the base is provided with a left rotating disc and right axial rotating turntable, the left end of each turntable is hinged with a connecting rod, and the free end of each connecting rod is hinged with the front end of the swinging rod on the left side; the utility model has ingenious conception and convenient use, reduces the working strength of the staff when stamping a plurality of files, and increases the working efficiency of the staff.

title_en: Waste discharging mechanism of dotter
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of dotters, in particular to a waste discharging mechanism of a dotter, which structurally comprises a machine body, the dotter, a controller and a workbench, wherein waste is adsorbed into the waste discharging mechanism through the arrangement of the waste discharging mechanism and is adsorbed into the waste discharging mechanism through the arrangement of a negative pressure device, and when an infrared detector detects that the waste is piled up, a second motor is started to rotate a baffle plate to enable the waste to pass through, the baffle plate is matched with a movable plate, the movable plate contacts with an inductor, an alarm is given out to remind a worker of discharging, so that the problem that the waste in a material collecting box is piled up and overflowed out and is waste in the machine body is solved.

title_en: Printing net frame of printing machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of net racks, in particular to a printing net rack of a printing machine, which comprises a bottom plate and net rack components symmetrically fixed on the side edge of the upper side surface of the bottom plate; the grid assembly comprises a bearing seat fixed on the side part of the upper side surface of the bottom plate, a shaft rod movably arranged in the bearing seat, a grid body fixed on the peripheral side of the shaft rod, fixing pieces fixed on the edge of the lower side surface of the grid body at equal intervals, heating strips arranged between the fixing pieces, a control box fixed on the end part of the upper side surface of the grid body, and an output shaft of a motor fixed with one end of the shaft rod; the turntable is arranged in the middle of the lower side surface of the bottom plate, the net rack assembly is arranged to carry printed products after printing, the printed products are heated through heat conduction of the heating strips, air drying of the printed products is accelerated, meanwhile, the positions of the two net rack assemblies are switched, continuous transfer of the printed products is facilitated, the net rack body is turned over, and the dried printed products are conveniently transferred to a subsequent conveying device.

title_en: Internal-light double-spray coating cloth
abstract_en: The utility model provides an internal-light double-spray coating cloth which is characterized by comprising a base cloth layer based on polyester materials, wherein two layers of coating layers are respectively coated on the front side and the back side of the base cloth layer, a single-side coating layer is divided into two layers of a primer layer and an ink absorption layer, and each coating layer is processed in a mode of scraping the coating layer by a knife.

title_en: Safe button sewing machine for clothing production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of button sewing machines, and discloses a safe button sewing machine for clothing production, which comprises a workbench, two longitudinal grooves are formed in the upper surface of the workbench, and longitudinal frames are connected inside the two longitudinal grooves in a sliding mode. The utility model has the following advantages and effects: through the first threaded rod and the second threaded rod that set up, can realize the purpose of adjusting the longitudinal position and the transverse position of cloth, reached the effect of carrying out the button sewing to the position of the different regions of surface fabric, avoid the workman to remove the process of surface fabric and with the contact of button sewing machine by hand simultaneously, intensity of labour has been reduced, the security has been improved simultaneously, the spaced homogeneity of button sewing and degree of accuracy have been guaranteed again, can realize tightening and fixing the cloth of different width through splint and the two-way threaded rod that set up, avoid the in-process of button sewing, the condition of taking place the surface fabric fold, through the air cock that sets up, can clean the surface fabric surface in advance, avoid the surface fabric surface to have harder impurity.

title_en: Multifunctional rain trousers heat-sealing and cutting device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a multifunctional rain trousers heat-seal cutting device which comprises a mounting large plate, a ironing knife, a cutter and a lifting mechanism, wherein the ironing knife is U-shaped and is connected with the mounting large plate, the cutter is U-shaped and is connected with the mounting large plate, the ironing knife is sleeved outside the cutter and is arranged at intervals, and the lifting mechanism is linked with the mounting large plate. The beneficial effects of the utility model are as follows: the multifunctional rain trousers heat seal cutting device has the advantages of high efficiency, convenient operation, low cost, convenient maintenance and the like.

title_en: Polishing device for edges of paper boards of cartons
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a polishing device for the edges of paper boards of cartons, which relates to the technical field of carton processing and comprises the following components: the dust collector comprises a bottom plate, a placing table is fixedly connected to the top of the bottom plate, a pressing plate is fixedly connected to the output end of a cylinder, dust collection devices are arranged above a supporting frame, grooves are formed in the upper surface of the bottom plate and located on two sides of the placing table, rotating rods are arranged on the inner walls of the grooves, sliding blocks are sleeved on the outer side faces of the rotating rods, polishing frames are fixedly connected to the top of the sliding blocks, two rotating shafts are fixedly connected to the output ends of motors, and polishing belts are arranged on the outer side faces of the rotating shafts. Through having set up slider, clamp plate, grinding frame and polishing area, be convenient for polish the cardboard both sides of variation in size, improved the quality of polishing and the efficiency of polishing of cardboard, set up dust extraction and be convenient for collect the cardboard piece after polishing to reduced workman's work load, promoted the machining efficiency of cardboard.

title_en: Production equipment for producing sanitary wear capable of measuring body temperature
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of intelligent clothing production, and discloses a production device for producing a sanitary wear capable of measuring body temperature, which comprises a workbench and a temperature measuring device, wherein a pressing device is arranged on the workbench and is used for pressing cloth; a second bracket is fixedly connected to the workbench, and a suture device is arranged on the second bracket and is used for sewing the temperature measuring device on the fabric; the side wall of the second bracket is fixedly connected with a fourth bracket which is L-shaped, and a punching device is arranged on the fourth bracket and is used for punching on the fabric; the temperature measuring device comprises a base, the upper surface of the base is fixedly connected with a display, button-type temperature recorders are fixedly arranged on the upper surface and the lower surface of the base, and the button-type temperature recorders are electrically connected with the display, so that automatic production of the sweater capable of measuring body temperature is realized.

title_en: Reed structure with gradual change distribution
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of production of dipped cord fabrics, in particular to a reed structure with gradual change distribution, which comprises the following components: a first reed beam; a second reed beam; a plurality of reeds arranged between the first reed beam and the second reed beam in parallel with each other, wherein each reed is perpendicular to the length direction of the first reed beam or the second reed beam; the reed comprises a plurality of reed arranging areas, wherein the reed arranging areas are divided into a plurality of areas along the arrangement direction of the plurality of reeds, and each area comprises a middle area at a middle position and 1-n side areas symmetrically arranged from the middle area to two sides. The reed is divided into a plurality of areas, the areas gradually decrease from the center to the two sides, the density of the reed also gradually decreases from the center area to the two sides, the gradual reed distribution ensures that the warp density is approximately thin from the middle to the two sides, but the transition of each area is uniform, and the gum dipping cord formed in the way can effectively solve the problem of uneven local warp density of the cord fabric, especially uneven warp density at the edge.

title_en: Silk degumming and dissolving device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a silk degumming and dissolving device, and belongs to the technical field of silk treatment. The utility model provides a silk dissolving device that comes unstuck, includes the dissolving tank, and the dissolving tank internal fixation is provided with the heating piece that is used for the heating, still includes: rotating a rotating shaft arranged in the dissolving tank, wherein a second dissolving cavity is formed in the dissolving tank, a second stirring frame is fixedly arranged on the rotating shaft, the second stirring frame is rotatably arranged in the second dissolving cavity, a scraping plate is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the second stirring frame, and the scraping plate is propped against the inner bottom of the second dissolving cavity; a discharge pipe communicated with the second dissolution cavity is fixedly arranged on the dissolution tank, and a valve is fixedly arranged on the discharge pipe; according to the utility model, the second stirring frame is rotatably arranged in the second dissolving cavity, so that on one hand, the mixing of the dissolving agents can be quickened, the occurrence of precipitation is prevented, and on the other hand, the scraping plate on the second stirring frame can scrape the residues adhered to the bottom in the second dissolving cavity, thereby facilitating the cleaning of the second dissolving cavity and improving the use effect.

title_en: Vibration cotton feeding box
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of non-woven equipment, and provides a vibrating cotton feeding box, which comprises a box body, wherein a conveying pipe is communicated with the top of the box body, a first conveying belt is arranged at the bottom of the conveying pipe in the box body, the conveying tail end of the first conveying belt is connected with a second conveying belt which is obliquely arranged, one end of the second conveying belt, which is far away from the first conveying belt, is connected with a material guide plate which is obliquely arranged, the bottom of the material guide plate is connected with a vibrating plate, one side, which is far away from the second conveying belt, of the vibrating plate is relatively provided with an adjustable cotton blocking barrier, one end, which is far away from the material guide plate, of the vibrating plate is connected with a third conveying belt, and the conveying tail end of the third conveying belt extends to the outer side of the box body; the first material beating licker-in is rotatably arranged in the box body and is close to the material conveying side of the second conveying belt, and the second material beating licker-in is rotatably arranged in the box body and is close to the material guide plate. The utility model solves the problems that the adjustment of the vibration feeding gap of the vibrating plate in the cotton feeding box is troublesome and even can not be adjusted at present.

title_en: Thermoprinting machine for plastic products
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of plastic part production of washing machines, in particular to a thermoprinting machine for plastic products, which comprises a moving mechanism for conveying plastic parts of the washing machines during thermoprinting, wherein a clamping mechanism for fixing the plastic parts of the washing machines is arranged on the upper side of the moving mechanism. The utility model utilizes the lifting frame to drive the heating seat to move downwards, then enables the two supporting rollers to roll and stretch the heating belt on the washing machine plastic part through the supporting rods, then can carry out thermoprinting treatment on the washing machine plastic part with a curved surface structure, utilizes the lifting spring and the lifting cylinder telescopic part on the lifting frame to retract to drive the lifting frame to move upwards along the guide frame, and then can prevent thermoprinting paper from being offset printed to cause damage when the heating belt is lifted upwards.

title_en: Mobile digital printer
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of printers and discloses a mobile digital printer which comprises a mounting plate, wherein the right end of the upper side of the mounting plate is fixedly connected with a printer main body, the left end of the upper side of the mounting plate is fixedly connected with a drying box, the front end and the rear end of the drying box are both rotationally connected with rotating shafts, the lower ends of the rotating shafts are both fixedly connected with impellers, the upper ends of the rotating shafts are both fixedly connected with belt pulleys corresponding to the upper side of the drying box, the belt pulleys are connected through a belt, and the rear end of the upper side of the drying box is fixedly connected with a supporting seat. According to the utility model, the impeller rotates to generate wind, and the generated wind carries heat generated by the heating lamp to contact with the printed text, so that the drying of printing ink is accelerated, the blurring caused by friction generated during stacking is avoided, the connecting rod and the rotating piece drive the shell to descend, the roller is contacted with the ground, the printer is supported up, the printer is convenient to move, and the roller can be retracted when the printer is not used.

title_en: Tablecloth flat sewing machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tablecloth sewing machine which comprises a material table, wherein a sewing machine is fixedly arranged on the outer surface of the upper end of the material table, lug plates are fixedly arranged on the left side and the right side of the outer surfaces of the two ends of the material table, a needle head and a lifting rod are arranged at one end of the outer surface of the lower end of the sewing machine, a needle moving groove is formed in one end of the outer surface of the upper end of the material table, the needle moving groove is positioned below the needle head, a presser foot is detachably connected with the outer surface of the lower end of the lifting rod, and comprises a concave presser foot, a guide block, a chamfer, a mounting groove, a pressing shaft, a connecting shaft, a gasket, a screw rod, a thread groove and a compression spring, and the thread groove is formed in the middle of the outer surface of the lower end of the lifting rod. According to the tablecloth sewing machine, the stability of the presser foot after installation can be improved through the arranged gasket and the compression spring, the friction force between the cloth and the presser foot is reduced conveniently through the arranged pressing shaft, and the tablecloth can conveniently travel on the outer surface of the lower end of the presser foot.

title_en: Automatic control device for front and rear operation panel of fur machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of sewing equipment, in particular to an automatic control device for front and rear operating panels of a fur machine. The machine comprises a machine body, one side fixedly connected with stitch of organism, one side fixedly connected with crochet hook that the organism is close to the stitch, the needle bar is installed to one side that the organism is close to the crochet hook, one side fixedly connected with second motor that the organism is close to the stitch, the output fixedly connected with back pay-off carousel of second motor, one side that the organism is close to the stitch is equipped with adjusting structure, adjusting structure includes the slide rail, the inner wall sliding connection of slide rail has the sliding plate, the upper surface fixedly connected with lead screw of sliding plate. The automatic control device for the front and rear operating panels of the fur machine has the advantages that a person can conveniently adjust the distance between the front feeding turntable and the rear feeding turntable, so that the device can convey cloth with different thicknesses, and the application range of the device is improved.

title_en: MLCC printing electrode automated inspection bad device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic defect detection device for an MLCC printing electrode, which comprises a workbench, detection brackets, a defect detection mechanism, an automatic labeling machine and a label induction mechanism, wherein the detection brackets are arranged on the workbench and positioned at two sides of the running direction of a PET film; the automatic labeling machine has the advantages that the defective position is automatically detected by the defective detection mechanism, the automatic labeling machine labels the defective position, after the defective label is detected by the label sensing mechanism, signals are fed back to the controller to stop and alarm, and production is continued after defective products are removed, so that outflow of defective products is reduced.

title_en: Spinning box
abstract_en: The utility model provides a spinning box body. The spinning manifold includes: the spinning machine comprises a bottom plate, wherein a spinning box is arranged at the top of the bottom plate, a miniature refrigerating device is fixedly arranged on the outer wall of the front end of the spinning box, a spinning pump is fixedly arranged on the outer wall of the left end of the spinning box, a spinning nozzle is fixedly arranged at a liquid outlet of the spinning pump, the spinning nozzle penetrates through the spinning box, an exhaust pipe is fixedly arranged at the top of the spinning box, and a cooling box is arranged in the spinning box. The spinning box body provided by the utility model is easy to break due to a certain tensile force when the temperature is too high during the spinning is just processed, so that the cooling measure can be continuously carried out on the just processed spinning through the mutual matching of components such as the miniature refrigerating device, the refrigerating plate, the motor, the second rotating shaft, the first belt pulley, the belt, the second belt pulley, the round rod, the fan and the like, so that the spinning cannot be broken by pulling and the production efficiency is not influenced.

title_en: Keyboard printing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses keyboard printing equipment, which comprises a processing table, wherein one side of the processing table is connected with a fixing frame for fixing a material box through bolts, a guide pipe for conveying printing materials in the material box to a printing plate is fixed on one side of the material box through screws, an electric telescopic rod for driving the printing plate to move is fixed on the inner part of the fixing frame through screws, a servo motor for driving a driving sleeve outside a screw rod to transversely move is fixed on the outer part of the processing table through screws, a driving rod for driving a placing frame to move is welded on the outer side of the driving sleeve, and a driving motor for driving the screw rod to rotate is fixed on the outer side of the placing frame through screws; according to the utility model, the problems that the existing keyboard printing equipment is inconvenient to clamp and fix a keyboard when in use, the keyboard is easy to shake during printing, the position of the keyboard is inconvenient to adjust, and the printing efficiency of the keyboard is low are solved through the servo motor, the driving motor, the threaded rod, the screw rod, the positioning clamp A, the positioning clamp B, the ball, the limiting groove and the driving rod.

title_en: Thermoprinting device suitable for processing plastic engine oil cover
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a thermoprinting device suitable for processing a plastic engine oil cover, and belongs to the technical field of plastic engine oil cover processing equipment. The thermoprinting device suitable for processing the plastic engine oil cover comprises a frame, a material storage device, a manipulator, a thermoprinting device A, a thermoprinting device B and a conveying plate chain; the frame is provided with a conveying plate chain; a plurality of supporting seats are uniformly arranged on the outer surface of the conveying plate chain; a material storage device is arranged above one end of the conveying plate chain; a mechanical arm is arranged on the rack at one side of the material storage device; a thermoprinting machine A is arranged on a frame at one side of the manipulator; a thermoprinting machine B is arranged on the frame at one side of the thermoprinting machine A; the thermoprinting machine A and the thermoprinting machine B are respectively positioned at two sides of the conveying plate chain. The thermoprinting device suitable for processing the plastic engine oil cover solves the problem that the existing thermoprinting device has low working efficiency when finishing thermoprinting work of the plastic engine oil cover, and is particularly suitable for thermoprinting the plastic engine oil cover.

title_en: Cotton polyester elastic twill double-faced fabric
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of textile fabrics, and provides cotton-polyester elastic twill double-sided fabric, which solves the problems of low water absorbability and low softness of the existing double-sided elastic fabric and comprises a fabric main body, wherein the fabric main body is formed by interweaving warp yarns and weft yarns, the weft yarns are formed by combining and twisting an elastic fiber and a combed yarn, the warp yarns comprise first warp yarns and second warp yarns, the first warp yarns, the second warp yarns and the weft yarns respectively form a surface texture and a lining texture according to twill weave, the first warp yarns are formed by combining and twisting two combed yarns, the second warp yarns are formed by combining and twisting a polyester fiber and a combed yarn, the twisting direction of the first warp yarns is the same as the slant of the surface texture, the twisting direction of the second warp yarns is opposite to the slant of the lining texture, the surface texture and the lining texture are respectively formed by the first warp yarns, the second warp yarns and the weft yarns according to the twill weave, the surface texture is high in softness, and the lining texture wear resistance is high, and the cotton-polyester fabric can be used differently.

title_en: Continuous paper box binding mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of carton binding, in particular to a continuous carton binding mechanism, when the continuous carton binding mechanism is used, a worker carries out carton continuous stapling through a binding assembly, when the height of the binding assembly needs to be adjusted, the worker operates the cooperation of a lifting assembly and a rack to enable a square tube to be adjusted in height on a stand column, and in the height adjustment process of the square tube, one person can realize the height adjustment of the binding assembly, so that convenience is improved; including base, stand, spout and rack, the base top is provided with the stand, and the right-hand member of stand is provided with the spout, installs the rack in the spout, still includes side pipe, opening, lifting unit and binding assembly, and side pipe slip-on suit is in the outside of stand, is provided with the opening on the side pipe, is provided with lifting unit on the side pipe, and the top right part of side pipe is provided with binding assembly.

title_en: Horizontal tow oiling machine
abstract_en: The horizontal tow oiling machine comprises a mounting frame, an oiling roller and a driving system for driving the oiling roller to rotate, wherein a roller shaft of the oiling roller is arranged on the mounting frame in a lifting and falling mode, a scraping plate system for oiling the roller surface of the oiling roller is arranged above the oiling roller, and tows pass through the lower portion of the oiling roller and are in contact with the roller surface; the scraper system comprises a scraper fixedly arranged above the oiling roller, the scraper is provided with a diversion slope surface which enables oil to flow to the roller surface of the oiling roller, the diversion slope surface is opposite to the rotation direction of the oiling roller, and an included angle of 80-100 degrees is formed between the diversion slope surface and the tangent line of the oiling roller; the oil feeding amount is controlled by controlling the distance between the roller surface and the scraping plate, and the device has the advantages of simple structure, convenient operation and good use prospect.

title_en: Positioning fixture for leather embroidery
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a positioning fixture for leather embroidery, which belongs to the technical field of leather processing and comprises a first supporting plate, wherein an embroidery panel is arranged on the top surface of the first supporting plate, a supporting bar is fixedly arranged on the bottom surface of one end of the embroidery panel, and one end, far away from the supporting bar, of the embroidery panel is hinged with the first supporting plate. Through setting up first backup pad surface articulated embroidery panel, can make embroidery panel surface mounting with embroidery panel after the leather material erects embroidery work, the both sides of embroidery panel all are equipped with the clamping piece in addition, can utilize the draw-in groove on clamping piece surface to fix a position the centre gripping by the frame department of clamping piece with the both sides of leather material at embroidery panel, and convenient operation, overall structure's setting can conveniently let the leather material after the centre gripping location erect at embroidery panel's surface, then carry out embroidery work from the operation mouth, convenience when improving artifical embroidery, and then improve work efficiency, this simple structure makes of conveniently drawing materials simultaneously.

title_en: Impurity treatment device for purifying core pulp
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an impurity treatment device for purifying core pulp, which relates to the technical field of impurity treatment and comprises a pulp inlet pipe, a pulp storage barrel, a conveying pipe, a conveying control valve and an impurity detector, wherein one end of the conveying pipe is fixedly connected with a filter ball for filtering the core pulp, and the inner wall of the filter ball is rotatably connected with a cross sieve plate. According to the utility model, through the cooperation of the filter balls, the cross sieve plates, the positioning gears, the adjusting motors and the connecting belts, the cross sieve plates can be adjusted and rotated as required, the whole filtering efficiency of equipment can be kept by rotating the cross sieve plates under the condition that different filter plates do not need to be replaced, and the cleaning spray head, the electric push rod, the conveying hose and the cleaning mounting box are used in a cooperation manner, so that the cleaning spray head can quickly clean impurities on the cross sieve plates, and meanwhile, the cleaning spray head can adjust the cleaning angle, thereby ensuring the cleaning effect on the cross sieve plates.

title_en: Bearing mechanism of UV printer mesa
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of UV printers, in particular to a supporting mechanism of a table top of a UV printer, which comprises a mounting frame, a rotating plate and a moving plate, wherein a guide rail is arranged in the mounting frame, a moving block is arranged in the guide rail, the rotating plate is rotatably arranged between the moving blocks, and a telescopic plate is movably arranged in the rotating plate. The device utilizes the effect of inside pivoted plate position of convenient regulation mounting bracket and turned angle, has solved the adjustment that current uv printer supporting mechanism lacks angle and position, leads to the device of feeding unable realization feeding angle's regulation, influences the problem of the effect of printer work.

title_en: Paper products processing coloring device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a paper product processing and coloring device, which comprises: the support frame, fixed mounting are in support frame top U-shaped shell, set up jointly elevating system of U-shaped shell inner wall both sides, set up relatively the coloring mechanism and the stoving mechanism at elevating system top, the both sides of U-shaped shell inner wall still are provided with conveying mechanism jointly. Through one of them of start a plurality of water pumps for to a plurality of independent storage cavity, the inside material water of one of them is extracted, and the inside of hydrojet pipe is carried to the material water of extraction through the hose to from the inside blowout of a plurality of atomizer, through a plurality of water pumps and a plurality of independent storage cavity, effectively switch the colouring, thereby improved paper products processing colouring efficiency, blow in the inside of fixed shell with outside gas through the fan, gas is hot-blast through the heater strip production, hot-blast blows and breaks up on the arc deep bead, the hot-blast of breaking up blows on the paper products after spraying paint for the paper products after spraying paint are dried.

title_en: Wine box packaging and bonding device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of wine box packaging and bonding, and discloses a wine box packaging and bonding device which comprises a processing table and a mounting plate, wherein the upper part of the processing table is fixedly connected with a mounting frame, the right side of the upper part of the mounting frame is fixedly connected with a fan, the input end of the fan is fixedly connected with an air inlet, the output end of the fan is fixedly connected with a connecting pipe, the upper part of the mounting frame is fixedly connected with a heating box, the other end of the connecting pipe is fixedly connected inside the heating box, a heating wire is arranged inside the heating box, the left side outside the heating box is fixedly connected with a hose, the other end of the hose penetrates through the inside of the mounting frame and the mounting plate and is fixedly connected inside a guide pipe, and both sides of the lower part of the guide pipe are provided with air outlets. According to the utility model, the wine box with the bonded wine box is dried conveniently, the curing time of glue or other adhesives can be accelerated by drying, the strength of the bonded part is enhanced, and the production efficiency is improved.

title_en: Wet towel cutting machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wet towel cloth cutting machine, which comprises a conveyer belt bracket, a conveyer belt arranged on the conveyer belt bracket, a cutting device and a cutting device, wherein the cutting device is fixedly assembled at the top of the middle end of the conveyer belt bracket, the cutting device is arranged at the front end of the conveyer belt bracket, the middle part and the bottom of the front side of the conveyor belt bracket are sequentially provided with a first conveying roller and a second conveying roller, the first conveying roller and the second conveying roller are both positioned below the conveyor belt, and wet tissues sequentially bypass the rear lower side of the second conveying roller and the front side of the first conveying roller and then enter the conveyor belt; the cutting device comprises a cutting box, at least one cutting knife and a bracket for installing the cutting knife, the structure is novel, the operation is simple, the wet towel fabric is sequentially conveyed through the second conveying roller, the second conveying roller and the conveying belt, and the cutting knife at the side of the wet towel fabric are used for longitudinally and transversely cutting the wet towel fabric, so that the wet towel can be cut at equal intervals each time, the cutting efficiency is improved, and the practicability is improved.

title_en: Side cut lap former is used in non-woven fabrics production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a trimming and rolling machine for non-woven fabric production, which comprises a frame, two placing frames, rotating wheels, an upper concave block and a lower concave block, wherein the two placing frames are respectively and fixedly connected to the front side and the rear side of the top of the frame, the number of the rotating wheels is two, the rotating wheels are respectively and threadedly connected to the tops of the two placing frames, and the bottoms of the rotating wheels penetrate through and extend to the bottoms of the placing frames. According to the utility model, through the matched use of the frame, the placing frame, the rotating wheel, the upper concave block, the lower concave block, the round cavity, the edge cutter, the groove, the fixed block, the locking block, the jack, the cavity, the positioning mechanism, the vertical block, the inserted link, the tension spring, the adjusting mechanism, the pressing rod, the connecting block, the pushing column, the cylinder, the swinging rod, the extrusion column, the vertical hole, the transmission hole, the spring and the sliding column, the problem that after the non-woven fabric is processed by the edge cutting lap former, the situation that the cutting part of the edge cutting device is worn or blunt is in a cutting state in a long time is solved, and the subsequent non-woven fabric cutting problem is affected.

title_en: Curing device is used in production of melamine impregnated paper
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a curing device for melamine impregnated paper production, which comprises a workbench, wherein a bin body is fixedly arranged at the top of the workbench, an ultraviolet lamp is fixedly arranged in the bin body, a moving mechanism is arranged on the workbench, a rotating mechanism is arranged on the moving mechanism, and a driving mechanism is arranged on the bin body. This curing means is used in melamine impregnated paper production, the staff places impregnated paper on rotary mechanism earlier, then opens ultraviolet lamp and mobile mechanism, mobile mechanism drives rotary mechanism and impregnated paper and enters into the inside of the storehouse body, ultraviolet lamp solidifies impregnated paper, open actuating mechanism, do not mesh with rotary mechanism when actuating mechanism, rotary mechanism and impregnated paper can not rotate, mesh with rotary mechanism when actuating mechanism, rotary mechanism and impregnated paper can rotate, the even solidification of impregnated paper of being convenient for has improved the result of use.

title_en: Inner support bottom corner cutting mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an inner support base angle cutting mechanism which comprises an angle cutting station, wherein a base angle cutting device is arranged at the angle cutting station and comprises an inner support angle supporting inner lining part, a cutter matching part and an angle cutting oblique cutter, the angle cutting oblique cutter is matched with a cutter matching part in a cutting manner, and the angle cutting oblique cutter is in transmission connection with an oblique movement angle cutting driving device. The internal support cutting machine can find and cut the bottom corner of the internal support, the normal use of the internal support is not affected, the opening below the internal support can be broken through cutting the bottom corner, the opening below the internal support can be deformed smoothly, the subsequent internal support can be placed into a paper box smoothly, the internal wall of the paper box is not scratched or scratched (particularly when the internal part is provided with facial tissues or a coating) due to the tightening and opening state, the material supporting component is used for supporting the internal support, the internal support is convenient to place and is supported so as to cut the bottom corner in a beveling mode, the side clamping and pressing material can clamp the side wall of the internal support in a matched mode, so that the beveling bottom corner is smooth and stable, and the internal support deformation is prevented from affecting the beveling bottom.

title_en: Shearing machine for sisal yarn
abstract_en: The utility model is applicable to the technical field of sisal yarns, and provides a shearing machine for sisal yarns, which comprises a body, wherein a conveyor is arranged on the body, an adjusting component is arranged on the body, the adjusting component is movably connected with a shearing box, and the shearing box is communicated with a collecting box; the cyclone yarn cutting device comprises a cutting box, a conveyor, a limiting protection assembly, a cyclone blade, a limiting protection assembly, a collecting box, a regulating assembly and a cyclone blade, wherein the cyclone blade is fixedly connected with an output shaft of the driving assembly, the driving assembly is arranged on the lifting assembly, the lifting assembly is arranged on the cutting box, the limiting protection assembly is arranged on the lifting assembly, the conveyor intermittently conveys sisal yarns into the body, the limiting protection assembly abuts against the limiting sisal yarns, the driving assembly drives the cyclone blade to rotate to drain air, suction is generated on the surfaces of the sisal yarns so as to adsorb burrs on the surfaces of the sisal yarns, the burrs are separated from the sisal yarns, the burrs penetrate through the limiting protection assembly and are cut by the cyclone blade so as to be separated from the sisal yarns, and the burrs are conveyed into the collecting box through the collecting box, and the regulating assembly drives the cutting box to reciprocate linearly, so that the cyclone cutting device has the advantages of high efficiency, high quality and complete cutting.

title_en: Wrapping paper fluting device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a wrapping paper slotting device, which relates to the technical field of wrapping paper processing and comprises a main board, wherein both sides of the top end of the main board are respectively provided with a sliding groove, two sliding blocks are connected in the sliding grooves in a sliding manner, the top ends of the two sliding blocks are jointly fixed with a supporting plate, the inner threads of the supporting plate are connected with a stud, the bottom end of the stud is rotationally connected with a pressing plate, the top end of the main board is fixed with a support, a fixed block is arranged in the support, the outer side of the fixed block is provided with an adjusting structure for driving the fixed block to move, the top end of the fixed block is provided with a cylinder, and the output end of the cylinder penetrates through the bottom end of the fixed block and is fixed with the fixed plate. Through the operation of first telescopic link, can drive the frame and wholly carry out vertical movement to the slotting cutter that its bottom was equipped with vertical movement, through the operation of second telescopic link, drive fixed block lateral shifting, the slotting cutter lateral shifting that its bottom was equipped with makes the slotting cutter of the device can the adjustment position at will.

title_en: Edge folding device for paper packaging box production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a flanging device for paper packaging box production, which particularly relates to the technical field of packaging box flanging, and comprises two conveying parts, two second electric push rods, a flanging mechanism and a flanging mechanism, wherein a first conveying channel for conveying packaging boxes along a preset path is formed between the two conveying parts, the telescopic ends of the two second electric push rods are respectively connected with the two conveying parts, the two conveying parts are close to or far away from each other through the telescopic of the second electric push rods, the flanging mechanism comprises a push plate which moves back and forth relative to the packaging boxes, and the conveying parts for conveying the packaging boxes along the preset path are arranged.

title_en: Modified soaking treatment equipment for mica paper crude product
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mica paper crude product modification soaking treatment device which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a solution tank is fixed on the upper end face of the bottom plate, vertical plates are symmetrically fixed in the solution tank in a left-right mode, a bearing on each vertical plate is connected with a rotating shaft, mounting plates which are obliquely arranged are symmetrically connected in the solution tank in a front-back mode, the bearing on each mounting plate is connected with a pressing roller, a mounting frame is also fixed on the upper end face of the bottom plate, and electric telescopic rods are symmetrically fixed on the lower end face of the mounting frame in a left-right mode. This modified soaking treatment facility of mica paper crude adopts tilting mechanism, can make things convenient for placing and soaking treatment of mica paper, and the flattening mechanism of cooperation linkage both can realize the flattening effect of mica paper, can extrude the residual soaking agent in the mica paper again after soaking is accomplished to make things convenient for later stage mica paper drying and avoid the soaking agent extravagant, the stirring mechanism of cooperation linkage again can make things convenient for mica paper and soaking agent fully to contact, guarantees the soaking effect.

title_en: Inclined line net type printing gravure
abstract_en: The application provides an inclined line net type printing gravure which comprises a panel and a plurality of single net holes arranged on the panel, wherein each single net hole is recessed downwards by a preset depth, and each single net hole is obliquely arranged. According to the application, the single net hole is obliquely arranged, so that the length of the single net hole is increased, the ink holding capacity of the single net hole is ensured, the depth of the single net hole can be reduced, and the transfer efficiency of the ink is ensured. The method is suitable for printing fine characters, greatly reduces the addition of solvents in the printing production process, reduces the discharge of volatile organic compounds in the solvents, improves the safety of products, reduces the atmospheric pollution and has higher social benefit.

title_en: Paper feeding positioning mechanism of paper cutter for processing packaging box
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a paper feeding and positioning mechanism of a paper cutter for processing packaging boxes, which relates to the technical field of paper cutters, and comprises a bottom plate, wherein supporting legs are symmetrically arranged on the lower surface of the bottom plate, vertical plates are symmetrically arranged on the upper surface of the bottom plate, a transmission assembly is arranged on the upper surface of the bottom plate between the two vertical plates, the utility model discloses a paper cutting machine, including riser, fixed plate, hydraulic pressure paper cutting subassembly, riser, locating component is provided with on the side that the riser leans on the inside, the one end of riser is provided with the L template, the end of L template horizontal surface is provided with the fixed plate, the riser both sides are provided with the mount, be provided with hydraulic pressure paper cutting subassembly on the mount. According to the utility model, the purpose of controlling the width of the cut packaging paper is achieved through the cooperation of the transmission assembly, the limiting assembly and the hydraulic paper cutting assembly.

title_en: Carding roller of spinning machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a carding roller of a spinning machine, wherein an angle adjusting mechanism comprises a positioning ring which is rotationally connected to the outer wall of a positioning sleeve, one side of the outer wall of the positioning ring is fixedly provided with a toothed ring, the edge of the outer wall of the positioning ring is fixedly connected with a positioning plate, the top of the positioning plate is rotationally connected with a movable handle, one end of the movable handle penetrates through one side of the positioning plate and is fixedly connected with a gear, the outer wall of the gear is meshed with the outer wall of the toothed ring, one end of the outer wall of the positioning sleeve is penetrated and provided with a plug pin, the outer wall of the plug pin is sleeved with a first spring, and the outer wall of one end of the plug pin is fixedly provided with a limiting ring.

title_en: Protection mechanism for wireless jacquard needle
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of textile machinery, and particularly relates to a protection mechanism for a wireless jacquard needle, which comprises a wireless jacquard needle comb seat, a protection cover which is detachably arranged on the bottom surface of the upper half end of the wireless jacquard needle comb seat and used for protecting a control circuit and electronic components in the wireless jacquard needle comb seat, a protection plate which is detachably arranged on the top surface of the lower half end of the wireless jacquard needle comb seat and used for preventing the contact surface of the wireless jacquard needle comb seat from being worn, and the like. The utility model uses the protection mechanism (the guard board and the protection cover), the working environment of the wireless jacquard needle is more stable and reliable, the influence of external factors on the work of the wireless jacquard needle can be reduced, and the performance and the reliability of the wireless jacquard needle are improved.

title_en: Warping machine convenient for replacing cylinder
abstract_en: The utility model provides a warping machine convenient for replacing a cylinder, which relates to the technical field of warping equipment and comprises a machine body, wherein an adjusting component and a locking component are arranged in one side of the machine body, a wire guide roller is arranged on the machine body through the locking component and the adjusting component, the adjusting component comprises a concave installation seat arranged in the machine body, a sliding groove is formed in the edge of the upper end surface of the concave installation seat, a sliding plate is arranged in the sliding groove in a sliding manner, an annular seat is arranged at the top of the sliding plate, a bearing seat is embedded in the annular seat, and the locking component is arranged at the top of the annular seat.

title_en: Automatic tectorial membrane conveyer of tile formula carton
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of paper box film coating and discloses an automatic film coating and conveying device for tile-shaped paper boxes, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein two mounting plates are fixed on the top surface of the bottom plate, a fixing plate is fixed between the two mounting plates, a second electric push rod is fixed at the bottom of the fixing plate, a concave plate is fixed at the telescopic end of the second electric push rod, a second driving motor is fixed at the bottom of the concave plate, a plurality of fan blades are fixed at equal angles on the outer wall of the output end of the second driving motor, and an extrusion cylinder is rotatably arranged in the concave plate. According to the utility model, the surface of the tile-shaped paper box is heated through the heating cylinder, so that the film is more fit, and the second electric push rod drives the extrusion cylinder to press the film, so that bubbles are removed, the waterproof performance and the overall quality of the product are further improved, the manual operation requirements are reduced in the automatic stretching, heating, cooling and pressing processes, the production flow is accelerated, and the working efficiency of the production line is improved.

title_en: Consumption reduction mechanism for paper printing tectorial membrane
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of paper printing, and discloses a consumption reducing mechanism for paper printing tectorial membrane, which comprises a printer shell, wherein a printing plate is detachably arranged on the inner bottom surface of the printer shell, a lifting folded plate is slidably arranged in the printer shell, a printing roller is rotatably arranged in the lifting folded plate, two connecting strips are fixed on one side of the lifting folded plate, a mounting plate is fixed between the two connecting strips, a plurality of warm air heaters are arranged on the top surface of the mounting plate, a sliding opening is formed in the top surface of the printer shell, a sliding strip is slidably arranged in the sliding opening, and two cylinders are fixed on the top surface of the sliding strip. In the utility model, in the process, the heating fan in the working state heats the printing paper and the coating film on the printing paper, so that the shrinkage fit of the coating film and the printing paper is quickened, and in the whole processing process, the proportion of manual operation is increased under the condition of not influencing the processing, and the consumption of electric energy is reduced.

title_en: Drying device of color printer
abstract_en: The utility model provides a drying device of a color printing machine, which comprises a shell, wherein a material inlet and a material outlet are respectively arranged on the shell, mounting frames are fixedly arranged at two ends of the outer part of the shell, guide rollers are rotatably arranged on the mounting frames, a purifying mechanism is arranged on the shell and comprises a shell and an air inlet end, a plurality of groups of shells are fixedly arranged at the top of the shell, and a plurality of groups of air inlet ends are respectively arranged at the material inlet and the material outlet inside the shell. When the drying device is used, through the installation of the shell and the air inlet ends, along with the use of the device, the air at the material inlet and the material outlet can be sucked by the multiple groups of air inlet ends and is discharged outwards after being purified by the purifying box in the shell, so that peculiar smell generated by ink evaporation in the drying process of the device cannot be diffused to the outside of the device from the inside of the drying device, the external working environment and the physical health of operators are influenced, and the practicability and the use safety of the drying device are improved.

title_en: Broken yarn detection equipment for fiber polyester viscose cloth
abstract_en: The utility model discloses broken yarn detection equipment for fiber polyester viscose cloth, and relates to the technical field of broken yarn detection. Comprises a bracket base, wherein the front wall and the rear wall of the bracket base are provided with supporting frames connected through adjusting components, the inner wall of the upper end of the supporting frame is fixedly connected with a protective shell, the utility model compresses a pressing plate on the protective shell through a first spring and a telescopic sleeve rod to drive a detection shell on a first vertical plate to slide downwards along the protective shell, so that a photoelectric sensor in the detection shell can slide out of the protective shell, the detection device is used for detecting work, then presses the elastic piece again to separate from the bottom of the locking block, and enables the detection shell to shrink into the protection shell through elastic recovery of the first spring, so that a protection barrier can be provided, the photoelectric sensor is protected from mechanical damage such as accidental collision, impact or extrusion, the space on the device is reduced, and excessive space occupied by the device due to the fact that the sensor protrudes is avoided.

title_en: Yarn composite winding device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a yarn composite winding device which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a rotary plate is arranged above the bottom plate, the left end of the rotary plate is coaxially and fixedly connected with a rotating shaft, the upper end of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a vertical plate, the rotating shaft is rotationally connected with the vertical plate, a plurality of placing shafts are fixedly arranged at the non-center positions of the right end of the rotary plate, yarn barrels are sleeved outside the placing shafts, limiting mechanisms for limiting the yarn barrels are arranged on the placing shafts, a wire loop is arranged on one side, far away from the rotary plate, of the placing shafts, the wire loop is fixedly connected with the rotary plate through an L-shaped plate, a composite wire barrel is arranged on the right side of the rotary plate and is fixedly connected with the bottom plate through a fixing plate, a transmission shaft is rotationally connected between the vertical plate and the fixing plate, and the transmission shaft is in transmission connection with the rotation shaft through a transmission mechanism. The utility model has simple structure and convenient operation, and can not cause the condition of yarn loosening.

title_en: Automatic cutting device for artificial fiber for bath towel
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic artificial fiber cutting device for bath towels, which relates to the technical field of artificial fiber production and comprises a support frame, wherein a fixing plate is fixedly arranged at the top end of the support frame, rear connecting seats are fixedly arranged at two sides of the rear end of the fixing plate, a connecting rod is rotatably arranged in the rear connecting seats, a paying-off wheel is sleeved at equal angles on the outer ring of the connecting rod, and a tensioning and adjusting mechanism is arranged in the fixing plate. The paying-off wheel and the connecting rod in the automatic artificial fiber cutting device for the bath towel can rotate in the rear connecting seat, so that stable paying-off work is conveniently performed on the rolled artificial fibers, the tensioning adjustment mechanism can be set according to tensioning requirements of the artificial fibers, the phenomenon that the lengths of the artificial fibers are inconsistent in the subsequent cutting process is avoided, and the cutting effect and tensioning adaptability of the automatic artificial fiber cutting device for the bath towel are improved.

title_en: Cloth cutting machine suitable for warp knitting cloth
abstract_en: The application discloses a cloth cutting machine suitable for warp knitting cloth, which comprises a workbench, four supporting legs which are symmetrically arranged at the bottom of the workbench, a portal frame which is arranged at the top of the workbench, a driving component which is arranged on the workbench, and a plurality of cloth cutting tables which are symmetrically arranged on the driving component and are positioned at the upper side of the workbench, wherein the cloth cutting tables are used for placing warp knitting cloth, the cloth cutting tables are slidably arranged at the top of the workbench, a cutting component is arranged on the portal frame, the cutting component plays a role of cutting the warp knitting cloth, and the driving component can sequentially drive the cloth cutting tables to move to the lower side of the cutting component, so that the cutting component can cut the warp knitting cloth placed on the cloth cutting table.

title_en: Large-format double-sided printing machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a large-format double-sided printing machine which comprises a printing machine body and a flying unit arranged in the printing machine body, wherein a longitudinal paper feeding unit is arranged in the flying unit, a transverse paper feeding unit is arranged on the side surface of the longitudinal paper feeding unit, and the transverse paper feeding unit is used for feeding paper to the longitudinal paper feeding unit; the utility model has simple structure and reasonable design, realizes the stable lifting of the printing paper stack by arranging the longitudinal paper feeding unit, realizes the stable paper feeding of the printing paper stack by arranging the longitudinal paper feeding unit outside the paper feeding end of the printer body, avoids the direct paper feeding in the machine body, reduces the paper feeding difficulty, ensures that the printing paper stack can stably and accurately enter the longitudinal paper feeding unit by arranging the positioning unit, improves the paper feeding stability, and greatly reduces the paper feeding difficulty of large-format printing paper.

title_en: Crease-resistant textile fabric rolling machine for jean production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-wrinkling textile fabric rolling machine for jean production, which comprises a frame and rolling rollers, wherein mounting seats are welded on two sides of the top of the frame, a support plate is fixed on one side of each mounting seat, a rolling motor is arranged on the upper side of each mounting seat, and two groups of mounting seats are connected with auxiliary rollers through bearings. This crease-resist formula textile fabric machine of beating for denim production drives carousel unidirectional rotation through starting driving motor for the carousel drives push-and-pull rod rotary motion, thereby the push-and-pull rod can drive through the spout and dial the board and produce reciprocating swing effect round the rotation axis, make the first roller of flattening roller one side cambered surface and flattening roller one side planar second roller alternate with the surface fabric rolling contact, when flattening roller one side planar second roller contacted the surface fabric, the heat that the electric heating strip heating produced can transmit for the second roller, make the second roller intermittent type roll the surface fabric ironing, and then can eliminate the fold line on the surface fabric.

title_en: Leather shell machine convenient for edge covering
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of paper box production equipment, and particularly discloses a leather case machine convenient for edge wrapping, which comprises a conveying frame, edge pressing assemblies, an edge wrapping frame and a transmission assembly, wherein the edge pressing assemblies are arranged on two sides of the conveying frame and used for pressing and compacting leather cases needing edge wrapping, the edge wrapping frame is arranged at the front end of the conveying frame and used for supporting various parts, the transmission assembly is arranged on the inner side of the edge wrapping frame and used for wrapping two edges of the leather case, and through the arrangement of the edge pressing assemblies, the leather case can be compacted at the position where the leather case needs edge wrapping when the leather case is transported, the leather case is prevented from moving in the transportation process and is separated from the whole device, so that a production line is stopped when the device is processed, production loss of the production line is caused, the compactness between the leather case and the book case can be improved, convenience assistance is provided for edge wrapping, and edge wrapping efficiency is improved.

title_en: Self-cleaning printing jig
abstract_en: The utility model provides a self-cleaning printing jig, which relates to the technical field of chip printing and comprises a shell, a rotary bearing platform and a cleaning base, wherein a cleaning water inlet hole is formed in the cleaning base, the shell is arranged on the cleaning base, the rotary bearing platform is rotatably arranged at the top end of the shell and is provided with a bearing groove, the rotary bearing platform corresponds to the cleaning water inlet hole, and the cleaning water inlet hole sprays cleaning water and cleans the bearing groove. When in actual use, the bearing groove of the rotary bearing platform is upward at first, a device to be printed is placed, the conventional laser printing action is completed, after the device is removed, the rotary bearing platform can be rotated downward, and the bearing groove is cleaned by the cleaning water inlet hole, so that residual dust or foreign matters in the bearing groove are cleaned. Compared with the prior art, the laser marking device can clean residual dust or foreign matters after laser marking, and prevent dust from polluting devices.

title_en: Cylinder computer printing paper rotating bracket
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cylinder type computer printing paper rotating bracket which comprises a first base, wherein the top of the first base is fixedly connected with a first support plate, one side of the first support plate is fixedly connected with a mechanical box, the mechanical box is fixedly connected with a driving motor and is suitable for rotating auxiliary printing paper, a second base is suitable for replacing auxiliary printing paper, and the first base, the first support plate, the mechanical box, the driving motor, a rotating shaft, a fixing sleeve and a dust-proof plate are matched for use, so that the device can provide auxiliary force when facing heavier cylinder type computer printing paper, and the auxiliary cylinder type computer printing paper can roll to enable the printing paper to be output, so that the situation of breakage of the printing paper caused by excessive dragging of the printing paper is avoided, dust accumulation above the printing paper can be avoided, the cleanliness of the printing paper is protected, waste is avoided, and convenience and practicability of the device are improved as a whole.

title_en: Light and thin sun-proof fabric and sun-proof clothing using same
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a light and thin sun-proof fabric and sun-proof clothes using the same, which comprise a fabric body, wherein the fabric body is in two paths of one cycle, the two paths are six-needle one cycle, the 1 st path is woven into a first yarn, the 2 nd path is woven into a second yarn, the 1 st path and the 2 nd path are respectively formed by looping, and the first yarn and the second yarn comprise ultraviolet-resistant fibers. By adopting the technical scheme, the fabric has certain stiffness and is not thick and heavy due to the two-way one-cycle double-sided structure woven by the first yarn and the second yarn, the first yarn and the second yarn are provided with the ultraviolet-resistant fibers, so that the woven fabric has excellent ultraviolet resistance, in addition, the fabric is matched with the bamboo joints, so that the contact area between the fabric and skin is reduced when the fabric is worn, the air permeability is increased, and meanwhile, the medical stone fibers are added into the first yarn, so that the woven fabric has antibacterial property, and the wearing comfort is improved.

title_en: Indentation mechanism is used in corrugated case production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an indentation mechanism for corrugated paper box production, which comprises two inner side frames which are symmetrically arranged left and right, wherein a top plate is connected between the inner side frames, a pressing plate is arranged on the inner side frames, a wheel hole is formed in the pressing plate, wheel frames are respectively arranged on the left side and the right side of the wheel hole, guide wheels are rotatably connected between the wheel frames, outer side frames which relatively slide up and down are arranged on the outer sides of the inner side frames, outer armrests positioned at the top are arranged between the outer side frames, an inner armrest is arranged on the top plate, a rotating head is rotatably connected on the outer armrests, one end of the rotating head is provided with a rotating groove, the other end of the rotating head is connected with a stud, the stud is in threaded connection with the inner armrest, a main shaft is rotatably connected between the outer side frames, a follow-up pinch roller is arranged on the main shaft, and an adjusting hole for the main shaft to pass through and move up and down is formed on the inner side frames. The indentation mechanism has the characteristics of adjustable indentation depth and convenient adjustment, and has perfect overall function and strong practicability.
