title_en: Pressure accumulating type elastic bag body control mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model provides an accumulation type elastic bag body control mechanism which comprises a support, a pipe member, an elastic bag body, a displacement driving device and a pump body, wherein the pipe member is transversely or obliquely arranged in a sliding mode upwards relative to the support, the pipe member is provided with a hollow pipe body, the end part of the pipe body is provided with a plurality of through holes, the elastic bag body is sleeved outside the pipe body and covers the through holes, the opening end of the elastic bag body is sealed and fixedly arranged relative to the pipe body, the displacement driving device is used for driving the pipe member to move towards the outer end of the support, the end, provided with the through holes, of the pipe body is located outside the edge of the end part of the support, and the pump body is used for inputting fluid into the pipe body or extracting fluid in the pipe body. The pressure accumulating elastic bag body control mechanism utilizes the side wall of the inner cavity of the pipe body to buffer fluid.

title_en: High-strength corrugated medium
abstract_en: The utility model discloses high-strength corrugated medium paper which comprises a plurality of upper patches adhered to facial tissues and a plurality of lower patches adhered to bottom tissues, wherein the lower patches and the upper patches are arranged in a staggered mode, inclined support sheets are connected between the upper patches and the lower patches adjacent to the upper patches, a plurality of reinforcing components which are arranged at intervals along the length extending direction of the inclined support sheets are arranged between the adjacent inclined support sheets, each reinforcing component comprises a first reinforcing sheet connected with one inclined support sheet and a second reinforcing sheet connected with the other inclined support sheet, the second reinforcing sheets and the first reinforcing sheets are both connected onto the inclined support sheets in a rotating mode, first process holes are formed in the first reinforcing sheets, inserting sheets connected with the first reinforcing sheets are arranged in the first process holes, and inserting holes matched with the inserting sheets are formed in the second reinforcing sheets. The corrugated medium paper has the characteristics of strong pressure resistance and high structural strength, and is perfect in overall function and strong in practicability.

title_en: But automatic positioning UV flat-bed printer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic positioning UV flat printer which comprises a base, wherein a processing table is fixedly connected to the top of the base, an operation panel is arranged on the front end face of the base, a first driving assembly is arranged on one side of the top of the processing table, a second driving assembly is arranged on the first driving assembly, a printing assembly is arranged on the second driving assembly, a positioning assembly is arranged on the processing table, and a fixing assembly is arranged in the center of the base.

title_en: Cotton opener for cellulose production
abstract_en: The application relates to a cotton opener for cellulose production, which belongs to the technical field of textile machinery and comprises a shell, wherein a cotton inlet, a cotton outlet and a impurity outlet are formed in the shell, a blower is fixedly connected to the shell, a shifting-out groove is formed in one side wall of the shell, a sealing plate is arranged at the shifting-out groove, the sealing plate is in plug-in fit with the shifting-out groove, a clamping assembly for being clamped and fixed with the sealing plate is arranged at the shifting-out groove, a rotating shaft is arranged on the sealing plate, the rotating shaft penetrates through the sealing plate and is in rotary connection with the sealing plate, one end of the rotating shaft, far away from the sealing plate, penetrates through one side wall of the shell, far away from the shifting-out groove, is connected with a motor, an output shaft of the motor is fixedly connected with one end of the rotating shaft, a filter screen is arranged in the shell, a dodging groove is formed in the side wall of the shell, one end of the filter screen extends to the dodging groove, the filter screen is in sliding connection with the shell along the direction of the dodging groove, and the circumferential side wall of the rotating shaft is connected with a clapping plate.

title_en: Textile fabric humidifier
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a textile fabric humidifier, which comprises an operation table, wherein a support is arranged on the operation table, the support is L-shaped, an L-shaped vertical section of the support is fixedly connected with the rear end face of the operation table, an L-shaped transverse section of the support is arranged above the operation table, a humidifier and a dust removing component are arranged on the support, the humidifier is arranged above the operation table and is fixedly connected with the L-shaped transverse section of the support, the dust removing component comprises a slide way, a sliding motor, a sliding sweeping rod and a dust pushing component, the rear end face of the slide way is fixedly connected with the front end face of the L-shaped vertical section of the support, the sliding motor is fixedly connected with the slide way, the sliding sweeping rod is arranged above the operation table and is perpendicular to the slide way, the sliding sweeping rod is in sliding connection with the slide way through the sliding motor, the dust pushing component is arranged on the left side of the sliding sweeping rod and is parallel to the sliding sweeping rod, and the dust pushing component is fixedly connected with the slide way. The utility model has the beneficial effects that the utility model can partially humidify and remove dust on partial fabrics.

title_en: Automatic shearing and folding device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic shearing and folding device, which comprises a base, supporting legs, a conveying mechanism, a concave supporting plate, a first cylinder, a first piston rod, a cutter groove, a folding table, a guide plate, an upright post, a top plate, a fixing component and a folding component, wherein the lower part of the base is provided with a plurality of supporting legs, the front end above the base is provided with the conveying mechanism for conveying woven labels, the rear end of the conveying mechanism is provided with the concave supporting plate, the upper part of the concave supporting plate is provided with the first cylinder, the automatic fabric label cutting and folding machine comprises a concave supporting plate, a first piston rod is arranged below the concave supporting plate, the output end of the first cylinder penetrates through the concave supporting plate to be connected with the first piston rod, the tail end of the first piston rod is connected with a cutter, a cutter groove corresponding to the cutter is formed in a base, and a folding table is arranged at the rear end of the upper part of the base.

title_en: High-strength high-silica glass fiber grid cloth
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of glass fiber gridding cloth and discloses high-strength high-silica glass fiber gridding cloth which comprises weft yarns and warp yarns, wherein the weft yarns and the warp yarns are formed by first reinforced metal core yarns, first tensile layers, alkali-resistant core layers, high-silica protective layers, wear-resistant layers and alkali-resistant coatings, the inner cores of the weft yarns and the warp yarns are the first reinforced metal core yarns, the first tensile layers are arranged on the outer sides of the first reinforced metal core yarns, the alkali-resistant cores are arranged on the outer sides of the first tensile layers, the high-silica protective layers are arranged on the outer sides of the alkali-resistant cores, the wear-resistant layers are arranged on the outer surfaces of the weft yarns and the warp yarns, and reinforcing connecting belts are arranged at connecting gaps of the weft yarns and the warp yarns. Through the cooperation setting of first strengthening metal heart yearn, first tensile layer, alkali-resisting core, high silica protective layer, wearing layer, alkali-resisting coating, tie point to reached can improve the holistic intensity and the alkali resistance of glass fiber net cloth, improved glass fiber net cloth's life.

title_en: Ink jet numbering machine shower nozzle cleaning device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a spray head cleaning device of a code spraying machine, which comprises a cleaning tank and a waste liquid tank, wherein a spray head placing opening is formed in an upper cover of the cleaning tank, a heat conducting plate is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the cleaning tank, a semiconductor refrigerating sheet is arranged below the heat conducting plate, a condensing plate is arranged below the semiconductor refrigerating sheet, the semiconductor refrigerating sheet comprises a hot end which is used for being attached to the heat conducting plate and a cold end which is used for being attached to the condensing plate, the condensing plate is positioned at the upper side position inside the waste liquid tank, a liquid inlet and an air extracting opening are formed in the upper side of the cleaning tank, a liquid outlet pipe which leads into the waste liquid tank is formed in the bottom of the cleaning tank, an air inlet pipe which leads into the condensing plate is arranged above the side wall of the waste liquid tank, a conveying pipe is connected between the air extracting opening and the air inlet pipe, and an air extracting pump is arranged on the side wall of the cleaning tank.

title_en: Flexible container bag suspender sewing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a flexible container sling sewing device, which relates to the technical field of container bags and comprises a bottom plate, wherein the left side of the top of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a sewing machine body, the middle end of the top of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a second supporting rod, the top of the second supporting rod is fixedly connected with a detection box, the back of an inner cavity of the detection box is fixedly connected with a camera body through a bolt, the right side of the top of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a vertical plate, the top of the left side of the vertical plate is fixedly provided with a motor through a connecting plate.

title_en: Cutting and processing device for packaging paper boxes
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cutting and processing device for a packaging paper box, which comprises a workbench, a bracket, two air cylinders, a mounting plate and two cutter seats, wherein two connecting mechanisms are respectively arranged on the two cutter seats, the two cutter seats are connected with a cutting assembly through the two connecting mechanisms, the utility model relates to the technical field of cutting the packaging paper box, replaces the traditional bolt connection mode between a cutting knife and the cutter seats through the connecting mechanisms, the staff only need rotate the lead screw and can carry out quick installation and dismantlement to the sword of tailorring, need not to use external tools such as screwdriver to operate, convenient operation installs fast and dismantles the sword of tailorring and means that the production line can resume the operation more fast when changing the sword of tailorring, reduces down time, improves production efficiency, can carry out quick regulation limiting plate and the distance between the sword of tailorring through adjusting part to adapt to not unidimensional packing carton.

title_en: Drying device for packaging printing machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a drying device for a packaging printer, which comprises a base frame, wherein the inside of the base frame is hollow to form a drying cavity, a first traction wheel and a second traction wheel are arranged in the drying cavity, the first traction wheel is horizontally and symmetrically arranged relative to the second traction wheel, and a first contact column and a second contact column which extend radially are respectively arranged on the first traction wheel and the second traction wheel in a circumferential array. According to the drying device for the packaging printer, the first abutting columns and the second abutting columns are utilized to rotate in sequence to abut against and support the material belt so as to reduce the contact area between the first traction wheel, the second traction wheel and the material belt, and further the first traction wheel and the second traction wheel do not need to be in contact with each position of the material belt, so that the problem that printing patterns are damaged due to the fact that the first traction wheel and the second traction wheel scratch the material belt with ink is avoided.

title_en: Linen yarn braiding broken yarn splicing device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of linen yarn processing, in particular to a linen yarn knitting broken yarn splicing device. The utility model provides a linen yarn knitting broken yarn connecting device which can timely detect yarn breakage and timely connect broken yarns, thereby ensuring continuity and efficiency of textile production. The utility model provides a broken yarn splicing apparatus is compiled to flax, includes installation base, telescopic link, first slide rail and detects frame etc. and the last slidingtype of installation base is connected with the telescopic link, and the telescopic link upside is connected with first slide rail, and slidingtype is connected with detects frame on the first slide rail. According to the utility model, the detection frame drives the contact block to contact with the sensor after the linen yarn is broken, the detection frame moves to drive the rotating frame to rotate through the connecting frame, and the rotating frame rotates to drive the clamping block to clamp broken yarn, so that the effects of timely detecting yarn breakage and timely continuing broken yarn are achieved, and the continuity and efficiency of textile production are ensured.

title_en: Hot tectorial membrane compression roller with rapid heating function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hot laminating press roller with a rapid heating function, which comprises a bearing block and an electric telescopic rod, wherein the surface of the bearing block is fixedly connected with a rapid heating mechanism, the rapid heating mechanism comprises a laminating press roller main body fixedly connected to the surface of the bearing block, the surface of the laminating press roller main body is electrically connected with a heating wire through a power wire, the surface of the heating wire is fixedly connected with an aluminum roller, the surface of the aluminum roller is sprayed with carbon fiber powder, and the electric telescopic rod is fixedly connected to the right side of the top surface of the bearing block. This thermal laminating compression roller with rapid heating function does benefit to the device and reaches required operating temperature rapidly to shortened preheating time, improved production efficiency, and avoided when the contact between device and the printing plate, static leads to material adhesion such as ink or waste paper on the machine, causes printing quality to descend, even shut down, after using the device, with the arc groove block in electrostatic stick surface of seting up below the protecting crust, make the electrostatic stick protected.

title_en: Cloth spreading machine
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of cloth spreading machines, in particular to a cloth spreading machine which comprises a cloth spreading table, wherein a first guide rail is arranged on the side surface of the cloth spreading table, a first travelling mechanism is arranged on the first guide rail, a cloth spreading mechanism is arranged on one side of the first travelling mechanism, a cloth cutting mechanism is arranged at the top of the cloth spreading table, a guide roller mounting frame is arranged on the side surface of the cloth spreading table, a guide roller is arranged on the inner side of the guide roller mounting frame, a clamping roller mounting frame is arranged at the top of the cloth spreading table, a lower clamping roller device is arranged on the inner side of the clamping roller mounting frame, a second cylinder is arranged at the top of the clamping roller mounting frame, the bottom end of a piston rod of the second cylinder is connected with the upper clamping roller device, an upper suction cover and a lower suction cover are arranged on the inner side of the clamping roller mounting frame.

title_en: Leather punching cutter
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a leather punching cutter in the technical field of leather processing tools, which comprises a handle and a punching cutter head arranged at the front end of the handle, wherein a punching hole is formed in the end part of the punching cutter head, the periphery of the punching hole is a cutter edge for cutting leather, a cutter mounting hole which is horizontally arranged is formed in the end part of the cutter head, one end of the punching cutter head, which is far away from the cutter edge, is a fastening part, the punching cutter head is inserted into the cutter mounting hole through the fastening part, a fixing hole is formed in the top end surface of the cutter head, a conducting structure is arranged between the fixing hole and the cutter mounting hole, a fastening piece is arranged in the fixing hole and can extend into the cutter mounting hole and is in contact with the fastening part for fixing, so that the punching cutter heads with different sizes and shapes can be positioned in the cutter mounting hole of the cutter head for replacement, and the punching cutter head is suitable for punching of various holes and has strong suitability.

title_en: Woven bag heat sealing machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of woven bag heat sealing, in particular to a woven bag heat sealing machine, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a transverse plate is arranged above the bottom plate, the top of the transverse plate is fixedly connected with two side plates, and the left side of one side plate on the right side is fixedly connected with a plurality of electric heating rods. According to the utility model, the woven bag to be sealed is placed on the right side of the vertical plate, the flexible steel rope is driven to move downwards by stepping on the pedal, the flexible steel rope drives the vertical plate to move rightwards, the vertical plate drives the return plate to move through the transverse block, the woven bag is extruded on one side of the hot melt plate while the vertical plate moves, the hot melt plate seals the woven bag in a hot melt manner, after the sealing is finished, the stepping force on the pedal is relaxed, the vertical plate drives the return plate to move leftwards to reset to shield the hot melt plate through the transverse block, the automatic return movement is performed to shield after the sealing is finished, the scalding of personnel during taking and placing is effectively avoided, the rapid and safe sealing operation can be realized through simple stepping action, and the working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Multi-functional work or material rest and automated printer with adjustable
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of printers and discloses an adjustable multifunctional material rack which comprises an installation fixed frame, a movable material discharging mechanism and a limiting mechanism, wherein the movable material discharging mechanism comprises limiting guide rods connected to two ends above the installation fixed frame through bolts, a first material discharging roller and a second material discharging roller which are respectively connected to the two groups of limiting guide rods in a horizontal sliding mode, and the limiting mechanism comprises a sliding rail connected to the outer side wall of the second material discharging roller through bolts, threaded holes formed in the sliding rail, small bolts arranged in the threaded holes and a sliding block connected to the inside of the sliding rail in a sliding mode. According to the utility model, the sliding rail, the threaded hole, the small-size bolt and the sliding block are arranged, so that the sliding block on one side of the second discharging roller is displaced to one side of the first discharging roller by moving the sliding block, and the sliding block can be contacted with the outer wall of one group of discharging rollers in the moving process, so that the first discharging roller and the second discharging roller can be aligned quickly.

title_en: Water loom capable of adjusting weaving width
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of water jet looms, and discloses a water jet loom with adjustable weaving width, which comprises a distribution box, wherein a control panel is fixedly arranged on the outer wall of the distribution box, an access door is arranged on the outer wall of the distribution box, a discharging wheel is arranged on an inner wall bearing of the distribution box, the weaving width is conveniently adjusted through a through hole and a discharging roller, the outer wall of the discharging wheel is fixedly arranged through a fixing hole of the outer wall of an adjusting plate, the adjusting rod is fastened and fixed through a protection block, the limit is avoided through the protection block, so that the change of the weaving width is conveniently adjusted, the splashing of water stains in the working process of the water jet loom can be prevented from splashing outside through a splash guard of the outer wall of a mounting plate, the working environment of a workshop is improved, the health of workers is ensured, the rolling roller is rolled through the rolling roller is conducted through an electric heating tube and a heat conducting sheet, the cloth before rolling is dried through the drying roller, further processing is conveniently carried out, and the processing efficiency is improved.

title_en: Automatic unreeling mechanism for bag making machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of bag making machines, in particular to an automatic unreeling mechanism for a bag making machine, which comprises a frame seat, wherein a sliding cylinder is slidably arranged on the top surface of the frame seat, two groups of sliding cylinders are arranged on the top surface of the sliding cylinder, support plates which can be used for supporting are integrally formed on the top surface of the sliding cylinder, when the bag making machine operates, garbage bag raw materials can be conveniently placed on the periphery of a material roller, meanwhile, the material roller can be directly placed in arc grooves on the surfaces of the two groups of support plates on the top of the frame seat, gears on the periphery of the material roller are conveniently meshed with tooth rollers in a shell outside the support plates, then a motor in the shell can be operated, the motor can conveniently drive the tooth rollers to rotate under the operation of a speed reducer, the tooth rollers can be meshed with the gears to rotate, then the material roller can rotate, and the automatic discharging is convenient, so that the bag making machine can operate more smoothly, and the damage condition of the garbage bag raw materials due to pulling force is reduced.

title_en: Winding device of high-speed two-for-one twister
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a winding device of a high-speed two-for-one twister, which belongs to the technical field of winding of two-for-one twisters and comprises a mounting plate, wherein one side of the mounting plate is fixedly connected with a fixing plate, the surface of the mounting plate is provided with a mounting assembly, one side of the fixing plate is fixedly connected with a motor frame, a driving motor is arranged in the motor frame, an output shaft of the driving motor is provided with a supporting cylinder, and the inner side of the mounting plate is sleeved with a connecting shaft through a bearing A.

title_en: Hemming machine for processing paper tube
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of paper tube processing, and particularly relates to a hemming machine for paper tube processing, which comprises a workbench, wherein a rotating part is arranged above the workbench, a plurality of paper tube positioning stations are arranged on the rotating part, the paper tube positioning stations are a plurality of positioning grooves which are circumferentially distributed on the edge of the rotating part and take the center of the circle of the rotating part as the center, the positioning grooves are of a V-shaped structure, one end of the workbench is provided with a feeding assembly, the feeding assembly comprises a conveying frame and a conveying belt which is arranged on the conveying frame, positioning frames for positioning the paper tubes are arranged on two sides of the conveying frame.

title_en: Environment-friendly degradable warp knitted fabric
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an environment-friendly degradable warp knitted fabric which comprises a moisture guiding layer, a bacteriostatic layer and a soil release layer which are sequentially compounded, wherein the moisture guiding layer, the bacteriostatic layer and the soil release layer are compounded through a net-shaped degradable hot melt adhesive, the moisture guiding layer is formed by warp knitting of degradable moisture guiding fiber yarns, the bacteriostatic layer is formed by warp knitting of degradable bacteriostatic fiber yarns, the soil release layer is formed by warp knitting of siri biodegradable fiber yarns, and the soil release layer is a warp knitting twill mesh structure. The environment-friendly degradable warp knitted fabric is formed by knitting the degradable yarns with the functions of moisture conduction, bacteriostasis and soil release, is more environment-friendly and environment-friendly, accords with sustainable development strategy, has good moisture conduction performance, can quickly absorb and guide out sweat and moisture discharged by a human body, can prevent bacteria from breeding in a wet environment of the fabric by virtue of the antibacterial layer, is easy to clean when being stained with greasy dirt due to the arrangement of the soil removing layer, and is suitable for being used as fabric such as skirt, coat and the like.

title_en: Printing ink color development device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an ink color-spreading device, which belongs to the technical field of ink color spreading and comprises a mounting frame, wherein an inking rod is rotatably connected to the mounting frame through holes formed in two sides of the mounting frame, a first gear is fixedly connected to one end of the inking rod, connecting blocks are fixedly connected to two sides of the mounting frame, and cleaning components are arranged in grooves formed in two sides of the mounting frame through mounting seats; according to the utility model, the scraper frame is arranged inside, the motor is started to carry out ink homogenizing, when cleaning is needed, the reciprocating screw rod is driven to rotate through transmission, so that the scraper frame is driven to carry out reciprocating movement through the mounting seat, through the design, the automatic cleaning of the ink homogenizing rod is realized, when the ink homogenizing rod needs to be cleaned after color development is completed, the ink homogenizing rod can be rapidly cleaned through the scraper frame, the condition that ink is stained on hands during manual cleaning can be avoided, harm is avoided, cleaning time is saved, and efficiency is improved.

title_en: Protective film stacked sputtering film forming auxiliary tool for thermal printing head
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a stacked sputtering film forming auxiliary tool for a protective film of a thermal printing head, and belongs to the technical field of production of thermal printing heads. The device comprises a film forming jig, wherein the top of the film forming jig is obliquely provided with a containing groove, the containing groove comprises a front end containing groove and a baffle containing groove, the front end containing groove and the baffle containing groove are positioned at two ends of the film forming jig, and a plurality of middle containing grooves are adjacent between the front end containing groove and the baffle containing groove. The utility model has the beneficial effects that the multiple ceramic substrates are stacked and placed on the film forming jig, so that the substrates only expose the film forming area, the utilization rate of film forming raw materials is improved, the film forming process is simplified, the sputtering film forming of multiple ceramic substrates is completed at one time, and the working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Conveyor for shoe processing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of shoe processing, and discloses a conveyor for shoe processing, which comprises a bottom plate, a conveying mechanism, a partition plate and a feeding mechanism, wherein the conveying mechanism is positioned at the top of the bottom plate, the partition plate is positioned at the top of the bottom plate, the feeding mechanism is positioned at two ends of the top of the bottom plate, and the conveying mechanism comprises. The utility model relates to a conveying mechanism, in particular to a conveying mechanism which is provided with a first conveying belt, a second conveying belt, an operation plate and a conveying shaft. The double-line operation processing effect is achieved, the overall efficiency is improved, the space is effectively utilized, and the overall yield and the processing speed are directly and indirectly improved.

title_en: Looping auxiliary device for single-groove double needles
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a single-groove double-needle looping auxiliary device which comprises a needle plate, sinkers and yarn separating pieces, wherein the sinkers are a pair and are inserted into the upper edge of the needle plate at intervals, the yarn separating pieces are arranged between the sinkers and are inserted into the upper edge of the needle plate, a first limiting strip is penetrated through the needle plate, one end of each sinker is movably connected with the first limiting strip, a second limiting strip is penetrated through the upper edge of the needle plate, an arc-shaped slotted hole is formed in the other end of each sinker, and the arc-shaped slotted holes are in sliding fit with the first limiting strips so that the sinkers can swing up and down around the first limiting strips. The structure of the needle plate is greatly simplified, and the sinker realizes the functions of yarn pressing and yarn blocking, thereby better assisting knitting needle looping.

title_en: Transmission device and printing equipment
abstract_en: The conveying device comprises an interactive conveying device arranged in a first direction, an upper and lower material conveying belt module arranged in front of or behind the interactive conveying device, a transfer module arranged between the interactive conveying device, a base of the interactive conveying device, a traversing device arranged on the side edge of the base, and a lifting device arranged on the traversing device, wherein a bearing table moves in the first direction and the vertical direction to reach a material loading end and a material unloading end, the transfer module comprises a base body, a traversing module arranged on the side edge of the base body in a second direction, and a lifting module arranged on the traversing module, and the transfer fork module moves in the first direction and the vertical direction to reach the upper and lower material conveying belt module and the interactive conveying device to transfer materials. Adopt the transfer module to go up unloading conveyer belt module and interactive transmission device's material transmission, guarantee transmission speed and productivity.

title_en: Adjusting mechanism for gauge of rotary cover plate of carding machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a regulating mechanism for the gauge of a rotary cover plate of a carding machine, and relates to the technical field of carding machine equipment. The utility model provides a carding machine gyration apron gauge adjustment mechanism includes the support body and sets up apron and brush roll in the support body, the support body has left side wall and right side wall, one side of left side wall, one side of right side wall all have the joint, brush roll looks adaptation sets up in the joint, and follow the joint removes, be provided with first joint spare on the brush roll, be provided with the second joint spare on the joint, the brush roll passes through first joint spare with second joint spare looks adaptation joint. According to the utility model, the gear is matched with the gear plate, so that the gauge between the brush roller and the cover plate can be adjusted in the operation process of the cover plate, and the problem that the brush roller is contacted and rubbed with the cover plate clothing under the condition of winding fibers, so that the cover plate clothing is damaged is avoided.

title_en: Paperboard punching device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a paperboard punching device, which relates to the technical field of paperboard punching and comprises a support frame, wherein a fixing frame is fixedly arranged at the top of the support frame, a symmetrical installation frame is fixedly arranged at one end of the fixing frame, the installation frames are arranged in an L shape, two installation frames are provided with rotating shafts in a matched mode, one ends of the rotating shafts extend to the outer sides of the installation frames and are provided with flywheel in a matched mode, eccentric wheels are arranged in the middle of the rotating shafts in a matched mode, the bottoms of the eccentric wheels are arranged on an upper punching die in a matched mode, the upper punching die comprises a hard plate, an annular groove is formed in the hard plate, and when the paperboard punching device is used, the flywheel is driven to rotate by a driving motor to drive the eccentric wheels to continuously rotate, and the eccentric wheels drive the upper punching die to be matched with the lower punching die to effectively punch paperboard materials at the position of a hole.

title_en: Thermal print head for uniform printing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of manufacturing of thermal print heads, in particular to a thermal print head which has reasonable structure and simple wiring and is suitable for uniform printing in industrial production and application, and is characterized in that a public COM is arranged in parallel with a public electrode, a driving IC is fixed on the upper surface of the public electrode, a protective layer is arranged between the driving IC and the public electrode, the first bonding lead and the third bonding lead are arranged between the drive IC and the circuit board side by side and are alternately arranged, and the upper parts of the bonding lead and the drive IC are protected by sealant.

title_en: Adjusting mechanism of chemical fiber cloth production loom
abstract_en: The utility model provides an adjustment mechanism of chemical fiber cloth production loom, the on-line screen storage device comprises a base, be equipped with the support column on the base, the canopy is connected on the support column top, tension adjusting device and lateral offset adjusting device are connected to the canopy bottom, tension adjusting device includes first jib, first horizontal pole, first electric telescopic handle, the second horizontal pole, the spring, the short pole, first fixed axle and first roll, lateral offset adjusting device includes the motor hanging seat, first motor, first threaded rod, first thread bush, the second electric telescopic handle, the third horizontal pole, the second motor, the second threaded rod, the second thread bush, the second jib, go up the backup pad, the lower backup pad, the third electric telescopic handle, the lifter plate, go up the connecting rod, go up the minor axis, go up the compression roller, the lower connecting rod, lower minor axis, the lower compression roller, the pivot, bearing and bearing hanging seat, lateral offset adjusting device can carry out lateral adjustment to the chemical fiber cloth that takes place the skew, make it get back to the normal position.

title_en: Marking device for automobile motor
abstract_en: The utility model provides a marking device of car motor, car motor marking device is including marking the aircraft nose, beat parts such as mark head mounting panel, main mounting panel, riser, curb plate, reinforcing plate, auxiliary mounting panel. The marking machine head is arranged on the marking machine head mounting plate, and the marking machine head is positioned in the main mounting plate, the vertical plate, the side plates and the reinforcing plate. The lower end of the main mounting plate is provided with a locating pin, a clamping mounting block, a fixing block and a supporting block, the cylinder A drives the clamping block to abut against the motor shell or the frame shell, and the cylinder B is arranged at the upper end of the main mounting plate and can move along the linear guide rail to realize clamping and limiting. The whole structure is compact in design and complete in function.

title_en: High-speed paper mounting machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-speed paper mounting machine, which comprises a paper mounting machine base, a pressing mechanism, a conveying mechanism and a centering adjusting mechanism, wherein the pressing mechanism, the conveying mechanism and the centering adjusting mechanism are all arranged at the top of the paper mounting machine base, a push rod is inserted into the bottom of a support frame, a pressing plate is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the push rod, first limiting sliding grooves are formed in two sides of the outer wall of the pressing plate, sliding blocks are arranged in the inner walls of the two first limiting sliding grooves in a sliding mode, a roller is rotatably arranged between the two supporting bars, and a first motor is arranged in the inner wall of one sliding block. According to the utility model, the first motor is started to rotate and support before the lamination mechanism is laminated, so that the first motor can rotate downwards to contact glue on the bottom paperboard, and the first electric telescopic rod is started to drive the sliding blocks to move back and forth on two sides of the lamination plate, so that the roller can repeatedly roll to uniformly distribute the glue, the surface paper and the paperboard are fully sticky when laminated, gap openings are not easy to occur, resource waste is reduced, and lamination quality of the paper laminating machine is improved.

title_en: Bracket device of flat knitting machine roller
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of knitting machinery, in particular to a bracket device for a roller of a flat knitting machine, which comprises a transmission base, wherein the inside of the transmission base is rotationally connected with two transmission shafts, the front end of the transmission base is fixedly connected with a bottom plate, the upper end of the bottom plate is slidably connected with a movable seat, the front end of the transmission base is provided with the movable seat, the inside of the movable seat is rotationally connected with two connecting shafts, the two connecting shafts and the transmission shafts are connected through connecting pieces, each connecting piece comprises a connecting plate, a notch and a second bolt, the inside of each connecting shaft is rotationally connected with the connecting plate, the upper end faces of the two transmission shafts are respectively provided with the notch, and the two connecting plates are respectively positioned in the two notches and are fixedly connected with the transmission shafts through the second bolts. According to the utility model, the roller is conveniently disassembled on the premise of not moving and disassembling the transmission base under the mutual matching of the connecting piece, the fastening piece and the movable base.

title_en: Improved non-woven fabric hot-pressing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides improved non-woven fabric hot-pressing equipment, which belongs to the technical field of non-woven fabric processing equipment and comprises a machine body, wherein a main body steel roller is fixedly connected between inner side walls of the machine body, sliding grooves are formed in the inner walls of two sides of the machine body, two first air cylinders are fixedly connected to the upper surface of the machine body through a bracket, output ends of the two first air cylinders penetrate through the upper surface of the machine body and extend into the two sliding grooves respectively, and bearing blocks are fixedly connected to the output ends of the two first air cylinders. According to the utility model, the combination of the steel roller and the rubber roller is adopted, so that the problem of a single structure that the surface of the non-woven fabric after hot pressing treatment is too smooth is avoided, the non-woven fabric is endowed with a burr structure through the combination of the rubber rollers, so that the non-woven fabric after hot pressing cannot die and is stiff, and the stress uniformity of the non-woven fabric extrusion can be ensured by setting the included angle between the adjacent rubber rollers to be stable at sixty degrees.

title_en: Glass fiber high-speed disposable creel for warping machine convenient for replacing bobbins
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of warping machines, in particular to a high-speed disposable glass fiber warping machine bobbin cradle convenient for replacing bobbins, which comprises a cradle body, wherein a placing frame is fixedly connected to the outer wall of the cradle body, a cylinder body is movably connected to the outer wall of the placing frame, a disassembling component is movably connected to the outer wall of the placing frame, the disassembling component comprises a limiting frame, a spring, a fixing plate, a handle, a limiting groove, a rubber ring, a screw rod and an adjusting block, one side of the limiting frame is fixedly connected with the spring, and one side of the spring is fixedly connected with the fixing plate; this glass fiber is creel for disposable warper of high speed convenient to change bobbin adopts the mutually supporting of dismantling the subassembly to realized fixing the barrel and dismantling the effect, at first according to the length of barrel with spacing swing joint in the outer wall of rack, drive the fixed plate through stretching the spring immediately and stretch to spacing groove swing joint to the one end of rack.

title_en: Yarn collecting device, drying chamber and spinning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a filament collecting device, a drying chamber and a spinning device. The wire collecting device comprises at least one wire collecting roller, the wire collecting roller comprises a wire collecting part and a limiting part, the wire collecting part is arranged in an extending mode along a first direction, the limiting parts are arranged at intervals on the two wire collecting parts in the first direction, and the maximum radial size of the wire collecting part on the cross section perpendicular to the first direction is smaller than the minimum radial size of the limiting part on the cross section perpendicular to the first direction. In the utility model, when the membrane wires move towards the two ends of the wire collecting part in the first direction, the limiting part can limit the membrane wires in the wire collecting part.

title_en: Steerable printed matter printing device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of printing guidance, in particular to a guidable printed matter printing device. The printing device aims to solve the technical problems that in the prior art, due to the lack of a positioning guide structure, paper is easy to shift in the conveying process, sundries or dust are easy to adhere to the outer side of the paper, and the printing quality of a printed matter is caused by the factors. A guidable printed matter printing device comprises an operating table, a limiting groove, a limiting assembly and a guiding assembly. According to the utility model, the limiting assemblies can be used for carrying out proper adjustment according to the width of the paper, the two sides of the paper are limited, the paper is prevented from being influenced by external factors to move and deviate in the conveying process, the paper is stably pressed and driven to be conveyed forwards by the two groups of guide assemblies, the paper can be conveyed forwards by the cleaning assemblies, and the front side and the back side of the paper can be cleaned in time, so that the guide effect is good when the printing machine is designed, the paper is cleaner when in printing, and the quality of printed matters is greatly improved.

title_en: Down jacket down-proof cloth with function of preventing down from falling down to pile up and agglomerate
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a down jacket velvet fabric with a function of preventing down from falling down and piling up and agglomerating, which relates to the technical field of down jackets and comprises warp yarns, velvet fabric blanks and weft yarns, wherein the velvet fabric blanks are internally provided with weft yarn velvet and warp velvet, the weft yarn velvet and the warp velvet are firmly adsorbed with the velvet of the down, the down falling down and the agglomeration can be well solved, the weft yarn velvet and the warp velvet are arranged on both sides of the velvet fabric blanks, the velvet fabric blanks are directly scraped with glue, the weft yarn velvet and the warp velvet are respectively and directly adhered with the glue, the down jacket has the advantages that the down jacket has the reinforcing effect, the delamination risk is reduced, the velvet isolating cloth blank is subjected to the velvet scraping treatment, the outside cold air is isolated outside, the internal heat is locked, the outside is wetted during raining, the internal heat is prevented from losing, the effects of warming and water proofing are achieved, the velvet isolating cloth blank is subjected to the velvet scraping treatment during clothes washing, the internal velvet can be protected from being wetted completely, and the down jacket is protected.

title_en: Directional yarn guiding mechanism of computerized flat knitting machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of flat knitting machines, in particular to a directional yarn guiding mechanism of a computer flat knitting machine, which comprises a mounting base, wherein a transverse mounting bar is fixedly arranged at the top of the mounting base, a telescopic mounting block is arranged on the side wall of the transverse mounting bar and is rotationally connected with the transverse mounting bar through a first rotating seat, a transverse limiting groove is formed in the mounting base, a transverse moving pushing assembly is arranged in the transverse limiting groove, the other end of the telescopic mounting block is rotationally connected with the transverse moving pushing assembly through a second rotating seat, and a protective yarn guiding assembly with a limiting function is arranged on the telescopic mounting block.

title_en: Movable coating single machine
abstract_en: The utility model provides a mobile coating single machine, which relates to the technical field of automobiles and aims to solve the problems that the existing carrier coating has higher and higher automation degree and higher quality closed loop traceability requirement, huge energy and equipment waste exist for small-batch carrier production by an automatic production line, and the traditional single machine mode lacks quality traceability. The manipulator can drive the code spraying machine and reciprocate, control the code spraying demand of removing in order to compatible different diameters and high carrier for spout the sign indicating number to the carrier, and the camera of installation on the manipulator can drive the camera through the manipulator and reciprocate, control the discernment of removing in order to compatible different diameters and high carrier upper two-dimensional code, thereby can carry out the quality to the carrier spraying and trace back, small batch carrier coating is with low costs, and the practicality is strong.

title_en: Cotton seed impurity removing machine with automatic feeding structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cotton seed impurity removing machine with an automatic feeding structure, which comprises a cotton seed impurity removing box, wherein the top end of the cotton seed impurity removing box is provided with a feeding mechanism, and a discharge pipe is fixed at the bottom end of one side of the cotton seed impurity removing box. According to the utility model, the first rotating shaft is driven to rotate by the driving motor, the second rotating shaft and the driving shaft are matched with the driving belt to rotate, so that two groups of rotating drums in the cotton seed impurity removing box and multiple groups of cotton seed scattering page plates can perform rotary motion, the input cotton seeds can be stirred, the scattering effect is achieved, impurities mixed in the cotton seeds are separated from the cotton seeds, the primary separation effect is achieved, and in the process, multiple groups of scraping steel wires in the through groove are used for contacting with the cotton seeds, so that the impurities partially adhered to the cotton seeds can be scraped, and the effect of fully removing impurities is achieved.

title_en: Yarn catching and cutting device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a yarn catching and cutting device which comprises a yarn catching mechanism, a yarn sucking mechanism and a yarn cutting mechanism. The yarn cutting device has the advantages of simple structure, low manufacturing cost, convenience in disassembly and assembly, easiness in replacement of a vulnerable blade, capability of reducing the working strength of workers in assembly and disassembly, improving the working efficiency, reducing the later maintenance cost, suitability for yarns with different counts, capability of cutting yarns with high counts, and good effect on yarns with low counts.

title_en: Clothing hem device for clothing processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a garment flanging device for garment processing, which comprises a rectangular box, wherein a flanging opening which is in a strip shape and extends along the front-back direction is formed in the top of the rectangular box, two ironing plates which are positioned on two sides of the flanging opening are arranged in the rectangular box, a first cylinder is arranged on the left inner wall and the right inner wall of the rectangular box, an elastic component is arranged between a telescopic shaft of the first cylinder and the ironing plates on the same side, a concave character frame is arranged on the top of the rectangular box, an inserting mechanism which corresponds to the flanging opening is arranged on the left side of the inner top wall of the concave character frame, a clamping mechanism is arranged on the right side of the inner top wall of the concave character frame, the elastic component comprises a box body, a spring, a limiting plate and a telescopic block, the telescopic shaft of the first cylinder is provided with the box body, and the limiting plate is arranged in the box body.

title_en: Cutting mechanism for processing glass fiber cloth
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of glass fiber cloth processing equipment, in particular to a cutting mechanism for glass fiber cloth processing, which comprises an equipment main body, an external interface, a connecting disc and a connecting bolt, the external interface is arranged on the top side end surface of the equipment main body, the connecting disc is arranged on the bottom side end surface of the equipment main body, and the connecting bolt is arranged on the inner upper end of the connecting disc. According to the utility model, the heat conduction mechanism and the cutting cone made of high-temperature alloy are arranged, when the device is connected with the external structure for starting to use, the external high temperature of the external connection structure is conducted to the cutting cone made of high-temperature metal at the bottom end of the device through the heat conduction of the heat conduction mechanism, the cutting cone receives the high-temperature state of heating to 600 ℃ after being preheated for a certain time, then the device is controlled by the transmission conveying structure connected with the outside to carry out transverse and longitudinal movement cutting, and when the cutting cone is contacted with the glass fiber cloth, the glass fiber cloth is rapidly decomposed and cut by the high temperature.

title_en: Tension tensioning device for spun-bonded non-woven fabric production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tension tensioning device for producing spun-bonded non-woven fabrics, which particularly relates to the technical field of fabric production, and comprises a mounting plate, wherein the top of the mounting plate is provided with two first support plates, a tension adjusting roller is arranged between the two first support plates, the two ends of the tension adjusting roller are provided with first sliding blocks, one side of two first sliders all is provided with adjustment mechanism, and the top of mounting panel is provided with the link, and the inside of link is provided with two electric telescopic handle one, and the one end of two electric telescopic handle one is provided with first cleaning brush, and one side of first cleaning brush is provided with the second cleaning brush, and one side of link is provided with smooths mechanism. The utility model is convenient to adjust the tension for testing the spun-bonded non-woven fabric, can clean the filth adhered on the surface of the spun-bonded non-woven fabric, and smoothes the surface of the spun-bonded non-woven fabric, so that the spun-bonded non-woven fabric can better perform tension detection.

title_en: Presser foot of towel sewing machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of sewing machine parts, in particular to a towel sewing machine presser foot, which comprises two presser foot bodies, wherein the upper end surfaces of the two presser foot bodies are respectively provided with a mounting groove, the two mounting grooves are fixedly connected with a connecting part together, and the opposite side walls of the two presser foot bodies are fixedly connected with a front mounting box and a rear mounting box together; according to the utility model, by arranging the front mounting box, the rear mounting box, the first rod, the second rod, the first roller and the second roller, when relatively thick materials such as towels are required to be sewn, the first roller and the second roller in the front mounting box and the rear mounting box can respectively rotate on the first rod and the second rod along with the movement of the towel materials below the presser foot body, and the rolling of the first roller and the second roller can enable the movement of the towel materials below the presser foot body to be smoother when the towel materials are sewn below the presser foot body, so that the sewing effect of the towel materials is improved.

title_en: Paper saucer production facility
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of paper cup holder production, in particular to paper cup holder production equipment, a production box, wherein a hole is formed in the outer surface of the production box, a sliding column is connected in the hole in a penetrating manner, one end of the sliding column is clamped with a fixed block, the other end of the sliding column is fixedly connected with a rotating rod, the top end of the rotating rod is connected with a cleaning column in a threaded manner, a grid plate is connected to the inner side wall of the production box in a sliding manner, a limit pipe is connected in the hole in a penetrating manner, and one side of the limit pipe is connected with a reciprocating threaded rod in a threaded manner. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the sliding column, the fixed block, the rotating column, the cleaning column and the grid plate, when the device is used, the fixed block is driven by the sliding column, the rotating column is driven by the sliding column, the cleaning column is driven by the rotating column, and then the device is matched with the grid plate for use, so that the effect of cleaning the interior of the paper cup holder production device is achieved.

title_en: Cloth baling press washes with dust removal function
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of wash cloth processing and specifically relates to relate to a wash cloth baling press with dust removal function, the on-line screen storage device comprises a base, install two fixed plates on the base, two the same side of fixed plate is provided with the rolling subassembly, two be provided with the backup pad between the fixed plate, the backup pad below is provided with the toper baffle, toper baffle both sides all are provided with clamping assembly, one side of fixed plate is provided with collects the box, the utility model discloses a set up spacing roller, the toper baffle, collect the box, fan etc. parts are spacing to washing the cloth through spacing roller part to toper baffle both sides in the course of the work for the rolling subassembly is to washing the region that carries out the rolling and collect box part, fan part between mutually supporting, thereby carry out dust collection processing with the region that the toper baffle covers, and send into the collection box with the dust through the connecting piece in, thereby reach the effect that washes cloth and wash the quality of cloth.

title_en: Warping device for loom
abstract_en: The utility model is suitable for the technical field of textile machines, and provides a warping device for a loom, which comprises a base, a warping assembly, a driving assembly and a driving assembly, wherein arc-shaped supporting plates are arranged at two ends of the top surface of the base, the warping assembly comprises end plates and a central shaft, the end plates are in one-to-one correspondence with the arc-shaped supporting plates, the central shaft is rotatably arranged between the end plates, two movable seats and two circulating grooves with opposite directions are arranged on the central shaft, a plurality of outer supporting plates are uniformly arranged on the outer part of the central shaft in a surrounding mode, connecting rods are rotatably arranged between the movable seats and the outer supporting plates, one end plate is connected with a fixed gear, one end of the central shaft is slidably provided with a sliding gear, a locking groove is formed in the fixed gear, the driving assembly comprises a rotating shaft and an electromagnet, the rotating shaft is rotatably arranged on the base, a forward rotating gear and a reversing gear are rotatably arranged on the rotating shaft, and the electromagnet matched with the sliding gear is arranged on the base. Therefore, the utility model can automatically complete the adjustment of the outer diameter of the warping component and the warping operation, expands the application range, reduces the use cost and improves the warping efficiency.

title_en: Drying device of single paper ink-jet printer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a drying device of a single paper ink-jet printer, which belongs to the technical field of ink-jet printers and comprises a shell, a horizontal paper feeding channel dividing the inner space of the shell into an upper drying area and a lower drying area, an upper overturning lower paper feeding channel positioned in the upper drying area and a lower overturning upper paper feeding channel positioned in the lower drying area, wherein an upper hot air cavity for spraying hot air to the upper overturning lower paper feeding channel is arranged at the side of the upper overturning lower paper feeding channel, the upper hot air cavity enters the hot air from an upper port of the upper hot air cavity, the lower hot air cavity for spraying the hot air to the lower hot air cavity is arranged at the side of the lower overturning upper paper feeding channel, and the lower hot air cavity enters the hot air from a lower port of the lower hot air cavity and the upper port of the lower hot air cavity is used for spraying the hot air. The drying rate is improved, and the drying is uniform.

title_en: Cotton feeding box of carding machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cotton feeding box of a carding machine, which comprises a box body, a conveying mechanism assembled in the box body, a material stirring mechanism assembled in the box body and positioned at the top of the conveying mechanism, and a blowing mechanism assembled in the box body, wherein the conveying mechanism comprises three rotating rollers which are rotatably installed in the box body and distributed in an L-shaped arrangement, conveying belts are arranged on the outer sides of the three rotating rollers in a transmission manner, and the material stirring mechanism comprises a first movable frame movably installed in the box body and a second movable frame positioned at the bottom of the first movable frame. This carding machine feeds cotton case, through setting up the stirring mechanism, first movable frame and second movable frame take place to overturn the swing from top to bottom when utilizing the vibrations that the operation produced, can be comparatively convenient evenly scatter the cotton raw materials of agglomeration, conveniently improve the cotton effect of feeding to the carding machine, the difficult condition that takes place the jam.

title_en: Double-station box holding device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of box making machines, in particular to a double-station box holding device which comprises a mounting frame and two box holding mechanisms, wherein each box holding mechanism comprises a longitudinal box holding driving mechanism and two box holding modules, the longitudinal box holding driving mechanism drives the two box holding modules to be close to or far away from each other, and each box holding module comprises a longitudinal moving plate, a transverse moving driving mechanism for driving the transverse moving plate to reciprocate, a lifting seat arranged on the transverse moving plate in a lifting manner, a lifting driving mechanism for driving the lifting seat to lift, two box holding corner pieces which are transversely connected with the lifting seat in a sliding manner and are oppositely arranged, a transverse box holding driving mechanism for driving the two box holding corner pieces to be close to or far away from each other, and a box clamping assembly arranged on the outer side of the transverse moving plate. According to the utility model, the longitudinal box holding driving mechanism and the transverse box holding driving mechanism are cooperatively matched to drive the four box holding corner pieces to hold the four corners of the box body tightly, so that the box holding corner pieces in the prior art can move along the direction of 45 degrees only by controlling the air cylinders, the structure is simplified, and the cost is reduced.

title_en: Doffing cleaning device of roving frame
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a doffing cleaning device of a roving frame, which relates to the technical field of textile machinery and comprises a dust collection box, a dust collection pipe, a box door and a vibration assembly, wherein the dust collection pipe is arranged on one side of the dust collection box, the box door is arranged on one side of the dust collection box away from the dust collection pipe, the vibration assembly comprises a vibration motor, the bottom of the vibration motor is fixedly connected with a fixed plate, two sides of the fixed plate are fixedly connected to the inner wall of the dust collection box, the inner wall of the dust collection box is also provided with two support plates, the output end of the vibration motor is movably connected with a filter plate, a spring is arranged between the filter plate and the support plates, and the cleaning assembly is arranged on the filter plate.

title_en: Warp let-off structure for warp knitting machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of warp knitting machines, in particular to a warp feeding structure for a warp knitting machine, which comprises a fixed-length warp feeding device, a linear speed sensor and a controller, wherein the fixed-length warp feeding device comprises a driving motor, a speed reducer, a driving sprocket, a driven sprocket, a chain, a first fixed-length warp feeding roller, a second fixed-length warp feeding roller, a driving fixed-length warp feeding roller gear and a driven fixed-length warp feeding roller gear, the linear speed sensor is arranged on the outer surface of the end part of the first fixed-length warp feeding roller, the linear speed sensor and the first fixed-length warp feeding roller keep the same linear speed to rotate, and the linear speed sensor is electrically connected with the controller through a wire.

title_en: Cloth feeding mechanism of sewing machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cloth feeding mechanism of a sewing machine, which comprises a fixed side plate, a semi-sleeve type cloth feeding cylinder, an active tooth rack, a differential tooth rack, a tooth transmission assembly, an active transmission assembly, a differential transmission assembly and a lifting transmission assembly, wherein the cloth feeding cylinder is detachably arranged on one side of the fixed side plate, the active transmission assembly, the differential transmission assembly and the lifting transmission assembly are arranged on the other side of the fixed side plate, the active tooth rack, the differential tooth rack and the tooth transmission assembly are all arranged in the cloth feeding cylinder, the active tooth rack comprises an active swing arm and an active swing rack which are integrally connected, the active swing rack is positioned at the lower end of the active swing arm, the differential tooth rack comprises a differential swing arm and a differential swing rack which are integrally connected, and the active swing rack and the differential swing rack are in sliding contact with each other and have the same shape. The utility model improves the transmission efficiency and the cloth feeding stability of the cloth feeding mechanism.

title_en: Textile fabric wetting device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a textile fabric wetting device which comprises a processing box, a feeding hole and a discharging hole, wherein the feeding hole and the discharging hole are respectively distributed on two sides of the processing box, and the textile fabric wetting device further comprises a guiding component for guiding a fabric, a humidifying component for uniformly humidifying the fabric and a processing component for adhering dust and extruding redundant water to the fabric. The utility model belongs to the technical field of cloth treatment, and particularly relates to a textile cloth wetting device which solves the problem that after a textile is wetted by water spraying, a large amount of water is adsorbed on the surface of the textile, and the phenomenon that the quality of the textile is reduced due to overlarge humidity of the textile.

title_en: Deviation correcting device of carton cardboard bending mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a deviation correcting device of a paper box paperboard bending mechanism, which relates to the technical field of paper box production equipment and particularly comprises a frame, wherein a front conveying device and a rear conveying device for conveying paperboards are arranged on the frame, a height difference is arranged between the front conveying device and the rear conveying device, a bending mechanism for bending the paperboards is arranged between the front conveying device and the rear conveying device, the bending mechanism comprises two symmetrically arranged guide rods, the guide rods extend upwards to the rear conveying device along the outer side of the front conveying device, a deviation correcting device for correcting deviation of the sheet pieces is arranged at the rear conveying device, the deviation correcting device comprises a mounting seat, a belt conveying device driven by a motor is arranged on the mounting seat, and the conveying speed of the belt conveying device is higher than that of the rear conveying device.

title_en: Paper bag machine perforating device
abstract_en: The application belongs to the field of bag making machines, and provides a paper bag machine punching device which comprises a wallboard, a conveying assembly, a moving assembly and a punching assembly. The conveying assembly comprises a supporting plate which is arranged at intervals and connected with the wallboard, and a push rod which is movably arranged in the intervals of the supporting plate and can linearly move along a channel formed by the intervals of the supporting plate, the moving assembly comprises a punching seat and an adjusting mechanism which is connected with the punching seat and is used for driving the punching seat to move in a plane parallel to the supporting plate, the punching seat forms a top plate and a bottom plate which are spaced in the direction perpendicular to the supporting plate, the upper end face of the supporting plate is level to the upper end face of the bottom plate, and the punching assembly comprises an air cylinder connected to the top plate, a punch connected to the output end of the air cylinder and a die connected to the bottom plate and used for allowing the punch to pass through.

title_en: Built-in pressing plate and sealing and cutting mechanism of bag making machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a built-in pressing plate and a sealing and cutting mechanism of a bag making machine, wherein the built-in pressing plate comprises a pressing plate, a cutter accommodating groove and a reversing roller accommodating groove are formed in the pressing plate along the length direction of the pressing plate, the reversing roller accommodating groove is arranged at the top of the cutter accommodating groove, pressing plates are respectively arranged at the edges of two sides of an opening at the bottom of the cutter accommodating groove, a plurality of guide posts are arranged at the top of the pressing plate and are vertically arranged, a cooling water channel is arranged in the pressing plate, and a water inlet and a water outlet are formed in the cooling water channel. The copper knife sealing device has the advantages that water can be introduced to cool the pressing plate to keep the lower temperature, the phenomenon that the pressing plate is too high in temperature and scalds a product due to heat transfer of the copper knife sealing is avoided, the pressing plate presses the product firstly when the product is produced, then the cutter cuts off the product, then the copper knife seals the product again, no stretching is generated on the product in the production process, the product can be effectively prevented from being broken from the sealing position, the whole pressing plate is installed in a built-in mode, the pressing plate is not required to be removed when the high-temperature cloth is replaced, and the use is more convenient.

title_en: Hand-held type label coding machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of label coding machines and discloses a handheld label coding machine which comprises a coding gun, wherein a rotating shaft is rotatably connected inside the coding gun, the left side of the coding gun is fixedly connected with a shell, the inner top wall of the shell is fixedly connected with a loop bar, the inner wall of the loop bar is in sliding connection with a pull rod, the middle part of the pull rod is fixedly connected with a baffle plate, the bottom of the baffle plate is fixedly connected with a first spring, the right side of the loop bar is fixedly connected with a slide bar, the outer part of the slide bar is in sliding connection with an inserting rod, a connecting rod is arranged between the inserting rod and the baffle plate, and a storage assembly is arranged on the left side of the coding gun and used for storing standby label paper. According to the utility model, the baffle plate is driven to compress the first spring by pulling the pull rod, and meanwhile, the connecting rod is driven to pull the inserting rod under the limit of the slide rod, so that the quick unlocking and the fixing of the rotating shaft are realized, and the phenomenon that the rotating shaft is worn to cause falling in the traditional dismounting mode is avoided.

title_en: Material feeding unit and processing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a feeding device and processing equipment, and relates to the technical field of medical packaging bag production, comprising a frame, wherein a conveying line is arranged on the frame and used for conveying a base film to be processed; the device comprises a rack, an upper feeding mechanism, a lower feeding mechanism and a traction module, wherein the upper feeding mechanism is arranged above the rack in a crossing way and used for conveying an upper film to be processed, the lower feeding mechanism is arranged below the rack and positioned below the conveying line and used for conveying a lower film to be processed, and the traction module is arranged on the rack and positioned at the tail end of the conveying line and used for selectively dragging the upper film or the lower film to be butted with the base film to form a product to be processed. The technical scheme provided by the utility model adopts the traction module to selectively traction the raw materials conveyed by the upper feeding mechanism or the lower feeding mechanism so as to feed the functional structure, and solves the technical problems that the existing feeding device lacks flexibility and cannot effectively meet the production requirement of high efficiency.

title_en: Heat sealing cutter of bag making machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a heat sealing cutter of a bag making machine, which comprises a first heat sealing cutter head, a second heat sealing cutter head, a cutting cutter head, a cutter rest cross beam, a motor driving rod seat and a cutter bearing table. The knife rest beam is provided with a first knife rest adjusting rod, a second knife rest adjusting rod and a third knife rest adjusting rod, the motor driving rod seat comprises a motor driving rod connected with the knife rest beam to drive the knife rest beam to lift and lower, synchronous driving lifting of cutting and heat sealing is completed, procedures are saved, efficiency is improved, the knife bearing table is contacted with the cutting knife head, the first heat sealing knife head and the second heat sealing knife head after the knife rest beam descends, the knife bearing table is connected with and adjusted to correspondingly control the heat sealing knife head or the distance between the cutting knife head and the knife rest beam through the connection and the adjustment of each knife rest adjusting rod, the knife head capable of contacting a plastic film is changed, and various operation modes such as independent edge sealing, independent cutting, synchronous edge sealing and cutting, bag bottom edge sealing and bag mouth edge sealing are freely selected according to different application scenes, so that the application range of the heat sealing knife is wider.

title_en: Folding device of automatic carton forming machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a folding device of an automatic carton forming machine, which comprises a box body, wherein two sides of the box body are respectively provided with an opening, a conveying belt is arranged at the opening, a calibration table is arranged on the inner bottom surface of the box body, a turnover plate is arranged at the center of the calibration table, one end of the top surface of the turnover plate is also provided with an adhesive plate, a cutting assembly is arranged at the inner top of the box body, and a laser cutting head is arranged at the bottom of the cutting assembly.

title_en: Automatic change ultrasonic welding perforating device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic ultrasonic welding perforating device which comprises a conveying platform, an ultrasonic welding machine, a rotary platform, a plurality of clamps and a feeding mechanism, wherein the conveying platform is provided with a position sensor along the length direction of the conveying platform and used for sensing and determining the conveying position of a mail bag, the ultrasonic welding machine is arranged at the top end of the conveying platform along the length direction of the conveying platform and connected with one side of the conveying platform, the rotary platform is round and arranged at the top end of the conveying platform and connected with one end of the conveying platform far away from the ultrasonic welding machine, the clamps are arranged along the circumferential direction of the rotary platform and connected with the periphery of the rotary platform, and the feeding mechanism is arranged at one end of the clamp far away from the rotary platform and used for feeding lining sheets into the clamps.
