According to the utility model, through the automatic ultrasonic welding perforating device, full-automatic mechanical operation is completed, so that the labor cost is greatly reduced, and the production efficiency is greatly improved. Greatly reduces the production cost of the mail bags.

title_en: Adjustable stop gear and corrugated paper indentation device thereof
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an adjustable limiting mechanism and a corrugated paper creasing device thereof, which are applied to the field of paperboard limiting, and the adjustable limiting mechanism comprises a mounting bottom plate, wherein an creasing machine body is fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the mounting bottom plate, four limiting connecting plates are fixedly arranged at two sides of a creasing section of the creasing machine body, an adjusting component is arranged at the top of one side, far away from a conveying belt of the creasing machine body, of each limiting connecting plate, a limiting pressing plate is connected between two sides of each limiting connecting plate in a sliding manner, and each adjusting component is in contact with the upper surface of the corresponding limiting pressing plate. According to the corrugated paper thickness mark, the adjusting rotating handle is arranged, the adjusting screw is used for adjusting, the limiting pressing plate is used for displacing, when corrugated paper is conveyed on the conveying belt of the creasing machine body, the thickness mark of the corrugated paper is observed through the mark dividing ruler, the limiting pressing plate is located right above the corrugated paper, and the adjusting component and the resetting component are used for adjusting the height of the limiting pressing plate according to the thickness of the corrugated paper, so that the corrugated paper thickness mark is high in applicability.

title_en: Rotary machine head and template sewing machine thereof
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rotary machine head and a template sewing machine thereof, which relate to the technical field of template sewing machines and aim to solve the problem that a driven wheel of the traditional rotary machine head is easy to wear, the rotary machine head comprises a machine head rotating seat, a rotary motor and a synchronous belt transmission assembly connected with the rotary motor are arranged on the machine head rotating seat, the synchronous belt transmission assembly is connected with the machine head below the machine head rotating seat through a first bearing, the synchronous belt transmission assembly comprises a driving wheel, a driven wheel and a synchronous belt wound on the peripheries of the driving wheel and the driven wheel, the driving wheel is connected with a motor shaft of the rotating motor, two ends of the driven wheel are respectively provided with a first extending part and a second extending part, the first extending part is connected with the machine head through a first bearing, the periphery of the second extending part is provided with a bearing assembly, and the driven wheel is fixed through the cooperation of the bearing assembly and the first bearing, so that the driven wheel can be prevented from being worn by the unilateral stress of the synchronous belt, and the service life of the driven wheel is indirectly prolonged.

title_en: Auxiliary air cushion device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of thermal transfer printers and discloses an auxiliary air cushion device which comprises a base, wherein a movable drawing base is arranged on the base, a base plate is arranged on the drawing base, a handle is hinged to the top of the base, a heating adapter plate is arranged on the handle, a heating assembly body is arranged at the bottom of the heating adapter plate, and an air cushion in butt fit with the base plate is arranged at the bottom of the heating assembly body. Compared with the prior art, the utility model has the advantages that the air cushion has a buffer function, the transfer printing pattern is more stable, the effect is good, and the efficiency is high.

title_en: Wool yarn carding impurity removing mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wool yarn carding and impurity removing mechanism which comprises an impurity removing box, wherein a working cavity is arranged in the impurity removing box, a sliding groove is formed in the bottom inner wall of the working cavity, a sliding block is connected in the sliding groove in a sliding mode, a storage plate is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the sliding block, a bolt is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the storage plate, a clamping carding device is movably connected to the side surface of the bolt, a motor is fixedly connected to the side surface of the impurity removing box, a threaded rod is fixedly connected to the output end of the motor, a sleeve is connected to the side surface of the threaded rod in a threaded mode, and a limiting block is fixedly connected to the side surface of the sleeve. According to the clamping carding device, the wool yarns at the clamping part can be carded, impurities of the wool yarns at the clamping part are carded, the impurities are pushed out and concentrated to be stored, the overall working efficiency is improved, and the trouble of subsequent manual cleaning is reduced.

title_en: Textile cleaning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a textile cleaning device, which relates to the field of textile cleaning, and comprises a box body and textiles, wherein a partition plate is arranged in the box body and used for dividing the box body into two independent washing cavities and a flushing cavity, two sides of the box body are respectively provided with an entering groove and a leaving groove, the partition plate is provided with a strip-shaped groove, the textiles enter the washing cavity through the entering groove and then enter the flushing cavity through the strip-shaped groove and finally leave the box body through the leaving groove, a cleaning component is arranged in the washing cavity and used for cleaning the textiles, and a flushing component is arranged in the flushing cavity. The cleaning assembly has the beneficial effects that the cleaning assembly is used for cleaning the surface of the textile, the cleaning assembly is matched with the washing liquid to ensure that the textile is cleaned, the cleaned textile enters the washing cavity, the surface foam of the textile can be removed through washing of the washing assembly, the washing liquid is prevented from remaining on the surface of the textile, and the quality of the textile is ensured.

title_en: Bag conveying device of plastic woven bag cutting, sleeving and sewing integrated machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bag transporting device of a plastic woven bag cutting, sleeving and sewing integrated machine, which comprises a frame, wherein a conveying belt is arranged in the frame, two first pressing and holding assemblies are symmetrically arranged above the conveying belt, each first pressing and holding assembly comprises a first mounting plate which is of a U-shaped structure, two first driving wheels which are symmetrically connected in the first mounting plate in a rotating mode and a first driving belt which is arranged between the first driving wheels, a gap is formed between the bottom of each first driving belt and the conveying belt, two second pressing and holding assemblies are symmetrically arranged at the top of the frame and are positioned on one side of the first mounting plate, each second pressing and holding assembly comprises a second mounting plate which can move up and down and is of a U-shaped structure, two second driving wheels which are symmetrically connected in the second mounting plate in a rotating mode and a second driving belt which is arranged between the second driving wheels. Through above-mentioned structure, simple structure, conveying efficiency are high, can effectively promote the production efficiency of plastic woven sack, and the practicality is strong.

title_en: Antifouling seal
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-fouling seal which comprises a seal seat and a handle arranged at the top of the seal seat, wherein the bottom of the seal seat is provided with a mounting hole, a telescopic rod is movably arranged in the mounting hole, the upper end of the telescopic rod is connected with the lower end of an elastic piece, the upper end of the elastic piece is connected with the inner end of the mounting hole, when the handle is pressed, the telescopic rod is retracted into the mounting hole, the elastic piece is contracted, when the handle is released, the elastic piece is extended, the lower end of the telescopic rod is driven to extend out of the mounting hole by the elastic piece, after the seal is finished, the seal seat is not required to be covered on the seal seat, the seal can be directly and vertically placed on a table top or a paper surface, the seal surface on the seal seat does not pollute the table top or the paper surface, the trouble of repeatedly taking the seal seat off the seal seat or covering the seal seat when a plurality of seals is covered can be avoided, and the operation is convenient.

title_en: Substrate encapsulation device and substrate printing equipment using same
abstract_en: The utility model provides a substrate encapsulation device and substrate printing equipment using the same, wherein the substrate encapsulation device comprises a roller mounting seat, a pair of bearing bases, a bearing pressing plate, a locking piece and a locking piece, wherein the pair of bearing bases are arranged on two sides of the roller mounting seat at intervals, roller mounting grooves are formed in the tops of the bearing bases, the locking piece is arranged on one side of the roller mounting grooves, the bearing pressing plate can be installed on the tops of the bearing bases in a turnover mode, the locking piece is installed on the bearing pressing plate and matched with the locking piece, and when two ends of an encapsulation roller are rotatably installed in the corresponding roller mounting grooves, the bearing pressing plate is turned close to the roller mounting grooves and matched with the locking piece through the locking piece, so that the bearing pressing plate is locked on the bearing base, and the encapsulation roller is sealed between the roller mounting grooves and the bearing pressing plate. The rubber covered roller of the substrate rubber covered device provided by the utility model is convenient to assemble and disassemble and maintain, can correct the position and angle offset of the rubber covered roller relative to a target substrate, and can scrape excessive ink on the surface of the rubber covered roller, thereby improving rubber covered precision.

title_en: Novel roller spindle nose
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel roller shaft head, which comprises a roller, wherein the left side of the roller is detachably provided with a shaft head, and the roller and the shaft head are positioned at the same axis. According to the utility model, the shaft head and the roller can be conveniently detached, and when the shaft head and the roller are detached, only the handle is required to be rotated anticlockwise, so that the threaded clamping rod moves to the right side in the threaded sleeve, the threaded clamping rod is separated from the clamping groove, then the baffle plate is pulled upwards, the limiting block can be driven to move upwards, and then the limiting block is separated from the second through groove, the limiting port and the first through groove, so that the limiting block is taken down, the shaft head is pulled leftwards, and the insert block is separated from the slot, so that the shaft head and the roller can be detached, the operation is simple, time and labor are saved, and great convenience is provided for a user.

title_en: Multitube way mill base discharge mechanism and duplex pulp mixing system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a multi-pipeline color paste discharging mechanism and a double-station paste mixing system, wherein the discharging mechanism comprises a discharging plate, a plurality of through holes are distributed on the discharging plate, discharging connectors are arranged in the through holes, the upper end and the lower extreme that the ejection of compact connects all are provided with the pagoda and connect, and upper end pagoda connects and is connected with the conveying pipeline, and lower extreme pagoda connects and is connected with the ejection of compact mouth. The multi-pipeline color paste discharging mechanism can be connected with a plurality of conveying pipelines, and meanwhile, the discharging nozzle at the lower end is convenient for discharging and is suitable for centralized conveying of various printing slurries. The double-station paste mixing system comprises a plurality of dye tanks, a plurality of conveying pumps and two sets of discharging mechanisms, can realize automatic quantitative paste conveying, efficiently prepares printing paste with different colors, and has high conveying efficiency and small operation error.

title_en: Dynamic compensation three-roller pressing mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of embossing rollers, and particularly relates to a dynamic compensation three-roller embossing mechanism, which comprises a roller shaft support, wherein an embossing roller with an embossing layer on the surface is horizontally installed on the roller shaft support, a rubber roller and a smooth roller are respectively installed on two sides of the embossing roller, two ends of the rubber roller are connected with sliding seats, the sliding seats are sleeved in sliding grooves, the sliding seats are in driving connection with telescopic cylinders, the embossing roller is in driving connection with rotary servo, and the rotary servo and the telescopic cylinders are electrically connected with an industrial control module. The embossing roller mechanism provided by the utility model utilizes the rotating speed of the hydraulic cylinder linked embossing roller to adjust the compaction and relaxation of the rubber roller, ensures stable operation of equipment, can quickly adjust the distance among the embossing roller, the rubber roller and the smooth roller along the chute, supports two embossing modes, and has strong adaptability.

title_en: Water jet loom line pressing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a line pressing device of a water-jet loom, which relates to the technical field of line pressing of the water-jet loom, and comprises a base, wherein a line pressing assembly is arranged at the top end of the base, a cleaning assembly is arranged on the outer wall of the line pressing assembly, the line pressing assembly comprises two shells, a first screw rod and a second screw rod are respectively rotatably arranged on the inner walls of the two shells, one ends of the outer walls of the first screw rod and the second screw rod respectively penetrate through one ends of the outer walls of the two shells, driving wheels are fixedly arranged on the outer walls of the two driving wheels, a belt is sleeved on the outer walls of the two driving wheels, the cleaning assembly comprises two sliding rods and a sliding block, a cleaning ring is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the sliding block, the first screw rod and the second screw rod are arranged to enable two lead rollers on two sides to drive yarns to ascend, the middle line pressing rollers drive the yarns to descend, and the path of the yarns to change greatly, so that the tension adjusting range of the yarns is increased, and impurities on the surfaces of the line pressing rollers can be removed by sliding cleaning rings.

title_en: Finished product drying device after books printing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of book drying, and discloses a finished product drying device after book printing, which comprises a base, wherein one side of the base is provided with a first servo motor, the output end of the first servo motor is sleeved with a gear, one side of the gear is connected with a toothed ring in a meshed manner, the inside of the toothed ring is fixedly connected with a circular ring, and the inside of the circular ring is uniformly provided with second servo motors at intervals. According to the utility model, when the device is used, the second servo motor drives the threaded rod to move the supporting plate, the bolt is used for driving the pressing plate to move, books with different sizes are firmly fixed, the books are ensured to be kept stable in the drying process, deformation is prevented, the quality of finished products is improved, meanwhile, the third servo motor drives the books to rotate, the books are ensured to be heated uniformly under the infrared heater, the drying time is shortened, the production efficiency is improved, the damage of the books caused by local overheating is effectively avoided, and the quality of the books is ensured.

title_en: Gravure press scraper edulcoration mechanism
abstract_en: The application discloses a gravure press scraper impurity removing mechanism, which relates to the technical field of impurity removing mechanisms and comprises a cutter holder, wherein a scraping knife is arranged at one end of the cutter holder, the cutter holder is connected with a sliding seat in a sliding manner, a guide structure is connected between the cutter holder and the sliding seat, the cutter holder is connected with a moving piece for driving the sliding seat to slide, and the sliding seat is connected with a scraping rod for abutting against the scraping knife. The moving part drives the tool apron to slide, namely the scraping rod moves along with the movement of the tool apron, and the guide structure plays a role in guiding the sliding of the tool apron, so that the stability of the sliding of the tool apron is improved, namely the stability of the sliding of the scraping rod is improved, the effect of the scraping rod in scraping impurities attached to the scraping knife is improved, and the scraping rod is prevented from touching paper in the moving process.

title_en: Paperboard cutting device for packaging box production and processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a paperboard cutting device for producing and processing a packaging box, which comprises a cabinet, wherein a workbench is arranged on the upper surface of the cabinet, upper upright posts are fixedly arranged on two sides of the upper surface of the workbench through welding, a supporting transverse plate is fixedly arranged between the top ends of the two upper upright posts, a cutting frame is arranged below the supporting transverse plate, bearing seats are fixedly arranged at two ends of the lower surface of the cutting frame, a threaded screw rod is rotationally connected between the two bearing seats, the threaded screw rod is a positive and negative type screw rod, sliding seats are in threaded connection with the outer surfaces of the two ends of the threaded screw rod, connecting columns are fixedly arranged on the lower surfaces of the two sliding seats, and a cutter rest is fixedly arranged at the bottom ends of the connecting columns.

title_en: Bio-based high-elasticity body-shaping fabric
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fabrics, in particular to a bio-based high-elastic body-shaping fabric, which comprises a warp knitting body and a PLA electrostatic spinning nano microporous membrane, wherein the PLA electrostatic spinning nano microporous membrane is compounded on the inner surface of the warp knitting body, the warp knitting body is formed by warp knitting of a guide bar GB1 and a guide bar GB2, the guide bar GB1 adopts bio-based nylon 56 yarns to be woven into open warp plain tissues, and the guide bar GB2 adopts spandex yarns to be woven into heavy warp tissues. The fabric has the advantages of compact structure, excellent stretching rebound performance, good elastic recovery rate, small plastic deformation rate, ventilation, moisture permeability, water resistance, antibacterial function and the like, is combined with the swimwear fabric, effectively protects skin and mucous membrane in complex environments such as sea swimming, swimming pools and the like, has good biocompatibility, and meets the requirements of trauma, patients after plastic surgery, nursing period posture resumptors and the like.

title_en: Ink stack assembly and ink jet printer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an ink stack assembly and an ink jet printer, which relate to the technical field of printers, wherein the ink stack assembly comprises an ink stack, an infusion pipeline and a liquid discharge pipeline, the ink stack comprises a supporting seat, an ink stack platform and an ink pad, the ink stack platform is arranged on the supporting seat, the ink pad is arranged on the ink stack platform and is used for cleaning and/or moisturizing a nozzle of a printing head, the infusion pipeline is communicated with the ink pad to provide liquid for the ink pad, the liquid discharge pipeline is communicated with the ink pad to discharge waste liquid of the ink pad, and a limiting structure is arranged on the supporting seat and/or the ink stack platform and is connected with the infusion pipeline and the liquid discharge pipeline to limit the direction of the infusion pipeline and the liquid discharge pipeline in the supporting seat. The technical scheme provided by the utility model can improve the arrangement rationality of the infusion pipeline and the liquid discharge pipeline.

title_en: Coiling device for water-jet loom
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of coiling devices, and discloses a coiling device for a water-jet loom, which comprises a frame, wherein an adjusting mechanism is arranged on the frame and comprises a supporting plate, a screw rod, screw hole blocks, through holes, a limiting groove, a lifting frame and a cloth guide roller, wherein the supporting plate is fixedly arranged at the top of the frame, the top end of the screw rod is rotatably connected to the supporting plate through a bearing, the screw hole blocks are sleeved on the outer wall of the screw rod in a threaded manner, the through holes are formed in the frame, the limiting groove is formed in two sides of the inner wall of the through holes, the inner wall of the limiting groove is slidably connected with limiting blocks, the limiting blocks are fixedly connected with the screw hole blocks, and the lifting frame is fixedly connected with the screw hole blocks. The cloth guide roller can guide the fabric to smoothly enter the winding drum, and can adapt to fabrics with different thicknesses at the same time so as to adjust the tension of the fabric in the transmission process and avoid the damage of the fabric caused by excessive stretching.

title_en: Crimping device with damping function for needle group
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a thread pressing device with a damping function for a needle group, which comprises a transverse installation pipe, wherein a plurality of limit angle plates are installed on the upper end face of the transverse installation pipe, an elastic corrugated pipe is arranged on the inner side of the limit angle plate, a transmission rod is installed at the bottom end of the elastic corrugated pipe, a rubber connecting plate is installed on the inner side of the upper end of the transmission rod, damping plates are slidably connected to the two sides of each rubber connecting plate, a plurality of damping bulges are arranged on one side, close to each damping plate, of each two adjacent damping plates, an installation sleeve plate is installed on the outer side of each damping plate, a double-head positioning plate is installed at the bottom end of the transmission rod, and a connecting angle plate is installed on the rear end face of each double-head positioning plate. According to the utility model, the spinning thread in the conveying state is automatically damped and regulated, so that the tightening state of the spinning thread can be effectively maintained, the spinning quality is improved, the positioning and pressing of the spinning thread are facilitated, and the replacement and conveying stability of the spinning thread are further improved.

title_en: T-shirt top fly lining cloth clamp
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a T-shirt front piece lining cloth clamp which comprises a front piece supporting component used for clamping a T-shirt front piece, a front piece positioning component arranged in the front piece supporting component and used for pressing the front piece lining cloth, and a base which is arranged at the end of the front piece positioning component and connected with a computer pattern machine, wherein the front piece positioning component comprises a left front piece positioning piece and a right front piece positioning piece which are arranged in parallel, a left adjusting piece and a right adjusting piece which are connected with the base are correspondingly arranged at the rear ends of the left front piece positioning piece and the right front piece positioning piece, a left elastic pressing plate and a right elastic pressing plate are respectively and correspondingly arranged at the left front piece side edge and the right front piece side edge of an opening, the bottom edges of the left elastic pressing plate and the right elastic pressing plate are pressed on the left front piece and the right front piece under the action of a corresponding left spring hinge and a right spring hinge, the lining cloth is prevented from shifting, stitching lines are respectively stitched along the side edges of the left elastic pressing plate and the right elastic pressing plate, the stitching lines are neatly straightened, the accuracy of a manual line is ensured, and the working procedures of positioning and cutting pieces are saved.

title_en: Button sewing structure of button sewing machine
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the application field of button sewing machines, and particularly relates to a button sewing structure of a button sewing machine, which comprises a base, wherein one end of the base is provided with a first mounting plate and a second mounting plate, the upper part of the base is provided with a motor, one side of the motor, which is fixed on the first mounting plate, is fixedly connected through a fixing rod, a buffer bracket is arranged between the first mounting plate and the second mounting plate, two sides of the buffer bracket are respectively clamped in empty clamping grooves in the middle parts of the first mounting plate and the second mounting plate, a button sewing die is further arranged at the lower part between the first mounting plate and the second mounting plate, the button sewing die penetrates through the base and is clamped on the buffer bracket to reduce abrasion of the button sewing die in operation, a new operation system is formed between the second connecting rod and the button sewing die by adopting a first connecting rod, and the stability in the button sewing process is improved.

title_en: Production is with surface spouting sign indicating number device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a surface code spraying device for production, which belongs to the technical field of surface code spraying and comprises a code spraying machine, wherein a dust removal warning structure is arranged on the code spraying machine, the dust removal warning structure comprises a mounting shell and a switch, the mounting shell is mounted on one side of the code spraying machine, a push knife is connected in a sliding manner in the mounting shell, and a sliding groove is formed in the mounting shell. Through setting up dust removal warning structure, the push broach scrapes the attached dust on injection molding goods surface, the code spraying of being convenient for of ink jet numbering machine, in addition, when injection molding goods surface has the bump, push broach tangential bump, if directly cut, then injection molding goods continue to remove and spout the code, if the cutter is supported by the bump, then spring atress compression, finally, lead to first slide extrusion to the switch, thereby by switch control siren ring, and then the effect of reminding the staff has been reached, the existence of dust, the bump has avoided as far as possible influences the evenness and the integrality of injection molding goods surface code spraying.

title_en: Carton processing is with high-efficient carton folding device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of carton folding operation, in particular to a high-efficiency carton folding device for processing cartons, which comprises a feeding table, wherein the front surface of the feeding table is fixedly connected with a processing table, the top of the feeding table is provided with a feeding frame, a moving column is fixedly connected between the feeding table and the processing table, the top of the processing table is provided with a folding component, the folding component is used for folding the cartons, further, the cartons are moved into a conveying roller through a tray on a moving seat, the conveying of the cartons is completed through the rotation of the conveying roller, scratches or wrinkles on the surfaces of the cartons in the conveying process can be avoided, a sliding block is driven to move through a hydraulic cylinder, the cartons are conveyed into the folding component through a sucker, the cartons are limited through a clamping plate, and the folding of the cartons is completed through a folding plate.

title_en: Heat sealing device with fold prevention function for raincoat production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a heat sealing device with a wrinkle preventing function for raincoat production, which comprises a wrinkle removing mechanism and a heat sealing plate arranged at the bottom of the wrinkle removing mechanism, wherein a fixed stretching mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the wrinkle removing mechanism, a fixed support is symmetrically arranged at the top of the fixed stretching mechanism, the wrinkle removing mechanism comprises a heat sealing fixed rod, a supporting top plate is fixedly arranged at the top of the heat sealing fixed rod, a lifting cylinder is fixedly arranged at the center of the bottom of the supporting top plate, a lifting plate is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the lifting cylinder, a supporting block is fixedly arranged at the center of the bottom of the lifting plate, a heat sealing plate is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the supporting block, a lifting sliding sleeve is fixedly arranged around the lifting plate, and the characteristics of sliding connection of the wrinkle removing sliding rod and the wrinkle removing sliding sleeve in the wrinkle removing support are utilized to drive the wrinkle removing sliding sleeve and the wrinkle removing pressing plate to move when the wrinkle removing rotating rod rotates, so that the raincoat can be primarily removed.

title_en: Indentation device for processing packaging box
abstract_en: The utility model provides an indentation device for processing a packaging box, which comprises a frame, wherein a feeding conveyor belt and a discharging conveyor belt are respectively arranged on two sides of the frame, an indentation mechanism is arranged in the middle of the frame and comprises an indentation roller arranged in the middle of the frame and a squeeze roller arranged right above the indentation roller, a plurality of indentation grooves are formed in the outer surface of the indentation roller, a pressing block and a transverse adjusting mechanism for adjusting the pressing block are arranged on the outer surface of the squeeze roller, fixing frames are respectively arranged on two sides of the top of the frame, vertical adjusting mechanisms are respectively arranged in the middle of the two fixing frames, and driving ends of the two vertical adjusting mechanisms are respectively fixedly connected with two ends of the squeeze roller. The device drives the fixed block through electric putter, makes the squeeze roll can reciprocate in the movable tank, can be applicable to the packing carton of different thickness, slides on the slide bar through the briquetting, and the position of setting is fixed to the briquetting on the slide bar with the nut mounting to the adjustability of press mold position is realized.

title_en: Folding bag discharging structure of plastic bag making machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a folding bag discharging structure of a plastic bag making machine, which comprises a workbench and a folding bag discharging structure, wherein the folding bag discharging structure is used for transversely folding and longitudinally folding a plastic bag, the folding bag discharging structure comprises two folding parts, the folding parts comprise a pushing component, a folding plate is arranged at the output end of the pushing component, a strip-shaped through hole matched with the folding plate is formed in the workbench, a conveying component is arranged on the workbench of the longitudinally arranged folding part, a conveying component is arranged on the workbench of the transversely arranged folding part, and an adjustable sensing device is arranged on the workbench along the advancing direction of a plastic film.

title_en: Plane stretching machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a plane stretching machine, which belongs to the technical field of leather detection and comprises a frame, at least three execution pieces which are uniformly distributed on the same plane on the frame, wherein each execution piece is connected with the frame in a sliding manner and moves in a power driving manner, the moving direction of each execution piece points to the centers of a plurality of execution pieces, clamps connected with the execution pieces on the plurality of execution pieces are respectively used for clamping edges of leather to be processed, the leather is stretched through coordinated movement of the plurality of execution pieces, and the leather edges are uniformly clamped and pulled through the coordinated movement of the plurality of execution pieces and the clamps connected with the execution pieces, so that the leather can be sufficiently stretched, and the accuracy of leather flaw detection is improved.

title_en: Full-automatic corrugated paper nailing production line
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a full-automatic corrugated paper nailing production line which comprises a conveyor belt, wherein the conveyor belt is driven by a driving roller, a cleaning roller is arranged below the conveyor belt at the bottom of the driving roller, bristles are arranged on the surface of the cleaning roller, the bristles of the cleaning roller are attached to the conveyor belt, a cleaning spray pipe is arranged on one side of the cleaning roller in the moving direction of the conveyor belt, one end of a spray head of the cleaning spray pipe is close to the conveyor belt, a box nailing mechanism is arranged above the conveyor belt at the upper end of the driving roller, two ends of the driving roller are respectively provided with a mounting frame, two ends of the driving roller are respectively connected with one mounting frame in a rotating manner, a supporting leg is fixedly connected with the mounting frame, one side of the mounting frame, which is far away from the driving roller, is fixedly connected with a box nailing mechanism, and two ends of the box nailing mechanism are respectively provided with an inlet and an outlet.

title_en: Reeling machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of silk processing, in particular to a silk reeling machine, which comprises a rack and a tray, wherein the tray is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the rack, a plurality of silk drawing mechanisms are uniformly arranged at intervals on the rack, and each silk drawing mechanism comprises a thread hooking component, a porcelain eye, an upper drum, a lower drum, a positioning drum, a cutting prevention drum and a small drum The small part Driven by a first motor, the yarn sequentially passes through the yarn hooking component, the porcelain eye, the upper drum, the lower drum, the cutting prevention drum and the positioning drum to be wound on the small yarn A brake mechanism is also arranged to brake the small part when the porcelain eye is lifted The silk reeling machine can effectively avoid the silk from being broken, and improves the silk reeling efficiency.

title_en: Twisting device for polyester knitting grey cloth
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a polyester knitting grey cloth twisting device which comprises a protective box, wherein an installation plate is detachably arranged on the inner wall of the bottom of the protective box through bolts, a twisting component is arranged at the top of the installation plate, the twisting component comprises an installation shaft coaxially fixed on the outer wall of the top of the installation plate, a toothed belt wheel is rotatably connected to the circumferential outer wall of the installation shaft through a bearing, a plurality of extending plates distributed at equal intervals are arranged on the circumferential outer wall of the toothed belt wheel, a gear rod is rotatably connected to the outer wall of the top of the extending plate, a toothed ring is coaxially fixed on the outer wall of the top of the installation plate, a plurality of gear rods are meshed with the toothed ring, and a collecting ring is coaxially fixed on the outer wall of the top of the toothed belt wheel.

title_en: Oil tank transmission structure of artificial lawn mower
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an oil tank transmission structure of an artificial lawn machine, which comprises a first needle bed, a second needle bed and an oil tank, wherein the first needle bed and the second needle bed are arranged in parallel at intervals in the front-back direction of the machine, the first needle bed is driven by a first driving mechanism to move up and down in the vertical direction, the second needle bed is driven by a second driving mechanism to move up and down in the vertical direction, and the oil tank transmission structure also comprises an oil tank traversing mechanism for driving the oil tank to traverse back and forth in the front-back direction of the machine. The oil tank sideslip mechanism preferably comprises a sideslip motor, a screw rod, a nut, a sideslip guide rail and a sideslip slide block, wherein the screw rod is connected with an output shaft of the sideslip motor, the screw rod and the sideslip guide rail are arranged along the front machine and the rear machine direction of the lawn mower, the sideslip motor and the sideslip guide rail are respectively and fixedly arranged on a frame, the nut and the sideslip slide block are fixedly arranged on a bottom plate of the oil tank, and the sideslip slide block is in sliding fit with the sideslip guide rail. The utility model can ensure that the first needle bed and the second needle bed can accurately change to the working position to work, thereby improving the lawn quality.

title_en: Rib cuff guider combination accurate frame
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of rib cuff production and processing, in particular to a rib cuff guiding device combined accurate frame. The combined accurate matching frame comprises a main body installation supporting plate in the horizontal direction, wherein a combined accurate matching frame which is symmetrically distributed in the front-back direction is arranged at the upper end of the main body installation supporting plate, a cylindrical first combined stop column is arranged at the position close to the left side of the front surface of the combined accurate matching frame, a cylindrical second installation matching column is arranged at the position close to the right side of the upper end of the combined accurate matching frame, a cylindrical third installation combined column is arranged at the position close to the lower end of the right side of the combined accurate matching frame, and the central shaft of the second installation matching column is positioned above the plane where the upper end face of the combined accurate matching frame is positioned. The utility model has the advantages that the utility model can realize the matching installation of the multi-position guide structures with different heights, ensures the combination connection precision among different positions, has better matching stability during installation and has higher overall space utilization rate.

title_en: Spray painting device for football leather
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of football leather processing, and discloses a spray painting device for football leather, which comprises a spray painting table, wherein the upper surface of the spray painting table is fixedly connected with a mounting plate, the upper surface of the mounting plate is provided with a mounting groove, one side of the mounting plate is fixedly provided with a stepping motor, the output end of the stepping motor is fixedly connected with a screw rod, the outer thread of the screw rod is connected with a moving block, the moving block is slidably connected in the mounting groove, the lower surface of the moving block is fixedly provided with a spray painting machine, and the lower surface of the spray painting table is provided with a limiting mechanism. The utility model is beneficial to limiting the movement or the deviation of the leather in the spray painting process, is convenient for the alignment of spray painting patterns and the leather, reduces the repeated adjustment of the leather position by operators, obviously improves the production efficiency, simultaneously is convenient for cleaning the flock particles adhered on the leather surface, improves the cleanliness of the leather surface, and reduces the problem of uneven leather surface after spray painting caused by residual flock on the leather surface.

title_en: Rapid fabric cutting equipment for processing running shoes
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of cutting equipment and discloses fabric rapid cutting equipment for processing running shoes, which comprises an operation table, wherein the top of the operation table is fixedly connected with a sliding seat, a cutting head is connected inside the sliding seat in a sliding manner, the top of the operation table is provided with a fixing component, two sides of the operation table are provided with adjusting components, the fixing component comprises a plurality of spring extrusion plates, the spring extrusion plates are positioned at the top of the operation table, two sides of the top of the operation table are fixedly connected with a first supporting frame, two sides of the top of each supporting frame are fixedly connected with a telescopic cylinder, and the output end of each telescopic cylinder is fixedly connected with a second supporting frame. According to the utility model, the first sliding chute in the first connecting plate is driven to move by the electric telescopic rod, the spacing between the connecting blocks is adjusted, the spring extrusion plates are ensured to be accurately distributed at the top of the fabric, the telescopic cylinder is used for driving the spring extrusion plates to extrude and fix the fabric, and the stability of the fabric in the cutting process is enhanced.

title_en: Feeding structure of ink-jet printing machine and ink-jet printing machine
abstract_en: The utility model provides a feeding structure of an inkjet printing machine and the inkjet printing machine, and relates to the technical field of the structure of the inkjet printing machine, wherein the feeding structure of the inkjet printing machine comprises a main body, a conveyor belt, a detection assembly and a controller; the main body is internally provided with the ink-jet assembly, the conveyor belt is provided with a starting end and a feeding end, the starting end is positioned outside the main body, the feeding end is positioned below the ink-jet assembly, the conveyor belt is provided with a bearing surface for attaching a substrate, the detection assemblies are arranged on one side of the conveyor belt and can detect the surface of the substrate for multiple times, the detection assemblies can form multiple detection lines, and the detection accuracy and stability are higher.

title_en: Yarn water feeding device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a yarn water feeding device which comprises a deformation box body, wherein a water outlet rod and a deformation nozzle are arranged on the deformation box body, a counter bore is formed in the front end of the water outlet rod, a hollow yarn guiding porcelain piece is embedded in the counter bore, a circle of water storage grooves are reserved around the yarn guiding porcelain piece, the depth of the water storage grooves is larger than the height of the yarn guiding porcelain piece, and the yarn passes through the yarn guiding porcelain piece and the deformation nozzle. The yarn wetting device can be used for completing the soaking of the filaments in water when the filaments pass through the wetting device, meanwhile, the water flow is not wasted due to the fact that the water flow is completely taken away by the yarns, the normal wetting function of each filament is maintained, meanwhile, the waste water generation on the air-texturing machine is reduced, the filament yarn water feeding effect is stable, and the waste of the waste water is greatly reduced.

title_en: 3D mesh hole socks vamp
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a 3D mesh sock vamp, which comprises a vamp main body, wherein the vamp main body is provided with a mesh area, the mesh area is formed by alternately weaving high-melting-point fiber A1 wires and low-melting-point thermal fuse A2 wires through a weft knitting process, the A2 wires form a mesh after being heated and melted, and the A1 wires form a supporting mesh structure due to curling characteristics. According to the sock shoes, in the aspect of perspiration and ventilation, the 3D three-dimensional structure can form a smoother air circulation channel, the air mobility in the shoes is effectively improved, the moisture and heat generated by feet are accelerated to be discharged, the perspiration and ventilation effects are remarkably improved, the feet are kept dry and comfortable, the 3D three-dimensional design is adopted, the traditional planar net structure is abandoned, the appearance of the shoes is more fashionable and unique, and the pursuit of modern consumers on individuation and aesthetic feeling is met.

title_en: Corrugated carton indentation device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a corrugated case creasing device in the technical field of corrugated case creasing, which comprises a supporting substrate, wherein a carton squeezing assembly is arranged at the top of the supporting substrate, corrugated paper boards are arranged between the supporting substrate and the carton squeezing assembly, the carton squeezing assembly comprises two groups of connecting plate bodies, guide connecting parts are arranged at the bottoms of the two groups of connecting plate bodies, a squeezing roller is further connected between the two groups of guide connecting parts, the guide connecting parts comprise a first connector, a second connector is arranged at the bottom of the first connector, a compression spring is connected between the first connector and the second connector, a driver is further arranged at one side of one group of the second connectors, and the driver is in transmission connection with the squeezing roller.

title_en: Seal clamping device and seal machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a seal clamping device, which relates to the technical field of seals and comprises a cylinder for storing the seals, an auxiliary clamping ring and a plurality of clamping pieces, wherein the auxiliary clamping ring is arranged in the cylinder and surrounds the inner wall of the cylinder, an inner hole of the auxiliary clamping ring is used for accommodating the seals, and the clamping pieces penetrate through the side wall of the cylinder and are abutted with the peripheral wall of the auxiliary clamping ring so as to clamp the auxiliary clamping ring in the cylinder. The utility model uses a plurality of clamping pieces to apply clamping force to the auxiliary clamping ring to clamp the auxiliary clamping ring in the cylinder body. The auxiliary clamping ring can enable the seal to be more stable in the clamp, and prevents shaking, displacement and other conditions in the stamping process. Simultaneously, the seal with different sizes can be adapted through the auxiliary clamping ring, and the seal mounting and dismounting device is simple in structure and easy to operate.

title_en: Side printing machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of cylindrical workpiece surface printing equipment, in particular to a side surface printer which comprises a transfer manipulator, a printing jig and a printer head, wherein the printing jig comprises a mounting seat, a material carrying assembly, a first driving assembly, a material pressing assembly and a fine adjustment assembly, the material carrying assembly is arranged on the mounting seat and is used for fine adjustment of the mounting seat, the material carrying assembly comprises a trough and a first air passage, the first air passage is communicated with the trough, the trough is provided with a notch, the notch is arranged on the side wall of the trough and is used for accommodating an external workpiece, the first driving assembly is arranged on the mounting seat and is used for driving the material carrying assembly to rotate so that the notch is upwards, the material pressing assembly is arranged on the mounting seat and is positioned below the material carrying assembly and is used for pressing the external workpiece in the trough, the transfer manipulator is used for transferring the external workpiece into the trough, and the printer head is positioned above the printing jig, and the production efficiency and the controllability of the production quality stability are improved.

title_en: Printing device for clothing manufacture
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of printing devices, in particular to a printing device for clothing manufacture, which is characterized in that the upper end of a bed body is rotationally connected with a left-right direction conveyor belt, the front side and the rear side of the upper end of the bed body are fixedly connected with vertical rods, the upper ends of the two vertical rods are fixedly connected with a longitudinal rod, a printing component is vertically and slidingly connected between the two vertical rods, a driving component for driving the printing component is arranged on the longitudinal rod, the printing component comprises vertical grooves formed in the opposite ends of the two vertical rods, connecting rods which are longitudinally arranged are vertically and slidingly matched with the two vertical grooves, the lower ends of the connecting rods are fixedly connected with a plurality of vertical shafts which are longitudinally and equally arranged at intervals, and printing dies corresponding to the conveyor belt are coaxially and detachably connected to the lower ends of the vertical shafts.

title_en: Automatic control printer ink concentration equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of ink concentration control of a printer, in particular to an automatic control printer ink concentration device which comprises an ink barrel and an ink concentration detection assembly arranged on one side of the ink barrel, wherein the ink barrel is also communicated with a solvent supplementing assembly, the ink concentration detection assembly and the solvent supplementing assembly are electrically connected with a control system, the control system is communicated with the ink concentration detection assembly, the ink concentration detection assembly is arranged on one side of the ink barrel, so that the ink concentration value in the ink barrel can be monitored in real time through the ink concentration detection assembly, and the control system drives the solvent supplementing assembly to release solvent to the ink barrel, thereby automatically regulating the ink concentration in the ink barrel in real time, improving the production line working efficiency and accurately regulating the ink concentration to a required range.

title_en: Cutter fixing mechanism of thermal printer
abstract_en: The application discloses a cutter fixing mechanism of a thermal printer, which comprises an upper shell body, a transmission assembly and a pressing sheet, wherein a lower shell body is fixedly arranged on the outer side of the upper shell body through a screw, an insert is fixedly arranged in the middle of the lower end of the upper shell body, the transmission assembly is arranged in the upper shell body, the pressing sheet is fixedly arranged in the lower shell body, a blade support is arranged on the outer side of one end, close to the lower shell body, of the pressing sheet, and a blade body is fixedly arranged on the outer side of the blade support. The application belongs to the technical field of cutters of thermal printers, and aims to solve the problems that the whole blade body is complicated to assemble and the occupied area is large in the prior art, so that the space and the cost of the thermal printer are increased. The blade body can be assembled conveniently, the occupied area is reduced, and the space and the cost of the thermal printer are saved during writing.

title_en: Receiving device for electrostatic spinning machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a receiving device for an electrostatic spinning machine, which belongs to the field of electrostatic spinning equipment and comprises a cylindrical receiving roller, wherein a receiving surface is formed on the circumferential surface of the receiving roller, a slot is formed at the top end of the receiving surface, a fixing plate is embedded in the slot, the fixing plate comprises a first plate and a second plate which are bonded front and back, the lower end of the first plate is bent backwards to form an abutting end, the upper surface of the abutting end is bonded with the lower end of the second plate, the rear end of the abutting end is abutted with the inner side wall of the slot, a flexible rubber layer is arranged on the front side of the first plate, a flexible rubber layer is arranged on the rear side of the second plate, and the flexible rubber layers on the first plate and the second plate are bonded with the inner side wall of the slot. The utility model completes the fixing process of the base material by the slot structure at the inner side of the receiving roller, and can not influence the surface of the receiving roller.

title_en: Stable output plastic bag making equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides bag making equipment for stably outputting plastic bags, which relates to the technical field of plastic bags and comprises a base, wherein a deviation rectifying assembly is fixedly connected to the center of the top of the base, a detection assembly is fixedly connected to the position of the top of the base, which is positioned on the right side of the deviation rectifying assembly, the deviation rectifying assembly comprises a deviation rectifying roller and two adjusting seats, two ends of the deviation rectifying roller are rotatably connected with mounting seats, the inner surfaces of the two mounting seats are fixedly connected with rotating seats, and the positions of two sensors can be adjusted under the action of a motor, a support frame, a moving block, a bidirectional screw rod and a sliding rod.

title_en: Consumable chip, chip assembly and consumable box
abstract_en: The application provides a consumable chip which is used for being installed in imaging equipment and is characterized by comprising at least one conductive part, a plurality of probe contact parts and an auxiliary part, wherein the at least one conductive part is connected with an electronic module of the consumable chip and is not used for being contacted with probes on the imaging equipment side, the plurality of probe contact parts are used for being contacted with the probes on the imaging equipment side, at least one probe contact part of the consumable chip is electrically disconnected from the electronic module in an initial state, and the auxiliary part is used for carrying out initialization recovery on a modified chip when necessary so as to at least solve the technical problem of poor upgrading resistance of the existing partial consumable chip.

title_en: Negative pressure energy-saving control device for cotton suction pipe of spinning frame
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a negative pressure energy-saving control device for a cotton suction air pipe of a spinning frame, which relates to the technical field of cotton suction negative pressure of the spinning frame and comprises a connecting block, wherein the top of the connecting block is fixedly connected with a cotton suction mechanism, one side of the top of a support frame is fixedly connected with a frequency converter, one side of the frequency converter is fixedly connected with a first wire, one end of the first wire is fixedly connected with a controller, the bottom of the controller is fixedly connected with a broken wire detection device, and the inside of the support frame is movably connected with an air pipe structure. According to the utility model, the threaded connecting cylinder connected with the threaded rod is moved left and right by driving the motor to rotate, so that the device is moved left and right on the mounting platform, the device is convenient to adjust the position, meanwhile, the yarn twisting range is enlarged, the cotton suction fan in the negative pressure system can operate at a lower frequency, the working energy consumption is greatly reduced, the heat generated by the rotation of the rotating motor is discharged from the discharge pipe, the hot air is not discharged to the yarn, and the yarn breakage is prevented.

title_en: Rope binding machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rope binding machine which comprises a frame, wherein a power transmission cam mounting bottom plate is fixedly connected to the inside of the frame, a plane plate is fixedly connected to the top of the frame, an upper housing is fixedly connected to the top of the plane plate, a paper bag moving platform is arranged on the inner side of the plane plate, and a rope penetrating mechanism is arranged on the upper surface of the plane plate and positioned on one side of the paper bag moving platform. Belongs to the technical field. This rope machine of ordering, after starting, the container bag moving platform sends the whole stack container bag into the lathe in, the container bag is worn to the rope needle, then press the rope module to start the rope clamping piece and clip the rope head that passes, the rope needle returns, then the knot is tied the knot and is turned round the rope that passes and twist the knot, the rope that the knot was tied is taut to the tight hook of rethread rope head of tying, cut the rope tail end with the scissors simultaneously, and the container bag moving platform returns and accomplishes the rope motion of wearing, with this cyclic reciprocation, compare manual rope efficiency higher, the cost of labor has been practiced thrift simultaneously.

title_en: Twisting positioning structure for coated yarns
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wrapped yarn twisting positioning structure, which relates to the technical field of wrapped yarn processing and comprises a roller assembly and a first positioning assembly, wherein a first positioning assembly is arranged on one side of the roller assembly, a second positioning assembly is arranged on one side frame of the roller assembly, which is far away from the first positioning assembly, and a twisting assembly is arranged in the middle of a stabilizing frame. This cladding yarn twisting location structure, through the structure setting of two-way lead screw, make can be to the roller of going up of last drive shaft bearing side and the roller of driving down of bearing frame side remove the regulation down in the vertical direction, with this control perpendicular interval each other, thereby the different yarn processing of adaptation, and the structure setting of first locating component, second locating component, the location separation effect when can furthest assist the roller subassembly to stranded yarn transport, avoid appearing the condition of mutual interference, in order to follow-up twisting component twines the yarn and operate.

title_en: Environment-friendly production device for digital label paper
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of digital label paper production and discloses an environment-friendly digital label paper production device which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a first mounting frame is fixedly connected to the top of the bottom plate, an unreeling roller is rotatably connected to the inner wall of the bottom plate, a second mounting frame is fixedly connected to the top of the bottom plate, a winding roller is rotatably connected to the inner wall of the second mounting frame, a first motor is fixedly connected to the front end of the second mounting frame, a shielding cover is fixedly connected to the top of the bottom plate, a filtering assembly is arranged at the upper end of the shielding cover, and a spraying assembly is arranged at the left end of the filtering assembly. According to the utility model, the negative pressure pump is started, the negative pressure pump sucks air in the shielding cover through the air suction pipe, the shunt pipe and the air collecting cover, then the air is discharged into the filter box through the exhaust pipe, harmful gas is filtered through the active carbon filter screen in the filter box, and then the filtered gas is discharged through the top of the filter box, so that the influence of the harmful gas on the working environment is avoided.

title_en: Cutting device for tent production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of tent production, in particular to a cutting device for tent production. The utility model provides a cutting device for tent production, which comprises a base, a cutting assembly, a smoothing assembly, a double-shaft motor, a feeding assembly, a collecting assembly, a controller and the like, wherein the cutting assembly is arranged at the upper part of the base, the smoothing assembly is arranged between the upper parts of the base, the right double-shaft motor is arranged at the rear side of the right part of the base, the controller is arranged at the front side of the right part of the base, and the collecting assembly comprises a material collecting frame, a spring piece, a first bevel gear, a second bevel gear, a driving roller, a collecting roller, a handle and a collecting frame. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the double-shaft motor, the collecting roller, the collecting frame and other parts, the double-shaft motor drives the collecting roller to roll the cut cloth, and the waste is brought into the collecting frame for collecting by the synchronous belt through the conveying of the cloth, so that the effect of automatically collecting the waste and the cut cloth is achieved.

title_en: Detachable sectional type weaving cylinder structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a detachable sectional type textile needle cylinder structure, which comprises a needle cylinder body, wherein the needle cylinder body comprises four first arc-shaped blocks, the four first arc-shaped blocks enclose a first needle cylinder body, fastening grooves are formed in two sides of the outer side wall of each first arc-shaped block, two fastening grooves form a rectangular groove, the fastening blocks are embedded in the rectangular grooves, arc-shaped grooves are formed in the bottoms of the inner sides of the arc-shaped blocks, a second arc-shaped block is sleeved in the arc-shaped grooves, and the second arc-shaped blocks are spliced to form a second needle cylinder body. The utility model adopts a sectional structure, a first syringe body and a second syringe body are formed when the first arc-shaped block and the second arc-shaped block are surrounded, a rectangular groove between the first arc-shaped blocks is embedded with a fastening block to realize fastening, the installation and the disassembly are convenient, the fastening degree is good, the inner side of the first arc-shaped block is provided with an arc-shaped groove, the lower part of the second arc-shaped block is in an L-shaped structure, and the first arc-shaped block and the second arc-shaped block are bonded and fastened to form a layered syringe.

title_en: Mounting structure of opening mount in fixed material subassembly of sack
abstract_en: The application relates to an installation structure of an opening fixing frame in a bag opening fixing assembly, which comprises a placing plate, an opening fixing frame and a quick-dismantling assembly, wherein an installation block is detachably connected to the opening fixing frame, the quick-dismantling assembly comprises a locking block, a first air cylinder and a connecting piece, the locking block is connected with the placing plate through the connecting piece, a first groove matched with the installation block is formed in the bottom surface of the locking block, the first air cylinder is fixedly arranged on the side wall of the locking block, a second groove for a piston rod of the first air cylinder to move is formed in the locking block, the first groove is communicated with the second groove, and a slot for the piston rod of the first air cylinder to insert is formed in the side wall of the installation block. When the opening fixing frame is replaced, the piston rod of the first air cylinder is pulled out of the slot, the locking of the mounting block is released, and the mounting block can be quickly detached, when the opening fixing frame is installed, the mounting block is inserted in alignment with the first slot, and when the air cylinder is restarted, the piston rod is inserted into the slot, the mounting can be quickly completed, so that the replacement efficiency of the opening fixing frame is improved, and the problem that the mounting block is difficult to detach due to space limitation in a traditional mode is solved.

title_en: Embossing laminating machine
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of laminating machines and discloses an embossing laminating machine, which comprises a machine body, wherein the front surface and the back surface of the machine body are both provided with sliding grooves, the inside of each sliding groove is connected with a swinging rod in a sliding manner, the outer surface of each swinging rod is rotationally connected with a compacting roller, the front end of each swinging rod is fixedly connected with a ratchet wheel, the front end of each compacting roller is fixedly connected with an elastic pawl, the elastic pawls are in contact with the ratchet wheels, the inner wall of the machine body is fixedly connected with elastic frames, laminating rollers are rotationally connected between the elastic frames, and electric push rods are arranged on the front surface and the back surface of the machine body. This embossing laminating machine can promote film and the inseparable contact of paper through the cooperation of installation elastic support and tectorial membrane roller, makes its contact that can be abundant, avoids there being the bubble between film and the paper to can compact the paper that has tectorial membrane at the in-process that swing arm was reciprocating motion through installation compaction roller, make the film can be closely connected with the paper.

title_en: Automatic gluing and pasting mechanism for corrugated board
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of gluing and pasting mechanisms, and particularly relates to an automatic gluing and pasting mechanism for corrugated boards. The utility model comprises a main conveying device and a gluing box assembly, wherein the gluing box assembly is provided with a box body, the box body is provided with side opening parts, meanwhile, the lower wall of the inner side of the side opening parts is provided with baffle plate parts, a chute part is formed between the baffle plate parts and the inner bottom of the box body, a positioning head part and a moving head part are arranged in the chute part, meanwhile, the positioning head part and the moving head part are provided with rollers, a pitch-changing assembly is arranged between the front upper parts of a main positioning block and an auxiliary positioning block, one side of the auxiliary positioning block is provided with a top block and a threaded rod, and the threaded rod passes through a limiting block.

title_en: Physical static eliminating equipment for dust-free packaging bag production line
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of static electricity eliminating equipment and discloses physical static electricity eliminating equipment for a dust-free packaging bag production line, which comprises a fixing frame, wherein sliding blocks are connected to the left inner wall surface of the fixing frame in a sliding manner, two sliding blocks are symmetrically arranged, a shell is fixedly arranged on the left end surface of each sliding block, a rotating shaft penetrates through a transverse bearing on the left side wall of the shell, an ion fan is fixedly arranged at the left end of the rotating shaft, and an angle adjusting mechanism is arranged on the shell. This dust-free wrapping bag is physical static elimination equipment for production line can rotate angle regulation with the ion fan of upper and lower both sides through same power, and the ion fan of both sides is synchronous with angle regulation about the guarantee not only reduces use cost, guarantees the high uniformity of angle regulation simultaneously, guarantees the static effect that removes in the dust-free wrapping bag production process, is favorable to the production of dust-free wrapping bag, easy and simple to handle nimble, and the practicality is strong.

title_en: Film pasting device for processing paper cutlery box
abstract_en: The utility model provides a film pasting device for processing paper cutlery boxes, which comprises a support frame, wherein a conveyor belt is arranged in the support frame, a plurality of paper cutlery boxes are placed on the conveyor belt, a positioning structure is arranged in the support frame, a glue box is fixed in the support frame, a glue spraying structure is arranged on the glue box, a pressing block is slidably matched in the support frame, an air cavity is arranged in the pressing block, a heating structure is arranged in the air cavity, a cutting structure is arranged on the periphery of the pressing block, a waste roller and a film material roller are rotatably matched in the support frame, a film material is coiled on the periphery of the film material roller, and the film material corresponds to the waste roller. According to the utility model, the positioning structure is arranged in the support frame, so that the paper cutlery box can be positioned, the film material can be contacted with the paper cutlery box, the film pasting is convenient, the heating structure is arranged in the air cavity, the glue spraying structure is arranged on the glue box, the glue box can be used for pasting films of different types, the application range of the device is enlarged, and the air cavity can be used for blowing air to enable the film material to be pressed down, so that the film pasting is performed.

title_en: Paper mounting machine tilting mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of paper mounting machines and discloses a paper mounting machine turnover mechanism which comprises a main body frame, wherein a connecting shaft is rotatably arranged on the main body frame, a turnover plate is fixedly arranged at the end part of the connecting shaft, a driving motor is arranged on the side face of the main body frame, an output shaft of the driving motor is fixedly connected with the connecting shaft, an auxiliary assembly is arranged on the back face of the turnover plate, and the auxiliary assembly comprises an exhaust hole penetrating through the turnover plate and a mounting plate arranged on the back face of the turnover plate. This paper mounting machine tilting mechanism through setting up auxiliary assembly at the back of upset board to press the gasbag, produced air current accessible gas transmission cover and exhaust hole blow into between paper and the upset board, and then after the upset of upset board, can enlarge the clearance between paper and the upset board, reduce the adhesive force between paper and the upset board, ensure after the upset of upset board, the paper can be quick drop down, in order to ensure the availability factor of whole device.

title_en: Leather processing is with piece skin machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a leather product processing sheet machine, which belongs to the technical field of leather processing equipment and comprises a sheet machine body, wherein one end of the sheet machine body is a feeding end, the other end of the sheet machine body is a discharging end, the discharging end is matched with a leather receiving mechanism, the leather receiving mechanism comprises a material receiving table, the material receiving table is connected with a horizontal moving assembly and a vertical moving assembly, and the horizontal moving assembly and the vertical moving assembly drive the material receiving table to flexibly move up and down and horizontally. According to the utility model, the material receiving table is arranged and can horizontally move up and down, so that the stacking of the leather materials on the material receiving table is automatically completed, manual operation is not required, the working efficiency is improved, and the production cost is reduced.

title_en: Coating device for aluminum-plated paper production
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of aluminized paper production equipment, and discloses a coating device for aluminized paper production, which comprises a coating machine body, wherein a first coating roller, a second coating roller and a third coating roller are rotatably arranged in the coating machine body, the first coating roller, the second coating roller and the third coating roller are arranged in the same diameter and length, the second coating roller is positioned right below the first coating roller, the third coating roller is positioned right side of the second coating roller, the third coating roller is contacted with the second coating roller, a first coating liquid containing box and a second coating liquid containing box are fixedly arranged in the coating machine body, the first coating liquid containing box is positioned right below the second coating roller, the bottom of the second coating roller extends into the first coating liquid containing box, the second coating liquid containing box is positioned right below the third coating roller, and the bottom of the third coating roller extends into the second coating liquid containing box. The application has the advantages and effects that the double-sided simultaneous coating can be realized, and the coating uniformity and the coating quality can be improved.

title_en: Yarn guiding structure for preventing yarn hooking of warping machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of warping machines, in particular to a yarn guiding structure for preventing yarn hooking of a warping machine, which comprises a bottom plate and a first vertical plate, wherein the upper end of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with the vertical plate, the right end of the first vertical plate is fixedly connected with a cross rod, the outer wall of the cross rod is sleeved with a warp beam, the right side of the cross rod is provided with a dismounting structure, the left end of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a warping machine main body, the front end of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a transverse plate, and the upper end of the transverse plate is fixedly connected with a shell. Through the cooperation of dismantlement structure and staff, the upward movement handle removes and drives the limiting plate and remove, makes the limiting plate no longer support tightly with the horizontal pole, then will dismantle the structure and take off, inserts new warp beam to the horizontal pole on, inserts the horizontal pole, and elasticity effect through the spring makes limiting plate support tightly with the horizontal pole, accomplishes dismantlement and the installation work to the warp beam, can carry out the warp that the convenient staff of next time work will collect and take out, improves device work efficiency.

title_en: Pad printing machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pad printing machine which comprises a frame, a support bracket, a printing platform and a pad printing rubber head, wherein a transverse moving groove is formed in the frame, a transverse moving block is arranged in the transverse moving groove in a sliding mode, the transverse moving block can be driven to slide along the transverse moving groove through a driving device, a longitudinal sliding groove is formed in the transverse moving block, a longitudinal sliding block is arranged in the longitudinal sliding groove in a sliding mode, a sliding cylinder is fixedly arranged on the side wall of the longitudinal sliding block, a cylinder sliding groove matched with the sliding cylinder in a sliding mode is formed in the frame, the sliding cylinder slides along the cylinder sliding groove in the moving process of the transverse moving block, and then the longitudinal sliding block is driven to slide along the longitudinal sliding groove, the pad printing rubber head is detachably arranged at the bottom end of the longitudinal sliding block through a connecting structure.

title_en: Centering alignment marking device for anchorage
