abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anchor centering alignment marking device which comprises an objective table, wherein an anchor centering device is arranged on the table top of the objective table, the anchor centering device comprises a positioning part corresponding to an anchor hole on an anchor, one side of the objective table is provided with a linear driving piece for driving the anchor centering device to linearly move on the objective table, and the top of the objective table is provided with a typing device corresponding to the anchor centering device.

title_en: Powder scattering assembly of printing machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a powder scattering component of a printing machine, which relates to the technical field of printing machines and comprises a tank body, wherein a fixing mechanism is arranged in the tank body and comprises a fixing frame, the fixing frame is fixedly connected to the top of the inner wall of the tank body, a stirring mechanism is arranged in the tank body and comprises a motor, the motor is fixedly connected to the bottom of the inner wall of the fixing frame, the output end of the motor is fixedly connected with a rotating shaft, and a vibrating mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the rotating shaft. The device has the advantages that the conical cover of the device rotates to drive the impact blocks to rotate, the impact blocks continuously impact the convex blocks to generate vibration, the vibration is transmitted to the filter screen through the fixing columns, powder on the surface of the filter screen is prevented from being blocked by the vibration, normal operation of the device is guaranteed, meanwhile, redundant powder sprayed on paper can be extracted upwards by the extension pipe and the collection cover, and the redundant powder flows back to the tank body through the pressurizing pipe again, so that the powder enters the powdering process again, cost is saved, and raw material waste is avoided.

title_en: Printing device and printing system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of printers and discloses a printing device and a printing system. The printer comprises a printer body, a paper discharge port, a paper supporting disc, a paper supporting surface and an arc-shaped paper supporting surface, wherein the paper discharge port is arranged on the printer body, the paper supporting groove is formed in the printer body corresponding to the paper discharge port, the paper supporting disc is detachably arranged in the paper supporting groove, the top surface of the paper supporting disc, which is close to the paper discharge port, is the paper supporting surface, the distance between the paper supporting surface and the paper discharge port in the vertical direction is gradually reduced from the direction from the position close to the paper discharge port to the direction away from the paper discharge port, and the paper supporting surface is arranged in an arc shape. According to the utility model, the paper supporting disc with a certain thickness is arranged, so that when the paper is discharged from the paper discharging port, the contact angle between one side of the paper, which is far away from the paper discharging port, and the paper supporting surface is reduced, the impact force between the paper and the paper supporting surface is further reduced, the probability of paper jam of the paper discharging of the printer is reduced, the contact angle is smaller, and crease or abrasion on the side edge of the paper caused by the impact of the paper and the paper supporting surface can be prevented.

title_en: Adjustable double-deck surface fabric deburring sewing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses adjustable double-layer fabric trimming and sewing equipment, which relates to the technical field of double-layer fabric production and comprises a workbench, wherein the top of the workbench is fixedly connected with a first mounting plate at equal intervals, a winding roller is rotatably connected between one sides of the first mounting plate, the top of the workbench is fixedly connected with a second mounting plate at equal intervals, a winding roller is rotatably connected between one sides of the second mounting plate, and one side of one of the second mounting plates is provided with a motor. According to the adjustable double-layer fabric trimming and sewing equipment disclosed by the utility model, the movable component flattens the fabric through the pressing plate, so that possible wrinkles in the rolling process are effectively restrained, the tension of the fabric is increased, the fabric is smoother in rolling, and two groups of blades can trim two sides of the fabric simultaneously through the trimming component, so that the symmetry and consistency of edge effects are ensured, and the appearance and the overall quality of a final product are obviously improved.

title_en: Antibacterial antigen fiber lyocell grey cloth
abstract_en: The utility model provides antibacterial antigen fiber lyocell grey cloth, which relates to the technical field of grey cloth fabrics and comprises an outer antigen layer, an inner antigen layer, composite antibacterial yarns and a surface coating, wherein the inner antigen layer is adhered to the inner side of the outer antigen layer, the inner antigen layer is formed by warp-weft knitting of the composite antibacterial yarns, the surface coating is arranged on the outer side surface of the outer antigen layer, the composite antibacterial yarns comprise third antigen yarns and middle antibacterial yarns, the composite antibacterial yarns are of a core-spun structure, the composite antibacterial yarns consist of the outer layer third antigen yarns and the middle antibacterial yarns of a core layer, and the composite antibacterial yarns encircle the outer sides of the middle antibacterial yarns. The third antigen yarn is contacted with the outside first, so that the abrasion of the antibacterial yarn in the outside is reduced, the effective life of the antibacterial agent of the antibacterial yarn in the middle is prolonged, and the problem that the antibacterial performance is reduced due to the abrasion of the antibacterial yarn caused by the abrasion of the antibacterial yarn in the production and transportation of the antibacterial yarn is solved.

title_en: Flattening device for package printing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of package printing, in particular to a flattening device for package printing, which comprises a workbench, wherein two sides of the workbench are fixedly connected with fixing blocks, a lever is arranged between the two fixing blocks, two ends of the lever are respectively and fixedly connected with the fixing blocks, a transmission mechanism is rotationally connected with a cylindrical surface of the lever, the fixing blocks are slidably connected with a flattening device, the flattening device is matched with the transmission mechanism, the workbench is vertically and slidably connected with the fixing device, one end of the fixing device stretches into the transmission mechanism and is matched with the transmission mechanism, the transmission mechanism is used for driving the fixing device to descend, and the device can automatically fix a package when the package is flattened, so that the package to be printed is prevented from shifting.

title_en: Printer with anti-disassembly function
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of printing equipment and discloses a printer with an anti-disassembly function, which comprises a printing equipment body, a front panel, a rear panel, a pair of middle side panels and a pair of middle top panels, wherein an inner space is formed by the front panel, the rear panel, the pair of middle side panels and the pair of middle top panels, the printing equipment body is arranged in the inner space, a plurality of first L-shaped buckles are respectively formed by outwards extending the front part and the rear part of the middle top panels, a plurality of second L-shaped buckles are respectively formed by outwards extending the front part and the rear part of the middle top panels, the first L-shaped buckles and the second L-shaped buckles are respectively clamped and installed on the front panel and the rear panel, a tail section circuit is arranged on at least one of the first L-shaped buckles or the second L-shaped buckles, a front section circuit is arranged in a clamping groove correspondingly connected with the first L-shaped buckles, a closed loop is formed after the front section circuit is contacted with a tail section circuit, and a circuit breaking alarm device is connected to the closed loop. The printer with the anti-disassembly function has higher anti-disassembly performance.

title_en: Chemical fiber processing steam box with scald preventing effect
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a steam box for chemical fiber processing with an anti-scalding effect, which comprises a box body for storing steam and a supporting frame for fixing the box body, wherein one end of the box body is provided with a feed inlet, the other end of the box body is provided with a discharge outlet, the feed inlet and the discharge outlet are respectively provided with an air suction cover, the top of the box body is provided with a bracket, the bracket is provided with an air suction fan, and an air suction pipe is respectively arranged between the air suction inlet of the air suction fan and the two air suction covers.

title_en: Thread end sucking machine convenient to clean
abstract_en: The utility model provides a wire end sucking machine convenient to clean, and belongs to the technical field of wire end sucking machines. The collecting box is inserted into the lower portion of the box in a sliding mode, a screen plate is connected between the upper walls of the inner sides of the box in a sliding mode, camshafts arranged on two sides of the bottom of the screen plate are symmetrically and rotatably connected between the inner walls of the box, a driving portion is arranged on the box, conveying hoses which are communicated are arranged on the side walls of the box, a suction fan which is communicated is arranged on the top of the box, and a wire suction hood is arranged at a port of each conveying hose. According to the utility model, the thread ends and the fine scraps sucked into the box body are blocked at the bottom of the baffle plate, the cam shaft is enabled to rotate by starting the driving part, and then the baffle plate is driven to lift and vibrate up and down, so that the thread ends and the fine scraps attached to the baffle plate can be vibrated and fall down, the fallen thread ends and the fine scraps fall into the collecting box to be collected, the collecting box is pulled out from the box body and turned over to pour out the thread ends and the fine scraps in the collecting box, the collected thread ends and fine scraps can be conveniently cleaned, and the cleaning is more time-saving and labor-saving.

title_en: Trolley bottom plate for printer
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a trolley bottom plate for a printer, which belongs to the technical field of printers and comprises a bottom plate body, wherein an installation groove is formed in the top of the bottom plate body, an ink outlet through groove is formed in the bottom of the inner side of the installation groove, fixed installation slots are symmetrically formed in the bottom end of the bottom plate body, a connection protection mechanism is movably inserted into the inner side of each fixed installation slot and comprises a connection installation insertion block, the bottom ends of the connection installation insertion blocks are fixedly connected with a protection bottom plate, and the connection protection mechanism are connected and matched through the mutual matching between the fixed installation slots when the bottom plate body and a printing nozzle are not used, so that the connection protection mechanism is positioned at the bottom of the bottom plate body, and the printing nozzle arranged at the top of the bottom plate body can be protected stably, and the operation is convenient.

title_en: Child camera paper feeding guide structure and printing device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of cameras, in particular to a paper feeding guide structure of a child camera, which comprises a mounting frame, wherein the mounting frame is provided with a motor, one side of the mounting frame is provided with a gear box driven by the motor, the output end fixedly connected with paper feed rubber roll of gear box, and paper feed rubber roll and mounting bracket rotate to be connected, are provided with the baffle in the mounting bracket, install the thermal print head on the baffle, the mounting bracket internal fixation has the paper guide board. Due to the arrangement of the first R angle and the second R angle, the friction resistance of the thermal paper or the self-adhesive material in the paper feeding process is reduced, the problems of paper jam, scratch or degumming caused by right angles or acute angles are avoided, and the thermal printing head and the horizontal plane are at different angles under the action of the springs through the baffle plate, so that the thermal printing head can adapt to paper with different thicknesses, and in addition, the inclined angle of the paper guiding slope is 25 degrees, so that the paper guiding slope can guide thermal paper put in by a user to stably enter an internal transmission path.

title_en: Carding machine for spinning processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a carding machine for spinning processing, which comprises a shell, wherein a blanking hopper is arranged at the top of the shell, a blanking assembly is arranged in the shell, the blanking assembly is arranged at the bottom of the blanking hopper, a cylinder and a doffer are rotatably arranged in the shell, a driving box is arranged at the rear side of the shell, and two driving shafts are arranged in the driving box. According to the utility model, the cone is driven to rotate by the driving motor, cotton can be guided to continuously and orderly move along the surface of the cone by the bidirectional spiral guide groove arranged outside the cone, the cotton is distributed more uniformly on the surface of the cone by the design of the bidirectional spiral guide groove, local accumulation is avoided, the cotton can be gradually conveyed along the bidirectional spiral guide groove along with the rotation of the cone, so that the smoothness of the whole material guiding process is maintained, and then the cotton is guided by the cooperation of the material guiding assembly, so that stable and continuous material guiding work is realized, and the condition that the thickness of a cotton web is uneven due to cotton accumulation and yarn quality is influenced is avoided.

title_en: Full-automatic planer-type sewing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses full-automatic gantry type sewing equipment which comprises a machine base, wherein an operation platform, a gantry beam and a sewing template for bearing materials are arranged on the machine base, the gantry beam is transversely arranged above the operation platform, the sewing equipment is provided with a first displacement mechanism which is connected with the sewing equipment, lifting and retracting mechanisms which are symmetrically arranged at two sides of the operation platform and are used for being abutted and lifted with two end parts of the sewing template, a template conveying mechanism which is symmetrically arranged below the operation platform drives the template to move below the sewing machine, a clamping sewing mechanism which is arranged at the rear side of the operation platform, and a second displacement mechanism which is arranged on the machine base. According to the automatic replacement device, automatic alternate replacement of the sewing template is realized, a manual replacement mode is replaced, the replacement efficiency and accuracy of the sewing template are effectively improved, and automatic sewing can be realized.

title_en: Fabric corner falling prevention device and fabric treatment equipment using same
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of textiles, in particular to a fabric corner drop preventing device and fabric treatment equipment using the same. The fabric corner drop preventing device comprises a fabric guide roller, two rotatable press rollers and two first movement driving mechanisms, wherein the fabric guide roller is configured as a power roller and used for supporting a fabric, each press roller is used for pressing one side edge of the fabric on the fabric guide roller, and each first movement driving mechanism corresponds to one press roller and is connected with the corresponding press roller and used for driving the corresponding press roller to axially move along the fabric guide roller. The utility model can effectively prevent the fabric from falling off corners in the production and processing process of the fabric.

title_en: Thermal printing module
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a thermal printing module, which belongs to the technical field of thermal printers and comprises a printer shell, a paper placing bin, thermal paper, a winding paper cylinder, an inserting shaft body, a sliding groove and supporting blocks, wherein a plurality of supporting blocks on two sides can simultaneously and inwards slide and can outwards expand, a plurality of supporting blocks on two sides can simultaneously and outwards move and inwards contract, further, winding paper cylinders with different inner diameters can be clamped, the contact area between the plurality of supporting blocks and the winding paper cylinder is large, the fixing effect is better, the winding paper cylinder cannot slip, friction deformation of the winding paper cylinder can be prevented, and when the thermal printing module is installed, two side baffles are pressed and a bidirectional screw rod is rotated, so that two side inner screw rings simultaneously move oppositely or oppositely, and the supporting blocks outwards expand or inwards contract by matching with the appearance of the inserting shaft body and the telescopic connection of the supporting blocks and the inner screw rings.

title_en: Positioning and clamping mechanism for variable laser thermoprint label
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of coating and rolling mechanisms, in particular to a positioning and clamping mechanism for variable laser thermoprinting labels, which comprises a supporting plate and a positioning assembly, wherein the supporting plate is used for supporting an integral device, the upper surface of the supporting plate is fixedly connected with a supporting frame, the positioning assembly is arranged on the outer wall of the supporting frame and used for fixing the labels, the positioning assembly comprises a rotating shaft which is rotatably connected to the inner wall of a swinging frame, the outer wall of the rotating shaft is fixedly connected with the swinging frame, a flattening assembly is arranged on the outer wall of the swinging frame and used for flattening the labels, the flattening assembly comprises a flattening frame which is hinged to the outer wall of the swinging frame, the flattening frame is U-shaped, the flattening assembly is provided with the positioning assembly to drive, and when an operator operates the positioning assembly, the flattening assembly can drive a flattening piece to squeeze the labels, so that the labels can be kept flat, and flattening operation can be realized while positioning.

title_en: Dustproof assembly of electric engraving machine for plate making production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of electric engraving machines and discloses an electric engraving machine dustproof assembly for plate making production, which comprises two dustproof shells, a dustproof mechanism, a driving mechanism and a sealing assembly, wherein the two dustproof shells are transversely arranged and are arranged on the electric engraving machine in a sliding mode, a transparent observation plate is arranged on one side, away from each other, of the two dustproof shells, the dustproof mechanism comprises a dust removing pipe and a dust collecting head, the dust collecting head is arranged on the inner side of the dustproof shells, the dust removing pipe is fixedly arranged on the dustproof shells, one end of the dust removing pipe stretches into the inner side of the dustproof shells and is connected with the dust collecting head, the driving mechanism is fixedly arranged on the electric engraving machine and is positioned on one side of the dustproof shells, the driving mechanism comprises a double-head screw rod and a nut, the double-head screw rod is fixedly arranged on the electric engraving machine and is driven by a motor, the nut is in threaded connection with the double-head screw rod and is symmetrically arranged, the nut is fixedly connected with the two dustproof shells respectively, and the sealing assembly comprises a rubber strip, and the rubber strip is fixedly arranged at the lower end, on one side, away from each other, of the dustproof shells. The utility model has the advantages that the dust collector is provided with the closed dust removing component, thereby avoiding negative influence of dust on the bottom plate.

title_en: Multifunctional cold and hot pressing ironing machine
abstract_en: The utility model provides a multifunctional cold and hot pressing ironing machine which comprises a workbench, a lifting piece and a pressing seam mechanism, wherein the top surface of the workbench is provided with a pressing seam station, the lifting piece is lifted above the pressing seam station, the output end of the lifting piece is connected with the pressing seam mechanism, the pressing seam mechanism moves towards a direction close to or far away from the pressing seam station, the pressing seam mechanism comprises a machine case with a downward opening, a hot pressing head and a cold pressing head which are arranged in the machine case, the machine case is provided with a driving piece for driving the hot pressing head and the cold pressing head to switch in displacement, the machine case is provided with a micro switch, when an obstacle is mistakenly touched with the micro switch, the micro switch controls the stop operation of the lifting piece, so that the problem that the adhesive effect is poor due to excessive shrinkage of a film after cooling is solved, and if the micro switch is contacted with a human hand or other obstacles, the micro switch is triggered to stop the lifting piece, so that installation production is realized.

title_en: Paperboard line-touching machine for packaging carton production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a paperboard line-striking machine for producing packaging cartons, which relates to the technical field of producing packaging cartons and comprises a machine body, wherein a fixing plate is arranged in the machine body, a connecting frame is arranged in the fixing plate, a line-pressing cutter is movably clamped in the connecting frame, a screw rod is rotationally connected in the line-pressing cutter, when the line-pressing cutter needs to be disassembled, a push block needs to be pulled to drive a fixed limiting block to move together, at the moment, the limiting block is separated from the clamping connection of a clamping groove formed in the line-pressing cutter, at the moment, two clamping blocks sleeved on the screw rod are moved back to each other under the action of threads through rotating the screw rod, and then are separated from the clamping connection of two limiting grooves formed in the connecting frame, the limiting is opened, at the moment, the line-pressing cutter can be disassembled, sharp parts need to be contacted closely during maintenance of the fixed line-pressing cutter, scratch risks exist, the whole disassembly blade assembly is supported to be maintained in a safe area, direct contact between operators and dangerous parts is reduced, and the safety of workshops is improved.

title_en: Opener fiber separating device for processing non-woven fabrics
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an opener fiber separating device for processing non-woven fabrics, which relates to the technical field of openers and comprises an opener box, wherein a first opener roller is rotatably arranged at the upper end of the opener box, a maintenance hole is formed in the side wall of the opener box, a sealing cover is arranged in the maintenance hole in a threaded manner, a second opener roller is rotatably arranged in the opener box, the second opener roller comprises an opener roller body rotatably arranged in the opener box, a movable sliding groove is formed in the opener roller body, a movable plate is slidably arranged in the movable sliding groove, comb teeth are fixedly arranged on the movable plate, a winding mechanism is arranged in the opener roller body, a positioning hole is formed in the bottom of the opener roller body, a spring guide rod is slidably arranged in the positioning hole, and a reset spring is sleeved on the spring guide rod. This opener fiber separating device of processing non-woven fabrics uses through the cooperation of winding mechanism and broach, can realize the quick separation of fibre and broach.

title_en: Yarn guiding device of elasticizer for polyester yarns with various specifications
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of polyester yarn processing and discloses a yarn guiding device of a yarn texturing machine with various specifications, which comprises a yarn guiding plate, wherein a plurality of baffle plates are arranged on the upper surface of the yarn guiding plate in a left-right sliding manner, guide grooves are formed in the front surface and the rear surface of the upper surface of the yarn guiding plate, the left ends of the two guide grooves are respectively provided with an opening, guide blocks are fixedly connected to the inner walls of the baffle plates at positions corresponding to the two guide grooves, the guide blocks are respectively connected with the inner parts of the two guide grooves in a sliding manner, an adjusting mechanism is arranged in the yarn guiding plate, the number of the baffle plates can be increased and the distance between the baffle plates can be adjusted through the arrangement of a rotary threaded rod and the two tightening plates, the baffle plates can be inserted or pulled out at any time through the opening design of the left end of the guide grooves, the rapid locking function of the adjusting mechanism can be matched, the number of the baffle plates can be flexibly increased or decreased according to the production requirements of different yarn numbers and specifications, and the use effect of the yarn guiding device is improved.

title_en: Yarn separating device for processing different-warp heavy-twist jacquard fabric
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of fabric processing auxiliary devices, in particular to a yarn separating device for processing different-warp heavy-twist jacquard fabric, which comprises a vertical plate, a distance changing mechanism and a positioning mechanism, wherein the distance changing mechanism comprises an adjusting plate, a driving assembly, a traction assembly and a plurality of sliding plates, the positioning mechanism comprises a plurality of mounting plates, a plurality of locking plates and a plurality of adjusting assemblies, and the plurality of adjusting assemblies are arranged between the plurality of mounting plates and the plurality of locking plates.

title_en: Alignment roller frame structure of PU space leather transfer printing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an alignment roller frame structure of a PU space leather transfer printing device, which comprises a mounting frame, a roller shaft and a roller shaft connecting part, wherein the mounting frame comprises a base and two end supporting seats, the supporting seats are provided with a mounting structure and a hydraulic telescopic device, the hydraulic telescopic device is connected with a connecting seat sleeved outside the roller shaft, the two ends of the roller shaft are provided with bearing structures, the roller shaft is in a strip shape, the outer surface of the roller shaft is provided with a working area, the roller shaft connecting part comprises a gear assembly, and the roller shaft is connected with an external driving device through a driving end connecting piece. This structure can stabilize the back-up roll, smoothly transmit power, accurately adjusts the roller position through hydraulic telescoping device, promotes the accuracy and the efficiency of PU space leather rendition.

title_en: Low twist spinning device for processing composite yarn
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a low-twist spinning device for processing composite yarns, which relates to the technical field of composite yarn processing and comprises a spinning device, wherein a positioning mechanism is arranged above the spinning device and used for positioning and conveying the composite yarns to eliminate static electricity, the positioning mechanism comprises an anti-shaking unit and a static eliminating unit, the anti-shaking unit is arranged above the spinning device and comprises a fixing frame, two rotating shafts are rotatably arranged in the fixing frame, four grooved wheels are fixedly arranged on the surface of the rotating shaft, a mounting frame is fixedly arranged at the top of the fixing frame, and the anti-shaking unit is arranged.

title_en: Quick impurity filtering device in paper towel processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rapid impurity filtering device in paper towel processing, which relates to the technical field of paper towel production and comprises a collecting frame, wherein a disc-shaped filter box is arranged at the top end of the center of the collecting frame, a filter hole is formed in the bottom end of the disc-shaped filter box, a scraping strip is arranged in the disc-shaped filter box, and the filter hole and the scraping strip are used for removing fiber bundles, incompletely decomposed lignin fragments and resin precipitates in mixed paper pulp. The fine pulp falls into the collecting frame through the filter holes and the disc-type filter box, and lignin fragments and resin precipitates possibly remained in the pulp are remained at the top ends of the filter holes. Thereby achieving the effect of filtering lignin fragments and resin precipitates in the pulp. Breaking up the pulp helps to promote separation of fines from impurities, making the fine pulp easier to pass through the filter openings, while larger impurities are trapped above the filter openings.

title_en: Ink delivery roller adjusting device for printing plastic packaging products
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of ink delivery roller adjusting equipment, and relates to an ink delivery roller adjusting device for printing plastic packaging products. The installation component is used for the installation of device fixedly, and adjusting part realizes delivery roller position and angle modulation, and the delivery roller after fixed subassembly is firm to be adjusted, and drive assembly drives delivery roller and rotates the inking. The device has solved plastic packaging goods printing in-process, and the inking roller is difficult to change accurate regulation according to the printing plate roller to and adjust the stability after not enough influence print quality's problem, has improved inking accuracy and print quality, is applicable to the print operation of different specification printing plate rollers.

title_en: Gradient temperature control spinneret plate for melt re-spinning of aramid waste filaments
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of aramid fiber waste silk, in particular to a gradient temperature control spinneret ‌ ‌ for melt re-spinning of aramid fiber waste silk, which comprises a protective outer ring, a top spinneret plate, an inner spinneret plate and a bottom spinneret plate, wherein the top spinneret plate, the inner spinneret plate and the bottom spinneret plate are all arranged in the protective outer ring, and silk drawing holes are circumferentially and completely formed in the top spinneret plate, the inner spinneret plate and the bottom spinneret plate. According to the gradient temperature control spinneret plate for melt-spinning of the aramid fiber waste silk, through the design of the wire drawing holes distributed in a gradient decreasing mode, the melt-spinning process of the aramid fiber waste silk is optimized, compared with the wire drawing holes with the same size in the prior art, the wire drawing holes with the gradient size can apply reducing force to the waste silk at different stages, stress concentration caused by large deformation is avoided, the occurrence of the wire breaking condition is reduced, and the stability and the production efficiency of the whole melt-spinning process are improved.

title_en: Non-woven fabrics production heating device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of textile engineering and discloses a heating device for producing non-woven fabrics, which comprises a working area, wherein the front side and the rear side of the working area are fixedly connected with protective shells, the far sides of the two protective shells are fixedly connected with a first motor, the driving end of the first motor is fixedly connected with a first rotating rod, the outer part of the first rotating rod is rotationally connected with a rotating plate, the rear side of the rotating plate is fixedly connected with a sliding rod, the rear side of the protective shell is in sliding connection with a connecting block, the front side of the connecting block is fixedly connected with a first moving plate, the rear side of the connecting block is rotationally connected with a third rotating rod, and the rear side of the third rotating rod is fixedly connected with a heating assembly for heating a rotating roller. In the utility model, the first motor rotates the first rotating rod, the rotating plate rotates, the sliding block rotates in the first moving plate, the first moving plate moves, the hot roller moves, and tension adjustment of non-woven fabrics in the heating device is realized.

title_en: Cutting tool for carbon felt of single crystal furnace
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cutting tool for a carbon felt of a single crystal furnace, which comprises a circular ring and a movable rod with two ends in the circular ring, wherein two cutting slide blocks are sleeved on the periphery of the movable rod, cutting pieces with opposite cutting edges are arranged at the bottoms of the cutting slide blocks, and the cutting tool also comprises a hand-held block fixedly connected with the movable rod, wherein the hand-held block is contacted with the inner wall of the circular ring to drive the movable rod and the cutting slide blocks to do circular motion around the center of the circular ring. The synchronous cutting of the two ends of the cutting piece is realized, the consistency of batch cutting of the carbon felt is ensured, the precision is controllable, the fit clearance during assembly is reduced, the heat leakage is reduced, and the thermal field heat insulation performance is improved.

title_en: Plasma widening device for fiber tows
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a plasma stretching device for fiber tows, which belongs to the technical field of textile and composite material production equipment and comprises a plasma treatment assembly, a plasma generation unit and a compressed gas generation unit, wherein the plasma treatment assembly comprises a fixed plate and a hollow structure which are connected together, the hollow structure is connected with the compressed gas generation unit through an air pipe, the hollow structure is connected with the plasma generation unit through a wire, at least one discharge tube is communicated with the hollow structure, the outlet end of the discharge tube faces the fiber tows to be treated, the fiber tows can be stretched and modified at the same time, the treatment efficiency of the plasma stretching device for the fiber tows is obviously higher than that of the traditional equipment, and the utilization rate of the equipment is improved.

title_en: Cotton mixer for high-count cotton bunchy yarn fabric
abstract_en: The application relates to a cotton mixer for high count cotton bunchy yarn fabric, which relates to the technical field of textile machinery equipment and comprises two feeding holes, wherein a driving assembly is fixedly connected to the inside of a cotton mixing box body, cotton carding rollers are connected to the outside of the driving assembly in a sliding manner, grooves on the left side and the right side of the inside of the cotton mixing box body are connected to two guide plates in a sliding manner, a partition plate is fixedly connected to the inside of the cotton mixing box body, a discharging hole is fixedly connected to the bottom of the cotton mixing box body, a rotary valve is fixedly connected to the outside of the rotary assembly, and an atomizing nozzle is fixedly connected to the outside of the atomizing assembly. The application has the advantages that the guide plate guides the fibers to flow to the lower layer, uniform mixing is realized in the flowing process, the mixed fibers are discharged through the discharge hole, the mixing effect and the fiber integrity are ensured, the atomizing assembly is additionally arranged, the fibers are wetted by atomized water vapor, the electrostatic interference is reduced, the mixing uniformity is further improved, and the strength and the consistency of the high-count cotton yarn are ensured.

title_en: Special distributed coloring marking equipment for ceramic tiles
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of tile production auxiliary equipment, in particular to special distributed coloring and marking equipment for tiles, which comprises a transfer device, a first conveying device, a second conveying device, a finishing device and a coloring and marking device, wherein the transfer device comprises a first transfer component and a second transfer component, the first transfer component and the second transfer component alternately run, the first conveying device, the finishing device, the first transfer component, the coloring and marking device and the second transfer component are sequentially arranged, the finishing device is used for carrying out position correction and arrangement adjustment on a plurality of tiles so that the tiles form parallel queues with single side edges aligned to enter the first transfer component, the coloring and marking device is used for coloring the single side edges of the parallel tiles transferred by the first transfer component in a one-to-one correspondence manner so as to mark products of different production lines.

title_en: Stable structure of nailing machine for packaging product
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a stabilizing structure of a packaging product nailing machine, which comprises a bearing assembly, wherein the bearing assembly comprises a bearing plate, the edge of the lower end of the bearing plate is fixedly connected with a support column which is bilaterally symmetrical, the outer wall of the support column is provided with equidistant surrounding sliding rails, the outer wall of the support column is provided with a limiting assembly, the limiting assembly comprises a sliding sleeve which is slidably arranged on the outer wall of the support column, the inner wall of the sliding sleeve is provided with equidistant surrounding sliding grooves, the sliding grooves correspond to the sliding rails, one end inner wall of the sliding grooves, which is close to the outer wall of the sliding sleeve, is provided with a screw hole I in a penetrating manner, the sliding grooves are internally provided with sliding blocks in a sliding manner, the outer wall of the sliding blocks is attached to the inner wall of the sliding rails, the screw holes I are internally provided with bolts, the tail ends of the bolts are attached to the outer wall of the sliding blocks, one ends, which are mutually close to each other, are jointly provided with an adjusting assembly, and the adjusting assembly comprises an adjusting frame fixedly connected to the outer wall of the sliding sleeve. The utility model has the advantages that the adjustable sliding piece is attached to the sliding rail, so that the adjusting stability of the nailing machine is ensured before devices such as the sliding rail are replaced.

title_en: Novel quilt core processing and positioning device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of quilt core processing and discloses a novel quilt core processing and positioning device, which comprises a workbench surface, wherein an installation frame is fixedly installed on the outer wall of the workbench surface, a first limiting shallow sliding groove is formed in the front end of the top of the workbench surface, a second limiting shallow sliding groove is formed in the rear end of the top of the workbench surface, a first limiting deep sliding groove is formed in the left side of the top of the workbench surface, a second limiting deep sliding groove is formed in the right side of the top of the workbench surface, a first positioning mechanism is arranged at the front end of the inner wall of the workbench surface, the first positioning mechanism comprises a first servo motor, the back surface of the first servo motor is fixedly connected with the front surface of the installation frame, and through the cooperation of the first positioning mechanism and the second positioning mechanism, accurate and stable positioning of quilt cores with different sizes can be realized, powerful protection is provided for subsequent quilt core processing, and the production efficiency and the product quality of quilt core processing are greatly improved.

title_en: Vacuum pattern suction mechanism for manufacturing patterns on surface of synthetic leather
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of synthetic leather production, in particular to a vacuum grain suction mechanism for manufacturing patterns on the surface of synthetic leather, which comprises a grain suction machine, wherein a leveling mechanism is arranged on the grain suction machine, the leveling mechanism comprises a supporting plate, one side of the grain suction machine is horizontally connected with the supporting plate, a supporting frame is arranged at the top of the supporting plate, a pushing plate is arranged at the center of the top of the supporting plate, the pushing plate is of a triangular structure, the top of the pushing plate is rotationally connected with a screw rod, the screw rod is in threaded connection with the center of the top of the supporting frame, a certain gap is formed between the bottom of the pushing plate and the top of the supporting plate, a cleaning mechanism is arranged on the pushing plate, the leveling of cloth is realized through the matching of the supporting plate and the triangular pushing plate, the wrinkling position of the cloth is leveled, and the height of the pushing plate can be adjusted through the screw rod, so that the vacuum grain suction machine is suitable for cloth with different thicknesses.

title_en: Hard semi-dry calender roll for drying cambered surface paper patterns
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hard semi-dry calender roll for drying an arc paper sample, which comprises a base, wherein the upper end of the base is respectively provided with a sealing cover through bolts, the base and the sealing covers form a supporting seat, opposite surfaces of the two supporting seats are respectively provided with a through hole, the calender roll is arranged between the interiors of the two through holes and is rotationally connected with the interiors of the through holes through bearings, the hard semi-dry calender roll further comprises an adjusting mechanism, the adjusting mechanism comprises supporting blocks, adjusting rods, arc plates, supporting columns and L-shaped rods, the inner wall of the right side of the left base is respectively provided with a supporting block, the interiors of the supporting blocks are respectively and slidably connected with an adjusting rod, one side of each adjusting rod close to the center of the base is fixedly connected with the arc plates, the inner arc surfaces of the arc plates are respectively provided with friction plates, the hard semi-dry calender roll for drying the arc paper sample can rapidly respond to paper sample changes, and dynamically adjust the rotating speed to match production requirements, and the surface flatness and glossiness of the paper products of the same batch are ensured to be uniform and consistent.

title_en: Shedding mechanism of jean air-jet loom
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of air jet looms, and discloses an opening mechanism of an jean air jet loom, which comprises an air jet loom main body, wherein an upgrading assembly is arranged in the air jet loom main body, a cleaning assembly is arranged outside the air jet loom main body, the upgrading assembly comprises a protective shell, the outer part of the protective shell is fixedly connected to the front side of the air jet loom main body, ten conjugate cams are rotatably connected inside the protective shell, ten rotor swing rods are rotatably connected inside the protective shell, a connecting rod is rotatably connected to the top of each rotor swing rod, a lever is rotatably connected to the rear side of each connecting rod, and a push-pull rod is rotatably connected to the bottom of each lever. According to the utility model, ten heald frames are formed by adding two conjugate cams and rotor swing rods on the original conjugate cams and rotor swing rods, so that more complex varieties can be woven, and when twill, satin or little jacquard fabrics are required to be produced, the number of the heald frames is increased to realize independent control of multiple groups of warp yarns, and the production efficiency is effectively improved.

title_en: Double-sided oil passing unit of printing machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a double-sided oiling machine set of a printing machine, which comprises an oiling base, wherein a first-stage bracket is fixedly arranged on the outer wall of one side of the oiling base, a second-stage bracket is fixedly arranged on the outer wall of the other side of the oiling base, a first oiling roller is rotatably arranged between the first-stage bracket and the second-stage bracket through a bearing, one side of the first oiling roller is provided with a second oiling roller, two ends of a shaft body of the second oiling roller are respectively connected with the first-stage bracket and the second-stage bracket through bearings, a lower oiling plate is fixedly arranged below the first oiling roller and between the first-stage bracket and the second-stage bracket, and an oiling box is arranged above the second oiling roller.

title_en: Knitting needle of flat knitting machine with symmetrical elastic needle turning piece
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of flat knitting machine needles, in particular to a flat knitting machine needle with symmetrical elastic needle turning pieces. The elastic needle turning device comprises a needle body, a needle rod and an elastic needle turning piece, wherein symmetrical mounting grooves and cylindrical pins are formed in two sides of the needle body to mount and fix the elastic needle turning piece, the end part of the needle rod comprises a needle hook and a needle tongue with a needle tongue pin hole of the needle groove, the bottom part of the needle rod comprises a symmetrical accommodating groove and a cavity avoiding cavity, and the elastic needle turning piece consists of a fixing section, a bending part, a horizontal section and an arc section and is symmetrically mounted in the mounting groove. The structure effectively realizes smooth needle turning process through the synergistic effect of the symmetrical elastic needle turning pieces, can uniformly bear force when the needle is turned, avoids unstable structure caused by single-side force, reduces the left-right movement distance of the knitting needle by utilizing the symmetrical structure, and ensures that the density of the fabric is more compact and uniform. The whole structure is reasonable in design, the components cooperate, the service life of the knitting needle is prolonged, the maintenance cost is reduced, and the knitting efficiency and the fabric quality of the knitting needle of the flat knitting machine are obviously improved.

title_en: Jacquard jacquard device and wireless power supply device for same
abstract_en: The utility model provides a jacquard device and be used for jacquard device's wireless power supply unit, jacquard device includes at least a base and at least one piezoelectric jacquard comb and at least one wireless power supply unit that can install alternatively on the base, through setting up wireless power supply unit, carry out the circular telegram to the executive part of piezoelectric jacquard comb with wireless power supply's mode, thereby copper bar and conductive contact among the prior art have been saved, and there is not the problem because the air oxidation between secondary side charging unit and the primary side charging unit in the use also not have the problem of being extruded, and convenient to use is when piezoelectric jacquard comb installs on the base, primary side charging unit is supplied power to secondary side charging unit with wireless power supply's mode, make the executive part circular telegram, when piezoelectric jacquard comb and base separate, primary side charging unit and secondary side charging unit separate, make the executive part outage.

title_en: Multi-functional transport counterpoint platform
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a multifunctional conveying alignment platform which comprises a platform support, wherein a movable cross beam and a plurality of mounting longitudinal beams are arranged on the platform support, the length directions of the mounting longitudinal beams are parallel to the conveying direction of a paperboard, the mounting longitudinal beams are sequentially arranged along the horizontal direction perpendicular to the conveying direction of the paperboard, a baffle plate is arranged at the top of any two non-adjacent mounting longitudinal beams, a baffle rod is arranged at the top of the mounting longitudinal beam between the two baffle plates and is positioned at the rear side of the baffle plate along the conveying direction of the paperboard, the movable cross beam is arranged below the mounting longitudinal beams, the length direction of the movable cross beam is horizontal and perpendicular to the conveying direction of the paperboard, the movable cross beam can reciprocate along the conveying direction of the paperboard, at least two pushing blocks are arranged at the top of the movable cross beam, an abutting surface is arranged at the front side of each pushing block along the conveying direction of the paperboard, and a transition surface is arranged at the rear side of each pushing block along the conveying direction of the paperboard.

title_en: Single-sided corrugating machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to corrugated board processing equipment, in particular to a single-sided corrugating machine, which comprises a corrugated paper forming mechanism and a base paper attaching mechanism, wherein the corrugated paper forming mechanism is connected with the base paper attaching mechanism, the corrugated paper forming mechanism comprises a first corrugated roller and a second corrugated roller which are matched, the first corrugated roller is provided with first bulges at intervals along the circumferential direction, the second corrugated roller is provided with second bulges at intervals along the circumferential direction, the second bulges are stretched in between the first bulges, the first bulges are obliquely arranged relative to the axial direction, the second bulges are obliquely arranged relative to the axial direction and axially symmetrical to the first bulges, and the first bulges and the second bulges are meshed to form oblique corrugated teeth on corrugated paper.

title_en: Fiber web shaping device with progressive compaction and periodic drafting functions
abstract_en: A fiber web shaping device with progressive compaction and periodic drafting functions belongs to the technical field of non-woven machinery. The device comprises a pair of frames, a drafting roller, a fiber web conveying mechanism, a cotton pressing mechanism, a fiber web buffering and releasing mechanism and a buffering curtain roller up-and-down reciprocating displacement driving mechanism, wherein the frames are arranged between a fiber web output mechanism of a carding machine and a lapping machine, the drafting roller is rotatably supported between opposite sides of the frames at a position corresponding to the right side of the fiber web output mechanism, the fiber web conveying mechanism is used for conveying a fiber web to the lapping machine, and the buffering curtain roller up-and-down reciprocating displacement driving mechanism is arranged between opposite sides of the frames. The method has the advantages that the lapping trolley of the lapping machine in the subsequent lapping process is guaranteed to accurately position and lay the cotton net to the preset position, the transverse preset contour control is achieved, the transverse uniformity adjustment of the non-woven product is accurately realized, the length of the output cotton net in unit time is guaranteed to be consistent with the length of the output cotton net in the unit time, and the lapping trolley can be adapted to the repeated alternate rhythm of the lapping speed of the lapping trolley.

title_en: Thread cutting transmission mechanism of sewing machine and sewing machine
abstract_en: The utility model provides a thread cutting transmission mechanism of a sewing machine and the sewing machine, and belongs to the technical field of sewing machine equipment. It solves the technical problems of how to stabilize the thread cutting transmission of the sewing machine. The wire cutting transmission mechanism comprises a swing rod, a connecting piece and a push rod, wherein the outer end of the swing rod is directly or indirectly hinged to a shell to form a first hinge point, the middle end of the swing rod is hinged to a power source to form a second hinge point, the power source drives the second hinge point to move so that the swing rod swings around the first hinge point, the connecting piece is provided with a through groove, the inner end of the swing rod is provided with a pin roll, the pin roll is connected with the through groove and can slide in the through groove, the connecting piece is fixedly connected to the inner end of the push rod, and the outer end of the push rod is connected with the wire cutting mechanism. The swing rod swings to drive the pin shaft to slide in the through groove on the connecting piece, and drives the push rod fixedly connected with the connecting piece to move, so that the wire cutting mechanism moves, and the pin shaft slides in the through groove, so that the transmission mode is stable.

title_en: Automatic measuring and cutting device of multi-needle quilter
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic measuring and cutting device of a multi-needle quilting machine, which comprises a frame, wherein the frame is arranged at the tail part of the multi-needle quilting machine and comprises two side plates which are symmetrically arranged, one end of the frame, which is close to the multi-needle quilting machine, is provided with a plurality of conveying rollers, the top of the other end of the frame is provided with a cloth guide roller, a meter counter is arranged above the cloth guide roller, a fixing plate is arranged below the cloth guide roller, the fixing plate is fixedly arranged between the two side plates, a cutting groove is formed in the fixing plate in a penetrating manner along the length direction of the fixing plate, one side of the fixing plate is slidably provided with an electric sliding rail, the electric sliding rail is arranged in parallel with the fixing plate, one side, which is close to the fixing plate, of the electric sliding rail is fixedly provided with a cloth clamping plate, a through groove is formed in the length direction of the cloth clamping plate, the through groove is opposite to the cutting groove and is arranged on the same horizontal plane, cutting edges of the cutting scissors are arranged on the electric sliding rail, the cutting edges of the cutting scissors penetrate through the grooves and are positioned between the fixing plate and the cloth clamping plate, one side, which is far away from the cloth clamping plate, and a cylinder for pushing the cutting edge, which is close to or far from the fixing plate, and is arranged.

title_en: Hoisting type split filter element for filtering high-viscosity aramid fiber slurry
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hoisting type split filter element for filtering high-viscosity aramid fiber slurry, which relates to the technical field of filtering and comprises a filter element framework, wherein one end of the filter element framework is fixedly connected with a connecting external thread, the connecting external thread is rotationally connected to the bottom end of a flower plate in a filter, a filter element framework nut is arranged at one end, far away from the connecting external thread, of the filter element framework, a compression bolt is arranged at one end, close to the filter element framework nut, of the filter element framework, and the compression bolt penetrates through a filter element filter sleeve and is rotationally connected with the filter element framework nut. According to the utility model, through the split structure that the connecting external threads arranged at the top of the filter element framework are fixed on the flower plate, and the bottom is locked with the filter element framework nut through the compression bolt, the filter element filter sleeve can be independently taken down only by loosening the bottom compression bolt without disassembling the connection between the top and the flower plate during maintenance, the convenient operation of disassembling the filter element filter sleeve at the bottom of the fixed top is realized, and the pollution of slurry caused by the complete exposure of a flower plate interface in the air during maintenance is avoided.

title_en: Carpet edge-covering workbench
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of carpet processing, in particular to a carpet edge-covering workbench, which comprises a workbench and further comprises a plurality of groups of mounting holes formed in the surface of the workbench, wherein an upper cover assembly is arranged in each mounting hole, a ring blade for cutting a wire head is embedded in each upper cover assembly, one section of each ring blade is arranged in a notch, balls which are anastomotic with the ring blade are arranged in each upper cover assembly, a limiting assembly is arranged at the bottom of each upper cover assembly, and a locking assembly is arranged at the bottom of each limiting assembly.

title_en: Packing box cardboard structure, packing box cardboard indentation cutting device and package system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of line pressing and cutting of paperboards for packaging boxes, in particular to a paperboard structure of a packaging box, a paperboard indentation cutting device of the packaging box and a packaging system, which comprise a longitudinal indentation component, a seam material cutting component and an ear material cutting component which are arranged on a paperboard conveying path, wherein the longitudinal indentation component can press longitudinal indentations for folding the paperboards on the paperboards, and the seam material cutting component and the ear material cutting component are used for cutting off redundant materials on the paperboards; the cutting track of the ear material cutting component and the indentation track of the longitudinal indentation component are collinear in the feeding direction of the paper board, and the seam material cutting component cuts a narrow-band-shaped kerf on the paper board along the direction perpendicular to the feeding direction of the paper board. Through the mutual matching of the seam material cutting device and the ear material cutting device, ear materials are cut off at the top angle of the paperboard, so that the flying wing and the top angle can not interfere when being folded, and the folded paper box is quite attractive.

title_en: Printing ink automatic replenishment printing machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of printing machines, in particular to an automatic ink supplementing printing machine which comprises a frame, wherein a reference flat plate is fixedly connected to the frame, a printing table is arranged on the reference flat plate, a Y-axis sliding rail is connected to a cutter holder table in a sliding mode, a scraper and an ink returning cutter enclosing block are arranged below the cutter holder table, the enclosing block is a hollow cuboid frame, fixing clamps are arranged at two ends of the Y-axis sliding rail, the enclosing block is fixed through fixing bolts, the hollow position of the enclosing block is used for installing a screen printing plate, a first sliding table is connected to the Z-axis sliding rail in a sliding mode, the other end of the first sliding table is fixedly connected with the Y-axis sliding rail, an ink supplementing assembly is provided with a liquid level detection sensor in an ink tank, ink is added into an oil tank through an ink inlet when the liquid level of the ink is lower than a limit value, and an ink nozzle is used for timing/instruction control of ink jet. Can automatically add printing ink, promote printing efficiency.

title_en: Dye-sublimation printing
abstract_en: Dye-sublimation printers and methods are disclosed for porous substrates or for polyester-coated substrates. In an example the device comprises a substrate path, a printhead, over a print zone of the substrate path, to transfer a print fluid on the substrate; a narrow band radiation source, over a sublimation zone of the substrate path to sublimate a portion of the transferred print fluid to form an image on the substrate; and an advancing mechanism, to transfer the substrate from the print zone to the sublimation zone.

title_en: Cardboard box assembly device
abstract_en: A cardboard box assembly device, that folds four flaps provided at edges of an opening in a cardboard box to surround the opening, is disclosed. The cardboard box assembly device includes a folding unit, a pushing unit, and a drive unit. The folding unit folds each of the four flaps in a prescribed sequence and closes the opening. The pushing unit pushes one of the four flaps, that is folded last, inward into the cardboard box as a locking flap, and overlaps the locking flap onto the other flaps. The drive unit contacts the cardboard box and imparts a prescribed displacement to the cardboard box. Parts that engage with one another are formed between the locking flap and at least one of the other flaps. The drive unit moves the locking flap relative to the other flaps due to the displacement when the pushing unit pushes the locking flap.

title_en: Brush
abstract_en: A toothbrush comprising a handle and a head, the head having a front and a back with bristles protruding from the front of the head and in which the handle, the head and the bristles are many from the same class of polymeric re-cyclable material.

title_en: Liquid ejecting apparatus, drive circuit, and integrated circuit
abstract_en: A liquid ejecting apparatus includes a liquid ejecting head ejecting a liquid by supplying a drive signal to a drive element, and a drive circuit. The drive circuit includes an integrated circuit, an amplifier circuit, and a demodulation circuit. The integrated circuit includes a modulation circuit that modulates the base drive signal to output a modulation signal, a switching circuit that outputs the amplification control signal according to the modulation signal, a discharge circuit, a constant voltage output circuit that outputs a DC voltage signal, and an output terminal from which the DC voltage signal is output. The constant voltage output circuit and the discharge circuit are electrically coupled to the output terminal, and a shortest distance between the output terminal and the constant voltage output circuit is shorter than a shortest distance between the output terminal and the discharge circuit.

title_en: Compositions and methods for producing microfibrillated cellulose with increased tensile properties
abstract_en: Methods for preparing aqueous suspensions comprising microfibrillated cellulose, and optionally inorganic particulate material, with increased tensile properties, and methods for selecting a fibrous substrate comprising cellulose for preparation of microfibrillated cellulose having increased tensile properties.

title_en: A control circuit for an inkjet head
abstract_en: According to one embodiment, a control circuit for an inkjet head or the like includes an input circuit configured to receive drive information for driving liquid ejection from a plurality of nozzle arrays. The drive information includes a drive signal value to be supplied to a channel of the plurality of nozzle arrays. A latch circuit array of the control circuit has latch circuits for storing the drive information for each array in the plurality of nozzle arrays. A setting register is configured to receive a setting value to configure the input circuit to correspond to a connection mode for the plurality of latch circuits. The setting value corresponds to the number of arrays in the plurality of nozzle arrays.

title_en: Inkjet printing method
abstract_en: An inkjet printing method on a continuous substrate web (100), having a pair of edges (1011, 1021), comprising the steps: a) forming a pair of elongated strips (101, 102) by bending said substrate web (100) along a pair of lines (1010, 1020) wherein each line is parallel to the pair of edges (1011, 1021); and b) supporting said bent substrate web in a support zone (201) of a printer (200) wherein said pair of elongated strips (101, 102) are oriented below said zone (201); and printing an image (500) on said supported substrate web by an inkjet-printhead (202) of said printer (200).

title_en: Numerical control apparatus for automated cutting of a sheet of material or of multiple superimposed sheets
abstract_en: Numerical control apparatus (1) for automated cutting of a sheet (2) of material or of multiple superimposed sheets (2), comprising: - a cutting chamber (3) equipped with an inlet (4) and an outlet (5), said cutting chamber (3) being configured to house at least one portion of the sheet (2) lying on a plane (α); - cutting means (80) active within said cutting chamber (3) to perform the cutting of said sheet (2) according to a predefined pattern; - conveying means (6) adapted to feed the sheet (2) into said cutting chamber (3) in a forward direction (A) along a longitudinal direction (Y); - holding or retaining means (10; 115) active on said sheet (2) in a combined manner with said conveying means (6) to ensure the stability of said sheet during the cutting operation of said cutting means (80); - a control unit (U) configured to control said apparatus (1); - wherein said material may be indifferently a hide, a fabric or a synthetic material, and may be fed as a single sheet (2) or as a multilayer of sheets (2), without modifying said forward direction (A).

title_en: Blowing equipment for doctor equipment of a fibre web machine and fibre web machine doctor equipment equipped with blowing equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to blowing equipment for doctor equipment of a fibre web machine. The blowing equipment (10) includes a distribution channel (11), the length of which corresponds essentially to the length of the doctor equipment (40). The blowing equipment (10) also includes nozzle devices (12) for directing blowing in the doctor equipment (40). The nozzle devices (12) are arranged to be adapted to a blade holder (13) that belongs to the doctor equipment (40) for establishing doctor blowing. The distribution channel (11) is adapted to be fastened to the blade holder (13). The invention also relates to doctor equipment of a fibre web machine, where the doctor equipment is equipped with blowing equipment.

title_en: Failing nozzle compensation and non-uniformity correction in inkjet printing
abstract_en: A method and system for detecting one or more failing nozzles in an inkjet printhead (12) of an inkjet printer (10) for printing an image on a substrate and compensating failing nozzles, as well as for correcting colour uniformity of a printed image in inkjet printing an image on a substrate are disclosed. The method comprises printing a first test pattern (30) on a dedicated substrate (16), which is optically scanned. From the scan failing nozzles are identified, which are to be compensated by other nozzles. To these compensating nozzles compensated nozzle control data are allocated, which are used in printing a second test pattern (36) that is also scanned and analysed for local deviations of colorimetric greyscale value. Corrected nozzle control data are allocated to the nozzles associated with the local deviation.

title_en: Paper-specific moisture control in a traveling paper web
abstract_en: A network-based system and method for providing desired moisture set point values for individual papers lines based on the physical properties of each liner and the atmospheric conditions associated with a corrugator is disclosed. The desired moisture set point values are based on the hygroexpansivity of each individual paper liner. Once the moisture set point value has been determined, a conditioning apparatus adjusts a moisture value for each liner in order to tune the post-warp characteristics of the final corrugated product.

title_en: Granules containing composite fibers composed of fibers and inorganic particles
abstract_en: The present invention aims to provide highly flowable granules comprising a complex fiber of a fiber with inorganic particles. Granules comprising a complex fiber of a fiber with inorganic particles are provided by the present invention. The granules of the present invention have a particle size of 0.1 to 10 mm and a water content of less than 60 %.

title_en: Liquid ejection head and recording device
abstract_en: A liquid discharge head (8) includes a head body (20), a plurality of driver ICs (33), a flexible substrate (31), and a wiring board (32). The head body (20) includes a discharge hole (63) configured to discharge a liquid. The plurality of driver ICs (33) controls drive of the head body (20). The plurality of driver ICs (33) are mounted at the flexible substrate (31), and the flexible substrate (31) is electrically connected to the head body (20). The wiring board (32) includes a plurality of connectors (32a). In addition, the flexible substrate (31) includes: a plurality of protruding portions (31p) configured to protrude in the same direction and each including a tip portion to be inserted into corresponding one of the plurality of connectors (32a); and a slit (31s) formed between the protruding portions (31p) adjacent to each other and extending up to a region between the driver ICs (33) adjacent to each other.

title_en: Method for producing a spunbond nonwoven
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method (100) for producing a spunbond nonwoven (1). A spinning material (2) is extruded through the nozzle holes (4) of at least one spinneret (3, 30) in order to form filaments (5, 50), and the filaments (5, 50) are stretched in an extrusion direction and laid on a first conveyor device (9) in order to form the spunbond nonwoven (1), said spunbond nonwoven (1) undergoing at least one washing process (10). The aim of the invention is to increase the throughput of the method without any loss in quality. This is achieved in that the spunbond nonwoven (1) undergoes the washing process (10) at least partly on a perforated second conveyor device (13) with a slower conveyor speed than the first conveyor device (9), wherein the spunbond nonwoven (1) is sprayed with washing fluid in the washing process (10), and the washing fluid is at least partly discharged through the perforated second conveyor device (13).

title_en: Printing apparatus and carriage apparatus
abstract_en: A printing apparatus (1) include a carriage (3) mounted with printing means (2), a belt (62), a first motor (61R or 61L) arranged to drive the belt at one end in the widthwise direction, a second motor (61L or 61R) arranged to drive the belt at the other end in the widthwise direction, and control means (11) configured to control the first motor and the second motor. The control (11) means performs first control by driving the first motor in which the carriage moves from a state in which the carriage is stopped. In the first control, an output of the second motor is controlled from a first state lower than an output of the first motor to a second state higher than the first state.

title_en: Textile for cleaning products
abstract_en: The invention relates to a textile for a cleaning product which comprises at least one first area and one second area, wherein the first area is comprised of a plurality of long bristles, and wherein the second area comprises a smooth surface backstitch.

title_en: Solid-state composite electrolytes comprising aramid polymer fibrils
abstract_en: A solid-state composite electrolyte, suitable for use in solid-state batteries, and a battery comprising same, the solid-state composite electrolyte comprising 70 to 99 weight percent inorganic solid electrolyte and 1 to 30 weight percent aramid polymer fibrils, based on the total weight of the inorganic solid electrolytes and aramid fibrils in the solid-state composite electrolyte, wherein the aramid polymer fibrils have: i) a diameter of 10 to 2000 nanometers, ii) a length of 0.2 to 3 millimeters, iii) a specific surface area of 3 to 40 square meters/gram, and iv) a Canadian Standard Freeness of 0 to 100 milliliters; the solid-state composite electrolyte having a thickness of 5 to 1000 micrometers.

title_en: Non-fluorinated copolymer composition and oil-resistant agent for paper
abstract_en: Provided is a non-fluorinated copolymer composition comprising (1) a non-fluorinated copolymer and (2) acetylene alcohol. The non-fluorinated copolymer (1) preferably contains no styrene skeleton. The non-fluorinated copolymer (1) preferably has (a) repeating units which are formed from an acrylic monomer that has a long-chain hydrocarbon group having 7 to 40 carbon atoms. In addition, the non-fluorinated copolymer (1) preferably has (b) repeating units which are formed from an acrylic monomer that has a hydrophilic group. The non-fluorinated copolymer composition exhibits little foaming during processing and can impart excellent oil resistance and water resistance to a base material.

title_en: Circuit board and production method therefor, circuit device and production method therefor, and printing material container assembly
abstract_en: Provided are a circuit board and production method therefor, a circuit device and production method therefor, and a printing material container assembly. The circuit board is mounted on a printing material container. The circuit board includes an original circuit board and an auxiliary part. The original circuit board includes multiple terminals configured to be in contact with the printing material container or a printing device. The auxiliary part is disposed on the original circuit board and is configured to perform at least one of the following: providing a conductive path or breaking off a conductive path between the terminals.

title_en: Polyester yarn, and method for manufacturing same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to polyester yarn containing polyester obtained by polymerization in the presence of an inorganic tin compound catalyst, and a method for manufacturing the polyester yarn, wherein the polyester yarn of the present invention which contains an inorganic tin compound may overcome problems caused by a residual antimony catalyst and may have excellent warping properties.

title_en: Zipper-type circuit fabric and smart clothes composed thereof
abstract_en: Disclosed is a zipper-type circuit fabric and smart clothes composed thereof, comprising a clothes body. The clothes body is made of waterproof conductive fabric body (1). The waterproof conductive fabric body (1) is provided with a plurality of conductive wires (3) and conductive contacts (4). Rectangular elongated conductive media (61) and folded conductive media (62) are arranged inside the conductive wires (3) so that the conductive media are stable and ductile. The clothes body is further provided with a waterproof zipper body (2). The zipper teeth on the waterproof zipper body are all electrically connected to the conductive wires (3). When the zipper body is closed, a metal probe (18) on a zipper tooth (15) is placed into a connecting slot (19) so that the left and right sides of the clothes body form a closed circuit. The clothes body can be connected to glove bodies (28) and is internally provided with a plurality of flexible sensors, which are used to identify the movements of the human body, can transmit data to the cloud/a controller, and achieve body movement analysis, health monitoring, human-machine interaction and other functions. The utility model is about clothes that integrate a conductive fabric (1), a zipper body (2) interface and flexible sensors, and have the features such as good flexibility, stretchability, non-perishability and water resistance.

title_en: Method of generating a multiplexed image for printing
abstract_en: A method of generating a multiplexed image (18) for printing that can be observed in a plurality of modes includes determining a finite shape (22) of a multiplexed palette (10) in a combined color space.
