The contrast of the multiplexed image (18) in each mode can be optimized by determining a maximum volume hyperrectangle (20) enclosed in the finite shape (22). Gamut mapping to this maximum volume hyperrectangle (20) allows for generation of a multiplexed image (18) that has a maximum contrast and is free from artifacts caused by an interdependency between the colors in each mode. Performing a dimensionality reduction using PCA allows for reducing the complexity of the optimization problem.

title_en: Warp knitted spacer mesh fabric with high air permeability, elasticity and support
abstract_en: A spacer fabric (10) is comprising a first knit layer (12), a second knit layer (14) and a third layer (16) comprising monofilament spacer yarns extending between and connecting the first and second knit layers (12, 14), with the first knit layer (12) having a mesh structure.

title_en: Inorganic-fiber woven fabric for construction film material, and construction film material
abstract_en: Provided are an inorganic-fiber fabric for a construction membrane material and construction membrane material having excellent resistance to heat damage, great ease of weaving, and high applicability for use in a construction membrane material. An average Al 2 O 3  content of a warp, At, and an average Al 2 O 3  content of a weft, Ay, are 17.5 mass% or more; a mass per unit length of the warp, Tt, and a mass per unit length of the weft, Ty, are within a range of 100 to 600 g / 1000 m; a weave density of the warp, Wt, and a weave density of the weft, Wy, are within a range of 10.0 to 55.0 filaments / 25 mm; a ratio of Tt to Ty, Tt/Ty, is within a range of 0.66 to 1.50; and At, Ay, Tt, Ty, Wt, and Wy satisfy the following formula (1-1). 316.5 ≤ Wt 1/3 ×Tt 1/2 /(At/100) + Wy 1/3 ×Ty 1/2 /(Ay/100) ≤ 550.0 ...(1-1)

title_en: Article of footwear
abstract_en: The claimed invention relates to an upper for an article of footwear comprising a knit component forming at least a surface of the upper, wherein the knit component comprises a first surface and a second surface and one or more yarns extending between the first surface and the second surface. The one or more yarns form at least part of one or more of the first surface and the second surface. The claimed invention also provides an article of footwear, comprising a sole and an upper secured to the sole. The upper comprises a knit component forming at least a surface of the upper. The knit component comprises a first surface and a second surface and one or more yarns extending between the first surface and the second surface. The one or more yarns form at least part of one or more of the first surface and the second surface.

title_en: Moisture wicking and perspiration concealing textile
abstract_en: Aspects herein are directed to a moisture wicking and perspiration concealing knit spacer textile (100) and garments (700, 800) formed therefrom that includes a first knit layer (110) formed from yarns that have been treated with a durable water repellant (DWR) finish prior to being formed into the first knit layer (110) and a second knit layer (112) formed from yarns that have been treated with a wicking finish prior to being formed into the second knit layer (112). The first knit layer (110) and the second knit layer (112) are interconnected by tie yarns (114). When the textile (100) is formed into the garment (700, 800), the second knit layer (112) is configured to be positioned adjacent to a skin surface (610) of a wearer and the first knit layer forms (110) an outer-facing surface of the garment (700, 800).

title_en: Density unevenness correction data creation method, density unevenness correction data creation apparatus, printing system, program, test chart, and test chart data creation apparatus
abstract_en:
Provided are a density unevenness correction data creation method, a density unevenness correction data creation apparatus, a printing system, a program, a test chart, and a test chart data creation apparatus in which density unevenness correction with high accuracy is implemented. 
     A captured image of a test chart including a density step pattern, an alignment mark, and a line mark is acquired, and in a case of acquiring correspondence relationship information between a theoretical position and an imaging position from the captured image, a rough correspondence relationship is acquired by using positional information of the alignment mark, a detailed correspondence relationship is acquired by using positional information of the line mark estimated by using the rough correspondence relationship, and density unevenness correction data is created by estimating a density value of each position of the density step pattern by using the detailed correspondence relationship.

title_en: Repositionable notes mural pad
abstract_en: Methods for assembling a stack of notes for use in recreating an image. The method includes receiving an image and dividing the image into pieces. The pieces of the image are printed on adhesive-coated repositionable notes in a particular order, and the printed notes are assembled into a stack of notes in the particular order. A user can recreate the image by removing the notes from the stack of notes and placing them on a surface in the particular order, such as in rows left to right and top row to bottom row. Alternatively, the method can assign color or grayscale values to the pieces for use in recreating a version or resemblance of the image.

title_en: Hollow guide shaft, pneumatic spinning device, spinning machine, and hollow guide shaft set
abstract_en: The hollow guide shaft has a shaft portion having a fiber introduction hole into which fibers are introduced and a fiber passage that is continuous with the fiber introduction hole and extends along an axial direction. Where A is an inner diameter of the fiber passage and B is a diameter of an introduction opening serving as an opening end of the fiber introduction hole, 1.12 ≤ B/A ≤ 1.3 is established.

title_en: Method for manufacturing a décor sheet for decorative panel
abstract_en: A method for manufacturing a printed décor sheet comprising the steps of: - providing a first printable or printed substrate; - performing at least one predetermined operation on said substrate, wherein said predetermined operation causes the deformation of the substrate in at least one direction; - measuring said deformation to obtain at least one deformation parameter; - providing a first master image; - performing an image processing operation on said first master image to obtain a second master image; - printing said second master image on a second printable substrate to obtain the décor sheet; characterized in that said image processing operation involves at least modifying the first master image on the basis of said first deformation parameter.

title_en: Polylactic acid and polyether compounds
abstract_en: The present invention relates to compounds which are polylactic acid and polyether copolymers, wherein the compounds comprise: a) at least one of: a sorbitan ester residue, a C6 to C24 fatty alcohol residue or a C6 to C24 fatty acid residue; b) at least 2 lactic acid residues; and c) at least 2 oxyethylene groups; and wherein the compounds comprise at least two ether bonds and at least two ester bonds. The invention also relates to a process for producing a compound wherein the process comprises the step of reacting the following reactants: a) at least one of: a polysorbate, a C6 to C24 fatty alcohol ethoxylate or a C6 to C24 fatty acid ethoxylate; and b) lactide; wherein the compound comprises at least 2 lactic acid residues at least 2 oxyethylene groups. The invention also relates to the use of such compounds as fibre finishes in non-woven materials such as personal hygiene products and/or as surfactants in cleaning applications such as home care formulations.

title_en: Folding apparatus for folding a strand of filling material placed in continuous rod of tobacco industry
abstract_en: A folding apparatus (4, 4', 4", 4‴, 4"") for folding a strip of a filling material (3) placed in a continuous rod (CR) of the tobacco industry, comprising an inner folding element (20, 20', 20", 20‴) having first folding surfaces (22) situated radially around the axis (k) of the inner folding element (20, 20', 20", 20‴) and adapted to crimp the strip of the filling material (3), an outer folding element (21, 21', 21", 21‴) having second folding surfaces (23) situated radially around the axis (m) of the outer folding element (21, 21', 21", 21‴) and adapted to crimp the strip of the filling material (3), whereas the first folding surfaces (22) situated radially around the axis (k) of the inner folding element (20, 20', 20", 20‴) are arranged between the second folding surfaces (23) situated radially around the axis (m) of the outer folding element (21, 21', 21", 21‴).

title_en: Methods for producing overt security features exhibiting one or more indicia
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the field of methods for producing eye-catching overt security features exhibiting one or more indicia as anti-counterfeit means on value documents or articles as well as decorative purposes. In particular, the present invention provides methods for producing security features that can be easily, directly and unambiguously authenticated by the human without any external device or tool, wherein said security features comprised a cured ink and one or more cured indicia, said ink comprising cured cationically curable compounds or cured hybrid curable compounds and silver nanoplatelets.

title_en: System and method for producing a single-layer or multi-layer nonwoven
abstract_en: The invention relates to a system and a method, comprising - at least one carding machine (1), which is designed to generate a fibrous web (3) by means of an aerodynamic process, - a first conveying belt (4), which is designed to convey the fibrous web (3) from the carding machine to a compactor, - a compactor, which is designed to compact the fibrous web (3) to a nonwoven (24), - a drafting device (10), which is arranged downstream in the material-conveying direction and is designed to draw the nonwoven (24) by at least the factor of 1.5, - and a consolidator, which is arranged downstream in the material-conveying direction.

title_en: Droplet discharging device and maintenance method
abstract_en: A droplet discharge device includes a droplet discharge head, a supply unit, and a controller. The droplet discharge head discharges droplets of a coloring liquid. The supply unit supplies the coloring liquid to the droplet discharge head. The controller controls each unit. During at least a part of a maintenance period after a discharge period in which droplets of the coloring liquid are discharged from the droplet discharge head, the controller controls the supply unit to supply the coloring liquid having a viscosity lower than that of the coloring liquid in the discharge period to the droplet discharge head.

title_en: Maintenance device and inkjet recording apparatus
abstract_en: A maintenance device (30) maintains a head unit (11) including an inkjet head (11). The maintenance device (30) includes a cap (72), a supply part (92), an air pump (95), and a restriction part (96). The cap (72) is attached to a nozzle surface of the inkjet head (12). The supply part (92) stores a humidifying medium, generates a humidified air by passing air through the humidifying medium, and supplies the humidified air to the cap (72). The air pump (95) sends air recovered from the cap (72) to the supply part (92) through a supply flow pass (95N). The restriction part (96) is provided in the supply flow pass (95N), and generates a loss of pressure of 4σ/R or more (σ : a surface tension of the humidifying medium WM, R : an inner diameter of the supply flow pass (95N))).

title_en: Head unit and ink jet recording device
abstract_en: Provided are a head unit and an ink jet recording device having a compact configuration including a cap mechanism. A head unit includes a recording head that has a nozzle surface on which a plurality of nozzles are disposed and is movable between a first position and a second position; a cap that is provided on the recording head and is movable between a third position that covers the nozzle surface and a fourth position that opens the nozzle surface; and an interlocking mechanism that moves the cap from the third position to the fourth position by an operation of moving the recording head from the first position to the second position and moves the cap from the fourth position to the third position by an operation of moving the recording head from the second position to the first position.

title_en: Printing cassette and printing device
abstract_en:
There is provided a printing cassette whose orientation is easy to confirm. 
     The present disclosure is a printing cassette including: a printing tape roll; and a case. The printing tape roll includes a printing tape. The printing tape is wound about an axis parallel to a first direction. The case accommodates therein the printing tape roll. The case has: an opening; a first outer surface; a second outer surface; a first recess; and a second recess. The opening allows the printing tape to be exposed outside. The first outer surface and the second outer surface cross the first direction. The printing tape roll is interposed between the first outer surface and the second outer surface in the first direction. The first recess is recessed in a second direction crossing the first direction from a peripheral edge of the first outer surface. The second recess is recessed in the second direction from a peripheral edge of the second outer surface. The second outer surface has a notch defining a part of the opening. When viewed in a direction parallel to the first direction, at least a part of the first recess overlaps at least a part of the second recess.

title_en: Inkjet printing method
abstract_en: Provided is an inkjet printing method for forming, on a printing medium, a printed image containing a dark image forming region and a light image forming region, wherein a printing duty of a colorant-containing ink in the dark image forming region is larger than that in the light image forming region, including: Step 1: a step of applying a pretreatment liquid to an outer edge portion of a region to be the dark image forming region, thereby obtaining a printing medium having a pretreatment liquid applied portion; and Step 2: a step of applying, using a line-head type inkjet method, the colorant-containing ink to the region to be the dark image forming region on a face having the pretreatment liquid applied portion of the printing medium obtained in Step 1.

title_en: Flat knitting machine and knitting method for knitted fabric
abstract_en: Provided is a flat knitting machine (1, 8) that can accurately carry out stitch density deciding and in which a sinker loop (91) is unlikely to be clamped between a fixed sinker (3) and a movable sinker (4). A flat knitting machine (1, 8) includes a movable sinker (4) and a loop stopper (22). The movable sinker (4) includes a knitting yarn catching portion (4B) and a first protrusion (4A). The flat knitting machine (1, 8) includes a swing mechanism (5) configured to swing the movable sinker (4) between a retracted position and a pressing position. A leading end portion (4a) of the first protrusion (4A) at the retracted position overlaps the knitting yarn (90) extending from the hook (21F) to the fixed sinker (3) as viewed from the longitudinal direction of the needle bed (2). When swinging the movable sinker (4) from the retracted position to the pressing position, the swing mechanism (5) swings the movable sinker (4) so that the leading end portion (4a) moves along the outer shape of the loop stopper (22), and thereafter swings the movable sinker (4) toward the pressing position. While the leading end portion (4a) moves along the outer shape, the first protrusion (4A) overlaps the knitting yarn (90) extending from the fixed sinker (3) to the hook (21F) as viewed from the longitudinal direction of the needle bed (2).

title_en: Dryer for drying coated fiber webs and production line for producing coated multi-ply fiber webs
abstract_en: The invention relates to a dryer for drying coated fiber webs, which comprises three air compartments (81, 82, 83) configured to provide drying air blows towards passing fiber web (W). Two of the air compartments (81, 82) are substantially rectangular chambers and located next to each other with two longitudinal back sides towards each other, that third air compartment (83) is a turning air compartment located with a straight surface towards ends of the two rectangular air compartments (81, 82) and having a substantially curved outer, advantageously semi-circular, outer surface. The dryer (80) is configured to form a first longitudinal drying run for the fiber web (W) in a first vertical portion (87), a curved drying run for the fiber web (W) in a turning portion (89) and a second longitudinal drying run for the fiber web (W) in a second vertical portion (88). The dryer (80) further comprises along the vertical portions (87, 88) at a distance from the air compartments (81, 82) at least one blow device (85) configured to provide support air blows to support the run of the passing fiber web (W). The rectangular air compartments (81, 82) comprise an inlet channel (84) and two outlet channels (86) and that the inlet channel (84) is located in between the outlet channels (86) in length direction of the rectangular air compartment (81, 82). The invention relates also to a production line for producing coated multi-ply fiber webs, which comprises a forming section with a head box/head boxes and a forming unit, a press section, a drying section, a sizing section, a calender, a coating section, a reel-up and a slitter-winder, The coating section comprises at least one coater for applying coating onto the multi-ply fiber and that the coater is followed by at least one dryer (80).

title_en: Boosting the cross-machine direction shrinkage and extensibility of a fiber product
abstract_en: The present invention concerns a method for modifying a fiber network of a fiber web, typically made of a cellulose-based pulp, in order to increase the drying shrinkage as well as boost the cross-machine direction (CD) extensibility of the thus prepared fiber product. The method includes the steps of imposing a three-dimensional pattern in the wet fiber web, and drying the web using evaporative drying while allowing the web to shrink without major restraints. The pattern is imposed on the web in the forming section or after the forming section, before evaporative drying, while utilizing the wet elongation of the web for the shapes of the pattern, thereby not affecting the width of the wet web. The invention also concerns the formed fiber product having an increased CD extensibility.

title_en: A high yield cooking method
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a cooking method and a digester system wherein partly digested cellulosic fiber source is compressed during cooking to provide high molecular weight xylan, high molecular weight lignin and pulp.

title_en: Bio-sustainable Nonwoven Fabrics and Methods for Making said Fabrics
abstract_en: Non-woven fabric 1 comprising a layer of plant-derived and/or biodegradable polymer fibres 2 and a biodegradable and/or biobased binder applied to an intended outer surface of the fabric. The layer may comprise a carded hydroentangled and/or thermally bonded non-woven of plant-derived fibres and/or biobased or biodegradable polymer fibres with a barrier layer composed of wetlaid cellulose-based fibrils which may be blended with biodegradable polymer fibres and/or plant-derived fibres or PLA meltblown layer or a permeable PLA film. The plant derived fibres may be cellulosic fibres selected from viscose fibres and wood pulp. The blend may comprise a carded nonwoven mix of polylactic acid fibres and Veocel® and/or bicomponent PLA/PLA fibres. One or more additional layers of plant-based fibres (16) may be included in the fabric, such as a layer of regenerated cellulose fibres, wood pulp with other cellulosic fibres and/or biodegradable PLA. The fabric can be constructed from carded, wetlaid, meltblown, spunbond nonwoven layers as well as appropriate film laminated together. The fabric may be used in a surgical article such as a surgical gown, surgical drape or disposable bed sheet.

title_en: Steel stamp box
abstract_en: A steel stamp box is configured to accommodate multiple steel stamps 30 and comprising a cap 20. The cap includes an extension 22 extending therefrom and at least one defining orifice 23 vertically passing through the extension, such that one of the multiple steel stamps is selectively removed from a body, and the one steel stamp is fixed in the least one defining orifice of the cap. Then, the cap is moved to confirm a stamping position of the one steel stamp so that the one steel stamp is tapped to stamp at least one text or symbol. The steel stamps are received in an accommodation chamber 11 of the body 10 which is covered by the cap 20. A hollow portion 24 is formed on an end of the extension facing the body. The extension may be provided with two or three defining orifices.

title_en: Information bearing contact lenses
abstract_en: A method and system for printing information on a contact lens, comprising a substrate 203 for locating contact lenses 100 thereon; a first optical measurement device 201 configured to perform a depth detection procedure to determine the location of an inner layer of the contact lens; and a printing module 202 configured to print information 103 in the inner layer Z2, Z3 of the contact lens determined from the depth detection procedure. The information may be a QR Code imprinted outside the visual optic zone on the contact lens flange. Also provided is a method for authenticating a user of a first electronic device, comprising capturing, by a first image capture device of the first electronic device, an image of the user’s eyes (510, Fig.5); analysing the captured image to identify the presence of machine-readable information in the region of the user’s eye (520, Fig.5); determining the contents of the machine-readable information (530, Fig.5); comparing the contents information against the contents of a first database (540, Fig.5); and in response to determining that the contents of the information is contained in the first database, altering the state of the first electronic device or a second electronic device (550, Fig.5).

title_en: Liquid injection head and liquid injection system
abstract_en: To provide a liquid injection head and a liquid injection system which make it possible to more efficiently recover a liquid in the vicinity of a nozzle.SOLUTION: A liquid injection head includes a supply port and an exhaust port for a liquid. The liquid injection head includes a first flow channel 201 extended between the supply port and the exhaust port in a first axial direction Y, and a nozzle 21 branched from the first flow channel 201 and designed to inject the liquid along a second axial direction Z orthogonal to the first axial direction Y. The first flow channel 201 includes a protrusion 153 opposed to an opening of the nozzle 21 which is located close to the first flow channel 201.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Transfer device and printer
abstract_en: To prevent misalignment of particles during transfer between transfer units in a transfer device having a plurality of transfer units.SOLUTION: A transfer device includes a first transfer unit 31 and a second transfer unit 32 having a first circulation section 61 and a second circulation section 71 having a plurality of through holes 610 arranged in a grid pattern, respectively. The first circulation section 61 has a cylindrical surface-shaped delivery portion in which a first suction region 611, a blow region 612, and a first blocking region 613 are adjacent to each other in an order from an upstream side. The second circulation section 71 has a cylindrical receiving portion facing a sending portion, in which the second blocking region 711 and the second adsorption region 712 continuing from a position P1 facing the blow region 612 to a downstream side are adjacent to each other in the order from the upstream side. Thereby, particles held in one transfer unit before and behind the delivery portion are not affected by an air pressure inside the other transfer unit. Therefore, misalignment of the particles can be suppressed.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: Information hiding sheet
abstract_en: To provide an information hiding sheet which makes it difficult to visually recognize information formed inside even when the sheet is seen through, while suppressing a cost of the sheet.SOLUTION: In the information hiding sheet, a first base material 1 and a second base material 2 opposite each other are peelably adhered, and hidden information 3 which is information to be hidden is formed on either the first base material 1 or the second base material 2. Background information 4 that contacts and surrounds the hidden information 3 is formed around the hidden information 3. One of the hidden information 3 and the background information 4 is formed by printing with a first ink, and the other thereof is formed by printing with a second ink. The first ink is characterized by having a lower content ratio of pigments than the second ink.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Image forming apparatus and image forming method
abstract_en: To provide an image forming apparatus that can improve productivity even when it detects a sheet on which an image is defective and performs recovery processing.SOLUTION: An image forming apparatus comprises: an input unit 2 that receives input of image data; an image forming unit 102 that executes image forming processing of forming an image on a sheet for every page of the image data input to the input unit 2; a controller unit 101 that controls the image data processed by the image forming unit 102; and a noise detection unit 110 that detects noise. When the noise detection unit 110 detects noise during the processing of the image data, the controller unit 101 controls the image forming unit 102 to re-execute image forming processing on a page corresponding to the image data.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Image forming apparatus, method for controlling image forming apparatus, and program for controlling image forming apparatus
abstract_en: To check, with an additional substrate, the operation of an arbitrary processing unit of a plurality of processing units provided in an image forming apparatus.SOLUTION: An image forming apparatus comprises: an image input unit that receives input of an image to generate data; an image output unit that outputs an image corresponding to the data; a plurality of processing units that process the data generated by the image input unit or data supplied to the image output unit; a first connection unit to which an additional substrate is connected, which includes a test unit that outputs test data for testing any one of the plurality of processing units, receives test result data output from the processing unit that receives input of the test data, and checks the operation of the processing unit that receives the input of the test data; a first selection unit that selects, from the plurality of processing units, a processing unit that receives input of the test data received from the additional substrate connected to the first connection unit; and a second selection unit that selects the test result data output from a processing unit, of the plurality of processing units, which receives input of the test data, and outputs the data to the additional substrate.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Printer, control method, and program
abstract_en: To improve print quality in printing performed by use of a thermal head.SOLUTION: A printer (1) comprises: a printing part (27) which performs printing on a printed medium (12) by a thermal head (701) on the basis of printing data; and a control part (21) which determines a split system for splitting a plurality of heater elements of the thermal head (701) into a plurality of groups, when printing on an area of one line on the printed medium (12), on the basis of printing data, and causes the printing part (27) to execute printing on the basis of the determined split system. The printing part (27) shifts timing of applying electric current to the heater element included in at least one group of the plurality of groups and timing of applying electric current to the heater element included in other groups from each other, when printing on the area of one line on the printed medium (12), on the basis of the split system determined by the control part (21).SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Liquid discharge device and system
abstract_en: To perform discharging of liquid in order to recover an abnormal nozzle in accordance with user's taste.SOLUTION: Association information indicating association between a degree of abnormality of an inkjet head and a type of a suction purge is memorized. Each of a plurality of nozzles of the inkjet head is determined for abnormality to evaluate the degree of abnormality of the inkjet head (S201). In an automatic mode (S204:YES), the suction purge determined based on the degree of abnormality of the inkjet head and the association information is performed (S205 and S206). In a manual mode (S204:NO), the suction purge corresponding to a purge selection signal inputted by a user is performed (S207, S208 and S213). Further, if the suction purge indicated by the purge selection signal is different from that indicated by the association information (S210:YES), the association in the association information is changed (S211).SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: Information processing device, learning device, and information processing method
abstract_en: To provide an information processing device, a learning device, and an information processing method and the like for executing proper processing against occurrence of dew condensation on a nozzle plate of a print head.SOLUTION: An information processing device 200 includes: a storage part 230 for storing a learned model that has been machine-learned on the basis of a data set in which temperature information, setting information and countermeasure information are associated with each other; a reception part 210 for receiving temperature information and setting information during ink discharge by a print head 30; and a processing part 220 for determining a countermeasure to be executed against dew condensation, on the basis of the received temperature information and setting information, and the learned model.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 12

title_en: Image forming device, printing method, and program
abstract_en: To provide an image forming device capable of preventing deterioration in productivity of the device and reducing occurrence of blank paper jam caused by conveyance stop even when a plurality of paper feed trays are provided and the lengths of conveying routes vary.SOLUTION: An image forming device 10 comprises a paper feed mode determination part 36 which compares the quantity of image information to be printed on paper sheets of a maximum number calculated by a maximum number calculation part 35 with capacity of the image information capable of being stored in a first memory 21, and determines whether to convey the paper sheets in a first paper feed mode or to convey the paper sheets in a second paper feed mode.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 9

title_en: Image processing system and program
abstract_en: To provide a technology for controlling a state of a control panel of an image processing system in accordance with a user's state.SOLUTION: An MFP 100 receives instructions on execution of a job and the like by an operation for a control panel 30. The MFP 100 also receives the instructions on the execution of the job and the like by a voice input into a microphone 102. When receiving the instructions by the voice, the MFP 100 can turn an attitude of the control panel 30 into a standing attitude.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Inorganic fiber molded body having surface treatment layer
abstract_en: To provide an inorganic fiber molded body capable of heightening a maximum service temperature by suppressing a heating linear shrinkage low.SOLUTION: There is provided an inorganic fiber molded body in which a surface treatment layer is formed on the surface of a base material including as a main component, the inorganic fiber comprising preferably a silica/calcia-based, silica/magnesia-based or silica/magnesia/calcia-based organism-dissoluble fiber. The surface treatment layer is composed of crystallized inorganic powders which are obtained by crystallizing the same type of inorganic fiber as the above fiber, and an inorganic binder. In the crystallized inorganic powder, the crystallinity of cristobalite is 70% or more, and a median size is less than 95 μm. The thickness of the surface treatment layer is in a range of 0.1 to 2.0 mm.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: sewing machine
abstract_en: To provide a sewing machine capable of adjusting a thread residual amount on a processed fabric side to be an optional amount.SOLUTION: A sewing machine 1 comprises a cutting member 63 and a thread length adjustment mechanism 64. The cutting member 63 cuts a needle thread S2 and a bobbin thread S1 between a hole 31 of a needle plate 3 and the cutting member 63. The thread length adjustment mechanism 64 adjusts the lengths of the needle thread S2 and the bobbin thread S1 from the hole 31 of the needle plate 3 to the cutting member 63.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 13

title_en: Image formation device
abstract_en: To solve such the problem that a system not using fθ lenses has a high-magnification correction rate and a chip surface light volume varies for each image height, therefore a relation between a pulse width and an integrated light quantity varies and gradation of image density deviates.SOLUTION: An image formation device includes: magnification specifying means for specifying a magnification in accordance with an image height of image data; pixel size determination means for determining a pixel size in accordance with a magnification; and gradation characteristic determination means for determining gradation characteristic in accordance with a pixel size and a light volume. The image formation device corrects magnification of image data.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 10

title_en: Management device, method, and program
abstract_en: To provide a mechanism to appropriately manage the operating state of applications installed in a device and the resources of the device.SOLUTION: A management device manages an image processing apparatus via a network, and has: first acquisition means that acquires application information for applications installed in the image processing apparatus; creation means that creates a task for monitoring related to the operations of the applications in the image processing apparatus; and second acquisition means that, in accordance with the generated task, acquires resource information on resources necessary for using the applications in the image processing apparatus. When the acquired resource information satisfies a predetermined condition, instructions for processing related to a second type application installed in the image processing apparatus are executed.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 15

title_en: Liquid storage body and manufacturing method for the same
abstract_en: To provide a liquid storage body comprising a holding member that can be integrally molded and also can be improved in ink supply performance.SOLUTION: The liquid storage body is a liquid storage container which comprises: a cassette; a liquid storage bag, placed on the cassette, which stores liquid discharged from a liquid discharge device; a joining member provided at an opening part at one end of the liquid storage bag; a connecting member joined to the joining member and extended to the middle of the inside of the liquid storage bag; a holding member comprising a spacer part joined to the connecting member; and tubes, mounted on the joining member and the spacer part, which derive liquid from the liquid storage bag. The spacer part has a main groove to which one end side of the tube is fitted and an auxiliary groove communicating with the main groove, where a partial non-contact space is configured between an inner side surface of the main groove and an outer side surface of the fitted tube and the auxiliary groove is communicated with the non-contact space.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Information processing system and method for controlling information processing system
abstract_en: To provide an information processing system having a user authentication function that prevents a device from falling into a non-operable state, while preventing a remote operation of an image processing measure with an initial password to increase security, and a method for controlling the information processing system.SOLUTION: In a system in which an image forming apparatus and a client terminal communicate with each other via a LAN, the image forming apparatus controls not to permit a situation in which a value for making a key lock function effective and a value of an initial password are simultaneously set as preset values of the client terminal.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7

title_en: Bag making machine, bag making machine control method, and bag manufacturing method
abstract_en: To provide a bag making machine that improves a position adjustment accuracy of a processing unit and reduces a product loss at a start of production, a bag making machine control method, and a bag manufacturing method.SOLUTION: There is provided a bag making machine comprising: a transport device that intermittently transports a long bag-making film with a reference mark printed thereon; a plurality of processing units that are arranged in a displaceable manner and perform predetermined processing while the long bag making film is stopped; a plurality of processing unit drive devices that displace the processing units individually; a cutting unit; a front mark sensor that determines a stop position of the long bag making film; a rear mark sensor that is located behind a rearmost processing unit; and processing unit displacement control means that records a reference mark sensor offset distance which is an amount of transportation from a stop position in the previous stage to detection of the reference mark by the rear mark sensor, individually calculates a target position of the plurality of processing units based on an amount of expansion and contraction in the device calculated from a difference between before and after transporting in a predetermined cycle so as to displace to the target position.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Printing device
abstract_en: To provide a printing device that can switch between two sheet conveyance destinations which occur after cutting with a simple configuration.SOLUTION: A printing device (1) includes: a transportation part for transporting a sheet (P) in a first transportation direction; an image recording part for recording an image on the sheet (P); and a cutter unit (100) including a cutter carriage (10) moving in a scanning direction and a blade (14) for cutting the sheet (P). The cutter unit (100) includes: a first guide part (11) for guiding one end in a width direction of the sheet (P) to the blade (14); and a second guide part (12) for guiding a second sheet in a second transportation direction.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Improvements in artificial muscle actuators
abstract_en: To provide an artificial muscle actuator.SOLUTION: An actuator includes a plurality of artificial muscle fibers and at least one conducting material. The at least one conducting material electrically stimulates the plurality of artificial muscle fibers during actuation of the actuator. The actuator device comprises at least one artificial muscle fiber and at least one high strength creep resistant fiber.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Image formation method and image formation system
abstract_en: To provide an image formation method for forming images in a common recording medium between an embroidering machine and a printer, and facilitating positioning of the images.SOLUTION: An image formation method includes: a step of setting a positional relationship between a first image I1 by an embroidering machine and a second image I2 by a printer; a step of setting the positions of the first image I1 and the second image I2 to a reference point P1 of a position of a recording medium 5 set in a support base 122 of the printer; a step of creating data of a third image I3 that is an image indicating a position of the reference position P1 and is formed by the embroidering machine; a step of forming the first image I1 and the third image I3 on the recording medium 5 by the embroidering machine; a step of supporting the recording medium 5 by the support base 122 so that the position of the reference point P1 indicated by the third image I3 and the reference point P1 coincide with each other; and a step of removing the third image I3 from the recording medium 5.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: Thermal transfer sheet
abstract_en: To provide a thermal transfer sheet capable of accurately transferring a transfer layer on a transferee in a region to be transferred.SOLUTION: A thermal transfer sheet 20E has a base material 5, and a heat seal layer 14D having a thermal expansion region including a hollow particle having a thermal expansion on one surface thereof. The thermal expansion region expands by heating at a predetermined temperature, and the heat seal layer 14D has a laminate structure including a first heat seal layer 11, a second heat seal layer 12 and a third heat seal layer 13. The second heat seal layer 12 is arranged nearer to the base material 5 than the first heat seal layer 11, and the third heat seal layer 13 is arranged farther from the base material 5 than the first heat seal layer 11. The thermal expansion region is contained in the first heat seal layer 11, the first heat seal layer 11 has a larger degree of expansion by heating at the predetermined temperature than the second heat seal layer 12 and the third heat seal layer 13.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 16

title_en: Information processing device and program
abstract_en: To provide an information processing device and a program for performing first authentication of a user with a smaller processing load as compared with a configuration in which the voice of the user used for operation is collated with the characteristics of voices of all users to authenticate the user and then for suppressing a third party from impersonating the user to perform the operation.SOLUTION: An information processing device in an image processing system is provided with a processor. The processor acquires a registered first voice of a first user identified in first authentication by another authentication method different from a voice using authentication method and a second voice that a second user emits in operation, compares the feature of the first voice with that of the second voice, performs second authentication to confirm that the second user is the first user identified in the first authentication, and executes processing according to the operation associated with the second voice if the second authentication is successful.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Inkjet head and image formation device
abstract_en:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an inkjet head that has high effect of preventing retention of ink in the vicinity of an outlet of a nozzle and can maintain ink injection property for a long term. 
     SOLUTION: An inkjet head includes: a pressure chamber capable of applying pressure to the ink remaining inside thereof; an ink discharging nozzle including a discharge opening for discharging ink and provided while being communicated to the pressure chamber; and multiple ink discharge channels connected while being in proximity to a communication part of the nozzle to the pressure chamber. The multiple ink discharge channels are provided asymmetrically against the discharge opening of the nozzle.

title_en: Molding production method, molding, and eraser
abstract_en: To provide a molding with improved tensile strength.SOLUTION: A molding production method has a fibrillation step for fibrillating feedstock, which includes a first layer including fibers and a second layer including a water-repellent material, a deposition step for depositing the product fibrillated in the fibrillation step, and a molding step for binding the products deposited in the deposition step with a binder to form a molding.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7

title_en: Image formation apparatus and image formation program
abstract_en: To align a re-printing page and an excellent page whose printing result is excellent and collectively output the pages in a case of performing printing processing for printing data of plural pages and acquiring the re-printing page by performing re-printing processing for a defective page whose printing result is defective.SOLUTION: An excellent page that is determined to be excellent by an inspection processing part 36 out of printing media printed by a printing processing part 34 is arranged on a re-use tray 16, and an instruction of re-printing processing is input to an image formation apparatus 10. A posture detection part 38 detects a posture of the excellent page arranged on the re-use tray 16, and a re-printing setting determination part 40 determines printing setting of the re-printing processing according to the posture of the excellent page. The printing processing part 34 executes the re-printing processing with the determined printing setting to acquire a re-printing page. An output control part 42 makes a conveyance device convey the excellent page from the re-use tray 16 and the re-printing page and collectively discharge these pages to an OK tray 12.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Water-based ink
abstract_en: To provide a water-based ink that has excellent re-dispersibility and can improve image density even in plain paper printing, and a method for producing the water-based ink.SOLUTION: A water-based ink contains crosslinked polymer particles (A) containing pigment, a crosslinked polymer emulsion (B), and water. A constituent polymer of the crosslinked polymer particles (A) containing pigment is a polymer (a) having a carboxylated vinyl monomer-derived constitutional unit and a hydrophobic vinyl monomer-derived constitutional unit crosslinked with an epoxy compound (a). A constituent polymer of the crosslinked polymer emulsion (B) is a polymer (b) having a carboxylated vinyl monomer-derived constitutional unit and a hydrophobic vinyl monomer-derived constitutional unit crosslinked with an epoxy compound (b). The epoxy compound (a) has a [C/O] ratio of 2.7-3.8 and the epoxy compound (b) has a [C/O] ratio of 1.6 or more and less than 2.7.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Image forming device
abstract_en: To provide an image forming device capable of making the effects of a process liquid substantially similar between first and second surfaces.SOLUTION: The image forming device such as an image forming system 1 comprises: a recording medium loading unit such as a paper feed tray 110a, 110b on which a recording medium such as a sheet P is loaded; coating means such as a coating unit 210 that coats one surface of the recording medium with a process liquid; and image forming means such as an ink-jet recording unit 301 that is located downstream of the coating means in the transport direction of the recording medium, and forms an image on the recording medium. The image forming device has a reverse conveyance path 140 for reversing and re-conveying the recording medium passed through the image forming means to the coating means.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Postscript printing system, postscript printing method, and control method for postscript printing system
abstract_en: To provide a postscript printing system capable of adjusting a phase of a pre-print pattern of a new web to a phase of a pre-print pattern of the present web by a simple structure.SOLUTION: A postscript printing system 30, for joining a first web 2A provided with a first mark 7A with a second web 2B provided with a second mark 7B, comprises: a first mark sensor 34 that detects a first mark 7A and generates a first mark signal; a first supply unit 38A that supplies a first web 2A; a second supply unit 38B that supplies a second web 2B; and a control unit 40 that generates a speed command signal for controlling a speed of the second supply unit 38B and outputs it to the second supply unit 38B. The control unit 40, when a moving speed at a head portion 32S of the second web 2B becomes equal to a moving speed of the first web 2A, generates a speed command signal to match phases of the first and second marks and, when the phases are matched, joins the head portion 32S to the first web 2A.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Image processing method, and image processing apparatus
abstract_en: To correctly determine the cause of a noise point being one type of an image defect based on a test image.SOLUTION: A processor 80 creates an extraction image g23 obtained by extracting a noise point Ps13 being one type of an image defect in a test image g1. In addition, the processor 80 determines the cause of the noise point Ps13 by using at least one of an edge intensity of the noise point Ps13 in the extraction image g23, the degree of flatness of the noise point Ps13, and a pixel value distribution in a traversal pixel column AR1 being a pixel column traversing the noise point Ps13.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Recording device and control method of recording device
abstract_en: To suppress an occurrence of a problem in sucking.SOLUTION: A recording device includes: sucking means for sucking liquid from a discharge port; a valve provided at a first position of a supply passage, which can be switched between an open state in which the supply passage is communicated and a closed state in which the supply passage is closed; and control means for executing first sucking control in which, with the valve in the open state, the sucking means executes sucking so that the liquid reaches the first position or a second position on the downstream side of the first position, executing second sucking control in which the sucking means executes sucking with the valve in the closed state, after the first sucking, and executing control to bring the valve into the open state after the second sucking.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 10

title_en: Image output device and image forming apparatus comprising image output device
abstract_en: To provide an image output device and an image forming apparatus that, even in the absence of a recognition device automatically recognizing the direction of an image, estimate the direction of the image to increase convenience for a user compared to before.SOLUTION: An image output device (digital multi-functional machine 1) comprises: an image data acquisition unit that acquires image data; an operation panel that has a display unit displaying a preview image based on the image data and an operation unit receiving instructions from a user, and is rotatable around a predetermined rotation shaft; a detection unit that detects the direction of rotation of the operation panel; and a control unit that controls the image data acquisition unit, the display unit, the operation unit, an image output unit, and the detection unit. The display unit of the operation panel has a rectangular shape comprising long sides and short sides. The display unit is provided with the rotation shaft allowing the display unit to rotate in at least two directions including vertical and horizontal directions. The control unit causes the image output unit to output, to an output destination, an image in a direction according to the direction of rotation of the operation panel.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Laminated nonwoven fabric, and production method of the same
abstract_en: To provide a laminated nonwoven fabric which is an integrated combination of a cellulose-based short fiber and a substrate suppressed in dropout of cellulose-based short fibers while having flexibility.SOLUTION: A laminated nonwoven fabric is composed of an integrated combination of a cellulose-based short fiber layer including a cellulose-based short fiber and a substrate by entangling fibers each other, where the substrate has a contexture such that a melt-blown nonwoven fabric is positioned between long fiber nonwoven fabrics, a face of the substrate contacting the cellulose-based short fiber layer is a surface of a long fiber nonwoven fabric, a surface farthest from a face contacting the cellulose-based short fiber layer of the substrate is the surface of the long fiber nonwoven fabric, and the bending resistance of the laminated nonwoven fabric is 5.0 cN or higher and 15.0 cN or lower.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Printing system and printing method
abstract_en: To provide a printing system capable of suppressing a deterioration in printing quality and a reduction in productivity due to the control of a conveyance speed for reducing a difference in processing speeds between a printing apparatus and a post-processing machine.SOLUTION: A printing system, including a printing apparatus for delivering printing paper after printing to a post-processing machine, and a web buffer for temporarily holding the printing paper after printing, is provided with: a required printing time calculation unit 152 for calculating a required printing time PT for each job; an amount-of-increase/decrease calculation unit 153 for calculating an amount Z of an increase/decrease in buffer consumption per set for each job on the basis of a difference between a minimum processing time MT required for processing in the post-processing machine and the required printing time PT; a predicted value calculation unit 154 for obtaining a predicted value PV of the web buffer consumption by accumulating the amount Z of the increase/decrease; and a conveyance control unit 143 for controlling the conveyance speed of the printing paper on the basis of the predicted value PV.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Recording device and maintenance method
abstract_en: To provide a technique for suppressing ejection failure at an ejection port that is caused by reaction of a reaction liquid and ink during a wiping operation.SOLUTION: In a recording device in which an ejection port surface of recording means having a first ejection port array capable of ejecting ink and a second ejection port array capable of ejecting a reaction liquid that reacts with the ink is wiped by maintenance means capable of receiving the ink and reaction liquid ejected from the recording means, ink that does not contribute to recording is ejected to a region of the maintenance means before the wiping, the region is between regions on which the first ejection port array and the second ejection port array respectively abut during the wiping.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 10

title_en: printer
abstract_en: To properly support a bent and deformed tube assembly.SOLUTION: A printer 10 comprises tube assemblies 30 that move together with movements in a scanning direction Y of an ink head 22 and a support member 50 that supports the tube assemblies 30. The tube assemblies 30 have ink tubes 32 that can be elastically deformed and leaf springs 36 extending along the ink tubes 32. The support member 50 has a bottom surface 51, connection surfaces 55 extending obliquely in a direction in which the surfaces separate from the bottom surface 51 as going upward from the bottom surface 51 when viewed from the scanning direction Y, and abutting surfaces 60, extended obliquely in the direction in which the surfaces separate from the bottom surface 51 as going upward from the connection surfaces 55 when viewed from the scanning direction Y, to which the tube assemblies 30 are abutted by elastic force by the ink tubes 32 and by the leaf springs 36. The connection surfaces 55 and the abutting surfaces 60 form bent parts 65.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: Oxidized cellulose, nanocellulose and liquid dispersions thereof
abstract_en:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide oxidized cellulose excellent in defibration. 
     SOLUTION: The oxidized cellulose is oxidized cellulose which is an oxide of a cellulose-based raw material by a hypochlorous acid or a salt thereof, and substantially contains no N-oxyl compound, wherein the degree of polymerization is 600 or less.

title_en: Polypropylene colored resin composition and method for producing the same
abstract_en: To provide a polypropylene colored resin composition that excels in color development, washing resistance, and sublimation resistance and can be stably supplied.SOLUTION: A polypropylene colored resin composition contains a polypropylene resin and a colorant, the colorant including a compound of a predetermined structure.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Image processing device and image processing device control method
abstract_en: To provide an image processing device capable of reliably obtaining a job execution result desired by a user reusing setting history information while keeping convenience of the reuse of the setting history information related with execution of a novel job, and an information processing method.SOLUTION: The device comprises: a storage unit which stores setting values related with execution of a job; a job execution unit which is capable of executing the job based on the setting values; and a control unit which controls the job execution unit based on the setting values read from the storage unit. In a case where a specific setting value is changed from an initial value in reading the setting values, the control unit restricts application of the specific setting value.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: recording device
abstract_en: To accurately measure density.SOLUTION: A recording device includes: a flow channel through which liquid to be supplied to a recording head for discharging the liquid flows; and a density measurement part including a light-emitting part for emitting light and a light receiving part for receiving light and measuring density of liquid. The density measurement part is disposed in a direction change part where a flow direction of the liquid flowing through the flow channel changes.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 8

title_en: Printing system, information processing apparatus, and control program
abstract_en: To provide an efficient printing system that reduces energy consumption.SOLUTION: A printing system is a printing system in which a printer and an information processing apparatus are connected via a network, the information processing apparatus receiving image data from an imaging apparatus that picks up an image of a user of the printer and performing authentication processing on the user based on the image data. The printer comprises a detection unit that detects a human body, and a transmission unit that transmits detection information from the detection unit. The information processing apparatus comprises a receiving unit that receives the detection information, and a control unit that controls whether to perform the authentication processing based on the detection information.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: printer
abstract_en: To prevent the mist of ink from scattering inside a printer 1.SOLUTION: A printer 1 comprises: a printing part 30 for discharging ink from an inkjet head 31 onto a medium M; and a mist suction part 40 for suctioning mist of the ink. The printing part 30 includes a first inkjet head, and a second inkjet head which is provided downstream of the first inkjet head in a conveyance direction H of the medium M. The mist suction part 40 includes: a first mist suction unit provided between the first inkjet head and the second inkjet head in the conveyance direction H; a second mist suction unit provided downstream of the second inkjet head in the conveyance direction H; a first flow channel connecting a blower 50 and the first mist suction unit to each other; and a second flow channel connecting the blower 50 and a second mist suction unit to each other. Suction force of the second mist suction unit is stronger than suction force of the first mist suction unit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Communication apparatus and control method for the same, and program
abstract_en: To appropriately performing control for stopping an operation in a state for receiving setting information, as the object of the present invention.SOLUTION: The problem is solved by providing changing means for executing, when a predetermined process is completed during a communication apparatus is operating in a first state, a first change process that executes at least one of a change to increase a counted first value and a change to decrease a first threshold.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Fiber body manufacturing method and fiber body manufacturing device
abstract_en: To provide a fiber body manufacturing method and a fiber body manufacturing device, which can quantitatively supply even materials having different compositions or densities to a defibrating section.SOLUTION: A fiber body manufacturing method includes a first supply step to measure and supply a first raw material (paper strip M1) to a defibrating section (defibrating machine 30) and a second supply step to measure and supply a second raw material (small strip M2) having different composition and density from the first raw material (paper strip M1) to the defibrating machine 30. The fiber body manufacturing method also includes a defibrating step to defibrate the supplied paper strip M1 and the small strip M2 by the defibrating machine 30, a dispersion step to disperse the paper strip M1 and the small strip M2 that were defibrated in the defibrating step, and an accumulation step to accumulate the paper strip M1 and the small strip M2 that were dispersed. In the first supply step and the second supply step, materials are intermittently supplied to the defibrating machine 30. Supply timing to the defibrating machine 30 is different between the first supply step and the second supply step.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Liquid cartridge and liquid consuming device
abstract_en: To provide a liquid cartridge which can reduce the number of sensors and is less likely to be deformed by impact.SOLUTION: An ink cartridge 30 includes: a housing 33 having a liquid storage chamber 36; a residual quantity detection part 62 that has a light access part 133A to which light traveling in right and left directions 55 and 56 crossing upper and lower directions 53 and 54 and front and back directions 51 and 52 is emitted on an upper side 54 of the liquid storage chamber 36, and changes the state of the light according to a quantity of liquid stored in the liquid storage chamber 36; and a plate member 67 that is positioned above the liquid storage chamber 36 and in front 51 of the light access part 133A in the attachment posture, is rotatable around an axis A in the upper and lower directions 53 and 54, and changes its posture to a first posture extending in the front and back directions 51 and 52, and a second posture extending in a direction crossing the front and back directions.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: Inkjet recording device
abstract_en: To provide an inkjet recording device capable of reducing an influence of residual vibration at the time of continuous discharge, without delaying a discharge cycle of ink.SOLUTION: An inkjet recording device includes: a recording head including a plurality of compression chambers and a plurality of compression elements that apply a pressure to ink in each compression chamber to discharge the ink; a head drive part that applies a drive voltage to the compression elements to cause a drive waveform according to an ink discharge amount to be generated; a conveyance part; and a control part. When a timing at which vibration generated due to application of the drive voltage at the time of ink discharge is composed with a residual amplitude of a vibration waveform remaining from the time of preceding ink discharge is set as a composition timing, the control unit applies a drive voltage at the time of N-th ink discharge such that a vibration direction of the residual amplitude remaining from the time of N-1-th ink discharge is the same as a vibration direction of vibration generated due to the drive voltage at the time of N-th ink discharge.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 10

title_en: Image formation apparatus, control method and program
abstract_en: To guarantee that a chart printed in proper printing setting is used as a chart for color adjustment of an image formation apparatus.SOLUTION: A scanner unit reads a chart. A read image determination device acquires a read RGB value of a patch being a single color of C, M, Y from read image data. The read image determination device converts the acquired read RGB value of each of C, M, Y into a density value of each of C, M, Y. The read image determination device acquires a target density value with a gradation target table of each of C, M, Y. The read image determination device compares the target density value with the density value calculated from the read RGB value, and determines whether or not an absolute value of a difference between the target density value and the density value calculated from the read RGB value is larger than a prescribed threshold. The read image determination device displays on a display part a warning message that urges a user to invalidate setting of density adjustment (color adjustment) and toner saving and execute automatic gradation correction.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Image processing device, image processing method, recording device and program
abstract_en: To provide a technique that enables a character/line drawing recorded with metallic colors to be visually recognized easily as metallic color image.SOLUTION: An image processing device generates recording data representing application and non-application of first ink and of second ink in each pixel so that the first ink containing metallic particles and the second ink containing color materials are applied to form a metallic color image, on the basis of image data. When forming an image having a narrow line width or an image having a narrow area, with respect to pixels forming the metallic color image, the image processing device generates recording data for controlling the application of the first ink and of the second ink so that a metallic film formation level which is a percentage of metallic particles fused to form a metallic film in a state where there is no color material around the metallic particles in the applied metallic particles becomes lower.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 12

title_en: Fabric and production method of fabric
abstract_en: To provide a fabric which expresses high water repellency without using a fluorine-based or silicone agent, and has excellent washing durability, and to provide a production method of the same.SOLUTION: A fabric including an organic fiber (excluding a polyolefin fiber) is obtained by subjecting a surface of at least one side of the fabric to X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy analysis at a sample inclination angle of 45°. In the fabric, a ratio of an area of a peak of C-C coupling and C-H coupling to a gross area of a peak of C1s spectrum is 90% or more. A production method of the fabric includes a step of bringing a vinyl compound represented by the following formula (1) into contact with a fabric base material including an organic fiber (excluding a polyolefin fiber), and irradiating the product with ultraviolet rays. R-CH=CH2(1) (wherein, R represents an alkyl group having 6 or more carbon atoms.)SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Surface treatment agent and leather surface-treated using the same
abstract_en: To provide a surface treatment agent which imparts excellent abrasion resistance to a base material for leather without impairing bending resistance, and can impart antifouling performance having both excellent SG property and SR property thereto.SOLUTION: A surface treatment agent contains (A) an aqueous polyurethane resin, (B) an acrylic resin, (C) a fluorine-containing compound, and (D) a hydrophilic compound, wherein (A) the aqueous polyurethane resin is a chain elongation material by (e) polyamide having two or more amino groups and/or imino groups of a neutralized product of an isocyanate group-terminated prepolymer that is a reaction product of (a) organic polyisocyanate, (b) polyol, (c) a compound having an anionic hydrophilic group and at least two active hydrogens, and (d) polyhydric alcohol, (b) the polyol includes at least one selected from the group consisting of (b1) polycarbonate diol having a diol-derived structural unit having a branch structure having 3 to 10 carbon atoms, and (b2) polycarbonate diol having a diol-derived structural unit having a linear structure having odd numbers of 3 to 9 carbon atoms, and (d) the polyhydric alcohol contains polyhydric alcohol having at least three or more active hydrogens.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: recording device
abstract_en: To provide a technique that enables a recording device, which can selectively switch recording of a cut sheet and recording of a continuous sheet, to perform an appropriate process for a conveyance disorder.SOLUTION: A recording device comprises: a recording part that records an image on sheets; a first conveyance path through which a cut sheet which is the sheet is conveyed toward the recording part; a second conveyance path through which a continuous sheet which is the sheet is conveyed toward the recording part; and a common conveyance path through which the sheets are conveyed in a conveying direction from a merging point where the first conveyance path and the second conveyance path merge with each other to the recording part. When the sheet is not detected in the second conveyance path and the sheet is detected in the common conveyance path after a conveyance disorder of the sheet is sensed, the recording device executes an ejection operation of conveying the cut sheet through the first conveyance path toward the recording part.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Thermal ink jet print head and thermal ink jet printer
abstract_en: To provide a thermal ink jet print head and a thermal ink jet printer suited for enlarging the printing width in a main scanning direction.SOLUTION: A thermal ink jet print head A1 comprises: a substrate 1; a resistor layer 4; an electrode layer 3; a protective layer 5; a plurality of foam formation rooms 61 arranged on one side in the thickness direction to correspond to each of a plurality of heating parts 41; a plurality of discharge ports 62 connecting to the plurality of foam formation rooms 61 respectively; an ink tank 9 storing ink Ik to be introduced to the plurality of foam formation rooms 61; and an introduction passage 63 connecting the ink tank 9 and the plurality of discharge ports 62. On the substrate 1, the ink Ik which contains ceramic and stays in a foam formation room 61 foams due to heat from a heating part 41, making the discharge ports 62 discharge a drop Dr of the ink Ik.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Image formation apparatus. conveyance control method of image formation apparatus and program
abstract_en: To reduce a loss of a recording medium following acceleration/deceleration in an apparatus.SOLUTION: An image formation apparatus comprises: conveyance means which conveys a continuous recording medium; image formation means which is arranged so as to be opposed to the recording medium and forms an image in the recording medium according to the conveyance of the recording medium; and conveyance control means which controls conveyance of the recording medium in the conveyance means. The conveyance control means conveys the recording medium by a prescribed amount to the side opposite to the first direction after the prescribed amount of conveying the recording medium to the side opposite to the first direction before starting conveyance of the recording medium in the first direction is determined.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Program and information processing device
abstract_en: To enhance reproducibility of an image of a printed matter to be displayed on a screen in comparison to a case where a masking effect due to increase in a total amount of color materials used for formation of the image is not reflected on the appearance of the image of the printed matter.SOLUTION: There is provided a program which causes a computer that reproduces an image of a printed matter before printing and displays the image on a screen to implement a changing function of, in a case where a first image generated according to density values of color materials and a second image representing a surface of a sheet to be used for printing are combined to generate the image of the printed matter, changing appearance of the second image, according to a total amount of the color material to be used for printing the corresponding first image, for each pixel position.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: liquid discharge device
abstract_en: To suppress discharge characteristics from deteriorating.SOLUTION: A liquid discharge device is provided with: a liquid discharge head that comprises a first piezoelectric element that is driven in response to supply of a driving signal, a first nozzle that discharges liquid by pressure applied when the first piezoelectric element is driven, and a first individual passage, communicated with the first nozzle, through which liquid is supplied to the first nozzle and liquid not discharged from the first nozzle is ejected; a circulation control part that controls circulation motion of circulating liquid in the first individual passage; and a micro vibration control part that supplies a driving signal having a first waveform to the first piezoelectric element and controls micro vibration motion of vibrating liquid in the first nozzle while preventing the first nozzle from discharging liquid. The circulation control part starts the circulation motion at a first timing, and the micro vibration control part starts the micro vibration motion at a second timing later than the first timing.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 16

title_en: Image forming apparatus
abstract_en: To provide an image forming apparatus that, even if it is shut down while printing is suspended, can easily start printing the next page when it is started up after the shutdown.SOLUTION: An image forming apparatus has: a start-up control unit Pr6 that starts up the image forming apparatus; a print processing unit Pr3 that forms an image on a medium; an image processing unit Pr2 that generates page data and outputs it to the print processing unit Pr3; and a holding processing unit that, in a medium ejection unit, holds a printed material on which an image is formed while causing a part of the printed material to project to the outside of an apparatus body. When the power is turned off with the printed material held in the medium ejection unit, the image processing unit Pr2 records, in a storage 55, the number of data outputs of the page data to the print processing unit Pr3. Even if the image forming apparatus is shut down, the image forming apparatus can easily start printing the next page when it is started up after the shutdown.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Optica scanner and image formation device
abstract_en: To provide an optical scanner and an image formation device having high vibration suppression effect with a simple configuration.SOLUTION: An optical scanner 20 is attached to an image formation device 10 as a unit. The optical scanner 20 is fixed on one end side of a beam emitting direction (longitudinal direction X) of the optical scanner 20 relative to the image formation device 10, and is positioned by one-point locking by a locking part 25 on the other end side of the beam emitting direction. A weight member 28 is provided on the other end side of the optical scanner 20.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7A

title_en: Sheet for thermal transfer recording
abstract_en: To provide a sheet for thermal transfer recording that enables the creation of images that remain stable in color balance even when stored for a prolonged period.SOLUTION: A sheet for thermal transfer recording includes a substrate, and a yellow colorant layer, a magenta colorant layer, a cyan colorant layer and a protective layer, which are formed on the substrate. The yellow colorant layer, the magenta colorant layer, the cyan colorant layer, and the protective layer are formed in surface sequence. The protective layer includes a compound represented by the general formula (1). [In the general formula (1), A's independently represent =CH- or =CH-C6H4-, Y's independently represent an oxygen atom or a sulfur atom, and R1 and R2 independently represent a hydrogen atom or a C1-4 alkyl group.]SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Absorber, liquid receiving part and liquid discharging device
abstract_en: To provide an absorber which can improve maintainability when an absorber is replaced.SOLUTION: An absorber 811 for absorbing a liquid discharged from a liquid discharge head is formed by stacking three or more layers, wherein an upper most layer 801 and a lower most layer 802 are non-woven fabrics and have through holes penetrating through the layers in a lamination direction, and an inner layer 820 has a porous structure having high liquid absorption force than the uppermost layer and the lowermost layer.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Printer
abstract_en: To provide a printer which improves convenience of a user at the time of printing a plurality of printing data as compared to before.SOLUTION: A printer includes a printing head and a control part. The control part acquires code information obtained from one read-out identification code (S2). The control part specifies first printing data and second printing data different from the first printing data from code information (S16). The control part executes printing processing of driving the printing head, and executing printing of a first label based on the first printing data specified by the specific processing, and printing of a second label based on the second printing data.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: Image formation device
