abstract_en: To solve the problem in which in a case where discharging sheets remaining in a sheet conveyance path to a reverse tray, depending upon a length of the sheet to be discharged may decrease buckling of the sheet, and decrease a load of a sheet processing property by a user.SOLUTION: An image formation device comprises: sheet supply means that has a sheet conveyance path; image formation means that forms images on sheets; reverse means that has a reverse conveyance path and a reverse conveyance roller; driving means that drives the reverse conveyance roller; double-sided conveyance means that has a double-sided conveyance path; reverse support part that supports the sheet; and control means that controls the driving means so as to discharge the sheet remaining in the reverse conveyance path. The control means is configured to, when a conveyance failure occurs in the sheet passing through the sheet supply conveyance path or double-sided conveyance path and the sheet remaining in the reverse conveyance path is discharged to the reverse support part, control the number of sheets to be discharged to the reverse support part on the basis of information on a length of the sheet.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7

title_en: Liquid discharge device
abstract_en: To provide a liquid discharge device capable of downsizing, and improving accuracy of liquid discharge.SOLUTION: A liquid discharge device comprises a substrate unit which is electrically connected to a print head by fitting a first connector and a second connector, and which has a wiring board containing a plurality of rigid members and a flexible member. A first rigid member laminated on a first plane of a first region of the flexible member and a second rigid member laminated on a first plane of a second region of the flexible member are positioned so as to face each other. A third rigid member laminated on a first plane of a third region of the flexible member is positioned so that a normal direction of a third surface crosses a normal direction of a first surface and a second surface. Further in the liquid discharge device, the second connector is provided on a fourth rigid member laminated on a second plane of a third region of the flexible member, and sizes of the third rigid member and the fourth rigid member are smaller than a size of the print head when viewing a first discharge part from the first connector.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 30

title_en: Liquid discharge head and liquid discharge device
abstract_en: To provide a liquid discharge head and a liquid discharge device which can improve mounting property.SOLUTION: A liquid discharge head includes a piezoelectric member, a substrate, an individual electrode and a common electrode. The piezoelectric member has a plurality of piezoelectric elements which are composed of a piezoelectric material and have a plurality of grooves formed in one direction and are arranged through the groove, and a connection part for connecting the plurality of piezoelectric elements. The substrate is joined to the connection part of the piezoelectric member. The individual electrode and the common electrode are formed on side faces on one side and the other side in the one direction of the piezoelectric member. The groove is configured so that the depth of the end on the individual electrode side is deeper than the end on the common electrode side, and the individual electrode side has such a depth as to reach the substrate.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Notification Management Device
abstract_en: To prompt a printing device to return to an online state where automatic purchase is possible when automatic purchase of printing privileges may be performed but the printing device is offline.SOLUTION: A notification management program 131 executes: a procedure of S40 to determine whether or not a printing system is in an auto-charge mode in which the number of printable sheets of paper can be increased by automatic purchase of printing privileges; a procedure of S10 to determine whether a multifunction machine 200 is in an online state in which instructions can be received from a management server 100 via a network NT or in an offline state in which instructions cannot be received from the management server 100 via the network NT; and a procedure of S35 to output an offline notification indicating that auto-charge is not executed in response to determination that the printing system is in the auto-charge mode in the procedure of S40 and determination that the printing system is in the offline state in the procedure of S10.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 8

title_en: Image Recording Device
abstract_en: To inhibit decrease in the operating rate of the image recording device.SOLUTION: In a printer 100, a conveyance path 440B connects a supply tray 410B with a platen 470B and a recording head 480B. A conveyance path 440A is arranged on an inner side of the conveyance path 440B and connects a supply tray 410A with a platen 470A and a recording head 480A. An outer cover 540 closes the conveyance path 440B at a closed position P2a on an outer side of the conveyance path 440B, and moves away from the closed position P2a to an open position P2b where the conveyance path 440B is open. An inner cover 530 closes the conveyance path 440A at an outer mounting position on an outer side on the conveyance path 440A, and moves away from the mounting position so as to open the conveyance path 440A. The inner cover 530 is located at the mounting position when the outer cover 540 opens the conveyance path 440B.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Liquid discharge head and liquid discharge device
abstract_en: To provide a technology that can properly manage impact from humidity on a driving element and members around the driving element with a simple structure in which the driving element and a temperature detection part are connected to one wiring board in a liquid discharge head.SOLUTION: A liquid discharge head includes: a wiring board; a plurality of pressure chambers storing liquid and communicated to a nozzle; a driving element electrically connected to the wiring board and changing internal pressure of the pressure chambers; and a humidity detection part electrically connected to the wiring board and detecting humidity.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Network device and processing method for network device
abstract_en: To allow the security of communication to be enhanced.SOLUTION: A network device includes: acquisition means that acquires proxy information set in the network device; and communication means that communicates with a management server via a proxy server using the proxy information if an aggregation mode is enabled and the proxy information is information received from the proxy server, or if the aggregation mode is not enabled, and that does not communicate with the management server if the aggregation mode is enabled and the proxy information is not information received from the proxy server.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 12

title_en: Image formation apparatus and processing method
abstract_en: To provide an image formation apparatus which improves the convenience of setting.SOLUTION: An image formation apparatus 100-A includes a communication unit 110-A which communicates with another image formation apparatus 100-B via a network and a processing unit 120-A. The processing unit 120-A provides a setting screen, when the setting of the image formation apparatus 100-A is received in the setting screen, reflects the setting on the image formation apparatus 100-A, and reflects the setting reflected on the image formation apparatus 100-A on the other image formation apparatus 100-B.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Image forming apparatus
abstract_en: To feed a recording medium to an image forming unit based on the state of the recording medium.SOLUTION: An image forming apparatus 100 comprises: an image forming unit 17 that forms images on a recording medium; a pickup roller 151 that feeds the recording medium to the image forming unit; a medium sensor 14 that detects the state of the recording medium; and a control unit 20 that determines the level of the state of the recording medium from a plurality of levels for classifying the state of the recording medium based on a result of detection made by the medium sensor, and controls the pickup roller based on the determined level.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: Cleaning of lower side of screen
abstract_en: To provide means for using a variable vacuum source to maximize cleaning performance.SOLUTION: In a method, a cleaning head which may move over a surface of a print screen is used to clean the print screen. The method includes: a step in which a vacuum source connected to the cleaning head through a flow line is used to create a suction force applied to the surface of the print screen in the cleaning head; and a step in which the cleaning head is moved over the surface of the print screen. The suction force applied to the surface is controlled according to determined printing parameters.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7

title_en: Device and method
abstract_en: To reduce a fluid crosstalk in which pressure is transmitted to a pressure chamber.SOLUTION: A liquid discharge device includes: a passage member having a passage in which a pseudoplastic liquid flows; an actuator which applies a pressure to the liquid in the passage to cause droplets to be discharged from the passage member; and a passage sequentially circulating through a supply reservoir, a plurality of supply manifolds, a plurality of supply passages, a plurality of pressure chambers, a plurality of recovery passages, a plurality of recovery manifold, and a recovery reservoir. The passage has a passage shape such that an average viscosity of the liquid in the supply passages becomes a half of or lower than an average viscosity of the liquid in the supply manifolds when a circulation flow rate is a target flow rate to reduce fluid crosstalk.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 8

title_en: Printer and adjustment method of printer
abstract_en: To provide a printer which can suppress skew of a printing medium.SOLUTION: A printer 1 includes: a conveyance unit 24 which conveys a printing medium; a print head 42 which performs printing on the printing medium on a conveyance path R; a first guide 70 which is arranged on a lateral side in a conveyance direction of the printing medium with respect to the printing medium; a second guide 90 which is arranged on the opposite side of the first guide 70 across the printing medium and can move in a cross direction I crossing the conveyance direction F from a position of contacting the printing medium to a position of separating from the printing medium; a third guide 72 which is arranged at a position closer to the conveyance unit 24 than the first guide 70 and the second guide 90 and on the lateral side of the printing medium; and a fourth guide 92 which is arranged at a position closer to the conveyance unit 24 than the first guide 70 and the second guide 90 and is arranged on an opposite side to the third guide 72 with the printing medium interposed therebetween. The third guide 72 and the fourth guide 92 are provided in a movable manner in the cross direction I to the position of separating from the printing medium.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Inkjet ink composition and recording method
abstract_en: To provide an inkjet ink composition that is excellent in discharge stability by an inkjet method, and also in clog recoverability in an inkjet head, and to provide a recording method that can stably discharge an inkjet ink composition with excellent stability, can suitably recover when clog is generated in an inkjet head, and can stably produce a recorded matter formed with a recording part with a desired pattern.SOLUTION: An inkjet ink composition contains dye stuff, an organic solvent and water. As the organic solvent, at least one kind selected from the group consisting of 1-(2-hydroxyethyl)-2-pyrrolidone, and 2-pyrrolidone, and a compound represented by the following formula (1) are contained.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Hollow fiber membrane module and manufacturing method of hollow fiber membrane module
abstract_en: To provide a hollow fiber membrane module capable of improving adhesiveness between a potting part and a case and effectively performing filtering/deaeration treatment on processed liquid without detachment of the potting part and the case, and a manufacturing method of a hollow fiber membrane module.SOLUTION: A hollow fiber membrane module comprises: a hollow fiber membrane bundle 11 obtained by bundling a plurality of hollow fiber membranes 1 so as to be aligned in a length direction; a case 2 in which the hollow fiber membrane bundle 11 is stored; and a potting part 3 which fixes at least one end 11A of the hollow fiber membrane bundle 11 in the length direction into the case 2 in a state where an end face 1A of the hollow fiber membrane 1 is opened. When a heat cycle test defining a condition that temperatures and times are {-20°C×2 hours} and {60°C×2 hours} as one cycle is implemented in 50 cycles on a hollow fiber membrane module 10, the potting part 3 and the case 2 are not peeled and an adhered state is maintained.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Film for ultraviolet laser printing, printed matter and method for producing the same, and worked article
abstract_en: To provide a film for ultraviolet laser printing which can obtain printing spots excellent in printing clarity for one point when being irradiated with an ultraviolet laser beam, and further has heat-sealability, a printed matter in which an irradiation region is discolored by irradiating the film for ultraviolet laser printing with an ultraviolet laser beam and a method for producing the same, and a worked article using the film for ultraviolet laser printing or the printed matter.SOLUTION: A film for ultraviolet laser printing has a film base material obtained by internally adding titanium oxide, and a sealant layer on at least one surface of the film base material, wherein a content of the titanium oxide in the film base material is 0.2 mass% or more, and a crystallite size of the titanium oxide is 30 nm or more.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Polyester fiber product and polyester fiber product dyeing method
abstract_en: To provide a polyester fiber product, which can reduce water and energy amount used in dyeing while suppressing uneven dyeing and has sufficient strength for practical use, and also to provide a method to dye the polyester fiber product.SOLUTION: A polyester fiber product to be provided includes: a polyester yarn having high surface crystallinity lower by 4% or more and 20% or less than a central part crystallinity; and a disperse dye. A polyester fiber product dyeing method to be provided includes: a laser pretreatment step to make the surface crystallinity lower by 4% or more and 20% or less than the central part crystallinity by irradiating laser to the polyester fiber product; and a printing step to print the disperse dye after the laser pretreatment step.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Reactive hot-melt adhesive, bonded body, method for producing the same, and garment
abstract_en: To provide a reactive hot-melt adhesive excellent in both initial adhesive force and initial tackiness.SOLUTION: A reactive hot-melt adhesive contains an urethane prepolymer having: a polymer chain containing a polyol-derived structural unit and a polyisocyanate-derived structural unit; and an isocyanate group bonded to a terminal of the polymer chain. The polyol-derived structural unit contains 60 mass% or more of structural units derived from aromatic ring-containing polyester polyols. The aromatic ring-containing polyester polyols include a polyester polyol having number average molecular weight of 700 or less and a polyester polyol having number average molecular weight of 2,000 or more. The content of a structural unit derived from the polyester polyol having the number average molecular weight of 700 or less is 1-10 mass% in the polyol-derived structural unit.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Partition member for total heat exchange element, total heat exchange element using the same, and method for manufacturing partition member for total heat exchange element
abstract_en: To provide a partition member for a total heat exchanger with excellent heat exchange efficiency, and a manufacturing method thereof.SOLUTION: The present invention provides a partition member for a total heat exchange element containing a hydrophobic porous substrate, and fine fibers of polymeric polysaccharides with a fiber width of 1 to 1,000 nm provided in at least pore portions of the hydrophobic porous substrate, where an air permeability is 10,000 seconds or more, and a moisture permeability under a condition of 20°C and 65% RH is 2,500 g/m2 24Hr or more; and a method for manufacturing the partition member for the total heat exchange element, comprising applying coating liquid containing the fine fibers of polymeric polysaccharides with a fiber width of 1 to 1,000 nm to the hydrophobic porous substrate, and drying the coating liquid.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Use of modified polyamide for manufacturing anti-bacterial textile products
abstract_en: To provide economical, more effective and less polluting methods for manufacturing textile articles with anti-bacterial properties.SOLUTION: The invention provides the use of a polyetheramine in a polyamide containing nylon, in order to impart or increase anti-bacterial properties of the polyamide.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Recording apparatus
abstract_en: To solve the first problem that not both of downsizing and heat generation of a motor are taken into consideration and the second problem that not both of downsizing and quietness are taken into consideration, in a conventional art.SOLUTION: A recording apparatus comprises: a recording part that performs recording on a medium being conveyed in a first direction; a recording-time conveyance path opposing to the recording part; a guiding path which is positioned below the recording-time conveyance path, and through which the medium passed from the recording-time conveyance path is guided in a second direction being an opposite direction to the first direction; a reversing path that is connected to the guiding path, reverses the medium. and causes the medium to join to the recording-time conveyance path; a reversing roller that is arranged in the reversing path, and feeds the medium downstream in the reversing path; a motor for reversing that drives the reversing roller; a first path forming part forming a lower surface of the recording-time conveyance path; and a second path forming part forming an upper surface of the guiding path. Therein the motor for reversing is arranged at a position sandwiched by the first path forming part and the second path forming part.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Conveying device
abstract_en: To provide a conveying device that can stably suck and convey a sheet member and prevent deterioration of the image quality due to mist.SOLUTION: A conveying device includes: a conveying belt 21 which has a plurality of belt holes 21a, and sucks and conveys a sheet member P by negative pressure generated within the belt holes 21a; and a platen 26 which is provided on the opposite side of the conveying belt 21 to a suction surface of the sheet member P, supports the conveying belt 21, and has a plurality of suction holes 32. The belt holes 21a and the suction holes 32 are formed at positions where they do not overlap in a direction (front-to-back direction) perpendicular to a conveying direction of the sheet member P when viewed vertically from the suction surface side of the conveying belt 21.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Liquid jet head
abstract_en: To provide a liquid jet head that can exert high injection performance.SOLUTION: A liquid jet head includes: a flow passage formation substrate which has a pressure chamber partitioned by a bulkhead; a diaphragm which is provided on one surface side of the flow passage formation substrate; a piezoelectric actuator which is provided along a first direction from the one surface side of the diaphragm and has a first electrode, a piezoelectric layer and a second electrode; a curvature control unit which can control a curvature of the diaphragm, overlaps with the diaphragm when viewed from the first direction, and is provided along an edge of the pressure chamber.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Aerosol product for forming clothing
abstract_en: To provide a novel and improved aerosol product for forming clothing that can form clothing.SOLUTION: The aerosol product for forming clothing comprises at least liquid concentrate containing polymer and solvent and a propellant for spraying aerosol, and forms a film having detachability by spraying the aerosol product to product clothing covering a part of a human body.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Operating device and image processing apparatus
abstract_en: To provide an operating device that easily copes with positional deviation of an operating position, and an image processing apparatus.SOLUTION: An operating device comprises a display processing unit and a selection processing unit. The display processing unit displays a plurality of objects Ob1-Ob6 on a touch panel display 15. The selection processing unit selects, from the plurality of objects Ob1-Ob6, any one object on which a touch operation is performed, on the basis of a user's touch position P1 on the touch panel display 15. When the touch position P1 is within a specific range corresponding to two or more objects Ob1, Ob2, the display processing unit displays objects other than the two or more objects Ob1, Ob2 in a non-active state, and the selection processing unit executes selection support processing of selecting one object from the two or more objects Ob1, Ob2.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Printing System
abstract_en: To provide a printing system capable of preventing a roll sheet from running out during printing, the running out having occurred in conventional banner printing where the printing length and the remaining amount of roll sheet are compared for each page.SOLUTION: A printing system according to the invention is configured to: for banner printing where a sheet cannot be replaced during printing, calculate size of a sheet received from a client before starting printing; and determine whether or not to print so as to eliminate waste of the sheet due to interruption of printing during the printing can be exchanged on the way of printing in banner printing. The printing system is configured to: calculate size of a sheet received from a mobile terminal before starting printing; and determine whether or not to print. The printing system is configured to: for IPP printing where sheet size for each page is included in raster data, analyze, after receiving, by a printer, page information, received data; and determine whether or not to print.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Three-dimensional object printing system and three-dimensional object printing method
abstract_en: To provide a three-dimensional object printing system and a three-dimensional object printing method capable of easily improving the accuracy of printing a three-dimensional object and easily increasing productivity.SOLUTION: The three-dimensional object printing system comprises: a printing table T on which a three-dimensional object 10 is placed; a detection reference mark 15 fixed on the printing table T; detection means 101 for detecting a position of the detection reference mark 15 and a detection point on a surface of the three-dimensional object 10; printing data generation means 102 for generating printing data; printing means 103 for executing printing on the three-dimensional object 10 on the basis of the generated printing data; and control means 104. The printing data generation means 102 calculates a correction value of a printing position on the basis of the position of the detection reference mark 15 detected by the detection means 101 and a position of a printing reference point c, reflects the correction value in calculation of a position and a rotation angle of the three-dimensional object 10, and generates the printing data in accordance with the position and the rotation angle of the three-dimensional object 10 reflecting the correction value.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Repellent
abstract_en: To provide a repellent capable of imparting oil resistance to a base material (for example, fiber or paper).SOLUTION: The present disclosure provides a water dispersible repellent containing a modified form of polyol and a dispersant, wherein the modified form of polyol is a polymer having a polymerization degree of at least 5.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Image recording device and control method
abstract_en: To suppress a difference in ink discharge amounts between recording elements, while reducing a temperature difference between recording element rows to perform recording operation.SOLUTION: An image recording device includes a plurality of recording element selection patterns with different heating levels. In at least one recording element selection pattern, the central recording element group has a lower heating level than the end recording element group. In at least one recording element selection pattern, the central recording element group has a higher heating level than the end recording element group. These recording element selection patterns are combined to perform temperature control.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 9

title_en: Exchange jig and image formation device
abstract_en: To improve workability in exchange of a flexible flat cable.SOLUTION: An image formation device includes: a photoreceptor; an exposure head which has a connector, forms a shape elongated in an axial direction of the photoreceptor, and exposes the photoreceptor; a control board; a flexible flat cable configured to electrically connect the connector with the control board; and a guide member which is provided extending in a lateral direction of the image formation device and holds the flexible flat cable along the lateral direction. An exchange tool is used to exchange the flexible flat cable in the image formation device. The exchange tool has a sheet member forming an elongated shape. The sheet member has, at one end side in a longitudinal direction, a cable holding part which holds the flexible flat cable. A length from the cable holding part to the other end in the longitudinal direction is, through the guide member, a length such that the other end is exposed from a first through hole disposed at one side in the lateral direction, and the cable holding part is exposed from a second through hole disposed at the other side in the lateral direction.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 48

title_en: Printing device, printing device control method and program
abstract_en: To properly perform transition of a power state.SOLUTION: A printing device, which is operated by electric power supplied from a wired interface terminal or electric power charged into a power storage part, comprises confirming means that confirms amounts of charge in the power storage part, and transiting means that transits a power state into a power state where a function is restricted, in accordance with whether the device is in a supply state where the electric power is supplied from the wired interface terminal or not and the amounts of charge.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 9

title_en: Post-processing device
abstract_en: To receive a retreat instruction of a stapler at an operation part without increasing the number of buttons of the operation part which receives an operation from a user.SOLUTION: A post-processing device comprises a processing tray on which a sheet bundle is placed, a stapler for performing staple processing, a movement mechanism for moving the stapler, an operation part and a control part. Modes of the staple processing includes a normal mode and a manual mode. The operation part has a manual input part for receiving an execution instruction of the staple processing in the manual mode. When a first operation is performed for the manual input part, the control part makes the stapler perform the staple processing. When a second operation is performed for the manual input part, the control part makes the stapler retreat to a retreat position.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 11

title_en: Sheet
abstract_en: To provide a novel sheet having a high mechanical strength, capable of retaining a shape for a fixed period of time even exposed to flame.SOLUTION: A sheet includes at least a fiber layer A and a fiber layer B, which are laminated. The fiber layer A includes cellulose fiber and the cellulose fiber includes silicon in the fiber. The fiber B incudes a heat-resistant fiber, in which the lowest of melting point, softening point, and decomposition temperature is 400°C or more.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Printer
abstract_en: To provide a printer allowing for easily performing connection and separation between a mask cleaner and a movement mechanism in an inexpensive configuration.SOLUTION: A printer 1 includes: a mask cleaner 17 moving relatively to a mask 14 and thereby performing mask cleaning for removing paste adhering on a lower surface of the mask 14; and a camera movement mechanism 41 moving the mask cleaner 17 relatively to the mask 14. The mask cleaner 17 is moved while coupling with the camera movement mechanism 41 by coupling force caused by magnetic force of an electromagnet 61 to perform the mask cleaning, and then, separated from the camera movement mechanism 41 as the coupling force caused by the magnetic force of the electromagnet 61 is released at a retreat position which is set in a cleaner retreat area R3 on an outer side of a cleaning-target area R1 being a mask cleaning target.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 10

title_en: Tricyclodecane dimethanol composition, ultraviolet-curable composition, and polymer composition, method for producing tricyclodecane dicarbaldehyde composition, and method for producing tricyclodecane dimethanol composition
abstract_en: To provide a tricyclodecane dimethanol composition to be used as a starting raw material of polyester-based polymers or the like, the composition having excellent polymerizability and enabling efficient production of polyester-based polymers or the like while suppressing reduction in molecular weight, and to provide a production method for the tricyclodecane dimethanol composition.SOLUTION: A tricyclodecane dimethanol composition contains tricyclodecane dimethanol and a tricyclodecane compound having one or two carboxyl groups within the molecule. A method for producing a tricyclodecane dimethanol composition containing the corresponding tricyclodecane dimethanol, the method comprising hydrogenation reduction of tricyclodecane dicarbaldehyde in a tricyclodecane dicarbaldehyde composition. The method includes regulating the proportion of the tricyclodecane compound having one or two carboxyl groups within the molecule, which is contained in the tricyclodecane dimethanol composition, to be equal to or less than a predetermined threshold.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Defect analysis method and defect analysis system of printing surface
abstract_en: To provide a defect analysis method and a defect analysis system of a printing surface in which more secure, accurate and efficient analysis for causes of a defect can be performed.SOLUTION: A defect analysis method comprises: identifying a defect and a position thereof from image information of a printing surface 10 that is obtained by first imaging means 11; estimating causes of a defect on the basis of a shape and color density of the defect; identifying an inspection area 101 that is composed of dot images which is appropriate to analyze the estimated causes in detail; and analyzing causes of the defect in detail on the basis of the dot image in which the inspection area 101 is imaged by second imaging means 12 to acquire.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Recording device
abstract_en: To improve the convenience of a recording device that uses ultraviolet curable ink.SOLUTION: A recording device is provided with: a recording part that has an emitting part that emits ultraviolet ray to a medium and records an image by discharging ultraviolet curable droplets to the medium: a light source that can emit illumination light to the recording part; a shielding member that can transmit visible light and suppress transmission of ultraviolet ray; and a switching part that moves the shielding member and switches the member between a first position where the shielding member is positioned between the recording part and the light source and a second position where the member is not positioned between the recording part and the light source.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Liquid jet head and liquid jet device
abstract_en: To provide a liquid jet head which is prevented from deteriorating in reliability, and a liquid jet device.SOLUTION: The liquid jet head comprises: a head module including a flow passage opening forming member and a chip; a supply flow passage member that supplies liquid to the head module; an elastic seal member that liquid-tightly connects the flow passage opening forming member to the supply flow passage member; and a fixing member fixing the supply flow passage member to the flow passage opening forming member. A seal region held by the flow passage opening forming member and the supply flow passage member of the seal member overlaps with the chip when viewed in a jetting direction. A dimension in the jetting direction of a portion overlapping with the seal region, of the flow passage opening forming member, is larger than a distance between the seal region and the fixing member when viewed in the jetting direction.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Destaticizing device and image forming system including destaticizing device
abstract_en: To enable a user to measure the charge amount of the sheet with no need of preparation of a grounding environment for grounding the conductive plate and the potential measuring device.SOLUTION: There is provided a destaticizing device that eliminates static electricity from a sheet on which an image is formed by an image forming apparatus. The destaticizing device comprises: a destaticizing unit that eliminates static electricity from a sheet on which an image is formed by an image forming apparatus; a receiving unit that receives a setting of a static elimination level of the destaticizing unit; and a grounded terminal that is provided on a top surface or a front surface of the destaticizing device.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 8

title_en: Printing apparatus
abstract_en: To provide a printing apparatus that allows for easy and reliable opening and closing of an opening/closing section including a fixed blade even when a recording sheet is caught.SOLUTION: A printing apparatus includes: a printing section that performs printing on a recording sheet; a fixed blade 51 and a movable blade 52 that cut the recording sheet printed by the printing section; a body section that supports the movable blade 52; an opening/closing section that supports the fixed blade 51 and is openably and closably connected to the body section; an opening/closing lever 8; and a separation mechanism S. The opening/closing lever 8 is provided at an end of the opening/closing section on an opposite side of an end connected to the body section and rotates between a release position where the opening/closing section can be opened and closed and a lock position where the opening/closing section is fixed to the body section. The separation mechanism S separates the fixed blade 51 from the movable blade 52 in a separation direction intersecting an operation direction of the movable blade 52 in coordination with a release operation of rotating the opening/closing lever 8 from the lock position to the release position.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7

title_en: Process paper
abstract_en: To provide process paper that can prevent evaporation of volatile ingredients during storage or transportation.SOLUTION: Process paper has barrier-coated paper and a release agent layer on at least one surface of the barrier-coated paper, wherein the barrier-coated paper comprises a paper substrate and a gas barrier coating layer on at least one surface, and the paper substrate has a thickness of 50 μm or more and 200 μm or less, a density of 0.5 g/cm3 or more and 1.1 g/cm3 or less, and a dry shrinkage ratio in the CD direction of 0.6% or less.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Recording device
abstract_en: To make it possible to perform rewinding work of a medium 2 such as correcting initial winding deviation in a roll body state of the medium 2 and changing a winding shaft 16 of the roll body by using a top surface part 14 forming a part of an exterior 15.SOLUTION: A recording device includes: a payout unit 8 that pays out a medium 2 from a roll; a medium transport device 3 that transports the medium paid out from the payout unit in a transport direction F; a recording unit 51 that records on the medium transported by the medium transport device; and an exterior 15 that houses the recording unit and the medium transport device and has a flat top surface 14. The top surface is equipped with a positioning unit 17 on which a wind-up shaft 16 for winding up the medium can be placed such that the placement position of the wind-up shaft 16 is decided by placing the wid-up shaft 16 in contact therewith. An orthogonal mark 18 is provided that indicates a direction L2 orthogonal to an axial direction L1 of the wind-up shaft positioned by the positioning unit 17.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Pulp sheet for fluff pulp, fluff mat, absorbent article, and manufacturing method of pulp sheet for fluff pulp
abstract_en: To provide a pulp sheet for fluff pulp with suppressed discoloration and excellent fibrillation properties.SOLUTION: In a pulp sheet for fluff pulp containing a conifer pulp, a pulp sheet for fluff pulp is characterized in that a content of a hardwood pulp in a total pulp component in the pulp sheet for fluff pulp is 30 mass% or under, ISO whiteness variation calculated by the following formula is 1.5% or under. ISO whiteness variation (%)=(B0(%)-B1(%))/B0(%)×100; in the formula above, B1 is ISO whiteness of the pulp sheet for fluff pulp after heating at 105°C for 2 hrs measured according to JIS P 8154-1:2008, and B0 is ISO whiteness of the pulp sheet for fluff pulp before heating.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Printing system, control method of printing system, and program
abstract_en: To provide a mechanism capable of confirming in which device a jam occurred without looking at an operation unit of an image forming apparatus when the jam of a sheet occurs.SOLUTION: A printing system includes an image forming apparatus and a sheet conveying apparatus configured to convey a sheet conveyed from the image forming apparatus, where the sheet conveying apparatus includes a notification unit for notifying a jam of the sheet in the sheet conveying device.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Detection apparatus and detection method
abstract_en: To detect a remaining amount of ink stored in a storage container.SOLUTION: A detection apparatus includes: a first Peltier element disposed on a wall surface of a storage container that stores ink; and a detection unit that detects a remaining amount of ink stored in the storage container based on an output from the first Peltier element.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Aqueous ink, ink cartridge, inkjet recording method, aqueous pigment dispersion, method for producing aqueous pigment dispersion, and method for producing aqueous ink
abstract_en: To provide aqueous ink for inkjet containing C.I.pigment orange 43 which enables recording of an image having good discharge stability and good color development property.SOLUTION: Aqueous ink for inkjet contains a pigment, a resin dispersant, and an aqueous medium. The pigment contains C.I. pigment orange 43. The aqueous ink has an absorbance ratio represented by the following expression (1) of 0.95 or more and 1.15 or less. Absorbance of 50 mass% of an upper layer when the aqueous ink is subjected to centrifugal separation at 217,000 G for 30 minutes in 1.5 mass% of a pigment content is less than 0.20 at a wavelength 350 nm or more and 550 nm or less. Expression (1): absorbance ratio=absorbance of a peak in the vicinity of a wavelength 532 nm/absorbance of a peak in the vicinity of a wavelength of 496 nm.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Density adjustment method in inkjet printing apparatus
abstract_en: To adjust the density of a printing image so as to maintain good printing quality regardless of the kind of a base material to be used in an ink jet printer using a treatment liquid such as a primer or the like.SOLUTION: A color-ink-density correction-value table indicating a correspondence relation between color-ink-density signal values and densities that should appear by discharging color inks onto a base material is created (S100). A plurality of primer-concentration correction-value tables, which express the corresponding relations between primer-concentration signal values and concentrations which should appear by discharging colored inks onto primers, are formed (S110). A colored ink concentration correcting value is obtained based on the concentration of a first color image formed only by colored ink by referring to a colored ink concentration correcting value table (S140). By referring to a primer-density correction-value table corresponding to the densities of the colored inks, primer-density correction-values are obtained on the basis of the densities of the second color images formed by the primers and the colored inks (S180).SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 12

title_en: Image forming apparatus, method for controlling image forming apparatus, and storage medium
abstract_en: To provide an image forming apparatus capable of reducing automatic output unnecessary for a user, a control method of the image forming apparatus, and a program.SOLUTION: The image forming device 101 automatically outputs a sheet if the setting of automatic outputting is ON and does not automatically output a sheet if the setting of automatic outputting is OFF in a case where a condition for automatic outputting is satisfied, and has a CPU107 for updating the setting of automatic outputting to OFF in a case where the image forming device 101 enters a printing upper limit management mode in which a predetermined number of sheets can be outputted for a predetermined amount of money.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Printer, control method, and storage medium
abstract_en: To provide a printer, a control method, and a program capable of suppressing variation in a movement amount after stop.SOLUTION: In a printer, a thermal head performs printing on a medium. The conveyance motor is a DC motor. The platen roller is driven by rotation of the conveyance motor, and conveys the medium while sandwiching the medium between the platen roller and the thermal head. The electronic governor circuit supplies a current to the conveyance motor while the ON signal is input, and stops the supply of power to the conveyance motor while the OFF signal is input. The CPU outputs an ON signal or an OFF signal to the electronic governor circuit. A CPU outputs an ON signal to an electronic governing circuit to rotate a carrying motor at a first speed V1 when carrying media. When stopping the conveyance of the media, the CPU executes deceleration processing for alternately switching output of an ON signal and output of an OFF signal so that the conveyance motor rotates at the second speed V2. After continuing the deceleration processing for a predetermined period, the CPU outputs an OFF signal to the electronic governor circuit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 8

title_en: Liquid leakage detecting device and ink jet recording apparatus
abstract_en: To improve space efficiency inside an ink jet recorder.SOLUTION: A liquid leakage detection device provided inside an ink jet recording apparatus includes an ink detection unit in which an exposed conductor portion of a first core included in a multi-core flat cable and an exposed conductor portion of a second core included in the multi-core flat cable are configured as a pair of electrode terminals, and a detection circuit that detects that a liquid has leaked by detecting that a potential difference between the pair of electrode terminals has fallen below a predefined threshold value.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Ink composition for ink jet printing
abstract_en: To maintain inkjet discharge stability and preferably improve long-term stability while securing low-temperature fluidity even without using a hydrocarbon-based solvent in a nonaqueous or oily inkjet ink.SOLUTION: Provided is a solvent-based inkjet printing ink composition containing a colorant, a dispersant, and a solvent, wherein the colorant is a colorant containing a pigment and / or a dye, the solvent contains a saturated fatty acid diester-based solvent and an unsaturated fatty acid monoester-based solvent, the total amount of the saturated fatty acid diester-based solvent and the unsaturated fatty acid monoester-based solvent is 50% by mass or more relative to the total amount of the solvent-based inkjet printing ink composition, and the weight ratio of the saturated fatty acid diester-based solvent and the unsaturated fatty acid monoester-based solvent is 2:8 to 8:2.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Hat frame
abstract_en: To provide a hat frame enabling embroidery even to the vicinity of the brim of a crown.SOLUTION: In a hat frame 1 for supporting a hat by receiving the side of the embroidered part of a crown C from the lower side by a lower frame 2 and pressing the side of the embroidered part of the crown C from the upper side by an upper frame 8, the lower frame 2 is provided with a slip pressing device 21 for pressing a slip E pulled out from hats A and B from the upper side. The lower frame 2 does not have a part for receiving the vicinity of the flange D of the crown C and the upper frame 8 does not have a part for pressing the vicinity of the flange D of the crown C.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Communication apparatus and computer program for communication apparatus
abstract_en: To provide a technology for enabling a communication device to quickly and appropriately receive a processing execution notification from a notification server.SOLUTION: When the processing execution instruction is transmitted from the terminal device to the notification server, the communication device receives the processing execution notification from the notification server and executes the predetermined processing. The communication device operates in parallel in each of a first mode and a second mode, transmits a polling signal to a notification server and receives a processing execution notification from the notification server in the first mode, and establishes a server push type connection and receives the processing execution notification from the notification server in the second mode.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: Basalt fiber reinforced flame retardant complex member for repairing and reinforcing concrete structure and method of repairing and reinforcing concrete structure using the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a basalt fiber composite flame-retardant reinforcing material for repairing and reinforcing a concrete structure, and a method for repairing and reinforcing a concrete structure using the same. According to the present invention, the basalt fiber composite flame-retardant reinforcing material for repairing and reinforcing a concrete structure comprises: 60 to 90 wt% of a basalt fiber; 3 to 8 wt% of one or more high-strength fibers selected from the group consisting of a carbon fiber, an aramid fiber, and a mixture fiber thereof; and 5 to 35 wt% of a flame-retardant epoxy resin composition. According to the present invention, excellent adhesive strength can be maintained.

title_en: Indexer device for button sewing
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an indexer device for sewing buttons to stably supply fabric for sewing buttons and also smoothly load button-sewn fabric. According to the present invention, the indexer device comprises: a fabric supply member supplying an input fabric to the front side where a sewing machine is located; a head assembly transferring the fabric supplied by the fabric supply member in a lateral direction perpendicular to a supply direction, wherein the fabric is transferred by a certain distance according to a button sewing cycle by the sewing machine; a piling member receiving the fabric, on which a button is sewn by the sewing machine, from the head assembly to move and load the same to a designated position for loading; a tilting member installed to be tilted backward while supporting the head assembly to transfer the fabric, on which button sewing is completed, from the head assembly to the piling member by a rear tilting operation; and a loading member installed on the rear side of the piling member to load the fabric moved by the piling member.

title_en: Paper bag manufacturing device and paper bag
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a paper bag manufacturing apparatus. More particularly, the present invention relates to a reinforced handle groove integrated paper bag manufacturing apparatus and a paper bag manufactured using the same. According to the present invention, in manufacturing a paper bag, the manufacturing apparatus is configured to continuously perform the supply of the fabric, the supply and adhesion of the padding, the folding of the fabric, the attachment of the fabric, the cutting of a handle groove, the cutting of the fabric, and the bonding process of the paper bag, so that it is possible to manufacture a paper bag in which a handle groove is integrated without a handle forming operation through a separate device. In addition, the reinforced paper bag having an integrated handle groove with a tear prevention function during gripping by configuring the handle groove to be able to reinforce the fabric through additional paper attachment.

title_en: Printer Having Infinite Ink Supply Device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a printer having an endless ink supply apparatus, comprising: a printer main body (10); an ink housing (30) connected to the side surface of the printer main body (10) and including the outer bottom surface (31a) and the inner bottom surface (31b); and an endless ink supply unit (20) inserted into the ink housing (30). The endless ink supply unit (20) includes first to fifth ink cases (21, 22, 23, 24, 25) in which inks of various colors are stored. The first to fifth ink cases (21, 22, 23, 24, 25) are inserted into a main body (31) of the ink housing (30) and are supported by first to fifth rows of protrusions (35a, 35b, 35c, 35d, 35e) protruding from the inner bottom surface (31b). The housing inner bottom surface (31b) is inclined with respect to a ground, but the housing outer bottom surface (31a) is formed horizontally to the ground. The first to fifth rows of the protrusions (35a, 35b, 35c, 35d, 35e) have different heights from the inner bottom surface (31b) to the top, but heights from the outer bottom surface (31a) to the top are all the same, so that the first to fifth ink cases (21, 22, 23, 24, 25) are placed horizontally from the ground.

title_en: Apparatus for printing solder paste
abstract_en: The present invention is to provide a solder paste printing apparatus which can effectively print a solder paste on a device. To this end, the solder paste printing apparatus of the present invention includes: a mask which has a through hole; a squeegee which is disposed on a lower side of the mask, and includes a receiving unit of which the inside is filled with a solder paste, wherein the receiving unit has an open upper part facing a lower surface of the mask; and a driving unit which moves the squeegee. The solder paste filling the receiving unit fills the through hole by inertial force acting in a direction opposite to the moving direction of the squeegee moving along the lower surface of the mask, and the solder paste adheres to a device which stands by in an upper part of the through hole.

title_en: Method for coating a eco-friendly coating material on a board
abstract_en: The present invention is to manufacture a Korean paper surface material processed product which has economic effectiveness through process automation in order to maximize traditionality, design, and eco-friendliness, which are the unique advantages of Korean paper. The present invention is to manufacture a decorative plate processed product with a single automated hot-pressing process by inserting a colored base paper for melamine resin impregnation between the wooden board and Korean paper.

title_en: Cleanig method of nozzle for hollow fiber spinning and manufactuaring method hollow fiber using the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for cleaning a nozzle for spinning a hollow fiber membrane and a method for manufacturing a hollow fiber membrane using the same, and more specifically, to a method for cleaning a nozzle for spinning a hollow fiber membrane and a method for manufacturing a hollow fiber membrane using the same, wherein uniform pressure is applied to a spinning nozzle used in a spinning step of a composition mixed with a resin, a plasticizer and the like in a manufacturing process of a hollow fiber membrane used to manufacture a nano-filtration membrane for virus removal and the like, so that the uniformity of a discharged molten mixture can be continuously maintained.

title_en: Method of reinforcing fiber for indoor play facilities and reinforcing fiber mesh
abstract_en: The present invention provides a method for producing rigidity-improved reinforced fiber woven fabric for play facilities and a reinforced fiber mesh net comprising the same. The method comprises the steps of: weaving at least one of nylon and polyester fiber yarn to produce a braid with a diameter of 5-20 mm; immersing the reinforced fiber braid in a softener for 100-150 minutes (min) in a temperature range of 25-40℃; washing the reinforced fiber braid by immersing the same in purified water or water; and producing a mesh-shaped reinforced fiber woven fabric using the reinforced fiber braid in a state where moisture from the distilled water or water remains. According to the present invention, the reinforced fiber mesh net produced thereby can greatly improve durability of play facilities.

title_en: Biodegradable eco-friendly plastic straw and its manufacturing method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a biodegradable eco-friendly plastic straw and a manufacturing method thereof and, more specifically, to a method for manufacturing an eco-friendly plastic straw with a biodegradable structure. The method comprises: a mixture forming step of supplying raw material to a stirrer and stirring the same to form a mixture; a coating solution forming step of supplying the mixture to a heater to form a coating solution in which the mixture is melted; a coating solution filling step of delivering the coating solution to a supply tank and filling the supply tank therewith; a straw body forming step of receiving a pulp sheet from a sheet roll at an angle, and spraying the coating solution while winding the same around a rotating shaft, to form a straw body with an outer surface coated with the coating solution; and an outer coating layer forming step of heating the straw body to dry the applied coating solution to form an outer coating layer. Therefore, the biodegradable eco-friendly plastic straw and the manufacturing method can manufacture a straw using polylactic acid (PLA) extracted from corn, and pulp, thereby being harmless to the human body and preventing environmental pollution by biodegradation, and can form coating layers on the inner and outer surfaces of the straw, thereby improving strength and durability and reducing deformation due to heat and moisture.

title_en: Manufacturing method of multi-functional non-woven fabric and multi-functional non-woven fabric prepared therefrom
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for manufacturing a multifunctional composite nonwoven fabric, wherein the fabric is manufactured by laminating and intertwining a first sheet layer made of any one of a long fiber web, a short fiber nonwoven fabric, and a long fiber nonwoven fabric, and a second sheet layer made of any one of a short fiber web, a film, and an ultrafine fiber web, and a multifunctional composite nonwoven fabric manufactured therefrom.

title_en: Biodegradable banner manufacturing method
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a method for manufacturing a biodegradable banner having improved biodegradability by mixing a biodegradable polymer and an oxidative biodegradable polymer. The method for manufacturing a biodegradable banner includes: a raw material preparation step (S10); a warp manufacturing step (S20); a weft manufacturing step (S30); a fabric weaving step (S40); a coating layer forming step (S50); a fabric cutting step (S60); and a printing step (S70). According to the present invention, due to a banner using a combination of a biodegradable polymer and an oxidative biodegradable polymer, biodegradability can be improved, thereby reducing the cost of processing waste banners and preventing the generation of environmental pollutants.

title_en: Assistive devices for shoe repair
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an auxiliary device for repairing shoes, which comprises: a main body installed on the ground; a bottom surface polishing unit mounted on a front surface of a housing formed on an upper portion of the main body, and grinding and flattening a bottom surface of a shoe sole by a polishing stone rotating at a high speed; a dust collection unit formed in the housing of the main body, formed in a lower portion of the bottom surface polishing unit, and sucking dust generated when the bottom surface is polished; an edge processing unit formed to protrude from a side surface of the housing of the main body, and cutting or polishing an edge of the shoe sole; an edge waxing unit formed on one side of a lower portion of the front surface of the main body, and performing a waxing and finishing process on the edge of the shoe sole; and a sole adhesive unit including a shoe holder formed on the front surface of the main body, and holding the shoes so that the bottom surface faces upward, an application unit applying an adhesive to the bottom surface of the shoes held on the shoe holder, a sole seating unit seating the shoe sole on the bottom surface of the shoes to which the adhesive is applied, and a pressing adhesive unit pressing and bonding an upper surface of the shoe sole.

title_en: Composite functional fabric and sportswear manufactured using the same
abstract_en: The present invention provides a multifunctional fabric comprising: a base layer; an inner layer formed on a lower surface of the base layer; and an outer layer formed on an upper surface of the base layer, wherein an air resistance reduction pattern is formed on a surface of the outer layer.

title_en: Protective band of tree for pest control of net structure using cutresistant fiber
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a tree protector in a net structure for controlling pests using fiber yarn with enhanced cutting resistance. Specifically, the present invention is manufactured in a plain weave or raschel type using a net made by HPPE or UHMWPE fiber yarn alone, a net made by combining the HPPE and UHMWPE fiber yarn with synthetic resin yarn, and a net made by coating tarpaulin on the net. The tree protector for controlling pests according to the present invention has been confirmed to be excellent in the control effect of Bursaphelenchus xylophilus by preventing the escape of Cerambycidae because Cerambycidae could not cut the tree protector.

title_en: Hydantoin based multi-functionalized thermoplastic polyurethane, method of preparing the same, and composition, non-woven fiber, membrane and film comprising the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to hydantoin-based multifunctionalized thermoplastic polyurethane, a method for manufacturing the same, and a composition, fiber, membrane and film comprising the same. More particularly, the present invention relates to hydantoin-based multifunctionalized thermoplastic polyurethane, which is multifunctionalized by an azido-alkyne click reaction on azido-thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU), a manufacturing method thereof, and a fiber, membrane and film comprising the same.

title_en: Glitter film and manufacturing method therewith
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a glitter film and manufacturing method thereof capable of significantly improving the adhesion of glitter powder by forming an adhesive binder on one side of a hot melt layer and performing a heat-setting process at the same time. Improving ink absorption and adhesion while harmless to a human body compared to the conventional application of an oil-based binder by applying a water-based binder to increase the adhesion of glitter powder, and dramatically improving the smoothness, flexibility and elasticity of glitter particles.

title_en: An electroconductive fabric of multi-layer structure and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention provides a conductive fiber of a multi-layer structure comprising: a first level; a second level laminated on the first level and made of a carbon nanotube; and a third level laminated on the second level to protect the carbon nanotube, wherein the first to third levels are configured of a sensor of a wearable device having a curved surface or a deformation. Therefore, the present invention is capable of improving a wearing comfort.

title_en: Moisturizing tissue coating system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a moisturizing tissue application system for applying a moisturizer on a sheet, comprising: a sheet supply part (110) for supplying a sheet; a transitional application module (130) connected to a first moisturizer storage part (120) and applying a first moisturizer to at least one surface of the sheet supplied from the sheet supply part (110) in a transitional manner; a spray application module (150) connected to a second moisturizer storage part (140) and connected to a rear end of the transitional application module (130) to apply a second moisturizer to at least one surface of the sheet on which the first moisturizer is applied from the transitional application module (130) in a spraying manner; and a control module (160) controlling the transfer speed of the sheet supplied from the sheet supply part (110) and moving to the transitional application module (130) and the spray application module (150). The control module (160) is configured to adjust the transport speed of the sheet according to the viscosity of the first and second moisturizers. The present invention is capable of maximizing moisturizing power and surface feel in the process of applying a moisturizer to the tissue and at the same time suppressing their volatilization.

title_en: Method for Forming Fine Pattern Using Inkjet
abstract_en: A fine pattern forming method using inkjet comprises the following steps of: forming a first fine ink pattern by inkjet-printing photosensitive ink according to a pattern determined on a base material; arranging a mask having a fine penetration pattern having a width smaller than that of the first fine ink pattern on the base material; curing the first fine ink pattern to correspond to the fine penetration pattern by irradiating light; removing the mask; and forming a high-resolution second fine ink pattern having a width smaller than that of the first fine ink pattern by removing uncured photosensitive ink from the first fine ink pattern.

title_en: Manufacturing method of monofilament yarn using recycled Thermoplastic Polyester elastomet
abstract_en: The present invention is to manufacture thermoplastic polyester elastomer (TPEE) monofilament yarn using recycled TPEE obtained from defective products produced at the beginning and end of production in a manufacturing (production) process of TPEE and discarded due to non-compliance with the desired specifications because of unstable physical properties and defective products produced when troubles occur at process conditions or the like in a production process and discarded due to non-compliance with the desired specifications because of unstable physical properties. A method for manufacturing monofilament yarn using recycled TPEE comprises the processes of: combining TPEE process defective products and PBT process defective products in a certain ratio to mold the defective products into recycled TPEE chips; and melting, extracting, and spinning the recycled chips to manufacture the monofilament yarn. The method for manufacturing the monofilament yarn using the recycled TPEE according to the present invention has the effect of manufacturing monofilament yarn suitable for shoes, shoemaking, or chairs with a spinning apparatus while adjusting the hardness of the recycled TPEE raw material to the hardness of yarn for fabric production and, in particular, has an advantage of increasing the supply of recycled raw materials according to eco-friendly requirements since high-quality recycled TPEE monofilament yarn can be supplied from the discarded defective products.

title_en: Spunbnond non-woven having enhanced permeable waterproof and mechanical properties in machine direction and cross direction, manufacturing method and articles comprising the same
abstract_en: This application relates to a spunbond non-woven fabric and a manufacturing method thereof. Specifically, the present application relates to non-woven fabrics manufactured using split filament, spunbond and spunlace methods, and a method for manufacturing the same. According to the present application, the spunbond non-woven fabric with excellent bi-directional mechanical properties and shape stability and improved airtightness is provided.

title_en: Polyaramid fiber and preparing method for the same
abstract_en: Provided are polyaramid fiber and a preparing method thereof. The method for preparing polyaramid fiber includes a step of preparing a polyaramid solution in which polyaramid represented by the following formula (1) is dissolved in a solvent containing water. The polyaramid solution is spun into a coagulating liquid through a spinning nozzle to form polyaramid gel fiber. The polyaramid gel fiber is dried to form polyaramid fiber. In formula 1, Ara_1, Ara_2, Arb_1, and Arb_2 are C5 to C6 arylene groups regardless of each other, La and Lb are bonds or ether groups regardless of each other, at least one among Ra_1, Ra_2, Ra_2, and Ra_4 is an anionic functional group, the rest are hydrogen, a is an integer of 0 or 1, and n is a value depending on the average molecular weight and may be 1,000 to 1,000,000. The strength of the polyaramid fiber can be greatly increased.

title_en: Manufacturing method of Composite material for anode active material of lithium secondary battery using electrospinning
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for manufacturing a composite material for an anode active material of a secondary battery, comprising: a first step of preparing silica spun fiber by electrospinning a mixed solution of a silicon precursor and a polymer material; a second step of preparing a silica-carbon (SiO_x-C) fiber composite by heat-treating the silica spun fiber of the first step; a third step of preparing a silicon-carbon (Si-C) fiber composite by metal thermal reduction of the silica-carbon (SiO_x-C) fiber composite of the second step; and a fourth step of coating the silicon-carbon (Si-C) fiber composite of the third step with one or more of a carbon-based coating material and silicon powder. The present invention can provide a composite material for an anode active material of a secondary battery having high-capacity/high-efficiency while exhibiting high charge/discharge capacity and cycle stability.

title_en: Inkjet print system and inkjet printing method using the same
abstract_en: An inkjet printing system and an inkjet printing method using the same are disclosed to form a droplet forming layer with surface uniformity on a printing medium. An inkjet printing system according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a stage which moves in a first direction and is capable of supporting a printing medium; an inkjet head in which a plurality of nozzle arrays capable of ejecting ink, including a first nozzle and a second nozzle adjacent to the first nozzle, are formed at certain intervals in a second direction perpendicular to the first direction; and a processor capable of controlling the discharge frequency of the first nozzle independently of that of the second nozzle.

title_en: Nanofibers for bone regeneration using phycocyanin and fish collagen and preparation method of the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to nanofibers for bone tissue regeneration using phycocyanin and flounder collagen and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the nanofibers containing phycocyanin, flounder-derived collagen, calcium alginate, and biodegradable polymers of the present invention have excellent activity in increasing alkaline phosphatase (ALP) activity and promoting bone mineralization, thereby being usefully used as a support for promoting bone tissue regeneration or bone formation.

title_en: Head pack having a plurality of ink heads for an inkjet printer
abstract_en: Disclosed is a head pack in which a plurality of ink heads (H) are assembled. The head pack comprises: a pack base on which a plurality of ink heads (H) having a length in a first direction and a width in a second direction and extending in the first direction are aligned at regular intervals in the second direction; a plurality of head fixing parts disposed at regular intervals in the second direction on an end portion of the pack base to correspond to the plurality of ink heads (H) to individually fix the ink head (H) to the pack base; and a plurality of head alignment units disposed at regular intervals in the second direction on both end portions of the pack base to be individually in contact with both end portions of each of the plurality of ink heads (H), and performing linear alignment and angular alignment on the ink head (H). The head alignment can be easily performed by the pressure of the shape variable body formed by the rotation of the bolt by constituting the shape variable body disposed to surround the bolt having the taper shape and eccentrically with the bolt shaft.

title_en: method for printing 3 dimensional pattern
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a method for printing a three-dimensional pattern. The method comprises the steps of: forming a plurality of line patterns on a substrate using a first fine tip; forming a printed pattern on the line patterns using a second fine tip wider than the first fine tip; curing the printed pattern and the line patterns by providing ultraviolet light to the printed pattern and the line patterns using a mask having a hole similar to the second fine tip; and determining whether to stop forming the printed pattern, wherein the first fine tip, the second fine tip, and the mask may be connected to an edge of a flat plate disk. According to the present invention, it is possible to form a printed pattern with a high aspect ratio using a plurality of line patterns formed through a grafting process.

title_en: Profile feedback patterning system for reducing stitch mura of multi head inkjet printing
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a speckle reducing profile feedback patterning system of multihead inkjet printing. According to the present invention, a controlling unit generates modified target image information by reflecting thickness profile information of a first output image measured by a thickness measurement unit in an original target image. A printing unit prints a target image by ejecting an ink whose density is adjusted according to the modified target image information. Because the modified target image reflects density compensation for a stitch speckle due to an overlapping inkjet head and a swath speckle due to an overlapping multihead, the stitch speckle and the swath speckle are reduced in the output image according to the modified target image information. Therefore, speckles can be reduced without an additional leveling time. Because of the same, an increase in a tact time due to the leveling time is avoided, and a high-angle edge slope can be maintained. The speckle reducing profile feedback patterning system of the multihead inkjet printing of the present invention comprises: a transferring unit; a printing unit; a thickness measuring unit; a curing unit; and a controlling unit.

title_en: HYBRID NANOFIBERS FOR Li-S BATTERIES, Li-S BATTERIES COMPRISING THE SAME AND MANUFACTURING METHOD THEREFOR
abstract_en: A composite nanofiber for a Li-S battery according to various embodiments of the present invention may comprise: a metal nanoparticle; a carbon layer surrounding the metal nanoparticle; and a carbon nanotube grown from the metal nanoparticle. A Li-S battery according to various embodiments of the present invention may include a separator having the coated composite nanofiber. A manufacturing method of a composite nanofiber according to the present invention comprises the steps of: preparing a mixture of a metal precursor and a carbonizable organic material; electrospinning the mixture to form a first precursor; and performing heat treatment of the first precursor.

title_en: Donor substrate, and method for manufacturing display device
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a display device manufacturing method comprises the following steps of: providing a donor substrate including a first base substrate and an organic material layer disposed on the first base substrate; etching the organic material layer by using a laser device; providing a display substrate including a second base substrate and a plurality of first electrodes disposed on the second base substrate; aligning the donor substrate and the display substrate so that the etched organic material layer faces the plurality of first electrodes; and transferring the etched organic material layer onto the display substrate by using an energy generating device.

title_en: Tattoo printing method, ink fixative composition for tattoo printing, ink composition for tattoo printing, fixer composition for tattoo printing and tattoo printing kit comprising the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an ink composition for tattoo printing, wherein the ink composition may include a humectant which is at least one of glycerin and PEG-8; a surfactant which is at least one of polyglyceryl-4 caprate and PEG-7 glyceryl cocoate; or a defoaming agent which is at least one of glycereth-26 and plant-derived oil.

title_en: Surface opening device for recycling non-woven waste, which increases the recycling rate by controlling speed of plurality of rollers
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide an opening device for recycling nonwoven waste by controlling the speed of a plurality of rollers to increase the recycling rate. An opening device for recycling compressed waste nonwoven fabric includes: a conveying belt means for transporting waste nonwoven fabric to supply it; a first beating means, a second beating means, a third beating means, and a fourth beating means comprising upper and lower rollers and an upper roller; and a defusing means for striking and punching the waste nonwoven fabric deflated primarily through the defusing means to deflate it a second time.

title_en: Button cover for push button switch and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a button cover for a push button switch, which has excellent electrical insulation, heat resistance, cold resistance, repeated bending performance, repulsive elasticity, and light transmittance, which are physical properties of silicon, and can display two printing imprints on one key top, and to a manufacturing method thereof. The button cover for a push button switch having a plurality of key tops (10) made of a light-transmissive silicone rubber base material, comprises: the key top (10); and a keypad (20) insert-molded integrally with the key top (10). At least one of the key tops (10) includes a separation key top (15) including a first key top (11) divided into both sides and formed of a light-transmissive silicone rubber base material to transmit light, a separation wall (12) coated with black silicon ink on one sidewall of the first key top (11), and a second key top (13) molded by inserting the light-transmissive silicone rubber base material from a mold together with the first key top (11) coated with black silicon ink.

title_en: Polypropylene resin composition and polypropylene fiber prepared using the same
abstract_en: The present invention provides a polypropylene resin composition suitable for an ultralow basis weight and high-rigidity nonwoven fabric, and a polypropylene fiber manufactured therefrom. The polypropylene resin composition is prepared by using a polypropylene resin produced in the presence of a metallocene compound having a specific structure and a molecular weight modifier within a predetermined range, thereby optimizing a melt index, a melting point, and a crystallization temperature while maintaining a narrow molecular weight distribution.

title_en: Eco-friendly pulp mold using bamboo, bagasse and Sargassum horneri and its manufacturing method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an eco-friendly pulp mold using bamboo, bagasse, and Sargassum horneri and a manufacturing method thereof. The eco-friendly pulp mold using bamboo, bagasse, and Sargassum horneri according to the present invention can reduce the amount of wood used due to logging restrictions to preserve green areas and reduce carbon dioxide emissions, reduce the amount of plastic waste discharged by reducing the amount of plastic products used, and replace pulp with high import dependence with domestic bamboo raw materials, thereby having price competitiveness and eco-friendly effects.

title_en: Method of production nanocellulose
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a manufacturing method of nanocellulose comprising: (a) a step of setting a purity of nanocellulose; (b) a step of washing with a neutral solution after separating unbleached cellulose from biomass according to the condition of the set purity; (c) a step of bleaching the unbleached cellulose; (d) a step of washing with the neutral solution after hydrolysis by treating the bleached cellulose with a sulfuric acid solution of 0.5-1% concentration and a hydrogen peroxide solution of 0.3-0.7% concentration, and (e) a step of obtaining single-fibrillated nanocellulose by refining the washed cellulose.
