abstract_en: The invention discloses a rail type die changing system which comprises a conveying die frame, a conveying rail and a plurality of automatic inserting and taking vehicles; the conveying die carrier is positioned at one side of the conveying track and used for storing the foaming die, and has the function of conveying the foaming die so as to facilitate automatic insertion and extraction of the vehicle; each automatic inserting and taking vehicle is in sliding fit with the conveying track and is used for taking, placing and conveying the foaming mold between the conveying mold frame and the hooks of the foaming line. The rail type die changing system provided by the invention has the advantages that the structure is novel, the implementation is easy, the rapid die changing of the foaming die on the foaming line can be realized, the die changing efficiency of the foaming die is greatly improved, the automation degree is high, and the labor is greatly reduced.

title_en: Thermoplastic film raw material cleaning device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of thermoplastic film manufacturing, in particular to a thermoplastic film raw material cleaning device which comprises a shell, wherein a water tank, a water outlet hole for water to flow out of the water tank and a first feed inlet are formed in the top surface of the shell, a rotating shaft is arranged in the shell, a water baffle plate, a filter plate and spiral stirring blades are sequentially arranged on the rotating shaft from top to bottom, the upper end surface of the water baffle plate is contacted with the top surface of the shell, the water baffle plate is fixedly connected with the rotating shaft, a second feed inlet and a water inlet are formed in the water baffle plate, the water inlet and the second feed inlet can be respectively overlapped with the water outlet hole and the first feed inlet when the water baffle plate rotates along with the rotating shaft, a impurity removing area is formed between the water baffle plate and the filter plate, and a water washing area is formed between the filter plate and the bottom of the shell. The thermoplastic film raw material cleaning device provided by the invention can simultaneously clean and remove impurities from raw materials, reduces production procedures and improves production efficiency.

title_en: Device for monitoring bait feeding settlement process
abstract_en: The invention relates to a device for monitoring the settlement process of fed baits, wherein a main floating pipe of a net cage is a closed frame connected end to end, the lower part of the net cage is hung with a netting, the upper part of the net cage is provided with a handrail pipe of the net cage, a connecting position of a testing device is arranged on the handrail pipe, a stainless steel hoop and a testing rod base are arranged at the connecting position of the testing device, the stainless steel hoop is annular and clamps an arc-shaped testing rod base, the testing rod base is tightly attached to the main floating pipe of the net cage, and the stainless steel hoop and the testing rod base stay at the rotated position after rotating around the main floating pipe of the net cage; the bracing piece is fixed on the test bar base, and cavity and be equipped with the exhaust spillway hole, the outside cover has video acquisition device. The invention is suitable for underwater detection, multi-point, multi-azimuth and multi-angle observation of the feed sedimentation process, monitoring of the ingestion behavior of fishes, and providing a basis for the feeding amount and the development of baits.

title_en: Nutrient for improving gamma-aminobutyric acid content in germinated bean raw material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nutritional agent for improving the content of gamma-aminobutyric acid in a germinated bean raw material, and a preparation method and application thereof; the raw materials comprise the following components in percentage by mass: 70.00-80.00% of vine tea extract, 10.00-20.00% of sodium glutamate, 63.00-8.00% of vitamin B and 1.00-5.00% of vitamin E. Calculated according to the content of gamma-aminobutyric acid in the whole germinated bean raw material, the content of the gamma-aminobutyric acid in the germinated bean raw material after being soaked in a nutrient solution reaches more than 311.5mg/100 g. The nutrient solution of the invention has no toxicity and low price.

title_en: Heat-recoverable article, method of manufacturing a heat-recoverable article, wire tie and wire harness
abstract_en: The present invention provides a heat-recoverable article that has good manufacturability and good shrinkability at relatively low temperatures, such as 130 ℃ or higher and 140 ℃ or lower, and that is capable of effectively suppressing the occurrence of tearing and breaking and has good adhesion to a covered object even when used in a wide temperature environment of about-60 ℃ to about 120 ℃. The heat-recoverable article of the present invention has a cylindrical shape and comprises a substrate layer. The base material layer contains a polyolefin resin. In the base material layer after heating at 180 ℃ for 2 minutes, the melting point peak temperature is 115 ℃ to 128 ℃, the heat of fusion of all resin components is 80J/g to 150J/g, the storage modulus at 120 ℃ is 4MPa or more, the gel fraction is 40 mass% to 80 mass%, and the storage modulus at 180 ℃ is 0.5MPa or more and less than 3.0 MPa. The polyolefin resin is preferably a mixture of a first polyolefin resin having a melting point of 125 ℃ or higher and 135 ℃ or lower and a second polyolefin resin having a melting point of less than 125 ℃.

title_en: Nursery stock is planted, is fertilized, ridging, suppression all-in-one
abstract_en: A seedling planting, fertilizing, ridging and pressing integrated machine belongs to the field of seedling planting equipment. The method is characterized in that: the lower part of the rack (4) is sequentially provided with a traveling driving mechanism (9), a distance mechanism (10), a ridging mechanism (11) and a compacting mechanism (7) according to a traveling direction, driving traveling wheels (901) of the traveling driving mechanism (9) are connected with the distance mechanism (10) through a transmission mechanism, the two sides of the distance mechanism (10) are correspondingly provided with the ridging mechanisms (11) which are symmetrically arranged, and one side of the distance mechanism (10) is rotatably connected with a liquid manure adding mechanism (3). The invention can continuously complete a whole set of planting procedures of planting, applying water (water fertilizer), covering soil, pressing and the like of fruit seedlings at one time, and can synchronously apply the water fertilizer in time after planting, thereby thoroughly avoiding the condition that the survival rate of the fruit seedlings is influenced because the water fertilizer cannot be applied in time when the fruit seedlings are planted in an orchard with low soil moisture content.

title_en: Pulp moulding equipment and mould used in pulp moulding equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a press (1) for preparing large moulded pulp objects, having raisable and lowerable male mould halves (5) which are perforated (10, 8) for suction dewatering after immersion in a pulp slurry (16). The moulding surface of the male mould half (5) is coated with an elastomer (6) in order to maintain a flat surface contact with the moulded pulp object during pressurization and during thermal expansion or contraction of the mould halves (3, 5). Advantageous embodiments include a vacuum distribution groove (14) in the male mould half (5) below the elastomer layer (6), a plurality of wire mesh layers (7) on top of the perforated elastomer layer (6), and a slight lateral adjustability of the fixed female mould half (3).

title_en: Method for producing liquid-repellent molded body and liquid-repellent composition
abstract_en: Provided is a method for producing a liquid-repellent molded article, wherein a liquid-repellent composition comprising an aqueous liquid in which a compound having a perfluoroalkyl group having 6 or less carbon atoms is dissolved or dispersed in an aqueous medium can be uniformly applied to the surface of a resin molded article, and a liquid-repellent molded article having excellent liquid repellency can be obtained. A method for producing a liquid-repellent molded article, which is characterized by applying a liquid-repellent composition to a resin molded article to produce a liquid-repellent molded article, the liquid-repellent composition comprising: a fluorine-containing copolymer containing a structural unit based on a monomer having a perfluoroalkyl group with 4 to 6 carbon atoms, water, and an alcohol having 1 to 4 carbon atoms, wherein the content of the alcohol is 70 to 99.9% by mass relative to 100% by mass of the liquid repellent composition, and the amount of the liquid repellent composition applied to the resin molded article is 0.001 to 0.2g/m in terms of fluorine atom amount 2 。

title_en: Feeding device and glass kiln feeding system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a feeding device and a glass kiln feeding system, wherein the feeding device comprises a movable storage tank (1) and a first feeding bin (2) which are sequentially arranged from top to bottom, and the bottom discharge port of the movable storage tank and the top feed port of the first feeding bin can be mutually propped up to realize communication feeding by enabling the movable storage tank to move downwards; the movable storage tanks are moved upwards, so that the movable storage tanks are separated from each other, and the material inlet and the material outlet are respectively closed, thereby realizing automatic opening and closing of the bin cover of the feeding bin and improving the production efficiency; in the feeding process, the raw materials in the bin are not contacted with the external air, so that the quality of the product is prevented from being influenced by the deterioration of the raw materials, an additional dust removing device is not needed, and the equipment investment is saved. The glass kiln feeding system is high in feeding efficiency, and a feeding dust removing device is not required to be arranged.

title_en: Multilayer core-wrapped minced fillet product and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multilayer core-wrapped minced fillet product and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the field of minced fillet product processing, wherein the minced fillet product skin slurry is prepared from the following raw materials: minced fillet, starch, salt and ice water, wherein the middle layer slurry of the minced fillet product is prepared from the following raw materials: the glutinous rice flour, water and stuffing in the minced fillet product are the following raw materials: cutting cheese, crushed ice, white granulated sugar and salt; the preparation method of the minced fillet product comprises the steps of preparing inner stuffing, middle layer slurry and outer skin slurry, adding the inner stuffing, the middle layer slurry and the outer skin slurry into a forming machine for forming to obtain the minced fillet product, and then forming, shaping, boiling, frying, cooling, quick freezing, packaging, freezing and the like. The minced fillet product with multi-level mouthfeel prepared by the invention has good elasticity of the outer skin, soft glutinous middle layer and aromatic milk flavor of the inner stuffing, not only has good mouthfeel, but also can improve the added value of marine products.

title_en: All-plastic glass structure with retention prevention function
abstract_en: The invention discloses an all-plastic glass structure with a retention-preventing function, which comprises a black edge layer and a transparent layer, wherein the black edge layer is connected with the transparent layer; the black edge layer is provided with a through hole, one end of the through hole is an outer opening end, the other end of the through hole is an inner opening end, and the transparent layer seals the inner opening end; any intersection line of any plane vertical to the transparent first layer surface and the outer edge of the black side layer is an outer guide line, and the angle between the outer guide line and the black side first layer surface is 10-60 degrees. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: the retention of the shower coating liquid near the junction of the outer edge of the black edge layer and the transparent layer can be effectively avoided, so that the molding effect, the performance and the appearance are qualified; can prevent the liquid from being detained, so that the liquid can flow away in time, and can ensure the thickness of the necessary black edge to adapt to the injection molding property, thereby avoiding the problem of poor injection molding caused by thin wall.

title_en: Double-die-closing protection device of swing rod linkage type lifting mechanism of plastic hollow forming machine
abstract_en: The double mold closing protection device comprises a working table, an injection lower mold, a blow lower mold, a first upright, a second upright and a main shaft, wherein the first upright is connected with an injection upper beam, the injection upper mold is arranged below an injection movable mold plate, the injection cylinder is arranged on the first upright lower connected with the injection lower beam, the blow upper mold is arranged below the blow upper beam, the blow upper mold is arranged below the blow movable mold plate, the blow cylinder is arranged on the second upright lower connected with the blow lower beam, a turret and a top cover are arranged on the main shaft, a core rod is arranged on the turret, the main shaft is connected with the swing rod in a lower mode, an upper bearing seat and a lower bearing seat are sleeved on the main shaft, a spring is arranged outside the main shaft between the upper bearing seat and the lower bearing seat, the upper bearing seat is movably connected with the swing rod, a photoelectric switch is arranged on a switch mounting plate, a photoelectric sensing disc is arranged on the main shaft, one side of the blow upper beam is connected with a mold closing protection frame, and a mold closing protection lead screw is arranged in the mold closing protection frame to be matched with the top cover.

title_en: PVC (polyvinyl chloride) cold-shrinkable sleeve label film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a PVC cold-shrinkable sleeve label film and a preparation method thereof, in the traditional PVC manufacturing process, TPVC thermoplastic elastomer and ACR-g-VC copolymer resin are blended and added, the materials are mixed into uniform dry mixture by a high-speed mixer and a cooling mixer, the dry mixture is plasticized and extruded by a single-screw extruder, and a cylindrical film product with required specification and size is formed by one-time blowing through a film blowing machine head. The TP VC has the advantages of high elasticity of the traditional crosslinked vulcanized rubber, good compatibility with PVC, convenient processing of common plastics and wide processing modes, is convenient for the processing modes of extrusion, blow molding and the like, and has rebound resilience after large-amplitude stretching; ACR-g-VC is a PVC blending modifier, can improve the toughness and elongation at break of PVC resin, and improve the impact resistance and other properties; therefore, the ACR-g-VC copolymer resin and the TPVC are blended and added, so that a certain resilience can be kept, and the toughness and the mechanical strength of the PVC resin can be ensured.

title_en: Preparation method of atherosclerosis mouse model with NOD genetic background
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of an atherosclerosis mouse model with an NOD genetic background, belonging to the technical field of genetic engineering and genetic modification. The invention firstly knocks out ApoE and LDLR genes in NOD genetic background mice at the same time to obtain a gene knockout mouse model of the NOD genetic background mice capable of generating atherosclerosis. The aorta of the atherosclerosis mouse model with the NOD genetic background obtained by the invention has obvious atherosclerotic plaque formation, and compared with the traditional classical atherosclerosis model C57B/L6 background ApoE gene knockout mouse, the incidence degree of the atherosclerosis mouse model is consistent.

title_en: In-situ sintering 3D printing device and 3D printing forming method
abstract_en: A3D printing device for in-situ sintering comprises a containing cavity, a frame body, a printing head, a carrying table, a first driving mechanism, a second driving mechanism and a heating component; the accommodating cavity comprises a first part fixedly arranged on the frame body and a second part capable of moving relative to the first part; when the second part moves to the first position, the first part and the second part are separated to print the molded model blank; when the second part moves to the second position, the first part and the second part are closed to form a closed space for sintering; the heating member is provided on the wall of the second portion, and is used for sintering the molded body formed on the mounting table. The 3D printing forming process and the later sintering process are combined in the same equipment to be completed, so that the problems that the parts are easy to deform and damage and complex in process and low in efficiency when the 3D printing forming parts are transferred into a sintering furnace for sintering are avoided, the process flow is obviously simplified, and the product quality and the production efficiency are improved.

title_en: Polyaniline/graphene/polyvinyl alcohol composite gel and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses polyaniline/graphene/polyvinyl alcohol composite gel, which is prepared by firstly carrying out dispersion reaction on graphene oxide and p-phenylenediamine to obtain graphene containing phenylamino; and carrying out hydrothermal reaction on aniline and graphene containing phenylamino to obtain polyaniline/graphene composite gel, and then soaking the polyaniline/graphene composite gel in a polyvinyl alcohol solution for cyclic freezing and thawing treatment to obtain the polyaniline/graphene composite gel. According to the invention, aniline is used as a reducing agent and a polymerization monomer at the same time, graphene oxide is reduced in a hydrothermal reaction by using aniline, and the polymerization of aniline is initiated through an aniline group grafted on graphene, so that the polyaniline and graphene are compounded at a molecular level, and the mechanical property of the obtained gel is enhanced by further utilizing the hydrogen bond interaction of polyvinyl alcohol and polyaniline, so that the composite gel has good compression recovery performance, and can be used for preparing a compressible super capacitor and the like; the preparation method is simple, the reaction conditions are mild, the components of the composite gel are adjustable, and the composite gel is suitable for popularization and application.

title_en: Method of manufacturing a composite laminate structure for a wind turbine blade component and related wind turbine blade component
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a method of manufacturing a composite laminate structure of a wind turbine blade component by resin transfer moulding, preferably vacuum assisted resin transfer moulding. Impregnating the fibre reinforcement material with a liquid resin in a mould cavity, wherein the mould cavity comprises a rigid mould part having a mould surface defining a surface of the wind turbine blade part. The method comprises alternately stacking on the rigid mould part i) a number of fibre-reinforced layers (42, 46) comprising electrically conductive fibres, such as carbon fibres, and ii) a flow strip layer (62) in the form of a layer of flow strips (62 a,62b,62 c) having a strip width, and the flow strips being arranged to form a void having a void width between two juxtaposed strips. The method comprises sealing the second mould part against the rigid mould part to form the mould cavity, the method comprising optionally evacuating the mould cavity, e.g. in a vacuum-based injection. The method includes providing resin to the mold cavity, i.e., the injection stage. The method includes curing or hardening the resin to form a composite laminate structure.

title_en: Discharging mechanism of concrete mixer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a discharging mechanism of a concrete mixer, which comprises a frame, wherein a mixer body is fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the frame, a fixed plate is fixedly connected to the side wall of the frame, two convex sliding blocks are connected to the side wall of the fixed plate in a sliding manner, sliding grooves matched with the convex sliding blocks are formed in the side wall of the fixed plate, movable blocks are fixedly connected to one sides of the two convex sliding blocks far away from the fixed plate, circular through holes are formed in the side walls of the two movable blocks, threaded rods are movably connected to the hole walls of the circular through holes, one ends of the two threaded rods, close to the convex sliding blocks, are fixedly connected with the convex sliding blocks, nuts are connected to the rod walls of the threaded rods in a threaded fit manner, and a positioning plate is vertically and fixedly connected to one sides of the two movable blocks far away from the fixed plate. The invention does not need to load the concrete again, saves time and labor, reduces the labor intensity of workers, ensures the engineering construction efficiency and improves the discharging efficiency of the concrete mixer.

title_en: Preparation method of artificial limb receiving cavity
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a prosthetic socket, which utilizes a 3D printing technology to complete the preparation of a prosthetic socket male die, and adopts a self-made winding device to automatically wind, scrape, paste, solidify and cut the 3D printed male die by adopting carbon fiber cloth to obtain the prosthetic socket. And in the process of preparing the receiving cavity, the receiving cavity can be automatically produced, and the receiving cavity proposal of the optimal residual limb anastomosis degree is obtained based on the biomechanical analysis of finite elements. The male die is made of nontoxic environment-friendly 3D printing materials, and is different from most male die milling and manual socket making modes in the prior art, so that the preparation of the artificial limb socket is simplified and accurate, the manufacturing cost is reduced, the manpower is saved, and the automatic production of the artificial limb socket is realized.

title_en: Game machine for pet
abstract_en: The invention relates to a game machine for pets, which comprises a fixed frame and a running device, wherein the fixed frame is higher than the ground, the running device comprises more than one roller, a left support frame, a right support frame and a crawler, one end of the left support frame and one end of the right support frame are arranged on the ground, the other ends of the left support frame and the right support frame, which are far away from the ground, are connected to the fixed frame and are higher than the ground, the axes of the left support frame and the right support frame are parallel and form an included angle with the ground, two ends of the roller are respectively provided with a rotating shaft, the rotating shafts are respectively connected with the left support frame and the right support frame in a rotating manner; the fixed frame is provided with a hamper. The pet game machine can be arranged in a cage, a pet can run up and down without loneliness, the interest of a pet game is increased, the pet can be run and exercised, and the pet game machine is favorable for the growth and the body health of the pet.

title_en: Blade scraping mechanism and automatic blade scraping device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a blade scraping mechanism, which comprises a cutter rest, a cutter head, a blade, a fixing piece and a spring, wherein one end of the cutter head is connected with one end of the cutter rest; the other end of the tool rest is provided with a guide sliding block, the fixing piece is provided with a first through hole matched with the guide sliding block, and two ends of the spring are respectively propped against or connected with the tool rest and the fixing piece. The blade scraping mechanism has good blade scraping effect and is suitable for irregular product processing; the deformation direction of the spring is limited through the fixing piece, so that the blade is prevented from swinging along the non-axial direction of the spring, the acting force of the deflected blade on the surface of a product is prevented from being too small, and the blade scraping effect is ensured. The invention also discloses an automatic blade scraping device, which comprises a blade scraping mechanism, a rotating assembly for driving the product to rotate and a fixing assembly arranged on the rotating assembly, wherein the fixing assembly is used for fixing the product. The automatic blade scraping device is used for processing the surface of an irregular product by fixing the product and using a blade scraping mechanism.

title_en: Drip irrigation cultivation method for medlar by double-layer cross covering of straws
abstract_en: The invention discloses a drip irrigation cultivation method for medlar by double-layer cross coverage of straws, belonging to the technical field of water-saving drip irrigation cultivation in arid and semi-arid regions. Aiming at the characteristics of soil and climate in semiarid and arid regions, the water-saving drip irrigation method improves the utilization rate of rainfall and irrigation water and reduces the ineffective waste of water resources by adopting medlar cutting seedling treatment, efficient rainwater collection in furrow, drip irrigation planting in furrow, irrigation system optimization and double-layer cross covering measures of broken wheat straws and corn straws. Compared with the traditional Chinese wolfberry flood irrigation cultivation method, the total yield is improved by 15.13 percent, the super-grade fruit yield is improved by 13.6 percent, the third-grade fruit yield is reduced by 4.6 percent, and the average hundred-grain weight of dry fruits is increased by 14.44 percent; the protein content is increased by 2.53 percent, the polysaccharide content is increased by 10.42 percent, and the carotenoid content is increased by 45.169mg/100 g.

title_en: Gardens are with convenient portable case of planting
abstract_en: The invention relates to a convenient and movable planting box for gardens, in particular to a convenient and movable planting box for gardens. The technical problems of the invention are as follows: the utility model provides a gardens that can easily carry out light removal and protect the plant are with convenient portable case of planting. The technical implementation scheme of the invention is as follows: a convenient movable planting box for gardens comprises a planting box, rollers, a bottom plate, a first bearing seat, a screw rod, a nut, a first handle, a guide rail, a first guide sleeve, a guide wheel, a steel wire rope and the like; four sides all are equipped with the gyro wheel around planting bottom of the case portion, and planting incasement lower part is equipped with the bottom plate, and it has a plurality of first through-holes to open on the bottom plate, and the left and right sides on planting case front and back two walls upper portion all is equipped with first bearing frame. According to the invention, a user can drive the first guide sleeve to move inwards by rotating the first handle, so that the first guide sleeve can drive the friction block to move upwards through the steel wire rope, and the user can drive the planting box to move easily through the roller, thereby reducing the labor amount of the user.

title_en: Preparation method of organic-inorganic hybrid octafunctional epoxy POSS resin and preparation method of carbon fiber reinforced composite material
abstract_en: A preparation method of organic-inorganic hybrid octafunctional epoxy POSS resin and a preparation method of carbon fiber reinforced composite material belong to the technical field of POSS resin preparation. The method comprises the following steps: adding an organic solvent, a tetramethylammonium hydroxide aqueous solution and 2- (3, 4 epoxy cyclohexyl) -ethyl triethoxysilane or 2- (3, 4 epoxy cyclohexyl) -ethyl trimethoxysilane into a round-bottom flask, and stirring for reaction; after the reaction was completed, 70% of the solvent was evaporated by a rotary evaporator to obtain a colorless transparent liquid. And mixing the transparent liquid and an epoxy resin curing agent, uniformly stirring to obtain a POSS-based epoxy resin composition, soaking the wound fibers in the transparent liquid, transferring the transparent liquid into a mold, and heating and curing to obtain the carbon fiber reinforced composite material. The invention has the advantages that: simple operation steps, mild reaction conditions, easily obtained raw materials, low cost and high yield. The prepared carbon fiber reinforced composite material has relatively high interlaminar shear strength at 200 ℃.

title_en: Automatic pollution discharge water changing fish tank and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automatic pollution discharge water changing fish tank and a control method thereof, comprising a fish tank body, and the automatic pollution discharge water changing fish tank is characterized in that: the fish bowl body is including supporting the fish bowl cavity on the mount pad the grid board has set firmly in the fish bowl cavity, and this grid board divide into the cultivation district on upper portion and the blowdown district of lower part with the fish bowl cavity, the blowdown district of fish bowl cavity lower part is the cone of back taper and fights, and the fight tail of this cone fights is the drain of fish bowl cavity, the fight mouthful size of cone fight with the size of grid board suits, just the cone fights to be fixed in the mount pad, the mount pad inside wall with the outer cone wall of cone fight encloses into the installation cavity. The fish tank is safe and reliable, and water can not overflow outwards even if no person takes care of the fish tank at home. The fish tank can also automatically drain and change water, so that the fish tank can be kept clean for a long time, multiple guarantees are provided, and the fish tank is reliable and safe.

title_en: A be convenient for clearance type cutter shaft for agricultural rotary cultivator
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cutter shaft for an agricultural rotary cultivator, in particular to a conveniently cleaned cutter shaft for the agricultural rotary cultivator. The technical problem is as follows: the convenient-to-clean cutter shaft for the agricultural rotary tiller can be cleaned conveniently by people, and is time-saving and labor-saving. The technical scheme is as follows: a conveniently cleaned cutter shaft for an agricultural rotary cultivator comprises a rotary cultivation shaft, a large sleeve, a first large rectangular pipe, a lower rotary cultivation cutter, a lower pin rod, a left pin rod, a right pin rod, a lower rectangular sleeve, a first connecting block, a second connecting block and the like; the rotary tillage shaft is provided with a first left pin hole and a first right pin hole which are penetrated through from top to bottom, the first right pin hole is positioned on the right side of the first left pin hole, and the large sleeve is sleeved on the rotary tillage shaft in a sliding manner. The conveniently cleaned cutter shaft for the agricultural rotary tiller is novel and unique in structure, and facilitates people to disassemble and assemble the rotary tillage shaft and the rotary tillage cutters, so that the clay wound and adhered on the cutter shaft is conveniently cleaned by people, the cutter shaft is convenient to maintain, and the service life is prolonged.

title_en: Biological feed additive production system with cooking fermentation function
abstract_en: The invention relates to a biological feed additive production system with digestion fermentation, which comprises a proportioning device and an aerobic fermentation machine, wherein the outlet of a feeding hopper is connected with a plurality of proportioning bins through a raw material lifting machine, the outlet of each proportioning bin is respectively connected with a proportioning scale, the outlet of each proportioning scale is connected with a raw material buffering bin, the outlet of each raw material buffering bin is connected with a feeding lifting machine, the outlet of each feeding lifting machine is connected with a feeding conveyor, the outlets of the feeding conveyor are respectively connected with digestion tanks, the discharge outlets of the digestion tanks are respectively connected with digestion material buffering bins, the feed screw outlets at the bottoms of the digestion material buffering bins are respectively connected with the feed inlet of an air cooling machine, and the discharge outlet of the air cooling machine is connected with a wet material air conveying pipeline. The wet material wind delivery pipeline is connected with the aerobic fermentation machine, the aerobic fermentation outlet is connected with the facultative fermentation machine or the anaerobic fermentation tank, and the facultative fermentation outlet or the anaerobic fermentation outlet is connected with the drying system. The system gives consideration to facultative or anaerobic fermentation, the feed is rich in nutrition balance, and the fermentation process is not easy to be contaminated by infectious microbe.

title_en: High-transparency PET anti-scratching master batch and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of high polymer materials, in particular to a high-transparency PET scratch-resistant master batch and a preparation method thereof. The key points of the technical scheme are as follows: the master batch comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: the PET flake material comprises, by weight, 50-80 parts of PET, 5-20 parts of a scratch-resistant auxiliary agent, 5-20 parts of a slipping agent, 10-30 parts of PCTA, 3-8 parts of calcium montanate, 0.1-1 part of an antioxidant and 3-20 parts of an anti-blocking agent.

title_en: Spliced plant planting box
abstract_en: The application provides a spliced plant planting box, relates to the field of plant planting devices, and solves the problems that the planting box is single in shape and structure and cannot be mutually assembled according to requirements; the device comprises: the box base is provided with upright post slots at four corners, and a plurality of first clamping grooves are formed in the side edges of the box base; the two ends of the connecting upright post are respectively provided with a socket part and a spigot part, and the spigot parts are inserted into the upright post slots and/or the spigot parts of the adjacent connecting upright posts; at least two side walls of the connecting upright post are provided with grooves which are concave inwards, and at least one side wall is provided with a convex groove corresponding to the groove; the side plates are provided with ribs on two side edges, the ribs are clamped with the grooves, clamping blocks and second clamping grooves are respectively arranged on the upper side and the lower side of the side plates, and the clamping blocks are clamped in the first clamping grooves and/or the second clamping grooves; the application can splice the box bodies with different sizes and layers, and can design the shape of the spliced box body according to the requirement; the structure is more diversified, and the diversified needs of people are satisfied.

title_en: Control system based on PLC metallographical test piece preparation facilities
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control system based on a PLC metallographic specimen preparation device, which comprises a PLC, wherein the PLC is respectively connected with a manipulator, a liquid preparation and injection molding control system, an embedding control system, a grinding and polishing control system and a corrosion, cleaning and airing control system; the liquid preparation and injection molding control system is used for controlling the proportion of acrylic powder and a curing agent, injecting the prepared liquid into the eight molds in sequence and completing the cleaning of the liquid preparation table; the embedding control system is used for controlling the mechanical arm to sequentially embed the chips into 8 dies; the grinding and polishing control system is used for controlling the manipulator to grind and polish the test piece; and the control system controls the manipulator to clamp the test piece and stop for 3 seconds on the corrosion table and the cleaning table in sequence, so that the test piece is corroded and cleaned, and finally the test piece is placed on the drying table. The invention has the characteristics of wide applicability, strong flexibility and high efficiency.

title_en: Auto parts injection mold convenient to change die cavity
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automobile part injection mold convenient for replacing a mold cavity, which comprises an upper mold, a limiting transverse rod and a limiting rod, wherein a connecting rod is fixedly welded on the upper surface of the upper mold, a first cross rod is installed on the outer side of the upper mold, the limiting transverse rod is fixedly inserted on the outer side of the first cross rod in a splicing manner, a limiting vertical rod penetrates through the outer side of the limiting transverse rod, a positioning screw rod is installed on the outer side of the limiting vertical rod, a lower mold is arranged below the upper mold, an injection mold cavity is arranged inside the upper mold, injection molding lugs are welded on the outer side of the injection mold cavity, an injection hole is formed among the injection molding lugs, and a first clamping block is welded on the outer side of the injection. This auto parts injection mold convenient to change die cavity adopts cross pole one and spacing horizontal pole, and is fixed cross pole one through spacing horizontal pole and spacing vertical pole, ensures the fixed stability of cross pole one, avoids the device to take place not hard up the condition at the operation in-process.

title_en: Cross linkage feeding and filling device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cross linkage feeding and filling device which comprises a machine base, a driving lever, a filling cylinder, a transmission mechanism and a feeding mechanism. Ammunition and an ammunition chain are arranged on the second bottom plate, a loading track, a limiting table and supports are fixed on the first bottom plate, the two supports are symmetrically distributed on two sides of the loading track in parallel, and the limiting table is positioned on one side of the ammunition chain in the feeding direction; the guide rail is fixed on the second bottom plate through a guide rail bracket, and the guide rail bracket is positioned at one end of the guide rail; two ends of the driving lever are respectively and rotatably connected with the two brackets of the base through bearings; the filling cylinder is arranged in the filling track, one end of the filling cylinder, which is far away from the ammunition, is connected with the driving lever, and the filling cylinder is driven by the driving lever to slide in a reciprocating manner along the filling track and perpendicular to the ammunition chain; one end of the feeding mechanism is arranged on the guide rail, the other end of the feeding mechanism is used for shifting ammunition and an ammunition chain, one end of the transmission mechanism is connected with the filling cylinder, and the other end of the transmission mechanism is connected with the feeding mechanism. The invention solves the problem of cross linkage of feeding and filling driven by reciprocating motion.

title_en: Efficient additive forming equipment and method for large multi-curved-surface high-precision casting sand mold
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-efficiency additive forming device and method for a large multi-curved-surface high-precision casting sand mold. The controller realizes the slicing of the printing model, the path planning, the adjustment of the process parameters and the like. The lifting mechanism realizes the up-and-down lifting of the printing platform; the horizontal movement system realizes the movement of the powder scraping trolley and improves the surface precision through the sand milling head; and the upper sand feeding system and the laser scanning system act together to perform high-efficiency printing in a subarea mode in the printing platform. The invention provides a multi-region 3D printing method of a casting sand mold based on a triaxial numerical control system, and the method is combined with a sand milling head to carry out synchronous material reduction manufacturing so as to avoid the defects of step effect and the like caused by the accumulation of process parameters or errors, so that the 3D printing precision of the casting sand mold can be improved, and the high-precision printing of a large-size multi-curved-surface casting sand mold is realized.

title_en: Vegetation 3D directly broadcasts device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of agricultural informatization, and discloses a 3D direct seeding device for plant growth, which comprises a collecting assembly, a direct seeding assembly and a control assembly, wherein the collecting assembly is used for collecting growth structure data of plants; the central control assembly is electrically connected with the acquisition assembly and is used for controlling the acquisition assembly to acquire growth structure data at regular time to generate a plant 3D model and a virtual scene; the display component is electrically connected with the central control component and is used for displaying the 3D plant model and the virtual scene; and the interactive assembly is electrically connected with the central control assembly and is used for sensing and identifying the input information of an interactor and forming interaction with the plant 3D model in the virtual scene according to the input information. According to the invention, the plant growth data is acquired at regular time through the acquisition component, the interactive experience of 3D live broadcast and the like of the plant growth of actual data is realized based on the central control component and the interactive component, a novel teaching system is provided for plant teaching and plant knowledge science popularization, and a miniaturized and low-cost solution is provided for the development of a biological system and a science popularization teaching aid system.

title_en: Automatic forming equipment for sponge inner support
abstract_en: The invention relates to sponge inner support automatic forming equipment which comprises a rack, wherein one side of the rack is provided with a mounting panel, and the mounting panel is provided with a flannelette feeding component, a recovery component and a separation component in transmission connection with the flannelette feeding component and the recovery component; the separation assembly is also connected with a lint tearing and cutting mechanism, and one side of the lint tearing and cutting mechanism is provided with a sponge feeding assembly and a forming mechanism; the molding mechanism is connected with the flannelette tearing and cutting mechanism and the sponge feeding component. The invention adopts the automatic feeding of flannelette, tears off the release paper, cuts off the flannelette according to the length required by actual production, automatically grabs sponge and bonds the flannelette, and automatically bordures and extrudes the sponge for molding; the production efficiency is improved, the energy consumption is reduced, the operation safety of equipment is improved, the difficulty of staff operating the equipment is reduced, and the practicability is high.

title_en: Manufacturing device for hollow cylindrical test piece and using method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a manufacturing device of a hollow cylindrical test piece and a using method thereof, wherein the manufacturing device comprises a first-diameter PVC pipe, a second-diameter PVC pipe, a semicircular steel belt, a connecting plate, a fixing piece, a first centering positioning disc and a second centering positioning disc; the periphery of the first centering positioning disc extends upwards to form a circle of first outer annular ribs along the direction perpendicular to the plane of the first centering positioning disc; a round bump is arranged at the center of the first centering positioning disc; a circular through hole is formed in the center of the second centering positioning disc; the periphery of the second centering positioning disc downwards extends a circle of second outer annular ribs along the direction perpendicular to the plane of the second centering positioning disc; by the technical scheme, the manufacturing device can be recycled and constructed conveniently.

title_en: Automatic seed processing device for biological breeding
abstract_en: The invention relates to a device related to biological breeding, in particular to an automatic seed processing device for biological breeding, which can automatically convey seeds, the seed conveying device of the device is provided with a switch and can be fixed, the device can separate light impurities mixed in the seeds by using air, the device can separate shrivelled seeds in the seeds by using water, the device can dry the water-sorted seeds, the device can add medicines and stir, a winnowing device is connected with a water sorting device, a conveying sleeve is connected with the water sorting device, a hot drying box is connected with the water sorting device, a water draining sleeve is connected with the water sorting device, a medicine powder adding box is connected with the water sorting device, the conveying sleeve is connected with the hot drying box, the seed conveying device is connected with a fixed block, the seed conveying device is connected with the winnowing device, and a fixed clamp is connected with the winnowing device, the fixed block is connected with the air separation device.

title_en: Method for inhibiting microbial blockage of drip irrigation emitter
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for inhibiting microbial blockage of a drip irrigation emitter, belonging to the technical field of water-saving irrigation. The method comprises the following steps: (1) determining key bacteria causing the blockage of the drip irrigation emitter by adopting a developmental molecular ecological network analysis, and then screening antagonistic bacteria for inhibiting the blockage of the drip irrigation emitter; (2) fermenting the screened antagonistic bacteria in a culture medium containing biogas slurry to prepare the antagonistic bacteria; (3) the antagonist is applied to a drip irrigation system. The method of the invention utilizes a molecular ecological network analysis method to obtain key bacteria causing the growth of the biomembrane of the drip irrigation emitter, screens out antagonistic bacteria capable of antagonizing the growth of the biomembrane by combining a microorganism antagonism principle, and can inhibit the growth of the biomembrane of the drip irrigation emitter.

title_en: Hot air type baking machine
abstract_en: The hot air type baking machine comprises: a housing; a fan unit (120) that sucks air into the housing; a baking cylinder with a hollow interior, wherein the baking cylinder is provided with an air inflow port and a baking chamber; a heater unit disposed between the air inlet and the baking chamber in the baking cylinder, and configured to heat air flowing in from the air inlet; and a baking cylinder cover (121) which covers a part of the outer peripheral wall of the baking cylinder and is arranged at a position separated from the part of the outer peripheral wall of the baking cylinder by a gap. The baking cylinder is formed of a material having a thermal conductivity of at least a predetermined value. The inner peripheral wall of the baking cylinder cover (121) and a part of the outer peripheral wall of the baking cylinder form a gap air duct (125) for guiding the air sucked by the fan unit (120) to the air inlet of the baking cylinder.

title_en: Flexible bulletproof and stab-resistant material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flexible bulletproof and stab-resistant material and a preparation method thereof, the flexible bulletproof and stab-resistant material comprises a basic layer and a passivation layer, wherein the basic layer comprises a fiber fabric, one side of the fiber fabric is infiltrated with a thermoplastic elastic material which is partially infiltrated into the fiber fabric after hot melting, shear thickening liquid is dispersed in the part, which is not infiltrated into the thermoplastic elastic material, of the fiber fabric, the passivation layer is prepared by coating a mixed solution of ceramic particles and thermosetting resin on one side, containing the thermoplastic elastic material, of the fiber fabric and curing, and a protective film is coated outside the basic layer and the passivation layer in a vacuum manner. The preparation method is used for preparing the flexible bulletproof stab-resistant material. The invention greatly improves the softness of the bulletproof and stab-resistant material and provides lightweight and comfortable bulletproof and stab-resistant effects.

title_en: Efficient soilless passion fruit cultivation process
abstract_en: The invention provides a process for efficiently cultivating passion fruit without soil, which breaks through the traditional process form of passion fruit cultivation, and selects a passion fruit variety and a land with proper climate as a cultivation base; mixing the waste mushroom dregs, the chicken manure and the straw powder for crushing; mixing the crushed mixture with disturbance sand, biogas slurry and a microbial agent, and uniformly stirring; putting the biogas slurry mixture into a fermentation tank for primary fermentation; stacking the first fermentation mixture into a plurality of stacks for a second fermentation; adding lime powder into the second fermentation mixture, uniformly mixing, and adjusting the pH value to 7-8; digging a plurality of cultivation pits in a sunward flat land of a cultivation base, filling the soilless culture mixture into the cultivation pits, and planting the roots of passion fruit seedlings in the soilless culture mixture; and covering the excessive soil at the edge of the cultivation pit on the surface of the soilless culture mixture and compacting. The invention reasonably ferments and processes organic waste to form organic fertilizer with sufficient nutrition, which can cultivate strong passion fruit tree.

title_en: Grouting type steel-concrete combined stair and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a grouting type steel-concrete combined stair and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the structure can comprise two inclined and symmetrically arranged ladder beams, an upper step plate and a lower step plate are connected between the two ladder beams, a cavity is arranged between the upper step plate and the lower step plate, grouting holes and grout outlet holes are formed in the ladder beams, the grouting holes and the grout outlet holes are communicated with the cavity between the upper step plate and the lower step plate, and filling materials are added into the cavity between the upper step plate and the lower step plate; go up step board, step board down and be welded connection between the ladder beam, just go up step board and step board's upper end portion down and lower tip all are provided with inclosed shutoff board. By adopting the manufacturing method of the grouting type steel-concrete combined stair provided by the invention, the stair has the advantages of high rigidity, good use comfort, small self weight, material saving and low cost.

title_en: Cultivation management method for replacing Pan-Ke-Hanm pears by flat-net rack high grafting
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cultivation management method for changing Pan-Ke-Hanm pears by overhead connection of a flat net frame, which is characterized by comprising the following steps: s1, selecting rootstocks; s2, selecting scions; s3, processing scions; s4, treating the rootstock; s5, grafting; s6, mounting an open angle on the upper frame; s7, culturing fruiting branches in the current year; s8, trimming management; s9, managing results; and S10, managing in the third year. Compared with the traditional mode without constructing a net rack, the method is easier to form flower buds, a large number of secondary branches can be formed after the young shoots are subjected to angle opening, and the constructing mode is easier to manage and pick, so that the managing and picking process is safer and more efficient compared with the traditional mode. The high-joint tree building net rack is more beneficial to ventilation and light transmission, and the fruit quality is obviously improved. The Chinese pear trees cultivated in the flat shed frame have no serious top-pop on the backs, the trimming and pruning are mainly to bud picking and branch thinning, the trimming workload is greatly reduced, and the Chinese pear trees have early fruiting, high yield and good quality.

title_en: Breed with exhaust device that disinfects
abstract_en: The invention provides a sterilizable exhaust device for breeding, which comprises a cage, wherein a plurality of fans are arranged on the wall body of the cage, each fan comprises a mounting frame and an air gathering barrel, fan blades are arranged in the air gathering barrel, a central rotating shaft of each fan blade is coaxially connected with a driving motor, a plurality of spray headers are arranged in the air gathering barrel, the spray headers are connected with a main pipe through branch pipes and a water pump and an ozone generator, each spray header comprises an inner pipe and a shell, bevel gears are fixedly arranged outside the inner pipes, the bevel gears are meshed with rotating rings rotatably connected to the outer wall of the air gathering barrel, each rotating ring is meshed with a rack at the bottom of the fan, and a filter plate. The invention has the beneficial effects that: reasonable in design, simple structure, safe and reliable, from taking spray disinfection, deodorization function.

title_en: Ejector rod adjusting method for injection molding machine
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for adjusting an ejector rod of an injection molding machine, which can prevent uneven contact of the ejector rod and can make ejection force of an ejected molded product uniform. An injection molding machine (10) of an ejector rod adjusting method of the injection molding machine is provided with: a movable platen (120) to which a mold is attached; and an ejector rod (230) which is arranged in a through hole of the movable platen (120) so as to be able to advance and retreat and ejects a molded product from the mold, wherein the front end surface (233) of the ejector rod (230) is made to conform to the mold mounting surface (121) of the movable platen (120).

title_en: High-survival-rate cultivation method for fries of cupfish with round mouth
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-survival-rate cultivation method for round-mouth copper fish fries, which adopts well water as a water source and has few pathogens for cultivating the round-mouth copper fish. Aiming at the physiological requirements of the round-mouth coppers fry in different stages, different feeds are provided in different stages, palatable corresponding baits are adopted, the growth speed of the fry is effectively improved, the fry is strong, the physique is good, the disease resistance is good, and the survival rate of the fry is high. The water bottom material is obtained by loading polymeric aluminum ferric silicate, cerium sulfate, sodium humate and a serratia grignard metabolite (obtained by activating, inoculating and fermenting serratia grignard ACCC 01695) on modified diatomite. Improve the water environment, greatly reduce the morbidity and improve the survival rate.

title_en: Be applied to vegetation wall in aspect of ecological corridor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vegetation wall applied to the aspect of ecological galleries, which comprises a wall body, wherein planting grooves are formed in the front side of the wall body, splicing structures are arranged on two sides of the wall body, a water storage and supply mechanism is arranged in the wall body, the water storage and supply mechanism comprises a water storage groove arranged on the upper wall of the wall body, an adjusting groove is formed in the wall body, the adjusting groove is located at the upper end of the wall body, an adjusting box is arranged in the adjusting groove, the outer wall of the adjusting box is tightly attached to the inner wall of the adjusting groove, the adjusting box is elastically connected with the bottom in the adjusting groove through a first spring, a baffle is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the adjusting box, and a water limiting hole is formed in the middle of the baffle. The device is easy to install and dismantle, has higher flexibility, can ensure that the plants cannot die due to excessive water in rainy days, can automatically and intermittently supply water to the plants at high temperature, prevents the plants from dying due to drought, and saves a great amount of time and energy for workers.

title_en: Seedling growth device for forestry
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of forestry, and particularly relates to a seedling raising device for forestry, which aims at solving the problem that seedlings are easily damaged when the seedlings are directly dug out of a seedling raising box. According to the invention, the seedlings are buried in the soil and arranged in the cultivation box, and when the seedlings in the cultivation box need to be transplanted after cultivation is finished, the cultivation box can be directly detached from the device and then the two mounting plates are separated from two sides, so that the damage of the seedlings caused by direct contact with the seedlings can be avoided.

title_en: Automatic production line for PPTC (polymeric positive temperature coefficient) overcurrent protection element
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic production line of a PPTC (polymeric positive temperature coefficient) overcurrent protection element, which relates to the technical field of automatic production lines and comprises a workbench, wherein the workbench is sequentially provided with: the device comprises a feeding mechanism I, a feeding mechanism, a cutting mechanism, a bending mechanism I, a tin coating mechanism, a flattening mechanism, a bending mechanism II, a warping mechanism, a power mechanism I, a feeding mechanism II, a hot welding mechanism, a power mechanism II and a cutting mechanism. The automatic feeding, bending, welding and discharging device realizes the automation of feeding, bending, welding and discharging, the matching among the processes is compact, the occupied area is small, and the quality and the performance of the production and the processing of the product are effectively improved; by arranging the anti-shake mechanism and the guide mechanism, the accurate positioning in the feeding process is realized; through set up the promotion piece in feed mechanism two, realized pushing the protection component that drops to collection device inside automatically, the arrangement of the protection component of being convenient for and can swiftly change collection device.

title_en: Liquid-phase medicine-loading mechanical secondary scattering device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mechanical secondary scattering device for liquid-phase medicines, wherein a lower end spring is a fourth spiral-rising revolving body, the spiral revolving axis of the fourth spiral-rising revolving body of the lower end spring is a straight line, the spiral revolving section of the lower end spring is a fourth circular plane, the lower end spring is in a cylindrical wire spiral revolving winding state, the upper end point of the lower end spring is a fourth upper end point, and the lower end point of the lower end spring is a fourth lower end point; the device is placed in the shell of the fire extinguishing bomb, when the liquid phase fire extinguishing agent is thrown, the liquid phase fire extinguishing agent is loaded in the device and cannot be atomized immediately, the air resistance encountered by the liquid phase fire extinguishing agent during movement is greatly reduced, the average speed of the movement can be improved, the liquid phase fire extinguishing agent is gradually extruded and atomized to form cloud clusters, and compared with the original scheme, the diameter of the thrown cloud clusters is increased due to the fact that the average speed of the movement of the fire extinguishing agent is increased.

title_en: Resin composition containing cellulose xanthate microfine fibers
abstract_en: The invention provides a material which can exert proper action on resin and rubber with high uniformity and has more excellent action on added resin composition. The resin composition and the resin dispersion liquid contain cellulose xanthate microfine fibers.

title_en: A aloe raw materials production system of processing for cosmetics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system for producing and processing cosmetics, which comprises a conveying belt; a feeding device; a trimming device; the edge cutting device comprises a frame body, a floating limiting part, two edge cutting parts and a feed inlet, wherein the floating limiting part is arranged on the frame body and can be used for compressing and positioning raw materials, the two edge cutting parts are symmetrically arranged, the feed inlet is formed between the two edge cutting parts, each edge cutting part comprises a cutting head, a touch sensing assembly matched with the cutting head and a driving assembly matched with the touch sensing assembly, when the raw materials are driven by a conveying belt to drive the lower head to be inserted into the feed inlet, the head of the raw materials outwards pushes against the cutting head, the cutting head outwards moves to drive the touch sensing assembly to start, and the touch sensing assembly controls the driving part to start to drive the cutting head to move outwards at a. The aloe cutting head can only cut the aloe rim charge to a fixed thickness when the cutting head cuts the aloe rim charge, and raw material waste in the aloe cutting process is effectively avoided.

title_en: CRISPR/Cas9 system for knocking out dmrt1 gene at double gRNA sites in pelteobagrus fulvidraco and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a CRISPR/Cas9 system for knocking out a dmrt1 gene from double gRNA sites in pelteobagrus fulvidraco, wherein the CRISPR/Cas9 system comprises the following steps: (1) the target site 1 is designed on the first exon of the pelteobagrus fulvidraco dmrt1 gene, and the target site 2 is designed on the third exon; (2) designing a primer to detect the accuracy of the target site in the parent fish according to the target site sequence in step (1), amplifying the target site 1 and the nearby sequence by using dmrt 1E 1F and dmrt 1E 1R, and amplifying the target site 2 and the nearby sequence by using dmrt 1E 3F and dmrt 1E 3R; (3) using pUC19-gRNA-scaffold plasmid as template, performing PCR amplification of gRNA1 fragment with dmrt 1E 1gRNA F and gRNA R, and performing PCR amplification of gRNA2 fragment with dmrt 1E 3 gRNA F and gRNA R; taking the PCR product as a template, and carrying out in-vitro transcription and purification to obtain gRNA; (4) in vitro transcription synthesis of Cas9mRNA by using pXT7-hCas9 linearized plasmid as a template; (5) micro-injecting Cas9mRNA and two gRNAs into a pseudobagrus fulvidraco one-cell-stage embryo; (6) and detecting the mutation type and calculating the gene editing rate.

title_en: High-comfort waterproof breathable yarn-card composite fabric and production method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-comfort waterproof breathable yarn-card composite fabric and a production method thereof, and relates to the technical field of textiles. The method comprises the steps of activating a yarn card fabric by a low-temperature plasma instrument, and then reacting the yarn card fabric with a silane coupling agent to obtain a modified yarn card fabric; and then reacting the polytetrafluoroethylene microporous membrane with a dopamine solution and a sulfonated chitosan solution in sequence to obtain a modified polytetrafluoroethylene microporous membrane, coating an adhesive on the modified polytetrafluoroethylene microporous membrane, attaching the modified yarn card fabric to two sides of the modified polytetrafluoroethylene microporous membrane coated with the adhesive, performing hot-pressing curing to obtain a high-comfort waterproof breathable yarn card composite fabric blank, and performing alkali etching on the high-comfort waterproof breathable yarn card composite fabric blank to obtain the high-comfort waterproof breathable yarn card composite fabric. The high-comfort waterproof breathable yarn-card composite fabric prepared by the invention has excellent waterproof performance and breathability.

title_en: Flat cable bending device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flat cable bending device which comprises a horizontally arranged adsorption platform, an air cylinder unit, a pressing cutter, a lower folding cutter and a driving unit, wherein the adsorption platform is configured to adsorb a product, the flat cable is connected to the product, the air cylinder unit is positioned above the adsorption platform, the pressing cutter is connected with the air cylinder unit and is driven by the air cylinder unit to do straight reciprocating motion in the vertical direction, the lower folding cutter is pivoted with the adsorption platform through a lower cutter rest and abuts against the flat cable, the driving unit is driven to rotate so as to drive the lower folding cutter to rotate, and the flat cable is forced to be bent to a preset angle, and when the air cylinder unit drives the pressing cutter to move downwards to a lower limit position, the pressing cutter is pressed on a folding position of the flat cable. The flat cable bending device has the advantages of simple structure and convenience in bending.

title_en: Film pasting equipment for reflective film of road cone
abstract_en: The invention discloses film pasting equipment for a reflective film of a road cone, which relates to the field of road cone processing and comprises a base, wherein a workbench is arranged at one end of the base, a positioning mechanism for positioning the reflective film is arranged on the workbench, a rack is arranged at one end of the base, which is away from the workbench, an installation seat is hinged at the upper end of the rack, a cylinder for driving the installation seat to overturn towards the direction of the workbench is arranged at one side, which is away from the workbench, of the installation seat, an installation rod is obliquely upwards arranged at one side, which is close to the workbench, the installation rod is rotatably connected with the installation seat, a tool for abutting the workbench and sleeved with the cone is arranged on the installation rod, and a driving mechanism for controlling the installation rod to rotate is arranged on the installation seat. The invention has the advantages that the reflective film is automatically wound and attached on the outer wall of the cone by arranging the high-automation film attaching equipment, so that the automatic attachment of the reflective film is realized, the labor is saved, the high-efficiency film attaching effect is achieved, and the production efficiency of the road cone is improved.

title_en: Cryptopteris macrocephala secretion collecting device and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a large cryptopteris secretion collecting device and a method, and the device comprises a collecting body, wherein a live insect inlet section and a live insect outlet section are arranged on the collecting body, a crawling channel penetrating through the live insect inlet section and the live insect outlet section is arranged in the collecting body, the crawling channel positioned at the live insect outlet section is provided with a pressing mechanism and a secretion collecting structure, the head or the chest of an insect is pressed by the pressing mechanism, so that the tail of the insect secretes defensive secretion, and the secretion collecting structure is used for adsorbing and collecting the secretion; the width of the crawling channel of the live insect outlet section is only capable of allowing one insect to pass through. The invention has the advantages that: the device simple structure, easy operation can effectively protect the big latent wing worm of live body insect body can not impaired when artifical the collection secretion, can effectively improve the toxin again and gather the volume, and the toxin is gathered efficiently and the difficult polluted environment of toxin.

title_en: Improved juicing head
abstract_en: An improved juicing head of the type present in juicing systems in which the fruit to be juiced is housed in a groove of a female element and is guided to come into contact with a head of a male element temporarily inserted in the groove, so as to squeeze the fruit and extract the juice, wherein the head comprises on its surface ribs arranged transversely to the direction of movement of the head.

title_en: A sprinkling irrigation equipment is collected to rainwater for big-arch shelter
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rainwater collecting and sprinkling irrigation device for a greenhouse, which is combined with a greenhouse frame to improve the rainwater collecting range and change two modes of water collection and water accumulation prevention through the change of air inflation and air exhaust of an air bag, and is characterized in that a plurality of mounting grooves are arranged on the greenhouse frame, the mounting grooves are distributed in a rectangular array, the air bag is arranged in each mounting groove, the air bag is fixedly connected with the greenhouse frame, a water through hole is arranged in the center of the air bag, a sprayer is arranged in the middle of the bottom of the air bag, the sprayer is correspondingly communicated with the water through hole, an electromagnetic valve is arranged on a channel in the sprayer, a booster pump is arranged on the channel in the sprayer, the booster pump is positioned below the electromagnetic valve, the booster pump is communicated with the channel in the sprayer, a spray head is arranged at the bottom of the sprayer, and a circle of protective bosses are arranged at the edge of the mounting grooves, a plurality of drainage grooves are formed in the protection boss, and the groove edge of the installation groove is an inclined plane.

title_en: Ceramic/polytetrafluoroethylene composite medium substrate and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of composite medium substrates, in particular to a composite material for a tape casting process and a ceramic/polytetrafluoroethylene tape casting sheet prepared from the composite material by taking glass fiber cloth as a substrate, and also relates to a ceramic/polytetrafluoroethylene composite medium substrate and a preparation method thereof. The ceramic/polytetrafluoroethylene composite medium substrate disclosed by the invention is simple in preparation process, environment-friendly in raw material, capable of meeting the requirements of high-content ceramic filling and large ceramic/resin layer thickness, and excellent in electrical property and low in thermal expansion coefficient.

title_en: Photocurable 3D printed polyester oligomer and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a photocurable 3D printed polyester oligomer and a preparation method and application thereof. The prepared light-cured aliphatic polyester oligomer can be directly combined with a photoinitiator, and is suitable for DLP type 3D printing. The photo-curing aliphatic polyester resin material prepared by the invention has high purity, lower viscosity and adjustability, can be used in the field of biological medicine, especially in the fields of drug sustained release, tissue engineering, bone fixation, repair materials and the like, and simultaneously combines the photo-curing polyester degradable material with a 3D printing technology, so that the printed material is non-toxic and has excellent biocompatibility and mechanical property, the degradation rate is between 6 and 36 months, and a new direction is provided for the application of 3D printing.

title_en: Process for making porous articles from alternating poly (ethylene tetrafluoroethylene) and articles made therefrom
abstract_en: The present invention provides a poly (ethylene tetrafluoroethylene) (ETFE) polymer having an average molecular weight of at least 300000 g/mole and a melt enthalpy of at least 57 j/g. The ETFE polymer may comprise at least one other comonomer. ETFE polymers are used to form porous tapes or membranes having a node and fibril structure. The porous ETFE tape can be formed by lubricating the ETFE polymer and applying pressure to the lubricated polymer at a temperature below the melting point of the ETFE polymer. Optionally, the tape may be expanded at a temperature below the melting temperature of the ETFE polymer to form an expanded ETFE membrane. Alternatively, the ETFE polymer may be subjected to heat and pressure treatment without the addition of a lubricant to form a dense preform. The dense preform may then be cut in the length direction and drawn to form a dense ETFE fiber.

title_en: Secondary recycling method for woven bags
abstract_en: The invention relates to a secondary recycling method of woven bags, which mainly comprises the following steps of classification treatment, crushing treatment, rinsing operation, raw material mixing, extrusion forming, drying treatment, packaging operation and other multiple processes, wherein used woven bag crushing equipment comprises a bottom plate, a cleaning device, a crushing device and a conveying device; b, when traditional reducing mechanism smashed the braided bag, often lead to the braided bag to smash incompletely for the subsequent processing degree of difficulty increases, and can not in time carry out cleaning to the braided bag piece, lead to plastic powder and piece diffusion to cause the pollution to the environment, changing waste into valuables reduces the pollution to the environment.

title_en: Device and method for stretching optical fiber base material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a stretching device and a method for an optical fiber base material, wherein the device comprises a vertical tower, a stretching heating furnace, a detector arranged below the heating furnace and a data processing center, wherein an upper lifting chuck and a lower lifting chuck are respectively arranged at the upper end and the lower end of the vertical tower, the upper lifting chuck and the lower lifting chuck are respectively connected with an upper rotating chuck and a lower rotating chuck, the data processing center comprises a PID controller, the input end of the PID controller is connected with the detector, and the output end of the PID controller is connected with the upper lifting chuck and the lower lifting chuck. In the process of drawing the optical fiber base material, a detector finds a detection point at the slope position of the base material, and the detected outer diameter and the up-down chuck simultaneously carry out PID (proportion integration differentiation) associated control. The invention can make the control response of the outer diameter of the preform stretching target quicker and more accurate by finding the detection point at the slope position of the base material and simultaneously carrying out PID association control on the numerical value of the detection point and the up-down lifting chuck, and can improve the stretching precision of the optical fiber base material and the glass utilization rate of the starting section and the ending section of the base material.

title_en: Liquid storage planting plate
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of plant water planting, in particular to a liquid storage planting plate, which comprises a planting box and a planting groove, wherein the planting box is embedded in the planting groove, a gap is formed between the bottom of the planting box and the bottom of the planting groove to form a circulation chamber, a plurality of drain holes are formed in the bottom of the planting box, liquid inlets are formed in the side walls of the planting box, the inside of the planting box is communicated with the circulation chamber through the drain holes, ports matched with the liquid inlets are formed in the side walls of the planting groove, and the ports, the liquid inlets and the drain holes are sequentially communicated to form a rain curtain liquid guide channel. According to the invention, the drain holes are formed in the planting plate to increase the fluidity of the nutrient solution, and the nutrient solution can be uniformly distributed, so that the nutrient solution can drop on the rhizosphere of plants in a rain curtain manner, the single use amount of the nutrient solution is reduced, the dissolved oxygen of the rhizosphere is improved, the requirement of the nutrient solution on a bottom cultivation groove is reduced, and the aim of combining water and mist is fulfilled.

title_en: Soft light bullet-proof vest core piece and manufacturing method thereof
