abstract_en: The invention provides a soft light bulletproof vest chip and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the bulletproof vest chip consists of a bulletproof layer and a buffer layer; adding a curing agent and a toughening agent into the glue solution, adopting aramid fibers to form aramid cloth through a special weaving process, and then overlapping the aramid cloth to form a bulletproof layer; when the bulletproof chip consisting of the bulletproof layer and the buffering material is impacted by a specific bullet, the sunken depth is less than 40mm, and the surface density is less than 5.5kg/m 2 The half edge of the bulletproof chip freely falls by an angle exceeding 30 degrees, and has the advantages of small recess depth, light weight and good softness.

title_en: Preparation and application method of hypoxic degradable phosphorylcholine polymer nanogel
abstract_en: A preparation method of hypoxic degradable phosphorylcholine polymer nanogel comprises the steps of firstly preparing a hypoxic degradable cross-linking agent containing azobenzene groups by using amide reaction, and secondly reacting a phosphorylcholine zwitterion monomer and an azo type hypoxic degradable initiator in an organic solvent by using a reflux precipitation polymerization method to obtain the hypoxic degradable phosphorylcholine polymer nanogel; an application method of the hypoxia degradable phosphorylcholine polymer nanogel adopts a finished product of the hypoxia degradable phosphorylcholine polymer nanogel as a carrier and adopts the nanogel to load an anti-tumor drug to treat tumors. The finished product prepared by the invention is applied to tumor treatment, can keep high stability in the blood circulation process, has hiding capability, is not easy to be identified and phagocytized by an endothelial reticulum system, and can be quickly degraded and release loaded drugs after reaching a tumor hypoxia environment, thereby effectively killing tumor cells and providing powerful technical support for cancer treatment. The invention has good prospect.

title_en: Efficient flocculation active strain suitable for growth in northern low-temperature pond environment and application thereof
abstract_en: A high-efficiency flocculation active bacterial strain suitable for growing in northern low-temperature pond environment and an application thereof are provided, wherein the high-efficiency flocculation active bacterial strain is Bacillus megaterium SP1 which is preserved in China center for type culture Collection with the preservation number of CCTCC NO: m2015712. The high-efficiency flocculation active bacterial strain suitable for growing in the northern low-temperature pond environment is applied to fish culture. The method screens and obtains a new microbial strain suitable for growth of a northern low-temperature carp culture pond; the novel strain is applied to carp pond culture in low-temperature environment in northern areas by utilizing the characteristics of suitability for low-temperature environment growth and flocculation, and has the effects of adjusting the water quality of the culture pond and improving the culture yield.

title_en: Black phosphorus ink and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses black phosphorus ink and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: dissolving black phosphorus in a solvent to obtain a black phosphorus dispersion liquid; adding trimesic acid into the black phosphorus dispersion liquid, and obtaining the black phosphorus ink under the ultrasonic condition. According to the invention, a self-assembled molecular layer structure is formed on the surface of the black phosphorus nano structure through the hydrogen bond action between hydroxyl functional groups at the tail end of the trimesic acid, and the self-assembled structure can not only prevent the oxidation reaction of air and the black phosphorus nano structure, but also avoid stacking and sedimentation caused by Van der Waals acting force between black phosphorus layers. The prepared black phosphorus ink effectively maintains stable dispersion of a black phosphorus low-dimensional structure, has excellent processing characteristics, and shows excellent response performance in the field of printable flexible devices.

title_en: Method for manufacturing a composite component comprising a core and at least one skin region
abstract_en: A method of manufacturing a composite component comprising a core (16) and at least one skin region (20, 22) formed of a skin polymer attached thereto, the skin polymer being a low friction thermoplastic polymer, the method comprising the steps of: a) Providing a mold having a heatable mold cavity; b) Loading a core element into a mould cavity, the surface of the core element having at least one contact area provided with a plurality of anchor sites (10), and loading a skin polymer layer in powder form into the mould cavity adjacent to said contact area and embedded in the anchor sites beforehand or subsequently; c) -applying a hot-pressing step, whereby the skin polymer powder is melted to form a molten skin polymer matrix (20, 22, 32); d) A cooling step is applied whereby the skin polymer matrix solidifies to form skin areas that are mechanically engaged into the anchoring sites of the core elements forming the core. The method allows the production of lightweight composite components having excellent surface properties of skin regions.

title_en: Agricultural machinery straw bundling state video monitoring terminal equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a video monitoring terminal device for a bundling state of agricultural machinery straws, which comprises an annular rail, a rack, a camera, a conduction mechanism, a data acquisition mechanism, an anti-blocking device and a positioning and sending mechanism, wherein the positioning and sending mechanism comprises a piezoelectric generator, a storage battery, a wireless transmitting device and a controller, the piezoelectric generator is configured to send a voltage signal to the outside world when the piezoelectric generator is pressed by the rack and store the generated electric energy into the storage battery, the controller is configured to detect whether the conduction mechanism is in a conduction state, the storage battery supplies power to the wireless transmitting device and the camera when the conduction mechanism is in a disconnection state, and at the moment, a video signal of the camera is sent to the outside world through the wireless transmitting device. The invention aims to solve or at least reduce the problems that a camera of the existing bundling bin cannot move and video signals cannot be transmitted when a line is broken, and provides a video monitoring terminal device for the bundling state of straws of agricultural machinery.

title_en: Afforestation view pond structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landscaping landscape pool structure, which relates to the technical field of construction engineering, and adopts the technical scheme that: the landscape pool comprises a pool bottom and a pool wall, wherein water is filled in the landscape pool, an ornamental object protruding out of the water surface is arranged in the middle of the pool bottom, the landscape pool further comprises a rope net, one end of the rope net is connected to the pool wall, the other end of the rope net is connected to the ornamental object, the pool wall is provided with an inner cavity, an opening of the inner cavity is higher than the water surface, and a soil layer is arranged in the inner cavity; the soil layer is used for planting the lianas, and the rope net is used for the lianas to climb. The top of the pool wall is fixed with a top plate, the top plate is provided with a water leakage hole, the water leakage hole is communicated with the inner cavity, and the soil layer is located below the water leakage hole. By arranging the rope net, the landscaping landscape pool structure can provide a greening effect, can clean the lianas and enables the plants to continuously have a better greening effect; through setting up the hole that leaks, the brick layer of permeating water, the soil horizon does benefit to the existence of liana.

title_en: Rat hyperlipidemia model feed and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of experimental animals, and particularly relates to a preparation method of a rat hyperlipidemia model feed, which comprises the steps of accurately weighing basic feed, 1.25% of cholesterol and 0.2% of thiouracil for mixing; adding oil with the heat ratio of 40% to stir; adding water, stirring and mixing, granulating by a granulator to obtain soft granulated feed; and (5) drying the water at a low temperature to obtain the model feed for the rat hyperlipidemia. The invention also provides a rat hyperlipidemia model feed and application thereof. The invention reduces the content of cholesterol, reduces the content of bile salts and thiouracil, and the rat hyperlipidemia model feed construction model provided by the invention accords with the human pathogenesis of hyperlipidemia, and accelerates the model construction process and shortens the experimental period on the basis of ensuring the success rate of modeling, thereby improving the experimental efficiency. In addition, the rat hyperlipidemia model feed provided by the invention enables rats to eat freely without the need of gastric lavage, so that the feed not only accords with animal ethics, but also saves the labor cost for implementing gastric lavage.

title_en: Automatic cement floor grooving machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of grooving machines, in particular to an automatic cement floor grooving machine. The positioning trolley and the grooving trolley are arranged in front of and behind each other, the positioning trolley is fixedly connected with a supporting column, a signal emitter is arranged on the supporting column, a signal receiver is arranged on the grooving trolley, the signal receiver and the signal emitter are correspondingly arranged at the same height position, the signal receiver can receive signals sent by the signal emitter, the grooving trolley is provided with a grooving module and a control module, and the control module is electrically connected with the grooving module, the signal receiver and the grooving trolley respectively. The invention can automatically complete positioning grooving, improves the working efficiency and quality of grooving, releases manpower, has straighter grooving, adjustable grooving depth and meets different use requirements, and the movable wheels adopt Mecanum wheels, so that the device can move more flexibly and accurately.

title_en: A filter equipment for feed-grade protein peptide
abstract_en: The invention discloses a filtering device for feed-grade protein peptide, which comprises a shell, wherein a mounting frame is fixed in the shell, a filtering membrane is fixed on the mounting frame, a plurality of supporting arms are axially connected with the mounting frame, the supporting arms are in sliding contact with the filtering membrane, elastic pieces are connected in front of the supporting arms and the mounting frame, a waterproof motor is further installed on the shell through a hydraulic cylinder, a plurality of scraping plates are installed on the waterproof motor, the scraping plates are in sliding contact with the filtering membrane, a backflushing nozzle is further installed in the shell, and the backflushing nozzle and the supporting arms are positioned on the same side of the filtering membrane. The invention can improve the defects of the prior art, realize the online cleaning of the filtering membrane in the filtering process, reduce the blocking rate of the filtering membrane and prolong the service life of the filtering membrane.

title_en: Fruit size sorting equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fruit size sorting device, comprising: the fruit sorting machine comprises a support frame, a fruit feeding vibration mechanism, a fruit sorting mechanism and a fruit grading and feeding mechanism; the lower fruit vibrating mechanism is rotatably arranged on the supporting frame; the fruit sorting mechanism is connected with the fruit discharging vibration mechanism and is obliquely arranged relative to the horizontal direction; the fruit grading and blanking mechanism is communicated with the fruit sorting mechanism and is used for grading and collecting the fruits sorted by the fruit sorting mechanism. The fruit size sorting equipment disclosed by the invention realizes high-efficiency automatic grading screening of fruits, has high production efficiency and greatly saves manpower.

title_en: Method, device and system for creating subjects for simulated shooting training
abstract_en: The application relates to a method, a device and a system for creating a simulated shooting training subject, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a background picture or a background video and a target picture; acquiring a first effect of the background element hit by the bullet and a second effect of the target element hit by the bullet; embedding the target picture into a background picture or a background video to form a training background; providing a visual area, and displaying a training background on the visual area; on the visualization area, a first corresponding relation between the first effect and the first area corresponding to the background element is established, and a second corresponding relation between the second effect and the second area corresponding to the target element is established. The application is helpful for improving the level of correlation of people who need to master shooting skills.

title_en: Quartz glass crucible and method for producing same
abstract_en: The present invention provides a silica glass crucible comprising a bottom part, a curved part and a straight body part, wherein the silica glass crucible has an outer layer made of opaque silica glass containing bubbles and an inner layer made of transparent silica glass, the outer layer is made of the same kind of raw material powder or two or more different kinds of raw material powder and has two or more parts divided by a content density of the bubbles, and the bubble content density of two adjacent parts of the outer layer is defined such that the bubble content density of a part a having a high bubble content density is d  a  (pcs/mm  3  ) And d represents a bubble content density of the portion b having a low bubble content density  b  (pcs/mm  3  ) When the bubble content density in the adjacent two portions is different from each other, D = (D)  a  ‑d  b  )/d  b  Is more than 10 percent. Thereby providing a silica glass crucible in which each part in the outer layer of the silica glass crucible can have different functions.

title_en: Label placing device and label placing method
abstract_en: The invention provides a label placing device and a label placing method, comprising a label storage mechanism, a first label transfer mechanism, a second label transfer mechanism and a third label transfer mechanism, wherein the label storage mechanism is provided with a plurality of label stacking positions and corresponding label outlets which are in one-to-one correspondence with cup molds on a cup manufacturing mold, the first label transfer mechanism is provided with a plurality of first label sucking mechanisms which are in one-to-one correspondence with the label outlets in number and arrangement positions, and the first label sucking mechanisms are used for labeling the side surfaces of the cups.

title_en: Atomizing disinfection device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disinfection instruments, in particular to an atomization disinfection device which comprises a slide rail, wherein an atomizer is connected to the slide rail in a sliding manner, the atomizer is connected with a power mechanism for driving the atomizer to move, the atomizer is connected with a cleaning broom for cleaning excrement, one end of the slide rail is provided with a platform for an animal to stand, and the atomizer is initially positioned at the other end of the slide rail. The invention is suitable for sterilizing the breeding house, does not need to manually push the sterilizing machine to move, can clean excrement while sterilizing, and solves the problem of troublesome operation when sterilizing the breeding house at present.

title_en: Prefabricated wallboard clamping device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a prefabricated wallboard clamping device, which relates to the field of prefabricated wallboard processing and comprises a first mounting plate, a fixing assembly, a transferring assembly and a water spraying assembly, wherein the fixing assembly is fixedly arranged on one side of the first mounting plate, the transferring assembly is arranged on the first mounting plate, and the water spraying assembly is arranged beside the transferring assembly.

title_en: Composition for improving memory, soft capsule and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a composition for improving memory, a soft capsule and a preparation method thereof, wherein the composition comprises fish oil extract, phosphatidylserine, ginkgo leaf extract, vegetable oil and beeswax, the soft capsule can rapidly pass through blood brain barrier and enter the brain, and can relieve brain capillary smooth muscle cells, increase brain blood supply, improve brain blood oxygen content and DHA content, effectively improve memory, and simultaneously can play roles in regulating emotion and improving sleep quality, and is especially suitable for brain workers and elderly people with brain function degeneration.

title_en: Medical neutral borosilicate glass melting furnace capable of homogenizing and clarifying
abstract_en: The invention provides a medical neutral borosilicate glass melting furnace capable of homogenizing and clarifying, wherein a row or a plurality of rows of bubbling systems are arranged at the bottom of the glass melting furnace; a discharging kiln bank is arranged at the downstream of the bubbling system; the bubbling system and the bubble discharging weir are arranged along the vertical direction of the longitudinal central line of the glass melting furnace; the middle of the bubble discharging kiln bank is provided with a perforated brick, the bottom of the bubble discharging kiln bank is provided with a kiln bank cushion brick, kiln bank tiling bricks are arranged on the two sides of the upper and lower positions of the perforated brick, a cooling water bag is placed in the middle of the perforated brick, and the homogenization and clarification of the medicinal neutral borosilicate glass liquid are realized by the bubbling system and the bubble discharging kiln bank together. Compared with the existing vertical stirring system of the melting furnace and the bubble discharging weir built by the inverted U-shaped bricks, the invention can effectively solve the problems of homogenization and subsequent clarification caused by higher viscosity of the medicinal neutral borosilicate glass liquid, and realizes the aims of energy conservation and efficiency improvement in the production process of the medicinal neutral borosilicate glass.

title_en: Material increasing and decreasing manufacturing device and material increasing and decreasing composite manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an increased and decreased material manufacturing device and an increased and decreased material composite manufacturing method thereof, which comprise a base body, wherein a rotating platform with 3 degrees of freedom, an SLM laser scanning device and an ultrafast laser polishing device which can move with single degree of freedom, a high-speed numerical control processing unit with 2 translational degrees of freedom, a high-precision three-dimensional vision measuring device and a radiation flaw detection system are arranged on the base body. The device realizes the alternate laser additive manufacturing, high-speed numerical control cutting processing and ultrafast laser polishing surface treatment in one device, thereby realizing the dimensional accuracy and the surface roughness equivalent to those of a processing center, realizing the manufacture of a high-precision inner cavity structure and a conformal channel which can not be realized by the processing center, successfully integrating the free manufacturing of the laser additive manufacturing, the high-speed high-precision manufacturing of the processing center and the ultrafast laser polishing surface treatment into a whole, and improving the comprehensive performance of produced parts.

title_en: Curing agent stirring system and curing agent stirring method
abstract_en: A curing agent agitation system comprising: the connecting rod assembly comprises an upper support and a lower support which are arranged on the screw rod, a connecting rod contraction arm connected with the upper support and the lower support, and a mounting block connected with the connecting rod contraction arm and used for mounting a workpiece to be moved; wherein the link retraction arm expands as the distance between the upper support and the lower support approaches and contracts as the distance between the upper support and the lower support becomes larger; the stirring container is used for containing a container to be stirred with the slurry; the stirring assembly is arranged in the stirring container and is used for stirring the mixed slurry in the stirring container; and the conveying assembly comprises a conveying pipe for conveying the curing agent into the stirring container, and the conveying pipe is arranged on the mounting block.

title_en: Centrifugal ridging seeder and seeding quantity feedback control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a centrifugal ridging seeder and a seeding quantity feedback control method, wherein the relation S ═ f (n) between the rotating speed of a seeding unit and the number of seeding grains in unit time is determined through tests according to S 0 ＝f(n 0 ) Calculating the initial seed-metering device rotating speed S 0 And drives the centrifugal seed sowing device to rotate and calculate the current driving speed V of the ridger Measuring 2 pi rA/a according to the current driving speed V of the ridger Measuring Obtaining the seed number n of the current travelling speed of the ridger Theory of things ＝V Measuring /l 0 Then obtaining S from S ═ f (n) Theory of things Measuring the number n of the seed-metering grains Measuring B, mixing n with Measuring And the theoretical seed number n Theory of things Comparing; the running speed of the seeder and the seed feeding amount of the seed feeding port are detected by setting the seed distance, and the rotating speed of the stepping motor is changed in real time according to the relation between the working rotating speed of the seed sowing device and the seed feeding amount of the seed sowing in unit time, so that the precision control of the sowing amount of the centrifugal ridging seeder is realized, and the seeding is more uniform.

title_en: Microcapsule for embedding liquid grease and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a microcapsule for embedding liquid grease by taking sodium alginate/chitosan as a shell material and a preparation method thereof. The microcapsule uses liquid oil as core material, water-soluble sodium alginate and Ca 2+ And (3) performing crosslinking to obtain an intermediate layer, performing crosslinking of chitosan and water-soluble sodium alginate to obtain an outer shell layer, and preparing the microcapsule by using a microcapsule granulator. The average particle size of the microcapsule prepared by the invention is about 500 mu m, the microcapsule presents an obvious multilayer structure, has excellent mechanical property, oxidation resistance and slow release performance, realizes the controllable load of liquid grease, realizes the effective protection of functional grease by natural, nontoxic and degradable natural food packaging materials, and replaces petroleum-based synthetic plastics.

title_en: A algae feed cutting machine for chicken feed processing
abstract_en: The invention provides an algae feed cutting machine for chicken feed processing, and relates to the technical field of aquatic plant feed crushing. According to the invention, the aquatic weeds are cut by the first cutting knife and the second cutting knife in the rotation process of the stirring shaft, and the arc surface opening edges move towards each other to compress and cut the aquatic weeds, so that a better aquatic weed cutting effect is achieved, and the problem of huge engineering quantity of aquatic weeds due to large demand of aquatic weeds in a farm is solved.

title_en: Key cooling and demoulding mode
abstract_en: The present invention provides a key cooling and demolding method, which comprises: a key product, and there is a demoulding edging formed together at the leftover of the key product, this is to avoid tearing and causing the key product to damage because of the insufficient membrane thickness of the leftover when demold, and make by at least one vacuum cooling demoulding tool with the same size of shaping male mold button made of high coefficient of thermal conductivity material, this can fully laminate the inner wall of the key product and set up the vacuum suction pipe and cooling water inlet pipe in this tool, use the high thermal conductivity of the high coefficient of thermal conductivity material and double cooling of the cooling water inlet pipe to achieve the material expansion, soft rot produced when the fast local cooling of its key product because of high-temperature solidification; and the mode of sucking air comprehensively in vacuum is used for demoulding, and the damage of the key product caused by uneven force application during demoulding can be avoided: the key cooling demoulding mode can effectively improve the demoulding yield and the demoulding efficiency.

title_en: Adjustable film pasting mechanism for processing solar panel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a debugged film sticking mechanism for processing a solar panel, which comprises a base, a mounting frame and a box body, wherein one end of the top end of the base is provided with a mounting plate, a control box is arranged above one side of the mounting plate, a first mounting rod is arranged above the other side of the mounting plate, a disc is arranged on one side, away from the mounting plate, of the first mounting rod, a first rotating shaft is arranged on the front surface of the disc, a driving motor is arranged at the top end of the base at the bottom end of the first rotating shaft, a second rotating shaft is arranged at the output end of the driving motor, and a belt is arranged between the second rotating. According to the solar panel, the bearing plate, the push block, the metal rope, the second hydraulic telescopic rod and the first hydraulic oil pump are installed, the first hydraulic oil pump is used for driving the second hydraulic telescopic rod to stretch and retract, the second hydraulic telescopic rod is used for driving the push block to move up and down, and then the push block drags the bearing plate to move up and down through the metal rope, so that the position of the solar panel can be conveniently adjusted according to the size of the solar panel.

title_en: Method for simultaneous closed-loop control of gas assist and gas back-pressure in an injection molding process in relation to plastic melt pressure and plastic melt flow position
abstract_en: A controller for an injection molding system is in communication with a melt flow control unit, a gas assist control unit, and a gas backpressure control unit. The controller may implement real-time adjustment of the gas assist pressure and/or gas backpressure based on melt pressure or flow front position.

title_en: Efficient soil pollution treatment restoration equipment and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of soil pollution remediation, in particular to a high-efficiency soil pollution treatment remediation device and a method thereof, wherein the device comprises a shell, a bottom plate, wheels, a charging box, a spraying device, a soil crusher, a power supply pack, a heating and stirring device and a discharging device; through the setting of above structure, can place the agitator tank with the material, the agitator tank can preheat the material, and the charging box can seal before the material gets into rabbling mechanism simultaneously, can reduce scattering and disappearing of heat in the rabbling mechanism greatly, also can accelerate the process of melting of material, and the bottom plate front end is provided with soil breaker and makes soil renovate, is favorable to sprinkler to make soil pollution administer repair equipment production efficiency improve.

title_en: Auxiliary device for injection molding holes
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of injection molding, and discloses an auxiliary device for injection molding holes, which comprises a base, an upper die and a lower die, wherein a fixed frame is fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the base, a slide rail is transversely and fixedly arranged at the top of the fixed frame, a transverse moving mechanism is arranged inside the slide rail, a first air cylinder is fixedly arranged on the lower side of the slide rail, a fixed seat is fixedly arranged at the tail end of a piston rod of the first air cylinder, a first motor is fixedly arranged on the lower surface of the fixed seat, a punching head is detachably arranged at the tail end of an output shaft of the first motor, the lower die is fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the base, the upper die is positioned on the upper surface of the lower die, the right side walls of the upper die. This auxiliary device in injection moulding hole can accomplish automatically and open last mould and lower mould and expose its inside mould, also can clear up the piece in shaping downthehole portion simultaneously, has reduced staff's intensity of labour.

title_en: Foam concrete, preparation method thereof and composite material
abstract_en: The invention relates to foam concrete, a preparation method thereof and a composite material. The preparation raw material of the foam concrete comprises the following components in parts by weight: 621-750 parts of cement; 212-280 parts of fly ash; 30-70 parts of a composite foaming agent; 20-45 parts of a silane-based water repellent; 35-65 parts of propenyl ether copolymer. The foam concrete has the characteristics of light weight, high strength, fire resistance and hydrophobicity. The composite material can stabilize the dry density even at 300kg/m 3 ‑500kg/m 3 Within the range and simultaneously achieves the compressive strength of 3MPa to 5 MPa.

title_en: DLP (digital light processing) type 3D printing photocuring material with gradual color change and anodic oxidation effect imitation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of 3D printing, and particularly relates to a DLP type 3D printing photocuring material with gradual color change and an anodic oxidation effect imitation effect, which comprises the following raw materials, by mass, 10-30 parts of high-strength aliphatic polyurethane acrylate, 10-30 parts of high-toughness aliphatic polyurethane acrylate, 3-10 parts of a monofunctional radical acrylate monomer, 3-10 parts of a difunctional radical acrylate monomer, 1-5 parts of a pigment, 1-10 parts of 2,4, 6-trimethylbenzoyl-diphenylphosphine oxide, 1-10 parts of interference color aluminum paste, 1-10 parts of chameleon interference type pearl powder, 1-10 parts of UV curable cellulose ester resin, 1-10 parts of non-floating resin coated aluminum paste, 1-10 parts of electroplated silver resin and 1-10 parts of an anti-settling auxiliary agent. The invention combines two effects of the gradual change and the anodic oxidation effect imitation to achieve the appearance effects of high metal texture, dazzle color and gradual change, and simultaneously has excellent mechanical property and good storage stability of the toner.

title_en: Concrete mixing processing machine with quantitative feeding mechanism
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of concrete processing, in particular to a concrete mixing processing machine with a quantitative feeding mechanism, which comprises a device main body, wherein the device main body comprises a mixing box, a motor and a discharge door, a feeding mechanism is arranged in the mixing box and comprises a fixing groove, a positioning hole, a separation baffle and a fixing sleeve, feeding holes are formed in two sides of one end of the mixing box, the separation baffle is formed in each feeding hole, the positioning hole is formed in one side close to each of the two groups of feeding holes, the separation baffle is inserted into each positioning hole, and one end of each of the two groups of separation baffles extends to the inside of the fixing groove. According to the invention, the partition plate, the first connecting rod, the telescopic rod and the telescopic cylinder are arranged, and the telescopic rod and the telescopic cylinder are mutually matched, so that the inner part of the device is added through the feeding port, the device is more convenient to use, the device is further filled better, and the convenience in use of the device is increased.

title_en: Intelligent cup manufacturing auxiliary device convenient for demolding
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cup body mold manufacturing equipment, and discloses an intelligent auxiliary device for manufacturing a cup convenient to demold. This auxiliary device is made to cup of drawing of patterns of being convenient for of intelligence, the drawing of patterns of being convenient for avoids the drawing of patterns in-process because the improper damage that causes the mould product of drawing of patterns, the break-make electricity of electro-magnet intermittent type nature, and the inside magnet of expansion block one changes the expansion block extension state apart from the distance of magnetic pole one, reaches the effect in the corner of automatic reciprocating vibration scraping mould bottom, avoids the mould bottom to mould plastics and remains the influence production.

title_en: Disease-resistant planting method for Chinese roses
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disease-resistant planting method of Chinese roses, which comprises the following steps: a. preparation before planting: selecting land with soil depth of 70-90 cm, smooth topography and water source as planting land, and installing a greenhouse according to requirements; b. digging a pit of about 50cm, filling a black soil layer of 20-40cm into the pit, then spreading a self-made base fertilizer with the thickness of 2cm on the black soil, throwing a planting matrix on the upper layer of the self-made base fertilizer until gullies are filled with the planting matrix, finally covering the upper surface with a breathable film with a plurality of holes, and covering the surface of the breathable film with straws; c. treating seedlings; d. planting: and c, planting the seedlings in the step c in soil, removing the breathable films and the straws on the surfaces of the breathable films by planting money, watering and fertilizing, and regularly trimming branches and leaves. Through the mode, the disease-resistant planting method of the Chinese roses can improve the disease resistance of the Chinese roses in the planting process and improve the yield and the flower quality.

title_en: Preparation method of high-voltage and ultrahigh-voltage cable insulating material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a high-voltage and ultrahigh-voltage cable insulating material, which comprises the following steps: (1) compressing ethylene monomer, polymerizing the ethylene monomer into low-density polyethylene at high pressure in a reactor, separating the low-density polyethylene by a high-pressure separator and a low-pressure separator, cooling the low-density polyethylene, directly feeding the low-density polyethylene into a single-screw extruder, adding a liquid antioxidant, uniformly dispersing the liquid antioxidant in the low-density polyethylene, filtering the low-density polyethylene by a high-mesh filter screen, and granulating to obtain the low-density polyethylene containing the antioxidant; (2) dedusting and grading the antioxidant-containing low-density polyethylene, adding a cross-linking agent by adopting a post-permeation method, fully stirring, placing in an absorption bin for heat preservation, and then cooling, dedusting, removing impurities and filtering with metal to obtain the high-voltage and ultrahigh-voltage cable insulation material. The method provided by the invention avoids secondary melt processing of low-density polyethylene, reduces thermal aging of resin, improves cleanliness and stability of the insulating material, and has the advantages of high production efficiency, low cost and convenience in popularization and application.

title_en: Portable ultralow-capacity spraying device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable ultra-low volume spraying device, belongs to the technical field of ultra-low volume spraying, and mainly solves the technical problems of limited operation range, heavy volume, high manufacturing cost, small application range and the like of the conventional ultra-low volume sprayer. The technical scheme of the invention is as follows: a portable ultra-low capacity spraying device comprises a medicine box and two groups of spray gun devices; the medical kit rear side is equipped with two sets of braces rings, medical kit inner chamber upper portion is equipped with the stock solution storehouse, medical kit inner chamber lower part is equipped with the battery compartment, be equipped with lithium polymer battery in the battery compartment, the medical kit top surface is equipped with the medicine mouth that adds that is linked together with the stock solution storehouse, the medical kit lateral wall is equipped with the liquid outlet that is linked together with the stock solution storehouse and the power source of lithium polymer battery electrical connection. The invention has the advantages of small volume, light weight, fine atomization, long spraying distance, no limitation of an alternating current power supply, low manufacturing cost and the like.

title_en: Automatic seeder with adjustable seeding distance
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic seeder with adjustable seeding distance, which relates to the technical field of particle seed seeder equipment and comprises a base frame, wherein a hopper and three conveying pipes are fixedly arranged on the top side of the base frame through a support frame, discharging mechanisms are arranged on the three conveying pipes, two idler wheels and three cams are rotatably arranged on the bottom side of the base frame through a central rotating shaft, and a plurality of arc-shaped spokes are uniformly and rotatably arranged on one side of each idler wheel through a plurality of fixing shafts. The invention has reasonable structure and simple operation, the three material conveying pipes are arranged for sowing simultaneously, the discharging mechanism can release seeds for one time by rotating the cam for one circle, the sowing distance is the outer circumference of the roller, the outer circumference of the roller is changed by adjusting the distance between one end of the arc spokes and the central rotating shaft, the longitudinal sowing distance is adjusted, and the distance between the three material conveying pipes, namely the sowing row distance, is adjusted by the distance adjusting cross rod.

title_en: Anti-dazzle glass, production method and device thereof, and electronic display device with anti-dazzle glass
abstract_en: The invention relates to anti-dazzle glass, a production method and a device thereof, and an electronic display device with the glass, wherein the production method comprises an anti-dazzle glass original sheet production stage, and comprises the following steps: refining to form a glass fluid; float drawing to form a glass blank plate; carrying out anti-dazzle treatment on the glass blank plate to obtain an anti-dazzle glass blank plate; and further cooling and cleaning to obtain the anti-dazzle glass sheet. According to the invention, the anti-dazzle treatment step is advanced from the glass sheet processing stage to the glass sheet production stage, and special anti-dazzle liquid medicine heating equipment is not required to be arranged at the glass sheet processing stage, so that the anti-dazzle treatment process is simplified, and the equipment investment is reduced; and compared with the situation that anti-dazzle treatment errors occur in the glass sheet processing stage and then are abandoned, the processes of cutting, edging, drilling, toughening and silk-screen printing of the glass sheet which may be generated in the stage are saved, and the cost investment in the stage is greatly reduced.

title_en: Releasable cable tie
abstract_en: Releasable cable ties and methods are disclosed that provide a molded one-piece thermoplastic elongated planar strap for tying electrical cables, and a plurality of tie teeth formed on one side of the strap for engaging a locking head formed at one end of the strap. The novel releasable latch on the locking head provides a large and wide thumb pad having a width of at least 95% of the width of the strap, and a forefinger back plate located below the thumb pad and having a width and length at least as great as the width and height of the thumb pad.

title_en: High-pressure forming equipment and method for perforated pipe
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-pressure forming device for a perforated pipe in the technical field of pipe processing equipment, which comprises a workbench and a frame, wherein the frame is fixedly arranged on the outer wall of the top of the workbench, a lower die is fixedly arranged on the outer wall of the top of the workbench, the inner wall of the top of the frame is fixedly connected with an upper die through an electric telescopic rod, the outer wall of the center of the top of the upper die is provided with an opening, hydraulic cylinders are respectively fixed on the inner walls of the left side and the right side of the frame, a hydraulic rod at one end of each hydraulic cylinder close to the lower die is fixedly connected with a piston block, the piston block is positioned in the inner cavity of the lower die, a shielding device is arranged on the inner wall of the top of the upper die, the shielding device is inserted into a hole of the pipe, the hole of the pipe is shielded, so that liquid added into the inner cavities of the upper die and, the pipe is ensured not to be damaged during high-pressure forming.

title_en: Low-dielectric-property polyimide composite film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-dielectric-property polyimide composite film and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of polyimide materials. The low-dielectric-property polyimide composite film is obtained by imidizing a polymer with a structure shown in a formula (I) and a low-polarity polyimide polymer added with a specific amount of oxide after block polymerization, has better force performance and meets the requirement on peel strength in the industry on the premise of not coating a thermoplastic layer, and simultaneously obtains low dielectric property (dielectric loss factor is less than or equal to 0.005 and the electrical constant is less than or equal to 2.9 under the test frequency of 10 GHz) and meets the signal transmission requirement under the high-frequency condition. Wherein the repeating unit represented by the formula (I) has the following structure: in the formula (I), X is CH 3 Or CF 3 And n is an integer greater than or equal to 1.

title_en: Artificial fish spawning site at reservoir area dry branch junction
abstract_en: The invention provides an artificial fish spawning site at a main and branch junction of a reservoir area, which comprises a dam, a reservoir area main flow, branches, an artificial spawning site and a driving oil cylinder; the tributary is located in the reservoir area of the dam, and the artificial spawning site is located at the intersection of the tributary and the reservoir area main stream. The artificial spawning substrate is controlled to ascend and descend in the vertical direction by constructing the elevator capable of adapting to water level amplitude, the spawning water depth of the fishes in the spawning period is ensured to be in an appropriate range, the requirements of the native fishes on the spawning water depth, the spawning flow rate and the spawning substrate are met by remolding the bottom material of a river bed, configuring the artificial spawning substrate in an appropriate proportion and assisting with hydrophilic beauty of submerged plants and emergent plants, and the artificial spawning substrate has the characteristics of flexibility in operation, portability and strong adaptability and has strong popularization for the construction of the spawning sites of the fishes at the dry section and the branch junction section of the reservoir area.

title_en: Cultivation method of tree-shaped hydrangea macrophylla
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cultivation method of a tree-shaped hydrangea macrophylla, which comprises the following steps: (1) the method has the advantages that the production efficiency of the tree-shaped hydrangea macrophylla cultivated by the method is high, the cultivation technology is simple and convenient, large-scale production can be carried out, the supply of finished flowers is greatly increased, the market demand is met, the industrial structure of the hydrangea macrophylla is optimized, and the product profit is improved.

title_en: Air supply device, control method and system of air supply device and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides an air supply device, a control method and a control system of the air supply device and a readable storage medium. The air supply device includes: a base; the fan assembly is detachably arranged on the base and is suitable for rotating relative to the base to form airflow, an air tunnel is formed inside the fan assembly and is suitable for enabling the airflow to pass through and changing the flow rate of the airflow, and a functional assembly is arranged in the air tunnel; the control device is configured to determine an air supply mode and/or a function mode according to a control instruction; the fan assembly is controlled to work according to an air supply mode, and/or the functional assembly is controlled to work according to a functional mode. The user can control the air supply device to execute different air supply modes according to different requirements. The air supply device can realize different auxiliary functions according to different requirements of users in the working process.

title_en: Method for preparing high-strength light gypsum block by using phosphogypsum
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of solid waste recycling and the technical field of building material production, in particular to a method for preparing a high-strength light gypsum block by using phosphogypsum, which mainly comprises the following steps: drying and dehydrating phosphogypsum to obtain semi-hydrated phosphogypsum; adding a certain amount of water into the semi-hydrated phosphogypsum, uniformly stirring, and pressing a stirred material into a gypsum panel; preparing foaming semi-hydrated phosphorus gypsum slurry; erecting two gypsum panels at intervals relatively, and pouring foaming semi-hydrated phosphogypsum slurry between the two gypsum panels; after the foaming semi-hydrated phosphogypsum slurry is solidified, the high-strength light gypsum building block with a compact gypsum layer on the surface layer and a loose gypsum layer in the middle is obtained through natural drying. The preparation method of the invention does not need to use a mould for forming, does not need to carry out mould unloading operation after the gypsum slurry is solidified and generates strength, improves the production continuity, and the prepared gypsum block has compact surface layer structure, high mechanical strength and small integral density, and belongs to a high-strength light wall material.

title_en: Antibacterial biodegradable composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a biodegradable composite material and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the composite material is prepared by mixing the following raw materials in percentage by weight: 20-65% of poly (butylene adipate)/terephthalate), 10-30% of polycaprolactone, 5-30% of polylactic acid, 5-20% of compatilizer, 5-8% of plasticizer, 3-8% of tackifier, 5-50% of nano plant fiber powder and 0.5-1.5% of organic antibacterial agent. The invention adopts the synergistic effect of the degradable plastic, the nano plant fiber powder and the organic antibacterial agent to carry out antibacterial modification on the biodegradable plastic, and endows the product with antibacterial and bactericidal effects, so that the product can inhibit the propagation of microorganisms and keep the surface of the material clean, and the product has the effect of prolonging the food preservation period when being used for food packaging, can also be used for packaging medical products, and expands the application range of the degradable material.

title_en: Method for controlling hatching speed of embryonated eggs
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for controlling hatching speed of embryonated eggs, which comprises a box body, wherein a motor is arranged at the bottom end inside the box body, a rotating main shaft is arranged at the upper end of the motor, a plurality of groups of uniformly arranged turnover structures are arranged on the rotating main shaft, an oblique caliber is arranged at the upper end of the rotating main shaft, the outer part of the oblique caliber is mutually connected with an occlusion caliber of a central connecting disc arranged at one side, and the rotating main shaft drives the central connecting disc occluded with the oblique caliber to rotate and enables the central connecting disc to be obliquely arranged. According to the method for controlling the hatching speed of the embryonated egg, the egg turning function of a small hatching structure can be realized for a plurality of groups of internal turning structures, the low working efficiency of manual egg turning is avoided, the hatching rate and the hatching speed of fertilized eggs can be ensured, a safe and healthy hatching environment is provided for the embryonated egg, a proper hatching temperature is provided for the embryonated egg, the embryonic development of the embryonated egg is facilitated, the egg turning time is convenient to adjust, and the overall hatching rate is improved.

title_en: Egg liquid separation foaming device for pastry processing
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of cake dough making, and particularly relates to an egg-liquid separation foaming device for processing dough points, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a first mixing barrel and a second mixing barrel are fixedly installed at the top of the bottom plate, two supporting plates are fixedly installed at the top of the bottom plate, a same material receiving groove with an opening on one side is rotatably installed at one side, close to each other, of the two supporting plates, a first guide groove is fixedly installed at one side, open to the material receiving groove, the bottom of the first guide groove is provided with a plurality of linearly-arranged liquid dropping holes, the first guide groove is communicated with the material receiving groove, two connecting plates are rotatably installed at two sides of the first guide groove, and the same second guide groove is rotatably installed at one side, close to each other. The egg white and yolk separator has high practicability, can automatically and fully automatically separate egg white and yolk of a large number of eggs, and can perform foaming treatment on the separated egg white and yolk, so that the working intensity of a user is reduced.

title_en: Manual formula elevating gear for new material processing production
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lifting device for manual new material processing production, which adopts the technical scheme that: the cutting device comprises a lifting device, a cutting device and a cutting table, wherein the lifting device is fixedly installed on the inner wall of one end of the cutting table, the cutting table is close to a fixed installation support at the top of one end of the lifting device, the support is close to a fixed installation chute at one end of the lifting device, the lifting device is fixedly installed at one end of the chute, the cutting device is fixedly installed at the bottom of one end, away from the chute, of the lifting device, the lifting device comprises a bearing, the bearing is fixedly installed on the inner wall of one end of the cutting table, a threaded rod is connected to the inner wall of the bearing, an internal thread cylinder is fixedly installed on the outer wall of one end of the threaded rod, a: the novel material cutting device is favorable for realizing free up-and-down movement of the cutting device, so that the novel material cutting effect is good, and convenience is provided for subsequent processing of the novel material.

title_en: Automatic mold opening and closing mold for V-shaped metal rubber spring and automatic mold opening and closing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic die opening and closing die of a V-shaped metal rubber spring and an automatic die opening and closing method thereof, wherein the automatic die opening and closing die comprises an upper die assembly and a lower die assembly, wherein the upper die assembly comprises a top plate, a rubber injection plug, a rubber injection cylinder, a middle die, an upper insert and a middle die heating ring; the lower die assembly comprises a bottom die, a supporting plate, two side inserts, a lower insert and a split die combination; the floating plate also comprises two floating plates, four wedge blocks and four wedge grooves; the floating plate vertically moves in the supporting plate to drive the front and rear petals to vertically move, the wedge blocks are arranged at the positions of the two adjacent petals, the supporting plate drives the petal combination to be vertically separated from the bottom die, and the front and rear petals are combined by the horizontal movement under the action of the wedge blocks and the vertical downward movement of the floating plate to realize the separation from the cavity. The invention greatly reduces the labor intensity of operation; the mold is automatically opened, the mold cavity is automatically separated, the product is directly taken out, the product has no appearance damage, and the qualification rate of the product is improved; the die opening and closing time of the die is short, and the production efficiency of the product is improved.

title_en: Film roll and method for manufacturing same
abstract_en: The present invention provides a film roll having excellent blocking resistance and roll offset resistance even for a film having a low elastic modulus, and a method for producing the same. The film roll of the present invention is a film roll having knurled portions at least at both ends in the width direction of the film, wherein the knurled portion is defined as a portion a, a portion on the back surface side of the film opposite to the portion a is defined as a portion B, film surfaces other than the portions a and B, which are not subjected to knurling, are defined as a surface C, and the static friction coefficients of the portions a and B are defined as a and B, respectively, so that the following relational expressions (1) and (2) are satisfied: the static friction coefficient between the surfaces C of the formula (1) is < the static friction coefficient between the part A and the part B; formula (2) a < b.

title_en: Seedling device is urged in breeding suitable for plant factory
abstract_en: The invention discloses a breeding seedling accelerating device suitable for a plant factory, relates to the technical field of planting industry, and solves the problems that the currently used seedling accelerating device does not have the functions of continuously and automatically conveying plant seeds, heating the seeds and soaking the seeds in water in the conveying process. A breeding seedling-accelerating device suitable for plant factories comprises a main frame and a water tank; a water passing cylinder is fixedly arranged on one side of the top of the main frame; the fixed headstock that is provided with of body frame top opposite side, the headstock is 90 crisscross with a water section of thick bamboo, through being provided with a transport section of thick bamboo, for the device provides the function of carrying the seed, and the setting of pond and circulating pump, for the device provides the auxiliary function who soaks the seed, utilize the circulating pump to go into a water section of thick bamboo with the log raft in the pond, utilize the quad slit to soak the seed in getting into the transport section of thick bamboo, and be provided with the heater in the heating cabinet, can heat water at hydrologic cycle's in-process, utilize bubble water and the mode of heating to awaken up the seed, for urging the seedling to provide convenience.

title_en: Preparation method of shell powder-doped lignin spraying material and application of shell powder-doped lignin spraying material in protection of citrus fruit peel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a shell powder-doped lignin spraying material and application thereof in protecting citrus fruit peel, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: the first step is as follows: cleaning the collected shells with clear water; and a sixth step: mixing the white powder obtained after calcination with calcium lignosulfonate according to a certain mass ratio, and uniformly stirring; the seventh step: and adding a certain proportion of water into the uniformly stirred powder, adding some raw material ingredients, and fully stirring to obtain the shell powder coating. The preparation method of the shell powder lignin-doped spraying material and the application of the shell powder lignin-doped spraying material in the protection of citrus fruit peels add the sodium hydroxide solution in the preparation process, and when the sodium hydroxide solution is used for cleaning the shells, organic matters on the surfaces of the shells are separated, so that resources can be reasonably used, the utilization rate of the resources is increased, and meanwhile, the cost of some fertilizers is saved.

title_en: Insulating cylinder and forming process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a molding process of an insulating cylinder, which comprises the following steps: and a glass fiber winding step, namely winding the glass fiber subjected to gum dipping on the core mold. And a surface treatment step, wherein the wound glass fiber is subjected to glue scraping and surface leveling treatment. And a protective layer winding step of winding a protective cloth tape on the glass fiber subjected to the surface treatment to form a protective layer, wherein the winding angle and the thread pitch of the protective cloth tape are determined according to the diameter of the insulating cylinder, the width of the protective cloth tape and the lap joint width. And a curing treatment step, namely putting the glass fiber wound with the protective layer and the core mold into an oven for heating and curing. And demolding, namely removing the core mold to obtain the glass fiber insulation cylinder with the surface wound with the protective layer. The invention also discloses an insulation cylinder obtained by the molding process, which comprises: the glass fiber layer and the protective layer of parcel outside the glass fiber layer, the protective layer is formed by the winding of protection strap, glass fiber layer and protective layer through once heating solidification shaping.

title_en: Bacillus subtilis, microecological preparation, feed and application of bacillus subtilis to improvement of production performance and eggshell quality of hens
abstract_en: The invention provides bacillus subtilis, a microecological preparation, a feed and application thereof in improving the production performance and the eggshell quality of breeding hens, and relates to the technical field of biology. The bacillus subtilis Liu-c1 provided by the invention is derived from traditional cheese, and the inventor adds the bacillus subtilis Liu-c1 as a microecological preparation into the daily ration of a breeding hen to research and find that the laying rate of the breeding hen is improved by 5.63%, the qualified rate of hatching eggs is improved by 9.15%, and the feed-egg ratio is reduced by 4.09%; the superfine structure of the eggshell is improved, the thickness of the eggshell is increased by 3.67 percent, the strength of the eggshell is increased by 17.21 percent, and the calcium content of the eggshell is increased by 2.34 percent; and the calcium content of the serum, the tibia and the uterus of the breeding hen are respectively increased by 11.62 percent, 5.06 percent and 19.63 percent, and the relative expression quantity of genes participating in calcium transfer and calcification in the egg shell forming process of the uterus is improved.

title_en: Construction method of indoor building
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction method of an indoor building, which comprises the following steps of; step A, preparing concrete: crushing the construction waste by using crushing equipment to obtain crushed stone, and uniformly mixing the crushed stone, cement, water and a water reducing agent by using a stirrer to prepare concrete; step B, performance enhancement: adding reinforcing fibers to the mixture and continuing to stir to obtain concrete; step C, building a wall: erecting reinforcing steel bars at the positions corresponding to the indoor walls on the construction site, and building brick walls outside the reinforcing steel bars; step D, wall blank forming: pouring concrete into the brick wall and the steel bars, and forming a wall blank after the concrete is solidified; step E, plastering: plastering the wall body by using mortar, leveling the wall surface by using putty, and then coating emulsion paint; the crushing equipment comprises a crushing device and a control device; the control device is arranged to prevent dust from leaking when the collecting box is disassembled; the crushing device is arranged to crush the construction waste better.

title_en: Heat-resistant multilayer container and method for producing same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a multilayer container comprising: an outermost layer 1 composed of a propylene-based polymer A containing, as a main component, homopolypropylene having a melt flow rate of 2.0 to 10.0g/10 minutes; an inner layer 2 composed of 50 to 99% by weight of a propylene polymer B containing as a main component a homopolypropylene having a melt flow rate of 5.0g/10 min or less and an isotactic index of 93% or more, and 1 to 50% by weight of an ethylene-alpha-olefin copolymer C; and a barrier layer 4 which accounts for 5 to 20 wt% of the entire container, wherein the ratio (L/D) of the height (L) to the diameter (D) of the container is 0.5 or more, and the volume shrinkage rate before and after heat sterilization at 121 ℃ for 30 minutes is 5% or less. The multilayer container is excellent in gloss and impact resistance, and is also compatible with retort sterilization and the like.

title_en: Rice cold-resistant agent and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of crop cultivation, relates to a rice cold-resistant agent, and particularly relates to a rice cold-resistant agent taking alfalfa and willow bark extract as cold-resistant components. A rice cold-resistant agent comprises herba Medicaginis extract and willow bark extract. Compared with the cold-resistant agent prepared by pure chemical reagents such as salicylic acid, proline and the like, the cold-resistant agent is a plant extract component, has complex components and multiple functions, and is more favorable for the comprehensive growth capacity of plants. The cold-resistant component contained in the cold-resistant agent is from the plant body, and can better enter each organ of a rice plant, improve the osmotic concentration of cells and reduce the freezing point of water in the rice body; meanwhile, the photosynthetic system efficiency and the chlorophyll content of rice leaves can be improved, so that the method can be simultaneously suitable for seed dressing of rice seeds, spraying on leaf surfaces in a seedling stage and spraying on leaf surfaces in a spike stage and a grain filling stage of late rice, the cold resistance of early rice in the seedling stage and the flowering stage of late rice is improved, and the damage of low-temperature cold damage weather to the rice is reduced.

title_en: Molded body of cellulose fiber and method for producing same
abstract_en: [ problem ] to provide a molded body of cellulose fibers having an improved tensile modulus, preferably also having an improved tensile strength, and a method for producing the same. [ solution ] A molded body X of cellulose fibers mainly comprises cellulose fibers, wherein the cellulose fibers comprise pulp P and open fibers C, and the open fibers C comprise microfibrillated cellulose. In addition, in the production of the molded article X, a slurry S of cellulose fibers is prepared from the pulp P and the opened fibers C, a wet paper is formed from the slurry S of cellulose fibers, and the wet paper is dewatered and heated under pressure. In this case, microfibrillated cellulose or microfibrillated cellulose and cellulose nanofibers are used as the open fibers C.

title_en: Method for producing glass fine particle deposit and method for producing glass base material
abstract_en: A method for producing a glass soot body, comprising: the silicone gas and the carrier gas are ejected from the center of the burner, the seal gas is ejected from the radially outer side of the ejection port of the silicone gas and the carrier gas, and the combustion gas is ejected from the radially outer side of the ejection port of the seal gas, the volume concentration (C1) of the supply volume amount per unit time of the silicone gas with respect to the sum of the supply volume amount per unit time of the silicone gas and the supply volume amount per unit time of the carrier gas is set to 10.6 vol% < C1 < 20.0 vol%, and the volume concentration (C2) of the supply volume amount per unit time of the silicone gas with respect to the sum of the supply volume amount per unit time of the silicone gas, the supply volume amount per unit time of the carrier gas, and the supply volume amount per unit time of the seal gas is set to 5.8 vol% < C2 < 10.0 vol%.

title_en: Wood surface fine machining equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a wood surface fine processing device which comprises an installation frame, a clamping mechanism, a gluing mechanism and a film covering mechanism. The invention provides a wood surface fine processing device which can solve the following problems in the wood surface fine processing process: a. when the wood is used for indoor decoration, in order to achieve indoor attractiveness and bring a comfortable environment, finish machining treatment is usually required to be performed on two sides of the wood, and the surface of the wood is smooth and flat by film coating treatment on the surface of the wood; b. the existing film covering device can only cover one side of the wood, double-side film covering needs to be carried out twice, and the end face of the finished film covering is easily scratched in the process of secondary film covering, so that the attractiveness of the surface of the wood is affected; c. most of the existing laminating devices are easy to cause uneven surface laminating and have wrinkles in the laminating process, and the laminating is not compacted.

title_en: Prevent that surperficial coarse resin lens injection moulding device who floats fine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of resin lens production, and discloses resin lens injection molding equipment for preventing rough surface from floating fibers. This prevent resin lens injection moulding equipment that fibre was floated to surface roughness drives the outer mould shell rotation through the motor, and the molten resin extrudes gas to semicircle frame center air cavity inside under the centrifugal force effect, prevents the gas interference, and interior die carrier and outer mould shell inner wall form the enclosure space symmetric distribution simultaneously, constitute a pair lens space of moulding plastics jointly, through outwards pulling out branch, make the activity arc board draw in to the center rest is inside and deviate from via outer mould shell bottom, improve drawing of patterns efficiency.

title_en: Intelligent pet nursing system
abstract_en: The application discloses smart pet care system, this smart pet care system can use the nursing application in the smart mobile phone to feed for the pet and feed water, can provide stable nursing for the pet based on the information that obtains through the monitoring pet situation simultaneously. To this end, the present application provides a smart pet care system comprising: a pet care device for feeding food and water to a pet and transmitting status information related to the pet to an external device; a smartphone that controls the pet care device based on input information from a user; and a management server which transmits care information for caring for the pet to the smart phone based on the state information and the preset setting information.

title_en: Static explosion integral pile head breaking structure with built-in annular device and construction process thereof
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a static explosion integral pile head breaking structure with a built-in annular device and a construction process thereof, belonging to the technical field of cast-in-place pile construction, comprising a steel reinforcement cage body and a pile head breaking device, wherein the pile head breaking device comprises a baffle plate, an annular pipe and a liquid injection pipe, the baffle plate is positioned in the steel reinforcement cage body and is fixedly connected with the steel reinforcement cage body, the baffle plate is positioned above the elevation position of the broken pile head, the annular pipe is positioned above the baffle plate and is connected with the baffle plate, one end of the liquid injection pipe is communicated with the annular pipe, and the other end extends out of the top of the steel reinforcement cage body; the side wall of the annular pipe is provided with an embedded hole, a splitting block is bonded in the embedded hole, and one end, far away from the axis of the annular pipe, of the splitting block is provided with a spine portion. The method has the effects of reducing the condition that the pile body cracks and improving the pile forming quality.

title_en: Device is picked to mangosteen high efficiency
abstract_en: The invention discloses a momordica grosvenori high-efficiency picking device which comprises a vehicle body and a clamping assembly, wherein the vehicle body is provided with a container, a vertical upright post is fixed on the vehicle body centerline outside the container, a vertical screw rod device is fixed in the upright post, a lifting table is movably arranged on a guide rail of the screw rod device, a screw rod of the screw rod device is in threaded connection with the lifting table and can drive the lifting table to move up and down, two mechanical arm assemblies are respectively arranged on two sides of the lifting table, the clamping assembly is arranged on the end face of one end, away from the lifting table, of each mechanical arm assembly, and the mechanical arm assemblies can control the clamping assembly to move and rotate in multiple directions. Compared with the prior art, the fruit picking machine has the advantages that the clamping is stable and reliable, the fruits are uniformly stressed, the local crushing of the fruits is avoided, and the picking and recovery efficiency is high.

title_en: Laminating roller for laminating strips
abstract_en: The invention relates to a laminating roller for laminating a strip, in particular for a continuous strip wound by a strip, wherein the laminating roller comprises a roller body rotatable about a roller axis, wherein the roller body comprises a circumferential member and a support member provided with a connection end connected to the circumferential member and a base end for coupling the laminating roller to a rotational shaft, wherein the support member is made of a flexible material allowing the circumferential member to be tilted into a tilted orientation from a neutral orientation relative to the base end, wherein the support member comprises one or more reinforcement parts reinforcing the axial stiffness of the support member from an outer radius towards an inner radius.

title_en: High-toughness polyimide sound-absorbing foam material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-toughness polyimide sound absorption foam material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the high-toughness polyimide sound absorption foam material is prepared from aromatic dianhydride, low-molecular aliphatic alcohol, polar solvent, low-molecular aromatic diamine, unvulcanized high-temperature-resistant rubber and a surfactant; the preparation process comprises the following steps: preparing a diacid diester solution, carrying out acid-base neutralization reaction, preparing a precursor solution, preparing precursor powder, preparing a foam intermediate, curing after foam and the like. The material has excellent flexibility and sound absorption performance, and can be widely applied to application fields with higher requirements on flexibility and sound absorption performance, such as ship heat insulation, pipeline heat insulation and the like.

title_en: Method for improving germination vigor of melon seeds, method for obtaining germinated melon seeds and kit
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of plant breeding, and particularly relates to a method for improving germination potential of melon seeds, a method for obtaining the germination potential melon seeds and a kit. The method comprises the following steps: (1) soaking the dried melon seeds in warm water to obtain soaked melon seeds; (2) placing the soaked melon seeds in a container, and adding pyroligneous liquor diluted by 1000 times to obtain the melon seeds treated by the pyroligneous liquor; first water absorbing materials with the thickness of 3-5mm are placed at intervals at the bottom in the container, a gap is formed between the first water absorbing materials and the bottom in the container, a second water absorbing material is flatly laid on the first water absorbing materials, and soaked melon seeds are placed on the surface of the second water absorbing material; the addition amount of the wood vinegar liquid is not more than the upper surface of the second water absorbing material; (3) culturing the melon seeds treated by the wood vinegar until sprouting. The provided method can break the dormancy of the melon seeds, improve the germination potential of the seeds and has important value in commercial seedling raising.

title_en: Pet intelligence bathing all-in-one
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent pet bathing all-in-one machine, which relates to the technical field of pet bathing, and comprises a machine body, wherein the machine body is built through a main body frame, the bottom end of the machine body is provided with a horse wheel, the top end of the machine body is provided with a top plate, two sides of the machine body are respectively provided with a side door frame, the front end of the machine body is provided with a front door frame, the front door frame is provided with a pet observation window, the front door frame is also provided with a display panel, and the front door frame is also provided with a door panel switch for opening the front door frame. The pet bathing machine has the advantages that bathing and drying are integrated, so that bathing efficiency for pets is higher, and the pet bathing machine is practical and convenient.

title_en: Plastic mold
abstract_en: The invention discloses a plastic mold which comprises a base, a lower mold base, an upper cross beam and an upper mold base, wherein the lower mold base is fixedly connected to the upper side of the base, the upper mold base is fixedly connected to the lower side of the upper cross beam, a damping assembly is arranged between the upper mold base and the lower mold base, a mold cavity is arranged on the lower mold base, two cooling chambers for cooling the mold cavity are symmetrically arranged on the inner side of the lower mold base, and turbulent flow assemblies for eliminating residual heat of the mold cavity are arranged in the two cooling chambers. The invention has reasonable design, the damping assembly is arranged, the guide pillar is abutted against the buffer plate by utilizing the downward movement of the upper die base, the buffer plate is compressed downward to ensure that the piston transmits gas to the corrugated pipe, the corrugated pipe is aerated and then has volume collision, the water in the cooling chamber surges to improve the cooling effect, and meanwhile, the downward movement speed of the piston is reduced by the pressure of the water on the corrugated pipe, so that the upper die base is protected, and the possibility of increasing the damage of the die due to the excessively severe die assembly of the upper die base and the lower die base is avoided.

title_en: Fermentation process and fermentation device of coconut shell seedling raising matrix
