abstract_en: The application discloses a fermentation process of a coconut shell seedling raising matrix in the technical field of cultivation, which specifically comprises the following steps: soaking coconut shells in 65-80 ℃ water to separate coconut fibers from the coconut shells, and crushing the coconut shells in a crusher to obtain coconut shell blocks with the particle size of less than 3 cm; step two, stacking: placing the coconut fibers and the coconut shell blocks into a fermentation device in a layered manner for layered fermentation; step three, fermentation: and (3) supplementing water to the fermentation layer, turning over the fermentation materials every period of time, continuously fermenting, taking out the fermented materials on the layer in batches according to the fermentation degree, and then compounding with other components to obtain the coconut shell seedling culture substrate. The invention separates the coconut fiber and the coconut shell, and separately ferments, and arranges the top water cavity and the bottom water cavity, thereby reducing the water supplement amount, avoiding the water drainage, and avoiding the mosquito and fly breeding problem caused by the discharge of the fermented water.

title_en: Weeding device and using method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of agricultural planting, in particular to a weeding device and a using method thereof, which comprises a weeding motor, two weeding wheels and a plurality of weeding mechanisms, the weeding machine comprises a grass storage box, a soil loosening motor, a soil loosening shaft and a plurality of soil loosening blades, wherein the weeding motor is installed on the rear side of an operation box, the output end of the weeding motor is provided with a weeding shaft, two weeding wheels are respectively sleeved on the front side and the rear side of the weeding shaft, a plurality of weeding mechanisms are respectively and uniformly installed on the outer circumferences of the two weeding wheels, the grass storage box is installed inside the operation box, the top of the grass storage box is provided with a grass storage opening, a grass discharging pipe is communicated between the bottom of the right side of the grass storage box and the bottom of the right side of the operation box, a grass discharging cover plate is covered at the right end of the grass discharging pipe, a fixing plate is arranged on the left side of the operation box, the soil loosening motor is installed on the fixing plate, the soil loosening shaft is rotatably connected with the bottom of the fixing plate, and the plurality of soil loosening blades are uniformly installed on the soil loosening shaft; it can realize weeding fast in farmland, improves the efficiency of weeding.

title_en: Hedge trimmer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hedge trimmer which is small in overall size, light in weight and high in transmission efficiency, and comprises a main handle, an auxiliary handle, a cutting mechanism, a transmission assembly and a driver for driving the cutting mechanism to operate, wherein the driver is a permanent magnet coreless motor, and one side of the main handle is provided with a rechargeable battery for supplying power to the driver.

title_en: Special fresh peanut belt cleaning device in laboratory
abstract_en: The invention discloses a special peanut cleaning device for a laboratory, which is characterized in that a box body of the special peanut cleaning device is divided into an upper feeding and discharging area, a middle cleaning area and a lower settling area, a material inlet and outlet is arranged at the lower part of the material inlet and outlet area and used for taking out or putting in the cleaning basket, the bottom of the cleaning basket is fixedly connected with the supporting plate through a self-locking device, a cleaning tank is fixedly arranged at the middle part of the cleaning area, the bottom of the cleaning tank is connected with a water collecting funnel, fixed ultrasonic device between washing tank and box, the fixed sedimentation tank upper portion intercommunication of collection water funnel bottom and settling zone, the mud water control valve is fixed to be set up at collection water funnel and sedimentation tank junction, the sedimentation tank bottom sets up the mud valve, the machinery belt cleaning device top is connected with drive arrangement, drive arrangement drives mechanical belt cleaning device round trip movement between business turn over material district upper portion and washing tank, the layer board side is connected with drive arrangement, drive arrangement drives the layer board round trip movement between business turn over material district lower part and washing tank. The deep cleaning of the peanuts is realized through two cleaning modes of mechanical cleaning and ultrasonic devices.

title_en: Method for eliminating cracks in additive manufacturing metal material
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for eliminating cracks in an additive manufacturing metal material, which comprises the following steps: and heating and insulating the additive manufacturing metal material containing the cracks, then carrying out isostatic pressing treatment at the insulation temperature, and cooling to obtain the additive manufacturing metal material with the cracks eliminated. The elimination method provided by the invention adopts a micro remelting method to form an intercrystalline liquid film, backfills cracks to form a state of coexistence of solid and liquid phases, then controls the re-solidification rate, realizes uniform solidification and shrinkage of materials, can apply isostatic pressure in the process, inhibits the generation of shrinkage cavity, finally realizes the healing of the cracks and the densification of the component, and can also improve the comprehensive mechanical property of the component.

title_en: Novel steel wire mesh framework polyethylene composite pipe sealing die device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel steel wire mesh framework polyethylene composite pipe sealing die device, which relates to the technical field of polyethylene pipe processing technology and comprises an upper die pressing plate, a lower die bottom plate, a T-shaped guide rail, an upper die, a lower die, an upper die connecting plate, a lower die connecting plate, a left die, a right die and an inclined guide pillar; the upper die pressing plate is connected with the upper die, one side of the lower die is respectively abutted against one side of the left die and one side of the right die, the other side of the right die is abutted against the other side of the left die, and one end of the lower die bottom plate is respectively connected with the lower die, the left die and the right die; the two ends of the other side of the upper die and the lower die, the other side of the left die and the other side of the right die are respectively detachably connected through upper and lower die connecting plates; the left side die and the right side die are respectively arranged on the T-shaped guide rail in a sliding mode, two inclined guide pillars are arranged in the upper die, and inclined guide holes matched with the inclined guide pillars are respectively formed in the left side die and the right side die. When the mould locking and unlocking device is used, the mould locking and unlocking efficiency is improved, and the mould is convenient to transport and hoist.

title_en: Public mould jiao kou mould benevolence integration light guide plate forming die
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the technique of light guide plate production and specifically relates to a public mould jiao kou mould benevolence integration light guide plate forming die is related to, and it includes the mounting panel, and the mounting groove has been seted up at the top of mounting panel, installs the shaping piece in the mounting groove, and the edge horizontal direction at the top of shaping piece is concave in proper order to be equipped with shaping portion, jiao kou portion, subchannel portion and sprue portion, shaping portion and the appearance looks adaptation of light guide plate. This application has the light guide plate and is difficult for producing the foreign matter because of the clearance when injection moulding, and then improves the effect of production yields.

title_en: Preparation device and preparation method of steel fiber concrete pavement slab
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation device of a steel fiber concrete pavement slab, which comprises a box body, wherein two sides of the bottom of the box body are bolted with support frames, the left side of the top of the box body is communicated with a feeding pipe, the left side of the inner cavity of the box body is bolted with a fixing plate, the right side of the fixing plate is provided with a through groove, and the inner cavity of the box body is provided with a stirring mechanism. According to the invention, through the matching of the motor, the first stirring shaft, the first gear, the movable plate and the first stirring vane, a user can conveniently drive the first stirring shaft and the first stirring vane to carry out primary stirring on various raw materials by utilizing the motor, through the matching of the second gear, the second stirring shaft and the second stirring vane, the user can conveniently drive two groups of second stirring shafts to rotate around the first stirring shaft by utilizing the rotation of the movable plate, and simultaneously drive two groups of second gears to rotate by utilizing the first gear, so that the second stirring shaft and the second stirring vane are driven to rotate simultaneously, and further, the various raw materials are fully mixed and stirred.

title_en: Tail wing stable unshelling armor-piercing bullet holder and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an empennage stable unshelling armor-piercing bullet holder and a preparation method thereof, wherein the bullet holder is formed by combining 3 carbon fiber composite material clamping flaps with the angle of 120 degrees through a hoop, tooth buds of the bullet holder are formed by processing and combining a plurality of carbon fiber mould pressing plates with different layer laying angles and layer laying thicknesses, and an outer shell is formed by compression molding of short carbon fiber prepreg yarns; the preparation method comprises the steps of bullet holder design, tooth bud preforming, clamping flap forming and the like. The preparation method provided by the invention has simple process, and the prepared bullet holder has light weight and small inertia mass, and compared with the bullet holder made of metal materials, the bullet holder has higher initial speed and longer firing range under the same working condition; in addition, the tooth buds of the bullet holder are formed by continuous carbon fibers in advance, the tooth buds are high in strength and good in consistency, the bullet core can be better supported when the bullet holder is launched in a chamber, and the bullet holder has the advantage of being high in reliability.

title_en: Injection-molded current transformer and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an injection molding current transformer and a preparation method thereof, wherein the current transformer comprises a winding magnetic core, a lead and a shell; the shell comprises a supporting body and a plastic layer surrounding the outer surface of the mutual inductor, wherein the supporting body consists of a fixing plate, a boss with a through hole, a lead fixing groove and a positioning column, the fixing plate is used for supporting the winding magnetic core, the boss is used for assembling and fixing the winding magnetic core, and the through hole of the boss is used for installing a primary winding; the lead fixing groove and the fixing plate are formed into a whole and used for fixing a lead; the positioning column is arranged at the bottom of the fixing plate and is used for connecting and positioning with an injection mold thimble; the winding magnetic core and the supporting body are both injected in the plastic layer. The current transformer has stable and reliable quality, good toughness, insulativity and sealing performance, the preparation method comprises five steps of coil winding, lead connection, support body preparation, winding magnetic core assembly and injection molding, the preparation process is simple, and the production efficiency is high.

title_en: Three-dimensional greening planting device system for urban viaduct
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional greening planting device system for an urban viaduct, which relates to the technical field of urban greening and comprises an overhead guardrail and a cross beam, wherein one end of the cross beam is fixedly connected with a mounting semi-ring, and the mounting semi-ring is movably connected with a rotating semi-ring through a hinge. According to the invention, the planting shell is arranged, plants can be planted in the planting shell and planted outside the overhead guardrail, the traffic on the overhead bridge cannot be influenced, the water spray head can be used for irrigating the plants, the water leakage holes can prevent excessive water, so that the plants can grow better, and the purpose of increasing the urban greening rate is achieved.

title_en: Automatic material cutting device and method
abstract_en: One or more embodiments of the present disclosure provide an automatic material cutting device and method. The automatic cutting device comprises a grabbing assembly arranged on the top layer of the frame and a cutting assembly arranged on the middle layer of the frame. When the device is operated, the grabbing component grabs materials, carries the materials to move above the cutting component, and places the materials on the cutting component; the cutting assembly stops after cutting of the materials is completed, the grabbing assembly moves to the position above the cut materials, grabs the cut materials and moves to the position above the receiving device, and the grabbing assembly equally separates the cut materials and places the cut materials on the receiving device. The automatic cutting device and the automatic cutting method can effectively improve the working efficiency and reduce the loss of materials during manual cutting.

title_en: Damper and anti-burst tractor
abstract_en: The invention provides a damper and an anti-burst tractor, relates to the field of pet traction devices, and solves the problems that the service life of the damper is short and the anti-burst effect of the tractor is easy to lose. The damper comprises a magnetic component and a damping piece, wherein the magnetic component and the damping piece are magnetically adsorbed and synchronously rotate or are static when the rotating speed of the wire spool is smaller than a set speed, when the rotating speed of the wire spool exceeds the set speed, any one of the magnetic component and the damping piece is connected with the wire spool, the other one of the magnetic component and the damping piece is connected with a static component, and the magnetic adsorption force between the magnetic component and the damping piece forms resistance for limiting the rotation of the wire spool when the magnetic component and the damping piece relatively rotate. The magnetic component and the damping sheet are attached and magnetically adsorbed, damping materials such as adhesive oil are not needed to be filled, heat generated by friction of the damping materials is reduced, and the magnetic component and the damping sheet have larger magnetic force under the condition of abrasion, so that the service life is greatly prolonged.

title_en: Medium-length hole blasting mining process for steeply inclined thin ore body
abstract_en: The invention relates to a medium-length hole blasting mining process of a steeply inclined thin ore body, which relates to the technical field of mining.A central control module equally divides the ore body into three operation units, compares the average thickness of the ore body of the three operation units, and respectively defines the three operation units as a first operation unit, a second operation unit and a third operation unit according to the sequence of the average thickness from small to large; when blasting is carried out on the cutting well slot-drawing blast holes of the first operation unit, the central control module compares the ore body hardness A with the preset ore body hardness, and selects the corresponding charging length of the hole bottom detonators according to the comparison result; after the charging length of the hole-bottom detonator is selected, the central control module compares the aperture R of the cutting well trompil blast hole with the aperture of the preset trompil blast hole, and selects a corresponding charging length adjusting coefficient according to the comparison result to adjust the charging length of the selected preset hole-bottom detonator. The process effectively improves the mining efficiency of the ore body.

title_en: Method for determining an optical device suitable for a wearer and processing means for determining an optical device suitable for a wearer
abstract_en: In order to determine an optical equipment (1) suitable for a wearer and comprising an optical lens (3, 7) and a spectacle frame (5), a method implemented by a processing device comprises the steps of: -providing data relating to the wearer, the data comprising optical requirements of the wearer, -providing an optical cost function (O) related to an optical function parameter of the optical lens (3, 7) and defined at least on the basis of a portion of the data relating to the wearer, -providing a comfort cost function C related to a comfort parameter, -providing a mechanical interaction cost function M that varies according to a geometric parameter of the spectacle frame (5) and a geometric parameter of the optical lens (3, 7), -determining the optical equipment (1) that minimizes an overall cost function G, the overall cost function G being a weighted sum of all cost functions. A corresponding processing device is also described.

title_en: Temperature control device for bevel gear production die
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of gear machining and discloses a temperature control device for a bevel gear production mold, which comprises a base, wherein a supporting rod is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the base, a display screen is fixedly connected to the upper end of the supporting rod, an operating keyboard is arranged on the display screen, a lower mold is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the base, an upper mold is arranged on the lower mold, a lower molding cavity is arranged on the upper surface of the lower mold, an upper molding cavity is arranged on the lower surface of the upper mold, a through hole is formed in the upper surface of the upper mold, the through hole is communicated with the upper molding cavity, and a vacuum tube is fixedly connected to the. This temperature control device for bevel gear production mould makes the gear when heating and cooling, and the temperature that contacts is more even, and then guarantees the shaping effect of gear to and reduce the appearance of wastrel, and then reduced the waste of raw and other materials, reduce the expenditure of cost, and then guaranteed that the mould can not receive the damage, and guarantee that the gear of producing accords with the user demand.

title_en: Water and fertilizer integrated intelligent supply irrigation system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a water and fertilizer integrated intelligent supply irrigation system and a method, wherein a mixing stirrer and a concentration water level monitor are arranged at the middle lower part inside a main control water tank, the bottom of the mixing stirrer is electrically connected with a mixing stirring motor, the concentration water level monitor and the mixing stirring motor are electrically connected with a controller, one side of the main control water tank is communicated with an independent pressure supply control box through a one-way drainage electromagnetic valve, the upper part of the independent pressure supply control box is provided with a pressure control device with a pressure supply motor, the pressure supply motor is electrically connected with the controller, the bottom of the independent pressure supply control box is communicated with a discharge connector through an independent pressure supply electromagnetic control valve, and intelligent batching devices matched with the controller are arranged inside the feeding supply box and at the bottom; guarantee that mixed liquid can be even feed to terminal irrigation system in the irrigation operation, guarantee that liquid concentration can not reduce, reduce the emergence that output liquid concentration has the difference phenomenon, be favorable to the liquid composition evenly distributed to crops irrigation terminal of irrigation in-process liquid composition of liquid manure integration.

title_en: Agricultural machine vehicle body mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle body mechanism of agricultural machinery, and belongs to the technical field of agricultural machinery. A vehicle body mechanism of agricultural machinery comprises a carrier, wherein the advancing end of the carrier is connected with a control mechanism through a vertical plate, the lower end of the control mechanism is transversely provided with a connecting arm, the terminal of the connecting arm is longitudinally provided with a grabbing component, and the grabbing component is used for grabbing a stack; the control mechanism comprises a support plate fixedly arranged at the upper end of the vertical plate, a base is fixedly arranged on the support plate, a lifting assembly and a rotating assembly are respectively arranged on the base, the lifting assembly is used for lifting and grabbing the assembly, and the rotating assembly is used for rotating and grabbing the assembly. According to the invention, the control mechanism and the grabbing component are arranged at the advancing end of the carrier, and the lifting component and the rotating component in the control mechanism are utilized, so that the grabbing component can be conveniently adjusted to grab the stacks with different shapes, and the working requirements of various baler machines are met. The invention has compact and reasonable structural design, powerful function and stable grabbing, and the lifting assembly is driven to rotate by the rotating assembly, thereby being beneficial to reducing the production cost and being beneficial to market promotion.

title_en: Revolving body mouth part pressing device and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a revolving body mouth part pressing device and a revolving body mouth part pressing system.A mounting hole is formed at the bottom end of a mouth tightening seat body, and a mouth tightening mould pressing sleeve is arranged in the mounting hole in a sliding manner; the free end of the mouth-tightening mould pressing sleeve facing the outside of the mounting hole is connected with the elastomer positioning sleeve; one end of each mouth tightening die connecting rod is hinged with the bottom end of the mouth tightening seat body, and the other end of each mouth tightening die connecting rod is hinged with the mouth tightening die; the mouth tightening die is positioned between the mouth tightening die pressing sleeve and the elastic body positioning sleeve, and the mouth tightening die slides on the end face, facing the mouth tightening die pressing sleeve, of the elastic body positioning sleeve; the bullet body positioning sleeve is provided with a positioning through hole for passing through a bullet; the sliding direction of the tight mould pressing sleeve in the mounting hole is in the same direction as the axial direction of the positioning through hole; all the tight opening dies are annularly and symmetrically distributed by taking the positioning through holes as base points; all the fastening dies are radially distributed by taking the positioning through holes as cores in the sliding direction on the projectile body positioning sleeve. The problems of deformation of the mouth of the projectile body, poor sealing performance and the like can be effectively solved, the production yield of products can be improved, and the potential safety hazard of a production line can be reduced.

title_en: Flame-retardant formaldehyde-free rock-planting plate and production method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flame-retardant formaldehyde-free rock-planting plate and a production method thereof, belonging to the technical field of artificial boards. The rock-planting plate comprises a plate bottom layer, a plate middle layer and a plate surface layer, wherein the plate bottom layer and the plate surface layer are composed of biomass, an inorganic flame retardant, an adhesive, an inert agent, a stabilizer and a warming agent, and the mass ratio of the biomass to the mixture of the inorganic flame retardant, the adhesive, the inert agent, the warming agent and the stabilizer is 6-7: 3-4; the plate middle layer is composed of biomass, ceramsite, inorganic flame retardant, adhesive, inert agent, stabilizer and temperature increasing agent, and the mass ratio of the biomass to the ceramsite is 0.5-1.5: 0.5-1.5, wherein the mass ratio of the biomass to the mixture of the ceramsite and the inorganic flame retardant, the adhesive, the inert agent, the temperature raising agent and the stabilizer is 6-8: 2-4; the mass ratio of the inorganic flame retardant, the adhesive, the inert agent, the stabilizer and the warming agent in the bottom plate layer, the middle plate layer and the surface plate layer is 3-4: 2-4: 2-3: 2-3: 1-2.

title_en: Anti-burning steel wire rope core flame-retardant conveying belt and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-burning steel wire rope core flame-retardant conveyor belt and a manufacturing method thereof.A covering layer and an intermediate bonding layer respectively select ethylene propylene diene monomer rubber/chlorosulfonated polyethylene rubber/polyisobutylene and EPDM/CSM/SEPS as main materials, and the manufactured anti-burning steel wire rope core flame-retardant conveyor belt has the performances of high wear resistance, impact resistance, high temperature resistance, aging resistance, flame retardance, burning resistance and the like by optimizing a formula and a process, has good mechanical properties and longer service life under the conditions of a use temperature of 400-.

title_en: Plant cultivation device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a plant cultivation device, which comprises: the device comprises a main body, a mist generation assembly and a conveying assembly; a water storage space is arranged in the main body; the fog generating assembly is arranged on the main body and used for converting liquid in the water storage space into fog; compared with the traditional watering mode, the plant cultivation device provided by the embodiment of the invention has the advantages that the mist generation component is arranged on the main body to convert the liquid in the water storage space of the main body into the mist, and then the mist is conveyed to the target plant through the conveying component, so that the step of manually watering the target plant is omitted, the time and the labor are saved, and the plant cultivation device is more intelligent.

title_en: A conveying type goes out birds device for birds is bred
abstract_en: The invention provides a conveying type poultry discharging device for poultry breeding, which belongs to the technical field of poultry breeding and comprises a box body; the box body is symmetrically provided with two handles, the bottom of the box body is provided with a group of conveying mechanisms and a buffer mechanism, and the box body is provided with a group of transparent glass; one side of the box body is provided with a connecting frame A shaped like a Chinese character 'hui', and a group of connecting rods are fixed on the box body through bolts; the other end of the connecting rod is fixedly connected with the connecting frame B. Be provided with the connecting block in the bottom of box, the effect that the supporting seat supported has been played to the connecting block, the supporting seat has played the effect that supporting bolt supported, supporting bolt has played the effect that the right side axis of rotation supported, be provided with reset spring between connecting block and supporting seat, reset spring has played the effect that the supporting seat promoted outward, thereby make supporting bolt promote the axis of rotation on right side outwards, reset spring has played the effect of drive belt tensioning, reset spring has still played the effect that the drive belt buffering was inhaled and is inhaled.

title_en: Root digger and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rooter and a using method thereof, and the rooter comprises a control rod, a transmission shaft, a soil grabber, a cutter head and a telescopic device; one end of the control rod is connected with the soil grabber with an opening at the bottom end through a telescopic device; the rotating shaft is arranged in the control rod, the telescopic device and the soil grabber, one end of the rotating shaft, which is close to the soil grabber, is connected with the cutter head, and the other end of the rotating shaft can be connected with the backpack gasoline engine; the cutter head is arranged in the soil grabber; the backpack gasoline engine can provide power for the root digging device, so that the transmission shaft can rotate rapidly and drive the cutter head to rotate. The invention provides special equipment with the characteristics of portability and digging of the roots of perennial weeds on the basis of utilizing the existing backpack gasoline engine to provide power, and realizes the killing of the perennial weeds in the tea garden.

title_en: Greening outer wall for building
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of building greening, and particularly relates to a greening outer wall for buildings, which comprises a flow guide mechanism and a pot unit, wherein the flow guide mechanism and the pot unit are connected with a sewer pipe arranged on a building wall surface; meanwhile, pipelines between the connecting sewer pipe and the water tank are hidden inside the pot culture, so that the attractiveness of the wall surface of a building cannot be influenced, the pot culture designed in the invention is subjected to modular management, the pot culture is convenient to install, and only the flowerpot or the water tank needs to be directly taken out in the replacement process, and other things do not need to be disassembled; the greening outer wall designed by the invention can also irrigate the potted plant by pouring domestic water into the sewer pipe under the condition of not raining for a long time.

title_en: Application of melatonin in regulating and controlling straightening degree of peony flower stems
abstract_en: The invention discloses application of melatonin in regulating and controlling the straightening degree of peony flower stems, and in the growth process from a peony leaf expanding period to a flower bud color exposing period, a melatonin solution is sprayed on peony branches and leaves. The invention firstly proposes that the melatonin is used for regulating and controlling the straightening strength of the flower stem of the peony, the method has the advantages of simple and convenient operation, quick response, easy popularization and utilization and the like, and can be applied in large-scale production of the peony cut flower in the field; the method has obvious effect, not only can improve the strength of the peony flower stem by more than 10 percent, but also can improve the stem thickness and the stem weight, and obviously improves the straightening degree of the peony flower stem.

title_en: Method for purifying biogas slurry by interplanting cane shoots and cress
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for purifying biogas slurry by interplanting water bamboo and cress, and aims to solve the problems that in the prior art, the water bamboo is planted by taking the biogas slurry as a fertilizer, and after the biogas slurry is irrigated, the phosphorus content in water in a planted field is in an overproof state for a long time and does not meet the discharge standard. A method for purifying biogas slurry by interplanting water bamboo and cress comprises the following steps: planting wild rice stem seedlings in the middle 7 th of the month; when the cane shoot seedlings grow to 3-5 tillers, irrigating for the first time to set the concentration and set biogas slurry added at a set depth; planting cress seedlings in the middle or last ten days of the month in the rows of the zizania latifolia; and after the cress seedlings are planted for 8-12 days, irrigating the biogas slurry with set concentration and set addition depth for the second time. By adopting the interplanting of the cane shoots and the cress, compared with the single cane shoot planting, the biogas slurry digestion amount is higher, and after the cane shoots and the cress are irrigated with the optimal biogas slurry digestion concentration, the phosphorus content in the water of the planting field can reach the discharge standard only after 30 days of the digestion of the cane shoots and the cress.

title_en: Can avoid gluing face leaf production of gluing blade and use section device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a slicing device for producing dough leaves, which can avoid adhering blades and can avoid the situation that the blades need to be frequently stopped and cleaned due to the adhesion of the blades in the production process of the dough leaves, and relates to the technical field of dough leaf production devices, and the slicing device comprises a supporting plate, wherein the lower surface of the supporting plate is fixedly connected with two symmetrically arranged frame plates, the two frame plates are fixedly connected through a bottom plate, the upper surface of the supporting plate is fixedly connected with a top plate through a plurality of supporting columns, the upper surface of the supporting plate is fixedly connected with a dough kneading box, a dough kneading mechanism is arranged above the dough kneading box, the dough kneading mechanism is connected with the lower surface of the top plate, the upper surface of the supporting plate is also fixedly connected with a die box, and a die pressing mechanism is arranged above the die box, not only improves the quality of the production of the flour leaves, but also improves the efficiency of the production of the flour leaves.

title_en: Flavonoid delivery system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a flavonoid delivery system comprising a co-precipitate of a hydrophobic flavonoid and a protein. The flavonoid delivery system comprises a high flavonoid to protein ratio such that the food product can be fortified with relatively large amounts of flavonoids without compromising the organoleptic properties of the food product.

title_en: Selective laser sintering forming device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a selective laser sintering forming device which comprises an aluminum profile frame, two powder supply boxes, a forming box, two recovery boxes, a vibrating mirror system, a linear guide rail, a preheating device, a powder spreading roller system and two whitewashes, wherein the powder supply boxes are arranged on the aluminum profile frame; the powder supply boxes are fixed on two sides of the aluminum profile frame, arc-shaped grooves are formed in the adjacent sides of the box openings of each powder supply box and the aluminum profile frame, the arc-shaped grooves incline inwards, the powder leakage ends of powder leakage channels of the arc-shaped grooves are provided with arc-shaped groove powder leakage openings, the vibrating mirror system is arranged on the top of the aluminum profile frame, the linear guide rail and the preheating device are fixed in the middle of the aluminum profile frame, the powder spreading roller system is in sliding connection with the linear guide rail, and a painting is respectively arranged at the place where the movement of the powder spreading roller system stops briefly; the molding boxes are arranged below the powder leakage openings of the two arc-shaped grooves, two recovery boxes are arranged on two sides of each molding box, and the plastering is positioned at the upper port of the corresponding recovery box. The invention can simultaneously supply different kinds of powder, can prepare molded parts sintered by different powders, and realizes the classified recovery of the residual powder.

title_en: Mold for composite material bulkhead, manufacturing method of bulkhead and bulkhead
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mold of a composite material bulkhead, which comprises a bottom mold, an inner side mold, an outer side mold and an auxiliary mold, wherein the bottom mold is detachably fixed on a frame; the invention also provides a method for manufacturing the composite material bulkhead by adopting the mould of the composite material bulkhead and the manufactured composite material bulkhead. The invention has the advantages of realizing continuous pressurization on the product in the vertical direction and the lateral direction in the curing process, and ensuring that the product has the advantages of good internal quality, high compactness, accurate external dimension and smooth surface.

title_en: Protection device that agricultural irrigation used
abstract_en: The invention relates to a protection device for agricultural irrigation, which comprises a water pipe, a protection mechanism and a shielding mechanism, wherein the protection mechanism is arranged in one end of the water pipe, the shielding mechanism is arranged on one side of the water pipe, the protection mechanism comprises a limiting ring, a first spring, a sealing plate and a water spraying assembly, the shielding mechanism comprises a shielding plate, a driving assembly and a driven assembly, the protection device for agricultural irrigation realizes multi-stage protection on a spray head through the matching of the protection mechanism and the shielding mechanism, the first-stage protection on the spray head is realized through the protection mechanism, the second-stage protection on the spray head is realized through the shielding mechanism, the multi-stage protection on the spray head is realized through a pure mechanical structure, the service life of the device is prolonged, meanwhile, the protection device is realized through the impact force of water flow, the electricity is not needed, the electric energy is saved, and the practicability of the use is improved.

title_en: Organic vegetable production system
abstract_en: An organic vegetable production system comprises a cabinet body, wherein a cabinet door is arranged on the front side of the cabinet body, and the cabinet door is made of transparent glass; the cabinet body comprises a frame, and transparent glass is mounted on each surface of the frame; a rotating shaft is rotatably arranged in the cabinet body and is connected with a speed reducing motor through a transmission device, and the speed reducing motor is fixedly arranged in the cabinet body; the fixed unit of planting that is equipped with a plurality of in the pivot, it can be at the internal rotation of cabinet to plant the unit, it includes that support and main planting dish to plant the unit, the support is conical, and conical bottom surface up, be equipped with on the lateral surface of support rather than the corresponding reflection of light convex lens of shape, support fixed mounting is in the pivot, main planting dish is fixed to be located on the support. The organic vegetable production system can plant organic vegetables indoors; the main planting plate is driven to rotate by the speed reducing motor, so that the vegetables on the main planting plate can be uniformly illuminated.

title_en: Polygonum capitatum planting method
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for planting polygonum capitatum, and relates to the technical field of plant cultivation. The embodiment of the invention provides a method for planting polygonum capitatum, which comprises the following steps: selecting land, preparing land, lifting seedlings, transplanting, managing in field and harvesting. The method can stably cultivate Polygonum capitatum, and the obtained Polygonum capitatum has good quality and high yield.

title_en: Mask processing glue applying system and method for positioning mask
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of masks, and discloses a mask processing gluing system for positioning a mask, which comprises a case, a positioning trigger component and a positioning pressing component, wherein the top end of the case is fixedly provided with a workbench, the top end of the workbench is fixedly provided with a rear seat, the inner wall of the rear seat is movably connected with the outer wall of the positioning trigger component, the outer wall of the positioning trigger component is movably connected with the outer wall of the positioning pressing component, the mask processing gluing system and the method for positioning the mask are characterized in that the movement of a gluing head is matched with an ejector rod and a built-in magnetic block thereof to drive a connecting rod to move, the movement of the connecting rod is matched with a limiting rod to drive a movable column to move, when the ejector head is contacted with the workbench, a telescopic rod and a flexible spring drive a movable plate to move, so that the mask is initially fixed along with the movement of a gluing device in the process of gluing the mask, and then the positioning gluing effect is started.

title_en: Network optical cable wiring equipment based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network optical cable wiring device based on big data, which relates to the technical field of cable wiring and comprises a trolley, an atomizing cylinder, a circulating fog discharging mechanism and a swing adjusting mechanism. According to the invention, the circulating fog discharging mechanism is arranged on the atomizing cylinder, a local low-temperature steam and water fog circulating environment is formed in the fog discharging cavity, and static electricity is rapidly eliminated on two sides of the cable with the circular longitudinal section, so that the water content in the network machine room is reduced on the premise of ensuring static electricity elimination and dust removal; through setting up swing adjustment mechanism in arranging the fog intracavity for the in-process of cable pre-wiring, the static elimination goes on in step with automatic wiring, under the installation environment of different temperatures, can be according to the crane span structure installation condition in the permission bend angle scope, and the real-time radius of curvature of accurate control cable row group, and the interior outer both sides of synchronous balanced line row bend press the tensile stress, avoid the fixed back of cable wiring to take place phenomenons such as warpage or even disconnected core.

title_en: Hydraulic adjusting type seedling killing device of potato harvester
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of agricultural machinery, and relates to a seedling killing device, in particular to a seedling killing device of a potato harvester. The utility model provides a seedling device is killed to hydraulic pressure regulation formula potato harvester, includes hydraulic motor, disc cutter, adjustment mechanism, installation fixed establishment, and its technical scheme is: when the potatoes are harvested, a hydraulic motor taking a tractor hydraulic system as a power source drives a disc cutter to cut stubble and seedling vines left at the top of ridges on the potato planting ridge type; in the operation process, the flow direction of hydraulic oil of a hydraulic cylinder in the adjusting mechanism is adjusted in time to change the inclination angle of the disc cutter plane so as to adapt to the change of the working inclination angle of the potato harvester in different operation environments, and the disc cutter plane is parallel to the ridge top plane all the time. The device cuts the stubble-remaining seedling vines of the potatoes, can shorten the length of the stubble-remaining seedling vines, reduce the seedling vine congestion, improve the working efficiency of the seedling removing device of the potato harvester and improve the open potato rate.

title_en: Product modeling displacement prevention device for product design and using method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a product molding displacement prevention device for product design and a using method thereof, the product molding displacement prevention device comprises a workbench, a fixing mechanism and an ejection mechanism, the top of the workbench is fixedly connected with a base, the top of the base is fixedly connected with a support column, the interior of the workbench is connected with a second push rod in a sliding manner, one end of the second push rod penetrates through the workbench and the base and extends to the interior of the support column to be fixedly connected with a second top plate, and the outer side of the second push rod is provided with the fixing mechanism in the support column, the product molding displacement prevention device has the beneficial effects that: through adding fixed establishment, be convenient for to the product location, prevent that the product from taking place the skew at moulding the in-process, through adding ejection mechanism, be convenient for ejecting fast to the product, improve ejecting efficiency, through adding stopper and spacing groove, be convenient for spacing to slider No. one, prevent that slider No. one from droing, through adding No. two slide bars, be convenient for spacing to No. two connecting blocks, prevent that No. two connecting blocks from following No. two push rod motions.

title_en: Artificial breeding method of black beard dirty flies
abstract_en: The invention discloses an artificial feeding method of black bearded flies, which comprises the steps of collecting an initial insect source, obtaining adult black bearded flies and larvae, selecting a field and feeding indoors. The breeding method uses fresh lean pork similar to the wound to breed the larvae of the black beard flies, overcomes the defect of in vitro culture of the black beard flies, scientifically breeds the experimental black beard flies, and can not be influenced by seasons. The artificial feeding method can completely meet the requirement of indoor subculture feeding of the black bearded flies, and a large number of test insects with regular and consistent growth and development can be obtained.

title_en: Lens and mold transfer system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lens and mould transfer system, comprising: a mold feeding section for feeding a mold discharged from the lens molding machine to a first position; a mold transfer unit that transfers a mold located at a first position to a second position along a first direction; and a mold delivery unit that delivers the mold located at the second position to the lens molding machine, the mold transfer unit including: a plurality of transfer tables arranged in a first direction between a first position and a second position so as to be formed in a manner of setting and sliding-transferring a mold; and a height correcting unit disposed between the mold feeding unit and a transfer table adjacent to the mold feeding unit among the plurality of transfer tables, wherein the horizontal seating surfaces of the plurality of transfer tables are arranged so that the height thereof gradually decreases in a first direction, and the height correcting unit is movable in a vertical direction so as to compensate for a difference in height between the horizontal seating surface of the adjacent transfer table and the seating surface of the mold feeding unit.

title_en: Fluorescent powder for LED lamp cultivation in kelp and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of plant cultivation, and particularly relates to fluorescent powder for an LED lamp for kelp cultivation and preparation thereof. The invention uses MgAl 2 O 4 Is a matrix, because the matrix has MgO in an ordered arrangement 4 Tetrahedron and AlO 6 The octahedron structure has stronger lattice rigidity, so that the substrate has good thermal stability and wet stability. According to the solid solution intermiscibility principle, Mn is mixed in the invention 4+ With Mg 2+ Simultaneously doping MgAl 2 O 4 Al of matrix 3+ Lattice sites, Mn-O-Mn ion pairs are replaced by Mn-Mg ion pairs, oxygen quenching centers and Mn-Mn non-radiative energy transfer pairs Mn are effectively reduced 4+ Reduction of luminescence and increase of Mn 4+ The luminescence quantum yield of (a). The invention combines the fluorescent powder with a blue InGaN chip to prepare the blueThe LED lamp with double-emission of red light is applied to kelp cultivation, and the rapid growth of kelp is realized.

title_en: Collagen casing extrusion molding device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of casing processing, in particular to a collagen casing extrusion molding device which comprises a case, a shaping mechanism, a refining mechanism, a kneading mechanism and an extrusion mechanism, wherein the refining mechanism is fixedly arranged at the upper end inside the case, a feed inlet communicated with the refining mechanism is formed in the top of the case, the lower end of the refining mechanism is communicated with the kneading mechanism, and the lower end of the kneading mechanism is communicated with the extrusion mechanism. The invention has compact structure, and can further refine, stir, knead and extrude the raw material of the collagen casing in one device, so that the continuity of the production process of the collagen casing is higher.

title_en: Method for ultrasonically assisting 3D printing of turbocharging blade and nano gradient coating
abstract_en: The invention provides an ultrasonic-assisted 3D printing method for a turbocharging blade and a nano gradient coating. Firstly, plating Ni on the surface of graphene by using a chemical plating method, and completing the preparation of Ni-coated graphene/composite powder and a turbocharger blade substrate by using a mechanical ball milling method and a 3D printing technology under the assistance of ultrasonic impact; then carrying out surface polishing and laser etching treatment, and cleaning the blade substrate by ultrasonic alcohol and deionized water in sequence to ensure that the surface of the blade substrate is clean and free of impurities; then preparing the TGO bonding layer by a magnetron sputtering method; and finally, preparing the nano powder of the gradient coating by using a stirring ball mill, and preparing the nano gradient heat-insulating coating with the linear expansion coefficient gradually decreasing in a gradient manner from the surface of the coating to the substrate by using a 3D printing technology. The invention has the advantages that: the nano gradient thermal insulation coating which is formed by 3D printing and has the linear expansion coefficient gradually reduced in gradient from the coating surface to the substrate has no obvious sharp change steps, can obviously improve the thermal shock resistance and service life of the thermal barrier coating, and can effectively solve the problems of coating cracks and falling caused by repeated thermal shock at high temperature and low temperature.

title_en: Red flesh peach is planted with automatic insecticidal device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic insect killing device for red peach planting, which relates to the technical field of red peach planting and comprises a placing seat, insect killing mechanisms and cleaning mechanisms, wherein the insect killing mechanisms are distributed on two sides above the placing seat, and the cleaning mechanisms are arranged at the upper ends of the insect killing mechanisms; clearance mechanism includes: the electric push rods are vertically arranged on two sides of the upper end of the insect killing mechanism, the lower ends of the electric push rods are connected with connecting rings, and the connecting rings are distributed in a parallel mode with the insect killing mechanism. The electric push rods symmetrically distributed on the two sides of the upper end of the connecting ring can ensure the stability of the connecting ring in the process of driving the brush ring to move up and down, so that the cleaning effectiveness of the brush ring on the outer side of the power grid is ensured.

title_en: Preparation process of ASA film for outdoor house and heat sealing process of synthetic resin tile
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation process of an ASA film for outdoor use of a house and a heat sealing process of a synthetic resin tile. The ASA film prepared by the invention can ensure that the color difference Delta E is less than or equal to 5 within ten years, and the synthetic resin tile compounded by the ASA film has a plurality of excellent physical and chemical properties of light weight, high strength, water resistance, moisture resistance, corrosion resistance, flame retardance, sound insulation, heat insulation and the like.

title_en: Adsorption prevention device used in centrifugal dehydration of vegetable processing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of centrifugal dehydration, and discloses an anti-adsorption device for vegetable processing during centrifugal dehydration, which comprises a rotating shell, wherein a pressing block is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the rotating shell, a pressing table is fixedly arranged below the pressing block, a connecting block is fixedly arranged below the pressing table, a sliding rod is slidably arranged below the connecting block, a pushing block is fixedly arranged below a fixing clamp, and the rotating table is fixedly arranged below a centrifugal rotary drum. This an anti-adsorption device when being used for vegetables processing centrifugal dehydration, rotate through rotating the casing and drive the pressure piece and rotate, make the pressurized stage downstream, the pressurized stage drives connecting block downstream, the connecting block drives the slide bar downstream, the slide bar drives and promotes a downstream, the messenger promotes the piece and promotes the rotation main shaft, the messenger rotates the shake that the main shaft drove centrifugal rotary drum can the low frequency, thereby reached and made centrifugal rotary drum prevent through vibration that vegetables from pressing close to a section of thick bamboo inner wall effect.

title_en: Automatic feeding system for laboratory mice
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic feeding system for laboratory mice, and relates to the technical field of laboratory auxiliary equipment. The supporting frame is provided with a lower plate, an upper plate and a top plate respectively, the lower plate is positioned below the upper plate, the top plate is positioned above the upper plate, the upper plate is of a hollow structure, the upper plate is provided with an excrement treatment device, the excrement treatment device is composed of connecting columns, coil springs and rotating blocks, the connecting columns are arranged on the inner walls of two sides of the upper plate in an equidistant mode, the connecting columns are provided with at least one coil spring, and the coil springs are fixedly arranged on the connecting columns; the invention has reasonable and simple structure, is convenient for feeding mice in a laboratory and is convenient for experimenters to watch and clean the mice.

title_en: Optical glass with high photoinduced refractive index change, optical fiber prepared from optical glass, and preparation method and application of optical fiber
abstract_en: The invention provides optical glass with high photoinduced refractive index change, an optical fiber prepared from the optical glass, and a preparation method and application of the optical glass, wherein the optical glass comprises the following components in percentage by weight: 30% -35% of silicon dioxide; 40-45% of lead oxide; 10-15% of titanium dioxide; 5-10% of lanthanum sesquioxide and niobium pentoxide; 0-5% of boron trioxide; 0-5% of potassium oxide; 0-5% of barium fluoride. The refractive index (n) of the optical glass prepared by the method of the invention d ): 1.71-1.73; the material has extremely high light absorption rate in a deep ultraviolet band (namely an ultraviolet laser band), and the spectral transmittance in a 180-300nm band is less than or equal to 30 percent; the spectral transmittance in the range of 400-2000nm is more than or equal to 95 percent; the optical communication band (usually 1310nm or 1550nm) has extremely low absorptivity, namely the spectral transmittance in the 1100-1600nm band is more than or equal to 99 percent; after ultraviolet laser irradiation, the refractive index changes by 1.0-1.5 multiplied by 10 ‑2 And as the content of the lead oxide increases, the change of the light-induced refractive index increases.

title_en: Automatic cutting scrapping device for unqualified outer diameter of pipe
abstract_en: The application relates to an automatic cutting scrapping device for unqualified outer diameters of pipes, which is characterized by comprising an infrared diameter measuring instrument and an infrared diameter measuring instrument bracket, wherein the infrared diameter measuring instrument and the infrared diameter measuring instrument bracket are connected and fixed through four hexagon socket screws. The application has novel design and reasonable conception, mainly has the functions of unqualified detection of the outer diameter of the pipe and cutting rejection, has simple structure, saves cost, has little dependence on environment, is convenient to install and operate, is convenient to operate, and prevents the pipe with unqualified outer diameter from flowing into the market.

title_en: Dual focal plane reticle for optical sighting device
abstract_en: The present application relates to a dual focal plane reticle for an optical sighting device, and in particular provides an optical sighting device comprising: a body having a first end and a second end; an objective lens system disposed within the body; an eyepiece disposed within the main body; a positive image lens system disposed within the main body; the objective lens system, the ocular lens and the positive lens system form an optical system with a first focal plane; a first reticle located at a first focal plane; an electronic reticle placed on the same focal plane as the first reticle, and wherein the electronic reticle is configured to selectively display at least one of the following two marker patterns: (a) A series of dip points or other dwell-aiming points or angle marks corresponding to the supersonic pattern; and (b) a series of dip points or other dwell points or angle marks corresponding to the subsonic pattern, and the first reticle includes at least one display pattern selected from the group consisting of a crosshair, a series of hash marks, and combinations thereof.

title_en: Injection mold capable of realizing autorotation demolding of upper mold
abstract_en: The invention provides an injection mold for upper mold autorotation demolding, which comprises a base plate, an A plate, a helical tooth forming insert, a bearing, an upper mold core, a B plate, a lower mold core and an ejector pin, wherein the helical tooth forming insert is rotatably arranged in the A plate through the bearing and is matched with the lower mold core and the upper mold core to form an injection mold cavity, when the A plate is separated from the B plate, the helical tooth forming insert slowly autorotates in situ under the driving of a helical gear product, the helical tooth forming insert and an upper mold core forming end are revolving bodies, the upper mold core forming end is arranged in the helical tooth forming insert, the base plate is arranged on one side of the A plate, which is far away from the B plate, the lower mold core is embedded in the B plate, and the ejector pin penetrates through the B plate and the lower mold core until reaching the bottom surface of the injection mold cavity. According to the invention, the helical tooth forming insert is rotatably arranged on the upper die in situ, so that the autorotation demoulding of a helical gear product with a blocking block on one side of helical teeth and a product packing force on one side of the blocking block larger than that of the other side of the helical teeth is well realized, the demoulding efficiency is high, the stability is good, and the automatic integrated production of the helical gear product is convenient to realize.

title_en: Domestic fish head processing positioner
abstract_en: The invention relates to a household fish head processing positioner which comprises a base, wherein a fish head positioning mechanism is arranged on the base, a gill processing mechanism is arranged at one end of the fish head positioning mechanism, the gill processing mechanism is fixedly connected with the base, and through the arrangement of the fish head positioning mechanism, the shaking of a fish head is reduced and the processing is convenient when gills in the fish head are processed.

title_en: Microcrystalline glass, electronic equipment and preparation method of microcrystalline glass
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides microcrystalline glass, electronic equipment and a preparation method of the microcrystalline glass, and relates to the technical field of glass, wherein the microcrystalline glass comprises the following components in percentage by mass: SiO 2 2 10% -22% of Al 2 O 3 6 to 15 percent of Na 2 O, K greater than 0% and not greater than 4% 2 O, more than 0% and not more than 5%Li 2 O, more than 0% and not more than 10% of MgO and a crystal nucleating agent. The microcrystalline glass provided by the embodiment of the application has the advantages of higher hardness, higher bending strength and deeper ion exchange depth.

title_en: Polylactic acid and stereocomplex film material thereof and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a polylactic acid and a stereocomplex film material thereof and a preparation method, comprising the following steps: reacting a dihydroxyl micromolecule organic compound, a lactone monomer and a catalyst to obtain dihydroxyl functionalized copolyester; the dihydroxy functional copolyester, lactide and catalyst react to obtain dihydroxy functional copolyester/polylactic acid block copolymer; adding a dihydroxy functional copolyester/polylactic acid block copolymer and 2 (6-isocyanate-hexamethylene ureido) -6-methyl 4[1H ] -pyrimidone into toluene, adding a catalyst, and reacting to obtain a flexible multi-block polymer; mixing the flexible multi-block polymer with the levorotatory polylactic acid and/or the dextrorotatory polylactic acid, and obtaining the polylactic acid or polylactic acid stereocomplex film material through tape casting or blending granulation and injection molding. Compared with the toughening of the conventional polylactic acid and the stereocomplex material thereof, the polylactic acid or the stereocomplex material of the polylactic acid prepared by the invention has higher mechanical strength and toughness and has the potential of being used as a packaging material.

title_en: Volume reducing machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a volume reducer, which comprises a material pushing assembly and two extrusion assemblies; the material pushing assembly comprises a material distribution box and two material pushing screws which are positioned in the material distribution box and arranged in parallel, a material distribution part positioned between the two material pushing screws is arranged in the material distribution box, a material inlet and two material outlets are formed in the material distribution box, and the material inlet is opposite to the material distribution part; the extrusion assembly comprises an extrusion groove and an extrusion component positioned at an opening of the extrusion groove, an extrusion cavity with two communicated ends is formed between the extrusion groove and the extrusion component, the extrusion cavity is provided with a feeding end and a discharging end, the extrusion component is rotatably connected with the extrusion groove, and a rotating shaft between the extrusion component and the extrusion groove is positioned at the feeding end; the two extrusion assemblies are arranged in parallel, and the feed ends of the extrusion assemblies are connected with the corresponding discharge ports; the material pushing screw rod continuously stirs and conveys the foam materials to the extrusion cavity, and the extrusion component extrudes and compacts the foam materials in the extrusion groove, so that the foam materials are automatically and continuously stirred and extruded.

title_en: Tree transplanting fixing support
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tree transplanting and fixing bracket, which comprises a hoop and a plurality of supporting pieces, wherein the hoop is circumferentially arranged around a trunk, and the supporting pieces are arranged at the lower part or the side part of the hoop in a swinging way; the hoop is composed of a plurality of bendable hoop rods which are connected end to end in sequence, and the hoop rods can stretch along the length direction of the hoop rods, so that the hoop can expand outwards along the radial direction of the hoop. Based on the structure, the size of the hoop can be adjusted adaptively at any time along with the growth of the branches, so that the fixing requirement can be met, and the growth of trees can not be influenced; in addition, when the tree branches grow on a large scale, the size of the hoop can be adjusted on a large scale by increasing the number of the hoop rods, so that the size of the branches is satisfied, the loss of parts can be avoided due to the fact that the hoop rods are connected through the connecting piece of the hoop rods, and the fact that the assembly and the disassembly are more convenient can be guaranteed.

title_en: Cow nose ring and cow health monitoring device and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of livestock raising, and provides a cattle nose ring, a device and a method for monitoring the health of a cow thereof. The data collection device comprises an air pressure sensor, an environment sensor, a water pressure sensor and a nine-axis sensor. The microcontroller controls the data collection device, collects atmospheric pressure, temperature, carbon dioxide concentration, water pressure data and milk cow motion information data, combines the motion gesture of observing the milk cow, analyzes milk cow drinking behavior, respiratory state and judges whether the milk cow has lameness behavior, synthesizes the health status of separating out the milk cow. According to the invention, the data collection, the data transmission, the microcontroller and the power supply module are arranged on a single ox-nose ring, so that the defects of incomplete monitoring data, inaccurate data and overhigh monitoring cost are overcome.

title_en: Bird repeller
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bird repeller which comprises a fixed seat, a rotating shaft rotatably arranged on the fixed seat, fan blades, a positioning piece fixed on the rotating shaft, a puncture needle arranged on the positioning piece, and a sliding piece with a trepanning; the fan blade is provided with a shaft hole and sleeved on the rotating shaft through the shaft hole and rotates synchronously with the rotating shaft; the rotating axis of the rotating shaft is horizontally arranged, the number of the pricking pins is multiple, and each pricking pin is provided with a sliding piece in a sliding manner; the two ends of each felting needle are respectively a connecting end and a tip end; the connecting end of each felting needle is connected with the positioning piece; the distance between the connecting ends of the pricking pins is smaller than the distance between the tips of the pricking pins, the sliding parts are sleeved on the pricking pins through the sleeve holes and can slide along the pricking pins, a preset included angle is formed between the sliding direction of each sliding part and the rotating axis of the rotating shaft, and the preset included angle is larger than 0 degree. The invention can not only prevent birds from staying on power equipment facilities, but also clean excrement of the birds, and belongs to the technical field of bird damage prevention and control devices.

title_en: Purple perilla seedling cultivation method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of seedling cultivation, in particular to a perilla seedling cultivation method and a perilla seedling cultivation device, wherein the perilla seedling cultivation method comprises a cultivation box, a box door is arranged on the side surface of the cultivation box through a hinge, an observation window is embedded in the side surface of the box door, concave guide rails are welded at the bottom of an inner cavity of the cultivation box in a bilateral symmetry manner, a cultivation disc is arranged at the upper end of each concave guide rail, sliding plates are welded at the lower end of the cultivation disc in a bilateral symmetry manner, the sliding plates are in sliding connection with the concave guide rails, nutrient soil containing subacidity and high humus or loose fertile nutrient soil is selected, the nutrient soil is placed in a cultivation disc 2, and the nutrient soil is leveled; the method has the beneficial effects that the purple perilla fine variety seeds with full and undamaged particles are selected and uniformly planted in the nutrient soil at equal intervals, and the method has the following beneficial effects: through the temperature sensor and the cooperation of moisture detector that set up for temperature and humidity to in the incubator regulate and control, make the temperature and the humidity in the incubator be in the growth environment of suitable purple perilla seedling all the time, guarantee the normal growth of purple perilla seedling.

title_en: Repeatedly beating device for exuding casing collagen
abstract_en: The invention discloses a repeated beating device for exuding casing collagen, which comprises a frame body, a rotating shaft, a first driving device and a plurality of beating rods, wherein the rear parts of the beating rods are connected to the frame body through hinged seats; the outer wall of pivot is provided with a plurality of driving levers along length direction on, is provided with the thumb wheel on the driving lever, each thumb wheel and each beat excellent one-to-one and correspond to each other, and pivot pivoted in-process drives the rear end portion that the thumb wheel contact pushed down and beaten the stick through the driving lever, realizes beating the slope perk of excellent front end, breaks away from the contact back when thumb wheel and the rear end portion of beating the stick, beats the stick and falls to the normal position naturally and contact with the casing, so circulate and realize beating repeatedly of casing. The invention can realize the repeated beating action in the casing making process, effectively improves the production efficiency compared with a manual mode, and in the beating process, the tray for containing the casing can rotate, further improves the beating uniformity of the casing, and shortens the collagen exudation time of the casing.

title_en: Anti-aging high-elasticity polyurethane automobile seat sponge and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-aging high-elasticity polyurethane automobile seat sponge and a preparation process thereof, and relates to the technical field of automobile seat sponges, wherein the automobile seat sponge comprises the following components in parts by weight: 100-140 parts of raw materials, 20-30 parts of foaming auxiliary agents, 14-20 parts of adhesives, 3-11 parts of light stabilizers, 4-12 parts of modifiers, 2-4 parts of catalysts and 20-30 parts of solvents. According to the invention, the highest aging rate of the automobile seat sponge 30d is 6.5%, the aging rate is reduced with the increase of the light stabilizer, the aging rate can be increased, the automobile seat sponge has good aging resistance, the automobile seat sponge can bear 81.2% of compression ratio at the lowest, and the maximum compression ratio is increased with the increase of the graphene modifier, so that the automobile seat sponge has high elasticity.

title_en: Pump body forming die
abstract_en: The invention provides a pump body forming die, which comprises a pump body forming external die and a core die, wherein the forming external die comprises a first external die and a second external die, a parting surface formed by a joint surface of the first external die and the second external die is vertical to the axial direction of a pump body A and passes through a symmetrical surface of a pipe core of a liquid outlet pipe B of the pump body A, the inner wall of a second external die forming cavity is matched with the outer wall of an axial front section of the pump body A, the inner wall of a first external die forming cavity is matched with the outer wall of an axial rear section of the pump body A, a cavity for forming the pump body A is arranged in the first external die forming cavity, a pipe core die for forming the inner wall of the liquid outlet pipe B is arranged in a pipe cavity for forming the outer wall of the liquid outlet pipe B, the pipe core die comprises a pipe core die outer section and a pipe core die inner section, the pipe core die outer section is used for forming the outer section of the liquid outlet pipe B, the pipe core die inner section is used for forming the inner section of the liquid outlet pipe B, and a joint end of the pipe core die is closely combined with the pipe core die inner section, the outer section of the pipe core mould and the inner section of the pipe core mould are connected with a core pulling mechanism.

title_en: Turtle shell bionic curved surface block-shaped net-shaped bimetal repair structure and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: A bionic curved surface block-shaped net-shaped bimetal repairing structure of a tortoise shell comprises: the shape-following additive layer is formed by splicing and combining a plurality of blocks, each block comprises an internal hard filling block and a boundary gap soft filling frame, each block boundary gap soft filling frame is a frame with the inward offset width d of the boundary of each block, and the internal hard filling block is arranged in the middle of each boundary gap soft filling frame; the preparation method comprises the following steps: step 1, obtaining a curved surface to be repaired; step 2, discrete blocks of the curved surface to be repaired are divided; step 3, planning a curved surface shape-following additive track; step 4, shape-following additive repair; step 5, performing shape-following material increase on the areas in the blocks; step 6, filling the blocking gap area with a shape-following additive; and 7, performing heat treatment and machining. The design not only can realize the tough coupling and effectively prolong the service life of parts, but also can adapt to the differentiated performance requirements of different areas, and has wide application range.

title_en: Low-pressure 3D printing method and device for high-performance polymer and composite material thereof
abstract_en: A low-pressure 3D printing method and device for high-performance polymer and composite materials thereof are disclosed, the device comprises a control cabinet and a low-pressure forming chamber, the control cabinet comprises a control panel and a vacuum pump, the control panel comprises low-pressure forming chamber air pressure control, temperature control, printing head temperature control, heating platform temperature control and motion control, and the vacuum pump extracts air from the low-pressure forming chamber; the low-pressure forming chamber comprises an air inlet valve, a sensor, a radiation heating lamp tube and a heating platform, wherein the heating platform has a porous characteristic and is matched with a sand blasting PEI film for use; firstly, setting a target pressure value of a low-pressure forming cavity through a control panel, and then pumping air in the low-pressure forming cavity by a vacuum pump to form a vacuum environment; setting the required temperature of a low-pressure forming chamber, the temperature of a printing head and the like by using a control panel, and completing a 3D printing forming process in the low-pressure forming chamber; the invention realizes the manufacture of high-performance polymer with high interlayer bonding strength, high crystallinity and small warpage deformation and the composite material 3D product thereof.

title_en: UV anti-adhesive film and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a UV anti-adhesive film, a preparation method and application thereof. The UV anti-adhesive film comprises a bottom coating layer, a substrate layer, an anti-adhesive layer and a release film layer which are sequentially overlapped; the anti-adhesive layer is made of a UV anti-adhesive composition; the UV glue reducing composition comprises the following components in parts by weight: 100 parts of acrylic resin, 0.9 to 2.8 parts of curing agent, 2 to 5 parts of antistatic agent and 0.9 to 2.5 parts of initiator.
