Firstly, coating waterborne polyurethane on one side of a substrate layer, and drying to obtain a prime coat and the substrate layer which are attached to each other; then coating the UV anti-adhesion composition on any side of the release film layer, and drying to obtain an anti-adhesion layer and the release film layer which are attached to each other; and finally, compounding the anti-adhesive layer at the side far away from the release film layer with the substrate layer at the side far away from the bottom coating layer, and curing to obtain the UV anti-adhesive film. The UV anti-adhesive film provided by the invention has lower haze, higher transparency and better antistatic property.

title_en: Oil tank flash removing equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an oil tank flash removing device which comprises a bottom plate and a supporting plate used for supporting an oil tank, wherein the supporting plate is positioned above the bottom plate, a plurality of stand columns distributed in the circumferential direction are arranged between the supporting plate and the bottom plate, the upper end of each stand column is fixed with the lower end face of the supporting plate, and the lower end of each stand column is fixed with the upper end face of the bottom plate; the outer wall of each upright post is vertically and slidably connected with a clamping mechanism, each clamping mechanism is used for clamping the flash positioned on the outer peripheral wall of the oil tank, and the outer wall of each upright post is also provided with a first driving mechanism used for driving the clamping mechanism at the corresponding position to vertically slide so as to enable the clamping mechanism to pull out the flash from the oil tank; the invention realizes the removal of the flash on the outer wall of the oil tank in a mechanical mode, can improve the removal efficiency of the flash on the outer wall of the oil tank, can reduce the labor intensity of workers and can achieve the aim of reducing the labor cost.

title_en: High-speed hose production line
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hose production, in particular to a high-speed hose production line. The cold extrusion machine, the threading machine, the annealing furnace, the inner spraying machine, the curing furnace, the bottom color machine, the first drying oven, the multicolor printing machine, the second drying oven, the cap twisting machine and the tail coating machine are sequentially connected. The invention integrates a cold extrusion machine, a threading machine, an annealing furnace, an inner spraying machine, a curing furnace, a bottom color machine, a first oven, a multicolor printing machine, a second oven, a cap twisting machine and a tail coating machine into a whole production line, realizes the high-speed production of aluminum hoses, fills the domestic blank and has high production efficiency.

title_en: Avoid output pressure change and automatic pressure regulating's feeding device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of toy accessories and discloses a material conveying device capable of avoiding output pressure change and automatically regulating pressure. Through the inside resistance of electromagnetic bar diminish, electromagnetic bar and magnetic path repulsion each other promote the slider and slide, drive the baffle motion, reduce the through-hole area of input row material storehouse, reduce the feeding volume to reached and to have reduced when solution increases in inside, arrange the pressure in material storehouse automatically, prevent the overspeed of solution and flow, practiced thrift the effect of material.

title_en: Road greening three-dimensional maintenance device based on smart city
abstract_en: The invention provides a road greening three-dimensional maintenance device based on a smart city, which comprises an operation vehicle and a working plate, a working plate is fixed at the lower end of one side of the operating vehicle, a driving frame is fixed at the middle part of the upper surface of the working plate, which is close to one side of the operating vehicle, the inner wall of the driving frame is rotatably connected with a pulling mechanism for removing necrotic or malnutrition shrubs, the invention can automatically complete the work of pulling out dead and withered shrubs in the shrub seedling supplementing work in the urban road greening and maintenance work, and can automatically remove the soil at the root of the withered wood in the process of pulling out, thereby achieving the effect of preventing the soil in the greening from losing, meanwhile, the shrubs on two sides can be pulled out in the pulling-out process, so that enough space can be provided for people to replant, the operation of people is facilitated, and the phenomenon that the shrubs scratch when people plant is greatly reduced.

title_en: Method for improving pipeline welding efficiency
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for improving the welding efficiency of a pipeline, which solves the problem that in the whole hot-melt welding process, due to the influence of the construction characteristics of the welding process of PE pipelines, partial machines and operators are in an idle state in the process of heat absorption and natural cooling of the pipelines, and the construction efficiency is influenced. According to the method, the entering field sectional stacking of the PE pipe is guided, on the basis of an original welding machine tool, a plurality of butt welding machine frames are added, so that a heating plate and a milling cutter can be recycled under the condition of no shutdown and idling, the cross connection of welding procedures is achieved, workers and machines reach the saturation state of the construction efficacy as much as possible, the welding efficiency of the PE pipe is improved, and the welding progress of the PE pipe is accelerated.

title_en: High-precision movable intelligent chiseling device for prefabricated hollow plate beam and using method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent chiseling device for a high-precision movable type prefabricated hollow slab beam and a using method, belonging to the technical field of bridge engineering and comprising the following steps: the vehicle-mounted unit comprises a bearing frame, a traveling mechanism and a power assembly, wherein the traveling mechanism and the power assembly are both arranged on the bearing frame, and the power assembly is in driving connection with the traveling mechanism; the chiseling machine is arranged on the bearing frame in a distance-adjustable and angle-adjustable manner; the automatic spraying unit comprises a water storage tank and a plurality of spray heads, wherein the water storage tank is arranged at the upper end of the bearing frame; high accuracy laser control unit, including laser lamp and with the laser sensor that the laser ray of laser lamp transmission corresponds the setting, the laser lamp is installed on bearing the frame with adjustable distance. The invention avoids manual automatic scabbling, solves the problem of a large number of pneumoconiosis of workers, can avoid the dust problem in the scabbling process by automatic spraying, realizes automatic reception of scabbling powder, and avoids the problem of difficult cleaning of a large number of beam slab precast yard bases.

title_en: L-shaped thin-wall component forming unit and system thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an L-shaped thin-wall component forming unit and a system thereof, wherein the unit comprises a bottom die and a forming frame, wherein the forming frame is provided with a material storage hopper, a winch and forming hoppers, the two forming hoppers are hinged on the material storage hopper to form an L-shaped structure, and the forming hoppers are communicated with the material storage hopper; the two ends of the steel strand on the winch are respectively connected with the forming hopper, a discharge hole is formed in the forming hopper, and the bottom die is arranged below the L-shaped structure and can move relative to the forming frame. The invention utilizes the material storage hopper to be communicated with the forming hopper to form the feeding cavity, can realize automatic feeding, and combines the L structure formed by the forming hopper with the male die to form the forming cavity, thereby realizing the automatic forming of the slurry falling on the male die.

title_en: Base material distributing machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a base material distributing machine, which comprises a rack and a skip arranged on the rack, wherein the skip is provided with a material cavity, a feeding door frame, a material door, a discharging door frame and a material door oil cylinder which are sequentially arranged below the material cavity; the upper end and the lower end of the material cavity are both provided with openings, and the feeding door frame is locked with the material cavity and is provided with a first discharging opening communicated with the material cavity; the two sides of the blanking door frame and the two sides of the loading door frame are provided with movable adjusting mechanisms capable of adjusting the distance between the two sides, and the blanking door frame is provided with a second blanking port communicated with the first blanking port; the material door is inserted between the feeding door frame and the discharging door frame, and the material door oil cylinder pushes the material door to move back and forth so as to conduct or close the first discharging port and the second discharging port; the base material distributing machine can adjust the distance between the feeding door frame and the discharging door frame, improve the sealing effect between the material door and the material cavity, avoid material leakage and have better distributing effect; the service life of the skip car is prolonged, and the production cost is reduced.

title_en: Miniature agricultural seeding equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a micro agricultural sowing device, which comprises a base plate, wherein a sowing box is fixedly connected to the upper end surface of the base plate, the sowing box comprises a fixing frame, a fertilizer box, a seed box, a screening plate and a stripping groove, the fertilizer box is arranged on one side of the upper end surface of the fixing frame, the seed box is arranged on the other side of the upper end surface of the fixing frame, the screening plate is fixedly connected to the upper end surface of the seed box, the screening plate comprises a screening plate main body, a screening groove, a screening plate and a threaded rod, the screening groove is formed in the upper end surface of the screening plate main body, the screening plate is connected to the inner part of the screening plate main body in a sliding manner, the threaded rod is fixedly connected to the side end surface of the screening plate main body, the stripping groove is formed in the upper part of the side end surface of the seed box, a sowing device is arranged on the upper end surface of the base plate, the sowing device comprises a fixing table, a feeding plate, a fertilizer groove, a seed transition block and a rotary connecting groove, the invention effectively improves the sowing efficiency, can adjust the sowing depth and can cover soil after sowing.

title_en: Method for preparing porous and super-hydrophobic PLA film with adjustable aperture by using solvent freezing phase separation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing a porous super-hydrophobic PLA film with adjustable aperture by using a solvent freezing phase separation method, which comprises the following steps: 1) mixing PLA and a solvent, stirring for dissolving, and then pouring into a mould, wherein the solvent contains 10-95% by volume of 1, 4-dioxane; 2) and (3) putting the mould with the PLA solution in the step 1) into low temperature for freezing, taking out after freezing, and standing at room temperature to obtain the porous super-hydrophobic PLA film with adjustable aperture. The invention utilizes the freezing point of the solvent to fix the distance between PLA chains through freezing to prepare the porous super-hydrophobic material which is not easy to collapse. The method is simple to prepare and easy to realize large-scale production, and meanwhile, the porous super-hydrophobic PLA film with the adjustable pore diameter has degradability and biocompatibility and can be used in the fields of energy storage, adsorption materials, oil-water separation, microfluid transportation, self-cleaning, sound absorption, heat insulation and the like.

title_en: Automatic electrified bird repeller dismantling device and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automatic live bird dispeller dismantling device and method, and belongs to the technical field of power supply equipment guarantee. The technical scheme is as follows: ejecting axle bed (5) are fixed at supporting seat (6) medial surface, ejecting axle (4) longitudinal sliding sets up on ejecting axle bed (5), the lower extreme and the power unit of ejecting axle (4) are connected, ejecting axle (4) upper end is equipped with and demolishs sleeve (1), it is equipped with between sleeve (1) and ejecting axle bed (5) and blocks spring (18) to demolish, demolish sleeve (1) and for having the internal screw thread tubular structure, power unit drives through ejecting axle (4) and demolishs sleeve (1) and rotates, demolish sleeve (1) and drive the mounting nut matching of bird ware. The invention has the beneficial effects that: can dismantle the work of driving the bird ware under the circuit electrified state, easy operation has ensured the safe operation of line equipment, has improved the power supply reliability, has guaranteed staff's equipment security.

title_en: Titanium alloy mixed powder for laser additive manufacturing of titanium alloy part and method for manufacturing titanium alloy part in laser additive mode
abstract_en: The application relates to titanium alloy mixed powder for laser additive manufacturing of a titanium alloy part and a method for manufacturing the titanium alloy part in a laser additive mode, and belongs to the technical field of laser additive manufacturing. Wherein the titanium alloy mixed powder includes: ZrB 2 Powder, Al-Zr alloy powder and titanium alloy powder; ZrB 2 The powder accounts for 0.1 to 1 percent of the mass percent of the titanium alloy mixed powder, and the Al-Zr alloy powder accounts for 0.5 to 2 percent of the mass percent of the titanium alloy mixed powder. ZrB is added into the titanium alloy mixed powder 2 Powder, reducing the deposition of titanium alloys when preparing titanium alloy parts by laser additiveGrain size; meanwhile, Al-Zr alloy powder is added into the mixed powder, so that the refining of crystal grains and the refining of an alpha lath structure are facilitated, the plasticity of the material is improved, and the anisotropy of the deposited material is greatly reduced.

title_en: Biomass straw grading and crushing equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses biomass straw grading crushing equipment, which relates to the technical field of crushing and grinding equipment and comprises a rack, a conveyer belt, a discharge barrel and a grading rolling and cutting mechanism, wherein the conveyer belt is arranged at the side end of the rack, the upper end of the rack is provided with a collecting cover, the discharge barrel is fixedly arranged at the lower part of the rack, and the upper part of the discharge barrel is provided with an electric heating ring plate. According to the invention, the grading grinding mechanism is arranged in the rack, so that concentric reverse rotation of the sieve barrel and the rotating shaft is realized, and the grading grinding degree can be effectively improved; through the vertical blade in the hierarchical grinding mechanism and the electric heating ring board that sets up on going out the feed cylinder, realize being lifted once more and recutting after horizontal blade cuts up to kibbling straw that becomes more meticulous, and then let the crushing straw that falls the reswelling receive the heat of coming from the electric heating ring board more comprehensively, promote the stoving effect, be convenient for transport and store.

title_en: Dendrobium officinale seedling cultivation device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dendrobium officinale seedling cultivation device and method, wherein a monitoring part is electrically connected with an air treatment device and an air adjusting component inside a cultivation shed, the air treatment device and the air adjusting component inside the cultivation shed are preset according to the temperature, the humidity and the particulate matter content of the environment, air adjusting parameters are changed, and the air flowing in from the outside is controlled to be adjusted according to the air parameters required by seedlings.

title_en: Individualized skin penetrating and supporting positioning device based on 3D printing and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a manufacturing method of a skin penetrating and supporting positioning device based on 3D printing, which comprises the following steps: searching a skin penetration fulcrum on a human body by adopting an ultrasonic Doppler positioning method, marking, simultaneously drawing the body surface outline of the human body, acquiring a body surface visible mark, and then acquiring image forming data by adopting scanning equipment; importing the acquired image data into three-dimensional modeling software for image data processing, and establishing a three-dimensional model; importing the established three-dimensional model data into 3D printing equipment, and printing by a three-dimensional printing technology to obtain a personalized skin penetrating branch positioning device capable of being tightly combined with skin; and verifying the printed skin penetrating and supporting positioning device and the skin to determine whether the printed skin penetrating and supporting positioning device is accurate or not. The method provided by the application is simple to operate, and the prepared skin penetrating and supporting positioning device has the advantages of good fitting property, accurate positioning and good functionality.

title_en: Metering type color masterbatch mixer with good mixing effect
abstract_en: The invention provides a metering type color master batch mixer with good mixing effect, which comprises a quantitative feeding device, wherein the quantitative feeding device is arranged at the top of a stirring barrel, a weighing device is arranged at the bottom of the quantitative feeding device, the middle part of the top surface of the stirring barrel is detachably connected with a turning device, stirring blocks are arranged on four sides of the bottom of the stirring barrel, a driving device is arranged at the bottom of each stirring block, a discharge port is arranged in the middle of each stirring block, and a switching part is arranged on one side of each discharge port, so that the technical problem that the bottom material of the existing color master batch mixer is difficult to turn, and the finished product effect is poor is solved.

title_en: Molded body and method for producing same
abstract_en: An object is to provide an injection molding circuit component (MID) capable of realizing electronic component mounting and a manufacturing method thereof. The skin-like layer 3 is partially removed from the surface of the synthetic resin molded body 1, and the conductive section 8 is present on the base 4 of the molded body exposed from the removed section 5. It is characterized by comprising: a molding step of molding the synthetic resin molded body; a skin layer removing step of removing at least a part of the skin layer generated on the surface in the forming step by laser etching; an etching step of etching the portion from which the skin layer is removed; and a conductive part forming step of forming a conductive part on the etched part.

title_en: Edible mushroom is cultivateed with cultivateing full-automatic perforating device of bag
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full-automatic punching device for a culture bag for edible mushroom culture, and relates to the technical field of edible mushroom culture; comprises an arc-shaped frame which is fixed on the top of a machine base and used for supporting a fungus stick and a puncturing part used for punching the fungus stick; the puncturing part comprises an annular shell and a driving ring movably arranged in the annular shell, a first guide groove and a second guide groove are formed in the inner wall of the driving ring, and a plurality of groups of puncturing mechanisms in circular arrays are arranged on the first guide groove and the second guide groove. The invention can effectively increase the pore channels of the fungus sticks, increase the exchange efficiency with the outside air, is beneficial to the growth of edible fungi, and can effectively prevent the crack damage of the fungus stick packaging bag caused by the too early extending time of the auxiliary pricker.

title_en: Production method of kiwi fruit seedlings without canker pathogenic bacteria
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of seedling propagation and discloses a production method of kiwifruit seedlings without canker pathogenic bacteria, which comprises the following steps: taking healthy and strong kiwi fruit leaves to detect the pathogenic bacteria of the canker; sterilizing the detected kiwi leaves without the pathogenic bacteria of the ulcer disease; carrying out enrichment culture by using the disinfected kiwi leaves; and culturing the tissue culture seedling to obtain the kiwi fruit seedling without the pathogenic bacteria of the canker. The method utilizes plant biotechnology to culture the kiwi fruit seedlings without the pathogenic bacteria of the kiwi fruit canker, not only lays a foundation for large-scale production of high-quality and disease-free seedlings in the future, but also has good reference function for producing other kiwi fruit seedlings without the pathogenic bacteria of the kiwi fruit canker. Meanwhile, the method cuts off the carrying and the transmission of pathogenic bacteria from the source, can more effectively prevent the occurrence of the kiwifruit canker, namely the destructive bacterial disease, is more environment-friendly, is more convenient for fruit growers to operate and manage, and is beneficial to the fruit growers to cultivate.

title_en: Deodorization cat litter and cat litter deodorant adding, mixing and stirring device for processing same
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cat litter and deodorant stirring, in particular to a cat litter and deodorant adding, mixing and stirring device for processing the cat litter and deodorant, which comprises a bracket, wherein a stirring barrel is arranged on the bracket, a stirring mechanism for stirring cat litter and deodorant is arranged on the stirring barrel, a driving mechanism for driving a storage mechanism to slide is arranged on the bracket, a blanking mechanism for quantitatively blanking is connected on the stirring barrel, an adjusting mechanism for adjusting the blanking amount is arranged on the blanking mechanism, and a shaking mechanism is arranged on the stirring barrel and is connected with the stirring mechanism; can realize the circulation unloading when unloading mechanism rotates, and unloading volume is the same at every turn, do benefit to quick quantitative unloading packing to stirred cat litter, need not discharge the cat litter to a big container inside carry out the secondary partial shipment, easy operation, and can adjust the volume of holding cat litter through adjustment mechanism, be favorable to carrying out quantitative unloading to cat litter according to different holding containers.

title_en: Novel passive energy-saving yield-increasing greenhouse based on photoluminescence principle
abstract_en: This patent provides a novel passive energy-conserving increase production big-arch shelter based on photoluminescence principle, including big-arch shelter structure subassembly, solar energy system, temperature and humidity measurement and linked system, illuminance detection and linked system, carbon dioxide concentration detection and linked system, photoluminescence system and control system. This big-arch shelter make full use of passive form solar energy technique, on the one hand send through solar energy, the normal operating of equipment in the power supply mode guarantee canopy, but environmental parameter such as automated inspection canopy internal temperature, soil moisture, illuminance and carbon dioxide concentration, and realize the coordinated control of relevant equipment through control system, on the other hand utilizes the luminous characteristic of photoluminescence material photic illumination to satisfy the demand of plant growth to illuminance based on the photoluminescence principle, and promote the photosynthesis of plant to a certain extent, restrain the respiration of plant, finally realize the premature birth of crops, increase production and excellent production, accord with the energy-concerving and environment-protective efficient theory of modern agriculture.

title_en: Avocado water culture method
abstract_en: The invention provides a avocado water culture method which comprises seed germination water culture or tissue culture rooting seedling water culture, wherein the seed germination water culture comprises the steps of seed treatment, cleaning, primary culture, water culture and the like, and the tissue culture rooting seedling water culture comprises the steps of seedling hardening, pre-culture, cleaning of tissue culture seedlings, primary culture, water culture and the like of the tissue culture rooting seedlings. The invention establishes the hydroponic culture system of the avocado seeds and the tissue culture seedlings by utilizing the avocado hydroponic culture solution formula, the culture technology and the matched equipment thereof and by methods of staged culture and the like, improves the rooting efficiency, the seed germination rate, the seedling rate and the survival rate of the avocado, and reduces the root rotting rate.

title_en: Egg skin forming machine for processing egg meat rolls
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of food processing, and particularly discloses an egg skin forming machine for processing egg meat rolls, which comprises: a stable seat; a first case; a second case; the egg storage bin is arranged at one end of the second box body, which is far away from the first box body; the eggshell separating device is fixedly arranged inside the second box body; a shaping and guiding device; a linkage pressing device; wherein the eggshell separation apparatus comprises: the material collecting bin assembly is fixedly connected with the inside of the second box body; propelling movement cleaning device, propelling movement cleaning device and the inside sliding connection of collection feed bin subassembly, this device realizes the effective separation of egg liquid and eggshell through inside collection feed bin subassembly and propelling movement cleaning device cooperation, and the linkage is pressed and is covered the device and can be carried out many times and press and cover the design, has further improved egg skin shaping quality, and simultaneously, the synchronous drive is scraped and is moved the subassembly, realizes the automatic conveying of leading of egg skin.

title_en: Granular feed machine for breeding
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of feed machines, in particular to a granular feed machine for cultivation, which comprises a rack; the inner layer forming unit for producing the inner layer feed is connected with the upper end of the frame; the outer layer forming unit for forming the outer layer feed outside the inner layer feed is arranged on the rack at the lower part of the inner layer forming unit; the cutting unit for intermittently blocking extrusion and intermittently cutting the feed integrally formed on the inner layer and the outer layer is positioned at the lower end of the outer layer forming unit and is connected with the rack; the inner layer forming unit and the outer layer forming unit are matched to work, so that the feed with an inner layer and an outer layer can be produced, the quality of the feed can be improved, the production cost of the feed can be reduced, and the feeding effect of poultry or livestock can be improved.

title_en: Adaptive tractor suspension hydraulic pressure intensity of rise and fall mechanism
abstract_en: The invention relates to an adaptive tractor suspension hydraulic pressure intensity lifting mechanism which comprises a lifting shaft and lifting outer arms, wherein the lifting shaft is rotatably arranged on the tractor hydraulic pressure, splines are arranged at two ends of the lifting shaft respectively, magic sleeves are symmetrically arranged at two ends of the lifting shaft on the splines respectively in a sleeved mode, a rotating cavity which is used for containing the magic sleeves and can be in rotating fit with the magic sleeves is arranged at one end of each lifting outer arm, and the inner diameter of the rotating cavity is equal to the outer diameter of each magic sleeve. The multifunctional hinge base can be matched with the lifting shafts of almost all types of tractors on the market through the magic sleeve and the n-shaped multifunctional hinge base on the lifting outer arm, the magic sleeve and the rotating cavity of the lifting outer arm are matched to rotate, the lifting outer arm is supported by the lifting shafts and the multifunctional hinge base is connected with the piston rod of the oil cylinder by taking the hydraulic oil cylinder as power, and the rear suspension mechanism of the tractor is driven to perform strong lifting and strong lifting operation.

title_en: Self-curing 3D printing biological ink and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses self-curing 3D printing biological ink and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the field of biomedical materials. The biological ink comprises hydroxyapatite, a calcium silicate-based self-curing material and a polyether F127 solution, wherein the calcium silicate-based self-curing material is selected from one or more of tricalcium silicate and dicalcium silicate; the mass ratio of the hydroxyapatite to the silico-calcium based self-curing material is (0.05-20): 1; the mass concentration of the polyether F127 solution is 5% -25%; the ratio of the total mass of the hydroxyapatite and calcium silicate based self-curing material to the mass of the polyether F127 solution is 1: (0.25-0.5). The invention overcomes the defects of poor self-curing characteristic of alpha-TCP and complex preparation process of organic binder in the prior art, is easy for 3D printing and forming, can be cured automatically under mild conditions, can load medicines, proteins, growth factors and the like, and can realize co-printing with bioactive substances.

title_en: Material screening machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of screening machines, in particular to a material screening machine which comprises a storehouse body, wherein the side wall of the storehouse body is rotatably connected with a plurality of rotating shafts, the surface of one rotating shaft is fixedly connected with a clamping wheel, the side surface of the clamping wheel is lapped with a conveying belt, the side surface of the storehouse body is fixedly connected with a motor, the top end of the storehouse body is fixedly connected with a grain inlet, the bottom of the storehouse body is fixedly connected with a grain outlet, a first layer of conveying belt is arranged into an oval sieve mesh, a rotating shaft 2 where a first layer of conveying belt 4 is arranged is fixedly connected with the side surface of the output end of a motor 7, so that the first layer of conveying belt shakes in the transferring process, grains are prevented from being accumulated in a certain position, the grains can fall from the sieve mesh, the screening speed is accelerated, and the design of a ventilation opening realizes the drying of the grains on the conveying belt and the separation of light impurities such as rice hulls.

title_en: Hollow mesoporous silicon sphere modified liquid crystal polymer film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of liquid crystal polymer films, and particularly relates to a modified liquid crystal polymer film and a preparation method and application thereof. The modified liquid crystal polymer film comprises the following components: liquid crystal polymer, coupling agent, hollow mesoporous silicon spheres, antioxidant and dispersant. According to the technical scheme provided by the invention, the dielectric constant and the dielectric loss value of the liquid crystal polymer film can be effectively reduced by adding a proper amount of hollow mesoporous silicon spheres, and the thickness uniformity of the film is improved. In addition, the addition of the dispersing agent and the coupling agent can effectively promote the uniform dispersion and the interfacial interaction of the filler in the liquid crystal polymer matrix and improve the film forming property. The prepared liquid crystal polymer composite film has low hygroscopicity, low dielectric constant and dielectric loss, high temperature resistance, excellent mechanical property and good thickness uniformity, and can be applied to the manufacture of high-frequency high-speed flexible printed circuit boards.

title_en: A smart volume seed metering ware for maize breeding is experimental
abstract_en: The invention discloses a precise seed sowing device for a corn breeding test, and relates to the technical field of agricultural planting equipment; the two seeding supports are oppositely fixed on the seed sowing base frame from left to right; the seed cylinder is fixed between the horizontal ends of the left seeding bracket and the right seeding bracket; the feed hopper is embedded and fixed on the upper side of the seed cylinder; the seed-dressing brackets are respectively fixed on the outer ring wall of the rotating shaft in an equal-number and equal-angle circumferential distribution manner; the seed discharging frame is arranged at the lower side of the seed cylinder body and is fixed at the bottom of the horizontal end in the seeding bracket; the movable plug is arranged at the lower side of the seed cylinder body; the upper side surface of the movable plug is arranged in an arc structure; the plug body moving mechanism is arranged on the lower side of the movable plug; the connecting table is fixed on the lower side of the seed arranging frame; the quantity control mechanism is arranged on the lower side of the connecting table; the corn seed dressing machine can be used for dressing corn seeds before seed discharging, can control the seeding distance between the corn seeds, and improves the efficiency of manual seeding and the quality of seeding.

title_en: Microenvironment artificial intervention auxiliary device and method for mountain forest dendrobium nobile cultivation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of agriculture and forestry planting, and discloses a microenvironment artificial intervention auxiliary device and method for mountain forest planting of dendrobium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: weaving the straw ropes to form a ladder type straw rope group; winding the ladder type straw rope group, spirally winding the ladder type straw rope group on a tree, and arranging a water receiving tank at the bottom of the tree; controlling humidity, and arranging a water tank on the trees; the bottom of the water tank is provided with an atomizing nozzle, and the top of the water tank is led with a plurality of water diversion ropes; temperature control, a plurality of burners are arranged; when the growth humidity of the dendrobium is lower: spraying water mist through an atomizing nozzle; and/or water is absorbed from the water receiving tank through the grass rope group; and/or absorbing water from the water-retaining water moss through the grass rope group; and/or leading water from the water tank to the root of the dendrobium through a water leading rope; when the growth temperature of the dendrobium is lower: the heat is radiated to the dendrobium by the combustion of the fuel in the burner. The device and the method have the advantages that natural resources in mountain forests are fully utilized, and the energy consumption is low; and the intervention is simple and convenient, and the wild planting cost of the dendrobium can be effectively reduced.

title_en: Pond river crab accurate bait casting method based on river crab growth model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pond river crab accurate bait casting method based on a river crab growth model. Determining an environmental factor which has the greatest influence on the growth and development of the river crabs by utilizing a grey correlation degree analysis method, and constructing an accurate bait casting expert system based on a GA-BP neural network. Firstly, through inputting environmental parameters and through GA-BP neural network training, the optimal environmental impact factor value is calculated. And step two, obtaining the total bait feeding amount of the pond. And thirdly, scientifically distributing the total bait feeding amount to each area of the pond. And fourthly, arranging monitoring feeding platforms in a plurality of representative water areas of the pond, and feeding back and correcting the bait distribution amount of each area to realize the purpose of accurate bait casting for river crab culture. The method can adjust the bait feeding amount in real time according to the change of environmental parameters and the actual feeding condition of the river crabs, so that the feeding is more accurate, the growth and development of the river crabs are facilitated, the yield is increased, the high-specification river crabs are cultured, and the culture benefit is improved.

title_en: Manufacturing method and application of light-weight high-strength male mold suitable for large-scale composite material structural member
abstract_en: The invention relates to a light high-strength positive mold manufacturing method and application suitable for large-scale composite material structural members, and belongs to the field of composite material and framework filling and manufacturing male molds. Meanwhile, the surface of the core mould is made of a soluble core mould, so that the strength is high, and deformation is not easy to occur in the forming process. Therefore, the light high-strength male mold manufacturing technology is an efficient and environment-friendly framework filling method and male mold manufacturing technology, and can provide a more excellent male mold manufacturing solution for composite material molding.

title_en: Environment-friendly polypropylene composite material for 3D printing and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to an environment-friendly polypropylene composite material for 3D printing and a preparation method thereof, wherein the environment-friendly polypropylene composite material for 3D printing comprises the following components in parts by weight: 100 parts of polypropylene, 30-40 parts of UHMWPE, 40-50 parts of PLA, 10-20 parts of diatomite, 3-5 parts of PP-g-GMA and 0.5 part of antioxidant; the preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, mixing PP-g-GMA with diatomite, extruding the mixture through a double screw to obtain an intermediate product A, uniformly mixing the intermediate product A with polypropylene, UHMWPE, PLA and an antioxidant to obtain a mixed raw material, and finally, placing the mixed raw material into a double screw extruder for melt extrusion granulation to obtain the environment-friendly polypropylene composite material for 3D printing. According to the application, the compatibility of PP and PLA is improved through the intermediate of PP-g-GMA and diatomite mixed extrusion, so that the PP material has better adhesiveness, can be better used in the 3D printing industry, and has the advantages of higher impact strength, low odor, environmental protection and the like.

title_en: Portable trawl net hauling and fish unloading system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable trawl net lifting and fish unloading system, which comprises a foundation storage structure, wherein an angle regulation structure is arranged at one side of the upper end of the foundation storage structure; the rolling transmission structure is arranged at one side of the outside of the angle regulating structure; a fish plate provided on one side of the outside of the base housing structure; the closed sealing structures are arranged at two sides of the lower end of the fish placing plate; the bottom of the lower end of the rolling transmission structure is provided with a fishing collecting structure. This portable trawl plays net and unloads fish system, the fishing net main part is upwards lifted to accomplish the fishing operation, and when going up and down to a certain extent, can make the fishing net main part lower extreme be the opening form through the rear end collecting beam line of not hard up fishing net main part lower extreme, make the fish drop out, in order to reach the purpose of quick unloading the fish, available rotating electrical machines in addition, reverse drive control room carries out angle modulation, thereby change the fishing position of fishing net, can more accurate carry out the fishing operation.

title_en: Geocell with wing type nested structure and processing and mounting method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geocell with a wing type nested structure and a processing and installing method thereof, wherein a plurality of geocell units are connected in an array arrangement mode, and each geocell unit is formed by mutually nested welding of a unit body, a first wing plate and a second wing plate which are mutually nested; the pair of first wing plates and the pair of second wing plates form a three-dimensional structure at the opening of the unit body in a mutually nested mode, the first wing plates and the second wing plates supplement each other, the first wing plates provide transverse support for the structure, the second wing plates provide vertical counter force, and meanwhile holes are uniformly formed according to structural characteristics so as to meet the requirement of drainage; the first wing plate is quadrangular, the middle of the top edge of the first wing plate is provided with an r-shaped notch, and the second wing plate is trapezoidal; the geocell has the characteristics of large tension, high strength, difficult cracking and long service life by the arrangement of the nested structure, and has good drainage performance.

title_en: Rare earth doped glass with ultra-wideband near-infrared fluorescence emission and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides rare earth doped glass with ultra-wideband near-infrared fluorescence emission, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the rare earth doped glass takes tellurate glass as a glass substrate and rare earth oxide as a doping substance, and consists of the following components in percentage by mole: 0.3-0.4 mol% of Pr 6 O 11 0.05-0.15 mol% of Tm 2 O 3 0.15-0.35 mol% Er 2 O 3 60-63 mol% of TeO 2 27 to 30mol percent of ZnO and 5 to 8mol percent of WO 3 2-5 mol% of Bi 2 O 3 . The rare earth doped glass has a better spectral width range and a flatter spectrumThe transmission meets the requirements of being applied to electronic devices such as optical fiber amplifiers, tunable optical fiber lasers and the like, and provides a better choice for the electronic devices.

title_en: Control mechanism and lawn mower
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mowers, and particularly discloses an operating mechanism and a mower. The mechanism is suitable for a mower to control the mower to work and comprises a frame module, a rotating module, a potentiometer main body, a connecting bracket and a resetting piece; the frame module is fixedly arranged on the mower; the rotating module has an initial position relative to the frame module and is rotatably mounted on the frame module from the initial position, and the rotating module is provided with a butt joint part; the potentiometer main body outputs a voltage signal according to the rotation state of the rotation module; the connecting bracket is provided with a limiting part, and the butting part is matched with the limiting part so as to limit the rotating angle of the rotating module relative to the frame module; the reset piece is installed in the frame module, and when the rotating module rotates relative to the frame module from an initial position, the reset piece provides a movement reset trend for the rotating module. The design of the connecting support realizes the automatic reset of the rotating module, and avoids abnormal sound when the rotating module rotates.

title_en: Can prevent puncher for toughened glass processing that skids
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-slip perforating machine for processing toughened glass, and relates to the technical field of toughened glass production equipment; the two clamping mechanisms are respectively and fixedly arranged on the left side and the right side of the bottom surface of the top plate; the upper side of the clamping mechanism is connected with a symmetrical adjusting mechanism arranged on the top surface of the top plate; the anti-slip punching mechanism is arranged on the bottom surface of the sliding block in the transverse sliding rail pair; the two roller conveyors are movably embedded on the left side and the right side of the operating platform respectively; the upper side surface of a roller of the roller conveyor is exposed at the upper side of the operating platform; the roller conveyer is connected with an external power supply; the supporting mechanism is arranged in the middle of the operating platform; can carry on spacingly to the upper and lower and left and right sides position of the drill bit that punches, effectually prevent to produce the phenomenon of skidding at the in-process drill bit that punches on the toughened glass board, conveniently carry out the last unloading of toughened glass board simultaneously, the centre gripping is more stable, and then convenient follow-up operation of punching.

title_en: Winding and unwinding mechanism for asphalt waterproof coiled material production and processing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a winding and unwinding mechanism for producing and processing asphalt waterproof coiled materials, which belongs to the technical field of coiled material winding and unwinding and comprises a support, wherein two side surfaces of the support are integrally connected with sliding plates, sliding grooves are formed in the sliding plates, side plates are connected in the sliding grooves of the sliding plates in a sliding manner, telescopic rods are simultaneously arranged in the sliding grooves of the sliding plates, the outer surfaces of the telescopic rods and the side plates are in pin joint, a motor is arranged on the outer side of the side plates, a driving end of the motor penetrates through the side plates and is connected with a rotating shaft, an engagement mechanism is arranged on the rotating shaft, a winding roller is connected between the engagement mechanisms, and a tension mechanism is arranged on the upper surface of the support and in front of the side plates. Can conveniently fix the roller through the interlock mechanism that sets up, also guarantee the stability of roller simultaneously, through the tension mechanism that sets up, can be at the in-process of receiving and releasing the coiled material, the elasticity condition of control coiled material for the coiled material can be compacter, and can make the waterproofing membrane of putting down at the uniform velocity and level at the process of unreeling.

title_en: Light supplementing device and method based on thermoluminescent material
abstract_en: The invention relates to a light supplementing device and a method based on a thermoluminescent material, wherein the light supplementing device comprises a lamp body component and a light collecting plate used for receiving, storing and/or utilizing light energy in light rays, the lamp body component can determine illumination parameters according to the type and growth state of a target plant planted in a corresponding breeding area, the light collecting plate can be obliquely arranged to enable one side of the light collecting plate to receive the light rays emitted by a lamp body unit, the light rays falling in a light emitting area can excite a plurality of thermoluminescent crystals arranged in the light emitting area, the light rays falling in a heat collecting area can be stored and/or transmitted in a form of being converted into heat energy, and the light rays irradiated to the light collecting plate by the lamp body unit at least comprise escaping light rays passing through gaps between stems and leaves of the target plant.

title_en: Modularized vertical liquid flow plant hydroponic unit, hydroponic device and hydroponic system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of plant cultivation, and discloses a modularized vertical liquid flow plant water planting unit, a water planting device and a water planting system, wherein the modularized vertical liquid flow plant water planting unit comprises an installation body, a flow guide core and at least one planting plate, the planting plate is fixed on the side surface of the installation body, the flow guide core is fixed in the installation body, a vertical flow channel is formed between the side surface of the flow guide core and the planting plate, planting holes which are arranged in an array are arranged on the planting plate, the top of the installation body is provided with a water inlet, the bottom of the installation body is provided with a water outlet, a plurality of transverse diversion bulges are arranged at intervals from top to bottom on the side face of the diversion core towards the planting plate, diversion grooves are formed between the adjacent diversion bulges, the positions of the diversion grooves correspond to the positions of planting holes on the planting plate, and the diversion bulges can increase the contact area of plant roots, so that stable and uniform growth of objects is ensured.

title_en: Strengthened glass with scratch resistance and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a strengthened glass with scratch resistance and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the field of glass manufacturing. The tempered glass is provided with a glass body, wherein an ion exchange layer and an intrinsic layer are sequentially distributed on the glass body in a direction extending from the surface to the inside, and the sum of the depth of the ion exchange layer and the depth of the intrinsic layer is less than 1100 mu m; scratch-resistant critical load P on surface of ion exchange layer L At a load of 1KG, a scratch width W of 35N or more L Below 80 μm; scratch-resistant critical load P of this certificate layer 0 At a load of 1KG, a scratch width W of 30N or more O Below 100 μm. The tempered glass has strong intrinsic property and mechanical property, and simultaneously has good scratch resistance, thereby having wide application prospect.

title_en: Intrinsic low-dielectric fluorine-containing polyimide film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of polyimide films, and particularly relates to an intrinsic low-dielectric fluorine-containing polyimide film and a preparation method thereof. The intrinsic low-dielectric fluorine-containing polyimide film is obtained by polycondensation reaction of 4,4 '-diamino-3, 3' -bis (trifluoromethyl) diphenylcyclohexane and aromatic dianhydride monomer, wherein the 4,4 '-diamino-3, 3' -bis (trifluoromethyl) diphenylcyclohexane is synthesized by raw materials of fluorinated 4,4 '-diamino-3, 3' -dimethyl diphenylcyclohexane. The polarizability of the C-F bond of the strong-polarity fluorine-containing group introduced into the molecular chain is low, and meanwhile, the fluorine-containing group and the alicyclic structure destroy the regularity of the molecular chain, increase the space gap of molecules, reduce the number of polarized molecules in a unit volume of the material and reduce the dielectric constant of the material; the molecular structure contains a large proportion of rigid structure benzene ring and nitrogen-containing hybridization, so that the fluorine-containing polyimide has excellent heat resistance and dimensional stability.

title_en: Multi-light fusion sighting telescope and multi-light fusion method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-light fusion sighting telescope and a multi-light fusion method, wherein the multi-light fusion sighting telescope comprises a shell, and a visible light imaging component, an infrared thermal imaging component, a dividing component and a prism component which are arranged in the shell, wherein the visible light imaging component comprises a visible light channel, a spectroscope is arranged in the visible light channel, the infrared thermal imaging component and the dividing component are respectively arranged at two sides of the prism component, and the prism component forms transmission on an infrared image of the infrared thermal imaging component and refracts a dividing image of the dividing component, so that the infrared image and the dividing image are fused after passing through the prism component; the spectroscope transmits the visible light image of the visible light imaging component and reflects the infrared image and/or the division image, so that the visible light image, the infrared image and/or the division image are fused after passing through the spectroscope, and the all-weather use requirement of a user can be met.

title_en: Preparation method of semi-solid armillaria mellea strain
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for preparing semi-solid Armillaria mellea strain, which prepares an Armillaria mellea stock culture medium into a semi-solid shape of jelly, wherein the semi-solid shape has both solid and liquid, and the germination speed, growth speed and purity (yield) of an Armillaria mellea stock culture on the stock culture medium are obviously improved; meanwhile, when the Armillaria mellea cultivar is prepared, the culture medium of the sealing covering material is prepared, so that the germination speed and the growth speed of the stock on the culture medium of the cultivar are obviously improved, the stock is quickly sealed, the mixed bacteria pollution is reduced, and the yield of the cultivar is improved by 5-8%; during culturing Armillaria mellea, the growth temperature of mycelium is regulated at different stages, i.e. early stage culture temperature is 15-18 deg.C, middle and late stage culture temperature is 22-24 deg.C, and preservation temperature is controlled at 4-8 deg.C. The process realizes the scientization, the uniqueness and the precision of the armillaria mellea strain production, and lays a solid foundation for the large-scale and industrial strain production.

title_en: Soil arrangement is with integrative equipment of ditching loosening soil
abstract_en: The invention discloses ditching and soil loosening integrated equipment for soil preparation, which belongs to the technical field of land ditching, and comprises a rubber belt, wherein a supporting mechanism for supporting the shape of the rubber belt is arranged on the inner side of the rubber belt, a plurality of groups of soil digging mechanisms for digging soil and ditching are arranged on the side wall of the rubber belt at equal intervals, each group of soil digging mechanisms comprises a plurality of direction rods in rows at equal intervals, the direction rods are perpendicular to the outer surface of the rubber belt and are rotatably arranged on the side wall of the rubber belt, a bent digging plate is fixedly arranged on the direction rods positioned on the outer side of the rubber belt, and direction synchronous wheels are coaxially and fixedly arranged at the ends of the direction rods positioned at the lower end of the rubber belt; the invention solves the problem that the prior chain type ditcher usually adopts the fixed scraper to rotate around the chain to dig out soil below the ground, and the fixed scraper can not change the direction and move to the upper end of the ground along with the chain, so that the excavated side of the excavating plate faces upwards, the excavating plate can not efficiently discharge the mud, and the excavating efficiency is low because the fixed scraper carries the soil to rotate back and forth.

title_en: Hydrolyzed protein composition with improved flavor and method for preparing the same
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydrolyzed protein composition for improving flavor, which comprises maltodextrin, hydrolyzed protein powder, anionic polysaccharide, compound mineral substances, compound vitamins, vegetable fat powder, edible essence and sweetener; the composition adopts the anionic polysaccharide to improve the astringency caused by hydrolyzed protein and metal cation salt in the compound mineral, improves the use pleasure of consumers, improves the sensory acceptability and the dependency, and further plays a better role in supporting nutrition for people with limited eating, digestive absorption disorder, metabolic disorder and nutrient supplement; the pure dry mixing process is simple and convenient to operate, and saves working procedures and energy consumption.

title_en: Double-sided laminating device for sandwich insulation board
abstract_en: The invention provides a double-sided laminating device for a sandwich insulation board, which comprises a rack, a conveying assembly, a storage frame and a movable plate, wherein: the rack is horizontally arranged, and the conveying assembly is arranged on the rack; the storage frame is arranged on the rack and positioned above the conveying assembly, and an opening at the bottom end of the storage frame is positioned above the conveying assembly; the conveying assembly comprises a fixing plate, the fixing plate is horizontally arranged on the rack, a rectangular slideway is formed in the fixing plate along the length direction of the fixing plate, and the sandwich heat-insulation plate can slide on the rectangular slideway. The feeding device is novel in design and simple in operation, the plurality of sandwich insulation boards in the storage frame can slide on the rectangular slide way on the conveying assembly through the arrangement of the conveying assembly, the pushing mechanisms can sequentially push the plurality of sandwich insulation boards on the rectangular slide way, the end parts of the sandwich insulation boards slide on the rectangular slide way, the upper side and the lower side of the sandwich insulation boards are in an empty state, the subsequent film coating treatment on the upper side and the lower side of the sandwich insulation boards is facilitated, and the feeding device is simple in operation.

title_en: Automatic processing equipment for concrete test block
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an automatic concrete test block processing equipment relates to the technical field of concrete test block processing, and it includes feeding transport mechanism, compaction device and ejection of compact transport mechanism that sets gradually, feeding transport mechanism, compaction device and ejection of compact transport mechanism place the position and be L shape, the last compaction case that has placed of feeding transport mechanism, compaction device keeps away from feeding transport mechanism's one end is provided with the pouring device, the pouring device is used for to pour concrete in the compaction case; the utility model discloses a discharging conveyor, including ejection of compact conveying mechanism, vibrating device, ejection of compact conveying mechanism, vibrating device keep away from one end of ejection of compact conveying mechanism is provided with pusher, pusher includes push pedal and second cylinder, the push pedal is the rectangle, the second cylinder sets firmly the push pedal deviates from one side of vibrating device, the push pedal is followed under the effect of second cylinder ejection of compact conveying mechanism's length direction promotes the case that shakes. The application has the effects of saving time and labor and improving the manufacturing efficiency of the concrete test block.

title_en: Three-dimensional simulation test method for directional drilling grouting
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional simulation test method for directional drilling grouting, and relates to the technical field of mine water damage grouting treatment. The test system comprises a test bed, a grouting device, a pressure-bearing water sump device and a data monitoring device, wherein the grouting device provides grouting conditions required by experiments for the test bed, the pressure-bearing water sump device provides running water conditions required by the experiments for the test bed, and the data monitoring device realizes the functions of dynamic monitoring and information processing of the experimental process. Through presetting the grouting branch pipes in the laying process of the test sample, after the grouting branch pipes are laid, the overall shape formed by all grouting port positions is in a feathered shape or a fan shape, and the test simulation of directional drilling three-dimensional grouting can be realized. The test method can study the diffusion and storage mechanism of the slurry in the water guide and storage space, and explore the grouting transformation mechanism of the target rock stratum and the rule of slurry water driving diffusion under the condition of water driving by adopting different grouting branch hole layout modes.

title_en: Seed soaking, chest breaking and germination accelerating temperature control device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a seed soaking, chest breaking and germination accelerating temperature control device, which comprises a controller, a seed soaking box, a water storage tank and a heater, wherein the controller comprises: the seed soaking device is characterized in that the water storage tank is connected with a water source, a heater and a seed soaking tank, the water storage tank is connected with the seed soaking tank through a water conveying pipeline, the seed soaking tank is connected with the heater, a temperature sensor and a water level sensor are arranged in the seed soaking tank, and the controller executes instructions according to a set program to control other devices to work. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of accurate temperature setting, real-time control and the like.

title_en: Promote indoor planting vegetation's LED light
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of plant growth lamps, and discloses an LED illuminating lamp for promoting the growth of indoor planted plants, which comprises a housing, wherein a connecting assembly is arranged on one side of the housing, a fixing assembly is movably arranged in the housing, the fixing assembly is provided with an illuminating lamp in a matching manner, the illuminating lamp is electrically connected with the connecting assembly, an installation assembly is arranged on the fixing assembly, the installation assembly is detachably connected with the housing, and a cleaning assembly for cleaning the outer surface of the illuminating lamp is movably arranged on the fixing assembly.

title_en: Rain-sheltering cultivation method for reducing disease occurrence of polygonatum sibiricum
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rain sheltering cultivation method for reducing the occurrence of polygonatum sibiricum diseases, and belongs to the field of crop cultivation. The method comprises the steps of land selection, land preparation, simple rain shelter construction, tuber treatment, sealwort planting and management, wherein biological preparations such as trichoderma harzianum, bacillus subtilis and the like are sprayed in the management step. The invention effectively solves the problems of diseases, insect pests and weeds through the rain shelter and the biological agent, improves the yield of rhizoma polygonati and provides an effective method for developing pollution-free agricultural products.

title_en: Application of hierarchical porous structure polymer material as slow-release base material
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application of a hierarchical porous structure polymer material as a slow release base material, and belongs to the field of slow release materials. The density of the hierarchical porous structure polymer material is 0.20-0.60 g/cm 3 And has a multi-level pore structure. The abundant pore structure of the material can realize that the active substance is gradually adsorbed, permeated and analyzed through the internal and external pressure difference of the slow-release base material and the affinity between the active substance and the molecules of the slow-release base material, and the process determines that the active substance is released into the external environment at a stable speed, so that the slow-release action time is long and the effect is stable; in addition, the material has the performance characteristics of heat insulation and preservation due to the multi-level pore structure, and can effectively avoid the potential safety hazards and the like caused by inactivation, accelerated volatilization and overlarge internal pressure of active substances due to external light and heat stimulation; on the other hand, the hierarchical porous structure polymer material has excellent mechanical property and machining property, and can be processed into a sustained-release base material device with an independent structure.

title_en: Online detection method for stress condition of substrate in selective laser melting process
abstract_en: The invention relates to an online detection method for stress condition of a substrate in a selective laser melting process, which is characterized in that a detection value output by a strain gauge in real time is received in the selective laser melting process, wherein the strain gauge is fixed on the surface opposite to the forming surface of a substrate sample, and the stress condition of the substrate is obtained according to the relationship between the stress of the substrate and the output detection value of the strain gauge obtained by calibration in advance.

title_en: Automatic peanut seeder
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of peanut planting, in particular to an automatic peanut seeding device, which comprises a travelling vehicle body, a peanut sowing device and a peanut sowing device, wherein the travelling vehicle body can move along a farmland; the traveling vehicle body is sequentially provided with a soil loosening assembly, a barrier lifting assembly, a sorting drilling and seeding assembly and a pesticide spraying assembly backwards along the front end, and is used for sequentially performing soil loosening, barrier lifting, seeding and pesticide spraying operations in the moving process along with the traveling vehicle body. The automatic peanut seeding device can realize the sequential operations of loosening the soil, starting the peanut, seeding and spraying pesticide in the process of moving along with the travelling vehicle body. Above-mentioned each work assembly adopts the subregion to arrange the mode of complementary interference, can realize carrying out the hierarchical operation of peanut seeding in the farmland in order, and each process continuity is higher, compares artifical planting and has promoted seeding efficiency by a wide margin.

title_en: Seedling raising substrate and production method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a seedling raising substrate and a production method thereof. In particular to a preparation method of a seedling raising substrate. The rice seedlings cultured by the seedling raising base material soil release culture method are dense and good in growth vigor, and the components of the seedling raising base material are easy to degrade and good in biocompatibility.

title_en: Preparation method of high-strength high-elasticity plant protein hydrogel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of high-strength high-elasticity pea protein hydrogel, which relates to the technical field of hydrogel material preparation, and comprises the steps of pea protein isolate extraction, protein hydration, low-temperature precooling of NaOH solution and protein, preparation of protein alkaline solution, addition of a cross-linking agent, defoaming, water bath heating cross-linking, and cooling to form gel. The invention adopts low-temperature alkaline condition to pretreat protein, compared with the traditional method for heating to denature protein, the method has the advantages that the protein molecular chain is expanded to a greater extent, the network structure formed by crosslinking is tighter under the action of the crosslinking agent, the prepared gel has better strength and elasticity and good water holding performance, and the plant protein gel can not deform or damage after being soaked in water for a long time, so that the plant protein gel can be applied to wider fields.

title_en: Saline-alkali soil modifier and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a saline-alkali soil conditioner and a preparation method and application thereof, relating to the technical field of resource utilization of solid wastes and soil environment treatment; the preparation method of the saline-alkali soil modifier comprises the following steps: drying, crushing, pyrolyzing and condensing straws to prepare a pyrolysis liquid; uniformly mixing the pyrolysis liquid with an ammonium sulfate solution and ethanol according to parts by weight to prepare a mixed solution; the modifier is obtained by ultrasonic and centrifugation of the mixed solution. The invention can effectively improve the physicochemical property of the saline-alkali soil, improve the contents of total organic matters, quick-acting nitrogen, phosphorus and potassium in the soil, improve the activity of enzyme in the soil and effectively reduce the alkalinity of the saline-alkali soil.

title_en: Dental model fixing seat and dental model machining process
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of dental product manufacturing, in particular to a dental model fixing seat and a dental model processing technology, wherein the dental model fixing seat comprises: the device comprises a fixed seat, a mounting seat and a pouring mold; the mounting seat is fixedly mounted on the jaw frame, a mounting mechanism is arranged between the mounting seat and the fixing seat, and the fixing seat is detachably mounted on the mounting seat through the mounting mechanism; and a fixing seat mounting hole matched with the fixing seat is formed in the bottom of the pouring mold. Can dismantle between fixing base and the mount pad in this scheme, fixing base and tooth mould are pour simultaneously, can reduce the use of the gypsum of pouring, shorten the height of gypsum, also reduce the renovation to the gypsum of pouring to simplified originally and need pour twice processing technology, thereby improved production efficiency, reduced manufacturing cost.

title_en: Self-adaptive clamping and transferring device and method for monocrystalline silicon material
abstract_en: The invention relates to a device and a method for adaptively clamping and transferring monocrystalline silicon feeding, which comprises a feeding mechanism and a transferring mechanism which is positioned beside the feeding mechanism and used for receiving monocrystalline silicon, wherein the feeding mechanism comprises a feeding rack and a feeding rack which is hinged on the feeding rack and is driven by a feeding driving mechanism to rotate, the transferring mechanism comprises a sliding table and a transferring clamping jaw used for clamping monocrystalline silicon, the transferring mechanism is provided with a monocrystalline silicon rod clamping mechanism beside, the monocrystalline silicon rod clamping mechanism comprises a rotary lower clamping piece used for bearing a monocrystalline silicon rod and an upper clamping piece which is positioned above the rotary lower clamping piece and is driven by a clamping driving device to press the monocrystalline silicon rod downwards, the invention provides a device for adaptively clamping and transferring monocrystalline silicon feeding, the feeding and transferring of the monocrystalline silicon rod can be realized through the combination of a placing rack and a clamping jaw set, the feeding time is shortened, the conveying efficiency of the rod is improved, and the self-adaptive clamping and clamping mechanism is utilized, the actual axial gravity center of the silicon crystal bar can be found, and the silicon crystal bar is stably erected by means of the locking device.

title_en: Tire bead wire separating device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of recovery processing equipment, in particular to a tire bead wire separating device which comprises a separating rack, a workpiece cutting assembly, a workpiece conveying device and a wire separating assembly, wherein the workpiece conveying device is arranged on the outer side of the separating rack, and the workpiece cutting assembly is arranged above the separating rack; the tire steel wire cutting device is characterized in that the workpiece cutting assembly comprises a telescopic cylinder, the output end of the telescopic cylinder is connected with a push rod, the other end of the push rod is connected with a rotating mechanism, a workpiece pressing frame and a pressing frame limiting spring are sleeved outside the push rod, transverse bidirectional screw rod sliding tables are arranged on two sides of the output end of the rotating mechanism, and the transverse bidirectional screw rod sliding tables are connected with vertical bidirectional screw rod sliding tables.

title_en: Special combined workbench for rapid single person assembly and disassembly of multi-cavity blow molding die
abstract_en: The application discloses a special combined workbench for rapid single person assembly and disassembly of a multi-cavity blow molding die, which comprises a mounting frame, wherein a roller mechanism is arranged in the middle of the upper end surface of the mounting frame, a first disassembly and assembly mechanism and a second disassembly and assembly mechanism are respectively arranged on two sides of the roller mechanism, and the first disassembly and assembly mechanism and the second disassembly and assembly mechanism are symmetrically arranged in structure; the roller mechanism is lifted by a lifting mechanism. The application has the beneficial effects that the blow molding die can be quickly disassembled and assembled by a single person, so that the operation can be performed, the time and the labor are saved, the operation efficiency is higher, and the application is convenient for industrial popularization and use.

title_en: Preparation device and preparation process for preparing polymethacrylimide foam plastic
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation device and a preparation process for preparing polymethacrylimide foam plastic in the field of plastic foam preparation, wherein the preparation device comprises a water bath barrel provided with a heating mechanism, a forming die is fixedly arranged in the water bath barrel, a stirring mechanism and a telescopic mechanism for driving the stirring mechanism to stretch out and draw back are arranged on the bottom surface of the forming die, the stirring mechanism is vertically and slidably arranged on the bottom surface of the forming die, and the telescopic mechanism drives the bottom surface of the forming die to vertically move so that the top surface of the stirring mechanism is flush with the bottom surface of the forming die. According to the invention, when high-temperature prepolymerization is needed, raw materials in the forming die are heated in a water bath and stirred by the stirring mechanism to promote the prepolymerization; when low-temperature polymerization is needed, the forming die is driven to leave the water bath, and the top surface of the stirring mechanism is parallel to the bottom surface of the forming die, so that the raw materials in the forming die can be polymerized into a complete block.

title_en: Synchronous driving device for segmented mold of vertical mechanical vulcanizing machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a synchronous driving device of a vertical mechanical vulcanizer segmented mold, comprising a frame, a fixed mold is fixedly arranged on one side surface of the frame, a right-angle support is fixedly arranged on one end surface of the frame, a first telescopic rod is fixedly arranged on one end surface of the right-angle support, a movable mold is slidably arranged on a rod head of the first telescopic rod, the movable mold is positioned at one end of the fixed mold, a second telescopic rod is fixedly arranged on the other end surface of the frame, a U-shaped driving frame is fixedly connected with the rod head of the second telescopic rod, an open slot is arranged on the side surface of the U-shaped driving frame, a driving cylinder is fixedly arranged on the side surface of the open slot, a piston is slidably arranged on the side surface of one end of the driving cylinder, a driving rod is fixedly connected with the surface of one side of the piston, and the surface of the driving rod is slidably connected with the side surface of the other end of the driving cylinder, therefore, the convenience and the stability of use can be greatly improved, and the safety and the high efficiency of drive adjustment are ensured.

title_en: Hydraulic engineering slope protection structure and method
