abstract_en: The application discloses a hydraulic engineering slope protection structure and a hydraulic engineering slope protection method, the hydraulic engineering slope protection structure comprises a slope body and a planting area which is arranged on an inclined surface of the slope body and is used for planting plants, a water storage cavity for storing water is arranged in the slope body, the water storage cavity is communicated with a river channel through a communicating water channel, a water storage tank for storing water is arranged on one side of the slope body, which is close to the planting area, an overflow pipe for draining water is arranged on one side of the water storage tank, a guide groove corresponding to the overflow pipe is arranged on the inclined surface of the slope body, and the lower end of the guide groove is communicated with a water absorption area of an inner cavity of the planting area.

title_en: VOC plank processing high accuracy spraying plastics device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-precision plastic spraying device for VOC (volatile organic compound) board processing, which relates to the technical field of VCO (voltage controlled oscillator) boards and comprises a plastic spraying mechanism, wherein a plastic spraying cover is fixedly arranged at the top of a processing table, the plastic spraying mechanism is fixedly arranged at the top of the plastic spraying cover, a conveying belt is fixedly arranged at the top of the processing table and below the plastic spraying cover, and a fixing mechanism is fixedly arranged on the outer wall of the conveying belt. According to the drying device, the drying pipe, the installation bin, the exercise-grade ropes, the vibration balls and the light air blocking sheets are matched, the VOC wood board after being sprayed with plastics can be dried through the drying pipe, so that the drying speed of the VOC wood board can be accelerated, and in the drying process of the VOC wood board, the generated hot air is light in weight and floats upwards, so that the angle of the light air blocking sheets is pushed to be changed, the hot air can flow, and the hot air is prevented from being accumulated and damaging the drying pipe.

title_en: Grinding and milling device for cat nails
abstract_en: Provided is a grinding and abrading device for cat nails, which can grind nail tips efficiently while the cat grinds the nails. The grinding and polishing device for cat nails has a grinding and polishing surface (1 a) for grinding and polishing the nails of cats on an upper surface, wherein the grinding and polishing device for cat nails has a polishing member (2) having a polishing surface (2 a) for polishing the nails of cats on at least one side surface, an inner core (3) having a plurality of wavy shapes on the side surface, and an inner liner (4), an end surface of the polishing member (2), an end surface of the inner core (3) having a wavy shape, and an end surface of the inner liner (4) are formed on the upper surface of the grinding and polishing device for cat nails, and a space is formed between the polishing surface (2 a) of the polishing member (2) and the side surface of the inner core (3), which communicates with the upper surface of the grinding and polishing device for cat nails.

title_en: Silk treatment method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of silkworm treatment, and particularly relates to a silk treatment method. The silk cleaning device has the advantages that residual silks on the surfaces of the paper cocooning frames can be cleaned in the paper cocooning frame moving process, the cleaning efficiency of the paper cocooning frames is improved, the silks on the surfaces of the paper cocooning frames are cleaned through the adsorption force generated by rotation by utilizing the light flexibility of the silks, the force generated by the linear moving of the paper cocooning frames is converted into the rotary adsorption force for adsorbing the silks on the surfaces of the paper cocooning frames in the whole process, the residual silks on the surfaces of the paper cocooning frames can be adsorbed in the rotating process and can be taken up by the silks on the surfaces of the paper cocooning frames at the same time through the cylindrical structure of the adhering part, and the silks on the surfaces of the adhering part can be treated by utilizing the cutter assembly after the silks are collected.

title_en: Ionomer modified foaming regulator and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an ionomer modified foaming regulator and a preparation method and application thereof. An ionomer-modified foam modifier comprising: 50-90 parts of methacrylate compounds, 15-40 parts of acrylate compounds, 1-3 parts of dispersing agents, 1-3 parts of isolating agents, 5-15 parts of ionomers, 0.05-0.15 part of emulsifying agents and 0.07-0.5 part of initiating agents. After the ionomer modified foaming regulator is applied to the PVC composite foaming material as an auxiliary agent, the dispersion flow property of the PVC composite foaming material is improved, and the melt strength of the PVC composite foaming material is enhanced; the finished product prepared from the PVC composite foaming material has uniform cell size, and the mechanical property of the finished product is improved; the surface quality of a finished product prepared from the PVC composite foaming material is improved.

title_en: Environment-friendly degradable polylactic acid flame-retardant masterbatch and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a green environment-friendly degradable polylactic acid flame-retardant master batch and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of master batch manufacturing; preparing a P-N-S composite flame retardant by adopting 1-3 parts of ammonium polyphosphate (APP), 4-8 parts of deionized water, 10-20 parts of absolute ethyl alcohol, 1-2 parts of Anhydrous Sulfanilic Acid (ASA) and 1-2 parts of Phytic Acid (PA); then adding 1-10 parts of P-N-S composite flame retardant, 10-80 parts of PLA powder, 1-15 parts of pigment, 1-5 parts of high-density polyethylene (HDPE) and 1-5 parts of Casein (CS) into a high-speed mixer, stirring for a certain time to uniformly mix the materials, quantitatively feeding the mixture into a double-screw extruder through a weightlessness scale, and carrying out bracing and grain cutting treatment to prepare PLA flame-retardant color master batches; the flame-retardant masterbatch has the flame-retardant performance and the coloring function, and has the characteristics of simple preparation process, low price, environmental protection, no toxicity, wide application range and the like.

title_en: Bent glass processing device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of glass manufacturing, and particularly relates to a bent glass processing device which comprises a supporting table, wherein a cavity is arranged in the supporting table, a moving table is arranged in the cavity, a moving mechanism is arranged between the moving table and the bottom wall of the cavity, a first groove and a second groove are formed in the top end of the moving table, a groove capable of being communicated with the first groove and the second groove is formed in the top of the cavity, an elastic supporting film is fixedly connected to the side wall of the second groove in a sealing mode, and a communicating channel is formed in the bottom wall of the second groove. According to the invention, the extrusion force on the glass is balanced under the action of the lower pressing bag and the elastic supporting film, so that the glass can be stably bent downwards, the condition that the glass is not uniformly distributed is avoided, then the bent glass is extruded and shaped through the constant-pressure piece, and finally the bent glass with good quality can be obtained.

title_en: Intelligent desert sapling irrigation vehicle
abstract_en: The intelligent desert sapling irrigation vehicle comprises a sapling identification module, a depth detection module, an excavation module, a humidity detection module, an irrigation module, a driving module and a power supply control module; sapling identification module sets up on degree of depth detection module, is responsible for discerning the sapling and measures the distance apart from the sapling, it sets up on degree of depth detection module to excavate the catch pit, degree of depth detection module links to each other with the module of traveling, is responsible for detecting the degree of depth that excavates the module and insert in the sand, the module of traveling is responsible for the removal of drive irrigation car, humidity detection module sets up on degree of depth detection module, is responsible for detecting the humidity in the sand, according to detecting humidity and predetermine the difference between the humidity, calculates the water demand, irrigation module sets up on the module of traveling, is responsible for carrying out the irrigation action according to the water storage capacity, power control module respectively with sapling identification module, degree of depth detection module, excavate module, humidity detection module, irrigation module and the module electric signal connection that travels.

title_en: Method for treating waste material and reactor system therefor
abstract_en: The reactor system includes a reactor vessel having at least one inlet and first and second outlets configured for depolymerization of the polycondensate and configured for removal of first and second portions of the reaction mixture. The reactor system further includes a heat exchanger downstream of the first outlet. In this context, the second outlet is arranged at a lower position of the reactor vessel than the first outlet. The first outlet is configured for removing a first portion that is a dispersion and/or solution in a solvent comprising the polycondensate and its depolymerization product. The first portion is directed to a heat exchanger. The second outlet is configured to remove a second portion comprising agglomerates. The reactor system is used for depolymerization of polycondensates.

title_en: Chlorella biofertilizer for promoting growth and improving disease resistance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a chlorella biofertilizer for promoting growth and improving disease resistance. Belongs to the technical field of biological fertilizer. The biological fertilizer comprises the following components in parts by volume: 1000 parts of chlorella extract and 1-3 parts of intelligent agent. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the beneficial effects that: (1) The chlorella extract and the intelligent synergistic effect in the chlorella biofertilizer are obviously higher than that of single components, so that the activity of root systems is effectively promoted, the photosynthesis of leaves is obviously improved, the yield of crops is obviously improved, the metabolic efficiency of plants is improved, and the disease resistance is increased; (2) The chlorella biological fertilizer has the advantages of few components, simple and feasible preparation process, effective extraction and retention of bioactive substances in chlorella, low production cost, easy control of the production process, contribution to large-scale industrial production and field application, and easy popularization and application.

title_en: Method for making crusty pancake pit
abstract_en: A method for making crusty pancake pits comprises the following steps: (1) manufacturing a mold foundation, and manufacturing a mold by using bricks; (2) sprinkling water to the mould; (3) stirring the nitre soil; (4) placing a base; (5) forming a nitre mould; (6) polishing; (7) sealing and light receiving; after the seal is sealed and the light is received, placing for two minutes, and then taking off the opening frame; (8) naturally drying in the air; (9) fixing an iron wire; (10) drying in air and then blanking; (11) placing matches; (12) and (4) manually firing, spraying salt water after firing, and finishing the manufacture after spraying the salt water.

title_en: Thermosetting resin composition, prepreg comprising thermosetting resin composition, laminated board and printed circuit board
abstract_en: The invention provides a thermosetting resin composition, a prepreg, a laminated board and a printed circuit board containing the thermosetting resin composition, wherein the thermosetting resin composition comprises thermosetting resin and a curing agent, the thermosetting resin comprises tert-octyl phenolic epoxy resin, when the thermosetting resin composition is used for preparing the laminated board, gummosis is easy to control in the hot press molding process of the prepreg, and the prepared copper-clad laminated board has high Tg, low CTE and excellent processability.

title_en: Domestication method of Debao dwarf horses
abstract_en: A domestication method of a sports Debao dwarf horse is characterized by comprising the steps of seed selection, breeding and management before mare reproduction, mare production process nursing, young colt feeding, sports training, feed supply and disease prevention and treatment.

title_en: Ridging and pond-digging integrated device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ridging and pond-digging integrated device, which relates to the field of pond-digging machines and comprises fixed side plates, wherein a top cross rod is horizontally welded on the side edge between the fixed side plates, a bottom supporting plate is butted on the bottom surface of the top cross rod, top cover plates are butted on the top surfaces of the top cross rod, fixed bases are vertically and upwards welded on the top surfaces of the two top cover plates, supporting bases are vertically and upwards welded on the top surfaces of the two top cover plates, a main cylinder is inserted into a top clamping groove of each fixed base, an overturning rod is horizontally inserted into a top groove of each supporting base, top fixing plates are symmetrically welded on the top surfaces of the overturning rods, and a supporting cross rod is horizontally welded at one end, far away from the supporting bases, of each overturning rod. The device disclosed by the invention is simple in design and integrated structure, simple and convenient to operate and connect, is more suitable for various environments due to the adoption of various adjusting modes, and greatly improves the working efficiency due to the integrated structure of ridging and pond digging.

title_en: Double-steam-chamber tyre mould
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of tire mold manufacturing, in particular to a double-steam-chamber tire mold, which comprises: the mold comprises a mold body, wherein a steam chamber is arranged on the outer periphery side of the mold body; a vertical partition; the annular partition plate divides the steam chamber into two parts, an upper steam chamber is arranged above the annular partition plate, and a lower steam chamber is arranged below the annular partition plate; the annular partition plate is of a horizontal or spiral downward structure, the starting point of the annular partition plate is intersected with the first end face of the vertical partition plate at a first position, the ending point of the annular partition plate is located at a second position close to the second end face of the vertical partition plate, the second end face is opposite to the first end face, a gap is reserved between the second position and the second end face, and steam flows downwards along the annular partition plate in a spiral manner from the upper steam chamber and enters the lower steam chamber through the gap; condensed water generated at the joint of the annular partition plate and the inner wall of the steam chamber can be rapidly and effectively discharged under the action of steam pushing and self gravity, so that the influence of the condensed water is reduced, and the vulcanizing efficiency is improved.

title_en: Water culture device and method for sweet potato seedling propagation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water culture device and method for sweet potato seedling propagation, which belong to the technical field of water culture of sweet potato seedlings. Can make the sweet potato seedling at the in-process of development through thermoregulation device, can carry out the adjustment of temperature along with the development of each stage sweet potato seedling, and through the reasonable ventilation of ventilation equipment, can increase the transpiration of plant, and then make the sweet potato seedling improve photosynthesis, develop better.

title_en: Graphene-nano lanthanum oxide-PTFE composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a graphene-nano lanthanum oxide-PTFE composite material and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the field of PTFE materials. The graphene-nano lanthanum oxide-PTFE composite material comprises PTFE, a graphene-nano lanthanum oxide composite material and a silane coupling agent. The preparation method of the graphene-nano lanthanum oxide-PTFE composite material comprises the following steps: preparing a silane coupling agent modified graphene-nano lanthanum oxide composite material, and blending and extruding PTFE and the modified graphene-nano lanthanum oxide composite material to obtain the graphene-nano lanthanum oxide-PTFE composite material. The graphene-nano lanthanum oxide-PTFE composite material has the advantages of low friction coefficient and high bending strength.

title_en: Arbuscular mycorrhizal fungi propagation method and application thereof in relieving successive cropping obstacles of konjak
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biology, and provides an arbuscular mycorrhizal fungus propagation method and application thereof in relieving continuous cropping obstacles of konjak, wherein the method comprises the following steps: expanding propagation of an arbuscular mycorrhizal fungal inoculant by utilizing konjak to expand arbuscular mycorrhizal fungi in a mixture matrix of sterilized locust leaf mold and river sand, wherein the arbuscular mycorrhizal fungi are root cyst funguses in roots, and after expanding propagation, an air-dried matrix containing konjak root segments, arbuscular mycorrhizal fungal spores and hyphae is obtained, namely the arbuscular mycorrhizal fungal inoculant, and the spore yield of the root cyst funguses in the roots of the arbuscular mycorrhizal fungal inoculant is 84 spores/cm 3 . The arbuscular mycorrhizal fungi of the invention are fungi capable of symbiotic with the root system of konjak, and the arbuscular mycorrhizal fungi can be used for killing konjakDifferent from the existing strains such as biocontrol bacteria, biocontrol actinomycetes and the like used for promoting the growth of the konjak and preventing diseases. The arbuscular mycorrhizal fungi strains are inoculated to form a symbiotic system with the root system of the konjak, so that the disease resistance and survival rate of the continuous cropping konjak and the non-continuous cropping konjak are improved, the use amount of chemical pesticides is reduced, the yield of the konjak is improved, the phosphorus nutrition of plants is improved, and the continuous cropping obstacle of the konjak is relieved.

title_en: Multipurpose modularization unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multipurpose modular unmanned aerial vehicle which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle main body, wherein bearing arms are arranged at four corner edges of the outer wall of the unmanned aerial vehicle main body. According to the invention, the side baffle is arranged on the outer wall of the propeller, so that the propeller can be protected, the infrared obstacle avoidance sensor is arranged on the outer wall of the side baffle, the surrounding environment can be detected in real time, data can be transmitted to the inside of the main body of the unmanned aerial vehicle, the buzzer bird repeller can be controlled to buzz and alarm when the alarm distance is reached, the propeller of the unmanned aerial vehicle can be effectively protected when the unmanned aerial vehicle flies, the safety of equipment is improved, the servo motor can be controlled to rotate the ball screw when the object needs to be transmitted, the ball screw can drive the storage box to slide out of the inner wall of the storage box through the screw nut, the object can be placed in the storage box, and the storage module of the unmanned aerial vehicle can be used for quickly taking and placing the object, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle can conveniently carry out transmission work.

title_en: Sponge strip sticking device of cup mask machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sponge strip sticking device of a cup mask machine, which comprises: a feeding mechanism and a sequence transferring mechanism; feeding mechanism includes: the device comprises a material reel, a correlation inductor, a main shaft motor, a waste shaft and a waste motor; transfer preface mechanism includes: the device comprises a tearing cylinder, a sequence conversion cylinder, a micro cylinder, a forming cylinder, a material moving cylinder, a clamping jaw cylinder, a servo motor and a rotating cylinder; the main shaft motor is connected with the driving shaft and controls the output speed of the sponge strips; the waste motor and the waste shaft are connected with the waste bracket to control the speed of collecting the waste; the servo motor is fixed on the motor mounting bracket and connected with the lead screw, and controls the stroke of the rotary male die; the correlation inductor is fixed on the inductor bracket; the invention overcomes the problems of labor waste, low efficiency and high cost of the cup mask machine, and through the design of the invention, the sponge strip sticking device of the cup mask machine can reduce labor, improve efficiency and be put into production and application.

title_en: Lagerstroemia plant trunk segment tenon-and-mortise grafting modeling cultivation method in lythraceae
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a cultivation method for grafting and modeling tree trunk segments of lagerstroemia plants in lythraceae by mortise and tenon joint. The method comprises the following steps: the requirement and selection of the whole body of the living trunk art model on the trunk section for grafting; the principle and the method for constructing the whole body by grafting the living trunk section; the connection mode and the integral design of the mortise and tenon grafting of the tree trunk section; designing a mortise and tenon grafting interface of each type of configuration tree section; designing and manufacturing a tree section grafting integral body support frame; preparing a trunk section before grafting the structure and the shape; cutting, jointing and fixing a grafting trunk section joint; maintaining the grafting body; and (4) detecting the quality of the grafted shaped nursery stock and outplanting. The cultivation method provided by the invention can realize the shaping of the trunk sections according to the designed extending direction and turning angle, so that the trunk sections are grafted to form a planar or three-dimensional artistic shape body, the integral ornamental value and commodity value are improved, and the requirement of the trunk artistic shape is met.

title_en: Laser additive manufacturing method
abstract_en: According to the laser additive manufacturing method provided by the application, in an inert environment, a substrate is heated to 500-900 ℃, the substrate is made of copper or copper alloy, the inert environment is kept, and blue laser beams are adopted to melt the substrate and copper or copper alloy powder so as to realize additive manufacturing of components, compared with the existing double-beam additive manufacturing technology, only single blue light is adopted, a double laser and a composite cladding head with a complex optical structure are not needed, the equipment is simpler and low in cost, in addition, infrared laser is not involved in the equipment, and the problems of optical device damage, personnel safety threat and the like caused by high reflection rate of copper to infrared beams are avoided; meanwhile, the temperature gradient is reduced by blue laser and the heating of the copper substrate, the laser absorption rate is improved, the laser energy utilization rate is high, the melting and metallurgical reaction in the printing process is sufficient, the fusion quality is good, and the density of the additive manufacturing component is good.

title_en: Device for measuring bending of saw wire of wire sawing machine
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of cutting of semiconductor hard and brittle materials, and particularly relates to a device for measuring bending of a saw wire of a wire saw machine, which comprises a device body, wherein the device body comprises a support, the bottom of the support is movably provided with a bottom plate, the front wall and the rear wall of the support are respectively provided with a split light screen in a sliding way, one side wall of the support is provided with a light source for illumination, the other side wall of the support is correspondingly provided with a plurality of sensors for sensing the light source, the side wall of the support is also provided with a signal processing box which is electrically connected with the plurality of sensors, when the saw wire is bent too much, the sensor at the upper half part sends a signal, the signal processing box sends a signal which is bent too much and needs to reduce the feeding speed to a control center of the machine tool through judgment, the control center of the machine tool sends a command of reducing the rotating speed of the motor to the feeding motor of the machine tool through identification and judgment, so that the feeding speed and the bending of the saw wire are reduced, the yarn can not be broken; the cutting efficiency is improved, and the method is suitable for wide popularization.

title_en: Special lubricating wear-resistant coating for repairing automobile wiper rubber strip, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lubricating wear-resistant coating special for repairing an automobile wiper rubber strip, a preparation method and application thereof. The chloroprene rubber base coat material comprises the following components in percentage by weight: 100 parts of chloroprene rubber, 3-5 parts of peroxide vulcanizing agent, 5-10 parts of cross-linking agent, 1-5 parts of carbon black, 1-3 parts of anti-aging agent and 300-400 parts of organic solvent. The epoxy resin topcoat material comprises the following components in percentage by weight: 100 parts of rubber modified epoxy resin, 5-15 parts of a room temperature curing agent, 1-3 parts of an accelerator, 7-30 parts of graphene-like molybdenum disulfide, 3-25 parts of graphite, 1-8 parts of a metal oxide, 0.5-1.0 part of a dispersant and 300-600 parts of an organic solvent. The original worn surface of the wiper rubber strip is repaired by the neoprene bottom coating material to form a new flat rubber surface, and then a layer of epoxy resin surface coating material is coated, so that the wiper rubber strip has excellent cleaning effect and more excellent wear resistance again.

title_en: Intelligent beehive and bee identification tracking counting system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of bee breeding. The method specifically comprises the following steps: the lower part of the beehive is provided with an access channel; the camera is arranged on the beehive, and the monitoring direction faces to the access passage; the weighing instrument is arranged at the bottom of the beehive; the temperature and humidity sensor is arranged inside the beehive; and the terminal is arranged outside the beehive, is in communication connection with the camera, the weighing instrument and the temperature and humidity sensor respectively, and is used for collecting collected data and transmitting the collected data to the micro server. The invention can automatically collect the time-space multi-dimensional, multi-angle and multi-structure full-period data in bee breeding, intelligently analyze and process the data, provide the statistical analysis result display of the bee activity rule and the environmental data and the alarm of the data beyond threshold value, and form the data analysis, management and decision of the whole honey production process. The invention is characterized in that the bee identification tracking counting system based on deep learning comprises the following components: the method comprises the steps of bee image data set construction, bee detection and identification model construction and bee identification model construction.

title_en: Intelligent spraying equipment for adhesive for ice locking and freshness keeping of crayfishes
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of freezing preservation of aquatic products, in particular to intelligent spraying equipment for an adhesive for freezing preservation of crayfish packages. The device comprises a control panel arranged on the side wall of a shell and used for setting different spraying modes of an adhesive; the CCD industrial camera is arranged on a sliding block mounting seat of the mobile device and used for collecting the spraying condition of the adhesive on the surface of the crayfish in the shell; the moving device is fixedly arranged at the top of the inner side of the shell, so that the translation of the CCD industrial camera is facilitated; the adhesive groove pipe is fixedly arranged at the upper part of the shell, the pressure pump is used for spraying and boosting the pressure of the adhesive, and the pressure pump is communicated with the adhesive groove pipe through a connecting bent pipe; the adhesive spraying device is fixedly arranged in the shell and is connected and communicated with the adhesive groove pipe; the adhesive groove is communicated with the pressure pump, and the industrial control intelligent spraying is used for replacing manual spraying, so that the uniform spraying of the crayfish adhesive is ensured, the uniform ice coating of the crayfish is further ensured, and the individual crayfish fresh-keeping effect is good.

title_en: Heterogeneous intermetallic compound additive machining equipment and machining method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses heterogeneous intermetallic compound additive processing equipment and a processing method thereof. Heterogeneous intermetallic compound vibration material disk processing equipment includes hot plate, first welding power supply, diplopore send a contact tip, first send a machine, second to send a machine and second welding power supply, the hot plate is used for placing the base plate, first welding power supply is used for adding the heat fusion to the vibration material disk on the base plate, first send a machine with the second send a machine all with the diplopore send a contact tip to connect and respectively with the diplopore send a first silk hole, the second of sending of contact tip to send the silk hole to communicate with each other, second welding power supply can move and be used for heating the melting to vibration material disk, the diplopore send a contact tip first welding power supply with second welding power supply all with the hot plate sets up relatively. The heterogeneous intermetallic compound additive processing equipment can improve the structural property uniformity of the complex special-shaped component.

title_en: Convenient well hollow plate extrusion molding mould of dismantling and using in a flexible way
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hollow plate extrusion molding die convenient to disassemble and flexible to apply, and relates to the technical field of extrusion molding dies. The upper die positioning seat is used for fixing the upper die and assisting the upper die and the lower die to complete detachable assembly and fixation; the lower die positioning seat is used for fixing the lower die and assisting the lower die and the upper die to complete detachable assembly and fixation; the upper die and the lower die jointly form an extrusion molding die. The invention mainly comprises the manufacture of the hollow plate, has simple disassembly and assembly operation, can be completed without the assistance of tools in the operation process, and greatly improves the production efficiency of the hollow plate.

title_en: Slip casting mould, process and ceramic product
abstract_en: The invention provides a slip casting mould, a process and a ceramic product, wherein the slip casting mould comprises: the outer die holder is provided with a cavity; the first module is arranged in the cavity; the second module is arranged in the cavity and corresponds to the first module, and a cavity is formed between the first module and the second module; the runner is communicated with the cavity and is used for grouting to the cavity; wherein the second module is movable in a direction towards and away from the first module, and/or the first module is movable in a direction towards and away from the second module. The slip casting mold provided by the invention can inject ceramic slurry into the cavity through the runner so as to realize preparation of a ceramic product. Through the direction motion of drive second module to being close to first module, or the direction motion of drive first module to being close to the second module, extrude ceramic slurry to the bubble in the discharge slurry, thereby can prevent that forming defects such as crackle, layering, bubble, slump from appearing in the ceramic forming process.

title_en: Method for improving planting survival rate of stone mountain nursery stock
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving planting survival rate of stone mountain nursery stocks, and belongs to the technical field of forestry forestation. The method for improving the planting survival rate of the stone mountain nursery stock comprises the following steps: (1) Manufacturing fish scale pits at planting points, spraying microorganism mixed bacterial liquid in the fish scale pits, and backfilling mixed nutrient soil; (2) pretreating the seedlings; (3) Digging out the mixed nutrient soil, transplanting the pretreated seedlings, and backfilling the mixed nutrient soil; and (4) performing post-transplanting management. The seedling planting method can enable the survival rate of the biota orientalis seedlings to reach more than 95%, solve the problem of low survival rate of the seedlings transplanted on the rocky mountain with a thinner soil layer, and provide a new technology for improving the afforestation survival rate for the rocky mountain.

title_en: Preparation method of poly (fluorophenyl ester) polymer with low dielectric loss
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a poly (fluorophenyl ester) polymer with low dielectric loss, which reduces the polarization loss through a high saturated electron localization structure and a low polarizable electron cloud structure so as to reduce the dielectric loss of the polymer. The low dielectric loss polyphenyl ester polymer has wide raw material sources and low material cost, and can be used for polymer film capacitors.

title_en: Climbing-preventing device for high-voltage transmission tower
abstract_en: An anti-climbing device for a high-voltage power transmission tower belongs to the technical field of power transmission tower protection, and aims to solve the problems that the high-voltage power transmission tower is ventilated on four sides, easy to climb and easy to cause animals or irrelevant people to climb so that equipment at the upper end of the high-voltage power transmission tower is damaged; the utility model provides a high tension electricity tower anti-climb device, includes support column and the anti-tendril mechanism of setting in the outside of support column, the support column is provided with four groups, and four groups support column top be provided with anti-climb mechanism, anti-climb mechanism upper end fixedly connected with transmission tower, the inside rainwater collection mechanism that is provided with of transmission tower, the outside fixedly connected with of anti-climb mechanism keeps off the fence, utilize the unable atress climbing of the big angular tilt of movable plate and the position that magnetic force inductive switch reachs fixed magnetic ring, the water impact scares away animal or irrelevant personnel, the action of prevention climbing reaches the effect that prevents irrelevant personnel or animal to high tension electricity tower climbing.

title_en: Fruit preservation and fruit expansion method for promoting early ripening of grape fruits
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of grape planting, in particular to a method for promoting grape fruits to be premature. The method provided by the invention comprises the following steps: gibberellin (GA) is adopted 5-10 days after the end of the final flowering phase  3  ) Processing the clusters by the solution; the concentration of the gibberellin solution is 100-150 mg/L; the processing mode comprises the following steps: soaking or spraying. The method adopts GA 5-10 days after the end of the end flowering phase  3  The solution treatment can not only realize the fruit preservation and fruit expansion of the summer black grapes, but also effectively promote the early ripening of the fruits; meanwhile, the method is simple to operate, only needs one-time hormone treatment, greatly saves the cost of manpower and material resources, and is suitable for labor-saving production of summer black grapes.

title_en: Gas air supply device, casting device and preparation method of casting film
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of casting film preparation, in particular to a gas air supply device, a casting device and a casting film preparation method. The invention provides a gas air supply device and a tape casting device, which can blow solvent gas to the edge of a liquid film, can jointly act the blown solvent gas and the volatilized solvent gas of the liquid film, improve the flatness of the edge of a TAC film, avoid the bending of the edges of two sides and even the curling and the breaking phenomenon in the operation of the liquid film at the later stage, and improve the yield. In addition, the gas conveyed in the gas air supply device can adopt high-concentration gas wind collected by the air exhaust device in the casting process, no extra solvent is introduced, the production cost is saved, the influence of the extra solvent gas on the flatness of the intermediate liquid film is further avoided, the edge and the middle of the obtained liquid film have high flatness, and the number of broken pieces in the subsequent drying process is reduced.

title_en: Thermoplastic polyurethane elastomer for film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of C08L high polymer materials, and in particular provides a thermoplastic polyurethane elastomer for a film and a preparation method thereof. The invention provides a thermoplastic polyurethane elastomer for a film, which is prepared from polyester polyol, polyalcohol compounds, isocyanate, antioxidant, carbodiimide, ultraviolet absorber and the like. Compared with the prior art, the thermoplastic polyurethane elastomer for the film has excellent mechanical properties, has medium and low crystallization speed and reduced water vapor transmittance, and can be processed by film blowing or casting in the process of being used in the film field, so that a new strategy is provided for preparing the polyurethane elastomer with low moisture permeability, and the application range of the thermoplastic polyurethane elastomer is widened.

title_en: Integrative quantitative fertilizer placement drill of liquid manure
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of agricultural irrigation, and discloses a water and fertilizer integrated quantitative fertilizer placement drill, which comprises: the bottom plate, the equal fixedly connected with fixed block one in both sides of bottom plate, the other end fixedly connected with of fixed block one mixes the liquid pipe, the inside swing joint who mixes the liquid pipe has the extrusion circle piece, one side fixedly connected with stripper bar of extrusion circle piece, stripper bar and liquid pipe sliding connection mix, the one end fixed connection carriage release lever that the stripper bar stretches out the liquid pipe that mixes, the lower surface both sides of bottom plate all are provided with motor two, motor two's output shaft fixedly connected with ellipse type connecting plate. This kind of integrative quantitative fertilizer placement drill of liquid manure can effectually spray crops, and the volume that control was sprayed is controlled to the rotational speed of accessible control motor two simultaneously, improves the practicality of device, and the in-service use of laminating more sprays liquid through the shower nozzle form simultaneously for crops can be better absorption liquid manure liquid.

title_en: Kidney bean is planted with high-efficient convenient atomizer
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of engineering, in particular to a high-efficiency convenient spraying device for kidney bean planting, which can change the positions and the distances of wheels and a ground turner, is matched with kidney bean ridges to avoid damaging kidney beans, can change the positions and the orientations of spray irrigation, and further corresponds to various spray irrigation conditions, and comprises a vehicle body device, a fertilizer application device, a spraying device and a belt I, wherein water and medicaments are put into a water tank from a material inlet II and a material inlet pipe in a two-way manner, the belt I is driven to rotate along with the rotation of a rotating wheel III, the rotating wheel VII is driven to rotate, the belt VII is driven to rotate, the rotating wheel VIII is driven to rotate, the stirring wheel I and the stirring wheel II are driven to rotate, so that the water and the medicaments in the water tank are fully stirred, a water pump is started to drive the water in the water tank to be sucked out from a water spray pipe through a water pipe II to spray the kidney beans on the side, a long rod V is rotated to drive a water spray pipe nozzle to face downwards, and the sliding block eight is slid to spray the kidney beans below, so that the position of the spray irrigation is changed.

title_en: Fertilizer feeding device
abstract_en: The application provides a fertilizer feeding device which comprises a shell, a feeding mechanism, a control unit and a discharging unit, wherein a containing space is formed in the shell, the feeding mechanism is arranged in the containing space and comprises a connector and at least two charging barrels, the at least two charging barrels are uniformly arranged on the connector at intervals along a circumferential track, one ends of the at least two charging barrels are attached to a first end face of the shell, the control unit is connected with the shell and connected with one side, far away from the first end face of the shell, of the feeding mechanism, the control unit can drive the feeding mechanism to rotate by taking the central axis of the circumferential track, which is arranged by the charging barrels, as an axis, of the central axis, wherein a discharging hole is formed in the first end face of the shell, and the control unit controls the feeding mechanism to rotate so that one ends of the at least two charging barrels are opposite to the discharging hole in sequence.

title_en: Forming die for heat-sealing quality-guaranteeing and freshness-keeping lunch box
abstract_en: The invention provides a forming die for a heat-sealing quality-guaranteeing fresh-keeping lunch box, which relates to the technical field of fresh-keeping lunch boxes and comprises a workbench, wherein a fresh-keeping meal die is fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the workbench, two fixed rods are fixedly arranged at two ends of one side of the workbench, which is close to the fresh-keeping meal die, a rectangular fixed plate is fixedly arranged at one end of each fixed rod, which is far away from the workbench, a heating injection molding mechanism is arranged on each rectangular fixed plate, a circulating cooling mechanism is arranged at one end inside the workbench, a motor can be matched with a worm to drive a worm gear to rotate, the worm gear can be matched with a connecting shaft to drive two gears to rotate while rotating, the gears can be matched with teeth arranged on one side of a movable column to drive the movable column to move upwards, meanwhile, the movable column is matched with a rectangular connecting plate and a connecting rod to lift a lifting plate upwards when moving upwards, and then a finished product which is formed and is arranged inside the fresh-keeping meal die, ejecting at a constant speed, and collecting by workers.

title_en: Fabricated concrete slab with high shock resistance, template and production method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fabricated concrete slab with high shock resistance, a template and a production method, and belongs to the technical field of building construction equipment. The fabricated concrete panel includes: concrete main part and support piece, support piece set up in the concrete main part, and it extends along the length direction of concrete main part to crooked predetermined radian to the lateral direction of concrete main part. According to the invention, the support piece extends along the length direction of the concrete body in the concrete body and bends to the lateral direction of the concrete body by the preset radian at the same time, so that the concrete slab can be supported in the length direction and the lateral direction, the shock resistance of the concrete slab is improved, and the problem of weak shock resistance of the concrete slab in the prior art is solved.

title_en: Quick fertilizer injection unit of vegetable planting usefulness
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quick fertilizing device for vegetable planting, which comprises a greenhouse assembly, a frame and a thin film covering layer, wherein the thin film covering layer is arranged on the top of the frame, a fertilizing mechanism comprises a fertilizing support, the fertilizing support is of a grid-shaped pipeline structure with a plurality of groups of vertical distribution, a fertilizing dropper is arranged at a node of a grid, a spraying mechanism is arranged on the top of the frame and comprises a liquid drainage support, and a plurality of groups of spray heads are uniformly arranged below the liquid drainage support. According to the invention, the fertilizing mechanism correspondingly adds the nutrient solution required to be fertilized to the roots of the planted vegetables through the fertilizing dropper, the planting positions of the vegetables are distributed according to the positions of the fertilizing droppers, the liquid nutrient solution in the fertilizing frame is pressurized and conveyed to the fertilizing droppers of the fertilizing bracket through the pump, the quick and accurate fertilizing effect on the vegetables is realized, the pressure of the pump is uniformly distributed through the multi-connection block, and the uniformity of the fertilizing use is improved.

title_en: Spraying type environment-friendly polyurethane foam for heat preservation of container modular building
abstract_en: The invention relates to spray type environment-friendly polyurethane foam for heat insulation of a container modular building, which is prepared by spraying a component A and a component B through a spraying device, wherein the component A comprises the following components in parts by weight: 100 parts of polyol, 1-5 parts of surfactant, 2-10 parts of catalyst, 0.5-1.0 part of water, 20-30 parts of physical foaming agent and 10-20 parts of flame retardant; the polyol is melamine resin polyol and polyester polyol, and the weight ratio of the melamine resin polyol to the polyester polyol is 30-50:50-70 parts of; the component B is polyphenyl polymethylene polyisocyanate. According to the invention, by adding melamine resin polyol, a composite flame retardant, three types of composite catalysts and an environment-friendly physical foaming agent and changing the proportion of the raw material components, on the basis of ensuring that the polyurethane foam material meets the performances of good mechanical properties and low heat conductivity coefficient, the fire resistance, safety and comfort of the material are greatly improved.

title_en: Sampling method for harmful water-soluble substance sample
abstract_en: The invention provides a sampling method of a sampling device for a harmful water-soluble substance sample, which comprises the following steps: step 1, mounting a sealing film on an inner-layer bottle cap, and then mounting the inner-layer bottle cap on a bottleneck of a sampling bottle; step 2, mounting the outer-layer bottle cap on the inner-layer bottle cap, pulling the sealing plate out of the outer-layer bottle cap through the sampling groove, and fixing the positions of the outer-layer bottle cap and the sealing plate through the limiting buckle; step 3, connecting the lifting pull rope with a connector of a sampling bottle, and connecting the sampling pull rope with a limiting buckle; step 4 is to put into the sewage that awaits measuring with the sample bottle to through the cooperation of stay cord and pulley, release lift stay cord and sample stay cord simultaneously, after the seal membrane dissolves in sewage, retrieve the sample stay cord, pull out spacing buckle, the closing plate passes through the effect of torsional spring, gets into in the sample groove and holds the chamber, seals the bottleneck, then retrieves the lift stay cord, and it is after pulling out the sample bottle.

title_en: Aqueous composition, cured product and laminate
abstract_en: [ problem ] to provide an aqueous composition, a cured product, and a laminate, which have improved antistatic properties and good storage stability. The present disclosure relates to an aqueous composition containing: a poly (meth) acrylate (A) having a hydroxyl value of 60mgKOH/g or less; a surfactant (B); a pi-conjugated conductive polymer (C); and an aqueous solvent (D), wherein 80% by mass or more of 100% by mass of the component (D) is water.

title_en: Prefabricated combined stair and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of prefabricated building processing, in particular to a prefabricated combined stair and a construction method thereof, wherein the prefabricated combined stair comprises a supporting die, two platform hanging plates, a circulating steel die and a shielding assembly, the supporting die is a pattern steel plate, the supporting die is arranged in a stair-shaped inclined structure, the platform hanging plates are respectively vertically and oppositely welded on two sides of the supporting die, the supporting die and a steel ladder frame are combined permanently, and then are matched with the circulating steel plate which can be recycled, the prefabricated stair is prefabricated in a steel structure, meanwhile, under the matching action of a connecting assembly, the assembly is simple and convenient, the use is convenient, the use of a traditional cast-in-place template is reduced, the resources are saved, the environment is protected, in addition, the prefabricated stair step is a folded shape, compared with the traditional prefabricated stair with a plane bottom, the advantages of light weight are achieved, the advantages of saving materials, the field hoisting efficiency and the like are achieved, the integral supporting die and the circulating steel die enable the apparent quality of the stair to be high, and the secondary leveling and the process of the traditional cast-in-place stair is avoided.

title_en: Intelligent feed feeding device and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of feed putting, in particular to an intelligent feed putting device which comprises a hopper, wherein putting parts are arranged in the hopper in a penetrating mode, two groups of first extending frames symmetrically extend from two sides of the hopper, moving parts are arranged at the end parts of the two groups of first extending frames, two groups of second extending frames symmetrically extend from the front end surface and the rear end surface of the hopper, floating parts are arranged at the end parts of the two groups of second extending frames and are connected with the moving parts, and the putting parts are respectively connected with the first extending frames and the floating parts.

title_en: Poultry gizzard oiling system and oiling method thereof
abstract_en: The utility model provides a birds gizzard oiling system, include the main frame and a plurality of oiling modules of being connected with the main frame, a plurality of oiling modules are upper and lower layering arrangement, the birds gizzard is transmitted along a plurality of oiling modules in proper order, the arrangement direction of two adjacent oiling modules is perpendicular, the arrangement space has been saved greatly, the oiling module is including the guide device of oiling device and top, wherein the oiling device is including two screw rods that set up side by side, two screw rods are the bull threaded rod structure of roll meshing, and the rotation direction extrusion of meshing one side is downward, thread tooth quantity on two screw rods is different, the guide device includes conveying chute and inside conveying belt and baffle, birds gizzard falls to removing oil feed rod group under conveying belt and baffle effect, and accomplish the clearance of surface grease under the spiral propelling movement effect of two screw rods and roll extrusion meshing effect, the grease that drops that the clearance of clearance gets off can be in thread clearance department, the adhesion of grease that has effectively prevented gapless roll meshing and has resulted in the paste to the screw rod, the cleanliness of screw rod has been guaranteed.

title_en: Preparation method of ceramic
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of ceramic, which is characterized by comprising the following steps: the ceramic powder is pretreated to obtain modified ceramic powder; preparing a first photo-curing solution, and then adding a degreasing auxiliary agent and mixing to obtain a second photo-curing solution; adding the modified ceramic powder into a second photo-curing solution to obtain ceramic slurry; the ceramic slurry is printed through 3D to obtain a ceramic blank; sectional glue discharging is carried out on the ceramic blank; sintering the ceramic blank after discharging the glue, thus obtaining the ceramic; the degreasing auxiliary agents comprise a first degreasing auxiliary agent, a second degreasing auxiliary agent and a third degreasing auxiliary agent; the problems of deformation or low machining precision of the prepared ceramic blank are avoided, and the problems of deformation and cracking of the ceramic blank in the degreasing and glue discharging process are solved.

title_en: Three-dimensional cultivation purifying system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field related to three-dimensional cultivation, in particular to a three-dimensional cultivation purification system, which comprises a chicken raising area and a fish raising area which are vertically distributed, wherein a grid is arranged between the chicken raising area and the chicken raising area; the three-dimensional chicken raising and fish raising areas are vertically distributed, the occupied area is small, the planting columns are vertically arranged, a plurality of planting pipes are distributed along the length direction of the planting columns, the plant yield in unit area is improved, the three-dimensional chicken raising and fish raising device can become a main food source for chickens, substances such as nitrogen and phosphorus in water absorbed by plants can purify water, and chicken manure falls into the fish raising area through the grids for being eaten by fish, so that three-dimensional circulation is formed.

title_en: Environment-friendly plastic injection mold
abstract_en: The invention discloses an environment-friendly plastic injection mold which structurally comprises a mold block, a sealing plate and injection ports, wherein the sealing plate is arranged at the top of the mold block, the injection ports penetrate through the upper surface and the lower surface of the sealing plate, the mold block comprises a first block body, a mold pipe and a collecting mechanism, the mold pipe is arranged in the first block body, the collecting mechanism is fixed at the bottom end of the mold pipe, six mold pipes are arranged and consist of two halves, the collecting mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the mold pipe, overflowed fluid is drained into a collecting pipe through a liquid inlet on the surface of the fixed block of the collecting mechanism and collected, the accumulation of the fluid at the bottom in the first block body of the mold block can be reduced, the collected fluid can be reused, the waste of raw materials can be reduced, a second magnetic block is arranged at the bottom of the collecting pipe, the second magnetic block is in magnetic movable fit with the first block, the collecting mechanism can be taken out and cleaned, a movable ring is arranged in the collecting pipe, and the movable ring can generate thrust to accelerate the discharge of the fluid in the collecting pipe.

title_en: Mold and method for preparing fiber composite material part with V-shaped opening structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a die for preparing a fiber composite material part with a V-shaped opening structure, which comprises an upper die and a lower die, wherein the upper die and the lower die form a cavity of the transverse part of the V-shaped structural part, the lower die comprises a lower die main body and a detachable sliding block, the detachable sliding block is arranged at the depth part (longitudinal bending part) of the part corresponding to the lower die main body, and forms a cavity of the depth part (longitudinal bending part) of the V-shaped structural part together with the lower die main body.

title_en: Preparation method of polycarbosilane reinforced alumina ceramic slurry and 3D printing photocuring forming process
abstract_en: The application discloses a preparation method of polycarbosilane reinforced alumina ceramic slurry and a 3D printing photocuring forming process, and belongs to the technical field of ceramic materials. Optimizing Al by adjusting the mass percentage of liquid polycarbosilane in the entire suspension  2  O  3  The silicon carbide of the composite material and the mullite content generated by chemical reaction can achieve the purpose of enhancing the mechanical property of the ceramic. Silicon carbide polymers are a relatively stable precursor polymer material, but undergo chemical reactions upon aqueous solution resulting in curing. The problem of slurry instability can be solved only by selecting proper resin monomer, dispersant, photo-inducer and plasticizer. The pyrolysis process of three stages is designed to ensure that the silicon carbide converted by the polymer does not generate oxidation reaction, and silicon carbide fibers are formed in the alumina, so that the effect of the reinforcement is achieved.

title_en: Antibacterial hydrophobic membrane and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an antibacterial hydrophobic membrane and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises the steps of preparing a eugenol derivative with sulfydryl and a pulullan derivative with double bonds, grafting the eugenol derivative on the pulullan derivative through click reaction, and finally obtaining a product. The reaction can be carried out under relatively mild conditions, the reaction speed is high, and the product has high selectivity. The prepared membrane material has remarkable antibacterial, hydrophobic, ultraviolet-resistant and corrosion-resistant properties. The prepared raw materials can be extracted from plants, are green and nontoxic, have high application value, and can be widely applied to the living fields of food packaging, medical facilities and the like.

title_en: Full-hydraulic modularized crawler-type power platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full-hydraulic modularized crawler-type power platform which comprises a triangular crawler chassis, wherein the triangular crawler chassis is connected with a lifting mechanism, the lifting mechanism comprises a lifting hydraulic oil cylinder support, a preposed tool connecting plate and a lifting hydraulic oil cylinder, the lifting hydraulic oil cylinder support is welded on the triangular crawler chassis, one end of the lifting hydraulic oil cylinder support is hinged with a fixed seat of the lifting hydraulic oil cylinder, the other end of the lifting hydraulic oil cylinder support is hinged with one end of the preposed tool connecting plate, the other end of the preposed tool connecting plate is fixed with the inner side surface of a sliding plate part, and the telescopic end of the lifting hydraulic oil cylinder is hinged with the middle part of the preposed tool connecting plate. The invention adopts the triangular crawler chassis, the gravity center of the whole machine is low, and the trafficability characteristic is strong. And the power is transmitted by adopting closed hydraulic pressure, so that the size of the whole machine is reduced. Can realize more convenient and quick replacement with the front-mounted tool. The power can be provided by the preposed tool of the conversion plug, and the output requirement is enriched.

title_en: Flower planting is with supplementary system of looking after
abstract_en: The invention provides an auxiliary caring system for flower planting, and relates to the field of flower planting. The auxiliary caring system for flower planting comprises a first motor, a pressure sensor, a loudspeaker, an LED lamp, a second motor, a camera, a processor and a water pump, wherein the processor is respectively connected with the first motor, the pressure sensor, the loudspeaker, the LED lamp, the second motor, the camera and the water pump in a signal mode and used for controlling the operation of the equipment. Take place the transient variation through pressure sensor perception pressure, and then judge that there is birds to fall to the foot when on carousel or flower planting basin, first motor will order about the carousel rotation and fly birds with the surprise, the speaker utilizes the sound to fly birds with the surprise simultaneously, the LED lamp utilizes the light flash to fly birds with the surprise, thereby realize the supplementary looking after of flowers, furtherly, the usable intelligent terminal of user passes through radio signal's mode remote control water pump, and then carry out moisture supply to flowers, and is various in function, and convenient to use, the supplementary purpose of looking after of flower planting has been realized.

title_en: Impregnation device and process for impregnating epoxy resin into wind power glass fiber pultrusion plate
abstract_en: The invention discloses an impregnation device and an impregnation process for impregnating wind power glass fiber pultrusion plates with epoxy resin, which belong to the technical field of wind power component manufacturing, and comprise a mold, a plurality of laying mechanisms, an impregnation mechanism and a fixed frame, wherein the mold is fixedly arranged on the fixed frame, the laying mechanisms are sequentially and vertically arranged above the mold in a linear array manner, the impregnation mechanism is arranged above the mold, the laying mechanism is used for laying a single layer of glass fiber cloth and directly laying a complete layer of glass fiber cloth in the mold, and the impregnation mechanism is used for carrying out resin vacuum impregnation on the glass fiber cloth in the mold after the glass fiber cloth in the mold is laid; the glass fiber cloth can be paved on each paving mechanism at the same time, and the efficiency of the paving process is greatly saved.

title_en: Crank arm structure of plastic film residue collector and plastic film residue collector
abstract_en: The invention relates to a crank arm structure of a residual film recycling machine, which comprises a connecting rod long arm, a connecting rod short arm and a spline housing, wherein a sliding assembly is arranged at the other end of the connecting rod long arm and the other end of the connecting rod short arm, and a limiting boss is arranged on the connecting rod long arm; the invention has the advantages that: because the long connecting rod arm and the short connecting rod arm are both provided with the sliding assemblies, when the film collecting roller rotates to drive the crank arm structure to rotate, one sliding assembly moves on the outer track of the forward cam, when the film collecting roller moves to be separated from the outer track of the forward cam, the other sliding assembly enters the inner track of the reverse cam to move, so that the connecting rod structure rotates according to the given movement track, the limit boss is abutted against the baffle plate, the damage caused by excessive rotation of the crank arm structure can be avoided, the service life of the crank arm structure can be prolonged, and in addition, the invention also discloses a residual film recycling machine which comprises the crank arm structure of the residual film recycling machine.

title_en: Forming die and forming method of I-shaped composite material workpiece
abstract_en: The invention provides a forming die and a forming method of an I-shaped composite material workpiece, and relates to the technical field of composite material part die design and forming, comprising two forming dies, wherein a row of floating pressing pieces are respectively arranged on the two forming dies; the two forming die parts are respectively provided with an ejection driving part, four sliding connecting parts are fixedly connected between the two forming die parts, a workpiece main body is connected between the two forming die parts, the positioning is more accurate, demolding and fracture are not easy to occur, meanwhile, the forming process can be optimized, the finished product qualification rate of the parts is greatly improved, the twisting filling quality is higher, and the problems that the existing I-shaped composite material parts are inaccurate in forming and positioning, difficult to demold and even layering are solved, and the finished product defective rate of the parts is improved.

title_en: Water bag combined coral reef cultivation device and setting method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water bag combined coral reef cultivation device which comprises a coral reef cultivation medium and a flexible water bag breakwater which are connected through mechanical connectors. The flexible water bag breakwater consists of a rubber film semi-cylindrical structure and a steel plate, and the rubber film and the steel plate are riveted to form a closed structure, so that the flexible water bag breakwater has the advantages of low cost, convenience in arrangement and disassembly, good stress performance and durability. In normal sea conditions, the water bags without water injection do not affect water body exchange, substance transfer and coastal landscapes of coral reef areas, and in extreme weather such as typhoons, the flexible water bags with water injection can utilize unique wave eliminating performance of the flexible water bags, so that incident waves and currents can be effectively blocked, reflected and dissipated, coral reef individuals in the device for cultivating the dike are prevented from being affected by extreme hydrodynamic force, the survival rate of the coral reef is improved, and meanwhile, the wave affecting action of the coral reef coasts can be reduced. The invention has novel design, gives consideration to wave elimination, cost and environmental effect, and has important ecological significance and economic and practical value.

title_en: Three-dimensional printing method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a three-dimensional printing method, a three-dimensional printing device, three-dimensional printing equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring data of an additional three-dimensional object and first printing data; the first printing data comprises data of a printed part and data of a part to be printed of a currently executed first printing job; determining whether to add an additional three-dimensional object according to the first printing parameters; the first printing parameters are first printing data, or the first printing parameters are the first printing data and the data of the additional three-dimensional object; if the additional three-dimensional object is determined to be added, generating data of the base according to the first printing data and the data of the additional three-dimensional object; the base is used for supporting a three-dimensional object printed according to the additional three-dimensional object; generating a second printing operation according to the data of the part to be printed, the data of the base and the data of the additional three-dimensional object; and performing three-dimensional printing based on the second printing job. Additional three-dimensional objects can be added in the printing process of the first printing job, and the working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Metal radiating fin rivet pressing machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a metal radiating fin rivet pressing machine.A turntable mechanism is provided with at least one material taking station in the rotating direction; the carrier assembly is used for bearing and positioning the metal radiating fin and can move to or away from an assembling station for installing rivets in a controlled manner; the feeding mechanism is used for conveying rivets to the material taking station in a placing state that the rivets are placed vertically and the heads of the rivets face upwards; the picking and placing mechanism is provided with a grabbing state which is fixed with the head of the rivet on the material taking station and limits the upward movement of the rivet relative to the picking and placing mechanism and a releasing state which enables the rivet to be separated from the picking and placing mechanism; the transfer pressing mechanism is used for driving the taking and placing mechanism to controllably move back and forth between the taking station and the assembling station; the transfer and downward-pressing mechanism comprises an up-and-down moving mechanism for driving the pick-and-place mechanism to move up and down. The automatic assembling machine has high automation degree, can automatically assemble the plastic rivets on the metal radiating fins, has high operation efficiency, saves time and labor, and effectively meets the assembling requirement of the metal radiating fins.

title_en: Automatic change birds, beasts and eggs conveyer
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic poultry egg conveyor in the technical field of poultry egg conveying, which comprises a splicing track, wherein the splicing track comprises a straight line section, a turning section and a rising section, the upper end surface of the splicing track is provided with a plurality of semi-capsule-shaped eggshells, the opening of each eggshell is upward, a universal connecting mechanism is arranged between every two eggshells, the lower end of each eggshell is positioned at the position of the splicing track and is provided with a clamping mechanism for keeping the opening of the eggshell upward all the time, and the lower end of the eggshell is connected to an existing power mechanism in a transmission way; the invention effectively solves the problems that the existing poultry egg conveyor can only achieve climbing with higher gradient by extending the gradient when the climbing height is larger, but cannot infinitely extend the gradient length due to the environmental influence of a farm, so that the required gradient lifting cannot be performed to a certain extent, and the poultry eggs are easy to drop and throw when climbing with larger amplitude, so that the poultry eggs are cracked.

title_en: Clothing lace processing equipment
abstract_en: A garment lace processing device comprises a lace machine body, a flattening component and a moving component; the lace machine body comprises a platform (1), an upright post (2), a fixing frame (3), a lace wheel (4), a sleeve (5), a support column (8) and a first limiting rod (9), wherein the flattening assembly comprises a moving frame (10), a screw rod (11), a motor (12), a support rod (13), a first stop block (14), a shell (15), a first spring (16), a flattening roller (17) and a fan (18); the moving assembly comprises a fixed block (19), a rotating rod (20), a limiting block (21), a second spring (22), a universal wheel (23) and a first handle (24). According to the equipment, the flattening assembly is arranged, the flattening roller (17) is utilized to flatten the cloth, so that the phenomenon that the quality of embossing is affected due to the fact that the cloth is wrinkled during embossing is avoided, the fan (18) is utilized to dissipate heat of the cloth, the cooling speed is increased, and the time is saved; the device is provided with the moving assembly, and the device can be conveniently moved by utilizing the retractable universal wheels (23), so that the device is convenient to carry.

title_en: Pre-pressing assembly type asphalt mixture surface layer forming equipment and process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pre-pressing assembly type asphalt mixture surface layer forming device and a pre-pressing assembly type asphalt mixture surface layer forming process, which belong to the technical field of road engineering and comprise the following steps: wheel grinds shaping module and pre-compaction shaping module, wheel grinds shaping module and is used for preliminary compaction hot mix asphalt mixture, pre-compaction shaping module includes: the top of the second reaction frame is hung with a second loading device, and the output end of the second loading device is fixedly connected with a pre-pressing plate; the wheel grinds the below of shaping module and pre-compaction shaping module and runs through a conveyer belt, be provided with the base on the conveyer belt, be fixed with around the base and enclose and keep off the mould. According to the invention, through the pre-pressing module and the process, the compaction load is continuously applied to the hot-mix asphalt mixture surface layer, the rebound of the conventional asphalt layer after compaction can be reduced, the stressed contact between the aggregate and the asphalt is kept at all times, the influence of the shrinkage of the aggregate and the asphalt on the adhesiveness is effectively reduced, and therefore, the strength and the service life of the assembled asphalt pavement are improved.

title_en: Combined deep sea fishery breeding system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a combined deep sea fishery culture system which comprises a hull and a net cage detachably mounted at the tail of the hull, wherein a wave compensator is mounted at the tail of the hull, a first guide rail is mounted on the upper side of the tail of the hull, and a portal crane is slidably mounted at the upper part of the first guide rail; the net cage comprises a box body, a compensator notch which is arranged on the side part of the box body and is in butt joint with the wave compensator, and a second guide rail which is arranged on the upper part of the box body; after the box body is in butt joint with the ship body, the side part of the second guide rail is in butt joint with the first guide rail, and the specifications of the second guide rail and the first guide rail are the same. According to the invention, the connection between the tail part of the ship body and the net cage is realized through the matching of the wave compensator and the compensator notch, the integral movement of the net cage is conveniently driven by the ship body, the movement position of the net cage is convenient, the gantry crane can be moved to the upper part of the net cage through the matching of the first guide rail and the second guide rail, and the subsequent fishing and the transfer of the captured fish are convenient.

title_en: Plastic battery box gripping device for injection molding
abstract_en: The invention discloses a plastic battery box grabbing device for injection molding, which comprises: the mount, the mount includes a plurality of montants, is equipped with the crossbeam between two adjacent montants wherein, be equipped with the activity car in the crossbeam, the activity car is used for along the crossbeam motion, a pair of supporting rod and promotion subassembly are equipped with on the activity car, the promotion subassembly is used for driving a pair of supporting rod in opposite directions or reverse motion, the supporting rod bottom is equipped with the holder. The injection-molded plastic battery box is pushed and moved by the fixed frame, the cross beam, the movable vehicle and the pushing assembly, so that the operation is simple and convenient, and the time and the labor are saved.

title_en: Method for realizing carbon fiber surface modification by creating controllable three-dimensional microstructure on carbon fiber surface
abstract_en: The invention provides a carbon fiber surface modification method. Comprises immersing carbon fiber in sizing agent to finish sizing, and freeze-drying to obtain modified carbon fiber. The carbon fiber modified by the method can form a controllable three-dimensional microstructure on the surface of the carbon fiber, has obviously increased surface roughness, not only has abundant groups capable of being chemically connected with a matrix, but also has strong mechanical interlocking capability with the matrix, and is beneficial to improving the interface performance of the carbon fiber reinforced composite material.
