The modification method is efficient, convenient and environment-friendly, is applied to high-performance carbon fiber reinforced polymer composite materials, and has wide application prospects in the fields of aerospace, vehicle engineering, energy equipment, intelligent equipment and the like.

title_en: Weeding composition containing herbicide adjuvant and weeding method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of herbicides, in particular to a weeding composition containing a herbicide assistant and a weeding method thereof, and provides a scheme which comprises that the herbicide composition comprises effective components and a pesticide assistant; the effective components of the herbicide composition include acetochlor, butachlor, fluoroglycofen-ethyl, methoxone, bentazon, dicamba and mixed liquor. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the technical progress that: the weeding composition has longer weeding duration and obvious complementary action, can prevent weeds after early stage germination, and has better wettability and permeability on plant surfaces.

title_en: Rice processing is with equipment of shelling
abstract_en: The invention relates to husking equipment for rice processing, which comprises a first box body, wherein a feeding pipe is arranged at the top end of the first box body, two mutually matched rolling rollers are rotatably arranged inside the first box body, a first motor is arranged on the side wall of the first box body in a matched mode, a second box body is connected below the first box body, a vibration material guide plate is obliquely arranged in the second box body, a sliding installation structure is arranged between the vibration material guide plate and the second box body, a driving mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the vibration material guide plate in a matched mode, a blowing pipe is arranged at the top end inside the second box body, a plurality of blowing heads are uniformly arranged on the blowing pipe, and the blowing direction of each blowing head is obliquely and upwards arranged in a matched mode with the vibration material guide plate.

title_en: 360-degree free walking device of mower in situ
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mower equipment, in particular to a 360-degree free walking device of a mower in situ, which comprises a main body, wherein a mowing mechanism is arranged at the bottom end of the main body, a supporting mechanism is connected onto the main body, a walking mechanism is arranged between the supporting mechanism and the main body, a steering mechanism is connected between the walking mechanism and the mowing mechanism, an adjusting mechanism is arranged between the supporting mechanism and the main body, and a compensating mechanism is arranged between the supporting mechanism and the walking mechanism; the distance between the mowing mechanism and the ground can be conveniently adjusted through the adjusting mechanism; the plurality of movable rollers are conveniently and synchronously driven to synchronously steer through the steering mechanism, and can move in a universal way, so that the steering is more flexible; rugged ground reaction connecting axle turned angle, later conduction drive take-up pulley adjust the tensioning dynamics, for first synchronous area dynamics compensation size, ensure running gear's linkage effect avoids not smooth because the connection that the fixed arm deflected and caused, provides stable power take off for improve equipment trafficability characteristic.

title_en: Processing equipment and processing method of three-layer fragrant meat
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of three-layer fragrant meat preparation, in particular to a processing device and a processing method of three-layer fragrant meat, wherein the processing device comprises a clamping component, a placing component, an adjusting baffle, a grab handle component and a clamping component, and has the beneficial effects that: through being provided with the centre gripping subassembly that has the grab handle subassembly, thereby elasticity through a pair of grid net is pegged graft, realize carrying out the centre gripping to the streaky pork piece, realize fixing the centre gripping subassembly of fried in-process through setting up the placement component and place, prevent the scald, utilize the cooperation of adjusting the bezel and grab handle subassembly, realize the upper and lower regulation and the rigidity of grab handle subassembly, thereby different according to the processing procedure, make the centre gripping subassembly while the fried and fried oil two kinds of processing methods of adaptation, utilize the joint subassembly to further improve the installation stability of grab handle subassembly simultaneously.

title_en: Fan blade adhered with corrosion-resistant coating and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fan blades, in particular to a fan blade adhered with a corrosion-resistant coating and a preparation process thereof. The following technical scheme is proposed: the blade comprises a blade body, wherein one side surface of the blade body is of an arc-shaped structure, an anti-corrosion layer is sprayed on the outer surface of the blade body, and the blade body comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 60-90 parts of polystyrene resin, 40-70 parts of polypropylene resin, 5-15 parts of compatilizer, 4-8 parts of curing agent, 10-15 parts of carbon black and 5-10 parts of carbon fiber. According to the invention, the anti-corrosion layer is sprayed on the outer surface of the blade body, the preparation raw materials of the anti-corrosion layer comprise tungsten carbide, magnesium powder, aluminum oxide and polyurethane adhesive, the spraying stability is good, the blade has good anti-corrosion performance, the blade can work in a humid environment, the outer surface of the blade cannot be overlooked, and the service life of the blade is prolonged; the blade has an antistatic effect, and the safety of the operation of the blade is improved; the fan is mainly applied to fans.

title_en: BP film and COP film splicing equipment and splicing process method
abstract_en: The invention discloses BP film and COP film splicing equipment and a splicing process method, wherein a partition plate is arranged in a main frame body, a BP film conveying roller and an upper PF (propene Polymer) carrying film conveying roller are arranged above the partition plate, a first cutting mechanism is arranged on the inner side above the partition plate, a COP film conveying roller and a lower PF carrying film conveying roller are arranged below the partition plate, a second cutting mechanism is arranged on the inner side below the partition plate, an upper PF carrying film winding roller and an RF (radio frequency) film conveying roller are arranged in the main frame body at the rear end of the partition plate, a third cutting mechanism is arranged on the rear side of the RF film conveying roller, a stripping circular angle plate is arranged behind the third cutting mechanism, and a lower PF carrying film waste discharging winding roller is arranged on the inner side below the stripping circular angle plate; the invention greatly reduces the equipment cost by the integrated equipment and the splicing process method after synchronously cutting the BP film and the COP film, and has the advantages of simple process, high synchronous production splicing accuracy, quick equipment fault maintenance, production investment without long-time debugging and great increase of the production efficiency.

title_en: Multilayer composite electrolyte membrane based on metal-organic frame material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multilayer composite electrolyte membrane based on metal-organic framework (MOF) and a preparation method thereof, wherein the composite electrolyte membrane is an ultrathin asymmetric solid electrolyte composed of a rigid MOF layer with ion regulation capability and an interface-friendly polymer layer, the rigid MOF layer improves the thermal stability of the membrane, the uniform deposition of lithium is regulated, the growth of lithium dendrites can be inhibited by higher elastic modulus, the ion conductive solution or the polymer layer can realize good electrode-electrolyte interface contact, the lithium metal symmetric battery based on the electrolyte has excellent ion uniform deposition stability, and the battery using the composite electrolyte membrane containing the ion conductive MOF layer still shows excellent electrochemical performance (-20 to 170 ℃) in the wide temperature range change process and has higher safety.

title_en: Multi-functional tree obstacle cleaning device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional tree obstacle cleaning device, which relates to the technical field of tree obstacle cleaning and comprises a handle, wherein the lower end of the handle is connected with a handle, a sleeve is sleeved outside the handle in a sliding mode, the upper end of the sleeve is connected with a cutter, the cutter comprises a connecting block arranged at the upper end of the sleeve, a cutter plate is arranged at the upper end of the connecting block, sawteeth are arranged on one side of the cutter plate, a chopping blade is arranged on the other side of the cutter plate, a hook is arranged on one side below the cutter plate, and a nicking tool is arranged on the foremost side of the cutter plate. This multi-functional tree barrier cleaning device realizes transmission line tree barrier clearance through gang tool, accomplishes colluding, shovel, drawing, cutting, multinomial operation such as saw to the tree barrier, need not to change different cutters, through setting up the burin, conveniently carves the mark on the tree, prevents that personnel from taking place the condition of lost, through setting up the extensible member, rotates the knob, can drive the sleeve and slide from top to bottom, and then can adjust length, makes things convenient for the better clearance to the tree barrier of personnel.

title_en: Intelligent robot for comprehensively nursing household green plants
abstract_en: An intelligent robot for comprehensively nursing home green plants comprises a machine body, wherein a main control board is arranged in the machine body, an identification component, a voice broadcasting component, a detection component, an execution driving component, a collection component and a communication component are connected to the main control board, and the identification component is used for identifying and judging different types of plants and positioning the growth positions of the plants and receiving growth information; the voice broadcasting assembly is used for transmitting voice information to a user to prompt the growth habit of the corresponding type of plants and intelligently recommend the placement positions of the plants, and when the liquid level sensor in the liquid storage tank detects that a certain liquid is exhausted, the user can be reminded of replenishing the liquid in time through broadcasting; the detection component is used for detecting and acquiring a plurality of plant care related information parameters; the execution driving assembly is used for executing and driving the corresponding functional device to complete comprehensive nursing of the plants.

title_en: Riding mower
abstract_en: The application discloses a riding mower which comprises a frame and a traveling system arranged at the front end and the rear end of the frame, wherein the traveling system comprises a front traveling wheel and a rear traveling wheel, a plane which passes through the rotation center of the front traveling wheel and is perpendicular to the traveling direction of the frame is a third plane, a seat assembly is arranged above the frame and is close to one side of the rear traveling wheel, a plane which is arranged at the forefront end of the seat assembly and is perpendicular to the traveling direction of the frame is a second plane, a power supply device is further arranged above the frame, the power supply device is positioned at one side of the second plane facing the third plane, and a display panel is arranged above the power supply device, is positioned at one side of the second plane facing the third plane and is not intersected with the second plane. The riding mower arranged in the mode can solve the problem that the existing riding mower is overturned or turned sideways due to unstable gravity center.

title_en: Starch-based food packaging film and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a starch-based food packaging film and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of food packaging materials. The microsphere immobilized pullulanase constructed by the fatty acid grafted modified chitosan nanocrystalline is adopted, the debranching enzymolysis behavior of common starch is regulated, the content of amylose in hydrolysate is improved, short amylose produced by hydrolysis and fatty acid are effectively compounded to construct a starch lipid compound, and the compound can increase the molecular distance of long amylose, inhibit retrogradation of amylose and plasticize starch molecular chains. The starch-based food packaging film has the advantages of simple preparation process, low cost and easy industrial production, and also has excellent mechanical strength and plasticity.

title_en: Template device of mirror surface concrete precast beam
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of precast beam dies, in particular to a template device of a mirror surface concrete precast beam. The mold device of the mirror-surface concrete precast beam comprises a support, a plurality of supports, a first pull rod, a second pull rod, a mold device of the mirror-surface concrete precast beam, a mold device and a mold device, wherein the plurality of supports are sequentially arranged to form a mold set, the two groups of mold sets are oppositely arranged, a movable vibration guide part is arranged in the middle of the support, a transmission gear set is arranged below the support, two ends of the first pull rod are respectively connected with the upper part of the support, one end of the second pull rod is meshed with the transmission gear set, the other end of the second pull rod is connected with the support, the mold device of the mirror-surface concrete precast beam is used for guiding vibration through displacement to cause mold vibration and matching manual vibration, vibration is performed, stress is uniform, and finished product quality is guaranteed.

title_en: Automatic change look masterbatch granulator
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of color master batch preparation, in particular to an automatic color master batch granulator, which comprises a color master batch cutting box, an outward expansion bracket, a multi-aperture extrusion granulating mechanism, an air-blast forming screen material integrated component and a reciprocating movement type screen material mechanism, wherein the outward expansion bracket is welded at the bottom of the color master batch cutting box and is used for reinforcing the color master batch cutting box, the multi-aperture extrusion granulating mechanism is fixedly arranged in the inner side wall of the color master batch cutting box, the air-blast forming screen material integrated component is fixedly arranged at the central position of the bottom of the color master batch cutting box, the air-blast forming screen material integrated component is positioned under the multi-aperture extrusion granulating mechanism, the reciprocating movement type screen material mechanism is arranged on the ground and is positioned at the bottom of the air-blast forming screen material integrated component, and the top of the color master batch cutting box is provided with a feeding groove for entering color master batch.

title_en: Toughened glass cooling system and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a toughened glass cooling device, which comprises a cooling shell; the top end of one side of the inside of the cooling shell is provided with a heating water tank, the bottom end of the heating water tank is provided with a heat conducting plate, the central position of one side of the cooling shell is provided with a mounting bracket, the top end of the cooling shell is provided with an air cooler, and a plurality of groups of ventilation pipes are arranged below the air cooler in the inside of the cooling shell; according to the invention, the heat-conducting plate and the heating water tank structure are adopted, so that the internal heat of the toughened glass is absorbed and utilized, when the toughened glass passes under the heat-conducting plate at the traction roller, the heat-conducting plate absorbs the heat radiated by the toughened glass, then the heat-conducting plate transfers the absorbed heat into the heating water tank, and the water in the heating water tank is heated by the absorbed heat, so that the waste of the heat generated by the internal heating of the toughened glass is avoided, the heat is fully utilized, and the energy-saving and environment-friendly effects are achieved.

title_en: Liquid manure control system
abstract_en: The application provides liquid manure control system, include: the system comprises a water and fertilizer irrigation model, a fertilizer PH value and EC value acquisition device, a target area PH value and EC value acquisition device, a fertilizer proportioning module and an irrigation plan module; the method comprises the steps of establishing a water and fertilizer irrigation model, simulating plant states or time periods, providing guidance for an irrigation plan of each state or time period, monitoring the PH value and EC value of the fertilizer and the PH value and EC value of the fertilizer in a pipeline, and setting a fertilizer proportioning module and an irrigation plan module to ensure irrigation accuracy; the precision of irrigation plan can be guaranteed to this application, and the better control of liquid manure control system is to the irrigation of the fertilization of plant, and then guarantees the growth of plant, accomplishes the planting of plant better, and increase of production and economic benefits reduce the manual work.

title_en: Fish scale removing mechanism
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of aquatic product processing, and discloses a fish scale removing mechanism, which comprises: the device comprises a connecting frame, a cleaning mechanism, a water conveying mechanism and a fish scale removing mechanism; wherein the upper surface of the connecting frame is provided with a mounting part; the clearing mechanism consists of a first fixing column, a second fixing column, two fixing rings, a rubber tube and a plurality of barbs; the water delivery mechanism consists of a water pump, a water delivery pipe, four third fixing columns, two water storage barrels and four fixing pipes. This fish scale clearance mechanism, can strike off the fish scale of fish both sides during two rubber tube antiport, the size of fish body is big more, the range that two rubber tubes outwards warp is big more, it is wider to strike off the scope, through driving two sets of descaler mechanism antiport, make and strike off the mechanism and strike off the fish scale, under the power cooperation of drawing of the first spring of multiunit, the effect of striking off of fish scale hook has not only been improved, make and strike off the mechanism and clear up the fish scale comprehensively, water in the leading wheel is from a plurality of standing grooves department blowout, the fish scale of fish scale hook and fish body department adhesion is washd.

title_en: Manufacturing method of environment-friendly aerated concrete block
abstract_en: The invention discloses a manufacturing method of an environment-friendly aerated concrete block, which comprises the following steps: s1, proportioning raw materials; s2, mixing the raw materials; s3, adding materials; s4, injecting into a mold; s5, steaming; the stirrer used in the manufacturing method of the aerated concrete block comprises a stirrer main body, wherein a fixed pipe is fixedly connected to the inner top of the stirrer main body, a stirring mechanism used for stirring materials is arranged in the stirrer main body, and the stirring mechanism comprises a driving rod which is rotatably connected to the inner bottom of the stirrer main body. The stirring device is reasonable in structure, the stirring range of the stirring blades can be expanded by arranging the stirring mechanism and the adjusting mechanism, so that materials can be stirred more fully, heat and water vapor generated in the stirring process can be reasonably utilized by arranging the collecting mechanism, the waste of energy can be effectively avoided, and the device is more environment-friendly.

title_en: Heat preservation furnace for PCVD deposition lathe
abstract_en: The invention relates to a heat preservation furnace for a PCVD deposition lathe, which comprises an upper furnace body and a lower furnace body which can be opened and closed, wherein graphite rods are respectively arranged in the upper furnace cavity and the lower furnace cavity, an axial through groove is formed in the bottom of the lower furnace body, a resonant cavity vertical frame penetrates through the axial through groove, the upper end of the resonant cavity vertical frame is connected with a resonant cavity arranged in the upper furnace cavity and the lower furnace cavity, the lower end of the resonant cavity vertical frame is connected with an axial reciprocating mechanism, and the heat preservation furnace is characterized in that follow-up heat preservation layers which are hermetically arranged with the axial through groove are respectively arranged on two sides of the resonant cavity vertical frame. The invention ensures that the axial through groove is always kept in a closed state, greatly enhances the closed heat preservation performance of the opening of the axial through groove below the furnace body, effectively improves the heat preservation performance of the heat preservation furnace and the temperature distribution uniformity in the furnace, is beneficial to improving the PCVD processing deposition quality of the optical fiber perform rod and reduces the energy consumption; the closed structure of the upper furnace body and the lower furnace body which can be lifted up and down is adopted, so that not only is the actual operation and the use and the maintenance of equipment convenient, but also the airtight heat preservation performance of the heat preservation furnace is further enhanced.

title_en: Vertical mold layout structure and mold opening and closing method for manufacturing prefabricated part
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vertical mold layout structure and a mold opening and closing method for manufacturing a prefabricated part, wherein the layout structure comprises a rail; two die box groups arranged in groups or one die box group arranged independently; the mould box group comprises a plurality of mould boxes which are arranged at intervals, wherein two mould box groups which are arranged in groups are respectively arranged at two ends of the track, so that a space is reserved between the two mould box groups which are arranged in groups; thereby when making the die sinking, the mould case of two mould case groups that set up in groups moves in opposite directions, and during the compound die, the mould case dorsad motion of two mould case groups that set up in groups. The travelling crane that can make the vertical form production can not overlap, guarantees that the production beat is not influenced, goes into the mould, and the operation safety of demolding has under the condition of vibrator in every mould case unit, does not disturb another unit when pouring the concrete, promotes the vertical form preparation efficiency and has still guaranteed the security simultaneously.

title_en: Powder additive-rolling near-net forming equipment and method for metal ring
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of metal material processing, and particularly discloses powder additive-rolling near-net forming equipment and method for a metal ring, wherein the equipment comprises a convex frame, a powder spreading and feeding mechanism, a rapid heating sintering device and a surrounding mill roller holding mechanism, wherein one set of the convex frame is fixed, and the other set of the convex frame is movable; the convex frame is sequentially provided with a ring rolling machine core roller system, a casting machine side seal mechanism and a ring rolling machine pressing roller system, which surround to form a powder pool area, and powder is fed to the powder pool area through a powder feeding mechanism; the ring rolling machine core roller system and the ring rolling machine pressing roller system form a pair of rollers with adjustable intervals; the rapid heating sintering device is used for heating and sintering the metal powder attached to the surface of the ring piece; the encircling mill roller-holding mechanism is used for applying roller-holding force to the ring. The invention provides the high-efficiency near-net forming equipment with short flow, low energy consumption, low cost and infinitely adjustable size for the metal ring, and has important significance for realizing the integrated near-net forming of the ring with the target size.

title_en: Double-cylinder stroke adjusting method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of transfer rings and discloses a double-cylinder stroke adjusting method which is provided with a primary cylinder and a secondary cylinder which are connected in series; during stroke adjustment, the first-stage cylinder is kept locked and fixed, and the second-stage cylinder reciprocates to adjust the stroke. The invention provides a double-cylinder stroke adjusting method, wherein a cylinder lock is used for continuously locking a primary cylinder in the using process, the opening and closing times of the cylinder lock are greatly reduced in the whole process, the abrasion degree of the cylinder lock is reduced, and the service life of the device is prolonged. In addition, the original single cylinder is replaced by the two cylinders connected in series, only the second-stage cylinder acts in the using process, the first-stage cylinder keeps a locking state and is fixed, the stroke of the cylinder can be shortened by two thirds, and the production efficiency is greatly improved.

title_en: Molecular marker assisted and artificial inoculation pathogenic bacteria tomato breeding and planting method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a molecular marker assisted and artificial inoculation pathogenic bacteria tomato breeding and planting method, which comprises the following steps: selecting and breeding strains which have good commercial properties and contain Cf-5, mi and Ty-1 3 resistance genes and can resist tomato leaf mold, tomato root knot nematode and tomato yellow leaf curl virus, and planting to obtain seeds; soaking the obtained seeds in 0.1% chlorpyrimide solution, stirring and soaking in warm water, accelerating germination until the seeds are exposed to white, and planting the seeds in planting soil obtained by mixing and stirring planting soil, amino acid long-acting slow-release nitrogen, potassium dihydrogen phosphate and polysaccharide polypeptide biological potassium, so as to carry out conventional seedling culture; and after the tomato seedlings are 15-20 days old, transplanting the tomato seedlings into a planting area where soil preparation is completed, transplanting the tomato seedlings together with planting soil during transplanting, and carrying out reasonable field management, fertilizer and water management until the tomatoes are harvested. The invention can realize the rapid breeding of excellent varieties of tomatoes on the premise of ensuring high yield, low incidence and high varieties of tomatoes.

title_en: Seedling raising humus soil with garden waste as main raw material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides seedling raising humus soil taking garden waste as a main raw material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the seedling raising humus soil taking the garden waste as the main raw material mainly comprises the following components: deciduous wood, deciduous needle wood, greening plant waste, sand, garden soil, mixed nutrient elements, compound microorganism liquid and water are suitable for seedling cultivation, are treated by micro-carbonization and allelopathy, have no inhibiting effect on seed germination and seedling growth, have no potential pest and disease damage threat, have rich nutrients, strong microorganism activity, moderate porosity and pH value, have good promoting effect on seed germination and seedling growth, can replace turf, nutrient soil, greening matrix and under-forest humus soil, can be used for agricultural planting and urban and garden greening, are treated by micro-carbonization and allelopathy to quickly kill potential pest and disease damage and allelopathy, and utilize polyamine substances such as putrescine and cadaverine generated under the anaerobic condition of bean pulp as plant growth regulators.

title_en: Kiln bottom steel structure of glass melting furnace and mounting method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of glass melting furnaces, in particular to a furnace bottom steel structure of a glass melting furnace and an installation method of the furnace bottom steel structure of the glass melting furnace. The kiln bottom steel structure of the glass melting kiln comprises a longitudinal main beam layer and a transverse secondary beam layer which are connected with each other, wherein the longitudinal main beam layer is arranged below the transverse secondary beam layer, two sides of the transverse secondary beam layer are respectively supported with a stand column, and the bottoms of the stand columns at two sides are connected with the transverse secondary beam layer. This glass melting furnace's kiln end steel construction adopts two-layer structure, supports the stand and fixes on horizontal secondary beam layer, under the prerequisite that does not influence the kiln end steel construction normal function of glass melting furnace, has reduced the horizontal girder layer of one deck, makes the kiln end steel construction of glass melting furnace obtain simplifying, and the structure is comparatively simple.

title_en: Water-saving farmland irrigation system capable of preventing straw crops from toppling over
abstract_en: The invention provides a water-saving farmland irrigation system for preventing straw crops from toppling over, which belongs to the technical field of agricultural irrigation and comprises a rack, wherein the rack comprises a plurality of rack slide rails and an adjusting rack connected to the rack slide rails, and front wheels and rear wheels are respectively arranged at two ends of the adjusting rack so that the rack can advance in a farmland; the soil rotating and slotting mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the rack slide rail and is used for slotting a groove in a farmland so as to lay a water-saving pipe; the soil covering and reinforcing mechanism is arranged on the rear side of the soil rotating and grooving mechanism and used for distributing soil which is dug by the soil rotating and grooving mechanism to two sides of the groove so that the soil is accumulated at the bottoms of straw crops on two sides to thicken the thickness of the soil at the root of the straw crops; the invention greatly reduces the labor cost of drip irrigation laying, improves the laying efficiency, ensures that the drip irrigation technology can be applied to the farmland, has good water-saving effect and can improve the lodging resistance of straw crops.

title_en: Portable radio fuse hanging bomb test frame
abstract_en: The invention discloses a movable radio fuze hanging bomb test stand, which is a radio fuze test auxiliary device, wherein a main body of the test stand is formed by telescoping a plurality of trusses, each truss is provided with a steel wire rope and a pulley block, the trusses are lifted by winding the steel wire rope through a winding drum, and the reverse and vertical directions of the trusses are realized by a hydraulic telescopic cylinder. The fuze hanging bomb test frame has the characteristics of being telescopic, can realize rapid movement by using a trailer after shrinking when realizing higher detection test height of the fuze, so that the test of the fuze under different fields is realized rapidly, and the test frame occupies smaller space and is convenient to store.

title_en: A device for scurrying bullet test
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device for a spring fleeing test, which can synchronously realize spring pressing and spring fleeing and has a fault protection function. The servo motor is arranged on the machine body, a first magazine fixing device and a second magazine fixing device are adjacently arranged, the first magazine fixing device is used for fixing a first magazine, the second magazine fixing device is used for fixing a second magazine, the servo motor is connected with a first group of crank link mechanisms through a first group of belt transmission mechanisms, output shafts of the first group of belt transmission mechanisms are connected with a second group of crank link mechanisms through a second group of belt transmission mechanisms, the second group of crank link mechanisms output linear reciprocating motion in the vertical direction, output ends of the second group of crank link mechanisms are connected with a bullet pressing sliding block and a bullet pressing head, and the bullet pressing head is downwards aligned above the second magazine; the first group of crank link mechanisms output linear reciprocating motion in the horizontal direction, the output ends of the first group of crank link mechanisms are connected with the bullet fleeing slide block and the ejector rod, and the ejector rod is aligned with the tail part of the bullet on the uppermost layer in the first magazine.

title_en: Fertilizer spraying device of plant protection machine based on fertilizer quantitative control
abstract_en: The invention provides a fertilizer spraying device of a plant protection machine based on quantitative fertilizer control, which belongs to the technical field of plant protection and comprises a stirring box, wherein an impact resistant module is arranged at the bottom of the stirring box, a supporting piece is fixedly connected to the upper part of the stirring box, the supporting piece is connected with a motor shell, a stirring shaft is fixedly connected to the power output end of the motor, and a plurality of stirring rods are arranged at the lower end of the stirring shaft extending into the stirring box. The fertilizer device is spouted to plant protection machine can't carry out the ration when spouting fertile, continuously spray an area, have probability when displacing and suffer the collision and can cause displacement piece to suffer the injury always, can appear concussion when spouting fertile and easily appear the problem of empting when displacing too soon.

title_en: Resin composition, preparation method thereof and carbon fiber prepreg
abstract_en: The application discloses a resin composition, a preparation method thereof and a carbon fiber prepreg, and relates to the technical field of composite materials. The resin composition comprises the components of an epoxy resin component, a thermoplastic resin and an aromatic curing agent with a flexible branched chain, wherein the addition amount of the thermoplastic resin is 3% -28% of the epoxy resin component, the molar ratio of active hydrogen of the aromatic curing agent to the number of epoxy groups in the epoxy resin component is 0.7-1.3, the epoxy resin component comprises, by mass, 5% -50% of a first epoxy resin with a cyclohexane structure and 50% -95% of a second epoxy resin with a benzene ring structure, and the resin composition provided by the application has good flexibility and heat resistance, and the flexible chain segments of the first epoxy resin and the curing agent can eliminate large deformation of the tensile stress effect of a composite material, delay the breakage of the resin chain segments and realize high-strength conversion rate of carbon fibers.

title_en: Equipment for automatically kneading and forming tea leaves
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device for automatically packing, kneading and forming tea leaves, which is characterized in that a lifting mechanism is arranged on a frame, the lifting mechanism is connected with an upper rolling mechanism, the upper rolling mechanism can vertically move relative to the frame along with the lifting mechanism, a lower rolling mechanism is arranged on the frame, and the lower rolling mechanism is positioned right below the upper rolling mechanism; the machine frame is provided with a driving mechanism which is connected with the upper rolling mechanism and the lower rolling mechanism at the same time. The invention uses the inward oblique angle of the crank, and the extension circle of the crank center intersects with the extension circle of the crank center and the center circle of the edge of the kneading disc at one point, so that the kneading disc can always keep a small gap without interference with the kneading drum during swinging, the overflow of tea leaves from the gap is prevented, and the inner walls of the upper kneading disc, the lower kneading disc and the kneading drum form a closed containing cavity which can change shape along with the swinging of the kneading disc. The worker only needs to lift the upper rolling device, a proper amount of tea leaves are filled in the upper rolling device, the equipment is started, and the upper rolling disc automatically enters the packing and kneading cylinder to seal the tea leaves in the packing and kneading cylinder.

title_en: High-hydrophilicity inorganic doped composite porous polymer diaphragm, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of hydrogen production by alkaline electrolysis of water, and particularly relates to a high-hydrophilicity inorganic doped composite porous polymer diaphragm, a preparation method and application thereof. The organic high molecular polymer with a benzimidazole structure and high-hydrophilicity inorganic filler which are better than polysulfone in hydrophilicity are selected as raw materials to be doped, so that the organic polymer and the inorganic filler have high compatibility, and then a non-solvent induced phase conversion method is used for preparing the inorganic doped porous polybenzimidazole diaphragm with high hydrophilicity, high conductivity, high gas barrier property and low ohmic resistance.

title_en: Production device and production method for multilayer structure current collector
abstract_en: The invention discloses a production device for a multilayer structure current collector, which comprises: an evaporation tank; the built-in substrate is arranged in the evaporation tank, a sealing outer ring is arranged on the built-in substrate, and the built-in substrate is rotationally connected in the evaporation tank through the sealing outer ring; the placement notches are circumferentially distributed on the built-in substrate and used for supporting the middle polymer film material; the carbon column forming assembly is fixed on one side of the evaporation tank and sleeved outside the built-in substrate; and the carbon coating device is erected in the evaporation tank and is positioned above the built-in substrate, and can carry out surface carbon coating on the polymer film materials in each placement notch and form a carbon layer, so that the porosity generated in the excessive evaporation of the polymer film materials is reduced.

title_en: Bamboo shoot slice cleaning equipment for bamboo shoot processing
abstract_en: The invention discloses bamboo shoot slice cleaning equipment for processing bamboo shoots, which comprises a base, wherein a cleaning box body is arranged on the base, a conveying mesh belt is arranged in the cleaning box body, two ends of the conveying mesh belt are in transmission connection with rotating rollers, a sliding groove is formed in the position, close to the top end, of the cleaning box body, a plurality of groups of conveying plates are arranged on the outer side of the conveying mesh belt, the conveying plates are hollow, and a plurality of groups of air blowing holes are formed in two sides of the conveying plates.

title_en: A general precast beam mould for lying water
abstract_en: The invention aims to solve the problem of pouring of precast beams, and discloses a universal precast beam mould for lying pouring, which comprises a supporting plate, wherein connecting frames are fixedly arranged on the left side surface and the right side surface of the supporting plate, rotary drums are arranged on the connecting frames, a conveying belt is connected between the rotary drums, a mould is fixedly arranged in the middle of the surface of the supporting plate, guide rods are symmetrically arranged on the left side surface and the right side surface of the mould, racks are welded on the outer surfaces of the guide rods, lantern rings are sleeved outside the guide rods, inclined frames are fixedly arranged on the side surfaces of the lantern rings, first motors are fixedly arranged at the outer ends of the inclined frames, gears are arranged in the middle of the first motors, connecting plates are uniformly arranged above the mould, connecting rods are connected between the connecting plates and the lantern rings, and connecting belts are connected between the connecting plates. According to the invention, the conveying belt is arranged, and the pressing plate is pressed, so that the mold can be formed into molds with different shapes, and the pouring is more convenient.

title_en: System for leukemia diagnosis and treatment
abstract_en: The present application relates to a system for performing leukemia diagnosis and treatment, the system comprising: a modeling module for constructing a leukemia patient-specific humanized disease model and at least one detection module for detecting the presence and/or proportion of leukemia cells. The system has the characteristics of high specificity and the like, and can be used for personalized diagnosis and treatment of patients.

title_en: Cable molding raw material treatment process
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of equipment related to cable raw material treatment, and particularly relates to a cable forming raw material treatment process, which comprises a treatment box and a feeding port, wherein one side of the upper end surface of the treatment box is provided with the feeding port, a plurality of material distributing openings are uniformly arranged in the feeding port in the linear direction, a dust removing box is connected and arranged below the material distributing openings in the treatment box, a material distributing box is arranged in the dust removing box, the top of the material distributing box is connected and communicated with the material distributing openings, a sealing slide plate is arranged at the bottom of the material distributing box in a sliding manner, a mesh sieve plate is obliquely and elastically arranged in the dust removing box below the sealing slide plate, one side of the dust removing box is fixedly provided with a grinding box in the treatment box, one side of the grinding box, close to the dust removing box, is provided with a stirring bin, two stirring crushing shafts are symmetrically arranged at the bottom of the stirring bin, and a plurality of grinding bins are uniformly arranged in the grinding box in the linear direction. The invention can effectively mix and crush plastic particles.

title_en: Amino molding plastic ball-milling powder making device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of amino molding plastic processing equipment, and particularly discloses an amino molding plastic ball-milling powder making device which comprises a base, support frames and ball-milling rollers, wherein the support frames are fixed at the left end and the right end of the base; this amino molding plastic ball-milling powder process device also can have better ball-milling effect to amino molding plastic under less volume, just discharges it fast after guaranteeing amino molding plastic fully to ball-mill simultaneously, has effectively improved the effect that whole device carries out the ball-milling powder process to amino molding plastic.

title_en: Preparation method of conductive organic hydrogel, hydrogel and application thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a preparation method of a conductive organic hydrogel, which comprises the following steps: dispersing cellulose nanocrystals in ultrapure water until the cellulose nanocrystals are completely dissolved, adding tannic acid into the ultrapure water in which the cellulose nanocrystals are dissolved, continuously stirring, and continuously stirring to obtain a cellulose nanocrystal solution coated by tannic acid; dispersing sodium dodecyl sulfate and graphene in ultrapure water, continuously stirring, performing ultrasonic treatment on the mixture, and completely dispersing the mixture to obtain a graphene dispersion liquid; mixing a cellulose nanocrystalline solution coated by tannic acid and a graphene dispersion solution, adding polyacrylamide and borax pentahydrate into the mixed solution, continuously adding an initiator, a cross-linking agent and a catalyst, and performing free radical polymerization to obtain a hydrogel precursor; and fully drying the hydrogel precursor, and introducing an organic solvent ethylene glycol into the dried hydrogel precursor through solvent replacement to prepare the conductive organic hydrogel. The application also provides a hydrogel and application thereof.

title_en: Automatic silt cleaning system for aquaculture
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of aquaculture, in particular to an automatic silt cleaning system for aquaculture, which comprises a control module, a silt cleaning module and a dispersing module; the control module is a central processing unit; the silt cleaning module comprises a silt cleaning unit and an anti-sucking fish unit; the mud cleaning unit comprises a mud pumping cylinder and a mud pump, and the mud pumping cylinder is arranged at the bottom of the culture pond; the fish suction preventing unit comprises a filter screen, a motor and a baffle; the mud pump and the motor are controlled to operate by the central processing unit, so that the mud in the breeding pond is pumped out, the fish can be sucked to a random position on the filter screen, and when the baffle rotates to the position, the suction force at the position disappears, and the fish can freely swim; the dispersing module comprises a drainage tube, a packing auger and an elastic strip; the external water source supplies water to the drainage tube, and the water flow drives the elastic strip to rotate through the auger to dispel and frighten nearby fishes, so that the fishes are prevented from entering the mud pumping barrel.

title_en: ETPU particulate material 3D printer
abstract_en: The invention relates to an ETPU (electronic toll collection) particle material 3D printer, wherein a printing head conveying device is arranged on a frame, a first printing head is arranged at the output end of the printing head conveying device, the first printing head is close to a workpiece at any position, the workpiece conveying device is arranged on the frame, the workpiece conveying device is provided with two mutually perpendicular rotating shafts, a workpiece is clamped at the output end of the workpiece conveying device, the workpiece can be contacted with the first printing head at any angle, the first printing head comprises a first particle inlet, a first aqueous gel inlet, a first aqueous catalyst inlet and a gel-carrying particle outlet, particles enter the first printing head from the first particle inlet, the first aqueous gel inlet injects aqueous gel, and injects aqueous catalyst at the first aqueous catalyst inlet, so that adjacent particles can be mutually adhered, and the gel-carrying particle outlet extrudes particles with the surface full of the gel to the workpiece to be piled up to realize 3D printing, and the printed workpiece has good elasticity and air permeability.

title_en: Deep-open sea net cage pump water circulation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep-open sea net cage pump water circulation system which comprises a floating ring, a coaming and a first lice separating net, wherein the coaming is arranged outside the floating ring, a baffle plate is arranged outside the coaming, the first lice separating net is arranged at the bottom of the baffle plate, baffles are arranged on the surface of a stabilizing frame at intervals, and filtering holes are formed in the surface of the baffle plate. In the using process of the invention, the clamping plate and the reset spring are mutually matched, so that the main scraping plate and the auxiliary scraping plate can scrape sludge impurities outside the baffle, external seawater can smoothly enter the baffle, the liquid inlet hopper arranged in the upper area and the lower area of the liquid inlet pipe can enable external seawater to enter the liquid inlet pipe, and the seawater can be discharged through the jet grooves arranged on the surface of the jet pipe, so that the seawater discharged by the jet grooves can impact one surface of the lice separating net, the sludge and sea lice attached to the one surface of the lice separating net can be further removed, the one surface of the lice separating net can be ensured to be clean, and the water circulation effect can be further ensured.

title_en: Sizing material feeding system and sizing material feeding method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sizing material feeding system and a sizing material feeding method, and relates to the technical field of tire production. The adhesive bonding feeding support comprises a conveying support, a conveying mechanism, a pressing roller mechanism, a material delivery mechanism and a forming drum, wherein the conveying support is fixedly arranged above the conveying support, the conveying mechanism is carried on the conveying support and used for receiving and conveying the adhesive from the main feeding device, the pressing roller mechanism is carried on the conveying support and used for rolling and bonding the adhesive, the conveying mechanism is carried on the conveying support, and the conveying mechanism is used for respectively conveying the material head and the material tail of the adhesive on the conveying mechanism to the forming drum so as to finish head-tail joint of the adhesive on the forming drum. The invention can avoid the gap at the joint after the glue is attached, thereby improving the attaching quality and attaching efficiency.

title_en: Colored fiber, colored fiber piece, fiber-reinforced composite, structural member and preparation method
abstract_en: The application discloses colored fibers, colored fiber pieces, fiber reinforced composite materials, structural parts and a preparation method, and belongs to the field of fiber materials. The colored fiber includes: transparent inorganic fiber and pigment, transparent inorganic fiber is hollow structure, and pigment is located transparent inorganic fiber's cavity inside. The color of the colored fiber has permeability, and the pigment is protected by the transparent inorganic fiber and is not easy to be abraded or destroyed. The preparation method of the colored fiber is simple and easy to operate, has low cost, is not excessively limited in the process of adding pigment into the transparent inorganic fiber, and meets the customization requirement of rapid iteration of the colored fiber product.

title_en: Multi-gear acceleration shell throwing device
abstract_en: In order to effectively solve the problem of congestion of a cartridge in a shell throwing guide during low-speed shooting of a rotary pipe type gun, the invention provides a multi-gear accelerating shell throwing device, which can match corresponding shell throwing speeds aiming at the shooting speeds of different gears, and ensure that the shell throwing speed is kept high at the multi-gear shooting speed, so that the smoothness of shell throwing is ensured. The invention adopts the input shaft, the cylindrical gear, the first duplex gear, the second duplex gear and the elliptic gear to form the fixed-axis gear train, and the transmission keys on the output shaft are combined with different gears to select different transmission routes through the axial forward and backward movement of the output shaft, so that the selection of transmission speed ratio gears is realized, the rotating speed of the shell throwing claw shaft which is coaxially and synchronously butted with the output shaft and rotates can be gradually accelerated from the same rotating speed as the shooting speed after receiving a shell (or a cartridge) and the shell throwing speed can be ensured to be kept at a high speed under the multi-gear shooting speed, thereby ensuring the smoothness of shell throwing and preventing the congestion of a subsequent shell throwing guide channel.

title_en: High-performance concrete decorative material and forming method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-performance concrete decorative material and a forming method thereof, wherein the high-performance concrete decorative material comprises, by weight, 100-120 parts of a composite cementing material, 100-170 parts of sand, 0.4-6 parts of fibers, 0.05-0.24 part of an additive, 10-50 parts of water, 0.01-0.12 part of a pigment, 8-13 parts of expanded perlite and 2-8 parts of vitrified micro bubbles. The high-performance concrete decorative material has the advantages of ultrahigh mechanical strength, ultrahigh weather resistance, ultralow water absorption and excellent dirt resistance, so that the service life of the material even exceeds that of a building matrix, and the material is very ideal building outer wall skin.

title_en: Automatic intelligent wolfberry picking system and wolfberry planting method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic medlar picking intelligent system which comprises a picking machine, a sensing detection unit, an unmanned aerial vehicle Internet of things unit and a system configuration unit. The picking machine comprises a vibrator, a cuboid harvesting device and a rail guiding vehicle body, wherein the vibrator is used for applying sine excitation with variable frequency amplitude to medlar plants to harvest medlar fruits with different maturity, the cuboid harvesting device is matched with an electric push rod through a fork frame to realize automatic collection action, and the rail guiding vehicle body is controlled and scheduled through a sensing detection unit, an unmanned aerial vehicle Internet of things unit and a system configuration unit to realize whole-course automatic picking. The invention provides the concept of an intelligent agricultural factory, the cultivation pruning mode of the matrimony vine in a layered manner is used for managing matrimony vine agriculture according to an industrial mode, so that the picking efficiency and the picking quality are improved, the labor cost and the labor intensity are reduced, and the intelligent matrimony vine cultivation pruning method has great significance for economic development and intelligent picking of the matrimony vine industry in China.

title_en: Construction method and application of ZDHC 21 gene mutation animal model
abstract_en: The invention provides an sgRNA for specifically targeting a ZDHC 21 gene through a CRISPR-Cas9 system, a method for preparing a ZDHC 21 gene mutant animal model based on the sgRNA, and application of the constructed animal model as an Alzheimer disease animal model; the method for constructing the Alzheimer's disease animal model with the ZHHC 21 gene mutation can obtain higher success rate, and the constructed ZHHC 21 gene mutation animal model can be used for an animal model of Alzheimer's disease, which has important application value for the occurrence and development mechanism of Alzheimer's disease (particularly researching the action of the ZHHC 21 gene in the occurrence and development of Alzheimer's disease) or screening therapeutic drugs of Alzheimer's disease.

title_en: Container unit for plant cultivation and greening method using the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a container unit for greening a wall surface or the like, and a greening method using the container unit, and is a container unit for plant cultivation which is easy to handle, is very easy to construct for greening a wall surface or the like, can be performed in a short period of time, is easy to replace planting, and is excellent in maintainability. The container unit for plant cultivation comprises: an outer container having an upper surface opening and a front surface opening; an inner container inserted into the front opening of the outer container and locked; and a fixing plate for fixing the inner container to the outer container, wherein the inner container can accommodate the plant cultivation substrate such as soil and the potted plant, has a front opening portion capable of exposing a part of the plant body of the potted plant to the outside, has an upper surface opening portion for accommodating the plant cultivation substrate and the potted plant separately from the front opening portion, and has a front flange portion engaged with a wall portion around the front opening portion of the outer container on the front surface having the front opening portion, and the inner container is configured to be detachably accommodated in the outer container.

title_en: Method for degrading plastic products
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for degrading plastic products and the use thereof. The method of the invention comprises in particular a step of amorphizing the plastic product before the depolymerization step. The process of the invention is particularly suitable for degrading plastic products comprising polyethylene terephthalate and/or polylactic acid. The invention also relates to a method for producing monomers and/or oligomers from a plastic product comprising at least one polyester, in particular polyethylene terephthalate and/or polylactic acid, said method comprising subjecting the plastic product to both an amorphisation step and a depolymerization step.

title_en: Fertilizing device and fertilizing method for corn fertilizer
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field related to fertilizer applying devices, in particular to a fertilizer applying device and a fertilizer applying method for corn fertilizer, comprising a supporting plate, wherein a fertilizer storage cylinder is fixed on the upper surface of the supporting plate, a group of material guiding pipes are fixed at the bottom of the fertilizer storage cylinder, a group of material discharging pipes matched with the material guiding pipes are arranged at the bottom of the supporting plate, an anti-blocking device is arranged in the material discharging pipes, a first sliding groove is formed in the outer side wall of the material discharging pipes, a first sliding block is slidably arranged in the first sliding groove, a connecting plate is fixed on the outer side wall of the first sliding block, a first supporting plate is fixed at the lower end of the connecting plate, a second supporting plate is fixed on the upper surface of the first supporting plate, and the first supporting plate and the second supporting plate are arranged in a three-dimensional mode, so that blocking probability of fertilizer in the material discharging pipes can be released is reduced, the connecting plate drives the first supporting plate and the second supporting plate to slide in the material discharging pipes, soil can be extruded out from the material discharging pipes, pipelines of the fertilizer applying device can be conveniently cleaned, and the efficiency of cleaning the blocked pipelines can be improved.

title_en: Application process for producing medical surgical gloves by using low-ammonia latex
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of latex gloves and discloses an application process for producing medical surgical gloves by using low-ammonia latex, which comprises the following steps of S1, presulfiding the latex, namely presulfiding low-ammonia concentrated natural latex; S2, pre-treatment of the mould, namely cleaning, drying and preheating the mould, S3, gum dipping of the mould, namely dipping pre-vulcanized latex in the mould, S4, vulcanization molding, namely drying and vulcanizing the adhesive film and then post-treating to obtain the finished glove. The medical surgical glove is prepared by latex pre-vulcanization, mold pretreatment, mold gum dipping and vulcanization molding in sequence, has the advantages of good elastic deformation capability, convenient wearing, good tensile property, difficult tearing phenomenon, good aging resistance, stable comprehensive performance under a long-time severe environment, puncture resistance, high safety and prevention of infection, and is not easy to break due to cutting and puncturing of surgical equipment when a doctor wears the medical surgical glove.

title_en: Plant oil-based polyphenol and method for preparing recyclable polyurethane foam by using plant oil-based polyphenol
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of polyurethane materials, and particularly relates to a plant oil-based polyphenol and a method for preparing recyclable polyurethane foam by using the plant oil-based polyphenol. According to the invention, a series of vegetable oil-based polyphenols are obtained by modifying vegetable oil, and then blended with auxiliary agents such as isocyanate, foaming agent and the like, and the polyurethane foam is prepared by curing, wherein phenolic hydroxyl groups in the vegetable oil-based polyphenols react with isocyanate to form phenol-carbamate, and the phenolic hydroxyl groups can not only keep the performance stability of the material in use, but also realize cyclic recycling under mild conditions, so that the polyurethane foam is an ideal dynamic bond for constructing thermosetting polyurethane materials; in addition, the prepared vegetable oil-based polyurethane foam not only has more excellent mechanical and cyclic regeneration performance, but also takes vegetable oil which is a forest resource in China as a raw material, and has the dual effects of saving resources and protecting environment.

title_en: Ceramic automatic molding die
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic ceramic product forming die, which belongs to the field of ceramic roll forming and comprises a forming frame and a forming mechanism arranged in the forming frame, wherein the forming mechanism comprises a material guide assembly, a jacking assembly and a forming assembly, the material guide assembly comprises a working motor, a threaded rod, a connecting sliding block and a material guide plate, the inner wall of the forming frame is fixedly connected with the working motor, the output end of the working motor is provided with the threaded rod, the outer wall of the threaded rod is in threaded connection with the connecting sliding block, the outer wall of the connecting sliding block is fixedly connected with the material guide plate, the automatic ceramic product forming die is provided with a forming guide post, the connecting sliding block slides through a forming hole plate to drive the forming guide post to slide along the outer wall of a forming guide groove, the forming guide post slides through the forming groove plate to drive the forming motor to vertically slide along the outer wall of a second limiting guide groove, and the forming motor slides to drive a male end die to enter a female end die, so that roll forming operation is realized on a blank column in the female end die.

title_en: Mould structure of sectional type high-pressure injection technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of mold equipment, in particular to a mold structure of a sectional type high-pressure injection process, which comprises a mold upper cover and a mold base, wherein a mold cavity and a glue overflow cavity are formed in the bottom surface of the mold upper cover, the mold cavity is positioned at the inner side of the glue overflow cavity, and the mold cavity is communicated with the glue overflow cavity through an openable or closable glue overflow channel; the top surface of the die base is provided with a die body which can be matched with the die cavity, and a glue injection cavity can be formed between the die body and the die cavity. According to the die structure of the sectional type high-pressure injection process, the glue overflow channel which is convenient to open or close through the channel control mechanism is arranged in the die structure, when the pressure of the press is increased in the second section, the glue overflow channel is opened to be communicated with the glue injection cavity and the glue overflow cavity, the pressure in the glue injection cavity is reduced, and glue overflow is facilitated.

title_en: Regenerated indica rice harvester
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regenerated indica rice harvester which comprises an engine, a frame, a crawler travelling mechanism, a middle conveying groove and a header, wherein the engine is arranged on the frame, the crawler travelling mechanism is arranged below the frame, the middle conveying groove and the header are arranged in front of the frame, two ends of the middle conveying groove are respectively connected with the frame and the header, and two ends of a header oil cylinder are respectively connected with the frame and the header; the crawler travelling mechanism comprises a rubber crawler, and the depth of the inner side teeth of the rubber crawler is larger than that of the outer side teeth of the rubber crawler; the cutting table is made of aluminum alloy materials, the width of the rubber track is 200-260 mm, the width of the cutting table is more than 2600mm, and the specific pressure of the rubber track in grounding is 20-30 Kpa. The invention is suitable for harvesting indica rice, has light weight of the whole machine, large width of the cutting table, less ground specific pressure of the rubber track, low rolling loss rate of rice piles, high survival rate in regeneration seasons and high yield.

title_en: Plastic turnover plate vacuum plastic-sucking forming equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses vacuum plastic sucking molding equipment for a plastic turnover plate, which comprises a feeding device, wherein the outer surface of the feeding device is fixedly connected with a plastic sucking device, the feeding device comprises a storage box, the outer surface of the storage box is fixedly connected with a discharge hole, and the vacuum plastic sucking molding equipment relates to the technical field of plastic processing.

title_en: Preparation method of closed porous benzoxazine resin-based low-dielectric material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a closed porous benzoxazine resin-based low dielectric material, which comprises the following steps of dissolving a prepared poly alpha-methyl styrene star polymer and benzoxazine with a specific structure in a proper solvent according to a certain proportion to form a uniform true solution, pouring the uniform true solution into a preheated mold after vacuum defoamation, heating and curing the uniform true solution in a gradient manner, and thermally decomposing the poly alpha-methyl styrene star polymer (the upper limit temperature T  c =61 o  C of polymerization) with low thermal decomposition temperature in the curing process to form closed holes with uniform pore diameters to obtain the closed porous benzoxazine resin-based low dielectric material. The closed porous material prepared by the method has uniform pore size distribution, low dielectric constant and high breakdown strength, and excellent mechanical strength and dimensional stability, and can be used in the field of high-frequency copper-clad plates.

title_en: Method for preparing trays for carrying leather in tannery by utilizing tannery chrome-containing leather ash
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for preparing a tray for carrying leather in a leather factory by utilizing tanning chrome-containing leather scraps, which comprises the steps of uniformly mixing dried chrome-containing leather ash, special modified glue, a toughening agent, a toughening synergist, a special synthetic fatliquor for the tray and a softening agent, putting the mixture into a mold, heating and pressurizing in a vulcanizing machine, spraying isopropyl palmitate on the surface, curing to obtain a tray carrier, granulating PE particles in a double-screw extrusion device to obtain master batches, putting the modified master batches in a casting device to prepare a modified film, arranging 3 heating areas on the double-screw extrusion device and the casting device, spraying the modified film on the tray carrier, bonding the obtained tray, and then, bearing the leather weight of 2 tons of pressure.

title_en: Rotor manufacturing device and rotor manufacturing method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a rotor manufacturing apparatus and a rotor manufacturing method. A resin injection device (30) for manufacturing a rotor of a rotating electrical machine is provided with a resin injection machine (40) having an injection port (40A) for injecting resin, and is further provided with a runner (60), wherein the runner (60) has an injection port (60A) capable of being connected to the injection port (40A), and a plurality of injection ports (60B) which are communicated with the injection port (60A) and are arranged at positions corresponding to a hole (1B) of a rotor core (1A) where a magnet is arranged.

title_en: Rocket fairing horizontal projectile separation method under high overload condition
abstract_en: The invention relates to a horizontal projectile separation method of a rocket fairing under a high overload condition, wherein the fairing comprises a first half cover, a second half cover and a separation device; and calculating to obtain a fairing centroid, and positioning the combined force acting point of the separation device above the fairing centroid through position layout. The center of mass of the horizontal projectile separation fairing is positioned at the outer side of overload acting force of the rocket and the half-cover, the combined force of the separation device is positioned at the upper side of the center of mass of the fairing, and the fairing is separated to form an inverted splayed shape of the fairing half-cover so as to avoid collision with effective load. The horizontal projectile separation is carried out on the rocket driving section, the projectile shroud timing is advanced, the flying weight of the upper stage is reduced, and the rocket carrying capacity can be effectively improved.

title_en: Mower calibration method and device, electronic equipment, storage medium and mower
abstract_en: The application provides a mower calibration method, a device, electronic equipment, a storage medium and a mower, comprising: collecting position data of a preset number of mowers in the moving process of the mowers relative to the charging piles; performing straight line fitting by using position data of a preset number; and if the preset number of position data are fitted to form a straight line, determining the orientation of the charging pile according to the slope of the fitted straight line. Therefore, the method and the device can accurately determine the orientation of the charging pile, and have the advantages of high calibration accuracy and low calibration cost.

title_en: Pepper growth is with pertinence root fertilizer injection unit
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of agricultural fertilization, in particular to a specific root fertilization device for pepper growth. The invention aims to provide a specific root fertilizing device for pepper growth, which can accurately position the root of a pepper and then put in fertilizers. The utility model provides a hot pepper growth is with pertinence root fertilizer injection unit, is equipped with root fixed point mechanism including removing frame, root fixed point mechanism and root fertilizer injection mechanism, removes frame lower part inboard for accurate location hot pepper root, removes the inside root fertilizer injection mechanism that is equipped with of frame for fertilize the hot pepper root that has been fixed a position, root fertilizer injection mechanism is located root fixed point mechanism top. Through removing the frame to the hot pepper top, until hot pepper root contact steering plate, the rethread steering plate promotes and pushes away the frame, makes the accuse flitch no longer block up the conveying pipeline to make fertilizer fall on the soil of hot pepper root, in order to fertilize, prevent to apply fertilizer in the place beyond the hot pepper root, reach the extravagant effect of reduction fertilizer.

title_en: Vegetable cleaning tank and using method thereof
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of cleaning tanks, and discloses a vegetable cleaning tank, which comprises a water tank main body, a treatment tank, a cleaning shaft, an adjusting component and a rotation component, wherein the water tank main body is divided into a vegetable cavity and a common cavity, one side of the vegetable cavity is embedded in the treatment tank, the cleaning shaft is arranged in the vegetable cavity and is rotatably connected with an opening on one side of the treatment tank, and a plurality of adjusting components are slidably arranged in the treatment tank; the adjusting components are provided with autorotation components; the cleaning shafts are provided with a plurality of groups, each group is provided with a plurality of groups, the distance between every two adjacent groups of cleaning shafts is adjusted through the adjusting component, each group of cleaning shafts rotates through the rotating component, and automatic multiple groups of cleaning shafts are arranged in the water tank body. The invention can wash the placed vegetables and fruits with water, and can further clean the outer walls through the brush hairs, so that sediment and agricultural residues on the vegetables can be thoroughly cleaned, the effective cleaning is achieved, and meanwhile, both hands can be released, thereby improving the automation.

title_en: Elliptic core optical fiber and preparation method and equipment thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an elliptical core optical fiber, a preparation method and equipment thereof, and belongs to the technical field of optical fibers. An elliptic core optical fiber comprises an elliptic fiber core, a cladding and a coating layer. A method of making the optical fiber described above, comprising the steps of; (1) Processing two symmetrical pore canals in a coating layer of the prefabricated rod to obtain a pre-tensioned wire rod; (3) Drawing the pre-tensioned wire rod, coating a coating layer material, and cooling and solidifying to obtain the elliptic core optical fiber. The equipment for the preparation method comprises a rod feeding device, a pressurizing and heating wire drawing device, a PLC control part and a detection device. The elliptic core optical fiber has good polarization maintaining property, the preparation method does not need to grind and decompress and shrink the optical fiber preform, the processing size is accurate, the production process is simple, and the cost is low; related equipment has simple structure and easy operation, can accurately monitor parameters of the elliptical core in real time, has high finished product rate of the processed optical fiber and reduces production cost.

title_en: Optical disk self-service receiving and transmitting system and optical disk self-service receiving and transmitting method
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a self-service optical disk transceiving system and a self-service optical disk transceiving method, the self-service optical disk transceiving system comprising: an object grabbing device, a coding device and a control device; the control device is respectively connected with the object grabbing device and the encoding device in a communication way; the control device is used for controlling the encoding device to encode the blank optical disc, controlling the object grabbing device to grab the blank optical disc from the feeding channel to the encoding device, controlling the object grabbing device to grab the encoded blank optical disc to the dispensing window, and controlling the object grabbing device to grab the waste optical disc from the recycling window to the recycling channel. By the technical scheme, labor cost is reduced, and the receiving and dispatching efficiency and accuracy of the optical disk are improved.

title_en: Preparation method of ferrite magnetic material with high magnetic conductivity
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ferrite magnetic processing, in particular to a preparation method of a ferrite magnetic material with high magnetic conductivity; the method comprises the following steps: step one: preparing annular ferrite; step two: the annular ferrite is arranged on a calcination supporting table and is sent to a calciner for calcination; step three: removing the calcination supporting table from the calcination furnace, and cooling the annular ferrite; step four: a plurality of annular ferrites are placed on a calcination supporting table in a concentrated mode, and the side parts and the side edges of the annular ferrites are polished; the annular ferrites are arranged on the supporting component at intervals or in a concentrated manner; because the ferrite of high permeability is comparatively sensitive to mechanical stress, so this application reduces the mechanical damage that causes the annular ferrite of high permeability through reducing the transport demand to annular ferrite.

title_en: Improve device that sweet potato was gathered
