abstract_en: The invention discloses a device for improving sweet potato harvesting, which relates to the technical field of sweet potato harvesting equipment, and comprises a frame, wherein an excavating mechanism, a soil-potato separating screen and an adjustable screening mechanism are sequentially arranged on the frame along the sweet potato conveying direction; the frame is provided with a rear outlet for rolling out the sweet potatoes; the adjustable screening mechanism comprises a first screen frame and a second screen frame, wherein a plurality of first screen bars are uniformly arranged at intervals, the second screen frame is positioned at the bottom of the first screen frame, the first screen bars and the second screen bars are arranged in parallel, the distance between two adjacent first screen bars is equal to the distance between two adjacent second screen bars, and the distance between two adjacent first screen bars is equal to the distance between two adjacent second screen bars along the width direction of the first screen bars; adopt the mode that forms the sweet potato that is used for getting rid of the sweet potato of minor diameter between adjacent first screen bar and second screen bar and leak the sweet potato gap, can change the size that leaks the sweet potato gap according to actual conditions, and then reach the purpose of carrying out automatic screening to the sweet potato of equidimension not, replaced the mode of manual cleaning, can use manpower sparingly to show and promote screening efficiency.

title_en: Small prefabricated part pouring mold and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of building member processing, in particular to a small prefabricated member pouring die which comprises a bottom pad, wherein a lateral enclosing mechanism is arranged above the bottom pad; the reinforcing connecting piece is arranged on the lateral enclosing mechanism and used for limiting and reinforcing the lateral enclosing mechanism; the separation mechanism is arranged in the lateral enclosing mechanism and divides the lateral enclosing mechanism into a plurality of workpiece pouring areas; the beneficial effects are as follows: the small prefabricated component pouring die provided by the invention adopts a universal structure, and after the die components are assembled and combined for use, different building components are poured, so that the high cost brought by independently matching the whole set of equipment for the building components is reduced.

title_en: Post grouting device for bored pile and application method of post grouting device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post grouting device for a bored pile and a use method thereof, and relates to the technical field of grouting devices; to ensure stability during grouting; the device specifically comprises a base and a supporting part, wherein the supporting part comprises: and (3) supporting seats: the outer wall of the bottom of the vertical rod is fixed with a vertical rod through a pin, and the outer wall of the bottom of the vertical rod is fixed with a mounting ring through a pin; t-shaped rod: the mounting ring is fixed on the circumferential inner wall of the mounting ring through a pin; guide frame: the movable connecting device is movably connected to the circumferential outer wall of the T-shaped rod; and a hydraulic cylinder II: the device is fixed on the outer wall of the top of the supporting seat; and (3) moving the disc: the hydraulic cylinder is fixed at the output end of the hydraulic cylinder II through a pin; the application method of the grouting device comprises the following steps: the whole grouting device is moved to a grouting site by using universal wheels. The invention uses the transmission function of the belt I to drive the stirring blade and the stirring column to rotate, so that the slurry in the bored pile can be stirred and mixed in the grouting process, and the uniformity of the slurry is ensured.

title_en: Rice combine harvester based on combined navigation technology
abstract_en: The application discloses rice combine harvester based on integrated navigation technique relates to agricultural machinery technical field, includes: the harvester comprises a harvester main body, wherein a panoramic data acquisition device and an INS inertial navigation system are arranged on the harvester main body, the panoramic data acquisition device comprises a top data acquisition device and a peripheral data acquisition device, and the panoramic data acquisition device is used for reconstructing topographic information; the marking device is arranged at the middle position of the tail of the harvester main body, a plurality of marking rods are preloaded in the marking device, and the marking device is in signal connection with the INS inertial navigation system and is used for generating a passing route marking point according to the walking position of the harvester main body; wherein, top data acquisition mechanism settles in the top of harvester main part. The rice combine harvester based on the combined navigation technology avoids the problem of poor route precision caused by multiple factors, and ensures that the harvester has higher precision and reliability in use under more complex scenes.

title_en: Preparation method of high-strength and high-toughness nano composite hydrogel
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-strength and toughness nano composite hydrogel and a preparation method thereof, belongs to the technical field of hydrogel preparation, and solves the problem that the existing hydrogel cannot have high water content and high strength and toughness. The hydrogel contains high molecules and two-dimensional nano sheets, wherein the high molecules are distributed in any area in the hydrogel, and the two-dimensional nano sheets are arranged in the hydrogel in an oriented manner; and a nanometer finite field space is formed between adjacent two-dimensional nanometer sheets, and a layered PVA crystallization area is contained in the nanometer finite field space. Realizes the preparation of the hydrogel with high water content and high mechanical property.

title_en: Plastic pipe for cosmetics and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of polymers, and particularly relates to a plastic pipe for cosmetics and a preparation process thereof. The five-layer composite hose with the structure of PET/ADMER/EVOH/ADMER/modified PET is prepared by taking EVOH as an intermediate layer, ADMER as an adhesive layer, and PET as an inner layer and modified PET as an outer layer. The hose prepared by the invention has excellent barrier property.

title_en: Sterilization method for sterilizing a blown web of a thermoplastic container forming machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for sterilizing a container forming machine, comprising a blowing wire and a sterilizing device, the sterilizing device comprising a source of drying gas, a source of sterilizing steam, a mixing chamber for mixing the sterilizing steam with the drying gas to form a sterilizing gas mixture, the method comprising a heating step (E1) for heating the wire pipes by injecting hot drying gas, a second step (E2) for injecting the sterilizing gas mixture into the blowing wire, characterized in that the second step (E2) is started when the coldest spot of the blowing wire reaches a treatment temperature (Ti) above the condensing temperature (Td) of the sterilizing steam and below the temperature (Tg) of the drying gas.

title_en: Film pressing equipment of precise filter shell and application method of film pressing equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hot pressing equipment, in particular to film pressing equipment of a precise filter shell and a using method thereof. The invention can be used for vertically placing the filter shell at the top of the positioning table, and because the positioning table is internally provided with the negative pressure suction channel, the invention can simultaneously fix two liquid films and can simultaneously carry out hot-press welding on the two liquid films, thereby being beneficial to improving the production efficiency of the filter.

title_en: Preparation device and preparation method of TPE wear-resistant sealing material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation device and a preparation method of TPE wear-resistant sealing materials, which belong to the technical field of production of sealing rings, and comprise a support frame arranged at one side of an extrusion molding discharging machine, a cutting unit and a centrifugal molding unit, wherein the wire arranging molding unit comprises a driving motor arranged on the support frame, the driving motor is connected with a molding cylinder through a driving shaft, a servo motor is connected with a lead screw guide rail through a transmission component, the lead screw guide rail is connected with a traction block through a guide rail sliding block, a fixing component is arranged on the traction block, and butt joint clamping pieces are arranged on the molding cylinder in pairs. According to the invention, the injection molded material is wound on the molding cylinder through the rotation of the molding cylinder and the movement of the traction block, the material is clamped through the butt joint seat and the clamping seat and then cut, the two ends of the sealing ring are driven to align through the movement of the clamping seat after the cutting, and the molding of the sealing ring is realized through fusion butt joint after the alignment.

title_en: Double-response hydrogel and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a hydrogel precursor with double responses to hydrogen peroxide and zinc ions, which comprises the steps of firstly preparing Fe-MOF suspension, and then mixing the Fe-MOF suspension with a buffer solution of acrylamide and N, N-methylene bisacrylamide, and a solution containing an oxidant and tetramethyl ethylenediamine to obtain the hydrogel precursor. The hydrogel precursor is then dried to yield the hydrogel. The invention also discloses the application of the hydrogel precursor and the hydrogel. The preparation method has short reaction time, is simple and has certain universality. The prepared hydrogel material has the characteristics of good mechanical property, large specific surface area, good three-dimensional network structure, good conductivity and quick response change, can be used in electrochemical sensors, and has wide application prospects in the fields of biological detection, disease diagnosis, food sanitation and the like.

title_en: Process for producing straw mushrooms by feeding EM (effective microorganisms) reed basket
abstract_en: The invention discloses a process for producing straw mushrooms by loading EM bacteria reed baskets, which comprises the following steps: step one, peeling reed: removing the outer layer of reed with sharp edge or blade to make reed softer and reduce breaking risk; step two, cleaning reed: putting reed into a bathtub or a basin, adding a proper amount of clear water, soaking the reed in warm water, and then rubbing the reed with hands for a few minutes until the reed becomes clean; step three, airing reed, the invention can effectively decompose waxy layer on the surface layer of reed and substances such as internal cellulose, lignin and the like through EM bacteria fermentation, and decompose macromolecular substances of reed into micromolecular nutrient substances which are convenient for straw mushroom strain decomposition and absorption; the special charging basket is convenient for production: the EM bacterium reed straw mushroom blocks can be rapidly produced in batches; the special charging basket is convenient for transportation: can be quickly transported and placed on the mushroom house layer rack; the special charging basket is convenient for recycling: can quickly clean reed blocks after fruiting, and is recycled.

title_en: 3D printing method for manufacturing an article made of concrete or mortar and having a through hole
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for producing an article (G) made of concrete or mortar by 3D printing, wherein: a) the web (2) of the concrete or mortar composition (1) is deposited layer by layer, whereby a base part (S) of the product (G) is produced, B) a support structure (5) extending from one side to the other side of the product (G) is arranged on a through-hole area (B) of the base part (S), C) the other web (2) of the concrete or mortar composition (1) is deposited layer by layer onto a wall area (B') adjacent to the through-hole area (B) on one or both sides, whereby one wall part (W) of the product (G) adjacent to the support structure (5) on one side or two wall parts (W) adjacent to the support structure (5) on both sides is produced, wherein the height of one or more wall parts corresponds to the height of the support structure (5), D) the other web (2) of the concrete or mortar composition (1) is deposited layer by layer onto one or more wall parts (W) and the support structure (5), whereby a cover part (D) of the product (G) is produced.

title_en: Processing method of multi-cell composite energy absorbing component
abstract_en: The invention provides a processing method of a multi-cell composite material energy-absorbing component, wherein the used prepreg is carbon fiber woven composite material prepreg, five layers of prepregs are wound on each die, then four wound dies are combined, and finally five layers of prepregs are wound on the combined die, so that the thickness of each side length of a multi-cell structure is ensured to be the same. Compared with other composite material multi-cell thin-wall structure forming processes, the multi-cell thin-wall structure forming process is relatively easy to process and low in cost, the preparation steps can be reduced, the thickness and mechanical properties of each side length of the multi-cell carbon fiber thin-wall structure are guaranteed to be the same, and further the excellent mechanical properties of the multi-cell carbon fiber multi-cell thin-wall structure can be fully exerted. The practical application of the multicellular carbon fiber multicellular thin-wall structure is quickened.

title_en: Wheeled tractor suitable for agriculture
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of tractors and discloses a wheeled tractor suitable for agriculture, which mainly comprises a fender, a rear plate and a front plate, wherein the fender is fixedly connected with the wall surface of a vehicle body above wheels, a protection groove is formed in the bottom end of the fender, the fender is in contact with a moving part through the protection groove, one side of a part of the moving part positioned in the protection groove is fixedly connected with the inner wall of the fender through a limiting part, the moving parts positioned at two sides of the limiting part are fixedly connected with the inner wall of the fender through connecting parts, and the part of the moving part not positioned in the protection groove is movably clamped with the wall surface of the front plate. According to the application, the movable part is fixedly connected to the top end of the front plate, and is connected with the inner wall of the mud guard by the limiting part and the connecting part, and the reciprocating movement of the front plate effectively drives the movable part to move in the protection groove, so that the dirt at the bottom end of the mud guard, which is polluted by the rotation of wheels, is effectively cleaned, and the dirt is prevented from affecting the normal operation of the device.

title_en: Peanut red skin peeling device equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of peanut food processing equipment, in particular to peanut red skin peeling device equipment; comprising the following steps: the treatment bin, it is connected with the negative pressure mechanism that is used for providing wind-force to handle bin one side, negative pressure mechanism includes the air compressor machine, and air compressor machine is close to and is connected with the gas holder through the pipeline in treatment bin one side, negative pressure mechanism still includes gas channel, and gas channel one end and gas holder keep away from air compressor machine one side external surface connection to the gas channel other end is connected with the shunt cover and establishes at handling bin surface, negative pressure mechanism still includes the gas blowing hole. According to the peanut red skin peeling device, the red skin on the outer surface of the peanut kernels is removed through wind power in the treatment bin, so that the purpose of peeling is achieved, the shape and the size of materials do not need to be considered, frequent debugging equipment is not needed, the materials are prevented from being extruded and crushed to a great extent, and the powder generation rate of the materials is reduced to a great extent.

title_en: Seed coating method
abstract_en: Provided is a seed coating method which can obtain high-quality coated seeds which are singulated in a short time and in a simplified process in an iron-based seed coating technique. The method for coating seeds according to the present invention is a method for coating the surfaces of seeds with a seed coating agent containing an iron-based powder, and comprises a step of adhering the seed coating agent to the surfaces of the seeds, and a step of oxidizing the iron-based powder by supplying water and air while flowing the seeds on which the seed coating agent is adhered, thereby forming a coating layer on the surfaces of the seeds.

title_en: Environment-friendly intelligent water resource monitoring equipment for pollution control
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of water resource monitoring, in particular to intelligent water resource monitoring equipment for environmental pollution control, which comprises a pontoon, wherein the top of the pontoon is connected with a conical cover through a telescopic mechanism, the conical cover is driven by a first driving mechanism to rotate, the bottom of the conical cover is fixedly connected with a plurality of first inclined plates arranged in an array, the side wall of each first inclined plate is fixedly connected with a first cutter, and the side wall of the pontoon is slidably connected with a movable ring through a first reset mechanism. This kind of intelligent water resource monitoring facilities for environmental protection pollution control is convenient for monitor the water resource of different degree of depth, simultaneously, at the in-process that removes, can cut processing to pasture and water etc for the removal of flotation pontoon is more reliable and stable, avoids being hindered even entangles, and when bumping, can play fine buffering protection effect to the flotation pontoon, avoids it to empty or even turn on one's side, guarantees its monitoring effect and life.

title_en: Suspension type punching and screw mounting system
abstract_en: The invention provides a suspension type punching and screw-mounting system which comprises a main frame, wherein a sling is arranged on the main frame, supporting mechanisms are arranged on two sides of the length direction of the main frame, the supporting mechanisms are used for preventing the main frame from shaking greatly in the lifting process, the supporting mechanisms are also used for fixing the position of the main frame when the system punches and screws, a buttress mechanism matched with the side wall of a well is arranged on one side of the main frame, which is close to a surface to be processed, a punching and screw-mounting mechanism is arranged below the main frame, and a driving mechanism used for driving the punching and screw-mounting mechanism to move along an X axis, move along a Y axis and rotate along a Z axis is arranged between the main frame and the punching and screw-mounting mechanism. According to the suspension type punching and screw mounting system provided by the invention, the main frame is provided with the supporting mechanism, the wall supporting mechanism, the driving mechanism and the punching and screw mounting mechanism which are matched with each other, and the hole site vertical to the ground is punched on the wall of the well, so that the position of the expansion screw in the hammer hole site is accurate, the structural strength of the support fixed on the inner wall of the well is ensured, and the stability of lifting equipment is ensured.

title_en: Dry powder disinfection scattering machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dry powder disinfection sowing machine, which comprises a frame, wherein two parallel hanging rails are arranged on the frame, four hanging wheel mechanisms are arranged on the two parallel hanging rails, hanging plates are connected below the four hanging wheel mechanisms, a powdering mechanism is arranged on the hanging plates, and a powder blocking mechanism is also arranged at the bottom of the powdering mechanism; the frame is also provided with a lifting rope traction mechanism for driving the lifting plate to move. When the powder scattering box does not rotate, the powder blocking mechanism can ensure that the upper powder scattering hole on the powder scattering box is not communicated with the lower powder scattering hole on the powder blocking plate under the reset action of the reset spring; when the powder spraying box rotates, the powder spraying plate rotates relative to the powder spraying box while the reset spring is lengthened through the centrifugal action of the powder blocking plate, so that the upper powder spraying hole is communicated with the lower powder spraying hole, and the powder spraying action is realized by utilizing the rotation of the powder spraying box and the vibration generated by the rotation of the rotating shaft in the rotating shaft hole.

title_en: Automatic laminating machine and using method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of laminating machines, in particular to an automatic laminating machine which comprises a laminating machine frame and a feeding frame, wherein the feeding frame is arranged in the laminating machine frame. According to the invention, the film laminating mechanism is arranged on the film laminating frame and mainly comprises the mounting frame, the hot pressing roller and the cutting assembly, after the film roll is attached to the surface of a product, the hot pressing roller is used for hot pressing the surface of the film roll, so that the film roll is subjected to heat shrinkage on the surface of the product, the film laminating stability between the film roll and the surface of the product is improved, and a better protection effect is achieved on the surface of the product; after finishing the tectorial membrane processing to between membrane roll and the product, cut the piece inside and cut the wheel and cut off the membrane roll, accomplish automatic cutting processing, the operation flow that tectorial membrane and cut is closely related, compares the mode of cutting after artifical tectorial membrane again, adopts automatic tectorial membrane equipment can improve the tectorial membrane efficiency to product surface greatly to the tectorial membrane is effectual, tectorial membrane steady quality.

title_en: Soil ball lifting device for transplanting big tree
abstract_en: The application discloses a soil ball hoisting device for transplanting big trees, which particularly relates to the technical field of tree transplanting.

title_en: Intelligent ventilation micro-environment system
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the field of plant planting equipment, and provides an intelligent ventilation micro-environment system, which comprises a cabinet body, wherein a first cabinet door and a second cabinet door are rotatably connected to the cabinet body, and the intelligent ventilation micro-environment system further comprises: the device comprises a partition board, a planting box, a control screen, a controller, an air supply system, an exhaust system and a constant humidity system; a partition board is arranged in the cabinet body, and a planting box is arranged on the partition board; the control screen is arranged on the outer side of the cabinet body, the controller is arranged on the cabinet body, and the control screen is connected with the controller through a line. An air supply system and an air exhaust system are arranged through a control screen, so that the ventilation environment in the cabinet body is realized; the humidity factor needs to be controlled in the plant growth space, and the humidity in the cabinet body is automatically adjusted by the constant humidity system, so that the humidity required by the planting environment is achieved, and further the regulation of air exhaust, air supply and humidity in the cabinet body is realized.

title_en: Method for reducing arsenic absorption and accumulation of mice
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for reducing arsenic absorption and accumulation in mice, which adopts lactose oligosaccharide as a supplement to reduce arsenic absorption and accumulation in the intestinal tract of the mice. Meanwhile, the method can promote the colonization of partial probiotics in the intestinal tract, thereby obviously increasing the growth of goblet cells in epithelial cells, promoting the secretion of mucin Muc2, forming a viscous gel-type reticular structure mucus layer together with water, inorganic salt, antibacterial peptide and the like in the digestive tract, and enhancing the barrier function of the intestinal tract. The dietary supplement galacto-oligosaccharide can promote mineral element absorption, improve immunity, promote Short Chain Fatty Acid (SCFA) anti-tumor effect, reduce harmful microorganism metabolism, and promote health. This patent finds dietary supplements50g·kg  ‑1  Galactooligosaccharides (daily galactooligosaccharides are ingested in a dose of about 8.75 g.kg)  ‑1  Body weight) can significantly reduce arsenic absorption in mice.

title_en: Waterproof TPU film and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to a film, and particularly discloses a waterproof TPU film and a preparation process thereof. The waterproof TPU film comprises a TPU film, wherein a water vapor isolation layer is arranged on the TPU film, and an insulation layer is arranged between the water vapor isolation layer and the TPU film: the raw materials of the water vapor isolation layer comprise the following components in parts by weight: 70-90 parts of elastic polyurethane, 5-15 parts of hydrophobic fluorinated polyurethane and 10-20 parts of filler; the raw materials of the filler comprise: boron nitride, ethanol, dimethylvinylethoxysilane. The TPU film in the application has better waterproof performance.

title_en: Production process for bean jelly product
abstract_en: The invention discloses a production process for bean jelly products, which belongs to the technical field of food processing, and comprises the following steps of S1: injecting quantitative water and starch into the container; step S2: mixing and stirring; step S3: after being stirred uniformly, the starch solution is heated; step S4: after the bean jelly is ripe, the heating is closed; step S5: quantitatively discharging in the placing basin; step S6: conveying the placing basin filled with bean jelly, and vibrating the placing basin; step 7: and cleaning equipment for realizing quantitative blanking and uniform stirring.

title_en: Automatic operation control system of bundling machine and bundling machine adopting same
abstract_en: The application discloses an automatic operation control system of a bundling machine and the bundling machine adopting the same, which utilize a multi-light path pulse detector to perform pulse ranging, and the emitted pulse light is beaten in a blank area and beaten on a stack, so that a mutation value exists, the blank area and the stack row can be automatically realized, and the intelligent recognition of the stack row is realized. And the automatic alignment target curve is obtained based on the multiple distance information and the loop zone location information detected by the multiple light path detector during standard farmland operation, and the actual curve is obtained based on the multiple distance information and the loop zone location information detected by the multiple light path detector during actual farmland operation, so that the driving direction is automatically controlled and adjusted according to the deviation condition of the actual curve relative to the target curve, the actual curve is overlapped with the target curve, the automatic alignment control is realized, and compared with the existing manual alignment control mode, the intelligent control is realized, and the alignment accuracy is greatly improved.

title_en: Experimental system for be used for laser material-increasing to make synchrotron radiation normal position characterization
abstract_en: According to the invention, through designing an ultrathin metal powder bed, a powder laying method and an improved matched system, the penetration flux of X-ray during synchronous radiation in-situ characterization is remarkably improved, the characterization effect is improved, the data quality is improved, and the possibility of carrying out laser additive manufacturing in-situ characterization on heavier high-density materials (weaker in X-ray penetration capability) is provided. The laser adjusting system is utilized to simplify the construction of equipment, so that the experimental space is greatly saved, the design of the numerical control displacement system and the sealed cavity enables the cavity to be further miniaturized, the experimental space is saved, the equipment cost is reduced, the propagation path of X-ray in the cavity is greatly shortened, and the data quality is further improved.

title_en: CPVC power tube shaping equipment and automatic production line
abstract_en: The application discloses CPVC power tube shaping equipment and an automatic production line, which comprise a connecting column, wherein the connecting column is provided with: an inner wall cooling assembly including a cooling portion fixedly mounted on the connection post; the outer wall cooling assembly comprises a cooling sleeve fixedly arranged on the connecting column; the cooling sleeve and the cooling part form a channel for the movement of the pipeline, and the cooling part and the cooling sleeve are respectively provided with a plurality of first cooling channels and second cooling channels for the flow of cooling water. According to the CPVC power tube shaping equipment and the automatic production line, when the pipeline is produced, fluid raw materials enter the inner wall cooling assembly and the outer wall cooling assembly through the connecting columns, at the moment, the cooling sleeve and the cooling part plasticity the pipeline, then cooling liquid respectively enters the first cooling channel and the second cooling channel, the cooling liquid flows along the cooling channels to cool the pipeline, the pipeline is primarily cooled and shaped, the strength of the pipeline is primarily improved, and deformation of the pipeline after leaving the outer wall cooling assembly is avoided.

title_en: Aromatic fluorine substituted polyimide film with ultralow dielectric loss and near zero thermal expansion, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an aromatic fluorine substituted polyimide film with ultralow dielectric loss and near zero thermal expansion, and a preparation method and application thereof. Based on the main chain structure of rigid polymer molecule, aromatic fluorine substituted polyimide monomer is selected for homopolymerization and copolymerization, and polyimide film material is prepared by a two-step thermal imidization mode. The invention selects aromatic fluorine substituted monomer instead of large free volume-CF  3  Or- (CF)  3  )  2  . In contrast, the polyimide film prepared by the invention has higher heat resistanceThermal expansion coefficient near zero and dielectric loss ultra-low at 10GHz<0.003 Excellent optical properties, ultra-low water absorption, ultra-high thermal decomposition temperature, etc. The polyimide film has potential application value in the fields of antennas for 5G/6G communication, FCCL base materials, transparent substrates for flexible display (OLED) low-temperature polysilicon process, electronic packaging materials and the like.

title_en: Pseudomonas and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses pseudomonas and application thereof in the technical field of biological pesticides. The classification of the strain CSC-1 is named Pseudomonas pseudomonas sselii, deposited with the Guangdong province microorganism strain collection under the accession number GDMCCNO.62145, and the date of deposition is 2021, 12 months and 20 days. The CSC-1 can well inhibit the population growth of cnaphalocrocis medinalis, can be used for preparing biocontrol bactericides and biopesticides, can prevent and treat lepidoptera pests, has the death rate of 60.95-69% on low-age larvae of cnaphalocrocis medinalis, and is a potential biocontrol bacterium.

title_en: Grouting device for civil engineering
abstract_en: The application belongs to the field of civil engineering construction equipment, and provides a grouting device for civil engineering, which comprises a concrete mixer truck, wherein a package extension bucket is arranged below a discharge bucket of the concrete mixer truck, a speed reduction driving mechanism is arranged at a driving end of the package extension bucket, a pair of support arms are arranged at two sides of the package extension bucket, the support arms are Y-shaped and have fork openings facing away from a truck body, an installation seat is arranged at the upper end of each fork opening, a brake arm matched with the package extension bucket is rotatably arranged on the installation seat, one end of the bottom of each brake arm is matched with the back surface of the package extension bucket, a flushing mechanism is arranged at the other end of each brake arm, a support roller is arranged at the lower end of each fork opening, a pair of support zippers are arranged at the bottoms of extension ends of the package extension buckets, the other ends of the support zippers are arranged in the package boxes, and the package boxes are arranged at the bottoms of the truck body. The device has reasonable design and simple structure, can effectively lengthen the grouting landing range, is beneficial to reducing the working strength of workers and improving the grouting operation efficiency, and is suitable for large-scale popularization.

title_en: Modified fluororesin material, material for circuit board, laminate for circuit board, and method for producing modified fluororesin material
abstract_en: The invention provides a novel modified fluororesin material with low linear expansion coefficient, a material for a circuit substrate, a laminate for a circuit substrate, a circuit substrate and a method for manufacturing the modified fluororesin material. A modified fluororesin material comprising a modified fluororesin comprising tetrafluoroethylene units, a modified monomer unit based on a modified monomer copolymerizable with tetrafluoroethylene, and a tertiary carbon, wherein the tertiary carbon is 0.001 to 0.100 mol% relative to the total of the tetrafluoroethylene units and the modified monomer units, and the linear expansion coefficient at 20 to 200 ℃ is reduced by 5% or more as compared with a non-modified fluororesin material comprising tetrafluoroethylene units and a modified monomer unit based on a modified monomer copolymerizable with tetrafluoroethylene and containing no tertiary carbon.

title_en: Rolling jet grouting equipment and process for processing concrete pouring molding pipe
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pipe processing, in particular to a rolling jet grouting device and a rolling jet grouting process for processing a concrete pouring molding pipe, wherein the grouting device comprises the following components: the device comprises a supporting bottom plate, a rotating mechanism, a buckling mechanism, a guiding mechanism, a reciprocating driving mechanism and a guniting mechanism; after the operating personnel carries the tubular product to rotary mechanism and lock joint mechanism, rotary tubular product drives the reciprocal actuating mechanism who sets up in guiding mechanism and removes, drives the spraying mechanism and carries out the spraying of difference in height in succession simultaneously, effectively solves the tubular product spraying problem of different pipe diameters, length, solves the drip problem that the thick liquids fluidity leads to, utilizes a small amount of motor drive can accomplish reciprocal cover spraying whole flows simultaneously, has higher practicality and spreading value, is favorable to the use of product.

title_en: Straw crushing device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cutting equipment suitable for cutting hay, straw or the like, in particular to a straw crushing device. The device comprises a crushing part, a feed chute and a discharge pipe, and also comprises a drying part, wherein one side of the drying part is communicated with the feed chute, the other side of the drying part is communicated with the feed end of the crushing part, and the discharge end of the crushing part is communicated with the discharge pipe; a hydraulic cutting device for rough cutting is arranged in the feed chute; drying chamber in the stoving portion, drying chamber is provided with the conveyer belt, and the conveyer belt is used for conveying the straw to crushing portion by the feed chute, is provided with drying component on the last chamber wall in stoving chamber, and the cooperation forms the stoving passageway between the upside in conveyer belt and the last chamber wall in stoving chamber. The straw crushing device solves the problems that in the prior art, when a plurality of straws which are not dried well are crushed by the straw crushing device, the crushing roller is extremely easy to be wound and dead, so that the crushing roller cannot realize crushing operation on the straws.

title_en: Resin composition
abstract_en: The invention provides a resin composition, which can obtain an insulating layer with low dielectric loss tangent, excellent crack resistance and excellent foaming resistance. The solution of the present invention is a resin composition comprising (A) an organic filler comprising a polymer containing a specific repeating unit, and (B) a curable resin, wherein the average particle diameter of the organic filler (A) is 5 [ mu ] m or less.

title_en: Manufacture of aluminum pistons with cast iron ring carriers using powder bed fusion process
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the manufacture of aluminum pistons with cast iron ring carriers using a powder bed fusion process. A method of manufacturing an aluminum piston for an automotive vehicle engine comprising: printing an aluminum crown portion including an Additive Manufacturing (AM) crown work piece using an initial aluminum powder defining an initial aluminum powder bed; removing the aluminum piston crown portion from the initial aluminum powder bed; fixedly attaching a cast iron ring carrier to the AM piston crown work piece; placing the aluminum piston crown portion with the cast iron ring carrier into a secondary aluminum powder bed and a tertiary aluminum powder bed; and printing a piston skirt integrally connected to the AM crown work piece and the cast iron ring carrier.

title_en: Electronic device sleeve heat-shrinkable sleeve forming machine
abstract_en: The application discloses an electronic device sleeve heat-shrinkable sleeve forming machine which comprises a frame, and a feeding mechanism, a turntable, a feeding mechanism, a gummed paper feeding mechanism, a gumming mechanism, a sleeve mechanism, a calibration mechanism, a heat-shrinkable mechanism and a blanking mechanism which are respectively connected with the frame; the turntable is provided with a clamp; the feeding mechanism is used for automatically providing electronic devices, and the feeding mechanism is used for transferring the electronic devices on the feeding mechanism to the clamp; the gummed paper feeding mechanism is used for automatically feeding gummed paper; the glue pasting mechanism is used for pasting the glue paper on the glue paper feeding mechanism on the top surface of the electronic device, the sleeve mechanism is used for sleeving the heat-shrinkable sleeve on the electronic device, and the calibration mechanism is used for calibrating the sleeving position of the heat-shrinkable sleeve; the application solves the technical problem of how to automatically attach gummed paper to an electronic device and sleeve a heat-shrinkable sleeve.

title_en: Silicon carbide ceramic slurry for 3D printing, preparation method, application and silicon carbide ceramic
abstract_en: The invention discloses silicon carbide ceramic slurry for 3D printing, a preparation method, application and silicon carbide ceramic, wherein the silicon carbide ceramic slurry for 3D printing is prepared from the following raw materials, by weight, 55-70 parts of silicon carbide powder, 22-42 parts of photosensitive resin, 2-3 parts of dispersing agent and 1-5 parts of initiator, and the silicon carbide powder comprises coarse silicon carbide particles with the D  50  of 10.5-12 microns and fine silicon carbide particles with the D  50  of 0.85-1.5 microns. The silicon carbide slurry provided by the invention has smaller scattering in the printing process of the additive manufacturing digital light processing photocuring 3D printer, and the printed sample has better dimensional accuracy and can be used for printing more complex structures.

title_en: Intelligent agriculture precise agriculture technical method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of agriculture, and discloses an intelligent agriculture precise agriculture technical method, which comprises the following steps: step 1, monitoring a sensor: through the sensor assembly of installing in soil, real-time supervision soil humidity, temperature and other environmental parameter also can acquire more accurate irrigation demand information through monitoring meteorological data. According to the intelligent agriculture precise agriculture technical method, excessive waste of water resources is avoided by accurately calculating irrigation water quantity, a large amount of water sources can be saved by accurately controlling irrigation, and energy consumption for extracting, processing and conveying the water resources is reduced; the method can provide accurate irrigation regulation and control according to the growth stage and the demand of crops, ensure that the crops obtain proper water supply, and is beneficial to promoting the growth and development of the crops and improving the yield and quality of the crops; soil humidity and environmental conditions can be automatically monitored, and automatic irrigation control can be performed according to a preset irrigation strategy.

title_en: Artificial breeding method for phoenix snails
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of phoenix snail breeding, in particular to an artificial breeding method of phoenix snails, which comprises the following steps: randomly selecting 60 good-vitality red-lovely phoenix snails, wiping off redundant water on the surfaces of the red-lovely phoenix snails, measuring morphological parameters of the red-lovely phoenix snails by using a vernier caliper, weighing the mass Y1 by using an electronic balance, dissecting a sample, weighing the mass Y2 of a soft part, performing anatomical observation, distinguishing and recording sexes; the method provided by the invention develops the artificial breeding technology by observing the propagation biological characteristics of the red-lovely phoenix snails, provides scientific basis for artificial breeding of the species, and has important significance for promoting sustainable utilization and protection of the red-lovely phoenix snails, so that the development and popularization of the artificial breeding technology of the red-lovely phoenix snails are promoted, market demands are favorably met, the income of the breeding industry is increased, wild fishing is reduced, and sustainable utilization and protection of ecological resources of the red-lovely phoenix snails are promoted.

title_en: In-mold transfer printing process for foaming toy production
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of toy production, and particularly relates to an in-mold transfer printing process for producing a foaming toy, which comprises the following steps of; step one: preparing materials; step two: preparing a material; step three: assembling; step four: checking; step five: packaging and warehousing; in the process of preparing the foaming toy, the prefabricated pattern and the foaming toy are integrally formed through an in-film transfer printing technology; the in-film transfer printing technology comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of designing a grinding tool, forming and positioning, injecting foaming plastic and a finished product, wherein the preparation of the material comprises the steps of forming an injection molding piece and decorating the surface of the injection molding piece. The material preparation also includes molding of the trim piece by preparing the assembly for assembly with the injection molded plastic piece with a grinding tool and decorating the surface, embedding the connecting piece. The invention can accelerate the molding efficiency of the foaming toy by the mode of in-mold transfer printing.

title_en: Production process of assembled floor support plate
abstract_en: The application discloses a production process of an assembled floor support plate, which comprises the steps of a, manufacturing a transverse truss; b. the upper chord steel bars and the lower chord steel bars of the longitudinal trusses are vertically crossed with the transverse trusses and fixedly connected to form a transition steel bar cage, and web member steel bars of the longitudinal trusses are fixed on the disassembly-free bottom die; or, welding and fixing the upper chord steel bars of the longitudinal truss with web member steel bars of the longitudinal truss, and vertically and cross-connecting the upper chord steel bars and the web member steel bars of the longitudinal truss to form a transition steel bar cage, wherein the lower chord steel bars of the longitudinal truss are fixed on the bottom die; c. and splicing to form the assembled floor support plate. The application has the advantages of good structural integrity, easy guarantee of assembly precision, convenient automatic and industrialized production and high production efficiency.

title_en: Polarizing film manufacturing apparatus and manufacturing method
abstract_en: The invention provides a manufacturing device and a manufacturing method of a polarizing film capable of recycling a volatilized dichroic dye. Provided is a production apparatus for producing a polarizing film from a polyvinyl alcohol resin film, wherein the production apparatus comprises 1 or more treatment tanks for containing a treatment liquid for impregnating the polyvinyl alcohol resin film, wherein the 1 or more treatment tanks comprise dyeing treatment tanks for containing a dyeing treatment liquid containing a dichroic dye, and wherein the production apparatus further comprises a trapping part for trapping the dichroic dye floating in the air.

title_en: Preparation method and application method of ultra-stable rhizobium astragalosis pre-inoculation microbial inoculum
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of an ultra-stable rhizobium astragalosis pre-inoculation microbial inoculum. The method comprises the following steps: optimizing a culture medium; the optimized culture medium GSG special for the rhizobium astragalosis is as follows: 5 to 20 g/L of glycerol, 0.1 to 0.5 g/L of sodium succinate, 0.1 to 0.5 g/L of sodium glutamate, 0.1 to 0.8 g/L of monopotassium phosphate, 0.1 to 1 g/L of disodium hydrogen phosphate, 0.1 to 0.5 g/L of magnesium sulfate heptahydrate, 1 to 2 g/L of yeast powder, peptone 0.1-1 g/L; step two: preparing a freeze-drying protective agent; step three: preparing a rhizobium violaceum freeze-dried agent; step four:and (5) measuring the viable count of the rhizobium sinicus freeze-dried powder, and warehousing for storage. The invention has the advantages of prolonging the survival period of rhizobia on seeds to 3-6 months and improving nitrogen fixation efficiency. The invention also discloses an application method of the ultra-stable rhizobium astragalosis pre-inoculation microbial inoculum.

title_en: Braided continuous fiber reinforced material battery case and production method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a braided continuous fiber reinforced material battery case and a production method thereof, wherein the production method comprises the following steps: a continuous fiber unidirectional prepreg tape processing step, wherein the continuous fiber unidirectional prepreg tape is prepared through a melt impregnation process; a braiding step, braiding a continuous fiber unidirectional prepreg tape into a unidirectional tape sheet; and a forming step, namely laminating a plurality of unidirectional tape thin plates into a prefabricated plate, and heating and die-pressing the prefabricated plate to form the woven continuous fiber reinforced material battery case. The production method of the woven continuous fiber reinforced material battery case is environment-friendly, does not produce pollutants in the production process, and has small environmental burden; the produced battery case has high strength, good interlayer bonding force is provided by the warp knitting step, and the structure is more stable; the molding efficiency is high, the molding energy consumption is low, and the cost benefit is high; the steps are simplified, and the production flow is simplified.

title_en: Plastic steel production process and plastic steel
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of plastic steel window frame manufacturing, in particular to a plastic steel production process and plastic steel, which comprises the following steps: s1, preprocessing raw materials; s2, feeding and rolling; s3, welding and heating the profile or heating the profile seaming; s4, drawing the profile; s5, co-extrusion molding; s6, traction shaping; s7, cooling. The plastic steel produced by the method has the advantages of rigidity, difficult deformation and damage, corrosion resistance, difficult corrosion resistance, reduced maintenance cost, fire resistance, capability of providing additional safety guarantee when a fire breaks out, prolonging escape time and reducing the risk of fire spreading, capability of reducing adverse effect on environment, no need of frequent replacement and reduction of waste materials.

title_en: Tunnel plain noodles blasting drilling appearance frame platform truck
abstract_en: The utility model provides a tunnel smooth blasting drilling appearance frame platform truck, solves present tunnel smooth blasting construction quality relatively poor, the lower problem of efficiency. The drilling machine comprises a trolley body, wherein an arc-shaped first drilling sample frame capable of adjusting the horizontal position and the vertical position is arranged above the trolley body, and vertical second drilling sample frames capable of adjusting the horizontal position are arranged on the left side and the right side of the trolley body. By adopting the device, smooth blasting holes are accurately drilled, the blasting holes are overlapped with the excavation outline surface in height, the excavation outline surface of the cavity is excavated by utilizing energy gathering blasting, the drilling sample frame trolley can be recycled, the excavation surface is smooth and flat, and the overall smooth blasting quality of the cavity is improved. The invention makes the tunnel wall smoother and smoother, reduces the over-excavation of the tunnel chamber, reduces the loss rate of sprayed concrete, and has obvious economic effect.

title_en: Viscera cleaning production line for processing smoked pigeons
abstract_en: The invention discloses a viscera cleaning production line for processing smoked pigeons, wherein one end of a perforated limiting barrel is provided with a transmission motor through a motor base, an output shaft of the transmission motor is clamped with a turning fixing frame, the inner side of a fixed mounting box is connected with a storage fixing box in an inserting mode, one ends of a plurality of clamping springs are fixedly connected with clamping fixing blocks, the positions, corresponding to the clamping fixing blocks, of an output shaft of a chain type transmission box are clamped with sponge cleaning brushes, a plurality of porous flushing pipes are clamped at the side ends of the fixed centralized pipes at equal intervals through an adapter, ultrasonic cleaning and flushing deslagging are matched with each other, fine corners are cleaned, pollution discharge flushing is matched with continuous treatment, and the cleaning operation and the combined operation are switched, so that centrifugal dehydration is utilized, the cleaning effect is ensured, and meanwhile, the sewage residue can be reduced, and the speed and the cleanliness of the treatment are ensured.

title_en: Preparation and application of hydrogenated nitrile rubber viscous state
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of processing of hydrogenated nitrile rubber, and particularly relates to preparation and application of a viscous state of hydrogenated nitrile rubber. The invention provides a preparation method and application of a viscous state of hydrogenated nitrile rubber, comprising the following steps: cutting and crushing the hydrogenated nitrile rubber; pouring crushed hydrogenated nitrile rubber and N-methyl pyrrolidone into a reaction kettle, heating and stirring; after stirring, starting external circulation, delivering materials in the reaction kettle from the bottom of the reaction kettle, passing through three filters along an external pipeline, returning the filtered materials to the reaction kettle, and repeatedly circulating; closing the external circulation, and heating and stirring the materials in the reaction kettle again; and after stirring again, discharging and packaging the materials through a filter. The preparation method realizes simple and rapid changing of the solid hydrogenated nitrile rubber into viscous flow, and can be directly used in the manufacturing process of the positive electrode of the lithium battery.

title_en: Harvesting device for hawthorn fruits
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of agricultural fruit harvesting devices, in particular to a harvesting device for hawthorn fruits, which comprises a collecting vehicle body and is characterized in that: the collecting vehicle body comprises a carrier plate vehicle, a first strip-shaped through groove is formed in the middle of the front portion of the carrier plate vehicle, a tree shaking device matched with the first strip-shaped through groove is arranged at the rear end of the carrier plate vehicle, a net bag frame detachably mounted on the carrier plate vehicle is arranged in the tree shaking device, two inclined soft plates located on the carrier plate vehicle are arranged between the first baffle and the second baffle, two collecting box grooves matched with the inclined soft plates are formed in the rear end of the carrier plate vehicle, an automatically detachable collecting box is arranged on the collecting box groove, a fixing device is arranged at the bottom of the rear end of the carrier plate vehicle, and a detachable branch stirring device is arranged at the rear end of the carrier plate vehicle. The harvesting device for the hawthorn fruits is small in size, can be used for rapidly harvesting the hawthorn fruits, and improves harvesting efficiency.

title_en: Autoclave for adjusting temperature of longitudinal countercurrent transverse heat pipe
abstract_en: The invention relates to an autoclave for regulating temperature by a longitudinal countercurrent transverse heat pipe, which solves the problem that the temperature uniformity of an oversized longitudinal non-uniform thickness and transverse large-size wing wallboard product is difficult to control effectively in the prior art. The middle part of the middle partition plate is provided with an opening, the outline of the opening is matched with the outline of a long workpiece to be heated, the workpiece to be heated is positioned at the opening position of the partition plate during heating, the left half side of the workpiece to be heated is positioned in the left cavity, and the right half side of the workpiece to be heated is positioned in the right cavity. The invention can more effectively and conveniently control the temperature uniformity of the ultra-large longitudinal non-uniform thickness and transverse large-size wing wallboard products.

title_en: Medlar processing is with wasing loading attachment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medlar processing, in particular to a cleaning and feeding device for medlar processing, aiming at the problems that sundries on medlar are not processed before medlar is fed in the prior art, a blanking plate is required to be opened manually, time and labor are wasted and working efficiency is reduced. The invention has simple structure, can treat sundries on medlar, can automatically open the blanking plate, saves time and labor, improves the working efficiency and is convenient for people to use.

title_en: Pipeline blockage alarm of fertilizer distributor for planting
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fertilizer distributor pipeline blockage alarm for planting, which relates to the technical field of pipeline blockage alarms and comprises the following components: the main part, the main part is including the casing, fixedly connected with connection port in the casing, a plant and use fertilizer distributor pipeline jam alarm including: the sealing anti-blocking mechanism is arranged on one side of the false alarm prevention auxiliary mechanism; under the setting of stirring frame, stir the fertilizer of inside circulation, better messenger's fertilizer misce bene prevents to condense, and cause the problem of jam, can correctly convey and use when guaranteeing the fertilizer circulation, reduce the waste of fertilization resource, and reduce the pipeline that blocks up and need wash and prosthetic problem, guarantee the cost of manpower, material resources and time, prevent that the pipeline from blockking up and leading to the pipeline to break, the connecting piece is not hard up or equipment damage, increase maintenance and the cost of changing equipment, better improvement fertilization efficiency.

title_en: Water-saving automatic irrigation system and irrigation method for orchard
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of orchard planting and irrigation, in particular to a water-saving automatic irrigation system and an irrigation method for an orchard. The soil-shifting device comprises a water injection cylinder assembly, a brushing assembly, a soil shifting assembly and a supporting box, wherein the water injection cylinder assembly can be inserted into soil for injecting water, so that deep watering is realized, water can be ensured to penetrate deep into the soil, the development of plant root systems to the deep soil is facilitated, and waste caused by evaporation of water in sunny days is avoided; the brushing assembly can brush the soil adhered on the water injection barrel assembly, so that the soil is prevented from blocking the water injection hole, the soil stirring assembly can stir out surface soil out of a water storage pit when the water injection barrel assembly is inserted, the water storage in the water storage pit can prolong the time of keeping the soil in a high humidity state, and the watering times are reduced; one end of the right end direction of the supporting box is of a closing structure, and the special structure can be used for pulling out branches and leaves to disturb irrigation of plants, so that branches and leaves on two sides of the bearing vehicle cannot be hung on a water injection part to affect irrigation.

title_en: Full-automatic manufacturing device of concrete prefabricated part
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of concrete prefabricated part manufacturing, in particular to a full-automatic manufacturing device of a concrete prefabricated part, which comprises a support transmission part, wherein an orientation transmission device is symmetrically and fixedly arranged at the top end of the support transmission part, a bottom plate is arranged in the orientation transmission device, the orientation transmission device comprises a first inserting plate, an extension bracket, a first gear, a first rack, a second gear, a second rack, a second inserting plate, a support guide rod and a storage cavity, the extension bracket is fixedly arranged at the bottoms of two ends of the storage cavity, the support guide rod is symmetrically and fixedly arranged at the bottoms of two ends of the storage cavity, the support guide rod is positioned at the outer side of the extension bracket, the first gear is rotatably arranged in one end of the extension bracket far away from the storage cavity, and the second gear is fixedly arranged at the centers of two ends of the first gear. Through the arrangement of the directional transmission device and the supporting transmission component, the purposes of die guiding type assembly and directional extraction of the prefabricated part by the concrete prefabricated part manufacturing device are realized.

title_en: Preparation process of flame-retardant quartz stone plate
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of building materials, and discloses a preparation process of a flame-retardant quartz stone plate, which comprises the following component raw materials in parts by weight: 55-75 parts of quartz sand, 20-30 parts of quartz powder, 8-11 parts of resin, 5-8 parts of antibacterial agent, 2-3 parts of curing agent, 0.6-2 parts of coupling agent, 4.5-8 parts of flame retardant and 0.05-2 parts of pigment; the method comprises the following steps: sampling, mixing, compression molding, curing, demolding and polishing. Through adding the flame retardant, the flame retardance of the quartz stone plate added with the resin material can be effectively reduced, and through adding the antibacterial agent, the propagation of escherichia coli can be inhibited, and the artificial quartz stone plate has a certain inhibiting effect on escherichia coli, and the strength of the plate can not be obviously influenced through adding the antibacterial agent and the flame retardant, so that the plate can still maintain the hardness of the plate.

title_en: Silicon nitride ceramic formula capable of being used for 3D printing process and silicon nitride ceramic preparation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a silicon nitride ceramic formula capable of being used for a 3D printing process and a preparation method of silicon nitride ceramic. The ceramic formula comprises 75-85% of silicon nitride powder, 3-6% of boron oxide powder or 3-6% of boric acid, 3-5% of silicon oxide powder, 3-6% of aluminum oxide powder, 3-6% of yttrium oxide powder and 3-5% of boron nitride powder. The preparation method comprises the steps of powder weighing and mixing, water-material ratio (1-2), 1 liquid phase ball milling, drying, crushing and 100-mesh sieving, wherein the preparation process comprises the steps of preparing a silicon nitride blank by photosensitive solidification molding or fused deposition molding, and sintering the blank, wherein the temperature rising rate of 400-800 ℃ is 0.5-2 ℃ per minute, the temperature rising rate of 800-1300 ℃ is 3-6 ℃ per minute, the temperature rising rate of 1300-1750 ℃ is 5-10 ℃ per minute, the final sintering temperature is 1700-1800 ℃, and the heat preservation time is 1-2h. According to the silicon nitride ceramic formula and the preparation method, the prepared silicon nitride ceramic has the compactness of 70-94%, the bending strength of 200-300MPa, and the product can be used in the aerospace field.

title_en: Preparation method of super-elastic photoelectric composite fiber
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a super-elastic photoelectric composite fiber. The preparation method comprises the following steps: respectively cleaning and drying the first elastomer particles and the second elastomer particles; carrying out vacuum pressurizing heat treatment on the pretreated first elastomer particles under a first preset condition, and forming into an bubble-free elastomer cladding prefabricated member with an inner hole; carrying out vacuum pressurizing heat treatment on the pretreated second elastomer particles under a second preset condition, and forming into an bubble-free elastomer fiber core prefabricated member; inserting the elastomer fiber core prefabricated member into an inner hole of the elastomer cladding prefabricated member to form an elastomer fiber prefabricated rod; and carrying out hot drawing treatment on the elastomer fiber preform rod to obtain the super-elastic photoelectric composite fiber. The preparation process is simple and easy to realize, and the prepared super-elastic photoelectric composite fiber has excellent light guide, electric conduction and tensile properties, can be prepared in batches, and can be widely applied to the field of stress strain monitoring.

title_en: Prefabricated wallboard production construction process
abstract_en: The invention relates to a production and construction process of a prefabricated wallboard, and belongs to the technical field of prefabricated wallboard production. The invention relates to a production and construction process of a prefabricated wallboard, which comprises the following steps: step one, stamping to manufacture a steel plate; step two, forming a steel plate net by the punched steel plate, and performing slurry coating treatment on the steel plate net; thirdly, forming salient points on one side of the steel plate mesh after the sizing; step four, manufacturing a frame, and reserving an inner groove on the inner side surface of the frame; step five, assembling the frame and the steel plate net to form a mould box, so that one side of the steel plate net with the convex points is assembled in the frame; and step six, pouring concrete slurry into the mold box. The invention provides a production and construction process of prefabricated wallboards, which can be used for mass production.

title_en: Lower plastic ultrasonic hot melting equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses lower plastic ultrasonic hot melting equipment, which relates to the technical field of lithium battery accessories and comprises a welding body, a fixed clamping mechanism and a piece unloading mechanism, wherein the welding body comprises a mounting table, a mounting plate, a mounting frame, a transducer and an ultrasonic pressing block; the positioning and clamping mechanism is arranged above the mounting table and comprises a positioning plate, a clamping plate and a double-shaft air cylinder, the top cover sheet is positioned on the upper side of the positioning plate through a positioning groove on the positioning plate, and the double-shaft air cylinder drives the clamping plate to translate inwards and clamp the lower plastic above the top cover sheet; the unloading mechanism is arranged above the mounting table and comprises a first hydraulic cylinder, a second hydraulic cylinder and an unloading block, and the first hydraulic cylinder and the second hydraulic cylinder drive the unloading block to turn backwards and unload the assembled lower plastic and the top cover plate from the positioning groove. The invention has the characteristics of reasonable scheme, compact structure and convenient use, can avoid the errors of placement and assembly between the lower plastic and the top cover sheet, and can improve the loading and unloading efficiency.

title_en: Planting method for continuously interplanting stropharia rugoso-annulata and Hui Baiju in low-age orchard
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of plant planting, and particularly relates to a planting method for continuously interplanting stropharia rugoso-annulata and Hui Baiju in an low-age orchard. The planting method provided by the invention has the advantages of nutrient substance complementation and gas exchange virtuous circle, realizes reasonable utilization of land resources, and further solves the problems of no benefit of low-age orchards or low economic benefit of interplanting with stropharia rugoso-annulata in the prior art.

title_en: Interference type quick-insertion assembly pressing-in device
abstract_en: The invention relates to an interference type quick-insertion assembly pressing device which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a rubber tube placing assembly, a limiting plug placing assembly and a push rod assembly are sequentially arranged on the bottom plate, and the rubber tube placing assembly, the limiting plug placing assembly and the push rod assembly are distributed in the same straight line; the plug-in port of the rubber tube placing component faces the limiting plug placing component, the limiting plug placing component is connected with the push rod component, the limiting plug placing component is moved towards the rubber tube placing component by pushing of the push rod component, and the quick plug-in connector is pressed into a port of the rubber tube; the beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: the limiting plug placing component is driven to move towards the rubber tube placing component by the force applied by the push rod component, so that the quick plug is pressed into a port of the rubber tube; the press-in device has the advantages of easy press-in and in-place press-in, greatly improved efficiency, capability of being used as a mass production process and greatly reduced labor cost.

title_en: Seed clamping-preventing zoom type seed sucking disc of air vibration type precision seeder and control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-clamping zooming type seed sucking disc of an air vibration type precision seeder and a control method, belonging to the field of agricultural air vibration type precision seeders; comprising the following steps: the device comprises an air chamber, an air outlet pipeline, a motor, a supporting plate, a screw rod and the like; the upper suction plate of the shrinkage type hole is provided with a shrinkage type suction hole, and the suction hole consists of a V-shaped hole and a straight hole; the expansion type hole lower suction plate is provided with an expansion type suction hole; when the seeder starts to work, the seed sucking disc is close to the vicinity of the vibration population, the fan sucks seeds at negative pressure, and the seeds are adsorbed on the expansion type suction holes of the expansion type hole lower suction plate; the seed sucking disc moves to the upper part of the seedling raising disc, the expansion type sucking holes are aligned with each hole of the seedling raising disc, the motor drives the expansion type hole lower sucking plate to move upwards, the straight hole of the contraction type hole upper sucking plate is embedded into the expansion type sucking hole of the expansion type hole lower sucking plate, and seeds adsorbed or clamped in the expansion type sucking holes are discharged into the holes of the seedling raising disc in cooperation with positive pressure of a fan, so that seed discharging is realized. The invention achieves the technical effects: can high-efficiency seed cleaning and prevent seed clamping problems in the seed sowing process.

title_en: Indoor cultivation pool fish yield increasing cultivation lamp
abstract_en: The invention discloses an indoor cultivation pool fish yield increasing cultivation lamp, and relates to the technical field of cultivation lamps. This indoor pond fish yield increase breed lamp, including breeding lamp body and fixed roof, the fixed orifices that corresponds the setting about both sides all have been seted up around the fixed roof upper surface, four fixed orifices all run through the lower surface of fixed roof, the transmission shaft drives two first gears and rotates, two first gears drive the connecting axle through the second gear and rotate left, the connecting axle drives two fixed sleeves and the first spliced pole that is connected with it and rotates left, two fixed sleeves and the first spliced pole that is connected with it drive the protective housing whole and move left, thereby change the irradiation direction of breeding the lamp body, through the rotation direction of control first motor, realize the regulation to breed lamp body illumination angle, avoid the appearance of illumination blind area, improve the practicality of this breed lamp, thereby make things convenient for the night to the observation and the throwing feed of shoal of fish, it is more convenient to make the shoal of fish.

title_en: Tire mold side plate and design method and repair method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of tire repair, in particular to a tire mold side plate, a design method thereof and a repair method. The tire mold side plate comprises a plurality of texture areas which are arranged on the surface of the tire mold side plate, wherein a spacing area is formed between every two adjacent texture areas, and the spacing area is positioned between the two adjacent texture areas; the texture area is provided with set grains to realize blackening effect. According to the tire mold side plate, each texture area forms an independent repairing unit through the existence of the interval area, when the texture area is damaged, the texture area can be repaired independently, surrounding texture areas cannot be affected, the repairing efficiency is high, and the repairing effect is good.

title_en: Metal ion catalyzed tannin resin foaming material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a metal ion catalyzed tannin resin foaming material and a preparation method thereof, comprising the following steps: s1, dissolving metal salt ions in water, and controlling the mass fraction to be 1% -5%; s2, adding tannin, furfuryl alcohol and a metal ion solution into a foaming mold, and uniformly stirring; s3, adding a stabilizer and a cross-linking agent, continuously stirring uniformly, adding a catalyst, stirring at a high speed until the resin heats and foams, standing at room temperature for 2 hours, and transferring into an oven for drying treatment after the resin foams and is pre-cured to obtain a foaming material, wherein the mass ratio of the tannin to the furfuryl alcohol is 1:1; the invention provides a metal ion catalytic foaming technology, and the obtained foaming material has good appearance, uniform cell distribution, excellent compression strength and other performances, and more obviously, the foaming technology greatly shortens the foaming time, improves the foaming efficiency and saves the production cost.

title_en: Seed coating agent for preventing and treating peanut root rot and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of seed coating agents, and particularly discloses a seed coating agent for preventing and treating peanut root rot and a preparation method thereof; according to the invention, flowers 12 and C140 in 2 peanut varieties with high-sensitivity root rot are used as test materials, the influence of effective components of different seed coating agents on peanut emergence and seedling growth is researched, fludioxonil, azoxystrobin and thifluzamide are selected as the effective components, and the prepared seed coating agent has good control effect on peanut root rot and is beneficial to improving peanut yield; the seed coating agent is prepared by the electrostatic spinning technology, and compared with the traditional seed coating agent, the seed coating agent prepared by the method has better air and water permeability, can realize the controllable release of active ingredients, and has more advantages in preventing root rot and improving crop yield; the resveratrol modified sodium alginate and the filler which can be used as a soil conditioner can improve the soil environment and further reduce the incidence of root rot.

title_en: Trajectory compensation method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a trajectory compensation method and device, which comprises the steps of assembling a composite sighting device on a firearm, calibrating the composite sighting device to obtain calibration data, obtaining a shooting target distance, obtaining a sighting point position according to the shooting target distance and the calibration data, and carrying out shooting decision according to the sighting point position. Through calibrating compound sighting telescope to obtain the sighting point position according to shooting target distance, make can carry out the shooting decision according to the sighting point position when shooting, not only simplified the operation of ballistic compensation when shooting, can also effectively improve the precision of ballistic compensation, solved current ballistic compensation scheme and used inconvenient and compensation deviation great problem.

title_en: Recycled aggregate reinforcement manufacturing equipment for building
