abstract_en: The invention discloses a building recycled aggregate strengthening manufacturing device, which relates to the technical field of building materials and comprises a base and a pushing device, wherein an electric push rod is fixedly arranged on the surface of the base, an extrusion box is fixedly arranged at the top of the base, stirring equipment is arranged on the right side of the base, the pushing device comprises a push plate, a connecting rod, a trapezoidal plate, a gear, a hollow plate, a rack plate and a guide plate, the electric push rod is started to drive the push plate to move towards the stirring equipment, the push plate can drive the connecting rod to move towards the stirring equipment, the push plate is fixedly arranged at the output end of the electric push rod, the connecting rod is fixedly arranged at the top of the push plate, the trapezoidal plate is slidably arranged on the surface of the extrusion box, and recycled aggregate, cement, sand and other concrete ingredients are stirred together to form recycled concrete, so that the recycling rate of waste concrete is improved.

title_en: Transplanting device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of agricultural machinery, and particularly discloses a transplanting device, wherein a first opening and a second opening are respectively arranged at two ends of a transplanting pipe, the first opening is used for receiving a seedling body of a seedling separating device, the second opening is used for planting the seedling body into soil, a plurality of sliding blocks are arranged on a horizontal guide rail in a sliding manner, the sliding blocks are arranged in a one-to-one correspondence manner with the transplanting pipes, the transplanting pipes are fixedly connected to the sliding blocks, a plurality of locking pieces are arranged in a one-to-one correspondence manner with the sliding blocks, and the locking pieces are used for locking or unlocking the relative positions of the sliding blocks and the horizontal guide rail. Before transplanting cultivation, the sliding block can slide on the horizontal guide rail to drive and adjust the horizontal position of the transplanting pipes, so that the horizontal distance between two adjacent transplanting pipes can be regulated and controlled, the dynamic adjustment of the distance between the transplanting pipes is realized, the horizontal movement of the transplanting pipes is controlled, the pipe distance is accurately set to meet the planting requirements of different crops, and the agricultural production efficiency and the planting accuracy are improved.

title_en: Autoclaved aerated concrete block cutting device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an autoclaved aerated concrete block cutting device, which relates to the technical field of cutting equipment and comprises a base, wherein a mounting seat is arranged on the base, a movable box is arranged on the mounting seat, rollers are arranged on the movable box, a driving mechanism for driving the rollers to rotate is arranged on the movable box, a connecting block is arranged on the mounting seat and connected with the mounting seat through a first bolt, a first threaded hole matched with the first bolt is formed in the mounting seat, and a cutting mechanism is arranged on the base. When removing not unidimensional building block, adjust the position of removing the case, and then through the cooperation of first bolt and first screw hole, and then realize removing the fixed work after the case position is adjusted to the removal case of realizing different positions removes the work to not unidimensional building block, and the building block removes convenient and fast, facilitate the use.

title_en: Shielding cover film covering stretching equipment for electronic product
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of mobile phone shielding cases, and particularly relates to shielding case film covering stretching equipment for electronic products. According to the invention, through the arrangement of the first stretching units, after the distance between the two first stretching plates is adjusted, the shielding cover film is placed on the placing block and the first stretching plates, then under the action of the pressing cylinder, the pressing rod piece is driven to move downwards and is contacted with the second connecting rod, the second connecting rod is driven to move downwards, the second stretching plates are driven to also move downwards, the shielding cover film is clamped by the first stretching plates and the second stretching plates, and then the shielding cover film is stretched under the driving of the first power unit.

title_en: Super-hydrophobic photo-thermal sponge for rapidly adsorbing high-viscosity petroleum and preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of super-hydrophobic adsorption materials, in particular to a super-hydrophobic photo-thermal sponge for rapidly adsorbing high-viscosity petroleum, and preparation and application thereof, comprising the following steps: soaking the sponge in a dopamine solution, carrying out in-situ oxidation polymerization reaction, and washing and drying after the reaction is finished to obtain the PDA sponge; soaking the PDA sponge obtained in the step S1 into cobalt solution for reaction, taking out and washing to obtain an intermediate, putting the intermediate into hexahydroxy triphenylene solution for reaction, taking out and washing, and drying to obtain the Co-HHTP/PDA sponge; immersing the Co-HHTP/PDA sponge obtained in the step S2 in a polydimethylsiloxane solution, and performing post-curing and drying to obtain the PDMS/Co-HHTP/PDA sponge. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of low price, excellent mechanical stability, easily obtained raw materials, suitability for large-scale production and the like.

title_en: Silicon nitride ceramic microbead production and processing equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of silicon nitride ceramic processing, in particular to silicon nitride ceramic microbead production and processing equipment. The invention provides a silicon nitride ceramic microbead production and processing device which comprises a heating furnace, a hot melting cabin and the like. The sliding inner cabin and the annular cabin shell firstly drive the silicon nitride ceramic microsphere blank to be immersed into the paraffin solution downwards in a closed state, then the sliding inner cabin and the annular cabin shell are separated, the silicon nitride ceramic microsphere blank is driven to leave the paraffin solution, and hot air flow is blown to the paraffin solution coated on the surface of the silicon nitride ceramic microsphere blank from top to bottom and then from bottom to top through an annular pipeline, so that the coating uniformity and smooth continuity of the paraffin solution on the surface of the silicon nitride ceramic microsphere blank are improved. Solves the technical problem that the paraffin solution is quickly solidified on the surface of the silicon nitride ceramic microsphere blank in an uneven form at the moment when the silicon nitride ceramic microsphere blank immersed in the paraffin solution is taken out upwards.

title_en: Mining explosion-proof diesel engine concrete mixing transport vechicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mining explosion-proof diesel engine concrete mixing transport vehicle, and relates to the technical field of mining transport equipment. The four-wheel drive vehicle comprises a vehicle frame assembly, wherein the vehicle frame assembly is provided with a front axle four-wheel drive assembly and a rear axle four-wheel drive assembly; the cab assembly is arranged at one side of the front end of the frame assembly; the anti-explosion diesel engine assembly is connected to the frame assembly and is in power connection with the front and rear axle four-wheel drive assembly through a hydraulic mechanical transmission system, and the anti-explosion diesel engine assembly is arranged adjacent to the cab assembly; the stirring assembly is connected to the frame assembly and is positioned on one side of the explosion-proof diesel engine assembly, and one end, close to the explosion-proof diesel engine assembly, of the stirring assembly is provided with a feed inlet and a discharge outlet. The concrete mixer truck for the mining explosion-proof diesel engine has a firm structure, can effectively dissipate heat of the explosion-proof diesel engine, and effectively avoids the influence of concrete falling on the explosion-proof diesel engine in the feeding and discharging process on the service life of the explosion-proof diesel engine.

title_en: Glue solution emulsifying and mixing device and emulsifying and mixing method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of glue solution emulsification mixing, in particular to a glue solution emulsification mixing device which comprises a frame body and a reaction kettle, wherein a driving pipe is arranged on the inner side of the reaction kettle, transverse branch pipes are arranged on the driving pipe, each transverse branch pipe is communicated with a group of piston cylinders, a shunt pipe is arranged on each group of piston cylinders, the shunt pipe is connected with the main flow pipe, the main flow pipe is connected with a moving pipe, the moving pipe is connected with a liquid storage cylinder, an upper sealing cover is arranged at the top of the liquid storage cylinder, a piston pressing assembly is arranged in each group of piston cylinders, the piston pressing assembly is powered by a pushing assembly, and the pushing assembly and a linkage assembly are driven through the rotary motion of the driving pipe. The emulsifying and mixing device not only ensures that the emulsifying agent is uniformly dispersed in the glue solution, but also reduces energy waste; the invention also provides an emulsifying and uniformly mixing method, which enables the emulsifying agent and the glue solution to be fully mixed.

title_en: Automatic pouring system and automatic pouring method for wind power blade
abstract_en: The wind power blade automatic pouring system comprises a valve control system corresponding to each pouring partition of the blade and a monitoring system for shooting real-time scenes of the pouring partitions, wherein the valve control system and the monitoring system are in communication connection with an intelligent management platform, a central storage device, an upper computer and a display screen through corresponding Internet of things gateway equipment and a switch; the flow guiding net of the blade pouring partition is filled with resin through a resin pouring pipeline, the resin pouring pipeline is connected with a pouring machine through a resin runner, and the on-off of the resin of each blade pouring partition is controlled through a valve control system. According to the wind power blade automatic pouring system and the automatic pouring method, the automatic pouring system automatically controls the whole process until the pouring is finished, the degree of automation is high, the dependence on personnel can be reduced, and the risk of pouring quality problems caused by insufficient experience or insufficient concentration of the personnel can be reduced.

title_en: Grape pruning device for agricultural planting
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of agricultural planting, in particular to a grape pruning device for agricultural planting, which comprises a pruning device protective shell, wherein a pruning blade assembly is arranged on the inner side of the pruning device protective shell, and a branch-collecting limiting assembly is arranged below the pruning device protective shell, and has the beneficial effects that: the second motor drives the olecranon-type shearing knife to rotate for cutting grape branches, meanwhile, the first driving shaft is arranged below the rotating shaft sleeve, the first gear is matched with the third gear to enable the rotating shaft to rotate towards the direction opposite to the olecranon-type shearing knife, when the olecranon-type shearing knife rotates downwards for cutting, the olecranon-type shearing knife rotates upwards to clamp and limit grape branches, the olecranon-type shearing knife cuts the grape branches and falls into the processing box, secondary cutting processing is carried out, and the problem that grape branches are splashed to fruit growers of the handheld pruning device due to the fact that the other side of the grape branches are lack to the grape branches due to the fact that the rotation of the blades is utilized in the prior art is solved.

title_en: Light integrated device and method for automatically identifying insect sticking plate pests
abstract_en: The invention discloses a light integrated device and a method for automatically identifying insect pests of a sticky trap, and belongs to the field of pest monitoring equipment. The device comprises a grid box, a bidirectional insect sticking plate rotating mechanism, a camera, a controller and a power supply; the bidirectional insect sticking plate rotating mechanism is vertically arranged in the grid box and consists of a motor and a rotating plate, and the rotating plate can rotate under the drive of a motor rotating shaft; the camera is arranged on the inner side of the wall-attached backboard of the grid box, and the rotating board is positioned in the visual angle range of the camera; the controller is connected with the camera and the motor in the bidirectional insect sticking board rotating mechanism. According to the pest trapping device, the rotatable bidirectional pest sticking plate rotating mechanism is arranged in the grid box, and the camera is controlled to take the bidirectional pest sticking plate in a wheel flow mode according to a certain time interval, so that pest trapping efficiency can be improved; the grid box is used as a device shell, so that the pest entering and exiting are not affected, the shielding problem can be avoided, and the whole grid box is simple and portable in structure; through uploading the image local identification of shooting to the high in the clouds, practiced thrift the flow cost.

title_en: Al-Si alloy powder for laser melting forming and preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses Al-Si alloy powder for laser melting forming and preparation and application thereof, wherein the raw materials comprise 7-8.5 wt.% of Si, 2-3 wt.% of Mg, 0.2-0.5 wt.% of Zr, 0.2-0.5 wt.% of Sc, 0.2-0.3 wt.% of Mn, 0.1-0.2 wt.% of Cu and the balance of Al. According to the invention, through reasonable regulation and control of the proportion of each element of the Al-Si alloy powder, the solid solution strengthening, sc and Zr fine crystal strengthening and Mn precipitation strengthening are adopted, so that the part of the Al-Si alloy powder printed by the SLM has high density, high strength and few defects, and the problems of low strength and easiness in crack formation in the SLM forming of the traditional Al-Si alloy powder are solved.

title_en: Nano titanium composite organosilicon coating liquid and surface treatment method of insulating part
abstract_en: The invention relates to a nano titanium composite organic silicon coating liquid and a surface treatment method of an insulating part, wherein the nano titanium composite organic silicon coating liquid is prepared from the following raw materials in percentage by weight: 5-20% of precursor, 30-65% of solvent, 10-30% of auxiliary film forming agent, 0.05-3% of acid catalyst, 1-10% of hydrophobic modifier and the balance of water; the precursor is titanate, and the hydrophobic modifier is one or two of C8-C16 alkyl trimethoxysiloxane or C8-C16 alkyl triethoxysiloxane. The surface treatment method of the insulating part comprises the steps of surface cleaning, coating and curing by adopting the nano titanium composite organosilicon coating liquid, and after treatment, the surface of the insulating part has extremely strong ultraviolet resistance, and meanwhile, the original toughness of the material is maintained.

title_en: 3D printing device capable of starting up self-checking
abstract_en: The invention discloses a 3D printing device capable of starting up self-checking, which comprises: the invention discloses a 3D printing device capable of starting up and self-checking, which is used for solving the problem that a part of plastic area is provided with gaps and the molding efficiency is influenced due to untimely transmission of wires when the wires are transmitted.

title_en: Cold forming of complex curved glass articles
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to a glass article for a vehicle interior component, comprising a base including a base surface; and a glass sheet adhered to the base surface via an adhesive layer such that the glass sheet conforms to the base surface and is cold formed, wherein the glass sheet comprises a first major surface and a second major surface disposed opposite the first major surface, and wherein the second major surface is adhered to the base surface, wherein as a result of cold forming the first major surface comprises: a first concave region curved with a first radius of curvature; and a second concave region curved with a second radius of curvature different from the first radius of curvature; and at least one of an antiglare coating, an antireflective coating, an oil resistant coating, a scratch resistant coating, or an ink coating.

title_en: Moulding tool and stretch blow moulding polyester bottle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a moulding tool (11) for producing stretch blow moulded polyester bottles (13), comprising a neck (23) made of a preform, a body (21) and a base (27), the moulding being movable between an open position and a closed position. The moulding tool (11) has a first and a second moulding shell (15 a,15 b), wherein in the closed position the bottle (21) can be moulded; a retaining plug (17) is insertable into the neck (23) of the bottle, the stretching mandrel being used for compressed air introduction of the biaxially oriented preform; and a bottom part (19) closing the two molded shells (15 a,15 b) at the bottom and for molding the bottle bottom (27). A base (31) is formed on the bottom part (19) which protrudes into the interior space (29) of the moulding tool (11), the side walls (33) of which have an inclination angle (alpha) of not more than 5 degrees with the vertical axis (35) of the moulding tool (11) and are preferably oriented parallel to the vertical axis (35) of the moulding tool (11).

title_en: Net winding device and bundling machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to a net winding device and a bundling machine, and relates to the field of bundling machines, wherein the net winding device comprises a frame, a rotary net winding disc and a net breakage alarm mechanism, the net breakage alarm mechanism comprises a support plate, a pressing plate and a distance sensor, the middle part of the pressing plate is rotationally connected with the support plate, the distance sensor is fixedly connected with one end of the pressing plate, the rotary net winding disc is rotationally arranged on the frame, a net winding through hole is formed in the middle part of the rotary net winding disc, the support plate is fixedly connected with the frame, and the other end of the pressing plate is positioned in the net winding through hole; the distance sensor detects its distance from the frame. The baler includes a net winding device. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: the net winding disc rotates with the net bundle, so that the net belt is wound on the outer sides of the other ends of the grass bundle and the pressing plate, and whether the net belt is wound on the net or not is judged through the distance measured by the distance sensor. The operator does not need to cut off the power to get off the vehicle to observe whether the vehicle breaks the network or does not break the network, so that the manual operation frequency is reduced, the parking and starting processes are reduced, and the working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Sampling device for monitoring underwater zooplankton
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of underwater animal monitoring, and discloses a sampling device for monitoring underwater zooplankton, which solves the problems of inaccurate sampling and low efficiency, and comprises a supporting plate, wherein a supporting rod is fixed at the bottom of the supporting plate, a cable reel is arranged on the upper surface of the supporting plate, a controller is fixed at the left side of the cable reel, a rotating rod is arranged at the left side of the controller, a fixed rod is arranged below the rotating rod, a plurality of sampling mechanisms are arranged at the outer side of the fixed rod, a filter plate is arranged inside each sampling mechanism, and a sampling net is arranged at the bottom of each sampling mechanism; the sampling net fixing plate and the sampling net supporting plate at the bottom of the sampling net fixer are mutually matched, so that the sampling net can be disassembled, the whole equipment can be reused, and the service life of the whole equipment is prolonged.

title_en: Comprehensive control method for bacterial diseases of greenhouse vegetables
abstract_en: The invention provides a comprehensive control method for bacterial diseases of greenhouse vegetables, which relates to the technical field of vegetable planting, wherein the comprehensive control method for bacterial diseases of greenhouse vegetables comprises the following steps: preparation work before planting includes: carrying out high-temperature greenhouse closing on the facility greenhouse; adjusting the height of the planting groove; a control measure in a planting process comprising: controlling the temperature and the humidity in the facility greenhouse; root irrigation is carried out through biological bacterial fertilizer in the growth period of seedlings; spraying a bactericide during the flowering and fruiting periods; in the high-incidence period of bacterial diseases, the medicament is irrigated to roots and sprayed to leaf surfaces.

title_en: Wood-plastic plate forming die
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of wood-plastic plate processing, and particularly relates to a wood-plastic plate forming die which comprises a fixed die, an end die and a core column structure, wherein a plurality of connecting dies which are connected in sequence are detachably arranged between the fixed die and the end die, die cavities are formed in the fixed die, the end die and the connecting dies, the core column structure is detachably arranged in the die cavities of the fixed die, the core column structure extends to the die cavities of the end die, cooling grooves which are positioned at the periphery of the die cavities are formed in the fixed die, the end die and the connecting dies, the cooling grooves in the fixed die, the connecting dies and the end die are sequentially communicated, a first pipe orifice which is communicated with the cooling grooves is fixedly connected to the fixed die, and a second pipe orifice which is communicated with the cooling grooves is fixedly connected to the end die. The invention can combine moulds with different lengths according to the demands of users, is used for stably and uniformly producing wood-plastic boards with different lengths, and has lower assembly difficulty.

title_en: Plant protection spraying robot and spraying method based on laser ranging and path planning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a plant protection spraying robot and a spraying method based on laser ranging and path planning, wherein the plant protection spraying robot comprises a ridge-crossing walking supporting mechanism, a pesticide spraying mechanism and a path recognition module, wherein the pesticide spraying mechanism and the path recognition module are arranged on the ridge-crossing walking supporting mechanism; the visual camera scans ground information of the vegetable spraying sites, the laser ranging sensor scans barrier information of the vegetable spraying sites on two sides of the robot, an optimal path from the current position to the target spraying position of the robot is planned through the barrier information of the ground, the plane displacement of the robot and the spraying amount of the vegetable spraying sites are calculated according to the optimal path, and the robot performs spraying operation along the optimal path.

title_en: Peeling device for intelligent nut automatic production line
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of nut peeling devices, in particular to a peeling device for an intelligent nut automatic production line, which comprises a peeling box, wherein a rectangular hole is formed in a top plate body of the peeling box, a feeding hopper is fixedly arranged on the hole wall of the rectangular hole, a first extrusion roller is rotatably connected between left and right plate bodies of the feeding hopper, a second extrusion roller is rotatably connected between left and right plate bodies of the feeding hopper, second driving motors are coaxially arranged at the tail ends of the first extrusion roller and the second extrusion roller, a left first rotating shaft and a right first rotating shaft and two second rotating shafts are rotatably connected between front and rear plate bodies of the peeling box, the two first rotating shafts are connected through a mesh conveying belt, the two second rotating shafts are connected through a flexible conveying belt, the flexible conveying belt is positioned below the mesh conveying belt, and the first driving motor is coaxially arranged at the tail ends of one of the first rotating shaft and one of the second rotating shafts. The invention is convenient for peeling operation and use.

title_en: Branched polyaryl hexahydropyrimidine polymer anion exchange membrane and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a branched polyaryl hexahydropyrimidine polymer anion exchange membrane and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of high polymer materials, and comprising the following steps: preparation of poly (aryl-hexahydropyrimidinone) Polymers (PAM); preparation of a poly (aryl-hexahydropyrimidinone) anion exchange membrane; dissolving the prepared poly (biphenyl-hexahydropyrimidinone) polymer in dimethyl sulfoxide DMSO, adding CH  3  I into the solution, stirring and reacting for 12 hours at 70 ℃, casting the solution on clean glass, drying to obtain PAM-I  ‑ , stripping the obtained film, immersing in NaOH solution for ion exchange, and obtaining the branched polyarylhexahydropyrimidine polymer anion exchange film. The obtained membrane structure has two quaternary ammonium base structures, double ion transmission channels can be formed, the ion conductivity can be improved on the premise of ensuring stable mechanical properties, and redundant H does not exist on beta-C, so that the problem of easy decomposition in an alkaline environment is avoided.

title_en: Seed separating device and machine for secondary polymerization speed-increasing seed metering device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pneumatic seeding, and particularly discloses a seed separating device and a seed separating machine of a secondary polymerization acceleration-type seed metering device, wherein the seed separating device comprises a seed separating device shell and a seed separating device top cover, the seed separating device top cover is arranged in an upper end opening of the seed separating device shell, a plurality of seed outlet pipes are uniformly connected with an outer circular surface of the seed separating device shell, a pressurizing pipe is connected with the lower end of the seed separating device shell, the pressurizing pipe is in an hourglass shape with wide upper and lower ends and narrow middle, and the lower end of the pressurizing pipe is connected with an airflow seed conveying pipe; the machine comprises a frame, an air-feeding seed sowing device, a rotary tillage device, a ditching device, a compacting device and a fertilizer application device; the seed separating device and the seed separating machine for the secondary polymerization acceleration type seed metering device realize the secondary polymerization of the air-seed two-phase flow through the design of the hourglass-shaped pressurizing pipe, and the polymerized seeds can be uniformly dispersed along with the air flow, so that the consistency of seeding of each row of the seed metering device is ensured, the seeding effect is improved, and meanwhile, the seeding effect of the seed separating machine under the complex topography condition is realized.

title_en: Ergothioneine composition embedding delivery preparation, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ergothioneine composition embedding and delivering preparation, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the ergothioneine composition embedding and delivering preparation comprises embedding carrier particles and active components loaded on the embedding carrier particles; wherein the particle size of the embedding carrier particles ranges from 10nm to 1mm; the embedded carrier particles are liposomes; the active component comprises a hydrophilic active ingredient and a hydrophobic active ingredient; the hydrophilic active ingredient is ergothioneine. The ergothioneine composition embedding and delivering preparation has the advantages of low transdermal absorption rate, low bioavailability, poor light stability and other pain points of ergothioneine, simultaneously, synchronous steady embedding and delivering of hydrophilic ergothioneine and hydrophobic functional active ingredients, and improving the formula compatibility and stability of the hydrophobic functional active ingredients.

title_en: Environment-friendly biscuit processing and producing equipment and production process thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biscuit processing, and particularly relates to biscuit processing and production environment-friendly equipment and a production process thereof. When producing, stir the raw materials through raw materials agitated vessel, then roll the shaping in rolling former is placed in to the automatic transmission of raw materials that will stir through transmission equipment to send into stoving baking tunnel and bake, then will dry through waste heat collecting device and bake the waste heat input heat-seal equipment in baking tunnel, thereby cooperate heat-seal equipment to encapsulate its biscuit that toasts, carry out automatic vanning through vanning equipment at last, realize utilizing the waste heat of toasting to encapsulate automatically, need not the human cost input, improved the quality and the efficiency of whole material process of spilling.

title_en: Automatic oxygenation device and method for aquaculture
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of aquatic animal cultivation, in particular to an automatic oxygenation device and method for aquaculture, comprising the following steps: s1, collecting oxygen content in a cultivation water area; s2, collecting environment parameters of a cultivation water area; s3, establishing a historical oxygen consumption curve; s4, establishing an oxygen content prediction model; s5, constructing a standard oxygen content interval curve; s6, generating an oxygenation strategy. According to the method, an oxygen content prediction model is built, the influence of water area environment parameters and historical oxygen consumption is considered in addition to the water area oxygen content in the current time period of the strategy, and the oxygen content prediction value in the next time period is obtained by training the prediction model based on the machine learning model so as to cope with the sudden state.

title_en: Polyetherimide/polyvinylidene fluoride composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polyetherimide/polyvinylidene fluoride composite material, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein polyvinylidene fluoride dispersion liquid is added into 4,4' -diaminodiphenyl ether dispersion liquid, and composite solution is obtained by ultrasonic treatment; adding bisphenol A type diether dianhydride into the composite solution, and stirring to obtain polyvinylidene fluoride-polyamide acid composite sol; and (3) casting the polyvinylidene fluoride-polyamide acid composite sol into a wet film, drying, and calcining to obtain the polyetherimide/polyvinylidene fluoride composite material. According to the invention, polyvinylidene fluoride is added, so that the full-organic dielectric film which is mutually crosslinked with polyetherimide is prepared, the condition of unmatched dielectric properties and the viscosity of a precursor are reduced, and the original flexibility is kept, so that the electrical insulation property and operability of the composite material are improved, and the composite material has more application potential. In conclusion, the simple preparation method ensures that the invention has wide application prospect.

title_en: Single cylinder control pneumatic shunt device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of pneumatic split, and particularly relates to a single-cylinder control pneumatic split device for solving the technical problem of flow marks, which comprises a lower split template, an upper split template, a middle end mounting plate, a pneumatic split group, a glue injection cylinder, a middle end bearing plate and a toothbrush mold.

title_en: Grass flattening equipment for sheep raising and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses grass flattening equipment for sheep raising and a using method thereof, and relates to the technical field of sheep raising, in particular to grass flattening equipment for sheep raising and a using method thereof; the top welding of feed bin has the feed inlet, the top laminating of feed inlet has the magnetism to inhale the piece, peg graft in one side of feed bin has the connecting seat, peg graft in one side of connecting seat has the carriage release lever, peg graft in the opposite side of carriage release lever has the removal ring, should amortize equipment, be equipped with independent absorption grass and get into the bin, can replace traditional handling device transportation grass, the feed inlet is equipped with the magnetism and inhales the subsides, can fix the entrance to a cave fast and dismantle, be equipped with parallel movement and break up the grass, the cooperation is even with the device that the grass was flattened, be equipped with evenly rocking the device of breaking up, can control the connecting axle when the wheel motion and rock the grass device.

title_en: Broken fishing net shredder
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of shredders, and discloses an obsolete fishing net shredder, which comprises a shell, a supporting plate positioned in the shell, a first smashing roller and a second smashing roller arranged below the tail end of the supporting plate, and further comprises: the extrusion roller is used for extruding the fishing net on the supporting plate; the knocking mechanism comprises a plurality of knocking rods and is used for knocking the supporting plate; the utility model provides a tear mechanism, including the feed roll, reciprocating motion subassembly and fixed frame, fixed frame inner wall slidable mounting has the third slide bar, and a plurality of opening has been seted up to the third slide bar outer wall, and every opening inner wall rotates installs the cutter, and the second dog is installed to the cutter outer wall, and second dog upper end butt has the first dog of installing on the opening, and when the feed roll carried the fishing net, reciprocating motion subassembly drove the cutter fast movement through fixed frame, tear the fishing net in the backup pad. The invention solves the problems of blocking of the crushing roller and damage of the hard shell aquatic organism accelerating crushing roller caused by winding the fishing net around the crushing roller.

title_en: Buried line and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an embedded wire and a preparation method thereof, wherein the embedded wire comprises a wire body, at least one lifting assembly and two needle heads fixed at two ends of the wire body, and the lifting assembly comprises a cone and a limiting structure; the cone penetrates through the wire body, and the limiting structure is used for limiting the cone in a preset section on the wire body. The embedded wire and the preparation method thereof can solve the problems of fatigue damage, stress relaxation, embrittlement of materials, short service life and the like of wire materials, which are caused by knotting of the wire body, of the embedded wire in the prior art.

title_en: Discharge uniformity adjusting structure of mixer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mixing machine discharging uniformity adjusting structure, which comprises: a spoiler bar; the turbulent flow rod is arranged in the discharging pipe, and two ends of the turbulent flow rod respectively extend outwards to penetrate through the side wall of the discharging pipe; the side wall of the discharging pipe is provided with a mounting hole for one end of the turbulent flow rod to pass through, and a sealing bearing is arranged in the mounting hole and used for connecting the turbulent flow rod; the inside of the turbulent flow rod is hollow, two ends of the turbulent flow rod are open, one end part of the turbulent flow rod is connected with an air pump to input air into the turbulent flow rod, the side wall of the turbulent flow rod is penetrated with a vibration sheet, and two ends of the vibration sheet are respectively positioned inside and outside the turbulent flow rod; according to the invention, the radially penetrating turbulence bar is arranged in the discharge pipe of the gypsum slurry side discharge mixer, so that the discharge direction of slurry flowing along the axis of the discharge pipe is changed, and a plurality of groups of vibration plates arranged in different arrangement modes are arranged on the periphery of the turbulence bar, so that the gypsum slurry can be vibrated and homogenized by utilizing the vibration action of the vibration plates when passing through the surrounding area of the turbulence bar.

title_en: High-density polyethylene pipe fitting pipe splicing device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pipe splicing devices, and discloses a high-density polyethylene pipe splicing device which comprises a processing table, a first cylindrical gear rod, two electric boxes, a positioning driving mechanism and a push-pull moving mechanism, wherein the two electric boxes are respectively arranged on two sides of the middle of the bottom end of the processing table, the positioning driving mechanism is arranged on two sides of the middle of the top end of the processing table close to the edge, and the push-pull moving mechanism is arranged on two sides of the bottom end of the processing table. Through increasing and setting up tip preheating structure, before carrying out the welding concatenation to the tubular product tip after finishing the cleanness, the mode of preheating treatment not only can make high density polyethylene tubular product reach required molten state more easily when the welding to improve welded quality and stability, through carrying out preheating treatment to the tubular product tip, can also reduce the temperature difference in the welding process moreover, reduce the stress and the deformation on tubular product surface, crack and the defect that appear when reducing the welding, ensure the integrality and the leakproofness of welding seam.

title_en: Irrigation equipment for rice cultivation convenient to irrigate
abstract_en: The invention provides an irrigation device convenient for irrigation rice cultivation, which structurally comprises: the solar energy light plate comprises a water outlet pipe, a small guide piece, a vertical main body, a solar energy light plate and a large guide piece, wherein the water outlet pipe is embedded in the center of the surface layer of the small guide piece and is communicated with the inside of the vertical main body; according to the invention, after the vertical main body is further improved, the rust condition caused by continuous contact with water molecules can be effectively avoided through the cooperation of stainless steel metal materials of the rust-proof body, then the solid balance weight on the rust-proof body can press the center of the rust-proof body, so that the rust-proof body can keep a parallel state on a field, and then the vertical support is combined with the vertical support at the lower end of the rust-proof body for use, so that the vertical support can be inserted into the field according to the length of the vertical support, the irrigation device can be stably and parallelly arranged on Tian Deshang, and the inclined instability caused by water movement during irrigation is prevented.

title_en: Beef cattle feed additive capable of improving immunity and promoting growth, and use method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a beef cattle feed additive for improving immunity and promoting growth, and a use method and application thereof. The beef cattle feed additive provided by the invention comprises alpha-ketoglutaric acid and succinic acid, wherein the mass ratio of the alpha-ketoglutaric acid to the succinic acid is 1: (1.5-2.5). The beef cattle feed additive is mixed with basic ration to obtain feed, and the feed is used for feeding beef cattle. In the beef cattle feed additive provided by the invention, alpha-ketoglutaric acid and succinic acid can play a synergistic effect, obviously act on beef cattle of different varieties, sexes and growth stages, improve the immunity and weight gain of the beef cattle, improve the protein and blood fat conditions of the beef cattle and the like, further improve the production performance of the beef cattle and reduce the feeding cost, and have good application prospects.

title_en: Air suction device based on seed braider
abstract_en: The invention provides an air suction device based on a seed knitting machine, which comprises: an adsorption ring; the back panel is fixedly arranged on the back surface of the adsorption ring, the front surface of the adsorption ring is fixedly provided with the front panel, and the surface of the adsorption ring is provided with a plurality of adsorption holes; and the movable ring is arranged on the front surface of the front panel. According to the air suction device based on the seed knitting machine, the structures such as the adsorption ring, the rear panel, the front panel, the adsorption hole, the movable ring, the threaded rod, the rotating handle and the baffle are matched with each other, when the air suction device is used, when the quantity of adsorbed seeds is required to be adjusted, a user only needs to rotate the rotating handle to drive the threaded rod to be in threaded connection in the movable ring, then the movable ring drives the baffle to move on the surface of the adsorption ring, the whole adsorption ring is not required to be replaced by the user, the operation is convenient and quick, the consumption of manpower and material resources is reduced, and the use cost of the seed knitting machine is also reduced.

title_en: Insulation cotton sleeve equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pipe production and processing, and discloses heat-preservation cotton sleeving equipment which comprises a frame, a tube arranging unit, a cotton sleeving unit and a guiding unit, wherein the frame is provided with a trough along a first direction; the pipe arranging unit comprises a pipe feeding mechanism and a pipe pushing mechanism, wherein the pipe feeding mechanism is connected to the frame and is positioned at one side of the trough in the second direction, the pipe feeding mechanism is configured to feed pipes into the trough, and the pipe pushing mechanism is connected to the frame and can reciprocate along the first direction; the cotton sleeving unit is positioned at the outlet end of the trough and is configured to sleeve the pushed pipe into the heat-insulating cotton; the guiding unit is positioned between the cotton sleeving unit and the tube arranging unit. The automatic assembly of tubular product and heat preservation cotton has been realized, compares the mode that adopts manual assembly, has greatly improved the efficiency of equipment, has reduced cost of labor and intensity of labour, has reduced the equipment degree of difficulty, has still solved simultaneously and has laminated between heat preservation cotton and the tubular product and has not compact enough and the problem that the fracture risk appears after the heat preservation cotton atress.

title_en: Active heat accumulating type greenhouse
abstract_en: The invention discloses an active heat storage type greenhouse, which belongs to the technical field of heat storage greenhouses and comprises a greenhouse framework and an active heat storage mechanism, wherein the active heat storage mechanism comprises a plurality of heat storage wallboards which are sequentially laminated and arranged; each heat storage wallboard comprises a supporting frame, a linear motor is arranged on the upper side of the inner wall of the supporting frame, and a U-shaped lifting bracket is fixedly arranged at the output end of the linear motor. Through the initiative heat accumulation mechanism of configuration on the greenhouse skeleton inside wall, not only can dispose corresponding quantity's heat accumulation wallboard according to its rack's actual size and carry out heat accumulation, can also utilize the effect of the valgus extension of valgus extension mechanism in each heat accumulation wallboard, will dispose the light-receiving heat accumulation end of heat accumulation pipe mechanism and slope and stretch out, make it not only can take the heat accumulation end to stretch out and shelter the end, can also adjust the light-receiving angle through the slope, make convex light collecting mirror can remove reflection sunlight with better orientation, improve its heat accumulation wallboard's heat accumulation ability.

title_en: Laser-arc wire powder composite additive manufacturing equipment
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of composite additive manufacturing, and discloses laser-arc wire powder composite additive manufacturing equipment which comprises a laser powder feeding unit, an arc additive manufacturing unit and a moving unit, wherein the laser powder feeding unit comprises a laser deposition head, a powder feeder and a laser which are respectively connected with the laser deposition head, and the laser deposition head is arranged above a substrate so as to feed metal powder to the substrate and provide a laser heat source; the electric arc material adding unit comprises a wire feeding assembly, a welding gun and a welding machine connected with the welding gun, wherein the wire feeding assembly and the welding gun are respectively arranged above the substrate so as to respectively feed welding wires to the substrate and provide an electric arc heat source; the motion unit comprises a three-dimensional adjusting mechanism, and the three-dimensional adjusting mechanism is connected with the laser deposition head and the welding gun and is used for driving the laser deposition head and the welding gun to move. The application combines two heat sources of laser and electric arc, has higher forming speed and better forming quality, and simultaneously, the application effectively widens the application range of the material and can flexibly adjust the components of the material through silk powder composite additive manufacturing.

title_en: Insect capturing visual monitoring system based on Internet
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of insect capturing visual monitoring, which is used for solving the problem that most of traditional pest control methods are based on experience rather than scientific data, and particularly discloses an insect capturing visual monitoring system based on the Internet, comprising a device throwing module, a capturing monitoring analysis module, an execution processing module, a verification analysis processing module and a display terminal; according to the invention, the optimized image set of each subarea is obtained through continuous video acquisition and image analysis, the state of harmful insects is further analyzed, the target monitoring period is obtained, trend analysis is carried out on the number of the harmful insects in the target monitoring period, when the number exceeds the set threshold value, the pesticide spraying instruction is automatically triggered, after the pesticide spraying is carried out, the system verifies the control effect, if the pesticide spraying reaches the standard, a verification passing signal is generated, otherwise, a third party application signal is generated, and expert support is sought, so that the control effect is improved, the pesticide use is reduced, and sustainable agricultural development is promoted.

title_en: Plastic container hot filling cooling shaping equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hot filling and cooling of plastic containers, and discloses hot filling, cooling and shaping equipment of plastic containers. The device mainly utilizes the hydraulic cylinder output power on the top plate to drive the output end to perform telescopic operation, and the main wind cabin can be adjusted to a proper width and a proper height after the telescopic operation is performed by matching with the side cylinder output power on the side of the lifting block to drive the output end, when further adaptation and product use are needed, the gear motor output power on the main wind cabin is used for driving the output end to perform operation, and then the internal gear, the rack and the limiting rod are meshed for driving the expansion port to achieve the effect of adapting the main wind cabin and the fixed wind port to the product structure, so that the equipment can be effectively adapted and used with the product, and the use cost of the equipment is reduced.

title_en: Preparation method and application of AgMF-MXene@AgNPs/EP composite material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of AgMF-MXene@AgNPs/EP composite material, and belongs to the technical field of thermal interface materials. The preparation method of the AgMF-MXene@AgNPs/EP composite material comprises the following steps: etching a precursor Ti  3 AlC 2  by lithium fluoride/hydrochloric acid (LiF/HCl) to obtain a single-layer MXene; dispersing a single-layer MXene in deionized water by ultrasonic, dissolving AgNO  3  in deionized water, slowly adding AgNO  3  solution into the MXene dispersion, stirring and drying to prepare a heterogeneous structure MXene@AgNPs filler; and (3) fully mixing the MXene@AgNPs filler with the flake silver powder and the epoxy resin to obtain a mixture, preparing a film sample by screen printing, and curing to obtain the AgMF-MXene@AgNPs/EP composite material. The maximum heat conductivity coefficient of the AgMF-MXene@AgNPs/EP composite material prepared by the method is 65.51W/(m.K).

title_en: Integrated forming method and device for plate frame sealing structure of flow battery stack
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of flow batteries, and discloses a method and a device for integrally forming a plate frame sealing structure of a flow battery stack, wherein the method comprises the following steps: under the first injection molding parameters, performing injection molding on the mixture of the polypropylene and the inorganic filler after the drying treatment, and cooling and shaping to obtain a plate frame with a sealing groove; and under the second injection molding parameters, injecting the thermoplastic elastomer into the sealing groove of the plate frame to obtain the plate frame with the sealing ring. The integrated molding method solves the problem that the rubber sealing gasket is arranged on the middle plate frame in the prior art, reduces the risk of sealing failure of the flow battery stack, provides the plate frame sealing structure with high processing and installation efficiency and high quality stability, and the obtained injection molding plate frame has good heat resistance, high temperature modulus and chemical electrolyte resistance, the molding shrinkage rate of the injection molding plate frame is about 6 per mill-8.5 per mill, and the high temperature compression permanent deformation of the sealing ring is less than or equal to 40 percent.

title_en: Hydrotalcite modified water-based copolymer coated slow-release material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of a hydrotalcite modified water-based copolymer coated slow release material, belonging to the technical field of slow release fertilizers. The preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) Dissolving 6-8 g polyvinyl alcohol in 88.5-90 g distilled water at 90-95 ℃; (2) Cooling to 60 ℃, adding 0-2 g polyvinylpyrrolidone, stirring until the polyvinylpyrrolidone is completely dissolved, adding 2g epoxy resin, and stirring at constant temperature for 2h to completely fuse the three components; (3) Finally adding 0-1.5% hydrotalcite of the mixed solution (2), and stirring at a constant temperature of 60 ℃ for 1 h to obtain a coating solution; (4) And uniformly casting 10 mL coating solution in a culture dish, and then placing the culture dish in an incubator at 60-70 ℃ to be dried to form a film, thus obtaining the hydrotalcite modified water-based copolymer coating slow-release material. According to the method, hydrotalcite materials are added into a mixture of polyvinyl alcohol and polyvinylpyrrolidone to prepare a novel coating material, so that the hydrophobicity, the thermal stability and the acid and alkali resistance of the coating material are further improved, and the slow release effect of the fertilizer is improved.

title_en: Municipal garden is with dust protected weeder
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dustproof weeding machine for municipal gardens, which relates to the technical field of laser cutting and comprises a mounting mechanism, a cutting mechanism and an extrusion box device, wherein the mounting mechanism comprises two longitudinal supporting frames for supporting, a dustproof reinforcing component for preventing the hand actions of users from influencing the dustproof effect, and the cutting mechanism is positioned between the longitudinal supporting frames and comprises a battery for providing electric energy, a driving motor for providing power output and a motor output shaft positioned at the output end of the driving motor. The invention has the beneficial effects that the hinge, the upper side support frame and the dust cover are arranged on the longitudinal support frame, so that dust and fine grass scraps can be effectively prevented from scattering through gaps or in places which are not completely sealed, the dust prevention effect is improved, the ideal dust prevention state is achieved, the dust cover cannot be separated from the ground when the dust cover is pulled backwards, and the forward pushing is not influenced.

title_en: Fluororesin film and method for producing same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for producing a film by a T-die casting method, wherein the film is an extrusion molded film made of a tetrafluoroethylene polymer, has a thickness of 100 to 200 [ mu ] m, a haze value of 8% or less, and a thermal expansion and contraction ratio of-1 to +1% in both the flow direction and the width direction of the film after heating at 180 ℃ for 30 minutes, and comprises: extruding the tetrafluoroethylene polymer in a molten state from a die to form a film, and cooling the film by sandwiching the film between a cooling roll and a quenching roll having controlled temperatures; and blowing a slit-shaped air flow toward the cooling roller.

title_en: Movable directional seeder for mountain area plant seeds
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of sowing, and discloses a movable directional sowing machine for plant seeds in mountain areas, which comprises a sowing plate, a fertilizing plate fixedly arranged on the side surface of the sowing plate through a fixed block, a sowing assembly arranged on the sowing plate and composed of a driving mechanism, a seed hopper and a quantitative discharging mechanism, and a fertilizing assembly arranged on the fertilizing plate and composed of a fertilizing hopper, a moving mechanism and a fertilizing mechanism. The invention can fertilize around the sown seeds, ensures the uniformity of fertilized seeds after sowing, can automatically disconnect the communication between the fertilizer hopper and the hose, ensures that no fertilizer is discharged when the fertilising pipe returns (fertilizes seeds without sowing), effectively controls the utilization rate of fertilizer, saves fertilizer resources to the greatest extent, and further improves the sowing effect of the equipment.

title_en: Automatic glue scraping device and method suitable for composite gas cylinder
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automatic glue scraping device and method suitable for a composite gas cylinder, comprising the following steps: the hot air circulation mechanism absorbs heat in the pre-curing furnace through the high-pressure fan to be used as circulating gas for removing surface glue solution of the composite gas cylinder; the air supply pipeline in the hot air circulation mechanism is connected with the air outlet knife through the air knife connecting hose, and the air outlet knife scraping parameters in the air knife group mechanism, namely the scraping parameters of the linear air knife and the profiling air knife, are adjusted through the scraping adjusting mechanism, so that redundant glue solution seeping to the surface of the bottle body is automatically removed in the gas cylinder curing process, the generation of surface defects such as bubbles and holes is avoided, and the automatic scraping is realized by utilizing circulating gas, so that not only is energy sources saved, but also the production cost is reduced.

title_en: Single screw extruder based on plastics
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of single-screw extruders, in particular to a plastic-based single-screw extruder, which comprises a machine barrel and a screw, wherein two ends of the machine barrel are respectively communicated with a feed hopper and an extrusion head; the cleaning block is sleeved on the screw rod and axially slides along the machine barrel, a chute matched with a threaded strip part of the screw rod is formed in the cleaning block, a locking piece capable of fixing the position of the cleaning block is arranged on the machine barrel, the locking piece is located on one side, away from the extrusion head, of the feed hopper, and a starting piece capable of enabling the cleaning block to be connected with the threaded strip after the locking piece is unlocked is arranged in the machine barrel. The invention can facilitate cleaning of the single screw extruder, reduce waste and improve working efficiency.

title_en: Melon seed's device of scattering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a melon seed sowing device, and relates to the field of agricultural production. Including the seeder body, the seeder body is provided with first notch and second notch, and first notch inside is provided with the mechanism of opening soil, and second notch inside is provided with buries soil mechanism, and seeder body one side is provided with the gyro wheel that plows, and seeder body top is provided with feed mechanism, and feed mechanism is including setting up the pan feeding box in seeder body top, and the inside feed opening that sets up of pan feeding box, feed opening and seed holding tank looks adaptation, the seed holding tank is seted up in the axis of rotation, and the inside slope form that presents of pan feeding box. According to the invention, the soil is refreshed by starting the plough roller, so that melon seeds are conveniently sowed, and the soil just refreshed is pulled out by the soil-opening mechanism, so that a seeding pit which is convenient for sowing melon seeds is formed, and the refreshed soil can be buried by the soil-burying mechanism, so that automatic sowing of melon seeds is realized.

title_en: Gold thread lotus breeding device based on LED flexible film illumination and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses an anoectochilus formosanus cultivation device based on LED flexible film illumination and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the anoectochilus formosanus cultivation device comprises a device base, a supporting frame, a plant planting box, an LED flexible film and an intelligent control and driving system; the support frame is fixed on the device base, the plant planting box is arranged on the device base and located in the support frame, the LED flexible film is covered on the support frame, and the intelligent control and driving system is electrically connected with the LED flexible film. In the scheme of the invention, the technical characteristics of the LED flexible film are used for photosynthesis of plant growth, the LED flexible film can perform 360-degree omnibearing uniform illumination light supplementing on the anoectochilus formosanus, the photosynthesis efficiency of the anoectochilus formosanus is effectively improved, and the LED flexible film can be used for realizing intelligent control of the light quality, the photoperiod, the light intensity and the photosynthetic photon flux density of the LED simple substance light, so that the growth of the anoectochilus formosanus is promoted, and the yield of the anoectochilus formosanus is effectively improved.

title_en: Regeneration and restoration integrated machine for abandoned straw cultivated land
abstract_en: The invention discloses an integrated machine for regenerating and repairing waste straw cultivated land, which comprises a frame, wherein one end of the frame is connected with a tractor, and a plurality of groups of wheels are rotatably arranged at the bottom of the frame; the machine frame is provided with a straw crushing and recycling machine, a first rotary cultivator, a soil heating bin, a straw combustion bin and a pulse dust remover in sequence along the direction far away from the tractor. The straw smashing and recycling machine is characterized in that a throwing cylinder is arranged on the upper portion of the straw smashing and recycling machine, the upper end of the throwing cylinder extends to be fixedly arranged above a storage bin in the frame, an auger conveyor is arranged in the storage bin, and a discharge hole of the auger conveyor is communicated with the upper portion of the straw combustion bin. According to the invention, the combustion ash materials and the combustion heat of the waste straw are effectively utilized in a combustion mode, and the flue gas after the soil is heated can be filtered by the pulse dust collector, so that the tail gas is discharged into the atmosphere harmlessly.

title_en: Method for controlling cowpea pests by utilizing Leishmania listens Hypoaspis leeae
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preventing and controlling pests by predatory mites, which is used for preventing and controlling common thrips on cowpea pests by selecting Leishmania listens Hypoaspis leeae. The female adult mites and the young mites of the Leishmania donovani can effectively predatory common thrips. According to the invention, through a series of experiments on the common thrips predatory by the lower shield mites of the plum, the optimal prevention and control quantity of the lower shield mites of the plum on the false pupa of the common thrips is determined, a scientific basis is provided for preventing cowpea pests by the lower shield mites of the plum, a novel scientific method is provided for green biological prevention and control of the common thrips, and a novel direction is provided for application of the lower shield mites of the plum.

title_en: Triose redissolution device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a triose redissolution device, which comprises a material tank, a stirring tank, a sugar paste pump, a primary redissolution tank, a secondary redissolution tank and a syrup tank, wherein the material tank, the stirring tank, the sugar paste pump, the primary redissolution tank and the secondary redissolution tank are connected through pipelines in sequence; the syrup tank is connected with the secondary redissolution tank through a pipeline; the primary re-dissolution tank and the secondary re-dissolution tank are provided with stirrers; the bottom of the primary re-dissolving tank is connected with a steam pipeline, the top is connected with a hot water pipeline. The invention also discloses a triose redissolution method, which comprises the following steps: s1: the triose paste enters a stirring tank from a material tank, is stirred uniformly in the stirring tank, and is respectively sent into a triose seed tank, a triose seed tank and a primary re-dissolving tank through a sugar paste pump; s2: according to the amount of the triose paste entering the primary re-dissolving tank, a certain amount of hot water is introduced through a hot water pipeline to adjust the brix, steam is introduced through a steam pipeline, and the primary re-dissolving tank is stirred by a stirrer; after stirring, the mixture enters a secondary re-dissolution tank, is continuously stirred in the secondary re-dissolution tank, overflows out of a syrup tank, the brix is detected through a brix meter in the overflow process, and the water inflow of the hot water pipeline into the primary re-dissolution tank is regulated according to the brix; and S3, the triose paste discharged from the secondary re-dissolution tank is respectively conveyed into the first syrup tank, the second syrup tank and the third syrup tank through pipelines. The invention can dissolve the triose paste back, and can be used for boiling the first paste, thereby improving the quality of sugar boiling.

title_en: Piezoelectric antibacterial material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an antibacterial material, in particular to a piezoelectric antibacterial material and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: respectively taking a barium source, a calcium source, a titanium source, a tin source and/or a zirconium source according to stoichiometric Ba  1‑x Ca x Ti y Sn z Zr n O 3 , adding a ball milling medium after uniformly mixing, performing primary ball milling to obtain pre-powder, drying the pre-powder, calcining at 1200-1280 ℃ for 3.5-4.5 hours, and performing secondary ball milling to obtain the antibacterial piezoelectric material; wherein: y+z+n=1, where 0 < x < 1, and 0 < y < 1, 0.ltoreq.z < 1, 0.ltoreq.n < 1. The preparation process is simple in flow and low in preparation cost, and the prepared material is good in mechanical property and biocompatibility, and can show excellent long-acting antibacterial property under the stimulation of mechanical force of surrounding environment.

title_en: Full-automatic rubber injection molding machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to a full-automatic rubber injection molding machine, which belongs to the technical field of plastic molding and comprises a frame, an upper die system, a middle die system, a lower die system, a middle die ejection system, a middle die release agent spraying system and a lower die release agent spraying system, wherein the upper die system, the middle die system and the lower die system are respectively arranged on the frame, the middle die release agent spraying system is arranged on the middle die system, the lower die release agent spraying system is arranged on the lower die system, a molding position is formed between the upper die system and the lower die system, a movement track of the middle die system passes through the molding position, the middle die release agent spraying system is arranged on the middle die system in a shaking manner, a middle die accommodating groove for accommodating the middle die release agent spraying system is arranged on the middle die system, the lower die release agent spraying system is arranged on the lower die system in a shaking manner, the middle die ejection system points to the middle die system, and the release agent can be sprayed automatically and uniformly.

title_en: Center mechanism of tire vulcanizer
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of devices for controlling or monitoring the lamination process of tires, and provides a central mechanism of a tire vulcanizing machine, which comprises a tire vulcanizing machine main body, wherein a vulcanizing device is arranged at the central position, a waste gas air suction port is arranged at the top, a base is arranged at the bottom, the design of a side wall and a depth probe mounting frame is innovatively designed, a sensor monitoring bin is arranged inside the tire vulcanizing machine main body, the novel heat dissipation system comprises a copper plate heat dissipation channel, a water sump, a heat absorption copper column, a nitrogen heat dissipation chamber and the like, ensures that equipment can effectively dissipate heat even in high-load operation, maintains a stable working state, and realizes environment-friendly waste gas treatment by combining the waste gas purification device with a waste gas suction port.

title_en: Emulsion gel suitable for 3D printing and having natural antibacterial and antioxidant functions and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emulsion gel with natural antibacterial and antioxidant properties and a preparation method thereof, which are suitable for 3D printing, and belong to the field of food processing. The preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) Respectively dissolving essential oil, tannic acid and zinc acetate, and then carrying out mixed ultrasound to obtain an essential oil-tannin nanoparticle solution; (2) Mixing the essential oil nanoparticle solution and the chitosan solution, and uniformly stirring to obtain a mixed particle solution as a water phase; (3) Mixing the mixed aqueous phase solution with soybean oil, and stirring at high speed to obtain essential oil emulsion; (4) Adding a glycyrrhizic acid solution into the prepared essential oil emulsion, and stirring by a high-speed shearing machine to obtain the essential oil emulsion gel. The prepared emulsion gel can realize personalized customization of products and meet different consumption requirements.

title_en: Double-screw extruder for plastic pipe processing
abstract_en: The invention provides a double-screw extruder for plastic pipe processing, wherein a main motor is fixedly arranged on one side of the top of a mechanical base, a driving box is fixedly connected to the top of the mechanical base, a main rod is movably connected to the inside of the driving box, a screw piece is fixedly connected to the outer surface of the main rod, an installation box is fixedly connected to one side of the driving box, a discharging box is fixedly connected to one side of the installation box, a mounting plate is fixedly connected to the outer surface of the discharging box, a material box is fixedly connected to the top of the discharging box, a magnetic block can move along with a sliding block to drive a cleaning frame in the discharging box to move on the inner wall of the discharging box, the cleaning frame moves to the edge of the discharging box to finish cleaning of the inner wall of the discharging box, a scraping blade contacts the screw piece to scrape off redundant materials at the tail end of the screw piece, a structure in the discharging box is set, the residue in the discharging box is cleaned, the driving of a machine can not be influenced, and the material can be conveniently discharged after being scraped off.

title_en: Modular conveyor belt, conveyor belt module, method for producing a conveyor belt module, and use of a material for producing a conveyor belt module
abstract_en: A conveyor belt module (1) for a modular conveyor belt has an injection molded body (2) comprising recycled PET (rPET). The body (2) comprises a top surface (3) for supporting the products to be conveyed, a bottom surface for sliding on the conveyor track, and linking elements (7;5) at the front and rear of the body for coupling with the continuous conveyor belt modules. In addition, a modular conveyor belt, a conveyor system, the use of recycled PET (rPET) for molding conveyor belt modules of a modular conveyor belt, and a method of manufacturing conveyor belt modules for a modular conveyor belt are disclosed.

title_en: Light control method for promoting facility blueberry yield and quality dual increase based on red and blue light
abstract_en: An optical control method for promoting the double increase of the yield and the quality of facility blueberries based on red and blue light belongs to the technical field of plant illumination, and particularly relates to an illumination regulation and control method for promoting the double increase of the yield and the quality of facility blueberries; the problem that the existing blueberry lighting technology cannot promote the dual improvement of blueberry yield and blueberry quality is solved; the method comprises the following steps: step one, in a preset time period in spring, adopting spring irradiation light to irradiate facility blueberries: adopting spring irradiation light to simulate natural light irradiation law to carry out illumination regulation and control on facility blueberries, wherein the light period is 6:30 a.m. to 18:30 a.m., and the illumination duration is 6-12 h/d; the spring irradiation light is red and blue light, and the red-blue ratio is 1:3, 1:1 or 3:1. The light control method for promoting the double increase of the yield and the quality of the facility blueberries based on the red and blue light is suitable for cultivating the facility blueberries and promotes the double increase of the yield and the quality of the facility blueberries.

title_en: Vegetable greenhouse irrigation device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vegetable greenhouse irrigation device which comprises a water storage tank, an electric sliding rail, spray heads, L-shaped hairbrushes, a water supply mechanism, rotating mechanisms and angle adjusting mechanisms, wherein the electric sliding rail is arranged at the inner top of a vegetable greenhouse, the water storage tank is arranged at the bottom of the output end of the electric sliding rail, supporting plates are welded at the opposite sides of the outer wall of the water storage tank, two supporting plates penetrate through the rotating pipes, the spray heads are arranged at the bottoms of the two rotating pipes respectively, the L-shaped hairbrushes are arranged at the sides of the two spray heads respectively, the water supply mechanism is used for supplying water to the two spray heads, the rotating mechanisms are arranged symmetrically and are respectively used for driving the two spray heads to rotate, and the angle adjusting mechanisms are used for adjusting the angles of the two L-shaped hairbrushes. The invention can drive the spray heads to move and rotate, increase the irrigation range of the spray heads, and can irrigate all positions in the vegetable greenhouse comprehensively; the impurity on the water spray hole of the spray head can be automatically brushed away, so that the phenomenon that the impurity blocks the water spray hole to influence the smooth irrigation is prevented.

title_en: Bottle blank feeding mechanism for plastic bottle production
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of plastic bottle production, and provides a bottle blank feeding mechanism for plastic bottle production, which comprises a bottle blank conveying device arranged on a bracket; the first sliding part is arranged on the bracket in a sliding way, is positioned above the bottle blank conveying device and is close to or far away from the bottle blank conveying device after sliding; the first lifting piece is arranged on the first sliding piece in a lifting manner, and is close to or far away from the bottle blank conveying device after lifting; the clamping piece is arranged on the first lifting piece, after the first lifting piece is close to the bottle blank conveying device, the clamping piece enters the bottle blank and is used for clamping the bottle blank from the bottle blank, and the first sliding piece drives the clamping piece to enter the visual detection station after being far away from the bottle blank conveying device. Through above-mentioned technical scheme, solved among the prior art bottle base support can influence the problem of visual testing result.

title_en: Method for rapidly assembling and disassembling mold of rubber vulcanization injection machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for rapidly assembling and disassembling a die of a rubber vulcanization injection machine, which is characterized in that a movable ground carrier for carrying the die is arranged, a vehicle-mounted sliding rail and a bilge sliding rail with the same height from the ground are respectively arranged at the rear part of the ground carrier and the bottom of a die cabin of the vulcanization injection machine, the vehicle-mounted sliding rail and the bilge sliding rail can be in butt joint through moving the ground carrier, and the die can slide on the butt-jointed vehicle-mounted sliding rail and bilge sliding rail, so that rapid assembling and disassembling of the die are realized. The common sliding table capable of sliding on the vehicle-mounted sliding rail and the bilge sliding rail is further arranged, and the dies in the processes of assembly, disassembly and use are placed on the common sliding table.
