The ground carrier with the set height is used, the vertical height adjustment is not needed to be considered when the mould is assembled into or disassembled from the mould cabin, the accurate alignment of the vehicle-mounted sliding rail and the bilge sliding rail can be realized only by transverse adjustment, the mould can not be swayed like an aerial crane in the adjustment process, and endangering of personnel and equipment can be avoided.

title_en: System and method for producing one or more powders each formed of two or more materials
abstract_en: Systems and methods for producing one or more powders each formed from two or more materials are provided. The system comprises: a housing having a shell; a crucible configured to produce a melt of a first material; a droplet device configured to receive a melt of the first material and generate a stream of droplets thereof within the housing; a dispensing device configured to advance the second material into the droplet for mixing therewith, wherein the droplet solidifies to form particles of the first material, the second material, and/or a reaction product thereof; a platform within the housing configured to intercept the particles; and one or more generators configured to generate electromagnetic and/or acoustic waves to form a fluidized bed of particles on the platform. The platform and/or the one or more generators are configured to generate a powder comprising particles from the fluidized bed.

title_en: Control method and system for hot pressing equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control method and a control system of hot press equipment, wherein real-time hot press control parameters of the hot press equipment in a plurality of hot press forming stages are respectively adjusted through a first mathematical model and a second mathematical model which are established in advance so as to realize control of the hot press equipment. Because the first mathematical model is used for representing the relation between the first hot-pressing control parameter and the film forming quality, and the second mathematical model is used for representing the relation between the second hot-pressing control parameter and the film forming quality, the hot-pressing parameters can be accurately controlled according to the mathematical model of the hot-pressing control parameter and the film forming quality. Because the first hot-press control parameters comprise hot-press control parameters of the same hot-press forming stage, and the second hot-press control parameters comprise hot-press control parameters corresponding to different hot-press forming stages, the influence of the hot-press control parameters of different hot-press forming stages on film forming quality can be analyzed, the hot-press control parameters of different hot-press forming stages are dynamically adjusted, and the film forming quality of hot-press equipment is improved.

title_en: Method for eliminating air combustion-supporting photovoltaic glass melting foam and defoaming agent
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of air-assisted photovoltaic glass production, in particular to a method for eliminating air-assisted photovoltaic glass melting foam and a defoaming agent, wherein the defoaming agent adopts any one or two combination of external kiln injection and glass batch addition, so that when the glass batch is melted and micro bubbles are separated out under the action of high temperature in a kiln, the high-temperature-resistant nano material particles in the defoamer distributed on the glass batch immediately act on the tiny bubbles on the surface, the surface activity of the high-temperature-resistant nano material particles is utilized to reduce the surface tension of glass melting foam, so that the wall of the tiny bubbles is thinned and broken, the tiny bubbles are eliminated rapidly, the tiny bubbles are prevented from growing and accumulating into large-area foam, and the technical problem that the foam influences the thermal effect of the kiln when the defoamer is sprayed in the kiln in the prior art is solved.

title_en: Dewatering device of dried bamboo shoots
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dehydration device for dried bamboo shoots, which relates to the technical field of dehydration devices and comprises a bottom frame, wherein a machine case is fixedly arranged on the top surface of the bottom frame, a bamboo shoot inlet is formed in the front surface of the machine case, sliding grooves are formed in the tops of the left side and the right side of the machine case, a box door is hinged to the right side of the machine case, a bottom plate is fixed at the bottom end inside the machine case, two U-shaped plates are fixed on two sides of the top surface of the bottom plate, round rods are fixed on four sides of the top surface of the bottom plate, a plurality of return plates are connected with the outer walls of the four round rods in a sliding mode, springs are fixedly arranged on the four sides of the top surface of the lower return plates, and the distance between the trays is reduced through the springs on the return plates, so that the problem that when the dehydration device dehydrates dried bamboo shoots, the device is damaged due to overlarge extrusion force is avoided.

title_en: Water-cooled injection mold
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water-cooled injection mold, which relates to the technical field of injection molds and comprises a mold, a water tank and a cooling cavity, wherein a liquid stirring mechanism for improving cooling water heat dissipation is arranged in the water tank; according to the invention, through the arrangement of the liquid stirring mechanism, when water flows circularly in the water tank, the driving pipe in the liquid stirring mechanism rotates, the driving pipe can carry the air injection stirring pipe to continuously stir the water, the activity degree of the water in the water tank is improved, in the process, the air blower operates simultaneously, gas is continuously injected into the driving pipe through the air pipe, the gas is discharged from the air outlet hole to the water, and then an aeration effect is formed in the water, so that the stirring is combined with aeration, the heat dissipation effect on the water is enhanced, hot air volatilized by the water is discharged outwards from the opening of the die, and the water is kept at a certain proper temperature in the water tank.

title_en: Anti-dazzle film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to a high-definition anti-dazzle film and a preparation method thereof, wherein the anti-dazzle film has multiple performances of high transmittance, static resistance, low flash point and the like. The anti-static anti-dazzle layer formed by mixing and collocating micron-sized organic particles and nanometer-sized inorganic particles is coated on the surface of the transparent substrate, so that the dual functions of anti-dazzle and anti-static are realized. The organic particles are modified by adopting the antistatic acrylic resin, so that the compatibility of the particles and the resin coating liquid is improved, the particles are uniformly dispersed in the coating liquid, and the film is endowed with excellent antistatic performance. By adding inorganic particles and adjusting the proportion of organic and inorganic particles, the definition of the product is improved, the flash point is reduced, and the high-definition visual effect is achieved. The anti-dazzle film provided by the application not only has excellent anti-dazzle performance, but also has the characteristics of high transmittance, high definition, low flash point and the like, and meanwhile, has good antistatic effect and strong adhesive force, and can be widely applied to the fields of electronic display screens, touch screens and the like.

title_en: Inside air exhaust auxiliary device of mould for automobile parts
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of automobile part processing, in particular to an auxiliary device for exhausting air in a mold for automobile parts, which comprises the following components: the die body comprises a bottom plate, wherein the upper surface of the bottom plate is connected with a left die and a right die in a sliding manner, and die grooves are formed in the inner sides of the left die and the right die. According to the invention, the moving plate II moves to be separated from the gear III, and under the elastic action of the torsion spring II, the screw rod is rotated to reset, so that the moving block is driven to move downwards to reset, the push plate slides from the top end of the inner side of the die cavity to the bottom of the inner side of the die cavity, and the sealing plate is matched, so that the inside of the die cavity is in a sealing state, and meanwhile, air in the die cavity is discharged from the air outlet groove along with the process that the push plate slides from the top of the inner side of the die cavity to the bottom of the inner side of the die cavity, so that air is prevented from being arranged in the die cavity when liquid blanks are injected, the inside of a finished product after molding is hollow, and the quality of the finished product is influenced.

title_en: Screening method of carbon-fixing bacteria and method for improving carbon-fixing capacity of soil
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of soil improvement, and provides a screening method of carbon-fixing bacteria and a method for improving carbon-fixing capacity of soil. The screening method comprises the steps of obtaining soil to be screened; preparing a carbon fixing bacteria culture medium; adding the obtained soil into sterile water, uniformly stirring, placing at 25-35 ℃ and 130-150 r/min for 20-30 min to prepare suspension, and carrying out concentration gradient dilution; inoculating the suspension into the carbon-fixing bacteria culture medium under the aseptic condition, and culturing for 7-10 days at 26-30 ℃; the morphology of the carbon-fixing bacteria was observed and recorded. According to the application, the soil with the carbon fixing capability to be improved is screened out, so that the carbon fixing effect of the soil can be obviously improved, and the risk of failure in improving the carbon fixing capability by directly adopting exogenous carbon fixing microorganisms is avoided.

title_en: Automatic feed equipment raises chickens
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of feeding equipment, and discloses chicken raising automatic feeding equipment which comprises two support plates, wherein two conveying rollers are rotatably arranged between the two support plates, conveying belts are sleeved on the outer surfaces of the two conveying rollers, and a plurality of storage boxes are fixedly arranged on the upper surfaces of the conveying belts at equal intervals. According to the invention, through the staggered intermittent matching of the storage box, the pendulum bob and the blowing disc, the knocking and blowing effects on the storage box can be realized, and the feed residues adhered to the inner wall of the storage box are vibrated and blown to be cleaned, so that the storage box is immediately and automatically cleaned in the feeding process, and in the control system of the Internet of things, the refining actions do not need to be independently driven, the whole control can be realized, and the refining requirements in the chicken raising feeding process can be more stably met.

title_en: Printer frame for building 3D printing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a printer frame for building 3D printing, which belongs to the technical field of building printing, wherein a lifting frame is arranged at the top of an outer lifting cylinder, a first threaded rod is rotatably arranged between vertical seats, a moving frame is arranged between the first threaded rods in a threaded manner, symmetrical second threaded rods are rotatably arranged at two sides of the moving frame, a plurality of groups of moving vehicles are arranged between the second threaded rods in a threaded manner, a spraying mechanism is arranged on the moving vehicles, a front vertical plate and a rear vertical plate which are mutually matched are fixedly arranged at the bottom of the rotating seat, an arc plate is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the rear vertical plate, a swinging seat is slidably arranged on the side surface of the arc plate, a spray gun is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the swinging seat, and a deflection motor is arranged in the middle of the rear vertical plate. According to the invention, the formed building structure can be fed and discharged through the drawing vehicle, and the forming base and the spray gun are mutually matched, so that the printing efficiency is further improved. When the cleaning frame moves along the outer sliding groove, the hairbrush cleans the residual scraps on the forming base into the storage bin, and the design further improves the degree of freedom.

title_en: Wafer dicing process and InSb chip
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of chip processing, in particular to a wafer dicing process and an InSb chip. The dicing process provided by the invention uses a multi-step distance dicing mode to dice, can achieve the effect of gradually releasing the stress in the wafer under the setting of a specific dicing direction and step distance, and can prevent edge breakage; the special scribing mode is combined with the special material protection layer arranged before scribing, so that the risk of edge breakage and cracking during wafer scribing is reduced, and the qualification rate is high. Experiments show that the InSb wafer subjected to dicing by the dicing process has no edge breakage and cracking phenomenon under the observation of a 100-time optical microscope, and the InSb wafer subjected to dicing by the dicing method or the method for arranging the protective layer has more obvious edge breakage.

title_en: Reel tooth, reel mechanism and crop harvesting device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reel tooth, which comprises a reel tooth body; the gear shifting body is provided with a gear shifting part and a hinge part, and the gear shifting body close to the hinge part is also provided with a supporting part. On the other hand, a seedling pulling mechanism is provided, which comprises a driving sprocket wheel, wherein the driving sprocket wheel is in transmission connection with a driven sprocket wheel through a chain; a plurality of hinge seats are fixedly arranged on the periphery side of the chain, and a hinge shaft is arranged on one side of each hinge seat; at least one end of the hinge shaft is hinged with the hinge part; at least one side of the chain is fixedly provided with a supporting rail, and the supporting part is in friction connection with the supporting rail. In yet another aspect, the present invention provides a crop harvesting apparatus comprising a header provided with a cutter; at least one group of seedling pulling devices which are arranged in the same direction with the header are arranged above the header, a plurality of seedling pulling mechanisms which are arranged at intervals up and down in the height direction are arranged in the seedling pulling devices, and the seedling pulling mechanisms are mutually synchronous and driven in the same direction.

title_en: Extrusion speed control method and system based on dynamic programming algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses an extrusion speed control method and system based on a dynamic programming algorithm, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring key working state information of each component in the printing process of the 3D printing equipment in real time; determining an optimal printing strategy based on a dynamic programming algorithm according to the key working state information, and determining the current optimal extrusion speed according to the optimal printing strategy; and controlling the extrusion speed of the nozzle of the 3D printing device according to the optimal extrusion speed. By utilizing the embodiment of the invention, a more efficient and intelligent 3D printing process can be realized, the printing quality and the production efficiency are improved, the 3D printing technology is promoted to develop to higher level automation and intellectualization, and the method has important application prospect and economic value.

title_en: Facility vegetable field soil degradation prosthetic devices
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of soil preparation equipment, and particularly discloses a facility vegetable field soil degradation restoration device which comprises a connecting plate, wherein side plates are fixed at two ends of the length direction of the connecting plate, a soil smashing component is arranged between the two side plates, the position, close to the soil smashing component, of the top side of the connecting plate is bent downwards, a plurality of soil gathering components are arranged at the position, far away from the soil smashing component, of the top side of the connecting plate, a rotating material roller is arranged at the bottom side of the connecting plate, a film is wound on the material roller, a plurality of baffles are fixed at the top side of the connecting plate, the baffles and the soil gathering components are arranged in a staggered mode, a wire rope is wound on the wire coil corresponding to the position of each soil gathering component, and the facility vegetable field soil degradation restoration device prevents water dissolved with salt from penetrating into soil downwards, and carries out in-situ restoration on soil in a deep layer of the facility vegetable field, so that the cost of soil degradation restoration is reduced.

title_en: Low-sugar bread fermentation process and device containing small molecular peptide
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fermentation processes, and provides a low-sugar bread fermentation process and device containing small molecular peptides, wherein the low-sugar bread fermentation process comprises the following steps: the box, the one end of box is provided with the water tank, still includes: the heating block is arranged on the inner wall of the water tank, and a water inlet pipeline is arranged at the top of the tank body; the heating pipes are arranged in the box body, and one ends of the heating pipes are provided with water outlet pipes; the two temperature and humidity sensors are arranged in the box body, the temperature in the box body is conveniently increased by utilizing the plurality of heating pipes, the situation that the dough to be fermented is heated unevenly is conveniently avoided, the fermentation effect of the dough to be fermented is favorably improved, the hot water mist sprayed by the spray nozzle is conveniently improved, the humidity in the box body is conveniently improved, the good fermentation environment is favorably maintained, the fermentation effect is further improved, and meanwhile, the phenomenon that the water mist directly contacts the dough to be fermented is avoided.

title_en: Forming die of ceramic PTC thermal sensitive ceramic resistor element
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of forming dies, and provides a forming die for a ceramic PTC thermal-sensitive ceramic resistor element, which comprises a lower die holder; the lower die holder is sunken downwards to form a lower die cavity; a material ejection cavity arranged at the lower part of the lower die cavity; a group of ejection sliding grooves symmetrically arranged in the ejection cavity; the material ejection plate slides between the two material ejection sliding grooves; a material ejection spring is arranged at one side of the material ejection plate away from the material ejection push rod; the ejector spring is far away from the ejector plate one side is provided with a jacking block; the invention ensures the stability of the die guiding and the accurate forming of the resistor element by optimizing the forming and ejecting processes, and simultaneously realizes the automatic discharging and discharging procedures of the forming element; finally, the cooling fan is arranged in the inner cavity of the lower die holder, so that air is circulated continuously, and the running stability and reliability of the equipment are ensured.

title_en: Mangrove restoration method
abstract_en: According to the mangrove restoration method, the mangrove is divided into the areas, the front area of the sea wall is marked on the outer side of the restoration area of the cultivation pond, the reinforcing box is buried in the front area of the sea wall, on one hand, the purpose of curing the beach is achieved, on the other hand, a reinforcing point is provided for the wave absorber, the reinforcing box is simple in structure and convenient to install, the air bags are expanded through injecting air to be combined with injecting concrete, the purpose of curing soil is achieved, in addition, the impact of sea waves of tides on the cultivation planting area can be effectively reduced through combining the structure of the wave absorber, and the survival growth rate of the cultivation planting area is improved. The invention carries out suitable forest reconstruction according to the wave conditions, beach elevation, substrate properties and the like of the planting area, and can diversified configuration of mangrove tree species so as to achieve the expected aim of recovering mangrove forests.

title_en: Drop shaft plug cleaning robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a drop shaft blockage cleaning robot, belongs to the technical field of mining, and is used for solving the problems that in the prior art, when a drop shaft is cleaned, explosive charges are placed at the bottom of a blockage point to be blasted, the explosive charges are difficult to place, the explosive consumption is difficult to control and the safety is poor. Comprising the following steps: the device comprises a moving device, an angle adjusting mechanism, a cleaning executing mechanism and a monitoring mechanism; the angle adjusting mechanism comprises a swinging frame, a telescopic rod and a linear motion mechanism; the swing frame is hinged with the moving device, one end of the telescopic rod is hinged with the moving device, the other end of the telescopic rod is hinged with the swing frame, and the linear motion mechanism is arranged on the swing frame; the cleaning executing mechanism comprises a mechanical arm, a mounting rack and a jack; the mechanical arm is detachably arranged at the movable end of the linear motion mechanism; the installation is erect in the expansion end of arm, and jack fixed mounting is on the mounting bracket, and monitoring facilities fixed mounting is on mounting bracket or arm.

title_en: Full-automatic intelligent unmanned aerial vehicle reaction system
abstract_en: The invention relates to unmanned aerial vehicle countering, in particular to a full-automatic intelligent unmanned aerial vehicle countering system, wherein a control unit constructs an unmanned aerial vehicle detection model for unmanned aerial vehicle detection on a visible light image through an unmanned aerial vehicle detection model building module, and model training is carried out on the unmanned aerial vehicle detection model by utilizing an unmanned aerial vehicle detection model training module so as to obtain a trained unmanned aerial vehicle detection model; the control unit acquires a visible light image and a corresponding depth image of an area to be monitored through the image acquisition module, inputs the visible light image into a trained unmanned aerial vehicle detection model through the unmanned aerial vehicle detection module to carry out unmanned aerial vehicle detection, determines the position coordinates of the unmanned aerial vehicle through the position coordinate determination module based on the visible light image and the corresponding depth image, and carries out track estimation on the unmanned aerial vehicle through the track estimation module based on the position coordinates of the unmanned aerial vehicle; the technical scheme provided by the invention can effectively overcome the defect that the unmanned aerial vehicle in motion cannot be accurately controlled.

title_en: Crack glaze, preparation method thereof and sanitary ceramic containing crack glaze
abstract_en: The invention discloses a crack glaze and a preparation method thereof, and sanitary ceramic containing the crack glaze, wherein the crack glaze comprises the following raw materials, by weight, 1-8 parts of zirconium silicate, 33-38 parts of quartz, 20-25 parts of glass powder, 15-20 parts of calcite, 0.5-5 parts of zircon pigment and 21-50 parts of fluxing agent. The crack glaze is a single-layer glaze, the zircon pigment is directly added into the glaze, zirconium silicate is added to make the glaze color, quartz, calcite and glass powder are introduced in a high proportion to improve the thermal expansion coefficient of the glaze, the crack is formed on the glaze by utilizing the difference of the thermal expansion coefficients of the blank and the glaze, the generated crack is stable, the consistency of the product is high, the process flow is simplified, the cost of raw materials is reduced, nontoxic and environment-friendly raw materials are selected, and the harm to human bodies in the production process is reduced.

title_en: Fish anti-flow screening system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fish anti-flow screening system which comprises an anti-flow device and a behavior recording device arranged outside the device. The anti-flow device comprises an annular water tank, a water pump arranged in the annular water tank and a plurality of interception nets; the behavior recording device comprises a chip implanted in the fish body, a fish face identifier arranged in the annular water tank and a display controller arranged outside the water tank, wherein the display controller is in communication connection with the chip, the water pump, the interception net and the fish face identifier. According to the invention, the anti-flow training, observation and screening of the fish are simultaneously carried out, an experimenter can accurately judge the state of each fish according to the chip information and the image information transmitted by the fish face identifier, and the fish species with the up-to-standard anti-flow capability are selected, so that the technical problem of large deviation caused by judging only by means of naked eye observation in the prior art is avoided, and the workload of the experimenter is reduced to a certain extent.

title_en: Heating and pressurizing composite device for processing plastic-lined composite steel pipe
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heating and pressurizing composite device for processing a plastic-lined composite steel pipe, which relates to the field of steel pipe processing, and comprises a frame, a heating mechanism and a heating mechanism, wherein the heating mechanism is used for heating the outside of the steel pipe and comprises a support frame, a heating assembly, an A driving assembly, a B driving assembly and a C driving assembly; this compound steel pipe processing usefulness is moulded to lining heating pressurization composite device, the C drive assembly drive support frame that through setting up removes, drive the supporting disk when the support frame removes, B drive assembly, A drive assembly and heating element synchronous motion, thereby heating element can carry out comprehensive heating to the steel pipe and intensify, and can follow the supporting disk radial movement through a plurality of heating elements of A drive assembly drive, thereby can heat the heating to the lining plastic steel pipe of different diameters, simultaneously can support through B drive assembly drive and coil self axis and rotate, make a plurality of heating elements can rotate around the supporting disk axis, make heating element more even to the heating of steel pipe.

title_en: Milk cow feeding type feeding device and system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a dairy cow feeding device and a system, and relates to the technical field of dairy cow feeding devices. Including the agitator tank to be located the inner chamber bottom surface downwardly extending of agitator tank and seted up the feed opening, the feed opening has been seted up to feed opening direction to the lateral wall of agitator tank, the inside of feed opening is provided with the unloading dish that is used for the discharge, the one end both sides and the inner wall of feed opening of this unloading dish form articulated, and be provided with spring one respectively in the other end bottom surface both sides of unloading dish, the bottom surface both sides of unloading dish are close to spring one department and are provided with swivel mount one, and run through between two swivel mount one and set up rotatable rotary rod one, the rotation of this rotary rod one is driven through the motor that one side of unloading dish set up, and the other end that is located rotary rod one is provided with sprocket one, and one side of sprocket one still is provided with eccentric block, the forage falls into the unloading dish through the feed opening, motor drive rotary rod one is rotatory, make the unloading dish vibrate through eccentric block, in order to fluffy forage, avoid the caking.

title_en: Adjustable squid larva cleaning device and use method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an adjustable squid larva cleaning device and a use method thereof, comprising the following steps: the cleaning tank is internally provided with a spraying assembly; the distance control assembly is arranged in the cleaning tank and used for controlling the distance between the spraying assembly and the water level surface, and comprises a self-adjusting piece which comprises two mounting frames. According to the invention, the positions of the support columns and the mounting frame are automatically adjusted along with the height of the water level through the floating plate, the mounting frame drives the first spray pipes to automatically adjust the distance between the water level and the water level, the water level in the cleaning tank and the distance between the first spray pipes are fixed values no matter how much water source is added, the phenomenon that the first spray pipes interfere with bubble formation, can not uniformly spray cleaning liquid on all surfaces of cleaning objects and the phenomenon of insufficient spraying pressure can not be caused by the height of the water level is avoided, the height of the spraying liquid is ensured to be always kept at the optimal position, and therefore, good spraying cleaning effect and cleaning efficiency are maintained.

title_en: Automatic wrapping equipment for salted duck egg production and processing
abstract_en: The invention provides automatic wrapping equipment for salted duck egg production and processing, which belongs to the field of duck egg processing and comprises an inclined seat, wherein a charging barrel is fixedly connected to the inclined seat, an annular frame is fixedly connected to one side of the top of the charging barrel, an inclined plate is fixedly connected to the front side of the annular frame, a material moving assembly comprises a U-shaped frame fixedly connected to one side of the bottom of the charging barrel, a motor is fixedly connected to the U-shaped frame, the output end of the motor is fixedly connected with a rotating shaft, abutting blocks are respectively fixedly connected to the left side and the right side of the outer side of the rotating shaft, and connecting rods are respectively fixedly connected to the front side and the rear side of the outer side of the rotating shaft. According to the feeding device, through the arrangement of the material moving assembly, automatic feeding, material moving and discharging operations on the duck eggs can be guaranteed, and the operations can continuously carry out feeding and discharging operations on the duck eggs in a plurality of groups, so that the material wrapping speed and the material wrapping efficiency of the duck eggs are improved, manual operation is not needed, and the labor cost is reduced.

title_en: Anti-infection GOX silk and application thereof as material for repairing diabetic chronic wound surface
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-infection GOX silk and application thereof as a material for repairing diabetic chronic wound, according to the invention, by creating novel silkworm germplasm materials for biosynthesis of GOX silk and then utilizing the obtained functional GOX silk, GOX and Fe  3 O 4 NPs(GOX–Fe 3 O 4 ) silk hydrogel materials are developed. Finally, developed GOX and Fe  3 O 4 NPs(GOX–Fe 3 O 4 ) silk hydrogel is used for repairing diabetes chronic combined infectious wounds, and the treatment effect and the action mechanism of the silk hydrogel for promoting the healing of the diabetes chronic combined infectious wounds are systematically researched.

title_en: Antiknock supplement structure for deep sea island shelter, shelter antiknock structure and antiknock shelter
abstract_en: The invention relates to an antiknock supplement structure for a deep sea island shelter, a shelter antiknock structure and an antiknock shelter, wherein the antiknock supplement structure comprises a polygonal steel keel frame; the plurality of antiknock wave-absorbing blocks are diamond-shaped cones and are correspondingly arranged in each mounting frame; the first composite multilayer anti-knock plate is welded on one side of the polygonal steel keel frame, which is far away from the anti-knock wave-absorbing blocks, and is connected with the plurality of anti-knock wave-absorbing blocks; the anti-buckling restrained brace is connected between the first composite multilayer anti-explosion plate and the second composite multilayer anti-explosion plate. The invention has obvious antiknock effect, the original shielding part and the antiknock supplementary structure are connected to resist explosion impact together, the connection is simple and convenient, and the punching is not carried out on the original shielding part structure.

title_en: Intelligent tool for extrusion molding of silicon carbide cantilever paddle and application method of intelligent tool
abstract_en: The application relates to an intelligent tool for extrusion molding of a silicon carbide cantilever paddle and a use method thereof, wherein the intelligent tool comprises a control unit, a support frame and at least one bearing unit detachably connected to the support frame; the support frame includes upper frame and lower floor's frame, lower floor's frame bottom is equipped with supporting mechanism, upper frame is equipped with the pivot along geometric center, bear the weight of the unit and include square accepting board, cloth laying mechanism and water absorption mechanism, accepting the side geometric center department of board offer size and shape all with the through-hole that the pivot matches, the four corners of accepting the board all integrated into one piece has the supporting part with elastic supporting mechanism contact. The intelligent tool and the application method thereof can conveniently transfer the silicon carbide cantilever paddle biscuit and finish all working procedures before reaction sintering, thereby improving the qualification rate and the production efficiency of products and reducing the production cost.

title_en: Method for densifying fibrous structures by injecting a slurry
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method of densifying a fibrous structure made of a ceramic material for use in an injection device comprising-a mould cavity defined between a mould and an opposing mould, the mould cavity defining an interior space, and-a membrane comprising a strengthening zone, the membrane being to be placed between the fibrous structure in the mould cavity and the opposing mould, the strengthening zone of the membrane having a Young's modulus of more than 200GPa, the method comprising-placing (110) a pre-densified fibrous structure in the mould cavity, the pre-densified fibrous structure having corrugations on a surface, and placing the membrane on the pre-densified fibrous structure such that the strengthening zone of the membrane is in contact with peaks of the corrugations of the pre-densified fibrous structure, -closing (120) the injection device by placing the opposing mould on the membrane and applying a compaction pressure (P   Compaction  ) to the membrane to keep the strengthening zone of the membrane in contact with peaks of the corrugations of the pre-densified fibrous structure, and-densifying (130) the pre-densified fibrous structure by penetrating the slurry into pores of the pre-densified fibrous structure, the slurry being compacted (130) at a compaction pressure of between 35 Pa and 10.375Pa between the injection pressure and 35 Pa in the injection device.

title_en: Power source module, cleaning base station and cleaning system
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a power source module, clean basic station, clean system, the power source module includes driving motor, first work module, second work module. The first working module comprises a first supporting piece and a first working head arranged on the first supporting piece, wherein the first supporting piece is controlled by the driving of the driving motor, and the first working head is driven to move on the first surface so as to execute a working task. The second working module comprises a second supporting piece and a second working head arranged on the second supporting piece, the second supporting piece is driven by the first supporting piece, the second working head moves on the second surface, and further working tasks are executed, wherein the first surface and the second surface are arranged in an angle mode. The power source module can move in multiple directions and clean multiple working surfaces under the driving of the driving motor, and the structure of the cleaning base station can be effectively simplified, so that the cleaning base station is miniaturized and highly integrated.

title_en: Preparation method for preparing honeycomb porous structure metal material based on cold spraying and material thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of metal material processing, and relates to a honeycomb porous structure metal material prepared based on cold spraying and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method specifically comprises the following steps of S1, preparing metal hydrogenated powder, S2, cold spray forming, S3, and dehydrogenation treatment. The preparation method reduces the requirements of cold spraying, especially the requirement of powder on high critical spraying speed, widens the feasibility of cold spraying to process metal materials, and has the characteristics of rapidness, continuity, short flow compared with the preparation methods of casting, powder metallurgy, additive manufacturing and the like. Compared with the conventional metal material processed by cold spraying, the porous structure metal material prepared by the invention has higher electromagnetic shielding performance, and can be applied to the field of electromagnetic shielding at low cost.

title_en: Light-weight sound-insulation and noise-reduction sound-absorption cotton composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lightweight sound-insulating and noise-reducing sound-absorbing cotton composite material, a preparation method and application thereof, which are characterized in that the sound-absorbing cotton is bonded with a plastic film or a rubber-plastic damping film through glue and then rolled and bonded, and then the materials are sent into a drying tunnel for drying and solidification, and finally the sound-absorbing cotton composite material is obtained by rolling, and the sound-absorbing cotton composite material is used for sealing cabins or automobile interior trim parts. Through the mode, the sound-absorbing and noise-reducing device has the effects of sound absorption and noise reduction, also has the strong sound-insulating effects of reflecting noise, damping vibration reduction and noise reduction, has the advantages of light density, low cost and easiness in manufacturing, and has better noise-reducing effect when used in a closed cabin or an automobile interior.

title_en: Method for photocuring 3D printing high-temperature-resistant die
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for photocuring 3D printing high-temperature resistant die, which comprises the following steps of synthesizing high-temperature resistant photocuring 3D printing resin, wherein the high-temperature resistant photocuring 3D printing resin comprises, by weight, 50-80% of ethoxylated bisphenol A diacrylate, 15-35% of ethoxylated trimethylolpropane triacrylate, 3-10% of 2,4, 6-trimethylbenzoyl-diphenyl phosphine oxide, 1-5% of filler and 0-2% of auxiliary agent, constructing a die model through three-dimensional modeling software, constructing a die model structure comprising a conformal cooling water pipeline, slicing the die modeling model through slicing software, setting printing parameters to generate a slice file, guiding the generated slice file into photocuring 3D printing equipment, taking the high-temperature resistant photocuring 3D printing resin as a 3D printing material, and forming the high-temperature resistant die through a photocuring 3D printing technology. The method for photocuring 3D printing high-temperature resistant die can effectively improve the high-temperature resistance and compression resistance of the photocuring 3D printing forming high-temperature resistant die.

title_en: Special fertilizer injection unit is planted to grape
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of grape planting, in particular to a special fertilizer device for grape planting, which comprises a shell component, a slotting component and a slotting component, wherein the shell component comprises a first fertilizer box and a second fertilizer box which is arranged on the right side of the first fertilizer box, the first fertilizer box and the second fertilizer box are fixedly arranged through connecting plates and are parallel to each other, inclined plates are fixedly arranged in the first fertilizer box and the second fertilizer box, the slotting component comprises a double-headed motor fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the first fertilizer box, the output end of the double-headed motor is fixedly provided with a first bevel gear and a third bevel gear respectively, and both sides of the bottom end of the second fertilizer box are rotatably provided with a fifth rotating rod. The invention realizes the integrated flow of slotting, fertilizing and filling, so that the operation is more convenient, the follow-up flow of filling is reduced, the fixed-point quantitative effect can be realized during fertilization, the situations of blockage and excessive fertilization of the fertilizer are prevented, and meanwhile, the trouble caused by blockage of a discharge hole by soil during fertilization is avoided.

title_en: Health cake capable of improving sleep quality and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of cake making, and particularly discloses a health-preserving cake capable of improving sleep quality and a preparation method thereof. The health cake for improving sleep quality is prepared from parched semen Ziziphi Spinosae, bulbus Lilii, 40-50 parts of Poria, semen Nelumbinis, mori fructus, arillus longan, fructus Jujubae, rhizoma Polygonati, water, maltose, crystal sugar, sal, butter, and corn starch by mashing parched semen Ziziphi Spinosae, mixing with Bulbus Lilii, semen Nelumbinis, mori fructus, and rhizoma Polygonati, boiling with strong fire, decocting with slow fire to obtain medicinal juice, mixing Poria, arillus longan, fructus Jujubae with medicinal juice, pulverizing to obtain medicinal mud, mixing medicinal mud with maltose, crystal sugar, sal, butter, boiling, adding corn starch water, decocting with slow fire and stirring to viscous state, pouring into a mold, and naturally cooling to obtain health cake. The health cake for improving sleep quality has the advantages of solving sleep disorder and improving sleep quality.

title_en: Efficient stable-moving and ginseng-protecting rotary sea cucumber pool pouring equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-efficiency stable-moving and ginseng-protecting rotary sea cucumber pool pouring device which mainly comprises a sea cucumber seedling raising device, a lifting driving device consisting of a hydraulic cylinder, a coupler and a protecting cover, a rotary driving device consisting of a motor, a driving shaft, a driving gear, a driven shaft and a driven gear, a stable-moving support device consisting of an upper support, a lower support, a connecting rod, a lifting box and a steel cable, and a buffering and ginseng-protecting device consisting of a buffer box and a buffer plate. The device is characterized by saving labor, being efficient and stable in lifting and lowering, rotating the pool and buffering and protecting the ginseng in the pool pouring process. According to the invention, the sea cucumber grows in the sea cucumber seedling raising device, the reverse pond of the sea cucumber seedling raising box is lifted by the lifting driving device, the reverse pond of the sea cucumber seedling raising box is rotated by the rotating driving device, the stable reverse pond of the sea cucumber seedling raising box is realized by the stable moving bracket device, and the buffering and damage-preventing reverse pond of the sea cucumber seedling raising box is realized by the buffering and parameter protecting device.

title_en: Laser selective melting forming method of modified 7075 aluminum alloy composite powder
abstract_en: The invention provides a laser selective melting forming method of modified 7075 aluminum alloy composite powder, belonging to the technical field of special materials for aluminum alloy additive manufacturing. The 7075 aluminum alloy provided by the invention realizes grain refinement under the action of Ti2AlNb powder, so that the cracking tendency of the alloy is greatly reduced, and the mechanical property of the 7075 aluminum alloy is further improved, so that the 7075 aluminum alloy is more suitable for an SLM process, and the material system for manufacturing the aluminum alloy by additive is enriched. Experimental results show that the yield strength of the Ti2AlNb/7075 aluminum alloy prepared by SLM molding can reach 318.28MPa, the tensile strength can reach 380.96 MPa, the elongation can reach 6.43%, the density can reach 99.21%, and defects such as SLM cracks and air holes of the 7075 aluminum alloy can be obviously eliminated.

title_en: Bacillus bailii and application thereof in preventing and controlling wheat leaf blight and inhibiting plant pathogenic fungi
abstract_en: The invention relates to bacillus belicus and application thereof in preventing and controlling wheat leaf blight and inhibiting plant pathogenic fungi, belonging to the field of biological prevention and control. The bacillus behenryi HXYT is obtained by separating and screening tobacco leaves growing in Xuchang county of Ulmin, henan province (longitude: 113.73, latitude: 33.91), has remarkable inhibition effects on vermicularia, fusarium moniliformis, fusarium graminearum, aspergillus flavus and aspergillus niger, can damage mycelium structures of the vermicularia, inhibit germination of spores of the vermicularia, has obvious prevention and treatment effects on wheat leaf blight caused by the vermicularia, and provides a new microbial resource for prevention and treatment of wheat leaf blight.

title_en: Seeding device for ecological restoration of desertification grassland
abstract_en: The invention discloses a seeding device for ecological restoration of desertification grasslands, which relates to the technical field of agricultural machinery and comprises a seeding main body mechanism, a wheel body mechanism, an adjusting mechanism and a driving mechanism, wherein the seeding main body mechanism is used for realizing leveling treatment of a road surface, the wheel body mechanism is used for detecting that the device runs on a certain road section, the adjusting mechanism is used for adjusting one of a bottom mouth gag and soil depth, and the driving mechanism is used for providing power for movement of integral equipment. In the invention, the pressure value changes of the internal pressure sensor real-time monitoring equipment on different road sections of the two wheel body mechanisms are utilized in the running and rolling process, accurate data support is provided for adjusting the sowing depth, the automatic system generates corresponding control instructions according to the detection result, the precise adjustment of the height of the mouth gag is realized through the matching of a plurality of groups of telescopic adjusting plates and the reciprocating motor, the depth of the sowing opening is adjusted by the processing mode according to the detected gradient, and the planting effect of seeds on different gradient terrains is ensured.

title_en: Continuous injection molding method and device for mobile phone card holder
abstract_en: The application provides a continuous injection molding method and a device for a mobile phone card holder, which are characterized in that firstly, an in-mold pressure sequence is acquired in an injection molding process, a first plastic liquid diffusion angle of a mobile phone card holder mold is determined according to the in-mold pressure sequence and an initial plastic liquid flow rate, a plastic liquid infrared image set is acquired, temperature fault point extraction is carried out according to the plastic liquid infrared image set, a temperature fault point and a gradient temperature diffusion coefficient of mobile phone card holder plastic liquid are obtained, thermal diffusion analysis is carried out according to the temperature fault point and the gradient temperature diffusion coefficient, a second plastic liquid diffusion angle of the mobile phone card holder plastic liquid is obtained, a plastic liquid diffusion deviation degree is determined according to the first plastic liquid diffusion angle of the mobile phone card holder mold and the second plastic liquid diffusion angle of the mobile phone card holder plastic liquid, finally, the plastic liquid flow rate in a subsequent injection molding process is regulated according to the plastic liquid diffusion deviation degree, subsurface damage caused by local overheating inside the mobile phone card holder injection molding process can be avoided, and the processing quality of mobile phone card holder injection molding processing is improved.

title_en: Mariculture device
abstract_en: The offshore aquaculture device comprises an offshore drilling platform, an aquaculture net cage and a plurality of positioning ropes, wherein the offshore drilling platform comprises a platform buoyancy tank and a working layer, the platform buoyancy tank is located right below the working layer, the lower side face of the platform buoyancy tank and the upper side face of the working layer are fixedly connected into a whole through a plurality of support columns, the support columns extend in the vertical direction respectively, the aquaculture net cage is configured to be opened at the top of the box and located below the working layer, a sinker is connected to the bottom of the box of the aquaculture net cage and is configured to be located above the platform buoyancy tank, one ends of the positioning ropes are fixedly installed on columns of one of the support columns respectively, and the other ends of the positioning ropes are fixedly installed on the side walls of the box of the aquaculture net cage respectively. The offshore well-drilling platform can be used for realizing open sea cage culture, the throwing amount of the culture cage is increased, and the variety of marine product cage culture suitable for open sea environment is enriched.

title_en: Process for silica gel composite molding product
abstract_en: The invention discloses a process for manufacturing a silica gel composite mold product, which comprises the following steps of firstly manufacturing a master mold, processing the master mold according to the size specification and the shape standard of a 2D or 3D drawing by CNC real-time setting corresponding parameter standard, then performing laser rapid prototyping by SLA (laser light assisted laser system) or manufacturing a prototype of the master mold by 3D printing equipment, then manufacturing a silica gel mold, firstly manufacturing a mold frame, a runner and exhausting air when manufacturing the silica gel mold, mixing A, B materials 1:1 to prepare liquid silica gel, uniformly stirring, and vacuumizing. The invention can be used for plastic or polyurethane products with small batches and complex shapes, utilizes the good fluidity of liquid silica gel, fully fits with a master model, perfectly replicates the shapes, has the mold manufacturing time far lower than that of a steel mold, can greatly reduce the mold manufacturing period, has excellent elastic recovery capability, is easier to assemble and disassemble the mold, greatly reduces the operation difficulty of workers, and effectively saves working hours.

title_en: Processing device and preparation method of potted magnolia substrate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a processing device and a preparation method of a potted magnolia substrate, wherein the processing device comprises a bracket, one side of the bracket is provided with a processing component for granulating the substrate, the processing component comprises a discharge hopper and a granulating component, the granulating component comprises a roller and an arc-shaped matching sliding block, the surface of the roller is provided with a notch, an air chamber is arranged in the roller, the surface of the air chamber is in sliding connection with a moving sliding block, one end of the moving sliding block is fixedly connected with an arc-shaped sliding block, the arc-shaped matching sliding block is fixed on the surface of the discharge hopper, the arc-shaped sliding block is in sliding engagement connection with the arc-shaped matching sliding block, the surface of the moving sliding block is sleeved with a reset spring, the notch is in through connection with the air chamber through a pipeline, and in the granulating process, the air in the air chamber can assist the substrate to be separated from the notch smoothly, the substrate is prevented from being clamped in the notch, the granulating efficiency is remarkably improved, and the production process is smoother and more efficient.

title_en: Hardware injection molding assembly equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides hardware injection molding assembly equipment which comprises a frame, a hardware feeding mechanism, a hardware feeding and carrying manipulator, an injection molding feeding positioning seat, a rubber plug feeding and assembling mechanism, an injection molding finished product discharging and positioning assembly, a finished product collecting device and a finished product discharging and carrying manipulator, wherein the hardware feeding mechanism, the hardware feeding and carrying manipulator, the injection molding feeding and positioning mechanism, the rubber plug feeding and assembling mechanism, the injection molding finished product discharging and positioning assembly, the finished product collecting device and the finished product discharging and carrying manipulator are arranged on the side of a lifting device and used for taking out and carrying hardware on a lifted material supporting assembly to the injection molding feeding and positioning seat, the injection molding feeding and positioning seat is used for positioning the hardware and taking out for an injection molding machine, the injection molding finished product discharging and positioning assembly is used for taking out an injection molded finished product which is injected by the injection molding machine, the rubber plug feeding and assembling mechanism is assembled into an injection molded finished product discharging and positioning assembly, and the finished product discharging and carrying manipulator is used for taking out and carrying a finished product assembled in the rubber plug feeding and assembling mechanism into the finished product collecting device.

title_en: Screw assembly and method for manufacturing the same
abstract_en: The application relates to a screw assembly and a manufacturing method, wherein the screw assembly comprises a first screw head and a first screw rod, a first external thread is arranged outside the first screw rod, a tapping groove is formed in the first screw rod, internal threads are formed in the circumferential direction of the tapping groove, a second screw comprises a second screw head and a second screw rod, a second external thread is arranged outside the second screw rod, the second screw rod is inserted into the tapping groove of the first screw rod, the second external thread is matched with the internal thread, and the second screw head and the second external thread are both made of nylon materials. The screw assembly is compact in structure, the second screw head is attached to the surface of a fixed object in the process of fixing by using the screw assembly, and the second screw head made of nylon effectively prevents the conditions of gouging and paint dropping on the surface of the fixed object, plays a role in protecting the surface of the fixed object, and meets the requirements of users.

title_en: Multichannel 3D prints head
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multichannel 3D printing head, and aims to solve the defect that most of the existing 3D printing heads are single-channel and cannot realize selective printing of various printing materials, simultaneous extrusion printing and extrusion printing after mixing. The printing head comprises a printing head body, wherein at least two feeding channels are arranged on the printing head body, feeding screws are arranged in the feeding channels, the lower part of the printing head body is detachably connected with a discharging head, the feeding channels are communicated with the discharging head, and feeding inlets are arranged on the printing head body in one-to-one correspondence with the feeding channels. The multichannel 3D printing head can realize the selective printing of various printing materials, and simultaneously extrusion printing and mixed extrusion printing.

title_en: Threshing and cleaning device suitable for irregular grain beans
abstract_en: The invention discloses a threshing and cleaning device suitable for irregular granular beans, wherein the grain rods of a threshing part group are arranged into a plurality of groups at intervals on the circumference of a supporting inner cylinder, each group of long grain rods is arranged into a plurality of sub-modules which are closely arranged along the length direction, the plurality of sub-modules can be arranged on a long support in a reciprocating mode and are outwards ejected through respective elastic parts, the sub-modules and a screen keep an initial distance, when materials pass through the plurality of sub-modules and the screen, large-specification material extrusion enables the sub-modules to retract and compress the elastic parts so as to increase the distance for passing, the short grain rods are arranged into a plurality of groups on the circumference of the supporting inner cylinder, each group is provided with a plurality of intervals by taking the axial direction of the supporting inner cylinder as a reference, and the second gaps for passing materials are formed at the intervals. The threshing machine can adapt to the passing of beans with more specifications and irregular grains and performs extrusion threshing, and improves the applicability of the threshing and cleaning device.

title_en: Side spring block demoulding mechanism of injection mould fixed mould
abstract_en: The demolding mechanism of injection mold fixed mold side spring block includes an upper cover plate and a lower cover plate. A fixed template is set under the upper cover plate, a fixed mold insert is set under the fixed template, a perforation is opened in the lower cover plate, and a mold foot is set on the lower cover plate. The upper top pin plate, lower top pin plate, and top pin are set on the lower cover plate between the mold feet. The injection molding machine top rod passes through the perforation and contacts the lower top pin plate. A moving template is set on the mold foot, and a moving mold insert and a side core pulling slider are set on the moving template. There is a plastic part between the fixed mold insert, the moving mold insert, and the side core pulling slider. The lower part of the plastic part has a lower groove, which cooperates with the moving mold insert. The outer wall on the right side of the plastic part has a Side groove, with a convex angle set on the upper part of the side groove, and a spring block set under the fixed template. One side of the spring block is matched with the side groove, and the spring block slides with the fixed template through a limit sliding structure. A first inclined guide hole is opened in the spring block, A fixed column is set on the moving template, and an inclined guide rod is set on the fixed column, which is matched with the first inclined guide hole.

title_en: Method and apparatus for slicing multiple layer glass elements
abstract_en: The application provides a method of manufacturing a blank for a light-guiding optical element (1) from a composite glass laminate (3), the composite glass laminate (3) comprising a plurality of glass sheets (5) bonded together and a light-reflecting layer (7) arranged therebetween, the method comprising cutting a slice (9) from the composite glass laminate (3) along parallel cutting planes (11). The alignment of the composite glass laminate (3) with the cutting plane (11) comprises-adjusting the inclination of the plane (16) with the cutting plane (11) with an autocollimator (22), and-adjusting the position of the laminate (3) in a direction inclined, preferably perpendicular, to the cutting plane (11). The composite glass laminate (3) is fixed to a holder (23) in the direction in which it is aligned, and cut to form a blank for forming the light-guiding optical element (1).

title_en: High-temperature-resistant bulletproof plate and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of bulletproof plates, and particularly relates to a high-temperature-resistant bulletproof plate and a preparation method thereof, comprising the following steps of stacking high-temperature-resistant ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene laid cloth and polyimide films at intervals to obtain a composite material; wrapping the composite material with woven cloth, arranging a hot melt adhesive film between the composite material and the woven cloth, and then placing the composite material and the woven cloth into a die; the invention adds graphene into the ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene fiber, prepares the bulletproof plate by heating and heating, and in addition, a layer of heat insulation coating is smeared on the surface of the bulletproof plate, thereby remarkably improving the heat insulation performance of the ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene fiber, being capable of keeping performance in a high temperature environment of 100-110 ℃ and exceeding the upper limit of the use environment of the conventional ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene bulletproof plate, being applicable to the positions of automobile engines and the like.

title_en: CT needle cylinder production device for high-pressure injector
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of CT needle cylinder production, in particular to a CT needle cylinder production device for a high-pressure injector, which comprises production equipment, wherein one side of the production equipment is detachably connected with an upper die, the other side of the production equipment is detachably connected with a lower die, the inner side of the lower die is detachably connected with a plurality of needle cylinders, one side of the upper die is fixedly connected with a first fixed rod, the other end of the first fixed rod is fixedly connected with a rack, the bottom of the rack is meshed with a gear, the inner side of the gear is in threaded connection with a screw rod, one side of the gear is rotationally connected with a first fixed plate, the other end of the screw rod is rotationally connected with a second fixed plate, the outer surface of the second fixed plate is provided with a square hole in a penetrating way, the inner side of a square groove of the second fixed plate is slidably clamped with an upper clamping plate, the outer surface of the needle cylinder can be clamped by the upper clamping plate when the upper die slides, and then the needle cylinder is driven to drop from the inner side of the upper die when the needle cylinder is output by an electric push rod, so that a plurality of needle cylinders can be taken out at one time, and the times of taking pieces are reduced.

title_en: Rape sowing system and method suitable for sticky and heavy soil in hilly area
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of crop sowing and discloses a rape sowing system and a rape sowing method suitable for sticky and heavy soil in hilly areas, wherein the system comprises a sensor assembly, a sensor assembly and a control unit, wherein the sensor assembly comprises a humidity sensor and an image collector, and is arranged on a rape precise direct seeding machine; the control module is electrically connected with the sensor assembly and the rape precise direct seeding machine, is configured to collect real-time information of the sensor assembly and control the rape precise direct seeding machine according to the real-time information, and comprises a collecting unit, a processing unit and a control unit. The invention can improve the sowing precision, optimize the soil adaptability and improve the germination rate and the growth quality of rape through accurate soil data analysis and real-time adjustment, is particularly suitable for complex soil conditions in hilly areas, and has remarkable agricultural production benefits.

title_en: Movable mould adjusting device of injection moulding machine
abstract_en: The invention provides a movable die adjusting device of an injection molding machine, which belongs to the technical field of injection molds and comprises a movable die plate, a slideway, an adjusting device and a screw rod, wherein the adjusting device is arranged between the slideway and the movable die plate and is used for adjusting the parallelism of the movable die plate, the adjusting device comprises a sliding seat and an adjusting frame, one ends of the sliding seat and the adjusting frame are mutually hinged, the movable die plate is arranged on the adjusting frame, a chute is arranged on the adjusting frame, the sliding seat is slidably provided with a sliding block through a first sliding rail, a sliding column capable of sliding in the chute is arranged on the sliding block, the sliding seat is provided with the screw rod in threaded connection with the sliding column, and the screw rod in the adjusting device can be locked, so that the position of the sliding block is still ensured not to deviate even if the screw rod suffers from the external force influence caused by sliding or vibration of the movable die plate, and the screw rod can still be ensured to be rotated, so that the parallelism stability of the movable die plate is maintained.

title_en: Automatic pelletization equipment of tealeaves
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of tea processing, and discloses automatic tea granulating equipment. This tealeaves automatic pelletization equipment, a tealeaves automatic pelletization equipment, the on-line screen storage device comprises a base, the last fixed surface of base is connected with the processing case, the feed inlet has been seted up on the top of processing case, be provided with pelletization mechanism and detection mechanism in the processing case, including the feed divider subassembly in the pelletization mechanism, the feed divider subassembly is used for carrying out the pan feeding and distributing to the material. This automatic pelletization equipment of tealeaves through the setting of pelletization mechanism, can restrain tealeaves and the phenomenon of the agglomeration that the mixture appears under the condition of not pelletization to can make tealeaves and mixture more compact in subsequent pressing process, improve granule processing's precision, still can carry out quick pelletization through the size of required granule, reduce in the past need change equipment or component just can prepare not unidimensional granule, improve machining efficiency.

title_en: Feeding device for production and manufacture of heat insulation cotton
abstract_en: The invention discloses a feeding device for production and manufacture of heat-insulating cotton, and relates to the technical field of heat-insulating cotton processing equipment. Including the brace table, brace table upper end fixedly connected with support frame, the top of support frame is provided with mixed mechanism, and mixed mechanism's top is provided with edulcoration mechanism, and the right side of support frame is provided with feed mechanism, and the four corners of brace table lower extreme all is provided with the drive wheel. Utilize pin one in the edulcoration mechanism to cooperate with the vibration screen cloth to use and realize the clearance to impurity in the raw materials, utilize first and second cooperation of pan feeding frame to make multiple raw materials put in simultaneously, improve the efficiency of follow-up mixing, utilize hybrid motor to drive the dwang and rotate, and then utilize the dwang to drive the puddler and rotate the intensive mixing that realizes various raw materials, be provided with the lift cylinder in the below of material loading pipe, the slip ring and the material loading pipe sliding connection that lift cylinder upper end is connected utilize the lift of lift cylinder to realize the altitude mixture control of material loading pipe right side ejection of compact fill when using.

title_en: Dummy system and method for detecting injury effect of infrasonic wave on human body
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dummy system and a method for detecting the injury effect of infrasound waves on a human body, wherein the dummy system comprises a dummy body and an infrasound wave detection and collection processing device, the dummy body comprises a head part, a neck part, a trunk part, a dummy heart and a dummy lung, the dummy heart and the dummy lung are arranged in the trunk part, the head part, the trunk part, the dummy heart and the dummy lung are made of acoustic metamaterial materials, the infrasound wave detection and collection processing device comprises an acceleration sensor and a data acquisition module which are respectively arranged in the dummy body, an infrasound wave frequency test sensor and an infrasound sound pressure intensity test sensor which are respectively arranged in the environment where the dummy body is arranged, and an upper computer, wherein the data acquisition module is electrically connected with the acceleration sensor, the data acquisition module, the infrasound wave frequency test sensor and the infrasound wave sound pressure intensity test sensor respectively. The dummy system can simulate resonance and damage states of the human body under the influence of infrasonic waves.

title_en: Self-propelled corn harvester
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of agricultural machinery, in particular to a self-propelled corn harvester which comprises a crawler trolley, a portal frame arranged above the crawler trolley, a clamping mechanism and a picking roller, wherein the clamping mechanism is fixed on the portal frame and comprises a main beam with a tail part obliquely downwards from the head part and a seedling dividing assembly protruding out of the portal frame, the picking roller is connected to the tail part of the main beam and forms a lateral extrusion space with the clamping mechanism, the self-propelled corn harvester is used for solving the technical problems that the corn harvester is difficult to adapt to complex terrains, the occupied space is too large to flexibly turn, the energy consumption in the picking process is large, the extrusion damage to corn ears in the picking process is large, and the quality of the corn ears is poor.

title_en: Be used for root class traditional chinese medicine planting device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a root Chinese medicine planting device, which comprises a supporting substrate, wherein a moving wheel is arranged at the bottom of the supporting substrate, a side baffle is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the supporting substrate, two adjusting discs are arranged between the two side baffles, the two adjusting discs are mutually connected through a supporting rod, a planting box is arranged on the supporting rod, a positioning screw is arranged on the side edge of the supporting substrate, an abutting pressing block is fixedly arranged at the lower end of the positioning screw, the middle part of the adjusting disc is fixedly connected with the output end of a servo motor, the servo motor is fixedly arranged on the side baffle, a water pump is arranged on the side edge of the supporting substrate, a water suction pipe and a water delivery pipe are arranged on the water pump, and the water suction pipe is used for sucking external nutrient solution or water sources. The planting device for root Chinese herbal medicine can rotate the planting box of the Chinese herbal medicine when planting the Chinese herbal medicine, so that the Chinese herbal medicine on the upper layer and the lower layer can uniformly receive illumination, and the illumination uniformity of the Chinese herbal medicine on the upper layer and the lower layer is improved.

title_en: Antibacterial glass preparation method, antibacterial glass and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application relates to the technical field of glass, and discloses a preparation method of antibacterial glass, antibacterial glass and electronic equipment, wherein a coating comprising an antibacterial component is sprayed on a first surface of a glass body, and the antibacterial component is provided with a hydrophobic group; after the spraying is finished, tempering the glass body so as to sinter the antibacterial component on the first surface of the glass body to form an antibacterial layer, thereby obtaining the antibacterial glass. In this embodiment, when the antibacterial layer of the glass contacts bacteria, hydrophobic groups thereon can be inserted into the lipid layer of the bacteria to destroy the structure of cell membranes and affect the metabolism of the bacteria, thereby allowing the bacteria to die and achieving the sterilizing and antibacterial effects. In addition, the antibacterial component is formed on the glass body through tempering and sintering, so that the antibacterial layer has high adhesive force, and the antibacterial glass has good wear resistance and durable antibacterial performance. In addition, the antibacterial components are synchronously sintered to form an antibacterial layer in the toughening treatment process, so that the process can be simplified, and the cost can be saved.

title_en: Coating type matte PET film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coating type matte PET film and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of films, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps of preparing an antistatic agent, preparing a matting agent, preparing a coating liquid and coating; the coating liquid is prepared by mixing the aqueous polyurethane dispersion liquid, the antistatic agent, the matting agent and the aqueous organic silicon defoaming agent, stirring at room temperature, adding the acrylic leveling agent, the wear-resistant agent and the 3-aminopropyl trimethoxy silane, continuously stirring, adding the polycarbodiimide, and continuously stirring.

title_en: Accelerated early fruiting method, cultivation device and method for pear hybrid branches
abstract_en: A method for accelerating early fruiting of pear hybrid branches, a cultivating device and a method thereof are characterized in that terminal buds of the pear hybrid branches of the second year are grafted to perennial pear stocks, so that the growth from the terminal buds to fruiting branches is realized, fruiting nutrition is provided by the pear stocks, the technical problem that the pear hybrid branches are subjected to fruiting usually at least 5-10 years is solved, and therefore pear hybrid fruiting branches are obtained in the third year.

title_en: Large-size high-homogenization infrared chalcogenide glass and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of infrared optical material preparation, in particular to large-size high-homogenization infrared chalcogenide glass and a preparation method and application thereof. The method adopts a low-temperature reduction method or a low-temperature solid fractionation method to purify raw materials, effectively reduces impurity residues in the raw materials, meets the precision requirement of large-size infrared chalcogenide glass, adopts a supercooling atmosphere standing solidification method to cool and solidify, avoids the condition that the infrared chalcogenide glass has stripe or crack defects, improves the quality of glass blanks, eliminates the internal thermal stress of the glass materials through a process of combining two anneals with a special die, and improves the optical uniformity and permeability of the infrared chalcogenide glass. By utilizing the technical scheme of the invention, the problems that the existing large-size infrared chalcogenide glass has poor raw material purification effect and more residues in the preparation process, and stripes and cracks are easy to occur in the synthesis process so as to influence the optical uniformity and the internal quality of the infrared chalcogenide glass are effectively solved.
