title_en: Silicon rubber composite medium with good conductivity and high breakdown applied to cable accessories and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: A silicon rubber composite medium with good conductivity and high breakdown applied to cable accessories and a preparation method thereof belong to an electrical insulating material and a preparation method thereof. The invention aims to solve the problem that the electric field is locally concentrated due to mismatching of the electric conductivity of SiR and XLPE in the existing cable accessory. The composite medium is prepared by modifying silicon rubber by using 3-methyl-2-butene-1-ol and 4-propyl benzoic acid, wherein the 3-methyl-2-butene-1-ol is grafted onto a molecular chain of the silicon rubber to improve the conductivity of the silicon rubber in a low field, the 4-propyl benzoic acid is doped into the silicon rubber grafted by the 3-methyl-2-butene-1-ol to improve the free volume of the silicon rubber and the breakdown field strength of the silicon rubber in a high field, and the cable accessory is used in offshore wind power, urban underground power grids, transformer substation engineering, photovoltaic power generation and energy storage systems.

title_en: Glass fiber tape bundle forming device and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tire shearing bands and discloses a glass fiber band bundle forming device and a control method thereof, wherein the glass fiber band bundle forming device comprises a rolling mechanism, a waveform forming mechanism and a forming control mechanism, the waveform forming mechanism comprises a first transverse bar and a second transverse bar, the first transverse bar and the second transverse bar are both positioned at the input end of the rolling mechanism, the first transverse bar and the second transverse bar are mutually parallel, a first clamping tooth is arranged on the first transverse bar, a second clamping tooth is arranged on the second transverse bar, and the first clamping tooth and the second clamping tooth are oppositely arranged; the glass fiber belt bundle forming device is provided with the forming control mechanism, and can control the waveform forming mechanism to move along the direction parallel to the axis of the rolling mechanism, so that the glass fiber belt bundles with different preset waves can be formed.

title_en: Organosilicon modified bismaleimide resin and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses an organosilicon modified bismaleimide resin and a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of composite materials. The organosilicon modified bismaleimide resin contains a siloxane (Si-O-Si) skeleton and an aromatic ring structure, has lower polarization capacity, reduces the dielectric constant (Dk), dielectric loss (Df) and water absorption rate of the material, simultaneously has larger steric hindrance and rigidity, further crosslinks C=C double bonds, improves the crosslinking density and rigidity of the material, limits the rotation and movement of molecular chains, further improves the glass transition temperature and heat resistance of the material, and can maintain the excellent heat resistance, high modulus, lower dielectric constant and dielectric loss value and low water absorption rate of the material while improving the compatibility of bismaleimide and other resins, thereby meeting the requirements of high-performance application.

title_en: Soil microorganism for promoting growth of tea trees and improving flavor of tea
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of microorganisms, and discloses a soil microorganism for promoting the growth of tea trees and improving the quality of tea, wherein the strain is named Streptomyces cerasinus SI-3B1, the preservation unit is the Guangdong province microorganism strain preservation center, the preservation date is 2024, 9, 13 and the preservation number is GDMCC No.65129. The microorganism of the invention effectively improves the content of theanine and water extract of the first bud and second leaf of the spring tea of the large leaf species, the summer tea leaves are more hypertrophic, and the biomass of the leaves is increased.

title_en: Preparation system and application of fiber reinforced ceramic matrix composite
abstract_en: The application provides a preparation system of a fiber reinforced ceramic matrix composite material, which comprises a pressure device, a precursor resin providing device, a hot pressing device, a vacuum film bag to be impregnated, a precursor resin collecting device and a vacuum pump, wherein the pressure device is connected with the precursor resin providing device, the vacuum film bag to be impregnated is arranged in the hot pressing device and is respectively connected with the precursor resin providing device and the precursor resin collecting device through the hot pressing device, an outlet of the hot pressing device is connected with an inlet of the precursor resin collecting device, and an outlet of the precursor resin collecting device is connected with the vacuum pump. The application also provides application of the preparation system. The preparation system provided by the application can realize the efficient preparation of the fiber reinforced ceramic matrix composite material and improve the impregnation efficiency, and further, the preparation system provided by the application can also be used for preparing composite materials with large size and complex structure.

title_en: Soil saline-alkali modifier and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of soil improvement, and relates to a soil saline-alkali modifier and a preparation method and application thereof. The invention provides a soil saline-alkali modifier which comprises a shell slow-release layer, a middle conditioning layer and an inner functional layer, wherein the inner functional layer is a saline-alkali soil modifying microbial agent, biochar and a granulating adhesive, the middle conditioning layer comprises a conditioning agent, a first slow-release agent and a first solvent, the shell slow-release layer comprises humic acid, furfural residue, a calcium ion compound, a second slow-release agent and a second solvent, the calcium ion compound is at least one of phosphogypsum, desulfurized gypsum, calcium chloride and calcium sulfate, and the conditioning agent is at least one of coumarin, resveratrol and catechin. According to the invention, a multi-layer slow release structure is constructed, and each improvement component is sequentially contacted with the saline-alkali soil in a multi-layer slow release mode, so that an excellent improvement effect is exerted.

title_en: Injection mold
abstract_en: An injection mold comprises a first template, a first mold core and a cover plate. The first template is provided with a first accommodating groove. The first die core is arranged in the first accommodating groove. The first mold core comprises an upper surface, a lower surface, an injection molding groove formed on the lower surface, a central runner formed on the upper surface and a plurality of cooling runners formed on the upper surface. The central runner and the plurality of first ends of the plurality of cooling runners are located above the injection molding groove. The cover plate covers the upper surface, the central flow passage and the plurality of cooling flow passages. The injection molding groove, the central runner and the plurality of cooling runners are mutually separated, and the plurality of cooling runners are radially arranged on the upper surface and encircle the central runner. The first mold core comprises at least four cooling flow channels.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle detects and strikes equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to unmanned aerial vehicle detection and striking equipment, and belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle detection and striking. The unmanned aerial vehicle detecting and striking equipment comprises an installation seat, a control panel, a storage bin and a control seat, wherein the storage bin is arranged in the installation seat, a scanning radar is fixedly arranged at the top of the control seat, a striking mechanism is detected, the striking mechanism is detected and comprises a storage frame, an interference gun, an adjusting component and a positioning component, the storage bin and the installation seat enable the equipment to be stored and carried conveniently, the interference gun is matched with the scanning radar through the adjusting component, the striking and interference power of the interference gun can be adjusted in real time according to the flight speed of the unmanned aerial vehicle, enough interference signals can be provided under different flight speeds, the accuracy and the high efficiency of the interference effect are guaranteed, the strength and the frequency of the interference signals are adjusted under different unmanned aerial vehicle speeds, the interference effect is guaranteed, the energy is saved, and the service life of the equipment is prolonged.

title_en: Irrigation pipe network intelligent scheduling method and system based on hydraulic model
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent irrigation pipe network scheduling method and system based on a hydraulic model, which can simulate the hydraulic behavior of a pipe network in different operation scenes by constructing a hydraulic irrigation simulation model, thereby realizing the accurate simulation and prediction of the hydraulic behavior in the irrigation pipe network. On the basis, according to the crop type of the target area and the water demand of the growth period of the crop, the water supply quality is optimized, and an intelligent dispatching optimization objective function of the irrigation pipe network is established. The minimum absolute error between the actual irrigation quantity and the theoretical water demand is considered, key conditions such as water supply quantity constraint, head valve working pressure constraint and pipeline pressure constraint are also integrated, and scientificity and rationality of irrigation scheduling are ensured. Therefore, the irrigation efficiency can be remarkably improved, the water resources are saved, the healthy growth of crops is promoted, and an effective technical support is provided for solving the problems of water resource shortage, poor irrigation management and the like in modern agriculture.

title_en: Highland barley low-loss header real-time cutting depth adjusting method based on intelligent sensor
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent agricultural machinery, in particular to a highland barley low-loss cutting table real-time cutting depth adjusting method based on an intelligent sensor. The method comprises the steps of designing a highland barley special combine harvester with an intelligent real-time cutting depth adjusting function, collecting and preprocessing data, fusing and analyzing the data, generating cutting depth adjusting instructions, including depth adjusting decisions based on fused data analysis and redundancy and verification of the instructions, and realizing automatic adjustment of a cutting platform, including driving of an adjusting executing mechanism and real-time monitoring and feedback of the cutting platform position. Through intelligent sensor system and real-time feedback adjustment mechanism, solved that traditional harvester exists in highland barley harvesting process header regulation precision not enough, complex operation, adaptability subalternation problem, not only promoted the harvesting quality of highland barley, reduced the seed loss, still kept high-efficient operation in complicated field environment, greatly improved the whole effect that highland barley mechanized was reaped.

title_en: Continuous conveying equipment for 3D printing parts
abstract_en: The invention discloses 3D printing piece continuous conveying equipment which comprises a base, wherein a conveying assembly and a plurality of 3D printers are arranged on the base, and a piece removing mechanism is arranged on a Y-axis moving assembly of each printer. The stripping mechanism comprises a first fixing plate and a second fixing plate, a belt pulley group and a rolling curtain plate are arranged between the plates, and a printing platform is provided with a pressing plate assembly. The pressing plate component has various setting forms and is also provided with a trigger rod, an anti-rotation plate and other parts. In addition, in the case of the optical fiber, the equipment comprises a driving motor, a main backing plate, a secondary backing plate guide plate, guard plate and adjusting foot pad. Compared with the prior art, the device adopts a roller shutter type piece taking device, the piece taking device is quick in piece taking, the combination of a 3D printer and a conveying assembly is realized, automatic continuous conveying is realized, the production efficiency is improved, the printing quality is ensured by a pressing plate assembly, the abrasion of parts such as a trigger rod is reduced, the piece taking is assisted by a material guide plate, and the piece taking process is optimized by an elastic piece, so that the requirement of mass production is met.

title_en: Termite trapping and killing device for water conservancy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a termite trapping and killing device for water conservancy, which comprises a device body, wherein the device body comprises an inner cylinder and an outer cylinder which are coaxially arranged, termite inlet and outlet holes are formed in the side walls of the inner cylinder and the outer cylinder, an attracting module is arranged in the inner cylinder, a plurality of medicine filling cavities which are arranged in an array are arranged between the inner cylinder and the outer cylinder, a medicine applying device is arranged in the medicine filling cavities in an inserting and pulling mode, a top seat is arranged on the circumference of the top of the outer cylinder, an end cover is arranged on the surface of the top seat, a cone head is arranged at the bottom of the outer cylinder, a plurality of draining holes are formed on the circumference of the cone head, a plurality of supporting plates are arranged below the inner wall of the inner cylinder, a supporting groove for supporting the attracting module is arranged above the supporting plates, and the termite trapping and killing device for water conservancy is beneficial to conducting and killing on termites in the use process, the overall medicine application period is short, the termite trapping and killing efficiency is high, and is suitable for popularization and use.

title_en: High-precision injection mold with intelligent specification adaptation
abstract_en: The application relates to an intelligent specification-adaptive high-precision injection mold which comprises two mold cores which are arranged in an opening-closing manner, wherein forming holes are formed in the mold cores and communicated with each other, and a half-cavity surface adjusting component is arranged in the forming holes and is used for forming a finished piece cavity. The application has the effect of adapting to key products with different specifications.

title_en: Integrated self-irrigation green plant landscape modeling and manufacturing method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an integrated self-irrigation green planting landscape modeling and a cultivation method, wherein the integrated self-irrigation green planting landscape modeling is formed by a hollow double-layer landscape modeling and a reservoir, the hollow double-layer landscape modeling is integrally formed by an inner shell and an outer shell, a hollow interlayer is formed between the inner shell and the outer shell, through holes for installing capillary infiltrating irrigation flow guiding devices are arranged at the bottoms of the inner shell and the outer shell, the capillary infiltrating irrigation flow guiding devices at least comprise capillary infiltrating irrigation flow guiding beams and guide pipes matched with the capillary infiltrating irrigation flow guiding beams, the capillary infiltrating irrigation flow guiding beams are formed by flow guiding ropes and fixing rods, and the flow guiding ropes are inserted into soil of the interlayer through the fixing rods. Then the cultivation of the self-irrigation green planting landscape modeling is completed through the steps of manufacturing the landscape modeling, constructing a reservoir, filling nutrient soil or granular soil, removing a discontinuous sealing plate, installing capillary infiltrating irrigation guide beam, injecting water into an outer pool of the reservoir and planting green plants or green planting seeds. The invention can automatically supply water for green plants of landscape modeling, and can customize different landscape modeling to meet the requirement of diversified landscape modeling.

title_en: Electronic visual fishing float
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electronic information and discloses an electronic visual fishing float, which comprises a sealed waterproof shell, wherein a charging module is arranged at one end of the inside of the sealed waterproof shell and is used for wirelessly charging the fishing float, a remote connection module is arranged at the middle side of the inside of the sealed waterproof shell and is used for transmitting signals captured by the fishing float to electronic equipment of a user, a telescopic component is arranged at the other end of the inside of the sealed waterproof shell, one end of the telescopic component is connected with a camera module and is used for capturing fish conditions in water, a cleaning component is arranged at one end of the outside of the sealed waterproof shell and is used for protecting and cleaning the camera module, a switch is arranged on the outer wall of the sealed waterproof shell, and a sensor module is arranged at one side of the outer wall of the sealed waterproof shell. The fish condition signals captured by the camera module are transmitted to the electronic equipment of the user, the transmission distance reaches 15 meters, and the fisher can watch the underwater fish condition on line in real time.

title_en: Hybrid combine harvester and cooperative control method, device and medium for parts of hybrid combine harvester
abstract_en: The application discloses a hybrid combine harvester and a cooperative control method, device and medium for parts thereof, relating to the field of agricultural machinery. The method comprises the steps of establishing a feeding quantity prediction model representing the association relation between the torque of a roller motor and the torque of a bridge motor and the feeding quantity according to the rotating speed of the roller motor and the rotating speed of the bridge motor, processing torque predicted values of the roller motor and the bridge motor by adopting the feeding quantity prediction model to obtain predicted feeding quantity of the harvester, and carrying out speed regulation and/or anti-blocking processing of the roller on the basis of the predicted feeding quantity. According to the embodiment of the application, the speed of the vehicle is adjusted cooperatively according to the torque or the power of the roller and the gap bridge structure, so that the working efficiency can be effectively improved, and the blocking of the roller can be effectively prevented.

title_en: Fragrance-releasing primer-free film and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a fragrance-releasing primer-free film and a preparation process thereof, wherein the fragrance-releasing primer-free film has a multi-layer composite film with a porous structure, and the multi-layer composite film comprises a first surface layer, a core layer and a second surface layer which are sequentially arranged, wherein a fragrance auxiliary agent is added into the core layer and/or the second surface layer, and the fragrance auxiliary agent comprises at least one of powder with a fragrance component, particles based on the fragrance component, microcapsules based on the fragrance component and the like. Embodiments of the present disclosure are not only robust, but also have the advantage of achieving slow release of fragrance and providing a durable fragrance, thereby enabling a stable sensory experience.

title_en: Membrane laminating device and automatic pre-pressing and laminating equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a membrane pressing device and automatic pre-pressing membrane laminating equipment, and belongs to the technical field of membrane manufacturing. The invention designs a water sac with a semi-elliptic capsule structure as a pressing component of the membrane, and provides a two-stage pressing mode, wherein the first stage utilizes a jacking mechanism to realize the movement of the membrane from bottom to top, so that the membrane is firstly contacted with the tail end point of the water sac, the contact area of the membrane and the water sac is gradually enlarged until the membrane is completely jointed, and the progressive joint mode from the point to the surface enables bubbles among the membranes to escape outwards through gaps of areas which are not pressed, thereby effectively avoiding the generation of bubbles in the pressing process, and the second stage continuously increases liquid in the water sac. The whole pressing process is automatically completed, and the technical problems of low manual operation efficiency and unstable pressing effect in the traditional process are solved.

title_en: Device and method for simulating gap distance of underwater rock blasting
abstract_en: The application discloses a device and a method for simulating the gap between the submerged rock explosion, wherein the device for simulating the gap between the submerged rock explosion comprises a water storage tank, a silt area and a rock area are sequentially arranged in the water storage tank along the horizontal direction, a separation limiting layer is arranged between the silt area and the rock area, an explosion-proof cover capable of being opened is arranged above the water storage tank, an explosion-proof camera is arranged in the explosion-proof cover, an explosion-proof device is further arranged on the explosion-proof cover, and the explosion-proof device is arranged below the explosion-proof camera. Through adopting above-mentioned technical scheme, through setting up silt district and rock district in order to simulate the circumstances in the river course as far as possible, then separate silt district and rock district through separating spacing layer, promote the stability in silt district and rock district to the drilling in later stage is convenient for, utilizes explosion-proof lid to reduce the explosion simultaneously and causes dangerous possibility around to, and explosion-proof camera then can record the explosion picture, so as to carry out accurate analysis, and then promotes the precision of explosion test.

title_en: Device for transporting media
abstract_en: A device (1) for transporting a medium comprises a base body (2) and at least one functional element (3), the base body (2) being a blow-molded part, the functional element (3) being fastened to the base body (2). The base body (2) and the functional element (3) each comprise at least one fluid channel (4), the fluid channels (4) of the base body (2) and the functional element (3) being fluidly connected by means of an opening (5) provided in the base body (2). The base body (2) and the functional element (3) are connected to one another in a medium-tight manner by at least one integral bond formed around the opening (5).

title_en: Composite device and composite process of glue-free and wrinkle-free urine pad
abstract_en: The invention discloses a compound device and a compound process of a glue-free and wrinkle-free urine pad. The hot melting composite mechanism realizes glue-free fusion of materials by adjusting the gap between the inserting cylinder and the sleeve roller (0.1-0.5 mm) through the driving of the conical spring and combining with the accurate temperature control (+ -2 ℃) of the electric heating wire, and the dynamic extension assembly drives the elastic extension belt to periodically extend the materials along the arc-shaped guide groove through the central roller, so that the protrusion structure is meshed with the surface, and the extension amplitude is 1% -3% of the width of the materials. The manufacturing process comprises pre-stretching (frequency is calculated according to f=v/L), hot melting compounding (pressure is regulated according to P=0.8T+0.2), cooling and shaping. According to the scheme, chemical adhesives are abandoned, VOCs emission is zero, the tensile strength of a fusion interface is improved by 37% -48%, the wrinkle elimination rate is over 95%, the speed of an adaptive production line is 1.2m/s, the productivity reaches 7200 sheets/hour, and the method has the advantages of environmental protection, high efficiency and product quality.

title_en: Outdoor garden mower
abstract_en: The application relates to an outdoor garden mower, which comprises a main frame, a cutting assembly, a walking assembly, an operation assembly and a power supply device, wherein the power supply device comprises a first type battery pack, a second type battery pack and a battery compartment, the battery compartment is configured to accommodate the first type battery pack and/or the second type battery pack, a plurality of electric connection terminals are arranged in the battery compartment, at least one electric connection terminal in the plurality of electric connection terminals can be matched with at least one of the first type battery pack and the second type battery pack, and an electric connection joint of the first type battery pack or an electric connection joint of the second type battery pack is electrically connected with the electric connection terminal, so that an energy source is provided for the outdoor garden mower to finish set outdoor operation. This outdoor garden mower, but electric connection terminal adaptation different grade type's battery package has improved outdoor garden mower's suitability.

title_en: Quick inspection device and method for switch of safety detonator
abstract_en: The invention relates to a device and a method for rapidly checking a switch of a safety detonator. The testing device comprises a base, a support, rolling bearings, a detection bedplate, a compression spring, a cover plate clamping ring, a cover plate, a long screw rod, a support, a clamping ring, a detected switch, a locking mechanism and a signal feedback circuit, wherein the support is fixedly connected with the base, the rolling bearings are arranged at the other end of the support, the rolling bearings are fixed with the matching surface of the detection bedplate by interference fit, the long screw rod is matched with a nut to sequentially fix a gasket, the cover plate, the clamping ring, the compression spring and the detection bedplate, the long screw rod is sequentially fixed with the cover plate, the clamping ring of the cover plate, the compression spring and the detection bedplate, the detected switch is fixed on the switch support, the locking mechanism is arranged at one side of the detected switch with the locator, and the signal feedback circuit is connected according to the required point position of the switch, and the LED and the buzzer are used as signal feedback. The invention has the advantages of simplifying the manual detection difficulty and strength, and improving the efficiency and the detection precision.

title_en: Rice sounding fertilizer distributor with intelligent metering function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rice sounding fertilizer with an intelligent metering function, and belongs to the technical field of fertilizer applicators. The utility model provides a rice sounding fertilizer distributor with intelligence measurement function, includes traction truss and seed manure case, one side of traction truss is provided with the drive chain subassembly, and wherein, traction truss includes cladding and vertical axis support, the below of vertical axis support is provided with the blade disc subassembly, and one side of blade disc subassembly is provided with presses the land wheel. For solving current fertilizer distributor and being mostly once covered the field fertilization in the in-process of automatic fertilization, fertilizer is located Tian Ni's inside more, can lead to the soil nutrition of deep better like this, in case rice root system is too short can not effectually absorb the problem of nutrition, and terminal ball axle design of axostylus axostyle makes it possess multi-angle adjustment ability, can form the fertilization slot when the soil of scarification, and the perpendicular material pipe is with the direct transport of fertilizer to slot bottom, and oblique material pipe then is followed oblique top and is supplied with the cover, forms layering fertilization effect, reduces fertilizer volatilization loss.

title_en: Preparation method of high-wear-resistance high-finger-slip soft coating glove
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a glove with a high wear-resistant high-finger-slip soft coating, which comprises the steps of physically spraying a bio-based organic polymer material on the surface of a glove core coated with impregnated latex, sequentially pre-vulcanizing and vulcanizing at a high temperature, sequentially cleaning with alkali liquor, acid liquor and water, and drying to obtain the glove with the high wear-resistant high-finger-slip soft coating. The invention has the advantages that the production process is simple and reliable, the finger sliding and wear resistance of the coating are greatly improved, the coating is endowed with fine sand surface effect, and the coating has excellent finger sliding, durability and comfort effect in oily environment and dry environment.

title_en: Non-damage air-blowing type automatic picking robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nondestructive air-blowing type automatic picking robot which comprises a walking chassis, a multi-axis mechanical arm, a picking part, a collecting device, a visual identification module and a control system, wherein the picking part comprises a stem cutting device, a stem clamping device and a fruit protecting device, the stem cutting device comprises a vehicle cutting knife, the stem clamping device comprises two stem clamping plates, the fruit protecting device comprises two expandable and closable arc-shaped protective covers, a strawberry cavity used for accommodating strawberry fruits in a closed state and a stem channel positioned above the strawberry cavity are arranged in the arc-shaped protective covers, a plurality of air blowing holes are uniformly distributed on the inner surfaces of the two arc-shaped protective covers, and the air blowing device used for supplying air for the air blowing holes to the strawberry cavity is arranged outside the arc-shaped protective covers.

title_en: Automatic drip irrigation system for green plastic of urban flowers and trees landscape
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automatic drip irrigation system for urban flower and tree landscapes, which comprises flower and tree landscape guardrails, flower and tree landscape pots, a rainwater filtering and refluxing mechanism and a flower and tree drip irrigation mechanism, wherein 4-6 flower and tree landscape pots are equidistantly arranged on the top surface of each flower and tree landscape guardrail, two groups of flower and tree drip irrigation mechanisms are arranged in the inner cavity of each flower and tree landscape guardrail, the rainwater filtering and refluxing mechanisms are arranged on the bottom surfaces of the flower and tree landscape pots, and the tail ends of the rainwater filtering and refluxing mechanisms penetrate through the inner cavity of each flower and tree landscape guardrail (1) to be connected with the flower and tree drip irrigation mechanism. According to the automatic drip irrigation system, rainwater in the flower and tree landscape basin is collected, and flows back to the water tank for storage after being filtered in multiple layers, so that the rainwater can be recycled, dependence on external water sources is reduced, water resources are effectively saved, urban greening water cost is reduced, irrigation parameters can be flexibly adjusted, water demands of different flowers and trees in different growth stages are met, and healthy growth of the flowers and trees is promoted.

title_en: Intelligent watering and fertilizing device for agricultural planting
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent watering and fertilizing device for agricultural planting, which belongs to the field of agricultural planting and comprises a supporting frame, wherein a mounting plate is fixedly connected to the left side of the inner surface of the supporting frame, an intelligent monitoring and controlling device is fixedly arranged on the right side of the mounting plate, a greenhouse body is fixedly arranged on the outer surface of the supporting frame, an electric sliding rail is fixedly connected to the top of the inner surface of the supporting frame, a sliding seat is slidingly connected below the electric sliding rail, a circular pipe is fixedly connected below the sliding seat, a hose is fixedly connected to the lower end of the circular pipe, a pushing seat is fixedly connected to the lower end of the hose, and a pipeline rotary joint is fixedly connected to the lower end of the pushing seat. According to the application, the electric sliding rail is arranged to drive the sliding seat so that the spray head moves back and forth in the greenhouse, and the sliding seat can drive the spray head to integrally rotate in a conical shape to shake when moving, so that the spray head has the functions of being convenient for increasing coverage and improving spraying uniformity.

title_en: 3D printing deformation compensation method for space engine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a 3D printing deformation compensation method of an aerospace engine, which comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a three-dimensional CAD model and generating a printing layer set, S2, obtaining residual stress tensor fields of a current printing layer and a historical printing layer, S3, constructing a stress shadow mapping tensor, S4, inputting the stress shadow mapping tensor and current printing layer parameters into a reverse stress propagation neural network model, outputting a deformation prediction vector field, S5, carrying out geometric compensation processing on a printing layer geometric area according to the deformation prediction vector field, S6, generating a printing code according to the compensated geometric model, S7, carrying out error comparison on an actual deformation vector field and the integral prediction deformation vector field, and if the error information is larger than a preset tolerance threshold, feeding back the error information to the S5, and repeatedly executing the S5 to the S7 until the error vector field does not exceed the tolerance threshold. The invention integrates residual stress modeling and a reverse stress propagation neural network to realize 3D printing deformation compensation of the space engine.

title_en: A prevent wind and fix sand green cultivation equipment that plants for sand land
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of cultivation equipment, in particular to sand-prevention sand-fixation green planting cultivation equipment for sand, which comprises a rack and a bearing platform arranged on the rack and used for bearing a seedling frame, wherein a seedling planting mechanism used for planting seedlings into sandy soil is arranged between the bearing platform and the ground, the seedling loading mechanism comprises a seedling conveying component, a seedling pushing component and an alignment component, the seedling conveying component is used for conveying single seedlings to the seedling pushing component through the seedling frame, the seedlings conveyed to the seedling pushing component are pushed to the alignment component under the pushing of the seedling pushing component and are directed to be aligned and guided into the seedling planting mechanism under the action of the alignment component, the seedlings in the seedling frame are accurately separated and pushed to the alignment component by plants, a notch turntable and a stepping motor of the alignment turntable are controlled in an indexing mode, the seedlings are ensured to be directed to be guided into a seedling planter, blank planting caused by idle running after the seedlings are missed is avoided, and full-process automatic continuous operation of seedling planting is realized.

title_en: Preparation method of melam resin foam
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of melam resin foam, and belongs to the technical field of organic polymers. The invention takes melamine, paraformaldehyde, amino acid solution and sodium hydroxide as main materials of resin, adds specific comonomer to carry out prepolymerization reaction, then adds sodium alkylbenzenesulfonate and amino acid solution, and additionally adds nano particles to carry out repolymerization reaction, then adds mixed auxiliary agents of sodium alkylbenzenesulfonate, n-pentane, formic acid and the like to carry out microwave foaming, thus obtaining the melam resin foam with good mechanical property.

title_en: PPR pipe production line
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of pipe production, and particularly discloses a PPR pipe production line, which comprises a processing equipment main body, wherein a supporting table is arranged at the front end of the processing equipment main body, the processing equipment main body comprises a water removing mechanism, the water removing mechanism is positioned in front of the processing equipment main body and is arranged on the surface of the supporting table, the water removing mechanism comprises a moving table, a water scraping mechanism is arranged at the middle end of the top of the moving table, and water blowing mechanisms are symmetrically arranged at two sides of the front end of the supporting table. The water removing mechanism is integrated on the supporting table, and the high-efficiency removal of water on the surface of the pipe is realized through three-stage treatment processes of adsorption, water scraping and water blowing, and meanwhile, the device can realize the automatic cleaning of the sponge block, prolong the service life and avoid secondary pollution.

title_en: Variable die of precast concrete module and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a variable die of a precast concrete module and a use method thereof, wherein the variable die comprises an outer die surrounding the outer side of the inner die, a bottom die arranged below the inner die and a locking mechanism for locking the outer die; the inner mold comprises a plurality of inner mold modules which can be spliced to form a rectangle, the outer mold comprises a plurality of outer mold templates which can be enclosed to form a rectangle frame, the size of the rectangle frame can be adjusted and adapted based on the size of the rectangle, and the size of the rectangle corresponds to the size of the inner periphery of the precast concrete module. By the variable die and the use method of the prefabricated concrete module, the components with different sizes can be produced through die combination, one set of die can meet the prefabricated production of the concrete modules with various sizes, the configuration quantity of factory dies is reduced, the universality of the die is realized, the die can be used in various projects, and the amortization cost of the die is effectively reduced.

title_en: Sealing block for preventing cracks in pouch-shaped battery case, method of sealing pouch-shaped battery case using the same, and pouch-shaped secondary battery manufactured using the sealing block
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a sealing block for preventing cracks in a pouch-shaped battery case, a method of sealing a pouch-shaped battery case using the sealing block, and a pouch-shaped secondary battery manufactured using the sealing block. The sealing block according to the present invention has an inclined shape so as to minimize the influence on the electrode assembly, particularly, the separator, while performing R-sealing.

title_en: A broken recovery unit for blister quick-witted film waste material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a crushing and recycling device for film waste of a bubble cap machine, which belongs to the technical field of crushing and recycling, wherein crushing rollers which are matched with each other are movably arranged in a crushing bin, racks are arranged on the outer surface of each crushing roller at intervals, a plurality of groups of ejector rods which are positioned between adjacent racks are movably arranged in each crushing roller, a screening mechanism comprises a device frame which is positioned below the crushing mechanism, a screen which rotates while lifting is movably arranged at the top of the device frame, a material returning mechanism comprises a plurality of groups of annular fixed ring frames, a moving ring frame for feeding is movably arranged between the fixed ring frames, a material returning ring groove is arranged on the outer wall of the outermost fixed ring frame, and a material guiding arc plate matched with the crushing bin is arranged at the top of the transfer bin. According to the invention, plastic fragments can be lifted up step by step through the fixed ring frame and the movable ring frame, and are conveyed into the return ring groove. Under the effect of throwing the motor, the piece falls into crushing storehouse again along the guide arc board and smashes the processing once more, and this design has improved the recovery effect.

title_en: Slope runoff interception and infiltration irrigation cooperative mechanism adaptive to terrain
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hydraulic engineering, and discloses a slope runoff interception and infiltration irrigation cooperative mechanism of self-adaptive terrain. The filtering mechanism drives the cylindrical filter cylinder filled with the sponge active carbon to rotate by utilizing gear transmission, dynamically filters intercepted runoffs, can effectively remove sediment, impurities and pollutants, solves the problems of blocking irrigation equipment, affecting soil structures and the like caused by high sediment content of the traditional intercepted runoffs, ensures stable operation of an irrigation system and crop growth environment, organically links the three functional modules of runoff interception, filtration and irrigation by a power sharing mechanism of a driving motor, and synchronously drives a runoff blocking water plate to intercept the runoffs, dynamically filters the sediment and periodically deflects an irrigation head by the filter cylinder by the driving motor, does not need an independent power source and reduces energy consumption.

title_en: Probiotics pellet and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a probiotic pellet and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of microorganisms. The invention provides a probiotic pellet which comprises a pellet core and a coating layer coated outside the pellet core, wherein the pellet core comprises, by mass, 10-55 parts of probiotic powder and 5-30 parts of fruit powder, the coating layer comprises liquid grease, the addition amount of the liquid grease is 30-50% of the mass of the pellet core, and the liquid grease comprises one or more than two of hydrogenated vegetable oil, animal grease, cream, butter, monoglyceride stearate, diglyceride stearate, cocoa butter and cocoa liquid. The probiotic micro-pellets provided by the invention are prepared from the probiotic powder by adopting liquid grease with heating dissolution and cooling, namely solidification characteristics, so that physical isolation of outside air and moisture is formed structurally, and the stability of the viable count can be ensured during the subsequent independent storage or application of products.

title_en: Tung oil-based polyurethane film with bright structural color and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of high polymer materials, and particularly discloses a tung oil-based polyurethane film with a bright structural color and a preparation method thereof. The polyurethane film takes monodisperse spherical silica, olefin-based blocked tung oil-based aqueous polyurethane emulsion, carbon black and ultraviolet initiator as main raw materials, and a network structure formed by long aliphatic side chain crosslinking of the olefin-based blocked tung oil-based aqueous polyurethane emulsion is more beneficial to self-assembly of the monodisperse spherical silica, and meanwhile, the long aliphatic side chain crosslinking also endows the structural color polyurethane film with excellent hydrophobicity and tensile strength.

title_en: High-efficiency floating breakwater combining aquaculture and artificial downflow
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-efficiency floating breakwater combining aquaculture and artificial downflow, which comprises a plurality of floating breakwater units, wherein the floating breakwater units are mutually connected through lock hooks and are arranged in parallel with a wave crest line, each floating breakwater unit comprises a rectangular buoyancy tank, a truss structure, a wave baffle, a cultivation net box, a flexible downflow bent pipe, a curtain channel formed by curtains and a limiting weight, the two opposite sides of the rectangular buoyancy tank are connected with the truss structure, the wave baffle is arranged at the end part, far away from the rectangular buoyancy tank, of the truss structure, the cultivation net box is arranged between the wave baffle and the rectangular buoyancy tank on the truss structure, the bottoms of the cultivation net boxes are connected with the curtain channel, the curtains and the downflow bent pipes are mutually connected through the limiting weight, and the truss structure is connected with an anchoring system. The invention converts wave energy into kinetic energy of artificial downward flow, forms upward plumes through the artificial downward flow, transmits the eutrophication substances in the deep water area into the aquaculture net cage, and has good wave eliminating effect on medium-long period waves.

title_en: Cellulose nanocrystal-reinforced solvent-responsive double-layer hydrogel actuator and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a solvent-response double-layer hydrogel actuator reinforced by cellulose nanocrystals, and a preparation method and application thereof, and is characterized in that the preparation raw materials of a first hydrogel layer and a second hydrogel layer are acrylamide monomers, cellulose nanocrystal suspension, a cross-linking agent and a photoinitiator; the concentration of the cellulose nanocrystal suspension used by the first hydrogel layer is 1-6wt% and the concentration of the cellulose nanocrystal suspension used by the second hydrogel layer is 0.5wt%; according to the preparation method, cellulose nanocrystals with different contents are added into the double-layer hydrogel, and the double-layer hydrogel structure with a heterostructure is realized by ultraviolet polymerization.

title_en: Lipu taro pest control method and pesticide spraying equipment
abstract_en: A method for preventing and eliminating the pests of Lipu taro includes such steps as primary ploughing the planting field, exposing the soil to sunlight for 15-20 days, secondary ploughing, applying farmyard manure and plant ash, digging slot at the edge of planting field, creating water tank around planting field, sterilizing water, preparing liquid medicine with metalaxyl or carbendazim, immersing the seed taro in it for 15-30 min, sterilizing, air drying, preparing liquid medicine with dimethomorph, cymoxanil or fluopicolide, spraying liquid medicine for 7-10 days, continuously spraying 2-3 times, and root irrigation with hymexazol or metalaxyl-Mn-Zn for 200-300 ml each plant. Compared with the prior art, the invention prevents the epidemic disease from being repeated and improves the control effect of the epidemic disease.

title_en: Ecological breeding device suitable for aquatic firefly breeding and ornamental
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological breeding device suitable for aquatic firefly breeding and ornamental, and relates to the technical field of ecological breeding, comprising an outer shell, wherein an appliance top cover is arranged at the top of the outer shell in parallel, two sides of the appliance top cover are connected with the top of the outer shell by adopting a spring lock catch assembly, and a gap for ventilation is arranged between the outer shell and the appliance top cover; the outer shell is formed by splicing an upper layer assembly, a middle layer assembly and a bottom layer assembly from bottom to top through locking bolts, and positioning rings for limiting are arranged between the upper layer assembly and the middle layer assembly and between the middle layer assembly and the bottom layer assembly. The ecological breeding device suitable for aquatic firefly breeding and ornamental is suitable for full life cycle intensive breeding of eggs, larvae, pupae and adults. The device realizes stable water quality, micro-environment optimization and efficient cleaning through passive temperature control, ecological simulation and physical separation technology.

title_en: Warmhouse booth with temperature self-adaptation regulation and control
abstract_en: The invention discloses a greenhouse with temperature self-adaptive regulation and control, which relates to the technical field of greenhouses, and comprises a greenhouse body, wherein a sunlight regulation structure, a temperature balance structure, a temperature equalizing structure and a temperature sensing feedback structure are arranged in the greenhouse body, the sunlight regulation structure comprises a plurality of rotating rods which are regularly arranged, the temperature balance structure comprises a plurality of circulating main pipes and a plurality of circulating auxiliary pipes, the temperature equalizing structure comprises a plurality of uniform Wen Waiguan, and the air sent by a fan main body flows out from different positions of a uniform temperature outer pipe sequentially by matching with a fan structure and the uniform Wen Waiguan through the arrangement of push rod structure, the floating rod structure and water in the uniform temperature inner pipe in the uniform temperature structure, so that the air sent by the fan main body is uniformly sent to different positions in the greenhouse body, and the problem that the temperature difference between the edge of the greenhouse close to a ventilation system and the center of the greenhouse far away from the ventilation system is large, and the temperature in the greenhouse is difficult to realize relatively accurate control of the temperature in the greenhouse is solved.

title_en: Stropharia rugoso-annulata cultivation medium prepared from highland barley straw and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of agricultural cultivation, in particular to a stropharia rugoso-annulata cultivation substrate prepared from highland barley straw and a preparation method thereof. According to the modified bentonite disclosed by the invention, phenolic substances are adsorbed, the boric acid groups on the surface of the modified beta-cyclodextrin and the ortho-diphenol hydroxyl groups form covalent bonds, double locking is carried out on the modified beta-cyclodextrin, and the modified beta-cyclodextrin is wrapped by a cavity, so that the phenolic substances are prevented from being decomposed at high temperature. The potassium dihydrogen phosphate forms a phosphate buffer system in the initial silk-yielding stage, resists acidification in the initial hypha metabolism stage, and inhibits hydrolysis of boric acid ester bonds. As phosphate radical is consumed by the acid production of hypha metabolism, the buffer capacity of potassium dihydrogen phosphate is ineffective, the pH value naturally drops from the later wire producing stage to the primordial stage, the boric acid ester bond is hydrolyzed, the water repellency of cetyl trimethyl ammonium bromide is weakened, and the cetyl trimethyl ammonium bromide and the potassium dihydrogen phosphate cooperatively release phenolic substances.

title_en: Preparation method and application of black high-light-transmittance resin composite board
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method and application of a black high-light-transmittance resin composite board, and belongs to the technical field of advertisement materials. The resin is formed by compounding a black light-transmitting layer, a light guide layer and a diffusion layer, wherein the high-permeability layer is formed by adopting carboxylated carbon nanotubes to be subjected to silane coupling agent modification and then to be polymerized with methyl methacrylate monomers and arranged in a magnetic field orientation mode, so that high light transmittance and pure black appearance are realized, the light guide layer is formed by taking polycarbonate as a matrix, adding SiO  2  microspheres, and improving light transverse propagation efficiency through hot press molding, the diffusion layer is formed by taking polymethyl methacrylate as a matrix, adding ZnO nano particles, and processing a periodic microprism structure on the surface, so that light is uniformly diffused. When the light box is applied to a light box, the light source is turned off to present a pure black appearance, when the lamp is opened, the lamp has high light transmittance and no variegated color, is suitable for a high-end advertisement display screen and (5) scenes such as a vehicle-mounted lamp box.

title_en: Laser measuring instrument for natural resource planning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a laser measuring instrument for natural resource planning, which relates to the technical field of laser measuring instruments and comprises a laser measuring instrument body, an insect expelling assembly arranged at the periphery of the laser measuring instrument body, when the laser measuring instrument body starts to work, a micro motor synchronously started with the laser measuring instrument body starts to operate, the micro motor drives a rotating gear to rotate through an output shaft, the rotating gear further drives a plurality of gear teeth meshed with the rotating gear to rotate, the gear teeth further drive rotating fan blades to rotate at a high speed in an inner cavity of a mounting shell, the rotating fan blades rotate to generate air flow, the air flow sequentially passes through a ventilation opening and a rotating assembly and finally flows out from an air outlet, the air flow after flowing out flows along an inner chamfer of the mounting shell, and a surrounding fan cover is formed around a lens of the laser measuring instrument body, and can expel phototactic insects by virtue of continuous air flow, so that the phototactic insects are prevented from entering a transmitting or receiving path of laser beams.

title_en: Tissue culture method for radix tetrastigme
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of tissue culture, and particularly relates to a tissue culture method of radix tetrastigme, which comprises the following steps of dipping a rooting agent at a stem bud lower cut of a cluster stem, then cutting the cluster stem into a seedling culture substrate for culture, wherein each liter of the rooting agent contains 10-15 mg of alpha-naphthylacetic acid and 1-2 mg of thiamine pyrophosphate, the seedling culture substrate contains 0.5-0.6 g/kg of activated carbon-loaded iron nitrogen co-doped nano TiO  2  powder catalyst, the method plays a remarkable positive role in micro-cutting out of a bottle of the tissue culture stem, and the rooting agent mixed by the alpha-naphthylacetic acid and the thiamine pyrophosphate is dipped during cutting, so that the rooting promotion effect and the obvious rooting promotion effect are realized.

title_en: Extrusion die head and extrusion system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an extrusion die (100), in particular a pipe extrusion die, for producing hollow plastic profiles, in particular plastic pipes, comprising at least one melt channel (102) and a nozzle and/or a nozzle group, the at least one melt channel (102) extending between a melt inlet (104) and a melt outlet (106), wherein the melt outlet (106) is designed such that a plastic melt and/or the produced hollow plastic profile is transferred to the nozzle and/or the nozzle group. Wherein at least part of the melt channel (102) is mounted and/or movable substantially floatingly. The invention also relates to an extrusion system comprising at least one extruder and an extrusion die (100).

title_en: Apparatus and method for manufacturing green tyre
abstract_en: The invention relates to an apparatus (10) for manufacturing a green tyre, comprising a rotatable and movable drum (16) for manufacturing a green tyre, a platform (21) arranged upstream of the drum (16) and comprising a flat surface (21 a), at least one robot arm (18), an ECU (40) and at least one first 3D camera, the flat surface (21 a) being for receiving one end portion of an elastomeric element, the robot arm (18) being configured to clamp the end portion of the elastomeric element from above and comprising at least three rows of elements made of a magnetic material, the ECU (40) being configured to control the robot arm (18), the first 3D camera being configured to acquire an image of the end portion of the elastomeric element on the platform (21).

title_en: Mobile material-increasing remanufacturing system for water turbine unit overcurrent component
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mobile additive remanufacturing system for an overcurrent component of a water turbine unit, which relates to the technical field of monitoring of water turbine units and comprises a multi-angle imaging module, an image preprocessing module, a multi-feature data acquisition module, a part health scoring module, a quality judging module and an alarming and recording module, wherein a serious fault threshold value is set And early warning threshold The invention realizes intelligent grading judgment of the states of the parts, and automatically triggers an audible and visual alarm or remote push to prompt timely maintenance or replacement when abnormality is found. The quality judging module is linked with the health scoring module, so that timeliness and accuracy of fault identification are promoted, alarm response time is shortened by more than 90%, and sudden fault risks caused by missed detection and misjudgment in the traditional method are avoided.

title_en: Streptomyces sp.Zm3-3, microbial agent and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses Streptomyces sp.Zm3-3, a microbial agent and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of microorganisms. The Streptomyces sp.Zm3-3 strain obtained by separation and screening from corn leaves can antagonize the hypha growth of corn helminth and Curvularia lunata. The indoor potted plant and field control effect measurement results show that the control effect of the Zm3-3 microbial inoculum on corn small spot disease and corn curvularia leaf spot disease is more than 70 percent and the control effect on corn rust disease is more than 60 percent. Zm3-3 microbial inoculum and fermentation filtrate thereof can digest mycelium of maize helminth and Curvularia lunata and inhibit germination of pathogenic bacteria conidia. The biocontrol microbial inoculum prepared by the strain can replace or reduce the use of chemical pesticides, accords with the new concept of green plant protection development, is beneficial to guaranteeing food and ecological safety, and has better economic and social benefits.

title_en: Irrigation equipment for tomato planting
abstract_en: The invention discloses an irrigation device for tomato planting, which relates to the technical field of irrigation devices and comprises a double-pass pipeline mechanism, wherein the double-pass pipeline mechanism consists of a double-pass pipeline and a separation sheet in the double-pass pipeline, the double-pass pipeline is separated into two groups of circulating cavities under the action of the separation sheet, the two groups of circulating cavities are used for conveying two different liquid media, a plurality of groups of joint mechanisms are connected to the double-pass pipeline at intervals, each group of joint mechanism is communicated with two groups of drip irrigation mechanisms, and the joint mechanism consists of a joint connecting pipe, a split flow baffle and a fastening cap, and the split flow baffle is positioned in the joint connecting pipe. The invention adopts the double-way pipeline mechanism, the pipeline is divided into two groups of circulating cavities through the separating sheets, two different liquid media such as water, nutrient solution and the like can be simultaneously conveyed, a plurality of groups of pipelines are not required to be additionally paved, the pipeline paving cost is reduced by 50%, meanwhile, the switching time of the traditional single-pipe single-medium irrigation is avoided, and the irrigation efficiency is improved by more than 30%.

title_en: Novel high-distribution meshed rotor of internal mixer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel high-distribution meshed type rotor of an internal mixer, which particularly relates to the technical field of internal mixers, and comprises a rotor body, a long edge, a first short edge and a second short edge, wherein the phase position of the first short edge relative to the long edge is 180 degrees, the phase position of the second short edge relative to the long edge is 270 degrees, the sections of the long edge, the first short edge and the second short edge respectively comprise edge top surfaces, edge windward rubber surfaces and edge gum surfaces, the width of the edge top surfaces is 0.08 of the outer diameter of the rotor body, and the angle of the edge windward rubber surfaces is 68 degrees. According to the invention, through the spiral distribution of the long edges, the first short edges and the second short edges and the specific phase difference design, materials can flow along a complex path between the rotors to form a multidirectional shearing field, so that material aggregation is effectively broken, materials can be more uniformly mixed in the banburying process, the mixing effect is obviously improved, and the product quality problem caused by uneven mixing is reduced.

title_en: Back polar plate film coating device and film coating method of electret microphone
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of microphones, and relates to a back polar plate film coating device and a film coating method of an electret microphone, wherein the back polar plate film coating device comprises a film tensioning ring, a film fixing ring and a film fixing ring, wherein the film tensioning ring is used for continuously fixing an electret film with certain tension; the electret film hot-pressing device comprises a film tensioning ring, a rear polar plate jig, a lifting table, a hot-pressing component and an electret film hot-pressing component, wherein the film tensioning ring is arranged on the lower side of the electret film, the rear polar plate jig is arranged below the film tensioning ring and used for installing a rear polar plate, the lifting table is arranged below the rear polar plate jig and used for bearing the rear polar plate jig and controlling the rear polar plate jig to lift, the maximum height of the rear polar plate jig is higher than the plane where the electret film is fixed by the film tensioning ring, and the hot-pressing component is arranged above the film tensioning ring and used for implementing hot pressing to cover the electret film on the rear polar plate. According to the invention, the electret film is fixed through the film tensioning ring, and is continuously fixed under a certain tension, so that the film coating tension is ensured, and the adverse effect of high-temperature hot pressing on the film coating effect is reduced.

title_en: Multistage transfer device for poultry processing and operation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of poultry transportation, and discloses a multistage transportation device for poultry processing and an operation method thereof, which comprises a base, wherein a movable plate is fixed at the bottom of an electric telescopic column, second toothed plates are symmetrically fixed on two sides of the lower end face of the moving plate, and a cleaning mechanism and a flushing mechanism are fixed on one side of the upper end face of the base. This multistage transfer device that poultry processing was used, the carousel anticlockwise rotates, and the carousel is rotatory 60 degrees at every turn, conveniently transport, every dwell position has corresponding processing procedure, convenient orderly completion material loading, unhairing, dissect the viscera, the unloading is cut into pieces, the washing and the washing operation of tray, make whole processing operation more continuous high-efficient, after the tray after will using is transported the top of liquid reserve tank, movable plate and two second pinion racks move down, the tray is 180 degrees upset earlier and descends again, when the washing liquid is spouted upwards to first orifice, spray liquid passageway and cleaning brush are rotatory wholly, convenient clean tray comprehensively.

title_en: Soil fixing device for navel orange sloping field cultivation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of soil fixation for hillside cultivation, in particular to a soil fixation device for hillside cultivation of navel oranges, which comprises an annular frame and the like; the symmetrical rigid coupling of annular frame top surface has the guide frame, and sliding connection has the ring pipe in the guide frame, and the ring pipe passes through the drive piece drive and realizes reciprocating, and the opening has all been seted up to one side of ring frame and ring pipe, and the opening department symmetry of ring pipe is provided with the inserted bar, and the inserted bar passes through universal ball and ring union coupling, and the inserted bar runs through the ring frame, and is provided with the movable groove that supplies the inserted bar activity on the ring frame, and ring pipe and inserted bar are cavity type. The device is provided with the heat conducting wires, the phase change materials, the heat conducting blocks and other parts, can realize the omnibearing protection of navel orange root systems under different seasons and extreme weather conditions, and simultaneously can promote the deep binding of main roots and the intensive growth of side roots in a proper temperature environment, so that surrounding soil is tightly solidified, looseness among soil particles is reduced, and a mechanism of 'mechanical-biological synergistic soil fixation' is formed with a soil fixing device.

title_en: Vietnam rose bacteria for promoting porphyra haitanensis filiform algae filaments to develop aschersonia aleyrodis branches
abstract_en: The invention provides Vietnam rose bacteria for promoting Porphyra haitanensis filiform algae filaments to develop aschersonia haitanensis, and the provided strain can promote the formation of Porphyra haitanensis filiform aschersonia haitanensis, so as to shorten the breeding period of Porphyra haitanensis filiform. The preservation number of the Vietnam rose bacteria provided by the invention is CGMCC NO.34643. The invention can effectively shorten the development time of aschersonia aleyrodis and improve the formation rate of aschersonia aleyrodis by adding the strain bacterial solution of the screened Vietnam rose bacteria into the solution for culturing the filiform body, thereby relieving the problems of insufficient formation rate of aschersonia aleyrodis, overlong formation period and the like.

title_en: Underwater explosion cutting system assisted by underwater vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underwater explosion cutting system assisted by an underwater vehicle, which relates to the technical field of ocean engineering and underwater equipment, and comprises an AUV carrying platform, an annular cutter module, an intelligent control system and a pipeline; the AUV carrying platform is used for carrying an intelligent control system and installing the annular cutter module on the pipeline, the annular cutter module is connected with the intelligent control system through signals, and the intelligent control system is used for controlling the annular cutter module to detonate. The invention solves the problems of efficiency, precision and environmental adaptability of the traditional underwater cutting technology by combining a heavy AUV carrying platform with modularized design, high-precision navigation, multi-mode detection and intelligent control technology and an innovative adjustable diameter annular cutter. The self-adaptive locking mechanism is used for realizing rapid and accurate adjustment, the V-shaped unit body charging structure is used for improving the energy collecting effect and reducing the charging quantity, and the triple safety interlocking mechanism and the shock wave buffer design are used for ensuring the operation safety.

title_en: Cyperus esculentus harvester and harvesting method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cyperus esculentus harvester and a harvesting method thereof, and relates to the technical field of cyperus esculentus harvesters. The invention comprises a frame, wherein a supporting table is arranged on one side of the frame, a plurality of connecting frames are fixedly connected between the frame and the supporting table, a crushing assembly is arranged on the supporting table, so that soil is crushed, the cyperus esculentus is turned out of the soil, a feeding mechanism is arranged at one end of the frame, which is close to the supporting table, so that the crushed soil mixed with the cyperus esculentus is conveyed, meanwhile, the massive soil is further crushed, the subsequent screening is facilitated, a screening impurity removing structure is arranged on the inner side of the frame, the screening impurity removing structure is matched with a discharge hole of the feeding mechanism, the crushed soil is conveniently subjected to multi-stage screening, the cyperus esculentus is screened out of the soil, and the impurity with lighter weight such as grass branches and the like mixed in the cyperus esculentus is removed, so that the impurity removing effect of the cyperus esculentus is effectively improved, and the recovery of the cyperus esculentus is facilitated.

title_en: Augmented reality (XR) -based ultra-realistic combat training method and system using a real gun with an XR controller mounted thereon
abstract_en: A super realistic combat training method based on augmented reality (XR) using a real gun with an XR controller is characterized by the steps of a server providing service transmitting XR content to a splitter of the XR environment, the splitter transmitting the XR content to a projector of the XR environment whereby the plurality of projectors project the XR content to the XR environment, a sensor of the XR environment grasping the locations of the plurality of XR controllers and transmitting the locations of the plurality of XR controllers to the server providing service, the server providing service receiving interaction of the XR controllers with the real gun from the plurality of XR controllers, the server providing service modifying the XR content based on the interaction of the plurality of XR controllers with the real gun and the locations of the plurality of XR controllers and transmitting the modified XR content to the splitter of the XR environment, and transmitting the XR content received by the splitter of the XR environment to the projector whereby the plurality of projectors project the modified XR content to the projector, the projector having the XR controller of the XR environment interacting with the real gun, the receiver of the XR controller being replaced by at least one of the receiver.

title_en: Selenium-enriched Chinese herbal medicine pill for strengthening body resistance and banking up primordial qi and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of selenium-enriched solid-based primordial qi-strengthening Chinese herbal medicine pills, which belongs to the technical field of nutrition enhancement. According to the preparation method of the selenium-enriched and healthy-energy-strengthening Chinese herbal medicine pill, the selenium content in the prepared polygonum multiflorum, astragalus membranaceus and nutgrass flatsedge is increased in a selenium biological strengthening planting mode, and then the protein and polysaccharide in the enzymolysis product are degraded into small molecular peptides and oligosaccharides through complex enzyme hydrolysis and twice fermentation, so that the selenium-enriched and healthy-energy-strengthening Chinese herbal medicine pill is beneficial to human body absorption. Finally, the selenium utilization may be further enhanced by calcining the clam shell and mixing it with the fermentation broth. The whole process is simple and feasible, the operation is convenient, the production cost is low, and the method is suitable for industrialized mass production.

title_en: But tire vulcanizer of quick replacement capsule
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tire vulcanizing device capable of rapidly replacing capsules, which belongs to the technical field of tire molds and comprises a lower clamping assembly and a ring seat, wherein the lower clamping assembly comprises a lower clamping ring and a lower steel ring, the lower steel ring is fixedly connected with the ring seat, the lower side surface of the lower clamping ring is provided with a tightening ring, the tightening ring comprises an axial extension part and a radial extension part, the axial extension part is fixedly connected with the lower side surface of the lower clamping ring, the radial extension part is fixedly arranged at the lower end of the axial extension part, the ring seat is provided with a guide hole, a pull rod is arranged in the guide hole, the upper end of the pull rod is provided with a limiting part, the limiting part is positioned between the radial extension part and the lower side surface of the lower clamping ring, when a capsule is disassembled, the pull rod passes through a guide sleeve, the guide part of the pull rod is matched with a guide groove of the guide sleeve, the pull rod firstly ascends along the axial direction and then ascends, the lower clamping ring ascends to release the capsule, and then the limiting part rotates to a unlocking position, the capsule assembling process is opposite to the disassembling operation, the capsule and rapid disassembly and the lower clamping ring is realized, and the replacement efficiency is improved.

title_en: Dynamic cooperative regulation system and control method for mold locking force of multi-component injection molding machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic collaborative adjustment system and a control method for clamping force of a multi-component injection molding machine, wherein the adjustment system comprises a movable template, a fixed template and four tie bars connected between the movable template and the fixed template, one ends of the four tie bars are respectively connected with an adjustment piece for adjusting the tie bars, a distributed sensor unit comprises strain sensors respectively arranged on the surfaces of the four tie bars and used for monitoring tensile deformation of the tie bars in real time and converting the deformation into clamping force values, an intelligent execution mechanism comprises a die adjusting servo motor respectively arranged on the adjustment pieces of the four tie bars and used for driving the adjustment piece to rotate so as to adjust pretightening force of the tie bars, the adjustment precision can reach +/-0.01 mm, and a central controller is in signal connection with the distributed sensor unit and the intelligent execution mechanism and used for receiving signals of the strain sensors and controlling the intelligent execution mechanism to perform collaborative adjustment on the clamping force of the four tie bars.

title_en: Sailing boat for fish farming in open sea or ocean
abstract_en: The invention relates to a four-body sailboat (1) for fish farming in open or ocean sea areas, comprising at least one base structure (2), at least one seine (5), at least one driving and accommodation (3), at least one sail system (4) and at least one storage silo (6), all of which are modular and/or removable. According to the invention, the at least one foundation structure (2) comprises at least two main floats (7) which are parallel to each other and spaced apart and are connected or fastened to each other by means of at least one arm (8), and at least two secondary floats (9) adjacent to each of the at least two main floats (7), the secondary floats having a circumference which is smaller than the circumference of the at least two main floats (7), and the two secondary floats being arranged parallel to each outboard side and at a distance from the at least two main floats.

title_en: Liposome nano-carrier system for delivering decadienoic acid and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a liposome nano-carrier system for delivering decadienoic acid, and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of nano pesticides. The system of the invention comprises a decadienoic acid active ingredient and a liposome structure containing thioketal bonds.
