The carrier has response capability to reactive oxygen species signals induced by plant rhizosphere pathogenic bacteria infection, and when the ROS level is increased, thioketal bonds in lipid bodies are broken, so that the entrapped DDA is triggered to be selectively released, and the release efficiency and the control effect of the carrier at the pathogenic occurrence position are effectively improved. The method enhances the penetration capability of the liposome in plant leaves or root tissues, enables the active ingredient DDA to be delivered to target sites more efficiently, and simultaneously ensures that the nano-sized particle size of the liposome endows the liposome with good tissue affinity and adhesion capability, and improves the leaf surface deposition rate and systemic control effect.

title_en: Zanthoxylum bungeanum winnowing auxiliary heat drying and seed removing device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hot drying and seed removing device assisted by winnowing of pricklyash peel and a method thereof, comprising a collecting barrel, wherein a sieve barrel is coaxially arranged in the collecting barrel, a first end of the sieve barrel is connected with a power device, a second end of the sieve barrel is connected with a drying box, a drying device is connected below the drying box, a feeding device is connected above the drying box, the feeding device comprises a feeding pipe, winnowing devices and pricklyash peel shell discharge holes I are oppositely arranged on two sides of the feeding pipe, a plurality of sieve holes are uniformly distributed on the sieve barrel, the size of the sieve holes is larger than that of pricklyash peel seeds and smaller than that of pricklyash peel shells, and pricklyash peel seed discharge holes and pricklyash peel shell discharge holes II are formed in the bottom of the collecting barrel. According to the invention, through the combination of the mechanical structure and hot air drying, the moisture in the pepper shells is evaporated, so that the combination of the pepper shells and the pepper seeds is loosened, the seeds are naturally spitted, the pepper shells and the pepper seeds are separated by utilizing the roller screen, and the rapid and low-loss separation of the pepper shells and the seeds is realized.

title_en: Device and method for improving finless eel breeding survival rate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for improving the culture survival rate of finless eels, which relate to the technical field of aquaculture equipment, and the method comprises water quality management measures, temperature regulation and control measures, a culture system, a sewage treatment system, a water storage system, stress period management measures, a feeding strategy, a throwing density and a disease prevention strategy, and the accurate management of key water quality indexes and the stable regulation of air temperature and water temperature are realized by combining the water quality regulation and control strategy with the automatic temperature control strategy through the cooperative operation of the culture system, the sewage treatment system and the water storage system, so that the water body replacement is completed rapidly and efficiently, and the disease problem caused by overlarge temperature difference is effectively avoided; on the basis, the method is matched with stress period management, scientific feeding strategies, reasonable feeding density and systematic disease prevention measures, improves the habitat environment of finless eels from the fundamental aspect, enhances the physical health of the finless eels, and finally realizes effective improvement of the survival rate of cultivation.

title_en: Pressure-bearing type oxygenation filter vat for aquaculture
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of aquaculture equipment, and relates to a pressure-bearing oxygenation filter vat for aquaculture circulating water, which comprises a pressure-bearing sealing vat body, a Venturi ejector, a bag filter, a pressure cylinder and a water return pipeline system. The functions of oxygenation, filtration and biological purification are realized through an integrated design, and the problems of low integration level, easy blockage, high energy consumption and poor adaptability of the traditional RAS system are solved by utilizing the negative pressure oxygenation of the Venturi ejector, the gradient pore self-cleaning of the filter bag body and the secondary mixing of air gathered by the pressure cylinder. The invention is suitable for high-density circulating water culture and has the advantages of energy conservation, simple and convenient maintenance and stable operation.

title_en: Raising method for improving growth speed of longlin cattle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a raising method for raising the growth rate of longlin cattle, which relates to the technical field of raising, and comprises the steps of breeding cattle based on pre-acquired cattle files to obtain improved calves, feeding colostrum within one hour after the birth of the improved calves, periodically detecting health of the improved calves, dynamically adjusting a feed formula based on detection data, continuously raising till the improved calves are full of six months of age to obtain improved bred cattle, monitoring the regular growth state of the improved bred cattle, dynamically adjusting a raising scheme according to monitoring data, continuously raising till the improved bred cattle are full of eighteen months of age to obtain improved fattening cattle, periodically measuring feed consumption of the improved fattening cattle, continuously raising till the improved bred calves are full of twenty-four months of age based on measurement data to obtain improved calves. The invention improves the growth speed of the longlin cattle through a dynamically adjusted feeding scheme.

title_en: Laser energy source fault detection in additive manufacturing systems and methods
abstract_en: A method for registering one or more laser energy pixels on a build surface with at least one laser energy source of a plurality of laser energy sources and/or determining an operational state of the at least one laser energy source is described. In some embodiments, the photosensitive detector may capture at least one image of the build surface having one or more laser energy pixels formed thereon. The reference frame of the photosensitive detector may be registered with the reference frame of the one or more laser energy pixels based at least in part on the identified location of the one or more laser energy pixels within the at least one image. This may include using the characteristic spatial frequency of the laser energy pixels within at least one image. In some embodiments, at least one image including the fused pattern of the formed part may be compared to an expected fused pattern to determine an operational state of at least one laser energy source during operation.

title_en: Grouting device and grouting process for prefabricated assembly type component
abstract_en: The invention discloses a prefabricated assembly type component grouting device and a grouting process, which belong to the technical field of grouting devices and comprise a bottom frame, wherein the top end of the bottom frame is fixedly connected with a hopper and a conveying pipe, a stirring device is arranged in the hopper and comprises a hack lever, the top end of the inner wall of the hack lever is rotationally connected with a first shaft lever, the outer surface of a fixed ring is fixedly connected with a plurality of inclined bending stirring blades, and a lifting frame slides on the inner wall of the hopper. According to the stirring device, the first shaft rod can be driven to rotate through the operation servo motor, grouting materials inside the hopper are stirred through the stirring blades on the outer surface of the first shaft rod, the lifting frame moves up and down in the hopper, the grouting materials attached to the inner wall of the hopper are scraped to participate in stirring, meanwhile, water inside the water box is sprayed into the grouting materials through the spray head, and the phenomenon that the grouting materials inside the hopper solidify in advance after being placed for a period of time is avoided as much as possible.

title_en: Anion exchange membrane and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an anion exchange membrane and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the field of functional membrane materials. The invention provides a preparation method of an anion exchange membrane, which comprises the following steps of 1) dissolving polyketone resin in an ethyl acetate-ethanol-water ternary mixed solvent to form a polyketone solution, 2) carrying out Paal-Knorr reaction on the polyketone solution and diamine under the action of a catalyst to obtain a precursor solution, and then removing the catalyst to obtain a casting solution, namely adding the catalyst and a specific diamine into the polyketone solution for reaction, wherein the catalyst is a triethylamine or toluenesulfonic acid-montmorillonite composite catalyst, 3) casting the casting solution to form the polyketone membrane, and 4) carrying out specific treatment on the polyketone membrane to obtain the anion exchange membrane. The anion exchange membrane prepared by the invention has higher conductivity and better mechanical property.

title_en: Equipment for controlling plant diseases and insect pests for forestry seedling raising and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses equipment for controlling plant diseases and insect pests for forestry seedling cultivation and a using method thereof, and relates to the technical field of plant diseases and insect pests controlling equipment, the equipment comprises a medicament storage box, wherein an electric control bin is fixedly connected to the top of the medicament storage box, and the beneficial effects of the invention are that: the invention is provided with the driving moving mechanism, the wind-force insect expelling mechanism and the auxiliary insect expelling mechanism, the temperature and humidity sensor monitors temperature and humidity data of a nursery environment, the infrared sensor detects insect pest activity, when the operation position needs to be changed, the first driving motor drives the moving wheel to rotate through the worm gear reducer to drive equipment to move towards a target area, the spring and the damping damper are matched for use, so that the vibration in advancing is effectively relieved, the internal precise element is protected, the heating block appropriately heats the medicament to improve the activity, the treated medicament is sprayed onto nursery stocks through the discharge pipeline, the control efficiency and the environmental adaptability are improved, the use of chemical pesticides is reduced, and reliable control and guarantee for the plant diseases and insect pests is provided for forestry seedling cultivation.

title_en: Carbon fiber reinforced ultrahigh temperature resistant liquid crystal polymer composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a carbon fiber reinforced ultra-high temperature resistant liquid crystal polymer composite material and a preparation method thereof. Aiming at the problems of uneven impregnation, serious thermal degradation and the like existing in the preparation of a continuous carbon fiber reinforced Liquid Crystal Polymer (LCP) composite material by a traditional melting method, the invention adopts four key processes that carbon fibers and LCP fibers are woven into cloth in a blending way to create uniform impregnation channels; grinding LCP into micropowder under freezing condition to avoid thermal plasticization, preparing prepreg in solvent at normal temperature by slurry method, and shaping by stage hot pressing. The process remarkably improves the binding force of the carbon fiber between the liquid crystal polymers. The composite material disclosed by the invention is suitable for the fields of aerospace high-temperature parts and 5G electronic packaging, and has high cost effectiveness and industrialization potential.

title_en: Vacuum sole forming machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to a vacuum sole forming machine, which relates to the technical field of plastic forming and comprises a frame, an upper vacuum device, an upper conveying lifting device, an upper pressure device, a traction device, a lower conveying lifting device, a lower vacuum device, a lower pressure device and a plurality of filling devices, wherein the frame is provided with a forming top plate, a forming middle plate and a forming bottom plate from top to bottom, the upper pressure device points to the forming middle plate, the lower pressure device points to the forming bottom plate, the upper vacuum device is arranged on the frame in a lifting manner, the upper conveying lifting device is hung on the lower side of the upper vacuum device, the lower vacuum device is arranged on the frame in a lifting manner, the lower conveying lifting device is hung on the lower side of the lower vacuum device, the traction device is arranged on the side edge of the frame in a lifting manner, each filling device is respectively arranged in the upper vacuum device and the lower vacuum device, the inside each filling device respectively passes through the corresponding upper vacuum device and the lower vacuum device to be communicated with the outside, and the upper vacuum device and the lower vacuum device are respectively communicated with vacuum tubes, so that the production efficiency is high.

title_en: A mould for PVC-U pipe fitting injection moulding
abstract_en: The invention discloses a die for injection molding of PVC-U pipe fittings, which comprises a front die plate, a rear die plate, a fixed die plate, a movable die plate, die legs, an inner die plate and a demoulding mechanism, wherein the front die plate is connected with the fixed die plate, the movable die plate is connected with the rear die plate through the die legs, the demoulding mechanism is arranged between the movable die plate and the rear die plate, the inner die plate is arranged between the movable die plate and a positioning die plate, and the rear die plate is connected with the movable die plate through a long screw rod. The invention has the beneficial effects that the guide shafts are arranged on the four corners of the fixed die plate, the guide sleeves matched with the guide shafts are arranged on the four corners of the movable die plate, so that the movable die plate and the fixed die plate can be guided accurately in the die assembly process, the die plate deviation is avoided effectively, the pipe orifice of the pipe fitting can be supported by the first mandrel of the first core pulling mechanism, the auxiliary pushing and core pulling can be carried out on the pipe fitting by the second mandrel of the second core pulling mechanism, and the smooth die stripping of the pipe fitting is realized by matching with the stripping ejector pins of the die stripping mechanism, the damage condition of the pipe fitting is reduced, and the production efficiency is improved.

title_en: Injection molding machine accumulator pressure self-adaptive adjustment method based on working condition sensing
abstract_en: The application relates to a self-adaptive pressure adjusting method of an energy accumulator of an injection molding machine based on working condition sensing, which relates to the technical field of injection molding machines and comprises starting equipment and collecting initial pressure and current oil temperature of the energy accumulator; the method comprises the steps of determining a leakage rate according to initial pressure and current oil temperature, determining a charging pressure threshold according to the current oil temperature, calculating a temperature difference value between the current oil temperature and a preset oil temperature threshold if the current oil temperature is larger than the preset oil temperature threshold, adjusting the charging pressure threshold according to the leakage rate and the temperature difference value to obtain a secondary pressure threshold, determining a pressure volume according to the secondary pressure threshold and a preset pressure model, substituting the pressure volume into the preset oil mass model to be matched to obtain hydraulic oil mass in an injection molding process, and injecting when the initial pressure of an energy accumulator reaches the secondary pressure threshold and the hydraulic oil mass is larger than the preset hydraulic oil threshold. The application has the effect of improving the efficiency under different working conditions.

title_en: Method for producing a sheet or plate
abstract_en: A process for manufacturing a sheet or plate, wherein the sheet or plate comprises at least a layer of polyvinyl chloride comprising a filler material, wherein the 5 process comprises at least the steps of-mixing a PVC composition, -extruding the PVC composition using an extruder having at least one screw, and a slotted nozzle die connected to the outlet of the extruder, characterized in that the mixing step comprises at least a first sub-step, wherein a primary blend of 10 PVC and a first set of additives is produced, wherein the primary blend is free of filler material, or wherein the primary blend comprises 10wt% or less of filler material, and at least a second sub-step, wherein a secondary blend is produced, comprising at least the primary blend, a second set of additives, and a portion of filler material, wherein the PVC composition comprises or consists of a secondary blend 15.

title_en: Seed coating material containing byproduct yeast and polyglutamic acid, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of agricultural seed coating, in particular to a seed coating material containing byproduct yeast and polyglutamic acid, and a preparation method and application thereof. The protein extract from byproduct yeast is used as a main molecular skeleton, has excellent adhesive force, structural support and nutrition slow release function, is compounded with gamma-polyglutamic acid as a function synergist, and utilizes the high hydrophilicity and cohesiveness of the gamma-polyglutamic acid to enhance the continuity, flexibility and water retention capacity of a film layer, and lipopeptid is introduced into the system to improve the stress resistance of seeds, and biological source additives such as chitosan, glycerol and the like are used as auxiliary materials to jointly construct a compact, stable and multifunctional integrated seed coating material. The product of the invention is environment-friendly and sustainable, and can obviously improve the germination rate of seeds and the survival rate of seedlings.

title_en: Full-servo electric automatic vulcanizing machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tire vulcanizers, and provides a full-servo electric automatic vulcanizing machine which comprises a frame, wherein an upper die and a lower die are arranged on the frame, a vulcanizing capsule body is arranged on the lower die, the vulcanizing capsule body is provided with a first steam inlet for conveying steam, a gas conveyer is arranged in the vulcanizing capsule body, and the gas conveyer comprises a cylinder body, an impeller and a guide disc and can disperse the steam into the vulcanizing capsule body, so that the temperature distribution in the vulcanizing capsule body is more uniform, and the physical performance of capsule vulcanization is improved. The invention adopts the transmission coordination of the servo motor and the ball screw to work, realizes the direct transmission of power through the rigid connection of the motor and the ball screw, can quickly respond and drive the sliding table to stably lift, can keep the stability of the sliding table operation even in the quick action process, ensures the accurate alignment of the upper die and the lower die, does not need to wait for the time-consuming processes of hydraulic pressure establishment, air pressure stabilization and the like, and effectively shortens the time of die opening and die closing.

title_en: Full-ecological wheat straw plant planting frame
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full-ecological wheat straw plant planting frame, and belongs to the technical field of soilless culture of plants. The planting frame comprises a layer frame body, a planting disc, a spraying swing water pipe, a plant light supplementing lamp and a swing assembly, wherein the layer frame body comprises a plurality of layers of platforms which are fixedly connected through vertical upright posts, the layer height is matched with the height of wheat straw plants, the planting disc is horizontally arranged on the upper table surface of the platforms side by side, the swing assembly is fixedly connected to the side surface of the layer frame body, the spraying swing water pipe is connected above the planting disc through the swing assembly in a swinging mode, the plant light supplementing lamp is fixedly connected to the lower table surface of the platform side by side, the upper side of the planting disc is externally connected with a high-pressure water source, after the whole frame is completed, manual management is not needed, automatic light supplementing and water supplementing are achieved, swing spraying of the spraying swing water pipe is achieved, and water supplementing is comprehensive and uniform. Solves the technical problems of high layer frame, high manual operation difficulty, high risk and poor efficiency of cultivation without a layer frame.

title_en: Electrochromic polymer, electrochromic film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an electrochromic polymer, an electrochromic film and a preparation method thereof, wherein the structural formula of the electrochromic polymer is shown as formula I:  In the formula I, R is an alkane chain of C4-C50, n is a polymerization degree, n is 20-300, m is 0-2, the number average molecular weight Mn of the electrochromic polymer is 5000-20000 Da, and the polydispersity coefficient D is 3.0-10.0. The electrochromic polymer is prepared by taking an aromatic hydrocarbon carbazole derivative and trifluoroacetone as monomers through a Friedel-crafts hydroxy alkylation polycondensation reaction catalyzed by Lewis acid in one step.

title_en: Self-locking nut for aviation support plate, manufacturing method and composite material component
abstract_en: The invention discloses a supporting plate self-locking nut for aerospace, and relates to the technical field of aerospace structure connection. The assembly comprises a supporting plate and a self-locking nut, wherein a plurality of anchoring holes are formed in the supporting plate, and the surface of the supporting plate is provided with a micro-rough structure. The present invention integrates the composite structure during its manufacture by means of a co-curing process. The molten resin flows into the anchor holes and wets the microscopic surface, and after solidification, a 'chemical riveting' structure combining mechanical interlocking and chemical bonding is formed. The problem of hole edge stress concentration of the traditional mechanical riveting is fundamentally solved, the connection strength, the fatigue life and the tightness and durability of a connection area are obviously improved, and the composite material is particularly suitable for aerospace composite material components with extremely high requirements on weight and reliability, such as aircraft skins, satellite supports and the like.

title_en: Damping blasting control method for tunnel high-risk through section
abstract_en: The invention discloses a damping blasting control method for a tunnel high-risk penetration section, and aims to solve the technical problems that conventional blasting is easy to induce water and mud bursting accidents and the traditional scheme is difficult to fix parameters and adapt to dynamic geology when the residual rock mass of the tunnel penetration section is thin and the front is a high-pressure rich water body. The method strictly controls the blasting vibration speed to be less than or equal to 4cm/s through a vibration speed-geological dual-threshold dynamic regulation system, innovates a self-adaptive switching logic of a fusion guide Kong Yulie and pilot pit advance scheme, combines a Sargassy formula to correct the dosage parameter in real time, and newly adds a 'monitoring-correction-support' closed-loop mechanism.

title_en: Photovoltaic material transportation track laying device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic material transportation track laying device, which belongs to the technical field of photovoltaic track laying and comprises a movable carrier, a side plate member, a turf cutting module and a track laying module. Through setting up the turf cutting module at the removal carrier front end, through the cooperation of horizontal cutter and the vertical cutter in the turf cutting module, when removing the carrier and remove along predetermineeing the route, can accomplish the cutting and the collection of earth's surface turf voluntarily, both can effectively protect the earth's surface grassland vegetation in plateau area, can high-efficient construction material transportation rail again.

title_en: High-density silver-based component and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-density silver-based component and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of metal component preparation. The preparation method of the high-density silver-based component comprises the steps of providing metal powder, wherein the metal powder comprises 1-6% of copper and the balance of silver according to mass fraction, and performing laser selective melting forming on the metal powder to obtain the high-density silver-based component, and the density of the high-density silver-based component is more than or equal to 97.7%. The method can prepare the high-density silver-based component with the density of more than or equal to 97.7 percent, and has simple operation and low cost.

title_en: Greenhouse environment comprehensive regulation and control system based on multisource heat accumulation and release and greenhouse
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of facility environment regulation and greenhouse energy conservation, and provides a greenhouse environment comprehensive regulation and control system based on multi-source heat accumulation and release and a greenhouse. The comprehensive greenhouse environment regulation and control system based on multi-source heat accumulation and release is used for regulating the indoor temperature of a greenhouse and comprises a wet curtain ventilation and underground heat exchange device, a solar hot water soil heat collection device, a water passive heat accumulation and release device, a heat accumulation wall body and control equipment. The greenhouse environment comprehensive regulation and control system based on multi-source heat accumulation and release can solve the problems that the existing greenhouse has insufficient heat accumulation capacity, low utilization efficiency of light and heat resources and poor temperature regulation and control effect, and can not guarantee annual high-efficiency and high-quality production of greenhouse crops.

title_en: Carousel formula chicken feet peeling device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rotary table type chicken claw peeling device, and belongs to the technical field of poultry food processing equipment. The device comprises a chicken claw transmission part and a peeling execution part, wherein the chicken claw transmission part is provided with a thick turntable, a thin turntable, a transmission motor and a double-sided tooth synchronous belt transmission system, so that stable conveying and positioning of chicken claws can be realized, and the chicken claw peeling execution part has an excellent overload prevention function. The peeling execution part is provided with a middle peeling brush roller, a root peeling brush roller, a double-row rubber rod roller and three-row rubber rod rollers, and can perform differential peeling treatment on different parts of chicken feet. The turntable can be replaced according to the sizes of chicken feet, the center distance is adjustable, and the turntable is suitable for various chicken feet processing requirements. The device adopts an open structure, is convenient for clean maintenance, has adjustable transmission and execution motor rotation speed, can accurately control peeling strength and time, and can effectively peel and furthest protect chicken feet to be complete. The invention has reasonable structure, flexible operation, uniform peeling and small damage, and is suitable for the peeling process in the large-scale processing of chicken feet.

title_en: Device for treating horse face fish and using method
abstract_en: The application relates to a horse face fish processing device and a using method thereof, wherein the horse face fish processing device comprises a fish head separating mechanism, an viscera removing mechanism, a skin-meat separating mechanism and a tilting roller, wherein the viscera removing mechanism is connected to the fish head separating mechanism, the skin-meat separating mechanism is connected to one side of the viscera removing mechanism, which is far away from the fish head separating mechanism, the skin-meat separating mechanism comprises a separating support frame, the separating support frame is provided with a first conveying part and a skin cutting part, the skin cutting part is arranged on one side of the first conveying part, which is far away from the viscera removing mechanism, the separating support frame is also provided with the tilting roller, the tilting roller is arranged on one side of the first conveying part, which is close to the skin cutting part, and the tilting roller and the first conveying part are arranged at intervals along the direction perpendicular to the plate surface of the first conveying part, and the tilting roller is matched with the first conveying part to squeeze fish bodies, so that the skin cutting part cuts fish skin and fish meat. The fish head separating mechanism and the viscera removing mechanism remove fish heads and viscera respectively, and after the fish body enters the skin-meat separating mechanism, the tilting roller is matched with the first conveying part to enable the fish skin to be attached to the knife face of the fish skin cutting part.

title_en: Water-saving irrigation equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of irrigation, in particular to water-saving irrigation equipment, which comprises a water tank, a water pipe and a drip irrigation tube, wherein the water pipe is arranged on the water tank, the drip irrigation tube is connected on the water pipe, a dredging component is arranged in the drip irrigation tube, the dredging component comprises a piston rod, the piston rod is movably arranged in the drip irrigation tube, a piston is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the piston rod, an elastic rope is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the piston, a balancing weight is fixedly arranged on the surface of the elastic rope, which is positioned in the inner cavity of the drip irrigation tube, of the water-saving irrigation equipment, soil loosening can be realized through a soil loosening component, the fluidity of water at the drip irrigation tube and a second soil loosening component is improved, irrigation can be more uniform, irrigation effect is further improved, and the periphery of flowers can be uniformly irrigated by matching with the water passing component, meanwhile, the probability of soil hardening can be reduced, and irrigation operation can be further smoothly carried out.

title_en: Hot-work die steel powder material for additive manufacturing and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hot-working die steel powder material for additive manufacturing and a preparation method thereof, which belong to the technical field of metal powder, and comprise the following elements, by mass, 0.2-0.35% of C, 2.5-5.5% of Cr, 2-4% of Mo, 0.1-0.6% of V, 0.1-0.6% of Si and 0.1-0.6% of Mn, wherein on the basis of a C, cr, mo, V, si, mn base alloy system, microalloy synergism of Ta and Nb and rare earth compound regulation of Ce, mg, Y and La are introduced, so that the powder can ensure the forming suitability, simultaneously take strength, toughness and heat conducting property into account, and the requirements of a hot-working die on comprehensive performance under high temperature and thermal shock working conditions can be met.

title_en: Carrier rocket vertical take-off and landing flight demonstration and fire-fighting aircraft based on electric driving force system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a carrier rocket vertical take-off and landing flight demonstration and fire-fighting aircraft based on an electric driving force system, which comprises (1) a control subsystem, a power subsystem, a structural subsystem and a take-off and landing subsystem, wherein the control subsystem is used for collecting motion information, generating control instructions and ensuring accurate control and stable execution of flight, (2) the power subsystem is used for responding to the control instructions, managing working conditions of an engine and adjusting thrust to provide reliable power for whole-course flight, the structural subsystem is used for transmitting load and bearing external force and simultaneously connecting all parts into a whole to protect internal equipment, (4) the take-off and landing subsystem is used for providing buffering and supporting and ensuring stable safety and stable gesture of the whole landing process, and (5) the emergency recovery subsystem/fire-fighting subsystem is used for managing risks of special experiments or for accurately intervening in major disaster. The invention has the value of simplifying the repeated use flight demonstration flow and reducing the cost, and further endows the aircraft with accurate fire fighting capability, thereby providing a brand new technical means for coping with serious disaster.

title_en: (Meth) acrylic nitroxide radical polymer particles and method for producing same
abstract_en: The present invention provides a method for producing nitroxide (meth) acrylate polymer particles, which can inhibit the generation of coarse agglomerates and attachments and has excellent productivity. The method for producing the nitroxide (meth) acrylate polymer particles comprises a step (a) in which a solution obtained by dissolving a nitroxide (meth) acrylate polymer (A) in a hydrophobic organic solvent is dispersed in the aqueous medium in the form of oil droplets, a step (b) in which the solvent in the oil droplets is removed to obtain a slurry, and a step (c) in which the slurry is dehydrated and dried. The polymer (A) has a repeating unit represented by the formula (1), and the aqueous medium contains a polyvinyl alcohol-based polymer (B), and the mass Ratio (RD) of the PVA-based polymer (B), the Degree of Polymerization (DP) of the PVA-based polymer (B) and the Degree of Saponification (DS) of the PVA-based polymer (B) relative to the solution satisfy the relationship of RD×DP× (100-DS)  2 /100≥850. In the formula (1), R  1 、R 2 、R 3  and R  4  are each independently a hydrogen atom or an alkyl group having 1 to 6 carbon atoms, wherein at least one of R  1  and R  2  is an alkyl group having 1 to 6 carbon atoms, and at least one of R  3  and R  4  is an alkyl group having 1 to 6 carbon atoms, R  1  and R  2  may be bonded to each other to form a cyclic structure, R  3  and R  4  may be bonded to each other to form a cyclic structure, R  11  represents a hydrogen atom or a methyl group, X represents a single bond or a divalent linking group, and n is 0 or 1.

title_en: Inner wall cleaning device of concrete batching machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses an inner wall cleaning device of a concrete batching machine, which comprises a stirring barrel, a stirring motor, a lifting motor, a stirring roller, a scraping ring and a screw rod, wherein the stirring barrel comprises a top cover and a containing cavity, the stirring roller, the scraping ring and the screw rod are arranged in the containing cavity, the screw rod is connected with the scraping ring, the stirring motor is arranged at the center of the top cover, a rotor of the stirring motor penetrates into the containing cavity to be connected with the stirring roller, the scraping ring is attached to the wall part of the containing cavity, the lifting motor is arranged at the edge of the top cover, the rotor of the lifting motor penetrates into the containing cavity to be connected with the screw rod, and the lifting motor drives the scraping ring to ascend and descend against the wall part of the containing cavity through the screw rod. The novel energy-saving type energy-saving device has the advantages of simple structure, compact matching, reasonable design and the like, and is a product with excellent technical and economical properties.

title_en: Non-uniform thickness ultrathin glass capable of realizing sliding roll and manufacturing method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ultra-thin glass processing and manufacturing. The invention provides non-uniform thickness ultrathin glass capable of realizing sliding rolling, and a manufacturing method and application thereof, wherein the non-uniform thickness ultrathin glass comprises an ultrathin glass body, a non-bending region and a bending region, and a transition region is arranged in the bending region and used for connection and thickness transition; the special bending region structure ensures that the bending region is not in a conventional groove shape, but extends in a plane manner in a direction away from the region boundary and keeps the edge opposite to the region boundary exposed to the outside all the time, so that the ultrathin glass body has the structural characteristics of thin one end containing the edge and thick the other end opposite to the edge.

title_en: Crop growth illumination intensity and temperature adjusting method, greenhouse control system and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to the technical field of agricultural planting, in particular to a method for adjusting the illumination intensity and the temperature of crop growth, a greenhouse control system and a storage medium, wherein the greenhouse control system comprises a plurality of light source devices and a plurality of temperature devices, and the embodiment of the invention controls the target light source devices and the target temperature devices to respectively work at a first target power and a second target power by determining the first target power of the target light source devices and the second target power of the target temperature devices according to the growth data of target crops, the planting area of the target crop is positioned at the target illumination intensity and the target temperature, the target crop has better expected growth effect, so that the illumination intensity and the temperature of the planting area are controlled by adopting different light source equipment and temperature equipment aiming at different types of crops, the demand difference of the different types of crops on the illumination intensity and the temperature is fully considered, the growth and the setting condition of the crops are improved, the crop yield is improved, and the economic benefit of the crops is improved.

title_en: Plastic film for visible light driving light cleaning and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to functional plastic films. More particularly, relates to a plastic film for cleaning visible light driving light, a preparation method and application thereof. The plastic film is prepared by taking a polymer photosensitizer as a core functional component, adopting solution blending or melt blending with a plastic substrate, and then carrying out tape casting, film blowing and/or heat curing treatment, wherein the polymer photosensitizer is selected from the structures shown below. The light cleaning plastic film can generate singlet oxygen under the irradiation of visible light with the light intensity of 400-800nm and the light intensity of 10-80 mW/cm  2 , and the sterilization rate can reach more than 99% within 10 minutes, which proves that the plastic film has the capabilities of high-efficiency sterilization and disinfection and degradation of organic pollutants and toxic and harmful gases, and has great application prospects in the fields of biomedicine and environmental protection.

title_en: Duplex position blowing production facility
abstract_en: The invention relates to double-station blow molding production equipment which comprises a frame, an extrusion mechanism, a shearing mechanism, a blowing mechanism and a blowing mechanism, wherein the extrusion mechanism is fixed on the frame and comprises a spiral conveying cylinder and a die head vertically fixed on the frame, the die head is communicated with the spiral conveying cylinder, the die clamping mechanism is arranged below the die head and comprises two groups of rotating discs and four die mounting plates which move radially and reciprocally along the rotating discs, the mounting plates are fixedly provided with blow molding dies, the four blow molding dies are clamped to form a closed cavity, the shearing mechanism is arranged on the frame and comprises a cutter which is arranged at the die head and can relatively move to shear a hollow cylindrical die blank, the blowing mechanism is arranged on the frame, and the blowing mechanism is respectively arranged on the left side and the right side of the die head, so that the contact radian between each independent blow molding die and the corrugated surface of an automobile dust cover is obviously reduced, and the problem of stretching, tearing and even structural breakage of a product caused by overlarge overall coating force in the conventional two-half die demolding is effectively avoided.

title_en: High-strength high-modulus epoxy resin composition, preparation method and ultrahigh-compression composite material
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-strength high-modulus epoxy resin composition, a preparation method and an ultra-high compression composite material, belonging to the field of wet prepreg manufacturing for structural composite materials, wherein the composition comprises a polyfunctional and micromolecular monofunctional epoxy resin monomer, an aromatic amine curing agent and an epoxy reactive diluent, the resin matrix builds a high-strength high-modulus composite epoxy system by introducing intramolecular rigid chemical bonds, enhancing intermolecular acting force, improving crosslinking density and other synergistic effects, and realizes that the tensile strength is more than or equal to 125MPa and the modulus is more than or equal to 5.0GPa. The compressive strength of the composite material prepared from the high-strength high-modulus epoxy resin matrix and the domestic T800-level carbon fiber reinforcement is more than or equal to 2500MPa, the compression-pull ratio is more than or equal to 1.0, and compared with the compressive strength and compression-pull balance characteristics of the traditional resin matrix composite material, the composite material has obviously improved compression strength and compression-pull balance characteristics, and can meet the high-performance design requirements of new-generation aerospace equipment.

title_en: Edge beating mechanism and mowing device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mowing, and discloses an edge trimming mechanism and a mowing device, wherein the edge trimming mechanism is used for being connected with a vehicle body, and can follow expansion position and remove to storage position, the mechanism of beating limit includes swing arm assembly, blade disc subassembly, driving piece and guide. The first end and the automobile body of swing arm assembly are connected, and swing arm assembly can swing around first axis for the automobile body to can swing around the second axis, wherein, first axis and second axis form the contained angle, cutter head subassembly and swing arm assembly's second end are connected, and the driving piece is used for driving swing arm assembly and swings around first axis, and the guide is connected with swing arm assembly cooperation, and when the driving piece driven swing arm assembly swings around first axis, the guide is used for making swing arm assembly swing around the second axis. According to the invention, swinging around the double shafts is realized only through mechanical cooperation, so that the structural complexity is simplified, the motor faults are reduced, the cost is reduced, and the problem that the mowing robot in the prior art does not have enough storage space to store the edge beating mechanism is solved.

title_en: Gradient domestication seedling raising and high-survival cultivation method for saline-alkali resistant Chinese fir
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of agriculture and forestry planting, and discloses a gradient domestication seedling raising and high-survival cultivation method of saline-alkali resistant Chinese fir; the method comprises the steps of determining a permitted soil conductivity range of a target root zone according to soil layer conductivity distribution of 0-80 cm of a target saline-alkali forestation land, setting a container matrix as a first matrix layer, a second matrix layer and a third matrix layer from top to bottom in a nursery to form an incremental conductivity gradient, irrigating and supplementing water by different conductivity irrigation liquids in stages to enable the conductivity of the second matrix layer to be stable in the range, excavating planting holes in the forestation land, setting a salt discharging layer and a salt discharging channel communicated drainage ditch, backfilling a buffer layer, a transition layer and outer primary saline-alkali soil above the salt discharging layer in sequence, planting the container seedling together with root clusters, and maintaining according to an irrigation system to maintain the conductivities of the buffer layer and the transition layer not higher than the upper limit of the range.

title_en: Application of elaidic acid in preparation of vascular endothelial injury reagent, zebra fish model and construction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vascular endothelial injury reagent prepared from elaidic acid, application of the vascular endothelial injury reagent in a zebra fish model and a construction method. Relates to the technical field of animal models. Specific application, a method for constructing a zebra fish model with vascular endothelial injury and a method for screening medicines are provided. The invention can stably induce the vascular endothelial injury of the zebra fish and provides a brand new experimental model and technical means for the mechanism research and the drug screening of vascular endothelial injury related diseases. The method has the advantages of short test period, low cost, simple and convenient method and easy operation, and can realize the real-time visual observation of the pathological changes of the vascular endothelium.

title_en: Method for enriching 4- (alpha-L-rhamnosyloxy) -benzyl glucoside and related metabolites thereof in moringa oleifera seedlings
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of natural product enrichment, in particular to a method for enriching 4- (alpha-L-rhamnosyloxy) -benzyl glucoside and related metabolites thereof in moringa oleifera sprouts, which comprises the following steps of 1) removing the outer skin of moringa oleifera seeds to obtain peeled moringa oleifera seeds, 2) treating the peeled moringa oleifera seeds with aromatic amino acid, and 3) germinating and culturing the treated peeled moringa oleifera seeds. The method provided by the invention realizes the efficient enrichment of 4- (alpha-L-rhamnosyloxy) -benzyl glucoside and related metabolites thereof in moringa oleifera seedlings by directionally regulating metabolic flux, meets the safety and process stability requirements of the food industry, has controllable cost, and provides a brand-new process approach for the subsequent development of moringa oleifera functional foods.

title_en: Processing technology and assembly line equipment of quick-frozen pie
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of food processing equipment, in particular to a processing technology and assembly line equipment of quick-frozen pie. The utility model provides a quick-frozen pie's processing assembly line equipment, includes dough mixer, oodle maker, material loading machine, rolling machine, shortening brushing machine, filling material injection machine, package system machine, cake blank rolling machine, sabot machine, extremely freeze conveyer and packing conveyor that set gradually along the processing order, all machines all are equipped with the conveyer belt, and the conveyer belt tip butt joint and the high adaptation of adjacent machine form continuous conveying path, and each process is accomplished at corresponding conveyer belt. The flour mixer comprises a stirring cavity, a stirring assembly and a first conveying belt, and flour and water enter the stirring cavity from a feeding hole. The invention has the beneficial effects that the continuous conveying path is formed by sequentially connecting the special machines with the conveyor belts, the raw materials can be processed in the whole process without manual transportation, the labor intensity is greatly reduced, the production efficiency is improved, and the large-scale production requirement is adapted.

title_en: Epidemic prevention sterilizing sole product and production process thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an epidemic prevention sterilizing sole product and a production process thereof, comprising a rubber sole layer, a copper sheet layer and an EVA shoe bed, wherein the EVA shoe bed is arranged right above the rubber sole layer, the EVA shoe bed and the rubber sole layer are fixed on the rubber sole layer through hot press molding, one surface of the EVA shoe bed, which is opposite to the rubber sole layer, is provided with a copper sheet mounting groove, a copper sheet layer is fixedly arranged in the copper sheet mounting groove, and the middle part of the rubber sole layer is provided with a marking window, the marking window is arranged right opposite to the copper sheet layer, and the production process comprises the steps of S1, preparing the rubber sole layer, S2, preparing the EVA shoe bed, S3, preparing the copper sheet layer, S4, and integrally preparing an outsole finished product. According to the invention, the rubber sole layer is compounded below the EVA shoe bed, so that the wear resistance and the skid resistance of the sole can be greatly improved, and the copper ion material is mixed in the rubber sole layer, so that the sole has the sterilization and degerming capability.

title_en: Phosphate-solubilizing bacteria BPC41 and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of microorganism application, in particular to a phosphate solubilizing bacterium BPC41 and application thereof. The invention adopts a soil dilution coating method and a flat plate lineation method to separate salt tolerant bacteria from saline-alkali soil, and separates and identifies salt tolerant bacteria BPC41 from the saline-alkali soil of Tangshan based on the phosphorus dissolving capability of the salt tolerant bacteria. The comprehensive characteristic measurement results show that the strain has excellent saline-alkali tolerance and multiple growth promotion functions, and is particularly capable of efficiently dissolving organic phosphorus, dissolving inorganic phosphorus and fixing nitrogen, and has the growth promotion characteristics of secreting indoleacetic acid and forming a biological film. The germination test result shows that the BPC41 strain not only can promote germination of red bean seeds, lettuce seeds, cucumber seeds, wheat seeds and watermelon seeds, but also can promote growth of soybean seed buds under salt stress, and can relieve salt stress. The potted plant test result shows that the plant growth can be promoted under the condition of saline-alkali stress.

title_en: Heat insulation board for movable board house and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of novel building energy-saving materials and green building materials, in particular to a heat insulation board for a movable house and a preparation method thereof. The invention creatively integrates the front edge technologies of radiation reflection, vacuum heat insulation, phase change energy storage, intelligent temperature adjustment and the like by constructing a unique multilayer composite structure of 'exterior protection, radiation buffering, main heat insulation, heat insulation enhancement, intelligent temperature adjustment and interior decoration'. The functional layers are cooperatively combined through well-designed interface treatment and a gradient modulus adhesive system, so that the technical problems of stress concentration, interface stripping and the like caused by physical property differences among different material layers of the traditional insulation board are solved. The heat insulation board prepared by the invention not only realizes ultralow heat conductivity coefficient and excellent fireproof safety level, but also has dynamic thermal response capability, can automatically adjust indoor thermal comfort according to the ambient temperature, and simultaneously has the health environment regulation and control functions of resisting bacteria, releasing negative oxygen ions and the like.

title_en: Efficient resin bus duct pouring and demolding device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pouring and demolding of resin bus ducts, in particular to a high-efficiency pouring and demolding device for the resin bus ducts, which comprises a pouring supporting table, an accelerating solidification assembly, a mold supporting table and mold pouring frames, wherein two mold pouring frames are arranged on the upper surface of the mold supporting table, the two mold pouring frames are respectively arranged on the upper sides of two air cavities, an interlayer is arranged in the mold pouring frames, and a plurality of separation holes capable of spraying air to the inside are formed in the inner wall of the mold pouring frame. According to the invention, the cast die casting frame can be moved to the corresponding side of the solidification acceleration component for solidification treatment, the solidification acceleration component fills air flow into the air cavity through the round hole, then air flow is filled between the side surface of the internal casting piece and the contact surface of the die casting frame through the separation hole, the casting piece is pre-separated by air blowing of a plurality of points, the pulling force during separation of the casting piece is dispersed, and the damage probability during separation of the casting piece is reduced.

title_en: Tubular pile prestress tensioning machine for cement pole processing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tubular pile prestress tensioning machine for cement pole processing, which belongs to the technical field of cement pole processing and comprises a track, wherein a lifting frame is arranged at the top of the track, a mounting seat is fixedly arranged at the top of the lifting frame, a positioning cylinder is fixedly arranged at the left side of the mounting seat, a loosening mechanism is arranged outside the positioning cylinder, a transmission mechanism is arranged at the top of the mounting seat, a lubricating mechanism is arranged outside the positioning cylinder, and a locking mechanism is arranged outside the mounting seat.

title_en: Clamp device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hand clamping device which comprises a base, a first rotating shaft and a second rotating shaft which are rotatably arranged on the base, a first clamping jaw and a second clamping jaw, wherein one end of the first clamping jaw and one end of the second clamping jaw are respectively and fixedly connected with the first rotating shaft and the second rotating shaft, a driving rod, one end of which is fixedly connected with the first rotating shaft or the second rotating shaft, an elastic device, which is used for propping against the other end of the driving rod, and a connecting rod, the two ends of which are respectively connected with the first clamping jaw and the second clamping jaw, and the elastic device is used for applying elastic force to the driving rod. When the acting force is removed, the elastic device applies elastic force to the first clamping jaw and the second clamping jaw through the driving rod, the rotating shaft and the connecting rod, so that the first clamping jaw and the second clamping jaw can be closed (clamped). Therefore, when the bottle mouth is required to be clamped or released, the bottle mouth can be realized by withdrawing or applying corresponding acting force to the driving rod.

title_en: Multilayer PE nano clean tube and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of high molecular tubes, in particular to a multilayer PE nano clean tube and a preparation method thereof, comprising a physical barrier layer, a high-density PE shell, an inner liner layer and a buffer layer, wherein the inner liner layer is sleeved outside the physical barrier layer, the buffer layer cover is located outside the inner liner, the outside of buffer layer is located to high density PE shell cover, the inner wall of physical barrier layer is provided with the guiding gutter, the inner wall of inner liner is provided with the holding tank. According to the invention, through the diversion trench, the containing groove and the buffer layer, the cleaning effect can be improved while the bacteria breeding dead angle on the inner wall of the pipe is avoided, and the normal operation of the semiconductor process is effectively ensured.

title_en: ViGa gas atomization powder preparation post-treatment process and device
abstract_en: The application discloses a ViGa gas atomization powder preparation post-treatment process and a ViGa gas atomization powder preparation post-treatment device, wherein the process adopts four steps of cooperative treatment of classification pre-separation, plasma desorption, vibration densification and cooling shaping, free fine powder is removed through a three-level gas classifier, then the powder is bombarded, desorbed and attached to satellite balls and fused to irregular protrusions on the surface of powder through radio frequency plasma, powder densification and removal of residual satellite balls are realized through an ultrasonic vibration fluidized bed, finally the spherical morphology is fixed through rapid cooling shaping of inert gas, and the precise regulation and control of process parameters are realized through integrating a feeding system, a classification module, a plasma module, a vibration module, a cooling module and a control system.

title_en: Bamboo fiber composite layered material manhole cover and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bamboo fiber composite layered material well lid and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of bamboo fiber layered materials. According to the technical scheme, the bamboo fiber composite well lid with high strength, high toughness, excellent corrosion resistance, light weight and environmental protection is prepared by combining three-level synergistic modified bamboo fibers with a three-level protective structure and a one-time compression molding process. Can replace the existing cast iron or cement well covers to be applied to heavy-load scenes such as arterial roads, ports, airports and the like, has lower preparation cost and has better market application prospect.

title_en: Production device and method for fluidized bed silicon carbide ceramic lining cylinder
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ceramic production equipment, and discloses a production device and a production method of a fluidized bed silicon carbide ceramic lining cylinder, wherein the production device comprises a stamping table, a uniform material spraying mechanism and an ejection mechanism are arranged on the inner side of the stamping table, a portal frame connected with a hydraulic press is arranged on the outer side of the stamping table, and a replacement mechanism is arranged at the telescopic end of the hydraulic press; the uniform sprinkling mechanism is used for blanking by driving a rotating pipe through a motor, the production method comprises the steps of performing die assembly locking according to the size of a workpiece, adjusting the deflection angle of the rotating pipe and driving the rotating pipe to rotate at a uniform speed to perform circumferential spreading, enabling a sprinkling assembly to slide and back after the spreading is completed, pressing down by a hydraulic press for stamping forming, and enabling a cylinder to drive a sliding supporting rod to upwards demould and eject the workpiece. According to the invention, through the adjustable circumferential material spraying mechanism and the groove clamping structure, uniform and continuous material distribution and rapid die changing of the annular die cavity are realized, and interference between feeding and stamping actions is avoided.

title_en: Multi-beam synchronous motion carbon fiber spiral winding equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to carbon fiber spiral winding equipment with multiple bundles moving synchronously, and belongs to the technical field of fiber winding forming equipment. The device comprises a supporting mechanism, a driving mechanism, a plurality of groups of feeding mechanisms and a plurality of groups of rotary wire guide mechanisms, wherein the supporting mechanism comprises a bottom plate, a left side plate and a right side plate, the left side plate and the right side plate are fixed on the upper surface of the bottom plate in parallel at intervals, the driving mechanism comprises a driving assembly, a first large gear ring and a second large gear ring, the first large gear ring is fixed on the left side plate, the second large gear ring is fixed on the right side plate, the outer rings of the first large gear ring and the second large gear ring are respectively connected with a circle of first small gear and a circle of second small gear in a meshed mode, the driving assembly is used for driving the first large gear ring and the second large gear ring to rotate, the feeding mechanism is used for carrying out lifting movement under the action of the first small gear, and the rotary wire guide mechanism is used for carrying out rotation and wire guide under the action of the second small gear. According to the invention, through the external engagement layout, the winding efficiency of a plurality of bundles of carbon fiber yarns can be obviously improved.

title_en: Closed-loop drying mechanism and tunnel type fungus mushroom drying system comprising same
abstract_en: The invention discloses a closed-loop drying mechanism, which comprises a drying chamber and drying equipment arranged at the top of the drying chamber, wherein the drying equipment comprises an integrated shell, a heat exchanger is arranged in the integrated shell, the output end of an air inlet passage of the heat exchanger is connected with an air inlet channel, a condenser, a heater and an air inlet fan are sequentially arranged in the air inlet channel, two ends of the drying chamber are respectively provided with an air inlet and an air outlet, the output end of the air inlet channel is connected with the air inlet, the input end of the air inlet channel is connected with the air inlet channel, an air valve and a surface air cooler are sequentially arranged in the air inlet channel along the airflow flowing direction.

title_en: High-strength and high-toughness aluminum lithium alloy component optimization method for additive manufacturing through rare earth collaborative refinement
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of metal material processing, in particular to a high-strength and high-toughness aluminum lithium alloy component optimization method for additive manufacturing with rare earth collaborative refinement, which comprises the following steps of obtaining aluminum lithium alloy matrix powder, respectively obtaining CeH  2  powder serving as a cerium source and ZrH  2  powder serving as a zirconium source serving as reaction precursors, uniformly mixing CeH  2  powder, zrH  2  powder and aluminum lithium alloy matrix powder to form a composite powder raw material, and decomposing CeH  2  and ZrH  2  into high-activity Ce atoms and Zr atoms based on ultrahigh temperature and ultrahigh cooling rate environment provided by a molten pool formed on the composite powder raw material by high-energy beam scanning in the electron beam additive manufacturing process, and promoting the CeH 3548 and the ZrH 38362 to generate in-situ synthetic reaction with molten aluminum to generate a (Ce, zr) Al  3  nano composite phase. According to the invention, ceH  2  and ZrH  2  are used as precursors to generate a (Ce, zr) Al  3  nano composite phase, so that the space-time synchronization of the generation of a refined phase and the solidification nucleation is realized.

title_en: Active cleaning type anti-climbing optical fiber warning lamp with anti-perching structure for overhead line and installation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an active cleaning type climbing-preventing optical fiber warning lamp with an perching-preventing structure for an overhead line and an installation method thereof, and relates to the field of electric safety protection equipment; the circuit part comprises a single LED lamp, the LED lamp is connected with a plurality of light guide fibers, and the light guide fibers are embedded into the outer surface of the shell to realize low-power consumption multidirectional warning; the fixed locking mechanism composed of the main locking device and the auxiliary locking device is arranged at the lower end of the shell, the fixed locking mechanism can be adapted to a single-double cross arm structure, uninterrupted installation is realized by means of a command rod, the circuit component further comprises a short-distance sensing module, an alarm module and a communication module, a worker can approach and trigger a high-frequency warning and a remote notification, and the worker can close the alarm function through a remote controller.

title_en: Continuous controllable three-dimensional stitching device and method for layering/penetrating composite material preform
abstract_en: The invention provides a composite material preform layer-connected/penetrated continuous controllable three-dimensional stitching device and a method, wherein the composite material preform layer-connected/penetrated continuous controllable three-dimensional stitching method and the device thereof comprise a stitching device supporting platform, a mechanical arm and stitching mechanism bracket arranged on the stitching device supporting platform, a double-needle stitching mechanism and a curved needle stitching mechanism; the three-dimensional stitching method comprises the steps of planning a three-dimensional stitching path according to a geometry structure of a prefabricated body, identifying stitching modes of each section of stitching path to determine corresponding execution mechanisms, installing corresponding stitching execution mechanisms on a mechanical arm, executing stitching tasks according to a preset path, automatically identifying stitching modes of the next section of path by a control system, replacing the corresponding stitching execution mechanisms, adjusting movement tracks of the stitching mechanical arm at the same time, and repeating the steps until all stitching tasks are completed according to the planned path to obtain the composite material prefabricated body with the three-dimensional reinforced structure.

title_en: Extrusion mechanism of blowing and filling and sealing integrated machine and blowing and filling and sealing integrated machine
abstract_en: The application discloses an extrusion mechanism of a blowing and filling and sealing integrated machine and the blowing and filling and sealing integrated machine, which relate to the technical field of filling equipment, wherein a vertically arranged pipe body is arranged in a space surrounded by an extrusion die head to isolate heat and is used as a carrier, a plurality of rows and columns of vertically arranged semiconductor refrigerating sheets are arranged on the vertically arranged pipe body, and the hot ends of the semiconductor refrigerating sheets are close to the extrusion die head; the extrusion mechanism of the blowing and filling integrated machine has the technical effects of less damage to the liquid medicine filled in the extrusion mechanism when in use, capability of effectively accelerating the cooling of the inner container of the forming die and less influence on the fluidity of molten substances in the extrusion die.

title_en: Preparation method and application of nanocellulose-based composite heat-insulating material
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method and application of a nano-cellulose-based composite thermal insulation material. The preparation method comprises the steps of preparing GO-NC-Ce hybrid dispersion liquid through ultrasonic-assisted self-assembly, adding carbon nano tubes, pre-dispersed aerogel particles, phase-change microcapsules, a phase-change energy storage skeleton and a composite foaming system into a flexible polymer serving as a matrix, preparing multifunctional composite slurry through high-speed shearing and vacuum defoaming, forming a gradient ice crystal template through controlling a freezing rate by adopting a freeze drying technology, sublimating ice crystals to obtain a foam body with a bottom layer, a main body layer and a surface layer gradient pore structure, and finally spraying surface layer slurry containing sepiolite fibers, nano titanium dioxide and a hydrophobic agent on the surface of the foam body, and solidifying to obtain the composite heat-insulating material. The obtained material has controllable porosity and excellent heat insulation performance, and is suitable for the field of heat preservation of wearable textiles.

title_en: Modified PA66 material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a modified PA66 material, which comprises a PA66 resin matrix, an amorphous polyarylether resin and a compatilizer, wherein the amorphous polyarylether resin comprises structural units of-A-, B-, C-and-D-, and the A-is ; -B-is C is ; -D-is Wherein a, B, C, D is the mole fraction of structural units-A-, B-, C-, D-, satisfying a+b+c+d=1, a >0, D >0, 0≤b <1, 0≤c <1, respectively. The modified PA66 material provided by the invention has excellent mechanical property, heat resistance and low warpage characteristics, and can meet the comprehensive requirements of FDM 3D printing on rheological property, dimensional stability and molding quality of the material.

title_en: Excrement cleaning device for cow breeding
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of excrement cleaning devices, and discloses an excrement cleaning device for cow cultivation, which comprises a fixing mechanism, wherein the fixing mechanism further comprises a connecting column, a limiting rod is connected to the outer wall of the connecting column in a sliding mode, a first connector is fixedly connected to the front face of the limiting rod, a second connector is fixedly connected to the back face of the limiting rod, a pressing rod is arranged, the excrement is extruded in a segmented mode through the pressing rod in rotation, the follow-up pushing force is applied to the excrement through a scraper, moisture in the excrement on two sides is converged towards the middle, the moisture in the excrement can move towards the bottom of a ditch when the scraper extrudes the excrement which is mixed with solid and liquid, the viscosity of the excrement at the bottom is increased due to downward movement of a large amount of liquid, and the excrement is difficult to clean due to the fact that part of the excrement is still stuck to the bottom of the ditch when the excrement is scraped by the scraper, and the effective volume of the excrement ditch is reduced.

title_en: Air blowing acceleration seed feeding hill planter capable of separating seed taking from seed guiding
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air-blowing acceleration seed feeding hill planter for seed taking-seed guiding separation, and belongs to the technical field of agricultural sowing machinery. Aiming at the defects of unordered seed collision, mutual interference of picking and throwing procedures, low sowing rate, poor stability and poor seed falling uniformity of the traditional mechanical seed throwing device. The device mainly comprises a seed feeding cover, adjustable arc seed cleaning teeth, an acceleration seed feeding tunnel, a hollow shaft, a casting baffle disc, a seed taking disc and a negative pressure cavity. The adjustable arc seed cleaning teeth are provided with reverse teeth and forward teeth, can slide radially and are used for removing redundant seeds and adjusting the gesture of the seeds. Seeds are taken by negative pressure adsorption and are cleaned and corrected, and then enter an accelerating seed feeding tunnel, and the accelerating seed feeding is realized through the same positive pressure air flow. The invention realizes seed taking and seed guiding separation, effectively avoids the problems of procedure interference and seed damage, improves seed feeding speed, seed falling consistency and sowing precision, and greatly improves the stability of the whole machine and the field operation performance compared with the traditional duckbill type hill planter.

title_en: Modifier and modification method for salt-tolerant bacteria loaded on biochar of salinized soil
abstract_en: The invention discloses a modifier of a biochar loaded salt tolerant bacterium of salinized soil and a modification method, the modifier comprises a modified biochar loaded salt tolerant bacterium, a prewetting liquid, a cementing liquid and a nitrifying bacterium liquid, wherein the addition mass of the modified biochar loaded salt tolerant bacterium is 2% -5% according to dry soil per kilogram, the volume of the prewetting liquid is (60-200) mL/kg, the volume of the cementing liquid is (30-80) mL/kg, the volume of the nitrifying bacterium liquid is (1-3.5) mL/kg, the modification method is to oscillate the salt tolerant bacterium liquid according to 1g of the modified biochar (5-15) mL to obtain the modified biochar loaded salt tolerant bacterium, then the prewetting liquid is added and fully stirred, the spraying is carried out for many times through the cementing liquid, and finally the nitrifying bacterium liquid is applied to finish the modification of the biochar loaded salt tolerant bacterium of the salinized soil.

title_en: Pearlescent three-dimensional synergistic silica gel mold and use method thereof
abstract_en: The application belongs to the field of silica gel molds, and in particular relates to a pearlescent three-dimensional synergistic silica gel mold and a use method thereof, wherein the silica gel mold comprises a silica gel mold and a side core, the silica gel mold is provided with a side wall, an inner cavity formed by the side wall can form the shape of a finished product main body, the side core is arranged along the radial direction of the inner cavity, the first end of side core is equipped with a plurality of shaping pyramids, and the protruding setting of shaping pyramids relative lateral wall towards inner chamber central direction for use the finished product surface of silica gel mould shaping to form a plurality of pyramid concave pits, the side core is according to the required adhesion pearly luster powder position of finished product surface setting a plurality of. On one hand, for artware or ornament, a certain amount of pearl powder can be sprayed in the pyramid-shaped concave pits, so that the pearl powder is limited in the pyramid-shaped concave pits and cannot move at will, and on the other hand, for lipstick, the distance for spraying the pearl powder is increased or the force for spraying the pearl powder is reduced, a certain pattern or shape, in particular a stripe-shaped pattern, is formed by using the pearl powder, the three-dimensional effect of the surface of a finished product can be increased, and the three-dimensional synergy of the pearl of the finished product is realized.

title_en: Carousel formula injection moulding equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of injection molding equipment, in particular to rotary table type injection molding equipment which comprises a cabinet, wherein a top plate is fixedly arranged at the top of the cabinet, a mounting plate is fixedly arranged on the top surface of the top plate, a mounting platform is arranged on a fixing frame above the top plate, a rotary table device is rotatably arranged below the mounting plate on the top plate, a plurality of clamp devices for fixing workpieces are arranged on the rotary table device, a feeding device, an injection molding device, a water gap material taking-out device and a discharging device which are arranged in an equidistant and encircling manner are sequentially arranged on the outer side of the rotary table device, an electric detection device is arranged on the top plate corresponding to the discharging device, and the rotary table device, the feeding device, the injection molding device, the water gap material taking-out device, the discharging device and the electric detection device are electrically connected with a control system together.
