The application constructs a high-efficiency, high-precision and high-stability full-automatic injection molding production system through integrating a turntable assembly line, a multi-station automatic device and a centralized control system.

title_en: Greenbelt trimming equipment for greening engineering
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of green belt trimming, and provides green belt trimming equipment for a green engineering, which comprises a trimming cutter and a collecting carriage, wherein a guide groove plate is arranged above the edge of the collecting carriage, a rotating shaft is arranged above the inner side end of the guide groove plate, the rotating shaft is fixedly connected with the guide groove plate through a connecting rod, an inclined plate is fixedly connected with the outer side surface of the rotating shaft, a clamping assembly is arranged at the outer side end of the inclined plate, a first hydraulic cylinder is rotatably arranged on the outer side surface of the collecting carriage, the telescopic end of the first hydraulic cylinder is rotatably connected with the outer side end of the guide groove plate, the first hydraulic cylinder is controlled to extend, the guide groove plate is inclined upwards, the clamping assembly is simultaneously moved inwards, and a second hydraulic cylinder is further arranged on the collecting carriage, and the telescopic end of the second hydraulic cylinder is connected with the body of the trimming cutter. The invention can clamp the branches in the process of pruning, avoid splashing of the branches during pruning, and collect the pruned branches.

title_en: Anchor recess Kong Zaomao robot capable of autonomous walking and operation and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of autonomous walking and beam-end operation robots, and particularly relates to an anchor pocket Kong Zaomao robot capable of autonomous walking and operation and a control method thereof. The technical scheme is that the anchor pocket Kong Zaomao robot capable of automatically walking and operating comprises an independent walking chassis, a multi-degree-of-freedom mechanical arm, a vision camera, a roughening operation tool and a quick-change disc, wherein the independent walking chassis is provided with front and rear double steering wheel driving, the top of the independent walking chassis is connected with the fixed end of the multi-degree-of-freedom mechanical arm, the multi-degree-of-freedom mechanical arm is provided with the fixed end and an executing end, the executing end of the multi-degree-of-freedom mechanical arm is detachably connected with the roughening operation tool through the quick-change disc, the executing end of the multi-degree-of-freedom mechanical arm is arranged on the main disc side of the quick-change disc, the vision camera is arranged on the executing end of the multi-degree-of-freedom mechanical arm, and the roughening operation tool is arranged on the tool disc side of the quick-change disc.

title_en: Grape trellis over-and-under type operation platform device of picking
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of grape picking, and discloses a grape trellis lifting type picking operation platform device, which comprises a mobile lifter main body and an aluminum alloy flat plate, wherein the aluminum alloy flat plate is arranged at the upper end of the mobile lifter main body, a picking platform assembly is arranged at the upper end of the aluminum alloy flat plate, the picking platform assembly comprises an elastic mounting bottom plate which is connected at the upper end of the aluminum alloy flat plate through bolts, and the technical problem of vertical impact when an existing rigid platform bumps is solved by arranging an I-shaped elastic mounting bottom plate.

title_en: Bionic airflow time sequence coupling control method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bionic airflow time sequence coupling control method and a bionic airflow time sequence coupling control system, and belongs to the technical field of insect pest prevention and control. The method comprises the steps of controlling a CO2 release port to release CO2 gas in a bionic pulse mode to simulate the expiration stage of human body respiration, controlling an air suction port to start negative pressure inspiration in response to the stop of CO2 release to simulate the inspiration stage of human body respiration, and enabling CO2 release and negative pressure inspiration to be alternately performed in time to form a complete bionic rhythm of one breath. The invention also provides a multi-wind-port dynamic scheduling scheme, wherein a plurality of CO2 release ports and a plurality of wind suction ports are distributed in different directions of the shell, and the current working mode of each wind port is independently determined through a preset algorithm according to mosquito distribution information or trapping effect data, and the working mode of each wind port is dynamically updated in time. The intelligent bionic mosquito-attracting control system realizes intelligent bionic mosquito-attracting control in two dimensions of time and space.

title_en: Secondary battery manufacturing system and method for manufacturing secondary battery
abstract_en: According to an exemplary embodiment, a method of manufacturing a secondary battery is provided. The manufacturing method may include the steps of aligning the bottom pocket and the cover pocket, wherein each of the bottom pocket and the cover pocket includes a sealing material layer, a protective layer, and a metal layer between the sealing material layer and the protective layer, and the sealing material layer of the bottom pocket is aligned to face the sealing material layer of the cover pocket, and irradiating a laser beam to first sealing portions of the bottom pocket and the cover pocket. The wavelength of the laser beam may be in the range of 0.01 μm to 0.1 μm, or in the range of 0.8 μm to 1.0 μm.

title_en: Bubble type centering pot for quail eggs
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bubble type centering pot for quail eggs, which relates to the technical field of quail egg processing equipment and comprises a frame, an outer pot, an inner pot, a blanking mechanism and a bubble generation system, wherein the outer pot is fixed at the lower end of the frame, the inner pot is arranged in the outer pot, the frame is provided with a U-shaped clamping seat and a connecting seat for centering the inner pot, heating boxes with leakage-proof rubber mats and temperature controllers are detachably arranged on two sides of the outer pot, a porous box and a heating pipe are arranged in the inner pot, a water injection pipe and a connecting rod with impellers are further arranged on two sides of the outer pot, the bubble generation system comprises mounting strips, ventilation rigid pipes, an air pump and the like, bubbles can be uniformly discharged, the inner pot is provided with a pot door, a pull ring, a rotating block, a limiting column, a built-in supporting frame and a quail egg placement assembly, and the blanking mechanism adjusts the position of the inner pot through a main shaft, a traction steel cable, a regulating motor and the like.

title_en: Hardening paint for PET precoating film, preparation method thereof and paint film
abstract_en: The invention relates to a hardening paint for PET precoating film, a preparation method thereof and a paint film. The coating comprises a primer coating and a top coating, wherein the primer coating consists of epoxy modified acrylic ester, polyurethane modified acrylic ester, a photoinitiator, a cationic initiator, a leveling agent and an organic solvent, and the top coating consists of polyurethane modified acrylic ester, a photoinitiator, an organic fluorosilicone auxiliary agent, a reactive diluent, a filler and an organic solvent. The primer adopts epoxy modified acrylic ester and polyurethane modified acrylic ester, a free radical photoinitiator and cationic initiator double-initiation system is matched, the top coat adopts polyurethane modified acrylic ester as a main body, and an organic fluorosilicone auxiliary agent and a functional filler are matched, so that the hardness, hydrophobicity and wear resistance of the coating are synchronously improved.

title_en: Bird friendly device with UV spectral patterns
abstract_en: The bird friendly glass within the window is configured to reduce the likelihood of birds flying into it. For this purpose, the glass is preferably a layered structure having an outer layer, an inner layer and an intermediate layer between the inner layer and the outer layer. In particular, the intermediate layer may adhere to the inner surface of the outer layer and to the inner surface of the inner layer. To protect birds, the intermediate layer includes one or more ultraviolet absorbing coatings that produce a spectral pattern upon exposure to ultraviolet light (e.g., radiation). Ideally, the goal is to make the glass transparent enough for human use while still making the glass visible to birds. The ultraviolet absorbing coating may include a luminophore for inclusion into a Luminescent Solar Concentrator (LSC) to generate photovoltaic power, among other things. The bird friendly interlayer can serve the dual function of a bird friendly glass and a power generator.

When the parking is needed, the axle is braked by the parking module, so that the parking device is simple in operation structure and convenient to park rapidly and conveniently.

title_en: Biodegradable polyethylene breathable film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of polymer packaging materials and sanitary materials, and particularly relates to a biodegradable polyethylene breathable film and a preparation method thereof, wherein the biodegradable polyethylene breathable film comprises a PE base material and a degradable master batch, and the degradable master batch comprises the following raw materials, by weight, 70 parts of polypropylene, 20 parts of polycaprolactone, 5-8 parts of maleic anhydride grafted polypropylene, 0.3-0.5 part of amine stearate, 0.1-0.3 part of erucamide and 0.1-1.0 part of stearic acid. The biodegradable polyethylene breathable film prepared by the invention is obviously superior to the traditional PE film and the existing degradable PE film products in degradation performance, and achieves the expected technical target.

title_en: Flexible composite film material, flexible composite film, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a flexible composite film material, a flexible composite film, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of semiconductor test materials. The flexible composite film material comprises, by mass, 47% -83% of fluorine-containing polyamide acid, 5% -15% of core-shell structured nano filler, 10% -30% of thermotropic liquid crystal polymer and 2% -8% of modified aramid fiber grafted with benzoxazole structure. The flexible composite film material provided by the invention forms a synergistic effect through the fluorine-containing polyamide acid, the core-shell structured nano filler, the thermotropic liquid crystal polymer and the modified aramid fiber, so that the prepared flexible composite film has good flexibility, high temperature resistance, mechanical property and low dielectric loss, and can meet the long-term stable use requirements of related scenes of flexible electronic devices and semiconductor tests.

title_en: Creep-resistant laser melting flange chassis and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a creep-resistant laser melting flange chassis and a preparation method thereof, which relate to the field of green manufacture and belong to the technical field of plating of metal materials, and comprise the steps of preprocessing a matrix to construct a thermodynamic initial field; the preparation method comprises the steps of preparing modified alloy powder based on IN738LC and added with niobium, silicon, hafnium and carbon, forming a transition layer containing IN-situ generated NbN nano particles and a self-healing liquid film network IN a micro-oxygen nitrogen atmosphere by laser melting IN the first stage, constructing a creep-resistant main structure by controlling energy density and cooling rate to induce positive segregation of niobium element to strengthen dendrite stems and negative segregation of silicon element to strengthen dendrite interdendrite, and finally converting a brittle sigma phase and a Laves phase into a nano-level crystal boundary pinning phase and a spherical dislocation pinning phase by hot isostatic pressing, directional recrystallization and two-stage aging treatment.

title_en: Analysis method and application of rhizosphere microbial community structure of fritillaria cirrhosa cultivated
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of soil microorganism analysis, in particular to an analysis method and application of a microbial community structure of a rhizosphere of fritillaria cirrhosa. The method comprises the following steps of sample collection and treatment, soil physicochemical property determination, gene sequencing, 16S amplification sequencing and high-throughput sequencing, and data analysis, wherein the data analysis comprises the steps of carrying out microbial community diversity analysis, community composition analysis, differential group analysis, community structure difference analysis and correlation analysis of the soil physicochemical property and microbial communities. The dominant bacterial flora and the physicochemical property of the rhizosphere soil bacteria of the fritillaria cirrhosa are determined to regulate and control the dominant bacterial flora, so that a theoretical basis is provided for standardized planting and screening of geographic seed sources with excellent microorganism interaction capability of the fritillaria cirrhosa, and the yield and medicinal components of the fritillaria cirrhosa cultivated are improved.

According to the invention, through constructing the replaceable training models of different case classifications, setting the detection structure and combining the post-operation three-dimensional scanning registration and objective scoring output, the quantitative evaluation of the training process and training results is realized, and the authenticity, pertinence and objectivity of training are improved.

abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the rifle lamp, a conveniently change rifle lamp structure of battery package is related to, include: lamp body and battery package, be formed with an accommodation space on the lamp body, the battery package install in the accommodation space, all be equipped with the spacing groove on the relative both sides wall in the accommodation space, all be equipped with the elasticity buckle on the relative both sides wall on the battery package, the elasticity buckle passes the spacing groove is located the accommodation space is outside, so that the battery package can be fixed in the accommodation space, just the position of elasticity buckle, quantity with the position of spacing groove, quantity suit, the bottom of accommodation space still is equipped with pops out the part, pop out the part with the diapire butt of battery package. Its advantage lies in, when the battery package electric quantity in the rifle lamp runs out, can dismantle the change fast with the battery package in the rifle lamp to promote the user experience when using the rifle lamp.

title_en: Greenhouse capable of being opened at two ends
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a greenhouse capable of being opened at two ends, which comprises a greenhouse main body and two integral fans respectively arranged at two ends of the greenhouse main body, wherein the top ends of the integral fans are rotatably connected with the greenhouse main body, and the bottom ends of the integral fans can be contacted with the ground; two fixed frames are arranged in the greenhouse main body corresponding to each integral fan, each fixed frame is connected with the corresponding integral fan through a gas spring, one end of each gas spring is hinged with the integral fan, and the other end of each gas spring is hinged with the fixed frame; each integral fan is provided with an access door. The utility model discloses a big-arch shelter that can both ends open can make things convenient for the mechanized operation in the big-arch shelter.

title_en: Hydrocone type hydroponic device and accessory
abstract_en: The application provides a hydrocone type hydroponic device and accessory, this hydrocone type hydroponic device includes: a non-contact sensor; the timer, the water pipe, the water pipe fittings, the built-in joint bottle caps, the built-in spacer water pipe fittings and the bottle cap joints form a multilayer siphon type water culture device, a bottomless bottle is arranged on a bottle cap joint, a planting cup is arranged in the bottomless bottle, a water pump pumps water to the top layer to ensure that plant roots are submerged in the water, when the water level reaches the top of a siphon tube, siphon is generated by the siphon, when the non-contact sensor on the siphon monitors that liquid passes through the tube, the high potential of the timer is given, the power supply of the water pump is closed within 1 minute by the timer, the water on the upper layer is sucked to the lower layer through the siphon, when the water level of the lower layer is lower than the siphon pipe of the lower layer, the siphon pipe of the lower layer also produces siphon to suck the water of the lower layer away, the plant root system can breathe in the air, the nutrient solution filled in the bottle flows into the pipeline in a micro amount during each siphon, and the micro amount is added, so that the plant growth is benefited.

title_en: Oil boiling pot
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of food manufacturing, in particular to an oil boiling pot which comprises a pot body, wherein the pot body is provided with an installation part in a crossing manner, and two ends of the installation plate are respectively and fixedly connected to the side surface of the pot body; the middle point of the mounting plate is provided with a mounting hole, a mounting column is rotatably connected in the mounting hole, the mounting column is vertically arranged, the mounting column extends into the pot body, the side surface of the part of the mounting column extending into the pot body is fixedly connected with a plurality of stirring plates, and the plurality of stirring plates are circumferentially arranged by taking the mounting column as an axis; a containing cavity is formed in the stirring plate, an extending groove is formed in the end face, close to the inner wall of the pot body, of the stirring plate, the extending groove is communicated with the containing cavity, a cleaning plate is arranged in the containing cavity, and a driving assembly for driving the stirring plate to move out of the extending groove is arranged in the mounting column; the mounting panel top is equipped with drive mounting post pivoted runner assembly, and this application has for the convenience carries out abluent effect to the oil cooker inner wall after finishing using.

title_en: Flange of wind power blade manufacturing die
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a flange of wind-powered electricity generation blade manufacturing mould, in the process of compound die of first ring flange and second ring flange, the first radial calibration breach of first ring flange and the second radial calibration breach of second ring flange splice and form the socket, then stretch into radial calibration piece to this socket in, utilize the effort of radial calibration piece to first radial calibration breach and second radial calibration breach, thereby make first radial calibration breach aim at the second radial calibration breach, avoid first radial calibration breach and second radial calibration breach to produce the dislocation in the radial direction, peg graft the first axial calibration plug connector of first ring flange and the second axial calibration plug connector of second ring flange simultaneously, avoid first ring flange and second ring flange to produce the dislocation in the axial direction, just so can guarantee that two ring flanges can not produce the dislocation in the compound die process, improve the accuracy of pre-buried bolt cover position, and the rejection rate is reduced.

title_en: Die capable of preventing product from being sticky
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mould capable of avoiding product adhesion, which comprises a mould main body, a rear mould core arranged on the mould main body and a front mould core matched with the rear mould core; the outer part of the front mold core is connected with the arranged fixing plate, the middle part of the front mold core is provided with a panel, the panel is connected with the arranged bottom plate, and the panel is also provided with a thimble; the bottom plate is connected with the fixing plate through a spring, when the front mold core and the rear mold core are separated, the ejector pins push products positioned in the two mold cores to move towards the rear mold core, so that the products are completely separated from the front mold core, and the products are prevented from being stuck on the front mold core; because the front die and the rear die are separated, the ejector pin is returned by depending on the collision surface of the return pin and the rear die core during die assembly, and the problems that the product is stuck on the front die and the product is heavy and cannot be normally produced are further avoided. By the proposal, the problem that the product is sticky and leads to the unable normal work of mould is effectively solved to this mould, consequently the utility model discloses be worth promoting and using.

title_en: Injection molding device with heating and cooling functions
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an injection molding device with heating and cooling functions, which comprises an upper plate and a bottom plate which are arranged up and down relatively; an air cylinder is arranged above the upper plate, and the driving end of the air cylinder is connected with an air cylinder rod extending to the lower part of the upper plate; the cylinder rod is connected with an upper die, a hollowed upper die core is arranged at the lower part of the upper die, a lower die is arranged on the bottom plate, a hollowed lower die core is arranged at the upper part of the lower die, and the upper die core and the lower die core form a die cavity after the upper die and the lower die are contacted; an injection molding pipe communicated with the upper mold core is also arranged in the upper mold; and a mechanism for heating and cooling the mold cavity is also arranged, so that the rapid molding of the injection mold is realized.

title_en: Granary
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a granary, which comprises a granary body, a refrigerating device, an air duct structure and an exhaust fan, wherein the refrigerating device is arranged in the granary body and is higher than a grain loading line; the air duct structure is arranged on the inner wall of the bin body and is arranged along the length direction of the bin body, the air duct structure is provided with a first air duct and a second air duct which extend along the vertical direction and are arranged in parallel, the lower port of the first air duct is communicated with the lower port of the second air duct, the upper port of the second air duct penetrates through the air duct structure, and the upper port of the second air duct is higher than the grain loading line; the exhaust fan is arranged in the bin body, and the upper port of the first air channel is communicated with the exhaust fan; the first air duct is provided with a first side wall adjacent to the inner wall, and the first side wall is made of heat-insulating materials; the second air duct is provided with a second side wall far away from the inner wall, and the second side wall is made of heat conducting materials. The utility model discloses aim at solving the "hot skin" problem of the grain that is close to the wall body lateral wall.

title_en: Novel litchi is clean device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel litchi is clean device, including first box and baffle, the right side below opening part of first box has the baffle through a plurality of bolt threaded connection, rotating device is installed to the inside below of first box. This novel litchi cleaning device, through first motor, mutually support between first helical gear and the second box isotructure, can drive the second helical gear through first motor and rotate, the second helical gear drives first helical gear and rotates, first helical gear drives the second box and rotates, thereby make the abluent more even of litchi, through the second motor, the threaded rod, the second gear, mutually support between connecting rod and the convex pole isotructure, the output shaft that can pass through the second motor drives the threaded rod and rotates, the threaded rod drives the second gear and rotates, the second gear drives the convex pole through the connecting rod and removes, make the convex pole drive water storage pipe and shower nozzle and remove, thereby the cleaning performance of litchi has been improved.

title_en: Canal dykes and dams view platform structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a canal dykes and dams view platform structure, including oblique barricade, the barricade inboard is equipped with the water proof coating to one side, and the inside rock layer that is equipped with of water proof coating, rock layer inboard is equipped with reinforced concrete layer, barricade outside fixedly connected with warning baffle to one side, the first view platform of barricade upside fixedly connected with to one side, first view platform outside fixedly connected with switching round platform, and switching round platform outside fixedly connected with second view platform, second view platform downside fixedly connected with connecting block. The utility model provides a current canal dykes and dams view platform simple structure, only single view platform, can not the omnidirectional watch the scene, lead to the visitor not good of viewing and admiring effect, its protection and warning effect are not enough simultaneously, and the security is lower, has further reduced the problem of the practicality of view platform, and this canal dykes and dams view platform structure possesses the advantage of all-round sight scene, has improved the practicality of view platform.

title_en: Ware is picked to seedpod of lotus
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a ware is picked to seedpod of lotus belongs to agricultural product equipment technical field. The ware is picked to seedpod of lotus includes: the cutting assembly comprises a fixed part and a movable part which are hinged with each other, cutting edges are arranged on the side edges of the fixed part opposite to the movable part, the fixed assembly comprises a first arc-shaped fixed piece and a second arc-shaped fixed piece, the first arc-shaped fixed piece is arranged on the fixed part, the second arc-shaped fixed piece is arranged on the movable part, and an opening of the first arc-shaped fixed piece is opposite to an opening of the second arc-shaped fixed piece; the fixed part is fixed in the end of handheld telescopic link, and handheld telescopic link can drive the relative fixed part rotation of movable part to make the sword blade part of movable part and the sword blade part looks butt of fixed part. The lotus seedpod is accommodated while being sheared, the lotus seedpod is prevented from dropping after being picked, the picking and the use are convenient, the structure is simple, and the picking efficiency is improved while the labor intensity is reduced.

title_en: Irrigation system for lemon planting production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fruit tree planting tools, and discloses an irrigation system for lemon planting production, which comprises a cart plate, wherein a liquid storage tank is arranged on one surface of the cart plate, which is far away from the ground, and the liquid storage tank comprises a first water tank, a second medicine tank and a control assembly, and the first water tank is communicated with the second medicine tank through a circulation pipeline; first water tank disposes first drain pipe, the second medical kit disposes the second drain pipe, the tip of second drain pipe disposes detects the head, it is equipped with humidity transducer to detect the head, humidity transducer with the control assembly electricity is connected. This application is through setting up first water tank and second medical kit, and first water tank is used for satisfying the irrigation demand to the lemon tree, and the second medical kit satisfies the root irrigation demand to the lemon tree, because the used root irrigation liquid medicine of lemon fruit tree need examine according to the humidity to current soil, regulates and control the concentration of liquid medicine according to humidity.

title_en: Stirring compounding device that production livestock-raising fodder was used
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a stirring and mixing device for producing livestock breeding feed, which comprises a mixing box, a stirring shaft which is arranged in the mixing box and is driven by a stirring motor, a material sweeping frame, a mixing support frame and a scraping plate which are sequentially arranged on the stirring shaft from top to bottom; wherein the sweeping frame is provided with a sweeping brush attached to the inner wall of the mixing box; material combing rods for stirring materials are uniformly arranged on the material mixing support frame at intervals; the top of the mixing box is provided with a feed inlet. In the application, the material entering the mixing box is subjected to primary hot air drying by utilizing the air blower, the heater and the blast pipe as the feeding of the feeding hole, so that the uniform dispersion of the material entering the mixing box is ensured; in addition, the material combing rod and the material mixing support frame are used as a comb to mix the crushed materials, wherein the material combing rod has a certain inclination angle, so that the material is treated and stirred, and the uniform material mixing efficiency is further improved.

title_en: Thermosetting plastic injection molding mould
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of molds, and discloses a thermosetting plastic injection molding mold, which comprises an upper mold, a lower mold, a base, a positioning ring and a runner bushing, wherein the upper mold, the lower mold and the base are sequentially stacked from top to bottom; the middle part of going up the mould has seted up sprue and cover groove, install the heater in the cover groove, the top opening of sprue is linked together with the bottom of runner bush, the middle part through-hole of heater is linked together with the bottom opening of sprue. The utility model discloses can carry out the continuous heating to the thermosetting plastic raw materials for thermosetting plastic remains the melting flow state throughout and does not solidify, has guaranteed going on smoothly of injection moulding, has avoided thermosetting plastic to produce pouring waste material because of the local solidification, is favorable to saving raw and other materials, has wide market prospect, does benefit to the popularization.

title_en: Curved surface screen optical film attaches device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an attached device of curved surface screen optical film, including workstation subassembly, pressure membrane subassembly and fixed curved surface screen subassembly. The workbench component comprises a workbench connected with the ground, fixing plates symmetrically arranged on the left side and the right side of the top of the workbench, a thin rod fixedly connected with the front side of the fixing plates, a telescopic rod connected with the inner side of the thin rod and a slotted hole formed in the top of the telescopic rod. The film pressing component comprises an optical film connected with the top of the slotted hole and a film pressing column arranged on the top of the optical film. The fixed curved screen assembly comprises a curved plate connected with the top of the workbench, a curved groove formed in the top of the curved plate and a rectangular groove connected with the right side of the curved groove. This attached device of curved surface screen optical film has simple mechanism and lower cost, has reduced the possibility that optical film produced the bubble, and the convenient curved surface screen that will paste the optical film takes out, makes things convenient for placing of film, makes things convenient for personnel to carry out the optical film subsides and applies.

title_en: Anti-collision mounting structure of single-cylinder sighting telescope and single-cylinder sighting telescope
abstract_en: The utility model provides a crashproof mounting structure and single section of thick bamboo gun sight of single section of thick bamboo gun sight. The anti-collision mounting structure comprises a lens body, an objective lens outer cylinder, an objective lens inner cylinder, a prism barrel and a prism compression ring, wherein the prism compression ring is arranged between the prism barrel and the objective lens outer cylinder; the objective lens outer cylinder comprises a first connecting peripheral wall, a second connecting peripheral wall and a limiting boss protruding between the first connecting peripheral wall and the second connecting peripheral wall; the lens body is provided with an end part peripheral wall, the whole lens outer cylinder is positioned on the inner periphery of the end part peripheral wall, and the first connecting peripheral wall is connected with the end part peripheral wall; the objective lens inner cylinder is integrally positioned on the inner periphery of the objective lens outer cylinder and is connected with the second connecting peripheral wall; two ends of the prism compression ring are respectively abutted against the prism barrel and the limiting boss. The monocular scope includes an anti-collision mounting structure. The utility model discloses make the striking can not direct action on objective lens subassembly, prevent that objective lens subassembly's pine from taking off, guarantee long-term validity and increase of service life that single section of thick bamboo gun sight used.

title_en: Pig's hoof section sprays belt cleaning device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a pig trotter section spray cleaning device, which comprises a cleaning frame body and a cover plate, wherein the cover plate is arranged above the cleaning frame body, a filter screen is arranged at a lower position inside the cleaning frame body, and a vibration component is arranged at the bottom of the filter screen; a rotating rod is rotatably connected inside the cleaning frame body and above the filter screen, wherein a plurality of blades are arranged on the outer side of the rotating rod at equal intervals; two movable rods are arranged at the top of the cleaning frame body. In the utility model, the pig trotters are placed in the cleaning frame body for automatic spraying and cleaning by arranging the cleaning frame body, the automation degree is high, the condition of poor pollution caused by hands of multiple people can be avoided, and the manpower resource is saved; fix the water pipe on the movable rod simultaneously, the first motor of movable rod accessible drives, and then the angle of adjustable automatic water spray makes the pig's hoof spray and wash more thoroughly, sets up dwang and blade simultaneously and can drive the upset of pig's hoof, improves the abluent efficiency of pig's hoof, saves the scavenging period.

title_en: Nursery stock cultivation auxiliary device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a nursery stock cultivation instrument technical field, concretely relates to nursery stock cultivation auxiliary device. Including two first arc mounts of mutual symmetry, two first arc mounts butt joints, form first tubulose fixed knot and construct, be equipped with a plurality of mounting grooves in the inside of first arc mount, install detachable supporting mechanism in the mounting groove, the one end of keeping away from first arc mount on the supporting mechanism is equipped with a plurality of locating support, the locating support includes a plurality of subsections, each subsection forms the contained angle of different angles with first tubulose fixed knot constructs's axis respectively, and all be equipped with the installation through-hole on each subsection, the installation through-hole is used for erection bracing pole. The utility model discloses can form stable support to the nursery stock, effectively prevent it from falling on one side, and through the different segmentation designs of locating support to according to the selection of the ground actual conditions support angle around the nursery stock, improve the suitability of device.

title_en: Breeding basin for willow orchid breeding experiments
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a breeding equipment technical field, concretely relates to willow orchid breeding is breeding basin for experiment, including placing the case, the bottom of placing the case is provided with the bottom plate, the inside of placing the case is provided with floats the board, float and evenly seted up a plurality of spliced eyes on the board, the position department that floats the board and correspond a plurality of spliced eyes all is provided with placement machine and constructs, placement machine constructs including placing shell one and placing shell two. The utility model discloses in, position department through corresponding a plurality of spliced eyes at floating the board all is provided with placement machine and constructs to place in the top of placing the sponge through the seed with willow orchid, recycle and float the board and float the case and be convenient for support the placement machine who places willow orchid seed, and utilize the support through-hole to make the bottom and the nutrient solution contact of placing shell one and placing shell two, and utilize round hole one and round hole two to be convenient for place the sponge and absorb the nutrient solution, thereby the seed of willow orchid of being convenient for absorbs the nutrient solution, the breeding effect of willow orchid has been increased.

title_en: Concrete stirring production line
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a technical field of stirring production line discloses a stirring production line of concrete, its transport mechanism including the transportation material and the rabbling mechanism to the material stirring mixture, the transport mechanism includes two backup pads and the conveyer belt that are parallel to each other, two all be provided with the guide subassembly in the backup pad, the guide subassembly includes the spring towards conveyer belt one end fixed connection with the backup pad, the one end fixedly connected with deflector of backup pad is kept away from to the spring, the lower terminal surface of deflector pastes with the up end of conveyer belt, the length direction of deflector is the acute angle with the contained angle of the direction of transportation of conveyer belt, and this application has the effect that prevents that the material from dropping from the conveyer belt.

title_en: Plastic extruder
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a plastic extruder, belonging to the technical field of plastic extruders, which has the technical proposal that the plastic extruder comprises a bottom plate, different plastic particles are poured into a mixing cylinder, a first motor drives a mounting frame and the mixing cylinder to rotate, meanwhile, the second motor drives the driving wheel and the driven wheel to rotate, so that the rotating rod drives the stirring rod to rotate in the mixing cylinder, so that two different plastic particles in the mixing cylinder can be uniformly mixed by the rotation of the mixing cylinder and the rotation of the stirring rod, the mixed material body is discharged into the conveying cylinder, and then the third motor drives the threaded rod to rotate, meanwhile, the heating of the heating plate and the electric resistance wire and the mutual matching of the heating pipe can realize the heating of the interior of the conveying cylinder, which is beneficial to the plasticization of plastics, and simultaneously, the plasticized material body can be discharged out of the conveying cylinder through the discharge hole by the rotation of the threaded rod, thereby realizing the uniform mixing of different plastic particles and improving the efficiency of plastic plasticization.

title_en: PFA plastic pipe bending tool
abstract_en: The utility model provides a PFA plastic pipe bending tool, which comprises a bending platform, a fixed pipe clamp, a guide pin and a guide wheel; the bending platform is placed in a production space, the fixed pipe clamp is located on the bending platform, the guide pin penetrates through the pipe clamp, the guide pin is located on one side of the fixed pipe clamp and fixed on the bending platform, and the bending platform freely rotates and is abutted to the bent plastic pipe excircle. The utility model provides a pair of PFA plastic pipe frock of bending, plastic pipe after passing through this frock multiunit guide pulley for the heating provides removal power, make it move along inside uide pin, until the region of buckling reaches the specified size, set up the haulage rope simultaneously in the uide pin, for the support that the uide pin provided, the fixing of uide pin when realizing the plastic pipe motion, the process of will buckling keeps at the uniform velocity and guarantees the size of buckling, improve the efficiency of buckling, reduce the safety risk that high temperature plastic pipe brought.

title_en: Internet of things emergency broadcast with voice enhancement function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a from emergent broadcasting of thing networking of taking pronunciation enhanced feature, the on-line screen storage device comprises a base, the top fixedly connected with fixed sleeve of base, fixed sleeve's inside is provided with the bracing piece, the outside top of bracing piece is provided with top protective structure, the front end of megaphone is provided with horn mouth protective structure, fixed sleeve's inside is provided with high adjustment mechanism, and this from emergent broadcasting of thing networking of taking pronunciation enhanced feature is through being provided with hydraulic cylinder, stable cover, fixed hand wheel and spacing hole, during the use, when needs maintain the inspection to top equipment, hydraulic cylinder starts, draws back the bracing piece, and the back is finished in the maintenance, and hydraulic cylinder pushes up the bracing piece, when pushing away predetermined height, and hydraulic cylinder stops promoting, and fixed hand wheel and spacing hole mutually support and make bracing piece rigidity.

title_en: Calf breeds and uses breast-feed device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a calf breeds and uses breast-feed device relates to the cultured equipment field. This calf breeds and uses breast-feed device includes: the bottom of the front surface of the milk storage frame is fixedly connected with a plurality of nipples; the milk storage frame is connected with the two supporting strips in a sliding manner, the back surfaces of the two supporting strips are fixedly connected with two first clamps, and the back surfaces of the two supporting strips are fixedly connected with two second clamps; the milk storage frame comprises a limiting assembly, wherein the limiting assembly is assembled on the back face of the milk storage frame and is connected with a clamping tooth, a tooth groove is formed in the inner wall of the fixing strip, and the clamping tooth is clamped with the tooth groove. This calf breeds and uses breast-feed device, highly adjusting of storing up milk frame and nipple to great having made things convenient for the calf to suck the nipple.

title_en: Automatic cooling equipment of cake
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of automatic cooling sets up, a automatic cooling equipment of cake is related to, including brace table, first bearing and first pivot, still including the movable table, first bearing fixed connection is at the brace table upper surface, and first pivot is worn to establish in first bearing, and movable table fixed connection is in first pivot upper end, and fixed surface is connected with the cylinder on the movable table, and the cylinder surface is provided with first driving belt. Its beneficial effect is, the automatic cooling equipment of this cake, through setting up cooling body, screw thread post and screw cap, when operating personnel need accelerate the cooling rate of food, operating personnel only need through control switch control cooling body function, through control switch control second motor function simultaneously, thereby it rotates to drive the screw thread post, under the cooperation of screw thread post and screw cap, thereby the fly leaf that the drive was loaded with cooling body carries out reciprocal function from top to bottom, make the food of placing on first drive belt surface can the accelerated cooling, the device's practicality has been improved.

title_en: Seedling raising bed for pepper planting
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a seedling raising bed for pepper planting, which comprises two side vertical plates and a plurality of seedling raising mechanisms, wherein the seedling raising mechanisms are positioned between the two side vertical plates, each seedling raising mechanism comprises a placing seat and a seedling raising box without a cover, the outer wall of the top of the placing seat is provided with an inserting groove, the seedling raising boxes are inserted into the inserting grooves, the inner walls of the inserting grooves are fixedly connected with a plurality of rows of heightening heads, the tops of the heightening heads are in contact with the bottom of the seedling raising box, the inner walls of four sides of the seedling raising box, which are close to the bottom, are fixedly provided with a same grid through bolts, the outer walls of the four sides of the seedling raising box are provided with a plurality of groups of through holes, the outer wall of the bottom of the placing seat is provided with a plurality of groups of annularly distributed waist-shaped holes, and folded water leakage shells are inserted into the waist-shaped holes. The seedling bed for pepper planting can be used for facilitating carrying and watering of pepper seedlings by workers, facilitating independent planting of the pepper seedlings by the workers, and improving the use convenience of the seedling bed.

title_en: Portable drilling equipment for interior decoration
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable drilling device for indoor decoration, which comprises movable frames, fixed frames and supporting frames, wherein the movable frames are slidably arranged on the inner sides of the fixed frames, connecting frames are fixedly arranged between the movable frames, clamping seats are movably arranged on the inner sides of the movable frames, limiting frames are fixedly arranged on the outer sides of the movable frames, springs are movably arranged between the limiting frames and the fixed frames, the supporting frames are movably arranged at the bottoms of the fixed frames through fixed columns, and threaded sleeves are movably arranged between the supporting frames and the fixed frames. According to the utility model, the support frame is movably arranged at the bottom of the fixed frame, the movable frame is pushed by the handle to drive the drilling machine to perform drilling operation, the stability during drilling can be kept by matching with the support frame, and the spring is arranged between the limiting frame and the fixed frame to drive the movable frame to reset, so that the working intensity of an operator is effectively reduced, and the working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Internal mixer for yoga mat generation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an internal mixer for yoga mat generation, which comprises a base, wherein a protective sleeve is arranged outside a transmission shaft between a main motor and a material groove, the protective sleeve comprises a first protective sleeve and a second protective sleeve, the first protective sleeve and the second protective sleeve are axially symmetrical and are attached to each other on the end faces, a fixing buckle is fixed on one end face of each of the first protective sleeve and the second protective sleeve, a fixing groove is formed in the end face of the other end of each of the first protective sleeve and the second protective sleeve, the fixing buckle and the fixing groove are mutually corresponding and fixed, a containing groove is formed in the inner wall of each of the first protective sleeve and the second protective sleeve, lubricating oil is arranged in the containing groove, oil outlet holes are formed in the inner surfaces of the first protective sleeve and the second protective sleeve, and the oil outlet holes are mutually communicated with the inner parts of the connecting holes; the transmission shaft between lag protection main motor and the silo, the inside lubricating oil of lag inner wall paints on the transmission shaft surface via the oil outlet simultaneously, and the transmission shaft operation is more smooth, and the lag is by first sheath and the concatenation combination of second sheath, is favorable to the dismouting maintenance of lag.

title_en: Water environment restoration device for polyculture pond
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of water environment restoration, and discloses a mixed culture pond water environment restoration device.A floating bed of aquatic plants floats on the water surface of a pond, and a biomembrane water purification grid vertically sinks to a position close to the bottom of the pond; the biomembrane water purification grid is provided with two ropes which are parallel up and down, two ends of each rope are fixed on the pond ridge through a wooden pile, and a plurality of linear nylon grids are tied between the two ropes; the aquatic plant floating bed is provided with a frame, and an upper layer mesh sheet and a lower layer mesh sheet are fixed on the inner side of the frame through nylon ribbons. The biomembrane water purification grid is used as a carrier of a microbial community to form a biomembrane, and the biomembrane is fully mixed with air and water to convert and degrade pollutants generated in the culture process, so that the biomembrane water purification grid has the advantages of simple structure, low cost, simple and convenient operation, small occupied space, high treatment efficiency and the like; the aquatic plant floating bed absorbs, absorbs and converts excessive nutrient substances in the water body through the plant root system, so that the water quality is improved, the cost is saved, and the landscape is beautified.

title_en: Pesticide sprinkler for agricultural plant protection
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of agricultural plants, in particular to a pesticide spraying device for agricultural plant protection, which comprises a device main body, wherein the device main body comprises a water tank, a water pump and a device transverse plate, the input end of the water pump is fixedly connected with the water tank, the output end of the water pump is fixedly connected with a spraying head, and one side of the device transverse plate is fixedly connected with a first contraction plate. According to the water tank, the water pump and the device transverse plate, when the device is used, a worker can rotate the rotating rod to drive the screw rod to rotate through the first bevel gear and the second bevel gear, when the screw rod rotates, the screw rod can move on the surface of the screw rod through the thread block to drive the lifting plate to lift, when the lifting plate descends, the device can be stabilized on the ground through the close fit of the supporting plate and the ground, the use stability of the device is improved, when the device rotates anticlockwise, the supporting plate can be folded, and at the moment, the universal wheels are tightly fit with the ground to enable the device to be convenient to move.

title_en: Cutting device of carbon fiber plate prepreg
abstract_en: The utility model provides a cutting device for carbon fiber plate prepreg, which comprises a bottom plate and a working frame, wherein the working frame comprises a working left plate, a working right plate and a working transverse plate, the upper end of the working transverse plate is respectively provided with a pushing mechanism and a limiting mechanism from left to right, the pushing mechanism comprises a pushing cylinder and a pushing vertical plate, the limiting mechanism comprises a front limiting piece and a rear limiting piece, and the cutting mechanism comprises a cutting cylinder, a cutting block, a cutting motor and a circular cutting knife. The utility model has the beneficial effects that: the front limiting piece and the rear limiting piece can limit the carbon fiber plate prepreg and can adapt to carbon fiber plate prepregs with different widths; the left lower pressing plate and the right lower pressing plate can fully fix the carbon fiber plate prepreg, so that the carbon fiber plate prepreg is prevented from moving during cutting, and the carbon fiber plate prepreg is conveniently and orderly cut; the waste bin can be retrieved the sweeps that produces after the cutting, prevents the polluted environment.

title_en: Production is moulded plastics injection molding machine belt cleaning device for spoon
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an injection molding machine cleaning device for producing an injection molding spoon, which comprises a base, wherein the outer wall of the top of the base is rotatably connected with a rotating seat, second scrapers which are equidistantly and circularly distributed are fixed on the arc-shaped outer wall of the rotating seat through bolts, a partition plate is fixed on the inner wall of the bottom of the rotating seat through bolts, two vertically arranged transmission rods are fixed on the inner wall of the bottom of the rotating seat, which is positioned in the middle of the partition plate, through bolts, the arc-shaped outer walls of the two transmission rods are slidably connected with a same transmission block, and two cleaning assemblies which are symmetrically arranged are fixed on the arc-shaped outer walls of the transmission block through bolts. According to the utility model, through the rotary seat, the second scraper and the partition plate, when the solid raw materials generated in the process of cleaning the hopper by the first scraper fall under the action of gravity, the solid raw materials are collected in the rotary seat by the second scraper and are blocked by the partition plate, so that the unified collection of the waste materials is realized, the solid waste materials are prevented from falling into the injection molding machine, and further, the potential safety hazard in the use process is avoided.

title_en: Roller for rubber processing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of rollers, in particular to a roller for rubber processing, which comprises a roller shaft, wherein a first roller body is connected to the left side of the outer end of the roller shaft in a matching manner, a second roller body is arranged at the right end of the first roller body and is connected with the roller shaft in a matching manner, a third roller body is arranged at the right end of the second roller body and is connected with the roller shaft in a matching manner, a fourth roller body is arranged at the right end of the third roller body and is connected with the roller shaft in a matching manner, a fifth roller body is arranged at the right end of the fourth roller body and is connected with the roller shaft in a matching manner, fixing rings are arranged at the outer ends of the first roller body and the fifth roller body and are connected with the roller shaft in a matching manner, connecting bolts are rotatably connected inside the fixing rings, and fixing bolts are inclined on the upper end surfaces of the fixing rings and are connected with the roller shaft in a matching manner. According to the utility model, the connecting bolt is convenient for disassembling and maintaining the first rolling body, the second rolling body, the third rolling body, the fourth rolling body and the fifth rolling body, so that the maintenance cost and time are greatly reduced.

title_en: Hot runner system and forming die of base are strengthened to garbage bin
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of injection molding, and particularly relates to a hot runner system of a garbage can reinforcing base and a forming mold. The hot runner system comprises a Y-shaped flow channel and a heating pipe which are arranged in the upper die core; the Y-shaped flow passage comprises a main flow passage section positioned at the upper part of the upper mold core, a pair of branch flow passage sections positioned at two sides of the lower part of the upper mold core and an inclined flow passage section connecting the branch flow passage sections to the main flow passage section; and a group of heating pipes are respectively arranged in the upper die core and positioned on two sides of the plane of the inclined flow channel section. In addition, the utility model also provides a corresponding forming mold based on the hot runner system. The hot runner system provided by the utility model can shorten the farthest distance for the injection molding liquid to flow in the mold cavity and optimize the process for spreading the injection molding liquid in the mold cavity. The forming die provided by the utility model adopts the hot runner system, so that the garbage can reinforced base which is uniform, compact and low in internal stress can be manufactured.

title_en: Automatic stub bar shearing device for plastic product injection molding production process
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic shearing device for a stub bar used in a plastic product injection molding production process, which comprises a support frame and a top plate arranged at the top of the support frame, wherein an upper injection mold and a lower injection mold are sequentially arranged in the support frame from top to bottom, an injection molding cavity is arranged between the upper injection mold and the lower injection mold, shearing mechanisms arranged in the upper injection mold and the lower injection mold are arranged at the left side and the right side of the injection molding cavity, the shearing mechanisms are powered by a power mechanism, an injection molding pipeline positioned between the shearing mechanisms is arranged at the top of the injection molding cavity, an injection molding box is arranged at the top of the injection molding pipeline, an extrusion plate powered by the power mechanism is arranged in the injection molding box, and a feeding hole is formed in the side surface of the injection molding box. This automatic shearing mechanism of stub bar for plastic products production technology that moulds plastics accessible cylinder drives the inside part of shearing mechanism and operates, accomplishes and cuts the work to the injection moulding plastic body, improves work efficiency and reduces worker's work burden.

title_en: Ultrasonic bird-repelling unmanned aerial vehicle based on solar energy
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a solar-energy-based ultrasonic bird-repelling unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises an eight-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle and a bird-repelling control box, wherein an ultrasonic sound-generating device and a controller are arranged in the bird-repelling control box, and the solar-energy-based ultrasonic bird-repelling unmanned aerial vehicle is characterized in that: the ultrasonic bird repelling unmanned aerial vehicle based on solar energy is characterized by further comprising an object stage and a solar energy storage device, wherein the object stage is arranged below the eight-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle, the bird repelling control box is arranged at the top of the object stage, and the object stage and the bird repelling control box are fixedly connected through bolts and nuts; the storage battery is used for storing electric energy and independently supplying power to the bird repelling control box, so that the power supply is stable, and the bird repelling work is stable; the solar energy storage device and the bird repelling control box as well as the bird repelling control box and the objective table are detachably connected, so that later-stage disassembly, maintenance and repair are easy.

title_en: Vitamin feed granulator that pig was used
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of pig feed granulators, and particularly relates to a vitamin feed granulator for pigs, which comprises a granulating box, wherein a partition plate is transversely and fixedly arranged in the granulating box, material leaking holes which are uniformly distributed are formed in the side wall of the partition plate, a material extruding pipe is fixedly arranged at the lower end of the right side wall of the granulating box, the granulating plate is fixedly arranged in the material extruding pipe, a mounting frame is fixedly arranged at the right end of the lower side wall of the granulating box, a bag supporting plate is fixedly arranged at the right end of the mounting frame, and a collecting bag is sleeved in the bag supporting plate, so that the collecting bag is convenient to fix, extruded feed particles are directly collected, manual secondary operation is not needed for bagging, the labor cost is reduced, and the collecting efficiency is increased.

title_en: Greenbelt for protecting barren side slope
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a green nutrition belt for barren side slope protection, which belongs to the field of nutrition belts and comprises a vegetation protection net and at least one substrate slow-release strip for releasing a nutrition substrate in water, wherein the at least one substrate slow-release strip is attached to the vegetation protection net at intervals. The green nutrient band for protecting the barren side slope of the green nutrient band for protecting the barren side slope can slowly release nutrient media, ensures that a vegetable layer in the side slope is supplied with long-time nutrition, and effectively solves the problem of uniform supply of the nutrient media.

title_en: Improved light amphibious multifunctional working machine for artificial wetland
abstract_en: An improved constructed wetland light amphibious multifunctional working machine relates to the field of agricultural machinery, and comprises a walking chassis, a crawler, a frame, an intelligent control room, an adjusting device and a working device, wherein the working device comprises a connecting seat and a cutting knife; the connecting seat is connected with a sliding rail, two groups of brakes are arranged on the sliding rail and connected through a movable oil cylinder, one group of brakes is connected with a wiping box, a wiping piece is arranged in the wiping box, and lubricating grease is arranged on the wiping piece; the brake includes intermediate junction plate and two blocks of curb plates, and the both ends of intermediate junction plate are articulated mutually with the curb plate respectively, and two blocks of curb plates set up respectively in the both sides of slide rail, and two blocks of curb plates pass through brake cylinder and connect, all connect the gyro wheel through the back shaft in the inboard of every curb plate, and the gyro wheel of both sides sets up respectively inside the both sides of slide rail, and the friction disc is all connected to the inner of two back shafts, and the friction disc separates or brakes with the slide rail. The utility model improves the mowing efficiency and prolongs the service life of the cutting knife.

title_en: Plastic pellet agitating unit
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of plastic processing, in particular to a plastic particle stirring device; the spring clamping device comprises a base and a worm, wherein a plurality of springs are clamped on the upper end face of the base, a limiting block is clamped on the top of each spring, a first through hole is formed in a central bearing of the limiting block, a first thread is formed in the first through hole, a second thread is formed on the outer wall of the upper end of the limiting block, a screw rod is meshed in the first thread, the worm is fixedly connected to the upper end face of the screw rod, a sleeve is sleeved on the outer wall of the worm, a first groove is formed in the lower end of the sleeve, a third thread meshed with the second thread is formed in the inner wall of the first groove, and a torsion spring is clamped on the outer wall of the limiting block; according to the utility model, the limiting block is matched with the worm through the threads, and the torsion spring is matched with the spring, so that when the motor is started, the cleaning port is closed, and when the motor is stopped, the cleaning port is opened, the cleaning process of the cleaning port is effectively reduced, and the stirring work efficiency of plastic granules is effectively improved.

title_en: Logistics turnover table mold with corner auxiliary stripping mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a logistics turnover disc mold with a corner auxiliary stripping mechanism, which comprises: lower die mechanism, upper die mechanism and frame, lower die mechanism fixed mounting is on table surface, lower die mechanism includes the die holder, central authorities take off the flitch, the frame takes off flitch and push rod, be provided with the die cavity on the die holder, the pressure injection pipe communicates to the die cavity, central authorities take off flitch elastic connection on the bottom surface of die cavity, be provided with elastic connection's frame on the die cavity relative side takes off the flitch, the die holder is worn to locate by the push rod, the tip of push rod and the bottom contact surface that central authorities take off the flitch are the inclined plane, frame fixed mounting is on table surface, upper die mechanism is including driving actuating cylinder, upper die base and compaction template, it installs in the frame to drive actuating cylinder fixed mounting, it connects the compaction template through the jar pole to drive actuating cylinder, the upper die base is worn to locate by the jar pole. The logistics turnover disc mold with the corner auxiliary stripping mechanism is convenient for improving stripping speed of the turnover disc after molding and improving production efficiency.

title_en: Five-axis cutting machine
abstract_en: The utility model provides a five-axis cutter, which comprises: a frame; the double-shaft cutting mechanism is arranged on the rack and comprises a Z-direction moving device arranged on the rack, an X-direction moving device is arranged on the Z-direction moving device, and the cutting device is arranged on the X-direction moving device; install the triaxial rotary positioning mechanism in biax cutting mechanism bottom, triaxial rotary positioning mechanism includes and installs the rail set in the frame bottom along the Y direction, and rotary positioning device installs on rail set for the Y that drive rotary positioning device removed along the Y direction is installed on rail set and is connected with rotary positioning device to drive arrangement. The five-axis cutting machine is high in automation and integration degree, can realize automatic accurate alignment and cutting of the cutting position of the water gap of the complex workpiece of the flow channel, and is high in cutting precision and efficiency.

title_en: Mould with mould ejection structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a die with a die ejection structure, which comprises the ejection structure of the die, wherein the die ejection structure comprises a lower panel, the lower panel is rotatably connected with a rotating disc, an upper panel is arranged on the lower panel, the upper panel is fixedly connected with the lower panel, a through hole is formed in the upper panel, the through hole is rotatably connected with a rotating disc, the rotating disc is abutted against the rotating disc, an ejector pin is arranged on the rotating disc, the ejector pin is fixedly connected with the rotating disc, and an included angle is formed between the ejector pin and the rotating disc. The utility model provides a die which can realize rotary ejection of a cross-flow wind wheel middle joint.

title_en: Novel bird equipment is driven in farmland
abstract_en: The utility model designs a novel farmland bird repelling device which comprises a base, a supporting rod, a shelf, a bird repelling wind wheel, a solar cell panel and an illuminating ball, wherein the supporting rod is installed on the base, the shelf is fixedly installed on the supporting rod by taking the supporting rod as an axis, the bird repelling wind wheel is connected with the supporting rod through a connecting rod, the solar cell panel is installed on an installation part fixedly connected with the supporting rod, and the illuminating ball is installed at the top end of the supporting rod. The utility model has strong bird repelling capability, can simulate dynamic living objects to scare birds by the bird repelling wind wheel to achieve the aim of repelling the birds, and can simulate the cry of natural enemies of the birds such as hawks to achieve the aim of repelling the birds by the loudspeaker. The shelf, the charging interface and the hook are provided on the premise of mainly driving birds, the comfort level of work working can be enhanced, the illuminating lamp can drive bird work at night, and the camera in the illuminating ball can record scenes in a farmland within a period of time.

title_en: Plastic product sorting equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses plastic product sorting equipment, wherein an impurity separation device is communicated with a first storage bin, the first storage bin is communicated with a label removing device, the label removing device is communicated with a disc screen, the disc screen is communicated with the feeding end of a first air injection optical selection device, the first discharging end of the first air injection optical selection device is communicated with a second storage bin, and the second storage bin is communicated with a first packing device; the dish sieve includes: the device comprises a shell, a plurality of rollers, a push rod and a slide rail, wherein slide blocks are arranged at two ends of each roller, the slide rail is vertically arranged on the shell, and the slide blocks are arranged in the slide rail in a sliding manner; the roller is rotatably arranged on the sliding block, the push rod is arranged on the roller and used for driving the roller to slide along the sliding rail. The sorting efficiency of the plastic products is improved through the arrangement of the first air-jet light sorting device; simultaneously through set up the dish sieve at first jet-propelled light selection device front end, through the cylinder at vertical direction reciprocating motion, make plastic products when the transportation, automatic with the plastic bottle horizontal, the sorting of the first jet-propelled light selection device of being convenient for.

title_en: In-mold water-break port structure of highlight product
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of dies, in particular to a water cut-off structure in a highlight product die, which comprises a die core, an elastic plate, an elastic block, a thimble, a reset piece and a return pin, wherein the die core is provided with a through hole matched with the elastic block; the upper end of the elastic block is provided with a forming groove which is communicated with the channel of the mold core; the ejector pins sequentially penetrate through the elastic plate and the elastic block and are respectively connected with the elastic plate and the elastic block in a sliding mode. The utility model aims to provide a water cut-off structure in a highlight product mould, which solves the problem of yield reduction.

title_en: Extruding machine head cooling device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a cooling device for a head of a plastic extruding machine in the technical field of cable production, which comprises a head of the plastic extruding machine and a guide chute, wherein a cooling device is arranged between the head of the plastic extruding machine and the guide chute, the cooling device comprises a water cooling assembly and an air cooling assembly, the water cooling assembly comprises a cooling tank, the cooling tank is slidably connected onto a cooling tank support, one end of the guide chute of the cooling tank is slidably connected into the guide chute, one end of the cooling tank, far away from the head of the plastic extruding machine, is communicated with a cooling water inlet hose, two ends of the cooling tank are respectively provided with an arc-shaped groove through which a cable sheath can pass, a flexible water blocking member is arranged in the arc-shaped groove, the air cooling assembly is arranged between the cooling tank and the head of the plastic extruding machine, the air cooling assembly comprises a circular air cooling box and an air blower, the circular air cooling box is sleeved outside the cable sheath, and a plurality of air outlets are uniformly distributed on the inner side of the circular air cooling box. The cable sheath cooling device is simple in structure, convenient to adjust, high in cooling efficiency and good in cooling effect, and can effectively protect the cable sheath in the cooling process.

title_en: Displacement meter system and geological disaster monitoring terminal
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a displacement meter system and a geological disaster monitoring terminal, wherein the displacement meter system comprises a displacement meter, a protective tube and a hoop, the displacement meter comprises a pull wire box and a pull wire, the pull wire box is arranged on a first buttress, an anchor rod is arranged far away from the first buttress, the pull wire is connected with the anchor rod and the pull wire box, the protective tube is used for being sleeved on the pull wire, the hoop is sleeved on the protective tube, and the hoop supports the protective tube to enable the pull wire not to be in contact with the tube wall of the protective tube. According to the displacement meter system, the protective pipe is sleeved on the pull wire, the hoop is sleeved on the protective pipe, the hoop supports the protective pipe to enable the pull wire to be far away from the pipe wall of the protective pipe, the situation that an animal walks to touch the protective pipe is avoided, the protective pipe is driven to touch the pull wire to enable the geological disaster monitoring terminal to report by mistake, and the situation that inspection personnel frequently go out to check the protective pipe to cause waste of manpower and material resources is avoided.

title_en: Modernized farming liquid manure integration system equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of agricultural planting, and discloses a modern agricultural planting water and fertilizer integrated system device which comprises a device body, wherein a feed inlet is formed in the upper surface of the device body, a water storage structure is arranged on the left side of the device body, a control structure is arranged on the outer wall of the device body, an observation window is fixedly installed on the front side of the outer wall of the device body, a fertilizer application structure is arranged on the right side of the device body, a support plate is fixedly connected to the outer wall of the right side of the device body, a motor is fixedly connected to the top of the device body, and a rotating shaft is fixedly connected to the output end of the motor. This modernized farming liquid manure integration system equipment, through the setting of sensor, can survey the inside remaining water height of equipment body through the sensor, then with the display screen of information transmission to the controller show liquid level information and with the pilot lamp suggestion needs add liquid manure, functional improvement, easy operation, convenient to use.

title_en: Air purification device for livestock breeding
