abstract_en: The utility model provides an air purification device for livestock breeding, which relates to the technical field of livestock breeding and comprises a purification box, wherein a dust removal mechanism is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the purification box, electric shutters are fixedly arranged on the periphery of the purification box and correspond to the position of the dust removal mechanism, a disinfection box is fixedly arranged on the top surface of the dust removal mechanism, a group of ultraviolet sterilizing lamps is fixedly arranged on the inner top wall of the disinfection box, a liquid storage cavity is fixedly arranged between the opposite surfaces of the disinfection box and the purification box, ventilation holes communicated with the liquid storage cavity are fixedly arranged on the periphery of the disinfection box, a liquid spraying ring pipe is fixedly arranged on the outer wall of the disinfection box and corresponds to the position of the liquid storage cavity, spraying holes are uniformly distributed on the bottom surface of the liquid spraying ring pipe, a liquid supplementing pipe, a circulating pump and a liquid level sensor are fixedly arranged on the side surface of the purification box respectively, one end of the liquid level sensor extends to the inside of the liquid storage cavity, be used for solving and lack one kind in the current livestock-raising field and carry out the problem that edulcoration purifies and sterilization and disinfection equipment to the air.

title_en: Waste slurry anti-splash equipment for concrete pipe centrifugal forming process
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of concrete, in particular to waste slurry anti-splash equipment for a centrifugal forming process of a concrete pipe, which is convenient for opening a cylinder cover, saves time and labor and improves the cleaning efficiency; including the centrifuge bowl, a pedestal, the hinge, the top cap, the water tank, the connecting plate, the suction pump, handheld pipe and sprinkler bead, centrifuge bowl bottom and base top fixed connection, the centrifuge bowl top is equipped with the opening, the multiunit top cap is rotated through the multiunit handle respectively and is installed on the centrifuge bowl top, every group top cap top all is equipped with the handle, water tank and base side are connected, the water tank top is equipped with the moisturizing pipe, connecting plate and water tank fixed connection, suction pump bottom and connecting plate top fixed connection, the input and the water tank intercommunication of suction pump, the output of suction pump is equipped with the water pipe, the water pipe is through handheld pipe and sprinkler bead intercommunication.

title_en: Weeding and plowing device for cherry planting
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of cherry planting, and particularly relates to a weeding and plowing device for cherry planting, which comprises an installation support shell, wherein a storage battery is arranged on the top side of the installation support shell, a water tank is arranged on the outer side of the storage battery, a supporting handle is arranged at one end of the installation support shell, a connection fixing plate is arranged at one end of the bottom side of the installation support shell, and an installation fixing rod is arranged on the surface of the connection fixing plate. When needing to plant for the cherry and carry out the weeding, the weeding blade on surface is driven through the motor that sets up one rotates to weed and turn over the ground, and when needs increase weeding length, through the connecting rod frame of being connected with a motor both ends, the installation ring dish is connected with the pole axle that weed with inclining, increase length, thereby weed, and motor one is two electric motor car motors, the shovel piece through the setting of side weeding pole axle surface curve can be with the grass shovel, and the equal arc setting of weeding blade and shovel piece.

title_en: Box girder internal mold assembling tool
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a box girder inner mold assembling tool, which belongs to the technical field of concrete prefabrication molds and comprises a fixed support body and a movable support body, wherein an inner mold mounting space is arranged between the fixed support body and the movable support body, a conveying roller way is arranged at the bottom of the inner mold mounting space, the conveying roller way comprises a plurality of supporting rollers which are arranged in a row and used for supporting an inner mold standard section, a fixed supporting inclined plane matched with the inner mold standard section is arranged on one side of the fixed support body, which faces the movable support body, the movable support body comprises a supporting seat, and a turnover arm driven by a power mechanism is hinged on the supporting seat. The utility model solves the technical problems of high labor intensity and low assembly efficiency in the assembly of the box girder internal mold at present, and is widely applied to the prefabrication of the box girder.

title_en: Processing cooling device for plastic part production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a processing and cooling device for plastic piece production, which comprises a box body and a refrigeration box, wherein a box door is arranged at the middle position of the front surface of the box body through a hinge, the refrigeration box is arranged at the position, close to the bottom end, of one side of the box body, a blower is arranged at the position, close to the top end, of one side of the box body, supporting seats are arranged at the positions of the two sides of the bottom end in the box body, displacement shafts are sleeved at the middle positions of the two sides of the supporting seats, supporting plates are arranged at the positions, adjacent to the displacement shafts, of the two sides, and bases are arranged at the positions of the top ends of the supporting plates at the two sides. The utility model solves the problems that the existing device mostly directly immerses the plastic pieces into the cooling liquid for cooling and needs to dry the plastic pieces again, so that the resource waste is large, the production cost is high, the plastic pieces are mostly placed in a pile, the cooling uniformity of the plastic pieces is poor, and the cooling efficiency of the utility model is improved.

title_en: Afforestation is with device of transplanting seedlings that bankets
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of landscaping, and particularly relates to a ridging seedling transplanting device for landscaping, which comprises a frame body, wherein the top of the frame body is fixedly connected with a bearing platform, the bearing platform is provided with a plurality of transplanting cavities, a plurality of overlapping sleeves are arranged in the transplanting cavities and used for adjusting the sizes of the transplanting cavities, a supporting assembly is arranged at the bottom of each transplanting cavity, and the supporting assembly comprises a supporting plate and four connecting rods, so that the purpose of supporting is realized; through having seted up a plurality of transplantation chamber on the plummer, the seedling can be placed transplanting intracavity portion, is protecting the root of seedling, according to the size of seedling root, can select suitable stack cover to place, makes the rate of adaptation of device high to when the seedling removes the position that needs, can stimulate the backup pad downwards, make the backup pad can drive the seedling and deviate from the transplantation intracavity, thereby can be convenient for transplant the seedling, improve transplanting's efficiency.

title_en: Metering mechanism for injection molding screw
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of injection molding machines, in particular to a metering mechanism for an injection molding screw, which solves the problems that in the prior art, metering and feeding are inconvenient, too much or too little feeding is easily caused, the product production quality is affected, and the flexibility of a feeding mode is poor. The utility model provides a metering mechanism that can be used to screw rod of moulding plastics, includes the feed cylinder and sets up the screw rod body of moulding plastics in the feed cylinder inboard, and top one side intercommunication of feed cylinder has charge-in pipeline, and the feed inlet has been seted up at charge-in pipeline's top, the inboard fixedly connected with dead lever of feed inlet, the one end fixedly connected with center post of dead lever, and one side sliding connection of center post has the regulation pole, through folding cloth fixed connection between one side of dead lever and regulation pole, charge-in pipeline's top is carved with the scale. According to the utility model, the feeding quantity is controlled by adjusting the size of the feeding hole so as to measure and feed, so that the influence on the product production quality caused by too much or too little feeding is avoided, and the feeding mode is flexible.

title_en: Polyimide film colour difference processing apparatus
abstract_en: The utility model provides a polyimide film color difference processing device which comprises a main body, wherein a discharging roller is arranged on one side of the main body, adjusting rollers are arranged on two sides of the top end surface of the main body, a detection liquid crystal screen is clamped and arranged on the front end surface of the other side of the main body, leveling rollers are arranged on the top end surface of the main body and positioned on the side edge of the detection liquid crystal screen, the number of the leveling rollers is two, and a color difference processing frame is fixed on the top end surface of the main body and positioned on the side edge of the leveling rollers. The polyimide film color difference processing device provided by the utility model is matched with the sliding grooves formed in the top end surfaces of the side edges of the main body through the sliding blocks, the positioning seat is fixed in the middle of the two sliding grooves, the inside of the positioning seat is provided with the adjusting screw rod in a threaded connection mode, the adjusting screw rod is connected with the second fixing seat through the bearing, and the material receiving roller can be conveniently disassembled by rotating the adjusting screw rod to slide the position of the second fixing seat back and forth.

title_en: Solar heat collecting device for greenhouse
abstract_en: The utility model provides a solar heat collection device for a greenhouse, and belongs to the technical field of planting equipment. The solar heat collector comprises a rotating beam, a first hydraulic oil cylinder, a first bottom plate, a second bottom plate and a movable mechanism, wherein one end of the rotating beam is hinged to a rear wall, one end of the first hydraulic oil cylinder is hinged to the rear wall, the other end of the first hydraulic oil cylinder is hinged to the rotating beam, one side edge of the first bottom plate is hinged to one side edge of the second bottom plate, a first solar heat collecting plate is arranged on the first bottom plate, a second solar heat collecting plate is arranged on the second bottom plate, the movable mechanism is arranged on the rotating beam, and the movable mechanism can enable the first bottom plate and the second bottom plate to rotate in the opposite direction and in the opposite direction. The utility model can improve the utilization rate of sunlight and improve the heat storage and insulation effects of the greenhouse.

title_en: Pond tarpaulin device convenient to receive net
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fishpond tarpaulin device convenient for net collection, which relates to the technical field of fishpond tarpaulin and comprises a motor, wherein a threaded rod A is fixedly connected to the output end of the motor, a nut A is connected to the outer part of the threaded rod A in a threaded manner, two sides of the nut A are fixedly connected with an articulated piece A through a fixing plate, one end, far away from the nut A, of the articulated piece A is rotatably connected with a movable arm, two sides of the motor are fixedly connected with telescopic rods, each telescopic rod comprises a hollow tube, one end, far away from the motor, of the hollow tube is slidably connected with a sliding rod, the top of the sliding rod is connected with the bottom of the articulated piece A, and the top of each telescopic rod is fixedly connected with tarpaulin. Pond tarpaulin device convenient to receive net prevents that the staff from needing a large amount of time to receive the net, reduces work efficiency, prevents to remove the weight crushing that the wheel subassembly was filled with water by the tarpaulin, improves the life of tarpaulin, and the in-process that tarpaulin inside was filled with water automatically drives fixed threaded rod and descends, increases stability to the tarpaulin.

title_en: Integrated into one piece mould is used in electric motor car tire production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of electric vehicle tire production, in particular to an integrated forming die for electric vehicle tire production, which comprises a base and a rotating bedplate, wherein a plurality of die assemblies distributed at equal intervals are installed on the rotating bedplate, a fixed end cylinder is installed on the outer wall of the top of the base, an end post is fixedly installed at the circle center of the outer wall of the bottom of the rotating bedplate, the end post is rotatably connected with the fixed end cylinder through a bearing, and a driving mechanism is installed on one side, opposite to the end post, of the fixed end cylinder; the utility model utilizes the plurality of mould components, and can rotate to the lower part of the pouring mechanism at a fixed frequency for pouring during actual operation, thereby realizing approximate continuous pouring operation; meanwhile, the mold assembly after the pouring is finished can be matched with a refrigerator to perform refrigeration treatment and perform blanking, so that the cooling time and the blanking time cannot be counted into the production period of the product, the production period is greatly shortened, and the production efficiency of the tire is greatly improved.

title_en: Syringe suitable for kill orange longicorn larva
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an injector suitable for killing citrus longicorn larvae. Comprises a needle cylinder, a pushing part and an injection part; the utility model is mainly characterized in that: the injection part comprises a cylindrical leakage-proof part, a truncated cone-shaped sealing part, an injection hose and an annular water-absorbent resin layer; the injection part is movably inserted on the outer diameter end of the liquid outlet pipe through a circular insertion port; an annular water-absorbent resin layer is arranged in the annular groove; the truncated cone-shaped sealing part is arranged in the center of the top end of the cylindrical leakage-proof part; the top opening wall thickness circumference of the upper round through hole in the round platform-shaped sealing part extends upwards to form an injection hose; the spherical sealing head, the cylindrical leakage-proof part, the truncated cone-shaped sealing part and the injection hose are made of elastic corrosion-resistant rubber. The utility model provides an improved injector, which can prevent liquid medicine from flowing down to the body in clothes along a sleeve through a wrist when a fruit grower injects pesticide into a wormhole on a branch of a tall citrus tree, and reduce the pesticide poisoning phenomenon.

title_en: One-color mold and shell forming mold
abstract_en: The utility model provides a one-color mold, which comprises a mold core mounting seat and a one-color mold core; the mold core mounting seat comprises a one-color upper mold and a one-color lower mold, and the one-color mold core is positioned between the one-color upper mold and the one-color lower mold; the color mold core comprises a first slide block, a second slide block, a color rear mold insert and a color front mold core; the one-color rear mold insert is positioned between the first sliding block and the second sliding block; the one-color front mold core comprises a one-color front mold mounting seat and a one-color front mold boss fixed on the one-color front mold mounting seat, the one-color front mold boss is positioned between the first sliding block and the second sliding block, the one-color front mold boss is opposite to the one-color rear mold insert, the one-color front mold boss is provided with a fixed groove, and the first sliding block and the second sliding block are far away from or close to the one-color front mold boss and the one-color rear mold insert; a color forming cavity is formed among the first sliding block, the second sliding block, the color rear mold insert, the color front mold core and the shaping groove; according to the shell forming die provided by the utility model, the air lines are not easy to appear in the injection molding process of the semitransparent shell.

title_en: Agricultural fertilizer distributor
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of agricultural machinery, in particular to an agricultural fertilizer distributor. Fertile section of thick bamboo including the toper, bottom one side of fertile section of thick bamboo is provided with out fertile mouthful, the downside that goes out fertile mouthful is provided with spills fertile dish, the bottom of fertile section of thick bamboo is provided with the hob with the position that goes out fertile mouthful and correspond is vertical, the vane edge of hob is provided with the brush hair, the top of hob is the toper, the bottom of hob is provided with rotary drive device, the position that fertile section of thick bamboo and hob correspond is provided with the hob chamber, it sets up on the lateral wall in hob chamber to go out fertile mouthful, the inner wall of fertile section of thick bamboo is provided with the ratchet, the bottom of spilling fertile dish is connected with spills fertile drive arrangement, it passes through adapter sleeve and fertile section of thick bamboo fixed connection to spill fertile drive arrangement. The spiral rod is arranged at the fertilizer outlet, the ratchet is arranged on the inner wall of the fertilizer barrel, the rotating spiral rod is used for stirring the caked fertilizer under the cooperation of the ratchet, and the problem that the fertilizer is not smoothly discharged at the fertilizer outlet is solved.

title_en: Multifunctional utensil for food
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional appliance for food, which comprises a hanging ring, a holding rod and a supporting hook, wherein the hanging ring is connected with the holding rod through a connecting rod; the hanging ring is arranged at the upper end of the holding rod, and the lower end of the holding rod is provided with a supporting hook. The supporting hook is clamped into the plate, so that the bent supporting hook supports against the plate body, the inner hook supports against the inner side of the plate, and the plate can be lifted up by the holding rod; clamping the supporting hook into the bottle cap with the sawtooth closed, enabling the bent support of the supporting hook to abut against the top of the bottle cap, enabling the inner hook to abut against the sawtooth of the bottle cap, lifting the hand grasping the holding rod upwards, and opening the bottle cap under the interaction of the bent support and the inner hook; the bent support and the outer hook of the support hook are abutted against the fish scales, so that the multifunctional appliance moves from the fish tail to the fish head, the fish scales are scraped and tilted under the action of the outer hook, and then the tilted fish scales are scraped under the action of the bent support. The multifunctional utensil for food provided by the utility model has the advantages that the utensil can be used for taking dishes, opening a sawtooth closing-up bottle cap, removing fish scales and the like.

title_en: Injection molding deckle edge remove device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of injection molding, and discloses an injection molding burr removing device which comprises an operating table, wherein a telescopic rod is fixedly connected to the top of the operating table, a fixed frame is fixedly connected to the top of the telescopic rod, a sliding groove is formed in one side of the fixed frame, a moving plate is slidably connected inside the sliding groove, a rectangular hole is formed in the upper surface of the moving plate, an I-shaped moving block is slidably connected inside the rectangular hole, a motor is fixedly connected to the top of the I-shaped moving block, a polishing rod is fixedly connected to the output end of the motor, a screw is fixedly connected to the top of the I-shaped moving block, and a gripping opening is formed in the upper surface of the moving plate. The utility model has the following advantages and effects: through setting up operation panel, telescopic link, mount, sliding tray, movable plate, rectangular hole, I movable block, motor, polishing stick, screw and gripping mouth, when carrying out deckle edge to the injection molding and get rid of, adjust the telescopic link height.

title_en: Novel bird repeller capable of being installed in electrified mode
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel bird repeller capable of being installed in an electrified way, which comprises an equipment main body, wherein the outer surface of the equipment main body is provided with a bottom shell, the inner side of the top end of the bottom shell is provided with a collar rod, one end of the collar rod is provided with a buckle plate, one side of the bottom shell is provided with a sound-diffusing hole, the bottom end of the bottom shell is provided with a fixing ring, the bottom end of the fixing ring is provided with a transparent cover, one end of the buckle plate, which is close to the collar rod, is provided with a connecting screw rod, the inner part of the bottom shell is provided with an anti-corrosion layer, the inner part of the anti-corrosion layer is provided with an insulating layer, the inner part of the insulating layer is provided with a waterproof layer, the inner part of the flame-retardant layer is provided with an inner protective layer, the inner part of the transparent cover is provided with a lamp bead, and the inner part of the equipment main body is provided with a loudspeaker; this but novel bird ware that drives of electrified installation can fix it in a certain place through the neck gram stick that sets up to fix neck gram stick one end through buckle and connecting screw, guaranteed the unable effect that drops of equipment principal.

title_en: Bottom termite feeding type underground termite monitoring and controlling device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bottom termite feeding type underground termite monitoring and controlling device which comprises a barrel, a protective sleeve and a top cover and is characterized in that the barrel is provided with a bait accommodating cavity with an opening at the upper end and a conical cavity communicated with the bait accommodating cavity, the opening at the upper end of the barrel is detachably connected with the top cover, the conical cavity is provided with an termite feeding hole, the protective sleeve is arranged at the upper part of the barrel, the upper end of the protective sleeve is provided with a retaining ring which extends upwards and expands outwards, the retaining ring is coated and arranged at the outer side of the top cover, and the upper edge of the retaining ring is not lower than the upper edge of the top cover. The top cover is positioned in the upper part of the sheath, the hexagonal groove is arranged on the top cover, the top cover is opened or closed in a spiral mode through a customizing tool matched with the hexagonal groove, and the top cover is protected, so that the connection between the top cover and the barrel body is not damaged by external force and people. And the problem that the top cover and the opening of the cylinder are deformed in a long-term natural environment and are not easy to open can be solved.

title_en: Vibration shearing injection molding device for ultrahigh molecular weight polyethylene artificial joint material
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a vibration shearing injection molding device for an ultrahigh molecular weight polyethylene artificial joint material, and belongs to the technical field of injection molding. The utility model discloses an ultrahigh molecular weight polyethylene artificial joint material vibration shearing injection molding device, which comprises a pair of slide bars, wherein support plates are fixedly mounted at the top ends and the bottom ends of the pair of slide bars, a cylinder is arranged on the top wall of the support plate above the slide bars, an injection molding head is connected to the bottom of a cylinder rod of the cylinder, an injection molding machine matched with the injection molding head is arranged on one side of each slide bar, a plate body is fixedly sleeved outside the slide bars, a first elastic piece is sleeved outside the slide bars, movable blocks are sleeved outside the slide bars, a top plate is fixedly mounted between the two movable blocks, and an injection molding opening is formed in the top plate.

title_en: Greenhouse control equipment for planting pitaya in greenhouse
abstract_en: The utility model discloses greenhouse control equipment for planting dragon fruits in a greenhouse, which comprises greenhouse control equipment, a first mounting plate and a second mounting plate, wherein the rear side of the first mounting plate is fixedly connected with the surface of the greenhouse control equipment, the front side of the second mounting plate is fixedly connected with a limiting block, a limiting groove matched with the limiting block is formed in the first mounting plate, and the front side of the second mounting plate is movably connected with a support. The support and the support rod are matched for use and are used for supporting the greenhouse control equipment, the greenhouse control equipment is pulled to move downwards for convenient operation when the greenhouse control equipment is used, the support and the support rod are combined to prevent personnel from touching when the greenhouse control equipment is not used, and the problem that the panel is controlled to operate because the control panel is generally placed in a greenhouse due to the fact that a lot of personnel are in a planting field, and the control panel is easily interested and touched by the flow of the personnel is solved.

title_en: Premixing device of fodder core material
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a premixing device for a feed core material, which comprises a premixing tank, connecting blocks and an electric push rod, wherein a supporting plate is arranged on the outer surface of the premixing tank, a supporting rod is arranged at the bottom of the supporting plate, a base is arranged at the bottom of the supporting rod, and the connecting blocks which are symmetrically arranged are arranged at the top of the base; the inner surface of one group of the connecting blocks is provided with a bearing sleeve, and the outer wall of one side of the bearing sleeve is provided with a rotating drum; an electric push rod is installed on the inner wall of one side of the rotary drum, a push plate is installed at one end of the electric push rod, a brush is installed on the outer surface of the push plate, and the outer surface of the brush is attached to the inner surface of the rotary drum. According to the feed core premixing device, the electric push rod, the push plate and the brush are installed, after feed core materials are premixed, the electric push rod is started to drive the push plate to move leftwards, the inner wall of the rotary drum can be cleaned under the action of the brush, and waste caused by feed adhesion and residue is avoided.

title_en: Extrusion material conveying device for plastic sheet production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an extrusion material conveying device for plastic sheet production, which comprises: the automatic conveying device comprises base supports, wherein 2 symmetrical part supports which are parallel to each other are arranged at the upper ends of the base supports, a servo motor is installed on the outer side face of one part support, 2 through conveying rollers connected through bearings are distributed among the part supports, the end portions of the through conveying rollers penetrate through the outer side faces of the part supports, and the through conveying rollers which are uniformly distributed are connected through a heat dissipation and flow guide structure. This extrusion material conveyor for plastic sheet production can be at the in-process of carrying, carries out the precooling to the material of extruding to cooling structure's power derives from roller conveyor's self, has avoided need additionally to add the pump body, and then not only makes cooling structure open along with opening of roller conveyor and stops, has practiced thrift the energy consumption, and the relative fault rate that has reduced conveyor.

title_en: Electric rough coconut fiber fruit mold
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electric rough coconut fiber fruit die, which comprises a base, wherein a support is fixedly arranged above the base, a liquid storage tank is fixedly arranged at the right end of the support, the lower end of the liquid storage tank is connected with a first pipeline, a first valve is arranged in the middle of the first pipeline, a container is arranged at the lower end of the first pipeline, a second valve is arranged at the left end of the container, a second pipeline is fixedly arranged at the left end of the second valve, a piston is connected at the right end of the container in a transition manner, a screw rod is connected with the right end bearing of the piston and penetrates through the right end of the container, a handle is fixedly arranged at the right end of the screw rod, a first motor is fixedly arranged at the top of the support, an upper die is fixedly arranged at the output shaft of the first motor, a demoulding groove is arranged above the base, guide rails are fixedly arranged at two sides of the demoulding groove, and sliding blocks are connected on the surfaces of the guide rails in a sliding manner, the utility model has the characteristics of strong practicability and convenient demoulding.

title_en: Low-noise vibrating table for pc component production line
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a low-noise vibrating table for a pc component production line, which comprises a ground, wherein a supporting wheel is fixedly arranged on the ground, a mould table is arranged at the top of the supporting wheel, a vibrating table is arranged at the bottom of the mould table, and two sides of the vibrating table are respectively provided with a secondary sound insulation wall. This pc component production line shaking table that noise is low, through electric PLC control, air spring vibration isolation, electro-magnet locking mould platform, the vibrating motor vibration, measure such as the vibrating platform is totally closed realizes product safety, reliable guarantee production, the box form is made to the shaking table, surround vibrating motor, all around add the sound material of inhaling, vibrating motor has all added the converter, the vibrational force is big by little to, by big to little can free control, effectively solve current pc component production line shaking table mould platform and easily shift, the vibration sound is big, the vibration time is long, the vibration leads to the yielding of component and presss from both sides not tight scheduling problem greatly.

title_en: Feed scattering vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model provides a feed scattering vehicle, relates to the technical field of feed feeding equipment, and aims to solve the technical problem that the existing feed feeding equipment is inconvenient to use; the feed throwing equipment comprises a vehicle body and a material spreading assembly, wherein the material spreading assembly is arranged on the vehicle body and is characterized in that the material spreading assembly comprises a storage box, a material conveying unit and a material spreading unit, and the storage box comprises a plurality of side plates which are sequentially connected end to end; a discharge hole is formed in a side plate at the front end of the material storage box along the advancing direction of the vehicle body; the material conveying unit is arranged at the bottom of the material storage box and comprises a material pushing plate which rotates in a reciprocating manner, and the material pushing plate pushes the material in the material storage box out through a material outlet; the material scattering unit is positioned at the front end of the material storage box and comprises a conveying belt which rotates in a circulating reciprocating mode, the conveying belt receives the discharged materials of the discharge port, and the rotating direction of the conveying belt is orthogonal to the advancing direction of the vehicle body. The feed scattering vehicle is convenient to use.

title_en: Five-year-old silkworm breeding system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a five-instar silkworm breeding system which comprises a silkworm frame chopping device, a first carrier roller conveying line and a stacking device, wherein the silkworm frame chopping device is used for chopping four-instar silkworm frames conveyed by an AGV dispatching system, the first carrier roller conveying line is arranged on two sides perpendicular to the conveying direction of the silkworm frame chopping device and used for conveying the five-instar silkworm frames, the silkworm frame chopping device is connected with the splitting device which is used for splitting four-instar trough plates in the four-instar silkworm frames one by one and conveying the four-instar trough plates into the corresponding five-instar silkworm frames, the stacking device used for placing the five-instar trough plates in the five-instar silkworm frames is distributed above the first carrier roller conveying line, and the first carrier roller conveying line is connected with a silkworm frame feeding device used for covering the silkworm frames on the five-instar silkworm frames and bait. The utility model is provided with two first carrier roller conveying lines for conveying five-instar silkworm frames, improves the conveying capacity of five-instar silkworm eggs, and ensures the conveying efficiency of the five-instar silkworm eggs by splitting two four-instar trough plates in four-instar silkworm frames one by one through the splitting device.

title_en: A sprinkler is prepared to liquid pesticide for farming
abstract_en: The utility model provides a liquid pesticide preparation spraying device for agricultural planting, relates to the technical field of agriculture, and aims to solve the problem that the quality of diluted pesticide cannot be effectively controlled by manually diluting in the diluting process; the spraying device consists of a trolley, a stirring device, a storage device, a linkage structure and a supply device; the top of the cart is fixedly connected with a stirring device and a supply device respectively, and the stirring device is fixedly connected with the supply device; the top of the stirring device is movably connected with a storage device; the linkage structure is movably connected inside the stirring device and is in lap joint with the storage device. According to the linkage structure, the turntable with the notches in a certain proportion is arranged, so that liquid in the accommodating groove can be discharged when the turntable rotates, the liquid is discharged according to a specific proportion, and the condition that the diluted pesticide quality cannot be effectively controlled due to manual dilution in the dilution process is avoided.

title_en: Fruit type sweet corn is planted with device of growing seedlings
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of seedling raising devices, and discloses a seedling raising device for planting fruit type sweet corns, which comprises a first placing seat, wherein first placing grooves are uniformly formed in the first placing seat, a moving seat is arranged at the bottom of the first placing seat, connecting columns are uniformly arranged at the upper part of the first placing seat, a second placing seat is arranged at the upper part of the first placing seat, a fixed pipe is arranged at the bottom of the second placing seat, the connecting columns are movably clamped in the fixed pipe, a second placing groove is formed in the second placing seat, and nutrition bowls are arranged in the second placing groove and the first placing groove. The work of placing can be better to the nutritive cube, supplementary better draws the change work to the nutritive cube.

title_en: Injection molding device is used in production of ceramic plug
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an injection molding device for producing a ceramic plug, which comprises a box body, wherein a workbench is fixedly arranged at the top of the box body, a lower die is fixedly arranged at the top of the workbench, an upper die is arranged at the top of the lower die, a die cavity is arranged in the lower die, and a condensation hole is formed in the lower die and positioned on the outer side of the die cavity. This injection moulding device is used in ceramic plug production, the utility model discloses a hole of moulding plastics, go up the mould, the die cavity, the condensation hole, the cooperation of quick-operation joint and internal thread installation cover is used, constantly under the cooling of the inside hydrologic cycle of condensation hole, the plug solidification shaping has been accelerated, the staff need not a large amount of time and goes to wait, the production efficiency of ceramic plug has been improved, the cooling water who uses when producing ceramic plug simultaneously, through the inside heating of moulding plastics the raw materials of die cavity, finally flow into in the resident family, supply the resident to use, the waste to the water resource has been avoided.

title_en: Precast concrete mould frock clamp
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a precast concrete mould tool clamp, which comprises a mould body and a base, wherein the base comprises a first connecting frame and a second connecting frame, the second connecting frame is arranged at two ends of the first connecting frame, two ends of the first connecting frame are respectively provided with a first connecting mechanism, and the first connecting frame is connected with the second connecting frame through the first connecting mechanism, the precast concrete mould tool clamp is convenient to adjust the length of the base by arranging the first connecting mechanism, the application range of the tool clamp is increased, the flexibility is improved, the second connecting mechanism is convenient to disassemble the clamp when the mould body is taken out, the stability of the clamp is kept, the fixing effect of the clamp is improved by arranging the first fixing plate and the second fixing plate, the first fixing plate and the second fixing plate are convenient to rotate by arranging a rotating shaft, and the installation and disassembly of the first fixing plate and the second fixing plate are convenient, through setting up fixture block and groove, increase the connection effect between mould body and the arm lock.

title_en: Card location plastic shell injection moulding mould
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of injection molds, and discloses a card positioning plastic shell injection molding mold which comprises a base, wherein a lower mold is arranged on the base, a mold cavity is arranged in the lower mold, a bottom plate is arranged in the mold cavity, cylinders are arranged at two ends below the bottom plate, a cooling cavity is arranged in the lower mold and close to the mold cavity and the outer side of the cylinder, an upper mold is arranged above the lower mold, and a top plate is arranged above the upper mold. According to the utility model, the bottom plate is arranged in the die cavity, and the cylinders are arranged at the two ends below the bottom plate, so that a worker can observe the plastic shell from the observation window when performing injection molding on the plastic shell, and can adjust the height of the bottom plate according to the manufacturing requirement of the plastic shell, so that the device can meet the injection molding production of the plastic shells with different height sizes, the whole die does not need to be replaced, the injection molding process is more convenient, and the applicability and flexibility of the device are improved.

title_en: Converge and take curved subassembly and welding equipment
abstract_en: A bus bar bending assembly relates to the technical field of photovoltaic product production equipment, and comprises a bus bar receiving piece, a welding head and a bus bar grabbing assembly, wherein the bus bar receiving piece and the welding head are arranged in parallel, a plurality of first bending grooves are formed in the bus bar receiving piece or the welding head, the first bending grooves are uniformly arranged along the length direction of the bus bar receiving piece or the welding head at intervals, the grabbing assembly is arranged above the bus bar receiving piece and the welding head and can move in the horizontal direction and the vertical direction, the grabbing assembly comprises a fixing frame and a plurality of bending forming pieces arranged corresponding to the first bending grooves, the bending forming pieces are connected with the fixing frame and can grab a bus bar, the bending is carried out on the bus bar, so that the bus bar between every two welding points on a battery piece is in a bending state, and the deformation of the bus bar caused by thermal expansion and cold contraction is counteracted through bending, thereby improving the quality of the product. The utility model also provides welding equipment.

title_en: Side slope structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides a side slope structure, which comprises an original soil side slope, wherein a slope surface of the original soil side slope is provided with a plurality of root guide holes, and covering soil layers are arranged in the root guide holes and the slope surface of the original soil side slope; greening grass and shrubs are planted on the covering soil layer. The utility model has firm temperature and can effectively prevent the side slope from slipping.

title_en: Solar electromagnetic yield increasing instrument for promoting plant growth
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a solar electromagnetic yield increasing instrument for promoting plant growth, which comprises a base, wherein a mounting plate is arranged above the base, a blue light emitter is fixedly arranged in the middle of the upper surface of the mounting plate, a red light emitter is arranged at the upper end of the blue light emitter, a conical converter is arranged between the red light emitter and the blue light emitter, a conical electromagnetic emitter is arranged at the upper end of the red light emitter, and a solar panel is arranged at the upper end of the conical electromagnetic emitter; through blue light emitter, ruddiness emitter, toper converter and toper electromagnetic emitter's cooperation is used, can carry out photosynthesis to the plant on every side with blue light and the ruddiness reflection that blue light emitter and ruddiness emitter sent, in order to realize promoting the effect of vegetation on every side, cooperation through two sets of supporting component and runner assembly is used, can drive solar panel and rotate, and then can pass through the better absorption solar energy of solar panel, thereby can last supply power through the battery.

title_en: Energy-saving and environment-friendly seed germination accelerating device for water recycling
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an energy-saving and environment-friendly seed germination accelerating device capable of recycling water, and relates to the technical field of germination accelerating. This practicality has played the effect of reinforcing water retention effect through setting up germination accelerating disk, water pump, shower nozzle, filter screen, waffle slab and the cotton layer of water retention, utilizes the water pump to add pressure water and gets into the spray pipe through the connecting pipe, and the shower nozzle on the spray pipe sprays the water smoke and goes on, and the watering is more even, and the convenient control water yield prevents to water too much condition and takes place to utilize the cotton layer of water retention to preserve water, reduce the evaporation of water, reinforcing water retention effect.

title_en: Rice dumpling large-scale production is with equipment of cooking convenient to wash
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cooking device convenient for cleaning and used for large-scale production of rice dumplings, which comprises a base, wherein a cooking groove is fixedly connected to one side of the top of the base, a heating plate is arranged in the cooking groove, a movable frame is fixedly connected to one side of the cooking groove, an inclined filter plate is fixedly connected between two sides in the movable frame, the bottom of the movable frame is communicated with a water drain pipe, and a cleaning component is arranged on one side of the base. According to the utility model, the cooking groove is arranged, so that the storage of a large batch of rice dumplings can be accommodated, the cooking work of the rice dumplings is carried out, after the rice dumplings are cooked, the rice dumplings are arranged inside the movable frame, the water source on the rice dumplings is filtered through the obliquely arranged filter plate, and the cleaning assembly is matched to spray water on the rice dumplings for cleaning, so that the foam on the rice dumplings can be cleaned conveniently, the subsequent drying packaging is facilitated, the cleaning function is good, and the functionality of the cooking equipment is improved.

title_en: Irrigation equipment is planted to nursery stock
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a nursery stock planting irrigation device which comprises a planting pot and an irrigation pipeline above the planting pot, wherein a spray head corresponding to the planting pot is formed on the irrigation pipeline; the planting pot comprises a left pot body and a right pot body; the left pot body and the right pot body respectively comprise semi-annular pot bodies, wherein semi-annular bottom plates are fixed at the bottoms of the semi-annular pot bodies, and water storage cavities are formed in the semi-annular pot bodies; the left pot body and the right pot body are spliced to form a planting cavity with a truncated cone-shaped middle part; the semicircular pot body penetrates through the water absorption structure, one end of the water absorption structure is arranged in the water storage cavity, and the other end of the water absorption structure is arranged in the planting cavity; a cover plate is fixed at the top of the semi-annular pot body, and a water inlet is formed on the cover plate; the upper end part of the left pot body is formed with a clamping groove, and the end part of the right pot body is formed with a clamping block corresponding to the clamping groove. The utility model has simple structure and convenient use, can effectively prevent nursery stocks from lodging, fully utilizes water and fertilizer and effectively prevents the waste of water resources.

title_en: Zongzi production water line is with supplementary packing plant
abstract_en: The utility model provides an auxiliary packaging device for a rice dumpling production line, which comprises a rack, an upper layer conveying device, a lower layer conveying device, a wire wheel, a binding rope for binding rice dumplings, a shearing device, a mounting frame and a female die, wherein rice dumpling leaves are conveyed by the upper layer conveying device during working, workers take the rice dumpling leaves and then match the female die to carry out rice dumpling leaf shaping and filling work, the binding rope is cut by the shearing device, the rice dumpling leaves are bound and formed by the binding rope, the formed rice dumplings are conveyed to the next working procedure by the lower layer conveying device, the size and the shape of the rice dumplings tend to be unified by using the female die to play an auxiliary supporting and shaping role so as to reduce the complicated operation process of folding the rice dumpling leaves and supporting the rice dumpling leaves to carry out the filling work, the efficiency and the standardization degree of the rice dumpling packaging and forming are improved, wherein the female die is detachably mounted on the rack in cooperation with the mounting frame, so that other female dies can be conveniently replaced according to produce the rice dumplings with different sizes, is favorable for meeting the market demand and has stronger market competitiveness.

title_en: Novel non-energy bird repeller convenient to install
abstract_en: The utility model provides a novel non-energy bird repeller convenient to install, which comprises: a fixed seat; the contraction device is fixedly arranged in the middle of the top of the fixed seat and comprises a fixed column, a mounting hole is formed in the middle of the top of the fixed column, and a second thread layer is arranged inside the mounting hole; the two bolts are respectively meshed with the left side and the right side of the fixed seat in a threaded manner; the carriage release lever set up in the inside of mounting hole, the surface of carriage release lever is provided with first screw thread layer, the positive top of carriage release lever is provided with the screw hole. According to the novel energy-free bird repeller convenient to mount, the mounting plate, the moving rod and the contraction device of the bird repeller can be detached through the screw thread mode, a user can transport the bird repeller to a farmland on a mountain after detaching the bird repeller conveniently, the bird repeller can be assembled quickly through the screw thread, the user is convenient to mount and dismount, and the novel energy-free bird repeller is simple in structure, convenient to mount and dismount and high in practicability.

title_en: Extrusion die for manufacturing conductive composite material pipe
abstract_en: The utility model provides an extrusion die for manufacturing a conductive composite material pipe, which comprises: connecting pipe, guiding gutter, joint groove, mold core, joint board and mixing mechanism, connecting pipe one end can be dismantled and be fixed with the solid fixed cylinder, the transition chamber has been seted up to solid fixed cylinder inner wall one end, the guiding gutter equidistance is seted up at the transition intracavity wall, joint groove equidistance is seted up at the transition intracavity wall, the mold core sets up at the solid fixed cylinder inner wall, the joint board symmetry is fixed in the one end that the mold core is close to the transition chamber, and joint board and joint groove joint, mixing mechanism installs the one end that is close to the transition chamber at the solid fixed cylinder, mixing mechanism includes: the stirring device comprises a rotating shaft, a stirring rod, a first bevel gear, a flat gear ring, an inner bevel gear ring and a motor, wherein the rotating shaft is connected to one end, close to the transition cavity, of the fixed cylinder in a rotating mode through bearings in an equidistance mode, and the stirring rod is fixed to one end of the rotating shaft. The utility model can stir and mix the raw materials and improve the yield.

title_en: Hot device of burying of car light loading screw
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of vehicle lamp assembly, in particular to a vehicle lamp loading screw hot embedding device which comprises a PLC control cabinet, a feeding device, a manipulator, a screw taking clamp, a heating device, a first sensor, a cooling device and a second sensor, wherein the PLC control cabinet is arranged on a rack, and a tool table surface is arranged above the rack; the loading device is arranged on the tool table top and used for loading screws; the manipulator is slidably mounted on the frame; the nail taking clamp is slidably mounted on the rack; the heating device is positioned on the tool table surface at one side of the feeding device; the first sensor is positioned behind the heating device; the cooling device is positioned in front of the heating device and used for cooling the embedded screw; the second sensor is located on the front side of the feeding device. The utility model can realize the detection of the hot burial depth and neglected loading of the screw, improves the working efficiency, reduces the temperature after the hot burial and is beneficial to the subsequent operation of staff.

title_en: Special feed additive production of pig is with smashing mixing arrangement
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a crushing and mixing device for producing a special feed additive for pigs, which belongs to the technical field of crushing and mixing, and comprises a mixing tank, wherein a connecting rod is fixedly arranged on the outer wall of the upper end of the mixing tank, a crushing box body is fixedly arranged at one end of the connecting rod, which is far away from the mixing tank, a box top cover is arranged at the top end of the crushing box body, a first electric push rod is arranged on the outer wall of the front end of the connecting rod, the transmission end of the first electric push rod is connected with a bearing installation block, a fixed block is fixedly arranged at one end of the crushing box body, which is far away from the first electric push rod, the lower ends of the two fixed blocks are respectively provided with a second electric push rod, a motor support plate is fixedly arranged at one end of the second electric push rod, which is far away from the fixed blocks, a rotating motor is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the motor support plate, a crushing disc is arranged in the crushing box body, the crushing and mixing device utilizes the height difference between components to carry out material guiding work, and reduces the number of fans, the cost is saved, the structure of the crushing part is refitted at the same time, and the whole adjustability of the device is improved.

title_en: Automatic angle adjusting device for irrigation spray nozzle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic angle adjusting device for an irrigation nozzle, which comprises a nozzle and an angle self-adjusting assembly, wherein the angle self-adjusting assembly is positioned on one side of the nozzle, the angle self-adjusting assembly and the nozzle are both arranged on the outer wall of a main nozzle, the angle self-adjusting assembly comprises a cylinder, a self-rotating part, a first fan blade and a second fan blade, and the self-rotating part comprises a first circular plate, a second circular plate, a sleeve and a rolling ball; this automatic angle adjusting device for irrigation spray nozzle, shower nozzle spun irrigation water strikes angle self-modulation subassembly, when the rotation takes place for the angle self-modulation subassembly, direct shower nozzle spun irrigation water, make it have better sprinkling irrigation scope, wherein the central line of columniform the central axis parallels with the shower nozzle, first fan piece and the equal slope setting of second fan piece, the incline direction of first fan piece is opposite with the incline direction of second fan piece, strike two kinds of fan pieces in proper order at shower nozzle spun water, different fan pieces just can be with the different directions of irrigation water direction, better sprinkling irrigation scope like this, the practicality is good.

title_en: Be used for barren mountain afforestation auxiliary device of forestry
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an auxiliary device for forestation of forestry barren mountains, which comprises a moving vehicle body, wherein a medicine storage box is fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the moving vehicle body, a window is formed in the surface of the medicine storage box, a driving motor is fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the medicine storage box, the output end of the driving motor is in transmission connection with a first bevel gear, the bottom of the moving vehicle body is in rotary connection with a medicine spraying disc and a cutting blade, a transmission shaft is in rotary connection with the inside of the medicine storage box, a connecting pipe is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the transmission shaft, and the bottom end of the connecting pipe is fixedly connected with the medicine spraying disc. According to the auxiliary device for forestation of the forestry barren mountains, the driving wheel in the middle of the connecting pipe and the driven wheel at the upper end of the connecting shaft are in transmission through the belt, so that the driven wheel, the connecting shaft and the cutting blade are driven to rotate, the cutting blade cuts and removes barren grasses with long lengths, the contact area of liquid medicine and the barren grasses is increased, and the auxiliary device has a good weeding effect.

title_en: Home-use swift installation nursery cabinet
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a household rapid-installation seedling raising frame which comprises a support frame, wherein a clamping groove is formed in the outer surface of the support frame, a concave plate is movably installed at the bottom of the clamping groove, a convex plate is movably installed on the other side of the concave plate, a hinge is detachably installed at the top of the support frame, an installation bolt is movably installed on one side of the support frame, a connecting frame and a connecting sleeve are movably sleeved on the other side of the installation bolt respectively, a water leakage plate is fixedly installed on the other side of the connecting sleeve, a water receiving plate is detachably installed at the bottom of the water leakage plate, a water receiving groove is placed at the bottom of the water receiving plate, the connecting sleeve comprises a connecting rod, and a circular ring is integrally formed on one side of the connecting rod. In the above-mentioned scheme, the soil of not planting the dish winter has taken the most space of balcony, and does not have sufficient space to come the life, can pull down water leakage board, water receiving board and link in proper order this moment, separates concave plate and convex plate from top to bottom again, during the support frame is withdrawed respectively to the subdividing, can accomodate this device, and is very convenient, and does not take up space.

title_en: Reducing mechanism is used in processing of ABS plastic granules
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a crushing device for processing ABS plastic particles, which comprises a structure main body, wherein the structure main body comprises a crushing box rack and a motor rack arranged on one side of the crushing box rack; a crushing box is arranged on the crushing box machine frame, a crushing processing assembly is arranged in the crushing box, a discharge port which is obliquely arranged is arranged at the bottom of the crushing box, a feeding conveying belt is arranged on one side of the crushing box machine frame, a screening disc is arranged on the feeding conveying belt, and the screening disc is positioned below the discharge port; through setting up the sieve charging tray at the discharge gate, the plastic granules after smashing screens through the sieve charging tray, and the tiny particle after the screening is carried to the assigned position through the pay-off transmission band, and the great plastic granules of granule is stayed and is carried out the regrinding in the sieve charging tray, has improved plastic granules and has smashed fineness and degree of consistency, has improved the plastic products processingquality.

title_en: Rice processing is with equipment of pickling
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a soaking device for rice processing, which structurally comprises a fishing mechanism and a pushing mechanism, rice is poured into the cleaning part at the upper end of the reaction box through the feeding hole, the motor drives the rotating shaft to enable the stirring roller to stir the rice in the water, then immersing, pushing a pushing hand to enable a collecting tank to collect floating objects on the surface, then pouring the floating objects into the upper end of the screen through a rice outlet, separating water from rice by a screen, collecting screened rice in an output groove, the water is filtered by the filter box at the lower end and then is recycled by the water pump, so that the problems that most of the existing rice is directly poured into the cleaning box to be manually stirred and cleaned to clean impurities on the surface when the rice is processed and soaked are solved, the efficiency of not only making abluent is not high, and the utilization ratio of water resource is not enough moreover, causes the problem of water waste easily.

title_en: Sand-prevention sand-control gnawing-prevention device for improving afforestation survival rate
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sand prevention, sand control and gnawing prevention device for improving afforestation survival rate, relates to the technical field of sand prevention and sand control, and aims to solve the problems that the survival rate of vegetation is reduced due to gnawing of wild animals to the vegetation due to lack of a gnawing prevention component, and the survival rate is reduced due to withering and withering of a plurality of plants under intense sunlight after transplanting because moisture in plant branches and leaves is quickly evaporated and cannot be timely supplemented due to lack of a sun-proof structure and a timely water supplementing structure. The improved water supply device is characterized in that mounting fixing bolts are arranged on the mounting base plate, a supporting plate is arranged at the upper end of the mounting base plate, a water supply structure is arranged at the middle upper end of the mounting base plate, a cover plate structure is arranged at the upper end of the supporting plate, a connecting structure is arranged on the cover plate structure, mounting adjusting bolts are arranged on the connecting structure, a water supply port is formed in the upper end of the water supply structure, planting grooves are formed in two sides of the water supply structure, and a water supply pipe is arranged at the lower end of the water supply structure.

title_en: Novel lens production is with section equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides novel slicing equipment for lens production, which comprises a base, wherein a collecting box is arranged on one side above the outer wall of the base, a slicing mechanism is arranged on one side of the outer wall of the base, connecting rods are welded on two sides of the outer wall of the base, mounting seats penetrate through two ends of the connecting rods, limiting rings are arranged on two sides of each mounting seat, a supporting plate is fixedly arranged on the surface of each mounting seat, and a clamping mechanism is fixedly arranged on one side of the surface of each supporting plate. This novel lens production is with section equipment, through the setting of fixing base, second threaded rod, fixed block, sliding tray, spring, slider and cushion, can be when needs are polished the lens, fix the lens mould earlier, then rotate the backup pad, make the mould lens can take on the surface of fixed block, then drive the slider through the both sides spring and remove, make the cushion can carry out spacing fixed to the mould lens, prevent that the mould lens from rocking about rotatory in-process.

title_en: Multifunctional land-saving ecological grave
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional land-saving ecological grave, which comprises a box body, a bottom plate and a three-dimensional portrait, wherein the lower part of the box body is of a hollow structure, a cinerary casket is placed in the hollow structure, the bottom plate and the bottom of the box body are integrated, the three-dimensional portrait is fixed on the front side surface of the bottom plate, a left incense inserting cylinder and a right incense inserting cylinder are respectively fixed on two sides of the three-dimensional portrait, the left incense inserting cylinder is of a barrel-shaped structure, and an audio processing device, a playing device and a projecting device are arranged in the right incense inserting cylinder; the top of the box body is concave to form a plant planting pot, the rear part of the box body is provided with a placing room for placing the cinerary casket, and the opening is provided with a sealing cover of the placing room. The multifunctional land-saving ecological grave displays the departed as an artwork at home in a three-dimensional carving mode, saves land resources, achieves the land-saving effect, has the function of planting green plants, and can display audios, videos and videos in a projection mode so as to be convenient for recalling at any time.

title_en: Injection molding machine mode locking tailboard structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mold locking tail plate structure of an injection molding machine, which comprises an installation bottom plate, wherein the upper surface of the installation bottom plate is fixedly connected with an injection molding lower die holder, the upper surface of the injection molding lower die holder is provided with an injection molding cavity, a jacking discharging mechanism is arranged in the injection molding cavity, the side wall of the installation bottom plate is fixedly connected with a hydraulic telescopic rod, the telescopic end of the hydraulic telescopic rod is fixedly connected with an injection molding upper die, the injection molding upper die is matched with the injection molding lower die holder, and the central shaft of the injection molding upper die is provided with an injection molding hole. This injection molding machine mode locking tailboard structure, from the hole of moulding plastics to the inside injection moulding chamber plastics, the master form board is supported downwards and moves, plastics by the pressfitting on the lower surface of mould of moulding plastics, mould plastics between the inside wall of die holder and the upper surface of master form board, after plastics are stereotyped, mould plastics jack-up through the hydraulic telescoping rod extension, and reset spring upwards pushes up moves spacing slide bar, the master form board rebound, thereby with the ejecting die holder of moulding plastics of product, realize the purpose of the quick unloading of product.

title_en: Level land board assembly of harrow pulp grinder self-adaptation level land device
abstract_en: The flat land plate assembly of the pulp raking machine self-adaptive flat land device comprises two side wing plates, tension springs and a middle cover plate, wherein the side wing plates are separately suspended and hinged on two sides of the middle cover plate, and the tension springs are communicated with and articulated with the side wing plates and the middle cover plate. The side wing plates can be folded under the non-working state and tightened on the middle cover plate through the tension springs so as to reduce the transverse transportation width; the side wing plates can be unfolded and laid on the middle cover plate in a working state so as to increase the transverse working width. The operation width and the transportation width can be switched, and the uneven phenomenon of the flat ground joint generated by the operation is overcome.

title_en: A collection device for beasts and birds excrement is dirty
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a collecting device for livestock and poultry manure, which relates to the technical field of livestock and poultry, and particularly comprises a bucket and a fixing frame, wherein a first hydraulic telescopic rod is arranged on one side of the bucket, an installation plate is arranged at the movable end of the first hydraulic telescopic rod, a second hydraulic telescopic rod is arranged on one side of the installation plate, a connecting plate is arranged at the movable end of the second hydraulic telescopic rod, a supporting frame is arranged on one side of the connecting plate, a scraper is arranged at one end of the supporting frame, and a third hydraulic telescopic rod is arranged on one side of the supporting frame. Through the cooperation setting of scraper bowl, first hydraulic telescoping rod, mounting panel, second hydraulic telescoping rod, connecting plate, support frame and scraper blade, through making the scraper blade carry out removal from top to bottom and front and back in the in-process of using, accomplish automatically with the dirty scraper bowl of collecting of beasts and birds excrement in, need not artifical use tools and collect it, reduced artificial intensity of labour, realized the automatic collection of being convenient for and improved work efficiency's purpose.

title_en: Easily clear up sausage processing meat grinder
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of food production equipment, in particular to a meat grinder for processing sausages, which is easy to clean. The utility model provides an easily clear up sausage processing meat grinder, includes meat grinder main part, carries chamber, conveyor, meat grinder and belt cleaning device, the transport chamber set up in meat grinder main part inside, conveyor set up in the transport intracavity portion, meat grinder with meat grinder main part detachable connect, belt cleaning device with transport chamber detachable connect, transport chamber downside be connected with the blowdown chamber. Through setting up the fixed chamber of conical transport chamber and parallelogram's motor, can dismantle the meat grinder after the meat grinder finishes using, use belt cleaning device to carry intracavity portion to wash, sewage flows along the blowdown chamber, and it is convenient to wash, need not dismouting meat grinder, and it is convenient to use, the cleaning time of the equipment that can significantly reduce, improve equipment's availability factor.

title_en: Kneading machine is used in processing of plastics master batch
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kneading machine for plastic master batch processing, which relates to the technical field of plastic master batch production equipment and comprises a kneading cylinder, a driving mechanism and two groups of paddles arranged inside the kneading cylinder and in transmission connection with the driving mechanism, wherein two groups of polished rods parallel to the paddles are arranged inside the kneading cylinder, scrapers are sleeved on the polished rods in a sliding manner and are positioned above the paddles, one side of each scraper, which is close to the driving mechanism, is provided with a connecting rod, the outer wall of each kneading cylinder, which is close to one side of the driving mechanism, is provided with a fixed frame and a servo motor, one end of each polished rod penetrates through the kneading cylinder and the fixed frame and is fixedly connected with the fixed frame, and one end of each connecting rod penetrates through the kneading cylinder and the fixed frame and extends into the fixed frame. The kneading machine is provided with the polished rod, the scraper, the connecting rod, the servo motor, the movable frame and the reciprocating screw rod, so that the effect of further improving the kneading work efficiency on the basis of the conventional kneading machine is achieved.

title_en: EPC blowing mechanism of gluing machine for preventing glass cloth from folding
abstract_en: The utility model provides an EPC air blowing mechanism for a gluing machine to prevent glass cloth from being folded, which comprises a support bracket, a main air steel pipe, a plurality of air blowing bent pipes and a plurality of high-pressure air nozzles, wherein the air blowing bent pipes are arranged on the support bracket; the main gas steel pipe is horizontally fixed on the supporting bracket; the air blowing bent pipes are arranged in parallel and welded below the main air steel pipe at intervals; the end of each air blowing bent pipe is connected with the high-pressure air nozzle. The EPC blowing mechanism for preventing the glass cloth from being folded by the gluing machine is simple in structure and high in practicability; the used materials are common, and the cost is low; the improvement and the folding effect are good, and the operation is convenient and effective.

title_en: Production device for fertilizer and/or feed
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a device for producing manure and/or feed, comprising a chamber (26), a circulation element (29) arranged in the chamber (26) for circulating a mixture (14', 16) of an added emulsion (14') and an added organic waste (16), and a heating element (30) for drying the mixture (14', 16) by evaporating water (31) from the mixture (14', 16), the chamber (26) having a first opening (27) for receiving an emulsion (14') of waste water (8, 9) and grease (14), and a second opening (28) for adding the organic waste (16).

title_en: Multifunctional chisel type plough head
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional chisel-type plowshare, wherein the upper end of the inner side of a frame-type main body is provided with two fixed brackets connected with one end of a rocker, the other end of the rocker is connected with a driving block at the upper end, the driving block is connected with two adjusting rods, the other end of each adjusting rod is downwards connected with the other side of the frame-type main body, a plurality of rows of rakes are arranged below the frame-type main body, two sides of the upper end of the outer side are respectively provided with a support frame, the support frames are connected with one end of the support frames, the other end of each support frame is fixedly arranged with a connecting shaft at two ends of each roller rake, so that the roller rakes can rotate circumferentially, the adjusting rods connected with the driving blocks can synchronously drive the roller rakes to ascend or descend when the driving blocks are pulled forwards or backwards, the roller rakes and the rake ascend and descend simultaneously, and the driving blocks synchronously drive the adjusting rods to enable the frame-type main body to swing in a pitching manner when the upper end of the driving blocks swings in an angle manner, the plow share an integrated linkage, can dig soil and send and smash in step under agricultural equipment's drive, it is efficient, extensive applicability.

title_en: Clean and sanitary pet excrement storage device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a clean and sanitary pet excrement storage device which comprises a storage mechanism, a sealing sleeve and a sealing plate, wherein the sealing sleeve is fixed on the storage mechanism and provided with a sleeve opening, and the sleeve opening is aligned with an opening of the storage mechanism; the sealing plate is arranged on the sealing sleeve in a sliding fit mode and comprises a cover plate, a plate opening of the sleeve opening and a pull rod, the cover plate is used for sealing the sleeve opening after the whole sealing plate is pushed into the sealing sleeve, and the plate opening of the sealing plate is aligned with the sleeve opening after the sealing plate is pulled out to expose the opening of the storage mechanism. The sealing sleeve is fixed on the containing mechanism such as a plastic bag, the sealing plate is arranged in the sealing sleeve in a sliding fit mode, the sealing plate and the sealing sleeve are respectively provided with an opening opposite to the opening of the containing mechanism, and the opening of the containing mechanism can be closed or opened by pushing and pulling the sealing plate. So not only loading and unloading are simple, can completely cut off smelly flavor, and difficult quilt foul moreover sticks to hand, and more clean health uses experience to feel better.

title_en: Be used for high-efficient atomizing glaze spraying device of art pottery goods of furniture for display rather than for use
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-efficiency atomization glaze spraying device for artistic ceramic ornaments, which comprises a glaze spraying box, wherein the bottom end of the inner wall of the glaze spraying box is connected with a positioning rod, sliding blocks are sleeved on the positioning rod in a sliding manner, one opposite sides of two sliding blocks are fixedly connected with spray heads, the other side of one sliding block is fixedly connected with a rack, one side of the rack is engaged and connected with a gear, the middle part of the gear is fixedly inserted and connected with a main shaft, and one end of the main shaft is connected with a fixing device; fixing device includes spacing dish, dwang and elasticity stop gear. According to the utility model, the rack is driven to move vertically by the rotation of the gear through the meshing of the rack and the gear by utilizing the setting mode of matching the rack and the fixing device, and then the sliding block is driven to do up-and-down linear motion under the limit of the positioning rod, so that the height position of the spray head can be conveniently adjusted, the glaze spraying range of the spray head is wider, and the glaze spraying on ceramics with different heights is facilitated.

title_en: Wallboard saw with folding and interchangeable saw bit
