abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wallboard saw with folding and replaceable saw blades, which comprises: the center of the end part of the left shell is provided with a guide post, the guide post is sleeved with a rotating block, and the rotating block is provided with a shifting button; a position of the left shell corresponding to the toggle button is provided with a yielding groove; a limiting column for installing a saw blade is further arranged on one surface of the rotating block, which is far away from the left shell; the guide post is also provided with a pressing plate; the button is connected with the guide post through an elastic component; the positioning button is connected with the left shell through an elastic component; the positioning button is used for limiting the rotation of the rotating block; the right shell is connected with the left shell.

title_en: Hot pepper is planted with digging hole device with dust fall function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hole digging device with a dust falling function for pepper planting, which relates to the technical field of hole digging devices and comprises a connecting device, wherein the hole digging devices are arranged on two sides of the connecting device, a power device is arranged at the top end of the connecting device, and a shielding piece is arranged on the bottom side of the front end of the connecting device. Establish outside two lift posts through two drum covers that set up, and communicate two drums and hollow section of thick bamboo through two transport cylinders that set up, when electric putter shrink drove the lifter plate and descends, two lift posts can slide into two drums this moment, driving motor's output shaft drives the rotation axis and helical blade is rotatory descending in the drum this moment, can punch to ground, and the soil that produces when punching can rise in the drum along with helical blade's rotation, then through carrying in a landing to hollow section of thick bamboo, landing to subaerial along hollow section of thick bamboo, and then soil when having avoided punching scatters about, cause soil to scatter in the air.

title_en: Movable limiting structure and grain tank high-position grain discharging device with movable hard limiting function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a movable limiting structure and a grain tank high-position grain discharging device with movable hard limiting, and belongs to the technical field of high-position grain discharging. According to the movable limiting structure, the movable limiting block is horizontally arranged, and the movable limiting block is provided with a through groove; the movable limiting rod moves in the through groove; the vertical fixed setting of limit adjusting plate, the middle part through-hole can hold the activity stopper and pass through, and limit adjusting plate can block movable gag lever post. The rotation of the single movable limiting rod in two directions is limited, and the rotation angle of the movable limiting block can be larger than 360 degrees. The utility model provides a grain tank high-position grain discharging device with a movable hard limit function. The grain device combination is unloaded in the turn can be rotatory to two directions at the horizontal plane to activity stopper rotation angle can be greater than 360 degrees, guarantees the security of structure.

title_en: Shape bending structure of preapring for an unfavorable turn of events for FPC board joggling machine
abstract_en: An anti-deformation bending structure for an FPC board bending machine comprises an upper die structure assembly and a lower die structure assembly; the lower die structure assembly comprises a fixed seat and a lower die structure; the lower die structure comprises a connecting seat, a lower die component and a reinforcing component. When the carrier structure with the FPC board is moved to the bending structure position, the upper die structure assembly faces downwards and the lower die structure assembly faces upwards according to the bending shape requirement, and the FPC board is bent. In the bending process, the reinforcing component in the lower die structure of the lower die structure assembly moves towards the lower die assembly while the lower die assembly moves upwards, so that when the upper die structure assembly and the lower die structure assembly extrude each other to bend the FPC board, the lower die assembly is supported and reinforced, the strength of the lower die assembly is effectively improved, the deformation of the lower die assembly after multiple times of bending is avoided, and the bending quality of the FPC board is improved.

title_en: Automatic seed metering roller structure with high success rate
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic seed sowing roller structure with high success rate, wherein a plurality of seed sowing holes are arranged on the outer surface of a pneumatic seed sowing roller along the length direction, each row of seed sowing holes are distributed in the radial direction, each row of seed sowing holes of the pneumatic seed sowing roller are communicated with a corresponding single air pipe, the other ends of the air pipes are connected to an air exchange rotor, and the air exchange rotor is arranged at one end of the pneumatic seed sowing roller and is positioned in a negative pressure bin box. Compare in traditional seed metering cylinder, use the trachea to connect each row seed metering hole, make the suction that every seed metering hole obtained improve, reduce negative pressure power demand and improved the success rate and the rate of accuracy of adsorbing the seed, through the structure of the rotor of taking a breath, realized the independent management and control to the seed metering hole of next row, can realize stopping the negative pressure to the moment that needs the seed metering through the structure of tee bend interface and two solenoid valves, give the forward tonifying qi of malleation, can improve the success rate and the precision of seed whereabouts, thereby seed metering success rate and completion rate have been improved.

title_en: Automatic production die for O-shaped rings
abstract_en: The utility model provides an O type circle automatic production mould, it includes the mould body, this mould body comprises cope match-plate pattern and lower bolster from top to bottom symmetrical, be equipped with a plurality of sunken circular mould chambeies on cope match-plate pattern and the lower bolster symmetrical surface respectively, be equipped with the edge of a knife at circular mould die cavity top edge, and be equipped with a circle of feed inlet of taking the guide limit outside the edge of a knife, this feed inlet is just right to be equipped with the notes material hole, still be equipped with one section short runner to the feed inlet slope between notes material hole and the feed inlet, flow into the feed inlet through short runner and flow into in the edge of a knife finally flow into circular mould die cavity, circular mould intracavity central point still sets up a circular exhaust duct, the diaphragm groove of certain degree of depth is designed on the lower bolster, makes cope match-plate pattern and lower bolster opposite face position form a sealed diaphragm groove that communicates with each type chamber mutually when the compound die. The utility model has the advantages of simple structure, convenient processing, less investment, low energy consumption, convenient operation during production and high production efficiency.

title_en: Vacuum generating mechanism of silicon core pipe cooling device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a vacuum generating mechanism of a silicon core pipe cooling device, belonging to the technical field of silicon core pipe shaping equipment. The vacuum generating mechanism of the silicon core pipe cooling device comprises a cooling water tank, a water ring pump, a gas-water separator and a drain pipe; a water ring pump is arranged on one side of the cooling water tank; the air suction port of the water ring pump is connected with the upper end of the cooling water tank through a vacuum tube; the water outlet of the water ring pump is communicated with a drain pipe through a water outlet pipe A, a gas-water separator and a water outlet pipe B; the bottom end of the cooling water tank is communicated with a drain pipe through a sewer pipe; the sewer pipe is communicated with a water replenishing port of the water ring pump through a water replenishing pipe and a water replenishing valve; the sewer pipe above the water replenishing pipe is provided with a closing valve A. The vacuum generating mechanism of the silicon core pipe cooling device has the advantages of compact structure and ingenious design, can solve the problems that water mist existing in the existing vacuum generating mechanism of the silicon core pipe cooling device is diffused and the pipeline vibration is easily caused, and is particularly suitable for the use requirement of the silicon core pipe cooling device.

title_en: Press-forming device based on low energy consumption and constant temperature
abstract_en: The utility model provides a press-forming device based on low energy consumption and constant temperature, which comprises a supporting underframe, a working platform, a leakage hole, a PLC (programmable logic controller), a ship-shaped switch, a regulating knob, a return frame, a first electric cylinder, a lifting plate, a demoulding rod, a lower mould, a dry-burning heating pipe, a pressing mould head, a disassembling box, a second electric cylinder, a heat-insulating protective frame structure, a supporting wheel carrier structure and a movable regulating seat structure, wherein the periphery of the upper end of the supporting underframe is connected with four corners of the lower surface of the working platform through bolts; the leakage hole is formed in the right side inside the working platform; the PLC bolt install in the left side front portion of work platform lower surface to there are regulation and control knob and ship type switch on PLC front surface left side and the equal electric connection in right side. The arrangement of the supporting wheel frame structure and the movable regulating seat structure is beneficial to matching with parts for conveying.

title_en: Municipal administration guardrail
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a municipal guardrail, which comprises a guardrail unit, wherein the guardrail unit comprises an outer frame, a group of vertical rods are arranged in the outer frame, the bottom of the outer frame is fixedly connected with a base through supporting legs, a flower box hole is formed in each vertical rod, a cross beam is arranged at the bottom of the flower box hole, flower boxes are arranged on the cross beam and the vertical rods on two sides of the flower box hole, a limiting seat is fixedly connected to each vertical rod and is U-shaped, the limiting seat is clamped on each vertical rod, the side wall of the limiting seat is fixedly connected with the vertical rods through a group of screws, a limiting frame is arranged on the limiting seat, and the flower boxes are clamped in the limiting frames on the two sides. The utility model has the advantages of ingenious design, firmness, beautiful appearance and small occupied space.

title_en: Head cover is prevented stinging by feline
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of animal protection, in particular to a feline anti-bite hood, which comprises a first protective hood and a second protective hood matched with the first protective hood, wherein the tops of the first protective hood and the second protective hood are movably connected through a rotating device to form a full-head type hood body for accommodating the head of a feline, a plurality of air holes are formed in the first protective hood and the second protective hood, and fixing devices for fixing the first protective hood and the second protective hood are arranged on the first protective hood and the second protective hood. The bite-preventing cover is colorless, odorless, non-toxic to human and animals, transparent, strong in texture, waterproof, durable and firm.

title_en: Temperature control equipment for injection mold
abstract_en: The utility model provides a temperature control device for an injection mold, which comprises: the hydraulic pump, the hydraulic column, the side plate, the upper die, the sealing plate, the sealing shell, the processing bin, the storage device, the single chip microcomputer, the relay, the lead, the shell, the inner pad, the die cavity, the temperature sensor, the cooling pipe, the water suction pump, the feeding port, the lower die and the base are arranged on the lower end face of the hydraulic pump, the inner pad is arranged on the inner side of the shell, the die cavity is formed in the inner side of the inner pad, the temperature sensor is arranged on the inner side of the die cavity, the processing bin is formed in the inner side of the sealing shell, the storage device is arranged on the inner side of the processing bin, and the single chip microcomputer is arranged in the middle of the lower end face of the storage device. The lower die is used for carrying out molding cooling and temperature monitoring on the injection mold in the injection molding process, and the base is used for controlling the temperature of the injection mold, so that the temperature control effect of the injection mold is improved.

title_en: Novel air exhaust aluminum alloy glove mold
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel air-exhaust aluminum alloy glove mold, which relates to the technical field of glove molds and comprises a base, wherein the upper end of the base is fixedly connected with a main body, the front side of the main body is fixedly connected with a control device, the left end of the main body is provided with a slide bar, the upper end of the slide bar is slidably connected with a refrigerating device, the right end of the refrigerating device is fixedly connected with a mold block, a protection plate is arranged outside the mold block, a groove is arranged inside the main body, and a spraying device is arranged at the upper end of the groove. According to the glove box, the model of the glove can be inserted into the main body through the arrangement of the refrigerating device, the sliding rod, the mold block and the protection plate, so that the spraying on the outer part of the mold block is facilitated, the manufacturing of the glove is facilitated, in addition, the arrangement of the protection plate can effectively prevent liquid manufactured by the glove from being scattered to the outer part, the corrosion pollution to the outer component is avoided, and the service life of the glove box is effectively prolonged.

title_en: Mill is with high-voltage transformer who has alarming function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-voltage transformer with an alarm function for a factory, which comprises a high-voltage transformer main body, wherein the lower end of the high-voltage transformer main body is fixedly connected with a first mounting frame, the middle part of the upper end of the high-voltage transformer main body is provided with an alarm component, and the left end and the right end of the high-voltage transformer main body are both provided with vibration driving components. This mill is with high voltage transformer who has alarming function, when the infrared ray detection instrument detects there is people or birds biology in the high voltage transformer certain limit, controller control bee calling organ jingle bell, the warning light scintillation, remind the staff to keep away from high voltage transformer, the motor drives the cam rotation simultaneously, make the third connecting rod shake from top to bottom, thereby make the electric wire of block on the electric wire buckle shake from top to bottom, drive away the birds that fall the foot on the electric wire around the transformer, personnel's life safety has been ensured with this, avoid birds to high voltage transformer's damage, the practicality and the security of this transformer have been improved.

title_en: Forestry is planted with device that digs
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a soil turning device for forestry planting, which comprises a hand push frame, wherein first motors are fixedly arranged on two sides of the top of the hand push frame, fixed rods are fixedly arranged on two sides of the bottom of the hand push frame, a threaded groove is formed in the center of the inside of the hand push frame, a first threaded rod is rotatably connected to the inside of the threaded groove, a rotating disc is fixedly arranged on the top of the first threaded rod, an installation rod is arranged on one side, close to the fixed rods, of the fixed rods, and accommodating grooves are formed in two sides of the bottom of the installation rod. According to the utility model, the first motor and the fixed rod are installed by arranging the hand push frame, the idler wheel is installed by arranging the fixed rod, the first threaded rod is limited by arranging the threaded groove, the first threaded rod is convenient to rotate by arranging the rotary disc, the second threaded rod is driven by arranging the first motor, and the third motor is installed by arranging the accommodating groove.

title_en: Ecological device for preventing and controlling invasion of ampullaria gigas
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an ecological device for preventing and controlling invasion of ampullaria gigas, include: the anti-screw assembly comprises a connecting sheet and a plurality of pointed parts, and the plurality of pointed parts are arranged in the height direction of the connecting sheet; the length direction of the connecting sheet is provided with a plurality of pointed parts; the connecting sheet roll of the screw-thread prevention assembly is arranged into a cylindrical structure so that the plurality of pointed parts are distributed on the periphery of the cylindrical structure; the water-permeable enclosure is characterized in that the water-permeable enclosure is provided with anchoring assemblies on two sides, and the cylindrical structure is arranged at the top end of the water-permeable enclosure. The utility model discloses an ecological device for preventing and controlling fortune longevity snail invasion can prevent that fortune longevity snail climbing from getting into pending waters, carries out the physics prevention and cure.

title_en: Curing box

abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pet drying box, which comprises a box body, wherein the box body is divided into a heating cavity, a drying cavity and an exhaust cavity, a vertically arranged baffle is arranged between the heating cavity and the drying cavity, and the exhaust cavity is arranged at the top of the drying cavity; a pet rack is arranged in the drying cavity, a first exhaust port is arranged at the top of the drying cavity, and a second exhaust port is arranged on the exhaust cavity; the partition plate is provided with a first air duct communicated with the heating cavity and the drying cavity, the partition plate is provided with a second air duct communicated with the heating cavity and the drying cavity, and the first air duct is obliquely arranged upwards; a heating device, a first fan and a second fan are arranged in the heating cavity, an air outlet of the first fan is connected with a first air duct, and an air outlet of the second fan is connected with a second air duct; this application pet stoving in-process water droplet or excrement can not fall into the fan in, the clearance of the stoving cavity of being convenient for, first wind channel sets up to one side, and hot-blast up-blowing by the foot of pet, the stoving effect is better.

title_en: Extrusion forming device for processing hotpot condiment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an extrusion device is used in hot pot seasoning processing, including hot pot seasoning extrusion molding machine, the bottom fixedly connected with water tank of hot pot seasoning extrusion molding machine inner wall, the first water pump of top fixedly connected with of water tank, first water pump just is located hot pot seasoning extrusion molding machine's inner wall, the bottom fixedly connected with refrigerator of hot pot seasoning extrusion molding machine inner wall, the top fixedly connected with second water pump of refrigerant, the input intercommunication of first water pump has first water suction pipe, the other end of first water suction pipe runs through to the bottom of water tank inner wall, the output intercommunication of water tank has the outlet pipe, the top intercommunication that the outlet pipe runs through to hot pot seasoning extrusion molding machine has the tubule. The utility model discloses the extrusion device need not just can the shaping to the overheated static period of hot pot seasoning to hot pot seasoning extrusion back, and hot pot seasoning shaping time reduces, has promoted the machining efficiency of hot pot seasoning.

title_en: Open rubber mixing mill convenient to it is clean
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the rubber mixing machine and specifically relates to an open rubber mixing machine convenient to it is clean, including mounting plate, rotation motor, reduction gear and preceding cylinder, mounting plate's right side upper end sets up the rotation motor, rotates motor and connecting axle swing joint, the left side installation reduction gear of connecting axle, the reduction shaft is connected in the left side of reduction gear, the gear box is connected in the left side of reduction shaft, cylinder and rear drum before the left side installation of gear box, the left side and the slip mount swing joint of axis of rotation, the beneficial effects of the utility model it is fixed that cylinder anchor clamps pass through the front and back cylinder, when needing the clearance, can dismantle the front and back cylinder from the axis of rotation through left slip mount and cylinder anchor clamps, thoroughly clear up the surface of front and back cylinder, can change reserve cylinder during the clearance cylinder, can not lead to the rubber mixing machine to shut down, improved rubber mixing machine's work efficiency, the front and back cylinder personnel of being convenient to cylinder that can change simultaneously overhaul the maintenance, reduce the fault rate of rubber mixing machine.

title_en: Processing die of floor brush base cover plate
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a scrubbing brush processing field specifically is a scrubbing brush base cover plate's mold processing, including the base, department is fixed with the bed die in the middle of the top of base, and the top both sides of base all are fixed with the extension board, are fixed with the roof between two extension boards, and the top both sides of roof all are fixed with the pneumatic cylinder, and the roof downside is provided with the mould, and the piston rod of pneumatic cylinder runs through the roof and corresponds position fixed connection with the top of last mould. The utility model discloses a product shaping back, mould on the lifting, the electro-magnet lets in one-way electric current for hollow push rod promotes the quick drawing of patterns of product, and in the air pump produced gas entering hollow push rod, utilize first shower nozzle and second shower nozzle to clean lower mould surface and last mould inner chamber respectively, blow off impurity, thereby can realize drawing of patterns and clean quick automatic operation, thereby reduced staff intensity of labour, promoted the efficiency of processing simultaneously.

title_en: Coating film protective layer film structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides a pair of coating film protective layer membranous layer structure, include the plastic board and set gradually stratum basale, first absorbed layer, first dielectric layer, second absorbed layer, second dielectric layer, third absorbed layer and the protective layer on the plastic board, wherein, the stratum basale is the zirconium dioxide layer, first dielectric layer and second dielectric layer are the aluminous layer, and first absorbed layer, second absorbed layer and third absorbed layer are the three titanium pentoxide layer, the protective layer is the two aluminium trioxide layers, the utility model discloses a two aluminium trioxide layers protect the three titanium pentoxide layer, make it reduce and the air contact, avoid discolouing, have simultaneously and prevent scraping the wear-resisting advantage of flower.

title_en: Mould embedded type fine positioning structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mould embedded type fine positioning structure, which comprises a convex precision position block and a concave precision position block, wherein the convex precision position block comprises a first installation block and a convex block, the first installation block is detachably installed in the end surface of a cavity insert or a cavity plate, the convex block is arranged on the end surface of the first installation block facing the cavity insert or the cavity plate, the bottom end of the convex block is a plane parallel to the end surface of the first installation block, the convex block is a prism, the convex block is a cone, and the small end of the convex block is positioned on one side away from the first installation block; protruding precision position piece includes the second installation piece, and second installation piece detachable installs on the terminal surface of core insert or public template, the second installation piece towards set up on the terminal surface of first installation piece with protruding piece complex concave position, protruding piece can insert and establish in concave position, this kind of smart location structure processing is convenient, the precision is high, is difficult to the quilt wearing and tearing in the use, then can make the location accurate, prolong the mould life, improve product quality simultaneously.

title_en: Backplate glass tempering processingequipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a backboard glass tempering processing device, which comprises a tempering furnace heating section and a high-pressure air grid section, wherein the tempering furnace heating section comprises a tempering furnace heating section conveying roller, the shaft ends at the two sides of the tempering furnace heating section conveying roller are butted by using an upper symmetrical aluminum silicate material bearing bush and a lower symmetrical aluminum silicate material bearing bush for sealing, the tempering furnace heating section conveying roller is positioned in the combined part of an upper furnace body and a lower furnace body in a tempering furnace chamber, and the upper furnace body of the tempering furnace adjusts the height through a tempering furnace height adjusting device; the heating section of the toughening furnace and the high-pressure air grid section are connected in a front-back mode, the glass plate is conveyed and heated at the heating section of the toughening furnace, and after the heating section finishes heating, the glass plate is conveyed to the high-pressure air grid section through the conveying roller to be quenched. The high-pressure air grid section device of the toughening furnace comprises an upper air grid device and a lower air grid device, wherein the upper air grid device is connected to an upper air grid device bracket, and the lower air grid device is connected to a lower air grid device bracket; the compatible tempering processing of the 210 back plate glass by the back plate glass tempering furnace can be realized.

title_en: Weighing type bulk explosive charging device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a weighing bulk explosive charging device, which comprises an explosive containing and weighing component, an inflating component and an explosive discharging component, wherein the inflating component and the explosive discharging component are respectively connected with the explosive containing and weighing component; the gas charging assembly comprises a gas source generating part and a gas pipe which are communicated, and the gas pipe is communicated with one end of the explosive containing cavity; the explosive discharging assembly comprises an explosive discharging pipe and an explosive discharging valve arranged on the explosive discharging pipe, and the explosive discharging pipe is communicated with the other end of the explosive accommodating cavity; the utility model discloses in rely on the air pressure differential to make bulk explosive get into the big gun hole, do not have high-speed extrusion and the friction that the high-speed rotation of explosive conveying pump brought, essential safety nature security is higher to can every hole of real time control be applicable to the scattered blasting of engineering such as mine, road, water and electricity, tunnel, demolishs, explode temporarily and at the limited blasting construction of loading in mixture charge car service condition.

title_en: Seed culture ware is planted to agricultural skill
abstract_en: The utility model provides an agricultural planting seed culture vessel, which comprises a shell, a bottom plate arranged in the middle of the inside of the shell and a partition plate arranged at the upper end of the bottom plate, wherein a plurality of placing grooves are arranged in the partition plate, and culture containers are all inserted in the placing grooves; the inside water storage chamber that just is located the bottom plate below of casing, the casing right-hand member is fixed with rather than liquid box as an organic whole, runs through between water storage chamber and the liquid box and is fixed with the siphon. This seed culture household utensils are planted to agricultural technology, through pouring water or nutrient solution toward liquid box inside, when water level surpassed the siphon top in the liquid box along with, can produce siphonage this moment, the inside water of liquid box or nutrient solution can be discharged into the water storage intracavity portion from long pipe chute along short pipe chute and connecting bend, add water or nutrient solution like this and need not take out the cultivation container, thereby it is comparatively convenient to add, and a plurality of casings are convenient to pile up from top to bottom and are put and the level is put, make a plurality of seed culture household utensils of being convenient for use together.

title_en: Feed machine with drying function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a feed machine technical field just discloses a feed machine with stoving function, include: the base, the stoving case, fixed mounting is at the top of base, agitating unit, set up the inside at the stoving case, through setting up agitating unit, it is rotatory to drive the dwang through starting servo motor, make two rows of puddlers mix to the raw material stirring in the agitator, it strikes off to drive the raw materials of agitator bucket wall adhesion to drive the scraper blade when the dwang is rotatory and makes can more abundant mix, through setting up heating device, it makes the material be heated evenly to encircle agitator mode cooperation agitating unit through round heater strip parcel, and agitator and protection casing are with the material, better heat conductivity has, with promotion drying efficiency, in order to accelerate the stoving time.

title_en: Effectual thermoforming mould of shaping
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of dies, in particular to a thermal forming die with good forming effect, which comprises an upper die and a lower die, wherein the lower die is provided with a forming groove for forming a curved surface film, the forming groove comprises a bottom surface at the lower side and curved surfaces at two sides, and the lower side of the upper die is provided with a forming bulge matched with the forming groove; the lower die is characterized by comprising a lower die main body and a dismounting part, wherein the lower die main body is provided with a dismounting position, the dismounting part is detachably arranged on the dismounting position, the forming groove is formed between the dismounting part and the lower die main body, the bottom surface of the forming groove is positioned on the upper side of the dismounting part, and the curved surfaces of two sides of the forming groove are positioned on the lower die main body. The utility model discloses in, because the speed that lower mould main part transmitted heat to the dismouting piece rather than detachable being connected is slower relatively, can avoid mobile phone film middle part position to corrugate effectively, improve the yields of curved surface membrane production.

title_en: Non-metal flower basket welding machine
abstract_en: The utility model provides a non-metal basket of flowers welding machine, including frame, ratch fixing base, end plate advancing mechanism, elevating system and welding mechanism, set up horizontal partition frame in the frame, welding mechanism includes welder mounting bracket and welder, and the welding end of the welder of horizontal partition frame top sets up down, and the welding end of the welder of horizontal partition frame below sets up. This welding machine is applicable to the welding process of frock such as non-metallic basket of flowers, adopt the ratch fixing base to fix a position the ratch, end plate advancing mechanism can be fixed the end plate and impel the end plate to the ratch direction, impel the back that targets in place, the tip of ratch contacts the back with the end plate promptly, the welding mechanism of both sides moves respectively about elevating system drives, make the welding end motion of a plurality of welder to the contact department of many ratches and end plate, later welder erupts flame, weld ratch tip and end plate. The welding machine can improve the welding efficiency of the non-metal flower basket, reduce the labor cost and ensure the safety of personnel.

title_en: Rolled noodle slitting device of bread production line
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rolled noodle slitting device of bread production line, including a rolled noodle mechanism and a slitting mechanism, the discharge end of the rolled noodle mechanism is movably connected with the feed end of the slitting mechanism, the rolled noodle mechanism comprises a rolled noodle conveying plate, a rolled noodle seat fixed on the side edge of the rolled noodle conveying plate, a first conveying belt, a first driving component and a rolled noodle roller, the first driving component is rotatably arranged above the rolled noodle seat, the output end of the first driving component is connected with the tail end of the rolled noodle roller through a connecting piece, and the rolled noodle roller is positioned above the first conveying belt and is obliquely arranged relative to the conveying direction of the first conveying belt; the slitting mechanism comprises a slitting workbench, a second conveying belt and a mounting frame vertically arranged above the second conveying belt, a slitting assembly and a second driving assembly are arranged on the mounting frame, the slitting assembly is connected with the output end of the second driving assembly and is driven to reciprocate along the height direction of the mounting frame, and an anti-sticking assembly is arranged below the slitting assembly.

title_en: Surface laminating equipment for lamp panel of LED display product
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a LED display product lamp panel surface coating device, which comprises a feeding and discharging component, a film pasting machine head, a mechanical indexing turntable and a turntable; the mechanical indexing rotary table is arranged on the workbench, and the rotary table is arranged on the mechanical indexing rotary table and can rotate along with the mechanical indexing rotary table; a plurality of loading and unloading assemblies with the same structure are arranged on the turntable in a centrosymmetric manner; the film pasting machine head is positioned above the feeding and discharging assembly of the film laminating station and can move along the horizontal direction. The utility model discloses be the central symmetry form with the last unloading subassembly of a plurality of looks isostructures and install on the carousel, can rotate along with the carousel and go up the unloading subassembly one by one and turn to the tectorial membrane station with each, when the lamp plate carries out the tectorial membrane on going up the unloading subassembly to one of them, can place the lamp plate on other unloading subassemblies of going up, improved work efficiency.

title_en: Mosquito repellent device is used in beef cattle cultivation
abstract_en: The utility model provides a mosquito repellent device for beef cattle cultivation, which relates to the technical field of mosquito repellent equipment and comprises: the base is internally provided with an ultrasonic generator, the top of the base is provided with an audio amplifier, the audio amplifier is arranged at the top of the base, and the mosquito eradication assembly is arranged at the top of the base and used for eradicating mosquitoes. This kind of device, when needs drive the messenger to the mosquito, imitate the natural enemy of mosquito dragonfly or the frequency such as male mosquito through supersonic generator, rethread audio amplifier sends specific frequency, in order to reach the effect of driving the female mosquito of stinging the people, when the mosquito is too much, accessible supersonic generator sends specific frequency, send the sound through audio amplifier and attract the mosquito to be close to the device, the setting of rethread mosquito killing subassembly carries out the car light to the mosquito and kills, thereby reduce the quantity of mosquito, avoid being driven the mosquito after a period of time and can fly back from new the cowshed again and stink the beef cattle, the practicality of device has been improved.

title_en: Irrigation spray head capable of uniformly spraying
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of environment-friendly irrigation and discloses an irrigation spray head capable of uniformly spraying, which comprises a chassis, wherein a pipeline is fixedly connected to the top of the chassis, three annular guide pipes with different sizes are fixedly connected to the outer sides of the pipeline through connecting rods, and a plurality of identical spray heads are fixedly communicated with the outer sides of the three annular guide pipes at equal intervals; the three annular guide pipes are communicated with the pipeline through connecting pipes. This application can adjust shower nozzle spun water pressure through chassis, pipeline, ring conduit, shower nozzle, connecting pipe, relief pressure valve and water pressure gauge's setting, and then the shower nozzle spun water area scope on the different ring conduit is different, because ring conduit's size from bottom to top's increase, and then the accurate shower nozzle spun area on the different ring conduit of control of cooperation water pressure gauge, and then the shower nozzle spun water area is adjacent on the different ring conduit of messenger, and then avoids irrigation place to appear overlapping, further use of water economy resource.

title_en: Special-shaped tire filler cloth
abstract_en: The utility model discloses special-shaped tire laying cloth which comprises a connecting layer, wherein the upper surface of the connecting layer is fixedly connected with a laying cloth layer, the laying cloth layer consists of a special-shaped reed and a plurality of yarns, the lower surface of the connecting layer is fixedly connected with a heat conducting layer, the lower surface of the heat conducting layer is fixedly connected with a wear-resisting layer, the bottom of the wear-resisting layer is provided with a plurality of anti-skid grooves, both sides of the connecting layer, the laying cloth layer, the heat conducting layer and the wear-resisting layer are fixedly connected with edge sealing, both ends of the connecting layer, the laying cloth layer, the heat conducting layer and the wear-resisting layer are fixedly connected with connecting strips, and one side of each connecting strip is provided with a plurality of connecting ports. According to the utility model, the support force of the tire pad cloth can be improved through the arrangement that the pad cloth layer consists of the special-shaped reed and the yarns, so that the stability of molding of special-shaped rubber is ensured, the molding of special-shaped rubber tires can be accelerated, and the production efficiency is improved.

title_en: Agricultural land surface pesticide sprayer
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of agricultural equipment, and particularly discloses an agronomic surface pesticide sprayer which comprises a frame, wherein two front inserting arms are symmetrically fixed at the front end of the frame, a front wheel is rotatably arranged on each front inserting arm, a front grass baffle right opposite to the center of the front wheel is fixed at the front end of each front inserting arm, a transmission arm is fixed at one side of each front inserting arm, a driving motor is fixed at one end of each transmission arm, the driving motor is in transmission connection with the front wheel through the transmission arm, a fixed column is fixed at the rear end of the frame, and a rear wheel is fixed at the lower end of each fixed column. The beneficial effects are that: the pesticide can be directly sprayed on the surface of the near-ground weeds, so that the pesticide is prevented from killing crops together, repeated operation is reduced, and pesticide spraying efficiency is improved; the front wheel is provided with front grass baffle, the back grass baffle is installed to hydrojet pipe front limit, can avoid weeds winding on front wheel and hydrojet pipe in the work process of laxative, avoids the machine to damage, makes things convenient for the machine to walk normally in the field.

title_en: Mould guider with anticollision structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a die guiding device with an anti-collision structure, relates to the technical field of auxiliary devices for die guiding, and aims to solve the problems that the existing die guiding device mostly adopts direct die guiding, the probability of contact with the device is increased due to insufficient distance control when the die is guided, and meanwhile, the probability of damage to the die is increased due to overlarge collision probability. The outer fixing square blocks are arranged on two sides of the inside of the die guide block, the outer fixing square blocks are fixedly connected with the die guide block through the electric push rod, the guide square blocks are arranged on one side of the outer fixing square blocks, and the guide square blocks are fixedly connected with the outer fixing square blocks through the connecting column blocks; the distance measuring sensor is arranged at the abnormal middle position of the guide square block, the distance measuring sensor is fixedly connected with the guide square block through a clamping groove, the distance measuring sensor is electrically connected with the electric push rod, a guide rolling ball is arranged on one side of the guide square block, and the guide rolling ball is rotationally connected with the guide square block through the clamping groove.

title_en: Foam board apparatus for producing convenient to change mould
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a foam board production device convenient for replacing a die, which comprises a base, wherein a placing groove is further formed in the top surface of the base, a forming die capable of being quickly disassembled is arranged in the placing groove, a connecting seat is fixedly arranged in a mounting cavity, an adjusting screw is further rotationally arranged between the bottom wall of the mounting cavity and the connecting seat, a sliding seat matched with the adjusting screw is arranged on the adjusting screw, sliding rods are further respectively arranged at two ends of the top surface of the sliding seat, wedge-shaped blocks are jointly arranged on the top surfaces of the two sliding rods, swinging seats are further respectively hinged at two ends of the wedge-shaped blocks on the top surface of the connecting seat, positioning pins are respectively arranged on the upper parts of the opposite surfaces of the two swinging seats, a reset device is respectively arranged on the lower parts of the two swinging seats, and pin holes matched with the positioning pins are respectively arranged on the bottom wall of the forming die. The utility model can rapidly carry out the mounting and dismounting operation on the forming die, thereby facilitating the replacement and maintenance operation of the forming die and improving the service efficiency of the device.

title_en: Cat litter basin screen rake transmission device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cat litter basin screen rake transmission device, and belongs to the technical field of cat litter basins. Including cat litter basin main part, sieve harrow and sieve harrow body frame, the both ends of sieve harrow body frame are erect cat litter basin main part both sides, the both ends symmetry of sieve harrow body frame be equipped with the side slider with cat litter basin main part sliding connection, be fixed with the edge in the middle part below the cat litter basin main part the middle part track that the sieve harrow body frame direction of motion extends, slidable mounting has the middle part slider on the middle part track, is equipped with the synchronous connecting rod that stretches out to both sides on the middle part slider, the both ends of synchronous connecting rod are connected both sides the side slider, middle part transmission is connected to the middle part slider. The utility model can ensure that the cat litter basin screen rake operates more stably and smoothly and has balanced stress and convenient use.

title_en: Auxiliary release structure, rear mold and mold
abstract_en: The application discloses supplementary type structure and rear mould and mould that leaves. The auxiliary release structure comprises a male template, a sliding block, an ejector pin plate, an ejector pin and an insert pin. The sliding blocks comprise two sliding blocks which are arranged on the male template in a sliding way, the opposite sides of the sliding blocks are provided with concave parts, and the concave parts of the two sliding blocks are spliced to form a hole-shaped structure after the sliding blocks are connected; the middle part of the sliding block is provided with a through hole, two opposite inner wall surfaces of the through hole respectively form a first matching surface and a second matching surface, the first matching surface comprises a first matching straight surface and a first matching inclined surface which are sequentially connected, and the second matching surface comprises a second matching straight surface and a second matching inclined surface which are sequentially connected; the ejector rod is arranged on the ejector pin plate and movably penetrates through the male template, a first guide surface and a second guide surface are formed on two opposite sides of the ejector rod, and the first guide surface is in sliding fit with the first matching surface; the second guide surface is in sliding fit with the second matching surface, so that the two sliding blocks can be mutually far away; the insert pin is arranged on the ejector plate.

title_en: 3D prints defeated material sprayer
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of 3D printing accessories, and particularly relates to a 3D printing material conveying injector, which comprises a mounting plate and an injection head, wherein a motor is arranged on the mounting plate, a connecting sleeve is arranged on an output shaft of the motor through a bolt, a rotating box is fixedly connected to the connecting sleeve, two symmetrically distributed injection heads are connected to the bottom of the rotating box in a sliding manner, and a mounting ring is fixedly connected to the injection heads. Through setting up a transfer box that has cavity and arc wall, then install two injection heads on the transfer box, then the transfer box can rotate through the motor to owing to set up the commentaries on classics cover fixed by the dead lever on the mounting panel of installation motor, the cover is sheathe in the outside of transfer box, and the cover sets up the conveying pipeline in addition, can realize the exchange of two injection heads through the motor like this, after one of them injection head blocks up or damages, can change like this, reduce down time.

title_en: Gust lock test device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an array fan lock test device which comprises an upper loading plate, a rotating seat, a lower loading plate and a plurality of fasteners, wherein the rotating seat is provided with a groove which is arranged at the center of the rotating seat and is used for accommodating a test piece, and a first side part which is opposite to the groove, the rotating seat is of a fan-shaped structure and is provided with a rotating axis, the rotating seat can rotate around the rotating axis, the first side part of the rotating seat is symmetrically provided with a plurality of through holes, the first through holes of the plurality of through holes are positioned on the rotating axis, and the rest through holes on the first side part of the rotating seat are arranged along the fan-shaped arc line of the first side part. Compared with the traditional single-direction loading existing test device, the air lock test device can change the loading direction of the air lock test piece by selecting one through hole of the plurality of through holes which are arranged along the fan-shaped arc line of the first side part of the rotating seat so as to test the bearing capacity of the air lock test piece in different directions.

title_en: Engraving machine for denture processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an engraving machine for denture processing, which comprises an adjusting frame body, a processing table, a polishing drill bit and a clamp, wherein the polishing drill bit is arranged on the adjusting frame body; the processing table comprises a fixed table plate and a collecting assembly, wherein the collecting assembly is arranged in the fixed table plate and protrudes out of the upper end surface of the fixed table plate; powder and fragments produced during polishing of the fixture clamping false tooth can be pumped by the air pump to produce negative pressure in the collection dish, the dust collection chamber and the communication shell, so that an adsorption effect is formed, the powder is adsorbed, the adsorption receiving area of the powder and the fragments can be enlarged through the concave surface of the collection dish, and the volume of the collection dish can be increased through enlarging.

title_en: Supporting mechanism is transplanted to plant
abstract_en: The utility model provides a plant transplanting supporting mechanism, which comprises a clamping piece, wherein a plurality of supporting pieces are arranged at the bottom of the clamping piece and are distributed in a central symmetry mode relative to the clamping piece, a drip irrigation assembly is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the clamping piece and comprises a water storage bag and a fertilizer bag, the water storage bag is connected with the fertilizer bag in a conducting mode, and water in the water storage bag is mixed with fertilizer in the fertilizer bag to drip irrigation trees. According to the utility model, the clamping piece is arranged on the outer side of the trunk, the supporting piece is inserted into the ground and is used for supporting plants in an auxiliary mode with the clamping piece, water is added into the water storage bag, fertilizer is added into the fertilizer bag, and drip irrigation treatment is carried out on the area where the plants are located after the water and the fertilizer are mixed.

title_en: Transfer trolley
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of transfer vehicles, and discloses a transfer vehicle, including the transfer vehicle main part. This transfer car (buggy), the staff twists the fixed screw of flourishing hopper surface, through the cooperation of fixed screw and thread groove, can take out the fixed screw from the flourishing hopper, then the pulling pull ring can drive baffle upward movement, make first inserted block and first slot separation, second inserted block and second slot separation, and then can dismantle in the flourishing hopper with rabbling mechanism through the baffle and overhaul, in order to in time change the spare part of damage, reduce the probability that rabbling mechanism damaged effectively, make rabbling mechanism carry out continuous stirring to the concrete in the flourishing hopper, improve the transportation efficiency of transfer car (buggy) main part to a certain extent, reach the effect of being convenient for dismantle the maintenance to rabbling mechanism.

title_en: Electric detonator resistance tester with accurate measurement
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electric detonator resistance tester with accurate measurement, which comprises a tester, wherein a display screen is fixedly arranged at the front part of the left end of the tester, two connecting wires are fixedly arranged at the rear part of the left end of the tester, measuring rods are fixedly arranged at the left ends of the two connecting wires, a mounting assembly is fixedly arranged between the two measuring rods, a fixing assembly is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the tester, the fixing assembly comprises a fixing block, and a mounting block is fixedly arranged at the front part of the upper end of the fixing block. According to the utility model, through the fixed assembly, a user pulls the sliding block to slide in the sliding groove, then the resistor to be tested is placed in the mounting hole, the first spring pushes the sliding block to drive the second rubber block to extrude the first rubber block, and the resistor to be tested is fixed between the second rubber block and the first rubber block, so that the accuracy of detected data can be ensured, and the fixing of workers is facilitated.

title_en: Servo blowing device special for glass wine bottle forming
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a special servo blowing device for glass wine bottle molding, which comprises a workbench, wherein two ends of the outer wall of the top of the workbench are fixedly connected with side plates, lifting plates are arranged between the two ends of the side plates, a height adjusting mechanism is arranged between the lifting plates and the side plates, a blowing mechanism is arranged on the outer wall of the lifting plates, a mold is arranged on the outer wall of the top of the workbench, a rotating mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the mold, a molding cavity is formed in the inner wall of the mold, a heating mechanism is arranged in the inner wall of the molding cavity, and an oil collecting bin is formed in the inner wall of the workbench. According to the utility model, the mold at the top of the workbench and the forming cavity are arranged to bear glass liquid, the mold at the bottom of the workbench can be subjected to blow forming treatment by the blowing mechanism arranged on the outer wall of the lifting plate, the height of the lifting plate can be controlled by the lifting mechanism, so that the height of the blowing pipe can be controlled, the temperature of the cavity formed in the mold can be raised by the heating mechanism, the uniformity of the overall temperature of the mold is ensured, and uneven thickness is avoided.

title_en: Gardens sapling fixing device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of garden maintenance equipment, in particular to a garden sapling fixing device which comprises a base, wherein the top of the base is fixedly welded with the bottom of a support member, the inner wall of the base is in threaded connection with the outer wall of the support member, the outer wall of the support member is in sliding contact with the outer wall of the support member, the inner wall of the support member is in threaded connection with the outer wall of a clamping member, the support member is sleeved on the outer wall of a sapling and is fixed, the clamping member is rotated to enable the outer wall of the clamping member to be in contact with the outer wall of the sapling, the sapling is fixed at the center of the device, the fixing member penetrates through the base to penetrate through the ground through the rotation of the fixing member, the phenomenon that the fixing device is driven to displace after the sapling is inclined is avoided, convenience is brought to use of people, meanwhile, the outer wall of the clamping member is in contact with the outer wall of the sapling through rotation of the clamping member, the sapling is fixed at the center of the device, the contact area of a trunk is increased, and irreversible damage is avoided.

title_en: Concrete mixer
abstract_en: The application relates to a concrete mixer, and relates to the technical field of building equipment; the stirring device comprises a stirring barrel and stirring blades which are rotatably arranged in the stirring barrel, wherein a cover plate is arranged on the stirring barrel in a sliding manner, the cover plate is used for covering a discharging hole of the stirring barrel, a locking component used for fixing the cover plate is arranged on the stirring barrel, and the cover plate is fixed at the discharging hole of the stirring barrel through the locking component. According to the stirring device, the cover plate is fixed at the discharge hole of the stirring barrel through the locking assembly, and at the moment, a user can inject more aggregate into the stirring barrel, so that the aggregate capacity of the stirring barrel during stirring is improved, the stirring efficiency is improved, and the overall construction process of the user is accelerated to a certain extent; when the aggregate is injected into the mixing drum through the cover plate, the probability that part of the aggregate splashes out from the discharge hole of the mixing drum is reduced, and the comfort of a user during use is improved.

title_en: Carrot section drying device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a carrot slice drying device which comprises a drying box, wherein one side of the outer wall of the drying box is hinged with a box door, a feeding hole is formed in the middle position of the top wall of the drying box, a discharging pipe is fixedly connected to the top wall of the inside of the drying box, a supporting plate is fixedly connected to one side of the inner wall of the drying box, a servo motor is fixedly installed at the top end of the supporting plate, a blade is fixedly connected to an output shaft of the servo motor, a fan is fixedly installed at the other side of the inner wall of the drying box, and an air outlet end of the fan is fixedly connected with an air conveying pipe. This kind of carrot section drying device passes through the sliding connection of draw runner and T type inslot side when using, realizes the quick installation of filter and takes out, and is sliding connection in sliding block and spout inboard, under the condition of mutually supporting and using between limiting plate, mounting hole, constant head tank, reset spring and stopper, realizes limiting plate and draw runner's spacing to the stability of carrot piece in the stoving in-process has been improved.

title_en: Novel straight-line bottle blowing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel linear bottle blowing device, which comprises the following technical scheme: the bottle blowing machine comprises a workbench and a bottle blowing box, wherein the bottle blowing box is arranged in the middle of the top of the workbench, a motor is arranged on one side of the top in the bottle blowing box, a screw rod is arranged on an output shaft of the motor, a sliding block is sleeved on the outer surface of the screw rod, electric retractile B is arranged on two sides of the bottom of the sliding block, lifting plates are arranged on the output shaft of the electric retractile B on two sides, a clamping seat is arranged on the lower surface of the lifting plates, an inner groove is arranged in the middle of the inner part of the clamping seat, and a flexible chuck is arranged on the bottom in the inner groove. The utility model provides a novel straight line formula bottle blowing device has solved current part bottle blowing device and has adopted simplex position to blow bottle processing, and the unloading spends time longer on the beverage bottle, and clamping efficiency is lower, and the not good problem of beverage bottle blowing efficiency has reduced the last unloading spends time of beverage bottle to the bottle blowing efficiency of beverage bottle has been improved.

title_en: Anti-blocking dampproof fish tank feeding device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-blocking moistureproof fish tank feeding device, which is provided with a base, a rotating cylinder and a rotating motor part, wherein the rotating cylinder is integrally supported on the base and is driven to rotate by the rotating motor part; the rotary drum is provided with a fish feed inlet and outlet, a concave cavity is formed on the side surface of the drum wall of the rotary drum, a neodymium magnet I is installed in the concave cavity, a bucket-shaped structure is formed in the base, the center of the bucket-shaped structure is a discharge hole, a rotary cover capable of being movably turned is arranged at the bottom of the discharge hole, and another neodymium magnet II is installed in the rotary cover. The fish feeding device can automatically complete periodic fish feeding, the discharge hole is not blocked, excessive fish feed is not required to be manually removed, the cost is low, the efficiency is high, and the effect is good.

title_en: Injection mechanism of injection molding machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of injection molding equipment and discloses an injection molding mechanism of an injection molding machine, which comprises the injection molding machine, wherein a charging barrel is arranged on one side of the top of the injection molding machine, a nozzle is connected on one side of the charging barrel in a threaded manner, a sheath is fixedly connected on the outer surface of the nozzle, a rotating rod is fixedly connected on the outer surface of the sheath, a cleaning box is fixedly arranged on the other side of the top of the injection molding machine, a clamping block is fixedly arranged on the top of the cleaning box, and a jack is formed in the middle of the upper surface of the cleaning box. The utility model has the following advantages and effects: when the nozzle is blocked, the rotating rod outside the sheath can be rotated to detach, then the nozzle is inserted into the jack of the cleaning box, the clamping block clamps the rotating rod to prevent rotation, when the nozzle is pressed into the cleaning box, the plastic and sundries blocked in the nozzle are pushed down by the engraving knife, and the engraving knife pushes down the first spring at the bottom of the supporting plate through the electric push rod and the motor, so that the blocking in the nozzle is cleaned.

title_en: Grain seed soaking germination accelerating device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a cereal seed soaking and sprouting device, including electric hot water tank and be located its inside sprouting frame, the inside fixed a plurality of evenly distributed's that are provided with of sprouting frame sprouting board, one side of sprouting frame bottom articulates there is the closure plate, sprouting frame, a plurality of sprouting boards and closure plate all set up to filter screen type structure, the bottom contact of sprouting frame is provided with places the board, all is provided with the elastic component between four corners of placing the board bottom and the electric hot water tank; in this embodiment, through being provided with the sprouting frame and the sprouting board of filter screen formula structure in electric hot water tank, place the seed and separate behind the sprouting board layer upon layer, and the sprouting case is spacing inside electric hot water tank through the cooperation of placing board, elastic component and baffle, thereby conveniently dismantle it from electric hot water tank in get the seed and put, wholly effectively reduce the extrusion force that receives each other between the seed, improved holistic sprouting effect, and convenient operation, the practicality is higher.

title_en: Grafting broach
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of fruit tree grafting, and particularly relates to a grafting broach, which comprises a thumb sleeve and a finger guard, wherein the thumb sleeve is of a sleeve-shaped structure with an opening at one end, one closed end of the thumb sleeve is provided with a slope, the thumb sleeve can be worn on the thumb in a relatively attached mode, a cutter is arranged on the slope, the epidermis of a fruit tree trunk can be cut through the cutter, one end of the cutter is connected with a herringbone broach, the cut epidermis is pulled out by the herringbone broach, the finger guard is of a cylinder structure with two openings at two ends, the finger guard is sleeved on an index finger, and the herringbone broach or the cutter is prevented from being accidentally contacted with the index finger during peeling, so that the problem that the cutter is inconvenient to operate and is easy to hurt hands when the cutter is used for peeling the surface during grafting on a tiny branch at present is solved.

title_en: Anti-friction burning structure of injection mold and double-color injection mold
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-friction burning structure of an injection mold and a double-color injection mold, and relates to the technical field of injection molds. The front die assembly and the rear die assembly can be far away from each other or close to each other so as to finish die opening and die closing; the row position is provided with an elastic piece, the elastic piece is in a compressed state when the die is closed, and after the die is opened, the elastic piece drives the row position to be separated from the rear die assembly to form a gap; the driving structure drives the row bit to move laterally. The utility model can ensure that the row position is not in direct contact with the back die assembly in the process of die assembly and die opening of the front die assembly and the back die assembly, and prevent the row position and the back die assembly from being burnt, thereby ensuring the yield of product forming.

title_en: Chicken shed taste purifier for raising chickens
abstract_en: The utility model provides a chicken coop taste purifier for raising chickens, which relates to the technical field of chicken coop taste purifiers and comprises a chicken coop taste purifier main body, wherein one side of the chicken coop taste purifier main body is provided with a mounting assembly, one side of the chicken coop taste purifier main body is fixedly connected with a mounting seat, the middle part of the mounting seat is provided with a sliding groove, two clamping plates are slidingly connected to the sliding groove in the middle part of the mounting seat, a threaded rod is rotated into a groove of the clamping plate under the movable connection of two rotating rods, two nuts are rotated to clamp and fix the threaded rod and the clamping plates, the positions of the two clamping plates are further fixed, a connecting rod is transversely inserted onto the two threaded rods, clamping posts are sleeved at two ends of the connecting rod through rubber suction cups, and further fixing of the two threaded rods is facilitated, namely the chicken coop taste purifier main body is fixed on a support rod in a coop, and the situation that the chicken coop taste purifier main body is inclined and damaged due to accidental collision is avoided.

title_en: Rural citizen's host modularization afforestation equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rural civil sink modularized greening device, which belongs to the technical field of greening devices and comprises a greening device body, wherein the greening device body comprises a planting box, an accessory box is fixedly connected below the planting box, a planting bin is arranged at the front end of the planting box, a servo motor is fixedly arranged in the accessory box, a rotating shaft is arranged at the output end of the servo motor, the rotating shaft penetrates through the accessory box and extends into the planting bin, a shaft coupling is arranged at one end, far away from the servo motor, of the rotating shaft, a tooth shaft is fixedly connected at one end, far away from the rotating shaft, of the shaft coupling, and a bearing is fixedly arranged at one end, far away from the shaft coupling, of the shaft coupling.

title_en: Fishing floating platform capable of being flattened
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a flatly-unfolding fishing floating platform, which comprises a floating plate body and elastic hinges, wherein an assembly through hole is formed in the floating plate body, a connecting round table is arranged on the top surface of the thickness of the floating plate body, a protective rod is arranged in the center of the connecting round table, an adjusting pipe body is arranged at the top end of the protective rod, the elastic hinges are arranged on the surfaces of the left side and the right side of the floating plate body, an adjusting floating plate is arranged between the elastic hinges, the adjusting floating plate is positioned on the outer side of the floating plate body, a stable base is arranged below the floating plate body, a hollow groove is formed in the stable base, and a flow hole is formed in the center of the bottom end of the stable base. This but flatly formula fishing floating platform, the guard bar of threaded installation on the accessible connection round platform and the regulation body of guard bar top inlay fixed mounting are favorable to making guard bar and regulation body constitute the guardrail to improve holistic security performance to guard bar and the holistic dismouting work of regulation body are convenient, convenient split.

title_en: Preserved egg soaking device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a preserved egg soaking device, and relates to the technical field of preserved egg production and processing. The preserved egg soaking device comprises a bottom plate, a lifting mechanism and a lifting mechanism, wherein a soaking box is fixedly arranged at the top of the bottom plate, two groups of vertical plates are fixedly arranged at the top of the soaking box, a base is arranged at the bottom of the inner side of the soaking box, a soaking net frame is fixedly arranged at the top of the base, two groups of magnets are fixedly arranged at the top of the soaking net frame, and the lifting mechanism is arranged in the base. This preserved egg soaking device, through the cooperation of base, soaking screen frame and elevating system, can be when the preserved egg unloading on the lifter plate in to soaking screen frame, the control lifter plate constantly rises so that the preserved egg on it can be in the inside top of soaking screen frame with the in-process of continuous unloading constantly, with remaining preserved egg constantly in order to take, has improved the flexibility of device, has promoted the practicality of device.

title_en: Hot runner of bottle blank mould
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a hot runner of a bottle blank mold, which comprises a hot runner body and a cooling water connecting seat, wherein the hot runner body comprises a feeding seat and a heating seat, a feeding channel is formed in the feeding seat, an avoidance groove is formed in one end, connected with the heating seat, of the feeding seat, the cooling water connecting seat penetrates through the avoidance groove to be connected with the heating seat, an annular flow channel is formed in the heating seat, a heating ring is sleeved on the periphery of the annular flow channel, and a cooling water channel is formed in the inner side of the annular flow channel; the utility model sets the flow channel into an annular flow channel, the periphery of the annular flow channel is provided with the heating ring, the inner side of the annular flow channel is provided with the cooling structure, the contact area between the annular flow channel and the peripheral heating ring is increased, the temperature of a plastic original piece in the annular flow channel is controlled through the cooperation of the heating ring and the cooling structure, and the temperature of a pouring gate is properly reduced, so that the problem of pouring gate whitening is solved.

title_en: Cooling device for automobile part machining die
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of mold cooling, and discloses a cooling device for an automobile part processing mold, which comprises a box body, a water storage tank and a water tank; the water storage tank is characterized in that a motor is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the tank body, a transmission shaft at the top end of the motor is arranged at the inner side of the tank body, supporting rods are fixedly welded and arranged on the outer walls of the periphery of the transmission shaft and in the tank body, water storage tanks are fixedly welded on the outer walls of the supporting rods, the number of the water storage tanks is four, and electromagnetic valves are fixedly arranged at water outlets at the bottom of the water storage tanks; the lower left corner of the inner side of the box body is fixedly provided with a water tank. According to the technical scheme, the four groups of water storage tanks can be driven to rotate through the motor, so that the cooling water in each group of water storage tanks can be used sequentially, the circulating and flowing-back cooling water can flow into the previously emptied water storage tank for standing and cooling, and the cooling water is not used any more temporarily, so that the problem that the temperature is raised due to direct mixing into new cooling water, and the subsequent cooling quality is influenced is solved.

title_en: Epidermis cladding equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a skin cladding device, which comprises at least one first forming unit, wherein the first forming unit comprises a hanging needle floating mechanism and a push-pull edge wrapping mechanism for pushing and pulling fabrics, a hanging needle of the hanging needle floating mechanism is arranged on a needle withdrawing table, a lifting motor drives the needle withdrawing table to linearly move so as to realize a follow-up function, a needle withdrawing cylinder drives the hanging needle to finish the fixing and needle withdrawing actions of the fabrics, the first forming unit also comprises a rotating mechanism, the rotating mechanism comprises a rotating cylinder and a connecting plate driven by the rotating cylinder, and the push-pull edge wrapping mechanism is supported and arranged on the connecting plate so as to drive the push-pull edge wrapping mechanism through the rotating cylinder. According to the epidermis cladding equipment provided by the utility model, the hanging needle floating mechanism drives the hanging needle to execute action by following the downward pressing of the framework in the laminating process by virtue of the lifting motor, so that excessive tensioning of fabric is avoided, and meanwhile, the rotating mechanism can drive the push-pull edge-wrapping mechanism to rotate so as to prevent uneven laminating caused by accumulation of the fabric on a curved surface part.

title_en: Water-saving irrigation device for farmland
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a farmland water-saving irrigation device, which comprises: the stirring box is arranged at the top end of the base, the top end of the stirring box is provided with a fertilizer box, and the bottom end of the base is provided with a universal wheel; a water inlet pipe is arranged at the top end of the stirring box, a water outlet pipe is arranged at the bottom end of the front surface of the stirring box, and an electromagnetic valve and a water pump are arranged at the outer end of the water outlet pipe; the rear surface mounting of agitator tank has the motor, the output shaft of motor extends into the inner chamber of agitator tank and installs the puddler, the output shaft interference fit of motor has runner one, the surface engagement of runner one has the connecting band, the bottom engagement of connecting band has runner two. This farmland water conservation watering device passes through the motor and drives puddler and commentaries on classics piece and rotate simultaneously, makes the fertilizer that the stirring got off fall between the pin, avoids appearing the condition of more fertilizer gathering, can the outlet pipe discharge at every turn the volume of material, reduces the jam probability, and the practicality is stronger.

title_en: Low-oxygen insect-killing system
