abstract_en: The utility model relates to a low-oxygen insect-killing system, which comprises: the nitrogen generation device comprises a first nitrogen generation device, a second nitrogen generation device, a gas regulating station and a plurality of airtight spaces, wherein the highest nitrogen purity output by the second nitrogen generation device is higher than that output by the first nitrogen generation device, and the first nitrogen generation device and the second nitrogen generation device are in airtight connection with the plurality of airtight spaces through the gas regulating station; the plurality of airtight spaces are divided into one or more groups, each group comprises N airtight spaces, N is more than or equal to 1, adjacent airtight spaces in each group are connected in an airtight manner through pipelines, and each pipeline is provided with a valve; the gas conditioning station includes: the nitrogen generation device comprises a first branch, a second branch and a plurality of valves, wherein an air inlet of the first branch is connected with an air outlet of a first nitrogen generation device in an airtight manner; the air inlet of the second branch is connected with the air outlet of the second nitrogen making device in an airtight manner. According to the scheme, oxygen reduction is performed, the oxygen reduction time can be shortened, and the oxygen reduction efficiency is improved.

title_en: Polyurethane pouring device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a polyurethane pouring device, which comprises a cylinder body, a conveying pipe positioned at the middle position of the bottom of the cylinder body and an adjusting pipe positioned at the outer side of the conveying pipe, wherein the cylinder body comprises: the heat preservation groove is arranged in the shell of the cylinder body, and a plurality of groups of electric heating pipes are arranged in the heat preservation groove; and a plurality of groups of fixing buckles arranged on the outer side of the electric heating pipe, a feeding pipe is arranged on one side of the top of the cylinder body, and a rotating motor is arranged in the middle of the top of the cylinder body. According to the utility model, the spiral blade can be driven to rotate clockwise through the rotating shaft, so that polyurethane can be conveniently conveyed in the conveying pipe, the motor drives the screw rod to rotate, the external thread on the outer side of the screw rod is matched with the threaded hole in the adjusting ring, the adjusting ring and the limiting rod can slide through the limiting hole, the adjusting pipe is more stable to adjust, the adjusting pipe is telescopic to adjust, polyurethane can be conveniently poured, and the use effect of the pouring device is better.

title_en: Laminating machine for PE foaming material processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a laminating machine for processing PE (polyethylene) foaming materials, which relates to the technical field of PE foaming material processing and comprises a machine case, a limiting component and an upper box frame, wherein a workbench is welded and connected to the middle part of the upper side of the machine case, the limiting component for preventing deflection is connected to the upper side of the workbench, the limiting component comprises a cushion seat, sliding grooves, double-headed screws, sliding seats, supporting blocks and positioning plates, and the front end and the rear end of the upper surface of the cushion seat are provided with the sliding grooves. The laminating machine is provided with the locating plate, drives the double-end screw rod to rotate under the transmission of the driving piece in the pad seat, so that the sliding seat penetrating through the two ends of the locating plate slides along the spiral direction of the double-end screw rod, the adjustment of the locating plate is realized, the supporting blocks and the locating plate connected with the upper ends are correspondingly driven, the locating plates are mutually closed to clamp and locate the workpiece, the stability of the workpiece in the laminating processing process is ensured, and the locating plate can correspondingly adapt to the clamping laminating treatment of the workpieces made of foaming materials with different sizes through the sliding locating plate.

title_en: Automatic cleaning device for fruit juice production
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of fruit juice production, a self-cleaning device for fruit juice production is disclosed, which comprises a table top, one side of mesa is rotated and is had gear one, gear one's upper end is fixed with gear two, be connected with the tooth area between the gear two, one side of tooth area is fixed with the fixed block, the spout is seted up to the inside of fixed block, the spout internal fixation has the spring, the one end of spring is fixed with the clamping jaw, one side of mesa is fixed with the motor, the output of motor is fixed with gear three, one side of mesa is rotated and is had gear four, one side of mesa is fixed with the transport platform, one side of carrying the platform is fixed with the washing case. The utility model has the beneficial effects of reasonable structure, convenient control and good cleaning effect.

title_en: Automatic shredding device
abstract_en: Automatic filament cutting device relates to food shredding technical field, including soaking the shell, the bottom of soaking the shell is equipped with soaks the district, is equipped with soaking basket in the district, is equipped with the draining mechanism that lifts soaking basket to soaking district top in the soaking shell. The utility model solves the problems that the shredding device in the prior art is used for shredding potatoes, and an operator is required to drag out shredded potatoes from the water tank after the shredded potatoes fall into the water tank for soaking, so that time and labor are wasted, and water in shredded potatoes is easy to drip into the working environment.

title_en: Star-shaped pressure equalizing and shunting injection molding structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a star-shaped pressure equalizing and shunting injection molding structure, which comprises a mold core part, wherein a glue inlet setting plate is arranged corresponding to the mold core part, and a star-shaped distributed glue inlet structure is arranged on the glue inlet setting plate; the star-shaped distributed glue inlet structure comprises a glue collecting groove, a plurality of glue inlet openings are correspondingly communicated with the glue collecting groove, the glue inlet openings are distributed in a shape and correspond to corresponding mold cavities which are correspondingly communicated with an upper left unified equipment groove, an upper right partition equipment groove, a lower original equipment groove A and a lower original equipment groove B, and a multidirectional balanced top inflow structure is formed.

title_en: Anti-drop butt joint structure for gun rack and side plate
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an anti-drop butt joint structure for a gun rack and a side plate, which comprises the gun rack and the side plate, wherein the side plates are arranged on two sides of the rear part of the gun rack, inserting grooves are formed in two ends of the rear part of the gun rack, the lower ends of the side plates are inserted into the rear part of the gun rack, mounting grooves are formed in two sides of the gun rack, inclined plane protrusions with the upper ends inclined towards the bottom surface of the mounting grooves are formed in the lower parts of the mounting grooves, anti-drop protrusions capable of being inserted into the mounting grooves are formed in the lower parts of the side plates, and the anti-drop protrusions adopt inclined plane structures with the lower ends inclined towards the inner sides of the side plates. The utility model has the characteristics of improving the brightness degree of the gun rack installation part, facilitating the quick gun taking of users in emergency, improving the grabbing accuracy and the like.

title_en: Heat shield device with spray head assembly
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of manufacturing of quartz crucibles, in particular to a heat shield device with a spray head assembly, which comprises a mounting frame, a heat shield, an exhaust mechanism and the spray head assembly, wherein the heat shield is connected with the mounting frame, and a central hole for a graphite electrode to penetrate is formed in the heat shield; the exhaust mechanism is arranged on the mounting frame, the output end of the exhaust mechanism is positioned above the heat shield, and the output end of the exhaust mechanism is opposite to the graphite electrode; the shower nozzle subassembly includes link, nozzle and driving piece, and the link is provided with two and all is connected with the mounting bracket, and two links are located the both sides of heat shield respectively, and the nozzle is provided with two at least, and two at least nozzles respectively with two link sliding connection, the output of nozzle just is to graphite electrode, and is located the top of heat shield, and the driving piece is installed on the link, and the driving piece is used for driving the nozzle and removes along the direction that is close to or keeps away from exhaust mechanism. The application has the effect of cleaning the sediment on the graphite electrode.

title_en: Mortar premixing device for guaranteeing fine and uniform concrete
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of mortar premixing devices, in particular to a mortar premixing device for guaranteeing fine and uniform concrete, which comprises a shell, wherein a stirring cavity is formed in the top of the shell, a stirring mechanism is arranged in the stirring cavity, the stirring mechanism comprises a rotating motor, the rotating motor is fixedly connected with the front side surface of a supporting plate through a bolt, the output end of the rotating motor is connected with a cam, the position, close to the upper side, of the front end of the cam is rotationally connected with a connecting rod through a bearing, and the position, close to the lower side, of the front end of the connecting rod is rotationally connected with a moving rod through a bearing; the device is used for driving the stirring rod to move up and down conveniently by arranging the rotating motor, the cam, the connecting rod and the moving rod, so that the device can conveniently drive the stirring rod to move upwards at the bottom of the stirring cavity, the concrete stirred by the device is fine and uniform, and the device can scrape raw materials adhered to the circumferential inner wall of the stirring cavity by arranging the scraping plate.

title_en: Automatic feeding device for chicken breeding
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic feeding device for chicken breeding, which relates to the technical field of automatic feeding devices and comprises a feed storage box, wherein a caking breaking mechanism is arranged in the feed storage box, the caking breaking mechanism comprises a breaking rod I and a breaking rod II, the breaking rod I is rotatably connected to the inner wall of the feed storage box and extends to the outer part of the feed storage box, one end of the breaking rod I, which is positioned at the outer part of the feed storage box, is fixedly connected with a belt pulley I, and the outer surface of the breaking rod I is fixedly connected with a gear I. It can be through the cooperation setting between fodder bin, caking smashing mechanism, belt pulley two and the motor, can make when feeding the chicken, smash the processing to the caking in the fodder to effectually avoided because the fodder contains great caking and lead to discharging the condition that the pipe blockked up in the fodder, avoided simultaneously because the fodder contains great caking and lead to the chicken seedling to eat the condition that is influenced.

title_en: 3D printing device based on three-dimensional model data
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a 3D printing device based on three-dimensional model data, which relates to the technical field of 3D printing equipment and comprises a printer main body and a box door, wherein an air suction pipeline is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the bottom of the printer main body, and filter screens are fixedly arranged on the inner walls of the two ends of the air suction pipeline. According to the utility model, the fan motor drives the fan blades to rotate, harmful gas in the inner cavity of the printer main body is sucked through the air suction pipeline and is blown out of the room through the small purifier, and after the harmful gas passes through the small purifier, the harmful gas is adsorbed through the activated carbon adsorption plate, so that the discharged air is clean, the problem that the existing 3D printer generates some harmful gas when printing is caused by forming and printing the bondable materials such as plastics through high-temperature melting, and the damage to human body is caused when the printer door is opened is solved, the harmful gas generated by the printing model is absorbed and purified, and the body damage caused by long-time suction of the harmful gas by operators is prevented.

title_en: Irrigation equipment for afforestation engineering
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of irrigation equipment for landscaping engineering, and discloses irrigation equipment for landscaping engineering, which comprises a main body mechanism, an adjusting mechanism and a fertilizing mechanism, wherein the adjusting mechanism is positioned at the left end of the upper end of the main body mechanism, the fertilizing mechanism is positioned at the right end of the upper end of the main body mechanism, the main body mechanism comprises a bottom plate, universal wheels, a water tank, a fertilizer bin and a pushing handle, the universal wheels are fixedly arranged at the lower end of the bottom plate, the water tank is fixedly arranged at the right end of the upper end of the bottom plate, the fertilizer bin is fixedly arranged in the middle of the upper end of the water tank, and the pushing handle is fixedly arranged at the right end of the water tank. This irrigation equipment for afforestation engineering, through installation adjustment mechanism, direction and the height of being convenient for adjust irrigation according to specific condition have improved the flexibility, have reduced staff's intensity of labour, are convenient for irrigate some special positions or higher plants, have improved the irrigation effect, have improved irrigation efficiency, have improved the practicality.

title_en: A professional remote control unmanned ship for fishing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fishing, in particular to a professional remote control unmanned ship for fishing, which comprises a ship body, wherein the top of the ship body is fixedly connected with a bracket, the side wall of the ship body is fixedly connected with a swinging member, the output end of the swinging member is rotationally connected with a transmission rod, the end surface of the transmission rod is rotationally connected with a connecting plate, the end surface of the connecting plate far away from the transmission rod is rotationally connected with a straight rod, the outer wall of the swinging member is rotationally connected with a gear part, the gear part is fixedly connected with the top of the ship body through a base, the top of the bracket is fixedly connected with an adjusting sheet metal frame, the end surface of the side wall of the adjusting sheet metal frame is rotationally connected with a fastening clamp, the end surface of the top of the adjusting sheet metal frame is slidably connected with a supporting rod, the side wall of the supporting rod is fixedly connected with a stand column, the swinging member is in transmission connection with the transmission rod, the redundant energy loss in the transmission process is reduced, the transmission efficiency is further improved, and the combination of the straight rod and the connecting plate is further enabled to be more rapid in power transmission of the transmission rod.

title_en: Processing template of seamless film pocket
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a processing template of a seamless film pocket, which comprises a first template, wherein the front surface of the first template is movably connected with a second template through a hinge; the drawing pin fixing mechanism comprises a first fixing plate, the first fixing plate is fixedly connected with the first template, and drawing pins are fixedly connected to the front surface of the first fixing plate; the embedding mechanism comprises a second fixing plate, the second fixing plate is fixedly connected with the second template, a rubber embedding tube is arranged on the rear surface of the second fixing plate, and the rubber embedding tube is in embedded connection with the thumbtack. Through the structure, the cloth is expanded to the limit and hung on the drawing pin for fixing, and when the pocket is subjected to seamless film pasting, the first template and the second template can be combined, so that the drawing pin can be embedded into the rubber embedded pipe, and the cloth can be effectively prevented from being wrinkled during seamless film pasting.

title_en: Soil environment repair is with even medicine device that spills of ration
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a quantitative and uniform medicine spreading device for repairing soil environment, which relates to the technical field of soil environment repair, and comprises a bottom plate, wherein the bottom plate is connected with a movable wheel, and further comprises: the device comprises a raw material mixing mechanism, a quantitative liquid pumping mechanism, a fixed cylinder, a connecting pipe, a connecting mechanism, an atomizing nozzle, an adjusting mechanism and a soil breaking head. According to the utility model, the number and the spacing of the broken soil heads are adjusted through the adjusting mechanism, the connecting mechanism is used for fixing the atomizing spray heads, the raw materials are mixed and stirred by the raw material mixing mechanism, the mixed raw materials are quantitatively extracted by the quantitative liquid extracting mechanism and are sent into the fixing cylinder, finally the mixed raw materials are sprayed out through the atomizing spray heads to repair soil, and the problems that in the prior art, the scraper knife and the liquid receiving groove are fixedly arranged, the spacing between the scraper knife and the liquid receiving groove cannot be adjusted according to actual conditions, and the practicability is poor are solved.

title_en: Fixing piece of concrete prefabricated part
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fixing piece of a concrete prefabricated member, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein the top of the bottom plate is fixedly provided with the fixing piece, the inner wall of the fixing piece is fixedly provided with the concrete prefabricated member, the top of the bottom plate is fixedly provided with a fixing mechanism, the fixing mechanism comprises fixing plates, pressing plates, connecting plates, grooves and electric push rods, the top of the bottom plate is fixedly provided with four fixing plates, one sides of the four fixing plates are respectively provided with the grooves, the inner walls of the four grooves are respectively fixedly provided with the electric push rods, the output shafts of the four electric push rods are respectively fixedly provided with the connecting plates, one sides of the four connecting plates are respectively fixedly provided with the pressing plates, and the pressing plates are used for carrying out extrusion fixing action on the fixing piece and are connected with the fixing piece. The connecting plate can slide downwards in the groove by starting the electric push rod, the pressing plate is driven to move downwards, the fixing piece is extruded downwards, the fixing piece is pressed and fixed, and concrete leakage is prevented.

title_en: Diamond saw blade with high wear resistance
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a diamond saw blade with strong wear resistance, which comprises: the saw blade comprises a saw blade body, a grinding device and a cutting device, wherein the saw blade body is provided with a central ring part, an inclined ring part and a grinding ring part, the inclined ring part is arranged around the central ring part, the grinding ring part is provided with a mounting through hole, and the grinding ring part is sequentially provided with a first ring part, a second ring part and a third ring part from outside to inside; the first arc-shaped tooth blocks are arranged at intervals on the first ring part; the second inclined tooth blocks are arranged at intervals on the second ring part and are staggered with the first arc-shaped tooth blocks; the interval sets up in the third arc tooth piece of third ring portion, and third arc tooth piece aligns with first arc tooth piece, and the arc width is less than first arc tooth piece. According to the utility model, the grinding ring parts of the diamond saw blade are divided into 3 groups, and the first arc tooth blocks, the second inclined tooth blocks and the third arc tooth blocks are respectively arranged at intervals in a staggered manner and are matched with each other, so that the cutting grinding is enhanced, the wear resistance is improved, and the service life is prolonged.

title_en: Bubble film production automatic feeding
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic feeding device for bubble film production, which relates to the field of bubble film production and comprises a base, wherein a filtering component is fixedly connected to the left side of the top of the base, a mounting piece is inserted in the middle of an inner cavity of the filtering component, a cover plate is arranged at the top of the mounting piece, a first feeding pipe is fixedly connected to the middle of the top of the filtering component, a magnet channel is inserted in the inner cavity of the first feeding pipe, a mixing component is arranged on the right side of the filtering component, a stirring roller is rotationally connected to the inner cavity of the mixing component, a material conveying frame is arranged on the right side of the mixing component, a spiral feeding shaft is rotationally connected to the inner cavity of the material conveying frame, a material sucking pump is fixedly connected to the top of the right side of the material conveying frame, and a corrugated pipe is fixedly connected to the right side of the material sucking pump. According to the automatic feeding device for bubble film production, disclosed by the utility model, materials can be processed in the feeding process, so that the subsequent production efficiency is conveniently improved.

title_en: Plastic particle's pelleter
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a plastic particle's pelleter, including the organism, the feed inlet has been seted up to the organism lateral wall, the discharge gate has been seted up to the organism bottom, install pelleter on the organism, the organism inner wall rotates and is connected with the drive roll, the organism lateral wall is fixed with first motor, the output shaft of first motor runs through the organism and is fixed with the drive roll, the organism upper surface runs through and is provided with the threaded rod of being connected with the organism rotation, threaded connection has the slider of being connected with the organism inner wall slip on the threaded rod, the slider lateral wall rotates and is connected with the driven voller, install on the organism and be used for driving threaded rod pivoted drive assembly. When the material strips with different sizes are required to be cut into grains, workers only need to drive the threaded rod to rotate through the driving assembly, and the sliding block is connected with the inner wall of the machine body in a sliding manner due to the threaded rod and the sliding block in a threaded connection mode, so that the sliding block drives the driven roller to move up and down, the distance between the driven roller and the driving roller is adjusted, the material strips with different sizes are convenient to cut into grains, and diversified production requirements are met.

title_en: Heat insulation pad mold with locking mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a heat insulation pad mould with a locking mechanism, which relates to the technical field of moulds and aims to solve the technical problems that the mould in the prior art is generally lack of a heat insulation pad to prevent high temperature on the mould from being transmitted to a tabletop, and the upper mould and the lower mould are difficult to be quickly locked by the lack of the locking mechanism to realize stable installation of the mould; the upper end of supporting shoe is fixed to have seted up first cell body, the heat insulating mattress activity set up in the inner wall of first cell body, the fixed second cell body of having seted up of upper end of heat insulating mattress, the inner wall activity of second cell body is provided with the bed die, the fixed third cell body of having seted up of upper end of bed die, the inner wall activity of third cell body is provided with the mould, the fourth cell body has been run through at the front and back both ends of bed die, this mould possesses the heat insulating mattress can prevent that the high temperature on the mould from transmitting to on the desktop to possess locking mechanism can realize the stable installation of mould to last mould and bed die quick locking.

title_en: Mixed feed particle screening machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of feed screening and discloses a mixed feed particle screening machine which comprises a machine case, wherein a support column is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the machine case, a discharge chute is arranged on the front surface of the machine case, a flip cover is rotatably connected to the front surface of the discharge chute, a feed pipe is arranged at the top end of the machine case, motors are fixedly arranged at two sides of the machine case, a connecting shaft is fixedly arranged at an output shaft of each motor, a rotating plate is fixedly arranged at the other side of the connecting shaft, a baffle is fixedly arranged between the top end and the bottom end of the interior of the machine case, and a sliding plate is fixedly arranged on the side wall of the machine case. Drive two fixed striking boards through the pivoted board and reciprocate, and the screening board passes through slider and spring fixed connection, can make the start-up of motor, drive the screening board shake from top to bottom for the screening to the fodder, and reduce the fodder through the shake and block up at the inside possibility of screening board.

title_en: Plastic rice production possesses cleaning function and screens out device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of plastic processing, and particularly relates to a screening device with a cleaning function for plastic rice production. This plastics rice production possesses cleaning function and uses screening device, through setting up clean mechanism of installation in traditional washing cask, utilize clean mechanism's the net of catching to drive the net of catching and fall together when brushing the bucket subsidence, and make the net of catching wrap up the side of brushing the bucket through the receipts of spacing ring, and then catch the impurity of sunning through the net of catching, and after brushing the bucket upwards break away from the cask, catch the net and come up under buoyancy piece and collar's effect, and then take out and clean the material of catching, avoid a large amount of impurity to pile up in the cask, thereby be convenient for reduce clean water's change frequency when keeping clean effect, cleaning efficiency has been improved, and water resource has been practiced thrift.

title_en: A fermenting installation for bread idiosome
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fermentation device for bread embryo, relates to the technical field of fermentation devices, and aims to solve the problems that in the prior art, most of fermentation devices for bread embryo adopt a stirring structure, but the bread embryo is easy to generate viscosity and adhere to the inner wall of the fermentation device during fermentation, and is difficult to clean. The inside of fermentation cylinder is provided with the hollow tube, first branch is installed in the outside of hollow tube, and first branch passes through bolt fixed connection with the hollow tube, the scraper blade is installed to the one end of first branch, and the scraper blade passes through bolt fixed connection with first branch, the scraper blade is not laminated with the inner wall of fermentation cylinder, and the interval between the two is less than two centimetres, the cover dish is installed to the top of fermentation cylinder, and the cover dish passes through bolt fixed connection with the fermentation cylinder, the second branch is installed in the outside of hollow tube, the agitator is installed to the one end of second branch, the hollow tube passes through the bearing rotation with the cover dish and is connected.

title_en: Quick-dismantling mechanism for head of water drilling machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of water drilling machines and discloses a quick-dismantling mechanism for a machine head of a water drilling machine, which comprises a first connecting block, wherein a second connecting block is arranged at the bottom of the first connecting block, and a sliding block is integrally machined at the bottom of the first connecting block; according to the utility model, the first connecting block is mounted with the water drilling machine frame through the matching of the first mounting hole and the second mounting hole, and then the second connecting block is mounted with the water drilling machine head through the matching of the first mounting hole and the second mounting hole, so that a user can quickly plug the second connecting block with the first connecting block through the sliding chute and the sliding block, and the water drilling machine head can be effectively and conveniently quickly dismounted by the user; according to the utility model, the inserted link is inserted into the arc-shaped groove, so that one end of the limiting pin is clamped into the annular groove, and the spring pushes the limiting pin to limit the inserted link through the push plate, so that the first connecting block and the second connecting block can be effectively limited and fixed, and the first connecting block and the second connecting block are not easy to fall off.

title_en: Polygonal tree planting pit digger for sand
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of agriculture and forestry tree planting, and relates to a polygonal tree planting pit digger for sand lands. The technical scheme of the polygonal tree planting pit digger for the sand comprises the following steps: the first layer frame, each limit of first layer frame is provided with logical groove, the inside fixedly connected with second floor frame of first layer frame, both sides fixed mounting has the stand about the second floor frame both sides, rotatory semi-axis is installed to the stand centre, two rotatory semi-axes are with the eccentric suspension of work shelter in the second floor frame, the lower fixed surface at top is connected with the pneumatic cylinder in the work shelter, the lower extreme fixedly connected with hydraulic motor of pneumatic cylinder, hydraulic motor passes through the mounting panel and is connected with both ends slider, the slider is installed on the direction slide rail, the output rotation of hydraulic motor is installed auger bit. The polygonal tree planting pit digger can solve the problem that the existing tree planting pit digger is difficult to travel in a sand field, and can improve pit digging efficiency through fixed connection of a plurality of frames.

title_en: Feeding device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a feeding device, and relates to the field of aquatic product feeding equipment. Comprises a bait casting machine, a relay and a plurality of hydrodynamic sensors; the water-driven inductors are arranged in the water of the culture pond, and float on the water surface; the input end of the water power sensor is electrically connected with an external power supply, the output end of the water power sensor is electrically connected with the control end of the relay, the normally open end of the relay is electrically connected with the input end of the bait casting machine, and the public end of the relay is electrically connected with the external power supply. The utility model has reasonable structure, practicability, reliability and simpler feeding, and can effectively avoid the problems of overfeeding or insufficient feeding quantity.

title_en: Lake benthos collection system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of benthos collection, and discloses a lake benthos collection device, which comprises a porous net cylinder, wherein a rotary cleaning mechanism for cleaning the outer wall of the porous net cylinder is arranged outside the porous net cylinder, a disassembly and replacement mechanism for conveniently disassembling and replacing a brush plate is arranged at the upper end of the porous net cylinder, the brush plate is connected with the rotary cleaning mechanism through the disassembly and replacement mechanism, the rotary cleaning mechanism comprises a waterproof motor, the driving end of the waterproof motor is connected with the top end of a rotating shaft, the bottom of the rotating shaft is fixedly connected with a first rotary circular plate, the bottom of the first rotary circular plate is connected with the rotating end of a first unilateral rotary circular plate, and the bottom of the first unilateral rotary circular plate is fixedly connected with a first fixed plate.

title_en: Plastic mold capable of effectively filtering
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of plastic molds and discloses a plastic mold capable of effectively filtering, which comprises a plastic mold body, wherein a rubber layer is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the plastic mold body, a base is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the rubber layer, a bin is fixedly welded at the top of the plastic mold body, a feed inlet is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the bin, a delivery opening is arranged in the bin, a waste bin is fixedly arranged in the bin, a channel is arranged at the top end of the side wall of the delivery opening, and a discharge opening is fixedly welded at the side surface of the waste bin. The cooperation of first filter screen is sent out and the second filter screen is used, and first filter screen can filter in relevant impurity gets into the waste bin, and the removal that can the sweep pole simultaneously drives the blend stop and slightly stirs liquid for the speed that liquid permeated the filter screen, the baffle can outwards pop out under the effect of first spring, opens when having liquid to flow through the feed inlet, can protect inside the mould, has strengthened the filter effect of whole plastic mold.

title_en: Static drilling root planting internal thread pile
abstract_en: The static drilling root planting internal thread pile comprises a tubular pile body, wherein a plurality of protruding parts which are distributed along the axial direction are arranged on the outer side wall of the pile body, and the protruding parts are annular and are arranged around the pile body; the inside wall of pile body is equipped with along circumference arrangement's concave caulking groove, the inside and/or the outside pouring of pile body has the solidification soil. According to the scheme, the annular protruding part is arranged on the outer side wall of the pile body, so that a larger contact area is formed between the outer side of the pile body and the ground drilling hole, and the side friction resistance is increased; through the concave caulking groove that arranges along circumference in the inside wall setting of pile body to make the inside solidification soil of pile body can get into concave caulking groove, effectively increased the frictional force between inside wall and the solidification soil of pile body, thereby improved the holistic vertical bearing capacity of pile body. In addition, the concave embedding groove is arranged, so that the consumption of concrete raw materials required by production can be properly reduced on the premise of meeting the mechanical property of the pile body.

title_en: Temperature-controllable fruiting room
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a temperature-controllable fruiting room, which comprises a fruiting room, wherein an inner cavity of the fruiting room is divided into a processing cavity and a cultivating cavity by a partition plate, the bottom of the inner cavity of the processing cavity is fixedly connected with a dust removal cloth bag, the middle part of the inner cavity of the processing cavity is fixedly provided with an anion generator, the top of the inner cavity of the dust removal cloth bag is fixedly provided with an electric heating wire, two ends of one side of the top of the processing cavity are fixedly communicated with a communicating pipe, the bottom of the communicating pipe is fixedly communicated with an air outlet pipe, the corners of the top of the inner cavity of the fruiting room are fixedly provided with temperature detection sensors, and one end of the fruiting room, which is far away from a controller, is fixedly provided with a constant-current fan.

title_en: Glass fiber wire drawing device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a glass fiber drawing device, which comprises an outer tank body, wherein an inner tank body is arranged in the outer tank body, an installation ring is fixedly arranged on the upper end face of the inner tank body, the installation ring and the outer tank body are fixedly installed through bolts, an insulating layer is arranged on the inner wall of the outer tank body, a spiral heating wire is fixedly arranged on one side of the insulating layer and positioned in the outer tank body, the spiral heating wire is sheathed with the inner tank body, a wire is fixedly arranged on the outer wall of the outer tank body, one end of the wire penetrates through the outer tank body and is electrically connected with the spiral heating wire, a plug is fixedly arranged at the other end of the wire and positioned outside the outer tank body, and a user can connect the plug with an external power supply, so that the spiral heating wire can generate heat at the moment, thereby realizing the heating effect on raw materials in the inner tank body and preventing the wire from influencing the drawing quality of later-stage glass fibers due to too fast cooling.

title_en: Fermentation container of milk bun
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fermentation container of milk buns, and relates to the technical field of food processing. The bread fermentation barrel comprises a control cover, a bread fermentation barrel, a silica gel supporting frame and metal limiting frames, wherein the bottom end of the inner side of the bread fermentation barrel is clamped with a lifting cylinder, the upper side of the bread fermentation barrel is rotatably clamped with the control cover, the bottom end of the control cover is clamped with an infrared distance measuring module, the silica gel supporting frame is arranged on the inner side of the bread fermentation barrel, a plurality of metal limiting frames are arranged on one side of the bread fermentation barrel from top to bottom, and a plurality of limiting pipes are welded and fixed on the inner side of the metal limiting frames. The utility model solves the problems that the bread fermentation degree of the bread fermentation container is affected by the proficiency of operators and the distance between two doughs needs to be accurately controlled when the dough with smaller volume such as milk buns is subjected to final fermentation by controlling the cover, the bread fermentation barrel, the silica gel supporting frame and the metal limiting frame.

title_en: A hand-operated cutting machine for small-size stone material cutting process
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a hand-operated cutting machine for small stone cutting and processing, and belongs to the technical field of stone cutting. The technical scheme is provided as follows, and the problem that the spacing adjustment cutting machine is inconvenient is mainly solved. The machining device comprises a machining table, wherein a working box is fixedly connected to the top of the machining table, a threaded cylinder is rotationally connected to the inner wall of the working box through a bearing, a sector gear I is fixedly connected to the surface of the threaded cylinder, a rotating rod is rotationally connected to the front surface of the working box through the bearing, and a sector gear II is fixedly connected to one end of the rotating rod. According to the utility model, under the cooperation of the thread cylinder, the first sector gear, the second sector gear and the rotating rod, a worker can move the screw rod in a hand-shaking manner so as to control the moving direction of the moving seat, thereby adjusting cutting according to different stone sizes, effectively avoiding the situation that the cutting position is too single and can not work, and further improving the practicability of the cutting machine.

title_en: Sectional type tunnel furnace
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of tunnel furnaces, in particular to a sectional type tunnel furnace which comprises a workbench; the bottom of the workbench is fixedly connected with supporting legs; the surface of the workbench is provided with a conveying assembly; the transfer assembly includes a drive roll; the surface of the driving roller is rotationally connected with the surface of the workbench; the surface of one side of the workbench far away from the driving roller is rotationally connected with a driven roller; the surface of the driving roller and the surface of the driven roller are in transmission connection with a conveyor belt; one end of the driving roller is fixedly connected with a driven wheel; the surface of the driven wheel is connected with a driving wheel through belt transmission; a connecting shaft is fixedly connected to one side of the driving wheel; one end of the connecting shaft, which is far away from the driving wheel, is fixedly connected with a motor through a coupler; through sectional type structural design, realized carrying out the function of segmentation toasting with the cake, through setting up the cooler bin simultaneously, reach refrigerated function, improved the work efficiency of toasting.

title_en: Multifunctional steamed bread production line
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of steamed bread production equipment, and particularly provides a multifunctional steamed bread production line which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a cutter is inserted into the shell, a limiting hole is formed in the front surface of the cutter, mounting grooves are formed in the front surface and the rear surface of an inner cavity of the shell, a spring is fixedly mounted on the inner side of the mounting groove, one end of the spring is fixedly connected with a limiting block inserted into the limiting hole, and one end of the limiting block is fixedly connected with a connecting rod penetrating through the shell. According to the utility model, the connecting rod is pulled to enable the limiting block to compress the spring, so that one end of the limiting block is separated from the inside of the limiting hole formed by the cutter, and therefore the cutter is conveniently pulled out from the inside of the shell, and the technical problems that in order to cut a dough into a certain block-shaped structure in a steamed bread production line in the prior art, the cutter structure is usually arranged, however, the cutter is worn after long-time use, so that the cutter is inconvenient to detach and is troublesome to replace are solved.

title_en: Cutting mechanism and cutting machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of a cutting machine, in particular to a cutting mechanism and a cutting machine, comprising: a motor cabin is arranged on one side of the top end in the case, a motor baffle is fixedly connected in the motor cabin and fixedly connected to one side, close to the motor cabin, of the outside of the case, and a groove is formed in the baffle; the fixed block is fixedly connected with a cutter, the fixed block is connected with a connecting rod in a sliding manner, and the connecting rod penetrates through the box body of the case and the box body of the motor cabin to be fixedly connected with the motor; the beneficial effects are as follows: according to the utility model, the motor rotates the connecting rod, so that the cutter is driven to rotate, dough extruded from the surface opening is cut, the scraper structures are arranged on the two baffles, dough balls adhered on the two cutters are respectively removed, the effect of real-time cleaning is realized, the problem of production efficiency reduction caused by manual cleaning is avoided, and the scraper is replaced by disassembling the screw, so that the scraper is convenient to operate and clean.

title_en: Water dispenser
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of pet appliances, and particularly relates to a water dispenser. The water dispenser comprises a water storage basin and a control part, wherein the water storage basin is provided with an inner space and a water storage groove; the control part comprises a mounting shell provided with a mounting space and a water pump which is all arranged in the mounting space, wherein the mounting shell is also provided with a splicing groove, a sucker, a water outlet joint and a water suction joint which are all communicated with the water pump; the installation shell is installed on the water storage basin, the sucking disc adsorbs the outer wall of water storage basin, the border of water storage recess is pegged graft in the spliced groove, the joint that absorbs water is kept away from the one end intercommunication of water pump inner space, the joint that goes out is used for to output drinking water in the water storage recess. In the utility model, the control part and the water storage basin are easy to assemble and disassemble, thereby facilitating the cleaning of the water storage basin.

title_en: Mandarin fish culture pond with water quality monitoring function
abstract_en: The utility model provides a mandarin fish culture pond with a water quality monitoring function, which comprises a culture pond main body, wherein a cleaning assembly is arranged on the culture pond main body, and comprises a first cleaning plate.

title_en: Clamp suitable for trimming polyurethane cable sheath
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a clamp suitable for trimming a polyurethane cable sheath, and belongs to the technical field of clamp clamping. The clamp suitable for repairing the polyurethane cable sheath comprises a main shaft, wherein a bearing is sleeved on the main shaft, a rolling cylinder is sleeved outside the bearing, two ends of the main shaft are fixedly connected with auxiliary handles, so that the problem that a traditional cable outer sheath repairing device adopts two clamps with fixed radiuses to clamp a cable defect part, one of the two fixing clamps has a heating function, the other fixing clamp has a temperature control function, so that filling materials and original sheath materials are fully fused to achieve the repairing purpose is solved, the repairing device has a more accurate temperature control part, but the filling materials are required to be placed at the damaged part of the sheath in advance, the repairing device is a totally-enclosed heating repairing process, and if the fusion property of the externally added filling materials is poor, obvious fusion marks can appear, and the problem that the appearance and the reliability of the cable are possibly influenced is solved.

title_en: Marine product processing is with edulcoration device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of marine product processing, provides a marine product processing impurity removing device, and solves the problems of complex preparation work and low efficiency of an existing kelp cleaning device. The marine product cleaning device comprises a conveying belt and a sedimentation tank, wherein two ends of the sedimentation tank are respectively provided with a feeding end and a discharging end, the conveying belt is arranged at the feeding end, the marine product cleaning device further comprises a cleaning component, the cleaning component comprises a plurality of cleaning pipes and a plurality of spray heads arranged on the cleaning pipes, the cleaning pipes comprise a first cleaning pipe and a second cleaning pipe, the first cleaning pipe is arranged above the sedimentation tank, the second cleaning pipe is arranged below the sedimentation tank, the cleaning pipes are communicated with an external water supply pump, marine products are directly conveyed into the sedimentation tank through the conveying belt, the marine products are cleaned by the cleaning component, the marine products are not required to be manually fixed and then cleaned, and the production efficiency is improved.

title_en: Box piping lane pouring mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a box pipe gallery pouring mechanism which comprises a support frame and a top die, wherein the top of the support frame is fixedly connected with an outer die, two sides of the top die are rotatably connected with a top die, the bottom of the top die is rotatably connected with a bottom die, a bottom die is arranged between the bottom die, one side of the top die is fixedly connected with a first fixing plate, the top of the bottom die is fixedly connected with a third fixing plate, the upper surface of the third fixing plate is rotatably connected with two second double-head threaded pull rods, and the second double-head threaded pull rods are rotatably connected with the top die. The utility model not only can be used by matching the top angle die and the bottom angle die, and is convenient for a worker to take out the whole inner film, thereby improving the convenience of the device, but also can be used for facilitating the worker to take out the pouring body through the sliding plate, improving the material taking effect of the device, and ensuring that the connection between the ladder stand and the outer die is firmer through the fixing rod.

title_en: Self-cleaning anti-blocking underground oxygenation water-filling device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a self-cleaning anti-blocking underground oxygenation irrigator, which comprises an air compressor unit and a plurality of underground irrigation units; the plurality of underground irrigation units are connected with the air compressor unit; the underground irrigation unit comprises water inlet units and irrigators which are connected in sequence; a plurality of double labyrinth flow passages are arranged in the irrigator; the water inlet unit comprises a water inlet pipe, a wireless electromagnetic valve and a pressure reducing valve which are sequentially arranged from top to bottom; the water irrigator is connected with an air compressor unit. Can ensure that the device has the adjusting function of uniform drip irrigation, and can simultaneously oxygenation the root system of crops and prevent soil from entering the device to cause blockage.

title_en: Intelligent monitoring device based on 5G network
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of intelligent monitoring and discloses an intelligent monitoring device based on a 5G network, which comprises a connecting plate, wherein bolts are fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the connecting plate, a plurality of mounting holes are formed in the bottom end of the connecting plate, a threaded adjusting column is rotatably arranged in the bolts, a first shell is fixedly arranged on one side of the threaded adjusting column, a second connecting hole is fixedly formed in the side wall of the first shell, and a small-sized sound wave bird driving device is sleeved in the second connecting hole. According to the utility model, the device is provided with the small-sized sound wave bird repellent device, the sound wave emitting module, the top shell and the like to repel birds, when birds fly in front of the camera for a long time, the quality of detection is affected, the cleaning degree of the shell of the monitoring device is also affected, the device is more convenient for signal transmission based on the 5G network, and when the 5G signal receiving device receives and transmits signals, images can be received in a very short time at the receiving end, the image quality is high, and the delay is very low.

title_en: Discharging device of injection molding machine
abstract_en: The utility model provides a blanking device of an injection molding machine, which relates to the technical field of injection molding machines and comprises an extrusion head body, wherein a dredging mechanism is arranged at the top of the extrusion head body and comprises a fixed block, the top of the fixed block is connected with a connecting rod through a bearing, one end of the connecting rod is connected with a cross rod, one side of the cross rod is provided with a connecting ring, the inside of the connecting ring is connected with a threaded rod through threaded engagement, the bottom end of the threaded rod is provided with a dredging rod, the dredging rod can slide in a discharge chute of the extrusion head body, and the top of the threaded rod is in transmission connection with a knob. According to the utility model, through the use of the dredging mechanism, the dredging operation can be carried out on the discharge chute of the extrusion head body, so that the raw materials blocked in the discharge chute are poked out, and the blocked extrusion head body is prevented from influencing normal production.

title_en: Rice seedling raising device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of seedling raising devices and discloses a rice seedling raising device which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a water tank is fixedly connected to the top wall of the bottom plate, fixing blocks are fixedly connected to the front side and the rear side of the bottom plate, limiting grooves are formed in the adjacent sides of the two fixing blocks, a supporting plate is fixedly connected to the bottom of the front side of the fixing blocks, a motor is fixedly connected to the top wall of the supporting plate, a connecting rod is fixedly connected to the output end of the motor, a first bevel gear is fixedly connected to the side wall of the connecting rod, a sliding column is fixedly connected to the inside of the fixing blocks at the rear side of the connecting rod, and a second bevel gear is fixedly connected to the bottom of the threaded column. According to the utility model, the function of facilitating the observation of the growth condition of the rice roots by workers is realized, the overall working efficiency is improved, the culture cost is effectively saved, the flexible adjustment of the wettability of the rice roots is realized, the working efficiency is improved, and the rice yield is increased.

title_en: Cooling mechanism for pig feed production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cooling mechanism for pig feed production, and relates to the technical field of feed production; in order to solve the problem that the pig feed needs to be placed in a larger area for cooling after curing, the floor space is large, the cooling mechanism comprises a rotary connecting shaft connected to a servo motor and a conveyor belt arranged on two sides of the rotary connecting shaft and used for conveying feed, uniformly distributed rotary connecting plates are fixedly connected to the outer walls of the periphery of the rotary connecting shaft and used for conveying feed in a rotating mode, uniformly distributed stirring connecting rods are fixedly connected to the outer walls of the periphery of the rotary connecting shaft, and each stirring connecting rod is located between two adjacent rotary connecting plates. In the design of the utility model, when the rotary connecting plate rotates and transmits the feed, the feed can rotate, so that the aggregated feed is scattered, each part of the feed can obtain a better cooling effect, the stirring connecting rod stirs the feed, the feed is further scattered, and the contact area of the feed and the external environment is improved.

title_en: Concatenation formula tomb forming die with box centre form
abstract_en: A spliced tomb forming die with a box-type internal die belongs to the technical field of dies, solves the technical problems that chemical adhesives and a large amount of leftover materials are required to be used for stacking and discarding in the preparation process of the tomb, and adopts the following solution: the forming die comprises an outer die, a box-shaped inner die and an adjusting mechanism, wherein the outer die is of a rectangular frame body structure, a groove is formed in the bottom of the inner wall of the outer die, an outer decorative plate is arranged in the groove, anti-slip patterns are formed on the outer side face of the outer decorative plate, the bonding strength with pouring materials in the die is enhanced, and the box-shaped inner die is arranged in an area surrounded by the outer die. The gravels prepared by the method do not need to be bonded by using chemical reagents, the gravels are attractive in appearance, stable in structure and good in sealing performance, and the leftover materials and concrete materials are adopted to replace raw stone materials, so that the technical problems of stacking and discarding the leftover materials are solved, the production cost of the gravels is reduced, and the utilization rate of the stone materials is improved.

title_en: Mulch film pretreatment device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a mulching film pretreatment device which is used for pretreating mulching films before crushing, and comprises a bracket, a pretreatment structure and a conveying structure, wherein the pretreatment structure and the conveying structure are arranged on the bracket; the pretreatment structure comprises a shell provided with a feed inlet and a discharge outlet and a roller arranged in the shell and positioned between the feed inlet and the discharge outlet, wherein the surface of the roller is provided with at least one cutting edge; one end of the conveying structure is positioned below the discharge hole, and the other end of the conveying structure extends to the upper part of the inlet of the mulching film crusher. The mulching film pretreatment device provided by the utility model can pour the recovered mulching film at the lower part, can be operated manually, and is very convenient; simultaneously, the large and long mulching films can be cut off and extruded, so that the follow-up conveying is convenient, and the phenomenon that the mulching films are mutually entangled and dropped or entangled on a machine to cause mess in workshops is avoided.

title_en: Peanut picking and fruit removing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a peanut picking and fruit removing device which comprises a chassis, wherein a fruit removing frame is fixedly connected to the chassis, a first fixing frame is fixedly connected to the fruit removing frame, a driving motor is fixedly arranged on the first fixing frame, a transmission shaft is connected with an output shaft of the driving motor through a coupler, a net cage is rotatably connected to the fruit removing frame, a cleaning frame is fixedly connected to the chassis, a plurality of through holes are formed in the cleaning frame, a plurality of spiral rollers are arranged on the cleaning frame, a second fixing frame is fixedly connected to the chassis, a water pump is fixedly arranged on the second fixing frame, a water pipe is fixedly connected to the second fixing frame, the water pipe is connected with the water pump, and a water storage barrel is fixedly connected to the chassis. According to the peanut fruit separating device, soil on the surface of the peanut fruits is cleaned by the cleaning device, so that the staff of the staff is reduced, the peanut fruit collecting efficiency is improved, and the peanut fruits and plants can be separated more easily by the power device and the net cage, so that the peanut fruit separating task is completed.

title_en: Outdoor greening irrigation device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an outdoor greening irrigation device, and belongs to the technical field of water-saving greening. Including green planting district, pedestrian road and building, the ground of installation building is constituteed to green planting district and pedestrian road, and the building is surrounded by the pedestrian road, and green planting district is located the one side that the building was kept away from to the pedestrian road, plants a plurality of green flowers of planting in the green planting district, and bracing piece, axis of rotation, fixed block and manger plate layer are installed to the building upside, and the fixed block setting is at the side of being close to at the vertical side top of building. According to the utility model, rainwater is collected through the water storage tank structure, the supporting rod is turned downwards by rotating the rotating shaft in sunny days, at the moment, when the supporting rod is turned over ninety degrees by taking the rotating shaft as the shaft, water in the water storage tank structure can be discharged to a green planting area outside a building through the water blocking layer, so that the green planting flowers planted in the green planting area are irrigated, and the purposes of saving water resources and protecting environment are achieved.

title_en: Reverse hanging and spraying device for corn fields
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a corn field reverse spraying device which comprises a cross rod arranged on a corn high-frame spraying rack, two hanging spray bars arranged on the cross rod, and 8 fan-shaped atomizing spray heads fixed on the hanging spray bars. The device can effectively improve the mist deposition effect of the high-frame sprayer on the front surface of the corn leaf, the back surface of the corn leaf and different canopy positions of corn, improve the spraying efficiency, effectively reduce the pollution of liquid medicine in spraying operation to the environment, and reduce the phytotoxicity of excessive spraying to the leaf.

title_en: Large slide block demoulding mechanism for straight and inclined ejection of electric vehicle rear mudguard mould
abstract_en: The utility model provides a large slide block demoulding mechanism for a straight and inclined top of a rear mudguard mould of an electric vehicle, and belongs to the technical field of moulds. The novel mud guard molding device comprises an upper die plate, a lower die plate and a supporting plate which are sequentially arranged from top to bottom, a mud guard molding cavity is formed between the upper die plate and the lower die plate, a mud guard part molding part which is vertically arranged is arranged on one side of the mud guard molding cavity, an upper synchronous glue feeding structure is arranged on the upper side of the upper die plate, and a side molding insert which is connected with the mud guard part molding part is arranged on the side of the lower die plate. The upper and lower synchronous glue feeding structure can simultaneously feed injection molding liquid from the top of the mud guard molding cavity and the bottom of the mud guard molding part, so that injection molding efficiency can be improved, the side molding insert is matched with the lower die plate to form the mud guard part of the mud guard through injection molding, and the side molding insert ejection assembly can separate the side molding insert from the mud guard part towards a water level on one side far away from the lower die plate, so that the product can be demolded conveniently.

title_en: Dust collector of 3D printer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a dust removing device of a 3D printer, which mainly comprises a 3D printer main body; the dust removing mechanism is connected with the 3D printer body and comprises a mounting seat and a dust collection assembly, wherein the mounting seat is connected with the 3D printer body, the top of the mounting seat is fixedly connected with a dust collection box, and a dust collector is arranged on one side of the dust collection box; the dust collection assembly comprises a mounting block connected with the 3D printer main body, one side of the mounting block is connected with a dust collection pipe through a fixing plate, the other side of the mounting block is connected with a positioning plate, one end of the dust collection pipe is communicated with the dust collection box through a hose, and the other end of the dust collection pipe is communicated with a dust collection cover. According to the utility model, the dust collection assembly is arranged on the guide rod assembly in the 3D printer main body, so that the guide rod assembly can synchronously lift with the printing head in the 3D printer main body, and therefore, dust generated during printing of the printing head can be timely absorbed, and further, the dust can be prevented from flowing into a working environment along with air, and the health of staff is not easily damaged.

title_en: Morchella strain cultivation frame
abstract_en: The utility model provides a Morchella strain cultivation frame, relates to the technical field of strain cultivation, and solves the problem that the Morchella strain cultivation frame cannot conveniently loosen soil, so that infiltration of oxygen and moisture in the soil cannot be guaranteed. The support middle part is provided with the cultivation board, and cultivation board middle part is provided with the several culture tank, and cultivation board bottom both sides are provided with the several spout, and cultivation board bottom is connected with cultivation container, and cultivation container passes through movable part and is connected with the spout, and cultivation container passes through movable part and follows the spout and control and remove. The movable component arranged in the device can enable the cultivation container to vibrate and shake along the repeated pushing of the cultivation plate, so that soil inside the cultivation container is loosened to a certain extent, and oxygen and water are enabled to better act on mycelia of Morchella.

title_en: Mobilizable cubilose fruit germplasm keeps cultivation case
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of edible bird nest fruit cultivation equipment, and discloses a movable edible bird nest fruit germplasm preservation cultivation box, which is characterized by comprising a movable base and a low-temperature maintenance box, wherein the bottom of the low-temperature maintenance box is fixedly connected with the top surface of the movable base, the front side of the low-temperature maintenance box is provided with a box door, a plurality of cultivation plates which are horizontally placed are uniformly arranged from top to bottom in the low-temperature maintenance box, a separation frame is arranged on the cultivation plates, a plurality of accommodating cavities are contained in the separation frame, and edible bird nest fruit germplasm cultivation bottles are arranged in the accommodating cavities; the low temperature keeps the case to dispose the mechanism of taking a breath, and the mechanism of taking a breath includes fan and blast pipe, and the top of low temperature keeps the case is run through and is provided with the inlet port, and the fan is installed in low temperature and keeps the case outside, and the outlet duct way of fan passes the inlet port and stretches into low temperature and keep the incasement portion, and the side bottom of low temperature keeps the case is run through and is provided with the venthole, and the one end of blast pipe is connected in the venthole towards the outside one side of low temperature keeps the case.

title_en: Ejector sleeve secondary ejection mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a secondary ejection mechanism of a barrel, which belongs to the technical field of dies and comprises a double barrel assembly, a B plate, square iron, a first ejector plate, a second ejector plate, a limiting mechanism and a bottom plate; b, matching the plate with a double-barrel assembly to form a product glue position, and performing injection molding to form a product; the B plate, the first ejector plate, the second ejector plate and the bottom plate are sequentially arranged from top to bottom; the lower end of the double ejector sleeve component is fixed on the bottom plate and sequentially passes through the second ejector plate, the first ejector plate, the square iron and the B plate to the lower end of the product for secondarily ejecting the product; the limiting mechanism is used for limiting the movement stroke of the first ejector plate and the second ejector plate; square iron is positioned at two sides of the first ejector plate and the second ejector plate and between the B plate and the bottom plate; and a connecting pin is further arranged between the first ejector pin plate and the B plate, a spring is sleeved on the outer wall of the connecting pin, and the spring is used for ejecting and resetting. Two sets of barrel assemblies are used for carrying out secondary ejection, so that the efficiency is improved, and the product yield is ensured.

title_en: Sow delivery fence convenient for column adjustment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a sow delivery fence convenient for fence adjustment, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein the top of the bottom plate is fixedly provided with two first fixing rods, the top of the bottom plate is slidably provided with two second fixing rods, the top of the bottom plate is fixedly provided with a fixing plate, and an adjusting mechanism is arranged between the fixing plate and the second fixing rods. This sow delivery fence convenient to field is adjusted through setting up adjustment mechanism, when needs are adjusted delivery fence, can cancel fixing bolt spacing earlier to enclose pole cancellation spacing with fixed block and second, then promote the second and enclose the pole, make the second enclose the pole and drive first slider and second slider left and right sliding in first spout and second spout, and adjust the position of second rail and second dead lever according to sow's size, adjust back and fixing bolt spacing between first slider and the fixed plate, and adjust the telescopic link to suitable length, just so can adjust the size of delivery fence.

title_en: Native fish is bred with removing device of throwing something and feeding
abstract_en: The utility model provides a native fish is bred with removing feeding device, including the hull, the inboard upper portion connection of hull is equipped with the diaphragm, diaphragm upside middle part connection is equipped with the feed case, the hull left and right sides wall middle part is passed respectively and is connected and is equipped with two sets of feeding pipes, the inside slip of feeding pipe is equipped with the cylinder, diaphragm downside is connected and is equipped with the riser, riser left and right sides wall middle part is connected respectively and is equipped with two sets of electric telescopic handle, cylinder one end is equipped with the recess, electric telescopic handle stretches out end recess bottom to be connected, cylinder one end is connected and is equipped with the pushing plate, feed case left and right sides wall lower part is passed respectively and is connected and is equipped with two sets of feed pipes. Compared with the prior art, the utility model has the advantages that: according to the utility model, an external remote control motor is adopted, and the ship body is driven to move randomly in the pond through the rotation of the spiral blades, so that foodstuff is fed more uniformly; foodstuff inside the foodstuff box is conveyed to the middle part of the feeding pipe through the material guiding pipe, and the foodstuff in the middle part of the feeding pipe is pushed out by the electric telescopic rod pushing cylinder and the pushing plate, so that automatic feeding is realized.

title_en: High-precision valve needle adjusting device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of injection molding and discloses a high-precision valve needle adjusting device which comprises a screw rod sleeve, a rotating assembly for driving the screw rod sleeve to rotate, and a control host for controlling the rotating assembly, wherein the screw rod sleeve is in threaded connection with a screw rod shaft, the lower end of the screw rod shaft is fixedly connected with a spline shaft, the lower end of the spline shaft is provided with a valve needle, the device also comprises a photoelectric switch for detecting whether the screw rod shaft reaches a set position, and the control host is electrically connected with the photoelectric switch.

title_en: Cleaning device for laser welding jig
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a cleaning device of a laser welding jig. The cleaning device of the laser welding jig comprises a mounting seat, a feeding driving assembly and a brush head assembly, wherein the feeding driving assembly is mounted on the mounting seat; the brush head assembly comprises a brush head driving unit and a brush head, the brush head driving unit is connected with the free end of the feeding driving assembly, the brush head is connected with the output end of the brush head driving unit, and the brush head driving unit is used for driving the brush head to rotate. The cleaning device of the laser welding jig has the advantages of good cleaning effect, high efficiency and high degree of automation.

title_en: Pesticide sprinkler for sorghum planting
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of pesticide spraying, in particular to a pesticide spraying device for sorghum planting, which aims at the problems that the existing spraying device is inconvenient to uniformly spray and has a limited spraying range of a spraying head in the use process.

title_en: Dust removal powder recovery device of glass kiln
abstract_en: The utility model provides a dust-removing powder recycling device of a glass kiln, which comprises a dust-removing box and a collecting mechanism, wherein the dust-removing box is arranged on the dust-removing box; a purifying disc is arranged at the top of the dust removal box; the dust collection device comprises a dust collection box, a collection mechanism, a handle, a dust collection box and a dust collection mechanism, wherein the collection mechanism is arranged at the top of the dust collection box and comprises a filter plate, a shell and a collection box, the filter plate is slidably connected with the inner wall of the dust collection box, the shell is fixedly connected with the collection box at the top of the shell, the track is fixedly connected with the outer side of the collection box, a sliding groove is formed in the inner wall of the shell, the inner wall of the sliding groove is slidably connected with the outer side of the track, and the handle is fixedly connected with one side of the collection box. The dust-removing powder recovery device for the glass kiln solves the problems that dust powder generated by smoke filtration is inconvenient to collect, excessive accumulation can affect the filtration effect and reduce the working efficiency.

title_en: Image recognition is to target medicine machine that spouts with adjustable spray lance
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an image recognition targeting pesticide spraying machine with an adjustable spray boom, which comprises a base, a first chute, a telescopic cylinder, a sleeve, a PLC (programmable logic controller) processing unit and a telescopic rod, wherein the first chute is arranged at the top of the base, a material conveying pipe is arranged on one side of a material storage tank, a material guide hole is arranged in the center of a top plate, the telescopic cylinder is arranged at the bottom of the top plate, and the PLC processing unit is arranged on one side of the material storage tank. The medicine spraying machine is provided with a set of automatic positioning device: the user only needs to start first wheelset axle one side motor and second wheelset axle one side motor through the PLC processing unit, and two sets of motors finally drive the roof through a series of transmission and remove in the left and right sides and the fore-and-aft direction of horizontal plane for install the spraying equipment on the roof can carry out the location operation in the left and right sides and the fore-and-aft direction of horizontal plane to the crops of its below, and whole set location operation accessible PLC processing unit carries out automatic programming control, and is very efficient.

title_en: Nematode separator
