abstract_en: The utility model discloses a nematode separating device, which comprises a box body with an opening at the front end, wherein one side of the opening end of the box body is hinged with a box door, the bottom of the inner wall of the box body is provided with a first water storage box, the inner wall of the box body is provided with a fixed plate above the first water storage box, the upper end of the fixed plate is provided with an electric heating sheet, the upper end of the electric heating sheet is provided with a temperature sensor, the inner wall of the box body is provided with a humidity sensor, the inner wall of a groove is provided with a supporting sheet, the upper end of the supporting sheet is provided with a plurality of fixed grooves, each fixed groove is detachably connected with a device box consisting of a placement area and a separation area, the bottom of the outer wall of the second water storage box is communicated with a plurality of control valves, the lower end of each control valve is communicated with a water guide pipe, and one side of the outer wall of the box is provided with a control panel. When the method is used for separating the nematodes, the nematodes can be separated without passing through gauze or a filter screen, unlike the traditional mode, so that the recovery rate of the nematodes is greatly improved.

title_en: Wall perforating device for transformation of thermal power plant
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wall surface punching device for transformation of a thermal power plant, which comprises a transverse plate, wherein a lifting assembly is arranged at the top of the transverse plate, the surface of the lifting assembly is fixedly connected with a connecting shell, a moving assembly is arranged in an inner cavity of the connecting shell, the top of the moving assembly is fixedly connected with a short rod, and the top end of the short rod penetrates through the top of the connecting shell and is fixedly connected with a limiting plate. According to the utility model, the second motor, the threaded rod, the belt pulley and the lifting plate are matched, so that the automatic punching machine has the advantage of automatically adjusting the height to perform the punching function, is more convenient to operate, saves the physical strength of staff, and enables the staff to be easier; through water pump, flexible hose, atomizer and water tank cooperation, possess the advantage that can the dust fall, the dust that produces when making punching can not flow in the air, can not be inhaled in vivo by the staff, makes the health that the staff is healthy more, has also purified the environment of work.

title_en: Tea tree seedling planting plug
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tea tree seedling planting hole tray, which comprises a main body, wherein a plurality of planting holes which are uniformly distributed are formed in the main body, a planting box is arranged in the planting holes in a sliding manner, a spring is fixedly connected between the bottom of the planting box and the bottom of the planting hole, two supporting plates are fixedly connected to the upper part of the main body, a water tank is fixedly connected to the top of each supporting plate, a rigid water supply thin pipe penetrating through and connected to the water tank in a sliding manner is abutted to the upper side of each planting box, a water inlet is formed in the contact part of each water supply thin pipe with the water tank, and the water supply work is automatically controlled through the overall weight change caused by the change of the water content of soil and plants.

title_en: Pesticide sprinkler
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a pesticide spraying device which comprises a vehicle body, a pesticide spraying tank, a pesticide adding port and a water injection port, wherein the pesticide spraying tank is arranged at the top end of the vehicle body, the pesticide adding port is arranged at the top end of the pesticide adding tank, the water injection port is arranged at the rear end of the pesticide spraying tank, a filtering device is arranged at the bottom end of the water injection port and comprises a water purifying tank, a cobble layer, a coarse sand layer and a fine sand layer, the bottom of the water injection port is provided with the water purifying tank, the cobble layer, the coarse sand layer and the fine sand layer are sequentially arranged in the water purifying tank along the water flow direction, the bottom of the water purifying tank is provided with a water inlet pipe, one end of the water inlet pipe is connected with the water purifying tank, and the other end of the water inlet pipe is connected with the pesticide spraying tank.

title_en: Positioning frame for submerged plant planting
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of submerged plant planting, in particular to a positioning frame for submerged plant planting, which comprises a fixed column, wherein a frame body and a planting bed are inserted in the middle of the fixed column, the top of the planting bed is clamped with the bottom of the frame body, a planting box is clamped in the frame body, the bottom of the planting box is inserted with the planting bed, two sides of the planting box are fixedly connected with ventilation holes, a sand bag is movably placed in the frame body, and the top of the sand bag is connected with ropes in a tying mode. The sand bag is placed on the improved positioning frame, the positioning frame can be submerged under water in an auxiliary mode, and meanwhile, after the sand bag is pulled up by the aid of the ropes, the positioning frame can float upwards along the fixed column by aid of buoyancy, and the purpose of controlling the height is achieved.

title_en: Greenhouse irrigation device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of greenhouses, and discloses a greenhouse irrigation device. The greenhouse comprises a greenhouse body, wherein a fixing seat is fixedly connected to the inside of the greenhouse body, a first hose is uniformly distributed on the right side surface of the fixing seat, a first spray head is fixedly connected to one end of the first hose away from the fixing seat, a first limiting ring is fixedly connected to the side surface of the first spray head, a first connecting rod is fixedly connected to the lower surface of the first limiting ring, a multi-way pipe is fixedly connected to the lower surface of the fixing seat, a second hose is uniformly distributed on the side surface of the multi-way pipe, and a second spray head is fixedly connected to one end of the second hose away from the multi-way pipe.

title_en: Seedling support is fixed in seedling planting
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a seedling planting and fixing seedling support, which belongs to the technical field of seedling planting and particularly relates to a seedling planting and fixing seedling support, and comprises two arc hoops connected together, wherein a supporting piece is fixed at the bottom of each arc hoop, a spiral groove is transversely formed in each arc hoop, a screw is connected in each spiral groove in a threaded manner, one end of each screw is connected with a clamping plate through a bearing, the other end of each screw is fixedly connected with a handheld part, and a connecting port is formed in one side, away from the corresponding clamping plate, of each arc hoop.

title_en: Tree vine plant cleaner
abstract_en: The application provides a tree dish rattan class plant clearance ware, including handheld pole, the top of handheld pole is equipped with cutting structure, fixedly connected with support on the top lateral wall of handheld pole, the top fixedly connected with installing frame of support, symmetrical sliding connection has two sliders in the installing frame, two all be fixed with the clamp splice on the bottom lateral wall of slider, two all offered the smooth mouth on the inside wall of slider, and all sliding connection has the draw runner in the smooth mouth, two fixedly connected with movable block between the draw runner. The utility model discloses a through support, installing frame, slider, clamp splice, draw runner, movable block, connecting rod, first movable block, regulation pole, second movable block, interior pole, pull ring, connection piece and spring that set up, realized carrying out the centre gripping to the dish rattan class plant on the trees and lead, the high-efficient dish rattan class plant of cleaning has solved among the prior art inconvenient to climbing the dish rattan class plant on the trees effectively clear up the problem.

title_en: Water-saving irrigation device for crops
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of crop water-saving irrigation, and discloses a crop water-saving irrigation device, which comprises a base and a water storage tank, wherein the water storage tank is arranged above the base, a motor is arranged in an inner cavity of the base, a rotating rod is fixedly arranged at the output end of the motor, the other end of the rotating rod penetrates through the base and is fixedly connected to the bottom of the water storage tank, a first sliding mechanism is arranged on the opposite side wall of the water storage tank on the base, the first sliding mechanism comprises a circular sliding groove and rolling balls, the circular sliding groove is arranged above the base, a plurality of rolling balls which are circumferentially distributed are slidably arranged in the inner cavity, and the other end of each rolling ball is fixedly connected to the bottom of the water storage tank. According to the utility model, the electric push rod is started to drive the sliding block in the second sliding mechanism to move on the sliding groove, so that the electric push rod can drive the return plate to move, the height of the return plate can be adjusted, the position of the sprinkler head can be adjusted, and the sprinkler head is practical and suitable for wide popularization and use.

title_en: Novel automatic feeding and breeding equipment for breeding pigs and live pigs
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a novel automatic feeding and breeding equipment for pigs and live pigs, which comprises a hanging bracket, wherein the inner wall of the hanging bracket is fixedly connected with a feeding tank, the upper surface of the feeding tank is connected with a transmission mechanism through a first mounting bracket, one end of the transmission mechanism is movably connected with a stirring mechanism, the stirring mechanism is positioned in the feeding tank, the upper surface of the feeding tank is fixedly connected with a second mounting bracket, and the inner wall of the second mounting bracket is fixedly connected with a moving mechanism; the application relates to the technical field of live pig breeding. When the novel automatic feeding and breeding device for pigs and live pigs is used, the bucket-shaped isolation cover and the feeding tray are controlled to move upwards through the moving mechanism, feed slides between the bucket-shaped isolation cover and the feeding tray, the bucket-shaped isolation cover is controlled to move downwards, the feed between the bucket-shaped isolation cover and the feeding tray automatically slides into the feeding tray, so that the live pigs can eat conveniently, and the bucket-shaped isolation cover can partition the discharging part of the feeding tank after moving downwards to limit the feeding amount of the feed.

title_en: Cutting and cleaning integrated device for constructional engineering
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cutting and cleaning integrated device for construction engineering, which relates to the technical field of building material cutting devices, wherein a cutter groove is formed in one side of the top of a supporting table, a sewage inlet is formed in the bottom of one side of the cutter groove, a sewage outlet is formed in one side of the supporting table, the sewage inlet and the sewage outlet are communicated with each other, hanging rails are arranged on two sides of the bottom of the sewage outlet, a collecting box is slidably arranged at the bottom of the hanging rails, supporting blocks are welded at two ends of one side of a baffle plate, and a supporting plate is arranged at the top of the supporting block.

title_en: Injection mold for plastic part embedded with nut
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an injection mold for a plastic part embedded with a nut, which comprises an upper mold plate, an upper mold core, a lower mold plate and a lower mold core, wherein the bottom surface of the lower mold core is provided with a first inner cavity, a motor is fixedly connected in the first inner cavity, the output shaft of the motor is connected with a screw rod, the top end of the screw rod is connected with a nut in a threaded manner, and the screw rod extends into a third cavity; the first cavity is internally provided with a driving mechanism, a first ejector rod and a second ejector rod, the first ejector rod stretches into the bottom of the first cavity, the second ejector rod stretches into the bottom of the second cavity, and the driving mechanism drives the first ejector rod and the second ejector rod to lift. The hot-melted plastic material flows into the cavity through the gate and the runner. And the plastic material is molded in a third cavity and is connected with the nut. And (3) starting the motor, rotating the screw rod, and ejecting the material in the third cavity. The driving mechanism drives the first ejector rod and the second ejector rod to lift, and the first ejector rod and the second ejector rod respectively eject materials in the first cavity and the second cavity to be separated from the cavities.

title_en: Fiber composite fireproof air duct plate
abstract_en: The utility model aims to provide a fiber composite fireproof air duct board, which is formed by adopting casting forming and pulp-flowing roller leveling technology, so that the structural strength of the board is greatly improved, meanwhile, a structural support frame is adopted, the strength of the board is further enhanced, and then, through staggered arrangement of a first sound insulation hole and a second sound insulation hole, sound insulation cotton is filled, so that the sound insulation effect of the board is enhanced, the production cost is finally reduced, and meanwhile, the production efficiency is improved.

title_en: Water and fertilizer irrigation conveying device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a liquid manure irrigation conveying device which comprises a transportation trolley, wherein a stirring barrel is fixedly arranged on the transportation trolley, an arc-shaped support is fixedly arranged on the upper edge of the stirring barrel, a power motor is fixedly arranged on the arc-shaped support, a transmission shaft is fixedly arranged at the output end of the power motor, a brush plate is fixedly arranged on the transmission shaft, a filter screen support is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the stirring barrel, a water flushing piston is slidably arranged on the transmission shaft and positioned below the filter screen support, a reciprocating extrusion block is fixedly arranged on the water flushing piston, and an extrusion column is fixedly arranged on the transmission shaft. Through the cooperation of extrusion post and reciprocal extrusion piece, the extrusion post is rotatory can drive reciprocal extrusion piece and float from top to bottom, and reciprocal extrusion piece can drive to gush water and go up and down to do reciprocating motion, and upward the removal can drive the inside liquid manure of travelling bogie to gush out and move on gushing water and piston, makes the filter screen constantly have reciprocal liquid manure to wash away, avoids undissolved fertilizer to block up the filtration pore.

title_en: Sterilizing device for nut processing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of nut processing sterilization, in particular to a sterilization device for nut processing, which comprises a working box, wherein a blanking funnel is arranged above the working box, a blanking plate is arranged below the blanking funnel, the blanking funnel guides materials to the blanking plate below, a plurality of through holes are formed in the blanking plate, the blanking plate is inclined, an output end below a driving motor is arranged above the working box and is in rotary connection with a stirring shaft, and stirring blades are arranged on the stirring shaft. According to the utility model, through the rotation between the driving motor and the stirring shaft, the stirring shaft drives the stirring blade to realize stir-frying rotation, the stirring blade is provided with a plurality of through holes, the inside of the stirring blade is provided with the ultraviolet lamp, and nuts roll to the bottom of the discharge hole along the discharging convex block by taking away the pumping plate, so that the disinfection efficiency of the nuts is improved, the nuts can be conveniently taken after disinfection of the nuts is finished, and the use feeling of a user is optimized.

title_en: Murine excrement collecting and separating equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a murine excrement collecting and separating device which comprises a supporting seat, wherein a metabolic chamber is fixed on the upper surface of the supporting seat, and an excrement collecting funnel is fixed on the lower surface of the metabolic chamber. The utility model is provided with the supporting seat, the metabolism chamber, the excrement collecting funnel, the screen plate, the urine collecting container, the excrement collecting container, the urine filtering hole and the miniature motor, so that the mice can naturally discharge excrement and urine in the metabolism chamber, and the problem that other violent physiological reactions are caused by panic of the mice caused by using a clamp and the like and the effectiveness of the excrement is influenced is avoided; the excrement passes through the screen plate and enters the excrement collecting container, and part of urine is filtered out through the urine filtering holes and enters the bottom of the urine collecting container; the miniature motor drives the excrement collecting container to rotate, urine enters the urine collecting container through the urine filtering hole under the action of centrifugal force and is collected at the bottom of the urine collecting container, and the excrement is large in volume, so that the excrement is reserved inside the excrement collecting container, and further, the effective separation of mouse excrement and urine is realized.

title_en: Positioning structure for ultrathin stone processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a positioning structure for ultrathin stone processing, which belongs to the technical field of stone processing and comprises a conveying table, wherein a fixing frame is arranged at the bottom of the conveying table, the fixing frame is fixed at one side of the bottom of the conveying table through bolts, a double-shaft air cylinder is arranged at the bottom of the conveying table and positioned at the front of the fixing frame, a pushing block is fixedly connected to the front end of an output shaft of the double-shaft air cylinder, a rotating block is movably connected to the top of the pushing block, a sliding block is movably connected to the other end of the rotating block, a fixing block is connected to the top of the sliding block in a sliding manner, and the fixing block is fixedly connected to the middle of the bottom of the conveying table. According to the positioning structure for processing the ultrathin stone, the pushing block is pushed by the double-shaft air cylinder, so that the rotating block rotates on the pushing block, and then the rotating block acts on the sliding block to enable the sliding block to move in opposite directions or in opposite directions on the fixed block, and therefore the pushing plate connected to the top of the sliding block is controlled to synchronously move.

title_en: Automatic discharging device of stirrer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic discharging device of a stirrer, which relates to the technical field of plastic stirrers and comprises a vertical stirrer, a frame and a discharging hole, wherein the automatic discharging device is arranged at the discharging hole, a material sucking box is arranged at the tail end of the discharging hole, a discharging hole rear plate is welded on the vertical stirrer, a discharging hole front plate is arranged on the discharging hole rear plate, a drawing plate is arranged between the discharging hole rear plate and the discharging hole front plate, a cylinder is also arranged on the discharging hole, and the end head of a piston rod on the cylinder is connected with the drawing plate. According to the utility model, structural improvement is made on a manual discharging and discharging port of an original mixer, an automatic control pneumatic drawing plate is added, when materials needed by an injection molding machine are received, a feeding system sends a signal, and a cylinder automatically opens the drawing plate of a self-discharging device, so that automatic discharging and sucking are realized, the purpose of automation is realized, and the mixing requirement of plastics is met.

title_en: Walnut peeling machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a walnut peeling machine, which comprises a box body, wherein a first bearing, a feed hopper and a mounting cover are arranged at the upper part of the box body, a connecting shaft penetrates through the interior of the first bearing, a motor is arranged at the upper part of the mounting cover, a main gear is fixedly sleeved on the side wall of the output end of the motor, a driven gear is fixedly sleeved on the side wall of one end of the connecting shaft, a filter orifice plate is slidingly sleeved on the side wall of the connecting shaft, three groups of rotating rods are arranged on the side sides of the connecting shaft, a control panel is arranged on the other side of the box body, a discharge pipe penetrates through one side of the box body, three groups of annular grooves are formed in the inner wall of the box body, and annular built-in grooves are formed in the top surface and the bottom surface of the interior of the three groups of the annular grooves. The beneficial effects are that: according to the utility model, the rotary rod is adopted, and the transverse and vertical rotation of the crushing structure can be realized through the arranged rotary rod, so that the working efficiency of the walnut peeling machine is improved.

title_en: Preparation device for anti-cracking and anti-sedimentation road water stabilization layer material
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a preparation device of an anti-cracking and anti-settling road water stabilizing layer material, which comprises a concrete mixer, a bracket and a stirring frame, wherein the bracket is arranged at the bottom end of a shell of the concrete mixer, the stirring frame is arranged in the middle of the inside of the concrete mixer, the device also comprises a tank changing mechanism, the tank changing mechanism comprises a core ring tank, a fixed groove, a fixed plate, an inner backing ring, a lifting lug A, a lifting lug B, a back guide frame and a vibrating motor, the tank changing mechanism is arranged at the position of the concrete mixer above the bracket, the tank changing mechanism is internally provided with a core ring tank capable of being lifted and changed, the core ring tank is used for replacing the concrete mixer and is damaged by impact when the anti-cracking and anti-settling road water stabilizing layer material is stirred, and after the core ring tank is damaged, the core ring tank can be lifted from the concrete mixer for replacement by using a lifting rope of a crane from the lifting lug A and the lifting lug B, so that the inner tank body can be replaced according to the stirring requirement of the anti-cracking and anti-settling road water stabilizing layer material at the concrete mixer.

title_en: Constant temperature circulation control device for water
abstract_en: The utility model provides a water constant temperature circulation control device, which comprises: the dough making barrel is arranged in a sandwich type, a connecting port connected with the inside of the sandwich layer is arranged on the surface of the dough making barrel, the connecting port connects the dough making barrel with a water circulation system, the water circulation system comprises a heating pipe, a water inlet is arranged at the bottom end of the heating pipe, the water inlet is connected with a three-way valve, one of the other two paths of the three-way valve is connected with a water tank through a water inlet pipe and is used for providing water source for the inside of the heating pipe, and the other path of the three-way valve is connected with the water tank through a water outlet pipe and is used for draining and removing redundant air in the heating pipe; a water pump is arranged between the water inlet pipe and the water tank, and the water pump, the heating pipe and the three-way valve are connected with a monitoring device. The temperature control is carried out in a water circulation mode, so that the temperature in the dough making barrel is always in a constant temperature state, and dough fermentation is facilitated to an optimal state.

title_en: Adjustable fertilizer unloader
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of agricultural fertilization and discloses an adjustable fertilizer discharging device which comprises a screening box, wherein the bottom of the screening box is communicated with a discharging hopper, the lower end of the discharging hopper is communicated with a discharging pipe, the right side of the screening box is fixedly connected with a machine box, the bottom of the right side of an inner cavity of the machine box is fixedly connected with a rotating motor, the output end of the rotating motor is fixedly connected with a cam disc, and the top of the cam disc is movably connected with a shaft sleeve. This adjustable fertilizer unloader through setting up screening case, quick-witted case, spout, screening fill, supporting seat, slide, transfer line, connecting rod, axle sleeve, cam disc and rotating electrical machines, can screen fertilizer, avoids caking fertilizer to directly use and influences the fertilization effect, through setting up hopper, unloading pipe, bull stick, helical blade and servo motor, not only can adjust control unloading speed, can also avoid appearing the phenomenon that the pipeline blockked up, has promoted the efficiency of unloading.

title_en: Cherry planting greenhouse
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of planting greenhouses, in particular to a cherry planting greenhouse which comprises a greenhouse film, a plurality of cross bars, a plurality of vertical rods and an automatic covering component, wherein the automatic covering component comprises a support frame, a driving mechanism, a first sliding block, a second sliding block, a sliding rail, a first semicircular rod, a second semicircular rod and a door curtain; the utility model provides a plurality of pole setting and a plurality of horizontal pole interconnect constitutes the frame of big-arch shelter, the canopy membrane is used for hiding the car li subtree, the illumination lamp adopts plant to plant special lamp, can generally change illumination and promote the growth of plant, when need lift the canopy membrane, actuating mechanism drive the second slider removes, first slider with the second slider is parallel, when the second slider removes first slider follows the removal, thereby drives first semicircle pole removes, the canopy membrane can be lifted, when the closure the canopy membrane when drive arrangement back drive can, the curtain can lift and make things convenient for people to get into the big-arch shelter.

title_en: Root breaker for cultivated land
abstract_en: The application relates to a broken root machine in arable land belongs to agricultural machine technical field, and its broken root degree of depth is convenient for adjust according to service environment to it, has improved its usability, has reduced its use limitation, does benefit to and uses widely, includes: the working plate is internally provided with two mounting holes correspondingly; the connecting sleeve is rotationally connected with an adjusting column, and an adjusting rod is screwed in the rotating column through threads; the two mounting blocks are respectively and fixedly arranged at the bottom of the adjusting rod; the rotating column is rotatably arranged between the two mounting blocks, and the left end of the rotating column extends to the outside of the mounting blocks through the connecting hole; the rotary tillage blade group is fixedly sleeved on two support posts on the rotary column, the two support posts are fixedly arranged at the bottom of the working plate, and a support rod is vertically and slidably arranged in the support posts; the fixed plate is fixedly welded at the bottom of the supporting rod; and the driving motor is fixedly arranged on the fixed plate.

title_en: Seed collection device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of seed collection, in particular to a seed collection device, which comprises: a driving motor; the rotating shaft is connected with the output end of the driving motor; the fixed column is arranged on the driving motor; the collecting bottom plate is arranged on the fixed column and positioned above the driving motor, and a collecting inclined plane and a collecting hole are formed in the collecting bottom plate; one end of the collecting cloth is connected with the collecting bottom plate and is in an inverted cone shape; the filter screen is sleeved on the fixed column and is positioned above the collecting bottom plate, and the outer side of the filter screen is connected with the collecting cloth and the vibration part; the beneficial effects are as follows: the filter screen is knocked through the vibration part, and then the vibration of the filter screen is driven, and then sundries such as branches and leaves on the filter screen vibrate, so that the filter holes on the filter screen are prevented from being blocked by the branches and leaves sundries, seeds are guaranteed to fall onto the collecting bottom plate through the filter screen, and the collecting efficiency of the seeds is guaranteed.

title_en: Steel wire cleaning device and cutting machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of semiconductors, in particular to a steel wire cleaning device and a cutting machine. The steel wire cleaning device comprises at least two annular air knives, wherein the blowing directions of the annular air knives are consistent, and the annular air knives are sequentially arranged at intervals along the blowing directions; and in the blowing direction, the airflow blown out by the front annular air knife of any two adjacent annular air knives at least partially enters the central through hole of the rear annular air knife. So can be through producing conical sweep air current in order to realize the high-efficient cleanness to cutting steel wire circumferential surface to the high-speed line cutting machine supplies, and the cleaning degree of loop room, maintenance period such as extension bearing, guide pulley, reduction manpower personnel are originally, the broken string rate of reduction equipment is applicable to carborundum crystal cutting field.

title_en: Ponding prevention ground cover planting device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of planting, and particularly relates to a water accumulation preventing ground cover planting device which comprises a hydrophobic plate, wherein the hydrophobic plate is paved on a building plane, the hydrophobic foam plate is arranged on the hydrophobic plate, a drainage blind pipe is arranged at the top of the hydrophobic foam plate, a culture medium is covered and tamped above the hydrophobic foam plate, a building wall body is provided with the hydrophobic foam plate and the drainage blind pipe along the wall edge of the building wall body, the hydrophobic foam plate is matched with the landfill direction of the culture medium and is longitudinally or transversely arranged in succession, the culture medium is backfilled above the culture medium again to form a backfill layer, the top array of the hydrophobic foam plate is provided with hydrophobic holes, the hydrophobic holes penetrate through the hydrophobic foam plate, and the top of the hydrophobic foam plate is paved with geotechnical cloth I for preventing the culture medium from blocking the hydrophobic holes. The utility model can fix earthwork, maintain the stability of the earthwork, provide good environment for plant growth and reduce the effect of mosquito breeding caused by ponding.

title_en: Gallium arsenide wafer cutting device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of wafer processing, in particular to a gallium arsenide wafer cutting device, which comprises a box body and an observation window, wherein a control rod is rotationally connected to a guide hole on the front end surface of the box body, a rotary knob is fixedly connected to the front end of the control rod, a first bevel gear is fixedly connected to the rear end of the control rod, a transmission rod is arranged on the rear side of the first bevel gear, a second bevel gear is fixedly connected to the outer side of the transmission rod, the first bevel gear is in meshed connection with the second bevel gear, third bevel gears are fixedly connected to the left end and the right end of the transmission rod, a fixing plate is fixedly connected to the inner side of the front end surface of the box body, a reciprocating screw rod is rotationally connected to the left side and the right side of the lower end surface of the fixing plate, and the like.

title_en: Tree fixing frame
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tree fixing frame, which relates to the technical field of fixing frames and comprises a first fixing clamp plate, a second fixing clamp plate and a tree body, wherein arc grooves are formed in opposite surfaces of the first fixing clamp plate and the second fixing clamp plate, rectangular supporting legs are fixedly connected to lower surfaces of the first fixing clamp plate and the second fixing clamp plate, fixing foot frames are fixedly connected to lower ends of the rectangular supporting legs, fixing blocks are fixedly connected to front and rear surfaces of the first fixing clamp plate and the second fixing clamp plate, the four fixing blocks are connected together through fixing bolts and threaded holes in a threaded mode, the arc fixing sleeves are driven to move forwards through fixing rods, the two telescopic springs are driven to extend forwards by the arc fixing sleeves, after the two arc fixing sleeves contact the surface of the tree body, the tree body can be fixed, rotation can be stopped, the phase difference distance between the two arc fixing sleeves can be adjusted to adapt to the tree bodies with different sizes, and the applicability of the tree fixing frame is improved.

title_en: Replaceable cat-comma rod
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of pet toys, in particular to a replaceable cat-flying stick, which comprises a plurality of sections of telescopic rods, wherein one end of the lower side of each section of telescopic rod is fixedly provided with a handle, the upper side of each section of telescopic rod is fixedly provided with a rope throwing, the other end of each rope throwing is fixedly provided with a hanging ring, the inner side of each hanging ring is detachably connected with a connecting piece in a buckling manner, the outer side of each connecting piece is fixedly provided with a magnetic attraction block, the lower side of each magnetic attraction block is magnetically connected with a metal piece, and the lower side of each metal piece is fixedly provided with a cat-flying piece; the cat attracting device is novel in design and ingenious in structure, the whole length is convenient to adjust according to the needs by arranging the rod body into the multi-section telescopic rod, the cat attracting piece and the magnetic attracting block are connected through the metal piece, the cat attracting device has the characteristic of being detachable and replaceable, and the phenomenon that the cat attracting piece is single and the cat loses interest is avoided; the rope throwing device has the advantages that the rope throwing device is provided with the binding groove, so that the rope throwing device can bind the rope through the binding belt when not in use, is convenient to store, and improves practicality.

title_en: Mobile phone shell forming die
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of mobile phone shell molds, in particular to a mobile phone shell molding mold, which comprises a frame, wherein a fixed block is fixedly connected to the frame, an injection molding opening is formed in the fixed block, a T-shaped slot is formed in the fixed block, a mold block is inserted in the T-shaped slot on the fixed block in a sliding manner, a third fixed plate is fixedly connected to the frame, a second fixed plate is fixedly connected to the frame, a fixed rod is fixedly connected to the second fixed plate, and a second positioning block is connected to the fixed rod in a sliding manner; the output shaft through setting up the motor drives the threaded rod and rotates for first locating piece removes on the threaded rod, after the cooling of moulding plastics is finished, the briquetting is to the reverse removal of fixed block, after the push pedal contacted the stopper, the spring begins the compression, makes four push rods on the push pedal follow the surface protrusion of briquetting, pushes up the cell-phone shell down from the briquetting surface, has realized not needing the manual effect that can take off the cell-phone shell after the cooling of moulding plastics from the clamp plate.

title_en: Ray apparatus installation mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model provides an optical machine installation mechanism, and belongs to the technical field of optical machines. The utility model relates to an optical machine installation mechanism, which comprises an optical machine support and an installation mechanism, wherein a top plate is installed at the top of the optical machine support, an optical machine body is installed at the top of the top plate, a clamping mechanism is fixedly connected with the top of the top plate and is provided with two groups of baffles, the baffle is installed at the top of the top plate, and a clamping plate is installed at the top of the top plate.

title_en: PVC gloves production feeding device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a PVC glove production and material conveying device, which relates to the technical field of glove production and comprises a hand die, wherein an installation part is installed at the end part of the hand die, connecting plates are symmetrically distributed on the side edges of the installation part, connecting rods are symmetrically distributed on the inner sides of the connecting plates, one sides of the connecting rods, which are close to each other, are connected through sleeve blocks, an air cylinder is inserted into the sleeve blocks, and a limiting plate is arranged on one side of the air cylinder, which is close to the hand die. According to the glove mold, the air cylinder and the limiting plate are arranged, when the glove mold is used, the glove outside the glove mold can be fixed through the mutual matching of the air cylinder and the limiting plate, so that the glove is prevented from shifting and falling in the process of taking out from the solution basin, the glove is ensured to be smoothly processed, the sleeve rod and the spring are arranged, and in the use process, the impact force generated when the limiting plate is in contact with the hand mold can be effectively prevented through the mutual matching of the sleeve rod and the spring, and the protection of the hand mold can be realized, so that the service life of the hand mold is ensured.

title_en: Raw material screening mechanism of injection molding machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of raw material screening of injection molding machines, in particular to a raw material screening mechanism of an injection molding machine, which solves the problems that in the prior art, the characteristics of injection molding raw materials influence, and part of injection molding raw materials have certain viscosity, so that a small part of raw materials possibly adhere to the inside of the screening mechanism in the screening process, and the subsequent screening operation efficiency is influenced. The utility model provides a raw materials screening mechanism of injection molding machine, includes the shell, the top one side fixedly connected with feeder hopper of shell, the inner chamber of shell and along two screening frames of vertical direction fixedly connected with of shell, the equal fixedly connected with collecting vessel in both sides of one side outer wall of shell. According to the utility model, after each use of the screening device, personnel can carry out rapid screening operation on the raw materials remained on the surface of the screening frame, so that the situation that the screening frame is blocked due to the residues of the raw materials is avoided, the practicability of the screening mechanism is enhanced, and the later maintenance times of the personnel are reduced.

title_en: Insect-proof air valve
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of air valves, and provides an insect-proof air valve which comprises an air valve main body, a lower cover and threads, wherein the lower cover is arranged at the bottom of the air valve main body, the threads are arranged on the outer side wall of the bottom end of the lower cover, clamping structures are arranged on two sides of the bottom end of the air valve main body, each clamping structure comprises a connecting rod, a clamping block and clamping grooves, the clamping grooves are arranged on two sides of the inside of the lower cover, and a protection structure is arranged on one side of the top of the air valve main body. According to the insect prevention air valve, the clamping structure is arranged, the air valve main body is moved, so that one end of the air valve main body driving the clamping block is abutted against one end of the clamping groove, the air valve main body is pressed, the air valve main body drives the clamping block to move into the clamping groove through the connecting rod, the clamping block and the clamping groove are clamped with each other, and then the air valve main body and the lower cover are mutually fixed, the function of the insect prevention air valve for facilitating splicing is realized, and therefore convenience of the insect prevention air valve in use is improved.

title_en: Agricultural straw crushing machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an agricultural straw crushing machine which comprises a vehicle-mounted frame, a deep ploughing structure and a crushing structure, wherein the deep ploughing structure is arranged on the vehicle-mounted frame, the crushing structure is arranged on the vehicle-mounted frame, the deep ploughing structure comprises a first support column, a slotting cutter, a second support column and a soil filling push plate, the first support column is arranged on the vehicle-mounted frame, the slotting cutter is arranged on the first support column, the second support column is arranged on the vehicle-mounted frame, and the soil filling push plate is arranged on the second support column. The utility model belongs to the technical field of straw crushing equipment, and particularly relates to an agricultural straw crushing machine, which effectively solves the problems that crushed straws cannot be deeply buried by the straw crushing machine in the current market, are only mixed in surface soil, and are rotten to cause bacterial breeding, so that the production of the next crop is affected and the yield is low.

title_en: Automatic loading and unloading frame machine for cement tile production line
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic loading and unloading frame machine for a cement tile production line, which relates to the field of cement tile production and comprises a frame discharging device, a frame unloading machine, a frame loading machine, a frame feeding device and a tile frame body; the frame feeding device comprises a frame feeding conveyor belt, a frame feeding push rod and a frame feeding base; the rack loader comprises a lifting device, a plurality of rack feeding bracket and a rack loader base; the lifting device is arranged on the base of the rack loader, and a plurality of rack feeding supporting grooves are symmetrically connected to the lifting device in two rows and ascend along with the lifting device; the frame feeding push rod is opposite to the central shafts of the two rows of frame feeding bracket, and one end of the frame feeding conveyor belt is opposite to the central positions of the two frame feeding bracket at the bottom; the tile rack body comprises a plurality of single-row tile racks which are connected in sequence, and the central shafts of two rows of rack feeding bracket of the rack loading machine are opposite to one single-row tile rack; the feeding device and the loading machine realize automatic installation of tile blanks, the discharging device and the unloading machine realize automatic disassembly of the tile blanks, realize automatic production of tile blank loading and unloading, reduce the labor intensity of workers and improve the production efficiency.

title_en: Fork truck wheel mould with quick cooling function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a forklift wheel mold with a rapid cooling function, which relates to the technical field of mold processes and comprises a box body, wherein a cooling mechanism is arranged on the front surface of the box body, the cooling mechanism comprises a protective box fixedly connected with the front surface of the box body, and a semiconductor water circulation refrigerator and a water pump are respectively fixedly connected with the inner bottom wall of the protective box.

title_en: Agricultural broadcast sowing machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an agricultural broadcasting machine, which belongs to the technical field of broadcasting machines and comprises a frame, wheels and a broadcasting assembly, wherein the wheels and the broadcasting assembly are arranged on the frame, the broadcasting assembly comprises a feed box, a broadcasting motor, a rotating shaft, a stirring plate and a broadcasting plate, the broadcasting motor is arranged below the feed box, the rotating shaft is arranged on an output shaft of the broadcasting motor, the stirring plate is positioned in the feed box, the broadcasting plate is positioned between the feed box and the broadcasting motor, a blanking opening is arranged on the feed box, the projection of the blanking opening along the axial direction of the rotating shaft is positioned on the broadcasting plate, the stirring plate is arranged to periodically cover the blanking opening in the rotating process of the rotating shaft, so that the rotating speed of the output shaft of the broadcasting motor can be reduced in a certain range, and the running speed of the frame can be matched for carrying out broadcasting amount adjustment.

title_en: Calender traction roller structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a calender traction roller structure, and belongs to the technical field of calender. The device comprises a main body, wherein a power cavity is fixedly connected to the left side surface of the main body, a first supporting plate is fixedly connected to the inside of the power cavity, and the first supporting plate is provided with a first motor, a transmission plate, a fixed column, a gear and the like.

title_en: Lockable square gun spray head
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of spray heads, in particular to a lockable square gun spray head, which comprises an outer shell, wherein a mixing chamber shell is arranged on the inner wall of the outer shell, a pushing force is applied to a clamping plate when a grab handle switch is pressed to move backwards, so that the clamping plate rotates on the outer wall of a rotating shaft, meanwhile, the clamping plate drives a limiting spring to stretch, when the clamping plate is inserted into the inner wall of a clamping groove when the clamping plate is opposite to Ji Kacao, the stretched limiting spring rebounds when the sliding groove is opposite to the protruding structure of Ji Kacao, so that the limiting spring applies a reverse pulling force to the clamping plate, so that the clamping plate reversely rotates on the outer wall of the rotating shaft, and meanwhile, the sliding groove of the clamping plate is clamped in the protruding structure of the clamping groove to fix the grab handle switch, so that the grab handle switch is locked.

title_en: Auxiliary device is used in concrete production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of concrete production, and discloses an auxiliary device for concrete production, which comprises a box body, a scraping mechanism, a vibrating mechanism, an opening and closing door assembly and an electric heating plate, wherein the scraping mechanism is arranged at the top of the box body, the vibrating mechanism is arranged at one end of the box body, the opening and closing door assembly is arranged at the other end of the box body, the electric heating plate is arranged at two sides of the box body, the scraping mechanism comprises a mounting frame, a rotating screw rod, a first motor, a moving block, a mounting rod, an air cylinder, a lifting rod and a scraping plate, and the mounting frame is fixedly connected to the top of one side of the box body. This auxiliary device is used in concrete production drives through first motor and rotates the screw rod and rotate for rotate the outside movable block of screw rod and control and remove, the cylinder at installation pole top drives the lifter and carries out the lift adjustment, adjusts the height of scraper blade, thereby strickles the concrete top surface in the box, reduces artificial strickle work, improves strickle efficiency.

title_en: Cake piece blowing and demolding device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cake sheet blowing and demolding device, which comprises a baking tray conveying device and a baking tray arranged on the conveying device, wherein a swing rod motor, a swing rod and a blowing pipe are arranged on the side part of the baking tray conveying device, the swing rod motor is connected with the swing rod, the end part of the swing rod is connected with one end of the blowing pipe, and the swing rod motor controls the blowing pipe to move for a certain distance along with the baking tray through the swing rod. The utility model provides a cake sheet air blowing and demolding device, which controls an air blowing pipe to rotate by an angle along with a baking tray through a swing rod motor, prolongs the air blowing and demolding time of cake sheets, improves the demolding effect and reduces the shutdown probability of failing to mold the cake sheets.

title_en: Novel pearl cotton right angle bonder
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a novel pearl cotton right-angle bonding machine which comprises a processing table, wherein an electric sliding rail is arranged at the upper end of the processing table, a mounting frame is arranged on the electric sliding rail, a moving mechanism is arranged on the mounting frame, a glue spraying head is arranged on the moving mechanism, the upper end of the mounting frame is fixedly connected with a glue box, a glue conveying pipe is communicated between the glue box and the glue spraying head, and a mounting plate is arranged at the outer side of the mounting frame. This novel cotton right angle bonder of pearl, through having set up moving mechanism, through driving motor's start-up, the threaded rod rotates, under the cooperation of spacing groove and spacing seat, and the screw thread seat drives spouts the gluey head and removes spouts gluey, and electronic slide rail can drive the mounting bracket and remove the assigned position, after the rubber coating is accomplished, starts servo motor, under the cooperation of slide and spout, drives cotton downwardly moving of pearl through rack-meshed mounting panel, makes two cotton accurate right angles bonding of going on of their pearl, has accelerated the cotton machining efficiency of pearl.

title_en: Ceramic flowerpot capable of automatically fertilizing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a ceramic flowerpot capable of automatically fertilizing, which comprises a flowerpot body, wherein a bayonet is arranged at the top of the flowerpot body, a fertilizing box is clamped on the bayonet, one end of the fertilizing box is inserted with an annular pipe, the annular pipe is fixed on the circumferential inner wall of the flowerpot body through bolts, the bottom end of the annular pipe is inserted with a plurality of drippers, the top of the fertilizing box is fixedly connected with a quantitative water pump, the top of the quantitative water pump is fixedly connected with a first timer, the water outlet end of the quantitative water pump is inserted with a water outlet pipe, the other end of the water outlet pipe is communicated with the fertilizing box, the inner wall of the bottom of the fertilizing box is fixedly connected with a bump, the top of the fertilizing box is inserted with a feed pipe, the top of the feed pipe is sleeved with a storage pipe, and the feed pipe is provided with a quantitative valve and a second timer. According to the utility model, the plants in the ceramic flower pot can be automatically fertilized through the cooperation of the quantitative water pump, the first timer, the quantitative valve and the second timer, so that the frequency of watering and fertilizing is reduced.

title_en: Deodorizing device for farm
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a deodorizing device for a farm, which comprises a fixed seat and a deodorizing device, wherein a first placing groove is formed in the lower end of the fixed seat, a sliding rod is symmetrically and fixedly arranged in the first placing groove, a synchronous plate is symmetrically and movably arranged on the sliding rod, an arc-shaped clamping plate is fixedly arranged at the lower end of the synchronous plate, a split bolt is movably arranged in the first placing groove and is in threaded connection with the synchronous plate.

title_en: Pre-cutting adjustment-free tire mold
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pre-cutting adjustment-free tire mold, which comprises a middle sleeve, wherein the top end of the middle sleeve is provided with an upper ring, the bottom end of the upper ring is provided with a lantern ring matched with the middle sleeve, the lantern ring is connected with the lantern ring through a limiting assembly, the top end of the middle sleeve is provided with a plurality of circumferentially-arrayed placement grooves, nitrogen springs are arranged in the placement grooves, and the top ends of the nitrogen springs extend out of the placement grooves and contact with the upper ring in a propping mode. The beneficial effects are that: through setting up spacing subassembly when needs change nitrogen spring, personnel only need press the button and drive the sliding plate and remove, and the sliding plate drives the spacer pin and breaks away from the travel hole, can pull down the upper ring from the well cover this moment, and the dismouting is simple convenient laborsaving, and the personnel of being convenient for change nitrogen spring.

title_en: Landscape ecological channel
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a landscape ecological channel, which comprises a water passage channel, wherein the side wall of the water passage channel is of a vertical structure, an ecological planting floating bed is arranged in the water passage channel, a plurality of planting holes for planting aquatic plants are uniformly formed in the ecological planting floating bed, and the ecological planting floating bed is arranged on the side wall of the water passage channel through a limiting structure; the two sides of the upper end of the water passing channel are respectively provided with a widening channel, the bottom of the widening channel is provided with a plurality of water outlets, the lower end of the water passing channel is provided with a water draining channel, and the water outlets are communicated with the water draining channel through water draining pipes; the two sides of the widening channel are provided with inclined ecological slopes, and the tops of the ecological slopes are provided with sidewalks. The utility model can plant plants in a large area in the channel and on the side slopes around the channel, can greatly improve ecological restoration capability and purification capability and improves the landscape effect around the channel.

title_en: Composite pipe sealing device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a sealing device, in particular to a composite pipe sealing device. The utility model provides a compound pipe sealing device for automatically conveying compound pipes. The utility model provides a composite pipe sealing device which comprises a support frame, a second guide rail, a sliding block, a support disc, a heating block and an electric push rod, wherein the second guide rail is fixedly connected to the rear side of the support frame, the sliding block is arranged on the second guide rail in a sliding mode, the support disc is fixedly connected to the top of the sliding block, the heating block is installed in the support disc, the electric push rod is installed on the rear side of the second guide rail, and a movable rod of the electric push rod is connected with the support disc. The first conveying wheel rotates and is matched with the second conveying wheel in an auxiliary mode through starting the motor to convey the composite pipe backwards, and therefore the composite pipe and the heating block are guaranteed to be in the same level.

title_en: Afforestation water saving fixtures
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an landscaping water-saving device, which comprises a box body, wheels are arranged at four corners of the bottom of the box body, a handrail is arranged above one side wall of the box body, a water filling port is arranged above one side wall provided with the handrail, a water outlet is arranged below the water filling port, an access door is arranged on the other side wall of the box body, an operation panel is arranged on one side wall of the access door, a spray pipe is arranged below the operation panel, a water tank is arranged in the box body, a water diversion pipe is arranged in the water tank, and water pipes are arranged on two sides of the water diversion pipe. The beneficial effects are that: according to the utility model, through the design of the quartz sand filter box, sewage can be irrigated for use after being filtered by the quartz sand filter box, so that the waste of water resources is avoided, and meanwhile, through the design of the water storage tank and the water seepage holes, dropped water can return to the water tank through the water seepage holes on the water storage tank, and the waste of water resources is avoided.

title_en: Injection mold convenient to drawing of patterns
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an injection mold convenient to demolding, which relates to the technical field of injection molds and aims at solving the problems that the existing injection mold is clamped and injection molding pieces need to be removed after the injection mold stretches into the mold, and the safety and the practicability are improved. The efficient demolding operation can be realized, and meanwhile, the worker does not need to stretch into the mold to take materials, so that the demolding machine is high in safety and high in practicability.

title_en: One-way valve forming die
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a one-way valve forming die, comprising: a rear die provided with a rear die insert; the front die is arranged opposite to the rear die and can move towards or away from the rear die, a front die insert is arranged on the front die, and at least one cavity is formed between the front die insert and the rear die insert; at least one thread insert is rotatably arranged on the front die and penetrates through the front die insert, each thread insert is arranged corresponding to one cavity, and one end of the thread insert is provided with an external thread and is used for extending into the cavity to form an internal thread of the one-way valve in a matching manner; the driving assembly is arranged on the front die and is connected with at least one threaded insert; and the at least one supporting piece is arranged on the rear die and penetrates through the rear die insert, each supporting piece corresponds to one cavity, and one end of the supporting piece penetrates into the cavity to match with the formed one-way valve and support the one-way valve. This check valve forming die can drop the check valve after moulding plastics automatically, need not artifical manual the taking out, has not only avoided operating personnel to scald, still improves production efficiency.

title_en: Ear tag pliers for livestock and poultry
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a livestock ear tag clamp which comprises a protective shell, wherein a plurality of control panels are arranged on the surface of the protective shell, a storage battery is arranged at the end, far away from the protective shell, of the control panels, a processing component is arranged at one side end of the protective shell, one end of the processing component extends from the outside of the protective shell to the inside of the protective shell, an auxiliary component is arranged at one end and one side of the processing component, a sterilizing component is arranged at one side of the auxiliary component, and the sterilizing component is partially arranged inside the protective shell, so that animal ears can be fixed in advance and then are mounted with ear tags, thereby avoiding the problems that the ear tags deviate during mounting and the ear animals with ear tag needles inserted into the livestock are frightened, further avoiding staff from being injured.

title_en: Insect pest prevention green prevention and control device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of insect pest prevention devices, in particular to an insect pest prevention and control device, which comprises a prevention and control device body, wherein the top of the prevention and control device body is fixedly connected with an electric shock type insect killer, one side wall of the prevention and control device body is in through connection with a feed inlet, the bottom of the prevention and control device body is in through connection with a discharge outlet, one end of the discharge outlet is in through connection with a flexible hose, one end of the flexible hose is fixedly connected with a conveying pipe needle, a plurality of groups of energy-saving batteries are arranged in a battery box, a storage box is arranged in the prevention and control device body, the conveying pipe needle is inserted into soil through the cooperation of the flexible hose and the conveying pipe needle, insect pest inside the storage box can be conveyed to the ground, the prevention and control device body is convenient to move, and the effect of killing underground insect pests is achieved when a user is convenient to move the prevention and control device body.

title_en: Dead weight delay type dewatering device for dewatering section of primary laver processing unit
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a dead-weight extension type dehydration device for a dehydration section of a laver primary processing unit, which comprises a lower laver dehydration die arranged on a dead-weight extension extrusion pressing upper die. This a dead weight is prolonged pressure formula dewatering device for laver processing unit dehydration section once through being provided with receipts material locating component, holds and draws the removal receipts material underframe, because riser sliding connection is on the slide bar, riser and activity inner panel structural design as an organic whole, activity inner panel then moves inside the opening frame, first spring that establishes between the two, can be to the whole distance of compressing mould department to dead weight is prolonged to the activity inner panel in order to adjust, simultaneously under effort, can make the slide bar carry out back and forth movement in the riser inslot, in order to change receipts material underframe overall position, with setting up it on the device according to the demand, after installing it, according to demand adjustment installation demand, ensure the holistic result of use of device when carrying out the material collection operation.

title_en: Road greening support frame device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a road greening support frame device which comprises a binding belt, wherein a supporting block is slidably arranged on the binding belt, a mounting groove is formed in the front surface of the supporting block, a connecting block is rotatably arranged in the mounting groove, a connecting hole is formed in the lower end of the connecting block, a support column is slidably arranged in the connecting hole, a thread adjusting column is arranged in the support column in a threaded mode, a limiting hole is formed in the binding belt, a connector is fixedly arranged at one end of the binding belt, a threaded hole is formed in the connector, a limiting bolt is arranged in the threaded hole in a threaded mode, and the limiting bolt is matched with the limiting hole. Through will supporting the piece and overlap on the tie through the spread groove, bind the bandage again on the trunk, tighten back rotatory stop bolt, make stop bolt pass spacing hole, can be with supporting the piece bolt on the trunk to make the device can fix on the trees of different diameters.

title_en: Concentrated feed proportioning equipment that yak was fattened
abstract_en: The utility model discloses concentrated feed proportioning equipment for fattening yaks, which comprises a mixing box and supporting columns, wherein the bottom end of the mixing box is fixedly connected with the supporting columns, one side of the bottom end of the mixing box is provided with a feed opening, the bottom end of the mixing box is fixedly provided with a first driving motor, the output end of the first driving motor penetrates through the inside of the bottom end of the mixing box and is fixedly connected with a stirring shaft, and the outside of the stirring shaft is fixedly connected with stirring blades. This concentrated feed proportioning equipment that yak fattened is through being provided with backup pad, second driving motor, fly leaf, weight sensor, fixing base, connecting axle, utilizes weight sensor to weigh the back to the fodder, opens second driving motor, and the drive connecting axle rotates, can drive the fly leaf that outside cup jointed and rotate when the connecting axle rotates to the fodder can fall into the mixing box of bottom and carry out the compounding and handle, makes more accurate when the ratio, has solved the problem of not being accurate enough when the ratio.

title_en: Recycled aggregate environment-friendly dry-mixed mortar production line
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of dry-mixed mortar, in particular to an environment-friendly dry-mixed mortar production line for recycled aggregate, which comprises an upper bin, wherein the output end of the upper bin is connected with a drying cylinder through a first belt conveyor, the output end of the drying cylinder is respectively connected with a first classifying screen, a cyclone dust collector and a first cloth bag dust collector, the first classifying screen is provided with four paths of output, and the first classifying screen is respectively connected with a bucket lift, a bucket lift II, a waste material area and the cyclone dust collector, and the cyclone dust collector is connected with the waste material area through a screw conveyor; the output end of the bucket elevator is sequentially connected with the sand making machine, the powder selecting machine and the second classifying screen. The utility model carries out production treatment on the recycled aggregate and the natural sand, improves the production efficiency, solves the application problem of the aggregate, improves the application efficiency of the aggregate and reduces the production cost.

title_en: Top cover for electric melting furnace
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a top cover for an electric melting furnace, which comprises a steel member, wherein a plurality of sillimanite hooks are hung at the bottom of the steel member, a sillimanite cover plate is fixedly connected at the bottom of each adjacent sillimanite hook, and light heat-insulating cotton is arranged at the top end of the sillimanite cover plate.

title_en: Concrete member mould for assembled building
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of concrete member molds, in particular to an assembled building concrete member mold, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein supporting panels are fixed at two ends of the top surface of the bottom plate, a mold box body is arranged between the two supporting panels, the mold box body comprises two first mold plates which are rotationally connected with the supporting panels, second mold plates are arranged between the tops of the first mold plates and between the bottoms of the first mold plates, overflow aggregate pieces are detachably fixed on the outer sides of the supporting panels, and the overflow aggregate pieces comprise sleeves. According to the utility model, the first die plate and the second die plate on the die box body are movable, and the two die plates are close to each other, so that the mortar in the die box body can be extruded tightly for the second time, and the saturation of the mortar pouring column body is improved.

title_en: Quick cooling device based on injection molding
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of injection molding and cooling, in particular to a rapid cooling device based on injection molding, which comprises a supporting frame, wherein a driving belt is arranged in the supporting frame, a supporting plate is fixedly connected to the outer side of the driving belt, a placing groove is formed in the top of the supporting plate, a cooling hole is formed in the top of the driving belt, and a cold air box is arranged in the driving belt. The advantages are that: the injection molding piece has certain interval under the backup pad supports with the drive belt for cold wind box can cool off the bottom of injection molding piece through cold wind groove and cooling hole, makes the cooling box and air cavity cooperation can carry out the omnidirectional cooling to the injection molding piece, has improved the cooling effect of device, and the drive belt can be spacing to the injection molding piece through the standing groove in the backup pad, makes the injection molding piece can not appear rocking the phenomenon when removing, and the injection molding piece can directly place on the drive belt simultaneously, and the phenomenon of colliding with is difficult to appear in this in-process.

title_en: Glass fiber winding device for processing heat preservation pipe
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of heat preservation pipe processing, in particular to a glass fiber winding device for heat preservation pipe processing, which comprises a workbench and a concave plate, wherein the lower surface of the workbench is fixedly connected with the outer wall of the concave plate, the upper surface of the workbench is fixedly connected with the bottom of a supporting frame, the upper surface of the workbench is fixedly connected with the outer wall of a wire placing frame, and the lower surface of the workbench is fixedly connected with supporting legs. The two motors in the winding device drive the speed reducers to rotate, the two speed reducers drive the screw rods to be in the same direction of threads on the two screw rods, the two screw rods drive the screw rod nuts to move, the two screw rod nuts drive the placing plate at the lower end to move to the lower side of the workbench, and when one winding station works, the other winding station can be subjected to material taking and discharging, so that part of time is saved, and the working efficiency of the winding device is improved.

title_en: Toughened glass homogeneity stove feed arrangement
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of toughened glass homogenizing furnace feeding devices, and discloses a toughened glass homogenizing furnace feeding device which comprises a base and a cleaning mechanism, wherein the cleaning mechanism comprises a fixing frame, a sliding frame is fixedly arranged at the position, close to two sides, of the upper end of the fixing frame, a lifting gear frame is movably connected with the fixing frame through a mounting groove, a synchronous belt is movably connected with the fixing frame through a forward and reverse rotating motor, a shaft gear is movably connected with the other end of the synchronous belt, a cleaning frame is fixedly arranged on the side surface of the lifting gear frame, a wet cleaning plate is fixedly connected with the cleaning frame through a liquid inlet, a dry cleaning plate is fixedly arranged on the lower surface of the cleaning frame, and the surfaces of glass entering the toughened glass homogenizing furnace can be cleaned through the fixing frame, the mounting groove, the forward and reverse rotating motor, the synchronous belt, the shaft gear, the lifting gear frame, the sliding frame, the liquid inlet, the wet cleaning plate and the dry cleaning plate, so that the effect on the result is avoided.

title_en: Be used for apricot tree molding design adjusting device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of shaping and shaping of apricot trees, and provides an adjusting device for shaping and shaping of apricot trees, which comprises a first U-shaped ring, a second U-shaped ring is arranged on the first U-shaped ring in a sliding manner, the first U-shaped ring and the second U-shaped ring are in butt joint to form an encircling structure, the first U-shaped ring and the second U-shaped ring are respectively provided with a mounting sliding groove, shaping adjusting components are respectively arranged on the first U-shaped ring and the second U-shaped ring in a sliding manner, the shaping adjusting components comprise sliding blocks, the sliding components are arranged on the mounting sliding grooves in a sliding manner, a supporting rod is arranged on the sliding blocks in a sliding manner, a telescopic rod is arranged between the supporting rod and the sliding rod, two rotating rods are respectively arranged on the supporting rod and the sliding rod in a rotating manner, and two branch claws are respectively arranged on the two rotating rods. Through the technical scheme, the problem that secondary regulation cannot be carried out according to apricot branches in the prior art is solved.

title_en: Feed pelletization waste recovery device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of feed pelleting waste recycling devices, in particular to a feed pelleting waste recycling device, which comprises a box body and an inclined tube, wherein a shaking device is arranged in the box body, the shaking device comprises a shaking box and a first motor, one end of a first spring is fixedly connected with a protruding part on the surface of the inclined tube, the surface of a sliding rod is slidably connected with the protruding part on the surface of the inclined tube.

title_en: Hot briquetting machine is used in automotive interior processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hot-press forming machine for processing automotive interiors, relates to the technical field of hot-press forming machines for processing automotive interiors, and aims to solve the problem that after an existing hot-press forming machine is used for hot-rolling an object into a required shape, the object is difficult to take down due to the fact that the overall temperature of the object is increased in the hot-rolling process, and the object with higher wire outlet temperature is possibly adhered to a forming die. Including touchdown fixing base, be provided with the connection support column on the touchdown fixing base, connection support column and touchdown fixing base welded connection, be provided with forming die on the touchdown fixing base, forming die and touchdown fixing base bolted connection still include the apopore, the apopore sets up on forming die, the apopore sets up as an organic wholely with forming die, forming die inner wall lower extreme is provided with the blast structure, blast structure and forming die inner wall bolted connection, the blast structure is provided with the air duct in the one end of keeping away from forming die inner wall.

title_en: Edible fungus processing and airing device
