abstract_en: The utility model provides an edible fungi processing drying device, includes first frame, first net, first backup pad, fixed leg, second frame, second net, second backup pad, rotation landing leg, rectangle magnetic sheet, installation bedplate, pivot of shining, first frame internally mounted first net that shines, first frame is connected at first backup pad both ends, evenly distributed in first frame to a plurality of first backup pads, first backup pad upper surface is laminated mutually with first net that shines, first frame inside four corners has first frame interior flange, fixed leg upper portion connection first frame interior flange, fixed leg is in first frame bottom four corners distribution, first frame side is laminated mutually with the second frame, the second frame has second hinge mounting groove, the hinge inserts and connects the second hinge mounting groove, first frame has first hinge mounting groove, the hinge inserts and connects first hinge mounting groove, a set of hinge is distributed at first frame, second frame side.

title_en: Nylon ribbon ejection forming device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of nylon processing and production, and discloses a nylon ribbon ejection forming device which comprises a former body shell and a lifting die body, wherein a lifting limiting chute is formed in the inner wall of the former body shell, and a die plate body is arranged on the outer wall of the lifting limiting chute. This ejecting forming device of nylon ribbon sets up the spacing spout of paired going up and down through the inside at former body shell for the spacing spout of going up and down can carry out spacingly to the mould board body that goes up and down, and when outside driving motor transmission shaft stretches out and draws back simultaneously, it can drive trapezoidal support slider and inside slip in the spacing spout of direction, and pushes up the trapezoidal support of bottom on trapezoidal support slider through the slip of trapezoidal support slider and the trapezoidal support outer wall of bottom, thereby makes equipment obtain improving to the stability of mould board body, and goes up and down spacing spout and can prevent effectively that the skew of mould board body emergence position.

title_en: Powder fodder quick mixing arrangement
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a powder feed rapid mixing device, which comprises a bin body, wherein the bin body comprises a decompression atomization bin and a gravity-free mixing bin connected with the bottom of the decompression atomization bin, a stirring shaft connected with a top driving motor is arranged in the middle of the bin body, and a plurality of layers of blades inclined in the same direction are arranged on the stirring shaft; the diameter of the decompression atomization bin is larger than that of the gravity-free mixing bin, a plurality of fans which are inclined upwards and directed to the axis of the bin body are uniformly connected to the bottom side of the decompression atomization bin, the inlet of each fan is connected with the outlet of a Venturi mixer, the feed inlet of the Venturi mixer is connected with a feeding device, and the air inlet of the Venturi mixer is connected with a compression air pipe; the top of the bin body is provided with a pressure relief structure, and the bottom of the bin body is provided with a discharge hole. According to the utility model, the raw materials are firstly sprayed to the central area in an atomized form to be collided and mixed with the air flow mixing condition, and then the powder feed is thrown upwards by the paddles step by step to be suspended, and the influence of gravity or specific gravity on the powder feed is reduced in the process, so that the powder feed can be quickly and uniformly mixed, and layering is avoided.

title_en: Livestock-raising edible groove
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of livestock breeding, in particular to a livestock breeding edible tank which comprises an edible tank main body and a stirring tank, wherein a supporting frame is arranged at the bottom end of the stirring tank, a stirring rod is arranged in the stirring tank, a motor is arranged at the top end of the stirring tank, a feeding bin cover is arranged at the top end of the stirring tank, a pump is arranged at one side of the stirring tank, a water suction pipe is arranged at one side of the pump, and one end of the pump is communicated with the inside of the stirring tank through a pipeline. The feed after the stirring in the stirring tank can automatically enter the main body of the edible tank through the feed delivery pipe, and the feed cannot be scattered from the main body of the edible tank in the process of entering the main body of the edible tank, so that the waste of the feed is avoided.

title_en: Cutting machine and aerated concrete production line
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cutting machine and an aerated concrete production line, wherein the cutting machine comprises a frame and a plurality of steel wire cutting devices, the frame is provided with a cutting space, and the plurality of steel wire cutting devices are arranged at intervals along the extending direction of the cutting space; each steel wire cutting device comprises a wire hanging plate, a detection assembly and two upright post assemblies, wherein the two upright post assemblies are respectively arranged at two sides of a cutting space, and each upright post assembly is provided with a moving platform capable of sliding along the height direction; each steel wire cutting device further comprises a cutting steel wire transversely arranged in the cutting space, and two ends of the cutting steel wire are correspondingly connected with the two movable platforms through a wire hanging plate respectively; the detection component is connected with the middle vertical column component. In the utility model, the moving platform drives the wire hanging plate to move up and down, and synchronously drives the two ends of the cutting steel wire to move up and down so as to adjust the height of the cutting steel wire. And after the adjustment, the height error of the cutting steel wire is detected and corrected through the detection assembly, so that the probability of batch scrapping of products is reduced.

title_en: Eel slicer
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of fish processing equipment, and discloses an eel slicing machine, which comprises a cutting device for cutting eels, and a feeding device for removing mucous membranes of the eels through friction, wherein the cutting device is positioned in the feeding device, and a flushing device for cleaning cutters through water flow and dissolving the eel mucous membranes by utilizing brine is arranged in the feeding device; the feeding device comprises a feeding frame, two feeding rollers are symmetrically arranged inside the frame, a first motor is mounted at the top of each feeding roller, two groups of brushes are arranged on one side of each feeding roller, a plurality of positioning wheels are arranged on one side of each brush, and springs are mounted at two ends of each positioning wheel. According to the eel slicing machine, the mucus on the surface of the eel is removed through friction, so that the eel is prevented from skidding in the subsequent cutting process; the mucous membrane is dissolved by the brine, so that the eel is beneficial to later preservation; through the setting of rivers clean cutter, avoid the residual blade cutting quality that influences of flesh of fish.

title_en: Multifunctional running wheel for rats and mice
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional mouse running wheel, which comprises a base, an adjusting seat and a variable frequency motor, wherein a guide rail is arranged at the top of the base, the adjusting seat moves along the guide rail, bearing seats are oppositely arranged at the top of the adjusting seat, a shaft lever is arranged between the bearing seats, wheel bodies are respectively arranged at two ends of the shaft lever, driven pulleys are arranged at the periphery of the shaft lever, a fastening knob for locking the adjusting seat is arranged on the side wall of the adjusting seat, a driving pulley is arranged at the output end of the variable frequency motor, and a transmission belt is wound between the driving pulley and the driven pulley and between the adjacent driven pulleys.

title_en: Foaming mould with rapid prototyping function for foaming auto-parts production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a foaming mold with a rapid forming function for producing foaming automobile accessories, which comprises a liquid storage tank, wherein a protective shell is fixedly arranged at the top of the liquid storage tank, a stirring lifting assembly is arranged on the right side of an inner cavity of the liquid storage tank in a penetrating manner, the stirring lifting assembly comprises a self-locking motor and a connecting rod, the top of the connecting rod is movably connected with a lower mold through a rotating shaft, radiating fins are fixedly arranged on the surface of the liquid storage tank, auxiliary guide assemblies are arranged at four corners at the bottom of the inner cavity of the liquid storage tank, an upper mold is fixedly arranged at the center of the top of the inner cavity of the protective shell, and a feeding pipe is communicated with the feeding end of the upper mold. According to the utility model, the liquid storage tank, the stirring lifting assembly, the radiating fins and the spraying cooling assembly are used in a matched manner, so that the surface of the lower die can be sprayed for primary cooling, and the lower die can be submerged into the liquid storage tank for secondary cooling under the action of the self-locking motor, thereby improving the cooling rate.

title_en: Silicon rubber filling hot-press forming device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of silicone rubber production, in particular to a silicone rubber pouring hot-press forming device, which comprises a base and a supporting seat, wherein the top of the base is fixedly connected with the supporting seat, the top of the supporting seat is fixedly connected with a lower die, the rear end of the base is fixedly connected with a support post, the top of the support post is fixedly connected with a support plate, the bottom of the support plate is fixedly connected with an electric telescopic arm, the front end of the electric telescopic arm is provided with a shunt switch, the bottom of the electric telescopic arm is fixedly connected with a socket, the bottom of the support plate is fixedly connected with a hydraulic cylinder, and the bottom of the hydraulic cylinder is fixedly connected with a hot-press plate.

title_en: Pet sofa
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of pet furniture, and discloses a pet sofa. The sofa comprises a sofa main body and grabbing plates, wherein the sofa main body is in a triangular prism shape, the sofa main body comprises three groups of side surfaces and two groups of top surfaces, one group of side surfaces are inwards sunken to form a seat cushion area, a person can sit in the seat cushion area, first grooves are respectively formed in the two groups of top surfaces of the sofa main body, grabbing plates are detachably arranged in the first grooves, and sisal hemp layers are wrapped on the grabbing plates; solves the problem that in the prior art, furniture can be scratched by the paws of the pets, so that the pets cannot play together when the owners sit on the sofa.

title_en: Scrap cleaning equipment for plastic master batch production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of plastic master batch production, in particular to scrap cleaning equipment for plastic master batch production, which comprises a feed box, wherein a discharge hole is formed in the bottom of one side of the feed box, a guide plate is fixedly arranged at the outer side of the bottom of the discharge hole on the surface of the feed box, a screen material component is arranged at the outer side of the bottom of the guide plate, a cleaning component is arranged at the bottom of the screen material component, the screen material component comprises a fixed screen material device and a movable screen material device which is internally arranged in the fixed screen material device, the scrap cleaning device for plastic master batch production adjusts a movable screen plate according to the size of master batch, so that the size of gaps between the fixed screen plate and the bottom of the movable screen plate is changed, the size of the screened scrap can be effectively controlled, the cleaning component can effectively avoid the problem that the screen material is blocked at the bottom of the screen material device, and the problem that the screen material is not smooth due to the blocking is solved, and the problem that the common stirring cleaning equipment cannot completely clean the crushed materials is solved.

title_en: Pulverizer for soil hardening
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pulverizer for soil hardening, which relates to the field of soil turning and rolling and comprises a frame, wherein two groups of containing sleeve plates are installed on the frame, the two groups of containing sleeve plates are symmetrically distributed on the frame, movable grooves are formed in the inner sides of the containing sleeve plates, a second support frame is arranged in each movable groove and is in sliding connection with the movable grooves, a rotating shaft is rotatably connected onto the second support frame, a plurality of groups of pulverizing blades are distributed on the rotating shaft, a plurality of groups of pulverizing blades are linearly distributed on the rotating shaft, an extending plate is fixedly connected onto the frame, a mud guard is fixedly connected onto the extending plate, a grippable handle is installed on the mud guard, and the grippable handle is U-shaped. The utility model has good mud blocking effect, and avoids the phenomenon that a great amount of mud is sputtered on clothes when a user works; the depth of crushed hardened soil can be adjusted, and the applicability is improved.

title_en: Road green belt
abstract_en: The utility model provides a road green belt, which relates to the technical field of urban construction and comprises a green flower bed, wherein symmetrical limiting mechanisms are arranged in the green flower bed and comprise sliding rods which are connected to the inner wall of the green flower bed in a sliding manner. This road green belt has the cooperation setting between afforestation flower bed, stop gear, crossbeam one, crossbeam two, guard bar and the bracing piece, can make the staff prune the shiqing with the guard bar upset when opening to no longer need the staff to prune the shiqing with the guard bar, it is more convenient not only to the staff, and the effectual operation degree of difficulty that reduces the staff, simultaneously effectually avoided the staff to prune the shiqing with the guardrail, the top of guardrail can cause the condition of damage to the health of staff, the further operation safety of having guaranteed the staff.

title_en: Novel agricultural product planting sprinkler
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of agricultural product sprayers, and discloses a novel agricultural product planting sprayer. According to the application, the back of the sprinkler body is fixedly connected with the fixing plate, the middle of the fixing plate is connected with the disc, the middle of the disc is provided with the hand rocker, the other end of the hand rocker is connected with the connecting shaft, the connecting part of the connecting shaft and the sprinkler body is provided with the fixing frame, the inside of the fixing frame is provided with the plurality of rotating beads, the surface of the connecting shaft is connected with the anti-overflow ring, the tail end of the connecting shaft is connected with the fan blade, when required liquid is injected into the sprinkler body, an operator can manually rotate the hand rocker, at the moment, the connecting shaft connected with the hand rocker starts to rotate, the rotating beads on the surface of the connecting shaft rotate while the fixing frame plays a role of fixing, friction force can be reduced, the anti-overflow ring can effectively prevent liquid from overflowing, and the arrangement can effectively mix liquid, fully stir and evenly mix the concentration of the liquid.

title_en: Be used for forestry sapling breeding device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a seedling cultivation device for forestry, which relates to the technical field of forestry planting and comprises a cultivation frame body, wherein four groups of fixing components used for fixing seedlings are uniformly arranged in the cultivation frame body, the four groups of fixing components are connected with the inner side wall of the cultivation frame body through movable components, the fixing components are pushed towards the direction of the fixing blocks through pushing cushion blocks, the fixing blocks are pushed through the elastic force of elastic pieces, the trunk of the thickened seedlings are fixed through the fixing blocks, the trunk of the thickened seedlings is fixed through the elastic pieces and the fixing blocks, the growth of the seedlings is guaranteed to a certain extent, the height position of a first connecting plate is adjusted through rotating threaded rods, the middle position of the seedlings can be kept fixed in the process of the growth of the seedlings, and the situation that the seedlings are inclined or even damaged when suffering severe weather such as strong wind is prevented to a certain extent.

title_en: Extruder screw rod convenient to dismantle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an extruder screw convenient to detach, which comprises a box body, wherein one side of the lower end of the inner wall of the box body is connected with a partition plate, the upper end of the partition plate is connected with the upper end of the inner wall of the box body, and the middle part of one side of the partition plate is connected with a screw rod. This extruder screw rod convenient to dismantle, through the mutual cooperation of lead screw, movable block, riding block, connecting cylinder, connecting block, draw-in groove, fixture block and connecting rod that set up, can conveniently drive the connecting cylinder and remove to one side for the fixture block joint is inside the draw-in groove, and the motor drive of being convenient for drives the screw rod body and rotates, makes screw rod body and motor be the separation form, is convenient for dismantle the auger fast, has increased the practicality; through the mutually supporting of connecting cylinder, first mounting panel, second mounting panel, extrusion tube, fixed plate and the connecting block that set up, be convenient for quick with extrusion tube and connecting cylinder separation, and then realize being convenient for take out the screw rod body from inside dismantlement of connecting cylinder and overhaul the processing.

title_en: High-efficient MPP tubular product extrusion device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a high-efficiency MPP pipe extrusion device, which comprises an extrusion cylinder, wherein the top of the extrusion cylinder is provided with a feed inlet, a feed inlet is provided with a discharge bin, the side wall of the extrusion cylinder is provided with a heating cylinder, a first vacuum interlayer is formed between the heating cylinder and the extrusion cylinder, an electric heating wire is arranged in the first vacuum interlayer, the axis of the extrusion cylinder penetrates through and is rotationally provided with a rotating rod, the rotating rod is provided with a spiral pushing blade, and the end part of the extrusion cylinder is provided with a discharge hole; the side wall of the discharging bin is provided with a second vacuum interlayer; the first vacuum interlayer and the second vacuum interlayer are communicated through a communicating pipe; a guide rod and a guide assembly are arranged in the discharging bin, a collision plate is arranged at the top end of the guide rod, a pressing head is arranged at the bottom end of the guide rod, and a tension spring is sleeved on the guide rod; the side wall of the discharging bin is rotationally provided with a first rotating shaft, one end of the first rotating shaft is provided with an eccentric wheel, and the other end of the first rotating shaft is in transmission connection with the second rotating shaft. The utility model can efficiently melt the raw materials for producing the MPP pipe, and ensures the production quality and the production efficiency of the MPP pipe.

title_en: Bagging machine for cultivating crab-flavor mushrooms
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bagging machine for cultivating hypsizigus marmoreus, which relates to the technical field of cultivation of hypsizigus marmoreus, in particular to a bagging machine for cultivating hypsizigus marmoreus, and comprises a transfer plate, wherein a plurality of opening plates for opening bags are arranged at the bottom of the transfer plate, a plurality of first basic blocks corresponding to the opening plates are fixed at the top of the transfer plate, a connecting column is movably connected in the middle of the top of the transfer plate, a feeding hopper is fixed at the top of the connecting column, a notch for feeding is formed in the top of the feeding hopper, and a feeding channel is formed in the feeding hopper in a penetrating manner. This sack filling machine is used in cultivation of crab flavor mushroom is through under the rotatory effect of transfer board for the opening board can drive the sack and remove to the bottom of feeder hopper in proper order and cultivate the assembly of soil, after the assembly of accomplishing cultivateing the soil, the sack is removed, carries out the assembly of next sack cultivates the soil, and the sack of accomplishing the assembly of cultivateing the soil is taken off in other positions.

title_en: Plant quarantine device for advanced agrologists
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a plant quarantine device for an advanced agrologist, which belongs to the technical field of plant quarantine and comprises the following components: the fumigating box is characterized in that a lifting unit with the function of adjusting the size of the internal space of the fumigating box is fixedly arranged in the fumigating box, an air circulation unit with the function of accelerating the air circulation rate is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the fumigating box, a fumigating agent storage box is fixedly arranged on one side of the upper surface of the fumigating box, an atomizing nozzle is arranged in the fumigating box, the lower end of the fumigating agent storage box is fixedly connected with the atomizing nozzle, and an inlet and an outlet are formed in one side of the fumigating box. Therefore, the fumigating space inside the fumigating box can be adjusted to be suitable for the current fumigating target size by starting the lifting unit to lift, and the circulation rate of the fumigant gas inside the fumigating box is accelerated by the air circulation unit, so that plants are fully contacted with the fumigant gas, and the fumigating effect is improved.

title_en: Soil turning equipment for agricultural planting
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of soil turning equipment and discloses soil turning equipment for agricultural planting, which comprises a frame, wherein hydraulic cylinders are arranged at the tops of the front end and the rear end of the frame, a supporting block is fixedly connected to the driving ends of the hydraulic cylinders, a first transmission rod is rotatably connected to the tops of the opposite sides of the two supporting blocks, a motor is arranged at the top of the front side of the supporting block at the front end of the supporting block, the driving end of the motor is fixedly connected to the front end of the first transmission rod, a transmission assembly is fixedly connected to the front end of the outer part of the first transmission rod, a second transmission rod is rotatably connected to the bottoms of the opposite sides of the two supporting blocks, and a plurality of rotating discs are fixedly connected to the outer part of the second transmission rod. According to the utility model, the hard land is crushed, so that the soil turning plate can turn the land well, the soil turning is more uniform, the turning efficiency is improved, and the impact or shaking generated during the use or movement of the device is absorbed.

title_en: Granulating device of cable material extruder
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a granulating device of a cable material extruder, which relates to the technical field of cable material processing, and comprises a device main body, wherein four corners of the lower end of the device main body are respectively provided with a support column, the lower ends of the four support columns are respectively provided with a base, the upper end of the device main body is limited with a support plate near the left side, the upper end of the support plate is provided with an extruder, the right end of the extruder is provided with a cooling box in a penetrating way, the upper end of the inside of the cooling box is provided with a flow equalizing cavity, the lower end of the flow equalizing cavity is provided with a plurality of cooling holes, and the upper end of the device main body is provided with a cooler near the upper left corner; the utility model has the advantages that: the granules extruded by the extruder are cooled faster, the granulating efficiency is increased, and the larger granule quantity is reduced, so that the granules molded by the extruder can be directly screened, the manual additional treatment is not needed, and the working intensity of a user is reduced.

title_en: Insert fixed knot that moulds plastics constructs
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of injection molds and discloses an injection mold insert fixing structure which comprises an injection mold, an insert and a first abutting piece, wherein the injection mold is provided with a cavity, a first accommodating hole communicated with the cavity and a second accommodating hole laterally and crosswise communicated with the first accommodating hole, one end of the insert is inserted into the first accommodating hole, the other end of the insert extends into the cavity, and the first abutting piece is telescopically arranged in the second accommodating hole and abuts against the side wall of the insert. The injection molding insert fixing structure disclosed by the utility model improves the mounting stability of the insert and expands the production range of the outer diameter size of the insert.

title_en: Automobile bumper pouring equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automobile bumper casting device, comprising: the base is hinged with a cover plate at one side; the lower surface of the inner wall of the base is slidably provided with a mounting seat; the lower die is detachably arranged on the upper surface of the base; the upper die is arranged above the lower die, electric push rods are arranged at four corners between the upper die and the base, and a material injection port is formed in the middle of the upper surface of the upper die; the cooling assembly and the fixing assembly are both provided with two groups, the two groups of fixing assemblies are respectively arranged at two ends of the base, the two groups of cooling assemblies are respectively arranged at two ends of the upper die, and the cooling assemblies and the fixing assemblies can be connected in a clamping mode. The utility model has the advantages that the cooling component can be in butt joint with the fixing component, the upper die and the lower die are fixed while the cooling component is limited and fixed through the fixing component, thereby achieving the effect of convenient fixing, and the cooling component is started to cool the upper die and the lower die, so that the model is rapidly molded, and the occurrence of sticking of the model is reduced.

title_en: Spiral fish scale roller of corn husker of anti-sticking stick structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides a spiral fish scale roller of a corn husker with an anti-sticking rod structure, which comprises a main body roller, wherein fish scale-shaped ribs are fully distributed on the outer surface layer of the main body roller, the fish scale-shaped ribs are integrally formed by staggered stacking of a plurality of layers of terraces with arc-shaped grooves at the edges, the arc-shaped grooves are in a nonuniform arc shape, a plurality of spiral ribs are uniformly distributed at intervals around the outer surface layer of the main body roller, and natural rubber is integrally formed among the main body roller, the fish scale-shaped ribs and the spiral ribs. The corn husker has the advantages that the problem that the damage rate of the corn ears and the breakage rate of the seeds of the traditional corn husker are high is solved, the stripping rate of the corn husker is improved, the damage rate of the corn ears and the breakage rate of the seeds are effectively reduced, and the working efficiency and the product quality of the corn husker are effectively improved. Perfectly solving the phenomena that the fish scale roller is damaged by the clamping rod and the grain is dropped in the peeling process.

title_en: Afforestation plant fixed knot constructs
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of landscaping and discloses a landscaping plant fixing structure which comprises a fixing box, wherein a placing basin is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the fixing box, a first threaded column is rotatably connected to the inside of the fixing box, a first handle is fixedly connected to one end of the first threaded column, a moving block is connected to the outer side wall of the first threaded column in a threaded mode, a rotating rod is rotatably connected to the inside of the moving block, a sliding block is rotatably connected to one side of the rotating rod, a limiting rod is fixedly connected to the inside of the fixing box, the lower surface of the sliding block is connected to the outer side of the limiting rod, and a clamping assembly is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the sliding block. According to the utility model, the moving block is driven to move through the rotation of the first threaded column, and the fixing plate is driven to move through the movement of the connecting rod, so that the effect of fixing plants is achieved, the problem that plants with different sizes cannot be fixed and protected in traditional gardens is solved, and the service life of the plants is prolonged.

title_en: Gantry multi-blade stone cutting machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a gantry multi-piece stone cutting machine, which comprises a conjoined upright post steel frame and a conveying belt workbench, wherein the conjoined upright post steel frame is connected with the conveying belt workbench, the upper end of the conjoined upright post steel frame is fixedly provided with a guide column body, a lifting hydraulic system is arranged on the guide column body, a plurality of lifting guide columns are arranged in a penetrating manner in the guide column body, the lifting hydraulic system is connected with the lifting guide columns, stone cutting devices are arranged on the lifting guide columns, the conveying workbench is arranged at the bottom of a working area of the stone cutting device, roller transition frames are arranged at two ends of the conveying workbench, a plurality of rollers are arranged on the roller transition frames, the conveying belt is arranged on the conveying workbench, the horizontal plane of the conveying belt and the section of the top of each roller are on the same plane, and a transmission device is arranged on the conveying workbench and the roller transition frames.

title_en: Ridging cutter for mini-tiller
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a ridging cutter for a mini tiller, which relates to the technical field of accessories of mini tiller and comprises a cutter shaft, wherein a first blade which extends spirally along the length direction of the cutter shaft is arranged on the cutter shaft, a second blade which extends spirally along with the first blade is fixedly connected with the outer edge of the first blade, a plurality of cutter teeth which are distributed spirally along with the outer edge of the second blade are formed on the second blade at equal intervals, and the wear resistance coefficient of the second blade is larger than that of the first blade. The cutter shaft rotates to drive the first blade to rotate, the first blade drives the second blade to rotate, the second blade drives the cutter tooth to turn over soil, simultaneously the first blade and the second blade which extend in a spiral mode can dial over the turned over soil, the second blade with higher wear resistance coefficient is added, the cutter tooth is arranged on the second blade, the wear resistance and the durability of the cutter tooth are improved, the probability of cutter abrasion replacement is reduced, and therefore the service life of the ridging cutter is prolonged.

title_en: Loading attachment is used in degradable plastic bag production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a feeding device for producing degradable plastic bags, which comprises a discharging box, a material guiding box and a feeding groove, wherein the material guiding box is arranged at the front end of the discharging box, the feeding groove is arranged in the upper end of the discharging box, a feeding component is arranged on the discharging box, and the feeding component can feed the raw materials for producing the degradable plastic bags, and relates to the technical field of plastic bag production: the supporting ring and the supporting plate I are arranged on the outer side of the conveying screw, the conveying screw rotates in the supporting ring through the supporting plate I, and the angle of the conveying screw is adjusted, so that the conveying screw is convenient to adjust the direction of conveying raw materials; the upper end of the conveying screw is provided with a first connecting pipe which is a fixed-height row material, a second connecting pipe is arranged on the basis of the fixed-height row material, materials in the first connecting pipe are extracted, degradable plastic bag production materials are discharged into the equipment through the corrugated pipe and the second connecting pipe, and after the height position of the second connecting pipe is adjusted, the blowing machine with different heights can be fed.

title_en: Edible fungi cultivation is with planting frame
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a planting frame for cultivating edible fungi, and relates to the technical field of edible fungi cultivation frames. The utility model comprises a bracket body, a plurality of placing components and a distance adjusting mechanism, wherein the placing components and the distance adjusting mechanism are positioned in the bracket body, the placing components are uniformly distributed on the bracket body from top to bottom, the placing components are arranged on one side of the distance adjusting mechanism, the other side of the distance adjusting mechanism is provided with a limiting strip, the distance adjusting mechanism comprises a mounting groove, a rack, a gear, a worm wheel, a worm, a knob, a tightening piece and a fixing rod, the rack is vertically arranged in the mounting groove, the gear is meshed with the rack, the center of one side of the rack is connected with the placing components through the fixing rod, the first end of the fixing rod is rotationally connected with the center of the gear, the other end of the fixing rod passes through a sliding groove on the mounting groove and is fixedly connected with the placing components, the worm wheel and the gear are coaxially fixed, the worm is meshed with the worm wheel, and one end of the tightening piece is fixedly connected between the worm wheel and the knob. The utility model can adjust the distance between the storage parts.

title_en: Brick press convenient for loading and unloading
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a brick machine convenient for loading and unloading, and relates to the technical field of brick machines. According to the brick pressing machine convenient for loading and unloading, the brick pressing raw materials are conveyed into the stirring tank through the first conveying belt, the stirring motor in the stirring tank drives the two groups of L-shaped stirring columns to rotate, the raw materials are fully fused, the stirred raw materials are injected into the brick pressing groove through the discharging pipe, the brick pressing table is conveyed to the lower part of the fixing frame through the second conveying belt, the pressing plate is pushed downwards by the brick pressing air cylinder, the raw materials are pressed, the brick pressing table is conveyed through the second conveying belt, the top plate is pushed upwards by the ejection air cylinder in the brick pressing groove, and the bricks in the brick pressing groove are ejected out.

title_en: Drying device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a drying device, comprising: the machine box is internally provided with a rolling mechanism and a hot air mechanism, and one side of the machine box is provided with a feed inlet; the rolling mechanism comprises a motor and a grid roller, the motor is arranged on one side of the inside of the chassis, the grid roller is arranged above the drawer, a roller is arranged in the center of the grid roller, an output shaft of the motor is fixedly connected with the center of the roller, a side opening door is rotatably connected to the opening, and the side opening door is fixed on the grid roller through a buckle assembly; the hot air mechanism comprises a heat supply air box which is arranged in the case. According to the drying device, the rolling mechanism is arranged, and fruits such as green plums are continuously turned over while being dried by the grid roller, so that the fruits can be uniformly dried inside the grid roller, impurities on the surfaces of the fruits such as green plums can be leaked out by the grid roller, and the taste of a finished product is improved; the arc-shaped plate can disperse and blow the hot air provided by the heat supply bellows into the grid roller, so that the preserved fruits in the grid roller are comprehensively dried.

title_en: Bird-preventing needle plate for power transmission line
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of bird prevention devices, and particularly relates to a bird prevention needle plate for a power transmission line, which comprises a needle plate base, wherein bird prevention needles are arranged at the upper end of the needle plate base, fixing holes are formed in the surface of the needle plate base, mounting pieces are connected to the lower end of the needle plate base, mounting holes are formed in the surface of the mounting pieces, and assembly bolts are arranged between adjacent mounting pieces. According to the utility model, the needle plate base, the fixing holes, the bird preventing needles, the mounting parts, the mounting holes and the assembly bolts are arranged, the center of the bird preventing needle adopted by the bird preventing needle plate is bent to be in a water drop shape, and the water drop shape structure is clamped inside the two adjacent fixing holes, so that not only is the assembly, disassembly and maintenance of the bird preventing needles convenient, but also the distance between the bird preventing needles can be adjusted according to the bird preventing size, the applicability and the bird preventing effect of the bird preventing needles are improved, meanwhile, the assembly connection and fixation can be carried out according to the protection area, the assembly structure is simple, and the use effect of the bird preventing needle plate is greatly improved.

title_en: Even concrete distributing device of cloth
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a concrete distributing device with uniform distribution, which comprises a frame and a hopper arranged on the frame, and is characterized by further comprising a discharging mechanism which is arranged on the frame and is convenient for uniform feeding, wherein the discharging mechanism comprises a plurality of screw conveyors arranged at the bottom of the hopper and a discharging component arranged on the screw conveyors; through the setting of discharge mechanism, in advance with the even distribution of concrete in every screw conveyer in the hopper, in the rethread screw conveyer carried the unloading hopper, avoided the concrete to directly fall in the die frame accumulational problem, make the even blanking of concrete in the die frame, promote production efficiency.

title_en: Agricultural intelligent agricultural is with accurate controlling means that fertilizies
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an agricultural intelligent agricultural fertilization accurate control device, which particularly relates to the field of agricultural apparatuses, and comprises a device main body, wherein supporting frames are fixedly connected to two sides of the top of the device main body; a storage bucket is embedded and connected at one side of the top of the supporting frame. The utility model provides stable support for the support frame during use, ensures the stability of the whole structure, the storage barrel is used for storing fertilizer, the fertilizer is conveyed to a fertilizing position through the material flowing pipeline, the rolling movable gear on the surface of the material flowing pipeline can prevent blockage, smooth conveying is ensured, the discharge port and the stirring shaft are matched for use, so that the fertilizer is fully stirred during discharging, the uniformity is improved, the sealing protection pad can prevent fertilizer leakage, the device is kept clean, the movable wheels on two sides of the bottom of the base are moved, the device is convenient to move and is suitable for different terrains, the fertilizer is conveyed to a designated position from the device main body through the material discharging pipeline, the impact force during the movement of the device is effectively reduced, and the safety is improved through the matched use of the buffer plate and the damper.

title_en: Garlic dewatering device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of garlic dehydration, and discloses a garlic dehydration device which comprises a support ring, wherein a drying mechanism is arranged in the support ring, a circulating mechanism is arranged in the drying mechanism, the circulating mechanism comprises a turning component and a rotating component, the rotating component is arranged in the drying mechanism, the turning component is arranged in the rotating component, the drying mechanism comprises a hot air blower, and the hot air blower is fixedly arranged outside the support ring. The inside garlic of storehouse is carried into to the conveying column inside through can will depositing when the hob rotates, and rethread conveying column top discharges, can circulate the garlic like this to can guarantee when drying the garlic that the bottom garlic is transported the top and make can let the bottom garlic carry out the position interchangeable with top garlic, thereby increase the area of contact of garlic with the heating installation, can effectively improve garlic stoving speed like this, thereby improve area of contact between garlic and the air.

title_en: Plastic container processing injection mold
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of plastic processing devices, in particular to a plastic container processing injection mold, which comprises: the bottom plate, bottom plate top middle part fixedly connected with base, base top middle part fixedly connected with bed die, base top four corners department all fixedly connected with support column, support column periphery upper portion sliding connection has the fly leaf, fly leaf bottom middle part fixedly connected with go up the mould; the demolding assembly is arranged in the base, the middle part of the top end of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a supporting frame, the middle part of the bottom end of the supporting frame is fixedly connected with a hydraulic cylinder, and the hydraulic cylinder drives the movable plate to move; the beneficial effects are as follows: after injection molding, the hydraulic cylinder can separate the upper die from the lower die, at the moment, the compression spring can push the sliding block, the sliding block can push the ejector rod upwards in cooperation with the connecting rod, and then the plastic container in the lower die can be demolded, so that the workload of workers is reduced, and the working efficiency of the workers is improved.

title_en: Ecological environment protects uses soil prosthetic devices
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a soil restoration device for ecological environment protection, which comprises a rotating rod, wherein both ends of the rotating rod are rotationally connected with idler wheels, two mutually symmetrical supporting rods are arranged on the outer wall of the rotating rod, one end of each supporting rod is provided with a connecting rod, a spraying mechanism is arranged on each supporting rod, and one side of a water tank is provided with a soil turning mechanism.

title_en: Square pile pouring device for municipal road bridge
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of square pile pouring, and discloses a square pile pouring device for municipal roads and bridges. The utility model has the advantages of convenient pouring of the square pile, convenient discharge of air in the concrete during pouring, prevention of hollowing in the square pile and improvement of the quality of the square pile.

title_en: Slicing device for silicon carbide processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a slicing device for silicon carbide processing, which belongs to the technical field of silicon carbide and comprises a substrate, wherein a cutting frame is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the substrate, a transverse plate is fixedly connected to the inner side wall of the cutting frame, a storage battery is placed on the upper surface of the transverse plate, a cutting head is fixedly connected to the bottom surface of the transverse plate, a sliding groove is formed in the upper surface of the substrate, a sliding block is movably connected to the inside of the sliding groove, a baffle is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the sliding block, the bottom surface of the baffle contacts with the upper surface of the substrate, and symmetrical stress plates are fixedly connected to the upper surface of the baffle. Through the cooperation of baffle and spout and slider, can carry out the position control to the processing thing, avoid the workman to appear inconvenient phenomenon when carrying out the position control to it, through being provided with the swivel plate, can carry out angle adjustment to the machined part, solved the workman easily because of can't carry out the phenomenon that the angle adjustment appears processing failure to it when using.

title_en: Disease and insect pest prevention equipment for potatoes
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of potato deinsectization, and discloses a disease and pest prevention device for potatoes, which comprises a supporting seat, wherein one side of the top end of the supporting seat is fixedly connected with a movable handle, four corners of the bottom end of the top end of the supporting seat are fixedly connected with universal wheels, one side of the top end of the supporting seat, which is close to the top end, is fixedly connected with a pesticide box, a protective cover is arranged on one side of the pesticide box, which is close to the top end, a forward and reverse rotating motor is started to drive a forward and reverse bidirectional screw rod in transmission connection with the positive and reverse rotating motor to rotate in a square sliding groove, so that two threaded sliding blocks are driven to relatively move, the rotation angle of a lifting hinge rod is driven to be adjusted to be high under the movable supporting action of a second movable part and a first movable part, and then the two square sliding blocks are driven to slide in a square groove in a sleeved mode, so that the top plate can be adjusted in height, and a sprayer on a position moving assembly can be guaranteed to uniformly spray pesticide on the roots and leaves of potatoes, and the disease and pest prevention are realized.

title_en: Biscuit sandwich machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a biscuit sandwich machine which comprises a bottom plate, wherein an organism is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the bottom plate, a feeding tank is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the organism, a conveying frame is fixedly connected to the right side surface of the bottom plate, a conveying belt is movably connected to the inner side wall of the conveying frame, bearing plates are fixedly connected to the front surface of the conveying frame and the back surface of the conveying frame, cooling frame bodies are fixedly connected to the top ends of the two bearing plates together, an air pump is fixedly connected to the inner top wall of the cooling frame bodies, two input ends of the air pump penetrate through the cooling frame bodies and extend to the upper side of the cooling frame bodies, nozzles which are arranged at equal intervals are fixedly connected to the output ends of the air pump, and a filter screen is fixedly connected to the inner side wall of the cooling frame bodies. The device can cool the dried biscuits by air cooling through being provided with the nozzle, replaces the problem that the traditional natural drying mode is easy to have low efficiency, and can filter the airflow sprayed out of the device by being provided with the filter screen.

title_en: Tropical fruit seedling greenhouse
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of seedling growing greenhouse, and discloses a tropical fruit seedling growing greenhouse which comprises a greenhouse shell, wherein ventilation boxes are arranged on two sides of the greenhouse shell, protective nets are arranged at openings of the ventilation boxes, fixing frames are arranged on surfaces of the ventilation boxes, first motors are arranged on surfaces of the fixing frames, screw rods are coaxially arranged on rotors of the first motors, lifting blocks are rotatably connected to surfaces of the screw rods, cleaning plates are arranged on surfaces of the lifting blocks, and mounting frames are arranged on upper surfaces of the ventilation boxes. The first motor that establishes is added and can drive the lead screw and rotate, and the lead screw rotates and can drive the lifter block and go up and down, and the lifter block can drive the clearance board and carry out reciprocating motion, and the clearance brush on clearance board surface can clear up the snow adsorbed on protection network surface when removing to prevent that the snow from covering the ventilation performance that influences the protection network at the surface of protection network.

title_en: Device for efficiently collecting heterochrosis ladybug egg blocks
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a device for efficiently collecting heterochrosis ladybug egg blocks, which comprises a raising cage, a flowerpot and an egg block collecting assembly, wherein the raising cage comprises a plurality of wood boards and a plurality of gauze, the wood boards form a cuboid frame of the raising cage, the gauze is respectively adhered to a plurality of inner surfaces of the raising cage to form a closed space inside the cuboid frame, and a wooden door and a buckle are arranged on one side surface of the raising cage; a plurality of flowerpots are arranged on the inner side of the raising cage, a plurality of broad bean seedlings are planted on the inner side of the flowerpots, a plurality of aphids are placed on the broad bean seedlings, and an egg collecting assembly is arranged on the outer side of the flowerpots; the egg block collecting assembly comprises a side film, a bottom film and a rubber band, wherein the side film is arranged on the cambered surface on the outer side of the flowerpot, the bottom film is arranged on the bottom surface of the flowerpot, the side film and the bottom film are wrapped and clung to the outer side of the flowerpot, and the side film and the bottom film are fixed on the flowerpot through the rubber band.

title_en: Automatic material mixing and proportioning device for regenerated colored PET fiber production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of recycling, in particular to an automatic mixing and blending device for recycling colored PET (polyethylene terephthalate) fiber production, which comprises a universal wheel, wherein the top of the universal wheel is movably connected with a bottom plate through threads, the top of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a stirring cavity, one side of the stirring cavity is fixedly connected with a motor box fixedly connected with the top of the bottom plate, the top of the stirring cavity is fixedly connected with a feed inlet, one end of the stirring cavity is fixedly connected with a discharge outlet, the top of a first layer of the inside of the motor box is movably connected with a hot air blower through screws, and the top of a second layer of the inside of the motor box is movably connected with a first motor through screws. The automatic material mixing and proportioning device after the improvement changes single stirring roller into triaxial stirring, can carry out secondary crushing with not completely kibbling material, has improved material utilization ratio, installs the air heater additional in the inside of stirring cavity simultaneously, installs the disinfection pipe additional at the top of motor case, deposit PET material that can be better.

title_en: Line wheel coplanarity detection tool and cutting equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides a wire wheel coplanarity detection tool and cutting equipment, belongs to the technical field of crystal silicon processing, and solves the problem of low wire wheel coplanarity detection efficiency in the prior art. The utility model comprises a standard section, wherein the length of the standard section is a set value; the first extension section is obtained by extending the standard section along a first direction; the second extension section is obtained by extending the standard section along a second direction; at least one of the first extension section and the second extension section is provided with a veneering surface which is used for being attached to a reference surface of equipment to be detected; and at least one of the first extending section and the second extending section is provided with a detecting part, and the detecting part is used for correcting the position of the wire wheel. According to the utility model, one of the first extending section and the second extending section is attached to the datum plane of the equipment to be detected, and the other extending section is used as a reference object for comparing the positions of the wire wheels, so that the positions of the wire wheels can be detected and judged rapidly.

title_en: Smashing device for plastic plate packaging
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a smashing device for plastic plate packaging, and belongs to the technical field of plastic plate production equipment. The structure comprises a frame, a driving motor and a transition bin are arranged on the frame, a transmission belt is arranged on the driving motor, a gear-shifting control box is arranged at the position above the transmission belt in a matched mode, a coupler is arranged at the position on the right side of the gear-shifting control box, a material crushing bin is arranged at the position on the right side of the coupler in a matched mode, a feeding hole is formed in the position above the material crushing bin, a transition bin is arranged at the position below the material crushing bin, and the transition bin is fixedly arranged at the position above the frame. The device adopts the controllable material crushing bin, and the speed change frequency of the speed change control box can be adjusted according to actual conditions, so that the crushing work of plastic plates with different specifications is completed; meanwhile, in the process of smashing the plastic plate, the sealing structure in the material smashing bin can avoid splashing of plastic plate scraps, so that safety accidents are caused.

title_en: PVC panel continuous type heat sink
abstract_en: The utility model provides a PVC (polyvinyl chloride) plate continuous cooling device, which relates to the technical field of PVC plate processing and comprises a shell and a cooling mechanism, wherein the cooling mechanism is arranged in the shell and comprises a water sprinkling assembly and a heat radiating assembly, one side of the shell is provided with the water sprinkling assembly, and the inner side of the shell is provided with the heat radiating assembly. Through setting up cooling mechanism, when using, the setting of watering subassembly can accelerate the cooling effect of PVC panel, evenly arranged's watering subassembly evenly sprinkles can avoid PVC panel to take place to warp scheduling problem because of the inhomogeneous PVC panel that arouses of cooling, realize cooling in the in-process that PVC panel carried in succession, improve cooling rate, the setting of infiltration hole can avoid panel to be soaked produced the injury by the water source for a long time, reduce the corruption and the harm that moisture and moisture led to the fact the structure to the PVC panel, can in time ooze the water source downwards, go to the water drainage tank in, the drain pipe in the water drainage tank can in time discharge waste water.

title_en: Cat toy
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cat toy, which comprises a balance base, wherein a support column is fixedly arranged at the center of the top of the balance base, a cloth placing cylinder is arranged at the outer side of the support column, the bottom end of the cloth placing cylinder is fixed on the balance base, a corrugated paper cylinder with the same height as the cloth placing cylinder is placed in the cloth placing cylinder, the corrugated paper cylinder is sleeved on the support column, the utility model designs a balance bracket consisting of the balance base and the support column, a cloth placing cylinder with an opening is fixed on the balance bracket, the corrugated paper tube can be placed in the placement cloth tube, only the corrugated paper tube at the opening is exposed outside for cat scratching, after scratching and wearing are serious, the corrugated paper tube can be rotated to enable the intact part to be rotated to the opening for continuous use, the corrugated paper tube is more convenient to replace and operate, in addition, the integral structure of the cat climbing frame can be used as a cat climbing frame, so that articles with two functions are integrated, and the placement space is saved.

title_en: Suspension type grape vine auxiliary winter protection cloth soil removing in-situ winding device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of agricultural mechanical devices, in particular to a suspension type grape vine auxiliary winter protection cloth soil removing in-situ rolling device for overwintering, which comprises the following components: frame, roll-up device and soil removing device. The rolling device is driven to rotate through chain transmission, when the cold-proof cloth is rolled, the cold-proof cloth passes through the soil removing device, a plurality of circles of the cold-proof cloth are wound in the rolling device in advance, the tractor is driven to the ground, and the power output shaft is started, so that the cold-proof cloth can be rolled on the ground without entering the field for rolling operation. The utility model solves the problems of difficult manual winding of cold-proof cloth and low winding efficiency, in particular to the problem that the cold-proof cloth is mechanically wound under the condition that a narrow row-spacing vineyard tractor cannot enter, improves the quality and efficiency of agricultural production, and provides a new device for the development of the grape industry.

title_en: Irrigation device for greenhouse planting
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of greenhouse planting, in particular to a watering device for greenhouse planting, which solves the problem that in the prior art, in the process of watering plants, watering is directly carried out through a water pipe or water scattering is carried out manually, and the mode greatly reduces the efficiency of watering the plants. The utility model provides a big-arch shelter is planted and is used watering device, includes the canopy body, the inboard upper portion fixedly connected with roof of the canopy body, and the top fixedly connected with roof frame of roof, the outer wall one side of roof frame is through bolt fixedly connected with driving motor, and the inboard rotation of roof frame is connected with the screw rod. According to the utility model, the spray plate at the bottom of the bearing plate is driven to move through the nut seat so as to uniformly spray plants in the greenhouse body, and meanwhile, the air cylinder can be started to drive the spray plate to move up and down so as to adapt to plant irrigation work at different heights, so that the uniformity and efficiency of spraying plants can be improved.

title_en: Filament cutter is used in fresh meat processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fresh meat processing shredder which comprises a pedestal, wherein the upper surface of the pedestal is fixedly connected with a supporting column, the side surface of the supporting column is fixedly connected with a fixed shaft, the outer surface of the fixed shaft is rotationally connected with a connecting piece, the outer surface of the connecting piece is fixedly connected with a second fixed plate, and the lower surface of the second fixed plate is provided with a chute. Through above-mentioned structure, the device is provided with washing mechanism, the water tank of being connected through first fixed plate lower surface, the effect of water pump is down with the water in the water tank at first outlet pipe and second outlet pipe drawing together to spout through the shower nozzle, wash the upper end, for preventing sewage causes the pollution, be provided with water drainage tank at the pedestal lower surface, concentrate through the sewage of seepage and collect, and for can controlling shredding thickness, be provided with the blade that can supply portable installation, be connected with the spout through the slider that links to each other with the blade.

title_en: Anti-pollution powder mixer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-pollution powder mixer, which comprises: a powder mixer body comprising a stirring assembly; the stirring assembly includes: the annular frame is arranged above the powder mixer main body; the inner side of the annular frame is rotatably provided with a charging barrel, and the annular frame is used for limiting the axial sliding of the charging barrel; the stirring blade and the rotating blade are arranged in the charging barrel; the sleeve rod base is installed at the two ends of the charging barrel, a common supporting frame is fixedly sleeved on the sleeve rod base, and the rotating blades are uniformly and equidistantly arranged on the supporting frame. Through the arrangement of the rotating blades, the rotating blades rotate together with the charging barrel on the supporting frame to form stirring trend stirring powder, stirring flow is formed, the stirring blades break the stirring flow while stirring, and other powder enters the stirring flow to continue stirring; after the power supply is turned off, the stirring blades continue to operate due to inertia, so that the residual powder at the two ends of the charging barrel is concentrated, and the waste of the powder is prevented.

title_en: Tree planting pit digging equipment for landscaping engineering construction
abstract_en: The utility model provides tree planting pit digging equipment for landscaping engineering construction, which belongs to the technical field of landscaping and comprises the following components: the utility model provides a workstation, the top fixedly connected with control switch of workstation, the top one side fixedly connected with control cabinet of workstation, the top fixedly connected with control panel of control cabinet, this kind of trees planting equipment of digging pit for afforestation engineering construction is through planting the hole subassembly and also can control from top to bottom when carrying out rotatory digging pit with planting the hole drill bit, utilize inertia and high adjustment to dig the hole of different degree of depth, in order to adapt to the tree of different varieties, and the whole machine of digging the hole of being in order, comparatively high-efficient and accurate, further improve the holistic result of use of device, the in-process backplate subassembly of planting the hole subassembly and digging the hole also can be adjusted according to the height of digging out earth, avoid digging the earth that the hole brought to sputter nearby, influence the holistic aesthetic property of afforestation engineering, further improve the functional of device.

title_en: A tongue-and-groove module, arrangement structure, cavity structure for prefabricated component preparation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mortise module, an arrangement structure and a cavity structure for manufacturing prefabricated parts, wherein the mortise module comprises a main body; the main body is provided with a mortise; one side of the main body, which is away from the mortise, is provided with a fixing part for clamping the prefabricated member reinforcing steel bars. The arrangement structure comprises a core mold of the prefabricated component mold and a plurality of mortice modules arranged on the surface of the core mold, so that after pouring of the prefabricated component mold is completed, the main body of the mortice modules forms mortises in the thickness direction of the inner wall of the cavity formed by the core mold. After the prefabricated component cavity is poured, new concrete enters the mortise after entering the prefabricated component cavity, the new concrete is combined with the old concrete to form a mortise structure, the structure can effectively disperse structural stress in all directions during earthquake waves, the concrete is not easy to slip when being subjected to upward subversion force, the new concrete and the old concrete are not easy to delaminate and split when being pressed downwards, and the integrity of a neutralization shaft is ensured when the concrete shakes left and right, and the feather flushing is not needed.

title_en: Large-scale printing opacity vault structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides a large-scale light-transmitting vault structure, and relates to the technical field of seedling planting; the light-transmitting dome comprises a supporting ring, wherein the upper end face of the supporting ring is fixedly connected with a light-transmitting dome body, the outer wall face of the supporting ring is provided with a conveying air opening, the outer wall face of the supporting ring is fixedly connected with a fixing plate, and the fixing plate is positioned below the conveying air opening. According to the utility model, carbon dioxide can be conveyed to the inner sides of the supporting ring and the light-transmitting vault body through the arrangement of the carbon dioxide conveying device, so that photosynthesis of seedlings on the inner sides of the supporting ring and the light-transmitting vault body is improved, survival rate of the seedlings is improved, and carbon dioxide conveying conveyed to the inner sides of the supporting ring and the light-transmitting vault body can be split by the carbon dioxide conveying device, so that carbon dioxide conveyed to the inner sides of the supporting ring and the light-transmitting vault body is uniformly distributed, and growth progress of the seedlings on the inner sides of the supporting ring and the light-transmitting vault body is uniform.

title_en: Air lift water outlet nozzle capable of floating and lifting and air lift filter
abstract_en: The utility model provides a floatable lifting air lift water outlet nozzle and an air lift filter, relates to the technical field of filters, and solves the technical problem that the fixed arrangement of the air lift water outlet nozzle is easy to deviate from the water surface, and the filtering effect is affected; the air lift water nozzle assembly comprises a fixed pipe seat, a lifting pipe, a limiter and an air lift water nozzle, wherein the fixed pipe seat is communicated with the air inlet pipe, and at least part of the lifting pipe is inserted into the fixed pipe seat and is communicated with the fixed pipe seat; the lifting pipe is fixedly connected with the gas lifting water nozzle, the limiter is fixedly connected with the lifting pipe and is in sliding connection with the air inlet pipe, and the limiter can drive the gas lifting water nozzle to float and lift along the fixed pipe seat under the buoyancy effect; when the water surface changes in a certain range, the limiter can enable the gas lift water nozzle to slide along the air inlet pipe under the action of buoyancy, and the gas lift water nozzle can be always located at the position of the water surface in the cylinder body, so that the gas lift water nozzle sprayed airflow can be guaranteed to better promote water flow, and the filtering effect of the gas lift filter on water is guaranteed.

title_en: Vegetable seed mixes medicine device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a vegetable seed medicine mixing device, which relates to the technical field of vegetable seeds and comprises: the bottom plate, four corner position fixedly connected with mounting bracket are close to at the top of bottom plate, the internal surface of mounting bracket sets up the jar body, the bottom fixedly connected with motor of jar body, the output of motor rotates the bottom of running through the jar body. When the vegetable seed mixing device is used, the lifting assembly and the filtering assembly are matched, the sealing cover can seal the top of the tank body, so that when vegetable seeds are mixed with medicines, partial scattered powdery medicines can enter the filter cylinder from the two connecting pipes and sequentially pass through the filter screen and the active carbon plate, the filter screen can block larger impurities, the active carbon plate can absorb harmful substances and adsorb peculiar smell, the effects of filtering and purifying are achieved, the phenomenon that part of medicines are scattered around in a powder form in the stirring process to harm nearby people is prevented, and the safety of the vegetable seed mixing device is improved.

title_en: Shallow soil excavating mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a shallow soil excavating mechanism, and belongs to the technical field of agricultural machinery. The shallow soil excavating mechanism comprises a frame and a plurality of spiral excavators which are arranged in the frame in parallel; the spiral excavator comprises a rotating shaft, at least one spiral component and a flat shovel blade; the rotating shaft is rotationally arranged on the frame through a bearing seat, and the spiral component and the flat shovel blade are fixed on the rotating shaft; the spiral component comprises two spiral blades symmetrically arranged on the rotating shaft at 180 degrees and a throwing plate fixed at the upper ends of the two spiral blades. The utility model can greatly improve the harvesting speed, the operation efficiency, and the crop is not easy to be damaged and the benefit effect is improved.

title_en: Snack production equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of snack production equipment, in particular to snack production equipment, which comprises a box body and a cleaning assembly, wherein the cleaning assembly comprises a guide frame, a net frame, a shaft post, a connecting rod, a cam plate, a driving member and a spraying member, wherein the guide frame is fixedly connected with the box body and is positioned in the box body, the net frame is slidably arranged on the guide frame, the shaft post is fixedly connected with the net frame and is positioned at one side of the net frame, the cam plate is connected with the box body through the driving member, the driving member is arranged on the box body and supports the cam plate, two ends of the connecting rod are respectively connected with the shaft post and the cam plate, and the spraying member is arranged on the box body.

title_en: Fresh fruit conveyor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fresh fruit conveyor, which relates to the technical field of conveyors and comprises a conveying box, wherein a conveying belt is installed at the rear position inside the conveying box through rotation of a rotating roller, a feeding port matched with the conveying belt is arranged at the rear end of the conveying box, a blow box is installed at the rear position on one side of the conveying box, a sundry outlet matched with the blow box is arranged at the other side of the conveying box, a sundry removing fan is installed at the rear position on one side of the conveying box, an air suction pipe of the sundry removing fan is connected with the sundry outlet, the sundry removing fan, the blow box, a drying air port and a water absorbing cotton cylinder are convenient to remove sundries from fresh fruits, the cleaned fruits are convenient to dry, and the problems that the traditional fresh fruit conveyor is difficult to process later in use, a large amount of water possibly exists on the surface of fruits, the fruits are difficult to take and pack, and the fruits fall down, and the processing efficiency is affected are solved.

title_en: Agricultural sprinkler
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of spraying devices, and particularly relates to an agricultural spraying device which comprises a spraying component, wherein two ends of the spraying component are fixedly connected with supporting components, a water inlet component for abutting joint of a pipeline is fixedly communicated with the middle of the side wall of the spraying component, the water inlet component comprises a water inlet disc fixedly communicated with the spraying component, a water inlet pipe is communicated with the bottom end of the water inlet disc, a connector is arranged at one end of the water inlet pipe, pushing hands are symmetrically and fixedly connected to the top end of the water inlet component, the spraying component comprises a main pipe, a spray head is arranged on the side wall of the main pipe, and connecting shafts for installing the supporting components are fixedly connected to the two ends of the main pipe. According to the utility model, water for irrigation enters the spraying part through the water inlet disc and is sprayed through the spraying part, and when water is sprayed, the spraying part is pushed to walk forwards by the pushing hand, so that the spraying efficiency is high, and the spraying uniformity is good.

title_en: Improved device for cladding sucker rod production line
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an improved device for a coated sucker rod production line, which relates to the technical field of sucker rod production and comprises a traction device and a terminal controller, wherein the traction device is used for the sucker rod full-coating production line and comprises a fixed platform, the front and the rear of the fixed platform are fixedly provided with supporting plates, one sides of the two supporting plates, which are opposite, are respectively provided with a positioning device, one side of the two supporting plates, which is opposite, is respectively provided with an adjusting device, and the positioning device on the right side is provided with two position sensors I. According to the utility model, all the threaded columns are electrically regulated, and the motor III is stopped when the movement difference value of the position sensor I and the displacement sensor II is the same, so that the regulating distance of the threaded columns is ensured, and compared with the mode of manually regulating a plurality of threaded columns in the prior art, the regulating is more time-saving and labor-saving, the mode that the threaded columns can reach the required positions only by manually regulating and correcting for many times is changed, and the production efficiency is effectively improved.

title_en: Continuous fiber reinforced gel composite material additive manufacturing device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a continuous fiber reinforced gel composite material additive manufacturing device, which comprises: the device comprises a wire winding driving mechanism, a printing mechanism, a gluing mechanism, a curing mechanism, a moving mechanism and a substrate platform; the printing mechanism, the gluing mechanism and the curing mechanism form a printing module; the printing module is movably connected to the moving mechanism and is positioned above the substrate platform, and the printing module is driven by the moving mechanism to move along the substrate platform; the wire winding driving mechanism is used for driving the wire main body to the printing mechanism, and the printing mechanism is used for printing the wire main body to the substrate platform; the gluing mechanism is used for coating the fusion agent on the wire main body, and the curing mechanism is used for heating and curing the wire main body and the fusion agent.
