The device mainly prints the wire materials in a normal temperature state through the matching of the printing mechanism, the gluing mechanism and the curing mechanism, mixes and cures the fusion agent and the wire materials, expands usable wire material types and increases structural stability.

title_en: Meat penetrating device with crushed aggregates collection structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a meat penetrating device with a crushed aggregates collecting structure, which comprises a meat penetrating table and a movable hinge, wherein the top end of the meat penetrating table is provided with the crushed aggregates collecting mechanism, the middle part of the crushed aggregates collecting mechanism is provided with a meat penetrating pressing tool rest, the movable hinge is arranged at the rear end of the meat penetrating pressing tool rest, one side of the crushed aggregates collecting mechanism is provided with a meat penetrating hole frame, one side of the meat penetrating hole frame is provided with a meat penetrating mechanism, the meat penetrating mechanism comprises a pushing plate, a telescopic rod and a pneumatic tube, and one side of the pushing plate is provided with the telescopic rod. This wear meat device with crushed aggregates collection structure, telescopic link movable mounting is on pneumatic tube, starts pneumatic tube and can promote the telescopic link and drive the fly leaf and slide, and the fly leaf can pneumatic pressure extrusion wear meat fixed establishment and wear meat hole frame, can carry out the slip cluster to wearing meat fixed establishment and wearing meat hole frame meat cluster raw materials, wears meat device and is suitable for small-size machinery, reduces large-scale commercial assembly line meat cluster processing cost.

title_en: Planting plate and vertical farm with same
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a planting plate and a vertical farm with the planting plate. Wherein plant the dish, include: the cultivation tray body is provided with clamping pieces and clamping holes matched with the clamping pieces in a clamping manner in a one-to-one correspondence manner on two opposite sides of the cultivation tray body; the cultivation disk body is provided with at least two, wherein the clamping piece of one cultivation disk body is clamped in the clamping hole of the other cultivation disk body. In the embodiment of the utility model, the specific structure of the cultivation tray body is improved, a planting frame channel is not required to be additionally arranged, the space utilization rate of crop planting can be improved, and the yield per unit area is improved. Meanwhile, the planting personnel do not need to walk frequently, labor and effort are saved, and management operation is more convenient.

title_en: Cooling equipment for pig house
abstract_en: The utility model discloses cooling equipment for a pig house, which comprises a pig house main body: the pig house comprises a pig house body, and is characterized in that an air inlet is formed in the left side of the pig house body, an air outlet is formed in the right side of the pig house body, a fan is fixedly connected to the right side of the pig house body, a cooling unit is arranged on the left side of the pig house body and comprises a fixing plate, the fixing plate is fixedly connected to the left side of the pig house body, a fixing block is fixedly connected to the upper side of the fixing plate, a connecting plate is fixedly connected to the outer side of the fixing block, a spray head is fixedly connected to the right side of the connecting plate, and a mounting groove is formed in the upper side of the fixing plate. Through being provided with pig house main part, fixed plate, connecting plate, shower nozzle, installation piece, mounting groove, kicking block, cascade and bull stick one, be convenient for cool down to the air to shower nozzle blowout water smoke, when needs carry out moisturizing to the pig house, rotate the cascade and make things convenient for shower nozzle blowout water smoke entering pig house inside, easy operation.

title_en: Oxygenation device is used in crayfish breed
abstract_en: The utility model provides an oxygenation device for crayfish culture, which relates to the technical field of crayfish culture auxiliary equipment and comprises a main body, wherein an adjusting mechanism is arranged at the lower end of the main body, a supporting plate is arranged at the lower end of the main body, a connecting plate is arranged at the lower end of the supporting plate, a microporous pipe is arranged on the inner wall of the connecting plate, an air suction pipe is arranged at the upper end of the microporous pipe, an air pump is arranged at the upper end of the air suction pipe, the adjusting mechanism is installed by fixing a connecting rod, a fixing bolt is screwed out, the length of the adjusting rod can be adjusted at the moment, so that the height of the oxygenation device can be adjusted according to different culture environments, the adaptation is good, the filtering mechanism is installed on an air suction port of the air pump through the connecting pipe, when oxygen is supplied, and when the air passes through an active carbon filter screen, impurities in the air can be removed by the active carbon filter screen, and the impurities or harmful gases are prevented from being sucked.

title_en: Prestressed beam mould of suspended-ceiling-free roof
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a prestress beam die of a suspended ceiling-free roof, which comprises a pair of supporting plates, a beam main body die, a tensioning mechanism and stress bearing strips, wherein the beam main body die is of a transversely-arranged cuboid structure with a top surface being provided with a shell, the supporting plates are oppositely arranged on two sides of the top end of the beam main body die along two long side edges of the top end of the beam main body die in a wing plate structure, groove bodies are arranged in the middle of the bottom surface of the beam main body die along the length direction, the cross sections of the groove bodies are identical in shape and equal in size, the stress bearing strips are arranged in the groove bodies, the shape of the stress bearing strips is matched with the shape of the groove bodies, the tensioning mechanism is a steel strand tensioning device which is oppositely arranged, and the tensioning mechanisms are respectively arranged on two end surfaces of the beam main body die. According to the utility model, the purpose of embedding the lighting equipment is realized by arranging the groove body on the bottom surface of the beam body, and meanwhile, the stress bearing strips are arranged during pouring, so that the internal stress structure is more reasonable during integral pouring, and the lighting equipment cannot generate excessive structural influence with two vertical surfaces of the beam body after being installed.

title_en: Masterbatch processing apparatus for producing
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of production equipment, in particular to a master batch processing and producing device, which aims at solving the problems that the prior master batch processing and producing device can not preheat raw materials and reduces the production efficiency, and because different extrusion heads are needed, a plurality of screws are used for fixing the master batch processing and producing device and the replacement time is long in the traditional process of installation, the master batch processing and producing device currently proposes a scheme which comprises a base, wherein the upper surface of the base is fixedly connected with a motor and an extrusion cylinder respectively, the circumference of the extrusion cylinder is internally and rotatably connected with a second auger, the heating pipe is arranged in the extrusion cylinder, the extrusion head is arranged at one end of the extrusion cylinder, and in the utility model, the handle is rotated to a certain position, so that the two fixing plates respectively move to the middle, the steel wire rope is conveniently fastened, the extrusion head is tightly connected with the extrusion cylinder, the quick disassembly can be realized, the fan blows air into the feeding cylinder through the air pipe, the heating wire in the heating box changes cold air into hot air, the preheating of materials in the feeding cylinder is facilitated, and the time for processing, heating and melting of master batches can be reduced.

title_en: Fishing campstool unloading force supporting component
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fishing campstool unloading force supporting member, which relates to the technical field of campstool equipment and comprises a campstool leg main body, wherein the lower end of the campstool leg main body is fixedly connected with a mounting connecting rod, and the mounting connecting rod is in threaded connection with the upper end of an unloading force supporting component through a threaded groove formed in the lower end of the mounting connecting rod. According to the utility model, through the mutual matching among the mounting block, the circular rotating block, the threaded post II, the fixed joint block, the nut and the force-unloading supporting block, the adjustment process of the orientation angle of the annular supporting base can be realized according to the difference of the flatness of the ground in the using process of the device, so that the lower end of the annular supporting base can be attached to the ground, the uniformity of the pressure between the lower end of the campstool and the ground in the using process is ensured, the contact area between the lower end of the campstool and the ground in the using process is increased, and a certain force-unloading effect is achieved in the using process of the campstool.

title_en: Seed culture germinator with siphon mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a seed culture germinator with a siphon mechanism, which comprises a base and a baffle plate integrally formed with the base, wherein a housing is sleeved on the baffle plate, a plurality of placing grooves for placing culture containers are formed in the baffle plate, a siphon box with an open top is fixedly bonded on the surface of the top end of the housing, a liquid storage tank is fixedly arranged on the surface of the top end of the housing through a group of support plates, a liquid outlet mechanism for supplying liquid to the siphon box is arranged at the bottom end of the liquid storage tank, the siphon mechanism is arranged in the siphon box and consists of a fixed column and a movable column, the bottom end of the fixed column penetrates through the housing, a water collecting box is arranged under the bottom end of the fixed column, communicating pipes are welded and communicated on the side walls of the two ends of the water collecting box, and the bottom ends of the communicating pipes are welded and communicated with a liquid guide pipe. The utility model carries out nutrient solution adding operation through siphoning action, thus no manual intervention is needed, repeated operation can be continuously carried out, the use effect is good, and the popularization and the use are facilitated.

title_en: Silage crushing apparatus
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of silage processing, in particular to silage crushing equipment, which comprises a crusher, a feed inlet and a supporting frame, wherein the feed inlet is arranged on one side of the crusher, and the supporting frame is arranged below the crusher and also comprises a filtering component; the filter component comprises a filter plate, a pushing scraping plate, a connecting piece, a driving member and a storage member, wherein the filter plate is in sliding connection with the support frame and is positioned in the support frame, the pushing scraping plate is in sliding connection with the filter plate and is positioned on one side of the filter plate, the connecting piece is in rotary connection with the pushing scraping plate, the driving member is rotatably installed in the support frame, the storage member is connected with the filter plate, the automatic cleaning of impurities filtered on the surface of the screen plate through the set member is realized, the filter holes of the screen plate are prevented from being blocked by the impurities, and then the normal filtering efficiency and the whole crushing processing efficiency are guaranteed.

title_en: Heating structure for injection molding of automobile plastic
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a heating structure for injection molding of automobile plastics, which comprises a heating cylinder, wherein the upper end of the heating cylinder is provided with a sealing cover, the outside of the heating cylinder is provided with a heating mechanism, the sealing cover is provided with a stirring mechanism, the stirring end of the stirring mechanism is positioned in the heating cylinder, the outer side surface of the sealing cover is fixedly provided with a pair of plug boards, one side of each plug board is provided with a mounting groove, a limiting block is connected onto the mounting groove in a sliding manner, and a spring is arranged between the limiting block and the inner wall of the mounting groove; compared with the prior art, the scraper on the stirring mechanism can scrape the plastic adhered to the inner wall of the heating cylinder when the stirring mechanism is started, so that the hot-melt plastic is prevented from being adhered to the inner wall of the heating cylinder, and the scraper can be conveniently detached through the elastic limiting sealing cover, so that the whole heating structure is convenient to clean, and inconvenience in cleaning caused by the fact that the plastic is adhered to the inside of the heating structure is avoided when the heating structure is used.

title_en: Anti-collision ecological guardrail
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of guardrails, and particularly relates to an anti-collision ecological guardrail, which comprises a base, wherein an installation seat is fixedly arranged at the top end of the base, a groove is formed in the front side of the installation seat, an installation plate is fixedly arranged in the groove, a plurality of telescopic cavities are formed in the front side of the installation plate and are all connected with sliding rods, the sliding rods are arranged in a buffer assembly, the buffer assembly is provided with a plurality of parts on one side of a fixed seat, a placing groove is formed in the front side of the fixed seat, a shock absorbing plate is fixedly arranged in the placing groove, a protection plate is embedded in the fixed seat, and planting is arranged at the top end of the installation seat.

title_en: Compacting device for recycling waste plastic bottles
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a compacting device for recycling waste plastic bottles, which comprises a hollow base and a supporting frame, wherein the supporting frame is arranged at the top end of the hollow base, a sliding arm is arranged in the supporting frame in a sliding manner, a pressure circular plate is arranged at the bottom end of the sliding arm, a hollow sleeve is arranged at the top end of the hollow base below the pressure circular plate in a sliding manner, the hollow sleeve extends into the hollow base, a second servo motor is arranged in the hollow base at one side of the hollow sleeve, a pinion is arranged at the output end of the second servo motor, and a large gear is sleeved on the surface of the hollow sleeve at one side of the pinion. The utility model not only realizes convenient repeated compaction operation and multi-position compaction operation on the waste plastic bottles and facilitates uniform compaction by circumferential rotation, but also facilitates discharge of the compacted plastic bottles, and improves compaction uniformity and discharge convenience of the compaction device.

title_en: Water, fertilizer and medicine integrated high-pressure spraying system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of agricultural spraying, in particular to a water, fertilizer and pesticide integrated high-pressure spraying system which comprises a pesticide storage barrel, wherein a discharge hole is formed in the lower end face of the pesticide storage barrel, a liquid inlet pipe is fixedly connected to the lower end of the discharge hole, one end, far away from the pesticide storage barrel, of the liquid inlet pipe is fixedly connected with the liquid inlet end of an electric plunger pump, the liquid outlet end of the electric plunger pump is fixedly connected with a main pipe, a branch pipe is fixedly connected to the main pipe, the upper end of the branch pipe is fixedly connected with a shunt pipe, a switching valve is mounted on the shunt pipe, a hose is fixedly connected to the inside of the switching valve, and one end, far away from the switching valve, of the hose is fixedly connected with a spray gun. When the spraying and fertilizing operation is carried out on the fruit trees, the spraying gun is manually held for movement, so that the labor intensity of workers can be reduced, and meanwhile, the three purposes of watering, water and fertilizer application and pesticide spraying of the orchard can be met by connecting the hoses in a plurality of areas. The operation efficiency is improved, and a large amount of manpower, material resources and time are saved.

title_en: Hydraulic engineering slope protection structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hydraulic engineering slope protection structure, which relates to the field of hydraulic engineering and comprises a slope, wherein slope protection belts are paved outside the slope, fixing pieces positioned in the slope are movably installed at four corners of the slope protection belts, a compression cylinder is movably installed inside the slope protection belts, the fixing pieces comprise fixing plates, the bottoms of the fixing plates are fixedly connected with a panel and a compression edge, and the panel is movably clamped inside the slope. According to the slope protection device, the slope protection belt is paved on the slope and is fixed from four corners of the slope protection belt by using the fixing pieces, so that the slope protection belt is fixed on the slope by using the slope, meanwhile, the slope protection belt is stabilized by penetrating the slope protection belt into the slope by using the compression cylinder, corrosion is relieved by adopting a corrosion-resistant material through the slope protection belt, rainwater is shielded and vegetation is planted in a matched mode, the slope protection belt can be rooted outside the slope, and the dike is protected by the vegetation in the later period, so that the protection effect in the later period is guaranteed.

title_en: Oil groove structure of fried food
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of fryers and discloses a fried food oil tank structure, which comprises a shell with an opening at the upper end, wherein a baffle is fixedly connected in the shell, a filter plate is connected on the inner side wall of the shell above the baffle in a sliding manner, two electric push rods are symmetrically arranged at the outer bottom end of the shell, the telescopic ends of the electric push rods sequentially penetrate through the shell and the filter plate and upwards extend and are connected to the baffle, a rotating pipe is connected at the inner bottom end of the shell in a rotating manner, a rotating rod is connected in the rotating pipe in a sliding manner, the upper end of the rotating rod penetrates through the pipe orifice of the rotating pipe and sequentially penetrates through the baffle and the filter plate, a stirring frame is connected at the upper end of the rotating rod, and the stirring frame is arranged on the filter plate. According to the technical scheme, the shell, the partition plate, the filter plate, the electric push rod, the rotary pipe, the rotary rod, the stirring rack, the motor and the like are arranged to be matched with each other, so that food can be automatically turned, meanwhile, the food can be ejected out of oil, a user can take out the food conveniently, and the applicability of the device is improved.

title_en: Apple picking machine for apple planting
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of picking machines, in particular to an apple picking machine for apple planting, which comprises a vehicle body and a bracket. The truck body is provided with a loading plate, the loading plate is provided with a lifting frame, the lifting frame is driven to be connected with a mounting plate, the mounting plate is provided with a mechanical arm, the mechanical arm is connected with a shearing clamp, the bottom of the shearing clamp body is provided with a vertical plate, one side of the vertical plate, which is close to the shearing clamp, is symmetrical and is provided with two mutually matched bearing plates in a sliding manner, and the vertical plate is provided with a bidirectional module for driving the bearing plates on two sides to synchronously act. The support sets up on the loading board, and the inboard rotation of support sets up the pivot, sets up the rotatory motor of drive pivot on the support. The rotating shaft is symmetrically provided with fixing blocks, a hanging basket is rotationally connected between the fixing blocks at two sides, and a weighing assembly is arranged in the hanging basket. The utility model can realize automatic picking and boxing of apples, and automatically switches the paper boxes for carrying apples, thereby saving time and labor and improving the efficiency of picking apples.

title_en: Injection molding die for small household appliance shell
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an injection molding die for small household appliance shells, which comprises a lower die plate, wherein an upper die plate is arranged on the upper part of the lower die plate, a supporting seat is connected to the lower part of the lower die plate through bolts, special cavities for injection molding of the small household appliance shells are formed in the upper die plate and the lower die plate, a refrigeration mounting box is fixedly connected to the right side of the supporting seat, and a water tank is arranged in the refrigeration mounting box. The utility model has the advantages that the cooling system is integrated, the cooling sheet is arranged in the rectangular through hole, the aluminum sheet radiator and the fan are matched, and the heat conduction silicone grease layer is matched, in particular, the cooling time of the mold is obviously shortened, the production cycle efficiency is improved, the thermal deformation problem in the injection molding process is effectively solved, the dimensional stability and the surface smoothness of the product are ensured, and the service life of the mold is prolonged.

title_en: Flower groove for landscape
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a flower receptacle for garden landscapes, and relates to the technical field of garden landscapes. This flower receptacle for landscape, including flower receptacle, grid board and diversion structure, the inside fixed mounting of flower receptacle has the division board, and the division board is with the internal partition of flower receptacle become to store the chamber and plant the chamber, has seted up three sets of water conservancy diversion holes that just are horizontal equidistance and arrange on the division board, and the grid board sets up in the inside of flower receptacle, and the grid board is located and plants the intracavity, and the mouth has all been seted up to the both sides of grid board, and diversion structure sets up in the water conservancy diversion intracavity, and the both ends of diversion structure extend to respectively store the chamber and plant the chamber. This flower receptacle for landscape can be when raining or when watering automatic with planting the unnecessary rainwater water conservancy diversion of intracavity and collect to the storage intracavity, is convenient for simultaneously when dry weather automatic with the water of storing the intracavity to planting the soil supplementation of intracavity, makes it need not to its moisturizing in the certain period, has reduced the frequency of moisturizing, can also reduce the damage that transplanting caused plant root system.

title_en: Temperature feedback system for injection molding process of sealing ring
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of sealing ring injection molding equipment, in particular to a temperature feedback system in the sealing ring injection molding process, which comprises an injection molding assembly, a temperature sensing assembly and a control display assembly, wherein the temperature sensing assembly is used for detecting the temperature of a sealing ring raw material transmission position, the injection molding assembly comprises an upper die, a lower die and a material conveying assembly, the opposite ends of the upper die and the lower die are provided with material conveying passages, the temperature sensing assembly comprises a first temperature sensor and a second temperature sensor, the first temperature sensor and the second temperature sensor are respectively arranged on the upper die and the lower die, one end parts of the first temperature sensor and the second temperature sensor extend to the material conveying passage, the first temperature sensor is used for detecting the temperature of the sealing ring raw material transmission passage, the second temperature sensor is used for detecting the temperature of the sealing ring forming passage, and the first temperature sensor and the second temperature sensor are respectively and electrically connected with the control display assembly.

title_en: Broken material silk kneading device in fodder harvesting processor
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of agricultural mechanical equipment, and particularly discloses a broken material wire kneading device in a feed harvesting and processing machine, which comprises a machine case, a conveying device and a wire kneading cylinder, wherein two ends of the conveying device are respectively connected with the machine case and the wire kneading cylinder, one side of the machine case, which is far away from the conveying device, is provided with a feeding port, the bottom of the feeding port is provided with a longitudinal cutter which extends into the machine case, the machine case is rotationally provided with a cutting-off cutter holder, a plurality of cutting-off cutters are arranged on the cutting-off cutter holder and are fixedly arranged in an inclined manner, the wire kneading cylinder is rotationally provided with the wire kneading cutter holder, a row of wire kneading blades are rotationally arranged on a plurality of cutter bars which are uniformly arranged in the circumferential direction, and a plurality of convex racks are arranged at intervals on the lower half part of the inner wall of the wire kneading cylinder; the crushing and wire kneading device disclosed by the utility model is matched with the existing silage harvester, so that a plurality of series of processing procedures such as silage harvesting, crushing, stirring, wire kneading and the like can be realized, and the on-line processing of silage is realized.

title_en: Tipping bucket device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tipping bucket device, which comprises a base, wherein the base is arranged on external equipment, a fixing mechanism is arranged on the base, the fixing mechanism comprises a rotating mechanism, a driving tooth, a fixing plate, fixing teeth, a push rod, a fixing sleeve, a clamping piece, a push spring, an annular sleeve and a collision mechanism, the rotating mechanism is arranged on the base, the driving tooth is connected to the rotating mechanism in a matching way, the fixing plate is arranged on the base, the push rod is arranged on the fixing teeth, the fixing teeth are connected to the fixing plate in a sliding way, the fixing mechanism can stably fix the tipping bucket at a plurality of angles, so that the accuracy and the safety of operation are ensured, the tipping bucket is allowed to be stably locked at a required specific position through the engagement of the push rod and the fixing teeth, which is critical to loading and unloading crops, and the fixing mode not only increases the flexibility of operation, but also reduces the safety risk caused by accidental movement of the tipping bucket.

title_en: T-shaped pile die
abstract_en: The utility model provides a T-shaped pile die, which comprises a head end die and a support column die, wherein the head end die comprises two end dies, the lower parts of the two end dies of the head end die and a bottom die form a panel die, the upper parts of the two end dies of the head end die form a support column die, the two end dies of the head end die and the bottom die form a through injection molding cavity, the left side and the right side of the panel die are respectively provided with an S-shaped component in a relative way, the S-shaped components at the two ends are mutually matched in shape, the two ends of the upper part of the support column die are respectively provided with a splicing component mutually matched with the S-shaped components in shape, the two end dies of the head end die and the tail end die are respectively provided with at least one hinged opening point, the die can be quickly demoulded through ingenious design of the hinged opening points, and the spliced components of the S-shaped components and the support column die can mutually match the panel part of the T-shaped pile produced by the die to obtain more splicing modes to adapt to different application scenes.

title_en: Evaporate and press aerated concrete board production with cutting device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of concrete slab production and discloses a cutting device for autoclaved aerated concrete slab production, which comprises a slab body, wherein a processing table is arranged below the slab body, pressing blocks are arranged on the left side and the right side of the upper end face of the slab body, a connecting rod is fixedly arranged at the upper end of each pressing block, and a moving assembly is arranged at one end, far away from each pressing block, of each connecting rod. According to the utility model, through the cooperation among the plate body, the pressing block, the moving assembly, the transverse electric push rod and the vertical electric push rod, the effect of adjusting the position of the pressing block is realized by utilizing the arrangement of the moving assembly, the transverse electric push rod and the vertical electric push rod, the problem of inconvenient adjustment of the adjusting rod in the technical content is effectively solved, and the mode of mechanically adjusting the position of the pressing block by adopting the moving assembly, the transverse electric push rod and the vertical electric push rod is adopted, so that the workload of a worker for positioning the plate body is reduced, and the plate body positioning efficiency is improved.

title_en: Energy-saving particle rubber material drying device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of rubber processing, in particular to an energy-saving particle rubber material drying device, which comprises a frame and a drying box, wherein the drying box is of a barrel-shaped structure, a hollow shaft is arranged at the center of two axial ends of the drying box, the hollow shaft is communicated with the inside of the drying box, the hollow shaft is rotationally connected to the frame through a bearing, and a feeding door and a discharging door are arranged on the side wall of the drying box; the hollow shaft of drying cabinet one end rotates and is connected with the waste gas and advances the pipe, and the hollow shaft of drying cabinet other end rotates and is connected with the waste gas exit tube, all sealing connection between waste gas advances pipe, waste gas exit tube and the corresponding hollow shaft, waste gas advances the union coupling to rubber vulcanization hot box, the waste gas exit tube is connected to exhaust treatment facility. According to the energy-saving particle rubber material drying device, the particle rubber material is dried by using high-temperature waste gas generated by rubber vulcanization, an additional heat source is not needed, the cost is greatly reduced, and the drying effect is good.

title_en: Landscape greening column with water collecting function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a landscape greening column with a water collecting function, which comprises a bottom plate, a support and greening columns, and is technically characterized in that the support is provided with a hollow water collecting cavity, a plurality of supporting wheel assemblies are uniformly arranged on the upper edge of the support around the central line of the hollow water collecting cavity, the greening columns are hollow columns, the hollow columns are sleeved outside the support, annular horizontal supporting plates are arranged on the inner peripheral walls of the hollow columns, the annular horizontal supporting plates are arranged on the supporting wheel assemblies, a transmission gear ring is arranged at the lower end of the hollow columns, greening vegetation covers the outer peripheral surfaces of the hollow columns, the upper ends of the hollow columns are provided with filter plates, the centers of the upper surfaces of the filter plates are provided with water pumps, annular liquid distributing pipes are fixed at the edges of the filter plates, the lower ends of the water inlet pipes of the water pumps are inserted into the hollow water collecting cavity, the liquid outlet pipes are communicated with the annular liquid distributing pipes, and a plurality of water spraying holes facing the upper edges of the greening vegetation are uniformly arranged on the outer peripheral surfaces of the annular liquid distributing pipes. The utility model solves the problem of low vegetation coverage rate of the greening columns and solves the problem of vegetation watering and maintenance.

title_en: Flowerpot capable of automatically watering downwards
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of flowerpots and discloses an automatic lower watering flowerpot which comprises a flowerpot, wherein a watering controller is arranged at the lower end of the flowerpot, a water tank is arranged at the lower end of the watering controller, a water pump intelligently controlled by the watering controller is arranged in the watering controller, a water inlet of the water pump is connected with a water suction pipe, the lower end of the water suction pipe extends to the bottom of the water tank, a water outlet of the water pump is connected with a water supply pipe, the upper end of the water supply pipe extends to the upper part of the flowerpot, and a pipe cap is arranged at the upper end of the water supply pipe. When the flowerpot is used, the water pump can be controlled by the watering controller to automatically pump water in the water tank into the flowerpot at regular intervals so as to water flowers and trees in the flowerpot, and the watering is stopped after a certain amount of water reaches, so that a large amount of time can be saved, and different flowers and trees can be subjected to fine and scientific nursing, so that the planted flowers and trees are easy, simple and interesting. But also keeps the overall appearance of the flowerpot and the flowers and the trees.

title_en: Pesticide spraying device for vegetable planting
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pesticide spraying device for vegetable planting, which comprises a guide rail arranged at the top end of a greenhouse, wherein the inner wall of the guide rail is connected with a movable slide block in a sliding manner, the movable slide block is in transmission connection with a driving mechanism, the driving mechanism is used for driving the movable slide block to move in the greenhouse, the bottom end of the movable slide block is connected with a lifting water component, the bottom end of the lifting water component is provided with a spraying pipe, the pesticide spraying device is related to the technical field of pesticide spraying devices, the driving mechanism is used for driving the spraying pipe to move in the greenhouse, so that the pesticide spraying efficiency is effectively improved, the spraying is uniform, personnel are not used in the greenhouse in the pesticide spraying process, the health of personnel is avoided, the pesticide spraying device is safer and more reliable to use, the pesticide can be configured by arranging the spraying component, and the pesticide can be stirred in the pesticide spraying process, so that pesticide precipitation is avoided.

title_en: Agricultural greenhouse with convenient water supply
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of agricultural greenhouses, and discloses an agricultural greenhouse with convenient water supply, which comprises an adjusting device, wherein the right end of the adjusting device is provided with a water supply device, the adjusting device comprises a greenhouse main body, the inside of the upper end of the greenhouse main body is fixedly connected with a fixing frame, and the inside of the fixing frame is in sliding connection with two vertically distributed guide rails. This convenient green house of feedwater drives telescopic link through pulling the locating piece, the locating piece extends to drive spring and flexible pipe and be stretched, rotate the locating piece, drive the turning block through the telescopic link and rotate, change the horizontal plane angle of shower nozzle, open the shower nozzle, draw the nutrition water in the water tank and pass through flexible pipe transmission to shower nozzle blowout, carry out the feedwater operation in the green house, the pulling locating piece drives the connecting block and removes, the connecting block slides on two guide rails, and drive the guide rail and remove on the mount, thereby reach the manual feedwater of being convenient for, adapt to the effect that greenhouse planting district changed.

title_en: A crushing apparatus for meat pretreatment
abstract_en: The application discloses crushing equipment for meat pretreatment, which belongs to the technical field of meat processing and comprises a crushing cylinder, wherein a gear seat capable of vertically reciprocating is arranged on one side above the crushing cylinder, a cylinder cover is rotatably arranged above the gear seat, a bottom cover for sealing is arranged below the crushing cylinder, and a chassis capable of vertically reciprocating is arranged inside the crushing cylinder. The crushing cutter is installed on the tube cover, can take out in the crushing section of thick bamboo along with the tube cover together, make things convenient for later stage clearance and take meat food, be rotatable lift's structure between tube cover and the crushing section of thick bamboo, make crushing cutter can move aside, avoid its fish tail user, and install the chassis in the bottom of crushing section of thick bamboo, the folding lever of its accessible below realizes going up and down, make the meat food that is smashed can rise a take altitude, conveniently take, and the mid-section of thick bamboo rotates and installs the impeller, through its rotation, can drive meat food and rotate together, improve crushing effect.

title_en: Be used for tablet device for oatmeal production and processing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of oatmeal production and processing, in particular to a tabletting device for oatmeal production and processing, which comprises a box body, two tabletting rollers arranged in the box body at intervals, a feeding adjusting component arranged in the box body, a cleaning discharging component arranged on one side of the box body, and a drying component arranged on the cleaning discharging component, wherein the cleaning discharging component comprises a discharging shell arranged on one side of the box body and communicated with the box body, a discharging conveyor belt arranged in the discharging shell, and a scraping plate arranged on the bottom side of the inner wall of the discharging shell, the drying component comprises two first mounting plates arranged on the top side of the inner wall of the discharging shell, two second mounting plates respectively arranged between the discharging shell and the inner wall of the box body, and a plurality of electric heating pipes arranged between the two first mounting plates and between the two second mounting plates.

title_en: Polyurethane raw material preheating and conveying device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of raw material conveying, in particular to a polyurethane raw material preheating and conveying device, which comprises a conveying tank and a top cover, wherein the top cover is positioned above the conveying tank, and further comprises a conveying assembly, a heat preservation assembly, a heating assembly and a feeding assembly, the conveying assembly comprises a motor, a rotating shaft and a spiral conveying plate, the motor is fixedly connected with the top cover and positioned at the top of the top cover, the rotating shaft is connected with the motor, the spiral conveying plate is fixedly connected with the rotating shaft, a feeding port is arranged at the bottom of the conveying tank, the heat preservation assembly is connected with the conveying tank, the heating assembly is connected with the top cover, and the feeding assembly is connected with the conveying tank.

title_en: Waste plastic smashes with throwing material device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a feeding device for crushing waste plastics, which comprises a first box body, wherein a second box body and a third box body are fixedly arranged at the top of the first box body, two groups of crushing assemblies are arranged in the first box body, one end of one group of crushing assemblies is fixedly connected with a first motor, the first motor is fixedly connected with the first box body, the waste plastics are fed into the third box body, when the waste plastics need to be crushed, the second motor is started to drive a moving plate to move left and right, and when the moving plate moves left and right, the moving assembly is pushed to move, so that the waste plastics alternately discharge, the fed amount is easy to control, the practicability of the device is enhanced, the waste plastics needing to be crushed are fed into the third box body, after the feeding is finished, a discharging pipe is closed, the waste plastics can move down into the second box body along a guide plate, so that after the feeding is finished, the discharging pipe is closed, smoke dust cannot run into air, and air is polluted.

title_en: Water-saving irrigation device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water-saving irrigation device, which relates to the technical field of water-saving irrigation devices and comprises a fixed seat, wherein one side of the top end of the fixed seat is fixedly connected with a control structure, the middle part of the top end of the fixed seat is fixedly connected with a liquid storage barrel, the inside of the liquid storage barrel is fixedly connected with a motor box, the inside of the motor box is fixedly connected with a servo motor, the output end of the servo motor is in spline connection with a transmission rod, one end of the transmission rod is fixedly connected with a stirring blade, the other side of the top end of the fixed seat is fixedly connected with two support plates, the inner wall of each support plate is fixedly connected with a sliding block, one side of each sliding block is fixedly connected with an irrigation assembly, and the middle of each support plate is fixedly connected with a hydraulic box.

title_en: Net tool capable of being rapidly stored
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of netting gear, and provides a netting gear capable of being rapidly stored, which comprises a fishing net, a circular ring, a chassis, a damping rotating shaft, rotating blocks, limiting frames, long rods, springs and rotating wheels, wherein the top of the fishing net is fixedly connected with the circular ring, the bottom of the fishing net is fixedly provided with the chassis, the damping rotating shaft is rotated on the bottom surface of the chassis, the rotating blocks are arranged on the surfaces of the damping rotating shaft, the limiting frames are arranged on two sides of the chassis, the long rods are arranged on the surfaces of the limiting frames, the utility model discloses a fishing net, including chassis, stock, spring, limiting frame, chassis sliding connection, fixedly connected with spring between limiting frame and the chassis, one side of limiting frame rotates there is the runner, during in-service use, through setting up fishing net, ring, chassis, damping pivot, commentaries on classics piece, limiting frame, stock, spring and runner, make fishing net fold back both ends can be spacing each other to the condition that scatters can not appear in carrying the in-process, make things convenient for subsequent accomodating operation, do benefit to in-service use.

title_en: Flue-cured tobacco topping and bud picking device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a flue-cured tobacco topping and bud picking device, which relates to the technical field of tobacco planting and comprises a handle and a cutting assembly, wherein a spraying assembly is arranged at one end of the handle, the cutting assembly is arranged in the middle of the spraying assembly, the top of the cutting assembly is connected with an upper shield assembly, and the bottom of the cutting assembly is connected with a lower shield assembly. This flue-cured tobacco is beaten top and is smeared bud device, through being provided with and tailors the subassembly, when can improving the operating efficiency of manual tailorring to the flue-cured tobacco, the cooperation sprays the use of subassembly, can spray the insecticide of insecticidal pest killing in step to will be cut up on the leaf of smeared bud and other leaf and insect egg carry out synchronous disinfection, and lower guard shield subassembly and fastening bolt's use, when both can prevent to tailorring the subassembly and beaten top and smeared bud, prevent the splash of tobacco leaf piece, can restrict the operation scope again, prevent to cause unnecessary processing to the tobacco leaf on every side.

title_en: Forestry machine that spouts medicine direction and position can be adjusted carries to target device of spouting medicine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of pesticide spraying, and discloses a forestry machine-carried targeting pesticide spraying device with adjustable pesticide spraying direction and position, which comprises a fixed plate, wherein the bottom of the fixed plate is provided with an adjusting mechanism, the fixed plate is provided with a pesticide spraying mechanism, the adjusting mechanism comprises a cross rod, the left side fixedly connected with first motor of horizontal pole, the adjustment tank has been seted up to the bottom of horizontal pole, be provided with two-way lead screw in the adjustment tank, the surface of two-way lead screw positive and negative screw thread is threaded connection respectively has the movable block, the bottom of movable block is fixedly connected with free bearing respectively, be provided with the regulation pole in the free bearing respectively. This forestry machine carries to target and spouts medicine device possesses the function of adjusting and spouts medicine direction and spouts medicine position, has guaranteed greatly to spout the medicine effect.

title_en: Quick belt cleaning device of cold bright chicken
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of chicken processing, in particular to a quick cleaning device for chilled fresh chicken, which is used for quickly cleaning the chicken through a cleaning device, transporting the chicken through a conveying device, blowing off liquid drops on the surface of the chicken through a blowing device, reducing the residual quantity of liquid on the surface of the chicken, driving the conveying device to vibrate through a vibrating device, so that the liquid drops on the surface and the bottom of the chicken drop, eliminating the residual liquid on the surface of the chicken independently by an operator, reducing the labor intensity of the operator and improving the practicability of the device.

title_en: Livestock and poultry hoof medicated bath device with fixed knot constructs
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of veterinary equipment, and provides a livestock and poultry hoof medicated bath device with a fixed structure, which comprises a main body and a clamping groove; clamping grooves are formed in two sides of the bottom of the main body, a storage box is arranged in the clamping grooves, clamping blocks are arranged on two sides of the storage box, and a cleaning structure is arranged on one side of the main body. According to the utility model, the cleaning structure is arranged, the motor is started to enable the hairbrush to rotate at a constant speed so as to clean the hooves of livestock and poultry, and meanwhile, the multi-group meshing gears drive the bidirectional threaded rod to rotate, so that the scraping plate is driven to enable scraps accumulated in the main body due to the brushing of the hooves of the livestock and poultry to fall into the storage box, and therefore, the cleaning of the livestock and poultry hooves and the inside of the main body is facilitated, and the purposes of cleaning the livestock and poultry hooves and saving energy are achieved.

title_en: Upper cover plate for fish tank and fish tank adopting upper cover plate
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an upper cover plate for a fish tank and the fish tank adopting the upper cover plate, which comprises an upper cover plate, wherein a window is formed in the upper cover plate, a transparent plate body is arranged at the window, and a lighting lamp is arranged on the periphery of the window on the bottom surface of the upper cover plate. By integrating the illuminating lamp on the upper cover plate, enough illumination can be provided for organisms in the fish tank, the growth and nutrient metabolism requirements of organisms such as fishes, pasture and the like are met, and the balance and stability of an ecological system are maintained.

title_en: Plastic mold with airflow type auxiliary cleaning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a plastic mold with an airflow type auxiliary cleaning device, which relates to the technical field of plastic molds and comprises a cleaning mechanism, wherein an adjusting mechanism is fixedly connected to the outer wall of the cleaning mechanism, a base is fixedly connected to the bottom end of the adjusting mechanism, a plurality of groups of guide rods are fixedly connected to the top end of the base, a lower mold plate is fixedly sleeved on the outer wall of each guide rod, and an upper mold plate positioned above each guide rod is slidably sleeved on the outer wall of each guide rod. According to the utility model, the air flow is pushed by the fan to pass through the filter cotton and enter the air inlet cover, in the process that the air passes through the filter cotton, dust and other particles in the air are filtered, so that the air flow is prevented from driving the particles to strike the inside of the die, the inner wall of the die is prevented from being scratched, and the wavy filter cotton can provide a larger surface area, so that the air can pass through the filter cotton more smoothly.

title_en: Agricultural planting is with fixed point device that waters
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fixed-point watering device for agricultural planting, which comprises a pipeline, wherein a plurality of groups of corrugated pipes and T-shaped pipes are arranged at the pipeline, one ends and the other ends of the T-shaped pipes are respectively connected with the corresponding corrugated pipes, one end of each group of corrugated pipes is connected with the pipeline, one end and the other end of each pipeline are fixedly connected with a first cross rod, and two groups of first cross rods are connected with a second cross rod in a sliding manner. The utility model can pull out the whole length of the device, adjust the distance between the T-shaped pipes, and to a certain extent, the T-shaped pipes drive the hose and the spray head to adjust the transverse position, thereby expanding the range of the spray head which can be inserted into the ground, facilitating the stable supply of the transported water to plants for absorption according to the actual plant watering area, and realizing the relatively flexible fixed-point watering operation.

title_en: Injection mold and injection magnet
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an injection mold and an injection magnet, wherein the injection magnet is provided with a first surface and a second surface which are opposite in the thickness direction of the injection magnet, and the first surface of the injection magnet is provided with a plurality of combination grooves. The injection molding magnet is formed by injection molding of an injection mold, the injection mold comprises a top clamping plate, a bottom clamping plate, a front template, a rear template, a cavity and a core, wherein the front template is arranged on the bottom surface of the top clamping plate, the rear template is arranged on the top surface of the bottom clamping plate, the front template is arranged right above the rear template, the cavity is arranged on the front template, the core is arranged on the rear template, and a containing cavity formed by combining the cavity with the core is matched with the shape of the injection molding magnet. The utility model gets rid of the problem that the relative dislocation sliding between the plastic body and the injection molding magnet possibly occurs in the using process of the workpiece formed by the injection molding of the traditional injection molding magnet, thereby leading to the technical defect that the workpiece is invalid in practical application.

title_en: Plastic injection molding water chiller capable of recycling heat
abstract_en: The utility model provides a plastic injection molding water chiller capable of recycling heat, which relates to the technical field of water chillers and comprises a water chiller body, wherein heat dissipation net plates are arranged on two sides of the water chiller body, a convenient disassembly device is arranged between the heat dissipation net plates and the water chiller body, exhaust fans are symmetrically arranged at the top of the water chiller body, a water inlet pipe and a water outlet pipe are symmetrically arranged on one side of the water chiller, and connecting pipes are arranged on the outer surfaces of the water inlet pipe and the water outlet pipe.

title_en: A constant temperature equipment for fermentation cylinder
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of fermentation production equipment, and particularly relates to a constant temperature device for a fermentation tank, which comprises a fermentation tank body, wherein two heating wires are fixedly connected to the side wall of the fermentation tank body, the two heating wires are oppositely arranged, two water pumps are fixedly connected to the side wall of the fermentation tank body, the two water pumps are oppositely arranged, a water inlet pipe is fixedly connected to the side wall of the water pump, a water storage pipe is fixedly connected to the bottom of the water pump, the two water storage pipes are fixedly connected between the two heating wires, the water storage pipe is transmitted to the inside of the fermentation tank body through temperature control outside the fermentation tank body, the heating and cooling effects can be performed under the condition of unstable temperature, the temperature inside the fermentation tank body can be kept stable through the cooperation of the heating wires and the water storage pipe, and the temperature inside the fermentation tank body can be kept balanced, so that a constant temperature fermentation environment can be effectively provided, and energy sources can be effectively utilized through the heating wires and the water storage pipe.

title_en: Grass chopping mechanism of mower
abstract_en: The utility model provides a grass breaking mechanism of a grass cutter. The grass smashing mechanism of the mower comprises a mower body, a sliding plate is slidably mounted at the bottom of the mower body, a cylinder is fixedly mounted in the mower body, the top end of the cylinder extends out of the mower body, an auger is mounted in the cylinder in a rotating mode, a first motor is fixedly mounted at the top end of the cylinder, an output shaft of the first motor extends into the cylinder and is fixedly connected with the auger, a grinding mechanism is fixedly mounted in the mower body, and a third pipeline is fixedly mounted on one side of the cylinder, which is close to the grinding mechanism. The grass breaking mechanism of the mower provided by the utility model has the advantages of convenience in use, capability of cleaning the cutting blade and repeated cutting and collection of larger weeds.

title_en: Plant seedling raising device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of vegetation seedling raising, and particularly relates to a vegetation seedling raising device which comprises a shell, wherein a water collecting tank is arranged at the top of the shell, a plurality of water leakage holes are uniformly formed in the bottom of the shell, a separation component is arranged in the shell, the bottom of the water collecting tank is communicated with the bottom of the shell through a plurality of connecting hoses, and a filter piece is arranged in the water collecting tank. The inside of the shell is divided into independent spaces by the separation assembly, so that seedlings can be taken out individually, the problem that root systems of the seedlings are mutually involved and torn up when taken out is solved, meanwhile, water is injected into the water collecting tank, and the water can be directly fed into the root systems of the seedlings by the aid of the connecting hose, so that the survival rate of the seedlings is further improved.

title_en: Rotary naan roasting furnace
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of crusty pancake baking furnaces, in particular to a rotary crusty pancake baking furnace. The technical scheme includes that the baking inner container comprises a bottom cabinet and a baking inner container, a protective shell is fixedly arranged at the top of the bottom cabinet, a plurality of groups of external heating rods are fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the protective shell at equal intervals, a plurality of groups of internal heating rods are fixedly arranged in the baking inner container, a rotating motor is fixedly arranged at the top of the inside of the bottom cabinet, and the output end of the rotating motor penetrates through the bottom cabinet and is fixedly connected with the bottom of the baking inner container. The device increases convenience of people when attaching the crusty pancake by combining various structures, reduces safety, improves efficiency and quality of baking the crusty pancake by the crusty pancake baking furnace by double heating, can store and proofing dough after the people knead the crusty pancake baking, avoids proofing the dough by external equipment when the people bake the crusty pancake, and solves the problem of proofing dough by teachers.

title_en: Food pelleting device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a food pelleting device for sesame pellet food processing, relates to the technical field of food processing equipment, and solves the problem that pelleting equipment in the prior art is easy to adhere in the pelleting process. The utility model comprises a frame, wherein a first hopper is arranged on the frame, a spiral extrusion mechanism is arranged at the lower opening of the first hopper, a cutting mechanism is arranged at the discharge port of the spiral extrusion mechanism, a rolling ball slideway corresponding to the discharge port of the spiral extrusion mechanism is arranged on the frame, a blowing component corresponding to the rolling ball slideway is arranged on the frame, the blowing component is connected with a second hopper, and a material tray corresponding to the lower end of the rolling ball slideway is arranged on the frame. The utility model not only avoids the adhesion of sesame ball raw materials to the forming part, but also can form balls with uniform texture by rolling the sesame ball raw materials, has simple and reliable structure, and can further improve the look and feel of the formed ball food by adhering sesame on the surface by rolling.

title_en: Raw material mixing device for high polymer material production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of high polymer material production and processing, and discloses a raw material mixing device for high polymer material production, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein the top of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with two side vertical plates, the side surfaces of the side vertical plates are provided with rotating mechanisms, and when raw materials are required to be discharged, the electric push rod is opened, the electric push rod can drive the bearing plate to move downwards so that the bearing plate does not support the mixing box any more, then the servo motor is opened, the fixing frame can drive the mixing box to rotate, so that the mixing box is inclined, the raw materials can be discharged rapidly, the raw material discharging efficiency is improved, the interior of the mixing box is convenient to clean, convenience is brought to the next use of the mixing box, and the practicability of the device is improved.

title_en: Feeding assembly of plastic extruder
abstract_en: The application provides a feeding component of a plastic extruder, and belongs to the technical field of plastic extruders. This feeding subassembly of plastic extruder includes feed mechanism and strengthens supporting mechanism, feed mechanism includes plastic extruder body, feeder hopper, adds a storehouse section of thick bamboo and connecting piece, the feeder hopper intercommunication set up in plastic extruder body top, strengthen supporting mechanism and include bracing piece, connecting plate and setting element, through setting up plastic extruder body, feeder hopper, add a storehouse section of thick bamboo and connecting piece, utilize the increase and decrease mode of adding a storehouse section of thick bamboo to adjust the feeding bucket capacity to need not the whole feeder hopper of dismouting, raise the efficiency when practicing thrift the cost, connect the feeder hopper and add a storehouse section of thick bamboo through the connecting piece and conveniently carry out quick assembly disassembly, through setting up bracing piece, connecting plate and setting element, utilize bracing piece and connecting plate to support to add a storehouse section of thick bamboo, share the loading, alleviate the pressure to thin mouthful junction, guarantee life.

title_en: Resin tank and photo-curing 3D printing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a resin tank and a photo-curing 3D printing device, wherein the resin tank comprises a resin tank main body for accommodating photosensitive resin; the non-stick coating is arranged on the inner surface of the resin tank main body and used for preventing the photosensitive resin from sticking to the inner surface of the resin tank main body. In this way, resin residue in the resin tank can be reduced and the ease of cleaning of the resin tank can be improved.

title_en: Rubber calender for tire production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of rubber calenders for producing tires, in particular to a rubber calender for producing tires, which can effectively improve the automation degree of rubber calender equipment and the use convenience of the equipment; including the base, fixed mounting has calender equipment on the base, servo electric jar output fixedly connected with connecting plate, two sets of articulated seats down of fixedly connected with of connecting plate top symmetry, two sets of fixed plates of fixedly connected with of symmetry on the calender equipment, two sets of guide bars of symmetry between two sets of fixed plates, two sets of drive slat bottoms are articulated with articulated seat under two sets of respectively, two sets of locating plate bottoms are all fixed and are equipped with the location inserted bar, two sets of guide slide tops all are equipped with the slotted hole, two sets of location inserted bars are installed respectively on two sets of slotted holes, all the spiro union has the knob bolt with the slotted hole intercommunication on two sets of guide slide, two sets of knob bolt ends are tightly with two sets of location inserted bar front ends top respectively.

title_en: Blood sampling tube production fast-assembling mould frame
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a quick-assembly die carrier for producing blood collection tubes, which comprises an upper die plate, a middle die plate, a quick-assembly die plate and a bottom die plate, wherein the upper die plate moves up and down along guide posts, the top of the middle die plate is provided with the guide posts, the side wall of the middle die plate is provided with movable positioning pins for inserting the quick-assembly die plate, the side wall of the quick-assembly die plate is provided with fixing pins for inserting the bottom die plate, and the bottom of the bottom die plate is provided with fastening bolts.

title_en: Rice processing equipment capable of controlling feeding
abstract_en: The utility model provides rice processing equipment capable of controlling feeding, which relates to the field of rice processing and comprises a processing equipment main body, wherein a feeding pipe is arranged on one side of the top of the processing equipment main body, a feeding mechanism is further arranged on the top of the processing equipment main body, the feeding mechanism comprises a mounting bottom plate fixedly arranged on the top of the processing equipment main body, a plurality of supporting rods are arranged on the top of the mounting bottom plate in an array mode, the tops of the supporting rods are commonly connected with a feeding hopper, a first material tray is arranged at the bottom of the inner side of the feeding hopper, the bottom of the first material tray penetrates out of the bottom of the feeding hopper, and the first material tray and a second material tray are driven to rotate at constant speed through a motor.

title_en: Drip irrigation tape laying device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a drip irrigation tape laying device, and belongs to the technical field of water-saving irrigation. According to the utility model, the guide mechanism is arranged on the movable trolley and comprises the connecting rod and the guide pipe, when the coiled drip irrigation tape is required to be paved, the drip irrigation tape wound on the reel is erected on the support frame of the movable trolley, one end of the drip irrigation tape paved passes through the guide pipe and is fixed by a worker, then the movable trolley is pushed by the worker to move, the reel wound with the drip irrigation tape rotates on the movable trolley, so that the drip irrigation tape paved is realized, the drip irrigation tape is prevented from being manually pulled, the guide pipe guides and limits the paving surface of the drip irrigation tape in the paving process, and the drip irrigation tape is prevented from overturning, so that the drip irrigation tape is distorted and later use is influenced.

title_en: Novel ammonia sugar calcium chondroitin sulfate tablet coating equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to novel coating equipment for a calcium-amino-sulfate chondroitin sulfate tablet, which relates to the technical field of the calcium-amino-sulfate chondroitin sulfate tablet and comprises a storage box, wherein a stirring cavity is formed in one side of the inside of the storage box, a spraying coating component is arranged on the top surface of the inside of the stirring cavity, a drying component is arranged at the top of the storage box, a stirring rotating component is arranged on one side of the storage box, and an inlet port is formed in the front surface of the storage box.

title_en: Water-saving greening landscape table for landscape architecture
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of landscaping facilities, in particular to a water-saving greening view table for landscape gardens, which comprises a bottom table and four water guide cylinders, wherein vertical upward decorative columns are arranged at four corners of the top surface of the bottom table, planting cavities are arranged below the inner parts of the four decorative columns, water collecting tanks which are integrally rectangular frame-shaped are arranged above the four decorative columns, one ends of the outer parts of the four water guide cylinders are respectively inserted into the four corners of the water collecting tanks, the other ends of the four water guide cylinders are obliquely upwards towards the center, a top seat is arranged between the upper positions of the four water guide cylinders, and photovoltaic plates are arranged on the top surfaces of the top seats. The drip irrigation device has the advantages that drip irrigation heads are arranged below four corners of the water collecting tank and above the planting cavity, collected rainwater can be used for drip irrigation of plants, and the collected rainwater can be discharged from a valve on one side outside the water collecting tank, so that the collected rainwater can be conveniently treated in a centralized manner.

title_en: Water-saving fertilizer injection unit is used in maize planting
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of agricultural equipment, and particularly relates to a water-saving fertilizer device for corn planting. Including the base, be provided with on the base and join in marriage the liquid case, the bottom both sides of base are fixedly connected with backup pad respectively, rotate between two backup pads and be connected with two-way lead screw, and one end of two-way lead screw runs through one of them backup pad fixedly connected with rocking handle, and threaded mounting has the support column respectively in the both sides of two-way lead screw, and the equal fixedly connected with mounting panel in bottom of two support columns, and the equal fixed mounting in bottom of two mounting panels has the shower nozzle, and two shower nozzles are respectively through hose and join in marriage the both sides intercommunication of liquid case, are connected with the water pump respectively on two hoses, and two water pumps are fixed respectively on the base of joining in marriage liquid case both sides, the bottom of base is provided with a plurality of supporting legs, and advancing wheel is installed to the bottom of supporting leg. The utility model can accurately fertilize the root system of the corn seedling, thereby not only ensuring the absorption effect of the corn seedling on the fertilizer, but also avoiding the occurrence of the phenomenon of seedling burning.

title_en: Hole pressing device for hollow bricks
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fixed brackets, in particular to a hollow brick hole pressing device. The cleaning device comprises a workbench and a hole pressing component, wherein one end of the L-shaped plate is fixedly connected with the workbench, the long arm end of the L-shaped plate is fixedly connected with a servo motor, the output end of the servo motor is fixedly connected with a rotating rod, the arc surface of the rotating rod is fixedly connected with two gears, the outer parts of the gears are meshed with racks, one end of each rack is fixedly connected with a fixing plate, one side of each fixing plate is fixedly connected with a square rod, one side of each square rod is fixedly connected with a supporting plate, and one side of each supporting plate is fixedly connected with a cleaning pad. The problem of traditional hollow brick presses hole device, can remain a little clay on the table surface after the hollow brick presses the hole to the next hollow brick to press the hole, remaining clay can adhere on the hollow brick, influences hollow brick production quality is solved.

title_en: Floating line concentration warning device for underwater blasting
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of underwater blasting auxiliary equipment, in particular to an underwater blasting floating line concentration warning device which comprises a float main body, a warning lamp and a control device, wherein a placing space for placing detonator bundles is formed in the float main body, a counterweight piece is arranged in the lower part of the float main body, a top cover is detachably arranged on the upper part of the float main body and used for sealing the placing space, and the lamp is arranged at the top end of the upper part of the main body. The line concentration warning device is durable, simple in structure, convenient to use, obvious in day and night warning effect, very beneficial to fixing and connecting the electronic detonator leg wires for underwater blasting operation, capable of ensuring firm connection of the detonator leg wires under meteorological conditions that the wind speed of a water area in an operation area is less than 9 m/s, the wave height is less than 0.9 m and raining, free of water inflow at a wire clamp, good in electric blasting network and capable of playing a positive role in realizing safe and efficient targets of underwater blasting.

title_en: Material stirring device for nonmetal sealing gasket production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of nonmetal sealing gasket production, in particular to a material stirring device for nonmetal sealing gasket production, which comprises a base, a sealing cover and a blocking cover, wherein a pillar is arranged on the outer wall surface of one side below the base, two guide sliding grooves are arranged on the base, a stirring groove is arranged between the two guide sliding grooves, a stirring paddle is arranged in the stirring groove, a motor is arranged at one end of the stirring paddle, a feeding pipe is arranged on the sealing cover, a through groove is arranged on one side of the blocking cover, a plurality of guide sliding blocks are arranged on the outer wall surfaces of one side below the sealing cover and the blocking cover, and the material stirring device can flexibly change the material stirring device according to the type of the material, so that the application range is increased.

title_en: Feeding device for ceramic cup processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a feeding device for ceramic cup processing, which comprises a base, wherein the upper end of the base is fixedly connected with first fixing plates, a first conveying mechanism is arranged between the first fixing plates, the upper end of the first fixing plates is fixedly connected with a first supporting rod, the upper end of the first supporting rod is fixedly connected with a first mounting plate, the upper end of the first mounting plate is fixedly connected with two second fixing plates, a second conveying mechanism is arranged between the two second fixing plates, the side ends of the second fixing plates are fixedly connected with a second motor, the upper ends of the second fixing plates are fixedly connected with a material distributing mechanism, the middle part of the lower end of the second mounting plate is fixedly connected with a material conveying pipe, and the side ends of the second fixing plates are fixedly connected with a material conveying mechanism. Can divide the material and add in the mould to the clay voluntarily, improve the qualification rate of the cup of processing out, reduce work load, guarantee work efficiency.

title_en: Side cut device is used in municipal road construction
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a trimming device for municipal road construction, which comprises a T-shaped vehicle body connecting seat, wherein a T-shaped guide rod and a multi-stage electric push rod are fixedly arranged at the top of the T-shaped vehicle body connecting seat, the extending end of the multi-stage electric push rod is fixedly connected with a transverse telescopic fine tuning assembly which is sleeved on the T-shaped guide rod in a sliding manner, and the right side of the transverse telescopic fine tuning assembly is fixedly connected with a movable rod. The utility model has the advantages that by arranging a series of structures, the cutting disc is convenient to drive to rotate and move downwards to carry out edge cutting on the road surface, the phenomenon that the cutting position is surrounded and shielded to prevent the broken slag from splashing when the cutting disc is cut is convenient to be close to the road surface all the time, the phenomenon that a large amount of broken slag splashes to the personnel is reduced, the blocking slag and the protection effect are improved, the cutting disc is convenient to automatically store and surround and protect the cutting disc after the cutting disc is lifted, the risk that the personnel is mistakenly collided with the cutting disc to cause injury is reduced, the use safety is improved, and the dust fall is convenient to spray to the cutting part and the cutting disc is cooled when the cutting disc is cut, and the environment friendliness and the service life of the cutting disc are improved.

title_en: Double-layer pudding production device
