abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of food processing, and discloses a double-layer pudding production device which comprises a conveying line, a first filling mechanism, a second filling mechanism and a third filling mechanism, wherein the conveying line is configured to convey a box body, the second filling mechanism and the third filling mechanism are sequentially arranged at intervals along the conveying direction of the conveying line, the first filling mechanism is configured to fill a lower base material into the box body, the second filling mechanism is configured to fill liquid nitrogen into the box body, and the third filling machine is configured to fill an upper base material into the box body. The second filling mechanism for injecting liquid nitrogen is additionally arranged between the first filling mechanism and the third filling mechanism, so that liquid nitrogen can be injected into the lower base material after the filling of the lower base material is completed, the surface of the lower base material is solidified by utilizing the low temperature of the liquid nitrogen, and then the box body is conveyed to the third filling mechanism for filling the upper base material, so that the sedimentation phenomenon is effectively avoided.

title_en: Cultivation device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cultivating device which comprises a bottom plate, a cultivating frame and a water collecting tank, wherein side frames are fixed at two ends of the bottom plate, a top plate is fixed at the top of each side frame, a threaded rod is fixedly connected with the middle of each side frame, limiting nuts are connected to the surfaces of the threaded rods in a threaded mode, the cultivating frame is uniformly arranged between the two groups of side frames, connecting blocks are fixed at two ends of the cultivating frame, a supporting plate is fixed at the bottom side of the interior of the cultivating frame, a partition plate is arranged above the supporting plate in the cultivating frame, a connecting rod is fixed at the rear end of the connecting block, a water collecting pipe is fixed above the connecting rod, and water spraying heads are uniformly arranged on the surfaces of the water collecting pipes. This breeding device can be through the use of division board cooperation cultivation frame that is "L" form, conveniently draws the division board for divide the division board to discharge in the cultivation frame, so that take out the vegetable seedling of cultivating fast in the cultivation frame form.

title_en: Stalk and spike harvesting equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses stalk and spike collecting equipment which comprises a mounting frame, wherein a mounting seat is fixedly arranged on the mounting frame, a casing is fixedly arranged on the mounting seat, one side of the casing is communicated and connected with a feeding channel, a cutting shaft is arranged in the center of the casing, mounting cutter holders are symmetrically and fixedly arranged on the cutting shaft, movable cutters are arranged on the mounting cutter holders, a fixing frame is welded on the top surface of the mounting frame, a material conveying cylinder is arranged on the fixing frame, a material conveying shaft is arranged in the center of the material conveying cylinder, a material conveying spiral is fixedly arranged on the material conveying shaft, a throwing port is formed in one side of the bottom of an inner cavity of the material conveying cylinder, the throwing port is communicated and connected with one end of a discharging channel, and the other end of the discharging channel is communicated and connected with the inner cavity of the casing. The utility model has the beneficial effects that the servo motor can be used for driving the movable knife to shear the stalk materials, and meanwhile, the stalk materials after harvesting and shearing can be stably conveyed to a high place for feeding and collecting, so that the materials are not easy to remain in the machine shell, and the practicability is stronger.

title_en: Feeding device for aquaculture
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a feeding device for aquaculture, which comprises a feed cylinder, wherein a feed conveying pipe is vertically and fixedly connected to the middle of the bottom end inside the feed cylinder, the top end of the feed conveying pipe penetrates through the feed cylinder and extends upwards, and a plurality of feed inlets are transversely formed in the bottom end of the outer surface of the feed conveying pipe in a penetrating manner. This aquaculture is with throwing something and feeding device, through setting up feed cylinder and conveying pipeline, the device is when using, at first the device motion to the middle part of pond, control pivot and dwang rotate then, pivot pivoted in-process drives the fodder through the conveying blade on its surface and upwards moves, until it removes to the top of conveying pipeline uncovered, at this moment high-speed pivoted breaks up She Jiuhui and will carry the fodder to this outwards breaks up, so carry out 360 omnidirectional to the fodder and shed, robbed of fish school has been reduced to a certain extent, just also reduced the fish and damaged possibility because robbed of eating, the practicality of the device has been improved.

title_en: Aerated brick breaking device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of aerated brick production, and discloses an aerated brick breaking device, which comprises a processing table, wherein a collecting opening is formed in the top of the processing table, a collecting box is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the processing table, supporting blocks are fixedly arranged at the top of the processing table, a plurality of evenly distributed cutting grooves are formed in the supporting blocks, a protective cover is fixedly arranged on the outer side of the processing table, two sliding grooves which are symmetrically distributed in front-back mode are formed in the left side and the right side of the inner wall of the protective cover, and connecting blocks are slidably arranged in the sliding grooves on the left side and the right side. This aerated brick breaks device off with fingers and thumb has possessed the collection box that is located the cutting groove below, collects the produced silt of cutting in-process to from last down cutting avoid long-time use, the silt on aerated brick surface causes the advantage of jam to the storage position of cutting wire.

title_en: Mixer for hydraulic and hydroelectric engineering building
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water conservancy and hydropower engineering building stirrer which comprises a stirring barrel and a supporting mechanism arranged below the stirring barrel, wherein the stirring barrel comprises a barrel body, a mixing mechanism is rotatably connected inside the barrel body, the mixing mechanism comprises a stirring shaft arranged at the center inside the barrel body, a first gear is fixedly sleeved on the surface of the stirring shaft, a plurality of second gears are in meshed connection with the surface of the first gear, threaded rods are fixedly connected to the inner walls of the second gears, and mounting plates are rotatably connected to the top and the bottom of the threaded rods. This equipment possesses the advantage of high-efficient scraping, has solved current scraping plate and often inconvenient reciprocate along the container inner wall, and the material that can not effectively clear up remains on the inner wall, probably leads to the material extravagant, also can influence the quality of stirring next time simultaneously, because remaining old material can mix with new batch's material, has reduced the problem of the mixing efficiency of mixer.

title_en: Novel glass heating die casting machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel glass heating die casting machine which comprises a frame, a rotating mechanism, a plurality of material clamping pipes, a plurality of die casting devices and a plurality of heating assemblies, wherein the rotating mechanism comprises a mounting bracket, a revolution assembly and a rotation assembly which are fixedly connected with the frame, the revolution assembly comprises a plurality of revolution positioning plates and a driving shaft at the center of the revolution positioning plates, a second transmission gear is arranged on the driving shaft, a power source is arranged on the mounting bracket and used for driving the driving shaft to rotate, the material clamping pipes are arranged on the revolution positioning plates in a circular shape, and the material clamping pipes are connected with the revolution positioning plates in a rotating way. The revolution locating plate plays a locating effect on the material clamping tube, the material clamping tube and the revolution locating plate are integrally revolved, so that the overall stability of the revolution assembly is better, the power source drives the revolution locating plate to rotate through the driving shaft, power transmission is realized between the power source and the driving shaft through gear meshing, and therefore the accuracy of the revolution assembly in the rotation process is improved.

title_en: Multistation frock
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of pipeline manufacturing and discloses a multi-station tool, which comprises a platform base, wherein two fixing bolts are fixedly penetrated through the upper side and the lower side of the inner wall of the platform base, electric heating resistance wires are fixedly penetrated through the top ends of the fixing bolts, an inner core is sleeved at the bottom ends of the two fixing bolts, a heat insulation core is fixedly arranged on one side of the inner core, a pushing motor is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of one side of the platform base, a pushing wheel is fixedly arranged at the output end of the pushing motor, a temperature control box is fixedly arranged in the middle of the top end of the platform base, a water pump is fixedly arranged on the other side of the top end of the platform base, and cooling fins are fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the platform base. In order to solve the defects in the prior art, the utility model provides processing equipment convenient to position, which separates a heating part from a cooling part, so that the cooling and shaping effects of a die are better, a water circulation device is added, and water is saved.

title_en: Material pushing groove protection device for glass melting furnace feeder
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of glass production equipment, in particular to a pushing groove protection device for a glass melting furnace feeder, which comprises a feeder, a glass melting furnace and a protection device, wherein the glass melting furnace is arranged at one side of the feeder; the top of the feeder is provided with a storage hopper, the discharge end of the storage hopper is connected with a pushing groove which is obliquely arranged, the output port of the pushing groove extends into the feed inlet of the glass melting furnace, and the protection device comprises a top air supply plate arranged at the upper part of the output port of the pushing groove and a bottom air supply mechanism arranged at the lower part of the top air supply plate. The utility model can blow air to the junction of the pushing groove of the glass melting furnace feeder through the matching use of the top air delivery plate and the bottom air delivery mechanism, so as to achieve the effect of cooling and protecting the pushing groove and prolong the service life of the pushing groove; the device is flexible and convenient to use, reduces the use cost in the later maintenance aspect, ensures the production efficiency of enterprises and brings benefits to the enterprises.

title_en: Double-layer cat litter box
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a double-layer cat litter box, which is characterized in that two side plates are arranged at two ends of the width direction of the upper surface of a bottom plate, a plurality of first perforations are arranged on the side plates in an array manner, a top plate is arranged at the top of the two side plates, a back plate is arranged at the rear part of a box body and connects the two side plates, an upper door plate is connected and sealed at the front part of the box body and is arranged corresponding to an upper space, the upper door plate is arranged corresponding to a sand removing area, an inlet is arranged on the upper door plate corresponding to the sand removing area, and a lower door plate is arranged corresponding to a lower space and hinged to a hinged fixing structure. According to the double-layer cat litter box provided by the utility model, the plurality of first perforations are arranged on the side plates in an array manner, the top plates are arranged at the tops of the two side plates, and the hook position-selecting installation, the grabbing plate position-selecting installation or the cat climbing frame position-selecting installation and fixing can be completed through the first perforations. The pedal part is arranged in the working space and positioned in the middle of the height direction to divide the working space into an upper space and a lower space, and the lower space is the placement position of the cat litter basin.

title_en: Raw material processing equipment for seasoning hot and spicy sauce
abstract_en: The utility model discloses raw material processing equipment for seasoning hot and spicy sauce, which belongs to the technical field of sauce processing, and can enable a conduction pipe to integrally swing, liquid enters into a communication pipe and enters into the conduction pipe to fall through a cleaning head to clean hot and spicy pepper, so that the hot and spicy pepper is cleaned in an auxiliary manner, and the situations that the hot and spicy pepper raw material is cleaned in place and needs to be cleaned for a second time due to the fact that the spraying range of the conduction pipe is fixed can be effectively avoided. The raw material processing equipment for the seasoning hot and spicy sauce comprises a cleaning box, wherein a cleaning cavity is formed in the top of the cleaning box, an inclined plate is obliquely fixed at one end of the cleaning cavity, a material guide component is obliquely arranged at the other end of the cleaning cavity, a cleaning component is arranged in the middle section of the cleaning box corresponding to the cleaning cavity, the cleaning component is rotatably arranged on a guide pipe, cleaning heads are equidistantly arranged at the bottom of the guide pipe, one end of the guide pipe extends out of the cleaning box, a transmission component is arranged at one end of the guide pipe extending out of the cleaning box, and a communicating pipe is rotatably embedded in the guide pipe.

title_en: Rice polishing equipment with prevent stifled function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rice polishing device with an anti-blocking function, which relates to the technical field of rice processing, and comprises a bottom plate and a polishing machine body, wherein the bottom plate is fixedly connected with the polishing machine body, a first fixing frame is arranged at the front and rear of the bottom plate, a support frame is movably clamped on the upper surface of the first fixing frame, a feeding box is arranged between the two support frames, the rice to be processed is put into the feeding box, the filtering screen is fixed in the feeding box to filter foreign matters except rice, the vibrating pump is started to drive the feeding box to transversely vibrate together, the feeding box shakes left and right, the two springs are extruded and stretched to resonate, the filtering effect of the filtering screen is further improved, the occurrence of the condition that the foreign matters are blocked is avoided, the filtered rice falls into the conical block arranged below to be dispersed, and the phenomenon that excessive rice is put into once is avoided to be accumulated.

title_en: Water conservancy river levee reinforced structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water conservancy river levee reinforcing structure, and relates to the technical field of water conservancy river levee reinforcement. The river levee main body is provided with a top pressing plate, a second pressing plate, a connecting frame and an auxiliary frame, and the river levee main body is connected and matched with the vertical anchor rod through a first concrete casting pile, a second concrete casting pile, a longitudinal anchor rod and a vertical anchor rod. The cooperation between the first concrete pouring pile, the second concrete pouring pile, the longitudinal anchor rod and the vertical anchor rod is more favorable for connection between the device and the river levee main body, the overall stability of the river levee is effectively improved, the influence of water flow scouring and geological activities can be resisted, long-term safety of the river levee is ensured, the water flow flowing into the river levee is absorbed by the water inlet hole, the effect of the water flow on the river levee is reduced, meanwhile, the arc-shaped water baffle is utilized to guide the water flow which cannot be absorbed by the water inlet hole into a river, meanwhile, the guided water flow is utilized to impact the water flow of the river levee, the direct impact force of the water flow on the river levee is further reduced, and the damage risk of the river levee is reduced.

title_en: Movable adjusting type concrete block grooving tool
abstract_en: The utility model provides a movable adjusting type concrete block grooving tool, wherein a left sleeve and a right inserted rod are arranged in the left-right direction, the left end of the right inserted rod is inserted into the right end of the left sleeve in the left-right direction and is arranged in an adjustable mode relative to the left-right position of the right inserted rod, left and right support plates are vertically arranged in the front-back direction and are arranged at intervals left and right, the upper ends of the left and right support plates are respectively connected with the left end of the left sleeve and the right end of the right inserted rod, left and right guide rollers are horizontally arranged and respectively and rotatably arranged in the lower ends of the left and right support plates, the right side of each left guide roller protrudes towards the right side face of the left support plate, the left and right grooving devices are arranged at intervals left and right and are respectively positioned below the left sleeve and the right inserted rod and are respectively and movably connected with the left and right side of the left inserted rod, and are respectively used for grooving concrete blocks in the front-back direction. The utility model can slot different slotting positions of concrete blocks with different sizes, and quickens construction progress.

title_en: Stalk pulling device for tobacco stalk pulling machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a stalk pulling device for a tobacco stalk pulling machine, which relates to the technical field of agricultural mechanical equipment and comprises a connecting shaft and two pulling rods arranged on the connecting shaft, wherein the connecting shaft is used for being connected with the stalk pulling machine, the two pulling rods are oppositely arranged on the connecting shaft and extend forwards, and the distance between the two pulling rods is gradually increased from front to back. The pulling rod machine drives two driving rods to synchronously move when moving forwards, the two driving rods respectively correspond to two groups of tobacco stems, the driving rods extend to the tobacco stems on two adjacent sides, along with the movement of the pulling rod machine, the two driving rods distribute the two groups of tobacco stems to two sides of the pulling rod machine, the tobacco stems generate an outward falling trend under the action of the driving rods, then the tobacco stems are pulled up through a pulling rod mechanism of the pulling rod machine, the tobacco stems fall to two sides of the pulling rod machine under the action of self gravity, the probability of breakage of the tobacco stems is reduced, and meanwhile, the convenience of subsequent collection and picking of the tobacco stems is improved, so that the efficiency of collecting the tobacco stems is improved.

title_en: Mower convenient to use
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of mowers, in particular to a mower convenient to use, which comprises a mounting rack, wherein one side of the top end of the mounting rack is provided with a push rod, the top end of the mounting rack is provided with a transmission box, the side surface of the transmission box is provided with a collecting box, the side surface of the collecting box is provided with an exhaust fan, the other side of the collecting box is provided with a connecting pipeline, one end of the connecting pipeline is positioned at the bottom of the mounting rack, when the height of a cutter is required to be adjusted, a double-shaft motor is directly started, and the double-shaft motor can quickly and stably drive the driving motor and the transmission rod to descend through the arrangement of a worm, a worm wheel, a bidirectional screw rod, a moving block, a rotating connecting rod and a lifting plate, so that the height adjustment of the cutter is completed.

title_en: Inner and outer multilayer liquid storage explosion-proof container
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an inner and outer multilayer liquid storage explosion-proof container, which is hollow in the container and is used for placing an explosion source, wherein a container shell comprises an inner liquid storage module, a metal structure layer and an outer liquid storage module which are sequentially arranged from inside to outside, the inner liquid storage module comprises at least one anti-explosion liquid storage layer which is sequentially arranged from inside to outside, the outer liquid storage module comprises at least one anti-explosion liquid storage layer which is sequentially arranged from inside to outside, and the anti-explosion liquid storage layer are hollow and store liquid. According to the utility model, the internal liquid storage module is used for effectively reducing the breaking speed, the metal structural layer is used for carrying out bottom-catching protection on the broken pieces after the speed reduction, and the external liquid storage module is used for increasing the equivalent mass of the metal structural layer and protecting the metal structural layer from large deflection deformation and breakage, so that the structural mass and the production cost can be greatly reduced while the combined load of explosion shock waves and high-speed broken pieces is effectively prevented.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted barrel type transmitting device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a vehicle-mounted barrel-type transmitting device, which belongs to the technical field of barrel-type transmitting devices and comprises a height adjusting mechanism, wherein the height adjusting mechanism comprises a supporting seat, one side of the upper surface of the supporting seat is rotationally connected with two first hinging rods, the surface of each first hinging rod is rotationally connected with a second hinging rod, a supporting plate is arranged above each second hinging rod, one end of each second hinging rod is rotationally connected to the bottom of each supporting plate, the height of each supporting plate can be adjusted through the cooperation of the first hinging rods and the second hinging rods, so that the height of a functional mechanism can be adjusted, a rotating shaft is rotationally connected to the surface of a rotating toothed ring, the angle of the functional mechanism can be adjusted, and then the barrel-type generator body is adjusted on the surface of the rotating seat, so that the transmitting angle of the barrel-type generator body can be adjusted, and an operator can rapidly adjust the transmitting angle according to real-time tactical requirements, so that accurate coverage of a target is realized.

title_en: Bean harvester
abstract_en: The bean harvester comprises an engine and a harvester frame, wherein a hanging frame is arranged on the front side of the harvester frame, a lifting hydraulic cylinder is arranged between the hanging frame and the harvester frame and used for lifting the hanging frame, two land wheel assemblies and two seedling separators are arranged on the front side of the hanging frame, in sum, the distance between bean cutting disks is allowed to be adjusted by a user through the matching of a power shaft and a spline sleeve so as to adapt to the ridge distance of different bean plants, the flexibility and the application range of the harvester are increased, the land wheel assemblies can adjust the height of a screw through a rocking handle, so that the cutting depth of the bean cutting disks is changed, the harvester can adapt to crops with different heights and ground conditions, the floating seedling separator is beneficial to better adapting to the condition of uneven ground, and meanwhile, the crop is stably guided to the bean cutting disks.

title_en: Tire inlet and outlet device of vulcanizing machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tire access device of a vulcanizing machine, which belongs to the technical field of rubber product processing and maintenance devices and comprises a stand column, wherein a driven rotating head is arranged at a position, close to the middle part of the outer side wall of the stand column, the driven rotating head is rotatably arranged along the axis of the stand column, a functional vertical pipe is arranged on the driven rotating head, the axis of the functional vertical pipe is parallel to the axis of the stand column, a first transmission component is arranged between the stand column and a first gearbox, the first transmission component can control the rotation action of the functional vertical pipe relative to the stand column, a supporting cantilever for placing tires is arranged on the functional vertical pipe, a second transmission component is arranged at a position, where the supporting cantilever is connected with the functional vertical pipe, of the supporting cantilever is controlled by the second transmission component to move on the functional vertical pipe along the axis direction of the functional vertical pipe.

title_en: Land reclamation device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a land reclamation device, which comprises a reclamation device main body, wherein the front end of the reclamation device main body is provided with a soil turning component, the rear of the soil turning component is provided with a grinding component, the rear of the grinding component is provided with a spraying component, the grinding component comprises a U-shaped frame, a soil turning cylinder is rotatably arranged on the U-shaped frame, a sliding groove is arranged on the soil turning cylinder, a plurality of fixing holes are formed in the surface of the soil turning cylinder, a plurality of protruding structures are arranged on the sliding frame and are matched with the sliding groove on the soil turning cylinder, the sliding frame is fixed on the fixing holes through fixing bolts, and a plurality of soil turning pieces are arranged on the surface of the sliding frame. According to the utility model, the interval and the number of the sliding frames can be adjusted according to the needs through the sliding frames, so that the range of cultivated soil can be conveniently adjusted according to the reasons such as the area of the soil, and the large soil blocks can be crushed by arranging the crushing assembly, so that the sowing is convenient, and meanwhile, the spraying assembly can be used for fertilizing the soil.

title_en: Storage device for picking up poultry eggs
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a storage device for picking up poultry eggs, and belongs to the field of poultry egg collection. The utility model discloses a storage device for picking up poultry eggs, which comprises a frame, wherein a bearing structure is arranged at the top of the frame, an egg plate is stored at the inner side of the bearing structure, eggs are inlaid on the surface of the egg plate, the frame can displace through rollers, a positioning structure positioned at the outer side of the egg plate is arranged on the surface of the bearing structure, the egg plate can be fixed by the positioning structure, and a transmission structure for driving the positioning structure to be closed is arranged in the frame.

title_en: A insecticidal device for city
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of urban insecticidal devices, and discloses an urban insecticidal device, which solves the problem that the existing insecticidal device cannot effectively cover a dense area of all pests to cause insufficient insecticidal effect due to the fact that the existing insecticidal device is a fixing device. The utility model provides a insecticidal device for city, includes the fixed plate, and fixed plate one side is provided with the butt joint board, and fixed plate opposite side fixed mounting has the insecticidal lamp, and the fixed plate includes solar panel, wiring board, mounting panel, mounting hole, bearing, rotating assembly, and rotating assembly includes motor, actuating lever, gear, rack A, has realized improving the effect that the insecticidal lamp can be even to the surrounding environment insecticidal.

title_en: Radially contractible wearing structure and bark stopper
abstract_en: The application provides a radial contraction wearing structure and a bark stopper, which comprises a radial contraction module, a traction rope and a driving module, wherein the radial contraction module and the driving module are connected end to form a perforation, the perforation is used for a living body to pass through, the radial contraction module is positioned at one side close to the perforation and is used for being connected with an electric shock contact, the radial contraction module is provided with a contraction station which contracts towards the direction close to the center line of the perforation and an expansion station which expands outwards towards the direction far away from the center line of the perforation, the first end of the traction rope is connected with the radial contraction module, the second end of the traction rope is connected with the driving module, and the driving module is used for winding the traction rope and releasing the traction rope. The electric shock contact can be controllably contacted with the skin of the organism, the compressive damage to the skin of the organism can be effectively avoided, meanwhile, the wearing structure can be avoided from being frequently picked up manually, the operation is simpler, and the use convenience is improved.

title_en: Energy-saving irrigation device for planting sweet oranges
abstract_en: The utility model provides an energy-saving irrigation device for sweet orange planting, which relates to the technical field of agricultural irrigation and comprises a protective shell and a working mechanism, wherein the working mechanism is fixedly connected to the inner side of the protective shell and comprises a rotating assembly, a water pumping assembly, an inner assembly, a driving protection assembly and an atomizing irrigation assembly, the water storage tank is arranged to allow the device to keep water source supply in a discontinuous working state, frequent starting and energy consumption of a water pump are effectively reduced, the rotating assembly realizes efficient power transmission through a gear system, meanwhile, a telescopic suction pipe and a U-shaped pipe of the inner assembly provide the capability of adjusting water suction depth and balancing water pressure, the stability of water flow and the uniformity of irrigation are ensured, in addition, the driving protection assembly not only provides additional power, but also protects a sealing cover of the device, the service life of the device is prolonged, the maintenance cost is reduced, the atomizing irrigation assembly further improves the water utilization efficiency through a fine atomizing technology, and water saving and uniform irrigation are realized.

title_en: Forming machine for cement product processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cement product processing forming machine which comprises a base, wherein a supporting frame is fixedly arranged at the top of the base, a shell is fixedly arranged on the right side of the supporting frame, a motor is fixedly arranged on the right side of the shell and close to the top of the shell, a driving gear is fixedly arranged at the output end of the motor, a driven gear is movably meshed with the bottom of the driving gear, a rotating rod is fixedly arranged on the left side of the driven gear, and the other end of the rotating rod penetrates into the inner side of the supporting frame and is fixedly connected with a die. According to the utility model, through the cooperation of the structures, the overturning of the die is realized, so that the cement product can be automatically discharged, and the convenience in processing the cement product is further improved.

title_en: Processing equipment for production raw materials of safety net
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of safety net production, and discloses processing equipment for safety net production raw materials, which comprises a mounting box, wherein a positioning shell is arranged in the mounting box, an upper containing box is arranged in the positioning shell, a lower containing box is arranged at the bottom of the upper containing box, and a traction assembly is also arranged in the mounting box. The utility model solves the defects in the prior art, can screen plastic particles for producing the safety net, separate out plastic particles with larger diameters, ensure that the plastic particles for producing the safety net are all fine products with smaller diameters, ensure that the produced safety net is finer and more uniform, and can automatically collect the plastic particles with smaller diameters in the lower accommodating box and collect the plastic particles with larger diameters in the upper accommodating box when the plastic particles are screened, thereby being simple and convenient to operate and improving the working efficiency.

title_en: Cutter head device on bark scraping electric device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cutterhead device on an electric bark-shaving device, which comprises a cutter frame and blades, wherein the blades are uniformly and respectively arranged on the cutter frame at intervals, two ends of each blade are correspondingly welded on the inner side end surface of the cutter frame, the edges of the blades are exposed from the circumference of the cutter frame, and the edges of the blades face the same direction. The utility model has the advantages that on the basis of reasonable design and simple structure, the clamping mode of the knife rest and the knife blade is ended, the stability and the tightness of the connection of the knife rest and the knife blade are greatly improved, the occurrence of loosening or detachment is avoided, and the stability, the reliability and the safety of use are improved.

title_en: Extrusion system for PC film production line
abstract_en: The application discloses an extrusion system for a PC film production line, which comprises an extruder and an extrusion die, wherein the extruder comprises a feed hopper, a machine barrel, a screw and a driving device, the screw comprises a rod body and threads, the rod body is sequentially provided with a feeding section, a separation section, a metering section and a mixing section from front to back, the outer diameter of the threads is equal and unchanged, the threads of the separation section are divided into a main edge and an auxiliary edge by a liquid phase groove, the lead of the main edge is larger than the lead of the threads of the feeding section, the auxiliary edge is sequentially provided with a first section, a second section and a third section from front to back, the lead of the first section is larger than the lead of the main edge, the lead of the second section is equal to the lead of the main edge, the lead of the third section is larger than the lead of the first section, the mixing section is provided with a plurality of mixing sections which are sequentially arranged from front to back, each mixing section winds the rod body for a circle and radially protrudes outwards, each mixing section is provided with a plurality of mixing grooves which are circumferentially distributed around the rod body, the length ratio of the screw is 38:1, and the length of the separation section is 1.5 times of the length of the metering section.

title_en: Stubble height adjusting device is stayed to straw crushing still field machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a stubble height adjusting device of a straw crushing and returning machine, which comprises a returning machine main body, wherein a left sliding plate and a right sliding plate are arranged on the left side and the right side of the returning machine main body, adjusting holes are formed in the left sliding plate and the right sliding plate, mounting brackets are fixedly arranged on the left side and the right side of the bottom of the returning machine main body respectively through U-shaped bolts and locking nuts, the whole mounting brackets are of U-shaped structures and are provided with pin shaft mounting holes, pin shafts are arranged in the pin shaft mounting holes, swing arms are movably sleeved outside the pin shafts, a hub shaft assembly is fixedly connected to the swing arms, and the hub shaft assembly comprises an adjusting hole plate and a hub shaft. According to the utility model, the swing arm and the hub shaft assembly are mutually matched, so that the stubble height of the straw can be adjusted, and the problems of uneven ground surface, overhead roller and inconsistent stubble height caused by turning of the long roller field head are solved.

title_en: Egg collecting device for livestock breeding
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an egg collecting device for livestock breeding, which belongs to the field of livestock breeding and comprises a breeding cage, wherein an egg collecting slide way is arranged below the breeding cage, and a conveying device is arranged at the outlet end of the egg collecting slide way. Compared with the prior art, the device has the advantages that the anti-collision net is arranged at the outlet end of the egg collecting slideway, the anti-collision net is used for decelerating the sliding eggs, the steering table is driven to rotate 180 degrees through the rotation of the servo motor, so that the anti-collision net is enabled to steer, the eggs are ejected out through the telescopic device, and the eggs fall onto the conveying device, so that the deceleration and the transportation of the eggs are completed.

title_en: Masterbatch production materials extrusion device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of extrusion devices, in particular to a color master batch production material extrusion device. The utility model comprises a mounting block, wherein the left end of the mounting block is fixedly connected with an extrusion barrel, the arc surface of the extrusion barrel is provided with an electric heating ring, one side of the extrusion barrel is provided with an extrusion hole, the inside of the electric heating ring is provided with an electric heating wire, the arc surface of the extrusion barrel is provided with a cutting assembly, the upper end of the mounting block is fixedly connected with a feed hopper, the upper end of the feed hopper is provided with a mixing assembly, when the color master batch raw materials are required to be mixed, the two color master batch raw materials are respectively poured into the mixing hoppers at the two sides, and through a driving mechanism, the blanking wheels in the two mixing hoppers rotate to enable the two color master batch raw materials to fall into the mixing hoppers, and meanwhile, the driving mechanism drives a stirrer to rotate to mix the color master batch raw materials, so that the effect of uniformly mixing the two color master batch raw materials is achieved as quickly as possible.

title_en: Tool and 3D glass film sticking machine of 3D glass film sticking machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a glass processing technology field, especially relates to a tool of 3D glass film sticking machine and 3D glass film sticking machine, the tool includes that the surface is leveled top, is provided with on the top and inhales the flat region, inhales flat mechanism, and it includes a plurality of absorption holes, and a plurality of absorption holes are offered in many rows and many columns on inhaling flat region in order to be used for inhaling flat on inhaling flat region with 3D glass, positioning mechanism sets up in the position that is close to inhaling flat region edge on the top in order to be used for accurately placing 3D glass on inhaling flat region. The jig disclosed by the invention is characterized in that the flat suction area is arranged at the top of the body with a flat surface, 3D glass is positioned on the flat suction area through the positioning mechanism, and the 3D glass is sucked on the flat suction area through the flat suction mechanism, so that the 3D glass with different curvatures can be fixed on the body of the jig without replacing the profiling jig, the production efficiency is improved, and meanwhile, the 3D glass is changed into a plane shape from a curved surface shape, so that the problem of easy generation of bubbles caused by film pasting on the curved surface is avoided.

title_en: Ear picking device for fresh corn harvester
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a spike picking device for a fresh corn harvester, which comprises a fixing frame, a stem pulling roller and spike picking plates, wherein the fixing frame is arranged on the corn harvester, the side ends of the spike picking plates are arranged on the fixing frame, two stem pulling rollers below the spike picking plates are arranged on the fixing frame in parallel, the spike picking plates further comprise a horizontal part and an arc part, one side of the arc part is connected with the horizontal part, the edge of the other side of the arc part is arc, a gap and an included angle are formed between the two spike picking plates, the gap is wide in front and narrow in back, a plurality of stem pulling roller blades are arranged on the stem pulling rollers and along the periphery of the stem pulling rollers, so that the stem pulling rollers are in an inverted trapezoid shape with thin front and thick back, the spike picking parts can reduce the seed breakage rate of corn spikes in the spike picking process, reduce the damage to the corn spikes, ensure the integrity of the corn spikes and promote the agricultural yield increase.

title_en: Automatic feeding equipment water supply tank of raising chickens in cages
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water supply tank of automatic raising equipment for raising chickens in cages, which comprises a mounting frame, wherein mounting holes are formed in two ends of the mounting frame, a first driving motor is fixedly connected to the middle part of the upper part of the mounting frame, a screw rod is downwards arranged at the output end of the first driving motor, a threaded sleeve is connected to the outer end of the screw rod in a threaded manner, a connecting piece is fixedly connected to the lower end of the threaded sleeve, a water tank is fixedly connected to the outer end of the connecting piece, telescopic rods are fixedly connected to the two ends of the inner side of the mounting frame, the extending ends of the telescopic rods are fixedly connected with the connecting piece, lifting adjustment of the water supply tank can be realized by arranging the first driving motor, the screw rod and the threaded sleeve, the height of a water tank body can be adjusted according to different heights in the same cage chicken growing process, and meanwhile, a cleaning push plate is arranged in the water supply tank to conveniently push out and clean residual feed and sundries in the water supply tank, so that the practicability and convenience of the whole water supply tank are improved.

title_en: Chilli grafting cutting device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of pepper grafting, in particular to a pepper grafting cutting device which comprises a holding part and a linear cutting blade arranged at one end of the holding part, wherein the holding part comprises a scion cutting seat connected with one end of the linear cutting blade, a trapezoid cavity arranged at the upper side of the scion cutting seat, an inlet arranged at the lower side of the scion cutting seat and communicated with the trapezoid cavity, inclined plane cutting mechanisms respectively matched with two inclined planes on the inner wall of the trapezoid cavity in a sliding manner, and a pushing mechanism arranged at one side of the scion cutting seat and connected with the two inclined plane cutting mechanisms.

title_en: Water bowl for pet water dispenser
abstract_en: The utility model provides a drinking bowl for a pet drinking machine, which comprises a gushing pump, a flushing mechanism and a base, wherein a drinking shell is arranged at the top of the base, a drinking cavity and a mounting cavity are formed at the top of the drinking shell, a partition plate is arranged between the drinking cavity and the mounting cavity, a slope for enabling water to roll is arranged at the bottom of the drinking cavity, the bottom of the mounting cavity is provided with the gushing pump and the flushing mechanism, a mounting seat is arranged at the top of the mounting cavity, a mounting groove is formed at the top of the mounting seat, a detachable filter assembly is arranged in the mounting groove, the filter assembly can be directly taken out from the mounting groove through the arrangement of the detachable filter assembly, the maintenance convenience is improved without disassembling the whole machine, the water can be in a dynamic flowing state through the arrangement of the slope for enabling the water to roll, the oxygen content in the water can be increased, and more excellent drinking water is provided for pets, meanwhile, the rolling water also reduces accumulation of impurities such as hair, dust and the like at the bottom, and keeps the cleanliness of drinking water.

title_en: Hollow brick molding device
abstract_en: The application provides a hollow brick forming device, which relates to the technical field of hollow brick processing and comprises a forming outer die, a forming top plate and a supporting plate, wherein forming inner dies are processed on the bottom surfaces of two ends of the forming top plate, a forming bottom plate is processed on the top of the supporting plate, positioning notches are processed in the supporting plate and the forming bottom plate, a device bracket is arranged on the outer side of the forming outer die, a transverse plate is assembled on the top and the middle of the device bracket, a guide frame is processed on one end of the forming inner die, and the cross section of the guide frame is isosceles trapezoid.

title_en: Mould for ceramic processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a die for ceramic processing, which comprises a mounting seat, wherein a bottom box is arranged on the mounting seat, two first slide bars are symmetrically fixed on two side walls in the bottom box, the upper ends of the first slide bars are connected with first slide blocks through first pressing springs, and a transverse plate is fixed between the two first slide blocks. The ceramic mold has the advantages that through the design of the slots, the plugboards, the rubber pads and the transverse plates, when the upper mold and the lower mold of the device are assembled, the plugboards of the upper mold are matched with the design of the rubber pads, so that the upper mold and the lower mold can be assembled perfectly, the outflow of pug is avoided, the aesthetic property of ceramic manufactured by the device is effectively ensured, and meanwhile, when the device is used, the design of the pressing spring I matched with the pressing spring II can lead the lower mold on the transverse plate to be ejected, and the assembly and the disassembly are convenient at any time.

title_en: Die changing system for forming die
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a tire mold changing system, which comprises a tire mold frame (1), a tire mold base (2) and a grabbing robot (3) for grabbing a tire mold (4) and switching the tire mold frame (1) and the tire mold base (2), wherein the tire mold frame (1) comprises a mold frame (11) for placing the tire mold, a tire mold frame locating pin (12) capable of being aligned with the tire mold (4) is arranged on the mold frame (11), a laser material sensor (13) for detecting the type of the tire mold and a position sensor (14) for locating are also arranged on the mold frame (11), and the tire mold base (2) comprises a tire mold base locating pin (21) capable of being aligned with the tire mold (4) in a locating mode and a clamping cylinder (22) for fixing the tire mold (4). Compared with the prior art, the die changing system provided by the utility model avoids manual operation, improves the die changing efficiency, and reduces the potential safety hazard of manual operation.

title_en: Morchella strain cultivation frame
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a morchella strain cultivation frame, which comprises a frame body, the top of framework is fixed with the frame, the inner wall equidistance of frame is fixed with a plurality of orifice plates of placing, the outer wall both sides of frame are fixed with mounting panel and installing frame respectively, the inside of frame is located the top of every orifice plate of placing and all installs the spray piece, the outer wall of mounting panel is installed the water supply subassembly that supplies water for the spray piece, install in the installing frame and realize spray piece wobbling actuating mechanism, the spray piece includes the water pipe, the outer wall bottom equidistance of water pipe is fixed with the shower nozzle that a plurality of pairwise symmetries were arranged. The utility model discloses can realize the swing of water pipe, under the work of water pump, can take out the water in the framework, spray out from the shower nozzle to can realize the circulation, the swing of water pipe sprays, realizes that furthest sprays the morchella on placing the orifice plate, and the moisturizing is convenient, uses manpower sparingly.

title_en: High-efficient peeling machine of walnut-meat
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a walnut kernel efficient peeling machine which comprises a supporting frame, peeling plates and a packing auger, wherein the peeling plates are arranged on the inner sides of the supporting frame, cross rods are arranged on the inner walls of the two ends of the peeling plates, bearings are arranged at the centers of the cross rods, teeth are arranged on the upper surfaces of the bearings, swing wheels are meshed at the upper ends of the teeth, mounting plates are connected to the lower surfaces of the two sides of the upper ends of the supporting frame, a connecting rod is connected to one side of the upper ends of the swing wheels, one end of the connecting rod penetrates through the mounting plates and is connected with the swing rods, the connecting rod can rotate in the mounting plates, a first servo motor is arranged on the upper surface of the supporting frame, the output end of the first servo motor is connected with a rotating rod, and one end of the rotating rod is arranged on the inner sides of the swing rods.

title_en: Sizing material mixing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sizing material mixing device, which relates to the technical field of sizing material mixing, and particularly comprises a shell, wherein a feed hopper is arranged at the top of the shell, an extruding device is arranged at the bottom of one end of the shell, the extruding device is internally communicated with the shell, a first installation shaft is arranged at the inner bottom of the shell, one end of the first installation shaft is connected with the extruding device, a second installation shaft is arranged above the first installation shaft, two ends of the second installation shaft and one end of the first installation shaft, which is far away from the extruding device, are respectively connected with the shell in a rotating way, and a plurality of cutting blades are arranged on the surfaces of the first installation shaft and the second installation shaft, and one ends of the first installation shaft and the second installation shaft, which are far away from the extruding device, are respectively connected with a driving device. When the rubber mixing machine is used, rubber to be mixed is placed into the shell through the feeding hopper, the cutting blades which are distributed in an up-and-down staggered mode can quickly cut the rubber into small sections, and the cut rubber can be mixed along with continuous stirring of the cutting blades.

title_en: Experimental pig drinking device convenient for liquid medicine proportioning
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of drinking devices for pigs, in particular to an experimental pig drinking device convenient for liquid medicine proportioning. The stirring device comprises a chassis, the upper surface fixedly connected with fixed pipe on chassis, the upper end fixedly connected with agitator of fixed pipe, the bung is installed to the upper end of agitator, the last surface mounting on chassis has support piece, support piece is connected with the agitator, a plurality of tap is installed to the circular arc surface of fixed pipe, the diapire of agitator is equipped with stirring structure, stirring structure includes the circular rail, circular rail and agitator fixed connection, the inner wall swing joint of circular rail has a plurality of connecting rod, the upper end fixedly connected with upper cover of connecting rod. The experimental pig drinking device convenient for proportioning the liquid medicine has the advantages that the liquid medicine and the water flow can be conveniently mixed and proportioned, and the inner wall of the stirring barrel can be cleaned during mixing and proportioning.

title_en: High-row seat sponge production material injection gun
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of high-row seat sponge production, in particular to a high-row seat sponge production material injection gun, which comprises a material injection gun, wherein one end of the material injection gun is fixedly connected with a material injection pipe, in the utility model, through the components such as the material injection gun, the material injection pipe, a first rotating shaft, a fixed rod, a telescopic rod, a fixed plate, a motor, a second rotating shaft, a connecting shaft, a heating layer, bristles, a discharging chute and the like, the fixed rod is driven to move left and right under the action of the first rotating shaft, make components such as motor and fixed plate remove the supporting ring inboard, then stimulate the fixed plate, the fixed plate removes under telescopic link and dead lever's effect, and the telescopic link can be pulled out dead lever part this moment, then continue to rotate the dead lever, makes the connecting axle aim at the blown down tank, later starts motor and zone of heating through external switch, drives second pivot, connecting axle, zone of heating and brush hair through the output of motor and rotates, clears up in the blown down tank through the rotation of brush hair.

title_en: Concrete ground slotting device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of building construction, in particular to a concrete ground slotting device, which comprises a main body frame, wherein a plurality of fixed wheels are fixedly connected to the bottom end surface of the main body frame, a U-shaped groove is formed in the head end of the main body frame, a fixing device is rotationally connected to the U-shaped groove, a cutting machine is rotationally connected to the fixing device, an adjusting device is further arranged on the fixing device, the cutting machine can be fixed with the fixing device and can adjust the angle of the cutting machine and the fixing device, a driving rod is rotationally connected to the main body frame, the driving rod can stir the fixing device to rotate, the driving rod is fixedly connected with a handle, the handle can stir the fixing device to rotate through the driving rod, so that the cutting machine on the fixing device rotates downwards to contact and cut the ground.

title_en: Just, dismantlement formula plastic housing forming device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a just, dismantlement formula plastic housing forming device, include: the main body mechanism comprises a base, a working platform fixed on one side of the base, two movable seats arranged on the base in a sliding manner, a driving piece arranged in the base and extending into the working platform, a portal frame fixed on the top end of the movable seat, and hydraulic rods symmetrically arranged on the portal frame, wherein the base is used for installing other components, ensuring the stability of each component, the working platform is used for placing tools when workers work, the first sliding grooves are symmetrically formed in the base, the second sliding grooves are symmetrically formed in the working platform and are mutually communicated, the second sliding grooves are used for installing the movable seat and limiting the movement of the movable seat, the movable seat is used for installing the portal frame and driving the portal frame to move, the movable seat comprises a threaded sleeve arranged in the first sliding grooves in a sliding mode and a support fixed to the top end of the threaded sleeve, and the detachable plastic shell forming device has the advantages of being convenient to install and detach and high in practicality.

title_en: Plastic cutlery box plastic uptake production forming device
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of plastic cutlery box production, and discloses a plastic cutlery box plastic sucking production molding device, which comprises a machine body, wherein a lower die is fixedly connected to the middle part of the inner side of the machine body, a positive and negative pressure air pipe is arranged at the bottom of the lower die and connected with an external vacuum pump, and a cooling chamber is arranged on the inner side of the upper end of the machine body; according to the application, the cooling chamber is arranged at the inner side of the upper end of the machine body, the servo motor is used for driving the transmission screw rods connected with the cooling chamber to rotate, and the two transmission screw rods are connected through the synchronous belt, so that the two transmission screw rods synchronously rotate, and when the transmission screw rods rotate, the movable fan frame can move along the axial direction of the transmission screw rods in the cooling chamber, so that the cooling fan synchronously moves, ambient air can be blown to the bottom of the lower die to take away heat, forced cooling of the lower die is realized, the cooling and shaping process of the meal box is accelerated, the cooling time is obviously shortened, and the requirement of mass production is met.

title_en: Sound wave mosquito repellent fan camping lamp
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of camping lamps, in particular to an acoustic wave mosquito-repellent fan camping lamp which comprises a machine body assembly, a lamp assembly, an ultrasonic mosquito-repellent assembly, a fan assembly, a charging assembly, a hanging member assembly and a control button assembly, wherein a first key can generate 20kHz-55kHz ultrasonic waves 20HZ-20000HZ for bass driving of small-sized mosquitoes, a second key can use 50000HZ and warning thorn sounds for driving small or large-sized animals, a second key can use an LED heating lamp, eight lamps and a weak-medium-strong three-gear, is more energy-saving, is used for SOS help signals in a fourth gear, a third key can use a first power-saving fan, a second power-saving fan can be folded and then placed in a machine body cabin, the machine body and the fan blades are respectively provided with a magnet for butt joint absorption, an internal battery can charge the device, and a magnetic absorption function can be used for absorbing magnetism in a metal bracket or a metal wall at will, and a hanging member is shaped.

title_en: Livestock and veterinary isolation cage
abstract_en: The utility model provides a livestock or poultry animal is with keeping apart cage, includes keeps apart cage bottom plate, horizontal sideboard, vertical sideboard, middle fixed plate, rectangle installation piece, rotation baffle, pivot, first rotation hypoplastron, middle linking board, second rotation hypoplastron, the cage bottom plate is kept apart in angle fixed column lower part connection, horizontal sideboard is connected to angle fixed column side, vertical sideboard lower part connection keeps apart the cage bottom plate, vertical sideboard side connection is horizontal sideboard, evenly distributed from top to bottom, a plurality of vertical sideboards horizontal evenly distributed, the cage bottom plate is kept apart in middle fixed plate lower part connection, the horizontal sideboard is connected to middle fixed plate side, first rotation hypoplastron side has a side connection axle sleeve, a side connection axle sleeve suits with middle fixed plate, a side connection axle sleeve inserts middle fixed plate, middle fixed plate has a location axostylus axostyle jack, the location axostylus axostyle suits with the location axostyle jack, middle fixed plate passes through the location axostylus axostyle and connects the axle sleeve.

title_en: Garlic grading table
abstract_en: The utility model provides a garlic classification platform, relate to garlic processingequipment technical field, the on-line screen storage device comprises a base, be provided with two backup pads on the base, rotate between two backup pads and install screening subassembly, screening subassembly includes U template, the pivot, baffle and sieve, rotate between the both sides of U template and two backup pads respectively and be connected, the spout has been seted up to the bottom of U template, the sieve is installed through the spout to the U template, the pivot is installed at the open end top of U template, the baffle is installed through the pivot to the U template, install the roof on the base, fixed mounting has the motor on the roof, the output shaft of motor passes the roof and is connected with the control panel, the control panel passes through the connecting plate and is connected with screening subassembly rotation. According to the utility model, the motor drives the control panel, so that the connecting plate drives the screening assembly, the screening assembly swings around the supporting plate back and forth, garlic with different sizes can be screened out from the screen plate, the problems of time and labor waste in the existing garlic classification are solved, the screening efficiency is improved, and the labor intensity is reduced.

title_en: Flue-cured tobacco bud suppression device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of agricultural equipment and discloses a flue-cured tobacco bud suppression device which comprises an electric sprayer and also comprises scissors, wherein one cutter handle of each pair of scissors is fixed on a spray boom of the electric sprayer, a pull rope is fixed on the other cutter handle of each pair of scissors, a rotating shaft of each pair of scissors is close to a spray head of the electric sprayer, a spring is arranged between the two cutter handles of each pair of scissors in a compression mode, a limiting ring is fixed on the spray boom, the limiting ring is sleeved on the pull rope, a finger ring is fixed at one end, far away from each pair of scissors, of the pull rope, and the finger ring is close to a grip of the spray boom. The utility model has the advantages that the scissors are arranged on the spray boom, the bud tops can be cut off by pulling the pull ropes through fingers buckled in the finger rings, the bending or squatting is not needed, the labor intensity is reduced, and the spray boom can be used for accurately and timely spraying the inhibitor on the flue-cured tobacco after the bud tops are cut off.

title_en: Konjak porous food material preliminary embryo shaping filling device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a konjak porous food material preliminary blank forming and filling device, which comprises a stirring paddle, an air compressor, a three-way valve, a bottom air supply pipe, a pressure regulating air inlet control valve, a water inlet device, an alkaline water supply device and a discharging device, wherein the stirring paddle is arranged in a tank body and is connected with a main shaft of a motor, the motor is fixedly arranged at the top of the tank body, the top of the tank body is provided with a solid material feeding device for feeding raw materials, the air compressor is connected with the three-way valve through a main air supply pipe, one outlet of the three-way valve is connected with the bottom air supply pipe, the bottom air supply pipe is communicated with the bottom of the tank body through the pressure regulating air inlet control valve, the other outlet of the three-way valve is communicated with the upper part of the tank body through the pressure sensing automatic air inlet control valve, the side wall of the tank body is communicated with the water inlet device, the side wall of the tank body is communicated with the alkaline water supply device for supplying alkaline water, and the bottom of the tank body is provided with the discharging device. In the preparation process, a small amount of air is introduced into the bottom, so that bubbles can be formed rapidly and fully, the large air holes can be formed in the food material primary blank conveniently, and the product quality requirement can be met.

title_en: Laser selective metal 3D prints preheating device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of metal powder laser melting additive manufacturing, and discloses a laser selective metal 3D printing preheating device which comprises a shell, wherein a side plate is fixedly connected to the top end of the shell, a printing forming plate is arranged on the inner wall of the shell, a preheating mechanism is arranged on the upper surface of the shell, the preheating mechanism comprises a constant temperature component, a fixing component and a heating component, the constant temperature component comprises a mounting plate, a reflecting plate is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the mounting plate, heating rods are fixedly connected to the inner wall of the mounting plate, the number of the heating rods is multiple, sliding grooves are formed in the inner wall of the side plate, and a sliding block I is connected to the inner wall of the sliding groove in a sliding mode. According to the utility model, by arranging the constant temperature component, the paved metal powder can be kept at the temperature when the powder is paved in the powder storage bin, so that the paved metal powder is prevented from being rapidly cooled due to the increase of the contact area, the preheating effect of the heating component is reduced, and the preheating effect of the device is improved.

title_en: Easy demoulding concrete examination mould
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an easy-to-demold concrete test mold which comprises a base, a boss, a plurality of coamings, a mounting seat, a sliding block and a driving mechanism, wherein the base is horizontally arranged on a tabletop, the boss is arranged on the upper end face of the base, the coamings are vertically arranged on the base and surround the boss, a mold cavity with an upper end opening is formed by the boss, the mounting seat is arranged on the outer wall of the coamings, the sliding block is connected with the mounting seat and slides in the circumferential direction along the central position of the base, and the driving mechanism is used for controlling the sliding blocks to synchronously slide. The concrete forming device has the advantages that the sliding coaming matching bosses are arranged to jointly form the die cavity for concrete forming, and after the concrete is formed, all coamings are controlled to be away from each other, so that the rapid separation of the concrete and the test die is realized, and the effect of convenient demoulding is achieved.

title_en: Polyurethane foaming machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a polyurethane foaming machine which comprises a first charging basket, a second charging basket, a first feeding pipe provided with a first hydraulic pump, a second feeding pipe provided with a second hydraulic pump, a mixing gun, a first feeding pipe provided with a first overflow valve and a first control valve in sequence, and a second feeding pipe provided with a second overflow valve and a second control valve in sequence, wherein one end of the first feeding pipe is communicated with the first charging basket, the other end of the first feeding pipe is communicated with the mixing gun, one end of the second feeding pipe is communicated with the second charging basket, the other end of the second feeding pipe is communicated with the mixing gun, one end of the first feeding pipe is connected with the first charging basket, the other end of the first feeding pipe is connected with the other end of the first feeding pipe, one end of the second feeding pipe is connected with the second charging basket, and the other end of the second feeding pipe is connected with the other end of the second feeding pipe. Compared with the prior art, the utility model has the advantages of ensuring that the polyurethane raw materials can be uniformly mixed when the mixing gun is opened after the shutdown, avoiding material waste and effectively reducing the occurrence of shutdown and production shutdown caused by the blockage of the mixing gun.

title_en: Corn seed storage device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a corn seed storage device, which comprises a walking vehicle, a fan arranged at the upper end of the walking vehicle, a ventilation assembly arranged at one side of the walking vehicle, a four-way pipe detachably connected with the rear end of a fixed pipe, control valves arranged at the left side and the right side of the four-way pipe, an air duct communicated with an air outlet of the fan, a quick connector detachably connected with the front end of the fixed pipe, a control panel arranged at the upper end of the walking vehicle, and a plurality of groups of quick connectors arranged between every two adjacent ventilation assemblies and communicated through the communication pipe. The utility model not only can realize the heat radiation and ventilation effects when corn seeds are stored, but also can be suitable for storage devices with different sizes and types, can play a role in flexible use, and has higher applicability.

title_en: Be used for camel forage crushing mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model provides a camel forage crushing mechanism which comprises a crushing machine body, wherein a crushing box is arranged on the crushing machine body, a crushing discharging pipe is arranged on the crushing box, a nipple with a downward opening is arranged on the crushing discharging pipe, a turnover barrel is fixedly connected to the bottom of the nipple, a rotary table is opened at the bottom of the turnover barrel and connected with the turnover barrel, an eccentrically distributed blanking pipe is arranged at the bottom of the rotary table, and a scraper is connected in the turnover barrel in a rotating manner. According to the utility model, the blanking pipes which are eccentrically distributed by the peripheral drum, the rotary table and the opposite rotary table are arranged, so that materials discharged by the crushing discharging pipes after crushing the crushing box are conveniently discharged to different positions, the problem that the in-situ stacking needs to be manually spread is avoided, and the continuous bagging treatment of the follow-up crushing materials is facilitated.

title_en: Plant lamp
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of plant growth lighting tools, in particular to a lamp for plants, which comprises a lamp tube, wherein the lamp tube comprises a light-transmitting plate and a light-shielding plate, a lamp bead assembly and a heat dissipation assembly are arranged in the lamp tube in a penetrating manner, the lamp tube comprises a first end and a second end, the first end is provided with a first end cover, the first end cover is connected with a power supply assembly, the lamp bead assembly is close to the first end and is connected with a power supply assembly, the power supply assembly is connected with the power supply assembly, and the second end is provided with a second end cover. The utility model has simple structure, convenient assembly, good heat radiation performance and good waterproof performance of the integrally formed lamp tube.

title_en: Pottery clay billet cutting device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a ceramic adobe cutting device which comprises a cutting table and a cutting driving mechanism, wherein the upper end of the cutting table is fixedly connected with a driving frame, an adjustable cutting frame is arranged in the driving frame, the cutting driving mechanism comprises a rotating shaft, a driving handle, sliding seats and sliding rails, the rotating shaft is respectively and symmetrically connected to the upper ends of the inner walls of the left side and the right side of the driving frame in a rotating mode, one end, close to the center of the cutting table, of the rotating shaft is fixedly connected with the driving handle, the lower end of the driving handle is respectively and rotatably connected with the sliding seats, the sliding rails are respectively and fixedly connected to the left end and the right end of the cutting frame, the lower ends of the sliding seats are respectively and slidably connected with the corresponding ends of the vertically adjacent sliding rails, a control switch group is arranged in the middle of the left side surface of the driving frame, the input ends of the control switch group are electrically connected with an external power supply, and the ceramic adobe cutting device can meet cutting requirements of ceramic adobe with different lengths, and meanwhile stable cutting of ceramic adobe is realized by the cutting frame with four-point stressed cutting frames.

title_en: Stick sticking automatic line capable of improving productivity
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an adhesive rod automatic line capable of improving productivity, which comprises an automatic assembly line, wherein a feeding seat is arranged at the end part of the automatic assembly line in a positioning way, a discharging device, a cleaning device, a gluing device, a silicon rod feeding device and a weight feeding device are sequentially arranged at the side of the automatic assembly line, the silicon rod feeding line is arranged at the side of the silicon rod feeding device, a silicon rod feeding station is arranged at the position of the automatic assembly line, which is positioned on a rotating seat, a weight feeding station is arranged at the position of the automatic assembly line, and a scram safety device and a grating alarm device are arranged at the position of the weight feeding station. According to the stick sticking automatic line capable of improving productivity, two operation actions of a silicon stick feeding process are decomposed, beat time of the link is shortened, a group of grating alarms are increased, a module cannot act when staff processes a splice joint, an emergency stop safety device is increased, and a line body can stop running in emergency.

title_en: Seedling culture device is planted to rice
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of rice and discloses a rice seedling cultivation device which comprises an incubator, wherein a supporting plate is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the incubator, a planting chamber is arranged in the incubator, a red light lamp bead is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the incubator, a blue light lamp bead is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the incubator, a groove is formed in the inner wall of the incubator, a guide rod is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the groove, a guide block is slidably connected to the outer wall of the guide rod, a lug is fixedly connected to the top end of the guide block, a switch is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the groove, a connecting rope is fixedly connected to the outer wall of the guide block, and a floating ball is fixedly connected to the end part of the connecting rope. According to the utility model, through the structures such as the floating ball, the guide rod, the guide block and the like, oxygenation is carried out on water according to the change of the water level, so that the root system of rice is prevented from being subjected to anoxic stress, and the cultivation effect of rice seedlings is ensured.

title_en: Proliferation releasing throwing device of movable platform
