abstract_en: The utility model discloses a proliferation releasing and throwing device of a movable platform, which comprises a releasing box, wherein a water inlet hole is formed in the releasing box, a water inlet pipe is communicated with a water outlet Kong Jinshui hole, a water pump is communicated with one end of the water inlet pipe, which is far away from the releasing box, an opening and closing mechanism is arranged on the water outlet hole, the opening and closing mechanism is used for controlling the water outlet hole, a partition plate is fixedly connected in the releasing box, the partition plate divides the releasing box into a water adding chamber and a throwing chamber, the water inlet hole is positioned in the throwing chamber, a through hole is formed in the partition plate, a water outlet pipe is arranged on the water outlet hole, a hose is detachably connected to the water outlet pipe, a connecting pipe is detachably connected to one end of the hose, which is far away from the water outlet pipe, a plurality of releasing grooves are detachably connected to the connecting pipe, a plurality of telescopic supporting legs are fixedly connected to the releasing box, universal wheels are arranged on the telescopic supporting legs, and a plurality of handles are fixedly connected to the releasing box. The utility model not only can realize the function of releasing and throwing, but also can be disassembled, is convenient to carry and carry, and is more convenient to use.

title_en: Internal thread structure of plastic product forming die
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of dies and discloses an internal thread structure of a plastic product forming die, which comprises a base, wherein a ball screw is fixedly connected to the upper part of the base, a driving gear is fixedly connected to the outer side of the ball screw, main rotary cores are arranged on the left side and the rear side of the ball screw, auxiliary spiral parts are fixedly connected to the middle side of the outer part of the main rotary cores, a transmission gear is fixedly arranged on the lower side of the auxiliary spiral parts, a product is arranged on the upper side of the main rotary cores, the transmission gear is in meshed connection with the driving gear, and the product is in threaded connection with the outer side of the main rotary cores. According to the utility model, when the die needs to be opened, the die plate drives the ball screw to rotate, the ball screw rotates to drive the driving gear to rotate, and the driving gear rotates to drive the transmission gear to rotate, so that power transmission is realized, the thread starting point can be ensured, the stability is good, the production period is short, and the efficiency is improved.

title_en: Treatment apparatus for treating styrene-acrylonitrile
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a processing device (1) comprising a processing screw (4) for processing dehydrated rubber (7) and styrene-acrylonitrile, a dehydrating screw (2) for dehydrating wet rubber (6) and for providing the dehydrated rubber (7), and a feeding device (3) for feeding the dehydrated rubber (7) into the at least one processing screw (4). Since the dewatering and the treatment are mechanically separate, a simple, flexible and efficient treatment can be achieved.

title_en: Humidity control device for dried edible fungi
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a humidity control device for dried edible mushrooms, which comprises a box body, wherein a placement frame is slidably arranged in the box body, a humidity sensor is arranged on the inner side wall of the box body, a humidifier is arranged at the bottom of the side wall of the box body, a dehumidifier is arranged at the bottom of the box body, a ventilation opening is arranged at the top of the box body, and a placement screen plate is movably arranged in the placement frame. The utility model belongs to the technical field of humidity control devices, and particularly relates to a humidity control device for dried edible fungi.

title_en: Net clothes cultivation and offshore photovoltaic fusion equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a net cage culture and offshore photovoltaic fusion device which comprises a support, a net cage culture box, a photovoltaic panel and a floating body, wherein the net cage culture box is used for culturing fishery and is connected with the support, the photovoltaic panel for carrying out photovoltaic power generation is arranged on the support, the floating body is connected with the support to enable the support to float, the net cage culture box is connected with the support, anchor points of the traditional net cage culture box are reduced, the rolling swing of the support is reduced, sea space is saved, and double benefits of fishery culture and photovoltaic power generation are realized in the same sea area.

title_en: Continuous forming device for activated carbon
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of activated carbon production equipment, in particular to an activated carbon continuous forming device which comprises a first conveying table, a second conveying table and a sliding support frame, wherein the first conveying table is positioned at the front end of the second conveying table, the sliding support frame is slidably arranged on the second conveying table, the device also comprises a cutting assembly and a moving assembly, the cutting assembly comprises a plurality of connecting plates, a plurality of steel wires, a transverse support plate and a lifting member, the plurality of connecting plates are fixedly connected with the transverse support plate and uniformly distributed at the front end and the rear end of the transverse support plate, the plurality of steel wires are respectively arranged between the two connecting plates, the transverse support plate is connected with the sliding support frame through the lifting member and positioned below the sliding support frame, the lifting member is arranged on the sliding support frame and connected with the transverse support frame, the transverse support plate is driven to move, the whole device has continuity, the moving activated carbon is pushed to move and the effect of improving the active production and processing quality.

title_en: Controllable isolated fabric distributing mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of concrete brick production equipment, in particular to a controllable isolation type fabric distributing mechanism which comprises a die box, die cavities, a skip car, a bin, a skip car front wall, a skip car rear wall and a blanking control mechanism. According to the utility model, the bin carrying the fabric is fed into the die cavity of the die box through the skip car, and the bin is controlled to vertically feed into the die cavity or timely feed the material, so that the controllable feeding amount of the bin is realized, the bin is isolated from the die cavity, and the feeding amount of each die cavity is more uniform and more saturated, thereby ensuring the density of the building block, improving the molding quality of the brick, and improving the practicability.

title_en: 3D prints shaping integral type mold core with thermal-insulated structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides a 3D printing forming integrated mold core with a heat insulation structure, which comprises a bearing assembly member, a raw material guiding member, a raw material input member, a cooling member, a circulating connecting member, an injection molding exhaust member and a heat conduction isolation member, wherein the mold core is manufactured by 3D printing, each part of the mold core is integrally formed, the manufacturing process can be simplified, the integrity and the structural strength of the mold core can be improved, a cooling water channel with a spiral structure corresponds to the front section part position of the raw material guiding member, can carry out cooling to the raw materials more effectively and handle, help accelerating cooling rate, improve production efficiency, exhaust side opening helps in time to discharge gas at the in-process of moulding plastics, prevent the production of bubble and defect to improve the appearance quality and the performance of product, keep apart the intermediate layer and will bear the weight of the assembly component and separate into cooling anterior segment and heat preservation posterior segment, reducible thermal transfer and loss help keeping the whole temperature stability of mold core, further guarantee the quality of product.

title_en: Automatic double-sided adhesive tape compounding device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic double-sided adhesive composite device which comprises a device main body, a double-sided adhesive film layer and double-sided adhesive film base material composite materials, wherein the device main body consists of a discharging mechanism, a compression roller pressing mechanism, a control panel, a limiting mechanism and a winding mechanism, double-sided adhesive film discharging support frames are arranged on two sides of the top end of the device main body, the double-sided adhesive film layer is arranged on the inner sides of the double-sided adhesive film discharging support frames, the double-sided adhesive film base material composite materials are pressed, compounded and adhered through the compression roller main body and then are pressed and flattened again, air bubbles generated in the compounding process of single-roll base materials and double-sided adhesive layers are reduced, and therefore the adhesion and fixation performance of the double-sided adhesive film base materials are improved, and the whole process is automated when the base material materials and the double-sided adhesive films are compounded through the collocation of the discharging mechanism, the compression roller pressing mechanism, the control panel, the limiting mechanism and the winding mechanism.

title_en: Liquid medicine disinfection pruning shears
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of forest protection, and provides a liquid medicine disinfection pruning shear which comprises a shear body, a liquid medicine bottle, a sprayer, a first guide pipe, a second guide pipe and a collecting bowl, wherein the shear body comprises a mounting seat, a fixed blade and a movable blade, the fixed blade is fixed at one end of the mounting seat, the movable blade is rotationally connected with the fixed blade, the sprayer is fixed on the upper side surface of the movable blade, the spraying direction of the sprayer faces to the knife edge of the movable blade and the knife edge of the fixed blade, the liquid medicine bottle is fixed on the mounting seat, the sprayer is connected with a liquid outlet of the liquid medicine bottle through the first guide pipe, the collecting bowl is fixed on the lower side of the fixed blade, a drainage port is arranged at the bowl bottom of the collecting bowl, one end of the second guide pipe is connected with the drainage port, and the other end of the second guide pipe is connected with a liquid inlet of the liquid medicine bottle, and the bowl opening of the collecting bowl is obliquely arranged and faces to the knife edge of the fixed blade. The utility model can realize simultaneous pruning of branches and disinfection of liquid medicine, has short time consumption and improves the efficiency of pruning the forest.

title_en: Printing bed structure for 3D printing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a printing bed structure for 3D printing equipment, which belongs to the field of 3D printing equipment and comprises a printing bed, wherein the printing bed comprises a mounting frame and a supporting platform arranged on the mounting frame, the supporting platform comprises a left supporting plate and a right supporting plate which are arranged left and right, a bending space is formed between the left supporting plate and the right supporting plate, the left supporting plate and the right supporting plate are horizontally arranged, the upper surfaces of the left supporting plate and the right supporting plate are positioned on the same horizontal plane to form a mounting surface, a flat-plate-shaped aluminum plate is fixedly attached to the mounting surface, the mounting frame comprises a left connecting arm fixedly connected with the bottom of the left supporting plate and a right connecting arm fixedly connected with the bottom of the right supporting plate, the left connecting arm and the right connecting arm are mutually and rotatably connected through a rotating connecting structure, and the printing bed also comprises a mounting base used for mounting the printing bed, and the printing bed is mounted on the mounting base through the mounting frame. The utility model can avoid the situation that the printed piece is damaged due to the removal of the printed piece.

title_en: Gas circulation pump and tire vulcanizing device comprising same
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of tire vulcanization, and particularly relates to a gas circulation pump and a tire vulcanization device comprising the same. The gas circulation pump comprises a first thermal pipeline, a second thermal pipeline and a third thermal pipeline which are sequentially communicated, wherein a movable structure is arranged in the second thermal pipeline, the second thermal pipeline is divided into a first cavity and a second cavity by the movable structure, the first cavity is communicated with the first thermal pipeline through a first one-way valve, the second cavity is communicated with the third thermal pipeline through a third one-way valve, the gas circulation pump further comprises a bypass branch, one end of the bypass branch is communicated with the first cavity, the other end of the bypass branch is communicated with the second cavity, and the bypass branch is provided with a second one-way valve. The application realizes the gas pressurizing device with a single movable structure through few parts, has more compact structure, high applicability, universal and easy replacement of parts, is easy to maintain and replace, and reduces the manufacturing cost and the maintenance cost of equipment.

title_en: Ecological bank protection that rainwater was collected
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an ecological slope protection for rainwater collection, which comprises a plant-growing bag layer, an inclined slope surface, a bottom layer design terrace layer and a flood-intercepting drought stream, wherein the plant-growing bag layer is obliquely downwards arranged along the top layer design terrace layer, the plant-growing bag layer comprises a plurality of plant-growing bags stacked and arranged along the edge of the top layer design terrace layer, a metal net is fixedly anchored on the inclined slope surface along the slope surface, a planting base layer is sprayed on the surface of the metal net, the flood-intercepting drought stream is recessed relative to the bottom layer design terrace layer, the flood-intercepting drought stream sequentially comprises an aquifer layer, a clay protection layer, a non-woven fabric layer, a bentonite waterproof blanket layer, a non-woven fabric layer, a sand soil layer and an plain soil layer from top to bottom, and the plant-growing bags are obliquely upwards paved along the side slopes on two sides of the flood-intercepting drought stream from the clay protection layer. According to the utility model, by combining ecological slope protection with rainwater collection, the purpose of slope protection can be realized, rainwater can be collected and stored, and water source supply is provided for plant growth.

title_en: Balance ring type string hanging column on composite bow eccentric wheel
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a balance ring type string hanging column on a composite bow eccentric wheel, which comprises an eccentric wheel, wherein a connecting piece is arranged on the eccentric wheel, a string hanging sleeve is sleeved on the connecting piece, the eccentric wheel comprises an eccentric wheel main body, the eccentric wheel main body is provided with a concave structure, a connecting hole matched with the connecting piece is formed in the position of the concave structure of the eccentric wheel main body, a string groove is formed in the outer side of the eccentric wheel main body, the string hanging sleeve comprises a sleeve main body, a first limiting ring and a second limiting ring are respectively arranged at two ends of the sleeve main body, and a jack matched with the connecting piece is formed in the sleeve main body. According to the utility model, the string hanging sleeve can rotate on the connecting piece, so that the string tension force of the strings (of the bows on two sides of the integrated bowstring) is nearly consistent, and the string hanging column exists, so that the string tension force is consistent, the adjusting process is also automatic, the rebound speed is consistent, and the driven marble seat is stressed more (balanced) and accurate.

title_en: Marine concatenation formula modularization plant cultivation basin
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a marine spliced modularized plant planting water tank which is applied to the field of planting water tanks and comprises a planting tank, wherein planting plates are placed in the planting tank, connecting plates are symmetrically placed at the tops of the planting plates, one sides of the connecting plates are attached to the inner walls of the planting tank, fixing bolts penetrate through one sides of the connecting plates, the other ends of the fixing bolts are connected with fixing nuts in a threaded manner, through grooves are formed in the tops of the planting plates, planting baskets are placed in the through grooves, and fixing rods are symmetrically installed at the tops of the planting baskets. Can possess assembled concatenation function, can make the basin become the modularization and divide into a plurality of independent tiny and pass through from the passageway department, the practicality is high.

title_en: Guiding device for plastic plate extrusion production line
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of plastic plate production, and discloses a guide device for a plastic plate extrusion production line, wherein conveying rollers are arranged in a front dense and rear sparse mode, the supporting contact area of the bottom of a plate in a hot melting state can be increased through the conveying rollers densely arranged at the front part, the contact pressure is reduced to avoid deformation damage of the plate, a limiting side seat is arranged at the upper part of the conveying rollers in a limiting mode through bolts, the limiting width can be flexibly adjusted according to the size of the plate during operation, the device can meet the conveying and guiding requirements of plates with different sizes while collision damage of the plate is avoided, the conveying rollers are subjected to a contact water-cooled cooling mode, the lower part of the conveying rollers is contacted with water liquid in a guide conveying seat during rotation operation of the conveying rollers, adhesion between the conveying rollers and the plate can be avoided through the water liquid, cooling is performed through a fin type heat dissipation structure, and the cooling efficiency of the plate can be effectively improved.

title_en: Water conservancy construction cementer
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of water conservancy construction grouting, in particular to a water conservancy construction grouting device. The fixing device comprises a fixing component, wherein the fixing component comprises a fixing ring, a sliding block is arranged on one side of the fixing ring in a bilateral symmetry sliding mode, clamping rings are inserted in the middle of the sliding block in a rotating mode, fixing blocks are arranged on the upper side of the fixing ring in a bilateral symmetry sliding mode, and the fixing blocks are perpendicular to each other. According to the utility model, the two sliding blocks are driven to rotate while the shell shakes, when the bumping amplitude is larger, the two sliding blocks increase the rotation amplitude and drive the fixed ring to rotate, the stirring bin is kept still all the time under the pressing of the two damping springs, the device can automatically stabilize the stirring bin, the pollution to the device caused by cement inside the stirring bin when the device is in a bumping road section due to cement spilling out is prevented, and the practicability of the device is improved.

title_en: Vegetable processing cleaning equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses vegetable processing and cleaning equipment, which comprises a cleaning machine body, wherein a punching and pushing mechanism is arranged at the top of the cleaning machine body and comprises two long supporting blocks, a straight pipe, a plurality of spray heads, a holding pipe, a water supply hose, a water suction pump and two short supporting blocks, one side of one long supporting block is provided with a first positioning hole, the back surface of one short supporting block is provided with an extension block, one side of the extension block is provided with a second positioning hole, the outer wall of the holding pipe is sleeved with a mounting plate, one side of the mounting plate is provided with a threaded hole, and the inner cavity of the threaded hole is provided with a positioning bolt. According to the utility model, by means of the arrangement of the flushing mechanism, stacked vegetables can be driven to enter the cleaning area of the bubble cleaning machine in a flushing manner through the cooperation of the straight pipe, the spray head, the hand-held pipe, the water supply hose, the water suction pump, the short supporting block, the extension block, the mounting plate and the positioning bolt, so that the situation that the vegetables stay in the cleaning pool for too long time is effectively avoided, and the efficiency of vegetable cleaning work is improved.

title_en: Device for in-situ printing lymph node regeneration
abstract_en: The utility model provides an in-situ printing lymph node regeneration device, which comprises an operation arm, a combined connection pile, an adjusting component, a control component and a control component, wherein the combined connection pile consists of a connection pipe and a spray head, the combined connection pile is arranged at one end of the operation arm, and the adjusting component comprises a fixed ring fixedly arranged at one end of the spray head, a movable disc arranged in the fixed ring and a plurality of movable blocks, and is used for controlling and adjusting the aperture of the spray head; according to the utility model, the operation arm, the connecting pipe, the spray head, the ultraviolet lamp and the adjusting component are arranged, and the spray caliber of the spray head is controlled by the adjusting component, so that printing staff can conveniently realize quick printing of printing models with different demands without frequently replacing spray heads with different models, meanwhile, the precision degree of the printing model can be effectively controlled by controlling the caliber of the output material, and the phenomenon that the printing model is not completely solidified due to insufficient irradiation of the ultraviolet lamp is prevented.

title_en: Classified storage device for hybrid seeds of rice
abstract_en: The utility model discloses rice hybrid seed classified storage equipment which comprises a shell, supports fixedly connected to four corners of the bottom of the shell, a yielding hole integrally arranged at the top end of the inside of the shell, a filtering assembly assembled at the upper end of the inside of the shell, and a storage device for storing rice hybrid seeds. According to the mechanical linkage design, rice seeds placed in the barrel can be subjected to vibration treatment, so that rice seeds with smaller volume in vibration can fall into the lower end of the shell body through screening of the screen mesh for storage, and seeds with larger volume are stored in the barrel body, so that the effect of classifying and storing the rice seeds is improved. By the design of the branch discharging function, small-volume rice seeds and large-volume rice seeds can be discharged from the first discharging assembly and the second discharging assembly respectively, so that the convenience of the user for the subsequent use of the small-volume rice seeds and the large-volume rice seeds is ensured by using the device.

title_en: Automatic material sucking machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of a material sucking machine, in particular to an automatic material sucking machine, which comprises a material cylinder, wherein the side wall of the material cylinder is communicated with a material inlet, the top of the material cylinder is provided with a top cover, a filter screen is arranged in the material cylinder and positioned above the material inlet, a scraping plate is arranged on the lower surface of the filter screen, the scraping plate is in sliding fit with the lower surface of the filter screen, a rotating shaft is arranged on the top cover, the bottom end of the rotating shaft movably penetrates through the filter screen and is connected with the scraping plate, and a driving piece for driving the scraping plate to rotate is arranged on the top cover. The utility model has the effect of conveniently cleaning the filter screen.

title_en: Sleeper production line turnover mould structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sleeper production line turnover mould structure, and relates to the technical field of sleeper production. The utility model comprises a rectangular bottom plate and a placing plate arranged above the rectangular bottom plate, wherein the rectangular bottom plate and the placing plate are provided with a clamping mechanism and a turnover mechanism, the clamping mechanism comprises a motor sleeve fixedly connected to the bottom of the rectangular bottom plate, a motor I is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the motor sleeve, an output shaft of the motor I is fixedly connected with a rotating shaft through a coupler, the top of the rotating shaft is in rotating connection with the placing plate, the outer wall of the rotating shaft is fixedly connected with a rotating rod, and the turnover mechanism comprises two L-shaped connecting rods hinged to the top of the rectangular bottom plate. The utility model solves the problems that the existing sleeper production line turnover mould structure is easy to collide with a mould or other parts in the use process, so that the surface of the sleeper is scratched, falls off angles, lacks edges and the like, and the appearance quality and the dimensional accuracy of the sleeper are affected.

title_en: Kelp silk processing soaks edulcoration device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of kelp processing, and discloses a kelp processing, soaking and impurity removing device which comprises a tank assembly used for soaking dry kelp and removing impurities, and further comprises a converging assembly which is arranged at one end of the bottom of the tank assembly and used for storing and converging sediment towards the center, and a sediment discharging assembly which is arranged in the middle of the bottom of the converging assembly and used for lifting sediment to be discharged outwards, wherein the converging assembly comprises a settling tank, a pushing mechanism used for converging sediment towards the center is arranged in the middle of the settling tank, a second sediment outlet is arranged in the center of the bottom of the settling tank, the sediment discharging assembly comprises a sediment discharging barrel, the sediment discharging barrel is obliquely arranged, a connecting pipe is arranged at the bottom of the sediment discharging barrel, a lifting mechanism is arranged in the middle of the sediment discharging barrel, a third sediment outlet is arranged at the top of the sediment discharging barrel, and the height of the third sediment outlet is higher than the height of the water level in the tank assembly. According to the kelp thread processing, soaking and impurity removing device, the sediment discharge arrangement is improved, the loss of water liquid is avoided, and water resources are saved.

title_en: Automatic quantitative feeding device for bright beads
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of firework and firecracker production, in particular to an automatic quantitative bright bead feeding device. The utility model provides the automatic bright bead quantitative feeding device which can improve the bright bead feeding quality and precision without missing problems. The utility model provides an automatic ration pan feeding device of bright bead, is including installing case, swing frame and first electric putter etc. and the installation case top is opened has the interpolation mouth, and the inside sliding connection of installing case has the swing frame, and the installation case left and right sides all is connected with first electric putter. According to the utility model, the first electric push rod is used for controlling the swinging frame to reciprocate left and right, the swinging frame reciprocates left and right to control the internal bright beads to roll, meanwhile, the driver is used for controlling the rotating disc to rotate, the rotating disc drives the fixed block to rotate, the fixed block rotates to match with the left and right swinging of the swinging frame, so that the bright beads can accurately fall into holes on the fixed block, the problem of missing does not occur, and the bright bead feeding quality and precision are improved.

title_en: Intelligent mower
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent mower, which comprises a mower body, wherein an opening is formed in the top of the mower body, a collision piece is arranged on the top of the mower body and configured to protrude out of the top of the mower body through the opening, and at least partially retract into the top of the mower body under the action of external force, the intelligent mower can execute corresponding actions at least comprising a first action and a second action according to the retraction state of the collision piece, the first action is executed as forward movement when the intelligent mower executes mowing operation and the collision piece does not retract into the mower body in the vertical direction, the second action is executed when the collision piece is in the retraction state and the force applied by the collision piece from top to bottom is smaller than 10 newtons in the process of executing the mowing operation, and the second action is continuous forward movement, so that the problem of poor judgment accuracy of the intelligent mower on suspended obstacles is solved.

title_en: Interactive pet feeding device
abstract_en: The utility model provides an interactive pet feeder, and belongs to the technical field of pet feeders. The interactive pet feeder comprises an equipment cabin, a grain storage barrel, a top cover and a bowl seat, wherein the grain storage barrel is arranged at the top end of the equipment cabin, two groups of movable buckles are sleeved on two sides of the inner wall of the equipment cabin in a sliding manner, and the extending ends of the grain storage barrel are movably clamped on the outer wall of the movable buckles. The pet feeding device has the advantages that the pet touches the interaction button, the back surface of the interaction button is contacted with the touch sensor I, the touch sensor which receives signals sends a prompt to the mobile phone end, the host which receives the prompt can observe the state of the pet through the camera module by using the mobile phone end, and can control the feeder to discharge grains through the mobile phone end, so that the effect of dynamic feeding is achieved, the participation of the host in the feeding process of the pet can be increased through the remote feeding system, the feeding state of the pet can be observed through the camera module, and the host can know the state of the pet conveniently.

title_en: Pasteurization and quenching kneading integrated device for butter production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pasteurization and rapid cooling kneading integrated device for butter production, which comprises a pasteurization unit, a transition unit, a rapid cooling unit and a kneading unit, wherein the pasteurization unit comprises a pasteurization tank, a heating wire for heating is arranged in the tank wall of the pasteurization tank, a rotating shaft is arranged in the pasteurization tank, stirring blades for stirring are arranged on the rotating shaft, the transition unit comprises a transition tank, a first screw rod is arranged in the transition tank, a second motor is arranged on the side surface of the first screw rod, the rapid cooling unit comprises a rapid cooling tank, a rapid cooling pipe is arranged in the tank wall of the rapid cooling tank, and the kneading unit comprises a kneading tank. According to the pasteurization and quenching kneading integrated device for butter production, a transition unit for gradually cooling is arranged between pasteurization and quenching kneading, so that the temperature of butter is gradually reduced, the temperature difference between butter and a quenching unit is reduced, and the quenching effect and the product quality of butter are improved.

title_en: Three-dimensional batching system for preparing high polymer modified asphalt
abstract_en: The application relates to a three-dimensional batching system for preparing high polymer modified asphalt, which relates to the field of asphalt preparation and comprises a heat exchanger, a standard asphalt feed pump, a high polymer crusher, a disperser, a modified asphalt kneader, a batching tank, a modified asphalt discharge pump and a homogenizer, wherein a feed port of the disperser is connected with a discharge port of the high polymer crusher, the discharge port is connected with a first feed port of the modified asphalt kneader, an output end of the heat exchanger is connected with an input end of the standard asphalt feed pump, an output end of the standard asphalt feed pump is respectively connected with a second feed port of the modified asphalt kneader and a first feed port of the batching tank, the second feed port of the batching tank is connected with a discharge port of the modified asphalt kneader, the discharge port is connected with an input end of the modified asphalt discharge pump, and an output end of the modified asphalt discharge pump is connected with the homogenizer. The application can crush the high polymer SBS at one time, and the crushed particles and the rubber powder can be uniformly dissolved in the preheated matrix asphalt, thereby improving the production efficiency and reducing the electric energy consumption.

title_en: Colorful feed allocation device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of feed allocation, and discloses a gorgeous feed allocation device which comprises a shell and a discharge pipe, wherein a cover body is movably arranged on the shell, a mounting hole matched with the discharge pipe is formed in the cover body, a rotating table is rotatably arranged in the shell, placing grooves are formed in the rotating table at equal intervals, a taking opening is formed in the shell, a leakage receiving mechanism is arranged on the shell, and a driving mechanism is arranged on the shell. According to the utility model, the rotating table is driven by the servo motor to automatically rotate, after the container is received, the subsequent empty container can be quickly and smoothly moved to the position right below the discharge pipe, the transfer activity of filling the container and the adding activity of the empty container are carried out at other positions, frequent stopping activity is not needed, the continuity of the material receiving activity is stronger, the efficiency is higher, meanwhile, the receiving plate with the collecting cavity is utilized to effectively catch and replace the feed which possibly leaks in the gap of the container, and the continuity and the cleanliness of the operation are ensured.

title_en: Auricularia auricula-judae fungus culturing system
abstract_en: The utility model provides an edible fungus culturing system which comprises a culturing room body with a heat preservation layer, a culturing base frame arranged in the culturing room body, a temperature regulating device arranged in the culturing room body, a humidity regulating device arranged in the culturing room body, a ventilating device arranged on the culturing room body, a plurality of sensors arranged at different positions in the culturing room body and an electric control device arranged outside the culturing room body, wherein the electric control device is respectively and electrically connected with the sensors, the temperature regulating device, the humidity regulating device and the ventilating device, the temperature regulating device comprises a plurality of heat pipes and a plurality of uniform heat convection assemblies arranged at the bottom of the culturing room body, the heat pipes and the uniform heat convection assemblies are alternately arranged at intervals, and the humidity regulating device comprises a suspension column type atomizer fixed at the top of the culturing base frame. According to the utility model, through integrated structural design and intelligent control, accurate sensing and automatic regulation and control of fungus culturing environmental parameters are realized, and the fungus culturing efficiency and quality are improved.

title_en: Toy for preventing pet from biting and eating
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a pet biting and feeding leakage toy, which belongs to the field of pet supplies and comprises a storage part and a buckling part which are connected by a connecting piece, wherein one end of the storage part, which is close to the buckling part, is provided with a sliding groove along the length direction of the storage part, the middle section of the connecting piece is arranged in the sliding groove, the two ends of the connecting piece are respectively embedded in the upper end face and the lower end face of the buckling part, the storage part is provided with a storage groove, and the position of the buckling part, which corresponds to the storage groove, is provided with an air hole communicated with the storage groove.

title_en: Biological feed charging premixing device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a biological feed feeding premixing device which comprises a fixed seat, wherein a supporting rod is welded on the fixed seat, a fixed plate is movably arranged at the bottom of the supporting rod, a feeding pipe is rotatably arranged on the fixed plate, a feeding hopper is fixed at one end of the feeding pipe, the feeding pipe is arranged on the fixed plate through a bearing, a supporting component is arranged on the feeding pipe, a ring seat is fixed on the fixed seat, a barrel body is rotatably arranged in the ring seat, and a driving motor is fixedly arranged on the ring seat. This device is mixed in advance in biological feed is rotatory through the inside stirring board of inlet pipe when using, and the stirring board stirs the material and enters into the inside completion additive of staving, and the material carries out preliminary stirring through the spliced pole in the staving, and later stage friction ring upwards moves and accomplishes the clearance to staving inner wall.

title_en: Embossing device for plastic floor production
abstract_en: The application discloses an embossing device for plastic floor production, and belongs to the technical field of floor production. The embossing roller comprises a conveying assembly, two embossing assemblies, a first mounting frame, an adjusting assembly and a positive and negative motor, wherein the conveying assembly is provided with two groups of brackets, the two groups of embossing assemblies are arranged on the brackets, each embossing assembly is provided with a holding unit for supporting two ends of an embossing roller, a spring for adapting to change of the position of the holding unit, the first mounting frame is arranged on the spring, the adjusting assembly is arranged between the two groups of embossing assemblies, and the adjusting assembly is provided with a first rack and a second rack for adjusting the heights of the two groups of embossing rollers respectively, a gear for driving the first rack and the second rack to move, and the positive and negative motor for driving the gear to rotate. According to the embossing device for plastic floor production, the first embossing roller and the second embossing roller are switched by using the positive and negative motors as power sources and utilizing the meshing transmission of the gears with the first rack and the second rack, so that resources are saved.

title_en: Carbon isotope labeling device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a carbon isotope labeling device which comprises a lower box body, a ventilation base, a supply system, an upper box body, a partition, a culture unit and a fan, wherein the ventilation base is connected to the bottom of the lower box body, the supply system is connected to the ventilation base, the upper box body is connected to the top of the lower box body, the partition is connected to the upper box body, the culture unit is connected to the partition, and the fan is connected to one side of the upper box body. Each culture unit can be independently adjusted, and conditions such as temperature, illumination and the like can be adjusted as required, so that research requirements under different experimental conditions are met. The independent operating environment reduces variable interference, so that the data is more accurate and reliable. The stable working environment, the accurate temperature control provided by the Peltier module and the stable illumination output of the LED lamp create an ideal environment which is favorable for biological growth.

title_en: Automatic door control device for free range chicken house
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of automatic doors, and discloses an automatic door control device for an free-range chicken house, which comprises a chicken house, a fixed connecting seat and a feed throwing component, wherein a slope base is arranged on the front surface of the chicken house, a light sensor is arranged on the front surface of the chicken house, a camera is arranged in the chicken house, a chicken house door is arranged on the front surface of the chicken house, and the feed throwing component is arranged in the chicken house. The light sensor is used for transmitting signals to the fixed connecting seat, the driving motor is used for driving the rotation threaded rod to rotate in the fixed connecting seat, the sliding threaded block is driven to slide downwards through the rotation of the rotation threaded rod, the sliding of the sliding threaded block drives the first adjusting support to pull the henhouse door to move, the henhouse door is closed, normal chicken entering and exiting of the henhouse door and the henhouse door are enabled to have a rest, further the growth health of the chickens is guaranteed, and the situation that the chickens are not fully closed in the henhouse or the chickens are prematurely closed outside the henhouse is prevented.

title_en: Intelligent proportioning saccharomyces cerevisiae culture feeding device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of livestock raising devices and discloses a raising device for an intelligent proportioning saccharomyces cerevisiae culture, which comprises a stirring barrel, a material distribution frame and a material storage frame, wherein a plurality of material storage boxes are arranged in the material storage frame, discharging pipes are arranged at the bottom ends of the material storage boxes and are communicated to the inner wall of the material distribution frame, a plurality of material distribution pipes corresponding to the bottom ports of the material distribution pipes are arranged in the material distribution frame, a plurality of inner sliding plugs corresponding to the material distribution pipes are arranged in the material distribution frame, electric push rods are connected to the output ends of the inner sliding plugs, and the output ends of the inner sliding plugs extend out to enable the electric push rods to extend into the corresponding material distribution pipes. The automatic proportioning of various yeast cultures and feeds is realized through the dynamic volume adjustment and synchronous partition design of the distributing pipe array, the blanking amount of each material is accurately limited by the sliding plug in the distributing pipe under the control of the electric push rod, and the upper spacer is driven by the turntable to synchronously cut off the material storage channel so as to realize the direct connection of the materials in the stirring barrel and the material storage box.

title_en: Warmhouse booth of golden cicada breeds
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of golden cicada breeding and discloses a greenhouse for breeding golden cicada, which comprises a greenhouse, wherein a temperature control box is arranged at the top end of the interior of the greenhouse, a temperature control assembly is arranged in the temperature control box, guide hoods are fixedly arranged at two ends of the temperature control box, a plurality of guide holes are formed in one side of each guide hood in a penetrating manner, and a humidifying assembly is arranged at one end of the bottom of each guide hood. According to the utility model, by arranging the temperature control assembly, a more accurate and comprehensive temperature regulation system can be formed in the greenhouse, and the electric heating rod is mainly utilized to be matched with cooling liquid in the coiled pipe, so that the fan can selectively heat and refrigerate discharged wind, the temperature in the greenhouse is quickly regulated, the purpose of quickly balancing the temperature in the greenhouse is achieved, and the regulated temperature and humidity are uniformly distributed in the greenhouse through the guide cover and the guide holes, so that different requirements of golden cicada larvae on the temperature in different growth stages are met.

title_en: Milling and grinding machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a milling and grinding machine which comprises a milling component, a grinding component, a fixing component, a first driving component, a second driving component, a third driving component, a first grating ruler and a second grating ruler, wherein the milling component and the grinding component are arranged on the first driving component, the milling component and the grinding component move towards a direction close to or far away from the fixing component under the driving of the first driving component, the second driving component is arranged on one side of the fixing component, the third driving component is arranged on one side of the second driving component, the first grating ruler is arranged on one side of the milling component and the grinding component, and the second grating ruler is arranged on one side of the third driving component. The milling and polishing device can automatically mill and polish the workpiece, replaces manual work, reduces labor cost, improves working efficiency, improves machining precision, and ensures that the machined workpiece has good consistency. And a grating ruler is added, so that the precision of a processed product is higher.

title_en: Anti-slip sofa cushion for pets
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-slip pet sofa cushion, which relates to the field of pet sofa cushions and has the technical scheme that the anti-slip pet sofa cushion comprises a sofa cushion and a surrounding baffle, wherein a plurality of fastening belts used for being plugged into gaps of a sofa are arranged at the edge of the surrounding baffle, and the fastening belts can be fixed through a fixing structure to form a filling roll after being rolled. According to the utility model, the fastening belt is rolled into the filling roll and is plugged into the gaps of the sofa, so that a pet is physically prevented from drilling into the bottom of the sofa cushion, meanwhile, the filling roll is clamped in the gaps of the sofa, so that the sofa cushion and the enclosure can be fixed, the effect of preventing the pet from being mixed can be achieved, the size of the filling roll can be adjusted according to the quantity of the rolled part of the fastening belt, the depth and the width of different gaps of the sofa can be adapted, the fastening belt is made of nylon woven belts, the tearing resistance of nylon materials is strong, and the fastening belt is prevented from being damaged by the pet when the pet is caught.

title_en: Environment-friendly building decoration material apparatus for producing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an environment-friendly building decoration material production device, which relates to the field of building decoration material production, in particular to an environment-friendly building decoration material production device, and comprises a stirring tank for building decoration material production, wherein a material adding component for adding auxiliary materials is arranged on the stirring tank, the material adding component comprises a feeding pipe, one side of the feeding pipe is connected with a feeding hopper, the feeding hopper is communicated with the inside of the stirring tank through the feeding pipe, and a switching component is arranged in the feeding pipe.

title_en: High-frequency heat sealing machine
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of bioengineering equipment, and particularly discloses a high-frequency heat sealing machine, which comprises a box body, a heat sealing device, wires and a support, wherein the box body is detachably connected with the heat sealing device through the wires, the heat sealing device comprises a heat sealing head and a hand-held heat sealing handle, the support is separately arranged with the box body and the heat sealing device, the support comprises a base, an upright post and an elastic clamping piece, the upright post is arranged on the base, the whole upright post is in a shape of 7, a groove is arranged at the upper end of the upright post and is used for positioning an infusion tube, the upper end of the upright post is provided with an arc-shaped elastic clamping piece, the concave arc surface of the elastic clamping piece is propped against the upright post, the elastic clamping piece clamps the infusion tube, the number of the upright posts is two, the two upright posts are arranged on the base at intervals, the heat sealing device is convenient for heat sealing the infusion tube between the upright posts, the movable support is arranged for clamping the infusion tube, the infusion tube is prevented from shaking during heat sealing, the infusion tube is not required to be held by hand in the heat sealing operation, and the heat sealing effect is improved on the basis of improving the flexibility of the heat sealing machine.

title_en: Injection action control hydraulic circuit of injection molding machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a glue injection action control hydraulic circuit of an injection molding machine, which comprises a six-position four-way servo valve and a glue injection cylinder, wherein a P port of the six-position four-way servo valve is communicated with an oil inlet, a T port of the six-position four-way servo valve is communicated with an oil return port, an A port of the six-position four-way servo valve is communicated with a rear oil port of the glue injection cylinder, a B port of the six-position four-way servo valve is communicated with a front oil port of the glue injection cylinder, a cartridge valve is arranged between the rear oil port of the glue injection cylinder and the A port of the six-position four-way servo valve, a control port of the cartridge valve is communicated with a direction valve, when the six-position four-way servo valve stops working, the direction valve is controlled to be uncharged, hydraulic oil at the rear oil port of the glue injection cylinder is not blocked by the cartridge valve, the screw rod is prevented from backing due to leakage of a valve core of the six-position four-way servo valve, the screw rod connected with a conveying end of the glue injection cylinder is always kept at a feeding end position, the same starting point of the next mould is ensured, and the influence on the product precision is avoided.

title_en: Ceramic trimming device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of ceramic green bricks, and discloses a ceramic green brick repairing device which comprises a base, wherein a driving motor is fixedly arranged on the upper end face of the base, the output end of the driving motor is fixedly connected with a rotating rod, the top end of the rotating rod is fixedly connected with a bottom plate, a plurality of support rods are annularly arranged on the upper end face of the bottom plate, the top ends of the support rods are fixedly connected with a rotating disc, a plurality of limiting sliding grooves are annularly arranged on the rotating disc, the upper end face of the rotating disc is provided with a clamping assembly for clamping ceramic green bricks, the ceramic green bricks cannot slide or shift in the rotating process through the arranged clamping assembly, and the clamping assembly can slide in the limiting sliding grooves or adjust positions so as to adapt to ceramic green bricks with different sizes.

title_en: Seed treatment device before pepper planting
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of seed treatment, in particular to a seed treatment device before pepper planting, which aims at the problems that the existing treatment device only can soak seeds, has single function, needs to drag out the seeds after soaking, has relatively troublesome operation and is inconvenient to use, and the utility model provides a proposal that the seed treatment device comprises a treatment box and a placement box, wherein a baffle plate is fixedly connected in the treatment box, the treatment box is divided into a first cavity and a second cavity by the baffle plate, an opening is arranged at the bottom of the placement box, and a filter plate for sieving the seeds is fixedly connected at the bottom of the placement box through bolts.

title_en: Fertilizer sowing equipment for agricultural planting
abstract_en: The application discloses fertilizer sowing equipment for agricultural planting, and belongs to the technical field of agricultural planting. The device comprises a moving vehicle, wheels, a storage vat, a discharging mechanism, a driving mechanism and a discharging mechanism, wherein the wheels are arranged at two ends of the moving vehicle, the storage vat is arranged at the top of one end of the moving vehicle, the discharging mechanism is arranged between the storage vat and the moving workshop, the driving mechanism is arranged on the moving vehicle and connected with the discharging mechanism and the wheels, the wheels and the discharging mechanism are synchronously driven by the driving mechanism, so that the moving speed of the moving vehicle and the discharging amount of the discharging mechanism are in a fixed ratio, the same fertilizer spreading amount per unit distance is realized, and the discharging mechanism uniformly spreads fertilizer on soil after spreading the fertilizer from the storage vat, and ensures uniform fertilizer spreading.

title_en: Ruby shaddock weak branch trimming means
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of a ruby shaddock weak branch pruning device, in particular to a ruby shaddock weak branch pruning device, which comprises a handle, wherein an adjusting cap is rotatably arranged at the front end of the handle, a connecting rod is slidably arranged in the handle, a pruning component is arranged at the front end of the connecting rod, a control button is arranged at the front side of a base surface of the handle, a pruning component is arranged on the ruby shaddock weak branch pruning device, a driving motor is operated to drive a rotating disc to rotate, a movable rod can be driven to move through an adjusting column and an adjusting rod, the movable rod drives an adjusting frame to move, and therefore when a sliding block on the adjusting frame moves to the front ends of a first adjusting groove and a second adjusting groove, the first pruning claw and the second pruning claw rotate inwards, and pruning can be carried out through a pruning blade, so that the device is convenient to prune, time-saving and labor-saving, simple in structure, convenient to operate and higher in practicability.

title_en: Fuli cage laying hen house
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a welfare cage laying hen house which is characterized by comprising a ground movable area (3), a plurality of movable platforms and a plurality of egg producing platforms to form at least two layers, wherein one layer is formed by superposing the plurality of movable platforms, the other layer is formed by superposing one or more movable platforms and one or more egg producing platforms or is formed by superposing the plurality of egg producing platforms, a three-dimensional crossed movable space exists between the two layers, the two layers are positioned on the ground movable area (3) to form a U-shaped structure, and the laying hen can freely move on any platform between the two layers. On the premise of providing a larger activity space for the laying hens, the utility model provides a cross three-dimensional perching platform by utilizing the space height of the henhouse, increases the number of the laying hens in unit volume and reduces the raising cost.

title_en: Feed heavy metal detoxification purifier who contains processing member
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of feed detoxification, in particular to a feed heavy metal detoxification purification device comprising a treatment part, a steam pipe and a spray pipe, wherein the treatment part comprises a cooking bin and a mixing bin, the output end of the steam pipe is positioned in the cooking bin, a breathable metal net for supporting feed is arranged in the cooking bin, a vibration component is arranged in the cooking bin and is used for vibrating the breathable metal net, so that the feed is comprehensively digested by high-temperature steam.

title_en: Melt-blown non-woven fabric adsorption material processing extruder
abstract_en: The application relates to a melt-blown non-woven fabric adsorption material processing extruder, which relates to the technical field of adsorption material production and aims to solve the problem of uneven shearing stress of the extruder, and comprises a frame, wherein an extrusion cylinder is arranged on the frame, a feed inlet and a discharge outlet are respectively arranged at two ends of the extrusion cylinder in the length direction, a feed mechanism is arranged at the feed inlet of the extrusion cylinder, a melting heating mechanism is arranged on the cylinder body of the extrusion cylinder, the inside rotation of extrusion cylinder is provided with main screw rod, left screw rod and right screw rod, main screw rod, left screw rod and right screw rod all are arranged along extrusion cylinder extrusion direction, left screw rod and right screw rod symmetry are arranged in main screw rod both sides, left screw rod and right screw rod screw thread direction are the same, and opposite with main screw rod screw thread direction, be provided with the actuating mechanism that is used for driving main screw rod, left screw rod and right screw rod rotatory in the frame. The application has the effects that the shearing stress can be more uniformly distributed and the mixing effect is enhanced.

title_en: Efficient trimming device for rubber ring processing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of rubber ring processing, in particular to a high-efficiency trimming device for rubber ring processing, which comprises a supporting column, a motor I and a trimming and cleaning assembly, wherein the trimming and cleaning assembly is arranged outside the motor I, simultaneously, the rubber rings with different diameters are also favorable for being placed for trimming, the rubber rings are fixed in the sliding grooves of the placing rods by the placing rods, the placing rods are started to rotate by the second motor, and the placing rods are reduced after trimming is finished so as to be taken down by a user, so that the device can trim a large number of rubber rings at one time, the working efficiency is improved, and meanwhile, the device can trim rubber rings with different specifications, so that the adaptability of the device is improved.

title_en: Ecological bank protection structure suitable for hydrophilic footpath
abstract_en: The ecological shore protection structure comprises wood piles, wherein the wood piles are in two rows, the wood piles in each row are densely distributed, the upper ends of two adjacent wood piles are arranged in a tooth shape, a gabion is arranged on each wood pile, two grooves are formed in the bottom of each gabion, the two rows of wood piles are respectively inserted into the grooves of each gabion, connecting plates are arranged on two sides of each gabion, pedals are arranged on each gabion, guardrails are arranged on the outer sides of the pedals, retaining grooves are formed in the other sides of the pedals, anchor rods are arranged at the retaining grooves, slope protection is arranged on the outer sides of the retaining grooves, vegetation nets are arranged on the slope protection, the tops of the wood piles and the bottoms of the gabions are constantly immersed in water, dry and wet circulation rot is avoided, no preservative treatment is needed, the tooth arrangement of the two rows of wood piles enhances biting force, the gabion is fixed on the wood piles through the grooves, sliding risks are reduced, the connecting plates on the two sides of the gabion and the pedals form a semi-surrounding structure, deformation of the gabion is further limited, and the overall stability is improved.

title_en: Pick-and-place device and processing equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a picking and placing device and processing equipment. The picking and placing device comprises a bracket, an implantation assembly and a transfer assembly. The implantation assembly comprises a first clamping piece and an absorption piece, wherein the first clamping piece comprises a first driving piece and two first clamping jaws, the first driving piece is arranged on the support, the two first clamping jaws penetrate through the support, the first driving piece is connected with the two first clamping jaws to enable the two first clamping jaws to clamp or loosen a first workpiece, and the absorption piece penetrates through the support and is configured to absorb a second workpiece. The transferring component is connected with the bracket and used for driving the bracket to move, so that the implanting component can absorb the first workpiece and the second workpiece and implant the first workpiece and the second workpiece into the die. The picking and placing device can absorb the first workpiece and the second workpiece, accurately implant the first workpiece and the second workpiece into the die, has higher automation degree, can reduce the labor intensity of workers, improve the implantation efficiency of the first workpiece and the second workpiece, and can improve the yield and the yield of products.

title_en: Fishery trapping device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of fishing equipment, in particular to a fishing trapping device which comprises a trapping box and a mounting frame, wherein trapping ports are formed in two sides of the outer part of the trapping box, a food trapping box is arranged in the trapping box, regulating components are arranged on two sides of the inner part of the trapping box, an outlet is formed in the bottom of the trapping box, a collecting net is detachably connected to the bottom of the outlet, the caliber of the trapping ports on two sides can be regulated through two groups of first regulating plates and second regulating plates, smaller fishes can be trapped when the trapping ports are regulated to be small, larger fishes can be trapped when the trapping ports are regulated to be large, the fishing accuracy and the use flexibility of the device are improved, the trouble that the fishes need to be classified again after the fishing is finished is avoided, the labor burden of workers is reduced, the collecting net filled with the fishes can be quickly disassembled and replaced after the fishing is finished, the trouble of dumping the fishes into the ground or a ship body is avoided, and the working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Perforating device for Chinese yam planting
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a perforating device for Chinese yam planting, which is characterized in that when soil needs to be perforated in the actual Chinese yam planting process, a hole digger body can be moved to a position needing to be perforated through a moving component, a stable frame is then righted, a stable pile is penetrated into the soil through stepping on the stable frame, then the hole digger body is operated, the soil is perforated through the hole digger body, the hole digger body is pressed down, a lifting plate slides downwards on a guide plate and drills deep holes into the soil, torsion is borne by the stable frame, a fixed plate and the guide plate, and the stable frame is prevented from moving through penetrating the stable pile in the soil, so that the soil can be perforated better, the hole digger is more stable during perforation without the need of a planter to resist the torsion, and the phenomenon that a planting hole is askew is prevented.

title_en: High-speed kneader for producing composite material
abstract_en: A high-speed kneader for producing composite materials relates to the technical field of kneaders and solves the problems of easy oxidation and performance reduction in the kneading process of composite materials in the prior art. The automatic feeding device comprises a tank body, wherein a discharging tank is connected to the bottom of the tank body, a discharging pipe is connected to the lower end of the discharging tank, a feeding pipeline and a vacuum pipeline are connected to the upper end of the side wall of the tank body respectively, a rotating shaft is coaxially connected to the tank body in a rotating mode, the lower end of the rotating shaft is arranged in the discharging tank, an air inlet hole is formed in the end face of the bottom of the rotating shaft, a plurality of air outlet holes are uniformly formed in the side wall of the top of the rotating shaft, an electric heating element is connected in the rotating shaft, a plurality of mixing paddles are connected to the rotating shaft in a surrounding mode along the peripheral side, a material carrying disc is arranged at the top of the discharging tank, and an air inlet pipeline is connected to the side wall of the discharging tank. The method has the beneficial effects that the contact between the material and oxygen can be inhibited, and the performance stability of the composite material is improved.

title_en: Vulcanizing device for rubber oil seal processing
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of rubber oil seal processing, and particularly relates to a vulcanizing device for rubber oil seal processing, which comprises a workbench, wherein a die adjusting device is arranged in the middle of the top surface of the workbench, a die clamping device is arranged near the right end of the top surface of the workbench, limiting auxiliary devices are arranged near the bottom of the front surface and the back surface of the die clamping device, the die clamping device comprises an exhaust mechanism and a die clamping mechanism, the die clamping mechanism is arranged at the top and the bottom of the exhaust mechanism, the exhaust mechanism comprises an upper die, an exhaust pipe is arranged on the top surface of the upper die, a memory spring is arranged in the exhaust pipe, and a blocking block is arranged at the top end of the memory spring. This a vulcanizer for rubber oil blanket processing usefulness, through the setting of closing die set, when carrying out vulcanization molding to the rubber oil blanket, make memory spring extend in the heating process to promote the shutoff piece to slide and leave inside the blast pipe, thereby utilize the blast pipe to exhaust, and the shutoff piece can effectively prevent that the dust from getting into inside the mould.

title_en: Cherry seedling transplanting soil compacting device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cherry seedling transplanting soil pressing device, which relates to the technical field of cherry planting and comprises a placing bottom plate, wherein a damping rotating disc is rotatably arranged on the upper surface of the tail end of the placing bottom plate and consists of a disc body, a rotating rod and a damping gasket, a supporting vertical plate is arranged on the upper surface of the damping rotating disc, a guide chute is formed in the surface of the supporting vertical plate, and a guide sliding block is slidably arranged on the inner surface of the guide chute. Compared with the conventional common cherry seedling transplanting soil compacting device, the cherry seedling transplanting soil compacting device has the advantages that the damping rotating disc is arranged, the soil compacting plate can be driven to rotate through the damping rotating disc after the soil compacting plate compacts the soil, the soil can be compacted at multiple angles, the compaction efficiency is improved, the first reset spring is arranged, the soil compacting plate can be driven to compact the soil through the pedal, and the first reset spring is used for resetting the soil compacting plate to facilitate next compaction.

title_en: Branch and leaf spraying equipment for fruit trees
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fruit tree spraying equipment, in particular to fruit tree branch and leaf spraying equipment, which comprises a conveying pump, wherein a conveying pipe is fixedly arranged at the water outlet end of the conveying pump, a plurality of auxiliary pipes are fixedly arranged on the conveying pipe, a plurality of first hollow pipes are arranged on one side of each auxiliary pipe, a second hollow pipe is arranged above the first hollow pipe, a third hollow pipe is arranged above the second hollow pipe, a bent hollow pipe is arranged above the third hollow pipe, the first hollow pipe and the second hollow pipe, the second hollow pipe and the third hollow pipe are all detachably connected, a spray head is in threaded connection with the end part of the bent hollow pipe, the first hollow pipe and the auxiliary pipes are detachably connected through a corrugated pipe, and a support base is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the first hollow pipe. The utility model is convenient for spraying operation, saves labor and is convenient for use.

title_en: Pressing machine for bag production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pressing machine for bag production, which relates to the technical field of bag production and comprises a base, wherein fixed adjusting components are fixedly arranged at four corners of the upper end of the base, buffer extrusion components are fixedly arranged at the front and rear parts of the fixed adjusting components, the pressing components are fixedly arranged at the rear part of the upper end of the base, the fixed adjusting components comprise a movable frame, and connecting frames are fixedly arranged at the front and rear parts of the left side and the right side of the movable frame. According to the pressing machine for producing the bags, the height and the position of the roller can be flexibly adjusted according to different sizes, shapes and pressing requirements of the bags and the cloth materials through the fixed adjusting component, the pressing machine can adapt to the production of various bags and the universality of equipment is improved. The buffer extrusion assembly can ensure that the pressure applied by the roller to the bag Bao Buliao is uniform and moderate, so that all parts of the cloth can be better combined in the pressing process, and the pressing quality and stability are improved.

title_en: Automatic granulator
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of grain cutting equipment, in particular to an automatic grain cutting machine, which comprises a base, wherein the upper end of the base is provided with a grain cutting machine main body, the upper end of the grain cutting machine main body is provided with a mounting seat, a cutter box and a driving component for driving a cutter inside the cutter box are arranged on the mounting seat, one side of the grain cutting machine main body is provided with a large electric box and a small electric box, one side of the grain cutting machine main body is provided with a feed inlet, two sides of the feed inlet are provided with support plates, a traction roller for arranging material strips in a gap mode and pulling the material strips into the grain cutting machine main body is arranged between the two support plates, the material strips enter through the feed inlet, are arranged in a gap mode by the traction roller between the support plates and pulled into the grain cutting machine main body, the driving component drives the cutter inside the cutter box to cut the material strips, the large electric box and the small electric box provide power source and control support, the traction roller solves the problem of uneven spacing of the material strips in the prior art, overlapping or missing cutting occurs during cutting is avoided, the fluctuation of the grain length and the flat material is reduced, the shutdown adjusting frequency is lowered, and the subsequent processing quality is improved.

title_en: Rubbing crusher is used in rubber processing
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of rubber processing, and particularly relates to a pulverizer for rubber processing, which comprises a workbench and a pulverizing box fixedly connected to the workbench, wherein a pulverizing shaft I and a pulverizing shaft II which are symmetrically distributed are connected to the pulverizing box in a sliding manner, pulverizing blades are fixedly connected to the pulverizing shaft I and the pulverizing shaft II, a reciprocating driving mechanism is mounted on the workbench, a carrier plate is arranged at the top of the reciprocating driving mechanism, a driving part is mounted on the carrier plate, and an output shaft of the driving part is fixedly connected with the pulverizing shaft II. According to the utility model, the crushing shaft I and the crushing shaft II which are symmetrically distributed are connected on the crushing box in a sliding manner, and the reciprocating driving mechanism is arranged on the workbench, so that the driving component, the crushing shaft I and the crushing shaft II can be driven to slide in a reciprocating manner during use, the crushing area of the blade is expanded, the crushing effect is further increased, and the problem that the crushing effect of the device at the present stage is common is solved.

title_en: Injection mold with ejection structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an injection mold with an ejection structure, and relates to the technical field of injection molding. The utility model comprises a movable die, wherein a fixed die is abutted on the side wall of the movable die, an ejection assembly is arranged on the side of the movable die, the ejection assembly comprises a placement plate arranged on the side of the movable die, ejector rods fixedly connected with a rectangular array on the side wall of the placement plate penetrate through the movable die, a top plate is commonly connected between the four ejector rods, a spiral ring is connected on the peripheral side wall of the ejector rods in a threaded manner, a reset spring connected on the side wall of the spiral ring is sleeved on the peripheral side wall of the ejector rods, and an anti-collision assembly is arranged on the side wall of the movable die. According to the utility model, the ejector rod is arranged to replace the ejector pin, the ejector rod is far larger than the diameter of the ejector pin, the load capacity is increased, the ejector rod is effectively prevented from bending when ejecting an injection molding product, the service life is prolonged, the replacement of the ejector rod is reduced, materials are saved, and the anti-collision assembly is arranged to weaken the impact force of the movable die and the fixed die during die assembly, so that the fixed die is prevented from loosening due to overlarge vibration, and injection molding is performed more stably.

title_en: Thermal insulation device for hot bottle mould of bottle blowing machine
