abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of bottle blowing processing equipment and discloses a bottle blowing machine hot bottle die heat insulation device which comprises two groups of die assemblies and a first locking structure, wherein each group of die assemblies comprises a die hanging frame, a heat insulation die sleeve, a hot bottle die and a second locking structure, the two groups of die assemblies can be mutually buckled to enable the two hot bottle dies to be matched to form a die cavity, the two die hanging frames of the two groups of die assemblies are locked through the first locking structure, the die hanging frames, the heat insulation die sleeve and the hot bottle die are coaxially arranged, the heat insulation die sleeve is positioned between the hot bottle die and the die hanging frames, the heat insulation die sleeve comprises a die sleeve body and the heat insulation structure, and the die hanging frames, the die sleeve body and the hot bottle die are locked through the second locking structure. The heat insulation die sleeve in the heat insulation device of the bottle blowing machine hot bottle die can reduce the heat transfer of the hot bottle die to other parts, and avoid the phenomenon of thermal expansion effect caused by heating of other parts as much as possible.

title_en: A play water subassembly for pet feeder
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of pet supplies, and particularly relates to a water outlet assembly for a pet feeder, which is arranged at the mouth of a water storage bottle of the pet feeder and comprises a sealing cover, a movable plate, a spring and a movable sealing plug, wherein one end of the sealing cover is in threaded connection with the mouth of the water storage bottle, the other end of the sealing cover is circumferentially provided with an upwards extending supporting wall, the top of the supporting wall is at least provided with an upwards opened notch, the notch penetrates through the thickness direction of the supporting wall, the sealing cover is provided with a water outlet hole, a support is fixedly arranged in the water outlet hole, a penetrating chute is arranged on the support, one surface of the movable plate, facing the support, is provided with a positioning column which extends downwards, the positioning column penetrates through the chute and is connected with the movable sealing plug, the spring is sleeved on the periphery of the positioning column, and two ends of the spring are respectively abutted against the movable plate and the support, and the spring enables the movable plate to be always positioned above the water outlet hole, and enables the movable sealing plug to be positioned below the water outlet hole and seal the water outlet hole. Simple structure, low in production cost, zero circuit, need not to charge, and pure mechanical structure realizes the function of supplying water as required for the pet.

title_en: Even pelletization device of straw and tail dish mixed feed
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of feed pelletization, and discloses a device for uniformly pelleting mixed feed of straw and tail vegetables, which comprises a main body assembly, wherein the main body assembly comprises a pelletization device, one side of the pelletization device is provided with a feeding device, one side of the feeding device is provided with a stirring device, the pelletization device comprises a feeding cylinder, a pelletization cylinder is arranged below the feeding cylinder, and a discharge hole is formed in the pelletization cylinder; the discharging device is positioned on one side of the granulating cylinder and comprises a discharging plate and a pushing piece, and the discharging plate is fixed on the granulating cylinder. The utility model has the beneficial effects that the periodically moving pushing plate is arranged at the discharge hole of the granulating cylinder, a tiny gap is kept between the bottom and the inclined discharge plate during forward pushing, particles are pushed to move towards the collecting frame, the particles are prevented from accumulating at the connecting position, the pushing plate is lifted upwards during reverse moving and is separated from contact with the particles, and meanwhile, the scraping structure can automatically scrape the particles adhered to the surface of the pushing plate during reverse moving of the pushing plate.

title_en: Oil spraying device for bread baking tray
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of food processing equipment, in particular to an oil spraying device for a bread baking tray, which comprises a workbench, wherein a driving motor is fixedly arranged at the rear part of the left end of the workbench, a connecting device is arranged at the middle part of the upper end of a supporting plate in a clamping way, two sliding grooves are formed between the left plate wall and the right plate wall of the supporting plate, the other ends of a plurality of hoses are fixedly connected with oil spraying cylinders, lifting assemblies are fixedly connected with the outer surfaces of the oil spraying cylinders together, and an oil storage tank is arranged at the middle part of the upper end of the supporting plate in a clamping way. According to the oil spraying device for the bread baking tray, which is disclosed by the utility model, the height-adjustable connecting device, the electromagnetic valve for accurately controlling oil, the evenly-distributed oil spraying air nozzles, the sliding block chute and the transparent baffle which have the functions of stable guiding and splash prevention observation are designed, so that the efficient, accurate and even oil spraying is realized, the manual operation difficulty and cost are reduced, the oil waste is reduced, and the overall benefit of the oil spraying operation of the bread baking tray is improved.

title_en: Ash squeezing device for oil field workover operation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an ash squeezing device for oilfield workover operation, which comprises a first stirring barrel, a second stirring barrel and a conveying pipe. According to the utility model, the mounting plate fixed at the bottom of the second stirring barrel is aligned to the mounting groove in the mounting process through the mounting groove, the first transmission rod and the internal gear ring, and the mounting plate is completely embedded into the mounting groove by vertical downward pressing, so that the second stirring barrel is firmly mounted at the top of the first stirring barrel; if the stirring barrel is inconvenient to assemble, disassemble and clean, residual mortar can be solidified and agglomerated in the barrel, so that the follow-up stirring quality and efficiency are affected, the equipment abrasion is increased, bacteria can be bred, peculiar smell is generated, and the newly configured mortar is polluted.

title_en: Lower mould core pulling structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a lower die core-pulling structure which comprises a lower die, a movable die and a thimble plate, wherein the lower die and the movable die are connected, the thimble plate is arranged on the lower die, a core-pulling needle extending into a die cavity of the movable die is arranged on the thimble plate, a movable supporting piece is arranged on one side of the lower die, the supporting piece is arranged at the lower end of the thimble plate, the thimble plate is suspended in the air, and when the die is opened, the supporting piece moves to enable the thimble plate to drive the core-pulling needle to downwards complete core pulling. When the core pulling is needed to be carried out on a workpiece in a movable die cavity, the supporting piece moves along the preset direction, so that the thimble plate lacks support, at the moment, the thimble plate loses support force, moves downwards under the action of gravity and drives the core pulling needle fixed on the thimble plate to synchronously move downwards, and therefore the thimble plate is stably pulled out from the hole site or the precise characteristic in the workpiece.

title_en: Toughened glass cutting and positioning device with edge collapse preventing structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a toughened glass cutting and positioning device with an edge collapse preventing structure, which relates to the technical field of toughened glass cutting and positioning and comprises a workbench, wherein a water collecting tank is fixedly connected to the bottom of the workbench, an edge collapse preventing structure is arranged at the top of the workbench, baffles are respectively and fixedly connected to the left side and the right side of the top of the workbench, which are close to the outer part of the edge collapse preventing structure, opposite surfaces of the two baffles are respectively and mirror-image-arranged with a positioning and clamping mechanism, a first hydraulic cylinder is fixedly connected to the outer wall of the baffle on the right side, a first water pump is fixedly connected to the top of a water tank, a water spraying assembly is arranged at the other end of the water pipe, a filtering assembly is arranged at the front end of the water collecting tank, and a cutting mechanism is arranged at the bottom of an X-axis sliding block. According to the utility model, the edge breakage preventing structure is operated, the vertical plate and the baffle are vertically arranged on the workbench to protect the periphery of the toughened glass cutting, so that the edge breakage of the glass is further prevented, the impact force of splashing of the glass fragments is resisted, and therefore, other people are prevented from being accidentally injured.

title_en: Semi-split lifter
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a semi-split lifter, which belongs to the technical field of tractor lifters and comprises a shell, wherein a lifting arm for connecting farm tools is arranged on the shell, a multi-way valve is further arranged on the shell, the multi-way valve is communicated with an oil cavity of a lifting oil cylinder through an oil pipe, a power output end of the lifting oil cylinder is connected with the lifting arm, a flow regulating rod is arranged on the multi-way valve, the lifter further comprises a connecting rod mechanism, one end of the connecting rod mechanism is connected with the lifting arm, a shifting piece is connected with the other end of the connecting rod mechanism, when the lifting arm acts, the shifting piece pushes the flow regulating rod to act, when the farm tools are limited by cultivated land conditions and the angle of the lifting arm does not meet the preset position, the flow regulating rod of the multi-way valve can be pushed by the cooperation of the connecting rod mechanism and the shifting piece in time, so that the flow of the lifting oil cylinder is increased or decreased, the lifting arm correspondingly descends or ascends, the cultivated land depth is ensured to be consistent, meanwhile, the lifter is convenient to detach and replace, and the lifter is not required to be detached integrally during maintenance and overhaul, and maintenance cost and time are reduced.

title_en: Cladding equipment is used in processing of fire-retardant optical cable
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of optical cable processing and discloses a coating device for flame-retardant optical cable processing, which comprises a base, wherein an extruding machine is fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the base, a discharging pipe is fixedly arranged at the output end of the extruding machine, a flattening assembly is arranged on the upper surface of the base, and the flattening assembly comprises a bracket, a fixing frame, a rotating drum, an annular tooth socket, a servo motor, a gear, a mounting column, a coil spring and a contact wheel. This cladding equipment is used in fire-retardant optical cable processing is through being provided with flattening the subassembly, and when passing the rotary drum that lasts the pivoted through the optical cable of cladding, the multiunit contact wheel that is spiral line array form setting leaves spiral line's motion track when the surface contact of optical cable in the rotary drum, through a plurality of contact wheels coextrusion that are the spiral line array setting for the surface homoenergetic of whole cladding optical cable obtains extrusion effect, and the atress is more even, makes its surface cladding shaping effect better.

title_en: Disc fertilization and seeding integrated machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fertilizing and seeding, in particular to a disc fertilizing and seeding integrated machine which comprises a frame, a hopper arranged on the frame, a first opening device group arranged at the bottom of the frame, a vibrating roller group and a second opening device which are arranged at the bottom of the frame and positioned at two sides of the first opening device group, a blanking mechanism connected with the hopper and positioned above the first opening device group and the second opening device, and a driving mechanism arranged on the vibrating roller group, wherein the driving mechanism is respectively in transmission connection with the first opening device group, the second opening device and the blanking mechanism, and is used for driving the first opening device group and the second opening device to rotate and driving the blanking mechanism to perform blanking; this disc fertilization seeding all-in-one is through unique actuating mechanism to the third transmission shaft is the power transmission core, drives first mouth gag group, vibration compression roller group, second mouth gag and unloading mechanism and operates in step, accomplishes fertilization and seeding twice process integration in one time operation, reduces the number of times that equipment comes and goes to farmland, promotes production efficiency.

title_en: Hydraulic grab bucket of palm car
abstract_en: The utility model provides a hydraulic grab bucket of palm car, includes grab bucket connecting seat, grab bucket hydro-cylinder, supports the linking arm, hydro-cylinder connection pad and fight lamella, the flexible end of grab bucket hydro-cylinder is equipped with the hydro-cylinder connection pad, the quotation of hydro-cylinder connection pad sets up perpendicularly with the flexible end of grab bucket hydro-cylinder, the cylinder body top of grab bucket hydro-cylinder still outwards evenly welds the several hydro-cylinder branch arm, the hydro-cylinder branch arm articulates in the one end that supports the linking arm, the other end that supports the linking arm articulates in the top of fight lamella, the hole is still offered at the top of fight lamella and is used for articulated the setting with the hydro-cylinder connection pad. According to the utility model, through the tight fit among the grab bucket connecting seat, the grab bucket oil cylinder, the supporting connecting arm, the oil cylinder connecting disc and the bucket valve, the connection of components is stabilized, the grabbing stability can be maintained even in long working time, the multi-valve grab bucket design can well wrap palm fruits, and the grabbing is more convenient and flexible.

title_en: Termite detection trapping device
abstract_en: The termite detection trapping and killing device comprises a box body, wherein a plurality of inlet openings are formed in the three sides of the box body, a trapping and killing platform is fixedly connected in the box body through a plurality of fixing plates, a placing barrel is fixedly connected in the middle of the trapping and killing platform, trapping and killing wood blocks are placed in the placing barrel, a flushing device is arranged around the outer side of the top end of the placing barrel, a water tank is fixedly connected to one side of the box body, which is not provided with the inlet openings, and is fixedly connected with a water delivery pipe, one end of the water delivery pipe, which is far away from the water tank, is communicated with the flushing device.

title_en: Electric tool
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an electric tool, which comprises a handle shell extending along the axial direction, a connecting component extending into the handle shell at least partially along the axial direction and a power shell axially positioned at the rear end of the handle shell, wherein the power shell and the handle shell are formed into a split component, and the power shell at least partially extends into the handle shell in the axial direction. In addition, the power shell and the handle shell are respectively connected with the connecting component without direct connection relation, so that the stability of connection of the power shell and the handle shell can be ensured, and the risk of fracture after falling is reduced.

title_en: Raw material pretreatment device for leather sheath keyboard production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a raw material pretreatment device for leather sheath keyboard production, which comprises a supporting frame, wherein a supporting plate is fixedly arranged on the supporting frame, a heating tank is fixedly arranged on the supporting plate, a feeding hopper is arranged on the top surface of the heating tank, a discharging hopper is fixedly arranged on the bottom surface of the supporting plate, a discharging mechanism is arranged on the bottom surface of the heating tank and comprises a connecting sleeve and an adjusting mechanism, the connecting sleeve is connected to the bottom surface of the heating tank, a sliding groove is formed in the inner side of the connecting sleeve, a plurality of groups of sliding grooves are formed in the sliding groove, sliding blocks are arranged in the inner side of the sliding groove in a sliding manner, the adjusting mechanism comprises a flow blocking plate and an adjusting sleeve, the flow blocking plate is fixed in the inner side of the plurality of groups of sliding blocks, connecting plates are connected between the adjusting sleeve and the plurality of groups of flow blocking plates, and the positions of the flow blocking plates can be accurately controlled through the synergistic effect of the connecting sleeve and the adjusting mechanism, so that the flowing space formed between the plurality of groups of flow blocking plates can change along with demands.

title_en: Car back ceiling closed angle surface fabric welding set
abstract_en: The utility model provides a welding device for sharp corner fabrics of a rear ceiling of an automobile, which comprises a frame, wherein a positioning die core for placing and positioning the rear ceiling is arranged on a base of the frame, a first pressing assembly for pressing the upper surface of the rear ceiling is arranged on the periphery of the positioning die core on the base, a lifting plate and a lifting driving cylinder for driving the lifting plate to move up and down are connected to a top plate of the frame, a second pressing assembly for pressing the fabrics at the sharp corners of the rear ceiling and an ultrasonic welding assembly for welding the fabrics at the sharp corners of the rear ceiling are connected to the lower end of the lifting plate, and a trimming assembly for straightening and leveling the fabrics to be welded is also connected to the position, corresponding to the sharp corners of the rear ceiling, on the base. According to the welding device for the sharp corner fabric of the automobile rear ceiling, disclosed by the utility model, the automatic positioning of the automobile ceiling and the straightening and trimming of the welded point fabric are realized, the welding is automatically carried out through the ultrasonic welding assembly, the working efficiency is effectively improved, and the welding surface is smooth and attractive.

title_en: Quick forming die of plastic shell
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of injection molds, in particular to a rapid forming mold of a plastic shell, which comprises an upper mold and a lower mold, wherein a cooling mechanism is arranged on the lower mold, an injection cavity is arranged in the upper mold, a cavity is arranged in the lower mold, a high-efficiency cooling circulation system is constructed through the cooling mechanism consisting of a double-side circulating fan, a copper pipe and the like, the cooling time is greatly shortened, the leakage of plastic raw materials in the injection molding process is avoided through the close fit of a sealing frame around the injection cavity and a sealing groove around the cavity, the occurrence of surface flaws and dimensional deviation of products is avoided, the defective rate is obviously reduced, the consistency and the qualification rate of the products are improved, the positioning rod is prevented from being damaged due to collision in the mold closing process through a precise positioning mechanism, the service life of the mold is prolonged, the long-term stable operation of the mold is maintained, and the quality of the products is always stable.

title_en: Device is buried underground to dustproof cloth mould
abstract_en: The utility model provides an embedded device of a dustproof cloth mold, which comprises a cloth placing mechanism, a plastic part forming mechanism and a cloth pulling and cutting mechanism which are sequentially arranged along the vertical direction, wherein the plastic part forming mechanism comprises a female mold and a male mold which is arranged opposite to the female mold, the male mold can be relatively close to/far away from the female mold to form the plastic part, the cloth placing mechanism is used for feeding dustproof cloth with a preset length between the male mold and the female mold before the male mold is close to the female mold to mold the plastic part, in the process of molding the plastic part by closing the male mold and the female mold, the dustproof cloth fed between the male mold and the female mold is attached to a preset surface of the plastic part, after the male mold is far away from the female mold to open the mold, the cloth pulling and cutting mechanism clamps the lower end of the dustproof cloth to a preset position, and cuts the dustproof cloth at a cutting position far away from the lower end of the dustproof cloth. The in-mold burying device for the dustproof cloth provided by the utility model can directly bond the plastic product with the dustproof cloth in the process of molding the plastic product, has no glue participation, is environment-friendly, saves cost and can effectively improve the production efficiency.

title_en: Bird-repellent device for protecting upland rice
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bird-driving device for protecting upland rice, which relates to the field of upland rice protection and comprises a connector, wherein the bottom end of the connector is connected with a movable structure, the movable structure is rotatably connected to a lifting structure, the lifting structure is used for being connected and fixed with the ground, connecting holes are respectively formed in the periphery of the connector and are respectively used for connecting rods, the connecting rods are in threaded connection with the connecting holes, one end of each connecting rod, which is far away from the connector, is connected with a mirror bracket, a reflector is installed on the mirror bracket, and the top end of the connector is connected with a rotating structure for driving the connector and the movable structure connected with the connector to rotate. From the whole design improvement bird repellent device, this bird repellent device can replace "scarecrow" or "screen panel" to drive the bird, not only lay implementation convenient and fast through this bird repellent device, does not need to consume electric power resource moreover, uses manpower sparingly and time.

title_en: Adjustable hanging hook rack for hanging vines
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of vine hanging, and discloses an adjustable vine hanging hook frame which comprises a hook frame body, wherein an upper hook is arranged at the top end of the hook frame body close to the rear side, a lower hook is arranged at the bottom end of the hook frame body close to the front side, a first through hole is formed in the center of the front side of the hook frame body in a penetrating manner, a second through hole is formed in the center of the front side of the hook frame body close to the bottom of the first through hole in a penetrating manner, a third through hole is formed in the center of the bottom of the hook frame body in a penetrating manner, and the adjustable vine hanging hook frame further comprises a lifting rope collecting and releasing assembly which is connected with the hook frame body in a rotating manner through the first through hole, and the lifting rope collecting and releasing assembly is used for collecting and releasing lifting ropes.

title_en: Rose seedling transplanting device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a rose seedling transplanting device. The rose seedling transplanting device comprises a bottom plate, handrails, upright rods, a magnetic bar and a movable groove, wherein universal wheels are fixedly arranged at the bottom of the bottom plate, the handrails are fixedly arranged on the bottom plate, the upright rods are fixedly arranged on two sides of the bottom plate, a placing frame is fixedly arranged between the upright rods, a vertical baffle is arranged on one side, close to the handrails, of the placing frame, the movable groove is formed in the placing frame, a lifting plate is hinged in the movable groove and used for helping a container filled with rose seedlings to be separated from the placing frame through a traction mechanism, and the magnetic bar is fixedly arranged on the upright rod on the side far away from the handrails. The rose seedling transplanting device provided by the utility model has the advantages of simplifying the assembly and disassembly processes of the device and improving the transplanting efficiency of the rose seedlings.

title_en: Demoulding structure for plastic mould
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a demoulding structure for a plastic mould, which comprises a driving block, a forming block, a movable core block, a fixed core block, a main body, a first movable core pulling unit, a second movable core pulling unit and a rotary core pulling unit, wherein the driving block and the forming block are respectively arranged in front of and behind the driving block and are mutually matched, the movable core block and the fixed core block are respectively embedded in the rear side of the driving block and the front side of the forming block and are mutually matched, the main body is arranged between the driving block and the forming block and is mutually matched with the movable core block and the fixed core block, the main body comprises a first movable core pulling unit, a second movable core pulling unit and a rotary core pulling unit which are mutually matched, the rotary core pulling unit comprises a gear which is rotatably connected in the front side of the forming block and is positioned between the first sliding block and the fixed core block, a sector block which is concentrically fixed in the front end of the gear and is movably connected in the front of the first sliding block so as to have an arc-shaped movement function, a rack which is movably arranged in the front side of the forming block so as to have an up-down vertical movement function and is vertically meshed with the right side of the gear, and a third oil cylinder which is fixed on the outer wall of the upper side of the forming block.

title_en: Concrete cloth vibration equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to concrete cloth vibration equipment which comprises a cloth machine, a lifting platform, a vibration table and a noise reduction room, wherein the cloth machine, the lifting platform and the vibration table are all arranged in the noise reduction room, the cloth machine is arranged at the upper part of the noise reduction room, a cloth station for distributing workpieces is arranged at the upper part of the noise reduction room, the vibration table is arranged at the bottom of the noise reduction room, a vibration station for vibrating the workpieces is arranged at the lower part of the noise reduction room, and the lifting platform can lift the workpieces to the vibration station for cloth processing or lower the workpieces to the vibration station for vibration processing. The distributing machine, the vibrating table and the lifting platform of the concrete distributing vibrating equipment are positioned at the same projection plane, so that the three-dimensional space is fully utilized, the production line circulation time is reduced, and the production efficiency is improved under the condition that the stations of the production line are not reduced.

title_en: A method of attaching at least two pieces of fabric and a footwear comprising a membrane
abstract_en: A method of attaching at least two pieces of fabric (42, 44) in a waterproof fabric product, whereby the at least two pieces of fabric (42, 44) are attached at a seam and whereby the seam subsequently is sealed by application of a sealing tape (48). The method comprises - attaching the at least two pieces of fabric (42, 44) to each other by a welding process to form a welded seam (46), and - performing said sealing by applying said sealing tape (48) to cover said welded seam (46) at one side of the fabric. Also disclosed is a waterproof fabric product (40) that has been produced using the method of attaching at least two pieces of fabric (42, 44) and even further, a footwear comprising a membrane wherein the membrane comprises at least two pieces of fabric that are attached at a seam.

title_en: Procedure for the decoration of portions of objects
abstract_en: The invention relates to a process for decorating portions of the surface of objects (2) which comprises, in order: - the deposition of decorating materials or other semi-finished materials used for decorating objects (2) onto individual portions of surface; - the physical-chemical fixing or firing of the materials deposited onto the said portions of the surface through the action of at least one laser beam (3) aimed at the individual portion of surface in question.

title_en: Sic-si composite member production method and sic-si composite member
Glass fiber for road reinforcement
abstract_en: A device for producing and applying a fibrous reinforcement material, such as a texturized strand material, as well as systems for and methods of reinforcing a road using the fibrous reinforcement material, are disclosed.

title_en: Power tool
abstract_en: A power tool (1) is disclosed comprising an electric motor (3) configured to power a tool (5) of the power tool (1), a power supply arrangement (7, 9) configured to supply electricity to the electric motor (3), and an air-cooling path (11, 11') extending past at least portions of the electric motor (3) and the power supply arrangement (7, 9) so as to cool the electric motor (3) and the power supply arrangement (7, 9) when air is flowing through the air-cooling path (11, 11'). The power tool (1) further comprises a fan (13) arranged in the air-cooling path (11, 11') between the electric motor (3) and the power supply arrangement (7, 9). The fan (13) is configured to generate an air flow through the air-cooling path (11, 11') in a flow direction (d) from the electric motor (3) towards the power supply arrangement (7, 9).

title_en: Silicon nanostructures as luminescent markers for the recycling of plastic
abstract_en: The invention relates to the use of silicon nanostructures as luminescent markers for plastics. Polymers in which the nanostructures described herein have been uniformly dispersed acquire luminescence with a long life span. This acquired characteristic makes it possible to use an optical recognition technique which consists of applying a delay between excitation and analysis of the sample. Applying a delay to the reading eliminates spurious signals, preserving the luminescence of the silicon nanostructures, which thus has an advantage in respect of sensitivity and reduces the amount of marker necessary.

title_en: Method for producing a thermoplastically deformable, fiber-reinforced flat semi-finished product
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for producing a thermoplastically deformable, fiber-reinforced, flat semi-finished product having a composite structure (A-B-A') or (A-B), comprising: • a core layer (B) consisting of a porous reinforcement fiber thermoplastic material, having a mass per unit area of 300 to 3,000 g/m 2 , a fiber content of 20 to 60 wt.% and an air pore content of 5 to 80 vol.%, and • one or two cover layers (A, A') which are integrally bonded to the core layer (B) and are made of a woven or nonwoven reinforcement fiber fabric impregnated with thermoplastic, each cover layer having a thickness of 0.2 to 2.5 mm, a mass per unit area of 200 to 4,000 g/m 2  and an air pore content of less than 3 vol.%. According to the invention, the following method steps are carried out: • the following are applied to one or both sides of a core layer precursor in the form of a flat, porous reinforcement fiber thermoplastic material having a mass per unit area of 300 to 3,000 g/m 2 , a fiber content of 20 to 60 wt.% and an air pore content of 20 to 80 vol.%: at least one woven or nonwoven reinforcement fiber fabric having a mass per unit area of 100 to 1,000 g/m 2 , and a thermoplastic layer which has a low viscosity compared with the thermoplastic material of the core layer precursor and a mass per unit area of 50 to 1,000 g/m 2 ; • the layer structure (A-B) or (A-B-A') thus formed is heated and compressed such that the thermoplastic of the low-viscosity thermoplastic layer is melted and penetrates into the applied woven or nonwoven reinforcement fiber fabric and into the core layer and, after cooling, forms an integral bond of the core layer and the cover layer.

title_en: Growth medium with polymer
abstract_en: Various disclosed examples relate to a growth medium including expanded polymer particulates, as well as a growth environment including the growth medium, a container housing a nutrient solution and a plant such that roots of the plant are received in the growth medium. Associated methods of preparing the growth medium are also contemplated, including sterilization of the growth medium and preparation of the growth medium with a growth promoting agent.

title_en: Methods of manufacturing articles having foam particles
abstract_en: Methods for manufacturing three-dimensional components of articles, including articles of footwear, apparel, and sporting equipment are provided. The disclosed methods comprise providing a first composition comprising a plurality of foam particles suspended in a liquid polymerizable composition, polymerizing a first portion of the liquid polymerizable composition to form a first layer of polymeric material at least partially encapsulating a first portion of the plurality of foam particles, repeating the polymerizing and forming for at least a second and third iteration, each iteration forming a layer on the previous layer, thereby forming a three-dimensional component having at least three layers, each layer including foam particles at least partially encapsulated by the first polymeric material. Articles manufactured using the disclosed methods are also provided.

title_en: Method and apparatus for forming an apex
abstract_en: A method for forming an apex is disclosed. The method comprises the steps of: winding an elastomer strip of rubber onto a rotatable platen (110), wherein the rotatable platen has a radially expandable bead chuck (115) located on a radially inner portion of the rotatable platen (110), wherein the rotatable platen (110) has an outer surface having a nonstick coating, and wherein the rotatable platen further includes one or more bars (120). Also, an apparatus for forming an apex and bead subassembly is disclosed. The apparatus (100) comprises a rotatable platen (110), a radially expandable bead chuck (115) mounted on the rotatable platen (110), wherein the rotatable platen (110) has an outer surface having a nonstick coating, and wherein the outer surface further includes one or more bars (120).

title_en: Mincing drum for a cutting and separating device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mincing drum (110) for a cutting and separating device, at the first end section (112) of which there is an inlet opening (113) and at the second end section (114) of which there is an outlet opening (115), a plurality of cutting openings (120) being arranged in a pressure housing section (116) of the mincing drum (110) and passing continuously through the pressure housing section (116) from an inner wall (117) to an outer wall (118), each cutting opening (120) having, on the inner wall (117), a cutting opening edge (112a) facing the outlet opening (115) and a drawing-in opening edge (122b) facing the inlet opening (113). The invention addresses the problem of improving a mincing drum (110) such that the cutting performance of the cutting and separating device and the quality of the desired food component is significantly improved. The problem is solved according to the invention in that a feed channel (100) which is recessed relative to the inner wall (117) is situated between the cutting opening edge (122a) and the drawing-in opening edge (122b).

title_en: 3d printing machine and manufacturing method
abstract_en: A multi-head 3D printing machine has a first and second common guides for a plurality of deposition heads and provides a relative displacement between the deposition heads along a third guide, the first, second and third guides identifying a reference frame. The 3D printing machine further comprises a control unit programmed to process a sequence of discretized position information within the reference frame and deposition information so as to deposit non-replica, non-mirrored segments while the deposition heads simultaneously operate.

title_en: Oxide layer-containing zirconium-niobium alloy partitioned trabecular bone single-compartment tibial plateau and preparation method
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a zonal trabecular uni-compartmental tibial plateau containing zirconium-niobium alloy on oxidation layer and preparation method, including following steps: using zirconium niobium alloy powder as raw material, conducting a 3D printing for one-piece molding to obtain an intermediate product of the uni-compartmental tibial plateau, performing hot isostatic pressing and cryogenic oxidation to obtain the uni-compartmental tibial plateau; the lower surface of the semi-tibial plateau support and the surface of the keel plate are both provided with a bone trabeculae; the zonal trabecular uni-compartmental tibial plateau adopts the structure of arranging step distributed bone trabeculaes which can reduce the fretting wear of the interface between the prosthesis and the bone, and reduce the stress shielding effect of the prosthesis on the bone tissue, homogenize the stress of the tibial plateau bone tissue, and improve the initial stability and long-term stability of the uni-compartmental tibial plateau. The present invention adopts integral 3D printing technology so as to solve the problem that traditional machining cannot prepare a complex structure, and has high bonding strength between trabeculae and the matrix, therefore it is not easy to fall off, thereby improving the service life of the prosthesis.

title_en: Sensor having an injection moulded housing made from liquid silicone rubber
abstract_en: The invention relates to a sensor (1) comprising a sensor element (2), a connecting element for electrical connection and a housing (8) applied onto the sensor element. Here the housing (8) comprises a housing material with cured liquid silicone rubber (LSR) as a main component.

title_en: Master batch, resin composition, polyolefin resin film, production method therefor, and layered film
abstract_en: The masterbatch includes a non-modified polyolefin resin, a modifier, and an antifogging agent, the modifier is at least one selected from a group consisting of an ethylene vinyl acetate copolymer, an ethylene unsaturated carboxylic acid ester copolymer, and a modified polyolefin resin with an unsaturated acid anhydrate, the antifogging agent is at least one selected from a group consisting of an alkylsulfonic acid alkali metal salt, an alkylarylsulfonic acid alkali metal salt, and an alkylsulfate alkali metal salt, content ratios of the modifier and antifogging agent are respectively 4 to 85 parts by mass and 0.4 to 16.0 parts by mass based on 100 parts by mass of the non-modified polyolefin resin.

title_en: Additive manufacturing compositions and methods including resin stabilized pigments
abstract_en: Additive manufacturing compositions and methods may include a resin stabilized pigment. The pigment may be easily combined with at least one component of a co-reactive system, such as a co-reactive prepolymer formulation, via solid mixing without the need for grinding or additional solvents. The prepolymer formulation may be pigmented, printed, and cured under ambient conditions, and one or more pigments may be incorporated into the composition to change the color of the composition during printing and/or to selectively change the color of the printed article among several colors.

title_en: Milk storage tank
abstract_en: There is provided a milk storage tank (1) arranged to store milk at an animal milking site, the milk storage tank (1) comprising a tank housing (2) provided with a milk storage space (3); a milk outlet opening (10) in the tank housing (2) enabling passing of milk out of the milk storage space (3); at least two milk inlet openings (20, 30) in the tank housing (1), separate from the milk outlet opening (10), each milk inlet opening (20, 30) enabling passing of milk into the milk storage space (3), wherein each milk inlet opening (20, 30) is adapted to receive and be connected to a respective milk conduit (21, 31); and, for each of the at least two milk inlet openings (20, 30), a respective valve (22, 32) mounted on the outside surface of the tank housing (2) at the respective milk inlet opening (20, 30), the valve (22, 32) being configured to close or open the respective milk opening (20, 30).

title_en: Padel bat
abstract_en:
Provided is a padel bat 2 having excellent durability and stiffness. 
     A padel bat 2 has a handle 4 and a head 6. The head 6 has a face fabric 18. The face fabric 18 has a first fiber inclined in a first direction relative to the axial direction of the head 6, and a second fiber inclined in a second direction relative to the axial direction. The head 6 further has a plurality of holes 20. A first array inclined in the first direction relative to the axial direction and a second array inclined in the second direction relative to the axial direction are each formed of the holes 20. A direction of the first fiber and a direction of the first array coincide with each other. A direction of the second fiber and a direction of the second array coincide with each other.

title_en: Polyolefin composition for roofing applications
abstract_en: A soft polyolefin composition comprising for producing sheets or membranes, the polyolefin composition comprising: (A) 18-35% by weight of a copolymer of propylene with at least one alpha-olefin, wherein the copolymer contains 2.0-4.0% by weight of alpha-olefin, the amount of alpha-olefin is based on the weight of (A) and has melt flow rate (MFRA) ranging from 30 to 60 g/10min; and (B) 65-82% by weight of a copolymer of propylene with at least one alpha-olefin, and optionally a diene, the copolymer comprising 20-35% by weight of alpha-olefin, the amount of alpha olefin being based on the weight of (B), wherein - the polyolefin composition comprises a fraction that is soluble in xylene at 25°C (XS(tot)) in an amount higher than 70% by weight; - the amounts of (A), (B) and of the fraction soluble in xylene at 25°C (XS(tot)) are based on the total weight of the polyolefin composition; and - the melt flow rate (MFR) of the polyolefin composition ranges from 0.2 to 2.0 g/10 min.

title_en: Low environmental impact flexible hose, as well as manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: A thermoplastic elastomer for manufacturing a low environmental impact flexible hose for transporting fluids, in particular liquids, consisting of (A) from 30% by weight to 80% by weight of a polymer matrix consisting of from 10% by weight to 35% by weight with respect to the total weight of the thermoplastic elastomer of a first thermoplastic part (A1) and from 20% by weight to 45% by weight with respect to the total weight of the thermoplastic elastomer of a second elastomeric part (A2); (B) from 30% by weight to 55% by weight of at least one plasticising agent; (C) from 0% to 30% by weight of at least one filler; (D) from 0% to 10% by weight of at least one additive. The thermoplastic elastomer has a Shore A hardness measured according to the UNI EN ISO 868 standard comprised between 50 Sh A and 85 Sh A and a percentage of post-consumer material according to the UNI EN ISO 14021 and UNI EN 15343 standards greater than or equal to 50%. The thermoplastic elastomer is in an amount greater than or equal to 90% by weight on the total weight of the flexible hose.

title_en: Device and method for introducing seeds or seedlings into a substrate cord, having a substrate cord covered with a sheath, and system for cultivating plants with a substrate cord
abstract_en: The invention relates to a device and a method for introducing seeds (13) or seedlings (46) into a substrate cord (2), and to a substrate cord (2) covered with a sheath (4), and to a system for cultivating plants (46) with a substrate cord (2). It is essential for the invention that the substrate cord (2) is surrounded by a sheath (4) and the space enclosed by the sheath (4) is filled with a plant substrate (3). According to the invention, openings (9) are introduced at a predetermined point into the sheath (4), through which openings the seeds (13) or seedlings (46) are inserted into the plant substrate (3). The advantage of the invention consists in substantial automation of these operations in order to increase the efficiency and economic viability.

title_en: Method and machine for the production of an optical element by additive manufacturing
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a method and a device for the production of an optical element from a curable material by using an additive manufacturing technology. According to the disclosure, this method comprises: A - providing a curable material; B - curing said curable material inside sliced outlines (C1) whose geometry are determined according to the geometry of said optical element, said optical element comprising at least: a first volume element (V1) and a second volume element (V2), by forming the first volume element (V1) by irradiating the curable material with at least a first curing surface energy (E1) with a first light depth penetration value within the curable material (Dp1), and forming the second volume element (V2) by irradiating the curable material with at least a second curing surface energy (E2) with a second light depth penetration value within the curable material (Dp2), wherein said second light depth penetration value within the curable material (Dp2) is different from the first light depth penetration value within the curable material (Dp1).

title_en: Method for pyrolysis of used rubber and rubber material for pyrolysis
abstract_en: Provided is a thermal decomposition method of used rubber that has excellent yields of isoprene and limonene without reducing the efficiency of thermal decomposition. The method is a method of thermally decomposing used rubber, including bringing the used rubber into contact with or swelling the used rubber in a medium, where the medium has a SP value of 8.3 (cal/cm 3 ) 1/2  to 11 (cal/cm 3 ) 1/2  and an endothermic peak temperature of 235 °C or higher measured by thermogravimetry (TGA), and the medium is liquid at 150 °C, and then performing thermal decomposition.

title_en: Chemical treatment of components
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method of treatment of objects produced by an additive manufacturing method, having at least one surface formed from a polymer having a glass transition temperature of at least 120°C, and preferably being formed from such a polymer, and in which the surface of the object is contacted with an organic or inorganic solvent. Such a treatment can smooth the surface of the objects and improve relevant mechanical properties. The present invention further relates to three-dimensional objects produced by such a method and to the use of organic or inorganic solvents for reduction of surface roughness and/or for improvement of mechanical properties and/or chemical stability.

title_en: Improved detection of a solar panel for a robotic work tool
abstract_en:
A method for use in a robotic work tool system (200) comprising a robotic work tool (100) arranged to operate in an operational area (205) comprising one or more solar panels (10) each solar panel (10) having a panel (11) and one or more poles (12) connected to the panel (11) through a supporting structure (13), the operational area (205) having a surface that is at least partially irregular, and the robotic work tool comprising a memory (120) configured to store supporting structure geometry data, an image sensor (185), wherein the method comprises: 
receiving an image from the image sensor (185) detecting a pole (12) in the image and determining a scale based on the determined height of the detected pole (12), wherein the pole (12) is detected based on the stored supporting structure geometry data.

title_en: Method for polymerizing superficial features in 3d-printed parts
abstract_en: A method includes: accessing a part model comprising a three-dimensional representation of a part; accessing a material profile relating exposure energy and three-dimensional polymerization geometry of a material selected for the part; segmenting the part model into a set of model layers; detecting a first upward-facing surface in the part model; defining a first model volume in a first model layer, adjacent the first upward-facing surface, and fully contained within the part model; based on the material profile, calculating a first exposure energy predicted to yield a first three-dimensional polymerization geometry approximating a first contour of the first upward-facing surface when projected onto the material during a build; populating a first print image with the first exposure energy in a first image area corresponding to the first model volume in the first model layer; and storing the first print image in a print file for the part.

title_en: Large-area blank for prosthesis fabrication and method for manufacturing same
abstract_en: The present invention provides a large-area blank wherein no crystal-phase peak exists in the range of 2θ 10-70, and the degree of crystallinity of 0.00% in an X-ray diffraction analysis pattern using CuKα rays, but crystalline particles having an average particle size of 10-70nm are confirmed to be distributed in an amorphous SiO 2 -Li 2 O-Al 2 O 3 -series glass matrix from an SEM-based analysis, and the blank has a long-axis length of at least 60 mm and a thickness of at least 6 mm. The present invention is advantageous as follows: the blank is a workpiece having a large area and excellent processability such that processability can be improved during cutting, thereby reducing tool resistance and wear ratio, and increasing the tool lifespan; edge chipping can be reduced during processing; when fabricating multiple dental restorations successively as needed by using a single blank, the blank use efficiency can be improved, and dental restoration productivity can be improved; high-strength dental restorations having different degrees of transparency can be manufactured from processed dental restorations through simple processes with different post heat treatment conditions; and dental restorations that implement various shades can be manufactured through a single blank, thereby contributing to circulation management simplification.

title_en: Porous glass atomization core, preparation method therefor, and electronic atomizer
abstract_en: This application relates to the technical field of electronic atomization devices, and in particular to a porous glass atomization core, a production method therefor and an electronic atomizer. In the production method for the porous glass atomization core, the porous glass is produced with glass powder as a main component, and a fiber component as a framework, preventing the pore structure collapse caused by the softening and flow of glass, and ensuring the pore structure of the porous glass to a great extent. The produced porous glass has the characteristics of high porosity (50-80%), appropriate pore size (10-200 µm), smooth and continuous internal surface, which can reduce the adsorption of low-viscosity components in atomizing mediums by a porous substrate, and ensure the full atomization of atomizing medium components; and as a substrate of a heating unit in the electronic atomizer, the porous glass improves the taste and aroma reduction degree of the electronic atomizer. By specifically limiting the diameter and aspect ratio of the fiber component, smoke attenuation and carbon deposition during the smoking process can also be avoided.

title_en: System for location monitoring and uses thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system (100) for determining the location of a number of animals in a group of animals, comprising a first number of first mobile devices (10A - 10C) forming anchor devices, each configured to be attached to an animal of a first subgroup of the group of animals, each first mobile device (10A - 10C) comprising a satellite positioning unit (11) for detecting a precise location of the first mobile device (10A - 10C), and a first radio frequency (RF) unit (12) for transmitting a low power RF signal, a second number of second mobile devices (20A - 20J) forming roaming devices, each configured to be attached an animal of a second subgroup of the group of animals, each second mobile device (20A - 20J) comprising a second radio frequency (RF) unit (21) for receiving one or more RF signals transmitted by the first number of first mobile devices (10A - 10C), and a second controller (22) configured to determine a location or relative location of the second mobile device (20A – 20J) based on the one or more received RF signals utilizing an RF mesh positioning technique.

title_en: Pick-up attachment for a harvesting machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to a pick-up attachment for a harvesting machine.

title_en: Recyclable crosslinked epoxy resin
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a thermoset crosslinked epoxide resin composition obtainable by a method that comprises mixing an epoxide-functionalised resin with a cross-linking agent and a catalyst; and curing the mixture thus obtained, with the proviso that the cross-linking agent comprises a disulphide bond. It also relates to composites, prepregs and articles comprising them and a reinforcement phase comprising fibres. And a process for recycling the thermoset crosslinked epoxide resin and the reinforcement phase comprising fibres from the composite or the article containing the thermoset crosslinked epoxide resin.

title_en: Open field game arrangement comprising responsive targets
abstract_en: An open field game arrangement comprising a playing field including one or more unmanned vehicles that serve as ground or air targets, one or more display projectors that generate holographic targets, and a control system that determines whether a particular target was struck and generates one or more responses, such as a sound effect, a smoke effect, a scoring event, or other preprogrammed responses to a particular event.

title_en: Process for the production of wood fiberboard
abstract_en: The process for the production of wood fiberboard comprises the step in which refined material from recycled wood fiberboards is wetted, heated and pressurized using steam; the step in which this material is kept under pressure and temperature for a certain amount of time, followed by the step of reducing the pressure of this material by at least 3 bar. After this pressure reduction, the material is transformed into recycled wood fibers, possibly with a fraction of wood fiber clumps and any other impurities. The recycled wood fibers are supplied as feedstock in a production line for producing wood fiberboard.

title_en: Ultrahigh-concentration shear thickening fluid, preparation method therefor, and use thereof
abstract_en: Disclosed are an ultrahigh-concentration shear thickening fluid, a preparation method therefor, and a use thereof. The fluid is composed of nanoparticles and a solvent, the volume fraction of the nanoparticles in the fluid is 0.63-0.65, and the solvent is liquid polyhydric alcohol. The nanoparticles are pre-mixed and then are subjected to strong shear dispersion until a "Tyndall effect" appears, then a high-circulation instrument is used for further mixing uniformly such that the fluid has good uniformity, and finally drying is performed until the total content of small molecule alcohol impurities is not more than 3.5 wt%. The shear thickening fluid of the present invention has a concentration of 0.63 to 0.65, has a greater thickening amplitude (the ratio of the highest concentration to the lowest concentration is more than 1000 times at most) than that of discontinuous shear thickening of all existing fluids, has a better impact energy absorption effect, and has more significant improvement on the impact resistance of products to which the shear thickening fluid is applied.

title_en: Prediction method, prediction program, environmental adjustment method, and environmental adjustment program
abstract_en: To accurately predict a cultivation period from flowering to a time when a fruit is able to be harvested in a fruit vegetable, a computer implements processing of acquiring or estimating a fruit temperature that is a temperature of a fruit surface of the fruit vegetable on and after a flowering date, calculating a period of each of a plurality of stages acquired by dividing a period from flowering to harvest, based on the fruit temperature, and predicting the cultivation period by summing calculated periods of the plurality of stages, in the calculating, a contribution degree of the fruit temperature to a calculation result of a period of each of the plurality of stages is determined for each of the stages.

title_en: Build material composition and thermally conductive agent for three-dimensional printing
abstract_en: Examples of a build material composition and a thermally conductive agent for three-dimensional printing are disclosed. An example of the build material composition includes from about 90 wt% to about 99 wt% of thermoplastic polyurethane particles and from about 1 wt% to about 10 wt% of a thermally conductive filler, based on a total weight of the build material composition. An example of the thermally conductive agent includes an aqueous vehicle and from about 1 wt% active to about 10 wt% active of the thermally conductive filler, based on a total weight of the thermally conductive agent. In both examples, the thermally conductive filler is selected from cubic boron nitride and diamond-like carbon.

title_en: Heater module for aerosol generating device and aerosol generating device including the same
abstract_en: A heater module for an aerosol generating device includes a module main body including a heater accommodation groove for accommodating a heater detachably coupled to a cartridge including an aerosol generating material, and a printed circuit board (PCB) accommodation groove for accommodating a PCB unit electrically connected to an aerosol generating device, a heater terminal arranged in the module main body and electrically connected to the heater to transmit, to the heater, power from a battery included in the aerosol generating device, and a recognition terminal arranged apart from the heater terminal in the module main body and electrically connected to the PCB unit and the cartridge.

title_en: Selectively attachable lighting devices and methods
abstract_en: A lighting device for a dynamic securement on tactical equipment and corresponding methods are disclosed. The lighting device includes a housing with a channel defined by first and second opposed surfaces of the housing, where the channel is configured to receive a mounting member therein. The lighting device further includes one or more fasteners extending from the first surface and/or the second surface and configured to bias against the mounting member to secure the mounting member in the channel. Lighting device further includes an optical assembly secured to the housing and comprising a light source.

title_en: A compact stick snack product coating assembly
abstract_en: The invention relates to a coating assembly for baked stick snack products comprising (22): a plurality of claws (10) engaging a plurality of rowed and spaced apart baked stick snack products (2) provided at a feeding station (1) so as to hold them at one end; a transport equipment (30) receiving opposite ends of a spindle (80) bearing each of the claws (10) and supporting the claws (10) so as they advance in continuous motion along a line at a predetermined line speed from a loading zone (A) near to a feeding station (1) towards a further entry zone (B); a container (22) containing a fluid or semi-fluid coating liquid in which the snack product (2) is at least partially immersed to provide coating (3) upon aligning from the top in a coating position the claws (10) carrying the snack product (2) in a vertical position, characterized in that the transport equipment (30) comprises a returning zone (E) which advances so as to carry the coated (3) snack product (2) to a discharge station (5) close to the feeding station (1).

title_en: Heat-ray blocking film and agricultural greenhouse
abstract_en: A heat ray shielding film has, in the following order, a thermoplastic resin substrate A, a heat ray shielding layer including a binder resin and an inorganic particle, and a thermoplastic resin substrate B.

title_en: Instrument for ophthalmic surgery
abstract_en: Instrument comprising: a. forceps (1) with an active end (1d) and a sleeve (2) receiving the forceps (1) with sliding, b. a central body (3) with a first, proximal end (3p) integral with a handle (4) and a second, distal end (3d) to which is fixed a first end (1p) of the forceps, opposite the active end (1d) of said forceps (1), c. an actuator (5) formed by a set of levers (6) extending around the central body (3) and having first ends (6p) connected to the central body (3) and second ends (6d) joined by a socket (7) to which the sleeve (2) is fixed, the levers (6) being elastically deformable between a first, deactivated position of the forceps (1), in which position the active end (1d) of the forceps (1) is open and projects from the sleeve (2), and a second, activated position, in which the sleeve (2) exerts a force on the active end (1d) of the forceps (1), forcing the closure of the active end (1d) of the forceps (1), wherein the central body (3), the actuator (5) and the socket (7) are a one-piece component.

title_en: Method and apparatus for preparing flakes
abstract_en: There is disclosed a method of manufacturing flakes, comprising: a) providing a liquid stock comprising at least one solid material dissolved or dispersed in a liquid; b) applying the liquid stock to a first movable surface, so as to form thereon a thin film of liquid stock; c) cyclically i) evaporating at least a part of the liquid from the thin film, so as to increase the concentration of solid particles, and ii) applying pressure to the film by passing it through at least one nip formed by urging opposed surfaces towards one another, so as to progressively form a layer comprised of relatively dry flakes consisting of agglomerated and/or compacted solid particles. Flakes made thereby and an apparatus for producing the same are also disclosed, as well as uses and advantages of such flakes.

title_en: Fractionation process of lignocellulosic biomass producing rich biogenic carbon products
abstract_en: It is provided a fractionation process of a lignocellulosic biomass feedstock producing biogenic carbon products comprising impregnating the lignocellulosic biomass feedstock with water producing an impregnated wet solid fraction after draining the liquid; raising the temperature of the impregnated wet solid fraction by adding steam producing steamed wet solids; adding water to said steamed wet solids to a ratio of liquid to solids below 16 obtaining a mixture of liquid and steamed wet solids; filtering the mixture of liquid and steamed wet solids producing an hydrolysate fraction and a wet solid fraction; concentrating the hydrolysate fraction to obtain a concentrated sugar solution which can be converted into humins; drying the wet solid fraction and mixing the dried wet solid fraction in an ethanol solution containing a mineral acid producing a slurry; heating the slurry and filtering the heated slurry producing a liquid phase, a solid cake containing lignin oligomers convertible into biofuels and an acid-impregnated cellulose-rich residue.

title_en: Method for producing uniaxially stretched multilayer film
abstract_en: Method for producing monoaxially stretched multilayer film comprising the steps of: a) providing a multilayer film having two external layers comprising virgin thermoplastic material, and an internal layer comprising post-consumer recycled thermoplastic material, said film having a thickness greater than 100µm, b) heating said multilayer film to a temperature between 70 and 85°C, c) monoaxially stretching said multilayer film, while maintaining the temperature between 70 and 85°C, to a thickness of less than 100µm, d) annealing said monoaxially stretched film by maintaining the temperature of said film between 70 and 85°C for at least 20 seconds. Preferably, the internal layer, or core, comprises recycled PET, while external layers comprise virgin PET. The invention also relates to a monoaxially stretched multilayer film of thickness less than 100µm having two external layers comprising virgin PET and an internal layer comprising recycled thermoplastic material.

title_en: Systems and methods for gap adjustment in response to splice detection
abstract_en: A system for ultrasonically welding an elastic composite component, including a first guide roller to receive an elastic composite component including a first and second web layers and a plurality of elastic strands disposed between the web layers. A second guide roller receives the elastic composite component and feeds the elastic composite component in a machine direction. At least one of a working surface defined by a horn and an anvil surface defined by an anvil are moveable to adjust a distance therebetween. The elastic composite component is received between the working surface and the anvil surface from the second guide roller. A bottommost point of the second guide roller is offset from the working surface along a first axis corresponding to a thickness of the elastic composite component such that the elastic composite component is tensioned around an upstream edge of the working surface or the anvil surface.

title_en: Vulcanizable rubber compositions and vulcanizates therefrom that are free of metal-containing accelerators
abstract_en: A vulcanizable composition of matter comprising (a) a vulcanizable rubber; (b) a curative; (c) a filler; and (d) a Type I or Type II eutectic composition; where the composition is substantially devoid of a metal-containing accelerator.

title_en: Extruded thermoplastic foams and uses in applications requiring strength and lighweight
abstract_en: Disclosed are extruded foam comprising an extruded thermoplastic, closed-cell foam having at least a first surface and comprising: (i) thermoplastic polymer cell walls formed by an extrusion step, with the walls being comprised of at least about 0.5% by weight of ethylene furanoate moieties and optionally one or more co-monomer moieties; (ii) blowing agent contained in at least a portion of said closed cells; and a material different than said thermoplastic, closed-cell foam attached to and/or integral with at least a portion of said first foam surface.

title_en: Insect breeding equipment (Machine-translation by Google Translate, not legally binding)
abstract_en: Insect breeding equipment, characterized in that it is made up of a series of modules with a circular tray (1) that has an exit hole (2) towards a lower module, and a push sweeper (3) towards the hole , with a relative movement between each tray (1) and its sweeper (3), a control module that contains the electronics and one or more modules that include a water and excrement collection tank.  (Machine-translation by Google Translate, not legally binding)

title_en: SET OF APPLIANCES FOR MANUAL SOWING OR PLANTING (Machine-translation by Google Translate, not legally binding)
abstract_en: Set of apparatus for manual sowing or planting, characterized in that it consists of a first apparatus (1) formed by a table (1.1) with support elements adjustable in height (1.1.1) and handles (1.1.2) at its ends, said table (1.1) having an electric or combustion motor (1.2) to which a mechanical transmission is coupled and protected with a casing (1.2.1) responsible for rotating a series of vertical helical drills (1.2.2) oriented downwards and arranged on the table (1), and having on one of the handles (1.1.2), or on the table (1.1), a control (1.2.3) for starting or stopping and changing the rotation of the motor (1.2); It consists of a second apparatus (2) formed by a set of funnels (2.1) with vertical tubes (2.1.1), also oriented downwards, of the same number as the number of vertical helical drills (1.2.2) arranged in the first apparatus (1), and with the same separation distance. title_en: A system for spraying the interior of a container
abstract_en: A spraying system and method is provided for more efficiently accessing the interior of a container having an access opening to the container that is offset from or in angular relationship to the center and/or rotational axis of the container to contact the interior walls and surfaces of the container with a medium, such as a liquid, mixture, solution or suspension. The spraying system and method includes a non-linear boom that is elevated by a support structure, where the non-linear boom includes at its front end a plurality of spray nozzles. In one example, the support structure is a movable support structure that includes a guide mechanism where the guide mechanism is mounted on the moveable support structure at an angle relative to the surface supporting the moveable support structure to allow access to the interior of the container.

title_en: Manufacture of PET expanded cellular foams
abstract_en: A method of manufacturing an expanded cellular foam composed of polyethylene terephthalate (PET) from a polyethylene terephthalate component in particulate form. The polyethylene terephthalate in the polyethylene terephthalate component comprises of recycled polyethylene terephthalate, and has a melt flow rate (MFR) within the range of from 10 to 35 g/10 min; and an intrinsic viscosity within the range of from 0.70 to 1.0 dl/g. The polyethylene terephthalate component is blended with a chain extender, such as pyromellitic dianhydride (PMDA), nucleating agent(s), such as a thermoplastic fluoropolymer, and physical blowing agent(s), such as nitrogen or carbon dioxide, to form a molten expandable polyethylene terephthalate composition which is extruded through a die to form an expanded cellular foam, formed from polyethylene terephthalate, having improved fire-retardant properties.

title_en: Film
abstract_en: The present invention provides a polymeric film comprising a random distribution of inclusions that are incompatible with the polymeric material of the polymeric film, wherein the inclusions are present in an average number between about 0.4 and 120 inclusions per cm2 film. The films are preferably made from propylene, most preferably biaxially-orientated polypropylene and may be multi-layered films which are preferably used in food packaging. The voids may be included by including a dissimilar material, such as another polymer or inorganic material such as calcium carbonate or titanium dioxide. Preferably, the film contains some recycled material or post-consumer waste.

title_en: Printed annular metal-to-metal seal
abstract_en: A metal-to-metal seal for sealing an annular space between a well casing and a wellbore. The seal includes an inner portion and an outer portion, each portion including a central seal portion. The central seal portion has a concave shape in a de-energized state which curves towards the centerline of the seal and is capable of flexing radially outward towards surface of the annular space when energized. The central seal portion further includes at least one outer ridge extending outward away from the centerline of the seal and sealingly engages with the outer annular surface when energized.

title_en: Material transfer device
abstract_en: To arrange multiple materials on a delivery position (on a placement base of a next step) in an arrangement pattern with a high degree of freedom.SOLUTION: A material transfer device includes: a hand part (41) provided with holding parts (70a, 70b); and an arm part which moves the hand part. Each holding part has multiple needles (71, 72) and holds a material (K) by the needles sticking thereinto. The hand part (41) further includes: a frame part (62) connected to the arm part; and driving devices (64a, 64b) which are attached to the frame part and operate the multiple holding parts independently.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Foamable colored resin particle, method for producing the same and foam particle molding
abstract_en: To provide a foamable colored resin particle that shows a blue color and can inhibit the occurrence of a decomposition product of a coloring agent to cause an odor, a method for producing the same and a foam particle molding.SOLUTION: A foamable colored resin particle has a base resin containing a polystyrene resin, a coloring agent containing a green dye and a violet dye, and a foaming agent. The content of the coloring agent is 0.05 pt.mass or more and 0.30 pt.mass or less with respect to the base resin 100 pts.mass. The ratio of the violet dye content to the green dye content is 0.2 or more and 2.0 or less.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Glass supply device and method for manufacturing glass article
abstract_en: To provide a glass supply device that can preferably supply molten glass even when a flow passage wall is heated externally, and to provide a method for manufacturing a glass article.SOLUTION: A glass supply device 11 includes: a flow passage wall 12 for forming a flow passage for molten glass G; and a heating device 13. The heating device 13 includes a heat generating part 16a and externally heats the flow passage wall 12 using the heat generating part 16a. The flow passage wall 12 includes a main body pipe 14 constituted of an integrated molding of a non-metal material that can withstand the heat of molten glass G.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Resin molded article
abstract_en: To provide a resin molded article that improves an appearance of a mounting part.SOLUTION: A resin molded article comprises: a main body portion having a design surface and an opposite surface and having a first foam layer formed inside; an overhang portion that is provided on a peripheral edge of the main body portion and that projects to a side opposite to the design surface in a thickness direction of the main body portion; and a protrusion portion provided at a tip of the overhang portion in an overhang direction.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Decorative film and decorated molded object
abstract_en: To provide a decorative film which exhibits excellent adhesiveness to adherends including a polypropylene resin.SOLUTION: This invention relates to a decorative film including a decorative layer and an adhesive layer, wherein the adhesive layer comprises: a block copolymer including a block formed from an isopentane-derived structure; and a terpene phenol-based resin. This invention further relates to a decorated molded object obtained by applying the decorative film to an adherend including a polypropylene resin.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Fluid-flow-modification plate and extruder comprising the same
abstract_en: To provide a device and method for depositing an extruding material on a surface.SOLUTION: A fluid-flow-modification plate 200 comprises: a monolithic body 300 having an inlet-side surface 301 and an outlet-side surface 302; a first passage 501; a second passage 502; a third passage 503; and a fourth passage 504. The first passage through the fourth passage each extends between the inlet-side surface and the outlet-side surface. The first passage and the second passage intersect each other at a first intersection boundary 530. The third passage and the fourth passage intersect each other at a second intersection boundary 531. The first passage and the third passage do not intersect each other. The first passage and the fourth passage do not intersect each other. The second passage and the third passage do not intersect each other. The second passage and the fourth passage do not intersect each other. An outer peripheral boundary of a first passage-inlet-opening has a single-contact point with an outer peripheral boundary of a fourth passage-inlet-opening. An outer peripheral boundary of a second passage-outlet-opening has a single-contact point with an outer peripheral boundary of a third passage-outlet-opening.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Fireproof slab, rocket launch pad, and method of replacing fireproof brick in fireproof slab
abstract_en: To provide a fireproof slab that can make fireproof bricks partially replaceable.SOLUTION: The fireproof slab includes a bottom plate 12, a plurality of fireproof bricks 14 spread and arranged on the bottom plate 12, and a regulating member that regulates the movement of a position of the fireproof brick 14 on the bottom plate 12. The regulating member has a shaft portion that penetrates the bottom plate 12 and projects toward the fireproof brick 14 from a surface of the bottom plate 12 opposite to the arrangement side of the fireproof brick 14.
