By inserting a part of the shaft portion protruding toward the fireproof brick 14 from a bottom surface of the fireproof brick 14 facing the bottom plate 12 into the fireproof brick 14, the movement of the position of the fireproof brick 14 on the bottom plate 12 is regulated. The bottom plate 12 is provided with through holes 12A and 12B that can press the bottom surface of the fireproof brick 14.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Fish preserve
abstract_en: To provide a fish preserve capable of protecting cultured marine products from birds by having a stable steric hindrance above the level of water.SOLUTION: A fish preserve has a top face, side face parts, and a bottom face part, the top face is an opening surface that substantially coincides with the level of water, the side face parts extend from the side of the level of water to a water bottom side, the bottom face part is arranged at a lower side substantially parallel in the opening surface, and the side face parts and the bottom face part integrally form a fish preserve body 30 for housing marine products. The fish preserve includes a side rope 21 forming the external edges of the opening surface of the top face, a plurality of first floating bodies 22 attached to the side rope 21 at a substantially fixed interval, first support posts 28 fixed to the side rope 21 at a substantially fixed interval to extend upward, a second floating body 23 fixed to the inside of the side rope 21 on the opening surface separately from the side rope 21, a second support post 29 attached to the second floating body 23 to extend upward, and at least one first rope body 25 for connecting the first support posts 28 and the second support post 29 with one end fixed to a position higher than the level of water of the second support post 29 and with the other end fixed to a position higher than the level of water of the first support posts 28.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Pretreatment method and pretreatment apparatus of waste plastics
abstract_en: To provide a pretreatment method and a pretreatment apparatus of waste plastics capable of enhancing heating efficiency for a fluidized bed in a furnace while suppressing influence on a subsequent combustion apparatus to a minimum.SOLUTION: An apparatus for pretreating waste plastics to be supplied as a combustion improver to a fluidized-bed incinerator includes a crusher 2A for crushing waste plastics PO to obtain waste plastics crushed products P1, a first gravity separator 2B for separating and removing polyvinyl chloride from the waste plastics crushed products P1 to obtain waste plastics to be molded P2, a compression molding machine 2C for compression-molding the waste plastics to be molded P2 to produce waste plastics molded bodies P3, and a second gravity separator 2D for separating the waste plastics molded bodies P3 into high density waste plastics molded bodies P4 having an apparent specific gravity of 0.7 g/cm3 or more and low density waste plastics molded bodies P5 having an apparent specific gravity of less than 0.7 g/cm3 and selecting the high density waste plastics molded bodies P4 as the combustion improver to be supplied to the fluidized-bed incinerator.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Extrusion molding die, plastic manufacturing device, and plastic manufacturing method
abstract_en: To provide an extrusion molding die, a plastic manufacturing device, and a plastic manufacturing method that can suppress the occurrence of corrugated wrinkles in foamed plastic.SOLUTION: An extrusion molding die, such as a die 1, includes: an extrusion port 1c through which a plastic composition containing at least one type of plastic is extruded; and a plastic flow path 111 through which the supplied plastic composition flows to the extrusion port 1c. The plastic flow path 111 has: a supply flow path 111a through which the plastic composition is fed; and an extrusion flow path 111b. The extrusion flow path 111b has a flow path cross-sectional area perpendicular to a flow direction of the plastic composition in the extrusion flow path gradually changing to the extrusion port 1c, and in a cross-section parallel to an extrusion centre axis g including the extrusion centre axis g, an inner wall surface of the flow path is a convex surface that is convex to the inside of the flow path.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Hot runner device
abstract_en: To suppress occurrence of an inclination of a nozzle due to thermal expansion of a runner block toward a nozzle side in a hot runner device.SOLUTION: There is provided a hot runner device 10, in which: a hot runner block 18 has a first block 42 to which a supply nozzle 56 for supplying a molten resin R is connected, and a second block 44 to which a nozzle unit 20 is connected, which are slidably connected to each other along a longitudinal direction; the second block 44 has first and second insertion holes 80 and 82 into which first and second positioning pins 38 and 40 are inserted into a lower surface 44a facing a fixed mold 12; and the first insertion hole 80 on a supply nozzle 56 side is formed larger than the second insertion hole 82 on a nozzle unit 20 side.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Method for cultivating japanese horseradish and japanese horseradish cultivation management system
abstract_en: To provide a method for cultivating high-quality Japanese horseradish in a short time.SOLUTION: A method for cultivating Japanese horseradish in an indoor facility is provided, including a growing step in which, with the rhizomes of a seedling of Japanese horseradish being immersed in a nutritious liquid, artificial light is applied for circulation of the nutritious liquid, causing the rhizomes to grow. Here, the temperature of the indoor facility is set to 20°C or higher and the temperature of the nutritious liquid is set to 16°C or lower.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Polypropylene-based film and lamination film
abstract_en: To provide a polypropylene-based film and a lamination film capable of reducing environmental load without deteriorating the physical properties of a film by using biomass-derived polypropylene produced by the same production method as petroleum-derived polypropylene as a raw material for a film in a polypropylene-based film and a lamination film thereof used in the packaging field.SOLUTION: There is provided a polypropylene-based film in which a resin raw material comprises a biomass polypropylene including either or both of a propylene polymer obtained by polymerizing propylene produced by thermal cracking and fractionating bionaphtha or propylene produced by dehydrogenizing biopropane and a polypropylene copolymer obtained by poymerizing at least one of the propylene and an α-olefin, wherein the biomass polypropylene has a biomass degree of 5% or more, a melt flow rate of 0.1 to 50 g/10 min and a density of 0.850 to 0.910 g/cm3.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Lightweight concrete hardened body, lightweight concrete composition and method for producing lightweight concrete hardened body
abstract_en: To provide a lightweight concrete hardened body having improved crack resistance and carbonation resistance, excellent in durability, a lightweight concrete composition capable of obtaining a lightweight concrete hardened body excellent in durability, and a method for producing the lightweight concrete hardened body.SOLUTION: Provided are a lightweight concrete hardened body, a lightweight concrete composition, and a method for producing the lightweight concrete hardened body, which is a hardened body of a kneaded body including a lightweight coarse aggregate impregnated with a compound represented by an expression (I), cement, a fine aggregate, and water. In the expression (I), RIA is a hydrogen atom or a hydrocarbon group having 1-30 carbon atoms, RIB is an alkylene group having 1-5 carbon atoms, IC is an integer of 1-100, and a plurality of existing RIBO may be the same or different from each other.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Polyvinyl chloride resin substrate with antiviral properties
abstract_en: To provide a polyvinyl chloride resin substrate that suppresses the bleeding of low molecular substances like plasticizers, without compromising flexibility as a flexible polyvinyl chloride resin material, and demonstrates antiviral properties both initially and over time.SOLUTION: A polyvinyl chloride resin substrate comprises a coating layer on the surface of a flexible polyvinyl chloride resin layer. The coating layer comprises an antiviral agent containing a quaternary ammonium salt and a UV-curable resin. The content of the quaternary ammonium salt is more than 1 pts.mass and less than 10 pts.mass with respect to 100 pts.mass of the UV-curable resin.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Automatic traveling system and automatic traveling method
abstract_en: To provide a configuration that eliminates the need for position adjustment of a plurality of travel routes even when a plurality of travel paths are set for the same field, and that can efficiently manage the plurality of travel paths.SOLUTION: An automatic traveling system includes a control unit and a display control unit. The control unit is capable of switching between a first mode in which a work vehicle is caused to automatically travel along a first travel path including a straight path and a turning path and a second mode in which the work vehicle is caused to automatically travel along a second travel path including only a straight path. The display control unit causes a display unit 73 to display at least one of a work history of work performed by the work vehicle in the first mode and a work history of work performed by the work vehicle in the second mode.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 11

title_en: Roasting device
abstract_en: To provide a roasting device capable of sufficiently stirring a material to be roasted in a roasting pot, and preventing an occurrence of variations in a roasting degree.SOLUTION: A roasting device includes a heating part 14 provided in a draft air duct for heating passing air, and a cylindrical bottomed roasting pot 15 for storing the material to be roasted inside. A plurality of slit-shaped openings 16 are provided on the side face of the roasting pot 15 for taking in the air heated by the heating part 14. Each of the openings 16 extends long and obliquely in the height direction, and an opening area of the lower half is larger than that of the upper half. The material to be roasted is roasted while being stirred by the air taken in from the opening 16. Here, by making the opening area of the lower half of the opening 16 larger, much air is sent to the material to be roasted near the bottom surface of the roasting pot 15, and the material to be roasted in the roasting pot 15 can be sufficiently stirred.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Management device, management method, computer program, and management system
abstract_en: To efficiently collect performance data on an agricultural machine that can change operation modes.SOLUTION: A device according to one aspect of the present invention is a management device that communicates with an agricultural machine whose operation modes include an automatic operation and a non-automatic operation, and includes a processing device for creating an automatic operation plan for the agricultural machine, a communication device for transmitting the automatic operation plan to the agricultural machine, and receiving performance data that the agricultural machine collects on it, and a storage device for storing the received performance data. The performance data includes data that the agricultural machine has collected during the non-automatic operation performed by the intervention that has occurred during the automatic operation according to the automatic operation plan.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Biaxially oriented polyester film
abstract_en: To provide a biaxially oriented polyester film that has excellent mechanical property, transparency, heat resistance, as well as is excellent in suitability for secondary fabrication and print appearance, and to provide a method for producing the same.SOLUTION: Provided is a biaxially oriented polyester film in which at least one film surface satisfies the following (1) and (2), and the film satisfies the following (3) and (4). (1) The maximum protrusion height (SRp) is 1.2 to 1.6 μm. (2) Arithmetic mean roughness (SRa) is 0.024 to 0.045 μm. (3) Tensile strength in longitudinal and transverse directions is 180 to 300 MPa. (4) Haze is 7% or less.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Method for producing three-dimensional molded object
abstract_en: To provide a method for producing a three-dimensional molded object, which can effectively prevent collapse of an outer mold when a thermosetting resin is heated and cured.SOLUTION: A method for producing a three-dimensional molded object of the present invention includes the steps of: curing a resin composition containing a curable resin and thermally expandable micro-capsules to form an outer mold; filling the outer mold with a thermosetting resin composition and heating and curing it; and heating the outer mold to a temperature equal to or higher than a foaming initiation temperature of the thermally expandable micro-capsules, collapsing them, and removing the three-dimensional molded object made of the cured thermosetting resin composition. A heating temperature in a heat curing step of the thermosetting resin composition is lower than the foaming initiation temperature of the thermally expandable micro-capsules by 30°C or more.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 8

title_en: Work vehicle
abstract_en: To provide a work vehicle capable of performing appropriate fertilization work correspondingly to a fertile degree of a field by appropriately detecting electric conductivity of soil in order to solve the problem of a sulky rice transplanter equipped with a fertilization device that determines a fertile degree of the soil from the electric conductivity of the soil detected by electrode plates provided at left and right front wheels of a traveling vehicle body and, correspondingly to the fertile degree, changes a fertilization amount of the fertilization device, where in relation to the electrode plates being provided on the outside of the front wheels and the outside of the front wheels being covered by front wheel covers, the electric conductivity of the soil cannot be detected appropriately because mud cannot lie between the left and right electrode plates if the mud does not climb over tires of the front wheels in a shallow field.SOLUTION: A work vehicle is: equipped with electrode plates 52 each at each of left and right front wheels 6, 6 to determine a fertile degree of a field from electric conductivity of the left and right electrode plates 52; and configured to change a fertilization amount of a fertilization device. Therein, the electrode plates 52 are disposed on inner side of the front wheels 6.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4A

title_en: Mold
abstract_en: To provide a mold that can achieve both improved cooling efficiency and weight reduction.SOLUTION: The mold comprises: a mold portion having a first surface on which a recess having a predetermined shape is formed and a second surface opposite to the first surface; a base portion having a third surface on which an attachment portion to be attached to another member is formed, and a fourth surface opposite to the third surface; and a connection portion connecting the second surface and the fourth surface, wherein a void is formed in the connection portion, a hole penetrating between the first surface and the second surface is not formed, as a hole communicating with the void, in the mold portion, and a hole penetrating between the third surface and the fourth surface is not formed, as a hole communicating with the void, in the base portion.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Method for producing resin particles
abstract_en: To provide a method for producing resin particles that enables stable production of flattened resin particles.SOLUTION: A method for producing resin particles comprises: a polymerization initiation step in which suspension polymerization of a monomer is initiated in an aqueous suspension containing water, the monomer, a specific amount of tricalcium phosphate having a specific average particle diameter, and an anionic surfactant; and a heat treatment step in which the aqueous suspension is treated at a temperature higher than that at the polymerization initiation point, at a specific timing, wherein the L/D of the resin particles is 0.85 or less.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Hard Coat Film
abstract_en: To provide a hard coat film having excellent adhesion to the other hard coat layer even when another hard coat layer is laminated.SOLUTION: There is provided a hard coat film 1 comprising a base material film 11 and a hard coat layer 12 provided on at least one surface of the base material film 11, wherein the silicon atom ratio measured by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy on the surface opposite to the base material film 11 of the hard coat layer 12 is 1 atomic % or more and 14 atomic % or less.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Three dimensional shaping apparatus and shaping method
abstract_en: To provide a three-dimensional shaping apparatus and a shaping method capable of improving shaping efficiency while improving shaping quality.SOLUTION: The three-dimensional shaping apparatus extrudes a shaping material to shape a three-dimensional shaped object. The three-dimensional shaping apparatus includes an extruder 3 that extrudes a shaping material, an imaging device 6 that images a discharge state of the shaping material discharged from the extruder 3, and a control device 7 that controls the extruder 3. The control device 7 includes an operation control unit 72 that controls the operation of the extruder in a predetermined operation pattern, an acquisition unit 73 that acquires the image data of the discharge state captured by the imaging device 6, and an adjustment unit 75 that adjusts the predetermined operation pattern based on the image data of the discharge state acquired by the acquisition unit 73. The operation control part 72 operates the extruder 3 in the operation pattern adjusted by the adjustment part 75.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: EPS furnace apparatus
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a Styrofoam foaming device having a new structure so that an operator can easily check whether foamed beads (9), which are raw materials of Styrofoam, are foamed at an appropriate specific gravity. The Styrofoam foaming device according to the present invention uses an outer case (10) provided on the outside of a drying case (7), connected to the drying case (7) through a discharge pipe (11) and a return pipe (12), and having a door (13) on one side and an exhaust fan (21) connected to the return pipe (12) and discharging the air inside the outer case (10) to the drying case (7) to discharge the foam beads (9) stored in the drying case (7) to the outer case (10). The operator can check the foamed state or the dry state of the foamed beads (9) using the foamed beads (9) stored in the outer case (10) so that it is possible to easily check whether the foamed beads (9) are foamed at an appropriate specific gravity and the dry state of the foamed beads (9).

title_en: Marine afforestation system and method the same
abstract_en: The present invention provides an eco-friendly sea forest creation system and method. The system comprises: a plurality of outlines coupled to surround a sea forest creation area; a fixed line composed of an installation line in which both ends are joined to opposite outer lines; a fixed line installation tool for fixing both ends of each of the outer lines to an attachment substrate; and an imitation bag produced by weaving rice straw ropes in a continuous polygonal shape, receiving an imitation for spreading seaweed spores inside, passing through the installation line, and coupled to the installation line. A plurality of the installation lines are spaced apart at a set interval (W1) and combined. A plurality of knots produced by tying the installation line are formed at a set interval (W2). Between the knots, an imitation bag penetrates and is combined.

title_en: Antimicrobial PVC panel, and and method for manufacturing the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an antibacterial polyvinyl chloride panel, which is manufactured by extrusion molding a formulation composition comprising polyvinyl chloride (PVC), metal hydroxide-based particles, carbon black, surface-modified zinc oxide nanoparticles, silver-zinc zeolite, fillers and pigments, and to a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the antibacterial polyvinyl chloride panel not only has excellent flame retardancy, but also has excellent antibacterial performance against biological contaminants such as bacteria, viruses, fungi and the like.

title_en: eco-friendly stone octopus habitat block
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an eco-friendly stone octopus habitat block, comprising: a block main body having a predetermined shape; and a central passage formed by penetrating through the block main body and providing a habitat environment for sea creatures, wherein the block main body is formed of stone, and the surface roughness of an inner wall surface of the central passage is greater than the surface roughness of an outer wall surface of the block main body.

title_en: Windproof material using foamed foam
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a windproof material using foam, comprising: a window frame member in which a first guide rail and a second guide rail spaced apart at a predetermined distance from the first guide rail are formed such that a pair of windows are movably installed, a first space unit and a second space unit are formed to be movable along the first guide rail and the second guide rail and a central space unit is formed between the first space unit and the second space unit; a window member composed of a first window installed to be movable along the first guide rail and a second window installed to be movable along the second guide rail; and a windproof member tightly fitted between the first window or the second window and the central space unit to fill a gap between the first window and the second window, thereby filling the space unit, formed between the window frame member and the window member, with the windproof member to block a gap, cutting off movement of external air and internal air by means of the windproof member filled between the window and the guide rail to enhance indoor thermal efficiency, and conveniently installing the windproof member between the window and the guide rail.

title_en: Soybean paste sauce containing walnut and manufacturing method for the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a walnut-containing soybean paste sauce and a method for preparing the same. According to the present invention, a traditional fermented food and seasoning sauce is provided using walnut, which is healthful in various ways and provides a savory flavor. In addition, preference improvement is achieved based on an activation effect and flavor improvement. The present invention includes: a step of preparing a walnut soybean lump by mixing boiled beans and walnut fruit in a 9:1 weight ratio; a step of obtaining an extract by mixing dried smooth luffa fruit, dried beet, and water in a weight ratio of 0.5:0.5:9 and then heating and concentrating at 100 to 120 degrees Celsius for 6 to 8 hours; a step of adding salt to the extract to obtain brine in a salinity range of 16 to 18%; a step of mixing schisandra and refined white sugar in a 1:1 weight ratio and then aging and fermenting for 3 to 6 months to obtain schisandra enzyme; a step of mixing the walnut soybean lump and the brine prepared using the extract in a weight ratio of 1:3 to 1:5 and primarily fermenting at 15 to 20 degrees Celsius for 40 to 60 days; a step of separating the soybean lump solid part and the soy sauce liquid part after the primary fermentation and then mixing and stirring the soybean lump, soy sauce, and schisandra enzyme in a weight ratio of 2:1:1; and a step of aging and fermenting the mixture for 3 to 6 months at 15 to 30 degrees Celsius.

title_en: Method of forming FKM fabric round corner for non metal square expansion joint
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fluoro rubber fabric round corner forming method for a non-metal square expansion joint. The method distributes the load concentration applied to a cut part by forming the cut part at a 45-degree angle in a cutting step, heat-seals a complementary part attached to a partial mapping part with the optimal time and pressure by an independently developed thermal welding machine in a thermal welding step, and forms an edge part at the tip of the cut part to reinforce the strength of the cut part. The method reduces the manufacturing time and manufacturing cost of a fluoro rubber fabric round corner for a non-metal square expansion joint, improves the durability and safety of a non-metal square expansion joint by minimizing the occurrence of defective products, reduces maintenance costs by increasing the lifespan of the non-metal square expansion joint, and increases exports and stimulates domestic demand by reducing production costs.

title_en: A flower bed connected type flood wall and its construction method
abstract_en: The present invention provides a flower bed-type flood protection wall and a construction method thereof. The flower bed-type flood protection wall comprises: a subslab concrete layer; a plurality of support units consisting of a bottom support member coupled to the surface of the subslab concrete layer and a side support member coupled to the bottom support member and extended upwards to be formed; a plurality of post units including a post coupled to the side support member and the bottom support member making up the support units and a first flower bed coupling hole formed on the post; a foundation concrete layer formed to be deposited on the upper side of the subslab concrete layer to bury a portion of the support units therein; a waterproofing plate formed between the post units; and a flower bed unit including a post coupling unit coupled to the post of the post units, a second flower bed coupling hole corresponding to the first flower bed coupling hole, and a vegetation space unit therein. The subslab concrete layer is deposited, and then the support units and the post units are coupled to the subslab concrete layer. Then the foundation concrete layer is deposited to allow the deposited foundation concrete layer in which the support units are formed to function as a support structure for supporting the post units while the post units are connected to the support units to improve the supporting power of the post units to form a water barrier wall of a stable structure. The easiness of maintenance and repair can be secured and costs can be reduced when performing maintenance and repair by changing the design of the flower bed unit to reinstall the flower bed unit in accordance with a request of a user when the flower bed unit is damaged or after long-term use.

title_en: Manufacturing method of functional salt containing ginsenosides
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for producing functional salt containing ginsenoside. More specifically, the method for producing functional salt containing ginsenoside comprises the steps of: producing roasted salt by heating sea salt; producing an extract from steamed and dried wild ginseng cultured roots, red ginseng, or a mixture thereof; mixing the produced extract with the produced roasted salt; and drying the mixed salt. According to the present invention, the efficacy of ginsenoside can be expected just by consuming salt, and various diseases caused by excessive intake of salt can be prevented. In addition, the functional salt does not have a bitter taste characteristic of salt, and has an excellent umami taste to increase sensory preferences.

title_en: Defecation pads for companion animals containing charcoal powder
abstract_en: The present invention provides a defecation pad for companion animals containing charcoal powder, which has improved excrement absorption power of the defecation pad, and prevents surrounding pollution through contamination of excrement, odor removal, and ammonia concentration increase suppression, thereby creating a hygienic environment. The present invention comprises: an upper sheet transmitting urine, secretion, or excrement of a companion animal; an absorption pad located under the upper sheet and absorbing and storing the transmitted urine, secretion, or excrement; and a lower sheet located under the absorption pad and preventing moisture absorbed by the absorption pad from leaking. The upper sheet is formed of polyethylene (PE) mesh. The absorption pad is made of a composition for the absorption pad consisting of charcoal powder, non-woven fabric, Korean paper, and an adsorbent. The composition for the absorption pad includes 10 to 20 parts by weight of the charcoal powder, 180 to 220 parts by weight of the non-woven fabric, 1 to 10 parts by weight of the Korean paper, and 5 to 15 parts by weight of the adsorbent. The present invention has an effect of creating a hygienic environment by improving the excrement absorption power of the defecation pad and preventing the surrounding pollution through the contamination of the excrement, the removal of odor, and the suppression of the increase in ammonia concentration.

title_en: Kimbap automatic cutting machine
abstract_en: According to the present invention, an automatic gimbap cutter comprises: a main body unit having a driving unit and an operation unit; a transfer belt disposed to be inclined on both sides of the front of the main body unit and rotating in accordance with driving force of the driving unit; a gimbap table on which gimbap is seated, and both ends of which are connected and fixed to the transfer belt to be lifted or lowered in an inclined direction along a path of the transfer belt; a gimbap cutting unit mounted on a front surface of the main body unit, having a blade to cross a moving path of the gimbap seated on the gimbap table when the gimbap table is lifted to cut the gimbap into a predetermined size, and having a first protrusion unit protruding from both sides thereof; and a safety cover provided on the front surface of the main body unit to cover the main body and having a second protrusion unit protruding toward the main body unit inside both sides thereof. The main body unit includes a gimbap cutting unit mounting detection unit which comprises a latch interfering with the second protrusion unit at a first position when the gimbap cutting unit is incorrectly mounted to prevent the safety cover from being mounted, and when the gimbap cutting unit is mounted at a right position, the first protrusion unit moves the latch to a second position to avoid interference with the second protrusion unit.

title_en: Method for producing four-season meju with lactic acid bacteria and beneficial bacteria that reduces the harmful factors of traditional soybean paste
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for manufacturing lactic acid bacteria (beneficial bacteria) four-season fermented soybean lump reducing risk factors in traditional fermented sauces realized with: a raw material and auxiliary raw material bringing-in step; a selection and washing step; an immersion step; a steaming step; a starter inoculation step; a grinding step; a compression and molding step; a fermentation step; and a drying step, wherein the manufactured four-season fermented soybean lump have a remarkable effect of developing the traditional fermented soybean lumps industry into a competitive industry by making the allowable range of apratoxin and biogenic amine, which are risk factors, meet domestic and international standards.

title_en: Artificial bait for hairtail fishing using pacific saury by-products and its manufacturing method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an artificial bait for hairtail fishing using Pacific saury by-products and a method for manufacturing the same. The artificial bait for hairtail fishing of the present invention is manufactured by using by-products generated in a process of cleaning Pacific saury, and thus the peculiar smell of Pacific saury, fish feed, and fluorescent pigments attract hairtail in visual and olfactory aspects, thereby having an effect of improving the ability to collect hairtail.

title_en: Method for manufacturing toothbrush and toothbrush manufactured by the method
abstract_en: The present invention provides a method for manufacturing an anchorless toothbrush having a soft brushing feeling and excellent cleaning power with a constant quality by comprising the following steps: heat-treating a tapered part (length of 3 to 8 mm) of fine bristles (thickness of 0.07 to 0.14 mm); implanting fine bristles, in which tapered part is heat-treated, into a large-area hair transplanting holes (19 mm^2 or more in area) of a head insert; and coupling the head insert in which fine bristles are implanted to a toothbrush head. In addition, the present invention also provides the anchorless toothbrush manufactured by the method.

title_en: Alloy support
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for printing a structure body having a plurality of fillers. The method for printing comprises: a step of discharging only a first droplet of a printing material such as liquid metal from each of a plurality of filler positions; and a step of sequentially discharging only a second droplet of the printing material on the first droplet from each of the plurality of printing positions. Additional droplets are discharged from two or more filler positions among the filler positions to form the plurality of fillers. Discharge of the first droplet only from each filler position can solidify (cool or dry) the first droplet before discharge of the second droplet. A printer continues printing during solidification of the droplets, thereby improving processing efficiency and increasing a production processing amount.

title_en: Water-level control notification device of paddy field
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a water-level notification device for paddy fields which measures the water-level in one or more paddy fields, and notifies a manager when it is determined that the water-level is low so that the paddy fields can be stably managed. The water-level notification device of the present invention comprises: a hollow body which constitutes a body; an upper lid which can be installed by being fitted over a top of the body; a lower support part which can be installed by covering a lower part of the body; and one or more supports which fix the water-level notification device. The upper lid is formed in a two-stage structure of an upper side of the lid and a lower side of the lid. A battery, a distance measuring sensor, and a transmitter capable of communicating with a manager's terminal by wire or wirelessly are provided at the upper side of the lid. The lower support part is formed in a two-stage structure of a lower side of the support part and an upper side of the support part, and one or more fitting parts are formed on a bottom surface of the lower side of the support part so that the one or more supports are installed in each of the one or more fitting parts.

title_en: Base attached blade
abstract_en: Provided is a base-attached blade in which a base and a blade are firmly coupled. A disk-shaped base and an annular blade having an opening part in the center are provided. The base has an annular convex portion protruding from the surface of the base, the blade has a concave portion formed toward the outer peripheral edge side from the side exposed in the opening part, and the base and the blade are attached through the first adhesive attached to the surface of the base in a state where the convex part is fitted into the opening part. The base-attached blade is filled in the concave portion and bonded by a second adhesive which has penetrated into the gap between the convex portion and the side surface.

title_en: Pet house
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a pet house, and to a pet house preventing the internal temperature of an accommodating space accommodating a pet from being varied according to the weather outside, easily communicating a plurality of accommodating spaces, and allowing the internal state of the accommodating space to be optimally controlled so that the pet can relax comfortably. The present invention comprises: a flow path panel assembly (100) accommodating a fluid heated by an external boiler and heating the accommodating space by circulating the fluid; a wall unit (200) formed perpendicular to an upper part of the flow path panel assembly (100) and partitioning the accommodating space; a ventilation unit (300) discharging the internal air of the accommodating space to the outside of the pet house (10); and a light irradiating unit (400) irradiating light into the accommodating space.

title_en: Room transportable aquaponics system for shrimp farming
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an aquaponics system for compartment transfer to cultivate a shrimp comprising: a water tank which is opened to an upper side and stores water; one or more port beds which are arranged to move in a ring-shaped path in the water tank and include inserting holes for inserting a plant port to be immersed in the water of the water tank; a bed transferring unit which moves each of port beds along the path; a plurality of separating compartments which are circulated and moved along the ring-shaped path inside the water tank, and divide and form a space for cultivating the macrobrachium rosenbergii inside the water tank; and a compartment transferring unit which moves each of separation compartments along the path. According to the present invention, since the port beds in which the plant port is mounted in aquaponics are easily circulated and moved from a cultivating position to a harvesting position, economical cultivation is facilitated through labor cost reduction by decreasing unnecessary movement of a worker and reducing effort and manpower required for harvesting. The present invention reinforces individual cultivation by considering characteristics eating each other; promotes mass cultivating by increasing breeding density despite of the individual cultivation; conveniently performs work necessary for cultivation of the macrobrachium rosenbergii in a predetermined place by facilitating transferring for each compartment which provides the cultivating space; and minimizes effort and the number of people required for the cultivation.

title_en: Device for peeling onion shell
abstract_en: Disclosed is a device for peeling onions to significantly reduce tact time. According to the present invention, the device for peeling onions comprises: a cutting means cutting a stem portion and a root portion from the body of an onion while guiding the onion along a transfer path; and a peeling means spraying compressed air on the body of the onion from which the stem and root portions are cut to remove peels. The peeling means includes: a third finger cylinder gripping the onion from which the stem portion and the root portion have been cut and releasing gripping of the peeled onion; a third transfer cylinder reciprocating the third finger cylinder to an onion loading/discharging area connected to the rear end of a cutter of the cutting means for cutting the stem and root portions from the body of the onion and a peeling area formed at one side of the onion loading/discharging area; a cut forming unit disposed in the peeling area and forming a cut in the peel covering the body of the onion regardless of the size of the onion guided into the peeling area; and a plurality of spray nozzles disposed in the peeling area and spraying compressed air on the onion having the cut formed by the cut forming unit to remove peels.

title_en: Surface Modification and Application of Silicone Hydrogel Contact Lens
abstract_en: The present invention relates to preparation of aminated hyaluronic acid and a method for surface treatment of a contact lenses with the aminated hyaluronic acid. The present invention chemically bonds hyaluronic acid to the surface of the contact lens having a low expansion rate due to moisture, thereby providing the contact lens with high oxygen permeability, surface wettability, and remarkably improved wearing comfort.

title_en: Device for crops cultivation, method and system using the same
abstract_en: A crop cultivation device according to an embodiment of the present invention includes: an artificial soil unit provided with artificial soil in which crops are planted; a sensor unit capable of sensing a position of a root of the crop located in the artificial soil depending on the growth state of the crop; and a fluid supply unit capable of supplying fluids having different composition ratios and different amounts to different positions in the artificial soil through microfluid supply patterns provided in different areas of the artificial soil unit based on the position of the root of the crop sensed. Therefore, it is possible to provide a growth environment optimized for the surrounding environment of the crops.

title_en: Injection device for rigid PVC hollow duct
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an injection device for a rigid PVC hollow duct, in which the pressure of a through-hole of a nozzle for a molten PVC material to pass through can be greatly reduced, so that the molten PVC material can smoothly pass through the inside of the nozzle and be injected into a mold. Accordingly, the formability of the rigid PVC hollow duct can be greatly improved, and the temperature rise can be easily controlled. Therefore, it is possible to injection-mold high-quality rigid PVC with a reduced defect rate without fear of discoloration, gas, black spots, and black streaks.

title_en: Ceramic ball having detergent function and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a ceramic ball having a detergent function and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the ceramic ball is molded and manufactured to make a surface area in contact with water wide to improve a cleaning power, and has improved production efficiency and reduced manufacturing costs because of a continuous automatic manufacture. The manufacturing method comprises: a first process which crushes raw materials to mold the ceramic ball by a predetermined size and mixes the same to produce a raw material powder; a second process which puts the raw material powder produced through the first process into a ball molding device and injects water and a coupling agent to mold a ball; a third process which performs a primary dry to mold a through-hole on the ball molded in the second process; a fourth process which molds the through-hole on the ball having the primary dry performed through the third process using a through-hole molding device; a fifth process which, when the through-hole is completely molded on the ball through the fourth process, performs a secondary dry to completely remove moisture; and a sixth process which fires the ball dried through the fifth process and finally manufactures the ceramic ball.

title_en: A market system that supports NFT transactions between players
abstract_en: An embodiment of the present invention relates to a shooting simulation game system, and a technical problem to be solved is to allow users to select a game difficulty level for various shooting simulation contents according to each user's game skill, and to maximize the sense of reality through physical sensory aids. The shooting simulation game system includes multiple projectors; a screen; a simulated firearm; a first camera; and a management server.

title_en: Water Soluble Coenzyme Q10 and Preparation Method The Same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for preparing water-soluble coenzyme Q10, comprising: a first step of dissolving hydrophobic coenzyme Q10 in an emulsifier Tween80 and heating the same; a second step of gelatinizing OSA modified starch in water; a third step of mixing the coenzyme Q10 emulsified solution and the OSA modified starch gelatinized solution to form a complex; and a fourth step of drying the complex of coenzyme Q10 emulsified solution and the OSA modified starch mixed solution. In the method for preparing water-soluble coenzyme Q10 of the present invention, a high content of water-soluble coenzyme Q10 can be manufactured by simplifying the manufacturing process and increasing the recovery rate.

title_en: Lead apparatus for companion animal
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a companion animal lead device, and more specifically, to a companion animal lead device, comprising: a lead line formed of a rope or chain and having one end connected to a companion animal; a handle part having a ring shape on the other end of the lead line and having an internal storage space for storage and a passage hole formed through which the lead line passes; a rotating part rotatably connected to the passage hole of the handle part and coupled to the lead line to rotate according to the left-right movement of the lead line; a rotated part rotatably connected to the handle part and rotated left-right in conjunction with the rotation of the rotating part in the left-right direction; a camera photographing part installed in the rotated part to capture images of the companion animal; and a black box in which images captured by the camera photographing part are stored. As the companion animal moves left-right, the lead line and the rotating part rotate along with the companion animal, and the rotated part having the camera photographing part installed is rotated in conjunction with the rotating part to enable tracking and photographing of the companion animal.

title_en: Method of extracting laver natural pigment and manufacturing method of functional salt using the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method of manufacturing a functional salt containing a natural pigment extract of laver. The objective of the invention is to manufacture a functional salt that not only contains phycoerythrin, a natural pigment protein, but also functional components abundantly present in laver such as amino acids (e.g. taurine, alanine, etc.), minerals (e.g. iodine, potassium, etc.), porphyran, vitamins (e.g. vitamin B, vitamin C, etc.), sinorins, and porphyra-334 or the like, resulting in a product that is both nutritionally beneficial and organoleptically pleasing. To this end, the method is largely divided into two stages: first, preparing a pigment extract containing the natural pigment protein from laver; and second, producing a purple-colored salt by coating the extract onto solar salt. The resulting salt contains not only minerals from laver and solar salt, but also various functional components, while also exhibiting superior visual appeal.

title_en: Internal organs automatic cleaning device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an internal organs automatic cleaning device that enables quick and hygienic cleaning of internal organs, which are the target objects, on an integrated conveyor structure. Disclosed is an internal organs automatic cleaning device, which comprises: a frame body forming a skeletal structure; a conveyor installed to traverse the frame body and configured to automatically transport the target object; a brush roller installed in connection with the frame body on an upper side along the conveyor transfer path to remove impurities from the transported object; a pressing roller installed along the conveyor path to press and spread the object that has passed through the brush roller; a cleaning spray roller installed along the conveyor path to spray cleaning water onto the object that has passed through the pressing roller; and a cleaning water collection container installed at a lower end of the conveyor path to collect the cleaning water.

title_en: Polymer Material
abstract_en: The present application may provide a polymer material, a method for preparing the same, and a use thereof. The present application can provide a polymer material made of a biodegradable material and exhibiting balanced absorption properties. The present application may also provide a method and use for preparing such a polymer material.

title_en: Welding apparatus with pressing hinge block
abstract_en: Provided is a deposition apparatus with a pressing hinge block, comprising: a movable deposition mold on which a bonding target object with an undercut portion is mounted and which presses and deposits a bonded portion of the bonding target object with respect to a fixated deposition mold according to a moving direction; a pressing hinge block having one side on which a pressing hinge is equipped to be able to rotate and the other side to which a rotational angle adjusting stopper is coupled to support the pressing hinge so that the pressing hinge does not further rotate in one direction due to its own weight; and a pusher that, when the movable deposition mold moves toward the fixated deposition mold, pushes the pressing hinge to rotate the same in a reverse direction so that the pressing hinge applies pressure to a portion, that cannot be pressed due to the undercut portion, of the bonded portion of the bonding target object. The deposition apparatus according to an embodiment of the present invention can automatically press a portion, that cannot be pressed due to the undercut portion, of the bonded portion of the bonding target object, due to the pressing hinge being reciprocatively rotated by gravity and the pusher according to the moving direction of the movable deposition mold with respect to the fixated deposition mold, thereby significantly enhancing the deposition quality of the bonding target object having the undercut portion and shortening the deposition time of the bonding target object having the undercut portion.

title_en: Contact lens manufacturing method using raw material dispersed mpc
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for manufacturing a contact lens, comprising: a first step of manufacturing a raw material in which 2-methacryloyloxyethylphosphorylcholine is dispersed; a second step of mixing a hydrophilic monomer and an additive with the raw material; and a third step of injecting the mixture from the second step into a contact lens mold and polymerizing it to obtain a contact lens. According to the present invention, the method for manufacturing a contact lens of the present invention may include a large amount of a raw material, such as 2-methacryloyloxyethylphosphorylcholine (MPC), which is difficult to control in quantity, through a step of manufacturing a raw material in which 2-methacryloyloxyethylphosphorylcholine is dispersed, thereby improving the functional properties of the contact lens, and when a primarily cross-linked raw material is used as a raw material for the contact lens, cross-linking control is possible during polymerization of the entire raw material for the contact lens, thereby suppressing unreacted monomers from remaining in the polymer, thereby improving the mechanical properties of the contact lens, and by causing the polymerization reaction of the raw material by irradiating it with radiation or infrared rays, problems arising from the use of a cross-linking agent or initiator may be solved.

title_en: Drug for extinguishing metal fires comprising porous ceramics particles, method for manufacturing the same, fire extinguisher and energy storage system containing the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire extinguishing agent for metal fire, a manufacturing method thereof, a fire extinguisher for metal fire including the same, and an energy storage system (ESS). The fire extinguishing agent for metal fire according to the present invention is silicate-based vitreous and is characterized by containing porous ceramic particles having an average diameter of 50 μm or more and less than 1,000 μm and a density of 0.4 to 1.5 g/cm^3. The fire extinguishing agent of the present invention is effective for initial suppression by absorbing heat flowing in when a metal fire occurs, and maximizes an oxygen blocking suffocation effect by forming a glass film at a metal fire occurrence point. In particular, the fire extinguishing agent of the present invention is a high eco-friendly fire extinguishing agent which is highly eco-friendly, is completely harmless to the human body, and does not generate any toxic substances at a high temperature at which a fire occurs.

title_en: Agricultural machine for collecting field crops with foreign substance sorting function
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a field crop collection device having a foreign substance classification function, which excavates a field crop growing underground and transfers the same to be collected in a collection unit, comprises: an excavating unit which is inserted into soil to excavate a field crop; a classification and transfer unit which is provided at a rear portion of the excavating unit, and on which the field crop and foreign substances excavated by the excavating unit are seated and transferred, and which drops the field crop downward in a transfer process, and discharges the foreign substances to the outside to automatically classify the field crop and the foreign substances; a crop transfer unit which is spaced apart from a lower portion of the classification and transfer unit, and which is arranged to form an intersection area within a predetermined range with the classification and transfer unit, and allows the field crop dropped from the classification and transfer unit to be seated through the intersection area and transferred to the collection unit provided at the rear portion; and a discharge guide unit which is provided in the classification and transfer unit, and allows the foreign substances transferred along the classification and transfer unit to be pushed to the outside of the classification and transfer unit to be discharged.

title_en: Back cover of electronic device and method for manufacturing thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a back cover and a method for manufacturing the back cover. The method for manufacturing a back cover comprises the steps of: applying a photocurable resin composition on a base substrate; disposing a mold on the photocurable resin composition layer; pressing the mold downward by rotating a roller from a first direction to a second direction; irradiating ultraviolet rays to form a pattern of the photocurable resin composition layer corresponding to a pattern of the mold on the base substrate in a state in which the pressed mold is adsorbed on the photocurable resin composition layer; and separating the mold, wherein the mold further comprises: a pattern member whose length in the vertical direction is changed from one end to the other end; and a support member disposed adjacent to one end of the pattern member and having a preset length in the vertical direction.

title_en: Masterbatch containing cellulose nanofibers and anti-vibration device containing the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a masterbatch and a natural rubber composition comprising the same. According to the present invention, a masterbatch comprises: cellulose nanofibers of which surface charge is negatively charged; and natural rubber latex of which surface charge is positively charged. The cellulose nanofibers form a network of network filler, and the natural rubber latex forms a continuous phase by filling pores of the network.

title_en: Water-soluble film comprising cellulose and method for manufacturing the same
abstract_en: Disclosed is a water dissociable film comprising cellulose according to various embodiments of the present invention for realizing the above-described problem. The water dissociable film may include furan, carboxymethyl cellulose, and cellulose.

title_en: Pesticide spraying vehicle for crops
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pesticide spraying vehicle for crops, which comprises a vehicle frame, a pesticide storage barrel fixed on the vehicle frame, and lateral side arms with internal flow cavities, wherein the flow cavities are communicated with the pesticide storage barrel, two lateral side arms are arranged and respectively installed on the lateral sides of the vehicle frame, and the bottom of the lateral side arms are sequentially provided with a plurality of pesticide spray nozzles at intervals along the length direction; the lateral side arms are in a front-back folding structure and are folded to realize unilateral lateral spraying width adjustment; it can ensure efficient work and improve the spraying accuracy.

title_en: Negative poisson's ratio structure with three-dimensional dilatancy characteristics and design method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a negative Poisson's ratio structure with three-dimensional dilatancy characteristics and a design method thereof, comprising: combining several concave hexagons into basic units; orderly arranging basic units to obtain a unit cell structure; arranging several unit cell structures in order to obtain a three-dimensional overall structure with negative Poisson's ratio, where combining several concave hexagons into a basic unit includes: the basic unit includes a first concave hexagon and a second concave hexagon, and the first concave hexagon and the second concave hexagon form a square structure; where obtaining a three-dimensional overall negative Poisson's ratio structure includes: horizontally and orderly arranging the unit cell structure to obtain a single-layer three-dimensional structure; longitudinally extending the single-layer three-dimensional structure to obtain a three-dimensional overall negative Poisson's ratio structure. The negative Poisson's ratio structure of the invention can play a role in energy absorption and buffering, vibration reduction and noise reduction.

title_en: Process for producing royal jelly
abstract_en: The invention relates to beekeeping, in particular to a process for producing royal jelly.The process, according to the invention, includes the introduction into the breeding family of frames equipped with qeen cells with transferred larvae and the daily feeding of the nurse bees, in the absence of a maintenance honey flow, with a mixture of sugar syrup and a biostimulator, for 3 days, after which the frames are removed from the hive to collect the royal jelly, and the procedure is repeated twice, at the same time the biostimulator is an aqueous solution containing: D-glucuronic acid, potassium hydroxide, choline chloride and water.

title_en: System, method, and composition for incubating spores for use in aquaculture, agricultural, wastewater, and environmental remediation applications.
abstract_en: A system and method for generating an incubated bacteria solution by heating a nutrient germinant composition and bacteria, including at least one species in spore form, to a preferred temperature a range of 35-50°C for 2-60 minutes using exothermic chemical reaction heat. An incubated bacteria solution is preferably generated at or near a point-of-use in an aquaculture, agriculture, wastewater, or environmental remediation application. The nutrient-germinant composition comprises L-amino acids, optionally D-glucose and/or D-fructose, a buffer, an industrial preservative, and may include bacteria spores (preferably of one or more Bacillus species) or they may be separately combined for incubation. A first chemical contained in a pouch is activated by contact with a second chemical, water, or air in a flameless heater to initiate exothermic reaction to provide incubation heat. A potable, single-use incubation bag is configured to hold the flameless heater and a container of nutrient germinant composition and spores.

title_en: Melanoidin compositions for protecting crops from nonfungal pests.
abstract_en: Use of brown melanoidins in compositions and methods to protect plants against a wide variety of non-fungal pests is disclosed. In some exemplary embodiments of the invention, the plants are nightshades, for example tomato. In some exemplary embodiments of the invention, the plants are cucurbits, for example cucumber. Alternatively or additionally, in some embodiments the pests are selected from the group consisting of viruses, bacteria, oomycetes, and arthropods.

title_en: Method for extruding a semi-finished product made of elastomeric material.
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for extruding a semi-finished product made of elastomeric material, wherein an elastomeric material is fed to an inlet channel (20a) of a gear pump (20) with an inlet pressure value and dispensed through an exit channel (20b) of the gear pump (20) with an exit pressure value greater than the inlet pressure value. The method comprises detecting the exit pressure value and adjusting the operation of said gear pump (20) so as to maintain a predetermined pressure difference between said exit pressure and said inlet pressure based on the detection of the exit pressure value. The aforementioned method is used in a process for building a tyre for vehicle wheels.

title_en: Control method and control system for tire forming machine, and readable storage medium.
abstract_en: Disclosed in the present application are a control method and control system for a tire forming machine, and a readable storage medium. The control method comprises: in response to a signal for mounting a tire bead, a second mechanical arm body driving a second claw part to move to a material preparation area, and the second claw part executing a grabbing action on the tire bead and a spacer; the second mechanical arm body driving the second claw part to place the tire bead at a preset tire bead position and place the spacer at a spacer holding position; in response to a green tire rolling signal, a first pressing roller part rolling a first sidewall of a green tire on a forming drum and a tire tread adjacent to the first sidewall, and a second pressing roller part rolling a second sidewall of the green tire and a tire tread adjacent to the second sidewall; and in response to a green tire unloading signal, a first mechanical arm body driving a first claw part to grab the green tire, and transferring the green tire to a tire unloading position. By means of integrated control, the control method shortens the space occupied by a mechanical device, reduces the control complexity, and avoids the possibility of interference caused by executing mutual actions between mechanical parts.

title_en: Food packaging films and methods of making food packaging films
abstract_en: A packaging film including protein, a plasticizer, and reducing agent is provided. A coating for use with packaging films is also provided. The coating includes wax particles, ethyl cellulose, and an emulsifier. The film is prepared by a method comprising mixing protein with water to form a first mixture, obtaining a supernatant from the first mixture, adding a plasticizer and reducing agent to the supernatant to form a second mixture, and drying the second mixture to form the film. The coated film is prepared by a method comprising melting wax to form melted wax, adding an emulsifier and a solvent to the melted wax to form a third mixture, homogenizing the third mixture to form an emulsion, adding ethyl cellulose to the emulsion to form a coating solution, and applying the coating solution to a film to form the coated film.

title_en: Process and formulation of polyamide polymeric bio compounds with natural fibers with a high concentration of organic compounds with low thermal stability
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the process and formulation of polymeric biocomposites, using natural fibers with a high concentration of organic compounds with a thermal stability of less than 200°C. Said process and formulation allow processing by the melt mixing method, avoiding fragmenting the natural fibers (FN) and maintaining their morphology. Also, it avoids using compatibilization or coupling agents to promote adhesion between the polyamide (PA) and the FN, observing adequate interfacial adhesion and compatibility between both phases (FN-PA). Further, it increases the crystallinity of the biocomposite at a micrometric scale, a unique advantage to this technology not possible to achieve with other processes reported in the state-of-the-art, reducing the polymeric matrices. The present invention relates to the polymer or plastic industry, construction, food, plastic recycling, and the automotive sector, among others.

title_en: Plastic material for industrial former
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a plastic material for use in various application. Further, the present invention relates to a plastic material for an industrial former (herein also designated as a mold). Additionally, the present invention relates to a mold made of a plastic material and the method for the manufacture of said mold. Furthermore, the present invention relates to an industrial process using such mold, such as in a process for making rubber goods comprising dipping of a mold into a rubber emulsion, wherein the mold consisting of a plastic material having a surface tension in the range from 25 to 60 mJ/m2 measured according to ASTM standard D-2578/09.

title_en: Animal shed system with an air trap and a scrubber
abstract_en: The invention relates to an animal shed system comprising an animal shed having an animal shed floor with a first and a second surface spaced apart, such that the floor has a thickness different from zero, and multiple flow holes extending from the first to the second surface; a reservoir situated under the animal shed floor, wherein the flow holes open up to the reservoir, and the flow holes allow a fluid flow from the animal shed to the reservoir; a floor opening in the animal shed floor to allow manure to be dumped in the reservoir; an air extraction device for extracting air underneath the floor, out of the reservoir; and a device extending from the floor opening into the reservoir, wherein the device is configured to prevent an airflow from the animal shed to the reservoir through the floor opening when in use.

title_en: A method of preparing and supplying humidified feed to insects and a system for preparing and supplying humidified feed to insects
abstract_en: A method and system of preparing and supplying humidified feed to insects, such as mealworms, said method comprising the steps of: - receiving, by a first dosing unit, a dry feed stock; - supplying, by a first supply unit, to said dry feed stock, received by said first dosing unit, a liquid, such that a weight component of said liquid is in the range of 5% to 20%, preferably in the range of 5% to 15%, of a combined weight of said dry feed stock and said liquid; - mixing, by a mixing arrangement of said first dosing unit, said liquid and said dry feed stock, thereby creating said humidified feed; - supplying, by a supply arrangement, a predetermined volume or a predetermined weight of said humidified feed to said insects.

title_en: An irrigation method for improving soil water holding capacity and reducing co2 emissions
abstract_en: The present disclosure discloses a method for improving soil water retention performance and reducing C02 emissions. The present disclosure realizes the improvement of soil water 5 retention performance and the reduction of COz emissions through non-pyrolysis raw material M1 and pyrolysis raw material M2 with speciﬁc irrigation technology, and provides new means for soil erosion control and farmland carbon emission reduction.

title_en: Vehicle system for the processing of a botanical plant
abstract_en: The invention relates to a vehicle system for the processing of a botanical plant, wherein the system comprises a processing device provided with processing means for the processing of the botanical plant and comprising a base with driving means comprising wheels, and an axis extending in a perpendicular direction from the base, wherein the processing means comprise a robot for executing at least one processing action on the botanical plant and a control unit for controlling the robot, wherein the robot comprises two or more robotic arms provided on the axis, wherein a first robotic arm is movably mounted on the axis and a second robotic arm is movably mounted on the axis, between the first robotic arm and the base, the first and second robotic arms being independently movable in a height direction along the axis between the base and a top end of the axis, wherein the second robotic arm has a maximum height set by the first robotic arm, and the first robotic arm has minimum height set by the second robotic arm.

title_en: Animal weighing system
abstract_en: A portable weighing unit (10) comprising a body for containing the portable weighing unit (10) for transportation, the body having a pair of side walls (12, 14) and an end wall (13) defining a space for receiving an animal. A holder (17) mounted within said space and configured to receive an enticement (18) for attracting an animal into the space. A reader (19) mounted with respect to the body and configured to read animal identification (ID) information provided on an ID tag of the animal within the space. A platform (15) located within said space, wherein the platform (15) is configured to be supported by one or more load bars (16) containing load cells to receive the front feet of the animal and take a weight measurement of the front feet when said animal enters said space. A controller (20) mounted to the body for receiving the said weight measurement of the front feet from the platform (15) and the animal ID information from the reader (19), said controller (20) being configured to provide said weight measurement of the front feet and said animal ID information to a microprocessor for one or more of processing, storage, and transmitting collected data.

title_en: Process of Cryoprotectant-Based Dried Boneless Siganids (Siganus Canaliculatus)
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a process for preparing cryoprotectant-based dried boneless siganids product, belonging to the technical fields of aquatic product processing. The main process of the invention comprises the following steps of: washing, deboning, and cutting the fresh siganids into a butterfly shape, soaking the boneless siganids with cryoprotectant solution for 30 minutes, draining, filing, and drying the treated boneless siganids in the mechanical drying rack using a temperature between 50-60Â°C for 4 hours or more, then cooling the cryoprotectant treated dried boneless siganids in the cooling rack at least 10 minutes for packing and labeling, thus the cryoprotectant-based dried boneless siganids is obtained. The cryoprotectant-based dried boneless siganids disclosed by the invention has good quality in terms of sensory characteristics which strengthens teeth and bones, is complete nutritional food preventing osteoporosis, colon cancer and lowering cholesterol level, can be used for high-quality leisure food commodities and for commercialization

title_en: Technology of collecting, transporting and storing wood biomass resulting from vineyard exploitation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a technology for collecting, transporting and storing wood biomass resulting from the exploitation of vineyards. According to the invention, the technology consists in performing the pruning for fructification with the accumulation of tendrils at two intervals, collecting and transporting the biomass, the cut tendrils, by means of the baling press with constant chamber, which forms cylindrical bales and comprises a left-right dual system of rotating brushes with elastic fingers marginally arranged on the interval, gathering them towards the center, to be then baled by the towed press, to result in bales of standard sizes, with a diameter of 450 mm, a length of 850 mm and an average weight of 25-30 kg, then transporting bales on the interval between the vine rows, with an average length of 100 m, up to the main roads, by means of specialized single-axle trailers of reduced width, in order for them to fit in the inter-row interval, they being manually loaded by means of a tipping bucket mounted on the tractor, after which the bales are transported to the storing place with single-axle platform trailers with double wheels, provided with inwards tiltable grates during no-load run, whereas, during loading, they tilt outwards, the loading space being increased thereby 40 cm on each side, and the bales are stored in semi-open stores provided with a roof to prevent biodegradation, equipped with a system (1) of temperature and humidity monitoring sensors to allow control of these fundamental process parameters, some fans (2) placed at the lower side for blowing cold dry air, and some fireproof systems (3) because the temperature rising in certain areas may lead to the tendril self-ignition.

title_en: Method and system for controlling functions of a set of booms or a wood processing device attached thereto in connection with a tree felling, as well as a corresponding device and a logging machine
abstract_en:
FIELD: timber Industry. 
     SUBSTANCE: group of inventions relates to the logging machine control. During wood cutting, a woodworking device is controlled using a first control means. Set of booms is controlled using second control means. Either a set of booms or a woodworking device is a working unit, and the other is a control unit. Pre-recorded function of working unit is specified in memory and is connected to first input data created by operator for working unit. Performing selection of pre-recorded function of working unit automatically from memory based on first input data created by operator, generating second input data based on determined current operating state of control unit, which contains a criterion-dependent criterion for triggering a selected pre-recorded function of the working unit, starting selected pre-recorded function of working unit automatically when observing the criterion of second input data, execution of selected pre-recorded function of working unit started by means of second input data. 
     EFFECT: higher efficiency of logging machine operation. 
     18 cl, 5 dwg

title_en: Method for reclamation of contaminated lands and waste dumps
abstract_en:
FIELD: removal and processing of solid wastes. 
     SUBSTANCE: invention relates to the field of environmental technologies, in particular to reclamation of lands containing toxic wastes in places of their location, including solid domestic wastes and industrial wastes. Method involves coating in series with protective layers consisting of a clay mineral, a polyacrylamide polymer with further tilling of the surface with sowing of grasses. Wastes are laid in waste. First, lower protective layer of substrate is placed from a mixture of: bentonite with 2–5 wt. % of polyacrylamide polymer, natural sand and water in ratio, wt. %: bentonite:sand:water = (10–15):(75–80):10 with thickness of up to 1 m with subsequent rolling of said mixture to thickness of 30–40 cm and applying, on top of layer of substrate, layer from overburden of sand extraction pit with thickness of up to 20 cm with tilling surface by sowing perennial grasses in following ratio, wt. %: meadow fescue - 40, wheat grass - 40, red clover - 20. 
     EFFECT: method provides reclamation of contaminated lands and dumps of toxic wastes and restoration of vegetation and soil cover on contaminated sites to obtain a stable protective waterproof coating in the form of a substrate of natural materials and a fertile layer of man-made non-toxic materials using a grass mixture, which ensures high productivity when used during reclamation. 
     1 cl, 1 tbl

title_en: Method for illuminating a target to ensure the use of ammunition with a laser semi-active homing head
abstract_en:
FIELD: high-precision weapons. 
     SUBSTANCE: invention relates to means of ensuring the use of high-precision weapons with a laser semi-active homing head. The method includes determining the topographic coordinates of the target designator and firing position, detecting and measuring the spherical coordinates of the target with the target designator, determining the topographic coordinates of the target, calculating and implementing firing settings, firing an ammunition shot. The hardware components used are mounted on a quadcopter capable of hovering over a target. A laser target illuminator made as a separate component is installed on the quadcopter in the nadir position, which is ensured by the self-orientation of the illuminator due to gravity. For this, the illuminator is fixed at the lower end of a rigid rod, the upper end of which is attached to the bottom of the quadcopter by means of a hinge joint. The height of the quadcopter hovering over the target is determined by the values ​​of the angle of divergence of the laser beam of the illuminator and the minimum planned overall size of the target. 
     EFFECT: ease of implementation and expansion of the scope of laser target illumination for high-precision homing ammunition. 
     1 cl, 1 dwg

title_en: Tooth harrow
abstract_en:
FIELD: agricultural engineering.  
     SUBSTANCE: invention relates to agricultural engineering, in particular to the design of tillage implements. The tooth harrow consists of a frame with polyhedral or spring teeth placed in it. Holes are made in the teeth with elastic rods bent in the middle with a gap in them, the lateral ends of which are smoothly curved in their front part opposite from the attachment point, while the distance from the end of the teeth to the center of the attachment of the rods corresponds to half the depth of tillage with a harrow. The axes of the sides of the curved rods form the upper and lower planes with the axis of the hole adjacent to them, the angle between which is 10…15º, and the extreme points of the end parts are on the same straight line parallel to these planes and the axis of the hole. Curved rods are located in the holes of the harrow teeth with alternating sides in the upper and lower planes in a staggered manner. On the straight end parts of the elastic rods bent in the middle along their entire length of these straight end parts, truncated straight circular cones with a central cylindrical hole, the diameter of which is equal to the diameter of the curved elastic rods, are fixed with their large bases outward. At the same time, the smaller base of each truncated straight circular cone facing the tooth has a diameter 1-2 mm larger than the diameter of the curved elastic rods, and its larger base has a diameter three times larger than the diameter of the curved elastic rods.  
     EFFECT: use of the invention will make it possible to improve the quality of tillage by better crumbling of soil lumps and combing weeds into its surface layers while increasing the anti-erosion properties of the field surface.  
     1 cl, 5 dwg
