The present disclosure aims to quickly and smoothly realize the oil return process of a three-pipe air conditioning system in a refrigerating-alone mode or a heating-alone mode, in which one of the three pipelines are in the refrigerant circulation, where the lubricating oil in this pipeline cannot smoothly return to the compressor.

title_en: Filter cleaning device, filter system, and filter cleaning method
abstract_en: Provided is a filter cleaning device capable of cleaning a filter while suppressing the shortening of the life of the filter. The present technology provides a filter cleaning device that determines a contaminated region from a plurality of regions of a filter that captures particles or molecules, and supplies energy for reducing a contamination level to some of the plurality of regions determined as the contaminated region.    According to the present technology, it is possible to provide a filter cleaning device capable of cleaning a filter while suppressing the shortening of the life of the filter.

title_en: A system and method for producing electricity
abstract_en: A system and method of producing electricity is provided. Fluid is pumped from a feed tank to a steam generator using a pump. The steam generator has a high temperature heater for heating the fluid and increasing pressure before the fluid travels to a steam chamber. The fluid flows from the steam generator to the steam chamber. At least one chemical that creates an exothermic reaction is injected into an ignition chamber and the chemical reaction is initiated using an igniter. The exothermic reaction increases the energy available in the system. Fluid from the steam chamber flows through a steam turbine to generate electricity.

title_en: Double-heat source heat pump-solar energy combined heating system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a double-heat-source heat pump-solar energy combined heating system and a method, wherein the system comprises a double-heat-source heat pump unit, a solar energy system and a user side device; the solar energy system is connected with the user side device and is used for converting solar energy into heat energy, heating a water source and providing the heat energy for the user side device; the double-heat-source heat pump unit is connected with the user side device and is provided with a double-heat-source heat pump for assisting the solar energy system to provide heat energy for the user side device. The invention solves the problems of easy condensation and low heat exchange efficiency of the air source heat pump in the heating engineering by adopting the mode of combining the double heat source heat pump and solar energy for heating, so that the strategy of changing coal into electricity can be smoothly carried out.

title_en: Gas stove
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gas stove, which comprises a first air pipe connected with a gas pipeline and a second air pipe connected with the gas stove, wherein an isolation air pipe is arranged at the joint of the first air pipe and the second air pipe, a choke plug is movably arranged in the isolation air pipe, the choke plug is connected with a piston rod, the piston rod is connected with an air cylinder, the second air pipe is connected with an inner combustion head and an outer combustion head, a control part is arranged below the inner combustion head and the outer combustion head, a screw seat is arranged at the bottom of the control part, a first support and a second support are arranged at two sides of the screw seat, a first conductive end and a second conductive end are respectively arranged on the first support and the second support, a copper rod is arranged on the screw seat in a screw connection manner, and a baffle ring is arranged on the copper rod, so that a circuit between the first conductive end and the second conductive end is communicated when the baffle ring is pressed on the first conductive end and the second conductive end. After the gas stove is used, the gas stove and the gas pipeline can be automatically isolated, and dangerous situations are avoided.

title_en: Heating unit and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heating unit and a control method thereof, wherein the unit comprises: the device comprises a compressor (1), a condenser (2), a reversing mechanism and two evaporators; the condenser (2) and the reversing mechanism are sequentially and adaptively connected in a refrigerant circulation loop between the exhaust end of the compressor (1) and the suction end of the compressor (1); the two evaporators are respectively connected to the refrigerant circulation loop in an adaptive manner through the reversing mechanism and are used for realizing the switching defrosting of two heating modes through the reversing of the reversing mechanism. The scheme of the invention can overcome the defects of poor heating stability, large defrosting difficulty, poor user experience and the like in the prior art, and realize the beneficial effects of good heating stability, small defrosting difficulty and good user experience.

title_en: Wall-mounted indoor unit and air conditioner
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wall-mounted indoor unit and an air conditioner, wherein the wall-mounted indoor unit comprises a shell, a first driving device, a second driving device and a controller; the shell is provided with an air outlet channel, a first air outlet and a second air outlet, wherein the first air outlet and the second air outlet are communicated with the air outlet channel, the first air outlet is rotationally provided with a first wind shield, and the second air outlet is rotationally provided with a second wind shield; the first driving device is arranged in the shell and connected with the first wind shield to drive the first wind shield to rotate so as to open or close the first air outlet; the second driving device is arranged in the shell and is connected with the second wind shield so as to drive the second wind shield to rotate and open or close the second air outlet; the controller is connected with the first driving device and the second driving device to selectively control the driving operation of the first driving device and the second driving device. The wall-mounted indoor unit can switch the air outlet direction of the wall-mounted indoor unit so as to prevent the air outlet air flow from directly blowing to a user.

title_en: Heat pump air conditioning system and electric automobile
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heat pump air conditioning system and an electric automobile. The heat pump air conditioning system comprises a compressor (604), an indoor condenser (601), an indoor evaporator (602) and an outdoor heat exchanger (605), wherein an outlet of the compressor (604) is communicated with an inlet of the indoor condenser (601), an outlet of the indoor condenser (601) is selectively communicated with an inlet of the outdoor heat exchanger (605) through a first throttling branch or a first through-flow branch, an outlet of the outdoor heat exchanger (605) is selectively communicated with an inlet of the compressor (604) through a second through-flow branch or communicated with an inlet of the indoor evaporator (602) through a second throttling branch, and an outlet of the indoor evaporator (602) is communicated with an inlet of the compressor (604). From this, can reach and improve the heating efficiency, satisfy defrosting defogging legal and control requirement, effect such as installation of being convenient for.

title_en: Cardboard mechanism of air source heat pump unit's indoor set
abstract_en: The invention discloses a clamping plate mechanism of an indoor unit of an air source heat pump unit, which comprises a plurality of sections of pipelines penetrating out of an indoor unit shell, and a water receiving disc, wherein the water receiving disc is positioned at the front side of the bottom of the indoor unit shell; and the clamping plate is positioned at the rear side of the bottom of the indoor unit shell, the pipeline penetrates through the clamping plate to the outside of the indoor unit shell, the matching part of the pipeline and the clamping plate is sealed, and the clamping plate is fixed to a drain pipe leading to the water receiving disc from a pressure relief valve in the indoor unit. The invention has the advantages that the pipeline leading to the indoor unit water receiving disc is fixed, and the abnormal sound caused by the swinging of the drain pipe and the water leakage caused by the splashing of the water flowing out of the water receiving disc after the swinging of the drain pipe are avoided when the safety valve discharges water.

title_en: Renewable energy source energy supply system
abstract_en: A renewable energy source energy supply system comprises a gas power generation system with an exhaust-heat boiler, a biogas fermentation system, a heating system, a driving absorption refrigeration system, a CO  2  trapping system and a CO  2  Rankine cycle power generation system; the gas power generation system with the waste heat boiler comprises a blower, an air compressor, a combustion chamber, a gas turbine generator set, a waste heat boiler, a heat collector, an induced draft fan and a chimney which are connected in sequence; the biogas fermentation system comprises a biogas fermentation tank and a biogas storage tank, wherein the biogas fermentation tank and the biogas storage tank are sequentially connected, and the biogas fermentation tank is connected with a water heat exchanger arranged in a waste heat boiler through a pump; the heating system comprises a water heater, a heating pipeline, a heat user, a water return pipeline and a water return pump which are sequentially and circularly connected and preset in the waste heat boiler, wherein a water supplementing tank is arranged on the water return pipeline; the driving absorption refrigeration system comprises a generator, a condenser, an evaporator and an absorber which are sequentially connected, wherein the absorber is connected with the generator through a pump and a throttle valve, the generator is connected with a heat exchanger, and the heat exchanger is connected with a heat collector arranged in a waste heat boiler. The invention not only saves energy, but also can realize the triple supply of cold, heat and electricity, thereby realizing the distributed utilization of energy.

title_en: Heat pump unit and operation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heat pump unit and an operation method thereof, and the heat pump unit comprises an indoor unit (1), an outdoor unit (2), a liquid pipe connecting pipe (3) for connecting the indoor unit (1) and the outdoor unit (2), and a first expansion valve (411) connected between one end of the liquid pipe connecting pipe (3) and the outdoor unit (2) in series; the indoor unit further comprises a second expansion valve (412) connected in series between the other end of the liquid pipe connecting pipe (3) and the indoor unit (1), the first expansion valve (411) is used for adjusting the opening degree of the heat pump unit when the heat pump unit is in refrigeration operation so that part of the refrigerant flows into the liquid pipe connecting pipe (3) through the first expansion valve (411), and the second expansion valve (412) is used for adjusting the opening degree of the heat pump unit when the heat pump unit is in refrigeration operation so that part of the refrigerant flowing into the liquid pipe connecting pipe (3) through the first expansion valve (411) is stored in the liquid pipe connecting pipe (3). The invention has the advantage of avoiding excessive refrigerant entering the outdoor unit (2).

title_en: Isolated continuous tunnel vacuum furnace
abstract_en: The invention discloses an isolated continuous tunnel vacuum furnace, which comprises a plurality of tunnel cavities, vacuum valves, a loading vehicle and a normal pressure valve plate door, wherein the vacuum valves are arranged on the tunnel cavities; the tunnel cavities are connected in parallel in a straight line, a vacuum valve is arranged between the adjacent tunnel cavities, and the carrying vehicle is connected in a sliding manner in the tunnel cavities; the two side ends of the valve body are provided with normal pressure valve plate doors, and the normal pressure valve plate doors comprise valve frame bodies, air cylinders, air cylinder supporting plates and normal pressure plate valves; the cylinder is vertically connected and fixed to the top of the valve frame body, the output shaft of the cylinder is connected with a cylinder supporting plate, and the cylinder supporting plate is connected with a normal pressure plate valve; the tunnel cavity comprises a cavity body, a servo motor, an air cylinder, a cooling mechanism, a tooth shifting mechanism and a heating movable contact mechanism. The isolated continuous tunnel vacuum furnace can ensure high consistency of drying quality of a drying object; the drying process is smooth and compact and has stable performance; the equipment is integrated automatically, so that manpower and material resources are saved; high drying quality and high efficiency.

title_en: Smoke ventilator with axial-flow type wind wheel
abstract_en: The utility model provides a smoke ventilator with axial-flow type wind wheel, be provided with the cigarette machine main part, cigarette machine main part internal assembly has axial-flow type convulsions subassembly, the air inlet place plane L of convulsions subassembly is on a parallel with gas outlet place plane P, the convulsions subassembly includes the spiral case, the upper and lower surface of spiral case corresponds and has been seted up out, the air inlet, spiral case internal assembly has the motor, the rotor end rotation assembly blade of motor, the plane M at blade central point place is on a parallel with plane L and plane P respectively, the air inlet passes through the air intake group intercommunication of wind channel with the cigarette machine main part, the discharge flue at gas outlet intercommunication cigarette machine main part top, the air intake group is equipped with a plurality ofly, and the air intake group is including clean air intake group and oil smoke air intake group. This smoke ventilator with axial-flow wind wheel, simple structure, easy dismounting, simultaneously, this axial-flow wind wheel does not let in the wind wheel with the oil smoke inside according to the aerodynamics principle, can directly discharge the oil smoke, keeps the inside cleanness of wind wheel, prolongs the life of wind wheel.

title_en: Waste heat utilization device of waste oil regeneration rectification catalytic system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a waste heat utilization device of a waste oil regeneration and rectification catalytic system, and relates to a waste oil regeneration device. This waste heat utilization device, its characterized in that has the buffer tank on the water cooling tank, has the oil cooling tank on the buffer tank, is equipped with oil cooling tank coil pipe in the oil cooling tank, is equipped with waste oil import and waste oil export on the lateral wall of oil cooling tank, is equipped with the water cooling tank coil pipe in the water cooling tank, has the waste heat recovery pipe at oil gas output tube overcoat, is equipped with the waste oil export after the heating at the waste heat recovery pipe. The waste heat utilization device of the waste oil regeneration and rectification catalysis system has reasonable structure, is safe and reliable, and can fully utilize the waste heat of oil gas in the waste oil regeneration and rectification catalysis system to preheat the waste oil; the waste oil can be heated to more than 100 ℃ from normal temperature, so that the energy consumption of rectifying catalytic regeneration of the waste oil is obviously reduced, the production cost is obviously reduced, the energy is saved, and the popularization value is realized.

title_en: Fuel gas preheating method for reforming heating furnace and reforming device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a fuel gas preheating method for a reforming heating furnace, wherein the fuel gas is subjected to primary preheating and secondary preheating before entering the reforming heating furnace; during primary preheating, the fuel gas and the led-out flue gas exchange heat in a first preheater; then the fuel gas is led into a secondary fuel gas preheating unit to carry out secondary preheating; and introducing the fuel gas after the two-stage preheating into a fuel gas fine treatment unit for fine treatment, and then introducing into a combustor for combustion. The invention preheats the fuel gas by utilizing the high-temperature flue gas entering the convection section, reduces the amount of steam generated by the fuel gas and improves the energy utilization efficiency; meanwhile, the fuel gas is preheated to a temperature which meets the requirement of fine treatment, so that the problem of corrosion of the sulfuric acid dew point after the heat efficiency of the heating furnace is improved is solved, the problem of exceeding standard of sulfur dioxide during fluctuation of a fuel gas coarse desulfurization system can be solved, and the emission concentration of nitrogen oxides is further reduced. The embodiment of the invention also provides a reforming device based on the reforming heating furnace fuel gas preheating method.

title_en: Control method of gas water heater
abstract_en: The invention relates to a control method of a gas water heater, when the gas water heater detects water flow, the actual load of the gas water heater is calculated according to the detected water flow value, and then the work execution component of the gas water heater is controlled according to the actual load of the gas water heater, which is characterized in that: the actual load of the gas water heater is obtained by calculating the following modes: q ═ (set temperature-influent water temperature) water flow rate "; the water flow rate is a long-term filtering value, a medium-term filtering value and a short-term filtering value. Compared with the prior art, when the actual load of the gas water heater is calculated, the short-term filter value is compared with the medium-term filter value and the long-term filter value ceaselessly according to the detected water flow condition, the change degree of the current water flow is judged according to errors, whether the water flow is stable, or the water flow shakes occasionally, or the water flow fluctuates ceaselessly is judged, and then the three states are switched to meet the temperature control requirements of different periods.

title_en: Biological air purifier
abstract_en: The invention relates to a biological air purifier, and belongs to the technical field of air purification. The invention uses sodium alginate and carboxymethyl cellulose to embed and fix the methylobacterium which has special formaldehyde metabolic pathway and can remove pollution benzene series and the modified photosynthetic bacterium inorganic salt culture medium to obtain methylobacterium sponge ball, uses sodium alginate and carboxymethyl cellulose to embed and fix the photosynthetic bacterium which has formaldehyde photosynthetic assimilation pathway and the inorganic salt culture medium to obtain photosynthetic bacterium sponge column as air purifying material. The sponge ball embedded with the methyl bacteria is placed in a gas purification area, the photosynthetic bacteria sponge strips are soaked in water of the water tank, the photosynthetic bacteria sponge columns in the water tank can be replaced by hydroponic plants, an air purifier based on a bioreactor principle is constructed, formaldehyde and other toxic organic compounds polluted in the air are purified, and the aim of purifying indoor air is fulfilled. The purifier has the characteristics of economy, practicality and environmental protection, and meets the requirements of modern living facilities on environment protection.

title_en: Range hood with detachable oil-smoke separator
abstract_en: A range hood with a detachable oil smoke separator is provided with a range hood main body and the oil smoke separator capable of separating oil smoke, wherein the oil smoke separator is detachably mounted inside the range hood main body. The oil smoke separator of the range hood can be detached to be discharged outside the range hood to be cleaned independently and also can be detached to be maintained. Compared with the range hood in the prior art, the oil fume separator of the range hood generates additional centrifugal force, can effectively remove oil fume particles, prevents the oil fume particles from entering the air draft assembly, and greatly improves the separation effect of the oil fume particles. Meanwhile, the range hood can prevent the air containing the oil smoke particles from contacting with the wind wheel, and the oil smoke particles can be effectively removed from the interior of the range hood.

title_en: Smoke machine capable of generating positive pressure
abstract_en: A smoke machine capable of generating positive pressure is provided with an air draft assembly, a positive pressure generating assembly capable of rotating and generating positive pressure and a cleaning program controller; the positive pressure generating assembly is fixedly assembled at the bottom of the oil pumping smoke hole of the air draft assembly. When using the convulsions subassembly of lampblack absorber, clean program controller takes place the subassembly through control convulsions subassembly and malleation and carries out the rotation of equidirectional not, thereby produce the air current of the oil absorption mouth direction of cigarette mouth to the convulsions subassembly by the play oil smoke mouth of convulsions subassembly, and the greasy dirt that makes originally attached to in convulsions subassembly surface by the drive of air current produces the opposite direction with the adhesive force originally, at first further reduce the adhesive force of greasy dirt, then make the greasy dirt break away from convulsions subassembly surface through the drive of the positive pressure air current that lasts again, reach the purpose of clean convulsions subassembly, this can produce the cigarette machine of malleation, and is simple in structure, and convenient to use's characteristics.

title_en: Fume exhaust fan
abstract_en: The invention discloses a range hood, which comprises: the fan assembly comprises a fan box and a fan arranged in the fan box, and the fan box is provided with an air inlet and an air outlet; the sound-proof housing, the sound-proof housing includes fan adapter and falls the subassembly of making an uproar, the fan adapter have with the wind passageway that crosses of air intake intercommunication falls the subassembly of making an uproar set up in cross in the wind passageway, in order to the separation the transmission of the produced noise of fan. The technical scheme of the invention reduces the noise of the range hood.

title_en: Continuous fermentation device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a continuous fermentation apparatus capable of transferring and fermenting a continuously fed fermentation object, and provides a continuous fermentation apparatus including a plurality of fermentation modules, each of the plurality of fermentation modules including: a conveyor belt for transferring the fermentation object continuously fed from one side to the other side; an agitator on the conveyor belt; and an air dispersing pipe located at one side of the conveyor belt, wherein the fermentation object continuously fed is fermented while passing through the fermentation module and is continuously discharged. This has the following effect: since the process time can be significantly reduced and the operation time of the production process can be shortened by continuously realizing the input of raw materials, fermentation, discharge of fermentation products, and the like, the investment cost is reduced, the productivity is improved, and the enterprise competitiveness is improved in mass production and development using solid fermentation, and the production cost of the produced product is significantly reduced.

title_en: Air conditioner fault detection method and device, air conditioner and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air conditioner fault detection method, a detection device, an air conditioner and a storage medium, wherein the method controls a compressor and an external fan to operate for preset time when the air conditioner is started, acquires an operating current value of the compressor, and finally determines that a control line of the compressor and a control line of the external fan are connected in error when the operating current value is smaller than a first preset threshold value.

title_en: Hot air circulation device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hot air circulation device, which comprises a machine body, wherein a hearth for baking is formed in the machine body, and the hot air circulation device further comprises a temperature control system, a hot air generation system, a hot air circulation system and an adjusting system, wherein the temperature control system is positioned on the machine body, the hot air generation system is connected with the temperature control system, the hot air circulation system is connected with the hot air generation system, the hot air circulation system is communicated with the hearth, and the adjusting system is connected with the hot air circulation system and is used for adjusting the pressure and the humidity in the hearth. The invention can reduce energy consumption, improve production efficiency and realize effective baking.

title_en: Fuel feeding system and fuel feeding method
abstract_en: The invention provides a fuel feeding system, which comprises a fuel storage device, a fuel switching device and a material conveying device, wherein the fuel storage device comprises a fuel storage tower and a lifting part; the material conveying device comprises a control host and a material conveying single piece, wherein the material conveying single piece comprises a conveying pipeline group, a conveying chain and a blanking device group. The fuel feeding system has the following effects: the structure is simplified; the annular channel formed by the conveying chain and the pipelines is combined to drive the fuel to be conveyed in a dragging mode in the conveying pipeline, so that the stable operation of the feeding system is ensured, the pipeline is in a circulating conveying state during conveying, and no blocking occurs; the specific number of the material conveying single pieces is designed according to actual demands, a plurality of conveying lines can be designed, stable conveying of fuel can be guaranteed, the demands of a plurality of combustion devices can be met, and the practicability is high. The invention also discloses a fuel feeding method, which is convenient to operate and has strong practicability.

title_en: Air guide component and cabinet air conditioner indoor unit with same
abstract_en: The invention provides an air guide member. The air guide component comprises a shell, an upper communicated air channel and an air outlet frame, wherein the shell is provided with an air inlet opening and an air outlet opening respectively on the bottom wall and the top wall, and the upper communicated air channel is fixed in the shell and communicated with the air inlet opening. The air outlet frame is configured to be capable of moving between an open position where the air outlet is exposed above the air outlet opening and a closed position where the air outlet is completely positioned in the shell, so that the gravity center of the whole machine is lowered, and dust is prevented from falling into the air outlet frame. The air outlet frame is further configured to always jet the air outlet cover with the upper part communicated with the air channel into the air channel in the process of moving between the opening position and the closing position, so that airflow uninterruptedly flows through the upper air supply air channel and the air outlet frame, and the technical problems of low air flow rate, incompact whole structure and high noise of the cabinet air conditioner indoor unit with the movable air outlet frame in the prior art are solved.

title_en: Sectional temperature-control humidity-control continuous special-flow water heat pump drying line and drying method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sectional temperature-control humidity-control continuous agriculture special flow water heat pump drying line, which comprises a heat pump system and a drying room, wherein the drying room is divided into a cooling channel, a heating channel and a drying channel from top to bottom; the drying room is divided into a plurality of drying sections in the front-back direction, and heating channels of adjacent drying sections are separated by a partition plate; a set of heat pump system is arranged in each drying section; a forced wet-exhausting fan for sucking the gas in the heating channel into the cooling channel is arranged in the cooling channel above the condenser in each drying section, and an air inlet of the forced wet-exhausting fan is communicated with the heating channel; a water receiving tray for containing condensed water is arranged below the evaporator, the water receiving tray is connected with a flow guiding pipe, and a condensed water collecting box is arranged below the tail end of the flow guiding pipe. The invention also discloses a drying method using the drying line. The invention has the advantages of energy saving, environmental protection and zero pollution, can collect aromatic substances generated in the drying process, and can prevent large-scale air flow mixing of drying channels of different drying sections.

title_en: Stainless steel heat exchanger
abstract_en: The invention discloses a stainless steel heat exchanger, which comprises a surrounding frame, a plurality of heat exchange tubes welded on the surrounding frame, and end covers arranged on the surrounding frame and positioned at two ends of the heat exchange tubes; the heat exchange device is characterized in that a partition board is arranged in the end cover, and the partition board connects the heat exchange pipes into a water channel; a groove is formed in the partition board, and a sealing gasket with the same shape as the groove is arranged in the groove; the end cover and the surrounding frame are sealed by the sealing gasket and are fixedly connected by bolts. According to the invention, the partition plate and the groove are arranged in the end cover, and the end cover and the surrounding frame are fixed by bolts around the end cover during assembly, so that brazing is not needed, and the end cover is simple to process and convenient to assemble.

title_en: Air conditioner, control method and device thereof and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air conditioner control method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring the current total current of the electricity environment where the air conditioner is located and acquiring the target frequency of the last frequency reduction operation of the air conditioner; when the total current is in a preset interval, determining the current target frequency of the air conditioner according to the total current and the target frequency of the last frequency reduction operation; and reducing the operating frequency of the air conditioner according to the determined target frequency. The invention also discloses an air conditioner control device, an air conditioner and a readable storage medium. The invention is closer to the operating characteristic of the circuit on-off device, improves the effective utilization degree of the electric quantity in the power utilization environment, and more reliably prevents the circuit on-off device from tripping.

title_en: Fireproof structure and air conditioner
abstract_en: The invention provides a fireproof structure, which comprises a water receiving disc and a first fireproof part, wherein a first concave wire groove is formed in the surface of the water receiving disc, the first wire groove is used for an electric control box to enter and exit a wire, the first fireproof part is arranged on the first wire groove and is made of fireproof materials, and the air conditioner with the fireproof structure is further disclosed. According to the first fireproof part, the electric wires in and out of the electric control box are isolated from the surface of the water receiving disc, so that the water receiving disc is prevented from being ignited by sparks generated by the electric wires when the air conditioner operates, the safety performance of the air conditioner can be improved, and the air conditioner operates more reliably.

title_en: Exhaust fan
abstract_en: The invention discloses an exhaust fan, which comprises a fan body and a fan, wherein the fan body is attached to the edge of a window frame or a door frame, an air channel is arranged in the fan body, a mounting seat is arranged on one side of the fan body, a communication hole used for being communicated with the air channel is formed in the mounting seat, an outlet of the fan is connected with the communication hole of the mounting seat, and the fan body is provided with an air outlet. The exhaust fan provided by the invention supplies air through the fan positioned on the outer side of the door frame or the window frame, and the air is introduced into a room through the fan body to complete indoor ventilation. The fan body is connected with the window frame or the door frame, and the volume of the fan body is obviously smaller than that of an exhaust fan in the prior art because the center of the fan body is not provided with fan blades, a motor and other parts, so that the shielding of doors and windows can be obviously reduced, and the influence on indoor lighting is small.

title_en: Control method of air conditioner and air conditioner
abstract_en: The invention aims to provide a control method of an air conditioner and the air conditioner, which can remove harmful substances adsorbed on a dehumidifying rotor and discharge the harmful substances to the outside. A control method of an air conditioner of the present invention for achieving the object is a control method for an air conditioner including: a first air flow path, both ends of which are connected with the indoor; a second air flow path having both ends connected to the outside; a dehumidifying rotor equipped with an adsorbent that is switched to alternately pass through a first area equipped on the first air flow path and a second area equipped on the second air flow path, characterized in that, in a state where the first blower equipped on the first air flow path is stopped from operating, the dehumidifying rotor is rotated and a purge operation mode as follows is operated: the second blower provided in the second air flow path is operated to suck the outdoor air into the second air flow path, and the air passes through the adsorbent in the second region and is then discharged to the outside.

title_en: Diagnosis and early warning system and device for boiler of thermal power station
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a thermal power station boiler diagnosis early warning system and device. The system comprises a plurality of wall temperature measuring points, for example, and is arranged on a boiler comprising a water wall, a superheater, a reheater and an economizer; the server side is used for the terminal to access through network connection; and the signal conversion board card is connected with the wall temperature measuring points and the server end and is used for providing the heating surface temperature information acquired by the wall temperature measuring points for the server end. Wherein, diagnosis early warning software is installed to the server end, just diagnosis early warning software includes: and the boiler graphic representation module is used for displaying a three-dimensional graph of the wall temperature state of the boiler, wherein the three-dimensional graph of the wall temperature state of the boiler is used for displaying the temperature states of the wall temperature measuring points. Therefore, the embodiment of the invention can realize the purpose of finding the problems existing in the four pipes of the boiler in advance, carrying out intelligent diagnosis and early warning.

title_en: Combined type adjustable water mixing ejector energy-saving device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a combined type adjustable water mixing ejector energy-saving device, which comprises: the adjustable muddy water sprayer of one-level, the adjustable muddy water sprayer of second grade, the governing valve, the tee bend that supplies water, return water tee bend 5, 4 interface flanges and the pipeline that is used for carrying on the internal connection. The invention integrates various circuit signal test functions, can dynamically adjust the heating mode of the residential district, realizes that floor heating users independently adjust the household valve, obtains proper heat, greatly reduces the power consumption of the circulating pump while improving the working stability of the water mixing jet pump, and can meet the user requirements and save energy.

title_en: Solar energy-heat pump coupling heat supply system and operation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of cross-season heat supply, in particular to a solar energy-heat pump coupling heat supply system and an operation method. The invention provides a solar energy-heat pump coupling heat supply system, which comprises a solar heat collector and a heat storage water tank, wherein the solar heat collector and the heat storage water tank form a heat storage circulation system, a heating tail end and the heat storage water tank form a heating circulation system, and a domestic water tail end and the heat storage water tank form a domestic water circulation system; the heating circulation system also comprises a heating heat exchanger and a high-temperature heat pump unit, and the domestic water circulation system also comprises a hot water heat exchanger and a conventional heat pump unit. The operation method of the solar-heat pump coupling heat supply system comprises an intelligent control system and the solar-heat pump coupling heat supply system, wherein the heat exchange process comprises a whole-year heat collection process, a heating heat supply process and a domestic water heat supply process, and the intelligent control system regulates and controls the conversion of each heat exchange process. The invention provides a solar energy-heat pump coupling heat supply system with stable heating process and an operation method.

title_en: Air current stirring formula inner loop air purifier
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air flow stirring type internal circulation air purifier which comprises a main body box, wherein an upper cover is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the main body box, a bottom box is fixedly arranged at the lower end of the main body box, and two groups of air inlets III and two groups of air inlets IV are respectively formed in the side wall of the upper cover. The air flow stirring type internal circulation air purifier provided by the invention can emit strong air flow to realize stirring of indoor air flow, so that indoor air can achieve optimal purification effect in the shortest time, flows of two purification paths can be realized, the purification range of the whole space is increased by more than 3 times, dead angles and dead zones are avoided, the space position is saved by adopting hanging type installation, meanwhile, the air purifier is integrated into the indoor attractive and comfortable environment, the surrounding environment can be comprehensively purified, and the independent module structures with different functions are adopted, so that the air purifier is more convenient to assemble and replace, the manufacturing cost is lower, the use is more worry-saving, and better use prospect is brought.

title_en: Adjustable temperature-sensitive adjusting mechanism for heat accumulating type electric heater
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of heat accumulators, in particular to an adjustable temperature-sensitive adjusting mechanism for a heat accumulating type electric heater, which comprises an inner container upper plate, an air outlet grid and a baffle plate, wherein the air outlet grid and the baffle plate are arranged on the inner container upper plate, and the adjustable temperature-sensitive adjusting mechanism further comprises: the automatic adjusting device is arranged at one end of the air outlet grid and is used for realizing displacement of the air outlet grid by bending at high temperature; the positioning device is arranged on the upper plate of the liner and used for limiting the air outlet grids by the displacement of the air outlet grids when the automatic adjusting device takes effect; the manual adjusting device is arranged at one end, far away from the automatic adjusting device, of the air outlet grid and used for manually returning the air outlet grid to an initial position at low temperature, the adjusting mode of the bimetallic strip is changed, the knob adjusting function fails after the bimetallic strip deforms under the original high-temperature condition, the bimetallic strip and the adjusting strip are not in direct contact through changing the design structure, and the automatic adjusting device and the manual adjusting device can be matched with each other and adjust an air outlet switch under the conditions of low temperature and high temperature.

title_en: Heavy-duty die preheating and quick replacing system and method of multidirectional double-acting extrusion hydraulic press
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heavy mould preheating and quick replacing system and method of a multidirectional double-acting extrusion hydraulic press, wherein the system comprises a mould automatic clamping device, a mould moving table device, a mould transporting double-U-shaped trolley, a mould preheating furnace bottom device, a mould assembling platform device and a longitudinal track device; the method is characterized in that the die is automatically clamped and loosened in the replacement process, and is automatically conveyed and assembled and disassembled among a hydraulic press, a preheating furnace and a die assembling position. The invention initiates a rapid automatic replacement integrated system from die assembly to preheating, loading and unloading and transportation of integrated heavy dies, realizes automatic and intelligent operation, improves the load rate of equipment, shortens the die assembly, heating and turnover processes and die replacement time, saves manpower, reduces production and operation costs, workshop crane capacity configuration and factory building cost, and is particularly suitable for the simultaneous rapid replacement requirement of vertical and horizontal heavy dies of a large-scale multidirectional double-acting extrusion hydraulic press.

title_en: Multifunctional integrated equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides multifunctional integrated equipment, which comprises a refrigerator with a refrigerating chamber and a control unit, and further comprises a water cooling system, an exhaust system and a humidifying unit connected with the exhaust system, wherein the exhaust system is provided with a deformable air deflector, the water cooling system and the humidifying unit can respectively generate cold air and humid air through the exhaust system, the control unit can selectively send a refrigerating instruction or a humidifying instruction to correspondingly open the water cooling system or the humidifying unit, a fan converts the air entering the exhaust system into the cold air or the humid air and then blows the cold air or the humid air outwards through the inner wall of the air deflector, and the air deflector has an initial state and a preset state of upward or downward arching and can change the state under the control of the control unit to guide the air direction.

title_en: Centralized cooling type heat pipe air conditioner multi-split system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of air conditioners and discloses a concentrated cooling type heat pipe air conditioner multi-split system which comprises a plurality of indoor units and outdoor units, wherein the indoor units and the outdoor units are distributed in a machine room, each indoor unit comprises a compressor evaporator, a compressor, an expansion valve and a heat pipe evaporator, each outdoor unit comprises an air conditioner plate heat exchanger, a compressor plate heat exchanger, two water pumps and a plurality of dry coolers with fans, the water pumps drive water to circulate in the outdoor units, and low-temperature water enters the dry coolers and flows out of the dry coolers. The invention has the following advantages and effects: the indoor units which are connected in parallel can be configured with different refrigerating capacities according to different heating values of all areas of the machine room, so that the problems of uneven heating and local partial heating of the machine room are effectively solved, and the refrigeration according to the needs is realized; the invention uses the heat pipe working condition for cooling in power utilization, uses the heat pipe working condition and the compressor working condition for cooling in spring and autumn, and uses the compressor working condition for cooling in summer, thereby shortening the working time of the compressor and reducing the energy consumption of the compressor.

title_en: Air conditioner water guide structure and air conditioner
abstract_en: The invention provides an air conditioner water guide structure and an air conditioner, and relates to the technical field of air conditioners. The air conditioner water guide structure can better guide water in the flow channel and prevent the water in the flow channel from splashing on the upper base side plate and the lower base side plate; and set up manger plate portion in the gap department of last base curb plate and lower base curb plate, effectively prevent to splash the water of gap department, further prevent that the comdenstion water from spilling out from the gap department and leading to the air conditioner to leak, water guide simple structure, the design is more reasonable, and the aesthetic property is higher.

title_en: Compact air conditioner
abstract_en: The invention relates to a compact air conditioner, which comprises a shell, a micro compressor, a compressor driver, a condensation heat exchanger, a condensation fan, a filter, an expansion valve, an evaporation heat exchanger, an evaporation fan, a gas-liquid separator, a water pan, a first flow-limiting cover plate, a second flow-limiting cover plate, an air inlet pipe body and an air outlet pipe body, wherein the shell comprises a bottom plate, a protective cover, a flow-limiting cover and a flow guide cover; the condensation heat exchanger is arranged on the first support, the first flow-limiting cover plate is covered on the condensation heat exchanger, the condensation fan is arranged between the first flow-limiting cover plate and the protective cover and is communicated with the first flow-limiting cover plate in a butt joint mode, the evaporation heat exchanger is arranged on the second support, the second flow-limiting cover plate is covered on the evaporation heat exchanger, and the evaporation fan is arranged between the second flow-limiting cover plate and the flow-limiting cover and is communicated with the second flow-limiting cover plate in a butt joint mode. The invention has the advantages of compact structure, good use performance, high reliability, small volume, convenient use, large application range and the like.

title_en: Electrical apparatus box casing, electrical apparatus box and electrical apparatus
abstract_en: The invention provides an electric appliance box shell, an electric appliance box and an electric appliance, and relates to the field of electric appliances. The electrical box housing includes a first sidewall; the first side wall is provided with a first wiring structure, a second wiring structure and a guide plate, the first wiring structure comprises a first wiring hole and a first winding card, and the first winding card is positioned below the first wiring hole; the second wiring structure comprises a second wiring hole and a second winding card, and the second winding card is positioned below the second wiring hole; the first routing structure is located above the second routing structure, and the guide plate is located between the first routing structure and the second routing structure. The electric appliance box of the technical scheme has the advantages of safe wiring, compact structure and good waterproof performance.

title_en: Air conditioner controller and method for controlling air conditioning system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a controller for controlling a first air conditioning system and a second air conditioning system having separate refrigerant circuits but arranged for conditioning a common space. The controller includes a multivariable regulator for determining control signals for controlling operation of first components of the first and second refrigerant circuits to jointly simultaneously reduce an environmental error between a setpoint and a measured value of an environment in the common space. The controller also includes at least two univariate regulators for receiving an operating error between a setpoint and a measured value of operation of a second component of the first refrigerant circuit and the second refrigerant circuit. The controller determines control signals for controlling the operation of the different refrigerant circuits and reducing the operation error, respectively. The controller also includes a look-up table that stores values of other inputs to the system that improve its performance, and the controller selects particular input values for the multivariable regulator and/or the univariate regulator based on the outputs of the two systems. The controller includes an electrical circuit for controlling the first air conditioning system and the second air conditioning system according to the determined control signal.

title_en: Vertical air conditioning equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vertical air conditioning equipment, which comprises a microcomputer digital controller, an electrical appliance control panel, an air outlet structure, an expansion valve, a heat exchanger and a machine body, wherein the electrical appliance control panel is arranged right above the machine body, the microcomputer digital controller is arranged on the electrical appliance control panel, the air outlet structure is arranged on the machine body right above the microcomputer digital controller, the heat exchanger is arranged in the machine body opposite to the air outlet structure, and the heat exchanger is mechanically connected with the expansion valve. The drying of the ground where the bottom of the machine body is located is ensured.

title_en: Refrigeration cycle device
abstract_en: The refrigeration cycle device is provided with: a first refrigerant circuit including a first compressor, an oil separator, a first heat exchanger functioning as a condenser, a first refrigerant flow path of a second heat exchanger, a first expansion device, and a third heat exchanger functioning as an evaporator, and through which a first refrigerant flows; a second refrigerant circuit including a second compressor, a fourth heat exchanger functioning as a condenser, a second throttle device, and a second refrigerant flow path of the second heat exchanger, and through which a second refrigerant flows; an oil return circuit including a first opening/closing device that connects the oil separator and the first compressor and returns the refrigerating machine oil accumulated in the oil separator to the first compressor; and a control device that controls the first compressor, the second compressor, the first throttle device, the second throttle device, and the first opening/closing device, wherein the control device performs a first control of starting an operation of the second compressor and opening the first opening/closing device when the first compressor and the second compressor are stopped and a pressure of a low pressure portion of the first refrigerant circuit becomes a reference value or more.

title_en: Motor control method and device and air conditioner
abstract_en: The invention provides a motor control method, a motor control device and an air conditioner, wherein the motor control method comprises the following steps: after a current rotating speed instruction of the motor is detected, acquiring current quadrature axis current; determining a direct axis compensation current according to the current quadrature axis current, wherein the direct axis compensation current is a current component with a negative direction; generating a current direct-axis expected current of the motor based on the direct-axis compensation current; controlling the motor based on the current desired current for the direct axis. The invention can reduce the energy consumption loss of the air conditioner.

title_en: Oblique eave step type anti-extinguishing combustor for stove
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of stoves, and discloses an oblique eave stepped anti-extinguishing burner for a stove, which comprises a gas channel, wherein a gas cavity is fixedly connected to the outside of the gas channel, a small-fire burner injection part is fixedly connected to the top of the gas cavity, a small-fire burner injection part cover is fixedly connected to the top of the small-fire burner injection part, a small injection part cover vent hole is formed in the surface of the small-fire burner injection part cover, a small-fire cover is movably connected to the top of the small-fire burner injection part, a large-fire burner injection part is fixedly connected to the top of the gas cavity, a large-fire burner injection part cover is fixedly connected to the top of the large-fire burner injection part, and a large-fire burner injection part cover is arranged on the top of the large-fire burner injection part cover and the small-fire cover and provided with convex oblique eave parts, so that when a large amount of liquid overflows from boiling in a pot and flows onto the large-fire cover and the small-fire cover, the liquid, and the flame holes cannot be blocked to cause flame extinguishment to cause gas leakage.

title_en: Automatic regulating device in semi-sealing equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automatic regulating device in semi-sealed equipment, which is characterized by comprising an air inlet pipe, a time delay device, a ventilation guide pipe, an air outlet inclined hole and an O 2 The air inlet pipe is connected with a ventilation guide pipe, an air outlet inclined hole is formed in the ventilation guide pipe, and the O-shaped hole is formed in the ventilation guide pipe 2 The determinator is connected with the electric needle valve through an induction wire, and the time delay device is connected with the electric needle valve; the scheme ensures that the content of O2 in the semi-sealed equipment reaches the human body requirement standard, namely 21 percent, and ensures regular and effective circulating ventilation in the semi-sealed equipment.

title_en: Preparation method and application of aerogel-polypyrrole photothermal conversion material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of an aerogel-polypyrrole photothermal conversion material 3 The material is subjected to in-situ polymerization and is uniformly attached to chitosan aerogel to obtain the aerogel-polypyrrole photothermal conversion material, the structure of the material is stable, the material has excellent hydrothermal conversion performance and light absorption performance, and the material can be used as a photothermal conversion material and applied to occasions such as seawater desalination, sewage treatment and the like.

title_en: Water outlet slow-release structure of water heater
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water heaters, and discloses a water outlet slow release structure of a water heater, which comprises a water outlet control valve, wherein a slow release cylinder is arranged at the water outlet end of the lower part of the water outlet control valve, a piston is connected in the slow release cylinder in a sliding manner, a damping hole is formed in the piston, the damping hole penetrates through the upper end and the lower end of the piston, and a reset tension spring is fixedly connected to the top end of the piston. According to the invention, the slow release cylinder is arranged at the water outlet end of the water outlet control valve, the piston and the liquid outlet channel are arranged in the slow release cylinder, when the water outlet control valve is suddenly opened, the quantity of water flowing through the damping holes is less due to the damping effect of the damping holes formed in the piston, and the liquid outlet channel can be opened after the upper space of the piston is filled, so that when the water outlet control valve is suddenly opened, the water flow is ensured not to flow out at a large flow rate, and the water flow starts to flow out in a large quantity after slowly flowing out through the damping holes, so that a user has time to respond whether the water is discharged from a shower head or a faucet, and has time to respond whether the temperature of the discharged.

title_en: Defrosting control method for air conditioner
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of air conditioners, and particularly relates to a defrosting control method of an air conditioner. In order to improve the defrosting efficiency of the air conditioner, the defrosting control method of the air conditioner provided by the invention aims at the air conditioner with double fans arranged on an outdoor unit, and the method comprises the following steps: detecting the current I of the upper fan On the upper part And current I of lower fan Lower part (ii) a When I is Up/or Ie is greater than or equal to a first preset value and I Lower- When the/Ie is larger than or equal to a first preset value, enabling the air conditioner to enter a defrosting mode; after the air conditioner enters a defrosting mode, controlling the upper fan and the lower fan to stop rotating; after a first set time, according to t On the upper part 、t In 、t Lower part And I On the upper part And I Lower part Selectively controls the upper fan and the lower fan to rotate reversely/stop. The invention is based on t On the upper part 、t In 、t Lower part And I On the upper part And I Lower part At least one of the upper fan and the lower fan is selectively controlled to rotate reversely, so that the frost layer is accurately blown down, and the defrosting efficiency of the air conditioner is greatly improved.

title_en: Control method and control device of variable frequency air conditioner, storage medium and air conditioner
abstract_en: The invention provides a control method, a control device, a storage medium and an air conditioner of a variable frequency air conditioner, wherein the control method of the variable frequency air conditioner comprises the following steps: when the current operating frequency f of the compressor At present At a predetermined frequency f Preset of Within a range and a continuous operating time t of said compressor (Continuous) At a preset time t Preset of Controlling the air conditioner to enter an oil return control mode within the range; when the preset frequency f Preset of The lower the preset time t is Preset of The shorter.

title_en: Energy-saving defrosting control method and device, storage medium and air conditioner
abstract_en: The invention provides a control method, a control device, a storage medium and an air conditioner for energy conservation and defrosting, wherein the control method comprises the following steps: in the heating mode of the air conditioner, every first preset time t 1 Detecting the first outer disc temperature Tw once; calculating a first variation slope X of the outer disc temperature according to the detected first outer disc temperature Tw; judging whether the inner disc temperature Tn is detected or not according to the first change slope X of the first outer disc temperature Tw; and judging whether the air conditioner enters a defrosting mode or not according to the first change slope X of the first outer plate temperature Tw and the inner plate temperature Tn. The mode of the invention can realize preposition defrosting, effectively reduce the running time of a defrosting mode and realize the purpose of energy saving.

title_en: Air conditioner control method based on face recognition and air conditioner
abstract_en: The invention provides an air conditioner control method based on face recognition and an air conditioner, wherein the control method comprises the following steps: when the processor detects a control signal of the remote controller, the face data of a user using the remote controller is obtained through the camera; matching the acquired face data with the face data in the memory; acquiring air conditioner control parameters corresponding to successfully matched face data in a memory; the processor controls the air conditioner to operate according to the acquired air conditioner control parameters; through face identification, the last air conditioner control parameter of the user is extracted quickly, the time required for the user to set the air conditioner control parameter is shortened, the operation flow is simplified, different habits of different users in using the air conditioner are met, and the user experience is improved.

title_en: Air conditioner installation structure and installation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an air conditioner mounting structure and a mounting method, wherein the air conditioner mounting structure comprises a mounting rack, wherein the mounting rack comprises a frame and two vertical rods; the outdoor unit comprises a base, wherein a plurality of first through holes are formed in both ends of the top of the base, a plurality of second through holes are formed in both ends of the top of the frame, and the first through holes and the second through holes are arranged in a one-to-one correspondence manner; a damping device is arranged in each second through hole and comprises a first lead screw, a first sliding block, a first connecting rod vertically and fixedly connected to the top of the first sliding block and a first spring sleeved on the first connecting rod; the top of the first connecting rod penetrates through the first through hole and is in threaded connection with a nut; the top of the second through hole is provided with a sinking groove, the top of the first spring is abutted against the bottom of the base, and the bottom of the first spring is abutted against the bottom of the sinking groove; and a driving device for driving the plurality of first lead screws to rotate is arranged at the bottom of the frame. The damping device is arranged, so that the possibility of looseness of the mounting frame can be reduced.

title_en: Solar device and vehicle
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a solar device and a vehicle, the solar device including: a heat collecting plate (1); a steam generator (3) for generating steam using the heat collected by the heat collecting plate (1); the heat collecting plate comprises a pneumatic telescopic piece (2), wherein the pneumatic telescopic piece (2) is connected with the heat collecting plate (1), and the pneumatic telescopic piece (2) is driven to stretch by steam generated by the steam generator (3) so as to change the direction and the angle of the heat collecting plate (1). The solar device has the advantages of simple structure and low energy loss, wherein the pneumatic telescopic piece of the solar device can be telescopic only by the driving of steam, the additional increase of motor driving is not needed, the number of parts is reduced, and the structure of the solar device is simplified; the solar device directly converts heat energy into mechanical energy, the number of energy conversion intermediate processes is small, energy loss is reduced, and the utilization rate of the heat energy is improved.

title_en: Boiler drum and method for reforming boiler drum based on reverse simulation analysis
abstract_en: The application provides a boiler drum and a method for reforming the boiler drum based on reverse simulation analysis, and belongs to the technical field of boiler reforming. An inner cavity and a steam-water introducing cavity are arranged in a steam drum shell of the boiler, and a first steam-water introducing pipe communicated with the steam-water introducing cavity and a second steam-water introducing pipe communicated with the inner cavity are arranged on the steam drum shell. The first pore plate is connected with the steam drum shell to divide the inner cavity into a first cavity and a second cavity, the steam-water introducing cavity is positioned on one side of the first pore plate, which is far away from the second cavity, and the pipe orifice of the second steam-water introducing pipe is positioned in the first cavity and the second cavity. The steam-water separator comprises a separator body and a steam-water inlet pipe, the separator body is located in the first cavity, one end of the steam-water inlet pipe is connected with the separator body, and the other end of the steam-water inlet pipe is communicated with the steam-water inlet cavity. And one end of the drainage tube is connected to the pipe opening of the second steam-water introducing pipe, and the other end of the drainage tube penetrates through the first pore plate and is communicated with the steam-water introducing cavity. This boiler drum has connected a drainage tube, can improve the quality of steam.

title_en: Combustion device for premixed airflow high-speed rotational flow jet flue gas backflow low-nitrogen combustion
abstract_en: The invention relates to a combustion device for premixed airflow high-speed rotational flow jet smoke backflow low-nitrogen combustion, which effectively solves the problems of high-efficiency, energy-saving and low-nitrogen combustion of oxygen control, combustion control and temperature control of an industrial furnace, wherein a combustor is formed by concentrically sleeving an outer gas airflow channel pipe, a middle air airflow channel pipe and a central adjusting airflow inlet pipe together, and the outer port of the outer gas airflow channel pipe is hermetically connected with the outer wall of the air airflow channel pipe to form a gas airflow channel; the outer gas flow channel pipe is provided with a gas inlet pipe, and the outer port of the air flow channel pipe is hermetically connected with the outer wall of the central regulating gas flow inlet pipe to form an air flow channel; the air inlet pipe is arranged on the pipe wall of the closed outer end of the air flow channel on the air flow channel pipe to form two annular channels and a central pipe channel, one end of each annular channel is closed, the other end of each annular channel is opened, and the two ends of each central pipe are an inlet end and an outlet end. The invention has simple structure and good use effect, and is an innovation on the combustion device.

title_en: Sealing equipment of grate cooler transmission mechanism for cement production
abstract_en: The invention discloses sealing equipment of a grate cooler transmission mechanism for cement production, and relates to the technical field of cement production; in order to effectively clean impurities such as powder and the like attached to the transmission shaft; the device comprises a sealing chamber and a fixed seat, wherein the sealing chamber is fixed on the outer wall of one side of an equipment shell through bolts, the fixed seat is fixed on the outer wall of a transmission shaft through jackscrews, a first waterproof bearing is fixed on the inner wall of one side of the sealing chamber through a first bearing seat, a second waterproof bearing is fixed on the inner wall of the other side of the sealing chamber through a second bearing seat, and the first waterproof bearing and the second waterproof bearing are both arranged on the outer wall of the transmission shaft; the outer wall of the fixed seat is connected with a water storage chamber in a sliding manner. The invention can clean the surface of the transmission shaft while sealing by arranging the structures such as the brush, the brush head seat, the flow guide pipe and the like; through setting up screw thread post, locking knob and locking seat, can change the driving nature of brush and transmission shaft according to the demand to increase cleaning work's controllability.

title_en: Cooling tower system with haze removal function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cooling tower system with haze removal function, which comprises: the central processing equipment and the air chamber are provided with an air chamber cavity, a first air inlet, a second air inlet and a plurality of mixed air outlets, wherein the first air inlet is communicated with an air outlet of the cooling tower, the second air inlet is communicated with ambient air, the first air inlet and the second air inlet are both provided with a thermometer and a hygrometer, and each mixed air outlet is provided with a valve; the central processing equipment is in communication connection with each thermometer and hygrometer so as to draw an air humidity chart, obtain an isenthalpic line of saturated hot and humid air and draw a mixed gas state line on the air humidity chart; the central processing equipment is in communication connection with a valve at each mixed gas outlet, and when the mixed gas state line passes through the wet air supersaturated area or is positioned on the isenthalpic line of saturated wet and hot air, the valve is opened to discharge the mixed air in the air chamber forming water mist.

title_en: Self-cleaning range hood and self-cleaning control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-cleaning range hood, which comprises a box body, a fan arranged in the box body, an oil fume filtering device, a self-cleaning device used for cleaning the oil fume filtering device and a filtering detection device used for judging the oil-stained state of the oil fume filtering device, wherein the filtering detection device is positioned at the downstream of the oil fume filtering device on an oil fume flow path and comprises a micro air duct used for sensing the pressure difference inside and outside the box body, and a pressure feedback device which acts according to the pressure difference inside and outside the box body sensed by the micro air duct is arranged in the micro air duct. Also discloses a self-cleaning control method of the self-cleaning range hood. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages that: the operation of the self-cleaning device can be automatically controlled according to the actual state of the oil fume filtering device, so that the smoothness of the oil fume filtering device is ensured, and the energy is saved; through the micro air channel for inducing the pressure difference and the pressure feedback device arranged in the micro air channel, the oil staining state of the oil fume filtering device can be accurately judged.

title_en: Radiator and air conditioner
abstract_en: The application provides a radiator and an air conditioner, which comprise a first radiating part, a second radiating part and a connecting part, wherein the connecting part comprises a first section and a second section, the first section is arranged on the first radiating part, the second section is arranged on the second radiating part, and the connecting part can be bent so as to enable the first radiating part and the second radiating part to be arranged at an angle. The radiator and the air conditioner provided by the embodiment of the application can effectively improve the contact area of the radiating air and the radiator, improve the radiating efficiency of the radiator and ensure the service life of a power device.

title_en: Integral prefabricating device for light-burning kiln working layer
abstract_en: The invention discloses an integral prefabricating device for a light-burning kiln working layer, which comprises a base and a first PLC (programmable logic controller), wherein a first motor is fixedly installed on the right side of the base, a groove is formed in the top of the base, an inner cavity of the groove is rotatably connected with a second threaded rod through a bearing, an output shaft of the first motor is fixedly connected with the second threaded rod, a bottom plate is connected to the outer surface of the second threaded rod in a threaded manner, the bottom plate is movably connected with the inner cavity of the groove, and sliding blocks are fixedly connected to the left end and the right end of the bottom plate. According to the invention, through the mutual matching of the first motor, the forming box, the cover plate, the first threaded rod, the second motor, the first belt pulley, the second belt pulley, the sliding chute, the sliding block, the bottom plate, the second threaded rod and the threaded groove, the problems that the existing integral prefabricating device does not have a profile fine-tuning function, so that the mixing of refractory materials in a working layer is not uniform, the attractiveness of the working layer of the light-burning kiln is influenced, and the sealing effect is poor are solved.

title_en: Air conditioner, control method and control device thereof, and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides an air conditioner, a control method and a control device thereof, and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the air conditioner comprises: a plurality of external fans; a first temperature measurement member configured to be suitable for detecting an ambient temperature; the processor is electrically connected with the first temperature measuring part and the plurality of outer fans; a memory for storing processor-executable instructions, wherein the processor, when executing the executable instructions stored in the memory, performs the steps of: controlling the air conditioner to heat and start up; and controlling the air conditioner to start up according to the ambient temperature by a first program or a second program, wherein the first program comprises the step of controlling the plurality of external fans to run, and the second program comprises the step of controlling at least one of the plurality of external fans to be turned off. The air conditioner provided by the scheme can better avoid the problem that the heating starting leads to the overhigh temperature or pressure of the inner pipe when the environment temperature is higher, solves the problem that the starting fails or is frequently started due to the overhigh temperature or pressure of the inner pipe, and realizes the starting efficiency of the air conditioner.

title_en: Air guide assembly for air conditioner, air guide device and air conditioner
abstract_en: The invention provides an air guide assembly for an air conditioner, an air guide device and the air conditioner, wherein the air guide assembly comprises blades and blade connecting rods; the blade connecting rod drives the blade to swing, the blade connecting rod is positioned between the base and the middle frame of the air conditioner, and the blade connecting rod avoids the air duct. In addition, the blade connecting rod drives the blade to swing, so that the swing and steering of the blade can be adjusted outside the air duct through the blade connecting rod, and the swing and steering of the blade can be adjusted without the mode that an operator stretches hands into the air duct.

title_en: Kitchen air conditioner all-in-one
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of air conditioning, in particular to a kitchen air conditioning integrated machine. The invention aims to solve the problems of inconvenient installation and occupied indoor space of the existing kitchen air conditioner. For this purpose, the kitchen air conditioner all-in-one machine comprises a box body, wherein a refrigerating chamber and a refrigerating chamber are arranged in the box body from top to bottom, a first air outlet communicated with the interior is arranged at the top of the refrigerating chamber, an air outlet plate capable of being opened and closed is arranged at the first air outlet, a refrigerating unit is arranged in the refrigerating chamber, the refrigerating unit comprises a compressor, a condenser, a throttling element and an evaporator which are sequentially connected, the evaporator is provided with a fan, a second air outlet is further arranged in the refrigerating chamber, and the refrigerating chamber is communicated with the refrigerating chamber through the second air outlet. The integrated kitchen air conditioner can integrate multiple functions while adjusting the temperature of a kitchen, and effectively saves the space of the kitchen.

title_en: Thyroid cancer gene detection kit
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical equipment, and particularly relates to a thyroid cancer gene detection kit which comprises a box body, wherein a first servo motor is fixedly installed at the bottom of the box body, a coupler is fixedly connected to the output end of the first servo motor, a first threaded rod is fixedly connected to the inside of the coupler, an internal thread sleeve is sleeved on the surface of the first threaded rod, a connecting rod is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the internal thread sleeve, the top end of the connecting rod is fixedly connected with a lifting plate, and a sliding block is fixedly installed on one side of the lifting plate. Through being provided with first servo motor, can drive shaft coupling and first threaded rod rotatory, through first threaded rod cooperation internal thread cover, the rotatory accessible interact power drive internal thread cover vertical movement of first threaded rod to make the lifter plate go up and down, be convenient for change the height of lifter plate, through slider cooperation slide rail, take place the skew when can avoiding the lifter plate vertical migration.

title_en: Air conditioner
