abstract_en: The present invention relates to an air conditioner having an outdoor unit (1) and an indoor unit (2), and the air conditioner is provided with: a converter main circuit (8) which rectifies and smoothes an AC power supply (3) to generate a DC voltage in a main circuit capacitor (12); an inverter main circuit (16) that converts a direct-current voltage generated by the main circuit capacitor (12) into an alternating-current voltage; a compressor motor (17) driven by the inverter main circuit (16); an outdoor fan (29); a fan motor (30) for driving and rotating the outdoor fan (29); and a microcomputer (26) that controls the outdoor unit (1), wherein the microcomputer (26) prevents the outdoor unit (1) from shifting from the standby power reduction mode to the operation stop state when the outdoor unit (1) is in the power generation state due to the fan motor (30) rotating while outside air blows the outdoor fan (29) in the standby power reduction mode.

title_en: Water collector subassembly and dehumidifier
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of dehumidifiers, and provides a water pan assembly and a dehumidifier. The water collector subassembly includes the water collector, connecting pipe and elastic component, the water collector has along the first direction drain nozzle that extends down, the connecting pipe has first pipeline section and second pipeline section, first pipeline section overlaps on the periphery wall of drain nozzle along first direction slidable, the lower extreme along first direction of first pipeline section is the blind end, the second pipeline section is connected with the periphery wall of first pipeline section, the lumen and the lumen intercommunication of second pipeline section of first pipeline section, the elastic component is located between drain nozzle and the connecting pipe, the elastic component forces the connecting pipe to slide to the drain nozzle and with the intercommunication of second pipeline section to the mouth of pipe shutoff of first pipeline section, and the blind end is with the mouth of pipe shutoff of drain nozzle. The mouth of pipe of water drainage mouth and the intercommunication of second pipeline section to the mouth of pipe of first pipeline section all by the shutoff, are favorable to promoting the shutoff effect, are favorable to reducing the risk that the comdenstion water leaked through water drainage mouth and connecting pipe.

title_en: Heating cooker
abstract_en: The invention provides an induction heating cooker capable of ensuring the strength of a glass top plate and inhibiting breakage. The disclosed device is provided with: a main body (1) having a main body opening formed at the upper part; a glass top plate (2) which is provided above the body (1) and on which an object to be heated is placed; heating coils (3 a, 3b, 3 c) provided below the top plate (2); a reinforcing plate (40) provided between the top plate (2) and the heating coils (3 a, 3b, 3 c); a frame (80) covering the periphery of the top plate (2); a fan device (9) for blowing out cooling air for cooling the heating coils (3 a, 3b, 3 c); and an inverter for supplying power to the heating coils (3 a, 3b, 3 c). The top plate (2) is provided with a vent hole (H2) for discharging at least air flowing to the fan device (9), and the reinforcing plate (40) is provided with an opening (42) in a region corresponding to the main body opening and the vent hole (H2).

title_en: Hot water supply device
abstract_en: The invention provides a hot water supply device. The hot water supply device can improve the use convenience when the hot water supply device is used for supplying hot water and when the air conditioner is used. A switching control device (27) capable of switching a heat medium flow path (4,5) between an air-conditioning usable state and a hot-water-supply usable state switches the heat medium flow path to the hot-water-supply usable state by a switching valve (21) when the air-conditioning usable state is on standby and the air-conditioning is not in use until the air-conditioning use standby time elapses.

title_en: Actuator for a valve and device having such an actuator
abstract_en: The invention relates to a control drive (10) for a valve (11), having an actuating device (17), a control member (16) and a manually actuable switching device, wherein the control member (16) moves the actuating device (17) between two end positions as a function of a control or control variable, and wherein the actuating device (17) can be moved into at least one of the two end positions independently of the control or control variable using the manually actuable switching device. In order to be able to switch the adjustment drive (10) into one of its end positions in a simple and convenient manner, the adjustment drive (10) according to the invention is characterized in that the switching means is an eccentric (29), which eccentric (29) can be actuated by means of a manual actuating element (23). The invention also relates to a device having such an adjusting drive (10).

title_en: Solar water heater
abstract_en: The invention discloses a solar water heater, and belongs to the field of solar water heating equipment. The invention discloses a solar water heater, which comprises a water storage tank, a wind mechanism, an adjusting mechanism, a transmission mechanism and a circulating mechanism, wherein the wind mechanism is arranged on the water storage tank and comprises a second rotating shaft and a plurality of fan blades capable of driving the second rotating shaft to rotate; the circulating mechanism comprises a first rotating shaft transversely arranged in the water storage tank, a plurality of impellers are axially arranged on the first rotating shaft, and the impellers are used for driving water in the water storage tank to flow; the transmission shaft of the transmission mechanism is used for connecting the first rotating shaft and the second rotating shaft in a transmission manner, and the adjusting mechanism is used for controlling the rotating speed of the transmission shaft. The solar water heater of the invention utilizes wind energy to drive the circulating mechanism to uniformly mix cold and hot water in the water storage tank, and the adjusting mechanism controls the rotating speed of the first rotating shaft of the circulating mechanism, thereby improving the uniformity of water temperature in the water storage tank and avoiding the generation of cold and hot water stratification.

title_en: Remote controller for air conditioner
abstract_en: The remote controller of the air conditioner of the invention comprises: an external button for the user to operate to change the operation state of the air conditioner body; an internal button for a user to operate to change the operation state; a cover that covers the inner button and can be opened and closed; a cover opening/closing detection unit that detects opening/closing of the cover; a display unit that displays an enlarged display screen showing at least 1 of the operation mode, the set temperature, and the set humidity, and a detailed display screen showing functions of the internal buttons; and a display switching unit that displays the enlarged display screen on the display unit when the cover opening/closing detection unit detects the closed state of the cover, and displays the detailed display screen on the display unit when the cover opening/closing detection unit detects the open state of the cover.

title_en: Air conditioning system
abstract_en: An air conditioning system (1) is provided with an outdoor unit (2) and an indoor unit (3), and the indoor unit is connected to the outdoor unit (2) via an air conditioning communication line (6). The outdoor unit (2) is provided with a control unit (11), a compressor (12), a fan (14), a compressor inverter (13), a fan inverter (15), a heat exchanger, various valves, and the like. A control unit (11) of an outdoor unit (2) has a coupling capacitor (22) and a noise reduction transformer (23) between a communication circuit (21) and an air conditioning communication line (6).

title_en: Automatic cleaning type industrial humidifier
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic cleaning type industrial humidifier which comprises a humidifier body, wherein four supporting legs are arranged below the humidifier body, and rollers are arranged below the four supporting legs; a water tank is arranged at one end of the machine body, a first cavity and a second cavity are symmetrically arranged on the inner side of the machine body, the water tank is connected with the first cavity and the second cavity through a pipeline, a first electromagnetic valve is arranged on the pipeline, a first heating structure and a second heating structure are respectively arranged in the first cavity and the second cavity, the middle part of the first heating structure is detachably connected with a lifting limiting structure, the lower end of the lifting limiting structure is connected with the lower opening of the first cavity in an extrusion manner, the machine body is detachably connected above the lifting limiting structure, and a lifting cleaning structure is arranged on the outer side of the lifting limiting structure; the organism top is equipped with the pressure reducer, and the pressure reducer corresponds first cavity of pipe connection, and first cavity and second cavity can dismantle the connection through first connecting pipe, and is equipped with gaseous check valve on the first connecting pipe, and second cavity other end top is equipped with row's material pipe, arranges the material pipe top and is equipped with the fog shower nozzle.

title_en: Recovery method of high-condensation-point waste gas
abstract_en: A high-condensation-point waste gas recovery device is characterized by comprising a heat exchanger, a dirty oil tank, an alkaline washing tower and a fan, wherein a waste gas inlet pipe is arranged at the top end of the heat exchanger, a discharge pipe is arranged at the bottom end of the heat exchanger, a waste gas outlet is formed in the top end of the dirty oil tank, a waste gas inlet is formed in the middle or bottom of the alkaline washing tower, an exhaust port is formed in the top of the alkaline washing tower, an alkaline liquid inlet is formed in the upper portion of the alkaline washing tower, an alkaline liquid outlet is formed in the lower portion of the alkaline washing tower, and the air inlet end of combustion equipment is connected with the exhaust port of the alkaline washing tower. The invention also discloses a high-condensation-point waste gas recovery method. And the treatment of cooling, alkali liquor absorption and combustion is adopted, and finally, C5 and C5+ components are condensed and collected in a dirty oil tank, and C4 and light components below are sent to combustion equipment to complete combustion, so that the treatment efficiency is high, the emission is reliable, the whole equipment is simple and easy to maintain, and the relative treatment cost is lower.

title_en: Comprehensive garbage and biogas treatment method for urban densely populated areas
abstract_en: A comprehensive treatment method for garbage and methane in urban dense population areas can collect methane from a large number of anaerobic tanks in cities, and intensively convey the methane to a garbage incinerator to be used as a garbage combustion improver; the method can solve the problem that the anaerobic pond biogas pollutes the urban environment, and can save combustion improver such as coal, oil, natural gas and the like used for garbage incineration. The environmental problems of urban solid waste and urban waste gas are fundamentally improved.

title_en: Energy gathering ring assembly and gas stove
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy gathering ring assembly and a gas stove. According to the invention, the dividing piece of the energy-gathering ring assembly is arranged on the outer peripheral surface of the outer ring fire cover, and the at least one outer ring fire hole is arranged below the dividing piece, so that partial flame of the outer ring fire hole can be combusted below the dividing piece, when air flows through the energy-gathering ring assembly, the hotter dividing piece firstly heats the air, and the flame and smoke gas sprayed from the outer ring fire hole can further heat the air, so that the air can be effectively heated, the temperature of the air is increased, the heat required by mixing the air and the fuel gas and reaching the ignition point can be reduced, and the combustion efficiency of the gas stove can be effectively improved.

title_en: Commercial complex air conditioner energy recovery method and system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a commercial complex air conditioner energy recovery system, relates to the field of air conditioning systems, and comprises a cooling system, a heating system and a fan coil, wherein the cooling system and the heating system are respectively communicated with the fan coil; the heating system comprises a boiler and a heating unit, the fan coil is respectively communicated with the boiler and the heating unit, and the heating unit is communicated with the boiler. The time of opening cooling tower and boiler can be reduced to this application to reduce the consumption of the energy.

title_en: Automatic deashing hot-blast furnace
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automatic ash removal hot blast stove which comprises a shell, a combustion furnace and a heat exchanger communicated with the combustion furnace, wherein an ash removal component capable of rotating to carry out ash removal on the inner wall of the combustion furnace is arranged in the combustion furnace, a scraper knife for removing ash is accommodated in the furnace wall of the combustion furnace, and a hydraulic cylinder in the ash removal component pushes the scraper knife to extend out of the furnace wall and is driven by a rotating ring in the combustion furnace above the scraper knife to rotate along the furnace wall so as to remove ash. According to the invention, the accommodating cavity and the sliding door are arranged on the inner wall of the combustion furnace to accommodate and protect the scraper knife, so that the scraper knife is prevented from interfering with combustion of fuel in the combustion furnace or being damaged by long-term heating of the combustion furnace, the motor drives the gear, the gear drives the rotating ring to rotate through the gear teeth on the outer wall of the rotating ring, the rotating ring drives the scraper knife pushed out of the accommodating cavity by the hydraulic cylinder through the clamping groove, the circumferential rotation is carried out on the inner wall of the furnace body of the combustion furnace, the ash removal operation of the inner wall of the furnace body is realized, and the manual trouble is avoided through automatic cleaning.

title_en: Pulse type temperature equalizing plate
abstract_en: The pulse type temperature equalizing plate of the invention comprises: an inner plate having: a first face; and a second face opposite to the first face; the first outer plate body is fixedly arranged on the first surface of the inner plate body; the second outer plate body is fixedly arranged on the second surface of the inner plate body; two paths, each path has a first end and a second end, and the first ends of the paths are communicated with each other and the second ends of the paths are communicated with each other, thereby the two paths form a loop; wherein: wherein a path is formed between the first surface of the inner plate and the first outer plate; and the other path is formed between the second surface of the inner plate body and the second outer plate body; two through holes which are formed on the first surface and the second surface of the inner plate body in a penetrating way, wherein one through hole is communicated with the first end of each path, and the other through hole is communicated with the second end of each path; and a working fluid located in the two paths.

title_en: Double-deck energy-conserving curtain of breathing type
abstract_en: The application relates to a double-layer breathing type energy-saving curtain wall, which comprises an inner wall and an outer wall which are connected with each other, and a water storage piece arranged between the outer wall and the inner wall, and install in the switch spare at interior wall top, one side of interior wall towards the outer wall is provided with the recess that holds that is used for holding the water storage spare, interior wall top is provided with the groove that slides that is used for holding the switch spare along the horizontal direction, the switch spare is including water swelling portion and setting portion, water swelling portion fixed connection is in the one side of sliding groove back to the outer wall, the bottom and the top in groove that slides hold recess and external world through the through-hole intercommunication of intaking respectively, be provided with the switch through-hole in the setting portion, water swelling portion absorbs water and promotes the setting portion in order to align switch through-hole and water inlet through-hole, water swelling portion loses water and pulls the setting portion in order to stagger switch through-hole and water inlet through-hole, be provided with a plurality of air inlet through-holes on the outer wall, the bottom of outer wall is provided with a plurality of air-out through-holes. This application has the outside heat in isolated house and to the effect of indoor cooling.

title_en: Building steel structure crossbeam that contains fire hazard prevention function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building steel structure crossbeam with a fire hazard prevention function, which comprises a crossbeam wall body, wherein a steel structure frame is arranged in the crossbeam wall body, a steel structure upright post is arranged in the steel structure frame, circulating water pipes connected through connecting water pipes are uniformly wound on the steel structure upright post, a fire prevention assembly comprises water pipe telescopic cavities which are symmetrically arranged in the crossbeam wall body and the steel structure frame from left to right and a fan blade telescopic cavity which is positioned at the side of the water pipe telescopic cavity far away from the steel structure upright post, water flows circulate in the circulating water pipes, the steel structure is cooled in summer, a heating pipe heats the circulating water pipes in winter, a lifting water pipe extends downwards out of the crossbeam to spray water when the temperature rises due to fire hazard, meanwhile, smoke induction fan blades extend downwards, and when smoke is large, the fan blades rotate quickly and the water.

title_en: Gas water heater control method, device and system and gas water heater
abstract_en: Before the gas water heater performs the cyclic heating operation, the main control device of the gas water heater can analyze the current state of the gas water heater according to a learning instruction sent by a user to obtain control parameters such as the rotating speed of a circulating water pump matched with the cyclic heating of the current gas water heater. And then when the user needs to perform cyclic heating, the main control device realizes the cyclic heating control operation of the gas water heater according to the control parameters. Through the scheme, the water pump is always in the maximum power running state when the gas water heater is heated circularly, so that energy waste is effectively avoided, less noise is generated, and the gas water heater has high circulating heating reliability and poor working reliability.

title_en: Air circulation type liquid collecting pool heat taking method
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of gas-water heat exchange, and provides an air circulation type liquid collecting pool heat-taking method, which comprises the following specific steps: step 1, arranging a heat exchange packed bed, and arranging a PVC (polyvinyl chloride) trickle packing layer on a liquid collecting tank; step 2, leaching the heat exchange packed bed, and uniformly leaching the ground immersion liquid on the heat exchange packed bed by using a liquid distribution water pump, a water suction port liquid supply pipe and a water distribution disc; step 3, performing first-time gas-water heat exchange, using a heat source tower as power, enabling low-temperature air to pass through a heat exchange packed bed, conducting shallow geothermal heat to circulating air through packing, and enabling the circulating air to enter an air pipe; step 4, performing secondary air-water heat exchange, and conveying the circulating air which absorbs heat sufficiently in the air pipe to a closed heat source tower by taking a booster fan as power; and 5, providing power by the primary intermediary water pump, and conducting heat in the primary intermediary water to the secondary intermediary water through the heat exchange coil. Therefore, the invention realizes the purpose of saving resources by utilizing the waste heat in the in-situ leaching uranium mining engineering.

title_en: Noise reduction structure of fan and range hood
abstract_en: The invention discloses a noise reduction structure of a fan and a range hood, wherein the fan is provided with a volute and comprises a flow guide device, a noise reduction device, a driving device and a control device, one end of the flow guide device is arranged on a volute tongue of the volute and used for collecting noise at the position of the volute tongue, the other end of the flow guide device extends along the circumferential direction of the volute, the flow guide device and the noise reduction device are movably connected together to define a noise reduction channel together, the driving device is arranged on the outer side of the volute, the noise reduction device is arranged on the volute in a sliding mode through the driving device, the driving device is electrically connected with the control device, and the driving device drives the noise reduction device to move relative to the flow guide device so as to achieve standing wave noise reduction of different frequencies. The noise reduction device is simple in structure, noise interference of the fan can be remarkably reduced, and therefore the noise reduction effect of the fan is further improved.

title_en: High-temperature thermochemical cycle energy storage system and method based on calcium-based adsorbent
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-temperature thermochemical cycle energy storage system and method based on a calcium-based adsorbent, which comprises a first reactor, a second reactor, a heating device, a saturated steam conveying device, a gas storage device and a steam generator, wherein the first reactor is connected with the second reactor through a pipeline; the interiors of the first reactor and the second reactor are respectively filled with fillers; the heating device continuously and alternately inputs high-temperature media into the first reactor and the second reactor and calcines the filler to obtain carbon dioxide, and the obtained carbon dioxide gas is conveyed into the gas storage device; the saturated steam conveying device continuously and alternately inputs saturated steam into the second reactor and the first reactor, and the gas storage device continuously and alternately inputs preheated carbon dioxide gas into the second reactor and the first reactor to obtain superheated steam; the first reactor and the second reactor continuously and alternately input superheated steam to the steam generator, and then the steam generator continuously generates electricity. The method can effectively solve the matching problem between the discontinuous energy storage and continuous energy release processes, and is suitable for the technical field of high-temperature energy storage.

title_en: Fresh air dehumidifying unit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fresh air dehumidifying unit, which comprises: the main casing body, apron and a plurality of installation piece, the main casing body apron and a plurality of the installation piece adopts the integrative injection moulding of elastic material respectively, be formed with a plurality of component installation spaces on the main casing body, it is a plurality of the installation piece sets up respectively in the component installation space, with correspond the component installation space forms jointly and treats the component mounting groove that the installation component corresponds, the apron with main casing body fixed connection, will the installation piece seal in inside the fresh air dehumidification unit. Through providing the main casing body and the fixed block that sets up on the main casing body, the fixed block can adopt the mode of pegging graft to fix the main casing body on, can realize the fixed block to the fixed of the inside spare part of unit, effectively support the spare part through the fixed block structure when guaranteeing unit casing rigidity, fixed effectual, reduced the use of connecting pieces such as screw, simple to operate uses manpower sparingly, save time.

title_en: Plate-shell type heat exchanger integrated with gas-liquid mixer and method and device system for treating organic wastewater by using plate-shell type heat exchanger
abstract_en: The invention discloses a plate-shell type heat exchanger integrated with a gas-liquid mixer, and a method and a device system for treating high-concentration organic wastewater by using the same. The heat exchanger of the invention is used for wastewater treatment, adopts full gas-liquid mixing and feeding, and has stable operation temperature and pressure, high heat exchange efficiency, low equipment investment and good organic wastewater treatment effect.

title_en: Denitration SCR catalyst supporting and hanging device based on graded modification of economizer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a denitration SCR catalyst supporting and hanging device based on graded modification of an economizer, which comprises an economizer hanging plate, an upper-level economizer, a lower-level economizer, a catalyst supporting main beam and a plurality of catalyst supporting secondary beams, wherein the lower-level economizer is arranged above the economizer hanging plate; the upper end of the coal economizer hanging plate is connected with a higher-level coal economizer, the lower end of the coal economizer hanging plate is connected with a lower-level coal economizer, the catalyst support main beam is positioned between the higher-level coal economizer and the lower-level coal economizer, the catalyst support main beam is connected with the middle of the coal economizer hanging plate, each catalyst support secondary beam is fixed on the catalyst support main beam, the catalyst modules are fixed on the catalyst support secondary beams, and each catalyst support secondary beam and the coal economizer hanging plate are distributed in parallel.

title_en: Mirror symmetry's water head control vibration loop heat pipe
abstract_en: The invention provides a loop heat pipe which comprises a middle evaporation pipe, a left collecting pipe, a right collecting pipe and a pipe group, wherein the pipe group comprises a left pipe group and a right pipe group, the left pipe group is communicated with the left collecting pipe and the middle evaporation pipe, the right pipe group is communicated with the right collecting pipe and the middle evaporation pipe, so that the middle evaporation pipe, the left collecting pipe, the right collecting pipe and the pipe group form a heating fluid closed cycle, a heat source is arranged in the middle evaporation pipe, a liquid level sensing element is arranged in the middle evaporation pipe and used for detecting the liquid level of fluid in the middle evaporation pipe, the liquid level sensing element is in data connection with a controller, the controller extracts liquid level data according to time sequence, the liquid level difference or the accumulation of the liquid level difference change is obtained through comparison of the liquid level data of adjacent time periods, and when the liquid level data is lower than. The loop heat pipe can judge whether the loop heat pipe reaches a stable state or not according to the internal liquid level difference or the accumulated liquid level difference, and then intelligently controls the heating of the heat source according to the internal pressure difference, so that the internal fluid can realize frequent vibration, and good descaling and heating effects are realized.

title_en: Fresh air equipment with air purification function
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fresh air equipment and discloses fresh air equipment with an air purification function, which comprises a fresh air box, wherein a filter element is arranged in the fresh air box, a fan is arranged in the fresh air box, air inlet pipes are fixedly communicated with two sides of the fresh air box close to the box top, one ends of the two air inlet pipes far away from the fresh air box are fixedly connected with a filter screen plate, a conversion mechanism is connected in the fresh air box and comprises a moving groove, a threaded rod, a threaded hole, a moving block, a fixed block, a supporting block, a rotating shaft, a first belt pulley, a second belt pulley, a through hole and a belt, the moving groove is formed in the inner box top of the fresh air box, two ends of the threaded rod are rotatably connected onto the groove wall of the moving groove through a first bearing, the first bearing is fixedly arranged on the groove. The double-air-inlet-pipe type air conditioner has the advantages that the double air inlet pipes are arranged, the filter screen plate can be cleaned under the condition that a fresh air fan is not closed, the use is more convenient, and the time and the labor are saved.

title_en: Temperature measurement cable for indirect air cooling system, intelligent online temperature measurement system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a temperature measurement cable for an indirect air cooling system, an intelligent online temperature measurement system and a method, wherein the intelligent online temperature measurement system comprises the following steps: the temperature measuring units are used for measuring temperature and are respectively arranged at different positions on the side of the return water pipe of the radiator; the temperature acquisition unit is used for acquiring a temperature signal of the temperature measurement unit; the signal conversion unit is used for converting the temperature signal acquired by the temperature acquisition unit; and the data processing unit is used for storing the temperature data converted by the signal conversion unit and analyzing, processing and alarming the temperature data. The invention can prevent the radiator of the indirect air cooling system from being frozen and improve the operation economy of the indirect air cooling system on the premise of ensuring safety; analyzing and judging the tightness of the closing of the louver of the indirect air cooling system; monitoring the states of the water filling and draining processes of the radiator, and preventing the situation that the water is accumulated in the radiator due to the blockage of a valve to cause freezing; the system has the function of optimizing and analyzing the running performance of an indirect air cooling system; meanwhile, real-time data interaction can be provided for the optimized operation of the unit.

title_en: Dust removal method of VD furnace under normal pressure
abstract_en: The invention relates to a dust removal method of a VD furnace under normal pressure, which is characterized in that a tee joint is additionally arranged on a vacuum pipeline, and a vacuum pipeline switching device and a dust removal pipeline switching device are used for connecting and sealing a vacuum tank with a vacuum pump system pipeline during vacuum treatment of molten steel, and connecting with a workshop ventilation dust removal system pipeline after vacuum is broken again for dust removal operation. Through the position change of the pipeline switching device and the auxiliary equipment, the smoke generated by the wire feeding can be completely pumped into a workshop ventilation and dust removal system. The invention solves the problem of environmental protection, improves the production efficiency and increases the income.

title_en: Two-stage compression refrigeration system, refrigeration control method and refrigeration equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-stage compression refrigeration system, a refrigeration control method and refrigeration equipment, wherein the two-stage compression refrigeration system comprises: the one-level compression unit, the second grade compression unit, the condenser, one-level throttling element, first evaporimeter and second evaporimeter that connect gradually, the gas vent of one-level compression unit passes through the induction port of intercooling tube coupling second grade compression unit, the exit linkage intercooling tube way of first evaporimeter, the induction port of the exit linkage one-level compression unit of second evaporimeter, first evaporimeter is connected with the switching module, the refrigerant flows through the condenser in proper order, throttling element and switching module, the switching module can switch and send into liquid refrigerant or gaseous refrigerant in the first evaporimeter. The invention can switch between different refrigeration demands, thereby effectively reducing the energy consumption of the system.

title_en: Push-and-pull open-type electric vehicle solar charging device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of charging devices, and discloses a push-pull open type electric vehicle solar charging device which comprises a charging pile, wherein a rotating mechanism is arranged on the upper side of the charging pile, a solar panel is attached to the left side surface and the right side surface of the rotating mechanism, a water collecting shell is fixedly connected to the left side surface and the right side surface of the charging pile, a water outlet is formed in the lower surface of the water collecting shell, a plurality of heat conducting rods are fixedly connected to the left side surface and the right side surface of the charging pile, and the heat. This scheme is through setting up slewing mechanism, utilizes the manual work to rotate the commentaries on classics board to make the commentaries on classics board drive first pivot and rotate, the rotation of utilizing first pivot can make the screw thread post rotate, the rotation of utilizing the screw thread post can make the screw cap drive the gyro wheel and reciprocate, thereby make the angle between two solar panel change, thereby make people can adjust solar panel to the optimum angle according to the difference that fills electric pile mounted position, solar panel's work efficiency has been improved.

title_en: Control method, device and equipment of air supply equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a control method, a control device, equipment and a storage medium of air supply equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: controlling the array type distance measuring sensor to emit light signals to the target air supply area and receiving reflected light signals reflected by the target air supply area; determining the outline information of a wind-receiving object in a target air supply area based on the reflected light signals received by the array type distance measuring sensors; determining the type of the wind-affected object based on the contour information of the wind-affected object; and determining the working mode of the air supply equipment based on the type of the wind-receiving object. Therefore, the array-type distance measuring sensors are controlled to emit light signals to the wind-receiving object, the plurality of distance measuring sensors on the array-type distance measuring sensors receive the light signals reflected by the wind-receiving object, the profile of the wind-receiving object is determined according to the characteristics of the received reflected light signals, and the type of the wind-receiving object is determined based on the profile of the wind-receiving object, so that the air supply equipment works in a matched working mode according to the type of the wind-receiving object, the intelligence of the air supply equipment is improved, and the air supply accuracy of the air supply equipment is also improved.

title_en: Modularized heat energy complex and method for heating mine air by using same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a modular thermal energy complex comprising at least one upper module, at least one lower module and at least one process module, each module comprising a support frame and at least one wall panel, all modules being connectable together. Each upper module contains a fuel supply system and a cold air duct, and each lower module contains a thermal assembly and a heat exchanger. In another aspect, the thermal assembly includes a combustion chamber having a fuel reservoir, an air blast system associated therewith, a secondary air blast system, and a recovery system. Furthermore, a cleaning system and a fume extraction system passing through the upper and lower modules are connected to the combustion chamber. The heat exchanger is connected to a hot gas line through the lower module and a cold gas line through the upper module. The thermal energy complex is controlled by an automatic control system in the process module. The invention is compact, simple to install and convenient to use. The multi-level purification of the flue gas reduces the harm to the health of the user. The combustion chamber uses solid fuel.

title_en: Electronic expansion valve control method and device of carbon dioxide heat pump
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a method and a device for controlling an electronic expansion valve of a carbon dioxide heat pump. According to the technical scheme, the proportional link Kp value is determined according to the exhaust deviation of the environmental temperature, the actual exhaust temperature and the target exhaust temperature, the set integral link Ki value is determined, the differential link Kd value is determined based on the deviation difference value of the current exhaust deviation and the last exhaust deviation, the opening degree of the expansion valve of the electronic expansion valve is calculated based on a PID algorithm according to the determined proportional link Kp value, the integral link Ki value and the differential link Kd value, the electronic expansion valve is adjusted and controlled according to the opening degree of the expansion valve, all environmental temperature working conditions in the unit operation range can adapt to, and the situation that the exhaust temperature or the exhaust pressure of the unit is too high is effectively reduced.

title_en: Air conditioner electric heating, method and device for controlling air conditioner electric heating and air conditioner
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of intelligent air conditioners and discloses an air conditioner electric heating method, an air conditioner electric heating device and an air conditioner. The method comprises the following steps: under the condition that the wing profile electric heating in the air conditioner is determined to be in rotating operation, acquiring current operation parameters of the wing profile electric heating at a current rotating position; and under the condition that the current operation parameters are determined to meet set conditions, controlling the electric heating to stop at the current rotation position, wherein the set conditions are matched with the current working mode of the air conditioner. Therefore, the position of the rotatable wing section for fixing and stopping the electric heating is determined according to the operation parameters corresponding to the working modes of the air conditioner, so that the electric heating in the air conditioner with different working modes can provide better effects, and the intelligence of the air conditioner is further improved.

title_en: Solar photovoltaic board angle conversion device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of photovoltaic electronic equipment, in particular to a solar photovoltaic panel angle conversion device, aiming at the problem that the existing device is difficult to rotate along with the sun by utilizing biological energy, the invention provides the following scheme. According to the invention, when the sunflowers grow towards the sun, the first direction sensor monitors position signals and transmits the signals to the control box, the control box processes the signals and sends an instruction to the first motor, and the first motor drives the mounting mechanism to rotate, so that the device rotates along with the sun in real time.

title_en: Electronic expansion valve control method and device and heat pump unit
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of heat pump control, and particularly relates to a method and a device for controlling an electronic expansion valve and a heat pump unit. The invention provides a control method of an electronic expansion valve, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining an ambient temperature TA, determining an initial opening degree of an electronic expansion valve according to the ambient temperature TA and a preset initial opening degree rule, then calculating air suction superheat degree deviation between a theoretical air suction superheat degree SH and a target air suction superheat degree SHT and an air suction superheat degree deviation change rate after the electronic expansion valve operates for a first preset time, and finally determining an opening degree adjustment quantity of the electronic expansion valve according to the superheat degree deviation, the superheat degree deviation change rate and a preset opening degree change table so that the electronic expansion valve can adjust the opening degree according to the opening degree adjustment quantity. The electronic expansion valve control method, the electronic expansion valve control device and the heat pump unit can enable the electronic expansion valve to be rapidly matched with the target opening after entering automatic adjustment, so that the opening adjustment efficiency of the electronic expansion valve is improved.

title_en: Coating composition for heat exchange tube, heat exchange tube and coating method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a coating composition for a heat exchange tube, a heat exchange tube and a coating method. Provided is a coating composition for a heat exchanging tube comprising vanadium (V), a flux and a binder, wherein the content of vanadium is 28 to 38 parts by weight relative to 100 parts by weight of the composition; and a coating method of a heat exchanging tube using the coating composition.

title_en: Steam generating device applied to wastewater zero-emission system of coal-fired power plant
abstract_en: The invention relates to a steam generating device applied to a wastewater zero-emission system of a coal-fired power plant, wherein a water outlet is formed in the bottom of the water supplementing tank, the water outlet is connected with an inlet of the steam generating device through a water supplementing pump, a flue gas inlet is formed in a shell of the steam generating device, the flue gas inlet is connected with an outlet of a booster fan through a pipeline, low-temperature flue gas at an outlet of the booster fan is led into the steam generating device, a first outlet of the steam generating device is connected with a flash evaporation device, a second outlet of the steam generating device is connected with a desulfurization absorption tower, the flash evaporation device comprises a flash evaporation tank, a superheated water outlet is connected with the flash evaporation tank through a pipeline, the top of the flash evaporation tank is connected with a vacuum pump, the flash evaporation tank is provided with a steam outlet, the steam outlet is connected with an evaporation concentration system through a steam compressor, and the water outlet of the evaporation concentration system is connected with the water supplementing tank through a pipeline.

title_en: Double-circulation heat-conducting oil steam superheating system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-circulation heat-conducting oil steam superheating system which comprises an electric heating heat-conducting oil furnace (10), a heat-conducting oil heat storage device (20) and an oil-steam heat exchanger (30) which are sequentially connected, wherein the electric heating heat-conducting oil furnace (10) comprises an electric heater (11), the oil-steam heat exchanger (30) is externally connected with a steam input pipeline (31) and a steam output pipeline (32), and heat-conducting oil in the oil-steam heat exchanger (30) can heat steam in the oil-steam heat exchanger (30). The double-circulation heat-conducting oil steam superheating system adopts a mode of heating saturated steam by a heat source combining electric heating and a heat-conducting oil medium: firstly, the conventional fuel combustion mode is replaced, and the pollutant emission is eliminated; secondly, a heat source system is simplified; thirdly, realizing accurate control of the steam temperature; fourthly, the energy utilization efficiency is improved.

title_en: Door control device of sintering furnace and sintering furnace
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a gate control device of a sintering furnace and the sintering furnace, wherein the gate control device of the sintering furnace comprises: the furnace door, the heat preservation door, the inner container door, the universal ring, the pin shaft thread sleeve mechanism, the buffer mechanism, the fan and the telescopic mechanism; a fan is horizontally arranged at the center of the furnace door, a universal ring mounting hole is formed in the highest point in the edge of the furnace door, a universal ring is mounted in the universal ring mounting hole through a fixing nut and is suspended in the furnace door, and the diameter of the nut is smaller than that of the universal ring mounting hole so that the universal ring can obtain swinging freedom; the heat preservation door is connected with the inner container door through a buffer mechanism; the universal ring is connected with the heat preservation door through a horizontally arranged pin shaft thread sleeve mechanism, and the pin shaft thread sleeve mechanism has circumferential freedom degree so that the universal ring can do circumferential motion relative to the pin shaft thread sleeve mechanism in the swinging process; the bottom of the universal ring is provided with a moving support, and the moving support is connected with a telescopic mechanism which is horizontally arranged. The equipment cost and the assembly difficulty are reduced.

title_en: Energy-saving stripping tower with temperature exchange function
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy-saving stripping tower with temperature exchange, which comprises a stripping tower assembly, wherein the stripping tower assembly comprises a stripping tower main body, a stripping tower exhaust pipe is fixedly connected above the stripping tower main body, an outer rib plate is fixedly connected to the outer surface of the stripping tower main body, a steam inlet flange is fixedly connected below the stripping tower main body, a rib plate threaded hole is formed in the outer surface of the outer rib plate, a vent hole is formed in one side of the outer rib plate, and a recovery pipe is fixedly connected above the stripping tower exhaust pipe. This take energy-saving strip tower of temperature exchange sets up through the cooperation of strip tower assembly, air-blower, heat preservation cotton and shrouding, makes this take energy-saving strip tower of temperature exchange possess the heat that the make full use of was retrieved and has kept out the effect that the heat runs off from the surface in the tower, through the setting of strip tower assembly, makes this take energy-saving strip tower of temperature exchange possess the light but the enough and effect of being convenient for the transportation of intensity of quality.

title_en: Ground source heat pump system
abstract_en: The invention provides a ground source heat pump system, which comprises a ground heat pump unit and a ground water network system, wherein the ground water network system comprises a hot water dam, a heat pipe exchanger, a turbine and a cold water dam which are sequentially connected through pipelines, and the ground heat pump unit comprises a circulation loop consisting of a heat exchanger, a compressor, a water-cooled condenser, a liquid reservoir and a throttle valve which are sequentially connected through pipelines; the water-cooled condenser comprises a cold water inlet and a hot water outlet, and water enters the water-cooled condenser through the cold water inlet and then flows out through the hot water outlet after absorbing heat. The invention utilizes the ground source heat pump system to treat the heat damage of the mine deep well, the ground source heat pump system is arranged in the mine deep well to utilize the terrestrial heat of the deep well, and the part of heat can be used for heating domestic water and can be converted into energy in other forms.

title_en: A intelligent degassing unit for infectious department
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent disinfection device for infectious department, which comprises a transfer device, a high-temperature disinfection box, a low-temperature disinfection box, a chemical disinfection box, a normal-temperature flushing box, a device packaging box, a display operation part and a program control center, wherein the high-temperature disinfection box, the low-temperature disinfection box and the chemical disinfection box are used for disinfecting devices to be disinfected; can set up multiple mode to different infection sources and carry out the pertinence disinfection, improve the disinfection effect to utilize program control transfer device to reach automatic effect, the disinfection is convenient high-efficient more.

title_en: Defrosting control method and device and multi-split air conditioner
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a defrosting control method and device and a multi-split air conditioner. The defrosting control method comprises the following steps: detecting whether each outdoor unit module in the multi-split air conditioner meets a preset defrosting condition; under the condition that any one outdoor unit module meets the preset defrosting condition, controlling the multi-split air conditioner to enter a continuous heating defrosting mode; sequentially detecting whether each external unit module in the multi-split system is in a frostless state currently according to the sequence of the priority levels of the external unit modules from large to small; if the ith outdoor unit module which is currently detected is currently in a frostless state, directly marking the ith outdoor unit module as that the defrosting is finished; if the ith outdoor unit module is in a frosted state currently, carrying out defrosting treatment on the ith outdoor unit module, and marking the ith outdoor unit module as being finished after the defrosting treatment is finished; and under the condition that all the outdoor unit modules are marked as defrosting completed, controlling the multi-split air conditioner to exit the continuous heating defrosting mode. The defrosting time can be effectively shortened.

title_en: Shell-and-tube heat exchanger with composite tube sheet
abstract_en: A shell-and-tube heat exchanger assembly is disclosed having a first tube sheet configured for securing to a shell of the shell-and-tube heat exchanger assembly, the first tube sheet comprising a first section and a second section, the second section configured to be secured to a first shell end of the shell, and the first section comprising a plurality of holes configured to support a corresponding plurality of aluminum tubes extending through the shell, wherein the first section is configured to limit a current response of the plurality of aluminum tubes when exposed to cooling water.

title_en: Refrigerating system and temperature control system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of semiconductor manufacturing, in particular to a refrigerating system and a temperature control system. Through increasing first heat exchanger to increase the subcooling degree, increase the refrigerating output, increase the superheat degree, reduce the compressor and return liquid, improve compressor reliability.

title_en: Wire passing cover and air conditioner
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wire passing cover and an air conditioner, comprising an end cover body, a second cover plate and a first cover plate, wherein a wire passing hole is formed in the end cover body, the second cover plate is detachably arranged on one side of the end cover body, a second clamping part is arranged on the end face, facing the end cover body, of the second cover plate, and the second clamping part is connected with the wire passing hole. The problem of current casing trompil make insect and foreign matter get into the air conditioner from the trompil and have the hidden danger of quality under the condition of not threading or poling is solved.

title_en: Chemical hydrogen production system and hydrogen production method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a chemical hydrogen production system and a hydrogen production method, wherein the hydrogen production system comprises: a feeding unit: comprises a solid material feeding subunit and a water feeding subunit; a reactor: the device comprises a heat insulation sleeve and an inner container, wherein the heat insulation sleeve is fixed outside the inner container, the inner container is connected with a feeding unit, and a catalyst is placed in the inner container; a drying unit: is connected with a gas outlet of the reactor and is used for drying the hydrogen; a hydrogen storage unit: connected with the drying unit and used for storing the dried hydrogen or providing the hydrogen to the outside; a purging unit: the device comprises a vacuumizing unit and a feeding bin purging unit, wherein the vacuumizing unit is connected with a hydrogen storage unit and is used for vacuumizing the reactor, the drying unit and the hydrogen storage unit; the feeding bin purging unit is connected with the hydrogen storage unit and used for purging the solid material feeding subunit. The invention can generate hydrogen and a large amount of heat, realizes heat and hydrogen combined supply and has high safety.

title_en: Thermal control cabinet convenient to remove
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of accessories of a thermal control system, in particular to a thermal control cabinet convenient to move, which can remove snow accumulated on a control cabinet body in time; the control cabinet body can be leveled; the universal wheel type control cabinet comprises a control cabinet body and four groups of universal wheels, wherein a display screen and a plurality of groups of keys are arranged in the upper half area of the front side wall of the control cabinet body; the left reciprocating telescopic motor and the right reciprocating telescopic motor are respectively provided with a left output shaft and a right output shaft at the top output ends; the universal wheel brake device further comprises a bottom plate, four groups of threaded pipes, four groups of threaded rods and four groups of support plates, wherein the four groups of universal wheels are provided with brake plates.

title_en: Modular air energy water heater water tank
abstract_en: The invention relates to a modular air energy water heater water tank, which comprises an outer barrel, an inner container and a coil pipe, wherein the inner container is arranged in the outer barrel, the coil pipe is arranged in the inner container, a refrigerant flows in the coil pipe, pipe orifices at two ends of the coil pipe are fixedly provided with a quick connector, the upper end of the quick connector extends out of the outer barrel, the inner container comprises an inner container barrel and an inner container upper cover arranged above the inner container barrel, the inner container upper cover is provided with two limiting pipes, the limiting pipes extend out of the inner container upper cover, the limiting pipes are coaxially provided with through holes for the quick connector to pass through, and the quick connector is fixedly arranged on the limiting pipes. The limiting pipe is arranged to limit the position of the coil pipe, the universality of the water tank is enhanced, the research and development, production and management costs are reduced, the quick structure is connected at the pipe orifice of the coil pipe, the pipeline connection is convenient, and the production efficiency of the water tank is improved.

title_en: Compression-assisted regeneration adsorption refrigeration system for refrigeration transportation
abstract_en: The invention relates to an adsorption refrigeration system for compression-assisted regeneration of refrigerated transport, comprising a compressor (6), a condenser (2), an expansion valve (3), and an evaporator (4), two identical adsorption beds: an adsorption bed a (101), an adsorption bed b (102), a cooler (5) and a four-way valve (7); the adsorption bed a (101), the adsorption bed b (102), the cooler (5) and the evaporator (4) are respectively connected with a four-way valve (7), and the outlet of the cooler (5) is sequentially connected with the compressor (6), the condenser (2), the expansion valve (3) and the evaporator (4). Compared with the prior art, the refrigeration capacity requirement of the refrigerator car can be efficiently met by recovering the waste heat of the water of the engine cylinder sleeve, the power consumption of the compressor is reduced, the energy efficiency is obviously improved, the refrigeration transportation cost and the environmental pollution are finally reduced, and the energy conservation and emission reduction are realized.

title_en: Fault detection and positioning method for centralized smoke exhaust system of building
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fault detection and positioning method of a building centralized smoke exhaust system, wherein the building centralized smoke exhaust system comprises an indoor smoke exhaust ventilator, an outdoor host system of a public flue and a cloud server, and the method is characterized in that the building centralized smoke exhaust system carries out fault detection and positioning by the following steps: step 1, powering on any indoor range hood, and awakening a centralized smoke exhaust system of a building; step 2, the indoor range hood which is powered on sends the running state information of the indoor range hood to a cloud server directly or through an outdoor host system; step 3, the cloud server analyzes and positions the fault according to the floor position information and the running state information of the indoor range hood; and sends the location information of the failed floor and the service priority to the maintenance service personnel. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages that: the problem of among the prior art indoor suction lampblack absorber fault detection slow, inefficiency, inconvenient inspection etc is solved.

title_en: Fresh air system, container building group and cooling method
abstract_en: The invention provides a fresh air system, a container building group and a cooling method, relates to the technical field of air conditioners, and solves the technical problem that condensed water of an air conditioner is directly discharged and wasted. The fresh air system comprises a cooling chamber, a water storage structure, an air inlet, an air outlet, a cooling assembly, a first water pumping assembly, a second water pumping assembly and an air supply assembly, wherein the water storage structure is arranged in the cooling chamber and connected with an air conditioning system to collect condensed water; the first water pumping assembly and the second water pumping assembly are selected to operate. The invention reuses the condensed water, humidifies the air in the dry container, carries out current conversion ventilation and refrigeration in the room, and solves the problem of waste of the condensed water in the container community.

title_en: Spiral coil pipe type phase change heat storage device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a spiral coil type phase change heat storage device, which comprises: a protective housing having an interior cavity; the heat preservation layer is arranged in the protective shell and comprises an inner container arranged at an interval with the protective shell and a heat preservation material arranged between the protective shell and the inner container; the spiral coil type heat exchange tube is arranged in the cavity of the protective shell; a plurality of rows of electric heating elements, wherein each row is positioned between every two heat exchange coil pipes, each row comprises the electric heating elements which are uniformly distributed in a multi-layer manner from top to bottom, and each electric heating element is horizontally arranged; and the phase change material is filled in the protective shell and outside the spiral coil type heat exchange tube. The problem of current multilayer coil pipe series connection flow resistance too big is solved.

title_en: Humidity-adjusting gas generator
abstract_en: The present invention provides an improvement of a humidity control gas generating device which is applicable to a semiconductor manufacturing process. The humidity-controlling gas generating apparatus 1 includes: a saturation tank body 2 including a gas region G and a water storage region W located below the gas region G; and a gas reflux device 4 disposed inside the saturating tank main body 2. The gas recirculation apparatus 4 includes a gas return pipe 40, a gas delivery pipe 41, a drain pipe 42, and a collection tank 43. The gas return pipe 40 passes through the water storage area W from the gas inlet 40a disposed in the gas area G to the gas outlet 40b disposed in the collection tank 43. The gas delivery pipe 41 reaches a gas delivery port 41b disposed outside the saturation tank body 2 from a gas delivery port 41a disposed in the collection tank 43. The drain pipe 42 extends from a water inlet 42a disposed in the collection tank (43) to a water outlet 42b disposed outside the saturation tank main body 2.

title_en: Based on CO2Flash evaporation system of mixed refrigerant
abstract_en: Based on CO 2 The flash evaporation system of mixed refrigerant, comprising: flash vessel, evaporimeter, regenerator, compressor and the air cooler that closed loop connects in proper order to and five control valve members, wherein: the liquid phase output end of the flash evaporator is connected with the input end of the evaporator, the output end of the evaporator is connected with the low-pressure input end of the heat regenerator through the first stop valve, the low-pressure output end of the heat regenerator and the input end of the compressor are sequentially connected with the compressor and the air cooler, the output end of the air cooler is connected with the two-phase input end of the flash evaporator through the high-pressure input end of the heat regenerator, the high-pressure output end of the heat regenerator and the first needle valve, and the gas phase output end of the flash evaporator is connected with the compressor through the second needle valve, the third stop valve and the second stop valve. The invention adopts a CO-based method 2 The mixed refrigerant is used as a circulating refrigeration working medium, so that the greenhouse effect and the damage to the ozone layer are reduced; the flash evaporator is adopted, so that the dryness of the refrigerant entering the evaporator is reduced, the capacity of the evaporator is fully utilized, the refrigeration efficiency is improved, and the needle valve accurately adjusts the flow of the steam bypass branch so as to adjust the refrigeration capacity.

title_en: Power wheel with U-shaped liquid seal pipe
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power wheel with a U-shaped liquid seal pipe. The invention relates to a machine device of a mechanical power system. The power wheel with the U-shaped liquid seal pipe is mainly characterized by comprising a power ring, the liquid seal pipe, support spokes and a connecting ring, wherein the connecting ring is a hollow circular ring, the liquid seal pipe is formed by the U-shaped pipe, when the corner of the U-shaped pipe faces downwards, liquid can be stored at the corner position so as to prevent gas from flowing, and the power ring is formed by connecting a plurality of sealing cylinders back and forth. The engine uses solar energy as energy, and has the advantages of higher working efficiency, more complete structure and less heat loss.

title_en: Double-layer coated zinc cathode, preparation method thereof, zinc-air battery and direct current water heater
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of electric water heaters, and discloses a zinc cathode for a zinc-air battery, which is a porous felt body constructed by composite fiber yarns; the composite fiber wire comprises a carbon fiber core, a zinc oxide coating inner layer and a porous carbon coating outer layer. The zinc cathode of the porous felt body in the embodiment of the disclosure is a double-layer coated carbon fiber felt in which a carbon fiber core is coated with zinc oxide and porous carbon. The outer porous carbon coating layer is coated outside the inner zinc oxide coating layer, so that the falling of the negative active material can be prevented, the long-term maintenance-free charging and discharging of the zinc-air battery can be realized, and the maintenance cost can be reduced. And the pores on the porous carbon layer can enable electrolyte to enter and contact with the zinc oxide coating inner layer, so that the electrode reaction is ensured. Also discloses a preparation method of the zinc cathode, a zinc-air battery comprising the zinc cathode, and a direct current water heater.

title_en: Ultrathin heat pipe with bionic liquid absorption core
abstract_en: The invention provides an ultrathin heat pipe with a bionic wick, which comprises an evaporation section, a heat insulation section and a condensation section which are connected in sequence; the evaporation section comprises an evaporation pipe body and an evaporation liquid absorption core; a plurality of hydrophobic micro-nano small holes are distributed in the evaporation liquid absorption core; the inner wall of the evaporation tube body is provided with a cavity; the wall and the edge of each hydrophobic micro-nano small hole and the surface of the cavity are covered with a hydrophobic film; the surface of the hydrophobic film is uniformly and densely distributed with super-hydrophobic nucleation pits; the condensation section comprises a condensation pipe body and a condensation liquid absorption core; the condensation liquid absorption core is provided with a plurality of hydrophilic micro-nano small holes; the wall and the edge of each hydrophilic micro-nano pore and the inner wall of the condensation pipe body are covered with a hydrophilic film; the surface of the hydrophilic film is uniformly and densely distributed with super-hydrophilic nucleation convex points; the super-hydrophobic nucleation pit is in an inverted cone shape; the super-hydrophilic nucleation convex points are cylindrical. The heat pipe improves the heat exchange performance by improving the phase change heat exchange capacity, and realizes light weight and compactness.

title_en: Smoke guide plate reinforcing device for steaming and baking integrated stove and mounting method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a smoke guide plate reinforcing device for a steaming and baking integrated stove and an installation method thereof, and the smoke guide plate reinforcing device comprises a top reinforcing structure arranged on the top surface of a smoke guide plate, wherein the top reinforcing structure comprises a reinforcing frame, a reinforcing seat and a connecting assembly; the method comprises the following steps: a. preparing before installation; b. mounting a support component; c. mounting a top reinforcing structure; d. and (5) installing decorative panels. According to the invention, the top reinforcing structure is arranged on the top of the smoke guide plate, the reinforcing frame is firstly fixed on the top surface of the smoke guide plate, then the reinforcing seat is arranged on the top of the integrated stove, and then one end of the connecting component is fixed with the reinforcing seat, so that the connection integrity between the integrated stove and the smoke guide plate is improved, and the connection stability between the integrated stove and the smoke guide plate is improved.

title_en: Negative pressure type distillation system and distillation process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a negative pressure type distillation system, which comprises a raw material box, a negative pressure evaporation and concentration chamber, a heat recovery device and a condensate tank, wherein the raw material box is connected with the negative pressure evaporation and concentration chamber; the raw material box is connected with the negative pressure evaporation concentration chamber through a feeding pump and a liquid supplementing pipe; the heat recovery device forms a circulating heating loop with the negative pressure evaporation concentration chamber through a heating circulating pump and a circulating temperature rising pipe; the negative pressure evaporation concentration chamber is connected with the heat recovery device through a steam pipe; the heat recovery device is connected with the condensate tank through a back-stage plate exchanger and a steam pipe; steam generated by the negative pressure evaporation concentration chamber enters the heat recovery device through a steam pipe; the steam enters the condensate tank through the back-stage plate and the steam pipe after absorbing heat energy by the heat recovery device; the negative pressure evaporation concentration chamber is connected with the solid-liquid separation device through a discharge water pump and a crystallization transfer pipe; the invention fully recycles most energy of the steam, reduces energy waste and has good energy-saving and environment-friendly effects; the negative pressure type distillation system has low manufacturing cost, reduces the production cost and has higher distillation efficiency.

title_en: Sintering furnace based on alloy smelting and cooling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sintering furnace and a cooling method based on alloy smelting, comprising a base plate, wherein the left side of the top of the base plate is fixedly connected with a supporting plate, the right side of the supporting plate is fixedly connected with a transverse plate, the right side of the transverse plate is fixedly connected with a case, the top of the case is provided with a sintering furnace body, and the right side of the bottom of the sintering furnace body is communicated with a drain pipe. According to the invention, the water spraying pipe is arranged to cool the material storage sleeve, and the material storage sleeve is used for cooling the raw materials in the material storage sleeve, so that the effect of rapidly cooling the alloy is achieved, the problem that the existing alloy smelting sintering furnace cannot rapidly cool the alloy is solved, and the alloy smelting-based sintering furnace and cooling method have the advantages of rapidly cooling the alloy, and a user does not need to cool the alloy naturally or through some cooling equipment during cooling, so that a certain processing time is saved, and the production efficiency is improved.

title_en: Children mask forming die
abstract_en: The application discloses a children mask forming die which comprises a die base, a cover plate and a refrigerating system, wherein a female die is arranged on the die base, and a male die is arranged on the cover plate; a cooling pipeline is embedded in the mold base and is positioned on the inner side of the female mold; the cooling pipeline is connected with a cooling medium inlet pipe and a cooling medium outlet pipe, and the cooling medium inlet pipe and the cooling medium outlet pipe are both arranged on one side wall of the mold base; the cooling medium inlet pipe and the cooling medium outlet pipe are both fixedly connected with joint nuts; the cooling medium inlet pipe and the cooling medium outlet pipe are connected with a refrigeration system through the joint nut. This application has buried cooling line underground in the mould base, and the cryogenic cooling medium that refrigerating system produced when the cooling line, can take away the heat of the inside customization conjuncted polymer of die, makes its temperature descend rapidly to make conjuncted polymer cooling condense rapid shaping, improved the efficiency of moulding plastics, shortened the preparation cycle, satisfied the demand in market.

title_en: Range hood with automatic oil stain cleaning function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a range hood with an automatic oil stain cleaning function, wherein a second water storage tank is also arranged in a groove at the top of an oil smoke collecting part, and a water inlet pipe and a water outlet pipe are respectively arranged on the second water storage tank; still be equipped with first storage water tank in the second storage water tank, one side of first storage water tank is equipped with the connector, be equipped with first shutoff pipe on the opposite side, still be equipped with the shutoff board in the first storage water tank, still the cover is equipped with the movable pipe on the inlet tube, movable pipe one end is located the oil smoke collection portion outside, the other end inserts to the second storage water tank in, still be equipped with fixed pipe on the end of movable pipe, still be equipped with flexible pipe on the terminal surface of fixed pipe, flexible pipe still is equipped with the second shutoff pipe on the terminal surface of first storage water tank direction, still be equipped with a plurality of through-holes on the circumference outer wall of movable pipe. When the oil stain on the separating disc is absorbed, the separating disc can be quickly cleaned without being detached from the range hood, and the cleaning efficiency of the separating disc is improved.

title_en: Intelligent household ventilation device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent household ventilation device, which comprises a box body, a driving device, an air outlet device, an air inlet device, a clamping mechanism, a first air box, a second air box, an installation box and a controller, wherein the top of the inner wall of the box body is arranged on the first air box, the bottom of the inner wall of the box body is provided with the second air box, the installation box is arranged between the first air box and the second air box, the driving device is arranged at the position, corresponding to the installation box, of the outer wall at one side of the box body, the air inlet device is arranged at the upper part of the installation box, the air outlet device is arranged at the lower part of the installation box, the clamping mechanism capable of adjusting the angle is arranged at the outer wall at one side of the box body, away from the driving device, the controller is fixedly arranged on the outer wall at the top of the box body, and the controller is electrically connected with, the gas flow is facilitated, and the application range is wider and more practical.

title_en: Constant temperature and humidity unit and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a constant temperature and humidity unit and a control method thereof. Wherein, the method comprises the following steps: acquiring indoor temperature and indoor humidity; controlling the electromagnetic valve in the constant temperature and humidity unit to be switched on or off based on the indoor temperature and the indoor humidity; wherein, constant temperature and humidity unit includes: a main circuit and a reheat circuit, the main circuit including: compressor, cross valve, outdoor heat exchanger, first electronic expansion valve and the indoor heat exchanger that connects gradually, the reheat circuit includes: the indoor heat exchanger comprises a reheating condenser and a second electronic expansion valve which are sequentially connected, wherein the second electronic expansion valve is connected with the indoor heat exchanger, and the solenoid valve is connected between the four-way valve and the reheating condenser. The invention solves the technical problems of more energy consumption and lower resource utilization rate of the constant temperature and humidity unit in the related technology.

title_en: Vertical fire tube waste heat boiler
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of waste heat recovery, in particular to a vertical fire tube waste heat boiler which comprises an outer packaging shell, wherein the bottom end inside the outer packaging shell is provided with a base, the outer side wall of the base is regularly provided with a plurality of smoke inlets, smoke outlets and ash removal ports, the top end of the base is provided with a large cylinder, the lower end of the outer side of the large cylinder is provided with a water inlet, the middle of the top end inside the large cylinder is provided with a small cylinder, a plurality of first convection tube bundles are regularly arranged between the side wall of the small cylinder and the position, close to the outer edge, of the bottom plate of the large cylinder, a plurality of second convection tube bundles are regularly arranged between the bottom plate of the small cylinder and the position, close to the.
