The invention has the advantages of small design volume, compact structure, low investment, low use and maintenance cost, good heat preservation effect, low heat energy loss, improvement of waste heat utilization rate, reduction of exhaust gas temperature, environmental protection, energy conservation and improvement of the safety performance of the boiler, and can improve the heat exchange efficiency of the boiler.

title_en: Ultrasonic defrosting mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultrasonic defrosting mechanism which comprises an evaporator body, a liquid containing box, an ultrasonic generator and brushes, wherein the liquid containing box is arranged below the vertically arranged evaporator body of a refrigerator, the side surface of the liquid containing box is connected with a movable fixing assembly used for being connected with the refrigerator, the top end of the liquid containing box is welded with a group of vertically arranged linear reciprocating motors, the side surface of a moving part of each linear reciprocating motor is connected with an adjusting assembly, the side surface of each adjusting assembly is welded with a square-shaped supporting frame, the supporting frames are sleeved on the periphery of the evaporator body, two groups of symmetrically arranged vertical inner walls of the supporting frames are connected with two groups of brushes through a plurality of groups of screws, the two groups of brushes are arranged in parallel, the two groups of brushes are respectively arranged on two sides of the evaporator body, and the top end of each linear reciprocating motor is welded with a top plate. The ultrasonic defrosting mechanism not only has the function of cleaning frost and ice, but also has the function of receiving the frost and the ice.

title_en: Combined sleeve pipe winding pipe type heat exchanger
abstract_en: The invention discloses a combined sleeve pipe wound tube type heat exchanger used in the fields of petrochemical industry, pharmacy, nuclear energy, LNG industry and the like, wherein a metal layer net is adopted to wrap the heat exchange combined sleeve pipe, the processing workload of a winding pipe bundle lead can be reduced on the premise of maintaining a certain heat exchange area, meanwhile, a metal net layer can greatly increase the specific surface area, and meanwhile, the retention time of fluid in a shell pass cavity is longer, so that the heat exchange is more sufficient.

title_en: Phase-change heat storage device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a phase-change heat storage device, which comprises an energy storage unit, a turbulent flow unit and a fluid transportation channel, wherein the energy storage unit is composed of a heat insulation material, a shell, a Hilbert curve-shaped metal framework and a phase-change material: the heat insulation material is wrapped on the outer side of the shell; the metal frameworks in the Hilbert curve configuration are uniformly distributed in the shell; the phase-change material is uniformly filled between the shell and the metal framework with the Hilbert curve configuration; the turbulence bodies are uniformly attached to one side of the fluid of the metal framework with the Hilbert curve configuration according to the array, each turbulence body consists of a turbulence column and a bottom plate, and the turbulence columns are distributed according to the Sierpinski blanket fractal and the cantor set fractal; the fractal order of the Sierpinski blanket is equal to that of the cantor set; the fluid transport channel consists of a divergent inlet, a heat exchange channel and a convergent outlet. The invention can effectively enlarge the heat exchange area between the fluid and the phase-change material, so that the temperature distribution is uniform, the fluid turbulence is increased, the heat transfer efficiency is improved, and the heat storage or heat release is carried out quickly and efficiently.

title_en: Energy-saving and environment-friendly device for working by utilizing water flow impact force ground source heat pump pipeline
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ground source heat pumps, and discloses an energy-saving and environment-friendly device for working by utilizing water flow impact force of a ground source heat pump pipeline, which comprises a rotating blade, the rotating blade is connected with an automatic scale outlet mechanism and an automatic collection anti-clogging mechanism, when the local source heat pump works, the water flow in the rotating blade circulates, at the moment, the impact force of the water flow drives the rotating blades to rotate, the rotating blades rotate to drive the rotating central block to rotate, the rotation of the rotating central block stretches the centrifugal spring under the action of centrifugal force, thereby causing the centrifugal block to move outwards, the outward movement of the centrifugal block drives the connecting wheel to move downwards, thereby drive scale removal drill bit also downstream, even carry out abundant incrustation scale of rejecting to the pipe wall, incrustation scale that rejects is broken owing to the rotation of broken commentaries on classics leaf when the incrustation scale that rejects passes through broken commentaries on classics leaf to reach the automatic incrustation scale that peels off on the pipeline and carry out broken function.

title_en: Pet water dispenser with dehumidification function
abstract_en: The invention relates to a pet water dispenser with a dehumidification function, which comprises a bottom plate provided with a communicating vessel, wherein a base is arranged on the bottom plate, a small water tank is arranged on the communicating vessel, a low water table is arranged on the small water tank, a large water tank with the dehumidification function is arranged on the base, the pet water dispenser also comprises a water column button mechanism and a cover plate provided with a high water table, the high water table enables a pet to drink water comfortably, and the high water table can be externally connected with decorative parts such as a mushroom spray head and the; a liquid level sensor is arranged on the outer surface of the small water tank communicating vessel and used for sending water replenishing signals to the double-output power water pump in the large water tank; the invention has the water outlet modes of water column water outlet, waterfall water outlet and spring eye water outlet, and can also be provided with the LED lamp strip to attract pets; the large water tank is provided with a semiconductor condensation plate, a heat dissipation device, a liquid level sensor and three single-hole output submersible pumps, so that moisture in air can be liquefied, and the liquefied water is filtered by the filter element assembly and then is drunk by pets while the dehumidification function is realized, so that the water is saved; the invention can effectively dehumidify under the condition of ensuring beautiful appearance, convenient disassembly and cleaning.

title_en: Liquid distributor, falling film type heat exchanger and air conditioner
abstract_en: The invention provides a liquid distributor, a falling film type heat exchanger and an air conditioner. The liquid distributor comprises a liquid distribution cavity, wherein the liquid distribution cavity at least comprises an inner cavity and an outer cavity, the inner cavity is arranged in the outer cavity, and the inner cavity is provided with a feed inlet; the bottom of the inner cavity is provided with a first overflow hole, and the side part of the inner cavity is provided with a first exhaust hole; the bottom of the outer cavity is provided with a second overflow hole, and the side part of the outer cavity is provided with a second exhaust hole. The gas-liquid two-phase reagent naturally flows in layers in the two-layer liquid distribution cavity due to density difference, is discharged through the exhaust hole and the overflow hole respectively, and realizes gas-liquid separation in the liquid distribution cavity, so that the interference of gas phase to liquid phase uniform distribution is reduced, and the uniformity of liquid distribution is improved.

title_en: Preparation method of crucible for vacuum induction melting furnace
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a crucible for a vacuum induction melting furnace. The crucible ramming process of the method comprises the following steps: knotting the bottom of a crucible by adopting a refractory material at the bottom in an induction coil in a vacuum induction smelting furnace, and scraping the refractory material on the upper surface of the crucible bottom; placing a mold core which is manufactured by taking the size of an inner cavity of a crucible as the overall dimension centrally on the bottom of the crucible, and then feeding and tamping layer by layer to form a crucible wall; adding a layer of refractory material with the thickness of 5-10 cm into a cavity between a mold core and an induction coil, tamping the refractory material by using a vibrator, scratching the upper part of the refractory material by 1-3 cm, and adding the next layer of refractory material; preparing a crucible mouth above the crucible wall by using a prefabricated forming brick; or placing the refractory material uniformly mixed with water at a preset position of the crucible mouth above the crucible wall, tamping the refractory material and shaping the crucible mouth. The crucible is uniform in wall thickness at all positions and is tightly connected between layers.

title_en: Heating device for building
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of building heat preservation, in particular to a heating device for a building, which comprises a wall body, an air bag layer is arranged outside the wall body and comprises a plurality of air bag units with the same structure, the air bag unit is provided with an extension pipe communicated with the air bag unit, the wall body is provided with a through hole for the extension pipe to pass through, a cavity is arranged in the wall body to form a structure that the heat absorbed by the air bag layer is transferred to the interior of the wall body through the extension pipe, the invention discloses a solar energy heating system, which is characterized in that a valve for opening or closing is arranged at one end, far away from an air bag unit, of an extension pipe, and a heating plate is arranged at one end, far away from the air bag unit, of a cavity, so that the problem that the temperature requirement of people and the resource use in the heating process cannot be met by sunlight irradiation in cold areas, particularly rural self-built houses in the prior art under the condition of good weather is solved.

title_en: Air conditioner and control method
abstract_en: The invention provides an air conditioner. An air conditioner (100) is provided with an indoor unit (20) and an outdoor unit (30). The outdoor unit (30) is provided with an outdoor heat exchanger (8) and an outdoor fan (10) that sends air to the outdoor heat exchanger (8). The air conditioner (100) is further provided with a control unit K (37) for controlling the outdoor fan (10). The control unit K (37) controls the defrosting operation to be started in response to the first condition being satisfied during the heating operation, and controls the outdoor fan to be rotated in the reverse direction in response to the second condition being satisfied before the defrosting operation is started.

title_en: Air conditioner air-out adjusting device and air conditioner with lower air-out
abstract_en: The invention provides an air conditioner air outlet adjusting device and a lower air outlet air conditioner. The device includes: the air outlet device comprises a mounting plate, a shell, an air outlet body and a first driving mechanism; the mounting plate is provided with a first through hole, and a slide way is arranged around the first through hole; the shell is inserted into the slideway, an opening is formed in one end, close to the mounting plate, of the shell, the air outlet body is mounted at one end, far away from the mounting plate, of the shell, and the air outlet body is provided with a plurality of air outlet holes; the first driving mechanism is in transmission connection with the shell and is used for driving the shell to move along the slide way; the first driving mechanism comprises a first rotating motor, a gear and a rack; first rotating electrical machines is fixed in the outside of slide, and casing or slide inner wall are equipped with first recess, and the rack is installed in the cell wall of first recess, and the gear hold in first recess and with rack toothing, first rotating electrical machines's drive shaft and gear fixed connection prevent that hot-blast come-up from piling up and causing the cold and hot inequality of indoor environment above indoor environment, improve the result of use of air conditioner, increase the comfort level.

title_en: Air treatment equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses air treatment equipment, which comprises a machine shell, an ultraviolet light catalytic sterilization module and an ultraviolet light sterilization module, wherein the machine shell is provided with an air inlet, an air outlet, an air supply channel and a mounting hole; the ultraviolet light catalytic sterilization module is arranged in the air supply channel and comprises a photocatalytic structure facing the mounting hole; the ultraviolet sterilization module comprises a first ultraviolet lamp and a driver, wherein the first ultraviolet lamp and the driver are movably arranged in the mounting hole, the first ultraviolet lamp is provided with a light-emitting side and a first position and a second position, the first position is movable to the light-emitting side and faces outwards, and the second position is arranged at the light-emitting side and faces towards the photocatalytic structure. In the invention, the whole machine at least has two disinfection modes of ultraviolet light catalytic sterilization and ultraviolet light sterilization; when the first ultraviolet lamp is at the first position, the surface of an object in the environment can be sterilized and disinfected; when the first ultraviolet lamp moves to the second position, the ultraviolet lamp can be prevented from irradiating a user, the ultraviolet catalytic sterilization function can be enabled or enhanced, the coexistence of man-machine and the enhancement of the relevance between two sterilization modes can be realized.

title_en: Novel ventilation of dry coal canopy enclosed construction of steel presses down dirt device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ventilation and dust suppression device of a novel steel dry coal shed sealing structure, which is characterized in that a leveling steel pier is arranged, and the bottom of the leveling steel pier is matched with the top of a coal shed in a shaping manner, so that the ventilation and dust suppression device can be horizontally arranged at the top of the coal shed; simultaneously through setting up the shaped steel basis, play the supporting role between ventilator and the steel mound of making level, form the air intake of ventilation dust suppression device between the shaped steel basis and seek to level between the steel mound, wherein pass through bolted connection between ventilator base, shaped steel basis and the steel mound of seeking to level, the on-the-spot welding work volume that has significantly reduced not only is convenient for the on-the-spot installation but also is convenient for the maintenance and the change in later stage. The ventilation dust suppression device has a simple structure, is easy to install and replace, reduces the field construction strength and workload, can realize the exchange of the air inside the coal shed and the outside air, meets the ventilation requirement inside the coal shed, can smoothly discharge the heat generated by mechanical operation along with the air flow, and ensures the quality of coal.

title_en: Kitchen energy-saving system based on thermoelectric conversion
abstract_en: The invention provides a kitchen energy-saving system based on thermoelectric conversion, which comprises a storage battery and four groups of waste heat collecting and thermoelectric conversion devices arranged on the periphery of a combustion chamber, wherein each group of waste heat collecting and thermoelectric conversion devices comprises a heat collecting plate, a thermoelectric module group and a cooling plate; the thermoelectric module group comprises a plurality of thermoelectric modules which are connected in series and used for thermoelectric conversion; the cooling plate is attached to the cold end of the thermoelectric module group; all the thermoelectric module groups are respectively connected with the storage battery through wires, and the storage battery stores the electric energy converted by the thermoelectric module groups and supplies power to the load. The invention collects most of the waste heat in the gas water heater, converts the waste heat into electric energy by utilizing the thermoelectric effect, and stores the electric energy into the electric power storage module to supply power for other small-sized electric appliances in a kitchen.

title_en: Spliced modularized movable kitchen
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of outdoor mobile kitchens, in particular to a spliced modularized movable kitchen, which aims at the problems that sewage generated by the existing kitchen is discharged at will, the environment is polluted, oil smoke generated by cooking food is directly discharged and the environment is polluted. The invention has simple structure and convenient operation, and can filter sewage and waste gas to avoid environmental pollution.

title_en: A kind of refrigerator
abstract_en: The invention provides a refrigerator, which is provided with a drawer, wherein the drawer can be pushed into or pulled out of a compartment of the refrigerator, the drawer comprises a drawer bottom plate and a drawer side wall, the drawer side wall extends upwards around the periphery of the drawer bottom plate to form a containing part, and the containing part is divided into a plurality of compartments; the ice making unit is accommodated in one of the compartments and comprises a bracket and an ice storage box, and the ice storage box can be pushed into or pulled out of the bracket; the pop-up structure is arranged between the first side wall of the bracket and the second side wall of the ice storage box, and the first side wall is adjacent to the second side wall; the pop-up structure comprises a touch lug, a sliding lever, a second elastic piece and a constraint groove, the touch lug is arranged on the second side wall, a lug part of the sliding lever is clamped into the constraint groove, and the second elastic piece is stretched to be in a stretching state; the rear end of the second elastic piece is connected with the sliding lever, and the front end of the second elastic piece is connected with the first side wall.

title_en: Automatic discharging system and discharging method for roller kiln saggar
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic discharging system and an automatic discharging method for a roller kiln sagger. The conveying device comprises a longitudinal conveying roller way, a transverse conveying roller way and a turning conveying roller way. The automatic leveling device is arranged on two sides of the longitudinal conveying roller way and is positioned at the upstream of the longitudinal conveying roller way. The automatic rotary discharging device is arranged at the downstream of the longitudinal conveying roller way and comprises a rotary automatic clamping mechanism, a rotary driving mechanism, a rotation angle detection mechanism and the like. The system has the advantages of simple structure, quick unloading and low sagger loss rate. The system can simultaneously realize the turnover discharge of materials in a plurality of saggars in a single row, greatly improve the production efficiency and reduce the production cost.

title_en: Movable rotary dehumidifier
abstract_en: The invention discloses a movable rotary dehumidifier which comprises a dehumidification rotating wheel driven by a motor, wherein the dehumidification rotating wheel is divided into a drying area and a dehumidification area; the air inlet of the drying area of the dehumidification runner is communicated with air to be treated, the air outlet of the drying area of the dehumidification runner is divided into two paths, one path is connected with a treatment fan, the other path is connected with the air inlet of the dehumidification runner through a regeneration air channel, and air exhausted from the air outlet of the dehumidification runner passes through a heat pump circulating unit and then enters a regeneration fan to be treated and discharged or recycled. The invention solves the problem of discharge of high-temperature and high-humidity gas generated in the working process of the dehumidifier by adding the regeneration dehumidification area and the heat pump unit, replaces the conventional drilling discharge, achieves mobility, has compact structure, meets the application requirements of different working positions, has low cost and high dehumidification efficiency, realizes cyclic utilization of energy and reduces energy consumption.

title_en: Heat exchanger unit and method for manufacturing a heat exchanger unit
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a heat exchanger unit and a method of manufacturing a heat exchanger unit, the heat exchanger unit according to the present disclosure comprising: a combustion chamber in which a flame produced by a combustion reaction is located; a heat exchanger for a condensing boiler, the heat exchanger being located below the combustion chamber and including heat exchange tubes that receive heat generated by the combustion reaction and heat heating water flowing through the heat exchange tubes, and a main housing having the heat exchange tubes accommodated in an inner space thereof; and a combustion chamber insulation tube disposed adjacent to the combustion chamber and receiving heating water and allowing the heating water to flow therethrough to insulate the combustion chamber.

title_en: Air sterilization module for combined air conditioning unit
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air sterilization module for a combined air conditioning unit, which relates to the field of air sterilization modules and aims at solving the problems that the existing air sterilization module is low in reliability, poor in effect and difficult to efficiently inactivate viruses or bacteria in the air due to negative influence. This device can conveniently carry out the dual disinfection of circulation high-efficiently, and convenient dismantlement installation location simultaneously can recycle, great improvement disinfection's effect and reliability and the characteristics that do not have negative effects.

title_en: Regional control method, regional control system and air conditioning equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a zone control method, a zone control system and air conditioning equipment. Wherein, the method comprises the following steps: determining whether the unit needs to operate or not and whether an air valve in each target area is opened or not according to the temperature of each target area; wherein, each target area is correspondingly provided with an air valve; after determining that an air valve in a target area is opened, acquiring control parameters of the target area; wherein the control parameters include: the number of people in the target area and the difference value between the current temperature of the target area and the target temperature; and determining the opening degree of the air valve in the target area according to the control parameters, and controlling the air valve to open the corresponding opening degree. According to the invention, the opening of the air valve in the target area can be controlled according to the personnel distribution condition of the target area, so that the air intake is controlled, the temperature of each target area is controlled in a targeted manner, the comfort is improved, and the energy waste is avoided.

title_en: Cooling device for muffle furnace external steel structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a muffle furnace external steel structure cooling device which comprises a muffle furnace body and a supporting base arranged on the lower bottom surface of the muffle furnace body in a matching mode, wherein supporting columns are fixedly arranged on the periphery of the top surface of the supporting base. According to the invention, the first cooling mechanism and the second cooling mechanism are arranged outside the muffle body, so that the outside of the muffle body can be cooled by continuously inputting cooling water, the problems that the outer layer steel structure is easy to deform at a continuous high temperature, the inner structure of the muffle is extruded and deformed, and equipment is damaged are solved, and waste gas is not generated by the arrangement, so that the production stability is not influenced; the first cooling mechanism can be changed in position by arranging the first hydraulic column, so that the device is suitable for cooling muffle furnaces of different sizes; through setting up the first coupling mechanism of multiunit, can change the density degree of the outside water pipe of muffle furnace body to adjust water pipe density according to actual conditions, be suitable for in-service use.

title_en: Heat exchanger
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heat exchange device, which comprises a shell, wherein a smoke inlet bell mouth is arranged at an inlet of the shell, a smoke outlet bell mouth is arranged at an outlet of the shell, a plurality of heat pipe heat exchange units are arranged in the shell, and each heat pipe heat exchange unit consists of a plurality of heat pipe heat exchange modules; the structure of the heat pipe heat exchange module comprises: the frame is provided with the baffle in the frame, and the baffle becomes upper and lower cavity with frame internal partitioning, and the interval has arranged a plurality of heat pipe banks side by side on the baffle, and every row of heat pipe bank comprises a plurality of heat pipes, and the heat pipe structure includes: the device comprises a pipe body, wherein a refrigerant sleeve is sleeved at the upper part of the pipe body, a refrigerant cavity is formed between the refrigerant sleeve and the pipe body, a spiral tooth-punching fin is arranged on the outer wall of the lower part of the pipe body, a sealing plug is arranged at the lower end of the pipe body, and a mesenchymal evacuation end socket is arranged at the upper end of the pipe body; the refrigerant chambers of all the heat pipes in each row of heat pipe rows are sequentially communicated to form a refrigerant flow passage, one end of the refrigerant flow passage is connected with the water inlet header, and the other end of the refrigerant flow passage is connected with the water outlet header. The invention has the advantage of high heat exchange efficiency.

title_en: Pipe connection structure of air conditioning equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a pipe connecting structure of air conditioning equipment, which relates to the following pipe connecting structure of air conditioning equipment: a corrugated tube (200) detachably separated from and connected to an object (100) to be connected, the corrugated tube comprising a clip (300), the clip (300) comprising: a fixing plate (320) fixed to the object (100); and a pressing protrusion (350) formed to protrude in a direction opposite to the fixing plate (320), wherein in a state where the fixing plate (320) is fixed to the coupling object (100), the end of the corrugated tube (200) enters between the fixing plate (320) and the pressing protrusion (350) to be pressed by the pressing protrusion (350), thereby preventing separation.

title_en: Upper air inlet combustion device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an upper air inlet combustion device which comprises a base and a furnace end, wherein the furnace end is arranged above the base, an installation cavity is formed between the base and the furnace end, a support is arranged in the installation cavity, clamping positions for installing and fixing a dry burning prevention probe, an ignition needle and a thermocouple are formed on the support, the support is detachably arranged on the base, and the dry burning prevention probe, the ignition needle and the thermocouple are installed through the support, so that the dry burning prevention probe, the ignition needle and the thermocouple can be taken out relatively through removing the support, and a user can install and detach the dry burning prevention probe, the ignition needle and the thermocouple more easily.

title_en: Dehumidifier with overhead water tank
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dehumidifier with a top-mounted water tank, which comprises a shell, a heat exchange device and a circulating air system, wherein the heat exchange device and the circulating air system are fixedly arranged in the shell from bottom to top, a water receiving disc is arranged below the heat exchange device, the top of the shell is provided with the water tank, an automatic water inlet device which is communicated with the water receiving disc and the water tank is arranged in the shell, an overflow drainage device is arranged below the water tank, and condensation beads on the surface of the water tank are suitable for being dripped onto the heat exchange device through the overflow drainage device. The invention adopts the structure of the upper water tank, thereby being more convenient for pouring water; through setting up overflow drainage device in the water tank below, with the water tank surface because the condensation pearl drainage that the difference in temperature produced to heat transfer device surface to carry out water-cooling to heat transfer device, reduce the running power of complete machine, improve complete machine dehumidification efficiency, avoid condensation pearl too much or the water tank to leak simultaneously and cause the damage of the inside electrical components of machine, can not wet the floor more.

title_en: Multi-fuel environment-friendly automatic heating furnace with high thermal efficiency
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-fuel environment-friendly automatic heating furnace with high thermal efficiency, wherein a plurality of layers of sleeves are arranged outside a hearth; the lower part of the hearth is provided with a combustion chamber, the lower part of the combustion chamber is provided with a slag-removing air distribution device, and the movable end of the slag-removing air distribution device is fixedly connected with a grate; the fixed end of the slag-removing air distribution device is connected with an air inlet pipe, a blower is arranged outside the hearth, and the blower is connected with the air inlet pipe; the lower part of the hearth wall is provided with a water temperature probe, an upper fire position probe and a lower fire position probe; a control box is also arranged outside the hearth; under the control of the control box, the fire position, air distribution, slag pressing and slag discharging of the heating furnace can be automatically adjusted according to the combustion condition in the hearth, so that the fuel is fully combusted, and the heat efficiency is improved by more than 30 percent compared with that of a common coal-fired furnace; the upper part of the hearth is provided with a plurality of layers of sleeves, so that the contact area between high-temperature flue gas after combustion and water is increased, the heating speed of water is increased, the heat utilization rate of the heating furnace is improved, and the environment protection of smoke discharge is ensured because the smoke filtering pool is arranged inside the hearth.

title_en: Air conditioner fire prevention control method and device, air conditioner and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides an air conditioner fire prevention control method and device, an air conditioner and a readable storage medium. The fire prevention control method of the air conditioner comprises the following steps: acquiring environmental parameters of an air conditioner; obtaining a fire prevention decision value T using the environmental parameter through a fuzzy neural network model  Judgment  (ii) a At T  Threshold(s)  ≤T  Judgment  When the air conditioner works, controlling the air conditioner to execute a fire prevention action; wherein, T is  Threshold(s)  Is the fire threshold. The problem of there is the potential safety hazard in the fire prevention control of current air conditioner is solved.

title_en: Conveying module with tension adjusting mechanism and baking device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a conveying module with a tension adjusting mechanism, which comprises: the tension detection mechanism is connected with one of the free wheels, the tension adjustment mechanism is arranged at the feeding end and comprises a rod piece and a counterweight member, the position of the mass center of the counterweight member is not on the same axis with the rod piece, and the control mechanism controls the position of the counterweight member relative to the rod piece according to the detection result of the tension detection mechanism. The invention solves the problem that the tension of the material belt is difficult to adjust under the condition of no shutdown of the conveying module in the prior art. The invention also provides a baking device with the tension adjusting mechanism.

title_en: Timer for controlling on and off of thermocouple electromagnetic valve
abstract_en: The invention discloses a timer for controlling the on and off of a thermocouple electromagnetic valve, which comprises a controller, a negative voltage generating circuit, a valve breaking circuit, a valve sucking circuit, an I/O input/output circuit, a booster circuit, a dry battery voltage detection circuit electrically connected between the controller and a dry battery, and a switch signal input circuit electrically connected between the controller and a touch switch. The timer provides stable attracting current for the thermocouple, increases the service life of the household gas cooker battery, reduces the requirements on the pulse igniter, reduces the cost and simplifies the wiring of a control system.

title_en: Single-layer radiation refrigerating film for enhancing Mie scattering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a single-layer radiation refrigeration film for enhancing Mie scattering, which comprises a matrix, wherein a first scattering body and a second scattering body are uniformly distributed in the matrix, the first scattering body is an invaded scattering body, the second scattering body is a solid-state scattering body, and part of the second scattering body invades into the first scattering body to form a scattering body interface. The invention has the beneficial effects that: through introducing the second scatterer, the scattering coefficient has been increased, the scatterer interface has been formed, and then form the Mie scattering of reinforcing, the thickness dependence of the radiation refrigerator who relies on the scattering has been reduced, use cost reduces, optical property improves, avoided because the rete is too thick, the film curling phenomenon of the inhomogeneous formation of stress, promote convenience and reliability, the interface that forms between second scatterer and two kinds of scatterers is that the manual work adds the formation, controllable nature that has size and volume fraction, the uncontrollable characteristic of scatterer that is superior to the multiple hole film, mechanical properties is strong, reliable structure, further promoted the performance.

title_en: Air-cooled condenser and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an air-cooled condenser and a control method thereof. The air-cooled condenser includes: the heat exchange device comprises an exhaust pipeline, a first fin tube bundle, a second fin tube bundle, a first condensing box and a second condensing box, wherein a heat exchange cavity with an opening is formed between the second fin tube bundle and the first fin tube bundle; the fan is arranged at the opening; the flow guide assembly is arranged in the heat exchange cavity and comprises at least one flow guide plate, a plurality of through holes are formed in the flow guide plate, the flow guide plate comprises a first flow guide part and a second flow guide part, an included angle theta is formed between the first flow guide part and the second flow guide part, and the size of the included angle can be changed. The control method of the air-cooled condenser comprises the following steps: arranging a flow guide assembly in the heat exchange cavity; obtaining P1, P2 and Tain, taout, ts; the controller adjusts the included angle θ according to the obtained at least some parameters. The air-cooled condenser can be suitable for different environment working conditions, can be flexibly adjusted according to real-time environment working conditions, and is wide in application range.

title_en: Parallel operation waste incineration power generation thermodynamic system
abstract_en: The invention provides a waste incineration power generation thermodynamic system running in parallel, which comprises a high-parameter waste heat boiler, a high-parameter steam turbine, a medium-low parameter waste heat boiler and a medium-low parameter steam turbine; the outlet of the high-parameter waste heat boiler is communicated with a high-pressure steam inlet of a high-parameter steam turbine through a pipeline; the outlet of the medium-low parameter waste heat boiler is respectively communicated with a medium-low pressure steam inlet of the high-parameter steam turbine and a medium-low parameter steam inlet of the steam turbine through pipelines; the high-parameter steam turbine drives a first generator to generate electricity through a gear box; the medium-low parameter turbine directly drives a second generator to generate electricity; and the low-pressure steam inlet in the high-parameter steam turbine is used for absorbing steam increased by the low-medium parameter waste heat boiler. In the operation process of the system, the steam exhaust parameters of the two turbines are consistent, and the condensate water regenerative system and the deoxidization system are shared. The thermodynamic system can reduce auxiliary equipment, reduce investment and operation and maintenance costs, fully utilize the heat load of the medium-low parameter waste heat boiler, and improve the power generation efficiency and economic benefits of a power plant.

title_en: Air conditioner control method, air conditioner control device, air conditioner, medium, and program product
abstract_en: The application provides an air conditioner control method, an air conditioner control device, an air conditioner, a medium and a program product. When it is determined that the target space is empty, a preset linkage working mode is started, then a linkage working instruction is sent to the sweeper, so that the sweeper responds to the linkage working instruction to start the sweeping working mode, then a cleaning working instruction sent by the sweeper is received, and a washing module of the air conditioner is started according to the cleaning working instruction to enter a working state, so that air in the target area is purified through the washing module. The intelligent household service of cleaning and air purification can be automatically provided for the user when the target space is unmanned through the combined control of the air conditioner and the sweeper, the requirement of the user for high intelligent control is met, and the user use experience of the intelligent household appliance is further improved.

title_en: Evaporation chamber, electronic device, and sheet for evaporation chamber
abstract_en: An evaporation chamber in which a working fluid is enclosed in a closed space, wherein the closed space is provided with a first flow path and a liquid flow path section adjacent to the first flow path.

title_en: Heat pump system
abstract_en: The present invention provides a heat pump system, comprising: the heat exchange pipeline is provided with an energy supply end and an energy consumption end; the first heat exchanger and the second heat exchanger are both shell-and-tube heat exchangers, each shell-and-tube heat exchanger comprises a main body, an end cover and a control pipeline, and the main body is provided with a plurality of flow channels which are arranged at intervals; the end covers are respectively positioned at two ends of the main body, a plurality of mutually independent cavities are arranged between each end cover and the main body, each cavity is mutually communicated with the corresponding flow channel, and one cavity on one end cover is communicated with two cavities on the other end cover; the shell-and-tube heat exchanger is provided with at least two communicating ports, the communicating ports are arranged on the end covers, and one communicating port is communicated with one cavity; the control pipeline is arranged between the two adjacent cavities and used for controlling the connection or disconnection of the two adjacent cavities. Through the technical scheme provided by the application, the problem that a heat pump system in the prior art cannot meet the heat exchange requirement can be solved.

title_en: Waste heat recovery device and control method thereof
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a waste heat recovery device and a control method therefor, which can detect leakage of refrigerant relatively quickly even when refrigerant leaks from a refrigerant circuit. The waste heat recovery device (1) is provided with: a refrigerant circuit (10) having a condenser (14) that condenses the refrigerant passing through a turbine (13) by heat exchange with cooling water, the turbine being rotated by the refrigerant evaporated by an evaporator (12); a cooling water pipe (52) through which cooling water having passed through the condenser (14) flows; and a leak detector (30) that is provided in the cooling water pipe (52) and detects the refrigerant contained in the cooling water flowing through the cooling water pipe (52).

title_en: Combustor heat radiation structure and water-cooling combustor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a burner heat dissipation structure and a water-cooled burner, which comprise a fire grate module and a water-cooled module, wherein the fire grate module comprises a plurality of fire grate components arranged side by side, the water-cooled module comprises a plurality of sections of water pipelines, at least one section of water pipeline is clamped between two adjacent fire grate components, the water pipeline is clamped between two adjacent fire grate components, and the fire grate components can be fully contacted with the water pipelines, so that the heat exchange efficiency is improved, the temperature of the fire grate components is reduced, the gas combustion is more sufficient, the combustion efficiency is improved, and the generation and emission of harmful gases such as nitrogen oxides are reduced.

title_en: Outdoor easy-maintenance power generation equipment for medical institution
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of new energy power generation of medical institutions, in particular to an outdoor easy-maintenance power generation device for medical institutions. The outdoor easy-maintenance power generation equipment for the medical institution adopts an outer wall installation type layout design, can effectively solve the problem of space occupation of the medical institution, greatly utilizes the surface space of an outer wall, is more reasonable in layout, is fixed at the position of an outer window, and is more convenient to install in the early stage and overhaul in the later stage; the sub-overturning assembly frame is inserted into the lateral positioning hole through the screw rod telescopic locking mechanism and is connected with the external overturning frame, solar panels of different sizes can be installed as required, the installation positions and the number of the solar panels can be changed as required, and the application range is wider.

title_en: Wind direction controllable far infrared hot blast stove
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind direction controllable far infrared hot blast stove which comprises an upper heating chamber and a lower heating chamber which are formed by dividing a heating chamber partition plate which is horizontally arranged, wherein heating devices are arranged in the upper heating chamber and the lower heating chamber, a wind passing opening is arranged on the right side of the heating chamber partition plate, an end surface flow guide device for adjusting the wind direction blown into the lower heating chamber from the upper heating chamber is arranged at the wind passing opening, manual maintenance channels are arranged on two sides of the heating device of the lower heating chamber, and side flow guide devices for adjusting the wind directions on two sides of the heating chamber are arranged on the manual maintenance channels. Through the mode, the wind direction controllable far infrared hot blast stove can adjust the wind directions at two sides and the up-and-down wind directions in the heating chamber by matching the end surface flow guide device with the side flow guide device, ensures that hot air can be uniformly heated in the heating chamber, does not generate local high temperature, and is convenient for maintenance and adjustment of maintenance personnel.

title_en: Outdoor unit of air conditioner
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of air conditioners, and particularly relates to an outdoor unit of an air conditioner. The invention aims to solve the problems that in the disassembly process of the existing maintenance door, after the rotation angle of the maintenance door exceeds a certain angle, the maintenance door can automatically fall off, and if maintenance personnel are not familiar with the structure and the operation method of the maintenance door, the maintenance personnel can be injured by falling off and crashing when the maintenance door rotates. In order to achieve the above object, in the outdoor unit of an air conditioner according to the present invention, a first sliding rail and a first sliding seat sliding along the first sliding rail are provided on a door frame of a casing of the outdoor unit, a connecting member is hinged on the first sliding seat, and an outer end of the connecting member is hinged with a door body. So, through the connecting piece respectively with first slide and the door body articulated and first slide is followed first slide and is slided, realized the relative slip and the rotation of door body and casing position to the door body need not to dismantle the door body that can be in the air conditioner off-premises station in narrow and small space and opens, avoided the maintenance door to drop when rotating and smash the problem of injuring the maintenance personal.

title_en: Method for determining accumulated use duration of consumable, controller, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a controller, equipment and a storage medium for determining the accumulated use duration of consumables. The method for determining the accumulated use time of the consumables is applied to an air conditioner, the air conditioner comprises the consumables, and the determining method comprises the following steps: acquiring the total usable time of the consumable items and the accumulated usable time of the consumable items; updating the accumulated use time length or stopping updating the accumulated use time length according to at least one of the working state of the consumable and the working state of the air conditioner; and generating a consumable replacement signal when the updated accumulated use time is greater than or equal to the total use time. The embodiment of the application can enable the accumulated use time to only comprise the working time of the consumable, and avoids the calculation error of the remaining usable time of the consumable.

title_en: Method for recovering and controlling oil stain in pipe of outdoor unit
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of air conditioner self-cleaning, in particular to a method for recovering and controlling oil stain in a pipe of an outdoor unit. This application aims at solving the problem that how to realize the intraductal greasy dirt of off-premises station and retrieve. To this end, the air conditioner of this application includes the recovery pipeline, and its one end and outdoor heat exchanger import intercommunication, the other end and compressor induction port intercommunication are equipped with the on-off valve on the recovery pipeline. The method comprises the following steps: responding to a received command of recovering the oil stain in the pipe, and entering an outdoor unit pipe oil stain recovery mode; controlling the air conditioner to operate in a heating mode; controlling the compressor to adjust to a preset first recovery frequency; adjusting the opening degree of the throttling device to enable the temperature of a coil of the outdoor heat exchanger to be less than or equal to a preset temperature; when the temperature of the coil pipe is less than or equal to the preset temperature and lasts for a first preset time, controlling the air conditioner to be switched into a refrigeration mode; and controlling the on-off valve to be opened and the throttling device to be closed to the minimum opening degree. This application can realize retrieving the intraductal greasy dirt of off-premises station.

title_en: Cavitation heat supply device
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a cavitation heat supply apparatus, including: a power module for outputting torque; the pump body is connected with the power module and is used for inputting and outputting a heat supply medium; the driven shaft is fixedly connected with an output shaft of the power module; the centrifugal wheel is coaxially and fixedly connected with the driven shaft and used for generating centrifugal force and outputting the heat supply medium from the inner pipeline through the centrifugal force; the cavitation structure is sleeved on the driven shaft and is fixed in the cavity structure of the pump body; the cavitation structure is adjacent to the second end surface of the centrifugal wheel; the cavitation structure is provided with a cavitation hole, and the cavitation hole is used for outputting the heat supply medium output by the pipeline to the cavity structure of the pump body; the baffle is sleeved on the outer diameter of the first end face of the centrifugal wheel and is fixed in the cavity structure of the pump body. The cavitation heat supply device can generate the cavitation effect inside and heat a heat supply medium, the generated heat is high, the operation is not influenced by the environment temperature, no emission and no pollution are caused, and the device has small heat loss and high heat supply efficiency.

title_en: Liquid heat recovery and impurity removal integrated method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a liquid heat recovery and impurity removal integrated method, which comprises the following steps: introducing exhaust gas into an impurity removing chamber, wherein the exhaust gas is blown to an impurity removing wall formed by a plurality of liquid conveying pipes from an exhaust inlet of the impurity removing chamber; introducing liquid into a plurality of liquid conveying pipes, wherein the liquid moves to the front of an exhaust inlet along the liquid conveying pipes; the impurity removal wall limits the flow space and the flow direction of the exhaust gas, reduces the flow speed of the exhaust gas, and the impurities sink and fall under the action of gravity; meanwhile, the exhaust gas is contacted with the impurity removing wall, and heat is transferred to the liquid conveying pipe from the exhaust gas and then is transferred to the liquid from the liquid conveying pipe; leading the liquid after obtaining heat to an evaporator of a dryer; and the exhaust gas after impurity removal is discharged from an exhaust outlet of the impurity removal chamber. The invention can recover the heat of exhaust through liquid while removing impurities, not only has larger heat transfer temperature difference, but also can reduce the heat exchange area; but also can lead the liquid to the evaporator of the heat pump to increase the evaporation temperature.

title_en: Air conditioner shell transportation equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses air conditioner shell conveying equipment, which relates to the field of air conditioner processing equipment and comprises a box body, wherein the box body is used for placing an air conditioner shell; the cover plate is arranged at the upper end part of the box body; a plurality of pressing pieces are laid on the lower surface of the cover plate; a fixing member; the pressing piece comprises a sleeve, an elastic rod, a spring and a pressing wheel; the outer surface of the sleeve is concavely provided with a sliding chute; the top of the elastic rod is convexly provided with a sliding block, and the sliding block is connected with the sliding groove in a sliding manner; the sleeve is vertically fixed on the lower surface of the cover plate; the elastic rod is inserted in the sleeve in a sliding manner; the spring is arranged between the elastic rod and the sleeve. The problem of air conditioner shell in the course of working, need carry out faster transportation to the shell to save time, if conventional transportation satisfies the speed requirement, then can't guarantee air conditioner shell stationarity is solved.

title_en: Sock setting machine capable of recycling steam and control method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses socks forming machine of recoverable steam includes: transport mechanism, transport mechanism are arranged in transporting the forming mechanism with socks that socks board and cover were established on the socks board, and transport mechanism includes: the base is placed on the ground; the conveying belt is arranged on the base; the plurality of socks are arranged on the conveying belt; the driving mechanism is used for driving the conveying belt to operate; the forming mechanism, the forming mechanism is used for carrying out the steam with the socks on the socks board and stereotypes, and the forming mechanism includes: the rack is arranged on the base; the sock shaping chamber is arranged on the rack; the steam generator is connected with the sock shaping chamber and provides steam for the sock shaping chamber; the control device is connected with the steam generator and controls the steam generator; and the stacking mechanism is used for collecting and stacking the socks after shaping.

title_en: Heating device and heating system for hot melting of civil building material waterproof coiled material
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of building materials, in particular to a heating device and a heating system for hot melting of a waterproof coiled material of a civil building material, which comprises a heating box, wherein an outer sleeve is welded on the outer wall of one side of the heating box, a hot melting pipe is welded inside the outer sleeve, a spray head is welded at one end of the hot melting pipe, a circulating pipe is installed on one side of the inner wall of the heating box through a bolt, vent hoods are welded at two ends of the circulating pipe, limiting rings are welded on two sides inside the heating box, limiting pipes are installed on two sides of the limiting rings through bolts, a spring is welded on one side of the inner wall of the limiting pipe, a pushing plug is welded at one end of the spring, a universal ball is arranged at one end of the pushing plug, a spacing plate is welded at one side of the inner wall of the heating box, a rotating disc in the heating device is driven by a first motor, the rotating disc can push the pushing plug, the spring can deform, so as to control the gas circulation in the two limiting pipes, is beneficial to the hot melting of the waterproof coiled material in different degrees.

title_en: Air conditioner, control method and device thereof and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air conditioner, a control method and a control device of the air conditioner and a computer readable storage medium. Wherein, the method comprises the following steps: when the concentration value of a preset substance in a target room is determined to be greater than a preset concentration value, generating a purification instruction, wherein the target room is a room where an air conditioner is located, and the preset substance is a substance in the air in the target room; when the target user in the target room is determined to be in a non-rest state, generating a voice playing instruction; and after determining that the air conditioner responds to the voice playing instruction, controlling the air conditioner to release the air purifying substance based on the purifying instruction. The invention solves the technical problems that the air conditioner in the related art can not automatically control the negative ion generator, needs manual control by a user and has lower intelligent degree.

title_en: Air conditioner fresh air volume control method and device and air conditioner
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air conditioner fresh air volume control method and device and an air conditioner. Wherein, the method comprises the following steps: monitoring specified parameters, wherein the specified parameters comprise: climate information, indoor ambient temperature, and air conditioner operation information; determining the number of people in the air conditioning action area according to the designated parameters; and determining a target fresh air volume according to the number of people, and outputting fresh air according to the target fresh air volume. According to the invention, the designated parameters are monitored by means of the components of the air conditioner, the number of people in the area is calculated according to the designated parameters, the required fresh air volume is further determined based on the number of people, no additional monitoring equipment such as an air quality sensor or an infrared camera is needed to be added, the air conditioner operation environment and the air conditioner operation state are monitored, the fresh air volume is accurately controlled on the basis of not increasing the cost, and the comfort and energy conservation of the air conditioner are ensured when the fresh air is started.

title_en: Heat exchange tube outer wall belt cleaning device and application apparatus thereof
abstract_en: The utility model provides a heat exchange tube outer wall belt cleaning device, set up upper end open-ended washing chamber in the casing, upper cover one end is articulated with the casing, an opening for opening and closed washing chamber, be equipped with the heat exchange tube import on the left side lateral wall in washing chamber, be equipped with the heat exchange tube export on the lateral wall of right side, form heat exchange tube washing passageway between heat exchange tube import and the heat exchange tube export, the sealing washer that central authorities were equipped with the round hole with the heat exchange tube laminating is established to heat exchange tube import and heat exchange tube export endotheca, it is equipped with the buck to wash the intracavity, the opening part in washing chamber is equipped with spray set, the water pump of one end in the buck is connected to spray set's the other end, the water pump provides spray set with the buck. Has the advantages that: simple structure, lubricating oil on the heat exchange tube outer wall in effective and thorough clean heat exchange tube course of working, and can with heat exchange tube processing equipment lug connection, easy to assemble and use.

title_en: Ward air disinfection and air change equipment with detect alarming function
abstract_en: The invention discloses ward air disinfection and ventilation equipment with a detection alarm function, and relates to the technical field of ward air disinfection. This ward air disinfection and air change equipment with detect alarming function, the design that can utilize hydraulic pressure gas pole can carry out the adjustment of position from top to bottom to the roof, thereby the inside adjustment subassembly of roof can move down to the outside of air outlet front end, and end put between the frame outside and the air outlet be connected for magnetism, thereby can guide the adjustment to the air-out position under special environment, the connecting band is a plastic bag, can stimulate it to the outside according to the use needs, convenient to use person adjusts the air-out position.

title_en: Dewaxing device of sintering furnace
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a sintering furnace dewaxing device, which relates to the technical field of sintering furnace dewaxing, and mainly aims to solve the problem that the existing sintering furnace dewaxing device is incomplete in collecting a forming agent.

title_en: Equipment control method and air conditioner
abstract_en: The application discloses an equipment control method and an air conditioner, comprising the following steps: sending control data of an indoor unit of the air conditioner to a first relay control module of the air conditioner by using an outdoor unit in the air conditioner; processing the control data by using the first relay control module, and executing a first function supported by the first relay control module; sending the control data to a function expansion module of the air conditioner by using the first relay control module; and processing the control data by using the function expansion module, and executing a second function supported by the function expansion module.

title_en: Intelligent control method for refrigerating operation of household water machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent control method for refrigerating operation of a household water machine, which is characterized in that the indoor air outlet temperature is enabled to quickly meet the user requirements by detecting the return air temperature of an air disk, the return air relative humidity of the air disk, the outdoor atmospheric temperature and the like in real time, comparing the return air temperature with the indoor environment target value, dividing the energy demand interval, and adjusting the system water temperature, the air quantity of the air disk, a water valve and the like according to the divided interval, so that the temperature change of the indoor air outlet is more gentle, the phenomenon of large-amplitude fluctuation is avoided, and the comfort of user experience is improved.

title_en: Heating and ventilation system applied to thermal power plant
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heating and ventilating system applied to a thermal power plant, which comprises a heat exchange water bath furnace, a plurality of heat exchange sheets arranged in the heat exchange water bath furnace, a heat exchange control valve arranged at the front end of each heat exchange sheet, a heating and ventilating pipeline connected with the heat exchange water bath furnace, a circulating pump arranged on the heating and ventilating pipeline, an inlet temperature sensor and a return water temperature sensor arranged at the upper inlet end and the return water end of the heating and ventilating pipeline, and a central controller used for controlling a steam control valve, the heat exchange control valve and the circulating pump; the invention firstly exchanges heat between the waste heat steam and the heat exchange water bath furnace, thereby avoiding the problems of overhigh heating temperature and difficult temperature adjustment caused by directly adopting the waste heat steam, and simultaneously, the invention realizes the switching of the number of the heat exchange control valves by reasonably and logically controlling the switching of different numbers of the heat exchange control valves through the central controller, thereby conveniently realizing the adjustment of the heating temperature and greatly improving the intelligence of the operation of the heating and ventilation system of the thermal power plant.

title_en: Directly-heated heat pump water heater with water tank
abstract_en: The invention discloses a directly-heated heat pump water heater with a water tank, which comprises the water tank and an inner disc heat exchanger arranged in the water tank, wherein the upper part of the water tank is provided with a refrigerant inlet and a hot water outlet, the lower part of the water tank is provided with a refrigerant outlet and a cold water inlet, two ends of a refrigerant channel of the inner disc heat exchanger are respectively connected with the refrigerant inlet and the refrigerant outlet, and two ends of a water channel are respectively connected with the cold water inlet and the hot water outlet. According to the invention, the heat exchange between the water supplementing cold water and the refrigerant and the water in the inner plate heat exchanger is realized through the inner plate heat exchanger, the heating quantity during use is increased, the hot water quantity is larger, the water in the water tank has a heat storage function, tap water is turned off, the inner plate heat exchanger can continue to work for heat storage, the problem of frequent start and stop in the use process of the existing direct-heating heat pump water heater is solved, the reliability is improved, meanwhile, the water in the inner plate heat exchanger and the water in the water tank is heated simultaneously, the water yield is increased, and the use comfort level is improved.

title_en: Cold air prevention control method
abstract_en: The invention provides a cold air prevention control method, which comprises the following steps: controlling the air conditioner to be in an air outlet mode of upper air outlet; controlling the starting of an electric heating structure of the air conditioner; detecting the temperature of the electric heating structure and according to the temperature T of the electric heating structure Heat generation Controlling the operation of the fan structure of the air conditioner. Through the technical scheme provided by the invention, the technical problem that the waiting time for hot air supply is long due to the cold air release requirement in the prior art can be solved.

title_en: Gas water heater and phase change heat exchanger
abstract_en: The invention relates to a gas water heater and a phase change heat exchange device. The shell is provided with an air inlet and a smoke outlet. The heat absorption portion is in contact with the high-temperature flue gas in the shell to absorb heat energy of the high-temperature flue gas and transmit the heat energy to the heat conduction portion, the heat conduction portion transmits the heat energy to the phase-change material, the phase-change material accumulates the heat energy, the heat insulation piece reduces the transmission of the heat energy accumulated by the phase-change material to the external environment, and heat energy loss is reduced, so that energy of the high-temperature flue gas is reasonably utilized, and the heat absorption portion is energy-saving and environment-friendly. In addition, when the gas water heater is turned off and then started, the heat accumulated by the phase change material in the phase change heat exchange device can preheat cold water in the cold water inlet pipe or warm water in the hot water outlet pipe, the outlet water temperature of the hot water outlet pipe is ensured to be close to the hot water temperature set by a user, the problems of sudden cold and sudden hot bathing water and large water temperature fluctuation are avoided, and the constant temperature effect of the whole gas water heater is improved.

title_en: Flexible glass cooling water system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flexible glass cooling water system, and belongs to the technical field of flexible glass manufacturing. The flexible glass cooling water system comprises water circulation equipment arranged on a lower layer and a water rack arranged on an intermediate layer; the water circulation equipment is respectively provided with a water inlet pipeline and a water return pipeline, the water frame comprises a water feeding pipeline branch and a water return pipeline branch, the water inlet pipeline is communicated with a water inlet pipeline interface on the high-rise kiln through the water feeding pipeline branch, and the water return pipeline is communicated with a water return pipeline interface on the high-rise kiln through the water return pipeline branch. Therefore, the flexible glass cooling water system can effectively reduce the temperature of key equipment of a kiln and a channel and prevent the electrode brick and the flange from erosion and deformation at high temperature.

title_en: Preparation method of novel Ti-6Al-4V medical alloy material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a novel Ti-6Al-4V medical alloy material, which needs to be prepared by a synthesis device, wherein the synthesis device comprises a cooling mechanism, a filtering mechanism, a base, a controller and a mixing mechanism, and the mixing mechanism comprises a smelting tank, a driving motor arranged at the top of the smelting tank, a rotating rod arranged at the output end of the driving motor and stirring rods welded on the outer wall of one side of the rotating rod and distributed at equal intervals; the process method of the novel Ti-6Al-4V medical alloy material comprises the following steps of 1: injecting titanium, aluminum, tin, carbon, vanadium and nickel into a smelting tank through a feed hopper and a connecting pipe, and starting the smelting tank to carry out heating smelting. According to the invention, the temperature sensor can transmit signals to the controller when the temperature is too high, and the controller controls the two cooling fans to operate simultaneously to blow air to the driving motor for cooling, so that the driving motor can be always at a relatively proper working temperature, the working efficiency of the device can be improved, the cooling effect is increased, and the service life of the device is prolonged.

title_en: Metatitanic acid cooling device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a metatitanic acid cooling device, which is characterized in that: the metatitanic acid circulation tank is provided with a circulating acid pump which is used for circularly conveying acid liquid in the metatitanic acid circulation tank to a metatitanic acid cooler, an output port at the other end of the metatitanic acid cooler is connected with an acid storage tank in a next procedure and the metatitanic acid circulation tank, and an acid liquid temperature detection control device is arranged at the output end of the metatitanic acid cooler and is used for controlling the acid liquid output from the metatitanic acid cooler to enter the acid storage tank in the next procedure or the metatitanic acid circulation tank; the cooling device is provided with the cooler with the high-frequency ultrasonic vibrator, the inclined acid liquid pipeline, the reverse cooling liquid runner and the like, so that the acid liquid crystals can be reduced to be attached to the pipe wall through high-frequency vibration, and the inclined pipe further prevents the crystals from settling and accumulating in the pipeline; the reverse cooling liquid flow direction reduces the temperature difference, avoids the damage of the acid liquid pipe caused by the violent cold and hot reaction with overlarge temperature difference, and has better and more obvious cooling effect.

title_en: Intelligent-control low-temperature air heat pump unit
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligently controlled low-temperature air heat pump unit, which belongs to the technical field of air heat pumps and comprises a shell, wherein an evaporator box is fixedly installed at the top of an inner cavity of the shell, an evaporator pipe is installed in the evaporator box, a water tank is fixedly installed at the bottom of the inner cavity of the shell, the evaporator pipe penetrates through the evaporator box and is fixedly connected with the water tank, a water inlet pipe is fixedly installed at one side of the water tank, an air inlet pipe is fixedly sleeved at one side of the shell, which is close to the water inlet pipe, the air inlet pipe is connected with the evaporator box, a rotating shaft is installed in the air inlet pipe, a fan is fixedly installed on the rotating shaft, a transmission mechanism is installed between the rotating shaft and the water inlet pipe, a dust screen is fixedly installed on the inner wall of one end, which is far away from the evaporator box, of the air inlet pipe, a cleaning mechanism is installed between the rotating shaft and the dust screen, and a water collecting mechanism is installed between the bottom of the evaporator box and the shell. Drive mechanism when the inlet tube flows into cold water, drive mechanism drives the pivot and rotates for fan work makes the air current pass through the evaporimeter case, thereby the evaporimeter pipe of being convenient for absorbs heat, and unit operation effect is guaranteed in the linkage of whole intelligence.

title_en: Heating and refrigerating system based on forward and reverse circulation coupling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heating and refrigerating system based on forward and reverse circulation coupling, the system consists of a solar heat collection unit, an organic Rankine cycle unit, a heat supply and refrigeration unit and a control unit. The heat collected by the solar heat collection unit is transferred to the generator in the organic Rankine cycle unit, the organic working medium in the generator is evaporated to form steam, the steam enters the expander, mechanical energy output by the expander in the organic Rankine cycle unit is transferred to the compressor of the heat supply and refrigeration unit through the direct drive shaft, the heat supply and refrigeration unit is driven, the evaporator in the heat supply and refrigeration unit absorbs heat, the water temperature in the cold water tank is lowered, the condenser in the heat supply and refrigeration unit releases heat, water in the hot water tank is heated, the system does not need to drive the compressor by additional electric energy, and low-grade solar energy can be fully utilized to realize refrigeration and heat supply.

title_en: Microchannel heat exchanger
abstract_en: The application discloses a microchannel heat exchanger which comprises a flat tube body and a row of channels, wherein the flat tube body comprises a first plane, a second plane, a first side face and a second side face, the first plane and the second plane are arranged on two opposite sides of the flat tube body in the thickness direction, the first side face and the second side face are arranged on two opposite sides of the flat tube body in the width direction, the first side face is connected with the first plane and the second plane, the second side face is connected with the first plane and the second plane, the row of channels are arranged in the flat tube body in the width direction, the row of channels penetrate through the flat tube body in the length direction, and the row of channels at least comprise a first channel, a second channel and a third channel which are arranged in the width direction, wherein the cross section areas of the first channel, the second channel and the third channel in the width direction change exponentially or in a plurality of ways, so that the heat exchange performance of the microchannel heat exchanger is improved.

title_en: Liquid collection control method and system of air conditioner and air conditioner
abstract_en: The invention provides a liquid collection control method and system of an air conditioner and the air conditioner. The air conditioner comprises an outdoor machine heat exchanger, an indoor machine heat exchanger, a compressor, a liquid pipe and a throttling assembly; the liquid pipe is arranged between the outdoor unit heat exchanger and the indoor unit heat exchanger, the throttling assembly is arranged on the liquid pipe, and the liquid receiving control method comprises the following steps: the air conditioner operates in a refrigeration mode, and if liquid is collected, the operating frequency of the compressor is reduced; and detecting the return air pressure of the compressor, and controlling the corresponding mode of the air conditioner to operate according to the return air pressure. The invention solves the technical problem that the air conditioner fails to collect liquid because the exhaust pressure of the compressor is overlarge in the liquid collecting process.

title_en: Water drainage assembly and gas equipment with same
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water drainage component of gas equipment and the gas equipment, the gas equipment is provided with a controller, the water drainage component comprises: the water inlet pipe is provided with a condensed water inlet; the water outlet pipe is provided with a condensed water outlet; the water level detector is arranged in the water outlet pipe and is used for detecting the water level in the water outlet pipe; the water level detector includes: the static part is statically arranged in the water outlet pipe and is provided with a first connecting point; the movable part is provided with a second connecting point, the movable part is movably arranged on the static part at a first position and a second position, and the movable part is positioned at the second position and the first connecting point is in contact with the second connecting point under the condition that the water level in the water outlet pipe reaches a preset value, so that an electric signal is generated.
