According to the drainage component of the gas equipment, the water level detector is arranged in the water outlet pipe, and the water level in the water outlet pipe is monitored in real time through the water level detector, so that safety accidents caused by blockage of the water outlet pipe are avoided.

title_en: Oil fume treatment system, range hood and working method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an oil smoke treatment system, which comprises a filtering component, a plurality of oil smoke treatment units and a plurality of oil smoke treatment units, wherein the filtering component comprises a plurality of pipe bodies which are arranged in an oil smoke channel in a crossing manner, and at least part of the pipe bodies in the filtering component are heating pipes; the heat radiation detection device is used for detecting the heat radiation temperature of the heating pipe so as to judge the oil stain attachment amount on the filtering component; the scraping plate is provided with a through hole for each pipe body to penetrate in a matching way; and the driving component is in driving connection with the scraper so as to drive the scraper to move axially and reciprocally relative to the pipe body. This oil smoke processing system simple structure, can accurate detection greasy dirt adhere to the condition, can improve the mobility of greasy dirt simultaneously, and then improve easy cleanability. The invention also relates to a range hood applying the oil smoke treatment system. The invention also relates to a working method of the range hood. The working method of the range hood can accurately obtain the oil pollution degree.

title_en: Air conditioning system fault diagnosis method and system based on fault judgment rule
abstract_en: The invention provides an air conditioning system fault diagnosis method and system based on fault judgment rules, wherein the method comprises the following steps: judging whether all equipment in the air-conditioning system is normally started or stopped according to the relationship between the current time and a preset working time period, the relationship between the current indoor temperature value and a preset indoor temperature value and the relationship between the current power consumption of each piece of equipment and the standby power consumption corresponding to each piece of equipment; if any equipment of the air conditioning system is abnormally started and stopped, determining abnormal equipment of the air conditioning system; if all the equipment in the air conditioning system is started and stopped normally, acquiring the actually measured energy efficiency data of each equipment, and judging whether the equipment in the air conditioning system is low-energy-efficiency equipment or not according to the actually measured energy efficiency data of each equipment and the preset energy efficiency parameters of each equipment. According to the invention, whether the start-stop of the air-conditioning system is normal or not is judged, then the energy efficiency of the main equipment is further checked, and the accuracy of fault diagnosis of the air-conditioning system is improved.

title_en: Electric heating auxiliary system of solar water heater
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of water heaters, and relates to an electric heating auxiliary system of a solar water heater, which comprises a vacuum tube, wherein a water tank is fixedly arranged above the vacuum tube, a water storage tank is arranged on one side in the water tank, a water inlet tank is arranged on the other side in the water tank, a water inlet pipe is connected and arranged on a water tank shell of the water tank, a pressure relief module is fixedly arranged above the water storage tank in the direction far away from the water inlet tank, a cold and hot control module is arranged below the pressure relief module in the water storage tank, a water outlet pipe is connected to the outer side of the water tank close to the cold and hot control module, and an electric heating module is fixedly connected to the outer side of the water tank close to the water storage tank in the horizontal position of the water outlet pipe. The invention also solves the problem that the solar water heater cannot normally heat by using solar energy and does not use hot water when overcast and rainy weather or other conditions occur.

title_en: Heat exchanger with four fluids cooperatively controlling interval change
abstract_en: The invention provides a heat exchanger with four fluids cooperatively controlling interval change, wherein inlets of a first heat exchange tube, a second heat exchange tube and a third heat exchange tube are respectively provided with a first valve, a second valve and a third valve; along the length direction of the central tube, the tube group on the same side (left side or right side) is arranged in a plurality of numbers, and along the flowing direction of fluid in the shell side, the distance between the adjacent tube groups on the same side (left side or right side) is continuously reduced. According to the invention, through increasing the spacing amplitude of the heat exchange tubes, the shell-side fluid outlet position can be ensured to fully exchange heat, a heat exchange effect similar to counter flow is formed, and the heat transfer effect is further enhanced, so that the whole vibration effect is uniform, the heat exchange effect is increased, and the heat exchange effect and the descaling effect are further improved. Experiments show that better heat exchange effect and descaling effect can be achieved by adopting the structural design.

title_en: Shell-and-tube phase-change heat storage device with conical spiral coil pipe structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a shell-and-tube phase-change heat storage device with a conical spiral coil pipe structure, which comprises a heat exchange pipe set, a phase-change heat storage material and a heat storage device shell; the heat exchange tube group comprises an inlet main pipe, an outlet main pipe and a conical spiral coil; the conical spiral coil is a coil structure in which the central line of the pipe rotates from outside to inside one by one on a conical surface; the multiple groups of conical spiral coil pipes are arranged together in an equidistant and coaxial manner; the inlet of each group of spiral coil pipes is arranged at the outer side of the spiral, and the outlet is arranged at the inner side of the spiral; the inlet and the outlet of the spiral coils are respectively connected to form a heat exchange tube set; the heat exchange tube group is immersed in the phase change heat storage material and is wrapped by the heat storage device shell to form the phase change heat storage device with the conical spiral coil structure. The device utilizes the rotatory process of fluid to promote going on of heat accumulation process, has compact structure, the efficient advantage of heat accumulation.

title_en: Tank type heat exchanger and heat pump system
abstract_en: The application relates to a tank heat exchanger and a heat pump system, and relates to the field of heat exchange devices. The tank type heat exchanger comprises an outer cylinder; the inner cylinder is arranged inside the outer cylinder; the partition plate is arranged in the outer barrel so as to divide the space between the outer barrel and the inner barrel into a first chamber and a second chamber, and the second chamber is positioned above the first chamber; the heat exchange tube is arranged in the first cavity and spirally wound outside the inner cylinder; the liquid inlet pipe is used for providing liquid refrigerant to the second chamber; the gas outlet pipe is used for sucking the gaseous refrigerant from the first chamber; the partition plate is provided with a spraying hole, and the spraying hole is used for spraying the liquid refrigerant of the second cavity to the heat exchange tube. In the pot-type heat exchanger of this application, liquid refrigerant sprays to the heat exchange tube, has improved the utilization ratio in the main pipe district of heat exchange tube, has improved heat exchange efficiency. All liquid refrigerants enter the first cavity in a spraying mode, the liquid refrigerants are fully contacted with the heat exchange pipe, and the heat exchange effect is good.

title_en: Method for calculating flow coefficient of regulating valve of refrigeration compressor performance testing device
abstract_en: A method for calculating flow coefficient of regulating valve of a refrigeration compressor performance test device comprises the following steps: aiming at performance design parameters of the refrigeration compressor, a working condition operation diagram of the compressor is built in a two-dimensional coordinate system taking evaporation pressure as an abscissa and condensing pressure as an ordinate, and working condition inflection points on the working condition operation diagram are obtained; variable parameters and fixed parameters corresponding to the inflection points of all working conditions are obtained; and obtaining the maximum value of the flow coefficient primary upper limit values of the regulating valve to be calculated under different working condition inflection points as the flow coefficient upper limit value of the regulating valve to be calculated, and obtaining the minimum value of the flow coefficient primary lower limit values of the regulating valve to be calculated under different working condition inflection points as the flow coefficient lower limit value of the regulating valve to be calculated. According to the invention, the finally obtained flow coefficient adjusting range of the adjusting valve to be calculated can meet the requirement of any working condition inflection point, and support is provided for parameter selection of the adjusting valve of the refrigerating compressor performance testing device.

title_en: Box type high-temperature degradation furnace
abstract_en: The invention discloses a box type high-temperature degradation furnace, belongs to the technical field of organic glass production, and aims to provide a box type high-temperature degradation furnace which solves the problems of low heat utilization rate, insufficient energy conservation and environmental protection when the existing organic glass waste is recycled and degraded. The spiral conveying mechanism comprises a furnace body, the furnace body top is provided with spiral conveying mechanism, spiral conveying mechanism's discharge end and furnace body intercommunication, spiral conveying mechanism's feed end intercommunication has the storage silo, be provided with the heater in the furnace body, the heater is the heating box, the heating box intercommunication has the heating pipe, be provided with heating medium in the heating box, be provided with the agitator in the furnace body, it still is provided with the material distributor to be located the heating box top in the furnace body, furnace body top intercommunication has the condenser, material export and cooling mouth of a river have been seted up to the condenser, the furnace body bottom still is provided with the ware of slagging tap. The invention is suitable for the organic glass waste high-temperature degradation furnace.

title_en: Novel air conditioner humidification system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel air conditioner humidifying system, which comprises an external shell, a humidifying mechanism arranged in the external shell and a ventilation mechanism matched with the humidifying mechanism; the humidifying mechanism comprises a humidifier water tank, an electric heating pipe arranged in the humidifier water tank and a humidifier atomizing spray hole arranged at the top end of the humidifier water tank; a humidifier water supply port is arranged on the side wall of the water tank; the ventilation mechanism comprises a fresh air inlet channel arranged at the rear end of the external shell, a return air channel arranged at the rear part of the top end of the external shell, a fresh air outlet channel arranged at the front part of the top end of the external shell, and a fresh air supply fan and a return air fan which are respectively arranged at the front side and the rear side of the humidification mechanism; the device has the advantages of large steam amount, obvious humidifying effect, safe use and energy saving; the centralized control panel can be integrated to set specific temperature and humidity; the humidifier can be externally hung on other air conditioning equipment for auxiliary use and humidification.

title_en: Air sterilizing device and air processing equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of disinfection and sterilization and discloses an air sterilization device. The air sterilization device comprises a sterilization part, a ventilation pipeline and a fan; the sterilization part is set to emit electromagnetic wave with specific frequency band to sterilize; the ventilation pipeline is wound on the sterilization part and comprises an air inlet and an air outlet; the fan is arranged on the ventilation pipeline and is set to drive air to flow from the air inlet to the air outlet. This application is through with the ventilation pipeline around locating the portion of disinfecting that can launch the electromagnetic wave of specific frequency band, make specific frequency band electromagnetic wave radiation in the ventilation pipeline, in order to fully disinfect to the air in the ventilation pipeline, the ventilation pipeline is around locating the portion of disinfecting that can launch the electromagnetic wave of specific frequency band, it is more abundant to make the electromagnetic wave of specific frequency band to the radiation of ventilation pipeline also, the realization is effectively disinfected to air in the ventilation pipeline, improve the cleanliness factor that air treatment equipment blew out the air, thereby improve indoor environment's air quality. The application also discloses an air treatment device.

title_en: Multi-split system control method, control device, multi-split system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-split system control method, a control device, a multi-split system and a storage medium, wherein the multi-split system control method comprises the following steps: starting the multi-split system, and adjusting the frequency of a compressor; acquiring the difference between the actual evaporation temperature and the target evaporation temperature of a plurality of started indoor units and the variation of the difference; wherein the frequency of the compressor is adjusted according to the variation of the temperature difference. The invention solves the technical problems that the refrigeration effect of each indoor unit in the multi-split air conditioner is unbalanced, so that some indoor units are shut down when frequently reaching the set temperature and some indoor units cannot reach the set temperature for a long time, and realizes the technical effect of balancing the refrigeration effect of each indoor unit.

title_en: Passivation method for aluminum alloy micro-channel radiator inner surface flow channel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a passivation method for an inner surface flow channel of an aluminum alloy micro-channel radiator, and belongs to the technical field of passivation processes. The method specifically comprises the following steps: 1) before passivation, immersing the microchannel radiator into NaOH solution for electrochemical polishing; 2) in the passivation process, a 2-electrode electrochemical system is adopted to regulate the voltage of a direct current power supply at a certain speed, wherein a platinum counter electrode immersed in electrolyte is connected with the negative electrode of the direct current power supply, and a metal microchannel radiator is connected with the positive electrode of the direct current power supply; 3) leading the inner surface flow channel of the micro-channel radiator to be filled with the electrolyte through a PV hose; 4) after passivation, washing the microchannel radiator with deionized water, and drying in the air; 5) and carrying out hole sealing treatment on the micro-channel radiator. The invention can form a uniform and compact anodic aluminum oxide layer on the inner surface of the micro-channel, and can improve the corrosion resistance of the micro-channel in the micro-channel radiator.

title_en: Supergravity high-temperature metallurgy device and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a supergravity high-temperature metallurgical device which comprises a high-temperature reactor box body, wherein the high-temperature reactor box body is divided into a high-temperature metallurgical area and a driving area, the high-temperature metallurgical area is positioned above the driving area, a centrifugal machine rotating shaft penetrates through the high-temperature metallurgical area in the vertical direction, a high-temperature resistance furnace and a balancing device are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the centrifugal machine rotating shaft, a driving component is fixedly connected in the driving area and positioned below the high-temperature metallurgical area, the driving component is in transmission connection with the centrifugal machine rotating shaft, a rotary guide ring sealed by magnetofluid in the high-temperature resistance furnace is communicated with a gas source assembly, a heating component and a thermocouple are arranged in the high-temperature resistance furnace, the heating component and the thermocouple are electrically connected with a measurement and control system through sliding conducting rings, and the measurement and control system is fixedly arranged at the top of the outer side of the high-temperature reactor box body. The invention provides a technical and equipment foundation for scientific research and technical development of a novel supergravity high-temperature metallurgy technology.

title_en: Voice-controlled atomizer and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a voice control atomizer and a method thereof, wherein the voice control atomizer comprises: the machine body comprises a base, a shell and an upper cover, wherein the bottom of the shell is connected with the base, and the top of the shell is provided with a connecting seat and the upper cover; the upper cover is provided with a mist guide sealing cover, and an air guide pipeline is arranged in the shell; the connecting seat is arranged between the shell and the upper cover, the top end of the connecting seat is connected with the upper cover, and the bottom end of the connecting seat is connected with the top wall of the shell; the atomizing mechanism comprises an air pump assembly and an atomizing assembly, and the air pump assembly is connected with the atomizing assembly through the air guide pipeline; and the voice control mechanism is arranged above the base and is in circuit connection with the air pump assembly. The invention adopts the system action of the voice control mechanism and the atomization mechanism, picks up voice information and converts an audio control command into a control signal to control the atomization mechanism, so that the product is more intelligent, the detachable connecting seat is arranged, the contact air tightness is increased in the installation state, and the atomization effect is ensured.

title_en: Control method and device for refrigeration equipment, refrigeration equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of refrigeration equipment and discloses a control method for refrigeration equipment, which comprises the steps of obtaining water temperature information of chilled water exchanging heat with an evaporator; according to the water temperature information, load information and an energy coefficient of the compressor are determined; determining a first load coefficient corresponding to the current rotation speed of the compressor according to the rotation speed of the compressor and the load information; and adjusting the current rotating speed of the compressor according to the energy coefficient and the first load coefficient so as to obtain the target rotating speed of the compressor. The method can improve the stability of water temperature control of the refrigeration equipment. The application also discloses a control device for the refrigeration equipment, the refrigeration equipment and a storage medium.

title_en: Method and device for self-cleaning of heat pump dryer, heat pump dryer and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of heat pump dryers, and discloses a method for self-cleaning of a heat pump dryer, which comprises the following steps: triggering the first drying system to be in a stop running state, and triggering the second electronic expansion valve to be in a closed state; adjusting the valve opening degree of the dehumidification electronic expansion valve to enable the temperature of a coil of the dehumidification evaporator to be within a set temperature range; and triggering the second compressor to stop running after the temperature of the coil of the dehumidification evaporator is in the set temperature interval for a preset duration. The second electronic expansion valve is closed by stopping the operation of the first drying system, the second evaporator stops refrigerating, the valve opening of the electronic expansion valve is adjusted, the surface of the dehumidifying evaporator frosts, and the second compressor is stopped after the operation lasts for the preset time, so that the surface of the dehumidifying evaporator stops refrigerating and defrosting are carried out, and self-cleaning of the heat pump dryer is achieved. The application also discloses a device for self-cleaning of the heat pump dryer, the heat pump dryer and a storage medium.

title_en: Heavy metal removing agent direct-in-furnace blending combustion system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for directly feeding heavy metal removal agent into a furnace for blending combustion, wherein the system comprises a belt, a middle storage bin, a feeding hole, a dust remover and a boiler furnace, the belt is connected with the middle storage bin, the middle storage bin is connected with the boiler furnace through the feeding hole, one side of the boiler furnace is provided with a cyclone separator, and a discharging hole of the cyclone separator is connected with the dust remover. The method is characterized in that a belt is additionally arranged beside an original conveying belt and conveyed to a middle storage bin through the belt, then a heavy metal removing agent is conveyed into a boiler hearth through a shaftless angle dragon, and after adsorption reaction, the heavy metal removing agent is reacted in a dust remover through a tail flue. The belt is arranged through the remover bypass, the dust of the heavy metal remover is sent into the boiler hearth through the blanking port by the middle storage bin, the concentration of heavy metal particles in the smoke discharged by the fire coal is effectively reduced through the adsorption effect of the remover on heavy metal ions, and the pollution of the coal-based thermal power plant to the environment is further reduced through reducing the pollution of heavy metals to the environment.

title_en: Carbon-reducing emission-reducing semi-coke production system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a semi-coke production system for reducing carbon and emission and also discloses a semi-coke production method for reducing carbon and emission. Has the advantages that: the effective gas components in the coal gas can be greatly improved, so that the quality of the coal gas is improved, the coal gas meets the process standard of chemical raw material gas, and the economic value of the coal gas is improved; the reaction temperature in the coking furnace can be controlled within a certain range, and a non-coke powder semi-coke product can be obtained, is used for the industries of ferroalloy, calcium carbide, synthetic ammonia and the like, and can volatilize most of volatile components to improve the gas yield of coal gas; by incorporation of CO 2 For coke ovens and gas turbinesThe combustion part plays a role in protection, and the damage to the combustion part caused by too high reaction temperature is avoided; the content of nitrogen oxides in the flue gas generated by the gas turbine can be used for preparing food-grade liquid carbon dioxide or sending the liquid carbon dioxide to a calcium carbide post to be used as inert gas shielding gas for production; without discharging CO 2 The purposes of carbon reduction and emission reduction are realized, and the production concept of green and low carbon is met.

title_en: Double-working medium combined cycle heat pump device
abstract_en: The invention provides a double-working-medium combined cycle heat pump device, belonging to the technical field of refrigeration and heat pumps. The compressor is provided with a circulating working medium channel which is communicated with the heat supplier and then divided into two paths, wherein the first path is communicated with the heat regenerator through the expander, the second path is communicated with the second compressor, the second compressor is also provided with a circulating working medium channel which is communicated with the heat regenerator, then the heat regenerator is provided with a condensate liquid pipeline which is communicated with the evaporator through the throttle valve, the evaporator is also provided with a circulating working medium channel which is communicated with the heat regenerator through the third compressor, and the heat regenerator is also provided with a circulating working medium channel which is communicated with the compressor; the low-temperature compressor is provided with a circulating working medium channel which is communicated with the low-temperature evaporator through the evaporator and the low-temperature throttle valve, and the low-temperature evaporator is also provided with a circulating working medium channel which is communicated with the low-temperature compressor; the heat supply device is also provided with a heated medium channel communicated with the outside, the low-temperature evaporator is also provided with a low-temperature heat medium channel communicated with the outside, and the expander is connected with the compressor and transmits power to form the double-working-medium combined cycle heat pump device.

title_en: Multifunctional energy-saving emission-reducing planting container
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional energy-saving emission-reduction planting container, and relates to the technical field of agricultural facilities. Comprises a planting container, an air energy cooling and heating dual-supply device, an agricultural product fresh-keeping chamber and a drying chamber; the aerial fog cultivation planting module is arranged in the planting box, and the outer layer of the planting box is provided with a water tank jacket layer; the air energy cooling and heating dual-supply device is divided into a summer cooling and drying system and a winter heating and refreshing system; the summer refrigerating and drying system comprises an external heat pump unit and a drying chamber, wherein the external heat pump unit introduces hot gas into the drying chamber, and cold gas tail gas is introduced into the planting box; the winter heating and fresh-keeping system comprises a built-in heat pump unit, a water tank jacket layer on the outer layer of the planting box and a fresh-keeping chamber, the built-in heat pump unit heats the water tank, and cold air is introduced into the fresh-keeping chamber. The invention overcomes the defects of large electric energy consumption, high planting cost and poor energy-saving and emission-reducing benefits in the movable planting cabin in the prior art, and further realizes water conservation and environmental protection by aerial fog cultivation and rainwater collection.

title_en: Self-cleaning water heater and control method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a self-cleaning water heater and a control method thereof, relates to the technical field of water heaters, and comprises the following steps: the water heater body, the water heater body has internal pipeline and driving piece, the water heater body is provided with the self-cleaning assembly with the internal pipeline intercommunication, self-cleaning assembly is connected with the controller, the controller control self-cleaning assembly releases the sanitizer to the internal pipeline to through the operation of driving piece, with drive sanitizer internal loop, in order to wash the internal pipeline, the internal pipeline still communicates there is the blow off pipe, sewage after the washing flows through the blow off pipe. Through setting up self-cleaning assembly to automatic control's mode can make the water heater have self-cleaning's function, avoids influencing the entering of temperature rate of heating and discharge because of remaining incrustation scale in the water heater, improves customer experience and feels, has also reduced the cost of maintenance that the complaint produced simultaneously.

title_en: Control method, cooking appliance and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control method, a cooking appliance and a storage medium. The control method comprises the following steps: under the condition of receiving a starting instruction, controlling a display screen of the cooking appliance to display the start of cooking; acquiring the temperature of the probe and a target temperature; acquiring the temperature of the food according to the temperature of the probe; controlling the display screen to display a first state under the condition that the temperature of the food is lower than a first preset temperature; under the condition that the temperature of the food is not less than the first preset temperature, controlling the display screen to display a second state and acquiring the induction ending temperature; and under the condition that the temperature of the probe is greater than the induction end temperature, acquiring the estimated time length according to the induction end temperature and the target temperature and controlling a display screen to display the estimated time length in a countdown mode. In the control method, the temperature of the food is obtained by inserting the temperature of the probe of the food, and the display screen is controlled to display the corresponding state and the estimated duration of the cooking residual according to the temperature of the food and/or the target temperature, so that a user can know the cooking state of the food.

title_en: Raw flue gas hydrothermal utilization system based on ceramic membrane flue gas hydrothermal trapping device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a raw flue gas hydrothermal utilization system based on a ceramic membrane flue gas hydrothermal trapping device. The heat recovered from the flue gas is used for heating the condensed water of the power plant, and the recovered water is used as the water supplement of the desulfurizing tower. The invention can effectively save water for a power plant, firstly, the system can recover moisture in the flue gas, and secondly, the system reduces the temperature of the flue gas at the inlet of the desulfurizing tower so as to reduce the water consumption of the desulfurizing tower. The invention can reduce the energy consumption of the power plant, recover the waste heat of the flue gas and preheat the condensed water of the power plant, reduce the steam extraction quantity of the steam turbine, improve the power of the generator and reduce the coal consumption at the same time. Provides an effective way for energy conservation and emission reduction of power plants.

title_en: Control method of air conditioner
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of air conditioners, and particularly provides a control method of an air conditioner, aiming at solving the problems that a large amount of bacteria and viruses are bred after the running time of the air conditioner is prolonged, the oxygen content in the air of an indoor space is reduced and the like in the prior art. To this end, the control method of the present invention includes: obtaining a first bacterial content in air of an indoor space; judging whether the content of the first bacteria exceeds a first preset value; and selectively controlling the hydrogen peroxide generation device and the fan to be started based on the judgment result. According to the invention, whether the hydrogen peroxide generation device and the fan are started or not is determined based on the content of the first bacteria in the air of the indoor space, the introduction of fresh air and hydrogen peroxide molecules can be controlled according to the actual situation of the indoor space, the sterilization effect can be ensured, the air condition of the indoor space is improved, and the electric energy can be saved.

title_en: Heat energy source heat exchange method for artificial underground circulation ditch
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heat energy source heat exchange method for an artificial underground circulation ditch. The first step is to build an artificial underground circulation ditch heat energy exchange system which comprises a recharging tank, a filter layer, a permeable heat exchange filling layer, a conduction and permeation prevention layer, a water outlet, a circulating pump and a circulating tank, wherein the ditch is excavated underground, the conduction and permeation prevention layers are laid at the bottom and the two sides of the ditch, the permeable heat exchange filling layer and the filter layer are laid on the conduction and permeation prevention layers, the two ends of the permeable heat exchange filling layer are connected with the filter layer, the two ends of the filter layer are respectively connected with one end of a water outlet pipe and the lower end of a water inlet pipe, the other end of the water outlet pipe is arranged at the upper part of the circulating tank, and the circulating pump is arranged at the bottom of the circulating tank.

title_en: One-driving-multiple air conditioner
abstract_en: According to the one-to-many air conditioner of the present invention, the three pipes, i.e., the high-pressure pipe, the low-pressure pipe, and the liquid pipe, are connected to the plurality of indoor units, so that a part of the indoor units can be driven to perform cooling and another part of the indoor units can be driven to perform heating, and waste heat discharged from the indoor units driven to perform heating can be recovered and utilized.

title_en: Heating equipment of integrated humidification system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure discloses a heating device integrated with a humidifying system. The heating device comprises an air outlet, and is characterized in that the humidifying system comprises a humidifying net component integrated to the heating device, the humidifying net component is arranged to the air outlet, and in an operating state, warm air of the air outlet acts on the soaked humidifying net component to generate humid air. This embodiment can act on the humidification net subassembly when the heating equipment blows out the warm air through setting up the humidification net subassembly to the air outlet. When under the effect of this warm braw, improved the temperature of this humidification net subassembly, and then improved the saturated water content of air. Therefore, the amount of evaporation of the moisture on the humidification mesh assembly can be greatly increased, and the amount of humidification can be further increased.

title_en: Mixed solar energy efficient thermodynamic device and hydrogen-oxygen pair for generating multiple energies
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power generation system comprising a solar energy collection device and a power generation device, characterized in that the generator comprises an absorber (5), the absorber (5) receiving solar energy for heating a thermodynamic device, the absorber (5) being arranged in an optional heating zone by means of a burner (8).

title_en: Absorption heat exchanger unit for deep recycling of flue gas waste heat
abstract_en: An absorption heat exchanger unit for deep recycling of flue gas waste heat relates to the technical field of waste heat recycling. The unit comprises a flue gas cooling and dehumidifying module, a waste heat recovery module and a condensate water processing module. The flue gas cooling and dehumidifying module comprises a flue gas heat exchanger and a circulating water tank, wherein the flue gas heat exchanger is horizontally arranged, a flue gas inlet, a flue gas outlet and a circulating water inlet are arranged on the flue gas heat exchanger, a spraying device connected with the circulating water inlet is arranged at the top end of an inner cavity of the flue gas heat exchanger, and a water outlet of the circulating water tank is connected to the waste heat recovery module through a waste heat circulating water pump; the condensed water treatment module is an automatic dosing device, and the automatic dosing device is connected to the circulating water tank. The invention can utilize boiler hot water or steam to drive the heat exchange unit, and heat boiler water supplement or heat supply network water return after recovering flue gas waste heat, thereby obviously improving the wet smoke plume phenomenon of boiler smoke discharge, improving the thermal efficiency of the boiler, and having the characteristics of wide application range, low construction difficulty and relatively small occupied area.

title_en: Particle heat absorber with load adjusting function
abstract_en: The invention provides a particle heat absorber with a load adjusting function, which comprises: the heat absorption device comprises a shell, a heat absorption pipe and a heat absorption pipe, wherein a heat absorption port is formed in the shell; the adjusting plate is obliquely and rotatably arranged in the shell; the inclined plate is obliquely arranged in the shell; the height adjusting piece is used for adjusting the vertical distance between the inclined plate and the inner bottom wall of the shell; the inclined plate is connected with the adjusting plate through the towing piece; a first cold particle inlet; a second cold particle inlet; the hot particle bin is arranged at the bottom of the shell. According to the particle heat absorber with the load adjusting function, when the heat absorber is subjected to variable load, the flow of particles needs to be adjusted, and the adjustment of the flow of the particles is changed from adjusting the thickness of the curtain to a conventional particle flow adjusting mode, so that the heat absorber is high in load adjusting precision, small in adjusting difficulty and low in adjusting equipment price, meanwhile, in the load adjusting process of the heat absorber, the sparsity of the particle curtain is not changed, and the heat absorbing efficiency is higher under the working condition of variable load.

title_en: Negative ion impregnated paper and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses negative ion impregnated paper which comprises base paper, a melamine resin layer, a negative ion glue layer and a negative ion coating from inside to outside; the melamine resin layer is formed by curing melamine glue; the negative ion glue layer is formed by solidifying negative ion glue prepared from a negative ion mixed solution and melamine glue; the negative ion mixed solution consists of tourmaline powder, nano titanium dioxide, polyvinylpyrrolidone, camphor, lemon oil, ethanol and water; the negative ion coating is formed by spraying and drying the negative ion mixed liquid. The anion impregnated paper has strong anion release capacity, and can effectively improve the air purification efficiency; meanwhile, the water-soluble polyurethane has a large surface contact angle and strong hydrophobicity.

title_en: Range hood with adjustable body length
abstract_en: The invention provides a range hood with an adjustable body length, which belongs to the technical field of range hoods and comprises a case, a smoke collecting cavity and a smoke collecting cavity, wherein the case comprises an upper case body connected with an air duct and a lower case body arranged below the upper case body; two sets of movable assemblies are respectively arranged at the left side and the right side above the lower box body, each movable assembly comprises a movable piece and a translation mechanism for driving the movable piece to translate, and the translation mechanisms drive the movable pieces to laterally extend out of the lower box body or furl into the upper part of the lower box body. The invention has the advantage of adapting to different kitchen spaces.

title_en: Dehumidifier and control method
abstract_en: The invention provides a dehumidifier and a control method, wherein the dehumidifier comprises a shell, a filter screen assembly and a cleaning assembly; the shell is provided with an air inlet; the filter screen assembly comprises a filter screen and a filter screen driving mechanism, wherein the filter screen is arranged at the air inlet and can be controlled to move at the air inlet; the cleaning component comprises a hairbrush which is arranged on the motion path of the filter screen and is in contact with the filter screen; when the filter screen is controlled to do unidirectional circular motion or bidirectional reciprocating motion, the brush can clean dust on the filter screen; the filter screen driving mechanism comprises a first rotating shaft and a second rotating shaft, and the driving motor drives the second rotating shaft to rotate so as to move the filter screen; the structure is simple, the cleaning process is optimized, the cleaning coverage is large, the cleaning is comprehensive, and the cleaning efficiency is improved; the automation degree is high, and the problem that the cleaning process is complicated when the filter screen is manually cleaned is solved; the problem that dust falling off from the filter screen easily enters the dehumidifier when the brush moves is avoided.

title_en: Ventilation energy-saving equipment for green building
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ventilation energy-saving device for a green building, which belongs to the field of building ventilation and comprises a rotating pipe, wherein a plurality of fan blades are arranged on the outer surface of the rotating pipe, the rotating pipe is rotatably sleeved on the outer side of a fixed pipe, a bottom ring is arranged on the outer wall of the top end of the fixed pipe, a top plate is arranged on the bottom ring through a support rod, the top plate is positioned above the fixed pipe and the rotating pipe, a mesh enclosure is arranged on the bottom wall of the top plate, a cleaning brush is arranged on the outer side wall of the mesh enclosure in a sliding manner, a fan is arranged inside the fixed pipe, and the fan is arranged at the bottom of a main shaft; the invention can utilize natural wind and the motor to drive the fan to rotate, quickly blow outdoor fresh air into the room, improve the comfort level of the indoor environment, simultaneously improve the quality of the blown air by filtering dust in the air, and the device has a self-cleaning effect and saves the cost of manual cleaning.

title_en: Green energy-saving building wall
abstract_en: The invention relates to a green energy-saving building wall, which comprises a plurality of wall structures, wherein a plurality of mounting transverse beams are arranged on the outer side of each wall structure along the height direction, a plurality of energy-saving turnover mechanisms are arranged between adjacent mounting transverse eaves beams, each energy-saving turnover mechanism comprises an energy-saving turnover plate, a heat exchange bent pipe is arranged in each energy-saving turnover plate, the upper end and the lower end of one side of each energy-saving turnover plate are respectively connected with the mounting transverse beams at the upper part and the lower part in a rotatable axial positioning manner, the upper end of each heat exchange bent pipe is communicated with a water distribution pipe in the mounting transverse beam at the upper part through the upper end of one side of each energy-saving turnover plate in a rotatable axial positioning manner, the lower end of each heat exchange bent pipe is communicated with the water distribution pipe in the mounting transverse beam at the lower part through the lower end of one side of each energy-saving turnover plate in a rotatable axial positioning manner, and the water distribution pipes are communicated with an underground water storage tank through a water inlet main pipe and a water exchange main pipe. The invention adopts the building wall scheme of the energy-saving turnover mechanism which is arranged on the outer side of the wall and used for collecting solar energy, and has the characteristic of better energy-saving effect.

title_en: Steam generating equipment and heat exchange device thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quick steam generating device with energy saving, high efficiency and high reliability and a heat exchange device thereof, wherein the heat exchange device for the steam generating device comprises: a housing; a first coil unit and a second coil unit located within the housing; an inner space surrounded by the first coil unit is configured as a combustion chamber; the second coil unit surrounds the first coil unit; a spacing structure is arranged between the second coil unit and the first coil unit; a first flue gas flow channel is arranged between the first coil pipe unit and the spacing structure; a second flue gas channel is formed between the spacing structure and the shell; the second flue gas flow channel is communicated with the downstream of the first flue gas flow channel; the flow direction of the flue gas flowing into the second flue gas flow channel from the first flue gas flow channel is changed by more than 150 degrees; the first coil pipe unit is provided with a communicated flue gas channel which is used for communicating the first flue gas channel with the combustion chamber.

title_en: Switchable silencer and air conditioner
abstract_en: A switchable silencer and an air conditioner comprise a silencer, a branch pipe and a fixing device, wherein an outlet and an inlet of the silencer are respectively connected with the branch pipe through the fixing device, and an adjusting device with a plurality of gears is further arranged inside the fixing device. The switchable silencer and the air conditioner solve the problems of much time consumption and waste of refrigerant in the process of improper silencer design, can adjust the working state of the silencer in the running state of an air conditioner outdoor unit, and can ensure that silencers of different specifications can be replaced in the non-stop state.

title_en: Boiler combustion explosion-proof equipment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of boiler explosion prevention, and particularly relates to boiler combustion explosion-proof equipment which comprises a boiler body, wherein an upper feeding chamber is arranged above the boiler body, a side feeding chamber is arranged on the side edge of the boiler body, a steam pipeline is fixedly arranged on the boiler body, which is close to one side of the side feeding chamber, of the upper feeding chamber, an explosion-proof module is arranged below the steam pipeline in the boiler body, a first explosion-proof baffle and a second explosion-proof baffle for preventing further explosion and the like are arranged on the explosion-proof module in a sliding manner, the first explosion-proof baffle is close to one side of a valve of the upper feeding chamber, the second explosion-proof baffle is close to one side of a valve of the side feeding chamber, a switching module for changing pressure relief flux is arranged in the explosion-proof module, and a first-stage air inlet channel is arranged on the side edge of the steam channel.

title_en: Ultralow-load combustion device suitable for tangential boiler
abstract_en: An ultralow-load combustion device suitable for a tangential boiler relates to the technical field of combustion boilers, in particular to an ultralow-load combustion device suitable for a tangential boiler. The invention provides an ultra-low load combustion device, which is characterized in that a layer of low-capacity pulverized coal burner is additionally arranged on an original uppermost layer of primary air burner, a layer of secondary air nozzle is additionally arranged on the low-capacity pulverized coal burner, a new small-capacity pulverized coal giving device is additionally arranged, and the small-capacity pulverized coal giving device is communicated with the low-capacity pulverized coal burner-5 tangential boiler reconstruction structures. The ultralow-load combustion device can realize the long-term stable operation of the boiler with 15% rated load and below without any auxiliary combustion supporting means such as oil, gas, plasma, oxygen enrichment and the like.

title_en: Extract type torch combustion system and combustion method
abstract_en: The invention provides an extract type torch combustion system and an extract type torch combustion method. The invention adopts the reburning structure with dual functions of catalytic combustion and heat storage-assisted reburning, on one hand, the reburning structure accumulates heat and performs flameless combustion on the passing mixed gas, thereby improving the reliability of the reburning, on the other hand, the mixed gas is subjected to catalytic combustion, thereby improving the combustion efficiency and cleanliness, reducing the emission of pollutants such as soot and the like, and partially eliminating the problem of carbon deposition.

title_en: Air conditioner control method and device and air conditioner
abstract_en: The invention provides an air conditioner control method and device and an air conditioner, and relates to the technical field of air conditioning. The method comprises the following steps: determining that a heater in the bathroom is started and the temperature in the bathroom is lower than a first preset temperature; controlling an air outlet mode of the air conditioner according to the operation information of the air conditioner; under the condition that the warmer is in a standby state, controlling the running frequency of a compressor of the air conditioner according to the temperature in the bathroom; and under the condition that the heater is in a working state, controlling the running frequency of the compressor according to the gear information of the heater. The air conditioner control method and device and the air conditioner are beneficial to improving the working efficiency, the control efficiency and the intelligent degree of the air conditioner and enhancing the user experience.

title_en: Inlet ring subassembly, centrifugal fan and lampblack absorber
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of kitchen electrical equipment, in particular to an air inlet ring assembly, a centrifugal fan and a range hood. The wind ring assembly comprises a wind ring main body, a plurality of pre-rotation assemblies and a power assembly, wherein the wind ring main body surrounds the outer side of an air inlet of the fan, the pre-rotation assemblies are circumferentially distributed on the wind ring main body at intervals, a pre-rotation flow channel is formed between two adjacent pre-rotation assemblies, the pre-rotation assemblies are connected with the wind ring main body in a rotating mode, the power assembly is arranged on a shell of the fan, the power assembly drives the pre-rotation assemblies to deflect at the same angle at the same time, so that the deflection angle of the pre-rotation assemblies can be actively and accurately controlled according to different working conditions, different degrees of pre-rotation air flows are guided, reasonable deflection of the air flows is achieved, optimal pre-rotation effects are achieved under different working conditions, the performance of the centrifugal fan is improved, and impact noise caused by air flow separation of the air flow channels is reduced.

title_en: Zero-live wire self-adjusting circuit and method and air conditioner
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a zero-live wire self-adjusting circuit, a method and an air conditioner, wherein the zero-live wire self-adjusting circuit comprises the following components: the zero line detection module, the zero line selection switch module, the MCU and the switch driving module; the first power wire is connected with the first end of the zero line detection module, the first power wire is connected with the first end of the zero line selection switch module, the second power wire is connected with the second end of the zero line selection switch module, and the third end of the zero line selection switch module is connected with the zero line communication module; the second end of the zero line detection module is grounded, the third end of the zero line detection module is connected with the first end of the MCU, the second end of the MCU is connected with the first end of the switch driving module, and the second end of the switch driving module is connected with the fourth end of the zero line selection switch module. Through the mutual cooperation of the zero line detection module, the zero line selection switch module, the MCU and the switch driving module, the zero line can be detected and the zero line communication module can be accessed, so that the zero line and the live line do not need to be distinguished in indoor and outdoor installation.

title_en: Heat exchange module and cabinet
abstract_en: The heat exchange module is applied to the cabinet, the cabinet further comprises a cabinet body, the cabinet body is provided with a first space and a second space, the temperature of the first space is higher than that of the second space, the heat exchange module is provided with a first air circulation system and a second air circulation system, and heat exchange can be carried out between the first air circulation system and the second air circulation system; an air inlet and an air outlet of the first air circulation system are both used for being communicated with the first space; and the air outlet of the second air circulation system is communicated with the external space, and the air inlet of the second air circulation system is selectively used for being communicated with the external space and/or the second space. According to the heat dissipation requirements of the first space and the second space, an air inlet of the second air circulation system is selected to take air from the external space and/or the second space, heat dissipation of the first space and/or the second space can be achieved through one heat exchange module, and flexibility is high.

title_en: Electronic ignition and flame detection circuit
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electronic ignition and flame detection circuit which comprises a control chip, a first booster circuit, an energy storage circuit, an ion probe, a second booster circuit, a flame detection circuit, an electromagnetic valve and a valve control circuit, wherein the first booster circuit is connected with a first signal output port; the energy storage circuit is connected with the first booster circuit; the second booster circuit is respectively connected with the energy storage circuit and the ion probe; the input end of the flame detection circuit is connected with the second signal output port, and the output end of the flame detection circuit is connected with the flame detection port; the valve control circuit is respectively connected with the battery valve and the gas valve control port. According to the invention, the ignition operation is realized by arranging the first booster circuit, the energy storage circuit and the second booster circuit, intelligent ignition is realized, real-time flame detection is carried out by the flame detection circuit, the output of the first signal output port can be closed in time after flame exists, so that the service life of an electronic device for realizing the ignition function is long, and the intelligent control of the electromagnetic valve is realized by the valve control circuit.

title_en: Air volume control method, device and equipment of range hood system and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides an air volume control method, device, equipment and storage medium of a range hood system, and relates to the technical field of range hoods. The method comprises the following steps: determining whether the pot cover is in a working state or not according to temperature data detected by a temperature detection device arranged in the pot cover; if the pot cover is in a working state, determining whether the pot cover is opened or not according to infrared data detected by an infrared detection device arranged in the pot cover; if the pot cover is opened, the operation parameters of the fan in the range hood system are adjusted to target operation parameters and/or the opening angle of the power distribution valve is adjusted to a target opening angle. By applying the embodiment of the application, the air volume adjusting accuracy in the range hood can be improved.

title_en: Silicon carbide vacuum sintering furnace optimization method based on computational heat transfer simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a silicon carbide vacuum sintering furnace optimization method based on computational heat transfer simulation, which comprises the following steps of: establishing a heat radiation and heat conduction model of the vacuum sintering furnace in the heating process according to the parameters of the vacuum sintering furnace body; performing computational heat transfer chemical simulation to obtain a temperature rise curve of the vacuum sintering furnace in the whole heating process; the original furnace type is optimized by calculating and comparing the temperature rise curves of the workpieces at different heating rates, different diameters of the graphite heating pipes, different distances between the graphite heating pipes and the effective heating area, the temperature difference between the vertex workpiece and the central workpiece and the temperature difference between the surface and the core of the same workpiece. According to the invention, through researching the influence of different heating rates, different graphite heating pipe diameters and different distances between the graphite heating pipes and the effective heating area on the heating efficiency and the furnace temperature uniformity of the vacuum sintering furnace, reference is provided for the performance optimization of the vacuum sintering furnace, the production requirements of the silicon carbide vacuum sintering furnace process are met, and the heating efficiency and the furnace temperature uniformity of the heating system are improved.

title_en: Dual-energy totally-enclosed liquid heating equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a double-energy full-closed liquid heating device which comprises: comprises a solar flat plate collector, an electric boiler, a circulating pump, a radiator, a pressure regulating expansion tank and a control center; the solar flat plate collector is connected with an electric boiler through a pipeline, the electric boiler is connected with a circulating pump, a heating plate and a pressure regulating expansion tank through pipelines, the pressure regulating expansion tank is respectively connected with the solar flat plate collector and the electric boiler through pipelines, branch pipelines connected with the electric boiler are respectively provided with a first relay switch and a second relay switch, the solar flat plate collector is respectively provided with a first temperature sensor and a second temperature sensor, a third temperature sensor is arranged in the electric boiler, and the first relay switch, the second relay switch, the first temperature sensor, the second temperature sensor and the third temperature sensor are all connected with a sensing line of a control center; the heating device realizes the maximization of resource utilization by combining the electric energy and the solar energy, saves more electric energy, reduces the power consumption of products and saves the power consumption cost.

title_en: Coal mine low-concentration gas heating device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine low-concentration gas heating device, belonging to the technical field of gas heating equipment; comprises a shell, a feeding pipe, a detection mechanism, a power mechanism and a heating mechanism; the feeding pipe is fixedly arranged in the shell and comprises a guide pipe, and a retainer ring is fixedly arranged on the guide pipe coaxially; the detection mechanism comprises a sealing assembly and a detection assembly, the sealing assembly is coaxially and slidably mounted on the guide pipe, and the detection assembly is fixedly mounted on the sealing assembly; the power mechanism comprises a linear motion unit and a circular motion unit, and the linear motion unit and the circular motion unit are both connected with the detection mechanism; the heating mechanism is fixedly arranged on the shell and heats through low-concentration gas. The invention realizes heating by using low-concentration gas through the detection mechanism, the power mechanism and the heating mechanism, and has simple structure and convenient operation.

title_en: Cigarette machine frame and cigarette machine
abstract_en: The application discloses a smoke machine frame and a smoke machine, wherein the smoke machine frame is provided with a mounting space for mounting a fan assembly, an air outlet mounting hole is formed in the top of the smoke machine frame and used for being connected with an air outlet of the fan assembly, the bottom of the smoke machine frame is used for being connected with a smoke outlet of a smoke diversion assembly of the smoke machine, an air inlet of the fan assembly, the mounting space and the smoke outlet of the smoke diversion assembly are mutually communicated, when the air inlet of the fan assembly in the smoke machine frame faces a first direction, the smoke machine frame can be connected with the first type of smoke diversion assembly, when the air inlet of the fan assembly faces a second direction, the smoke machine frame can be connected with the second type of smoke diversion assembly, and the first direction and the second direction are opposite. The frame of the smoke machine can improve the universalization and standardization degree of the smoke machine.

title_en: Novel building ventilation device for building construction
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of building ventilation devices, and particularly relates to a novel building ventilation device for building construction, which comprises an air inlet pipeline, an air inlet adjusting mechanism, a ventilator, an air purifying box and an air outlet pipeline, wherein the air inlet adjusting mechanism is arranged in the air inlet pipeline and used for adjusting the air inlet amount, the ventilator is arranged and communicated with the air inlet pipeline, the air purifying box is connected with the ventilator pipeline, the air outlet pipeline is communicated with the air purifying box, the tail end of the air outlet pipeline is connected with an air distribution box, and a motor used for driving the air inlet adjusting mechanism is also arranged in the air inlet pipeline.

title_en: Single-machine two-stage screw compression ultra-large ultralow temperature air source heat pump unit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a single-machine two-stage screw compression ultra-large ultralow temperature air source heat pump unit which comprises a shell and tube condenser, an economizer, a high-pressure liquid storage device, an evaporator, a fin heat exchanger, a four-way valve and a single-machine two-stage compressor, wherein the shell and tube condenser is connected with the economizer; the economizer is provided with an inlet and an outlet, one outlet of the economizer is communicated with an inlet of the high-pressure liquid storage device through a pipeline, an electronic expansion valve B is installed on the pipeline, and the other outlet of the economizer is connected with an air suction port B of the single-machine two-stage compressor through a pipeline; the single-machine two-stage compressor is internally provided with a low-pressure compressor cavity and a high-pressure compressor cavity, a pair of intermeshing male and female rotors in each compressor cavity, the low-pressure compressor cavity is provided with an air suction port B, and the high-pressure compressor cavity is provided with an air suction port A. The invention combines the single-machine two-stage screw compression technology with the air-supplying enthalpy-increasing technology, improves the enthalpy value of the refrigerant after absorbing heat in the ultralow temperature environment, improves the energy efficiency ratio of the unit, and realizes the high-quality operation of the unit in the ultralow temperature environment.

title_en: Energy-saving instant drinking machine for boiled water and control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cool boiled energy-saving direct drinking machine and a control method thereof, wherein the cool boiled energy-saving direct drinking machine comprises a shell, a water inlet channel, a water purifying container, a heat dissipation device, a first water pump, a heating device, a water outlet channel, a hot water channel and a cool boiled water channel, which are arranged in the shell, wherein the water inlet channel is connected with a water source and the water purifying container, the cool boiled water channel is respectively connected with the water purifying container, the heat dissipation device is arranged in the water purifying container and is communicated with the hot water channel and the cool boiled water channel, the water outlet channel is connected with the water purifying container and the hot water channel, the heating device and the first water pump are respectively arranged on the water outlet channel, the hot water channel is also provided with a hot water electromagnetic valve, and one end of the hot water channel and one end of the cool boiled water channel respectively extend out of the shell to be used as a hot water outlet and a cool boiled water outlet.

title_en: Variable frequency control automatic cooling device of closed cooling tower
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cooling towers, in particular to a variable frequency control automatic cooling device of a closed cooling tower, which comprises a cooling tower main body, wherein a condensing mechanism is arranged in the cooling tower main body, a spraying mechanism is arranged on the cooling tower main body, a warning mechanism is arranged in the cooling tower main body, an adding mechanism is arranged on the warning mechanism, an adjusting mechanism is arranged on the spraying mechanism, and a defogging mechanism is arranged on the cooling tower main body; the warning mechanism is arranged in the cooling tower main body, so that an alarm is conveniently given when circulating water is about to be consumed, the circulating water is prevented from being not supplemented, and the cooling effect of the cooling tower main body is ensured; the adding mechanism is arranged on the warning mechanism, so that corresponding softening agent can be conveniently and automatically added into circulating water when needed, and metal ion precipitation is avoided, and therefore the spray assembly is prevented from being blocked; the demisting mechanism is arranged on the cooling tower main body, so that steam fog generated in the cooling process can be eliminated conveniently in operation, and accidents are reduced.

title_en: Refrigerating system with powerful spray/steam function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a refrigerating system with a powerful spray/vapor function, which comprises a condenser, an evaporator, an expansion valve and a compressor, wherein the compressor, the condenser, the expansion valve, the evaporator and the compressor are sequentially connected to form a main loop for completing a refrigerating or heating process, and the refrigerating system also comprises a refrigerant pump, wherein the refrigerant pump pumps liquid or vapor refrigerant condensed by the condenser into a compression cavity of the compressor. The refrigerant pump, the condenser and the compressor form a cooling loop for forcedly injecting the refrigerant into the compression cavity of the compressor at specific time, and the injection pressure is controllable.

title_en: Energy storage device capable of automatically separating non-condensable gas
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy storage device capable of automatically separating non-condensable gas.A non-condensable gas collecting and discharging assembly is arranged at the input end of a steam energy accumulator body and is positioned below the liquid level or is matched with the liquid level; the controller is electrically connected with the non-condensable gas collecting and discharging assembly; the controller is electrically connected with the first temperature sensor and acquires a first temperature provided by the first temperature sensor, and the controller calculates a second pressure corresponding to the liquid according to the acquired first temperature; the controller is electrically connected with the second pressure sensor and simultaneously acquires a third pressure provided by the second pressure sensor; the controller compares the third pressure with the second pressure, when the third pressure is greater than the second pressure, the amount of the non-condensable gas in the non-condensable gas collecting and discharging assembly exceeds a set value of the controller, and the controller controls the non-condensable gas collecting and discharging assembly to be opened to discharge the non-condensable gas or the mixed gas of the non-condensable gas and the steam. The invention has the advantage of automatically discharging non-condensable gas.

title_en: Solar cell bracket
abstract_en: The invention discloses a solar cell bracket which comprises a telescopic rail, wherein the telescopic rail comprises a plurality of hollow rail sections, two adjacent rail sections are connected in a sleeved mode, a plurality of groups of sliding piece sets capable of moving relative to the telescopic rail are arranged on the telescopic rail, each group of sliding piece sets is used for supporting a cell mounting frame, each group of sliding piece sets comprises a first sliding portion and a second sliding portion, the first sliding portion is movably connected with one side edge of the cell mounting frame, a telescopic rod is movably connected to the back side of the cell mounting frame, and the other end of the telescopic rod is movably connected with the second sliding portion. The invention solves the problem that the existing solar cell bracket is difficult to move.

title_en: W-shaped radiant tube support structure for smoke circulation and reburning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of metallurgy, in particular to a W-shaped radiant tube support structure for smoke circulation and reburning, which comprises a left wall and a right wall, wherein a first transverse tube and a second transverse tube are horizontally arranged on the left wall, and a first elbow and a second elbow which are respectively and fixedly connected with the first transverse tube and the second transverse tube are fixedly arranged on the right wall. The clamping plate is fixed at the appointed part under the action of the anti-skidding mechanism, so that the clamping plate is prevented from sliding to one end close to the first elbow, the effect of ensuring that one ends of the second transverse pipe and the third transverse pipe close to the third elbow can be acted by an upward force is achieved, and the drooping degree of the second transverse pipe and the third transverse pipe is reduced; when using for a long time and leading to the impaired fracture of cardboard, stop letting in the gas in to the radiant tube, treat the radiant tube cooling back that gets off, the shrink of memory alloy silk, the cardboard can rotate around first violently pipe this moment to can take out the cardboard through rotatory cardboard, consequently played quick replacement's effect.

title_en: Air conditioner
abstract_en: Provided is an air conditioner which can save energy. An air conditioner of one embodiment includes a 1 st and a 2 nd indoor heat exchangers, an outdoor heat exchanger, 1 st to 4 th pipes, a compressor, an ejector, a 1 st expansion valve, and a gas-liquid separator. The ejector is provided with an outlet port connected to the 1 st indoor heat exchanger, a 1 st outlet port connected to the 2 nd indoor heat exchanger, and a 2 nd inlet port, and mixes and boosts the refrigerant supplied to the 1 st inlet port and the refrigerant supplied to the 2 nd inlet port, and supplies the mixed refrigerant from the outlet port to the 1 st indoor heat exchanger. The gas-liquid separator includes a 1 st opening connected to the outdoor heat exchanger, a 2 nd opening connected to the 1 st expansion valve and through which the liquid refrigerant passes, and a 3 rd opening connected to the 2 nd inflow port and through which the gas-containing refrigerant passes.

title_en: Rotary negative pressure balancing system
abstract_en: The application discloses a rotary negative pressure balancing system, which can comprise a spacer body, wherein the spacer body is used for spacing a room from the inside to the outside of the room; the room is provided with a negative pressure generating device which can enable the indoor space of the room to generate a negative pressure environment; the air exchanging device is arranged in the airflow channel arranged in the spacer body; the air flow channel is used for conducting indoor and outdoor. The rotary negative pressure balancing system provided by the application can be used for communicating indoor and outdoor air by opening the ventilation device when the smoke exhaust ventilator is used, so that a series of problems of suspended ceiling deformation cracking, door and window air tightness reduction, bathroom odor reversion and the like caused by large negative pressure generated indoors are avoided, the door and window is not required to be opened, and the operation is simple and convenient. The system is provided with the compound filter screen, so that air entering the room can be filtered, and the indoor air quality is ensured.

title_en: Control method of air conditioner
abstract_en: The application provides a control method of an air conditioner, the air conditioner comprises a compressor, an evaporator, at least two condensers, at least two throttling parts and at least two condensing branches, wherein the compressor is provided with an air suction port and two exhaust ports with different pressures; one of the condensation branches is communicated with one of the exhaust ports and the inlet of the evaporator, the other condensation branch is communicated with the other exhaust port and the inlet of the evaporator, and each condensation branch is connected with a condenser and a throttling component in series; the control method comprises the following steps: acquiring the current exhaust temperature and the target exhaust temperature of each exhaust port; and adjusting the opening degree of the corresponding throttling component according to the current exhaust temperature and the target exhaust temperature of each exhaust port. According to the control method, the valve core opening of each throttling component is independently controlled, and the condensation temperature of the condenser is matched with the heat exchange of the external heat exchange fluid by adjusting the opening of the throttling component, so that the refrigerating capacity of the compressor is improved, and the power consumption is reduced.

title_en: Boiler system of circulating fluidized bed coupling ion waterfall
abstract_en: The invention provides a boiler system of a circulating fluidized bed coupled with an ion waterfall, which relates to the technical field of coal-fired boilers and comprises: circulating fluidized bed boiler and flue are provided with in the flue: the device comprises a preposed dust removal and collection unit, a first ion waterfall dust removal unit, a second ion waterfall dust removal unit, a desulfurization unit, a denitration SCR catalyst unit, an air preheating unit, a carbon dioxide capturing unit and a demisting and ammonia capturing unit; the denitration SCR device comprises a first ion waterfall dust removal unit, a denitration SCR catalyst unit, a second ion waterfall dust removal unit and an air preheating unit, wherein the first ion waterfall dust removal unit, the denitration SCR catalyst unit, the second ion waterfall dust removal unit and the air preheating unit are distributed in a shape like a Chinese character ji, the denitration SCR catalyst unit is positioned at the top of the shape like a Chinese character ji and is vertically arranged along the horizontal direction, and the first ion waterfall dust removal unit, the second ion waterfall dust removal unit and the air preheating unit are respectively positioned on two sides of the shape like a Chinese character ji. The boiler system disclosed by the invention applies an ion waterfall dust removal means to flue gas dust removal, and a denitration SCR catalyst unit is not blocked, so that efficient denitration is realized. The ion waterfall dust removal means is not influenced by the specific resistance of dust, and the dust removal efficiency is high.

title_en: Condenser and organic Rankine cycle power generation equipment
