abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of condensers of power generation equipment, in particular to a condenser and organic Rankine cycle power generation equipment, wherein the condenser comprises a condensation box, a cooling pipe, a condensation coil and a rotating assembly, and the condenser has the beneficial effects that: through the cooperation that sets up hose and folding pipe, the realization carries out the flexible mounting to the tip of condenser coil and cooling tube to adaptation in the rotation of cooling tube, when steam is more, folding pipe and condenser coil are strikeed to steam, thereby cause the cooling tube to rotate the slope, make the liquid of condensation increase mobility under the effect of tilt force, improve flowing back speed, avoid causing the jam, the drawing of elasticity rope simultaneously, the impact of buffering steam realizes rotating and resets.

title_en: Photovoltaic panel distributed support system and construction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic panel distributed supporting system which comprises a plurality of rows of supporting rods, wherein a plurality of supporting rods are uniformly and fixedly connected to the length direction of a water collecting tank on the top of a steel shed at intervals in each row, and the supporting rods are fixedly connected with photovoltaic panels. According to the photovoltaic panel, the supporting rods are arranged in the length direction of each water collecting tank of the shed roof at intervals, the photovoltaic panel is fixed by the supporting rods, the theoretical contact surface (only two ends are in contact in the conventional way) of the photovoltaic panel can be reduced, the effective supporting and fixing of the supporting rods and the photovoltaic panel are increased, the stability of the photovoltaic panel is greatly improved, the damage caused by uneven stress is avoided, and the installation safety and the use reliability are improved.

title_en: Air purifying device
abstract_en: In the air purification device (1), when a control unit (13) opens and closes a first opening/closing valve (33) to supply a first predetermined amount of water from a water pipe (32) to a water storage container (16) and operates a fan (4) and an electrolysis unit (18) for a predetermined time, when the first opening/closing valve (33) is not closed and water is continuously supplied to the water storage container (16), a water drain container of a water drain and storage unit (8) stores water overflowed from the water storage container (16), and the control unit (13) executes a first failure notification operation for notifying a failure of the first opening/closing valve (33) by a failure notification unit.

title_en: Indoor unit of air conditioner
abstract_en: The invention provides an indoor unit of an air conditioner, comprising: a housing forming a shape; a front door module for opening and closing a front discharge port formed in the front surface of the housing or for switching the direction of the air flow; and a side door module for opening and closing a side discharge port formed in a side surface of the housing or for switching the direction of the air flow. The side door module includes: a side door moving in the front-rear direction to open and close the side discharge port; a first driving part providing a driving force to the side door; and a support frame combined with the casing, having a side discharge port, and supporting the side door and the first driving part. The side door includes: a cover plate extending from an upper end to a lower end of the housing by a prescribed width and formed in one body; the reinforcing plates are attached to one surface of the cover plate and are provided in a plurality, so that the rigidity of the cover plate is enhanced. The side door module may be coupled to the housing by a coupling mechanism such as bolts. The side discharge port may be formed with a plurality of side blades for guiding the flow direction of the discharged air. At this time, the side blades may be formed integrally with the support frame.

title_en: Refrigerating system, air conditioner and control method of refrigerating system
abstract_en: The invention provides a refrigerating system, an air conditioner and a control method of the refrigerating system, wherein the refrigerating system comprises: indoor unit, outdoor unit and functional module, the setting position height of outdoor unit is higher than the setting position height of indoor unit, indoor unit includes the compressor, evaporimeter and first throttling arrangement, the outdoor unit includes the condenser, functional module includes oil separator, the reservoir, first branch road and three-way valve, the first end and the inside intercommunication of oil separator of three-way valve, the second end communicates with the condenser, the third end can communicate through the inside intercommunication of first branch road and reservoir, the second end can communicate with the third end when the compressor is shut down, so that the refrigerant can get into the reservoir from the condenser through first branch road. According to the invention, the refrigerant in the condenser can be led into the liquid storage device through the first branch when the compressor is stopped, so that the condition that the refrigerant is reversed to return to the exhaust port of the compressor when the compressor is stopped is effectively prevented, and the problem of liquid refrigerant reflux is solved.

title_en: Ventilation device
abstract_en: A ventilation device for an automotive HVAC system having a control support blade (3) and a controlled blade (6), wherein the control support blade (3) and the controlled blade (6) are arranged in respective arrays of different orientations, the control support blade (3) supports a control member (4) connected to the controlled blade (6), the control member is arranged behind the control support blade (3), and at least a portion of the control member (4) is located at least partially within the control support blade (3).

title_en: Hood, fresh air assembly and fresh air conditioner
abstract_en: The application provides a hood, new trend subassembly and new trend air conditioner. At least two air door plates are rotatably arranged on the side wall of the pipe body, and when the air cap is arranged on the fresh air pipe, the air door plates automatically drop downwards under the action of gravity and are in an open state, so that the air inlet is opened; when any wind door plate is driven by external force or blown by wind power and the like, the wind door plate can rotate to a closed state along the outer side wall of the pipe body, and the linkage mechanism can drive the remaining wind door plates to rotate to the closed state according to the rotation of the wind door plate, so that all the wind door plates are in the closed state to close the air inlet. When any side of the blast cap is driven by external force or wind power and the like, all the blast gate plates can be driven to be in a closed state to close the whole air inlet under the action of the linkage mechanism; and then on the basis of guaranteeing the intake of hood, can let the hood self-closing air intake under bad weather, improved new trend quality.

title_en: Plasma air disinfection device
abstract_en: The invention provides a plasma air sterilizing device, which relates to the technical field of sterilizing devices and comprises a ceiling seat and a sterilizing bin, wherein a cross arm support is connected between the lower part of the ceiling seat and the sterilizing bin, an exhaust fan is arranged at the bottom of the sterilizing bin, and a plasma generator is arranged in the sterilizing bin at the output end of the exhaust fan; according to the invention, air is sucked by the exhaust fan and enters the disinfection bin, the air is primarily disinfected by the plasma generator, then the air is discharged into the disinfection cavity, the electrolyte is subjected to electrolytic reaction by the electrode plate to generate subacidity hypochlorous acid electrolyzed water, the electrolyzed water is led into the atomization bin by the liquid pump, and the atomized sterilized water enters the disinfection cavity from the spray head by providing blowing force by the mist blowing fan after being atomized by the ultrasonic atomizer, so that the primarily disinfected air is secondarily disinfected and disinfected, the subacidity electrolyzed water has strong disinfection capability, no harmful substances are generated, and the killing effect on fine particles (such as biological aerosol) is good.

title_en: Method for increasing production of coal bed gas by using medium-low enthalpy dry rock geothermal energy
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of coal bed gas exploitation, and provides a method for increasing the coal bed gas by using medium-low enthalpy dry rock geothermal energy. Step 2, constructing a directional pinnate horizontal well system for extracting coal bed gas in a target coal bed position area, and arranging a cold water injection well, a heat injection well, a hot water collection well and a heat extraction well; and 3, heating the free coal bed gas by utilizing the heated injection fluid, and injecting the heated coal bed gas into the coal bed to achieve the effect of heating and increasing the coal bed gas. The invention integrates the directional feathered horizontal well production increasing technology and the heat injection production increasing technology, utilizes geothermal resources as a heat energy supply source, uses drained and mined underground water as a heat exchange medium, and uses heated coal bed gas as a heat injection heat source, thereby not only saving resources, but also avoiding the defects of the traditional heat injection production increase, realizing more effective production increase and greatly improving the yield of the coal bed gas.

title_en: Green power-coal power coupling power generation system and method utilizing renewable energy discarded power
abstract_en: The invention discloses a green electricity-coal electricity coupling power generation system and method utilizing renewable energy discarded electricity. The renewable energy abandoned electricity is used as the power source of the primary wind power electric heater and the secondary wind power electric heater, and is sent into the furnace in the form of primary wind power and secondary wind power, so that the renewable energy consumption is realized, and meanwhile, the high-efficiency electricity-electricity conversion of the abandoned electricity is realized. In addition, the coal pulverizing system based on the operation flexibility of the coal pulverizing system can quickly adapt to the load change of renewable energy sources, and the coal consumption can be reduced by adjusting the amount of coal entering the coal pulverizer while keeping the output power of a unit constant.

title_en: Semiconductor heat treatment equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses semiconductor heat treatment equipment, and belongs to the technical field of semiconductor process equipment. The semiconductor heat treatment apparatus includes: a chamber inner tube having an inner circumferential surface; the exhaust pipe is communicated with the inner pipe of the cavity; the exhaust structure is arranged on the inner peripheral surface, an exhaust cavity is formed between the exhaust structure and the inner tube of the cavity, the exhaust cavity is communicated with the exhaust pipe, an exhaust port is arranged on the exhaust structure, and the total exhaust area of the exhaust port is larger than a first preset area so that gas in the inner tube of the cavity flows into the exhaust cavity in a diffusion mode. The scheme can solve the problems that residues are easy to form in semiconductor heat treatment equipment, the pressure of a process chamber is difficult to reduce to a target value in a short time, and the temperature field of an inner tube of the chamber is not uniform.

title_en: Composite cooling film comprising organic polymer layer, UV absorbing layer and reflective metal layer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a composite cooling film, which comprises a non-fluorinated organic polymer layer; a metal layer disposed inwardly from the non-fluorinated organic polymer layer; and a stain resistant, uv absorbing hardcoat layer disposed outwardly from the non-fluorinated organic polymer layer.

title_en: Coal chemical-looping combustion mercury removal device and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a coal chemical-looping combustion mercury removal device, which is used for combusting an oxygen carrier and coal containing mercury and carrying out oxidation adsorption on the coal containing mercury. The oxidation-reduction unit comprises a fuel reactor, an air reactor and a magnetic separator, wherein the magnetic separator comprises a vertical cylindrical cyclone, and an air inlet channel, a gas discharge channel and a solid discharge channel are arranged on the vertical cylindrical cyclone; the smoke collecting unit comprises a quencher, a dust remover, a desulfurizing tower and a carbon dioxide catcher; the oxidized mercury recovery unit comprises a filter and a condenser; the ash recovery unit comprises an ash bin, and the ash bin is connected with the solid discharge channel.

title_en: Condenser mounting mechanism of energy-saving low-temperature refrigerator
abstract_en: The invention discloses a condenser mounting mechanism of an energy-saving low-temperature refrigerator, which relates to the technical field of condenser mounting and comprises a refrigerator, a bottom plate, a mounting plate and a connecting plate, wherein the bottom plate is in threaded connection with the bottom of the refrigerator, the mounting plate penetrates through the bottom plate and is in clamping connection with the inner wall of the refrigerator, the connecting plate is in a spiral shape, the outer wall of the connecting plate is fixedly connected with the inner side wall of the mounting plate, the connecting plate is connected with a plurality of connecting assemblies in a sliding mode, the connecting assemblies are connected with the condenser pipe in a clamping mode, a moving cavity is formed in the mounting plate, a transmission assembly is arranged in the moving cavity, a clamping strip is arranged on the outer wall of the mounting plate and is connected with the transmission assembly, a pushing assembly is fixedly connected with the inner side wall of the bottom of the mounting plate and is connected with the transmission assembly, and the condenser pipe is convenient to disassemble and can timely remove frost and ice blocks in the outer wall of the condenser pipe and in the inner cavity.

title_en: Intelligent pre-purification management method and system for operating room behaviors
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent management method and system for pre-purification of operating room behaviors, which belong to the field of artificial intelligence, and the method comprises the following steps: the intelligent hospital information management platform is used for collecting operating room scheduling information, acquiring operating room use flow information, analyzing to obtain a pre-purification time node, collecting operating room personnel circulation information to conduct feature analysis to obtain personnel flow degree information, analyzing to obtain an infection risk evaluation value, and conducting parameter setting on an operating room purification device according to the pre-purification time node, the personnel flow degree information and the infection risk evaluation value, and conducting automatic pre-purification management on the operating room through the operating room purification device. Solves the technical problems that the prior art cannot intelligently control the purification time point and the pre-purification efficiency is low. The technical effect of pertinently controlling the pre-purification time point of the operating room and improving the management efficiency by evaluating the risk in the operation process is achieved.

title_en: Three-fluid plate heat exchanger
abstract_en: A three-fluid heat exchanger (1) is disclosed, comprising a stack of plates (20a, 20b, 20c, 30a, 30b, 30c) and: -a first circuit (11) for circulation of a first heat transfer fluid between a first inlet manifold (11a) and a first outlet manifold (11B) of the first heat transfer fluid, -a second circuit (12) for circulation of a second heat transfer fluid between a second inlet manifold (12a) and a second outlet manifold (12B) of the second heat transfer fluid, -a third circuit (13) for circulation of a third heat transfer fluid between a third inlet manifold (13a) and a third outlet manifold (13B) of the third heat transfer fluid, the stack of plates (20a, 20B, 20c, 30a, 30B, 30c) forming alternating first (A) and second (B) circulation spaces for circulation of the heat transfer fluid, the stack being stacked in the direction of the plates (20a, 20B, 20c, 30a, 30B, 30c), the first circuit (11) being arranged in the first circulation space (A) and in the second circulation space, the second (12) and third (13) circuits are arranged jointly in the second circuit (B).

title_en: Wood carbon fiber heating composite floor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wood carbon fiber heating composite floor which sequentially comprises a wear-resistant layer, a color film layer, a fireproof core material layer A, wood carbon fiber heating paper, a fireproof core material layer B, a hollow heat-insulating base and a mute pad from top to bottom; the wood carbon fiber heating composite floors are connected through a base in a clamping mode, a wire set is arranged in the base, and the wire set is connected with wood carbon fiber heating paper; the wire group comprises a male plug, a female plug, electrode plates, a main wire and branch wires, wherein two ends of the two main wires are respectively connected with the male plug and the female plug, the two electrode plates are connected with two ends of the wood carbon fiber heating paper, one ends of the two branch wires are respectively connected with the two electrode plates, and the other ends of the two branch wires are respectively connected with the two main wires. The invention has the advantages of good heating effect, good safety performance, energy conservation, low consumption and long service life, and meets the heating requirement in winter.

title_en: Secondary injection combustion device for capturing and recovering fly ash
abstract_en: The invention discloses a secondary injection combustion device for capturing and recovering fly ash, which relates to the technical field of combustors, and has the technical scheme that: the mixing device comprises an outer pipe, an inner pipe and a mixing pipe which are sleeved in sequence from outside to inside, wherein the front ends of the outer pipe and the inner pipe are provided with injection covers, and the injection covers are provided with injection holes; the rear ends of the outer pipe and the inner pipe are respectively provided with a first air inlet and a second air inlet; the powder spraying pipe is arranged in the mixing pipe, the front end of the powder spraying pipe is provided with a powder spraying end, and the powder spraying pipe can be axially adjusted along the powder spraying pipe so as to adjust the powder spraying pipe to extend out of or retract into the inner pipe. The invention can mix and blow the waste material, realize the secondary mixing and calcining of the fly ash, realize the smooth circulation of the mixed fly ash through the internal pipeline structure, keep the stable operation of the burner and the smooth output and mixed combustion of the sprayed powder.

title_en: Dehumidification module, dehumidifier and dehumidification control method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of dehumidification, and discloses a dehumidification module, a dehumidifier and a dehumidification control method, wherein the dehumidification module comprises an evaporator, a condenser and a rotary wheel dehumidification assembly positioned between the evaporator and the condenser; the first side of runner dehumidification subassembly and evaporimeter are hugged closely, are provided with the heating box on the second side of runner dehumidification subassembly, and the terminal surface of condenser is provided with the breach, and the heating box is arranged in the breach and makes the condenser can hug closely runner dehumidification subassembly's second side. The evaporator, the rotating wheel dehumidification assembly and the condenser are arranged in a close fit manner through the notches, so that the integral structure is more compact, and the space utilization rate is improved; when dehumidification is carried out, air enters an evaporator to be cooled, moisture is separated out, drying is achieved, and the temperature of the dried air is raised through a condenser, so that the temperature of blown air is proper; on this basis, still increased runner dehumidification subassembly, further improved the ability of separating out moisture for holistic dehumidification effect is better.

title_en: Ventilation module for a motor vehicle cooling module, ventilation device comprising such a module, and cooling module for a motor vehicle comprising such a ventilation device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a module comprising: -at least one, preferably only one, tangential turbine (28-1; 28-2) comprising an impeller (32-1; 32-2) and a motor (33-1; 33-2) for rotationally driving the impeller (32-1; 32-2), -a frame (30-1; 30-2), which forms an opening (60-1; 60-2), preferably only one opening, -closing means (62-1; 62-2), designed to selectively close the opening (60-1; 60-2), the closing means (62-1; 62-2) having at least two zones, these areas are in contact where the closing means (62-1; 62-2) leave the opening clear and are separated by a distance where they close the opening (60-1; 60-2).

title_en: Intelligence humidification purifies circulation air purifier
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent humidification and purification circulating air purifier which comprises two L-shaped supporting frames, wherein the two L-shaped supporting frames are arranged in a bilateral symmetry mode, sliding grooves are formed in the opposite ends of the two L-shaped supporting frames, a positive and negative motor is fixedly installed at the upper end of the right L-shaped supporting frame, an output end of the positive and negative motor is fixedly installed with an adjusting screw rod, the adjusting screw rod is movably installed with the sliding grooves through bearings, a supporting rod is fixedly installed in the sliding groove on the right side, a purifier main body is installed between the two sliding grooves in a sliding mode, the left side of the purifier main body is installed with the supporting rod in a sliding mode, and the right side of the purifier main body is in threaded connection with the adjusting screw rod. The intelligent humidification and purification circulating air purifier disclosed by the invention is a comprehensive intelligent machine integrating air purification, humidification, circulation and air supply, can meet various requirements, is available in four seasons, is convenient to move, has strong flexibility and can be popularized and used.

title_en: Control method and device of air conditioning system
abstract_en: The application discloses a control method and a device of an air conditioning system, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining that the air conditioning system meets the entry condition of a set water cooling storage mode, controlling the air conditioning system to enter a water cold storage mode, wherein the entry condition comprises that the air conditioning system is in a low-load running state and the chilled water return temperature is smaller than the set entry mode temperature, determining that the air conditioning system meets the exit condition of the set water cooling storage mode, controlling the air conditioning system to exit the water cold storage mode, and the exit condition comprises that the chilled water return temperature is larger than the set exit mode temperature, wherein the set entry mode temperature is lower than the set exit mode temperature.

title_en: Air purifying device
abstract_en: The present invention provides an air purification device, comprising: the air purifier comprises a first purifying chamber, a first air exchange assembly and a second air exchange assembly; the first purifying chamber is filled with purifying liquid and is provided with a first communicating port; the first air exchange assembly is provided with a first air port and a second air port, and the second air port extends into the purified liquid; the first port of the second air exchange assembly is used for being communicated with an outdoor environment, and the second port of the second air exchange assembly is communicated with the first air exchange assembly or the first purification chamber; the first communication port and the first air port are used for being communicated with an indoor environment; the first communicating port, the first air port and the second air exchange assembly are provided with air doors. The invention respectively controls the opening or closing of the first communication port, the first air port and the second air exchange component by opening or closing the air door, thereby changing the path of air circulation, enabling the air purification device to have multiple working modes and increasing the functions of the air purification device.

title_en: Air monitoring device for solid wood furniture production workshop
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air monitoring device for a solid wood furniture production workshop, which belongs to the technical field of workshop air monitoring devices and comprises an air detection device, wherein the input end of the air detection device is connected with an air suction pipe, the output end of the air detection device is connected with an air purifier through an air delivery pipe, the air suction pipe comprises a hose and a plurality of air suction ports uniformly formed in the hose, and a fan for guiding air outside the hose to the air detection device is arranged inside the hose. According to the invention, the hose is coiled around a certain area of a production workshop, the air in the area is uniformly sucked through the plurality of air inlets on the hose and conveyed into the air detection device for detection, the length and the bending shape of the air suction pipe can be adjusted to monitor the whole air quality of the area, the condition that the plurality of detection points at the air inlet position detect the whole air quality in the certain area is collected, the monitoring value is more accurate, and when the air quality is detected to be poor by the air detection device, the warning lamp performs early warning.

title_en: Air conditioner and defrosting control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air conditioner and a defrosting control method of the air conditioner, wherein the air conditioner comprises the following steps: when the air conditioner heats and operates, determining that the increased value of the operating frequency in a preset period exceeds a preset frequency threshold value, and controlling the air conditioner to enter a false defrosting mode; recording the current operating frequency of the compressor as the temperature difference between the first frequency and the outdoor heat exchange at the initial moment of entering the pseudo-defrosting mode, and controlling the air conditioner to keep the heating operation so as not to perform the conventional defrosting mode; when the running frequency is determined to be unchanged in n continuous preset periods, recording the current running frequency of the compressor at the current moment as a second frequency; and controlling the air conditioner to continuously maintain the false defrosting mode in a preset time period according to the first frequency, the outdoor heat exchange temperature difference and the second frequency, and controlling the air conditioner to exit the false defrosting mode after the preset time period is exceeded. The air conditioner can avoid defrosting without frost and frequent defrosting, and can exit the false defrosting mode in time, thereby avoiding energy consumption.

title_en: Quantitative control method for slag cooler
abstract_en: The application discloses a quantitative control method of a slag cooler, which comprises the steps of obtaining production data and material layer pressure differences of all sampling time points, recording the production data as stable data when the maximum difference value of the production data in the sampling time period is smaller than or equal to a first stable threshold value, calculating sampling average values of adjustment amounts of the slag cooler in all sets of stable data and the change rate of the material layer pressure differences, respectively calculating the maximum difference value of adjustment amounts of a coal feeder and an adjustment amount of a primary fan in two adjacent sets of stable data, calculating the change amounts of the adjustment amounts of the slag cooler and the change rate of the material layer pressure differences in the two adjacent sets of stable data when the two are smaller than or equal to a second stable threshold value, generating a fitting curve according to the change amounts of the adjustment amounts of the slag cooler and the change rate of the material layer pressure differences, and determining target adjustment amounts of the slag cooler on the fitting curve according to given change target values of the change amounts of the material layer pressure differences. By the technical scheme, the problem of poor control accuracy of the bottom slag discharge capacity of the conventional slag cooler is solved.

title_en: Rack connecting plate for rotating air deflector, air deflector and air conditioner indoor unit
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of air conditioners, and discloses a rack connecting plate for rotating aviation baffle, including rack portion, and be used for with the connecting portion that the aviation baffle is connected, wherein, rack portion includes: the first rack extends towards one end of the rack connecting plate in an arc shape; and the second rack extends towards the other end of the rack connecting plate in an arc shape, wherein a gap is formed between the first rack and the second rack. The rack connecting plate can realize large-angle rotation of the air deflector by adopting a set of gear driving equipment, effectively simplifies a movement mechanism, reduces development cost and equipment failure probability, and improves the movement reliability of the air deflector. The application still discloses aviation baffle, machine in air conditioning.

title_en: Solid waste cement kiln is processing apparatus in coordination
abstract_en: The invention discloses a solid waste cement kiln cooperative treatment device, which belongs to the technical field of cooperative treatment of wastes, and aims to solve the problems that when the cooperative treatment device is used, a large amount of dust is easy to remain on the inner wall of a placement box after dumping and feeding materials for one time, the self-weight of the placement box is easy to increase, and the dust in the dumping process is easy to adhere to a piston rod of a hydraulic cylinder, so that the surface of the piston rod is easy to be worn or scratched due to the fact that the dust adheres to the piston rod in a large amount in a reciprocating manner.

title_en: Rapid cooling device and method for vanadium slag tank
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vanadium slag tank rapid cooling device, the vanadium slag tank is provided with a movable end cover, the movable end cover is provided with a first through hole and a second through hole, the first through hole is arranged at the center of the movable end cover, the device comprises: the vanadium slag tank is placed in the water bath; the stirrer is provided with a motor, a rotating shaft connected with the output end of the motor and a stirring blade arranged on the rotating shaft, and the rotating shaft penetrates through the first through hole and is rotatably fixed on the movable end cover; the flue gas treatment mechanism is provided with a flue gas pipe and a washing water tank, one end of the flue gas pipe is tightly communicated with the second through hole, and the other end of the flue gas pipe is communicated with the washing water tank. The invention also provides a cooling method using the vanadium slag tank rapid cooling device. The device disclosed by the invention is reasonable in structure and simple to operate, and the cooling time is reduced from 30 days to 5 days by the device disclosed by the invention, so that the vanadium slag can be rapidly cooled, harmful substances in the vanadium slag can be integrally treated, and the vanadium loss is avoided.

title_en: Electric heater device and heat treatment furnace comprising same
abstract_en: An electric heater device (10) installed on the inner side wall of a furnace of a heat treatment furnace comprises: a rod-shaped rod (12); a rod support portion (14), the rod support portion (14) being used for supporting the end of the rod (12) through the furnace inner side wall; a plurality of hooks (16), the plurality of hooks (16) being suspended from a rod (12); and an electric heater (18), wherein the electric heater (18) is supported by being hooked to the plurality of hooks (16).

title_en: Heating and barbecue integrated stove table
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heating and roasting integrated stove table which comprises a body, a combustion system and a roasting assembly, wherein the combustion system is arranged on the body and comprises a fire basin and a control assembly, a first air outlet structure and a second air outlet structure are arranged on the fire basin, the roasting assembly is movably connected with the body and is provided with a roasting tray, and the roasting tray can be suspended above the fire basin or stored on the body. The boss at the center of the fire pan is used for generating flame, and the center of the baking tray is directly heated, so that the baking tray is heated more uniformly, the conditions of low center temperature and high peripheral temperature are reduced, and the efficiency of baking food is improved.

title_en: Take water conservancy diversion integration level to prevent frostbite natural draft wet cooling tower of shutter
abstract_en: The invention discloses a natural ventilation wet cooling tower with a diversion integrated horizontal anti-freezing shutter. The tower shell of the natural ventilation wet cooling tower is hyperbolic, and the tower bottom is supported by a herringbone column to form an air inlet of the cooling tower; the integrated horizontal anti-freezing shutter with the diversion function consists of a diversion plate, a diversion plate fixing device, an anti-freezing device structural framework and horizontal shutter anti-freezing units, and is arranged along the circumferential direction of the cooling tower. The guide plate is positioned in the middle of the adjacent shutter and is vertically installed with the shutter. When the temperature is higher, the guide plate can improve the air inlet uniformity of the cooling tower and improve the cooling efficiency of the cooling tower; when the temperature is lower, the horizontal anti-freezing shutter flexibly adjusts the air inlet volume at different positions of the cooling tower according to the environmental temperature and the air inlet direction and the air speed, so that the possibility of local freezing of the cooling tower under the influence of cross wind is reduced, the integral water outlet temperature of the system is minimum, the normal operation of the cooling tower is ensured, and the cooling performance and the economic benefit are improved.

title_en: Fluorine pump pressure refrigeration system and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a fluorine pump pressure refrigeration system, which comprises: the compressor, the condenser, the liquid storage tank, the fluorine pump and the evaporator are connected to form an air conditioner circulation loop; the fluorine pump pressure refrigeration system further comprises a four-way valve and a heat exchange piece, one end of the heat exchange piece is communicated to a C port of the four-way valve, the other end of the heat exchange piece is communicated to the liquid storage tank, an exhaust port of the compressor is communicated to a D port of the four-way valve, the evaporator is communicated to an S port of the four-way valve, a solenoid valve and a booster pump which are connected in parallel are connected between one end of the condenser and an E port of the four-way valve, and the booster pump can enable fluid to flow from the condenser to the E port of the four-way valve. The defects of fusion design of a fluorine pump heat pipe refrigerating system, a heat recovery system, a double-evaporation-temperature refrigerating system and a conventional refrigerating system in the prior art are overcome.

title_en: Liquid fuel concurrent heating coupling hot air sintering device and method thereof
abstract_en: A liquid fuel concurrent heating coupling hot air sintering device comprises a sintering machine trolley, a hot air cover and a liquid fuel injection device; the hot air cover is arranged at the upper part of the sintering machine trolley; the liquid fuel injection device comprises a liquid fuel main pipe and a liquid fuel branch pipe; the liquid fuel main pipe is arranged on the outer side of the hot air hood and is positioned above the sintering machine trolley; one end of the liquid fuel branch pipe is connected with the liquid fuel main pipe, the other end of the liquid fuel branch pipe extends into the hot air cover, and a fuel nozzle is arranged at one end extending into the hot air cover; the hot air hood is also provided with a heat medium pipeline which is communicated with the inner space of the hot air hood. The device capable of spraying the liquid fuel in a rotating mode is adopted, the liquid fuel can be uniformly sprayed onto the surface of a sintering material according to the process requirement, the device is simple in structure, a pressurizing device does not need to be additionally arranged on a pipeline, and the technical and safety problems caused by the pressurizing device are avoided.

title_en: Prevent capillary of jam
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-blocking capillary tube, which comprises a hollow capillary tube, wherein the capillary tube comprises a first insertion section, a second insertion section and a middle section, the first insertion section is used for being connected with a condenser section, the second insertion section is used for being connected with an evaporator section, the middle section is integrally connected with the first insertion section and the second insertion section, the first insertion section extends into the condenser section, and the second insertion section extends into the evaporator section; the end parts of the first insertion section and the second insertion section are provided with openings communicated with the inside of the capillary circular tube, and the openings are provided with anti-blocking notches penetrating through the tube wall at the edge of the tube wall of the capillary circular tube. According to the invention, the anti-blocking notches are arranged at the openings at the two ends of the capillary circular tube, so that the blocking probability of the capillary circular tube is effectively reduced, and the vibration and noise caused by the capillary circular tube are reduced.

title_en: Range hood and air supply control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a range hood and an air supply control method thereof, wherein the range hood comprises a first air inlet component and a fan system, the range hood further comprises a second air inlet component, the first air inlet component is arranged in a first indoor space, the first indoor space is a kitchen, the second air inlet component is arranged in a second indoor space isolated from the first indoor space, the fan system is arranged outside the first air inlet component and the second air inlet component, the first air inlet component and the second air inlet component share the fan system as power, and the air supply module can send air sucked by the second air inlet component into the first indoor space. Compared with the prior art, the kitchen ventilator has the advantages that the kitchen ventilator is provided with the fume suction assemblies in different spaces, airflow is supplemented during negative pressure suction of a kitchen, negative pressure vacuumizing and other conditions are reduced, the kitchen ventilator can cool and send the kitchen by utilizing the low temperature of other indoor spaces, and temperature comfort experience is improved.

title_en: Intelligent waste heat recovery and radiation cooling integrated system for commercial kitchen
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent integrated system for waste heat recovery and radiation cooling for a commercial kitchen, and belongs to the technical field of waste heat utilization. The system comprises a water inlet pipe, a coil pipe, a water outlet pipe, a radiation plate, a mounting plate, a fixing structure, a cleaning module, a rocker, a temperature sensor and a control valve. The system is arranged on a wall between the cooking bench and the smoke exhaust hood; the water inlet pipe is communicated with tap water, and the tap water flows out of the system through the water outlet pipe after flowing through the coil pipe; the coil pipe is tightly attached to the radiation plate, is positioned on the back of the radiation plate, is fixed on the mounting plate by a fixing structure and is mounted on the wall together with the radiation plate; the temperature sensor is installed at the outlet pipe, but transmission signal to control valve, and control valve realizes intelligent control according to signal automatically regulated discharge. The invention can improve the high-temperature thermal environment of a cook through cold radiation, and simultaneously recycle the radiant heat of the flame of the stove, the waste heat of combustion waste gas, the waste heat of oil smoke and steam to prepare hot water and reduce the energy consumption of the kitchen.

title_en: Liquid slag discharging boiler adopting tangential firing mode
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a slag tapping boiler in a tangential firing mode, which comprises a boiler body and a burner, wherein a hearth and a slag combustion chamber are arranged in the boiler body, the slag combustion chamber is provided with an inlet and an outlet, the outlet of the slag combustion chamber is communicated with the hearth, a plurality of slag combustion chambers are arranged, the slag combustion chambers encircle the periphery of the hearth, the central line of the outlet of each slag combustion chamber is a tangent line of the same imaginary tangential circle, and the burner is connected with the boiler body so that the outlet of the burner is communicated with the inlet of the slag combustion chamber. The liquid slag-discharging boiler adopting the tangential firing mode has the advantages that slag bonding and heating surface contamination are not easy to occur in the boiler body, and the ash content of flue gas is low.

title_en: Combined skirting line heater
abstract_en: The invention discloses a combined skirting line heater which comprises a first combination body and a second combination body, wherein the first combination body comprises a first shell, a first heating pipe arranged in the first shell and a first power line connected with the first heating pipe, a first inclined plane plate is arranged on one side of the first shell, the included angle between the first inclined plane plate and the rear side panel of the first shell is 45 degrees, the second combination body comprises a second shell, a second heating pipe arranged in the second shell, a second power line connected with the second heating pipe and a power socket connected with the second power line, a second inclined plane plate is arranged on one side of the second shell, and the included angle between the second inclined plane plate and the front side panel of the second shell is 45 degrees. Can be with first combination and the split independent use of second combination or make up whole the use, in addition, this room heater both can use in the bottom skirting line position of whole wall, also can use in corner bottom skirting line position, has further improved space utilization.

title_en: Novel healthy energy-conserving air purification system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel healthy energy-saving air purification system, which belongs to the technical field of air purification and comprises a purifier body, wherein a purification device is arranged inside the purifier body, an air outlet is formed in the upper surface of the purifier body, one end of the purification device is fixedly communicated with the air outlet, an air inlet is formed in the outer surface of the purifier body, and a filtering mechanism is arranged in the air inlet; the filter mechanism comprises a fixed frame, the fixed frame is fixedly installed on the inner surface of the air inlet, the upper surface and the lower surface of the fixed frame are provided with through grooves, two sides of the inner surface of the fixed frame are provided with grooves, and two sides of the outer surface of the fixed frame are symmetrically and fixedly connected with cylinders.

title_en: Air conditioner and sterilization control method thereof
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of intelligent household appliances, and particularly relates to a sterilization control method of an air conditioner and the air conditioner. The air conditioner solves the technical problems that in the prior art, the air conditioner can only be mechanically controlled to be opened in a fixed sterilization mode based on the opening operation of a user, the personalized sterilization requirement of the user cannot be met, and the sterilization effect is possibly low. In the application, when the air conditioner is identified to be in a sterilization mode, the information of indoor personnel is acquired; the information of the indoor personnel comprises user information of the indoor personnel and the number of the indoor personnel; judging whether the sterilization mode, the user information of the indoor personnel and/or the number of the indoor personnel meet sterilization enhancement/reduction conditions or not; and if the sterilization enhancement/reduction condition is judged to be met, correspondingly adjusting the sterilization power in the sterilization mode or correspondingly adjusting the sterilization mode, and controlling the air conditioner to perform sterilization treatment by using the adjusted sterilization power in the sterilization mode or the sterilization power corresponding to the adjusted sterilization mode.

title_en: Humidifier and control method thereof
abstract_en: Provided is a humidifier (10) which can exert an appearance effect without reducing the original function of humidifying the inside of a room, the humidifier comprising: a water tank (20); an ultrasonic vibrator (25) provided in the water tank (20); a water drop outlet (31) which communicates with the water tank (20) and discharges the mist water drops generated by the ultrasonic vibrator (25) to the outside; a fan (46) which is provided so as to blow air into the tank (20) and which discharges atomized water droplets from the water droplet outlet (31); and a control unit (47) that controls the ultrasonic transducer (25) and the fan (46), wherein the control unit (47) controls the fan (46) to be stopped when the ultrasonic transducer (25) is activated.

title_en: Piston compressor and refrigerating device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a piston compressor and a refrigerating device, belonging to the refrigeration field, comprising a cylinder seat and an exhaust structure, wherein the cylinder seat is provided with a cylinder hole, the exhaust structure comprises an exhaust silencing cavity arranged on the cylinder seat, the exhaust silencing cavity is provided with an air inlet position and an air outlet position, the air inlet position is provided with a vent hole, the vent hole is communicated with the exhaust silencing cavity and the cylinder hole, the piston compressor further comprises an exhaust pipe, one end of the exhaust pipe is positioned outside the exhaust silencing cavity to form an air outlet, the other end of the exhaust pipe extends into the exhaust silencing cavity from the air outlet position to form an inner exhaust pipe section, the end part of the inner exhaust pipe section forms an air inlet, and the exhaust silencing cavity is provided with at least one section of cavity reducing part from the air inlet position to the air outlet position.

title_en: Smoke monitoring system, method and device based on air conditioner and air conditioner
abstract_en: The invention provides a smoke monitoring system, a method and a device based on an air conditioner and the air conditioner, wherein the smoke monitoring system comprises: the smoke monitoring device is arranged on an outdoor unit of the air conditioner, monitors the smoke concentration, the smoke color and the smoke flowing speed of a target area, and sends out an alarm signal according to at least one of the smoke concentration, the smoke color and the smoke flowing speed; and the control panel is connected with the smoke monitoring device, receives the alarm signal of the smoke monitoring device and controls the air conditioner to give out smoke alarm according to the alarm signal. The air conditioner comprises the air conditioner-based smoke monitoring system. The smoke monitoring system can timely and effectively remind indoor users when fire occurs in a target area, so that the users have enough buffering time to escape and alarm, and danger is avoided.

title_en: Raise boring machine with extending mechanism
abstract_en: The invention provides a raise boring machine with an extension mechanism, comprising: a main body frame; the air outlet assembly is arranged between the main body frame and the air outlet assembly; an extension mechanism. According to the courtyard machine with the extension mechanism, the extension mechanism is used for increasing the guide of the first air outlet, namely the length of the lower side surface of the air supply air duct is increased, so that the air outlet of the first air outlet is far away from the main body frame, the problem that people are blown due to the fact that only down-blowing type air flow can be generated in the prior art is effectively solved, the 'waterfall' refrigeration is achieved, meanwhile, in order to guarantee the air outlet effect, the second air outlet for down air outlet is further arranged, the courtyard machine can achieve the requirement of down air outlet in the prior art, the air outlet mode of the courtyard machine is increased through opening and closing of the first air outlet and the second air outlet, and the air outlet effect of the courtyard machine is further improved.

title_en: Photo-thermal conversion coating, preparation method thereof and photo-thermal conversion device
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of photo-thermal conversion materials, and particularly relates to a photo-thermal conversion coating, a preparation method thereof and a photo-thermal conversion device. The preparation method of the photo-thermal conversion coating comprises the steps of obtaining a porous substrate, adsorbing an initiator in situ in the porous substrate to obtain a modified porous substrate, and carrying out gas-phase polymerization reaction on conjugated polymer monomers, a chlorine source and the modified porous substrate to form a chlorine-doped photo-thermal conversion coating on the surface of the porous substrate in situ. According to the preparation method of the photo-thermal conversion coating, the initiator is adsorbed in situ in the porous substrate, the conjugated polymer monomer is dissipated in the surface layer of the substrate in a gas phase form, the monomer is initiated to polymerize in situ in the pores of the substrate, the bonding firmness of the coating and the substrate is improved, meanwhile, the structuring and doping effects improve the utilization rate of the coating on light energy, so that the photo-thermal conversion coating has the characteristics of high solar spectrum absorption efficiency, wide light absorption range, high absorbance, high utilization rate and the like, and the super-strong photo-thermal effect is shown.

title_en: Circulating waste heat power generation system based on spiral heat exchange technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a circulating type waste heat power generation system based on a spiral heat exchange technology, which comprises a base, spiral heat exchange mechanisms and a waste heat power generation mechanism, wherein supports are arranged on the base, the spiral heat exchange mechanisms are arranged between the supports, the waste heat power generation mechanism is also arranged in the spiral heat exchange mechanisms, the waste heat power generation mechanism is connected to a power storage box body, and the power storage box body is arranged on the upper surface of the base. When the system is used, the condition that other equipment is needed to be used for introducing cold air is avoided, the cooled first wave air can be utilized, and in addition, the heat energy in the hot air can be converted into electric energy to a greater extent through a plurality of waste heat power generation mechanisms arranged in the system, so that the thermoelectric conversion efficiency is improved.

title_en: Gas stove
abstract_en: The invention provides a gas stove which comprises a shell, a combustion device, a panel, a thermal efficiency lifting device and at least one light-emitting assembly, wherein the thermal efficiency lifting device comprises a smoke collecting device, the top of the smoke collecting device is butted with the panel, the bottom of the smoke collecting device is abutted against the periphery of the combustion device, a combustion space is formed between the smoke collecting device and the combustion device as well as between the smoke collecting device and the panel, and the light-emitting assembly is positioned in the combustion space and used for converting heat energy released by the combustion device into infrared light energy. Compared with the prior art, the invention not only can provide enough circulating space for the hot smoke generated by the combustion device through the arrangement of the combustion space, slow down the flow of the hot smoke in the combustion space and improve the utilization rate of the hot smoke, but also can convert the heat energy released in the combustion process into infrared light energy through the light-emitting assembly and transfer the heat energy to a vessel or other heating carriers placed on the panel, thereby obviously improving the heat efficiency of the gas stove and realizing the efficient heating of the vessel or other heating carriers.

title_en: Electric heating stove
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of heating appliances, in particular to an electric heating furnace, wherein a structure in a shell is skillfully designed, particularly the position distribution of a partition plate, airflow is enabled to form a first air channel in the shell by utilizing a first fan, the first air channel enables the airflow to sequentially flow through a first air inlet, the first fan, a control circuit module, a heating body and a first air outlet, and meanwhile, the heat dissipation requirements of the control circuit module and the heating body are met. Through the ingenious design of the structure inside the shell, particularly the position distribution of the partition plate, the second fan is utilized to enable the airflow to form a second air duct inside the shell, and the second air duct enables the airflow to sequentially flow through the second air inlet hole, the second fan, the heating body and the second air outlet, so that the auxiliary heat dissipation requirement of the heating body is met.

title_en: Drainage device, air conditioner and drainage method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a drainage device, an air conditioner and a drainage method, relates to the field of air conditioners and solves the problems that in the prior art, the drainage device drains water through an electric water pump, electric energy is consumed, and blockage and noise exist after long-time use. The drainage device comprises a wind power driving assembly and a drainage assembly, wherein the windward surface of the wind power driving assembly faces the air outlet direction of the equipment unit, the wind power driving assembly is connected with the drainage assembly, the wind power driving assembly is used for providing power for the drainage assembly, and the drainage assembly is used for draining collected condensed water. According to the drainage device, the wind power driving assembly and the drainage assembly are of mechanical structures, so that the problem of potential electrical safety hazards can be effectively solved, the problem that the drainage assembly fails due to blockage can be prevented, the maintenance cost is reduced, and meanwhile, the working noise of the drainage device can be reduced; the wind power driving assembly drives the water discharging assembly to discharge water based on the wind power provided by the equipment unit, and the energy-saving effect is achieved.

title_en: Filter screen for indoor air purification
abstract_en: The invention discloses a filter screen for purifying indoor air, which comprises a shell, an air inlet, an air outlet and a filter screen assembly, wherein the filter screen assembly is arranged, impurities in the air are filtered through a filter screen structure between a first winding drum and a second winding drum, the first winding drum and the second winding drum are driven to synchronously rotate through a driving synchronous wheel and a driven synchronous wheel of a driving structure, a filter screen roll wound on the outer side of the first winding drum is unreeled, the filter screen roll is reeled through the second winding drum, the used filter screen roll is reeled, the unused filter screen roll is partially moved to a position between the air inlet and the air outlet for air filtration, the filter screen is not required to be dismounted and cleaned, the filter screen replacement frequency is reduced, the workload of workers is further reduced, the position of the filter screen is not required to be moved and replaced through a machine shell of an air purifier, and the indoor air purification effect is ensured.

title_en: Linkage conductive equipment of full-automatic graphitizing internal furnace
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of graphitization processes, in particular to a full-automatic graphitization internal series furnace linkage conductive device. The high-voltage transformer moving rack comprises a moving rack, wherein a high-voltage transformer is arranged on the moving rack, an upward moving device is arranged on the upper side of the moving rack, a low-voltage transformer is arranged on the upward moving device, and the low-voltage transformer is arranged on the upper side of the high-voltage transformer. This carry out the provision of electric energy through setting up low voltage transformer and high voltage transformer to string stove in the graphitization, in earlier stage, string stove provides low-voltage low current in to the graphitization through low voltage transformer, when entering into the later stage, high voltage transformer carries out the supply of high key high current to string stove in the graphitization again, the in-process that string stove was using in making the graphitization, can receive different voltage electric current, in order to accomplish the rational utilization of power, dislocation set about simultaneously going on low voltage transformer and high voltage transformer through receiving mechanism, make low voltage transformer and high voltage transformer realize the isolated operation.

title_en: Assessment method and system for double-balance state monitoring of air conditioner water system
abstract_en: The invention provides an evaluation method and system for double balance state monitoring of an air-conditioning water system, which relate to the field of control system monitoring and comprise the following steps: the method comprises the steps of calling basic information of an air-conditioning water system through a field layer, wherein the basic information comprises a water system branch sequence and a water system branch service area sequence; traversing the water system branch sequence and the water system branch service area sequence to generate an expected backwater temperature sequence; monitoring the temperature of the water system branch sequence to generate a real-time backwater temperature sequence; carrying out flow analysis according to the expected backwater temperature sequence and the real-time backwater temperature sequence to generate an expected branch flow sequence; transmitting the valve state optimization result to an application layer for valve control optimization analysis, generating a valve state optimization result, transmitting the valve state optimization result to a field layer, and judging whether the real-time valve state meets the valve state optimization result or not; if not, generating valve state abnormality monitoring information. The technical problem that the global adaptability is weak due to the fact that local monitoring and evaluation are relied on in the prior art is solved.

title_en: Sun-tracking solar support
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sun-tracking solar support, which comprises a working plate, wherein two groups of sliding rods are fixedly connected to the working plate, a motor is arranged on the lower side of the working plate, a movable plate is arranged between the sliding rods, an adjusting structure is arranged on the movable plate, an air cylinder is arranged on one side of the working plate, and an installation structure is arranged on the side edge of the air cylinder; through being provided with the regulation structure, the board of placing in the regulation structure can be according to backup pad angle of adjustment, can adjust solar panel's angle of elevation through the height that changes the board of placing, makes solar panel absorb more sunshine, utilizes solar energy resource better, through being provided with mounting structure, mounting panel among the mounting structure can move on the movable rod, makes the cylinder can follow the outer fishplate bar and dismantles, and the propulsion board of setting can be followed the fixed plate and dismantled, is convenient for maintain chasing after the formula solar rack.

title_en: Control method and device of air conditioner, air conditioner and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control method and device of an air conditioner, the air conditioner and a storage medium. The invention relates to the technical field of air conditioners, wherein the air conditioner comprises an air outlet, and a negative ion generator and a bipolar ion generator which are arranged on the air outlet, and the method comprises the following steps: acquiring the ozone content, the particulate matter concentration, the carbon dioxide concentration and the humidity of the working environment of the air conditioner; detecting whether the working environment meets sterilization conditions or not according to the ozone content; and if the working environment meets the sterilization condition, controlling the negative ion generator and the bipolar ion generator to be turned on or turned off according to the concentration of the particulate matters, the concentration of the carbon dioxide and the humidity so as to sterilize the working environment. The invention not only can improve the sterilization effect, but also is beneficial to human health, does not harm human body, and improves the indoor air quality and user experience.

title_en: Superconducting magnet device, cryogenic refrigerator, and method for cooling superconducting magnet device
abstract_en: A superconducting magnet device (10) is provided with: a superconducting coil (12); a radiation shield (14) thermally protecting the superconducting coil (12); a main cold head (102) that cools the superconducting coil (12); a secondary cold head (104) that cools the radiation shield (14); a common compressor (106) that supplies refrigerant gas to the main cold head (102) and the sub-cold head (104); a 1 st temperature sensor (40) that measures the temperature of the radiation shield (14); a 2 nd temperature sensor (42) for measuring the temperature of the superconducting coil (12); and a controller (110) configured to activate the sub-cold head (104) for initial cooling of the superconducting magnet device (10), to stop the operation of the sub-cold head (104) on the basis of the output of the 1 st temperature sensor (40) or the 2 nd temperature sensor (42), and to operate the main cold head (102) in a state in which the operation of the sub-cold head (104) is stopped.

title_en: Air duct assembly and range hood
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air duct assembly and a range hood, belongs to the technical field of household appliances, and is designed for solving the problems of thicker range hood, narrow application range and the like of the existing range hood. The air duct assembly disclosed by the invention comprises: the air duct shell is provided with an air inlet, an inner circulating air port and an outer circulating air port, the air inlet is communicated to the external space through the outer circulating air port, the air inlet is communicated to the inner circulating air port through the inner circulating air duct, and the inner circulating air port is communicated to the purifying device; the two fans are arranged in the air duct shell, and the rotation directions of the two fans are opposite; and two valve plates, wherein each valve plate is arranged between one fan and the outer circulating air port. The air duct assembly and the range hood provided by the invention can select the internal circulation working mode or the external circulation working mode according to the requirements, and are flexible and convenient, low in energy consumption and wide in application range. By replacing one larger conventional fan with two smaller fans, the thickness of the duct housing is significantly reduced.

title_en: Refrigeration adjusting method, heat exchanger and heat exchange equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to a refrigeration adjusting method, a heat exchanger and heat exchange equipment, which concretely comprise the steps of obtaining real-time refrigeration capacity generated in the operation process of the heat exchange equipment, judging the size of the real-time refrigeration capacity and preset target refrigeration capacity, and adjusting the air inlet angle of the windward side of the heat exchanger of the heat exchange equipment to achieve the air inlet corresponding to the target refrigeration capacity if the real-time refrigeration capacity is not equal to the preset target refrigeration capacity. In this way, in the operation process of the heat exchange equipment, the control is performed according to the comparison between the real-time refrigerating capacity and the preset target refrigerating capacity, when the real-time refrigerating capacity is equal to the target refrigerating capacity, the heat exchange equipment is indicated to be just in accordance with the user requirement at the moment, when the real-time refrigerating capacity is not equal to the target refrigerating capacity, the heat exchange equipment is indicated to be in accordance with the user requirement at the moment, and the air inlet angle is adjusted to change the air inlet quantity so as to ensure the heat exchange effect of the heat exchange equipment.

title_en: Power line routing structure of saddle type air conditioner and saddle type air conditioner
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power line wiring structure of a saddle type air conditioner and the saddle type air conditioner, wherein the saddle type air conditioner comprises an indoor unit positioned at the indoor side, an outdoor unit positioned at the outdoor side and a saddle bridge structure connecting the indoor unit and the outdoor unit, a through cavity is arranged in the saddle bridge structure and is used for communicating the inner cavity of the indoor unit with the inner cavity of the outdoor unit, an electrical box is arranged in the through cavity, a power line is led out from the interior of the electrical box and extends to the side of the indoor unit, a threading hole is arranged on a shell of the indoor unit, and the power line penetrates out through the threading hole, so that the space is fully utilized, and the power line wiring is simple and convenient.

title_en: Fume exhaust fan
abstract_en: The invention provides a range hood, which comprises a shell, wherein a volute component and an oil net are arranged in the shell, the volute component is connected with a fume collecting device, the oil net and the fume collecting device can generate an electric field with an adsorption function, fume is ionized and electrified when passing through the oil net, and the fume collecting device adsorbs charged fume particles, so that the fume particles are collected. According to the range hood provided by the invention, the positive electrode is connected with the oil net, the positive electrode tungsten wire is arranged in the oil net, and the positive electrode tungsten wire discharges static electricity, so that oil smoke particles or dust are positively charged, the negative electrode plate is fixed on the fixing ring through the screw to form a positive electric field and a negative electric field, the adsorption effect of charged grease on the negative electrode plate is improved, and the grease deposition on the oil net is reduced.

title_en: Evaporated water recovery system for refrigeration system and refrigeration system
abstract_en: The invention provides an evaporated water recovery system for a refrigeration system and the refrigeration system, wherein the evaporated water recovery system comprises: an evaporative condenser and a recovery device; the evaporative condenser comprises a box body, a first heat exchange pipe, a second heat exchange pipe and a spraying device, wherein the second heat exchange pipe, the spraying device and the first heat exchange pipe are sequentially arranged in the box body along the height direction of the box body; the inlet of the first heat exchange tube is connected with a recovery device, the recovery device comprises an air cooler and a recovery assembly, and cold energy taken away by defrosting media in the air cooler can flow into the first heat exchange tube through the recovery assembly; the inlet of the second heat exchange tube is used for being connected with the compressor, and the outlet of the second heat exchange tube is used for being connected with the evaporator. The cooling water sprays to the surface of second heat exchange tube and forms the water film, and the water film evaporation is changed into vapor and is melted in the air and form hot humid air and flow to first heat exchange tube department, takes place the heat exchange with the cold volume in the first heat exchange tube, and hot humid air meets cold and becomes liquid water and descends to the box in, effectively realizes the recovery of evaporation water.

title_en: Rotary kiln for cement production and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rotary kilns, in particular to a rotary kiln for cement production and a use method thereof. According to the rotary kiln for cement production and the application method thereof, the lubricating oil in the column tube is extruded along the micro gap between the movable ball and the ball port to realize atomization oil injection, and the lubricating effect among the lubricating oil, the riding wheel and the ring groove is guaranteed by spraying on the wheel belt, so that the atomization spraying of the lubricating oil is realized by utilizing the rotation of the wheel belt, the oil consumption of the lubricating oil is greatly reduced, the surface of the wheel belt can be kept fresh and proper amount of the lubricating oil all the time, meanwhile, the rotary kiln has the blowing effect, the cleaning operation of a friction pair is facilitated, the possibility that the polluted impurities and worn particles return to an oil cavity can be eliminated, the oil cavity is free from being polluted by a lubricating medium due to the fact that the oil cavity is free from an opening, the lubricating efficiency is high, the fresh oil mist lubricating effect can be dispersed to a required lubricating friction part along with compressed air, the lubricating effect is good and even, and the service life of a transmission part is greatly improved.

title_en: Fresh air conditioner circulating system
abstract_en: The application provides a new trend air conditioner circulation system relates to new trend air conditioner circulation system technical field, including the structure of four bibliographic categories, is respectively: the fresh air conditioner comprises a fresh air conditioner body, a cover frame, an internal circulation storage frame and an air exhaust assembly, wherein one side of one end of the internal circulation storage frame is fixedly connected with a warm air conveying pipe, one side of the other end of the internal circulation storage frame is fixedly connected with a cold air conveying pipe, a cover plate is fixedly connected between the warm air conveying pipe and one side of the cold air conveying pipe, the air exhaust assembly comprises an air exhaust pipe, the other end of the air exhaust pipe is in threaded connection with a one-way valve, and one end of the one-way valve is in threaded connection with an air inlet pipe; the technical key points are as follows: when the fresh air conditioner blows warm air from the inside of the warm air conveying pipe to the indoor at a high speed, pressure difference is generated between the inside of the warm air conveying pipe and the inside of the external circulation storage frame, cold air in the external circulation storage frame is directly pressed into the inside of the exhaust pipe from the air inlet pipe through the one-way valve, and finally the cold air directly enters the indoor along with the warm air in the warm air conveying pipe, so that the improvement of the indoor air quality is facilitated.

title_en: Method for keeping heat of rotary kiln uniformly distributed
abstract_en: This patent provides a method for keeping rotary kiln heat evenly distributed, the intake pipe is inside spiral deep rotary kiln, and set up the outside nozzle according to the interval of difference at the intake pipe outer wall, the nozzle presents different angles with the pipe, set up a plurality of nozzles and have the support of bearing on the rotary kiln length, the spiral pipe can also be through flexible adjustment bocca position, make heat transfer no dead angle in the kiln, just so guaranteed that the heat that obtains in the unit length kiln is the same, also need not high-pressure injection gas, finally reach the heat evenly distributed in the rotary kiln, make this combustor keep at rotary kiln axle center position simultaneously.

title_en: Water collector subassembly and air conditioning unit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water pan assembly and an air conditioning unit, wherein the water pan assembly comprises: the first water receiving tray is provided with a first water receiving groove; and the second water receiving tray is provided with a second water receiving tank, the second water receiving tray is connected to the first water receiving tray, and the first water receiving tank and the second water receiving tank are mutually isolated. The water pan assembly and the air conditioning unit effectively solve the problem that the air conditioning unit loses cold energy due to the accumulation of condensed water in the water pan in the prior art.

title_en: Up-drawing continuous casting furnace
abstract_en: The invention relates to an up-drawing continuous casting furnace which comprises a smelting furnace, an ultra-cooler and an intelligent traction system, wherein the intelligent traction system comprises a traction frame, a driving assembly and electric communication, an upper traction shaft, a lower traction shaft and a fixed clamping seat are arranged on the front side and the rear side of the traction frame, and the ultra-cooler is arranged in front of the fixed clamping seat and baked by a baking device. The invention controls the operation of the whole upward casting through the central touch type operation control screen, thereby realizing higher degree of automation and lower operation cost, having higher operation efficiency and longer service life, being suitable for continuous casting processing production of alloy rod blanks with higher requirements, especially large-specification alloy containing volatile elements, such as large-specification Cu-Mg alloy with the wire diameter of 30mm and continuous casting production of Cu-Cr (0.5-0.6 percent) -Zr (0.1 percent) alloy.

title_en: Segmented heat storage adjusting device and method for long-distance pipeline network
