abstract_en: The invention discloses a long-distance pipeline network subsection heat accumulation adjusting method which comprises a unit device and a relay pump station device connected with the unit device, wherein the unit device comprises a unit and a heat supply network heater, the unit device is connected with the heat supply network heater through a pipeline, the relay pump station device comprises a pressure-isolating heat exchanger, a first water mixing valve, a second water mixing valve and a pressure-isolating station bypass valve, the first water mixing valve is arranged on a first branch, the second water mixing valve is arranged on a second branch, and the pressure-isolating station bypass valve is arranged on a third branch. The invention changes the heat load through various sectional flow regulation and heat accumulation regulation, realizes the heat supply accurate regulation requirement, reduces the cycle of the quantity regulation, can flexibly regulate at various moments to realize the rapid response of the load side, reduces the local water supply flow of the long-distance transmission network, realizes the energy-saving operation of a multi-stage pump station of the long-distance transmission network and the decoupling of the unit side electric load and the user side heat load, and is favorable for realizing the peak regulation requirement taking the hour as the scale.

title_en: Linkage control method and device, electronic equipment, formaldehyde purifier and storage medium
abstract_en: According to the linkage control method and device, the electronic equipment, the formaldehyde purifier and the storage medium, whether a target air conditioner establishing a linkage relation with the formaldehyde purifier is in a standby state or not is determined under the condition that the trigger operation of a linkage mode is obtained; and under the condition that the target air conditioner is in a standby state, controlling the target air conditioner to enter a heating mode, and controlling the formaldehyde purifier to work, so that formaldehyde can be better removed.

title_en: Air conditioner energy-saving control method, air conditioner control equipment and air conditioning system
abstract_en: The invention provides an air conditioner energy-saving control method, air conditioner control equipment and an air conditioner system, wherein the method is applied to the air conditioner control equipment, the air conditioner control equipment is respectively in communication connection with infrared equipment and positioning equipment, and the method comprises the following steps: the air conditioner control equipment acquires first infrared information detected by infrared equipment; the air conditioner control equipment judges whether a user exists in the room or not according to the first infrared information; if no user exists in the room, the air conditioner control equipment acquires first position information of the user through the positioning equipment; the air conditioner control device controls the operation state of the air conditioner according to the first position information. The invention can control the running state of the air conditioner according to the first position information of the user under the condition that no user exists in the room, and is more intelligent compared with the existing air conditioner.

title_en: Open hole snake-shaped horizontal well dry hot rock exploiting method based on closed loop geothermal system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for exploiting dry hot rock by using a naked-eye snake-shaped horizontal well based on a closed-loop geothermal system, which belongs to the field of geothermal exploitation, wherein an injection well and a production well are drilled in a target exploitation area, the dry hot rock reservoir of the injection well is the naked-eye snake-shaped horizontal well, and then a low-temperature heat transfer medium is injected into the injection well, and a high-temperature heat transfer medium is produced from the production well so as to achieve the purpose of obtaining heat from the dry hot rock reservoir; the optimized horizontal well type can increase the heat exchange area between the flowing medium and the hot dry rock reservoir, prolong the retention time and properly increase the flow resistance; the uniform flow of the flowing medium is ensured, the heat exchange medium and the reservoir layer complete the full heat exchange, and higher heat recovery efficiency is obtained.

title_en: Multi-biomass alternative fuel feeding system for cement production
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-biomass alternative fuel feeding system for cement production, which comprises a negative pressure separator, wherein the air inlet end of the negative pressure separator is connected with a bag package, the air outlet section of the negative pressure separator is connected with a Roots vacuum pump, the bottom outlet of the negative pressure separator is connected with a storage bin, the top of the storage bin is provided with a material level meter, the pyramid part of the storage bin is connected with the Roots vacuum pump, the right lower part of the bottom outlet of the storage bin is connected with a pneumatic gate valve, the right lower part of the pneumatic gate valve is connected with a metering scale, the lower part of the outlet of the metering scale is connected into a buffer bin, one end of the top of the buffer bin is connected with a belt conveyor, the tail part of the belt conveyor is connected with a reverse taper type feeding bin and an iron remover, the middle part of a belt of the belt conveyor is provided with a through belt scale, and the bottom of the buffer bin is connected with a pneumatic conveying device. The invention can simultaneously treat biomass alternative fuels with various types, different forms and different approach modes, has compact structure and small investment, integrates storage, metering and conveying into a whole, does not need bag breaking, is environment-friendly, can be switched quickly, can stabilize multi-point feeding and reduce energy consumption.

title_en: Household appliance control method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a method and a device for controlling a household appliance, wherein the household appliance comprises a range hood and an air conditioner, the range hood and the air conditioner share one or a group of exhaust channels, and share one or a group of induced draft fans; the method comprises the following steps: detecting the current gas discharge capacity of the range hood after detecting the start of the range hood and the air conditioner; adjusting an operating state of the air conditioner according to the air displacement. In the scheme of this application embodiment, when lampblack absorber and air conditioner equal during operation, can be based on the gas discharge capacity of lampblack absorber, the operating condition of air conditioner is adjusted dynamically, self-adaptation, both can avoid air conditioner during operation exhaust gas to cause the influence to the induced air state of lampblack absorber like this, can avoid the lampblack absorber to discharge fume the gas emission that influences the air conditioner and then lead to the air conditioning effect to descend again, consequently can guarantee the operating effect of air conditioner on the basis of guaranteeing the normal work of lampblack absorber.

title_en: Control method, control device, electronic apparatus, heating device, and storage medium
abstract_en: According to the control method, the control device, the electronic equipment, the heating device and the storage medium, whether a user exists in a target area or not is determined; under the condition that it is determined that no user exists in the target area, controlling a hot water valve corresponding to the target area to work in a preset mode, wherein the preset mode comprises the following steps: the mode of starting the preset time length at the preset interval time length can reduce heat loss, thereby saving energy.

title_en: Flame monitoring device in hearth
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flame monitoring device in a hearth, which comprises a monitoring assembly; the circulating module comprises a circulating component and a first linkage component, and the circulating component is movably connected with the linkage component; and the heat dissipation module comprises a driving assembly, a heat dissipation assembly, a second linkage assembly and a cleaning assembly, the driving assembly is respectively connected with the heat dissipation assembly and the second linkage assembly, and the second linkage assembly is movably connected with the cleaning assembly. According to the invention, the accommodating device is arranged, the temperature sensing device is continuously radiated by the circularly flowing heat conduction oil, the dust removal is carried out on the heat radiation air inlet position by the cleaning device, the heat radiation compensation caused by the blocking of the air inlet by dust is avoided, the circulating transmission device and the cleaning device are linked with the heat radiation device, the use cost of equipment is reduced, the continuous heat radiation is effectively carried out on the temperature sensing device by the circular heat radiation, and the service life of the temperature sensing device is ensured.

title_en: Stable power generation system combining inflation concentration electric heat cogeneration concentrated power generation and heat pump heating/thermal power generation mode conversion thermal energy storage
abstract_en: A solar power generation system with ultra-high efficiency, extremely low cost and stable power supply is composed of an inflatable non-imaging concentrating combined heat and power generation subsystem and a heat storage subsystem driven by a mode-convertible heating heat pump/heat power generation system. The inflatable non-imaging light-gathering system realizes large-scale sunlight concentration and gathering at extremely low cost, so that extremely low system cost is realized; the receiver of the cogeneration light-gathering system generates a large amount of electricity while generating electricity, thereby realizing ultrahigh conversion efficiency; the active heat storage system driven by the mode-convertible heating heat pump/heat power generation system heats the heat generated by the combined heat and power generation system through the heat pump and stores the heat in the heat storage medium, and power generation is carried out at night or in rainy days, so that heat is input and output. The photovoltaic power generation and the photo-thermal power generation are operated cooperatively to realize stable and constant power supply. The system does not need to consume chemical raw materials, has no potential safety hazard, is not limited by geographical conditions or other conditions, and is not limited by scale, so the system can be widely applied to various large, medium and small systems, and is particularly suitable for large-scale power supply of a power grid.

title_en: Air conditioner
abstract_en: The invention provides an air conditioner, which relates to the technical field of air conditioners, and comprises a middle frame and a base, wherein the middle frame is arranged on the base, an air duct shell is further arranged on the base, an air outlet is arranged on the outer side of the air duct shell, a first air deflector is further rotatably arranged on the base, a first air deflector is provided with a first air deflector hole, a second air deflector is further arranged in the air duct shell, a second air deflector hole is formed in the second air deflector, and an included angle of the second air deflector relative to the upper side wall of the air duct shell is 8-20 degrees. According to the invention, the air flow is prevented from directly impacting the upper side of the first air deflector, so that the first air deflector is prevented from being stressed and deformed, the first air deflector is prevented from being stressed and opened, a gap is prevented from being formed between the first air deflector and the front panel, condensation on the front panel is prevented, and the use experience is improved. In addition, through the flow equalizing effect of second wind guiding hole for the air outlet realizes even air-out, has further guaranteed zero wind sense demand.

title_en: Operation control method and system for multi-stage variable frequency air conditioning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for controlling the operation of a multi-stage variable frequency air conditioning system, which comprises the following steps: setting the lowest operation frequency for each air conditioning unit in the multi-stage variable frequency air conditioning system; comparing the real-time outlet air temperature with a preset target temperature, and regulating and controlling the working frequency of the air conditioning unit according to the comparison result; for any two air conditioning units adjacent to each other, judging whether the current working frequency of the preceding-stage unit is greater than the lowest operating frequency, if not, judging whether the output frequency of the subsequent-stage unit is greater than X% of the rated frequency, if so, controlling the preceding-stage unit to operate at the lowest operating frequency, and if not, controlling the preceding-stage unit to gradually reduce the load according to a preset time period until the air conditioning unit is stopped; based on the operation control method, system oscillation caused by frequent start and stop of the pre-stage unit can be avoided, and meanwhile, the two stages of units can be stably connected even under the environment condition of alternate seasons by limiting the unloading rate of the pre-stage unit.

title_en: Porous medium heat exchanger with extremely small curved surface and Kagome truss structure based on Sigmoid function hybridization method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of heat exchangers, and provides a porous medium heat exchanger with a minimum curved surface and a Kagome truss structure based on a Sigmoid function hybridization method, wherein a core body comprises a cold fluid channel and a hot fluid channel, the channels are separated by a partition board, the inlets and the outlets of the different channels are separated by seals, a DP-type hybridized three-period minimum curved surface disturbance structure is inserted into the hot fluid channel, the Kagome truss structure is inserted into the cold fluid channel, the ligament cross section of the Kagome truss structure is elliptical, and cold fluid and hot fluid are distributed in a cross flow manner. The heat exchanger has the advantages of compact structure, complex flow channel, large heat exchange area, high heat exchange efficiency and the like, compared with the traditional P-type minimum curved surface, improves the heat exchange area, increases the number of vortex flows, and improves the comprehensive heat exchange performance compared with the traditional round ligament Kagome truss structure. The heat exchanger is practical, efficient and safe, and provides a new thought for solving the problem of heat management of the aero-engine.

title_en: Energy conversion/storage system based on high-electric conduction/heat conduction ultra-high-performance concrete and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy conversion/storage system based on high-electric conduction/heat conduction ultra-high performance concrete and application thereof, and belongs to the field of intelligent/multifunctional cement-based material preparation and application. The invention prepares the high-electric/heat-conducting ultrahigh-performance concrete by adopting the molybdenum-chromium stainless steel microfilaments with micron-sized diameter, excellent electric and heat transfer performance and high mechanical and stainless characteristics and the ultrahigh-performance concrete in a synergistic way, further develops the energy conversion/storage system which has high conversion/storage efficiency, good long-term stability and excellent mechanical performance and meets the size requirement of small-section/thin plate components based on the high-performance concrete, can be directly used for developing bridge decks, road decks, airport pavement slabs, steps and tunnel openings for melting snow and ice through electric heating, is used for farms, home floor heating and the like for self-collecting thermal energy, and can also be used as a solar heat storage module to improve the collection utilization rate of new energy.

title_en: Air filtering equipment for production of toxin filtering box workshop and using method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of workshop air filtration, and discloses air filtration equipment for workshop production of a toxin filtering box, which comprises a shell, wherein a fixed box is fixedly arranged in the shell, two groups of sealing plates which are symmetrically arranged are connected to the fixed box in a sliding manner, a bearing frame is arranged on one side, opposite to the two groups of sealing plates, of each group of bearing frame, a fixing frame is connected to the inside of each bearing frame in a sliding manner, a driving mechanism is arranged on the lower side of the shell, and the driving mechanism comprises a main shaft; this strain air filtration equipment for toxin box workshop production drives U type frame through the cam rotation and reciprocates along bearing frame medial surface through the gyro wheel, and the filter screen high-speed shake shakes, shakes off the dust that stores up behind the filtration air on the filter screen, effectively improves the filter effect of equipment, reduces artifical clearance filter screen frequency, can change the filter screen fast, and the shrouding is with one side air flue shutoff that casing and fixed box are constituteed, need not to shut down and changes the filter screen, promotes work efficiency.

title_en: Net-shaped resin molded body and method for operating air conditioner using same
abstract_en: Provided are a net-shaped resin molded body capable of improving heat exchange efficiency of a heat exchanger by controlling electrification of air introduced into the heat exchanger, and an operation method of an air conditioner using the same. A net-shaped resin molded article is formed of a thermoplastic resin, has a plate shape and has a plurality of ventilation holes penetrating in the thickness direction, and is capable of improving the heat exchange efficiency of a heat exchanger by introducing air electrically controlled by the ventilation holes into the heat exchanger. It is composed of a thermoplastic resin of polyethylene or polypropylene in which a non-calcined powder of a montmorillonite clay mineral is dissolved. In addition, the operation method of the air conditioner arranges the mesh resin molded body so as to traverse an air flow path leading to the heat exchanger, and introduces air into the heat exchanger through the vent hole.

title_en: Pipeline clamp plate, air conditioner indoor unit and air conditioner
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a pipeline clamp plate, air conditioning indoor set and air conditioner, the pipeline clamp plate includes the clamp plate body, the clamp plate body has relative interval arrangement's first side direction pressfitting portion and second side direction pressfitting portion, and connects first side direction pressfitting portion with horizontal pressfitting portion between the second side direction pressfitting portion, wherein, first side direction pressfitting portion second side direction pressfitting portion with horizontal pressfitting portion is integrated into one piece structure. In the pipeline clamp plate that this disclosure provided, wholly can adopt U type integral type design, can carry out abundant pressfitting to the pipeline in the pipe space of walking, avoid the pipeline to have the risk of perk, guarantee that the face of inserting of hanging the board is the plane, easy to assemble hanging the board, simultaneously because as an organic whole formula structure has reduced the quantity of pipeline clamp plate, reduces assembly process, saves assembly time, improves assembly efficiency.

title_en: Gas detector, evaporator and refrigerating system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a gas detector, comprising a gas cell and a light source located inside the gas cell, the outer surface of the inner wall of the gas cell being coated with a first coating for refracting or reflecting light from the light source, and the outer side of the first coating being coated with a second coating made of a transparent material. The invention also provides an evaporator provided with the gas detector and a refrigeration system provided with the evaporator. The gas detector adopts the second coating layer made of transparent material, so that the first coating layer used for refracting or reflecting light on the inner wall of the gas chamber can be prevented from being corroded, and the detection precision of the gas detector is ensured.

title_en: Air energy water heater control method and device and air energy water heater
abstract_en: The application relates to a control method and device of an air energy water heater and control of the air energy water heater, wherein the exhaust temperature of a compressor, the temperature of a water tank and the ambient temperature of the air energy water heater are obtained, the frequency of the compressor is determined by combining the obtained exhaust temperature of the compressor, the temperature of the water tank and the ambient temperature, and finally the compressor of the air energy water heater is controlled to operate at the determined frequency of the compressor. According to the scheme, in the operation process of the air energy water heater, the current required compressor frequency can be determined by combining the exhaust temperature of the compressor, so that the compressor frequency can change along with the change of the load in time, the condition of shutdown protection caused by over-adjustment of the compressor frequency when the load of the air energy water heater changes rapidly is relieved, and the operation reliability of the air energy water heater is improved.

title_en: Toilet's physics falls device of making an uproar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a physical noise reduction device for a clean room, which relates to the technical field of noise reduction of the clean room and comprises a building column and a floor slab between the upper end and the lower end of the building column, wherein the clean room is formed between the building column and the floor slab, wall plate boxes are arranged on the periphery of the inner wall of the clean room, noise reduction structures are arranged on the inner wall of the wall plate box, an air pipe is arranged at the top of the wall plate box, and a sound absorption mechanism is arranged in the building column; the noise reduction structure is formed by splicing a plurality of noise reduction plates; a noise reduction assembly is vertically arranged inside the radio strip groove; the wall board box is matched with the noise reduction structure and the sound absorption mechanism, so that the equipment noise and the wind noise generated in the clean room during clean operation can be synchronously reduced, the noise can be conveniently subjected to noise reduction treatment for many times, the noise is prevented from generating echo in the clean room, and the noise with different frequencies, such as low, medium and high, can be synchronously reduced; the noise control effect of the clean room in use is improved, so that the physical noise reduction effect of the clean room is greatly improved.

title_en: Telescopic heat preservation device and method suitable for remanufacturing rollers of different specifications
abstract_en: The invention discloses a telescopic heat preservation device and a method suitable for remanufacturing rollers with different specifications, belonging to the technical field of remanufacturing of rollers and comprising a fixed end, a movable end and a telescopic furnace cover; the fixed end and the movable end both comprise furnace body end surfaces, open ends, heating units which are respectively arranged on the inner walls and used for heating the rollers, temperature measuring units used for measuring the temperature of the rollers, walking wheels which are arranged at the bottoms and used for adjusting the length of a hearth formed inside the fixed end and the movable end, and walking rails which are longitudinally arranged and used for guiding the walking wheels; the side wall of the fixed end is provided with a first step structure and a second step structure from the open end to the end surface of the furnace body; the open end of the movable end is inserted into the open end of the fixed end and is closed with the first step; the bottom of the hearth of the fixed end is provided with a conveying device and a receiving hopper; an operating platform is arranged on the upper portion of the fixed end. The invention realizes the remanufacture and heating of the product with the size range of 1800 mm-3000 mm at the same station and automatically removes slag.

title_en: Electronic expansion valve
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electronic expansion valve, which comprises a valve seat, a coil, a plunger, a valve rod, a valve needle, a partition plate and a porous metal device, wherein an inlet and an outlet of the valve seat are communicated with an inner cavity of the valve seat; the porous metal plate is arranged at the position, close to the outlet, of the valve seat and between the partition plate and the outlet, a space is formed between the porous metal plate and the partition plate to form a transition cavity, so that the refrigerant flows into the transition cavity after passing through the through hole in the center of the partition plate, and then flows through the porous metal plate to enable the refrigerant to form bubble flow more fully, namely the bubble flow is converted from plug flow, and therefore the flowing noise of the refrigerant after the electronic expansion valve is throttled is effectively avoided.

title_en: Ultrathin flexible vapor chamber structure and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an ultrathin flexible soaking plate structure, which comprises at least 2 soaking plates which are sequentially arranged, wherein a sealing cavity is arranged in each soaking plate, a liquid suction core, a liquid channel and a steam channel are arranged in the sealing cavity, working media are filled in the sealing cavity, a flexible heat transfer layer is arranged between adjacent soaking plates, and two ends of the flexible heat transfer layer are respectively connected with the adjacent soaking plates. Because the adjacent vapor chamber is connected through the flexible heat transfer layer, the heat of the vapor chamber can be mutually transferred through the flexible heat transfer layer, and the overall vapor chamber performance is effectively improved. The flexible heat transfer layer has the characteristic of flexibility, so that the ultrathin flexible soaking plate structure can be bent at the flexible heat transfer layer, and the flexible soaking plate structure can be applied to a scene needing bending and installation; can meet more complex heat dissipation requirements. The vapor chamber is of a flat structure, meets the thinning requirement of modern engineering on the phase change heat transfer device, and is beneficial to realizing miniaturization of electronic devices. The invention also relates to a preparation method of the ultrathin flexible vapor chamber structure.

title_en: Mould-proof durable composite wallboard
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mildew-proof durable composite wallboard, which comprises a mounting plate mounted on the inner wall of a bathroom, wherein the front side of the mounting plate is connected with a composite substrate, the left side and the right side of the composite substrate are respectively provided with a through pipe, and the lower end of the through pipe is internally provided with a discharge port; further comprising: the heating assembly and the condensing pipe assembly are embedded in the composite substrate, are respectively positioned in the lower end interior and the upper end interior of the composite substrate, and are communicated with each other; the liquid storage cavity and the liquid discharge cavity are arranged inside the through pipe and are respectively located inside the upper end and the lower end of the through pipe. According to the mould-proof durable composite wallboard, water liquid attached to the inside of the mounting plate is promoted to evaporate through the heating assembly to form water vapor and then the water vapor is discharged, so that the dehumidifying operation of the composite wallboard is realized, and the mould-proof performance of the wallboard is improved under the action of the mould-proof antibacterial coating agent.

title_en: Heat supply energy-saving system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heat supply energy-saving system and a heat supply energy-saving method, and belongs to the technical field of heat supply energy saving. The method comprises the steps of obtaining and storing real-time operation data of a heat supply system, and constructing a digital twin model of the heat supply system; analyzing the operation state of the heat supply system according to the real-time operation data and the historical data, and acquiring an energy-saving operation strategy of the heat supply system; and sending an operation instruction to the intelligent control device according to the energy-saving operation strategy so as to set parameters and control starting and stopping of equipment in the heating system. Based on big data and thing networking, combine terminal demand and energy supply, carry out energy-conserving regulation and control to heating system, under the prerequisite of guaranteeing the heat supply, realize the allocation as required of the energy, avoid the energy extravagant. The problem of exist among the prior art "in order to guarantee user experience, have the condition of heat supply excess, cause a large amount of energy extravagant".

title_en: Synthesis method of substituted nitrogen-containing quinazolinone compound
abstract_en: A method for synthesizing substituted nitrogen-containing quinazolinone compounds is implemented by using a reinforced heating sleeve, and takes 3-vinylpyridine, 2- (7-azabenzotriazole) -N, N, N ', N' -tetramethylurea hexafluorophosphate and 2-ethyl aminobenzoate as raw materials; finally obtaining the product (E) -3- (4-chlorobenzyl) -2- (2- (pyridine-3-yl) vinyl) quinazoline-4 (3H) -ketone.

title_en: Control method and control system of integrated kitchen range and integrated kitchen range
abstract_en: The invention provides a control method and a control system of an integrated kitchen range, and the integrated kitchen range is applied to the integrated kitchen range, and comprises a kitchen range and a range hood; the method comprises the following steps: acquiring cooking parameters; generating an integrated stove control instruction according to the cooking parameters and the corresponding relation between the preset cooking parameters and the firepower-air quantity; controlling the working state of the integrated cooker according to the control instruction of the integrated cooker, monitoring the temperature of the bottom of the cooker in real time, and controlling the cooker of the integrated cooker to stop heating if the temperature of the bottom of the cooker is higher than a first preset temperature until the temperature of the bottom of the cooker is lower than a second preset temperature; the second preset temperature is less than the first preset temperature. In the mode, the working state of the integrated cooker is controlled by a method of presetting cooking parameters and monitoring the temperature of the bottom of the cooker in real time, so that intelligent control of the integrated cooker is realized, the use feeling of a user is further improved, and the cooking safety of the user is ensured.

title_en: Casing, casing assembly, air conditioner indoor unit and air conditioner
abstract_en: The invention discloses a shell, a shell component, an air conditioner indoor unit and an air conditioner, wherein the shell component comprises a shell, a shell body and an electric control plate, the shell is provided with a wire passing hole, a part of the outer surface of the shell forms an electric control installation part, and an outer end hole of the wire passing hole is arranged on the electric control installation part; the cover body is covered on the electric control installation part, and an electric control installation space is defined between the cover body and the shell; the electric control board is arranged in the electric control installation space and can be electrically connected with a wire penetrating through the wire passing hole. The air conditioner indoor unit with the shell component has the advantages of high production efficiency of the whole machine, low production cost, convenience in maintenance and the like.

title_en: Wall-mounted indoor unit and air conditioner
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wall-mounted indoor unit and an air conditioner, wherein the wall-mounted indoor unit comprises a shell and an electric control box, the shell is provided with an electric control box installation position, and an integrated connection terminal is arranged on the shell corresponding to the electric control box installation position; and a butt-joint terminal is arranged on the electric control box corresponding to the integrated connection terminal, and the butt-joint terminal is in butt joint with the integrated connection terminal when the electric control box is mounted to the electric control box mounting position. When the indoor unit is installed, the electric control box is assembled firstly, and then the electric control box is installed at the corresponding position on the shell, and the plurality of wiring structures can be connected with the electric control box through the integrated connecting terminals and the butt-joint terminals, so that the complicated wiring and arranging process and the disassembling process are simplified, the production efficiency is improved, the wiring structure can be realized through full-intelligent automatic production during the assembly wiring, the productivity can be improved, the cost can be reduced, and the market competitiveness of the indoor unit can be improved.

title_en: Air conditioner shutdown control method and device, electronic equipment and air conditioner
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a shutdown control method and device of an air conditioner, electronic equipment and the air conditioner, wherein the method comprises the steps of responding to a shutdown instruction received in the refrigerating process of the air conditioner, acquiring outdoor environment temperature, outdoor coil temperature and compressor current; and controlling the operating frequency of the compressor according to the target frequency-reducing rate. Therefore, when a shutdown instruction is received in the refrigerating process of the air conditioner, the method determines a target frequency-reducing rate based on the outdoor environment temperature, the outdoor coil temperature and the compressor current, and controls the running frequency of the compressor according to the target frequency-reducing rate, so that the overlarge change of external load can be prevented, the overlarge stress of the outdoor coil caused by overlarge change of external load due to direct shutdown is avoided, and the risk of pipe breakage of the outdoor coil even caused by overlarge stress of the external coil is avoided.

title_en: Heat energy recovery device for ultralow-nitrogen gas module water heater
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of heat recovery, in particular to a heat recovery device for an ultralow-nitrogen gas module hot water furnace, which comprises a heat exchange box, wherein a heat exchange system, a water removal system and a power system for driving the water removal system are arranged on the heat exchange box; the dewatering system comprises a movable plate, wherein a clamping groove is formed in the movable plate corresponding to the position of the heat exchange tube, a sponge is arranged in the clamping groove, a reciprocating screw is arranged on the movable plate in a transmission mode, the reciprocating screw is rotatably arranged on the two covering plates, the top of the reciprocating screw extends out of a channel formed in the upper collecting shell, and an extrusion sleeve is fixed at the position, corresponding to the heat exchange tube, of the lower covering plate. According to the invention, the heat exchange box, the heat exchange system, the water removal system and the like are added, waste gas generated by combustion enters the heat exchange system, and in the heat exchange process, the water removal system can absorb condensed water on the outer surface of the heat exchange pipe, so that the corrosion of the condensed water on the heat exchange pipe is reduced, and the service life of the heat exchange system is prolonged.

title_en: Gas pipe connector and heating system of gas turbine power plant boiler pressure regulating station
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air pipe connector and a heating system of a pressure regulating station of a boiler of a fuel-fired power plant, which comprise a base, wherein the outer surface of the base is provided with threads, the end part of the threads is also provided with a backstop plate, and one surface of the backstop plate facing the threads is also provided with a backstop groove; and the plug assembly comprises a connector, a sleeve arranged outside the connector, an unlocking piece arranged inside the sleeve, a locking piece arranged at the end part of the unlocking piece, and a connecting plate arranged inside the unlocking piece, wherein the connecting plate is in threaded fit with the base. The connector is good in sealing performance, can prevent looseness caused by high-pressure gas impact, and is quite convenient to detach. The system avoids the direct contact between the electric heater and the natural gas, and can heat the natural gas in a closed circulation state by using the steam generated by the electric heater when the boiler is started to operate, thereby saving electric energy for the operation of a gas turbine power plant and eliminating the potential safety hazard of starting the explosion of a pressure regulating station of the boiler.

title_en: Air treatment device, air conditioner indoor unit and air conditioner
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air treatment device, an air conditioner indoor unit and an air conditioner, wherein the air treatment device comprises: a shell provided with an air duct; the purification module is arranged in the air duct and is used for adsorbing pollutants and desorbing the pollutants under the action of hot air; and the hot air generating assembly is arranged outside the shell and independent of the air duct and is used for conveying hot air to the purification module. The technical scheme of the invention has larger adsorption capacity, does not need to be replaced regularly, and can effectively reduce the use cost; meanwhile, the air inlet efficiency and the air inlet quantity can be ensured not to be influenced; in addition, the use safety of the hot air generating assembly can be improved.

title_en: Fume exhauster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a range hood, which comprises: the range hood shell is provided with a base plate and a smoke inlet formed on the base plate; the fan assembly is arranged in the shell of the range hood; the air deflector is positioned outside the base plate and used for guiding the oil smoke to enter the smoke inlet through a flow channel between the air deflector and the base plate; at least one shielding plate disposed on the inner surface of the substrate; at least one drive mechanism is operable to drive movement of the shutter for closing the smoke inlet and defining a smoke inlet region of the smoke inlet. The invention has the beneficial effects that the condition that the oil smoke flows backward and the oil smoke on two sides is easy to escape can be avoided.

title_en: Magnetic core sintering transfer device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a magnetic core sintering transfer device, which comprises a frame, a conveyor belt and a blanking mechanism, wherein the frame is provided with a plurality of magnetic cores; the bottom of the frame is provided with a travelling device, the conveyor belt is rotatably arranged on the frame, the conveyor belt is provided with a plurality of first limit baffles, the first limit baffles are arranged at equal intervals, and a magnetic core placement area is formed between the adjacent pair of limit baffles; the blanking mechanism is arranged on the frame and is close to the blanking portion, the blanking mechanism comprises a blanking bearing frame, a vertical moving assembly and a horizontal moving assembly, the top end of the blanking bearing frame is rotatably arranged on the horizontal moving assembly through a rotating shaft, the horizontal moving assembly is provided with a driving assembly for driving the rotating shaft to rotate, the horizontal moving assembly is arranged on the vertical moving assembly, and the vertical moving assembly is fixedly arranged on the frame. The invention has higher magnetic core transferring efficiency and better safety, and ensures the efficient and safe production of the magnetic core.

title_en: Burner with a burner body
abstract_en: The application relates to a burner and a combustion method, wherein the burner comprises a first shell, a second shell and a plurality of distribution parts, the first ends of the distribution parts are arranged on the outer peripheral surface of the second shell in a surrounding way by taking the axis of the second shell as a shaft, the second ends of the distribution parts penetrate through the first shell to divide a first cavity into a plurality of independent cavities along the radial direction, the independent cavities are respectively communicated with a plurality of first air outlet groups, the two opposite sides of each distribution part are respectively provided with a second air outlet group, and the connecting line between the second air outlet groups and the first air outlet groups is perpendicular to the axis of the first shell.

title_en: Cooking hob with display information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cooking top with display information, which comprises a top plate and a man-machine interaction panel. The hearth plate includes a plurality of heating cooking zones arranged in a rectangular array; the man-machine interaction panel comprises a working state display part and an instruction input part; the working state display part comprises temperature display, heating progress display and cooking state display; the temperature display is used for displaying the temperature of the cooking hearth in real time when the cooking hearth works; the heating progress display is used for displaying the heating condition of the cooking hearth in real time when the cooking hearth works; the cooking state display comprises a cooking area combination display and a cooking area division display; the cooking area combination area display and the cooking area partition display both comprise display blocks for displaying the working states of all heating cooking areas; the instruction input part includes a cooking mode selection area. The invention can realize the real-time display of the working state of the cooking equipment and can adjust the cooking mode and the heating range according to the requirements of users.

title_en: Electric steamer with automatic water supplementing system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an electric steamer with an automatic water supplementing system, which comprises a base component, a water storage tank and a steamer, wherein a steam storage cavity is defined in the base component, a heating disc is arranged at the bottom of the steam storage cavity, a one-way pressure relief channel for discharging steam in the steam storage cavity into the inner cavity of the steamer is arranged on the base component; the electric steamer can utilize high steam generated in the steam storage cavity to be discharged into the water storage tank, and water in the water storage tank is automatically supplemented into the steam storage cavity by increasing steam pressure, so that the steam storage cavity can be automatically supplemented with water.

title_en: Control method of steam energy-saving heating system
abstract_en: The invention provides a control method of a steam energy-saving heating system, which comprises a first heating mode and a second heating mode, wherein the second heating mode comprises the following steps: b1: controlling the material to be heated in the heating pipeline to exchange heat with the hot water heat exchanger, and heating the material to be heated to W1; b2: and controlling the material to be heated in the heating pipeline to exchange heat with the steam heat exchanger, wherein the temperature of the material to be heated is heated to W2, and W2 is more than W1. Through the condensate water cyclic utilization to steam heat exchanger, through detecting temperature, the difference of liquid level, switch different heating modes, improve holistic adaptability and the energy utilization ratio of system, reduced the consumption of steam, shortened heating time, improved the energy-conserving heating system heating efficiency of steam.

title_en: Phase change cold accumulation system based on transcritical carbon dioxide absorption refrigeration cycle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a phase-change cold accumulation system based on transcritical carbon dioxide absorption refrigeration cycle, which comprises a solar heat collection system, an absorption refrigeration cycle system and a phase-change cold accumulation and discharge system; the solar heat collection system is connected with the absorption refrigeration cycle system and is used for providing solar energy for the absorption refrigeration cycle system, and the absorption refrigeration cycle system is connected with the phase-change cold accumulation and release system and is used for providing refrigeration for the phase-change cold accumulation and release system. The invention effectively combines the green carbon dioxide refrigeration technology with other energy-saving technologies, namely solar heat supply technology, through the generator. When solar natural resources are rich in daytime, the transcritical carbon dioxide absorption refrigeration system fully utilizes heat energy provided by the transcritical carbon dioxide absorption refrigeration system to generate cold and supply cold continuously and stably, so that the high-efficiency utilization of renewable energy sources is realized, the advantages of environmental friendliness, sustainability and the like are realized, and the transcritical carbon dioxide absorption refrigeration system has important significance for energy conservation and carbon reduction.

title_en: Sintering mold, hot-pressing sintering system and interconnection method of chips
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of semiconductors, and provides a sintering mold, a hot-pressing sintering system and a chip interconnection method, wherein the sintering mold comprises a mold body, the die body is provided with a plurality of grooves, the grooves are used for bearing the chip components, and the notches of the grooves face the same end face of the die body. The bonding belt, the chip and the substrate can be layered in the groove of the sintering mold, the sintering interconnection can be integrally and rapidly completed, multiple sintering and mounting procedures can be avoided, and the chip interconnection efficiency is improved.

title_en: Evaporative condenser unit and air outlet height control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of heat exchange equipment, and particularly discloses an evaporative condenser unit which comprises a shell, a condenser, a spraying device and a fan. The condenser, the spraying device and the fan are all arranged on the shell, the spraying device is used for spraying liquid to the condenser, the spraying opening of the spraying device is arranged upwards or downwards, an air inlet and an air outlet are respectively arranged on two opposite sides of the shell, the fan is arranged between the air inlet and the air outlet, an air path is formed between the air inlet and the air outlet, the flow direction of the air path is orthogonal to the spraying direction of the spraying device, and the height of the air outlet on the shell is adjustable. The evaporative condenser unit provided by the invention can correspondingly adjust the height of the air outlet according to the rotating speed of the fan so as to better bring out the heat of the evaporated steam, further reduce the real-time wind resistance and improve the real-time energy efficiency of the evaporative condenser unit. The invention also discloses a method for controlling the height of the air outlet of the evaporative condenser unit, which has the technical effects.

title_en: Be suitable for clear stifled system of cement oxy-fuel combustion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a blockage removing system suitable for cement oxy-fuel combustion, which comprises a gas compression device, a gas gun blockage removing device and a gas pipeline, wherein the gas compression device is connected to the gas gun blockage removing device through the gas pipeline, the carbon dioxide volume percentage of a gas source of the gas compression device is more than or equal to 70%, the gas gun blockage removing device is connected with a spraying nozzle through the gas pipeline, and a compressed gas source of high-concentration carbon dioxide is quickly released through the gas gun blockage removing device to remove blockage or crust at each blockage removing position. According to the invention, the carbon dioxide flue gas with the volume percentage of more than or equal to 70% of the cement oxy-fuel combustion system is used as a compressed air source of the blockage removal device to replace air, so that the nitrogen amount brought into the oxy-fuel combustion system in the blockage removal process can be greatly reduced, the carbon dioxide concentration in the system can be improved to a certain extent, and the cost for capturing and purifying carbon dioxide can be greatly reduced.

title_en: Heat supply network scale and rust prevention system and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of heating ventilation, and particularly relates to a scale and rust prevention system and method for a heat supply network; the scale and rust prevention system of the heat supply network comprises: the device comprises an air purging module and an online medicament adding module, wherein the air purging module and the online medicament adding module are both communicated with a heat supply network pipeline. The air purge module includes: the system comprises an air pipeline, an orifice plate flowmeter, a pressure regulating valve and a humidity analyzer, wherein one end of the air pipeline is communicated with an air source, the other end of the air pipeline is communicated with a heat supply network pipeline, and the orifice plate flowmeter, the pressure regulating valve and the humidity analyzer are sequentially arranged on the air pipeline along the air circulation direction. The online medicament adding module comprises: the metering device comprises a first metering box, a first metering pump and a pressure relief valve, wherein the first metering box is communicated with the first metering pump, the pressure relief valve and a heat network pipeline in sequence.

title_en: Heat supply backwater mechanism of thermal power plant
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of heat supply backwater devices of thermal power plants, in particular to a heat supply backwater mechanism of a thermal power plant. The device comprises an iron removal box, a cation exchanger and a deaerator which are sequentially connected through a water return pipe, wherein a plurality of movably connected magnet plates are arranged inside the iron removal box, and a water return channel is arranged between the magnet plates and the inner wall of the iron removal box. The iron removing box with the magnet plate is arranged in front of the cation exchanger, so that iron in backwater can be adsorbed due to certain magnetism of the magnet plate, iron is prevented from depositing and accumulating in a backwater pipeline and the cation exchanger, and damage is reduced; a backwater channel is reserved between the iron removal box and the magnet plate, so that water is convenient to contact with the magnet plate, and the iron adsorption effect is ensured.

title_en: Central air conditioner control method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a central air conditioner control method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, comprising the following steps: in response to a received target control instruction, acquiring an initial measured temperature of a target space in an initial time period and an actual measured temperature of a preset time period, wherein the preset time period is positioned after the initial time period; determining the temperature state of the target space according to the relation between the initial measured temperature and the actual measured temperature; and determining a control strategy of the central air conditioner according to the target control instruction and the temperature state, so that resource waste is avoided.

title_en: Kiln waste heat combined ceramic integrated pulverizing system and process
abstract_en: The utility model provides a kiln waste heat combined ceramic integrated pulverizing system and a kiln waste heat combined ceramic integrated pulverizing process. The integrated pulverizing system comprises a kiln, a drying kiln, a first heat exchanger and drying equipment, wherein the kiln comprises three functional areas, namely a cooling zone, a sintering zone and a preheating zone; the preheating zone is communicated with a first heat exchanger through a kiln head flue gas pipeline, the first heat exchanger is communicated with drying equipment through a kiln head waste heat utilization pipeline, and the first heat exchanger is also respectively communicated with a fresh air inlet pipeline and a flue gas discharge pipeline after heat exchange; the cooling belt is communicated with the drying kiln through a first waste heat utilization pipeline at the tail of the kiln, and the drying kiln is communicated with the drying equipment through a waste heat utilization pipeline of the drying kiln. The integrated pulverizing system is also provided with a kiln tail second waste heat utilization pipeline communicated with the drying equipment. Because the kiln waste heat utilization technology and the improvement result of the drying equipment are comprehensively utilized, the whole heat energy required by the drying kiln and 77.78% of the heat energy required in the ceramic powder drying process are supplied by the kiln waste heat.

title_en: Hot ore chute of sintering machine
abstract_en: The invention provides a hot ore chute of a sintering machine, which belongs to the technical field of sintering machines and comprises a chute motherboard, wherein a plurality of segregation devices with different specifications are arranged on the chute motherboard, and the process segregation and the buffering of sintered red ores with different particle sizes are completed through repeated rolling and reflection of a sintered red ore material flow by a first segregation device, a second segregation device, a third segregation device and a fourth segregation device, and the forced centering and uniform distribution of the sintered red ore material flow are realized by the fourth segregation device by utilizing the change of the groove width, so that the sintered red ore material flow is forced to be centered and uniformly distributed on a discharging trolley of an annular cooler after flowing out by the fourth segregation device.

title_en: Hot steam recovery filtering device for coal power generation and treatment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heat steam recovery filtering device and a treatment method for coal power generation, and relates to the technical field of waste heat recovery filtering treatment. The invention comprises a box body, wherein a processing assembly is arranged in the box body, two groups of movable assemblies are arranged in the processing assembly, and the two groups of movable assemblies are sequentially arranged from bottom to top; the processing assembly comprises a first processing box, a heat exchange plate, a top plate, a first middle through pipe, a first four-way pipe, a first water level sensor, a second processing box, a second middle through pipe, a second four-way pipe and a second water level sensor, and the movable assembly comprises a movable rod, an extrusion block, an elastic air bag, a sealing plate, an air inlet, an air outlet and an extrusion plate. According to the invention, the hot air can be used through the movable assembly, and stays in the treatment box for a longer time, so that after the hot air exchanges heat with the heat exchange plate, the residual heat of the hot air rises upwards to exchange heat with the top plate continuously, the hot air can be fully utilized, and the utilization rate of waste heat is maximized.

title_en: Control method and device of air conditioning system, air conditioning system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control method and device of an air conditioning system, the air conditioning system and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining a current outer fan rotating speed range of an outer fan in the air conditioning system corresponding to the current pressure load of the air conditioning system, and recording the current outer fan rotating speed range as the current outer fan rotating speed range of the air conditioning system; determining the rotating speeds of n grades in the current rotating speed range of an external fan of the air conditioning system to obtain n rotating speeds; controlling an external fan in the air conditioning system to run at each of n rotating speeds; and determining the power of the air conditioning system at each rotating speed according to the direct current bus voltage and the direct current bus voltage at each rotating speed, obtaining n powers of the air conditioning system at n rotating speeds, and determining the rotating speed corresponding to the minimum power as the current rotating speed of the external fan. According to the scheme, the rotating speed range of the external fan is defined according to the pressure load of the air conditioning system, so that the external fan of the air conditioning system operates at the wind speed level with the lowest energy consumption, and the energy consumption of the air conditioning system can be reduced.

title_en: Steel cable and steel tube combined photovoltaic bracket and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a steel cable and steel tube combined photovoltaic bracket and a method, wherein the steel cable and steel tube combined photovoltaic bracket comprises a vertically arranged telescopic main bracket, a horizontally arranged auxiliary bracket, a concrete column below the main bracket, steel cables at four corners of the photovoltaic bracket, a photovoltaic plate and a fluctuation foundation; the main support of the steel cable and steel tube combined type photovoltaic support provided by the invention is telescopic in the vertical direction, so that all photovoltaic panels are ensured to be on the same plane, and the light energy absorption efficiency of the photovoltaic panels is enhanced; the high-strength steel cable flexibly adjusts the height difference at two ends of the photovoltaic support through adjusting the length, namely flexibly adjusts the angle of the photovoltaic panel, and reduces the structural cost and the maintenance and replacement cost of the traditional adjusting device.

title_en: Photovoltaic solar collector and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic solar collector and a use method thereof, and relates to the technical field of solar collectors. The solar panel can realize all-round adjustment to the left, the right, the front and the back, a plurality of solar panels can be folded and stored under the condition of complex weather change, and through the use of the heating and ventilation mechanism, when circulating water flows through a pair of heating pipes, the circulating water is heated, so that the whole solar panel is kept in a heating state, and when snow accumulation or freezing occurs on the solar panel, the solar panel can be melted by heat, so that the normal operation of the solar panel is ensured.

title_en: Waterproof protection device for photovoltaic panel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a waterproof protection device for a photovoltaic panel, which comprises a bottom frame; the bottom frame is used for supporting the upper element, a lifting angle adjusting assembly and a photovoltaic panel clamping assembly are arranged in the bottom frame, and a cover plate opening and closing assembly and a frame leakage-proof assembly are arranged on the bottom frame; the invention relates to the technical field of photovoltaic power generation assistance, which has the following beneficial effects: the scheme is that the photovoltaic panel is arranged in the transparent shell, rainwater can be prevented directly, the side and rear gaps of the bottom frame and the upper cover plate can be shielded by the rain shielding plate on the shell, the rainwater can slide down from the rear and the two ends, the gaps in front of the bottom frame and the upper cover plate can be sealed by the frame leakage-proof assembly, and the upper cover plate can be installed and fixed.

title_en: Dehumidifier
abstract_en: The invention provides a dehumidifier (1) which can efficiently select an air purification operation and a dehumidification operation, and has excellent dehumidification capability while suppressing operation sound. A dehumidifier (1) is provided with: a first air passage formed in the frame (3) and through which the air supply flow passes to reach the dehumidifying mechanism; a second air passage formed in the frame (3) and through which the air flow does not pass to reach the dehumidifying mechanism; and an airflow restricting mechanism (51) that restricts the flow of the airflow in the second air path. The inlet of the second air passage is located on the outer peripheral side of the air purifying mechanism, and the outlet of the second air passage is located on the center side of the air purifying mechanism from the inlet.

title_en: Air conditioning unit frame structure
abstract_en: The invention provides a frame structure of an air conditioning unit. This based on air conditioning unit frame construction, including first steel support, the inside of first steel support is provided with the second steel support, the left surface fixedly connected with first steel connecting rod of second steel support, the right surface fixedly connected with second steel connecting rod of second steel support, the side surface of first steel support is provided with first screw hole, the left surface fixedly connected with second stationary blade of first steel support, the mounting plate, the upper surface fixedly connected with longitudinal rod of mounting plate, the side surface fixedly connected with dead lever of longitudinal rod. Through designing connecting device, realize the device and can carry out the regulation of width at the in-process of using, increase the suitability of device and need not to customize, increase the efficiency of production, through the panel that can adjust the size, realize that the side direction of device can all be realized protecting to the equidimension of difference, increase the convenience of device use.

title_en: Infant incubator working parameter control method, infant incubator and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a control method of working parameters of an incubator, the incubator and a computer readable storage medium, and relates to the technical field of medical equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining initial working parameters of a current infant incubator according to a current infant identification, wherein the current infant identification is used for marking identity information of a current infant; acquiring vital sign parameters corresponding to the current infant identification according to a preset time interval; determining a weight coefficient of the vital sign parameter according to a preset weight parameter table; and calculating a target working parameter according to the vital sign parameter and the weight coefficient, and adjusting the initial working parameter to be the target working parameter. The whole infant incubator working parameter control process reduces participation of medical staff, reduces workload of the medical staff, reduces errors caused by manual control, and improves control accuracy.

title_en: Furnace gas utilization system for recovering heat energy of calcium carbide furnace gas
abstract_en: The invention discloses a furnace gas utilization system for recovering heat energy of furnace gas of calcium carbide, which belongs to the technical field of calcium carbide processing and comprises a furnace gas reaction box, wherein the front end of the furnace gas reaction box is fixedly connected with a dust removal pipe, the front end of the dust removal pipe is fixedly connected with a furnace gas pipeline, the rear end of the furnace gas reaction box is fixedly connected with an air outlet pipe, a self-switching filter assembly is arranged in the dust removal pipe, and the self-switching filter assembly can automatically switch a filter element to filter the furnace gas when the self-filtering effect of the self-switching filter assembly does not meet the filtering use after filtering certain impurities.

title_en: Heat storage material and heat storage module structure thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heat storage material, which is a thermochemical adsorption heat storage material taking crystalline hydrate as a main material, and is characterized in that the heat storage material is prepared by mixing hydrated potassium carbonate, expanded graphite and OP-10. The invention also discloses a heat storage module structure, wherein the heat storage module is positioned in the heat storage hot water layer, and is characterized in that: the thermal storage module is formed by encapsulation of a thermal storage material as described above. The solar heat-shielding system can assist in converting solar energy into hot water heat for use by users, and has better heat-shielding effect and solar light heat utilization efficiency.

title_en: Clothes hanger device
abstract_en: The clothes hanger device comprises a main body, a fan module, a discharge pipeline, a dust removing filter, a dehumidifying filter and a hanging unit, wherein the main body is provided with a suction part for sucking air and a discharge part for discharging sucked air, the fan module is arranged in the main body, the discharge pipeline is connected with the fan module and the discharge part, the dust removing filter is used for removing dust contained in the air sucked by the fan module, the dehumidifying filter is used for absorbing moisture contained in the air passing through the dust removing filter, the heater is used for heating the air passing through the dehumidifying filter, and the hanging unit is arranged on the bottom surface of the main body and is communicated with the discharge pipeline.

title_en: Flow control valve for gas stove
abstract_en: The invention relates to a flow control valve for a gas stove, which comprises a valve body, a valve rod and a valve core, wherein the valve core and the valve rod synchronously rotate, and the circumferential side wall of the valve core is provided with a vent hole which is selectively communicated with a vent channel when the valve core rotates, and the flow control valve is characterized in that: the circumference lateral wall of case is equipped with the oil section of receiving outward in radial, and this oil section of receiving is used for receiving the grease of scraping when the rotatory relative valve body of case, and compared with prior art, the advantage of this invention lies in: the oil collecting section which can be used for collecting the oil scraped when the valve core rotates relative to the valve body is arranged on the valve core, the air outlet hole can be prevented from being blocked by the oil, in addition, the cross section area of the outlet end of the air outlet hole positioned at the upstream is smaller than that of the outlet end of the downstream oil collecting section, on one hand, the oil collecting of the oil collecting section can be better facilitated, and on the other hand, the air outlet of the air outlet hole can be prevented from being influenced by the oil of the oil collecting section.

title_en: Split type boiler gas heater
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of gas heating, in particular to a split type boiler gas heater which comprises a supporting seat, wherein a plurality of upright posts are fixedly connected to the bottom of the supporting seat, a heating box is fixedly connected to the top of the supporting seat, a ladder used for climbing is arranged on the outer side of the heating box, the inside of the heating box is hollow, a gas inlet pipe and a flue gas outlet pipe are fixedly connected to one end of the heating box, the gas inlet pipe is positioned above the flue gas outlet pipe, a gas outlet pipe and a flue gas inlet pipe are fixedly connected to the other end of the heating box, the gas outlet pipe is positioned above the flue gas inlet pipe, a partition plate is fixedly connected to the middle part of the inner side of the heating box, the partition plate is used for dividing gas and flue gas, and the temperature of the gas is continuously raised from one end to the other end of the heating box through the staggered arrangement of the flue gas and the gas in the gas transmission direction, so that the gas can be uniformly heated, and the filtered waste heat is effectively utilized to heat the gas.

title_en: Ice making unit, air conditioner and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ice making unit, an air conditioner and a control method thereof, wherein the air conditioner comprises a host machine and a sub-machine, the host machine comprises a heat exchange air supply unit and an ice making unit, the sub-machine is detachably arranged on the host machine and comprises a refrigerating unit, when the sub-machine is connected to the host machine, ice cubes generated by the ice making unit can be conveyed into the refrigerating unit, and the ice making unit comprises: the ice making module comprises an ice making assembly, an ice removing assembly, a water supply assembly and an ice storage box, wherein the water supply assembly is used for supplying water to the ice making assembly, the ice making assembly is used for producing ice cubes, and the ice removing assembly is used for removing the ice cubes produced by the ice making assembly into the ice storage box. According to the ice making unit provided by the embodiment of the invention, the prefabricated ice cubes can be conveyed to the sub-machine, so that the sub-machine has a refrigerating function. Because the compressor is not required to be arranged in the sub-machine, the space utilization in the sub-machine can be effectively improved, the cold storage time is shorter, and a user does not need to wait for a long time. And, the ice making unit can conveniently realize the generation of ice cubes and the ice removal.

title_en: High-temperature heat driven solid free piston thermoacoustic refrigeration heat pump system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of refrigeration heat pumps, and provides a high-temperature heat driven solid free piston thermoacoustic refrigeration heat pump system. Comprising the following steps: a plurality of thermo-acoustic core units and a bypass mechanism; the thermoacoustic core units are connected end to end through connecting pipes, and a thermoacoustic engine and a thermoacoustic refrigerator which are mutually communicated are arranged inside the thermoacoustic core units; the first end of the bypass mechanism is arranged at the inlet side of the thermoacoustic engine, the second end of the bypass mechanism is arranged at the outlet side of the thermoacoustic engine, and the bypass mechanism is used for dividing the acoustic power so as to prevent the divided acoustic power from being acted on by the thermoacoustic engine and directly acted on by the thermoacoustic refrigerator. The invention solves the defects of the prior art that the energy flow between the thermo-acoustic engine and the thermo-acoustic refrigerator is not matched at high heating temperature, so that the system performance is deteriorated and the energy efficiency ratio is low, realizes that part of sound power bypasses the thermo-acoustic engine to be directly bypassed to the thermo-acoustic refrigerator, optimizes the energy flow matching between the thermo-acoustic engine and the thermo-acoustic refrigerator, and improves the energy efficiency ratio of the system.

title_en: Liquid distribution mechanism and cooling tower
abstract_en: The invention relates to a liquid distribution mechanism and a cooling tower. The liquid distribution mechanism comprises a liquid distribution piece and a driving piece. The liquid distribution piece is configured with at least one liquid distribution structure, and the liquid distribution piece is used for receiving and spraying cooling liquid from the liquid distribution structure. The driving piece is in transmission connection with the liquid distribution piece and is used for driving the liquid distribution piece to drive at least part of liquid distribution structures on the liquid distribution piece to move. The liquid distribution mechanism is characterized in that the liquid distribution piece receives the cooling liquid and sprays the cooling liquid out of the liquid distribution structure. Because the liquid distribution member is driven by the driving member to act, the liquid distribution structure is displaced along with the action of the liquid distribution member, and the spraying area of the liquid distribution member is changed continuously in the process. Therefore, the concentration degree of the liquid distribution mechanism is obviously reduced, liquid can be distributed to the condenser in a large range, and the spraying and covering effect is more sufficient. On the other hand, due to the reduction of the concentration degree of spraying, the cooling liquid can form a thinner liquid film on the surface of a larger range of the condenser, and the phase change of the cooling liquid is more fully utilized to absorb the heat of the condenser, so that the heat exchange efficiency is improved.

title_en: Drawer structure for dehumidification and humidification integrated machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to a drawer structure for a dehumidification and humidification integrated machine, which comprises a drawer body, and a condensate water tank, a circulating water tank and a water pump which are arranged in the drawer body, wherein the drawer body can be pushed in or moved out relative to the dehumidification and humidification integrated machine, the drawer body is internally provided with an installation space, the condensate water tank, the circulating water tank and the water pump are all positioned in the installation space, the condensate water tank is positioned at one side, which is close to the leading-out direction of the drawer body, in the installation space, the condensate water tank is used for receiving condensate water generated during the operation of the dehumidification and humidification integrated machine, the circulating water tank is used for storing a water source required during the humidification of the dehumidification and humidification integrated machine and is communicated with the water pump through a pipeline, and the water pump is used for conveying the water source in the circulating water tank to a humidification part of the dehumidification and humidification integrated machine through the pipeline. The drawer structure for the dehumidification and humidification integrated machine is compact in structure, and through the structural design, convenience in daily maintenance and after-sales maintenance work of the water pump and the water tank is effectively improved, water dripping sound generated when waste water discharged during operation of the dehumidification and humidification integrated machine is dripped can be effectively avoided, and user experience is greatly improved.

title_en: Water heater with multifunctional shower effect
