abstract_en: The invention relates to a water heater with a multifunctional shower effect, which comprises a host machine with a cold water inlet and a hot water outlet, wherein a heating assembly and a circuit controller are arranged in an inner cavity of the host machine, a waterway pipeline which is communicated with the cold water inlet and the hot water outlet is arranged on the heating assembly, a sterilizing device, a booster pump and an air pump which are electrically connected with the circuit controller are also arranged on the host machine, the sterilizing device and the booster pump are connected in series on the waterway pipeline, the air pump is provided with an air inlet and an air outlet, the air outlet is communicated with the waterway pipeline through an air channel pipeline, and an essential oil atomizer is arranged on the air channel pipeline; the water heater of this structure can realize pipeline pressurization, shower water disinfection to and realize functions such as hydraulic massage and essential oil are paintd when the user takes a shower, make the water heater have multi-functional characteristic, economical and practical, can improve user's use experience nature.

title_en: Energy-saving power supply vehicle, using method and energy management method
abstract_en: The invention provides an energy-saving power supply vehicle, a using method and an energy management method, and relates to the technical field of power supply vehicle equipment. Including the automobile body, automobile body one end is provided with the driving door window, the equal rotation of automobile body lower extreme both sides is connected with a pair of wheel, automobile body both sides are close to driving door window one end fixedly connected with rearview mirror, automobile body both sides fixedly connected with door window, the inside fixedly connected with control box of automobile body upper end, the movable groove has been seted up to the control box upper end, the control box top is provided with solar panel, fixedly connected with connects the base under the solar panel, automobile body lower extreme engine incasement is provided with the power supply box, through the mutually supporting of rack and pinion, makes solar panel reach adjustable angle's purpose, improves electric energy conversion efficiency, reaches energy-concerving and environment-protective purpose, and sets up a plurality of cylindrical heat dissipation posts, can effectively increase heat radiating area, and the dismouting that heat dissipation bellows can be made in the setting up of block groove and snap ring simultaneously is more convenient.

title_en: Preheater hanging plate and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preheater hanging plate and a preparation method thereof, wherein a high chromium nickel heat-resistant steel material is adopted as a base body of the preheater hanging plate, a working surface is a composite nano crystal coating material prepared by spraying a composite material on the base body by plasma, then performing shot blasting treatment on the sprayed surface by high-speed shot blasting, and finally sintering in a vacuum sintering furnace. The composite nano crystal coating material for the working surface of the hanging plate has good heat resistance and wear resistance, has high density, can effectively improve the high-temperature oxidation resistance, corrosion resistance, wear resistance and other performances of the working surface of the hanging plate, has high use safety coefficient and stable quality when being combined with a substrate, greatly prolongs the service life of the hanging plate, reduces the replacement times, and reduces the cost, and the economic benefit and the social benefit are obvious.

title_en: Swimming pool energy management integrated unit
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of swimming building equipment, in particular to an integrated swimming pool energy management unit, which comprises a unit body, an air inlet assembly, a detection assembly and a dehumidification assembly, wherein the air inlet assembly comprises a mounting plate, a first sliding shell and a blower, and the dehumidification assembly comprises a second slider, a guide rail, a support shell, a suction fan, a plurality of condensing plates, a water collector and a communicating pipe. During the use, inhale high humidity gas through the suction fan and enter into the water collector after condensing the drop of water through the condensate plate, the air after the drying enters into the one end of air-blower through communicating pipe to can circulate and dehumidify the air, air-blower and suction fan all can slide the position that changes the circulation of air, make dehumidification effect better.

title_en: Air conditioner water heater host fusion body with external heat exchanger structure complementary air path combination
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air-conditioner water heater main unit fusion body with external heat exchanger structure complementary air passages, which is characterized in that an air-conditioner main unit heat exchanger and a water heater main unit heat exchanger are combined, a plurality of external heat exchanger fin plate groups which are arranged side by side are arranged, an air-conditioner main unit refrigeration medium pipeline system and an air energy water heater main unit refrigeration medium pipeline system are arranged to alternately penetrate through each external heat exchanger fin plate group for a plurality of times, the air-conditioner main unit refrigeration medium pipeline system and the air energy water heater main unit refrigeration medium pipeline system occupy part of fins of each external heat exchanger fin plate group respectively, when the two are independently operated, the heat exchange function of fins of the external heat exchanger fin plate groups corresponding to a stopped operation main unit is evaluated through the vertical fin heat bridge effect, the improvement of the utilization coefficient of a fin tube heat exchanger is facilitated, the evaporation pressure during air-conditioner heat and hot water production is facilitated, the condensation pressure during air-conditioner refrigeration is reduced, and the energy efficiency ratio COP of the two sets of systems of the air conditioner and the water heater is improved.

title_en: Continuous heating furnace
abstract_en: The application relates to a continuous heating furnace, which comprises a furnace body, a feeding door, a discharging door and a walking beam, wherein the feeding door and the discharging door are used for plugging the furnace body, the walking beam is positioned in the furnace body and comprises a fixed frame body fixed in the furnace body, a movable frame body positioned in the fixed frame body and a driving mechanism for driving the movable frame body to move, a plurality of pushing plates are arranged in the fixed frame body, the pushing plates are positioned at one side close to the discharging door, the bottom of the furnace body is fixedly connected with a positioning spring which is arranged corresponding to the pushing plates, and the telescopic end of the positioning spring is connected with a mounting rod; the bottom of the fixed frame body is rotationally connected with a driving rod corresponding to the push plate, a rotating shaft of the driving rod is positioned between the push plate and the discharge door, and one end of the driving rod, which is far away from the discharge door, is contacted with the push plate; the furnace body is also provided with a power component; the furnace body is also provided with a guide piece, the guide piece enables the push plate to move upwards when approaching to the discharge door, and the upper surface of the push plate is lower than the upper surface of the fixing frame body in an initial state. The application has the effect of reducing the production cost.

title_en: Moxa cigarette purifying and smoke removing machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a moxa smoke purifying and removing machine, which relates to the technical field of moxa smoke treatment and comprises a first shell and a second shell, wherein the upper part of the first shell is communicated with a smoke inlet pipe, the bottom of the first shell is communicated with the top of the second shell through the smoke pipe, a tray is arranged in the first shell, a telescopic component and a one-way valve are arranged on the tray, the movable end of the telescopic component is connected with an active carbon filtering device below the tray, the one-way valve is in one-way conduction with the spaces on the upper side and the lower side of the tray, an atomization system is arranged in the second shell, the atomization system adopts a structure with a plurality of layers of water mist, an air freshener is added in water mist generated by the atomization system, the moxa smoke entering an inner cavity of the atomization system circulates in a plurality of layers of long distances in a folding cabin filled with the water mist, and the water mist and the moxa smoke can fully contact. The invention solves the problem that the smell of the moxa smoke cannot be completely filtered in the smoke discharging process of the traditional smoke discharging machine, and greatly reduces the influence on human bodies.

title_en: Energy-saving control method and system for solar energy combined heat pump
abstract_en: The application provides an energy-saving control method and system of a solar energy combined heat pump, which relate to the technical field of energy control, and the method comprises the following steps: the application solves the technical problem that the solar energy combined heat pump is very energy-consuming due to the lack of energy-saving control on the solar energy combined heat pump in the prior art, realizes the accurate energy-saving control on the solar energy combined heat pump, and reduces the energy consumption of the solar energy combined heat pump.

title_en: Control method and terminal of central air conditioning system and central air conditioning system
abstract_en: The invention provides a control method of a central air-conditioning system, a terminal and the central air-conditioning system, wherein the control method of the central air-conditioning system comprises the following steps: the control edge computer preprocesses the equipment information, receives target equipment information obtained after the preprocessing, inputs the target equipment information into a target equipment state detection model, obtains a state analysis result of the central air conditioning system, and obtains the current environmental information of the central air conditioning system when the state of the central air conditioning system is determined to meet the requirement according to the state analysis result; the environmental information is input into a pre-trained control strategy generation model to obtain a control strategy, the operation of each device of the central air conditioning system is controlled according to the control strategy, so that the control strategy is dynamically adjusted based on the environmental information, the central air conditioning system can correspondingly change along with the increase and decrease of the cooling load in the operation process, the central air conditioning system is always in the optimal operation condition, and the efficiency and the energy saving effect of the whole central air conditioning system are improved.

title_en: Mobile heat supply method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mobile heat supply method, which aims to solve the defects that the traditional steam supply mode is mostly transmitted through a pipeline, but when the distance between a heat source and a heat user is too long, the pipeline investment cost is high, the planning and approval are difficult, the construction period is long, and the heat supply service development is seriously restricted. The invention comprises the following steps: s1, leading out a branch pipe on a heat source steam pipeline, connecting a steam distributing pipe on the branch pipe, and installing a plurality of gas transmission pipes on the steam distributing pipe; s2, driving the heating vehicle to a steam distribution pipe position, connecting the heating vehicle with a gas pipe, and filling steam into the heating vehicle through the gas pipe; s3, the heating vehicle is started to the position of the user end after the steam is filled, the heating vehicle is connected with the pipeline of the user end, so that the steam in the heating vehicle is conveyed to the pipeline of the user end, and mobile heating is realized. The movable heat supply method can realize the remote distribution of the heat energy without the pipe network, saves the layout cost of the pipe network and shortens the construction period.

title_en: Intelligent control method of nursing bed, terminal equipment and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent control method of a nursing bed, terminal equipment and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: monitoring the indoor air temperature and air humidity in real time; when the air temperature is not in the preset temperature threshold range, starting a temperature controller to adjust the indoor temperature so that the indoor temperature is in the preset temperature threshold range; and when the air humidity is not in the preset humidity threshold range, starting a humidity controller to adjust the indoor humidity so that the indoor humidity is in the preset humidity threshold range. Solves the problem that the prior nursing bed can not automatically monitor and adjust the temperature and humidity around the patient, and achieves the effect of simplifying the control step of the nursing environment adjusting equipment.

title_en: High temperature and corrosion resistant heat exchanger
abstract_en: The application provides a heat exchanger resistant to high temperature and corrosion, and relates to the technical field of heat exchangers, comprising a first shell, wherein a second shell is arranged in the first shell through bolts, a front tube plate is arranged on one side of the first shell, and two inlet and outlet end covers are arranged on a plate body of the front tube plate; the application adopts a single-tube plate fin type structure, a high-temperature corrosive medium running side and a low-temperature medium running side, wherein the application also adopts a radiating fin group to strengthen the heat transfer of the high-temperature corrosive medium, and the heat exchange performance is greatly improved, the structure is compact, the volume is reduced, and the material cost is reduced; the cooling tube and the fins are in interference expansion joint or welding, the process is simple, the manufacturing quality is convenient to control, the manufacturing cost is reduced, the market competitiveness is greatly improved, and the front tube plate is connected with the second shell and the first shell through bolts, so that the heat exchanger can be pulled out from the front tube plate end for replacement or cleaning, and the heat exchanger can be quickly detached, thereby facilitating subsequent cleaning operation.

title_en: Reactor type heat exchange device and temperature control method
abstract_en: The application discloses a reactor type heat exchange device and a temperature control method, wherein the reactor type heat exchange device comprises: the device comprises a tower body, a connecting mechanism, a stirring mechanism and a thermal circulation heat source, wherein a spiral flow passage and a first annular flow passage are arranged in the side wall and the bottom wall of the tower body, and the first annular flow passage is communicated with the spiral flow passage; the connecting mechanism comprises a connecting ring and a connecting rod, a second annular flow passage is arranged in the connecting ring, a rod inner flow passage is arranged in the connecting rod, and the second annular flow passage is communicated with the first annular flow passage and the rod inner flow passage; the stirring mechanism comprises a stirring shaft and paddles, an inner shaft runner is arranged in the stirring shaft, and two ends of the inner shaft runner are respectively communicated with the inner shaft runner and the spiral runner. The reactor type heat exchange device can realize that the stirring shaft can pass through heating medium in the rotation process, and then can stir the material on one side in the middle part of the tower body, heat the material on one side, increase the heat transfer efficiency of inside material when promoting heating efficiency, reduce the difference in temperature of inside material, and then realize the accurate control of temperature.

title_en: Air purifier with heating and humidification functions
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of purifiers, and discloses an air purifier with heating and humidifying functions, which comprises: the shell is provided with an air inlet, an air outlet and a water mist outlet, a filter screen is arranged in the shell near the air inlet, and a light source is arranged near the water mist outlet; the heating element is arranged in the shell and is positioned between the air inlet and the air outlet; the fan is arranged in the shell, can suck air from the air inlet, and is discharged from the air outlet after passing through the filter screen and the heating element; the humidifying device is arranged on the shell, can atomize water and convey the atomized water to the water mist outlet for discharge; when the humidifying device conveys water mist to the water mist outlet and the light source is lighted, light emitted by the light source and the water mist are matched at the water mist outlet to present flame patterns. The invention has the advantages that when the heating and humidifying functions of the air purifier are simultaneously started, the water mist discharged from the water mist outlet is matched with the light emitted by the light source to present flame effect, so that the air purifier is convenient for a user to recognize, and the air purifier is more comfortable in sense organ and better in experience.

title_en: Self-holding device for high-grade biosafety laboratory
abstract_en: A self-holding device for high-grade biosafety laboratory belongs to biosafety laboratory automatic control technical field. In order to solve the problems that all signals are interrupted and a fan stops running under the emergency condition that the controller is short-circuited and the like in the existing automatic control system, the air can not be continuously exhausted to a laboratory, and the laboratory is out of pressure. After receiving the frequency control signal sent by the main controller, the main self-holding frequency converter controls the rotating speed of the corresponding main fan, and when the main controller interrupts outputting the frequency control signal, the main self-holding frequency converter sends a self-holding signal to the corresponding main fan to maintain the current rotating speed of the corresponding main fan; when the first electric actuator self-holding loop is in an opening state of the electric valve and the received switch control signal is lost, the electric valve is controlled to be in an opening state; when the current signal received by the analog electric actuator is lost, the corresponding electric valve is controlled to keep the current opening. For maintaining the laboratory in a negative pressure environment.

title_en: Control method and device of air conditioner in cooking environment and air conditioning system
abstract_en: The application provides a control method, a device and an air conditioning system of an air conditioner in a cooking environment, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining the current ambient humidity of the cooking environment and the temperature of the environment outside the cooking environment, and obtaining the first indoor ambient humidity and the outdoor ambient temperature; and determining an initial frequency of the air conditioner according to the first indoor environment humidity and the outdoor environment temperature, so that the initial frequency is inversely related to the first indoor environment humidity, the initial frequency is positively related to the outdoor environment temperature, and controlling a compressor of the air conditioner to operate according to the initial frequency. The method solves the problem that the comfort requirement of the cooking environment cannot be met in the prior art.

title_en: Water heater
abstract_en: A water heater relates to the field of water heaters and is used for solving the problems of high tightness and large hidden danger of water leakage of a constant-temperature pipeline arranged below the water heater. The water heater comprises an inner container, a water inlet pipe, an outer pipe and an inner pipe, wherein a water storage cavity is formed in the inner container, one end of the water inlet pipe is communicated with a water inlet of the water storage cavity, the other end of the water inlet pipe is used for communicating a water supply pipeline, the outer pipe is arranged in the water storage cavity, a first end of the outer pipe is fixed on the inner wall of the water storage cavity, a second end of the outer pipe is closed, a first water inlet and a second water inlet are formed in the side wall of the outer pipe, the first water inlet is formed in the upper side of the second water inlet, the inner pipe is arranged in the water storage cavity, the outer pipe is sleeved on the inner pipe, the first end of the inner pipe is communicated with a water outlet of the water storage cavity, the second end of the inner pipe is closed, a gap is formed between the inner pipe and the outer pipe, and a third water inlet is formed in the side wall of the inner pipe. The application is used for directly arranging the inner pipe and the outer pipe in the inner liner, mixing water in the inner liner and discharging water, thereby avoiding the water leakage phenomenon of the mixed water outside the inner liner.

title_en: Fume exhauster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a range hood, which comprises a first fume collecting hood, a second fume collecting hood, a fan frame and a fan, wherein the bottom of the fan frame is open to form a main air inlet, the first fume collecting hood and the second fume collecting hood are respectively in rotary connection with the fan frame and are respectively provided with a reinforced air inlet which is in fluid communication with the inside of the fan frame, the first fume collecting hood and the second fume collecting hood at least have a closed state and an open state, the first fume collecting hood and the second fume collecting hood are in the closed state to close the main air inlet, the first fume collecting hood and the second fume collecting hood are in the open state to open the main air inlet, the first fume collecting hood transversely extends out of the left side of the fan frame, the second fume collecting hood transversely extends out of the right side of the fan frame, and the reinforced air inlet is positioned at the bottom of the corresponding fume collecting hood. Compared with the prior art, the smoke exhaust ventilator has the advantages that the smoke exhaust ventilator can utilize the overturning of the smoke collecting covers to capture the escaped oil smoke when the smoke collecting covers are in the open state by arranging the reinforced smoke exhaust ventilator on each smoke collecting cover, so that the oil smoke exhaust ventilator can improve the oil smoke exhaust ventilator effect.

title_en: Air conditioning system, control method and control device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an air conditioning system, a control method and a control device, wherein the air conditioning system comprises a condenser, a compressor and at least one refrigerating end module, a temperature detection module for detecting temperature and a refrigerant monitoring module for monitoring leakage amount of refrigerant are arranged on each refrigerating end module, the heat load of each target refrigerating end module for leakage of refrigerant and the leakage speed of the refrigerant are determined, and a passage between the target refrigerating end module and the condenser is sequentially disconnected according to the heat load and the leakage speed. According to the application, the paths between the target refrigerating end modules and the condenser are sequentially disconnected according to the heat load and the leakage speed, so that the sudden drop of the refrigerating effect caused by simultaneously disconnecting all the target refrigerating end modules is avoided, the stable operation of the air conditioner refrigerating can be ensured, the risk of leakage of the refrigerant in the refrigerating end modules is reduced, and the performance of the air conditioning system can be improved.

title_en: Water heater for ship
abstract_en: The invention discloses a marine water boiler, and belongs to the technical field of water boilers. As the ship is inevitably subjected to stormy waves and jolt and shake during the sailing, the overflow phenomenon caused by the control water level failure caused by frequent up-and-down movement of the floating ball in the water tank due to the inclination and the swinging of the ship can be well solved by adopting the liquid level floating ball for controlling. When the liquid level floating ball moves up and down in the water tank, the single chip can process signals, and when signals are stable, corresponding instructions of the switch valve are sent to the electromagnetic valve, so that the water level of the floating ball in the water tank is ensured to be stable at a reliable position when the ship tilts and swings in the running process, thereby avoiding overflow phenomenon, and two holes of exhaust and overflow are designed into an overflow hole in an integrated way, realizing one-hole multi-function, simplifying the structure of the electric heating drinking water device and playing a good anti-shaking and anti-overflow function. And the descaling drain holes arranged on the upper side and the lower side of the main water tank are sealed by the efficient sealing descaling cap, so that water leakage of the water tank can be effectively prevented.

title_en: Solid melting furnace deflagration emergency current breaking device, anti-backfire method and solid melting furnace
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deflagration emergency current breaking device of a solid melting furnace, a backfire preventing method and the solid melting furnace, and relates to the technical field of billet hot working. The sealing head at the head end of the central tube is provided with a sealing chamfer, the head end of the combustion-supporting tube is in sliding connection with an inner movable sleeve, the head end of the fuel tube is in sliding connection with an outer movable sleeve, and the inner movable sleeve and the outer movable sleeve are respectively provided with an inner cone section and an outer cone section which have the same taper as the sealing chamfer. When the pressure in the solid melting furnace is greater than the pressure in the combustion chamber, the inner movable sleeve and the outer movable sleeve can slide laterally to close the output of the fuel gas and the fuel, and the flame in the combustion chamber is extinguished. On the contrary, the inner movable sleeve and the outer movable sleeve slide and reset, and the output of the fuel gas and the fuel is opened, so that the combustion chamber is re-ignited. By the ignition and flameout operation of the solid melting furnace, ignition is not affected, flameout can be carried out when the pressure in the solid melting furnace is larger than the pressure of the combustion chamber, and the occurrence of the back combustion phenomenon is reduced.

title_en: Heat exchanger
abstract_en: It is an object of the present application to provide a heat exchanger that is structurally coupled to an end plate without the need for a welding process of the connection members. In order to achieve the above object, a heat exchanger according to the present application includes: a plurality of main plates each including a through hole in which a heat exchange medium flows and an outer wall formed on a periphery, and stacked to form a heat exchanger core having a flow path formed therein; an end plate in contact with a surface of the main plate formed at an outermost side of the heat exchanger core and having at least one connection hole formed therein; and a connection member at least partially inserted into the connection hole and to be connected to the external part.

title_en: Efficient energy-saving alcohol dehydrogenation tail gas condenser
abstract_en: The application discloses a high-efficiency energy-saving alcohol dehydrogenation tail gas condenser, which belongs to the technical field of chemical industry condensers and comprises a condenser body, wherein the bottom end of the condenser body is provided with an air inlet pipe, and the top end of the condenser body is provided with an air outlet pipe; the two sealing plates are fixedly arranged on the upper side and the lower side of the inner cavity of the condenser body, and a cooling cavity is formed between the two sealing plates and the inner cavity of the condenser body; the lower end of the side wall of the condenser body is provided with a water inlet pipe, the upper end of the side wall of the condenser body is provided with a water outlet pipe, and the water inlet pipe and the water outlet pipe are both positioned between the two sealing plates; the ventilation pipes are uniformly arranged in the cooling cavity at intervals and penetrate through the two sealing plates up and down; the catalytic assembly is arranged on one side of the condenser body and is communicated with the air outlet pipe for removing hydrogen in tail gas after condensation. The condenser can ensure that the discharged hydrogen-containing tail gas is safely purified and treated in a catalytic reaction mode, and meets the requirement of hydrogen removal in the process.

title_en: Method for preparing sulfonate surfactant by sulfur trioxide film sulfonation
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for preparing a sulfonate surfactant by sulfur trioxide film sulfonation, and relates to the technical field of fine chemical engineering. According to the method provided by the invention, when the sulfonate surfactant is prepared by a sulfur trioxide film sulfonation method, part of heat released in the sulfur burning and conversion process is recovered through a fire tube heat exchanger to form steam, part of heat is converted into hot air through a tube heat exchanger, and the obtained hot air and steam are utilized to replace steam and hot air required in the traditional sulfur trioxide film sulfonation method sulfonate surfactant preparation process, so that the use of externally supplied steam and hot air is avoided; and sodium hydroxide solution is utilized to absorb the sulfur dioxide gas and then is subjected to oxidative evaporation crystallization to obtain mirabilite, so that the problem of discharge of alkaline washing waste liquid in the traditional process is avoided. The invention solves the problems of high energy consumption and high discharge of wastes and environmental harmful substances in the traditional process by improving the process for preparing the sulfonate surfactant by the traditional sulfur trioxide film sulfonation method.

title_en: Pyrolysis carbonization reaction furnace based on waste plastic recovery of garbage incinerator
abstract_en: The invention relates to a pyrolysis carbonization reaction furnace based on waste plastics of a garbage incinerator, which aims to solve the problems that in the prior art, the garbage carbonization furnace is complex in use and needs continuous heating to finish garbage carbonization, various gas-liquid solid substances generated during carbonization cannot be fully utilized, the carbonization furnace consumes high energy in the carbonization process, the cost is increased, the carbonization efficiency and the quality are low, an air inlet end cover is fixedly arranged at the large end of a conical cylinder body, a transmission shaft connecting end cover is fixedly arranged at the small end of the circular cylinder body, the transmission shaft is arranged in a heating barrel and is rotationally connected with the transmission shaft connecting end cover through a bearing, the transmission shaft is connected with an external driving motor, a discharge box is arranged on the heating barrel, a receiving funnel is arranged on the side wall at the top end of the heating barrel, an exhaust pipe is arranged on the side close to the small end of the heating barrel, and the exhaust pipe is arranged on the side wall at the top end of the heating barrel and is communicated with the heating barrel. The invention belongs to the technical field of carbonization furnaces.

title_en: Integrated movable wall structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses an integrated movable wall structure, which belongs to the technical field of wall structures and comprises the following components: the wall body is clamped on the first limiting seat, a second limiting seat is fixedly arranged on one side, close to the wall body, of the roof, and the second limiting seat is sleeved on the wall body; the middle part of the wall body is provided with a window body, and one side of the wall body, which is positioned on the window body, is hinged with a door body; the middle part of the wall body is provided with a ventilation assembly; the invention has the beneficial effects of flexibility, improved indoor air quality, waterproof performance, multiple functions and adjustment control capability, and the effects enable the wall body to have higher adaptability and functionality, thereby improving the comfort and the use experience of the indoor environment.

title_en: Control method, range hood, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of kitchen electricity, in particular to a control method, a range hood, equipment and a storage medium. The control method comprises the steps of controlling the cleaning device and the impeller to be started simultaneously; the rotation of the impeller is controlled, and the rotation period of the impeller is T  1  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the Controlling the cleaning device to move relative to the fan and jet the cleaning fluid to the rotating impeller so that the jet area of the ejected cleaning fluid to the impeller reciprocates between the two axial end parts of the impeller, and the period of the reciprocating movement of the jet area between the two axial end parts of the impeller is T  2  ，T  1  And T is  2  Are not identical. Impeller wheelIn the process of multiple times of rotation, the positions of the cleaning areas formed by at least part of times are different, and in a period of time, the formed total cleaning area can cover the larger area of the outer peripheral surface of the impeller, so that a better cleaning effect on the impeller can be realized. The range hood, the equipment and the storage medium can cover and clean the impeller in a large range, and can realize a good cleaning effect on the impeller.

title_en: Waste heat utilization device for clinker in grate cooler
abstract_en: The invention discloses a waste heat utilization device of clinker in a grate cooler, which comprises a main body and a conveying pipe, wherein the conveying pipe is used for conveying clinker produced by equipment, the outer surface of the conveying pipe is communicated with a recovery component, the position, close to the recovery component, of the conveying pipe is fixedly connected with the main body, the bottom of an inner cavity of the main body is fixedly connected with a treatment component, the position, far away from the recovery component, of the conveying pipe is fixedly connected with a cooling component, and one side, close to the recovery component, of the cooling component is communicated with the treatment component. This waste heat utilization device of cold inside grog of comb can keep the holistic sealing of equipment when fixed to the conveyer pipe, and the extrusion seat on the sealing cover can extrude the conveyer pipe when sealed, is convenient for extrude seat and processing assembly cooperation, and then has increased the intensity of conveyer pipe, prevents that the conveyer pipe from taking place to remove after the installation, leads to the hookup location of conveyer pipe to appear the gap and take place to leak when causing the grog to transport.

title_en: Cooling tower vapor recovery plant
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of industrial cooling towers, and particularly relates to cooling tower vapor recovery equipment which comprises a cooling tower, an air supply mechanism, a heat dissipation material, a water distribution system and a water removal mechanism, wherein the heat dissipation material, the water distribution system and the water removal mechanism are sequentially arranged in the cooling tower from top to bottom, and the water removal mechanism is arranged above an air inlet at the lower end of the cooling tower. According to the water removing mechanism, ninety-nine percent of water vapor in hot air can be adsorbed by the moving water absorbing belt arranged at the air inlet at the lower end of the cooling zone tower and driven by air flow at the air inlet, and the adsorbed water vapor can be extruded to form water drops to be circularly dropped into a water pool at the bottom of the cooling tower, so that the waste of circulating water in the hot air discharging process is reduced.

title_en: Multi-connected air conditioner and connection determination method
abstract_en: The multi-connected air conditioner includes a hot water indoor unit, an air indoor unit, and an outdoor unit connected to the hot water indoor unit and the plurality of air indoor units. The outdoor unit includes an outdoor unit control unit that controls the refrigerant circuit and transmits control commands for the hot water indoor unit and the air indoor unit via transmission signal lines. The outdoor unit control unit performs: a hot water indoor unit determination process of determining the branch port connected to the hot water indoor unit by causing the refrigerant circuit to perform a heating operation and causing the refrigerant to flow through the branch port one by the pressure reducing mechanism; and an air indoor unit determination process of determining a connection relationship between the branch port connected to the air indoor unit and the air indoor unit by causing the refrigerant circuit to perform a cooling operation and causing the refrigerant to flow through the branch ports not connected to the hot water indoor unit one by one after the hot water indoor unit determination process is performed.

title_en: Construction method of solar energy evaporator based on animal hair
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of solar water evaporation, and particularly relates to black animal hair and application thereof as a solar evaporator body main material. The black animal hair can be directly used for absorbing sunlight and converting light energy and heat energy without any processing treatment, and the black animal hair is a cheap natural substance with the characteristics of easy availability and environmental friendliness, but is not fully utilized. The characteristics of the black animal hair are deeply explored, so that the water evaporation field can play a great value. The black animal hair has wide spectrum absorption, high light-heat conversion capability, high water evaporation rate and efficiency, and can be ideally applied to the field of water evaporation.

title_en: Self-sustaining power supply system applied to tower type photo-thermal heliostat and design method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a self-sustaining power supply system applied to a tower type photo-thermal heliostat and a design method thereof, comprising the steps of grading energy storage batteries and selecting capacities: counting on-site meteorological conditions of a mirror site, including wind speed, wind force and duration; modeling a natural wind field, and determining heliostat wind load data at different positions; analyzing the motion stress of the mirror surface in the complete stroke to obtain a change curve of the torque of the heliostat driving motor along with the movement angle of the heliostat; calculating to obtain a change curve of the power of the driving motor along with the movement angle; fitting a curve and calculating average power among angles, and calculating the power consumption required by each heliostat to complete the whole formation; and finally, selecting storage batteries with different specifications according to different power consumption classification grades. According to the invention, the storage batteries are classified by calculation, the storage batteries with different specifications are selected for use, so that the optimal configuration is realized, and the construction and operation costs of the tower type photo-thermal power station are reduced.

title_en: Environment-friendly heat exchanger with cleaning mechanism
abstract_en: The invention provides an environment-friendly heat exchanger with a cleaning mechanism, which relates to the technical field of heat exchangers and comprises a shell, wherein a first mounting frame is fixedly connected to the bottom of the inner wall of the shell, a second mounting frame is fixedly connected to the top of the inner wall of the shell, and a plurality of heat exchange tubes are fixedly connected between the first mounting frame and the second mounting frame; the shell is provided with a cleaning component and a wastewater treatment component; through the gaseous subassembly that admits air of waiting of heat transfer and the waste water treatment subassembly of setting for can accomplish through waiting that the gaseous subassembly that admits air of heat transfer, add clean air and exchange heat, and then accomplish subsequent use, can dismantle when needs wash and wait that the gaseous subassembly that admits air of heat transfer, install waste water treatment subassembly, can carry out waste water treatment to wash port and coupling hole exhaust waste water, both simplified the process, environmental protection type is higher moreover, has avoided the discharge of waste water, simple structure, convenient operation.

title_en: Fan stall control method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a control method and device for fan stall, a storage medium and electronic equipment. The method comprises the following steps: and acquiring current working state parameters of the fan set, judging whether the fans in the fan set meet a stall condition according to the acquired current working state parameters, and controlling the fan set to enter a preset working mode according to a preset processing strategy if the fans in the fan set are judged to meet the stall condition. Through the technical scheme, after the fan is judged to meet the stall condition, the problem of the stall of the fan can be automatically processed according to the preset processing strategy, the fan set is quickly restored to the safe state, and compared with the existing manual processing mode, the efficient and safe control method for the stall of the fan is provided.

title_en: Preparation method of high-density vanadium-aluminum alloy
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of metallurgy, in particular to a preparation method of a high-density vanadium-aluminum alloy. S1, mixing vanadium pentoxide, aluminum powder and lime according to a preset proportion according to a smelting space of a smelting furnace to obtain a mixture; wherein, the weight proportion of the vanadium pentoxide, the aluminum powder and the lime in the mixture is as follows: 900-1100:700-900:10-100; s2, adding the mixture into a smelting space of a smelting furnace for smelting; s3, standing after smelting is completed, and disassembling the furnace body after the temperature in the smelting furnace is less than 100 ℃, separating the obtained alloy cake from slag, and removing slag attached to the surface of the alloy. The invention prepares the high-density measurement vanadium-aluminum alloy by controlling a plurality of technological processes of raw material proportioning, mixing, smelting, furnace body preparation, cooling and the like and adopting a one-step smelting method to prepare the high-density measurement vanadium-aluminum alloy, thereby realizing low-cost and high-quality production of the high-density vanadium-aluminum alloy, wherein the porosity of the obtained vanadium-aluminum alloy is less than 1.5 percent, and the method has short technological process and small loss of valuable metal vanadium in the process.

title_en: Control method and device of photovoltaic air conditioning system, air conditioning system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control method and a device of a photovoltaic air conditioning system, the photovoltaic air conditioning system and a storage medium, wherein the photovoltaic air conditioning system is provided with a photovoltaic array, a host and more than two slaves, and the method comprises the following steps: determining target output power of the photovoltaic array at a host side, determining an output power difference at any slave side according to actual output power of the slave and target output power of the photovoltaic array, feeding back the output power difference to the host, and controlling output current of the slave by combining a control strategy at the host side; the output current from the master side to the slave side is regulated in a balanced manner according to the output power difference of all the slaves at the master side. According to the scheme, the output current of the slave machines is controlled at the host machine side, and the output currents of all the slave machines are regulated, so that coordination of current output of different slave machines is realized, balanced distribution of power is realized, and the utilization efficiency of the photovoltaic energy source is improved.

title_en: Magnetic pressure coupling refrigerating device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a magnetic pressure coupling refrigerating device which comprises a water conservancy piston, a hot end heat exchanger, a cold end heat exchanger, a magnetic pressure heat regenerator, a first driving piece and a second driving piece, wherein the water conservancy piston comprises a piston cylinder, a pear-shaped workpiece and two pistons, the pear-shaped workpiece and the two pistons are arranged in the piston cylinder, the two pistons are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the pear-shaped workpiece and are abutted against each other, a left cavity and a right cavity of the water conservancy piston are sequentially communicated with the hot end heat exchanger, the cold end heat exchanger and the magnetic pressure heat regenerator through pipelines, a plurality of electromagnetic valves are arranged on the pipelines, a double-layer concentric halbach magnet is sleeved on the periphery of the magnetic pressure heat regenerator, the first driving piece is simultaneously connected to the pear-shaped workpiece and the concentric halbach magnet of an inner layer, and the second driving piece is connected to the pear-shaped workpiece and is used for driving the pear-shaped workpiece to horizontally move along the piston cylinder. The device combines the magnetocaloric effect and the autoclave effect, adopts ingenious structural design, realizes the magnetic pressure coupling refrigeration, reduces the volume of the refrigeration device and improves the refrigeration efficiency of the refrigeration device.

title_en: Heat exchange system, method and equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heat exchange system, a heat exchange method and heat exchange equipment, and relates to the technical field of heat exchange. The refrigerant storage tank stores a refrigerant medium with a preset pressure value; the first pneumatic ball valve regulates the pressure of the refrigerant medium according to the first control instruction to obtain the regulated refrigerant medium; the heat exchanger is used for carrying out heat exchange between the pressure-regulated refrigerant medium and the hot material; the liquid level meter is used for displaying the liquid level value of the refrigerant medium in the heat exchanger; the pressure sensor is used for detecting the internal pressure of the heat exchanger under different working conditions, obtaining a pressure value and sending a first control instruction; the discharge pipe module is used for discharging the refrigerant medium after heat exchange; if the absolute value of the pressure difference value is greater than or equal to the first pressure difference value threshold value, increasing the opening of the outlet of the discharge pipe module and continuously acquiring the internal pressure value of the heat exchanger; and if the absolute value of the pressure difference is smaller than the first pressure difference threshold value, reducing the opening of the outlet of the discharge pipe module and continuously acquiring the internal pressure value of the heat exchanger. The invention improves the heat exchange efficiency of the refrigerant medium.

title_en: Energy-saving smelting furnace for zinc ingot production
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of zinc ingot production, in particular to an energy-saving smelting furnace for zinc ingot production, which is characterized in that a salvaging mechanism is movably arranged in the smelting furnace, a power mechanism is rotatably arranged on the outer wall of the smelting furnace, and a cleaning mechanism is arranged at the top of the smelting furnace. The connecting block moves to the centre through the power unit drive for the connecting block moves along the guide track of guide rail and drives and drag for pocket synchronous motion, will float the oxide layer on the zinc liquid attached surface layer to stir to the centre, and through two upset in the middle of dragging for the pocket, will stir to the oxide layer in the centre and scoop up, thereby get rid of the oxide layer voluntarily, make this device when smelting the zinc ingot, need not the manual work to zinc liquid top layer oxidation floating layer handle, the security that improves the smelting and the use convenience and the practicality of device.

title_en: Control method, device, apparatus, medium and program product for air conditioning apparatus
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control method, a device, equipment, a medium and a program product of air conditioning equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: switching from a normal mode of the air conditioning apparatus to a linked mode; determining a current value of a first adjustment dimension of a plurality of adjustment dimensions of the air conditioning device; the second adjustment dimension is controlled based on the current value of the first adjustment dimension. Therefore, the control efficiency can be improved, and the user experience can be improved.

title_en: Closed-loop zero-emission waste heat recovery system for washing powder process
abstract_en: An environment-friendly energy-saving treatment method and a device thereof for a washing powder production process; the invention converts the open-loop discharge of air, moisture and heat in the production process of the washing powder into full-closed loop flow, and realizes the zero discharge of dust. The invention adds a recovery system in the existing washing powder production process, which mainly comprises a tail air cooling, dehydrating and purifying unit, a steam energy heat pump unit, a hot-blast stove air inlet heating unit, an intelligent control unit, a tower bottom transferring chamber and the like.

title_en: Control method of purifying equipment and purifying equipment
abstract_en: The present application relates to a control method of a purification apparatus, an apparatus, a purification apparatus, a computer-readable storage medium and a computer program product. The purification equipment comprises a purification component, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a mapping relation between a first operation parameter and a second operation parameter under the preset low ozone concentration, adjusting the first operation parameter of a high-voltage power supply of the purification component to enable the relation between the adjusted first operation parameter and the second operation parameter after the first operation parameter is adjusted to meet the mapping relation, and controlling the high-voltage power supply to work according to the adjusted first operation parameter and the second operation parameter after the first operation parameter is adjusted. The method can improve the safety of the purifying equipment in use.

title_en: Energy-saving green environment-friendly integrated building structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy-saving green environment-friendly integrated building structure, and relates to the technical field of integrated buildings. The invention comprises a foundation, wherein a building body is fixedly arranged above the foundation, a rain shield plate is fixedly arranged above the building body, a fixed column is fixedly arranged on the surface of the rain shield plate, a fixed plate is fixedly arranged above the fixed column, a clamping mechanism is arranged in the fixed plate, water collecting tanks are uniformly formed on two sides of the rain shield plate, the upper surface of each water collecting tank is fixedly and slidingly connected with a filter screen plate, a vibration mechanism is arranged below the filter screen plate, a water conveying pipe is fixedly arranged on each water collecting tank, and one end of each water conveying pipe is communicated with the inside of each water collecting tank. According to the invention, in overcast and rainy weather, rainwater is recovered, the rainwater is guided to the water collecting tank through the rain baffle, then the large-volume impurities are filtered by utilizing the filter screen plate above the water collecting tank, so that the cleanliness of the rainwater is ensured, at the moment, the rainwater flows into the water collecting tank, and finally, the rainwater is conveyed into the water tank through the water conveying pipe for storage.

title_en: Pumped refrigerant system and related method for cold starting a pumped refrigerant system
abstract_en: The pumped refrigerant system may include a condenser, a pump coupled downstream of the condenser, an evaporator assembly coupled downstream of the pump, the condenser coupled downstream of the evaporator assembly, and a refrigerant heating assembly coupled downstream of the pump, the condenser coupled downstream of the refrigerant heating assembly. The refrigerant heating assembly may include a tank and a heating element coupled to the tank and configured to heat a refrigerant within the tank. The inlet valve may be configured to selectively allow the pump to push refrigerant into the tank. The outlet valve may be configured to selectively inject heated refrigerant from the tank into a conduit upstream of the condenser.

title_en: Process and equipment for preparing micro-carbon ferrochrome by using hydrogen
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of micro-carbon ferrochrome, in particular to a process and equipment for preparing micro-carbon ferrochrome by hydrogen, which comprises the following steps: s01, adding raw materials into a melting furnace in a vacuum furnace; s02, vacuumizing the vacuum furnace, heating the furnace, and reacting the raw materials to generate an air hole channel; s03, inputting hydrogen and vacuumizing in sequence alternately in the vacuum furnace, so that the hydrogen is reduced at a high temperature to produce ferrochrome oxide, and vacuum micro-carbon ferrochrome is produced. According to the process and the equipment for preparing the micro-carbon ferrochrome by using the hydrogen, when the raw materials react to generate the air hole channel, the hydrogen is alternately input and vacuumized in sequence, so that when the hydrogen is input, the air hole channel is rapidly filled with the hydrogen to react with redundant oxygen radicals due to the influence of a vacuum environment, the vacuumization is continuously performed after the reaction, the vapor generated during the hydrogen reduction is extracted, and then the vacuumization is suspended and the hydrogen is continuously input.

title_en: Sagger conveying system for anode and cathode powder of lithium battery
abstract_en: The invention provides a sagger conveying system for anode and cathode powder of a lithium battery, which is characterized in that an output end of a sagger feeding device is connected with an input end of a turnover material pouring device, and an output end of the turnover material pouring device is connected with an input end of a sagger discharging conveying device, and the sagger conveying system is characterized in that: the sagger feeding conveyor is characterized in that a first pushing device is arranged on the upper portion of the sagger feeding conveyor, a second pushing device is arranged on the upper portion of the overturning and pouring machine device, the first pushing device and the second pushing device are arranged on the upper portion of the sagger feeding conveyor and the upper portion of the overturning and pouring machine device, disassembly and maintenance are convenient, compared with the pure ceramic wheel conveying speed, the sagger feeding conveyor is lifted to 20M/min from the original 6M/min, the first pushing device conveys the sagger at the output end of the sagger feeding device to the overturning and pouring machine device, and the second pushing device conveys the sagger at the output end of the overturning and pouring machine device to the sagger discharging conveying device in a rotating driving mode, so that the anti-dust effect is good.

title_en: Double-layer glass curtain wall and installation method
abstract_en: The application relates to a double-layer glass curtain wall and an installation method, and relates to the specific technical field of glass curtain walls, wherein the double-layer glass curtain wall comprises an inner-layer glass curtain wall, an outer-layer glass curtain wall, an inner-layer installation bracket for installing the inner-layer glass curtain wall and an outer-layer installation bracket for installing outer-layer glass; the cleaning device also comprises a ventilation shutter and a cleaning component corresponding to the ventilation shutter; the ventilation shutters are respectively and rotatably connected to the outer layer mounting bracket, and respectively outside the air outlet and the air inlet; the cleaning component is arranged in the ventilation cavity and is used for cleaning the ventilation louver. The application has the effect of reducing the occurrence of ventilation blind blockage and improving the use experience of the double-layer glass curtain wall.

title_en: Connection structure of metal hose and gas stove
abstract_en: The invention discloses a connecting structure of a metal hose and a gas stove, which has the technical scheme that: comprising the following steps: the frame body is arranged at the bottom of the gas stove; the frame is arranged in the frame body, both sides of the frame are provided with a pipe inlet and a pipe outlet, a metal hose is arranged in the frame, and a silicone tube is wrapped outside the metal hose; the gas tank can adapt to different placing positions of the gas tank, the storage length and the inserting direction of the pipeline can be changed by utilizing the plurality of fixing plates and the rollers, the problem that the pipeline is continuously moved to a non-embedded type gas stove with a table top placed in the prior art, the pipeline is continuously increased in folding degree or loosened in folding position when the kitchen range or the gas stove is cleaned, and the pipeline is folded, loosened and pulled for a long time, so that the metal hose is near the part of the pipeline at the gas interface of the gas stove to be tired to cause cracking, and the interface is also possibly loosened, so that the risk of gas leakage is caused is solved.

title_en: Raw material melting device for bronze casting processing
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of casting processing, in particular to a raw material melting device for bronze casting processing, which comprises a support, a heating furnace body arranged on the surface of the support, a crucible arranged in the heating furnace body and a rotary clamping assembly arranged in a furnace chamber of the heating furnace body, wherein the heating furnace body is provided with a plurality of heating furnace chambers; can make the crucible take place rotatory while in heating furnace body can also reciprocate from top to bottom, can more even heat, reduce the waste of heat energy, be convenient for increase the melting speed of the material in the melting crucible, the convenient automatic crucible lid of crucible is lifted from the surface of crucible, need not the manual work in this process to the crucible lid of crucible lift off the operation, avoid artifical closely with the liquid contact of high temperature melting, the convenient automatic liquid of melting with the crucible internal heating is poured out for the workman has better work to experience, also avoided the danger of high temperature burn.

title_en: Air conditioner supply circulation system of production workshop
abstract_en: The invention provides an air conditioner supply circulation system of a production workshop, which comprises a water chilling unit, a water softening device, boiler equipment, a heat exchanger, a fan and a radiator, wherein the water chilling unit is connected with the heat exchanger through a first pipeline, the heat exchanger is connected with the radiator through a second pipeline, the heat exchanger is connected with the water softening device through a third pipeline, high-temperature and high-pressure refrigerant in the water chilling unit exchanges heat with soft water in the water softening device through the heat exchanger, the refrigerant subjected to primary cooling is subjected to secondary cooling and is returned to the water chilling unit for circulation, the radiator is connected with an air inlet of the boiler equipment through an air duct, and the fan is arranged on the radiator for carrying out blowing cooling on fins of the radiator and sending hot air into the boiler equipment through the air duct for waste heat utilization. The invention can improve the energy utilization rate of the production workshop and reduce the production cost of enterprises.

title_en: Cloud control system for ice storage system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of cold accumulation, in particular to a cloud control system for an ice cold accumulation system, which comprises a detection module, a cloud server module, an analysis module, a resource scheduling module and a remote control module, wherein the detection module is used for detecting various operation parameters of the ice cold accumulation system, the cloud server module is used for storing detection results of the detection module, the analysis module is used for analyzing system operation conditions and future energy requirements of the ice cold accumulation system, the resource scheduling module is used for adjusting various parameters of the ice cold accumulation system, and the remote control module is used for receiving user instructions and allowing a user to control the ice cold accumulation system through the remote control module. According to the invention, the ice cold accumulation system is controlled by the cloud control system, so that the fluctuation of the electric power market and the actual demand change can be flexibly dealt with by adjusting parameters, and different cooling demands can be realized.

title_en: Dry heating type air sterilizing lamp
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dry heating type air sterilizing lamp, which comprises a fixed shaft, an inner shell, a middle shell and an outer shell, wherein an inner air passage, a middle air passage and an outer air passage are sequentially formed around the structure, the upper end and the lower end of each air passage are respectively provided with an opening, an LED bulb is arranged at the lower end of the fixed shaft, a lamp cap is arranged at the upper end of the fixed shaft, and the lamp cap integrally forms a bulb structure and can be installed on a bulb seat of the current general specification. The dry-heating type air sterilizing lamp not only has the original lighting effect, but also can utilize waste heat generated by the LED bulb and heat generated by the heating device to form a temperature difference and start air circulation flow to perform bacteriostasis and sterilization until the power supply is turned off, and has the environment-friendly effect of recycling heat energy.

title_en: Burner
abstract_en: The present invention provides a burner comprising: the burner comprises an inner ring airflow channel and an outer ring airflow channel arranged around the inner ring airflow channel; the combustion part is annular, the outer edge is provided with a fire outlet, the inner edge of the top wall of the combustion part is downwards bent and extended and inserted at the top of the inner annular airflow channel, and the inner edge of the bottom wall of the combustion part is downwards bent and extended and inserted in the side wall of the outer annular airflow channel far away from the axis; and, an inner fire cover; the top wall of the combustion part is provided with an annular positioning structure which is arranged around the downward bending extension part of the top wall of the combustion part; the inner fire cover comprises an infrared combustion plate and a fixing component which is arranged around the infrared combustion plate and used for fixing the infrared combustion plate, the bottom of the fixing component extends downwards in a protruding mode, and at least part of the fixing component is inserted into the annular positioning structure. According to the invention, the inner fire cover is arranged on the combustion part, so that a user can integrally detach the part above the furnace head, then the inner fire cover is detached and cleaned independently, sundries can be prevented from falling into the furnace end, and the use experience of the user is improved.

title_en: Photovoltaic structure for new energy building
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of photovoltaic supports, in particular to a photovoltaic structure for a new energy building, which comprises a central rod, an adjusting mechanism and a plurality of first photovoltaic plates which are uniformly distributed along the circumferential direction, wherein the bottom ends of the first photovoltaic plates are hinged to the circumferential side wall of the central rod, the top ends of the first photovoltaic plates are suspended, the first photovoltaic plates are configured to have a furled state and an open state, and are in the furled state and are arranged next to the central rod in rainy and snowy weather, so that the first photovoltaic plates are prevented from being directly crashed on the surfaces of the first photovoltaic plates, the first photovoltaic plates are prevented from being damaged in clear weather, and are arranged away from the central rod in the open state, the first photovoltaic plates can normally generate electricity, and when wind blows across the surfaces of the first photovoltaic plates, the wind can flow along the surfaces of the first photovoltaic plates, and the impact of the wind on the first photovoltaic plates is reduced; the adjusting mechanism is used for enabling the first photovoltaic panel to be switched between a furled state and an unfolded state.

title_en: Heat collector heating system and method utilizing compressed air to store energy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heat collector heating system and a method utilizing compressed air to store energy, wherein the system comprises a heat taking unit, a heat supplementing unit, a heat storage unit and a heating unit, the heat taking unit comprises a cooling tower, a waste heat water supply main pipeline and a waste heat water return main pipeline, the waste heat water supply main pipeline and the waste heat water return main pipeline are communicated with the cooling tower, the heat supplementing unit comprises a solar heat collector and a positive displacement heat exchanger, the primary side of the positive displacement heat exchanger is communicated with the solar heat collector, the secondary side of the positive displacement heat exchanger is communicated with the waste heat water supply main pipeline and the waste heat water return main pipeline, the heat storage unit comprises a waste heat storage tank, the waste heat storage tank is communicated with the positive displacement heat exchanger, the heating unit comprises a water source heat pump unit, the low-temperature side of the water source heat pump unit is respectively communicated with the waste heat storage tank and the positive displacement heat exchanger, and the high-temperature side of the water source heat pump unit is communicated with a heating pipe network outside a factory area or a factory area. The invention improves the energy utilization efficiency, reduces the operation cost and reduces the consumption of non-renewable energy sources.

title_en: Control method of gas heating water heater and gas heating water heater
abstract_en: The application relates to a control method of a gas heating water heater and the gas heating water heater. The method comprises the steps of obtaining water temperature of a water return pipe and water temperature of a water outlet pipe, determining water return temperature difference according to the water temperature of the water return pipe and the water temperature of the water outlet pipe, and adjusting the pump speed of a variable frequency pump, the constant speed pump and the on-off state of a bypass electric valve under the condition that the water return temperature difference deviates from a preset temperature interval so that the water return temperature difference is within the preset temperature interval, wherein the preset temperature interval is used for representing the temperature interval with highest heat exchange efficiency of the water heater. The method can effectively avoid the overlarge return water temperature difference to shorten the service life of the heat exchanger and improve the heat exchange efficiency.

title_en: Maintenance-free heliostat double-push-rod driving device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a maintenance-free heliostat double-push-rod driving device which comprises a supporting seat, an upright post, a first push-rod module and a second push-rod module, wherein the upright post is arranged on the supporting seat; the supporting seat is arranged at the top end of the upright post and is rotationally connected with the upright post; the first push rod module is rotationally connected with the supporting seat and is connected with the heliostat module on the supporting seat and used for driving the heliostat module to rotate; the second push rod module is fixedly arranged on the supporting seat and used for driving the supporting seat to rotate when the heliostat module rotates to a preset position, so that the mirror surface of the heliostat module faces downwards. The pitching angle of the heliostat module in the maintenance-free heliostat double-push-rod driving device is between 0 and 180 degrees, so that the mirror surface can be downward in a non-working state, deposition of dust, sand and the like is avoided, the mirror reflection efficiency is ensured, the cleaning frequency and the cleaning difficulty are reduced, and the maintenance-free heliostat double-push-rod driving device is simple in structure and easy for batch production.

title_en: Magnetic suspension photovoltaic power generation system
abstract_en: The invention provides a magnetic suspension photovoltaic power generation system, which is based on a magnetic suspension theory, replaces the traditional photovoltaic support mode through the repulsion and attraction of a permanent magnet, adjusts the height and the inclination angle of a designated row or an integral photovoltaic module through one-key operation of operation and maintenance personnel on a computer, has a uniform construction mode, can save calculation of the module ground-leaving height and the optimal inclination angle of a photovoltaic power station in the initial design stage, can save the use of concrete and steel, and can reduce the construction period, difficulty and cost of the photovoltaic power station by completely using magnetic force as the support system of the photovoltaic module.

title_en: Air conditioner operation control method and device, air conditioner and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to an air conditioner operation control method, an air conditioner operation control device, an air conditioner and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an outdoor environment temperature value of an air conditioner outdoor unit; determining an initial system pressure value of air conditioner operation according to the outdoor environment temperature value; determining the system pressure change rate of the air conditioner in the process of controlling the air conditioner to operate according to the initial system pressure value; according to the system pressure change rate, adjusting the frequency of a compressor operated by the air conditioner; and controlling the compressor of the air conditioner to operate according to the adjusted compressor frequency. Therefore, the comfort of the communication-free air conditioner can be improved, and the user experience is improved.

title_en: Device for replacing power frequency electric furnace inductor without stopping machine and use method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of metal smelting, and discloses a device for replacing a power frequency electric furnace inductor without stopping, wherein a zinc ingot port is formed in one side surface of a furnace body, a first telescopic rod is fixedly connected to the output end of a first cylinder, a U-shaped rod is fixedly connected to the outer surface of the first cylinder, a second cylinder is fixedly connected to the lower surface of the U-shaped rod, a second telescopic rod is fixedly connected to the output end of the second cylinder, a clamping ring is fixedly connected to the lower surface of the second telescopic rod, and a soft cushion is arranged on the outer surface of the clamping ring. The invention has the following advantages and effects: after all the bolts are removed, the crane is lifted off, if the lifting off is difficult and the inductor can be powered on, the inductor and the furnace body connection part can be electrified to melt, the power line is immediately removed and lifted off after being observed and separated in the process, the connection part is lifted off, the grinding is smooth, the inductor is replaced with a new inductor, and the inductor can be replaced in an hour generally.

title_en: Device and method for eliminating deviation of boiler flue gas flow field
abstract_en: The invention provides a device and a method for eliminating deviation of a boiler flue gas flow field. The invention can adjust the distribution of the flue gas flow field in the high temperature area in the width direction of the hearth, and realize the fine adjustment of the heat absorption deviation of local individual tube panels, thereby eliminating the deviation of the flue gas flow field and improving the proportion of the high-moisture sludge mixed combustion of the boiler.

title_en: Combined heat recovery air conditioning unit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a combined heat recovery air conditioning unit which comprises a box body, wherein a new air box, a heating section, a refrigerating section, a humidifying section, an air outlet box, a return air box, a heat exchange box and an air exhaust box are arranged in the box body. According to the combined heat recovery air conditioning unit, the heat exchanger is arranged, so that the heat exchanger can exchange heat of air passing through the heat exchanger, and when the unit heats, the heat exchanger absorbs heat in exhaust air, then the heat is transferred to fresh air, the fresh air returns to an environment needing heating, heat loss is reduced, energy consumption of the unit is reduced, when the unit refrigerates, the heat exchanger absorbs heat in the exhaust air, the exhaust air is transferred to the fresh air, the fresh air returns to the environment needing refrigeration, and refrigeration energy consumption of the unit is reduced.

title_en: Preheating type lithium/sulfur hexafluoride efficient combustion integrated device and control method
