abstract_en: The invention discloses a preheating type lithium/sulfur hexafluoride high-efficiency combustion integrated device and a control method, which belong to the technical field of underwater vehicle power, and the device fully utilizes a high-temperature area formed by fuel combustion, a working medium preheating pipeline is designed at a combustion chamber sealing cover, and the working medium preheating pipeline enters a main body area of a heat exchanger through a bypass pipeline, so that the temperature rising rate of the working medium is improved, and the heat exchange effect is effectively enhanced; by utilizing the electromagnetic heating principle, a heating coil is combined with a metal auxiliary combustion structure, part of Li metal can be quickly heated to the reaction temperature in a short time, and after oxidant SF  6  is timely introduced, the combustion reaction of the Li metal and SF  6  can be quickly started, and the heat released by the reaction can continuously heat the rest Li fuel to form positive feedback of combustion and heat release, so that the requirement of maintaining combustion of a system is met; the whole device has small volume, does not occupy excessive extra space, and can meet the overall requirement of compact structure of a power system.

title_en: New fan
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new fan, comprising: the shell is provided with an air outlet, and a partition piece is arranged in the shell and divides the interior of the shell into an air inlet cavity and an air outlet cavity; the cyclone separator is positioned in the air inlet cavity, and the air inlet end and the air outlet end of the cyclone separator are respectively communicated with the external atmosphere and the air inlet cavity; the dust outlet end of the cyclone separator is provided with a dust collecting box; the partition piece is provided with a filter element which is respectively communicated with the air inlet cavity and the air outlet cavity, the fan is arranged in the air outlet cavity, and the air outlet end of the fan is communicated with the air outlet; the heat exchange tube and the heating wire are wound on the outer side wall of the cyclone separator, and the heat exchange tube is communicated with an external refrigeration source. External air can enter the air inlet cavity after being filtered by the cyclone separator, air in the air inlet cavity can enter the air outlet cavity only after being filtered by the filter element, and the air blower can blow the air in the air outlet cavity into a room; the cyclone separator has large air inlet and is not easy to be blocked; the fresh air machine can effectively and rapidly heat or cool air entering the shell.

title_en: Flue gas waste heat recovery device for power plant boiler
abstract_en: The application provides a flue gas waste heat recovery device of a power plant boiler, and belongs to the field of energy conservation of power plant boilers. The flue gas waste heat recovery device of the power plant boiler comprises a shell and a plurality of heat exchange tubes; at least part of the side walls of the heat exchange tubes are provided with nozzles facing the surrounding heat exchange tubes, and the part of the heat exchange tubes are respectively provided with a spacing tube and a steam tube. The interval pipe is coaxially arranged in the heat exchange pipe; the steam pipe is coaxially arranged in the interval pipe, and an interval cavity is formed between the steam pipe and the interval pipe; the side wall of the interval pipe is provided with a plurality of connecting pipes which are respectively communicated with the nozzles; the side wall of the steam pipe is provided with a plurality of air valves, and the air valves are opposite to the connecting pipes one by one in the radial direction of the heat exchange pipe. The two annular pistons are arranged in the partition chamber, a sealing chamber is formed between the two annular pistons, and the two annular pistons slide along the axial direction so that the sealing chamber is communicated with the corresponding air valve and the connecting pipe. The nozzles are arranged on part of the heat exchange tubes to clean the surrounding heat exchange tubes, external equipment is not required to enter the shell, and collision of the heat exchange tubes is avoided.

title_en: Adjusting device of matrix type photovoltaic panel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regulating device of a matrix type photovoltaic panel, and relates to the technical field of photovoltaic power stations; the photovoltaic panel is installed at the top of the top support, an upper supporting seat is installed at the bottom of the top support, a lower supporting seat of an inverted U-shaped structure is installed on one side of the top of the bottom support, a movable supporting frame is installed at the top of the lower supporting seat in a rotating mode, and the bottom of the upper supporting seat is hinged to the top of the movable supporting frame. According to the invention, the photovoltaic panel can synchronously move along with the movement direction of the sun under the action of the adjusting device, the angle between the photovoltaic panel and the ground changes along with the movement of the sun, and the travelling mechanism moves from the low valley position to the high peak position of the adjusting guide mechanism to the low valley position of the other end of the adjusting guide mechanism, so that the photovoltaic panel and sunlight are in an all-weather optimal light receiving angle, the all-weather photovoltaic panel is in an optimal light receiving angle, and the power generation efficiency of the photovoltaic panel is improved.

title_en: Air conditioner control method, air conditioner and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control method of an air conditioner, the air conditioner and a computer readable storage medium. The control method of the air conditioner comprises the following steps of obtaining operation parameters determined according to at least two preset linkage modes; determining target operation parameters of the air conditioner according to the operation parameters corresponding to each linkage mode; the invention can realize that the air conditioner is simultaneously adapted to various different scene condition changes to adjust operation.

title_en: Corundum sagger for high-temperature sintering of high-purity alumina ceramic and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a corundum sagger for high-temperature sintering of high-purity alumina ceramic and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises the specific steps of mixing sintered corundum particles with a certain mass ratio with premixed fine powder to obtain a premix, wherein the premixed fine powder comprises sintered corundum fine powder, fused zirconia corundum fine powder, rare earth composite yttrium zirconium ceramic powder, cerium phosphate powder and amorphous alumina fine powder, sequentially adding potato starch with a certain mass and rho-alumina colloid solution into the premix to obtain a mixture, sealing the mixture to obtain plastic material, demoulding after compression molding the plastic material to obtain a green body, and hot-pressing and sintering the green body to obtain the corundum sagger for high-temperature sintering of high-purity alumina ceramic. The corundum sagger for high-temperature sintering of the high-purity alumina ceramic prepared by the invention has the advantages of high service temperature, good sintering performance, high strength, high softening temperature under load and good thermal shock resistance.

title_en: Sagger special for sintering sodium-electricity anode material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sagger special for sintering a sodium-electricity anode material and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: s1, mixing a premixed granule material and a premixed fine powder material in a certain mass ratio to obtain a mixture, adding a certain amount of potassium fluozirconate solution into the mixture, and stirring to obtain a castable; s2, pouring, vibrating and forming the castable, curing and demolding to obtain a sagger green body; s3, drying the sagger green body for a period of time, and performing high-temperature heat treatment for a period of time to obtain a sagger special for sintering the sodium electric anode material; wherein the premixed particles comprise calcium hexaluminate particles and fused zirconia corundum particles; the premixed fine powder comprises calcium hexaluminate fine powder, calcium dialuminate fine powder, calcium dodecaluminate fine powder, calcium acetate fine powder and rare earth composite yttrium zirconium ceramic powder. The invention has simple process, and the prepared sagger has high density, high strength, strong permeability resistance, good erosion resistance and high thermal shock stability.

title_en: Active stress regulation and control method, system, equipment, medium and device for boiler header
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, equipment, a medium and a device for actively regulating and controlling the stress of a boiler header, and belongs to the technical field of rapid start-stop and variable load regulation and control of coal-fired units. The regulation and control method comprises the following steps: acquiring the current pressure and temperature of a boiler header and DCS signals reflecting the running thermal state of a unit; if the current DCS signal indicates that the boiler header is in a starting state, heating a target regulation pipe section; if the current DCS signal indicates that the boiler header is in a normal running state, stopping heating the target regulation pipe section; and if the current DCS signal indicates that the boiler header is in a stop state, preheating the target regulation pipe section. According to the invention, the outer wall of the target regulation pipe section of the boiler header is heated during starting or when the boiler header is ready to start, so that the internal pressure stress caused by the temperature difference between the inner wall and the outer wall during quick starting is reduced, and the starting and stopping speed and the load changing capacity of the boiler header are improved.

title_en: Equipment for changing solid mineral particles into suspension state
abstract_en: The equipment for changing solid mineral particles into a suspension state adopts a vertical cylinder type structure, and comprises a first speed increasing section, a material back blowing section, a material mixing suspension section and a second speed increasing section from bottom to top in sequence; the height of the cylinder body of the material back-blowing section is 1-1.5 m; the inner side of the material back-blowing section is fixedly provided with a grid type material scattering baffle; a material inlet and an overhaul port are arranged on the cylinder body in the middle part of the material back-blowing section; the included angle between the material inlet and the horizontal plane is 0-20 degrees; the inner surface of the equipment cylinder body is fixedly provided with a castable lining serving as a wear-resistant layer, and the thickness of the castable lining is 60-100 mm; the large-diameter end cylinder opening of the first speed increasing section is a suspension air inlet, and the suspension air speed is 30-50 m/s. The invention has simple structure, can avoid the abrasion of the surface of the equipment, prolong the maintenance and the replacement period of parts, reduce the accumulation of materials at the bottom of the equipment, solve the problems of shutdown and forced termination of production caused by equipment blockage, prevent the scarring and blocking of solid mineral particles, reduce the running cost of the equipment and improve the running effect of the equipment.

title_en: Defrosting method of air energy heat pump evaporator
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of air-source heat pump evaporators, and discloses a defrosting method of an air-source heat pump evaporator, which comprises the following steps of: s1, local heating and cooling are realized by utilizing a metamaterial, and the metamaterial is excited by an external electric field or a magnetic field to generate accurate control of the surface temperature distribution of the evaporator; s2, adjusting water vapor adsorption and discharge by using a nano wetting technology, and realizing quick defrosting and reducing energy consumption through a nano wetting layer; s3, adopting an acoustic wave defrosting technology, and applying high-frequency acoustic waves on the surface of the evaporator to destroy the structure of a frosting layer so as to realize efficient defrosting; s4, intelligent defrosting control is carried out by combining an artificial intelligent algorithm, historical defrosting data are analyzed through a deep learning algorithm, and optimal defrosting time optimization energy efficiency is predicted; s5, introducing a magnetic field regulation technology to change frosting characteristics, and realizing a more efficient defrosting process. The invention has the advantages that: non-timing defrosting, artificial intelligence control defrosting, reinforcing user experience.

title_en: Calcining device, system comprising calcining device and use method of calcining device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a calcining device, a system containing the calcining device and a using method thereof, belonging to the technical field of heat treatment and equipment. The calcining device comprises an upright furnace wall, an inclined partition plate and a gate, wherein the furnace wall encloses a furnace body, and the inner space of the furnace body is divided into a plurality of hearths which are arranged up and down by the inclined partition plate; a ventilation pipe is arranged on the partition board; the hearth is communicated with the outside or the inside of the furnace body through a gate; the gate is used for controlling the height of the material level and/or the discharging rate, and controlling the material in the preheating zone to be a fixed bed; by using the device, the materials are discharged through the discharge opening after being preheated and calcined at least from top to bottom. By adopting the technical means, the invention can reduce the air consumption and the exhaust gas emission temperature, thus solving the problems of excessive air consumption and high exhaust gas emission temperature of the suspension calcining kiln in the prior art, thereby achieving the beneficial effects of improving the efficiency and saving the energy.

title_en: Liquid blast furnace slag granulating and waste heat recycling system and method
abstract_en: A system and a method for granulating liquid blast furnace slag and recovering waste heat, which comprise a rotational flow heat exchange device, a granulating device and a waste heat recovery device. Compressed air and water enter the cavity of the ejector through the granulating device to be mixed to form high-speed jet flow, molten blast furnace slag entering the guide cover is sheared, and slag is crushed and solidified into solid particles under the shearing and impact actions of the high-speed jet flow; the granulated blast furnace slag enters a cyclone heat exchanger along with high-temperature air and water vapor to realize rapid separation; the high-temperature slag separated from the gas enters a waste heat recovery device from the bottom of the cyclone heat exchanger; cooling water is introduced into a heat exchange pipe arranged in the waste heat recovery device, the liquid water rapidly absorbs heat in the waste heat recovery device and is converted into steam, the temperature of blast furnace slag is reduced to below 100 ℃, and low-temperature slag particles are discharged and sent out through the waste heat recovery device. The invention solves the problems of large water consumption, high energy consumption, serious pollution, low waste heat recovery efficiency, large occupied area of a system and the like of blast furnace slag granulation in the prior art.

title_en: Low-load stable combustion device
abstract_en: The invention provides a low-load stable combustion device, which relates to the field of deep peak regulation of thermal power units, and comprises the following components: the steady burning device body, steady burning device body includes: the air pipe is characterized by comprising a precombustion chamber, a plurality of gasified air nozzles are arranged around the precombustion chamber, a primary air swirling device, an oil combustion chamber and an oil air distribution swirling device are arranged on the inner side of one head of the air pipe, and a connecting pipe enters the secondary air swirling device and is connected with the precombustion chamber. According to the invention, the primary air cyclone device, the secondary air cyclone device, the oil combustion chamber and the oil air distribution cyclone device are arranged, so that the background technology is effectively improved: the existing stable combustion device is only provided with a group of air pipes to convey pulverized coal and oxygen in air to a precombustion chamber for combustion, and the invention lacks an air distribution cyclone device. Thus, uneven air distribution in the precombustor is easily caused, and the problems of unstable combustion and easy coking in the precombustor are further caused.

title_en: Home environment system and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a home environment system and a control method thereof. The house environmental system is applied to the house, the ground below of house is equipped with the overhead layer, includes: a ventilation part, the outside of which faces the outside of the room, and the inside of which faces the inside of the room, for communicating or isolating the inside and the outside of the room; the fresh air device is provided with a fresh air inlet, an air outlet, an air supply outlet and an air return inlet, wherein the fresh air inlet and the air outlet face the ventilation component respectively, and the air return inlet and the air supply outlet are communicated with the room respectively; the axial flow fan is arranged between the ventilation component and the fresh air equipment; the air detection component is arranged outdoors and is used for acquiring outdoor air parameters; the controller is in communication connection with the air detection component, and the fresh air equipment, the ventilation component and the axial flow fan are respectively and electrically connected with the controller; fresh air equipment and axial fan locate in the overhead layer, and ventilation unit locates the wall in overhead layer. The invention can improve fresh air exchange efficiency, keep the indoor air in a better state, and avoid potential safety hazards caused by suspended ceiling installation.

title_en: Method and device for controlling air conditioning unit, air conditioning unit and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for controlling an air conditioning unit, the air conditioning unit comprises: a refrigerant circulation circuit and a refrigerant pipe; the refrigerant circulation circuit includes: the compressor, the booster pump and the indoor air conditioner unit are communicated; one end of the refrigerant pipeline is connected between the air suction port of the compressor and the output end of the indoor air cooler unit, and the other end of the refrigerant pipeline is connected between the air exhaust port of the compressor and the inlet of the booster pump; the method comprises the following steps: acquiring the evaporation temperature of an indoor air cooler and the environmental temperature of the environment where the indoor air cooler is located; determining a target refrigeration cycle of the air conditioning unit according to the evaporation temperature and the environmental temperature; and controlling the operation states of the refrigerant circulation loop, the refrigerant pipeline, the compressor and the booster pump according to the target refrigeration cycle. On the one hand, the compressor can be prevented from always starting to waste energy. On the other hand, the problem that the compressor cannot be started due to low refrigerant pressure can be avoided. The application also discloses a device for controlling the air conditioning unit, the air conditioning unit and a storage medium.

title_en: Photovoltaic construction is with erection bracing equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of photovoltaic supporting equipment, and discloses a photovoltaic construction installation supporting equipment, which comprises a floating body and a controller, wherein a first electric telescopic rod is fixed at the top of the floating body and controlled by the controller, an installation frame is fixed at the output end of the first electric telescopic rod, a photovoltaic panel is arranged above the installation frame, stabilizing assemblies are arranged on two sides of the floating body, the photovoltaic construction installation supporting equipment controls the return stroke of the first electric telescopic rod by the controller, and drive mounting bracket and photovoltaic board decline for the focus of photovoltaic board moves down, increases its wind resistance, and unrestrained and rainwater are accumulated in the water storage tank simultaneously, increases the counter weight of body, and then has increased the unrestrained resistance of this device, and the rainwater enters into the bottom of water storage tank inner chamber through the check valve in the collecting hole, makes the buoyancy that the kickboard received water float, and pulling wire rope after the kickboard floats, and wire rope tightens and straightens, and pulls the mounting bracket, makes mounting bracket and photovoltaic board more stable.

title_en: Damping hydraulic breaking hammer and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a damping hydraulic breaking hammer and a using method thereof, which relate to the technical field of hydraulic breaking hammers and comprise a shell, a connecting plate, a temperature detection module, a hydraulic lever and a spraying module, the top of casing install the connecting plate, the bottom run through and install broken head, temperature detection module is installed to the bottom of casing, and temperature detection module is used for the temperature detection of broken head. According to the invention, when the processing module is installed and the temperature is detected to be in a state of not exceeding, the processing module controls the spraying module to start, the positioning module is not started, the infrared temperature detection head continues to detect real-time temperature data of the crushing head until the processing module detects that the temperature is in a state of exceeding or a state of exceeding the bottom, and when the processing module detects that the temperature is in a state of exceeding the bottom, the processing module controls the spraying module to not start, and the infrared temperature detection head continues to detect real-time temperature data of the crushing head until the processing module detects that the temperature is in a state of exceeding or a state of not exceeding the bottom.

title_en: Air conditioner control method, air conditioner and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a control method of an air conditioner, the air conditioner and a storage medium, wherein the air conditioner comprises an aromatherapy module and a fresh air module, the aromatherapy module is used for volatilizing aroma substances, the fresh air module is used for exchanging indoor air with outdoor air, the control method comprises the steps of determining a target concentration threshold value of indoor organic gaseous substances according to the running state of the aromatherapy module, obtaining a first concentration value of the indoor organic gaseous substances, and starting the fresh air module if the first concentration value exceeds the target concentration threshold value. According to the control method, under the opening state and the closing state of the fragrance module, the corresponding concentration threshold value is used as a standard for judging whether the fresh air module needs to be opened or not, so that the control intellectualization of the fresh air module and the fragrance module can be improved, the mutual influence of the fresh air module and the fragrance module in action is avoided, the good action effect of the fresh air module and the fragrance module is ensured, and the use experience of a user is improved.

title_en: Circulating dust-blocking air outlet mechanism for energy-saving air conditioner
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air outlet mechanism for a circulating dust-resistant energy-saving air conditioner, which relates to the field of air conditioners and comprises an air outlet outer frame arranged at an air outlet reserved frame, wherein an inner side mounting block is arranged in the air outlet outer frame, the inner side of the inner side mounting block is of a hollow structural design, the inner side mounting block and the air outlet outer frame form nested connection, the front side of the inner side mounting block is provided with decorating lines, the decorating lines are vertically and uniformly distributed, the rear side of the decorating lines is connected with a supporting upright post, and the supporting upright post is fixed in the inner side mounting block to provide support for the decorating lines. This energy-conserving air conditioner of dust is hindered to circulation formula is with going out fan mechanism can shelter from the inside of inboard installation piece through the setting of dust guard to block the entering of dust, improve its dustproof effect, avoided the air conditioner to close the back go out the fan mechanism and keep continuously opening the form and lead to the dust entering, and the switch of dust guard is controlled through rotatory, does not need external power, more energy-conserving.

title_en: Precision driving device for continuous tracking
abstract_en: The invention discloses a precise driving device for continuous tracking, which comprises an energy storage driving device, a driving device and a control device, wherein the energy storage driving device is used for storing potential energy and outputting driving force by utilizing the potential energy; a continuous power output control device for controlling the driving force to be continuously output in a set time period when the energy storage driving device releases the potential energy output power; the energy storage power source is used for driving the energy storage device to store potential energy in a time period except for the output driving force; compared with the existing driving device, the invention changes the precise driving equipment mode of continuous tracking usually driven by a motor, effectively ensures the tracking precision, greatly reduces the number of reduction stages and precise parts of a transmission mechanism, reduces the energy consumption in the driving operation process, reduces the requirements on the motor performance, integrally reduces the manufacturing and maintenance cost including driving equipment, finally reduces the energy consumption, improves the system efficiency and realizes the high-efficiency precise continuous tracking target.

title_en: Hydrogen crushing feeding device, hydrogen crushing device and hydrogen crushing system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydrogen crushing feeding device, a hydrogen crushing device and a hydrogen crushing system, belonging to the field of metal powder processing equipment; the hydrogen crushing feeding device comprises a storage box and a feeding mechanism which are arranged on the operation platform, and the feeding mechanism comprises a screw feeder and a pipeline connecting mechanism; the pipeline connecting mechanism comprises a guide pipe capable of bending and deforming and an adjusting mechanism of the guide pipe, and the adjusting mechanism of the guide pipe is used for moving a discharge hole of the guide pipe into a feed hole of the hydrogen crushing furnace; the automatic feeding of the hydrogen crushing furnace can be realized through the hydrogen crushing feeding device; according to the hydrogen crushing device, the hydrogen crushing furnace is arranged on the adjusting bracket, the hydrogen crushing furnace can be inclined through adjustment of the adjusting bracket, and then one side of the feed inlet of the hydrogen crushing furnace is lifted to be aligned with the discharge hole of the feed guide pipe, so that automatic feeding is facilitated, and discharging is facilitated; the hydrogen crushing system provided by the invention can realize the procedures of automatic feeding, heating, cooling, powder collecting and the like in the hydrogen crushing process, and greatly improves the production efficiency.

title_en: Dustproof mechanism of industrial refrigeration air conditioning equipment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of industrial refrigeration air conditioners, and particularly relates to an industrial refrigeration air conditioner dustproof mechanism which comprises a supporting bottom plate, wherein two supporting bottom plates are fixedly connected with an air conditioner outer unit body, air outlet ports are formed in two sides of the air conditioner outer unit body, grid plates are arranged on the air outlet ports, and dustproof plates are arranged in the air outlet ports. According to the invention, the heat radiation linkage dust removing mechanism is arranged, the air flow at the air outlet of the air conditioner external unit body is utilized to drive the flow fan to rotate, so that the dust removal and purification of the dust guard are achieved, the maintenance cost of the air conditioner external unit body is reduced, the refrigeration effect of an industrial air conditioner is improved, dust on an air inlet port cannot adhere, the spraying dust removing mechanism is arranged, dust removing treatment is carried out on the surrounding environment of the air conditioner external unit body through the atomization spraying port, and the surrounding environment of the air conditioner external unit body is clean.

title_en: Cooling system and method for improving cold energy utilization rate
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of refrigeration and cold supply, in particular to a cold supply system and a method for improving the utilization rate of cold energy, comprising a refrigeration system for providing cold for workshops, a workshop air conditioning system, a dry coil system, a process cooling system and an office area air conditioning system, wherein the systems are sequentially connected through a water supply main pipeline, and the office area air conditioning system is connected with the refrigeration system through a water return main pipeline; the water supply main pipeline is provided with a water supply pipeline, and the refrigerating system is connected with the dry coil system and the process cooling system through the water supply branch pipeline; valves are arranged between the systems on the water supply main pipeline and the water supply branch pipeline; the water supply main pipeline and the water supply branch pipeline are also provided with temperature sensors near the input end or the output end of each system. According to the invention, different demands of the cold quantity are ordered according to different areas of the workshop, so that the gradual utilization of the cold quantity provided by the refrigerating system is realized, the utilization rate of the cold quantity is improved, the energy waste is reduced, and the cooling cost is reduced.

title_en: Preventive structure for building fire and improved construction process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preventive structure of a building fire and an improved construction process, which comprise a top plate, a smoke discharging assembly and a sealing assembly, wherein the bottom of the top plate is fixedly connected with a temperature sensor, a through hole formed in the top plate is sleeved with a first ventilation pipe, and one side of the first ventilation pipe is fixedly connected with a second ventilation pipe; after the fire is stopped, the smoke discharging assembly is started to discharge toxic and harmful gases in the building out of the building, so that the subsequent rescue work can be unfolded more smoothly; an outer fireproof plate is arranged in the construction process to protect the inner circuit of the pipeline, so that the problem that the fire is increased due to the fact that the circuit is ignited in a fire disaster is avoided; the construction process is optimized by cleaning the concrete wall with the sodium bicarbonate cleaning agent, so that the fireproof plate is prevented from falling off from the wall due to various bacteria on the wall, and the service life of the fireproof plate is prolonged.

title_en: Air treatment device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air treatment device which comprises a shell, an air duct piece, a fresh air fan, an exhaust fan and an electric control box. The shell is provided with an indoor air inlet, an indoor air outlet, an outdoor air inlet and an outdoor air outlet; the air duct piece is arranged in the shell, the air duct piece and the shell define a fresh air duct and an exhaust air duct, the fresh air duct is communicated with the outdoor air inlet and the indoor air outlet, and the exhaust air duct is communicated with the indoor air inlet and the outdoor air outlet; the fresh air fan is arranged in the fresh air duct; the air exhaust fan is arranged in the air exhaust air duct, part of the air duct piece surrounds the air exhaust fan, and part of the air duct piece is positioned between the fresh air fan and the air exhaust fan; the electric control box is arranged on the outer wall surface of the shell, is positioned on one side of the air exhaust duct far away from the fresh air duct, and is provided with a wiring groove at one axial end of the air duct piece along the air exhaust fan. According to the air treatment device, wires of the electric parts of the air treatment device are orderly arranged, so that the electric conduction safety of the air treatment device can be improved.

title_en: Air conditioner frequency-raising control method, device, equipment and computer readable medium
abstract_en: The application relates to an air conditioner frequency-raising control method, an air conditioner frequency-raising control device, air conditioner frequency-raising control equipment and a computer readable medium. The method comprises the following steps: when the air conditioner is started, acquiring the environmental temperature of the space where the air conditioner is positioned; when the ambient temperature is in a preset extreme temperature interval, determining an up-conversion control strategy matched with the preset extreme temperature interval; and controlling the air conditioner to run in an extreme environment according to the frequency-raising control strategy. The application pointedly formulates corresponding frequency-raising control strategies for the starting of the air conditioner in different extreme environments, improves the reliability and the user experience of the air conditioner, avoids the failure condition in the frequency-raising control process of the air conditioner, and solves the technical problem that the air conditioning system frequently generates protection shutdown in the extreme environments.

title_en: Air conditioner and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of air conditioners, in particular to an air conditioner and a control method thereof. The control method of the air conditioner comprises the following steps: acquiring common operation parameters stored in an air conditioner; issuing a first query prompt containing common operating parameters; acquiring a first response instruction based on the first query prompt; and controlling the operation of the air conditioner according to the first response instruction. The invention inquires the user demand before controlling the operation of the air conditioner by the common operation parameters, avoids the problem that the air conditioner can not meet the user demand in real time caused by directly operating by the stored common operation parameters, improves the accuracy of predicting the defrosting time required for defrosting the object to be defrosted, better meets the user demand, and improves the intelligent level of the air conditioner, thereby improving the use experience of the user.

title_en: Water vapor energy storage system of coupling thermal power plant and operation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a water vapor energy storage system of a coupled thermal power plant and an operation method thereof, wherein an inlet of a medium pressure cylinder is connected with reheat vapor generated by a boiler, one path of an outlet of the medium pressure cylinder is connected with an inlet of a low pressure cylinder, the other path of the outlet of the medium pressure cylinder is connected with a first inlet of a precooler, a second inlet of the precooler is connected with an outlet of a low-temperature oil tank, a first outlet of the precooler is connected with a first inlet of a condenser, a second outlet of the precooler is connected with an inlet of a high-temperature oil tank, a first outlet of the condenser is connected with a first inlet of a medium temperature tank, a second outlet of the condenser is connected with a second inlet of the medium temperature tank, an outlet of the medium temperature tank is connected with an inlet of a flash tank, a first outlet of the flash tank is connected with an inlet of the low-temperature tank, an outlet of the low-temperature tank is connected with an inlet of a steam turbine through a pump, a second inlet of the superheater is connected with an outlet of the high-temperature oil tank, and a second outlet of the low-pressure cylinder is connected with an inlet of the condenser. The invention has two processes of energy storage and energy release.

title_en: All-weather stable-operation energy-saving aircraft ground air conditioning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an all-weather stable-operation energy-saving aircraft ground air conditioning system, which is characterized in that when one of a third evaporator and a fourth evaporator which are connected in parallel at the tail end of an air conditioning system is frosted in the using process, the flow direction of a refrigerant in a three-stage system is changed to switch the other evaporator to work by controlling the switch of two groups of electromagnetic valves so as to prevent the continuous increase of the frost layer on the surface of the original evaporator and deteriorate the heat transfer effect, thereby ensuring the stable air supply temperature of a unit and realizing the all-weather uninterrupted operation of the aircraft ground air conditioning unit, and simultaneously fresh air is introduced through a sixth or eighth air duct corresponding to the third evaporator or the fourth evaporator which is frosted, and can be directly fed into a first air duct after the cooling of the frost layer is absorbed, and is directly mixed with the fresh air which is acted by the first evaporator, namely the recovered cooling of the frost layer bears the required cooling capacity of the original first evaporator, so that the input power consumption of the first-stage system is reduced, and the energy saving and consumption of the whole air conditioning system is realized.

title_en: Nuclear energy transformation method for coal-fired power plant
abstract_en: A nuclear energy transformation method for a coal-fired power plant relates to the field of thermal power generation. Providing a clean steam supply module capable of replacing a coal-fired power plant boiler, using a nuclear reactor to provide heat energy, heating working medium at the primary side of a steam generator in the steam supply module by the nuclear reactor, and heating working medium at the secondary side of the steam generator by the working medium at the primary side to increase the temperature to become high-temperature working medium; the high-temperature working medium on the secondary side of the steam generator enters a steam turbine of the coal-fired power station to do work through a high Wen Shuyun pipeline; the high-temperature working medium becomes a low-temperature working medium after the steam turbine of the coal-fired power plant works, the low-temperature working medium is condensed into a liquid state after passing through the condenser of the coal-fired power plant, and the low-temperature working medium is returned to the steam supply module after passing through the main pump of the coal-fired power plant. The clean nuclear reactor is used for providing heat energy, and greenhouse gases such as carbon dioxide and the like are not discharged, so that clean power generation is realized.

title_en: Ventilation device for building
abstract_en: The application relates to a ventilation device for a building, which belongs to the field of ventilation devices and comprises an air inlet pipe and an air outlet pipe, wherein a filter screen and a fan are arranged in the air inlet pipe and the air outlet pipe, an auxiliary pipe is communicated with the air inlet pipe, the communication part of the auxiliary pipe and the air inlet pipe is positioned between the filter screen and the fan at the corresponding position, a guide rail is arranged in the air inlet pipe, the guide rail extends into the auxiliary pipe, a movable strip is connected onto the guide rail in a sliding manner, filter cloth is arranged on the movable strip, a control component for controlling the movable strip to move is arranged in the auxiliary pipe, and a solar incidence angle tester matched with the control component is arranged on the air inlet pipe. The control assembly controls the movement of the moving strip according to the detection value of the solar incidence angle tester so as to move the filter cloth into the air inlet pipe, and the air is filtered according to different dust contents in different time periods, so that the cleanliness of fresh air fed into a room is improved.

title_en: Silicon-based radiation refrigeration emitter for atmosphere water collection and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a silicon-based radiation refrigeration emitter for collecting water from atmosphere and a preparation method thereof, wherein on a silicon substrate cut by diamond wires, the composite nested structure of the groove and the air microcavity is prepared by a metal auxiliary chemical etching method and rounding treatment, and local oxidation treatment is carried out. In the invention, the air microcavity is introduced to enable a large number of bubbles to exist at the interface of the water drop and the radiation refrigeration emitter, thereby reducing the sliding angle of condensed water; the invention ensures the nucleation rate of water vapor condensation, and simultaneously, the condensed water film can be timely detached from the surface, thereby greatly improving the water taking rate of the air; the prepared silicon-based radiation refrigeration emitter with anisotropy and low sliding angle can realize high-efficiency atmosphere water collection.

title_en: Permanent magnet coreless motor control optimization method for compressor of refrigerating unit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a permanent magnet coreless motor control optimization method of a refrigerating unit compressor, which belongs to the technical field of PID control and comprises the steps of S1, constructing a permanent magnet coreless motor simulation control system of the refrigerating unit compressor, S2, improving a Hedera algorithm, S3, adjusting parameters of PID controllers of a rotating speed ring and a current ring by utilizing the improved Hedera algorithm, obtaining optimal Kp, ki and Kd parameters through optimization of the algorithm, S4, inputting the optimal PID parameters set by the Hedera algorithm into the permanent magnet coreless motor simulation control system of the refrigerating unit compressor, optimizing the control effect of the permanent magnet coreless motor, and improving the stability and robustness of PID control by improving the optimization of the Hedera algorithm to the PID controller.

title_en: HVAC (heating, ventilation and air conditioning) optimal control method based on scene recognition and demand prediction
abstract_en: The invention provides an HVAC (heating, ventilation and air conditioning) optimal control method based on scene recognition and demand prediction, which comprises the following steps: acquiring key variable data from a plurality of data sources in an independent space; data cleaning is carried out on the collected data; extracting useful features from the preprocessed data to construct feature vectors; inputting the feature vector into an LSTM model to obtain scene classification probability and a demand forecast value; dynamically adjusting the operation parameters of the HVAC system according to the scene recognition and the demand prediction result; and generating specific HVAC system control instructions according to the optimal control strategy. The invention provides an innovative HVAC optimization control method through multi-source data acquisition, application of an LSTM model and use of a multi-target optimization model, and compared with the prior art, the HVAC optimization control method has higher creativity and novelty, can effectively solve the problems of inaccurate control delay and prediction and the like in the prior method, and improves the overall efficiency and user comfort level of the system.

title_en: High-strength photovoltaic aluminum profile frame and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-strength photovoltaic aluminum profile frame and a preparation method thereof, wherein the high-strength photovoltaic aluminum profile frame comprises a first frame rod body and a second frame rod body, the first frame rod body and the second frame rod body form a frame of an aluminum profile in an inclined distribution posture, the second frame rod body is used for supporting a photovoltaic panel from the bottom end, the first frame rod body and the second frame rod body are connected through a supporting rod, a bending part is arranged at the joint of the supporting rod and the frame rod body, and the bending part is used for integrally positioning the supporting rod below a mounting surface of the back of the photovoltaic panel. This high strength photovoltaic aluminium alloy frame and preparation method thereof adopts novel support and additional strengthening, can enough guarantee the structural strength of frame whole and independent section bar, can utilize unique additional strengthening internal design again, and the use of cooperation heat absorption liquid realizes the supplementary cooling to the photovoltaic board, and excellent in use effect and commercial value are higher.

title_en: Air conditioning device
abstract_en: An air conditioning apparatus of the present disclosure is provided with a refrigerant circuit having a compressor, a heat source side heat exchanger functioning as an evaporator, a refrigerant flow path switching device, a load side heat exchanger functioning as a condenser, and a load side throttling device. The air conditioning device is provided with: a bypass pipe that guides the refrigerant discharged from the compressor to the heat source side heat exchanger; a first opening/closing device provided in the bypass pipe; and a control device. The compressor, the heat source side heat exchanger, the refrigerant flow switching device, the bypass pipe, and the first opening/closing device are mounted in an outdoor unit. When defrosting the heat source side heat exchanger, the control device sets the flow path of the refrigerant flow path switching device to a flow path through which the refrigerant discharged from the compressor flows into the load side heat exchanger, sets the first opening/closing device to an open state from a closed state, sets the load side throttling device to a closed state from an open state, and sets the refrigerant discharged from the compressor to flow into the heat source side heat exchanger from the bypass pipe.

title_en: Gravity-based heating system and heating method
abstract_en: The application relates to a gravity-based heating system and a gravity-based heating method, which are used for floor heating. The heating system comprises a heating unit, a sensing unit and a control unit; the heating unit is arranged below the floor; the heating unit comprises a plurality of heating modules and a plurality of water valves, and each heating module is communicated with the adjacent heating module through the water valve; the sensing unit comprises a plurality of gravity sensors; each gravity sensor is located in a floor on each heating module; the heating unit and the sensing unit are respectively and electrically connected with the control unit; the control unit is used for acquiring a gravity value corresponding to each heating module through each gravity sensor and opening or closing a water valve between an initial heating position and a target heating module based on the gravity value; the plurality of heating modules includes a target heating module. In the embodiment of the application, the target heating position is determined by measuring the gravity value, and the conveying direction of the heating hot water is automatically adjusted, so that the targeted local heating is realized, and the water resource and the electric energy are saved.

title_en: Double-fan gas water heater
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-fan gas water heater, which comprises: a housing; the combustion chamber is internally provided with a plurality of ventilation openings which are vertically arranged on a partition board, one side of the partition board is provided with a first ventilation board, the other side of the partition board is provided with a second ventilation board, the first ventilation board is provided with a plurality of first ventilation holes, the second ventilation board is provided with a plurality of second ventilation holes, the second ventilation board is positioned below the ventilation openings, the first ventilation board is positioned above the ventilation openings, the bottom of the combustion chamber is provided with a first air inlet and a second air inlet, the partition board is arranged between the first air inlet and the second air inlet, the first air inlet is positioned below the first ventilation board, and the second air inlet is positioned below the second ventilation board; the air supply assembly comprises a first fan and a second fan, the second fan is connected with the second air inlet, and the first fan is connected with the first air inlet. The full combustion of the fuel gas is realized to reduce the energy consumption of the fuel gas water heater.

title_en: Hydraulic compression energy storage system based on refrigeration system transformation and operation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydraulic compression energy storage system based on refrigeration system transformation and an operation method thereof, wherein the system comprises a condenser, the outlet end of the condenser is respectively connected with the inlet ends of an evaporator and an air storage tank through a first pipeline, and the outlet ends of the evaporator and the air storage tank are connected with the inlet ends of a compression device; the inlet end of the condenser is connected with the outlet end of the compression device through a second pipeline, and the outlet end of the compression device is also connected with the reservoir through a driving device. According to the system, on one hand, liquid-phase working media in the hydraulic compression energy storage system are subjected to heat release in the condenser, so that the technical problem that an energy storage effect is not up to standard due to unsmooth discharge of compression heat of the air storage tank in the existing hydraulic compression energy storage technology is solved, and on the other hand, the condenser is connected with the air storage tank, and liquid-phase refrigerant at an outlet in the condenser is conveyed into the air storage tank for storage, so that the refrigerating system has an energy storage power generation function.

title_en: Portable outdoor solar mobile power supply
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a portable outdoor solar mobile power supply, and relates to the technical field of mobile power supplies. The portable outdoor solar mobile power supply comprises a box body and a supporting mechanism; the box body is provided with a containing cavity and a battery cavity, a solar panel is arranged in the containing cavity, and a rechargeable battery is arranged in the battery cavity; the lower end of the bracket is connected with the box body, the upper end of the bracket is connected with the folding plate, the folding plate is clamped in the accommodating cavity, and the solar panel is embedded on the surface of the folding plate. According to the portable outdoor solar mobile power supply, the inclination angle of the plate body can be adjusted through the support supporting the folding plate, so that the light receiving capacity is improved by matching with the illumination angle, the solar plate is exposed outside only when the portable outdoor solar mobile power supply is used through folding and storage, the abrasion of the solar plate is reduced when the portable outdoor solar mobile power supply is not used, and the influence of surface roughness on the light receiving capacity is avoided.

title_en: Curtain wall unit and curtain wall system
abstract_en: The application discloses a curtain wall unit and a curtain wall system, relates to the technical field of buildings, and is used for solving the problem that rainwater and the like are easy to attach to a corrugated aluminum plate, so that the effect of the vertical face of the corrugated aluminum plate is poor. The curtain wall unit comprises a shielding piece, a fixing piece and a corrugated plate. The blinder is adapted to be coupled to a support frame of a curtain wall system. The shield extends in a horizontal direction. The mounting is located the shielding member below, and sets up with shielding member interval. The wave plate is connected to the lower part of the shielding piece and is connected with the fixing piece. The projection of the corrugated plate in the vertical direction is located within the projection of the shield in the vertical direction. The application is used for forming the facade of a building.

title_en: Flexible connection and pull-apart phase change heating device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flexible connection and pull-open phase-change heat supply device which is applied to the field of energy development and utilization and comprises a phase-change energy storage device, a heat exchange device connected with the phase-change energy storage device and a user connected with the heat exchange device, wherein the phase-change energy storage device is a module unit which is flexibly connected and can be opened and closed, the heat exchange device comprises a heat taking device and an ice melting device, the heat taking device is connected with the phase-change energy storage device through a pipeline to absorb phase-change solidification heat of water in the phase-change energy storage device to become ice for heating the user, and the ice melting device is connected with the phase-change energy storage device through a pipeline to release heat for melting ice on the surface of the phase-change energy storage device; the phase change energy storage device integrates energy storage, heat exchange, ice melting and ice removing, has novel design and reasonable structure, smoothly solves the problem of difficult ice taking, does not waste any water resource in the whole processes of icing, ice melting and ice taking, has good practicability and high energy utilization rate, and provides a new idea for large-scale production.

title_en: Defrosting control method for air conditioner, computer device and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a defrosting control method of an air conditioner, the air conditioner, a computer device and a readable storage medium, wherein the defrosting control method of the air conditioner comprises the steps of acquiring a first temperature value acquired by a first temperature sensor and a second temperature value acquired by a second temperature sensor, wherein the first temperature sensor and the second temperature sensor are both positioned on a first heat exchange pipeline of a heat exchanger and are arranged at intervals; judging whether the absolute value delta  i  of the difference value between the first temperature value and the second temperature value is smaller than or equal to a temperature threshold value; if yes, judging whether the value of delta  i  is reduced or unchanged after the preset time period; if the value of delta  i  is reduced or unchanged after the preset time period passes, entering a defrosting mode. The defrosting control method can judge the frosting of the outdoor unit through the temperature and the relative humidity of the environment where the outdoor unit is positioned and the temperature change of the refrigerant in the heat exchanger of the outdoor unit, is more visual, makes more effective judgment, and avoids the situation of mistaken defrosting or frosting failure.

title_en: Flow guide assembly for humidity adjusting device and humidity adjusting device
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of humidity control, and discloses a flow guide assembly for a humidity control device, which comprises the following components: a plurality of air inlets are respectively formed in the two opposite sides of the shell; the baffle is arranged in the shell; the guide plate is rotatably arranged in the shell; the deflector is used for forming different air flow paths together with the baffle and the plurality of air openings under the condition of rotating to different preset positions. Therefore, a large number of air valves are not required to be controlled, and different flow paths can be switched by adjusting the diversion assembly to rotate to different preset positions. Thus, when the flow guide assembly is applied to the humidity adjusting device, the complexity of the humidity adjusting device can be reduced. The application also discloses a humidity adjusting device.

title_en: Reduction reaction coal feeding device for suspension magnetization roasting furnace
abstract_en: The invention relates to a reduction reaction coal feeding device for a suspension magnetization roasting furnace, which belongs to the technical field of boiler coal feeding and comprises a feeding spiral storage bin, wherein the top of the feeding spiral storage bin is provided with a feed inlet, and the feed inlet is aligned to the storage bin; a discharge hole is formed in the bottom of the feeding spiral storage bin and corresponds to the reactor; the feeding port and the discharging port are respectively arranged at two ends of the feeding spiral storage bin; a screw feeding shaft is arranged in the feeding screw storage bin, the shaft body part of the screw feeding shaft is of a hollow structure, and the inner cavity is a cooling channel. The invention can directly send the materials into the system, and solves the problem of sintering caused by direct combustion at high temperature.

title_en: Ceramic material
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a method represented by formula (1): in the ceramic represented by (1-m) PbSc  0.5‑   x Ta 0.5+x O 3 -mPbMg 0.5‑y W 0.5+y O 3  (1), m satisfies 0.60.ltoreq.m.ltoreq.0.95, x.ltoreq.0.1, y.ltoreq.0.1 and 0.ltoreq.x+y.ltoreq.0.13 in the case of 0.ltoreq.x and 0.ltoreq.y in the case of 0>x and 0.ltoreq.y, x.ltoreq.0 and 0.ltoreq.y.ltoreq.0.1 in the case of 0.ltoreq.x and 0>y, -0.1.ltoreq.y and-0.13.ltoreq.x+y.ltoreq.0, and 0< x.ltoreq.0.1 and-0.1.ltoreq.y.0 in the case of 0< x and 0>y.

title_en: Stainless steel water heat exchange condensing boiler
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of boilers, in particular to a stainless steel water heat exchange condensing boiler, which provides the following proposal, comprises a boiler, a heat exchanger, two user pipelines, two heat exchange pipelines and two heating pipelines. According to the invention, the bottom of a boiler is fixedly connected with a boiler sliding seat, the bottom of a heat exchanger is fixedly connected with a heat exchanger sliding seat, the bottom of one side of the boiler, which is far away from the heat exchanger, is provided with an air inlet, one side of the air inlet, which is far away from the boiler, is fixedly connected with a blower, the bottom of the blower is fixedly connected with a base, one side of the base, which is close to the boiler, is fixedly connected with two parallel guide rails, the boiler sliding seat and the heat exchanger sliding seat are both in sliding connection with the tops of the two guide rails, the middle part of one side of the boiler, which is close to the heat exchanger, is fixedly connected with a vacuum cylinder, the inner part of the vacuum cylinder is in sliding connection with a piston, one side of the piston, which is close to the heat exchanger, is fixedly connected with a piston rod, and the middle part of one side of the heat exchanger, which is close to the boiler, is fixedly connected with a first fixing plate.

title_en: Mixed flow prevention temperature control thrust structure for heat storage water tank and heat storage water tank
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-mixed flow temperature control thrust structure for a heat storage water tank, which belongs to the technical field of thrust structures and comprises a thrust body, a baffle plate, a thrust rod, a piston connected with the thrust rod, wherein the thrust body is of a regular columnar structure, a first channel and a second channel which are mutually communicated are arranged in the thrust body, the cross-sectional area of the first channel is 25-30 times of the cross-sectional area of the second channel, and the length of the second channel is 4-6 times of that of the first channel; the piston is arranged in the second channel, the space, communicated with the second channel, of the first channel is divided into a pneumatic cavity and a push rod cavity by the piston, thrust gas is filled in the pneumatic cavity, and the thrust gas is used for increasing or reducing the volume when the temperature changes so that the thrust rod moves in the second channel. According to the scheme, the effect of preventing cold and hot water mixed flow is achieved through the design of the mixed flow prevention temperature control thrust structure, so that water temperature is prevented from being suddenly cooled and heated when the hot water storage tank is discharged.

title_en: Heat energy recovery system and process for producing silane, polysilicon and silicon-carbon negative electrode materials
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heat energy recovery system for producing silane, polysilicon and silicon-carbon negative electrode materials and a process thereof. The system comprises a process medium heat exchanger, a refrigerant buffer tank, a coupling heat exchanger, a primary compressor, a secondary compressor, a steam generator, a coupling heat exchanger, a refrigerant storage tank, a refrigerant conveying pump and a process medium heat exchanger which are sequentially and circularly connected. The process specifically comprises the following steps: (1) Pressurizing the low-temperature liquid-phase refrigerant in the refrigerant storage tank by a delivery pump and delivering the low-temperature liquid-phase refrigerant into a process medium heat exchanger for heat exchange; (2) sending the mixture into a coupling heat exchanger for heat exchange, compressing and heating; (3) sending the waste water into a steam generator for indirect heat exchange; (4) And sending the high-temperature liquid-phase refrigerant into a coupling heat exchanger for heat exchange, obtaining the low-temperature liquid-phase refrigerant after throttling and cooling, and sending the low-temperature liquid-phase refrigerant into a refrigerant storage tank. The invention makes the resource utilized to the maximum, and the process has simple operation, high safety and reliability, no environmental pollution and realizes the maximization of economic benefit and social benefit.

title_en: Low-temperature treatment device and low-temperature treatment process for coal gangue
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of comprehensive utilization of solid waste, in particular to the field of IPC F27B17, and more particularly relates to a low-temperature heat treatment device and a low-temperature heat treatment process of coal gangue. The method comprises the following steps: s1, coal gangue powder enters a device from a storage bin (1), is preheated by a primary cyclone preheater (3) and a secondary cyclone preheater (4), and then enters a boiling combustion system (6); s2, calcining the materials in a fluidized bed combustion system (6), enabling the fine materials obtained after calcination to enter a cyclone powder collector (7) along with flue gas from the upper part of the fluidized bed combustion system (6) to be cooled to obtain a finished product 1, discharging the crude materials obtained after calcination through an overflow port (14) after fluidized bed calcination, cooling and collecting the crude materials to obtain a finished product 2, and mixing the finished product 1 and the finished product 2. The powder prepared by the process has less loss on ignition of less than 2.5%, whiteness of more than 70%, and higher activity, and can be used for ceramic, cement additives and the like.

title_en: Solar synchronous track radiation refrigerator
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of refrigerators and discloses a solar synchronous track radiation refrigerator which comprises a carbon fiber frame, wherein a reflecting screen, a cold block and an earth screen are arranged on the carbon fiber frame, the carbon fiber frame comprises a bottom column body, a vertical column body and a top column body which are mutually connected, an inclined supporting rod for installing the reflecting screen is obliquely arranged on the top column body, a plane supporting plate for installing the cold block is arranged on the side wall of the vertical column body, the reflecting screen comprises a panel, a first reflecting screen, a second reflecting screen and a third reflecting screen which are sequentially connected, side plates are arranged on the side surfaces of the first reflecting screen, the second reflecting screen and the third reflecting screen, a screen fixing piece and a screen heat insulation support are arranged at one end, close to the inclined supporting rod, of the first reflecting screen, the second reflecting screen and the third reflecting screen, the cold block comprises a first cold block and a second cold block which are adjacently arranged, the edge of the first cold block is connected with the earth screen, and the edge of the second cold block is connected with the reflecting screen. The device provides an on-orbit environment without external heat flow for the cold block under the action of the earth screen and the reflecting screen.

title_en: Rotary kiln for lithium battery processing
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of rotary kilns, and discloses a rotary kiln for processing lithium batteries, which comprises a base, a rotary kiln, a smoke discharging mechanism, a buffer mechanism and a water storage mechanism, wherein the base is provided with a plurality of grooves; the rotary kiln is arranged on one side of the base, the water storage mechanism is arranged on the other side of the base, the smoke exhausting mechanism is arranged on the water storage mechanism and is communicated with the rotary kiln, and the buffer mechanism is arranged on the smoke exhausting mechanism and is communicated with the smoke exhausting mechanism; the smoke exhausting mechanism comprises a pipeline. This continuous flowing water can be before the touching of waste material granule and ceramic inner liner inner wall earlier with flowing water contact to can play the cushioning effect to the striking of waste material granule, and then the damage that ceramic inner liner received can be a large amount of reduction, can prevent simultaneously that acid condensate water from piling up on ceramic inner liner's pipe wall for a long time, prolonged ceramic inner liner's life, avoid ceramic inner liner to take place to rise to crack, very big reduction the pipeline by the back waste gas leakage risk of corroding.

title_en: Adjustable photovoltaic structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses an adjustable photovoltaic structure, which relates to the technical field of photovoltaic power generation and comprises a first photovoltaic module and a second photovoltaic module, wherein the first photovoltaic module comprises a first connecting piece and a first photovoltaic plate which are connected. The second photovoltaic module comprises a second connecting piece and a second photovoltaic plate which are connected, the outer walls of the second connecting piece and the first connecting piece are oval, the outer walls of the second connecting piece are in sliding connection with the outer walls of the first connecting piece, and the relative positions of the first photovoltaic plate and the second photovoltaic plate can be changed when the first photovoltaic plate and the second photovoltaic plate slide relatively. When the angle of the photovoltaic panel needs to be adjusted, the outer wall of the first connecting piece and the outer wall of the second connecting piece can slide relatively, so that the first connecting piece and the second connecting piece rotate relatively, and the first photovoltaic panel and the second photovoltaic panel are driven to rotate relatively to adjust the angle of the photovoltaic panel.

title_en: Solar street lamp capable of greatly improving sunlight utilization efficiency
abstract_en: The invention discloses a solar street lamp capable of greatly improving the utilization efficiency of sunlight, which comprises a supporting rod, a repulsive force changing device, a deflection device, a limiting traction device, a light transmission device, a solar panel, a street lamp extension rod, a stabilizing rod and a lamp cap, wherein the repulsive force changing device is arranged at the top of the supporting rod, the limiting traction device is arranged at the top of the repulsive force changing device, the deflection device is arranged in the repulsive force changing device and the limiting traction device, the light transmission device is arranged on the outer wall of the limiting traction device, and the solar panel is arranged at the top of the deflection device.

title_en: Burner and gas water heater
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of household appliances, and discloses a burner and a gas water heater, wherein the burner comprises: the burner comprises a burner main body, wherein a gas inlet and a fire hole are formed in the burner main body, the gas inlet is used for introducing gas, and the fire hole is communicated with the gas inlet; the water collecting flow passage and the fire hole are arranged on the same side surface of the burner main body and are spaced apart from the fire hole and used for collecting condensed water in flue gas generated by the combustion of the burner; the water outlet is formed on the burner main body and communicated with the water collecting flow passage for discharging condensed water. The burner provided by the embodiment of the application can overcome the problem that condensed water falls into the fire hole in the related technology, and can avoid influencing the normal operation of the burner due to the fact that the condensed water falls into the fire hole.

title_en: Cooling device of air conditioner condenser and working method thereof
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a cooling device of an air conditioner condenser and a working method thereof, wherein the device comprises the following components: the water distribution structure comprises a water tank for storing condensed water, a spraying structure and an air pressure driving structure, and the spraying structure is connected with the water tank through a pipeline; the pneumatic driving structure is connected with the spraying structure. By implementing the device provided by the embodiment of the invention, the condensed water can be efficiently utilized and uniformly sprayed, and the space limitation and the functionality of the water distributor are comprehensively considered.

title_en: Photovoltaic power generation group capable of conducting self-detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic power generation group capable of carrying out self-detection, which comprises the following components: the device comprises a base plate, wherein a plurality of first telescopic supporting rods and a plurality of second telescopic supporting rods are fixedly connected to the upper surface of the base plate, hinges are fixedly connected to the upper surface of the base plate, side plates and rear plates are fixedly connected to the outer surfaces of the hinges, fixing structures are arranged on the side plates and the rear plates, the side plates are connected with the rear plates through limiting structures, a plurality of storage grooves are formed in the rear plates, and fixing rods are stored in the storage grooves; the upper surfaces of a plurality of first flexible bracing pieces and a plurality of second flexible bracing pieces rotate and are connected with the support frame, smash the dead lever into underground, simultaneously with the ventilation hole on the support frame, increase the wind resistance, reduce the impact force of wind, protect photovoltaic power generation group, increase life, monitor photovoltaic power generation device through detecting system, when photovoltaic power generation device appears the hot spot, protect photovoltaic power generation device, avoid causing further loss.

title_en: Water heater control method and device and water heater
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water heaters and discloses a control method and device of a water heater and the water heater, wherein the method comprises the steps of judging fluctuation conditions of working parameters of a direct current fan of the water heater under the condition that the water heater is in a stable state, wherein the working parameters comprise at least one of rotating speed and current; and if the fluctuation of the working parameters is abnormal, adjusting the sensitivity of the driving controller of the direct current fan. Therefore, by means of reducing the sensitivity of the direct-current fan driving control board to the control parameters sent by the main controller, the situation that the direct-current fan driving controller reacts too fast is effectively avoided, the control signals of the direct-current fan are frequently regulated to cause fluctuation of working parameters such as fan rotating speed and the like, the stable reliability of the direct-current fan is fully ensured, the stable operation of the water heater is improved, the use requirement of a user is met, and the user experience is remarkably improved.

title_en: Method for cleaning adhered iron scales on water beam in heating furnace
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for cleaning an iron scale attached to a water beam in a heating furnace, which has the advantages that the iron scale attachment is arranged in a middle vacancy of left and right translation of two billets, the height of the iron scale attachment is adjusted by utilizing a moving beam, the lower edge of the steel billet is high, the moving beam is horizontally translated, so that the steel billet and the iron scale attachment are scratched, the side surface of the iron scale attachment is stressed, and the iron scale is scratched.

title_en: Smelting furnace for smelting waste copper and waste aluminum materials
abstract_en: The invention discloses a smelting furnace for smelting waste copper and waste aluminum materials, which relates to the technical field of metal recovery and comprises a smelting furnace, wherein a feeding hopper is arranged on a feeding port of the smelting furnace, an inner hollow outer frame is arranged between the feeding hopper and the feeding port of the smelting furnace, a slot penetrating up and down is formed in the middle of the outer frame, a door assembly and a driving assembly for driving the door assembly to open and close are arranged in the outer frame, the smelting furnace is closed when the door assembly is closed, and the smelting furnace is communicated with the feeding hopper when the door assembly is opened. Because the temperature is too high in the smelting furnace, the metal water is easy to splash during feeding, the damage is easy to generate during feeding of workers, the service life of the conveyor belt can be reduced during feeding by utilizing the conveyor belt, so when feeding is needed, the door assembly is closed, then the materials which are prepared according to the proportion are sequentially transmitted into the feeding hopper through the conveyor belt, the workers can be protected after leaving, the door assembly is opened by the driving assembly, and the conveyor belt can be protected by the quick door assembly after the materials are fed into the smelting furnace.

title_en: Air conditioner, ventilation assembly and self-cleaning control method of ventilation assembly
