abstract_en: The invention provides an air conditioner, a ventilation assembly and a self-cleaning control method thereof, wherein the ventilation assembly comprises a through-flow fan blade, a rotation control mechanism, an air guide channel, a movement control mechanism, a movable seat, a brush roller and a rotation control mechanism, the air guide channel is provided with an air inlet and an air outlet, the through-flow fan blade is rotatably supported in the air guide channel, the rotation control mechanism can control the through-flow fan blade to rotate, the movement control mechanism can control the movable seat to move along the extending direction of the air guide channel between the air inlet and the air outlet, the brush roller is rotatably supported on the movable seat and is positioned in the air guide channel, a brush part on the brush roller extends in the axial direction of the through-flow fan blade, and the rotation control mechanism can control the brush roller to rotate so that the brush part is abutted against the inner surface of the air guide channel or the outer surface of the through-flow fan blade. The ventilation assembly can perform self-cleaning dust removal on the cross-flow fan blades and the air guide channels, is better in self-cleaning effect, high in self-cleaning efficiency, simple and compact in structure and low in production cost.

title_en: Light control agricultural support that rotatory accomodate of photovoltaic module
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of photovoltaic power generation, and discloses a light control agricultural bracket for rotating and accommodating a photovoltaic module, which comprises a frame mechanism, a support component and an accommodating component, wherein the frame mechanism comprises an upright post, the support component is adaptively arranged on the outer side of the upright post, and the accommodating component is adaptively arranged on the outer side of the support component; through supporting part, hold the part, rotating part and power part's mutually support, can realize according to crops at the demand of different moments to illumination, the position of photovoltaic board is adjusted in good time, thereby nimble regulation and control photovoltaic power generation reaches the complementary effect of farming light with crop photosynthesis's relation, in addition when photovoltaic board level is laid, both sides are all spacing about, increase photovoltaic board's stability, and when extremely strong wind weather, also can make photovoltaic board remove to hold the incasement portion, thereby protection photovoltaic board is not damaged, utilize photovoltaic board to shelter also can prevent hail, high temperature sunshine, natural factors such as sudden drop storm to cause harm to cash crop under the board.

title_en: Air conditioning system and control method
abstract_en: The invention provides an air conditioning system and a control method, wherein the air conditioning system comprises a compressor and a gas-liquid separator, a heat exchange structure is provided with a first heat exchange channel and a second heat exchange channel, wherein the first heat exchange channel is used for carrying out heat exchange, the inlet of the first heat exchange channel is selectively communicated with or disconnected from the exhaust port of the compressor, the outlet of the first heat exchange channel is selectively communicated with the inlet of the gas-liquid separator, the inlet of the second heat exchange channel is selectively communicated with or disconnected from the bottom of the gas-liquid separator, the outlet of the second heat exchange channel is communicated with the air inlet of the compressor, and the first heat exchange channel is used for heating the second heat exchange channel. By the technical scheme provided by the invention, the technical problem that the compressor of the air conditioning system in the prior art is easy to generate liquid impact can be solved.

title_en: Filter element assembly and water heater with same
abstract_en: The invention discloses a filter element assembly and a water heater with the same, wherein the filter element assembly comprises a filter element mounting seat, the filter element mounting seat is provided with a water inlet and a water outlet, the filter element is detachably connected with the filter element mounting seat, the filter element comprises a shell, the shell is provided with a water inlet and a water outlet, a central pipe is arranged in the shell, a water passing hole is formed in the peripheral wall of the central pipe, a filter material cover is arranged in the shell and positioned at one side of the central pipe, which faces towards a water inlet, a filter material cavity is defined by matching the filter material cover, the outer wall surface of the central pipe and the inner wall surface of the shell, a filter material is filled in the filter material cavity, a central channel is defined at the inner side of the central pipe, a water stopping piece is used for opening and closing the water inlet, and a first valve is used for opening and closing the water outlet. According to the filter element assembly, the water inlet and the water outlet can be opened or plugged according to the use requirement, so that the use experience of a user is improved.

title_en: Correction method and device of current loop bandwidth, electronic equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a correction method, a correction device, electronic equipment and a correction medium of a current loop bandwidth, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining the temperature of a first outer pipe of an outdoor coil at the current moment and obtaining the temperature of an outer pipe of a compressor at the current moment; and determining a load change state of the compressor at the current moment according to the first outer pipe temperature and the second outer pipe temperature of the outdoor coil pipe at the moment which is the last of the current moment, and correcting the current loop bandwidth of the compressor at the current moment according to the load change state. Therefore, the load change state of the compressor is determined according to the outer ring temperature and the outer tube temperature, the current ring bandwidth of the compressor is corrected according to the load change state, the current ring bandwidth is enabled to be adaptive to the current running state of the compressor, accurate control of the current ring bandwidth is achieved, running reliability of the compressor is improved, and running effect of the compressor is guaranteed.

title_en: Building temperature regulating system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of energy-saving equipment, in particular to a building temperature regulating system, which comprises an air-conditioning indoor unit, an air-conditioning outdoor unit, a water tank and an atomization mechanism, wherein the air-conditioning outdoor unit is placed in the water tank, the air-conditioning outdoor unit is immersed in water in the water tank so as to increase the temperature difference of condensate in a pipeline when heat is transferred to improve the efficiency of a compressor, and the atomization mechanism is arranged at the lower part of the air-conditioning indoor unit or below the air-conditioning indoor unit so as to atomize water condensed by the indoor air in the air-conditioning indoor unit to reduce the temperature and keep the indoor humidity constant. The invention has the beneficial effects that the water tank is arranged, the heat conduction efficiency is improved, the power consumption of the compressor is reduced, the energy is saved, the atomizing mechanism is arranged, the water condensed by the air conditioner is atomized into water vapor and returned into the air, the humidity of the indoor air is kept constant, the problem of drying the indoor air caused by using the air conditioner is avoided, and the pipeline for arranging condensed water to flow away is also omitted.

title_en: High-flow heat pump scraper evaporator
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of heat pump evaporators and discloses a high-flow heat pump scraper evaporator which comprises a frame, a working part is arranged on the frame and used for providing a stable working space for crystallization precipitation in raw materials, a stirring part is arranged on the frame and the working part and used for uniformly distributing the raw materials and forming a film material flow, a feeding part is arranged at the inner bottom of the frame and used for inputting and outputting the raw materials, a double heat exchange part is arranged on the inner wall of the frame and used for dividing the raw materials and steam into two parts for circulation operation, and an original heating system, a heat exchange system and a cooling system are uniformly divided into two parts for independent control by adopting the double heat exchange part, a regeneration part and a cold row.

title_en: System and method for controlling pressure of parallel-gas side high-pressure bypass of gas turbine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for controlling high-pressure bypass pressure on a gas turbine parallel steam side, wherein the system comprises a non-module, a first switching module, a AND module, a second switching module, a multiplication module, a large selection module, a rate limiting module and a small selection module, and the method comprises the steps that when a No. 2 parallel steam electric valve is fully opened to be 1 and a No. 1 parallel steam electric valve is fully opened to be 1, the output of the first switching module is 0.5, the multiplication calculation is carried out on the output value of the front pressure of the No. 2 high-pressure parallel steam valve, and then a bypass pressure set value is obtained after numerical optimization of the large selection module, the rate limiting module and the small selection module. The invention solves the problems of poor effect and unstable control of various parameters in the initial parallel steam process of the unit start, realizes the stability of pressure and temperature in the unit start operation process, and ensures the safe and efficient operation of the unit.

title_en: Fume exhaust fan
abstract_en: The invention relates to a range hood. The range hood comprises a smoke frame and a plurality of groups of smoke collecting components which are sequentially arranged on the smoke frame, wherein the smoke collecting components comprise a smoke collecting hood, a first rack and a driving piece, the driving piece is arranged on the smoke frame and connected with the smoke collecting hood, the first rack is connected with the driving piece, and the driving piece is used for driving the first rack to move along a first direction or a second direction so as to drive the smoke collecting hood to move. The range hood can reduce energy waste.

title_en: Device and method for preparing ice slurry by utilizing seawater
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ice slurry preparation by using seawater, in particular to a device and a method for preparing ice slurry by using seawater. The device for preparing ice slurry by utilizing seawater comprises a seawater supply system, a refrigerant circulation system, a supercooled water circulation system and an ice slurry conveying system, wherein the seawater supply system is communicated with external seawater and is respectively connected with the refrigerant circulation system, the supercooled water circulation system and the ice slurry conveying system, the seawater supply system is used for providing seawater raw materials and cooling materials, the refrigerant circulation system is used for exchanging heat, and the supercooled water circulation system is used for preparing ice slurry. The invention does not adopt scraping type, has low energy efficiency, provides seawater raw materials for the invention through the seawater supply system, and provides cooling materials for the refrigerant circulation system through the seawater supply system. Therefore, the source of the seawater raw material is rich and almost free, and the condensation temperature can be reduced by using the seawater as a cooling medium, so that the aim of improving the energy efficiency of the system can be achieved.

title_en: Foldable storage type photovoltaic bracket and operation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a foldable storage type photovoltaic bracket and an operation method thereof, which belong to the technical field of photovoltaic brackets and comprise a support base, wherein one end of the support base is connected with a mounting assembly for mounting a photovoltaic panel, the other end of the support base is connected with a support assembly for supporting the mounting assembly, the support assembly is folded and stored on the inner side of the support base after being detached from the mounting assembly, the mounting assembly is folded and stored on the surface of the support base, the mounting assembly comprises an outer support plate and an inner support plate, the outer support plate is movably connected on the support base, the inner support plate is arranged on the inner side of the outer support plate, and the inner support plate is fixed on the outer support plate through a plum blossom handle bolt. The invention solves the problems of large occupied area, difficult collection and inconvenient use of the existing photovoltaic bracket caused by the fact that the existing photovoltaic bracket is not folded for storage. The foldable storage type photovoltaic bracket disclosed by the invention can be folded and stored, so that the occupied area of the photovoltaic bracket is reduced, and the photovoltaic bracket is easy to store and convenient to use.

title_en: Aluminum alloy photovoltaic bracket
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of photovoltaic equipment, and particularly discloses an aluminum alloy photovoltaic support which comprises an inclination angle adjusting seat and a protective frame, wherein the protective frame comprises a main frame body, movable shields and lifting limiting plates, the edges of the left side and the right side of the main frame body are bent upwards to form side protection plates, the front end and the rear end of the main frame body are hinged with the movable shields, the middle of the main frame body is provided with the lifting limiting plates, the movable shields are provided with a first plate surface and a second plate surface which are mutually and vertically connected, the transmission rod comprises a first rod body and a second rod body which forms a preset included angle with the first rod body, a sliding block is arranged at the joint of the first rod body and the second rod body, the lifting limiting plates are provided with sliding grooves, the sliding blocks are arranged in the sliding grooves, compression bars are arranged at the tail ends of the second rod body, and the inclination angle adjusting seat comprises a mounting plate, an inclination angle adjusting mechanism, a main connecting pipe and a base. By adopting the invention, the inclination angle of the photovoltaic panel can be automatically adjusted, the movable part is light and flexible, the photovoltaic panel can be driven by lower power, and the service life is long.

title_en: Intelligent electric heating system utilizing heat supply pipeline to store energy
abstract_en: An intelligent electric heating system utilizing heat supply pipelines to store energy is characterized by comprising an electric heating device (1), an energy storage water pump (2), an energy storage heat supply pipeline (3), an energy storage pipeline thermometer (4), an adjustable water mixing valve (5), a heat supply water pump (6), a radiator (7), a terminal heat supply pipeline (8) and a terminal heat supply pipeline thermometer (9). The electric heating device (1) is provided with an electric heating rod (1-1) and an energy storage and heat supply pipe (1-2), the electric heating rod (1-1) is started to heat energy storage medium water firstly when in low electricity, and the energy storage and heat supply pipe (1-2) is connected with an energy storage water pump (2) and an energy storage and heat supply pipeline (3) to form an energy storage circulation loop so that the energy storage medium water is heated uniformly. The adjustable water mixing valve (5) is provided with a hot water inlet interface (5-1), a cold water inlet interface (5-2) and a warm water outlet interface (5-3), wherein the hot water inlet interface (5-1) is connected with the energy storage heat supply pipeline (3) through a terminal heat supply pipeline (8), the warm water outlet interface (5-3) is sequentially connected with the heat supply water pump (6) and the radiator (7) through the terminal heat supply pipeline (8), and the tail end of the warm water outlet interface is connected to the cold water inlet interface (5-2) to form a terminal heat supply loop, so that heated circulating medium water supplies heat to a room for heating a user room. The radiator (7) is a fin or tube radiating heat into the user's room.

title_en: Heat supply control method and system of heat source tower heat pump unit, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a heat supply control method, a system, electronic equipment and a storage medium of a heat source tower heat pump unit, which comprises the specific steps of dividing a heat transfer and mass transfer control body of a heat source tower into a plurality of control body unit models along the air flow direction; the method comprises the steps of establishing an air side heat mass dynamic model and a solution side heat mass dynamic model which interact with a heat source tower based on a control body unit model, establishing a heat mass balance model of a heat and mass transfer control body of the heat source tower based on the air side heat mass dynamic model and the solution side heat mass dynamic model, establishing a heat transfer balance model of a heat and mass transfer control body of the heat source tower based on working parameters of a heat pump unit of the heat source tower, establishing an objective function which is maximized by heat supply of the heat pump unit of the heat source tower based on the heat mass balance model of the heat and mass transfer control body and the heat transfer balance model of the heat pump unit of the heat source tower, and solving the objective function to obtain a regulation result of the heat pump of the heat source tower and the heat and mass transfer control body of the heat source tower.

title_en: Automatic coal feeding equipment for tunnel kiln
abstract_en: The invention discloses automatic coal feeding equipment for a tunnel kiln, which belongs to the field of fuel feeding equipment for the tunnel kiln and comprises a kiln body, a movable frame, a coal feeding port, a coal feeding cover, a coal storage tank and a trolley, wherein the coal storage tank comprises a feed hopper, an electric control valve, a lifting pipe group, a main tank body and a screw conveyor, the lifting pipe group comprises an electric control telescopic rod, an inner pipe, a cover opening ejector rod and an outer pipe, the coal feeding cover comprises a receiving pipe, a control connecting rod, a shaft seat, a cover plate, a middle stop lever, a receiving hopper, an elastic piece and a control notch, the cover plate of the coal feeding cover is opened in a pressing manner by the cover opening ejector rod after the outer pipe is lowered, a lowering pipeline and the cover opening are realized together during coal feeding, the coal feeding cover can be automatically closed under the action of the elastic piece when the cover is separated from the range of the coal feeding cover, the equipment can travel to the position of the coal feeding port from any direction, the use of the quick coal feeding is facilitated, the elastic piece and the control connecting rod adopt an external structure, and the elastic piece and the maintenance of the cover opening is facilitated.

title_en: Plate-fin heat exchanger, method for manufacturing a plate-fin heat exchanger, and method for using a plate-fin heat exchanger
abstract_en: A plate-fin heat exchanger (100) with a heat exchanger block (10) is proposed, wherein heat exchanger passages (1) are arranged in the heat exchanger block (10), each having a distribution and collection structure (2) and one or more central structured sheets (3) arranged between the distribution and collection structures (2), wherein separation structures (41, 42) are arranged between the heat exchanger passages (1), and said heat exchanger block (10) is covered on a first side (U) and a second side (L) by covering structures (51, 52). It is provided here that at least one of the separating structures (41, 42) and/or at least one of the covering structures (51, 52) is designed as a leak detection structure (11) having a cavity (43) formed in the leak detection structure (11) in such a way that the width of the cavity (43) in the direction parallel to the first material layer (41 a) of the leak detection structure (11) and in the direction of the second side (L) is delimited by a second material layer (42 a), wherein in the area of the leak detection structure (11) not occupied by the cavity (43) the first material layer (41 a) and the second material layer (42 a) are connected to each other, the width of the cavity (43) in the direction parallel to the first material layer (41 a) and the second material layer (42 a) is smaller than the width of the central structured sheet (3) of the heat exchanger passage in the direction, and that a measuring device (45,46,50) is provided, which is designed as a rupture variable of the measuring device or a wall of the measuring device (43) is arranged in connection with the cavity (43). The invention also relates to a method for manufacturing a corresponding plate-fin heat exchanger (100) and to a method for using a plate-fin heat exchanger (100) of this type.

title_en: Hydrogen pulverized coal gasification combustion device and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a hydrogen coal powder gasification combustion device and a method, which relate to the technical field of power generation, the hydrogen burner is used as a stable torch with high rigidity and high temperature, the flame temperature is up to 1400-1500 ℃, coal powder in a coal powder combustion cylinder is contacted with hydrogen flame, coal powder particles are quickly heated and released to volatilize, the coal powder particles are broken and crushed, the coal powder particles are quickly ignited in the coal powder combustion cylinder, after preliminary combustion, coal powder air flow enters a gasification chamber with air flow provided by an air cylinder, the coal powder generates combustible gases such as carbon monoxide, hydrogen and the like and activated semicoke under a high-temperature anoxic environment, and then the activated semicoke is sprayed into a hearth to form a gas-like combustion torch, so that the purposes of ignition start and low-load stable combustion of a coal powder boiler are achieved.

title_en: Self-cleaning method of multi-split air conditioner and multi-split air conditioner system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-cleaning method and a self-cleaning system of a multi-split air conditioner, which relate to the technical field of air conditioners, wherein the multi-split air conditioner comprises an air conditioner external unit and a plurality of air conditioner internal units; when the air conditioner indoor units refrigerate, the outlet pipe temperature of the heat exchanger of each air conditioner indoor unit is obtained, the highest temperature value in the outlet pipe temperatures of the heat exchangers is used as a first target temperature, the running frequency of the compressor of the air conditioner outdoor unit and the running rotating speed of the fans of each air conditioner indoor unit are regulated so as to enable the air conditioner indoor units to continuously frost and increase the frosting quantity, the air conditioner indoor units heat according to heating instructions so as to enable the air conditioner indoor units to defrost, and when the defrosting of the air conditioner indoor units is completed, the air conditioner indoor units continuously heat according to the heating instructions so as to enable the temperature of the air conditioner indoor units to reach the target sterilization temperature, thereby high-temperature sterilization is carried out on the air conditioner indoor units.

title_en: Control method, control device, control system and air conditioner of compressor
abstract_en: The invention provides a control method, a control device, a control system and an air conditioner of a compressor, by dynamically adjusting a target voltage interval of a bus of the air conditioner compressor, the low-pressure protection value and the high-pressure protection value are determined in real time by combining the ambient temperature, so that the self-adaptive optimization of the compressor protection strategy is realized. By detecting whether the bus voltage is in the target voltage interval or not, a differential protection operation strategy is implemented, the frequency operation of the compressor is timely reduced when the voltage fluctuates, and the problem of over protection or insufficient response caused by a fixed voltage threshold in the protection strategy in the related art is avoided. The invention not only improves the running stability and efficiency of the compressor under different environment temperature and voltage fluctuation conditions, but also effectively prolongs the service life of the equipment and obviously enhances the safety and reliability of the system.

title_en: Automatic folding smelting furnace mouth heat preservation apron and smelting furnace
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of smelting furnace heat preservation, and provides an automatic folding smelting furnace mouth heat preservation cover plate and a smelting furnace, wherein the automatic folding smelting furnace mouth heat preservation cover plate comprises a front cover, a rear cover and a driving assembly, and the front cover is hinged with the rear cover; the top of furnace body is equipped with two parallel arrangement's fixing base, the back lid is kept away from the one end of protecgulum is rotated through the tilting shaft and is set up on the fixing base, drive assembly includes gear wheel, pinion, connecting rod and power supply, gear wheel rotates and sets up on the fixing base, the pinion is fixed on the tilting shaft, gear wheel and pinion meshing, the power supply drive gear wheel rotates, the one end of connecting rod articulates on the protecgulum, the other end articulates on the fixing base, the connecting rod be in hinge point on the fixing base be located with the pinion interval sets up. The automatic folding heat-insulating cover plate for the smelting furnace mouth has the advantages of small occupied space and strong environment application capability.

title_en: Novel high-efficiency dust collection cover of graphitizing furnace
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of graphite processing, and discloses a novel efficient dust collection cover of a graphitizing furnace, which comprises a main body mechanism, a collecting mechanism and a purifying mechanism, wherein the collecting mechanism is positioned in the main body mechanism, the purifying mechanism is positioned on the right side of the collecting mechanism, the main body mechanism comprises a cover body, an air inlet pipe and a movable door, the air inlet pipe is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the cover body, and the movable door is movably arranged at the front end of the cover body. This novel high-efficient dust collecting cover of graphitization stove through the installation to main part mechanism, has realized that motor drive shake pole can drive filter and filtration sack and shake, can shake the dust of filtering off down, is convenient for collect the dust, can avoid live time overlength filter and filtration sack to be blocked by the dust simultaneously and lead to unable filterable problem, this simple structure is effective, easily production, can reduce the maintenance cost of user, has improved the dust collecting effect of graphitization stove novel high-efficient dust collecting cover.

title_en: Control method and device of integrated kitchen range, integrated kitchen range and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a control method and device of an integrated cooker, the integrated cooker and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence. The method comprises the steps of detecting a first temperature value in a steaming and baking box in a current task period, determining a current rotating speed value of a variable frequency fan and a switching state of a fixed frequency fan in the current task period according to the first temperature value and a temperature change rate between the first temperature value and a second temperature value detected in a previous task period, adjusting the variable frequency fan based on the current rotating speed value, and controlling the fixed frequency fan based on the switching state so that the temperature of the steaming and baking box reaches a target temperature value. According to the technical scheme provided by the application, the heat radiation fan of the integrated oven is intelligently controlled according to the temperature in the oven and the temperature change rate, so that the heating rate of the oven is improved, and meanwhile, the heat radiation efficiency of the oven is ensured, thereby improving the experience of a user in using the integrated oven.

title_en: Air conditioner energy-saving control method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of electric appliances, and particularly relates to an energy-saving control method, device, equipment and storage medium for an air conditioner, wherein the energy-saving control method for the air conditioner is realized by acquiring the indoor environment temperature of the air conditioner; and if so, acquiring a first difference value, and adjusting the operating frequency of the compressor according to the first difference value, wherein the first difference value is an absolute value of the difference between the indoor environment temperature and the set temperature, so that the energy-saving control of the air conditioner can be started in time at a proper time, the operating frequency is accurately controlled according to the current indoor temperature condition, and the purposes of energy conservation and emission reduction are achieved on the premise of ensuring user experience.

title_en: Method and device for controlling compressor of heat exchange equipment and heat exchange equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of intelligent household appliances, and discloses a method for controlling a compressor of heat exchange equipment. The heat exchange device comprises a variable frequency rectifying circuit and a compressor, wherein the variable frequency rectifying circuit comprises a rectifying bridge and an electrolytic capacitor arranged at the output of the rectifying bridge, the electrolytic capacitor is connected with the compressor in parallel, the method comprises the steps of obtaining capacitance voltage values of two ends of the electrolytic capacitor in the variable frequency rectifying circuit, determining target instruction speed according to the capacitance voltage values, determining target operating frequency of the compressor according to the target instruction speed, and controlling the compressor to operate according to the target operating frequency. According to the method, the command speed is timely adjusted according to the change trend of the capacitor voltage at the two ends of the electrolytic capacitor, so that the command speed reaches the target command speed, the operating frequency of the compressor reaches the target operating frequency, and the refrigerating effect of the heat exchange equipment is improved. The application also discloses a device for controlling the compressor of the heat exchange equipment and the heat exchange equipment.

title_en: Manufacturing process for kitchen special liquid fuel and liquid fuel thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a manufacturing process of liquid fuel special for a kitchen and liquid fuel thereof, which relate to the technical field of liquid fuel manufacturing, and comprise the steps of S1, a fuel conveying process, starting a conversion motor, opening a corresponding feed valve, electrifying a feed electromagnetic ring, quantitatively feeding the liquid fuel into a distillation tank, S2, an evaporation detection process, closing a feed valve at the top, starting an evaporation electromagnetic ring, starting an annular electric plate, starting a water delivery pump, opening a water delivery valve connected with a cold delivery pipe, enabling condensed liquid beads to flow into a condensation tank, and starting a stirring motor.

title_en: System and method for enabling transfer of energy from a vehicle
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides "systems and methods for enabling transfer of energy from a vehicle". A vehicle configured to provide energy to a building is disclosed. The vehicle may include a transceiver configured to receive a setpoint temperature associated with the building, historical building load consumption information, and current building load consumption information. The vehicle may further include a processor configured to obtain a trigger signal and, in response to obtaining the trigger signal, transmit a command signal for causing activation of a building component to the set point temperature. The processor may also compare the current building load consumption information with the historical building load consumption information in response to activating the building component and determine a building component load curve based on the comparison and the setpoint temperature. The processor may then control building component operation based on the building component load profile.

title_en: Control method, device, medium and system of air conditioner
abstract_en: The application provides a control method, a device, a medium and a system of an air conditioner. According to the method, the current operation stage of the air conditioner is determined according to the current inner ring temperature and the target set temperature, and the air outlet mode, the upper fan rotating speed and the lower fan rotating speed of the air conditioner are regulated at least according to the current operation stage, so that the air conditioner has a comfortable air supply control scheme facing the human thermal stimulation demands of different environment temperatures, the aim of automatically controlling the optimal air outlet mode in real time in all time is fulfilled, the air outlet control of the upper and lower air outlet cabinet machines is not single any more, the user experience is improved, and the problem that the optimal air outlet mode cannot be automatically controlled in real time in all time due to the fact that the air outlet control method of the upper and lower air outlet cabinet machines is single in the existing scheme is solved, and the problem that the user experience is poor is caused.

title_en: Recycling system for industrial waste heat
abstract_en: The application discloses a recycling system for industrial waste heat, which relates to the technical field of heat exchange and comprises an upper heat exchanger, a lower heat exchanger, a mounting frame, a heat exchange tube group, a flow baffle plate group and a plate group adjusting mechanism; according to the application, the upper heat exchanger and the lower heat exchanger are arranged on the mounting frame, the industrial waste heat fluid flows from the upper heat exchanger to the lower heat exchanger, and the water flow flows from the lower heat exchanger to the upper heat exchanger, so that the secondary heat exchange treatment of the industrial waste heat fluid is realized, the low-temperature waste heat section of the industrial waste heat fluid can preheat newly-fed cold water first, the high Wen Duanze of the industrial waste heat fluid exchanges heat with the preheated water, and the continuous heat exchange efficiency of the heat exchanger is effectively improved. Meanwhile, the plate group adjusting mechanism is arranged in the heat exchanger to respectively drive the upper baffle plate and the lower baffle plate to move on the heat exchange tube group to adjust the distance between the baffle plate groups, so that the flow rate of the industrial waste heat fluid in the heat exchanger is adjusted, and the continuous heat exchange efficiency of the heat exchanger is further improved.

title_en: Gas water heater with new structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of gas water heaters, in particular to a gas water heater with a novel structure, which comprises a shell, wherein a combustion chamber is arranged in the shell, a heat exchanger is arranged above the combustion chamber, a water inlet pipe is arranged at the water inlet end of the heat exchanger in a communicated manner, a water outlet pipe is arranged at the water outlet end of the heat exchanger in a communicated manner, a water inlet joint and a water outlet joint are arranged at the lower part of the shell, one end of the water inlet pipe, which is far away from the heat exchanger, extends downwards and is communicated with the water inlet joint, one end of the water outlet pipe, which is far away from the heat exchanger, extends downwards and is communicated with the water outlet joint, and a space is reserved between the water inlet pipe and the water outlet pipe and the outer wall of the combustion chamber. The invention can reduce the problem that corrosion perforation is easy to occur near the welding point between the coil pipe and the combustion chamber of the heat exchanger.

title_en: Intelligent control cabinet for central air conditioner room module and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of control cabinets, and particularly discloses an intelligent control cabinet for a central air conditioner room module and a use method thereof. According to the invention, the rotating rod and the sliding block are matched to facilitate the inserting frame to drive the filter plates to move in the inner frame, so that the filter plates with different thicknesses can be conveniently matched and installed in the inner frame, and meanwhile, the filter plates with different numbers can be matched and installed in the inner frame, so that the suitability of the inner frame for different filter plates is improved, and the quick replacement of the filter plates is ensured.

title_en: Refrigerating system
abstract_en: The refrigerating system comprises an indoor unit, an outdoor unit, a switching valve, a distributor, a first gas-liquid separator, a second gas-liquid separator and a control part, wherein the switching valve is communicated with the first compressor and the second compressor, the distributor is communicated with the switching valve, the first gas-liquid separator and the second gas-liquid separator are respectively arranged in the first compressor and the second compressor, the control part is configured to control the first compressor and the second compressor to operate according to the same operating frequency, and when the operating frequencies of the first compressor and the second compressor are the same, the first gas-liquid separator and the second gas-liquid separator are estimated to be in a non-uniform liquid level state based on the difference of exhaust temperature between the first compressor and the second compressor and the difference of operating currents between the first compressor and the second compressor, and when the non-uniform liquid level state is estimated, the operating frequency of one of the compressors is regulated to be transited from the non-uniform liquid level state to the uniform liquid level state.

title_en: Gangue decarburization and recycling treatment system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal gangue decarburization and recycling treatment, and discloses a coal gangue decarburization and recycling treatment system which comprises a preheating device, a conveying device and a decarburization and ore phase reconstruction device, wherein the decarburization and ore phase reconstruction device is communicated with preheated air, a primary air preheating air outlet of the waste heat recovery device is communicated with the decarburization and ore phase reconstruction device, the decarburization and ore phase reconstruction device comprises a hot air supply system and a rotary kiln body, enthalpy values of coal gangue and air entering the ore phase reconstruction device are improved by means of material and air staged preheating, stable combustion decarburization of low-heat-value coal gangue is facilitated by effectively utilizing waste heat generated by combustion of the coal gangue, and heat transfer and reaction between the coal gangue and the hot air are enhanced by arranging fluidized air in the rotary kiln, so that combustion time is greatly shortened, and coal gangue is fully combusted.

title_en: Closed high-strength photovoltaic support section bar and photovoltaic support
abstract_en: The invention discloses a closed high-strength photovoltaic support profile and a photovoltaic support, which relate to the technical field of photovoltaic supports and comprise an adjusting mechanism, wherein a cleaning mechanism is arranged on one side of the adjusting mechanism and comprises a mounting frame, a first positioning block is fixedly connected to the inner side of the mounting frame, a second positioning block is arranged in the first positioning block through bolts, a photovoltaic plate is fixedly connected to one end of the second positioning block, sliding grooves are formed in two ends of the mounting frame.

title_en: Cooling system of irradiation test loop
abstract_en: The invention provides an irradiation test loop cooling system which comprises a reactor pool and a circulating flow path, wherein an irradiation test piece is arranged in the reactor pool, a main circulating pump, at least one regeneration heat exchanger and at least one non-regeneration heat exchanger are arranged on the circulating flow path, the outlet end of the main circulating pump is connected with the irradiation test piece, the non-regeneration heat exchanger is arranged in the reactor pool, a coolant sequentially flows through the regeneration heat exchanger to the non-regeneration heat exchanger under the driving of the main circulating pump, and the coolant cooled by the non-regeneration heat exchanger is used as a secondary side coolant to exchange heat with the regeneration heat exchanger and then returns to the irradiation test piece. According to the irradiation test loop cooling system, the system can transfer heat generated by the irradiation test device to the water tank without arranging a huge and complex irradiation loop two-loop and three-loop cooling system, so that the running condition of the system is met.

title_en: Preparation method of sound-insulating noise-reducing sponge and application of sound-insulating noise-reducing sponge in air conditioner
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of polyvinyl alcohol sponge, and discloses a preparation method of sound-insulating noise-reducing sponge and application thereof in an air conditioner. The polyvinyl alcohol is used as a sponge matrix, the grafted cellulose nano microcrystal is used as a reinforcing agent, and the foamed sponge material has higher tensile strength and sound absorption coefficient, good mechanical property and strong sound absorption, sound insulation and noise reduction performances. The polyepoxy quaternary ammonium salt cross-linking agent contains a large number of quaternary ammonium salt groups and is chemically cross-linked into the polyvinyl alcohol sponge matrix, so that the antibacterial and mildew-proof properties of the sponge material are obviously improved.

title_en: Solar power generation and power distribution integrated device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of solar power generation and distribution devices, and discloses a solar power generation and distribution integrated device which comprises a mounting frame, wherein the mounting frame is provided with a plurality of mounting grooves; the solar panel is installed on the installation frame through the connecting frame installed on the installation frame and the rotating rings on two sides of the connecting frame, the installation of the solar panel is facilitated through the installation frame, the solar panel is directly installed on the power distribution integrated device, the solar panel is more convenient to use, one end of the protection piece is pulled out and wound around the solar panel for one circle when the solar panel is transported, one end of the protection piece is fixedly installed on the protection frame, the supporting rods are rotated and stretched out, the supporting rods are fixed, the protection piece is supported from four corners inside the protection piece, and the protection of the solar panel is facilitated when the solar panel is transported.

title_en: For CO2Front-injection separation system of refrigerating unit
abstract_en: The invention relates to a separation system for leading injection of a CO  2  refrigerating unit, which relates to the technical field of separators and comprises a medium-temperature compressor, an oil separator, an air cooler, a heat exchanger, a separator, a pressure regulating valve, an injector, a flash tank, a low-temperature evaporator, a medium-temperature evaporator and a low-temperature compressor, wherein the separator comprises a separator cylinder, the outer wall of the separator cylinder is provided with a refrigerant inlet, an impact plate is arranged in the separator cylinder corresponding to the refrigerant inlet, an upper-layer guide plate is arranged above the impact plate, a gas refrigerant outlet is arranged above the separator cylinder, a lower-layer guide plate is arranged below the impact plate, and a liquid refrigerant outlet is arranged below the lower-layer guide plate. The separator arranged in front of the ejector can separate the gas from the liquid in the high-pressure section on the premise of not losing any system energy efficiency, so that the refrigerant entering the high-pressure gas inlet of the ejector is in a gaseous state, the efficiency of the ejector is ensured, and the energy efficiency of the system is ensured.

title_en: Power generation shelter of field operation power supply vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power generation shelter of a field operation power supply vehicle, which comprises a shelter body, a folding turnover mechanism, a solar power generation module and a solar power generation module, wherein the shelter body is provided with a side opening, the folding turnover mechanism comprises a telescopic component, a first turnover plate and a second turnover plate, the first turnover plate and the second turnover plate are hinged through a hinge component, the telescopic component is hinged in the shelter body, the other end of the telescopic component is hinged with the first turnover plate, the first turnover plate rotates relative to the top of the shelter body under the driving of the telescopic component, the first turnover plate and the second turnover plate are provided with a first state and a second state which are mutually overlapped under the driving of the telescopic component, the first turnover plate and the second turnover plate are positioned in the side opening, and the solar power generation module is arranged on the first turnover plate and/or the second turnover plate. When the first overturning plate and the second overturning plate are flattened, the light receiving area of the solar power generation module is the area of the first overturning plate and/or the second overturning plate, so that the outer side area of the cabin body can be fully utilized, and the total solar power generation efficiency is improved.

title_en: Energy supply system for polyester production
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of nitrogen purification or separation, and particularly discloses a polyester production energy supply system which comprises a nitrogen supply unit and a steam supply unit, wherein the nitrogen supply unit comprises an air compressor, an air purifier, an air dryer, an adsorption type nitrogen generator, a nitrogen tank and nitrogen equipment which are sequentially communicated, the steam supply unit comprises a heating boiler, a waste heat boiler, heat equipment and steam equipment, a flue gas pipeline is communicated between the heating boiler and the waste heat boiler, a circulating pipeline is communicated between the heating boiler and the heat equipment, a steam pipeline is communicated between the waste heat boiler and the steam equipment, an exhaust gas tank is communicated with the adsorption type nitrogen generator, a recycling exhaust gas pipe is communicated between the exhaust gas tank and the air purifier, and a combustion supporting exhaust pipe is communicated between the exhaust gas tank and the heating boiler. The technical scheme provided by the invention can solve the technical problems that the nitrogen-making waste gas is directly emptied by the nitrogen supply system in the prior art, the utilization rate of nitrogen is reduced, and energy waste is caused, and the quality of polyester products can be ensured.

title_en: Device and method for descaling circulating water outside closed cooling tower
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of cooling water treatment, and particularly relates to an external circulating water descaling device and method for a closed cooling tower. The invention comprises a tower body, a driving mechanism, an adjusting mechanism, a limiting mechanism and a sewage draining mechanism, wherein the central position of the bottom of the tower body is provided with a sewage draining outlet, the sewage draining outlet is connected with a sewage draining pipe, the upper end of the driving mechanism is fixedly connected to the top surface outside the tower body, the lower end of the driving mechanism extends into the tower body and is rotatably connected to the sewage draining outlet at the bottom of the tower body, the adjusting mechanism is connected to the upper part of the driving mechanism, the limiting mechanism is connected between the top surface inside the tower body and the adjusting mechanism, and the sewage draining mechanism is connected to the sewage draining outlet at the lower bottom surface of the tower body and is sleeved at the lower end of the driving mechanism. The invention has good cleaning effect, the scraped dirt can be discharged from the blow-down pipe, the cooling tower is not required to be disassembled, and the time and the labor are saved. The invention can strike the inner wall of the tower body while scraping dirt by the scraper, thereby effectively improving the cleaning effect and finally realizing the purpose of automatic descaling.

title_en: Tubular air conditioner heat exchanger
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tubular air conditioner heat exchanger which comprises a refrigerant box, wherein a heat exchange tube is arranged on the inner side of the refrigerant box, an inner cavity of the refrigerant box is connected with two ends of the heat exchange tube to form a passage, a sleeve hole sleeved on the surface of the heat exchange tube is formed in the surface of a fin group, the heat exchange tube comprises a plurality of groups of double-layer composite fins arranged along the surface of the sleeve hole, each group of composite fins is formed by combining a first pressing sheet and a second pressing sheet, and piezoelectric vibration assemblies are arranged at two ends of the fin group and used for cleaning the surface of the fin group through high-frequency vibration. In the invention, the micro fluid channels are integrated by CNC processing on the opposite surfaces of the double-layer fin group, and the heat pipe working medium (such as water, ethanol or acetone) is filled, so that the working medium absorbs heat and is vaporized at one end of the fin close to the heat exchange pipe, flows to the edge or thinner part of the fin, dissipates heat and condenses, and then flows back to the periphery of the heat exchange pipe to form circulation, thereby effectively improving the heat conduction efficiency and the temperature uniformity of the fin by effectively utilizing the heat pipe technology.

title_en: Multi-effect energy-saving rotating wheel dehumidification system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-effect energy-saving rotary wheel dehumidification system which comprises a water-cooling condenser, a first fin type evaporator, a second fin type evaporator, a first fin type condenser, a second fin type condenser, a rotary wheel dehumidifier and a refrigeration compressor, wherein the output end of the water-cooling condenser is respectively communicated and connected with the input end of the first fin type evaporator and the input end of the second fin type evaporator, the output end of the second fin type evaporator is respectively communicated and connected with the input end of the first fin type evaporator and the input end of the refrigeration compressor, the output end of the refrigeration compressor is respectively communicated and connected with the input end of the first fin type condenser and the input end of the second fin type condenser, and the output ends of the first fin type condenser and the second fin type condenser are respectively communicated and connected with the input end of the water-cooling condenser, the input end of the first fin type evaporator and the input end of the second fin type evaporator through second pipelines. The invention can provide a plurality of dehumidification modes, has good energy-saving effect and improves the user experience.

title_en: Super static particulate matter clarifier
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of air purification and discloses a super-static particulate matter purifier which comprises an inner shell, an outer shell movably sleeved outside the inner shell and a base fixed at the bottom end of the outer shell, wherein the inner shell is provided with a purifying cavity and a containing cavity, a filter screen, a static screen and a dust collecting screen are sequentially arranged inside the purifying cavity from right to left, one side of the dust collecting screen, which is far away from the static screen, is provided with a plurality of driving shafts, the outer wall of each driving shaft is fixedly sleeved with a wind wheel rotating inside the purifying cavity, two sides of the inner shell are provided with a first wind port, and two sides of the outer shell are provided with a second wind port corresponding to the first wind port. The invention can carry out repeated adsorption treatment on the particles in the air, thereby purifying the air, enlarging or reducing the size of the air outlet of the air purifier, regulating and controlling the air outlet range and the air outlet position, compressing and solidifying the scraped dust and particles, thereby facilitating the cleaning of the dust and the particles by users, and having high working performance and convenient use.

title_en: Cooking bench with fire extinguishing function
abstract_en: The application relates to a cooking bench with a fire extinguishing function, which comprises a cooking bench body, a detection device and an isolation device, wherein the cooking bench body is used for heating a pot, the detection device and the isolation device are arranged above the cooking bench body, the detection device is used for acquiring morphological characteristics of the cooking bench body and the pot, the isolation device comprises a driving mechanism and an isolation cover, the driving mechanism comprises a mounting piece and a plurality of telescopic brackets, the mounting piece is connected to the isolation cover, one end of each telescopic bracket is connected to the edge of the isolation cover and drives the edge of the isolation cover to be close to the cooking bench body, the other end of each telescopic bracket is movably arranged on the mounting piece so as to limit the geometric form of the isolation cover, the isolation cover defines an isolation space when the isolation cover is in an unfolded state, and the cooking bench body and the pot are positioned in the isolation space, and the cooking bench body and the isolation cover are arranged at intervals. In this embodiment, the cage can dodge pan and top of a kitchen range body, can avoid the cage to push over the pan, avoids the intensity of a fire grow.

title_en: Household gas stove repeated ignition alarm method based on attitude estimation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for repeatedly striking sparks of a household gas cooker based on gesture estimation, wherein the method comprises the steps that a video monitoring device collects image data of a user of the kitchen cooker in real time through a camera, monitoring video data are sent to a local server in real time in a video stream mode through a network cable, the local server processes each frame of image by adopting a VGG network and openpose algorithm to obtain human gesture estimation data, normalization processing and weighting processing are carried out on the human gesture estimation data, a graph model is constructed, space-time graph convolution is carried out, behavior categories are identified, and if the behavior categories are abnormal, an audible-visual alarm circuit is driven to repeatedly strike sparks for alarming. According to the repeated ignition alarming method for the household gas stove, the positions and the directions of limbs in the image are encoded, the body parts are associated with individuals in the image by using part of the affinity fields, and meanwhile, key point detection and association are carried out, so that accurate alarming for observing the stove eyes in a short distance during repeated ignition operation is realized.

title_en: Mounting structure of fire lid seat, combustor and gas-cooker
abstract_en: The invention provides a mounting structure of a fire cover seat, a burner and a gas stove, wherein the mounting structure of the fire cover seat comprises at least two gas injection structures for supplying gas into the fire cover seat, and at least one columnar bulge, and the fire cover seat is arranged on the fuel gas injection structure and the columnar bulge. According to the invention, the fire cover seat is supported by the at least two gas injection structures and the at least one columnar bulge, so that the stable support of the fire cover seat can be realized, meanwhile, the installation structure of the fire cover seat is simplified, the cleaning of a panel below the fire cover seat by a user is facilitated, and the appearance of the burner is more regular and attractive.

title_en: Control method of environment adjustment device, and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control method of an environment adjusting device, the environment adjusting device and a storage medium. The environment regulating equipment comprises a heat pump system and a secondary refrigerant circulating system in heat exchange connection with the heat pump system, wherein the secondary refrigerant circulating system comprises indoor terminal equipment, and the method comprises the steps of acquiring a first state parameter representing the condensation state of an indoor space when the environment regulating equipment is in a shutdown state or a standby state and a dampproof function is started; and when the first state parameter meets the condensation condition, controlling the heating operation of the heat pump system, and controlling the operation of the secondary refrigerant circulation system to convey the heat of the heat pump system to indoor terminal equipment in the indoor space. The invention aims to reduce the risk of indoor damp condensation.

title_en: Casting constant temperature and humidity control method and system based on waste heat recovery of roasting furnace
abstract_en: The invention discloses a casting constant temperature and constant humidity control method and system based on roasting furnace waste heat recovery, and relates to the technical field of waste heat recovery and utilization, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting high-temperature waste gas discharged by a roasting furnace, conveying the high-temperature waste gas to a lithium bromide unit through a high-temperature waste gas conveying pipeline, arranging an electric regulating valve on the high-temperature waste gas conveying pipeline, connecting an outlet end of the electric regulating valve with a bypass channel, and controlling the opening of the electric regulating valve according to the running state of the lithium bromide unit so that the high-temperature waste gas selectively enters the bypass channel or the lithium bromide unit of the lithium bromide unit to perform heat exchange on the high-temperature waste gas; and the chilled water is conveyed to a constant temperature and humidity unit through a circulating water pump so as to control the temperature and humidity of a shell-making drying area. According to the invention, by establishing the exhaust gas selective diversion mechanism, the closed-loop cooling circulation system and the accurate temperature and humidity control system, the high-efficiency utilization of the waste heat of the roasting furnace and the accurate control of the shell manufacturing process environment are realized, and the double effects of energy conservation, emission reduction and process quality control are achieved.

title_en: Boiler operation optimization method, device, equipment, medium and program
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of thermal power generation, in particular to a boiler operation optimization method, a device, equipment, a medium and a program, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining grating fiber Bragg wavelength data of a boiler during peak regulation operation, inputting the grating fiber Bragg wavelength data into a boiler temperature prediction model which is trained in advance, outputting the predicted temperature of the boiler by the boiler temperature prediction model, wherein the boiler temperature prediction model comprises a function relation between wavelength and temperature, determining the predicted temperature of the boiler by utilizing the function relation, wherein the function relation between the wavelength and the temperature is ：P(x)＝a 0 +a 1 x+a 2 x 2 +...+a k x k ;, P (x) is the predicted temperature of the boiler, x is the fiber Bragg wavelength data, a  0 ,a 1 ,a 2 ,...,a k  is a coefficient of a polynomial, k is an order of the polynomial, and optimizing the operation state of the boiler according to the predicted temperature. Therefore, the problems that in the related art, when the coal-fired boiler is in deep peak regulation operation, the temperature change in the boiler is difficult to accurately capture, the stability of the operation of the boiler is influenced due to local overheating and the like are solved.

title_en: Defrosting control method and controller of air conditioning system and air conditioning system
abstract_en: The application discloses a defrosting control method of an air conditioning system, a controller and the air conditioning system, wherein the air conditioning system comprises an outdoor heat exchanger and an indoor heat exchanger, and the outdoor heat exchanger comprises a first heat exchanger and a second heat exchanger; the defrosting control method comprises the steps of enabling the valve assembly to output a part of refrigerant output by the air outlet of the compressor to the first heat exchanger for defrosting when the first heat exchanger and the second heat exchanger are required to be defrosted, enabling the valve assembly to output a part of refrigerant output by the air outlet of the compressor to the second heat exchanger for defrosting after the first heat exchanger is defrosted, enabling the valve assembly to output a part of refrigerant output by the air outlet of the compressor to the first heat exchanger for defrosting after the second heat exchanger is defrosted, and ending defrosting after the first heat exchanger is defrosted. According to the embodiment of the application, defrosting can be performed while indoor heating is performed, and defrosting reliability is ensured.

title_en: High vacuum overlapping condenser
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-vacuum overlapped condenser which comprises a first condenser and a second condenser which are horizontally arranged, wherein the second condenser is arranged right above the first condenser, the first condenser comprises a first shell, the second condenser comprises a second shell, a first gas phase outlet and a second gas phase outlet are arranged at the upper part of the first shell, a first gas phase inlet and a second gas phase inlet are arranged at the lower part of the second shell, the first gas phase outlet is connected with the first gas phase inlet in a sealing way, the second gas phase outlet is connected with the second gas phase inlet in a sealing way, the middle part of the first shell is a shell expansion section, the inner diameter of the shell expansion section is larger than the inner diameters of two side parts of the first shell, the side part of the shell expansion section is provided with a total gas phase inlet, a liquid accumulation bag is arranged below the shell expansion section, and a condensate outlet is arranged at the lower part of the liquid accumulation bag.

title_en: Intelligent ventilation system for building decoration
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of building decoration equipment, and discloses an intelligent ventilation system for building decoration, which comprises a multidimensional acquisition module and an intelligent ventilation module. The intelligent ventilation system for building decoration acquires specification data of all indoor ventilation equipment, air detection data of all indoor areas and user activity data of all indoor areas through the multidimensional acquisition module, and classifies the specification data, the indoor air detection data and the user activity data of all indoor areas into a data set, the intelligent ventilation module analyzes various performance indexes of the ventilation equipment in a ventilation process, is favorable for subsequent rapid judgment of the residual life of a purification filter screen, has good efficient ventilation purification effect, analyzes the change trend of indoor temperature and ventilation noise value of each area and the extreme value of various indexes in the user activity data, judges whether the purification filter screen of the ventilation equipment is abnormal or not, generates corresponding management advice, and has good intelligent management user experience.

title_en: Electric heater safety start-stop regulation control method and system based on diversified analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric heater control, in particular to an electric heater safety start-stop regulation control method and system based on diversified analysis, wherein the system comprises a start-stop control center, a normalized supervision unit, a fault matching unit, a working condition interference unit, a start-stop performance unit, a regulation planning unit and a regulation feedback unit; the method is characterized in that the method is used for primarily analyzing from the normal control angle of the target electric heater to judge whether the target electric heater can normally perform closed-loop control, analyzing from two points of hardware and software based on an information progressive mode to judge the start-stop regulation fault type of the target electric heater, analyzing from the start-stop interference angle to clean a temperature probe or a water tank, and simultaneously carrying out start-stop response performance analysis to reduce the start-stop delay risk of the target electric heater, and carrying out start-stop intelligent regulation planning treatment on the target electric heater based on the start-stop normal state to avoid frequent start-stop damage to elements.

title_en: Carbon trapping system with lean and rich liquid waste heat recovery device
abstract_en: The invention provides a carbon trapping system with a lean and rich liquid waste heat recovery device, which relates to the technical field of carbon trapping systems, and comprises an absorption tower and a regeneration tower, the top of the absorption tower is communicated with the bottom end of the regeneration tower through a first pipeline, the bottom end of the absorption tower is communicated with the top of the regeneration tower through a second pipeline, and heat exchange is carried out between the first pipeline and the second pipeline through a heat exchanger. According to the invention, by additionally arranging the heat pump unit, the link that the barren solution is independently provided with the cooler is omitted, the utilization of heat carried by the barren solution from the bottom of the regeneration tower is increased, the barren solution at the bottom of the regeneration tower is used for heating, the requirement of the system on external energy is reduced, and the utilization rate of energy sources is further improved.

title_en: Clean energy storage regulating system and scheduling method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a clean energy storage regulating system and a scheduling method thereof, which relate to the field of residential electric energy storage and hot water supply, and comprise a supporting module; the photovoltaic panel is movably arranged on the supporting module to switch between a first state and a second state, the cogeneration unit is used for outputting electric energy through the generator, the energy storage device is used for storing the electric energy, the cooling module is used for cooling the photovoltaic panel and the cogeneration unit and comprises a spray head, wherein when the photovoltaic panel is in the first state, the back face faces the cooling module, when the photovoltaic panel is in the second state, the front face faces the cooling module, and the liquid outlet direction of the spray head faces the front face so as to spray cooling liquid to the front face, and the problem that the energy management and optimization ratio selection are insufficient in the existing composite energy system is solved, so that the running efficiency and the stability of the whole energy system are improved to a certain extent.

title_en: Dust prevention control method and device, air conditioner, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dust prevention control method and device, an air conditioner, a storage medium and electronic equipment. The method comprises the steps of obtaining wind baffles corresponding to the rotating speed of a fan after a machine set is started and reset, controlling the filter screen to rotate to the filter screen opening angle corresponding to the wind baffles, controlling the wind baffles to rotate to the wind baffle opening angle corresponding to the wind baffles, calculating single angle adjustment quantity of the filter screen and single angle adjustment quantity of the wind baffles when the wind baffles are detected to change, and sequentially and circularly adjusting the filter screen and the wind baffles according to calculated data and a preset sequence. According to the invention, the opening angle and the angle adjusting speed of the air deflector and the filter screen are controlled, so that on the premise of not increasing the hardware cost and not affecting the normal operation of the air deflector and the filter screen of the air port, dust of the filter screen is effectively prevented from blowing into a room, and the condition that the air deflector and the filter screen blow out dust from the air port at all opening angles is avoided.

title_en: Boiler heat exchanger
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of boiler heat exchangers, in particular to a boiler heat exchanger which comprises a connecting unit, a fixing plate, a mounting assembly and a heat exchange assembly, wherein the mounting assembly is arranged on the right side of the fixing plate, the heat exchange assembly is arranged on the outer side of the mounting assembly and is used for mounting the heat exchange assembly and the fixing plate, and the heat exchange assembly is used for realizing heat exchange and self-cleaning the inside. The self-cleaning device has the beneficial effects that the heat exchange fluid is split and guided through the splitter plate, the turbulence degree is increased, the heat exchange efficiency is improved, meanwhile, the fluid flow is utilized to drive the turbine in the cleaning piece to rotate, and then the cleaning brush and the auxiliary brush are driven to perform real-time self-cleaning on the inner wall of the heat exchange plate, so that the impurity deposition is effectively prevented, the high-efficiency operation of the heat exchanger is maintained, compared with the prior art, the self-cleaning function of the heat exchanger does not need to be stopped for complex manual disassembly and cleaning operation, the maintenance workload and the stop time are reduced, and the maintenance cost is reduced.

title_en: Heating stove
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of boilers, in particular to a heating furnace. The dry distillation type coal storage device comprises a main combustion chamber, a coal outlet, a smoke gathering port, a table top plate, a furnace cover and a smoke exhaust pipe, wherein the bottom of the main combustion chamber is provided with a tearing type furnace bridge, the side part of the main combustion chamber is provided with a dry distillation type coal storage chamber which is matched with a corresponding sealing cover, the lower end of the dry distillation type coal storage chamber is provided with the coal outlet which is matched with the tearing type furnace bridge, the upper part of the main combustion chamber is provided with the smoke gathering port, the table top plate is provided with the furnace cover corresponding to the position of the smoke gathering port, and the table top plate is provided with the smoke exhaust pipe communicated with the smoke gathering port. The invention relates to a heating furnace, an auxiliary combustion chamber is formed at the lower part of a carbonization coal storage chamber, carbonization and back burning gasification are that coal is preheated and carbonized in advance through the auxiliary combustion chamber, smoke-producing substances in the coal are converted into combustible gas in advance to be burnt in a main combustion chamber, the front end and the rear end of the main combustion chamber are provided with secondary air distribution openings, secondary air distribution can be carried out in the furnace when the furnace is subjected to anoxic combustion, so that flame combustion is more sufficient, and the problems of smoke generation and unstable combustion caused by direct coal addition are solved.

title_en: Self-adaptive regulation method and system for ventilation flow of laboratory
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of laboratory ventilation control, and discloses a laboratory ventilation flow self-adaptive regulation method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of combining ventilation nodes according to an environmental parameter distribution diagram to generate a ventilation link; the method comprises the steps of determining an adjusting gradient based on node flow weight, defining and matching flow parameters in a pre-adjusting stage, synchronously collecting environment parameters, grouping the flow parameters according to the environment parameters, extracting two types of flow parameters to generate an adaptive parameter set, monitoring the current environment parameters in real time in an executing stage, determining a target environment parameter, and calling the adaptive parameter set to generate a flow regulation instruction. The system comprises a link generation module, a preset data acquisition module, a parameter adaptation module and a regulation and control execution module. The invention realizes the self-adaptive regulation of the ventilation flow of the laboratory, improves the regulation precision and efficiency of the ventilation system, and ensures the safety and stability of the laboratory environment.

title_en: Flexible compression device and refrigerant cycle circuit having the same and method therefor
abstract_en: The invention relates to a compression device comprising a plurality of single-flow compressors or multi-flow compressors having a plurality of delivery channels, wherein the delivery channels or single-flow compressors are configured such that they can be operated in parallel connection for compressing a refrigerant from a low pressure to a higher pressure, wherein one or more of the delivery channels or single-flow compressors are switchably configured such that they can be operated in a connection setting for compressing a first sub-flow of refrigerant from a medium pressure between a low pressure and a higher pressure to a higher pressure, wherein the remaining delivery channels or single-flow compressors can be operated simultaneously for compressing a second sub-flow of refrigerant from a low pressure to a higher pressure, and the compression device has at least one switching device with one or more switching valves for switching the switchable delivery channel or single-flow compressor. The invention also relates to a refrigerant circuit with an economizer and such a compression device and to a method therefor.

title_en: Nitrogen cooling structure of furnace temperature-equalizing fan
