abstract_en: The invention provides a nitrogen cooling structure of a temperature equalizing fan for a furnace, which comprises a heating furnace, the temperature equalizing fan, a nitrogen inlet main pipeline and a nitrogen outlet main pipeline, wherein the temperature equalizing fan is connected to the top of the heating furnace and is connected with the nitrogen inlet main pipeline, and the temperature equalizing fan is connected with the nitrogen outlet main pipeline.

title_en: Air condensing water taking device
abstract_en: The condensing outer tube, the condensing inner tube and the water delivery main tube are formed by matching nano-scale bovine bone materials and powdery plastic materials, the nano-scale bovine bone materials and the powdery plastic materials respectively account for 28-32 percent and 72-68 percent of the total weight of the materials, and the condensing device can utilize a condensation principle to prepare small molecular group condensed water from vapor in the air, especially can meet the requirements of crop irrigation operation in arid regions, and has the characteristics of high condensing water taking efficiency, no blockage of a crop water delivery passage and good water absorption effect.

title_en: Coal feeder picture peg device of automatic mediation function in area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal feeder flashboard device with an automatic dredging function, which comprises a connecting pipeline connected to a coal feeding pipeline and a flashboard interception device arranged at the position of the connecting pipeline, wherein a bottom pipe is arranged at the bottom of the connecting pipeline, a discharging pipe is obliquely downwards arranged on the side surface of the bottom pipe, a side support is fixed outside the connecting pipeline, a linear sliding table module is arranged through the side support, a dredging device is carried by the linear sliding table module, and the dredging device passes through the flashboard interception device after ascending along the connecting pipeline, so that the device can actively dredge after blocking occurs.

title_en: Air disinfection and purification device for field rescue medical epidemic prevention shelter
abstract_en: The invention provides an air disinfection and purification device for a field rescue medical epidemic prevention shelter, which relates to the technical field of air disinfection and purification devices, and comprises a shell, a protection part, a front filter plate and an air suction part, an adjusting mechanism, a disinfection mechanism, a purification mechanism, a fan, a cleaning part and a transmission part, wherein the protection part, the front filter plate and the air suction part are detachably arranged in the shell, the adjusting mechanism comprises a moving part arranged in the shell, an adjusting part arranged on the moving part, the disinfection mechanism comprises a disinfection part arranged in the shell, a cleaning part and a rotating part arranged in the disinfection part, the purification mechanism comprises a filtering part, the cleaning part, a driving part and the transmission part which are arranged in the shell, the fan is rotated by starting a double-shaft motor, the volatilization effect of chlorine dioxide gel is improved, the cleaning ring is positioned on the outer wall of a disinfection lamp to move up and down by reciprocating a cross rod, the gear drives the toothed ring to rotate in the same direction as the gears, and four racks are mutually close or far away, and the elastic cloth is intermittently in an open and contracted state, so that the center of the front filter plate is periodically blocked.

title_en: Plate heat exchanger
abstract_en: The invention discloses a plate heat exchanger, which comprises a plurality of stacked plates, wherein the plates at least comprise a first plate and a second plate, the first plate and the second plate are stacked at intervals, the first plate is provided with a first plate flat part, a first separation rib and a plurality of first bulges, the first separation rib is bulged relative to the first plate flat part, the first bulge is bulged relative to the first plate flat part, the first plate is provided with at least a first angle hole and a second angle hole, the first angle hole and the second angle hole are positioned at two sides of the first separation rib, and the plate heat exchanger is provided with fins, so that the plate heat exchanger can be suitable for the condition of different fluid properties.

title_en: Multi-modularized synergistic high-temperature graphitizing furnace
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-module synergistic high-temperature graphitizing furnace which comprises an electrode structure, a muffle structure and a heat preservation layer structure which are arranged in a graphitizing furnace chamber, wherein the muffle structure comprises a plurality of Ma Fuqiang bodies, the plurality of Ma Fuqiang bodies are arranged in the graphitizing furnace chamber through muffle supporting columns, gaps are reserved between adjacent Ma Fuqiang bodies, a limiting block is arranged at the bottom of at least 1 muffle cavity at intervals and is arranged on the muffle supporting columns, the limiting block is clamped between two adjacent muffle cavities, the electrode structure comprises a heating pipe and an electrode block, the electrode block is arranged at the top of the heating pipe and provides heating energy for the heating pipe, heating pipes are arranged on the upper part and the lower part of the Ma Fuqiang bodies, a graphite sheath, an insulating sheath, a heating supporting sleeve and a soft felt gasket are sleeved at the end part of the heating pipe in sequence, and a channel I is formed between the graphite sheath and the heating pipe. The invention can make the high temperature graphitization furnace stably run for a long time.

title_en: Multi-flow plate heat exchanger
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of heat exchangers, and discloses a multi-flow plate type heat exchanger which comprises a fixed plate, a movable plate, a plurality of heat exchange plates and a steering assembly, wherein a first inlet and a second outlet are formed in the fixed plate, a first outlet and a second inlet are formed in the movable plate, at least two groups of heat exchange plates are arranged, angle holes are formed in the corners of the heat exchange plates so as to enable first fluid channels or second fluid channels to be formed between the heat exchange plates, the steering assembly is arranged between two adjacent groups of heat exchange plates, the steering assembly comprises a first steering plate, a second steering plate and a third steering plate which are sequentially arranged, a first channel hole is formed in the first steering plate, a second channel hole is formed in the second steering plate, a third channel hole is formed in the third steering plate, and the first channel hole, the second channel hole and the third channel hole are respectively communicated with the first fluid channels or the second fluid channels. Therefore, the heat exchange efficiency and the structure utilization rate of the multi-flow plate heat exchanger can be improved.

title_en: Thermal management integrated device
abstract_en: The application provides a thermal management integrated device, which comprises a fluid management piece, wherein the fluid management piece comprises a runner part, the runner part is provided with a heat insulation groove, and at least two runner cavities, the heat insulation groove is positioned between two adjacent runner cavities, and the heat insulation groove penetrates through the runner part along the length direction of the runner part. The fluid management piece of the heat management integrated device provided by the application is provided with the heat insulation groove and at least two runner cavities, the heat insulation groove is positioned between two adjacent runner cavities, and the heat insulation groove is used for insulating the two adjacent runner cavities, so that the heat transfer from a high temperature side to a low temperature side can be reduced, and the heat leakage between the runner cavities is reduced.

title_en: Energy-saving optimization control method for evaporative cooling air conditioner based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of energy-saving control of air conditioners, in particular to an energy-saving optimization control method of an evaporative cooling air conditioner based on deep reinforcement learning, which comprises the steps of calculating a heat load rising index according to the change trend and the change amplitude of the ambient temperature in a local period of each moment in the operation process of the evaporative cooling air conditioner; obtaining energy consumption peak value synchronous indexes according to the similarity degree of peak value fluctuation in fan, water pump and evaporator power in local time intervals of each moment, calculating environment complexity according to the difference condition of heat load rising indexes and energy consumption peak value synchronous indexes of each moment, setting a reward function in a deep reinforcement learning algorithm by integrating the environment temperature and the environment complexity of each moment, and optimally controlling the fan power of an evaporative cooling air conditioner by using the deep reinforcement learning algorithm according to the environment temperature, the water pump and the power of the evaporator at the current moment. The application can improve the accuracy of controlling the air conditioning energy by using the deep reinforcement learning algorithm.

title_en: Cement rotary kiln
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of rotary kilns and discloses a cement rotary kiln, which comprises a rotary kiln main body, a kiln door and a firing port, wherein the kiln door is arranged above the front surface of the rotary kiln main body, a handle is arranged on the kiln door, a heating chamber is arranged above the inside of the rotary kiln main body, the firing port is arranged below the left side surface of the rotary kiln main body, an air extraction structure is arranged on the right side surface of the rotary kiln main body near the lower edge, under the action of a driving structure, a switching sleeve of a changed filter element can be switched into a corresponding switching tube, then the switching sleeve of the filter element is required to be changed from the switching position of another switching tube, the filter element can be changed, and meanwhile, the corresponding switching tube can be automatically opened and plugged, so that when the filter element is changed, the normal operation of the processing operation can be ensured, meanwhile, the loss of hot air flow can be reduced, dust in the air can be prevented from entering the kiln, and the processing quality can be improved.

title_en: Integrated compressor and heat pump system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of heat pumps, and discloses an integrated compressor and a heat pump system. The integrated compressor comprises a double-layer box body, a compressor body and a heat exchange tube, wherein the double-layer box body comprises an inner box body and an outer box body, the inner box body is arranged in the outer box body, an interlayer space is reserved between the inner box body and the outer box body, the compressor body is arranged in the inner box body, an air inlet of the compressor body is communicated with an external evaporator, the heat exchange tube is arranged in the interlayer space, one end of the heat exchange tube is communicated with an air outlet of the compressor body, the other end of the heat exchange tube penetrates through the outer box body and is communicated with the external evaporator, heat exchange medium is filled in the interlayer space, is in heat exchange connection with the heat exchange tube, and can supply heat to the external heat system. The integrated compressor can improve the energy efficiency of the compressor body, saves the installation space, does not need to be additionally provided with a condenser, shortens the flow path length of the thermal cycle and the pressure drop of the flow process, and reduces the production cost and the operation noise.

title_en: Microchannel plate exchange
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of heat exchangers, and relates to a microchannel plate exchanger. The invention comprises a heat exchanger shell, wherein two ends of the heat exchanger shell are provided with a cover cap and a pipeline connecting piece, an alternating double-flow-channel heat exchange structure is arranged in the heat exchanger shell, and an end part alignment fixing piece for fixing the alternating double-flow-channel heat exchange structure is arranged between the cover cap and the heat exchanger shell. The invention breaks through the traditional single-layer plate stacking mode, adopts a double-layer micro-channel structure (flat tube staggered or tube fin combination) with alternating inner and outer flow channels, realizes the maximization of heat exchange area and the compactification of the structure through geometric layout optimization, replaces the traditional stainless steel flow channels with aluminum alloy materials, improves the heat conduction efficiency while reducing the weight, and reduces the energy consumption.

title_en: Energy-saving double-furnace vacuum sintering furnace for quartz waste liquid bottle for semiconductor
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of semiconductor processing, and discloses an energy-saving double-furnace vacuum sintering furnace for a quartz waste liquid bottle for a semiconductor, which comprises a nested structure of a heat preservation drying furnace and a high-temperature sintering furnace, wherein a rotary drying frame is arranged between the heat preservation drying furnace and the high-temperature sintering furnace, a furnace door is controlled to open and close respectively through a guide rail driving mechanism, a ceramic fiber heat preservation layer is covered outside the heat preservation drying furnace, the high-temperature sintering furnace adopts a molybdenum alloy lining, a vacuum pump is used for realizing high vacuum, the furnace door adopts perfluoroether rubber triple sealing, the rotary drying frame and the sintering frame are respectively provided with a quartz boat, a screw guide rail driving mechanism is used for ensuring high-precision positioning, and when the two furnaces are operated cooperatively, firstly, the waste liquid bottle is dried and preheated in the heat preservation drying furnace, and then transferred to the high-temperature sintering furnace for sintering, so that the energy consumption of vacuum interlayer heat insulation is reduced, the impurity volatilization rate is improved, and the high-efficiency energy-saving recovery of the quartz waste liquid bottle is effectively realized.

title_en: System and method for operating a compressor of an HVAC & R system
abstract_en: A heating, ventilation, air conditioning and/or refrigeration (HVAC & R) system includes a compressor having an impeller configured to rotate to pressurize a working fluid and direct the pressurized working fluid through a diffuser passage of the compressor, and an adjustable vane assembly. The adjustable vane assembly includes a vane configured to extend into the diffuser channel and direct the flow of the pressurized working fluid through the diffuser channel, and the adjustable vane assembly is actuatable to adjust a position of the vane within the diffuser channel.

title_en: Cooling tower special for auxiliary cooling of rubber high-temperature continuous plasticizing machine
abstract_en: A cooling tower special for auxiliary cooling of a rubber high-temperature continuous plasticizing machine. The water cooling isolating layer 9 is directly connected with the cooling section in a spiral way, cold water enters from the water inlet 12, and water 10 after heat exchange flows out from the water outlet 11 and enters the outdoor cooling tower. The cooling section spiral is directly connected with the cooling tower 1, the cooling tower 1 is provided with a heat conducting fin 6 and other heat conductors 5, the cooling tower 1 and the cooling section form a closed space, only heat exchange with the outside is realized, the upper part is provided with an umbrella edge 7, the lower part of the umbrella edge 7 is provided with an annular water pipe 2, and the lower part of the annular water pipe 2 is provided with a plurality of atomizing nozzles 3. When the temperature sensor 13 detects that the temperature of the discharging position of the cooling section is higher than 50 ℃, an electric signal is sent to the control system, the control system controls the power system to supply water to the water inlet 4, and then the water is atomized and sprayed out from the atomizing nozzle 3, and the temperature is further reduced. The invention further strengthens the cooling effect under the condition of no pollution, so that the cooling problem of the high-yield and high-efficiency rubber plasticizing system is solved.

title_en: Novel combustor system for improving low-load stable combustion threshold of coal-fired boiler and control method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power generation, and discloses a novel combustor system for improving a low-load stable combustion threshold of a coal-fired boiler and a control method thereof. The method adopts the main burner and the stable combustion burner to form the stable combustion burner layer, and when the boiler runs under low load, the running load of a single main burner in the layer is improved by stopping the main burner without the stable combustion burner, thereby achieving the purpose of improving the low load stable combustion threshold of the coal-fired boiler.

title_en: Smell adjustment and recommendation system based on intelligent internet of things
abstract_en: The application provides an intelligent internet-of-things-based odor adjusting and recommending system, and relates to the technical field of odor adjustment. The intelligent equipment is connected with the intelligent equipment through Bluetooth or MQTT protocols, parameters such as air quantity, concentration and the like of the remote control equipment are supported, a user can quickly start an atomization scheme recommended, customized or collected by the system to meet the odor adjustment requirements under various scenes, the user can freely match with various odor elements, flexibly configure atomization parameters (such as concentration and air quantity) by combining schemes of system recommendation, AI question-answer recommendation or community sharing, personalized odor experience is realized, and a community module supports the user to release use experience, associate the atomization scheme and commodities to form experience sharing and recommendation closed loops among users.

title_en: Thermal management system and vehicle
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of vehicles, in particular to a thermal management system and a vehicle, comprising a passage, a heat exchange system and a heat exchange system, wherein the passage can circulate refrigerant; the heat exchanger comprises a heat source mechanism capable of exchanging heat with a refrigerant, a compression mechanism capable of compressing the refrigerant, a heat exchange mechanism capable of exchanging heat with the refrigerant, and a control mechanism, wherein the compression mechanism is arranged on the passage, the heat exchange mechanism is arranged on the passage, and the control mechanism is arranged on the passage and can control the heat exchange mechanism to switch between a heat dissipation mode and a heat absorption mode. According to the application, based on the cooperation of the control mechanism and the heat exchange mechanism, different heat exchange requirements of the heat exchange mechanism can be met, and the adaptability to complex temperature requirements is improved.

title_en: Automatic stereoscopic warehouse for raw materials for bed processing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a raw material automatic stereoscopic warehouse for bed processing, and relates to the technical field of wood storage. The automatic stereoscopic warehouse for the raw materials for the bed processing comprises a warehouse main body, an air inlet pipeline and an air outlet pipeline, wherein a conveyor for conveying wood is arranged in the warehouse main body, the air inlet pipeline and the air outlet pipeline are respectively assembled on two sides of the warehouse main body, a first rotating rod is rotatably connected to the inner wall of the warehouse main body, and a wind wheel is assembled on the top of the first rotating rod. This automatic stereoscopic warehouse of raw and other materials for bed processing starts the air pump, lets in dry air in to the warehouse main part from the admission line to discharge comparatively moist air through exhaust duct, cooperation dwang first, wind wheel, bevel gear first, torsional spring pole first, bevel gear second, sprocket first, chain, dwang second and sprocket second, make the reciprocal rotation of horizontal guide plate, with dry air water conservancy diversion to each position in the warehouse main part, improved the ventilation efficiency of device.

title_en: Tunneling working face management and control method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a tunneling working face management and control method, a device and electronic equipment, which comprise the steps of obtaining wind speed alarm analysis data, wind speed early warning analysis data, a dynamic wind volume interval value of a tunneling working face, real-time wind volume of the tunneling working face, real-time wind speed of the tunneling working face and a tunneling roadway cross section, generating a local ventilator target control instruction, a wind window adjusting control instruction and a main ventilator control instruction, calculating a wind volume adjusting target value, and carrying out wind flow management and control on the target tunneling working face based on the local ventilator target control instruction, the wind window adjusting control instruction, the main ventilator control instruction and the wind volume adjusting target value. And selecting one or more control instructions from the local ventilator target control instructions, the air window adjusting control instructions and the main ventilator control instructions according to the air quantity adjusting target value to perform airflow control. Therefore, the flow of airflow control can be simplified, and simultaneously, better underground airflow control effect can be realized through combination of three airflow control modes.

title_en: Air conditioner energy-saving control method based on user behavior prediction
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air conditioner energy-saving control method based on user behavior prediction, and belongs to the field of intelligent control of air conditioners. According to the method, the user position information, the activity state and the environment parameters are acquired in real time through the multi-mode sensor, the space-time characteristic extraction and the graphic neural network model are utilized to conduct intelligent prediction on the user behavior and the space occupation state, and the accurate grasping of the air conditioner use requirements is achieved. The system dynamically adjusts the operation parameters of the air conditioner based on the prediction result and in combination with a multi-objective optimization algorithm, so that the energy consumption is effectively reduced on the premise of meeting the comfort level of users. Meanwhile, the system has an online self-adaption and anomaly detection mechanism, and can automatically optimize a control strategy according to user feedback and environmental change, so that the operation intelligence, robustness and safety are improved. The invention can be widely applied to indoor environments such as families, office buildings and the like, and has the advantages of energy conservation, high efficiency, intelligent self-adaption, excellent user experience and the like.

title_en: Refrigeration cycle device for performing dehumidification and reheating operations
abstract_en: And the dehumidification reheating operation and the defrosting operation are combined. A refrigeration cycle device (100) is provided with a heat source unit (10), a utilization unit (20), and a control unit (9). The heat source unit (10) has a first heat source heat exchanger (13 a) and a second heat source heat exchanger (13 b). The utilization unit (20) has a first utilization heat exchanger (23 a) and a second utilization heat exchanger (23 b). The control unit (9) causes the first heat source heat exchanger (13 a), the second heat source heat exchanger (13 b), the first use heat exchanger (23 a), and the second use heat exchanger (23 b) to function independently as a radiator or a heat absorber.

title_en: Intelligent control method for air quantity of smoke machine and smoke machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of variable frequency smoke machines, and discloses an intelligent control method for the air quantity of a smoke machine and the smoke machine, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring the rotating speed of a fan of the smoke machine in real time; when the working current of the fan is the first current, if the rotating speed is increased to be larger than the first rotating speed threshold value but smaller than the second rotating speed threshold value and the duration time reaches the first time threshold value, the working current of the fan is increased from the first current to the second current, and when the working current of the fan is the second current, if the rotating speed is reduced to be smaller than the second rotating speed threshold value but larger than the first rotating speed threshold value and the duration time reaches the first time threshold value, the working current of the fan is reduced from the second current to the first current. Thus, the duration of the rotation speed stabilization in the set rotation speed section is fully considered during the rotation speed increase and rotation speed decrease. The problem that the fan running current of the smoke machine is frequently switched between adjacent gears to cause unstable fan running is effectively avoided.

title_en: Heat conduction heating device capable of preventing heat loss
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of heat conduction heating, and discloses a heat conduction heating device for preventing heat loss, which comprises a cylinder body, two connecting sleeves, a water injection pipe, a lifting plate and a driving assembly, wherein an inner cylinder is sleeved in the cylinder body, the novel connecting sleeve is characterized in that a plurality of supporting blocks are fixedly connected to the bottom of the inner cylinder, the bottoms of the supporting blocks are fixedly connected with the cylinder body, a connecting column is fixedly connected to the top of the inner cylinder, the top of the connecting column is fixedly connected with the cylinder body, and two ends of the connecting sleeve are respectively fixedly connected with the cylinder body and the inner cylinder. Through setting up but the water injection pipe of sliding connection in the adapter sleeve to cooperation lifter plate, pinion rack and drive assembly have changed traditional heat conduction heating device water injection pipe fixed mounting's mode. The driving component can drive the toothed plate to move, so that the water injection pipe is driven to lift along the axis direction of the cylinder, the lifting of the water injection pipe in the connecting sleeve is realized, the height of the water injection port is adjusted, the water injection port is enabled to be close to the bottom of the oil surface for water injection, the resistance during water injection is reduced, and the energy consumption of the water pump is saved.

title_en: Slag discharging waste heat utilizing device for industrial boiler
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of boiler slag discharge, in particular to an industrial boiler slag discharge waste heat utilization device which comprises a conveying element, a heat exchange element and a self-cleaning element, wherein the conveying element is used for realizing continuous conveying of high-temperature coal slag, the heat exchange element is integrally arranged on the surface of a steel belt of the conveying element and is used for realizing directional flow of hot air flow from the upper layer to the lower layer of the steel belt and waste heat recovery, the self-cleaning element is matched with the heat exchange element and is used for ejecting coal slag, the conveying element comprises a slag well, an extrusion bin is arranged at the bottom end of the slag well and is used for extruding and conveying large coal slag into the conveying bin, a stable air flow channel is formed in the coal slag layer through the synergistic effect of a pit array, a one-way valve and a negative pressure system, a compact stacking structure is effectively destroyed, the penetration resistance of cooling air is reduced by 40% -60%, the heat exchange efficiency is improved, and meanwhile, slag particles clamped into pits can be removed in real time through the design of pressure triggering pit downward movement and spring rebound, and air permeability reduction caused by local blockage is avoided.

title_en: Shell assembly for air conditioner and air conditioner
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of air conditioners, and discloses a shell assembly for an air conditioner and the air conditioner. The shell assembly for the air conditioner comprises a shell, an air outlet guide plate, an air outlet driving mechanism and an air outlet guide plate, wherein the shell is used for limiting a containing cavity with an air inlet and an air outlet, the air inlet is formed in the bottom wall of the shell, the air outlet is formed in the front side wall of the shell, the air outlet guide plate is movably arranged in the air outlet and used for opening or closing the air outlet, the air outlet driving mechanism is in driving connection with the air outlet guide plate and can drive the air outlet guide plate to slide between a first position and a second position relative to the shell, when the air outlet guide plate is located at the first position, the air outlet guide plate is at least partially contained in the containing cavity and is located on the upper side of the air outlet so as to open the air outlet, the air outlet guide plate and the shell are arranged in a sliding mode, the occupied space for movement of the air outlet guide plate is small, and the air outlet guide plate can be completely or mostly hidden in the shell, and the air outlet guide plate is prevented from being influenced by the air outlet quantity.

title_en: Intelligent PCB post-manufacturing cooling equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses cooling equipment after manufacturing of an intelligent PCB (printed Circuit Board), which belongs to the field of manufacturing of circuit boards and comprises a box body, a cold guide belt body, a semiconductor refrigerator, a sliding plate, a conveying belt and a baffle, wherein the cold guide belt body is assembled on the front surface of the inner wall of the box body, the semiconductor refrigerator is assembled on the front surface of the inner wall of the box body, the sliding plate is fixedly connected to the top of the box body, the conveying belt is fixedly connected to the bottom of the box body, and the baffle is fixedly connected to the front surface of the inner wall of the box body. After the circuit board slides from the sliding plate to the cold guide belt body, the circuit board is driven to slide to the right side by the movement of the cold guide belt body, and the circuit board falls to the moving plate through the rubber pulley. The circuit board is turned over and moved to a new position by the cooperation of the first round gear, the first rotary lever, and the like. The collision between the circuit board and the baffle is reduced, so that the circuit board is prevented from deforming, the welding point is prevented from loosening or being clamped between layers, the turnover precision and the guiding effect are improved, and the circuit board is prevented from being damaged.

title_en: Heat supply sub-room balance regulation and control method and system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of heating regulation, in particular to a heating sub-room balance regulation method and system based on the Internet of things, which comprises the steps of collecting temperature change data of each floor by setting reference test temperature, and calculating the heat exchange efficiency attenuation coefficient of each floor according to the temperature rise time and the steady-state temperature difference, and quantifying the influence of the ageing degree of the heat dissipation equipment on the heat supply effect. And dividing the heat supply regulation period into a plurality of time nodes according to preset intervals, and generating a differential thermostatic valve regulation scheme for each floor by combining the attenuation coefficient and the time weight factor to form a complete dynamic regulation sequence. And (3) optimally selecting a plurality of control sequences by adopting a genetic algorithm, and obtaining an optimal control parameter combination through operations such as fitness function evaluation, selection, crossover, mutation and the like. The invention solves the problem of uneven heat supply of the traditional old scale vertical single-tube serial heat supply mode that the room of the top-layer resident needs to be windowed for heat dissipation and the heat supply of the bottom-layer resident needs additional electric heating equipment due to insufficient heat supply.

title_en: Active noise reduction method and system for ventilation grille
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ventilation noise reduction, and particularly relates to an active noise reduction method and an active noise reduction system for a ventilation grille. The method comprises the steps of constructing and pre-training a first noise reduction model and a second noise reduction model, selecting the first noise reduction model and the second noise reduction model which are matched with the current equipment to execute an active noise reduction algorithm according to microphone signals, pipeline mouth wind speed, grid slice deflection angles and current grid attributes, generating a first noise reduction signal and a second noise reduction signal, and driving an actuator to send noise reduction signals. The invention brings the noise of the pipeline noise and the noise of the ventilation grating cut by the ventilation airflow into the noise reduction system, and realizes the active control of the two kinds of noise.

title_en: High-concentration waste gas combined burner
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-concentration waste gas combined burner, which belongs to the technical field of waste gas treatment and comprises an air inlet bin, wherein a natural gas bin is arranged on the outer side of the air inlet bin, a combustion cylinder is fixed in the air inlet bin, a combustion-supporting air inlet is communicated with the side wall of the air inlet bin, a high-fuel-value waste gas chamber and a low-fuel-value waste gas chamber are arranged at one end of the combustion cylinder, a high-fuel-value waste gas conveying mechanism is arranged in the high-fuel-value waste gas chamber, the high-fuel-value waste gas conveying mechanism can convey high-fuel-value waste gas to an axle center area at the other end of the combustion cylinder, a low-fuel-value waste gas conveying mechanism is arranged in the low-fuel-value waste gas chamber, and the low-fuel-value waste gas conveying mechanism can convey low-fuel-value waste gas to an annular area surrounded by the inner side wall and the outer side wall at the other end of the combustion cylinder. The invention has the beneficial effects that the partition high-efficiency treatment of the high-fuel value waste gas and the low-fuel value waste gas is realized, the energy consumption is effectively reduced, and the deflagration problem is avoided.

title_en: Integrated module
abstract_en: The application provides an integrated module which comprises a barrel body, a runner part and a compressor core, wherein the barrel body is provided with a barrel cavity, the compressor core is positioned in the barrel cavity, the runner part is connected with the barrel body, the barrel cavity comprises an exhaust chamber and an air inlet chamber, and the integrated module comprises a sensor, and at least part of the sensor is positioned in at least one of the exhaust chamber and the air inlet chamber. According to the application, at least part of the sensor is positioned in one of the exhaust chamber and the air inlet chamber, and the sensor can sense and monitor the parameter state of the refrigerant entering or exiting the compressor core more timely, so that the timely and accurate monitoring effect is improved.

title_en: Copper-plated diamond powder material for additive manufacturing and forming process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a copper-plated diamond powder material for additive manufacturing and a forming process, and belongs to the technical field of 3D printing. According to the invention, the copper alloy layer is plated on the surface of the irregularly shaped diamond, the wettability between the metal material and the diamond is improved by elements such as Cr and Co in the copper alloy, and the copper-plated diamond powder with high sphericity is obtained by the fluidized bed wrapping technology, the plasma spheroidization technology and the like, so that good fluidity of the copper-plated diamond powder in the additive manufacturing process is ensured, defects such as spheroidization and pores of a product caused by uneven powder spreading flow are reduced, and high heat transfer performance and mechanical performance of the product can be ensured in the subsequent additive manufacturing process.

title_en: Indoor unit of air conditioner and control method and device thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of air conditioners, and provides an indoor unit of an air conditioner and a control method and a control device thereof, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a current wind pressure signal corresponding to a current position of an air deflector; and under the condition that the current wind pressure signal is not in the threshold range, reducing the running speed of the wind deflector, controlling the wind deflector to rotate from the current position to the next position, wherein one of the next wind pressure signal and the current wind pressure signal corresponding to the next position of the wind deflector is positive, and the other wind pressure signal is negative, and determining the target position of the wind deflector based on the comparison result of the next wind pressure signal and the threshold range. According to the invention, the current wind pressure signal of the air deflector is obtained, when the wind pressure signal is detected to be not in the threshold range, the running speed of the air deflector is reduced, the air deflector is adjusted to rotate from the current position to the next position, the stay position of the air deflector is determined by combining the comparison result with the threshold range, the adjustment of the position of the air deflector is realized, the wind outlet resistance is effectively reduced, and the refrigerating or heating performance of an air conditioning system is improved.

title_en: Roasting furnace and technology for pre-roasting anode production
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of roasting furnaces, in particular to a roasting furnace and a technology for prebaked anode production, which comprises a furnace body arranged at the lower part of a ground surface layer, wherein a base is arranged at the bottom of the furnace body, a plurality of roasting chambers are arranged in the furnace body, combustion chambers are arranged at the front side and the rear side of each roasting chamber, flues are arranged at the two sides of each roasting chamber, a plurality of heating ports are arranged at the two sides of the top of each combustion chamber, a base is arranged at the outer side of the top of each heating port, a top ring is arranged at the inner side of each base, an inner cavity is formed at the inner side of each top ring, a rotating block is connected to the inner side of each inner cavity, a magnet block II is inlaid at the upper part of one peripheral side of each rotating block, a bayonet is arranged at the middle part of the top end of each rotating block, a hub motor is arranged at the middle part of the periphery of each base, and a nozzle deflection adjusting mechanism is used for expanding the direct contact area of flame and a furnace wall, so that the problems of slow local heating and low overall efficiency in the prior art are solved, and the heating efficiency is remarkably improved.

title_en: Radial impeller driving rotary spray head, water distribution disc, cooling tower and water sprinkling method
abstract_en: The radial impeller driving rotary spray head, the water distribution disc, the cooling tower and the water spraying method comprise a guide barrel, an impeller mechanism, a water spraying cap and a limiting cover, wherein the impeller mechanism is arranged in the guide barrel, the water spraying cap is connected with the impeller mechanism, the limiting cover is connected with the lower side of the guide barrel and is simultaneously and rotatably connected with the impeller mechanism, the guide barrel comprises a spiral guide vane for changing the direction of water flow to the radial impact impeller mechanism, the impeller mechanism is used for receiving the impact of the water flow flowing out of the guide barrel and rotating, and simultaneously driving the water spraying cap to rotate, and the limiting cover is used for rotatably fixing the impeller mechanism. The invention adopts the spiral guide vane, and the water flows through the spiral guide vane to radially push the vane of the impeller mechanism, so that the impeller is subjected to larger radial kinetic energy.

title_en: A marker and carton for smoke ventilator packing for assisting smoke ventilator installation
abstract_en: The application provides an improved marking piece for assisting in mounting a range hood and a carton for packaging the range hood. The embodiment of the application provides a marking piece (11) for assisting in mounting a range hood, wherein a hanging hole of the range hood is arranged to be suitable for hanging on a corresponding hanging frame (8) so that the range hood is fixed on a wall surface (7) where the hanging frame (8) is located, the marking piece (11) is provided with a positioning through hole (12) which is suitable for the hanging frame (8) to pass through, when the marking piece (11) is attached to the wall surface (7), the hanging frame (8) passes through the positioning through hole (12), the matching relation between the hanging frame (8) and the positioning through hole (12) locks the positioning position of the marking piece (11) on the wall surface (7), and when the marking piece (11) is positioned at the positioning position, the marking piece (11) is arranged to be suitable for being used as a reference to draw a marking line for assisting in mounting the range hood on the wall surface (7). Thereby, the mounting efficiency of the range hood is improved.

title_en: Efficient magnetic suspension heat pump compressor
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of magnetic suspension heat pump compressors, in particular to a high-efficiency magnetic suspension heat pump compressor which comprises a compressor body, wherein an inlet and an outlet are formed in the compressor body, a filter assembly is arranged at one end of the inlet, the filter assembly comprises a connecting ring arranged at one end of the inlet, a first filter piece and a second filter piece are arranged in the connecting ring, the first filter piece comprises a first mounting ring arranged in the connecting ring, a filter screen is arranged in the first mounting ring, the second filter piece comprises a second mounting ring arranged in the connecting ring, and a filter element is arranged in the second mounting ring.

title_en: Peak regulation and frequency modulation system of coal-fired unit for coupling molten salt heat storage and operation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a peak regulation and frequency modulation system of a coal-fired unit for coupling molten salt heat storage and an operation method thereof, which belong to the technical field of peak regulation and frequency modulation of coal-fired units and comprise a steam subsystem, a high-pressure water supply subsystem, a condensate water subsystem, a first molten salt heat storage subsystem, a second molten salt heat storage subsystem, a steam bypass cooling subsystem, a high-water-adding bypass heating subsystem and a condensate water bypass heating subsystem, wherein the first molten salt heat storage subsystem and the second molten salt heat storage subsystem are respectively connected with the steam bypass cooling subsystem, the high-water-adding bypass heating subsystem and the condensate water bypass heating subsystem. The invention can realize the stable operation of the boiler in a mode of stopping and not stopping the boiler, avoids the energy waste caused by the direct-discharge condenser of the steam bypass, and obviously improves the load response speed of the unit in the primary frequency modulation process.

title_en: Noise eliminator and air conditioning unit
abstract_en: The invention provides a silencing device and an air conditioning unit, and relates to the technical field of refrigeration equipment, wherein the silencing device comprises an acquisition module, a signal conditioning module and an adjusting module, and the acquisition module is used for acquiring a vibration acceleration signal and a fluid pressure pulsation signal of current noise; the signal conditioning module is used for receiving the vibration acceleration signal and the fluid pressure pulsation signal, determining a target effective hole area Aeff based on an expanded Helmholtz resonance theory, and controlling the actual effective hole area of the muffler device to reach the target effective hole area Aeff. According to the silencing device, the adjusting module can adjust the target effective hole area Aeff according to the frequency of the target noise, so that the silencing device resonates with the specific target noise of the broadband noise, the precise inhibition of the broadband noise is realized, and the noise reduction effect is good.

title_en: Zirconium phosphate nanometer quantum dot light conversion material preparation equipment and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of photovoltaic material production, in particular to zirconium phosphate nanometer quantum dot light conversion material preparation equipment and a preparation method thereof. The preparation equipment of the zirconium phosphate nanometer quantum dot light conversion material comprises a protection shell, a vacuum drying module, a standing cooling module and a reaction module, wherein a working cavity is formed in the protection shell, the working cavity is sequentially divided into a drying cavity, a standing cavity and a reaction cavity from top to bottom, the vacuum drying module is arranged in the drying cavity and is used for carrying out vacuum drying on reactants, the standing cooling module is arranged in the standing cavity, the reaction module is arranged in the reaction cavity and comprises a reaction main body, a planetary stirring mechanism and a rotary heat exchange mechanism, the stirring assembly is in driving connection with a sun wheel of the planetary stirring mechanism, and the rotary heat exchange mechanism is in driving connection with a planet wheel and is used for guiding and heating reaction liquid in the reaction main body. The method can simply and conveniently obtain the zirconium phosphate nano quantum dot light conversion material by removing the influence of moisture in the reaction process, and has good application value.

title_en: Heat storage peak shaving operation system and method for gas generator set of iron and steel enterprise
abstract_en: The invention provides a heat storage peak shaving operation system and method for a gas generator set of a steel enterprise, which solve the problems of limited operation load and non-maximized economic benefit of the gas generator set. The system comprises a gas generating subsystem, a heat storage subsystem connected with the gas boiler unit in parallel, a fuel supply subsystem, a water supply subsystem, a main steam subsystem and a flue gas subsystem. And the gas distribution amount is regulated by the fuel regulating valve group, so that the energy storage and energy release mode switching is realized. The method is operated according to the electricity price signal in a time-of-day mode, wherein most of the gas is supplied to the molten salt heating furnace for heat storage in an energy storage mode, a small amount of the gas maintains low-load power generation, and in an energy release mode, most of the gas enters the gas boiler unit, and meanwhile, the heat storage subsystem releases heat for auxiliary power generation. The invention breaks through the gas supply constraint, improves the power generation capacity in the period of high electricity price, reduces the outsourcing electricity cost, has high system integration level and flexible operation, has obvious advantages of molten salt heat storage, and improves the energy utilization efficiency and the enterprise benefit.

title_en: Efficient LNG separating and conveying device for improving exploitation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device for improving the efficient separation and transportation of LNG after exploitation, which relates to the technical field of natural gas exploitation and transportation and comprises a heating component and a self-adaptive cleaning component, wherein the heating component comprises a three-section heating pipe, the inside of first heating section, second heating section and third heating section has all been embedded temperature sensor and viscosity sensor, the outer wall of inlet pipe, gas-supply pipe is connected with the heat recovery pipe through the conducting strip. This a LNG high-efficient separation and conveyor for after improving exploitation, through the setting of three-section heating section, based on the natural gas mixture temperature and the adjustment each section temperature that viscosity can nimble adaptability in each section heating section to realize heating as required in order to reduce the energy consumption, solve current pipeline whole section and adopt constant power operation and cause the extravagant problem of energy consumption from this, and to can retrieve the redistribution of heat, in order to further reduce the energy consumption and guarantee the even heating when natural gas mixture carries when preventing the extravagant heat.

title_en: Air outlet mechanism and cabinet air conditioner using same
abstract_en: The invention provides an air outlet mechanism and a cabinet air conditioner using the same, comprising an air outlet bracket, a soft air bracket and an adjusting mechanism, wherein the air outlet bracket is arranged in the middle of the air conditioner and is provided with a channel penetrating through two ends of the air outlet bracket, the soft air bracket is positioned in the channel and comprises two rotating surfaces and a blocking surface arranged between the two rotating surfaces, the two rotating surfaces are respectively and rotatably arranged on the inner side of the air outlet bracket, and the adjusting mechanism is arranged on the air outlet bracket and is connected with one rotating surface. Through setting up the air outlet support that has the passageway at the air conditioner middle part to dispose rotatable gentle wind support in the passageway, combine the shutoff face of adjustment mechanism drive gentle wind support around the axle center rotation, realized the passageway dynamic shutoff and the opening to the air outlet support, thereby according to the nimble direct-blowing mode of switching and gentle wind diffusion mode of user's demand.

title_en: Multifunctional heat pump system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional heat pump system, which comprises a first compressor, a first conduction port, a first heat exchanger, a second heat exchanger, an evaporator, a third heat exchanger, a fourth heat exchanger, a fifth heat exchanger, a sixth heat exchanger and a third heat exchanger, wherein the first conduction port is communicated with a first refrigerant inlet and a first refrigerant outlet through a first conduction pipe, the first heat exchanger is provided with the first inlet and the second inlet and is communicated with a second refrigerant inlet through a first pipeline, the second inlet and the second refrigerant inlet are communicated with a second conduction port through a second pipeline, the evaporator is communicated with a third conduction port through a third pipeline, the third inlet and the third heat exchanger is communicated with the evaporator through a fourth pipeline, the fourth inlet and the fourth conduction port are communicated with a fifth inlet and a fifth outlet, the fifth heat exchanger is communicated with the evaporator through a sixth pipeline, and the sixth heat exchanger is communicated with the fourth conduction port through a seventh pipeline. The invention can produce different temperatures.

title_en: Material leakage preventing structure for tail part of sintering machine
abstract_en: The invention provides a material leakage preventing structure at the tail part of a sintering machine, which comprises a guide chute, an ore discharging hopper and two material leakage preventing mechanisms, wherein the ore discharging hopper is arranged below the guide chute, a discharge hole of the guide chute is arranged towards the guide chute, each material leakage preventing mechanism comprises a movable frame, a sealing cover and a material receiving hopper, the movable frame is connected to the tail part of the sintering machine, the sealing cover is connected to the outer side of the guide chute, a movable gap is reserved between the movable frame and the sealing cover along the transverse direction, and the material receiving hopper is used for receiving bulk materials from the movable gap. The moving gap reserved in this way does not influence the expansion of the trolley after being heated, when the trolley runs the sinter to the tail part for unloading, most of materials in the middle of the trolley are led into the ore unloading hopper through the guide chute, and the bulk materials fall onto the receiving hopper through the moving gap and are led into the ore unloading hopper under the guidance of the receiving hopper, so that the bulk materials are prevented from leaking outwards to cause accumulation, the integrity of the unloading process is ensured, the normal running of the moving frame is prevented from being influenced, the structure is compact, and the service life is long.

title_en: Special cleaning equipment for battery pack cooler
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cleaning of battery pack coolers, and discloses special cleaning equipment for a battery pack cooler, which comprises a base and a movable cleaning mechanism; according to the invention, the movable cleaning mechanism is arranged, the caterpillar band in the movable frame is arranged in the cooler pipeline through the electric push rod, then the caterpillar band is driven to move through the rotation of the connecting shaft, the mounting block can move in the cooler pipeline, the connecting disc at the bottom of the mounting block can be pushed to move in the cooler pipeline through the movement of the mounting block, the cleaning liquid is conveyed into the connecting disc through the water pipe in the moving process, and is positioned in the immersion holes in the cleaning brush, so that the cleaning liquid can be sprayed out of the immersion holes through the spray holes to infiltrate the cleaning brush, the cleaning in the pipeline can be cleaned, the movement of the cleaning mechanism in the pipeline is realized, and the pertinence of the cleaning device is stronger through the movement in the pipeline, and the cleaning dead angle or channel damage is not easy to occur.

title_en: Tunnel freezing injury prevention device utilizing geothermal energy
abstract_en: The application provides a tunnel freezing injury prevention device utilizing geothermal energy, which comprises geothermal transmission equipment, a tunnel duct piece and a road surface antifreezing part, wherein the geothermal transmission equipment is provided with a first water inlet and a first water outlet, the first water inlet is externally connected with underground hot spring water, the tunnel duct piece comprises a plurality of layered composite duct pieces which are sequentially connected, the geothermal composite duct pieces are provided with a geothermal source water inlet and a geothermal source water outlet, the geothermal source water inlet is connected with the first water outlet, the geothermal source water outlet is connected with a tunnel drainage ditch, the road surface antifreezing part is paved on a road surface and is provided with a second water inlet and a second water outlet, the second water inlet is connected with the first water outlet, and the second water outlet is connected with the tunnel drainage ditch. The application adopts the underground hot spring water as a heat source, saves energy and reduces carbon, radically eliminates icing, eliminates the possibility of freeze burst damage, can be quickly disassembled and assembled and replaced without damage among layered composite segments, and reduces the operation and maintenance cost of tunnels.

title_en: Panel assembly of air conditioner and air conditioner
abstract_en: The invention discloses a panel assembly of an air conditioner and the air conditioner, wherein the panel assembly comprises a switching frame, a panel and a panel, the switching frame is arranged in a mounting hole and is connected with a ceiling, the panel is positioned below the ceiling, the panel is covered at least partially outside the switching frame and is connected with the switching frame, and the relative positions of the panel and the switching frame along the up-down direction can be adjusted. According to the panel assembly of the air conditioner, the relative positions of the panel and the transfer frame along the up-down direction can be adjusted, so that the air conditioner applying the panel assembly can adjust the relative positions of the panel and the host machine along the up-down direction according to the distance from the floor slab to the ceiling, the panel assembly is adapted to different house types and different indoor environments, the installation limit of the air conditioner is reduced, and the panel assembly is simple to install and high in installation efficiency.

title_en: Control method, control device and computer readable storage medium for humidifier
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of household appliances and discloses a control method, a control device and a computer readable storage medium of a humidifier, wherein the control method of the humidifier comprises the steps of obtaining the initial weight of a water tank before the humidifier works and the real-time weight of the water tank during the working process of the humidifier; and controlling the humidifier to perform a drying operation on the water tank according to a second preset threshold value of which the real-time weight is smaller than the initial weight, wherein the first preset threshold value is larger than the second preset threshold value. According to the invention, on the basis of not increasing the hardware cost, the detection logic of the weight of the water tank of the humidifier is updated, and the initial weight and the drying weight of the water tank of the humidifier are dynamically detected by utilizing the detection of the weight sensor, so that the weight detection of the humidifier can be realized with both precision and cost, and the dual requirements of a user on the water level detection precision and the water level detection cost of the humidifier are met.

title_en: New forms of energy heat pump efficient parallel flow heat exchanger for air conditioner and assembly processing device
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-efficiency parallel flow heat exchanger for a new energy heat pump air conditioner and an assembly treatment device, which belong to the technical field of evaporators and comprise a top cover, wherein a component disassembly structure is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the top cover, and a supporting rod is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the component disassembly structure. According to the invention, through the integrated assembly structure, the air in the condenser assembly is blown in from the first air ventilation pipe, the air flowing into the second air ventilation pipe and the third air ventilation pipe is finally blown out from the air jet, the air is blown in from the upper part of the evaporator assembly to the bottom of the inner cavity of the evaporator assembly, and then the air is extruded from the bottom by air pressure and blown out from the exhaust groove, so that the uniformity of the air flow in the evaporator assembly is improved, the air in the evaporator assembly can be discharged into the fourth air ventilation pipe from the ventilation pipe by starting the air opening and closing valve and finally conveyed to the second support sleeve plate, and the condenser assembly, the evaporator assembly and the heat storage assembly can be integrally used, so that the structure is more compact, and the occupied space is reduced.

title_en: Energy heat supply method and device for coupling shallow geothermal energy with thermal power plant
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy heating method and device for coupling shallow geothermal energy with a thermal power plant, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining the wellhead temperature of a geothermal well in the shallow geothermal energy; and adjusting parameters of the geothermal well and the thermal power unit based on the first target parameter and the second target parameter to realize coupling heat supply. Therefore, parameters of the geothermal well and the thermal power unit are adjusted based on the first target parameter and the second target parameter so as to couple the heating of the heating network heater, the steam extraction and heating of the steam turbine and the heating of the deaerator, thereby realizing the maximization of energy utilization, improving the energy utilization efficiency and realizing energy conservation and emission reduction.

title_en: Online optimization method and system for sintering waste heat power generation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an online optimization method and system for sintering waste heat power generation, which solve the problems of unstable operation and limited power generation efficiency of a waste heat power generation system in the prior art, and the method comprises the steps of acquiring real-time operation data of the whole process of the sintering waste heat power generation process; based on real-time data, the sensible heat potential of the sintering ore entering the circular cooler is predicted on line through a firing quantity prediction model, the power generation of the sintering waste heat is predicted on line through a full-flow energy efficiency model based on the sensible heat potential and process control parameters to be optimized, the power generation is maximized, an optimal process control parameter corresponding to the sensible heat potential of the current sintering ore is solved and determined through a constraint programming algorithm, and finally closed-loop optimization control is performed on the sintering waste heat power generation system based on the optimal parameter. The invention can accurately sense upstream waste heat fluctuation, and cooperatively optimize downstream operation parameters in a feedforward way, thereby remarkably improving the power generation efficiency and the operation stability of the non-afterburning sintering waste heat power generation system.

title_en: Automatic regulation and control method and system for optimizing cold end energy conservation of air cooling island
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of heat exchange regulation and control, in particular to an automatic regulation and control method and system for energy conservation optimization of a cold end of an air cooling island, wherein the method comprises the steps of dynamically partitioning the cold end of the air cooling island based on pneumatic characteristics and local heat flux characteristics; the method comprises the steps of obtaining an average subarea characteristic vector and subarea characteristic parameters of each control subarea, inputting the obtained subarea characteristic parameters into a pre-constructed area state type prediction model, and outputting the area state of the corresponding control subarea. According to the invention, dynamic partitioning is performed based on full-field pneumatic characteristics and local heat flux characteristics, so that multi-target subarea division of the cold end of the air cooling island is realized, and each subarea forms a control unit with the same pneumatic behavior and heat load characteristics in the operation process, so that abnormal states such as local countercurrent, high Wen Fugai, flow deflection, abnormal back pressure and the like are identified in real time, the energy consumption waste and the temperature rebound risk caused by traditional average regulation are avoided, and the stability improvement of the local state of the cold end and the maintenance of full-field pneumatic consistency are realized.

title_en: Secondary aluminum waste sorting and re-smelting equipment and processing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regenerated aluminum waste sorting and re-smelting device and a processing method, which relate to the field of regenerated aluminum processing and comprise a fixed bracket and a smelting furnace arranged on one side of the fixed bracket, wherein two filter screens are obliquely arranged on the fixed bracket and are distributed up and down, and the diameter of the screen mesh at the upper part is larger than that of the screen mesh at the lower part, a striking mechanism is arranged at one side of the bottom end of the second inclined frame, the striking mechanism strikes the screen mesh at the lower part, a first smelting cavity and a second smelting cavity in the smelting furnace independently run, and materials with different particle diameters can be respectively conveyed to the corresponding cavities through a conveying mechanism. Aiming at the characteristics that large-grain-size materials need to be smelted at a higher temperature for a longer time and small-grain-size materials need to be smelted at a moderate temperature, the power of the two-cavity burner is respectively adjusted, so that the problems of 'large grain size not being smelted and small grain size being excessively oxidized' are avoided, the materials are ensured to be evenly and fully smelted, and the smelting quality is improved.

title_en: Method for improving climbing supporting capacity of supporting power supply
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving climbing support capacity of a supporting power supply, and relates to the technical field of flexible frequency modulation of the supporting power supply. The method comprises the steps of reducing the water supply temperature of the boiler through the synergistic effect of a condensate water bypass system and a high-level-added three-level bypass, releasing the heat energy of metal and working medium stored in the boiler, and increasing the evaporation capacity of the boiler, so that the steam inlet flow of the steam turbine is increased, and the load response rate is greatly improved. In the adjusting process, a thermal stress real-time calculating and controlling system based on temperature gradient is adopted, and the cooling strength is dynamically adjusted according to the safety margin eta. The method can solve the problem that the inertia of the novel thermodynamic system is reduced and the peak regulation and frequency modulation requirements of the power grid are increased, improve the climbing support capacity of the supporting power supply, and provide safe and efficient flexible support for the novel thermodynamic system.

title_en: Low-impact waterproof sealing integrated reusable ventilation device for spacecraft
abstract_en: A low-impact waterproof sealing integrated reusable ventilation device for a spacecraft is characterized in that a ventilation hole is formed in a sealed cabin, a valve cover is arranged in the ventilation hole in a sealing mode, an inner sleeve is fixedly connected with the valve cover and arranged outside the cabin, an outer sleeve is of a two-section cylindrical barrel structure and sleeved outside the inner sleeve, a small-diameter section cylindrical barrel is sealed with the inner sleeve, a cavity is formed between a large-diameter section cylindrical barrel and the inner sleeve, an outer-cabin bent pipe is arranged on the side wall of the cavity, a separation spring is sleeved on the inner sleeve and is limited in a compressed state through a structure on the inner sleeve and the outer sleeve before ventilation, a compression rod penetrates through an inner hole of the inner sleeve, one end of the compression rod is connected with a fire separation nut, a pulling rod spring is sleeved at the other end of the compression rod and is arranged in an inner cavity of the inner sleeve, the compression rod spring is tensioned through a limit on the compression rod under the action of the fire separation nut before ventilation, a buffer pad is arranged between the end of the small-diameter end cylindrical barrel of the outer sleeve and the fire separation nut, and the inner end cover of the cabin is arranged at a position corresponding to the ventilation valve duct of the sealing cabin.

title_en: CO2Unit and CO2Heat pump system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of air conditioners, in particular to a CO2 unit and a CO2 heat pump system. The application aims to solve the problems that the exhaust temperature of a compressor of a CO2 heat pump unit is too high at a low ambient temperature and the performance of a heat pump is reduced when the backwater temperature of an air cooler is high. For this purpose, the CO2 unit according to the application comprises a first compressor, an air cooler, an intercooler, a first throttling element, a second throttling element, an evaporator and an air preheater. The first port of the second throttling element is communicated with the second heat exchange port of the intercooler, the second port is communicated with the first cooling port of the intercooler, the second cooling port of the intercooler is communicated with the air suction port of the first compressor, the air preheater is arranged on the upstream side of the air inlet direction of the evaporator, the first port of the air preheater is communicated with the heat supply backwater port of the CO2 unit, and the second port is communicated with the first liquid port. The application can improve the running stability and heating capacity of the unit under the low-temperature environment and simultaneously improve the heating performance of the heating scene.

title_en: Textile equipment air conditioning device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of air conditioning of textile equipment, and discloses an air conditioning device of textile equipment, which comprises an air treatment box, a dust falling component and a filtering component, wherein an air inlet pipe and an air outlet pipe are fixedly arranged on two sides of the air treatment box, and the dust falling component is arranged in the air treatment box and is used for filtering exhaust gas of the textile equipment. The air exhausted by the textile equipment is injected into the air treatment box through the fan and the air inlet pipe, is adsorbed on the inner wall of the flow channel under the action of the water film, continuously dips the outer peripheral surface into water in the air treatment box along with the continuous rotation of the first air guide pipe and the second air guide pipe, flies on dust and fiber attached to the inner wall of the flow channel, floats when meeting water and is separated from contact with the first air guide pipe and the second air guide pipe, so that the flow channel is cleaned, the accumulation of particulate matters on the surface of a filter medium is avoided, the pressure loss of the system is gradually increased, the filtration efficiency is exponentially reduced, and finally the filter screen is required to be disassembled, cleaned or replaced by stopping.

title_en: Efficient air filter
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of air filters, in particular to a high-efficiency air filtering device, which comprises a shell, a cover plate and a motor which are connected, and further comprises an adjusting component, an electric heating wire and a negative pressure component, wherein the adjusting component is arranged in the shell and comprises a rotating roller, the rotating roller is fixedly connected with the output end of the motor, one end of the rotating roller is provided with a treatment groove, a waiting groove and a working groove in a surrounding mode, filter elements are arranged in the treatment groove, the waiting groove and the working groove, a heating groove is formed in the axis of the rotating roller, the electric heating wire is arranged in the heating groove and connected with the cover plate, and the negative pressure component is arranged on the shell and is communicated with the treatment groove and the working groove. According to the invention, through the adjusting component, the electric heating wire and the negative pressure component, the filter element can be reused on the basis of avoiding formaldehyde desorption from affecting the indoor environment again.

title_en: Electromagnetic reversing valve
abstract_en: According to the invention, through the optimized design of the electromagnetic reversing valve structure, the concave part is additionally arranged at the transition part of the valve body part, and/or the convex part is arranged on the first plate-shaped part of the valve body part, so that the stress of a high-temperature high-pressure medium when entering the valve body part is dispersed, the fatigue stress of the valve body in a high-pressure environment is effectively weakened, and the reliability of the electromagnetic reversing valve is improved.

title_en: Carbon-carbon crucible and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of carbon/carbon composite material preparation, in particular to a carbon crucible and a preparation process thereof, the carbon crucible comprises a crucible body, wherein the crucible body comprises a crucible side, a crucible bottom and a transition area between the crucible side and the crucible bottom, the transition area and the crucible side sequentially comprise an outer layer, at least one middle layer and an inner layer from outside to inside, each layer sequentially comprises carbon cloth, a first net tire, a second net tire, a thick-repairing carbon cloth and a thick-repairing net tire from outside to inside, the carbon cloth and the first net tire are wound into a whole through the surface of carbon fiber, the transition area comprises a left cambered surface and a right cambered surface which are symmetrically arranged, and the density gradient is optimized and the risk of interfacial peeling is reduced through a layered structure design. Meanwhile, the mechanical impact force in the needling process is effectively dispersed by introducing the thick-repairing carbon cloth and the thick-repairing net tyre, and the body strength of the crucible is improved. The winding of carbon cloth and first net child has strengthened the interlayer connection, has promoted interlayer shear strength to effectively prevented the interlayer separation.

title_en: Energy-saving and consumption-reducing building structure and construction method
abstract_en: The application relates to an energy-saving and consumption-reducing building structure and a construction method, and relates to the technical fields of green building, energy conservation and environmental protection. The solar energy water collection system comprises a house body, a solar energy photovoltaic system, an adjustable water collection plate, a water collection circulation assembly and a shutter curtain wall piece. The application relates to an energy-saving and consumption-reducing building structure solar photovoltaic system which can realize energy source supply, an adjustable water collecting plate can automatically expand and collect water or fold and store the water, a water collecting circulation assembly is used for adjusting water temperature through a heating assembly or a refrigerating assembly after rainwater is filtered, circulating water flows through a circumferential liquid distribution pipe to keep the temperature of a house body or reduce the temperature, and a shutter wall piece is used for synchronously adjusting shutter angles through a transmission connecting plate-worm gear mechanism so as to control light and ventilation.
