By integrating the temperature sensor, the liquid level sensor and the intelligent control system, intelligent linkage and cooperative control of all components according to environmental parameters are realized, the energy consumption of the building in the aspects of temperature regulation, lighting and ventilation is obviously reduced, and the efficient cyclic utilization of energy and water resources is realized.

title_en: Be applied to steam leakage device that prevents of drainage valves
abstract_en: The invention discloses a steam leakage prevention device applied to a drain valve group, which comprises a first drain valve group and a second drain valve group, wherein the first drain valve group and the second drain valve group are connected in parallel, two ends of the first drain valve group and the second drain valve group are respectively connected with a vertical gas-liquid separation pipe section and a gas preheater, the upper part of the vertical gas-liquid separation pipe section is connected with a steam conveying pipeline, and steam condensate is output from the lower part of the vertical gas-liquid separation pipe section and conveyed to downstream equipment. The invention skillfully utilizes a section of process pipeline and a pipe cap combination thereof to realize the gas-liquid separation function which can be completed by expensive separator equipment traditionally. The special separator equipment and the complex internal components thereof are omitted, and the equipment purchasing, manufacturing and installing costs are remarkably reduced.

title_en: Intermittent heating control method and system for residential building
abstract_en: The invention discloses a residential building intermittent heating control method and system, and belongs to the technical field of building environments and energy application. The method comprises the steps of collecting building envelope temperature sequences, indoor and outdoor environment data and weather forecast information through a data sensing module, correcting weather forecast errors through a long-term and short-term memory network (LSTM), constructing a multi-node thermal network model, forecasting indoor temperature attenuation trend under the condition of no heating, evaluating heating intervention necessity and dynamically optimizing starting time through a decision module based on a forecasting result, and realizing self-adaptive optimization of model parameters through rolling forecasting and deviation monitoring through an optimizing control module. The method effectively solves the problems of insufficient thermal inertia quantification, large prediction deviation and unbalanced energy efficiency and comfort level of the building in the prior art, and has the advantages of easy implementation, obvious energy-saving effect and wide application range.

title_en: Heat pump system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application relates to the technical field of air conditioning equipment, in particular to a heat pump system, wherein an indoor unit comprises a first indoor heat exchanger and a second indoor heat exchanger; the water module comprises a first heat exchange assembly and a second heat exchange assembly, wherein two outdoor four-way valves and an outdoor heat exchanger are arranged in the outdoor unit, the first heat exchange assembly and the second heat exchange assembly are connected with the outdoor unit in series, the two outdoor four-way valves are used for keeping the output direction of a refrigerant in the outdoor unit, and when in a heating dehumidification mode and a refrigerating dehumidification mode, the first heat exchange assembly is used for heating the second indoor heat exchanger, and the second heat exchange assembly is used for refrigerating dehumidification of the first indoor heat exchanger. The refrigeration dehumidification and the heating dehumidification bidirectional heat recovery are realized through the cooperative control of the first heat exchange assembly and the second heat exchange assembly. Through two cross valves, the stability and the controllability of refrigerant flow direction under different operation modes are ensured, and the waterway system does not need to be switched in directions under different operation states, so that the heat recovery capacity of the system is stabilized and enhanced.

title_en: Intelligent induction cooker system
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of intelligent household appliances and discloses an intelligent induction cooker system which comprises an induction cooker main circuit, a monitoring module, a memory module, a voice interaction module and an AI interaction module, wherein a main control chip in the induction cooker main circuit is used for monitoring whether food is put into a cooker or not and whether food is put into the cooker or not in a cooking process according to energy information and cooker temperature acquired by the monitoring module and reporting the food to the AI interaction module, the AI interaction module is used for executing the steps of calling a cloud AI large model to generate a corresponding menu according to food information and taste information input by a user through the voice interaction module, feeding back and confirming menu information through the voice interaction module, guiding the user to cook step by step according to the menu confirmed by the user and combining with reporting information, and updating personalized cooking information in the memory module according to cooking process information, thereby having intelligent cooking guidance, high-precision state monitoring and personalized learning capability.

title_en: Kitchen range top panel and gas stove
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hearth panel and a gas stove. The hearth panel comprises a transparent cover plate, a thin film photovoltaic component, a detection component, a weak light illumination component and a weak light illumination component, wherein the transparent cover plate comprises at least one penetrating opening, the opening exposes a hearth frame of a gas stove, the thin film photovoltaic component is arranged on one side, facing the inside of the hearth panel, of the transparent cover plate, the front projection of the thin film photovoltaic component on the hearth panel covers at least part of the area of the transparent cover plate, the thin film photovoltaic component is used for self-generating electricity according to ambient light so as to ignite the hearth, the detection component is electrically connected with the thin film photovoltaic component and used for detecting ambient brightness around the hearth panel, the weak light illumination component is electrically connected with the thin film photovoltaic component, and the weak light illumination component is used for emitting light when the detection component detects that the ambient brightness is lower than a brightness threshold value. According to the cooking bench panel provided by the embodiment of the invention, the thin film photovoltaic assembly is adopted to replace a battery installed in a battery box, so that long-term endurance and convenience in use are realized.

title_en: Intelligent heat supply Internet of things regulation and control system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent heating Internet of things regulation and control system, relates to the technical field of heating Internet of things regulation and control, and aims to solve the problems of low regulation and control precision, poor efficiency and no closed loop link of a traditional system. The system comprises a sensing layer, a network layer, a platform layer and an application layer which are sequentially in communication connection, and a data closed-loop regulation link is formed. The sensing layer collects heat data by using a plurality of types of sensors, the edge calculation module performs denoising and pre-regulation, the network layer uses optical fiber transmission and combines encryption, authentication and CRC32 check to ensure safety, the platform layer uses cloud calculation to store and process the data, predicts 24h load and identifies abnormality by means of regression algorithm, visually displays the data, the application layer automatically regulates heat source power and pipe network flow, positions faults and pushes and overhauls a scheme within 10 seconds, and also supports user-defined peak-valley heat supply and parameter query feedback to realize efficient, accurate and low-consumption heat supply.

title_en: Honeycomb serpentine structure, preparation method and application method
abstract_en: The invention provides a honeycomb serpentine structure, a preparation method and an application method, and belongs to the field of functional materials and preparation and application. The serpentine structure is columnar, continuous honeycomb units are arranged on the section of the serpentine structure, through holes are formed in the columnar structure by each honeycomb unit, 60% -90% of serpentine materials are uniformly contained in the honeycomb wall, the serpentine structure has the functions of releasing negative oxygen ions and adsorbing air pollutants, the honeycomb units are regular hexagons, regular quadrilaterals or circles, during preparation, sintering aids with the total mass of 10% -40% are added into crushed serpentine powder, primary pugs are obtained, honeycomb green bodies are obtained through exhaust and extrusion molding, microwave shaping is carried out on the green bodies immediately after demoulding, and then drying and step calcining are carried out to obtain the honeycomb serpentine structure. The invention provides a novel air improvement structural material which has high preparation yield, short production period and low production cost, and can be used for releasing negative oxygen ions into ambient air.

title_en: Fume exhaust fan
abstract_en: The invention relates to a range hood, which comprises an air inlet box body, a smoke baffle plate and a scraping piece, wherein an air inlet is formed in the front part of the air inlet box body, the smoke baffle plate is rotatably connected to the front part of the air inlet box body, the driving mechanism comprises a driving piece and driving rods, the driving piece is arranged in the air inlet box body, the driving rods are arranged left and right side by side and can swing up and down relative to the air inlet box body, a first end of at least one driving rod is connected with a corresponding driving piece and can swing up or down under the driving of the driving piece, a second end of the two driving rods is connected to the back surface of the smoke baffle plate in an up-down sliding manner, and the scraping piece is arranged between the second ends of the two driving rods in an extending manner along the left-right direction, and contacts with the back surface of the smoke baffle plate and wipes the back surface of the smoke baffle plate from top to bottom in the process that the smoke baffle plate is driven by the driving mechanism to close the air inlet. The smoke baffle has the advantages that the phenomenon that oil stains on the back surface of the smoke baffle are excessively attached to the table top to influence the use experience of a user can be effectively avoided.

title_en: Multi-split air conditioner operation mode self-adaptive cluster management system based on data driving
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data-driven multi-split air conditioner operation mode self-adaptive cluster management system, and belongs to the technical field of air conditioner control. The method specifically comprises the steps of constructing a space-time associated operation feature set by fusing multi-source data, breaking through analysis limitation of a single data source, generating a dynamic energy efficiency state map by working condition decomposition and building thermal inertia compensation, quantifying energy efficiency distribution and disturbance influence, constructing a collaborative strategy network based on the dynamic energy efficiency state map, generating control strategy parameters considering energy efficiency and comfort through distributed optimization, executing the control strategy parameters, dynamically adjusting collaborative strategy network nodes and edge weights based on energy efficiency feedback, and realizing self-adaptive cluster management.

title_en: Waste heat recovery system and electric water heater
abstract_en: The invention discloses a waste heat recovery system and an electric water heater, which belong to the technical field of waste heat recovery and domestic hot water supply equipment and comprise a waste heat acquisition module, a heat exchange module, a cooperative control module, a fluid conveying module, a parameter monitoring module and a safety protection module. The invention can efficiently capture low-temperature waste heat in liquid state and gas state and accurately preheat cold water by arranging an independent and complete waste heat recovery system, control heat exchange key parameters by matching with a small amount of core formulas, regulate and control the key parameters accurately and efficiently, and the matched electric water heater pertinently optimizes an internal structure, is in seamless joint with the waste heat recovery system, and realizes stable hot water supply by electric heating and heat supplementing. The invention greatly improves the comprehensive utilization rate of energy, reduces the electric energy consumption of the electric water heater, runs stably and reliably, meets the hot water supply requirements of multiple scenes such as families, hotels, hospitals, industrial factories and the like, and has extremely strong popularization and application values.

title_en: Modularized phase change heat storage recovery system and method adapting to mine multi-type compressors
abstract_en: The invention discloses a modularized phase change heat storage recovery system which is suitable for a plurality of types of compressors of mines and comprises a compressor heat source unit, a modularized phase change heat storage unit, a heat energy output unit, an intelligent regulation and control unit, an intelligent control unit, a modularized phase change heat storage unit and a heat energy output unit, wherein the compressor heat source unit is used for preliminarily collecting condensation heat, the modularized phase change heat storage unit is used for storing the condensation heat with different temperature grades, the heat energy output unit is used for conveying the stored heat according to requirements to realize heat cascade utilization, the intelligent regulation and control unit is connected with the compressor heat source unit, the modularized phase change heat storage unit and the heat energy output unit, and the condensation heat temperature from the compressor heat source unit is automatically distributed into the modularized phase change heat storage unit through detection and identification. The invention can realize the accurate recovery and the on-demand distribution of the condensation heat of the mine so as to meet the different heat utilization requirements of the mine, improve the energy utilization efficiency, reduce the operation cost and reduce the environmental pollution.

title_en: Air-conditioning equipment trades wind structure
abstract_en: The invention provides an air-conditioning equipment air exchange structure, which relates to the technical field of air-conditioning equipment air exchange and comprises a rotary sleeve rotatably connected in a shell, wherein a plurality of sliding holes are formed in the rotary sleeve at equal intervals, a piston rod is respectively and slidably connected in each sliding hole, a reset spring is arranged on the piston rod and is abutted in each sliding hole, a transmission shaft is limited and connected in the rotary sleeve, a transmission ball is arranged on the transmission shaft, a transmission sleeve is rotatably sleeved on the transmission ball, and the air-conditioning equipment air exchange structure solves the problem of low filtering quality of the traditional air exchange system through an innovative pressurizing mechanism design.

title_en: Air conditioning unit, control method and device thereof, air conditioner and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to an air conditioning unit, a control method and a control device thereof, an air conditioner and a storage medium, wherein the air conditioning unit adopts a structure that a first electromagnet and a second electromagnet alternately drive an induced air plate to reciprocate, so that the running noise of the unit is obviously reduced, only airflow noise is generated, the cabin sound environment is greatly improved, meanwhile, the mechanical loss is low, the energy consumption is reduced, the reliability and maintainability of a system are improved, and the unit can be flexibly designed into various shapes and sizes according to the installation space, and has stronger adaptability. The control method obtains the current navigation state parameters of the ship and determines the target air supply quantity according to the parameters, so that a driving signal is generated to control the alternating work of the electromagnets, the self-adaptive matching of the air supply quantity and the ship working condition is realized, the output of the air conditioner can dynamically respond to the actual thermal load demand of the ship, the over-air supply or under-air supply is avoided, the optimization of the operation energy efficiency is realized while the comfort is ensured, and the overall operation rationality is improved.

title_en: Underground soil temperature regulation and control method, device, equipment, medium and program product
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a device, equipment, a medium and a program product for regulating and controlling the temperature of underground soil. Relates to the technical field of ground source heat pumps. The method comprises the steps of collecting state data of underground soil around a buried pipe in a preset time period, obtaining the state data through a plurality of sensor groups distributed in a buried pipe well, arranging the sensor groups in a layered array mode, inputting the state data into a preset thermal environment model for processing, identifying a thermal unbalance area in the underground soil, generating an adjusting instruction for adjusting operation parameters of a ground source heat pump system based on unbalance parameters of the thermal unbalance area, wherein the operation parameters comprise heat exchange data, and adjusting the operation parameters of the ground source heat pump system according to the adjusting instruction to conduct directional temperature compensation on the thermal unbalance area so as to enable the underground soil to recover a thermal balance state. According to the method, the soil heat balance can be recovered through accurate identification and directional temperature compensation of the heat unbalance area, and the efficient and stable operation of the system can be ensured.

title_en: Liquefied gas storage system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of low-temperature liquefied gas storage, and provides a liquefied gas storage system which comprises a liquefied gas storage tank and a pulse tube refrigerating device arranged on an air outlet pipe of the tank body, wherein the pulse tube refrigerating device comprises a condenser and a pulse tube refrigerating machine, the condenser comprises at least one condensing monomer, the condensing monomer is made of a metal material with a heat conductivity coefficient greater than 200, a first connecting part is arranged in the center of a first side surface of the condensing piece, a second connecting part is arranged in the center of a second side surface of the condensing piece, the first connecting part and the second connecting part can be matched and fixed, a guide hole is arranged on the condensing piece, and a cold finger of the pulse tube refrigerating machine is connected with the first connecting part of the first condensing monomer of the condenser. The liquefied gas storage system provided by the application has the advantages that the whole structure of the pulse tube refrigerating device occupies smaller space, the structure is simpler, the condensing monomer of the condenser can be detached and replaced, and the installation and the maintenance are simpler. The gas is not required to be discharged, and zero discharge and full recycling are realized.

title_en: Wind-solar-fire-storage coupling heat supply system
abstract_en: The invention provides a wind, light and fire energy storage coupling heat supply system, which utilizes electricity of new energy sources such as wind, light and the like to store heat energy in molten salt through an electric molten salt heater (21) when the system is in operation. Wherein, when wind power and photovoltaic do not generate electricity or in a low electricity price period, heat can be stored by utilizing electricity at the outlet of a generator (6) of the thermal power generating unit through an electric molten salt heater (21). After part of steam is extracted from main steam of a boiler (1) or the steam of a hot section of a reheater (2) is extracted in a thermal power plant, part of sensible heat is released through a steam fused salt heat exchanger (30), part of sensible heat is supplied to the outside, and part of sensible heat returns to a cold section of the reheater (2), so that the safety of the reheater (2) is ensured. When the electric load demand is higher or the external steam supply amount is large, the heat stored in the molten salt is released through the molten salt steam heat exchanger (28), the external steam supply parameter demand is met, and when the external steam supply is not needed, the heat can be directly returned to the unit from the cold section of the reheater (2) to generate power.

title_en: Biomass combustion boiler
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of boilers, in particular to a biomass combustion boiler which comprises a combustion bin, wherein a water tank is fixedly connected to the upper side of the combustion bin, a feeding pipe is fixedly connected to the middle part of the combustion bin, a combustion plate is fixedly connected to the left side of the feeding pipe, a plurality of small holes are formed in the combustion plate, a sensor is fixedly connected to the upper part of the combustion bin, a feed bin is fixedly connected to the right side of the feeding pipe, a storage bin is fixedly connected to the upper side of the right end of the feed bin, a feed shaft is rotatably connected to the inside of the feed bin, a spiral feed plate is fixedly connected to the feed shaft, a motor is fixedly connected to the right side of the feed bin, the motor drives the feed shaft to rotate, the sensor is connected with the motor through a circuit, a plurality of guide plates are fixedly connected to the lower end of the storage bin, a plurality of flow limiting shafts are fixedly connected to each flow limiting shaft, and a driving plate is fixedly connected to the lower side of each flow limiting shaft.

title_en: Adjustable gas stove with complete upper air inlet
abstract_en: The invention provides a gas stove with an adjustable air inlet completely, which belongs to the technical field of gas stoves and comprises a shell, a burner, a nozzle seat, an ignition needle, a thermocouple and a pot support, wherein the burner comprises a mixing seat, an injection pipe arranged on the mixing seat and a fire cover arranged on the mixing seat in a covering manner, the mixing seat is detachably arranged on the upper surface of the shell, the nozzle seat is provided with a nozzle mounting opening for discharging air to the injection pipe, and the ignition needle, the thermocouple and the nozzle mounting opening extend to the upper side of the shell. According to the invention, the air valve assembly for transversely adjusting the air inlet is arranged at the injection port of the burner, so that the primary air inlet amount is convenient to adjust, and the air inlet channel is reserved between the burner and the panel of the shell, so that the secondary air inlet can be realized, the complete upper air inlet of the gas stove is realized, the combustion process of the gas is obviously optimized, and meanwhile, the air valve assembly adopts a transverse movement mode, the occupied space in the height direction is smaller, and the ultrathin gas stove is facilitated.

title_en: Independent temperature and humidity control system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a temperature and humidity independent control system, which relates to the field of environmental control and comprises an acquisition module, a receiving module, a fusion module and a judging module, wherein the acquisition module acquires real-time physiological data and fuses the real-time physiological data into a comprehensive data packet, the receiving module receives real-time physiological data corresponding to a user and local environment parameters of the position based on the comprehensive data packet, an internal biological thermodynamic algorithm is operated to generate an individualized temperature set value and an individualized somatosensory humidity set value, the fusion module takes the minimum dissatisfaction degree as a target, a central controller inputs the individualized temperature set value and the individualized somatosensory humidity set value into a multi-target optimization algorithm to dynamically fuse to generate a global set temperature and a global set somatosensory humidity, and the judging module compares and judges based on the global set somatosensory humidity and outdoor air humidity to generate a mode instruction. The invention realizes the fine and intelligent environmental control which takes the individual comfort requirement and the energy efficiency of the whole system into consideration under the multi-user scene.

title_en: Control method and control device of air conditioner and air conditioner
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of electric appliances, and provides a control method and device of an air conditioner and the air conditioner. The method comprises the steps of outputting Pulse Width Modulation (PWM) signals to an inverter of a compressor, enabling current to flow in from any one phase of three-phase windings of the compressor and flow out from other two phases at the same time, heating an oil pool, obtaining actual heating power of a motor winding in real time, and dynamically adjusting duty ratio of the PWM signals according to a difference value between the actual heating power and preset target heating power, so that the actual heating power approaches to the target heating power. The invention does not need an external heating element, avoids the aging failure risk of the heating belt, breaks through the limitation of low iron loss heating power and insufficient heating efficiency of the two-phase winding, and obviously improves the heating efficiency, the system reliability and the control precision on the basis of multiplexing the original hardware by the three-phase winding cooperative heating and power closed-loop regulation and control.

title_en: Cold and hot hierarchical liquid air energy storage coupling carbon capture system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cold and hot graded liquid air energy storage coupling carbon capture system which comprises a liquid air energy storage system and a carbon capture system. The liquid air energy storage system comprises an energy storage unit and an energy release unit, wherein the energy storage unit comprises a first-stage compressor, a second-stage compressor, a third-stage compressor, a first-stage compression heat exchanger, a second-stage compression heat exchanger and a third-stage compression heat exchanger, the carbon capture system comprises an air dehumidifying device, a liquid-phase absorption-regeneration device and a solid absorption-desorption device, the first-stage compression heat exchanger is used for providing heat for the air dehumidifying device, the second-stage compression heat exchanger is used for providing heat for the liquid-phase absorption-regeneration device, and the first-stage compression heat exchanger is used for providing heat for the solid absorption-desorption device. According to the cold and hot graded liquid air energy storage coupling carbon capture system provided by the embodiment of the invention, the heat energy of the liquid air energy storage system is utilized, so that the regeneration energy consumption of the carbon capture system is reduced.

title_en: Fused salt heat storage and coal-fired unit coupled power generation system and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power generation systems, and provides a power generation system and a method for coupling molten salt heat storage with a coal-fired unit, wherein the power generation system comprises a coal-fired power generation unit, a boiler, a steam turbine high-pressure cylinder, a reheater, a steam turbine medium-low pressure cylinder, a condenser and a water supply pump which are sequentially connected; the molten salt heat storage unit comprises a cold salt tank, a hot salt tank, a molten salt-water supply heat exchanger and a molten salt-steam heat exchanger, wherein a water supply side inlet and a water supply side outlet of the molten salt-water supply heat exchanger are connected in parallel to a main water supply pipeline between a water supply pump and a boiler to form a first parallel pipeline, and a steam side inlet and a steam side outlet of the molten salt-steam heat exchanger are connected to a reheating cold section pipeline between a steam discharge port of a high-pressure cylinder of a steam turbine and a reheater to form a second parallel pipeline, so that heat energy is transferred in two directions between the coal-fired power generation unit and the molten salt heat storage unit. The invention can realize the efficient, bidirectional and controllable transfer of heat energy between the power generation unit and the heat storage unit, thereby improving the running adaptability and the full life cycle value of the coal-fired unit.

title_en: Quick feeding device for high-temperature sintering furnace
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of sintering furnaces, in particular to a rapid feeding device for a high-temperature sintering furnace, which comprises a sintering furnace body, wherein two sides of the sintering furnace body are respectively provided with an isolated feeding component and an isolated discharging component for preventing external gas from entering into an interference sintering environment, and a material turning component for assisting single-layer spreading movement of materials is arranged in the sintering furnace body; the invention forms a continuous airlock through preheating of negative pressure pumping air and protective gas by a double-wheel chamber sealing structure of an isolated feeding and discharging assembly, realizes feeding and discharging without stopping, blocks external air from entering and ensures stable micro-positive pressure atmosphere in a furnace, simultaneously realizes unidirectional lifting and turning of materials, no return of reverse idle stroke and low-level interception of a stop rod by means of the reset action of a differential sliding structure such as a reciprocating screw rod and a balancing weight, forces single-layer spreading of the materials and multi-frequency overturning and flattening of the materials, and effectively avoids the problems of material accumulation and uneven sintering.

title_en: Compressed CO coupling solar full spectrum utilization2Energy storage system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a compressed CO  2  energy storage system for coupling solar full spectrum utilization, wherein an outlet of a frequency division fluid high-temperature storage tank is divided into two paths, one path is communicated with a primary side inlet of an energy release heat exchanger, the other path is communicated with an inlet of a vacuum heat collecting tube, an outlet of a compressor is communicated with an inlet of a high-pressure storage tank through a secondary side of the energy storage heat exchanger, an outlet of the high-pressure storage tank is communicated with an inlet of a turbine through a secondary side of the energy release heat exchanger, an outlet of the turbine is communicated with an inlet of a low-pressure storage tank, and an outlet of the low-pressure storage tank is communicated with an inlet of the compressor.

title_en: Multi-station precision lamination piezoresistor sintering device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-station precision lamination varistor sintering device, which relates to the field of varistor sintering equipment and comprises a device shell and a plurality of mounting frames arranged on the inner side of the device shell, wherein the top of the mounting frames is provided with a mounting plate, the surface of the mounting plate is provided with a plurality of moulds distributed in a rectangular array, the bottoms of the moulds are slidably provided with push plates, the device also comprises a demoulding mechanism, a demoulding mechanism and a demoulding mechanism, the demoulding mechanism is arranged at the bottoms of the push plates, the demoulding mechanism comprises a push rod arranged at the bottoms of the push plates, and after the varistor sintering is completed, the push rod can push the push plates to move along the inner side of the moulds, and the push plates are in a rotary state to push the finished products, so that rotary thrust is provided for the finished products to be pushed out of the moulds, the convenience of finished product taking is improved, and workers can take materials quickly.

title_en: Serpentine heat exchange tube with composite enhanced heat transfer structure and photovoltaic/photo-thermal system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a snake-shaped heat exchange tube with a compound enhanced heat transfer structure and a photovoltaic/photo-thermal system, wherein two opposite sides in the heat exchange tube are respectively provided with a first corrugated base surface and a second corrugated base surface along the axial direction, the first corrugated base surfaces and the second corrugated base surfaces have the same structure and are symmetrically distributed, and form a contracted section flow passage with a reduced cross section area and an expanded section flow passage with an increased cross section area which are alternately connected in turn, the first corrugated base surface is provided with a first inner tube fin, the second corrugated base surface is provided with a second inner tube fin, the first inner tube fin and the second inner tube fin have the same structure and are symmetrically distributed at intervals, and the end face of the first inner tube fin is higher than the trough of the first corrugated base surface. Compared with the prior art, the invention solves the problem that the heat transfer and the resistance of the traditional single reinforced structure are difficult to balance, and the comprehensive heat efficiency of the system is obviously improved.

title_en: Multi-dimensional intelligent air purification method and system and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-dimensional intelligent air purification method, a system and electronic equipment, which relate to the technical field of air conditioning and comprise the steps of collecting indoor environment data in real time through a multi-dimensional sensor array, inputting the indoor environment data into a pollutant tracing model to obtain a pollution source type and a pollution source position probability, generating a purification control strategy based on the pollution source type and the pollution source position probability, controlling the air purification equipment to execute corresponding purification operation based on the purification control strategy, solving the technical problems that the prior art has limited sensor types and lacks data fusion analysis, is difficult to comprehensively identify coexisting states of various pollutants, is solidified by the control strategy, cannot adapt to dynamic changes of the pollution source, and is disjointed with pollution distribution conditions, so that insufficient regulation and control precision is caused, thereby the traditional system is difficult to realize differential purification aiming at specific pollutants, restricting the technical problem of improving the whole purification efficiency, and the effect of improving the purification efficiency of specific pollutants is achieved.

title_en: Automatic ventilating, dehumidifying and heat pump system for bathroom for residence and control method
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic ventilating and dehumidifying heat pump system for a bathroom for a residence and a control method thereof; the system comprises an air duct shell, an air processing unit, an air supply unit, an air valve assembly, a control unit and a sensor assembly, wherein the air valve and the heat pump module are coordinated through the control unit according to sensor signals, the system can be intelligently switched between a full-room fresh air mode and a bathroom ventilation mode, the processed fresh air is sent to main rooms such as bedrooms and living rooms in houses in the full-room fresh air mode, and air flow circulates in a bathroom or is exchanged with the outside in the bathroom ventilation mode, so that heating, ventilation or dehumidification functions are realized. The control method automatically selects and refines various working condition strategies such as summer, transitional seasons, winter and the like according to outdoor temperature, bathroom humidity and personnel presence signals, such as internal circulation rapid heating in winter and strong dehumidification and exhaust in summer without people.

title_en: High-temperature self-cleaning method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of control of an integrated oven of an induction cooker and an oven, in particular to a high-temperature self-cleaning method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method realizes preferential disabling of the induction cooker module by setting high priority to forcibly lock the starting front-end action of the induction cooker module, and solves the problem of overtemperature failure of a power device caused by superposition of high-temperature conduction of the oven and self-heating of the induction cooker; the automatic cleaning oven has the advantages that a safety defense line for starting self-cleaning is ensured through a double-state confirmation mechanism for disabling the electromagnetic oven and closing the oven door body, high-temperature leakage and misoperation risks are avoided, a self-cleaning process is adapted to different user demands based on a control parameter adjusting rule of a cleaning mode, cleaning pertinence and efficiency are improved, the heating effect of the oven and the carbonization cleaning effect of food residues are ensured through a cooperative adjusting strategy of the heating of the oven and the air outlet of the fan, the air outlet temperature is controlled in a safety range, damage to peripheral components is avoided, and the safety, the intellectualization and the practicability of the self-cleaning of the integrated oven of the electromagnetic oven are greatly improved.

title_en: Modularized controllable atmosphere high-temperature oxidation device for recycling unqualified zirconium sponge
abstract_en: The invention discloses a modularized controllable atmosphere high-temperature oxidation device for recovering unqualified zirconium sponge, which relates to the technical field of nuclear fuel circulation and materials, and comprises a furnace body system, a heat insulation layer and a detachable furnace pipe, wherein the furnace body comprises a steel structure shell, a fireproof heat insulation layer and a detachable furnace pipe from outside to inside in sequence; the furnace body is provided with a plurality of heating areas which are independently controlled along the axial direction of the furnace body, each area is provided with an independent heating element and a thermocouple, the atmosphere control system comprises a nitrogen gas source, an oxygen gas source, an inert gas source, a mass flow controller and a mixer, the sealing and cooling system adopts a high-temperature sealing ring and double-layer furnace shell design, circulating cooling water is circulated in an interlayer, and the automatic control system is provided with a temperature-atmosphere-time automatic control program for realizing full-automatic operation and remote monitoring of the oxidation process. The device provided by the invention can realize the efficient and uniform oxidation treatment of the irregular porous sponge zirconium at the temperature of 500-1000 ℃ and convert the irregular porous sponge zirconium into zirconium oxide with consistent physical properties.

title_en: Low-nitrogen combustion process modeling and emission control method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a low-nitrogen combustion process modeling and emission control method based on deep learning, which belongs to the technical field of combustion control and industrial process intelligent optimization based on deep learning, and aims to realize heterogeneous data acquisition and standardized state construction of a low-nitrogen combustion process through multi-source industrial perception so as to form a standard combustion state sample. Based on a deep learning and mechanism constraint coupling architecture, a low-nitrogen combustion joint modeling network is built, heterogeneous perception data is mapped into unified scene features by utilizing a multi-mode feature extraction network, and a core combustion index and a confidence score are synchronously output through a multi-task learning module. And a combustion mechanism consistency constraint training strategy is adopted, and an embedded physical boundary constraint forms a self-supervision feedback closed loop, so that a prediction result is ensured to accord with a physical rule. And finally, generating a control strategy based on confidence level gating and reinforcement learning, and issuing the control strategy to a distributed control system after safety verification, so that pollutant emission is reduced, and the safety and self-evolution intelligent level of the combustion system are improved.

title_en: Gas water heater and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of gas water heaters, and discloses a gas water heater and a control method thereof, wherein the gas water heater comprises a burner; a water inlet is arranged at one end of the water inlet pipeline; the water outlet pipeline is connected with the other end of the water inlet pipeline, and the water outlet pipeline comprises a heating pipe section for exchanging heat with the flue gas of the burner; the water channel valve is provided with a water inlet end, a first water outlet end and a second water outlet end, wherein the first water outlet end is communicated with the hot water outlet through a first water channel, the second water outlet end is communicated with the hot water outlet through a second water channel, the water inlet end is connected with a water outlet pipeline, the water channel valve is provided with a first state for communicating the water inlet end with the first water outlet end and a second state for communicating the water inlet end with the second water outlet end, and the water mixing tank is arranged in the first water channel. According to the invention, the water flow path can be flexibly switched according to the use requirement, so that the problem of hot water delay caused by cold water reserved in the water mixing tank after long-time deactivation is effectively solved, the time for a user to wait for hot water is obviously shortened, and the bathing experience is improved.

title_en: Air treatment device
abstract_en: An air treatment apparatus includes an oxygen generating device (20), a first section (11), a second section (17), and a controller (600). The oxygen production device (20) is configured to produce oxygen. The first section (11) comprises a first inlet (113) and at least one of a second inlet (111) or a third inlet (112). Oxygen generated by the oxygen generating device (20) enters the first section (11) through the first inlet (113). The second inlet (111) is communicated with the outdoor, and the outdoor air enters the first section (11) through the second inlet (111). The third inlet (112) is communicated with the indoor, and the indoor air enters the first section (11) through the third inlet (112). The second section (17) is in communication with the first section (11). The second section (17) comprises an air supply opening (171), the air supply opening (171) being configured to supply air indoors. The controller (600) is coupled to the oxygen generator (20), the controller (600) being configured to calculate an oxygen production amount of the oxygen generator (20) based on a demand space oxygen influencing factor, and to control operation of the oxygen generator (20) based on the calculated oxygen production amount.

title_en: Kitchen and bathroom plate electrostatic powder spraying equipment and process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses kitchen and bathroom plate electrostatic powder spraying equipment and a process thereof, which belong to the technical field of kitchen and bathroom plate electrostatic powder spraying, and comprise a preheating furnace body, an electrostatic powder spraying chamber, a bottom box fixedly arranged at the bottom of the electrostatic powder spraying chamber, a curing furnace body, a hanging feeding component, a high-voltage electrostatic generator positioned at one side of the electrostatic powder spraying chamber, and a controller arranged at one side of the curing furnace body, wherein the electrostatic powder spraying chamber is provided with the electrostatic powder spraying component, the output end of the high-voltage electrostatic generator is electrically connected with the hanging feeding component, a plurality of groups of electric heating pipes are uniformly distributed on the inner wall of the preheating furnace body along the feeding direction, a curing furnace component is arranged in the curing furnace body, and a heat recovery component is arranged between the preheating furnace body and the curing furnace body. According to the invention, the plate is laid, and the spray gun piece is driven by combining the double mechanical arms to spray the plate synchronously on both sides, so that the overall spraying quality is greatly improved.

title_en: Modularized liquid nitrogen cooling system for deep stope of metal mine and intelligent control method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mine heat damage prevention and safety engineering, in particular to a modularized liquid nitrogen cooling system of a deep stope of a metal mine and an intelligent control method. Through the concentric structure of three pipes, form vacuum insulation layer and little positive pressure dry nitrogen gas and form dry gas barrier, effective isolation deep high temperature high humidity environment. The vacuum insulation storage tank and the intelligent shunt valve group are arranged underground, so that liquid nitrogen is distributed to multiple stopes as required. The stope heat exchanger adopts a modularized skid-mounted structure and is matched with an environment monitoring box to execute graded safety interlocking logic. The intelligent control unit dynamically adjusts the cooling capacity, counts the liquid nitrogen consumption and carries out cost accounting. The invention has the advantages of small cold loss, dampproof and corrosion resistance, suitability for scattered stopes, perfect safety monitoring and the like, and can obviously improve the heat damage problem of deep metal mines.

title_en: GNN-based intelligent recognition and accurate adjustment method, system, equipment and medium for hydraulic unbalance of heat supply secondary pipe network
abstract_en: The application discloses a GNN-based intelligent recognition and accurate adjustment method, a GNN-based intelligent recognition and accurate adjustment system, GNN-based intelligent recognition and accurate adjustment equipment and a GNN-based intelligent adjustment medium for hydraulic unbalance of a heat supply secondary pipe network, and belongs to the technical field of hydraulic balance adjustment of heat supply pipe networks. The application can effectively capture the association relation between the pipe network topological structure and the hydraulic working condition, realize the accurate positioning and dynamic adjustment of the hydraulic unbalanced node, obviously improve the heat supply efficiency and reduce the operation and maintenance cost.

title_en: Intelligent disinfection control system and method for whole house
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full-house intelligent disinfection control system and method, wherein the system comprises an environment sensing module, an intelligent control module, an electrolysis module, a disinfection execution module and a safety protection module, wherein the environment sensing module is used for collecting multi-region sensing data, the intelligent control module is used for generating an electrolysis control instruction and a disinfection execution instruction through a preset intelligent control algorithm according to the multi-region sensing data, the electrolysis module is used for responding to the electrolysis control instruction and generating a disinfection medium in an electrolysis mode, the disinfection execution module is used for responding to the disinfection execution instruction and executing disinfection operation according to region priority by utilizing the disinfection medium, the safety protection module is used for carrying out abnormal state identification according to the multi-region sensing data and sending a protection strategy triggering signal, and the full-house intelligent and accurate disinfection control system has the advantages of being high in intelligent degree, good in disinfection effect, safe and reliable, energy-saving and environment-friendly.

title_en: Sample processing workstation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of sample processing for hospitals, in particular to a sample processing workstation, which aims to solve the problems that the prior hospitals are prone to error of sample information and the safety is affected due to excessive manual participation in sample collection and warehousing operations. For this purpose, the sample processing workstation of the invention comprises a butt joint area, an operation area and a plurality of temporary storage areas which are independent from each other, wherein the butt joint area can be in butt joint with the outside to realize the transmission and storage of the frozen storage box of the sample, the plurality of temporary storage areas can be used for storing the frozen storage box, a manipulator is arranged in the operation area, and the manipulator is arranged to clamp and transmit the frozen storage box and/or the frozen storage pipe, so that the frozen storage box and/or the frozen storage pipe can be transported among the butt joint area, the operation area and the plurality of temporary storage areas. The invention reduces the manual processing time and the normal temperature exposure time of the sample, and ensures the activity and the safety of the sample.

title_en: High-entropy alloy with hardness and corrosion resistance as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-entropy alloy with hardness and corrosion resistance, and a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of high-temperature chlorine corrosion resistant high-entropy alloy. The high-entropy alloy comprises, by atomic percentage, 19-21% of Al, 19-21% of Co, 9-29% of Cr, 12-29% of Fe and 18-22% of Ni. According to the invention, by matching Al, co, cr, ni with low-cost Fe with high corrosion resistance, the alloy material which has high cost performance and is suitable for high-temperature oxidative chlorine-containing environment is prepared, the smoke component of a garbage incinerator is simulated, and the corrosion resistance of the obtained alloy is tested, so that the result shows that compared with the existing IN625 nickel-based alloy, the high-entropy alloy has high-temperature oxidative chlorine-containing corrosion resistance, has certain hardness, and is expected to be applied to high-temperature oxidative chlorine-containing atmosphere working conditions such as the garbage incinerator, marine environment high-temperature equipment, coal-fired power generation and the like.

title_en: Electric arc stove
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of arc instruments, and provides an arc stove which comprises an arc stove shell, a power circuit board, a step-up transformer set and an arc generating device set. The power supply circuit board is arranged in the electric arc stove shell and is provided with multiple paths of alternating current output ends, multiple groups of voltage boosting transformer groups are arranged in the electric arc stove shell, each group of voltage boosting transformer groups comprises at least one voltage boosting transformer, each path of alternating current output end outputs alternating current to the corresponding voltage boosting transformer group, each voltage boosting transformer is provided with at least one secondary coil, each arc generating device group corresponds to the secondary coil and comprises two arc generating devices, the conducting ends of the two arc generating devices in the arc generating device groups are respectively and electrically connected with two ends of the corresponding secondary coil, and the arc generating ends of the two arc generating devices are positioned in a fire cavity. Therefore, the invention realizes current limiting and current dividing by utilizing the multiplexing output of the power panel, and the position setting of the step-up transformer is flexible.

title_en: Air supply control method, air treatment equipment, medium and product
abstract_en: The application relates to an air supply control method, air treatment equipment, a medium and a product. The air supply control method is used for air treatment equipment and comprises the steps of responding to a mode selection instruction to obtain a target air outlet mode, controlling a plurality of belt transmission driving mechanisms to work so as to adjust the rotation angles of a plurality of guide vanes, enabling the air outlet mode of the adjustable air outlet to be the target air outlet mode, enabling the target air outlet mode to be one of a direct blowing mode and a person avoiding mode, enabling the radiation range of the adjustable air outlet to cover the position of a target user in the direct blowing mode, and enabling the radiation range of the adjustable air outlet to avoid the position of the target user in the person avoiding mode. The air outlet mode of the adjustable air outlet comprises a direct blowing mode and a person avoiding mode. Based on the mode selection instruction, the rotation angle of the guide vane can be correspondingly controlled through the belt transmission driving mechanism, and the air outlet mode of the air outlet can be selected between the direct blowing mode and the person avoiding mode, so that the requirements of users on different air outlet modes in real time are met.

title_en: Wafer heating furnace and heating method
abstract_en: The wafer heating furnace comprises a furnace body, a furnace door, a wafer boat carrying platform, a heater, a plurality of internal temperature sensors, a plurality of external temperature sensors, a temperature control module and a temperature control module, wherein a constant temperature area is arranged inside the furnace body, a heating area is arranged outside the furnace body, the furnace door is closed with the furnace body, the wafer boat carrying platform is arranged at the bottom of the furnace body and used for carrying at least one wafer boat, the wafer boat is in and out of the furnace body, the heater is arranged outside the furnace body, surrounds the periphery of the furnace body and is far away from the furnace door, and/or is arranged at the top of the furnace body, the heater is provided with the plurality of heating modules, the plurality of internal temperature sensors are arranged in the constant temperature area, the plurality of external temperature sensors are arranged in the heating area, and the temperature control module is connected with the internal temperature sensors and is connected with the external temperature sensors and is coupled with the furnace door, and in an opened state of the furnace door, and the temperature of the constant temperature area is lower than the temperature of the heating area and corresponds to the position of at least one external temperature sensor. By adopting the technical scheme, the quality of the wafer can be improved.

title_en: Secondary filter screen for circulating water of condenser
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of condenser dirt cleaning equipment, and discloses a condenser circulating water secondary filter screen which comprises a lower shell, a dirt collecting device, a condenser and a control box, wherein an upper shell is welded above the lower shell, a first reinforcing rib is fixedly connected to the interior of the upper shell, a lower bearing seat assembly is fixedly arranged in the lower shell, a lower transfer shaft assembly is rotatably connected to the interior of the lower bearing seat assembly, a transfer shaft is fixedly connected to the top end of the lower transfer shaft assembly, and an upper transfer shaft assembly is fixedly connected to the top end of the transfer shaft. The invention has the advantages that the defect that the transmission system is complex and easy to generate faults in the old secondary filter screen is overcome, the operation is safe and reliable, the overhaul and the maintenance are convenient, the strong pollution discharge device is added according to the condition that the plastic film is seriously polluted, and the condition that other secondary filter screen devices cannot clean the plastic film is overcome.

title_en: Rotary kiln for cooperatively removing sodium and potassium impurities in industrial alumina by using microwaves-HCl and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kiln for cooperatively removing sodium and potassium impurities in industrial alumina by rotary microwaves-HCl and a use method thereof, belonging to the technical field of high-purity alumina preparation equipment, and comprising a rack, a feeding device, a rotary reaction cylinder, a driving device, a microwave coupling heating system, a hydrogen chloride gas supply system, a tail gas guiding-out and purifying system and a cooling discharging device, wherein the rotary reaction cylinder is obliquely arranged along the axial direction and is rotationally connected with a metal shell, and the feeding device, the cooling discharging device and the tail gas guiding-out and purifying system are all communicated with the rotary reaction cylinder; the rotary reaction cylinder is provided with a plurality of air inlet nozzles along the axial direction, the air inlet nozzles are respectively communicated with an air inlet ring in the metal shell in a rotating way, and the air inlet rings are communicated with a hydrogen chloride air supply system. The method has the advantages of rapid microwave heating, rotary turning and strengthening mass transfer, uniform distribution of HCl atmosphere, safe treatment of tail gas and the like, and is suitable for preparing high-purity alumina powder.

title_en: Control method and device for air conditioner, electronic equipment, storage medium and program product
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a control method, a device, an electronic apparatus, a storage medium and a program product of an air conditioner, and relates to the technical field of air conditioners, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of detecting first coordinate information corresponding to at least one target object through a plurality of radars arranged on an air conditioner, wherein the first coordinate information is based on coordinate information of a first coordinate system, and the first coordinate system is a coordinate system corresponding to a target radar detecting the target object and different radars correspond to different first coordinate systems. And converting the first coordinate information into second coordinate information under a second coordinate system, wherein the second coordinate system is based on the coordinate system of the azimuth of the air conditioner. And controlling the air conditioner according to the second coordinate information. According to the method and the device, the first coordinate information of the plurality of radars corresponding to different first coordinate systems is converted into the second coordinate system based on the azimuth of the air conditioner, unification of the coordinate information detected by the plurality of radars is achieved, accuracy of detecting target objects by the plurality of radars can be improved, and therefore intelligence of air conditioner control is improved.

title_en: Method and system for preparing synthetic gas by smoldering and decarbonizing full-grade gangue
abstract_en: The application belongs to the field of coal gangue decarburization, and particularly discloses a method and a system for preparing synthetic gas by smoldering and decarburizing full-grade coal gangue, wherein the method comprises the steps of mixing different grades of coal gangue with inert media to prepare a first mixed material and a second mixed material; the method comprises the steps of placing mixed materials in a smoldering furnace, separating the mixed materials by utilizing a heat conducting baffle plate so as to enable a second mixed material to be arranged around a first mixed material pile, preheating and igniting, forming a plurality of reaction layers in the first mixed material and the second mixed material, transferring heat generated by the second mixed material to the first mixed material, separating components of smoke collected from the smoldering furnace, and mixing the separated carbon dioxide-rich gas with air to serve as a gas supply source of the second mixed material. The application can solve the problems of complex system, high energy consumption and difficult realization of the treatment of the full-grade gangue in the existing gangue treatment process, and has the characteristics of wide adaptability, high product quality, short system flow and high economic value.

title_en: Steam supply system for power station
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power station equipment, and particularly discloses a steam supply system for a power station. The system comprises an absorption heat pump, a waste heat recycling pipeline and an external steam supply pipeline, wherein the waste heat recycling pipeline comprises a recycling loop and a cooling branch, the recycling loop is communicated with a steam supply part generating device and the cooling part, the cooling branch is communicated with a cooling liquid input part, a cooling part, the absorption heat pump and a cooling liquid output part, the external steam supply pipeline comprises a heating main pipeline and a heating branch, the heating main pipeline is communicated with a fresh water input part, the absorption heat pump, a primary heating part, a secondary heating part and a steam output part, the heating branch is communicated with the secondary heating part and the absorption heat pump, and the heating branch is communicated with a power generation steam supply part, the secondary heating part and the primary heating part. The invention recycles the residual heat in the power generation equipment, so that the residual heat is used for heating the steam, thereby reducing the waste of heat and the overall energy consumption of the system.

title_en: Titanium nitride-based composite aerogel solar evaporator and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a titanium nitride-based composite aerogel solar evaporator and a preparation method and application thereof. The solar evaporator comprises a porous polyurethane sponge skeleton and composite aerogel loaded on the surface and/or the pore wall of the sponge skeleton, wherein the composite aerogel comprises titanium nitride nano particles, carbon black and crosslinked polyvinyl alcohol, and the crosslinked polyvinyl alcohol is formed by crosslinking polyvinyl alcohol and glutaraldehyde under an acidic condition. Dispersing titanium nitride nano powder, carbon black and polyvinyl alcohol solution in water, regulating pH to be acidic, adding glutaraldehyde for crosslinking, immersing porous polyurethane sponge in a crosslinking reaction solution, taking out, and sequentially freezing by liquid nitrogen and freeze-drying in vacuum. The invention combines titanium nitride and carbon black, combines polyurethane sponge framework and cross-linked polyvinyl alcohol aerogel, has wide spectrum high absorption, high-efficiency photo-thermal conversion, good mechanical stability and circulation stability, and can be used for solar-driven high-salt wastewater evaporation, sea water desalination and salt-containing solution concentration.

title_en: CFB boiler deslagging coking-prevention blocking method and deslagging device using same
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preventing CFB boiler slag from coking and blocking and a slag discharging device using the method, the method is to move down an ash control valve for a certain distance, A section of slag column is constructed between the ash control valve and a slag discharge port of the hearth to form a sealing section, the resistance of the slag column is utilized to inhibit the channeling quantity of the fluidized wind of the hearth, and a slag discharge pipe above the ash control valve adopts a diameter-expanding step structure. The slag discharging device comprises a slag discharging pipe, an ash control valve, a slag cooler, a slag conveyer and a slag warehouse, wherein the slag discharging pipe, the ash control valve, the slag cooler, the slag conveyer and the slag warehouse are sequentially installed from a slag discharging port of a hearth, the ash control valve is installed at an outlet of the slag discharging pipe, a slag column in the slag discharging pipe blocks the amount of the fluid wind of the hearth, and the slag discharging pipe above the ash control valve adopts a diameter-expanding step structure. The invention has the technical effects that firstly, the ash control valve is provided with a slag section to reduce the flowing-in amount of fluidization wind, the carbon residue in the slag discharging pipe is prevented from being reburning and coking from the source, and secondly, the problems of slag discharging pipe blockage and coking caused by local accumulation, arch forming and bridging of large-particle-size bottom slag particles are avoided by utilizing the diameter-expanding step structure.

title_en: Indoor machine
abstract_en: The invention provides an indoor unit which comprises a shell and an air deflector assembly, wherein the shell comprises a bottom shell, a panel body and a front panel, the front panel and/or the panel body is/are connected with the bottom shell, the panel body is provided with an air outlet, the front panel is connected with the panel body, the air deflector assembly is connected with the shell and movably arranged at the air outlet, the air deflector assembly comprises a first air deflector and a second air deflector, the second air deflector is connected with the first air deflector, the second air deflector is provided with a first edge and a second edge, the first air deflector is provided with a first air deflector position for opening the air outlet, the second air deflector is provided with a first open position for guiding air, and when the first air deflector is positioned at the first open position, the first edge is abutted with the front panel, and an air outlet space is formed between the second edge and the panel body. The invention solves the technical problems that a large gap exists between the large-area air guide panel and the front panel, so that part of hot air escapes from the gap and the use comfort of a user is affected.

title_en: Gradient nickel-based alloy coating capable of resisting thermal fatigue cracking, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gradient nickel-based alloy coating capable of resisting thermal fatigue cracking, a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of thermal fatigue resistant pipelines. The cladding metal powder of the bottom layer comprises, by mass, 40-65% of Ni, 10-30% of Fe, 5-10% of Cr, 10-15% of Mo and 10-15% of W, and the cladding metal powder of the surface layer comprises, by mass, 50-70% of Ni, 2-10% of Fe, 15-25% of Cr, 2-10% of Mo, 2-10% of W, wherein the bottom layer and the surface layer are in double-layer gradient distribution, the average linear expansion coefficient of the bottom layer and the average linear expansion coefficient of the 12Cr1MoVg pearlite heat-resistant steel matrix are within 6% within the range of 500 ℃ at room temperature, and the surface layer has excellent thermal fatigue cracking resistance and high-temperature oxidation resistance, so that the two components are combined into a gradient coating to solve the technical problem of thermal fatigue cracking of the surface of the traditional desuperheater downstream pipeline.

title_en: Multi-source data fusion heat supply station environment safety monitoring method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of safety monitoring, in particular to a method and a device for monitoring environmental safety of a heating station by multi-source data fusion, wherein the method comprises the steps of synchronously collecting and preprocessing multi-source monitoring data in an edge gateway to obtain time-aligned and standardized monitoring data triples and uploading the time-aligned and standardized monitoring data triples to a cloud; the method comprises the steps of decoupling abnormal characteristics in a mode based on physical working conditions in a cloud, removing steam artifacts, equipment noise and baseline drift to obtain an observation evidence vector, introducing an improved whale migration algorithm to conduct iterative optimization on model parameters of a causal fusion evaluation model, generating a comprehensive risk index based on the model, defining a four-level evolution state space, combining a hidden Markov model to identify potential safety hazard evolution tracks, dynamically correcting an early warning threshold value based on risk fuzzy entropy if serious state transition exists, and triggering grading response. According to the invention, the depth decoupling and causal fusion of the heterogeneous data are realized, the hidden danger dynamic evolution is accurately tracked, and the accuracy and the robustness of the safety monitoring of the heating station are remarkably improved.

title_en: Spring heating cooling device
abstract_en: The elasto-thermal cooling device (10) comprises a plurality of elasto-thermal modules (12, 14, 16, 18, 20), wherein each of the elasto-thermal modules (12, 14, 16, 18, 20) has at least one tube (52) embedded in a holder (54). At least one tube (52) is formed of a shape memory alloy. A pump (30) is in fluid communication with each of the heat-ejection modules (12, 14, 16, 18, 20) for driving a Heat Transfer Fluid (HTF) through at least one tube (52) of each of the heat-ejection modules (12, 14, 16, 18, 20) in a cyclically alternating manner in the direction of fluid flow. The plurality of thermic modules (12, 14, 16, 18, 20) are fluidly connected in parallel such that fluid flow of a Heat Transfer Fluid (HTF) through at least one tube (52) of each of the thermic modules (12, 14, 16, 18, 20) is synchronized and consistent.

title_en: Method for concentrating heavy water by utilizing waste heat of offshore oil and gas platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for concentrating heavy water by utilizing waste heat of an offshore oil and gas platform, relates to the technical fields of nuclear fusion fuel preparation, ocean resource utilization and industrial waste heat recovery, and aims to solve the problems of high raw material conveying cost, high energy consumption, waste of the waste heat of the offshore oil and gas platform, difficult hydrogen sulfide treatment and the like of the existing land seawater deuterium extraction process. The invention uses the waste heat of the offshore oil and gas platform as a reaction heat source, uses the platform associated hydrogen sulfide as a hydrogen-deuterium exchange medium, realizes the preliminary enrichment of deuterium through a double-temperature method after waste heat recovery and pretreatment of raw material water and hydrogen sulfide, obtains a heavy water crude product through flash evaporation enrichment, and can recycle fresh water. The system consists of a water taking unit, a double-temperature method exchange reaction unit, a waste heat recovery unit, a flash evaporation enrichment unit, a liquid storage unit and an auxiliary unit. The invention realizes the comprehensive utilization of the waste heat and the hydrogen sulfide resource of the offshore oil and gas platform, reduces the energy consumption and the cost of heavy water preparation, and fills the technical blank of the use of the offshore waste heat for the heavy water preparation.

title_en: Air conditioner control method and device, air conditioner and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses an air conditioner control method, an air conditioner control device, an air conditioner and a computer readable storage medium, and relates to the technical field of air conditioners; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a plurality of working condition parameters of the air conditioner in a fresh air mode steady state operation, calculating a fresh air correction equivalent thermal resistance value based on the working condition parameters, calculating a fresh air condensation risk coefficient based on the fresh air correction equivalent thermal resistance value and the working condition parameters, calculating a risk change rate according to the fresh air condensation risk coefficient corresponding to different moments, determining a condensation risk level according to the fresh air condensation risk coefficient and the risk change rate, and controlling the air conditioner to execute anti-condensation actions corresponding to the condensation risk level. Therefore, the condensation risk level in the fresh air mode can be accurately judged by the scheme, and further condensation prevention action is carried out.

title_en: Device, shaft furnace and method for improving flow uniformity of furnace burden and air flow of shaft furnace
abstract_en: The invention relates to a device, a shaft furnace and a method for improving flow uniformity of furnace burden and air flow of the shaft furnace, belonging to the technical field of direct reduction iron making of the shaft furnace. The device comprises a fluid changing body, a central air supply pipeline, at least one layer of central air port group and a plurality of supporting pipelines, wherein the fluid changing body comprises an upper cone and a lower cone, the upper cone is connected with the lower cone to be matched with the lower cone to define a cavity, an air outlet port is formed in the bottom of the lower cone, a first end of the central air supply pipeline passes through the cavity and is connected with the top of the upper cone and is not communicated with the cavity, at least one layer of central air port group is arranged on the side wall of the first end of the central air supply pipeline, each layer of central air port group comprises a plurality of central air ports, the plurality of supporting pipelines are connected and fixed with the wall of the shaft furnace through the supporting pipelines, at least one supporting pipeline forms a first supporting pipeline communicated with the second end of the central air supply pipeline, and at least one supporting pipeline forms a second supporting pipeline communicated with the cavity. Solves the problem of insufficient central air flow in the related technology, and is beneficial to improving the uniformity of furnace burden and air flow of the shaft furnace.

title_en: Intelligent distribution control method and system for main pipe boiler load
abstract_en: A method and a system for intelligently distributing and controlling the load of a main pipe boiler relate to the technical field of automatic control and comprise the following steps of S01 dividing a layer condition for the boiler to construct a condition table, S02 judging the load lifting state of the boiler according to the calculation result of a main pipe steam pressure controller, S03 calculating a layer absolute weight matrix, a layer relative weight matrix, an energy relative weight matrix and the like based on the condition table when the boiler lifts the load, and S04 calculating the layer absolute weight matrix, the layer relative weight matrix, the energy relative weight matrix and the like based on the condition table when the boiler drops the load. And step S05, calculating N boiler load distribution outputs and the like according to the energy relative weight matrix, the condition relative weight matrix, the energy judgment matrix and the like. According to the invention, the multi-dimensional conditions of the plurality of boilers are used for carrying out weighted calculation, so that the intelligent load distribution of the plurality of boilers is realized, and the safety and stability of the production process are realized.
