title_en: Denitration control method, system and unit for start-up stage of circulating fluidized bed boiler
abstract_en: The invention discloses a denitration control method, a denitration control system and a denitration control unit for a circulating fluidized bed boiler in a starting stage, which comprise the steps of executing fuel increment control before the unit is loaded, enabling the temperature of a hearth and the temperature of an inlet of a separator to reach a denitration reaction temperature window, enabling an SNCR denitration system to enter an effective reaction temperature window in advance and to be put into operation before grid connection in response to the temperature of the hearth and the temperature of the inlet of the separator to reach the denitration reaction temperature window, executing material circulation establishment control for establishing material circulation in a furnace and stably transferring heat in the starting stage, and executing flue gas recirculation control for reducing oxygen in the furnace and inhibiting nitrogen oxide generation before the unit is loaded.

title_en: Control method and device of external fan, air conditioner and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a control method and device of an external fan, an air conditioner and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of air conditioners, wherein the scheme comprises the steps of obtaining an initial wind shield and an initial optimizing direction of the external fan; the method comprises the steps of obtaining an initial wind gear, carrying out preset wind gear optimizing action on the initial wind gear by taking power of a target air conditioning system as an optimizing target according to the initial optimizing direction, obtaining a target wind gear of an external fan, wherein the target air conditioning system comprises the external fan, the wind gear optimizing action is used for searching an optimal wind gear, the optimal wind gear is a wind gear capable of enabling the power of the target air conditioning system to be minimum under the condition that the capacity of the target air conditioning system is unchanged, and controlling the external fan to operate in the target wind gear. The method is used for reducing the electric energy loss when the air conditioning system is in operation.

title_en: Multi-room heat preservation control method, fresh air control system and air conditioner
abstract_en: The application provides a multi-room heat preservation control method, a fresh air control system and an air conditioner, and belongs to the technical field of energy-saving air conditioners. The method comprises the steps of respectively obtaining current temperature data of each heat-preserving room, wherein each heat-preserving room is a room which detects that a person leaves and receives a heat-preserving instruction of a wire controller, calculating a temperature difference value between the current temperature data and a target temperature value of each heat-preserving room, identifying a heat-preserving room in the heat-preserving rooms according to the temperature difference value, identifying a proportion of the heat-preserving rooms in the heat-preserving rooms, wherein the heat-preserving rooms are high-heat-load rooms with the temperature difference value larger than a set value, adjusting operation gears of an air pipe machine according to the proportion and the number of the heat-preserving rooms, and adjusting opening of air valves of each heat-preserving room according to the temperature difference value of each heat-preserving room, wherein the air valves comprise an indoor air outlet valve, an indoor return air valve, an outdoor air outlet valve and an outdoor return air valve. The problem that the comfort level of a user is affected due to the fact that an existing air duct system control scheme lacks a multi-room collaborative heat preservation mechanism under an unmanned scene is solved.

title_en: Anti-pollution device for circulating water system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-pollution device of a circulating water system, which relates to the technical field of protective structures, and particularly comprises a circulating water system, wherein a support unit which plays a role in supporting and fixing is arranged on the outer surface of the circulating water system, an inclined protective unit which can reduce the invasion of impurities is arranged at one end of the inner part of the support unit, a wall unit which has a protective effect and an entrance reservation function is arranged on the bottom surface of the inclined protective unit, and the support unit comprises a wall fixedly arranged on the surface of the circulating water system.

title_en: Environmental protection equipment for treating industrial waste gas
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of waste gas treatment, in particular to an environment-friendly device for treating industrial waste gas, which comprises a heat recovery mechanism, wherein the heat recovery mechanism comprises an absorption tower internally provided with a cavity, a water conveying cavity, a heat absorption cavity and a water inlet cavity are sequentially arranged in the absorption tower from top to bottom, a heat absorption pipe for connecting the water conveying cavity and the water inlet cavity is arranged in the heat absorption cavity, and the side walls at the upper end and the lower end of the heat absorption cavity are respectively provided with a water outlet pipe and a water inlet pipe which are communicated with the heat absorption cavity; an air inlet pipe is arranged at the upper end of the water inlet cavity, a water conveying pipeline for communicating the water inlet cavity with the water conveying cavity is arranged between the water inlet cavity and the water conveying cavity, one end of the water conveying pipeline extends into the bottom end of the water inlet cavity, and the end part of the water conveying pipeline, which is positioned at the bottom end of the water inlet cavity, is connected with a water pump; the pipeline at the upper end part of the water delivery cavity is connected with a waste gas filtering mechanism. The utility model discloses a heat recovery mechanism structure's setting has not only realized still having promoted the filter effect to waste gas to the recycle of the energy in the waste gas.

title_en: Heating device using solid fuel
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an use solid fuel's heating device belongs to civilian heating stove field, the utility model discloses an air distribution system has realized two way independent adjustable air supplies from top to bottom, can improve combustion efficiency more, and oxygen content in the adjustable furnace to realize more excellent combustion efficiency and better emission reduction effect adjustably. The control system can set different air distribution schemes including air distribution proportion and total air volume according to the combustion performance of different solid fuels, so that the combustion process of the solid fuels is always in the optimal combustion state, wherein the solid fuels particularly refer to coal.

title_en: Extensible photovoltaic module
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the photovoltaic field, in particular to a malleable photovoltaic component, which comprises a photovoltaic plate assembly, two first supporting rods, two second supporting rods and a bottom plate, and is characterized in that the photovoltaic plate assembly is composed of at least two first photovoltaic plates; the first photovoltaic panel is composed of a photovoltaic panel main body, and the latter first photovoltaic panel can be extracted from the former first photovoltaic panel; the bottom plate consists of a bottom plate main body and four first supporting seats positioned above the bottom plate main body; the first photovoltaic panel is connected with two first supporting seats of the bottom plate through two first supporting rods, and the last first photovoltaic panel is connected with the other two first supporting seats of the bottom plate through two second supporting rods; the utility model solves the problems of inconvenient transportation, inconvenient cleaning and inconvenient installation of the photovoltaic module in the prior art; the utility model has the advantages of simple structure, small volume, convenient installation, convenient transportation, convenient cleaning and the like.

title_en: Ammonium metavanadate dehydration system
abstract_en: The utility model provides an ammonium metavanadate dewatering system belongs to metallurgical technical field. The water tank comprises an arched furnace body, a water tank matched with the inner wall of the furnace body is arranged in the furnace body, the upper end of the water tank is opened, the water tank comprises a U-shaped inner plate and a U-shaped outer plate positioned on the outer side of the inner plate, a water storage cavity is formed between the inner plate and the outer plate, a heating cavity is formed in the inner plate, a gas backflow cavity is formed between the inner plate and the inner wall of the furnace body, a first collecting cover and a second collecting cover are arranged at the top of the furnace body, a driving motor is arranged at the top of the outer wall of the furnace body, the exhaust end of the first collecting cover is connected with a plurality of insertion tubes, the insertion tubes are inserted in the water storage cavity, the exhaust end of the second collecting cover is connected with a backflow tube; the gas reflux cavity is communicated with the water storage cavity, and the bottom of the furnace body is provided with an electric heater. The utility model has the advantages of reduce the ammonia processing degree of difficulty, improve dehydration efficiency, etc.

title_en: Desk lamp
abstract_en: The utility model provides a desk lamp, include: a lamp shade; the photocatalyst carrier and the lampshade surround to form an accommodating space, and the photocatalyst carrier is provided with a light-transmitting first area and a second area of which the outer surface is provided with a photocatalyst treatment layer; the illumination light source is arranged in the accommodating space and is provided with a first light path which penetrates through the first area and then exits out of the accommodating space, a second light path which penetrates through the second area and then exits out of the accommodating space, and the photocatalyst treatment layer is excited by visible light with the wavelength of 450nm to 650 nm. The utility model discloses can shine photocatalyst treatment layer through white light LED, play and kill the bacterium, subtract organisms such as organic suspended solid, reach air-purifying's effect.

title_en: Air supply and exhaust coupling ventilation system suitable for high pollution source industrial building
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an air supply and exhaust coupled ventilation system suitable for high pollution source industrial buildings, which comprises an air supply system, an exhaust system and a control system; the air supply system comprises a group of air supply devices, an air supply pipeline connected with the air supply devices and the air supply outlets, the air supply outlets arranged on the wall of one side of the building, an indoor operating table, a particulate matter monitoring sensor, two air outlets arranged on the wall of the other side of the building and a filtering device arranged at the air outlets; the air exhaust system comprises air exhaust devices arranged on the upper layer area of the operating table and the top of the building and an air exhaust pipeline connected with the air exhaust devices, and the air exhaust devices consist of exhaust fans; the control system comprises a monitoring unit and a control unit connected with the monitoring unit in real time. The utility model provides a main ventilation mode lead to the air consumption greatly among the prior art that the air volume that high pollution source industrial building faces is too big, ventilation efficiency crosses low, ventilation effect is difficult problems such as not showing significantly.

title_en: Air conditioning cold pipe capable of preventing condensation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an air conditioning cooling pipe of preventing condensing, including cooling pipe and fixing base, the surface of cooling pipe has cup jointed the slide cartridge, the inside wall fixed connection resilient means of slide cartridge, one side fixedly connected with rubber circle of resilient means. This empty modulation cooling pipe of preventing condensing, through the fixing base, the slide cartridge, resilient means, the rubber circle, including a motor, an end cap, a controller, and a cover plate, the threaded rod, the supporting shoe, the setting of backup pad and arc piece isotructure, both can make the slide cartridge drive the rubber circle, slide on the cooling tube surface, make the adnexed drop in cooling tube surface drop, and then avoid the drop to condense in the surface of cooling tube, cause the decline of air conditioner refrigeration efficiency, and the effect through resilient means, can make the rubber circle paste tightly in the surface of cooling tube, improve the device's work efficiency, through the slide cartridge, the water drainage tank, the setting of sealed lid and honeycomb duct, can make the drop, in the water drainage tank flows into the honeycomb duct, the water conservancy diversion of the drop of being convenient for is discharged, the device's practicality has.

title_en: Two-stage compressed concrete production aggregate precooling and preheating integrated system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a two-stage compressed concrete production aggregate precooling and preheating integrated system, which comprises a two-stage compressor and a medium-pressure heat exchanger, wherein the medium-pressure heat exchanger is provided with two liquid inlets; an inlet of the low-pressure stage refrigeration compressor is communicated with an air outlet of the low-pressure stage refrigeration compressor through a pipeline, two liquid inlets of the medium-pressure heat exchanger are communicated with an outlet of the high-pressure reservoir through a pipeline, a pipeline communicated with one liquid inlet and an outlet of the high-pressure reservoir penetrates through the interior of the medium-pressure heat exchanger and is connected to the liquid outlet of the medium-pressure heat exchanger, the liquid outlet of the low-pressure stage refrigeration reservoir is communicated with an inlet of a refrigerant pump through a pipeline, an air inlet of the medium-pressure heat exchanger is communicated with an air outlet of the low-pressure stage refrigeration compressor through a pipeline, and an air outlet of; can switch over the production of precooling and preheating aggregate through changing the pipe connection, can be used for the production of concrete preheating and can be used for precooling production again, simple structure, production efficiency height.

title_en: Waste heat recovery automation device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a waste heat recovery automation device, which comprises a wastewater disposal basin, a sand cylinder filter, a cyclone desander, a plate heat exchanger, a sewage source heat pump unit and a heat preservation water tank; the waste water tank comprises two waste water tanks which are respectively a first waste water tank and a second waste water tank, the output end of the first waste water tank is connected with the input end of a sand cylinder filter, the output end of the sand cylinder filter is connected with the input end of a plate type heat exchanger, the output end of the plate type heat exchanger is connected with the input end of the second waste water tank, the output end of the second waste water tank is connected with the input end of a sewage source heat pump unit, the output end of the sewage source heat pump unit is connected with a waste water pipe, and a tap water pipe is sequentially connected with a cyclone sand remover, the plate type heat exchanger, the sewage source. The device can recycle heat energy in waste hot water discharged by life, saves a large amount of heat energy, meets the current environment-friendly requirements of energy conservation and emission reduction, and can solve the problem of production cost rise caused by increasingly tense energy supply.

title_en: Cooling device is used in production of healthy tea drink
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cooling device is used in production of healthy tea drink, including the heat-preserving container, both ends all are fixed with the baffle about the heat-preserving container is inside, a side surface that the baffle was kept away from each other all is fixed with hemisphere tea drink storage jar, both sides are provided with tea drink inlet pipe and tea drink discharging pipe respectively about the heat-preserving container, tea drink inlet pipe and tea drink discharging pipe run through the heat-preserving container respectively about both ends and extend respectively in the hemisphere tea drink storage jar, be provided with a plurality of heat transfer copper pipes between the baffle, a plurality of heat transfer copper pipe upper end both ends all run through the baffle and extend to hemisphere tea drink storage jar respectively in, hemisphere tea drink storage jar left side that is located upside baffle upper surface is fixed with driving motor, the driving motor lower extreme runs through the baffle and is connected with the threaded rod, be connected with. The utility model discloses the heat transfer is effectual, makes water resource reuse, avoids incrustation scale accumulation on the heat transfer copper pipe, makes the device keep good cooling effect.

title_en: Air conditioner
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an air conditioner, include: the shell comprises a back panel and a panel, wherein the front side of the back panel is open, and the panel is positioned on the front side of the back panel; the rear end panel comprises reinforcing columns, wherein the inner wall surfaces of the left end and the right end of the rear end panel are respectively provided with the reinforcing columns, and at least one reinforcing column is connected with the rear end panel in a clamping mode through a clamping structure. According to the utility model discloses an air conditioner is through making the back panel and strengthening adopting dismantling of buckle structure joint to be connected the setting between the stand, the back panel of being convenient for and the dismouting of strengthening the stand to the maintenance and the change in the later stage of being convenient for, the manufacturing of being convenient for moreover.

title_en: Drying and sterilizing device for medical medicinal material production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a medical treatment is drying and disinfecting device for medicinal material production, belong to medicinal material drying and disinfecting device technical field, place the top of placing the net at the medicinal material through the sterile medicinal material that will dry, start electrical heating element and produce high-temperature steam, high-temperature steam breathing pipe through helical structure with high-temperature steam extracts through starting the air pump, and spout into the top of placing the net to the medicinal material through helical structure's medicinal material drying and disinfecting spray tube, start vibrations drive assembly simultaneously and drive the medicinal material and place the automatic of the continuous vibrations realization medicinal material of net and roll, the scald that has avoided artifical rolling to lead to and the problem of the extravagant manpower of inefficiency, and further improve the drying and disinfecting efficiency through helical structure's medicinal material drying and disinfecting spray tube.

title_en: Wall-mounted air conditioner indoor unit
abstract_en: The utility model provides a wall-mounted air conditioner indoor unit, which comprises a shell, wherein an air outlet is formed on the shell, and the air outlet penetrates through the front side and the transverse two sides of the shell to be used for exhausting air supply airflow in the shell; and the outer air guide plate is movably arranged on the shell and comprises an air guide plate body and two end plate parts bent and extended from the two transverse ends of the air guide plate body, and the air guide plate body and the two end plate parts are respectively used for opening and closing the air outlets on the front side and the two transverse sides of the shell. The utility model discloses a machine has realized comfortable air supply in wall-hanging air conditioning.

title_en: Heating controller of heating device

title_en: House building environmental protection noise insulation
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of house buildings, and relates to an environment-friendly sound insulation device for house buildings. Its beneficial effect is, this housing construction environmental protection noise insulation, through vacuum chuck, vacuum pump and vacuum cavity, vacuum pump work can absorb the air between vacuum chuck and the wall body, and carry the vacuum cavity through the connecting pipe and carry out interim storage, thereby can let the firm absorption at the wall body surface of installing frame, avoid using other mounting means to cause the destruction to the wall body, through the dehumidifier, dehumidifier work can absorb and convert into the form of water into with moisture on every side and carry the storage water tank in, thereby ensure that the acoustic celotex board surrounding environment is dry, avoid the moist life who influences the acoustic celotex board of air, whole device is rational in infrastructure, high durability and convenient use, therefore, the clothes hanger is strong in practicability.

title_en: Solar energy storage balancing device of ground source heat pump across seasons
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of ground source heat pump systems, in particular to a solar energy storage balancing device of a ground source heat pump spanning seasons, which comprises a solar energy collection system, a heat pump unit, a ground heat exchanger and a water tank, wherein the solar energy collection system is connected with a solar energy heating heat exchange coil in the water tank through a first pipeline; the first heat pump unit and the second heat pump unit work alternately, the heat pump units which stop working are overhauled in time, and guarantee is provided for next work.

title_en: Novel composite regenerative heating furnace
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel composite regenerative heating furnace. A fixed beam supported by a support column is arranged on the bottom of the heating furnace; the stepping mechanism drives a lifting column penetrating through the furnace bottom to drive a movable beam arranged on the lifting column and parallel to the fixed beam to do circulating stepping motion; furnace rollers are arranged in intervals among each row of support columns in the advancing direction, and one ends of the furnace rollers extend out of the furnace body and are in transmission connection with a driving device; the furnace roller is higher than the highest position of the movable beam during stepping or lower than the lowest position of the movable beam during stepping; a stepping feed inlet and a stepping discharge outlet are arranged on the furnace body corresponding to the fixed beam and the movable beam; the furnace body is provided with a furnace roller feeding hole and a furnace roller discharging hole corresponding to the furnace roller. The utility model innovatively adds the furnace roller and the matched transmission and cooling structure thereof, and simultaneously adds the furnace inlet channel and the furnace outlet channel at the two ends of the furnace in the length direction, so that the billet is consistent with the length direction of the heating furnace during heating, and the end inlet and the end outlet are realized.

title_en: Hot-blast direction adjustable radiator
abstract_en: The utility model provides a radiator with adjustable hot air direction, which relates to the field of radiators and comprises a plurality of radiators which are connected in series, a radiating cover arranged outside the radiators, and a first radiating device and a second radiating device which are arranged in the radiating cover, wherein the first radiating device comprises a first radiating unit which is respectively and independently coated on the periphery of each central radiator, the first radiating unit comprises a first air guide groove, the upper end of which is fixedly arranged on the upper inner wall of the radiating cover, a first fan arranged above the radiators and air outlets with different heights arranged at the lower half parts of the first air guide grooves, hot air is discharged from the lower ends and two sides of the radiators through the two radiating devices, the reduction of the comfortable feeling of users caused by overlarge hot air flow is prevented, the radiating efficiency is improved, and the discharged hot air is prevented from blowing straight through the arranged air outlets with different heights, directing the heated air to the desired height.

title_en: Furnace end with high-efficient combustion function
abstract_en: A furnace end with a high-efficiency combustion function relates to the technical field of kitchen ware equipment. It comprises a furnace end base, a furnace end upper cover and a feeding cover plate. The furnace end base comprises a feeding base, a first diversion pipeline, a second diversion pipeline and a base shell; the first diversion pipeline and the second diversion pipeline are arranged in parallel and are respectively connected with the feeding base and the base shell; a boss is arranged inside the base shell; a first flow guide channel is formed between the boss and the base shell; a second flow guide channel is arranged inside the boss; the first diversion channel is connected with the outlet of the first diversion pipeline; the second diversion channel is connected with the second diversion pipeline; the width and the depth of the first flow guide channel are gradually reduced from the outlet of the first flow guide pipeline. The fuel and air can be fully mixed, so that the utilization rate of the fuel is improved; not only avoids the waste of resources, but also is not easy to generate harmful substances such as carbon monoxide and the like, and improves the use safety.

title_en: Dry burning prevention probe support and burner thereof
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-dry-burning probe support and a burner thereof, wherein the anti-dry-burning probe support comprises a fixing frame and a mounting seat, the fixing frame is used for fixing an anti-dry-burning probe on a furnace head, the mounting seat is connected with the fixing frame, the mounting seat is provided with at least one positioning part and at least one mounting hole, and the mounting seat is fixed on the furnace head through the positioning part and the mounting hole. According to the dry-burning-prevention probe bracket, the mounting seat of the dry-burning-prevention probe bracket is provided with the at least one positioning part and the at least one mounting hole, and the bracket is fixed on the furnace head through the positioning part and the mounting hole.

title_en: Swimming pool heat pump for constant temperature swimming pool
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of swimming pool equipment, in particular to a swimming pool heat pump for a constant-temperature swimming pool, which comprises a mounting seat, wherein a protective cover is fixedly arranged on the upper side of the mounting seat through a support frame, a communicating pipe is arranged in the protective cover, the lower end of the communicating pipe is communicated with a heat exchange assembly fixedly arranged on the mounting seat through two connecting pipes, the front end of the heat exchange assembly is connected with two flanges, and two groups of filtering assemblies are arranged on the connecting pipes in parallel. Carry out filterable processing through the water to the swimming pool after the heat exchange, and then make the impurity of going into the aquatic of heat exchange carry out effectual filtration through the filtering component who sets up, and impurity after the filtration all attaches to the filter screen that sets up, and then carry out the replacement subassembly of dismouting with the filter through being convenient for that sets up, can conveniently clear up this filter after using a period, carry out effectual filtration to water when guaranteeing that the swimming pool temperature is invariable, guarantee the quality of water of swimming pool.

title_en: Solar wall heat collection system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a solar wall heat collecting system, which comprises a solar wall heat collecting plate and a water tank, wherein the solar wall heat collecting plate is arranged on the outer side of a building wall body; the solar wall heat collecting plate is internally provided with a heat collecting circulation component which is communicated with the water tank. The utility model integrates energy saving, environmental protection and heat preservation, and can realize the use of heating and hot water by utilizing the solar wall heat collecting plate and the air stored in the heat exchange chamber. The heat collecting circulation component is arranged in the solar wall heat collecting plate, so that the system can provide hot water in summer, and the utilization rate of the solar wall heat collecting system is improved.

title_en: Condenser device with simplified structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a condenser device with a simplified structure, which comprises a condenser main body, an air inlet and an air outlet, wherein the left end surface of the condenser main body is provided with the air inlet, the right end surface of the condenser main body is provided with the air outlet, a temperature insulation component is arranged in the air outlet, a protective component is arranged on the air inlet, the temperature insulation component comprises a movable bin, a fixed block, an auxiliary rod, a rotating plate, an auxiliary groove, a check washer and a temperature insulation plate, the outer wall of the air outlet is provided with the movable bin, a plurality of groups of fixed blocks are fixed in the movable bin, the fixed blocks are fixedly connected with the auxiliary rod, the auxiliary rod is rotatably connected with the rotating plate, the rotating plate is internally provided with the auxiliary groove, the auxiliary rod is provided with a plurality of groups of check washers, the check washer is fixed on the check washer, and the air outlet can be ensured not to scald hands due to high temperature in the condenser main body when in use, the practicability of the device is improved.

title_en: Closed-loop water cooler for brewing wine
abstract_en: The utility model provides a closed-loop water cooler for brewing, which comprises a water cooler body, wherein a cooling chamber is arranged in the water cooler body, a plurality of condenser pipes are arranged in the cooling chamber, the inlet end and the outlet end of the cooling chamber are respectively connected with a water inlet pipe and a water outlet pipe, a water pump is arranged on the water inlet pipe or the water outlet pipe, the water pump is connected with a heat dissipation assembly, the outlet end of the heat dissipation assembly is connected with the water inlet pipe, a cooling coil is arranged in the cooling chamber, and two ends of the cooling coil are connected with refrigerating and heating equipment.

title_en: Waste heat utilization energy saving and emission reduction environmental protection frying stove
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an energy-saving emission-reducing environment-friendly frying stove utilizing waste heat, which comprises a frying stove frame body, wherein two frying stove openings are formed in one side of the top end of the frying stove frame body, three radiating stove openings which are uniformly distributed at equal intervals are formed in the other side of the top end of the frying stove frame body, a partition plate is arranged on one side of the top end of the frying stove frame body, a water supply valve is arranged at the top end of the side surface of the partition plate, a cooling water valve is arranged on one side of the bottom of the water supply valve, two adjusting rotating handles are arranged on the frying stove frame body far away from the partition plate, heat taking openings are formed in the bottom ends of the adjusting rotating handles, a heat insulation box is arranged on one side, close to the partition plate, of the heat insulation box is internally provided with a dish steaming layer, a screen plate is arranged at the bottom end of the dish steaming layer, a water containing groove is formed in the bottom end of the screen plate, and a heat insulation layer is arranged at the top end of the interior of the heat insulation box. The heat is led out from the heat-radiating stove opening and the heat conducting rod leads out the heat from the heat-taking opening, so that the heat at the top end of the frying stove frame body is efficiently utilized, and the utilization rate of fuel is improved.

title_en: Firing device for producing super capacitor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a firing device for producing a super capacitor, which comprises a firing box, a limiting baking structure and an auxiliary drying structure, wherein the limiting baking structure and the auxiliary drying structure are arranged in the firing box, and high-temperature heating structures are arranged on the limiting baking structure and the auxiliary drying structure; the utility model relates to the technical field of capacitor production, wherein a plurality of high-temperature drying shaft tubes and a plurality of high-temperature shaft tubes are heated by plant electric hot oil, so that the phenomenon of waste gas pollution caused by coal combustion heating is avoided, and meanwhile, high-temperature gas in a firing box is rotated by an auxiliary drying structure, so that the phenomenon of temperature difference between the bottom end and the top end of the firing box is avoided.

title_en: High-efficient cold and hot operation of computer lab and controlling means
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-efficiency machine room cold and hot operation and control device, relates to the technical field of high-efficiency machine rooms, and aims to solve the problems that the conventional device for high-efficiency machine room cold and hot operation and control is inconvenient to use, the height of control equipment is different, the work of operators is affected, and meanwhile, the device cannot adjust an installation structure according to needs. The control box lower extreme is provided with the extension rod, and the extension rod lower extreme is provided with the connecting rod, connecting rod and extension rod swing joint, and the connecting rod lower extreme is provided with controls the box, controls the box lower extreme and is provided with the pull rod, and the control box rear end is provided with first fixed plate, and the control box both sides all are provided with the second fixed plate, and two second fixed plates and control box swing joint control the box front end and are provided with display screen and button.

title_en: Mini quick-heating electric water heater
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a mini quick-heating electric water heater which comprises an electric water heater body and a hanging frame, wherein the hanging frame comprises a bottom plate and chucks arranged on two sides of the bottom plate, the chucks are fixedly connected to the bottom plate through connecting columns, the electric water heater body comprises a cuboid shell and an electric heating assembly arranged in the cuboid shell, two longitudinal long round holes are formed in the upper position of the rear side of the cuboid shell, embedding holes matched with the chucks are formed in the bottoms of the longitudinal long round holes, and clamping pieces matched with the chucks on the two sides are symmetrically arranged in the cuboid shell. The utility model has simple structure, and can prevent the electric water heater body from separating from the hanging frame when the electric water heater body is accidentally subjected to external force by matching the clamping piece and the chuck, thereby improving the installation stability of the electric water heater.

title_en: Conveying and cooling device for refractory brick production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a conveying and cooling device for refractory brick production, which comprises a bottom plate, a cooling device and a conveying device, wherein the conveying device is arranged on the bottom plate, and the cooling device is arranged above the conveying device. The conveying and cooling device for producing the refractory bricks is simple in structure and convenient to operate, when the refractory bricks need to be cooled, the refractory bricks are placed on the cooling plate of the conveying device, then the conveying device is moved to the position below the air blower, then the air blower is turned on for cooling, and the cooling efficiency of the refractory bricks is improved.

title_en: Waste water heat exchanger for calcium carbide method polyvinyl chloride production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a waste water heat exchanger for calcium carbide process polyvinyl chloride production, which comprises an outer shell and an end cover, wherein a first connecting ring is arranged at the end part of the outer shell, a second connecting ring is fixedly arranged at the end part of the end cover, the first connecting ring and the second connecting ring are fixedly connected through a plurality of connecting bolts, a filter box is fixedly arranged on one side of the upper end of the outer shell, a coarse filter screen is fixedly arranged in the filter box, a water delivery pipe is fixedly connected to one side of the filter box, one end of the water delivery pipe, far away from the filter box, is communicated with the interior of the outer shell, and a fine filter screen is fixedly arranged in the water delivery pipe. The utility model discloses a waste water heat exchanger for calcium carbide process polyvinyl chloride production, which is characterized in that a coarse filter screen and a fine filter screen are arranged to carry out secondary filtration on impurities in waste water, a centrifugal design is adopted, and a sewage flow passage is widened, so that heat exchange is more sufficient, the heat exchange efficiency is higher, the problem that the traditional heat exchanger is easy to block is solved, and the waste water heat exchanger is worthy of popularization.

title_en: Humidifying incubator for newborn
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a humidifying and insulating box for a newborn, which comprises a storage cabinet and a transparent box body arranged above the storage cabinet, wherein a humidifying port communicated with a humidifying device is formed in the transparent box body, the humidifying device also comprises a dehumidifying device arranged in the transparent box body, the dehumidifying device comprises a dehumidifying pipe with two open ends and a partition plate arranged in the middle of the dehumidifying pipe, a round hole is formed in the partition plate, a semiconductor refrigerating sheet is arranged in the round hole, a fan is arranged at one end, close to the cold end of the semiconductor refrigerating sheet, of the dehumidifying pipe, the dehumidifying pipe also comprises a plurality of flow guide pipes communicated with the two sides of the partition plate, one end of each flow guide pipe faces the hot end of the semiconductor refrigerating sheet, the interior of the transparent box body is humidified through the humidifying port, when the humidity is too high, the fan blows air in the transparent box body to the cold end, the air is cooled through the cold end, steam in the air is condensed into drops, and the humidity in the air is reduced, after the air is cooled, the air is heated through the hot end of the semiconductor refrigerating sheet, so that the temperature in the heat preservation box is kept stable.

title_en: Oil receiving box and integrated stove
abstract_en: The embodiment of the utility model discloses an oil receiving box and an integrated stove, wherein the oil receiving box comprises an oil box, a buoy and a micro switch assembly, the buoy is rotatably connected to the oil box, the first end of the buoy extends into an oil cavity of the oil box and can float above oil contained in the oil cavity, and the second end of the buoy extends out of the oil box; when the first end of the buoy floats to a preset height along with the oil in the oil cavity, the second end of the buoy can be in contact with the micro-switch assembly and enables the micro-switch assembly to be started; the microswitch component can send out a cleaning prompt when being started. This connect oil box adopts lever principle to set up the buoy, and is right through the buoy the control of micro-gap switch subassembly realizes clean the warning, and its simple structure and cost are lower, still can rise to the settlement position at the liquid level and send clean warning, effectively prevents that fluid from spilling over in the oil box.

title_en: Ceiling type range hood
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of kitchen appliances, in particular to a top-suction type range hood. The utility model provides a top suction type range hood which comprises a main body and a smoke guide device, wherein a smoke inlet facing to the lower side and communicated with a flue is formed in the main body, the first end of the smoke guide device is rotatably connected with the main body, and the second end of the smoke guide device is detachably connected with the main body through a magnetic assembly. When the range hood does not work, the smoke guide device is retracted into the main body, and the space between the main body and the table top of the range body is larger because the range hood is a top suction type range hood; when the range hood works, the second end of the smoke guide device is separated from the main body, a smoke gathering cavity is formed between the smoke guide device and the main body, and the smoke guide device rotates downwards to form the smoke gathering cavity, so that the smoke inlet of the smoke gathering cavity moves downwards to be closer to a cooking bench, the movement distance of oil smoke is shortened, and the smoke exhaust effect of the range hood is improved. Simultaneously, the second end of leading cigarette device can be dismantled with the main part through the mode of magnetism and be connected, and convenience of customers uses.

title_en: Air outlet device and air conditioner with same
abstract_en: The utility model provides an air outlet device and an air conditioner with the same, wherein the air outlet device comprises: the main air duct component is provided with a main air duct for air flow to pass through and a main air outlet communicated with the main air duct; the auxiliary air duct component is provided with an auxiliary air duct for air flow to pass through and an auxiliary air outlet communicated with the auxiliary air duct; wherein, main air duct part and supplementary air duct part set up mutually independently. The air outlet device solves the problem that the air outlet volume of the air conditioner in the prior art is small.

title_en: Coal gas micro-positive pressure silent ventilator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a gas micro-positive pressure silent ventilator, which comprises a first steel pipe, wherein a plurality of first small holes are uniformly formed in the surface of the first steel pipe, a connecting piece is connected to the outer diameter of the first steel pipe in a sliding manner, a first through hole is formed in the center of the connecting piece, the left side, located outside the first through hole, of the connecting piece is fixedly connected to the right side of a sealing ring, a second through hole is formed in the center of the sealing ring, and the left side, located outside the second through hole, of the sealing ring is fixedly connected to the right side of a fixing ring. In the utility model, the plurality of first small holes are formed in the first steel pipe and used for emitting compressed air outwards, the plurality of second small holes are formed in the second steel pipe and used for emitting the compressed air for the second time, the air-out sound is eliminated, the air-out quantity is noiseless and uniform, the micro-positive pressure of a duty room is ensured, the prevention and early warning are realized, the safety of duty personnel is ensured, the gas is prevented from leaking into a main control room to cause gas poisoning accidents, and the gas-out-of-duty device is worthy of great popularization.

title_en: Air purification subassembly and air purification equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to an air purification assembly and air purification equipment, still be provided with insulating back corona generating device between discharge electrode and earthed electrode, when discharge electrode is gone up and is discharged, discharge electrode discharges and produces electrified carrier, under the effort of electric field and outside fan etc. that form between discharge electrode and earthed electrode, the carrier moves to earthed electrode. Due to the presence of the insulated back-corona generating device, part of the charge carriers (e.g. free electrons, etc.) will accumulate charge on the insulated back-corona generating device. At this time, a new electric field is formed due to the charge accumulation, and when the electric field is increased with the charge accumulation, back corona discharge occurs when the electric field is increased to the ionization intensity of the air in the ventilation hole. Then, ultraviolet streamer generated during back corona discharge activates a back corona purifier loaded on an insulating back corona generator, so that the back corona purifier and plasma generated by discharge generate a synergistic effect, and the efficient effects of filtering, sterilizing and removing aldehyde are achieved.

title_en: Road lighting lamp
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a road lighting lamp, which comprises a lamp post, a lampshade, a bulb, a controller, a lampshade cleaning device, a cleaning water heating device and a temperature sensor, wherein the lampshade cleaning device, the cleaning water heating device and the temperature sensor are respectively and electrically connected with the controller, the temperature sensor is used for acquiring the temperature of the lampshade, and the controller controls the cleaning water heating device according to the temperature of the lampshade. The utility model provides a road lighting lamp, which can wash a lampshade by controlling the water temperature to be close to the temperature of the lampshade under the condition that the water temperature is controlled to be close to the temperature of the lampshade, so that the high-temperature lampshade is prevented from being broken due to sudden cooling.

title_en: Energy-conserving air conditioner drainage device for engineering transformation
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of air conditioning equipment, and discloses an air conditioner drainage device for energy-saving engineering reconstruction, which comprises a base, an air conditioner host and a water storage tank, wherein the upper surface of the base is connected with the air conditioner host in a clamping manner, the bottom of the base is fixedly provided with the water storage tank, one side of the air conditioner host is fixedly provided with a water outlet pipe, the outer surface of the water outlet pipe is fixedly provided with a clamping assembly, and the outer surface of the water outlet pipe is fixedly provided with a communicating hose through the clamping assembly. This energy-conserving air conditioner drainage device for engineering transformation, through the setting of water storage box, played the effect of collecting the comdenstion water in the air conditioner host computer, can be used to watering usage such as flowers and plants after collecting the completion, thereby can reach the purpose of water economy resource, through the setting of centre gripping subassembly, in inserting the delivery pipe with the intercommunication hose during the use, twist the screw bolt, make it drive splint inwards support tightly, thereby played and carried out the effect of fixing to the intercommunication hose, and conveniently dismantled the maintenance and change.

title_en: Air-cooled condensation evaporator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an air-cooled condensation evaporator, wherein a fan port for mounting a fan is arranged on one side of a shell, a grid-shaped air outlet is arranged on the opposite side of the shell for mounting the fan, an air box is arranged on the side close to the fan in the shell, a condensation coil group is arranged on the side close to the air box in the shell, an evaporation coil group is arranged on the side close to the air outlet, the condensation coil group and the evaporation coil group respectively consist of a plurality of independent serpentine coils, two ends of the serpentine coils forming the condensation coil group are respectively connected and communicated with an upper condensation collecting pipe and a lower condensation collecting pipe, two ends of the serpentine coils forming the evaporation coil group are respectively connected and communicated with an upper evaporation collecting pipe and a lower evaporation collecting pipe, the upper condensation collecting pipe and the lower condensation collecting pipe are respectively provided with an air inlet pipe and an air outlet pipe, the upper evaporation collecting pipe and the lower evaporation collecting pipe are respectively provided with a liquid inlet pipe and a liquid outlet pipe, fins are arranged outside the serpentine coils, and a water receiving tray is arranged at the bottom in the shell, the utility model has the characteristics of simple structure, high heat exchange efficiency and low cost.

title_en: Filter for flue gas cleaning equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of oil smoke clarification plant, especially, relate to a filter for flue gas clarification plant, it includes: a mounting frame of regular rectangular shape; a plurality of positioning rods vertically arranged in the mounting frame; the metal filter screen is arranged in a folding type and penetrates through the positioning rod in a crossed manner; and the setting board of setting between the adjacent folding limit of metal filters, the edge of setting board respectively with the mutual butt of the adjacent folding limit of metal filters to effectively restrict metal filters's elastic deformation, and be equipped with the clamp plate at the locating lever, further carry on spacingly to metal filters in the corner of locating lever, improved the reliable and stable nature of metal filters installation, improve the area of contact of metal filters and flue gas simultaneously, improved the filter effect.

title_en: Fan and household appliance
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of household appliances, and discloses a fan and a household appliance. The fan includes: an impeller; the flow guide structure comprises a body and a connecting shaft, wherein the body is positioned inside the impeller, and one end of the connecting shaft is connected with the body; one end of the rocker is connected with the other end of the connecting shaft, and when the other end of the rocker is stressed to rotate, the rocker can drive the flow guide structure to rotate; wherein, the other end of rocker is not on the straight line that the axis of connecting axle is located. When the other end of rocker atress, the rocker drives the connecting axle and rotates, and the connecting axle and then drives the body of water conservancy diversion structure and rotate, and the body of water conservancy diversion structure is located the inside of impeller, can guide the inside air current of impeller, and then changes the air-out direction of impeller, and in addition, the other end of rocker is not on the axis of connecting axle, and the user just can rotate the water conservancy diversion structure through the other end application of force to the rocker, makes user's operation more nimble, saves strength, improves user's use and experiences. The application also discloses a household appliance.

title_en: From commercial cauldron kitchen range of mixed formula inner chamber for combustor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a self-mixing type inner chamber for a commercial big-pot stove type burner, which is in the shape of a dish of an inverted cone table, wherein the inner side surface of the inner chamber is provided with a diversion trench, the diversion trench ascends in a curve shape from bottom to top, and the diversion trench is uniformly distributed on the inner side surface of the inner chamber. The utility model is designed into an inverted cone frustum shape, and the inner side surface of the inner chamber is uniformly provided with the flow guide grooves which rise in a curve shape from bottom to top, thereby being beneficial to the convection rise of hot air on the one hand, increasing the wind resistance of the wind rotation of the ground and reducing the probability of generating the howling on the other hand.

title_en: Novel warmer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel heater, which comprises an installation base, an adjusting switch, an anti-falling switch, a wiring hole, a base shell, a power supply coupler, a first connector, a first heating pipe, a first fixed framework, a first anti-heat plate, a first coupler, a second connector, a second heating pipe, a second fixed framework, a second anti-heat plate, a second coupler, a top cover and a rotary knob, wherein the inside of the installation base is respectively provided with the adjusting switch and the anti-falling switch, and the installation base is provided with the wiring hole. The personalized requirements of the user are met, and therefore the practicability of the warmer is improved.

title_en: Preparation device of aluminum-based material for hydrogen production by hydrolysis
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of hydrolysis hydrogen production, in particular to a device for preparing an aluminum-based material for hydrolysis hydrogen production, which comprises a smelting crucible, wherein a feeding mechanism is arranged above the smelting crucible, a drainage channel is arranged at the bottom of the smelting crucible, and a stirring mechanism is arranged in the smelting crucible; the feeding mechanism comprises an aluminum-based feeding hopper, a reinforced particle feeding hopper and a plurality of metal feeders, wherein each metal feeder comprises a micro crucible, an electric heater is arranged outside the micro crucible, a discharging pipe is arranged at the bottom of the micro crucible, and the discharging pipe is communicated with the micro crucible and the smelting crucible; the smelting crucible comprises a furnace lining, a crucible is arranged in the furnace lining, a heater is arranged between the furnace lining and the outer wall of the crucible, an ultrasonic vibration plate is arranged on the inner wall of the furnace lining, and the ultrasonic vibration plate is connected with an external ultrasonic generator. The utility model can accelerate the fusion and dispersion, effectively prevent the enhanced particles from agglomerating and effectively improve the production efficiency.

title_en: Shunting air conditioner guide plate
abstract_en: The utility model provides a shunting type air conditioner flow guide plate, which relates to the field of air conditioner air outlet adjustment and comprises a flow guide body and two groups of symmetrically arranged connecting arms, wherein the flow guide body comprises a central guide plate and two groups of stretching plates, so that the air outlet adjustment of different models of hanging machines or central air conditioners can be met; and all seted up the reposition of redundant personnel air flue on tensile board and the central baffle, the outside that lies in the reposition of redundant personnel air flue on tensile board and the central baffle is equipped with the reposition of redundant personnel cover subassembly of umbrella dress, and partial cold air or hot-air flow direction reposition of redundant personnel cover subassembly from the reposition of redundant personnel air flue, and then realize the reposition of redundant personnel of air conditioner air outlet department cold air or hot-air, reduce the interference to the temperature-sensing ware of air conditioner.

title_en: Secondary refrigerant circulating system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of secondary refrigerants, in particular to a secondary refrigerant circulating system. The system includes two or more circulation paths for different coolants and are in heat transfer communication with each other; the circulating route of the first secondary refrigerant at least comprises a first route, and the first route comprises an air-cooled condenser, a throttle valve, a heat exchanger and a compressor which are sequentially connected to form a cycle, wherein the heat exchanger is used for carrying out heat transfer with the second secondary refrigerant; the circulation route of the second secondary refrigerant at least comprises a fourth route, and the fourth route comprises a heat exchanger and a secondary cooling fan which are sequentially connected to be circulated. The secondary refrigerant circulating system can coordinate different secondary refrigerant circulating routes, can meet the temperature requirements of a plurality of refrigeration points, can fully utilize cold energy, and can be used for testing the performance of the secondary refrigerant.

title_en: Water-cooling current-conducting plate heat exchange mechanism for silicon carbide production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a heat exchange mechanism of a water-cooled current-conducting plate for silicon carbide production, which comprises a heat exchange box, wherein the bottom of the heat exchange box is provided with a support frame, the top of the heat exchange box is provided with a connecting hook, two sides of the heat exchange box are movably provided with exchange arrangement plates extending to the inside of the heat exchange box, and the insides of the two exchange arrangement plates are respectively and movably provided with a heat exchange assembly penetrating through the exchange arrangement plates. This cold current conducting plate heat transfer mechanism of carborundum process water, spacing ring and detachable fixation nut through setting up, the exchange mounting plate that can make both sides is convenient for carry out the dismouting, convenient to use person clears up and maintains inside, the user is when needs are dismantled, can take off fixation nut from connecting the heat exchange tube, then demolish the exchange mounting plate of homonymy, convenient to use person clears up and maintains inside, avoid the long-time back surface adsorption impurity influence heat transfer performance that uses of spiral heat exchange tube.

title_en: Multifunctional firewood stove for field use
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a stove, in particular to a firewood stove, and particularly relates to a firewood stove with a water heating device. A multifunctional firewood stove for field use comprises a lower stove body, an upper stove body and a chimney, wherein the upper stove body and the lower stove body are cubic, the upper stove body and the lower stove body are movably connected, and a hot water pipe is arranged on the lower stove body; the lower furnace body comprises a shell, a partition plate, a hearth, an air inlet, a firewood inlet and a bracket; the air inlet and the firewood inlet are arranged on one surface of the lower furnace body, the shell and the partition plate form a hearth, and the center of the hearth is provided with an air port; the upper furnace body and the lower furnace body are connected by a lock catch. The utility model solves the problem that the field hot water is time-consuming and labor-consuming, realizes that when a traveler cooks or barbecues in the field, water enters the pipeline from the water inlet of the hot water pipe, and hot water is discharged from the water outlet, is convenient and quick for the traveler, and also saves time and labor. And when barbecuing, the charcoal fire box is arranged at the furnace mouth twice, so that oil can not drop into the charcoal fire box, and smokeless barbecuing is realized.

title_en: Assembling mechanism of pulse igniter
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an assembly mechanism of a pulse igniter, which comprises a valve main body and an igniter device, wherein the valve main body is provided with a valve seat, an ignition starting switch is arranged on the valve seat, a first terminal part extending outwards is connected to the ignition starting switch, the igniter device is fixedly connected with the valve main body, the igniter device comprises a circuit board, a second terminal part extending outwards is arranged on the circuit board, the first terminal part and the second terminal part are spliced to enable the ignition starting switch to be electrically connected with the circuit board, and the circuit board and the ignition starting switch can be electrically connected without a lead.

title_en: Indoor movable spray snow-making machine
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of snow makers, and particularly relates to an indoor movable type spray snow maker, which comprises: a chassis; the snow spray maker is connected with the chassis and used for forming snow cores, adding water mist and spraying the water mist, and comprises an outdoor air compression assembly, an outdoor cold water assembly and an indoor snow spraying assembly; the air compression assembly comprises: an air compression member; and a freeze dryer connected to the air compressor; the cold water assembly includes: a water chiller; and a pressurizing assembly connected with the water chiller; in the embodiment, the air compression assembly, the cold water assembly and the snow spraying assembly are combined, so that the snow spraying device can move to spray snow, and meanwhile, the snow spraying quality and the snow generating effect are ensured.

title_en: Low temperature deNOx systems in carbide slag production cement clinker kiln tail flue gas
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kiln tail flue gas medium-low temperature denitration system for producing cement clinker by carbide slag, which mainly solves the problems that the temperature of an air outlet of a preheater C1 is high, and a catalyst at a high temperature section is easy to sinter; the flue gas temperature after drying and breaking is low, the low temperature section can not reach the SCR reaction temperature window requirement, and the environmental protection problem of the ultra-low emission requirement of NOX is also met under the working condition. Secondly, the problem of SNCR denitration inefficiency has been solved. The system comprises: the decomposing furnace is internally provided with an SNCR ammonia spraying system; the inlet of the electric dust collector is communicated with the air outlet of the decomposing furnace and is used for carrying out dust fall treatment on the high-temperature dust-containing flue gas from the decomposing furnace; the inlet of the heat exchanger is respectively communicated with the air outlet of the electric dust collector and the air outlet of the grate cooler and is used for carrying out heat exchange on the high-temperature dust-containing flue gas from the grate cooler and the low-temperature flue gas from the electric dust collector; and the inlet of the SCR reactor is communicated with the air outlet of the heat exchanger and is used for carrying out reduction reaction on the flue gas to be treated from the heat exchanger and discharging the flue gas reaching the standard.

title_en: Integrated kitchen with cooking device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an integrated cooker with a cooking device, which comprises the cooking device with a box body and a cooker, wherein the cooker comprises a cooker shell, the cooker shell comprises a base plate and a panel, an exhaust window is arranged on the rear side of the panel, an exhaust cavity and a heat dissipation channel are respectively arranged in the cooker shell of the cooker, the exhaust cavity is provided with an air inlet and an air outlet which is communicated with the exhaust window in a fluid mode, the heat dissipation channel is provided with a heat dissipation fan, an air outlet port of the heat dissipation channel is communicated with the air inlet of the exhaust cavity in a fluid mode, a heat dissipation gap is formed between the bottom surface of the base plate of the cooker and the top surface of the box body of the cooking device, a lower air inlet of the heat dissipation fan is arranged on the bottom wall of the base plate, and an air inlet fan is arranged for feeding air through the lower air inlet. Compared with the prior art, the integrated cooker has good heat dissipation effect and high heat dissipation efficiency, and can avoid overhigh temperature of the working environment of the cooker and the electric elements in the cooking device.

title_en: Bubble water generating device and water heater
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bubble water generating device and a water heater, wherein the bubble water generating device comprises: the device comprises a body, a water inlet, a communication port and a bubble water outlet, wherein a mixing cavity is formed in the body, and the body is provided with the water inlet, the communication port and the bubble water outlet which are communicated with the mixing cavity; the hot water pipe is communicated with the water inlet and is provided with a first water valve; one end of the connecting pipe is communicated with the hot water pipe, the other end of the connecting pipe is communicated with the communicating port, and a second water valve is arranged on the connecting pipe; the bubble generation assembly is arranged on the connecting pipe and is communicated with the mixing cavity; and the controller is respectively electrically connected with the first water valve, the second water valve and the bubble generation assembly. Its simple structure takes place the work of subassembly through the bubble and in order to obtain the bubble water of different dissolved air volumes to effectively improve user's use and experience.

title_en: Steel rolling finished product waste heat power generation device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a steel rolling finished product waste heat power generation device, which comprises a recovery system and a power generation system; the recovery systems are in a plurality of groups, and each group of recovery systems comprises a heat collection cover, a hot air collection branch pipe, a hot air collection main pipe and an induced draft fan; the heat collecting covers are arranged above the cooling bed and are arranged along the width direction of the cooling bed, the top of each heat collecting cover is communicated to a hot air collecting main pipe, the hot air collecting main pipe is provided with an induced draft fan, and an air outlet of the induced draft fan is connected to other heat utilization units of a factory; the heat collecting cover is characterized in that a plurality of circles of heat exchange coil pipes are spirally arranged inside the heat collecting cover along the shape of the cover body, and the power generation system comprises a cold end heat exchanger, a hot end heat exchanger and a power generation assembly. The utility model fully recovers the heat emitted by the high-temperature rolled steel finished product, generates electricity through a power generation system by producing hot water through the preheater and the heat exchange coil pipe, and provides three resources of hot air, hot water and electricity for factories, thereby realizing full utilization of the waste heat of the rolled steel finished product and saving energy.

title_en: Connector for photovoltaic support
abstract_en: The utility model provides a connector for a photovoltaic bracket, which comprises: the connector comprises a connector body, a limiting member and a fastening member. The joint body is provided with an upper joint and a lower joint which are mutually jointed, and the joint of the two joints is configured into a seat-shaped structure. The limiting component comprises a first limiting part and a second limiting part, the first limiting part is in sliding contact joint with the upper joint, the upper joint can allow the first limiting part to select a height position along the vertical direction to implement transverse sliding contact and limit the first limiting part in the joint, and the second limiting part is embedded and assembled with the first limiting part arranged in the upper joint to form an inserting hole. The fastening member can wear to locate the top connection and the adaptation is to being docked in the spliced eye to restriction stop member continues the activity along its sliding contact direction, and attaches stop member lock in the top connection. The direct matching of the plugging mode is cancelled, the flexible and convenient assembly of each structure is guaranteed, the mutual separation of each component is limited, and the mounting effect is particularly obvious.

title_en: Boiler with heat is recycled
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of boilers, in particular to a boiler with heat recycling function, which comprises a supporting plate, a boiler and a secondary boiler device, wherein the left side of the upper surface of the supporting plate is fixedly connected with the boiler, the lower surface in the boiler is fixedly connected with a track, pulleys are connected in the track in a sliding manner, the outer side of each pulley is fixedly connected with a combustion chamber, the lower part of an air blower is fixedly connected with the lower surface in the boiler, the center of the boiler is fixedly connected with a supporting screen plate, the right side of the secondary boiler device is provided with a processing pipe, the lower part of the left side of the boiler chamber is fixedly connected with a water outlet pipe, the outer side of the water outlet pipe is fixedly connected with the interior of the boiler, the left side above the boiler chamber is fixedly connected with a first water inlet pipe, the outer side of the first water inlet pipe is fixedly connected with the interior of the boiler, in the utility model, the guide rail can be used for conveniently cleaning slag through the arranged combustion chamber, meanwhile, the combustion efficiency is improved, and the utilization rate of heat in the waste gas can be improved through the auxiliary boiler device.

title_en: Screen sound production device and air conditioner
abstract_en: The utility model provides a screen sounding device and an air conditioner. Wherein, screen sound generating mechanism includes: a screen panel; a fixing member; the screen panel comprises an electromagnetic induction structure, wherein one end of the electromagnetic induction structure is connected with the fixing component, the other end of the electromagnetic induction structure is connected with a vibration channel, and the vibration channel is connected with the screen panel. The screen sound production device provided by the utility model integrates the sound production device and the screen panel, so that the overall volume of the air conditioner is reduced, a structure corresponding to a sound amplification system is not required to be additionally arranged, and the overall manufacturing cost is reduced.

title_en: Copper-clad ceramic substrate single-sided sintering jig
abstract_en: The utility model provides a copper-clad ceramic substrate single-sided sintering jig which comprises a bottom gasket, wherein the bottom gasket comprises a middle part, four hollowed parts are arranged on one side surface of the middle part in a rectangular array, the hollowed parts form a cross with the middle part, the cross comprises two long shafts and two short shafts, the short shafts are arranged perpendicular to the long shafts, one ends of the two long shafts are respectively connected with a left end part and a right end part, a left strip for supporting a copper-clad ceramic carrier plate is arranged on the upper surface of the left end part, and a right strip for supporting the copper-clad ceramic carrier plate is arranged on the upper surface of the right end part, so that compared with the prior art, the copper-clad ceramic substrate single-sided sintering jig has the following beneficial effects: the direct contact between the isolated ceramic chip and the mesh belt is realized, and the heat is effectively transferred.

title_en: Radiator and air conditioning system with same
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of heat dissipation equipment, in particular to a radiator and an air conditioning system with the same. A radiator comprises a radiator core body which is used for heat exchange in contact with a heating source; the radiator core is connected with or a heat exchange channel is constructed in the radiator core; a flow limiting cavity is arranged at the end part of the heat exchange channel connecting the input pipe and the output pipe, a flow restrictor moving axially is arranged in the flow limiting cavity, a micro-channel is arranged in the flow restrictor, and a flow channel is formed between the flow restrictor and the side wall of the flow limiting cavity; the flow passage is blocked only when the restrictor is pressed against the inner end chamber port of the flow-restricting chamber under fluid impact pressure. The current limiter arranged in the radiator can play a throttling and evaporating role on a cooling medium in the air-conditioning system, so that a foundation is laid for improving the cooling effect of the radiator connected into the air-conditioning system.

title_en: Rapid Assembly formula phase transition module board
abstract_en: The utility model provides a rapid assembly type phase change module plate, which comprises a module plate base layer, a phase change supporting layer, a module plate suspension layer, a hydroelectric functional device and a sealing element, wherein the module plate base layer is provided with a plurality of grooves; the module board base layer comprises a hard support plate and an isolation layer; the lower end surface of the hard support plate is in contact with the ground, and the upper end surface of the hard support plate is in contact with the lower end surface of the isolation layer; and the lower end face of the isolation layer is contacted with the upper end face of the hard support plate, and the upper end face of the isolation layer is contacted with the phase change support layer.

title_en: Smoke machine lamp decoration panel
abstract_en: The embodiment of the utility model discloses a lighting panel of a cigarette machine, which comprises a base plate, a lamp assembly and a human body induction assembly, wherein the base plate is provided with a front side wall, a back side wall and a lamp assembly mounting hole, the front side wall is provided with an induction assembly mounting block, the induction assembly mounting block is provided with a lens mounting hole, the lens mounting hole penetrates through the back side wall, the human body induction assembly is mounted on the induction assembly mounting block, the human body induction assembly comprises an induction lens, the induction lens faces to the back side wall from the front side wall, the induction lens is arranged in the lens mounting hole, the lamp assembly is arranged in the lamp assembly mounting hole, and the human body induction assembly is electrically connected with the lamp assembly. The cigarette machine lamp assembly has the advantages that the human body sensing assembly senses a moving object to control the lamp assembly to be turned on and off, the lamp on the cigarette machine is turned on and off in a non-contact mode, the problem that the switch of the cigarette machine lamp is prone to failure due to long-term pressing is solved, and the cigarette machine lamp assembly is convenient for users to use.

title_en: Air conditioning system
abstract_en: The present invention provides an air conditioning system comprising: the air conditioning system comprises a first boiling point refrigerant and a second boiling point refrigerant, the boiling point of the first boiling point refrigerant is less than that of the second boiling point refrigerant, one end of the outdoor first heat exchanger can be communicated to an exhaust end or a suction end of the compressor, and the other end of the outdoor first heat exchanger can be communicated to one end of the outdoor second heat exchanger and/or one end of the outdoor third heat exchanger; the other end of the outdoor second heat exchanger and the other end of the outdoor third heat exchanger can be communicated with one end of the indoor heat exchanger after being mixed, and the other end of the indoor heat exchanger can be communicated to a suction end or a discharge end of the compressor. According to the utility model, the main condenser does not frost or relieves the frosting speed, and the defrosting and defrosting can be realized while the system stably heats through the alternate work of the 2 auxiliary heat exchangers, so that the comfort of the indoor environment is improved.

title_en: Self-circulation water pump cooling water system of water heater
abstract_en: A water heater self-circulation water pump cooling water system.
