Because the water temperature at the outlet of the water heater is too high, the water needs to be cooled by a heat exchanger. The cooling water source is taken from a tap water pipeline and is discharged after heat exchange of the heat exchanger, so that great economic loss is caused. The utility model comprises the following components: the water supply pipeline is respectively communicated with a heat exchanger (10) of the water heater heat exchange system to supply water for the heat exchanger, and a water outlet of a water delivery tank (9) of the water heater heat exchange system is communicated with the outdoor sewage discharge cooling system through a water discharge pipeline (8); and a cooling water pipeline (4) of the outdoor sewage draining and cooling system is communicated to the water supply pipeline. The utility model is used for the self-circulation cooling of the water heater.

title_en: Open pneumatic mechanism of aluminum alloy heat preservation furnace top
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an open type pneumatic mechanism of an aluminum alloy heat preservation furnace top, which comprises a furnace body and a furnace cover, wherein a cylinder support is arranged on the furnace body, a cylinder is arranged on the cylinder support and comprises a cylinder body and a cylinder head, the bottom end of the cylinder body is movably connected onto the cylinder support, one end of the furnace cover is connected onto the furnace body in a turnover mode, the other end of the furnace cover is movably connected with the cylinder head, and the cylinder is used for ejecting and closing the furnace cover. The utility model replaces the existing mode that the speed reducing motor drives the steel cable to lift the furnace cover upwards by utilizing the mode that the cylinder drives the furnace cover upwards, can quickly start and efficiently open the furnace cover, improves the opening efficiency of the furnace cover, does not have any other factors to interfere in the whole opening mechanism, has extremely high stability in opening and closing the furnace cover, simplifies the whole structure of the pneumatic mechanism compared with the existing opening mechanism, is convenient for subsequent maintenance and replacement, and ensures the continuous use effect of the pneumatic mechanism.

title_en: Box-type device for artificial negative electrode material graphitization furnace of lithium battery
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of box bodies for graphitizing furnaces, in particular to a box-type device for a lithium battery artificial negative electrode material graphitizing furnace, which consists of a plurality of box bodies; the box body comprises a bottom plate, a top plate, a middle plate, a plurality of side plates and a plurality of partition plates; the bottom plate is arranged at the bottom of the partition plate; the top plate is arranged at the top of the partition plate; the side plate is clamped on one side of the partition plate; the middle plate is clamped in the center of the partition plate; a first slot, a second slot and a third slot are respectively formed in one side of the partition plate; and a fourth slot, a fifth slot and a sixth slot are respectively formed in the other side of the partition plate. The utility model provides a box-type device for an artificial negative electrode material graphitization furnace of a lithium battery, which has low cost and is easy to install.

title_en: Novel flue gas waste heat recovery system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a novel flue gas waste heat recovery system, which comprises: the system comprises a flue gas cooler, a flue gas condenser, a flue gas heater, a heating medium water pump and a condensed water heater; the outlet of the air preheater is connected with the flue gas inlet of the flue gas cooler, the flue gas outlet of the flue gas cooler is connected with the inlet of the desulfurization absorption tower, the outlet of the desulfurization absorption tower is connected with the inlet of the flue gas condenser, the outlet of the flue gas condenser is connected with the flue gas inlet of the flue gas heater, and the flue gas outlet of the flue gas heater is connected with the chimney; the outlet of the heat medium water pump is connected with the heat medium water side inlet of the flue gas cooler, the heat medium water at the outlet of the flue gas cooler is divided into two branches, one branch of heat medium water is connected with the heat medium water side inlet of the flue gas heater, and the other branch of heat medium water is connected with the heat medium water side inlet of the condensed water heater. The utility model has the beneficial effects that: through setting up the flue gas condenser, reduced flue gas humidity, make full use of the comdenstion water in the flue gas, reached water conservation, energy-conserving purpose.

title_en: Burner capable of promoting combustion and fuel oil device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a combustor and a fuel device capable of promoting combustion, wherein the combustor comprises a burner tip, and the burner tip comprises a cavity structure with a burner port; the burner also comprises a fuel inlet arranged in the combustion nozzle cavity; the filling material is partially or completely positioned in the combustion nozzle cavity; the filler is made of metal and is provided with a screen plate structure or a flocculent structure; the mesh plate structure or the flocculent structure is located on a fuel oil ejection track of the fuel oil inlet. The fuel oil device comprises the burner. The scheme provides a technical scheme which aims at achieving the purpose of fuel gasification, is simple in structure and convenient to realize stable combustion.

title_en: Phase-change material based energy storage vehicle-mounted refrigerator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a phase-change material-based energy storage vehicle-mounted refrigerator, which is characterized in that a compressor forms a refrigeration and freezing functional circulation loop; a refrigeration function circulation loop; a refrigeration function circulation loop; a heating function circulation loop; a refrigeration and heating function circulation loop; and a freezing and heating function circulation loop. The utility model can keep the temperature of the freezing chamber and the refrigerating chamber of the refrigerator for a long time under the condition of power failure, realizes the heating function of the refrigerator under the condition of not increasing the power consumption of the automobile, and has good reusability.

title_en: Heat exchange coil structure of running water integrated water heater
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a heat exchange coil structure of a running water integrated water heater, which is arranged in an inner container of a shower screen, wherein the inner container stores water and is provided with an electric heater, and tap water in the heat exchange coil absorbs heat stored in the inner container to become hot water and then leaves the inner container; the spiral coil pipe is a section of spirally coiled pipe, the spiral coil pipe is coiled upwards from the bottom area of the inner container, and then the spiral coil pipe turns downwards in an inverted U shape at the top of the inner container until reaching the middle position of the inner container. According to the utility model, the spiral coil is arranged in the inner container in an inverted U shape, and the water outlet end of the spiral coil extends to the middle part of the inner container, so that the flowing water outlet end of the spiral coil is prevented from being immersed in the water body at the lower temperature at the bottom of the inner container, and the hot water output rate is improved.

title_en: Distillation retort with built-in heat exchange device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a distillation retort with a built-in heat exchange device, which comprises a bottom plate, a utilization box, a retort body and a coil pipe, wherein supporting legs are symmetrically welded at the lower end of the retort body, the bottom ends of the supporting legs are fixed on one side of the upper surface of the bottom plate through bolts, a supporting seat is welded at the lower surface of the bottom plate, a retort cover is clamped on the upper surface of the retort body, a condensation pipe is inserted and installed on the retort cover, the other end of the condensation pipe is movably inserted and installed on the utilization box, the utilization box is fixed on the other side of the upper surface of the bottom plate through bolts, the coil pipe is sleeved on the condensation pipe, a water inlet is arranged at one end of the coil pipe, a water outlet is arranged at the other end of the coil pipe, and the ends of the water inlet and the water outlet are all embedded and fixed on the utilization box. The utility model has compact structure and convenient use, is convenient for utilizing the waste heat in the distillation process and meets the use requirements of personnel.

title_en: Blowdown even drainage heat recovery system and glass melting furnace waste gas heat recovery system
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of heat recovery, and provides a blowdown continuous drainage heat recovery system and a glass melting furnace waste gas heat recovery system, wherein the blowdown continuous drainage heat recovery system comprises an exhaust-heat boiler, a steam distributing cylinder, a flash tank, a first pipeline, a second pipeline and a third pipeline, the steam distributing cylinder is communicated with the exhaust-heat boiler through the first pipeline, the flash tank is communicated with the exhaust-heat boiler through the second pipeline, one end of the third pipeline is connected to the second pipeline, and the other end of the third pipeline is connected to the first pipeline; the glass melting furnace waste gas heat recovery system comprises a blowdown continuous exhaust heat recovery system. The application provides a blowdown even drainage heat recovery system through the third pipeline will follow in the exhaust blowdown even drainage introduction steam-splitting cylinder in the exhaust-heat boiler steam pocket for the blowdown even the heat of drainage can be by recycle, has not only solved the blowdown even the unable recycle's of heat of drainage technical problem, still is favorable to reducing the consumption to exhaust-heat boiler main steam, thereby plays energy saving and consumption reduction's effect.

title_en: Solar heating system
abstract_en: The application discloses solar heating system, this system include solar collector 1, hot water storage tank 2, fan coil 3, circulating water pump 4, solar cell panel 11, battery 12 and charge-discharge controller 13. The water outlet 101 of the solar heat collector 1 is connected with the first water inlet 201 of the hot water storage tank 2, and the water inlet 102 of the solar heat collector 1 is connected with the first water outlet 202 of the hot water storage tank 2; the third water outlet 301 of the fan coil 3 is connected with the second water inlet 203 of the hot water storage tank 2 through the circulating water pump 4, and the third water inlet 302 of the fan coil 3 is connected with the second water outlet 204 of the hot water storage tank 2. The bottom of the heat storage water tank 2 is higher than the top of the solar heat collector 1. The solar cell panel 11, the storage battery 12, the circulating water pump 4 and the fan 31 of the fan coil 3 are all connected with the charge-discharge controller 13. The application discloses solar heating system reduces the consumer, need not external power supply, and the system operation is simple reliable, and the maintenance cost is low.

title_en: Adjustable central air conditioner disinfection and purification device and system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an adjustable central air-conditioning disinfection and purification device and system. The plasma filter comprises a shell, a primary filter screen, a plasma generator, an air inlet, an air outlet and a power supply system, wherein the air inlet and the air outlet are arranged on two sides of the shell in parallel; the primary filter screen and the plasma generator are arranged in the shell and are arranged in parallel with the air inlet and the air outlet; the shell is matched with the size of the central air-conditioning air outlet pipeline opening in a sealing way, so that the device air inlet is communicated with the central air-conditioning air outlet pipeline opening, and the device air outlet is aligned to the inner side of the wall grille of the central air-conditioning air outlet. Need not to reform transform former central air conditioning system, this device can be installed directly through the grid of dismantling the wall air outlet, does not account for the interior space, and utilizes the circulated air that central air conditioning formed after the installation, through the disinfection of this device and purifies, can kill bacterium and virus to the indoor air circulation, gets rid of PM2.5, smog, peculiar smell.

title_en: Observation window structure for isolation door of clean workshop
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an observation window structure for a clean workshop isolation door, which comprises a fixed frame, a right glass plate, a left glass plate, a right panel and a left panel, wherein the left end and the right end of the fixed frame are inner positioning frames; the right glass plate and the left glass plate are respectively embedded into frame holes of the right inner positioning frame and the left inner positioning frame, are attached to the inner rubber pads and form a closed cavity together with the fixing frame; the right panel is back shape platelike structure, and the shape frame of returning of left side wall is the strip groove on the lateral wall for outer positioning frame, frame hole is the spout, the structure of left side panel is the same with the structure of right panel, and bilateral symmetry, outer positioning frame cover on the right side is on the interior positioning frame on right side, outer positioning frame cover on the left side panel is on the left interior positioning frame. The utility model is convenient for disassembly and assembly and is convenient for replacing the glass plate.

title_en: Shell assembly and electrical equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides a shell assembly and electrical equipment, wherein the shell assembly comprises a body, a wire passing hole and an elastic assembly, wherein the wire passing hole is formed in the body; the elastic component is connected with the body and arranged in the wire passing hole. According to the shell assembly provided by the utility model, the elastic assembly is arranged in the wire passing hole of the body, so that when the elastic assembly in the wire group wire passing hole is stressed, the elastic assembly deforms, and then the wiring terminal can pass through the elastic assembly, after the elastic assembly passes through the wiring terminal, the elastic assembly loses external force, and the elastic assembly is recovered to the original shape, so that the elastic assembly can block the wiring terminal on the wire group, the wiring terminal is prevented from falling off from the wire passing hole provided with the elastic assembly, the situation that the terminal and the wire group can fall into the inside of a host machine in a transportation process is avoided, and other wire clamp structures are not required to be additionally arranged, and the wire group and the wiring terminal can be effectively fixed.

title_en: Heat-resisting sealed air door for boiler
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of air doors, and relates to a heat-resistant sealing air door for a boiler, which comprises a fixing frame, a through hole and a first transmission bin, wherein the through hole is formed in the surface of the fixing frame, the first transmission bin is formed in the fixing frame, the inner wall of the first transmission bin is fixedly connected with a support, and the support is fixedly connected with a motor. Its beneficial effect is, this heat-resisting sealed air door for boiler, through first bevel gear, the cooperation of second bevel gear and air door baffle, when people need adjust the position of air door baffle, people only need open sealing door board earlier, then people pass through the operation of control switch control motor, it rotates to drive first pivot, at first bevel gear, under the cooperation of second bevel gear and second pivot, can drive the rotation of air door baffle, when the air door baffle rotates to suitable position, people can be through control switch control motor stop function, the position of people's adjustment air door baffle has been made things convenient for, the people of being convenient for control the intake.

title_en: Constant-temperature efficient air energy water heater
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a constant-temperature high-efficiency air energy water heater, which relates to the technical field of air energy water heaters and comprises a water heater body, wherein a heat exchange assembly is arranged inside the water heater body, a water delivery pipe is connected below the heat exchange assembly, the bottom end of the water delivery pipe is connected with a constant temperature box arranged on the inner wall of the water heater body, the bottom end of the constant temperature box is provided with a temperature regulating box, the end surface of the temperature regulating box is connected with a water inlet pipe, the bottom end of the temperature regulating box is provided with a constant temperature box, the inner wall of the constant temperature box is provided with a water outlet control valve, the inner wall of the constant temperature box is provided with a water outlet cavity connected with an output port of the water outlet control valve, and the water outlet cavity is internally provided with a water outlet cavity. The constant-temperature water tank effectively solves the problem of inconvenient use of a user due to different water temperatures in the constant-temperature tank through the water inlet pipe, the electric control valve, the temperature regulating tank, the input pipe, the output pipe, the water pump and the constant-temperature tank; the precision of the temperature sensor is improved through the impeller, the stirring shaft and the stirring blade.

title_en: Touch screen control box for operating air energy water heater
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a touch screen control box for operating an air energy water heater, which relates to the technical field of water heater control boxes and comprises a mounting box, wherein a mounting cavity is arranged on the surface of the front end of the mounting box, and a control box main body is clamped and fixed in the mounting cavity; according to the utility model, the mounting box is mounted on the wall through the fixing bolt, the control box main body is clamped and fixed in the mounting cavity of the mounting box, and the mounting position of the control box main body is changed, so that people can remotely control the water heater, the requirements of different users can be met, the applicability is wider, the sliding block is pushed by matching the compression spring with the telescopic rod, and the sliding block can be matched with the first connecting strip and the second connecting strip to support the cover plate when sliding.

title_en: Ice extrusion type ice maker
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an ice extrusion type ice making machine which comprises a machine shell, an inner container, an ice basket, an ice making mechanism, a top water tank and a top cover, wherein the inner container is arranged in the machine shell; the inner container comprises a fixing ring and a container body, the container body comprises a placing part and a water storage part, and the ice basket is arranged in the placing part; the top water tank is of a thin shell structure with an opening at the upper end and a C-shaped cross section and is arranged in a rear annular hole of the fixing ring; the ice making mechanism is arranged in the C-shaped opening of the top water tank, the top water tank is connected with the ice making mechanism through a water supplementing pipe, the water storage part is connected with the top water tank through a water supply pipe, and a water supply pump is arranged on the water supply pipe; the upper port of the shell is butted on the lower surface of the fixed ring; the top cover is arranged on the fixing ring. The components of the ice making machine are reasonably and compactly arranged, the overall size of the ice making machine is effectively reduced, meanwhile, automatic water replenishing of the ice making mechanism can be realized by controlling the water level of the top water tank, and the continuous normal work of the ice making machine is ensured.

title_en: Beryllium copper is with high-efficient smelting furnace
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a beryllium copper efficient smelting furnace which comprises an outer furnace body, a heating electromagnetic ring, a telescopic driving mechanism and a heating wire ring group, wherein a vacuum reaction mechanism is installed at the top of the outer part of the outer furnace body, a first feeding pipe is connected to one end of the top of the outer furnace body, a second feeding pipe is connected to the other end of the top of the outer furnace body, a control panel is installed on the front surface of the outer part of the outer furnace body, and a first discharging pipe is connected to one side of the bottom of the outer furnace body. According to the utility model, the heating electromagnetic ring is wrapped on the outer layer of the heating pot body through accessories such as the heating pot body, the heating electromagnetic ring and the supporting plate, the heating electromagnetic ring is connected with the vacuum reaction mechanism to realize high-temperature heating of the heating pot body to start refining work on the internal solution, the whole heating pot body is stably fixed into the outer furnace body through the matching of the supporting plate and the fixing screw piece, the smelting speed is improved, and the high-efficiency and stable performances are achieved.

title_en: Volute component, fresh air module and air conditioner
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses volute component, fresh air module and air conditioner. The volute component comprises a volute cover, a first volute and a second volute, the volute cover and the second volute are enclosed to form an air inlet cavity, the first volute and the second volute are enclosed to form an air outlet cavity, and a partition plate of the second volute is located between the air inlet cavity and the air outlet cavity and is provided with a through hole to communicate the air inlet cavity and the air outlet cavity. The volute cover is provided with a first end face and a plurality of first side faces, and the side walls of the air inlet cavity are formed by the first side faces, so that the air inlet cavity is positioned on the volute cover; the first volute is provided with a second end face and a plurality of second side faces, and the plurality of second side faces form a side wall of the air outlet cavity, so that the air outlet cavity is located on the first volute. Compared with the traditional method that the air inlet cavity and the air outlet cavity are split on different parts, the structure can ensure the integrity of the air inlet cavity and the air outlet cavity, avoid the situation that the side walls of the air inlet cavity and the air outlet cavity deform under the long-term impact of fluid to cause poor sealing performance, and reduce the risk of air leakage of the volute component.

title_en: Refractory brick for kiln tail smoke chamber
abstract_en: The utility model provides a refractory brick for a kiln tail smoke chamber, which comprises a refractory brick I and a refractory brick II, wherein the refractory brick II is positioned at the top of the refractory brick I; the ventilation assembly is arranged between the first refractory brick and the second refractory brick and comprises a cavity, and a first airflow channel is formed in the first refractory brick so as to discharge hot air in the cavity through the first airflow channel; the positioning assembly is arranged between the first refractory brick and the second refractory brick so as to perform auxiliary connection between the first refractory brick and the second refractory brick through the positioning assembly. The utility model discloses an effectively prevented at the in-process of production and processing, because the fragment of brick is solid material, the steam that central point put the department gives off slower, leads to the inside steam of resistant firebrick and moisture can't obtain timely emission to influence resistant firebrick in use's exhaust performance and heat conductivility's problem.

title_en: Radiator assembly convenient to dismouting
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of radiators, and particularly discloses a radiator assembly convenient to disassemble and assemble, which comprises a radiator body and an installation plane, wherein the radiator body is integrally of a square structure, radiating fins are arranged at the upper part of the radiator body, and air holes are formed in two sides of the radiator body; the bottom of the radiator body is provided with an installation block, and a strip-shaped installation groove is formed in an installation plane; the section of the mounting block is of a trapezoidal structure, the mounting groove is correspondingly arranged, and the mounting block is clamped in the mounting groove in a matching manner; the radiator body is hollow and is provided with a heat conducting plate, and the heat conducting plate is connected with the top and the bottom of the inner cavity of the radiator body; the radiator provided by the utility model is slidably arranged in the mounting groove, the mounting mode is simple and stable, and the radiator is convenient to disassemble, assemble and maintain; due to the arrangement of the heat conducting plate structure, heat can be well conveyed, so that the heat radiating effect is ensured; the device has simple integral structure and reasonable design.

title_en: Artificial intelligence hot and cold water circulation variable frequency water pump controller based on singlechip
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an artificial intelligent cold and hot water circulating variable frequency water pump controller based on a single chip microcomputer. According to the scheme, the special artificial intelligence self-adaptive operation mode of the central processing unit adopts the mathematical modeling, tracking control, extreme value searching and optimization control technology of the nonlinear dynamic control system to intelligently learn the habits of using domestic hot water (shower and washing) of a user, and then the water pump is automatically started to circularly heat and preserve heat according to the using time point of the user, so that the user can enjoy comfortable and sanitary hot water. In the later daily life, if the use habits of the user change, the intelligent control can automatically learn and adapt to adjust the operation mode in real time.

title_en: Energy-saving scale prevention closed cooling circulation device for thermal power plant
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an energy-saving and anti-scaling closed cooling circulation device for a thermal power plant, and belongs to the field of closed cooling circulation. The energy-saving and anti-scaling closed cooling circulating device for the thermal power plant comprises a cooling pipe, wherein a motor is fixedly connected to the cooling pipe, a lead screw is fixedly connected to the output end of the motor, a sliding block is connected to the lead screw in a threaded manner, and a scraper is fixedly connected to the sliding block; the cooling device also comprises a filter box fixedly connected to the cooling pipe, wherein the filter box is communicated with the cooling pipe, a partition plate is fixedly connected in the filter box, a water receiving plate is fixedly connected between the partition plate and the filter box, and a filter hole is formed in the water receiving plate; according to the utility model, the scraper plate on the sliding block is driven by the screw rod to scrape scale attached to the inner wall of the bottom of the cooling pipe, so that the corrosion of the cooling pipe caused by the residual scale on the cooling pipe is reduced, the heat conduction effect of the cooling pipe is improved, and the service life of the cooling pipe is prolonged.

title_en: Ceiling hidden type air outlet panel electric appliance and electric appliance system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a ceiling hidden type air outlet panel electric appliance and an electric appliance system. The ceiling hidden type air outlet panel electric appliance provided by the utility model is used on an electric appliance system, the electric appliance system is arranged above a ceiling in an indoor space, the electric appliance system is provided with an air outlet channel, the ceiling hidden type air outlet panel electric appliance is arranged opposite to the air outlet channel, the ceiling hidden type air outlet panel electric appliance comprises a support piece, a driving mechanism and at least one air outlet panel, the support piece is opposite to the air outlet channel, the support piece is provided with an air outlet, the air outlet panel is movably arranged on one side of the support piece, which is far away from the air outlet channel, the driving mechanism is arranged on the support piece, and the driving mechanism is used for driving the air outlet panel to move so as to shield or expose the air outlet, so that the air outlet can be hidden when the ceiling is not used, on one hand, external dust or impurities can be avoided, and on the other hand, the ceiling in the indoor space can be enabled to be more neat and beautiful.

title_en: Pneumatic Stirling expander without spring support
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a spring-free supported pneumatic Stirling expander which comprises a cylinder (1), a piston (2), a base (3), a rear end cover (4) and a limiter assembly (5), wherein the rear end cover (4) is positioned at the rear end of the cylinder (1), the base (3) is positioned between the rear end cover (4) and the cylinder (1), two ends of the base (3) are fixedly connected with the rear end cover (4) and the cylinder (1) respectively, the piston (2) is arranged in a cavity formed by the cylinder (1), the base (3) and the rear end cover (4), and the limiter assembly (5) is arranged in the rear end cover (4). The dynamic balance of the piston during the work of the expansion machine is matched with the rotor quality and the cavity volume of the piston, the piston is supported by the gas spring to reciprocate, the limitation caused by the spring is eliminated, the processing and labor cost are reduced, the performance loss caused by installation is avoided, and the Stirling expansion machine is produced in batches and operated efficiently.

title_en: Angle-adjustable conveying device for boiler coal feeder
abstract_en: The utility model provides an angle-adjustable conveying device for a boiler coal feeder, which comprises a coal feeder, a base and a transmission mechanism, wherein the transmission mechanism comprises a first rotating shaft and a second rotating shaft, a reciprocating motor is arranged at one end of the first rotating shaft, a first transmission wheel is arranged at the other end of the first rotating shaft, a second transmission wheel is arranged on the surface of the second rotating shaft, the first transmission wheel is in transmission connection with the second transmission wheel through a transmission belt, first pulley assemblies are arranged at two ends of the second rotating shaft, a second pulley assembly is arranged on the inner side of the top of the base, a third pulley assembly is arranged at the top of the coal feeder, the first pulley assemblies, the second pulley assemblies and the third pulley assemblies are in transmission connection through wear-resistant ropes, an auxiliary mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the coal feeder, and a hinge is arranged at the bottom of the coal feeder. Connecting axle and installation piece. The utility model realizes convenient adjustment of the discharging angle, can stably and accurately adjust the angle and improves the practicability of the device.

title_en: Assembled multifunctional integrated board
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of indoor decoration, and relates to an assembly type multifunctional integrated plate, which comprises a plurality of substrate components, wherein adjacent substrate components are connected in an assembly manner, each substrate component comprises a panel and a bottom plate, the panels and the bottom plates are connected in a disassembly manner, the bottom plates are respectively arranged at intervals in an arrangement manner in the longitudinal direction and the transverse direction and are provided with supporting plates, a longitudinal guide groove is formed between the adjacent longitudinally arranged supporting plates, a transverse guide groove is formed between the adjacent transversely arranged supporting plates, and the longitudinal guide groove and the transverse guide groove are mutually communicated; the utility model discloses according to the on-the-spot particular case of fitment, through the permutation and combination to basic unit spare difference, produce assembled panel and bottom plate of various differences, be equipped with a plurality of faggings respectively on vertical and horizontal of bottom plate, adjacent fagging constitutes vertical guide way and horizontal guide way respectively on vertical and horizontal, communicates each other between the two, reaches the UNICOM of multiple direction to realize electric wire, net twine, supply water and the pipeline such as warm up and synthesize the multiple functions of rational arrangement.

title_en: Heat dissipation mechanism for metallurgical equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of metallurgy, and discloses a heat dissipation mechanism for metallurgical equipment, which comprises a fixing pin penetrating through the upper surface of a fixing plate, wherein a placing box is arranged on the upper surface of the fixing plate, ventilation pipes penetrate through the top and the bottom of the right side surface of the placing box, a water bucket is arranged on the right side surface of the placing box, and a connecting pipe penetrates through the water bucket. This heat dissipation mechanism for metallurgical equipment, through starting auxiliary fan, make the air pass the heat-conducting plate and take away the heat, the air after will cooling again through the connecting pipe upwards transmits, and then can absorb the heat that the equipment middle part produced, can prevent that the equipment from appearing the condition that the heat concentrates on one when using, avoid the phenomenon that the equipment appears damaging after overheated, the influence that the water-cooling caused normal use of equipment has been reduced, can make operating personnel carry out the heat dissipation of multiposition to equipment, the radiating efficiency of spare part in the device in the course of the work has further been improved.

title_en: Wall-penetrating type heat pump water heater
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wall-penetrating type heat pump water heater, which comprises a case, wherein the case is provided with a cavity; the case comprises an indoor part and an outdoor part; the indoor part is provided with a circulating water inlet, a circulating water outlet, a hot water outlet and a cold water inlet, and the indoor part is internally provided with a compressor and an electric cabinet; a condenser, an evaporator and a fan device are arranged in the outdoor part; the case is divided into an indoor part and an outdoor part, and the configuration of each part in the case is optimized, so that the water heater can be directly installed on a window or a wall hole reserved on an outer wall, the technical effect of wall-through installation is realized without integrally installing the unit at the outdoor or opening a balcony, and the problem that a traditional heat pump water heater cannot be installed in some buildings due to the limitation of installation conditions is solved.

title_en: Ice maker easy to clean
abstract_en: An easy to clean ice maker includes: the ice storage box, the inner container, the water box assembly, the ice making module, the main water outlet and the control system are arranged in a box body of the ice making machine, and the inner container is provided with an ice outlet communicated with the ice storage box; the water box assembly comprises a water box body with an opening, a partially removable water box cover, a fluid reversing element with an inlet and two outlets, and a plurality of hoses, wherein at least part of the water box body and the removable part of the water box cover are positioned on the outer side of the liner, and the water box body is communicated with the inlet through the hoses; the ice making module is communicated with one outlet through a hose and is provided with an ice making outlet communicated with the ice outlet; the main water outlet is communicated with the other outlet through a hose and is communicated with the water box body and the outer side of the ice maker; the control system is in electrical signal connection with the fluid reversing element; realize self-cleaning water box body, avoid the complete machine to dismantle, easy operation, the user operation of being convenient for improves clean efficiency.

title_en: Cooking utensil
abstract_en: The utility model provides a cooking appliance, which relates to the technical field of household appliances and aims to solve the problem of low safety of the cooking appliance in the related technology, the cooking appliance comprises a panel and a shell, the panel is covered on the shell and forms a cavity with the shell, an indicating piece is arranged in the cavity or on the panel, a controller, a power supply piece and a temperature detection piece are arranged in the cavity, the power supply piece, the temperature detection piece and the indicating piece are all electrically connected with the controller, the power supply piece is configured to supply power to the indicating piece, the temperature detection piece and the controller after the cooking appliance is powered off, the controller is configured to control the indicating piece to be in a light-on state when the temperature on the panel is higher than or equal to a preset temperature, and control the indicating piece to be in a light-off state when the temperature on the panel is lower than the preset temperature. The cooking utensil provided by the utility model can improve the safety in use.

title_en: Air purification device for new crown detection room
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an air purification device for a corona detection chamber, which comprises a ventilation pipeline, wherein a fixed side plate is integrally formed on one side of the ventilation pipeline, a mounting hole is formed in the surface of the fixed side plate, a ventilation groove is formed in the ventilation pipeline, a limiting block is embedded and installed on the surface of the inner wall of the ventilation pipeline, a rectangular notch is formed in the top surface of the ventilation pipeline, a fixed frame is detachably installed in the rectangular notch, and a filter plate is embedded and installed on the inner wall of the fixed frame. Among the above-mentioned scheme, through setting up the filter, fixed handle and fixed square frame and rectangle notch, utilize mutually supporting of several of its, at first, during operating personnel will fix the filter of square frame and surface and pass through the inside ventilative groove of fixed handle manual movement to air pipe, utilize the alcohol solution in the filter to kill the virus in the air, and then improved air pipe's purifying effect.

title_en: Central air-conditioning control system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of central air-conditioning control, and discloses a central air-conditioning control system which comprises a control cabinet, wherein a sealing door is hinged to the side wall of the control cabinet, a connecting frame is fixedly connected to the side wall of the control cabinet, threaded rods are rotatably connected to the front inner wall and the rear inner wall of the connecting frame through bearings, threaded cylinders are sleeved on the threaded rods in an externally threaded manner, guide plates are fixedly connected to the side walls of the threaded cylinders, guide openings are formed in the side wall of the control cabinet, connecting columns are fixedly connected to the side walls, extending out of the guide openings, of the guide plates, mounting plates are fixedly connected to the front ends of the connecting columns, and the side walls of the mounting plates are connected with a control system. According to the utility model, when the control system in the control cabinet is overhauled, the control system can be quickly moved out of the control cabinet to a proper position, so that the overhaul by operators is convenient, and the working efficiency of the operators is improved.

title_en: Copper sulfate solution condensation cooling device for recycling copper sulfate from electrolytic wastewater
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a copper sulfate solution condensation cooling device for recycling copper sulfate from electrolytic wastewater, which relates to the technical field of condensing devices and comprises a base, wherein a cooling box is fixedly arranged on one side of the upper part of the base, a main runner is arranged in the middle of the upper part of the cooling box, a liquid inlet is fixedly arranged in the position, located in the main runner, of the upper part of the cooling box, the lower end of the main runner extends to the middle of the inside of the cooling box, branch runners are obliquely arranged on two sides of the inside of the cooling box, the upper ends of the two branch runners are communicated with the lower end of the main runner, a cavity is arranged on the lower part of the inside of the cooling box, the lower ends of the two branch runners penetrate through the top wall of the cavity, a partition plate is vertically and fixedly arranged in the middle of the cavity, and divides the cavity into two cooling bins. According to the utility model, the two cooling bins are used for alternately cooling the copper sulfate liquid, so that the problem that one cooling bin works for a long time to cause poor cooling effect is avoided.

title_en: Combustor with flue gas backward flow function
abstract_en: The utility model provides a burner with a flue gas backflow function, which comprises a combustion barrel, wherein a supporting plate is arranged outside the combustion barrel, a filter box is arranged on the supporting plate, a filter screen is arranged in the filter box and divides the interior of the filter box into two chambers, the filter box is connected with an air inlet pipe and an air outlet pipe which are respectively communicated with the two chambers, and one end of the air outlet pipe, far away from the filter box, is connected with the combustion barrel and is communicated with the interior of the combustion barrel. According to the utility model, the flue gas generated in the boiler hearth is introduced into the filter box through the arranged gas inlet pipe, the flue gas is introduced into the combustion cylinder for re-combustion through the exhaust pipe after being filtered by the filter screen, and the impurities in the filtered flue gas enter the combustor after the filter screen is additionally arranged, so that the phenomenon that the combustor is damaged due to dust deposition in the combustor is avoided.

title_en: Outdoor flame gun support
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of cookers, in particular to an outdoor flame gun bracket, which comprises a fixed bracket and a movable bracket; two support rods are arranged on the fixed support, a horizontal plate used for connecting the two support rods is arranged at the top ends of the two support rods, and two circular slots are formed in the horizontal plate; the movable support is provided with two, all is provided with a bolt that corresponds with the slot on two movable supports, and the bolt rotates with the slot to be connected, forms a mounting groove between two movable supports. It passes through two bracing pieces of fixed bolster horizontal plate connection, later slot and two movable support connections through two circular settings to rotate through slot and bolt and be connected, make two movable support can rotate, the be convenient for depositing of shrink the support of being convenient for, reduce and occupy the space, perhaps rotate the back and support with bracing piece ground together and lean on the support, thereby be convenient for install the gas pitcher of flame gun through the mounting groove.

title_en: High-efficiency air cooler
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-efficiency air cooler which comprises a shell, wherein one end of the shell is provided with an air inlet, the other end of the shell is provided with an air outlet, and the middle part of an inner cavity of the shell is provided with an air guide opening for uniformly dispersing air flow; the detachable filter screen plate is arranged on the outer side of the air inlet, the filter screen is arranged in the middle of the filter screen plate, and the wet curtain paper is arranged in the inner cavity of the air inlet.

title_en: Ventilation device for construction
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of building construction, in particular to a ventilation device for building construction, which comprises a ventilation cavity and a case, wherein an air inlet grid and an air outlet grid are respectively arranged on two sides of the ventilation cavity, a motor is arranged on the inner wall of the ventilation cavity through a bracket, a rotating shaft, an insertion block and fan blades are fixedly arranged at the output end of the motor through a coupling, a detachable filter screen frame is arranged on the inner wall of the ventilation cavity through a limiting block, a filter screen is arranged in the middle of the detachable filter screen frame, a spline insertion rod and a scraping strip are inserted into a through hole formed in the middle of the filter screen, and the other end of the spline insertion rod is inserted into the middle of the insertion block. According to the utility model, the inserting block is arranged at one end of the rotating shaft, and the spline inserting rod with the scraping strip is inserted and arranged in the inserting block, so that when the rotating shaft rotates, the scraping strip on the spline inserting rod can be driven to clean the filter screen, the blockage of the filter screen caused by dirt is greatly reduced, and the ventilation efficiency is improved.

title_en: Layered electric heater
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a layered electric heater, which comprises a sealing seat and an electric heating assembly arranged on a sealing clamp, wherein a hidden groove is formed in the outer side of the sealing seat, a fixing bolt is arranged in the hidden groove, a shielding assembly used for protecting the fixing bolt is arranged in the hidden groove, a magnet strip block is arranged in the hidden groove, an inner groove is formed in the outer side of the magnet strip block, and a locking bolt in threaded connection with the sealing seat is arranged in the inner groove. This layer-stepping electric heater, after adopting fixing bolt to fix layer-stepping electric heater, rotate sealed lid back, utilize the magnetism relation between sealed lid and the magnet strip piece, realize the fixed to sealed lid, and utilize sealed lid to seal up the protection to fixing bolt, water smoke and water can not contact with fixing bolt, realize the protection to fixing bolt, avoid fixing bolt to rust, avoid taking place to rust because of fixing bolt and influence the condition of layer-stepping electric heater later maintenance.

title_en: Energy-saving and efficient refrigeration cascade system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an energy-saving and high-efficiency refrigeration overlapping system, which relates to the technical field of refrigeration systems and comprises a compressor unit and an evaporator, wherein an overlapping compressor and a refrigerant storage tank are arranged on the left side of the compressor unit, a liquid storage tank is arranged on the right side of the compressor unit, an air suction port at the upper end of the compressor unit is connected with a gas-liquid separator through a pipeline, the gas-liquid separator is connected with a heat exchanger through a pipeline, an air outlet of the compressor unit is connected with a condenser through a pipeline, the lower part of the condenser is connected with the liquid storage tank through a pipeline, and the liquid storage tank is sequentially connected with the gas-liquid separator and the upper end of the left side of the compressor unit through pipelines. The cascade system uses CO2 which is natural working medium, utilizes the advantage that the heat exchange performance of the cascade system is still good under the low-temperature working condition, and avoids the defect that the pressure of the cascade system is higher under the high-temperature working condition.

title_en: Air source heat pump hot water heat accumulation defrost system based on double-pipe heat exchanger
abstract_en: The utility model provides an air source heat pump hot water heat storage defrosting system based on a double-pipe heat exchanger, which comprises a heating water circulation module, a heat storage module, a refrigerant circulation module and a heat exchange module, wherein the heating water circulation module is connected with the heat storage module; the refrigerant circulation module is connected with the heat exchange module, the heating water circulation module is connected with the heat exchange module, and the refrigerant circulation module and the heating water circulation module perform heat transfer through the heat exchange module; the heat exchange module is arranged in the heat storage module, and the heat storage module is used for storing heat through the heat exchange module; the heat storage medium in the heat storage module comprises water. The utility model has the beneficial effects that: the utility model is designed with a plurality of heating and heat storage operation modes, the switching between different heating and heat storage modes is simple, and the reasonable distribution of the unit heating quantity under different operation environments can be realized, thereby ensuring the heat supply effect and the defrosting effect of the unit to be satisfied by users, and greatly improving the indoor comfort during the heating period.

title_en: Revolution and rotation synchronous heating uniform high-temperature furnace
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-temperature furnace with synchronous revolution and rotation and uniform heating, belonging to the technical field of heating furnaces, comprising a furnace body, wherein the edge part of one end of the furnace body is rotationally connected with a furnace door, the inside of the furnace body is rotationally connected with a placing table, the top end of the placing table is equidistantly connected with placing containers, the top end of the inner wall of the furnace body is fixedly provided with a positioning and blocking mechanism, and the positioning and blocking mechanism is mainly formed by combining a conical disc for combining and positioning objects, a fixed sleeve for driving the conical disc to move and a movable rod. The phenomenon of blockage of the top of the placing container can be avoided.

title_en: Cooking fume exhauster
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a range hood, which comprises a smoke collecting hood, wherein the bottom of the smoke collecting hood is provided with an air inlet, a smoke collecting cavity is formed in the smoke collecting hood, the smoke collecting cavity extends upwards from the air inlet, and the air inlet is provided with a smoke baffle plate capable of opening and closing the air inlet in a turnover manner, and the range hood is characterized in that: the collection petticoat pipe still includes the baffle, the baffle includes first plate body, first plate body is extended to collection smoke intracavity by the front side border of air intake, first plate body is plane or curved surface towards the surface of collection smoke intracavity, first plate body is alpha 1 towards the surface of collection smoke intracavity and the contained angle between the fender cigarette board of open mode to satisfy | alpha 1| ≦ 20. Compared with the prior art, the utility model has the advantages that: through setting up the baffle, make its first plate body in the collection smoke cavity parallel with the cigarette board as far as possible to make and keep off the ascending air current of cigarette board still smoothly upwards through the collection smoke cavity, avoid the air current to collide at collection smoke cavity front side and produce vortex and condensation.

title_en: Heat shield for stove and stove with heat shield
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a heat shield for a stove and a stove using the heat shield, which comprises a cover body with a central hole, and is characterized in that: the outer edge of the cover body vertically extends downwards to form an outer ring wall, the outer ring wall is provided with at least two secondary air ports which are communicated with the outside and the central hole at intervals along the circumferential direction, the bottom of the cover body is provided with an adjusting ring which can move vertically relative to the outer ring wall of the cover body, and further the local sectional area of the secondary air port is changed at least, compared with the prior art, the utility model has the advantages that: vertical movement through the relative cover body bottom of regulating ring makes the regulating ring can change the local sectional area of secondary air mouth, and then adjusts the effective airflow that secondary air got into cover body central hole, reaches the effect that can adjust secondary air make-up volume according to the in-service use needs, has overcome because of gathering the big problem of flue gas emission that the energy cover has reduced the exhaust port and has brought, makes the combustor be in a stable good combustion state.

title_en: Fluidized bed furnace for sulfuric acid production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fluidized bed furnace for sulfuric acid production, relates to the technical field of sulfuric acid production, and solves the technical problems of non-uniform boiling state and high oxygen content of discharged smoke of the conventional fluidized bed furnace; the fluidized bed furnace comprises a furnace body, a feed inlet, a slag discharge port and a flue gas output port, wherein a first air distribution plate is arranged at the lower part of the furnace body and divides the furnace body into an air inlet cavity at the lower part and a fluidized cavity at the upper part; according to the utility model, the air distribution plate is used for combining the vertical and horizontal movement of the material, so that the boiling state is more uniform, and the oxygen content of the introduced gas is controlled by regulating and controlling the mixing of fresh air and flue gas, thereby reducing the smoke discharge and heat loss.

title_en: Electronic expansion valve, refrigerating system and automobile
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electronic expansion valve, a refrigeration system and an automobile, wherein the electronic expansion valve comprises a valve seat and a valve body assembly, the valve seat is provided with a valve core seat, and the valve core seat is provided with a valve core cavity and a valve port communicated with the valve core cavity; the valve body assembly comprises a connecting seat, a bearing and a valve core assembly, the connecting seat is connected with the valve seat, the connecting seat is provided with a mounting groove, and the bearing is mounted in the mounting groove; the valve core assembly penetrates through the connecting seat and the bearing and is inserted into the valve core cavity so as to open and close the valve port; wherein, the bearing and the connecting seat are in interference fit. The technical scheme of the utility model reduces the number of parts of the electronic expansion valve.

title_en: Ventilation unit in simple and easy room
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of house ventilation, in particular to a ventilation device of a simple house, which comprises a house body, wherein a ventilation mechanism is arranged on one side inside the house body, a protection cover mechanism is arranged on one side outside the ventilation mechanism, and a shielding mechanism is arranged on one side outside the protection cover mechanism. The utility model has the advantages that: by arranging the ventilation mechanism, the house can be effectively ventilated, dust on the protection cover mechanism can be cleaned, meshes are prevented from being blocked by more dust on the filter screen, and the ventilation efficiency of the ventilation device of the simple house is improved; shelter from the mechanism through the setting, still can play the ventilation effect when making the commentaries on classics board be the closure state in the mount, at sleet weather, can carry out effectual sheltering from to ventilation unit, avoid indoor cold or sleet to waft into indoor and influence the life, be convenient for ventilative and sleet can't get into indoorly from the inclined hole to this ventilation unit of simple and easy room's practicality has been improved.

title_en: Air conditioner with longitudinal air duct
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an air conditioner with vertical wind channel. The air conditioner includes: the air conditioner comprises a machine body, a fan and a control device, wherein the machine body is provided with a side air inlet, an upper air outlet, a lower air outlet and a longitudinal air duct; the heat exchange system is arranged in the machine body and used for exchanging heat of air flow entering from the side air inlet; and the air supply system is arranged in the machine body and comprises an upper air supply mechanism and a lower air supply mechanism, the upper air supply mechanism is used for supplying air to the upper air outlet, the lower air supply mechanism is used for supplying air to the lower air outlet, and the longitudinal air duct is used for communicating the air outlet of the upper air supply mechanism with the air inlet of the lower air supply mechanism or communicating the air inlet of the upper air supply mechanism with the air outlet of the lower air supply mechanism. The utility model provides an air conditioner has vertical wind channel, can increase the air output of air outlet or lower air outlet.

title_en: Purifying, silencing and air supplying outlet of centralized air conditioning system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of purification and noise reduction of a centralized air conditioning system, in particular to a purification and noise reduction air supply outlet of a centralized air conditioning system, which comprises an air supply outlet body, a first fixing frame, a second fixing frame, a filter screen, a plurality of supporting blocks, a plurality of supporting sleeves, a plurality of limiting hooks, two auxiliary grooves, a connecting sleeve, two connecting plates, a connecting shaft, a mounting column, a limiting block, a limiting plate, two springs, a cleaning barrel, a plurality of brushes, a sliding frame, two sliding blocks, a plurality of first carding brushes, a plurality of sponge pads, a plurality of clamping grooves, a plurality of supporting shafts, an air supply plate, a connecting block and a mounting sleeve, wherein the connecting sleeve, the connecting plate, the connecting shaft, the cleaning barrel, the brushes and the first carding brush are arranged, the first carding brush and the second carding brush clean dust again, the distance between the first carding brushes is compact, so that compact dust can be wiped more cleanly.

title_en: Liquid accumulator and compressor
abstract_en: The utility model provides a reservoir and compressor, wherein, the reservoir includes: the device comprises a cylinder, an air inlet pipe, an exhaust pipe and a reinforcing plate; the barrel is provided with an inner cavity, the air inlet pipe is inserted into the barrel from the upper end of the barrel, the lower end of the air inlet pipe is closed, the side surface of the air inlet pipe is provided with an air outlet, and the air inlet pipe is communicated with the inner cavity through the air outlet; one end of the exhaust pipe and the air inlet pipe are inserted into the inner cavity of the cylinder body at a certain distance, and the other end of the exhaust pipe is positioned outside the cylinder body; the reinforcing plate is fixed on the inner wall of the barrel around the exhaust pipe, at least one filter hole is formed in the reinforcing plate, and a filter screen is arranged in the filter hole. In the reservoir and the compressor that this application provided, the reinforcing plate that the adoption has the filtration pore cooperatees with the intake pipe that adopts the side exhaust, not only can avoid rubbish to fall into in the blast pipe, can improve the effective volume of reservoir moreover, reduces the subassembly of reservoir, simplifies the assembly process of reservoir, and then reduces the manufacturing cost of reservoir and compressor.

title_en: High-temperature drainage cooling system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high temperature drainage cooling system draws together cooling water tank, inlet channel, outlet conduit, emergency water tank, heat exchanger, moisturizing pipe, bottom temperature measuring device, top temperature measuring device and water level monitoring device. The cooling water tank comprises a shell, a water containing cavity and a water outlet, a first water inlet and a second water inlet which are arranged on the shell. The water inlet pipeline is communicated with a first water inlet on the cooling water tank, the water outlet pipeline comprises a main water outlet pipe, a first water outlet pipe and a second water outlet pipe, the water inlet of the main water outlet pipe is communicated with the water outlet of the cooling water tank, and the water outlet of the water outlet pipeline is communicated with the first water outlet pipe and the second water outlet pipe through a tee joint. The heat exchanger includes drain line and heat transfer water pipeline, and the drain line is encircleed to the heat transfer water pipeline, and drain line's water inlet and first outlet pipe intercommunication, drain line's delivery port and second water inlet are linked together. The system completes the dynamic monitoring of the environment of the operating room through the gas monitoring unit and the dust particle monitoring unit, and completes the real-time dynamic adjustment of the environment of the operating room through the linkage air purification system.

The top outer part of the motor support is set to be a sharp corner to be collapsed, and the defects of hard printing, salient points and the like are eliminated. abstract_en: The utility model relates to a kitchen is with separating heat exchanger, including the cover body, the bottom of the cover body has along the stabilizer blade of circumference distribution, forms secondary air inlet channel, its characterized in that between the adjacent stabilizer blade: the bottom periphery of the cover body or adjacent to the bottom periphery thereof correspond each secondary air inlet channel and are provided with downwardly extending's extension respectively, offer the secondary air inflow entrance that supplies the secondary air inflow on the extension, compare with prior art, the utility model has the advantages of: the top periphery of the heat shield or the periphery near the top of the heat shield is provided with an upper extension part, so that the secondary air channel formed by the external secondary air passing through the extension part is narrowed, and the channel sectional area is obviously reduced, thereby having the following advantages: 1. the air inlet resistance is increased, the supplement amount of secondary air is reduced, and the reduction of excess air is beneficial to reducing the heat taken away by a large amount of smoke; 2. the space diminishes, and secondary air velocity can improve, and the velocity of flow improves and does benefit to the heat transfer.

title_en: Rotary kiln anti-corrosion device
abstract_en: The utility model provides an anticorrosive device of rotary kiln belongs to rotary kiln technical field. The device comprises a metal rotary kiln cylinder, a solid electrolyte layer and an auxiliary anode; the solid electrolyte layer is arranged on the surface of the metal rotary kiln cylinder used as the cathode; the auxiliary anode is wound on the surface of the solid electrolyte layer; the metal rotary kiln cylinder and the auxiliary anode are respectively used for being connected with an external negative electrode and an external positive electrode. By using the protected metal rotary kiln cylinder as a cathode, the electron migration caused by metal corrosion can be inhibited, and the corrosion can be avoided or weakened. The solid electrolyte layer can provide an ion migration channel of cathodic protection current, so that an electric field with uniform strength can be established between the auxiliary anode and the protected metal rotary kiln cylinder, the protection current is uniformly distributed on all surfaces of the protected metal rotary kiln cylinder, the effective corrosion protection of the metal rotary kiln cylinder is realized, and the service life of the rotary kiln is prolonged.

title_en: Sodium metasilicate cooling water circulator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sodium metasilicate cooling water circulator, include the header tank, install in inlet tube and the outlet pipe of the relative both sides surface of header tank, the top fixed mounting of header tank has the roof, the top demountable installation of header tank has the apron, two liang of a set of symmetry fixed mounting respectively of the relative both sides internal surface that the header tank is close to the outlet pipe has four limiting plates, and is two sets of insert between the limiting plate and be equipped with the filter, the inside packing of filter has active carbon, the filter is hollow structure, install rabbling mechanism between the diapire of roof and header tank. The utility model discloses a filter that sets up in the header tank filters and adsorbs the cooling water of discharge outlet pipe, gets rid of the impurity in the cooling water, when preventing to use for a long time, the pipeline is stopped up to the impurity in the cooling water, influences the unblocked nature that the cooling water flowed.

title_en: Resin reation kettle's waste heat recovery device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a waste heat recovery device of a resin reaction kettle, which comprises: the automatic feeding device comprises an inner shell, an outer shell, a hopper and a discharging pipe, wherein the outer shell is arranged outside the inner shell, the discharging pipe is arranged at the lower end of the inner shell, the other end of the discharging pipe extends out of the outer shell, the hopper is arranged on the inner shell and the outer shell, and an electric heating layer is arranged on the inner wall of the inner shell. According to the utility model, the phase change energy storage material can be used for recovering and storing heat emitted outwards by the inner shell, and the heat emitted by the inner shell is released when the inner shell is cooled to keep the temperature of the inner shell constant; and when the resin is discharged, the heat is absorbed through the discharge pipe and then transferred to the phase change energy storage material, so that the waste heat recovery can be further improved.

title_en: Fixing device for tripe wind gap convenient to installation
abstract_en: The utility model is suitable for the technical field of a shutter air port, and provides a fixing device for the shutter air port, which comprises an outer frame, wherein a shutter is arranged in the outer frame, fixing mechanisms are arranged at two ends of the outer frame, each fixing mechanism comprises an abutting block arranged at one side of the outer frame, a plurality of mounting grooves are formed in one side of the abutting block adjacent to the outer frame, screw-connection assemblies are arranged at two ends of the abutting block, a limiting block is vertically arranged at one side of the screw-connection assemblies adjacent to the outer frame, a stand column is vertically arranged in the abutting block, an elastic assembly is sleeved on the stand column, and a fixing block is vertically arranged at one side of the elastic assembly adjacent to the shutter.

title_en: Disinfection, purification and ventilation system device for operating room
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a disinfection, purification and ventilation system device for an operating room, which relates to the technical field of air purification, and comprises a case and a purification assembly, wherein the purification assembly is arranged in the case; the purifying component comprises a purifying box, a liquid inlet pipe, a first liquid control valve, a liquid outlet pipe, a second liquid control valve and a ventilation part, wherein the purifying box is fixedly arranged in a case, the liquid inlet pipe is fixedly arranged on one side of the top of the purifying box, the liquid inlet pipe penetrates through the case, and the first liquid control valve is fixedly arranged on the liquid inlet pipe. The utility model relates to a disinfection, purification and ventilation system device for an operating room, which is provided with a purifying box, a liquid inlet pipe, a first liquid control valve, a liquid outlet pipe, a second liquid control valve and a ventilation part, wherein air enters the purifying box for disinfection and then is introduced into the operating room through an air outlet pipe, the air is completely disinfected and sterilized, and the introduced air is clean and pollution-free.

title_en: Pipeline turbulent flow structure, heat exchanger and gas water heater
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of gas water heaters, and discloses a pipeline turbulence structure, a heat exchanger and a gas water heater. The pipeline vortex structure comprises a vortex piece, a first spiral section and a second spiral section are arranged on the vortex piece along the water flow direction, the spiral directions of the first spiral section and the second spiral section are opposite, the spiral turns of the first spiral section and the second spiral section are not less than 1 turn, and the spiral turns of the first spiral section are less than the spiral turns of the second spiral section. According to the pipeline turbulence structure, the turbulence piece is not easy to rotate, so that noise generated by rotation of the turbulence piece can be reduced to a certain extent.

title_en: Nasal cavity washing device of accuse temperature
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of medical equipment, in particular to a temperature-controlled nasal cavity flushing device, which comprises a main body, wherein a water suction pump and a negative pressure pump are arranged in the main body, a liquid supply container is arranged on the main body, the liquid supply container is connected with a water inlet end of the water suction pump through a conduit, a flushing pipe is connected with a water outlet end of the water suction pump, a double-hole rubber plug is arranged at one end of the flushing pipe, which is not connected with the water suction pump, a flushing pipe and a liquid discharge pipe are respectively arranged in the double-hole rubber plug, and the liquid discharge pipe is connected with the water inlet end of the negative pressure pump; the main body is provided with a controller and a power module, a heating device and a temperature sensor are arranged in the liquid supply container, and the controller is respectively and electrically connected with the water suction pump, the negative pressure pump, the power module, the heating device and the temperature sensor. The nasal cavity flushing device not only can control the temperature of the cleaning liquid and ensure the flushing safety, but also can suck out the flushing waste liquid to avoid discomfort of patients, so that the cleaning operation is not required to be continued, and the final cleaning effect is affected.

title_en: Variable-frequency control carbon dioxide heat pump
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of carbon dioxide heat pumps, in particular to a variable-frequency control carbon dioxide heat pump, which comprises a carbon dioxide heat pump main body, wherein an air inlet is formed in the carbon dioxide heat pump main body, a filter plate matched with the air inlet is arranged on the carbon dioxide heat pump main body, two fans are arranged on the carbon dioxide heat pump main body, and a cleaning mechanism is arranged on the carbon dioxide heat pump main body; the cleaning mechanism comprises four first fixing plates fixedly connected to the carbon dioxide heat pump main body, and a motor is fixedly connected to one of the first fixing plates; the carbon dioxide heat pump is changed from the original compressor fixed frequency control to variable frequency control, so that the compressor can run more stably, the service life of the compressor can be greatly prolonged, meanwhile, the defects that the compressor can not be used for a high-temperature hot water system due to high-temperature return air and the exhaust pressure of the system is increased and the like can be overcome by the compressor variable frequency control, and the carbon dioxide heat pump can be used for special fields such as high-temperature bath water and the like.

title_en: Heat exchanger structure, refrigerant system and refrigeration equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of heat exchanger gas-liquid separation, and discloses a heat exchanger, and this heat exchanger includes: a heat exchanger body having a plurality of heat exchange tubes and the plurality of heat exchange tubes together forming a heat exchange flow path, wherein the heat exchange flow path has a condensing flow direction; a liquid guiding part connected with a gaseous refrigerant accumulation area in at least one heat exchange tube in the condensing flow direction upstream pipeline and at least another heat exchange tube in the condensing flow direction downstream pipeline, and used for leading out liquid refrigerant from the upstream pipeline to the downstream pipeline when the heat exchanger is used as a condenser; wherein, be provided with flat mouthful drainage groove and heat exchange tube on the liquid extraction tube section of liquid guide portion and be connected. The flat-mouth drainage groove is arranged on the liquid extraction pipe section of the liquid guide part of the heat exchanger and is connected with the heat exchange pipe, and the drainage groove can play a role in smoothly and stably guiding condensate, so that the phenomenon of effusion and the phenomenon of local blockage are prevented. The application also discloses a refrigerant system and refrigeration equipment.

title_en: Purification high-temperature furnace for curing heat-insulating material
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a purification high-temperature furnace for a curing heat-insulating material, and relates to the technical field of material purification. This purification high temperature furnace for solidification heat-insulating material includes the base, the top surface fixedly connected with two support frames of base, two the top surface fixed of support frame is provided with the purification stove, and one side external surface fixed of purification stove is provided with the pan feeding mouth, one side external surface fixed of purification stove is provided with the discharge gate, one side external surface fixed of purification stove communicates there is the residue pipeline, the one end that the purification stove was kept away from to the residue pipeline has collection mechanism through the ring flange fixed intercommunication, and collection mechanism's bottom surface and the top surface fixed connection of base, the top surface fixedly connected with a plurality of support column of base, a plurality of the support column is kept away from the one end fixedly connected with of base and is placed the platform, and place platform and discharge gate looks adaptation, the problem that various gases that produce when current high temperature furnace purification solidification heat-insulating material cause environmental pollution easily has been solved.

title_en: Assembled clean laboratory
abstract_en: The utility model provides an assembled clean laboratory, and belongs to the technical field of assembled houses.
