This kind of assembled clean laboratory, including the side guard board, the top of side guard board is equipped with ceiling mechanism, the side guard board is equipped with lighting mechanism in the both sides that are close to ceiling mechanism respectively, ceiling mechanism includes roof, filter screen, set square, waterproof tile and fan, the set square is installed respectively to the top both sides of roof, two install a plurality of waterproof tiles between the set square, the bottom of roof is provided with the opening, open-ended internally mounted filter screen, the fan inlays to be established and installs in the outer wall one side of set square, lighting mechanism includes triangular frame, light-transmitting plate and reflective coating, the light-transmitting plate inlays to be established and is installed in one side of triangular frame, the inside bottom of triangular frame sets up reflective coating, one side of triangular frame communicates with each other with the outer wall of side guard board and is connected, the joint of triangular frame and side guard board is pasted there is joint strip.

title_en: Dielectric barrier plasma ammonia burner and pulverized coal ammonia-doped combustion system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a dielectric barrier plasma ammonia burner and a pulverized coal ammonia-doped combustion system, and belongs to the technical field of plasma application. The dielectric barrier plasma ammonia burner comprises a high-frequency high-voltage power supply and a dielectric barrier plasma generator; the medium blocking plasma generator is provided with an ammonia gas inlet and a cracking product outlet. The pulverized coal ammonia-doped combustion system comprises the dielectric barrier plasma ammonia burner, an ammonia fuel source, an ammonia/pulverized coal burner and a power plant boiler; the ammonia fuel source is sequentially connected with the dielectric barrier plasma ammonia burner, the ammonia/pulverized coal burner and the power plant boiler. The ammonia gas is partially converted into nitrogen and hydrogen by the dielectric barrier plasma ammonia burner arranged on the ammonia supply pipeline, which is favorable for ignition and stable combustion of the ammonia gas.

title_en: Photovoltaic module installation frock
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a photovoltaic module mounting tool which comprises two sleeves, wherein two connecting rods are fixedly connected to two sides of one opposite side of each sleeve, a rotating sleeve is fixedly connected between the two connecting rods on the same side through a support, a bidirectional threaded rod is rotatably connected to the inside of the rotating sleeve through a bearing piece, threaded sleeves are connected to two sides of the surface of each bidirectional threaded rod in a threaded manner, a first limiting frame is fixedly connected to the surface of each threaded sleeve, and a second limiting frame is fixedly connected to the surface of each sleeve. This photovoltaic module installs frock, through placing the photovoltaic board that waits to install between two spacing frames of second, then pull out the traction plate forward, after the gag lever post removes to the outside of two-way threaded rod, rotate two-way threaded rod, two first spacing frames of drive are simultaneously to the centre movement, and first spacing frame removes and reaches the effect that carries out the centre gripping to the photovoltaic board.

title_en: Firing kiln loading attachment
abstract_en: The utility model provides a firing kiln feeding device, which relates to the technical field of firing kilns and comprises an equipment base, wherein a firing kiln body is arranged at the position, close to the center, of the top of the equipment base, an opening and closing door is arranged on the outer surface of one side of the firing kiln body, a sliding groove is formed at one side, close to the corners, of the opening and closing door, a pushing structure is arranged on the top surface of the equipment base, the ceramic base is pushed into the firing kiln body through the pushing structure, the ceramic is placed at the top of the ceramic base, then a pushing effect is achieved through the matching of threaded holes on one side of the ceramic base and a threaded rod, after the ceramic base is pushed to a position separated from the threaded rod, the ceramic base which is separated from the threaded rod in the front is driven to push forwards by the follow-up pushed ceramic base, and finally, after the follow-up baking structure, workers only need to hook the ceramic base from one side far away from the pushing structure.

title_en: Ventilation structure of construction is built in room
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of ventilation devices, and discloses a ventilation structure for building construction, which comprises a body mechanism, a filtering mechanism, a dustproof mechanism and a dust falling mechanism, wherein the filtering mechanism is positioned at the inner end of the body mechanism, the dustproof mechanism is positioned at the outer end of the body mechanism, the dust falling mechanism is positioned at the right end of the filtering mechanism, the dustproof mechanism comprises a protective box, a dustproof filter screen, a mounting frame, a positioning block, an adjusting rod, a reset spring, a limiting block and an adjusting groove, the dustproof filter screen is movably mounted at the outer end of the protective box, the mounting frame is fixedly mounted at the outer end of the dustproof filter screen, and the positioning block is fixedly mounted at the outer end of the mounting frame. The ventilation structure of construction is built in this room will adjust the pole outside pulling, and cooperation dustproof filter screen forms dustproof construction in the outside of air exhauster, has increased the outside dustproof effect of the device when letting dustproof filter screen can convenient dismantlement, makes the device follow-up clean comparatively convenient, has improved the device ventilation effect in the construction is built in the room.

title_en: Injection type pilot lamp
abstract_en: The utility model provides an injection type pilot burner which is characterized in that a nozzle and a base are processed in a split mode, the nozzle and the base are connected in a detachable mode, the nozzle is convenient to replace and maintain, and the base is fixedly connected with an injection mixing pipe. And a sealing gasket is arranged between the nozzle and the base, so that the sealing performance of the nozzle structure is ensured. By the design, the size of the nozzle can be reduced, the control accuracy of fuel handling capacity is improved, the inner hole machining difficulty is reduced, and meanwhile, the replaceability of the nozzle is realized. The nozzle of the injection type pilot burner has the advantages of simple structural design, convenience in disassembly and assembly, stable structure, reduction in processing cost, convenience in replacement and maintenance, and great saving in manpower and material resources.

title_en: Carbon black tail gas boiler with hot air recirculation pipeline
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of carbon black tail gas boilers, in particular to a carbon black tail gas boiler with a hot air recirculation pipeline. In order to solve the problem that an air preheater in the existing carbon black tail gas boiler is easy to corrode and block, the carbon black tail gas boiler provided with a hot air recirculation pipeline comprises a boiler burner, an air preheater and a blower, wherein an air outlet pipeline of the blower is communicated with an air inlet of the air preheater, an air outlet of the air preheater is communicated with the air inlet of the boiler burner, and an air outlet of the air preheater is also communicated with an air suction pipeline of the blower through the hot air recirculation pipeline.

title_en: Knob switch and gas stove
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of kitchen appliances, and particularly discloses a knob switch and a gas stove, wherein the gas stove comprises a stove top and a knob switch, the stove top is provided with an installation cavity, the table surface of the stove top is provided with a first installation hole communicated with the installation cavity, the knob switch comprises a switch valve, a knob mechanism and a locking mechanism, the switch valve is arranged in the installation cavity and opposite to the first installation hole, the switch valve is provided with a rotating shaft, and the rotating shaft is provided with a first clamping position and a second clamping position along the axial direction at intervals; the knob mechanism is sleeved on the rotating shaft and is in sliding fit along the axial direction of the rotating shaft, and the knob mechanism is provided with a pin hole; the locking mechanism comprises a clamp and a driving assembly, the pin hole is opposite to the first clamping position or the second clamping position, and the driving assembly is configured to drive the clamp to penetrate through the pin hole and be clamped with the first clamping position or the second clamping position, or the driving assembly enables the clamp to be separated from the pin hole. The gas stove improves the beauty of kitchen and bathroom space and the practicability of the top of the kitchen range.

title_en: Refrigerating type range hood
abstract_en: The utility model provides a refrigeration formula range hood, the casing is inside to be equipped with the chamber of discharging fume, heat dissipation chamber and air-out chamber, the intracavity of discharging fume installs the range hood fan, install the condenser in the heat dissipation chamber, install the evaporimeter in the air-out chamber, the heat dissipation chamber is linked together with the chamber of discharging fume, install humidification membrane and spray set in the casing, spray set is used for spouting the air conditioner comdenstion water to the humidification membrane, spray set's water source is the air conditioner comdenstion water, install first blast gate at the air intake of heat dissipation chamber, install the second blast gate at the air intake of air-out chamber, it has the casing air intake to open on the casing, in the wind channel between casing air intake and the heat dissipation chamber air intake and between casing air intake and the air-out chamber air intake. The two air valves of the refrigeration type range hood control the air direction to flow through different opening and closing states, so that the cold quantity of condensed water can be fully utilized to directly and indirectly dissipate heat of the condenser, the refrigeration power and the energy efficiency are improved, and the air flowing through the humidifying film can be blown out from the air outlet of the air conditioner after being cooled further.

title_en: Combined air pipe for three-constant system ground air supply
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of three-constant system, and discloses a combined air pipe for three-constant system ground air supply, which comprises a connecting pipe, wherein a clamping groove for fixing the connecting pipe is fixedly connected to the outer part of the connecting pipe, and a clamping strip for matching the clamping groove is fixedly connected to the outer part of the connecting pipe. The accurate positioning of connecting pipe installation is guaranteed through draw-in groove and clamping strip cooperation, iron plate and magnetic plate increase clamping strip and draw-in groove block and obtain the fastening, the connecting hole cooperation bolt fastening a plurality of connecting pipes of four right angles department of connecting pipe, the structural strength and the length adjustment of a plurality of connecting pipe installations are increased conveniently, the installation and the later maintenance dismantlement of connecting pipe of also being convenient for, thereby the bellows rotates the axis pivoted fit bellows body self bending of ring simultaneously at the annular inboard rotation makes the bellows rotate around the annular and carries out the arbitrary regulation of air-out angle, electronic jar cooperation slide hole and spacing hole carry out spacing fixedly after the air-out angle is adjusted annular plate and annular fast, guarantee the stability of bellows air-out direction.

title_en: Transparent cover of trolley wheel of sintering machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a trolley wheel transparent cover of a sintering machine, which comprises a rotating wheel, wherein a cover plate is movably arranged on the left side of the rotating wheel, and an injection pipe is fixedly arranged on the left side of the cover plate. This design of sintering machine platform truck wheel is thoroughly covered, make the platform truck wheel possess through setting up fixed establishment and cover the function of carrying out convenient installation and dismantlement thoroughly, through convenient installation and the function of dismantling, the daily maintenance work of convenience staff that can be very big, can maintain and maintain or repair the change to equipment inside through quick dismantlement, traditional platform truck wheel, often all fix through a plurality of bolts, the fixed of a plurality of bolts, though when one end uses, can ensure its stability, but after long-time use, be difficult to avoid factors such as oxidation, lead to its fixed effect to worsen, the installation of a plurality of bolts is fixed simultaneously, be inconvenient for the staff to install and dismantle it, still need one by one carry out the twist of multiturn just can dismantle.

title_en: High-efficient condensation heat transfer copper pipe
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of condensation heat exchange copper pipes, in particular to a high-efficiency condensation heat exchange copper pipe. The utility model comprises a pipeline, wherein one end of the pipeline is provided with a connecting structure, the connecting structure comprises two connecting plates, the two connecting plates are fixedly connected with the pipeline, the inner wall of the connecting plates is connected with a sliding rod in a sliding manner, one end of the sliding rod, which is far away from the pipeline, is fixedly connected with a connecting rod, the upper end of the connecting rod is fixedly connected with a screw rod, one end of the screw rod, which is far away from the connecting rod, is fixedly connected with a threaded pipe, reverse threads are formed in the two ends of the threaded pipe, one end of the sliding rod, which is far away from the connecting rod, is fixedly connected with an extrusion plate, and one side, which is far away from the sliding rod, of the extrusion plate is fixedly connected with a sponge cushion. The problem that when protecting pipelines of different types, the protection sleeves of different sizes need to be replaced is solved, and the pipelines adopt Cu-30Ni alloy, so that the heat exchange effect is good and the corrosion resistance effect is achieved.

title_en: Multifunctional indoor unit
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of machine room air conditioners, in particular to a multifunctional indoor unit which comprises a machine body and a cleaning device, wherein a base is fixedly connected to the lower surface of the machine body, an air inlet pipe is arranged on the side surface of the machine body, an air outlet frame is arranged on the surface of the machine body, a heat dissipation hole is formed in the side surface of the machine body, the cleaning device is arranged on the surface of the machine body and comprises a connecting block, a sliding rod and a threaded rod, the connecting block is fixedly connected with the surface of the machine body, the sliding rod is fixedly connected with the inner wall of the connecting block, and the threaded rod is rotatably connected with the inner wall of the connecting block. According to the utility model, the cleaning device is arranged to effectively clean the surface of the air outlet frame, so that the effect of cleaning the surface of the air outlet frame is achieved, dust is easily adsorbed on the surface of the air outlet frame when the equipment is used, the equipment is blocked and cannot be used, and the practicability of the equipment is improved.

title_en: Vertical solar water heater
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a vertical solar water heater, which relates to the technical field of solar water heaters, and comprises a machine body, wherein a connecting block is fixedly arranged on the outer surface of the machine body, a mounting plate is detachably arranged at one end of the connecting block, which is far away from the machine body, mounting bars are fixedly arranged on two sides of the mounting plate, and screws distributed in an array are connected in the mounting bars.

title_en: Air purifier inlet structure convenient to adjust
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an air inlet structure of an air purifier convenient to adjust, which comprises a shell, wherein two annular grooves are formed in the outer peripheral surface of the shell, an adjusting sleeve is sleeved on the outer peripheral surface of the shell, two sliding rings are fixedly connected to the inner wall of the adjusting sleeve, the sliding rings are inserted into the corresponding annular grooves, a plurality of air inlets are formed in the position, located between the two annular grooves, of the outer peripheral surface of the shell, one side of the adjusting sleeve is hinged with an air inlet pipe, a hose penetrates through one side of the air inlet pipe, the hose penetrates through the outer wall of the adjusting sleeve fixedly and extends to a position between the two sliding rings, an air pump is fixedly connected in the air inlet pipe, a filter element is arranged in the air inlet pipe, an inner gear ring is fixedly connected to the bottom of the adjusting sleeve, and an angle adjusting assembly is arranged on one side of the inner gear ring. The utility model belongs to the technical field of air purifiers. The utility model is convenient to adjust the position of the air inlet pipe, changes the purification range and improves the purification effect on air.

title_en: Pressure reducing device and air conditioner
abstract_en: The utility model provides a pressure reducing device and an air conditioner, relates to the technical field of air conditioners, and solves the technical problems of high condensing pressure and poor refrigerating effect of an outdoor unit during summer. The pressure reducing device comprises a condensed water utilization assembly, wherein the inlet side of the condensed water utilization assembly is connected with an evaporator so as to recover condensed water; the outlet side of the condensed water utilizing component is connected with the condenser so as to utilize the recovered condensed water to cool and clean the condenser; an air conditioner includes an evaporator, a condenser, and a pressure reducing device installed above the condenser. When the air conditioner is used for refrigerating, the condensed water is reused, the running pressure of the high-pressure side of the unit is reduced, the condensation heat exchange amount is improved, the supercooling degree of the refrigerant is increased, and the refrigerating capacity and the indoor refrigerating effect of the air conditioner unit are improved; the condenser is cooled after the condensate water formed at the evaporator is recovered, so that the problem of reliability that the frequency of a press is forced to be reduced and the like due to overhigh pressure during high-temperature refrigeration is solved.

title_en: Efficient superconductive solar lithium bromide refrigerating device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the utility model discloses a high-efficiency superconductive solar lithium bromide refrigerating device, which comprises: the solar energy superconductive heat collector, superconductive solar energy generator filled with lithium bromide water solution, condenser, evaporator, coiled pipe air cooler and absorber; the superconductive solar heat collector is communicated with the superconductive solar generator; the water vapor sequentially passes through the condenser, the evaporator and the absorber through pipelines; the absorber is communicated with the bottom of the superconducting solar generator; the inlet of the coil pipe air cooler is communicated with the external circulation outlet of the evaporator, and the outlet of the coil pipe air cooler is communicated with the external circulation inlet of the evaporator. Aiming at the technical defects of the existing absorption type solar refrigerating system, the device is designed for protecting the environment, avoiding pollution, reducing the refrigerating cost, improving the happiness index of people, organically combining the efficient superconductive solar heat conversion technology with the lithium bromide absorption type refrigerating system.

title_en: Active ventilation system for machine room
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an active ventilation system of a machine room, which belongs to the field, and comprises a ventilation air box and a box cover, wherein the box cover is movably connected to the top surface of the ventilation air box through a hinge on the right side of the ventilation air box, the ventilation air box is fixedly connected with the box cover through a lock catch on the left side, a filtering mechanism is arranged on the left side of the inside of the ventilation air box, the filtering mechanism comprises a coarse filter screen, a fine filter screen and an active carbon filter screen, the first fan can introduce external air into the machine room through an air inlet pipe, and in the process of entering the machine room, the filtering mechanism in the ventilation air box can filter large and small particles in the air through the coarse filter screen and the fine filter screen, and can purify the air through the active carbon filter screen, so that the air is effectively purified, pollution to the air is avoided after the air enters the machine room, and meanwhile, the coarse filter screen, the fine filter screen and the active carbon filter screen can be conveniently installed and detached in a plug-in manner by matching with a clamping strip in a filter cavity.

title_en: Multifunctional spraying device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a multifunctional spraying device which comprises a shell, and a spraying unit, a light unit and an acoustic unit inside the shell, wherein the light unit is arranged on the inner side of the shell; the spraying unit comprises a high-pressure water pipe and a high-pressure atomization nozzle; the light unit comprises an LED controller and an LED lamp strip; the sound unit comprises a sound controller and a small waterproof sound. The utility model integrates the functions of spraying, lamplight and sound, meets the cooling requirement of the building in outdoor high-temperature weather, builds a comfortable outdoor environment, builds environmental effects of lamplight, sound effect and the like, and can meet the use requirements of different working conditions such as daytime, night and the like; the spraying system is simple in shape, integrates multiple functions, is efficient in use, high in flexibility and high in practicability, can be arranged on various building parts and components, and has strong suitability with building shapes.

title_en: Automatic crucible charging device for graphitizing negative electrode material
abstract_en: The application relates to a negative pole material graphitization is with crucible automatic charging installation, the base has the horizontal loading station that is used for placing the crucible, the both sides that the support frame is relative all are provided with the lift drive strip of perpendicular to horizontal loading station, lift drive portion and lift drive strip one-to-one drive cooperation, the surface that the pressure head deviates from the inlet pipe is the compacting surface, the unloading aperture has been seted up to the compacting surface, and perpendicular to horizontal loading station, compacting surface orientation horizontal loading station, the pressure head can be at the interior bottom surface of crucible and the vertical elevating movement between the opening. The lifting platform drives the feeding pressure head to move up and down to realize automatic charging and compaction of the crucible, replaces manual charging, is favorable for improving the production speed of each furnace, reduces the cost, improves the compaction uniformity of the anode material in the crucible through repeated operation of small amount of charging compaction, can enable the quality uniformity of the anode material to be high after graphitization treatment, and can improve the canning amount of each crucible so that the yield of each furnace is higher.

title_en: Waste gas recycling structure of heat pump equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of waste gas recycling, in particular to a waste gas recycling structure of heat pump equipment, which comprises a waste heat recoverer, wherein a filter screen is fixedly arranged in the waste heat recoverer, the surface of the waste heat recoverer is provided with a cleaning structure, the cleaning structure comprises a positioning plate, the surface of the positioning plate is fixedly arranged with the waste heat recoverer, the surface of the positioning plate is slidably sleeved with a support frame, the inner thread of the support frame is connected with a bayonet lock, a mounting rod is rotatably inserted in the support frame, one end of the mounting rod, which is close to the filter screen, is fixedly provided with a hairbrush, the surface of the hairbrush is slidably connected with the filter screen, and the arc surface of the mounting rod is in threaded connection with a fixing cylinder. According to the utility model, the defect that the filter screen is blocked by impurities in the waste gas when the waste gas generated by the heat pump equipment is reused by utilizing the waste heat recoverer in the prior art is overcome, so that the waste gas is influenced to be normally conveyed into the waste heat recoverer.

title_en: Movable furnace lining pushing mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model provides a movable furnace lining pushing-out mechanism which is characterized by comprising a frame and a sliding rail, wherein the sliding rail comprises a sliding rail body; the lifting unit comprises a lifting assembly and a clamp assembly, and the lifting assembly is arranged on the rack and is positioned above the sliding rail; the clamp assembly is hung on the lifting assembly, and the lifting assembly drives the clamp assembly to vertically and linearly move in the sliding rail; the hydraulic oil cylinder unit comprises an oil cylinder assembly and a hydraulic assembly, and the oil cylinder assembly is clamped in the clamp assembly; the hydraulic assembly is connected with the oil cylinder assembly, is installed on the frame and is located below the oil cylinder assembly. The oil cylinder is always in a stable state in the whole use process through the cooperation of the rack and the lifting unit; the hydraulic oil cylinder unit, the lifting unit and the frame are matched and installed into an integral mechanism, so that a corresponding maintenance plan can be conveniently and timely established.

title_en: Base for air cooler convenient to dismouting overhauls air cooler
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a base for an air cooler, which is convenient for disassembly, assembly and maintenance of the air cooler, and comprises the following components: the lifting device comprises a base, wherein a slope is arranged at the front end of the base, a slot is formed in the middle of the top end of the base, a lifting plate is slidably arranged in the slot of the base, a lifter is arranged at the bottom end of the lifting plate, and a buffer block is arranged at two sides of the bottom end of the slot of the base; the clamping blocks are arranged in inner cavities on two sides of a groove of the base, tail blocks are arranged at the inner ends of the clamping blocks, connecting blocks are arranged at the inner ends of the tail blocks, sliding blocks are arranged at the bottom ends of the connecting blocks, and a driving mechanism is arranged between the two sliding blocks. This base for air cooler convenient to dismouting overhauls air cooler passes through the lift and drives the lifter plate and go up and down, can be favorable to reducing the position of air cooler so that it is fixed, can pin the air cooler through the clamp splice, easy operation, and the practicality is stronger.

title_en: Bury formula new fan
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a buried fresh air machine, which comprises: the fresh air processing unit is internally provided with a fresh air processing unit; the underground base is connected to the bottom of the fresh air handling unit and is used for being installed in a floor overhead layer; an air supply chamber communicated with the inside of the fresh air handling unit is arranged in the buried base, and an air supply opening communicated with the air supply chamber is arranged on one side of the buried base; the air supply pipe is used for butting the air supply port with the ventilating pipeline in the floor frame empty layer; the locking piece capable of adjusting the fixed position is arranged between the air supply pipe and the buried base, and the air supply pipe is connected and locked with the buried base through the locking piece. The new trend that this scheme utilized buried in the base in the air supply chamber direct will pass through the new trend processing unit processing in the floor frame empty layer, the new trend blows out from bottom to top through the air outlet window on the floor in the room, compares in traditional aerial air supply mode, and this air supply mode air supply degree of consistency is high, and generally does not have the condition of direct blowing human body, and the somatosensory is comfortable.

title_en: Split type fresh air dehumidifying radiation convection integrated air conditioning system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of air conditioning systems, in particular to a split type fresh air dehumidifying radiation convection integrated air conditioning system which comprises a wall body, an outer wall bracket and an outdoor unit, wherein the left end of the wall body is fixedly connected with the outer wall bracket, the upper end of the outer wall bracket is fixedly connected with the outdoor unit, the lower side of the right end of the outdoor unit is hermetically connected with a Freon pipe, the upper side of the right end of the outdoor unit is hermetically connected with a condensate drain pipe, the right ends of the Freon pipe and the condensate drain pipe are hermetically connected with a HEPA filtering module, the right end of the HEPA filtering module is hermetically connected with a fluorine water heat exchange hydraulic module, the upper end of the fluorine water heat exchange hydraulic module is hermetically connected with a PPR air conditioning water pipe, and the air conditioner is conveniently paved on the top surface, and can meet the use requirements in various modes including a conventional air conditioner full-return mode, a fresh air dehumidifying mode, a fresh air ventilating mode, a fresh air dehumidifying+radiation air conditioning comfort mode and the like.

title_en: All-stainless steel furnace end
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an all-stainless steel furnace end, which comprises a stainless steel injection pipe and a stainless steel fire cover assembly, wherein a stainless steel connecting piece is arranged between the stainless steel injection pipe and the stainless steel fire cover assembly, the stainless steel connecting piece is in an annular tube shape and is provided with a first connecting part and a second connecting part, the first connecting part is in tight fit connection with the stainless steel fire cover assembly, the second connecting part is in interference fit connection with the stainless steel injection pipe, and the stainless steel connecting piece is arranged between the stainless steel injection pipe and the stainless steel fire cover assembly, so that the reliability of connection between the stainless steel injection pipe and the stainless steel fire cover assembly is improved, the material cost is reduced, and the stainless steel connecting piece is not easy to deform due to heating and is more durable as a whole.

title_en: Heat exchange device and air conditioner
abstract_en: The application provides a heat transfer device and air conditioner, include: the first heat exchanger group and the second heat exchanger group are sequentially arranged in the first direction; the first heat exchanger group and the second heat exchanger group are sequentially arranged in the second direction, and in the second direction, the positions of the parts of the first heat exchanger group and the parts of the second heat exchanger group are correspondingly arranged; wherein the first direction and the second direction are perpendicular to each other; the first heat exchanger group comprises at least one first heat exchanger and the second heat exchanger group comprises at least one second heat exchanger. According to the heat exchange device and the air conditioner, the heat exchanger as large as possible can be arranged in the space as small as possible.

title_en: Step-by-step heating furnace with compact step-by-step machinery of frame-type
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of heating furnaces in metallurgical industry, and particularly provides a stepping heating furnace provided with a frame type compact stepping machine, wherein the frame type compact stepping machine comprises a translation structure and a lifting structure, the translation structure comprises translation driving equipment and a plurality of translation units, each translation unit comprises a translation frame and translation rollers, the lifting structure comprises a lifting frame, lifting rollers, lifting driving equipment and a diagonal rail seat, the front end and the rear end of the translation frame are respectively connected with one group of translation rollers, the adjacent translation frames are connected with each other, the translation driving equipment is connected with the translation frame at the end part, and the translation frame is fixedly connected with each group of movable beams at the corresponding position; the lifting frame is internally provided with a groove structure, each group of translation rollers are arranged in the groove structure of the lifting frame, lifting driving equipment is connected with one end of the lifting frame, and each group of lifting rollers are matched with one inclined rail seat. The utility model reduces the cost of the medium and small heating furnaces and compresses the equipment space.

title_en: Low-temperature refrigerating system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a low-temperature refrigerating system which comprises a freeze-drying box body, wherein the freeze-drying box body is connected with a refrigerating assembly. The refrigeration assembly comprises a compressor, a condenser, a throttle valve, an evaporator and a plurality of thermoelectric refrigeration sheets; the outlet of the compressor is connected with the inlet of the condenser, the outlet of the condenser is connected with the inlet of the throttle valve, the outlet of the throttle valve is connected with the inlet of the evaporator, and the outlet of the evaporator is connected with the inlet of the compressor; a plurality of thermoelectric cooling fins are positioned between the evaporator and the lyophilization tank. The utility model has simple structure and more miniaturization, and can prepare a device with low temperature of-70 ℃ to replace the traditional cascade refrigeration system.

title_en: Filter assembly, fume extraction device and cooking equipment
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present utility model provide a filter assembly, a smoke extraction device and a cooking apparatus, the filter assembly comprising: the bracket is provided with a first opening and a second opening, and the first opening is used for air intake; the filter element cover is connected with the bracket and is positioned at the second opening, the filter element cover and the bracket are enclosed to form a filter cavity, and the filter cavity is communicated with the first opening and the second opening; the filter element is detachably arranged in the filter cavity. Through setting up the filter core lid at the second opening part and shelter from the filter core, when guaranteeing that air current such as oil smoke can follow first opening part air inlet and filter, avoid outside cigarette dirty, sewage etc. can be through second opening contact filter core, a large amount of filter cores to the absorption of cigarette dirty, sewage etc. and then effectively prolong the life of filter core, reduce the use cost of user to filter element.

title_en: Turnover structure and flexible photovoltaic bracket
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of photovoltaic panels, in particular to a turnover structure and a flexible photovoltaic bracket. The device comprises supporting component, upset subassembly, photovoltaic module, makes the photovoltaic board can take place to overturn through increasing upset subassembly, has solved in daytime, and the position of sun can change along with the time, and the photovoltaic board only accepts the light source towards a direction, makes the sunlight irradiation time that receives and the problem that illumination intensity will reduce greatly, increases the universal wheel in flexible photovoltaic support bottom, realizes the problem of quick transport under the circumstances that can not rely on the flexible photovoltaic support of split.

title_en: Peak-regulating frequency-modulation system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a peak regulation and frequency modulation system, which comprises: the heating module is used for generating heat energy and outputting the heat energy outwards; the heat accumulation module, heat accumulation module and heating module intercommunication, wherein, the heat accumulation module includes: the low-temperature heat storage device (13) and the high-temperature heat storage device (14), and the low-temperature heat storage device (13) and the high-temperature heat storage device (14) are communicated; the heating module, heating module and heat-retaining module intercommunication, wherein, heating module includes: and a heater (16), wherein the heater (16) is arranged between the low-temperature heat storage device (13) and the high-temperature heat storage device (14). Most of the heat generated by the heating module can be stored. During peak shaving, the heat storage module and the heating module are matched for heat storage, so that the system load can be greatly reduced, and the deep peak shaving and frequency modulation of the thermal power unit system are realized. Meanwhile, the stored high-temperature medium can generate high-quality steam, and the requirements of generating parameters of the turbine set are met.

title_en: Integrated kitchen of integrated gas heater
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an integrated kitchen range of an integrated gas water heater, which comprises an integrated kitchen range organism, wherein a containing cavity is defined in the organism, a fan assembly communicated with an external flue is arranged in the containing cavity, and the integrated kitchen range comprises: the water heater body is arranged in the accommodating cavity and is provided with a combustion chamber and a smoke outlet; the exhaust gas filtering device is arranged at the position of the smoke outlet and used for purifying the smoke generated by the water heater body; one end of the smoke exhaust component is communicated with the smoke exhaust port, and the other end of the smoke exhaust component is communicated with the fan component; and the controller is electrically connected with the fan assembly, the water heater body, the waste gas filtering device and the smoke discharging assembly respectively. The integrated kitchen air heater is simple in structure, and the gas water heater is integrated on the integrated kitchen, so that the space utilization rate of a kitchen is improved, and meanwhile, the gas is exhausted into a public flue through the operation of the integrated kitchen fan in a strong way, so that the gas utilization safety can be effectively guaranteed.

title_en: Integrated liquid metal circulation loop and radiating fin's integrative heat abstractor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an integrated heat dissipation device integrating a liquid metal circulation loop and heat dissipation fins, which comprises an electromagnetic pump, a liquid metal circulation pipe, a cavity and the heat dissipation fins; wherein the liquid metal circulating pipe is filled with low-melting-point liquid metal; the electromagnetic pump is fixed on the cavity and forms a closed loop with the liquid metal circulating pipe; one side of the cavity is used for installing and bearing the electromagnetic pump, the circulating pipe and the radiating fins, and the other side of the cavity is installed on the heat source; the liquid metal circulating pipe penetrates through the radiating fins. The liquid metal and the electromagnetic pump form self-driven circulation heat dissipation, and the liquid metal has the characteristic of high heat conductivity, so that the device has the characteristics of low power consumption and high heat dissipation power.

title_en: Closed suspended ceiling structure of paper mill
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a closed suspended ceiling structure of a paper mill, which comprises a closed suspended ceiling connected with a roof, wherein the closed suspended ceiling is connected with a circulating hot air pipeline, an air supply fan, a heating device and a temperature detection device are arranged on the circulating hot air pipeline, the heating device comprises a box body, two sides of the box body are respectively connected with the circulating hot air pipeline, a plurality of water pipes with heat conducting fins are arranged in the box body, the top and the bottom of the box body are respectively provided with an upper port and a lower port connected with two ends of the water pipes, heat exchange medium circulates in the water pipes through the upper port and the lower port, air enters from one side of the box body and is output from the other side after exchanging heat with the medium in the water pipes, and the heating device is also connected with a regulating valve for regulating the input quantity of the heat exchange medium; the circulating hot air pipeline is also connected with a fresh air supply pipeline. The utility model can ensure that no condensation and no water drop occur in the suspended ceiling area, has lower energy consumption, and can properly supplement filtered fresh air through the fresh air supply pipeline to ensure that the interior of the suspended ceiling is in a micro-positive pressure state.

title_en: Combustor new trend subassembly
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a combustor fresh air component, which comprises a machine body, a combustor main body and an annular plate, wherein a filter screen is fixedly arranged on the annular plate, an air inlet and an air outlet are respectively arranged on the machine body, the annular plate is fixedly arranged on the air inlet, a cleaning mechanism is arranged on the front surface of the machine body, the cleaning mechanism comprises a screw rod, a cleaning brush and a moving component, a nut seat is sleeved outside the screw rod, a connecting strip is fixedly arranged on the front surface of the cleaning brush, and the top of the connecting strip is fixedly connected with the nut seat; the cleaning mechanism is designed to facilitate cleaning dust and impurities attached to the surface of the filter screen on the annular plate in use, so that the surface of the filter screen is in a clean state, the condition that the air inlet quantity of the filter screen is reduced due to the blockage of the surface of the filter screen by the dust and the impurities is avoided, the air inlet quantity at the air inlet is stable, the service performance of the fan is improved, and the quantity of fuel and air fed into a hearth is improved.

title_en: Shell, air conditioner outdoor unit and air conditioner
abstract_en: The embodiment of the utility model provides a shell, an air conditioner outdoor unit and an air conditioner, wherein the shell is used for the air conditioner outdoor unit and comprises a press cavity, a fan cavity, a first side plate, a second side plate and a handle. The fan cavity is arranged at one side of the press cavity, a heat exchanger mounting area is arranged in the fan cavity, the first side plate is positioned at one side of the fan cavity, which is away from the press cavity, and a part of the area of the first side plate protrudes towards one side, which is away from the fan cavity, to form a boss with a handle mounting opening; the second side plate is adjacent to the first side plate, and a handle installation area is formed among the first side plate, the second side plate and the heat exchanger installation area; the handle sets up in handle installing port department, and the handle is including having the portion of gripping of finger holding tank, and in the at least partial region of portion of gripping stretched into handle installing region, and the degree of depth of the portion of gripping stretching into handle installing region was from keeping away from one side of second curb plate towards being close to one side of second curb plate increases gradually. The shell of the embodiment of the utility model can be convenient for carrying the air conditioner outdoor unit.

title_en: Automatic fire extinguishing system for cooking bench
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of automatic fire extinguishment, in particular to a hearth automatic fire extinguishment system, which comprises a temperature measuring device, a temperature measuring device and a temperature measuring device, wherein the temperature measuring device is arranged on one side of the hearth to monitor the temperature of a region at the position; a fuel switch device connected to the fuel supply part of the cooking bench and used for cutting off or communicating fuel; the fire extinguishing device is arranged at one side of the cooking bench to perform fire extinguishing work when a fire disaster occurs; the controller is connected with the temperature measuring device, the fuel switch device and the fire extinguishing device; after the temperature abnormality of the working area is monitored by the temperature measuring device, the fuel supply channel is cut off, so that whether fire occurs at the cooking bench or not can be judged according to whether the subsequent area is continuously heated, and the fire safety of the cooking bench can be effectively ensured.

title_en: Continuous multi-tube furnace for sintering molybdenum bars
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a continuous multi-tube furnace for sintering molybdenum bars, which comprises a horizontal furnace tube, furnace tubes, boats and a heating unit, wherein an external heating assembly and an internal heating assembly are adopted for simultaneously adjusting temperature, so that synchronous and rapid temperature adjustment of external and internal heating temperature areas is ensured, the problem that the temperature adjustment speed of each temperature area of the existing multi-tube furnace is slower is solved, rapid temperature adjustment of each temperature area is facilitated, uniform and rapid temperature adjustment of the furnace tubes is facilitated, the boats in the furnace tubes positioned at the same horizontal position are uniformly heated, the sintering temperature consistency of the molybdenum bars is good, and the product quality is ensured. And the sintering waste heat is collected by utilizing the waste heat collecting water jacket arranged at the tail part of the furnace tube bundle, so that the energy is saved and the environment is protected.

title_en: Air outlet device
abstract_en: The utility model provides an air outlet device, includes the frame, is provided with the air-out subassembly in the frame, goes up the air-out subassembly and includes the perforated plate, goes up the downside of perforated plate and is connected with down the perforated plate, goes up the perforated plate and all inclines in the horizontal plane with lower perforated plate, is provided with a removal perforated plate on the leading flank of last perforated plate, and the removal perforated plate constitutes the sliding pair that is on a parallel with the length direction of last perforated plate with last perforated plate, is provided with temperature-sensing drive arrangement in the frame, and temperature-sensing drive arrangement's power take off end is connected with removal perforated plate. The utility model uses the telescopic temperature sensor to sense the temperature of the air flow, drives the movable porous plate to move according to the temperature of the air flow, and opens or closes the upper porous plate, thereby controlling the blowing angle and speed of the air flow, the porous plate can make the air flow more uniform, the noise is smaller, the upper porous plate and the lower porous plate are provided with the inclination angles, the ventilation area is larger, the adjusting range is wider, the air is prevented from blowing to the human body, and the body temperature of the human body reaches the optimal state.

title_en: Composite control device for drum water level
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a composite control device for drum water level, and relates to the technical field of drum water level control. The top of the steam drum is connected with a steam mother pipe through a steam flowmeter, the bottom of the steam drum is connected with a descending pipe through a first regulating valve and a water outlet flowmeter, and the side wall of the steam drum is sequentially connected with a water inlet pipe, a water inlet flowmeter and a water pump through a second regulating valve; the side wall of the steam drum is provided with a liquid level meter; the side wall of the steam drum is provided with a cylinder body communicated with the steam drum, a floating block floats on the liquid surface in the cylinder body, the upper part and the lower part of the cylinder body are respectively provided with an infrared photoelectric proximity switch, the infrared photoelectric proximity switch is electrically connected with an alarm, and when the floating block shields the infrared photoelectric proximity switch, the alarm is electrified to send out an alarm signal. The steam drum water level is stably controlled through a steam flowmeter, a regulating valve, an inlet water flowmeter, an outlet water flowmeter and a liquid level meter; the limit position of the water level of the steam drum is monitored through the infrared photoelectric proximity switch and the floating block, and an alarm is used for alarming, so that the water level in the steam drum is prevented from being too high or too low.

title_en: Fume exhaust fan
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a range hood, wherein the range hood at least comprises: the main body is provided with a smoke collecting cavity, and the smoke collecting cavity is provided with an air inlet; a moving panel movably configured with respect to the body and configured to be adapted to switch between a closed position in which the air intake of the fume collection cavity is at least partially closed by the moving panel and an open position in which the air intake of the fume collection cavity is open; and at least one stop arranged such that a lower edge of the moving panel bears against the stop in the closed position. The motion panel can be effectively prevented from tilting when closed.

title_en: Movable high-frequency electromagnetic heating stove
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of high-frequency electromagnetic heating furnace equipment, and discloses a movable high-frequency electromagnetic heating furnace which comprises a heating furnace body, wherein a bottom box is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the heating furnace body, universal wheels are movably arranged at the bottom of the bottom box, and a brake motor is fixedly sleeved in the left end of the bottom box. According to the utility model, the cam, the friction block and the limiting block are arranged, and due to the operation of the brake motor, the rotating rod can rotate through the cam to extrude the friction block to move downwards and stretch the rigid spring, so that the limiting block can move downwards along the inner wall of the bottom box to limit the friction block until the friction block is tightly attached to the ground, and the friction block limits the whole heating furnace body through friction force between the friction block and the ground, thereby achieving the purpose of conveniently moving and fixing the heating furnace body, and further enabling operators not to fix universal wheels in sequence.

title_en: Heat recovery formula fresh air ventilator system control cabinet
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a heat recovery type fresh air ventilator system control cabinet which comprises a control cabinet, wherein a plurality of groups of lining plates are fixedly connected to the left and right inner walls of the control cabinet, a strip-shaped opening is formed in the front end face of a wire arrangement box in a penetrating mode, a sealing plate is rotatably connected to the inner wall of the strip-shaped opening, one end of the sealing plate is fixedly connected with a limiting block which is inserted into the strip-shaped opening, a rectangular frame with adjustable height is arranged between the two wire arrangement boxes, a plurality of wire passing holes corresponding to leads of electronic equipment are formed in the side walls of the wire arrangement boxes and the rectangular frame in a penetrating mode, and a cover plate is rotatably connected to the front end face of the rectangular frame. According to the utility model, the flat cable box and the rectangular frame are opened, so that workers can conveniently check the arrangement condition of the wires of the flat cable box and the rectangular frame, and meanwhile, when the electronic equipment needs to be replaced, the corresponding wires in the flat cable box can be directly taken out, the operation is simple, the original wires cannot be influenced, and the efficiency of maintaining the control cabinet by the workers is improved.

title_en: Water-cooling vacuum furnace shell capable of carrying out water circulation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water-cooling vacuum furnace shell capable of performing water circulation, which comprises a placing plate, wherein a fixed plate is fixedly arranged on the outer side of the upper end of the placing plate, a limiting mechanism is connected with the outer side of the upper end of the fixed plate, the limiting mechanism comprises a moving block, a clamping block, a spring and a connecting block, and a condensing water tank is fixedly arranged on the rear side of the upper end of the placing plate; the vacuum furnace shell body is connected to the inner side of the limiting mechanism, the positioning block is fixedly arranged on the outer side of the right end of the vacuum furnace shell body, the sealing block is fixedly arranged on the inner side of the right end of the vacuum furnace shell body, the end cover is connected to the outer side of the right end of the sealing block, the left end of the end cover is provided with a groove, the movable block is arranged on the outer side of the left end of the end cover, and the middle part of the movable block is connected with the mounting rod. This can carry out water-cooling vacuum furnace shell of hydrologic cycle conveniently carries out circulating water cooling to vacuum furnace shell, conveniently opens vacuum furnace end cover, and conveniently installs the vacuum furnace.

title_en: Heat exchange network structure of DMC (DMC) rectification system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of heat exchangers, and discloses a heat exchange network structure of a DMC (metal-insulator-metal) rectification system, which comprises the following components: the DMC rectifying heating equipment is characterized in that a bearing plate is fixedly arranged on the front side of the DMC rectifying heating equipment, a heat exchange box body is arranged at the top of the bearing plate, a liquid inlet pipe and an exhaust pipe are fixedly arranged at the top of the heat exchange box body, a liquid outlet pipe is fixedly arranged on the side surface of the heat exchange box body, and the rear side of the heat exchange box body is in close contact with the DMC rectifying heating equipment; the assembly component is arranged on the DMC rectifying heating equipment and the heat exchange box body and comprises a control block, a positioning block, a supporting piece, a driving piece, a clamping block and a control shaft, wherein two T-shaped grooves are formed in the front side of the DMC rectifying heating equipment, and the T-shaped grooves are in sliding contact with the T-shaped blocks. The utility model has the following advantages and effects: the heat exchange box body can be quickly assembled on DMC rectifying and heating equipment, and the operation is more convenient.

title_en: Check valve and range hood
abstract_en: The utility model provides a check valve and a range hood, and relates to the technical field of kitchen appliances, wherein the check valve comprises: a valve body and a ball check member; the valve body comprises a first pipeline and a second pipeline; the first pipeline extends vertically; one end of the second pipeline is communicated with the side wall of the first pipeline, and the second pipeline is inclined from bottom to top in a direction away from the first pipeline; the ball-shaped non-return part is positioned at the junction of the first pipeline and the second pipeline; the diameter of the spherical check component is larger than that of the first pipeline and smaller than or equal to that of the second pipeline; a guide structure is arranged in the first pipeline and used for guiding the spherical check component below the guide structure to enter the second pipeline; the ball-shaped check part is positioned in the first pipeline and is contacted with the inner wall of the first pipeline to block the first pipeline; in the working state, the ball check part is positioned in the second pipeline, and the first pipeline is in a conducting state.

title_en: Waste heat exchange steam generating device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of steam generation devices, and discloses a waste heat exchange steam generation device which comprises a hollow cylinder, wherein a steam generator component is connected inside the hollow cylinder, the steam generator component comprises a combustion chamber, a partition plate is fixedly connected inside the combustion chamber, a steam generation chamber is arranged at the top inside the combustion chamber, a steam pipe is communicated with the top of the combustion chamber, an exhaust pipe is communicated with the left side of the combustion chamber, and a water inlet pipe is communicated with the left side of the steam generation chamber. This waste heat exchange steam generator, rotatory impeller passes through the blast pipe and drives the stirring arm rotation to the inside rivers motion of drive exhaust gas case makes it carry out abundant contact with the exhaust gas return bend, thereby increases its speed of heating, erects the arm and drives the filter plate shake, cleans the sweeps of its bottom interception, thereby increases the life of filter plate, prevents that it from being blocked by the sweeps in the exhaust gas, thereby reduces its quality of use.

title_en: Internal circulation mechanism of heat storage water tank of upper solar heating machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an internal circulation mechanism of a heat storage water tank of an upper solar heating machine, which comprises a heat storage water tank, wherein the top of the left end face of the heat storage water tank is communicated with a first electric control valve, the outer side of the first electric control valve is communicated with a first connecting pipe, the bottom of the left end face of the heat storage water tank is communicated with a second electric control valve, the outer side of the second electric control valve is communicated with a second connecting pipe, hot water stored in the heat storage water tank flows into a shower nozzle through a water outlet pipe for use in the use process, and the hot water flows through the filter tank for filtering at the filter screen in the filter tank, so that water alkali mixed in the hot water can be filtered, and the shower nozzle can not be blocked by the internal circulation mechanism in the use process.

title_en: Novel photovoltaic power generation tracking support equipment
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of photovoltaic power generation, in particular to novel photovoltaic power generation tracking support equipment, which comprises a support base and a tracking mechanism arranged at the top end of the support base, wherein the tracking mechanism comprises a sliding component, a swinging component and a rotating component; the sliding assembly comprises a tracking frame, a tracking motor, a threaded rod and a threaded slider, wherein the top end of a support base is fixedly connected with the tracking frame, the inner wall of the tracking frame is fixedly connected with the tracking motor, the threaded rod is arranged at the output end of the tracking motor.

title_en: Mechanical temperature control frying pan furnace
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of furnace bodies, and discloses a mechanical temperature control frying pan furnace which comprises a furnace body, a frying pan arranged at the top of the furnace body, a temperature sensing rod, a temperature control valve and a gas circuit pipe, wherein the temperature sensing rod is arranged on the top of the furnace body; the temperature sensing stick is attached to the bottom of the frying pan, one side of the stove body is provided with an air channel pipe and a temperature control valve communicated with the air channel pipe, and the temperature control valve is connected with one end of the temperature sensing stick through a capillary tube. According to the utility model, the temperature sensing rod is attached to the bottom of the frying pan, so that the contact area between the temperature sensing rod and the frying pan is increased as much as possible, the temperature on the frying pan can be detected more accurately, and the temperature sensing rod is attached to the bottom of the frying pan and directly contacts with the frying pan, so that the temperature of the frying pan can be detected at the first time, the opening and closing degree of the temperature control valve is controlled along with the change of the temperature, and the gas quantity entering the furnace body is controlled, so that the temperature of the frying pan is always kept within a required range.

title_en: Keel structure for photovoltaic module installation
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of photovoltaic modules, and particularly discloses a keel structure for installing a photovoltaic module, which is used for installing the photovoltaic module and comprises the following components: main joist, first fossil fragments support and second fossil fragments support, first fossil fragments support and are located the perpendicular junction surface of main joist to have the spout portion that the opening was up, the second fossil fragments support and are located the first fossil fragments support under, and the second fossil fragments support also has spout portion, spout portion can hold photovoltaic module's frame entering to produce locking force from the horizontal direction to the frame. The keel structure provided by the utility model has the advantages that the framework of the photovoltaic module can be quickly slid into the chute track, an installation tool is not required in the installation process, and the installation of the module can be completed only by sliding the clamping chute of the framework of the module into the chute part of the keel, so that the photovoltaic module is convenient and quick, and time and labor are saved.

title_en: Cable structure flexible support suitable for complicated mountain region
abstract_en: The utility model provides a flexible support of a cable structure suitable for a complex mountain, which comprises a support body fixed with the mountain, wherein connecting parts capable of being connected with flexible cables are arranged on the adjacent support bodies, the support body comprises a fixed cylinder and an upright post which are vertically arranged and are mutually connected and matched in the height direction, a height adjusting assembly is arranged between the upright post and the fixed cylinder, and the top of the upright post is connected with the rigid connecting parts; and a rigid, adjustably secured cable end connector on the connecting member, the cable end connector including an ear plate protruding beyond the connecting member extent region and connected to the flexible cable. According to the utility model, the height of the connecting component can be adjusted according to the installation topography, so that the flexible cable can be kept in a good horizontal state, and the photovoltaic module can be well supported, and the photovoltaic module is suitable for photovoltaic installation in complicated mountain areas.

title_en: Assembled photovoltaic panel
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an assembled photovoltaic panel, which relates to the technical field of photovoltaic panels and comprises a protection frame group, a combination module and an adjusting module, wherein the combination module is arranged around the protection frame group, a photovoltaic cell panel is arranged in the protection frame group, a supporting frame is arranged on the back of the photovoltaic cell panel, and the adjusting module is connected between the supporting frame and the photovoltaic cell panel. This photovoltaic board that can assemble, through the combination module that sets up all around at the protective frame group for photovoltaic cell board can carry out the concatenation equipment on the structure through combination module, and then concentrate the series connection with more photovoltaic boards, the structural stability after the connection can be improved in the setting of mortise and tenon fourth of the twelve earthly branches structure simultaneously, and protective frame group itself can provide effectual protectiveness for photovoltaic cell board, avoids receiving the damage under outdoor environment, and adjustment module makes each photovoltaic cell board can be on the braced frame independent regulation, so that receive with many illumination.

title_en: Carbon crystal electric heater vibration/noise reduction mounting structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a shock-absorbing and noise-reducing mounting structure of a carbon crystal electric heater, which comprises a lower shell, wherein the upper end part of the lower shell is connected with an upper shell in a sliding manner, the inner side of the lower shell is provided with a supporting component, an electric heater main body is placed on the supporting component, the lower end part of the upper shell is provided with a connecting component, the inner side of the upper shell is fixedly connected with a stop block, the supporting component comprises a supporting plate, one end of the supporting plate is connected with the inner side of the lower shell in a sliding manner, and a damper is fixedly arranged between the lower end part of the supporting plate and the inner bottom wall of the lower shell. This brilliant electric heater shock attenuation of carbon falls mounting structure, the cooperation of first buffer spring and second buffer spring is crossed, makes the electric heater main part of placing in the backup pad produce when vibrating in the operation, can extrude first buffer spring and second buffer spring through the backup pad, and first buffer spring and the second buffer spring that resets can cushion the electric heater main part and fall and make an uproar, improves the comfort level when user's use.

title_en: Copper alloy founding equipment
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of casting equipment, in particular to copper alloy casting equipment, which comprises an equipment body, wherein a combustion chamber is fixedly arranged on the inner side of the equipment body, a casting chamber is fixedly arranged at the top of the combustion chamber, a first electric push rod is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the equipment body, a mounting frame is fixedly arranged at the left end of the first electric push rod, a scraping plate is connected to the right side of the mounting frame in a sliding manner, a second electric push rod is fixedly arranged at the top of the mounting frame, the control mechanism comprises a push rod and a positioning frame, a positioning mechanism and a control mechanism are respectively arranged at the top of the mounting frame, and the control mechanism is respectively matched with the positioning mechanism and the second electric push rod, and the copper alloy casting equipment comprises the following steps: through the inboard slip of control scraper blade in the casting room, the scraper blade just can strike off the dross, promotes the inboard to the equipment body with the dross, opens the door body again and just can collect cabinet door dross, need not multiple opening, prevents the cooling of casting room.

title_en: Chassis and outdoor unit
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of air conditioners, and discloses a chassis and an outdoor unit, wherein the chassis comprises a tray body, and the tray body is provided with a first installation area for installing a refrigerant treatment assembly and a second installation area for installing a heat exchange assembly; the first installation area is provided with a first drainage groove and a second drainage groove which are communicated, and the second installation area is provided with a third drainage groove and a fourth drainage groove which are communicated; the third water drainage groove is communicated with the second water drainage groove, and a plurality of water drainage holes are formed in the bottom of the third water drainage groove; the height of the bottom inner side wall of the first water drainage tank is higher than that of the bottom inner side wall of the second water drainage tank, the height of the bottom inner side wall of the second water drainage tank is higher than that of the bottom inner side wall of the third water drainage tank, and the height of the bottom inner side wall of the fourth water drainage tank is higher than that of the bottom inner side wall of the third water drainage tank. The chassis and the outdoor unit can timely drain accumulated water on the chassis, and avoid accumulated water from rusting the chassis and supporting legs of important parts such as a compressor, an oil separator and the like arranged on the chassis.

title_en: heat pump heater
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of heat pumps, in particular to a heat pump heater, which comprises an outer shell, an evaporator and at least one centrifugal fan, wherein the outer shell comprises an installation cavity surrounded by a top cover, a chassis and side walls, the side walls comprise a front panel, at least one air outlet is formed on the front panel, and a grid piece is detachably arranged on the air outlet; the evaporator is arranged in the installation cavity and is positioned between the top cover and the chassis; each centrifugal fan is detachably arranged in the installation cavity through the supporting piece, the air inlet end of the centrifugal fan faces the evaporator, and the air outlet end of the centrifugal fan horizontally faces the corresponding air outlet; the centrifugal fan horizontally outputs the air flow subjected to heat exchange from the evaporator; the arrangement of a plurality of centrifugal fans is favorable to improving heat exchange efficiency, and the upper and lower arrangement form of centrifugal fans is favorable to practicing thrift installation space, reduces the overall dimension of heat pump heating machine.

title_en: Combined dust hood of intermediate frequency furnace
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a combined dust hood of an intermediate frequency furnace. The dust hood comprises a stand column pipe, a tee joint, an elbow pipe and a hood body. The upright post pipe is fixed on the furnace platform, the upper end of the upright post pipe is communicated with the dust removing main pipe, the upper part of the upright post pipe is provided with a dust removing inlet, and the upper part of the upright post pipe is rotationally connected with the tee joint at the position of the dust removing inlet. The transverse pipe of the tee joint is detachably connected with the bent pipe, and the bent pipe is fixedly connected with the cover body above the furnace mouth. The upper end and the lower end of the vertical pipe of the tee joint are welded with a rotary table, the rotary table is rotationally connected with a fixed table fixed on the upright pipe through a small ball, and matched U-shaped openings are processed on the fixed table and the rotary table. Bolts are inserted into the U-shaped openings to fix the tee. The fixed disk and the rotary disk are provided with matched grooves, and the small balls roll in the grooves and are limited. The utility model uses rolling friction to facilitate the rotation of the cover body, can detachably enlarge the space of the furnace platform, has simple structure, low manufacturing cost, no maintenance and long service life.

title_en: Heating ventilation air conditioner installation base convenient to drainage
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a heating ventilation air conditioner installation base convenient for drainage, which relates to the technical field of heating ventilation air conditioner installation and comprises a fixing component and an installation base, wherein the bottom of the fixing component is movably connected with the top of the installation base, the fixing component comprises a fixing plate, and the bottom of the fixing plate is movably connected with the top of the installation base. According to the utility model, the heating ventilation air conditioner is placed on the fixed plate, the twisting blocks are rotated to enable the bidirectional screw rod to rotate, so that two groups of moving blocks on the surface of the bidirectional screw rod move towards the center on the limiting rod along with the rotating direction, the clamping plate moves towards the heating ventilation air conditioner, the cover plate is pulled in the moving process to slide on the sliding rail and stretch the springs, after the inner side of the clamping plate contacts the surface of the heating ventilation air conditioner and clamps the surface, the twisting blocks are stopped to rotate, the cover plate is loosened, the springs are not stressed any more, the cover plate is pulled to move downwards, and therefore the cover plate clamps the upper part of the heating ventilation air conditioner.

title_en: Outer ring fire cover and combustor
abstract_en: An outer ring fire lid and combustor, outer ring fire lid includes: the fire cover body is provided with an annular top wall, an inner annular wall extending downwards from the inner side edge of the annular top wall and an outer annular wall extending downwards from the outer side edge of the annular top wall, and an annular mixing cavity is formed among the annular top wall, the inner annular wall and the outer annular wall; the outer annular wall is provided with at least two first main fire holes penetrating through the wall thickness, the first main fire holes are arranged at intervals along the circumferential direction, and the directions of the first main fire holes are arranged in a clockwise or anticlockwise rotation direction integrally along the circumferential direction; the outer annular wall is provided with second main fire holes penetrating through the wall thickness at positions below the first main fire holes, at least two second main fire holes are arranged at intervals along the circumferential direction, and the second main fire holes are integrally arranged in the circumferential direction in a direction opposite to the rotation direction of the first main fire holes. Compared with the prior art, the utility model can reduce the flame-leaving risk.

title_en: Wire controller fixing structure and air conditioner outdoor unit
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of installation of line controllers and discloses a line controller fixing structure and an air conditioner external unit. Through set up the mounting panel that is used for confirming mounted position on the interior face of unit panel for fix the fixed plate on the mounting panel first fastener, and be used for holding the cavity of drive-by-wire ware, make the back of drive-by-wire ware be in relative confined cavity, above-mentioned simple structure moreover, and the installation is all convenient with dismantling, has the utilization and popularizes and applies.

title_en: Gas/electric heating dual-function indirect heat exchange type catalyst roasting furnace
