abstract_en: The utility model discloses a gas/electric heating dual-function indirect heat exchange type catalyst roasting furnace, which comprises a furnace body, wherein a furnace chamber is arranged in the furnace body, one side of the furnace body is provided with a furnace door, the bottom of the furnace chamber is provided with a roller rod conveying system, and the furnace door is provided with a hot air circulation system, an electric heating system, a gas heating system and an exhaust system; the furnace chamber is divided into an upper chamber and a lower chamber by a horizontal partition plate, a movable air box and a fixed air box are arranged in the lower chamber, a roasting space is formed between the movable air box and the fixed air box, an air outlet channel is formed between the movable air box and a furnace wall at the rear side of the movable air box, the air outlet channel is communicated with the roasting space through the movable air box, an air inlet channel is formed between the fixed air box and the furnace wall at the rear side of the fixed air box, the air inlet channel is communicated with the roasting space through the fixed air box, and a circulating fan, an electric heating type radiant tube and a fuel gas type radiant heat exchange tube are arranged in the upper chamber. The utility model uses the pumping force of the circulating fan to form pressure difference to guide the hot air to penetrate the material, so as to fully exchange heat with the catalyst in a convection way, and improve the roasting quality.

title_en: Cleaning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cleaning device, which relates to the technical field of air deflectors of central air conditioners and comprises a wall body and an air deflector, wherein the air deflector is positioned in the wall body, a wind deflector is fixedly arranged on the wall body, a protection frame is fixedly arranged on the outer wall of the wind deflector, a pair of moving grooves are formed in the wind deflector, moving rods are slidably arranged in the moving grooves, connecting rods are fixedly arranged at one ends of the moving rods, first cleaning brushes are fixedly arranged at one ends of the connecting rods, and second cleaning brushes are fixedly arranged at the other ends of the connecting rods. The wind shield is used for preventing the air conditioner from directly blowing and the condensed water of the wind shield from dripping, and the connecting rod drives the first cleaning brush and the second cleaning brush through the motor drive to erase dust on the inner sides of the wind shield and the wind shield, so that automatic cleaning is realized.

title_en: Radiating structure with detachable fins
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a radiating structure with detachable fins, which comprises a base and fins; the base comprises a heat conduction bottom plate, a first positioning piece and a second positioning piece; the first positioning piece and the second positioning piece are arranged on the heat conducting bottom plate at intervals; the fins are provided with a first end and a second end which are positioned in the length direction; the first end of the fin is provided with an abutting part, and the second end of the fin is provided with a spring plate structure; the elastic sheet structure has a rebound force towards the first end; the fins are in an inserting state and are synchronously inserted into the first positioning piece and the second positioning piece; in the plugging state, the abutting part abuts against the side surface of the first locating piece, which is opposite to the second locating piece, and the elastic piece structure abuts against the side surface of the second locating piece, which is opposite to the first locating piece. The fins can be disassembled, are convenient to replace, simplify the assembly steps of the fins, and are convenient to assemble and disassemble, time-saving and labor-saving.

title_en: Terminal humidification device of new trend system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a terminal humidifying device of a fresh air system, which comprises an air outlet pipe, wherein a humidifying mechanism for humidifying is arranged at the lower end of the air outlet pipe, the humidifying mechanism comprises a shell, an air outlet, a water storage bin, absorbent cotton and absorbent rods, the lower end of the air outlet pipe is arranged on the shell, a plurality of air outlets for ventilation are uniformly formed in the outer side surface of the shell, a storage bin is arranged at the lower end of the inner part of the shell, absorbent cotton is arranged at the upper end of the inner part of the storage bin, and a plurality of absorbent rods are uniformly and fixedly arranged on the outer side surface of the lower end of the absorbent cotton. The utility model has good use effect, adopts automatic evaporation and humidification, does not need any other power source, and is arranged at the tail end of the fresh air system, namely at the air outlet, so that a user can conveniently disassemble the fresh air system at any time to disinfect and clean the interior and keep healthy, and an overhaul port is not required to be added for a humidifying module when the fresh air system is built, and the fresh air system is convenient to decorate.

title_en: Two-way closed electric heater
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a two-way closed electric heater, which relates to the field of electric heaters and comprises a heater tank body, wherein a heating chamber is arranged in the middle of an inner cavity of the heater tank body, a diversion chamber and a liquid collecting chamber are respectively separated from two sides of the inner cavity of the heater tank body through a partition board, and the middle of the heating chamber in the inner cavity of the heater tank body is separated into a first heating chamber and a second heating chamber through a horizontal partition board for separating the chambers. The utility model realizes the independent medium supply to the first heating chamber or the second heating chamber, one of the first heating chamber or the second heating chamber is used as direct-current heating, the other one is used for keeping liquid storage type heating, the liquid storage type heating ensures that the medium is heated to high temperature, and after the temperature reaches the requirement, the high temperature medium can be discharged under the switching of the flow regulating valve core, thereby ensuring continuous process high temperature medium.

title_en: Building energy-saving water source heat pump
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a building energy-saving water source heat pump, and belongs to the technical field of water source heat pumps. Comprising the following steps: the heat pump body is used for exchanging heat; the filter box is fixedly connected to one end of the heat pump main body and is used for filtering impurities in water; the filter box is rotationally connected with a rotating shaft, a plurality of symmetrically arranged fan blades are fixedly connected to the outer side of the circumference of the rotating shaft, scraping plates are detachably connected to the other ends of the fan blades, a mounting plate is fixedly mounted in the filter box, and a filter screen is arranged on the mounting plate. The problem of blockage or even damage of an inner pipeline of the water source heat pump device is solved through the filtering device, so that the service life effect of the water source heat pump is improved. Meanwhile, the cooperation of the rotating shaft, the scraping plate and the brush hair can clean filter residues on the filter screen when a water source is filtered, so that the filter screen can be conveniently cleaned.

title_en: Photovoltaic board support convenient to angle regulation
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of photovoltaic panels and discloses a photovoltaic panel bracket convenient for angle adjustment, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a first supporting rod is fixedly connected to the front end of the left side of the top of the bottom plate, a third rotating rod is rotatably connected to the top of the first supporting rod, a second gear is fixedly connected to the front end of the third rotating rod, a second supporting rod is rotatably connected to the rear end of the third rotating rod, the bottom end of the second supporting rod is fixedly connected to the rear end of the left side of the top of the bottom plate, and a connecting plate is fixedly connected to the middle of the third rotating rod. According to the photovoltaic panel and the photovoltaic device, the photovoltaic panel is slid into the sliding groove to be installed and fixed, when the angle of the photovoltaic panel needs to be adjusted, the second rotating rod is rotated to be matched with the first gear, the second gear, the third rotating rod, the connecting plate and the first rotating rod to enable the connecting rod to rotate for adjusting the angle, the nut is screwed to fix the second rotating rod, the angle adjustment of the photovoltaic panel is completed, and the photovoltaic panel can receive the largest sunlight area.

title_en: Photovoltaic bracket with flexibly adjustable dip angle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a photovoltaic bracket with a flexible and adjustable inclination angle, which relates to the technical field of photovoltaic power generation devices and comprises a bottom fixing block, wherein a clamping groove is formed in the outer wall of the bottom fixing block, a supporting outer column is fixedly arranged at the top of the bottom fixing block, a supporting inner column is connected to the inner side of the supporting outer column in a sliding manner, a connecting disc is fixedly arranged at the top of the supporting inner column, an external connecting block is fixedly connected to the top of the connecting disc in a rotating manner, an internal rotating block is connected to the inner side of the external connecting block in a rotating manner, and an inserting block is fixedly arranged at the top of the internal rotating block. According to the utility model, the pushing block is pushed to push the pushing frame, so that the pushing frame slides in the mounting frame, the pushing frame drives the extrusion convex block to extrude the second spring in the movable groove, so that the limit clamping block is driven to be separated from the limit clamping groove, the inserting block crys to be pulled out of the mounting frame, and the problem that the existing photovoltaic support is inconvenient to flexibly adjust is solved.

title_en: Explosion-proof deoxidization heater
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an explosion-proof deoxidizing heater, which comprises a flange connecting seat, wherein the flange connecting seat is installed and connected at the position of the left end head of a cylinder body, and the upper end of the flange connecting seat is provided with a connecting component which is matched with the cylinder body.

title_en: Buffer flash device for weighing hopper of blast furnace sintering ore
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of blast furnace sintering ore screening equipment, and discloses a blast furnace sintering ore weighing hopper buffering flash device which comprises a weighing hopper body, wherein a clamping-connection material guide assembly and an adjustable discharge assembly are arranged outside the weighing hopper body, the material guide assembly comprises a first buffering flash plate arranged at the top of the weighing hopper body, a clamping-connection structure is arranged between the weighing hopper body and the first buffering flash plate, the discharge assembly comprises a first material guide plate arranged at the bottom of the weighing hopper body, an adjustable adjustment structure is arranged at the bottom of the first material guide plate, and a second buffering flash plate arranged at the bottom of the weighing hopper body.

title_en: Device for rapidly cooling waste gas of gas-based shaft furnace process
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a device for rapidly cooling waste gas in a gas-based shaft furnace process, which comprises a cooler shell, a gas deflector, radiating fins, a high-pressure water nozzle and a cooling water jacket; the cooler shell is of a tubular structure and is communicated with a process waste gas pipeline; the gas deflector is positioned inside the cooler housing; the cooling water jacket is sleeved outside the cooler shell in an annular manner, and an annular channel for cooling water to circulate is reserved between the cooling water jacket and the cooler shell; the radiating fins are provided with a plurality of fins, the radiating fins are radially distributed around the air deflector as a center, and one ends of the outer parts of the radiating fins penetrate through the cooler shell and then extend into the cooling water jacket or are connected with the inner wall of the cooling water jacket; the high-pressure water nozzles are arranged between the cooler shell and the gas deflector, and the high-pressure water nozzles are arranged at least one circle around the gas deflector. The device can rapidly and effectively cool the process waste gas flowing through.

title_en: Air guide structure is adjusted to two wind channel air conditioner
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an air guide structure for adjusting a double-air-duct air conditioner, which relates to the technical field of air conditioners and comprises a shell assembly, a conical partition plate and an adjusting mechanism, wherein the shell assembly comprises an air inlet shell and a lower shell which are arranged up and down, the inner side part of the air inlet shell is connected with the air duct shell in a bilateral symmetry manner, and an air inlet channel is formed between the air duct shell and the air inlet shell.

title_en: Rotatable tray of false tooth porcelain furnace
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of denture processing equipment, in particular to a rotatable tray of a denture porcelain furnace, which comprises a porcelain table, wherein the top of the porcelain table is hinged with an oven, the inner bottom wall of the porcelain table is fixedly connected with a supporting block, an adjusting mechanism is arranged in the porcelain table, a limiting assembly is arranged on the porcelain table, the adjusting mechanism comprises a motor I fixedly arranged at the top of the supporting block, the output shaft of the motor I is fixedly connected with a supporting plate, the inner part of the supporting plate is slidably connected with two limiting blocks, and the tops of the two limiting blocks are fixedly connected with a tray body. This rotatable tray of porcelain stove of artificial tooth makes porcelain stove possess rotatory function through setting up adjustment mechanism, reaches the effect of rotating the tray body to the convenience carries out even heating to the artificial tooth, and then improves porcelain stove's work efficiency, has made things convenient for user's use, has increased porcelain stove's practicality.

title_en: Waste water cooler with discharge filtering capability
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a waste water cooler with a discharging and filtering function, which particularly relates to the technical field of environmental protection, and comprises a fixed pipe, wherein a cooling cylinder for cooling waste water is arranged in the fixed pipe, one end of the fixed pipe, which is far away from a connecting pipe, is connected with a filtering pipe for filtering the waste water, and a rubber ring for improving the tightness of the waste water is arranged between the filtering pipe and the fixed pipe.

title_en: Automatic feeding device of calcium carbonate calciner
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic feeding device of a calcium carbonate calciner, which comprises a support frame, a conveying auger and a mixing shell, wherein the conveying auger is rotatably arranged on the support frame, a feeding pipe and a discharging pipe are respectively communicated with the conveying auger, the mixing shell is horizontally and transversely movably arranged on the support frame, a first baffle plate and a second baffle plate for covering the front side and the rear side of the feeding pipe are respectively fixedly arranged on the mixing shell at the front side and the rear side of a discharging hole of the mixing shell, a first material blocking assembly and a second material blocking assembly are respectively movably arranged on the mixing shell at the left side and the right side of the discharging hole of the mixing shell, the lower end of the first material blocking assembly and the lower end of the second material blocking assembly are respectively hinged to the left side and the right side of the feeding pipe, and a transition pipe cavity is formed by enclosing the first baffle plate, the second baffle plate, the first material blocking assembly and the second material blocking assembly. So that the mixed raw materials in the mixing shell are discharged to the conveying auger in a closed mode through the transition pipe cavity, and dust is prevented from being raised during discharging.

title_en: Kitchen air supplementing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kitchen air supplementing device, which comprises a control unit, a range hood monitoring unit and air supplementing louvers, wherein the control unit is used for controlling the range hood monitoring unit to control the range hood; the range hood monitoring unit is electrically connected with the range hood, the air supplementing louver is installed in the air supplementing pipeline, and the control unit is electrically connected with the range hood monitoring unit and the air supplementing louver respectively. According to the utility model, the air supplementing pipeline is arranged in the kitchen, when the range hood monitoring unit monitors that the range hood is opened, the air supplementing louver is opened to supplement air, so that automatic air supplementing can be realized, manual opening of windows and doors are not needed, the use of users is facilitated, and the indoor air quality is improved.

title_en: Ultraviolet air disinfection vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of ultraviolet disinfection, which aims at solving the problem that an ultraviolet lamp post cannot remove dust and clean and disinfect after an ultraviolet air disinfection trolley is disinfected; the utility model provides an ultraviolet air disinfection vehicle, comprising: ultraviolet lamp post, opening car body and cleaning assembly; the cleaning component comprises a water seepage piece and a soft brush ring; the soft brush ring is internally arranged in the opening car body; the soft brush ring is connected with the side wall of the open car body through the water seepage piece; the inner bottom of the open car body is provided with a lifting column; the lifting column extends through the hollow part of the open car body and is connected with the ultraviolet lamp column; the water seepage piece is arranged on the inner wall of the open car body in a surrounding mode; the side wall of the water seepage piece far away from the opening car body is a water seepage wall; the water seepage wall is detachably connected with the soft brush ring; the disinfection vehicle provided by the utility model adopts the open vehicle body to carry the ultraviolet lamp post to carry out ultraviolet disinfection on indoor air.

title_en: Medical low-temperature box
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of low-temperature refrigeration, in particular to a medical low-temperature box, which comprises an outer box, an inner box, a temperature regulating assembly and a containing sterilization mechanism, wherein the containing sterilization mechanism comprises a plurality of groups of containing assemblies and two groups of sterilization assemblies, each group of sterilization assemblies comprises a driving unit, two sliding grooves, two sliding blocks, a connecting plate, two hooks and a sterilizer, the two sliding grooves are fixedly connected with the outer box and are positioned on the inner wall of the outer box, the two sliding blocks are respectively and movably connected with the two sliding grooves, the two hooks are respectively and fixedly connected with the two sliding blocks and are positioned on the outer sides of the two sliding blocks, the connecting plate is fixedly connected with the two sliding blocks and is positioned between the two sliding blocks, the sterilizer is movably connected with the two hooks, and the driving unit is arranged above the outer box.

title_en: Compression-resistant refractory brick
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of refractory bricks, and discloses a compression-resistant refractory brick, which comprises a brick, wherein the surface of the brick is provided with an air vent, the inside of the brick is provided with a mounting structure, and the mounting structure comprises: the mounting box is fixedly connected with the inner wall of the brick; and (5) mounting a rod. This resistance to compression is able to bear or endure firebrick is provided with mounting structure, can install fast through installation pole and dome in the mounting structure, can install fast through gag lever post and stock about to the resistance to compression firebrick simultaneously, just can dismantle two resistance to compression firebricks through removing the handle simultaneously, played the effect of quick installation dismantlement resistance to compression firebrick, can change the resistance to compression firebrick of damage fast when a certain resistance to compression firebrick damages, avoided long-time change can lead to the heat that big fire produced in the coke oven can scatter out, cause the influence to surrounding environment.

title_en: Cooling tower convenient to install and fix
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cooling tower convenient to install and fix, which comprises a cooling tower body, wherein the cooling tower body comprises a lower tower body, a middle tower body, an upper tower body, a ladder, a water column and a water inlet, the lower end surface of a supporting disc is connected with supporting legs, the lower end surface of each supporting leg is connected with an installation sheet, an installation hole is formed in each installation sheet, a water spraying filler is arranged below the inner lower part of the middle tower body, a water distribution system is arranged above the inner lower part of the middle tower body, a spray pipe is arranged at the lower end surface of the middle tower body, a three-splashing spray head is arranged at the lower end surface of the spray pipe, the upper end surface of the middle tower body is connected with the upper tower body, the lower end surface of the supporting disc is connected with the water column, the upper end of the water column is provided with a water outlet, the lower end surface of the outer side of the middle tower body is provided with a fixed column, and the outer end of the fixed column is fixedly connected with the ladder. The utility model has the advantages that the main installation part is convenient for installation, and the water collecting box for collecting water can collect water, thereby preventing water resource waste.

title_en: Photovoltaic panel support
abstract_en: The application discloses photovoltaic panel support, including peg and bracing piece, the peg is used for with outside fixed, the bracing piece is used for with the photovoltaic panel fixed, the one end of peg and the one end of bracing piece rotate through adjusting the structure to be connected, adjusting the structure is used for adjusting the contained angle between peg and the bracing piece; meanwhile, the hanging rod is connected with the supporting rod through the supporting piece, one end of the supporting piece is arranged on the hanging rod, and the other end of the supporting piece is arranged on the supporting rod; the position of one end of the supporting piece on the hanging rod is adjustable, and/or the position of the other end of the supporting piece on the supporting rod is adjustable; and the supporting piece is arranged on the upper half part of the hanging rod, which is close to the adjusting structure, and the upper half part of the supporting rod, which is close to the adjusting structure. Therefore, the distance between the hanging rod and the supporting rod is changed due to the arrangement and the adaptation of the supporting piece and the adjusting structure; and the connecting strength between the hanging rod and the supporting rod is enhanced through the supporting piece, so that the whole stability is improved, and the operation is convenient and fast.

title_en: Gas combustion device based on gas energy-saving stack
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a gas combustion device based on a gas energy-saving stack, which comprises a device main body, wherein one side surface of the device main body is connected with a control panel, one end of the device main body is provided with a vent, the other end of the device main body is connected with a gas joint, the top end of the device main body is connected with a combustion part, the inside of the combustion part is provided with an air inlet space, the inner wall of the combustion part is connected with a flame spray head, the lower end of the flame spray head in the combustion part is connected with a heat insulation hopper, the heat insulation hopper is connected with an igniter, the lower end of the heat insulation hopper is connected with a blast pipe, the blast pipe is connected with a blower, the inside of the device main body is connected with the gas energy-saving stack, and an electrostatic adsorption device is arranged in the gas energy-saving stack.

title_en: Cold trap heat exchanger suitable for high viscosity material
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of heat exchangers, in particular to a cold trap heat exchanger suitable for high-viscosity materials. The utility model provides a cold trap heat exchanger suitable for high-viscosity materials, which can prevent the high-temperature high-viscosity materials from being adhered to the inner wall of a connecting pipeline when encountering cold, and prolong the service life and the quality of the heat exchanger. A cold trap heat exchanger suitable for high-viscosity materials comprises a base, a heat exchanger shell and the like, wherein the front side of the middle part of the base is connected with the heat exchanger shell. According to the utility model, the output shaft of the servo motor rotates to drive the reciprocating screw rod to rotate, the reciprocating screw rod rotates to enable the lifting scraping plate to move up and down on the connecting pipeline, the materials adhered to the outer wall of the connecting pipeline are scraped, and the effects of preventing the high-temperature high-viscosity materials from being adhered to the inner wall of the connecting pipeline when meeting cold and improving the service life and quality of the heat exchanger can be achieved.

title_en: Steam condensate heat utilization device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a steam condensate heat utilization device, which comprises a heat exchange assembly, wherein the heat exchange assembly comprises two toothed rings, four arc-shaped supporting plates, an agitating plate, four supporting rings, a transmission gear, a cleaning plate, a heat exchange tube, two driving motors, two split boxes and two connecting tubes; the two toothed rings are symmetrically and fixedly connected to the front part and the rear part of the outer side wall of the four arc-shaped supporting plates. According to the utility model, the purpose of heat recycling can be realized through the heat exchange tube, the driving motor drives the transmission gear, the toothed ring drives the four arc-shaped support plates to rotate, the cleaning plate moves along the heat exchange tube under the driving of the threads, at the moment, scale on the surface of the heat exchange tube can be scraped by the cleaning plate, the purpose of cleaning the heat exchange tube is achieved, the heat exchange efficiency is improved, and meanwhile, the arc-shaped support plates drive the stirring plate to rotate, so that domestic water can be fully contacted with the heat exchange tube, and further the heat exchange effect is improved.

title_en: Combustion tower and sintering furnace
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a combustion tower and a sintering furnace, wherein the combustion tower comprises a treatment area, a distribution area and a condensation area, organic waste gas in the sintering furnace sequentially flows through a converging area, the treatment area and then reaches the distribution area, the organic waste gas after combustion treatment in the combustion area is divided into two parts, one part of the organic waste gas continues to flow in the sintering furnace, is discharged out of the sintering furnace after cooling treatment in the condensation area, and the other part of the organic waste gas flows back into the sintering furnace with heat after being filtered by a filter box, so that closed loop circulation of high-temperature gas in the sintering furnace and the combustion tower is realized, the organic waste gas is prevented from continuously carrying a large amount of heat out of the sintering furnace, and the energy consumption of silicon chip sintering is increased.

title_en: Multifunctional energy-saving small frying stove
abstract_en: The utility model provides a multifunctional energy-saving small frying stove, which relates to the technical field of kitchen appliances and comprises a frying stove body, wherein an anti-overflow cover is arranged at the top of the frying stove body, a fire cover is arranged at the bottom of the inner side of the anti-overflow cover, a waste heat recovery hole is arranged at the inner side of the fire cover, a smoke exhaust ventilator is arranged at the top of the frying stove body, an oil smoke outlet pipe is arranged on the side surface of the smoke exhaust ventilator, a ventilation plate is arranged on the front surface of the frying stove body, a cover door is arranged at the bottom close to the ventilation plate, a buckle is arranged on the front surface of the cover door, a clamping groove is formed in the front surface of the frying stove body close to the bottom of the cover door, a placing cabinet is arranged at the inner side of the frying stove body, and an access door is arranged on one side surface of the frying stove body, so that heat energy generated by the frying stove during dish making can be recycled, the frying stove can be used in other heating works, and more heat energy is prevented from being lost during dish making work of the frying stove.

title_en: Quenching tower with water supply pipe having winterization preventing capability
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a quenching tower with a water supply pipe having winterization resistance, and relates to the field of quenching towers. Through dividing into three different regional sections for the delivery pipe of quench tower water supply, through setting up different sections, especially set up water supply main valve and emptying valve in the water section and cooperate and set up heat preservation and heating device at water supply main valve lower extreme, the inside through the inside of partial region's heating device assurance pipeline is not frozen owing to the low temperature, in addition when the quench tower is operated, can be according to first temperature sensor and second temperature sensor's temperature adjustment heating rod, avoid freezing, when the quench tower shut down, can guarantee through heating device that water supply main valve is not frozen below, the water of other outside pipelines of evacuation through the emptying valve simultaneously.

title_en: Multi-energy combined storage hot water system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a multi-energy-storage hot water system which comprises a backwater main pipe, a water supply main pipe, a temperature reduction system, a natural gas boiler waste heat recovery system, a heat conduction oil boiler waste heat recovery system, an electrode boiler heating system and an air compressor waste heat recovery system, wherein the natural gas boiler waste heat recovery system, the heat conduction oil boiler waste heat recovery system, the electrode boiler heating system and the air compressor waste heat recovery system are connected in parallel between the backwater main pipe and the water supply main pipe. The multi-energy-linked water heating system provided by the utility model utilizes the plurality of waste heat recovery systems to heat and convey cold water in the backwater main pipe to the water supply main pipe so as to provide heat energy required by a heating system or a domestic water heating system of a park, meanwhile, the electrode boiler heating system is switched between valley and peak electricity at night, the running cost is reduced, continuous heat supply is ensured, and the heat exchange and the cooling are carried out through the temperature reduction system and the cooling tower, so that the heat load and the circulating water quantity of the cooling tower are reduced, the number of the cooling towers is further reduced, the related civil engineering cost, the maintenance cost and the evaporation water quantity are reduced, and the comprehensive energy efficiency improvement of the whole park project is realized.

title_en: Novel lifting electric furnace
abstract_en: The utility model provides a novel lifting electric furnace, which comprises a base, wherein a furnace body is arranged at the top of the base, a motor is arranged on the front surface of the base, a groove body is arranged at the top of the base, a reciprocating screw rod is rotatably arranged on the inner wall of the groove body, the output end of the motor is connected with one end of the reciprocating screw rod, a threaded sliding block is arranged on the outer wall of the reciprocating screw rod in a meshed manner, a lifting furnace table is arranged at the top of the threaded sliding block, first idler wheels are symmetrically arranged at the two sides of the bottom of the lifting furnace table, and guide grooves are symmetrically arranged at the top of the base relative to the groove body. When the lifting electric furnace is used, the space of a factory building can be more effectively utilized, the occupied area of the base when the base is placed is reduced, workers only need to stand on site, the lifting furnace platform does not need to be manually pushed in or pulled out of the lower part of the furnace body, the operation is simple, the labor intensity is low, the phenomenon that the feet of the traditional lifting electric furnace touch the front guide rail by mistake and trip is avoided, and the applicability of products is improved.

title_en: Tilting type steam boiler energy-saving device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of energy conservation of steam boilers and discloses an energy-saving device of a tilting type steam boiler, which comprises a base, wherein the right end of the base is fixedly connected with a supporting plate, the top end of the supporting plate is fixedly connected with a motor, the driving end of the motor is fixedly connected with a first output rod, and the inner wall of the rear end of the base is fixedly and rotatably connected with a second output rod. According to the utility model, the motor drives the first output rod to rotate, and then the belt connected between the first output rod and the second output rod drives the connecting rod at the top end to rotate through the fixing block, so that the transmission rod drives the L-shaped plate to rotate at the outer diameter of the L-shaped plate, and then the other end of the transmission rod rotates at the outer diameter of the operation rod, so that the L-shaped plate limits the rotation of the fixing plate and improves the stability, and finally the fixing plate drives the steam boiler body to rotate, thereby realizing the angle adjustment of the steam boiler, and facilitating the taking out of the internal materials.

title_en: Cleaning device for solar water heater
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a solar water heater cleaning device, which belongs to the technical field of solar water heater cleaning, and comprises a solar water heater water tank, wherein a solar water heater vacuum tube is arranged on the solar water heater water tank, a cleaning sponge pad and a rubber scraping strip are movably arranged on the solar water heater vacuum tube, the rubber scraping strip is positioned at the front end of the cleaning sponge pad, the cleaning water tank is arranged at the upper end of the cleaning sponge pad, and the rubber scraping strip can rub with the solar water heater vacuum tube by arranging the cleaning device consisting of the cleaning sponge pad, the rubber scraping strip and the cleaning water tank, so that part of dust adhered on the cleaning sponge pad is scraped off, further, the first cleaning of the solar water heater vacuum tube is completed, meanwhile, cleaning water in the cleaning water tank can enter the cleaning sponge pad through a water outlet hole, so that the cleaning sponge pad is soaked, and further, the soaked cleaning sponge pad can perform secondary cleaning on the solar water heater vacuum tube.

title_en: Condensate tank exhaust steam recycling device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of condensate waste steam recycling, in particular to a condensate tank waste steam recycling device, which comprises a hot water tank, wherein a steam distributor is arranged in the hot water tank, the steam distributor comprises a main pipe with one end open and the other end closed, the exhaust steam pipe is connected to the open end of the main pipe, the main pipe is connected with at least two branch pipes, the free end of each branch pipe is of a closed structure, a plurality of steam spray pipe groups are arranged on each branch pipe along the length direction, each steam spray pipe group comprises a plurality of steam spray pipes arranged along the circumference of the branch pipe, a plurality of steam spray hole groups are arranged on the steam spray pipes along the length direction, and each steam spray hole group comprises a plurality of steam spray holes arranged along the circumference of the steam spray pipe. The utility model changes the exhaust steam emptying flow, essentially and thoroughly solves the problem of exhaust steam emptying of the condensate tank, and has the characteristics of safe and reliable operation, simple operation, effective and great improvement of exhaust steam recycling efficiency and the like.

title_en: Split type waste heat recovery device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a split type waste heat recovery device, which relates to the technical field of split type waste heat recovery devices and comprises a shell, wherein a heat exchanger is fixedly arranged in the shell, a top cover is fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the shell, a connector is fixedly arranged on the side surface of the shell, a fixed head is rotatably connected in the connector, a connecting pipe is fixedly arranged on the side surface of the fixed head, a base is fixedly arranged on the lower surface of the shell, and a limit box is fixedly arranged on the side surface of the shell.

title_en: Control system of feed water recirculation valve of once-through boiler
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of automatic control of coal-fired power plants, and discloses a control system of a once-through boiler water supply recirculation valve, which comprises a water supply pump inlet flow measuring device, a control unit and a recirculation valve, wherein the recirculation valve is connected with the once-through boiler to form a circulating water supply passage; the once-through boiler feed water recirculation valve control system also comprises a main feed water flow measuring device which forms a main feed water passage connected with the circulating feed water passage in parallel; the start-up system is used for establishing a start-up flow rate and a start-up pressure for the once-through boiler and simultaneously controlling the temperature and the flow rate of the water drain flowing into the deaerator. The utility model bidirectionally controls the output of the water feed pump and the opening of the recirculation valve, improves the coordination control precision and the automatic regulation level of the unit, ensures the minimum flow of the water feed pump, improves the regulation stability of the main water feed flow, prevents the main water feed flow from suddenly dropping caused by improper opening of the recirculation valve under abnormal conditions, triggers the protection of low water feed flow and causes the unplanned shutdown accident of the unit.

title_en: Single-head energy-saving big cooker
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a single-head energy-saving large kitchen range, which comprises a large kitchen range body and a through hole arranged at the center of the top of the large kitchen range body, wherein a kitchen range cylinder is arranged at the outer side of the top end of the through hole, and is fixedly connected with the outer wall of the top of the large kitchen range body through welding.

title_en: Warmer with hidden handle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of heaters, in particular to a warmer with a hidden handle, which comprises a shell and decorative covers, wherein the left side and the right side of the shell are respectively provided with accommodating areas, the decorative covers are at least two, and at least two decorative covers are symmetrically arranged in the two accommodating areas; the vertical section of the decorative cover comprises a first connecting section, a first supporting section, a second connecting section, an inclined section and a third connecting section which are sequentially connected from top to bottom; the first connecting section is connected with the upper end face of the shell, the third connecting section is connected with the lower end face of the shell, the second connecting section is horizontally arranged or obliquely arranged, and one end, connected with the second connecting section, of the oblique section is obliquely arranged towards the inner side direction of the shell; the second connecting section and the inclined section are arranged on the surface of the decorative cover to form an inwards concave handle area, so that the problem that the handle and the warmer are unstable in mounting structure or complex in structure and many in parts are solved.

title_en: Double heat source dryer hot-blast stove
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a double-heat-source dryer hot blast stove, which relates to the technical field of dryer hot blast stoves and comprises a combustion chamber base, wherein a combustion chamber barrel is arranged on the combustion chamber base, a natural gas burner is arranged at one end of the combustion chamber barrel, an air outlet is arranged at the other end of the combustion chamber barrel, and a biomass combustion zone is further arranged at the bottom position in the combustion chamber barrel; the combustion engine and the biomass combustion mechanism are used for supplying heat to the double heat sources in the combustion chamber, the bottom of the combustion chamber cylinder body is provided with a hood type air distribution device for supplying air to the biomass combustion mechanism, and the hot blast stove supports natural gas as a heat source and biomass particles as a heat source.

title_en: Dynamic self-checking burner controller
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of industrial boiler burners, in particular to a dynamic self-checking burner controller. The technical scheme includes that the damping vibration attenuation device comprises a base, damping vibration attenuation rods and a controller main body, U-shaped clamping plates are symmetrically and fixedly installed at two side positions of the outer surface of the controller main body, a dovetail groove is formed in the upper surface of the base, dovetail blocks are arranged at two side positions inside the dovetail groove, the damping vibration attenuation rods are fixedly connected to the upper surfaces of the dovetail blocks, inserting blocks are fixedly connected to the tail ends of the damping vibration attenuation rods, fixing threaded holes are formed in the positions, close to the outer sides of the two damping vibration attenuation rods, of the upper surface of the dovetail blocks, and fixing screws are inserted into the fixing threaded holes. The utility model can play a good role in damping the dynamic self-checking burner controller, is beneficial to the normal operation of the dynamic self-checking burner controller, and meanwhile, the split type mounting structure of the dynamic self-checking burner controller is convenient for the disassembly, assembly and transportation of the dynamic self-checking burner controller.

title_en: Plate heat exchanger convenient to installation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a plate heat exchanger convenient to install, and relates to the technical field of plate heat exchangers. According to the plate heat exchanger convenient to install, the movable screw rods are arranged, the compressed rear end plate moves towards the front end plate, the plates are compressed, and finally the plates are compressed and fixed through six groups of bolts, so that the operation is simple and convenient, and the compression force applied to the plates is uniform and stable due to the fact that the plates are compressed through the whole middle plate, deformation and other conditions are avoided, and the service life of the plates is prolonged.

title_en: Household open-mounted vertical fan coil
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of vertical fans and discloses a household open-mounted vertical fan coil, which comprises a main body mechanism, a filtering mechanism and a functional mechanism, wherein the filtering mechanism is positioned at the left end of the main body mechanism, the functional mechanism is positioned at the upper end of the main body mechanism, the main body mechanism comprises a vertical fan coil main body, a radiating window and an air outlet, the household open-mounted vertical fan coil is provided with the main body mechanism, the radiating window is fixed on the main body of the vertical fan coil, the air outlet blows hot air or cold air, a movable fan blade swings up and down to adjust the air outlet, a supporting frame below a rotating seat below the main body of the vertical fan coil is pushed to fix a fixed shaft and a pulley, the pulley rotates on the fixed shaft, equipment moves, the vertical fan coil main body is rotated, the supporting frame carries the pulley to rotate in the direction below the rotating seat, a pedal is pressed by a foot when the equipment stops, and a fixing piece below the pedal is used for fixing the pulley, so that the mobility of the household open-mounted vertical fan coil is improved.

title_en: Aluminum ingot melting furnace
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an aluminum ingot melting furnace, in particular to the technical field of aluminum ingot melting furnaces, which comprises a base and a furnace body for melting aluminum ingots, wherein the furnace body is arranged in the base, a stirring paddle is arranged in the furnace body, a filter assembly is sleeved on the outer wall of the stirring paddle and used for cleaning aluminum ingot slag in the furnace body, the filter assembly comprises three annular plates, six partition plates are fixedly arranged in each annular plate, a filter screen is fixedly arranged between every two adjacent partition plates, and the same lantern ring is fixedly arranged at the top of each partition plate. According to the utility model, the stirring paddle is driven by the first motor to rotate in the furnace body, so that the melting speed of the aluminum ingot liquid is accelerated, after melting is finished, the stirring paddle is driven by the adjusting component to move out of the furnace body, the aluminum ingot liquid in the furnace body passes through the filter screen, aluminum ingot residues are left on the filter screen and move out of the furnace body along with the filter screen, the aluminum ingot liquid is filtered, manual operation is not needed, the filtering effect on the aluminum ingot liquid is better, and the time consumed by filtering can be shortened.

title_en: Heat supply and humidity supply integrated device and tea fermentation room
abstract_en: The utility model provides a heat and humidity supplying integrated device and a tea fermentation room, wherein the integrated device comprises a movable machine body, a temperature and humidity sensor for detecting indoor temperature and humidity, and a controller, a hot air module and a steam module which are arranged in the machine body; the hot air module comprises a ceramic heating core and a fan which can blow hot air heated by the ceramic heating core out of a hot air outlet of the machine body; the steam module comprises a steam heating body, a water tank and a water pump capable of pumping water in the water tank into the steam heating body, wherein the steam heating body heats water to form high-temperature steam and is sprayed out from a steam outlet of the machine body. The utility model relates to a heat and humidity supplying integrated device which can be disassembled and moved at any time to be assembled with a tea fermentation room for heat and humidity supplying; and the integrated device can be replaced with another heat and humidity supplying integrated device for continuous use during maintenance, so that the fermentation work of the fermentation room is not affected.

title_en: Gas stove support and gas stove
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a gas-cooker technical field specifically is a gas-cooker support and gas-cooker, including gas-cooker body and support body, the top fixedly connected with of gas-cooker body is given vent to anger first and is given vent to anger the piece second, the ventilation slot has all been seted up to the inside of piece first and the piece second of giving vent to anger, and set up a plurality of ventholes that are linked together with the ventilation slot on the outer wall of piece first and the piece second of giving vent to anger, the top of gas-cooker body is set up flutedly, the support body includes supporting shoe first and supporting shoe second, four evenly setting bracing pieces of top fixedly connected with of supporting shoe first, the quantity of supporting shoe second is the same with the quantity of bracing piece, a plurality of jacks are seted up to the top fixedly connected with inserted block of bracing piece second, a plurality of jacks are pegged graft the cooperation with the jack, this gas-cooker support and gas-cooker are compared prior art and are convenient to carry out effectual support to different cookware, the application scope of support body has been improved, and practical operation is simple, the practicality is higher.

title_en: Multi-layer split heat-insulating tile for combustion chamber
abstract_en: The utility model provides a multi-layer split type heat-insulating tile for a combustion chamber, which comprises a shielding plate, an impact hole plate and a base which are detachably connected, wherein the edge of the shielding plate is abutted with the edge of the base to form the side wall of the heat-insulating tile; the impact hole plate is arranged between the shielding plate and the base; the base is provided with a plurality of through holes, and a first chamber is formed between the base and the impact hole plate; a second cavity is formed between the shielding plate and the impact hole plate, a plurality of impact holes are formed in the impact hole plate, and a plurality of cooling holes are further formed in the side wall of the heat insulation tile. The multi-layer split structure adopted by the utility model ensures that each part is easy to process and optimally designed, and proper materials are selected according to functions, so that the production cost is reduced. When the heat insulation tile is partially failed, all the components are easy to replace, so that the cost is further saved. Meanwhile, the heat-insulating tile provided by the utility model introduces cooling impact, has high cooling efficiency, and is beneficial to prolonging the service life and safety of the heat-insulating tile.

title_en: Water heater shell and water heater
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water heater shell and a water heater, comprising a shell body, a cavity arranged in the shell body, a protruding part arranged on the shell body, a clearance groove arranged on the protruding part, and a connecting mechanism arranged in the clearance groove and used for fixing the relative position between a water heater component and the protruding part; the connecting mechanism comprises a connecting fixing hole which is arranged in the clearance groove and used for communicating the cavity with the outside of the shell body, and a connecting piece which is inserted in the connecting fixing hole and used for connecting the components of the water heater, and the depth of the clearance groove is larger than the length of the connecting piece extending out of the shell body; when the shell body is installed, the shell body can be adhered to a wall, so that the installation is convenient, the connection is stable, the connecting piece is prevented from extending out of the shell body and propping up the wall, the shell body is propped up, the attractiveness is influenced, and potential safety hazards are caused; the utility model also provides a water heater, which comprises a water heater shell, and is simple in structure, stable in connection and convenient to install.

title_en: Vacuum furnace convenient to wash
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a vacuum furnace convenient to clean, and relates to the technical field of vacuum furnaces. The utility model comprises universal wheels, wherein aluminum profiles are arranged at the tops of the universal wheels, a bottom plate is arranged at the tops of the aluminum profiles, the aluminum profiles are fixedly connected with the bottom plate, a furnace body is arranged at the tops of the bottom plate, the furnace body is fixedly connected with the bottom plate, a second bearing plate is arranged in the furnace body, the furnace body is fixedly connected with the second bearing plate, a conveying device is arranged at the tops of the second bearing plates, the conveying device is fixedly connected with the second bearing plate, sliding rails are arranged on the side surfaces of the conveying device, a motor is arranged at the tops of the sliding rails, a spraying device is arranged at the bottom of the motor, and the spraying device is in sliding connection with the motor. The utility model obtains the benefit as large as possible by utilizing the principle of water circulation and with the smallest resource consumption and environmental cost as possible, promotes the resource to be continuously utilized and recycled, is beneficial to saving raw materials and is also generally beneficial to saving the energy consumed for remanufacturing new products.

title_en: Electric stove tail gas collection device
abstract_en: The utility model provides an electric furnace tail gas collecting device, which comprises a wall body and a smoke discharging mechanism, wherein the smoke discharging mechanism comprises a first elbow, a wireless thermocouple, a sealing sleeve, a smoke pipe and a second elbow, and the electric furnace tail gas collecting device relates to the technical field of electric furnace forging and has the following beneficial effects: through the setting of mechanism of discharging fume, when using, the setting of multiple elbow can make the device tobacco pipe be applicable to complicated production environment, conveniently lay the tobacco pipe to the convenience is retrieved the electric stove tail gas of different positions, and seal cover can strengthen junction sealing quality, can solve with dismantling many times and can produce between two tobacco pipes the poor problem of leakproofness, the design of multistage formula tobacco pipe, when carrying out the tobacco pipe maintenance and handling, can dismantle the problem tobacco pipe alone, can assemble by oneself according to the distance with the electric stove, can make the device be suitable for and multiple condition of discharging fume.

title_en: Device for assisting in cleaning heat dissipation plate of energy storage power station
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a device for assisting in cleaning a heat dissipation plate of an energy storage power station, which relates to the technical field of auxiliary cleaning devices and comprises a heat dissipation plate main body, wherein mounting plates are arranged on two sides of the heat dissipation plate main body, guide grooves are formed in the upper parts of the inner sides of the surfaces of the mounting plates on the two sides, a threaded rod is rotatably arranged on the inner surface of the guide groove on the right side of the mounting plate through a bearing, an adjusting block is connected with the surface of the threaded rod in the guide groove in a threaded manner, a driving motor is arranged at the rear end of the threaded rod penetrating through the right side guide groove, and the driving motor is fixedly connected with the rear end of the outer surface of the right side mounting plate. This device of supplementary clean energy storage power station heating panel compares with the device of the ordinary supplementary clean energy storage power station heating panel of current, carries out automatic clearance to the heating panel main part, reduces artifical intensity of labour, promotes clean efficiency, rolls in the left side guide way through the leading wheel is synchronous, can reduce the frictional force of global motion, increases the stability of removal, makes the clearance work more stable.

title_en: Air curtain helps fume extractor
abstract_en: The air curtain smoke exhaust assisting device has one casing around the kitchen range and with upper end surface not higher than the kitchen range to avoid damage to the casing caused by high temperature; and a plurality of air outlet devices arranged on the upper end face of the shell can independently open and close the air curtain, so that the requirement of a user on an action area of the air curtain is met, the air outlet is closed through the switch partition plate, the entry of dust, crawlers and other foreign matters is avoided, and the cleaning maintenance cost is reduced.

title_en: Air guide structure of wall-mounted air conditioner indoor unit and wall-mounted air conditioner indoor unit
abstract_en: The utility model provides an air guide structure of an indoor unit of a wall-mounted air conditioner and the indoor unit of the wall-mounted air conditioner, and relates to the technical field of air conditioners. The air deflector is rotatably arranged at the air outlet of the indoor unit of the wall-mounted air conditioner, the air deflector is provided with a first position for guiding air flow at the air outlet and a second position below the shell of the indoor unit of the wall-mounted air conditioner, and a drainage channel is defined with the bottom of the shell when the air deflector is positioned at the second position, so that the ambient air flowing through the drainage channel is converged with the air flow at the air outlet, the function of the air deflector can be increased, the air deflector can guide air and the practicability of the air deflector is improved.

title_en: Air-out panel component, air conditioner indoor unit and air conditioning system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of air conditioners, in particular to an air outlet panel assembly, an air conditioner indoor unit and an air conditioning system. This air-out panel assembly includes: the air-out panel body, tripe, translation mechanism and slewing mechanism. According to the air outlet panel assembly, the air conditioner indoor unit and the air conditioning system, the translation mechanism is utilized to drive the louver to translate, breeze air supply is realized in a working state, dust is prevented from entering the machine body in a shutdown state, and dust prevention of the machine body is realized; the shutter is driven to rotate by the rotating mechanism, so that a common air supply mode can be realized, and the air outlet direction of the shutter can be adjusted along with the adjustment of the rotating angle of the shutter, thereby avoiding direct blowing of a user and reducing the probability of suffering from air conditioning diseases.

title_en: Furnace bottom structure of submerged arc furnace
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a submerged arc furnace bottom structure, which comprises cooling blind holes and ventilation pipes, wherein a plurality of cooling blind holes are formed in the side wall of the submerged arc furnace bottom along the circumferential direction, and are arranged along the circle center of the submerged arc furnace bottom in a radial mode; the inside of each cooling blind hole is respectively inserted with one ventilation pipe, and the outer diameter of each ventilation pipe is smaller than the inner diameter of each cooling blind hole; the outer end of the ventilation pipe is communicated with the air supply pipe. The advantages are that: cooling air sent by the air supply pipe is sent into the cooling blind hole of the furnace bottom of the submerged arc furnace through the ventilation pipe, and then the cooling blind hole is discharged after absorbing heat of the furnace bottom of the submerged arc furnace, so that the temperature of the furnace bottom of the submerged arc furnace is controlled within a certain range, the condition of extremely rapid cooling and heating does not occur, further iron infiltration of the furnace bottom can be effectively prevented, the furnace bottom refractory material can bear the furnace bottom, and the service life of the furnace body is prolonged.

title_en: Smoke ventilator with detachable fan
abstract_en: The utility model provides a detachable smoke ventilator of fan, includes the fan shell, sets up the fan device on the fan shell, be equipped with uncovered on the fan shell, be equipped with sliding structure between fan shell and the fan device so that the fan device slides along the inside and outside direction of fan shell, sliding structure is including setting up the guide rail subassembly between fan device and fan shell, the guide rail subassembly extends along the slip direction of fan device and sets up. The utility model provides a detachable fan type smoke exhaust ventilator, wherein a fan device can be detached from a fan shell, so that the fan device and the fan shell can be conveniently cleaned, and the normal operation of the smoke exhaust ventilator is ensured.

title_en: Variable air volume double-position adjusting air valve for Internet of things
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of air purification, in particular to an air valve of the Internet of things. The utility model provides a variable air volume dibit regulation thing networking blast gate, includes the valve body, still including set up in first executor, second executor on the valve body, the preceding valve block group that links to each other with first executor, with the back valve block that the second executor links to each other, preceding valve block group include first valve block, with first valve block mechanical linkage's second valve block. The first valve block is arranged on the upper part of the inner side of the front end of the valve body, the second valve block is arranged on the lower part of the inner side of the front end of the valve body, and the rotating shafts of the first valve block and the second valve block are arranged in parallel and in the same plane. According to the utility model, the measuring precision of the potentiometer is improved through gear transmission, and simultaneously, the rotating speed of the motor is reduced through two-stage gear transmission, so that the torque is increased, and the purpose of accurately controlling the opening of the air valve is achieved. The linear characteristic of the air volume adjustment of the air valve can be greatly improved, and the accurate adjustment of the air volume of two continuous intervals with large air volume difference is achieved.

title_en: Auxiliary device for auxiliary installation of kitchen range and kitchen range equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to an auxiliary device for assisting in installing a kitchen range, the auxiliary device comprising an auxiliary unit comprising: a clamping portion configured to clamp an upper and lower mesa region of a cooktop adjacent to a mounting hole for mounting the cooktop; and an expansion part configured to expand inward with respect to an inner sidewall of the mounting hole at least in a state where the auxiliary unit is clamped to the hob by the clamping part, so as to hold the hob. The application also relates to a corresponding kitchen appliance. The application has the advantages that: so that the hob can be firmly mounted to the mounting holes of unsuitable dimensions by means of the auxiliary means.

title_en: Multidirectional atomization deodorizing device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of deodorizing devices and provides a multidirectional atomizing deodorizing device which comprises a supporting plate, wherein the top end of the supporting plate is fixedly connected with a mounting frame, one side, close to the supporting plate, of the mounting frame is provided with a mounting cavity, one side, close to the supporting plate, of the mounting cavity is fixedly connected with a mounting frame, the middle part of the mounting frame is fixedly connected with a filter screen, one side, far away from the supporting plate, of the mounting cavity is fixedly connected with a fixing strip, and one side, close to the filter screen, of the fixing strip is fixedly connected with a fan; according to the multidirectional deodorizing device provided by the utility model, the fan is started to blow air out from the air outlet holes through the top of the supporting plate, dust carried in the air is blocked by the fan, meanwhile, peculiar smell in the air is filtered through the baking soda layer and the agilawood layer, smell in the air is improved, the air breathed by people is healthier, and the universal wheels can push the device to reach the required position for working.

title_en: Dirt cleaning device for air conditioner cooling tower
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a dirt cleaning device for an air conditioner cooling tower, which relates to the technical field of cooling towers and comprises a water collecting disc, wherein a plurality of bases are fixedly arranged at the lower end of the water collecting disc, a fixed seat is fixedly arranged at the central position of the inner bottom of the water collecting disc, a supporting tube is fixedly arranged at the central position in the fixed seat, the upper end of the supporting tube is fixedly connected with a spraying mechanism, a water inlet pipe is fixedly arranged at one side of the fixed seat, a channel between the water inlet pipe and the supporting tube is communicated, and a water outlet pipe is fixedly arranged on the water collecting disc at one side of the water inlet pipe. Set up desilting mechanism in the water collecting tray, desilting mechanism comprises collar, fixed frame, installing frame and collecting bag, can drive fixed frame and installing frame through the collar conveniently and rotate in the water collecting tray to cooperate the baffle of the interior bottom of water collecting tray, can carry out the sediment of the interior bottom of water collecting tray and shovel and collect, promote the clear convenience of sediment in the water collecting tray, simultaneously, promote clean effect.

title_en: Heater assembly with connecting assembly
abstract_en: A heater assembly includes a pair of heating segments (22) and a connection assembly (24). Each heating section includes a conductive portion (52). The connection assembly (24) includes a connection housing (26) and a connection member (28) disposed within the connection housing (26). The conductive portions of the pair of heating sections are connected by a connecting member within the connecting housing.

title_en: Comprehensive sterilization device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a comprehensive sterilization device which comprises an ultraviolet sterilizer, wherein the ultraviolet sterilizer is formed by combining a protective shell, a main board and a light source component, a sterilization wind cavity is formed in an ultraviolet sterilizer body, a bottom mounting plate is fixedly arranged at the rear end of the protective shell, a lamp holder is fixedly arranged at the top end of the outer edge of the bottom mounting plate, an eddy fan is fixedly arranged at the top end of the rear wall of the lamp holder, the eddy fan is positioned in the sterilization wind cavity, the main board is fixedly arranged at the top of the outer wall of the front end of the lamp holder, and a plasma generator and an ozone generator are fixedly arranged on the outer wall of the front end of the lamp holder, which is positioned at one side of the main board. The utility model has simple structure, improves the sterilizing effect by the cooperation of the inner ultraviolet sterilizing lamp, the outer ultraviolet sterilizing lamp, the ozone generator and the plasma generator, and can kill bacteria, purify air and maintain air freshness.

title_en: Glass fiber gumming device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a glass fiber gumming device, which relates to the technical field of gumming devices and comprises a heating mechanism, wherein a shielding mechanism is movably inserted into the inner surface wall of the heating mechanism. According to the utility model, the sliding block is driven by the electric telescopic rod to move back and forth in the sliding groove formed in the top of the strip-shaped base, the top of the sliding block is fixedly provided with the fixed shaft, the outer surface wall of the fixed shaft is movably sleeved with the push rod, the bottom of the dipping tank is fixedly provided with the fixed column, the outer surface wall of the fixed column is movably sleeved with the rotary disc, the bottom of the rotary disc is fixedly provided with the support shaft, and the outer surface wall of the support shaft is movably sleeved in the through hole formed in the top of the push rod, so that the rotary disc is driven to slowly rotate on the outer surface wall of the fixed column, four heaters fixedly arranged on the rotary disc can uniformly heat the dipping tank in multiple directions, poor dipping effect of glass fibers caused by local heating is prevented, and the qualification rate of subsequent glass products is improved.

title_en: Building winter heating heat consumption monitoring system convenient to installation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a building winter heating heat consumption monitoring system convenient to install, and relates to the technical field of heat monitoring. The utility model uses the mutual coordination of the box body, the power supply, the display and the control button to fix the display on the outer wall of the box body for penetrating the internal condition of the box body, the power supply is used for starting the box body to make the box body operate, the control button is used for controlling the equipment in the box body, the heat detector is used for detecting the temperature of an object by the mutual coordination of the heat detector, the wire inserting groove and the heat radiating opening, and the wire inserting groove is used for electrifying the heat detector, and the heat radiating opening is used for radiating the heat in the box body.

title_en: Green economizer system of subway station ventilation air conditioner
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a green energy-saving system of a ventilation air conditioner of a subway station, and relates to the technical field of ventilation systems of subway stations; comprising the following steps: the air duct comprises a spliced air duct main body, clamping grooves are formed in four corners of two ends of the spliced air duct main body, the clamping grooves are of an L-shaped structure, and one side of each clamping groove is provided with an assembly hole; the heat preservation pad is sleeved outside the spliced air duct main body, and a plurality of first jacks are formed in the side face of the heat preservation pad; the connecting frame, the connecting frame both sides are provided with the head rod with first jack looks adaptation, and head rod detachable grafting is in first jack. According to the utility model, the spliced air duct main bodies are arranged and connected, and the installation quantity of the spliced air duct main bodies is controllable, so that the overall size of the ventilating duct can be flexibly adjusted to meet different installation requirements; the heat preservation pad is arranged to play a role in heat preservation, heat loss is reduced, meanwhile, the heat preservation pad is sleeved outside the spliced air duct main body, flexible disassembly and assembly are achieved, and practicability is high.

title_en: Active fresh air conditioner heat recovery system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an active fresh air conditioner heat recovery system, which is characterized in that a group of preheating coils are arranged in front of a surface cooling coil of a conventional fresh air conditioner heat recovery system, a group of heat recovery coils are arranged in front of an exhaust fan, the reheating coils are canceled and replaced by reheating recovery coils, an inlet of the reheating recovery coils is connected with an outlet of the heat recovery coils, an outlet of the reheating recovery coils is connected with an inlet of the preheating coils, and an outlet of the preheating coils is connected with an inlet of the heat recovery coils, so that circulation is completed; a pump is arranged on a pipeline between the heat recovery coil and the reheat recovery coil, and a heat supplementing plate is additionally arranged behind the pump for heat exchange; the two-way control valve is arranged in front of the inlet of the reheat recovery coil, the heat recovery control valve is arranged behind the outlet of the heat recovery coil, the three-way control valve is arranged at the outlet of the reheat recovery coil, the anti-freezing bypass is arranged in front of the pump, and the summer bypass is arranged after the heat-supplementing plate is replaced. The system has the advantages that the system can have higher Reynolds number under low load, and can distribute the flow of the heating medium, so that the system efficiency is maximized.

title_en: Honeycomb radiant tube
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of radiant tubes, in particular to a honeycomb radiant tube. Its technical scheme includes the wall body, the wall body is inside to be seted up to dismantle the groove, dismantle the groove both sides and all run through the wall body, the wall body is inside to be equipped with the radiant tube, four evenly distributed's mounting groove has been seted up on the radiant tube surface, every the inside gag lever post that all is equipped with of mounting groove, the gag lever post runs through the mounting groove and with the mounting groove cup joints mutually, the spout has all been seted up on the radiant tube surface, the spout is inside to be equipped with the stopper, the stopper with spout sliding connection, the radiant tube is multiple composite material combination and forms, can be better carry out demountable installation to the radiant tube, has reduced the cost of labor, has reduced the intensity to the radiant tube demountable installation.

title_en: Scraping mechanism and igniter thereof
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of field survival devices, and relates to a scraping and cutting mechanism and a igniter thereof, comprising: the scraping and cutting component can be arranged in the flame thrower in a back-and-forth moving way and is used for scraping and cutting the surface of the combustible component in the flame thrower, the spring pull rod is arranged on the scraping and cutting component, and the front end and the rear end of the spring pull rod are respectively connected with different positions on the scraping and cutting component and are used for driving the scraping and cutting component to move back and forth in the flame thrower; the driving part is arranged between the scraping part and the spring pull rod, and two ends of the driving part are respectively abutted with two ends of the spring pull rod; when the driving part moves forwards or backwards under the action of external force, the driving part can stretch the spring pull rod, so that the spring pull rod obtains elastic potential energy for driving the scraping part to move. When the lighter is used, the scraping and cutting mechanism can be driven to scrape and cut the combustible parts, so that the lighter can realize the lighter function, and the lighter efficiency and reliability of the lighter are improved.

title_en: Composite flow evaporative condenser with oil cooler
