abstract_en: The utility model discloses a composite flow evaporative condenser with an oil cooler, which belongs to the technical field of refrigeration equipment and comprises a shell, wherein a refrigerant heat exchange core and PVC (polyvinyl chloride) filler are arranged in the shell; according to the utility model, the oil cooler core body is additionally arranged on the basis of the existing structure, the lubricating oil of the compressor flows in the oil cooler core body, the low-temperature spray water flowing from the surface of the refrigerant heat exchange core body continuously flows on the outer surface of the oil cooler core body to cool the lubricating oil, so that the spray water flowing from the cooled refrigerant heat exchange core body is used for cooling the lubricating oil in the oil cooler core body, and the lubricating oil is cooled and combined into a refrigerant cooling system, so that a unit does not need to additionally add other oil cooling equipment, the structure is simplified, and the equipment input cost and the production labor cost are reduced.

title_en: Humidification assembly and air treatment device comprising same
abstract_en: A humidifying assembly includes a humidifying core, a lower sealing frame, and a chassis. A through hole is formed in the side wall of the chassis, a water inlet pipe is further formed on the outer side of the side wall, the water inlet pipe is communicated with the through hole, and the sectional area of an inner passage of the water inlet pipe is larger than the area of the through hole. In the humidifying assembly of this structure, when water enters the through hole of smaller area from the water inlet pipe, the water flow speed can be increased, thereby reducing or preventing accumulation of impurities at the through hole, thereby improving the operating efficiency of the humidifying assembly.

title_en: Ice extrusion screw installation structure of ice making barrel
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an ice extrusion screw installation structure of an ice making barrel, which comprises an ice making barrel, an ice outlet head, an ice extrusion screw and a plane bearing, wherein the ice extrusion screw is arranged in the ice making barrel, an annular supporting step is arranged on the inner wall of the ice making barrel, an adapter of the ice extrusion screw penetrates through the supporting step and is provided with a convex step corresponding to the supporting step, the plane bearing is arranged between the convex step and the supporting step, and the ice outlet head is arranged at the top of the ice making barrel and limits the ice extrusion screw to move upwards. The inside of the ice making cylinder body is provided with the bearing step for bearing the ice extrusion screw rod, the ice making cylinder body bears the pressure applied by the ice extrusion screw rod by utilizing the structure of the ice making cylinder body, so that the direct stress of a driving source can be avoided, and the problem that the driving source is damaged due to long-term stress is effectively solved.

title_en: Photovoltaic power generation tracking support
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of photovoltaic power generation supports and discloses a photovoltaic power generation tracking support, which comprises a left upright post, wherein the top of the left upright post is movably connected with a support, the bottom of one side of the support is movably connected with a right upright post, the top of the support is fixedly connected with a fixing plate, the top of the support is fixedly connected with a supporting plate, the tops of the two fixing plates are fixedly connected with lenses, the tops of the front surfaces of the left upright post and the right upright post are fixedly connected with large oil tanks, the tops of the large oil tanks are fixedly connected with supporting plates, the bottom of the large oil tank is fixedly sleeved with a connecting pipe, the bottom of the connecting pipe is fixedly sleeved with a lower oil tank, and the back surface of the lower oil tank is fixedly connected with the left upright post; according to the utility model, the connecting pipe is protected by the protective jacket, the protective jacket blocks the influence of external sunlight on the connecting pipe, the production cost of the protective jacket is low, the installation mode is simple and convenient, and the service life of the connecting pipe is guaranteed.

title_en: Novel low-nitrogen burner applicable to biomass gas fuel to replace part of pulverized coal
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a novel low-nitrogen burner suitable for replacing part of pulverized coal with biomass gas fuel, which comprises an air pipe assembly and a nozzle assembly arranged at the air supply end of the air pipe assembly, wherein the air pipe assembly comprises a central air pipe, a rotational flow air pipe, a pulverized coal pipe, a biomass gas pipe and an axial flow air pipe which are coaxially sleeved in sequence towards the nozzle assembly; the nozzle assembly comprises a central air plate, a rotational flow inner nozzle, a pulverized coal inner nozzle, a biomass gas inner nozzle and an axial flow inner and outer cylinder which are coaxially sleeved in sequence along the radial direction; the central air plate is axially and hermetically connected with the central air pipe, the rotational flow air inner spray head and the rotational flow air pipe, the pulverized coal inner spray head and the pulverized coal air pipe, the biomass gas inner spray head and the biomass gas air pipe, and the axial flow air inner and outer cylinders and the axial flow air pipe through connecting pipes. Partial biomass gas is used for replacing pulverized coal combustion in the combustion, so that the combustion performance of the burner is ensured, and simultaneously, the fuel use cost and the discharge of oxynitride are reduced.

title_en: Air purifying treatment device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of air treatment, in particular to an air purification treatment device, which comprises an outer frame, wherein a water tank is arranged in the middle of the outer frame, and a filter plate is connected inside the outer frame through a plurality of groups of springs; a servo motor mounted on the surface of the outer frame; the rotating shaft is connected to the output end of the servo motor and extends to the inner wall of the outer frame; the striking block is arranged in the middle of the rotating shaft; the filling layers are arranged at two ends of the inner part of the outer frame, an air outlet is formed in the left filling layer, and an air inlet is formed in the right filling layer; and the sound absorbing plate is arranged around the inner wall of the outer frame. The utility model overcomes the defects of the prior art, reduces the blocking condition of the filter plate by arranging the servo motor, the spring and the collecting box, is convenient for the subsequent air passing rate, and reduces the occurrence of air flowing noise caused by mutual collision and friction with various obstacles in the entering device by arranging the filling layer and the sound absorbing plate.

title_en: Solar air heater
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a solar air heater, which comprises the following technical scheme: solar air heater main part and universal wheel, the regulating plate is all installed through the column spinner to the surface around solar air heater main part one side, the locking pin is installed through the spring groove to the regulating plate inside, the inside locking hole that is located regulating plate position department that is located of solar air heater main part, install the removal post in the middle of regulating plate one side, the universal wheel is installed to the removal post end, the solar air heater main part top all is equipped with the locating hole near the front and back surface. The utility model provides a solar air heater has solved current solar air heater when removing, can't carry out effective support to solar air heater, and the weight that removes after a plurality of solar air heater stacks is heavier, leads to workman to remove the problem that the load increases, has reduced solar air heater's removal load to conveniently remove solar air heater.

title_en: Fume exhaust fan and its casing
abstract_en: The application relates to a range hood and shell thereof, the shell of range hood includes: a fume collecting hood and a rear panel. The rear side of the fume collecting hood is provided with a first flanging, and at least one first clamping part and at least one first connecting part are arranged on the first flanging. The rear panel is arranged at the rear side of the fume collecting hood, at least one second clamping part and at least one second connecting part are arranged on the rear panel, the first clamping part corresponds to the second clamping part in position and is matched with the second clamping part in a clamping way, and the first connecting part corresponds to the second connecting part in position and is fixedly connected through a fastener. When assembling, through the mutual joint of second joint portion and first joint portion, can realize that the back panel is tentatively fixed in on the collection petticoat pipe, need not the staff and make the back panel be located the rear side of collection petticoat pipe, then through the fastener with first connecting portion be connected fixedly with second connecting portion can, can reduce the use quantity of screw among the correlation technique like this, can reduce the equipment process, and can realize fast assembly, and then can improve packaging efficiency greatly.

title_en: High-efficient factory building air conditioner ventilation structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a high-efficiency factory building air conditioner ventilation structure, and belongs to the technical field of factory building air conditioner ventilation. The high-efficiency factory building air conditioner ventilation structure comprises a cleaning component, a locking component, a ventilation frame and a dust hopper; the utility model discloses a factory building wall, including ventilating frame swing joint in factory building wall's openly, ventilating frame both sides upper end and lower extreme fixedly connected with fixed foot respectively, fixed foot passes through fixing bolt and factory building wall connection to be provided with locking subassembly, ventilating frame back fixedly connected with runs through the ventilation pipe of factory building wall, ventilating frame's top is provided with clean subassembly, ventilating frame inner bottom wall fixedly connected with filter screen, the ash discharge groove has been seted up to the ventilating frame bottom of filter screen one end, the factory building wall openly fixedly connected with fixed plate of ventilating frame below, the top swing joint of fixed plate has the dust hopper. The utility model avoids the influence of the filter screen blockage caused by impurities such as dust and the like on the subsequent ventilation effect, thereby improving the practicability of the device.

title_en: Rotary kiln capable of quickly replacing retainer ring
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of rotary kilns and discloses a rotary kiln capable of quickly replacing check rings, which comprises a storage box, wherein a first bracket is fixedly arranged on the side surface of the storage box, a base is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the first bracket, a fixing seat is fixedly arranged at the top of the base, a cylinder body is fixedly arranged on the right side of the storage box, a filter plate is fixedly arranged in the storage box, a replacement structure is arranged at the top of the fixing seat, the rotary kiln comprises a second supporting seat, a second cylinder is fixedly arranged at the top of the second supporting seat, and the second cylinder is used for driving a second connecting rod to stretch and retract so as to drive the second check ring to clamp the cylinder body, and a first cylinder is started and drives the first connecting rod to stretch and retract so as to drive the first check ring to clamp the cylinder body.

title_en: Ultra-wide heating furnace multi-combination energy-saving furnace door structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi-combination energy-saving furnace door structure of an ultra-wide heating furnace, and relates to the technical field of heating furnaces. The utility model comprises a supporting frame, door plates and a movable rod, wherein the center of the top of the supporting frame is provided with a movable opening in a penetrating way, the door plates are symmetrically and movably connected in the lower part in the movable opening, the movable rods are movably connected between the two door plates and at both ends, the top ends of the movable rods are movably connected in the movable opening, the door plates comprise a sealing plate, and the sealing plate is movably connected in the lower part in the movable opening. The utility model solves the problems that the ultra-wide heating furnace door structure is easy to cause energy waste when working and the flexibility of entering and exiting the heating furnace for different components is insufficient by arranging the supporting frame, the door plate and the movable rod, and has the advantages that: the ultra-wide heating furnace door structure is more energy-saving in working, and can flexibly adjust the furnace door when different components enter and exit the heating furnace, so that the flexibility is better.

title_en: Heating furnace using biomass as fuel
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a heating furnace, in particular to a heating furnace taking biomass as fuel. The utility model provides a heating furnace taking biomass as fuel, which can quickly clean ash residues. The utility model provides a heating furnace taking biomass as fuel, which comprises a box body, a top shell, a feeding plate, a placement box, a gas tank, a connecting block and a compression bar, wherein the top shell is arranged on the upper part of the box body in a sliding manner, the feeding plate is communicated with the front side of the lower part of the top shell, the placement box is detachably arranged on the inner side of the middle part of the box body, the gas tank is arranged on the left side of the middle part of the box body, an air outlet pipe of the gas tank is communicated with the placement box, the heating furnace further comprises the connecting block and the compression bar, the connecting block is connected to the right front side of the bottom plate, and the compression bar is arranged on the left side of the upper part of the box body in a sliding manner. The ash is driven to move up and down by the pressing rod which is pulled up and down, so that the ash falls onto the sloping plate, and the aim of quickly cleaning the ash is fulfilled.

title_en: Fuel oil and gas boiler
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of boilers, and particularly relates to an oil and gas fired boiler, which comprises a base, wherein a supporting frame is fixedly welded on the upper end face of the base, a boiler body is fixedly installed between the supporting frames on the left side and the right side, an inner liner barrel is installed in the middle of the boiler body, a combustor is installed on the left side of the boiler body, sealing covers are fixedly installed on the left end face and the right end face of the boiler body, a sealing ring plate is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the sealing cover, a plurality of tail gas folding pipes are rotatably arranged between the sealing ring plates on the left side and the right side, a driving assembly for driving the tail gas folding pipes to synchronously rotate is installed on the boiler body, the driving assembly drives the tail gas folding pipes to rotate, and when the tail gas folding pipes rotate, a plurality of heat conducting fins are driven to rotate, so that water inside the boiler body can be stirred, the condition of uneven temperature of local water is avoided, and heating efficiency is improved.

title_en: Air conditioner indoor unit base and air conditioner
abstract_en: The utility model provides an air conditioner indoor unit base and an air conditioner, relates to the technical field of air conditioners, and aims to solve the problem that two cross flow wind wheel assemblies are insufficient in supporting rigidity at the joint of the two cross flow wind wheel assemblies. The air conditioner inner unit base comprises an air outlet frame part, an air duct part and a water duct part, wherein the water duct part comprises a front water duct part and a rear water duct part, a supporting seat for supporting a through-flow wind wheel assembly is arranged on the inner side surface of the air duct part, the air duct part is connected to the lower side of the rear water duct part, the air duct part is downwards bent and extended from the rear water duct part, the lower end of the air duct part is positioned at the front side of the rear water duct part, the air outlet frame part is connected to the lower end of the air duct part, the front water duct part is connected to the upper side of the air outlet frame part, the rear end of the supporting seat is connected to the inner side surface of the air duct part in an extending manner, the upper end of the supporting seat is connected to the rear water duct part, and the front lower end of the supporting seat is connected to the front water duct part; the support seat is integrally formed with the rear water channel part, the air duct part, the air outlet frame part and the front water channel part. The air conditioner indoor unit base can improve the supporting rigidity of the cross flow wind wheel assembly.

title_en: Reduce heating furnace oxynitride combustor
abstract_en: The utility model provides a burner for reducing nitrogen oxides of a heating furnace, which comprises a heating furnace body, wherein a burner shell is arranged on the heating furnace body, a pilot lamp fuel inlet, an ignition port and a fuel gas main pipe are arranged on the burner shell, a primary fuel gas inlet and a secondary fuel gas inlet are branched on the fuel gas main pipe, and the primary fuel gas inlet and the secondary fuel gas inlet are connected to the bottom of the burner shell and are communicated with an inner cavity of the burner shell; the burner is characterized in that an air duct is arranged on the burner shell, one end of the air duct is communicated with the inner cavity of the burner shell, an air inlet is formed in the other end of the air duct, and a control butterfly valve is arranged in the air duct. The burner utilizes the technical advantages of fuel classification and flue gas recirculation to reduce the nitrogen oxides generated in the combustion process; therefore, the pollution of nitrogen oxides to the environment is avoided, and the energy conservation and emission reduction are realized.

title_en: Boiler steam divides cylinder controlling means
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a boiler steam split cylinder control device, which comprises: the air distribution cylinder comprises a branch cylinder body, wherein an air inlet pipe is arranged at one side of the upper end of the branch cylinder body; the support leg plates are provided with two groups, and the two groups of support leg plates are fixedly arranged at the lower end of the split cylinder body; and the pipelines are provided with four groups. The utility model has the advantages that the air inlet pipe can enable steam to flow into the split cylinder body, the control component can push the baffle plate or pull the baffle plate, the pushed baffle plate can seal one group of pipelines, steam can not flow out, the other group of pipelines can be opened, and the steam can be treated, so that the effects of conveniently controlling the steam to flow into the pipelines, saving the operation time of workers and improving the working efficiency are achieved, and when the pipelines are required to be completely sealed, the valve body can seal the pipelines by rotating the valve body, so that the pipelines can be completely sealed.

title_en: Safe type alcohol fireplace convenient to warm hands
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a safe alcohol fireplace convenient for hand warming, which comprises a fireplace shell, a hand warming mechanism and a safety mechanism, wherein a protective cover is fixed at the top end of the fireplace shell, a first sliding chute and a second sliding chute are respectively arranged on the outer side wall of the fireplace shell, the hand warming mechanism comprises a blower and a heating loop, an air outlet of the blower is connected with an air supply pipe in a sealing manner, one end of the air supply pipe extends into the heating loop, the safety mechanism comprises a protective plate, and a limiting block is fixed at the bottom end of the protective plate. This safe type alcohol fireplace convenient to warm hand designs advanced, compact structure, convenient to use, safe and reliable, with the hot air transmission of fireplace burning production to heating ring way to the outer wall of heating fireplace casing provides the function of warm hand, can in time observe the temperature of fireplace outer wall, and shelter from the fireplace outer wall after heating when not needing warm hand, can avoid taking place the scald, improved the security.

title_en: Refractory brick
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of refractory brick structures, in particular to a refractory brick which comprises an insulating layer, wherein the insulating layer is in the shape of an isosceles trapezoid, a fireproof layer is fixedly arranged on the rear surface of the insulating layer, the fireproof layer is in the shape of an isosceles trapezoid, an inserting mechanism is arranged in front of and behind the fireproof layer, a side inserting mechanism is arranged on the side surface of the insulating layer, a vertical inserting mechanism is arranged on the upper surface of the insulating layer, and an inserted mechanism is arranged on the lower surface of the fireproof layer.

title_en: Self-cleaning air purifying equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses self-cleaning air purification equipment which comprises an air duct and a purification component, wherein the purification component is arranged in the air duct, the outer surface of the air duct is provided with two air openings, the self-cleaning air purification equipment also comprises an ultrasonic cleaning component and two shielding components, the ultrasonic cleaning component is arranged in the air duct, and the two shielding components are respectively connected with the two air openings and are in a self-cleaning state and a purification state. A cleaning cavity is formed between the air duct and the two shielding assemblies, the ultrasonic cleaning assembly is arranged in the cleaning cavity, water is injected into the cleaning cavity when the ultrasonic cleaning assembly is in a self-cleaning state, and the cleaning assembly is cleaned through the ultrasonic cleaning assembly; when the air conditioner is in a purifying state, the shielding assembly is opened, and a ventilation channel is formed in the air duct so as to remove dust and purify the passing air. Through setting up shielding assembly, make the wind channel switch between cleaning chamber and ventilation channel, simple structure, save space have removed the step of dismouting dust collection subassembly from, save time, and the cleaning performance is better.

title_en: Metal smelting furnace waste heat utilization device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a waste heat utilization device of a metal smelting furnace, which relates to the field of metal smelting furnaces and comprises the following components: the smelting furnace, set up in the exhaust pipe at smelting furnace top, set up in the sealed apron in the smelting furnace outside, set up in the recovery unit of smelting furnace outer end one side for collect the inside waste heat of exhaust pipe, set up in the deodorization subassembly of exhaust pipe outer end one side, be used for to the flue gas deodorization treatment. This kind of metal smelting furnace waste heat utilization device can be with the waste heat recovery in the flue gas through retrieving the subassembly, utilizes the waste heat can be to cold water heating, reaches waste heat recovery's purpose, avoids the heat in the flue gas to arrange extravagant in the atmosphere to can carry out deodorization to the foul smell in the flue gas through deodorizing the subassembly, avoid the direct atmospheric polluted air environment of arranging of flue gas, and then avoid influencing people's normal life.

title_en: Heat exchanger for refrigeration air-conditioning equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a heat exchanger for refrigeration and air-conditioning equipment, which relates to the technical field of heat exchangers, and comprises a front end plate, a supporting plate arranged on the front end plate, a plurality of plates and compacting plates arranged on the supporting plate, and a fastening screw rod and a fastening screw cap for fixing the plates, and further comprises the following components: the fixed plate is arranged at the end part of the supporting plate, the screw rod is arranged on the surface thread of the fixed plate, the push plate is arranged at one end of the screw rod through the bearing, the push plate is detachably arranged on the surface of the compacting plate, and the push plate is used for pre-fixing the compacting plate. The utility model has the advantages that the compression plate and the plate can be pre-fixed after being attached, so that the fastening bolt can be easily screwed or disassembled, and the plate is more convenient to assemble and disassemble, so that the problems that the installation process is complicated, and when the fastening nut is disassembled, the compression plate has an outward tension, the fastening nut can be extruded, and the loosening of the fastening nut is time-consuming and labor-consuming are solved.

title_en: Automatic humidification system of sauna room
abstract_en: The utility model provides an automatic humidification system of a sauna room, and relates to the technical field of sauna rooms. The utility model comprises a fixed shell, a motor, a temperature detection module and a control module, wherein an atomizer is arranged at one end in the fixed shell, an inner baffle is arranged at the other end of the fixed shell, an air inlet pipeline and an air inlet pipeline which are communicated with the fixed shell are arranged on the surface of the fixed shell, a fan is arranged in the air inlet pipeline, the inner baffle divides the fixed shell into an inlet area and an outlet area, a humidifying end is arranged in the outlet area, the temperature detection module is electrically connected with the control module, the control module is electrically connected with the motor and the atomizer, the humidifying end consists of a connecting pipe and a plurality of air outlet pipes which are fixed on the connecting pipe, air outlet grooves are formed in the air outlet pipes, and a rotating pipe is fixed at one end of the connecting pipe far away from the air outlet pipes. The utility model is convenient for humidification when the sauna room temperature is higher, and improves humidification uniformity and speed.

title_en: Continuous powder water-blocking cooling system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a continuous powder water-separating cooling system which comprises a cooling water tank and feeding structures transversely penetrating through two ends of the cooling water tank and distributed in an array, wherein the feeding structures comprise feeding barrels distributed in an array, a discharging hopper is arranged above the front side of the first end of the cooling water tank, a material receiving box body is integrally and hermetically connected with the second end of the cooling water tank, one side of a material inlet end of each feeding barrel penetrates out of the first end face of the cooling water tank and is communicated with an outlet end of the corresponding discharging hopper, and one side of a material outlet end of each feeding barrel stretches into the material receiving box body from the second end face of the cooling water tank. According to the utility model, the high-temperature powder body can be continuously and uniformly cooled by heat in the spiral rolling forward pushing process, the purpose of continuously and uniformly cooling is achieved, and the cooled high-temperature powder body is gradually cooled and then pushed into the collecting box body, so that the dust pollution of the environment is reduced, and the technical problem that the powder body is adhered in the feeding barrel is effectively avoided.

title_en: Resin high temperature ashing furnace
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of high-temperature ashing furnaces, in particular to a resin high-temperature ashing furnace, which comprises an ashing furnace, wherein the ashing furnace comprises a base bracket, a sealing door and a radiating opening, a control console, and the resin high-temperature ashing furnace comprises a shell, wherein the surface of the shell is provided with a dust cover, the surface of the dust cover is provided with a clamping block, the inside of the shell is provided with an inner shell, the surface of the inner shell is provided with a spring which is connected with the shell, and the resin high-temperature ashing furnace comprises a connecting base, and the connecting base is provided with a protective upper shell and a protective outer shell, and has the beneficial effects that: the high-temperature resin ashing furnace provided by the utility model has the advantages that the outer shell and the inner shell are arranged on the control console, the spring is arranged between the outer shell and the inner shell, the sliding groove is arranged on the inner wall of the inner shell, the stability of the control console is ensured, the collision and abrasion of the control console due to shaking are avoided, the cover plate is arranged on the outer shell, the exposed control console is provided with the dust cover on the outer shell, and the control console is effectively protected against dust and moisture.

title_en: Lifting melting furnace for noble metal extraction
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a lifting melting furnace for extracting noble metals, which belongs to the technical field of noble metals and comprises a box body, wherein a base is arranged at the lower end of the box body, a supporting plate is arranged at the side edge of the upper end of the box body, an electric push rod is arranged at the upper end of the supporting plate, a connecting plate is arranged at the other end of the electric push rod, a clamping plate is arranged at the side edge of the connecting plate, and a melting furnace body is arranged in the box body.

title_en: Automatic cleaning and flocculation preventing device for cooling tower
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of tire production, in particular to an automatic cleaning and flocculation prevention device of a cooling tower, which comprises a semi-cylindrical frame, wherein a flocculation prevention net is arranged on the outer side of the semi-cylindrical frame, a top plate and a bottom plate are respectively arranged at two ends of the semi-cylindrical frame, and a lifting plate is vertically arranged in the semi-cylindrical frame in a sliding manner through a lifting mechanism; the outer fringe of lifter plate is equipped with arcuation air duct, the lateral surface of air duct is equipped with the rectangular shape flat mouth of giving vent to anger towards preventing the batting net, the top of lifter plate is equipped with the fan, fan air outlet and air duct intercommunication. According to the utility model, the anti-flocculation net with the semi-cylindrical structure is arranged at the air inlet of the cooling water tower, so that the anti-flocculation net has a larger air inlet area, impurities carried by air inlet can be filtered, and then the anti-flocculation net is purged and cleaned through the lifting fan, so that the anti-flocculation net is prevented from blocking meshes, and the anti-flocculation net is more convenient to use.

title_en: High-temperature flue gas waste heat recovery heating steam device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-temperature flue gas waste heat recovery heating steam device, which structurally comprises a heating chamber, an overheating part arranged in the heating chamber, a fire supplementing structure for increasing the temperature and a fire reducing structure for reducing the temperature, wherein the overheating part can be directly used for discharging if the temperature of hot gas is moderate; and if the temperature is too low, the fire supplementing structure can supplement the temperature of the hot gas, and when the temperature is too high, the temperature of the hot gas is reduced through the fire reducing structure.

title_en: Central air conditioner blast pipe
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a central air conditioner blast pipe, which comprises a plurality of pipelines, mounting pieces and connecting pieces, wherein the pipelines are fixedly connected through the connecting pieces and bolts, the two ends of each pipeline are fixedly sleeved with the mounting pieces of a rectangular frame structure, a cavity is arranged in each pipeline, a buckling groove for mounting a filter box is arranged at the middle part of one side of each pipeline, one end of each filter box is inserted into each cavity through each buckling groove, and one end of each filter box far away from each cavity is fixedly connected with the middle part of one side of each buckling plate; and a sealing assembly is arranged between every two adjacent installation pieces, slots matched with the connection pieces are formed in one sides, far away from the sealing assembly, of the top ends and the bottom ends of the installation pieces, and the connection pieces are buckled on the top ends and the bottom ends of the two adjacent installation pieces. Through seal assembly's design, two pipelines around making can zonulae occludens, and then can improve the leakproofness between the pipeline, be equipped with the filter core in the rose box to can filter the air that enters into in the pipeline.

title_en: Rotary dehumidifier
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of dehumidifiers, and discloses a rotary dehumidifier which is technically characterized by comprising a frame, an air inlet part, a supporting plate group, a central control device, an air outlet part, a rotary wheel, a driving part and a heating device; the support plate group consists of a plurality of isolation plates and is arranged in the frame, the frame is isolated into a dehumidification section, an air inlet section and a central control space, the dehumidification section and the air inlet section are partially communicated, the central control device is arranged in the central control space and used for controlling the start and stop of the air inlet section, the temperature rising device, the air outlet section and the driving section, the rotating wheel is rotationally arranged in the dehumidification section, the driving section is arranged on the frame and used for driving the rotating wheel to rotate, the air outlet section is fixedly arranged on the frame and used for discharging dehumidified air, and the air inlet section is arranged in the air inlet section and used for introducing moist air; the runner is divided into an adsorption area and a desorption area, and the heating device is arranged in an air inlet area and used for heating the desorption area and carrying out moisture adsorption on the guided air through the runner.

title_en: Heat exchange system for air cooler
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a heat exchange system for an air cooler, which comprises a bracket (1), a first heat exchange system (2) and a second heat exchange system (3), wherein the first heat exchange system (2) and the second heat exchange system (3) are arranged on the bracket (1); the first heat exchange system (2) comprises a fan (21) fixed on the bracket (1), a first fin-and-coil pipe assembly (22) arranged right above the fan (21) and a first heat exchange channel (23) penetrating through the fan (21) and the first fin-and-coil pipe assembly (22); the second heat exchange system (3) comprises a spraying device (31) fixed on the bracket (1), a second fin-and-coil pipe assembly (32) arranged right below the spraying device (31) and a second heat exchange channel (33) penetrating through the second fin-and-coil pipe assembly (32) with the spraying device (31) as a starting point. According to the heat exchange system for the air cooler, smoothness of a heat exchange channel is guaranteed through structural design, and heat exchange efficiency is improved.

title_en: Special electric boiler based on internet of things and having carbon emission calculation function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of carbon emission calculation, and discloses a special electric boiler based on the Internet of things and having a carbon emission calculation function, wherein four heating components are fixed on the right side of the inside of the electric boiler main body, a solid state relay is electrically connected with the heating components, the four solid state relays are electrically connected with a Lora intelligent controller together, the Lora intelligent controller is electrically connected with a power consumption statistics device, a water level sensor is fixed in the middle of the right of the outer wall of the electric boiler main body, a water supplementing motor is fixed below the right of the outer wall of the electric boiler main body, and a water consumption statistics device is fixed at the right end of the water supplementing motor. Through Lora intelligent control ware, solid-state relay, temperature sensor, pressure sensor, water level sensor and moisturizing motor can have the control that realizes running the electric boiler main part, and the electric boiler main part's of electricity consumption can be counted out to Lora smart electric meter.

title_en: Heating combustion machine with safety protection mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of heating combustion engines, and discloses a heating combustion engine with a safety protection mechanism, which comprises a cooling protection cover, wherein the protection cover is connected with an anti-falling mechanism; the inside fixedly connected with water pump of protection casing, water pump input fixedly connected with outlet pipe, outlet pipe other end fixedly connected with water tank, the inside fixedly connected with inlet tube of water tank, inlet tube bottom fixedly connected with cold water pipe, the other end of cold water pipe links to each other with the output of water pump, protection casing rear end fixedly connected with radiator fan, prevent falling the mechanism and include movable base and fixed plate. According to the utility model, the cooling protection and dust protection of the machine are realized through the structures of the cooling protection cover, the water tank, the water pump and the like, so that the temperature stability of the machine is ensured, and the machine has a certain characteristic of collision prevention, so that the safety protection of one machine can be increased, and the service life of the machine is prolonged.

title_en: Air conditioner
abstract_en: The embodiment of the utility model provides an air conditioner, and relates to the field of heat exchange equipment. The air conditioner comprises a back coaming, a base, a supporting block and an electric control box; the back coaming is connected with the base, and the supporting block is connected with the back coaming and the base at the same time; the electric control box comprises a box body and a box cover which are detachably connected, and the box cover is detachably connected with the supporting block. The air conditioner can play a role in supporting and stabilizing the back coaming through the supporting blocks, and the whole air conditioner is prevented from toppling over. The box cover of the electric control box can be detachably connected with the supporting blocks and the box body respectively, when the electric control box needs to be detached for maintenance, the box cover and the box body can be detached and separated, local disassembly and assembly are realized, the whole disassembly and assembly of the electric control box can be realized through separating the box cover and the supporting blocks, and the convenience of disassembly, assembly and maintenance of the electric control box is further improved.

title_en: Indoor diffusion oxygen supply equipment in plateau
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of oxygen supply equipment, and particularly relates to indoor diffusion oxygen supply equipment for a plateau, which comprises a box body, quick-mounting mechanisms and lifting mechanisms, wherein inner plates are arranged in two sides of the box body, the quick-mounting mechanisms for quickly mounting or dismounting oxygen supply components are arranged between the inner plates, an oxygen generator is arranged between the quick-mounting mechanisms, a bottom plate is arranged at the lower end of the box body, and the lifting mechanisms with adjustable heights are arranged at the lower side of the bottom plate. When the oxygen generator is moved, the clamping plates are pulled up and down to separate from the clamping grooves so as not to collide with the bottom of the equipment when the oxygen generator passes through an uneven road surface, meanwhile, the clamping plates move outwards from the grooves to drive the side plates to move in the side grooves, potential energy is generated by extruding the hydraulic rods and the springs, and the oxygen generator is pulled forward to drive the two side plugboards to separate from the inner plates, so that the oxygen generator can be independently disassembled, the oxygen generator can be directly and comprehensively overhauled and maintained, and the use effect of the oxygen generator is improved.

title_en: Secondary air arrangement structure of fluidized bed boiler for burning solid waste and biomass fuel
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fluidized bed boilers, in particular to a secondary air arrangement structure of a solid waste and biomass fuel combustion fluidized bed boiler, which can ensure that CO in flue gas and oxygen in air are fully contacted and combusted, reduce the concentration of CO in the flue gas and ensure standard emission.

title_en: Quick cooling sample scald-proof device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rapid cooling sample scalding prevention device which comprises a box body, a storage rack, a drying box and a heat exchange coil; the inner wall of the box body is fixedly provided with a drying box, and a drying agent is arranged in the drying box; the box body is provided with a switch door which is provided with a guide device; the inside of the box body is provided with a temperature sensor. The utility model has the advantages that: under the cooperation of heat exchange coil and temperature sensor, the sample to the box inside is cooled down and temperature detection, and the purpose is to judge the temperature value of sample, has solved the scald problem that the temperature of operating personnel's hand heuristics sample caused.

title_en: Plug valve, combustion device and gas stove
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of gas equipment, in particular to a plug valve, a combustion device and a gas stove. The plug valve comprises a shell, a valve rod, a first elastic piece, a valve needle assembly, a deflector rod and a regulating valve. The valve rod is inserted into the shell and can move relative to the shell. The first elastic piece is connected with the valve needle assembly and is used for driving the valve needle assembly to reset. The valve needle assembly is disposed within the housing and has opposite first and second ends, the first end being connected to the valve stem. The valve needle assembly is internally provided with a second elastic piece to drive the second end to stretch and retract. The deflector rod is provided with a trigger end and a contact end, the trigger end is opposite to the second end, and the valve needle assembly is suitable for driving the deflector rod to move. The control valve is provided with a first position and a second position, the contact end of the control valve is propped against the control valve, the deflector rod is used for driving the control valve to move towards the first position, and when the control valve is located at the first position, the control valve is in a valve opening state. The plug valve has the advantages of simple structure, simple assembly process, good material universality and low cost.

title_en: Industrial furnace and industrial silicon processing device
abstract_en: The application relates to an industrial furnace and an industrial silicon processing device. The industrial furnace comprises a furnace body, a door body and a sealing assembly, wherein a furnace mouth is formed in the furnace body; the door body is arranged outside the furnace body and can move along a first direction relative to the furnace body so as to open or shield the furnace mouth; the sealing assembly comprises two first sealing elements and two second sealing elements; the two first sealing elements are arranged on two sides of the furnace mouth along the second direction in a one-to-one correspondence manner, extend along the first direction and intersect with the first direction; the two second sealing elements are connected to two sides of the door body along the second direction and extend along the first direction; each second seal is configured to slidably fit in a corresponding first seal along a first direction; and when the door body shields the furnace mouth, each second sealing piece is in sealing fit with the corresponding first sealing piece. The industrial furnace has a simple structure, can ensure the smoothness of the movement of the door body, and improves the tightness of the door body and the furnace body, so that the heat recovery and the flue gas recovery are facilitated, and the smelting efficiency is improved.

title_en: Rotary kiln waste heat recovery mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rotary kiln waste heat recovery mechanism which comprises a barrel body, wherein an air inlet is formed in the top of the barrel body, mounting grooves are symmetrically formed in two sides of the outer wall of the barrel body, a water storage barrel is fixed in the mounting grooves, a first stirring rod is arranged in the water storage barrel, a second stirring rod is arranged in the barrel body, a driving mechanism for driving the two first stirring rods and the second stirring rod to synchronously rotate is arranged at the top of the barrel body, and a drain pipe is arranged at the bottom of the outer wall of the water storage barrel. Under the action of centrifugal force, the flue gas heat is far away from the position of the second stirring rod and is closely attached to the heat conducting surfaces of the two water storage tanks, so that the flue gas waste heat is fully contacted with the heat conducting surfaces of the water storage tanks, the utilization rate is high, the water body can be stirred and heated uniformly under the rotation action of the first stirring rod, fine particles in the flue gas can be adhered to the surface of the water body, and the particles are prevented from drifting in the air.

title_en: Steam waste heat recycling device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a steam waste heat recycling device which comprises a filtering tank, wherein a filter plate is arranged on the filtering tank, the filtering tank is attached to a cover plate, an inlet is formed in the cover plate, a connecting rod is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the cover plate, the connecting rod is connected with the filtering tank through threads, a connecting pipe is fixedly connected to the bottom of the filtering tank, a thin pipe is fixedly connected to the connecting pipe, the thin pipe stretches into a heating tank, a drain pipe is arranged on the heating tank, and an outlet is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the heating tank. According to the utility model, under the action of the heat exchanger, the steam in the heating tank can be subjected to secondary heating on the steam in the water inlet pipe and the water outlet pipe, so that the steam is effectively reused, and the steam can be more efficiently transferred into the steam in the water outlet pipe.

title_en: Tray jig for annealing and annealing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides a tray jig for annealing and annealing equipment, wherein the tray jig for annealing comprises a graphite body, a silicon carbide coating is coated outside the graphite body, the graphite body comprises two tray parts which are arranged in a mirror symmetry mode, the two tray parts are bent to be arranged in a reverse V shape, a containing concave position is arranged on the top surface side of the tray part, a limit supporting part is formed at the end part of the tray part far away from the bending position, the limit supporting part extends out from the bottom surface side of the top surface side of the tray part back to the tray part, and a clamping position is formed between the two limit supporting parts; one annealing tray jig can be stacked in the clamping position of the other annealing tray jig, and a gap is reserved between the tray parts of two adjacent annealing tray jigs which are stacked. The annealing equipment is provided with the tray jig for annealing, and the tray jig for annealing has the advantages of being suitable for mass production and capable of improving production efficiency.

title_en: High-efficiency intermittent heat-supplementing multifunctional complementary system of ground source heat pump system in severe cold region
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-efficiency intermittent heat-supplementing multifunctional complementary system of a ground source heat pump system in severe cold regions, which aims at the conditions of long heating time in winter, low air temperature, large heating demand load and low cooling demand load in summer in severe cold regions, and adopts a multifunctional complementary system of a ground source heat pump, an air source heat pump and phase change heat storage to realize three operation modes of winter heating, summer cooling and intermittent soil heat supplementing in transitional seasons. The utility model has high comprehensive energy efficiency, low operation cost and long service life, and can realize multi-energy complementation.

title_en: Ventilator air door opening and closing mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a ventilator air door opening and closing mechanism, comprising: a mounting shell; an air inlet is formed in one side of the mounting shell, and an air outlet is formed in the other side of the mounting shell; the inside of the installation shell is provided with: the air door is matched with the air outlet, the transmission assembly is used for driving the air door to move, the driving assembly is used for driving the transmission assembly to move, and the locking assembly is used for limiting and fixing the driving assembly; the air door is in transmission connection with the output end of the transmission assembly; the output end of the driving component is in transmission connection with the input end of the transmission component; the locking component is arranged at the output end of the driving component; under the condition of complete opening and complete closing, the limit beads can enter the corresponding locking grooves, so that the effect of stopping the air door is achieved, the air tightness, the stability and the water tightness under the condition of opening or closing can be ensured, and a better effect is achieved.

title_en: Sand prevention device of cooling tower
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sand prevention device of a cooling tower, which comprises a sand prevention box, wherein one side of the top end of the sand prevention box is connected with a gas pipe, the other end of the gas pipe is connected with a treatment cylinder, the top end of the treatment cylinder is connected with a top cover, one side of the sand prevention box, which is far away from the gas pipe, is connected with a gas inlet grating plate, and the inner side of the sand prevention box is provided with a clamping groove; the combined use between link, cleaning brush, connecting rod and the spring that utilizes the setting can realize the vertical reciprocating motion of cleaning brush, make things convenient for follow-up to carrying out cleaning treatment to sand control board etc. and then prevent to use for a long time the back with this, have more impurity etc. to adsorb in sand control board's surface to influence follow-up air's circulation, make the connecting rod drive the spring and take place deformation thereupon when link longitudinal movement, combine the produced reverse effort of spring deformation can assist the cleaning brush to carry out vertical reciprocating motion, and then can carry out cleaning treatment to sand control board etc. and the practicality is higher.

title_en: Energy-saving heating pipe device for heating equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses energy-saving heating pipe equipment for heating equipment, which relates to the technical field of heating equipment and comprises a heating assembly and a heating energy-saving assembly, wherein the output end of the heating assembly is fixedly connected with the input side of the heating energy-saving assembly in an inserting mode, the heating assembly comprises a heater, a connecting pipe is fixedly connected with the output side of the heater in an inserting mode, and a heating pipe is fixedly installed in the connecting pipe. According to the utility model, the water flow is heated by the heater and then the heating is carried out to the user through the heating pipe, in the installation process of the heating pipe, the screw threads in the nut are staggered by rotating the adjusting screw, the upward displacement effect is achieved, the arc plate is pulled outwards by the connecting rod in the rotation process, so that the space in the connecting pipe is exposed, one end of the heating pipe is inserted, the end head of the heating pipe is contacted with the sealing ring, and the situation that the collecting hopper with a large inlet and a small outlet is not leaked in the process of transporting heat flow is ensured.

title_en: Energy-saving cost-reducing calcining preheating device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of cement processing equipment, in particular to an energy-saving and cost-reducing calcining preheating device, which comprises a rotary kiln body, a decomposition unit, a preheating unit and an air flow stirring assembly, wherein the top end of the preheating unit is provided with a feeding exhaust port, the bottom end of the preheating unit is provided with a discharging air inlet, the decomposition unit is respectively connected with the rotary kiln body and the discharging air inlet, the air flow stirring assembly is provided with a stirring pipe fitting and a conveying pipe fitting, the stirring pipe fitting is arranged close to the discharging air inlet, a plurality of high-pressure air nozzles are arranged on the stirring pipe fitting, the conveying pipe fitting is respectively connected with the rotary kiln body and the stirring pipe fitting, and the conveying pipe fitting is used for inputting the stirring pipe fitting after pressurizing high-temperature tail gas generated in the rotary kiln body.

title_en: Ventilation steel structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a ventilation steel structure, which aims to solve the technical problem of inconvenient adjustment of ventilation openings of a steel structure factory building, and comprises a steel structure factory building body, wherein a wind building is arranged at the top end of the steel structure factory building body, a transmission mechanism is arranged at the top end of the wind building, and two groups of ventilation pipes are symmetrically arranged at the top end of the steel structure factory building body relative to the transmission mechanism; the two groups of ventilation pipes are uniformly distributed, the ventilation pipes are internally provided with the adjusting mechanisms, and the input ends of the adjusting mechanisms penetrate out of the ventilation pipes and are connected with the output ends of the transmission mechanisms in a meshed mode.

title_en: Damping installation device of central air conditioning unit
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of air conditioner installation, and discloses a damping installation device of a central air conditioner unit, which comprises a central air conditioner host; the bottom support damping component is arranged at the bottom of the central air conditioner host; the two side support damper sets up in the upper portion both sides of central air conditioning host computer, and the end support damper includes end engaging lug, end rubber damper and end support mechanism, and end engaging lug welding is in the bottom of central air conditioning host computer, end rubber damper and end engaging lug fixed connection, and side support damper includes side engaging lug, side rubber damper and side support mechanism, and side engaging lug welding is in central air conditioning host computer upper portion both sides, side rubber damper and side engaging lug fixed connection. The side support damping component can damp the upper part of the air conditioner external unit, ensures the stability of the upper part, and can be matched with the installation of different air conditioner external units by the adjustable structure.

title_en: Microchannel aluminum flat tube
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of micro-channel aluminum flat tubes, and discloses a micro-channel aluminum flat tube, which comprises an aluminum flat tube body, wherein a channel is arranged in the aluminum flat tube body, the left side and the right side of the inside of the channel are respectively provided with a first plane, the upper side and the lower side of the inside of the channel are respectively provided with a first arc-shaped surface, the top of the outer side of the aluminum flat tube body is provided with a second arc-shaped surface, the bottom of the outer side of the aluminum flat tube body is provided with a third arc-shaped surface, and the left side and the right side of the outer side of the aluminum flat tube body are respectively provided with a second plane; the first arc-shaped surface, the second arc-shaped surface and the third arc-shaped surface are arranged on the aluminum flat tube body, so that the surface area of the inner wall of the channel is increased, the contact area of the channel is increased, the contact efficiency of the refrigerant is improved, and the heat exchange efficiency of the refrigerant is also improved; through the setting of temperature resistant layer, anti-freezing layer and corrosion protection layer, can effectually improve the life-span that aluminum flat tube body used, reduce its probability of taking place the damage in the use, avoid influencing its normal work.

title_en: Clothes drying and quilt warming machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a clothes and quilt drying machine, which comprises a shell, an air deflector and a hot air device, wherein the hot air device is arranged in an installation cavity formed by assembling the shell and the air deflector, hot air is provided by the hot air device to blow out from the air deflector so as to meet the drying application requirements of common clothes.

title_en: Heat exchanger structure convenient to clearance
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a heat exchanger structure convenient to clean, and relates to the technical field of heat exchangers. The utility model achieves the effect that the top cover can be opened and closed at will by the fixing mechanism, and the heat exchange tube inside the pot is convenient to replace.

title_en: Multistage condensation phase change mixing white eliminating equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses multi-stage condensation phase-change mixing white eliminating equipment which comprises a shell, wherein one side of the shell is fixedly and communicated with a smoke inlet pipe, the other side of the shell is fixedly and communicated with an air inlet pipe, a fan is arranged in the air inlet pipe, the bottom and the top of the shell are respectively fixedly and communicated with a drain pipe and a chimney, two groups of heat exchange components are arranged in the shell, each group of heat exchange components comprises a plurality of heat exchange plates which are arranged in parallel, a plurality of rectangular plates are also fixed in the shell, every two rectangular plates of the rectangular plates are correspondingly arranged, and an adjusting part for adjusting the angle of the heat exchange plates is arranged in the two corresponding rectangular plates. When the heat exchange plates need to be cleaned, the motor is started to drive the screw rod to rotate, the connecting plate, the pull rod and the sliding block are driven to move when the screw rod rotates, the heat exchange plates are driven to rotate when the sliding block moves, and the heat exchange plates are rotated to an inclined state, so that the water sprayed by the spray head is more effective in flushing impurities on the heat exchange plates.

title_en: Indoor self-circulation modular oil fume treatment device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an indoor self-circulation module type oil smoke treatment device, which is characterized in that an oil smoke-containing gas enters a purification module after smoke exhaust, purification and deodorization of a three-in-one module, and then enters a kitchen through the condensation of the purification module and the safe cleaning gas after purification and sterilization; the three-in-one module and the purifying module are arranged in a kitchen; the communication pipeline between the three-in-one module and the purification module is provided with a fire-proof valve; the three-in-one module comprises a centrifugal smoke exhauster, a smoke purifier and a smoke deodorizer which are sequentially arranged; the purification module comprises an oil smoke condensation pipeline, a condensation pipeline unit and pipeline air disinfection and purification equipment which are connected in sequence. The oil smoke treatment device has the beneficial effects that the structural design is reasonable, the oil smoke treatment device is arranged indoors, the oil smoke is subjected to crossed condensation and interception for a plurality of times through self-circulation, and the temperature is reduced, the purification and the disinfection are carried out, so that clean, safe and odorless gas is obtained, and enters a kitchen, the pollution to the atmospheric environment is avoided, the safety and the reliability are realized, and the environmental protection requirement is met.

title_en: Cladding wall structure applied to boiler top
abstract_en: The utility model provides a cladding wall structure applied to a boiler top, and belongs to the technical field of boilers; the problem that castable at the top of the tail part of the boiler falls off and the tail part of the heating surface absorbs insufficient heat is solved; the boiler comprises a convection heating surface arranged on a flue at the tail part of a boiler and a cladding pipe arranged on the outer side of a castable at the top of the boiler, wherein one end of the cladding pipe is connected with a cladding pipe inlet header, the other end of the cladding pipe is connected with a cladding pipe outlet header, the other end of the cladding pipe inlet header is connected with the convection heating surface through a connecting pipe, and the other end of the cladding pipe outlet header is connected with an eduction pipe; the connecting pipe is led out from the flue back wall, and the cladding pipe inlet header is fixed outside the flue back wall; the cladding pipe is fixed on the outer side of the furnace top castable through a hanging structure, and the hanging structure is fixed on a steel supporting structure in the boiler; the utility model is applied to boilers.

title_en: Heating furnace burner
abstract_en: The utility model provides a heating furnace combustor, includes inner tube and outer tube and the inside and outside pipe end face distance adjustment device of concentric setting, inside and outside pipe end face distance adjustment device includes actuating mechanism, driven slip cap and adapter sleeve, outer pipe suit is on the inner tube and can slide along inner tube straight line, driven slip cap pass through the adapter sleeve with outer union coupling, driven slip cap moves and drives along inner tube axial under actuating mechanism effect outer tube slides along inner tube straight line. According to the heating furnace burner, the relative positions between the inner pipe and the outer pipe of the burner are adjusted in real time by arranging the inner pipe and outer pipe end face distance adjusting device driven by the motor, so that the relative positions between the inner pipe and the outer pipe of the burner can be adjusted in real time according to the gas pressure in the use process, and the full combustion effect of the burner is improved.

title_en: Tile roof photovoltaic device
abstract_en: The application discloses a tile roof photovoltaic device, and relates to the technical field of photovoltaic equipment installation; the tile roof photovoltaic device is arranged on a tile hanging strip of a tile roof and comprises a cornice fixing piece, a fixing pressing plate and a photovoltaic module; the cornice fixing piece is arranged on a tile hanging strip positioned at the low position of the tile roof, the fixed pressing plate is arranged on the tile hanging strip positioned between the low position and the high position of the tile roof, and the photovoltaic module is provided with a first hook body, a second hook body and a fixing body; the photovoltaic module is installed one by one in the low-order direction to the high-order direction of tile roofing, and first couple body and the cornice mounting cooperation of first photovoltaic module push down at preceding photovoltaic module's upper edge at the lower edge of back photovoltaic module, and just at the first couple body of back photovoltaic module and the cooperation of preceding photovoltaic module's second couple body, and whole photovoltaic module's solid compresses tightly and fixes on hanging the tile through fixed clamp plate. The tile roof photovoltaic device is high in structural stability, good in fixing effect on a photovoltaic module and high in fusion degree with roof tiles in building appearance.

title_en: Synthetic ammonia tail gas treatment device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a synthetic ammonia tail gas treatment device, which comprises a box body, a boiler, a generator and an energy accumulator, wherein an air inlet is formed in one end of the box body, a filter screen and a water tank are sequentially arranged in the box body far away from the air inlet, the right side of the filter screen is connected with a gathering piece for gathering gas, an outlet of the gathering piece is communicated into the water tank, the water tank is provided with a water outlet, the water outlet is connected with a heating pot, and the top of the heating pot is connected with a storage tank through a first pipeline; the top of the water tank is communicated with the outside of the tank body through a second pipeline; the boiler is erected above the outlet of the second pipeline; the generator is connected with the boiler; the input end of the energy accumulator is electrically connected with the generator, and the output end of the energy accumulator is electrically connected with the heating pot. The utility model can recycle ammonia and realize full utilization of energy.

title_en: Lora wireless intelligent air conditioner controller
abstract_en: The utility model provides a Lora wireless intelligent air conditioner controller, which relates to the field of air conditioner controllers and comprises a shell and a bottom plate, wherein two limiting blocks are arranged at the top of the bottom plate, clamping grooves are respectively arranged at opposite sides of the two limiting blocks, a driving assembly is arranged at the top of the inner wall of the shell, two clamping blocks are respectively clamped with the two clamping grooves at one side of the driving assembly, when the air conditioner controller is installed, firstly, one ends of two pressing blocks are pressed to enable the two pressing blocks to shrink into the shell respectively, in the shrinking process, the pressing blocks slide on the surface of a limiting piece and squeeze an elastic piece, the pressing blocks can drive the clamping blocks at one side of the pressing blocks to move, the clamping blocks are separated from the clamping grooves formed at one side of the limiting blocks, so that the bottom plate loses limiting, the pressing blocks reset under the rebound effect of the elastic piece, and through the structure, the bottom plate can lose limiting by pressing the pressing of the pressing blocks, so that the bottom plate is convenient to disassemble to a certain extent.

title_en: Steam generator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a steam generator, which comprises a cylinder body and a steam generating mechanism arranged in the inner cavity of the cylinder body, wherein a water pump is fixed on the side wall of the cylinder body, an outer connecting pipe and a water inlet pipe are connected to the water pump, the outer connecting pipe is used for being connected with an external water conveying pipeline, one end of the water inlet pipe penetrates through the side wall of the cylinder body and enters the center of the inner cavity of the cylinder body, the water inlet pipe is L-shaped and vertically extends upwards at the center of the inner cavity of the cylinder body, two shunt pipes are symmetrically connected to one end of the water inlet pipe in the inner cavity of the cylinder body, one ends of the two shunt pipes, which are opposite, are welded with a water collecting ring, the water collecting ring is horizontally suspended in the inner cavity of the cylinder body, and the steam generating mechanism comprises a water receiving plate welded on the inner wall of the cylinder body and a mounting box welded on the bottom wall of the water receiving plate. The steam generator has the advantages that the water in the water receiving plate is always in a heating state, so that the phenomenon that the water falls at the bottom of the inner cavity of the cylinder body and cannot be heated and evaporated is avoided, and the steam generation efficiency is improved.

title_en: Integrated cooking system and oil smoke pumping device thereof
abstract_en: The application provides an improved integrated cooking system and an oil smoke exhaust device thereof. The embodiment of the application provides a lampblack pumping device which is arranged to be suitable for being embedded in a kitchen range cabinet (1), and comprises a driving device and a smoke guiding cavity (3), wherein the driving device is arranged to be suitable for driving the smoke guiding cavity (3) to move up and down; the smoke guide cavity (3) is sequentially provided with an air inlet (4) and an oil collecting device (5) from top to bottom; the driving device is arranged to drive the smoke guide cavity (3) to ascend and switch from a first position to a second position; when the smoke guide cavity (3) is positioned at the first position, the oil collecting device (5) is completely embedded and hidden in the kitchen range cabinet (1); when the smoke guide cavity (3) is located at the second position, the oil collecting device (5) is exposed above the kitchen range cabinet (1). Thereby, the grease path is shortened.

title_en: Exhaust tank for water heating
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of exhaust tanks, and discloses an exhaust tank for water heating, which comprises an exhaust tank main body, wherein the outer wall of the exhaust tank main body is fixedly connected with a water vapor inlet, and the outer wall of the water vapor inlet is fixedly connected with a connecting pipe. This an exhaust tank for water heating uses through the cooperation of exhaust tank main part and steam import, utilize the filter simultaneously so that be convenient for separate impurity for the impurity can drop the inner wall that holds the ware, collect with this, owing to hold the ware to rotate and connect the outer wall at the connecting pipe, thereby be convenient for carry out centralized processing to the impurity of collecting, and then make things convenient for the use of device, through the cooperation use of steam import and connecting block, the spout of seting up is utilized simultaneously, so that be convenient for install the filter, because the seal groove has been seted up at the top of connecting block, make closing plate and bolt can seal the device, and then prevent to take place to leak.

title_en: Zinc pot high-temperature flue gas recovery device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a zinc pot high temperature flue gas recovery unit, including zinc pot and collection box, the outside of zinc pot is equipped with the heating furnace, the top fixed mounting of heating furnace has the shrouding, the right side wall of heating furnace inlays and is equipped with the intake pipe, the inside of collection box is equipped with flue pipe and water source, the right-hand member fixed connection of intake pipe is at the input of flue pipe, the output fixedly connected with outlet duct of flue pipe, this patent is through being equipped with the mounting hole on the flue pipe, be equipped with the copper in the mounting hole, the both sides of copper all are equipped with the mounting, the copper passes through the mounting and is connected with the flue pipe, the intraductal high temperature flue gas of flue can contact with the copper, and then can be fast with the high temperature in the flue gas leading-in the water of collection box in, further increase flue pipe's heat conduction efficiency, the utilization ratio of high temperature flue gas is improved.

title_en: Centrifugal fan and refrigerating type range hood provided with same
abstract_en: The utility model provides a centrifugal fan and install refrigeration formula lampblack absorber of this centrifugal fan, centrifugal fan includes spiral case and impeller, the spiral case has outer rampart and interior rampart, form the air intermediate layer between outer rampart and the interior rampart, outer rampart closed end is connected with interior rampart closure, form the air intermediate layer air intake between outer rampart open end and the interior rampart, open at interior rampart has the vent, the vent forms the air intermediate layer air outlet, the air intermediate layer is linked together with spiral case inside wind channel through the vent, the radiator fan air outlet is linked together with the air intermediate layer air intake. The air outlet of the cooling fan of the refrigeration type range hood is communicated with the air interlayer air inlet, and as the air of the cooling fan does not contain oil smoke, the air outlet of the cooling fan passes through most of the inner annular wall of the range hood, so that the air of the range hood cannot pass through the inner annular wall and the inner side of the outer annular wall of the range hood, therefore, the inner annular wall and the inner side of the outer annular wall cannot be polluted by the oil smoke, and the problem that the oil smoke is difficult to clean on the inner surface of the volute is solved.

title_en: Temperature-control condenser
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of temperature control condensers, in particular to a temperature control condenser which comprises a first connecting plate and a control console, wherein two fixing pieces are fixedly connected to the upper surface of the first connecting plate, connecting pins which are arranged at equal intervals are rotationally connected to the inner wall of each cavity, gears are fixedly connected to the outer surfaces of the connecting pins, sliding pieces are slidingly connected to the inner wall of each cavity, the first rotating bolt drives the clamping blocks to move mutually to clamp test tubes, at the moment, the connecting pins are driven to rotate by the rotating connecting rods, at the moment, the connecting pins drive the gears to rotate, the gears and the teeth are meshed to drive the sliding pieces to rotate on the inner wall of the cavity, the sliding pieces drive the test tubes to rotate by the first bolts and the clamping blocks, the test tube clamping device can rapidly clamp the test tubes and simultaneously facilitate rapid adjustment of angles, the stability of the test tube clamping is enhanced, and the test tube falling phenomenon is prevented.

title_en: Antifreezing heat exchanger
