abstract_en: The utility model discloses an antifreezing heat exchanger, which comprises a shell, wherein a water inlet cavity is arranged on one side in the shell, a water inlet is connected to the upper end of the water inlet cavity, a water outlet is arranged on the other side in the shell, a water outlet is connected to the lower end of the water outlet cavity, a tube bundle cavity is arranged between the water inlet cavity and the water outlet cavity, a plurality of heat exchange tubes are uniformly connected in the tube bundle cavity, two ends of each heat exchange tube are respectively communicated with the water inlet cavity and the water outlet cavity, one end of each heat exchange tube, which is communicated with the water inlet cavity, is higher than one end of each heat exchange tube, which is communicated with the water outlet cavity, the shell is of a multilayer structure with an electric heating element, a temperature sensor is arranged in the shell, an alarm is arranged on the outer side of the shell, a photoelectric liquid level sensor is arranged at the bottom of the water outlet pipe, and the electric heating element, the temperature sensor, the alarm and the photoelectric liquid level sensor are electrically connected with a controller. According to the utility model, a temperature sensor feeds back a signal, an alarm alarms to prompt drainage and freezing prevention, a photoelectric liquid level sensor detects a water feedback signal, and a controller controls a resistance wire to heat the temperature of a shell, so that the pipeline is prevented from being frozen and cracked.

title_en: Gas control valve with quick-frying function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a gas control valve with a quick-frying function, and belongs to the field of kitchen appliances. The utility model solves the problems by adopting the following technical scheme: this gas control valve with stir-fry function, including gas control valve main part, first control valve and second control valve, its structural feature lies in: an inner ring fire air passage and an outer ring fire air passage are arranged in the gas control valve main body, the inner ring fire air passage and the outer ring fire air passage are controlled by a first control valve, and a second control valve is arranged on the outer ring fire air passage; the outer ring fire air channel comprises an outer ring fire air outlet channel, an outer ring fire air inlet channel, an outer ring fire cavity, a sealing ring and a ventilation groove, wherein the outer ring fire air outlet channel and the outer ring fire air inlet channel are communicated with the outer ring fire cavity, the sealing ring is located in the outer ring fire cavity, the sealing ring is arranged at one end of the outer ring fire air outlet channel, the ventilation groove is arranged on the sealing ring, the second control valve is arranged on the outer ring fire cavity, and the valve plug of the second control valve is matched with the sealing ring.

title_en: Air conditioner mount pad that possesses function of making an uproar falls
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an air conditioner mounting seat with a noise reduction function, which relates to the technical field of air conditioners and is applied to an air conditioner external unit, and comprises two mutually symmetrical bracket bodies, wherein the lower ends of the bracket bodies are provided with a plurality of uniformly distributed sleeves, the inner walls of the sleeves are provided with rotatable row plates, the inner sides of the sleeves are connected with cylinders in a sliding manner, the upper ends of the cylinders are fixedly connected with first buffer cushions, the lower ends of the sleeves are provided with rotatable screw rods, and the cylinders do reciprocating linear motion along the vertical direction; the outer machine of air conditioner is installed in support body upper end back, and slip cylinder upwards moves to not have the space that rises, fixes it, and the first blotter of cylinder upper end cushions, is convenient for change first blotter when making an uproar purpose of making an uproar, prevents that first blotter from losing the noise influence that the buffering effect caused because of the structure looseness that long-term vibration led to.

title_en: Central air conditioning waste heat recovery device
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of air conditioning equipment, and particularly relates to a central air conditioner waste heat recovery device which comprises an air inlet pipe, a heat exchange box, an air outlet pipe, a drying device and a plurality of hooks, wherein the air inlet pipe, the heat exchange box and the air outlet pipe are sequentially connected, the drying device comprises a drying cylinder and a support frame positioned in the drying cylinder, the support frame comprises a central shaft and a support rod, the support rod is arranged at the upper end of the central shaft, the support rod extends out along the radial direction of the central shaft, and the support rod is provided with the hooks. Compared with the prior art, the waste heat recovery device is provided with the heat exchange box and the drying cylinder, and has the functions of heating domestic water and drying; in the drying device, the blades correspond to the outlets of the air inlet pipes, so that air flowing out of the air inlet pipes automatically drives the central shaft to rotate, additional motors are not needed, energy sources are not consumed for driving the clothes to be dried to move, the drying effect is more uniform, and energy sources are saved.

title_en: Tempering-preventing large-space heating hot blast stove
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-backfire large-space heating hot blast stove, which relates to the technical field of heating furnaces and comprises a closed furnace body, wherein a combustion chamber is arranged at the lower end of the front part of the furnace body, a heat storage chamber is arranged at the side part of the combustion chamber, a heat dissipation chamber is arranged above the combustion chamber, and a smoke exhaust chamber is arranged above the heat dissipation chamber; the smoke discharging chamber is provided with a smoke discharging port which is connected with a smoke discharging pipe, a smoke extractor is arranged at the outlet of the smoke exhaust pipe; the front part of the heat dissipation chamber is provided with a heat dissipation opening, the rear part of the heat dissipation chamber is provided with a heat dissipation fan, and the heat dissipation chamber is internally provided with heat dissipation pipes which are vertically arranged and are communicated with the combustion chamber, the heat storage chamber and the smoke exhaust chamber; the rear part of the furnace body is provided with a fuel bin, the fuel bin is provided with a feed port, and a fuel conveying mechanism is arranged between the fuel bin and the combustion chamber; the combustion chamber communicates with an air intake that provides air for combustion of fuel. According to the utility model, the radiating pipes are arranged in a vertical structure, so that the air flow circulation in the furnace is smoother, and the blower at the air inlet of the combustion chamber is canceled, so that the backfire condition is prevented.

title_en: Warm air machine with humidification function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a warm air device with a humidifying function, which comprises a shell, wherein a warm air mechanism is arranged in the shell and comprises an atomizer, a water storage cavity is arranged in the shell, an air outlet is arranged in the shell and is communicated with the water storage cavity, the atomizer is arranged in the water storage cavity and is provided with a water inlet communicated with the water storage cavity, and the atomizer is provided with an atomizing port opposite to the air outlet.

title_en: Bellows with heated air circulation structure
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of bellows, and particularly discloses a bellows with a hot air circulation structure, which comprises a bellows body, wherein a limiting seat is fixedly arranged on the inner side of the bellows body in a penetrating manner, an air pipe is rotatably connected to the inner surface of the limiting seat, a fan is fixedly connected to the top of the air pipe, a circulating pipe is arranged in the bellows body, an air outlet end of the circulating pipe is rotatably connected with the bottom of the air pipe, a rubber pad is arranged at the bottom of the inner wall of the air pipe, a corner clamping mechanism is arranged on the outer surface of the air pipe, and the corner clamping mechanism comprises a seat cover fixedly sleeved on the outer surface of the air pipe. This bellows with heated air circulation structure removes two sets of driving levers along trompil each other, and this in-process accessible corner screens mechanism adjusts the access angle of fan, reduces the restriction of access ventilation duct, allows to deal with in a flexible way in different engineering scenes for the system adapts to different environment and space conditions more easily.

title_en: Tail gas burning exhaust port heat sink
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tail gas combustion exhaust port cooling device, and relates to the field of tail gas treatment equipment. A plurality of air inlet pipes are arranged on the air distribution plate. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of structures such as the combustion-supporting gas igniter, the ultraviolet fire wire detection probe and the like, when the tail gas to be combusted is divided into a plurality of paths from the bottom gas separation disc and is led into the combustion chamber, the ignited combustion-supporting gas is used for ignition, the infrared detection probe is used for monitoring whether the tail gas is combusted, medium-pressure air is led in from the side surface of the lower part of the combustion chamber, the led-in medium-pressure air forms a vortex form by virtue of the helical blades at the upper end of the combustion chamber, the medium-pressure air and waste gas generated by combustion are fully mixed for heat exchange, so that the average temperature of the gas above the combustion chamber is reduced, and meanwhile, the effect of increasing the heat dissipation sectional area is achieved by virtue of the heat absorption of the air of the inclined tube in the inner flue.

title_en: Antiseep finned radiator
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of finned radiators and discloses an anti-leakage finned radiator which comprises a base, wherein a frame is arranged at the top of the base, an oil outlet and an oil inlet are respectively and fixedly connected to two sides of the frame, a plurality of groups of radiating pipes are arranged in the frame, an adjusting plate is fixedly connected to the inside of the frame below the radiating pipes, positive and negative screw rods are movably connected to two sides of the inside of the adjusting plate through driving components, and anti-leakage sleeves are movably connected to the tops of the positive and negative screw rods through the driving components, so that the anti-leakage radiator can drive the positive and negative screw rods on two sides to rotate through the driving components, and when the positive and negative screw rods rotate, the anti-leakage sleeves can be driven to seal the radiating pipes by the adjusting mechanisms, so that leakage phenomena of the radiating pipes can be effectively avoided, and the service life and the radiating effect of the anti-leakage radiator are greatly improved.

title_en: Thermal expansion valve and thermal management system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a thermal expansion valve and a thermal management system, wherein the thermal expansion valve comprises a gas tank head, a valve body and a filter, the gas tank head is provided with a pressure equalizing chamber, the valve body is fixedly connected with the gas tank head, the valve body comprises a first inlet, the filter is positioned outside the gas tank head, the filter comprises a filter screen, a channel of the filter screen is communicated with the first inlet, and a channel of the filter screen is communicated with the pressure equalizing chamber. The filter can filter impurities in the refrigerant, and reduce the impurities from entering the pressure equalizing chamber.

title_en: Water-cooling system of electric vibration chute
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water cooling system of an electric vibration chute, which comprises: the cooling box is arranged outside the electric vibration chute, a filter box is fixedly connected to one end below the cooling box, a water storage chamber is fixedly connected to one end of the side face of the filter box, the water storage chamber is fixedly connected with the upper cooling box, a water inlet pipe is fixedly connected to one end of the side face of the water storage chamber, a water pump is connected to one end of the side face of the water inlet pipe in a threaded manner, and a water delivery pipe is connected to one end of the side face of the water pump in a threaded manner; according to the utility model, the recycling of water resources is realized through the mechanisms such as the cooling tank, the filtering tank and the water storage chamber, the waste of the water resources is avoided, a better working environment is created, the filtering tank mechanism can filter the recycled water, the residual particle impurities on the filter screen can be cleaned, the impurities can be cleaned in time, and the problems that the spray head cannot be cooled normally due to the blockage of the particle impurities and the impurities in the filter system are difficult to clean are solved.

title_en: Evaporation type electricity-saving air conditioner
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of air conditioners, in particular to an evaporative power-saving air conditioner, which aims at improving efficiency and provides a scheme that the evaporative power-saving air conditioner comprises an air conditioner body; the outer surface of the air conditioner body is provided with a ventilation port; the upper surface of the air conditioner body is provided with a second mounting groove; the inner surface of the second mounting groove is fixedly connected with a filter; the upper surface of the air conditioner body is fixedly connected with a ventilator; the inner surface of the air conditioner body is fixedly connected with a wet curtain; the upper surface of the air conditioner body is provided with a fixing mechanism. Through the arrangement of the fixing mechanism, the filter is quickly installed and detached, the filter screen is quickly cleaned, and the efficiency is improved; through the setting of mounting groove and spring No. one, no. one the spring can release the filter mounting groove No. two, is convenient for take the filter, and spring No. one upwards promotes the filter, makes the filter fix the fixed block, and the fixed block of being convenient for is fixed the filter.

title_en: Ventilating energy-saving system of green building
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a ventilating energy-saving system of a green building, which has the technical scheme that: the pipe comprises a pipe body, wherein a stepping motor is arranged in the pipe body, and a mounting ring is connected with the inside of the pipe body in a threaded manner; the limiting ring is fixedly connected to one end of the mounting ring, and fan blades are arranged in the limiting ring; the locating component is arranged inside the mounting ring and used for locating the fan blades, after the locating ring is rotated by a worker, the locating ring can drive the mounting ring to rotate, the mounting ring and the pipe body can be separated, workers can conveniently clean the detached fan blades and the filter screen at the same time, and further, the fan blades are prevented from depositing a plurality of dust after long-term use, the stepping motor drives the fan blades to run at a low speed so that the power consumption is increased, the effect of green energy conservation is achieved, and the locating block and the locating groove are movably sleeved together to avoid the loose state of the locating ring when long-term fixing.

title_en: Lithium iron phosphate sintering preparation system adopting electrothermal atmosphere rotary kiln
abstract_en: The utility model provides a lithium iron phosphate sintering preparation system adopting an electrothermal atmosphere rotary kiln, which relates to the field of lithium iron phosphate preparation, and comprises a weighing feeder and a rotary kiln, wherein a furnace end exhaust pipe of the rotary kiln is communicated with a wet dust collector, and the rear end of the rotary kiln is communicated with a lithium iron phosphate outlet and an inert gas inlet; the rotary kiln comprises a rotary kiln body, wherein the rotary kiln body is characterized in that a kiln barrel of the rotary kiln is divided into a heating section, a constant temperature section and a cooling section which are sequentially communicated, a plurality of spraying ports are formed above the cooling section, and the cooling section is also communicated with a cooling water return port. Compared with the prior art, the system can effectively roll materials through the rotation of the rotary kiln and the design of the internal structure, ensure that the materials are heated uniformly, effectively avoid the phenomena of raw burning and overburning, accelerate the decomposition and reaction of invalid carbon among lithium iron phosphate particles, wrap the carbon on the surfaces of the particles in a nano form, and greatly improve the generation of a carbon conductive network structure; meanwhile, an inert atmosphere protection and electric heating system is adopted, so that the sintering time is effectively shortened, the quality is improved, and the energy consumption is reduced.

title_en: Parallel screw refrigerating unit applied to heat recovery
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a parallel screw refrigerating unit applied to heat recovery, which comprises a base and an evaporator arranged at the top of the base through a fixing frame, wherein the rear end of the evaporator is connected with a condenser through a pipeline, the tops of the evaporator and the condenser are connected with a plurality of screw compressors through the fixing frame, a novel bearing displacement device is additionally arranged at four corners of the left end and the right end of the base of the parallel screw refrigerating unit, the bearing displacement device can be ensured to be normally and stably placed on the ground when in a storage state, and the displacement is required when the parallel screw refrigerating unit is assembled or maintained, at the moment, the displacement function of the bearing displacement device can be used for moving the base and the parallel screw refrigerating unit arranged on the base, and the device has excellent bearing capacity and can not be deformed and damaged due to the large weight of the parallel screw refrigerating unit in the displacement process.

title_en: Automatic furnace ramming facility for alloy smelting
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an automatic furnace tamping facility for alloy smelting, which comprises a bracket, a fixed hinge, a connecting rod and a furnace tamping machine, wherein the furnace tamping machine is rotationally connected to one end of the connecting rod; a pneumatic pick is arranged in the furnace tamping machine, the furnace tamping end of the pneumatic pick extends out of the furnace tamping machine, the tail end of the pneumatic pick is connected with an extension air pipe, and one end of the extension air pipe penetrates out of the furnace tamping machine; one end of the fixed hinge is connected with the tail end of the air pick, and the other end of the fixed hinge passes through the extension air pipe, bypasses an air pipe gear at the tail end of the extension air pipe and a bracket shaft gear on the bracket and is finally connected to the winch. By using such a furnace ramming facility, furnace ramming can be performed at high temperatures with simple machinery. The continuous operation of smelting can be ensured, the working efficiency is improved, the labor is saved and the effect is good compared with the manual and manual furnace tamping, meanwhile, the working intensity of workers is reduced, and the working body feeling is improved.

title_en: Energy storage heating system utilizing valley electricity and photovoltaic power generation for heating
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an energy storage heating system utilizing valley electricity and photovoltaic power generation for heating, which comprises a heat storage water tank, an air source heat pump, an electric boiler, a photovoltaic power generation system, a power supply module and a control module, wherein the heat storage water tank is sequentially communicated with a circulating pump, a first electric three-way valve, factory heat dissipation equipment and a second electric three-way valve, the second electric three-way valve is respectively communicated with the heat storage water tank and the heat storage pump, the heat storage pump is communicated with the air source heat pump through the first electric valve, the air source heat pump is communicated with the electric boiler, the air source heat pump is also communicated with the heat storage water tank through the second electric valve, and the other water outlet of the heat storage water tank is communicated with the heat storage pump through a third electric valve. The heating system of the utility model heats hot water to 75 ℃ by using valley electricity during the shutdown period of a factory at night to store heat, then supplies heat for the factory in daytime, supplements a part of heat by using photovoltaic power generation, and finally meets the heating requirement of the factory under the conditions of obviously saving energy and reducing pollution.

title_en: Online adjusting device for spraying and burning angle of boiler burner
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of combustion boiler equipment, and relates to an on-line adjusting device for the combustion angle of a boiler burner, which comprises a burner, wherein the top of the burner is provided with a rotating shaft, the rotary shaft is provided with a transmission rod, the top end of the transmission rod is connected with an electric actuator, the bottom end of the transmission rod is provided with a movable joint, the movable joint is provided with a connecting rod, and the connecting rod is connected to the blade. The utility model is convenient to adjust the spraying angle, and can be adjusted according to the current fuel property, the combustion state in the hearth and the smoke temperature deviation at two sides of the flue so as to achieve the optimal combustion working condition.

title_en: Quick detach heat accumulation formula medium temperature flue gas waste heat recovery device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a quick-dismantling heat accumulating type medium-temperature flue gas waste heat recovery device, and relates to the technical field of low carbon and energy conservation. The device comprises a collecting unit and a collecting unit, wherein the collecting unit comprises a recovery pipeline, and a high-temperature area, a medium-temperature area and a low-temperature area are sequentially separated in the recovery pipeline; the filtering separation unit comprises a first partition plate, a second partition plate and a pushing plate, wherein the first partition plate and the pushing plate are arranged in a high-temperature area and a low-temperature area, and the second partition plate is arranged in a medium-temperature area and is connected with the first partition plate; the installation fixing unit comprises a fixing connecting pipe, a first clamping piece and a second clamping piece, wherein the fixing connecting pipe is connected to the axis of the recovery pipeline, and the first clamping piece and the second clamping piece are respectively and symmetrically arranged in the fixing connecting pipe and are connected with the first partition board and the second partition board; the heat storage unit comprises heat storage balls, and the heat storage balls are arranged in the separation space of the first partition plate and the second partition plate. The utility model solves the problems of low waste heat recovery utilization rate and inconvenient installation and maintenance of the existing heat accumulator.

title_en: Cooling tower for electromechanical engineering
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cooling tower for electromechanical engineering, which belongs to the technical field of cooling towers and comprises a cooling tower assembly, wherein the cooling tower assembly comprises a water storage tank and a cooling tank, the cooling tank is fixedly connected to the middle position of the top of the water storage tank, supporting legs are fixedly connected to the bottom of the water storage tank close to four corners, a water inlet pipe is fixedly connected to the right side of the cooling tank close to the top in an inserting manner, and a water outlet pipe is fixedly connected to the right side of the cooling tank close to the bottom in an inserting manner; through setting up of flourishing material subassembly, can make two flourishing charging trays be the setting from top to bottom, and the flourishing charging tray in centre is fixed the setting to when rotating hand wheel, two flourishing charging trays relative movement or move in opposite directions about the accessible transfer line, transmission bevel gear, driven bevel gear, threaded rod, thread bush, sliding plate and the setting of spacing spout drive under, and then can adjust the interval between two adjacent flourishing charging trays according to the in-service use demand of packing, and the operation is more convenient.

title_en: Photovoltaic power supporting device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a photovoltaic power supporting device which comprises a bottom plate and a mounting plate, wherein the upper end of the bottom plate is movably connected with a first adjusting component, the first adjusting component comprises a U-shaped frame and a guide rod, the outer surface of the U-shaped frame is movably connected with a second adjusting component, and the second adjusting component comprises a rotating shaft and an inner gear ring. According to the photovoltaic panel adjusting mechanism, the guide rod is pulled to separate from the arc-shaped plate, the U-shaped frame is rotated to drive the mounting plate and the photovoltaic panel to rotate to a proper angle, the guide rod is loosened, the arc-shaped plate is fixed through the guide rod, the effect of adjusting the pitch angle of the photovoltaic panel is achieved, the inner gear ring is not meshed with the gear any more through pulling the handle, then the handle is rotated to drive the photovoltaic panel to rotate to a proper angle, the handle is loosened, at the moment, the inner gear ring is meshed with the gear again, and rotation of the rotating shaft is prevented, so that the inclination angle of the photovoltaic panel is adjusted, the adjusting range of the photovoltaic panel is increased through the adjusting component I and the adjusting component II, and the solar energy absorbing efficiency of the photovoltaic panel is improved.

title_en: Fan subassembly, fresh air module and air conditioner of air conditioner
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fan assembly, a fresh air module of an air conditioner and the air conditioner, wherein the fan assembly comprises: a housing having a receiving cavity, a first opening and a second opening; the rotary assembly is rotatably arranged in the accommodating cavity and comprises a separation plate, an air inlet baffle and an air outlet baffle, the separation plate can divide the accommodating cavity into an air inlet cavity and an air outlet cavity, the separation plate is provided with a communication port capable of communicating the air inlet cavity and the air outlet cavity, the air inlet baffle is arranged on one side of the separation plate facing the air inlet cavity, and the air outlet baffle is arranged on one side of the separation plate facing the air outlet cavity; the wind wheel is arranged in the air inlet cavity or the air outlet cavity; and the driving assembly is connected with the rotating assembly and the wind wheel. According to the fan assembly provided by the embodiment of the utility model, air can flow into the shell through different openings and flow out of the shell through different openings, so that passages in multiple directions are formed in the shell, the working modes of the fan assembly can be enriched, and the use experience of a user is improved.

title_en: DMAC rectifying energy-saving circulating cooling waterway system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an energy-saving circulating cooling waterway system for DMAC rectification, which belongs to the technical field of DMAC rectification and comprises a rectifying tower, a distilled water storage tank and a cooling tower; one side of the surface of the rectifying tower is connected with a DMAc waste liquid pipeline for inputting DMAc waste liquid after 5-level concentration, one side of the rectifying tower is connected with a waste water heat exchanger for heating DMAc waste water through a pipeline, the top of the rectifying tower is connected with a tower top water vapor pipeline, the tower top water vapor pipeline is respectively connected with the rectifying tower and a distilled water storage tank through a reflux cooling distilled water pipeline and a cooling distilled water pipeline, and the surface of the tower top water vapor pipeline is provided with a cooling heat exchanger for cooling tower top water vapor; the utility model realizes the purposes of energy saving and consumption reduction by combining the two groups of waterway systems, and simultaneously uses distilled water as circulating water replenishing water, thereby greatly reducing the consumption of tap water replenishing water, preventing distilled water from forming scale at the heat exchanger part and further prolonging the service life of each heat exchanger.

title_en: Radiator convenient to installation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a radiator convenient to install, which belongs to the technical field of heating radiators and comprises a radiator body, wherein two sides of the radiator body are respectively provided with a group of clamping assemblies. The radiator convenient to install has the advantages of being fast to install, convenient to detach and convenient to maintain, a user finally drives the two front and back threaded screw rods to rotate through rotating the rotating rod, so that the first clamping block and the second clamping block are clamped in a centering mode or expanded outwards, the radiator body is fast to install or detach, the radiator body can be fast installed on the support, complex steps required by traditional installation are omitted, especially under the condition that a large number of installation are needed, the installation efficiency is remarkably improved, meanwhile, the fast installation and detachment can enable later maintenance and cleaning to be more convenient, the time and labor cost in the detachment process are reduced, and the adjustability of the clamping assembly can be suitable for radiator bodies of different models.

title_en: Condensed water recycling treatment device in needle coke production process
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a condensed water recycling treatment device in a needle coke production process, and belongs to the technical field of needle coke production. The device comprises a condensation water main pipeline, wherein the output end of the condensation water main pipeline is sequentially provided with a condensation water tank, a film covering device and a demineralized water tank, the condensation water tank, the film covering device and the demineralized water tank are connected through pipelines, and a water pumping device is arranged between the condensation water tank and the film covering device. The utility model realizes the cooling and impurity removal of the condensed water, protects needle coke production equipment, recycles the heat of the condensed water, and realizes energy conservation and emission reduction.

title_en: Ignition device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of ignition devices, and provides an ignition device, which comprises: the device comprises a container with a containing cavity, a gas-generating medicament which is loaded in the containing cavity and can generate gas when being heated to a preset temperature, a heating element which is contacted with the gas-generating medicament and can generate heat to the preset temperature when being electrified, a first electrode electrically connected to one end of the heating element, and a second electrode electrically connected to the other end of the heating element; some or all of the first electrodes are located outside the container and some or all of the second electrodes are located outside the container.

title_en: Range hood with built-in cage smoke isolation structure of chassis
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a range hood with a built-in cage smoke isolation structure of a case, wherein two cage smoke isolation plates are arranged on two lateral sides of the case; the fume adsorption cavity is divided into a fume adsorption cavity and two outer separation cavities by a fume partition plate; the driving component is arranged in the outer separation cavity; the upper part of the cage smoke adsorption cavity is provided with a cage smoke diversion cavity, the upper part of the cage smoke diversion cavity is connected with a wind cabinet, and the cross section of the cage smoke diversion cavity is gradually narrowed from bottom to top. According to the utility model, the horn-shaped narrow oil smoke adsorption cavity can enable the oil smoke in the cage smoke adsorption cavity to be more smoothly collected and guided towards the wind cabinet, so that the suction force below the wind cabinet is ensured; and the driving assembly is arranged in the outer separating cavity, and the oil smoke can not adhere to the surface of the driving assembly, so that the cleanness and the neatness of the driving assembly can be ensured, the normal work of the driving element can be ensured, and the service life can be prolonged.

title_en: Kiln outer rail
abstract_en: The utility model provides a kiln outer rail, and relates to the field of demagnetization. The kiln outer rail comprises a conveying assembly, a kiln outer rail and a kiln outer rail, wherein the conveying assembly is used for conveying saggers; the magnetic removing assembly is connected with the conveying assembly and is provided with a magnetic removing part; when the sagger is transported by the conveying component, the demagnetizing component can adsorb the magnetic foreign matters at the bottom of the sagger to the position of the demagnetizing part. According to the kiln outer rail of the present utility model, the demagnetizing unit connected to the conveying unit is provided, and the demagnetizing unit is formed with a demagnetizing portion, so that when the sagger is transported by the conveying unit, the demagnetizing unit can adsorb magnetic foreign matters (i.e., the above-mentioned metallic foreign matters) at the bottom of the sagger to the position of the demagnetizing portion. Therefore, the material can be effectively prevented from being mixed with metal foreign matters in the guiding-out process, and the quality of the ternary cathode material finished product is further effectively ensured.

title_en: Refrigerator with a refrigerator body
abstract_en: The application provides a refrigerator, belongs to the technical field of household appliances, and aims to solve the technical problem that a heat exchanger of the refrigerator and a refrigerant circulating in the heat exchanger are low in heat exchange efficiency. The refrigerator comprises a heat exchanger, wherein a flow channel is formed in the inner part of a heat exchange tube in the heat exchanger, protruding parts are formed on the inner wall of the top and the inner wall of the bottom of the heat exchange tube, the protruding parts protrude towards the inner part of the flow channel, and the projection of the protruding part on the inner wall of the top is located outside the protruding part on the inner wall of the bottom. The bulge increases the contact area of the heat exchanger and the refrigerant, and further improves the heat exchange efficiency of the heat exchanger and the refrigerant. In addition, the bulge on the top inner wall and the bulge on the bottom inner wall are staggered, so that the flow guiding direction of the bulge on the top inner wall to the refrigerant above the heat exchange tube is different from the flow guiding direction of the bulge on the bottom inner wall to the refrigerant below the heat exchange tube, the disturbance effect on the refrigerant is improved, and the heat exchange efficiency of the refrigerant and the heat exchange tube is further improved.

title_en: Steam circulation device for heat supply
abstract_en: The application discloses a steam circulation device for heat supply, which comprises a hot water cavity, wherein a buffer cavity is formed on one side of the hot water cavity, a water inlet pipe is connected to the side of the buffer cavity, a water outlet pipe is connected to the other side of the hot water cavity, a heat exchange pipe is arranged in the hot water cavity, the heat exchange pipe is arranged in a bent shape, one end of the heat exchange pipe is communicated with a water storage cavity through a pipeline, the water storage cavity is connected with a steam boiler through a first water pump, the steam boiler is connected with one end of a heat supply pipeline through a pipeline, the other end of the heat supply pipeline is communicated with a return water cavity through a return pipe, and the return water cavity is connected with the other end of the heat exchange pipe through a second water pump; the heating water is preheated by the high-temperature wastewater, the temperature of the heating water is increased, so that when the heating water is heated into steam in the later stage, the heat energy required by heating the heating steam is reduced, the fuel consumed by heating is reduced, the carbon emission caused by heating is reduced, and the air environment is protected.

title_en: Circulation cooling system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of cooling towers, and discloses a circulating cooling system which comprises a first tower row and a circulating water pump room; the circulating water pump house includes the room body and sets up in the internal circulation nest of tubes in room, and first tower row includes the cooling tower, and the cooling tower sets up side by side with the room body, and the cooling tower includes the catch basin, and circulation nest of tubes communicates each other with the catch basin, and the catch basin sets up under first ground level, and the top surface of catch basin exceeds first ground level 300mm, and the room body sets up on the second ground level, and the second ground level is less than first ground level, and the highest point of circulation nest of tubes is less than the top surface of catch basin. The circulating cooling system provided by the utility model can arrange the circulating water pump room into the overground pump room by utilizing the relief height difference, so that the risk of flooding the circulating water pump room is avoided, the safe operation is ensured, and the construction cost is reduced.

title_en: Evaporative condenser capable of conducting drainage operation
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of drainage of evaporative condensers, in particular to an evaporative condenser capable of conducting drainage operation; technical problems: the existing evaporative condenser capable of conducting drainage operation generally causes impurities in spray water and dust at an air inlet to adhere to a condensing pipe to form scale when in operation, and long-time accumulation affects performance; the technical scheme is as follows: an evaporative condenser capable of conducting drainage operation comprises a bottom plate, a condensation assembly, a spraying assembly, a filtering assembly, a water collecting assembly, a flow dividing assembly and a wind channel assembly; compared with the traditional evaporative condenser capable of conducting drainage operation, the problem that impurities in spray water and dust at an air inlet adhere to a condensing pipe to form scale is solved, the filtering method is adopted in the evaporative condenser capable of conducting drainage operation, the impurities in the spray water are filtered and sprayed, and a dust baffle is arranged at the air inlet to avoid the adhesion of the impurities in the air circulation process.

title_en: Device suitable for tail gas heat transfer cooling
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a device suitable for heat exchange and cooling of tail gas, which comprises a treatment box, wherein one end of the treatment box is provided with an air inlet, a plurality of baffles are arranged in the treatment box, so that a curved airflow channel is formed in the treatment box, a radiating fin tube is arranged in the airflow channel, a water storage room is arranged at the bottom of the treatment box, one side of the treatment box is provided with an air outlet channel, a packing layer is arranged in the air outlet channel, a spraying mechanism is arranged above the packing layer, a fan is connected above the air outlet channel, and the fan is connected with an air outlet. The utility model has reasonable structural design, the baffle plate is arranged in the treatment box to form a curved airflow channel, so that the hot airflow and the radiating fin tube can be fully contacted, the cooling effect is far superior to that of common dust removing equipment, and the dust removal and the cooling effect are good by adopting a plurality of groups of filler layers.

title_en: Mine heat exchanger
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mine heat exchanger, which comprises a heat exchanger main body, wherein an access hole is formed in the surface of the heat exchanger main body, an access plate is arranged in the access hole, a connecting pipe is fixed at the top end of the heat exchanger main body, a quick dismounting mechanism is arranged between the access plate and the access hole, a dust prevention mechanism is arranged at the end part of the connecting pipe, and the quick dismounting mechanism comprises: the connecting components are arranged at two sides between the access panel and the access opening; the guide assemblies are arranged at two ends between the access panel and the access opening; according to the utility model, through the designed grooves, the built-in grooves, the limiting blocks and the operation blocks, the rapid limiting or the releasing of the limiting of the overhaul plate can be realized, and meanwhile, the overhaul plate can be rapidly disassembled and assembled by matching with the designed connecting grooves, the connecting blocks and the operation handles.

title_en: Solar energy utilization system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a solar energy utilization system, which comprises a linear Fresnel reflector device, an energy receiving end and a solar energy tracking device, wherein the energy receiving end is positioned at a light condensation position of the linear Fresnel reflector device; the solar tracking device is located between the mirror of the linear fresnel mirror device and the energy receiving end. According to the solar energy utilization system, the solar energy tracking device facing the linear Fresnel reflector is used for observing the utilization condition of solar energy, according to the observed light information, the mirror surface angle and/or direction to be controlled are obtained through analysis and processing, and a control signal is sent to the control device to control the mirror surface posture of the linear Fresnel reflector device, so that the sunlight tracking precision of the linear Fresnel reflector device is adjusted, and the system efficiency is improved. The solar energy utilization system has higher sunlight utilization efficiency, reduces the cost of manual monitoring and maintenance, and improves the utilization rate and economic benefit of the overall sunlight of the system.

title_en: Indoor smog rapid purification device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an indoor smoke rapid purification device, which belongs to the field of smoke purification devices and comprises a shell, wherein two air inlet grooves are formed in the outer surface of the shell, two air suction devices are fixedly connected to the inner bottom wall of the shell, an adsorption plate is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the shell, a filter screen plate is clamped to the inner wall of the adsorption plate, an active carbon plate is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the filter screen plate, a grooved groove is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the shell, smoke is rapidly sucked into the shell through the arranged adsorption plate, the filter screen plate, the active carbon plate, the air suction devices and a fan, the smoke is rapidly absorbed through the two air suction devices, then the fan generates air flow to enable the smoke in the shell to be discharged outwards, and impurities, gases in the smoke are sequentially adsorbed and secondarily filtered through the adsorption plate, the filter screen plate and the active carbon plate in the discharging process, so that the effect of rapid filtration and purification are achieved.

title_en: Wet-heat oxidation treatment system applied to high-concentration industrial wastewater
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wet-heat oxidation treatment system applied to high-concentration industrial wastewater, which comprises a wastewater tank, a reaction kettle, a first pumping branch, a second pumping branch, a discharge branch and a circulation branch, wherein the wastewater in the wastewater tank is pumped into the reaction kettle through the first pumping branch, the first pumping branch comprises a first water pump connected with the wastewater tank, a heating device connected with the reaction kettle and a first heat exchange device connected with the first water pump and the heating device, compressed air is pumped into the reaction kettle through the second pumping branch, the second pumping branch comprises an air compressor and a second heat exchange device connected with the air compressor and the reaction kettle, the wastewater in the reaction kettle circulates through the circulation branch, the circulation branch comprises the second heat exchange device and the second water pump, the gas-liquid mixture after reaction in the reaction kettle is discharged through the discharge branch, the discharge branch is a plate heat exchanger through the first heat exchange device, and the first heat exchange device and the second heat exchange device are all plate heat exchangers.

title_en: Magnesium alloy smelting and feeding device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a magnesium alloy smelting feeding device, and relates to the technical field of magnesium alloy smelting; the utility model comprises a smelting furnace, wherein a smelting chamber is arranged at the top end of the smelting furnace, fixed plates are fixedly connected to the top end of the smelting furnace and positioned on two sides of the smelting chamber, a charging barrel is rotatably connected between the two fixed plates, one end of a central shaft of the charging barrel extends to one side of the fixed plates and is fixedly connected with a first gear, one side of the fixed plate, which is close to the first gear, is rotatably connected with a second gear, and the first gear and the second gear are in meshed connection; through the cooperation between handle, second gear, action wheel, first gear, follow driving wheel, third gear and the rack to utilize the transmission ratio between first gear and the second gear, can realize the upset size operation of reinforced section of thick bamboo when the control apron is opened, thereby pour the inside raw materials of reinforced section of thick bamboo, convenient operation is swift, has further improved feeding efficiency.

title_en: Heat exchange plate, heat exchange plate pair, heat exchange plate bundle and heat exchanger
abstract_en: The application provides a heat exchange plate, a heat exchange plate pair, a heat exchange plate bundle and a heat exchanger, wherein the heat exchange plate comprises: the heat exchange plate comprises a first plate body, wherein a short side of the first plate body is provided with a first strip-shaped bulge along the width direction, a long side of the first plate body is provided with a second strip-shaped bulge along the length direction, the end part of the second strip-shaped bulge is provided with a second medium flow passage port, and the first strip-shaped bulge and the second strip-shaped bulge are used for welding connection between heat exchange plates; the edge of the second strip-shaped bulge is provided with a folded edge, and the folded edge is used for welding connection between the heat exchange plate pairs; the two ends of the first plate body along the length direction are first medium flow passage port areas, block-shaped protrusions are arranged in the first medium flow passage port areas, second plate bodies are embedded in the block-shaped protrusions, and the second plate bodies and the first plate bodies are located on the same horizontal plane. The heat exchange plate, the heat exchange plate pair, the heat exchange plate bundle and the heat exchanger provided by the application have the advantages of simple structure, convenience in manufacture and low production cost, can effectively improve the abrasion phenomenon, prolong the service life and improve the heat exchange effect.

title_en: Waste heat utilization device of grate cooler
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of waste heat utilization and discloses a waste heat utilization device of a grate cooler, which comprises a body, wherein one side of the body is fixedly connected with a filter box, one side surface of the filter box, which is far away from the body, is fixedly connected with a motor, an output shaft of the motor is fixedly connected with a rotating shaft, the surface of the rotating shaft is sleeved with three filter discs, one side of each of the three filter discs is provided with a plurality of mounting grooves, the interiors of the plurality of mounting grooves are respectively provided with a filter mechanism for filtering waste gas, two U-shaped plates are fixedly connected to the interior of one side of the body, which is close to the rotating shaft, the two U-shaped plates are symmetrically arranged, the tops of the two U-shaped plates are respectively connected with an abutting plate in a sliding manner, and cleaning brushes are respectively arranged on the surfaces of one side, which is close to the filter discs. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the cleaning brush, the filter block can keep a good filtering effect.

title_en: Air exhausting and dehumidifying mechanism of garage
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a garage air draft and dehumidification mechanism, which comprises a dehumidifier and a wall panel, wherein one side of the dehumidifier is fixedly connected with a U-shaped plate, one side of the U-shaped plate is provided with a mounting plate, one side of the mounting plate is fixedly connected with a filter screen, the filter screen is in sliding clamping connection with the inside of the U-shaped plate, one side of the mounting plate, which is close to the filter screen, is fixedly connected with an inserting block, one side of the inserting block is provided with an inserting hole, one side, which is close to the U-shaped plate, of the dehumidifier is fixedly connected with a fixing frame, a clamping plate is in sliding clamping connection with the inside of the fixing frame, one side, which is far away from the clamping plate, of the clamping block is movably penetrated through the fixing frame and extends into the inserting hole. The utility model has the beneficial effects that the filter screen is convenient to install and detach through the cooperation among the inserting block, the inserting hole, the fixing frame, the clamping plate, the clamping block, the unlocking plate and the spring, and the problem that the filter screen of the garage air draft and dehumidification mechanism is not easy to detach, so that extra mind and energy are required during cleaning is avoided.

title_en: Furnace door structure of biomass boiler
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of boiler furnace doors, in particular to a furnace door structure of a biomass boiler, which comprises a plate body, a glass body, a rotating frame and a second spring, wherein a positioning groove is formed in the plate body, the glass body is arranged in the positioning groove, a mounting seat is arranged on one side of the plate body, the rotating frame is rotatably arranged at the upper end of the mounting seat through a rotating shaft, and the second spring is arranged in the glass body. The device can utilize the explosion-proof layer glass with the function of cleaning the inner wall of the glass door and the double buffering effect, solves the problem that the existing biomass boiler door lacks the self-cleaning inner wall, lacks the effective safety protection effect, and does not achieve the best protection function when accidents occur.

title_en: Exhaust structure of pressure sintering furnace
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of sintering furnaces, in particular to an exhaust structure of a pressure sintering furnace. Its technical scheme includes blast pipe and filter tube, filter tube both ends respectively fixed mounting have one-way discharge valve and rotation motor, rotation motor output shaft end is provided with the socket through pivot fixedly connected with brush board, one side that the filter tube upper surface is close to one-way discharge valve is provided with the socket, the filter tube upper surface is located socket top position department and passes through bolt fixed mounting and have the fixed plate, fixed plate lower surface fixed mounting has the closing plate, one side fixed mounting that the closing plate lower surface is close to rotation motor has the filter screen, the filter screen surface is close to lower surface position department and is provided with the breach. According to the utility model, the filter screen can be cleaned under the condition that the filter screen is not dismounted, the operation is convenient, meanwhile, the sintering furnace does not need to be stopped in the cleaning process, the operation of the sintering furnace is not influenced, and the filter screen is convenient to replace.

title_en: Air-heating dryer
abstract_en: The utility model provides an air-heating dryer, which comprises a host, wherein the host comprises a plurality of rice-shaped pipes filled with drying agents, one or more upper cavities and lower cavities which are respectively communicated with the upper end and the lower end of the rice-shaped pipes, and an air outlet module and an air inlet module which are respectively communicated with the upper cavities and the lower cavities; the main machine is connected with the high-pressure fans of the heating box, hot air can be injected into the upper cavities through the heating box and the pipelines, and the main machine can respectively inject hot air into different upper cavities through the pipelines so as to dry the upper cavities and accelerate the regeneration of drying agents, thereby effectively improving the drying efficiency of the dryer.

title_en: Intelligent diffuse oxygen regulating system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a disperse oxygen adjusting technology and discloses an disperse oxygen intelligent adjusting system which comprises an oxygen generating module, a switch switching module and a plurality of oxygen supplying modules, wherein the oxygen generating module is used for preparing disperse oxygen and delivering the disperse oxygen to the oxygen supplying modules, the switch switching module is used for switching on and off of different oxygen supplying modules, and the oxygen supplying modules are used for supplying and outputting oxygen.

title_en: Vibration isolation and shock absorption piece, motor and range hood
abstract_en: Vibration isolation damping part, motor and range hood belong to domestic appliance technical field. The vibration isolation and shock absorption piece comprises a shock isolation pad part, an air bag part and an elastic part, wherein the shock isolation pad part comprises a first shock isolation pad arranged at one end of the shock isolation and shock absorption piece and a second shock isolation pad arranged at the other end of the shock isolation and shock absorption piece, the air bag part at least comprises an air bag arranged between the first shock isolation pad and the second shock isolation pad, the elastic part at least comprises an elastic piece, one end of the elastic piece acts on the shock isolation pad part, the other end of the elastic piece acts on the air bag part, or one end of the elastic piece acts on the first shock isolation pad, and the other end of the elastic piece acts on the second shock isolation pad. According to the technical scheme, the air bag can prevent the range hood from resonating and has the noise reduction effect, the isolation pad is matched with the air bag to have the dual shock absorption effect, the elastic piece simultaneously shares the compression force born by the air bag and the isolation pad, the obvious vibration isolation noise reduction effect is obtained, and the service life of the vibration isolation shock absorption piece is prolonged.

title_en: Quick assembly disassembly formula handle subassembly and outer machine of air conditioner
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of air conditioning devices, and provides a quick detachable handle assembly, which comprises a handle cover and a side plate which are detachably connected, wherein a plurality of clamping hook pieces are arranged on the handle cover, a plurality of clamping holes matched with the clamping hook pieces are correspondingly formed in the side plate, grooves are formed in the clamping hook pieces, when the handle cover is assembled with the side plate, the handle cover is covered on the side plate to enable the clamping hook pieces to enter the clamping holes, then the handle cover is horizontally pushed to enable the grooves to be clamped with the edges of the clamping holes, when the handle cover is detached from the side plate, the handle cover is pushed reversely to enable the grooves to be separated from the edges of the clamping holes, and the front face of the handle cover is provided with a buckling part. Therefore, the utility model replaces the screw connection of the handle cover and the side plate by the clamping connection of the handle cover and the side plate, and the handle cover can be disassembled by pushing the handle cover. The disassembly and assembly operation can be completed by one hand, the operation is simple and convenient, the screws and tools are not required to be additionally used, and the falling risk is avoided. The utility model also provides an air conditioner external unit with the handle assembly.

title_en: Laboratory electric stove with multiple heating modes
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a laboratory electric furnace with multiple heating modes, which comprises a main body, wherein a furnace plate is arranged on the main body, electric furnace wires are arranged on the furnace plate, a plurality of metal poking sheets are arranged in the main body, heating resistors with one-to-one correspondence and different resistance values are respectively connected in series, the heating resistors are connected in series with the electric furnace wires, and an adjusting button is arranged on the main body and used for controlling the electric furnace wires, the metal poking sheets and the corresponding heating resistors to be connected in series in sequence. The utility model has the beneficial effects that the utility model has a plurality of heating modes and can rapidly switch different heating modes according to the sample test stage.

title_en: Photovoltaic mounting frame for photovoltaic construction
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of photovoltaic construction, and discloses a photovoltaic mounting frame for photovoltaic construction, which solves the problem of poor adjusting effect of the existing photovoltaic mounting frame for photovoltaic construction. According to the photovoltaic panel, the notch, the movable plate, the fixed plate, the bidirectional motor, the screw rods, the rings, the connecting rods, the inclined plates, the connecting seats and the side plates are adopted, the screw rods at the output ends of the two ends are driven to rotate by the bidirectional motor, one ends of the two groups of screw rods are movably connected with the side plates, the side plates are fixed with the transverse plates, the two groups of screw rods are in threaded connection with the rings on the surfaces, the rings drive the connecting rods at the two ends to move towards the bidirectional motor, so that the two groups of connecting rods drive the inclined plates at the ends to rotate, the inclined plates gradually deviate from an inclined state to a vertical state, the height of the top plate is adjusted by the inclined plates, the accurate adjustment of the height of the central plate can be realized, the installation height of the photovoltaic panel meets the requirement, and the adjustment of a plurality of height ranges can be realized from the inclined state to the vertical state, and the requirements of different scenes are met.

title_en: Air preheater with good sealing performance
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an air preheater with good sealing performance, which relates to the technical field of air preheaters, and comprises an air inlet, an air outlet, a sealing head, a connecting sleeve, a guide cover, a first sealing gasket, an extension sleeve and an elastic sealing belt, wherein the sealing head is fixed on the air inlet and the air outlet, so that the guide cover can be arranged in the air inlet and the air outlet, the first sealing gasket can block the air inlet and the air outlet, the guide cover is used for transferring air to the main body of the preheater to realize heat exchange operation, meanwhile, the guide cover is attached to the inside of the air inlet and the air outlet, double sealing is realized from the inside together with the first sealing gasket, air is prevented from leaking from the joint of the sealing head, the air inlet and the air outlet, the extension sleeve and the elastic sealing belt are sleeved on the outer pipeline, the elastic sealing belt can be firmly fixed on the outer pipeline by using the anchor ear, sealing between the outer pipeline and the extension sleeve is realized, and the sealing performance is better.

title_en: Semiconductor processing cooling device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a semiconductor processing cooling device, which relates to the technical field of semiconductor processing and comprises a cooling box and a water tank, wherein a water outlet bucket is fixedly sleeved at the bottom of the cooling box, a first guide pipe is fixedly sleeved between the bottom of the water outlet bucket and the water tank, a first box cover is hinged at the top of the cooling box, two L-shaped rods are symmetrically and fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the first box cover, and hollow blocks are fixedly connected through the two L-shaped rods. According to the utility model, the fan blades are driven to rotate in the rotating process of the rotating rod through the arranged fan blades, so that the air flow in the cooling box can be accelerated through the two air inlets and the air outlets, the auxiliary cooling effect is achieved, the rotating rod and the stirring rod can be driven to synchronously work in the working process of the water pump through the arranged first driving mechanism and the second driving mechanism, the double cooling is realized, meanwhile, the cooling water can be recycled through the arranged water pump, and the waste of water resources is effectively avoided.

title_en: Electronic igniting gun
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of ignition guns, in particular to an electronic ignition gun which comprises a gas box main body, an ignition assembly and a hand pressing assembly, wherein the gas box main body is used for providing gas and is provided with an embedded groove, the ignition assembly is detachably embedded in the embedded groove and is used for igniting the gas output from the gas box main body, and the hand pressing assembly is arranged on the gas box main body and is used for controlling the on-off of the gas output by the gas box main body. The application has the effect of improving the assembly production efficiency of the electronic ignition gun.

title_en: Multi-stage split energy-saving combustion device for liquid fuel
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multistage split energy-saving combustion device for liquid fuel, which sequentially comprises a combustion cylinder, an ion combustion body and a combustion body installation box from top to bottom, wherein the upper end of the ion combustion body is fixedly connected with the combustion cylinder, the lower end of the ion combustion body is provided with an impeller air inlet channel, the impeller air inlet channel is positioned in the combustion body installation box, the combustion body installation box is of a hollow cavity structure, and the side surface of the combustion body installation box is provided with a fan air inlet and an oil inlet hole. Compared with the prior art, the utility model essentially changes the atomizing combustion mode of the original electric spraying fuel oil stove, does not need high-pressure atomizing nozzle atomization, realizes high-temperature vaporization combustion of liquid fuel in the primary combustion cavity, and stable combustion and full vaporization in the secondary combustion cavity, and full combustion and heating in the tertiary combustion cavity.

title_en: Refrigerator with a refrigerator body
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of refrigeration equipment and discloses a refrigerator, which comprises a box body, an inner container, a door body, a cover plate and an evaporator, wherein the inner container is arranged in the box body, an accommodating cavity with an opening at the front side is formed in the inner container, the door body is covered on the accommodating cavity, an air channel is defined between the cover plate and the inner container, the evaporator is arranged in the inner container and is positioned in the air channel, the inner container is provided with a first current-limiting part protruding towards the air channel, the first current-limiting part is inserted into a gap on the side surface of the evaporator, the cover plate is provided with a second current-limiting part protruding towards the air channel, and the second current-limiting part is attached to the front side of the evaporator. The utility model has the beneficial effects that the purposes that the air outlet channels on the two sides and the front of the evaporator are blocked and return air can only pass through the evaporator are realized under the condition of not increasing the investment of the mould and the cost of parts, and the refrigerating efficiency of the product is improved.

title_en: High-efficient aluminium bar heating furnace
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a high-efficiency aluminum bar heating furnace which comprises a machine pedestal, wherein a heating device is arranged on the machine pedestal, a heating bin is arranged at the top of the machine pedestal, a plurality of heating components are arranged in the heating bin, and a plurality of heating components are arranged in the heating bin, so that a worker can control a heating gun to set a plurality of sealing plates at different temperatures in the using process of the high-efficiency aluminum bar heating furnace, and the effect of processing a plurality of materials is realized. Through being provided with heat recovery storehouse and flue gas treatment storehouse and making it can effectually realize carrying out heat recovery's effect to the heating storehouse in the in-process that uses, avoided its in-process heat that uses to carry out the condition emergence of the heat loss that discharges and lead to through the flue gas, through being provided with the filter screen in flue gas treatment storehouse and making it can effectually realize absorbing effect to harmful gas and particulate matter in the smoke and dust in the in-process that uses.

title_en: Tail gas treatment device of calciner
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of tail gas treatment equipment, in particular to a calciner tail gas treatment device, which comprises a furnace body and a treatment box, wherein an air duct is fixedly arranged at the air outlet end of the furnace body, a treatment bin is arranged in the treatment box, a filter screen plate is fixedly arranged in the treatment bin, a purification box is fixedly arranged at the top of the treatment box, an air duct is fixedly arranged at the top of the purification box, a plate groove is formed in the right side surface of the purification box, a purification plate is hermetically arranged in the plate groove, an active carbon filter screen is embedded and arranged on the top surface of the purification plate, a mounting mechanism is arranged between the purification plate and the purification box, and the calciner tail gas treatment device is arranged by utilizing the structural design in the mounting mechanism, so that the purification plate is convenient to mount or dismount, the subsequent purification plate is convenient to replace, the shutdown time of the device is effectively shortened, and the treatment progress of the device is ensured.

title_en: Water cooling device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water cooling device which comprises a box body, a water storage tank and a water cooling mechanism, wherein the water storage tank and the water cooling mechanism are arranged in the box body, the water cooling mechanism comprises a water cooling frame, an upper refrigerating module and a lower refrigerating module which are arranged on the water cooling frame and are stacked up and down, and the upper refrigerating module and the lower refrigerating module respectively comprise a temperature conduction fin, a semiconductor chip connected with the temperature conduction fin and a refrigerating flow channel arranged in the temperature conduction fin. According to the utility model, the upper refrigeration module and the lower refrigeration module are arranged in the box body, so that the liquid in the corresponding refrigeration flow channels can be respectively refrigerated through the upper refrigeration module and the lower refrigeration module, the refrigeration efficiency is greatly improved, and when one refrigeration module fails, the other refrigeration module can normally refrigerate, so that the water cooling device can be ensured to continue to operate, and the loss to a user due to the fact that the water cooling device is damaged is avoided.

title_en: Ash bucket heat preservation device based on high-temperature clean flue gas of pin removal system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an ash bucket heat preservation device based on high-temperature flue gas purification of a pin removal system, which comprises a heat preservation coil pipe (2) spirally wound on the outer wall of an ash bucket (1), wherein a flow velocity partition is arranged in the heat preservation coil pipe (2), an air inlet (11) of the heat preservation coil pipe (2) is connected with a pin removal flue gas purification pipe (4) through a flue gas inlet pipeline (3), a flue gas extraction fan (5) is connected to the flue gas inlet pipeline (3), an air outlet (12) of the heat preservation coil pipe (2) is connected with a desulfurization inlet flue (7) through a flue gas exhaust pipeline (6), a temperature sensor (8) is connected to the flue gas exhaust pipeline (6), and the temperature sensor (8) is connected with the flue gas extraction fan (5) through a controller. The utility model has the advantages of fully utilizing the heat of the high-temperature purified flue gas of the pin removal system, saving energy, protecting environment, simultaneously effectively improving the heat exchange efficiency and the heat exchange effect and ensuring the heat preservation of the ash bucket.

title_en: Wheeled slide mechanism and heat exchanger
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wheel type slide way mechanism and a heat exchanger, and belongs to the technical field of heat exchangers, wherein the wheel type slide way mechanism comprises a plate type slide way, a baffle plate and a baffle plate, wherein the plate type slide way is arranged on the baffle plate; a ball assembly, at least one of which is provided; each ball assembly is disposed between two baffles; the heat exchanger comprises the wheel type slideway mechanism, and the heat exchanger has the advantages of simple structure, small occupied space and easy installation, can realize quick drawing and installation of a tube bundle, and effectively avoids scratching a cylinder body.

title_en: Door control device and cooking device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a door control device and a cooking device, belongs to the technical field of household appliances, and is designed for solving the problems that a door hook of an existing door control assembly is easy to hang clothes or scratch limbs of a user and the like. The gating device comprises a trigger area, a driving piece and a micro switch assembly, wherein the driving piece is configured to move relative to the trigger area and at least has a trigger state and a release state, the micro switch assembly is arranged in the trigger area and has a trigger end positioned on a moving path of the driving piece, and the driving piece can contact the trigger end in the trigger state and be away from the trigger end in the release state. According to the door control device and the cooking device disclosed by the utility model, the driving piece arranged on the box body is used for replacing the protruding door hook arranged on the box door in the prior art, and under the condition that the micro switch assembly can send a door closing signal to the control mechanism after the box door is completely closed, the structure of the box door is simplified, the appearance of the box door is more attractive, the number of parts is reduced, the use is safer, and the use experience is good.

title_en: Refrigerating type range hood
abstract_en: A refrigerating type fume exhaust fan comprises a fume exhaust fan, a heat radiation module comprises a condenser and a heat radiation fan, the heat radiation module comprises an evaporator and an inner fan, the condenser is vertically arranged, an evaporation net is arranged on the side wall of the condenser, condensed water condensed on the surface of the evaporator is collected and then conveyed to the top of the condenser, a water storage box is arranged below the condenser, a water outlet is formed in the bottom of the water storage box, a water inlet is formed in the volute, the water outlet is communicated with the water inlet through a water outlet channel, and a switch which can be opened when the water quantity in the water storage box reaches a proper amount is arranged at the water outlet. This vertical setting of condenser of refrigeration formula range hood, evaporation net locate on the condenser lateral wall, when making condenser slope arrangement because of complete machine installation error, the comdenstion water on the condenser is adsorbed by evaporation net, promotes condenser heat transfer efficiency, when the comdenstion water that falls from the condenser accumulates to a certain amount, the switch is opened, the comdenstion water gets into inside the spiral case and carries out self-cleaning, realizes the effective utilization of comdenstion water.

title_en: Annealing furnace for magnetic material production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an annealing furnace for magnetic material production, and aims to provide an annealing furnace for magnetic material production, which can automatically start and stop traction work. The automatic feeding device comprises a furnace body and a feeding car, wherein a socket, a discharge hole and a plurality of discharge grooves are formed in the furnace body, a first rack and a belt pulley are respectively arranged inside and outside a belt ring, a power supply, a single chip microcomputer and a plurality of servo motors are arranged on the furnace body, the belt pulley is connected with a motor shaft of the servo motors, a furnace door is detachably connected with the furnace body, a plug pin on the furnace door corresponds to the socket, a switch is arranged in the socket, the switch and the servo motors are electrically connected with the single chip microcomputer, the single chip microcomputer is electrically connected with the power supply, a drawer is detachably connected with the feeding car, steps are in one-to-one correspondence with the discharge grooves, and a second rack on the steps is matched with the first rack. The utility model has the advantages that the traction device can automatically start and stop traction work, is convenient for smooth placement and taking out of materials, and is provided with a part which can ensure that the belt pulley can stably work under the supporting effect.

title_en: Water curtain dust removing device for waste gas
