abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of waste gas treatment equipment, and particularly relates to a water curtain dust removal device for waste gas, which comprises a heat exchange tube, a spray tower and an exhaust fan, wherein a water tank is arranged in the spray tower, and a uniform partition plate with holes is arranged above the water tank; one end of the heat exchange tube is used for guiding waste gas, the other end of the heat exchange tube extends into the water tank, two layers of spraying assemblies are arranged in the spraying tower, an air gap for passing the gas is arranged between the spraying assemblies and the inner wall of the spraying tower, two layers of first baffle plates are arranged between the spraying assemblies positioned on the upper layer and the spraying assemblies positioned on the lower layer, the first baffle plates are obliquely arranged and have different oblique directions, a gap is arranged between the first baffle plates and the inner wall of the spraying tower, a flow gap is arranged between the two first baffle plates, the air gap, the gap and the flow gap jointly limit the flow direction of the gas, an air outlet is arranged on the spraying tower and is communicated with an exhaust fan, and the air outlet is positioned above the spraying assemblies on the upper layer. Therefore, the problems of low treatment efficiency and poor effect of fine particles in the waste gas at present are solved.

title_en: Gas combustion device and gas clothes dryer
abstract_en: The gas combustion device comprises a shell, a fire row, a gas valve, a discharge needle and an induction needle, wherein the shell comprises a bottom combustion chamber, a side air deflector, a fire row chamber and a top gathering chamber, the side air deflector is arranged on one side of a bottom air inlet adjacent to the fire row chamber, one end of the top gathering chamber is provided with a top air inlet, the other end of the top gathering chamber is provided with a top air outlet, the bottom of the top air inlet is provided with the top air deflector, the top air outlet is communicated with an air outlet groove, one end of the fire row chamber is provided with a through hole, the gas valve is provided with a longitudinally arranged nozzle, the fire row is arranged in the fire row chamber in an overlapping manner, the combustion end is opposite to the bottom combustion chamber, the injection tube is in butt joint with the through hole, the gas valve is arranged at one end of the shell, the nozzle is opposite to the injection tube, the discharge needle and the induction needle are fixed with an end plate of the shell, and the discharge needle and the end of the induction needle are matched with the fire row. The shell has the characteristics of air inlet at one end and air outlet at the other end, and is convenient to install when in use.

title_en: Floor air supply pipeline system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of ventilation pipeline equipment and discloses a floor air supply pipeline system which comprises a mounting box, wherein the outer wall of the mounting box is fixedly connected with a mounting plate, the inner wall of the mounting plate is connected with a top cover in a sliding manner, the inside of the top cover is fixedly connected with bilaterally symmetrical mounting blocks, the inside of the mounting blocks is rotationally connected with an adjusting rotating shaft, the lower surface of the adjusting rotating shaft is fixedly connected with a fixed shaft, the lower surface of the fixed shaft is fixedly connected with a turntable, the inside of the turntable is rotationally connected with a plurality of connecting rods, the outer wall of the connecting rod is fixedly connected with a hinging seat, and one side of the outer wall of the hinging seat is fixedly connected with a connecting rod. According to the utility model, the effect of facilitating rapid disassembly and cleaning of the inside of the mounting box is achieved by matching the mounting box, the mounting plate, the top cover, the mounting block, the adjusting rotating shaft, the fixing shaft, the turntable, the connecting rod, the hinge seat, the connecting rod, the clamping block and the spring, and the cleanliness of air is improved.

title_en: Internal spiral plug-in structure of high-efficiency heat exchange pipeline of electromagnetic heater
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an internal spiral plug-in structure of an efficient heat exchange pipeline of an electromagnetic heater, which comprises a spiral stirring plug-in arranged in a double-layer heat exchange pipe, wherein the double-layer heat exchange pipe is an annular spiral double-pipe heat exchange pipeline, the spiral stirring plug-in is concentrically arranged in the double-layer heat exchange pipe, the spiral stirring plug-in components can destroy the inner wall laminar boundary layer of double-deck heat exchange tube, increase the disturbance of fluid in the double-deck heat exchange tube, make the fluid reach abundant torrent, promote the heat transfer between fluid and the double-deck heat exchange tube, promote the heat transfer effect, accelerate the velocity of flow of fluid in the double-deck heat exchange tube through the spiral stirring plug-in components, and then can clear dirty and scale control to the double-deck heat exchange tube inner wall, do not need follow-up clearance.

title_en: Prevent wind mountain region photovoltaic power plant
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wind-proof mountain photovoltaic power station, which comprises a base, wherein a rotating motor is arranged at the top end of the base, a second wind-proof plate is arranged on the outer side of the base, and one end of a mounting block is provided with a dismounting structure. According to the utility model, the wind sensors are arranged on two sides of the second wind prevention plate, the wind sensors can sense the intensity of wind, when the intensity of wind is too high, the first servo motor can work to drive the threaded rod to rotate, the threaded rod can drive the first wind prevention plate to ascend, the first wind prevention plate can prevent wind from protecting a photovoltaic power station, the first wind prevention plate can descend when the first wind prevention plate is not needed, solar energy is not absorbed by the solar cell panel, meanwhile, when the wind is too strong, the wind can blow the fan blades to rotate, the fan blades can rotate through the cooperation of the wind power and the generator, certain electric power can be generated to supply power for the device, and certain energy saving can be realized for the device, so that the purpose that the mountain photovoltaic power station is convenient to prevent wind is achieved.

title_en: Combined bathroom heater
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of bathroom heaters, in particular to a combined bathroom heater which has the characteristic of improving practicability and comprises a bathroom heater shell, wherein a plurality of first threaded holes are formed in the lower portion of the bathroom heater shell, bolts are connected with the lower portion of the bathroom heater shell in a threaded mode, a cover is connected with the lower portion of the bolts in a threaded mode, a plurality of first round holes are formed in the right portion of the cover, a plurality of second round holes are formed in the right portion of the cover and are intersected with corresponding first round holes, an electric telescopic rod is arranged in the right portion of the bathroom heater shell, a bottom plate is arranged in the lower portion of the electric telescopic rod, a plurality of plugs are arranged in the lower portion of the bottom plate, and the electric telescopic rod is in plug connection with corresponding second round holes.

title_en: Mounting structure and air conditioner
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of air conditioner installation, and particularly relates to an installation structure and an air conditioner. The mounting structure comprises a shell, a connecting seat, a moving assembly and a clamping hook, wherein the connecting seat is used for being connected with a target piece, the shell is used for being connected with a mounting surface of the target piece, the moving assembly is arranged in the shell and comprises a first moving piece and a second moving piece, the first moving piece moves relative to the shell, the second moving piece is configured to move relative to the shell under the driving of the first moving piece so as to be connected with or disconnected from the clamping hook, the connecting seat is provided with a clamping groove, the clamping hook is rotationally arranged on the shell, and the clamping hook is configured to rotate relative to the shell under the action of gravity after being disconnected from the second moving piece so as to be clamped with the clamping groove. The installation structure provided by the application has the advantages of simpler and more convenient installation mode and higher installation efficiency.

title_en: Oval furnace body coaming installation reinforcing and shaping device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an elliptical furnace body coaming installation, reinforcement and shaping device which comprises a reinforcement main support, wherein a plurality of cross arm supports which are arranged in parallel are arranged on the reinforcement main support, all the cross arm supports are mutually perpendicular to the reinforcement main support, lines formed by connecting the outer ends of all the cross arm supports are in an outwards convex elliptical arc shape and are consistent with the arc shape in the corresponding top-blown furnace body coaming, the elliptical furnace body coaming installation and reinforcing device is simple in integral manufacture, high in applicability, capable of flexibly designing different coamings and quite convenient to manufacture, and the selected materials of the reinforcing device are channel steel, and low in cost.

title_en: Heat energy recovery device for power engineering
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a heat energy recovery device for power engineering, which comprises a base, wherein a heat source entering box is vertically arranged at the top of the base, a heat exchange box is vertically arranged at the top of the base, a plurality of heat exchange pipes are transversely and penetratingly arranged on the side wall of the heat exchange box, a scale cleaning component is arranged at the top in the heat exchange box, an exhaust box is vertically arranged at the top of the base, a filtering component is arranged in the exhaust pipe, and an opening component is arranged at the outer side of the exhaust pipe.

title_en: Connecting corner connector and photovoltaic module
abstract_en: The application relates to a connecting corner connector and a photovoltaic module. The connecting corner connector is used for connecting a first photovoltaic frame and a second photovoltaic frame, wherein the first photovoltaic frame and the second photovoltaic frame are vertically arranged, the connecting corner connector comprises a first connecting sleeve and a clamping portion, the first connecting sleeve is used for being connected with a port of the first photovoltaic frame in an inserting mode, the clamping portion extends along the extending direction of the second photovoltaic frame, a first port of the first connecting sleeve is connected with the clamping portion, a first sealing cover is arranged on a second port of the first connecting sleeve, the connecting corner connector further comprises a second connecting sleeve, the second connecting sleeve is used for being connected with second light Fu Biankuang in an inserting mode, the clamping portion is inserted into the second connecting sleeve through a first port of the second connecting sleeve and is connected with the second connecting sleeve in a clamping mode, and a second sealing cover is arranged on a second port of the second connecting sleeve. The connecting corner connector can realize the fixed connection of the first photovoltaic frame and the second photovoltaic frame of the photovoltaic module, and can improve the sealing performance of the photovoltaic module.

title_en: Electronic expansion valve
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electronic expansion valve, which comprises a main body assembly and a connecting assembly, wherein the main body assembly comprises a valve body and a locking piece, the locking piece is arranged at the bottom of the surface of the valve body, the connecting assembly comprises a mounting piece and an inserting piece, the mounting piece is arranged at the bottom of the surface of the valve body, the inserting piece is arranged at the top of the mounting piece, the locking piece comprises a connecting shell, a limiting groove and a sealing groove, and the connecting shell is fixedly connected to the bottom of the surface of the valve body. The valve body of the main body assembly has the advantages that the valve body of the main body assembly can accurately control the flow rate of the flowing gas, the valve body can be conveniently installed by workers through the locking piece, meanwhile, the valve body can be protected and shock-resistant, the sealing performance can be improved to a certain extent, the connecting assembly is provided with the installing piece, the workers can conveniently install the plug-in shell at the interface of external equipment, and the workers can conveniently install the valve body by matching the locking piece through the plug-in piece.

title_en: Energy-saving boiler
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of energy-saving boilers and discloses an energy-saving boiler, which comprises a shell, wherein a backfire chamber is fixedly arranged in the shell, a furnace pipe and a smoke pipe are fixedly arranged in the backfire chamber, a cylinder body is fixedly arranged on one side, far away from the furnace pipe, of the backfire chamber, a protective shell is fixedly arranged on one side, far away from the middle point, of a smoke box, and an exhaust pipe is fixedly arranged above the smoke box. According to the utility model, the exhaust pipe is fixedly arranged above the smoke box, when the water in the smoke box is heated, larger hot air is generated, and then the hot air flows into the water storage chamber through the exhaust pipe to heat the water in the water storage chamber, when the water temperature in the water storage chamber reaches a certain temperature, air pressure is generated to press the sealing plug downwards, so that the hot water in the water storage chamber is added into the smoke box, and the condition that more fuel gas is used for burning the smoke box again when cold water is added into the smoke box is prevented, and resources are saved.

title_en: Novel smelting furnace
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of smelting furnaces and discloses a novel smelting furnace, which comprises a base, wherein a connecting column is rotationally connected to the upper part of the base, a fixing box is fixed at one end of the connecting column far away from the base, a smelting furnace is fixed in the fixing box, a discharging pipe is arranged at one side of the smelting furnace, a cover body is arranged at the upper side of the smelting furnace, a sealing device is arranged at one side of the cover body close to the discharging pipe, a rotating shaft is fixed at one side of the fixing box far away from the connecting column, a driving motor I is connected to one end of the rotating shaft, a cleaning device is arranged below the fixing box, and a water spraying device is arranged at one side of the cleaning device.

title_en: Smoke removing device of holding furnace
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a smoke removing device of a heat preservation furnace, which comprises a heat preservation furnace main body, baffle plates, extrusion components, reset components, a spiral air supply pipe, a unidirectional circulation mechanism, an air supply pipe, a mounting shell, an air outlet pipe, an air inlet pipe and an elastic diaphragm, wherein the mounting shell is arranged above the outer part of the heat preservation furnace main body, the air outlet pipe and the air inlet pipe are respectively arranged above and below the outer part of the mounting shell, the baffle plates are arranged on two sides of the inner part of the mounting shell, mounting frames are arranged on two sides between the baffle plates, the elastic diaphragm is arranged in the mounting frames, the extrusion components are arranged between the elastic diaphragm and the mounting shell, the reset components are arranged between the elastic diaphragm and the baffle plates, and the spiral air supply pipe is arranged on the rear side of the outer part of the heat preservation furnace main body. Compared with the prior art, the utility model has the advantages that the unidirectional property and the continuous stability of the flue gas transportation are ensured, the flue gas is cooled as much as possible before the flue gas is scrubbed, and the evaporation of liquid in the gas scrubbing bottle is reduced.

title_en: Photovoltaic flexible support and steel cable supporting unit
abstract_en: The application provides a photovoltaic flexible support and a steel cable supporting unit, which comprises a cable rod and a connecting seat, wherein the cable rod comprises a circular pipe-shaped main body for supporting adjacent steel cables, two ends of the circular pipe-shaped main body are respectively provided with a fixing piece, each fixing piece is provided with an open slot, and in practical application, the connecting seat at least partially stretches into the open slots and is fixedly connected with the fixing pieces through locking pieces, so that the cable rod is connected to the steel cables. In the production process, the tubular main body of the cable rod is not interfered by human, so that the original form is maintained, the structural durability and bending resistance of the cable rod are improved, the service performance is ensured, meanwhile, the production difficulty of the cable rod is effectively reduced, the production yield is improved, the cable rod can be produced in batches, and the energy conservation and the cost reduction of enterprises are effectively promoted.

title_en: Modularized fan coil connection structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fan coil connecting structures, in particular to a modularized fan coil connecting structure. The utility model provides a modularized fan coil connecting structure with a simpler disassembly mode, which comprises a placing frame, a mounting plate, connecting rods and connecting blocks, wherein first mounting plates are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the placing frame, connecting rods are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the top of each first mounting plate, connecting blocks are arranged on the connecting rods, a sliding rod is driven by a pushing sliding block to drive the sliding rod to slide downwards in the connecting blocks, when the sliding block is pushed to slide downwards, the two first rotating rods at the moment can simultaneously rotate inwards and are inclined and rotate to be in a vertical state after the sliding plate is stopped to be in contact with the two first rotating rods, at the moment, the connecting rods on the placing frame are not fixed through the first rotating rods on the connecting blocks, and workers can descend through a crane and drive a fan coil body and the placing frame to descend so as to finish disassembly operation on the fan coil body.

title_en: Heating pipe assembly with slotting structure double-spiral flow guide
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a heating pipe component with a slotting structure and double spiral diversion, which belongs to the technical field of heating pipes and comprises a first mounting seat and a second mounting seat, wherein one side surface, which is close to each other, of each of the first mounting seat and the second mounting seat is fixedly connected with a limiting plate, the outer surfaces of the two limiting plates are fixedly connected with a heating pipeline together, and the equipment of a limiting plate, a sliding ring, a sliding plate, a sliding groove, a circular pipe, a double spiral blade, a diversion groove, a water inlet pipe, a water outlet pipe, a heating pipeline and a temperature sensor can control the flow rate of water, and can enable the flowing water inside the equipment to be smoother, so that the heating effect of the equipment is better, and the arrangement of a clamping block, a protective shell, a mounting plate, a mounting hole, a mounting screw, a first threaded hole, a second threaded hole, a positioning pipe, a positioning hole and a reinforcing plate is convenient for people to fix and disassemble the equipment, and the water inlet pipe and the water outlet pipe are more stable.

title_en: Double straight seam welding device for radiator
abstract_en: The utility model provides a double straight seam welding device for a radiator, which relates to the technical field of radiator processing and comprises a box body, wherein a cold air conveying assembly is fixedly connected to one side of the outer part of the box body, the cold air conveying assembly comprises an air inlet box, one side of the air inlet box is fixedly connected to the box body, an air suction device is arranged at one end, far away from the box body, of the air inlet box, a cold air box is fixedly connected to the top end of the box body, fins are fixedly connected to the inner wall of the cold air box, and a semiconductor refrigerating sheet is fixedly connected to the top end of each fin. According to the utility model, by providing direct and effective air cooling, the cooling efficiency and the welding speed are greatly improved, the whole welding process is further optimized, impurities, particulate matters and harmful gases in the air of the bellows are adsorbed, and when the purifying effect of the activated carbon is poor, the activated carbon of the filter assembly can be replaced, so that the operation is simple and convenient.

title_en: Automatic material distribution system for sintering production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic material distribution system for sintering production, which comprises a storage bin and a shuttle type material distribution vehicle for distributing materials to the storage bin, wherein the shuttle type material distribution vehicle comprises an adhesive tape conveyor and a traveling trolley, the traveling trolley comprises a driven wheel, a meter, a radar level gauge and a PLC (programmable logic controller), the meter comprises a wheel body, the wheel body is in rolling connection with the driven wheel, the radar level gauge is arranged above the storage bin and is used for detecting the material level of the storage bin, the radar level gauge is in communication connection with the PLC, and the meter is in communication connection with the PLC. The system is deployed, an operator changes a squatting type into a patrol type, only needs to check the running condition of equipment on site regularly, improves the distribution efficiency and reduces the labor intensity.

title_en: Anion module capable of monitoring release concentration and anion equipment comprising same
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of air purification and discloses an anion module capable of monitoring release concentration and anion equipment comprising the same, wherein the anion module capable of monitoring release concentration comprises an anion generator, an anion releaser, a releaser cleaning device and an anion release concentration monitoring device, the anion generator is in communication connection with the anion releaser, the releaser cleaning device comprises a cleaning driving device and a cleaning piece which are in transmission connection, the cleaning piece corresponds to the release end position of the anion releaser, the anion release concentration monitoring device comprises a display screen, the display screen is in communication connection with the anion releaser, and the display screen is used for displaying the concentration of anions released by the anion releaser. The negative ion module has the beneficial effects that the negative ion module can help a user to intuitively feel the effect of the negative ion module, and the negative ion module can be prevented from generating ozone so as not to negatively influence the human body.

title_en: Novel high-speed heat accumulation formula melts aluminium stove
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of aluminum melting furnaces, in particular to a novel high-speed heat accumulating type aluminum melting furnace which comprises an aluminum melting furnace body and a processing assembly, wherein the processing assembly comprises a conveying mechanism, a crushing box, a feeding pipe, two crushing rollers and two motors, the conveying mechanism is arranged at the top of the aluminum melting furnace body, the crushing box is arranged at the top of the conveying mechanism, the feeding pipe is fixedly connected and communicated with the crushing box, the two crushing rollers are respectively fixedly connected with the crushing box, aluminum alloy is added into the crushing box through the feeding pipe, the two motors are started to drive the two crushing rollers to rotate, a plurality of crushing teeth are arranged on the surface of each crushing roller, the aluminum alloy is crushed between the two crushing rollers, the crushed aluminum alloy enters the conveying mechanism, and the aluminum alloy is conveyed into the aluminum melting furnace body through the conveying mechanism to be melted.

title_en: Furnace door opening and closing device, reaction furnace and reaction furnace system
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to the technical field of photovoltaics or semiconductors, in particular to a furnace door opening and closing device, a reaction furnace and a reaction furnace system, which solve the problem that the sealing surface of a furnace door is easy to be polluted due to the large moving range of the related furnace door, so that the sealing performance between the furnace door and a cavity is poor. The furnace door opening and closing device comprises a first driving component, a first connecting piece, a second connecting piece and a third connecting piece, wherein the first driving component is fixedly arranged relative to the cavity and is connected with the first connecting piece, the first connecting piece is in sliding connection with the cavity, the second connecting piece is in sliding connection with the furnace door, and the third connecting piece is respectively and rotatably connected with the first connecting piece and the second connecting piece. The first driving component drives the first connecting piece to slide relative to the cavity and drives the second connecting piece to slide relative to the furnace door, so that the furnace door can turn over relative to the cavity to cover or open the furnace mouth, the moving range of the furnace door is small, the sealing surface of the furnace door and the sealing ring of the cavity are not easy to be polluted, and the sealing performance of the furnace door and the cavity is good.

title_en: Movable comprehensive energy emergency heating device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a movable comprehensive energy emergency heating device which comprises a heating vehicle body, wherein a carriage is arranged on the heating vehicle body, and the movable comprehensive energy emergency heating device further comprises a heating box body, an alternating current heating component, a direct current heating component, a natural gas heating box, a natural gas tank, a water supplementing box, a camera, a protective door and a protective plate. This emergent heating device of movable comprehensive energy is convenient for remove emergent heat supply through the cooperation of heating vehicle body, carriage, heating box, alternating current heating component, direct current heating component, natural gas heating cabinet, natural gas tank and moisturizing box etc. and is convenient for overhaul carriage inside through the cooperation of camera, guard gate and guard plate etc. simultaneously to improve emergent heat supply effect.

title_en: Redundant ignition control device of roasting furnace combustion station
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of roasting furnaces, and particularly discloses a redundant ignition control device for a roasting furnace combustion station, which is characterized by comprising a power supply system, a control assembly, a dew point test assembly, an ignition assembly, a manual button and an ignition relay KA1, wherein the control assembly comprises an automatic control switch and a counter connected with the automatic control switch in series, the other end of the automatic control switch and the manual button are connected with the power supply system, the dew point test assembly is in communication connection with the control assembly, the other end of the automatic control switch and the other end of the manual button are connected with the ignition relay KA1, and a normally open contact of the ignition relay KA1 is electrically connected with the power supply system and the ignition assembly. The redundant ignition control device for the roasting furnace combustion station has two control modes of manual control and automatic control, the water content of coal gas is detected through the dew point test assembly, and the on time of the automatic control switch is controlled, so that the ignition success rate is ensured, and the working efficiency of on-site operation is improved.

title_en: Heat insulation structure with ceramic nanofiber
abstract_en: The application discloses a heat insulation structure with ceramic nanofibers, which comprises a furnace body, wherein the heat insulation structure comprises an outer layer heat insulation brick and an inner layer heat insulation brick, the outer layer heat insulation brick and the inner layer heat insulation brick are arranged on the inner side of the furnace body, a gap is reserved between the outer layer heat insulation brick and the furnace body to form a first cavity, the outer layer heat insulation brick and the furnace body are connected through a plurality of groups of fixing components, a gap is reserved between the outer layer heat insulation brick and the inner layer heat insulation brick to form a second cavity, and the outer layer heat insulation brick and the inner layer heat insulation brick are connected through a plurality of connecting columns. According to the application, the heat insulation layers formed by the two layers of heat insulation bricks are separated to form a cavity with a gap, so that heat conduction is reduced, and the heat insulation performance is improved by covering the surface of the heat insulation bricks with the ceramic refractory fiber blanket.

title_en: Antifreezing device for cooling tower
abstract_en: The utility model discloses anti-freezing equipment for a cooling tower, and relates to the technical field of industrial equipment. The solar heat collection device comprises a cooling tower body, wherein the top of the cooling tower body is communicated with a ventilation pipe, a circulation pipeline is arranged in the cooling tower body, the top of the cooling tower is provided with a heat collection assembly, the heat collection assembly comprises a support plate, the top of the support plate is fixedly connected with a water tank, the top of the water tank is provided with a solar heat absorption plate, and one side of the solar heat absorption plate is communicated with a conveying pump. According to the utility model, solar energy can be collected and utilized through the arrangement of the heat collecting assembly, the solar heat absorbing plate is used for preheating water in the water tank, when the temperature in the cooling tower reaches a freezing point, the hot water can be sprayed to the circulating pipeline through the spraying pipe, the temperature of the circulating pipeline is increased, the circulating pipeline is kept in a circulating state, the effect of preheating the cooling tower body is achieved, and then equipment in the cooling tower is started to operate, so that the anti-freezing effect is improved.

title_en: Phase change cold plate based on penetration friction welding
abstract_en: The application provides a phase change cold plate based on penetration friction welding, which comprises a box body, a cover plate and a phase change laminate, wherein a sinking groove structure is arranged in the box body, a lapping step is arranged on the inner wall of the sinking groove structure, a plurality of reinforcing ribs are arranged at the bottom of the sinking groove structure, the sinking groove structure is divided into a plurality of unit cavities by the reinforcing ribs, the phase change laminate comprises a plurality of phase change blocks, each phase change block is arranged in each unit cavity, a reinforcing rib is arranged at the upper end of the reinforcing rib, a plurality of upper grooves are arranged on the lower end face of the cover plate, the edges of the cover plate are placed on the lapping step, and the reinforcing ribs are inserted into the upper grooves, so that the problems that the center of the cold plate is easy to deform due to stress and the structural strength is low when only welding joints are traditional.

title_en: Fume exhaust fan
abstract_en: The utility model provides a range hood, which comprises a first air inlet and a second air inlet, wherein the second air inlet is positioned above the first air inlet along the projection direction of a cooker, a first smoke baffle plate is arranged on the first air inlet, a second smoke baffle plate is arranged on the second air inlet, the first smoke baffle plate and the second smoke baffle plate can seal or open the first air inlet and the second air inlet, a flow guide area is formed between the first smoke baffle plate and the first air inlet and/or between the second smoke baffle plate and the second air inlet when the first smoke baffle plate is opened and/or between the second smoke baffle plate and the second air inlet and is positioned in the projection direction of the cooker, the range hood further comprises a range sensor used for detecting the height of the cooker, and a driving mechanism is respectively arranged between the first air inlet and the first smoke baffle plate and between the second air inlet and the second smoke baffle plate and is electrically connected with a control board. So as to improve the effect of absorbing the oil smoke and avoid the interference of the cooker and the smoke baffle of the range hood.

title_en: Self-cleaning heat exchange assembly and refrigerator
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of refrigeration equipment, and discloses a self-cleaning heat exchange assembly and a refrigerator. The self-cleaning heat exchange assembly comprises a first heat exchange tube, a second heat exchange tube, a plurality of heat dissipation pieces and ventilation equipment. The second heat exchange tube is arranged opposite to the first heat exchange tube, and the second heat exchange tube is arranged at intervals with the first heat exchange tube. The heat dissipation elements are arranged on the first heat exchange tube and the second heat exchange tube in a staggered mode. The ventilation device and the second heat exchange tube are respectively positioned at two opposite sides of the first heat exchange tube. Wherein the ventilation device is switchable between an induced draft state and a blown state to clean the heat sink. The application can improve the cleaning effect of the radiating piece, can improve the heat exchange efficiency, has simple structure and reduces the cost.

title_en: Wind power wide-distribution type air-cooled soil roadbed
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of frozen soil engineering, in particular to a wind-power wide-distribution type air-cooled soil roadbed, which comprises an air-cooling regulation and control unit, an air-power unit and an automatic temperature control air door, wherein the air-cooling regulation and control unit comprises a phase-change heat-exchange cold accumulation body, an air-cooling box body, an air discharge channel and an air circulation channel, a plurality of phase-change heat-exchange cold accumulation bodies are uniformly distributed in the air-cooling box body at intervals, a plurality of air circulation channels which are parallel and are arranged at intervals and extend to the outer side of the air-cooling box body are arranged among the plurality of phase-change heat-exchange cold accumulation bodies, two adjacent air circulation channels on the inner side of the air-cooling box body are distributed in a staggered manner, and a plurality of air holes which are internally and externally communicated are formed in one end side wall of each air circulation channel in the air-cooling box body.

title_en: Slag dragging machine of smelting furnace convenient to adjust
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a slag dragging machine of a smelting furnace, which is convenient to adjust, and the slag dragging machine comprises a bottom plate, wherein the bottom plate is arranged on the top surface of the smelting furnace, the top surface of the bottom plate is symmetrically provided with fixing rings, the two fixing rings are both rotationally connected with a sleeve, the sleeve is rotationally connected with a conveying pipe, and one end of the conveying pipe is connected with the upper end of a discharging pipe. According to the slag dragging device, the sleeve is driven to rotate through the transmission mechanism, the annular connecting plate and the slag dragging mechanism are driven to rotate through the sleeve to drag waste in the smelting furnace, meanwhile, the motor drives the spiral conveying rod to rotate through the transmission shaft to convey the waste into the discharge pipe to be discharged, when the slag dragging mechanism rotates, the second filter screen moves downwards in the groove under the influence of gravity until the second filter screen reaches the maximum moving distance or contacts with the bottom of the smelting furnace, so that the length of the slag dragging mechanism is adjusted, the slag dragging machine can drag the waste at the bottom of the smelting furnace, and the slag dragging efficiency of the slag dragging machine is improved.

title_en: Corrosion-resistant and wear-resistant boiler water-cooled wall structure
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of boiler transformation, and relates to a corrosion-resistant and wear-resistant boiler water wall structure, which comprises a water wall pipe body, an adherence air nozzle unit and a hot secondary air pipe, wherein the adherence air nozzle unit comprises a plurality of adherence air nozzles, a plurality of adherence air nozzles are distributed on the side wall of the water wall pipe body from top to bottom in a multi-layer reverse triangle structure, corrosion-resistant and wear-resistant composite coatings are sprayed on the water wall pipe body in the surrounding area of the adherence air nozzle unit, and the hot secondary air pipe is arranged outside the water wall pipe body and is communicated with the adherence air nozzle unit. According to the utility model, by designing the plurality of adherence air nozzles, hot secondary air is introduced into the water wall pipe body, so that the abrasion-proof effect of the water wall is greatly improved, and meanwhile, the corrosion-proof and abrasion-proof composite coating is sprayed on the water wall pipe body around the adherence air nozzles, so that the adaptability to high-sulfur coal is improved, and the corrosion resistance is enhanced.

title_en: Combustor and cooking utensil
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a burner and a cooking utensil, the burner includes a first body, a second body, and a second blocking structure. The first body and the second body surround to form and hold chamber and a plurality of fire hole, hold the chamber and including the portion of admitting air and the annular portion that the intercommunication set up, the portion of admitting air is used for with gas pipeline intercommunication, and a plurality of fire holes set up along predetermineeing the direction interval, and set up in the radial inboard of annular portion and communicate with annular portion respectively, a plurality of fire holes are used for the blowout of gas. The second blocking structure is arranged in the annular part and forms a flow limiting channel for communicating the annular part with the plurality of fire holes, the second blocking structure is provided with a first end and a second end which are arranged in an extending mode along a preset direction, and the first end and the second end are respectively arranged on two opposite sides of the intersection of the air inlet part and the annular part. According to the burner disclosed by the utility model, the second blocking structure is arranged, so that the gas output flow rate of the fire holes at the junction of the air inlet part and the annular part is reduced, and the output flow rate of each fire hole on the annular part is uniform.

title_en: Electromagnetic stove
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of household appliances and discloses an electromagnetic oven which comprises an oven body, wherein the oven body comprises an upper panel and an electromagnetic coil for heating a pot, the electromagnetic coil is arranged below the upper panel, the electromagnetic oven further comprises a heat insulation support, the upper panel corresponds to the electromagnetic coil to form a heating zone, the heat insulation support is arranged in the heating zone in a detachable manner and is used for bearing the pot, a wireless temperature detection assembly is arranged on the heat insulation support and comprises an energy receiving coil, a temperature detection sensor and a wireless communication module which are electrically connected with each other, the detection end of the temperature detection sensor is tightly attached to the pot, and the horizontal projection of the energy receiving coil is positioned in the horizontal projection range of the electromagnetic coil so that the electromagnetic coil can charge the energy receiving coil. The technical scheme can prevent the pot from being scalded by high temperature and ensure accurate temperature detection of the pot while the internal components of the upper panel are scalded.

title_en: Multifunctional swimming pool heat pump unit and constant temperature unit
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of swimming pool heat pumps, and discloses a multifunctional swimming pool heat pump unit and a constant temperature unit, the device comprises a compressor, a first reversing valve, a second reversing valve, a third reversing valve, an outdoor heat exchanger, a first heat exchanger, a dehumidifying heat exchanger and a pool heat exchanger. On the premise of not changing the number of the heat exchangers, the heating mode is added. The unit has the functions of dehumidification, swimming pool water heating, refrigeration and heating, and the occupied area of the unit is not increased due to the fact that one function is added.

title_en: Energy-saving stove core of gas stove
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an energy-saving stove core of a gas stove, which comprises a stove shell and a columnar bulge integrally formed at the central position of the bottom end of the stove shell, wherein an air inlet joint is fixed in the columnar bulge, an air inlet main pipe is fixed at the central position of the top end of the columnar bulge, a stove head is arranged at the top end of the air inlet main pipe, an upper sealing cover is fixed on the peripheral surface of the stove head, the bottom end of the upper sealing cover is fixedly connected with the top end of the stove shell, a plurality of pot foot supports are slidably arranged at the outer edge of the top end of the stove shell, and the top wall of each pot foot support is higher than the top surface of the upper sealing cover. According to the utility model, the single pot foot support does not need additional connecting pieces and components, the connection is firmer, potential safety hazards such as shaking and loosening which possibly occur in a split structure are avoided, unexpected situations are not easy to occur, the use safety of a user is improved, the pot foot support is not contacted with a cooking bench in the process, the occupation of additional cooking bench space is not increased, and the whole layout of a kitchen is more flexible.

title_en: Heat exchanger assembly and energy storage system
abstract_en: The application discloses a heat exchanger component and an energy storage system, wherein the heat exchanger component comprises a shell, a fan and a core component, wherein the shell is provided with a containing cavity, the shell is provided with an air outlet and an air inlet, the fan is arranged at the air outlet and is used for discharging gas in the containing cavity, the core component is arranged in the containing cavity and is adjustable in position, one side surface of the core component opposite to the air inlet is a main radiating surface, and an included angle between the main radiating surface and the air inlet direction of the air inlet is adjustable. From this, through adjusting the contained angle between main cooling surface and the air intake department air inlet direction, can adjust main cooling surface and the just to the area of air intake to can be according to the position control of heat transfer demand to the core subassembly, realize promoting the heat transfer energy efficiency of heat exchanger subassembly.

title_en: Auxiliary positioning device of sintering mold
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an auxiliary positioning device of a sintering mold, which belongs to the technical field of auxiliary positioning devices and comprises a first supporting rod and a second supporting rod which are matched with supporting rods in a sintering furnace, wherein a supporting transverse plate is arranged on the top of the first supporting rod and the top of the second supporting rod, a first supporting vertical plate and a second supporting vertical plate are arranged on the supporting transverse plate, through holes are formed in the first supporting vertical plate and the second supporting vertical plate, a cylindrical adjusting rod is arranged in the through holes in a penetrating mode, the cylindrical adjusting rod can rotate in the through holes, and an end limiting rod which is in contact with the rear side of the mold is arranged on the side wall of the adjusting rod. The adjusting rod is arranged to limit the right side of the sintering die, the end limiting rod is arranged to limit the rear side of the die until the sintering die is successfully aligned and installed, the adjusting rod can be rotated, and after the sintering die is installed, the adjusting rod is rotated to enable the end limiting rod to be erected, so that the whole device is conveniently taken out.

title_en: Heat exchange system capable of being quickly disassembled, assembled and maintained
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a heat exchange system capable of being quickly assembled, disassembled and maintained, which comprises a heat exchange system, wherein the heat exchange system comprises a heat exchanger mounting frame, a heat exchanger unit and a heat exchanger door positioned outside the heat exchanger unit, the heat exchanger unit sequentially comprises an upper heat exchanger and a lower heat exchanger from top to bottom, the heat exchanger mounting frame comprises a left fixing frame and a right fixing frame, and an upper guide assembly and a lower guide assembly which are distributed along the front-rear direction are sequentially arranged on the left fixing frame and the right fixing frame from top to bottom. The utility model designs a heat exchanger into a large part and a small part, which is suitable for a heat exchange system which has barriers outside the equipment and is inconvenient to assemble and disassemble.

title_en: Fresh air system suitable for dining room
abstract_en: The application relates to a fresh air system suitable for a canteen, and relates to the technical field of ventilation systems, which comprises a plurality of ventilation pipes arranged on a house body, wherein an exhaust fan and a primary filter screen are arranged on one side, close to the outside of the house body, of each ventilation pipe, honeycomb activated carbon blocks are arranged on one side, close to the inside of the house body, of each ventilation pipe, a limiting component used for limiting the position of each honeycomb activated carbon block in each ventilation pipe is arranged in each ventilation pipe, an access hole is formed in each ventilation pipe, and a blocking plate and a fixing component used for fixedly connecting the blocking plate on each access hole are arranged at each access hole. The application has the effect of reducing the influence of viscous oil smoke pollutants on the ventilation system of the canteen.

title_en: Tube plate type air preheater
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tube plate type air preheater, which belongs to the technical field of preheaters and comprises two support plates, wherein an upper tube plate and a lower tube plate are fixedly connected between the two support plates, a plurality of smoke tubes are arranged between the two support plates, two ends of each smoke tube are fixedly connected with the upper tube plate and the lower tube plate respectively, two sleeves are connected with the outer part of each smoke tube in a rotating manner and are respectively connected with the lower tube plate and the upper tube plate in a rotating manner, a plurality of scraping strips are detachably connected between the two sleeves and positioned in the smoke tube and are attached to the inner wall of the smoke tube in a sliding manner, a plurality of driving mechanisms are arranged on the lower tube plate and are in one-to-one correspondence with the plurality of smoke tubes, and the driving mechanisms are in transmission connection with the plurality of sleeves positioned on the same smoke tube. The utility model can realize online ash removal, is convenient to operate, thereby improving heat exchange efficiency and reducing exhaust temperature, and the sleeve is detachably connected with the scraping strip, so that the scraping strip is convenient to replace when damaged.

title_en: Water-cooled furnace cover
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a water-cooling furnace cover, which comprises a furnace cover, a conical ring plate, a furnace door frame, slag hanging nails, a furnace door, a furnace cover body, a flange, a lifting lug seat, reinforcing ribs, a water inlet and return distributor, lifting lugs, metal hoses and a leakage-proof welding layer, wherein the conical ring plate is arranged on one side of the furnace cover, one side of the conical ring plate is connected with the metal hoses, the flange is arranged on the lower side of the furnace cover body, the furnace door frame is arranged on the outer side of the metal hoses, the furnace door is arranged on the furnace door frame, the metal hoses are communicated with the water inlet and return distributor and are used for connecting cooling water loops, the reinforcing ribs are connected between the metal hoses at different positions, the strength of the water inlet and return distributor is ensured, the leakage-proof welding layer is arranged between the metal hoses, the slag hanging nails are arranged on the inner sides of the metal hoses, and the lifting lug seat is arranged on the metal hoses and is used for hoisting the water-cooling furnace cover. The utility model solves the problem of leakage of cooling water caused by metal corrosion and thermal stress in the water-cooling furnace cover in the prior art.

title_en: Shuttle kiln waste heat recycling system
abstract_en: The application relates to a shuttle kiln waste heat recycling system, which belongs to the technical field of ceramic production equipment and comprises a shuttle kiln, a smoke exhaust pipeline, a gas-gas heat exchanger and a gas-water heat exchanger, wherein the smoke exhaust pipeline is communicated with the shuttle kiln, the gas-gas heat exchanger and the gas-water heat exchanger are sequentially arranged on the smoke exhaust pipeline and are communicated with the smoke exhaust pipeline, the gas-gas heat exchanger is connected with a combustion-supporting gas heating pipeline, and the gas-water heat exchanger is connected with a water heating pipeline. The application can solve the technical problem that the waste of energy can be caused by directly discharging a great amount of heat in the flue gas which is generated when the shuttle kiln burns the product into the atmosphere.

title_en: Tube array heat exchanger
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tubular heat exchanger which comprises a base, a heat exchanger main body and clamping fixing assemblies, wherein fixing frames are arranged on two sides of the upper end of the base, a bracket is rotatably arranged in the middle of the base, the heat exchanger main body is arranged on the bracket and is positioned in the fixing frames, the clamping fixing assemblies are arranged on the fixing frames, the left end and the right end of the heat exchanger main body are respectively and hermetically sleeved with end covers, the end covers and the heat exchanger main body are fixed by the clamping fixing assemblies, and the clamping fixing assemblies comprise bidirectional screw rods, a forward-reverse rotating motor and a fixing clamping frame. The utility model relates to the technical field of heat exchangers, in particular to a tubular heat exchanger which is good in fixing effect and convenient to disassemble and assemble.

title_en: Radiator convenient to change and overhaul
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of radiators and discloses a radiator convenient to replace and overhaul, which comprises a radiating body, wherein a plurality of placing grooves are formed in the side wall of the radiating body along the length direction of the radiating body, positioning grooves are formed in the inner side wall of the placing grooves along the length direction of the radiating body, limiting grooves are formed in the inner side wall of the placing grooves along the width direction of the placing grooves, a radiating piece comprises a radiating plate arranged in the placing grooves and radiating fins arranged on the radiating plate, one side, far away from the radiating fins, of the radiating plate is provided with a mounting block, the mounting block is in plug-in fit with the positioning grooves, the mounting block is in sliding fit with the limiting grooves, and the limiting piece comprises a first limiting unit and a second limiting unit which are arranged on the inner wall of the placing grooves. The application has the effect of facilitating the replacement of the fins.

title_en: Novel ceramic kiln ignition gun
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of ceramic kilns, and particularly relates to a novel ceramic kiln ignition gun which comprises a gun barrel, wherein an installation plate is arranged outside the gun barrel, an installation hole is formed in the surface of the installation plate, a partition plate is arranged inside the gun barrel, a through hole is formed in the middle of the partition plate, a first sliding groove is formed in the surface of the partition plate, a second sliding groove is formed in one side of the through hole, a sliding block is arranged inside the first sliding groove, a main body is arranged on one side of the gun barrel, a nozzle is arranged on one side of the gun barrel, a filtering mechanism is arranged on the surface of the sliding block, and the main body comprises an air inlet pipe, a heat insulation sleeve, an oil rod, an atomizing head and an ignition electrode. According to the utility model, the oil rod, the atomizing head, the ignition electrode and the air inlet pipe are adopted to realize automatic ignition of the ignition gun under the action of the conventional fan, the firepower can be conveniently controlled, and meanwhile, the impurity in the gas and the fuel are prevented from being mixed and burned to cause sintering blockage on the nozzle under the action of the filtering mechanism, so that the use effect of the ignition gun is ensured.

title_en: Pot support and kitchen range
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pot support and a stove, and relates to the technical field of stoves, wherein the pot support comprises a first support, a second support and an upper support, a central hole is formed in the first support in a surrounding mode, the top of the second support is arranged around the central hole and is positioned on one side, close to the central hole, of the top of the first support, the upper support is used for supporting a piece to be heated and comprises a first support and a second support, the first support is arranged on the top of the first support, the second support comprises an upper bearing part arranged on the top of the second support, the top surface of the upper bearing part is not higher than the top surface of the first support, and the inner edge of a projection area formed by orthographic projection of the upper bearing part towards the plane where the central hole is positioned in the central hole. The technical scheme provided by the utility model can improve the heat efficiency of the cooker when the cooker support supports small-size cookers.

title_en: Scour-resistant full ceramic fiber furnace lining structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a scour-resistant all-ceramic fiber furnace lining structure which comprises a steel plate and ceramic fiber sheets, wherein a plurality of ceramic fiber sheets are arranged on the front side of the steel plate, the ceramic fiber sheets are bundled and fixed together through a bundling belt, a plurality of fixing rods are arranged at the front end of the steel plate at equal intervals, sleeves are fixedly arranged among the ceramic fiber sheets, clamping blocks are arranged on the outer walls of the upper end and the lower end of the outer wall of each fixing rod, sliding grooves are arranged on the upper end and the lower end of the inner wall of the front end of each sleeve, protruding blocks are arranged on the inner walls of the two sliding grooves, the sleeves are sleeved on the outer walls of the fixing rods and are fixed through the protruding blocks, the bundled ceramic fiber sheets can be prevented from falling off by fixing the ceramic fiber sheets in the mode, the service life of a furnace kiln can be greatly prolonged, the frequency of replacement and maintenance is reduced, the maintenance cost is reduced, the ceramic fiber sheets are prevented from falling off, exposure of high-temperature components can be avoided, the safety risk is reduced, and the occurrence probability of accidents is reduced.

title_en: Cleaning device of rotating wheel type heat exchanger
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a cleaning device of a rotating wheel type heat exchanger, which is characterized by comprising a machine table, wherein a rack is arranged on the machine table, a hydraulic cylinder is arranged on the rack, an installation seat is arranged at the output end of the hydraulic cylinder, a plurality of connecting frames are arranged on the installation seat and are uniformly distributed according to the circumference, the connecting frames can move along the radial direction, a brush roller is rotationally connected to the connecting frames, a rotating motor is arranged on one side of the connecting frames and is used for driving the brush roller to rotate, a placing seat is arranged below the brush roller, a fan-shaped placing groove matched with a fan-shaped wheel core is arranged on the placing seat, a plurality of fan-shaped placing grooves are uniformly distributed according to the circumference, a driving mechanism is arranged on the installation seat and is used for driving each connecting frame to synchronously move so that the brush roller covers the fan-shaped placing groove, and cleaning of the surface of the fan-shaped wheel core is completed. The utility model has the advantages that a plurality of fan-shaped wheel cores can be cleaned at the same time, and the cleaning efficiency of the whole wheel core is improved.

title_en: Zinc plate with high heat conduction structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of zinc plates and discloses a zinc plate with a high heat conduction structure, which comprises a main body mechanism and a heat radiation protection mechanism, wherein the heat radiation protection mechanism is positioned above the main body mechanism, the main body mechanism comprises a zinc plate body, an installation support plate and a disassembly and assembly component, the installation support plate is movably installed at the rear end of the zinc plate body, the disassembly and assembly component is positioned in front of the installation support plate, the disassembly and assembly component comprises a limiting chute and a manual rotary table, the limiting chute is fixedly arranged at the front end of the installation support plate, and the manual rotary table is movably installed at the upper end of the installation support plate. According to the zinc plate with the high heat conduction structure, the installation and disassembly capabilities of the main body mechanism are improved, the heat conduction plate and the zinc plate body can be conveniently installed according to the use requirement in the actual use process, the heat conduction plate is convenient to disassemble, and the use convenience of the zinc plate with the high heat conduction structure is improved.

title_en: Steel corner connector for high-adaptability photovoltaic frame
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a steel corner connector for a high-adaptability photovoltaic frame, which consists of two corner connectors perpendicular to each other, wherein the middle part of each corner connector is provided with a bulge formed by inwards bending, the outer end of each corner connector is provided with a rebound part, the rebound part comprises a first folded edge formed by inwards bending the free end at the outer side of each corner connector, a second folded edge formed by inwards bending the free end of each first folded edge and a third folded edge formed by inwards bending the free end of each second folded edge, and the vertical distance between the joint point between each corner connector and each first folded edge and the joint point between each second folded edge and each third folded edge is consistent with the distance between the outer side inner wall surface of the frame and a rectangular hole of the installation corner connector arranged on the inner side inner wall surface of the frame. According to the utility model, the protruding part is arranged on the corner brace edge, so that friction damage generated between the corner brace edge and the inner side surface of the frame can be reduced, the rebound part can realize rapid installation and locking of the steel corner brace, and high-strength stable matching connection between the steel corner brace and the photovoltaic frame is ensured.

title_en: Cabinet air conditioner
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cabinet air conditioner which comprises a machine shell, an air duct piece, a plurality of transverse air deflectors and a driving device, wherein the driving device comprises a driving motor and a linkage rod, one end of the linkage rod is in transmission connection with the driving motor, the first transverse air deflector is provided with a first connecting part and a second connecting part, the first connecting part is in transmission connection with the linkage rod, the second connecting part is rotatably connected with the air duct piece, the second transverse air deflector is arranged on the lower side of the first transverse air deflector and is provided with a third connecting part and a fourth connecting part, the third connecting part is in transmission connection with the linkage rod, the fourth connecting part is rotatably connected with the air duct piece, and the second connecting part is positioned right above the fourth connecting part and is arranged in a dislocation mode in the horizontal direction. The cabinet air conditioner can realize asynchronous rotation of the first transverse air deflector and the second transverse air deflector, and has better lower anti-direct blowing effect during refrigeration.

title_en: Inducer and radiator integrated machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an inducer and radiator integrated machine, which relates to the technical field of air conditioning. The indoor air can be induced to enter the induced heat exchange cavity by primary air to be cooled/heated through the heat exchange coil, or enter the induced heat exchange cavity by natural convection to be heated by the heat exchange coil, and the indoor air can also enter the natural convection heat exchange cavity by natural convection to be heated by the heat exchange component. The utility model combines the functions of the inducer and the radiator together, can adopt cold air for cooling in summer and hot air for heating in winter, and can also adopt radiation and convection modes for heating by the variable body radiator, thereby improving the comfort of heating.

title_en: Closed tower with self-cleaning structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of closed cooling towers and discloses a closed tower with a self-cleaning structure, which comprises a tower body, wherein a water tank is fixedly connected to the bottom of the inner wall of the tower body, a funnel is connected to a water inlet of the water tank, the side edge of the funnel is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the tower body, a filter screen is fixedly connected to the inside of the water tank, a motor is fixedly connected to one side of the tower body, an output end of the motor is fixedly connected with a push rod penetrating through the tower body and the water tank, one end of the push rod is fixedly connected with a fixing plate, a cleaning brush is arranged on one side of the fixing plate, which is close to a water outlet of the funnel, of the fixing plate, and a cleaning brush is arranged on one side of the fixing plate, which is close to the water outlet of the funnel. According to the utility model, the push rod is driven by the operation of the motor so as to drive the fixed plate to perform front-back linear motion, the service life of the spraying system is prolonged, and the air is sent into the box body from the air inlet pipe, so that the air cooling efficiency is effectively prevented from being influenced in rainy and snowy days while the air is cooled.

title_en: Electric flame stove burner convenient to maintain
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electric flame stove burner convenient to maintain, which comprises a burner top plate, a burner bottom shell and a plurality of electrode assemblies, wherein the burner top plate and the burner bottom shell are enclosed to form a burner cavity, a plurality of mounting holes corresponding to the electrode assemblies are formed in the burner top plate, threads are preset on the extended edges of the mounting holes in the burner top plate, the electrode assemblies comprise a fire spraying pipe, electrode needles and ceramic pipes, threads are preset at the lower end of the fire spraying pipe, and the lower end of the fire spraying pipe is fixedly connected with the corresponding mounting holes through the threads. The fire tube is fixed on the top plate of the furnace end through threads, if the electrode needle loosens, a user can unscrew the fire tube, further tightly clamp the loosened electrode needle, and then restore the fire tube to the original position. Compared with the prior art, the utility model has the advantages that the electrode needle is loose, the maintenance is simple and convenient, and the complicated steps of disassembling and installing the furnace end are reduced.

title_en: Electric control plate protection cover and water heater comprising same
abstract_en: The utility model provides an electric control plate protection cover and a water heater comprising the same. The electric control board protection cover is used for protecting an electric control assembly inside the water heater and comprises a first water blocking piece and a heat radiating piece. By enabling the heat sink to cover at least part of at least one side of the electrical control assembly, rain water inside the water heater near the electrical control assembly can be blocked, reducing the likelihood of electrical shorting or breakdown. The first water blocking piece is connected to the top of the heat radiating piece and protrudes out of the heat radiating piece in the direction away from the electric control component in the horizontal direction, rainwater entering the water heater from the upper side can be further blocked, infiltration from the heat radiating opening is avoided, the electric control component is protected, and meanwhile the possibility that the inserting port is infiltrated by water is reduced.

title_en: Passenger-receiving pavilion
abstract_en: The utility model provides a passenger-receiving type pavilion, which relates to the technical field of pavilions and comprises a bottom plate, wherein an upright post is arranged at the top end of the bottom plate, a lamp body is arranged on the surface of the upright post, a top plate is arranged at the top end of the upright post, a windproof rolling curtain is arranged at the bottom end of the top plate, a top canopy frame is arranged at the top end of the top plate, a ceiling plate is arranged at the top end of the top canopy frame, better use effect is achieved, and the uniform distribution of the upright posts and the design of the ceiling frame optimize the bearing and space utilization, and meanwhile, the overall stability and visual aesthetic feeling are improved. The symmetrical distribution of the lamp body and the uniform arrangement of the windproof roller shutters enhance the safety and convenience of night use, and simultaneously improve the protection capability for severe weather. The rotary connection of the frame A and the window body and the sliding connection of the frame B and the sliding door further improve the convenience of operation and the flexibility of space. The improvements combine to provide a guest-meeting kiosk with significant improvements in utility, aesthetics, and user experience.

title_en: Graphite electrode cooling device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of graphitization furnaces, and particularly relates to a graphite electrode cooling device, which comprises a graphite electrode and a cooling device, wherein the cooling device is connected to two ends of the graphite electrode, the cooling device comprises a cooling box assembly and a cooling pipe, at least two groups of cooling box assemblies are respectively arranged at two ends of the graphite electrode, at least two groups of graphite electrodes are respectively a graphite electrode I and a graphite electrode II, the cooling box assembly comprises a water collecting box and a water outlet box, wherein the water collecting box in one group of cooling box assemblies is arranged at one end of the graphite electrode I, the water outlet box is arranged at one end of the graphite electrode II, the water collecting box in the other group of cooling box assemblies is arranged at one end of the graphite electrode II, the water collecting box and the water outlet box are connected in series in a crossing way through the cooling pipe, so that the circulation time and the circulation length of cooling liquid in an integral passage are prolonged, and the occurrence of safety accidents caused by excessive expansion and bursting of the cooling pipe due to high temperature is prevented.

title_en: Gas jet kitchen ventilator
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of kitchen appliances, in particular to an air jet range hood. The negative pressure gas receiving cover of the device is internally provided with a jet pipe with a closed lower end, an air booster is arranged outside the negative pressure gas receiving cover, the air outlet end of the air booster is connected with an air pressure stabilizing device, the air outlet end of the air pressure stabilizing device is communicated with the inside of the jet pipe through a pipeline, the upper end of the negative pressure gas receiving cover is connected with a diffusion pipe, the upper end of the diffusion pipe is connected with a mixing pipe, the upper end of the mixing pipe is connected with a one-way valve, and the outlet of the upper end of the jet pipe extends into the diffusion pipe. The utility model realizes that negative pressure is generated by jet flow, the negative pressure difference is large, the adsorption force is strong, the efficiency is high, a fan is not adopted, the phenomenon that the rotating blades accumulate heavy oil stains to cause the oil fume adsorption effect is greatly reduced, an exhaust air flow channel is unobstructed, and the workload of cleaning the range hood is greatly reduced.

title_en: Refrigerating type range hood
abstract_en: A refrigerating type range hood comprises a shell, wherein a range hood fan, a compressor, a condenser, an evaporator and an inner machine fan are arranged in the shell, an air channel at the downstream of an air outlet of the range hood fan is divided into a first air channel and a second air channel, a first valve is arranged at the inlet of the first air channel and the inlet of the second air channel, a second valve is arranged at the outlet of the second air channel and the outlet of the second air channel, a third valve moves into the first air channel to close the first air channel, and moves into the second air channel to close the second air channel. According to the refrigeration type range hood, the air duct at the downstream of the air outlet of the range hood is switched between the first air duct and the second air duct through the switching of the valves, the first air duct is opened in a refrigeration mode, the second air duct is opened in a range hood mode, condensed water dripping from the condenser is guided into the range hood channel through the third valve in a condenser water treatment mode, and finally the condensed water is blown into a public flue or flows into an oil cup of the range hood, so that the condensed water is effectively treated.

title_en: Multi-color photovoltaic building integrated assembly
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a colorful photovoltaic building integrated assembly, which comprises an assembly body, wherein the assembly body comprises an upper glass plate, a photovoltaic cell plate and a lower glass plate which are sequentially arranged from top to bottom, the upper surface of the upper glass plate is a matte diffuse reflection surface with anti-dazzle textures and is covered with a nano optical film, through holes are respectively formed in four corners of the assembly body, rubber protection pieces of an integrated structure are arranged in the through holes in a penetrating way, the rubber protection pieces comprise rubber rings which are arranged in the through holes and used for penetrating bolts to realize that the assembly body is fixed on a support piece on the outer side of a building wall through bolts, and annular rubber flanging which is contacted with the outer side of the assembly body and used for realizing soft contact between the assembly body and the support piece and the bolt bolts are respectively arranged at two ends of the rubber rings. The utility model not only can effectively fix the assembly body and prevent the assembly body from falling off and damaging the assembly body, but also can meet the requirements of the existing building industry on the color BIPV assembly.

title_en: Photovoltaic power generation insulation house
abstract_en: The application discloses a photovoltaic power generation heat preservation room, and relates to the technical field of heat preservation rooms. The application provides a photovoltaic power generation heat preservation room, which is provided with a heat preservation cavity, wherein heat storage or heating equipment is arranged in the heat preservation cavity, the shell is provided with a first side wall and a second side wall which are oppositely arranged, and the first side wall and/or the second side wall is/are provided with a first photovoltaic module which is used for supplying power for the heat storage or heating equipment.

title_en: Water-saving counter-flow cooling tower
abstract_en: The application relates to a water-saving counter-flow cooling tower which comprises a tower body, a fan and a filler, wherein a spraying assembly is arranged above the filler, the spraying assembly comprises a water main arranged in the tower body, a plurality of water diversion pipes are arranged on the water main, a rain collecting box is arranged on the outer side wall of the tower body, a filter screen is arranged in the rain collecting box, a water supply pipe communicated with the water main is arranged on the outer side wall of the rain collecting box, a water pump is arranged on the water supply pipe, rainwater flows into the rain collecting box through the filter screen during raining, when the cooling tower needs to be supplemented with water, an operator turns on the water pump, the rainwater in the rain collecting box flows out from a water outlet of the water diversion pipes through the water main, the whole water supplementing process does not depend on tap water resources completely, and the utilization rate of natural water is improved. The application has the effect of saving tap water resources.

title_en: Constant temperature dehumidification air conditioner
